ekegusii: “Omonene abasesenie, abarende;
english: "'"The LORD bless you and keep you;

ekegusii: Enyongo ende yonsi omonto oria omorwaire arakune goika yaatwe, na egekorero kende gionsi keroiseirie omote arakune goika gesibigwe namache.
english: "'A clay pot that the man touches must be broken, and any wooden article is to be rinsed with water.

ekegusii: Oragererigwe omonto oria ogokora emeremo y’Omonene nobworo, na oragererigwe oria ogotanga omoro oye toitera amanyinga.
english: "A curse on him who is lax in doing the LORD's work! A curse on him who keeps his sword from bloodshed!

ekegusii: “Omosani nigo agwenerete kororera omonto bwerusirie moyo amabera, onye taibo, rirorio otigire koiroka Omonguru.
english: "A despairing man should have the devotion of his friends, even though he forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

ekegusii: “Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura embusuro yaye: Ekero akobusura, echinde chikagwa enchera ensemo, chigatiringwa namagoro, chinyoni chia igoro chigachiria.
english: "A farmer went out to sow his seed. As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path; it was trampled on, and the birds of the air ate it up.

ekegusii: Ogokora gw’okogechia na ogw’okoirokia gwakorekanire ase ense eye.
english: "A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land:

ekegusii: Ememera emeke nigo ekobotia ribomba rigima.
english: "A little yeast works through the whole batch of dough."

ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria, bakamotebia, “Omonto nachicha oumerana naintwe, ototebia ng’a toirane gocha asore, aye omoruoti gwatotomete, na kogotebia ng’a aya naro Omonene atebire: Nase ki ogotoma koboria Baali‐Sebubu, enyasae y’Ekironi? Nekiagera okagete ng’a Nyasae tari ase Abaisraeli? Ase ayio togoika korwa ase oborere obwo kwariina, korende ekeene, goika okwe.”
english: "A man came to meet us," they replied. "And he said to us, 'Go back to the king who sent you and tell him, "This is what the LORD says: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are sending men to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!" '"

ekegusii: “Erio omonto oyomo ore korokwa Anania, omoiroki Nyasae ase ogotunyana amachiko, ore gokwanwa buya n’Abayahudi bonsi abamenyete agwo,
english: "A man named Ananias came to see me. He was a devout observer of the law and highly respected by all the Jews living there.

ekegusii: “Omosacha, gose omokungu, orarigie ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose oyore omorogi, goika aitwe akwe. Abanto abwo baakwe amagena bakwe; okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nakobe okwabo.”
english: "'A man or woman who is a medium or spiritist among you must be put to death. You are to stone them; their blood will be on their own heads.'"

ekegusii: Omonto ochenegete abuuche ribu ri’eng’ombe eria, erio ariumore isiko y’egetwori, aase achenire. Ribu erio rigachwe agwo ase engencho y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli ase ogokorerwa emeremo y’ogochena amache akonyororokigwa ase okorusia ebibe.
english: "A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and put them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They shall be kept by the Israelite community for use in the water of cleansing; it is for purification from sin.

ekegusii: "A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
english: Ogochika okoyia nabaeire nakwo oko, mwanchane. Buna nabanchete inwe, nainwe mwanchane boigo.

ekegusii: “Omokuani tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo ki’omonto okure. Nare ne ribaga gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase abanto aba: ise, na ng’ina, na omwana oye, omomura gose omoiseke, na momura omwabo, na moiseke omwabo oyotaraba nomosacha.
english: "'A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person; however, if the dead person was his father or mother, son or daughter, brother or unmarried sister, then he may defile himself.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Omwana nigo asigete ise, na omosomba osigete omonene oye. Onye inche inde iso, amasikani aino asende, ng’ai are? Na onye inde omonene, okonyiroka kwaino, ng’ai kore? Inwe abakuani nigo mochayete erieta riane, naende nigo mokoboria: Nase enchera ki tochayete erieta riao?
english: "A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, where is the honor due me? If I am a master, where is the respect due me?" says the LORD Almighty. "It is you, O priests, who show contempt for my name. "But you ask, 'How have we shown contempt for your name?'

ekegusii: “Omworokigwa tari omonene kobua omworokia oye, gose omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye.
english: "A student is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his master.

ekegusii: “Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Omoro obe igoro ase Abakalidayo, na igoro ase abanto bamenyete Babeli, na igoro ase abanene b’oboruoti obwo, na igoro ase abanto abang’aini b’ense eyio!
english: "A sword against the Babylonians!" declares the LORD-- "against those who live in Babylon and against her officials and wise men!

ekegusii: “Ensemo ya ikomi y’okwama kwa mogondo, kerabe endagera gose amatunda, ebio nebi’Omonene, ebio nebichenu ase Omonene.
english: "'A tithe of everything from the land, whether grain from the soil or fruit from the trees, belongs to the LORD; it is holy to the LORD.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteba, “Noborwaire boramoite bwamonyorire, takoboka naende korwa ase araire.”
english: "A vile disease has beset him; he will never get up from the place where he lies."

ekegusii: “Eriogi riaigurwe Rama, okorera na okweumia. Raeli nkoreera are abana baye, tancheti akirigwe, ekiagera tibaiyo.”
english: "A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more."

ekegusii: eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye!”
english: "a voice of one calling in the desert, 'Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.'"

ekegusii: “Ring’ana ndire rianchicherete bobisi, nigo nariigwete rikomonyerera.
english: "A word was secretly brought to me, my ears caught a whisper of it.

ekegusii: Ritang’ani arue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asere omonyene, na ase abanto b’enka yaye, erinde baaberwe.
english: "Aaron is to offer the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household.

ekegusii: Kera emambia ekero Haroni akoroisia chitaya nabe ogosambera agwo ubani egotioka buya,
english: "Aaron must burn fragrant incense on the altar every morning when he tends the lamps.

ekegusii: “Naboigo Haroni arente eeri eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye, akore okobwatanigwa asere omonyene, na ase abanto b’enka yaye, anyenye eeri eria.
english: "Aaron shall bring the bull for his own sin offering to make atonement for himself and his household, and he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.

ekegusii: “Haroni nakwe, asangererekane amo nabanto baye. Ere tagosoa ase ense eria naeire Abaisraeli, ekiagera inwe babere mwasaretie, timwanyigwera buna nabachigete agwo ase amache a Meriba.
english: "Aaron will be gathered to his people. He will not enter the land I give the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against my command at the waters of Meribah.

ekegusii: “Chianga chiria chinchenu chia Haroni nigo chiraegwe ab’ororeria rwaye nyuma gakure, bachieboyie ekero bagochia goakwa amaguta na gwatananwa.
english: "Aaron's sacred garments will belong to his descendants so that they can be anointed and ordained in them.

ekegusii: Agateba, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata”, “Onsi nigo akonyarekana asore, onduserie egekombe eke, korende tari buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.”
english: "Abba, Father," he said, "everything is possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will."

ekegusii: “Erio ekero nare kogenda, konaikire ang’e na Damesiki, ekero kia mobaso gati mobosokano amasase akarwa igoro akambarera chinsemo chionsi.
english: "About noon as I came near Damascus, suddenly a bright light from heaven flashed around me.

ekegusii: "About the third hour he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
english: Agasoka chinsa isato, akarora abande bateneine echiiro, batari nemeremo,

ekegusii: Elisha akamotebia, “Ase engaki buna eye iga, ase omwaka ogocha, nobe kobwate omwana omoisia omoagate.” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Yaya, omonene one, omonto o Nyasae, tobaisa kong’aina inche omosomba oo.”
english: "About this time next year," Elisha said, "you will hold a son in your arms." "No, my lord," she objected. "Don't mislead your servant, O man of God!"

ekegusii: “Ankio engaki buna eye ninkorentere omonto korwa ase orogongo rwa Benjamin, naye omoake amaguta, erinde abe omonene igoro y’abanto baane Abaisraeli. Nere oratoorie abanto baane korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti, ekiagera narorire emechando y’abanto baane, na ekerero kiabo giaikire asende.”
english: "About this time tomorrow I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin. Anoint him leader over my people Israel; he will deliver my people from the hand of the Philistines. I have looked upon my people, for their cry has reached me."

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Tata oito nere Ibrahimu.” Yeso akabatebia, “Onye nabana ba Ibrahimu mware, anga mwakora emeremo ya Ibrahimu.
english: "Abraham is our father," they answered. "If you were Abraham's children," said Jesus, "then you would do the things Abraham did.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akabora: Mbare na Musa na ababani; tiga baigwere barabwo.
english: "Abraham replied, 'They have Moses and the Prophets; let them listen to them.'

ekegusii: “Ancha oire ebiegwa ebio korwa asebare, erinde bikorerwe emeremo agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Obie Abalawi, kera omonto anyore buna emeremo yaye ere.”
english: "Accept these from them, that they may be used in the work at the Tent of Meeting. Give them to the Levites as each man's work requires."

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia abanto baria, “Inche omoruoti Ahaswero natoma abasomba baria baane, nabachika barente Vasti eting’ana asende, korende ere bwanga koigwera ogochika okwo. Inee! Ngento ki agwenerete akorerwe kobwatekana nogochika?”
english: "According to law, what must be done to Queen Vashti?" he asked. "She has not obeyed the command of King Xerxes that the eunuchs have taken to her."

ekegusii: Petero akamotebia, “Ainea, Yesu Kristo okogwenirie; imoka bware oborere bwao!” Erio kegima akaimoka.
english: "Aeneas," Peter said to him, "Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and take care of your mat." Immediately Aeneas got up.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko amange omonene bw’abasomba baria agacha, akarigia gokora omobaro nabarabwo.
english: "After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.

ekegusii: Ekero engaki eraike, abanto barabe bakomanora na koimoka korwa ase ebitwori, na ekero Haroni na abamura baye bakoorire gotuba Eema y’Omosangererekano, amo nebinto bionsi bireo, Abakohati bachiche babogorie ebinto ebi ebichenu, korende tibabikuna. Baise kobikuna, nigo barakwe. “Emeremo y’okobogoria ebinto ebio bi’Eema y’Omosangererekano nigo erabe ey’Abakohati.
english: "After Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy furnishings and all the holy articles, and when the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites are to come to do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy things or they will die. The Kohathites are to carry those things that are in the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Bono yaetire emiaka etai meke ngacha ndetere abanto b’egesaku kiane ebiegwa, naende indue chisadaka.
english: "After an absence of several years, I came to Jerusalem to bring my people gifts for the poor and to present offerings.

ekegusii: “Ekero emiaka emerongo ene yachia koera, omomalaika akamoorokera ase ogwoka kw’omorero ase egetutu aaria erooro y’egetunwa gia Sinai.
english: "After forty years had passed, an angel appeared to Moses in the flames of a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.

ekegusii: “Nyuma konaeire Baruku, mosinto o Neria, okobwatana koria gw’okogorana kw’oboremo ngasaba Omonene nkabora:
english: "After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD:

ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo asoete Misiri, na Abamisiri bakabachanda, chisokoro chiaino chikarera ase Omonene ng’a achikonye, na Omonene agatoma Musa na Haroni. Barabwo bakabang’anyia korwa Misiri, bakabarenta bamenye ase ense eye.
english: "After Jacob entered Egypt, they cried to the LORD for help, and the LORD sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your forefathers out of Egypt and settled them in this place.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio nogende gochia ekegoro kia Nyasae agwo Gibea, ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti kere. Agwo ase egesoero ki’omochie noumerane nekeombe ki’ababani bagotirimboka korwa ase ekegoro aase agwo ebing’wanso bikoruerwa, babe bakobugia amakano ne chikonu, na ebiroria, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Barabwo mbabe bakobaboka ase okobana.
english: "After that you will go to Gibeah of God, where there is a Philistine outpost. As you approach the town, you will meet a procession of prophets coming down from the high place with lyres, tambourines, flutes and harps being played before them, and they will be prophesying.

ekegusii: “Nyuma y’ayio nkarora eng’iti ende yagwekaine engo, korende ase omogongo oye nigo yabwate chimbaba inye buna echie chinyoni. Eng’iti eyio nigo yabwate emetwe ene; nero ekaegwa okobua gw’okogamba.
english: "After that, I looked, and there before me was another beast, one that looked like a leopard. And on its back it had four wings like those of a bird. This beast had four heads, and it was given authority to rule.

ekegusii: “Naende nkarora ase amaroro aria a botuko eng’iti ya kane. Nigo yarenge ey’okoondokia na koirokia, boigo nigo yarenge ne chinguru chinyinge. Nigo yabwate amaino amanene ay’ebioma; ekaria na kobutorana, na eke yatigaretie ekagetindachera inse namagoro aye. Eyio nigo yarenge nogwatananekana korwa ase ching’iti chiria chiayetang’anerete; ero nigo yabwate chingunchara ikomi.
english: "After that, in my vision at night I looked, and there before me was a fourth beast-- terrifying and frightening and very powerful. It had large iron teeth; it crushed and devoured its victims and trampled underfoot whatever was left. It was different from all the former beasts, and it had ten horns.

ekegusii: Nyuma yaye Abalawi goika babeke amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe ye chieri chiria, naye orusie eeri eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na eyende ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa asende inche Omonene, na igo okore okobwatanigwa ase Abalawi.
english: "After the Levites lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, use the one for a sin offering to the LORD and the other for a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.

ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene aragoikie ase ense ya Kanani, buna akorierete eira, aye amo ne chisokoro chiao, na akoyee,
english: "After the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites and gives it to you, as he promised on oath to you and your forefathers,

ekegusii: “Nyuma, ekero Omwerwa oria akoorire gokigita etukia yaye, omokuani aimokie rireko ri’emingichi riaiyekirwe, na korwa ase egetonga arusie omogati oyomo otabekiri memera, na omogati oyomo omoo otabekiri memera, ayebeke ase amaboko ’Omwerwa oria.
english: "'After the Nazirite has shaved off the hair of his dedication, the priest is to place in his hands a boiled shoulder of the ram, and a cake and a wafer from the basket, both made without yeast.

ekegusii: “Nyuma ase aya ning’irane, ning’agache naende obomenyo bwa Daudi, boria bwagwete. Ning’agache naende aase agwo atagogete, nimbotenenie,
english: "'After this I will return and rebuild David's fallen tent. Its ruins I will rebuild, and I will restore it,

ekegusii: Ekero orabe gwakoorire korara engaki eyio, naende orarere orobega rwao rw’okorio, na obe kobogoretie obobe bw’Abayuda. Nagochikeire amatuko emerongo ene, rituko erimo ndibe buna omwaka oyomo.
english: "After you have finished this, lie down again, this time on your right side, and bear the sin of the house of Judah. I have assigned you 40 days, a day for each year.

ekegusii: Ekero kwabachenire na kobaatanana babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa, barabwo basoe ase Eema y’Omosangererekano babe bagokora emeremo aroro.
english: "After you have purified the Levites and presented them as a wave offering, they are to come to do their work at the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Korwa nyuma yao oboruoti bonde bore oboke ase obwao mbooroke, na nyuma y’oboruoti obwo, obonde bwa gatato bore obw’etaai mbooroke, na borobwo mbogambere ense yonsi.
english: "After you, another kingdom will rise, inferior to yours. Next, a third kingdom, one of bronze, will rule over the whole earth.

ekegusii: “Naende nabatebirie: Onye babere asemore bagwancherana ase ense igoro ya ing’ana rinde rionsi barasabe, inabakorerwe rirorio na Tata one ore igoro.
english: "Again, I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by my Father in heaven.

ekegusii: “Igo enga buna omonto ore kogenda orogendo, akarangeria abasomba baye, akabeka enibo yaye asebare.
english: "Again, it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted his property to them.

ekegusii: “Naende oboruoti bwa igoro mbogwekanirie nomonto omoonchoreria, okorigia chiruru chingiya.
english: "Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant looking for fine pearls.

ekegusii: “Naende omonyaboronge karaonchoke atige oboronge bwaye na akore ebibe, inche nimobekere ekegocha ase enchera yaye goika akwe. Onye tikwamokurerete, ere nakwe ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na ogokora kwaye kw’oboronge akorete ritang’ani tigokoinyorwa, korende amanyinga aye ninyaganie korwa ase okoboko kwao.
english: "Again, when a righteous man turns from his righteousness and does evil, and I put a stumbling block before him, he will die. Since you did not warn him, he will die for his sin. The righteous things he did will not be remembered, and I will hold you accountable for his blood.

ekegusii: “Naende mwaigwete ng’a abanto ba kare mbatebetigwe: Totiana bosa, korende oikeranerie Omonene chimuma chiao.
english: "Again, you have heard that it was said to the people long ago, 'Do not break your oath, but keep the oaths you have made to the Lord.'

ekegusii: Ning’o aye omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli gwachicheire? Ning’o okobwatia? Inee! Nesese ekwete okobwatia, gose nensona.
english: "Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom are you pursuing? A dead dog? A flea?

ekegusii: Labani agancha amang’ana ayio, agateba, “Tiga abe buna gwatebire.”
english: "Agreed," said Laban. "Let it be as you have said."

ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Abe buna mwateba.” Akabatiga bakagenda. Erio agasiba engori eria embariri ase ekebao keria.
english: "Agreed," she replied. "Let it be as you say." So she sent them away and they departed. And she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

ekegusii: Bakamotebia, “Ee bono, titokogoita, nigo toragosibe rioka, erio tokobeke ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.” Ase ayio bakamosiba ne chingori ibere chinyia, erio bakamorusia korwa ase egetare keria.
english: "Agreed," they answered. "We will only tie you up and hand you over to them. We will not kill you." So they bound him with two new ropes and led him up from the rock.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae! Naye gwatongete igoro chionsi, na ense, ase okobua kwao na ase okoboko kwao koramboire. Tikeri nonya negento ekemo kegosinyete.
english: "Ah, Sovereign LORD, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and outstretched arm. Nothing is too hard for you.

ekegusii: Erio nkamoiraneria, “Oo! Omonene Nyasae! Inche tinkomanya gokwana, ekiagera inde omwana omoke.”
english: "Ah, Sovereign LORD," I said, "I do not know how to speak; I am only a child."

ekegusii: Aye omoyio o birende bw’Omonene, ngoika ririri orabe kogendererete otari gotoerera? Irana ime ase ekegocho kiao, okire na gotimoka.
english: "'Ah, sword of the LORD,' [you cry,] 'how long till you rest? Return to your scabbard; cease and be still.'

ekegusii: “Ebitongwa ebisinini bionsi bire moyo bire ne chimbaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia asemore.
english: "'All flying insects that walk on all fours are to be detestable to you.

ekegusii: Na bono, onde bwensi ore asemore oitire omonto, na onde bwensi okunire egetondo, goika abeere isiko y’egetwori ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Ase rituko ria gatato, naende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, mwechene inwe abanyene, amo nabooswa baino.
english: "All of you who have killed anyone or touched anyone who was killed must stay outside the camp seven days. On the third and seventh days you must purify yourselves and your captives.

ekegusii: "All our enemies have opened their mouths wide against us.
english: “Ababisa baito bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gotosekerera.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi, abe omosacha gose omokungu, oragende ase omoruoti ase egoora ime atarangeiri, goika aitwe akwe. Okwo nogochika. Abasomba bonsi b’omoruoti na abanto bonsi be chingongo chi’oboruoti mbamanyete amang’ana ayio. Enchera neyemo yoka ogotooreka: erarente onye omoruoti abe okomworotera enyimbo yaye y’oboruoti eroisirie korwa ase etahabu, ebe ekemanyererio ng’a rirorio natigwe abe moyo. Korende bono tindarangerigwa kogenda ase omoruoti ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato.”
english: "All the king's officials and the people of the royal provinces know that for any man or woman who approaches the king in the inner court without being summoned the king has but one law: that he be put to death. The only exception to this is for the king to extend the gold scepter to him and spare his life. But thirty days have passed since I was called to go to the king."

ekegusii: “Abagambi bonsi ba sugusu nao bakare amo n’Abasidoni bonsi; bonsi bagendire gochia ase abwo baitetwe nemioro. Ase engencho y’obwoba barentete ekero barenge nokobua, bono babeire nobosooku. Nigo baraire batarogeti amo na baria baitetwe nemioro; nigo babogoretie obosooku bwabo bare ase egati y’abwo bagendete ase chimbeera.
english: "All the princes of the north and all the Sidonians are there; they went down with the slain in disgrace despite the terror caused by their power. They lie uncircumcised with those killed by the sword and bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

ekegusii: Akabora, “Ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”
english: "All these I have kept since I was a boy," he said.

ekegusii: Omomura oria akamotebia, “Ayio onsi nayabwatire; ing’ana ki rimochete?”
english: "All these I have kept," the young man said. "What do I still lack?"

ekegusii: “Naeirwe ebinto bionsi na Tata one; monto onde tari omomanyete Omwana otatiga Tata; na onde tari omomanyete Tata otatiga Omwana, na onde bwensi Omwana agochora komoorokeria.
english: "All things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.

ekegusii: Naeirwe ebinto bionsi na Tata one; monto onde tari omomanyete Omwana gose nere ng’o, otatiga Tata, gose Tata nere ng’o, otatiga Omwana, na onde bwensi Omwana anchire komoorokeria.”
english: "All things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him."

ekegusii: “Aya nabatebirie ekero inde asemore.
english: "All this I have spoken while still with you.

ekegusii: "All this I have told you so that you will not go astray.
english: “Amang’ana aya nabatebirie timocha kogochwa.

ekegusii: "All this I will give you," he said, "if you will bow down and worship me."
english: akamotebia, “Ebi bionsi ninkoe, koratung’ame na gonsasima.”

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Sulemani, “Aya onsi Omonene nigo andikerete nokoboko kwaye, akanyorokereria buna emeremo yonsi egochia gokoreka yare kobwatekana nomogwekano orwetwe.”
english: "All this," David said, "I have in writing from the hand of the LORD upon me, and he gave me understanding in all the details of the plan."

ekegusii: “Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini abare ase egati yaino, tiga bache baroisie ebinto bionsi Omonene achikire,
english: "All who are skilled among you are to come and make everything the LORD has commanded:

ekegusii: "All who rage against you will surely be ashamed and disgraced; those who oppose you will be as nothing and perish.
english: “Rora, abwo bonsi babagechete mbasookigwe na gotantanigwa; abwo bakobaengereria mbabe bosa basirigwe.

ekegusii: “Abakungu bao bonsi na abana bao abamura nabairwe ase Abakalidayo, naye omonyene tokorwa ase amaboko abo otooreke, korende omoruoti o Babeli nakobwate; na omochie oyo nosambwe nomorero.”
english: "All your wives and children will be brought out to the Babylonians. You yourself will not escape from their hands but will be captured by the king of Babylon; and this city will be burned down."

ekegusii: Abalawi baegwe orogongo robebekane norw’abakuani; nigo rorabe nobotambe bwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000). Obotambe bwe chingongo chionsi nigo borabe chimoti chilifu, emerongo ebere na isano (25,000) na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000).
english: "Alongside the territory of the priests, the Levites will have an allotment 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. Its total length will be 25,000 cubits and its width 10,000 cubits.

ekegusii: “Nainwe Abayuda boigo, mwarikeirwe engaki ye rigesa ri’ogokora kwaino, ekero ndasibore abooswa b’abanto baane.
english: "Also for you, Judah, a harvest is appointed.

ekegusii: “Obaache emeriibo ye chibao chi’emekonge, etano ase okoriiba chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,
english: "Also make crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,

ekegusii: Inche tindi na komocha. Tingochandekera obogima bwane; tinkobara obogima bwane ng’a negento.
english: "Although I am blameless, I have no concern for myself; I despise my own life.

ekegusii: “Aye nigo kwarenge omochie otigetwe na kogechwa, monto onde tarenge goeta ime yao, korende bono ningokore obe nobonene goika kare na kare, na aye nobe omochie orarente omogoko ekiaare ase ekiaare.
english: "Although you have been forsaken and hated, with no one traveling through, I will make you the everlasting pride and the joy of all generations.

ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria, “Inee! Inche n’Omoyahudi nde? Abanto b’egesaku kiao na abakuani abanene bakorentire asende. Inki gwakorete?”
english: "Am I a Jew?" Pilate replied. "It was your people and your chief priests who handed you over to me. What is it you have done?"

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna mokoimokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu, gocha kong’ira?
english: "Am I leading a rebellion," said Jesus, "that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me?

ekegusii: “Inee! Inche nigo inde Nyasae ore ang’e rioka? Tindi Nyasae ore aare boigo?
english: "Am I only a God nearby," declares the LORD, "and not a God far away?

ekegusii: Rigereria, Amaria, omokuani omonene, nabatenenere igoro ase amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene; na Sebadia, mosinto o Isumaeli, omonene bw’Abayuda, ere nabatenenere ase amang’ana onsi ay’omoruoti, na Abalawi mbabakorere buna abakonyi baino. Mobe abaremu ase ande onsi mogokora, na Omonene abe amo nabagokora ayare amaronge.”
english: "Amariah the chief priest will be over you in any matter concerning the LORD, and Zebadiah son of Ishmael, the leader of the tribe of Judah, will be over you in any matter concerning the king, and the Levites will serve as officials before you. Act with courage, and may the LORD be with those who do well."

ekegusii: “Abakori amabe nigo bakonyorekana ase egati y’abanto baane; abwo nigo bagotega buna abategi be chinyoni, nigo bakobeka amareba babwate abanto.
english: "Among my people are wicked men who lie in wait like men who snare birds and like those who set traps to catch men.

ekegusii: “Naroche oboriri ase ababani ba Samaria, nigo barenge kobana ase erieta ri’enyasae Baali, na gotantania abanto baane Abaisraeli.
english: "Among the prophets of Samaria I saw this repulsive thing: They prophesied by Baal and led my people Israel astray.

ekegusii: “Onye omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino bwanchete koria Epasaka y’Omonene nigo arakore koreng’ana nemeroberio eria yachigetwe. Mobe nogochika okomo ase omomenyi na ase omobiare.”
english: "'An alien living among you who wants to celebrate the LORD's Passover must do so in accordance with its rules and regulations. You must have the same regulations for the alien and the native-born.'"

ekegusii: Onye omomenyi omenyete bwoo bwanchete koria Epasaka y’Omonene, ere na abasacha bonsi abare amo nere goika barokigwe. Erio anyare koria Epasaka, na ere abe buna omobiare oino. Korende onde bwensi otarokiri tayeria.
english: "An alien living among you who wants to celebrate the LORD's Passover must have all the males in his household circumcised; then he may take part like one born in the land. No uncircumcised male may eat of it.

ekegusii: Akabatebia: Nomobisa okorete bo. Abasomba bakamoboria: Inee! Norigetie tochie toyasangererie?
english: "'An enemy did this,' he replied. "The servants asked him, 'Do you want us to go and pull them up?'

ekegusii: Omonene otebire boigo igoro ya Yesebeli; Chisese inachiriere Yesebeli agwo ase oboremo bwa Yesireeli.
english: "And also concerning Jezebel the LORD says: 'Dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.'

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosoa enyomba y’abanto bagokora omoyega na goikaransa agwo ase okoria na konywa amo nabarabwo.
english: "And do not enter a house where there is feasting and sit down to eat and drink.

ekegusii: Na bono, inwe oroiboro rw’abanto abanyabibe, mwabeire mamincha y’Omonene, buna chisokoro chiaino chiarenge, na mwagerire Omonene omentire endamwamu yaye ase Abaisraeli.
english: "And here you are, a brood of sinners, standing in the place of your fathers and making the LORD even more angry with Israel.

ekegusii: “Nimbae abanto baane ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Abamisiri; ekero moragende, timokogenda more namaboko amasa.
english: "And I will make the Egyptians favorably disposed toward this people, so that when you leave you will not go empty-handed.

ekegusii: “Ning’umorere abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na aba Yerusalemu, omoika bw’amabera na ogosaba. Ekero barandigererie mbarore oyo babetete babe bakondeera, buna omonto okoreera omwana oye omomoima; mbandeere bare nobororo buna obw’omonto okoreera omwana oye omotangi.
english: "And I will pour out on the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and supplication. They will look on me, the one they have pierced, and they will mourn for him as one mourns for an only child, and grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for a firstborn son.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo imanyete emeremo yabo, na ebirengererio biabo. Ninchiche gosangereria abanto b’ebisaku bionsi abagokwana emenwa ao ao, nabarabwo mbache barore obonene bwane.
english: "And I, because of their actions and their imaginations, am about to come and gather all nations and tongues, and they will come and see my glory.

ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oragere oyomo bw’aba abake abanyegenete akore ebibe, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, na gotugutwa nyancha ime.
english: "And if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for him to be thrown into the sea with a large millstone tied around his neck.

ekegusii: “Omobani karang’aineke akwane ring’ana ri’obobani, rirorio ninche Omonene nang’ainire omobani oyio; nindambore okoboko kwane imoite arue ase egati y’Abaisraeli, abanto baane.
english: "'And if the prophet is enticed to utter a prophecy, I the LORD have enticed that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand against him and destroy him from among my people Israel.

ekegusii: Bono nigo nacha gokwana aya asore, aye omonene one, ekiagera abanto banyoboirie. Ase igo inche omokungu, omosomba oo, nkarengereria ng’a nkwane naye omoruoti. Ande aye nonkorere aya inche, omosomba oo, nkoboria.
english: "And now I have come to say this to my lord the king because the people have made me afraid. Your servant thought, 'I will speak to the king; perhaps he will do what his servant asks.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio Farao, rigia omonto ore omomanyi na omong’aini, omobeke igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri.
english: "And now let Pharaoh look for a discerning and wise man and put him in charge of the land of Egypt.

ekegusii: Na bono omoyo one oberire ime yane; amatuko ’emechando ambwatereire bokong’u.
english: "And now my life ebbs away; days of suffering grip me.

ekegusii: Na bono inche nabeire engero egoterwa asebare, ee, nabeire asebare ring’ana rikorabaarwa.
english: "And now their sons mock me in song; I have become a byword among them.

ekegusii: “Bono inwe abakuani, amang’ana aya nigo achikirwe asemore.
english: "And now this admonition is for you, O priests.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Bono ninki imbwate aiga ekero abanto baane bairirwe obosomba engencho ende etaiyo? Ee, Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Abagambi abwo bakobachanda nigo bakobaakera amariogi, na erieta riane nigo richayire omobaso boira kogenderera botambe.
english: "And now what do I have here?" declares the LORD. "For my people have been taken away for nothing, and those who rule them mock," declares the LORD. "And all day long my name is constantly blasphemed.

ekegusii: Bono inwe igo morengereretie korwania oboruoti bw’Omonene bore ase amaboko ’abanto b’ororeria rwa Daudi, ekiagera more omoganda omonene, naende ekiagera mobwate emegwekano ye chimori ye chitahabu eria Yeroboamu abaroiseirie ekaba chinyasae chiaino.
english: "And now you plan to resist the kingdom of the LORD, which is in the hands of David's descendants. You are indeed a vast army and have with you the golden calves that Jeroboam made to be your gods.

ekegusii: Inche, omosomba oo, nkarengereria ng’a nonyare kong’a obotoereru, ekiagera aye, omoruoti one, nigo ore buna omomalaika o Nyasae ase okomanya gwatanana ayare amaya na ayare amabe. Omonene Nyasae abe amo naye!”
english: "And now your servant says, 'May the word of my lord the king bring me rest, for my lord the king is like an angel of God in discerning good and evil. May the LORD your God be with you.'"

ekegusii: Gaki bono rora, nkogenda nde Yerusalemu, nasibirwe n’Omoika. Timanyeti ayarachie koonyora aaria,
english: "And now, compelled by the Spirit, I am going to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there.

ekegusii: “Gaki bono, Omonene Nyasae, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro yane na ase ororeria rwane, na okore aya gwatebete ng’a nokore,
english: "And now, LORD God, keep forever the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house. Do as you promised,

ekegusii: “Na bono aye Omonene, ikerania onsi aya kwariete eira igoro yane inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ororeria rwane, na okore aya gwatebete ng’a noyakore,
english: "And now, LORD, let the promise you have made concerning your servant and his house be established forever. Do as you promised,

ekegusii: “Naende boigo nare aroro Simei, mosinto o Gera, omonto bw’egesaku kia Benjamin, korwa Bahurimu. Ere nandagereretie okoragereria okobe ase rituko riria nagendete Mahanaimu; korende ekero achete Yorodani koumerana nainche, nigo namorierete eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene, ngateba: Tinkogoita nomoro.
english: "And remember, you have with you Shimei son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, who called down bitter curses on me the day I went to Mahanaim. When he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the LORD: 'I will not put you to death by the sword.'

ekegusii: Naende Hamani akabora, “Esteri eting’ana, moka omoruoti, naroisia endagera, tarangeretie onde otatiga inche bweka amo nomoruoti. Nonya ng’ankio nagatorangeretie, inche amo nomoruoti.
english: "And that's not all," Haman added. "I'm the only person Queen Esther invited to accompany the king to the banquet she gave. And she has invited me along with the king tomorrow.

ekegusii: “Naende nkarora eng’iti ya kabere yagwekaine edubu ekaimokerera igoro na kogunkwaria rikere riaye erimo; nigo yabwate chimbaru isato ase omonwa oye, gati‐gati y’amaino aye. Eng’iti eria egatebigwa: Imoka, orie chinyama chinyinge!
english: "And there before me was a second beast, which looked like a bear. It was raised up on one of its sides, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. It was told, 'Get up and eat your fill of flesh!'

ekegusii: Ekero barasoke isiko mbarore emebere ekwete y’abanto abwo basaretie korwa asende inche Omonene. Amakonde arabe akoria emebere yabo tagokwa, na omorero orabe okobasamba tokorima. Abwo bakwete mbabe okogechia okobe ase abanto bonsi.”
english: "And they will go out and look upon the dead bodies of those who rebelled against me; their worm will not die, nor will their fire be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind."

ekegusii: Intwe nigo twarengerererie ng’a: Kerabe babe bagokwana igo asetore, gose ase abana b’ororeria rwaito, nabanyare kobairaneria: Rora, chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagachete egesasimero keng’ana buna eki’Omonene. Eke tikeri ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose ekeng’wanso kende, otatiga kere kirori egati yaito nainwe.
english: "And we said, 'If they ever say this to us, or to our descendants, we will answer: Look at the replica of the LORD's altar, which our fathers built, not for burnt offerings and sacrifices, but as a witness between us and you.'

ekegusii: Abamura bao babere, Hofini na Finehasi, nigo barakwe ase rituko erimo, na ayio nabe ekemanyererio asore ase aya nakwanire.
english: "'And what happens to your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will be a sign to you-- they will both die on the same day.

ekegusii: "And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?" They answered, "Seven."
english: “Na eria etano na ebere nkaa baria chilifu inye, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamotebia, “Mbitano na bibere.”

ekegusii: “Ekero mogosaba, timoba buna baria abang’ainereria; ekiagera barabwo nigo banchete gotenena na gosaba ase chisinagogi na ase amatabekania e chinchera, banyare kororwa nabanto. Nekeene nabatebirie ng’a banyorire eng’eria yabo.
english: "And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. I tell you the truth, they have received their reward in full.

ekegusii: Erio ise akababoria, “Ng’ai are? Naki mwakora mwatiga omonto oyio? Gachie momorangerie ache koragera amo naintwe.”
english: "And where is he?" he asked his daughters. "Why did you leave him? Invite him to have something to eat."

ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyanchire inche.
english: "And whoever welcomes a little child like this in my name welcomes me.

ekegusii: Ne chianga, nase ki mogochiechandera? Morigererie ebisicha bi’orosana buna bigokina; tibiri gokora emeremo, gose tibiri gwesisa;
english: "And why do you worry about clothes? See how the lilies of the field grow. They do not labor or spin.

ekegusii: “Naende okaira abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, abwo kwanyiborerete, okabarua bakaba ebing’wanso ase emegwekano eyio, okabasiria. Inee! Obonyaka obwo bwao ne ring’ana rike?
english: "'And you took your sons and daughters whom you bore to me and sacrificed them as food to the idols. Was your prostitution not enough?

ekegusii: “Naye Sulemani, omwana one, omomanye Nyasae one inche iso, naende omokorere nenkoro yao yonsi, na ase ogwancha kwao gwonsi, ekiagera Omonene nigo akorenga chinkoro chionsi, naende nigo amanyete kera omoroberio na ebirengererio bionsi. Koramorigie, ere nanche omonyore; korende onye gokomotiga, ere nigo aragotugute kare na kare.
english: "And you, my son Solomon, acknowledge the God of your father, and serve him with wholehearted devotion and with a willing mind, for the LORD searches every heart and understands every motive behind the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will reject you forever.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, nomanye ng’a ase rituko erio ndarusie korwa asebare ekio kere chinguru chiabo, na omogoko obo, na obonene bwabo, na omogoko bw’amaiso abo, na okogania gwe chinkoro chiabo, naende abana babo, abamura na abaiseke,
english: "And you, son of man, on the day I take away their stronghold, their joy and glory, the delight of their eyes, their heart's desire, and their sons and daughters as well--

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bana otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba igoro y’Abaamoni, na igoro y’okorama kwabo, otebe: “Omoyio, ee, omoyio osomoirwe ase ogoita, otierigwe na gosenigwa, nigo okomesa buna enkoba.
english: "And you, son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says about the Ammonites and their insults: "'A sword, a sword, drawn for the slaughter, polished to consume and to flash like lightning!

ekegusii: “Kwana ase egati y’ebisaku, mobirarerie! Imokereria igoro ebendera na morarie! Timobaisa kobisa amang’ana aya, korende motebe: Babeli obwatirwe, enyasae Beli yasookigwe, na Merodaki yatirwe. Emegwekano egosasimwa ereo yasookigwe, ne chinyasae chi’aroro chiatirwe.
english: "Announce and proclaim among the nations, lift up a banner and proclaim it; keep nothing back, but say, 'Babylon will be captured; Bel will be put to shame, Marduk filled with terror. Her images will be put to shame and her idols filled with terror.'

ekegusii: Tebia Abayuda, na morarie ase Yerusalemu: “Bugia egetureri ase ense eye yonsi, moake eriogi rinene, motebe: Sangererekana amo, togende ase emechie egiteire chindwaki.
english: "Announce in Judah and proclaim in Jerusalem and say: 'Sound the trumpet throughout the land!' Cry aloud and say: 'Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities!'

ekegusii: “Kwana aya ase Misiri, moyararie ase Migidoli, ee, yararie ase Memifisi na Tapanesi: Tenena, bwebeke ang’e, ekiagera omoro nosirie ase chinsemo chiao chionsi.
english: "Announce this in Egypt, and proclaim it in Migdol; proclaim it also in Memphis and Tahpanhes: 'Take your positions and get ready, for the sword devours those around you.'

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Tebia abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo amang’ana aya, oyararie ase Abayuda:
english: "Announce this to the house of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah:

ekegusii: Haroni na abamura baye obaake amaguta na kobaatanana babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
english: "Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

ekegusii: "Another said, 'I have just bought five yoke of oxen, and I'm on my way to try them out. Please excuse me.'
english: Oyonde akabora: Nagorire chintang’ana amachoki atano, nkogenda nde gochiteema; nagosabire, onyabere.

ekegusii: Ebirarero bionsi arararere, gose araikaransere, nigo birabe ebitachenegeti.
english: "'Any bed the man with a discharge lies on will be unclean, and anything he sits on will be unclean.

ekegusii: “Onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, orarie amanyinga ande onsi, inche Omonene nimbe mamincha y’omonto oyio, na inche nimwatanane korwa ase abanto baye.
english: "'Any Israelite or any alien living among them who eats any blood-- I will set my face against that person who eats blood and will cut him off from his people.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oraite eng’iti y’orosana, gose enyoni eyancheire koriegwa, goika aitere amanyinga aye inse, erio ayatube amaroba.
english: "'Any Israelite or any alien living among you who hunts any animal or bird that may be eaten must drain out the blood and cover it with earth,

ekegusii: “Korende eira ende yonsi, gose amang’ana ande onsi omokungu omoboraka, gose oyotiganire nomosacha oye ariete, gose aya atianete, goika aikeranigwe.
english: "Any vow or obligation taken by a widow or divorced woman will be binding on her.

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oranyore omonto oitirwe nomoro orosana ime, gose okwete ogokwa konde gwonsi, na amokune, gose akune riuga ri’omonto okwete, gose oboina, omonto oyio nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: "Anyone out in the open who touches someone who has been killed with a sword or someone who has died a natural death, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.

ekegusii: Onye omonto oria omorwaire ogokuna omonto onde ataraisaba amaboko, oria okunwa goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: "'Anyone the man with a discharge touches without rinsing his hands with water must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: "Anyone who attacks his father or his mother must be put to death.
english: “Onde bwensi oraake ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.

ekegusii: "Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.
english: “Onde bwensi oraragererie ise gose ng’ina, nere goika aitwe akwe.”

ekegusii: “Kera oyogotiga mokaye na konyuoma oyonde otomanire, nere oyokonyuoma oyotigirwe nomosacha oye, noyio otomanire.
english: "Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and the man who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orasoe ase enyomba eyio, ekero egendererete gosiekwa, nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: "Anyone who goes into the house while it is closed up will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: "Anyone who has sexual relations with an animal must be put to death.
english: “Omonto orarare neng’iti goika aitwe akwe.

ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraibe omonto goika aitwe akwe, karabe omoonirie gose omobwate ase amaboko aye.
english: "Anyone who kidnaps another and either sells him or still has him when he is caught must be put to death.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi karaite omonto onde moeneno, omonto oyio nere goika aitwe akwe ase oborori bw’abanto babere gose goetania, korende omonto tagoitwa ase oborori bw’omonto oyomo bweka.
english: "'Anyone who kills a person is to be put to death as a murderer only on the testimony of witnesses. But no one is to be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

ekegusii: Oyo bwanchete ise gose ng’ina kombua, oyio tangwenereti, na oyo bwanchete omwana oye omomura gose omoiseke kombua, oyio tangwenereti.
english: "Anyone who loves his father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; anyone who loves his son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me;

ekegusii: "Anyone who strikes a man and kills him shall surely be put to death.
english: “Monto onde bwensi oraake omonto na amoite akwe, nere goika aitwe akwe.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi, omobiare gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, orarie eng’iti ekwete yoka enyene, gose eyeitire ne ching’iti chinde chi’orosana, goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache; nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio, erio abe ochenekire.
english: "'Anyone, whether native-born or alien, who eats anything found dead or torn by wild animals must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be ceremonially unclean till evening; then he will be clean.

ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi arabe okorarera ekero are nomotienyi, nigo kerabe egetachenegeti, boigo nebinto bionsi araikaransere.
english: "'Anything she lies on during her period will be unclean, and anything she sits on will be unclean.

ekegusii: Abanto b’Arabia na abagambi bonsi ba Kedari, bagancha gokorentera chimanwa chie ching’ondi, ne chimingichi, ne chimbori, ase okoonchorerania naye.
english: "'Arabia and all the princes of Kedar were your customers; they did business with you in lambs, rams and goats.

ekegusii: Abasiiria bagakora oboonchoreria naye, ekiagera kwabwate ebinto ebinge bi’obotenenku; bagakorentera amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa alimasi, na erangi emonyinga, na ebitambaa bi’ebieni ao ao, na egatani engiya, na amakorongote, na amagena akorokwa agati, bakagora ebinto biao.
english: "'Aram did business with you because of your many products; they exchanged turquoise, purple fabric, embroidered work, fine linen, coral and rubies for your merchandise.

ekegusii: “Inee! Amang’ana aya amange natigwe tairanerigwa? Na omonto obwate amang’ana amange buna iga nabarerwe oboronge?
english: "Are all these words to go unanswered? Is this talker to be vindicated?

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, timonga buna Abaetiopia asende? Inee! Tinabarusetie inwe Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na Abafilisti korwa ase ense ya Kafitori, na Abaasuri korwa Kiri?” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Are not you Israelites the same to me as the Cushites?" declares the LORD. "Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt, the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir?

ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Amaene, naye omwana one Esau?” Yakobo akamoiraneria, “Ee, ninche.”
english: "Are you really my son Esau?" he asked. "I am," he replied.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Nonya ninwe timori nobong’aini? Timomanyeti ng’a kera egento kere isiko y’omonto gokeramosoe, tigekonyara komobekera ogotacheneka,
english: "Are you so dull?" he asked. "Don't you see that nothing that enters a man from the outside can make him 'unclean'?

ekegusii: "Are you still so dull?" Jesus asked them.
english: Akabora, “Inee! Nonya mbono nainwe timori nobong’aini?

ekegusii: "Are you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?
english: “Inee! Naye ore omonto bwe ritang’ani koiborwa? Gose naye gwatongetwe ritang’ani ebitunwa bitarabao?

ekegusii: Pilato akamoboria, “Aye naye Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?” Akamoiraneria, “Naboigo, aye gwatebire.”
english: "Are you the king of the Jews?" asked Pilate. "Yes, it is as you say," Jesus replied.

ekegusii: Aye tori Omomisiri oria, ere rero iga oseegeta abanto baria Abaiti chilifu inye, akabatang’ana gochia ase erooro?”
english: "Aren't you the Egyptian who started a revolt and led four thousand terrorists out into the desert some time ago?"

ekegusii: Imoka, mogende korwania egesaku ekio kemenyete ase obotoereru getechandereti ing’ana rinde, ekio getabwati ebiita gose emekorogoto y’ogosiekera, egesaku ekio kemenyete gioka. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: "Arise and attack a nation at ease, which lives in confidence," declares the LORD, "a nation that has neither gates nor bars; its people live alone.

ekegusii: “Imoka obare, ekiagera omobaso oo ochire, na obonene bw’Omonene bwakobareire.
english: "Arise, shine, for your light has come, and the glory of the LORD rises upon you.

ekegusii: “Buna koreng’ana omoibi akoba nobosooku ekero abwatirwe, naboigo n’Abaisraeli bararore obosooku barabwo amo nabaruoti babo, na abanene b’oboruoti bwabo, na ababani babo.
english: "As a thief is disgraced when he is caught, so the house of Israel is disgraced-- they, their kings and their officials, their priests and their prophets.

ekegusii: Abasidoni abwo bonsi bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa egati y’egetunwa kia Lebanoni na omochie o Misirefoti‐Maimu, inche omonyene nimbaserie barue bosio bw’Abaisraeli. Aye goika bwatananere Abaisraeli ense eyio ebe omwando obo, ase okoyeakera obomera, buna nagochigete.
english: "As for all the inhabitants of the mountain regions from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, that is, all the Sidonians, I myself will drive them out before the Israelites. Be sure to allocate this land to Israel for an inheritance, as I have instructed you,

ekegusii: “Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu; amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.
english: "As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield for all who take refuge in him.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania ndakore nabanto abwo: Omoika one oyio ore igoro asore, na amang’ana aane aya nabekire ime ase omonwa oo, ayio takorua ase omonwa oo, gose ase emenwa y’abana bao, gose ase emenwa y’abachokoro bao, korwa bono goika kare na kare.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "As for me, this is my covenant with them," says the LORD. "My Spirit, who is on you, and my words that I have put in your mouth will not depart from your mouth, or from the mouths of your children, or from the mouths of their descendants from this time on and forever," says the LORD.

ekegusii: “Rora, okobwatana kwane nabwatanire naye nakwo oko: Aye nobe sokoro bw’ebisaku ebinge.
english: "As for me, this is my covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.

ekegusii: “Boigo ekero omogeni, oria otari bw’abanto bao Abaisraeli, arabe okorwa ase ense y’aare ekiagera aigure igoro y’erieta riao rinene na igoro y’okoboko kwao ne chinguru koramboire, ekero nere arache asabe origereretie enyomba eye,
english: "As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm-- when he comes and prays toward this temple,

ekegusii: “Boigo onye omogeni korwa ase ense y’aare, oria otari bw’abanto bao Abaisraeli, okoigwa chinkuma chi’erieta riao rinene,
english: "As for the foreigner who does not belong to your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of your name--

ekegusii: Naende omonto karaigwe amang’ana aane, ko tayabwata, inche tinkomogambia, ekiagera tincheti kogambia ense, korende nyetoorie.
english: "As for the person who hears my words but does not keep them, I do not judge him. For I did not come to judge the world, but to save it.

ekegusii: “Ebisaku binde biratigare biegwe chingongo chiabo buna iga: Egesaku kia Benjamin keegwe orogongo rwaye korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "As for the rest of the tribes: Benjamin will have one portion; it will extend from the east side to the west side.

ekegusii: “Amang’ana igoro y’enyomba eye okong’agachera bono nigo arabe iga: Korabwatie emeroberio yane echikire na koigwera amachiko aane onsi na koyakora, erio nainche ning’ikeranie ring’ana riane asore, riria nakwanete na Daudi iso:
english: "As for this temple you are building, if you follow my decrees, carry out my regulations and keep all my commands and obey them, I will fulfill through you the promise I gave to David your father.

ekegusii: “Nimbatige inwe, abwo moratigare ase ense y’ababisa baino mobe nobwoba ase chinkoro chiaino ime, goika eriogi rie rito ri’omote rikonyegerigwa nembeo naribagose motame; ee, namotame buna omonto ogotama kagoserigwa korwa ase esegi, namogwe nonya onde tari kobabwatia.
english: "'As for those of you who are left, I will make their hearts so fearful in the lands of their enemies that the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. They will run as though fleeing from the sword, and they will fall, even though no one is pursuing them.

ekegusii: “Korende asetore intwe, Omonene nere Nyasae oito, na intwe titomotigeti. Intwe ntobwate abakuani bagokorera Omonene, baria bare b’ororeria rwa Haroni na Abalawi abare gokora emeremo yabo.
english: "As for us, the LORD is our God, and we have not forsaken him. The priests who serve the LORD are sons of Aaron, and the Levites assist them.

ekegusii: “Aya moroche; amatuko nache ritatigare rigena erimo igoro ase erinde eritatagorwe.”
english: "As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one of them will be thrown down."

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, genda nka bwoo. Ekero amagoro ao agosoa ase omochie omwana oria nakwe.
english: "As for you, go back home. When you set foot in your city, the boy will die.

ekegusii: “Korende aye Danieli, genda goika engaki eyio y’omoerio eike, ekero orabe gotimogete, noche koboka onyore egetari kiao ase engaki y’omoerio bw’amatuko ayio.”
english: "As for you, go your way till the end. You will rest, and then at the end of the days you will rise to receive your allotted inheritance."

ekegusii: Aye korataare ase obosio bwane, buna Daudi iso ataarete, na korakore onsi aya nagochikire na kobwata emeroberio yane yonsi echikire,
english: "As for you, if you walk before me as David your father did, and do all I command, and observe my decrees and laws,

ekegusii: Korabwatie chinchera chiane, buna Daudi iso achibwatetie, ase enkoro endonge na ase obwegenwa; na onye kogokora onsi aya nagochikire, na kobwata emeroberio yonsi echikire;
english: "As for you, if you walk before me in integrity of heart and uprightness, as David your father did, and do all I command and observe my decrees and laws,

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe ching’ondi chiane, ninache ekina ase egati y’eng’ondi na eng’ondi ende, na ase egati ye chimingichi ne chigoree.
english: "'As for you, my flock, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will judge between one sheep and another, and between rams and goats.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae akobatebia inwe Abaisraeli: Kera oyomo oino agenderere gosasima omogwekano oye! Korende ase engaki erache ekero morabe mokonyigwera timokora erieta riane richenu ribe eritachenegeti ase okorua ebiegwa biaino na gosasima emegwekano yaino.
english: "'As for you, O house of Israel, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Go and serve your idols, every one of you! But afterward you will surely listen to me and no longer profane my holy name with your gifts and idols.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, abanto bao nigo bagosangererekana amo agwo ase chinyasi, na ase ebisieri bie chinyomba, bagamba igoro yao, na kera omonto okwana nomogisangio oye, batebania: Inchuo togende, toigwe ng’a naki ring’ana rikorwa ase Omonene rigoteba.
english: "As for you, son of man, your countrymen are talking together about you by the walls and at the doors of the houses, saying to each other, 'Come and hear the message that has come from the LORD.'

ekegusii: Ekero nachagete gokwana, Omoika Omochenu okabaikera buna otoikerete intwe agwo ritang’ani.
english: "As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit came on them as he had come on us at the beginning.

ekegusii: “Ekero narigereretie nkarora ebirogo bi’obonene bigoterekwa, na omonto omokoro bw’amatuko amange agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye. Chianga chiaye nigo chiarenge chindabu se se, na etukia y’omotwe oye nigo yarenge endabu buna amarionya ’eng’ondi endabu asibirie; ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nigo kiarenge chimeme chi’omorero ogwoka, na amagoro ’ekerogo ekio nigo arenge omorero ogwoka.
english: "As I looked, "thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days took his seat. His clothing was as white as snow; the hair of his head was white like wool. His throne was flaming with fire, and its wheels were all ablaze.

ekegusii: “Nimborokie amakumia buna nakorete ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: "As in the days when you came out of Egypt, I will show them my wonders."

ekegusii: “Ntorete abana baito abaisia abatangi, ne chitugo chiaito chintangi ase abakuani abagokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito, buna erikire ase amachiko, torente ne chintangi chie chiombe, na echie chimbori, na echie ching’ondi.
english: "As it is also written in the Law, we will bring the firstborn of our sons and of our cattle, of our herds and of our flocks to the house of our God, to the priests ministering there.

ekegusii: “Engaki ense egendererete kobao, nebe engaki y’ogosimeka na ey’okogesa, engaki y’obokendu na ey’omobaso omororo, engaki y’etoigo na ey’egurugura, omobaso na obotuko, tichikoera nonya ng’ake.”
english: "As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease."

ekegusii: “Abana b’omonene oino nao bare nainwe, ne chigari ne chibarasi nao chire amo nainwe, amo nemechie egiteire chindwaki, boigo nebirwanero bionsi. Ase ayio, rirube rikobaikera,
english: "As soon as this letter reaches you, since your master's sons are with you and you have chariots and horses, a fortified city and weapons,

ekegusii: "As surely as God lives, who has denied me justice, the Almighty, who has made me taste bitterness of soul,
english: “Ekeene, buna Nyasae are moyo, oyo ong’urire ebiantungetie, na buna Omonguru aeire omoyo one obororo,

ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, omoruoti oyio ochayire eira yaye atianete ase omoruoti o Babeli, oria omobegete akaba omoruoti, na osaririe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, oyio goika akwere aaria Babeli.
english: "'As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, he shall die in Babylon, in the land of the king who put him on the throne, whose oath he despised and whose treaty he broke.

ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Ekeene buna inche inde moyo, timokogenderera gokwana omorabaaro oyo ase ense y’Abaisraeli.
english: "As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.

ekegusii: Omoruoti, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inde moyo, oyomo onga buna Tabori ase egati y’ebitunwa binde na onga buna Karimeli, egetunwa kere ang’e nenyancha, ngocha are.
english: "As surely as I live," declares the King, whose name is the LORD Almighty, "one will come who is like Tabor among the mountains, like Carmel by the sea.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, nonya aye Konia omoruoti bw’Abayuda, kore mosinto o Yehoyakimu, kwarenge koba ebonyi ere nekemanyererio kiane ebekire ase okoboko kwane gw’okorio, nabo nare kogosomora.
english: "As surely as I live," declares the LORD, "even if you, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, were a signet ring on my right hand, I would still pull you off.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, akamotebia, “Ekeene, buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, are moyo, timbwati gento kende keroisirie, otatiga mbwate obosie boisaine oroe oromo rwoka bore ekegancha, na amaguta amasinini oka are ase echuba. Bono inche nigo ngochora ebite ebi bike, erinde ndoiserie endagera asende na ase omwana one, erio torie toche tokwe.”
english: "As surely as the LORD your God lives," she replied, "I don't have any bread-- only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug. I am gathering a few sticks to take home and make a meal for myself and my son, that we may eat it-- and die."

ekegusii: Buna Tata anyanchete inche, na inche nabanchire inwe, menya ase obwanchani bwane.
english: "As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana igoro ere igoro mono korwa ase ense, naboigo ne chinchera chiane chire igoro mono kobua echiaino, na ebirengererio biane nabo bire kobua ebiaino.
english: "As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your thoughts.

ekegusii: “Buna koreng’ana igoro chiragenderere kobeera ase obosio bwane, naboigo ne chinderia chiaino chiragenderere kobao amo nerieta riaino boigo.” Nabo Omonene atebire. Naende otebire iga:
english: "As the new heavens and the new earth that I make will endure before me," declares the LORD, "so will your name and descendants endure.

ekegusii: “Ekero eira eria Nyasae aete Ibrahimu yachia goika ang’e gokieranigwa, abanto baria bakamenteka na kobucha mono aaria Misiri,
english: "As the time drew near for God to fulfill his promise to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt greatly increased.

ekegusii: Buna amabanchore agosangererigwa asambwa nomorero, naboigo nomoerio bw’ense orache koba.
english: "As the weeds are pulled up and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of the age.

ekegusii: “Mwamanyire ng’a nyuma y’amatuko abere nebe Epasaka, na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto naruegwe kobambwa.”
english: "As you know, the Passover is two days away-- and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified."

ekegusii: Adonia akamotebia, “Nomanyete ng’a oboruoti nobwane bwarenge, na Abaisraeli bonsi igo baganetie mbagambere, korende nonya naboigo, oboruoti bokaonchoka bokaba obwa momura ominto, ekiagera igo bwaba obwaye ase ogwancha kw’Omonene.
english: "As you know," he said, "the kingdom was mine. All Israel looked to me as their king. But things changed, and the kingdom has gone to my brother; for it has come to him from the LORD.

ekegusii: Buna ase rituko ri’omoyega omonene okarangeria ababisa baane bakanyoboyia korwa chinsemo chionsi; ase rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene onde tatooregete, gose gotigara, ase abwo nabogoretie na kobarera. Ababisa baane babasiririe.
english: "As you summon to a feast day, so you summoned against me terrors on every side. In the day of the LORD's anger no one escaped or survived; those I cared for and reared, my enemy has destroyed."

ekegusii: “Aye omoruoti, ekero kwaraire borere bwao, okarengereria amang’ana agochia gokorekana ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, na ere oria okoorokia obobisi nigo agokomanyia amang’ana agochia gokorekana.
english: "As you were lying there, O king, your mind turned to things to come, and the revealer of mysteries showed you what is going to happen.

ekegusii: Egesaku gi’Aseri keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Dani korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Asher will have one portion; it will border the territory of Dan from east to west.

ekegusii: “Aseri natware endagera y’obonoru, narue endagera engiya eragwenere abaruoti.
english: "Asher's food will be rich; he will provide delicacies fit for a king.

ekegusii: ng’a baborie abanto ba Sekemu, “Inki kere ekiya kobua, ng’a abana abamura emerongo etano na ebere ba Yerubi‐Baali babagambere, gose omonto oyomo bweka abagambere? Inyora boigo ng’a Abimeleki nigo are oyomino kegima bw’amanyinga ayamo.”
english: "Ask all the citizens of Shechem, 'Which is better for you: to have all seventy of Jerub-Baal's sons rule over you, or just one man?' Remember, I am your flesh and blood."

ekegusii: “Kwana nabanto bonsi b’ense eye, na abakuani, obaborie: Ekero mwarenge kweng’ata na korera ase kera omotienyi o gatano, na oyo o gatano na kabere, ase chingaki echi chionsi chi’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, Inee, nigo mwarenge kweng’ata ase engencho yane?
english: "Ask all the people of the land and the priests, 'When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for the past seventy years, was it really for me that you fasted?

ekegusii: "Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.
english: “Saba, namoegwe; rigia, namonyore; tura, namoigorerwe.

ekegusii: “Korende boria omanye ay’ebigori bia kare, bweigwere aya chisokoro chiao chianyorete.
english: "Ask the former generations and find out what their fathers learned,

ekegusii: “Boria Omonene, Nyasae oo, akoe ekemanyererio; tiga kerwe aase abakure inse, gose kerwe igoro mono.”
english: "Ask the LORD your God for a sign, whether in the deepest depths or in the highest heights."

ekegusii: “Inchuo montegerere, inwe abana ba Yakobo; montegerere inche Israeli iso.
english: "Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.

ekegusii: “Abaasuri nao bakare amo nemeganda yabo yonsi, chimbeera chiabo nigo chibaetanaine ase chinsemo chionsi. Bonsi baitirwe nemioro bakure.
english: "Assyria is there with her whole army; she is surrounded by the graves of all her slain, all who have fallen by the sword.

ekegusii: “Abaasuri mbaitwe nemioro, korende tari eya mwanyabanto, ee, emioro etari eya mwanyabanto nebasirie. Abanto abwo mbatame korwa ase esegi, na abamura babo mbairwe ase obosomba, bakore emeremo ase okobetererigwa.
english: "Assyria will fall by a sword that is not of man; a sword, not of mortals, will devour them. They will flee before the sword and their young men will be put to forced labor.

ekegusii: “Ogosemeria nkoreo ase omote, ekero ogechirwe noseboke naende, na emeseboko eyio tegosira.
english: "At least there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its new shoots will not fail.

ekegusii: Korende botuko gati gekaba egeturi: Rigereria, omonyuomi oyo! Soka momorotote!
english: "At midnight the cry rang out: 'Here's the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!'

ekegusii: Erio nario bararore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha ase amare ime amo ne chinguru chinyinge na obonene.
english: "At that time men will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eyio Mikaeli, omogambi oria omonene naoroke, atenenere abanto bao. Erio nebe engaki y’emechando emenene mono, eye etana koba rinde korwa ekero egesaku kia mwanyabanto giachagete kobao goika ase engaki eyio. Korende ase engaki eyio, abanto bao mbatoorigwe, kera oyomo oyo erieta riave riranyorekane ririkire ase ebuku eria.
english: "At that time Michael, the great prince who protects your people, will arise. There will be a time of distress such as has not happened from the beginning of nations until then. But at that time your people-- everyone whose name is found written in the book-- will be delivered.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio Musa akaiborwa, ere nigo arenge omuya mono, akagwenera Nyasae. Akarererwa nyomba mwa ise ase engaki y’emetienyi etato.
english: "At that time Moses was born, and he was no ordinary child. For three months he was cared for in his father's house.

ekegusii: “Oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekanirie nabaiseke ikomi ababogoretie chitaya chiabo, bagasoka gochia korotota omonyuomi.
english: "At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

ekegusii: Erio nario ekemanyererio ki’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto kerache kororekana igoro, na ebisaku bionsi bi’ense nario birarere; naende nabarore mwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha ase amare a igoro ne chinguru, na obonene obonge.
english: "At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky, and all the nations of the earth will mourn. They will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky, with power and great glory.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase engaki eyio amauga ’abaruoti b’Abayuda, na ay’abanene b’oboruoti obwo, na ay’abakuani, na ay’ababani, na aya bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, narusigwe ime ase chimbeera chiabo.
english: "'At that time, declares the LORD, the bones of the kings and officials of Judah, the bones of the priests and prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem will be removed from their graves.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase engaki egocha, inche nimbe Nyasae bw’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, na barabwo nababe abanto baane.”
english: "At that time," declares the LORD, "I will be the God of all the clans of Israel, and they will be my people."

ekegusii: “Naende ase engaki echikire nairane gochia ase ense ya irianyi, korende ase engaki eyio amang’ana takoba buna aye ritang’ani.
english: "At the appointed time he will invade the South again, but this time the outcome will be different from what it was before.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emeyega, na ey’Amatuko Amanene achikire, morue okoruegwa kw’endagera egetonga ekemo amo na kera eeri eyemo, na okoruegwa kw’endagera egetonga ekemo amo na kera emingichi eyemo, na amo nechimanwa chie ching’ondi okoruegwa kw’endagera ekerengo moranyare korua, na amo na kera egetonga gi’okoruegwa kw’endagera ebituba bine bi’amaguta.
english: "'At the festivals and the appointed feasts, the grain offering is to be an ephah with a bull, an ephah with a ram, and with the lambs as much as one pleases, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki y’omoerio omoruoti o irianyi namoumokere, korende omoruoti oria o sugusu nigo aramorindokere buna ekembugu‐mbugu ore ne chigari, na abariini be chibarasi, ne chimeeri chinyinge. Nigo arasoe ase chinse ao ao nomoganda omonene, aichore aoorie goeterao.
english: "At the time of the end the king of the South will engage him in battle, and the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots and cavalry and a great fleet of ships. He will invade many countries and sweep through them like a flood.

ekegusii: “Ayio nigo akogera enkoro yane yaiguswa, yatuma gocha ase omoyo.
english: "At this my heart pounds and leaps from its place.

ekegusii: "Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo and Beon--
english: “Ataroti, na Diboni, na Yaeseri, na Nimura, na Hesiboni, na Eleali, na Sibamu, na Nebo, na Beoni,

ekegusii: Omonene otebire, “Genda morwanie ense ya Merataimu na abanto ba Pekodi. Mobabwatie korwa nyuma, mobaite na kobasiria kegima, mokore onsi aya nabachikire.
english: "Attack the land of Merathaim and those who live in Pekod. Pursue, kill and completely destroy them," declares the LORD. "Do everything I have commanded you.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Aye omoro, imoka orwanie omorisia one, oyio ore oyomo nainche. Aka omorisia oyio, erinde ching’ondi chiserebekane; erio inche ing’onchore okoboko kwane igoro ya chiria chire chindeu.”
english: "Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, against the man who is close to me!" declares the LORD Almighty. "Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

ekegusii: Babeli goika esirigwe, ekiagera yagerete Abaisraeli abange bagakwa, naende boigo yaitete abanto abange mono b’ense yonsi.”
english: "Babylon must fall because of Israel's slain, just as the slain in all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.

ekegusii: “Mwerende timokora ogokora kwaino okuya ase amasio ’abanto, erinde mororwe nabarabwo, ekiagera komogokora ayio, timori neng’eria ase Iso oino ore igoro.”
english: "Be careful not to do your 'acts of righteousness' before men, to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria, ekiagera ekero bagokora obotomani ase ogosasima chinyasae chiabo na gochiruera ebing’wanso, mbabaise kobarangeria inwe morie ebing’wanso biabo.
english: "Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land; for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to them, they will invite you and you will eat their sacrifices.

ekegusii: “Motegerere mono onsi aya nabatebirie na moyabwate. Timwatora amarieta e chinyasae chinde; ayio taigugwa korwa ase emenwa yaino.”
english: "Be careful to do everything I have said to you. Do not invoke the names of other gods; do not let them be heard on your lips.

ekegusii: “Nabo mwerende chinkoro chiaino tichicha koengerwa nokoria bobe na ogotinda, na okwerosia kw’obogima obo, rituko riria ribachere mobosokano, buna omoeto okobwata.
english: "Be careful, or your hearts will be weighed down with dissipation, drunkenness and the anxieties of life, and that day will close on you unexpectedly like a trap.

ekegusii: "Be careful," Jesus said to them. "Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees."
english: Yeso akabatebia, “Rigereria, mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.”

ekegusii: "Be careful," Jesus warned them. "Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and that of Herod."
english: Yeso akabachika, akabora, “Rigereria, mwerende nememera y’Abafarisai na ememera ya Herode.”

ekegusii: “Tiga ebinema biaino biboyigwe, ne chitaya chiaino chioke;
english: "Be dressed ready for service and keep your lamps burning,

ekegusii: Inwe mwerende ase mwanyabanto, ekiagera barabwo nababaire ase ebigambero, babang’wanie emecharichi ase chisinagogi chiabo.
english: "Be on your guard against men; they will hand you over to the local councils and flog you in their synagogues.

ekegusii: "Be quiet!" Jesus said sternly. "Come out of him!" Then the demon threw the man down before them all and came out without injuring him.
english: Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Kira, omorwe!” Ekerecha keria gekamoiyeria agwo gati‐gati, gekamorwa, tikiamokorera gento.

ekegusii: "Be quiet!" said Jesus sternly. "Come out of him!"
english: Yeso akagetogonyera, akabora, “Kira, omorwe!”

ekegusii: “Inwe ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, mokire‐kiri, montegerere, tiga abanto b’ebisaku banyore chinguru chinyia, tiga basuke gocha ang’e, bakwane; toche amo, toike ang’e ase ekina.
english: "Be silent before me, you islands! Let the nations renew their strength! Let them come forward and speak; let us meet together at the place of judgment.

ekegusii: “Toerera, momanye ng’a ninche Nyasae; inche inde omonene ase abanto b’ebisaku, omonene ase ense.”
english: "Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."

ekegusii: Obe omokong’u na omoremu, ekiagera naye oraikie abanto aba, banyore ense eyio narierete chisokoro chiabo eira na gotiana ng’a nimbayee.
english: "Be strong and courageous, because you will lead these people to inherit the land I swore to their forefathers to give them.

ekegusii: “Mobe abakong’u na abaremu! Timwoboa gose timoondoka ase obosio bw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri na emeganda eyio ere amo nere. Oyore amo naintwe nigo are omonene komobua.
english: "Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged because of the king of Assyria and the vast army with him, for there is a greater power with us than with him.

ekegusii: Ase igo, motenene bokong’u, morende na koigwera boronge aya onsi arikire ase Ebuku y’Amachiko a Musa, timoonchoka gochia aande onsi, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.
english: "Be very strong; be careful to obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, without turning aside to the right or to the left.

ekegusii: “Indemereria ake igo, inche nkworokie amang’ana; nimbwate ring’ana ngokwana korwa ase Nyasae.
english: "Bear with me a little longer and I will show you that there is more to be said in God's behalf.

ekegusii: Naki oyo obwatanire nainche ase obwanchani nimotoorie, nimorende, ekiagera namanyete erieta riane.
english: "Because he loves me," says the LORD, "I will rescue him; I will protect him, for he acknowledges my name.

ekegusii: Bakamotebia: Ekiagera titorikiri na monto. Akabatebia: Genda nainwe boigo ase omogondo one bw’emesabibu.
english: "'Because no one has hired us,' they answered. "He said to them, 'You also go and work in my vineyard.'

ekegusii: “Obobe bwabo bwonsi nigo bore Giligali, agwo nao nachakerete kobagecha. Nimbaserie barue ase enyomba yane ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe. Tinkogenderera kobancha; abagambi babo bonsi nigo bare abasaria.
english: "Because of all their wickedness in Gilgal, I hated them there. Because of their sinful deeds, I will drive them out of my house. I will no longer love them; all their leaders are rebellious.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Bono ninchiche, ekiagera abataka baregirwe na abaremerwa nkorera bare. Ning’ee oborendi obuya ase abwo basemeretie kobonyora.”
english: "Because of the oppression of the weak and the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says the LORD. "I will protect them from those who malign them."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, rora, nindete obobe igoro ase enyomba yao aye Yeroboamu, ninsirie kegima kera omonto omosacha korwa ase enyomba yao, abasomba amo nabatari abasomba, ase egati y’Abaisraeli. Ninsirie kegima enyomba yao aye Yeroboamu, buna omonto akwabusa obonyira bwarua, kegima.
english: "'Because of this, I am going to bring disaster on the house of Jeroboam. I will cut off from Jeroboam every last male in Israel-- slave or free. I will burn up the house of Jeroboam as one burns dung, until it is all gone.

ekegusii: Nintogonyere ororeria rwaino, nintube amaiso aino nesike ye ching’iti echio mokorua chibe ebing’wanso. Abanto mbabarente bababeke ase esike eyio.
english: "Because of you I will rebuke your descendants; I will spread on your faces the offal from your festival sacrifices, and you will be carried off with it.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, ase engencho y’amabera ao amanene tikwabatigete agwo ase erooro. Riire riria riarenge kobaraa ase omobaso tiriaruete asebare; gose riire riria ri’omorero tiriatigete kobamorekera ase enchera barenge goeta ase obotuko.
