english: "Because of your great compassion you did not abandon them in the desert. By day the pillar of cloud did not cease to guide them on their path, nor the pillar of fire by night to shine on the way they were to take.

ekegusii: “Baria abagaaka baito ba kare bakarorera Yusufu ribero, bakamoonia gochia Misiri. Korende Nyasae akaba amo nere,
english: "Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him as a slave into Egypt. But God was with him

ekegusii: “Ababani abwo basiririe abanto baane, babaebereirie na kobatebia: Omorembe; na omorembe tori aande. Ekero abanto baagachire orwaki barabwo nigo bakoroaka echooka etochoganiri buya.
english: "'Because they lead my people astray, saying, "Peace," when there is no peace, and because, when a flimsy wall is built, they cover it with whitewash,

ekegusii: “Abanto aba bangire amache a Silo akwongora ng’ora, bagokire na kobwatana na Resini, naende na mosinto o Remalia.
english: "Because this people has rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah and rejoices over Rezin and the son of Remaliah,

ekegusii: Ekiagera otainyorete amatuko aria ay’oboke bwao, korende kwabeire gokongechia nogokora kwao gwonsi, rora, ningoakane ogokora kwao gokoiranere, na igo togokora ogokora okwo kw’obosooku gokomenta ase ebibe binde bi’okogechia gwakorire.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: "'Because you did not remember the days of your youth but enraged me with all these things, I will surely bring down on your head what you have done, declares the Sovereign LORD. Did you not add lewdness to all your other detestable practices?

ekegusii: “Nigo kwagendererete koba nobobisa ime ase enkoro yao igoro y’Abaisraeli, okabarua bagaitwa nemioro ase engaki y’emechando yabo, ekero baikerete engaki y’egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo.
english: "'Because you harbored an ancient hostility and delivered the Israelites over to the sword at the time of their calamity, the time their punishment reached its climax,

ekegusii: “Aye nigo gwatebete: Ebisaku ebi bibere mbibe ebiane, ne chinse echio ibere chibe echiane, na intwe tochigambere, nonya Omonene omenyeteo.
english: "'Because you have said, "These two nations and countries will be ours and we will take possession of them," even though I the LORD was there,

ekegusii: “Inwe aba mwasakorete omwando one, nonya mwagogete na gochenga, naende more nokogania buna ritororo riarisirie obonyansi, na mogokwana buna chibarasi chituoni,
english: "Because you rejoice and are glad, you who pillage my inheritance, because you frolic like a heifer threshing grain and neigh like stallions,

ekegusii: “Ritang’ani ntarakoora ogosaba ase omoyo one, narora Rebeka ogocha obegete enyongo yaye mareko, ogotirimboka gochia ase ensoko kobuucha amache, na inche namosaba: Koranche, ong’e amache inywe.
english: "Before I finished praying in my heart, Rebekah came out, with her jar on her shoulder. She went down to the spring and drew water, and I said to her, 'Please give me a drink.'

ekegusii: “Ekero konya ntaragotonga ase enda ya nyoko nakomanyete, na ekero konya otaraiborwa nagwatananete; nigo nagwatananete na kogochena obe omobani bw’ebisaku.”
english: "Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, before you were born I set you apart; I appointed you as a prophet to the nations."

ekegusii: “Omochie oyio onga buna omokungu okoibora atarachaka kobina; ekero konya ataraba nobororo bw’okobina, akaibora omwana omoisia.
english: "Before she goes into labor, she gives birth; before the pains come upon her, she delivers a son.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Agwo ase amasio aino ning’akane Babeli na Abakalidayo bonsi obobe bwabo bwonsi bakorete ase Sayoni.
english: "Before your eyes I will repay Babylon and all who live in Babylonia for all the wrong they have done in Zion," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Rigereria, ninchiche bwango.” Nasesenirie ere oyorendete amang’ana ’obobani, ayarikire ase ebuku eye.
english: "Behold, I am coming soon! Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy in this book."

ekegusii: “Rigereria, ninchiche bwango, ndetane eng’eria yane amo nainche, ning’ee kera omonto buna ogokora kwaye kore.
english: "Behold, I am coming soon! My reward is with me, and I will give to everyone according to what he has done.

ekegusii: (“Rigereria, ngocha nde buna omoibi agocha. Nasesenirie oyogesete na korenda chianga chiaye, tagenda getirianda, na abaise korora obosooku ase amasio ’abanto.”)
english: "Behold, I come like a thief! Blessed is he who stays awake and keeps his clothes with him, so that he may not go naked and be shamefully exposed."

ekegusii: “Rigereria, nintonge igoro chinyia, na ense enyia. Amang’ana e ritang’ani takoinyorwa gose takorengererigwa.
english: "Behold, I will create new heavens and a new earth. The former things will not be remembered, nor will they come to mind.

ekegusii: “Benjamin nesese y’orosana ekoria mono, engaki ya mambia yaria ebi’obotwari bwaye, na engaki ya mogoroba bwatanana ebiasakoire.”
english: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder."

ekegusii: “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariko, abanchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro, na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega,
english: "Beware of the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and love to be greeted in the marketplaces and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.

ekegusii: Kera omonto goika erite korwa ase omogisangio oye, gose onde tabaisa kwegena oyomwabo, ekiagera kera oyomo nomoitania, are na kera omogisangio nigo agoetanana gokwana amang’ana ’obogenki.
english: "Beware of your friends; do not trust your brothers. For every brother is a deceiver, and every friend a slanderer.

ekegusii: Aye nonya kore omonto bwe chinguru, Naama, Omonene nakobwate bokong’u, akorute gochia aare mono.
english: "Beware, the LORD is about to take firm hold of you and hurl you away, O you mighty man.

ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abare abataka ase omoika, ekiagera oboruoti bwa igoro nobwabo.
english: "Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abaabeirwe ebibe biabo, abwo ebibe biabo biatubirwe.
english: "Blessed are they whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abagochena chianga chiabo! Abwo mbaegwe ribaga barie amatunda ’omote bw’obogima na gosoa omochie goetera ase ebiita biaye.
english: "Blessed are those who wash their robes, that they may have the right to the tree of life and may go through the gates into the city.

ekegusii: “Imosesenirie inwe, ekero bakobarama na kobachanda, na kobatebera kera ring’ana riibe ase oborimo, ase engencho yane.
english: "Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of me.

ekegusii: Mbosesenirie oboruoti bogocha, oboruoti bwa sokoro yaito Daudi! Hosana aye ore igoro!”
english: "Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!" "Hosanna in the highest!"

ekegusii: bakobora, “Nasesenirie Omoruoti oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Omorembe igoro, na obonene bore igoro mono!”
english: "Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!"

ekegusii: “Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae akoa egesusuro ase okomorongeyia; ase ayio tobaisa gochaya ogoaka, gw’okorongeyia kw’oyore Omonguru.
english: "Blessed is the man whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.

ekegusii: “Orogongo robebekaine norwa Yuda korwa moocha goika bosongo, nigo roratigwe robe aase mokoruera okoruegwa ogochenu. Obogare bwaye nigo borabe obwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obotambe bwaye nigo borabe buna obwa kera egesaku korwa moocha goika bosongo. Gati‐gati y’orogongo orwo aase aachenu nao arabe.
english: "Bordering the territory of Judah from east to west will be the portion you are to present as a special gift. It will be 25,000 cubits wide, and its length from east to west will equal one of the tribal portions; the sanctuary will be in the center of it.

ekegusii: Abanto abanene na abake bare ase ense eye goika bakwe. Tibagotindekwa, na monto onde tari orabareere, gose gwekeba omobere, gose gokigita etukia ase engencho yabo.
english: "Both high and low will die in this land. They will not be buried or mourned, and no one will cut himself or shave his head for them.

ekegusii: “Ababani na abakuani tibamoirogeti Nyasae. Nonya nase enyomba yane obobe bwabo bwarorekanire.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Both prophet and priest are godless; even in my temple I find their wickedness," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ngokoboria nde, naye ong’iranerie.
english: "Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

ekegusii: “Orente Haroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, obasibie namache.
english: "Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

ekegusii: "Bring Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams and the basket containing bread made without yeast,
english: “Ira Haroni na abamura baye amo ne chianga chiabo chi’obokuani, na amaguta akweakwa, na eeri ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, ne chimingichi ibere, na egetonga kere nemegati etabekiri memera.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akarangeria Hamani ache bwango, erinde banyare gokora aya Esteri aganetie. Agwo omoruoti na Hamani bakagenda ase endagera eria Esteri aroisetie.
english: "Bring Haman at once," the king said, "so that we may do what Esther asks." So the king and Haman went to the banquet Esther had prepared.

ekegusii: Tiga baborente bototebie aya agochia koba; tiga bototebie amang’ana a kare buna arenge, erinde tonyare koyarengereria na komanya buna aikeranetigwe, naende botoorokerie buna amang’ana agochia koba.
english: "Bring in [your idols] to tell us what is going to happen. Tell us what the former things were, so that we may consider them and know their final outcome. Or declare to us the things to come,

ekegusii: "Bring me a new bowl," he said, "and put salt in it." So they brought it to him.
english: Elisha akabatebia, “Ndetera ebakuria enyia, mobeke omonyo ime.” Bakayerenta.

ekegusii: “Goika orente ogotongora okore okuya korwa ase omogondo oo, ase enyomba yane inche Omonene Nyasae oo. “Tobaisa koiyekera emanwa y’embori ime y’amabeere ’eng’ina.”
english: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.

ekegusii: “Goika orente ase enyomba yane, inche Omonene Nyasae oo, ogotongora kwao okore okuya korwa ase omogondo oo. “Tobaisa koiyekera emanwa y’embori ime y’amabeere ’eng’ina.”
english: "Bring the best of the firstfruits of your soil to the house of the LORD your God. "Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk."

ekegusii: “Orente eeri bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano; Haroni na abamura baye babeke amaboko abo ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio.
english: "Bring the bull to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

ekegusii: “Renta abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi, erinde obabeke bamokorere Haroni, omokuani.
english: "Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.

ekegusii: "Bring them here to me," he said.
english: Akabora, “Bindetere aiga.”

ekegusii: Na momura omwabo omonto narue oyomwabo, erinde aitwe, na ise narue omwana oye; na abana nabaimokere abaibori babo kobaita.
english: "Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.

ekegusii: Na momura omwabo omonto narue oyomwabo, erinde aitwe, na ise nomwana oye, na abana nabaimokere abaibori babo babaite,
english: "Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child; children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.

ekegusii: “Inwe abaminto, na abatata, ntegerera aya ngwekengera omonyene asemore bono.”
english: "Brothers and fathers, listen now to my defense."

ekegusii: “Abaminto, abanto b’ororeria rwa Ibrahimu, amo nabande asemore inwe abamoirogete Nyasae, ring’ana ri’ogotooreka riatomirwe asetore.
english: "Brothers, children of Abraham, and you God-fearing Gentiles, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.

ekegusii: “Abaminto, ninyare gokwana nainwe maiso marore igoro y’omogaaka oito o kare, Daudi, ng’a nigo akwete, naende agatindekwa, na embeera yaye nao ere aiga goika rero.
english: "Brothers, I can tell you confidently that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is here to this day.

ekegusii: “Oagache egesasimero gie chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano, nabo chinsemo chionsi inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.
english: "Build an altar of acacia wood, three cubits high; it is to be square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

ekegusii: "Build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.
english: Moagache chinyomba agwo, momenyeo. Rema emegondo, mosimeke endagera, morie okwama okwo.

ekegusii: Rora engaki neche, ee nabo yaikire gocha, namwatananeke, kera oyomo ase mwaye, namontige inche bweka, korende tindi inche bweka, ekiagera Tata nigo are amo nainche.
english: "But a time is coming, and has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own home. You will leave me all alone. Yet I am not alone, for my Father is with me.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akabora: Omwana one, inyora buna kwanyorete amaya ao ase obogima bwao, na Lazaro boigo akanyora amabe, korende ere bono aiga oremigwe, na aye ngochandeka ore.
english: "But Abraham replied, 'Son, remember that in your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things, but now he is comforted here and you are in agony.

ekegusii: Ase igo bonsi abarabasirie inwe nabarabwo mbasirigwe, na ababisa baino bonsi, kera oyomo obo nairwe obosomba. Abwo baraboose, nabarabwo mbooswe, abwo barabasakore, nabarabwo mbasakorwe.
english: "'But all who devour you will be devoured; all your enemies will go into exile. Those who plunder you will be plundered; all who make spoil of you I will despoil.

ekegusii: “Korende omonto orakore gento kende gionsi moeneno, karabe omobiare bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, oyio igo oramire Omonene, ere oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
english: "'But anyone who sins defiantly, whether native-born or alien, blasphemes the LORD, and that person must be cut off from his people.

ekegusii: “Buna egetunwa gekogwa na giasamunyokana, na egetare giasukigwa korwa aase aye;
english: "But as a mountain erodes and crumbles and as a rock is moved from its place,

ekegusii: “Korende inwe aba mogontiga inche Omonene na kweba egetunwa kiane egechenu, mwaba mokwarigania emesa ase enyasae ekorokwa Gadi, na mwaichoria ebikombe nedivai yochoganirie ase Meni, enyasae ende.
english: "But as for you who forsake the LORD and forget my holy mountain, who spread a table for Fortune and fill bowls of mixed wine for Destiny,

ekegusii: Ekero konya banyorire obotoereru, bagakora ebibe asore naende; aye ogatiga ababisa babo bakababua na kobagambera. Nonya naboigo, ekero barenge gokoiranera na korera asore, nigo kwarenge kobaigwa korwa agwo igoro, na ase engencho y’amabera ao amange nigo kwabete gokobatooria ase chingaki chinyinge.
english: "But as soon as they were at rest, they again did what was evil in your sight. Then you abandoned them to the hand of their enemies so that they ruled over them. And when they cried out to you again, you heard from heaven, and in your compassion you delivered them time after time.

ekegusii: “Bono boria ching’iti, nchikworokererie; boria chinyoni chia igoro chigotebie amang’ana;
english: "But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the air, and they will tell you;

ekegusii: Korende korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa gw’ense Nyasae nigo atongete omosacha na omokungu.
english: "But at the beginning of creation God 'made them male and female.'

ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani ase aya onsi nabababwate na kobachanda, nababaire ase chisinagogi, na ase chichela, namoirwe ase abaruoti na ase abagavuna ase engencho y’erieta riane.
english: "But before all this, they will lay hands on you and persecute you. They will deliver you to synagogues and prisons, and you will be brought before kings and governors, and all on account of my name.

ekegusii: “Nasesenirie omonto oria omosemeretie Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nere ogosemeria kwaye.
english: "But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in him.

ekegusii: Korende inwe mwensi, moirane gocha; tinkonyara konyora nonya nomonto oyomo ase egati yaino ore omong’aini.
english: "But come on, all of you, try again! I will not find a wise man among you.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Ase engencho eyio, rora, amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndanachere emegwekano egosasimwa ya Babeli ekina na abanto bonsi baakirwe chingoma nababe bakonakweumia ase ense eyio yonsi.
english: "But days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will punish her idols, and throughout her land the wounded will groan.

ekegusii: Timokaga ng’a inche nimbasoere ase Tata; nare oyo okobasoera, nere Musa, oyomosemeretie inwe.
english: "But do not think I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom your hopes are set.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamotebia: Omoriri oyo, obotuko obo omoyo oo oraganigwa, na enibo kwegacheire ang’e, neya ng’o erabe?
english: "But God said to him, 'You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you. Then who will get what you have prepared for yourself?'

ekegusii: Ere akairaneria oyomo obo: Omosani, tingokorereti bobe. Titwancheranete naye ase edinari eyemo?
english: "But he answered one of them, 'Friend, I am not being unfair to you. Didn't you agree to work for a denarius?

ekegusii: "But he refused. Instead, he went off and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay the debt.
english: Akaanga, agachia akamoruta echela ime goika aakane esira eria.

ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria: Nekeene nabatebirie: Timbamanyeti inwe.
english: "But he replied, 'I tell you the truth, I don't know you.'

ekegusii: “Korende ere tari koonchoka, ning’o oranyare komoonchorana? Egento aganirie gokora, nigo akogekora.
english: "But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? He does whatever he pleases.

ekegusii: Korende ere natebe: Nabatebirie, timbamanyeti aase mokorwa; karue asende, inwe mwensi abakori amabe.
english: "But he will reply, 'I don't know you or where you come from. Away from me, all you evildoers!'

ekegusii: Abanto b’ense yaye bakamogecha, bagatoma abatomwa komotunyana na komotebia, Titorigeti omonto oyo atogambere.
english: "But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, 'We don't want this man to be our king.'

ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero mwarenge ase ense ya Misiri. Timwabete momanyete enyasae ende yonsi otatiga inche; omotooria onde tari otatiga inche.
english: "But I am the LORD your God, [who brought you] out of Egypt. You shall acknowledge no God but me, no Savior except me.

ekegusii: Saulo akairaneria Samweli, “Ee, naigwera aya Omonene antebetie; nagenda aase antomete, nkarenta Agagi, omoruoti bw’Abaameleki, nigo naita kegima Abaameleki bande bonsi.
english: "But I did obey the LORD," Saul said. "I went on the mission the LORD assigned me. I completely destroyed the Amalekites and brought back Agag their king.

ekegusii: “Nimanyete ekero oikaransete na ekero ogosoka isiko, na ekero okoirana. Boigo nimanyete buna ore nekeririanda asende.
english: "But I know where you stay and when you come and go and how you rage against me.

ekegusii: “Korende nimanyete ekero oikaransete, na ekero ogosoka isiko na okoirana. Boigo nimanyete buna ore nekeririanda asende.
english: "'But I know where you stay and when you come and go and how you rage against me.

ekegusii: “Korende nabatebirie inwe abamokoigwa: Ancha ababisa baino, bakorere amaya abwo babagechete,
english: "But I tell you who hear me: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

ekegusii: “Naama! Nigo ngokoiraneria ng’a ase amang’ana aya tokwaneti ekeene; Nyasae nigo are omonene goetania mwanyabanto.
english: "But I tell you, in this you are not right, for God is greater than man.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo tinkorusia oboruoti bwonsi korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, korende nimobeke abe omogambi ase engaki y’amatuko aye onsi are moyo. Aya ninkore ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, oria nachorete, oria orendete amachiko aane amachenu na emeroberio yane echikire.
english: "'But I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon's hand; I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David my servant, whom I chose and who observed my commands and statutes.

ekegusii: “Korende nonya naboigo nintige abande baino babe moyo. Abande b’abwo baratooreke korwa ase emioro mbasiarerwe gochia ase chinse chinde, babe bamenyete ase egati y’ebisaku.
english: "'But I will spare some, for some of you will escape the sword when you are scattered among the lands and nations.

ekegusii: “Korende omonyaboronge karatige oboronge bwaye na akore ebibe, naende akore okogechia okwo omokori amabe agokora, Inee, oyio nabe moyo? Yaya, oboronge bwaye bwonsi obwo konya akorire tibokoinyorwa; goika akwe, ekiagera atabete omwegenwa, korende agakora ebibe.
english: "But if a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits sin and does the same detestable things the wicked man does, will he live? None of the righteous things he has done will be remembered. Because of the unfaithfulness he is guilty of and because of the sins he has committed, he will die.

ekegusii: “Korende omokori amabe karatige ebibe biaye bionsi ebio akorire, na arende emeroberio yane yonsi echikire, naende akore ayare amaya na amaronge, ekeene, nabe moyo, tagokwa.
english: "But if a wicked man turns away from all the sins he has committed and keeps all my decrees and does what is just and right, he will surely live; he will not die.

ekegusii: “Rora, nabeire nkogenda gochia bosio, korende ere taiyo; naende nabeire nkoirana gochia nyuma, korende tindi komorora.
english: "But if I go to the east, he is not there; if I go to the west, I do not find him.

ekegusii: “Yare koba ng’a ninche nanga nigo narigia Nyasae, nere bweka nare gotebia amang’ana aane.
english: "But if it were I, I would appeal to God; I would lay my cause before him.

ekegusii: "'But if just one person sins unintentionally, he must bring a year-old female goat for a sin offering.
english: “Onye omonto oyomo ogokora ebibe mosiabano atancheti, arue emanwa esubeni yakoorire omwaka oyomo, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

ekegusii: Korende onye omoiti oria o mosiabano ase engaki ende yonsi ogosoka korwa ase omochie bw’obotamero, agwo ase atamerete,
english: "'But if the accused ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he has fled

ekegusii: “Korende omokuani karachiche ayerenge arore ng’a ukoma boria tibwesiarereti nyuma koyaoomirwe, rirorio ukoma bwaerire, na ere atebe ng’a enyomba eria yachenekire.
english: "But if the priest comes to examine it and the mildew has not spread after the house has been plastered, he shall pronounce the house clean, because the mildew is gone.

ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria karatebe: Nimwanchete omonene one amo na mokane, na abana baane, tinganeti korua ase obosomba bwane,
english: "But if the servant declares, 'I love my master and my wife and children and do not want to go free,'

ekegusii: “Erio abwo baratigare goika baorokie ebibe biabo, naende baorokie ebie chisokoro chiabo, abwo batabete abegenwa asende, na ekiagera baangete konyigwera,
english: "'But if they will confess their sins and the sins of their fathers-- their treachery against me and their hostility toward me,

ekegusii: "'But if without hostility someone suddenly shoves another or throws something at him unintentionally
english: “Eise koba ng’a omonto igo atwomete oyonde atamogechete agwo ritang’ani, gose igo amorutete egento mosiabano,

ekegusii: Korende onye timogoseria ababiare b’ense eria barue asemore, rirorio baria moratige bamenye amo nainwe nababe buna chimbambo chinyoge chikobabeta amaiso aino, na buna amagwa akobabeta ase amakere aino; barabwo nababachande ase ense eyio mogochia komenya.
english: "'But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will give you trouble in the land where you will live.

ekegusii: Korende motaikeraneti chiira chiaino mwarire, ekeene rirorio mwakorire ebibe ase Omonene, na mobe nobomaene ng’a nase engencho y’ebibe ebio biaino moranyore egesusuro.
english: "But if you fail to do this, you will be sinning against the LORD; and you may be sure that your sin will find you out.

ekegusii: Korende inwe na abanto be chinderia chiaino komoreonchore na montige, naende timorenda amachiko aane na emeroberio yane nabaeire, korende mogende gokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasima,
english: "But if you or your sons turn away from me and do not observe the commands and decrees I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,

ekegusii: Moise koonchoka korwa asare, na mobwatane nabanto aba batigarete ase egati yaino, na konyuomerana, na igo mobe mogosanga nabarabwo, nabarabwo nainwe,
english: "But if you turn away and ally yourselves with the survivors of these nations that remain among you and if you intermarry with them and associate with them,

ekegusii: Korende komoratige emeroberio yane echikire na amachiko aane, ayio nabekire ase amasio aino, naende mobe mogokorera chinyasae chinde na gochisasima;
english: "But if you turn away and forsake the decrees and commands I have given you and go off to serve other gods and worship them,

ekegusii: “Korende onye timokonyigwera gose kobwata amachiko aya onsi,
english: "'But if you will not listen to me and carry out all these commands,

ekegusii: “Omokuani kararenge na arore ng’a ekemoa keria tigieserarereti ase eanga eria, gose ase egetambaa keria, gose ase kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa,
english: "But if, when the priest examines it, the mildew has not spread in the clothing, or the woven or knitted material, or the leather article,

ekegusii: “Korende amatuko aria, nyuma y’emechando eria, erioba naribekwe omosunte, na omotienyi tokobara,
english: "But in those days, following that distress, "'the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;

ekegusii: “Monto onde tabaisa koba omoengereria, gose monto onde tasoera onde. Nonya nabo inwe nigo mogosoera abakuani.
english: "But let no man bring a charge, let no man accuse another, for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Korende Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabanene b’oboruoti bwaye, na abanto ba Yerusalemu nigo baratigare ase ense eye, na baria bamenyete Misiri nimbakore babe buna amako ayio amabe atanyare koriegwa.
english: "'But like the poor figs, which are so bad they cannot be eaten,' says the LORD, 'so will I deal with Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the survivors from Jerusalem, whether they remain in this land or live in Egypt.

ekegusii: Gidioni akamoboria, “Omonene one, naki ndakore mbatoorie Abaisraeli? Eamate yane nigo ere enke kobua chiamate chinde ase egesaku kia Manase, na ase enyomba ya tata inche tindi omonto omanyekanete.”
english: "But Lord," Gideon asked, "how can I save Israel? My clan is the weakest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my family."

ekegusii: “Korende abanto baane tibaigwete eriogi riane; Abaisraeli abwo nigo bangete kegima konyigwera.
english: "But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me.

ekegusii: ekiagera batebete, “Tari ekero kie rituko rinene, tiribaisa gocha koba riroroche ase abanto.”
english: "But not during the Feast," they said, "or the people may riot."

ekegusii: Korende bakabora, “Taba ase rituko rinene, tiribaisa gocha koba riroroche ase abanto.”
english: "But not during the Feast," they said, "or there may be a riot among the people."

ekegusii: “Korende gento kende gionsi omonto aatananire ase Omonene ase enchera gete kebe ekiaye kegima, kerabe omonto, gose eng’iti gose oboremo bw’omwando oye, egento ekio tikebaisa koonigwa gose koboorigwa. Kera egento giatananirwe nigo kere egechenu mono ase Omonene.
english: "'But nothing that a man owns and devotes to the LORD-- whether man or animal or family land-- may be sold or redeemed; everything so devoted is most holy to the LORD.

ekegusii: Bono, komoranche mondigererie; ninde nobomaene kegima, tingokwana oborimo asemore.
english: "But now be so kind as to look at me. Would I lie to your face?

ekegusii: “Rora bono, Abaamoni na Abamoabu, na abanto b’ebigoro bia Seiri ngocha bare gotorwania. Ekero chisokoro chiaito Abaisraeli barwete ase ense ya Misiri, tikwabaete ribaga baete ase chingongo chiabo; ase ayio bakaba bakobaetanana.
english: "But now here are men from Ammon, Moab and Mount Seir, whose territory you would not allow Israel to invade when they came from Egypt; so they turned away from them and did not destroy them.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Nindangerie abarubi abange bachiche, barube abanto aba; nyuma y’ayio nindangerie abatwari abange bachiche batware abanto korwa ase kera egetunwa, na kera ekegoro, na korwa ase amakuruma ’ebitare.
english: "But now I will send for many fishermen," declares the LORD, "and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and from the crevices of the rocks.

ekegusii: "But now listen, O Jacob, my servant, Israel, whom I have chosen.
english: “Aye Yakobo, omosomba one, aye Israeli nagochorire, bono igwa!

ekegusii: “Korende bono abanto bare abake asende, nigo bagonsekerera, abwo abaise babo batagwenereti kende, anga ntababegete nonya nase egati ye chisese chikorenda amaicho aane.
english: "But now they mock me, men younger than I, whose fathers I would have disdained to put with my sheep dogs.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae oito ase engaki enke kwaorokirie obuya bw’amabera asetore, gwatotigire abatigari abatwatoorekire; gwatonyoreire obotamero ime y’Aase ao Aachenu. Nigo kwamorekeire amaiso aito ase engaki, erinde totimoke na tobe abayia ase obosibwa bwaito.
english: "But now, for a brief moment, the LORD our God has been gracious in leaving us a remnant and giving us a firm place in his sanctuary, and so our God gives light to our eyes and a little relief in our bondage.

ekegusii: “Aye Ayubu, bono inyigwe, ntegerera ase onsi aya ngokwana.
english: "But now, Job, listen to my words; pay attention to everything I say.

ekegusii: Na bono Omonene, inki nganyete? Naye bweka nsemeretie.
english: "But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in you.

ekegusii: “Na bono, aye Nyasae oito, ninki toranyare gokwana nyuma y’amang’ana aya onsi? Intwe twatigire kobwata amachiko ao,
english: "But now, O our God, what can we say after this? For we have disregarded the commands

ekegusii: Korende ase rituko erio nintige ensemo ya Goseni, ase abanto baane bamenyete; chingi echio tichigochiao, erio nomanye ng’a ninche Omonene bw’ense eye.
english: "'But on that day I will deal differently with the land of Goshen, where my people live; no swarms of flies will be there, so that you will know that I, the LORD, am in this land.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio chisokoro chiaito chikaanga koinoigwera, chikamosukeria are. Na ase ebirengererio biabo bakairana Misiri,
english: "But our fathers refused to obey him. Instead, they rejected him and in their hearts turned back to Egypt.

ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakamotebia, “Rabii, moisonde Abayahudi nigo barenge gokorigia gokoaka amagena, na aye gokogenda aroro naende?”
english: "But Rabbi," they said, "a short while ago the Jews tried to stone you, and yet you are going back there?"

ekegusii: Bono nigo tore abasomba aiga ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiaito ng’a barie okwama kwaye na kwegokeria amaya.
english: "But see, we are slaves today, slaves in the land you gave our forefathers so they could eat its fruit and the other good things it produces.

ekegusii: “Korende Oholiba akagenderera koba omonyaka goetania. Akarora emegwekano y’abasacha emeng’eire ase enyasi, eyarenge emegwekano y’Abakalidayo, yaakire erangi embariri ye rigori rinene.
english: "But she carried her prostitution still further. She saw men portrayed on a wall, figures of Chaldeans portrayed in red,

ekegusii: “Korende okorere abana ba Barisilai, Omogileadi, amaya, babe ase egati ya baria bakoragera amo naye, ekiagera ase obosani obo obuya, barabwo nabo bankorerete, ekero narenge gotoma korwa ase Abisalomu, momura omino.
english: "But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai of Gilead and let them be among those who eat at your table. They stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.

ekegusii: Gidioni agakwana nere, agateba, “Aye Omonene one, onye Omonene ore amo naintwe, nase ki rende aya onsi atonyorire? Naende ogokora kwaye gwe chinguru, ng’ai kore, koria chisokoro chiaito chiatotebetie ng’a Omonene nere otorusetie Misiri? Na bono Omonene otwangire na gotobeka ase amaboko ’Abamidiani.”
english: "But sir," Gideon replied, "if the LORD is with us, why has all this happened to us? Where are all his wonders that our fathers told us about when they said, 'Did not the LORD bring us up out of Egypt?' But now the LORD has abandoned us and put us into the hand of Midian."

ekegusii: Korende titobaisa kobagechia, genda nyancha orute endobio na enswe erache ritang’ani oyebwate; na ekero okoyiasamia omonwa oye norore eropia ereo, oyerusie, obae abwo ase engencho yane amo naye.”
english: "But so that we may not offend them, go to the lake and throw out your line. Take the first fish you catch; open its mouth and you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for my tax and yours."

ekegusii: “Ande omonto oyio nabe ng’a oiboire omwana omomura, ere arore ebibe bionsi ise akorete, korende airoke na takora amang’ana buna ayio.
english: "But suppose this son has a son who sees all the sins his father commits, and though he sees them, he does not do such things:

ekegusii: “Korende abana baria bagasaria asende; tibabwatetie emeroberio yane echikire, na tibarendete amachiko aane na tibayakorete, amachiko ayio omonto karayabwate nabe moyo goetera asaro. Bagakora Chisabato chiane chikaba echitachenegeti. Erio nkarengereria kobaumorera ekeririanda kiane, erinde endamwamu yane eerere igoro yabo agwo ase erooro.
english: "'But the children rebelled against me: They did not follow my decrees, they were not careful to keep my laws-- although the man who obeys them will live by them-- and they desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in the desert.

ekegusii: Korende ab’ekegambero mbaikaranse bagambe, bamoure okobua kwaye, na obogambi bwaye mbosirigwe boere kegima.
english: "'But the court will sit, and his power will be taken away and completely destroyed forever.

ekegusii: Korende ise agatebia abasomba baye: Renta bwango eganchwa ere engiya, momobekere; mobekere nebonyi ase ekiara kiaye, na ebikoroto ase amagoro aye.
english: "But the father said to his servants, 'Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.

ekegusii: Korende omoko oria okairaneria: Igo ngotiga obwansu bwane na amatunda aane amaya, erinde ngambere emete ende?
english: "But the fig tree replied, 'Should I give up my fruit, so good and sweet, to hold sway over the trees?'

ekegusii: Korende oria orenge gokorera oyomwabo bobe, akamosukeria are, agateba: Ning’o okobegete koba omonene gose omogambi asetore?
english: "But the man who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside and said, 'Who made you ruler and judge over us?

ekegusii: Omozeituni oria okairaneria: Inee! Igo ngotiga amaguta aane ayakorenta ogosika ase chinyasae na ase mwanyabanto, erinde ngambere emete ende?
english: "But the olive tree answered, 'Should I give up my oil, by which both gods and men are honored, to hold sway over the trees?'

ekegusii: “Korende abakuani Abalawi, abwo b’ororeria rwa Zadoki, abwo bagendererete gonkorera ase enyomba yane enchenu, ekero Abaisraeli bande basaretie bagantiga, barabwo mbache ang’e nainche bankorere, mbabe bagotenena ase obosio bwane banduere ebitinya na amanyinga. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: "'But the priests, who are Levites and descendants of Zadok and who faithfully carried out the duties of my sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from me, are to come near to minister before me; they are to stand before me to offer sacrifices of fat and blood, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Na oria omorusia ebango agatenena are, tarigia nonya nkoimokia amaiso aye igoro, korende ageaka‐aka egekuba kiaye, okobora: Nyasae, indorera amabera inche omonyene ebibe!
english: "But the tax collector stood at a distance. He would not even look up to heaven, but beat his breast and said, 'God, have mercy on me, a sinner.'

ekegusii: Abaremi baria bagatebania: Oyo nomonyamwando; gaki tomoite, omwando oye obe oyoito.
english: "But the tenants said to one another, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.'

ekegusii: Korende omosasibu okairaneria: Igo ngotiga okorua edivai yane, eria ekogokia chinyasae na mwanyabanto, erinde ngambere emete ende?
english: "But the vine answered, 'Should I give up my wine, which cheers both gods and men, to hold sway over the trees?'

ekegusii: “Korende nkiarengeo ekeongo kende ekenene kiabwate chimbaba chinene, na amarionya amange. Korwa aase omosabibu oria osimekire okaroria emeri yaye gochia ase ekeongo keria, naende ogakumba chinsagia chiaye gochia ase kiarenge ng’a keyonyorere amache.
english: "'But there was another great eagle with powerful wings and full plumage. The vine now sent out its roots toward him from the plot where it was planted and stretched out its branches to him for water.

ekegusii: "But they all alike began to make excuses. The first said, 'I have just bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please excuse me.'
english: Bagachaka bonsi korigia chintamero. Oyo bwe ritang’ani akamotebia: Nagorire omogondo, nindigetie kogenda koyorora; nagosabire, onyabere.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakeba Omonene, Nyasae obo. Ase igo ere akababeka ase amaboko a Sisera, omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’omochie o Hazori na ay’Abafilisti, na ay’omoruoti bw’Abamoabu, nabarabwo bakabarwania.
english: "But they forgot the LORD their God; so he sold them into the hand of Sisera, the commander of the army of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines and the king of Moab, who fought against them.

ekegusii: Korende bagachaya amang’ana aya, bakagenda, oyomo ase omogondo oye, na oyonde ase oboonchoreria bwaye;
english: "But they paid no attention and went off-- one to his field, another to his business.

ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo bagasaria asende, bakaanga konyigwera. Nonya noyomo tatugutete ebinto ebio bi’okogechia banchete korigereria, gose onde tatigete emegwekano eyio Abaisraeli barenge gosasima. Erio nkarengereria kobaumorera endamwamu yane, agwo ase ense ya Misiri.
english: "'But they rebelled against me and would not listen to me; they did not get rid of the vile images they had set their eyes on, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and spend my anger against them in Egypt.

ekegusii: “Korende abanto bakaba abamwenu, bakaanga koigwera, bagaticha amato abo ng’a tibabaisa koigwa.
english: "But they refused to pay attention; stubbornly they turned their backs and stopped up their ears.

ekegusii: “Nonya naboigo nigo bangete gokoigwera, bagasaria asore, bakaa amachiko ao amagega, bagaita ababani bao, abwo babakurerete bairane gochia asore; ase ayio bagakora okomocha okonge gw’okorama erieta riao.
english: "But they were disobedient and rebelled against you; they put your law behind their backs. They killed your prophets, who had admonished them in order to turn them back to you; they committed awful blasphemies.

ekegusii: Korende chisokoro chiaito, barabwo bakaba abaenenu, bagakong’ia ebigoti biabo ase ogotaigwera, bakaanga kobwata amachiko ao.
english: "But they, our forefathers, became arrogant and stiff-necked, and did not obey your commands.

ekegusii: Nonya nabo nigo obisete amang’ana ayio ase enkoro yao, nimanyete ng’a oko nakwo kwarenge okogania kwao.
english: "But this is what you concealed in your heart, and I know that this was in your mind:

ekegusii: Intwe twabarasire emegwe; Abahesiboni basirigwe, twabaitire goika Diboni. Tokabasiria goika Nofa na korwa Nofa goika Medeba.”
english: "But we have overthrown them; Heshbon is destroyed all the way to Dibon. We have demolished them as far as Nophah, which extends to Medeba."

ekegusii: "But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?"
english: Akababoria, “Nainwe mokobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nainwe nigo mokobora ng’a ninche ng’o?” Petero akairaneria, “Kristo o Nyasae.”
english: "But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?" Peter answered, "The Christ of God."

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nainwe nigo mokobora ng’a ninche ng’o?” Petero akamoiraneria, “Aye naye Kristo.”
english: "But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?" Peter answered, "You are the Christ."

ekegusii: Daudi akaboria Akisi, “Ngento ki nakorire? Korwa ekero inche, omosomba oo, nachete aa kogokorera, goika rituko ria rero, mbobe ki kwarorire asende bokogera tingenda korwania ababisa bao, aye omoruoti, omonene one?”
english: "But what have I done?" asked David. "What have you found against your servant from the day I came to you until now? Why can't I go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?"

ekegusii: Korende omosomba oyio, ekero achia korua aroro, akarora ase abasomba bande oyomo omoriete chidinari rigana erimo, akamobwata emioyo, akabora: Ng’akane ebi kwariete.
english: "But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him. 'Pay back what you owe me!' he demanded.

ekegusii: “Korende ekero omoruoti achia gosoa korigereria abageni, akarora omonto oyomo aroro otabegete eanga y’enyangi.
english: "But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing wedding clothes.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere koyaerire, ning’ee omoruoti o Babeli amo negesaku kiaye, na ense y’Abakalidayo, egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo; ninkore ense eria ebe bosa kogenderera botambe. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "But when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will punish the king of Babylon and his nation, the land of the Babylonians, for their guilt," declares the LORD, "and will make it desolate forever.

ekegusii: Korende abaremi baria bagachia komorora, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando, tomoite gaki, omwando onyare koba oyoito.
english: "But when the tenants saw him, they talked the matter over. 'This is the heir,' they said. 'Let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.'

ekegusii: Korende abaremi baria, ekero bachia korora omwana oria, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo: Oyo nere omonyamwando; gaki tomoite, omwando oye toyoire.
english: "But when the tenants saw the son, they said to each other, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him and take his inheritance.'

ekegusii: Korende ekero mwaroche Nahasi, omoruoti bw’Abaamoni, ogocha kobarwania mogantebia: Ntorigetie omoruoti oratogambere, nonya Omonene orenge omoruoti oino.
english: "But when you saw that Nahash king of the Ammonites was moving against you, you said to me, 'No, we want a king to rule over us'-- even though the LORD your God was your king.

ekegusii: Korende ng’ai obong’aini boranyorekane? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?
english: "But where can wisdom be found? Where does understanding dwell?

ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda kogora, omonyuomi agacha, na baria bebegete ang’e bagasoa amo nere ase omoyega bw’enyangi; na egesieri kegasiekwa.
english: "But while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The virgins who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet. And the door was shut.

ekegusii: “Korende inche ninki ing’isaine, na abanto baane ninki baisaine, goika twanyarire korua ebinto ase ogwancha buna oko? Ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa asore; ase ayio ebinto biaruete ase okoboko kwao nabio twakoeire.
english: "But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? Everything comes from you, and we have given you only what comes from your hand.

ekegusii: Ahabu akaboria, “Ngoetera ase ng’o?” Omobani oria akamoiraneria, agateba, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ngoetera ase abasomba abamura b’abagambi be chingongo chiabo.” Naende Ahabu akaboria, “Ning’o orachake esegi?” Omobani oria akairaneria, “Naye.”
english: "But who will do this?" asked Ahab. The prophet replied, "This is what the LORD says: 'The young officers of the provincial commanders will do it.'" "And who will start the battle?" he asked. The prophet answered, "You will."

ekegusii: “Korende, Inee, nekeene ng’a aye Nyasae nonyare komenya amo na mwanyabanto aiga ase ense? Rora igoro, na igoro aare mono, takogoisana komenya; naki rende enyomba eye nakoagacheire eragoisane?
english: "But will God really dwell on earth with men? The heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!

ekegusii: “Inee! Nekeene ng’a aye Nyasae nonyare komenya aa ase ense eye? Rora, igoro na igoro aare mono tekogoisana omenye, naki rende enyomba eye inche nakoagacheire eragoisane?
english: "But will God really dwell on earth? The heavens, even the highest heaven, cannot contain you. How much less this temple I have built!

ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino inwe abanda, ekiagera mwanyorire omogoko oino.
english: "But woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort.

ekegusii: Korende inwe timobaisa korokwa omworokia, ekiagera Omworokia oino noyomo, na inwe mwensi nabamo.
english: "But you are not to be called 'Rabbi,' for you have only one Master and you are all brothers.

ekegusii: “Inwe abana b’omokungu omoringoria, inwe ab’ororeria rw’oyore omotomani na omotayayi, suka gocha ang’e aa.
english: "But you-- come here, you sons of a sorceress, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Nonya naboigo timwanyigwerete. Ribaga ri’ayio nigo mwangechetie nkaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’emeremo y’amaboko aino, na nkabaa egesusuro.”
english: "But you did not listen to me," declares the LORD, "and you have provoked me with what your hands have made, and you have brought harm to yourselves."

ekegusii: “Ekeene, gwakwanire ase ntegererete, na inche naigure amang’ana ao.
english: "But you have said in my hearing-- I heard the very words--

ekegusii: “Aye Belisasari ore omwana oye, tibwekeeti ase enkoro yao nonya kwamanyete amang’ana ayio onsi,
english: "But you his son, O Belshazzar, have not humbled yourself, though you knew all this.

ekegusii: “Korende inwe mokaa Aberwa abwo beritete edivai bakanywa, mogakania ababani tibabana.
english: "But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.

ekegusii: Korende timoria chinyama chire nobomoyo, engencho yaye chire namanyinga ime yabo.
english: "But you must not eat meat that has its lifeblood still in it.

ekegusii: Korende ching’iti chintangi chie chiombe, gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori, tichikoboorigwa. Echio nchiatananwe asende. Amanyinga abo oyanyororokereria igoro ase egesasimero, na ebitinya biabo obisambe bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero kere ne rimisu rikongwenera.
english: "But you must not redeem the firstborn of an ox, a sheep or a goat; they are holy. Sprinkle their blood on the altar and burn their fat as an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: “Korende inwe nigo mokorikora ribe eritachenegeti ekero mogoteba ng’a emesa yane yakorirwe koba eyetachenegeti na gochaya okoruegwa gokorentwa aroro.
english: "But you profane it by saying of the Lord's table, 'It is defiled,' and of its food, 'It is contemptible.'

ekegusii: “Korende aye nigo gwasemeretie oboseera bwao, erio ogekora omotayayi, ekiagera kwamanyekanete mono, ogekayayia ase abaeti bonsi, ogechwara ase onde bwensi.
english: "'But you trusted in your beauty and used your fame to become a prostitute. You lavished your favors on anyone who passed by and your beauty became his.

ekegusii: “Korende aye Bethlehemu Efarata, aye ore omoke ase egati ye chiamate chi’egesaku ki’Abayuda, korwa asore nang’orokere oyomo orabe omogambi bw’Abaisraeli. Oyio nao arenge korwa agwo kare, ee, korwa kare na kare.”
english: "But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient times."

ekegusii: “Naye Bethlehemu, ase ense ya Yuda, tori moke ase egati y’abanene ba Yuda, naki korwa asore aye nache omogambi orache koba Omorisia bw’abanto baane Abaisraeli.”
english: "'But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for out of you will come a ruler who will be the shepherd of my people Israel.'"

ekegusii: “Korende inwe Abaisraeli, abasomba baane, inwe nabanto ba Yakobo nachorete, inwe nigo more ab’ororeria rwa Ibrahimu, omosani one.
english: "But you, O Israel, my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, you descendants of Abraham my friend,

ekegusii: Korende inwe ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, mokinie chinsagia, mwame amatunda ase Abaisraeli, abanto baane, ekiagera barabwo babeire ang’e koirana inka sobo.
english: "'But you, O mountains of Israel, will produce branches and fruit for my people Israel, for they will soon come home.

ekegusii: Amaiso ao na enkoro yao nigo bire ne ribero ri’okonyora ebitoki, na ogoitera amanyinga ’omonto otari nokomocha, na kwenaria obourereria na obotindi.”
english: "But your eyes and your heart are set only on dishonest gain, on shedding innocent blood and on oppression and extortion."

ekegusii: Na omoruoti bw’Abasiiria akamotebia, “Genda bono iga, nainche nintome rirube ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.” Naamani akagenda akairera omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli chitalanta chie chifeta ikomi, ne chisekeli chie chitahabu chilifu isano nemo, ne chianga chi’omoyega ikomi.
english: "By all means, go," the king of Aram replied. "I will send a letter to the king of Israel." So Naaman left, taking with him ten talents of silver, six thousand shekels of gold and ten sets of clothing.

ekegusii: Naamani akamotebia, “Koranche oire chitalanta ibere.” Igo akamosorora, akamosibera chitalanta ibere chie chifeta ase emebuko ebere, akamoa ne chianga ibere, agatweka abasomba baye babere. Barabwo bakabibogoria, bagatang’ana bosio bwa Gehasi.
english: "By all means, take two talents," said Naaman. He urged Gehazi to accept them, and then tied up the two talents of silver in two bags, with two sets of clothing. He gave them to two of his servants, and they carried them ahead of Gehazi.

ekegusii: bakamoboria, “Nase okobua ki ogokorera aya?”
english: "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you authority to do this?"

ekegusii: Omonene akaboria omoika oria: Nase enchera ere naki oramoebererie? Omoika oria okairaneria: Igo nkoimoka ngende, imbe omoika bw’obong’ainereria ase emenwa y’ababani bonsi b’Ahabu. Omonene akayotebia: Genda omoebererie ase enchera eyio. Nobue.
english: "'By what means?' the LORD asked. "'I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,' he said. "'You will succeed in enticing him,' said the LORD. 'Go and do it.'

ekegusii: Naende akaboria, “Inee! Insemo ki toraetere kogenda?” Yoramu akairaneria, “Igo toraetere enchera y’erooro y’Edomu.”
english: "By what route shall we attack?" he asked. "Through the Desert of Edom," he answered.

ekegusii: "Caesar's," they replied. He said to them, "Then give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's."
english: Akabatebia, “Nabo, ebia Kaisari moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae moe Nyasae.”

ekegusii: "Caesar's," they replied. Then he said to them, "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's, and to God what is God's."
english: Bakamoiraneria, “Nebia Kaisari.” Erio akabatebia, “Nabo, ebire bia Kaisari moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae moe Nyasae.”

ekegusii: “Bono rangeria! Inee! Onde nareo oragoitabere? Ase abwo abachenu, ning’o oraonchokere?
english: "Call if you will, but who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

ekegusii: “Inee! Nenyarekane ng’a omonto abe nengencho ase Nyasae? Ekeene, omonto oria ore nobong’aini nigo akwegwenera ere bweka omonyene.
english: "Can a man be of benefit to God? Can even a wise man benefit him?

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nanyare kobuna ekioma, ekio gekorwa sugusu, gose etaai?
english: "Can a man break iron-- iron from the north-- or bronze?

ekegusii: “Inee! Omokungu neebe omwana oye akogonkia, erinde tarorera omwana aiborete amabera? Ee, abakungu nabo bareebe, korende inche tinkobeeba inwe.
english: "Can a mother forget the baby at her breast and have no compassion on the child she has borne? Though she may forget, I will not forget you!

ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto nanyare gokania aba amache, tibabatiswa, abanyorire Omoika Omochenu koreng’ana buna intwe?”
english: "Can anyone keep these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just as we have."

ekegusii: Onde nare oranyare kworokereria Nyasae obong’aini, ere oria okogambia abwo bare igoro mono?
english: "Can anyone teach knowledge to God, since he judges even the highest?

ekegusii: “Inee! Nonyare gosiberania egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo? Gose bwororobie egetuse keria gekorokwa Orioni?
english: "Can you bind the beautiful Pleiades? Can you loose the cords of Orion?

ekegusii: “Inee! Nonyare komanya ebinto bia Nyasae bibisekanete? Nonyare komanya oboikeranu bw’Omonguru?
english: "Can you fathom the mysteries of God? Can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

ekegusii: “Inee! Aye nonyare kong’usa Leviatani, eng’iti enene y’okwoboyia, korwa rooche nendobio. Gose nonyare gosiba oromeme rwaye nengori?
english: "Can you pull in the leviathan with a fishhook or tie down his tongue with a rope?

ekegusii: “Nonyare goaka eriogi riao riike ase amare ogere embura enyinge egotwere?
english: "Can you raise your voice to the clouds and cover yourself with a flood of water?

ekegusii: “Naende goika orende Rituko Rinene rie Rigesa ekero okogesa ogotongora gw’okwama kw’omogondo oo gwasimegete na ogakora emeremo. “Orende boigo Rituko Rinene ri’Ogosangereria Rigesa ri’omoerio bw’omwaka ekero ogosangereria okwama kw’emeremo yao emekong’u gwakorete.
english: "Celebrate the Feast of Harvest with the firstfruits of the crops you sow in your field. "Celebrate the Feast of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you gather in your crops from the field.

ekegusii: Goika mobe mokorenda rituko eri rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ekiagera ase rituko eri nario emeganda yaino yarusetigwe ase ense ya Misiri. Morende rituko erio ebiaare ase ebiaare. Oko nakwo korabe ogochika asemore kogenderera botambe.
english: "Celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread, because it was on this very day that I brought your divisions out of Egypt. Celebrate this day as a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

ekegusii: “Orende rituko rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera; na buna nagochigete, orie emegati etabekiri memera ase amatuko atano na abere, ase engaki yachigetwe, y’omotienyi bw’Abibu, naki ase omotienyi oyio oyio noro kwaruete ense ya Misiri.
english: "Celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread. For seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in that month you came out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Goika orende Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera. Na buna nagochigete orie emegati etabekiri memera ase amatuko atano na abere, ase engaki eria yabegetwe ase omotienyi bw’Abibu, ekiagera omotienyi oyio noro kwaruete Misiri. Na monto onde tabaisa gocha ase obosio bwane namaboko amasa.
english: "Celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread; for seven days eat bread made without yeast, as I commanded you. Do this at the appointed time in the month of Abib, for in that month you came out of Egypt. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

ekegusii: “Orende Rituko Rinene rie Chichuma, ase engencho y’ogotongora kw’engano, ne Rituko Rinene ri’Ogosangereria Rigesa, omoerio bw’omwaka.
english: "Celebrate the Feast of Weeks with the firstfruits of the wheat harvest, and the Feast of Ingathering at the turn of the year.

ekegusii: “Chora abanto ikomi na babere, oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku,
english: "Choose twelve men from among the people, one from each tribe,

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Diboni, ika korwa ase obonene bwaino, moikaranse inse ase amaroba; oyio ogocha gosiria Abamoabu nabachere inwe; atagore chindwaki chiaino chinkong’u.
english: "Come down from your glory and sit on the parched ground, O inhabitants of the Daughter of Dibon, for he who destroys Moab will come up against you and ruin your fortified cities.

ekegusii: Naende Omofilisti oria agatebia Daudi, “Inchuo aiga asende, nainche ning’ee chinyoni ne ching’iti chi’orosana chinyama chi’omobere oo chichirie.”
english: "Come here," he said, "and I'll give your flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field!"

ekegusii: “Inchuo ang’e asende, moigwe amang’ana aya: Korwa omochakano tinabete ngokwana bobisi, korwa ekero keria amang’ana aya abete, inche nao narenge.” Bono Omonene Nyasae ontomire amo n’Omoika oye.
english: "Come near me and listen to this: "From the first announcement I have not spoken in secret; at the time it happens, I am there." And now the Sovereign LORD has sent me, with his Spirit.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inchuo togamberane nonya ebibe biaino biabariirire, mbisibigwe birabe se, bibe buna amagena ’embura; nonya biabeire ebibariri burure, mbirabe se bibe buna amarionya amarabu e ching’ondi.
english: "Come now, let us reason together," says the LORD. "Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red as crimson, they shall be like wool.

ekegusii: Bono ntore ne ribaga; tiga tomoite, tomorute ase engoro eyemo ye chingoro chire aa, erio totebe ng’a neng’iti y’orosana yamoriete, na torore chindoto echio chiaye buna chirabe.”
english: "Come now, let's kill him and throw him into one of these cisterns and say that a ferocious animal devoured him. Then we'll see what comes of his dreams."

ekegusii: Inchuo moigwane mobeke rigori nomonene one, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri. Nimbae chibarasi chilifu ibere, komoranyare konyora abariini be chibarasi echio.
english: "'Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses-- if you can put riders on them!

ekegusii: Inchuo moigwane mobeke rigori nomonene one, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri. Nimbae chibarasi chilifu ibere komoranyare konyora abariini be chibarasi echio.
english: "'Come now, make a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses-- if you can put riders on them!

ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, tama morue aroro! Kera omonto atoorie obogima bwaye korwa ase endamwamu enene y’Omonene.
english: "Come out of her, my people! Run for your lives! Run from the fierce anger of the LORD.

ekegusii: “Soka korwa ase obwato, aye na mokao, na abana bao abamura, na abakungu babo.
english: "Come out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and their wives.

ekegusii: Inchuo asende inwe mwensi aba mwarosigwe ase emeremo emerito, na abwo mwabunekire ne chigurube, na inche nimbatimokie.
english: "Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

ekegusii: “Sangererekana amo inwe mwensi, moigwe! Ning’o ase chinyasae echio obanete amang’ana aya? Omonto oyio Omonene anchete nere oraikeranie okogania kw’Omonene igoro ya Babeli, nere orarwanie Abakalidayo.
english: "Come together, all of you, and listen: Which of [the idols] has foretold these things? The LORD's chosen ally will carry out his purpose against Babylon; his arm will be against the Babylonians.

ekegusii: “Tiira gocha aa, monkonye, torwanie Abagibeoni, ekiagera barabwo bakorire omorembe na kobwatana na Yoshua na Abaisraeli.”
english: "Come up and help me attack Gibeon," he said, "because it has made peace with Joshua and the Israelites."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Imoka! Imoka motame, morue ase ense ya sugusu, ekiagera ninche nabasiarerete buna ngosiarera chimbeo inye chia igoro.” Nabo Omonene agoteba.
english: "Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north," declares the LORD, "for I have scattered you to the four winds of heaven," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Naama! Inwe mwensi abamore nerang’o, inchuo monywe amache! Inwe aba motabwati chibesa, inchuo mogore endagera morie! Inchuo mogore edivai na amabeere motari goakana chibesa, gose korua kende.
english: "Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters; and you who have no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost.

ekegusii: "Come, eat my food and drink the wine I have mixed.
english: “Inchuo orie endagera yane, na onywe edivai nochoganirie!

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inchuo montunyane na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’abanto.”
english: "Come, follow me," Jesus said, "and I will make you fishers of men."

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Inchuo montunyane, na inche nimbakore mobe abarubi b’abanto.”
english: "Come, follow me," Jesus said, "and I will make you fishers of men."

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagotebania: “Inchuo, tomoiranere Omonene! Ekiagera nere ototaboranire, naende nere oratogwenie; nere otoakire chingoma, nere oratoboe chingoma chiaito.
english: "Come, let us return to the LORD. He has torn us to pieces but he will heal us; he has injured us but he will bind up our wounds.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, inwe abamomenyete amo nabanto ba Babeli, imoka motame, mwetoorie!”
english: "Come, O Zion! Escape, you who live in the Daughter of Babylon!"

ekegusii: "Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Christ?"
english: “Inchuo, morore omonto ontebirie amang’ana onsi aya nakorire! Inee! Oyio tari ere Kristo?”

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Inchuo, aye osesenirie n’Omonene! Naki oteneine isiko aa? Inche nakoroiseirie enyomba ase ogochia korara, na aase e chingamia chiao.”
english: "Come, you who are blessed by the LORD," he said. "Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels."

ekegusii: Nigo agoteba, “Inchuo mbanyorere edivai tonywe, totinde nekenyugwa egetindi, rituko ri’ankio nabo rirabe rinene buna rero, naende rietanie eri.”
english: "Come," each one cries, "let me get wine! Let us drink our fill of beer! And tomorrow will be like today, or even far better."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inchuo morore.” Bagacha, bakarora aase amenyete, bakaba nere rituko riria; nigo chiarenge ang’e chinsa ikomi.
english: "Come," he replied, "and you will see." So they went and saw where he was staying, and spent that day with him. It was about the tenth hour.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Inchuo!” Petero agaika korwa ase obwato, agataara igoro ase amache, gochia ase Yeso.
english: "Come," he said. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus.

ekegusii: Erio Yonathani akamotebia, “Inchuo togende ase egetii.” Bonsi babere bakagendao,
english: "Come," Jonathan said, "let's go out into the field." So they went there together.

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Inchuo obe omotang’ani oito, erinde tonyare korwania Abaamoni.”
english: "Come," they said, "be our commander, so we can fight the Ammonites."

ekegusii: Nigo bagotebania: “Inchuo tobasirie tibaba egesaku naende, tiga erieta ri’Abaisraeli riebwe kegima!”
english: "Come," they say, "let us destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel be remembered no more."

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obachike: Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kanani, eyio nero ense erabe omwando oino, chimbebe chiaye nigo chirabe iga:
english: "Command the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter Canaan, the land that will be allotted to you as an inheritance will have these boundaries:

ekegusii: “Chika Abaisraeli ng’a barente amaguta amaya amitire korwa ase amazeituni akobekwa ase chitaya, erinde chigenderere gwoka botambe.
english: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning continually.

ekegusii: “Ochike Abaisraeli barente amaguta amaya, amitire korwa ase amazeituni, akobekwa ase chitaya kera rituko, chibe chikogenderera gwoka botambe.
english: "Command the Israelites to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light so that the lamps may be kept burning.

ekegusii: “Chika Abaisraeli ng’a korwa ase emiando eyio baranyore baatananere Abalawi emechie baramenye, amo noborisia boetanaineo.
english: "Command the Israelites to give the Levites towns to live in from the inheritance the Israelites will possess. And give them pasturelands around the towns.

ekegusii: “Bachike Abaisraeli barusie korwa ase ebitwori biabo kera omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, na omonto okorua amache anga buna chimengere, na omonto onde bwensi bwesoyirie ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo.
english: "Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone who has an infectious skin disease or a discharge of any kind, or who is ceremonially unclean because of a dead body.

ekegusii: “Bachike abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, ng’a batiire korwa Yorodan.”
english: "Command the priests carrying the ark of the Testimony to come up out of the Jordan."

ekegusii: "Consecrate those parts of the ordination ram that belong to Aaron and his sons: the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented.
english: “Naboigo oraatanane ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ekeng’wanso amo nekenama kiaye, ebitari ebio bi’emingichi eyio bibe ebitungetie Haroni amo nabamura baye.

ekegusii: “Nyatananere kera omwana omotangi bw’Abaisraeli, oyo okoigora enda ya ng’ina, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo. Abwo nabaane, na chirochio nechiane.”
english: "Consecrate to me every firstborn male. The first offspring of every womb among the Israelites belongs to me, whether man or animal."

ekegusii: Eatanane, mwerue mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: "'Consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Rigereria aya mokoigwa; na ekerengo keria mokorengera nakio morache korengerwa inwe, naende namomenterwe.
english: "Consider carefully what you hear," he continued. "With the measure you use, it will be measured to you-- and even more.

ekegusii: Rigereria ebisicha buna bigokina; tibiri gokora emeremo gose gwesisa, korende nabatebirie, nonya n’Sulemani ase obonene bwaye bwonsi tabegete chianga buna ekemo ki’ebi.
english: "Consider how the lilies grow. They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.

ekegusii: Bono rengereria, indi yabete ng’a omonto omoikeranu nasiretigwe? Naende indi yabete ng’a abanto abaronge mbatugutetwe?
english: "Consider now: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Where were the upright ever destroyed?

ekegusii: “Inwe aba mwanyebire inche Nyasae, rengereria amang’ana aya mono; onye taibo, nimbaake mbatandorane, na monto onde tari orabatoorie.
english: "Consider this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces, with none to rescue:

ekegusii: “Mobare chichuma isano na ibere ara gatano na kabere. (Kera echuma eyemo ebe ey’engaki y’omwaka omogima.) Naboigo engaki eyio ebe ey’emiaka emerongo ene, na kianda.
english: "'Count off seven sabbaths of years-- seven times seven years-- so that the seven sabbaths of years amount to a period of forty-nine years.

ekegusii: “Bara Abalawi enyomba ase enyomba, na eamate ase eamate. Orike kera omonto omosacha okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania.”
english: "Count the Levites by their families and clans. Count every male a month old or more."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Kora omobaro bw’Abalawi baria bare ab’ororeria rwa Merari, eamate ase eamate na enyomba ase enyomba.
english: "Count the Merarites by their clans and families.

ekegusii: Bagaaka eriogi naende, “Mobambe!”
english: "Crucify him!" they shouted.

ekegusii: “Oragererigwe omonto oria omong’ainereria obwate emingichi ase riicho riaye, eyio ariete eira ng’a ayerue, korende orenta asende inche Omonene eng’iti eng’ao ere na kemocho ase omobere oye. Inche nigo inde omoruoti omonene, na erieta riane nigo rire eri’okoirokwa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
english: "Cursed is the cheat who has an acceptable male in his flock and vows to give it, but then sacrifices a blemished animal to the Lord. For I am a great king," says the LORD Almighty, "and my name is to be feared among the nations.

ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto oraegwe riaaki, erinde agende goita omonto otari na komocha. Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.”
english: "Cursed is the man who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto oyoraroisie omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, koyotenenia na koyosasima bobisi, korabe omogwekano obaachire, gose oyo bw’ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa, eyere emeremo y’omoroisia omong’aini. Okwo nokogechia ase Omonene. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.
english: "Cursed is the man who carves an image or casts an idol-- a thing detestable to the LORD, the work of the craftsman's hands-- and sets it up in secret." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto ogochaya ise gose ng’ina. Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.
english: "Cursed is the man who dishonors his father or his mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto otari kobwata amang’ana onsi ay’ogochika oko, na koyakora.” “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe:” “Amina.”
english: "Cursed is the man who does not uphold the words of this law by carrying them out." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto orarare neng’iti ende yonsi. Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.
english: "Cursed is the man who has sexual relations with any animal." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto oraite omonto onde bobisi. Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.
english: "Cursed is the man who kills his neighbor secretly." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto ogotantania omonto omouko na komosiria enchera. “Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe:” “Amina.”
english: "Cursed is the man who leads the blind astray on the road." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto ogotumana orobebe rw’omogisangio oye. Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.
english: "Cursed is the man who moves his neighbor's boundary stone." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto orarare na moga ise, ekiagera ayio nokorentera ise obosooku. Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.
english: "Cursed is the man who sleeps with his father's wife, for he dishonors his father's bed." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto orarare na ng’ina biara. Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.
english: "Cursed is the man who sleeps with his mother-in-law." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto orarare nomoiseke omwabo, omoiseke o ise, gose oyo o ng’ina. Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.
english: "Cursed is the man who sleeps with his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: “Aragererigwe omonto okorina omomenyi, gose entakana, gose omoboraka, oboronge bwaye. Abanto bonsi bairanerie, batebe: Amina.
english: "Cursed is the man who withholds justice from the alien, the fatherless or the widow." Then all the people shall say, "Amen!"

ekegusii: Ekiagera aye nigo kwabwate obotenenku bwa kera egento, na ebinto ebinge kwaroisetie, abanto ba Damesiki bagakora oboonchoreria naye, bagakorentera edivai ya Heliboni, na amarionya amarabu e ching’ondi.
english: "'Damascus, because of your many products and great wealth of goods, did business with you in wine from Helbon and wool from Zahar.

ekegusii: “Dani nagambere abanto baye, buna egesaku ekemo ki’Abaisraeli.
english: "Dan will provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: Boigo abanto ba Wedani na aba Yavani bagakorentera ebioma bikomeka‐meka, na ebinsari bia kasia na ebia kalamusi.
english: "'Danites and Greeks from Uzal bought your merchandise; they exchanged wrought iron, cassia and calamus for your wares.

ekegusii: "Dear woman, why do you involve me?" Jesus replied. "My time has not yet come."
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Omong’ina, inki inche nde naye? Ensa yane teraika.”

ekegusii: Abanto ba Dedani bagakora oboonchoreria naye, bagakorentera ebitambaa bi’ebiikaransero bikobekwa ase chibarasi.
english: "'Dedan traded in saddle blankets with you.

ekegusii: Inee! Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, amo n’Abayuda bonsi mbaitete Mika? Yaya, Hezekia nigo amoirogete Omonene na komosorora anyore ogwancherwa asare. Na Omonene agatiga amabe aria konya atebire ng’a akorere abanto baria. Na bono intwe nigo tore ang’e mono kwerentera amabe amanene.”
english: "Did Hezekiah king of Judah or anyone else in Judah put him to death? Did not Hezekiah fear the LORD and seek his favor? And did not the LORD relent, so that he did not bring the disaster he pronounced against them? We are about to bring a terrible disaster on ourselves!"

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaboria, “Inee! Nagosabete aye omonene one ong’e omwana? Tinakwanete: Tobaisa kong’aina inche.”
english: "Did I ask you for a son, my lord?" she said. "Didn't I tell you, 'Don't raise my hopes'?"

ekegusii: “Igoro ya ubani eria mwasambete agwo ase emechie y’Abayuda na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu, inwe ne chisokoro chiano, na abaruoti baino, na abanene baino b’oboruoti, na abanto bonsi b’ense eyio, Inee, nigo mokagete ng’a Omonene tainyoreti amang’ana ayio onsi?
english: "Did not the LORD remember and think about the incense burned in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem by you and your fathers, your kings and your officials and the people of the land?

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene mwarenge ase erooro, mwandeterete ebing’wanso amo nokoruegwa konde?
english: "Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the desert, O house of Israel?

ekegusii: Omomura oria akamoiraneria, “Kora onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao. Genda, inche nigo inde amo naye, ninkore buna oganetie.”
english: "Do all that you have in mind," his armor-bearer said. "Go ahead; I am with you heart and soul."

ekegusii: “Naboigo orakorere Haroni amo nabamura baye koreng’ana buna nagochikire. Ogwatananwa kwabo kobe gokogenderera ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: "Do for Aaron and his sons everything I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.

ekegusii: Naende akabatebia, “Kora boigo eria kabere.” Barabwo bagakora boigo eria kabere. Naende akabatebia, “Kora boigo eria gatato.” Barabwo bagakora boigo eria gatato.
english: "Do it again," he said, and they did it again. "Do it a third time," he ordered, and they did it the third time.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gwancha oegwe riaaki, ekiagera riaaki nigo rikoukoria omonto erinde takorora ayare boronge; naende nigo rigosaria ekina ki’abanyene oboronge.
english: "Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.

ekegusii: Boigo omonto oria omoiti o mosiabano otamire gochia ase oyomo bw’emechie y’obotamero takoboorigwa ng’a erio airane ase ense yaye ekero omokuani bw’engaki eyio atarakwa.
english: "'Do not accept a ransom for anyone who has fled to a city of refuge and so allow him to go back and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.

ekegusii: "'Do not accept a ransom for the life of a murderer, who deserves to die. He must surely be put to death.
english: Omonto oitire omonto onde moeneno takoegerwa aruerwe embooria. Omoiti oria onyorekanire nokomocha kw’ogoita, nere goika aitwe akwe.

ekegusii: “Totiga omokungu omorogi abe moyo.
english: "Do not allow a sorceress to live.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa korara nomokungu ekero abwate omotienyi, ekiagera ere tachenegeti ase ekero ekio.
english: "'Do not approach a woman to have sexual relations during the uncleanness of her monthly period.

ekegusii: “Timoiroka inwe abamore omoganda omoke, ekiagera Iso oino ororire buya kobaa oboruoti.
english: "Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father has been pleased to give you the kingdom.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, timoiroka! Rigereria, Omoruoti oino ngocha are, igo ariinete emori y’etigere.”
english: "Do not be afraid, O Daughter of Zion; see, your king is coming, seated on a donkey's colt."

ekegusii: agantebia, “Aye omonto bwanchire mono, tibwoboa, omorembe obe amo naye! Tenena bokong’u, naende obe omoremu!” Ekero arenge gokwana nainche, nkanyora chinguru, nkamotebia, “Aye Omonene one, kwana, ekiagera kwambekeire chinguru!”
english: "Do not be afraid, O man highly esteemed," he said. "Peace! Be strong now; be strong." When he spoke to me, I was strengthened and said, "Speak, my lord, since you have given me strength."

ekegusii: Samweli akabairaneria, “Timwoboa! Amaene, mwakorire amabe aya onsi, korende nonya nabo, timobaisa koonchoka gochia ensemo na gotiga koigwera Omonene, korende momokorere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi.
english: "Do not be afraid," Samuel replied. "You have done all this evil; yet do not turn away from the LORD, but serve the LORD with all your heart.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa koiroka, ekiagera togosookigwa; toichana, ekiagera togosookigwa; mbwebe obosooku kwarenge nabwo korwa oboke bwao, na tokoinyora nonya ng’ake ogochaywa kw’oboboraka bwao,
english: "Do not be afraid; you will not suffer shame. Do not fear disgrace; you will not be humiliated. You will forget the shame of your youth and remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.

ekegusii: Timokumia ase aya! Naki ensa ngocha ere, ekero abanto bonsi bare ase chimbeera ime baraigwe eriogi riaye,
english: "Do not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice

ekegusii: Haroni akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, toba nendamwamu entindi, aye nomanyete abanto aba ng’a nababe.
english: "Do not be angry, my lord," Aaron answered. "You know how prone these people are to evil.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa korama Nyasae, gose koragereria omogambi bw’abanto bao.”
english: "Do not blaspheme God or curse the ruler of your people.

ekegusii: “Timobaisa koroka emeroberio ng’a nemebe, eyio abanto aba bakoroka ng’a nemebe, gose timobaisa kwoboa amang’ana boboete, gose kende tikebaondokia inwe.
english: "Do not call conspiracy everything that these people call conspiracy; do not fear what they fear, and do not dread it.

ekegusii: Nyasae akamotebia, “Tobaisa goika ang’e aa. Rusia ebikoroto biao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine naachenu.”
english: "Do not come any closer," God said. "Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground."
