ekegusii: Tobaisa koragereria omonto omotino, gose kobeka ekegocha bosio bw’omonto omouko, korende omoiroke Nyasae oo. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Do not curse the deaf or put a stumbling block in front of the blind, but fear your God. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: "'Do not cut the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard.
english: Timobaisa konacha chitukia chiaino, gose chinderu chiaino mesia.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gwesaraga emebere yaino ase okoreera abakure, gose gwesamba kobeka ekemanyererio kende gionsi. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Do not cut your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: “Inwe timobaisa gwekora abatachenegeti ase ogokora buna okwo. Ase enchera eyio abanto b’ebisaku mbesoetie ase ogotacheneka, na bono inche Omonene nkobaseria inde babatigere inwe ense eyio.
english: "'Do not defile yourselves in any of these ways, because this is how the nations that I am going to drive out before you became defiled.

ekegusii: "'Do not defraud your neighbor or rob him. "'Do not hold back the wages of a hired man overnight.
english: “Tobaisa korianania omogisangio oo, gose komourereria. Tobaisa gotanga eng’eria y’omonto origete okogokorera emeremo, tebeera asore goika mambia.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa korentera omoiseke oo obosooku ase okomoira abe omotayayi ase chihekalu, ense yonsi nigo erabaise gokora obotayayi na goichorwa nobonyaka.
english: "'Do not degrade your daughter by making her a prostitute, or the land will turn to prostitution and be filled with wickedness.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa korina omonto omotaka oboronge bwaye, ekero ekina kiaye gekogambwa.
english: "Do not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

ekegusii: "'Do not dishonor your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; do not have relations with her.
english: Tobaisa korara na nyoko. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku. Torentera nyoko obosooku.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara na moga iso moke omwabo iso; okwo nokorentera iso moke obosooku, ekiagera omokungu oyio nyoko moke are.
english: "'Do not dishonor your father's brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations; she is your aunt.

ekegusii: “Timobaisa koria enyama ende yonsi ebwate amanyinga ime yaye. Timobaisa gwancha oboragori, gose oborogi bonde bwonsi.
english: "'Do not eat any meat with the blood still in it. "'Do not practice divination or sorcery.

ekegusii: “Korende inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abasomba baane, timoiroka. Inwe Abaisraeli, timokwa emioyo. Naama! Nimbatoorie korwa ase ense y’aare. Abanto ba Yakobo nabairane bamenye ase obotoereru na korendwa, na monto onde tari oraboboyie.
english: "Do not fear, O Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, O Israel. I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.

ekegusii: Tobaisa koba ensemo y’abare abange kobarigetie gokora amabe, gose tobaisa kobakorera abwo bare abange ogwanchereria na gotanga oboronge ase okoba kirori bw’okoonchorana oboronge.
english: "Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong. When you give testimony in a lawsuit, do not pervert justice by siding with the crowd,

ekegusii: Tobaisa korua omwana onde oo abe ekeng’wanso ase enyasae Moleki, ekiagera okwo nokorentera erieta ria Nyasae oo obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Do not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: “Timoa chisese ekere egechenu, gose timoitera chiruru chiaino ase chimbeche, tichicha gochitacha namagoro abo, naende chibaonchokere inwe, chibaare.
english: "Do not give dogs what is sacred; do not throw your pearls to pigs. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.

ekegusii: Tobaisa goeta‐eta ase egati y’abanto bamino gokwana obogenki; tobaisa kogera oyomino aitwe ase okoba kirori bw’oborimo. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Do not go about spreading slander among your people. "'Do not do anything that endangers your neighbor's life. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: “Timokuna, Timoigwa, Timobwata”,
english: "Do not handle! Do not taste! Do not touch!"?

ekegusii: ogoteba, “Timosaria ense, gose enyancha, nonya nemete, goika twabekire abasomba ba Nyasae ekemanyererio ase amasio abo igoro.”
english: "Do not harm the land or the sea or the trees until we put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God."

ekegusii: “Tobaisa kogecha oyomino ime ase enkoro yao, korende omokurere maiso marore, erinde tokora ebibe ase engencho yaye.
english: "'Do not hate your brother in your heart. Rebuke your neighbor frankly so you will not share in his guilt.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara neng’iti ende yonsi na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nero. Na omokungu tabaisa kwerua korara neng’iti ende yonsi. Obwo nobonyaka obobe kegima bw’okogechia.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with an animal and defile yourself with it. A woman must not present herself to an animal to have sexual relations with it; that is a perversion.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara nomoiseke bw’omokungu kwabeire nere, gose tobaisa gotwara omochokoro oye, omoiseke bw’omwana oye omosubati, gose oyo bw’omomura oye, ekiagera abwo nabanto abamo. Obwo nobonyaka obobe.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. Do not have sexual relations with either her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter; they are her close relatives. That is wickedness.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara nomoiseke o nyoko moke, moga iso; oyio nomoiseke omino iso aiborete.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father's wife, born to your father; she is your sister.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa korara nomoiseke omwabo nyoko, gose omoiseke omwabo iso; obwo nobonyaka obobe, ekiagera abwo nabanyako moke. Obobe bw’ogosaria okwo nigo borabe igoro yabo.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with the sister of either your mother or your father, for that would dishonor a close relative; both of you would be held responsible.

ekegusii: "'Do not have sexual relations with your brother's wife; that would dishonor your brother.
english: Tobaisa korara na moka momura omino; okwo nokomorentera momura omino obosooku.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara na moka momura oo; obwo nobosooku, ekiagera nomokungu bw’omwana oo omomura.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son's wife; do not have relations with her.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara nomoiseke omwabo iso; oyio nyoko moke, omwabo iso.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with your father's sister; she is your father's close relative.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara na nyoko moke, moga iso. Okwo nokomorentera iso obosooku.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with your father's wife; that would dishonor your father.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara nomoiseke omwabo nyoko; oyio nyoko moke, omwabo nyoko.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with your mother's sister, because she is your mother's close relative.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara nomokungu bw’omosacha onde na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nere.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with your neighbor's wife and defile yourself with her.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara na moiseke omino, omoiseke o iso gose oyo o nyoko, onye moiboire komo ase enyomba eyemo, gose oiboire ase enyomba ende.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father's daughter or your mother's daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara nomochokoro oo, oyo bw’omwana oo omomura, gose oyo bw’omwana oo omosubati. Ayio nigo arakorentere obosooku.
english: "'Do not have sexual relations with your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter; that would dishonor you.

ekegusii: “Totebana kondetera ogotongora kwao kwe rigesa ri’endagera na eri’emesabibu. Ong’e omwana oo omomura omotangi ase abana bao, abe oyone.
english: "Do not hold back offerings from your granaries or your vats. "You must give me the firstborn of your sons.

ekegusii: "Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
english: “Timogambia, nainwe timokogambigwa; timonachera, nainwe timokonacherwa; abera, nainwe namwaberwe;

ekegusii: "Do not judge, or you too will be judged.
english: “Timogambia, nainwe timokogambigwa.

ekegusii: Timogenderera gokwana amang’ana obwerori, oboenenu tiborua ase emenwa yaino. Omonene nigo are Nyasae oyomanyete onsi, ere nigo akorenga aya onsi abanto bagokora.
english: "Do not keep talking so proudly or let your mouth speak such arrogance, for the LORD is a God who knows, and by him deeds are weighed.

ekegusii: Elisha akairaneria, “Yaya, tobaita. Inee! Noite abanto gwosire nomoro oo gose nobota bwao? Bae endagera barie na amache banywe, erio bairane, bagende ase omonene obo.”
english: "Do not kill them," he answered. "Would you kill men you have captured with your own sword or bow? Set food and water before them so that they may eat and drink and then go back to their master."

ekegusii: Omomalaika oria akamotebia, “Toramborera omwana okoboko kwao, gose tomokorera ing’ana rinde rionsi. Bono namanyire ng’a nomoirogete Nyasae, naende narorire ng’a tondineti omwana oo omomoima.”
english: "Do not lay a hand on the boy," he said. "Do not do anything to him. Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from me your son, your only son."

ekegusii: Morende mono, ekero Hezekia akobang’aina, ogoteba: Omonene natotoorie. Inee! Enyasae ende yonsi y’ebisaku yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane inche omoruoti bw’Abaasuri?
english: "Do not let Hezekiah mislead you when he says, 'The LORD will deliver us.' Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?

ekegusii: “Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino; momwegene Nyasae, nainche monyegene.
english: "Do not let your hearts be troubled. Trust in God; trust also in me.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korara nomonto omosacha buna okorara nomokungu; obwo nobonyaka obobe bw’okogechia.
english: "'Do not lie with a man as one lies with a woman; that is detestable.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotegerera amang’ana a Hezekia. Aya naro omoruoti bw’Abaasuri agoteba: Mokore omorembe nainche, moche asende, erio kera omonto ore asemore narie okwama kw’emesabibu yaye omonyene, na kera omonto narie okwama kw’emeko yaye omonyene, na kera oyomo oino nanywe amache ’ensoko yaye omonyene,
english: "Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and fig tree and drink water from his own cistern,

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotegerera amang’ana a Hezekia. Aya naro omoruoti bw’Abaasuri agoteba: Kora omorembe nainche, moche asende. Erio kera omonto asemore narie okwama kw’emesabibu na okw’emeko yaye omonyene, na kera oyomo oino nanywe amache ’ensoko yaye omonyene,
english: "Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me. Then every one of you will eat from his own vine and fig tree and drink water from his own cistern,

ekegusii: “Tibwekorera chinyasae korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa.
english: "Do not make cast idols.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana, “Timobaisa kweroiseria emegwekano mochie gosasima, gose gotenenia ase ense yaino emegwekano, gose chisiiro, gose rigena ribachire rire nemegwekano, ase okobisasima, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: "'Do not make idols or set up an image or a sacred stone for yourselves, and do not place a carved stone in your land to bow down before it. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gokorera omomenyi bobe, gose komochegia, ekiagera nainwe abanyene mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri.
english: "Do not mistreat an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in Egypt.

ekegusii: “Ekero okondetera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso, tobaisa koyandetera amo nomogati obekire ememera. Tobaisa gotigaria chinyama chinde chi’ekeng’wanso kie rituko rinene ri’Epasaka goika mambia.
english: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast, and do not let any of the sacrifice from the Passover Feast remain until morning.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa kondetera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso amo nomogati obekire ememera. Ebitinya bie chinyama echi nkoruerwa ekeng’wanso ase rituko riane rinene, tibitigara goika mambia.
english: "Do not offer the blood of a sacrifice to me along with anything containing yeast. "The fat of my festival offerings must not be kept until morning.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gokorera omomenyi bobe, naki inwe momanyete buna omomenyi akoigwa ase enkoro yaye, ekiagera nainwe abanyene mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: "Do not oppress an alien; you yourselves know how it feels to be aliens, because you were aliens in Egypt.

ekegusii: “Timokora ayatari boronge ekero ebina bikogambwa; timobaisa gwanchereria omotaka, gose koiroka omonda, korende monache ebina ebironge ase abagisangio baino.
english: "'Do not pervert justice; do not show partiality to the poor or favoritism to the great, but judge your neighbor fairly.

ekegusii: Moise gokora ayio, nigo morasarie ense eye ase momenyete na koyekora ebe eyetachenegeti, ekiagera amanyinga agoiterwa nigo arakore ense ebe etachenegeti, na okobwatanigwa konde tikori korakorwe ase ense eria ase engencho y’amanyinga aiteirwe, otatiga ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ay’oria omoiti oka.
english: "'Do not pollute the land where you are. Bloodshed pollutes the land, and atonement cannot be made for the land on which blood has been shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye tobaisa gosabera abanto aba, gose korera asende ase engencho ya barabwo, ekiagera inche tinkobaigwa ekero barandangerie ase engencho y’emechando yabo.”
english: "Do not pray for this people nor offer any plea or petition for them, because I will not listen when they call to me in the time of their distress.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakobana iga: “Timobaisa kobana! Onde tagwenereti kobana igoro y’amang’ana buna ayio; ogochaywa tikogotonyora.
english: "Do not prophesy," their prophets say. "Do not prophesy about these things; disgrace will not overtake us."

ekegusii: Tobaisa kweruseria egesiomba, gose kogenderera kogecha monto onde bwensi ase egesaku kiao, korende ancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete aye omonyene. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Do not seek revenge or bear a grudge against one of your people, but love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Tobaisa kogenka omosomba ase omonene oye, nigo arakoragererie, erinde obe nokomocha.
english: "Do not slander a servant to his master, or he will curse you, and you will pay for it.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosiarera oborimo. Tobaisa gokengera omokori amabe ase okomobera kirori bw’oborimo.
english: "Do not spread false reports. Do not help a wicked man by being a malicious witness.

ekegusii: "'Do not steal. "'Do not lie. "'Do not deceive one another.
english: “Timoiba, gose timong’ainana, gose timotebania oborimo.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamotebia, “Timomokania, ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaino nigo are ensemo yaino.”
english: "Do not stop him," Jesus said, "for whoever is not against you is for you."

ekegusii: Yeso agateba, “Timomokania, ekiagera monto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ase erieta riane, anyare erio bwango gonteba bobe,
english: "Do not stop him," Jesus said. "No one who does a miracle in my name can in the next moment say anything bad about me,

ekegusii: “Timogacha chinibo chiaino ase ense, aase ebigwankwa na oboboosu bigosaria, na abaibi bakobochora na koiba;
english: "Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.

ekegusii: “Timokaga ng’a nigo nachire korenta omorembe ase ense; tincheti korenta omorembe, korende omoro bw’esegi.
english: "Do not suppose that I have come to bring peace to the earth. I did not come to bring peace, but a sword.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotiana ogotiana kw’oborimo ase erieta riane. Moise gokora igo, nigo morarentere erieta riane obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Do not swear falsely by my name and so profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: "Do not take advantage of a widow or an orphan.
english: Tochanda omoboraka onde bwensi, gose omwana entakana oyo abaibori baye bakure.

ekegusii: "'Do not take your wife's sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is living.
english: Tobaisa koira mokoyoo, omwabo mokao, ekero mokao are moyo; ayio nabaise korenta obobisa.

ekegusii: “Timokaga ng’a nigo nachire gosaria amachiko, gose amang’ana ’ababani; tincheti kobisaria, korende ase okobiikerania.
english: "Do not think that I have come to abolish the Law or the Prophets; I have not come to abolish them but to fulfill them.

ekegusii: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."
english: agateba, “Timobaisa gokuna abaakwa amaguta baane, gose timokorera ababani baane bobe!”

ekegusii: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."
english: agateba, “Timobaisa gokuna abaakwa amaguta baane, gose timokorera ababani baane bobe.”

ekegusii: “Timontiga na koonchokera emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, gose timwekorera chinyasae korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa. Inche ninche Nyasae oino.
english: "'Do not turn to idols or make gods of cast metal for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: “Timorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase abanto abakoboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose timogenda ase abaragori. Moise gokora igo, nigo morabe abatachenegeti goetera asebare. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: "'Do not turn to mediums or seek out spiritists, for you will be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: “Timokorerana oborianania ase ebirengo binde bionsi, ebi’obotambe, gose ebi’oborito, gose ebi’obonge.
english: "'Do not use dishonest standards when measuring length, weight or quantity.

ekegusii: Elikana, omosacha oye, akamotebia, “Kora aya orarore are buya; ganya goika otache omwana. Tiga Omonene aikeranie ring’ana riaye.” Erio omokungu oria agatigara nka korera omwana goika akamotacha.
english: "Do what seems best to you," Elkanah her husband told her. "Stay here until you have weaned him; only may the LORD make good his word." So the woman stayed at home and nursed her son until she had weaned him.

ekegusii: “Inee! Naye okoa ebarasi chinguru? Naye oboetie ebigoti biaye namanya?
english: "Do you give the horse his strength or clothe his neck with a flowing mane?

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Kwaigure abana buna bakobora?” Yeso akabatebia, “Ee; timwana gosoma: “Nase emenwa y’abana na ey’abakogonka kwarentire ogotogia ogoikeranu?”
english: "Do you hear what these children are saying?" they asked him. "Yes," replied Jesus, "have you never read, "'From the lips of children and infants you have ordained praise'?"

ekegusii: “Inee! Nonyare gotwarera endo ebi ekoria, gose koigotia chindo chinsae chiganetie endagera,
english: "Do you hunt the prey for the lioness and satisfy the hunger of the lions

ekegusii: "Do you know when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears her fawn?
english: “Inee! Nomanyete chingaki ekero chimbori chi’orosana chikobiara? Gose ekero chinsune chikobiara?

ekegusii: Inwe timomanyeti aya inche ne chisokoro chiane twakorerete abanto bonsi be chinse chinde? Inee! Chinyasae chi’ebisaku biria nchianyarete gokonya chinse chiria na gochirusia ase okoboko kwane?
english: "Do you not know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the other lands? Were the gods of those nations ever able to deliver their land from my hand?

ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamoboria, “Togokwana nainche? Tomanyeti ng’a ninde nokobua gokobamba, naende ninde nokobua kogosibora?”
english: "Do you refuse to speak to me?" Pilate said. "Don't you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?"

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Noroche amaagacho aya amanene? Gee, aiga tirigotigara rigena erimo igoro ase erinde, eritanyare gotagorwa.”
english: "Do you see all these great buildings?" replied Jesus. "Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down."

ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria, “Inee! Mwarorire aya onsi? Nekeene nabatebirie: Aiga tirigotigara rigena erimo igoro ase erinde, eritatagorwe.”
english: "Do you see all these things?" he asked. "I tell you the truth, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down."

ekegusii: “Aye Ayubu, nigo okorengereria ng’a ayio nekeene? Gose nigo ogoteba ng’a nomonyaboronge ore ase obosio bwa Nyasae?
english: "Do you think this is just? You say, 'I will be cleared by God.'

ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Morigetie mbasiborere Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?”
english: "Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?" asked Pilate,

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a aye nomoruoti ore, ekiagera okoamererania nabande ase okoagachera emecharake? Inee! Iso tariete endagera na konywa, naende agakora ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge? Ee, ase engencho eyio amang’ana nigo abete amaya asare.
english: "Does it make you a king to have more and more cedar? Did not your father have food and drink? He did what was right and just, so all went well with him.

ekegusii: Erio Saitani akairaneria, agatebia Omonene, “Inee! Ayubu nigo agosigete aye Nyasae ngencho etaiyo?
english: "Does Job fear God for nothing?" Satan replied.

ekegusii: “Ekero omonto are ase ense, nigo abwate obogima buna obw’oyokorwana esegi. Amatuko ’obogima bwaye nigo anga buna ay’omorikwa emeremo.
english: "Does not man have hard service on earth? Are not his days like those of a hired man?

ekegusii: “Inee! Ogochika gwaito nkonachera kore omonto ekina ritang’ani totaramoigwa na komanya egiakora?”
english: "Does our law condemn anyone without first hearing him to find out what he is doing?"

ekegusii: “Inee! Nobong’aini bwao bokogera ekebaki kiairuruka igoro, naende kiarambora chimbaba chiaye koiruruka gochia irianyi?
english: "Does the hawk take flight by your wisdom and spread his wings toward the south?

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi bw’enyomba y’Ahabu orakwere ase omochie ime, chisese nachimorie; na onde bwensi orakwere isiko aarabu, chinyoni chia igoro nchimorie.”
english: "Dogs will eat those belonging to Ahab who die in the city, and the birds of the air will feed on those who die in the country."

ekegusii: “Obonene na okoirokia nigo bire ase Nyasae, nigo agokora omorembe aaria igoro mono.
english: "Dominion and awe belong to God; he establishes order in the heights of heaven.

ekegusii: Daudi akamotebia, “Toondoka, ekiagera ningokorere amaya ase engencho ya Yonathani iso. Ninkoiranerie emegondo yonsi ya Saulo, sokoro yao, naye nobe gokoragera ase emesa yane botambe.”
english: "Don't be afraid," David said to him, "for I will surely show you kindness for the sake of your father Jonathan. I will restore to you all the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul, and you will always eat at my table."

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Toiroka, ekiagera Saulo tata, tagokonyora agokorere bobe aye nobe omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, nainche nimbe oyo kabere asore. Tata namanyete ayio.”
english: "Don't be afraid," he said. "My father Saul will not lay a hand on you. You will be king over Israel, and I will be second to you. Even my father Saul knows this."

ekegusii: Elisha agatebia omosomba oye, “Tibwoboa, ekiagera abwo bare amo naintwe nigo bare abange goetania baria bare nabarabwo.”
english: "Don't be afraid," the prophet answered. "Those who are with us are more than those who are with them."

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia, “Timoichana; Yeso Omonazareti mokorigia, oria obambetwe. Ere obokire, tari aiga. Rigereria aase bamobegete!
english: "Don't be alarmed," he said. "You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him.

ekegusii: "Don't call me Naomi," she told them. "Call me Mara, because the Almighty has made my life very bitter.
english: Naomi akabatebia, “Timondoka Naomi, ndoke Mara, ekiagera Nyasae Omobui ondeteire obororo obonge.

ekegusii: "Don't collect any more than you are required to," he told them.
english: Akabairaneria, “Timorusia kobua ebi mwachigetwe.”

ekegusii: Naende akabatebia, “Timoitera amanyinga aye; morute ase engoro eyemo y’echi chire aa ase erooro, korende timorambora amaboko aino gochia asare ase okomoita.” Ere nigo abatebetie igo, erinde anyare komotooria korwa ase amaboko abo, amoiranie ase ise.
english: "Don't shed any blood. Throw him into this cistern here in the desert, but don't lay a hand on him." Reuben said this to rescue him from them and take him back to his father.

ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a kende gionsi kegosoa ase omonwa nigo kegoeta enda, kiagwa kebara?
english: "Don't you see that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then out of the body?

ekegusii: Tamari akamokania, akamotebia, “Yaya taibo, omwana ominto, tagonkorera obosooku buna iga. Amang’ana buna aya tagokoreka ase Abaisraeli. Tobaisa gokora obonyaka buna obo.
english: "Don't, my brother!" she said to him. "Don't force me. Such a thing should not be done in Israel! Don't do this wicked thing.

ekegusii: “Ekeene, inwe ninwe abanto bori, ekero morakwe, na obong’aini mbosire.
english: "Doubtless you are the people, and wisdom will die with you!

ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria akamotebia, “Kanywe, omonene one!” Agatoora enyongo yaye bwango, akayebeka koboko kwaye, akamoa, na ere akanywa.
english: "Drink, my lord," she said, and quickly lowered the jar to her hands and gave him a drink.

ekegusii: “Tabaisa konacha etukia yaye gose gwekigita goika okoorire amatuko aye onsi ariete eira gweatanana koba Omwerwa bw’Omonene. Ere nabe oyo bweatananire, na atige etukia y’omotwe oye ekine.
english: "'During the entire period of his vow of separation no razor may be used on his head. He must be holy until the period of his separation to the LORD is over; he must let the hair of his head grow long.

ekegusii: Na omwana bw’omokungu oyo agakwa botuko, ekiagera igo amorarerete.
english: "During the night this woman's son died because she lay on him.

ekegusii: “Gochakera rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, na kogenderera, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere Aria Amanene, omogambi oria arue ebing’wanso bi’ebibe buna biria amo nebi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’amaguta.
english: "'During the seven days of the Feast, which begins in the seventh month on the fifteenth day, he is to make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings and oil.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino asike ng’ina na ise, naende morende Chisabato chiane. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: "'Each of you must respect his mother and father, and you must observe my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Musa akabatebia, “Karie eye rero, ekiagera rero n’Esabato yaatananirwe ase Omonene. Rero timokoyerora isiko ase erooro.
english: "Eat it today," Moses said, "because today is a Sabbath to the LORD. You will not find any of it on the ground today.

ekegusii: “Abaedomu nao bakare amo nabaruoti babo, na abagambi babo bonsi. Nonya barenge nokobua nigo baraire amo na baria baitetwe nemioro, batarogeti bagendete ase chimbeera.
english: "Edom is there, her kings and all her princes; despite their power, they are laid with those killed by the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the pit.

ekegusii: “Edomu nosarigwe obe ekiorokererio gi’okoondokia. Kera omonto oraetere aase agwo naondoke na goichanigwa ase engencho y’amaakwa aye.
english: "Edom will become an object of horror; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.

ekegusii: Misiri nigo onga buna ritororo rigiya, korende ekiaramba kiarure sugusu na kiayorasire.
english: "Egypt is a beautiful heifer, but a gadfly is coming against her from the north.

ekegusii: Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’amaguta. Akamotebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, ikaransa bwango, orike emerongo etano.
english: "'Eight hundred gallons of olive oil,' he replied. "The manager told him, 'Take your bill, sit down quickly, and make it four hundred.'

ekegusii: “Abaelamu nao bakare amo nemeganda yabo yonsi eetanaine chimbeera chiabo. Bonsi baitirwe nemioro bakure. Abwo bonsi barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo; nigo bagendete gochia aase abakure ekero konya batararoka na bono babogoirie obosooku bwabo amo nabwo bagendire ase chimbeera.
english: "Elam is there, with all her hordes around her grave. All of them are slain, fallen by the sword. All who had spread terror in the land of the living went down uncircumcised to the earth below. They bear their shame with those who go down to the pit.

ekegusii: “Eleazari, omomura o Haroni, nere oratenenere amaguta e chitaya, na ubani egotioka buya, na okoruegwa kw’endagera gwa kera rituko, na amaguta akweakwa. Ase igo emeremo yaye ebe ey’okorenda Obomenyo Obochenu, na ebinto bionsi ebichenu, na ebinto bionsi ebichenu ebire imeo.”
english: "Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, is to have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering and the anointing oil. He is to be in charge of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including its holy furnishings and articles."

ekegusii: “Gareyia aase okobeka eema yao; orambore ebitambaa bi’eema yao. Tobaisa gotiga korambora chingori na gokong’ia ebirochi!
english: "Enlarge the place of your tent, stretch your tent curtains wide, do not hold back; lengthen your cords, strengthen your stakes.

ekegusii: “Soa ase egesieri kere ekegote, ekiagera egesieri gekogenda ase obosiru nekegare, na enchera ekogendao nengare, na abagosoa gochiao nabange.
english: "Enter through the narrow gate. For wide is the gate and broad is the road that leads to destruction, and many enter through it.

ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo banga buna riruma ririri, ritari nokomanya. Nigo bagosaba ogokonywa korwa Misiri, naende bagenda Asuri.
english: "Ephraim is like a dove, easily deceived and senseless-- now calling to Egypt, now turning to Assyria.

ekegusii: “Abaefraimu bochoganire nabanto b’ebisaku. Nigo banga buna omogati otaonchoiri kogekeire.
english: "Ephraim mixes with the nations; Ephraim is a flat cake not turned over.

ekegusii: Egesaku gia Efraimu keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Manase korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Ephraim will have one portion; it will border the territory of Manasseh from east to west.

ekegusii: Onye takoboorigwa ase enchera eyemo y’echio, rirorio ere na abana baye batigwe babe abasibore ase Omwaka bw’Omochengo.
english: "'Even if he is not redeemed in any of these ways, he and his children are to be released in the Year of Jubilee,

ekegusii: “Nonya ngoika rero okwemurungania kwane nigo kore okororo se; ogoakwa kwane nigo kore okorito kobua okweng’ereria kwane.
english: "Even today my complaint is bitter; his hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

ekegusii: Kera eng’iti ebwate ebitaago, korende tibiatananegeti kegima, naende teri koria eng’ang’ura, eyio nebe eyetachenegeti asemore. Monto onde bwensi orakune ching’iti echio nabe oyotachenegeti.
english: "'Every animal that has a split hoof not completely divided or that does not chew the cud is unclean for you; whoever touches [the carcass of] any of them will be unclean.

ekegusii: “Ebitongwa ebike bionsi bigoetanana ase ense nigo bire okogechia, tibiriegwa.
english: "'Every creature that moves about on the ground is detestable; it is not to be eaten.

ekegusii: “Kera emambia, rituko ase rituko, obe gokorua ase Omonene emanwa y’eng’ondi yakoorire omwaka oyomo etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
english: "'Every day you are to provide a year-old lamb without defect for a burnt offering to the LORD; morning by morning you shall provide it.

ekegusii: “Okoruegwa konde gwonsi kw’endagera bakonduera inche Omonene tigokoroiseranigwa nememera. Timobaisa gosamba ememera, gose obooke, bibe okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende.
english: "'Every grain offering you bring to the LORD must be made without yeast, for you are not to burn any yeast or honey in an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo are omoriri, tamanyeti gento, na kera omoroisia etahabu nigo agosookigwa nemegwekano yaye y’ogosasimwa, ekiagera emegwekano eyio ney’obong’ainereria, tebwati omoika ime yaye.
english: "Every man is senseless and without knowledge; every goldsmith is shamed by his idols. His images are a fraud; they have no breath in them.

ekegusii: “Kera ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rienekirie ng’a neri’ekeene. Ere nenguba ase abwo bakomotamera, barendwe.
english: "Every word of God is flawless; he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

ekegusii: ekiagera monto onde bwensi orakore okogechia konde gwonsi buna okwo, oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
english: "'Everyone who does any of these detestable things-- such persons must be cut off from their people.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi ababiare nabwo barabwatie omoroberio oyio, ekero bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kobe risimu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.
english: "'Everyone who is native-born must do these things in this way when he brings an offering made by fire as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: “Rora, omonto onde bwensi oganetie gokwana omoreng’anio, nigo arakwane igoro yao, atebe: Buna ng’ina omosubati are, nabo nomosubati oye are.
english: "'Everyone who quotes proverbs will quote this proverb about you: "Like mother, like daughter."

ekegusii: “Kera egento Abaisraeli baatananire asende nakebe ekiao.
english: "Everything in Israel that is devoted to the LORD is yours.

ekegusii: Gehasi akamoiraneria, “Amang’ana onsi namaya. Omonene one nigo antoma ng’a bono iga aborokigwa babere b’ababani bachire korwa ense y’ebigoro y’Efraimu, koranche obae etalanta eyemo y’efeta, ne chianga chi’omoyega ibere.”
english: "Everything is all right," Gehazi answered. "My master sent me to say, 'Two young men from the company of the prophets have just come to me from the hill country of Ephraim. Please give them a talent of silver and two sets of clothing.'"

ekegusii: “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi birankonye. “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tingwancha koba omosomba o gento kende gionsi.
english: "Everything is permissible for me"-- but not everything is beneficial. "Everything is permissible for me"-- but I will not be mastered by anything.

ekegusii: “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi birankonye. “Ninde nobosibore gokora kende gionsi”, korende tari bionsi bikoagacha.
english: "Everything is permissible"-- but not everything is beneficial. "Everything is permissible"-- but not everything is constructive.

ekegusii: Egeikaransero gekobekerwa eng’iti ekoriinwa, gokeraikaranserwe nomonto oria omorwaire, nakebe egetachenegeti.
english: "'Everything the man sits on when riding will be unclean,

ekegusii: Na ogokora kwabo gwonsi nigo bagokora ng’a barorwe nabanto; nigo bakogareyia ebitinti biabo birikire amariko, naende batambeyia emebarero y’ogochabera chianga chiabo.
english: "Everything they do is done for men to see: They make their phylacteries wide and the tassels on their garments long;

ekegusii: “Abaisraeli banga buna omoiseke omwekungi bagure, tibakonyara koboka naende; batigirwe bagwete ase ense yabo, monto onde tari orabagororokie batenene.”
english: "Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again, deserted in her own land, with no one to lift her up."

ekegusii: Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Ayio tiga abe are nainche; timbaisa gosaria omochie na koyosiria.
english: "Far be it from me!" Joab replied, "Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy!

ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene antange tinkora bo. Inee! Inywe amanyinga ’abanto bataegerete obogima bwabo?” Ase ayio akaanga, tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto Abwo Batato chituoni bakorete.
english: "Far be it from me, O LORD, to do this!" he said. "Is it not the blood of men who went at the risk of their lives?" And David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.

ekegusii: Taibo! Ayio abe aare naintwe ng’a ntorigetie kwanga koigwera Omonene, gose komotiga bono, ase okoagacha egesasimero ki’ogosambera ekeng’wanso, gose korua okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, egesasimero kere ao na keria kere bosio bw’Obomenyo bwaye.”
english: "Far be it from us to rebel against the LORD and turn away from him today by building an altar for burnt offerings, grain offerings and sacrifices, other than the altar of the LORD our God that stands before his tabernacle."

ekegusii: “Oroisie egesembe gi’ekina ase omokuani. Omoroisia omong’aini akeroisie ase egetambaa kere buna eki’egesibao ki’obokuani, korwa ase chiusi chie chitahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
english: "Fashion a breastpiece for making decisions-- the work of a skilled craftsman. Make it like the ephod: of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen.

ekegusii: Tata, abwo kwang’ete, ninganetie babe amo nainche aase aande onsi inde, banyare korigereria obonene bwane kwang’ete, ekiagera nigo kwanyanchete ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso.
english: "Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am, and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.

ekegusii: ogoteba, “Tata, koranche, onduserie egekombe eke, korende tari buna ndigetie inche, korende buna origetie aye, bikoreke.”
english: "Father, if you are willing, take this cup from me; yet not my will, but yours be done."

ekegusii: "Finally all the trees said to the thornbush, 'Come and be our king.'
english: Erio emete yonsi egatebia egetutu ki’amagwa: Inchuo aye otogambere!

ekegusii: Omorero okarua ase Hesiboni, chimeme chi’omorero korwa omochie o Sihoni, ogasaria Ari, omochie o Moabu, ogasamba abanene b’ebigoro bi’Arinoni.
english: "Fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the citizens of Arnon's heights.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Tiga abana baigote ritang’ani, ekiagera tari buya kobogoria obokima bw’abana, gotugutera chisese.”
english: "First let the children eat all they want," he told her, "for it is not right to take the children's bread and toss it to their dogs."

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Benjamin, sangererekana amo, motame korwa ase Yerusalemu, erinde mwetoorie. Bugia egetureri ase Tekoa, imokereria ekemanyererio igoro ase Beti‐Hakeremu, ekiagera obobe na ogosaria okonene biarorekanire korwa sugusu.
english: "Flee for safety, people of Benjamin! Flee from Jerusalem! Sound the trumpet in Tekoa! Raise the signal over Beth Hakkerem! For disaster looms out of the north, even terrible destruction.

ekegusii: Tama korwa Babeli, kera omonto atoorie obogima bwaye. Timobaisa gosirigwa ekero ense eyio eraegwe egesusuro kiaye, ekiagera eye nero engaki Omonene akorusia egesiomba, ayeakane buna koreng’ana nogokora kwaye kore.
english: "Flee from Babylon! Run for your lives! Do not be destroyed because of her sins. It is time for the LORD's vengeance; he will pay her what she deserves.

ekegusii: “Tama korwa Babeli, morue ase ense y’Abakalidayo, mobe buna chigoree chigotang’ana bosio bwe riicho.
english: "Flee out of Babylon; leave the land of the Babylonians, and be like the goats that lead the flock.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Hasori, tama, mogende mwebise aase aakong’u, ekiagera Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, okorire omoroberio bw’okobarwania, na nigo are nebirengererio bi’okobakora bobe. Nabo Omonene atebire:
english: "Flee quickly away! Stay in deep caves, you who live in Hazor," declares the LORD. "Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has plotted against you; he has devised a plan against you.

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia, “Ntunyana, ekiagera Omonene obekire ababisa baino Abamoabu ase amaboko aino.” Erio bakamobwatia, bagasieka ebiambokero bia Yorodan, ase Abamoabu banarete kwambokera, tibaa nonya noyomo ribaga ri’okwamboka.
english: "Follow me," he ordered, "for the LORD has given Moab, your enemy, into your hands." So they followed him down and, taking possession of the fords of the Jordan that led to Moab, they allowed no one to cross over.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, mobwate amachiko aane na koyakora, na mobwatie emeroberio yane echikire; erio nario moramenye ase ense na mobe nobotoereru.
english: "'Follow my decrees and be careful to obey my laws, and you will live safely in the land.

ekegusii: “Endagera ney’enda na enda ney’endagera”, korende Nyasae nasarie bionsi bibere, enda na endagera. Omobere tori ase obotomani, korende nase Omonene, na Omonene ase omobere.
english: "Food for the stomach and the stomach for food"-- but God will destroy them both. The body is not meant for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

ekegusii: Nigo nagotigete ase engaki enke mono, korende ninkororere amabera amange, nkoiranie.
english: "For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with deep compassion I will bring you back.

ekegusii: “Inche nabeire nkirete‐kiri ase engaki entambe, nabeire ngendererete gwetanga na gokira; korende bono ning’ake eriogi buna eri’omokungu okobina aibore; ning’use omoika na goita egekoe.
english: "For a long time I have kept silent, I have been quiet and held myself back. But now, like a woman in childbirth, I cry out, I gasp and pant.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae namanyete ng’a ekero morarie amatunda ’omote oyio nigo moraramokigwe amaiso aino, na inwe mobe buna Nyasae, mokomanya amaya na amabe.”
english: "For God knows that when you eat of it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."

ekegusii: “Naki Nyasae ayianchete ense, goika akarua Omwana oye omomoima, erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.
english: "For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

ekegusii: “Naama! Ninchike ng’a Abaisraeli basongwe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, buna obori bogosongwa. Korende nonya nenyeke ensinini tekogwa inse.
english: "For I will give the command, and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, and not a pebble will reach the ground.

ekegusii: Nimbasangererie inwe korwa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku na korwa ase chinse chionsi, erio mbarente ase ense yaino.
english: "'For I will take you out of the nations; I will gather you from all the countries and bring you back into your own land.

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nigo nyanchete oboronge, nigo ngechete obourereria na ogokora okobe. Nimbe omwegenwa, erinde ng’ee abanto baane eng’eria yabo, na ninkore nabarabwo okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwa kare na kare.
english: "For I, the LORD, love justice; I hate robbery and iniquity. In my faithfulness I will reward them and make an everlasting covenant with them.

ekegusii: Naki abarangerigwe nabange, korende abachorirwe nabake.”
english: "For many are invited, but few are chosen."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ebirengererio biane tibiri buna ebiaino, gose chinchera chiaino tichiri buna echiane.
english: "For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Kera rituko ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere mobe mokorua egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe; boigo mobe mokorua eeri ensae na emingichi korwa ase riicho, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: "For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both without defect.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli mbaire emetienyi etano na ebere ase okobatindeka, erinde bachene ense eyio.
english: "'For seven months the house of Israel will be burying them in order to cleanse the land.

ekegusii: “Ase emiaka etano nomo osimeke na kobusura endagera, na ogese ebiamire,
english: "For six years you are to sow your fields and harvest the crops,

ekegusii: Omogambi oria ase ekero egeke tancha; nyuma agateba ase omoyo oye: Nonya inche tinsigeti Nyasae, gose tindi koyiera monto,
english: "For some time he refused. But finally he said to himself, 'Even though I don't fear God or care about men,

ekegusii: Amanyinga ’abanto b’omochie oyio oiterete nigo agendererete kobeera imeo. Tayaumorete ase riroba riyatube na koyabisa, korende nigo ayaumorete igoro ase egetare.
english: "'For the blood she shed is in her midst: She poured it on the bare rock; she did not pour it on the ground, where the dust would cover it.

ekegusii: Okore ebichanga bie chitahabu chichenire bisisire, bibekwe ase egesembe keria.
english: "For the breastpiece make braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

ekegusii: Na ase egesoero oroisie egetambaa gi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, ebe emeremo y’omoroisia omong’aini. Egetambaa ekio gesiirwe ne chisiiro inye ne chinterekerero chiabo inye.
english: "For the entrance to the courtyard, provide a curtain twenty cubits long, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen-- the work of an embroiderer-- with four posts and four bases.

ekegusii: Naende ase egesoero ki’eema oroisie egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, buna omoroisia omong’aini aranyare gokeroisia.
english: "For the entrance to the tent make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen-- the work of an embroiderer.

ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso eke ki’ogosambwa kebe gekoruegwa ebiaare ase ebiaare botambe agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene. Agwo ndabe nkoumerana nainwe, naende nkwane naye.
english: "For the generations to come this burnt offering is to be made regularly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD. There I will meet you and speak to you;

ekegusii: “Naki oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomonto omonyene enyomba oyosogete mambia chuni kogenda korika abaremi ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.
english: "For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire men to work in his vineyard.

ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omokuani goika birende chisemi, na abanto barigie okworokererigwa korwa ase omonwa oye, ekiagera nigo are omotomwa one inche Omonene bw’Emeganda.
english: "For the lips of a priest ought to preserve knowledge, and from his mouth men should seek instruction-- because he is the messenger of the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: “Ekiagera babeire abatachenegeti, nabaimokie ribu ike ri’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, keria giasambirwe, na kobeka amache amaya a rooche igoro ye ribu riria.
english: "For the unclean person, put some ashes from the burned purification offering into a jar and pour fresh water over them.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Omoro bw’omoruoti o Babeli norentwe igoro yao.
english: "'For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Obobe nobw’omochie oyo oiterete amanyinga ’abanto, oyio onga buna enyongo eroisirie korwa ase etaai yaboosire, na oboboosu bwaye tibokorwao. Orusie korwa imeo egetari ase egetari otari gochora ng’a nkereki okorusia.
english: "'For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Woe to the city of bloodshed, to the pot now encrusted, whose deposit will not go away! Empty it piece by piece without casting lots for them.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora, nindete omoruoti ore omonene kobua abaruoti bande bonsi, Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, ache korwa sugusu amo ne chibarasi, ne chigari, na abariini be chibarasi, na omoganda omonene bw’abarwani esegi.
english: "For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: From the north I am going to bring against Tyre Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, king of kings, with horses and chariots, with horsemen and a great army.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Naki erabe emechando emenene goetania ekero ndatome ase Yerusalemu ebisusuro biane bine: omoro, na enchara, ne ching’iti chintindi, na oborwaire bogoita, erinde ng’ite na gosiria mwanyabanto amo ne ching’iti!
english: "For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem my four dreadful judgments-- sword and famine and wild beasts and plague-- to kill its men and their animals!

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Naama! Ninkobeke ase amaboko ’abanto abwo ogechete, baria kwagechetigwe nabarabwo okabatiga.
english: "For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to hand you over to those you hate, to those you turned away from in disgust.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Naama! Ninche bweka omonyene ndarigie ching’ondi chiane, nchinyore na gochirenda.
english: "'For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself will search for my sheep and look after them.

ekegusii: Igo arikire, “Ase engencho eyio, omonto natige ise na ng’ina abwatane na mokaye, na abwo babere nababe omobere oyomo.”
english: "For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh."

ekegusii: Naki Daudi, ekero akoorire gokorera ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase ekegori kiaye, agakwa, agatindekwa ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegete, akarora ogosareka.
english: "For when David had served God's purpose in his own generation, he fell asleep; he was buried with his fathers and his body decayed.

ekegusii: “Naki ning’o omanyete ebirengererio bi’Omonene, erinde amworokererie?” Korende intwe ntore nebirengererio bia Kristo.
english: "For who has known the mind of the Lord that he may instruct him?" But we have the mind of Christ.

ekegusii: “Orobebe rwaino rwa moocha rochakere korwa Hasari‐Enani, roikere Sefamu,
english: "'For your eastern boundary, run a line from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

ekegusii: “Orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu ndochakere korwa ase Enyancha Enene, rogenderere gochia ase egetunwa kia Hori.
english: "'For your northern boundary, run a line from the Great Sea to Mount Hor

ekegusii: Naki narikire ase ebuku ya Zaburi: “Obomenyo bwaye botigare bosa, nonya monto onde tabaisa komenyao; na: Oboteneneri bwaye omoao aboire.
english: "For," said Peter, "it is written in the book of Psalms, "'May his place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in it,' and, "'May another take his place of leadership.'

ekegusii: “Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao mbaagache chindwaki chiao, na abaruoti babo mbabe bakogokorera. Ekero narenge nendamwamu, nigo nakorenterete amaakwa, korende ase obwanchani bwane nakororeire amabera.
english: "Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you. Though in anger I struck you, in favor I will show you compassion.

ekegusii: “Timobaisa koinyora amang’ana a kare, gose korengereria igoro y’ebinto biaetire.
english: "Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past.

ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bine ebisinini mono ase ense, korende bire nobong’aini obonge, nabio ebi:
english: "Four things on earth are small, yet they are extremely wise:

ekegusii: “Otomire omorero korwa igoro osambire amauga aane oyabuire, otegire oboreba ase amagoro aane; ong’iranirie nyuma; ontigire inde bosa, ntari ne chinguru omobaso boira.
english: "From on high he sent fire, sent it down into my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.

ekegusii: Na ekero Petero amoiraneria, “Nkorwa ase abande,” Yeso akamotebia, “Rirorio abana babo barabwo nabasibore.
english: "From others," Peter answered. "Then the sons are exempt," Jesus said to him.

ekegusii: “Mobare chichuma isano na ibere korwa ase rituko rigotunyana eri’Esabato, rituko riria mokorentera Omonene riboa ri’ogotongora rigosungusigwa.
english: "'From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, count off seven full weeks.

ekegusii: Naki abanto babo bonsi, korwa omoke goika omonene, nigo bare ne ribero ri’okonyora ebitoki bi’obong’ainereria. Abakuani na ababani boigo nigo bagokora amang’ana ’oborimo.
english: "From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.

ekegusii: “Korwa ase engaki eyio ebing’wanso bia kera rituko mbirusigwe aroro, na okogechia kw’ogosaria ngotenenigweo, nabe amatuko elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo kianda (1,290).
english: "From the time that the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination that causes desolation is set up, there will be 1,290 days.

ekegusii: Korwa ase oroiboro rw’omonto oyio Nyasae orenteire Abaisraeli Omotooria, nere Yeso. Nabo abarierete eira.
english: "From this man's descendants God has brought to Israel the Savior Jesus, as he promised.

ekegusii: “Otebie abanto aba ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteba: Rora, nabekire ase amasio aino enchera y’obogima na ey’amakweri.
english: "Furthermore, tell the people, 'This is what the LORD says: See, I am setting before you the way of life and the way of death.

ekegusii: “Gadi namigwe nemeganda y’esegi, korende nere nabamige korwa nyuma.
english: "Gad will be attacked by a band of raiders, but he will attack them at their heels.

ekegusii: Egesaku kia Gadi keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Sabuloni korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Gad will have one portion; it will border the territory of Zebulun from east to west.

ekegusii: “Sangereria abanto baane abegenwa bache asende, abwo bakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainche ase okorua ebing’wanso.”
english: "Gather to me my consecrated ones, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice."

ekegusii: “Inwe abamore abatigari korwa ase ebisaku, sangererekana amo mosuke gocha ang’e! Abanto abwo bakobogoria emegwekano egosasimwa eroisirie korwa ase emete, abwo bagendererete gosaba chinyasae chitanyare kobatooria, tibari nokomanya.
english: "Gather together and come; assemble, you fugitives from the nations. Ignorant are those who carry about idols of wood, who pray to gods that cannot save.

ekegusii: “Karue ase omoganda oyo, otigere gochia aare, erio inche mbasirie ara rimo.” Musa na Haroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.
english: "Get away from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once." And they fell facedown.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamotebia, “Karuo!” Naende bagatebania, “Omonto oyo nomomenyi are aa seito, na bono nigo arigetie kogamba! Bono nigo toragokorere bobe mono kobua buna nanga tware gokorera abanto abwo.” Erio bagatwoma‐twoma Loti mono, bagaika ang’e gosaria egesieri.
english: "Get out of our way," they replied. And they said, "This fellow came here as an alien, and now he wants to play the judge! We'll treat you worse than them." They kept bringing pressure on Lot and moved forward to break down the door.

ekegusii: "'Get ready; be prepared, you and all the hordes gathered about you, and take command of them.
english: Eariganie, bwebeke ang’e, aye amo nomoganda oyio osangererekanire asore. Aye obe omoraai obo.

ekegusii: Korende aye kabe omoremu, oimoke, ogende obatebie amang’ana onsi nkogochika. Tobaisa koboboa. Oise koboboa, inche nigo ndakwoboyie ase amasio abo.
english: "Get yourself ready! Stand up and say to them whatever I command you. Do not be terrified by them, or I will terrify you before them.

ekegusii: “Moe Haroni amo nabamura baye ogochika oko igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa; Ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kebeere igoro ase egesasimero obotuko bwonsi goika mambia, na omorero bw’egesasmiero orendwe ogenderere gwoka.
english: "Give Aaron and his sons this command: 'These are the regulations for the burnt offering: The burnt offering is to remain on the altar hearth throughout the night, till morning, and the fire must be kept burning on the altar.

ekegusii: Elija agatebia omokungu oria, “Renta omwana oyio oo asende.” Akaimokia omwana oria korwa ase egekuba kiaye, akamoira goika ase akanyomba ka irongo ase amenyete, akaareria omwana oria ase oborere bwaye.
english: "Give me your son," Elijah replied. He took him from her arms, carried him to the upper room where he was staying, and laid him on his bed.

ekegusii: Aye omonyene obe ntenenera asende, imbe asore. Inee! Ning’o rende oranyare kwerua abe ntenenera asende?
english: "Give me, O God, the pledge you demand. Who else will put up security for me?

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli obachike ng’a ase ekero keria kerageire goika banduere ebing’wanso na okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
english: "Give this command to the Israelites and say to them: 'See that you present to me at the appointed time the food for my offerings made by fire, as an aroma pleasing to me.'

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteba: “Tosemie, tokorere ay’oboronge, tokendererie inse y’ekiriri kiaino mobaso gati. Tobise intwe abatwaserigwe, timobaisa gotorua intwe abatwatamire.
english: "Give us counsel, render a decision. Make your shadow like night-- at high noon. Hide the fugitives, do not betray the refugees.

ekegusii: “Obonene ase Nyasae ore Igoro Mono, na ase ense omorembe, ase abanto bagweneirwe nere.”
english: "Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom his favor rests."

ekegusii: “Genda moborie momanye korwa ase Omonene igoro yane, na igoro y’abanto baito, na igoro y’Abayuda bonsi, tomanye amang’ana are ase ebuku eye yanyorekanire. Endamwamu y’Omonene yokire asetore, ekiagera chisokoro chiaito tichiaigwerete amang’ana ’ebuku eye, na tichiakorete aya onsi arikire ase engencho yaito.”
english: "Go and inquire of the LORD for me and for the people and for all Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the LORD's anger that burns against us because our fathers have not obeyed the words of this book; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written there concerning us."

ekegusii: “Genda, moborie momanye korwa ase Omonene igoro yane na igoro y’abatigari b’Abaisraeli na ab’Abayuda, tomanye amang’ana are ase ebuku eye yanyorekanire. Endamwamu y’Omonene nentindi mono asetore, ekiagera chisokoro chiaito tichiaigwerete ring’ana ri’Omonene, naende tichiakorete onsi aya arikire ase ebuku eye.”
english: "Go and inquire of the LORD for me and for the remnant in Israel and Judah about what is written in this book that has been found. Great is the LORD's anger that is poured out on us because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD; they have not acted in accordance with all that is written in this book."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Elija agatebia omosomba oye, “Tiira gochia igoro, origererie gochia ase enyancha.” Omosomba oye agatiira, akarigereria, akamotebia, “Tindochi gento kende.” Ase chintunda isano na ibere Elija akamotebia, “Genda origererie!”
english: "Go and look toward the sea," he told his servant. And he went up and looked. "There is nothing there," he said. Seven times Elijah said, "Go back."

ekegusii: “Genda orarie ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Nainyoire buna kwarenge omwegenwa ekero kwarenge omoke, buna kwanyanchete ekero kwarenge omoriakari one, naende buna kwabete kogontunyana agwo ase erooro, ense eria etarenge gosimekwa kende kiameo.
english: "Go and proclaim in the hearing of Jerusalem: "'I remember the devotion of your youth, how as a bride you loved me and followed me through the desert, through a land not sown.

ekegusii: “Genda okwane na Daudi, omotebie ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Nabekire asore amang’ana atato; ase ayio chora erimo, eri ndagokorere.”
english: "Go and tell David, 'This is what the LORD says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.'"

ekegusii: “Genda okwane na Daudi, omotebie ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteba: Nabekire asore amang’ana atato; ase ayio chora erimo, eri ngochia kogokorera.”
english: "Go and tell David, 'This is what the LORD says: I am giving you three options. Choose one of them for me to carry out against you.'"

ekegusii: “Genda, otebie Obedi‐Meleki, Omoetiopia oria, ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Naama! Amang’ana aane nakwanete igoro ase omochie oyo ninyaikeranie, tari ase okoyorentera amaya, korende ninyorentere obobe. Aye nobeo ase rituko erio orore buna agokoreka.
english: "Go and tell Ebed-Melech the Cushite, 'This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am about to fulfill my words against this city through disaster, not prosperity. At that time they will be fulfilled before your eyes.

ekegusii: “Genda otebie Hanania ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Aye nkwabuna rikorogoto ri’omote, korende ribaga ri’erio Omonene naroisie eri’ekioma.
english: "Go and tell Hananiah, 'This is what the LORD says: You have broken a wooden yoke, but in its place you will get a yoke of iron.

ekegusii: “Irana otebie Hezekia ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi sokoro yaye, nigo ngoteba iga: Naigure ogosaba kwao, narorire amariga ao. Rora, nakomentire emiaka ikomi na etano ase obogima bwao.
english: "Go and tell Hezekiah, 'This is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will add fifteen years to your life.

ekegusii: “Genda otebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Inee! Nong’agachere enyomba ndamenye imeo?
english: "Go and tell my servant David, 'This is what the LORD says: Are you the one to build me a house to dwell in?

ekegusii: “Genda otebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Aye tokong’agachera enyomba imenye imeo.
english: "Go and tell my servant David, 'This is what the LORD says: You are not the one to build me a house to dwell in.

ekegusii: “Imoka, ogende goika Sarefata, omochie o Sidoni omenye aroro. Rora nachikire omokungu omoboraka aroro orakoragerie.”
english: "Go at once to Zarephath of Sidon and stay there. I have commanded a widow in that place to supply you with food."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia Hamani, “Genda bono bwango, oire chianga chiria na ebarasi eria, okorere Moredekai, Omoyahudi oyio ore ase egeita kiane, inche omoruoti, buna gwateba. Tobaisa kweba nonya ne ring’ana erimo ase aria gwateba.”
english: "Go at once," the king commanded Haman. "Get the robe and the horse and do just as you have suggested for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king's gate. Do not neglect anything you have recommended."

ekegusii: Abanto bakagobera, bakabora, “Karue aa! Inwe timochenegeti! Karue aa! Karue aa! Timokuna abanto!” Ase ayio barabwo bagatama na koombogana. Abanto b’ebisaku bakabakwana bakabora, “Tibakogenderera komenya asetore.”
english: "Go away! You are unclean!" men cry to them. "Away! Away! Don't touch us!" When they flee and wander about, people among the nations say, "They can stay here no longer."

ekegusii: “Irana otebie Hezekia, omoraai bw’abanto baane, ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi, sokoro yaye, nigo ngoteba iga: Naigure ogosaba kwao, narorire amariga ao. Rora, ninkogwenie. Rituko ria gatato notiire ogende ase enyomba yane, inche Omonene.
english: "Go back and tell Hezekiah, the leader of my people, 'This is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears; I will heal you. On the third day from now you will go up to the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio ontang’anere gotirimboka gochia Giligali. Inche ninchiche aroro asore ase okorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe. Onganye aroro ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere goika inchiche asore, nkworokie aya ogwenerete gokora.”
english: "Go down ahead of me to Gilgal. I will surely come down to you to sacrifice burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, but you must wait seven days until I come to you and tell you what you are to do."

ekegusii: “Imoka, otirimboke oumerane n’Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, oyio omenyete Samaria. Rora nao are ase omogondo bw’emesabibu o Naboti, agwo ogendire koyoira obe oyoye.
english: "Go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who rules in Samaria. He is now in Naboth's vineyard, where he has gone to take possession of it.

ekegusii: “Imoka, otirimboke, ogende ase enyomba y’omokori chinyongo, ningotebie amang’ana aane.”
english: "Go down to the potter's house, and there I will give you my message."

ekegusii: “Aye Babeli onga buna omoi seke omwekungi, aye omochie bw’Abakalidayo, ika korwa agwo, ikaransa ase amaroba otari nekerogo ki’obonene! Bono tokorokwa omwororo na omwereria nonya ng’ake.
english: "Go down, sit in the dust, Virgin Daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, Daughter of the Babylonians. No more will you be called tender or delicate.

ekegusii: Elisha akamotebia, “Genda nomorembe.” Korende ekero Naamani arure asare, agendire egeka egeke korwa aroro,
english: "Go in peace," Elisha said. After Naaman had traveled some distance,

ekegusii: Genda bono aase nechorerete agwo Silo; agwo nao ritang’ani nabegete erieta riane rimenyeo. Mwerorere egento nakorete aase aria ase engencho y’obokayayu bw’abanto baane Abaisraeli.
english: "'Go now to the place in Shiloh where I first made a dwelling for my Name, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel.

ekegusii: “Genda moriine ase chindwaki chi’omochie oyio moyosarie, korende timoyokoora kegima. Moarorie chinsagia chi’emesabibu yaye chirueo, ekiagera echio tichiri echi’Omonene.
english: "Go through her vineyards and ravage them, but do not destroy them completely. Strip off her branches, for these people do not belong to the LORD.

ekegusii: ng’a baete egati y’ebitwori batebie abanto ng’a beroiserie endagera, ekiagera ritang’ani amatuko atato ataraera inabamboke orooche oro rwa Yorodan, baire ense eyio Omonene, Nyasae obo, abaeire ebe eyabo.
english: "Go through the camp and tell the people, 'Get your supplies ready. Three days from now you will cross the Jordan here to go in and take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving you for your own.'"

ekegusii: Yonadabu akamotebia, “Genda orare borere, bwekore buna nomorwaire ore. Na ekero iso arache gokorora, omotebie; Koranche otebie Tamari ominto ache andoiserie endagera aa ase ndoche, erinde andagerie nokoboko kwaye.”
english: "Go to bed and pretend to be ill," Jonadab said. "When your father comes to see you, say to him, 'I would like my sister Tamar to come and give me something to eat. Let her prepare the food in my sight so I may watch her and then eat it from her hand.'"

ekegusii: “Inchuo Beteli, mokorere ebibe aroro; boigo inchuo Giligali, momente gokora ebibe aroro. Kera emambia mobe mokorenta ebing’wanso biaino; na ase kera rituko ria gatato morente ensemo yaino ya ikomi.
english: "Go to Bethel and sin; go to Gilgal and sin yet more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three years.

ekegusii: “Imoka ogende Nineva, omochie oria omonene, oake eriogi ri’okoyokurera, ekiagera ogokora kwaye okobe gwaikire ase obosio bwane.”
english: "Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before me."

ekegusii: “Imoka ogende Nineva, omochie oria omonene, erio orarieo amang’ana ndagotebie.”
english: "Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message I give you."

ekegusii: “Genda ase abanto b’eamate ya Rekabu, okwane nabarabwo, obarente ase eero eyemo y’enyomba y’Omonene, obae edivai banywe.”
english: "Go to the Recabite family and invite them to come to one of the side rooms of the house of the LORD and give them wine to drink."

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Genda goika agachie karia mokoorokera; kamwasoire ime, inamorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyesibore moyendetere.
english: "Go to the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

ekegusii: “Genda ase abanto aba, obatebie: Okoigwa namoigwe, korende timokomanya nonya ng’ake, na okorora namorore, korende timoyarengereria nonya ng’ake.
english: "'Go to this people and say, "You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving."

ekegusii: Minyoka gochia aaria na aaria ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu, morigererie na komanya. Moriga‐rigie ase chichiiro morore gose monyore omonto oyomo ogokora oboronge na korigia ekeene, erinde inche Omonene inyare kwabera omochie oyo.
english: "Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem, look around and consider, search through her squares. If you can find but one person who deals honestly and seeks the truth, I will forgive this city.

ekegusii: “Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa bi’Abarimu, ase egetunwa kia Nebo, kere ase ense ya Moabu, kororia Yeriko, erio origererie ense ya Kanani eyio ngochia koa Abaisraeli ebe eyabo.
english: "Go up into the Abarim Range to Mount Nebo in Moab, across from Jericho, and view Canaan, the land I am giving the Israelites as their own possession.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Misiri more buna abaiseke abekungi, tiira gochia ase Gileadi monyore amaguta akogwenia. Namoisa konyora amariogo amange a bosa asemore, okogwenigwa tikori asemore.
english: "Go up to Gilead and get balm, O Virgin Daughter of Egypt. But you multiply remedies in vain; there is no healing for you.

ekegusii: “Genda ase Hilikia, omokuani omonene, omoborie abare chibesa chiarentirwe ase enyomba y’Omonene, echio abarendi b’egesieri basangereirie korwa ase abanto.
english: "Go up to Hilkiah the high priest and have him get ready the money that has been brought into the temple of the LORD, which the doorkeepers have collected from the people.

ekegusii: Tiira gochia Lebanoni, morere, moake amariogi agwo Basani, morere korwa Abarimu, ekiagera abanchwa bao basirigwe.
english: "Go up to Lebanon and cry out, let your voice be heard in Bashan, cry out from Abarim, for all your allies are crushed.

ekegusii: Genda, osangererie abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a: Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nang’orokera, agantebia ng’a mbatebie: Amaene, narorire aya Abamisiri bakobakorera,
english: "Go, assemble the elders of Israel and say to them, 'The LORD, the God of your fathers-- the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob-- appeared to me and said: I have watched over you and have seen what has been done to you in Egypt.

ekegusii: Imoka, ochene abanto! Obatebie bechene na kwebeka ang’e goika ankio, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, natebire iga: Inwe Abaisraeli imobwate ase egati yaino ebinto biatananetwe na koragererigwa, timokonyara kobua ababisa baino goika mwarusirie ebinto ebio korwa asemore.
english: "Go, consecrate the people. Tell them, 'Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow; for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: That which is devoted is among you, O Israel. You cannot stand against your enemies until you remove it.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agateba, “Genda morigie aase amenyete, erio ntome abanto bamobwate.” Bakamotebia ng’a naaria Dotani amenyete.
english: "Go, find out where he is," the king ordered, "so I can send men and capture him." The report came back: "He is in Dothan."

ekegusii: “Genda osangererie Abayahudi bonsi bare aa Susa, mweng’ate ase engencho yane. Timoria gose konywa ase amatuko atato, omobaso na obotuko. Inche amo nabasomba baane abaiseke ntweng’ate boigo. Nyuma y’ayio ningende ase omoruoti mamincha y’amachiko; onye ngochia gosirigwa, insirigwe.”
english: "Go, gather together all the Jews who are in Susa, and fast for me. Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day. I and my maids will fast as you do. When this is done, I will go to the king, even though it is against the law. And if I perish, I perish."

ekegusii: “Genda, motenene ase Hekalu ime, motebie abanto amang’ana onsi igoro y’Obogima obo.”
english: "Go, stand in the temple courts," he said, "and tell the people the full message of this new life."

ekegusii: “Genda okwane na Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, omotebie abae Abaisraeli ribaga bagende, barue ase ense yaye.”
english: "Go, tell Pharaoh king of Egypt to let the Israelites go out of his country."

ekegusii: Genda obatebie bairane ase chiema chiabo.
english: "Go, tell them to return to their tents.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Genda bwesibie ase ritibo ria Siloamu” (okoonchorwa kwaye, oyotomirwe). Erio akagenda agesibia, akairana okorora.
english: "Go," he told him, "wash in the Pool of Siloam" (this word means Sent). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Genda! Okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Erio kegima akaba nkorora are, agatunyana Yeso gochia inchera.
english: "Go," said Jesus, "your faith has healed you." Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.

ekegusii: Erio agantebia: Imoka ochake orogendo, otang’ane abanto abwo, erinde bagende koira ense eria narierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nimbayee.
english: "Go," the LORD said to me, "and lead the people on their way, so that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them."

ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri, chinguru chiabo nigo chire buna echi’eng’era. Barabwo mbasirie abanto abare mamincha yabo, babune amauga ’emebere y’ababisa babo, na babarase ne chinsara chiabo.
english: "God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox. They devour hostile nations and break their bones in pieces; with their arrows they pierce them.

ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana ayio onsi ase omonto ara kabere, gose ara gatato,
english: "God does all these things to a man-- twice, even three times--

ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene ontange tiyanywa. Aya nigo anga buna nkonywa amanyinga ’abanto bataegerete obogima bwabo ase okorenta amache aya.” Ase ayio akaanga tayanywa. Ayio naro abanto abwo chituoni Batato bakorete.
english: "God forbid that I should do this!" he said. "Should I drink the blood of these men who went at the risk of their lives?" Because they risked their lives to bring it back, David would not drink it. Such were the exploits of the three mighty men.

ekegusii: Omonene onkorire nabeire ring’ana abanto bakorabaara, nabeire oyo abanto bagochaya ase ogotwa amate.
english: "God has made me a byword to everyone, a man in whose face people spit.

ekegusii: “Rora, Nyasae nigo agokora amanene ase okobua kwaye. Inee! Ning’o okworokereria buna ere?
english: "God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

ekegusii: “Rora, Nyasae nigo are Omonguru, ere tachayeti onde; nigo are nokobua ase chinguru na obong’aini.
english: "God is mighty, but does not despise men; he is mighty, and firm in his purpose.

ekegusii: Daudi agatoma amairanerio, agateba, “Ayio namaya, ninkore bo. Korende ninganetie onkorere egento ekemo. Kogocha aa ondetere Mikali, mosubati o Saulo. Onye togokora bo, rirorio tokonyara kondora.”
english: "Good," said David. "I will make an agreement with you. But I demand one thing of you: Do not come into my presence unless you bring Michal daughter of Saul when you come to see me."

ekegusii: Saulo agatebia omosomba oye, “Gwatebire buya; inchuo togende.” Ase igo bakagenda ase omochie ase omonto oyio o Nyasae arenge.
english: "Good," Saul said to his servant. "Come, let's go." So they set out for the town where the man of God was.

ekegusii: Naende ogakora oboonchoreria nense ya Giriki, na eya Tubali, na eya Meseki. Chinse echio chigakooneria abanto, ne ebinto bie chitahabu, na aye okabaooneria ebinto biao.
english: "'Greece, Tubal and Meshech traded with you; they exchanged slaves and articles of bronze for your wares.

ekegusii: “A! Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Ngwachire gotosiria? Nakomanyire aye, Omochenu o Nyasae.”
english: "Ha! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are-- the Holy One of God!"

ekegusii: Abanto ba Harani, na aba Kane, na aba Edeni, nabwo abaonchoreria ba Seba, na ab’Asuri, na aba Kilimadi, bagakora oboonchoreria naye.
english: "'Haran, Canneh and Eden and merchants of Sheba, Asshur and Kilmad traded with you.

ekegusii: “Ning’o ase abanene baito omwegenire, gose ase Abafarisai?
english: "Has any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?

ekegusii: Bagakwana, bagateba, “Inee! Omonene nigo agokwana na Musa bweka? Tari gokwana naintwe?” Omonene akaigwa amang’ana ayio.
english: "Has the LORD spoken only through Moses?" they asked. "Hasn't he also spoken through us?" And the LORD heard this.

ekegusii: “Orangerie Haroni, momura omino, amo nabamura baye korwa ase Abaisraeli, bache ase obosio bwao, babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani, ere Haroni amo nabamura baye Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.
english: "Have Aaron your brother brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, so they may serve me as priests.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Mobe nokwegena ase Nyasae.
english: "Have faith in God," Jesus answered.

ekegusii: “Omonene nigo akoboria: Inee! Amang’ana aya tagachiri asende? Tabekiri ekemanyererio ase ekungo yane?
english: "Have I not kept this in reserve and sealed it in my vaults?

ekegusii: "Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.
english: Inwe abasani baane, ndorera amabeebe, ndorera amabeebe, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae kwang’akire!

ekegusii: “Abaisraeli goika barende rituko ri’Epasaka ase engaki echikire.
english: "Have the Israelites celebrate the Passover at the appointed time.

ekegusii: “Mondoiserie Esanduku ye chibao chi’omokonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
english: "Have them make a chest of acacia wood-- two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

ekegusii: "Have you allowed all the women to live?" he asked them.
english: akabora, “Inee! Ninki kiaba motaita abakungu?

ekegusii: “Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase ebigachero bi’obokeng’entu, gose ebigachero bi’amagena ’embura?
english: "Have you entered the storehouses of the snow or seen the storehouses of the hail,

ekegusii: Inee! Ase obogima bwao bwonsi kwana gochika emambia ebeo? Kwana kworokia amasase a mambia aase akomoreka,
english: "Have you ever given orders to the morning, or shown the dawn its place,

ekegusii: “Inee! Kwana gosoa ime ase chinsoko chi’enyancha, gose kwana gotaara ase enkoro ye chindiba?
english: "Have you journeyed to the springs of the sea or walked in the recesses of the deep?

ekegusii: “Inee! Aye tikwana koigwa ng’a nigo nachigete ayio kare, ngakora emeroberio eyio ase amatuko a kare? Bono ngoikerania inde amang’ana ayio ng’a aye osarie emechie egiteire chindwaki ebe amaturi are chitui chi’amagena.
english: "Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.

ekegusii: “Inee! Aye tikwana koigwa ng’a nigo nachigete ayio kare, ngakora emeroberio eyio ase amatuko a kare? Bono ngoikerania inde amang’ana ayio ng’a aye osarie emechie egiteire chindwaki ebe amaturi are chitui chi’amagena.
english: "'Have you not heard? Long ago I ordained it. In days of old I planned it; now I have brought it to pass, that you have turned fortified cities into piles of stone.

ekegusii: “Inee! Kwaigure amang’ana abanto aba bagokwana? Nigo bagoteba: Omonene bwangire ebisaku biria bibere achorete. Nigo bachayire abanto baane, gose tibababareti koba egesaku.
english: "Have you not noticed that these people are saying, 'The LORD has rejected the two kingdoms he chose'? So they despise my people and no longer regard them as a nation.
