ekegusii: Aye nigo omorendete na komokengera ase chinsemo chionsi, ere amo nabanto b’enyomba yaye yonsi, na gento kende gionsi abwate. Ee, nigo osesenetie emeremo yaye yonsi agokora, naende gwakorire enibo yaye yamentekanire mono ase ense.
english: "Have you not put a hedge around him and his household and everything he has? You have blessed the work of his hands, so that his flocks and herds are spread throughout the land.

ekegusii: “Kwarorire buna Ahabu ekanyire ere omonyene, na obeire omoitongo ase obosio bwane? Ekiagera akorire igo, tinkorenta amabe ayio ase amatuko aye, korende nase amatuko ’omwana oye omomura ndarente amabe ayio ase enyomba yaye.”
english: "Have you noticed how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has humbled himself, I will not bring this disaster in his day, but I will bring it on his house in the days of his son."

ekegusii: "Have you understood all these things?" Jesus asked. "Yes," they replied.
english: Yeso akababoria, “Mwamanyire aya onsi?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee.”

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timwana gosoma buna ere oyobatongete korwa omochakano, nere obatongete omosacha na omokungu,
english: "Haven't you read," he replied, "that at the beginning the Creator 'made them male and female,'

ekegusii: "Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, a desolate place forever. No one will live there; no man will dwell in it."
english: Hasori nosareke, omenywe ne chisese chi’orosana, obe amaturi kogenderera botambe, gose monto onde takomenya aroro, gose omoeti takogobera aroro.”

ekegusii: Akabora: Nagosabire tata, omotome ase enyomba ya tata,
english: "He answered, 'Then I beg you, father, send Lazarus to my father's house,

ekegusii: "He asked me, 'Who are you?' "'An Amalekite,' I answered.
english: Erio akamboria: Naye ng’o? Nkamoiraneria ng’a n’Omoamelekiinde.

ekegusii: Ere takorete ebibe, gose obong’ainereria tibwaruete ase omonwa oye.
english: "He committed no sin, and no deceit was found in his mouth."

ekegusii: Ere taria ebing’wanso bikoruerwa ase ebitunwa igoro, gose tarigereria emegwekano Abaisraeli bagosasima, gose takora obonyaka nomokungu bw’omonto onde;
english: "He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor's wife.

ekegusii: “Ere nigo akong’usa chintonyi chi’amache gochia igoro, na chirochio chiatwa buna embura chiaba riime.
english: "He draws up the drops of water, which distill as rain to the streams;

ekegusii: “Aya naro akwanete igoro y’eng’iti eria ya kane, agateba: Oboruoti bwa kane mbobe ase ense, borobwo nigo borabe nogwatananekana korwa ase amaruoti ande onsi. Nigo borarie ense yonsi na koyetindachera inse, naende boyebutorane ebe ebing’ese.
english: "He gave me this explanation: 'The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on earth. It will be different from all the other kingdoms and will devour the whole earth, trampling it down and crushing it.

ekegusii: Narenge nomwana oyomo konya ataratoma, omwanchwa oye; oyo nere akamotoma asebare nyuma, akabora: Nabasike omwana one.
english: "He had one left to send, a son, whom he loved. He sent him last of all, saying, 'They will respect my son.'

ekegusii: “Nyasae ogerire abaminto bantigire, bambeereire aare, na abanto twamanyaine bantigire, babeire buna tibamanyeti.
english: "He has alienated my brothers from me; my acquaintances are completely estranged from me.

ekegusii: “Obaukoirie amaiso, okorire chinkoro chiabo chiakong’ire, tibacha korora namaiso abo, na komanya ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke na inche mbagwenie.”
english: "He has blinded their eyes and deadened their hearts, so they can neither see with their eyes, nor understand with their hearts, nor turn-- and I would heal them."

ekegusii: Zedekia omoruoti agatebia abagambi baria, “Rora nigo are ase amaboko aino, ekiagera inche omoruoti tinkonyara gokora amang’ana are mamincha yaino.”
english: "He is in your hands," King Zedekiah answered. "The king can do nothing to oppose you."

ekegusii: Nyasae tari omonto buna inche, erinde imoiranerie, na ngende nere ase ekegambero.
english: "He is not a man like me that I might answer him, that we might confront each other in court.

ekegusii: Ee, nigo akoebereretie, agakorusia korwa ase chimbanderana, agakorenta aase aagare, ase komigwa gotaiyo; boigo chindagera kwabekeretwe emesa nigo chiarenge chinoru.
english: "He is wooing you from the jaws of distress to a spacious place free from restriction, to the comfort of your table laden with choice food.

ekegusii: Abaiseke baria bakabairaneria, “Ee, nao are aa, oyio bosio bwaino. Genda bwango momonyore. Mbono achire ase omochie, ekiagera abanto ngochia bare korua ebing’wanso agwo ase ekegoro igoro.
english: "He is," they answered. "He's ahead of you. Hurry now; he has just come to our town today, for the people have a sacrifice at the high place.

ekegusii: “Omonene nere otongete ense ase okobua kwaye, nere oyetenenetie goetera ase obong’aini bwaye, na ase okomanya kwaye akarambora igoro.
english: "He made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

ekegusii: “Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amache amange.
english: "He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.

ekegusii: Nabatebirie: Kera oyore negento naegwe, korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.
english: "He replied, 'I tell you that to everyone who has, more will be given, but as for the one who has nothing, even what he has will be taken away.

ekegusii: Korende agantebia: Omonene oyo ngendererete ase obosio bwaye, natome omomalaika oye amo naye, asesenie orogendo rwao. Naye orentere omwana one omokungu korwa ase eamate yane, korwa ase omochie o tata;
english: "He replied, 'The LORD, before whom I have walked, will send his angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you can get a wife for my son from my own clan and from my father's family.

ekegusii: Akamotebia: Bataigwereti Musa na ababani, naisa koboka omonto korwa ase abakure, tibakoebererigwa banche.”
english: "He said to him, 'If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.'"

ekegusii: “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria. Ere n’Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, tiga aike bono korwa ase omosalaba, na intwe rirorio ntomwegene.
english: "He saved others," they said, "but he can't save himself! He's the King of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.

ekegusii: “Nyuma y’ayio anyenye embori eria ebe ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abanto, aire amanyinga ’embori eyio moino y’etoto eria, ayanyororokerie igoro ase Oboikaranso bw’Amabera bosio, na bosio bw’Oboikaranso boria akore buna akorete namanyinga ’eeri eria.
english: "He shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and take its blood behind the curtain and do with it as he did with the bull's blood: He shall sprinkle it on the atonement cover and in front of it.

ekegusii: Naende gekaimokia embusuro y’ense eyio gekayesimeka ase riroba ritobu, gekayesimeka ase egati y’emete enga emesobeti ase amache amange arenge.
english: "'He took some of the seed of your land and put it in fertile soil. He planted it like a willow by abundant water,

ekegusii: bagoteba, “Omonto oyo nigo asemeretie Omonene ng’a namotoorie, tiga amotoorie, ekiagera agokirie nere!”
english: "He trusts in the LORD; let the LORD rescue him. Let him deliver him, since he delights in him."

ekegusii: “Ekero achia koirana, kanyorire oboruoti, agachika abasomba baria aete chiropia barangerigwe, erinde anyare komanya ebitoki banyorire ase okoonchoreria kwabo.
english: "He was made king, however, and returned home. Then he sent for the servants to whom he had given the money, in order to find out what they had gained with it.

ekegusii: Omonto otari amo nainche nigo are mamincha asende. Nere oyotari gosangereria amo nainche nigo agoserebania.
english: "He who is not with me is against me, and he who does not gather with me scatters.

ekegusii: Omonto otari amo nainche nigo are mamincha asende, na ere oyotari gosangereria amo nainche nigo agoserebania.
english: "He who is not with me is against me, and he who does not gather with me, scatters.

ekegusii: "He who listens to you listens to me; he who rejects you rejects me; but he who rejects me rejects him who sent me."
english: “Oyorabaigwere inwe, nanyigwere nainche, na ere oyorabaange inwe, onyangire nainche, na ere oyoranyange inche, omwangire ere oyontomete.”

ekegusii: "He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives the one who sent me.
english: “Oyobanchire inwe, onyanchire na inche, na oyo oranyanche inche, omwanchire ere oyontomete.

ekegusii: “Naende naoroke omoruoti onde omokorekanu ase ribaga ri’oria oitetwe. Oyio ere takoegwa amasikani ase oboruoti obwo. Nigo arache ng’ora ng’ora ase obong’ainereria bw’okweansia aire oboruoti.
english: "He will be succeeded by a contemptible person who has not been given the honor of royalty. He will invade the kingdom when its people feel secure, and he will seize it through intrigue.

ekegusii: Bakamotebia, “Igo araite ababe baria ogoita okobe, na aatananere abaremi bande omogondo oria bw’emesabibu, abarache komoa amatunda ekero amire.”
english: "He will bring those wretches to a wretched end," they replied, "and he will rent the vineyard to other tenants, who will give him his share of the crop at harvest time."

ekegusii: Erio nabairanerie: Nekeene nabatebirie: Koreng’ana buna motare gokorera oyomo bw’aba abare abake, timwankorerete inche.
english: "He will reply, 'I tell you the truth, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for me.'

ekegusii: “Inwe aba momanyete oboronge, ntegerera moigwe, inwe aba amachiko aane are ime ase chinkoro chiaino; timoiroka abwo bakobachaya, gose timoondoka ekero bakobachecheria.
english: "Hear me, you who know what is right, you people who have my law in your hearts: Do not fear the reproach of men or be terrified by their insults.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igwa ogosaba kwane, otegerere okorera kwane; tokira‐kiri ekero nkoiyeria amariga, ekiagera inche nomogeni oo inde, na omoeti buna chisokoro chiane chiarenge.
english: "Hear my prayer, O LORD, listen to my cry for help; be not deaf to my weeping. For I dwell with you as an alien, a stranger, as all my fathers were.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto abang’aini, igwa amang’ana aane! Inwe abamanyi chisemi, ntegerera!
english: "Hear my words, you wise men; listen to me, you men of learning.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto b’ebisaku, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene, morirarie ase ebisinka na ase chinse chi’aare echire ang’e ne chinyancha, motebe: Oria osiarerete Abaisraeli, nabasangererie naende, ere nabarisie buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye.
english: "Hear the word of the LORD, O nations; proclaim it in distant coastlands: 'He who scattered Israel will gather them and will watch over his flock like a shepherd.'

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae, oyore Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteba iga: “Tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya, erio moyararie ase ororeria rwa Yakobo.
english: "Hear this and testify against the house of Jacob," declares the Lord, the LORD God Almighty.

ekegusii: Inwe abaruoti, igwa! Inwe abagambi, tegerera! Inche ninterere Omonene ase okomobaka, nintogie Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli!
english: "Hear this, you kings! Listen, you rulers! I will sing to the LORD, I will sing; I will make music to the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: “Inwe abakuani, igwa ring’ana eri! Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe! Inwe ab’enyomba y’omoruoti, tegerera moigwe! Ekina kianachirwe igoro yaino, ekiagera mwabeire oboreba agwo Misipa, na ekeonga getegire agwo ase Tabori igoro.
english: "Hear this, you priests! Pay attention, you Israelites! Listen, O royal house! This judgment is against you: You have been a snare at Mizpah, a net spread out on Tabor.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, tegerera moigwe, inche nkwane! Inwe Abaisraeli, inche nimbe nkorua oborori bore mamincha yaino. Inche Nyasae inde Nyasae oino.
english: "Hear, O my people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, igwa ekero nkobakurera! Inwe Abaisraeli, onye ndiria mware konyigwera!
english: "Hear, O my people, and I will warn you-- if you would but listen to me, O Israel!

ekegusii: "Hear, you deaf; look, you blind, and see!
english: “Inwe abamore emetino, tegerera moigwe, nainwe abamore emeuko, rigereria monyare korora!

ekegusii: “Igoro nekerogo kiane ki’obonene, na ense negeteni kiane ki’amagoro. Omonene otebire: Inyomba ki moranyare kong’agachera? Gose ng’ai aase are ndanyare gotimokera?
english: "'Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? says the Lord. Or where will my resting place be?

ekegusii: “Nonya Oholiba, mosubati omwaabo, oroche ayio, ere nigo abete omosareku goetania ase okoba nokogania okobe, na gokora obonyaka; obobe bwaye nigo bwabete obonge goetania obwa Ohola, mosubati omwabo.
english: "Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet in her lust and prostitution she was more depraved than her sister.

ekegusii: "Here comes that dreamer!" they said to each other.
english: Barabwo bagatebania, “Omonyandoto oyio ogocha.

ekegusii: "Here I will make a horn grow for David and set up a lamp for my anointed one.
english: Aroro agwo nimererie Daudi orogunchara, ekiagera naroiseirie omoakwa amaguta one etaya ekomoreka.

ekegusii: “Nare aa omosae, obwate emegati etano y’engano ne chinswe ibere, korende ebi inki biraisane ase abanto abange buna aba?”
english: "Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but how far will they go among so many?"

ekegusii: “Rora, omosomba one oyonachorire, omwanchwa one, omoyo one ogokirie nere. Nimobekere Omoika one, nere nararerie abanto b’Ebisaku ekina.
english: "Here is my servant whom I have chosen, the one I love, in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.

ekegusii: “Rora, omosomba one oyio inche nabekire chinguru ime yaye; omochore one omoyo one ogokirie nere. Namobekeire Omoika one, nere orarente oboronge ase abanto b’ebisaku.
english: "Here is my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen one in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him and he will bring justice to the nations.

ekegusii: “Ekio nakio egetari Nyasae akoa omokori amabe, na omwando Omonguru akoa abwo bagochanda abanto.
english: "Here is the fate God allots to the wicked, the heritage a ruthless man receives from the Almighty:

ekegusii: Daudi akamoiraneria, “Aye omoruoti, rora ritimo riao eri, toma omosae oyomo amboke arioyie.
english: "Here is the king's spear," David answered. "Let one of your young men come over and get it.

ekegusii: “Rora, omonto oyo bwangete gokora Nyasae abe obotamero bwaye, nigo egenete obonge bw’obonda bwaye omonyene, na akeenenia ase chinguru chiaye chi’ogosaria.”
english: "Here now is the man who did not make God his stronghold but trusted in his great wealth and grew strong by destroying others!"

ekegusii: Abarwani bande b’esegi batometwe nere mbakore Obomenyo Obochenu bobe botachenegeti, nabarusieo ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na agwo mbatenenie okogechia koria kogosiria.
english: "His armed forces will rise up to desecrate the temple fortress and will abolish the daily sacrifice. Then they will set up the abomination that causes desolation.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo arigereretie chinchera chi’omonto; ere nigo aroche amatambokero aye onsi.
english: "His eyes are on the ways of men; he sees their every step.

ekegusii: "His fellow servant fell to his knees and begged him, 'Be patient with me, and I will pay you back.'
english: Omosomba oria agatung’ama inse, akamosorora, agateba: Ing’ira ng’ora, na inche ningoakane.

ekegusii: Akamotebia nere boigo: Aye nobe igoro ase emechie etano.
english: "His master answered, 'You take charge of five cities.'

ekegusii: Akamotebia: Ase enkwana y’omonwa oo ninkogambie, aye omosomba omobe. Nkwamanyete ng’a inche nomonto omokong’u, nkobogoria eki ntagachete, na kogesa eki ntasimegete.
english: "His master replied, 'I will judge you by your own words, you wicked servant! You knew, did you, that I am a hard man, taking out what I did not put in, and reaping what I did not sow?

ekegusii: Omonene oye akamotebia: Gwakorire buya aye, omosomba omuya naende omwegenwa; kwabeire omwegenwa ase ebire ebike, ninkobeke igoro ase ebire ebinge. Soa ase omogoko bw’omonene oo.
english: "His master replied, 'Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master's happiness!'

ekegusii: Korende omonene oye akamoiraneria: Aye omosomba omobe naende omworo! Nkwamanyete ng’a nigo nkogesa aase ntasimegete, naende nigo ngosangereria aase ntabusurete?
english: "His master replied, 'You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?

ekegusii: “Naende naoroke omoruoti onde ase ribaga riaye, ere natome omobangi bw’ebango aete ase ense eria ere obonene bw’oboruoti bwaye, Ase engaki y’amatuko amake omoruoti oria naitwe, korende tari ase engencho y’endamwamu, gose ase esegi.
english: "His successor will send out a tax collector to maintain the royal splendor. In a few years, however, he will be destroyed, yet not in anger or in battle.

ekegusii: Yoramu agateba, “Beka egari yane ang’e!” Barabwo bakabeka egari yaye ang’e. Erio Yoramu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, na Ahasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, bakagenda, kera oyomo ase egari yaye, koumerana na Yehu. Barabwo bakaumerana nere agwo ase omogondo o Naboti, Omoyesireeli.
english: "Hitch up my chariot," Joram ordered. And when it was hitched up, Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah rode out, each in his own chariot, to meet Jehu. They met him at the plot of ground that had belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite.

ekegusii: "Honor your father and mother"-- which is the first commandment with a promise--
english: “Sika iso na nyoko” (ogochika oko nakwo ogochika kwe ritang’ani kore neira),

ekegusii: “Sika iso na nyoko, buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochikire; nario oramenye amatuko amange, naende erabe buya asore ase ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochia gokoa.
english: "Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live long and that it may go well with you in the land the LORD your God is giving you.

ekegusii: “Sika iso na nyoko, nario oramenye amatuko amange ase ense eye Omonene, Nyasae oo, akoeire.
english: "Honor your father and your mother, so that you may live long in the land the LORD your God is giving you.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, chiema chiaino naki chire chingiya! Inwe Abaisraeli aase momenyete, naki are aagiya mono!
english: "How beautiful are your tents, O Jacob, your dwelling places, O Israel!

ekegusii: Nikodemo akamoboria, “Naki omonto aranyare koiborwa kabeire omogaaka? Nanyare gosoa enda ya ng’ina eria kabere aiborwe?”
english: "How can a man be born when he is old?" Nicodemus asked. "Surely he cannot enter a second time into his mother's womb to be born!"

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaefraimu, naki ndakore mbatige? Inwe Abaisraeli, naki ndakore mbatige morue asende? Naki ndakore mbatige buna natigete Adima? Naki ndakore mbakorere buna nakorerete Seboimu? Enkoro yane nigo egwoka, na amabera aane onsi abokire ime yane.
english: "How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I treat you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is changed within me; all my compassion is aroused.

ekegusii: Korende omosomba oye agateba, “Naki ndanyare kobeka endagera eye ase amasio ’abanto rigana erimo?” Elisha agateba eria kabere, “Yee abanto barie, ekiagera aya naro Omonene atebire: Mbarie, naende batigarie eyende.”
english: "How can I set this before a hundred men?" his servant asked. But Elisha answered, "Give it to the people to eat. For this is what the LORD says: 'They will eat and have some left over.'"

ekegusii: Akamoiraneria, “Naki ndanyare komanya otatiga omonto antang’ane?” Agatebia Filipo ariine, aikaranse amo nere.
english: "How can I," he said, "unless someone explains it to me?" So he invited Philip to come up and sit with him.

ekegusii: Nikodemo akamoboria, “Naki aranyare koba aya?”
english: "How can this be?" Nicodemus asked.

ekegusii: Ngento ki torakore tonyorere abwo batigarete abakungu, ekiagera ntwariete eira na gotiana ase obosio bw’Omonene ng’a titokorua nonya noyomo bw’abaiseke baito anyuomwe noyomo obo?”
english: "How can we provide wives for those who are left, since we have taken an oath by the LORD not to give them any of our daughters in marriage?"

ekegusii: Naki moranyare goteba ng’a nabang’aini more, naende ng’a mobwate amachiko ’Omonene ase egati yaino? Rora aborokia b’amariko abare abang’ainereria barikire amachiko ’Omonene na koyaonchorana ase okong’ainereria.
english: "'How can you say, "We are wise, for we have the law of the LORD," when actually the lying pen of the scribes has handled it falsely?

ekegusii: Naki inwe moranyare goteba: Titori abatachenegeti, titwabwatetie chinyasae chikorokwa Baali? Rigereria chinchera chiaino ase amakura ime, inyora na komanya egento mwakorire; mwabeire buna engamia eaberi ekominyoka gochia aaria na aaria.”
english: "How can you say, 'I am not defiled; I have not run after the Baals'? See how you behaved in the valley; consider what you have done. You are a swift she-camel running here and there,

ekegusii: “Naki mogoteba: Intwe nabarwani chituoni, abanto tore ne chinguru ase okorwana esegi?
english: "How can you say, 'We are warriors, men valiant in battle'?

ekegusii: Natanaeli akamoboria, “Ing’ai kwamanyera?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ritang’ani Filipo atarakorangeria, ekero kwarenge inse ase omoko, konya nakororire.”
english: "How do you know me?" Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, "I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, igo ore omonene, aye Omonene Nyasae! Onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari, otatiga aye bweka, koreng’ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.
english: "How great you are, O Sovereign LORD! There is no one like you, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.

ekegusii: “Onye ndiria obogima bwane bware koba buna bwarenge ase amatuko a kare, amatuko aria Nyasae andendete!
english: "How I long for the months gone by, for the days when God watched over me,

ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri omoganda oyo omobe oremurunganie asende? Naigure Abaisraeli banyemurunganeirie.
english: "How long will this wicked community grumble against me? I have heard the complaints of these grumbling Israelites.

ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri moragenderere konacha ebina bitari noboronge? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwanchereria abanto ababe?
english: "How long will you defend the unjust and show partiality to the wicked? Selah

ekegusii: “Ngoika ririri orabe kogokwana amang’ana aya, na amang’ana ’omonwa oo abe buna omwaga omonene?
english: "How long will you say such things? Your words are a blustering wind.

ekegusii: “Ngoika ririri inwe abamotamanyeti amange moranche ogotamanya kwaino? Ngoika ririri abachecheria baregokie nogochecheria kwabo, na abariri bageche chisemi?
english: "How long will you simple ones love your simple ways? How long will mockers delight in mockery and fools hate knowledge?

ekegusii: "How long will you torment me and crush me with words?
english: “Inee! Ngoika ririri morabe mokogechia omoyo one na mogonsenyenta namang’ana aino?

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate? Genda morore!” Bagachia komanya bakabora, “Netano, ne chinswe ibere.”
english: "How many loaves do you have?" he asked. "Go and see." When they found out, they said, "Five-- and two fish."

ekegusii: Yeso akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere, ne chinswe chinsinini nke igo.”
english: "How many loaves do you have?" Jesus asked. "Seven," they replied, "and a few small fish."

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Emegati nerenga mobwate?” Bakamoiraneria, “Netano na ebere.”
english: "How many loaves do you have?" Jesus asked. "Seven," they replied.

ekegusii: Abanto nkorera bare, bagoteba: Naki Abamoabu baitirwe na gosirigwa. Naki Abamoabu baonchoire amagega abo bare nobosooku, babeire egento ki’ogosekererigwa na eki’ogoichanerwa ase abanto bonsi ababaetanaine.”
english: "How shattered she is! How they wail! How Moab turns her back in shame! Moab has become an object of ridicule, an object of horror to all those around her."

ekegusii: “Naki Sesaki, nero Babeli, eyere ogotogigwa gw’ense yonsi, yabwatirwe na koondokia ebisaku binde!
english: "How Sheshach will be captured, the boast of the whole earth seized! What a horror Babylon will be among the nations!

ekegusii: “Chituoni chiaitirwe ase esegi! Yonathani nao araire ase ebigoro igoro, oitire.”
english: "How the mighty have fallen in battle! Jonathan lies slain on your heights.

ekegusii: "How the mighty have fallen! The weapons of war have perished!"
english: “Chituoni chiaitirwe, na ebirwanero bi’esegi biasirigwe!”

ekegusii: Naki rende ndakore imanye gochora amang’ana agwenerete, erinde inyare koiraneria Omonene.
english: "How then can I dispute with him? How can I find words to argue with him?

ekegusii: Nabo bakamoboria, “Amaiso ao naki rende aramogetigwe?”
english: "How then were your eyes opened?" they demanded.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: “Naki enkoro yao ere nokogania okonene kw’ogwanchwa, ekiagera gwakorire aya onsi, ayare buna ogokora kw’omokungu omonyaka otari korora obosooku.
english: "'How weak-willed you are, declares the Sovereign LORD, when you do all these things, acting like a brazen prostitute!

ekegusii: Mariamu akaboria omomalaika oria, “Naki rirabe ring’ana eri, ekiagera tindaba nomosacha?”
english: "How will this be," Mary asked the angel, "since I am a virgin?"

ekegusii: "How you have helped the powerless! How you have saved the arm that is feeble!
english: “Naki ere buya aye gwakonyire omonto otari nokobua! Ee, aye gwatooririe omonto omoreu otari ne chinguru.

ekegusii: “Inche ninsibore abasibwa b’emechie eye: abasibwa ba Sodomu amo nab’abaiseke baye, na aba Samaria amo nab’abaiseke baye. Boigo naye Yerusalemu ningosibore kore ase egati yabo,
english: "'However, I will restore the fortunes of Sodom and her daughters and of Samaria and her daughters, and your fortunes along with them,

ekegusii: “Korende inwe komorange komoigwera Omonene, Nyasae oino, na goteba ng’a timokonyara kogenderera komenya ase ense eye,
english: "However, if you say, 'We will not stay in this land,' and so disobey the LORD your God,

ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba gwa Koresi, omoruoti o Babeli, ere Koresi naruete ogochika ng’a enyomba eye eagachwe naende.
english: "However, in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, King Cyrus issued a decree to rebuild this house of God.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire ng’a amatuko ngocha are, ekero abanto batakwane: “Ekeene, buna omonene are moyo, oyio orusetie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: "However, the days are coming," declares the LORD, "when men will no longer say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,'

ekegusii: Korende Ere Oyore Igoro Mono tari komenya ase chinyomba chiagachire namaboko, buna omobani agoteba:
english: "However, the Most High does not live in houses made by men. As the prophet says:

ekegusii: “Ekero emetienyi etato konya yatigaire endagera yame ngatanga embura tiyatwa. Nigo narenge gotoma embura yatwa ase omochie oyomo, korende nayetanga tegotwa ase emechie ende; nigo narenge koyerenta yatwa ase omogondo oyomo, korende nayetanga ase emegondo ende, ero yaba ekwoma.
english: "I also withheld rain from you when the harvest was still three months away. I sent rain on one town, but withheld it from another. One field had rain; another had none and dried up.

ekegusii: “Inche n’Omoyahudi, naiboreretwe Tariso, omochie o Kilikia, nkarererwa ase omochie oyo ase amagoro a Gamalieli, nkorokererigwa bokong’u amachiko e chisokoro chiaito. Nkaba omonto oyore nomokia ase Nyasae, buna inwe mwensi more rero iga.
english: "I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city. Under Gamaliel I was thoroughly trained in the law of our fathers and was just as zealous for God as any of you are today.

ekegusii: “Inche nabeire ang’e kogenda enchera eria abanto bonsi b’ense bakogenda. Obe omokong’u, bweorokie obe omonto oteneine boronge.
english: "I am about to go the way of all the earth," he said. "So be strong, show yourself a man,

ekegusii: Aye egetunwa kegosiria, gwasiririe ense yonsi, rora, inche nabeire mamincha yao; nindambore okoboko kwane asore; nkobwate ngoturunkanie korwa ase emienya y’ebitare, erio nkoonchore obe egetunwa giasambirwe.
english: "I am against you, O destroying mountain, you who destroy the whole earth," declares the LORD. "I will stretch out my hand against you, roll you off the cliffs, and make you a burned-out mountain.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, inche nigo inde mamincha yao; ninsambe chigari chiao chiimoke erioki, ning’ite chindo chiao chinsae nomoro; ninsirie ebinto gwasakorete birue ase ense, na eriogi ri’abanto bao gwatomete tirikoigugwa nonya ng’ake.”
english: "I am against you," declares the LORD Almighty. "I will burn up your chariots in smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions. I will leave you no prey on the earth. The voices of your messengers will no longer be heard."

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, nigo inde mamincha yao, ningwasiorie chianga chiao, na abanto b’ebisaku barore obogetirianga bwao, na amaruoti arore obosooku bwao.
english: "I am against you," declares the LORD Almighty. "I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness and the kingdoms your shame.

ekegusii: “Inche nomomenyi inde, imenyete ase egati yaino; komoranche mong’e aase ntindeke omokungu one onkwereire, imorusie ase obosio bwane.”
english: "I am an alien and a stranger among you. Sell me some property for a burial site here so I can bury my dead."

ekegusii: Na bono ngocha nde asore, na aya nkoyakwana, inde ase ense ime, erinde omogoko one obe oikeranigwe ime yabo.
english: "I am coming to you now, but I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.

ekegusii: "I am God, the God of your father," he said. "Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
english: Erio akamotebia, “Inche ninche Nyasae, Nyasae o iso; tobaisa kwoboa gotirimboka gochia Misiri, ekiagera ningokore obe egesaku ekenene aroro.

ekegusii: “Rora, inche nigo inde ang’e gokora Yerusalemu obe buna egekombe kere nekenyugwa kegotindia ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, boigo nkebanyore Abayuda ekero Yerusalemu orache koboerwa.
english: "I am going to make Jerusalem a cup that sends all the surrounding peoples reeling. Judah will be besieged as well as Jerusalem.

ekegusii: “Naichanire ekiagera nabegete Saulo koba omoruoti, ere oonchokire, otigire konyigwera na tabwateti amachiko aane.” Ayio akamoichania Samweli, erinde akaba okorera ase Omonene obotuko obogima ng’a akonywe.
english: "I am grieved that I have made Saul king, because he has turned away from me and has not carried out my instructions." Samuel was troubled, and he cried out to the LORD all that night.

ekegusii: Korende Paulo agakwana, “Omosike Festo, tindi ebarimo, korende nigo ngokwana amang’ana ’ekeene na ay’obong’aini kegima.
english: "I am not insane, most excellent Festus," Paul replied. "What I am saying is true and reasonable.

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inche timbwatiri nekerecha, korende nigo nsigete Tata one, na inwe timonsigeti.
english: "I am not possessed by a demon," said Jesus, "but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

ekegusii: Tindi gokwana asemore mwensi; nabamanyire aba nachorire, erinde amariko anyare goikeranigwa, ayagoteba: Oyokoria omogati amo nainche oimokereirie egotingiro kiaye igoro asende.
english: "I am not referring to all of you; I know those I have chosen. But this is to fulfill the scripture: 'He who shares my bread has lifted up his heel against me.'

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Bono inche nakoorire emiaka rigana erimo na emerongo ebere, tinkonyara kobaraa kogenderera. Boigo Omonene onkanirie ng’a tinkwamboka ngende ng’umbu ya Yorodan.
english: "I am now a hundred and twenty years old and I am no longer able to lead you. The LORD has said to me, 'You shall not cross the Jordan.'

ekegusii: Bono natomire asore Huramu‐Abi, omoroisia omong’aini ore nokomanya okonge.
english: "I am sending you Huram-Abi, a man of great skill,

ekegusii: Nabatebirie aya korwa bono ritang’ani ataraba, erio ekero arache koba monyare kwegena ng’a ninche ere.
english: "I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am He.

ekegusii: “Inche n’Alifa na Omega,” Omonene Nyasae otebire, oyoreo, na oyorengeo, na oyorache kobao, oyore Omobui.
english: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, "who is, and who was, and who is to come, the Almighty."

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omorisia omuya; omorisia omuya nigo akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho ye ching’ondi.
english: "I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

ekegusii: "I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me--
english: Inche ninche omorisia omuya, na echire echiane ninchimanyete, na echire echiane nchimanyete,

ekegusii: Korende inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, korwa ekero keria mwarenge Misiri, nimbabeke momenye ase chiema naende, buna yarenge Amatuko Amanene aria achikire.
english: "I am the LORD your God, [who brought you] out of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, as in the days of your appointed feasts.

ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oo, oyokorusetie ase ense ya Misiri, ase ense y’obosomba.
english: "I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense y’obosomba.
english: "I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

ekegusii: “Rora, inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae bw’abanto bonsi. Inee! Egento nkere gensinyete?
english: "I am the LORD, the God of all mankind. Is anything too hard for me?

ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, erio nario erieta riane; tindi koa omonto onde obonene bwane; tinkoa emegwekano egosasimwa ogotogigwa kwane.
english: "I am the LORD; that is my name! I will not give my glory to another or my praise to idols.

ekegusii: Mariamu akabora, “Rora, inche nomoiseke omosomba bw’Omonene; abe asende buna ring’ana riao.” Omomalaika akaimoka akarua asare.
english: "I am the Lord's servant," Mary answered. "May it be to me as you have said." Then the angel left her.

ekegusii: “Ekeene, inche nigo inde omoriri otagwenereti korokwa omonto, gose timbwati obomanyi bwa mwanyabanto.
english: "I am the most ignorant of men; I do not have a man's understanding.

ekegusii: Samweli akamoiraneria, “Ninche omorori oyio. Genda motang’ane gochia aase agwo ebing’wanso bikoruerwa, ekiagera rero namorie endagera aroro amo nainche. Ankio ninkoe ribaga ogende, na inche ngotebie amang’ana onsi are ase ebirengererio biao.
english: "I am the seer," Samuel replied. "Go up ahead of me to the high place, for today you are to eat with me, and in the morning I will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart.

ekegusii: "I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
english: “Inche ninche omosabibu bw’ekeene, na Tata one nomoroiseria.

ekegusii: Inche nomosabibu, na inwe nechinsagia. Oyo omenyete ime yane, na inche ime yaye, oyio name mono, ekiagera ntaiyo inche, timokonyara gokora kende gionsi.
english: "I am the vine; you are the branches. If a man remains in me and I in him, he will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.

ekegusii: “Omwando obo nigo orabe iga: Ninche omonyene inde omwando obo. Timokobaa enibo ende yonsi, ekiagera ninche omonyene inde enibo yabo.
english: "'I am to be the only inheritance the priests have. You are to give them no possession in Israel; I will be their possession.

ekegusii: "I am unworthy-- how can I reply to you? I put my hand over my mouth.
english: “Naama! Inche ting’isaini kende, ngento ki ndanyare gokoiraneria? Natubire omonwa one nokoboko kwane.

ekegusii: Yeso agateba, “Ee, ninche ere; na inwe namorore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore nokobua, ogocha namare a igoro.”
english: "I am," said Jesus. "And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven."

ekegusii: Erio namoboria: Nomoiseke o ng’o ore? Ere ong’iraneria: Inche nomoiseke o Betueli oyo Milka aiborerete Nahori. Agwo namobekera ekegera chimioro chiaye, na ebitange ase amaboko aye.
english: "I asked her, 'Whose daughter are you?' "She said, 'The daughter of Bethuel son of Nahor, whom Milcah bore to him.' "Then I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms,

ekegusii: Yohana akabairaneria, “Inche nigo nkobatisa ase amache, korende egati yaino nateneineo oyomotamanyeti inwe.
english: "I baptize with water," John replied, "but among you stands one you do not know.

ekegusii: “Inche nase amache nkobabatisera ase okoonchoka, korende ere, oyorache nyuma yane, nare ne chinguru kombua. Tinyisaini koimokia ebikoroto biaye. Nere orababatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.
english: "I baptize you with water for repentance. But after me will come one who is more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not fit to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

ekegusii: "'I bathed you with water and washed the blood from you and put ointments on you.
english: “Erio nkagosibia namache, ngasibia amanyinga ao onsi na kogoaka amaguta.

ekegusii: “Nyuma y’ayio nkabarenta ase ense y’Abaamori, baria bamenyete moocha ya Yorodan. Barabwo bakabarwania, korende inche nkababeka ase amaboko aino. Inwe mokaira ense yabo, na inche nkabasiria ase amasio aino.
english: "'I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived east of the Jordan. They fought against you, but I gave them into your hands. I destroyed them from before you, and you took possession of their land.

ekegusii: Ninche nabarusetie inwe korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erio nkabaraa ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, na inwe mokaira ense y’Abaamori ekaba eyaino.
english: "I brought you up out of Egypt, and I led you forty years in the desert to give you the land of the Amorites.

ekegusii: “Inche nkarangeria abanchi baane ng’a bankonye, korende bakang’aina; abakuani baane na abagaaka bagakwera ase omochie ime, ekero barenge korigia endagera barie banyore chinguru chinyia.
english: "I called to my allies but they betrayed me. My priests and my elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.

ekegusii: Yusufu akairaneria Farao, akabora, “Tari inche, korende Nyasae orakoe aye Farao okoiraneria kw’omorembe.”
english: "I cannot do it," Joseph replied to Pharaoh, "but God will give Pharaoh the answer he desires."

ekegusii: “Nigo nkorera asore, korende aye tori kong’iraneria; nigo nteneine asore, korende aye nigo onsonchete rioka.
english: "I cry out to you, O God, but you do not answer; I stand up, but you merely look at me.

ekegusii: “Korende ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, inche Omonene ngasiria Abaamori abwo barenge abatambe buna emecharake, naende abakong’u buna omote onga buna omotontera. Nigo nasiretie amatunda abo, ngasimora nemeri yabo yonsi.
english: "I destroyed the Amorite before them, though he was tall as the cedars and strong as the oaks. I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.

ekegusii: Tindi konyora obonene korwa ase abanto.
english: "I do not accept praise from men,

ekegusii: “Inche tinabaete gento kende mogotakuna ase emechie yaino yonsi, na endagera ekabora aase aino onsi. Korende nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "I gave you empty stomachs in every city and lack of bread in every town, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Naeire Abalawi ensemo ya ikomi, eye Abaisraeli bakorua, ebe eyabo, ebe eng’eria ase emeremo eye barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: "I give to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as their inheritance in return for the work they do while serving at the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: “Nakoeire kera ekere ekiya mono ki’ogotongora oko Abaisraeli bakondetera: Amaguta ’amazeituni, na edivai, na endagera.
english: "I give you all the finest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain they give the LORD as the firstfruits of their harvest.

ekegusii: Omomura oria akamoiraneria, “Nigo yaba ng’a nao nare ase egetunwa kia Giliboa, na aroro nkarora Saulo osigamerete ritimo riaye; chigari konya chiamoikereire ang’e, na abanto bariinete chibarasi bakomominyokia.
english: "I happened to be on Mount Gilboa," the young man said, "and there was Saul, leaning on his spear, with the chariots and riders almost upon him.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteba iga: “Inche nigo ngechete ogotigana, naende nigo ngechete ng’a omonto nigo agwetuba obotindi buna agwetuba eanga.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba. Ase engencho eyio mwerende timobasia koba abatari abegenwa.
english: "I hate divorce," says the LORD God of Israel, "and I hate a man's covering himself with violence as well as with his garment," says the LORD Almighty. So guard yourself in your spirit, and do not break faith.

ekegusii: “Inche nigo ngechete na gochaya Amatuko aino Amanene. Tingokiri nemesangererekano yaino y’ogosasima.
english: "I hate, I despise your religious feasts; I cannot stand your assemblies.

ekegusii: Abasani baane nigo bagonchecheria, inche oyo narenge korangeria Nyasae, na ere akaba okong’iraneria, inche omonyakeene ntari na komocha, bono nigo ngochecherigwa.
english: "I have become a laughingstock to my friends, though I called upon God and he answered-- a mere laughingstock, though righteous and blameless!

ekegusii: Bono inche namenyire bwoo emiaka emerongo ebere. Ching’ondi chiao gose chimbori, ekero chiabwate amarieme, ende terekereti; gose inche tinyenyeti chimingichi chinde chie riicho riao, na gochiria.
english: "I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten rams from your flocks.

ekegusii: “Nigo nachire gotongia omorero ase ense; onye ngwoka ore, anga ninki ndigetie naende?
english: "I have come to bring fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!

ekegusii: “Naroreire omoganda amabera, ekiagera abwo babeire amatuko atato baikaransete amo nainche batari na gento bakoria;
english: "I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat.

ekegusii: “Nasiririe abanto b’ebisaku; chiburi chiabo chi’ogwekengera nachitagoire. Natigire chinchera chiabo chire bosa, onde tari ogoetera aroro; emechie yabo yatagoirwe yabeire amaturi, onde tamenyeti aroro.
english: "I have cut off nations; their strongholds are demolished. I have left their streets deserted, with no one passing through. Their cities are destroyed; no one will be left-- no one at all.

ekegusii: “Nariete eira korua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe; rituko ria rero nayeikeranirie.
english: "I have fellowship offerings at home; today I fulfilled my vows.

ekegusii: “Inche naigure amang’ana amange buna ayio, inwe mwensi nigo more abaremia mogonchanda.
english: "I have heard many things like these; miserable comforters are you all!

ekegusii: “Naigure okwemurungania kw’Abaisraeli. Kwana nabarabwo, obatebie ng’a engaki ya mogoroba mbaegwe enyama barie, na mambia inabaigote omogati. Erio bamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.”
english: "I have heard the grumbling of the Israelites. Tell them, 'At twilight you will eat meat, and in the morning you will be filled with bread. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God.'"

ekegusii: “Naigure Abamoabu bagochecheria abanto baane na Abaamoni bakobarama na kobachecheria, naende buna bagwetogia ase ogotumana chimbebe chiabo, na gosoa ase ense yabo.”
english: "I have heard the insults of Moab and the taunts of the Ammonites, who insulted my people and made threats against their land.

ekegusii: Naigure amang’ana ’ababani abwo bagokwana, abwo bakobana oborimo ase erieta riane, bagoteba. Inche narotete, ee, narotete!
english: "I have heard what the prophets say who prophesy lies in my name. They say, 'I had a dream! I had a dream!'

ekegusii: Yeremia omobani akairaneria, akabatebia, “Naigure amang’ana aino; inche ngochia inde kobasabera ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, buna mwamboririe, na amang’ana ande onsi Omonene arabairanerie, nimbatebie, tinkobabisa nonya nerimo timbatebia.”
english: "I have heard you," replied Jeremiah the prophet. "I will certainly pray to the LORD your God as you have requested; I will tell you everything the LORD says and will keep nothing back from you."

ekegusii: “Nabekire omoruoti one ase Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu.”
english: "I have installed my King on Zion, my holy hill."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inche nimbanchete inwe.” Korende inwe nigo mokoboria: “Naki otwanchete?” Omonene nigo akoiraneria, “Inee! Esau tarenge oyomwabo Yakobo? Inche nigo namwanchete Yakobo,
english: "I have loved you," says the LORD. "But you ask, 'How have you loved us?' "Was not Esau Jacob's brother?" the LORD says. "Yet I have loved Jacob,

ekegusii: “Nakobekire aye obe gokorenga abanto baane, naende obateeme buna omoturi ebioma agoteema ebioma biaye, erio obamanye na goteema chinchera chiabo.
english: "I have made you a tester of metals and my people the ore, that you may observe and test their ways.

ekegusii: “Ninde nayande amange atigarete nkobatebia, korende timokonyara koyaremereria bono.
english: "I have much more to say to you, more than you can now bear.

ekegusii: Ninde namange ngokwana na kogamba ase engencho yaino, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene; na inche aya naigwete korwa asare, naro nkoorokia ase ense.”
english: "I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is reliable, and what I have heard from him I tell the world."

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Tindi nomosacha.” Yeso akamotebia, “Gwakwanire boronge ng’a tori nomosacha,
english: "I have no husband," she replied. Jesus said to her, "You are right when you say you have no husband.

ekegusii: Elija akamoiraneria, “Inche tinchandeti Abaisraeli, korende naye kwabachandire, aye amo nenyomba ya iso, ekiagera mwatigire amachiko ’Omonene na mwabwatirie chinyasae chikorokwa Baali.
english: "I have not made trouble for Israel," Elijah replied. "But you and your father's family have. You have abandoned the LORD's commands and have followed the Baals.

ekegusii: Erio ng’ina akamotebia, “Nimbwate okoboria goke igo nkorenta asore, tobaisa kwanga.” Omoruoti akamotebia, “Boria okoboria kwao, baba; tinkwanga aya okoboria.”
english: "I have one small request to make of you," she said. "Do not refuse me." The king replied, "Make it, my mother; I will not refuse you."

ekegusii: “Erieta riao nariorokeirie abanto baria kwang’ete korwa ase ense. Barabwo nigo barenge abao, okabang’a inche, ne ring’ana riao baribwatire.
english: "I have revealed you to those whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours; you gave them to me and they have obeyed your word.

ekegusii: Ase igo agatebia Musa, “Narorire abanto aba ng’a nabanyabigoti bikong’u.
english: "I have seen these people," the LORD said to Moses, "and they are a stiff-necked people.

ekegusii: “Bono natubire omobere one negunia, ne chinguru chiane nachitugutire ime ase orotu.
english: "I have sewed sackcloth over my skin and buried my brow in the dust.

ekegusii: okobora, “Namochire ase okorua amanyinga atari na bobe bonde.” Barabwo bakabora, “Ninki aya are asetore? Mbwerorere aye!”
english: "I have sinned," he said, "for I have betrayed innocent blood." "What is that to us?" they replied. "That's your responsibility."

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche nakwanire nense maiso marore. Amatuko onsi nigo narenge kworokereria ase chisinagogi na ase Hekalu, aase Abayahudi bonsi baare gosangererekana, gose tintebeti ing’ana bobisi.
english: "I have spoken openly to the world," Jesus replied. "I always taught in synagogues or at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.

ekegusii: “Inarangeretie omonto korwa sugusu, ere ochire; ee, nigo namorusirie korwa moocha, ere narangerie erieta riane akonywe, natiringere abagambi inse buna esike egotiringwa, na buna omokori chinyongo agotiringa esike.
english: "I have stirred up one from the north, and he comes-- one from the rising sun who calls on my name. He treads on rulers as if they were mortar, as if he were a potter treading the clay.

ekegusii: “Naigure Efraimu okorera, ogoteba: Aye kwang’akire ase okondongeyia, na inche narongeire buna emori etorokereiri, ng’iranie, na inche ning’iranigwe, ekiagera naye Omonene, Nyasae one.
english: "I have surely heard Ephraim's moaning: 'You disciplined me like an unruly calf, and I have been disciplined. Restore me, and I will return, because you are the LORD my God.

ekegusii: Ase ogwechanda mono nasangereirie ebinto bi’okoagachera enyomba y’Omonene. Nasangereirie chitahabu chitalanta chilifu rigana erimo (100,000) ne chifeta chitalanta emilioni eyemo (1,000,000), ne chitaai amo nebioma ebinge mono, bitari korengeka. Boigo narentire chibao na amagena. Ase ebinto ebio naye omente ebinde.
english: "I have taken great pains to provide for the temple of the LORD a hundred thousand talents of gold, a million talents of silver, quantities of bronze and iron too great to be weighed, and wood and stone. And you may add to them.

ekegusii: “Rora, inche omonyene neatananerete Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli ribaga ri’abana abatangi. Abalawi mbabe abaane,
english: "I have taken the Levites from among the Israelites in place of the first male offspring of every Israelite woman. The Levites are mine,

ekegusii: Korende oborori inde nabwo nobonene kobua boria bwa Yohana, naki emeremo eria naetwe na Tata inyekoore. Emeremo eyio ngokora, yambereire kirori, ng’a Tata nere ontomete.
english: "I have testimony weightier than that of John. For the very work that the Father has given me to finish, and which I am doing, testifies that the Father has sent me.

ekegusii: Aya nabatebirie, erinde monyare koba nomorembe ime yane. Ase ense namonyore emechando, korende remia emioyo; inche nabuire ense.”
english: "I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world."

ekegusii: “Nabeire ngotacha egeteera gi’okomita amasabibu inche bweka; onde tari ase abanto orenge amo nainche. Nigo nagetachete inde nendamwamu, ee, nkagetindacha inde nekeririanda. Amanyinga ’obogima bw’abanto akanyororokera chianga chiane, na bono nigo mbwate ebitamase bi’amanyinga ase chianga chiane.
english: "I have trodden the winepress alone; from the nations no one was with me. I trampled them in my anger and trod them down in my wrath; their blood spattered my garments, and I stained all my clothing.

ekegusii: Bono narure ogochika ng’a abanto bonsi bare ase oboruoti bwane baiguswe na koiroka ase obosio bwa Nyasae o Danieli.” “Ere nere Nyasae ore moyo, nigo areo goika kare na kare; oboruoti bwaye tibogosirigwa nonya ng’ake, na okogamba kwaye nkogenderere gotari nomoerio.
english: "I issue a decree that in every part of my kingdom people must fear and reverence the God of Daniel. "For he is the living God and he endures forever; his kingdom will not be destroyed, his dominion will never end.

ekegusii: "I know full well what you are thinking, the schemes by which you would wrong me.
english: “Rora, nimanyete ebirengererio biaino, na emeroberio yaino y’ogonkora bobe.

ekegusii: “Nimanyete ng’a aye nonyare gokora ebinto bionsi, naende ng’a aya kwaganirie gokora takonyara gotangwa taba.
english: "I know that you can do all things; no plan of yours can be thwarted.

ekegusii: “Nigo nakoimokereretie igoro korwa ase orotu, ngakobeka okaba omoraai bw’abanto baane Abaisraeli, na bono aye kwabwatirie chinchera chia Yeroboamu, naende kwagerire abanto baane Abaisraeli bakorire ebibe na bangechirie goika nabeire nendamwamu ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
english: "I lifted you up from the dust and made you leader of my people Israel, but you walked in the ways of Jeroboam and caused my people Israel to sin and to provoke me to anger by their sins.

ekegusii: “Omoyo one ogechire obogima bwane; nimbe nobosibore gokwana na kwemurungania, ninkwane nobororo bore ase omoyo one.
english: "I loathe my very life; therefore I will give free rein to my complaint and speak out in the bitterness of my soul.

ekegusii: Omonene, ninganyete ogotooreka kwao nogosemeria!
english: "I look for your deliverance, O LORD.

ekegusii: Nkarigia omonto ase egati yabo oranyare koagacha orwaki, na gotenena ase obosio bwane aase agwo atagoretwe, erinde akengere ense eyio, timbaisa koyesaria, korende tinanyorete onde.
english: "I looked for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand before me in the gap on behalf of the land so I would not have to destroy it, but I found none.

ekegusii: “Inche nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namaiso aane ng’a tinkorigereria omoiseke omwekungi ase okomogania.
english: "I made a covenant with my eyes not to look lustfully at a girl.

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nigo narengereretie buna nare konyara kobabeka inwe ase egati y’abana baane, erinde mbae ense ere engiya mono, ense y’omwando ere engiya kobua ey’ebisaku binde bionsi. Nigo narengereretie ng’a inwe namondoke Tata, na timware koonchoka montige.
english: "I myself said, "'How gladly would I treat you like sons and give you a desirable land, the most beautiful inheritance of any nation.' I thought you would call me 'Father' and not turn away from following me.

ekegusii: Ase ayio inche omonyene ninsangererie abatigari be riicho riane, mbarusie korwa chinse chionsi agwo ase nabasiarerete gochia; nimbairanie gocha ase obweri bwabo, na barabwo nabaibore na komentekana.
english: "I myself will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them and will bring them back to their pasture, where they will be fruitful and increase in number.

ekegusii: “Rora, inche ngokora nde okobwatana kw’ogotianania nainwe, amo nororeria rwaino roraiborwe korwa nyuma yaino,
english: "I now establish my covenant with you and with your descendants after you

ekegusii: “Ngasiria abanto bande baino, buna inche Nyasae nasiretie Sodomu na Gomora, na inwe nigo mwarenge buna ekegenga giataboretigwe korwa riko. Korende nonya nabo, timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "I overthrew some of you as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. You were like a burning stick snatched from the fire, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Nkabwatia ababisa baane, nkabasiria, gose tinairanete goika nkabakoora.
english: "I pursued my enemies and crushed them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

ekegusii: Korende nkabora: Yaya Omonene, ekiagera egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi, tibiana gosoa ase omonwa one nonya ng’ake.
english: "I replied, 'Surely not, Lord! Nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.'

ekegusii: “Nigo nanyorekanete ase abwo batarenge koboria igoro yane; nigo narenge koorokera abwo batarenge kondigia. Ngatebia egesaku getarenge korangeria erieta riane gekonywe: Nao inde aa. Nao inde aa.
english: "I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me; I was found by those who did not seek me. To a nation that did not call on my name, I said, 'Here am I, here am I.'

ekegusii: Natebire ng’a: “Inwe nechinyasae; inwe mwensi nabana b’Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.
english: "I said, 'You are "gods"; you are all sons of the Most High.'

ekegusii: Namororire, korende tari bono; namorigereirie, korende tari ang’e. Eng’enang’eni neoroke korwa ase egati y’abanto ba Yakobo, na enyimbo y’obogambi neoroke korwa ase Abaisraeli. Nesenyente chintakunero chi’emetwe y’Abamoabu, neiyerie abanto abebura‐buria b’esegi.
english: "I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel. He will crush the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of all the sons of Sheth.

ekegusii: “Nigo nabarenterete amaakwa anga buna aria narentete Misiri; naende ngaita abamura baino nemioro; nkabaura chibarasi chiaino, nkabatiokeria obogundo bw’abanto baino baitetwe, agwo ase ebitwori biaino. Korende nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "I sent plagues among you as I did to Egypt. I killed your young men with the sword, along with your captured horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camps, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Nabatebirie inwe: Omonto oria nigo aigete bwoye konya obareirwe oboronge kobua oria onde, ekiagera oyokweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.”
english: "I tell you that this man, rather than the other, went home justified before God. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."

ekegusii: Ekeene nabatebirie: Tinkonywa naende nonya ng’ake okwama kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa okoyia ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: "I tell you the truth, I will not drink again of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Ekeene nabatebirie: Onde bwensi oratebie egetunwa eke: Tegoka, otugutwe enyancha ime; oyo atabeti nogosiereria ase enkoro yaye, korende egene ng’a ayio ateba nabe, ayio nakoreke.
english: "I tell you the truth, if anyone says to this mountain, 'Go, throw yourself into the sea,' and does not doubt in his heart but believes that what he says will happen, it will be done for him.

ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyotasoereti egesieri ki’eero ye ching’ondi, korende aetere aao, oyio nomoibi naende nomokurumi.
english: "I tell you the truth, the man who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in by some other way, is a thief and a robber.

ekegusii: Ekeene nabatebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi aikeranire.
english: "I tell you the truth, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.

ekegusii: Nekeene nabatebirie: Ande onsi morasibe ase ense, nabe asibirwe na igoro; na ande onsi morasibore ase ense, nabe asiboirwe na igoro.
english: "I tell you the truth, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.

ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyokoigwa ring’ana riane, na komwegena ere oyontomete nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, gose tagoika ase ekina, korende oetire korwa ase amakweri, oikire ase obogima.
english: "I tell you the truth, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be condemned; he has crossed over from death to life.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Omobani tari oranyare gwanchwa ase ense yaye omonyene.
english: "I tell you the truth," he continued, "no prophet is accepted in his hometown.

ekegusii: "I tell you the truth," he said, "this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
english: Erio akabora, “Ekeene nabatebirie, Omoboraka oyo omotaka obekire ebinge kobua bonsi,

ekegusii: "I tell you the truth," Jesus answered, "before Abraham was born, I am!"
english: Yeso akabatebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ritang’ani Ibrahimu atarabao, inche nao naare.”

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Ase obotuko obo, ekero etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.”
english: "I tell you the truth," Jesus answered, "this very night, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times."

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Rero, ase obotuko obo, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga ara kabere, nonkane ara gatato.”
english: "I tell you the truth," Jesus answered, "today-- yes, tonight-- before the rooster crows twice you yourself will disown me three times."

ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Monto onde tari otigire enyomba, gose bamura bamwabo, gose basubati bamwabo, gose ng’ina, gose ise, gose abana, gose emegondo ase engencho yane, gose ase engencho y’enchili,
english: "I tell you the truth," Jesus replied, "no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for me and the gospel

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Monto onde tari otigire enyomba, gose mokaye, gose abamwabo, gose abaibori, gose abana, ase engencho y’oboruoti bwa Nyasae,
english: "I tell you the truth," Jesus said to them, "no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God

ekegusii: “Nagotebirie, imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”
english: "I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home."

ekegusii: “Nabatebirie inwe abasani baane, timoiroka abwo bagoita omobere, na nyuma ase ayio tibari negento baranyare gokora kobua.
english: "I tell you, my friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.

ekegusii: “Inche nigo nkobatebia, kera oyomo oranyatore ase mwanyabanto, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere namwatore ase abamalaika ba Nyasae;
english: "I tell you, whoever acknowledges me before men, the Son of Man will also acknowledge him before the angels of God.

ekegusii: "I tell you," he replied, "if they keep quiet, the stones will cry out."
english: Akairaneria, “Nabatebirie: Aba nabaisa gokira, amagena aya naake eriogi.”

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene tindi koonchoka, na ase engencho eyio, inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo timwasiretigwe.
english: "I the LORD do not change. So you, O descendants of Jacob, are not destroyed.

ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio. Goika aikerane. Ninkore ring’ana erio, tingotiga. Tinkoba namabera, gose tingweitia. Goika onacherwe ekina koreng’ana ne chinchera chiao, na ogokora kwao. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: "'I the LORD have spoken. The time has come for me to act. I will not hold back; I will not have pity, nor will I relent. You will be judged according to your conduct and your actions, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo nkoriga‐rigia ebirengererio bia mwanyabanto, na korenga chinkoro chiabo, erinde ng’ee kera omonto koreng’ana ne chinchera chiaye, na buna okwama kw’ogokora kwaye kore.”
english: "I the LORD search the heart and examine the mind, to reward a man according to his conduct, according to what his deeds deserve."

ekegusii: “Erio nkaba nkorengereria ng’a amatuko aane nigo arabe amange buna omokenye, erio ngokwa imbe ase egeswa kiane.
english: "I thought, 'I will die in my own house, my days as numerous as the grains of sand.

ekegusii: Nkabairaneria ng’a tari engencho y’Abarumi korua omonto onde bwensi aitwe ritang’ani omonto oria omosoerwa atararorana nabamosoeri baye obosio ase obosio, na koegwa ribaga gwekengera ase ogosoerwa kwaye.
english: "I told them that it is not the Roman custom to hand over any man before he has faced his accusers and has had an opportunity to defend himself against their charges.

ekegusii: "I told you that I am he," Jesus answered. "If you are looking for me, then let these men go."
english: Yeso akairaneria, “Naikire kobatebia ng’a ninche ere; nabo onye mokondigia inche, batige aba bagende.”

ekegusii: "I too was convinced that I ought to do all that was possible to oppose the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
english: “Ekeene inche omonyene naroche ng’a nengwenerete gokora amang’ana amange mamincha y’erieta ria Yeso o Nazareti.

ekegusii: “Nigo narenge ase omochie okorokwa Yopa, ngosaba nare, nkaba buna oyobwatire nobogondereria, nkarora ase okorora egento kere buna egetambaa kiabwatire emekoba ene, kegoikigwa korwa igoro gocha asende.
english: "I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision. I saw something like a large sheet being let down from heaven by its four corners, and it came down to where I was.

ekegusii: Ere agatebia Samison, “Nigo narengereretie ng’a nkwamogechete; ase ayio nkamoa omong’wansi oo, na ere akamonyuoma. Omoiseke omwabo omoke nare aa, ere nigo are omonyakieni kobua oria. Moire oyio ribaga ri’oria.”
english: "I was so sure you thoroughly hated her," he said, "that I gave her to your friend. Isn't her younger sister more attractive? Take her instead."

ekegusii: Nimbe Iso oino, na inwe mobe abana baane, abamura na abaiseke. Nabo Omonene Omobui otebire.”
english: "I will be a Father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty."

ekegusii: Nimbarente banyenywe buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi, ne chimingichi amo ne chigoree chikonyenywa.”
english: "I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams and goats.

ekegusii: Inche ning’egere omochie oyo na koyotooria ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one.”
english: "I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant!"

ekegusii: “Inche ning’orokie obonene bwane ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, erinde abwo bonsi barore ekina nanachire, na buna okoboko kwane gokorua egesusuro ase ababisa baane.
english: "I will display my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see the punishment I inflict and the hand I lay upon them.

ekegusii: "I will do whatever you say," Ruth answered.
english: Rutu akairaneria, “Aya onsi gwantebia ninyakore.”

ekegusii: Inche ninkobekere orobebe rwao gochakera Enyancha Embariri goikera Enyancha y’Abafilisti, naende korwa ase erooro goika orooche rwa Eufarati, ekiagera nimbeke ababiare b’ense eyio ase amaboko aino, na inwe mobaserie, batame korwa asemore.
english: "I will establish your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the desert to the River. I will hand over to you the people who live in the land and you will drive them out before you.

ekegusii: “Inche natigire abanto baane, natigire abanto bare omwando one. Nabekire abanchwa baane ase amaboko ’ababisa babo.
english: "I will forsake my house, abandon my inheritance; I will give the one I love into the hands of her enemies.

ekegusii: Bono Saulo akarengereria iga, “Nigo ndae Daudi omoiseke oyo, nere orabe okomotega, erinde agwe ase amaboko ’Abafilisti, nabarabwo bamoite.” Ase ayio Saulo agatebia Daudi eria kabere, “Bono onyuome omoiseke one, erinde inche imbe iso biara.”
english: "I will give her to him," he thought, "so that she may be a snare to him and so that the hand of the Philistines may be against him." So Saul said to David, "Now you have a second opportunity to become my son-in-law."

ekegusii: Omoika oria okairaneria: Nigo nkoimoka ngende, imbe omoika bw’obong’ainereria ase emenwa y’ababani baria bonsi b’Ahabu. Omonene akayotebia: Genda omoebererie ase enchera eyio. Nobue.
english: "'I will go and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets,' he said. "'You will succeed in enticing him,' said the LORD. 'Go and do it.'

ekegusii: “Nindete omorembe ase ense yaino, na inwe namorare motari kwoboa monto onde bwensi. Nindusie ching’iti chi’orosana chirueo, ne chisegi tichikobao.
english: "'I will grant peace in the land, and you will lie down and no one will make you afraid. I will remove savage beasts from the land, and the sword will not pass through your country.

ekegusii: Na Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabanene b’oboruoti bwaye, nimbabeke ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na ase amaboko ’abanto bakorigia gosiria obogima bwabo. Nimbabeke ase amaboko ’abarwani b’omoruoti o Babeli abwo konya babatigire.
english: "I will hand Zedekiah king of Judah and his officials over to their enemies who seek their lives, to the army of the king of Babylon, which has withdrawn from you.

ekegusii: “Ningwenie abwo batigire obwegenwa bwabo. Nimbanche nenkoro yane yonsi, ekiagera endamwamu yane yabatigire.
english: "I will heal their waywardness and love them freely, for my anger has turned away from them.

ekegusii: “Nimbeke amabe onsiigoro asebare, nimbarase nemegwe yane.
english: "I will heap calamities upon them and spend my arrows against them.

ekegusii: Akabora: Nimbise obosio bwane korwa asebare, erio ndore omoerio obo buna ogochia koba, ekiagera barabwo nekegori egesisekanu, abanto batari abegenwa.
english: "I will hide my face from them," he said, "and see what their end will be; for they are a perverse generation, children who are unfaithful.

ekegusii: Nimbasesenie moibore abana abange, momenteke. Ninkore okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania kogenderera koba nainwe.
english: "'I will look on you with favor and make you fruitful and increase your numbers, and I will keep my covenant with you.

ekegusii: Ninkore okobwatana kw’omorembe amo nabarabwo. Ninsirie ching’iti chintindi chirue ase ense eyio, na abanto baane mbamenye ase erooro na babe bakorara ase amanani bare nobotoereru.
english: "'I will make a covenant of peace with them and rid the land of wild beasts so that they may live in the desert and sleep in the forests in safety.

ekegusii: “Ninsarie Yerusalemu obe chitui chi’amaturi na amakuruma e chisese chi’orosana. Ninsarie emechie ya Yuda ebe bosa aase omonto atanyare komenya.”
english: "I will make Jerusalem a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals; and I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there."

ekegusii: Ase ayio nindigererie ng’a erieta riane richenu ndimanyekane ase egati y’Abaisraeli, abanto baane; tingotiga erieta riane rigenderere gokorwa eritachenegeti. Erio abanto b’ebisaku mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: "'I will make known my holy name among my people Israel. I will no longer let my holy name be profaned, and the nations will know that I the LORD am the Holy One in Israel.

ekegusii: Aye omochie, ningosirie obe amaturi na oyo ogochaywa nabanto b’ebisaku bigoetanaine, na ase amasio ’abanto bonsi abagoeta asore.
english: "I will make you a ruin and a reproach among the nations around you, in the sight of all who pass by.

ekegusii: "I will make you into a great nation and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.
english: Ningokore obe egesaku ekenene, ningosesenie, ninkore erieta riao ribe rinene, na aye nobe omosesenigwa.

ekegusii: "I will not enter my house or go to my bed--
english: “Tingosoa nyomba mwane, gose tinkoriina borere korara;

ekegusii: “Inche tingotiga ting’orokia buna ebiimo biaye bire, naende buna okobua ne chinguru chiaye bire, na buna amauga ’omobere oye aagachegete buya.
english: "I will not fail to speak of his limbs, his strength and his graceful form.

ekegusii: Ekero abaiseke baino barabe bagokora obonyaka na korua ebing’wanso, na baka bamura baino barabe bagokora obotomani, tinkobaa egesusuro, ekiagera abasacha abanyene nigo bakogenda ao bakora obonyaka nabatayayi be chihekalu, na abanto batari nokomanya goika basirigwe kegima.
english: "I will not punish your daughters when they turn to prostitution, nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery, because the men themselves consort with harlots and sacrifice with shrine prostitutes-- a people without understanding will come to ruin!

ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Tindigeti kogenda, korende nyuma yaye akaonchoka, akagenda.
english: "'I will not,' he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.

ekegusii: Nimbaboorie korwa ase okobua gw’aase abakure, na nimbatoorie korwa ase amakweri. Aye amakweri, amaako ao ng’ai are? Aye aase abakure, ng’ai ogosiria kwao kore? Ogweitia gwasirire korwa ase amaiso aane?
english: "I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. Where, O death, are your plagues? Where, O grave, is your destruction? "I will have no compassion,

ekegusii: Ase abanto abwo bamanyete inche ninyatore Rahabu, na Abababeli, na Abafilisti, na Abaturo, amo nabanto b’Etiopia, na goteba, “Oyo na oyo nao baiboreretwe ime aaria.”
english: "I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me-- Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush--and will say, 'This one was born in Zion.'"

ekegusii: Beni‐Hadadi akamotebia, “Emechie tata airete korwa ase iso ninkoyeiranerie; naye bweroiserie chinchera chi’oboonchoreria agwo Damesiki, buna tata akorete agwo Samaria.” Ahabu akamoiraneria, “Ase amang’ana ayio ningotige ogende.” Erio Ahabu agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere, akamotiga agende.
english: "I will return the cities my father took from your father," Ben-Hadad offered. "You may set up your own market areas in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria." [Ahab said,] "On the basis of a treaty I will set you free." So he made a treaty with him, and let him go.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Nimbaimokere, nsarie Babeli kegima, ninsirie erieta riaye na abatigari bare aroro. Tingotiga abana aroro gose abachokoro. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda natebire ayio.
english: "I will rise up against them," declares the LORD Almighty. "I will cut off from Babylon her name and survivors, her offspring and descendants," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ningokonye nkorusie ase amaboko ’abakori amabe na korwa ase abanto abatindi.”
english: "I will save you from the hands of the wicked and redeem you from the grasp of the cruel."

ekegusii: Nimbasiarere buna omoiriro ogosiarerwa nomwaga korwa ase erooro.
english: "I will scatter you like chaff driven by the desert wind.

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nigo nachikire ng’a amaakwa e chingencho inye nabanyore abasirie: Emioro ebaite, ne chisese chibatandorane, ne chinyoni amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana chibarie na kobasiria.
english: "I will send four kinds of destroyers against them," declares the LORD, "the sword to kill and the dogs to drag away and the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth to devour and destroy.

ekegusii: “Nintang’anie okwoboyia kwane bosio bwao goichanie na gotantania abanto bonsi abwo morabe mokoumerana nabarabwo; ninkore ababisa bao bonsi baonchoke batame korwa asore.
english: "I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run.

ekegusii: Nimbeke ekemanyererio ase egati y’abwo; abande b’abwo baratooreke nimbatome bagende ase abanto b’ebisaku, bagende Tarisisi, na ase abanto ba Puli na Ludi, abwo bamanyete korasa nemegwe, bagende Tubali na Yavani, na ase ebisinka ne chinse chi’enyancha chire aare, ase abanto batana koigwa chinkuma chiane, na agwo mbabararerie abanto b’ebisaku obonene bwane.
english: "I will set a sign among them, and I will send some of those who survive to the nations-- to Tarshish, to the Libyans and Lydians (famous as archers), to Tubal and Greece, and to the distant islands that have not heard of my fame or seen my glory. They will proclaim my glory among the nations.

ekegusii: Nintongie omorero ase chindwaki chia Damesiki, noro nosambe chinyomba chi’omoruoti Beni‐Hadadi.”
english: "I will set fire to the walls of Damascus; it will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad."

ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase abanto bakoboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, gose kogenda ase abarogi, taba omwegenwa asende, korende abe ogosasima emeika eyio, inche nimbe nendamwamu ase omonto oyio, na imwatanane korwa ase abanto baye.
english: "'I will set my face against the person who turns to mediums and spiritists to prostitute himself by following them, and I will cut him off from his people.

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene ninseegete Abamisiri baitane boka abanyene; kera omonto nigo ararwane noyomwabo, na kera omoamate arwane nomoamate omwabo. Ninseegete abanto b’omochie oyomo barwane nab’omochie onde, na oboruoti borwane noboruoti bonde.
english: "I will stir up Egyptian against Egyptian-- brother will fight against brother, neighbor against neighbor, city against city, kingdom against kingdom.

ekegusii: “Ning’ee Abayuda chinguru, ee, nintoorie abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu. Nimbairanie bamenye inka, ekiagera nabaroreire amabera; barabwo mbarorekane buna inche konya timbaangeti, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo, ninyigwe ogosaba kwabo.
english: "I will strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph. I will restore them because I have compassion on them. They will be as though I had not rejected them, for I am the LORD their God and I will answer them.

ekegusii: “Nindambore okoboko kwane igoro y’Abayuda, na igoro y’abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu. Ninsirie korwa aase aiga abatigari abwo bagosasima Baali, na amarieta ’ababani na ay’abakuani abagokorera emegwekano.
english: "I will stretch out my hand against Judah and against all who live in Jerusalem. I will cut off from this place every remnant of Baal, the names of the pagan and the idolatrous priests--

ekegusii: “Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, nimbasangererie inwe mwensi, ee ekeene, ninsangererie abatigari b’Abaisraeli buna ching’ondi chigosangererigwa chiabekwa ase obweri obomo, na buna riicho rie ching’ondi rikorisia aase aamo, mbabe bakwoga, ekiagera bare abange.
english: "I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob; I will surely bring together the remnant of Israel. I will bring them together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture; the place will throng with people.

ekegusii: “Ase igo, rora ninduta‐rute amaboko aane igoro ase ebitoki bi’oborianania kwanyorire, na ase amanyinga ’abanto gwaitire ase egati yao.
english: "'I will surely strike my hands together at the unjust gain you have made and at the blood you have shed in your midst.

ekegusii: Ninsirie mwanyabanto, ne ching’iti, ne chinyoni chia igoro, ne chinswe chi’enyancha. Ninsirie nebikorenta okogocha amo nabakori amabe; ee, ninsirie mwanyabanto korwa ase ense.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "I will sweep away both men and animals; I will sweep away the birds of the air and the fish of the sea. The wicked will have only heaps of rubble when I cut off man from the face of the earth," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ninsirie kegima kera egento kerue ase ense.
english: "I will sweep away everything from the face of the earth," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Nimbarusie mbasirie kegima. Amasabibu takonyorekana ase emesabibu yabo, gose amako ase emeko yabo. Nonya namato ’emete asusanire na kwoma. Ebinto nabaete konya biasirire korwa asebare.”
english: "'I will take away their harvest, declares the LORD. There will be no grapes on the vine. There will be no figs on the tree, and their leaves will wither. What I have given them will be taken from them. '"

ekegusii: “Nimborokererie igoro y’okobua kwa Nyasae; amang’ana onsi igoro y’Omonguru tinkoyabisa.
english: "I will teach you about the power of God; the ways of the Almighty I will not conceal.

ekegusii: Ninkore Babeli obe obomenyo bw’ebirongo, naende obe ne chitente chi’amache. Ninyoabusere ekiabuso ki’ogosiria. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda natebire ayio.”
english: "I will turn her into a place for owls and into swampland; I will sweep her with the broom of destruction," declares the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: "I would like to reply to you and to your friends with you.
english: Bono ngokoiraneria nde aye amo nabasani bao abamore komo.”

ekegusii: “Inche Danieli ngachandeka ase omoika one, na amaroro aria naroche akang’ondokia.
english: "I, Daniel, was troubled in spirit, and the visions that passed through my mind disturbed me.
