ekegusii: “Inche ninche bweka ngotinyia ogosaria kwao, ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na tinkoinyora ebibe biao.
english: "I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions, for my own sake, and remembers your sins no more.

ekegusii: “Inche ninche nkobaremia. Aye naye ng’o okoiroka mwanyabanto abwo bagokwa? Mwanyabanto abwo bagosira buna obonyansi.
english: "I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you that you fear mortal men, the sons of men, who are but grass,

ekegusii: “Inche Yeso natomire omomalaika one kobarentera inwe oborori obo ase chikanisa. Inche ninche Ritina ria Daudi, na Oroiboro rwaye, na Eng’enang’eni ya Mambia, eria ekobara mono.”
english: "I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, and the bright Morning Star."

ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, nakorangeirie ase oboronge; nakobwatire okoboko kwao nkorendete. Goetera asore ninkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabanto, obe omobaso bw’abanto b’ebisaku.
english: "I, the LORD, have called you in righteousness; I will take hold of your hand. I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people and a light for the Gentiles,

ekegusii: Inche obong’aini nakorire okomanya kwabeire obomenyo bwane, nigo inde ne chisemi, naende nimanyete kogamba buya.
english: "I, wisdom, dwell together with prudence; I possess knowledge and discretion.

ekegusii: “Eng’ombe eise goita omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, ne chingunchara chiaye, goika eakwe amagena ekwe, ne chinyama chiaye tichiriegwa; korende omonyene eng’ombe eyio taegwa egesusuro.
english: "If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull must be stoned to death, and its meat must not be eaten. But the owner of the bull will not be held responsible.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi ase ororeria rwa Haroni obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, gose okorua amache anga buna chimengere, tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu goika ekero arabe ochenekire; naboigo na onde bwensi orakune egento getachenegeti, buna egetondo, gose omonto ogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro,
english: "'If a descendant of Aaron has an infectious skin disease or a bodily discharge, he may not eat the sacred offerings until he is cleansed. He will also be unclean if he touches something defiled by a corpse or by anyone who has an emission of semen,

ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogosamba omorero, na omorero oyio bwesiarere gochia ase amagwa, na emesaima y’endagera ere ase omogondo eyie, omonto oria goika aakane yonsi pi.
english: "If a fire breaks out and spreads into thornbushes so that it burns shocks of grain or standing grain or the whole field, the one who started the fire must make restitution.

ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, nenyimbo, erinde akwere ase amaboko aye, goika aegwe egesusuro.
english: "If a man beats his male or female slave with a rod and the slave dies as a direct result, he must be punished,

ekegusii: “Omonto karasabe na koegwa etugo sagare korwa ase omoiri oye, na etugo eyio keraakwe gose ekwe, na omonyene tayerochi, omonto oria goika ayeakane.
english: "If a man borrows an animal from his neighbor and it is injured or dies while the owner is not present, he must make restitution.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogotomana nomokungu bw’omonto onde, abwo babere, omosacha oria amo nomokungu oria, goika baitwe bakwe.
english: "'If a man commits adultery with another man's wife-- with the wife of his neighbor-- both the adulterer and the adulteress must be put to death.

ekegusii: “Ekero omonto agwatanana enyomba yaye ebe enchenu ase Omonene, omokuani akore rigori ri’enyomba eria, buna ere engiya gose embe; buna omokuani arakore rigori ri’enyomba eria, nario erio rirabe.
english: "'If a man dedicates his house as something holy to the LORD, the priest will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, so it will remain.

ekegusii: “Omonto karaatanane ase Omonene oboremo agorete, obwo botari ensemo y’omwando oye,
english: "'If a man dedicates to the LORD a field he has bought, which is not part of his family land,

ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogwatanana ensemo y’oboremo bw’omwando oye, erio aye oyekorere rigori koreng’ana nekerengo gie chimbusuro chikobusurwa aroro, chimbusuro chi’esairi ebitonga ikomi chiakanwe chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo etano.
english: "'If a man dedicates to the LORD part of his family land, its value is to be set according to the amount of seed required for it-- fifty shekels of silver to a homer of barley seed.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Omonto karatigane nomokungu oye, na omokungu oria airwe nomonto omoao, inee, omosacha oria omotang’ani nairanere omokungu oria naende? Ense eria tekoba entwambu ase enchera eyio? Inwe mwakorire obotomani nabanchi abange. Na bono moganetie koirana asende?
english: "If a man divorces his wife and she leaves him and marries another man, should he return to her again? Would not the land be completely defiled? But you have lived as a prostitute with many lovers-- would you now return to me?" declares the LORD.

ekegusii: "If a man gives a donkey, an ox, a sheep or any other animal to his neighbor for safekeeping and it dies or is injured or is taken away while no one is looking,
english: “Omonto karae omoiri oye etigere, gose eng’ombe, gose eng’ondi, gose etugo ende yonsi ebe sagare, na etugo eria eitwe gose eakwe, gose eirwe monto tarora,

ekegusii: “Omonto karae omoiri oye chibesa, gose ebinto binde biaye amogachere, na birobio biibwe korwa nyomba mwaye, omoibi karanyorekane goika aakane ara kabere.
english: "If a man gives his neighbor silver or goods for safekeeping and they are stolen from the neighbor's house, the thief, if he is caught, must pay back double.

ekegusii: “Omonto kararisie etugo yaye ase omogondo bw’endagera, gose oyo bw’emesabibu, na gotiga riicho riaye ririe endagera y’omonto onde, nere goika aakane endagera enoru korwa ase omogondo oye, gose eyere engiya korwa ase emesabibu yaye.
english: "If a man grazes his livestock in a field or vineyard and lets them stray and they graze in another man's field, he must make restitution from the best of his own field or vineyard.

ekegusii: "'If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he must be put to death, and you must kill the animal.
english: Onye omonto okorara neng’iti, omonto oyio aitwe akwe, na eng’iti eyio eitwe ekwe.

ekegusii: “Omonto karaake omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, na komwata eriso, rirorio goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’eriso riaye.
english: "If a man hits a manservant or maidservant in the eye and destroys it, he must let the servant go free to compensate for the eye.

ekegusii: Onye omosacha okorara nomosacha onde buna akorara nomokungu, abwo bonsi babere bakorire okogechia okobe; goika baitwe bakwe, na okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo korabe okwabo.
english: "'If a man lies with a man as one lies with a woman, both of them have done what is detestable. They must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

ekegusii: Onye omonto omosacha okorara nomokungu ekero abwate omotienyi, omonto oyio orenteire omokungu oyio obosooku ase okorora ensoko y’amanyinga aye, nere oorokirie ase amanyinga agoiteka korwa; abwo babere baatananwe korwa ase abanto b’egesaku kiabo.
english: "'If a man lies with a woman during her monthly period and has sexual relations with her, he has exposed the source of her flow, and she has also uncovered it. Both of them must be cut off from their people.

ekegusii: Omosacha kararare nomokungu ore nomotienyi, ogotacheneka kw’omokungu oyio nakobe asare, ere nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, na gento kende gionsi arararere nakebe egetachenegeti.
english: "'If a man lies with her and her monthly flow touches him, he will be unclean for seven days; any bed he lies on will be unclean.

ekegusii: Onye omonto okonyuoma omokungu aire na ng’ina biara abasang’ananie, obwo nobonyaka obobe. Omosacha oria amo nabakungu baria babere basambwe nomorero bakwe, erinde obonyaka buna obwo tiboba ase egati yaino.
english: "'If a man marries both a woman and her mother, it is wicked. Both he and they must be burned in the fire, so that no wickedness will be among you.

ekegusii: Onye omonto okoira moka momura omwabo, okwo nogosaria, ere orenteire momura omwabo obosooku. Barabwo nigo baragombae.
english: "'If a man marries his brother's wife, it is an act of impurity; he has dishonored his brother. They will be childless.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto okoira omoiseke omwabo, oyo o ise gose o ng’ina, nabwo barorerane bare getirianda, obwo nobosooku obonene. Barabwo goika baatananwe barusigwe ase amasio ’abanto b’egesaku kiabo. Omonto oyio orenteire omoiseke omwabo obosooku. Obobe bw’ogosaria okwo nigo borabe igoro y’omonto oyio.
english: "'If a man marries his sister, the daughter of either his father or his mother, and they have sexual relations, it is a disgrace. They must be cut off before the eyes of their people. He has dishonored his sister and will be held responsible.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, obwate egesambo ase omotwe oye, gose ase ekenyonyobu,
english: "If a man or woman has a sore on the head or on the chin,

ekegusii: "If a man seduces a virgin who is not pledged to be married and sleeps with her, he must pay the bride-price, and she shall be his wife.
english: “Omonto karamogenke na gosaria omoiseke omwekungi otararierwa boko, goika aakane enibo eraisane amonyuome.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto okoonia enyomba ere ime ase omochie ogiteire orwaki, nanyare koyebooria goika ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo korwa ekero ayeoonetie. Ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo omogima nabe ne ribaga ri’okoyebooria.
english: "'If a man sells a house in a walled city, he retains the right of redemption a full year after its sale. During that time he may redeem it.

ekegusii: "If a man sells his daughter as a servant, she is not to go free as menservants do.
english: “Omonto karaoonie omwana oye omoiseke koba omosomba, omoiseke oyio tagosiborwa buna abasomba abamura barasiborwe.

ekegusii: “Omonto aise korara nomoiseke ore omosomba na oriereirwe boko nomonto omoao, na omoiseke oria taraboorigwa, gose taranyora obosibore, barabwo babere nigo baraegwe egesusuro, ko tibagoitwa, ekiagera omoiseke oyio taranyora obosibore.
english: "'If a man sleeps with a woman who is a slave girl promised to another man but who has not been ransomed or given her freedom, there must be due punishment. Yet they are not to be put to death, because she had not been freed.

ekegusii: Onye omonto okorara na moga ise moke, omwabo ise, igo orenteire ise moke obosooku. Egesusuro ki’ogosaria kw’ebibe biabo nigo kerabe ekiabo, na barabwo nigo barakwe bataiboreti bana.
english: "'If a man sleeps with his aunt, he has dishonored his uncle. They will be held responsible; they will die childless.

ekegusii: Onye omonto okorara na moka momura oye, abwo bonsi babere goika baitwe bakwe; bakorire okogechia. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo korabe okwabo.
english: "'If a man sleeps with his daughter-in-law, both of them must be put to death. What they have done is a perversion; their blood will be on their own heads.

ekegusii: Onye omonto okorara nomokungu ore moga ise, igo orenteire ise obosooku; abwo bonsi babere goika baitwe bakwe. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga abo nigo korabe okwabo.
english: "'If a man sleeps with his father's wife, he has dishonored his father. Both the man and the woman must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

ekegusii: “Omonto karaibe eng’ombe gose eng’ondi na koyenyenya, gose ayeoonie, nigo araakane chiombe isano ribaga ri’eng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi inye ribaga ri’eng’ondi eyemo.
english: "If a man steals an ox or a sheep and slaughters it or sells it, he must pay back five head of cattle for the ox and four sheep for the sheep.

ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oakire omonto onde negento buna ekioma, na omonto oria okure, omoiti oyio nere goika aitwe akwe.
english: "'If a man strikes someone with an iron object so that he dies, he is a murderer; the murderer shall be put to death.

ekegusii: "If a man uncovers a pit or digs one and fails to cover it and an ox or a donkey falls into it,
english: “Omonto karatige engoro yasie, gose onye okunyire engoro na tayekuneka, na eng’ombe gose etigere egwe imeo,

ekegusii: Eng’ombe y’omonto keraite ey’omonto onde ekwe, erio barabwo baoonie eng’ombe eyio ere moyo, baatanane chibesa echio, baatanane ne chinyama chi’eng’ombe eria yakure boigo.
english: "If a man's bull injures the bull of another and it dies, they are to sell the live one and divide both the money and the dead animal equally.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto onde bwensi ogokora ebibe mosiabano atancheti, ase amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene nakanete ng’a takorwa, na igo obeire nokomocha,
english: "'If a member of the community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the LORD's commands, he is guilty.

ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi aise gokora gento ase amang’ana ayio inche Omonene nakanete ng’a takorwa, nonya tamanyeti ng’a ayio akorire nokomocha, ere omochire, goika abarerwe okomocha okwo.
english: "If a person sins and does what is forbidden in any of the LORD's commands, even though he does not know it, he is guilty and will be held responsible.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorangerigwa abe kirori na gotiana, anyare koorokia aya aroche, gose aigwete, ko tayaorokia, ere goika abarerwe obobe boria bw’ogotaorokia.
english: "'If a person sins because he does not speak up when he hears a public charge to testify regarding something he has seen or learned about, he will be held responsible.

ekegusii: Onye omwana omoiseke bw’omokuani ogwesaria ase okoba omotayayi, igo orenteire ise obosooku; omoiseke oyio goika asambwe nomorero akwe.
english: "'If a priest's daughter defiles herself by becoming a prostitute, she disgraces her father; she must be burned in the fire.

ekegusii: Igo emogwenerete aakane chionsi. Onye tabwati gento, ere omonyene goika aoonigwe ase engencho y’oboibi bwaye. Onye etugo eyio aiba ekonyorekana ase amaboko aye ere moyo, aakane ara kabere, onye neng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi. “Omoibi karanyorekane ogotagora enyomba ase okoiba, nere aitwe akwe: omonto oria omoita takobarerwa oboiti obwo. Korende onye nigo amoita kobwakiire, rirorio nigo arabarerwe oboiti obwo.
english: "If a thief is caught breaking in and is struck so that he dies, the defender is not guilty of bloodshed;

ekegusii: Onye omokungu ogoika eng’iti ende yonsi ang’e, na korara nero, omokungu oyio goika aitwe akwe, na eng’iti eyio eitwe ekwe. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyiga abo nigo korabe okwabo.
english: "'If a woman approaches an animal to have sexual relations with it, kill both the woman and the animal. They must be put to death; their blood will be on their own heads.

ekegusii: “Onye omokungu ore bwoye ase omosacha oye oriete eira, gose agatiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete,
english: "If a woman living with her husband makes a vow or obligates herself by a pledge under oath

ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya onsi karabe abanyorire, na inwe mogenderere kwanga konyingwera, erio nario ndabae egesusuro ara gatano na kabere ase engencho y’ebibe biaino.
english: "'If after all this you will not listen to me, I will punish you for your sins seven times over.

ekegusii: “Onye omomenyi, gose omonto orikire omenyete bwoo, obeire omonda, na omonto omino bw’Abaisraeli obeire omotaka, eoonie ere omonyene ase omomenyi oria ore bwoo, gose ase monto onde bwensi bw’eamate y’abamenyi;
english: "'If an alien or a temporary resident among you becomes rich and one of your countrymen becomes poor and sells himself to the alien living among you or to a member of the alien's clan,

ekegusii: “Eng’iti ende yonsi yancheire koriegwa kerakwe, na omonto orayekune, rirorio omonto oyio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: "'If an animal that you are allowed to eat dies, anyone who touches the carcass will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: “Onye ukoma bore ase eanga eroisirie korwa ase amarionya gose egatani,
english: "If any clothing is contaminated with mildew-- any woolen or linen clothing,

ekegusii: “Omonto kagocha asende, nere atagecheti ise na ng’ina, na mokaye, na abana baye, na abamura bamwabo, na abasubati bamwabo, ee, nonya nobogima bwaye, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.
english: "If anyone comes to me and does not hate his father and mother, his wife and children, his brothers and sisters-- yes, even his own life-- he cannot be my disciple.

ekegusii: “Kera omonto okoragereria ise gose ng’ina, oyio goika akwe. Ekiagera oragereirie ise na ng’ina, okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye nigo korabe okwaye.
english: "'If anyone curses his father or mother, he must be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother, and his blood will be on his own head.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi otari bw’eamate y’omokuani orarie ebinto biria ebichenu ase ogotamanya, goika airanie egento egechenu ase omokuani, buna keria airete, na amente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio.
english: "'If anyone eats a sacred offering by mistake, he must make restitution to the priest for the offering and add a fifth of the value to it.

ekegusii: “Omonto aise gokora ebibe na gosaria asende inche Omonene ase okong’ainereria omogisangio oye ase okwanga koirania ebinto aetwe ase amaboko aye abirende, gose ase okomourereria, gose ase okomoibera ase okomorega,
english: "If anyone sins and is unfaithful to the LORD by deceiving his neighbor about something entrusted to him or left in his care or stolen, or if he cheats him,

ekegusii: "'If anyone takes the life of a human being, he must be put to death.
english: “Omonto oraite omonto onde, nere goika aitwe akwe.

ekegusii: “Omonto oria kararue emanwa y’eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, arente esigiti etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.
english: "'If he brings a lamb as his sin offering, he is to bring a female without defect.

ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oria takonyara konyora eng’ondi, gose embori, rirorio andetere inche Omonene amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, abe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ase engencho y’ebibe akorire. Erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
english: "'If he cannot afford a lamb, he is to bring two doves or two young pigeons to the LORD as a penalty for his sin-- one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering.

ekegusii: Karaete asibe abanto, gose kobagambia, ning’o oramotange?
english: "If he comes along and confines you in prison and convenes a court, who can oppose him?

ekegusii: “Omonto kararue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe asende inche Omonene korwa ase riicho rie ching’ondi, gose chimbori, arente eng’iti etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, etuoni gose eaberi.
english: "'If he offers an animal from the flock as a fellowship offering to the LORD, he is to offer a male or female without defect.

ekegusii: Onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ekio ase ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, rirorio amo nekeng’wanso ekio arue okoruegwa kw’amaandasi atabekiri memera aroisirie namaguta, na emegati emeoo etabekiri memera eakire amaguta, na emegati y’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta.
english: "'If he offers it as an expression of thankfulness, then along with this thank offering he is to offer cakes of bread made without yeast and mixed with oil, wafers made without yeast and spread with oil, and cakes of fine flour well-kneaded and mixed with oil.

ekegusii: "If he were not a criminal," they replied, "we would not have handed him over to you."
english: Bakairaneria, “Onye oyo atarenge omokori amabe, anga titwamorenta asore.”

ekegusii: “Onye ekeng’wanso kiaye nembori, ayerue ase obosio bwane,
english: "'If his offering is a goat, he is to present it before the LORD.

ekegusii: “Onye abanto b’ororeria rwaye bagochia gotiga amachiko aane, baange koigwera emeroberio yane echikire,
english: "If his sons forsake my law and do not follow my statutes,

ekegusii: Korende Elija akabairaneria, “Onye inche inde omonto o Nyasae, tiga omorero orwe igoro ogosambe na kogosiria, aye amo nabarwani bao emerongo etano.” Erio omorero okarwa igoro, ogasamba omotang’ani oria amo nabarwani baye emerongo etano, okabasiria.
english: "If I am a man of God," Elijah replied, "may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!" Then the fire of God fell from heaven and consumed him and his fifty men.

ekegusii: “Inse kwanga koroisia amang’ana ’omosomba one, omosacha gose omokungu, ekero baremurunganie igoro yane,
english: "If I have denied justice to my menservants and maidservants when they had a grievance against me,

ekegusii: "If I have denied the desires of the poor or let the eyes of the widow grow weary,
english: “Inche tinarinete omotaka egento aganetie, gose tinatigete omoboraka kwerusia moyo;

ekegusii: “Tinasemeretie etahabu, nonya netahabu echenire;
english: "If I have put my trust in gold or said to pure gold, 'You are my security,'

ekegusii: “Inee! Nagokerete ogosirigwa kw’omobisa one? Gose netogetie ekero amabe amocherete?
english: "If I have rejoiced at my enemy's misfortune or gloated over the trouble that came to him--

ekegusii: “Inee! Nabeire ngotaara ase chinchera chi’obong’ainereria, gose amagoro aane naminyokeire ay’oborimo?
english: "If I have walked in falsehood or my foot has hurried after deceit--

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nakwana bobe, orokia obobe boria, korende onye nakwana buya, ninki okong’akera?”
english: "If I said something wrong," Jesus replied, "testify as to what is wrong. But if I spoke the truth, why did you strike me?"

ekegusii: Inche kondeorokie omonyene, oborori bwane tibori obw’ekeene.
english: "If I testify about myself, my testimony is not valid.

ekegusii: “Komorabe mwanyorire egesusuro ekio gionsi timong’iranera, korende mogenderere koba maminche yane,
english: "'If in spite of these things you do not accept my correction but continue to be hostile toward me,

ekegusii: "'If in spite of this you still do not listen to me but continue to be hostile toward me,
english: “Komorabe mwanyorire emechando eye yonsi, na mogenderere kwanga konyigwera na koba mamincha yane,

ekegusii: Esteri akamoiraneria, “Omoruoti korarore mbuya, Abayahudi aba bare agwo Susa baegwe ribaga ankio boigo bakore koreng’ana nogochika kwa rero; tiga abamura ba Hamani ikomi batongwe ase chimbambo igoro.”
english: "If it pleases the king," Esther answered, "give the Jews in Susa permission to carry out this day's edict tomorrow also, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged on gallows."

ekegusii: Esteri akairaneria, “Koranche omoruoti, ochiche mwane rero, aye amo na Hamani, ase endagera nakoroiseirie aye omoruoti.”
english: "If it pleases the king," replied Esther, "let the king, together with Haman, come today to a banquet I have prepared for him."

ekegusii: akabora, “Aye omoruoti, onye kwarorire ng’a mbuya, na onye inche nanyorire ogwancherwa asore, ne ring’ana eri korirarorekane asore ng’a nerironge, aye omoruoti, naende inche ninkogokie, koranche amarube arikwe gochia ase chinsemo chionsi otange amang’ana aria Hamani, mosinto o Hamedata Omoagagi, achikire igoro y’Abayahudi ng’a aba bonsi bare ase chingongo chionsi chi’obogambi bwao basirigwe.
english: "If it pleases the king," she said, "and if he regards me with favor and thinks it the right thing to do, and if he is pleased with me, let an order be written overruling the dispatches that Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, devised and wrote to destroy the Jews in all the king's provinces.

ekegusii: “Abanto kobarabe bakorwana, na oyomo aake oyonde rigena, gose enkundi, oyio oakwa go takwa, korende abe okorwara borere,
english: "If men quarrel and one hits the other with a stone or with his fist and he does not die but is confined to bed,

ekegusii: “Abanto abasacha kobarabe bakorwana, na kogwera omokungu ore morito, na oborito bwaye bogwe, korende atabeti na bobe bonde, omonto oria omogwerete goika aakane buna omosacha bw’omokungu oria araborie nyuma abagambi kobanachire ekina.
english: "If men who are fighting hit a pregnant woman and she gives birth prematurely but there is no serious injury, the offender must be fined whatever the woman's husband demands and the court allows.

ekegusii: “Onye omoyo one obeire okoebererigwa na gwancha omokungu omoao, na igo nabeire nkoboera omonto onde ase egesieri kiaye imosirie,
english: "If my heart has been enticed by a woman, or if I have lurked at my neighbor's door,

ekegusii: “Inee! Oboremo bwane bwanakondeera gose emeng’ororia ye chintinde yana‐korererana?
english: "if my land cries out against me and all its furrows are wet with tears,

ekegusii: Onye ndiria abanto abwo baane bantegererete! Onye Abaisraeli mbabwatetie chinchera chiane!
english: "If my people would but listen to me, if Israel would follow my ways,

ekegusii: "'If one of your countrymen becomes poor among you and sells himself to you, do not make him work as a slave.
english: “Onye oyomino omenyete bwoo obeire omotaka, ere eoonie omonyene asore, tobaisa komokoria emeremo buna omosomba.

ekegusii: "'If one of your countrymen becomes poor and is unable to support himself among you, help him as you would an alien or a temporary resident, so he can continue to live among you.
english: “Onye oyomino obeire omotaka ere takonyara gwetenenera ere omonyene, aye nomoe ebio aremeire, abeere bwoo buna omomenyi, gose buna omorikwa.

ekegusii: Onye oyomino obeire omotaka na aoonie ensemo y’omwando oye, omoamate omwabo ore ang’e namoboorerie ensemo eyio konya aoonirie.
english: "'If one of your countrymen becomes poor and sells some of his property, his nearest relative is to come and redeem what his countryman has sold.

ekegusii: “Onye ndiria obororo bwane bwarenge korengwa, na emechando yane yonsi ebekwe ase ekerengo erengwe!
english: "If only my anguish could be weighed and all my misery be placed on the scales!

ekegusii: “Naki anga yaba buya, onye nkwambisa agwo aase abakure; onye kwandenda aase are bobisi, goika endamwamu yao ebe yaetire, onye gwanchikera engaki na kong’inyora!
english: "If only you would hide me in the grave and conceal me till your anger has passed! If only you would set me a time and then remember me!

ekegusii: “Omoiseke oria onye onyuomirwe nomosacha ritang’ani ataraikerania eira ariete, gose amang’ana akwanete ase ogotarengereria,
english: "If she marries after she makes a vow or after her lips utter a rash promise by which she obligates herself

ekegusii: “Korende omonto karakwe mobosokano ang’e nere, na akore omotwe oye ore nekemanyererio gi’okwerwa kwaye abe otachenegeti, rirorio Omwerwa oyio aganye amatuko atano na abere erio akigite etukia yaye, na abe oyochenekire.
english: "'If someone dies suddenly in his presence, thus defiling the hair he has dedicated, he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing-- the seventh day.

ekegusii: "If someone ventures a word with you, will you be impatient? But who can keep from speaking?
english: “Inee! Omonto arateema gokwana naye, nogechigwe nere? Nonya naboigo, monto ki oranyare gokira‐kiri takwana?

ekegusii: “Omonto kararue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, nigo ararente eeri gose eng’ombe etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.
english: "'If someone's offering is a fellowship offering, and he offers an animal from the herd, whether male or female, he is to present before the LORD an animal without defect.

ekegusii: “Onye omokuani oyoakire amaguta ogokora ebibe, na igo arentere abanto bonsi okomocha, goika arue eeri ensae etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ase engencho y’ebibe ebio akorire, ayerue asende ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye.
english: "'If the anointed priest sins, bringing guilt on the people, he must bring to the LORD a young bull without defect as a sin offering for the sin he has committed.

ekegusii: Onye oborwaire obwo bwa ukoma bwasokire ase risankwa isiko, na omokuani ororire ng’a bwesiareire ase omobere bwonsi korwa omotwe goika amagoro,
english: "If the disease breaks out all over his skin and, so far as the priest can see, it covers all the skin of the infected person from head to foot,

ekegusii: Omonto oyio omorwaire karatwere omonto ochenegete amate, nere goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, naende abe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: "'If the man with the discharge spits on someone who is clean, that person must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: “Ukoma boria koboratuboke naende ase enyomba eria nyuma amagena aria karusigweo, ne rioomo riria koriaoomoirwe, na enyomba eria yaoomirwe naende,
english: "If the mildew reappears in the house after the stones have been torn out and the house scraped and plastered,

ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa korwa ase amaicho e ching’ondi, gose chimbori, nigo ararente emingichi, gose egoree, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye.
english: "'If the offering is a burnt offering from the flock, from either the sheep or the goats, he is to offer a male without defect.

ekegusii: Onye nigo akorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa korwa ase amaicho e chiombe, arue eeri etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ayerente agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, erinde inche mwanchere.
english: "'If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he is to offer a male without defect. He must present it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting so that it will be acceptable to the LORD.

ekegusii: “Onye ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa akonduera inche Omonene gekorusigwa ase chinyoni, rirorio arente amaruma gose amage ’amaruma.
english: "'If the offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, he is to offer a dove or a young pigeon.

ekegusii: “Onye omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okorire ebibe mosiabano otancheti, na amang’ana ayio abe abisekanire asebare, kerabe bakorire kende gionsi eki inche Omonene nakanete ng’a tigekorwa, na igo babeire nokomocha,
english: "'If the whole Israelite community sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the LORD's commands, even though the community is unaware of the matter, they are guilty.

ekegusii: Ense kerabageche, momanyete ng’a yangechire inche etarabagecha inwe.
english: "If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first.

ekegusii: “Abaibi gose abasakori baise kogochera botuko, aye nosirigwe kegima. Ekeene, nigo baraibe binde bionsi baganetie. Inee! Abasangereria b’amasabibu baare kogochera, tibarenge kogotigera nonya naria agotigara?
english: "If thieves came to you, if robbers in the night-- Oh, what a disaster awaits you-- would they not steal only as much as they wanted? If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes?

ekegusii: Onye amang’ana ayio tari bo, ning’o oranyare kong’enekia ng’a nomorimo inde, naende aorokie ng’a amang’ana nakwanire nigo are bosa?”
english: "If this is not so, who can prove me false and reduce my words to nothing?"

ekegusii: “Onye eira y’omonto oria ariete nigoro y’eng’iti yancheire nainche Omonene ebe ekeng’wanso, ekeegwa buna ekio asende nakebe egechenu.
english: "'If what he vowed is an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the LORD, such an animal given to the LORD becomes holy.

ekegusii: Yoshua akabairaneria, “Onye more abange igo, na ensemo y’ebitunwa bi’Efraimu tebaisaini, tiira gochia rinani, morirabie, na momenye aroro ase ense y’Abaperisi na ey’Abarefai.”
english: "If you are so numerous," Joshua answered, "and if the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you, go up into the forest and clear land for yourselves there in the land of the Perizzites and Rephaites."

ekegusii: “Onye aye naye Kristo, totebie.” Korende akabatebia, “Ninsa kobatebia, timokonyara gwancha;
english: "If you are the Christ," they said, "tell us." Jesus answered, "If I tell you, you will not believe me,

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, etugute gochia inse, ekiagera nerikire: “Ere nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende, na barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.”
english: "If you are the Son of God," he said, "throw yourself down. For it is written: "'He will command his angels concerning you, and they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.'"

ekegusii: “Ekero okorenta okoruegwa kw’endagera esambeire riko nebe emegati etabekiri memera eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta, gose emegati emeoo eakire amaguta.
english: "'If you bring a grain offering baked in an oven, it is to consist of fine flour: cakes made without yeast and mixed with oil, or wafers made without yeast and spread with oil.

ekegusii: “Aye gokorenta ogotongora kw’endagera asende inche Omonene, goika orente ebigara ebibese bisambire ase omorero, bisenyentire.
english: "'If you bring a grain offering of firstfruits to the LORD, offer crushed heads of new grain roasted in the fire.

ekegusii: Koragore omosomba bw’Abaibirania, ere agokorere ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo, korende omwaka o gatano na kabere nigo ararue bwoo ore omosibore, tagoakana kende.
english: "If you buy a Hebrew servant, he is to serve you for six years. But in the seventh year, he shall go free, without paying anything.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Koranyare! Onsi nigo akonyarekana asare ere oyobwegenire.”
english: "'If you can'?" said Jesus. "Everything is possible for him who believes."

ekegusii: “Oise korora eng’ombe y’omobisa oo gose etigere yaye egosira goika omoyeiranerie.
english: "If you come across your enemy's ox or donkey wandering off, be sure to take it back to him.

ekegusii: “Komorabwatie aya nachikire, na kobwata amachiko aane na koyakora,
english: "'If you follow my decrees and are careful to obey my commands,

ekegusii: Onye kwabeire omoriri na kweimokereirie igoro, gose onye kwabeire gokorengereria amabe, beka okoboko kwao ass omonwa oo, oyotube.
english: "If you have played the fool and exalted yourself, or if you have planned evil, clap your hand over your mouth!

ekegusii: “Onye gokorosa ase okoamererania nabanto bakominyoka namagoro, naki rende oranyare gochia koamererania ne chibarasi chikominyoka? Na onye gokogwa ekero omenyete ase ense ere nomorembe, naki orakore ase amanani amanoru a Yorodan?
english: "If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out, how can you compete with horses? If you stumble in safe country, how will you manage in the thickets by the Jordan?

ekegusii: “Onye more nokomanya, igwa aya; tegerera moigwe aya ngoteba:
english: "If you have understanding, hear this; listen to what I say.

ekegusii: “Koratange okogoro kwao ase rituko ri’Esabato na bwetange tokora amang’ana ao agokogokia ase rituko riane richenu; koraroke Esabato ebe omogoko oo, rituko riria richenu ri’Omonene rituko ri’ogosikwa; korarisike otari kobwatia chinchera chiao omonyene, gose kwerigeria aya agokogokia, na tokwana amang’ana atagwenereti,
english: "If you keep your feet from breaking the Sabbath and from doing as you please on my holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight and the LORD's holy day honorable, and if you honor it by not going your own way and not doing as you please or speaking idle words,

ekegusii: “Oise komoa singo omonto onde one omotaka ore ase egati yaino, tobaisa gokora buna abwo bakoa abanto singo na koboria ebitoki ebinge; tobaisa komoboria ebitoki.
english: "If you lend money to one of my people among you who is needy, do not be like a moneylender; charge him no interest.

ekegusii: “Komoranyanche namobwate amachiko aane.
english: "If you love me, you will obey what I command.

ekegusii: “Komoranche ababanchete inwe, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo banchete abwo babanchete.
english: "If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' love those who love them.

ekegusii: “Onye naende mokogenderera koba mamincha yane na kwanga konyigwera, nindete amaakwa amange asemore, ara gatano na kabere, buna ebibe biaino biragwenere.
english: "'If you remain hostile toward me and refuse to listen to me, I will multiply your afflictions seven times over, as your sins deserve.

ekegusii: Moise goteba: Nase nchera ki tokomochanda? Nigo mokorengereria ng’a ninche nagerire amabe onsi anyorire?
english: "If you say, 'How we will hound him, since the root of the trouble lies in him,'

ekegusii: Ase igo onye gokooneria omonto onde gento kende gionsi, gose kogora korwa asare, timobaisa gokorerana oborianania.
english: "'If you sell land to one of your countrymen or buy any from him, do not take advantage of each other.

ekegusii: Erio Naamani agateba, “Onye taibo, nagosabire, tiga inche omosomba oo ng’egwe amaroba aisaine chigurube ibere, chiyombo ibere chiranyare kobogoria, ekiagera korwa bono na kogenderera inche omosomba oo tinkorua ebing’wanso ase enyasae ende yonsi, otatiga nase Omonene bweka.
english: "If you will not," said Naaman, "please let me, your servant, be given as much earth as a pair of mules can carry, for your servant will never again make burnt offerings and sacrifices to any other god but the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire iga: “Inwe Abaisraeli, onye morigetie koirana asende, ing’iranere. Motugute emegwekano yaino mogosasima ere okogechia ase obosio bwane, motari nechitang’u‐tang’u.
english: "If you will return, O Israel, return to me," declares the LORD. "If you put your detestable idols out of my sight and no longer go astray,

ekegusii: "If your brother sins against you, go and show him his fault, just between the two of you. If he listens to you, you have won your brother over.
english: “Oyomino karakore ebibe, genda omotebie okomocha kwaye, aye nere, inwe mweka. Karakoigwere, igo kwamonyorire.

ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oria takonyara konyora amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, rirorio arente obosie obonuke ebimunu bibere bobe okoruegwa kw’ebibe biaye. Tabeka amaguta, gose ubani, ase okoruegwa okwo, ekiagera nokoruegwa kw’ebibe.
english: "'If, however, he cannot afford two doves or two young pigeons, he is to bring as an offering for his sin a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering. He must not put oil or incense on it, because it is a sin offering.

ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto oria ore omotaka na takonyara konyora ebinge akorua, rirorio arente emanwa emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha kegosungusigwa ase okobwatanigwa kwaye. Boigo arente obosie ebimunu bibere bwochoganirie namaguta, bobe okoruegwa kw’endagera, na amaguta egetuba ekemo.
english: "If, however, he is poor and cannot afford these, he must take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be waved to make atonement for him, together with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, a log of oil,

ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto okorua ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’eira ariete, gose neki’ogwancha kwaye, nakeriegwe ase rituko riria gekoruegwa, na ekegotigara keriegwe ase rituko ria kabere.
english: "'If, however, his offering is the result of a vow or is a freewill offering, the sacrifice shall be eaten on the day he offers it, but anything left over may be eaten on the next day.

ekegusii: Korende onye intwe abanyene nigo twarenge korigia konyora oboronge ase Kristo, naende twanyoretwe tore abanyene ebibe, Inee, Kristo nabeire omosomba bw’ebibe? Yaya, taibo!
english: "If, while we seek to be justified in Christ, it becomes evident that we ourselves are sinners, does that mean that Christ promotes sin? Absolutely not!

ekegusii: Akamoiraneria, “Ninchie kogotomera emanwa egoree korwa ase riicho riane.” Omokungu oria akamoboria, “Inee! Inki orang’e kebe intenenera goika kwayentomeire?”
english: "I'll send you a young goat from my flock," he said. "Will you give me something as a pledge until you send it?" she asked.

ekegusii: Simion Petero akabatebia, “Nkogenda nde koruba chinswe.” Bakamotebia, “Naintwe natogende amo naye.” Bagasoka, bakariina obwato ime, korende obotuko boria tibanyora gento.
english: "I'm going out to fish," Simon Peter told them, and they said, "We'll go with you." So they went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.

ekegusii: Sisera agatebia Yaeli, “Ing’a amache inywe! Igo inde nerang’o.” Omokungu oria agakunora ekerandi gekorire korwa ase amasankwa, kiare namabeere, akamoa, na ere akanywa. Nyuma y’ayio Yaeli akamobisia naende.
english: "I'm thirsty," he said. "Please give me some water." She opened a skin of milk, gave him a drink, and covered him up.

ekegusii: “Korende bwango nyuma y’emechando y’amatuko aria, erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi tokobara, ne ching’enang’eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chia igoro nachitengechigwe.
english: "Immediately after the distress of those days "'the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.'

ekegusii: “Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.”
english: "In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me."

ekegusii: Ebing’wanso ebio amo nokoruegwa okwo goika mobirue ase Omonene ase chingaki chi’Amatuko aino Amanene achorire. Nabirobio bimentwe ase ebing’wanso biaino mwariete chiira ng’a morue, na ebing’wanso bi’ogwancha, onye nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose okw’ebinyugwa, gose ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.
english: "'In addition to what you vow and your freewill offerings, prepare these for the LORD at your appointed feasts: your burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings and fellowship offerings. '"

ekegusii: Ekero amariomana are ase abanto, abakuani mbabe abagambi b’ebina, mbabe bakogamba ebina ase okobwatia oboronge bwane. Mbarende emeroberio yane echikire, na amachiko aane ay’Amatuko Amanene. Boigo mbarende Chisabato chiane chibe chinchenu.
english: "'In any dispute, the priests are to serve as judges and decide it according to my ordinances. They are to keep my laws and my decrees for all my appointed feasts, and they are to keep my Sabbaths holy.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Nase Bethlehemu ya Boyahudi, ekiagera nabo yarigetwe nomobani,
english: "In Bethlehem in Judea," they replied, "for this is what the prophet has written:

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria amaicho gachiire rieme nkarigereria, nkarora ase chindoto ng’a chigoree echiaete amaicho amarieme nigo chiare namagwari na ebisembe, ne chimechege.
english: "In breeding season I once had a dream in which I looked up and saw that the male goats mating with the flock were streaked, speckled or spotted.

ekegusii: Engaki erache omwana oo karakoborie: Engencho y’amang’ana aya ninki? Goika omoiranerie: Ase okoboko kwaye gwe chinguru Omonene agatong’anyia korwa Misiri agwo ase twarenge abasomba.
english: "In days to come, when your son asks you, 'What does this mean?' say to him, 'With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

ekegusii: Naende konararire nkarora ase okorota kwane ebigara ebinene ebinoru bitano na bibere, bikinete ase oroboba oromo;
english: "In my dreams I also saw seven heads of grain, full and good, growing on a single stalk.

ekegusii: “Naende nkarora ase amaroro aane a botuko oyomo onga buna omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha amo namare a igoro, agaika ang’e ase omonto oria omokoro bw’amatuko amange, akarentwa ase obosio bwaye.
english: "In my vision at night I looked, and there before me was one like a son of man, coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was led into his presence.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abaiseke abekungi abanyabieni na abamura mbagoyane ase okoba nerang’o.
english: "In that day "the lovely young women and strong young men will faint because of thirst.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio kera oyomo oino narangerie oyomwabo ache, baikaranse komo inse y’emesabibu na emeko yaye.” “Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.”
english: "'In that day each of you will invite his neighbor to sit under his vine and fig tree,' declares the LORD Almighty."

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Ase rituko erio nebe ng’a ninyigwe ogosaba kwa igoro, na igoro nchiigwe ogosaba gw’ense.
english: "In that day I will respond," declares the LORD-- "I will respond to the skies, and they will respond to the earth;

ekegusii: “Rituko ngochicha rire ekero ndatenenie esaiga eria ya Daudi yagwete, ning’agache naende aase agwo atagogete, ngororokie amatombe aye; ninyeagache naende, ebe buna yarenge agwo kare.
english: "In that day I will restore David's fallen tent. I will repair its broken places, restore its ruins, and build it as it used to be,

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eyio nindangerie omosomba one Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia,
english: "In that day I will summon my servant, Eliakim son of Hilkiah.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eyio obonene bw’abanto ba Yakobo mbokeeigwe kegima, na obonetu bw’emebere yabo mboree.
english: "In that day the glory of Jacob will fade; the fat of his body will waste away.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Nebe ekero rituko riria riraike, nimbune amakorogoto, ninyerusie ase amagoti abo. Nimbasansore chingataare basibeire, na barabwo tibakoba abasomba b’abanto b’egesaku ekeao nonya ng’ake.
english: "'In that day,' declares the LORD Almighty, 'I will break the yoke off their necks and will tear off their bonds; no longer will foreigners enslave them.

ekegusii: Korende ase engaki eyio omosumari oria okong’onteretwe ase enyasi enkong’u nosimorwe korwao ogwe inse, ne chigurube chiasungireo nchigwe, chisamunyokane.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
english: "In that day," declares the LORD Almighty, "the peg driven into the firm place will give way; it will be sheared off and will fall, and the load hanging on it will be cut down." The LORD has spoken.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsirie chibarasi chiaino, ne chigari chiaino chirue asemore kegima.
english: "In that day," declares the LORD, "I will destroy your horses from among you and demolish your chariots.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsangererie ebirema, naende ninsangererie abwo naseretie, na bonsi abwo naete amaakwa.
english: "In that day," declares the LORD, "I will gather the lame; I will assemble the exiles and those I have brought to grief.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio abaruoti amo nabanene b’oboruoti tibakoba noboremu, abakuani mbaondoke na ababani mbakumie.”
english: "In that day," declares the LORD, "the king and the officials will lose heart, the priests will be horrified, and the prophets will be appalled."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio ninsirie abanto abang’aini ba Edomu, naende ninsirie okomanya gwonsi korwa ase Egetunwa gia Esau.
english: "In that day," declares the LORD, "will I not destroy the wise men of Edom, men of understanding in the mountains of Esau?

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Ase rituko erio nondoke omosacha oo, gose tokogenderera kondoka Baali yao.
english: "In that day," declares the LORD, "you will call me 'my husband'; you will no longer call me 'my master.'

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio nintige erioba rigwe mobaso gati, na nindete omosunte ase ense ekero omobaso obarete.
english: "In that day," declares the Sovereign LORD, "I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the earth in broad daylight.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio amatera agoterwa ase chihekalu naonchoke abe okorera gw’okweumia. Emebere y’abanto bakwete nigo erabe emenge aande onsi; abanto nigo barabe bakoyetuguta bakirete‐kiri.”
english: "In that day," declares the Sovereign LORD, "the songs in the temple will turn to wailing. Many, many bodies-- flung everywhere! Silence!"

ekegusii: Ase amatuko a Samigari, mosinto bw’Anati, na ase amatuko a Yaeli, chinchera chinene nigo chiariibete, abagendi nigo baare goeta ase chinsana.
english: "In the days of Shamgar son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the roads were abandoned; travelers took to winding paths.

ekegusii: “Ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani mobe ne Rituko Rinene ri’Epasaka, na ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere naro moyabwate na mobe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera.
english: "'In the first month on the fourteenth day you are to observe the Passover, a feast lasting seven days, during which you shall eat bread made without yeast.

ekegusii: “Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio, Nyasae otebire, nimbaiterere abanto bonsi Omoika one, na abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inababane. Abamura baino nabarore amaroro, na abagaaka baino nabarote chindoto.
english: "'In the last days, God says, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your young men will see visions, your old men will dream dreams.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki y’omoerio bw’amagambi ayio, ekero abasaria barabe baikeire ekerengo kiabo ki’omoerio, omoruoti omotindi mono oichire nobong’ainereria naoroke.
english: "In the latter part of their reign, when rebels have become completely wicked, a stern-faced king, a master of intrigue, will arise.

ekegusii: Ankio mambia goika mwerente aa bosio, egesaku ase egesaku. Abanto b’egesaku keria Omonene aratige obomera bobagwere goika bache bosio, eamate ase eamate Abanto b’eamate eria obomera boragwere bache bosio, enyomba ase enyomba. Abanto b’enyomba eyio Omonene aratige obomera bobagwere goika bache bosio omonto ase omonto.
english: "'In the morning, present yourselves tribe by tribe. The tribe that the LORD takes shall come forward clan by clan; the clan that the LORD takes shall come forward family by family; and the family that the LORD takes shall come forward man by man.

ekegusii: Abare gotama bagatenena ase ekiriri kia Hesiboni batari ne chinguru. Omorero okarua ase Hesiboni, chimeme chi’omorero korwa ase ense ya Sihoni, ogasaria amasio ’Abamoabu, na ogasamba ebiototeri bi’emetwe y’abanto banchete esegi.
english: "In the shadow of Heshbon the fugitives stand helpless, for a fire has gone out from Heshbon, a blaze from the midst of Sihon; it burns the foreheads of Moab, the skulls of the noisy boasters.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ’abaruoti abwo Nyasae ore igoro narente oboruoti botanyare gosarigwa, gose okobua kw’oboruoti obwo tibokoegwa egesaku kende. Obwo mbosenyente amaruoti onsi na koyasiria, na borobwo obonyene mbogenderere kobao goika kare na kare,
english: "In the time of those kings, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed, nor will it be left to another people. It will crush all those kingdoms and bring them to an end, but it will itself endure forever.

ekegusii: “Ekero naraire borere bwane, nkarora ase okorora kwane omorendi omochenu ogoika korwa igoro.
english: "In the visions I saw while lying in my bed, I looked, and there before me was a messenger, a holy one, coming down from heaven.

ekegusii: Ngachika Baruku agwo ase abanto bonsi baigwete, nkamotebia,
english: "In their presence I gave Baruch these instructions:

ekegusii: Na ase aase aiga ninsarie omoroberio bw’Abayuda na obw’abanto ba Yerusalemu. Nindue abanto b’emechie eyio baitwe nemioro ase obosio bw’ababisa babo na ase amaboko ’abanto baria bakorigia gosiria obogima bwabo. Nindue emebere yabo ekwete ebe endagera ye chinyoni na eye ching’iti chi’orosana.
english: "'In this place I will ruin the plans of Judah and Jerusalem. I will make them fall by the sword before their enemies, at the hands of those who seek their lives, and I will give their carcasses as food to the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.

ekegusii: “Ase Omwaka oyio bw’Omochengo kera omonto airanigwe ase omwando oye.
english: "'In this Year of Jubilee everyone is to return to his own property.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio na engaki eyio ninkore Omoseboka bw’oboronge oseboke korwa ase ororeria rwa Daudi. Oyio nanache ebina bi’ekeene na oboronge ase ense eye.
english: "'In those days and at that time I will make a righteous Branch sprout from David's line; he will do what is just and right in the land.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aria araike, tibagokwana iga nonya ng’ake: “Abaise babo barire amasabibu amaroro, na amaino ’abana babo abeire nobokang’iti.
english: "In those days people will no longer say, 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge.'

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda nabache amo babe bakorera na kondigia inche, Nyasae obo.
english: "In those days, at that time," declares the LORD, "the people of Israel and the people of Judah together will go in tears to seek the LORD their God.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio eyio abanto bande abange mbaimokere omoruoti o irianyi, naende abanto abasaria b’egesaku kiao nabeimokererie igoro ase ogwetogia, erinde bai keranie okorora koria aye kwaroche, mbagochwe bagwe.
english: "In those times many will rise against the king of the South. The violent men among your own people will rebel in fulfillment of the vision, but without success.

ekegusii: Nkaa abana baino egesusuro, korende tikiabarongeetie. Emioro yaino abanyene egaita ababani baino, buna nigo yarenge endo egoita.
english: "In vain I punished your people; they did not respond to correction. Your sword has devoured your prophets like a ravening lion.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio onsi, bono nigo togokora okobwatana gotari koonchoka na tokorike, erinde abanene baito amo n’Abalawi baito, na abakuani baito, babeke ebimanyererio biabo ase korokwo.
english: "In view of all this, we are making a binding agreement, putting it in writing, and our leaders, our Levites and our priests are affixing their seals to it."

ekegusii: Mobee, korende timokora ebibe; erioba tirigwa na inwe more nendamwamu,
english: "In your anger do not sin": Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry,

ekegusii: “Ase obwanchani bwao botari koera okaraa abanto aba kwabooretie, ase chinguru chiao okabaikia ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.
english: "In your unfailing love you will lead the people you have redeemed. In your strength you will guide them to your holy dwelling.

ekegusii: Na ababani bonsi abakwanete korwa Samweli, na baria bachete korwa nyuma yaye, bakararia igoro y’amatuko aya.
english: "Indeed, all the prophets from Samuel on, as many as have spoken, have foretold these days.

ekegusii: “Ekeene, namanyire ng’a ayio nabo are, korende naki omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae?
english: "Indeed, I know that this is true. But how can a mortal be righteous before God?

ekegusii: “Toborerie korwa ase Omonene, ekiagera Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, ngocha are gotorwania esegi; ande Omonene nabo arabaise gotokorera amakumia aye, erinde omoruoti oyio atotige tatorwania.”
english: "Inquire now of the LORD for us because Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon is attacking us. Perhaps the LORD will perform wonders for us as in times past so that he will withdraw from us."

ekegusii: “Inee! Eye nero engaki inwe mogwenerete komenya ase chinyomba chinyasi chiabo chitubire ne chibao chingiya, ekero enyomba eye egendererete koba ritombe?”
english: "Is it a time for you yourselves to be living in your paneled houses, while this house remains a ruin?"

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a nekiagera omoirogete, nakio gekogera agokoa egesusuro na gokorenta ase ekina?
english: "Is it for your piety that he rebukes you and brings charges against you?

ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe mwensi aba mogoeta inchera aa, aya nigo are amang’ana a bosa asemore? Rigereria morore gose emechando ende ere buna eyane, eyio yarentetwe asende, eyio Omonene andeterete, ekero arenge nendamwamu egwoka.
english: "Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see. Is any suffering like my suffering that was inflicted on me, that the LORD brought on me in the day of his fierce anger?

ekegusii: “Inee! Inche mwanyabanto nkwemurunganeria? Nase ki rende ndaremererie tinyemurungania?
english: "Is my complaint directed to man? Why should I not be impatient?

ekegusii: “Inee! Nyasae tari aaria igoro mono? Rigereria ching’enang’eni chia igoro buna chire aare mono!
english: "Is not God in the heights of heaven? And see how lofty are the highest stars!

ekegusii: “Inee! Ororeria rwane tirori boronge ase Nyasae? Takorete nainche okobwatana gwa kare na kare, okwo korobeirie gotari koonchoka? Inee! Nyasae tagonsesenia na gontooria, naende ang’e aya nganetie?
english: "Is not my house right with God? Has he not made with me an everlasting covenant, arranged and secured in every part? Will he not bring to fruition my salvation and grant me my every desire?

ekegusii: Inee! Ring’ana riane tiriri buna omorero, naende buna enyundo egwatia ebitare? Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Is not my word like fire," declares the LORD, "and like a hammer that breaks a rock in pieces?

ekegusii: “Okweng’ata inche nanchire noko: Mosibore chingataare chi’obobe; mosibore chinkini chi’amakorogoto, bae abachandegete ribaga bagende, na mobune kera rikorogoto.
english: "Is not this the kind of fasting I have chosen: to loose the chains of injustice and untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and break every yoke?

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Naye gwatebire ayio aye omonyene, gose nabanto bande bagotebirie amang’ana aya igoro yane?”
english: "Is that your own idea," Jesus asked, "or did others talk to you about me?"

ekegusii: bakababoria, “Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteba ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko? Naki akora orora bono?”
english: "Is this your son?" they asked. "Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?"

ekegusii: Oyo tari omwana bw’omobaachi? Ngi’na tari oria okorokwa Mariamu? Na bamura bamwabo tibari Yakobo, na Yusufu na Simion, na Yuda?
english: "Isn't this the carpenter's son? Isn't his mother's name Mary, and aren't his brothers James, Joseph, Simon and Judas?

ekegusii: “Abaisraeli nigo banga buna ching’ondi chigoserigwa ne chindo na goserebanigwa gochia aaria na aaria. Ritang’ani omoruoti bw’Abaasuri akababua na kobasiria, na bono omoerio Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, otakunire amauga abo.
english: "Israel is a scattered flock that lions have chased away. The first to devour him was the king of Assyria; the last to crush his bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon."

ekegusii: "Issachar is a rawboned donkey lying down between two saddlebags.
english: “Isakaru netigere ere ne chinguru, ekorara obweri bwe chitugo.

ekegusii: Egesaku gia Isakaru keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Simeoni korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Issachar will have one portion; it will border the territory of Simeon from east to west.

ekegusii: “Naende ndiatebetwe; Oyoratige mokaye, tiga amoe rirube ri’ogotigana.
english: "It has been said, 'Anyone who divorces his wife must give her a certificate of divorce.'

ekegusii: Ara aange kemoruta ase omorero na ase amache, erinde kemosirie, korende koranyare gokora ring’ana, tororere amabera, otokonye.”
english: "It has often thrown him into fire or water to kill him. But if you can do anything, take pity on us and help us."

ekegusii: Hezekia akairaneria, “Ne ring’ana rigusu omorengari otambee bosio ebitambokero ikomi, korende tiga omorengari oirane gochia nyuma ebitambokero ikomi.”
english: "It is a simple matter for the shadow to go forward ten steps," said Hezekiah. "Rather, have it go back ten steps."

ekegusii: Aya naro buna nagotebia aye Farao, ng’a Nyasae okworokirie aya agochia gokora iga bwango.
english: "It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nanachire iga, ng’a titochanda abanto baria b’Ebisaku abaonchokeire Nyasae,
english: "It is my judgment, therefore, that we should not make it difficult for the Gentiles who are turning to God.

ekegusii: "It is not for kings, O Lemuel-- not for kings to drink wine, not for rulers to crave beer,
english: Aye Lemweli, okonywa edivai tikogwenereti abaruoti, gose abagambi tibabaisa kogania ebinyugwa bigotindia.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Noyomo bw’aba ikomi na babere, ere oyogotobeka amo nainche ase esani.
english: "It is one of the Twelve," he replied, "one who dips bread into the bowl with me.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekeene, abaruoti b’Abaasuri basiririe abanto b’ebisaku ne chinse chiabo,
english: "It is true, O LORD, that the Assyrian kings have laid waste all these peoples and their lands.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nekeene ng’a abaruoti b’Abaasuri basiririe abanto b’ebisaku ne chinse chiabo,
english: "It is true, O LORD, that the Assyrian kings have laid waste these nations and their lands.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Nerikire: Enyomba yane nebe enyomba y’ogosaba, korende inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”
english: "It is written," he said to them, "'My house will be a house of prayer'; but you have made it 'a den of robbers.'"

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Nerikire: Enyomba yane nerokwe enyomba y’ogosaba, na inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”
english: "It is written," he said to them, "'My house will be called a house of prayer,' but you are making it a 'den of robbers.'"

ekegusii: Goika erierwe nyomba ime, timobaisa gosokia chinyama chinde isiko; timobuna riuga riaye rinde rionsi.
english: "It must be eaten inside one house; take none of the meat outside the house. Do not break any of the bones.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiaino nakio kiagerete abarikerete ogochika oko.
english: "It was because your hearts were hard that Moses wrote you this law," Jesus replied.

ekegusii: Naboigo buna yabete ase amatuko a Loti: Barenge koria na konywa, bakogora, bakoonia, bagosimeka, bakoagacha.
english: "It was the same in the days of Lot. People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.

ekegusii: Naboigo erache koba ase rituko riria Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto araoroke.
english: "It will be just like this on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria “Timoka, motoerere, timoondoka; Nyasae oino, oyore Nyasae o iso, nere obaete enibo eye ase chigunia chiaino; chibesa chiaino inachinyorete.” Erio akarenta Simeoni asebare.
english: "It's all right," he said. "Don't be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks; I received your silver." Then he brought Simeon out to them.

ekegusii: Omogori egento nigo agoteba: “Eke tigeisaini gento”, na ekero akeirire bwetogia.
english: "It's no good, it's no good!" says the buyer; then off he goes and boasts about his purchase.

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso Omonazareti.” Yeso akabatebia, “Ninche ere.” Yudas nere oyomoruete nigo ateneine amo nabarabwo.
english: "Jesus of Nazareth," they replied. "I am he," Jesus said. (And Judas the traitor was standing there with them.)

ekegusii: Ayubu nigo agoteba: Inche nomonyene oboronge, korende Nyasae ong’urire oboronge bwane.
english: "Job says, 'I am innocent, but God denies me justice.

ekegusii: “Yusufu nomote omorere okwama ang’e nensoko; chinsagia chiaye nigo chikoranda orobago igoro.
english: "Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine near a spring, whose branches climb over a wall.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Yuda na ab’ense y’Abaisraeli bagakora oboonchoreria naye; bagakorentera engano ekorwa Miniti, na amazeituni, na obooke, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na amaguta akogwenia.
english: "'Judah and Israel traded with you; they exchanged wheat from Minnith and confections, honey, oil and balm for your wares.

ekegusii: “Ense y’Abayuda nkorera ere, na ebiita biaye biatagoirwe, biagure inse. Abanto b’ense eyio baiyerigwe inse, nkweumia bare, ekerero ki’abanto ba Yerusalemu giaikire igoro.
english: "Judah mourns, her cities languish; they wail for the land, and a cry goes up from Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Egesaku kia Yuda keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Reuben korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Judah will have one portion; it will border the territory of Reuben from east to west.

ekegusii: “Aye Yuda, abamino inabagotogie; okoboko kwao inakobwate ebigoti bi’ababisa bao; abamura ba iso inabagosike.
english: "Judah, your brothers will praise you; your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; your father's sons will bow down to you.

ekegusii: “Ebibe bi’Abayuda nigo birikire nekaramu y’ekioma, na komang’erwa ne rigena rikong’u rikorokwa alimasi, ase chinkoro chiabo ime, na ase emegwekano ye chingunchara ere ase ebisasimero biabo.
english: "Judah's sin is engraved with an iron tool, inscribed with a flint point, on the tablets of their hearts and on the horns of their altars.

ekegusii: Naende buna yabete ase amatuko a Nuhu, naboigo erabe nase amatuko ’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.
english: "Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man.

ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Gwakwanire ekeene; inche tingocha korora obosio bwao naende.”
english: "Just as you say," Moses replied, "I will never appear before you again."

ekegusii: Mobwate amachiko aane onsi aya nabachikire. Inche ninche Omonene.”
english: "'Keep all my decrees and all my laws and follow them. I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: “Ase ayio mobwate amachiko aane na emeroberio yonsi nabachikire, na moyakore, erio ense eria ase nkobaira mogochia komenya tebaanga gose tebaseria korwa aroro.
english: "'Keep all my decrees and laws and follow them, so that the land where I am bringing you to live may not vomit you out.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio mobwate amachiko aane na koyakora. Inche ninche Omonene,
english: "Keep my commands and follow them. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: “Mobwate amachiko aane. Timobaisa gotiga chitugo chiaino chieenane amarieme ne chitari egesaku ekemo. Timobaisa kobusura chimbusuro chi’ebisaku bibere ase omogondo oyomo, timobeka chianga chiroisirie korwa ase chiusi ao ao.
english: "'Keep my decrees. "'Do not mate different kinds of animals. "'Do not plant your field with two kinds of seed. "'Do not wear clothing woven of two kinds of material.

ekegusii: Bwata bokong’u oboringoria bwao obonge na oborogi bwao, ebinto ebio gwechanderete korwa obwana bwao; ande nabo birabaise kogokonya, ande nabo birabaise goseria emechando yao.
english: "Keep on, then, with your magic spells and with your many sorceries, which you have labored at since childhood. Perhaps you will succeed, perhaps you will cause terror.

ekegusii: Inwe kira‐kiri, montige nkwane, na kende gionsi kegochia konyora, tiga kenyore.
english: "Keep silent and let me speak; then let come to me what may.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Chibesa echio gwachieirwe, na abanto kwabaeirwe, okore ande onsi orarore akogwenerete.”
english: "Keep the money," the king said to Haman, "and do with the people as you please."

ekegusii: “Omoruoti Agripa, nerorire omonyene ng’a ninde negesio, ekiagera ninyekengere ase obosio bwao rero, ase amang’ana aria onsi nasoerwa n’Abayahudi.
english: "King Agrippa, I consider myself fortunate to stand before you today as I make my defense against all the accusations of the Jews,

ekegusii: “Abaruoti b’abarwani esegi batamire, ee, batamire!” Abakungu batigarete ase chinka ngwatanana bare ebisakorwa.
english: "Kings and armies flee in haste; in the camps men divide the plunder.

ekegusii: Abaruoti bagacha, bakarwana, ee, abaruoti ba Kanani bakarwana ase Taanaki, agwo ase chindooche chia Megido, korende tibasakorete chifeta.
english: "Kings came, they fought; the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo, but they carried off no silver, no plunder.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, omanye na korengereria ng’a korwa engaki eria ring’ana riaruetwe igoro ya Yerusalemu ng’a noagachwe naende, goika ase engaki y’ogocha kw’oyomo Omoakwa Amaguta, oyore omogambi, nachibe chichuma isano na ibere. Naende ase chichuma emerongo etano nomo, na ibere, omochie noagachwe amo ne chinchera chiaye ne chiburi chiaye, korende ase engaki y’emechando emenene.
english: "Know and understand this: From the issuing of the decree to restore and rebuild Jerusalem until the Anointed One, the ruler, comes, there will be seven 'sevens,' and sixty-two 'sevens.' It will be rebuilt with streets and a trench, but in times of trouble.

ekegusii: “Ense ya Sabuloni na ense ya Nafutali, enchera egochia enyancha ng’umbu ya Yorodan, Galili, ense y’abanto b’Ebisaku,
english: "Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, the way to the sea, along the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles--

ekegusii: “Ekero naende naetete asore, ngakorigereria, nkarora ng’a gwaikire engaki y’ogwanchwa. Nkagotuba nomwambaro one, nkabisia obogetirianda bwao. Naende ngakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania naye, erio aye okaba oyone. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: "'Later I passed by, and when I looked at you and saw that you were old enough for love, I spread the corner of my garment over you and covered your nakedness. I gave you my solemn oath and entered into a covenant with you, declares the Sovereign LORD, and you became mine.

ekegusii: Naende nyuma yaye abaiseke baria bande bagacha, bakabora: Omonene, Omonene, toigorere!
english: "Later the others also came. 'Sir! Sir!' they said. 'Open the door for us!'

ekegusii: Nkanyora ng’a amaseko nigo are obobarimo, na omogoko tori gokora gento kende ekiya.
english: "Laughter," I said, "is foolish. And what does pleasure accomplish?"

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agateba, “Motige, agache aya goika rituko ri’ogotindekwa kwane.
english: "Leave her alone," Jesus replied. "[It was intended] that she should save this perfume for the day of my burial.

ekegusii: Yeso agateba, “Motige! Nase ki mokomorosia? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya.
english: "Leave her alone," said Jesus. "Why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.

ekegusii: “Karue aase aiga, oonchoke gochia moocha, bwebise aroro ase akarooche ga Keriti, akwo kare moocha ya Yorodan.
english: "Leave here, turn eastward and hide in the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Tiga ere abeere aroro; onde tabaisa korusia amauga aye.” Ase ayio bagatiga amauga aye, amo nay’omobani oria onde orwete ase ense ya Samaria.
english: "Leave it alone," he said. "Don't let anyone disturb his bones." So they spared his bones and those of the prophet who had come from Samaria.

ekegusii: “Tiga obobe bwabo bwonsi bororekane ase obosio bwao, obae egesusuro; buna kwang’ete inche ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nigo ng’umatete mono, na enkoro yane yanyarekire.”
english: "Let all their wickedness come before you; deal with them as you have dealt with me because of all my sins. My groans are many and my heart is faint."

ekegusii: “Oyo otamanyeti amange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri bwateba:
english: "Let all who are simple come in here!" she says to those who lack judgment.

ekegusii: oteba, “Onde bwensi otamanyeti amange, tiga ache aa!” Na ase oyore omoriri oteba,
english: "Let all who are simple come in here!" she says to those who lack judgment.

ekegusii: Samison akabatebia, “Tiga mbatebie omobayeno, na inwe montebie engencho yaye. Moise gontebia engencho yaye ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere ay’omoyega oyo, nigo ndabae chianga chi’egatani, ne chianga chinde chi’omoyega emerongo etato.
english: "Let me tell you a riddle," Samson said to them. "If you can give me the answer within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty linen garments and thirty sets of clothes.

ekegusii: Musa agakwana: “Tiga Abareuben bagenderere koba moyo, tibabaisa gokwa, nonya abanto abwo bare abake.”
english: "Let Reuben live and not die, nor his men be few."

ekegusii: “Tiga okobwatana kw’ogotianania kobe ase egati yane naye, buna kwarenge ase egati ya tata na iso. Rora nagotomeire ekeegwa gie chifeta ne chitahabu. Genda osarie okobwatana okwo kwao gwakorete na Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, erinde arue ase ense yane antigane.”
english: "Let there be a treaty between me and you," he said, "as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you a gift of silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me."

ekegusii: “Tiga okobwatana kw’ogotianania kobe ase egati yane naye, buna kwarenge ase egati ya tata na iso. Rora nagotomeire chifeta ne chitahabu. Genda osarie okobwatana kwao gwakorete na Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, erinde arue ase ense yane, antigane.”
english: "Let there be a treaty between me and you," he said, "as there was between my father and your father. See, I am sending you silver and gold. Now break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel so he will withdraw from me."

ekegusii: Nigo bagotebania, “Tobutore ebisibo biabo, totugute chingori chiabo batosiberete!”
english: "Let us break their chains," they say, "and throw off their fetters."

ekegusii: Agatebia Abayuda, “Inchuo toagache emechie eye toyeetananie chindwaki amo nemerobiri, na ebiita bire nemekorogoto. Ense eye nigo egendererete koba eyaito, ekiagera twarigirie Omonene, Nyasae oito; intwe twamorigirie, na ere otoeire omorembe ase chinsemo chiaito chionsi.” Ase ayio bakaagacha na bagasesenigwa.
english: "Let us build up these towns," he said to Judah, "and put walls around them, with towers, gates and bars. The land is still ours, because we have sought the LORD our God; we sought him and he has given us rest on every side." So they built and prospered.

ekegusii: “Inchuo togende ase obomenyo bw’Omonene, tosasime agwo ase egeteni kiaye ki’amagoro!”
english: "Let us go to his dwelling place; let us worship at his footstool--

ekegusii: Inchuo togende torwanie ense y’Abayuda toyioboyie, toyebue ebe eyaito, erinde tobeke mosinto o Tabeeli abe omoruoti aroro.”
english: "Let us invade Judah; let us tear it apart and divide it among ourselves, and make the son of Tabeel king over it."

ekegusii: “Koranche, otoe ribaga toete ase egati y’ense yao. Titogotiga enchera na kogobera gochia ase emegondo y’endagera, gose ey’emesabibu, gose titokonywa amache korwa ase chinsoko chiaino, korende nigo toraete ase enchera enene goika tobe twaetanirie ense yaino.”
english: "Let us pass through your country. We will not turn aside into any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the king's highway until we have passed through your territory."

ekegusii: Koranche onyanchere ng’etere ase ense yao. Nigo ndaete ase enchera enene yoka; tinkogobera aande, gochia borio gose bomosi.
english: "Let us pass through your country. We will stay on the main road; we will not turn aside to the right or to the left.

ekegusii: Erio bagatebania, “Titoyetandora, korende toyeakere obomera, torore gose neya ng’o ekoba.” Erio ririko riikerane, eri rigoteba, “Mbaatananete chianga chiane, naende eganchwa yane mbayekorerete obomera.”
english: "Let's not tear it," they said to one another. "Let's decide by lot who will get it." This happened that the scripture might be fulfilled which said, "They divided my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing." So this is what the soldiers did.

ekegusii: "Lift it out," he said. Then the man reached out his hand and took it.
english: Erio akamotebia, “Keimokie!” Na omonto oria akarambora okoboko kwaye, agakeimokia.

ekegusii: “Tenenia ebendera y’esegi igoro ase ense! Bugia egetureri ase egati y’ebisaku! Beka ebisaku ang’e birwanie Babeli. Rangeria amaruoti ayorwanie, ee, rangeria Ararati, na Mini, na Asikenasi. Chora abatang’ani b’esegi bayoumokere. Renta chibarasi chinyinge buna chingige chikogosa.
english: "Lift up a banner in the land! Blow the trumpet among the nations! Prepare the nations for battle against her; summon against her these kingdoms: Ararat, Minni and Ashkenaz. Appoint a commander against her; send up horses like a swarm of locusts.

ekegusii: “Imokia amaiso ao igoro, origererie chinsemo chionsi, abanto bonsi basangererekanire amo bagocha asore. Abamura bao mbache korwa aare na abaiseke bao mbabogorigwe namaboko, barentwe.
english: "Lift up your eyes and look about you: All assemble and come to you; your sons come from afar, and your daughters are carried on the arm.

ekegusii: Rora, buna koreng’ana endo egosoka korwa ase rinani rinoru ria Yorodani, erinde yagenda goita ching’ondi chire ime ase obweri obokong’u, naboigo na inche ndachiere Abaedomu mobosokano, mbaserie batame korwa aroro. Onde bwensi ndachore nimobeke abe omorisia igoro asebare. Ning’o oranyare koreng’anigwa nainche? Ning’o orambekere rituko indue omobaro? Morisia ki oranyare kweegerera ase obosio bwane?
english: "Like a lion coming up from Jordan's thickets to a rich pastureland, I will chase Edom from its land in an instant. Who is the chosen one I will appoint for this? Who is like me and who can challenge me? And what shepherd can stand against me?"

ekegusii: Igo mogwekaine omweya orambogete gochia aare, gose emegondo ere mbarabare y’orooche, nigo more buna emegaka Omonene asimegete. Gose emecharake ere ase amache mbarabare.
english: "Like valleys they spread out, like gardens beside a river, like aloes planted by the LORD, like cedars beside the waters.

ekegusii: “Tegerera mono moigwe amang’ana aane, ayio naro arabe okoremia kwaino asende.
english: "Listen carefully to my words; let this be the consolation you give me.

ekegusii: “Tiga amang’ana aya asoe ase amato aino, ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ngochia are kobekwa ase amaboko ’abanto.”
english: "Listen carefully to what I am about to tell you: The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of men."

ekegusii: “Gaki, igwa omoreng’anio bw’omobusuri.
english: "Listen then to what the parable of the sower means:

ekegusii: “Tegerera omoreng’anio onde. Narenge omonto orenge nenyomba; ere akarema omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akayoetananeria orobago, agakunya ime aroro egetera akomitera amasabibu, akaagacha orwaki, akaywatananera abaremi, akagenda orogendo.
english: "Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and went away on a journey.

ekegusii: "Listen to me and I will explain to you; let me tell you what I have seen,
english: “Integerera oigwe, na inche nkworokie; amang’ana narorire ninyararie.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Omonene one, ntegerera! Oboremo obwo bwe rigori rie chisekeli chi’efeta amagana ane, ngento ki toengereranie inche naye? Tindeka mokao agwo.”
english: "Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between me and you? Bury your dead."

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, inyigwere; inwe abanto b’egesaku kiane, tegerera monyigwe! Nindue ogochika kwane, na oboronge bwane mbobe omobaso ase abanto bonsi.
english: "Listen to me, my people; hear me, my nation: The law will go out from me; my justice will become a light to the nations.

ekegusii: “Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, inwe abatigari bonsi b’Abaisraeli, inwe aba nabeire mbabogoretie korwa ekero mwarenge ase chinda chi’abanyoko, na korwa ekero mwaagatire ase amaboko ’abanyoko, inyigwere!
english: "Listen to me, O house of Jacob, all you who remain of the house of Israel, you whom I have upheld since you were conceived, and have carried since your birth.

ekegusii: "Listen to me, O Jacob, Israel, whom I have called: I am he; I am the first and I am the last.
english: “Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, aba narangeretie, ntegerere! Inche ninche Ere, ninche omochakano na omoerio.

ekegusii: “Inwe aba mokorigia oboronge, ee, inwe aba mokondigia inche Omonene, tegerera monyigwe! Rigereria egetare ase mwabaachetwe korwa,
english: "Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness and who seek the LORD: Look to the rock from which you were cut and to the quarry from which you were hewn;

ekegusii: rigantebia: “Igwa amang’ana ’okobwatana kw’ogotianania, kwana n’Abayuda na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu,
english: "Listen to the terms of this covenant and tell them to the people of Judah and to those who live in Jerusalem.
