ekegusii: Aye Ayubu, igwa aya; karategerera, orengererie igoro y’emeremo y’ogokumia ya Nyasae.
english: "Listen to this, Job; stop and consider God's wonders.

ekegusii: “Inwe ab’enyomba ya Yakobo, aba mokorokwa Abaisraeli, na more ab’ororeria rwa Yuda, naende mogotiana ase erieta ri’Omonene na komoorokia Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, korende tari ase ekeene na oboronge, igwa amang’ana aya!
english: "Listen to this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel and come from the line of Judah, you who take oaths in the name of the LORD and invoke the God of Israel-- but not in truth or righteousness--

ekegusii: “Tegerera! Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura.
english: "Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.

ekegusii: Aye Yoshua, omokuani omonene, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aya, aye amo nabagisangio bao, abwo baikaransete ase obosio bwao, ekiagera abwo nabanto bare ekemanyererio ki’amang’ana agochigocha: Naama! Inche nintome omosomba one okorokwa Omoseboka.
english: "'Listen, O high priest Joshua and your associates seated before you, who are men symbolic of things to come: I am going to bring my servant, the Branch.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire iga: “Agwo kare inwe nigo mwerusetie rikorogoto riaino, mokaba mwesiboire, mogateba: Titorigeti koba abakoreri b’Omonene. Igoro ase kera ekegoro egetambe, na inse ya kera omote omobese, mogatung’ama mogasasima, timwabete abegenwa asende.
english: "Long ago you broke off your yoke and tore off your bonds; you said, 'I will not serve you!' Indeed, on every high hill and under every spreading tree you lay down as a prostitute.

ekegusii: “Rigereria engubo! Eyio natongete buna nagotongete aye. Nigo ekorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe.
english: "Look at the behemoth, which I made along with you and which feeds on grass like an ox.

ekegusii: “Rigereria morore ayare ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, mokumie na goichanigwa. Ngochia gokora inde ring’ana ase amatuko aino, eri motegene moise koritebigwa.
english: "Look at the nations and watch-- and be utterly amazed. For I am going to do something in your days that you would not believe, even if you were told.

ekegusii: Rigereria gochia ebitunwa igoro, morore! Ng’aase ki atigarete motakorereti obonyaka bwaino? Mwabeire mogoikaransa ase chinchera mbarabare motengerete buna Omoarabu ase erooro, moganyete abanchi baino. Mwakorire ense yabeire entwambu ase engencho y’obonyaka bwaino na obokayayu bwaino.
english: "Look up to the barren heights and see. Is there any place where you have not been ravished? By the roadside you sat waiting for lovers, sat like a nomad in the desert. You have defiled the land with your prostitution and wickedness.

ekegusii: “Naama! Abanto ngocha bare korwa sugusu, egesaku ekenene mono amo nabaruoti abange baseegetirwe korwa chinsinyo chi’ense.
english: "Look! An army is coming from the north; a great nation and many kings are being stirred up from the ends of the earth.

ekegusii: Esau agateba, “Rora, inche nigo inde ang’e gokwa, omwando oyo bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi inki orankonye?”
english: "Look, I am about to die," Esau said. "What good is the birthright to me?"

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, rigereria orore! Ning’o gwakorerete buna ayio? Inee! Abakungu mbarie oroiboro rwabo, abana abwo barerete ase amaboko abo? Inee! Abakuani na ababani mbaiterwe agwo Aase Aachenu ay’Omonene?
english: "Look, O LORD, and consider: Whom have you ever treated like this? Should women eat their offspring, the children they have cared for? Should priest and prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

ekegusii: Rigereria, inwe abachayi, mokumia, mosire, ekiagera ngochia gokora nde ring’ana ase amatuko aino, eri motegene nonya omonto naisa kobatebia.”
english: "'Look, you scoffers, wonder and perish, for I am going to do something in your days that you would never believe, even if someone told you.'"

ekegusii: Ere agatebia abanto baye, “Rigereria, Abaisraeli aba babeire abange kobua intwe, naende babeire ne chinguru gotobua.
english: "Look," he said to his people, "the Israelites have become much too numerous for us.

ekegusii: Agateba, “Rora, narorire igoro amaanokire, na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.”
english: "Look," he said, "I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Rigereria, bono mobaso, chinsa chi’ogosangereria amaicho tichiraika, nyoisia ching’ondi, naende mochiire gochirisia.”
english: "Look," he said, "the sun is still high; it is not time for the flocks to be gathered. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture."

ekegusii: Ase igo Naomi agatebia Rutu, “Naama! Oripa, moka momura omwabo omosacha oo, oiranire ase abanto baye, na ase enyasae yaye. Naye irana, mogende komo!”
english: "Look," said Naomi, "your sister-in-law is going back to her people and her gods. Go back with her."

ekegusii: Omorandia nigo agoteba iga: Naama! Amang’ana ayio nkayamanya, ekero nabekeranetie ring’ana erimo ase erinde koyamanya onsi.
english: "Look," says the Teacher, "this is what I have discovered: "Adding one thing to another to discover the scheme of things--

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Rora intwe abasomba bao ntobwate abanto emerongo etano bare ne chinguru, twagosabire, tiga abanto abwo bagende barigie omonene oo. Ande gose omoika bw’Omonene nomoimokirie igoro, na omorutire ase egetunwa gete, gose ase rikura.” Elisha akabakania agateba, “Timobaisa kobatoma.”
english: "Look," they said, "we your servants have fifty able men. Let them go and look for your master. Perhaps the Spirit of the LORD has picked him up and set him down on some mountain or in some valley." "No," Elisha replied, "do not send them."

ekegusii: “Omonene, ororere omomura one amabera, ekiagera nare nendurume, nigo achandegete mono. Naki ere, kero kende nigo akogwa ase omorero ime, na kero kende ase amache ime.
english: "Lord, have mercy on my son," he said. "He has seizures and is suffering greatly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.

ekegusii: Na inche nkabora: Omonene, barabwo mbamanyete ng’a nigo narenge gosiba baria bakwegenete na kobaaka ase chisinagogi chionsi.
english: "'Lord,' I replied, 'these men know that I went from one synagogue to another to imprison and beat those who believe in you.

ekegusii: Petero akamoiraneria, “Omonene, onye naye, ntebia nchiche agwo asore igoro ase amache.”
english: "Lord, if it's you," Peter replied, "tell me to come to you on the water."

ekegusii: “Omonene, baitire ababani bao, batagoire egesasimero kiao, ninche bweka natigaire, na barabwo nkorigia bare obogima bwane babosirie.”
english: "Lord, they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars; I am the only one left, and they are trying to kill me"?

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogokora oboronge botambe, korende intwe botambe nigo tokwerentera obosooku buna iga rero, intwe abanto ba Yakobo, na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, na Abaisraeli bonsi, baria bare ang’e na abare aare ase chinse chionsi ase kwabaseretie gochia, ekiagera titwabete abegenwa asore.
english: "Lord, you are righteous, but this day we are covered with shame-- the men of Judah and people of Jerusalem and all Israel, both near and far, in all the countries where you have scattered us because of our unfaithfulness to you.

ekegusii: Korende Anania akairaneria, “Omonene, naigure korwa ase abanto abange igoro y’omonto oyo, buna akoreire abachenu bao Yerusalemu amabe amange.
english: "Lord," Ananias answered, "I have heard many reports about this man and all the harm he has done to your saints in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: agateba, “Omonene, omosomba one nyomba araire, oborwaire bomogataetie, akoromwa mono.”
english: "Lord," he said, "my servant lies at home paralyzed and in terrible suffering."

ekegusii: Erio Martha agatebia Yeso, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.
english: "Lord," Martha said to Jesus, "if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Omonene, otoramokie amaiso aito.”
english: "Lord," they answered, "we want our sight."

ekegusii: “Oroisie egetuba gi’etaai amo nenterekerero yaye y’etaai. Okebeke egati y’Eema y’Omosangererekano na egesasimero, na obeke amache imeo.
english: "Make a bronze basin, with its bronze stand, for washing. Place it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.

ekegusii: “Oroisie eraaro y’Obomenyo. Ase ensemo ya irianyi oroisie ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire, bibe ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo, bibe bigokenga eraaro ensemo eyemo.
english: "Make a courtyard for the tabernacle. The south side shall be a hundred cubits long and is to have curtains of finely twisted linen,

ekegusii: "Make a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, with cherubim worked into it by a skilled craftsman.
english: “Oroisie etoto ye chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya, chisisire. Omoroisia omong’aini ayeroisie ebe nemegwekano y’abakerubi.

ekegusii: "Make a lampstand of pure gold and hammer it out, base and shaft; its flowerlike cups, buds and blossoms shall be of one piece with it.
english: “Oroisie ekebekerero gie chitaya gi’etahabu echenire esunyuntire, okeroisie na enterekerero amo ne ritina na emegwekano y’amamumu na ebisicha, bionsi bibe egento ekemo.

ekegusii: “Okore ebao y’etahabu echenire, na buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio omang’ere amang’ana ayio:” “Achenirwe ase Omonene”.
english: "Make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.

ekegusii: “Oroisie emesa ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
english: "Make a table of acacia wood-- two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high.

ekegusii: “Kora omote obe omuya, na amatunda aye abe amaya; gose kora omote obe omobe, na amatunda aye abe amabe; naki omote nigo okomanyekana ase amatunda aye.
english: "Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is recognized by its fruit.

ekegusii: “Oroisie egesasimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ubani egosamberwa.
english: "Make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.

ekegusii: Ong’agachere egesasimero ki’amaroba, onduere ebing’wanso igoro yaye, ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, korwa ase ching’ondi chiao, ne chiombe chiao. Kera aase ndatebe onsasimere, ninchiche asore, ngosesenie.
english: "'Make an altar of earth for me and sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, your sheep and goats and your cattle. Wherever I cause my name to be honored, I will come to you and bless you.

ekegusii: “Oroisie ekemumeko gi’etahabu echenire kebe Oboikaranso bw’Amabera. Obotambe bwaye bobe ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
english: "Make an atonement cover of pure gold-- two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

ekegusii: “Oroisie amarondia ikomi na rimo ay’amanya e chimbori, abe eema y’ogotuba Obomenyo obwo.
english: "Make curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle-- eleven altogether.

ekegusii: “Teema mono gosoa ase egesieri kere ekegote, ekiagera nabatebirie: Abanto abange nabarigie gosoa, na barabwo tibakonyara.
english: "Make every effort to enter through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able to.

ekegusii: “Kae Abamoabu banywe batinde, ekiagera beimokereirie igoro mamincha y’Omonene. Barabwo mbaroke, naende begara‐garie ime ase amaroki abo, abanto mbabasekerere.
english: "Make her drunk, for she has defied the LORD. Let Moab wallow in her vomit; let her be an object of ridicule.

ekegusii: Mokorere amagoro aino chinchera chindonge, erinde ekere ekerema tikeotoranwa, korende kobua mono kegwenigwe.
english: "Make level paths for your feet," so that the lame may not be disabled, but rather healed.

ekegusii: Obaroiserie chisirwari chi’egatani, chigoika amariagati abo, chibe chigotuba obogetirianda bwabo.
english: "Make linen undergarments as a covering for the body, reaching from the waist to the thigh.

ekegusii: "Make sure that you do not take my son back there," Abraham said.
english: Ibrahimu akamoiraneria, “Bwerende, tobaisa koira omwana one aroro.

ekegusii: “Bakore egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chiusi chie chitahabu na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire; keroisigwe nomoroisia omong’aini.
english: "Make the ephod of gold, and of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of finely twisted linen-- the work of a skilled craftsman.

ekegusii: “Okore eganchwa korwa ase egetambaa keroisirie ne chiusi chire buru chioka.
english: "Make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,

ekegusii: “Oroisie eema y’Obomenyo nebitambaa ikomi biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Omoroisia omong’aini abiroisie bibe nemegwekano y’abakerubi.
english: "Make the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim worked into them by a skilled craftsman.

ekegusii: “Roisia ebirombeta bibere bie chifeta chiturire. Obe gokobibugia ekero ogosangereria omoganda amo, na ekero abanto barabe bakoimoka korwa ase ebitwori gochaka orogendo.
english: "Make two trumpets of hammered silver, and use them for calling the community together and for having the camps set out.

ekegusii: “Oroisie chibao chi’emekonge ase Obomenyo, echio chiratenenigwe.
english: "Make upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle.

ekegusii: “Mwanyabanto okoiborwa nomokungu, amatuko aye namake; ere nigo aichire nemechando.
english: "Man born of woman is of few days and full of trouble.

ekegusii: “Manase, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, okorire okogechia okonge. Ere okorire ogosaria okonge goetania koria Abaamori bakorete, baria barengeo ritang’ani asare, naende ogerire Abayuda bakorire ebibe ase engencho y’emegwekano yaye agosasima.
english: "Manasseh king of Judah has committed these detestable sins. He has done more evil than the Amorites who preceded him and has led Judah into sin with his idols.

ekegusii: Egesaku kia Manase keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Nafutali korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Manasseh will have one portion; it will border the territory of Naphtali from east to west.

ekegusii: “Ase ekero ekio abanto b’ebisaku ebinge mbabwatane nainche Omonene; barabwo mbabe abanto baane. Ee, inche nimenye ase egati yaino.” Erio nario moramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda nere ontomire gocha asemore.
english: "Many nations will be joined with the LORD in that day and will become my people. I will live among you and you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me to you.

ekegusii: “Nkabarentera oborwaire bw’enyagetabo, na obw’okorigisia chindagera chiaino; emegondo yaino emenge, amo ney’emesabibu, na emeko yaino, na emezeituni yaino ekariegwa ne chingige. Korende nonya naboigo, timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Many times I struck your gardens and vineyards, I struck them with blight and mildew. Locusts devoured your fig and olive trees, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Abakungu abange bakorire ayare amaya mono, korende aye kwababuire bonsi.”
english: "Many women do noble things, but you surpass them all."

ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Martha, Martha, nigo okwerosia na gweichania ase engencho y’ebinto ebinge,
english: "Martha, Martha," the Lord answered, "you are worried and upset about many things,

ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao, tokamokania, ekiagera tabwataini naintwe.”
english: "Master," said John, "we saw a man driving out demons in your name and we tried to stop him, because he is not one of us."

ekegusii: Rutu akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, kwabeire omuya mono asende, kwandemirie ase ogokwana nobwororo nainche, omosomba oo, nonya tindi oyomo bw’abasomba bao abaiseke.”
english: "May I continue to find favor in your eyes, my lord," she said. "You have given me comfort and have spoken kindly to your servant-- though I do not have the standing of one of your servant girls."

ekegusii: “Tiga omobisa one abarwe buna omokori amabe, na oyore mamincha yane buna oyotari omonyaboronge.
english: "May my enemies be like the wicked, my adversaries like the unjust!

ekegusii: “Rituko riria naiboretwe, tiga risire riebwe kegima, boigo obotuko boria amang’ana aya akwanetwe: Omwana omoisia otongirwe enda ime.
english: "May the day of my birth perish, and the night it was said, 'A boy is born!'

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene Nyasae, aye oyokorua obogima ase abanto bonsi, chora omonto oraraae omoganda oyo,
english: "May the LORD, the God of the spirits of all mankind, appoint a man over this community

ekegusii: “Tiga amaiso ao abe atorigereretie namabera, inche omosomba oo amo nabanto bao Abaisraeli, otoigwe ekero kende gionsi togokorangeria ase oboitongo.
english: "May your eyes be open to your servant's plea and to the plea of your people Israel, and may you listen to them whenever they cry out to you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omorandia nigo agoteba. Aya mbosa, bosa; onsi mbosa kegima.
english: "Meaningless! Meaningless!" says the Teacher. "Everything is meaningless!"

ekegusii: Omorandia nigo agoteba: Mbosa na bosa kegima, mbosa, bosa. Amang’ana onsi mbosa.
english: "Meaningless! Meaningless!" says the Teacher. "Utterly meaningless! Everything is meaningless."

ekegusii: “Nabo oria omomura oye omonene nigo arenge mogondo; agachia goika ang’e nenyomba, akaigwa egeturi ki’ogotera na ogotenga.
english: "Meanwhile, the older son was in the field. When he came near the house, he heard music and dancing.

ekegusii: Enyama eyio kerakune gento kende gionsi getachenegeti esambwe nomorero, eyie eere. “Onye enyama echenegete, kera omonto ochenekire nare ne ribaga ri’okoyeria,
english: "'Meat that touches anything ceremonially unclean must not be eaten; it must be burned up. As for other meat, anyone ceremonially clean may eat it.

ekegusii: “Ekiagera ogokorerwa bobe kwabuchire, abanto nigo bakorera mono ng’a bakonywe; nigo bakorangeria bakonywe korwa ase amaboko ay’abare nokobua.
english: "Men cry out under a load of oppression; they plead for relief from the arm of the powerful.

ekegusii: Ekero narenge korua ogosemia, abanto nigo barenge gontegerera, bakira‐kiri.
english: "Men listened to me expectantly, waiting in silence for my counsel.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Togarima bagakooneria chibarasi chi’emeremo na echi’esegi, ne chiyombo, naye okabaooneria ebinto biao.
english: "'Men of Beth Togarmah exchanged work horses, war horses and mules for your merchandise.

ekegusii: bakabora, “Inwe abasacha ba Galili, nase ki moteneine morigereretie igoro? Oyo Yeso, obogorigwe korwa asemore kogenda igoro, naboigo arache koreng’ana buna mwamorora akogenda igoro.”
english: "Men of Galilee," they said, "why do you stand here looking into the sky? This same Jesus, who has been taken from you into heaven, will come back in the same way you have seen him go into heaven."

ekegusii: “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, igwa amang’ana aya, Yeso o Nazareti, omonto o orogetigwe asemore na Nyasae ase ogokora gwe chinguru, na amakumia, na ebikone ebi Nyasae akorete nere egati yaino, buna inwe abanyene momanyete,
english: "Men of Israel, listen to this: Jesus of Nazareth was a man accredited by God to you by miracles, wonders and signs, which God did among you through him, as you yourselves know.

ekegusii: “Abarwani esegi b’Ayemi, na Ludi na Puti, nigo barenge abarwani bao b’esegi. Nigo basungete chinguba chiabo na ebigogwa biabo bi’ebioma ase chinyasi chiao. Barabwo nigo bakorenterete obonene.
english: "'Men of Persia, Lydia and Put served as soldiers in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls, bringing you splendor.

ekegusii: “Abanto abare nokomanya, na kera omonto omong’aini orabe okonyigwa, nigo barantebie:
english: "Men of understanding declare, wise men who hear me say to me,

ekegusii: Nyuma emetienyi etano na ebere koyaerire mbachore abanto barabe bakona‐goeta aase aande onsi ase ense eyio babe bakorigia abwo bakwete batigarete riroba igoro, na abande babe bakobatindeka ase ogochena ense eyio.
english: "'Men will be regularly employed to cleanse the land. Some will go throughout the land and, in addition to them, others will bury those that remain on the ground. At the end of the seven months they will begin their search.

ekegusii: “Inwe abasacha, narorire ng’a orogendo oro narobe nemechando na ogosira okonge, tari ase chigurube na emeeri bioka, korende nonya nase obogima bwaito boigo.”
english: "Men, I can see that our voyage is going to be disastrous and bring great loss to ship and cargo, and to our own lives also."

ekegusii: “Inwe abasacha! Nase ki mogokora aya? Intwe nigo tore mwanyabanto koreng’ana buna inwe. Twabarandeirie inwe amang’ana amaya, erinde motige chinyasae echi chia bosa, moonchokere Nyasae ore moyo, oyotongete igoro na ense, na enyancha, na ebinto ebire imeo.
english: "Men, why are you doing this? We too are only men, human like you. We are bringing you good news, telling you to turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven and earth and sea and everything in them.

ekegusii: “Abameseki na Abatubali nao bakare amo nemeganda yabo yonsi, ne chimbeera chi’emeganda eyio nigo chibaetanaine ase chinsemo chionsi. Abwo bonsi nabanto batarogeti, nigo baitetwe nemioro. Agwo kare nigo barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo.
english: "Meshech and Tubal are there, with all their hordes around their graves. All of them are uncircumcised, killed by the sword because they spread their terror in the land of the living.

ekegusii: “Ekero Hezekia arenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Mika korwa Mosereti nabanete, agatebia Abayuda bonsi: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire:” “Sayoni noremwe buna omogondo okoremwa Yerusalemu nobe chitui chi’amaturi, na egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene nkebe egetunwa kie rinani.
english: "Micah of Moresheth prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. He told all the people of Judah, 'This is what the LORD Almighty says: "'Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.'

ekegusii: “Abamoabu babeire barendire bamenyete ase obotoereru korwa ase oboke bwabo. Babeire buna edivai etarakenonorwa korwa ase eturubo. Tibana koumorwa korwa ase ekebekerero ekemo gochia ase ekende, gose tibana gwoswa bairwe ase obosomba. Ase ayio rimisu riabo nabo rigendererete koba buna riarenge, na ogotioka kwabo tikwana koonchoka.
english: "Moab has been at rest from youth, like wine left on its dregs, not poured from one jar to another-- she has not gone into exile. So she tastes as she did, and her aroma is unchanged.

ekegusii: “Kwana nabanto b’enyomba y’omoruoti bw’Abayuda, obatebie: Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene,
english: "Moreover, say to the royal house of Judah, 'Hear the word of the LORD;

ekegusii: “Naende ntorente ase abakuani agwo ase ebinyomba ime, ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito, obosie bwaito bw’obotongora, na ebiegwa biaito, na amatunda ’emete yonsi, na edivai, na amaguta. Boigo ntorente ensemo ya ikomi y’okwama kwe riroba riaito ase Abalawi, ekiagera Abalawi nabwo bagosangereria chinsemo chia ikomi korwa ase emechie yonsi.
english: "Moreover, we will bring to the storerooms of the house of our God, to the priests, the first of our ground meal, of our [grain] offerings, of the fruit of all our trees and of our new wine and oil. And we will bring a tithe of our crops to the Levites, for it is the Levites who collect the tithes in all the towns where we work.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Musa, omosomba one, okure. Imoka, bwamboke orooche oro rwa Yorodan, aye na Abaisraeli aba bonsi, mosoe ase ense eria ngochia kobaa.
english: "Moses my servant is dead. Now then, you and all these people, get ready to cross the Jordan River into the land I am about to give to them-- to the Israelites.

ekegusii: Yaeli, moka Heberi Omokeni, nasesenirie kobua abakungu bande, ee, nasesenirie kobua abakungu bande bamenyete ase chiema.
english: "Most blessed of women be Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, most blessed of tent-dwelling women.

ekegusii: “Endamwamu yane nigo egwoka igoro y’abarisia, ning’ee chigoree chiria egesusuro, ekiagera inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ndendete riicho riane nabwo abanto b’enyomba ya Yuda; nindikore ribe ebarasi yane engiya y’esegi.
english: "My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders; for the LORD Almighty will care for his flock, the house of Judah, and make them like a proud horse in battle.

ekegusii: Abana abake, nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe. Namondigie; korende buna natebetie Abayahudi, ng’a aase ngochia inche, inwe timokonyara gochao, bono nabatebirie nainwe.
english: "My children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, so I tell you now: Where I am going, you cannot come.

ekegusii: “Okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete nere nokw’obogima na omorembe. Okwo nigo namoete, erinde anyiroke. Ere akanyiroka, akaba okoiguswa ase engencho y’erieta riane.
english: "My covenant was with him, a covenant of life and peace, and I gave them to him; this called for reverence and he revered me and stood in awe of my name.

ekegusii: “Amatuko aane nigo agoeta bwango kobua omominyoki okominyoka; nigo akoera bwango, tari korora maya ande.
english: "My days are swifter than a runner; they fly away without a glimpse of joy.

ekegusii: Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango kobua egekorero gi’okoroisia egetambaa, nigo akoera ntabwati gosemeria konde.
english: "My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and they come to an end without hope.

ekegusii: "My eyes have seen all this, my ears have heard and understood it.
english: “Naama! Amang’ana aya onsi nayarorire neriso riane, nayaigure nogoto kwane, nayamanyire.

ekegusii: Naende Sulemani agateba, “Igo kwarenge okogania gwa Daudi tata koagachera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba.
english: "My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: “Bono nigo kwarenge okogania gwa Daudi tata koagachera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba.
english: "My father David had it in his heart to build a temple for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Omoiseke oria akamotebia, “Tata, onye kwarierete Omonene eira, inkorere aya gwakwanete, ekiagera Omonene okoruseirie egesiomba ase ababisa bao Abaamoni.”
english: "My father," she replied, "you have given your word to the LORD. Do to me just as you promised, now that the LORD has avenged you of your enemies, the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Endagera yane neye: ogokora ogwancha kwaye oyontomete na goikerania emeremo yaye.
english: "My food," said Jesus, "is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Omotwe nkonyatia ore! Oo, omotwe one!” Ise agatebia omosomba oye, “Mobogorie omoire ase ng’ina.”
english: "My head! My head!" he said to his father. His father told a servant, "Carry him to his mother."

ekegusii: “Aye omoruoti, omonene one, abanto bakorire bobe mono ase amang’ana onsi bakorire ase Yeremia omobani ase okomobeka ime ase engoro eria. Bono ere nigo arakwereo ase engencho y’enchara, ekiagera emegati yonsi yaerire korwa ase omochie.”
english: "My lord the king, these men have acted wickedly in all they have done to Jeremiah the prophet. They have thrown him into a cistern, where he will starve to death when there is no longer any bread in the city."

ekegusii: akabora, “Abanene baane, gobera gocha aa, mosoe mw’omosomba oino, monyore amache mwesibie amagoro aino, morare goika mambia bokie; erio moche moimoke mambia, mogende.” Barabwo bagakana, bagateba, “Yaya, nigo tokoba aa inchera obotuko obo bwonsi.”
english: "My lords," he said, "please turn aside to your servant's house. You can wash your feet and spend the night and then go on your way early in the morning." "No," they answered, "we will spend the night in the square."

ekegusii: “Abanto baane nigo bare abariri, tibamanyeti inche. Barabwo nigo bare buna abana batari nobong’aini, tibamanyeti gento kende. Nigo bare aboge mono ase ogokora ebibe, korende tibamanyeti gokora amaya.”
english: "My people are fools; they do not know me. They are senseless children; they have no understanding. They are skilled in doing evil; they know not how to do good."

ekegusii: “Abanto baane babeire buna ching’ondi chinsiru. Abarisia babo babasiririe, ekiagera babeire bakona‐kobaong’anyia ase ebitunwa. Nigo bakona‐koong’anya buna ching’ondi, bakobaetanania korwa ase ebitunwa goika ase ebigoro; ase igo abanto baane bebire obweri bwabo.
english: "My people have been lost sheep; their shepherds have led them astray and caused them to roam on the mountains. They wandered over mountain and hill and forgot their own resting place.

ekegusii: Abanto baane bakorire amabe abere: bantigire inche inde ensoko y’amache amaya ay’obogima; bakunyire ebisima biabo bi’amache, ebisima biremogete, bitanyare kogacha amache nonya ng’ake.”
english: "My people have committed two sins: They have forsaken me, the spring of living water, and have dug their own cisterns, broken cisterns that cannot hold water.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto baane, ngento ki nabakoreire? Nase amang’ana ki nabarosirie? Ng’iranerie!
english: "My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me.

ekegusii: “Gose tari barabwo boka nasabeire, korende na baria baranyegene ase engencho ye ring’ana riabo,
english: "My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,

ekegusii: Daudi, omosomba one, nere orabe omoruoti obo, na barabwo mbabe nomorisia oyomo, mbabwatie emeroberio yane echikire, naende babwate amachiko aane na koyakora.
english: "'My servant David will be king over them, and they will all have one shepherd. They will follow my laws and be careful to keep my decrees.

ekegusii: agatebia abamwabo, “Ayee! Chibesa chiane nigo chiairanetigwe, rigereria, nao chire aa egunia yane ime!” Chinkoro chiabo chikagoyaana, bakarigererania na koiguswa, bagateba, “Inki eke Nyasae atokoreire iga?”
english: "My silver has been returned," he said to his brothers. "Here it is in my sack." Their hearts sank and they turned to each other trembling and said, "What is this that God has done to us?"

ekegusii: “Ogosaria kwane okonge nigo gwasiberanetigwe nokoboko kwaye, gokaba rikorogoto gokabekwa ase rigoti riane; na ase enchera eyio akang’ura chinguru. Omonene nigo ambegete ase amaboko ay’abwo ntanyare kobua.
english: "My sins have been bound into a yoke; by his hands they were woven together. They have come upon my neck and the Lord has sapped my strength. He has handed me over to those I cannot withstand.

ekegusii: Ise akamotebia: Omwana one, aye amatuko onsi nigo ore amo nainche, na ebinto bionsi inde nabirobio nebiao.
english: "'My son,' the father said, 'you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

ekegusii: "My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death," he said to them. "Stay here and keep watch."
english: Akabatebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, goika ogokwa; ikaransa aiga, morende.”

ekegusii: “Bono ebirengererio bire ime yane bianchandire, ase ayio biagerire imbe omwango koiraneria.
english: "My troubled thoughts prompt me to answer because I am greatly disturbed.

ekegusii: “Nafutali nengabi esiboire ekominyoka mono, nigo agosokia amang’ana amaya.
english: "Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.

ekegusii: Egesaku kia Nafutali keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norw’Aseri korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Naphtali will have one portion; it will border the territory of Asher from east to west.

ekegusii: Natanaeli akamoboria, “Egento ekiya nakenyare korwa Nazareti?” Filipo akamotebia, “Inchuo orore.”
english: "Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?" Nathanael asked. "Come and see," said Philip.

ekegusii: “Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, ondiire, onsegenyire; ontigire inde bosa buna ekebekerero getabwati gento. Omerire inche buna enchoka ekomera egento. Oichoirie enda yaye nebinto biane ebiya, ontigire inde bosa.
english: "Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has devoured us, he has thrown us into confusion, he has made us an empty jar. Like a serpent he has swallowed us and filled his stomach with our delicacies, and then has spewed us out.

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Oyo takorete ebibe, nonya nabaibori baye, korende aya akorekire, erinde emeremo ya Nyasae eorokigwe asare.
english: "Neither this man nor his parents sinned," said Jesus, "but this happened so that the work of God might be displayed in his life.

ekegusii: Omonto oria akairaneria, “Inche nigo inde omotang’ani bw’omoganda okorwana esegi y’Omonene, nakio bono nacheire aa.” Erio Yoshua agatung’ama inse akaumama, agasasima. Naende akamoboria. “Mang’ana ki obwate ogontebia, inche omosomba oo?”
english: "Neither," he replied, "but as commander of the army of the LORD I have now come." Then Joshua fell facedown to the ground in reverence, and asked him, "What message does my Lord have for his servant?"

ekegusii: Aroro agwo omwana takobao orakoore amatuko amake oka, gose omonto omogotu takobao otaikeranie amatuko ’obogima bwaye. Oyo orakwe ase oboke bwaye goika abe okoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na omonyabibe takoragererigwa goika abe okoorire emiaka rigana erimo.
english: "Never again will there be in it an infant who lives but a few days, or an old man who does not live out his years; he who dies at a hundred will be thought a mere youth; he who fails to reach a hundred will be considered accursed.

ekegusii: Yonathani akamoiraneria, “Taibo, togokwa. Tata tari gokora gento kende gionsi, ekenene gose egeke, atantebeti. Nase ki tata arambise ring’ana erio, atamanyia? Ayio takoba bo.”
english: "Never!" Jonathan replied. "You are not going to die! Look, my father doesn't do anything, great or small, without confiding in me. Why would he hide this from me? It's not so!"

ekegusii: Yonathani akairaneria, “Taibo! Takoba bo. Onye ndiria imanyete ekeene ng’a tata narengereretie kogokorera bobe, Inee, nanga rirorio tinagotebia amang’ana ayio.”
english: "Never!" Jonathan said. "If I had the least inkling that my father was determined to harm you, wouldn't I tell you?"

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo ningwenie abanto b’omochie oyo, babe nemebere emiya. Nimbagwenie mbae omorembe na obotoereru ase obonge.
english: "'Nevertheless, I will bring health and healing to it; I will heal my people and will let them enjoy abundant peace and security.

ekegusii: Erio bagaeta ase egati y’erooro, bagaetanana ense y’Edomu na ense ya Moabu, bagaika moocha y’ense ya Moabu, goika ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Arinoni. Bagatoora agwo, korende tibaambogete Arinoni, ekiagera oro norobebe rwa Moabu.
english: "Next they traveled through the desert, skirted the lands of Edom and Moab, passed along the eastern side of the country of Moab, and camped on the other side of the Arnon. They did not enter the territory of Moab, for the Arnon was its border.

ekegusii: "Next, the trees said to the fig tree, 'Come and be our king.'
english: Erio emete egatebia omoko: Inchuo aye otogambere!

ekegusii: "No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
english: “Naki tori omote omuya okwama amatunda amabe, gose omote omobe okwama amatunda amaya.

ekegusii: “Korende ase Abaisraeli, chimbambo gose amagwa tibikobao bibabete ekero bagendererete komenya ase egati y’abanto abwo babaetanaine babachayete. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene Nyasae.
english: "'No longer will the people of Israel have malicious neighbors who are painful briers and sharp thorns. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Ere tarochi obobe ase Yakobo, tarochi bokong’u bonde ase Abaisraeli. Omonene, Nyasae obo, nigo are amo nabarabwo, igo bakoraria nomochengo ng’a omoruoti nareo.
english: "No misfortune is seen in Jacob, no misery observed in Israel. The LORD their God is with them; the shout of the King is among them.

ekegusii: Omonto onde tari oranyare gocha asende, atang’usiri na Tata oyontomete, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.
english: "No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up at the last day.

ekegusii: “Onde tari oranyare gokorera abanene babere, ekiagera nageche oyomo, na anche oyonde, gose nabwatane noyomo, na achaye oyonde. Timokonyara gokorera Nyasae na enibo.
english: "No one can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and Money.

ekegusii: Abarendi baria bakairaneria, “Tana gokwana monto onde bwensi buna oyo agokwana!”
english: "No one ever spoke the way this man does," the guards declared.

ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi tabaisa korara nomokungu ore omoamate omwabo. Okwo nokorentera omoamate omwabo obosooku. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'No one is to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: “Korende amang’ana e rituko riria, na ensa eria onde tari omanyete, nonya nabamalaika ba igoro, nonya n’Omwana, otatiga Tata bweka.
english: "No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

ekegusii: “Korende amang’ana e rituko riria na ensa eria onde tari omanyete, nonya nabamalaika bare igoro, nonya n’Omwana, otatiga Tata.
english: "No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde tari ogotongia etaya na koyemumeka negento, gose koyebeka nyaro y’oborere; korende nigo akoyebeka igoro ase ekebekerero kiaye, erinde abagosoa barore oborabu.
english: "No one lights a lamp and hides it in a jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, he puts it on a stand, so that those who come in can see the light.

ekegusii: “Omonto gatongirie etaya tari koyebeka ase ekenunchi gose ayemumeke negetonga, korende nigo akoyebeka igoro ase ekebekerero, erinde abagosoa barore oborabu.
english: "No one lights a lamp and puts it in a place where it will be hidden, or under a bowl. Instead he puts it on its stand, so that those who come in may see the light.

ekegusii: “Omonto otari bw’eamate y’omokuani tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu. Omomenyi omenyete amo nomokuani, gose omonto orikire komokorera emeremo, abwo tibabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu.
english: "'No one outside a priest's family may eat the sacred offering, nor may the guest of a priest or his hired worker eat it.

ekegusii: Onde tari okobeka ekeraka ki’egetambaa ekeyia ase eanga engotu, ekiagera keria kiabekwa nigo kegotandora eanga eria, na ase yatandogete ake nigo ekona‐gochiererera.
english: "No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, for the patch will pull away from the garment, making the tear worse.

ekegusii: Gose tari monto onde okobareera ekeraka ki’egetambaa ekeyia ase eanga engotu ekiagera keria kiabekwa nigo kegotandora eanga eria, keria ekeyia giachierereria eanga eria engotu etandoke kobua.
english: "No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, making the tear worse.

ekegusii: “Korende chitugo chintangi nechiane, ase igo onde tachiatanana, kerabe eng’ombe gose eng’ondi, gose embori; eng’iti entangi nigo ere eyane.
english: "'No one, however, may dedicate the firstborn of an animal, since the firstborn already belongs to the LORD; whether an ox or a sheep, it is the LORD's.

ekegusii: Akamoiraneria, “Onde tari, Omonene.” Yeso akamotebia, “Na inche tingokogambia. Genda, korende tokora ebibe naende.”]
english: "No one, sir," she said. "Then neither do I condemn you," Jesus declared. "Go now and leave your life of sin."

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi bwatananirwe ase ogosirigwa takonyara koboorigwa; omonto oyio goika aitwe akwe.
english: "'No person devoted to destruction may be ransomed; he must be put to death.

ekegusii: Mosomba onde tari oranyare gokorera abanene babere, ekiagera nageche oyomo, na anche oyonde, gose nabwatane noyomo, na achaye oyonde. Timokonyara gokorera Nyasae na enibo.”
english: "No servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and Money."

ekegusii: Taibo! Nigo twakorire aya, ekiagera twoboire ng’a gose ase engaki erache abana b’ororeria rwaino baise gocha koboria ab’orwaito: Inee! Nainwe more negetari ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli?
english: "No! We did it for fear that some day your descendants might say to ours, 'What do you have to do with the LORD, the God of Israel?

ekegusii: Akabakania, “Yaya, nigo mwachire koroota ense, na korora ense ase ere bosa etari na getango.”
english: "No!" he said to them. "You have come to see where our land is unprotected."

ekegusii: Tamari akamoiraneria, “Yaya taibo, oyominto. Bono ogoseria oko ogonseria nigo kore okobe kobua amang’ana aya gwankoreire.” Korende Amunoni akaanga gotegerera amang’ana aye.
english: "No!" she said to him. "Sending me away would be a greater wrong than what you have already done to me." But he refused to listen to her.

ekegusii: Akabora: Yaya, tata Ibrahimu, korende oyomo korwa ase abakure aise kobachiera, inabaonchoke.
english: "'No, father Abraham,' he said, 'but if someone from the dead goes to them, they will repent.'

ekegusii: "'No,' he answered, 'because while you are pulling the weeds, you may root up the wheat with them.
english: Akabakania: Yaya; moise gosangereria amabanchore namosimore engano amo naro.

ekegusii: agateba, “Yaya, omonene one, ntegerera. Oboremo boria nakoeire amo ne rikuruma riria rire imeo, ase amaiso ’abanto baminto nakobieire; otindeke mokao aroro.”
english: "No, my lord," he said. "Listen to me; I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead."

ekegusii: Bakamokania, “Taibo, omonene, intwe abasomba bao nigo twachire kogora endagera.
english: "No, my lord," they answered. "Your servants have come to buy food.

ekegusii: Korende omoruoti akamokania, akamotebia, “Yaya taibo, omwana one, titokogenda twensi. Toise kogenda twensi nigo torakobuchere.” Abisalomu akamosorora mono, korende omoruoti tancha kogenda, otatiga amosesenetie.
english: "No, my son," the king replied. "All of us should not go; we would only be a burden to you." Although Absalom urged him, he still refused to go, but gave him his blessing.

ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akamotebia, “Taibo, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, koranche obwate ekeegwa eke korwa ase okoboko kwane; naki okorora obosio bwao nigo enga buna okorora obosio bwa Nyasae, ase ogwanchera kwanyancheire inche.
english: "No, please!" said Jacob. "If I have found favor in your eyes, accept this gift from me. For to see your face is like seeing the face of God, now that you have received me favorably.

ekegusii: Korende baria abang’aini bakabairaneria: Taibo. Takonyara gotoisana intwe nainwe twensi, mbuya mogende mwegorere ase abakoonia.
english: "'No,' they replied, 'there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.'

ekegusii: "No," said Peter, "you shall never wash my feet." Jesus answered, "Unless I wash you, you have no part with me."
english: Petero akamokania, “Togonsibia amagoro aane nonya ng’ake.” Yeso akamotebia, “Ntagosibeti, tori nobomo amo nainche.”

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba baye akamoiraneria, “Onde tari aa asetore, aye omoruoti omonene one, korende n’Elisha, omobani ore agwo ase Abaisraeli, nere ogotebia omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli amang’ana ogokwana ekero ore ase akanyomba kao g’okorara.”
english: "None of us, my lord the king," said one of his officers, "but Elisha, the prophet who is in Israel, tells the king of Israel the very words you speak in your bedroom."

ekegusii: Ekeene, onde tari ase abanto b’ekegori eke ekebe oraike ase ense eria engiya narierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nimbayee,
english: "Not a man of this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your forefathers,

ekegusii: Yonathani akairaneria Adonia, “Taibo, amang’ana tari amaya, ekiagera omonene oito, omoruoti Daudi, obekire Sulemani obeire omoruoti.
english: "Not at all!" Jonathan answered. "Our lord King David has made Solomon king.

ekegusii: “Tari kera omonto ogontebia: Omonene, Omonene, orasoe ase oboruoti bwa igoro, korende noyogokora ogwancha gwa Tata one ore igoro.
english: "Not everyone who says to me, 'Lord, Lord,' will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atai mange oria omoke agasangereria ebinto biaye bionsi, akaimoka akagenda orogendo gochia ense y’aare; agasiarera agwo enibo yaye ase ogokora kw’obokayayu.
english: "Not long after that, the younger son got together all he had, set off for a distant country and there squandered his wealth in wild living.

ekegusii: Hana akamoiraneria, “Taibo, omonene one, inche nomokungu inde nobororo ase enkoro yane. Tinyweti edivai gose ekenyugwa kende kegotindia. Nigo nabeire ngosaba na kobeka emechando yane yonsi ase Omonene.
english: "Not so, my lord," Hannah replied, "I am a woman who is deeply troubled. I have not been drinking wine or beer; I was pouring out my soul to the LORD.

ekegusii: Omogeni agacha bw’omonto oria omonda, na ere tanchete komonyenyera embori gose eng’ondi korwa ase riicho riaye, korende akaira akamanwa karia k’eng’ondi k’omotaka oria, erio agakanyenyerao mogeni oye.”
english: "Now a traveler came to the rich man, but the rich man refrained from taking one of his own sheep or cattle to prepare a meal for the traveler who had come to him. Instead, he took the ewe lamb that belonged to the poor man and prepared it for the one who had come to him."

ekegusii: Na bono, aye Omonene Nyasae, imoka ogende goika aase ao ase ogotimokera, aye amo n’Esanduku eria y’okobua kwao. Omonene Nyasae, tiga abakuani bao basiberanigwe nogotooreka; na abachenu bao tiga bagokere obuya bwao.
english: "Now arise, O LORD God, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might. May your priests, O LORD God, be clothed with salvation, may your saints rejoice in your goodness.

ekegusii: “Ase igo moiroke Omonene na komokorera ase okoigwera na ase obwegenwa. Rusia korwa asemore chinyasae chiria chisokoro chiaino chiare gokorera aaria ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Eufarati na ase ense ya Misiri; mokorere Omonene bweka.
english: "Now fear the LORD and serve him with all faithfulness. Throw away the gods your forefathers worshiped beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve the LORD.

ekegusii: korende imoka osoe omochie, notebigwe ayarakogwenere okore.”
english: "Now get up and go into the city, and you will be told what you must do."

ekegusii: “Ase ayio nigo nkobaboria ng’a korwa rituko ria rero mobe mokorengereria buna yarenge ekero keria rigena konya ritarabekwa igoro ase rigena rinde, ase okoagacha Hekalu y’Omonene.
english: "'Now give careful thought to this from this day on--consider how things were before one stone was laid on another in the LORD's temple.

ekegusii: “Bono nkogenda inde enchera eria abanto bonsi b’ense bagochia. Mwamanyire buya ase chinkoro chiaino ime, na ase emioyo yaino boigo, ng’a timoremeiri gento kende gionsi ekiya eke Omonene, Nyasae oino, abarierete eira ng’a nakebae. Amang’ana ayio onsi aikeranire, rinde tiriremeti.
english: "Now I am about to go the way of all the earth. You know with all your heart and soul that not one of all the good promises the LORD your God gave you has failed. Every promise has been fulfilled; not one has failed.

ekegusii: Korende bono nkogenda nde asare ere oyontomete; gose onde tari asemore okomboria: Ing’ai ogochia?
english: "Now I am going to him who sent me, yet none of you asks me, 'Where are you going?'

ekegusii: Gaki bono nababekire ase amaboko a Nyasae, na ase ring’ana ri’obuya bwaye, asare ere oyoranyare kobaagacha na kobaa omwando amo nabwo bonsi abachenirwe.
english: "Now I commit you to God and to the word of his grace, which can build you up and give you an inheritance among all those who are sanctified.

ekegusii: Naigure ng’a nkonacha ore ching’ondi chiao amarionya. Bono abarisia bao nigo barenge amo naintwe; titwabakorerete bobe bonde. Barabwo tibaiberetwe gento kende gionsi ase engaki yonsi barenge Karimeli.
english: "'Now I hear that it is sheep-shearing time. When your shepherds were with us, we did not mistreat them, and the whole time they were at Carmel nothing of theirs was missing.

ekegusii: Bono rora, namanyire ng’a timokondora obosio bwane naende, inwe mwensi aba nabeire ngotaara ase egati yaino na kobaranderia amang’ana ’oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
english: "Now I know that none of you among whom I have gone about preaching the kingdom will ever see me again.

ekegusii: Naki ningokore obe omoke ase egati y’ebisaku. Abanto bonsi nabagochaye.
english: "Now I will make you small among the nations, despised among men.

ekegusii: “Na bono, Inee, nigo mwakorete ayare boronge na ay’obwegenwa ekero mwachorete Abimeleki akaba omoruoti oino? Naende mwakorerete Yerubi‐Baali na ab’enyomba yaye boronge na ayamogwenerete ase ogokora kwaye?
english: "Now if you have acted honorably and in good faith when you made Abimelech king, and if you have been fair to Jerub-Baal and his family, and if you have treated him as he deserves--

ekegusii: “Korende nenyare koba ng’a mwamochire kobwatia amachiko ande onsi Omonene achikire Musa,
english: "'Now if you unintentionally fail to keep any of these commands the LORD gave Moses--

ekegusii: “Inwe abakuani, sorora Nyasae, erinde atororere amabera. Inee! Naroreire onde bwensi oino amabera, ekero mokorua okoruegwa konga buna okwo korwa ase amaboko aino?” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda akoboria.
english: "Now implore God to be gracious to us. With such offerings from your hands, will he accept you?"-- says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: “Korwa ase omoko eorokererie omoreng’anio oyo: Orosagia rwaye korwachakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, etoigo ng’ang’e ere.
english: "Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.

ekegusii: “Korwa ase omoko eorokererie omoreng’anio oye. Orosagia rwaye korwachakire koorokia amato aye, mwamanyire ng’a nekero ki’ogoseboka, etoigo ng’ang’e ere.
english: "Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bono totomere intwe, abasomba bao, engano, na esairi, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na edivai, ebinto biria aye, omonene one, gwatebete ng’a nototomere.
english: "Now let my lord send his servants the wheat and barley and the olive oil and wine he promised,

ekegusii: Ase ayio aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, bono kora aya kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata eira, ogateba: Takoborwa nonya ng’ake omonto korwa ase ororeria rwao oraikaranse ase obosio bwane, ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli, onye rioka abana bao bagochia korenda chinchera chiabo, erinde babwatie ogochika kwane, buna aye kwabeire gokobwatia ogochika okwo ase obosio bwane.
english: "Now LORD, God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, 'You shall never fail to have a man to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your sons are careful in all they do to walk before me according to my law, as you have done.'

ekegusii: Ase ayio aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ikerania bono aya kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata eira, ogateba; Takobora nonya ng’ake omonto korwa ase ororeria rwao oraikaranse ase obosio bwane ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli, onye abana bao bagochia korenda chinchera chiabo, erinde babwatie chinchera chiane, buna aye gwachibwatetie.
english: "Now LORD, God of Israel, keep for your servant David my father the promises you made to him when you said, 'You shall never fail to have a man to sit before me on the throne of Israel, if only your sons are careful in all they do to walk before me as you have done.'

ekegusii: Bono nagosabire, tiga okobua kwao, aye Omonene, kobe okonene buna aye kwarire eira, kogokwana:
english: "Now may the Lord's strength be displayed, just as you have declared:

ekegusii: “Bono omoyo one oichanire; ninki ngokwana? Tata, ontoorie korwa ase ense eye! Yaya, korende ase engencho y’ayio naikeire ensa eye.
english: "Now my heart is troubled, and what shall I say? 'Father, save me from this hour'? No, it was for this very reason I came to this hour.

ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, obane amang’ana aya onsi igoro asebare, obatebie: Omonene narume korwa igoro, naake eriogi riaye korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu. Narume ne chinguru igoro ye riicho riaye; naake eriogi buna eri’abanto bakomita amasabibu. Naake eriogi buna eri’ebanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense.
english: "Now prophesy all these words against them and say to them: "'The LORD will roar from on high; he will thunder from his holy dwelling and roar mightily against his land. He will shout like those who tread the grapes, shout against all who live on the earth.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamotebia, “Irania okoboko kwao eanga ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora bo, na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire buya, buna omobere oye ore.
english: "Now put it back into your cloak," he said. So Moses put his hand back into his cloak, and when he took it out, it was restored, like the rest of his flesh.

ekegusii: Aye omonene one, Omonene nere ogotangire tigwaitera amanyinga na kweruseria egesiomba nokoboko kwao omonyene. Bono buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye ore moyo, tiga ababisa bao, abwo bakorigia kogokora bobe, babe buna Nabali.
english: "Now since the LORD has kept you, my master, from bloodshed and from avenging yourself with your own hands, as surely as the LORD lives and as you live, may your enemies and all who intend to harm my master be like Nabal.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nere oseretie Abaamori ase engencho y’abanto baye Abaisraeli. Inee! Aye bono nigo oganetie koira ense yabo?
english: "Now since the LORD, the God of Israel, has driven the Amorites out before his people Israel, what right have you to take it over?

ekegusii: Ase igo roisia egari enyia, morente chiombe ibere chigokamwa, chitana gosiberwa rikorogoto; mosibere chiombe echio egari eyio, korende morusie chimori chiabo korwa ase chirochio, mochitige nka.
english: "Now then, get a new cart ready, with two cows that have calved and have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take their calves away and pen them up.

ekegusii: “Bono nkogotebia inde ayare ay’ekeene. Naama! Abaruoti bande batato nabaoroke ase ense y’Ayemi. Naende omoruoti o kane naoroke, nigo arabe omonda kobua abwo batato bonsi. Ekero aranyore chinguru goetera ase obonda bwaye, naseegete bonsi bagende korwania oboruoti bw’Abagiriki.
english: "Now then, I tell you the truth: Three more kings will appear in Persia, and then a fourth, who will be far richer than all the others. When he has gained power by his wealth, he will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.

ekegusii: "Now then, I will crush you as a cart crushes when loaded with grain.
english: Rora nimbaritoere gochia inse buna egari eichire chigurube ekoritoerwa.

ekegusii: Bono rora, emiaka emerongo ene, na etano, yaetire korwa rituko riria Omonene atebetie Musa amang’ana ayio, ase engaki eria Abaisraeli baetete ase erooro, na Omonene ondendire ngendererete koba moyo. Na bono, rora, nabeire nemiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etano,
english: "Now then, just as the LORD promised, he has kept me alive for forty-five years since the time he said this to Moses, while Israel moved about in the desert. So here I am today, eighty-five years old!

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye bwanchete kwegokia, igwa amang’ana aya! Aye oikaransete na kwegaara, gwateba ase enkoro yao; Inche ninche, onde tari otatiga inche bweka, tingotigwa imbe omoboraka, gose tingokwerwa abana.”
english: "Now then, listen, you wanton creature, lounging in your security and saying to yourself, 'I am, and there is none besides me. I will never be a widow or suffer the loss of children.'

ekegusii: “Na bono, inwe abana baane, ntegerere moigwe, mbasesenirie abwo barendete chinchera chiane,
english: "Now then, my sons, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.

ekegusii: Na bono, omonene one, nagosoroire, ntige imbe omosomba oo ribaga ri’ omosae oyo; ere omotige agende amo nabamwabo inka.
english: "Now then, please let your servant remain here as my lord's slave in place of the boy, and let the boy return with his brothers.

ekegusii: Bono tenena, mokire‐kiri, morore ring’ana eri rinene Omonene arakore ase amaiso aino.
english: "Now then, stand still and see this great thing the LORD is about to do before your eyes!

ekegusii: “Gaki bono naende kwana nomosomba one Daudi, omotebie amang’ana aya: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Nigo nakorusetie korwa ase oborisia aase kware gotunyana ching’ondi, ngakobeka okaba omogambi bw’abanto baane Abaisraeli.
english: "Now then, tell my servant David, 'This is what the LORD Almighty says: I took you from the pasture and from following the flock to be ruler over my people Israel.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro oratebie Daudi, omosomba one, ng’a inche Omonene bw’Emeganda natebire iga: Nigo nakorusetie korwa ase kwarenge korisia ching’ondi, erinde obe gokogambera abanto baane Abaisraeli;
english: "Now then, tell my servant David, 'This is what the LORD Almighty says: I took you from the pasture and from following the flock, to be ruler over my people Israel.

ekegusii: “Bono abana bao abamura babere kwaiborerete ase ense ya Misiri ritang’ani ntaracha aa, barabwo nabaane bararokwe. Efraimu na Manase nigo barabe abaane, buna Reuben na Simeoni bare abaane.
english: "Now then, your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here will be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh will be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Rusia chinyasae chingeni echire ase egati yaino, moonchore chinkoro chiaino ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.”
english: "Now then," said Joshua, "throw away the foreign gods that are among you and yield your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel."

ekegusii: Bono tebia Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu ng’a: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Naama! Nkoroisia inde na nkore emeroberio emebe igoro asemore. Kera oyomo tiga airane atige chinchera chi’obobe, morongeyie chingencho chiaino na ogokora kwaino.
english: "Now therefore say to the people of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, 'This is what the LORD says: Look! I am preparing a disaster for you and devising a plan against you. So turn from your evil ways, each one of you, and reform your ways and your actions.'

ekegusii: “Na bono, aye Nyasae oito, nigo ore omonene, na omobui, na oyo bw’okoirokia. Nigo orendete okobwatana kw’ogotianania, na obwanchani bwao boria bogendererete botambe. Tobara buna negento egesinini obokong’u obo bwonsi bwatonyorire. Korwa ase engaki eria abaruoti b’Abaasuri batogamberete goika rero, twabeire togochandeka intwe na abaruoti baito, na abanene baito, na abakuani baito, na ababani baito, ne chisokoro chiaito; ee, abanto bao bonsi.
english: "Now therefore, O our God, the great, mighty and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of love, do not let all this hardship seem trifling in your eyes-- the hardship that has come upon us, upon our kings and leaders, upon our priests and prophets, upon our fathers and all your people, from the days of the kings of Assyria until today.

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika ase Omwerwa: Ekero engaki yaye y’ogweatanana yaerire, arentwe ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangerekano.
english: "'Now this is the law for the Nazirite when the period of his separation is over. He is to be brought to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: “Bono aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Nase ki mogwekorera inwe abanyene obobe obo obonene? Nigo morigetie gosiria kegima abasacha na abakungu, na abana bakogonka, na abana bande, korwa ase Abayuda, na timotigaria nonya noyomo?
english: "Now this is what the LORD God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Why bring such great disaster on yourselves by cutting off from Judah the men and women, the children and infants, and so leave yourselves without a remnant?

ekegusii: Naama! Ebi nabio biarenge ebibe bia Sodomu, mosubati omino: Ere amo nabaiseke baye nigo barenge abaenenu na abaigotu b’endagera, naende nigo barenge nobotoereru, korende tibechanderete abataka na abaremerwa.
english: "'Now this was the sin of your sister Sodom: She and her daughters were arrogant, overfed and unconcerned; they did not help the poor and needy.

ekegusii: "Now what have I done?" said David. "Can't I even speak?"
english: Daudi agateba, “Ninki nakora rende? Nokoboria gwoka naboria.”

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Bono ningororoke ntenene, bono ninyimokerere igoro inyetogie.
english: "Now will I arise," says the LORD. "Now will I be exalted; now will I be lifted up.

ekegusii: “Bono rika ogotera oko, oborokererie Abaisraeli, bamanye kogotera, erinde korokwo kobe kirori one ase Abaisraeli.
english: "Now write down for yourselves this song and teach it to the Israelites and have them sing it, so that it may be a witness for me against them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, inwe abanto momenyete Yerusalemu, na inwe Abayuda, nababoririe monache ekina ase egati yane na omogondo one.
english: "Now you dwellers in Jerusalem and men of Judah, judge between me and my vineyard.

ekegusii: “Aye nomanyete eki Yoabu, omwana bw’omokungu Seruya, akorete asende, ase ogoita abachiki baria babere b’abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli: Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na Amasa, mosinto o Yeteri. Noinyorete buna aiterete amanyinga ase engaki y’omorembe buna nigo yarenge engaki y’esegi. Akabeka amanyinga atari na komocha ase orokini rwaye na ase ebikoroto bi’amagoro aye.
english: "Now you yourself know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me-- what he did to the two commanders of Israel's armies, Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether. He killed them, shedding their blood in peacetime as if in battle, and with that blood stained the belt around his waist and the sandals on his feet.

ekegusii: Kwabeire oyotachenegeti ase engencho y’obonyaka bwao. Nateemire kogochena, korende tochenegeti. Tokonyara gocheneka korwa ase ogotacheneka kwao goika inche ndete endamwamu yane igoro asore.
english: "'Now your impurity is lewdness. Because I tried to cleanse you but you would not be cleansed from your impurity, you will not be clean again until my wrath against you has subsided.

ekegusii: “Na bono baminto, namanyire ng’a nigo mwakorete aya ase ogotamanya kwaino, buna abanene baino bakorete.
english: "Now, brothers, I know that you acted in ignorance, as did your leaders.

ekegusii: “Bono, aye Nyasae one, tiga amaiso ao arigererie na amato ao aigwe ayio onsi asabirwe aase aiga.
english: "Now, my God, may your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

ekegusii: “Bono omwana one, Omonene abe amo naye, erio obe nokogenderera okuya ase okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oo, buna akwanete igoro yao.
english: "Now, my son, the LORD be with you, and may you have success and build the house of the LORD your God, as he said you would.

ekegusii: Na bono, Omonene, Nyasae one, aye gwankorire inche, omosomba oo, nabeire omoruoti ribaga ria Daudi tata, nonya inde omwana omoke. Timanyeti buna nkogamba na koraa.
english: "Now, O LORD my God, you have made your servant king in place of my father David. But I am only a little child and do not know how to carry out my duties.

ekegusii: “Na bono aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, aye kwarusetie abanto bao korwa ase ense ya Misiri nokoboko kwao kore nokobua, na kwemanyekanirie goika rituko ria rero. Intwe twakorire ebibe na ayare amabe.
english: "Now, O Lord our God, who brought your people out of Egypt with a mighty hand and who made for yourself a name that endures to this day, we have sinned, we have done wrong.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, aye Nyasae oito, igwa ogosaba kwane inche omosomba oo, na ogosorora kwane, na ase engencho yao aye Omonene oraberie Obomenyo bwao Obochenu ase obosio bwao, Obomenyo obwo bore rituuri.
english: "Now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of your servant. For your sake, O Lord, look with favor on your desolate sanctuary.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, barigererie abakungu b’abanto bao, abwo bakobana amang’ana akorwa ase ebirengererio biabo abanyene, obane amang’ana are mamincha yabo.
english: "Now, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy out of their own imagination. Prophesy against them

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, imokia ritabori, oribeke bosio bwao, erio orimang’ere omogwekano bw’omochie o Yerusalemu.
english: "Now, son of man, take a clay tablet, put it in front of you and draw the city of Jerusalem on it.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, imokia omoyio o birende omwoge, bwekigite etukia y’omotwe oo, ne chinderu chiao; erio orente ekerengero orengere etukia eyio na oyiatanane.
english: "Now, son of man, take a sharp sword and use it as a barber's razor to shave your head and your beard. Then take a set of scales and divide up the hair.

ekegusii: “Aye omochie ochandire, aye kwabeire gokoruta‐rutwa gochia aaria na aaria nomoubera, otari koremigwa nonde, rora, ninkoagacha namagena ao akomeka‐meka, nimbeke oboroso bwao namagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro.
english: "O afflicted city, lashed by storms and not comforted, I will build you with stones of turquoise, your foundations with sapphires.

ekegusii: “Inwe abakungu b’Abaisraeli, reerera Saulo, nere obaboyetie chianga chie rigori rinene, chianga chimbariri chi’okwegokeria, agachichabera ebinto bi’etahabu.”
english: "O daughters of Israel, weep for Saul, who clothed you in scarlet and finery, who adorned your garments with ornaments of gold.

ekegusii: “Aye riroba, tobaisa gotuba amanyinga aane, na ekerero kiane tikenyora ase kegotimokera.
english: "O earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry never be laid to rest!

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, tinkonyara kobakora inwe buna omokori chinyongo oyo akorete? Ee, inwe Abaisraeli, buna koreng’ana esike ere ase okoboko kw’omokori chinyongo, naboigo nainwe more ase okoboko kwane.
english: "O house of Israel, can I not do with you as this potter does?" declares the LORD. "Like clay in the hand of the potter, so are you in my hand, O house of Israel.

ekegusii: “Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe asore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao buna engoko egosangereria ebichuchu biaye aase chimbaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!
english: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing!

ekegusii: “Aye Yerusalemu, Yerusalemu, aye ogoita ababani na kobaaka amagena abatomirwe asore! Ng’ara karenga narigirie gosangereria abana bao, buna engoko egosangereria ebionuchu biaye ase chimbaba chiaye ime, korende timwancha!
english: "O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were not willing.

ekegusii: “Aye omoruoti, Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono naete Nebukadinesaro iso oboruoti, na obonene, na ogotogigwa, na okobua okonene,
english: "O king, the Most High God gave your father Nebuchadnezzar sovereignty and greatness and glory and splendor.

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aye omenyete nobonene bwao igoro y’Abakerubi, aye naye Nyasae, aye bweka, igoro y’amarouti onsi ay’ense; naye gwatongete igoro na ense
english: "O LORD Almighty, God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, kwang’orokeirie inche, omosomba oo, aya onsi, kogoteba: Ninkoagachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro yane kogosaba ogosaba oko.
english: "O LORD Almighty, God of Israel, you have revealed this to your servant, saying, 'I will build a house for you.' So your servant has found courage to offer you this prayer.

ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene, ekiagera bono nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, nagosabire ogende amo naintwe. Naki abanto aba nabanyabigoti bikong’u, korende otwabere ogosaria gwaito na ebibe biaito, otwanchere tobe abanto bao.”
english: "O Lord, if I have found favor in your eyes," he said, "then let the Lord go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, forgive our wickedness and our sin, and take us as your inheritance."

ekegusii: bagakwana, “Ayee! Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nase ki amang’ana aya abeire asetore intwe Abaisraeli ng’a rero egesaku ekemo giasirire korwa asetore?”
english: "O LORD, the God of Israel," they cried, "why has this happened to Israel? Why should one tribe be missing from Israel today?"

ekegusii: Omonene, ekero kwarwete ebitunwa bia Seiri, na ogataara korwa ense ya Edomu, ense egatengechigwa, ne embura egatwa korwa igoro. Ee, amare agaitera amache.
english: "O LORD, when you went out from Seir, when you marched from the land of Edom, the earth shook, the heavens poured, the clouds poured down water.

ekegusii: “Inwe ebigoro bia Giliboa, ogotoora kwe riime tikoba igoro asemore, gose embura tetwa, gose emegondo teba ekwama endagera ekoruegwa ase Omonene, ekiagera aroro agwo nao chinguba chie chituoni chiasareretigwe, na enguba ya Saulo etaagetwe amaguta naende.
english: "O mountains of Gilboa, may you have neither dew nor rain, nor fields that yield offerings [of grain]. For there the shield of the mighty was defiled, the shield of Saul-- no longer rubbed with oil.

ekegusii: "O my son, O son of my womb, O son of my vows,
english: Naki aye omwana one? Naki aye omwana bw’enda yane? Ninki ndagotebie, aye omwana bw’eira yane nariete?

ekegusii: “Aye otachenegeti, aye omokori amabe ore omogambi bw’Abaisraeli, rituko riao ri’okonyora egesusuro ki’omoerio ki’ebibe biao riaikire.
english: "'O profane and wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax,

ekegusii: “Inwe abatigari b’Abayuda, Omonene obatebirie ng’a timobaisa kogenda Misiri. Manya kegima ng’a inche nabakureire inwe rituko ria rero.
english: "O remnant of Judah, the LORD has told you, 'Do not go to Egypt.' Be sure of this: I warn you today

ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, bono kwanyorokirie inche, omosomba oo, omochakano bwoka bw’obonene bwao, na okoboko kwao gwe chinguru. Enyasae ende teri, igoro gose ase ense, eranyare gokora emeremo emenene na eya chinguru buna eye ogokora aye.
english: "O Sovereign LORD, you have begun to show to your servant your greatness and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or on earth who can do the deeds and mighty works you do?

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, naende ekebe, nimbe amo nainwe goika ririri, na koremereria nainwe? Renta omwana oo aiga.”
english: "O unbelieving and perverse generation," Jesus replied, "how long shall I stay with you and put up with you? Bring your son here."

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, naende ekebe, nimbe amo nainwe goika ririri? Nindemererie nainwe goika ririri? Mondetere aiga.”
english: "O unbelieving and perverse generation," Jesus replied, "how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy here to me."

ekegusii: "O unbelieving generation," Jesus replied, "how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy to me."
english: Akabairaneria, “Inwe ekegori getari nokwegena, nimbe nainwe goika ririri? Nindemererie nainwe goika ririri? Mondetere aa!”

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri goika morirende, ribe ogochika kwaino, aye amo nabana bao kogenderera botambe.
english: "Obey these instructions as a lasting ordinance for you and your descendants.

ekegusii: Morende Chisabato chiane, naende mosike Obomenyo bwane Obochenu. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Morende Chisabato chiane na mosike Obomenyo bwane Obochenu. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Observe my Sabbaths and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: “Bwata rituko ri’Esabato, oriatanane ribe richenu, buna Omonene Nyasae oo, agochigete.
english: "Observe the Sabbath day by keeping it holy, as the LORD your God has commanded you.

ekegusii: Ase igo morende rituko ri’Esabato, ekiagera ne rituko richenu asemore. Onde bwensi aise korisaria, nigo araitwe akwe. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abanto b’Omonene.
english: "'Observe the Sabbath, because it is holy to you. Anyone who desecrates it must be put to death; whoever does any work on that day must be cut off from his people.

ekegusii: “Monyare koria chinswe chire ase chinyancha ne chindooche ime, echibwate chingondo chinga buna chimbaba, na amagoocho.
english: "'Of all the creatures living in the water of the seas and the streams, you may eat any that have fins and scales.

ekegusii: “Ase ching’iti chinke chigoetanana ase ense, echio nchibe chitachenegeti asemore; Ekenyamunyonge, na embeba, na ekiigo ekenene, amo nebisaku biamwabo;
english: "'Of the animals that move about on the ground, these are unclean for you: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,

ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, mbitoki ki okorentera oyio okoyobomba? Oyio nomogwekano obombire ore omworokia omong’ainereria? Oyio oyoroisetie nigo asemeretie emeremo y’amaboko aye ere chinyasae chitari gokwana.
english: "Of what value is an idol, since a man has carved it? Or an image that teaches lies? For he who makes it trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.

ekegusii: "Oh, that I might have my request, that God would grant what I hope for,
english: “Naki nanga yaba buya onye nanyora aya nkoboria, onye Nyasae nanchera aya nganetie!

ekegusii: “Naki yare koba buya onye amang’ana aane narikwa bono! Yare koba buya arikwe ase ebuku,
english: "Oh, that my words were recorded, that they were written on a scroll,

ekegusii: Naende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Onye ndiria arenge gotoka omonto nonya noyomo korwa asemore asieke ebisieri bie Hekalu, erinde timobaisa kogenderera gouta omorero ase egesasimero kiane bosa, ekiagera tingokiri nainwe, gose tingwanchera ebing’wanso korwa ase amaboko aino.
english: "Oh, that one of you would shut the temple doors, so that you would not light useless fires on my altar! I am not pleased with you," says the LORD Almighty, "and I will accept no offering from your hands.

ekegusii: Ohola, ekero arenge oyone, nigo arenge gokora obonyaka, akaba nokogania okobe ase abanchi baye Abaasuri.
english: "Oholah engaged in prostitution while she was still mine; and she lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians-- warriors

ekegusii: “Nabo ase emeremo eyio nigo narenge kogenda Damesiki, nigo naetwe okobua na amachiko korwa ase abakuani abanene.
english: "On one of these journeys I was going to Damascus with the authority and commission of the chief priests.

ekegusii: “Ekero engaki eyio eraike, ensoko netuboke ase abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, erinde basibigwe korwa ase ebibe biabo, na ogotacheneka kwabo.
english: "On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio kera omobani nabe nobosooku ase amaroro aye ekero akobana; gose onde takobeka eganchwa eroiseirie amarionya ase okong’aina abanto.
english: "On that day every prophet will be ashamed of his prophetic vision. He will not put on a prophet's garment of hair in order to deceive.

ekegusii: “Ase rituko erio nindue Rigoko ri’Abaeti rire moocha y’enyancha, agwo ase ense y’Abaisraeli, erinde Gogi amo nemeganda yaye yonsi batindekwe aroro. Ase ayio ase rigoko erio chimbeera nchitange abaeti. Nigo rirarokwe Rigoko ri’Emeganda ya Gogi.
english: "'On that day I will give Gog a burial place in Israel, in the valley of those who travel east toward the Sea. It will block the way of travelers, because Gog and all his hordes will be buried there. So it will be called the Valley of Hamon Gog.

ekegusii: “Ase rituko erio nintige orogunchara rw’Abaisraeli romere, nimaanore omonwa oo okwane ase egati yabo. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: "On that day I will make a horn grow for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria ninkore abagambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda babe buna orogio rore nomorero ogosamba chinko, naende buna ekieri ki’omorero ogosamba emesaima y’amasakwe. Barabwo mbasambe abanto bonsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chiabo chionsi, basirie aande onsi, ensemo ya borio na eya bomosi, korende Yerusalemu nogenderere kobeera ase ore bono.
english: "On that day I will make the leaders of Judah like a firepot in a woodpile, like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will consume right and left all the surrounding peoples, but Jerusalem will remain intact in her place.

ekegusii: “Ekero rituko erio rirache, abatomwa mbarue asende, bariine chimeeri bagende Etiopia, baondokie abanto b’aroro, abwo batakagereti ng’a bobe bonde mbobanyore. Omoichano nobachere ase rituko riria ri’ogosirigwa kwa Misiri. Ee, rora, emechando eyio ngocha ere!
english: "'On that day messengers will go out from me in ships to frighten Cush out of her complacency. Anguish will take hold of them on the day of Egypt's doom, for it is sure to come.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Ase rituko riria ninkoire aye Serubabeli omosomba one, mosinto o Sealitieli. Naende Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Ningokore obe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio kiane, ekiagera nagochorire. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.”
english: "'On that day,' declares the LORD Almighty, 'I will take you, my servant Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel,' declares the LORD, 'and I will make you like my signet ring, for I have chosen you,' declares the LORD Almighty."

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio ninsirie amarieta ’emegwekano egosasimwa ase ense eye, tagwatorwa naende nonya ng’ake. Boigo nindusie ababani amo nomoika bw’ogotacheneka korwa aiga.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
english: "On that day, I will banish the names of the idols from the land, and they will be remembered no more," declares the LORD Almighty. "I will remove both the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko erio eriogi ri’okorera ndigugwe korwa ase Egeita gie Chinswe, na okweumia nkoigugwe korwa ase ensemo enyia y’omochie, na endumo enene korwa ase ebigoro.
english: "On that day," declares the LORD, "a cry will go up from the Fish Gate, wailing from the New Quarter, and a loud crash from the hills.

ekegusii: “Naki ase obotuko obwo ninche ng’ete ense ya Misiri, ing’ite abana abatangi bonsi ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi; ne chinyasae chionsi chia Misiri ninchigambie. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "On that same night I will pass through Egypt and strike down every firstborn-- both men and animals-- and I will bring judgment on all the gods of Egypt. I am the LORD.
