ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ndarue egesusuro ase Abaisraeli ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, ninsarie na gotagora ebisasimero bia Beteli; nintagore na koiyeria inse emegwekano ye chingunchara ere ase ebisasimero biria.
english: "On the day I punish Israel for her sins, I will destroy the altars of Bethel; the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani rie rigesa, ekero morabe mokorenta okoruegwa kw’endagera enyia ase Omonene, ase Rituko Rinene rie Chichuma, namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.
english: "'On the day of firstfruits, when you present to the LORD an offering of new grain during the Feast of Weeks, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

ekegusii: “Ribebe ria moocha richakere korwa ase egati ya Haurani na Damesiki, ribwatie orooche rwa Yorodan, gati ya Gileadi na ense y’Abaisraeli, rigenderere kobwatia Enyancha y’Omonyo. Naboigo morariate. Erio nario rirabe ribebe ria moocha.
english: "On the east side the boundary will run between Hauran and Damascus, along the Jordan between Gilead and the land of Israel, to the eastern sea and as far as Tamar. This will be the east boundary.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya moocha eyerabe nekerengo gie chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), ebiita bitato mbibeo: Egeita kia Yusufu, na ekia Benjamin, na ekia Dani.
english: "On the east side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Joseph, the gate of Benjamin and the gate of Dan.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato arente ebinto ebio bi’ogochenwa kwaye ase omokuani, agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
english: "On the eighth day he must bring them for his cleansing to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, before the LORD.

ekegusii: “Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato arente chimanwa ibere chimingichi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, na emanwa esigiti yakoorire omwaka oyomo, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, amo nobosie obonuke, ebimunu bitano na ekemo, bwochoganirie namaguta, ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Amo nayio arente amaguta egetuba ekemo.
english: "On the eighth day he must bring two male lambs and one ewe lamb a year old, each without defect, along with three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering, and one log of oil.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato goika mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.
english: "'On the eighth day hold an assembly and do no regular work.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Timokora emeremo ende yonsi, korende morende Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: "'On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. Celebrate a festival to the LORD for seven days.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano morue chieri kianda, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: "'On the fifth day prepare nine bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko. Rituko erio nigo rirabe rituko ri’okobugia ebiroria.
english: "'On the first day of the seventh month hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work. It is a day for you to sound the trumpets.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ria kera omotienyi mobe mokorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene. Morue chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi echitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: "'On the first of every month, present to the LORD a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani nerituko ri’Epasaka y’Omonene.
english: "'On the fourteenth day of the first month the LORD's Passover is to be held.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kane morue chieri ikomi, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: "'On the fourth day prepare ten bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Esabato morue chimanwa chimingichi ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Amo nachirochio morue obosie obonuke ebimunu bine bwochoganirie amaguta ’amazeituni, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Morue boigo okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochikire.
english: "'On the Sabbath day, make an offering of two lambs a year old without defect, together with its drink offering and a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere morue chieri chinsae ikomi na ibere, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: "'On the second day prepare twelve young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere orue egoree ensae, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe; na egesasimero gechenwe buna giachenetwe nekeng’wanso ki’eeri eria.
english: "On the second day you are to offer a male goat without defect for a sin offering, and the altar is to be purified as it was purified with the bull.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na kabere morue chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: "'On the seventh day prepare seven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na rimo morue chieri isano na isato, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: "'On the sixth day prepare eight bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: “Ribebe ria irianyi richakere korwa Tamari, rigenderere goikera ase amache a Kadeshi‐Meriba; korwa agwo rigenderere kobwatia akarooche ka Misiri, ritwomere Enyancha Enene. Erio nario rirabe ribebe ria irianyi.
english: "On the south side it will run from Tamar as far as the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi [of Egypt] to the Great Sea. This will be the south boundary.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya irianyi eyerabe nekerengo gie chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), ebiita bitato mbibeo: Egeita gia Simeoni, na egia Isakaru, na egia Sabuloni.
english: "On the south side, which measures 4,500 cubits, will be three gates: the gate of Simeon, the gate of Issachar and the gate of Zebulun.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi oyio o gatano na kabere, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Mobe mokweng’ata na gweitia. Timokora emeremo ende yonsi.
english: "'On the tenth day of this seventh month hold a sacred assembly. You must deny yourselves and do no work.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato morue chieri ikomi nemo, ne chimingichi ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: "'On the third day prepare eleven bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: “Enyancha Enene nero erabe ribebe ria bosongo goikera ase egesoero kia Hamati. Eyio nero erabe ribebe ria bosongo.
english: "On the west side, the Great Sea will be the boundary to a point opposite Lebo Hamath. This will be the west boundary.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya bosongo eyerabe nekerengo gie chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500), ebiita bitato mbibeo: Egeita kia Gadi, na egia Aseri, na ekia Nafutali.
english: "On the west side, which is 4,500 cubits long, will be three gates: the gate of Gad, the gate of Asher and the gate of Naphtali.

ekegusii: “Naende oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bonga buna ekeonga ekiarutetwe ase enyancha ime, kegasangereria chinswe chia kera egesaku.
english: "Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was let down into the lake and caught all kinds of fish.

ekegusii: Erio omonto natoke korwa ase omori bw’omokungu oria, oyio nache arwanie abarwani esegi b’omoruoti o sugusu, asoe ase chiburi chiaye, akore ase abanto buna anchete na kobabua.
english: "One from her family line will arise to take her place. He will attack the forces of the king of the North and enter his fortress; he will fight against them and be victorious.

ekegusii: Emiaka emeke netigarete, inche mbwatie enchera ekogenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao naende.”
english: "Only a few years will pass before I go on the journey of no return.

ekegusii: Bono nigo ngokoboria onkorere ebinto bibere, nario ntebise korwa ase obosio bwao:
english: "Only grant me these two things, O God, and then I will not hide from you:

ekegusii: Omoroberio oyo obekirwe ase ebinto ebio oise korusigwa asende, ororeria rw’Abaisraeli nigo rorasire tirobao, tibakoba egesaku ase obosio bwane kogenderera botambe.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Only if these decrees vanish from my sight," declares the LORD, "will the descendants of Israel ever cease to be a nation before me."

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Igora ekebao kerochie moocha!” Yehoasi agakeigora. Erio Elisha akamotebia, “Rasa!” Nere akarasa. Elisha agakwana, “Omogwe bw’obobui bw’Omonene. Omogwe bw’obobui igoro y’Abasiiria. Aye norwanie Abasiiria agwo Afeki goika obasirie kegima.”
english: "Open the east window," he said, and he opened it. "Shoot!" Elisha said, and he shot. "The LORD's arrow of victory, the arrow of victory over Aram!" Elisha declared. "You will completely destroy the Arameans at Aphek."

ekegusii: Gose naki omonto aranyare gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani omonto oria omonyene chinguru? Erio nyuma anyare gosakora enyomba yaye.
english: "Or again, how can anyone enter a strong man's house and carry off his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can rob his house.

ekegusii: “Omonto karabe omwango gotiana ase ogokora amabe gose amaya, ogotiana konde gwonsi abanto bakoba abaango gotiana batari korengereria, na ayio abe abisekanete ase omonto oyio, ekero arayamanye, nabe nokomocha ase amang’ana ayio.
english: "'Or if a person thoughtlessly takes an oath to do anything, whether good or evil-- in any matter one might carelessly swear about-- even though he is unaware of it, in any case when he learns of it he will be guilty.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogokuna kende gionsi getachenegeti, korabe omobere okwete bw’eng’iti y’orosana etachenegeti, gose oyo bw’eng’iti etugire etachenegeti, gose oyo bw’akang’iti agake gatechenegeti, nonya amang’ana ayio abisekanete, ere nabe oyotachenegeti, abarerwe obobe bwaye.
english: "'Or if a person touches anything ceremonially unclean-- whether the carcasses of unclean wild animals or of unclean livestock or of unclean creatures that move along the ground-- even though he is unaware of it, he has become unclean and is guilty.

ekegusii: “Omonto aise gokuna egento kende gionsi kia mwanyabanto getachenegeti, go korabe ogotacheneka gwa kende gionsi keramokore abe oyotachenegeti, nonya amang’ana ayio abisekanete asare, ekero arayamanye, nabe nokomocha.
english: "'Or if he touches human uncleanness-- anything that would make him unclean-- even though he is unaware of it, when he learns of it he will be guilty.

ekegusii: “Gose inse gotoma omoro ase ense na ntebe: Omoro tiga oetere ense eye, naende insirie kegima mwanyabanto ne ching’iti,
english: "Or if I bring a sword against that country and say, 'Let the sword pass throughout the land,' and I kill its men and their animals,

ekegusii: “Gose inse gotoma oborwaire bogoita ase ense eyio, ing’umore endamwamu yane egere ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, ng’ite mwanyabanto ne ching’iti aroro,
english: "Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out my wrath upon it through bloodshed, killing its men and their animals,

ekegusii: “Gose inse korenta ching’iti chi’orosana chintindi chichiche ase ense eyio chiyesarie ebe bosa, erinde monto onde tabaisa goeta ase ense eyio ase engencho ye ching’iti echio,
english: "Or if I send wild beasts through that country and they leave it childless and it becomes desolate so that no one can pass through it because of the beasts,

ekegusii: Gose moruoti ki, gakogenda korwana nomoruoti onde, otaikaranse ritang’ani na korengereria onye ere amo nabanto chilifu ikomi nanyare koumerana nere oyokomochera nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere?
english: "Or suppose a king is about to go to war against another king. Will he not first sit down and consider whether he is able with ten thousand men to oppose the one coming against him with twenty thousand?

ekegusii: "Or suppose a woman has ten silver coins and loses one. Does she not light a lamp, sweep the house and search carefully until she finds it?
english: “Gose mokungu ki ore ne chisiringi ikomi, na eyemo esire, tagotongia etaya na kwabusa enyomba, arigie nomokia goika ayenyore?

ekegusii: gose, “Ning’o oranyare kogenda aike inse ase eora y’abakure?” (Engencho yaye nokorenta Kristo igoro korwa ase abakure).
english: "or 'Who will descend into the deep?'" (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).

ekegusii: “Tata nigo akwerete agwo ase erooro. Ere tarenge ase egati y’ekeombe keria giasangererekanete amo gekaba mamincha y’Omonene, ase abwo barenge ase ensemo ya Kora, korende ere nigo akwete ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene. Ekero akwete tatigete abana abamura
english: "Our father died in the desert. He was not among Korah's followers, who banded together against the LORD, but he died for his own sin and left no sons.

ekegusii: “Eema y’oborori nigo yarenge amo ne chisokoro chiaito ase erooro, buna Nyasae achigete, ekero atebetie Musa ng’a ayekore buna ekiorokererio keria aroche.
english: "Our forefathers had the tabernacle of the Testimony with them in the desert. It had been made as God directed Moses, according to the pattern he had seen.

ekegusii: Abanto baria bakamoiraneria, “Nigo tore ang’e gokwa onye titogotooria obogima bwaino, komorabe timoorogeti amang’ana aito ase ogotosigaana. Ekero Omonene arabe otoeire ense eye, ntobakorere amaya, buna twarire eira.”
english: "Our lives for your lives!" the men assured her. "If you don't tell what we are doing, we will treat you kindly and faithfully when the LORD gives us the land."

ekegusii: “Ogoitwa nemioro nigo kore isiko, na oborwaire bogoita, na enchara, nigo bire ase omochie ime. Omonto okare isiko y’omochie naitwe nomoro, na oyore ase omochie ime, enchara na oborwaire mbimoite.
english: "Outside is the sword, inside are plague and famine; those in the country will die by the sword, and those in the city will be devoured by famine and plague.

ekegusii: “Naende baare egetambaa kere buru kegima igoro ase egesasimero keroisirie korwa ase etahabu, na bagetube ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche; erio basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria egesasimero keria.
english: "Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth and cover that with hides of sea cows and put its poles in place.

ekegusii: “Igoro ase emesa y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Omonene baare egetambaa kere buru kegima, naende babekeo chinteru, ne chisani ase ubani, amo nebitaabo na ebitoono, ase ebio bagochia koumora okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa. Emegati ekoruegwa botambe ase Omonene ebekweo boigo.
english: "Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and put on it the plates, dishes and bowls, and the jars for drink offerings; the bread that is continually there is to remain on it.

ekegusii: "Pay attention, Job, and listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.
english: “Aye Ayubu, ntegerera, okire‐kiri, inche nkwane.

ekegusii: “Abanto b’ebisaku ebinge nabaetere ase omochie oyo, babe bakoborania: Nase ki Omonene akorire omochie oyo omonene osarekire iga?
english: "People from many nations will pass by this city and will ask one another, 'Why has the LORD done such a thing to this great city?'

ekegusii: “Abanto baigure buna ng’umatete, na onde tari nonya noyomo okondemia. Ababisa baane bonsi baigure igoro y’emechando yane, bagokire ng’a naye gwakorire aya. Renta rituko riria gwatebete ng’a orarente, na barabwo babe buna inche.
english: "People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my distress; they rejoice at what you have done. May you bring the day you have announced so they may become like me.

ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Ekero Farao ararore abwo baitetwe, nigo areremie ase engencho y’emeganda yaye yonsi eyio yaitetwe nemioro.
english: "Pharaoh-- he and all his army-- will see them and he will be consoled for all his hordes that were killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: “Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Haroni omokuani, nere ogera endamwamu yane yatigire Abaisraeli, ekiagera ere aba ne risemi buna inche inde ne risemi ase egati y’abanto aba. Ase ayio tinasiretie bonsi ase risemi riane.
english: "Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, has turned my anger away from the Israelites; for he was as zealous as I am for my honor among them, so that in my zeal I did not put an end to them.

ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Inyimokie, mondute ase enyancha ime; ero netoerere asemore, ekiagera namanyire ng’a ninche nagerire ekembugu‐mbugu kiabacheire.”
english: "Pick me up and throw me into the sea," he replied, "and it will become calm. I know that it is my fault that this great storm has come upon you."

ekegusii: Obeke egesasimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe bosio bw’egesoero ki’Obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.
english: "Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;

ekegusii: “Koranche ototeeme intwe abasomba bao ase engaki y’amatuko ikomi, obe kogotoa chindagera chikwama korwa ase riroba tokoria, na amache tokonywa.
english: "Please test your servants for ten days: Give us nothing but vegetables to eat and water to drink.

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Koranche omonene, otoigwe! Engaki eria entang’ani twachete aiga kogora endagera,
english: "Please, sir," they said, "we came down here the first time to buy food.

ekegusii: “Omonene, Nyasae o Israeli, atogigwe, ekiagera obacheire abanto baye na kobabooria.
english: "Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, because he has come and has redeemed his people.

ekegusii: “Atogigwe Omonene oria oeire abanto baye Abaisraeli obotoereru buna abarierete eira! Nonya ne ring’ana erimo tiriri ritaikeranetigwe ase eira yaye yonsi engiya ariete goetera ase Musa, omosomba oye.
english: "Praise be to the LORD, who has given rest to his people Israel just as he promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises he gave through his servant Moses.

ekegusii: “Roisia ebinyuri, ekiagera ense yaichoirwe nogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, na obotindi bwaichoire ase omochie ime.
english: "Prepare chains, because the land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of violence.

ekegusii: Nigo bagoteba: “Twebeke ang’e korwania Sayoni. Imoka togende toyorwanie mobaso gati! Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera nkoira bore, na emerengari ya mogoroba yamentire koba emetambe.
english: "Prepare for battle against her! Arise, let us attack at noon! But, alas, the daylight is fading, and the shadows of evening grow long.

ekegusii: “Beka chinguba ne ching’aya ang’e, mogende bosio ase esegi.
english: "Prepare your shields, both large and small, and march out for battle!

ekegusii: Omonene, Omoruoti bw’abanto ba Yakobo, nigo agoteba iga: “Renta amang’ana aino, renta oborori bwaino botoenekerie.
english: "Present your case," says the LORD. "Set forth your arguments," says Jacob's King.

ekegusii: “Omokuani tabaisa kogingira ensemo ende y’etukia y’omotwe oye, gose konacha chinderu chiaye mesia, gose gwesaraga omobere.
english: "'Priests must not shave their heads or shave off the edges of their beards or cut their bodies.

ekegusii: “Raria naende, otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Emechie yane neichorigwe nogosesenigwa okonge, na inche Omonene nindemie Sayoni naende, na ninchore Yerusalemu obe oyone naende.”
english: "Proclaim further: This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'My towns will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion and choose Jerusalem.'"

ekegusii: “Beka egetureri monwa mokebugie! Omobisa ngocha are igoro y’enyomba y’Omonene buna ekeongo, ekiagera abanto basaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, na batigire amachiko aane.
english: "Put the trumpet to your lips! An eagle is over the house of the LORD because the people have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamotebia, “Irania omoyio oo o birende aase aye, ekiagera bonsi abakoimokia omoyio o birende inabasire ase omoyio o birende.
english: "Put your sword back in its place," Jesus said to him, "for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.

ekegusii: “Mosorore nyoko, ee, momosorore, ekiagera ere tari omokungu one, na inche tindi omosacha oye. Tiga atige obonyaka borue ase obosio bwaye, na obotomani borue ase egekuba kiaye.
english: "Rebuke your mother, rebuke her, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband. Let her remove the adulterous look from her face and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.

ekegusii: Goka ase rituko riria, na gochenga, ekiagera ekeene eng’eria yaino nenene igoro; naki chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani engencho eyio eyio.
english: "Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For that is how their fathers treated the prophets.

ekegusii: "Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad for her, all you who love her; rejoice greatly with her, all you who mourn over her.
english: “Inwe aba mwanchete Yerusalemu, yogokere na koyochenga! Nainwe mwensi aba mokoyoreera, goka amo noro na gochenga!

ekegusii: “Inyora ring’ana riria Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abachigete ekero abatebetie ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabae obotoereru ase ense eyio arabae momenye.
english: "Remember the command that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you: 'The LORD your God is giving you rest and has granted you this land.'

ekegusii: Bono inyora amang’ana aria gwachigete Musa, omosomba oo, okamotebia: Inwe motabeti abegenwa, goika imbasiarere gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku ebiao.
english: "Remember the instruction you gave your servant Moses, saying, 'If you are unfaithful, I will scatter you among the nations,

ekegusii: “Inwe inyora amachiko a Musa, omosomba one, na emeroberio yonsi namochigete agwo ase egetunwa kia Horebu, orokererie Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: "Remember the law of my servant Moses, the decrees and laws I gave him at Horeb for all Israel.

ekegusii: “Riinyore rituko ri’Esabato, orirende ribe richenu.
english: "Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, inyora amang’ana aya, ekiagera inwe nabasomba baane. Inwe Abaisraeli, tinkobeeba.
english: "Remember these things, O Jacob, for you are my servant, O Israel. I have made you, you are my servant; O Israel, I will not forget you.

ekegusii: "Remember this, fix it in mind, take it to heart, you rebels.
english: “Inwe abasaria, inyora amang’ana ayio, moyarengererie mono.

ekegusii: “Bono Omonene nagosoroire, inyora buna nabeire ngokobwatia ase obwegenwa na ase enkoro yane yonsi, naende buna nakorire ayare amaronge ase obosio bwao.” Erio Hezekia akarera nobororo.
english: "Remember, O LORD, how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

ekegusii: akabora, “Bono Omonene nagosoroire, inyora buna nabeire ngokobwatia ase obwegenwa, na ase enkoro yane yonsi, naende nakorire ayare amaronge ase obosio bwao.” Erio. Hezekia akarera nobororo.
english: "Remember, O LORD, how I have walked before you faithfully and with wholehearted devotion and have done what is good in your eyes." And Hezekiah wept bitterly.

ekegusii: “Irana nka bwoo orarie amang’ana amanene aya Nyasae agokoreire.” Akagenda bwoye, akararia ase omochie omogima amang’ana amanene aya Yeso amokoreire.
english: "Return home and tell how much God has done for you." So the man went away and told all over town how much Jesus had done for him.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire iga: “Inwe abana baane motari abegenwa, ing’iranere, ekiagera ninche Omonene oino. Nindusie oyomo oino korwa ase kera omochie, na babere korwa ase kera eamate, mbarente ase egetunwa gia Sayoni.
english: "Return, faithless people," declares the LORD, "for I am your husband. I will choose you-- one from a town and two from a clan-- and bring you to Zion.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto motari abegenwa, ing’iranere, nainche ningwenie ogotegena kwaino. Inwe nigo mogoteba: “Intwe twakoiraneire, ekiagera naye Omonene, Nyasae oito.
english: "Return, faithless people; I will cure you of backsliding." "Yes, we will come to you, for you are the LORD our God.

ekegusii: Egesaku kia Reuben keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Efraimu korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Reuben will have one portion; it will border the territory of Ephraim from east to west.

ekegusii: “Reuben, aye nomwana one omotangi, aye nokobua kwane, na ogotongora gwe chinguru chiane. Noetanetie abamino ase okobua, nobaetanetie ase chinguru.
english: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, the first sign of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.

ekegusii: Ani! Ekero ekio abanto batato baikire ase enyomba eria namenyete, na barabwo nigo batometwe asende korwa Kaisaria.
english: "Right then three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea stopped at the house where I was staying.

ekegusii: Tata omonyene oboronge, ense tiyakomanyete, korende inche nakomanyete; na aba bamanyire ng’a naye gwantomete.
english: "Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, imoka moore, ekiagera ninkore chingunchara chiaino chibe echi’ebioma, na ebitaago biaino bibe ebi’etaai, erinde moake abanto abange, mobasamunyore.” Ebinto biabo morasakore mobiatanane bibe ebichenu ase Omonene, ne chinibo chiabo chibe echi’Omonene bw’ense engima.
english: "Rise and thresh, O Daughter of Zion, for I will give you horns of iron; I will give you hoofs of bronze and you will break to pieces many nations." You will devote their ill-gotten gains to the LORD, their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.

ekegusii: “Otenene ase omonto omogotu ore ne chimbuche, ase okomosika; omoiroke Nyasae oo. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "'Rise in the presence of the aged, show respect for the elderly and revere your God. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: “Omonyo nomuya, korende omonyo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki orabekwe bwanse?
english: "Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again?

ekegusii: Omonyo nomuya, korende omonyo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki morayobeke bwanse? Mobe nomonyo ime asemore, momenye ase omorembe inwe ase inwe.”
english: "Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with each other."

ekegusii: “Saulo na Yonathani barenge abanchwa baito, barenge gotogokia. Ase obogima na ase amakweri tibaatananetwe. Barabwo nigo barenge abaango kobua chinsoti, nigo barenge ne chinguru kobua chindo.”
english: "Saul and Jonathan-- in life they were loved and gracious, and in death they were not parted. They were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

ekegusii: "Say of your brothers, 'My people,' and of your sisters, 'My loved one.'
english: “Mobaroke abamino abamura Ami, na abamino abasubati Ruhama.

ekegusii: “Aye goika obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, abanto abwo bamenyete ase amaturi mbaitwe nemioro, na abare isiko nintome ching’iti chi’orosana chibarie; abwo bamenyete ase ebitare na ime ase amakuruma, amarwaire amabe nabaite.
english: "Say this to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: As surely as I live, those who are left in the ruins will fall by the sword, those out in the country I will give to the wild animals to be devoured, and those in strongholds and caves will die of a plague.

ekegusii: “Moe Haroni amo nabamura baye ogochika oko igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe: Agwo ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gekonyenyerwa nao agwo eki’ebibe keranyenyerwe, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Ekeng’wanso ekio negechenu mono.
english: "Say to Aaron and his sons: 'These are the regulations for the sin offering: The sin offering is to be slaughtered before the LORD in the place the burnt offering is slaughtered; it is most holy.

ekegusii: “Kwana na Haroni, omotebie ng’a onde bwensi ore ekerema tabaisa goika ang’e kondetera inche, Nyasae oye, okoruegwa kw’endagera. Okwo nogochika koragenderere botambe ase ororeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: "Say to Aaron: 'For the generations to come none of your descendants who has a defect may come near to offer the food of his God.

ekegusii: “Aya naro moratebie Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda: Tobaisa gwancha Nyasae oyio oo osemeretie akong’aine, erinde orengererie ng’a Yerusalemu tokobekwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
english: "Say to Hezekiah king of Judah: Do not let the god you depend on deceive you when he says, 'Jerusalem will not be handed over to the king of Assyria.'

ekegusii: “Tebia Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, otebie n’Abaisraeli bonsi bare ase orogongo rwa Yuda na orwa Benjamin ng’a
english: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah and to all the Israelites in Judah and Benjamin,

ekegusii: rikamotebia, “Tebia Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, otebie nabanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yuda, na aba eya Benjamin, na abanto bande abatigari ng’a:
english: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah, to the whole house of Judah and Benjamin, and to the rest of the people,

ekegusii: “Kwana nomoganda bw’abanto oyotebie: Tigera morue aase aetanaine chiema chia Kora, na Datani, na Abiiramu.”
english: "Say to the assembly, 'Move away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram.'"

ekegusii: “Tebia abanto ba Sayoni, Rigereria, Omoruoti oino okobachera are, nomokanyeku, oriinire etigere, nase emori y’etigere, akamori g’etigere.”
english: "Say to the Daughter of Zion, 'See, your king comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.'"

ekegusii: Naende otebie Abaisraeli ng’a omonto karakwe, onye ere tabwati omwana omomura, omwando bw’omonto oyio omwana oye omoiseke ayoire.
english: "Say to the Israelites, 'If a man dies and leaves no son, turn his inheritance over to his daughter.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli obatebie: Goika morende Chisabato chiane, ekiagera echio nekemanyererio egati yane nainwe ebiaare ase ebiaare, erinde momanye ng’a ninche Omonene oyokobachena.
english: "Say to the Israelites, 'You must observe my Sabbaths. This will be a sign between me and you for the generations to come, so you may know that I am the LORD, who makes you holy.

ekegusii: “Otebie Abaisraeli ng’a omokungu karabe morito na aibore omwana omoisia nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, amatuko ang’ana buna ekero abwate omotienyi abe oyotachenegeti.
english: "Say to the Israelites: 'A woman who becomes pregnant and gives birth to a son will be ceremonially unclean for seven days, just as she is unclean during her monthly period.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Monto onde bwensi oino, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, orarue omwana onde oye ase enyasae Moleki, goika aitwe akwe. Omoganda oino bwonsi omoake amagena.
english: "Say to the Israelites: 'Any Israelite or any alien living in Israel who gives any of his children to Molech must be put to death. The people of the community are to stone him.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a omonto onde bwensi orarue ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, arue korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio gentungetie inche Omonene.
english: "Say to the Israelites: 'Anyone who brings a fellowship offering to the LORD is to bring part of it as his sacrifice to the LORD.

ekegusii: "Say to the Israelites: 'Do not eat any of the fat of cattle, sheep or goats.
english: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a tibabaisa koria ebitinya binde bionsi, ebi’eng’ombe, gose ebi’eng’ondi, gose ebi’embori.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, mobatebie: Ase ching’iti chire ase ense, echi nachio morarie chinyama chiabo:
english: "Say to the Israelites: 'Of all the animals that live on land, these are the ones you may eat:

ekegusii: “Batebie Abaisraeli: Rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi oyio o gatano na kabere nario Rituko Rinene ri’ogochaka Amatuko Amanene ase Omonene. Amatuko ’Ebigutu agenderere ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: "Say to the Israelites: 'On the fifteenth day of the seventh month the LORD's Feast of Tabernacles begins, and it lasts for seven days.

ekegusii: “Batebie Abaisraeli ng’a rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere batimoke, batige emeremo kegima. Rituko erio naribe Rituko Rinene ri’Ekeinyorio, rirarigwe ase okobugigwa kw’ebiroria, babe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima.
english: "Say to the Israelites: 'On the first day of the seventh month you are to have a day of rest, a sacred assembly commemorated with trumpet blasts.

ekegusii: “Tebia Abaisraeli ng’a, ekero omonto omosacha, gose omokungu, arakore ebibe binde bionsi abanto bagokora ase ogotaba abegenwa ase Omonene, na omonto oria orabe omomochi,
english: "Say to the Israelites: 'When a man or woman wrongs another in any way and so is unfaithful to the LORD, that person is guilty

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a monto onde bwensi orakore ebibe mosiabano atancheti, ase amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene nakanete ng’a takorwa, goika abe okobwatia amachiko aya:
english: "Say to the Israelites: 'When anyone sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the LORD's commands--

ekegusii: Ase ayio otebie Abalawi: Ekero morabe mwarure ebinto ebiya mono korwa ase ensemo ya ikomi eria, erio ebinto ebio nigo birabarwe asemore, inwe Abalawi, buna okoruegwa kwaino kw’endagera, na okomitwa kw’edivai, na okw’amaguta.
english: "Say to the Levites: 'When you present the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the product of the threshing floor or the winepress.

ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, okwane nabarabwo, obatebie ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteba: Ekero abanto bakogwa, inee, tibari koimoka naende? Onye omonto oonchokire na otigire enchera, tari koonchoka oirana?
english: "Say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: "'When men fall down, do they not get up? When a man turns away, does he not return?

ekegusii: Bono obairanerie, obatebie: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Okoorokerigwa oko nigo kore igoro y’omogambi o Yerusalemu, amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bare imeo.
english: "Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: This oracle concerns the prince in Jerusalem and the whole house of Israel who are there.'

ekegusii: “Aye otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inee! Omosabibu oria nogenderere gokina buya? Togosimorwa amo nemeri yaye, na amasabibu aye ataborwe, otigwe okwoma? Ee, amato aye onsi nome. Tokogania chinguru chinyinge, gose abanto abange, ase okoyosimora amo nemeri yaye.
english: "Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Will it thrive? Will it not be uprooted and stripped of its fruit so that it withers? All its new growth will wither. It will not take a strong arm or many people to pull it up by the roots.

ekegusii: “Ase igo obatebie ng’a monto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, kararue ekeng’wanso kegosambwa ekegima, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi,
english: "Say to them: 'Any Israelite or any alien living among them who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice

ekegusii: Obatebie ng’a onye omonto onde bwensi ase ororeria rwabo, ekero are oyotachenegeti; aise goika ang’e nebinto ebio Abaisraeli barabe bagwatanana asende inche Omonene, omonto oyio naatananwe korwa ase obosio bwane, tagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "Say to them: 'For the generations to come, if any of your descendants is ceremonially unclean and yet comes near the sacred offerings that the Israelites consecrate to the LORD, that person must be cut off from my presence. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Aye, kwana nabarabwo, obatebie: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Kera ekeguru nageichorigwe nedivai. Barabwo nigo barakoiranerie ng’a mbamanyete buya kegima ng’a kera ekeguru nigo kegoichorigwa edivai.
english: "Say to them: 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Every wineskin should be filled with wine.' And if they say to you, 'Don't we know that every wineskin should be filled with wine?'

ekegusii: “Boria egesaku eke getari koigwera: Timomanyeti engencho y’amang’ana aya? Batebie: Rora, omoruoti o Babeli nachete Yerusalemu, akaira omoruoti na abagambi b’aroro goika Babeli.
english: "Say to this rebellious house, 'Do you not know what these things mean?' Say to them: 'The king of Babylon went to Jerusalem and carried off her king and her nobles, bringing them back with him to Babylon.

ekegusii: Rora, abagambi b’Abaisraeli bamenyete ime yao, kera oyomo nigo asemeretie chinguru chiaye omonyene ase ogoitera amanyinga.
english: "'See how each of the princes of Israel who are in you uses his power to shed blood.

ekegusii: “Rora, chiburi chi’ogwekengera chiaagachirwe ase chinsemo chionsi chi’omochie, erinde omochie oirwe. Ase engencho y’esegi, na enchara, na oborwaire, Abakalidayo abwo nabanyare koyoira. Omonene, amang’ana gwakwanete aikeranire, na bono kwayarorire.
english: "See how the siege ramps are built up to take the city. Because of the sword, famine and plague, the city will be handed over to the Babylonians who are attacking it. What you said has happened, as you now see.

ekegusii: “Rora bono, inche ninche bweka Nyasae, onde tari otatiga inche bweka. Ninche ngoita, naende nairania obogima, ninche ngoaka, naende nagwenia. Onde tari oranyare kwerwanerera ekonye korwa ase okoboko kwane.
english: "See now that I myself am He! There is no god besides me. I put to death and I bring to life, I have wounded and I will heal, and no one can deliver out of my hand.

ekegusii: “Timotiga abanto be chiamate chia Kohati basirigwe korwa ase Abalawi.
english: "See that the Kohathite tribal clans are not cut off from the Levites.

ekegusii: “Rigereria, timobaisa gochaya oyomo bw’aba abake; naki nabatebirie inwe, nonya nabamalaika babo igoro tibagotiga korora obosio bwa Tata one ore igoro. [
english: "See that you do not look down on one of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of my Father in heaven.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Rigereria, totebia monto onde bwensi amang’ana aya; korende genda bweorokie ase omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso egiachigetwe na Musa ase ogosibeka kwao, erinde kebe kirori ase abanto.”
english: "See that you don't tell this to anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them."

ekegusii: Agatebia abanto bonsi, “Rigena eri nigo rirabe kirori asetore, riaigure amang’ana onsi aya Omonene akwana naintwe. Ase igo riabeire kirori igoro yaino, erinde mobe abegenwa ase Nyasae oino.”
english: "See!" he said to all the people. "This stone will be a witness against us. It has heard all the words the LORD has said to us. It will be a witness against you if you are untrue to your God."

ekegusii: Rora, oyo okweimokereria igoro, omoyo oye tori omoronge, korende omonyene oboronge nabe moyo goetera ase okwegena kwaye.
english: "See, he is puffed up; his desires are not upright-- but the righteous will live by his faith--

ekegusii: “Naende inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, natebire: Aye Babeli ore omoenenu, igwa, inche nabeire mamincha yao; rituko riao riaikire, engaki eye ngokoa egesusuro.
english: "See, I am against you, O arrogant one," declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty, "for your day has come, the time for you to be punished.

ekegusii: “Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane na gokorenda ase enchera, agoikie aase aria nakoroiseirie.
english: "See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.

ekegusii: "See, I have chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,
english: “Rora, nachorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri, bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

ekegusii: “Rora, nimbakore inwe mobe egekorero gi’okoora, kere ekiya na kere namaara amoge; inwe moore ebitunwa, mobisamunyore, imokore ebigoro bibe buna omoiriro.
english: "See, I will make you into a threshing sledge, new and sharp, with many teeth. You will thresh the mountains and crush them, and reduce the hills to chaff.

ekegusii: “Rora, ningokore obe omoke ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, obe kogochaywa mono.
english: "See, I will make you small among the nations; you will be utterly despised.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, nintome omotomwa one andoiserie enchera, na Omonene oyio mokorigia nache mobosokano ase Hekalu yaye; nere omotomwa bw’okobwatana kw’ogotianania oyio moganetie. Ee, ngocha are.”
english: "See, I will send my messenger, who will prepare the way before me. Then suddenly the Lord you are seeking will come to his temple; the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, will come," says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Rora nkobatomera nde ching’iti chingenda inse chire nobosongo; amarubi atatangwe ase okoyaroga, nachirochio nachibarome.”
english: "See, I will send venomous snakes among you, vipers that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Rora, nimbatomere Elija omobani atang’anere rituko riria rinene ri’Omonene ri’okoondokia ritaracha.
english: "See, I will send you the prophet Elijah before that great and dreadful day of the LORD comes.

ekegusii: "See, it is I who created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame and forges a weapon fit for its work. And it is I who have created the destroyer to work havoc;
english: “Naama! Natongire omoturi bw’ebioma, oyio ogoutera omorero bw’amakara na aroisie ebirwanero buna bigwenerete koba. Boigo natongire omosaria bw’okobisaria.

ekegusii: Rora, amang’ana aya nigo arikire ase obosio bwane, agoteba: “Inche tingokira, goika mbaakane, ee, goika mbaakane ogokora kwabo kobe ase ebikuba biabo.
english: "See, it stands written before me: I will not keep silent but will pay back in full; I will pay it back into their laps--

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, rigereria buna inde ase emechando, omoyo one oonchokanire, na enkoro yane yaonchoranirwe, ekiagera nabeire oyo otari omoigweri. Abana baane baitirwe nemioro ase chinchera, na amakweri abeire ase enka yane,
english: "See, O LORD, how distressed I am! I am in torment within, and in my heart I am disturbed, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is only death.

ekegusii: Naende ntomere emecharake, na emetarakwa, na emete ekorokwa alugumu korwa Lebanoni, ekiagera nimanyete ng’a abasomba bao mbamanyete kogecha emete agwo Lebanoni. Na abasomba baane mbabe bagokora emeremo amo nabao,
english: "Send me also cedar, pine and algum logs from Lebanon, for I know that your men are skilled in cutting timber there. My men will work with yours

ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, ntomere omonto omong’aini omanyete mono gokora emeremo ase chitahabu, ne chitaai, na ebioma, na koroisia ebitambaa bire nebieni bimonyinga, na ebibariri, na ebire buru, naende akore emeremo y’okomang’a. Ere abe ogokora emeremo amo nabakori b’emeremo eyio baria bare amo nainche aiga ase ense ya Yuda, na ase Yerusalemu, abwo Daudi tata abegete.
english: "Send me, therefore, a man skilled to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, and in purple, crimson and blue yarn, and experienced in the art of engraving, to work in Judah and Jerusalem with my skilled craftsmen, whom my father David provided.

ekegusii: “Chora omotang’ani oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku ase ebisaku bionsi ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli, erio obatome bagende koroota ense ya Kanani, ense eria ngochia koa Abaisraeli.”
english: "Send some men to explore the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each ancestral tribe send one of its leaders."

ekegusii: “Toma amang’ana gochia ase abanto bonsi bare ase obosomba, obatebie: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro ya Semaya Omonehelamu: Ekiagera Semaya obabaneire ntamotometi, ere ogerire inwe kwegena oborimo.
english: "Send this message to all the exiles: 'This is what the LORD says about Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, even though I did not send him, and has led you to believe a lie,

ekegusii: “Tigera, morue ase abanto b’omoganda oyo, erinde mbasirie ara rimo.”
english: "Separate yourselves from this assembly so I can put an end to them at once."

ekegusii: “Naende Omonene agateba: Imoka, mochake orogendo rwaino, mwamboke orooche rw’Arinoni. Naama! Nabekire ase amaboko aino Sihoni Omoamori, omoruoti o Hesiboni, amo nense yaye. Ase igo, mochake komorwania esegi, moire ense yaye.
english: "Set out now and cross the Arnon Gorge. See, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his country. Begin to take possession of it and engage him in battle.

ekegusii: “Ebekere ebimanyererio ase enchera yao, beka ekiorokererio kegokoraa ase ogoetera. Rengereria mono igoro y’enchera enene, enchera eyio gwaeterete. Irana inwe Abaisraeli abamore buna omoiseke omwekungi, irana ase emechie yaino.
english: "Set up road signs; put up guideposts. Take note of the highway, the road that you take. Return, O Virgin Israel, return to your towns.

ekegusii: Otenenie Obomenyo obwo buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.
english: "Set up the tabernacle according to the plan shown you on the mountain.

ekegusii: “Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, otenenie Obomenyo, Eema eria y’Omosangererekano.
english: "Set up the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the first month.

ekegusii: Bwatana nomogosoeri oo bwango, ekero more nere inchera gochia ase ekegambero, erinde omogosoeri oo tabaisa gokobeka ase okoboko kw’omogambi, na omogambi akobeke ase omorendi bw’echela, na aye nobekwe ase echela.
english: "Settle matters quickly with your adversary who is taking you to court. Do it while you are still with him on the way, or he may hand you over to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and you may be thrown into prison.

ekegusii: “Chichuma emerongo etano na ebere nachio chiachikirwe ase abanto bao, na ase omochie oo omochenu, gokoora ogosaria na gosiria ebibe, na gokora okobwatanigwa ase engencho y’obobe, naende korenta oboronge bwa kare na kare na kobeka okorora koria na obobani boria ekemanyererio, boigo goaka Aase Aachenu Mono amaguta na koachena.
english: "Seventy 'sevens' are decreed for your people and your holy city to finish transgression, to put an end to sin, to atone for wickedness, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy and to anoint the most holy.

ekegusii: “Tieria chinsara! Imokia chinguba! Omonene oseegetire emeika y’abaruoti b’Abamedi, ekiagera nigo aroberetie gosiria Babeli. Ekio negesiomba Omonene akoruseria Hekalu yaye.
english: "Sharpen the arrows, take up the shields! The LORD has stirred up the kings of the Medes, because his purpose is to destroy Babylon. The LORD will take vengeance, vengeance for his temple.

ekegusii: Ere orusia enyongo yaye bwango korwa ase amareko aye, oyebeka inse, ontebia: Kanywe, ne chingamia chiao ninchinyoisie boigo. Erio ong’a, nanywa, oa ne chingamia, nachirochio chianywa.
english: "She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, 'Drink, and I'll water your camels too.' So I drank, and she watered the camels also.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, goka na gochenga! Naama! Ngocha inde komenya ase egati yaino.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Shout and be glad, O Daughter of Zion. For I am coming, and I will live among you," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Aka eriogi rinene, tobaisa gokira, aka eriogi buna eri’egetureri! Tebia abanto baane ogosaria kwabo, batebie abwo bare ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo ebibe biabo.
english: "Shout it aloud, do not hold back. Raise your voice like a trumpet. Declare to my people their rebellion and to the house of Jacob their sins.

ekegusii: "Show me a denarius. Whose portrait and inscription are on it?"
english: “Inyorokia ebesa! Ekieni eke na amariko aya nebiang’o?” Bakabora, “Nebia Kaisari.”

ekegusii: Omonene, imanyie omoerio bw’amatuko aane, na ekerengo ki’amatuko aane naki keng’ana, erinde imanye ng’a obogima bwane nobweng’e.
english: "Show me, O LORD, my life's end and the number of my days; let me know how fleeting is my life.

ekegusii: "Simeon and Levi are brothers-- their swords are weapons of violence.
english: “Simeoni na Lawi naba ng’ina omo, ebirwanero biabo nebi’obotindi.

ekegusii: Egesaku gia Simeoni keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Benjamin, korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Simeon will have one portion; it will border the territory of Benjamin from east to west.

ekegusii: Akabora, “Simion, Simion, rora Saitani nabarigetie abaire anyare kobasoonga buna engano,
english: "Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift you as wheat.

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, nigo mwagendererete gokora ebibe korwa ase amatuko aria mwarenge Gibea, na goika bono nigo mogendererete gokora bo. Inee! Esegi y’okorusia egesiomba igoro y’abakori amabe tiyababuete agwo Gibea?
english: "Since the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, O Israel, and there you have remained. Did not war overtake the evildoers in Gibeah?

ekegusii: “Aye ore omogomba otaiborete, tera; aye otana kobina ase okoibora, aka eriogi rinene ri’ogotera kw’omochengo! Omonene otebire ng’a abana b’oyo otigetwe bosa nigo bare abange kobua ab’oyo obwate omosacha. Nabo Omonene agoteba.”
english: "Sing, O barren woman, you who never bore a child; burst into song, shout for joy, you who were never in labor; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband," says the LORD.

ekegusii: “Omonene, totegerere! Aye nigo ore omonto omonene o Nyasae ase egati yaito. Tindeka omokungu oo ase embeera ende yonsi engiya orachore. Onde tari ase egati yaito orakorine embeera yaye gose agotange totindeka omokungu oo.”
english: "Sir, listen to us. You are a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the choicest of our tombs. None of us will refuse you his tomb for burying your dead."

ekegusii: Akamoiraneria: Omonene, yotige omwaka oyo naende, goika nyoburugere na koyobekera obwoyo.
english: "'Sir,' the man replied, 'leave it alone for one more year, and I'll dig around it and fertilize it.

ekegusii: Na omosomba oria akabora: Omonene, ayio gwachika aikire gokoreka, ko nonya mbono ribaga ndireo.
english: "'Sir,' the servant said, 'what you ordered has been done, but there is still room.'

ekegusii: (Bakamotebia: Omonene, oyo nare nebirengo ikomi).
english: "'Sir,' they said, 'he already has ten!'

ekegusii: Omorwaire oria akamoiraneria, “Omonene, tindi nomonto okombeka ase ritibo, ekero amache agoturubanigwa; korende ekero ngochicha inche, omonto onde asoa ritang’ani asende.”
english: "Sir," the invalid replied, "I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am trying to get in, someone else goes down ahead of me."

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Omonene, narorire ng’a nomobani ore.
english: "Sir," the woman said, "I can see that you are a prophet.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Omonene, tori negento gi’okobuuchera, na ensoko yachiire inse mono; ng’ai kwanyorire amache aya are moyo?
english: "Sir," the woman said, "you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?

ekegusii: Nabo bakamotebia, “Omonene, amatuko onsi otoe omogati oyio.”
english: "Sir," they said, "from now on give us this bread."

ekegusii: bakabora, “Omonene, twainyoire ng’a omonyaborimo oria natebete ekero arenge moyo: Nyuma ase amatuko atato nimboke.
english: "Sir," they said, "we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, 'After three days I will rise again.'

ekegusii: “Aye Babeli, omochie bw’Abakalidayo, ikaransa ase omosunte okire‐kiri, tokorokwa eting’ana y’amaruoti naende.
english: "Sit in silence, go into darkness, Daughter of the Babylonians; no more will you be called queen of kingdoms.

ekegusii: “Ase amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere otimoke, na eng’ombe yao na etigere yao nachirochio chitimoke; naboigo nomosomba oo omomura oiboreire bwoo, na omomenyi oo, nabarabwo batimoke.”
english: "Six days do your work, but on the seventh day do not work, so that your ox and your donkey may rest and the slave born in your household, and the alien as well, may be refreshed.

ekegusii: “Okore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere otimoke, nonya nengaki y’okorema na eye rigesa.
english: "Six days you shall labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even during the plowing season and harvest you must rest.

ekegusii: Moe Abalawi emechie etano nomo ey’obotamero, erinde ekero omonto aitire omonto onde mosiabano, anyare gotamerao, naende mobae emechie ende emeao emerongo ene na ebere.
english: "Six of the towns you give the Levites will be cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone may flee. In addition, give them forty-two other towns.

ekegusii: Erio Saitani akairaneria Omonene, akamotebia, “Risankwa ase risankwa; omonto nigo ararue gento kende gionsi abwate ase ogotooria obogima bwaye.
english: "Skin for skin!" Satan replied. "A man will give all he has for his own life.

ekegusii: “Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, ekero mwakoorire rigesa ri’emegondo yaino, namorende Amatuko Amanene atano na abere ase Omonene. Rituko rie ritang’ani naribe rituko ri’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka kegima, naboigo nase rituko ria gatano na gatato.
english: "'So beginning with the fifteenth day of the seventh month, after you have gathered the crops of the land, celebrate the festival to the LORD for seven days; the first day is a day of rest, and the eighth day also is a day of rest.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio ching’iti chi’orosana, amo ne chinyang’au, ne chisagero nachimenye ase ense eyio. Abanto tibagocha komenyao nonya ng’ake, korwa ekiaare goika ekiaare kogenderera botambe.
english: "So desert creatures and hyenas will live there, and there the owl will dwell. It will never again be inhabited or lived in from generation to generation.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, timoiroka baria, ekiagera ing’ana rinde tiriri rimumekeirie ritache koorokigwa, gose eribisekanete ritache komanyekana.
english: "So do not be afraid of them. There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, timoiroka, inwe Abaisraeli, timoondoka, ekiagera naama, nimbatoorie korwa ase ense y’obosomba. Abanto ba Yakobo mbairane banyore omorembe na obotoereru; monto onde tari oraboboyie”
english: "'So do not fear, O Jacob my servant; do not be dismayed, O Israel,' declares the LORD. 'I will surely save you out of a distant place, your descendants from the land of their exile. Jacob will again have peace and security, and no one will make him afraid.

ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, tobaisa gosabera abanto aba, gose korera ase engencho y’abwo. Tobaisa gocha gonsorora ase engencho y’abwo, ekiagera tingokoigwa.
english: "So do not pray for this people nor offer any plea or petition for them; do not plead with me, for I will not listen to you.

ekegusii: Na bono aye, chika abanto bangechere emete emecharake ya Lebanoni. Abasomba baane mbabwatane nabasomba bao ase emeremo eyio, na inche ning’akane abasomba bao eng’eria ende yonsi orabeke. Nomanyete ng’a abanto baane tibamanyeti kogecha emete buna abanto ba Sidoni.”
english: "So give orders that cedars of Lebanon be cut for me. My men will work with yours, and I will pay you for your men whatever wages you set. You know that we have no one so skilled in felling timber as the Sidonians."

ekegusii: Erio akarangeria abasira b’omonene oye, oyomo ase oyomo, akaboria oyo bwe ritang’ani: Ninki oriete ki’omonene one?
english: "So he called in each one of his master's debtors. He asked the first, 'How much do you owe my master?'

ekegusii: Erio akarua ase ense y’Abakalidayo, akamenya Harani. Nyuma ise gakure, Nyasae akamong’anyia korwa aroro goika ense eye inwe momenyete bono.
english: "So he left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After the death of his father, God sent him to this land where you are now living.

ekegusii: “Nase ki rende mokondemia namang’ana a bosa? Ayatigaire ase amairanerio aino nigo are oborimo bwoka.”
english: "So how can you console me with your nonsense? Nothing is left of your answers but falsehood!"

ekegusii: Ase ayio ogosemia kwane noko: Orente Abaisraeli bonsi amo korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba babe abange buna omokenye ore engegu y’enyancha; naye omonyene ogende amo nabarabwo ase esegi.
english: "So I advise you: Let all Israel, from Dan to Beersheba-- as numerous as the sand on the seashore-- be gathered to you, with you yourself leading them into battle.

ekegusii: Inwe mwangire kobwatia chinchera chiane; nigo mogwanchereria abanto ekero mokworokereria amachiko. Ase ayio nimbatige mochaywe na gokeeigwa ase amasio ’abanto bonsi.”
english: "So I have caused you to be despised and humiliated before all the people, because you have not followed my ways but have shown partiality in matters of the law."

ekegusii: "So I say to you: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.
english: Na inche nkobatebia nde inwe: Saba, namoegwe; rigia, namonyore; tura, namoigorerwe.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkamoika ang’e, nkamoita, ekiagrea nigo namanyete ng’a tare koba moyo nyuma kagure. Nkamorusia egutwa y’obogambi yare motwe oye na egetange kiarenge koboko kwaye, narentire ebinto ebio aa asore, aye omonene one.”
english: "So I stood over him and killed him, because I knew that after he had fallen he could not survive. And I took the crown that was on his head and the band on his arm and have brought them here to my lord."

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Nimbaike ang’e ase okonacha ekina. Nimbe kirori omwango igoro y’abarogi na abatomani, na abagotiana oborimo, na abagokorera abarikwa emeremo bobe ase okobarina ching’eria chiabo, na abagokorera ababoraka ne chintakana bobe, na abakoonchorana oboronge bw’abamenyi, korende tibanyirogeti.
english: "So I will come near to you for judgment. I will be quick to testify against sorcerers, adulterers and perjurers, against those who defraud laborers of their wages, who oppress the widows and the fatherless, and deprive aliens of justice, but do not fear me," says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Ninchene Eema y’Omosangererekano amo negesasimero; naboigo ninchene Haroni amo nabamura baye babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
english: "So I will consecrate the Tent of Meeting and the altar and will consecrate Aaron and his sons to serve me as priests.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ninsirie obonyaka boria korwa ase ense yaino, erinde abakungu bande beorokererie tibabaisa gokora obonyaka buna obwo.
english: "So I will put an end to lewdness in the land, that all women may take warning and not imitate you.

ekegusii: Gaki, kobarabatebie: Rora, oyo ore ase erooro, timosoka isiko; kobarabatebie: Oyo ore ebinunchi bia bobisi, timwancha.
english: "So if anyone tells you, 'There he is, out in the desert,' do not go out; or, 'Here he is, in the inner rooms,' do not believe it.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, inwe abanto abamore nokomanya, inyigwa! Nyasae tabaisa gokagerwa ng’a nakore amabe. Inee! Ere Omonguru nakore ebibe?
english: "So listen to me, you men of understanding. Far be it from God to do evil, from the Almighty to do wrong.

ekegusii: Omonto nigo agosira oruao buna egento ekegundo, na buna eanga yarirwe nebigwankwa.”
english: "So man wastes away like something rotten, like a garment eaten by moths.

ekegusii: “Omonene, tiga ababisa bao bonsi basire buna igo, korende baria bagwanchete babe buna erioba rire ekero rigosoka ne chinguru.” Na ense eria ekaba nobotoereru ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
english: "So may all your enemies perish, O LORD! But may they who love you be like the sun when it rises in its strength." Then the land had peace forty years.

ekegusii: “Ase igo enkoro yane nigo ekobareera Abamoabu na abanto ba Kireresi, ase eriogi buna eri’ekeroria. Obonda benyorerete bwasirigwe.
english: "So my heart laments for Moab like a flute; it laments like a flute for the men of Kir Hareseth. The wealth they acquired is gone.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio bono aiga ase amasio ’Abaisraeli bonsi bare omosangererekano bw’Omonene, na ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito oyotoigwete, morende mono amachiko onsi ay’Omonene, Nyasae onio, na koyabwatia, erio nario moramenye ase ense eye engiya na koyetigera abana baino, ebe omwando obo kogenderera botambe nyuma yaino.
english: "So now I charge you in the sight of all Israel and of the assembly of the LORD, and in the hearing of our God: Be careful to follow all the commands of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land and pass it on as an inheritance to your descendants forever.

ekegusii: boigo ase amatuko aya narobeirie gokora amaya ase abanto ba Yerusalemu na ase Abayuda. Ase ayio timoiroka!
english: "so now I have determined to do good again to Jerusalem and Judah. Do not be afraid.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, rora bono, Omonene obekire omoika bw’obong’ainereria ase omonwa bw’ababani abwo bonsi, ekiagera ochikire ng’a nonyore egesio ekebe.”
english: "So now the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of all these prophets of yours. The LORD has decreed disaster for you."

ekegusii: “Ase ayio rora bono, Omonene obaeire omoika bw’obong’ainereria ase emenwa y’ababani aba bao bonsi, ekiagera ochikire ng’a nonyore egesio ekebe.”
english: "So now the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of these prophets of yours. The LORD has decreed disaster for you."

ekegusii: “Na bono kondagende inka ase tata, omosomba oo, ntaireti omosae oyo amo naintwe, oyo tata nigo amwanchete mono, takorora buya.
english: "So now, if the boy is not with us when I go back to your servant my father and if my father, whose life is closely bound up with the boy's life,

ekegusii: "So the last will be first, and the first will be last."
english: Naboigo abanyuma inababe abe ritang’ani, na abe ritang’ani inababe abanyuma.”

ekegusii: Ase igo, tari inwe mwantomete gocha aa, korende Nyasae omonyene. Nere ombegete imbe ise Farao, na omonene ase enka yaye yonsi, na omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.
english: "So then, it was not you who sent me here, but God. He made me father to Pharaoh, lord of his entire household and ruler of all Egypt.

ekegusii: “Aye omoruoti Agripa! Ase ayio tinare kwanga koigwera okorora koria kwarwete igoro,
english: "So then, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the vision from heaven.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bana oake chinkobi. Tiga omoyio oyio ogochia goita omentwe chinguru ara kabere, nonya ng’ara gatato; oyio nomoyio bw’ogoita bw’oyio omonene, na omoyio oyio obaetananire ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: "So then, son of man, prophesy and strike your hands together. Let the sword strike twice, even three times. It is a sword for slaughter-- a sword for great slaughter, closing in on them from every side.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene otebire ng’a amatuko ngocha are, ekero abanto batakwane: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyio orusetie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: "So then, the days are coming," declares the LORD, "when people will no longer say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of Egypt,'

ekegusii: “Naboigo bararangerie erieta riane ribe igoro y’Abaisraeli ase okobasesenia, erio inche omonyene nimbasesenie.”
english: "So they will put my name on the Israelites, and I will bless them."

ekegusii: “Gaki gokorua ebiegwa, tobugia engoma, buna baria abang’ainereria bagokora ase chisinagogi na ase chinchera chinene chi’emechie, erinde batogigwe nabanto. Nekeene nabatebirie ng’a banyorire eng’eria yabo.
english: "So when you give to the needy, do not announce it with trumpets, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men. I tell you the truth, they have received their reward in full.

ekegusii: “Gaki, naboigo kamogocha korora okogechia kw’ogosaria gwatebetwe nomobani Danieli, kogotenena aase aachenu (oyogosoma amanye),
english: "So when you see standing in the holy place 'the abomination that causes desolation,' spoken of through the prophet Daniel-- let the reader understand--

ekegusii: “Inwe namobe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae oino.”
english: "'So you will be my people, and I will be your God.'"

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, omochie o Turo ogokeire ogosarigwa kwa Yerusalemu na goteba: Ahaa! Ahaa! Egeita ki’abanto giatagoirwe, kianyigokeire. Bono inche ninyetenenkie, ekiagera Yerusalemu osarekire.
english: "Son of man, because Tyre has said of Jerusalem, 'Aha! The gate to the nations is broken, and its doors have swung open to me; now that she lies in ruins I will prosper,'

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, manyia Yerusalemu okogechia kwaye.
english: "Son of man, confront Jerusalem with her detestable practices

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, tebia Abaisraeli amang’ana ayio igoro y’enyomba eyio, erinde basookigwe ase engencho y’amabe abo. Tiga barenge oboagacho obwo obuya.
english: "Son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their sins. Let them consider the plan,

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, ekeene, Abaisraeli abwo batari koigwera mbakoborie ng’a ninki ekio ogokora.
english: "Son of man, did not that rebellious house of Israel ask you, 'What are you doing?'

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, Inee, naki omote bw’omosabibu nobuete emete ende yonsi, ase ogotogigwa, gose orosagia rw’omosabibu rore ase egati y’emete ende ere rinani?
english: "Son of man, how is the wood of a vine better than that of a branch on any of the trees in the forest?

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, inche nabunete okoboko gwa Farao, omoruoti o Misiri; na rora, tikwana koboerwa ebitete kogwene, erinde kobe ne chinguru kobwate omoro naende.
english: "Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt. It has not been bound up for healing or put in a splint so as to become strong enough to hold a sword.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, nakobekire obe omorendi bw’Abaisraeli. Ekero kende gionsi oraigwe ring’ana rikorwa ase omonwa one, aye obatebie ring’ana erio riane ri’okobakurera.
english: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye mwanyabanto, nakobekire obe omorendi bw’Abaisraeli. Kero kende gionsi oraigwe ring’ana rikorwa ase omonwa one, obakurere ribaga riane.
english: "Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel; so hear the word I speak and give them warning from me.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, onye ense egokora ebibe asende ase ogokora aya atari ay’obwegenwa, nindambore okoboko kwane igoro yaye, ninsirie endagera nyerentere enchara, naende ng’ite mwanyabanto ne ching’iti,
english: "Son of man, if a country sins against me by being unfaithful and I stretch out my hand against it to cut off its food supply and send famine upon it and kill its men and their animals,

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, eroiserie chinchera ibere chikworokia ase omoro bw’omoruoti o Babeli oraetere. Echio ibere nigo chirarwe ase ense eyemo. Naende otenenie ekemanyererio ase amatabekania ’omochie.
english: "Son of man, mark out two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to take, both starting from the same country. Make a signpost where the road branches off to the city.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, agatiga abarwani baye b’esegi bagokora emeremo agwo ase omochie o Turo. Kera omotwe ogasunyoka etukia, na kera rireko rikaniaroka. Korende nonya naboigo, ere na abarwani baye b’esegi, tibaakaneretwe ng’eria ende yonsi ase ogokorera Turo emeremo.
english: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon drove his army in a hard campaign against Tyre; every head was rubbed bare and every shoulder made raw. Yet he and his army got no reward from the campaign he led against Tyre.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bana igoro ya Gogi, omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye Gogi, rora, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, aye omogambi omonene bw’ense ya Rosi, na eya Meseki, na eya Tubali.
english: "Son of man, prophesy against Gog and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

ekegusii: “Aye mwayabanto, bana mamincha y’ababani b’Abaisraeli, abwo bakobana amang’ana akorwa ase ebirengererio biabo abanyene, obatebie: Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
english: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel who are now prophesying. Say to those who prophesy out of their own imagination: 'Hear the word of the LORD!

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bana, otebie abarisia b’Abaisraeli ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae akobatebia: Obobe nobwaino, inwe abarisia b’Abaisraeli, ekiagera mwabeire mokwerageria inwe mweka abanyene! Inee! Tegwenereti abarisia barisie ching’ondi?
english: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy and say to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the shepherds of Israel who only take care of themselves! Should not shepherds take care of the flock?

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bana otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteba: Otebe iga: “Omoyio otierigwe, ee, otierigwe na gosenigwa;
english: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'This is what the Lord says: "'A sword, a sword, sharpened and polished--

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bana otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Eumie, morere:” “Obee! Naki rituko eri rire?”
english: "Son of man, prophesy and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Wail and say, "Alas for that day!"

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bana otebie ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli: Inwe ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
english: "Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say, 'O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rika erieta rie rituko ria rero, ekiagera rituko eri nario omoruoti o Babeli achire korwania Yerusalemu.
english: "Son of man, record this date, this very date, because the king of Babylon has laid siege to Jerusalem this very day.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, kwana na Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, amo nomoganda oye, oborie:” “Ning’o orareng’anigwe naye ase obonene bwao?
english: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his hordes: "'Who can be compared with you in majesty?

ekegusii: “Ase ayio aye mwanyabanto, inyoria Abaisraeli aya bagokwana, bateba: Ogosaria gwaito, na ebibe biaito biatoritoeire, na ebio bigendererete gotochanda na gotoreyia. Naki rende toranyare koba moyo?
english: "Son of man, say to the house of Israel, 'This is what you are saying: "Our offenses and sins weigh us down, and we are wasting away because of them. How then can we live?"'

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, otebie ense: Aye nigo ore ense etachenegeti, gose embura tegotwa igoro asore ase rituko ri’endamwamu yane.
english: "Son of man, say to the land, 'You are a land that has had no rain or showers in the day of wrath.'

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, tebia omoruoti o Turo ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Enkoro yao yeimokereirie igoro, aye nigo ogoteba: Inche nigo inde Nyasae, nigo ing’ikaransete ase ekerogo kia Nyasae ase egati y’enyancha. Korende aye nigo ore mwanyabanto rioka, tori Nyasae, nonya kwarengereirie ase enkoro yao ng’a nigo ore Nyasae.
english: "Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'In the pride of your heart you say, "I am a god; I sit on the throne of a god in the heart of the seas." But you are a man and not a god, though you think you are as wise as a god.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, kwana omobayeno, otebie Abaisraeli omoreng’anio.
english: "Son of man, set forth an allegory and tell the house of Israel a parable.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, onchoka origererie Gogi bw’ense ya Magogi, oyore omogambi bw’ense ya Rosi, na eya Meseki, na eya Tubali, obane mamincha yaye,
english: "Son of man, set your face against Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal; prophesy against him

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rigereria gochia Yerusalemu, orarie ring’ana rire mamincha y’Aase Aachenu, na obane mamincha y’ense y’Abaisraeli.
english: "Son of man, set your face against Jerusalem and preach against the sanctuary. Prophesy against the land of Israel

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rigereria gochia ase Egetunwa gia Seiri, obane mamincha yaye,
english: "Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir; prophesy against it

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rigereria gochia ase Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, obane mamincha yaye, na mamincha ya Misiri yonsi.
english: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rigereria gochia Sidoni, obane mamincha yaye,
english: "Son of man, set your face against Sidon; prophesy against her

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, onchoka origererie Abaamoni, obane mamincha yabo.
english: "Son of man, set your face against the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rigereria gochia ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, obane mamincha yabo,
english: "Son of man, set your face against the mountains of Israel; prophesy against them

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rigereria gochia ensemo ya irianyi, oyerarerie ring’ana rire mamincha yaye, na obane igoro ye rinani ri’ense ya Negebu.
english: "Son of man, set your face toward the south; preach against the south and prophesy against the forest of the southland.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, kwana nabagaaka abwo b’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inee! Nigo mwachire koboria momanye amang’ana korwa asende? Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, tingwancha mborigwe amang’ana nainwe. Ninche Omonene natebire ayio.
english: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel and say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Have you come to inquire of me? As surely as I live, I will not let you inquire of me, declares the Sovereign LORD.'

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, tebia abanto bamino ng’a ekero ndarente omoro igoro ase ense, na abanto b’ense eyio bachore omonto oyomo obo, bamobeke abe omorendi obo,
english: "Son of man, speak to your countrymen and say to them: 'When I bring the sword against a land, and the people of the land choose one of their men and make him their watchman,

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, imokia enyimbo oyerike: Ase Abayuda na ase Abaisraeli abwo babwatanire nabarabwo. Naende imokia enyimbo ende oyerike: Ase enyomba ya Yusufu (nero eya Efraimu) na ase Abaisraeli bonsi babwatanire nenyomba eyio.
english: "Son of man, take a stick of wood and write on it, 'Belonging to Judah and the Israelites associated with him.' Then take another stick of wood, and write on it, 'Ephraim's stick, belonging to Joseph and all the house of Israel associated with him.'

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rera obokie amagombo igoro ya Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, omotebie: Aye nigo kwareng’anetigwe nendo ensae ase egati y’ebisaku, nigo onga eng’iti enene mono buna eng’oina ere enyancha ime. Nigo kwaberogetie korwa ase chindooche chiao, okaburukania amache namagoro ao, okabokia etintira y’amache e chindooche chiabo.
english: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him: "'You are like a lion among the nations; you are like a monster in the seas thrashing about in your streams, churning the water with your feet and muddying the streams.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bokia amagombo igoro y’omoruoti o Turo, omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye nigo kwarenge omoikeranu goetania ebitongwa bionsi bi’obonene; nigo gwaichire nobong’aini, naende kwarenge omosiani omoikeranu.
english: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning the king of Tyre and say to him: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'You were the model of perfection, full of wisdom and perfect in beauty.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, tera ogotera gw’okoreera omochie o Turo.
english: "Son of man, take up a lament concerning Tyre.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, Abaisraeli babeire asende buna amabiria. Bonsi nigo banga buna etaai, ne ribati, na ekioma, ne risasi, bire ase eriko ri’omorero, ee, beonchoire babeire buna amabiria e chifeta.
english: "Son of man, the house of Israel has become dross to me; all of them are the copper, tin, iron and lead left inside a furnace. They are but the dross of silver.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, Abaisraeli nigo bagoteba iga: Okorora koria ere arorire nokw’amatuko atabe bwango; nigo akobana igoro ye chingaki chikare aare chitaracha.
english: "Son of man, the house of Israel is saying, 'The vision he sees is for many years from now, and he prophesies about the distant future.'

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, abanto abwo bamenyete ase amaturi aaria ase ense y’Abaisraeli, nigo bagokwana, bateba: Ibrahimu nigo arenge omonto oyomo, na ere akanyora ense eye ekaba eyaye; korende intwe nigo tore abange, ekeene, ense eye nero twaeirwe ebe eyaito.
english: "Son of man, the people living in those ruins in the land of Israel are saying, 'Abraham was only one man, yet he possessed the land. But we are many; surely the land has been given to us as our possession.'

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, mbarenge abaiseke babere ba ng’ina omo.
english: "Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, abanto aba baeire emegwekano bagosasima ribaga koba ase chinkoro chiabo, na emegwekano eyio yabeire ekegocha gekobaraa gochia gokora ebibe. Inee! Ninyanche abanto banga buna abwo baborie amang’ana korwa asende?
english: "Son of man, these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces. Should I let them inquire of me at all?

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agotebia ense y’Abaisraeli: Oyo nomoerio! Omoerio ngocha ore ase chinsemo inye chi’ense eye.
english: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says to the land of Israel: The end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Kwana na kera egesaku gie chinyoni na egie ching’iti chi’orosana, ochitebie: Esangererie, moche amo korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, mochiche ase omoyega omonene bw’ekeng’wanso nabaroiseirie. Oyio nigo orabe omoyega omonene bw’ekeng’wanso igoro ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli; inwe imorie chinyama, monywe na amanyinga.
english: "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Call out to every kind of bird and all the wild animals: 'Assemble and come together from all around to the sacrifice I am preparing for you, the great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, karie endagera yao kore nomoondoko, na onywe amache ao gokoiguswa na gochandeka.
