english: "Son of man, tremble as you eat your food, and shudder in fear as you drink your water.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, bokeria emeganda ya Misiri amagombo, obatugute abanto baye gochia inse, amo nabanto b’ebisaku bire nobonene, bagende aase abakure agwo ase chimbeera, ase abakure bagendete.
english: "Son of man, wail for the hordes of Egypt and consign to the earth below both her and the daughters of mighty nations, with those who go down to the pit.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, ninkwana ki eye mogokwana ase ense y’Abaisraeli, mogoteba: Amatuko abanetwe abeire amange mono, na amaroro ’obobani abeire bosa?
english: "Son of man, what is this proverb you have in the land of Israel: 'The days go by and every vision comes to nothing'?

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, ekero Abaisraeli bamenyete ase ense yabo, bakayekora ekaba eyetachenegeti goetera ase chinchera chiabo na ogokora kwabo, ekiagera ogokora kwabo nigo kwabete ase obosio bwane buna ogotacheneka kw’omokungu, ekero are nomotienyi.
english: "Son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own land, they defiled it by their conduct and their actions. Their conduct was like a woman's monthly uncleanness in my sight.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, Inee, nonachere omochie oiteire amanyinga ’abanto abange ekina? Onye nabo, yworokie ebibe biaye bionsi bi’okogechia,
english: "Son of man, will you judge her? Will you judge this city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her detestable practices

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, rora, goetera ase ogokwa kwa mobosokano nindusie korwa asore oyore omogoko bw’amaiso ao; nonya naboigo tomoreera gose kobokia amagombo, gose amariga taiteka korwa ase amaiso ao.
english: "Son of man, with one blow I am about to take away from you the delight of your eyes. Yet do not lament or weep or shed any tears.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto omenyete ase egati y’abanto batari koigwera; abwo babwate amaiso akorora, korende tibari korora, na amato akoigwa, korende tibari koigwa, ekiagera barabwo tibari koigwera.
english: "Son of man, you are living among a rebellious people. They have eyes to see but do not see and ears to hear but do not hear, for they are a rebellious people.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu nigo bagokwana igoro y’abanto bamino ab’egesaku kiao, ee, igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi, bagoteba: Barabwo nigo bare aare korwa ase Omonene, ense eye nintwe twaeirwe ebe eyaito.
english: "Son of man, your brothers-- your brothers who are your blood relatives and the whole house of Israel-- are those of whom the people of Jerusalem have said, 'They are far away from the LORD; this land was given to us as our possession.'

ekegusii: “Bugia ebitureri bi’esegi agwo Gibea, na mobugie ebirombeta agwo Rama! Aka eriogi ri’ogotabobora agwo Beti‐Aveni! Inwe abanto ba Benjamin, ababisa nkobabwatia bare.
english: "Sound the trumpet in Gibeah, the horn in Ramah. Raise the battle cry in Beth Aven; lead on, O Benjamin.

ekegusii: “Omonene, bono otige omosomba oo agende nomorembe, koreng’ana nering’ana riao.
english: "Sovereign Lord, as you have promised, you now dismiss your servant in peace.

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia ng’a ntebie abanto abwo ring’ana eri: “Amariga nigo agoiteka korwa ase amaiso aane obotuko na omobaso, gose tagokama goiteka, ekiagera omoiseke oria omwekungi, engencho yaye abanto baane, oakirwe, bwatirwe chingoma chimbe chitanyare kogwenigwa.
english: "Speak this word to them: "'Let my eyes overflow with tears night and day without ceasing; for my virgin daughter-- my people-- has suffered a grievous wound, a crushing blow.

ekegusii: “Tebia Haroni na abamura baye, na Abaisraeli bonsi, ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, aganetie konduera inche Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, kerabe nase engencho y’eira, gose neki’ogwancha kwaye,
english: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: 'If any of you-- either an Israelite or an alien living in Israel-- presents a gift for a burnt offering to the LORD, either to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering,

ekegusii: “Tebia Haroni na abamura baye amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi ng’a inche Omonene nachikire iga:
english: "Speak to Aaron and his sons and to all the Israelites and say to them: 'This is what the LORD has commanded:

ekegusii: “Tebia Haroni ng’a, ekero arabeke chitaya isano na ibere ase ekebekerero gie chitaya, achibeke erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.”
english: "Speak to Aaron and say to him, 'When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.'"

ekegusii: “Tebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli: Mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo inde omochenu,
english: "Speak to the entire assembly of Israel and say to them: 'Be holy because I, the LORD your God, am holy.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a bakoe chinyimbo chiabo, eyemo ase kera omotang’ani o kera egesaku kiabo, chinyimbo ikomi na ibere, Orike erieta ria kera oyomo ase enyimbo yaye.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and get twelve staffs from them, one from the leader of each of their ancestral tribes. Write the name of each man on his staff.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie buna barachie gokora ekero baraike ase ense eria ngochia kobaa.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'After you enter the land I am giving you as a home

ekegusii: “Tebia Abaisraeli ng’a natebire iga: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: “Batebie Abaisraeli ng’a ekero omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, akoria eira abe oyo bweatananire ase Omonene abe Omwerwa oye,
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'If a man or woman wants to make a special vow, a vow of separation to the LORD as a Nazirite,

ekegusii: “Tebia Abaisraeli: Ebaise koba ng’a omokungu bw’omonto obeire otari omwegenwa’ asare.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'If a man's wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him

ekegusii: “Otebie Abaisraeli: Onye eira yarietwe ng’a omonto aruegwe ase ogokorera Omonene, na omonto oyio karaboorigwe arueo, goika akorerwe rigori buna iga:
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'If anyone makes a special vow to dedicate persons to the LORD by giving equivalent values,

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Morarie Amatuko Amanene ay’Omonene, na mobe nemesangererekano yaatananirwe ase ogosasima.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'These are my appointed feasts, the appointed feasts of the LORD, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obachike ng’a bakore amasugunia ase emego ye chianga chiabo, babeke ase kera obosugunia eusi ere buru. Naboigo barakore ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'Throughout the generations to come you are to make tassels on the corners of your garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, mobatebie ng’a onye omonto omosacha okorua amache anga buna chimengere korwa ase ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha, amache ayio neubi.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When any man has a bodily discharge, the discharge is unclean.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a ekero omonto onde bwensi korwa ase egati yabo akondetera inche Omonene eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso, ayerusie korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When any of you brings an offering to the LORD, bring as your offering an animal from either the herd or the flock.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Ekero morabe mwambokire Yorodan na mwaikire ase ense ya Kanani,
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Ekero moramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodan na goika ense ya Kanani,
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you cross the Jordan into Canaan,

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Ekero moraike ase ense eria Omonene arabae, na mokogesa okwama kwaino, morente riboa ri’ogotongora kwe rigesa riaino ase omokuani.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter the land I am going to give you and you reap its harvest, bring to the priest a sheaf of the first grain you harvest.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Ekero moraike ase ense eria Omonene arabae, ense eyio ebe n’Esabato ase Omonene, etimoke.
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter the land I am going to give you, the land itself must observe a sabbath to the LORD.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Ekero moraike ase ense eria ase ngochia kobaira,
english: "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter the land to which I am taking you

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abalawi, obatebie: Ekero mokonyora ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Abaisraeli, eria Omonene abaeire ebe eyaino, erio morusie ensemo ya ikomi y’okoruegwa okwo, moyerentere Omonene.
english: "Speak to the Levites and say to them: 'When you receive from the Israelites the tithe I give you as your inheritance, you must present a tenth of that tithe as the LORD's offering.

ekegusii: “Kwana na Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, omogavuna bw’Abayuda, na Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na abatigari bonsi b’abanto, obaborie:
english: "Speak to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people. Ask them,

ekegusii: "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute.
english: Maanora omonwa oo, okwanere rimama, orwanerere oboronge bw’abwo batigirwe bachandegete.

ekegusii: Baalamu agatebia abanto baria, “Rara aa ase obotuko obo, nainche nimbarentere amairanerio korwa ase Omonene ankio mambia.” Ase ayio abanene baria ba Moabu bakabeera aroro amo na Baalamu.
english: "Spend the night here," Balaam said to them, "and I will bring you back the answer the LORD gives me." So the Moabite princes stayed with him.

ekegusii: “Genda agwo ase egeita ki’enyomba y’Omonene, na aroro agwo orarie ring’ana eri: Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene, inwe abanto bonsi ba Yuda aba mogosoa ase ebiita ebio komosasima.
english: "Stand at the gate of the LORD's house and there proclaim this message: "'Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah who come through these gates to worship the LORD.

ekegusii: Sisera agatebia Yaeli, “Tenena ase egesoero ki’eema, na omonto onde bwensi orache akoborie: Onde nare ime aa? Aye okane, otebe: Yaya, onde taiyo.”
english: "Stand in the doorway of the tent," he told her. "If someone comes by and asks you, 'Is anyone here?' say 'No.'"

ekegusii: Motenene agwo aase are aachenu buna abateneneri b’ebiombe bie chiamate chi’Abaisraeli bamino batari abakuani. Abalawi babekwe ase kera ekeombe.
english: "Stand in the holy place with a group of Levites for each subdivision of the families of your fellow countrymen, the lay people.

ekegusii: Oyonde akabora: Nanyuomire omokungu, na ase engencho eye tinkonyara gocha.
english: "Still another said, 'I just got married, so I can't come.'

ekegusii: “Amache aibire nigo are amansu, na omogati okorierwa aase a bobisi nigo okogokia.”
english: "Stolen water is sweet; food eaten in secret is delicious!"

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Timwemurunganerania inwe ase inwe.
english: "Stop grumbling among yourselves," Jesus answered.

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akamotebia, “Kirakiri! Ngotebie aya Omonene antebetie ase obotuko obo bwaetete.” Saulo agateba, “Kwana aye!”
english: "Stop!" Samuel said to Saul. "Let me tell you what the LORD said to me last night." "Tell me," Saul replied.

ekegusii: “Obwatane na Nyasae, nario orabe nomorembe; korakore igo, nonyore amaya.
english: "Submit to God and be at peace with him; in this way prosperity will come to you.

ekegusii: “Rangeria abanto bamanyete korwanera amata bachiche korwania Babeli. Moyoboere ase chinsemo chionsi, timotiga nonya nomonto oyomo atame atooreke. Yoakane koreng’ana nogokora kwaye. Buna koreng’ana oro okorete tiga okorerwe boigo, ekiagera omochie oyio oenenire ase Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: "Summon archers against Babylon, all those who draw the bow. Encamp all around her; let no one escape. Repay her for her deeds; do to her as she has done. For she has defied the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: "Suppose a man says to God, 'I am guilty but will offend no more.
english: “Inee! Monto onde nare otebirie Nyasae: Inche naremereirie egesusuro gi’okondongeyia, nonya tinkorereti monto onde bobe.

ekegusii: "Suppose he has a violent son, who sheds blood or does any of these other things
english: “Ande omonto oyio nabe ng’a oiboire omwana omomura oyore omoibi na omoiti, gose abe ogokora erimo ri’ayio

ekegusii: “Korende ning’o asemore oyore nomosomba okorema, gose okorisia ching’ondi, oramotebie ekero akorwa mogondo agosoa nyomba: Inchuo bwango oikaranse, orie endagera?
english: "Suppose one of you had a servant plowing or looking after the sheep. Would he say to the servant when he comes in from the field, 'Come along now and sit down to eat'?

ekegusii: “Monto ki oino oyore ne ching’ondi rigana erimo, na eyemo esire, tagotiga chiria emerongo kianda na kianda ase erooro, na gochia korigia eria yasirire, goika ayenyore?
english: "Suppose one of you has a hundred sheep and loses one of them. Does he not leave the ninety-nine in the open country and go after the lost sheep until he finds it?

ekegusii: Naki ning’o asemore, onye origetie koagacha oboagacho, otaikaranse ritang’ani kobara rigori ri’oboagacho obo, gose nabwate ebinto biisaine kobokoora?
english: "Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. Will he not first sit down and estimate the cost to see if he has enough money to complete it?

ekegusii: "Suppose there is a righteous man who does what is just and right.
english: “Origererie orore omonto ore omoronge, ogokora ayare boronge na ekeene.

ekegusii: “Rora, Nyasae takonyara kwanga na gotiga omonto omoikeranu; gose tagokonya abakori amabe.
english: "Surely God does not reject a blameless man or strengthen the hands of evildoers.

ekegusii: "Surely he will have no respite from his craving; he cannot save himself by his treasure.
english: Ekeene, ribero ri’omonto oyio riagerire taba nobotoereru, takonyara kogacha gento kende gekomogokia.

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto karagwe takorambora okoboko kwaye, na ase emechando yaye arere akonywe?
english: "Surely no one lays a hand on a broken man when he cries for help in his distress.

ekegusii: Korende Petero akabora, “Yaya Omonene, ekiagera tinana koria nonya ng’ake egento getachenegeti gose ekere neubi.”
english: "Surely not, Lord!" Peter replied. "I have never eaten anything impure or unclean."

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, rituko ngocha rire rigosamba buna omorero o riko ogosamba. Erio abanto abaenenu bonsi, na abakori amabe bonsi, mbabe buna obonyansi obwomo, ne rituko erio rigocha nigo rirabasambe kegima, tirigotiga omori gose orosagia.
english: "Surely the day is coming; it will burn like a furnace. All the arrogant and every evildoer will be stubble, and that day that is coming will set them on fire," says the LORD Almighty. "Not a root or a branch will be left to them.

ekegusii: “Rora inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ndarigererie namaiso aane obogambi obwo bogokora ebibe. Nimbosirie borue ase obosio bw’ense, korende tingosiria kegima abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Surely the eyes of the Sovereign LORD are on the sinful kingdom. I will destroy it from the face of the earth-- yet I will not totally destroy the house of Jacob," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Inee! Aye tikwana komanya ng’a korwa kare, ekero mwanyabanto babegetwe ase ense,
english: "Surely you know how it has been from of old, ever since man was placed on the earth,

ekegusii: Korende Israeli akamotebia, “Tiana ng’a nonkorere bo.” Ere agatiana. Erio Israeli agetureka ase ogotoorera omotwe borere bwaye.
english: "Swear to me," he said. Then Joseph swore to him, and Israel worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

ekegusii: “Oegwe ebiegwa korwa ase Helidai na Tobia, na Yedaya, abanto abwo bairane korwa Babeli ase barenge abasomba. Ase rituko erio erio ogende ase enyomba ya Yosia, mosinto o Sefania, ase basoete.
english: "Take [silver and gold] from the exiles Heldai, Tobijah and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon. Go the same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.

ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’Abalawi baria bare b’ororeria rwa Gerisoni, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.
english: "Take a census also of the Gershonites by their families and clans.

ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’Abalawi baria bare be chiamate chia Kohati, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba,
english: "Take a census of the Kohathite branch of the Levites by their clans and families.

ekegusii: “Rika abanto bonsi abakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, buna Omonene achigete Musa.” Abaisraeli abwo barwete ense ya Misiri nabwo aba:
english: "Take a census of the men twenty years old or more, as the LORD commanded Moses." These were the Israelites who came out of Egypt:

ekegusii: “Mobare omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, eamate ase eamate. Morike, abanto bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baranyare korwana esegi.”
english: "Take a census of the whole Israelite community by families-- all those twenty years old or more who are able to serve in the army of Israel."

ekegusii: “Kora omobaro bw’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba. Orike amarieta ’abanto bonsi abasacha, omonto ase omonto.
english: "Take a census of the whole Israelite community by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.

ekegusii: Pilato akabatebia, “More nabarendi; genda morende mono oboina buna moranyare.” Bakagenda bakaborenda mono, bakabeka rigena riria ekemanyererio, naende bakabeka abarendi.
english: "Take a guard," Pilate answered. "Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how."

ekegusii: “Imokia ebuku, orike ime yaye amang’ana onsi nakwanete naye igoro y’Abaisraeli na Abayuda, na igoro y’ebisaku bionsi. Orike kera egento gochakera rituko riria nakwanete naye, ekero Yosia arenge kogamba, goika rituko ria rero.
english: "Take a scroll and write on it all the words I have spoken to you concerning Israel, Judah and all the other nations from the time I began speaking to you in the reign of Josiah till now.

ekegusii: “Imokia ebuku ende, orike amang’ana aria onsi arenge ase eria entang’ani, eria Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, asambete.
english: "Take another scroll and write on it all the words that were on the first scroll, which Jehoiakim king of Judah burned up.

ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tigeria rigena.” Martha, mosubati omwabo bw’oria okwete, akamotebia, “Omonene, otiokire bono, ekiagera obeire egetondo ase amatuko ane.”
english: "Take away the stone," he said. "But, Lord," said Martha, the sister of the dead man, "by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days."

ekegusii: “Aye goika oimokie obosie obonuke, oroisie emegati ikomi na ebere. Kera omogati oire obosie boisaine ebimunu bine.
english: "Take fine flour and bake twelve loaves of bread, using two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf.

ekegusii: “Orusie ebitinya bi’emingichi eyio, na omokera oye ore omonoru, na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, na ebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete, na ebachwa ya borio, ekiagera emingichi eyio nigo yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu.
english: "Take from this ram the fat, the fat tail, the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh. (This is the ram for the ordination.)

ekegusii: “Ira Yeremia, omorende buya mono. Tobaisa komokorera amang’ana ande amabe, korende amang’ana aragotebie omokorere”
english: "Take him and look after him; don't harm him but do for him whatever he asks."

ekegusii: “Orente emingichi eyemo ase echio ibere, na Haroni na abamura baye babeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.
english: "Take one of the rams, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

ekegusii: “Oimokie amaguta akweakwa, oake Obomenyo na ebinto bionsi ebire imeo na obwatanane Obomenyo amo nebinto biaye bionsi, erinde bibe ebichenu.
english: "Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it; consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.

ekegusii: “Imekia orokini orwo kwagora, obegete kenema, ogende goika orooche rw’Eufarati, orobise ase omwenya bw’egetare ime.”
english: "Take the belt you bought and are wearing around your waist, and go now to Perath and hide it there in a crevice in the rocks."

ekegusii: “Mosokie isiko y’egetwori omonto oyio oragereretie Omonene, na abanto baria bonsi bamoigwete gakoragereria, babeke amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe oye, na omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena akwe.
english: "Take the blasphemer outside the camp. All those who heard him are to lay their hands on his head, and the entire assembly is to stone him.

ekegusii: Naende akamotebia, “Ng’usa obota bwao!” Nere akabong’usa. Na Elisha akabeka amaboko aye ase amaboko ’omoruoti oria,
english: "Take the bow in your hands," he said to the king of Israel. When he had taken it, Elisha put his hands on the king's hands.

ekegusii: “Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Amaguta a manemane chikiro ikomi, na omodalasini ore ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano, na amanukato are ne rimisu rigiya chikiro isano,
english: "Take the following fine spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half as much (that is, 250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane,

ekegusii: “Atanana Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli na obachene.
english: "Take the Levites from among the other Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.

ekegusii: “Ira Abalawi babe abaane ribaga ri’abanto abasacha abatangi b’Abaisraeli, naende oire ching’iti chi’Abalawi chibe echiane ribaga rie chingiti chintangi chi’Abaisraeli. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites are to be mine. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: “Erio orente emingichi eria ende, na Haroni na abamura baye babeke amaboko abo ase omotwe oye.
english: "Take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on its head.

ekegusii: “Oire emingichi eria yarurwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, oiyekere chinyama chiaye aase aatananire.
english: "Take the ram for the ordination and cook the meat in a sacred place.

ekegusii: “Imokia enyimbo eria, erio aye na Haroni mosangererie omoganda bwonsi, na agwo ase amasio ’abanto bonsi mokwane negetare keria, na amache nasoke korwa aroro. Ase enchera eyio mosokerie abanto amache banywe, ne chitugo chiabo chinywe.”
english: "Take the staff, and you and your brother Aaron gather the assembly together. Speak to that rock before their eyes and it will pour out its water. You will bring water out of the rock for the community so they and their livestock can drink."

ekegusii: Gaki, moure etalanta yaye, moe oria obwate chitalanta ikomi.
english: "'Take the talent from him and give it to the one who has the ten talents.

ekegusii: Yehu agatebia abanto baye. “Babwate bare moyo!” Na barabwo bakababwata bare moyo, bakabaita na kobaruta ase engoro agwo ang’e na Beti‐Ekedi, abanto emerongo ene, na babere; tatigaretie nonya noyomo.
english: "Take them alive!" he ordered. So they took them alive and slaughtered them by the well of Beth Eked-- forty-two men. He left no survivor.

ekegusii: “Ira ebuku eye y’amachiko, moyebeke ensemo y’Esanduku eria ere nokobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene Nyasae oino, erio ebeereo ase okoba kirori asemore.
english: "Take this Book of the Law and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God. There it will remain as a witness against you.

ekegusii: Orente amagena abere a oiniki, na ase amagena ayio omang’ere amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli:
english: "Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel

ekegusii: “Aye omokungu omotayayi konya kwebirwe, imokia obokano, oetanane ase omochie bwonsi, otere neriogi rigiya, otere amatera amange, erio nario orainyorwe.”
english: "Take up a harp, walk through the city, O prostitute forgotten; play the harp well, sing many a song, so that you will be remembered."

ekegusii: Aye tera ogotera gw’okobokia amagombo igoro y’abagambi b’Abaisraeli,
english: "Take up a lament concerning the princes of Israel

ekegusii: “Inwe mwensi momanyete gokumba amata, ebeke ang’e morwanie Babeli ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi. Yorute chinsara, timotiga nonya neyemo, ekiagera okorire ebibe ase Omonene.
english: "Take up your positions around Babylon, all you who draw the bow. Shoot at her! Spare no arrows, for she has sinned against the LORD.

ekegusii: “Genda obaruserie Abaisraeli egesiomba ase Abamidiani ase engencho y’ayio abanto abwo babakorerete, erio nyuma yaye aye nokwe, osangererekane amo nabanto bao.”
english: "Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people."

ekegusii: Oimokie engano, na esairi, ne ching’ende, ne chinchorogo, na amaemba, na engano ende, erio obeke ebinto ebio ase ekebekerero ekemo, obiochoganie, obiroisie emegati. Eyio nero orabe gokoria ase engaki eyio y’amatuko amagana atato, na emerongo kianda, orabe koraire.
english: "Take wheat and barley, beans and lentils, millet and spelt; put them in a storage jar and use them to make bread for yourself. You are to eat it during the 390 days you lie on your side.

ekegusii: “Abatarisisi bagacha asore bagakora oboonchoreria naye, okanyora korwa asebare chifeta, na ebioma ao ao, na amabati; naye okabaooneria ebinto ao ao, ekiagera kwabwate obotenenku obonge.
english: "'Tarshish did business with you because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin and lead for your merchandise.

ekegusii: "Teach me, and I will be quiet; show me where I have been wrong.
english: “Inyorokererie, na inche ninkire‐kiri imanyie amamocho nakorire.

ekegusii: “Omworokia, ngochika ki kore okonene ase amachiko onsi?”
english: "Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?"

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Omworokia, ayio onsi ninyabwatete korwa obwana bwane.”
english: "Teacher," he declared, "all these I have kept since I was a boy."

ekegusii: Yohana akamotebia, “Omworokia, ntwarora omonto ogoseria ebirecha ase erieta riao; tokamokania, ekiagera tare gototunyana intwe.”
english: "Teacher," said John, "we saw a man driving out demons in your name and we told him to stop, because he was not one of us."

ekegusii: Erio bakamoboria, “Omworokia, aya indi arabe rende? Naende ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi arabe ang’e goikerana?”
english: "Teacher," they asked, "when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?"

ekegusii: bakobora, “Omworokia, Musa natebete: Omonto karakwe, na ere tari nabana, momura omwabo atware omoboraka oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.
english: "Teacher," they said, "Moses told us that if a man dies without having children, his brother must marry the widow and have children for him.

ekegusii: “Omworokia, Musa natorikerete ng’a momura omwabo omonto karakwe atige omokungu oye; onye tari nomwana, momura omwabo atware omokungu oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.
english: "Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man's brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and have children for his brother.

ekegusii: bakamoboria, “Omworokia, Musa natorikerete ng’a momura omwabo omonto karakwe, na ere nare nomokungu, korende tari nabana, nagwenerete momura omwabo atware omokungu oria, atenenerie momura omwabo egesaku.
english: "Teacher," they said, "Moses wrote for us that if a man's brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and have children for his brother.

ekegusii: “Kwana na Haroni na abamura baye, obatebie ng’a barende na bakore amasikani ase ebinto ebichenu, biria Abaisraeli bagwatanana asende, erio tibabaisa korenta obosooku ase erieta riane richenu. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: "Tell Aaron and his sons to treat with respect the sacred offerings the Israelites consecrate to me, so they will not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: "Tell Aaron and his sons, 'This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:
english: “Motebie Haroni amo nabamura baye ng’a, ekero barabe bagosesenia Abaisraeli, bakwane amang’ana aya:

ekegusii: “Tebia Eleazari, omomura o Haroni omokuani, ng’a arusie chindogio chiria chi’omorero korwa ase omorero oyio ogwoka, na omorero oyio ayosiare gochia aare. Chindogio chiria chi’omorero konya chiabeire chinchenu.
english: "Tell Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest, to take the censers out of the smoldering remains and scatter the coals some distance away, for the censers are holy--

ekegusii: Timoteba amang’ana aya ase Gati, timoyararia ase chinchera chi’Askeloni. Timotiga abaiseke b’Abafilisti bachenge; timotiga abaiseke b’abanto baria batarogeti bagoke!”
english: "Tell it not in Gath, proclaim it not in the streets of Ashkelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines be glad, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised rejoice.

ekegusii: “Batebie Abaisraeli ng’a bandetere ebiegwa; aye obisangererie korwa ase kera omonto oyoranche kobirua asende.
english: "Tell the Israelites to bring me an offering. You are to receive the offering for me from each man whose heart prompts him to give.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a bachore emechie y’obotamero, buna nabatebetie goetera ase Musa.
english: "Tell the Israelites to designate the cities of refuge, as I instructed you through Moses,

ekegusii: “Batebie Abaisraeli ng’a bairane gochia Pi‐Hahiroti, batoore agwo ase egati ya Migidoli na enyancha kororia Baali‐Sefoni ase enyancha mbarabare.
english: "Tell the Israelites to turn back and encamp near Pi Hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea. They are to encamp by the sea, directly opposite Baal Zephon.

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli obatebie: Onye omonto onde oino, gose oyo bw’ororeria rwaino, obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo, gose nigo are aare ase orogendo, na onye origetie korenda rituko ri’Epasaka y’Omonene,
english: "Tell the Israelites: 'When any of you or your descendants are unclean because of a dead body or are away on a journey, they may still celebrate the LORD's Passover.

ekegusii: Kwana nabanto, obatebie: Echene inwe abanyene ase engencho y’ankio; namonyore chinyama mokoria. Omonene oigure okwereera kwaino na buna mwaboria: Ning’o ogotoa chinyama torie? Ekero twarenge ase ense ya Misiri, nigo twarenge buya. Ase ayio Omonene nache abae chinyama morie.
english: "Tell the people: 'Consecrate yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, when you will eat meat. The LORD heard you when you wailed, "If only we had meat to eat! We were better off in Egypt!" Now the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat it.

ekegusii: Mobatebie ng’a chinyasae chiria chitatongete igoro na ense nachisire, tichiba inse y’erioba.
english: "Tell them this: 'These gods, who did not make the heavens and the earth, will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.'"

ekegusii: Kurera abanto b’ebisaku ng’a amabe ngocha are; raria ase Yerusalemu, motebe: Abagochia koboera ngocha bare korwa ase ense y’aare, bagoaka eriogi ase emechie y’Abayuda.
english: "Tell this to the nations, proclaim it to Jerusalem: 'A besieging army is coming from a distant land, raising a war cry against the cities of Judah.

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Totebie nase okobua ki ogokora aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”
english: "Tell us by what authority you are doing these things," they said. "Who gave you this authority?"

ekegusii: Tworokererie aya togochia gokwana asare; titokonyara konyora amang’ana togochia gokwana, ekiagera tore ase omosunte.
english: "Tell us what we should say to him; we cannot draw up our case because of our darkness.

ekegusii: “Totebie, aya indi arabe? Ninki ekemanyererio kiaye ekero aya onsi arabe ang’e goikerana?”
english: "Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to be fulfilled?"

ekegusii: “Kwana na Serubabeli, omogavuna bw’Abayuda, omotebie ng’a inche nintengechie igoro chionsi amo nense.
english: "Tell Zerubbabel governor of Judah that I will shake the heavens and the earth.

ekegusii: Okorengwa nkoreo. Inee! Naki gwachayete enyimbo? Tekonyara koba buya asore. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "'Testing will surely come. And what if the scepter [of Judah], which the sword despises, does not continue? declares the Sovereign LORD.'

ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo twatebete: Tiga toagache egesasimero, tari ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi,
english: "That is why we said, 'Let us get ready and build an altar-- but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices.'

ekegusii: “erinde ebe buya asore, nario oramenye amatuko amange ase ense.”
english: "that it may go well with you and that you may enjoy long life on the earth."

ekegusii: Naende omosomba oria omanyete ogwancha kw’omonene oye, na tebeka ang’e, gose gokora ogwancha kwaye, naakwe ebiranya ebiroro,
english: "That servant who knows his master's will and does not get ready or does not do what his master wants will be beaten with many blows.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagateba, “Aya namanyinga! Abaruoti baria barwanire barabwo ase barabwo na goitana. Ase ayio bono intwe Abamoabu, togende tosakore!”
english: "That's blood!" they said. "Those kings must have fought and slaughtered each other. Now to the plunder, Moab!"

ekegusii: Yeremia akamotebia, “Obwo noborimo, tinkogenda kobwatana n’Abakalidayo.” Korende Iriya tancha koigwa amang’ana a Yeremia. Akamobwata akamoira ase abagambi.
english: "That's not true!" Jeremiah said. "I am not deserting to the Babylonians." But Irijah would not listen to him; instead, he arrested Jeremiah and brought him to the officials.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakabora: “Ayio tari amaene; totebie bono.” Erio akabatebia, “Ere nigo antebia ng’a aya naro Omonene atebire: Inche nagoakire amaguta obe omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.”
english: "That's not true!" they said. "Tell us." Jehu said, "Here is what he told me: 'This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.'"

ekegusii: Amata ’abanto chituoni abunekire, korende abakogochwa babekirwe chinguru.
english: "The bows of the warriors are broken, but those who stumbled are armed with strength.

ekegusii: “Amaagacho ’amatabori agure inse, korende nigo torayaagache namagena abaachire. Emeko yagechirwe, korende ntosimeke emecharake ribaga ri’eyio.”
english: "The bricks have fallen down, but we will rebuild with dressed stone; the fig trees have been felled, but we will replace them with cedars."

ekegusii: “Naama! Rituko riria ngocha rire! Ngocha rire! Egeku nkobachera kere! Enyimbo y’okobaaka yasebokire, na obomwenu bwareeretire.
english: "The day is here! It has come! Doom has burst forth, the rod has budded, arrogance has blossomed!

ekegusii: “Rituko ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire gochera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi. Buna mwabeire mogokora, naboigo nainwe morakorerwe. Ogokora kwaino nkobairanere inwe abanyene.
english: "The day of the LORD is near for all nations. As you have done, it will be done to you; your deeds will return upon your own head.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire, “Naama! Amatuko ngocha are ndaikeranie eira narierete chiamate chi’Abaisraeli na echi’Abayuda.
english: "'The days are coming,' declares the LORD, 'when I will fulfill the gracious promise I made to the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Amatuko ngocha are, ekero inche ndabusure ense y’Abaisraeli, na ey’Abayuda, ne chimbusuro chia mwanyabanto na echie ching’iti.
english: "The days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will plant the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the offspring of men and of animals.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteba: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, inche ndabae egesusuro abanto baria bonsi barogete, ko nonya nabo nigo bare buna abatarogeti.
english: "The days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will punish all who are circumcised only in the flesh--

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Amatuko ngocha are ekero ndasebokie oyomo ore Omoseboka omoronge o Daudi. Oyio nabe omoruoti, oragambe nobong’aini na konacha ebina bi’ekeene na ebi’oboronge ase ense.
english: "The days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will raise up to David a righteous Branch, a King who will reign wisely and do what is just and right in the land.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Rora amatuko ngocha are, ekero omoremi araikeere omogesi, na omomiti amasabibu araikeere omobusuri chimbusuro. Ebitunwa mbitonyie edivai enyansu, na ebigoro mbiichore edivai.
english: "The days are coming," declares the LORD, "when the reaper will be overtaken by the plowman and the planter by the one treading grapes. New wine will drip from the mountains and flow from all the hills.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Amatuko ngocha are ekero omochie oria oraagachwe naende asende, gochakera ase Omorobiri o Hananeli goikera ase Egeita gi’Ekoona.
english: "The days are coming," declares the LORD, "when this city will be rebuilt for me from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, ndarente enchara ase ense, tari enchara y’endagera, gose tari erang’o y’amache, korende nenchara ye ringana ri’Omonene.
english: "The days are coming," declares the Sovereign LORD, "when I will send a famine through the land-- not a famine of food or a thirst for water, but a famine of hearing the words of the LORD.

ekegusii: “Emeika y’abanto bakwete nigo ekoiguswa; boigo namache na ebimenyete imeo.
english: "The dead are in deep anguish, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

ekegusii: Okonachwa kw’amang’ana aya kwarurwe nabarendi baria abachenu, na ogochika oko nigo kwarurwe na baria abachenu. Ase igo abare moyo banyare komanya ng’a Oyore Igoro Mono nere okogambera oboruoti bwa mwanyabanto, naende nere okoa oboruoti obwo ase onde bwensi aranche, naende nigo akobeka oria ore omoke mono ase egati y’abanto agambe ase oboruoti obwo.
english: "'The decision is announced by messengers, the holy ones declare the verdict, so that the living may know that the Most High is sovereign over the kingdoms of men and gives them to anyone he wishes and sets over them the lowliest of men.'

ekegusii: Goetanana omochie bwonsi nigo orabe ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000). Korwa rituko erio omochie oyio nigo orarokwe Omonene Nao Are Aa.”
english: "The distance all around will be 18,000 cubits. "And the name of the city from that time on will be: THE LORD IS THERE."

ekegusii: “Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, amaroso a igoro agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene arenge nendamwamu.
english: "The earth trembled and quaked, the foundations of the heavens shook; they trembled because he was angry.

ekegusii: “Na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli inabaigwe amang’ana ao. Erio mogende, aye na barabwo, ase omoruoti o Misiri, momotebie: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaibirania, natoorokera; na bono twagosabire, otoe ribaga togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erio toruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso.
english: "The elders of Israel will listen to you. Then you and the elders are to go to the king of Egypt and say to him, 'The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has met with us. Let us take a three-day journey into the desert to offer sacrifices to the LORD our God.'

ekegusii: “Omobisa agateba,” “Nimbabwatie, mbaikeere, mbiatanane ebi ndasakore, omoyo one oisaneke; ninsomore omoyio one o birende, k nimbasirie nokoboko kwane.”
english: "The enemy boasted, 'I will pursue, I will overtake them. I will divide the spoils; I will gorge myself on them. I will draw my sword and my hand will destroy them.'

ekegusii: "The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eyes are good, your whole body will be full of light.
english: “Etaya y’omobere neriso. Nabo onye eriso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi noichorwe noborabu;

ekegusii: "The eye that mocks a father, that scorns obedience to a mother, will be pecked out by the ravens of the valley, will be eaten by the vultures.
english: Eriso ri’omonto ogochecheria ise na gochaya ng’ina ndirusigwe nebigonkoru bie rigoko na ririegwe namage e chinsoti.

ekegusii: Emechando y’Abamoabu yabeire ang’e mono, na egeku nigo gekoayerera kobachera.
english: "The fall of Moab is at hand; her calamity will come quickly.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, oyio noro omochakano bw’obong’aini, na okomomanya Oyore Omochenu nabwo obomanyi.
english: "The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

ekegusii: “Kera omwana omoisia omotangi nabe oyone, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo, chibe chieri gose chimingichi.
english: "The first offspring of every womb belongs to me, including all the firstborn males of your livestock, whether from herd or flock.

ekegusii: Oyo bwe ritang’ani agacha, okobora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo ikomi binde.
english: "The first one came and said, 'Sir, your mina has earned ten more.'

ekegusii: Eng’iti entang’ani nigo yagwekaine endo, korende yabwate chimbaba buna echi’ensoti. Buna nabete ndigereretie, chimbaba chiaye nigo chiasimoire, ero ekaimokererigwa igoro korwa ase riroba, egatenenigwa namagoro abere buna omonto, ekaegwa enkoro ya mwanyabanto.
english: "The first was like a lion, and it had the wings of an eagle. I watched until its wings were torn off and it was lifted from the ground so that it stood on two feet like a man, and the heart of a man was given to it.

ekegusii: “Obonene bwa Lebanoni mborentwe bobe obwao, emetarakwa na emeuru, na emebunduki, nerentwe gochabera aase Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bore, na inche ninkore aase amagoro aane agotenena abe nobonene.
english: "The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the pine, the fir and the cypress together, to adorn the place of my sanctuary; and I will glorify the place of my feet.

ekegusii: Nyasae, oyotongete ense na ebinto bionsi ebireo, tari komenya ase ebihekalu biagachire namaboko, ekiagera nere Omonene o igoro na ense,
english: "The God who made the world and everything in it is the Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples built by hands.

ekegusii: “Abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo bagachete endamwamu ime ase chinkoro chiabo; barabwo tibari korera barigie bakonywe, ekero Nyasae akobaa egesusuro.
english: "The godless in heart harbor resentment; even when he fetters them, they do not cry for help.

ekegusii: Rituko rinene ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire, nigo rire ang’e mono rikoayerera. Tegerera oigwe, rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire! Abarwani esegi chituoni nigo bakorera bare nobororo.
english: "The great day of the LORD is near-- near and coming quickly. Listen! The cry on the day of the LORD will be bitter, the shouting of the warrior there.

ekegusii: “Serubabeli obekire oboroso bw’enyomba eye namaboko aye, boigo nere orayekoore namaboko aye. Erio nario oramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda nere ontomete asemore.
english: "The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this temple; his hands will also complete it. Then you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me to you.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakorera: “Rigesa riaerire, etoigo yaerire, naintwe titotooregeti.”
english: "The harvest is past, the summer has ended, and we are not saved."

ekegusii: Aase aimokererete igoro, ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Isaka bagosasimera bosa, na aase ande onsi Abaisraeli bagosasimera natagorwe abe bosa. Ning’ite abanto b’enyomba ya Yeroboamu nemioro.”
english: "The high places of Isaac will be destroyed and the sanctuaries of Israel will be ruined; with my sword I will rise against the house of Jeroboam."

ekegusii: “Oyore omokuani omonene ase abamwabo, oyio onyororokeretigwe amaguta akweakwa ase omotwe oye, naende bwatananirwe ase okobeka chianga chi’obokuani, ere tatiga etukia yaye esang’ang’are, gose tatandora chianga chiaye ase okoreera omonto okure.
english: "'The high priest, the one among his brothers who has had the anointing oil poured on his head and who has been ordained to wear the priestly garments, must not let his hair become unkempt or tear his clothes.

ekegusii: “Ekero Abaisraeli baratoore, kera omonto abe inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiaye, na inse y’ekemanyererio ki’eamate yaye; batoore baetanane Eema y’Omosangererekano, ne chiema chi’abanto chirigererie Eema eria.
english: "The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting some distance from it, each man under his standard with the banners of his family."

ekegusii: “Abayahudi bonsi mbamanyete obogima bwane korwa obosae bwane buna bwarenge korwa omochakano, ase egesaku kiane na ase Yerusalemu.
english: "The Jews all know the way I have lived ever since I was a child, from the beginning of my life in my own country, and also in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: “Omoruoti o irianyi nabe ne chinguru, korende oyomo bw’abagambi b’oboruoti bwaye nabe ne chinguru komobua, na oboruoti bwaye mbobe obonene mono.
english: "The king of the South will become strong, but one of his commanders will become even stronger than he and will rule his own kingdom with great power.

ekegusii: “Omoruoti oria nigo arakore buna anchete. Ase obomwenu bwaye neimokererie igoro ase kera enyasae, nakwane amang’ana ’ogokumia mamincha ya Nyasae oyobuete chinyasae chionsi. Nagenderere konyora chinguru goika ekeririanda kia Nyasae geikeranigwe. Aria aroberetigwe ng’a nabe goika aikeranigwe.
english: "The king will do as he pleases. He will exalt and magnify himself above every god and will say unheard-of things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been determined must take place.

ekegusii: Na Omoruoti nabairanerie: Nekeene nabatebirie: Koreng’ana buna mware gokorera oyomo bw’aba abaminto abare abake, ninche mwakorerete.
english: "The King will reply, 'I tell you the truth, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of mine, you did for me.'

ekegusii: “Oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomoruoti okorete omoyega bw’enyangi y’omwana oye.
english: "The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.

ekegusii: “Oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nenibo yabisire ase omogondo, eye omonto anyorete, akayebisa; erio ase omogoko oye akagenda, akaoonia ebiabwate bionsi, akagora omogondo oria.
english: "The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and then in his joy went and sold all he had and bought that field.

ekegusii: “Amaene, omobaso bw’omokori amabe norime, gose amasase aye takobara.
english: "The lamp of the wicked is snuffed out; the flame of his fire stops burning.

ekegusii: “Aatananere abanto aba chingongo chibe emiando yabo. Ochiatanane kobwatekana nomobaro bw’abanto.
english: "The land is to be allotted to them as an inheritance based on the number of names.

ekegusii: “Ense tekoonigwa ebe egenderere koba ey’oyio oyegora, ekiagera ense neyane; inwe nigo more abamenyi momenyete asende.
english: "'The land must not be sold permanently, because the land is mine and you are but aliens and my tenants.

ekegusii: “Amachiko narengeo, na ababani boigo, goika ekero kia Yohana. Korwa ekero keria amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti bwa Nyasae nkorandigwa are, na kera omonto nigo akobosoa ne chinguru.
english: "The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the good news of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

ekegusii: Rikorominyo ndibwate abaiseke babere; barabwo nigo bakorangeria, “Toe, toe!” Mbire ebinto bitato bitari goisaneka; ee, mbire bine bitari goteba ng’a biaisanekire, nabio ebi;
english: "The leech has two daughters. 'Give! Give!' they cry. "There are three things that are never satisfied, four that never say, 'Enough!':

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi mbare ne ribaga kobooria chinyomba chi’emechie ere emiando yabo engaki ende yonsi.
english: "'The Levites always have the right to redeem their houses in the Levitical towns, which they possess.

ekegusii: “Abalawi abwo baruete asende bagantiga, bakagenda gosasima emegwekano yabo, ekero Abaisraeli bande basaretie; egesusuro ki’ogosaria kwabo nkebairanere.
english: "'The Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray and who wandered from me after their idols must bear the consequences of their sin.

ekegusii: Naomi agatebia Rutu, moka momura oye, “Boazi oyio tiga asesenigwe n’Omonene, oyo ogoikerania chiira chiaye ase abwo bare moyo, na ase abwo bakure.” Naende agateba, “Omonto oyio nomonyamwando ominto, oyomo bw’abagwenerete gotorenda.”
english: "The LORD bless him!" Naomi said to her daughter-in-law. "He has not stopped showing his kindness to the living and the dead." She added, "That man is our close relative; he is one of our kinsman-redeemers."

ekegusii: Erio Boazi akamotebia, “Mwana one, Omonene agosesenie. Aye bono kworokirie obwegenwa kobua obwo kworogetie ritang’ani ase nyoko biara. Tikware korigia abamura bande, abataka gose abanda.
english: "The LORD bless you, my daughter," he replied. "This kindness is greater than that which you showed earlier: You have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoita, naende oirania obogima; ere nigo agotoma abanto gochia aase abakure, naende obabokia.
english: "The LORD brings death and makes alive; he brings down to the grave and raises up.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge nainche korwa omochakano bwe chinchera chiaye, agwo kare konya ataratonga kende gionsi;
english: "The LORD brought me forth as the first of his works, before his deeds of old;

ekegusii: “Omonene nigo ang’ete eng’eria y’obuya, ekiagera inde omoronge; nigo ansesenetie, ekiagera inde namaboko atari na komocha.
english: "The LORD has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

ekegusii: “Igo nabo Omonene ankoreire ase amatuko aya andigereretie, na konduseria obosooku bwane ase amasio ’abanto.”
english: "The Lord has done this for me," she said. "In these days he has shown his favor and taken away my disgrace among the people."

ekegusii: Omonene oseririe abanto b’ebisaku ebinene bire ne chinguru; onde tari obabuire goika rero iga.
english: "The LORD has driven out before you great and powerful nations; to this day no one has been able to withstand you.

ekegusii: “Bono Omonene oikeranirie eira ariete, ekiagera inche natenenire ribaga ria Daudi tata, naikaransire ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene ariete eira, naende naagacheire erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba,
english: "The LORD has kept the promise he made. I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the LORD promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: “Bono Omonene oikeranirie eira eria ariete, ekiagera inche natenenire ribaga ria Daudi tata, na ngoikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene ariete eira, naende naagacheire erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba.
english: "The LORD has kept the promise he made: I have succeeded David my father and now I sit on the throne of Israel, just as the LORD promised, and I have built the temple for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: “Omonene bwangire abanto bonsi chituoni, abamenyete ime yane, orangeirie omosangererekano bw’abanto, erinde osenyente abamura baane. Abayuda abwo banga buna omoiseke omwekungi, Omonene obatiringeire inse, babeire buna amasabibu agotiringwa ase ekemitero.
english: "The Lord has rejected all the warriors in my midst; he has summoned an army against me to crush my young men. In his winepress the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.

ekegusii: “Omonene otorenteire oboronge bwaito. Inchuo torarie ase Sayoni emeremo y’Omonene, Nyasae oito.
english: "'The LORD has vindicated us; come, let us tell in Zion what the LORD our God has done.'

ekegusii: “Omonene nomonyene oboronge, nonya naboigo inche tinyigwereti amachiko aye. Inwe abanto bonsi, tegerera moigwe, morigererie emechando yane, abaiseke baane abekungi, na abamura baane, boosirwe na koirwa ase obosomba.”
english: "The LORD is righteous, yet I rebelled against his command. Listen, all you peoples; look upon my suffering. My young men and maidens have gone into exile.

ekegusii: “Omonene nigo are moyo! Ere oyore egetare kiane atogigwe! Nyasae, egetare ki’ogotooreka kwane, aimokererigwe igoro.
english: "The LORD lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be God, the Rock, my Savior!

ekegusii: Korwa aaria igoro aase aye aachenu Omonene nigo arigereretie gocha aa, ee, nigo arigereretie gocha ase ense,
english: "The LORD looked down from his sanctuary on high, from heaven he viewed the earth,

ekegusii: “Omonene agatebia Omonene one: Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao?
english: "'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet."'

ekegusii: “Omonene nigo agechetigwe mono ne chisokoro chiaino.
english: "The LORD was very angry with your forefathers.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nechorere omoruoti oragambere Abaisraeli, na omoruoti oyio nasirie kegima enyomba ya Yeroboamu, na ayio nakoreke korwa bono.
english: "The LORD will raise up for himself a king over Israel who will cut off the family of Jeroboam. This is the day! What? Yes, even now.

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nintoorie obomenyo bw’Abayuda ritang’ani, erinde abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, na aba Yerusalemu, tibabaisa gwetogia ng’a mbare nobonene igoro y’Abayuda.
english: "The LORD will save the dwellings of Judah first, so that the honor of the house of David and of Jerusalem's inhabitants may not be greater than that of Judah.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae o igoro na ense, oyondusetie o tata korwa ase ense eria naiboreretwe, ere nigo akwanete nainche na gotiana, ogoteba: Ning’ee ororeria rwao ense eye, ere natome omomalaika oye agotang’ane; aye norentere omwana one omokungu korwa aroro.
english: "The LORD, the God of heaven, who brought me out of my father's household and my native land and who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, 'To your offspring I will give this land'-- he will send his angel before you so that you can get a wife for my son from there.

ekegusii: “Omonto oria omonene bw’ense eria nigo akwanete naintwe amang’ana amakong’u agatoroka ng’a intwe nechirooti, tokoroota ense.
english: "The man who is lord over the land spoke harshly to us and treated us as though we were spying on the land.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio oirete embori eria ase erooro ase Asaseli, asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache; nyuma y’ayio amanye gosoa ase egetwori.
english: "The man who releases the goat as a scapegoat must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water; afterward he may come into the camp.

ekegusii: Naende oria oetwe chitalanta ibere agacha, akabora: Omonene, nkwang’ete chitalanta ibere, rora, nanyorire ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.
english: "The man with the two talents also came. 'Master,' he said, 'you entrusted me with two talents; see, I have gained two more.'

ekegusii: Omorendi oria akabora ase omoyo oye: Ninki ndakore, ekiagera omonene one ondusirie ase oborendi bwane? Tindi ne chinguru chi’okorema; ogosaba nobosooku asende.
english: "The manager said to himself, 'What shall I do now? My master is taking away my job. I'm not strong enough to dig, and I'm ashamed to beg--

ekegusii: Omonene oria agatogia omorendi otarenge omoronge, ekiagera akorete ase obong’aini. Naki abana b’ense eye nabang’aini kobua abana b’omobaso, ase ekegori kiabo abanyene.
english: "The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the people of this world are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the people of the light.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Dedani bagakora oboonchoreria naye; boigo abe chinse chinyinge chiarenge ang’e nenyancha bakaba bagokora oboonchoreria naye, bakagoakana amaino e chinchogu ne chibao chi’emete ekorokwa eboni.
english: "'The men of Rhodes traded with you, and many coastlands were your customers; they paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.

ekegusii: Abaonchoreria ba Seba na aba Raama bagakorentera ebinsari ao ao ebiya mono, na amagena e rigori rinene, ne chitahabu, naye okabaooneria ebinto biao ebiya kwabwate.
english: "'The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you; for your merchandise they exchanged the finest of all kinds of spices and precious stones, and gold.

ekegusii: Na abaonchoreria b’ense bakorera na komweumeria, ekiagera onde tari oragore ebinto biabo naende:
english: "The merchants of the earth will weep and mourn over her because no one buys their cargoes any more--

ekegusii: “Omonguru nere Nyasae! Nere Omonene! Omonguru nere Nyasae! Nere Omonene. Ere namanyete aya twakorire, nainwe Abaisraeli boigo moyamanye. Onye aya twakorire akorirwe mamincha y’Omonene, gose onye titwarenge nobwegenwa asare, rirorio timogototooria rero.
english: "The Mighty One, God, the LORD! The Mighty One, God, the LORD! He knows! And let Israel know! If this has been in rebellion or disobedience to the LORD, do not spare us this day.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Erie ritang’ani nario eri: Igwa, Abaisraeli, Omonene Nyasae oito, Omonene noyomo;
english: "The most important one," answered Jesus, "is this: 'Hear, O Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ebing’wanso biaino ebinge mokorua asende, ninki ndakore nabirobio? Nigo narosire nebing’wannso bi’ogosambwa bie chimingichi, na ebitinya bie ching’iti chinoru. Tingokiri namanyinga e chieri, gose aye chimanwa chie ching’ondi, gose aye chigoree.
english: "The multitude of your sacrifices-- what are they to me?" says the LORD. "I have more than enough of burnt offerings, of rams and the fat of fattened animals; I have no pleasure in the blood of bulls and lambs and goats.

ekegusii: Amariogi ’okwoga akaigugwa korwa agwo, na amo nabanto barengeo batari namasikani; abande abagotinda bakarentwa korwa ase erooro, na barabwo bakabekera abakungu ebigera ase amaboko abo, ne chigutwa chingiya ase emetwe yabo.
english: "The noise of a carefree crowd was around her; Sabeans were brought from the desert along with men from the rabble, and they put bracelets on the arms of the woman and her sister and beautiful crowns on their heads.

ekegusii: Korende akabea, tarigia gosoa. Erio ise agasoka, akamosorora,
english: "The older brother became angry and refused to go in. So his father went out and pleaded with him.

ekegusii: “Oyochire korwa igoro, oyio nigo are igoro ase onsi; oyore bw’ense noyo bw’ense, nigo agokwana amang’ana ’ense; ere oyochire korwa igoro nigo are igoro ase onsi.
english: "The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.

ekegusii: Erio abasomba b’omonyene enyomba bagacha, bakamoboria: Omonene, tikwabusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oo? Naki rende ororekanire namabanchore?
english: "The owner's servants came to him and said, 'Sir, didn't you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?'

ekegusii: Ebitii bi’oborisia morae Abalawi bichakere korwa ase chindwaki chi’omochie, bigareigwe gochia ase oboare bw’amaboko elifu eyemo korwa ase kera ensemo y’omochie.
english: "The pasturelands around the towns that you give the Levites will extend out fifteen hundred feet from the town wall.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Abaisraeli na Abayuda babeire bagendererete gokora ebibe ase obosio bwane korwa obwana bwabo. Ee, Abaisraeli tibakorete kende ekiya, otatiga amabe oka, ayio akangechia nkaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’emeremo y’amaboko abo.
english: "The people of Israel and Judah have done nothing but evil in my sight from their youth; indeed, the people of Israel have done nothing but provoke me with what their hands have made, declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Omonene otebire: Abanto ba Yuda bakorire ebibe ase obosio bwane, babekire emegwekano y’okogechia ase enyomba eria ekorokwa ase erieta riane, bayekorire yabeire eyetachenegeti.
english: "'The people of Judah have done evil in my eyes, declares the LORD. They have set up their detestable idols in the house that bears my Name and have defiled it.

ekegusii: Omonto oria ogochia gochenwa goika asibie chianga chiaye, na akigite etukia yaye yonsi, naende esibie omobere namache, erio abe oyochenegete. Nyuma y’ayio asoe ase egetwori, korende abeere isiko y’eema yaye ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere,
english: "The person to be cleansed must wash his clothes, shave off all his hair and bathe with water; then he will be ceremonially clean. After this he may come into the camp, but he must stay outside his tent for seven days.

ekegusii: “Omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma abeke chianga amachanchabe, tabaisa gochanoa etukia yaye, atube omonwa oye ase egekoba kia igoro, erio aake eriogi na gokuura: Inche tinchenegeti! Tinchenegeti!
english: "The person with such an infectious disease must wear torn clothes, let his hair be unkempt, cover the lower part of his face and cry out, 'Unclean! Unclean!'

ekegusii: “Ekero abataka na abaremeire barabe bakorigia amache na tibayanyora, ekero chimeme chiabo chirabe chiabwatanire namang’ang’ura; inche Omonene nimbaigwe, inche Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tinkobatiga.
english: "The poor and needy search for water, but there is none; their tongues are parched with thirst. But I the LORD will answer them; I, the God of Israel, will not forsake them.

ekegusii: “Omokuani arente ebinto ebio ase obosio bw’Omonene na arue ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na eki’ogosambwa ase engencho y’omonto oria.
english: "'The priest is to present them before the LORD and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.

ekegusii: “Erio omokuani arike amang’ana ayio ay’okoragereria okwo ime ase ebuku, naende ayasibie namache aria amaroro.
english: "'The priest is to write these curses on a scroll and then wash them off into the bitter water.

ekegusii: “Omokuani arente omokungu oria amobeke ase obosio bw’Omonene,
english: "'The priest shall bring her and have her stand before the LORD.

ekegusii: “Abakuani bonsi goika barende amang’ana aya nachikire. Batayabwateti, nababe abakori ebibe ase ayio, na barabwo mbakwe, ekiagera bagosaria aya nachikire. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.
english: "'The priests are to keep my requirements so that they do not become guilty and die for treating them with contempt. I am the LORD, who makes them holy.

ekegusii: Omogambi ore ase egati yabo naimokie ebinto biaye abibeke ireko agende; ekero omosunte ochire abochore ekebao ase enyasi aetereo; nigo aratube obosio bwaye tabaisa korora ense namaiso aye.
english: "The prince among them will put his things on his shoulder at dusk and leave, and a hole will be dug in the wall for him to go through. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land.

ekegusii: “Ensemo ende yatwe eegwe omogambi. Eyio nigo erabe ase chinsinyo chionsi ibere chi’oboremo boria obochenu, na obw’omochie oria omonene, ensemo ya moocha na eya bosongo. Korwa ensinyo ya bosongo y’oboremo boria obochenu, na boria bw’omochie omonene, oboremo bw’omogambi bogaree gochia bosongo boreng’ane nobwa kera egesaku, na ensemo ya moocha boigo bogaree gochia moocha.
english: "'The prince will have the land bordering each side of the area formed by the sacred district and the property of the city. It will extend westward from the west side and eastward from the east side, running lengthwise from the western to the eastern border parallel to one of the tribal portions.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inche ninchiche mboorie abanto ba Sayoni, na abwo ba Yakobo baonchoke na batige ogosaria kwabo.
english: "The Redeemer will come to Zion, to those in Jacob who repent of their sins," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Orogongo roratigare rore nobogare bwe chimoti chilifu isano (5,000), na obotambe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), nigo rorabe orw’abanto bande bonsi, baraagache emechie yabo aroro, naende robe orw’oborisia. Agwo nao omochie omonene oraagachwe gati‐gati.
english: "The remaining area, 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, will be for the common use of the city, for houses and for pastureland. The city will be in the center of it

ekegusii: Abanto abatigarete, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abateri, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, na abanto bonsi konya berusananirie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku ase engencho y’amachiko a Nyasae, barabwo amo nabakungu babo, na abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, nabwo bonsi babwate obong’aini bw’okomanya,
english: "The rest of the people-- priests, Levites, gatekeepers, singers, temple servants and all who separated themselves from the neighboring peoples for the sake of the Law of God, together with their wives and all their sons and daughters who are able to understand--

ekegusii: Ekero abanyaboronge bakorora ayio, nigo bakogoka; ee, abwo batari na komocha nigo bagosekerera abakori amabe na kobachecheria,
english: "The righteous see their ruin and rejoice; the innocent mock them, saying,

ekegusii: “Ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha nigo kore okomo nogw’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Omokuani oria ogokora okobwatanigwa nakerokio aire chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso eke chibe echiaye.
english: "'The same law applies to both the sin offering and the guilt offering: They belong to the priest who makes atonement with them.

ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere agacha, akabora: Omonene, ekerengo kiao kiarentire ebirengo bitano.
english: "The second came and said, 'Sir, your mina has earned five more.'

ekegusii: Bono mbasimeke chimbusuro chiabo bare nomorembe; emesabibu inayame amasabibu, ne riroba narirente okwama kwaye, boigo na igoro nachirente riime. Nimbae abanto aba abatigari ebinto bionsi bibe ebiabo.
english: "The seed will grow well, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will produce its crops, and the heavens will drop their dew. I will give all these things as an inheritance to the remnant of this people.

ekegusii: Omosomba oria agacha, akorokia omonene oye amang’ana aya. Erio oria omonyene enyomba akabea, agatebia omosomba oye: Soka bwango, ogende ase chinchera na ebinchera bi’emechie, orente abataka, na ebirema, na emeuko, na amagata.
english: "The servant came back and reported this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and ordered his servant, 'Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the town and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind and the lame.'

ekegusii: Omosomba oria akagwa inse, akamosorora, agateba: Omonene, ing’ira ng’ora, na inche ningoakane bionsi.
english: "The servant fell on his knees before him. 'Be patient with me,' he begged, 'and I will pay back everything.'

ekegusii: Chimeeri chia Tarisisi chikabogoria ebinto bi’oboonchoreria bwao. “Bono ogaisaneka ogaichorwa nebinto ebinge agwo ase kwarenge ase egati y’enyancha.
english: "'The ships of Tarshish serve as carriers for your wares. You are filled with heavy cargo in the heart of the sea.

ekegusii: Omwana oria akamotebia: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao, tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo.
english: "The son said to him, 'Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.'

ekegusii: Abamura ba Haroni omokuani nabwo barabe bakobugia ebirombeta ebio. “Oko nakwo korabe ogochika asemore kogenderera botambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: "The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to blow the trumpets. This is to be a lasting ordinance for you and the generations to come.

ekegusii: “Ninsangererie amo abwo baichanete, ekiagera berusananirie korwa ase omosangererekano bw’ogosasima. Barabwo nigo bare abao, betwekire chigurube chi’ogochaywa.
english: "The sorrows for the appointed feasts I will remove from you; they are a burden and a reproach to you.

ekegusii: “Tegerera moigwe ekerero gekorwa Babeli. Eriogi ri’ogosirigwa okonene riarure ase ense y’Abakalidayo.
english: "The sound of a cry comes from Babylon, the sound of great destruction from the land of the Babylonians.

ekegusii: “Abanto ba Hesiboni na ab’Eleale nigo bakorera, na eriogi riabo riaigurwe goika Eleale na Yahasi; boigo ndigugwe korwa ase Soari goika Horonaimu na Egilati‐Selisia. Na amache a Nimirimi nakame na gosira.
english: "The sound of their cry rises from Heshbon to Elealeh and Jahaz, from Zoar as far as Horonaim and Eglath Shelishiyah, for even the waters of Nimrim are dried up.

ekegusii: “Ribebe ria irianyi nigo rirabebekane norongogo rwa Gadi. Nigo riragenderere korwa Tamari gochia ase amache a Kadeshi‐Meriba, na korwa aroro ribwatie akarooche ka Misiri ritwomere Enyancha Enene.
english: "The southern boundary of Gad will run south from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh, then along the Wadi [of Egypt] to the Great Sea.

ekegusii: “Orogongo orwo morotige robe orw’Omonene; obotambe bwaye nigo borabe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000).
english: "The special portion you are to offer to the LORD will be 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide.

ekegusii: “Omoika bw’Omonene nigo ore igoro yane, ekiagera ong’akire amaguta koranderia abataka amang’ana amaya. Ontomire koranderia abasibwa ogosiborwa, na koa abare emeuko banyare korora naende, na gosibora abasionoirwe,
english: "The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to release the oppressed,

ekegusii: “Omoika bw’Omonene ogokwana goetera asende, ring’ana riaye nigo rire ase omonwa one.
english: "The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me; his word was on my tongue.

ekegusii: Baria bamanyete kominyoka chimbero tibakonyara gotama, nonya nabarwani bare chituoni tibagotooreka. Agwo sugusu, ang’e norooche rw’Eufarati, bagochirwe na kogwa.
english: "The swift cannot flee nor the strong escape. In the north by the River Euphrates they stumble and fall.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omoyio oyio orurwe otierigwe, erinde obekwe ang’e okorerwe emeremo; otierigwe na gosenigwa, obekwe ase okoboko kw’omoiti.
english: "'The sword is appointed to be polished, to be grasped with the hand; it is sharpened and polished, made ready for the hand of the slayer.

ekegusii: “Aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai baikaransire ase ekerogo kia Musa.
english: "The teachers of the law and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat.

ekegusii: Enyomba inche ngochia koagacha nigo erabe enene mono, ekiagera Nyasae nomonene goetania chinyasae chinde chionsi.
english: "The temple I am going to build will be great, because our God is greater than all other gods.

ekegusii: Ne chingunchara chiria ikomi kwaroche, echio nabaruoti ikomi abataranyora oboruoti, korende mbaegwe okobua koba abaruoti ase ensa eyemo amo neng’iti eria.
english: "The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but who for one hour will receive authority as kings along with the beast.

ekegusii: Abaremi bakabwata abasomba baye, oyomo bakamoaka, oyonde bakamoita, na oyonde bakamoaka amagena.
english: "The tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

ekegusii: “Rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi oyio o gatano na kabere, erio nario Rituko ri’Okobwatanigwa, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima, na inwe inamobe mokweng’ata na gweitia, na mondetere inche Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero.
english: "The tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Atonement. Hold a sacred assembly and deny yourselves, and present an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Na egetutu ki’amagwa gekairaneria emete yonsi: Onye ekeene mwanchire gonchora imbe eruoti yaino, inchuo mokenderere inse y’ekiriri kiane, korende onye taibo, tiga omorero osoke korwa ase chinsagia chiane chi’amagwa, osambe emecharake ya Lebanoni.
english: "The thornbush said to the trees, 'If you really want to anoint me king over you, come and take refuge in my shade; but if not, then let fire come out of the thornbush and consume the cedars of Lebanon!'

ekegusii: Omotaka oria agakwa, akabogorigwa nabamalaika, akabekwa ase egekuba kia Ibrahimu. Na oria omonda agakwa boigo, agatindekwa,
english: "The time came when the beggar died and the angels carried him to Abraham's side. The rich man also died and was buried.

ekegusii: okobora, “Engaki yaikeranire, na oboruoti bwa Nyasae bwaikire ang’e; onchoka na mwegene enchili.”
english: "The time has come," he said. "The kingdom of God is near. Repent and believe the good news!"

ekegusii: Omonene otebire iga: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndakore okobwatana okoyia kw’ogotianania nenyomba y’Abaisraeli na ey’Abayuda.
english: "The time is coming," declares the LORD, "when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

ekegusii: “Rigereria, omoiseke omwekungi nabe morito, erio naibore omwana omoisia, na erieta riaye narokwe Imanueli” (engencho yaye: Nyasae amo naintwe).
english: "The virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel"--which means, "God with us."

ekegusii: Okorora okwo igoro ye chimogoroba ne chimambia gwakwanetwe nogw’ekeene. Kogache okobise, ekiagera nigo koraire amatuko amange komanye goikeranigwa.”
english: "The vision of the evenings and mornings that has been given you is true, but seal up the vision, for it concerns the distant future."

ekegusii: Eriogi rigantebia eria kabere korwa igoro: Eki Nyasae achenire tokeroka ng’a tikeri egechenu.
english: "The voice spoke from heaven a second time, 'Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.'

ekegusii: "The waves of death swirled about me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.
english: “Emerindo y’amakweri konya yang’etananire, chiooro chi’obobe chikandetera obwoba.

ekegusii: Ase obogare bw’eraaro ensemo ya bosongo oroisie ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano, ne chisiiro ikomi, amo ne chinterekerero chiabo ikomi.
english: "The west end of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide and have curtains, with ten posts and ten bases.

ekegusii: “Intwe nigo togokwana ribaga ri’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Omonene. Nase ki motari nobwegenwa ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli? Mwatigire Omonene rero ase okweagachera egesasimero, mwabeire mamincha y’Omonene.
english: "The whole assembly of the LORD says: 'How could you break faith with the God of Israel like this? How could you turn away from the LORD and build yourselves an altar in rebellion against him now?

ekegusii: “Esagero nigo egosamunsa chimbaba chiaye chioga; korende, Inee, chimbaba echio nchibwate obwanchani?
english: "The wings of the ostrich flap joyfully, but they cannot compare with the pinions and feathers of the stork.

ekegusii: "'The woman he marries must be a virgin.
english: Ere anyuome omoiseke ore omwekungi.

ekegusii: Erio Hezekia agatebia Isaya, “Ring’ana ri’Omonene aye gwakwanire nerigiya.” Naende akamotebia, “Omorembe na okorendwa okuya nigo bigochia koba ase obogima bwane.”
english: "The word of the LORD you have spoken is good," Hezekiah replied. For he thought, "There will be peace and security in my lifetime."

ekegusii: Hezekia agatebia Isaya, “Ring’ana ri’Omonene aye gwakwanire nerigiya”. Nigo arengereretie ng’a onye rioka omorembe na oborendi obuya biare gochia konyorekana ase obogima bwaye.
english: "The word of the LORD you have spoken is good," Hezekiah replied. For he thought, "Will there not be peace and security in my lifetime?"

ekegusii: Ekero baria barigetwe chinsa ikomi nemo bachete, bakanyora kera oyomo edinari eyemo.
english: "The workers who were hired about the eleventh hour came and each received a denarius.

ekegusii: “Ogokora kwabo kwabatangire tibairanera Nyasae obo. Omoika bw’obotomani nigo ore ime yabo, tibamomanyeti Omonene.
english: "Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God. A spirit of prostitution is in their heart; they do not acknowledge the LORD.

ekegusii: amagoro abo nigo are amaango ase ogoitera amanyinga,
english: "Their feet are swift to shed blood;

ekegusii: "Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness."
english: Emenwa yabo yaichoirwe nokoragereria na obororo,

ekegusii: Emioyo yabo noboina bwasie, ase emenwa yabo nigo bagokwana obong’ainereria, obosongo bwe ching’iti nigo bore ase ebikoba bi’emenwa yabo.
english: "Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit." "The poison of vipers is on their lips."

ekegusii: Erio enchara ekaba igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na Kanani, na emechando emenge, ne chisokoro chiaito tichianyora endagera echiisanete.
english: "Then a famine struck all Egypt and Canaan, bringing great suffering, and our fathers could not find food.

ekegusii: “Nyuma y’ayio Haroni asoe Eema y’Omosangererekano, arusie chianga chi’egatani chiria abegete ritang’ani atarasoa Aase Aachenu, achitigeo.
english: "Then Aaron is to go into the Tent of Meeting and take off the linen garments he put on before he entered the Most Holy Place, and he is to leave them there.

ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi inababaroke abasesenirie, ekiagera ense yaino nebe y’okogokia. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteba.”
english: "Then all the nations will call you blessed, for yours will be a delightful land," says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: "Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
english: Erio abaiseke baria bonsi bakaimoka koroisia chitaya chiabo.

ekegusii: Naende oyonde agacha, akabora: Omonene, eke nakio ekerengo kiao nagachete ase egetambaa;
english: "Then another servant came and said, 'Sir, here is your mina; I have kept it laid away in a piece of cloth.

ekegusii: Agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Omwerwa oria akigite etukia y’omotwe oye ere ekemanyererio ng’a neatananete ase Omonene. Erio aire etukia yaye, ayerute ase omorero oria ore inse y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.
english: "'Then at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the Nazirite must shave off the hair that he dedicated. He is to take the hair and put it in the fire that is under the sacrifice of the fellowship offering.

ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, bwate enyongo eye ase amasio ’abanto abwo moragende komo,
english: "Then break the jar while those who go with you are watching,

ekegusii: "Then bring your livestock," said Joseph. "I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock, since your money is gone."
english: Yusufu akabairaneria, “Onye chibesa chiaino chiaerire, ndetera chitugo chiaino, na inche mbae endagera morie.”

ekegusii: Obatebie bandoiserie Obomenyo Obochenu, na inche inyare komenya ase egati yabo.
english: "Then have them make a sanctuary for me, and I will dwell among them.

ekegusii: Naende akaboria oyonde: Naye ninki oriete? Akairaneria: Ebirengo rigana erimo bi’engano. Akamotebia: Bogoria ekaratasi yao, orike emerongo etano na etato.
english: "Then he asked the second, 'And how much do you owe?' "'A thousand bushels of wheat,' he replied. "He told him, 'Take your bill and make it eight hundred.'

ekegusii: Erio agatebia abasomba baye: Enyangi yabeire ang’e, korende abarangeretigwe tibagwenereti.
english: "Then he said to his servants, 'The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited did not deserve to come.

ekegusii: Ere agantebia: Koranche, ong’ike ang’e ong’ite, ekiagera nonya ngendererete koba moyo, nigo inde nobororo bw’ogokwa.
