english: "Then he said to me, 'Stand over me and kill me! I am in the throes of death, but I'm still alive.'

ekegusii: Agatebia abarengeo: Moure ekerengo kiaye, moe oria oyore nebirengo ikomi.
english: "Then he said to those standing by, 'Take his mina away from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.'

ekegusii: Akabora: Ninkore iga: Nintagore ebiage biane, mbiaagache ebinene kobua, na aroro ningache endagera yane yonsi, na ebinto biane.
english: "Then he said, 'This is what I'll do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

ekegusii: Agantebia: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito ogochorire onyare komanya ogwancha kwaye, na korora Omonyene Oboronge, na koigwa eriogi rikorwa ase omonwa oye.
english: "Then he said: 'The God of our fathers has chosen you to know his will and to see the Righteous One and to hear words from his mouth.

ekegusii: Naende agatoma abasomba bande, agateba: Motebie abarangerigwe: Rigereria, endagera yane naroisirie, chiombe chiane na ebinoru biane bianyenyirwe, na bionsi biabeire ang’e; inchuo ase omoyega bw’enyangi.
english: "Then he sent some more servants and said, 'Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner: My oxen and fattened cattle have been butchered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.'

ekegusii: Erio asoke agende ase egesasimero kere agwo ase obosio bwane, agekorere okobwatanigwa, naende aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri eyio, ayagindie ase emegwekano yonsi ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero ekio,
english: "Then he shall come out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it. He shall take some of the bull's blood and some of the goat's blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.

ekegusii: Erio natebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee: Karue asende inwe abamwaragereretigwe, mogende ase omorero o kare na kare, oyoroiseretigwe Saitani na abamalaika baye,
english: "Then he will say to those on his left, 'Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.

ekegusii: Na inche ngatebia omonene one: Aande omokungu oria atancheraneti gocha amo nainche.
english: "Then I asked my master, 'What if the woman will not come back with me?'

ekegusii: Na inche nkabora: Naye ng’o Omonene? Omonene agantebia: Ninche Yeso, oyogwachandire aye.
english: "Then I asked, 'Who are you, Lord?' "'I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,' the Lord replied.

ekegusii: “Ekero narigereretie ekaba ng’a orogunchara roria rwagendererete gokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu. Ase engencho eyio nkarora eng’iti eria egaitwa, na omobere oye ogasarigwa okarutwa ase omorero ogasambwa.
english: "Then I continued to watch because of the boastful words the horn was speaking. I kept looking until the beast was slain and its body destroyed and thrown into the blazing fire.

ekegusii: “Ekero naetete agwo ase kwarenge, ngakorora gokwegara‐garia ime ase amanyinga ao, nkagotebia: Buna oraire ase amanyinga ao ime, obe moyo; ee, nkagotebia: Buna oraire ase amanyinga ao ime, obe moyo.
english: "'Then I passed by and saw you kicking about in your blood, and as you lay there in your blood I said to you, "Live!"

ekegusii: Erio ngatoma Musa na Haroni, ngaaka Abamisiri namaakwa aya nabarenterete, na nyuma y’ayio nkabarusia inwe aroro.
english: "'Then I sent Moses and Aaron, and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there, and I brought you out.

ekegusii: “Erio nkagania komanya ekeene igoro y’eng’iti eria ya kane, eyarenge nogwatananekana korwa ase chiria chinde. Nigo yarenge ey’okooondokia mono, yabwate amaino ’ebioma ne chinchara chi’etaai; ekaria na kobutorana, na eke yatigaretie ekagetindachera inse namagoro aye.
english: "Then I wanted to know the true meaning of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others and most terrifying, with its iron teeth and bronze claws-- the beast that crushed and devoured its victims and trampled underfoot whatever was left.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatoma abanto gochia ase Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, agwo Hesiboni bamoborie ribaga baete ase ense yaye, bagende ase ense yabo abanyene.
english: "Then Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, and said to him, 'Let us pass through your country to our own place.'

ekegusii: “Erio aye orarere orobega rwao rw’okobee, obe kobogoretie obobe bw’Abaisraeli igoro yao. Koreng’ana namatuko ayio orabe koraire igo, naboigo orabogorie obobe bwabo.
english: "Then lie on your left side and put the sin of the house of Israel upon yourself. You are to bear their sin for the number of days you lie on your side.

ekegusii: “Oroisie chitaya isano na ibere, ochibeke igoro y’ekebekerero keria, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio.
english: "Then make its seven lamps and set them up on it so that they light the space in front of it.

ekegusii: “Ase enchera eyio ning’umore endamwamu yane, na obotindi bwane, igoro asebare, erinde ing’isaneke. Ekero ndabe naumoire endamwamu yane asebare, mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio inde ne risemi.
english: "Then my anger will cease and my wrath against them will subside, and I will be avenged. And when I have spent my wrath upon them, they will know that I the LORD have spoken in my zeal.

ekegusii: "Then our father said, 'Go back and buy a little more food.'
english: Na ekero tata atotebetie ng’a toirane tomogorere endagera inke,

ekegusii: Erio ngatebigwa ng’a mbatebie amang’ana aya: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Kanywe, motinde na moroke, mogwe inse na timoimoka naende, ase engencho y’esegi ndarente ase egati yaino.
english: "Then tell them, 'This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Drink, get drunk and vomit, and fall to rise no more because of the sword I will send among you.'

ekegusii: Akamochiera oyo okabere, akamotebia boigo. Nere akamoiraneria: Nkogenda inde, omonene; go tagenda.
english: "Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, 'I will, sir,' but he did not go.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti oyio o irianyi nabe nendamwamu enene, nache korwania omoruoti o sugusu, na oria o sugusu nasangererie omoganda omonene bw’abarwani esegi, korende barabwo nababekwe ase okoboko kw’omoruoti o irianyi.
english: "Then the king of the South will march out in a rage and fight against the king of the North, who will raise a large army, but it will be defeated.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia abakoreri: Moboe amaboko na amagoro, momotugute ase omosunte isiko; aroro abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.
english: "Then the king told the attendants, 'Tie him hand and foot, and throw him outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'

ekegusii: Erio Omoruoti natebie abare ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio: Inchuo inwe abamwasesenetigwe na Tata one, soa ase omwando bw’oboruoti mwaroiseretigwe korwa ogotongwa gw’ense,
english: "Then the King will say to those on his right, 'Come, you who are blessed by my Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia: Rusia ebikoroto biao korwa ase amagoro ao, ekiagera aase agwo oteneine naase aachenu.
english: "Then the Lord said to him, 'Take off your sandals; the place where you are standing is holy ground.

ekegusii: Nere agantebia: Genda, ekiagera inche ningotome aare ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”
english: "Then the Lord said to me, 'Go; I will send you far away to the Gentiles.'"

ekegusii: Korende Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akabeka Sihoni amo nabanto baye ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakababua. Abaiisraeli bakaira ense yonsi y’Abaamori baria bamenyete ase ense eria.
english: "Then the LORD, the God of Israel, gave Sihon and all his men into Israel's hands, and they defeated them. Israel took over all the land of the Amorites who lived in that country,

ekegusii: Na oria oetwe etalanta eyemo agacha, akabora: Omonene, nakomanyete ng’a nigo ore omonto omokong’u, okogesa aase otasimegete, na gosangereria aase otabusurete;
english: "Then the man who had received the one talent came. 'Master,' he said, 'I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio, omonene bw’ense eria, agatotebia: Ase amang’ana aya naro ndamanyere gose nabanto abaronge more: Tiga oyomo oino aiga asende, inwe abande genda, moire endagera ase engencho y’enchara ekare inka seino.
english: "Then the man who is lord over the land said to us, 'This is how I will know whether you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me, and take food for your starving households and go.

ekegusii: Erio omonene oye akamorangeria, akamotebia: Aye omosomba omobe! Inche ngakwabera esira yonsi, ekiagera gwansororete.
english: "Then the master called the servant in. 'You wicked servant,' he said, 'I canceled all that debt of yours because you begged me to.

ekegusii: Omonene oria agatebia omosomba oye: Genda ase chinchera ne chimbebe, obabetererie basoe, erinde enyomba yane enyare goichora.
english: "Then the master told his servant, 'Go out to the roads and country lanes and make them come in, so that my house will be full.

ekegusii: Abatigarete bagatirimboka gochia ase abatang’ani babo; Omonene agacha ase engencho yane arwanie chituoni.
english: "Then the men who were left came down to the nobles; the people of the LORD came to me with the mighty.

ekegusii: na oria ore ime namoiranerie, na goteba: Tondosia, egesieri giasiekirwe, na inche amo nabana baane twararire borere, tinkonyara koimoka nkoe?
english: "Then the one inside answers, 'Don't bother me. The door is already locked, and my children are with me in bed. I can't get up and give you anything.'

ekegusii: "Then the owner of the vineyard said, 'What shall I do? I will send my son, whom I love; perhaps they will respect him.'
english: Oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu akabora: Inki ndakore? Nintome omwana one, omwanchwa one, aande ere inabamosike.

ekegusii: “Erio omokuani arue ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ogochia gochenwa, acheneke korwa ase ogotacheneka kwaye. Nyuma y’ayio anyenye ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa,
english: "Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness. After that, the priest shall slaughter the burnt offering

ekegusii: Erio omokuani oria aimokie emanwa eyemo, ayerue ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, ayerue amo namaguta egetuba ekemo, erio abisungusie agwo ase obosio bwane bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa.
english: "Then the priest is to take one of the male lambs and offer it as a guilt offering, along with the log of oil; he shall wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.

ekegusii: Erio abanyene oboronge nabamoiranerie: A! Omonene, indi twakoroche kore nenchara, togakorageria? Gose indi twakoroche kore nerang’o, togakoa okanywa?
english: "Then the righteous will answer him, 'Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?

ekegusii: "Then the trees said to the vine, 'Come and be our king.'
english: Emete egatebia omosabibu: Inchuo aye otogambere!

ekegusii: Erio barabwo mbandangerie, korende tinkobaigwa; mbandigie, korende tibakonyora inche.
english: "Then they will call to me but I will not answer; they will look for me but will not find me.

ekegusii: Na abanto aba nabagende ase egesusuro gia kare na kare, korende abanyene oboronge nabagende ase obogima bwa kare na kare.”
english: "Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life."

ekegusii: Erio abanto abamenyete ase emechie y’Abaisraeli mbagende basangererie ebirwanero; chinguba, ne ching’aya, na amata, ne chinsara, ne chisimisi, na amatimo, babikore chinko bagoutera omorero ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere.
english: "'Then those who live in the towns of Israel will go out and use the weapons for fuel and burn them up-- the small and large shields, the bows and arrows, the war clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eyio ning’iranerie abanto enkwana y’emenwa echenegete, erinde bonsi babe bakorangeria erieta riane inche Omonene, na bagonkorera bare nomoyo oyomo.
english: "Then will I purify the lips of the peoples, that all of them may call on the name of the LORD and serve him shoulder to shoulder.

ekegusii: Mokaamboka Yorodan, mogaika Yeriko. Abanto ba Yeriko bakabarwania, naboigo Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abagirigasi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi bakorete, korende nkababeka ase amaboko aino.
english: "'Then you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The citizens of Jericho fought against you, as did also the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites and Jebusites, but I gave them into your hands.

ekegusii: "Then you said to your servants, 'Bring him down to me so I can see him for myself.'
english: Erio ogatotebia intwe, abasomba bao: Gachie momondetere, ache aa imorore.

ekegusii: “Erio inababarue monyare gochandwa na goitwa, na inwe inamogechwe nebisaku bionsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.
english: "Then you will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.

ekegusii: Erio norueo, ogenderere orogendo, oike ase omote onga buna omotontera ore agwo Tabori. Aroro agwo noumerane nabanto batato bagotiira gochia gosasima Nyasae agwo Beteli. Oyomo obo nabe obwate chimanwa chie chimbori isato, na oyonde obogoretie emegati etato, na oyonde ekerandi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa kere nedivai.
english: "Then you will go on from there until you reach the great tree of Tabor. Three men going up to God at Bethel will meet you there. One will be carrying three young goats, another three loaves of bread, and another a skin of wine.

ekegusii: Erio namochake goteba: Nigo tware koria na konywa ase obosio bwao, naye nkworokereria kwarenge ase chinchera chiaito.
english: "Then you will say, 'We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.'

ekegusii: Erio Hanameli, omomura o tata moke, agacha asende agwo ase nasibire, buna Omonene konya akwanire, agantebia, “Gora omogondo one ore agwo Anatoti, ase ense ya Benjamin, ekiagera naye ochigete oyogore na koyobooria obe oyoo.” Erio inche nkamanya ng’a riria nigo riarenge ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: "Then, just as the LORD had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and said, 'Buy my field at Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin. Since it is your right to redeem it and possess it, buy it for yourself.' "I knew that this was the word of the LORD;

ekegusii: Erio Simion Petero akamotebia, “Omonene, tari amagoro aane oka, korende nonya namaboko na omotwe one.”
english: "Then, Lord," Simon Peter replied, "not just my feet but my hands and my head as well!"

ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo mokore emeremo yaino, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka, rituko ri’omosangererekano bwatananirwe ase ogosasima. Timobaisa gokora meremo ende yonsi. Erio nerituko ri’Esabato ri’Omonene, aande onsi ase moramenye.
english: "'There are six days when you may work, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of rest, a day of sacred assembly. You are not to do any work; wherever you live, it is a Sabbath to the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende ase ching’iti chikoria eng’ang’ura gose chibwate ebitaago biatananegete timoria engamia, ekiagera nigo ekoria eng’angu’ra, korende tebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio techenegeti.
english: "'There are some that only chew the cud or only have a split hoof, but you must not eat them. The camel, though it chews the cud, does not have a split hoof; it is ceremonially unclean for you.

ekegusii: Ekegori nkere gekoragereria abaise na tikeri gosesenia abang’ina.
english: "There are those who curse their fathers and do not bless their mothers;

ekegusii: “Abanto bande bangire oborabu, nonya ne chinchera chi’oborabu tibachimanyeti, gose tibari kobwatia chinchera chi’oborabu obwo.
english: "There are those who rebel against the light, who do not know its ways or stay in its paths.

ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bitato bikogokia ase ogotaara kwabo, ee, mbire bine bire nogotaara okuya, nabio ebi:
english: "There are three things that are stately in their stride, four that move with stately bearing:

ekegusii: Ebinto mbire bitato bire bi’ogokumia asende; ee, mbire bine ebio ntamanyeti, nabio ebi:
english: "There are three things that are too amazing for me, four that I do not understand:

ekegusii: “Ekeene, ribwago ase chifeta chigokunywa korwa ndire, na aase abanto bagosiberia chitahabu nare.
english: "There is a mine for silver and a place where gold is refined.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Nyasae tikori ase amaiso abo.”
english: "There is no fear of God before their eyes."

ekegusii: “Onde tari ore omochenu buna Omonene, onde tari buna ere, egetare kende tikeri buna Nyasae oito.
english: "There is no one holy like the LORD; there is no one besides you; there is no Rock like our God.

ekegusii: “Aye Yesuruni, onde tari ore buna Nyasae oo, oria ogoeta igoro gati ase obonene bwaye gocha kogokonya.
english: "There is no one like the God of Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens to help you and on the clouds in his majesty.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari onga buna aye, gose Nyasae onde tari otatiga aye bweka, koreng’ana buna ayio konya twaigure namato aito.
english: "There is no one like you, O LORD, and there is no God but you, as we have heard with our own ears.

ekegusii: Nyasae one nigo agoteba iga: “Omokori amabe tari nomorembe.”
english: "There is no peace," says my God, "for the wicked."

ekegusii: Omonene otebire, “Omokori amabe tabwati omorembe.”
english: "There is no peace," says the LORD, "for the wicked."

ekegusii: “Narenge omonto gete omonda, orenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga na echi’egatani engiya, na kwegokia kera rituko ase okoria.
english: "There was a rich man who was dressed in purple and fine linen and lived in luxury every day.

ekegusii: “Naende nabibe ebimanyererio ase erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, na ase ense emechando ase ebisaku, nabatang’ang’e ase okoeera kw’enyancha na emerindo yaye.
english: "There will be signs in the sun, moon and stars. On the earth, nations will be in anguish and perplexity at the roaring and tossing of the sea.

ekegusii: Erio namobe nokorera na okoriania amaino, ekero morarore Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, na ababani bonsi ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae, na inwe abanyene namotugutwe isiko.
english: "There will be weeping there, and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac and Jacob and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves thrown out.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna Omonene agoteba: Soka korwa asebare, mweatanane, gose timokuna egento getachenegeti, na inche nimbaroisie.
english: "Therefore come out from them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you."

ekegusii: “Kera oyomo oyokoigwa amang’ana aya aane, na koyakora, nagwekanigwe nomonto orenge omong’aini, oagachete mwaye igoro ase egetare;
english: "Therefore everyone who hears these words of mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock.

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, ichana, ee, ichana obe buna oyo obunekire chibachwa, obe nobororo ase amasio ’abanto abwo.
english: "Therefore groan, son of man! Groan before them with broken heart and bitter grief.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio nimoebererie, imoire ase erooro, erinde nkwane nere amang’ana amororo ay’obwanchani.
english: "Therefore I am now going to allure her; I will lead her into the desert and speak tenderly to her.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire iga: “Inche ningendererete kobagambia inwe ekina, boigo ningambie abana baino, na ororeria rwabo.
english: "Therefore I bring charges against you again," declares the LORD. "And I will bring charges against your children's children.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkamorua na komobeka ase amaboko abanchi baye Abaasuri, abwo arenge nokogania okobe asebare.
english: "Therefore I handed her over to her lovers, the Assyrians, for whom she lusted.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoboria, montegerere, erinde nkwane ayare ase ebirengererio biane.
english: "Therefore I say: Listen to me; I too will tell you what I know.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eye nabatebirie, ng’a oboruoti bwa Nyasae naborusigwe asemore, boegwe egesaku egekwama amatunda aye. [
english: "Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio nabatebirie ng’a timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie, gose eki moranywe, gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeke. Inee! Obogima tibori obonene kobua endagera? Na omobere tori omonene kobua chianga?
english: "Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or drink; or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more important than food, and the body more important than clothes?

ekegusii: Naki amanyekane asemore ng’a ogotooreka oko kwa Nyasae kwairirwe ase abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarabwo nabaigwe.” [
english: "Therefore I want you to know that God's salvation has been sent to the Gentiles, and they will listen!"

ekegusii: “Ase ayio nintagore Samaria obe chitui chi’amagena, obe omogondo ase emesabibu erasimekwe. Ninturunkanie amagena ’omochie oyio gochia ase rigoko, nintubore amaroso aye atigwe maiso marore.
english: "Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble, a place for planting vineyards. I will pour her stones into the valley and lay bare her foundations.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, tinkonyara gokira tinkwana, nimbe ngokwana emechando y’omoyo one na kwemurungania nobororo ase omoyo one.
english: "Therefore I will not keep silent; I will speak out in the anguish of my spirit, I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ning’iranie endagera yane, na edivai yane, ekero engaki eraikerane, boigo ning’ire amarionya aane e ching’ondi, na egatani, ebio namoete atube obogetirianda bwaye.
english: "Therefore I will take away my grain when it ripens, and my new wine when it is ready. I will take back my wool and my linen, intended to cover her nakedness.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, rora, ase engaki eyio ninyemanyekanie ase abanto bamanye chinguru chiane na okobua kwane, erinde bamanye ng’a erieta riane n’Omonene.
english: "Therefore I will teach them-- this time I will teach them my power and might. Then they will know that my name is the LORD.

ekegusii: Renda boigo, ekiagera timomanyeti ekero omonene bw’enyomba agochi‐gocha, gose mogoroba, gose mbotuko gati, gose etuoni gekobuga, gose mambia,
english: "Therefore keep watch because you do not know when the owner of the house will come back-- whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, renda, ekiagera timomanyeti ituko ki Omonene oino agocha.
english: "Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.

ekegusii: Ase igo renda, ekiagera timomanyeti rituko, nonya nensa.
english: "Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.

ekegusii: “Naboigo, tiga enyomba yonsi ya Israeli emanye ekeene ng’a Nyasae obekire Yeso, oyio mwabambete, obeire Omonene naende Kristo.”
english: "Therefore let all Israel be assured of this: God has made this Jesus, whom you crucified, both Lord and Christ."

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, tebia Abaisraeli ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe Abaisraeli, tingokora ayio ase engencho yaino, korende nase engencho y’erieta riane richenu, erio mwakorire koba eritachenegeti ase egati y’ebisaku ebio ase mwagendete.
english: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: It is not for your sake, O house of Israel, that I am going to do these things, but for the sake of my holy name, which you have profaned among the nations where you have gone.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, tebia Abaisraeli ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Eitie moonchoke, motige gosasima emegwekano yaino; onchoka motige ebibe biaino bionsi bi’okogechia.
english: "Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Repent! Turn from your idols and renounce all your detestable practices!

ekegusii: Ase ayio, tebia Abaisraeli ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae akoboria: Inee! Nainwe nigo mwesoirie ase ogotacheneka ase okobwatia chingencho chie chisokoro chiaino na gokora obokayayu ase ogosasima emegwekano yabo y’okogechia?
english: "Therefore say to the house of Israel: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Will you defile yourselves the way your fathers did and lust after their vile images?

ekegusii: Ase ayio obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Amang’ana aane tagotebana nonya ng’ake taikeranigwa, onsi aya nakwanire goika aikeranigwe. Ninche Omonene Nyasae nakwanire.”
english: "Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: None of my words will be delayed any longer; whatever I say will be fulfilled, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: “Ase ayio obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Nonya nabaseririe gochia aare ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku na kobasiarera gochia ase chinse chionsi, inche omonyene nabeire inde obomenyo bwabo obochenu ase engaki eyio enke, agwo ase chinse echio baseretigwe gochia.
english: "Therefore say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Although I sent them far away among the nations and scattered them among the countries, yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries where they have gone.'

ekegusii: “Ase ayio obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Nimbasangererie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, na korwa ase chinse echio ase nabasiarerete gochia, erio mbairanie inwe Abaisraeli, mbae ense yaino.
english: "Therefore say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will gather you from the nations and bring you back from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you back the land of Israel again.'

ekegusii: Gaki, onye tore ababiare ba Nyasae, tetogwenereti gokaga ng’a obonyasae nigo bonga buna omogwekano bw’etahabu, gose efeta, gose rigena, buna ebinto bibaachire ase chisemi na obong’aini bwa mwanyabanto.
english: "Therefore since we are God's offspring, we should not think that the divine being is like gold or silver or stone-- an image made by man's design and skill.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, natebire iga: Nigo nariete eira ng’a abanto b’eamate yao, na ab’ororeria rwa sokororia yao mbabe bagokora emeremo y’obokuani ase obosio bwane kogenderera botambe. Korende bono nigo ngoteba ng’a tinyancheti bo, ekiagera abanto bansigete, nainche nimbasike, na baria banchayete, nabarabwo mbachaywe goetania.
english: "Therefore the LORD, the God of Israel, declares: 'I promised that your house and your father's house would minister before me forever.' But now the LORD declares: 'Far be it from me! Those who honor me I will honor, but those who despise me will be disdained.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio chinchera chiabo nachibe asebare buna chinchera chinterere ase omosunte, agwo ase baraserigwe gochia, bagweo. Nindete obobe igoro asebare ase omwaka oria ndabae egesusuro.” Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: "Therefore their path will become slippery; they will be banished to darkness and there they will fall. I will bring disaster on them in the year they are punished," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, amang’ana ayio naro ndabakorere. Ase ayio, ekiagera ngocha kobakorera ayio, ebeke ang’e, moumerane nainche Nyasae oino.”
english: "Therefore this is what I will do to you, Israel, and because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, O Israel."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’abanto b’Anatoti, abwo bakorigia kong’ita, bagoteba ng’a timbaisa kobana ase erieta ri’Omonene, bateba ng’a inse gokora igo nigo barang’ite.
english: "Therefore this is what the LORD says about the men of Anathoth who are seeking your life and saying, 'Do not prophesy in the name of the LORD or you will die by our hands'--

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri: Ere tagocha ase omochie oyo, gose takorasa omogwe agwo; tagocha ase omochie oyo obogoretie chinguba, gose takoagacha orwaki bosio bwaye.
english: "Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria: "He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.

ekegusii: “Ase igo, aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri: Ere tagocha ase omochie oyo, gose takoruta omogwe aroro; tagocha ase omochie oyo ne chinguba, gose takoagacha eburi bosio bwaye.
english: "Therefore this is what the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria: "He will not enter this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not come before it with shield or build a siege ramp against it.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro amang’ana Omonene agoteba: Mokao nabe omotayayi, abe ogokora obonyaka ase omochie omonene, na abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, mbaitwe nemioro. Oboremo bwao mbwatananwe ase okorengwa nengori; aye omonyene nokwere ase ense etachenegeti. Abaisraeli goika barusigwe ase ense yabo, bairwe ase obosomba.”
english: "Therefore this is what the LORD says: "'Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword. Your land will be measured and divided up, and you yourself will die in a pagan country. And Israel will certainly go into exile, away from their native land.'"

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agochitebia: Inche bweka omonyene ninache ekina ase egati ye ching’ondi chinoru ne chindeu.
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says to them: See, I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the lean sheep.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekiagera aye kwarengereirie ng’a nigo ore omong’aini buna Nyasae,
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Because you think you are wise, as wise as a god,

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Obobe nobw’omochie oyo oiterete amanyinga ’abanto! Nainche boigo nintumbe chinko chibe chinyinge, ase omorero.
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the wood high.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Buna omote bw’omosabibu ore ase egati y’emete ende ere ase rinani orauterwe omorero oyie, naboigo ndatugute abanto ba Yerusalemu.
english: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: As I have given the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest as fuel for the fire, so will I treat the people living in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ekiagera achayete eira eria atianete asende, na agasaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, nimoakane ogokora kwaye komoiranere.
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: As surely as I live, I will bring down on his head my oath that he despised and my covenant that he broke.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekiagera kweimokereretie igoro na ogakina ogaetania emete ende, na enkoro yao ekaenenera obotambe bwaye,
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because it towered on high, lifting its top above the thick foliage, and because it was proud of its height,

ekegusii: “Ase ayio aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ekiagera mwakwanire ay’obong’ainereria naende mwarorire amaroro ay’oborimo, rora, inche nigo inde mamincha yaino. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because of your false words and lying visions, I am against you, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekiagera mwagerire ebibe biaino biainyoirwe, na ogosaria kwaino gwakorirwe kororekane maiso marore, na ase ayio onsi mwakorire, ebibe biaino biarorekanire, ee, ekiagera mwainyoirwe iga, inamobwatwe nokoboko gwe chinguru.”
english: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because you people have brought to mind your guilt by your open rebellion, revealing your sins in all that you do-- because you have done this, you will be taken captive.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora nagechire ebimoya bire namaebi, ebio mokobwatera abanto buna nechinyoni mokobwata; nimbibutore korwa ase amaboko aino, erinde nsibore abanto abwo mwabwatire, barabwo batame buna chinyoni.
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against your magic charms with which you ensnare people like birds and I will tear them from your arms; I will set free the people that you ensnare like birds.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Rora, inche ninche inde mamincha yaino, nimbachere, mbanachere ekina agwo ase egati yaino, ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku.
english: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself am against you, Jerusalem, and I will inflict punishment on you in the sight of the nations.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora, nindete omoro igoro yao, nsirie mwanyabanto ne ching’iti.
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will bring a sword against you and kill your men and their animals.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Bono ning’iranie abooswa ba Yakobo; nindorere egesaku gionsi ki’Abaisraeli amabera; nimbe ne risemi ase erieta riane richenu.
english: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will now bring Jacob back from captivity and will have compassion on all the people of Israel, and I will be zealous for my holy name.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Nintome ekembugu‐mbugu inde nendamwamu na ekeririanda, nintome embura ere ne chinguru, naende ase endamwamu yane nintome embura ere namagena amanene, nsarie bionsi kegima.
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: In my wrath I will unleash a violent wind, and in my anger hailstones and torrents of rain will fall with destructive fury.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ning’umore endamwamu yane enene, na okogechia kwane igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro ase mwanyabanto, ne ching’iti, na emete y’orosana, na ase chindagera chionsi chi’emegondo. Endamwamu eyio yane nigo eroke buna omorero, na onde tari oranyare koyerimia.”
english: "'Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: My anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man and beast, on the trees of the field and on the fruit of the ground, and it will burn and not be quenched.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekiagera kwanyebire inche, naende kwaonchokire, kwang’eire omogongo, goika obogorie egesusuro ekio ase engencho y’obosooku na obonyaka bwao.”
english: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Since you have forgotten me and thrust me behind your back, you must bear the consequences of your lewdness and prostitution."

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Abwo mwaitire baraire ase omochie ime nabwo chinyama, na omochie oyo noro enyanyeni ekoiyeka; korende inwe abanyene nimbasokie korwa ase omochie oyo.
english: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: The bodies you have thrown there are the meat and this city is the pot, but I will drive you out of it.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Inwe mwabeire abebura‐buria kobua ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine, gose timobwateti emeroberio yane echikire, gose timorendeti amachiko aane, na timobwateti nonya namachiko ’ebisaku ebio bibaetanaine.”
english: "Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: You have been more unruly than the nations around you and have not followed my decrees or kept my laws. You have not even conformed to the standards of the nations around you.

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti koranche orue ogochika kw’oboruoti ng’a Vasti tabaisa kororekana ogocha ase obosio bwao nonya ndinde rionsi, aye omoruoti Ahaswero. Orike ogochika okwo ase amachiko ’Abaayemi na ay’Abamedia arikire, erinde ayio tanyara koonchorwa. Aye omoruoti ochore omokungu omoao ore omuya kobua Vasti, omoe obonene obwo bw’oboruoti.
english: "Therefore, if it pleases the king, let him issue a royal decree and let it be written in the laws of Persia and Media, which cannot be repealed, that Vashti is never again to enter the presence of King Xerxes. Also let the king give her royal position to someone else who is better than she.

ekegusii: Nabo gokorenta esadaka yao ase egesasimero korainyore ng’a oyomino nare ne ring’ana asore,
english: "Therefore, if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you,

ekegusii: Ase ayio baminto, tiga amanyekane asemore ng’a goetera ase oyio nigo mokoranderigwa okwaberwa kw’ebibe,
english: "Therefore, my brothers, I want you to know that through Jesus the forgiveness of sins is proclaimed to you.

ekegusii: “Aya naro inche Omonene, Nyasae ngoteba: Inwe Abaisraeli ase engencho y’ayio nimbanachere ekina, kera omonto anacherwe buna chinchera chiaye chire. Onchoka! Motige ogosaria kwaino gwonsi, erinde obobe bwaino tiboba ekegocha gi’okobasiria.
english: "Therefore, O house of Israel, I will judge you, each one according to his ways, declares the Sovereign LORD. Repent! Turn away from all your offenses; then sin will not be your downfall.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye Oholiba, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Naama! Ninseegete abanchi bao abwo kwagechetigwe nabarabwo, nimbarente bakorwanie korwa ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: "Therefore, Oholibah, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will stir up your lovers against you, those you turned away from in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side--

ekegusii: Ase igo otebie Abaisraeli ng’a, Inche ninche Omonene, ndabarusie korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri. Nimbatoorie korwa ase obosomba bwaino. Ase okoboko kwane koramboire, na goetera ase ebisusuro ebinene, nimbaboorie.
english: "Therefore, say to the Israelites: 'I am the LORD, and I will bring you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians. I will free you from being slaves to them, and I will redeem you with an outstretched arm and with mighty acts of judgment.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye mwanyabanto, ebeke ang’e amo nebinto biao, obe buna omonto okong’anya korwa ase ense yaye, ong’anye mobaso ekero abanto baroche. Ong’anye korwa aase ao otaare goika aase aande kobaroche. Ande nabo barabaise komanya nonya bare abanto batari koigwera.
english: "Therefore, son of man, pack your belongings for exile and in the daytime, as they watch, set out and go from where you are to another place. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious house.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye mwanyabanto, bana otebie Gogi ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli, abanto baane, mbabe bamenyete ase obotoereru, nario oramanye amang’ana ayio.
english: "Therefore, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: In that day, when my people Israel are living in safety, will you not take notice of it?

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, tebia abanto bao ng’a ekero omonyaboronge aratige oboronge bwaye akore ebibe, oboronge boria bwaye tibokomotooria; na ekero omokori amabe araonchoke atige obobe bwaye, obobe boria bwaye tibokomoita, kareitie na kobotiga. Omonyaboronge takoba moyo ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye rituko riria arakore ebibe.
english: "Therefore, son of man, say to your countrymen, 'The righteousness of the righteous man will not save him when he disobeys, and the wickedness of the wicked man will not cause him to fall when he turns from it. The righteous man, if he sins, will not be allowed to live because of his former righteousness.'

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye mwanyabanto, kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase amang’ana ayio chisokoro chiaino nigo chiandamete ase ogotaba abegenwa asende.
english: "Therefore, son of man, speak to the people of Israel and say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: In this also your fathers blasphemed me by forsaking me:

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomoruoti origetie gokora omobaro nabasomba baye.
english: "Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli agoteba: Naama! Nanachire ekina, ase ebirengererio biane ng’a nimbarentere amaakwa na kobasiria inwe Abayuda bonsi.
english: "Therefore, this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I am determined to bring disaster on you and to destroy all Judah.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, oyore Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Naama! Inche nkorenta nde amabe onsi nakwanete achiche igoro y’Abayuda na abanto bonsi ba Yerusalemu, ekiagera nabeire ngokwana nabarabwo, korende barabwo bangire koigwera; nabeire nkobarangeria, korende bangire goitaba.”
english: "Therefore, this is what the LORD God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'Listen! I am going to bring on Judah and on everyone living in Jerusalem every disaster I pronounced against them. I spoke to them, but they did not listen; I called to them, but they did not answer.'"

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Inche nairanire Yerusalemu na koyororera amabera. Enyomba neagachwe imeo, na engori y’okorengera eramborwe igoro ya Yerusalemu. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
english: "Therefore, this is what the LORD says: 'I will return to Jerusalem with mercy, and there my house will be rebuilt. And the measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem,' declares the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba: Inwe mwangire konyigwera, na koraria obosibore kera omonto ase oyomwabo, na ase omogisangio oye. Rora inche nkobaa nde inwe obosibore bwaino; obosibore obwo nabwo obo: Nigo moraitwe nemioro, na oborwaire bogoita, na enchara. Na amaruoti onsi ay’ense naondoke ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio ndabakorere inwe.
english: "Therefore, this is what the LORD says: You have not obeyed me; you have not proclaimed freedom for your fellow countrymen. So I now proclaim 'freedom' for you, declares the LORD-- 'freedom' to fall by the sword, plague and famine. I will make you abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth.

ekegusii: Inee! Karache omonyene omogondo, naki arakore abaremi baria?”
english: "Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?"

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye omotayayi, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
english: "'Therefore, you prostitute, hear the word of the LORD!

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, inwe abarisia, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: "'Therefore, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

ekegusii: Naende omonene otebire: Inche nigo inde mamincha y’ababani abwo bakoiba na koura abande amang’ana aane.
english: "Therefore," declares the LORD, "I am against the prophets who steal from one another words supposedly from me.

ekegusii: “Nase chinyoni chirabe okogechia asemore motarie nachio echi: Ekeongo, na ensoti, na obotere;
english: "'These are the birds you are to detest and not eat because they are detestable: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

ekegusii: "These are the laws you are to set before them:
english: “Aya naro amachiko orae Abaisraeli:

ekegusii: “Naende nareo Amatuko ande Amanene ay’Omonene, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima, moyararie ase engaki yachikire.
english: "'These are the LORD's appointed feasts, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times:

ekegusii: “Ebi nabio ebirengo bi’egesasimero, ase ekerengo ki’amaboko amo neki’obogare bw’egesanyi: Enterekerero yaye nigo yarenge ey’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo korwa inse gochia igoro, na obogare gochia ase egesasimero ekenyene okoboko okomo. Orosingo roetanaine omogo bw’enterekerero eria nigo rwarenge orw’ekerengo gi’ekeng’ese gi’okoboko okomo gochia igoro. Eyio nigo yarenge enterekerero yaye.
english: "These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits, that cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: Its gutter is a cubit deep and a cubit wide, with a rim of one span around the edge. And this is the height of the altar:

ekegusii: “Abanto aba nabwo bagochia kogokonya gwatanana ense: Ritang’ani Eleazari omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.
english: "These are the names of the men who are to assign the land for you as an inheritance: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika gotenenerete ching’iti ne chinyoni, na kera egetongwa kere moyo kegoetanana ase amache ime, na ebitongwa ebisinini bigoetanana ase ense,
english: "'These are the regulations concerning animals, birds, every living thing that moves in the water and every creature that moves about on the ground.

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika ase omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma. Ase rituko riria arabe agochenwa arentwe ase omokuani,
english: "These are the regulations for the diseased person at the time of his ceremonial cleansing, when he is brought to the priest:

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe, ekio omonto ararente ase Omonene.
english: "'These are the regulations for the fellowship offering a person may present to the LORD:

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okoruegwa kw’endagera: Abamura ba Haroni babe bakorua okoruegwa kw’endagera ase obosio bw’Omonene, agwo ase egesasimero.
english: "'These are the regulations for the grain offering: Aaron's sons are to bring it before the LORD, in front of the altar.

ekegusii: "'These are the regulations for the guilt offering, which is most holy:
english: “Oko nakwo ogochika gw’okorua ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha. Ekio nekeng’wanso egechenu mono.

ekegusii: “Oyo noro omoroberio buna ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli biramenye: Egesaku kia Dani keegwe orogongo rwa sugusu. Ribebe riabo ribwatie enchera ya Heteloni agwo ase egesoero kia Hamati, rigenderere gochia Hasari‐Enoni, omochie ore ase ribebe ria sugusu ria Damesiki. Orogongo orwo rwa Dani nigo rorabe korwa ensinyo ya moocha y’ense eyio goika ensinyo ya bosongo.
english: "These are the tribes, listed by name: At the northern frontier, Dan will have one portion; it will follow the Hethlon road to Lebo Hamath; Hazar Enan and the northern border of Damascus next to Hamath will be part of its border from the east side to the west side.

ekegusii: Okwo nogochika kwa boronge korabe asemore ebiaare ase ebiaare, aase aande onsi ase morabe momenyete.
english: "'These are to be legal requirements for you throughout the generations to come, wherever you live.

ekegusii: “Abanto aba babeire abasani baito, tiga bamenye ase ense yaito, babe abaonchoreria, ekiagera ense eye nenene, nebaisaine. Intwe tonyuome abaiseke babo, na barabwo banyuome abaito.
english: "These men are friendly toward us," they said. "Let them live in our land and trade in it; the land has plenty of room for them. We can marry their daughters and they can marry ours.

ekegusii: “Abanto aba nigo bansigete ase ebikoba biabo igoro, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa asende.
english: "'These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.

ekegusii: "These will be the exits of the city: Beginning on the north side, which is 4,500 cubits long,
english: “Ebi nabio birabe ebiita bi’omochie oyio orabe nekerengo gie chimoti chilifu inye, na amagana atano (4,500):

ekegusii: Erio barabwo nabamoiranerie: Omonene, indi twakoroche aye kore nenchara, gose kore nerang’o, gose kore omogeni, gose kore getirianda, gose kore omorwaire, gose kore echela ime, na titwagokorera?
english: "They also will answer, 'Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or needing clothes or sick or in prison, and did not help you?'

ekegusii: “Bono batang’ang’ire, tibakonyara kong’iraneria nonya ng’ake; tibabwati ring’ana bagokwana.
english: "They are dismayed and have no more to say; words have failed them.

ekegusii: Yusufu akamoiraneria, “Aba nabana baane Nyasae ang’erete aiga.” Erio Israeli akamotebia, “Bandetere aiga asende, mbasesenie.”
english: "They are the sons God has given me here," Joseph said to his father. Then Israel said, "Bring them to me so I may bless them."

ekegusii: Barabwo babuuche ribu, naende batube egesasimero negetambaa kere monyinga.
english: "They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and spread a purple cloth over it.

ekegusii: “Erio baimokie egetambaa kere buru kegima, batube ekebekerero gie chitaya amo ne chitaya chiaye, na ebinachi, ne chindogio chiaye, ne chichuba chire namaguta ’amazeituni, ebinto bigokorerwa ase emeremo y’obokuani.
english: "They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand that is for light, together with its lamps, its wick trimmers and trays, and all its jars for the oil used to supply it.

ekegusii: Nabaimokie ebinto bionsi bigokorerwa ase emeremo agwo ase Obomenyo Obochenu. Babibeke ime ase egetambaa kere buru kegima; erio babitube ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche na kobibeka ase ekebogorerio.
english: "They are to take all the articles used for ministering in the sanctuary, wrap them in a blue cloth, cover that with hides of sea cows and put them on a carrying frame.

ekegusii: “Omonene, aba nigo bare abasomba bao na abanto bao. Naye kwababooretie nokobua kwao okonene goetera ase okoboko kwao kore ne chinguru.
english: "They are your servants and your people, whom you redeemed by your great strength and your mighty hand.

ekegusii: “Nigo bakogokia omoruoti nogokora kwabo okobe, na kogokia abagambi nobong’ainereria bwabo.
english: "They delight the king with their wickedness, the princes with their lies.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gokora ayare amaya. Nigo bagachete ebinto bi’obouri na ebi’oboibi ase chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u.”
english: "They do not know how to do right," declares the LORD, "who hoard plunder and loot in their fortresses."

ekegusii: “Naende nigo batomete amang’ana bakarangeria abanto korwa chinse chi’aare. Barabwo bagacha, na ase engencho yabo aye ogesibia, ogeaka amaiso ao chirangi ao ao, na ogechabera nebinto ebiya.
english: "They even sent messengers for men who came from far away, and when they arrived you bathed yourself for them, painted your eyes and put on your jewelry.

ekegusii: Omonto oria akamotebia, “Barure aa, bachiire, naki nigo nabaigwa bagotebania: Tiga togende Dotani.” Erio Yusufu akababwatia korwa nyuma, akabanyora Dotani.
english: "They have moved on from here," the man answered. "I heard them say, 'Let's go to Dothan.'" So Joseph went after his brothers and found them near Dothan.

ekegusii: Aye nigo oratebe, “Nigo bang’agete bororo, korende tinyigweti bobe; nigo bang’wanetie bokong’u, korende tinyigweti kende. Indi ngocha koboka? Ngende korigia eyende.”
english: "They hit me," you will say, "but I'm not hurt! They beat me, but I don't feel it! When will I wake up so I can find another drink?"

ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibamanyeti gento, tibari nobong’aini, nigo bagotaara bakona‐kouna‐una ime ase omosunte; amaroso ’ense anyegerigwe.
english: "They know nothing, they understand nothing. They walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagokumba chimeme chiabo buna amata; oborimo nigo bomentete koba obonge kobua ekeene ase ense yabo. Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Nigo bagendererete komenta ebibe ase ebibe binde, gose tibamanyeti inche.”
english: "They make ready their tongue like a bow, to shoot lies; it is not by truth that they triumph in the land. They go from one sin to another; they do not acknowledge me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Omokuani tabaisa konyuoma omokungu omotayayi, gose oyotari omwekungi, gose oyobatiganire nomosacha oye, ekiagera omokuani nigo achenegete ase Nyasae oye.
english: "'They must not marry women defiled by prostitution or divorced from their husbands, because priests are holy to their God.

ekegusii: “Abakuani abwo tibagokigita chitukia chi’emetwe yabo, gose tibagochitiga chitambee, korende nigo barachinache chieng’ee.
english: "'They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but they are to keep the hair of their heads trimmed.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo babusuire embeo, mbagese ekembugu‐mbugu. Ebimeri bigokina ase emegondo yabo tibigosomoria, ase ayio tibikwama chindagera. Biise kwama, abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni mbache bachigese.
english: "They sow the wind and reap the whirlwind. The stalk has no head; it will produce no flour. Were it to yield grain, foreigners would swallow it up.

ekegusii: Inyora ng’a nabwo baigwerete ogosemia kwa Baalamu, bakagera Abaisraeli tibaba abegenwa ase Omonene, ekero barenge agwo Peori, na ase ayio amaakwa agacha ase egati y’omoganda bw’abanto b’Omonene.
english: "They were the ones who followed Balaam's advice and were the means of turning the Israelites away from the LORD in what happened at Peor, so that a plague struck the LORD's people.

ekegusii: Ense eyio nesarigwe ebe bosa ase egati ye chinse chinde chisaregete chikaba bosa, na emechie yaye nesarigwe ebe bosa ase egati y’emechie ende esaregete ekaba bosa.
english: "'They will be desolate among desolate lands, and their cities will lie among ruined cities.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Abanto aba mbabe abanto baane bori ase rituko erio ndakore ring’ana, nimbarorere amabera buna omonto akorora amabera ase omwana oye okomokorera.
english: "They will be mine," says the LORD Almighty, "in the day when I make up my treasured possession. I will spare them, just as in compassion a man spares his son who serves him.

ekegusii: Amarwaire amabe nabaite bakwe. Tibakoreerwa, gose gotindekwa, korende emebere yabo nigo erabe buna obwoyo igoro ase ense. Nigo baraitwe nemioro na enchara, na emebere yabo ekwete nebe endagera ye chinyoni chia igoro na eye ching’iti chi’ense.
english: "They will die of deadly diseases. They will not be mourned or buried but will be like refuse lying on the ground. They will perish by sword and famine, and their dead bodies will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth."

ekegusii: Mbaragere, korende tibakoigota; mbabe bagokora obonyaka, korende tibakomentekana, ekiagera bantigire inche Omonene, na baonchokeire chinyasae ching’ao.
english: "They will eat but not have enough; they will engage in prostitution but not increase, because they have deserted the LORD to give themselves

ekegusii: “Ekero ndabaserie gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku na mbasiarere gochia ase chinse ching’ao, barabwo mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene.
english: "They will know that I am the LORD, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

ekegusii: Yeremia akamotebia, “Tokobekwa ase amaboko abo. Igwera amang’ana ’Omonene aya nkogotebia, erio nario amang’ana arabe amaya asore, aye notigwe obe moyo.
english: "They will not hand you over," Jeremiah replied. "Obey the LORD by doing what I tell you. Then it will go well with you, and your life will be spared.

ekegusii: Ekero barabe bairanire ase ense eyio, mbatugute korwa aroro emegwekano egosasimwa ey’obosooku, na okogechia gwonsi.
english: "They will return to it and remove all its vile images and detestable idols.

ekegusii: “Okwama koria omoyo oo oganetie kwagosireirie, na ebinto bionsi ebiterere. Na ebinto bikomeka‐meka biagosireirie, gose tokonyara kobinyora naende nonya ng’ake!”
english: "They will say, 'The fruit you longed for is gone from you. All your riches and splendor have vanished, never to be recovered.'

ekegusii: “Boigo nakoeire okoruegwa Abaisraeli barabe bakorenta asende buna ebing’wanso bi’ogosungusia. Nakoeire aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, nabibe ebiaino kogenderera botambe. Kera omonto ochenegete ore ase enyomba yao nanyare koria ebinto ebio.
english: "This also is yours: whatever is set aside from the gifts of all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I give this to you and your sons and daughters as your regular share. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

ekegusii: “Eye nero emeremo y’Abalawi: Abwo bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na etano, na goetania, nigo barabe bagokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: "This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years old or more shall come to take part in the work at the Tent of Meeting,

ekegusii: Agwo nao korabe okomanya okore nobong’aini. Emetwe eria etano na ebere nebitunwa bitano na bibere, aase omokungu oria aikaransete.
english: "This calls for a mind with wisdom. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.

ekegusii: Rituko eri inaribe asemore rituko rikoinyorwa, na inwe morirende ribe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene. Nigo moraribwate ebiaare ase ebiaare, ribe rituko rinene ri’omoyega goika kare na kare.”
english: "This is a day you are to commemorate; for the generations to come you shall celebrate it as a festival to the LORD-- a lasting ordinance.

ekegusii: Oyo nigo orabe omoroberio ochikire oragenderere botambe ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase morabe mokomenya, ng’a timobaisa koria ebitinya, gose konywa amanyinga.”
english: "'This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live: You must not eat any fat or any blood.'"

ekegusii: “Oyo noro omoroberio inche Omonene nachikire: Tebia Abaisraeli ng’a barente eng’ombe eaberi embariri etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, naende etana kobekerwa rikorogoto ase ogokorigwa emeremo.
english: "This is a requirement of the law that the LORD has commanded: Tell the Israelites to bring you a red heifer without defect or blemish and that has never been under a yoke.

ekegusii: Igo arasoe ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono nyuma karentire eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
english: "This is how Aaron is to enter the sanctuary area: with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

ekegusii: Naboigo are ere oyokwegachera emonga omonyene, na ere tari omonda ase Nyasae.”
english: "This is how it will be with anyone who stores up things for himself but is not rich toward God."

ekegusii: Naboigo na Tata one ore igoro arabakorere nainwe, onye timokwabera abamino ase chinkoro chiaino ime.”
english: "This is how my heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother from your heart."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Aya naro amanyinga aane, ay’okobwatana okoyia, aitekire ase engencho y’abange.
english: "This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many," he said to them.

ekegusii: “Aase aa nao obotimokero bwane bwa botambe, aa nao ndabe nkomenya, ekiagera naanchire.
english: "This is my resting place for ever and ever; here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it--

ekegusii: Musa oyio nere otebetie Abaisraeli ng’a: Nyasae nabaimokerie omobani onga buna inche korwa ase egati y’abamino.
english: "This is that Moses who told the Israelites, 'God will send you a prophet like me from your own people.'

ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Oko nakwo okobwatana ndakore n’Abaisraeli nyuma y’amatuko ayio: Nimbeke amachiko aane ime yabo; ninyarike ase chinkoro chiabo. Inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto baane.
english: "This is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after that time," declares the LORD. "I will put my law in their minds and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okobwatana ndache kobwatana nabarabwo nyuma y’amatuko ayio, Omonene otebire: Nimbeke amachiko aane ase chinkoro chiabo ime, ninyarike ase ebirengererio biabo.”
english: "This is the covenant I will make with them after that time, says the Lord. I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds."

ekegusii: “Echio nachio chindoto inche Nebukadinesaro omoruoti narota. Aye Beli‐Tesasari, intebie engencho yaye, ekiagera abanto abang’aini bonsi bare ase oboruoti bwane basinyirwe gontebia engencho yaye, korende aye nonyare, ekiagera omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yao.”
english: "This is the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, had. Now, Belteshazzar, tell me what it means, for none of the wise men in my kingdom can interpret it for me. But you can, because the spirit of the holy gods is in you."

ekegusii: “Oyo noro omoerio bw’amang’ana ayio. Inche Danieli nkaba ng’ondogete ase ebirengererio biane, na obosio bwane bokaonchoka bokarachoka; korende nkagacha amang’ana aria ase enkoro yane ime.”
english: "This is the end of the matter. I, Daniel, was deeply troubled by my thoughts, and my face turned pale, but I kept the matter to myself."

ekegusii: "This is the inscription that was written: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN
english: “Amariko arigetwe naro aya: MENE, MENE, TEKELI, NA‐PARISINI.

ekegusii: “Aye omoruoti, engencho ye chindoto chiria neye: Okonachwa kw’amang’ana aya nigo kwarurwe n’Oyore Igoro Mono gocha asore, aye omoruoti, omonene one.
english: "This is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree the Most High has issued against my lord the king:

ekegusii: Ayio naro amagombo arabokigwe igoro ya Misiri. Abakungu b’ebisaku mbabokie amagombo igoro yaye, na igoro y’emeganda yaye yonsi. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: "This is the lament they will chant for her. The daughters of the nations will chant it; for Egypt and all her hordes they will chant it, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Chinsemo chiatigaire nachio echi: Chinsemo chionsi chi’Abafilisti, na ense yonsi y’Abagesuri.
english: "This is the land that remains: all the regions of the Philistines and Geshurites:

ekegusii: “Eye nero ense moraatanane ase ogoaka obomera, ebe emiando y’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli. Ebio nabio birabe ebitari biabo. Nabo inche Omonene Nyasae natebire.
english: "This is the land you are to allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these will be their portions," declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase oyoriete eira ng’a abe Omwerwa bw’Omonene, goika arue ase Omonene aya amorierete eira akorua ore Omwerwa oye, korende onye orire eira arue goetania, goika ayeikeranie kegima koreng’ana nogochika gw’okwerwa.
english: "'This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD in accordance with his separation, in addition to whatever else he can afford. He must fulfill the vow he has made, according to the law of the Nazirite.'"

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika gwe Hekalu: Igoro y’egetunwa, na aase onsi areo, nabe aachenu mono; ee, okwo nakwo ogochika gwe Hekalu.
english: "This is the law of the temple: All the surrounding area on top of the mountain will be most holy. Such is the law of the temple.

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo ogochika: Omonto onde bwensi orasoe eema eria omonto akwereire ime yaye, na omonto onde bwensi ore imeo, nabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: "This is the law that applies when a person dies in a tent: Anyone who enters the tent and anyone who is in it will be unclean for seven days,

ekegusii: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio asore korwa ase Omonene, ng’a naikeranie amang’ana ayio atebire:
english: "'This is the LORD's sign to you that the LORD will do what he has promised:

ekegusii: "This is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.
english: Omoreng’anio noro oyo: Embusuro nering’ana ria Nyasae.

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okoruegwa Haroni na abamura baye bararue asende inche Omonene ase rituko riria onde obo araakwe amaguta na gwatananwa: Ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke, buna okoruegwa kw’endagera gwa kera rituko, ekemo mambia na ekende mogoroba.
english: "This is the offering Aaron and his sons are to bring to the LORD on the day he is anointed: a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering, half of it in the morning and half in the evening.

ekegusii: “Musa nere oyio bangete, bagateba: Ning’o okobegete koba omonene gose omogambi? Nere otometwe na Nyasae, goetera ase amaboko ’omomalaika oria omoorokerete ase egetutu keria, koba omonene na omosibori.
english: "This is the same Moses whom they had rejected with the words, 'Who made you ruler and judge?' He was sent to be their ruler and deliverer by God himself, through the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

ekegusii: Eye nero emeremo abanto be chiamate chia Gerisoni barakore naende buna barabe bakobogoria ebinto ebi:
english: "This is the service of the Gershonite clans as they work and carry burdens:

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okorua morarente: Ebimunu bibere korwa ase ebitonga ikomi bi’engano, na ebimunu bibere korwa ase ebitonga ikomi bi’esairi.
english: "'This is the special gift you are to offer: a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat and a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley.

ekegusii: Eyio nenchera y’omokungu omotomani: Nigo akoria na otinyia omonwa oye, erio oteba, “Inche tindakora obonyaka bonde.”
english: "This is the way of an adulteress: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, 'I've done nothing wrong.'

ekegusii: Emeremo Abakohati barakore agwo ase Eema eria nokorenda ebinto bire ebichenu mono.
english: "This is the work of the Kohathites in the Tent of Meeting: the care of the most holy things.

ekegusii: Omoroberio oyio ochikirwe asemore oragenderere botambe, ng’a okobwatanigwa kobe kogokorerwa ase Abaisraeli ara rimo ase omwaka ase okobachena korwa ase ebibe biabo bionsi.” Musa agakora buna Omonene amochigete.
english: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: Atonement is to be made once a year for all the sins of the Israelites." And it was done, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: “Oyo noro omoroberio ochikire asemore moragenderere korenda botambe. Rituko ria ikomi, ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere, inamobe mokweng’ata na gweitia; timokora emeremo ende yonsi, inwe abanyene, gose abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino.
english: "This is to be a lasting ordinance for you: On the tenth day of the seventh month you must deny yourselves and not do any work-- whether native-born or an alien living among you--

ekegusii: “Eri nario rirabe ribebe riaino: Ribebe ria sugusu richakere korwa ase Enyancha Enene, rietere emechie ya Heteloni, na Sedadi,
english: "This is to be the boundary of the land: "On the north side it will run from the Great Sea by the Hethlon road past Lebo Hamath to Zedad,

ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya naro inche Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, ngoteba: Omonene, Nyasae o igoro, ong’eire amaruoti onsi are ase ense. Ere onchikire imoaagachere enyomba aaria Yerusalemu, omochie ore ase ense y’Abayuda.
english: "This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: "'The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth and he has appointed me to build a temple for him at Jerusalem in Judah.

ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya naro inche Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, ngoteba: Omonene, Nyasae o igoro, ong’eire amaruoti onsi are ase ense. Ere onchikire imoagachere enyomba aaria Yerusalemu, omochie ore ase ense y’Abayuda. Onde bwensi ore ase egati yaino, ore bw’abanto baye, tiga atiire agende aroro, na Omonene, Nyasae oye, abe amo nere.”
english: "This is what Cyrus king of Persia says: "'The LORD, the God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth and he has appointed me to build a temple for him at Jerusalem in Judah. Anyone of his people among you-- may the LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.'"

ekegusii: Yusufu akamotebia, “Engencho y’okorota okwo nero eye: Chinsagia echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.
english: "This is what it means," Joseph said to him. "The three branches are three days.

ekegusii: Na Yusufu akamoiraneria, “Engencho y’okorota okwo nero eye: Chinteru echio isato, ayio namatuko atato.
english: "This is what it means," Joseph said. "The three baskets are three days.

ekegusii: “Aya naro inche Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, ngokwana: Ninki mosemeretie, inwe abamonaaririe agwo Yerusalemu?
english: "This is what Sennacherib king of Assyria says: On what are you basing your confidence, that you remain in Jerusalem under siege?

ekegusii: “Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Monache ebina bia boronge, na kera omonto abe nobwanchani na amabera ase oyomwabo.
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Administer true justice; show mercy and compassion to one another.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Boria abakuani naki amachiko agoteba.
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Ask the priests what the law says:

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Korabwatie chinchera chiane, na obwate aya nagochikeire, rirorio nogambere enyomba yane, na orende chiraaro chiane. Ninkoe ribaga ogochera asende amo nabwo bagonkorera aiga.
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'If you will walk in my ways and keep my requirements, then you will govern my house and have charge of my courts, and I will give you a place among these standing here.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Ara rimo naende, engaki enke yatigaire nintengechie igoro chionsi, na ense, na enyancha, amo nense enyomo.
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'In a little while I will once more shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba, “Aase aiga are buna erooro ase abanto batamenyeti, gose ching’iti, korende emechie yaye yonsi nemenywe nabarisia bakorisia ching’ondi naende.
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'In this place, desolate and without men or animals-- in all its towns there will again be pastures for shepherds to rest their flocks.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: “Menta ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa ase ebing’wanso binde, morie chinyama echio.
english: "'This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go ahead, add your burnt offerings to your other sacrifices and eat the meat yourselves!

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Genda okwane n’Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu, obaborie: Inee! Timori gwancha amorokererio na koigwera amang’ana aane inche Omonene?
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Go and tell the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem, 'Will you not learn a lesson and obey my words?' declares the LORD.

ekegusii: aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atebire: “Nabunire rikorogoto ri’omoruoti o Babeli.
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Naama! Inche nkorenta inde ase omochie oyo omonene na ase emechie yaye yonsi amang’ana onsi amabe natebete ng’a nindete, ekiagera abanto nigo bare abanyabigoti bikong’u bangire koigwera amang’ana aane.”
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'Listen! I am going to bring on this city and the villages around it every disaster I pronounced against them, because they were stiff-necked and would not listen to my words.'"

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Inwe mwarorire amabe onsi narentete ase Yerusalemu, na ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda. Nonya ngoika rero emechie eyio nigo esaregete, na onde tamenyeti aroro,
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You saw the great disaster I brought on Jerusalem and on all the towns of Judah. Today they lie deserted and in ruins

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Aye gwatomire rirube ase erieta riao gochia ase abanto bonsi bare Yerusalemu, na ase Sefania, mosinto o Maaseya omokuani, na ase abakuani bonsi. Ase rirube erio kwarikire iga:
english: "This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You sent letters in your own name to all the people in Jerusalem, to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the other priests. You said to Zephaniah,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na Omobooria obo, oyore Omonene b’Emeganda, agoteba: “Ninche oyo bwe ritang’ani, na oyo bw’omoerio; onde tari, otatiga inche bweka inde Nyasae.
english: "This is what the LORD says-- Israel's King and Redeemer, the LORD Almighty: I am the first and I am the last; apart from me there is no God.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli na Omotongi obo, agoteba: “Mborie inche igoro y’amang’ana agochia koba; ntige inyechandere abana baane, ekiagera abwo nemeremo y’amaboko aane.
english: "This is what the LORD says-- the Holy One of Israel, and its Maker: Concerning things to come, do you question me about my children, or give me orders about the work of my hands?

ekegusii: Omonene ochorire Koresi, omobwatire okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, amobuere ebisaku na aure abaruoti okobua kwabo. Amoigorere ebisieri, na ebiita tibisiekwa. Bono aya naro Omonene akomotebia:
english: "This is what the LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I take hold of to subdue nations before him and to strip kings of their armor, to open doors before him so that gates will not be shut:

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Omobooria oo, oyogotongete ase enda ya nyoko, agoteba: “Ninche Omonene natongete ebinto bionsi; ninche bweka naramborete igoro chionsi, nkaara ense gochia chinsinyo chionsi, na onde tarengeo onkonyete.
english: "This is what the LORD says-- your Redeemer, who formed you in the womb: I am the LORD, who has made all things, who alone stretched out the heavens, who spread out the earth by myself,

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene oyotongete ense, oyo oyebombete akayekora egenderere kobao, ere oyio erieta riaye n’Omonene, agoteba:
english: "This is what the LORD says, he who made the earth, the LORD who formed it and established it-- the LORD is his name:

ekegusii: “Aya naro inche Omonene ngoteba: Twaigure eriogi ri’okorera kw’omoondoko, okorera kw’obwoba na tikori okw’omorembe.
english: "This is what the LORD says: "'Cries of fear are heard-- terror, not peace.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Naama! Ning’iranie abanto ba Yakobo ase chiema chiabo, nimbe namabera ase obomenyo bwabo. Omochie o Yerusalemu noagachwe naende ase orenge. Na enyomba y’omoruoti neagachwe ase yarenge.
english: "This is what the LORD says: "'I will restore the fortunes of Jacob's tents and have compassion on his dwellings; the city will be rebuilt on her ruins, and the palace will stand in its proper place.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Abanto abwo bonsi abagokonya Abamisiri mbagwe, na okobua kwabo kw’obonene ngosirigwe; abanto mbaitwe nemioro ase ense eye korwa Migidoli goikera Siwene. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: "'This is what the LORD says: "'The allies of Egypt will fall and her proud strength will fail. From Migdol to Aswan they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Ogochandeka kwaino tigokogwenigwa, amaote aino abeire amabe mono.
english: "This is what the LORD says: "'Your wound is incurable, your injury beyond healing.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba, “Buna koreng’ana narentete amabe aria onsi amanene igoro ase abanto aba, naboigo ngochia kobarentera amaya onsi aya nabarierete eira kobarentera.
english: "This is what the LORD says: As I have brought all this great calamity on this people, so I will give them all the prosperity I have promised them.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Timobaisa kweng’aina na goteba ng’a Abakalidayo tibakoirana gocha kobarwania; goika bairane gocha.
english: "This is what the LORD says: Do not deceive yourselves, thinking, 'The Babylonians will surely leave us.' They will not!

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Nakorete okobwatana kwane igoro y’omobaso na obotuko, erinde bibe bikororekana ase chingaki chiabo chichikire, na okobwatana okwo tikogosareka.
english: "This is what the LORD says: 'If you can break my covenant with the day and my covenant with the night, so that day and night no longer come at their appointed time,

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ase enchera eyio nabo inche ndasarie oboenenu bw’Abayuda na oboenenu obonene mono bw’abanto ba Yerusalemu.
english: "This is what the LORD says: 'In the same way I will ruin the pride of Judah and the great pride of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ee, Omonene otebire iga: Ningotubokerie obobe korwa ase enyomba yao; nkoure abakungu bao, mbae omonto omoao, nere arare nabarabwo maiso marore.
english: "This is what the LORD says: 'Out of your own household I am going to bring calamity upon you. Before your very eyes I will take your wives and give them to one who is close to you, and he will lie with your wives in broad daylight.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene atebire: Otenene ase eraaro y’enyomba y’Omonene, na okwane nabanto b’emechie yonsi y’Abayuda bagocha gosasima ase enyomba eyio. Obatebie amang’ana onsi pi, ayio ndagochike okwane nabarabwo. Tobaisa gotiga nonya ne ring’ana erimo otabatebie.
english: "This is what the LORD says: Stand in the courtyard of the LORD's house and speak to all the people of the towns of Judah who come to worship in the house of the LORD. Tell them everything I command you; do not omit a word.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Omonto oratigare kobeera ase omochie oyo naitwe nomoro, gose nenchara, gose noborwaire bogoita, korende oyo orasoke korwa aiga, na erue ase Abakalidayo, oyio nagenderere koba moyo. Oyio natooreke, tabaisa goitwa ase esegi.
english: "This is what the LORD says: 'Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague, but whoever goes over to the Babylonians will live. He will escape with his life; he will live.'

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba, “Abanto nigo bagokwana ng’a aase aiga asarekire, abeire buna erooro, abanto tibaiyo, gose ching’iti, ee, amaene emechie y’Abayuda ne chinchera chia Yerusalemu biatigaire bosa; abanto tibaiyo, gose ching’iti.
english: "This is what the LORD says: 'You say about this place, "It is a desolate waste, without men or animals." Yet in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that are deserted, inhabited by neither men nor animals, there will be heard once more

ekegusii: “Aye Baruku, aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akogotebia:
english: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to you, Baruch:

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Genda okwane na Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, omotebie ng’a aya naro inche Omonene ngoteba: Rora, nkobeka inde omochie oyo ase okoboko kw’omoruoti o Babeli. Omoruoti oyio nayosambe nomorero.
english: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Go to Zedekiah king of Judah and tell him, 'This is what the LORD says: I am about to hand this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Nigo nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania ne chisokoro chiaino ekero nachirusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nkabasibora korwa ase ense eria y’obosomba, nkabatebia:
english: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I made a covenant with your forefathers when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery. I said,

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Abayuda abwo narusirie aase aiga na kobaira ase obosomba ase ense y’Abakalidayo nimbabare ng’a nabaya buna amako ayio are amaya.
english: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Like these good figs, I regard as good the exiles from Judah, whom I sent away from this place to the land of the Babylonians.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Genda otebie omoruoti bw’Abayuda, oyio obatoma moche komboria amang’ana: Naama! Abarwani ba Farao, abwo baare gocha kobakonya, mbairane gochia Misiri, ase ense yabo.
english: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of me, 'Pharaoh's army, which has marched out to support you, will go back to its own land, to Egypt.
