ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Amang’ana onsi nagotebetie, yarike ase ebuku,
english: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Write in a book all the words I have spoken to you.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agotebia Turo: Inee! Ekero aye oraiyerigwe inse na gosarigwa, ebisinka tibigotengechigwa neriogi erio, na ase okweumia kw’abanto baakirwe ekero ogoitwa okonene korabe ase egati yao?
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says to Tyre: Will not the coastlands tremble at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and the slaughter takes place in you?

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ninsirie emegwekano egosasimwa, ee, ninsirie kegima chinyasae chi’oborimo chia Memifisi, gose omogambi takoba ase ense ya Misiri; ase igo nindete obwoba ase ense eyio.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis. No longer will there be a prince in Egypt, and I will spread fear throughout the land.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ninsirie obotenenku bwa Misiri goetera ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Nindute ekeonga kiane igoro yao, nakio omoganda omonene orakong’use okobeke ase rikuru riane ime.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'With a great throng of people I will cast my net over you, and they will haul you up in my net.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Aye nonywere egekombe ki’egesusuro giaetwe mosubati omino, kere ekegare naende egetambe gochia inse. Nosekererwe ase ogochaywa, ekiagera egekombe ekio nigo geichire.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "You will drink your sister's cup, a cup large and deep; it will bring scorn and derision, for it holds so much.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye naye omonto oria nakwanete igoro yao ase chingaki chia kare goetera ase abasomba baane ababani b’Abaisraeli; barabwo bakaba bakobana emiaka ase emiaka ng’a ninkorente orwanie Abaisraeli.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Are you not the one I spoke of in former days by my servants the prophets of Israel? At that time they prophesied for years that I would bring you against them.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Abaedomu bakoreire Abayuda bobe ase okorusia egesiomba, na babeire nokomocha ase okobakorera igo.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because Edom took revenge on the house of Judah and became very guilty by doing so,

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Abamoabu na Abaseiri nigo bagokwana ng’a Abayuda nigo banga buna abanto b’ebisaku binde bionsi.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because Moab and Seir said, "Look, the house of Judah has become like all the other nations,"

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Abanto nigo bagoteba ng’a aye ense nigo okoria abanto, naende gwaitire abana b’egesaku kiao.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because people say to you, "You devour men and deprive your nation of its children,"

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Abafilisti barusirie egesiomba bare nobobisa ase chinkoro chiabo, na ase okogecha kogendererete botambe basiririe ababisa babo kegima.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because the Philistines acted in vengeance and took revenge with malice in their hearts, and with ancient hostility sought to destroy Judah,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Nimbarentere omoganda bw’abanto babakorere bobe na kobasakora.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Bring a mob against them and give them over to terror and plunder.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Rora, obobe ngocha bore, obobe borabe bogoetania bonde bwonsi.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Disaster! An unheard-of disaster is coming.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Nonya ninche nimbutore enkoro y’omocharake omotambe, ee, nimbutore enkoro y’omote oria mesia egesebo ekerere, inche omonyene ngesimeke ase egetunwa egetambe igoro.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I myself will take a shoot from the very top of a cedar and plant it; I will break off a tender sprig from its topmost shoots and plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ningokorere koreng’ana buna gwakorire, ekiagera gwachayire eira gwatianete, na gwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will deal with you as you deserve, because you have despised my oath by breaking the covenant.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Omogambi karae oyomo bw’abana baye abamura oboremo bw’orogongo rwaye, oboremo obwo mbobe omwando bw’oyio oboegwa; ee, omwando oyio nigo orabe oyo bw’abana b’omomura oyio.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: If the prince makes a gift from his inheritance to one of his sons, it will also belong to his descendants; it is to be their property by inheritance.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, moire eeri ensae etari na kemocho ase omobere oye ase ogochena Hekalu.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: In the first month on the first day you are to take a young bull without defect and purify the sanctuary.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase engaki eyio aye nigo orabe nemeroberio ase ebirengererio biao, oraroberie gokora ayare amabe.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On that day thoughts will come into your mind and you will devise an evil scheme.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase rituko erio ndabe nabachenire korwa ase ebibe biaino bionsi, nindue ribaga emechie eyio emenywe, na amaagacho ayio atagoretwe aagachwe naende.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day I cleanse you from all your sins, I will resettle your towns, and the ruins will be rebuilt.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase rituko erio omote oria ogendete aase abakure ngachika ebirero birerwe; nigo natubete chindiba ase engencho yaye, ngatanga chindooche chiaye, nkaochania amache amanene. Nigo nachigete egetunwa kia Lebanoni keyobokerie amagombo, na emete yonsi y’orosana egasusana ase engencho yaye.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day it was brought down to the grave I covered the deep springs with mourning for it; I held back its streams, and its abundant waters were restrained. Because of it I clothed Lebanon with gloom, and all the trees of the field withered away.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ninyanchere Abaisraeli bamborie ng’a mbakorere ayio; mbabuchie babe buna amaicho e ching’ondi.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Once again I will yield to the plea of the house of Israel and do this for them: I will make their people as numerous as sheep,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba, “Samunsa amaboko aino, na motinere amagoro aino inse, morere: Obee! Obee! Nase engencho y’obobe bwonsi bw’okogechia kw’Abaisraeli obwo bwagerire ng’a baitwe nemioro, na enchara, na amarwaire.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Strike your hands together and stamp your feet and cry out "Alas!" because of all the wicked and detestable practices of the house of Israel, for they will fall by the sword, famine and plague.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Egeita kia moocha kegosoerwa gochia ase eraaro ya ime, goika kegenderere gosiekwa ase engaki yonsi y’amatuko atano na rimo ay’ogokora emeremo, korende ase rituko ri’Esabato, na eri’Omotienyi Omoyia, goika keigorwe.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: The gate of the inner court facing east is to be shut on the six working days, but on the Sabbath day and on the day of the New Moon it is to be opened.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Oyo noro Yerusalemu; nayobekire ase egati‐gati y’abanto b’ebisaku, ne chinse chinde chiyoetanaine.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: This is Jerusalem, which I have set in the center of the nations, with countries all around her.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ninsangererie Abaisraeli, mbarusie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku agwo ase basiareretwe gochia, na ning’orokie obochenu bwane asebare ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku; erio mbarente bamenye ase ense yabo eria naete Yakobo, omosomba one.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When I gather the people of Israel from the nations where they have been scattered, I will show myself holy among them in the sight of the nations. Then they will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ningosirie obe omochie ore bosa buna emechie etamenyiri. Nindete chindiba chigotube, na amache amange agotube boigo.
english: "This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When I make you a desolate city, like cities no longer inhabited, and when I bring the ocean depths over you and its vast waters cover you,

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe abagambi b’Abaisraeli, amabe ayio mwakorire aisanire. Motige kegima ogokora okobe na okourereria; monache ebina bi’ekeene na oboronge; timoseria abanto baane korwa ase chinka chiabo. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: You have gone far enough, O princes of Israel! Give up your violence and oppression and do what is just and right. Stop dispossessing my people, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Engencho y’amang’ana ayio nero eye: MENE, engencho yaye: Nyasae obarire amatuko ’oboruoti bwao obokoorire;
english: "This is what these words mean: Mene: God has numbered the days of your reign and brought it to an end.

ekegusii: “Aya naro orakore ase Haroni na abamura baye ase okobaatanana, babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani: Orusie eeri ensae ne chimingichi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: "This is what you are to do to consecrate them, so they may serve me as priests: Take a young bull and two rams without defect.

ekegusii: Aya naro morakore: Moite kera omonto omosacha, na kera omokungu omenyanire nomosacha, mobasirie kegima.”
english: "This is what you are to do," they said. "Kill every male and every woman who is not a virgin."

ekegusii: “Na ebing’wanso orabe gokorua igoro ase egesasimero nabio ebi: Kera rituko botambe, orue chimanwa ibere chie ching’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo.
english: "This is what you are to offer on the altar regularly each day: two lambs a year old.

ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’amang’ana aya nigo nkorera, amaiso aane nigo akoiyeria amariga, oyio okondemia nigo are aare korwa asende, oyio okong’a chinguru chinyia; abana baane batigaire bare boka, ekiagera ababisa baane bambuire.”
english: "This is why I weep and my eyes overflow with tears. No one is near to comfort me, no one to restore my spirit. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed."

ekegusii: bagateba, “Omonto oyo nigo akoebereria abanto ng’a basasime Nyasae mamincha y’amachiko.”
english: "This man," they charged, "is persuading the people to worship God in ways contrary to the law."

ekegusii: “Omotienyi oyo nobe oyo bwe ritang’ani asemore, oyo bw’ogochaka omwaka.
english: "This month is to be for you the first month, the first month of your year.

ekegusii: Naki amaguta aya anga naoonigwa ase chisiringi chinyinge na chiegwe abataka.”
english: "This perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money given to the poor."

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okorota kwarotete, na bono intwe ntogotebie aye omoruoti engencho yaye.
english: "This was the dream, and now we will interpret it to the king.

ekegusii: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio asore aye Hezekia: Omwaka oyo inamorie endagera ekwemeria yoka enyene, na omwaka o kabere boigo. Erio omwaka o gatato mobusure na kogesa, mosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo na morie okwama kwabo.
english: "This will be the sign for you, O Hezekiah: "This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

ekegusii: “Eke nakio ekemanyererio asore Hezekia: Omwaka oyo inamorie endagera ekwemeria yoka enyene, na omwaka o kabere boigo. Erio omwaka o gatato imobusure na kogesa, imosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo na morie okwama kwabo.
english: "This will be the sign for you, O Hezekiah: "This year you will eat what grows by itself, and the second year what springs from that. But in the third year sow and reap, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire iga: Eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asemore, ng’a nimbae egesusuro aase aiga, erinde monyare komanya ng’a amang’ana aane nabe okobarentera amabe.
english: "'This will be the sign to you that I will punish you in this place,' declares the LORD, 'so that you will know that my threats of harm against you will surely stand.'

ekegusii: “Inwe gaki, saba iga: Tata oito ore igoro, Erieta riao risikwe.
english: "This, then, is how you should pray: "'Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name,

ekegusii: “Oko nogochika ase amang’ana e risemi, ekero omokungu atari omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, korende akore obotomani na gwekora omosaria.
english: "'This, then, is the law of jealousy when a woman goes astray and defiles herself while married to her husband,

ekegusii: Na Omonene akamotebia, “Okore igo, na barabwo inabegene ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo nakoorokera.”
english: "This," said the LORD, "is so that they may believe that the LORD, the God of their fathers-- the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob-- has appeared to you."

ekegusii: Abwo bare nobong’aini ase egati y’abanto mborokererie abange babe nokomanya. Korende ase engaki enke abande babo nabaitwe nemioro, na abande basambwe nomorero, na abande bairwe ase obosomba, na abande basakorwe ebinto biabo.
english: "Those who are wise will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by the sword or be burned or captured or plundered.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakoonchokera emegwekano egosasimwa ere bosa, abwo nigo bagweatanana korwa ase Oyore Amabera abo.
english: "Those who cling to worthless idols forfeit the grace that could be theirs.

ekegusii: “Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Abanto bagweatanana na gwechena ase ogosasima ime ase ebigondo bagotang’anwa noyomo ore ase egatigati yabo, abwo bakoria enyama y’embeche, na eye chimbeba, na ey’okogechia konde gwonsi, abwo bonsi mbasirigwe amo.
english: "Those who consecrate and purify themselves to go into the gardens, following the one in the midst of those who eat the flesh of pigs and rats and other abominable things-- they will meet their end together," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Ekiagera Abaefraimu beagacheire ebisasimero ebinge bikogera bakore ebibe, ebio biabeire ebibe asebare.
english: "Though Ephraim built many altars for sin offerings, these have become altars for sinning.

ekegusii: “Nonya obobe bore obwansu ase omonwa oye ime, na abobise inse y’oromeme rwaye,
english: "Though evil is sweet in his mouth and he hides it under his tongue,

ekegusii: Nigo atubire obosio bwaye namaguta ’obonoru, naende onorire ase ebibono biaye.
english: "Though his face is covered with fat and his waist bulges with flesh,

ekegusii: Rora, nigo nkorera mono ngoteba: Nakoreirwe bobe, korende tindi koiranerigwa; nigo nkorangeria neriogi rinene ng’a nkonywe, korende ekeene, oboronge tibori gokorwa.
english: "Though I cry, 'I've been wronged!' I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.

ekegusii: “Aya nakwanire nainwe ase emereng’anio; engaki neche ntakwane naende ase emereng’anio, korende nimborokie maiso marore amang’ana a Tata.
english: "Though I have been speaking figuratively, a time is coming when I will no longer use this kind of language but will tell you plainly about my Father.

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, nonya mogokora obotomani, timobaisa gotiga Abayuda bakore ogosaria okwo. Timobaisa kogenda Giligali, gose gotiira gochia ase Beti‐Aveni, gose timobaisa gotiana mogoteba: Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo.
english: "Though you commit adultery, O Israel, let not Judah become guilty. "Do not go to Gilgal; do not go up to Beth Aven. And do not swear, 'As surely as the LORD lives!'

ekegusii: “Ekeene, ense eyio yaino yasaretigwe kegima, egatigwa bosa, korende bono nebe enke mono, ekiagera abaramenyeo nigo barayebuchere; abanto abwo babakorerete bobe batamire gochia aare mono.
english: "Though you were ruined and made desolate and your land laid waste, now you will be too small for your people, and those who devoured you will be far away.

ekegusii: Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene Nyasae.
english: "Three times a year all the men are to appear before the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: “Kera omwaka nobe kogontwarera Amatuko Amanene ara gatato.
english: "Three times a year you are to celebrate a festival to me.

ekegusii: Ng’ina Sisera akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, agatengera goetera ase ekebao kiabekire ebitange, akarera, “Nase ki chigari chiaye chiatebanire gocha? Nase ki amagoro e chibarasi chiaye chie chigari chiatebanire koirana?
english: "Through the window peered Sisera's mother; behind the lattice she cried out, 'Why is his chariot so long in coming? Why is the clatter of his chariots delayed?'

ekegusii: Yehu akabatebia, “Tuguta omokungu oyio gocha inse aa!” Ase ayio bakamotuguta gochia inse; amanyinga aye agasiarokera enyasi amo ne chibarasi, Yehu akamotindachera inse ne chibarasi ne chigari.
english: "Throw her down!" Jehu said. So they threw her down, and some of her blood spattered the wall and the horses as they trampled her underfoot.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are nobong’aini na okobua, boigo nare nogosemia na obomanyi.
english: "To God belong wisdom and power; counsel and understanding are his.

ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya nigo are asende buna aria abete ekero kia Nuhu. Nigo natianete ng’a amache buna aria achete ekero kia Nuhu, tagocha ase ense naende; naboigo natianire ng’a tinkogenderera koba nendamwamu asore, gose tinkogotogonyera.
english: "To me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So now I have sworn not to be angry with you, never to rebuke you again.

ekegusii: “Ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa y’Efeso rika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyobwate ching’enang’eni chiria isano na ibere ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, ere oyogotaara gati‐gati ase ebibekerero biria bie chitaya bitano na bibere bie chitahabu.
english: "To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: These are the words of him who holds the seven stars in his right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands:

ekegusii: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Laodikia rika: Amang’ana aya naro oyore Amina agokwana, oyore kirori omwegenwa na oyo bw’ekeene, naende omochakano bw’ebitongwa bia Nyasae.
english: "To the angel of the church in Laodicea write: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God's creation.

ekegusii: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Perigamo rika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyore nomoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere.
english: "To the angel of the church in Pergamum write: These are the words of him who has the sharp, double-edged sword.

ekegusii: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Filadelfia rika: Amang’ana aya naro ere oyore omochenu agokwana, ere oyore bw’ekeene, oyore nekeigorero gia Daudi, oyokoigora, naende onde tari oranyare gosieka, nere ogosieka, gose onde tari oranyare koigora.
english: "To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of him who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

ekegusii: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Saridi rika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyobwate emeika eria etano na ebere ya Nyasae, ne ching’enang’eni chiria isano na ibere. “Namanyire ogokora kwao. Nore nerieta ng’a moyo ore, korende nigo okwete.
english: "To the angel of the church in Sardis write: These are the words of him who holds the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. I know your deeds; you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

ekegusii: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Sumurina rika: Amang’ana aya naro agokwana, ere oyore bwe ritang’ani na oyo bw’omoerio, oyo konya okure, naende akaba moyo.
english: "To the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These are the words of him who is the First and the Last, who died and came to life again.

ekegusii: “Na ase omomalaika bw’ekanisa ya Tiatira rika: Amang’ana aya naro Omwana o Nyasae agokwana, ere oyore namaiso agwoka buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, na amagoro aye nigo anga buna etaai esenirie mono.
english: "To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These are the words of the Son of God, whose eyes are like blazing fire and whose feet are like burnished bronze.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ore omwegenwa ase abwo bare abegenwa; nigo okweorokia ng’a nomoikeranu ore ase abwo bare abaikeranu.
english: "To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

ekegusii: “Korende inaki ndagwekanie ekegori eke? Nkegwekaine nabana baikaransete ase chichiiro, bakorangeria abagisangio babo, bagoteba,
english: "To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:

ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Ninki ndagwekanie abanto b’ekegori eke? Barabwo ninki bagwekaine?
english: "To what, then, can I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

ekegusii: "To whom will you compare me or count me equal? To whom will you liken me that we may be compared?
english: “Ning’o moranyare kondeng’ania ng’a imbe buna oyio? Ning’o moranyare kongwekania ng’a togwekane nere?

ekegusii: Oyore Omochenu nigo akoboria iga: “Ning’o rende moranyare kondeng’ania, ng’a imbe buna oyio?”
english: "To whom will you compare me? Or who is my equal?" says the Holy One.

ekegusii: agateba, “Aye ninkoe ense ya Kanani ebe omwando bw’ororeria rwao.”
english: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Ninkoe ense ya Kanani ebe egetari oraire kebe omwando oo.”
english: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto, ninwe nkorangeria; eriogi riane nigo rigochera mwanyabanto.
english: "To you, O men, I call out; I raise my voice to all mankind.

ekegusii: Rero moetere orobebe rwa Moabu ase enchera ya Ari.
english: "Today you are to pass by the region of Moab at Ar.

ekegusii: Farao akairaneria, “Ng’ankio.” Musa akamotebia, “Nigo erabe buna gwateba, erinde omanye ng’a onde tari buna Omonene, Nyasae oito.
english: "Tomorrow," Pharaoh said. Moses replied, "It will be as you say, so that you may know there is no one like the LORD our God.

ekegusii: “Umokera Abamidiani, obasirie,
english: "Treat the Midianites as enemies and kill them,

ekegusii: “Inwe abe chinsinyo chi’ense, ng’onchokere mbatoorie, ekiagera inche ninche Nyasae, onde tari otatiga inche bweka.
english: "Turn to me and be saved, all you ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.

ekegusii: "Two men owed money to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
english: “Omonto oyomo omorua singo orenge nabasira babere; oyomo omoriete esira ye chidinari amagana atano, na oyo o kabere emerongo etano.

ekegusii: “Abanto babere bagatiira gochia Hekalu gosaba; oyomo n’Omofarisai na oyonde omorusia ebango.
english: "Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.

ekegusii: "Two things I ask of you, O LORD; do not refuse me before I die:
english: Amang’ana abere naro nagosabire, toyandina ntarakwa.

ekegusii: Nare amang’ana atato akonyegeria ense, ee, nare ane etanyare koyaremereria, naro aya:
english: "Under three things the earth trembles, under four it cannot bear up:

ekegusii: "Unless you people see miraculous signs and wonders," Jesus told him, "you will never believe."
english: Nabo Yeso akamotebia, “Motarochi ebikone na amakumia, timori kwegena nonya ng’ake.”

ekegusii: Akabora, “Tiga abe buna mwateba, omonto oranyorekane okebwate nigo arabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande inamobe motari na komocha.”
english: "Very well, then," he said, "let it be as you say. Whoever is found to have it will become my slave; the rest of you will be free from blame."

ekegusii: Batiseba akamoiraneria, “Ayio mbuya; ninkwane nomoruoti ase engencho yao.”
english: "Very well," Bathsheba replied, "I will speak to the king for you."

ekegusii: Debora akamoiraneria, “Goika ngende amo naye, korende orogendo oro tirogokorentera ogotogigwa, ekiagera Omonene nigo agochia gotiga Sisera agwe ase amaboko ’omokungu.” Erio Debora akaimoka akagenda amo na Baraki, bagaika Kedesi.
english: "Very well," Deborah said, "I will go with you. But because of the way you are going about this, the honor will not be yours, for the LORD will hand Sisera over to a woman." So Deborah went with Barak to Kedesh,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene agantebia, “Bono ninkoe ribaga okoroiseria endagera yao igoro y’omorero bw’obwoyo obwomo bwe chiombe ribaga ri’omorero bw’obonyira bwa mwanyabanto.”
english: "Very well," he said, "I will let you bake your bread over cow manure instead of human excrement."

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Hesiboni, rera mono, ekiagera Ai osarigwe! Inwe abakungu ba Raba, rera! Mweboyie chigunia, mobokie amagombo, mobe mokominyoka gochia aaria na aaria ase chinka chionsi, ekiagera enyasae eyio Milikomu neirwe ase obosomba amo nabakuani baye, na abanene abakogamba nero.
english: "Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is destroyed! Cry out, O inhabitants of Rabbah! Put on sackcloth and mourn; rush here and there inside the walls, for Molech will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.

ekegusii: Renda, mosabe, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika oro nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”
english: "Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the body is weak."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ndigererie, mokore buna ndakore. Ekero ndaike ase ensinyo y’egetwori, mondigererie buna ndakore nainwe mokore bo.
english: "Watch me," he told them. "Follow my lead. When I get to the edge of the camp, do exactly as I do.

ekegusii: “Mwerende nababani b’oborimo abwo bagocha asemore beboyetie chingobo chie ching’ondi, na ime yabo nigo bare chisese chi’orosana chikoria kegima.
english: "Watch out for false prophets. They come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ferocious wolves.

ekegusii: “Naende ntobe tokorenta okwama kwe ritang’ani kwe riroba riaito, na amatunda amatang’ani ay’emete yonsi, ase enyomba y’Omonene, omwaka ase omwaka.
english: "We also assume responsibility for bringing to the house of the LORD each year the firstfruits of our crops and of every fruit tree.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteba: Intwe twanyorire obosooku, ekiagera twabeire togochecherigwa. Obosooku bw’ogochaywa bwatubire amaiso aito, ekiagera abanto b’egesaku ekegeni basoire chinsemo chinchenu chi’enyomba y’Omonene oito.
english: "We are disgraced, for we have been insulted and shame covers our faces, because foreigners have entered the holy places of the LORD's house."

ekegusii: "We are doomed to die!" he said to his wife. "We have seen God!"
english: Manoa agatebia mokaye, “Amaene goika tokwe, ekiagera twarorire Nyasae.”

ekegusii: Kobare inchera, akabatebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore gochia Yerusalemu, na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nabekwe ase amaboko ’abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko, na barabwo nabamogambie akwe,
english: "We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death

ekegusii: akabora, “Rigereria, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nabekwe ase amaboko ’abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko. Abwo nabamogambie akwe, na bamobeke ase amaboko abanto b’Ebisaku,
english: "We are going up to Jerusalem," he said, "and the Son of Man will be betrayed to the chief priests and teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death and will hand him over to the Gentiles,

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titogokoaka amagena ase emeremo emiya, korende nase okorama, ekiagera aye nomonto ogwekora omonyene ng’a naye Nyasae.”
english: "We are not stoning you for any of these," replied the Jews, "but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God."

ekegusii: Na intwe nigo tore abarori b’amang’ana onsi aya arenge gokora ase ense y’Abayahudi na ime ya Yerusalemu. Bakamoita, bakamosunga ase omote,
english: "We are witnesses of everything he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem. They killed him by hanging him on a tree,

ekegusii: Bagatebia Yoshua, “Intwe nabasomba bao tore.” Yoshua akababoria, “Inwe mbanto ki more? Ng’ai mokorwa?”
english: "We are your servants," they said to Joshua. But Joshua asked, "Who are you and where do you come from?"

ekegusii: “Twanchire ng’a kera omwaka, torue ensemo ya isato y’esekeli ekorerwe emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito.
english: "We assume the responsibility for carrying out the commands to give a third of a shekel each year for the service of the house of our God:

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Nigo twarotete chindoto, na onde tari oranyare gototebia engencho ye chindoto chiaito.” Yusufu akabatebia, “Nigoro ya Nyasae kobatebia engencho yaye. Komoranche, mochintebie.”
english: "We both had dreams," they answered, "but there is no one to interpret them." Then Joseph said to them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams."

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Natonyare.” Yeso akabatebia, “Egekombe nkonywera inche namokenywere, na ebatiso mbatisire inche namobatiswe,
english: "We can," they answered. Jesus said to them, "You will drink the cup I drink and be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with,

ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Titokonyara gokora bo goika ekero amaicho onsi arache asangererekane amo, erinde abarisia bamanye gotigeria rigena korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko; erio tomanye konyoisia ching’ondi.”
english: "We can't," they replied, "until all the flocks are gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep."

ekegusii: “Echela nigo twayenyora esiekire buya kegima, na abarendi bateneine bisieri, korende twachia koigora titwanyora monto onde ime.”
english: "We found the jail securely locked, with the guards standing at the doors; but when we opened them, we found no one inside."

ekegusii: “Inee! Titwabakanetie bokong’u ng’a timworokereria ase erieta eri? Na rora, mwaichoirie Yerusalemu nokworokereria kwaino, naende morigetie korenta amanyinga ’omonto oria igoro asetore.”
english: "We gave you strict orders not to teach in this name," he said. "Yet you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and are determined to make us guilty of this man's blood."

ekegusii: “Naama! Twabeire togokora obotuki ase amang’ana ayio; naro nay’ekeene. Ase ayio bono igwa amang’ana ayio, oyagache ase omoyo oo.”
english: "We have examined this, and it is true. So hear it and apply it to yourself."

ekegusii: Naki twanyorire omonto oyo ng’a nomochege are, na omochaki bw’eriomana ase Abayahudi abare ase ense yonsi, naende nomotang’ani bw’ekeombe ki’Abanazareti.
english: "We have found this man to be a troublemaker, stirring up riots among the Jews all over the world. He is a ringleader of the Nazarene sect

ekegusii: Twaigure igoro y’oboenenu bw’Abamoabu; nigo bare abaenenu mono. Twaigure buna beimokereirie igoro, na buna bagwekaga na koba nobomwenu, na buna bare ne chinkoro chi’obwerori.
english: "We have heard of Moab's pride-- her overweening pride and conceit, her pride and arrogance and the haughtiness of her heart.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamotebia, “Titobwati gento aiga, otatiga emegati etano ne chinswe ibere.”
english: "We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish," they answered.

ekegusii: "We have sinned and rebelled and you have not forgiven.
english: “Intwe twasaririe asore, twabeire abatari abaigweri, naye togotwabera.

ekegusii: “Ntwamoigwete ogoteba: Inche nintagore Hekalu eye yakoregete namaboko, na ase amatuko atato ning’agache eyende etakoregeti namaboko.”
english: "We heard him say, 'I will destroy this man-made temple and in three days will build another, not made by man.'"

ekegusii: Abaibori baye bakairaneria, “Twamanyire ng’a oyo nomwana oito, naende ng’a nigo aiboretwe ore omouko;
english: "We know he is our son," the parents answered, "and we know he was born blind.

ekegusii: "'We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.'
english: Twababugeirie ebiroria, na inwe timotengeti; tweumirie, na inwe timorereti.

ekegusii: Bagateba, “Titokorua abaiseke baito banyuomwe nabanto b’ense eye, gose titokonyuomeria abamura baito abaiseke babo.
english: "We promise not to give our daughters in marriage to the peoples around us or take their daughters for our sons.

ekegusii: Na intwe twabarenteire amang’ana amaya aria Nyasae arierete chisokoro chiaito eira.
english: "We tell you the good news: What God promised our fathers

ekegusii: “Boigo intwe abakuani, na Abalawi, na abanto bande, twaakire obomera ng’a tomanye buna abanto be chiamate chiaito barabe bakorenta chinko, omwaka ase omwaka, echio chirabe chigosamba ebing’wanso ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, Nyasae oito, ase chingaki chichikire, na buna erikire ase Ebuku y’Amachiko.
english: "We-- the priests, the Levites and the people-- have cast lots to determine when each of our families is to bring to the house of our God at set times each year a contribution of wood to burn on the altar of the LORD our God, as it is written in the Law.

ekegusii: Intwe n’Abayahudi ase okoiborwa gwaito, gose tari abanyene ebibe b’Ebisaku,
english: "We who are Jews by birth and not 'Gentile sinners'

ekegusii: Erio abatang’ani abwo bakairaneria, bagateba, “Goika toiranie ebinto ebio, gose titoboria ebitoki korwa asebare; ntokore buna gwatebire.” Agwo nkarangeria abakuani batianie abatang’ani abwo barie eira ng’a bakore buna batebetigwe.
english: "We will give it back," they said. "And we will not demand anything more from them. We will do as you say." Then I summoned the priests and made the nobles and officials take an oath to do what they had promised.

ekegusii: “Igoro y’amang’ana ayio gwakwanire asetore ase erieta ri’Omonene, intwe titokoigwera.
english: "We will not listen to the message you have spoken to us in the name of the LORD!

ekegusii: Nanga nabo twagwenetie Babeli, korende togwenetigwe. Togende, totige Babeli; kera omonto agende ase ense yaye, ekiagera obobe bwa Babeli bwaikire igoro nonya nase amare.
english: "'We would have healed Babylon, but she cannot be healed; let us leave her and each go to his own land, for her judgment reaches to the skies, it rises as high as the clouds.'

ekegusii: “Oroisie eganchwa entambe amo nekegogwa korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya, na orokini rwe chiusi chire ne chirangi ao ao.
english: "Weave the tunic of fine linen and make the turban of fine linen. The sash is to be the work of an embroiderer.

ekegusii: Akamotebia: Gwakorire buya, aye omosomba omuya! Ekiagera kwabeire omwegenwa ase egento kere egeke, nabo nobe nokobua igoro ase emechie ikomi.
english: "'Well done, my good servant!' his master replied. 'Because you have been trustworthy in a very small matter, take charge of ten cities.'

ekegusii: Omworokia oria bw’amariko akamotebia, “Ekeene, Omworokia, gwatebire buya ng’a Nyasae noyomo, na onde tari otatiga ere;
english: "Well said, teacher," the man replied. "You are right in saying that God is one and there is no other but him.

ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Rora, bono nachire asore, nigo okagete ng’a inche nimbwate okobua nonya nogoke gokwana ring’ana asore? Ring’ana riria Nyasae arantebie nario ndakwane.”
english: "Well, I have come to you now," Balaam replied. "But can I say just anything? I must speak only what God puts in my mouth."

ekegusii: bagoteba, “Inki torakorere abanto aba? Ekiagera egekone eke giakorirwe nabarabwo kere maiso marore ase abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, titokonyara kogekana.
english: "What are we going to do with these men?" they asked. "Everybody living in Jerusalem knows they have done an outstanding miracle, and we cannot deny it.

ekegusii: "What are you arguing with them about?" he asked.
english: Akababoria, “Ninki mokoengererania nabarabwo?”

ekegusii: Aye egetunwa ekenene, ninki oisaine ase obosio bwa Serubabeli? Noiranigwe inse obe buna ense omweya. Serubabeli nabeke rigena ri’ogokoorera, abanto kobaakire eriogi, bagoteba: Obuya, obuya bobe igoro yaye!”
english: "What are you, O mighty mountain? Before Zerubbabel you will become level ground. Then he will bring out the capstone to shouts of 'God bless it! God bless it!'"

ekegusii: Elisha akaboria, “Ngento ki omokungu oyo agwenerete akorerwe?” Gehasi akairaneria, “Naremeire egento ekemo, tabwati omwana, na omosacha oye ogotire.”
english: "What can be done for her?" Elisha asked. Gehazi said, "Well, she has no son and her husband is old."

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaefraimu, ngento ki ndabakorere? Inwe Abayuda, ngento ki ndabakorere? Obwanchani bwaino nigo bonga buna ritaturi, na buna riime ria mambia rigosira bwango.
english: "What can I do with you, Ephraim? What can I do with you, Judah? Your love is like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears.

ekegusii: Yudaakairaneria, “Ninkitogoteba asore, omonene oito? Ninki togokwana? Gose inatonyare kweenekia ng’a nabaronge tore? Nyasae ororire ebibe biaito intwe abasomba bao; na bono, omonene oito, intwe amo nere, oyo egekombe kianyorekana ase okoboko kwaye, tiga tobe abasomba bao.”
english: "What can we say to my lord?" Judah replied. "What can we say? How can we prove our innocence? God has uncovered your servants' guilt. We are now my lord's slaves-- we ourselves and the one who was found to have the cup."

ekegusii: "What did Moses command you?" he replied.
english: Ere akabairaneria, “Inki Musa abachigete?”

ekegusii: “Ninki engencho y’omorabaaro oyo okoiranererwa gokwanwa ase ense y’Abaisraeli: “Abaise barire amasabibu amabese amaroro, na amaino ’abana babo abeire nobokang’iti?
english: "What do you people mean by quoting this proverb about the land of Israel: "'The fathers eat sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'?

ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Amosi, ngento ki eke oroche?” Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Negetonga kere namatunda amatobu.” Erio Omonene agantebia, “Omoerio ocheire abanto baane Abaisraeli. Tinkobaetania nonya ng’ake.”
english: "What do you see, Amos?" he asked. "A basket of ripe fruit," I answered. Then the LORD said to me, "The time is ripe for my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

ekegusii: “Naki inwe mokorengereria ase Kristo? Nomwana o ng’o are?” Bakamoiraneria, “Nomwana o Daudi.”
english: "What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is he?" "The son of David," they replied.

ekegusii: “Inki mokorengereria? Omonto, onye ore ne ching’ondi rigana erimo, na eyemo kerasire, Inee, tagotiga chiria emerongo kianda na kianda ase ebitunwa, achie korigia eria yasirire?
english: "What do you think? If a man owns a hundred sheep, and one of them wanders away, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?

ekegusii: “Naki moroche? Omonto gete narenge nabana babere abamura. Akamochiera oria bwe ritang’ani, akamotebia: Omwana one, genda rero okore emeremo ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.
english: "What do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said, 'Son, go and work today in the vineyard.'

ekegusii: “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, inyare korora.”
english: "What do you want me to do for you?" "Lord, I want to see," he replied.

ekegusii: "What do you want me to do for you?" he asked.
english: Akababoria, “Inki morigetie mbakorere?”

ekegusii: Yeso akamoboria, “Ninki origetie ngokorere?” Omonto oria orenge omouko akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, inyare korora.”
english: "What do you want me to do for you?" Jesus asked him. The blind man said, "Rabbi, I want to see."

ekegusii: akabora, “Inki tore naye, Yeso o Nazareti? Inee! Nigo gwachire gotosiria? Nakomanyire aye, Omochenu o Nyasae.”
english: "What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are-- the Holy One of God!"

ekegusii: "What do you want with us, Son of God?" they shouted. "Have you come here to torture us before the appointed time?"
english: Na rora, barabwo bagaaka eriogi bakabora, “Inaki intwe tore naye, Omwana o Nyasae? Inee! Ngwachire aiga gotoita ekero engaki etaraika?”

ekegusii: Saulo akamoboria, “Naki ekerorekana?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Nomogaaka omogotu bwetubete egetambaa gi’okwambara.” Erio Saulo akamanya ng’a oyio n’Samweli, agatung’ama inse, akaorokia amasikani.
english: "What does he look like?" he asked. "An old man wearing a robe is coming up," she said. Then Saul knew it was Samuel, and he bowed down and prostrated himself with his face to the ground.

ekegusii: Mbitoki ki aye oranyore onye ngokwa na gosoa ase oboina ime? Inee! Orotu rw’amaroba ndonyare kogotogia? Ndonyare koraria obwegenwa bwao?
english: "What gain is there in my destruction, in my going down into the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your faithfulness?

ekegusii: Naende Daudi akamoboria, “Naki esegi egendererete? Nagosabire ontebie.” Omonto oria akamoiraneria, “Abanto abange batamire korwa ase esegi eria, na abande abange mono baitirwe bakure. Boigo Saulo amo na Yonathani, momura oye, baitirwe bakure.”
english: "What happened?" David asked. "Tell me." He said, "The men fled from the battle. Many of them fell and died. And Saul and his son Jonathan are dead."

ekegusii: Na bono nonya amang’ana aya onsi aikire gotonyora ase engencho y’ogokora gwaito okobe, na okomocha gwaito okonene, twarorire ng’a aye, Nyasae oito, totoeti egesusuro buna ebibe biaito bigwenerete, korende gwatotigeire abatigari buna aba iga.
english: "What has happened to us is a result of our evil deeds and our great guilt, and yet, our God, you have punished us less than our sins have deserved and have given us a remnant like this.

ekegusii: Obadia akamoiraneria, “Mbibe ki nakorire goika ondue inche, omosomba oo, na okombeka ase okoboko kw’Ahabu, ang’ite?
english: "What have I done wrong," asked Obadiah, "that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to be put to death?

ekegusii: Samweli akamoboria, “Inki eke gwakorire?” Saulo akamoiraneria, “Nigo narora ng’a abanto ngotama bare korwa asende, naende naye gwatebana, tocheti ase engaki eria gwatebete ng’a nochiche. Boigo Abafilisti konya basangererekanire agwo Mikimasi.
english: "What have you done?" asked Samuel. Saul replied, "When I saw that the men were scattering, and that you did not come at the set time, and that the Philistines were assembling at Micmash,

ekegusii: Korende Farao akamoboria, “Ngento ki kwaremeirwe aiga asende ekiagera okoboria ribaga ogende ase ense yao?” Hadadi akamoiraneria, “Aye ntiga rioka, ngende.”
english: "What have you lacked here that you want to go back to your own country?" Pharaoh asked. "Nothing," Hadad replied, "but do let me go!"

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaboria, “Inee! Ngosika ki, gose masikani ki Moredekai akoreirwe ase engencho y’ayio?” Abanto b’omoruoti abarenge komokorera, bakamoiraneria, “Tana gokorerwa kende.”
english: "What honor and recognition has Mordecai received for this?" the king asked. "Nothing has been done for him," his attendants answered.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoboria, “Inki origetie?” Akamoiraneria, “Chika ng’a abana baane babere baikaranse, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio, na oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okobee ase oboruoti bwao.”
english: "What is it you want?" he asked. She said, "Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at your right and the other at your left in your kingdom."

ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto ninki aisaine, goika okomokora koba oyo bw’engencho enene, naende oba komorengereretie mono?
english: "What is man that you make so much of him, that you give him so much attention,

ekegusii: Inee! Mwanyabanto ninki are goika anyare koba oyochenegete? Gose ere oyio oiboire nomokungu ng’a anyare koba omonyaboronge?
english: "What is man, that he could be pure, or one born of woman, that he could be righteous?

ekegusii: “Abanto aba nyanchete bakorire okogechia. Inki rende bagokora ase enyomba yane? Inee! Chiira bakoria, na ebing’wanso bakorua, nabinyare koonchora ogosirigwa kwabo gokobachera? Ekero mwakorire ebibe, nario mokogoka?
english: "What is my beloved doing in my temple as she works out her evil schemes with many? Can consecrated meat avert [your punishment]? When you engage in your wickedness, then you rejoice."

ekegusii: “Enchera ekogenda ase oborabu bore, ng’ai ere? Nomanyete ase omosunte omenyete,
english: "What is the way to the abode of light? And where does darkness reside?

ekegusii: Pilato akamoboria, “Ekeene ngento ki?” Gakwanire ring’ana eri agachiera Abayahudi isiko eria kabere, akabatebia, “Inche tindochi bobe bonde asare.
english: "What is truth?" Pilate asked. With this he went out again to the Jews and said, "I find no basis for a charge against him.

ekegusii: Ere akamoboria, “Ase amachiko inki kerikire? Naki ogosoma?”
english: "What is written in the Law?" he replied. "How do you read it?"

ekegusii: Akabora, “Emechie eye kwang’eire, oyominto, naki ere?” Ase eyio igo ekorokwa ense ya Kabuli goika rero iga.
english: "What kind of towns are these you have given me, my brother?" he asked. And he called them the Land of Cabul, a name they have to this day.

ekegusii: Inche Daudi, inki ndagotebie naende kobua ayio, ekiagera gwansikire iga? Aye nigo omanyete inche, omosomba oo.
english: "What more can David say to you for honoring your servant? For you know your servant,

ekegusii: Inche Daudi, inki ndagotebie naende kobua ayio? Aye Omonene Nyasae, nigo omanyete inche, omosomba oo.
english: "What more can David say to you? For you know your servant, O Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: “Orogongo roratigare robebekaine na roria orochenu amo norw’omochie ase kera ensemo nigo rorabe orw’omogambi. Chingongo echio nigo chirachakere iga: Oromo korwa ase orogongo roria orochenu rw’ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere, na isano (25,000), rogenderere gochia moocha koreng’ana ne chingongo chiria chi’ebisaku, na oronde gochia bosongo koreng’ana ne chingongo chiria chi’ebisaku. Chingongo echio nigo chirabe echi’omogambi. Orogongo orwo orochenu ase Hekalu erabe nigo rorabe gati‐gati.
english: "What remains on both sides of the area formed by the sacred portion and the city property will belong to the prince. It will extend eastward from the 25,000 cubits of the sacred portion to the eastern border, and westward from the 25,000 cubits to the western border. Both these areas running the length of the tribal portions will belong to the prince, and the sacred portion with the temple sanctuary will be in the center of them.

ekegusii: Nkaboria: Ninki ndakore Omonene? Omonene agantebia: Imoka ogende goika Damesiki, agwo notebigwe onsi aya gwachikirwe oyakore.
english: "'What shall I do, Lord?' I asked. "'Get up,' the Lord said, 'and go into Damascus. There you will be told all that you have been assigned to do.'

ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Imokore naki Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?” Bakamotebia bonsi, “Tiga abambwe!”
english: "What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called Christ?" Pilate asked. They all answered, "Crucify him!"

ekegusii: Pilato akairaneria naende, akabatebia, “Imokore naki oyo mogoteba ng’a n’Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?”
english: "What shall I do, then, with the one you call the king of the Jews?" Pilate asked them.

ekegusii: Labani akamoboria, “Ninki ndakoe rende?” Yakobo akamoiraneria, “Tinganeti ong’e kende. Oise gonkorera ring’ana eri ndagotebie rioka, rirorio naende ningenderere korisia amaicho ao, na koyarenda.
english: "What shall I give you?" he asked. "Don't give me anything," Jacob replied. "But if you will do this one thing for me, I will go on tending your flocks and watching over them:

ekegusii: "What should we do then?" the crowd asked.
english: Emeganda eria ekamoboria, “Ninki rende torakore?”

ekegusii: "What strength do I have, that I should still hope? What prospects, that I should be patient?
english: Chinguru chiane inki chiisaine imbe nokoganya kore nogosemeria? Na omoerio one naki ogochia koba, ngenderere koremereria?

ekegusii: Bono inki rende omonene oria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu arakore? Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.
english: "What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki?” Bakamotebia, “Amang’ana a Yeso Omonazareti, oyorenge omobani, omonyene chinguru ase ogokora na ase ring’ana, ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase abanto bonsi;
english: "What things?" he asked. "About Jesus of Nazareth," they replied. "He was a prophet, powerful in word and deed before God and all the people.

ekegusii: Eli akamoboria, “Ninki Omonene agotebetie? Tobaisa kombisa gento. Korambise gento kende gionsi, nonya ne ring’ana erimo, rirorio Nyasae akoe egesusuro ekenene.”
english: "What was it he said to you?" Eli asked. "Do not hide it from me. May God deal with you, be it ever so severely, if you hide from me anything he told you."

ekegusii: “Abaiseke ba Selofehadi nekeene bakoboria. Bae omwando obo ase egati ya bamura bamwabo ise. Tiga omwando o ise obe oyobo.
english: "What Zelophehad's daughters are saying is right. You must certainly give them property as an inheritance among their father's relatives and turn their father's inheritance over to them.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agateba, “Obobe nobwaito! Omonene otorangeirie intwe abaruoti batato atobeke ase amaboko Abamoabu.”
english: "What!" exclaimed the king of Israel. "Has the LORD called us three kings together only to hand us over to Moab?"

ekegusii: "Whatever town or village you enter, search for some worthy person there and stay at his house until you leave.
english: Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, na agachie gonsi, morigie ning’o ogwenerete aroro, mobeere nere goika moruo.

ekegusii: “Ekero emori, gose emanwa y’eng’ondi, gose ey’embori, yabiarirwe, etigwe ebe ase eng’ina ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, korende korwa ase rituko ria gatano na gatato yancherwe ebe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende.
english: "When a calf, a lamb or a goat is born, it is to remain with its mother for seven days. From the eighth day on, it will be acceptable as an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: “Omogambi karakore ebibe mosiabano atancheti, na akore amang’ana ande onsi inche Omonene, Nyasae oye, nakanete ng’a takorwa, na igo obeire nokomocha,
english: "'When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is forbidden in any of the commands of the LORD his God, he is guilty.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto omosacha ogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro, rirorio esibie omobere namache, na agenderere koba oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: "'When a man has an emission of semen, he must bathe his whole body with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto osunyokire etukia, risio riachiire magega, nigo are nyaisio, ere ochenekire,
english: "When a man has lost his hair and is bald, he is clean.

ekegusii: “Omonto oria gachenekire korwa ase okorua kw’amache aria anga buna chimengere goika abare amatuko atano na abere ay’ogocheneka kwaye. Erio asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache amaya a rooche, ere nabe oyochenegete.
english: "'When a man is cleansed from his discharge, he is to count off seven days for his ceremonial cleansing; he must wash his clothes and bathe himself with fresh water, and he will be clean.

ekegusii: “Onye omosacha gose omokungu obwate ebisambo ebirabu ase risankwa ri’omobere,
english: "When a man or woman has white spots on the skin,

ekegusii: “Omonto karakorere omonto onde bobe na aborigwe koria emuma, erio achiche arie emuma eria bosio bw’egesasimero kiao ase enyomba eye,
english: "When a man wrongs his neighbor and is required to take an oath and he comes and swears the oath before your altar in this temple,

ekegusii: “Omonto karakorere omonto onde bobe, na aborigwe koria emuma, erio achiche arie emuma eria bosio bw’egesasimero kiao ase enyomba eye,
english: "When a man wrongs his neighbor and is required to take an oath and he comes and swears the oath before your altar in this temple,

ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi karasarie na akore ebibe mosiabano atancheti ase ogotarua ebinto biatananirwe na gochenwa asende, goika andetere emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ayerusie korwa ase riicho riaye ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye. Naye oyekorere rigori rireng’aine eri’esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
english: "When a person commits a violation and sins unintentionally in regard to any of the LORD's holy things, he is to bring to the LORD as a penalty a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value in silver, according to the sanctuary shekel. It is a guilt offering.

ekegusii: Omonto bwe chinguru ore nebinto bi’esegi, gakorenda enyomba yaye, enibo yaye nigo ekoba ase omorembe,
english: "When a strong man, fully armed, guards his own house, his possessions are safe.

ekegusii: “Omokungu karagenderere goiteka amanyinga ase amatuko amange atari ay’omotienyi oye, gose ayagoiteka goetania amatuko aye ay’omotienyi, nigo arabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki eyio yonsi arabe ogoiteka amanyinga; nabe oyotachenegeti buna ekero are nomotienyi.
english: "'When a woman has a discharge of blood for many days at a time other than her monthly period or has a discharge that continues beyond her period, she will be unclean as long as she has the discharge, just as in the days of her period.

ekegusii: “Ekero omokungu are nomotienyi nigo arabe oyotachenegeti ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Onde bwensi oramokune nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: "'When a woman has her regular flow of blood, the impurity of her monthly period will last seven days, and anyone who touches her will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: “Ekero omoiseke otarasoka korwa ase omochie o ise akoria eira ase Omonene, gose gotiana ng’a netange korwa ase egento gete,
english: "When a young woman still living in her father's house makes a vow to the LORD or obligates herself by a pledge

ekegusii: “Ekero Haroni akoorire gokora okobwatanigwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono, na ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, na ase egesasimero, arente embori eria ere moyo.
english: "When Aaron has finished making atonement for the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting and the altar, he shall bring forward the live goat.

ekegusii: Korende ekero amang’ana ayio araikeranigwe (ekiagera goika aikeranigwe), erio nario baramanye ng’a omobani narenge ase egati yabo.”
english: "When all this comes true-- and it surely will-- then they will know that a prophet has been among them."

ekegusii: “Timobaisa kobakorera bobe abamenyi bamenyete ase ense yaino.
english: "'When an alien lives with you in your land, do not mistreat him.

ekegusii: “Ekero ekerecha ki’eubi kiarure ase omonto, nigo kegoeta gati aase atari namache, kiarigia aase kegotimokera, korende tigekonyora.
english: "When an evil spirit comes out of a man, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.

ekegusii: “Ekero ekerecha ki’eubi kiarure ase omonto, nigo kegoeta gati aase atari namache, gekorigia aase kegotimokera; getanyoreti kiabora: Ning’irane ase enyomba yane ase narwete.
english: "When an evil spirit comes out of a man, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, 'I will return to the house I left.'

ekegusii: “Omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, oreatanane korwa asende na koa emegwekano eyio ribaga ase enkoro yaye, eyio ekoba ekegocha gekomoraa gochia gokora ebibe, naende abe ogocha ase omobani komboria amang’ana goetera asare, oyio ninche Omonene omonyene ndamoiranerie.
english: "'When any Israelite or any alien living in Israel separates himself from me and sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face and then goes to a prophet to inquire of me, I the LORD will answer him myself.

ekegusii: “Ekero omonto abeire negesambo, gose abimbire risankwa ri’omobere oye, gose risankwa riatorekire na koonchoka ribe buna oborwaire bwa ukoma, omonto oyio arentwe ase Haroni omokuani, gose ase oyomo bw’abamura baye ore omokuani.
english: "When anyone has a swelling or a rash or a bright spot on his skin that may become an infectious skin disease, he must be brought to Aaron the priest or to one of his sons who is a priest.

ekegusii: “Ekero omonto abwate oborwaire bwa ukoma ararentwe ase omokuani,
english: "When anyone has an infectious skin disease, he must be brought to the priest.

ekegusii: “Ekero omonto arabe nokomocha ase amang’ana goika aorokie ebibe ebio akorire.
english: "'When anyone is guilty in any of these ways, he must confess in what way he has sinned

ekegusii: “Abaefraimu mbaroche oborwaire bwabo, na Abayuda amagumba abo. Ase ayio Abaefraimu bakagenda ase Abaasuri, bakarangeria omoruoti Yarebu. Korende omoruoti oyio takonyara kobagwenia korwa ase oborwaire bwaino, gose amagumba aino,
english: "When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his sores, then Ephraim turned to Assyria, and sent to the great king for help. But he is not able to cure you, not able to heal your sores.

ekegusii: Ekero riagorobire, omonyene omogondo agatebia omorendi oye: Rangeria abaremi, obae eng’eria yabo, ochakere korwa abanyuma goika abe ritang’ani.
english: "When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, 'Call the workers and pay them their wages, beginning with the last ones hired and going on to the first.'

ekegusii: “Kerabe enchara erache ase ense, gose oborwaire obobe bogoita, gose oborwaire bw’enyagetabo ase chindagera, gose obw’ogochirigisia, gose chingige, gose amakonde, gose ababisa bakoboera ase omochie onde bwonsi ase emechie yabo, gose obobe bonde bwonsi, gose oborwaire bonde bwonsi,
english: "When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when an enemy besieges them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,

ekegusii: “Kerabe enchara yachire ase ense, gose oborwaire obobe bogoita, gose oborwaire bw’enyagetabo ase chindagera, gose obw’ogochirigisia, gose chingige, gose amakonde, gose ababisa bakoboera ase omochie onde bwonsi ase emechie yabo, gose obobe bonde bwonsi borache, gose oborwaire bonde bwonsi;
english: "When famine or plague comes to the land, or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers, or when enemies besiege them in any of their cities, whatever disaster or disease may come,

ekegusii: Goika agachia kweirana kweboria ere omonyene, akabora: Abasomba b’eng’eria ba tata mbarenga bakare koria endagera na gotigaria, na inche aiga ngokwa nenchara!
english: "When he came to his senses, he said, 'How many of my father's hired men have food to spare, and here I am starving to death!

ekegusii: Omonto oria omoiti, ekero aratamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio goika agende atenene ase egeita ki’omochie oyio, akwane amang’ana aye nabatang’ani b’omochie oria. Barabwo bamosoyie ase omochie bamoe aase akomenya ase egati yabo.
english: "When he flees to one of these cities, he is to stand in the entrance of the city gate and state his case before the elders of that city. Then they are to admit him into their city and give him a place to live with them.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Buna koreng’ana barabwo bataigwerete ekero nabarangeretie, bono nainche tinkoigwa ekero barandangerie.
english: "'When I called, they did not listen; so when they called, I would not listen,' says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: “Inche nacha rero ase ensoko, nasaba iga: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Ibrahimu, koranche onsesenie bono ase orogendo rwane nkogenda.
english: "When I came to the spring today, I said, 'O LORD, God of my master Abraham, if you will, please grant success to the journey on which I have come.

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene nigo nanyorete Abaisraeli banga buna emesabibu ase erooro; nigo naroche chisokoro chiaino chinga buna okwama ogotang’ani kw’emeko. Korende bakagenda Baali‐Peori, bakerua abanyene gosasima enyasae eria y’obosooku, bakaba okogechia buna enyasae eria banchete ere.
english: "When I found Israel, it was like finding grapes in the desert; when I saw your fathers, it was like seeing the early fruit on the fig tree. But when they came to Baal Peor, they consecrated themselves to that shameful idol and became as vile as the thing they loved.

ekegusii: “Ekero nairanete Yerusalemu, ngosaba narenge ase Hekalu ime, nkabwatwa nobogondereria,
english: "When I returned to Jerusalem and was praying at the temple, I fell into a trance

ekegusii: Ekero ndasieke igoro, erinde ntange embura tetwa, gose nchike chingige chisarie ense, gose ntome oborwaire bogoita ase egati y’abanto baane,
english: "When I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or command locusts to devour the land or send a plague among my people,

ekegusii: Ekero narenge kogenda ase egeita ki’omochie, goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane agwo ase ekeraario,
english: "When I went to the gate of the city and took my seat in the public square,

ekegusii: “Ekero Israeli arenge omwana, nigo namwanchete, na korwa Misiri nkarangeria omwana one.
english: "When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.

ekegusii: “Ekero akoorire emiaka emerongo ene, akarengereria ase enkoro yaye kogenda korora abamwabo, Abaisraeli.
english: "When Moses was forty years old, he decided to visit his fellow Israelites.

ekegusii: Ekero omoyo one ogiregete ime yane, nigo nakoinyorete aye Omonene, na ogosaba kwane gokagoikera agwo ase Hekalu yao Enchenu.
english: "When my life was ebbing away, I remembered you, LORD, and my prayer rose to you, to your holy temple.

ekegusii: “Ekero Farao arababorie ng’a mokore egekone, erio aye Musa otebie Haroni abogorie enyimbo yaye, ayerute inse bosio bwa Farao, na ero neonchoke ebe eng’iti.”
english: "When Pharaoh says to you, 'Perform a miracle,' then say to Aaron, 'Take your staff and throw it down before Pharaoh,' and it will become a snake."

ekegusii: Ekero ogoiteka kwaye kw’amanyinga gwakamire, abare amatuko atano na abere, erio nabe ochenekire.
english: "'When she is cleansed from her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.

ekegusii: Ekero eng’ina yaganyete, na ogosemeria kwaye gokaera, ekaimokia emanwa yaye ende, ekayetuga ekaba endo ere nechinguru.
english: "'When she saw her hope unfulfilled, her expectation gone, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.

ekegusii: “Ekero omonto akondetera inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera, arue obosie obonuke, anyororokerie amaguta ase obosie obwo, abeke na ubani.
english: "'When someone brings a grain offering to the LORD, his offering is to be of fine flour. He is to pour oil on it, put incense on it

ekegusii: “Omonto onye orenge ne rigumba ase risankwa riaye, ne rigumba erio koriagwenire,
english: "When someone has a boil on his skin and it heals,

ekegusii: “Onye omonto ore ne risambo ri’omorero ayiete ase risankwa ri’omobere oye, na enyama embariri ekineteo ebe egesambo ki’obobariri na oborabu, gose kebe ekerabu,
english: "When someone has a burn on his skin and a reddish-white or white spot appears in the raw flesh of the burn,

ekegusii: “Gokorangerigwa nomonto ase omoyega bw’enyangi, toikaransa ase ekerogo kie ritang’ani; onye omonto bw’amasikani kobua aye orangeretigwe nere,
english: "When someone invites you to a wedding feast, do not take the place of honor, for a person more distinguished than you may have been invited.

ekegusii: Korende karache Omokonyi, oyo ndabatomere korwa ase Tata, Omoika bw’Ekeene okorwa ase Tata, ere nambere kirori.
english: "When the Counselor comes, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father, he will testify about me.

ekegusii: “Ekero amatuko ’omokungu oyio ay’ogochenwa aerire, karabe nomwana omoisia aiboire, gose egesagane, omokungu oyio arente eng’ondi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, ne riige rie riruma, gose riruma, ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Abirente ase omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: "'When the days of her purification for a son or daughter are over, she is to bring to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting a year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a dove for a sin offering.

ekegusii: “Ekero igoro erabe esiekire na embura tetwa, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore, kobarasabe barigereretie aase aiga, naende batogie erieta riao na baonchoke batige ebibe biabo, ekero aye orabae egesusuro,
english: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and confess your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,

ekegusii: “Ekero igoro erabe yasiekirwe na embura tetwa, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore, kobarasabe barigereretie aase aiga, naende batogie erieta riao na baonchoke batige ebibe biabo, ekero aye orabae egesusuro,
english: "When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because your people have sinned against you, and when they pray toward this place and confess your name and turn from their sin because you have afflicted them,

ekegusii: Abaruoti b’ense, abwo babwatanire nere ase obotomani na okogania okobe nabamoreere na komweumeria ekero bararore erioki ri’okoyia kwaye.
english: "When the kings of the earth who committed adultery with her and shared her luxury see the smoke of her burning, they will weep and mourn over her.

ekegusii: “Onye abanto b’ense eye bakorenta ebinto gose chindagera gotooneria rituko ri’Esabato, titokobigora ase Esabato gose ase rituko rinde richenu. Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere ntotige emegondo yaito etimoke teremwa, ne chisira titochiboria chiakanwe.
english: "When the neighboring peoples bring merchandise or grain to sell on the Sabbath, we will not buy from them on the Sabbath or on any holy day. Every seventh year we will forgo working the land and will cancel all debts.

ekegusii: “Ekero abanto b’ense eyio barache ase obosio bw’Omonene gosasima ase Amatuko Amanene, abwo barasoere egeita gia sugusu gocha gosasima, goika basokere egeita kia irianyi; na abwo barasoere egeita kia irianyi goika basokere egia sugusu; monto onde tairanera ase asoerete, korende airanere egeita kerochie ase ekio asoerete.
english: "'When the people of the land come before the LORD at the appointed feasts, whoever enters by the north gate to worship is to go out the south gate; and whoever enters by the south gate is to go out the north gate. No one is to return through the gate by which he entered, but each is to go out the opposite gate.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, ekiagera abaraai batang’anete Abaisraeli, na abanto beruete ase ogwancha kwabo!
english: "When the princes in Israel take the lead, when the people willingly offer themselves-- praise the LORD!

ekegusii: “Ekero Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto agochi‐gocha ase obonene bwaye, na abamalaika bonsi amo nere, erio naikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.
english: "When the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, he will sit on his throne in heavenly glory.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ekero oyomo bw’abanto aba, gose omobani, gose omokuani, arakoborie: Egurube y’Omonene nereri? Obairanerie, obatebie: Ninwe egurube yaye, ere nabaserie morueo.
english: "When these people, or a prophet or a priest, ask you, 'What is the oracle of the LORD?' say to them, 'What oracle? I will forsake you, declares the LORD.'

ekegusii: Ekero barabe bagosoa ase ebiita bigosoerwa ase eraaro ya ime, babeke chianga chiroisirie korwa ase egatani. Tibabaisa kobeka chianga chiroisirie korwa ase amarionya, ekero bagendererete gokora emeremo agwo ase amaagacho are egeita kegosoerwa ase eraaro ya ime, na ime ase enyomba.
english: "'When they enter the gates of the inner court, they are to wear linen clothes; they must not wear any woolen garment while ministering at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple.

ekegusii: “Omonto tari otagokora ebibe. Ase igo baise kogokorera ebibe, na aye korabe nendamwamu asebare na obabeke ase amaboko ’ababisa babo bairwe ase ense eng’ao, ere aare gose ang’e;
english: "When they sin against you-- for there is no one who does not sin-- and you become angry with them and give them over to the enemy, who takes them captive to a land far away or near;

ekegusii: “Omonto tari otagokora ebibe. Ase ayio baise kogokorera ebibe, na aye korabe nendamwamu asebare na kobabeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na abwo baboose na kobaira ase ense y’ababisa ere aare gose ang’e, obaigwe.
english: "When they sin against you-- for there is no one who does not sin-- and you become angry with them and give them over to the enemy, who takes them captive to his own land, far away or near;

ekegusii: “Inee! Ngoika ririri ogochia korigia amang’ana agokwanwa? Yarengererie, nyuma yaye naintwe tokwane.
english: "When will you end these speeches? Be sensible, and then we can talk.

ekegusii: “Ekero morabe mogoaka obomera ase ogwatera abanto ense yaino ebe emiando yabo, mwatananere na Omonene emonga yaye ebe enchenu. Obotambe bw’emonga eyio nigo borabe obw’ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare bwaye chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000). Emonga eyio engima nigo erabe enchenu.
english: "'When you allot the land as an inheritance, you are to present to the LORD a portion of the land as a sacred district, 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide; the entire area will be holy.

ekegusii: Naende kobakobaira ase chisinagogi, na ase abagambi, na ase abare nokobua, timochandeka buna morachie koiraneria gose buna morakwane,
english: "When you are brought before synagogues, rulers and authorities, do not worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say,

ekegusii: Na enyomba ende yonsi morasoe, ritang’ani mobore: Omorembe obe ase enyomba eye.
english: "When you enter a house, first say, 'Peace to this house.'

ekegusii: "When you enter a town and are welcomed, eat what is set before you.
english: Na omochie onde bwonsi morasoe, kobarabaroisie, karie eki barabae.

ekegusii: “Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kanani na mosimeke emete y’ebisaku ao ao ekwama amatunda, timobaisa koria amatunda ’emete eyio ase engaki y’emiaka etato ye ritang’ani, korende moyebare ng’a nekanire.
english: "'When you enter the land and plant any kind of fruit tree, regard its fruit as forbidden. For three years you are to consider it forbidden; it must not be eaten.

ekegusii: “Ekero moraike ase ense ya Kanani, eyio ndabae ebe eyaino, na kondarente ukoma ase enyomba gete agwo,
english: "When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving you as your possession, and I put a spreading mildew in a house in that land,

ekegusii: “Ekero mokweng’ata timokonyiria amasio aino buna abang’ainereria, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakonyiria amasio abo, erinde banyare kororwa nabanto ng’a mbeng’atete. Nekeene nabatebirie ng’a banyorire eng’eria yabo.
english: "When you fast, do not look somber as the hypocrites do, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting. I tell you the truth, they have received their reward in full.

ekegusii: “Ekero mogosaacha abakungu b’Abaibirania kobakoibora, morigererie mwana ki oiborwa; onye nomoisia, momoite, korende onye nomoiseke, momotige abe moyo.”
english: "When you help the Hebrew women in childbirth and observe them on the delivery stool, if it is a boy, kill him; but if it is a girl, let her live."

ekegusii: Ekero okorua eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi, onye nase ogoikerania eira kwariete, gose ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase Omonene,
english: "'When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice, for a special vow or a fellowship offering to the LORD,

ekegusii: “Ekero mokogesa emegondo yaino, timogesa moikie ase chingito kegima, gose timoirana gochora ebitigari ase emegondo.
english: "'When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest.

ekegusii: “Ekero mokogesa emegondo yaino, timogesa moikie ase chingito kegima, gose timoirana gochora ebitigari ase emegondo yaino; eyio motigere abataka na abamenyi. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: "'When you reap the harvest of your land, do not reap to the very edges of your field or gather the gleanings of your harvest. Leave them for the poor and the alien. I am the LORD your God.'"

ekegusii: “Onye moganetie korua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe asende inche Omonene, mobwate emeroberio yachikirwe, erio nario ekeng’wanso ekio kerancherwe.
english: "'When you sacrifice a fellowship offering to the LORD, sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

ekegusii: Ekero moganetie konduera inche Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, mokerue ase enchera endonge, erinde monyare gwancherwa.
english: "When you sacrifice a thank offering to the LORD, sacrifice it in such a way that it will be accepted on your behalf.

ekegusii: “Korende, komorarore Yerusalemu oetananirwe nemeganda y’abarwani b’esegi, erio momanye ng’a ogosareka kwaye gwaikire ang’e.
english: "When you see Jerusalem being surrounded by armies, you will know that its desolation is near.

ekegusii: “Korende komorakorore okogechia kw’ogosaria kogotenena aase atagwenereti, (oyogosoma amanye), erio abare Boyahudi batame gochia ase ebitunwa;
english: "When you see 'the abomination that causes desolation' standing where it does not belong-- let the reader understand-- then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

ekegusii: “Ekero orabe gokobara Abaisraeli ase okorikwa kwabo, kera omonto arue ekeegwa ase Omonene, kebe embooria ase obogima bwaye, tibabaisa konyora amaakwa ekero bakorikwa.
english: "When you take a census of the Israelites to count them, each one must pay the LORD a ransom for his life at the time he is counted. Then no plague will come on them when you number them.

ekegusii: “Aye Yeremia, obatebie amang’ana ayio onsi, korende barabwo tibakogotegerera. Nobarangerie, korende tibakogoitabera.
english: "When you tell them all this, they will not listen to you; when you call to them, they will not answer.

ekegusii: “Ekero oratebie abanto amang’ana aya onsi, barabwo babe bagokoboria: Nase ki Omonene arentire obobe obo obonene asetore? Obobe bwaito mborobi? Ebibe twakorire ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, mbiribi?
english: "When you tell these people all this and they ask you, 'Why has the LORD decreed such a great disaster against us? What wrong have we done? What sin have we committed against the LORD our God?'

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bamino barakoborie iga: Inee! Nototebie engencho gwakorera iga?
english: "When your countrymen ask you, 'Won't you tell us what you mean by this?'

ekegusii: “Abanto bao kobaragende ase esegi korwania ababisa babo ase enchera ende yonsi aye orabatome gochia, na kobaragosabe aye Omonene barigereretie omochie oyio gwachorire, na enyomba eye naagacheire erieta riao,
english: "When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to the LORD toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,

ekegusii: “Abanto bao kobaragende korwania ababisa babo ase enchera ende yonsi aye orabatome gochia, na kobaragosabe aye Omonene barigereretie omochie oyio gwachorire, na enyomba eye naagacheire erieta riao,
english: "When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you send them, and when they pray to you toward this city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name,

ekegusii: “Onye abanto bao Abaisraeli babuirwe nababisa babo, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore, korende bagokoiranera naende na gotogia erieta riao, na ase enyomba eye bakogosaba na gokoboria ase oboitongo,
english: "When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you and when they turn back and confess your name, praying and making supplication before you in this temple,

ekegusii: “Ekero abanto bao Abaisraeli barabe babuirwe nababisa babo, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asore korende bagokoiranera naende na gotogia erieta riao, na ase enyomba eye bakogosaba na gokoboria ase oboitongo,
english: "When your people Israel have been defeated by an enemy because they have sinned against you, and when they turn back to you and confess your name, praying and making supplication to you in this temple,

ekegusii: Naboigo Haroni arabogorie amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase egesembe keria gi’ekina igoro y’enkoro yaye ekero agosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu, ayarente abe ekeinyorio botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: "Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he will bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of decision as a continuing memorial before the LORD.

ekegusii: “Ekero nganetie kogwenia Abaisraeli, ogosaria kw’Abaefraimu na ogokora okobe kw’Abasamaria nigo gokororekana maiso marore. Barabwo nigo bagokora ay’obong’ainereria; abaibi nigo bagotagora chinyomba basoa ime, na ebiombe bi’abauri nigo bikourereria isiko.
english: "Whenever I would restore the fortunes of my people, whenever I would heal Israel, the sins of Ephraim are exposed and the crimes of Samaria revealed. They practice deceit, thieves break into houses, bandits rob in the streets;

ekegusii: "Where are they taking the basket?" I asked the angel who was speaking to me.
english: Nkaboria omomalaika oria orenge gokwana nainche, “Ng’ai bakoira egetonga keria?”

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Ng’ai origetie toyeroiserie?”
english: "Where do you want us to prepare for it?" they asked.

ekegusii: Daudi akamoboria, “Ng’ai okorwa?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Nigo natoorekire korwa ase egetwori ki’Abaisraeli.”
english: "Where have you come from?" David asked him. He answered, "I have escaped from the Israelite camp."

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ng’ai mwamobeka?” Bakamotebia, “Omonene, inchuo orore!”
english: "Where have you laid him?" he asked. "Come and see, Lord," they replied.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoboria, “Ng’ai akare?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Nigo akare o Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, aaria Lo‐Debari.”
english: "Where is he?" the king asked. Ziba answered, "He is at the house of Makir son of Ammiel in Lo Debar."

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Ng’ai are oyio?” Akabora, “Timanyeti.”
english: "Where is this man?" they asked him. "I don't know," he said.

ekegusii: "Where is your faith?" he asked his disciples. In fear and amazement they asked one another, "Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him."
english: Akabatebia, “Okwegena kwaino, ng’ai kore?” Bakairoka, bagakumia bagatebania, “Oyo nere ng’o, ogochika nonya nomwaga na enyancha, bikomoigwera?”

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoboria, “Ng’ai Sara mokao are?” Ere akabairaneria, “Neema ime are.”
english: "Where is your wife Sarah?" they asked him. "There, in the tent," he said.

ekegusii: “Bono rende, obong’aini ng’ai bokorwa? Na ng’ai okomanya komenyete?
english: "Where then does wisdom come from? Where does understanding dwell?
