ekegusii: Ng’ai kwarenge ekero nabegete oboroso bw’ense? Ntebie onye aye kore omong’aini.
english: "Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Ng’ai Omonene?” Akabairaneria, “Ase ribego rire nao chinsoti chigosangererekana.”
english: "Where, Lord?" they asked. He replied, "Where there is a dead body, there the vultures will gather."

ekegusii: “Amakweri, ng’ai okobua kwao kore? Amakweri, ng’ai obororo bwao bore?”
english: "Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?"

ekegusii: “Norori ase emete yonsi ya Edeni oreng’anigwe naye ase ogosikwa na obonene? Aye noirwe amo nemete ende yonsi ya Edeni, otugutwe inse ye riroba amo nero; nobe amo nabwo batarogeti, abaitetwe nemioro. “Ayio naro arakoreke ase Farao amo nomoganda oye bwonsi. Omonene Nyasae otebire ayio.”
english: "'Which of the trees of Eden can be compared with you in splendor and majesty? Yet you, too, will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the earth below; you will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword. "'This is Pharaoh and all his hordes, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Inee! Norori ase baria babere okorete ogwancha gwa ise?” Bakabora, “Noria bwe ritang’ani.” Yeso akabatebia, “Nekeene nabatebirie ng’a abarusia ebango na abakungu abatayayi nkobatang’anera bare gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
english: "Which of the two did what his father wanted?" "The first," they answered. Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you.

ekegusii: Gavuna akababoria naende, “Ase abanto aba babere, norori morigetie mbasiborere?” Bakamotebia, “Baraba.”
english: "Which of the two do you want me to release to you?" asked the governor. "Barabbas," they answered.

ekegusii: Naki rende oroche ase abaiga batato, norori orenge omogisangio oye ere oyogwete ase amaboko ’abauri?”
english: "Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?"

ekegusii: Naki monto onde nare asemore oyore ise, na omwana oye amosabe omogati, Inee, namoe rigena? Gose karamosabe enswe, ase ribaga ri’enswe namoe eng’iti?
english: "Which of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?

ekegusii: Gose monto onde nare asemore, na omwana oye amosabe omogati, Inee, namoe rigena?
english: "Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone?

ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Ayare buna arari?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Toita, Totomana, Toiba, Toteba oborimo,
english: "Which ones?" the man inquired. Jesus replied, "'Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not give false testimony,

ekegusii: Buna narenge ndigereretie na korengereria igoro ye chingunchara chiria, nkarora orogunchara ronde oroke rokooroka korwa ase egati‐gati ye chingunchara chiria. Orogunchara roria oroke rogasimora chingunchara isato ase echio ikomi chiarotang’anerete, rogachisimora amo nememio‐mio. Nkarora orogunchara roria robwate amaiso buna ay’omonto, na omonwa orenge gokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu.
english: "While I was thinking about the horns, there before me was another horn, a little one, which came up among them; and three of the first horns were uprooted before it. This horn had eyes like the eyes of a man and a mouth that spoke boastfully.

ekegusii: “Bogoria amagena amanene ase amaboko ao, erio oyaoomeranie inse, ang’e negesoero ki’enyomba ya Farao, agwo Tapanesi. Okore ayio ekero Abayuda baroche.
english: "While the Jews are watching, take some large stones with you and bury them in clay in the brick pavement at the entrance to Pharaoh's palace in Tahpanhes.

ekegusii: “Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye ase egati ye chinyasae? Ning’o onga buna aye ore nobonene na obochenu? Naye ogwenerete koirokwa na gotogigwa, aye naye oyogokora amakumia.
english: "Who among the gods is like you, O LORD? Who is like you-- majestic in holiness, awesome in glory, working wonders?

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Baba na bamura baminto mbarabi?”
english: "Who are my mother and my brothers?" he asked.

ekegusii: “Mbarabi aba bagoeta buna amare agoeta igoro, aba banga buna amaruma akoiruruka gochia ase ebiswa biabo?
english: "Who are these that fly along like clouds, like doves to their nests?

ekegusii: Nkairaneria: Naye ng’o Omonene? Agantebia: Ninche Yeso o Nazareti oyogwachandire aye.
english: "'Who are you, Lord?' I asked. "'I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you are persecuting,' he replied.

ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Naye ng’o Omonene?” Akairaneria, “Ninche Yeso, oyogwachandire aye,
english: "Who are you, Lord?" Saul asked. "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting," he replied.

ekegusii: Boazi akamoboria, “Naye ng’o?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Ninche Rutu omosomba oo, nachire ontuge, ekiagera nigo ore omonyamwando o tata biara.”
english: "Who are you?" he asked. "I am your servant Ruth," she said. "Spread the corner of your garment over me, since you are a kinsman-redeemer."

ekegusii: Nabo bakamoboria, “Naye ng’o?” Yeso akabairaneria, “Nonya nayio nabatebirie inwe korwa omochakano.
english: "Who are you?" they asked. "Just what I have been claiming all along," Jesus replied.

ekegusii: Ning’o orachaye rituko ri’amang’ana amake kagochaka, ekero amaiso aria atano na abere ararore ekebiro ase okoboko gwa Serubabeli, nagoke? “Ayio atano na abere namaiso ’Omonene arigereretie chinsemo chionsi chi’ense.”
english: "Who despises the day of small things? Men will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. "(These seven are the eyes of the LORD, which range throughout the earth.)"

ekegusii: "Who has ever given to God, that God should repay him?"
english: Gose ning’o omoete ekeegwa ritang’ani, erinde akeiranerigwe?”

ekegusii: “Naki ning’o omanyete ebirengererio bi’Omonene? Gose ning’o okomotebereria buna agwenerete agambe?
english: "Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?"

ekegusii: “Ning’o orangeretie oyomo korwa moocha, oria oumeranete nobobui aande onsi ase agendete? Ere nigo akobeka abanto b’ebisaku inse y’okobua kwaye, erinde atachere abaruoti inse y’amagoro aye; oyio nigo agoita abanto b’ebisaku nomoro, obakora baba buna orotu, na ase obota bwaye nigo akobasiarera buna obonyansi obwomo.
english: "Who has stirred up one from the east, calling him in righteousness to his service? He hands nations over to him and subdues kings before him. He turns them to dust with his sword, to windblown chaff with his bow.

ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Ning’o oyio, Omonene, nyare komwegena?”
english: "Who is he, sir?" the man asked. "Tell me so that I may believe in him."

ekegusii: Nigo bagoteba: “Ning’o Isaya aganetie kworokereria obong’aini, na ning’o ere aranyare komanyia amang’ana aye amaya? Inee! Nabana abake abwo batachirwe, abwo batigigwe kogonka?
english: "Who is it he is trying to teach? To whom is he explaining his message? To children weaned from their milk, to those just taken from the breast?

ekegusii: “Aye naye ng’o okorenta omosunte ase ogosemia ase ogokwana amang’ana atari ay’obong’aini?
english: "Who is this that darkens my counsel with words without knowledge?

ekegusii: "Who is this that rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters?
english: Ning’o oyo onga buna orooche rwa Naili rwaichoire, oyo onga buna chindooche chiaichoire amache?

ekegusii: "Who let the wild donkey go free? Who untied his ropes?
english: “Ning’o otigire etigere y’orosana esiboire? Gose ning’o bwororobirie ebisibo bi’etigere ere enyango?

ekegusii: “Ning’o osiegete ebisieri bi’enyancha, ekero yarindoretie buna ndiria yarenge ime ase enda y’ense?
english: "Who shut up the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,

ekegusii: “Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, obegetwe nomonene oye igoro ase enyomba yaye, ae abanto endagera ase ekero ekeronge?
english: "Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?

ekegusii: Yeso akaboria, “Ning’o onkuna?” Ekero abanto bonsi bagakana, Petero na baria barenge amo nere bakamotebia, “Omonene, omoganda nigo ogoetanaine na gokomiga.”
english: "Who touched me?" Jesus asked. When they all denied it, Peter said, "Master, the people are crowding and pressing against you."

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, ning’o orabarorere amabeebe, gose abechandere, gose oraonchoke gocha asemore, baborie amang’ana aino?
english: "Who will have pity on you, O Jerusalem? Who will mourn for you? Who will stop to ask how you are?

ekegusii: Naki kera omonto oranyatore ase mwanyabanto, nainche boigo nimwatore ase Tata one ore igoro,
english: "Whoever acknowledges me before men, I will also acknowledge him before my Father in heaven.

ekegusii: “Oyore omwegenwa ase ekere egeke, nabo are omwegenwa ase ekere ekenene; na oyotari omoronge ase ekere egeke, naboigo tari omoronge ase ekere ekenene.
english: "Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokurera omonyacheche, nigo akwenyorera obororo; na oyogotogonyera omonto omokori amabe nigo akwenyorera ogochaywa.
english: "Whoever corrects a mocker invites insult; whoever rebukes a wicked man incurs abuse.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi oratame ase engencho y’omoondoko nagwe ase eirima, na oyo orasoke korwa ase eirima nabwatwe nomoeto. Nindete ayio igoro y’Abamoabu ase omwaka ndabae egesusuro kiabo. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Whoever flees from the terror will fall into a pit, whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare; for I will bring upon Moab the year of her punishment," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Omonto oraruere enyasae ende yonsi ekeng’wanso, otatiga Omonene bweka, goika asirigwe kegima.
english: "Whoever sacrifices to any god other than the LORD must be destroyed.

ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oraitere amanyinga a mwanyabanto, amanyinga ’omonto oyio naiterwe na mwanyabanto, ekiagera Nyasae nigo atongete mwanyabanto ase omogwekano oye.
english: "Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man shall his blood be shed; for in the image of God has God made man.

ekegusii: “Monto onde bwensi orakune omobere bw’omonto okwete, nabe oyotachenegeti ase amatuko atano na abere.
english: "Whoever touches the dead body of anyone will be unclean for seven days.

ekegusii: "'Whoever touches the man who has a discharge must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.
english: Na onde bwensi orakune omonto oyio omorwaire goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

ekegusii: “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyomo buna oyo ase erieta riane, oyio onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, tanyancheti inche, korende ere oyontomete.”
english: "Whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me does not welcome me but the one who sent me."

ekegusii: “Ning’o kwoboete na okamoiroka goika ogakwana oborimo? Tikware kong’inyora gose ondengererie? Inee! Tinabete ndemereretie ase engaki entambe, naye tikwabete gokonyiroka?
english: "Whom have you so dreaded and feared that you have been false to me, and have neither remembered me nor pondered this in your hearts? Is it not because I have long been silent that you do not fear me?

ekegusii: Saulo akamoboria, “Omosae oyo, noyo ng’o ore?” Daudi akamoiraneria, “Inche nomwana bw’omosomba oo, Yese o Bethlehemu.”
english: "Whose son are you, young man?" Saul asked him. David said, "I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem."

ekegusii: Nase ki toikaransete tokirete‐kiri? Inchuo tosangererekane amo, togende tosoe ase emechie egiteire chindwaki, erinde tokwere aroro. Omonene, Nyasae oito, otonacheire ekina tosire, otoeire amache abekire obosongo tonywe, ekiagera twakorire ebibe asare.
english: "Why are we sitting here? Gather together! Let us flee to the fortified cities and perish there! For the LORD our God has doomed us to perish and given us poisoned water to drink, because we have sinned against him.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inaki mwararire? Boka, mosabe, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.”
english: "Why are you sleeping?" he asked them. "Get up and pray so that you will not fall into temptation."

ekegusii: “Ninki kiagerete tinakwera inda ya baba? Ninki kiagerete tinakwa ekero keria nasogete korwao?
english: "Why did I not perish at birth, and die as I came from the womb?

ekegusii: “Nase ki motarierete ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe agwo aase are aachenu? Ekio negento egechenu mono mwaeirwe, erinde moruserie omoganda ebibe biabo, na gokora okobwatanigwa asebare ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: "Why didn't you eat the sin offering in the sanctuary area? It is most holy; it was given to you to take away the guilt of the community by making atonement for them before the LORD.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Nase ki okomboria ninki kere ekiya? Oyomo nareo oyore omuya. Onye korigetie gosoa ase obogima, bwata amachiko.”
english: "Why do you ask me about what is good?" Jesus replied. "There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, obey the commandments."

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nakwanire iga: Nase ki mokwemurungania asende? Inwe mwensi mwasaririe asende.
english: "Why do you bring charges against me? You have all rebelled against me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Naki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.
english: "Why do you call me good?" Jesus answered. "No one is good-- except God alone.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Naki okondoka omuya? Onde tari omuya otatiga Nyasae bweka.
english: "Why do you call me good?" Jesus answered. "No one is good-- except God alone.

ekegusii: “Nase ki mokondoka Omonene, Omonene, na inwe timori gokora aya ngoteba?
english: "Why do you call me, 'Lord, Lord,' and do not do what I say?

ekegusii: Inaki okorigereria ekeogoto kere ase eriso ri’oyomino, na omoribo ore ase eriso riao ime toyorochi?
english: "Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother's eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?

ekegusii: “Nase ki aborokigwa bao bagosaria chingencho chi’abagaaka? Naki kobakoragera tibari goisaba amaboko abo.”
english: "Why do your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They don't wash their hands before they eat!"

ekegusii: “Nase ki Omonguru atabegeti chingaki chi’ekina? Naende nase ki baria bamwanchete batararora rituko riria riaye?
english: "Why does the Almighty not set times for judgment? Why must those who know him look in vain for such days?

ekegusii: “Naki oyo agoteba iga? Nkorama are! Ning’o oranyare kwabera ebibe, otatiga oyomo, nere Nyasae?”
english: "Why does this fellow talk like that? He's blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?"

ekegusii: “Naende naki ase emioyo yaino motari gwatanana ayare boronge?
english: "Why don't you judge for yourselves what is right?

ekegusii: Omosacha oye akamoboria, “Nase ki okogenda asare rero? Rero tikori okooroka kw’omotienyi nonya n’Esabato.” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Nabo erabe buya.”
english: "Why go to him today?" he asked. "It's not the New Moon or the Sabbath." "It's all right," she said.

ekegusii: “Nase ki oyochandegete akoegwa korora omobaso? Nase ki oria obwate obororo ase enkoro akoegwa obogima?
english: "Why is light given to those in misery, and life to the bitter of soul,

ekegusii: Hasaeli akamoboria, “Ninki kiaba aye, omonene one, okorera?” Elisha akamoiraneria, “Nekiagera namanyire obobe boria orakore ase Abaisraeli; nosambe chiburi chiabo, noite abasae babo nomoro, naende nonachane abana babo abake ebing’ese, na abakungu babo bare barito noboore chinda chiabo.”
english: "Why is my lord weeping?" asked Hazael. "Because I know the harm you will do to the Israelites," he answered. "You will set fire to their fortified places, kill their young men with the sword, dash their little children to the ground, and rip open their pregnant women."

ekegusii: Erio Yonathani akamoboria, “Nase ki araitwe akwe? Ngento ki akorire?”
english: "Why should he be put to death? What has he done?" Jonathan asked his father.

ekegusii: “Naki ndakore mbaabere? Abana baino bantigire, nigo bagotiana ase chinyasae ching’ao. Ekero nabaete ebinto biisaine nigo babete bagotomana, bakagenda ase chinyomba chi’abakungu abanyaka.
english: "Why should I forgive you? Your children have forsaken me and sworn by gods that are not gods. I supplied all their needs, yet they committed adultery and thronged to the houses of prostitutes.

ekegusii: “Nase ki kwandusetie ase enda ya baba? Naki anga yare koba buya onye nakwete ekero monto onde atarandora,
english: "Why then did you bring me out of the womb? I wish I had died before any eye saw me.

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Nase ki rende Musa achigete komoa omokungu rirube ri’ogotigana, nakomotiga?”
english: "Why then," they asked, "did Moses command that a man give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?"

ekegusii: “Nase ki amaguta aya ataoonigwa chidinari amagana atato, na echio chiegwe abataka?”
english: "Why wasn't this perfume sold and the money given to the poor? It was worth a year's wages."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Naki mokondigia? Timomanyeti ng’a nengwenerete koba ase enyomba ya Tata one?”
english: "Why were you searching for me?" he asked. "Didn't you know I had to be in my Father's house?"

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Barabwo bakamenta goaka egeturi, bakobora, “Tiga abambwe!”
english: "Why? What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"

ekegusii: Pilato akababoria, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete?” Bakamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Mobambe!”
english: "Why? What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nanyare konyibera inche Nyasae ebiane? Korende inwe mwanyibeire ebiane. Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ninki twakoibeire? Mwanyibeire ensemo ya ikomi na okoruegwa konde.
english: "Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me. "But you ask, 'How do we rob you?' "In tithes and offerings.

ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi nigo baramokorere echeche baroisie engero y’okomochecheria batebe, “Obobe nobwaye oyo‐gosangereria amo ebinto bitari ebiaye, na bwetweka ebinto airete bibe ntenenera. Ngoika ririri aragenderere gokora igo?”
english: "Will not all of them taunt him with ridicule and scorn, saying, "'Woe to him who piles up stolen goods and makes himself wealthy by extortion! How long must this go on?'

ekegusii: Inee! Ense tegotengechigwa ase engencho eyio, na kera omonto omenyete imeo arere na kobokia amagombo. Ee, ense engima nenyegerigwe na koimokererigwa igoro buna orooche rwa Naili roichire, nigo egotwoma‐twomana, naende yairana inse, buna orooche roria rwa Misiri”
english: "Will not the land tremble for this, and all who live in it mourn? The whole land will rise like the Nile; it will be stirred up and then sink like the river of Egypt.

ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene natotigire kegima? Tagotororera amabera rinde?
english: "Will the Lord reject forever? Will he never show his favor again?

ekegusii: "Will the one who contends with the Almighty correct him? Let him who accuses God answer him!"
english: “Inee! Omonto okona‐korigia amamocho naamereranie n’Omonguru? Aye okona‐koamererania na Nyasae, iraneria rende!”

ekegusii: “Inee! Eng’era nayanche egokorere emeremo? Nenyare korara ase obweri bwao botuko?
english: "Will the wild ox consent to serve you? Will he stay by your manger at night?

ekegusii: “Barabwo mbairane gochia ase ense ya Misiri, na Abaasuri mbabagambere, ekiagera bangire koirana gocha asende.
english: "Will they not return to Egypt and will not Assyria rule over them because they refuse to repent?

ekegusii: “Aye mwanyabanto, Inee, noganetie kobanachera ekina? Aye nobanachere ekina? Onye naboigo rirorio bamanyie ogokora kw’okogechia gwe chisokoro chiabo,
english: "Will you judge them? Will you judge them, son of man? Then confront them with the detestable practices of their fathers

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mogochia kogenderera koiba, na goita, na gotomana, na gotiana ase oborimo, na gosamba ubani ase enyasae eria Baali, naende gosasima chinyasae chinde ching’ao, echio motamanyeti.
english: "'Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, burn incense to Baal and follow other gods you have not known,

ekegusii: “Ere nabe noboremu, asangererie abarwani esegi abange mono gochia korwania omoruoti o irianyi, na omoruoti o irianyi nere nebeke ang’e korwana esegi nomoganda omonene mono ore ne chinguru, korende takobua, ekiagera nakorerwe emeroberio y’obong’ainereria.
english: "With a large army he will stir up his strength and courage against the king of the South. The king of the South will wage war with a large and very powerful army, but he will not be able to stand because of the plots devised against him.

ekegusii: "'With a ram prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of oil,
english: Ekero okorua emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso, orente amo nero obosie obonuke ebimunu bine, bwochoganirie namaguta egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera.

ekegusii: Obobe nobw’omonto oyio okoagacha omochie ase ogoitera amanyinga na kobeka oboroso bw’omochie ase ogokora ebibe.
english: "Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by crime!

ekegusii: Obobe nobw’omonto oyio okoagacha enyomba yaye ase chinchera chitari chia boronge, na ase oborianania koroisia chiero chinene chi’enyomba yaye; oyio ogokora omogisangio oye amokorere emeremo bosa, na tari komoakana eng’eria yaye.
english: "Woe to him who builds his palace by unrighteousness, his upper rooms by injustice, making his countrymen work for nothing, not paying them for their labor.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oria okonyora ebitoki bi’obobe na kobirenta ase enyomba yaye, erinde bweagachera egeswa kiaye aase aimokererete igoro ng’a abe noborendi korwa ase okobua kw’amabe.
english: "Woe to him who builds his realm by unjust gain to set his nest on high, to escape the clutches of ruin!

ekegusii: Obobe nobw’omonto oria okoa omonto onde ekenyugwa giochoganirie nobosongo kiamotindia, erinde anyare korigereria obogetirianda bwaye.
english: "Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors, pouring it from the wineskin till they are drunk, so that he can gaze on their naked bodies.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobw’oyio okoamererania n’Omotongi oye, oyio ore ekegonkorio ase egati y’ebinde. Inee! Esike neborie omoroisia iga: Ninki eke okoroisia? Gose ekeroisirie ngetebie omoroisia iga: Aye tobwati amaboko?
english: "Woe to him who quarrels with his Maker, to him who is but a potsherd among the potsherds on the ground. Does the clay say to the potter, 'What are you making?' Does your work say, 'He has no hands'?

ekegusii: Erio ngateba, “Obobe nobwane, ekiagera nasirire! Inche nigo mbwate ebikoba bitachenegeti, na nigo imenyete ase egati y’abanto babwate ebikoba bitachenegeti; naende amaiso aane arorire Omoruoti, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda.”
english: "Woe to me!" I cried. "I am ruined! For I am a man of unclean lips, and I live among a people of unclean lips, and my eyes have seen the King, the LORD Almighty."

ekegusii: “Obobe nobw’Abaasuri, abwo bare enyimbo y’endamwamu yane; okogechigwa kwane nigo kore enungu ase amaboko abo.
english: "Woe to the Assyrian, the rod of my anger, in whose hand is the club of my wrath!

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Obobe nobwaino inwe abana baane abamore abasaria, aba mogokora emeroberio etari eyane, nigo mogokora okobwatana okwo gotari okw’omoika one, na mwamenta ebibe igoro ase ebibe binde.
english: "Woe to the obstinate children," declares the LORD, "to those who carry out plans that are not mine, forming an alliance, but not by my Spirit, heaping sin upon sin;

ekegusii: Obobe nobw’abarisia abwo bagosaria na goserebania ching’ondi chie riicho riane. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: "Woe to the shepherds who are destroying and scattering the sheep of my pasture!" declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobw’ense ase engencho y’amateemwa ayakorenta ebibe! Naki amateemwa takomocha kobao, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oyio okorenta ogoteemwa!
english: "Woe to the world because of the things that cause people to sin! Such things must come, but woe to the man through whom they come!

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omorisia oyio otagwenereti, oyio ogotiga riicho rie ching’ondi! Tiga omoro oake okoboko kwaye na eriso riaye ria borio. Tiga okoboko kwaye kwome pa, na eriso riaye ria borio riukore kegima!”
english: "Woe to the worthless shepherd, who deserts the flock! May the sword strike his arm and his right eye! May his arm be completely withered, his right eye totally blinded!" An Oracle

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe abanto b’amachiko! Ekiagera mwarusirie ekeigorero gie chisemi; inwe abanyene timwasoa, na baria abaare gosoa mwabatangire.”
english: "Woe to you experts in the law, because you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering."

ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino Abafarisai, ekiagera mokorua ensemo ya ikomi ye chiarare, na kera egesaku gie chinyeni, mogotiga oboronge na obwanchani bwa Nyasae. Naro aya nabagwenerete moyakore, motari gotiga ayande.
english: "Woe to you Pharisees, because you give God a tenth of your mint, rue and all other kinds of garden herbs, but you neglect justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without leaving the former undone.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, Abafarisai! Ekiagera mwanchete goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro.
english: "Woe to you Pharisees, because you love the most important seats in the synagogues and greetings in the marketplaces.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mogwekaine chimbeera chitari kororekana, na abanto baeta igoro yaye batamanyeti.”
english: "Woe to you, because you are like unmarked graves, which men walk over without knowing it."

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mokoagacha chimbeera chi’ababani, abwo chisokoro chiaino chiaitete.
english: "Woe to you, because you build tombs for the prophets, and it was your forefathers who killed them.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, abaraai emeuko, inwe abamogoteba: Onde bwensi kararie emuma ase Hekalu, tari gento, korende onde bwensi kararie emuma ase etahabu ye Hekalu, bwesibire nemuma yaye.
english: "Woe to you, blind guides! You say, 'If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gold of the temple, he is bound by his oath.'

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwao, Korasin! Obobe nobwao, Bethisaida! Ekiagera onye mbiakoregete ase Turo na Sidoni ebikone bie chinguru ebiakoregete asemore, abanto b’aroro anga mbaonchogete kare na goikaransa babegete chianga chie chigunia na beagete ribu.
english: "Woe to you, Korazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwao, Korasin! Obobe nobwao, Bethisaida! Ekiagera onye mbiakoregete ase Turo na Sidoni ebikone bie chinguru ebiakoregete asemore, abanto b’aroro, anga mbaonchogete kare na kobeka chianga chie chigunia, na kweaka ribu.
english: "Woe to you, Korazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! If the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogwekaine nechimbeera chiakire echooka; na chirochio isiko chirorekana ng’a nechingiya, korende ime nigo chiichire namauga ’ebitondo, na euramba yonsi.
english: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men's bones and everything unclean.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mokoagacha chimbeera chi’ababani, na koroisia chimbeera chi’abaronge,
english: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime biaichoire nobouri na okogania gotari nekerengo.
english: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mokorua ensemo ya ikomi ye chiarare, na ebinsari, ne chinyeni chinde, na mwatiga amang’ana ayare amanene ay’ogochika na oboronge, na amabera, na okwegena. Naro ayio nabagwenerete moyakore, amo na gotatiga ayande.
english: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You give a tenth of your spices-- mint, dill and cummin. But you have neglected the more important matters of the law-- justice, mercy and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.

ekegusii: “Korende obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera mwasiekeire abanto oboruoti bwa igoro; naki inwe abanyene timwasoa, nonya nabaare gosoa, timware kobaa ribaga basoe. [
english: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the kingdom of heaven in men's faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let those enter who are trying to.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera nigo mogosiongorokana enyancha na ense enyomo konyora omotunyani oyomo, na ekero abeire omotunyani, mwagera oba omwana bw’omorero o kare na kare ara kabere kobua inwe abanyene.
english: "Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga, “Obobe nobwao! Nyuma kogwakorire amabe aya onsi,
english: "'Woe! Woe to you, declares the Sovereign LORD. In addition to all your other wickedness,

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Omong’ina, ninki okorera? Ning’o okorigia?” Ere agakaga ng’a nomorendi bw’omogondo, akamotebia, “Omonene, onye naye kwamoira, ntebia aase kwamobeka, na inche nimorusie.”
english: "Woman," he said, "why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?" Thinking he was the gardener, she said, "Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him."

ekegusii: “Inee! Omonto omong’aini nagwenerete airanerie amang’ana are buna omwaga okogusa, na goichoria enda yaye nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha?
english: "Would a wise man answer with empty notions or fill his belly with the hot east wind?

ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare kombara ng’a nomomochi inde? Norigetie kongambia inche, erinde obarerwe oboronge?
english: "Would you discredit my justice? Would you condemn me to justify yourself?

ekegusii: "Write, therefore, what you have seen, what is now and what will take place later.
english: Bono rika amang’ana aya kwarorire, ayareo, na ayarache koba nyuma y’ayio.

ekegusii: "Yes, go," she answered. And the girl went and got the baby's mother.
english: Omoiseke o Farao akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda!” Erio akagenda, akarangeria ng’ina omwana oria.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Ee, nkorua are.” Goika agasoa nyomba, Yeso agatang’ana gokwana na Petero, akamoboria, “Inki okorengereria Simion? Abaruoti b’ense nigo bakorusia ebango na ogochoga korwa ase ng’o? Nkorwa ase abana babo, gose nase abanto bande?”
english: "Yes, he does," he replied. When Peter came into the house, Jesus was the first to speak. "What do you think, Simon?" he asked. "From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes-- from their own sons or from others?"

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Naboigo. Aye gwatebire, korende nabatebirie inwe, korwa bono inamorore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto oikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore nokobua, ogocha ase amare a igoro.”
english: "Yes, it is as you say," Jesus replied. "But I say to all of you: In the future you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven."

ekegusii: Korende ere akamoiraneria, “Nabo Omonene, nonya nechisese nyaro ye chimesa nigo chikoria amatori ’abana.”
english: "Yes, Lord," she replied, "but even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs."

ekegusii: Akabora, “Ee, Omonene, korende nonya ne chisese nkoria chire amatori ayakogwa korwa ase chimesa chi’abanene babo.”
english: "Yes, Lord," she said, "but even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table."

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Ee, Omonene; inche negenire ng’a aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae, oria ogocha ase ense.”
english: "Yes, Lord," she told him, "I believe that you are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world."

ekegusii: Baruku akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Ee, ekero Yeremia agendererete gokwana amang’ana aya, inche nario nagendererete koyarika newino ase ebuku eye.”
english: "Yes," Baruch replied, "he dictated all these words to me, and I wrote them in ink on the scroll."

ekegusii: Elija akamoiraneria, “Ee, ninche. Genda otebie omonene oo ng’a inche Elija nao inde aiga.”
english: "Yes," he replied. "Go tell your master, 'Elijah is here.'"

ekegusii: “Korende nyuma y’ayio ning’iranerie Abaamoni amaya abo. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: "Yet afterward, I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire, “Nonya nase amatuko ayio tinkobasiria inwe kegima.
english: "Yet even in those days," declares the LORD, "I will not destroy you completely.

ekegusii: Aye Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene, ekiagera aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro yao: Aye togoitwa nomoro.
english: "'Yet hear the promise of the LORD, O Zedekiah king of Judah. This is what the LORD says concerning you: You will not die by the sword;

ekegusii: “Inee! Ng’ara karenga chitaya chi’abakori amabe chikorimigwa? Ng’ara karenga emechando ekobachera? Inee! Nyasae nkobaa are emechando ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye?
english: "Yet how often is the lamp of the wicked snuffed out? How often does calamity come upon them, the fate God allots in his anger?

ekegusii: Korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha ning’iranerie Abaelamu amaya abo. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: "Yet I will restore the fortunes of Elam in days to come," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: “Korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha ning’iranerie Abamoabu amaya abo. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.” Ayio naro arakoreke ase Abamoabu.
english: "Yet I will restore the fortunes of Moab in days to come," declares the LORD. Here ends the judgment on Moab.

ekegusii: Ninsa koba ngokwana, obororo bwane tibogokea; na ninsa koremereria nkire, emechando yane tegokea nonya ng’ake.
english: "Yet if I speak, my pain is not relieved; and if I refrain, it does not go away.

ekegusii: “Onye omomalaika nkoba arenge asare, oyomo bwa baria chilifu bagokora okobwatania asare, erinde amworokie ayare ay’oboronge,
english: "Yet if there is an angel on his side as a mediator, one out of a thousand, to tell a man what is right for him,

ekegusii: “Oise kwebeka ang’e ase enkoro yao gokora amaronge, na orambore amaboko ao gochia ase Nyasae;
english: "Yet if you devote your heart to him and stretch out your hands to him,

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Abaisraeli nigo barabuche mono, babe buna omokenye o nyancha, tibakorengeka gose kobareka. Nebe ng’a ase barenge gotebigwa: Inwe timori abana baane, bono mbatebigwe: Inwe nabana ba Nyasae ore moyo.
english: "Yet the Israelites will be like the sand on the seashore, which cannot be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, 'You are not my people,' they will be called 'sons of the living God.'

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aganchora korwa ase enyomba ya tata, akambeka nkaba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli kogenderera botambe. Nigo achorete Abayuda bakaba abaraai, na korwa ase Abayuda agachora enyomba ya tata, na ase egati y’abana baye Omonene akagokigwa nainche, akambeka nkaba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: "Yet the LORD, the God of Israel, chose me from my whole family to be king over Israel forever. He chose Judah as leader, and from the house of Judah he chose my family, and from my father's sons he was pleased to make me king over all Israel.

ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagasaria asende, agwo ase erooro; tibabwatetie emeroberio yane echikire, korende bakaanga amachiko aane ayio omonto karayabwate nabe moyo goetera asaro. Bagasaria mono Chisabato chiane, bagachikora chikaba echitachenegeti. Erio nkarengereria kobaumorera endamwamu yane agwo ase erooro, mbasirie kegima.
english: "'Yet the people of Israel rebelled against me in the desert. They did not follow my decrees but rejected my laws-- although the man who obeys them will live by them-- and they utterly desecrated my Sabbaths. So I said I would pour out my wrath on them and destroy them in the desert.

ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mogoteba: Omokori amabe nigo akoirwa bwango ne chiooro, na egetari kiaye ase ense eye nigo keragereirie, ere takonyara koirana ase emegondo yaye y’emesabibu.
english: "Yet they are foam on the surface of the water; their portion of the land is cursed, so that no one goes to the vineyards.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekero emiaka emerongo ene yaerire, ninsangererie Abamisiri, mbarusie korwa ase egati y’abanto abwo ase basiareretwe gochia.
english: "'Yet this is what the Sovereign LORD says: At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered.

ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ninki keragere omwana atanyore emechando ase engencho y’ebibe bia ise? Nigo nkobairaneria iga: Ekero omwana akorire ayare amaya na amaronge, na obeire okorenda emeroberio yane echikire na ayekore, ekeene, nabe moyo.
english: "Yet you ask, 'Why does the son not share the guilt of his father?' Since the son has done what is just and right and has been careful to keep all my decrees, he will surely live.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, timwandangeretie, ee, inwe Abaisraeli, timwanyechanderete.
english: "Yet you have not called upon me, O Jacob, you have not wearied yourselves for me, O Israel.

ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mogoteba: Enchera y’Omonene teri endonge. Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa bono: Inee! Enchera yane nero etari endonge? Chinchera chiaino, tari chirochio chitari chindonge?
english: "Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' Hear, O house of Israel: Is my way unjust? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

ekegusii: “Abanto b’egesaku kiao nigo bagoteba: Chinchera chi’Omonene tichiri echi’ekeene, korende chinchera chiabo nachio chitari echi’ekeene.
english: "Yet your countrymen say, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' But it is their way that is not just.

ekegusii: Samweli akamotebia, “Gwakorire egento ki’oboriri. Tikwabwatete ogochika okwo Omonene, Nyasae oo, akoete. Onye nkwaigwerete, Omonene anga nakora oboruoti bwao bobe obokong’u, bogenderere kobao botambe ase Abaisraeli.
english: "You acted foolishly," Samuel said. "You have not kept the command the LORD your God gave you; if you had, he would have established your kingdom over Israel for all time.

ekegusii: Aye omokungu omotomani nigo gwatigete omosacha oo okaba kore nabasacha abaao!
english: "'You adulterous wife! You prefer strangers to your own husband!

ekegusii: “Aye amo n’Eleazari omokuani na abaraai b’ebisaku bi’omoganda bwonsi, mobare ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto booswa, amo ne chitugo barenta.
english: "You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the community are to count all the people and animals that were captured.

ekegusii: “Aye amo nabamura bao timobaisa konywa edivai, gose ekenyugwa kegotindia, ekero mogosoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe. Okwo nogochika koragenderere asemore ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: "You and your sons are not to drink wine or other fermented drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

ekegusii: “Aye omwana o Nyachieni omobisa bw’oboronge bwonsi, oichire nobong’ainereria na obobe bwonsi, torigeti gotiga gokora bogeka chinchera chi’Omonene chire boronge?
english: "You are a child of the devil and an enemy of everything that is right! You are full of all kinds of deceit and trickery. Will you never stop perverting the right ways of the Lord?

ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamoboria, “Aye nomoruoti rende?” Yeso akairaneria, “Aye gwatebete ng’a inche nomoruoti. Inche nigo naiboretwe ase engencho y’aya, na ase engencho y’aya, ngacha ase ense, erinde imbe kirori ase ekeene. Kera oyore oyo bw’ekeene nigo akoigwa eriogi riane.”
english: "You are a king, then!" said Pilate. Jesus answered, "You are right in saying I am a king. In fact, for this reason I was born, and for this I came into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me."

ekegusii: Naende goika obatebie iga, Ira chigari korwa aa Misiri, ase okobogoreria abana baino abake, na abakungu baino, mobogorerie na iso, moche nabarabwo.
english: "You are also directed to tell them, 'Do this: Take some carts from Egypt for your children and your wives, and get your father and come.

ekegusii: "You are demon-possessed," the crowd answered. "Who is trying to kill you?"
english: Omoganda okairaneria, “Nore nekerecha! Ning’o okorigia kogoita?”

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli mwesiririe inwe abanyene ase okoba mamincha yane, inche oyo narenge ogokonyeka kwaino.
english: "You are destroyed, O Israel, because you are against me, against your helper.

ekegusii: "You are Israel's teacher," said Jesus, "and do you not understand these things?
english: Yeso akamoiraneria, akamotebia, “Inee! Aye nomworokia bw’Abaisraeli, na aya toyamanyeti?

ekegusii: agatebia Daudi, “Aye nigo ore omonyaboronge kombua, ekiagera kwang’akanire amaya ase amabe, korende inche nagoakanire amabe ase amaya.
english: "You are more righteous than I," he said. "You have treated me well, but I have treated you badly.

ekegusii: "You are my war club, my weapon for battle-- with you I shatter nations, with you I destroy kingdoms,
english: “Aye nenturago na ekerwanero kiane gi’esegi; goetera asore ning’ake ebisaku bibe ebisamunye, ninsirie amaruoti.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inwe nigo more birori baane, abasomba baane nachorire, erinde monyare komanya inche na konyegena, naende momanye ng’a inche ninche Ere. Enyasae ende teri yantang’anerete, ende teri erabombwe nyuma yane.”
english: "You are my witnesses," declares the LORD, "and my servant whom I have chosen, so that you may know and believe me and understand that I am he. Before me no god was formed, nor will there be one after me.

ekegusii: “Timoa abanto aba naende chimboba ase ogokorera amatabori, buna mware kobaa agwo ritang’ani. Tiga bagende barabwo boka kwerigeria chimboba.
english: "You are no longer to supply the people with straw for making bricks; let them go and gather their own straw.

ekegusii: "You are not one of his disciples, are you?" the girl at the door asked Peter. He replied, "I am not."
english: Erio omoiseke oria orenge korenda gesieri akaboria Petero, “Aye tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye omonto oyo?” Ere agakana, “Tari inche.”

ekegusii: Yoabu akamokania, akamotebia, “Yaya, rero tokonyara koba omonto okoira amang’ana amaya. Rituko rinde nonyare koira amang’ana amaya, korende tari rero, ekiagera omwana bw’omoruoti okure.”
english: "You are not the one to take the news today," Joab told him. "You may take the news another time, but you must not do so today, because the king's son is dead."

ekegusii: "You are not yet fifty years old," the Jews said to him, "and you have seen Abraham!"
english: Erio Abayahudi bakamotebia, “Torakoora emiaka emerongo etano, na Ibrahimu kwamororire?”

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba igoro y’omochie oyo mogoteba ng’a obekirwe ase okoboko kw’omoruoti o Babeli, osirigwe nemioro, na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita:
english: "You are saying about this city, 'By the sword, famine and plague it will be handed over to the king of Babylon'; but this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says:

ekegusii: “Inwe nomobaso bw’ense. Omochie tokobiseka koagachire ase egetunwa igoro.
english: "You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae gwachorete Aburamu na okamorusia korwa Uri bw’Abakalidayo, erio okaonchora erieta riaye, okamoroka Ibrahimu.
english: "You are the LORD God, who chose Abram and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans and named him Abraham.

ekegusii: “Inwe nomonyo bw’ense; korende omonyo korasirie obwansu bwaye, ninki orabekwe bwanse? Togwenereti gento kende otatiga ogotugutwa isiko, otiringwe nabanto.
english: "You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its saltiness, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.

ekegusii: “Mobe abanto baane abachenu; timobaisa koria eng’iti ende yonsi eyaitirwe nenyang’au ase orosana, motugutere chisese chinyama echio.”
english: "You are to be my holy people. So do not eat the meat of an animal torn by wild beasts; throw it to the dogs.

ekegusii: Aye amo nabamura bao, ninwe mweka morakore emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu na ase egesasimero, erio nario endamwamu yane etabaise koba igoro y’Abaisraeli naende.
english: "You are to be responsible for the care of the sanctuary and the altar, so that wrath will not fall on the Israelites again.

ekegusii: “Naboigo moraaterane ense eyio koreng’ana buna inwe ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli more.
english: "You are to distribute this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: “Naende mwate ensemo ende eye ebebekaine noboremo obwo obochenu ebe nobogare bwe chimoti chilifu isano (5,000), na obotambe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000). Eyio nebe ase omochie omonene oraagachwe, ase Abaisraeli bande bonsi baranyare komenya.
english: "'You are to give the city as its property an area 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, adjoining the sacred portion; it will belong to the whole house of Israel.

ekegusii: Omogaaka oria akamotebia, “Kabe nomorembe! Tiga inche ngokonye ase kende gionsi oremeire. Tokonyara korara isiko aa ase eraaro botuko.”
english: "You are welcome at my house," the old man said. "Let me supply whatever you need. Only don't spend the night in the square."

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene Nyasae oito, kwagweneire konyora obonene, na ogosikwa, na okobua, ekiagera aye naye gwatongete ebinto bionsi; na ekiagera ase ogwancha kwao nigo biabete aroro, na bigatongwa.”
english: "You are worthy, our Lord and God, to receive glory and honor and power, for you created all things, and by your will they were created and have their being."

ekegusii: "You believe at last!" Jesus answered.
english: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Igo bono mwegenire?

ekegusii: Inwe iga mokondoka Omworokia, naende Omonene; na igo mbuya mokobora, naki naboigo inde.
english: "You call me 'Teacher' and 'Lord,' and rightly so, for that is what I am.

ekegusii: Aye kwaigwete korwa igoro ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ogakwana nabarabwo korwa igoro, okabachikera emeroberio emeronge na okabaa amachiko ay’ekeene.
english: "You came down on Mount Sinai; you spoke to them from heaven. You gave them regulations and laws that are just and right, and decrees and commands that are good.

ekegusii: "You can see for yourselves, and so can my brother Benjamin, that it is really I who am speaking to you.
english: “Na bono imoroche namaiso aino, na Benjamin boigo naroche namaiso aye, ng’a ninche omonyene ngokwana nainwe.

ekegusii: "You do not want to leave too, do you?" Jesus asked the Twelve.
english: Erio Yeso akaboria baria ikomi na babere, “Nainwe boigo morigetie kogenda?”

ekegusii: "You don't know what you are asking," Jesus said to them. "Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?" "We can," they answered.
english: Yeso akairaneria, “Inwe timomanyeti eri mogosaba. Inee! Namonyare konywera egekombe ndache konywera inche?” Bakamotebia, “Natonyare.”

ekegusii: "You don't know what you are asking," Jesus said. "Can you drink the cup I drink or be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?"
english: Yeso akabatebia, “Timomanyeti eki mogosaba. Inee! Namonyare konywera egekombe nkonywera inche, na kobatiswa ebatiso mbatisire inche?”

ekegusii: “Nigo mwasemeretie monyore ebinge, korende mokanyora ebike; na ekero mwabirentete inka, nkabirurukia bikagenda. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo nkobaboria: Nase ki yabete bo? Nekiagera enyomba yane yatigirwe egendererete koba ritombe, na kera oyomo oino nigo echanderete enyomba yaye omonyene.
english: "You expected much, but see, it turned out to be little. What you brought home, I blew away. Why?" declares the LORD Almighty. "Because of my house, which remains a ruin, while each of you is busy with his own house.

ekegusii: “Okabaa okobua igoro ase amaruoti; okabaatanera chinse ao ao. Bakaira ense ya Sihoni, omoruoti o Hesiboni, na eya Ogi, omoruoti o Basani.
english: "You gave them kingdoms and nations, allotting to them even the remotest frontiers. They took over the country of Sihon king of Heshbon and the country of Og king of Bashan.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Kwairaneirie buya. Kora iga, nario orachie kare.”
english: "You have answered correctly," Jesus replied. "Do this and you will live."

ekegusii: Elija akamoiraneria, “Kwamboririe egento egekong’u. Korandore nkoirwa korwa asore, aye noyonyore, korende onye tokondora, rirorio takoba buna kwaboria.”
english: "You have asked a difficult thing," Elijah said, "yet if you see me when I am taken from you, it will be yours-- otherwise not."

ekegusii: "You have covered yourself with anger and pursued us; you have slain without pity.
english: “Aye gwetubire endamwamu na gwatochandire, gwaitire, gose tobeti namabera.

ekegusii: “Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania nabanto baane, kwandendire nabeire omogambi bw’abanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba baane.
english: "You have delivered me from the attacks of my people; you have preserved me as the head of nations. People I did not know are subject to me,

ekegusii: “Mwaigwete ng’a abanto ba kare mbatebetigwe: Toita; na oyoraite nabe omonto okonacherwa ekina.
english: "You have heard that it was said to the people long ago, 'Do not murder, and anyone who murders will be subject to judgment.'

ekegusii: "You have heard that it was said, 'Do not commit adultery.'
english: “Mwaigwete ng’a ndiatebetwe: Totomana.

ekegusii: “Mwaigwete ng’a ndiatebetwe: Eriso ase eriso, na erino ase erino;
english: "You have heard that it was said, 'Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.'

ekegusii: "You have heard that it was said, 'Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.'
english: “Mwaigwete ng’a ndiatebetwe: Ancha omogisangio oo, na ogeche omobisa oo.

ekegusii: Mwaigure okorama kwaye. Naki moroche?” Bonsi bakamonachera ekina ng’a nagwenerete akwe.
english: "You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?" They all condemned him as worthy of death.

ekegusii: Mwabeire mokonakoong’anya ase ense eye y’ebitunwa ase engaki entambe eisaine; bono onchoka mogende gochia ensemo ya Sugusu.
english: "You have made your way around this hill country long enough; now turn north.

ekegusii: Abanto bakairaneria, “Aye tigwatoriananetie kende, gose tigwatokorerete bobe, gose tikwairete gento ki’omonto onde bwensi.”
english: "You have not cheated or oppressed us," they replied. "You have not taken anything from anyone's hand."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inwe mwakwanire amang’ana amakong’u igoro yane. Korende nigo mokoboria: Mang’ana ki amakong’u twakwanire igoro yao?
english: "You have said harsh things against me," says the LORD. "Yet you ask, 'What have we said against you?'

ekegusii: Inwe mwatebire: Okomokorera Nyasae, ayio namang’ana a bosa. Mbuya ki twanyorire ase okobwata amachiko aye, gose ase ogotaara ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’Emeganda tore nomoichano?
english: "You have said, 'It is futile to serve God. What did we gain by carrying out his requirements and going about like mourners before the LORD Almighty?

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakamoiraneria, “Gwatooririe obogima bwaito. Onye twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, omonene oito, tiga tobe abasomba ba Farao.”
english: "You have saved our lives," they said. "May we find favor in the eyes of our lord; we will be in bondage to Pharaoh."

ekegusii: Inwe mwatomete abanto ase Yohana, na oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene.
english: "You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.

ekegusii: Mwaigwete inche nkobatebia: Nkogenda nde, na ninchiche naende asemore. Onye mwanyanchete, anga mwagogete, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, ekiagera Tata nomonene kombua.
english: "You heard me say, 'I am going away and I am coming back to you.' If you loved me, you would be glad that I am going to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.

ekegusii: Inwe igoro chionsi, tonyia amatoima, oboronge tiga borwe igoro, botwe buna amare agotwa embura; ense tiga emaanoke, eichorwe nogotooreka na oboronge. Ninche Omonene natongire ayio.”
english: "You heavens above, rain down righteousness; let the clouds shower it down. Let the earth open wide, let salvation spring up, let righteousness grow with it; I, the LORD, have created it.

ekegusii: “Nomanyete ng’a Daudi tata tanyarete koagacha enyomba ase ogosasimera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye, ekiagera ababisa nigo barenge komorwania chisegi chinsemo chionsi, goika ekero Omonene ababegete inse ase obogambi bwa Daudi.
english: "You know that because of the wars waged against my father David from all sides, he could not build a temple for the Name of the LORD his God until the LORD put his enemies under his feet.

ekegusii: “Aye omoruoti, ase okorora kwao okarora omogwekano omonene mono, oteneine ase obosio bwao. Omogwekano oyio nigo orenge omotambe, okomeka‐meka noborabu obonene, na okororekana kwaye nigo kwarenge gw’okoondokia.
english: "You looked, O king, and there before you stood a large statue-- an enormous, dazzling statue, awesome in appearance.

ekegusii: Ise akamotebia, “Genda!” Akamotoma agende ase engaki y’emetienyi ebere. Igo omoiseke oria akagenda amo nabasani baye gochia ase ebitunwa, na aroro agwo bakareera obwekungi bwaye.
english: "You may go," he said. And he let her go for two months. She and the girls went into the hills and wept because she would never marry.

ekegusii: "You mean he has deceived you also?" the Pharisees retorted.
english: Erio Abafarisai bakabairaneria, “Inee! Nainwe boigo mwatantanigwe?

ekegusii: “Mwerende inwe abanyene, ekiagera nababaire ase amatongo, na ase chisinagogi, namoakwe. Naende namoirwe gotenena ase amasio ’abagavuna na ase abaruoti ase engencho yane, koba kirori asebare.
english: "You must be on your guard. You will be handed over to the local councils and flogged in the synagogues. On account of me you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.

ekegusii: “Ase enchera eyio okurere Abaisraeli igoro y’ogotacheneka kwabo, tibabaisa kogera Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bore ase egati yabo bobe obotachenegeti. Baise gokora bo, nigo barakwe.”
english: "'You must keep the Israelites separate from things that make them unclean, so they will not die in their uncleanness for defiling my dwelling place, which is among them.'"

ekegusii: bakabatebia, “Timobaisa korenta aa abanto abwo mwosete; moise gokora bo, nigo morabaise kogera tobe nokomocha ase Omonene komenta amo nebibe na okomocha tore nakwo bono. Okomocha tobwate nigo kore okonene, na endamwamu entindi ya Nyasae nigo ere igoro ase Abaisraeli.”
english: "You must not bring those prisoners here," they said, "or we will be guilty before the LORD. Do you intend to add to our sin and guilt? For our guilt is already great, and his fierce anger rests on Israel."

ekegusii: “Abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi tobabara amo n’Abaisraeli bande.
english: "You must not count the tribe of Levi or include them in the census of the other Israelites.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa konyuoma omokungu bw’aase aiga, gose koiborera abana, abamura na abaiseke, aase aiga.
english: "You must not marry and have sons or daughters in this place."

ekegusii: Inwe goika momanye gwatanana ching’iti chichenegete korwa ase echitachenegeti, ne chinyoni chichenegete korwa ase echitachenegeti. Timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase okoria ching’iti gose chinyoni chitachenegeti, gose timoria ching’iti chinde chionsi chikwagura ase ense, echi naatananire chibe chitachenegeti asemore.
english: "'You must therefore make a distinction between clean and unclean animals and between unclean and clean birds. Do not defile yourselves by any animal or bird or anything that moves along the ground-- those which I have set apart as unclean for you.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli b’ekegori eke, igwera ring’ana riane, inche Omonene. Inee! Inche nigo nabeire buna erooro asemore? Gose nigo nabeire buna ense y’omosunte ekerima asemore? Nase ki inwe abanto baane mogoteba ng’a mobwate obosibore, na timorigeti kong’iranera inche?
english: "You of this generation, consider the word of the LORD: "Have I been a desert to Israel or a land of great darkness? Why do my people say, 'We are free to roam; we will come to you no more'?

ekegusii: “Ninwe mweka imanyete ase chiamate chionsi chi’ense. Ase ayio nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaino bionsi.”
english: "You only have I chosen of all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your sins."

ekegusii: Nimbatebie: Nigo mokorenta ase egesasimero kiane okoruegwa kw’endagera gotari ogochenu. Erio mwaboria: Nase inchera ki twagokorire oyotachenegeti. Nimbairanerie: Nase okorengereria ng’a emesa yane inche Omonene ney’ogochaywa.
english: "You place defiled food on my altar. "But you ask, 'How have we defiled you?' "By saying that the LORD's table is contemptible.

ekegusii: “Aye kwaroche emechando ye chisokoro chiaito aaria Misiri, naende okaigwa okorera kwabo agwo mbarabare ase Enyancha Embariri.
english: "You saw the suffering of our forefathers in Egypt; you heard their cry at the Red Sea.

ekegusii: Amang’ana mokorengereria tagoikeranigwa nonya ng’ake, ekiagera nigo mogoteba: Ntoganetie tobe buna abanto b’ebisaku binde na abe chinse chinde, tosasime emete na amagena.
english: "'You say, "We want to be like the nations, like the peoples of the world, who serve wood and stone." But what you have in mind will never happen.

ekegusii: "You see the people crowding against you," his disciples answered, "and yet you can ask, 'Who touched me?'"
english: Aborokigwa baye bakamotebia, “Kwarorire omoganda buna okomigete, na aye gokoboria: Ning’o onkuna?”

ekegusii: “Toba ne chinyasae chinde otatiga inche.
english: "You shall have no other gods before me.

ekegusii: "You shall not commit adultery.
english: “Totomana.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa kogania enyomba y’omogisangio oo. Tobaisa kogania omokungu bw’omogisangio oo, nonya nomosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yaye, gose etigere yaye, gose kende gionsi omogisangio oo abwate.”
english: "You shall not covet your neighbor's house. You shall not covet your neighbor's wife, or his manservant or maidservant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."

ekegusii: “Tobaisa kogania omokungu bw’omogisangio oo. Tobaisa kogania enyomba y’omogisangio oo, nonya nomogondo oye, gose omosomba oye, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yaye, gose etigere yaye, gose gento kende gionsi abwate.
english: "You shall not covet your neighbor's wife. You shall not set your desire on your neighbor's house or land, his manservant or maidservant, his ox or donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor."

ekegusii: "You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
english: “Tomotebera omogisangio oo oborimo.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gwekorera omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, omogwekano o getongwa kende gionsi kere igoro, gose kere ense, gose kere ime ase amache inse y’ense.
english: "You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gwekorera omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, omogwekano o getongwa kende gionsi kere igoro, gose ase ense, gose ime ase amache inse y’ense.
english: "You shall not make for yourself an idol in the form of anything in heaven above or on the earth beneath or in the waters below.

ekegusii: “Toriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oo, ekiagera Omonene tagotiga komoa egesusuro omonto oria okoriatora bosa na korikorera bobe erieta riaye.
english: "You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.

ekegusii: “Toriatora na korikorera bobe erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oo, ekiagera Omonene tagotiga komoa egesusuro oria okoriatora na korikorera bobe erieta riaye.
english: "You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold anyone guiltless who misuses his name.

ekegusii: "You shall not murder.
english: “Toita.

ekegusii: "You shall not steal.
english: “Toiba.

ekegusii: Inwe ching’iti, oroiboro rw’amarubi, naki morakore motame ekina ki’omorero o kare na kare.
english: "You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?

ekegusii: “Inwe abamore nebigoti ebikong’u, motarogeti ase chinkoro, nonya namato, motaonchogeti; botambe nigo mokoamereria Omoika Omochenu. Buna chisokoro chiaino chiarenge gokora, nainwe nabo mogokora.
english: "You stiff-necked people, with uncircumcised hearts and ears! You are just like your fathers: You always resist the Holy Spirit!

ekegusii: “Nainwe Abaetiopia boigo inche Omonene nimbaite nomoro one.”
english: "You too, O Cushites, will be slain by my sword."

ekegusii: “Naboigo nainwe Abamisiri, morasenyentwe, morare amo nabatarogeti, abwo baitetwe nemioro.
english: "You too, O Pharaoh, will be broken and will lie among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.

ekegusii: Nigo kwabakurerete bairane babwate amachiko ao, korende ase engencho y’oboenenu bwabo bakaanga koigwera amachiko ao, bagakora ebibe ase emeroberio yao echikire, eyio omonto karayebwate nabe moyo. Bakaenena, bagakong’ia ebigoti tibaigwera.
english: "You warned them to return to your law, but they became arrogant and disobeyed your commands. They sinned against your ordinances, by which a man will live if he obeys them. Stubbornly they turned their backs on you, became stiff-necked and refused to listen.

ekegusii: Inwe abamokoriina chitigere chindabu, nainwe abamogoikaransa ase emegeeke yaino, nainwe abamogotaara ase chinchera, morarie amang’ana ayio!
english: "You who ride on white donkeys, sitting on your saddle blankets, and you who walk along the road, consider

ekegusii: Na Yeso akabatebia, “Inwe mwensi inamogochwe na gontiga, naki arikire: Ning’ake omorisia, ne ching’ondi nachiserebekane.
english: "You will all fall away," Jesus told them, "for it is written: "'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.'

ekegusii: Inwe namobe nobosooku ase emete eyio enga emetontera mwagokerete, na ase emegondo eyio mwachorete.
english: "You will be ashamed because of the sacred oaks in which you have delighted; you will be disgraced because of the gardens that you have chosen.

ekegusii: “Ase ebitongwa ebio nigo moresoyie ase ogotacheneka. Monto onde bwensi orakune ebikwete ase ebio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio,
english: "'You will make yourselves unclean by these; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Eng’iti egatebia omokungu, “Ogokwa, timogokwa nonya ng’ake.
english: "You will not surely die," the serpent said to the woman.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one kwang’orokeirie inche omosomba oo, ng’a nong’agachere enyomba. Ase ayio inche, omosomba oo, nabeire noboremu ase enkoro yane kogosaba ogosaba oko.
english: "You, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build a house for him. So your servant has found courage to pray to you.

ekegusii: Naende aye omoruoti, ekero kwarigereretie, okarora omorendi oria omochenu ogoika korwa igoro ogoteba: Gecha omote oyo oyosirie, korende otige egesike kiaye kere nemeri yaye ase riroba. Ogetige gesibire nekenyuri gi’ekioma na etaai, agwo ase obonyansi oborere bw’orosana, kenyirirerwe ne riime rikorwa igoro; egetari ki’omoruoti oyio kebe amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana ase ebiro bitano na bibere.
english: "You, O king, saw a messenger, a holy one, coming down from heaven and saying, 'Cut down the tree and destroy it, but leave the stump, bound with iron and bronze, in the grass of the field, while its roots remain in the ground. Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven; let him live like the wild animals, until seven times pass by for him.'

ekegusii: Abamura na abagaaka nigo baraire ase chinchera inse, abaiseke baane, na abamura baane, baitirwe nemioro; ase rituko ri’endamwamu yao kwabaitire otari namabera.
english: "Young and old lie together in the dust of the streets; my young men and maidens have fallen by the sword. You have slain them in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered them without pity.

ekegusii: “Iso igo akorete rikorogoto riaito rikaba ririto. Ase ayio bono aye orikore ribe rigusu, bwororobie emeremo eria emekong’u iso atobekerete, naintwe natogokorere.”
english: "Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you."

ekegusii: “Iso nigo akorete rikorogoto riaito rikaba ririto. Ase ayio bono aye orikore ribe rigusu, bwororobie emeremo eria emekong’u iso atobekerete, naintwe ntogokorere.”
english: "Your father put a heavy yoke on us, but now lighten the harsh labor and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you."

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, obonene bwaino bwasireire igoro ase ebigoro biaino! Chituoni chi’esegi chiaitirwe.
english: "Your glory, O Israel, lies slain on your heights. How the mighty have fallen!

ekegusii: "Your hands shaped me and made me. Will you now turn and destroy me?
english: “Amaboko ao naro ambombete, akandoisia; na bono kwang’onchokeire na gonsiria.

ekegusii: Onye koganetie abasomba, abamura gose abaiseke, nabo oranyare kobagora korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bibaetanaine inwe.
english: "'Your male and female slaves are to come from the nations around you; from them you may buy slaves.

ekegusii: “Nyoko nigo arenge buna omosabibu ase egati y’emesabibu, osimekire ase amache mbarabare, Okaba okwama mono na okaba ne chinsagia chinyinge, ekiagera osimegetwe ase amache amange are.
english: "'Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard planted by the water; it was fruitful and full of branches because of abundant water.

ekegusii: Chinchera chiaino, na ogokora kwaino, nabio biagerire amang’ana ayio abanyorire inwe. Oko nakwo ogosirigwa kwaino, na nigo kore nobororo obonge. Obororo obwo bwasoire ime ase chinkoro chiaino.
english: "Your own conduct and actions have brought this upon you. This is your punishment. How bitter it is! How it pierces to the heart!"

ekegusii: “Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio nkore nokobua okonene, Omonene, okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngosenyente ababisa.
english: "Your right hand, O LORD, was majestic in power. Your right hand, O LORD, shattered the enemy.

ekegusii: Aburamu nere agatebia Sarai, “Rora, omosomba oo oyio nase amaboko ao are; mokorere buna oranche.” Erio Sarai akamochanda bobe, na ere agatama korwa asare.
english: "Your servant is in your hands," Abram said. "Do with her whatever you think best." Then Sarai mistreated Hagar; so she fled from her.

ekegusii: Erio omosomba oo tata agatotebia: Momanyete ng’a omokungu one nigo anyiborerete abana abamura babere boka.
english: "Your servant my father said to us, 'You know that my wife bore me two sons.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya irianyi, ense yaino eike ase erooro ya Sini, egenderere gochia ase orobebe rwa Edomu. Orobebe rwaino rwa irianyi rochakere ensemo ya moocha ase ensinyo y’Enyancha y’Omonyo,
english: "'Your southern side will include some of the Desert of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern boundary will start from the end of the Salt Sea,

ekegusii: "'Your western boundary will be the coast of the Great Sea. This will be your boundary on the west.
english: “Enyancha Enene nero erabe orobebe rwaino rwa bosongo.

ekegusii: Bakamotebia, “Nebarimo ore!” Korende akaamereria mono, agateba ng’a naboigo are. Bakabora, “Nomomalaika oye!”
english: "You're out of your mind," they told her. When she kept insisting that it was so, they said, "It must be his angel."

ekegusii: Egesaku gia Sabuloni keegwe orogongo rwaye robebekane norwa Isakaru, korwa ensinyo ya moocha goika eya bosongo.
english: "Zebulun will have one portion; it will border the territory of Issachar from east to west.

ekegusii: “Sabuloni nigo aramenye ase enyancha mbarabare, agwo ase chimeeri chigotenenigwa, orobebe rwaye rosinyane norw’Abasidoni.
english: "Zebulun will live by the seashore and become a haven for ships; his border will extend toward Sidon.

ekegusii: “Naki yare koba buya onye nanyora omonto okonyigwa. Inche nakoorire amang’ana aane! Oria Omonguru nang’iranerie! Ninganetie ndore amang’ana omobisa one andikerete ase okonyomania.
english: ("Oh, that I had someone to hear me! I sign now my defense-- let the Almighty answer me; let my accuser put his indictment in writing.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Amatuko Amanene ase Omonene; moyararie, mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Ase amatuko ayio momoruere Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso binde, na okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa, kera ekemo ase rituko riaye richikire.
english: ("'These are the LORD's appointed feasts, which you are to proclaim as sacred assemblies for bringing offerings made to the LORD by fire-- the burnt offerings and grain offerings, sacrifices and drink offerings required for each day.

ekegusii: Naki mbarengeo abasacha chilifu isano iga. Agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Baikaransie abanto aba ase ebiombe, na kera ekeombe koreng’ana emerongo etano.”
english: (About five thousand men were there.) But he said to his disciples, "Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each."

ekegusii: Abaatene bonsi na abamenyi abamenyete agwo tibarenge ne ribaga ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ogokwana na gotegerera amang’ana amayia.
english: (All the Athenians and the foreigners who lived there spent their time doing nothing but talking about and listening to the latest ideas.)

ekegusii: (Abanto bonsi na abarusia ebango bagachia koigwa aya, bakaorokia oboronge bwa Nyasae, ekiagera babatisetwe ase ebatiso ya Yohana;
english: (All the people, even the tax collectors, when they heard Jesus' words, acknowledged that God's way was right, because they had been baptized by John.

ekegusii: Boigo omochie orabeo norokwe Hamona. Ase enchera eyio mbachene ense eyio.
english: (Also a town called Hamonah will be there.) And so they will cleanse the land.'

ekegusii: (Ekerengo ki’ebimunu bibere ekio nensemo ya ikomi y’ekerengo gi’efa.)
english: (An omer is one tenth of an ephah.)

ekegusii: Naki ase ring’ana erio nigo togokora emeremo ase ogwechanda, ekiagera tomosemeretie Nyasae ore moyo, ere oyore Omotooria bw’abanto bonsi, mono bw’abwo begenire.
english: (and for this we labor and strive), that we have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, and especially of those who believe.

ekegusii: Buna atebete korwa omochakano goetera ase emenwa y’ababani baye abachenu,
english: (as he said through his holy prophets of long ago),

ekegusii: (buna arikire ase amachiko ’Omonene, “Kera omoisia omotangi okoigora enda ya ng’ina narokwe omochenu ase Omonene”),
english: (as it is written in the Law of the Lord, "Every firstborn male is to be consecrated to the Lord"),

ekegusii: Omwana omoiseke o Aseri nigo arenge korokwa Sera.
english: (Asher had a daughter named Serah.)

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria inche nabete nteneine ase egati y’Omonene nainwe, narenge gokwana nainwe ring’ana ri’Omonene, ekiagera inwe nigo mwarenge nobwoba ase engencho y’omorero oria, timwatiirete gocha ase egetunwa. “Omonene agakwana:
english: (At that time I stood between the LORD and you to declare to you the word of the LORD, because you were afraid of the fire and did not go up the mountain.) And he said:

ekegusii: (Ere nomonto obegetwe ase echela ase engencho y’eriomana riakoregete ase omochie ime, na ase oboiti.)
english: (Barabbas had been thrown into prison for an insurrection in the city, and for murder.)

ekegusii: Besaleli, mosinto o Uri o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda, agakora onsi aya Omonene achigete Musa.
english: (Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything the LORD commanded Moses;

ekegusii: Abayahudi na abanto b’ebisaku binde abaonchogete, Abakirete na Abaarabu, intwe twensi twaigure abaiga bagokwana ase emenwa yaito igoro y’ogokora gwe chinguru kwa Nyasae.”
english: (both Jews and converts to Judaism); Cretans and Arabs-- we hear them declaring the wonders of God in our own tongues!"

ekegusii: Korende Abagesuri na Abaaramu bakaira korwa asare emechie etano nomo, emechie ya Yairi na Kenati amo nebichie biaetanaineo. Abanto bonsi bamenyeteo nigo barenge b’ororeria rwa Makiri ise Gileadi,
english: (But Geshur and Aram captured Havvoth Jair, as well as Kenath with its surrounding settlements-- sixty towns.) All these were descendants of Makir the father of Gilead.

ekegusii: Ere konya obairire kerama igoro, obatubire chimboba chi’egatani anekerete aroro.
english: (But she had taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the stalks of flax she had laid out on the roof.)

ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’egesaku kia Dani basiretie ense yabo, bakagenda Lesemu, bakayoumokera, bakayoira na bagaita abanto b’agwo nemioro. Bagasakora chinibo chiarengeo, bakamenya omochie oyio. Erio bakaonchora erieta ri’omochie oyio Lesemu, bakayoroka Dani, erieta ria sokoro yabo Dani.
english: (But the Danites had difficulty taking possession of their territory, so they went up and attacked Leshem, took it, put it to the sword and occupied it. They settled in Leshem and named it Dan after their forefather.)

ekegusii: Rero inwe mwabeire mamincha y’enyomba ya tata, na mwaiteire abana baye abamura, abanto emerongo etano na ebere, ase rigena erimo igoro, naende mwabekire Abimeleki, omwana bw’omosomba oye omokungu, obeire omoruoti bw’abanto ba Sekemu, ekiagera are momura omino.
english: (but today you have revolted against my father's family, murdered his seventy sons on a single stone, and made Abimelech, the son of his slave girl, king over the citizens of Shechem because he is your brother)--

ekegusii: Omonto oyo omonyene oboronge, oyomenyete ase egati yabo, nigo arenge gwechanda ase omoyo oye omoronge rituko ase rituko ase aya onsi arenge korora na koigwa ase ogokora kwabo kw’ogosaria amachiko.
english: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)--

ekegusii: (naki okwama kw’omobaso nigo gokonyorekana ase obuya bwonsi, na ase oboronge, na ase ekeene).
english: (for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness and truth)

ekegusii: Naki rinde tiriri riaikeranetigwe namachiko. Ribaga ri’ayio ogosemeria okore okuya mono kobua gokarentwa, na ase okwo twamoikire Nyasae ang’e.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a better hope is introduced, by which we draw near to God.

ekegusii: (Agwo kare ase Abaisraeli, ekero omonto arenge kogenda koboria ring’ana korwa ase Nyasae nigo arenge goteba, “Inchuo togende ase omorori.” Omonto okorokwa omobani bono, kare nigo arenge korokwa omorori.)
english: (Formerly in Israel, if a man went to inquire of God, he would say, "Come, let us go to the seer," because the prophet of today used to be called a seer.)

ekegusii: Korwa ase abwo abanto b’enyancha mbarabare na ab’ebisinka bagesiarera, bakaba ababiare be chinsemo echio, kera eamate nomonwa obo na egesaku kiabo.
english: (From these the maritime peoples spread out into their territories by their clans within their nations, each with its own language.)

ekegusii: Naki tamanyete eki agokwana, ekiagera babete nomoondoko omonene.
english: (He did not know what to say, they were so frightened.)

ekegusii: Nabo akorete ase okworokereria kera ekegori ki’Abaisraeli engencho y’esegi, mono abwo konya batararwana esegi ende yonsi.
english: (he did this only to teach warfare to the descendants of the Israelites who had not had previous battle experience):

ekegusii: Nigo akwanete igoro ya Yudas, omwana o Simion Iskariota, ekiagera oyo nere orache komorua; na ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.
english: (He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who, though one of the Twelve, was later to betray him.)

ekegusii: Oria otongete egetuse gie ching’enang’eni chiria isano na ibere, na ekio gekorokwa Orioni, oria okoonchora omosunte ekerima oba emambia, naende oonchora omobaso oba obotuko, oria okorangeria amache ’enyancha oyaumora igoro ase ense, Omonene, nario erieta riaye.
english: (he who made the Pleiades and Orion, who turns blackness into dawn and darkens day into night, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land-- the LORD is his name--

ekegusii: Kare Heburoni nigo orenge korokwa Kiriati‐Ariba. Ariba nigo arenge omonto omonene ase Abaanaki. Na bono ense eria ekaba nomorembe, etari nesegi.
english: (Hebron used to be called Kiriath Arba after Arba, who was the greatest man among the Anakites.) Then the land had rest from war.

ekegusii: (Abanto ba Sidoni nigo bakoroka egetunwa kia Herimoni Sirioni, na Abaamori nigo bagokeroka Seniri.)
english: (Hermon is called Sirion by the Sidonians; the Amorites call it Senir.)

ekegusii: Chimeeri chia Hiramu, chiria chiarentete chitahabu korwa Ofiri, chikarenta naende korwa aroro chibao chi’emete ekorokwa alumugu chinyinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene.
english: (Hiram's ships brought gold from Ophir; and from there they brought great cargoes of almugwood and precious stones.

ekegusii: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
english: Naki aborokigwa baye konya bachiire omochie kogora endagera.

ekegusii: Ise konya tana komotogonyera nonya ng’ake ase okomoboria, “Nase ki gwakora aya na aya?” Boigo Adonia nigo arenge omonto omonyakieni; ere nigo aiboretwe nyuma Abisalomu kaiboirwe.
english: (His father had never interfered with him by asking, "Why do you behave as you do?" He was also very handsome and was born next after Absalom.)

ekegusii: Meredi nabwate naende omokungu Omoyuda; nere akaibora Yeredi, ise abanto ba Gedori, na Heberi, ise abanto ba Soko, na Yekutieli, ise abanto ba Sanoa.
english: (His Judean wife gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.) These were the children of Pharaoh's daughter Bithiah, whom Mered had married.

ekegusii: Abaibori baye tibamanyete ng’a omoroberio oyio igo orure ase Omonene. Ere nigo are korigia enchera yare kogera arwanie Abafilisti. Ase engaki eria Abafilisti nigo barenge kogambera Abaisraeli.
english: (His parents did not know that this was from the LORD, who was seeking an occasion to confront the Philistines; for at that time they were ruling over Israel.)

ekegusii: ekiagera onye omonto tamanyeti gotenenera ab’enyomba yaye omonyene, nakiaranyare korenda ekanisa ya Nyasae?
english: (If anyone does not know how to manage his own family, how can he take care of God's church?)
