english: A tabernacle was set up. In its first room were the lampstand, the table and the consecrated bread; this was called the Holy Place.

ekegusii: Okorere chitahabu chichenire chikiro emerongo etano ase okoroisia ekebekerero gie chitaya amo nebikorero biaye.
english: A talent of pure gold is to be used for the lampstand and all these accessories.

ekegusii: Omogondo bw’emesabibu ore chieka ikomi nigo orame amasabibu akomitwa aisaine egetonga ekemo gioka, na embusuro eichire ebitonga ikomi nigo erame eyeisaine egetonga ekemo gioka.”
english: A ten-acre vineyard will produce only a bath of wine, a homer of seed only an ephah of grain."

ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde, oyo o gatato, akabatunyana, ogoteba neriogi rinene, “Omonto karasasime eng’iti eria na omogwekano oye, na kobekwa ekemanyererio ase obosio bwaye igoro, gose ase okoboko kwaye,
english: A third angel followed them and said in a loud voice: "If anyone worships the beast and his image and receives his mark on the forehead or on the hand,

ekegusii: na ensemo ende ya isato barende ase Egeita gia Suri, na ensemo ende ya isato barende ase egeita magega y’abarendi. Naboigo mobe mokorenda ase enyomba y’omoruoti.
english: a third at the Sur Gate, and a third at the gate behind the guard, who take turns guarding the temple--

ekegusii: Ase amaakwa, ayio atato, omorero, na erioki, na ekebiriti, ebi biaruete korwa ase emenwa yabo, ensemo ya gatato ya mwanyabanto bagaitwa.
english: A third of mankind was killed by the three plagues of fire, smoke and sulfur that came out of their mouths.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya gatato y’enyancha ekaba amanyinga, na ensemo ya gatato y’ebitongwa bire moyo ime ase enyancha bigakwa, na ensemo ya gatato ye chimeeri chigasarigwa.
english: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

ekegusii: na ensemo ende ya isato babe bakorenda enyomba y’omoruoti, na ensemo ende ya isato ase Egeita ki’Oboroso; na abanto bande bonsi babeere ime ase chiraaro chi’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: a third of you at the royal palace and a third at the Foundation Gate, and all the other men are to be in the courtyards of the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ensemo eyemo ya isato y’abanto baino mbaitwe namarwaire agoita, na bakwe nenchara, agwo ase omochie ime, na ensemo ende ya isato mbaitwe nemioro agwo ase chinsemo chionsi isiko y’omochie; na ensemo ende ya isato nimbasiarere gochia ase chinsemo chionsi, mbabwatie inde nomoro.
english: A third of your people will die of the plague or perish by famine inside you; a third will fall by the sword outside your walls; and a third I will scatter to the winds and pursue with drawn sword.

ekegusii: Abanto elifu eyemo nabaisa kogwa ase rikere riao, gose chilifu ikomi ase ensemo yao ya borio, korende ayio tagokonyora aye.
english: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.

ekegusii: Abanto baino elifu eyemo mbaserigwe ase okogoswa nomonto oyomo, gose nabanto batano, goika abatigari baino babe buna omoenga oyomo ore ase egetunwa igoro, na buna ekemanyererio keimokereirie ase ekerogo igoro.
english: A thousand will flee at the threat of one; at the threat of five you will all flee away, till you are left like a flagstaff on a mountaintop, like a banner on a hill."

ekegusii: a time to be born and a time to die, a time to plant and a time to uproot,
english: Nere engaki y’okoiborwa, na ey’ogokwa; engaki y’ogosimeka, na ey’ogosimora ekio giasimegetwe;

ekegusii: a time to kill and a time to heal, a time to tear down and a time to build,
english: engaki y’ogoita, na ey’okogwenia; engaki y’ogotagora, na ey’okoagacha;

ekegusii: a time to love and a time to hate, a time for war and a time for peace.
english: engaki y’ogwanchana, na ey’okogechana; engaki y’esegi, na ey’omorembe.

ekegusii: a time to scatter stones and a time to gather them, a time to embrace and a time to refrain,
english: engaki y’ogosiarera amagena, na ey’okoyasangereria; engaki y’okoboania, na ey’ogotaboania;

ekegusii: a time to search and a time to give up, a time to keep and a time to throw away,
english: engaki y’okorigia, na ey’ogosiria; engaki y’okogacha, na ey’ogotuguta;

ekegusii: engaki y’ogotandora, na ey’okobareera; engaki y’ogokira, na ey’ogokwana;
english: a time to tear and a time to mend, a time to be silent and a time to speak,

ekegusii: a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance,
english: engaki y’okorera, na ey’ogoseka; engaki y’okobokia amagombo, na ey’ogotenga;

ekegusii: Oboreba mbomobwate ase egetingiro na omoeto nomobwate omong’userere bokong’u.
english: A trap seizes him by the heel; a snare holds him fast.

ekegusii: Kirori ore omwegenwa tari gokwana oborimo, korende oyotari omwegenwa nigo agokwana oborimo bwoka.
english: A truthful witness does not deceive, but a false witness pours out lies.

ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete gokwana ekeene nigo akoorokia oboronge, korende kirori bw’oborimo nigo agokwana ay’obong’ainereria.
english: A truthful witness gives honest testimony, but a false witness tells lies.

ekegusii: Kirori ogokwana ekeene nigo agotooria obogima, korende oyogokwana oborimo nigo are omosigaani.
english: A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is deceitful.

ekegusii: Omogambi otari nobong’aini nigo are omochandi omotindi, korende oria ogechete konyora ebitoki bitari bi’oboronge, nigo akogenderera kogamba ase amatuko amange.
english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment, but he who hates ill-gotten gain will enjoy a long life.

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o kabere, abanto abange mono bagasangererekana agwo Yerusalemu korenda Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera.
english: A very large crowd of people assembled in Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the second month.

ekegusii: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
english: Na abange b’emeganda bakaara chianga chiabo inchera; abande bakanacha chinsagia chi’emete bagachiaara nchera.

ekegusii: Omonto omotindi nigo akoebereria omonto onde omoraa gochia ase enchera embe.
english: A violent man entices his neighbor and leads him down a path that is not good.

ekegusii: Eriogi rigasoka korwa ase riire riria rigoteba, “Oyo n’Omwana one, Omochorwa one; moigwere ere!”
english: A voice came from the cloud, saying, "This is my Son, whom I have chosen; listen to him."

ekegusii: Omonto orure ase orogongo rwa Dani, orentire amang’ana neriogi rinene, nigo akoraria obobe korwa ase ense y’Efraimu.
english: A voice is announcing from Dan, proclaiming disaster from the hills of Ephraim.

ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ogoteba: “Roisia enchera y’Omonene ase erooro; rongeyia enchera enene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, agwo ase erooro.
english: A voice of one calling: "In the desert prepare the way for the LORD; make straight in the wilderness a highway for our God.

ekegusii: Eriogi rigoteba, “Raria amang’ana!” Na erinde rikoboria, “Mang’ana ki nkoraria?” “Raria ng’a mwanyabanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, obuya bwabo bwonsi nigo bonga egesicha kere mogondo.
english: A voice says, "Cry out." And I said, "What shall I cry?" "All men are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers of the field.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atano na atato aborokigwa baye nao barenge naende ase enyomba eria ime, na Tomas amo nabarabwo. Yeso agacha ekero ebisieri bisiekire, agatenena gati‐gati, akabora, “Omorembe obe asemore!”
english: A week later his disciples were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you!"

ekegusii: Ekeranya nigo kere ase ogoaka ebarasi, na ekeokio ase okoraa etigere, naboigo nenyimbo ere ase ogoaka omogongo bw’omonto omoriri.
english: A whip for the horse, a halter for the donkey, and a rod for the backs of fools!

ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu nkebaabuse ne chinguru chiaye, na barabwo mbasookigwe ase engencho y’ebing’wanso biabo.
english: A whirlwind will sweep them away, and their sacrifices will bring them shame.

ekegusii: Ekegori ekebe ki’obotomani kerigetie egekone, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga ekia Yona.” Erio akabatiga, akagenda.
english: A wicked and adulterous generation looks for a miraculous sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah." Jesus then left them and went away.

ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoegwa riaaki bobisi, erinde asarie chinchera chi’ekina.
english: A wicked man accepts a bribe in secret to pervert the course of justice.

ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotegerera oigwera amang’ana ’obokorekanu, na omonyaborimo nigo akoigwera chinkwana chi’ogosiria.
english: A wicked man listens to evil lips; a liar pays attention to a malicious tongue.

ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agokong’ia obosio bwaye, korende oyore nenkoro endonge nigo akorenda orogendo rwaye.
english: A wicked man puts up a bold front, but an upright man gives thought to his ways.

ekegusii: Omotomwa otari omwegenwa nigo akogwa ase emechando, korende oyore omwegenwa nigo akogwenia.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy brings healing.

ekegusii: Omokungu omuya nigo are egutwa y’omosacha oye, korende omokungu okorenta obosooku nigo are buna obogundo ase amauga ’omosacha oye.
english: A wife of noble character is her husband's crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare konyora omokungu omuya? Omokungu omuya nigo are nengencho enene kobua amagena e rigori rinene.
english: A wife of noble character who can find? She is worth far more than rubies.

ekegusii: Mwabeire buna etigere eaberi y’orosana enarete ase erooro, ekero ere nokogania nigo ekoeyana mono na gwesesa. Ning’o oranyare gotanga etigere ase okogania kwaye? Etigere etuoni ekoyerigia tekwerosia enyene, ekiagera engaki yaye egoika eganetie erieme neoroke enyene.
english: a wild donkey accustomed to the desert, sniffing the wind in her craving-- in her heat who can restrain her? Any males that pursue her need not tire themselves; at mating time they will find her.

ekegusii: korende omwaga oyio ninyotome obe omotindi mono goetania. Bono ninche ndabanachere ekina.”
english: a wind too strong for that comes from me. Now I pronounce my judgments against them."

ekegusii: Omoruoti ore omong’aini nigo akomanya abakori amabe obaatanana, erio obatiringera inse namagoro e chigari.
english: A wise king winnows out the wicked; he drives the threshing wheel over them.

ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akoumokera omochie ore nabarwani esegi chituoni oyobua, erio otagora chindwaki chiria abanto abwo basemeretie.
english: A wise man attacks the city of the mighty and pulls down the stronghold in which they trust.

ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akwoboa na kwerenda korwa ase amabe, korende omoriri nigo akoba omoremu ase ogokora amabe.
english: A wise man fears the LORD and shuns evil, but a fool is hotheaded and reckless.

ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo are ne chinguru, na oyore nokomanya nigo akoorokia okobua okonene.
english: A wise man has great power, and a man of knowledge increases strength;

ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekworokereria omonwa oye ong’aiinie, naende yamenta chisemi ase ebikoba biaye.
english: A wise man's heart guides his mouth, and his lips promote instruction.

ekegusii: Omosomba omong’aini nagambere omwana bw’omonene oye, oyio ogokora amang’ana ’obosooku, naende naatananerwe omwando amo nabana b’omonene oye.
english: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son, and will share the inheritance as one of the brothers.

ekegusii: Omwana omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo agochaya ng’ina.
english: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish man despises his mother.

ekegusii: Omwana omong’aini nigo akoigwera amorokererio a ise, korende oyore omochayi tari gwancha ogokurerwa.
english: A wise son heeds his father's instruction, but a mocker does not listen to rebuke.

ekegusii: Erio omokungu gete omong’aini akarangeria korwa ase orwaki rw’omochie, agateba, “Tegerera, tegerera! Tebia Yoabu ache aiga ang’e, nkwane nere.”
english: a wise woman called from the city, "Listen! Listen! Tell Joab to come here so I can speak to him."

ekegusii: agacherwa nomokungu orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta e rimisu rigiya aye rigori rinene; gaikaransete ase endagera, akamonyororokeria ase omotwe oye.
english: a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, which she poured on his head as he was reclining at the table.

ekegusii: na omokungu oyomo akaruta ensio agosera, agaaka Abimeleki omotwe, agasenyenta ekeore kiaye.
english: a woman dropped an upper millstone on his head and cracked his skull.

ekegusii: Omokungu gakobina ase okoibora, nigo are nomoichano, ekiagera ensa yaye yaikire; korende gaikire koibora omwana, tari koinyora obororo bwaye naende, ase engencho y’omogoko bw’okoiborwa kw’omonto ase ense.
english: A woman giving birth to a child has pain because her time has come; but when her baby is born she forgets the anguish because of her joy that a child is born into the world.

ekegusii: Omokungu nigo asibire ase omosacha oye ekero omosacha oye are moyo, korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe; nanyare konyuomwa na monto onde bwensi oyo aranche, korende nase Omonene oka.
english: A woman is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, but he must belong to the Lord.

ekegusii: “Omokungu tabaisa kobeka chianga chi’omosacha, gose omosacha tabaisa kobeka echi’omokungu. Onde bwensi orakore bo, nigo arakore ayare okogechia ase Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: A woman must not wear men's clothing, nor a man wear women's clothing, for the LORD your God detests anyone who does this.

ekegusii: Tiga omokungu eorokererie ase ogokira, na ase ogosika gwonsi.
english: A woman should learn in quietness and full submission.

ekegusii: Ring’ana rigokwanwa ase enchera egwenerete nigo ringa buna amatunda amororo amaya mono abekire ase egekabu keroisirie korwa ase efeta.
english: A word aptly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

ekegusii: Nyuma Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, kagwenire korwa ase oborwaire bwaye, akarika ogotera oko:
english: A writing of Hezekiah king of Judah after his illness and recovery:

ekegusii: A young Levite from Bethlehem in Judah, who had been living within the clan of Judah,
english: Bono narenge omomura omosae, Omolawi omenyete agwo Bethlehemu o Yuda buna omomenyi.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo omosae akaminyoka ase Musa, akamotebia, “Elidadi na Medadi nkobana bare ase egetwori.”
english: A young man ran and told Moses, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."

ekegusii: Omomura oyomo akamotunyana, bweboyetie egetambaa ki’egatani gioka. Bakamobwata,
english: A young man, wearing nothing but a linen garment, was following Jesus. When they seized him,

ekegusii: Haroni na abamura baye bagwesibia amaboko na amagoro ase amache ayio.
english: Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet with water from it.

ekegusii: Haroni na abamura baye goika bachibeke botambe ekero bagosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, gose kobakogenda ase egesasimero gokora emeremo y’obokuani Aase Aachenu ime, tibabaisa kwerentera okomocha na gokwa. Oko nogochika koragenderere ase Haroni na ororeria rwaye.”
english: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. "This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants.

ekegusii: Haroni na abamura baye goika barie eyegotigara ase okoruegwa okwo etabekiri memera, bayeriere aase achenire, agwo ase eraaro y’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Aaron and his sons shall eat the rest of it, but it is to be eaten without yeast in a holy place; they are to eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Haroni akabatebia, “Rusia ebigera bie chitahabu bire ase amato ’abakungu baino, na ase abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, mobindetere.”
english: Aaron answered them, "Take off the gold earrings that your wives, your sons and your daughters are wearing, and bring them to me."

ekegusii: Haroni agakora bo, akabeka chitaya echio, erinde chimoreke gochia bosio bw’ekebekerero ekio, buna Omonene achigete Musa.
english: Aaron did so; he set up the lamps so that they faced forward on the lampstand, just as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Naende Haroni arente Abalawi ase obosio bwane, babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa korwa ase Abaisraeli. Naboigo Abalawi baatananwe, babe ekeegwa ase ogonkorera inche Omonene.
english: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the Israelites, so that they may be ready to do the work of the LORD.

ekegusii: Aaron married Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, and she bore him Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
english: Haroni akanyuoma Elisheba, omoiseke bw’Aminadabu, omoiseke omwabo Nashoni. Ere akamoiborera Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.

ekegusii: Haroni goika ayebeke ekero agokora emeremo y’obokuani, na eriogi rie chindege chiria riigweke ekero agosoa Aase Aachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ekero agosoka, tabaisa gokwa.
english: Aaron must wear it when he ministers. The sound of the bells will be heard when he enters the Holy Place before the LORD and when he comes out, so that he will not die.

ekegusii: Haroni akairaneria Musa, “Rora, rituko ria rero abanto barure ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’ebibe, na eki’ogosambwa, ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende nonya naboigo nomanyete emechando eye nanyorire. Onye inaria ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe rituko ria rero, Inee, nanga nancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene?”
english: Aaron replied to Moses, "Today they sacrificed their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD, but such things as this have happened to me. Would the LORD have been pleased if I had eaten the sin offering today?"

ekegusii: Egoree eria erabe yagwereirwe nobomera asende, Haroni ayerente ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
english: Aaron shall bring the goat whose lot falls to the LORD and sacrifice it for a sin offering.

ekegusii: Erio Haroni akarenta ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe bi’abanto. Akaimokia embori y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe bi’abanto, akayenyenya, akayerua buna aruete eria ye ritang’ani ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene.
english: Aaron then brought the offering that was for the people. He took the goat for the people's sin offering and slaughtered it and offered it for a sin offering as he did with the first one.

ekegusii: Haroni konya okoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na etato (123), ekero akwerete agwo ase egetunwa keria Hori.
english: Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died on Mount Hor.

ekegusii: Aaron was the father of Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
english: Basinto ba Haroni nabwo aba: Nadabu, na Abihu, na Eleazari, na Itamari.

ekegusii: korende amataana na ebinema bia borio akabisungusia bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene, buna Musa achigete.
english: Aaron waved the breasts and the right thigh before the LORD as a wave offering, as Moses commanded.

ekegusii: Nadabu na Abihu, abamura ba Haroni, kera oyomo akaimokia orogio rwaye, akabeka omorero ase orogio orwo, na akabeka ubani igoro ase omorero oyio, bakarentera Omonene omorero orenge bw’engencho eng’ao, oyio Omonene atabachigete.
english: Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu took their censers, put fire in them and added incense; and they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD, contrary to his command.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto momenyete Moabu, karue ase emechie yaino, mogende komenya ase ebitare, mobe buna riruma rikoagacha egeswa kiaye ime y’omwenya bw’egetare.
english: Abandon your towns and dwell among the rocks, you who live in Moab. Be like a dove that makes its nest at the mouth of a cave.

ekegusii: Abdon, Zicri, Hanan,
english: Abidoni na Sikiri, na Hanani,

ekegusii: Abi‐Aliboni korwa Araba na Asimaweti korwa Bahurimu;
english: Abi-Albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

ekegusii: Abieseri korwa Anatoti, na Mebunai korwa Husa;
english: Abiezer from Anathoth, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

ekegusii: Abigail lost no time. She took two hundred loaves of bread, two skins of wine, five dressed sheep, five seahs of roasted grain, a hundred cakes of raisins and two hundred cakes of pressed figs, and loaded them on donkeys.
english: Erio agwo Abigaeli agasangereria emegati amagana abere na ebirandi bibere bi’amasankwa biichire nedivai, ne chinyama chie ching’ondi isano chiyekire, na ebigara bisambire ebitita ebinene bitano, na amasabibu amomo amabomba rigana erimo, na amako amomo amabomba amagana abere. Erio akabiberekia chitigere.

ekegusii: Abigaeli akebeka ang’e bwango, akaimoka akariina etigere, akagenda amo nabasomba baye abaiseke batano. Bagatunyana abanto abwo Daudi atomete, na omosubati oyio akaba moga Daudi.
english: Abigail quickly got on a donkey and, attended by her five maids, went with David's messengers and became his wife.

ekegusii: Abigail was the mother of Amasa, whose father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
english: Abigaeli akaibora Amasa, na ise Amasa nere Yeteri, Omoisumaeli.

ekegusii: Abiya amo nabanto baye bagaita Abaisraeli ase ogoita okonene mono. Abanto baitetwe nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano (500,000), abanto abachore.
english: Abijah and his men inflicted heavy losses on them, so that there were five hundred thousand casualties among Israel's able men.

ekegusii: Abiya akabwatia Yeroboamu, akamoura emechie eye: Beteli, na Yesana, na Efuroni, amo nebichie biabo.
english: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took from him the towns of Bethel, Jeshanah and Ephron, with their surrounding villages.

ekegusii: Na Abiya agatenena igoro ase egetunwa gia Semaraimu, agwo ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, akabora, “Aye Yeroboamu, nainwe Abaisraeli mwensi, ntegerera moigwe!
english: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, "Jeroboam and all Israel, listen to me!

ekegusii: Abiya akagenda korwana esegi, akaira abarwani esegi chilifu amagana ane (400,000), abanto chituoni chi’esegi bachoretwe, korende Yeroboamu agacha komorwania, akaroberia abarwani baye b’esegi chilifu amagana atano na atato (800,000), abanto chituoni.
english: Abijah went into battle with a force of four hundred thousand able fighting men, and Jeroboam drew up a battle line against him with eight hundred thousand able troops.

ekegusii: Abimeleki na abanto b’ekeombe kiaye bakaayerera gochia gotenena ase egeita ki’omochie, korende abanto b’ebiombe biria bibere binde bakarindokera na koumokera abanto bonsi abarenge ase egetii, bakabaita.
english: Abimelech and the companies with him rushed forward to a position at the entrance to the city gate. Then two companies rushed upon those in the fields and struck them down.

ekegusii: Abimeleki agaseria Gaali, na ere agatama. Abange bagaitwa, bakarambereria inse goika ase egeita ki’omochie.
english: Abimelech chased him, and many fell wounded in the flight-- all the way to the entrance to the gate.

ekegusii: Abimeleki, mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali, akagenda Sekemu, ase abang’ina rome, na ase abanto bonsi b’eamate ya ise ng’ina, akabatebia
english: Abimelech son of Jerub-Baal went to his mother's brothers in Shechem and said to them and to all his mother's clan,

ekegusii: Abimeleki akairana Aruma, na Sebuli agaseria Gaali na abamura bamwabo, erio tibanyara kogenderera komenya Sekemu.
english: Abimelech stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove Gaal and his brothers out of Shechem.

ekegusii: Abimeleki agacha koumokera omorobiri oyio, agaika ang’e negesieri kiaye ayosambe nomorero,
english: Abimelech went to the tower and stormed it. But as he approached the entrance to the tower to set it on fire,

ekegusii: Abisai agatebia Daudi, “Rora Nyasae obekire omobisa oo ase okoboko kwao, ase ayio ing’a ribaga imobete ritimo erimo rioka, imobwateranie riroba, gose tinkomobeta kabere.”
english: Abishai said to David, "Today God has delivered your enemy into your hands. Now let me pin him to the ground with one thrust of my spear; I won't strike him twice."

ekegusii: Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, agaita Abaedomu chilifu ikomi na isano na isato (18,000) agwo ase Riranya ri’Omonyo.
english: Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

ekegusii: Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu bw’omokungu Seruya ere nigo amanyekanete ase Baria Batato; akarwania abanto amagana atato, akababeta ne ritimo riaye, akabaita, akaba nerieta rinene ase Baria Batato.
english: Abishai the brother of Joab son of Zeruiah was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.

ekegusii: Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, nigo amanyekanete ase baria Batato; akarwania abanto amagana atato akabaaka ne ritimo riaye, akabaita, na igo akaba nerieta rinene ase egati ya baria Batato.
english: Abishai the brother of Joab was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed, and so he became as famous as the Three.

ekegusii: Abishua the father of Bukki, Bukki the father of Uzzi,
english: Abisua akaibora Buki, na Buki akaibora Usi;

ekegusii: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,
english: Abisua na Naamani, na Ahoa,

ekegusii: Moka Abisuri nigo arenge korokwa Abihaili, nere akamoiborera Ahabani na Molidi.
english: Abishur's wife was named Abihail, who bore him Ahban and Molid.

ekegusii: Abineri agakwana nabanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin boigo. Erio akagenda Heburoni, agatebia Daudi amang’ana ayio Abaisraeli na Ababenjamin bonsi banchete gokora asare.
english: Abner also spoke to the Benjamites in person. Then he went to Hebron to tell David everything that Israel and the whole house of Benjamin wanted to do.

ekegusii: Erio Abineri akarangeria Yoabu, akamoboria, “Inee! Nigo oganetie omoro oite abanto kogenderera botambe? Tomanyeti ng’a omoerio nobororo borabe? Nengaki eng’ana naki oraganye goika omanye gokania abanto bao tibabwatia abamwabo?”
english: Abner called out to Joab, "Must the sword devour forever? Don't you realize that this will end in bitterness? How long before you order your men to stop pursuing their brothers?"

ekegusii: Agwo Abineri agakwana nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli, akabora, “Korwa ase chingaki chinde chiaetire mwabeire mokogania ng’a Daudi abe omoruoti oino.
english: Abner conferred with the elders of Israel and said, "For some time you have wanted to make David your king.

ekegusii: Abineri akeonchora, akamoboria, “Naye Asaeli?” Ere akairaneria, “Ee, ninche.”
english: Abner looked behind him and asked, "Is that you, Asahel?" "It is," he answered.

ekegusii: Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na abasomba ba Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, bakarua Mahanaimu, bakagenda ase omochie o Gibeoni.
english: Abner son of Ner, together with the men of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, left Mahanaim and went to Gibeon.

ekegusii: Erio Abineri akaba nendamwamu enene ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio a Isi‐Boseti, akabora, “Inee! Inche nigo inde omotwe bw’esese korwa ase ense ya Yuda? Goika rituko ria rero ngendererete koba omwegenwa ase abanto b’eamate ya Saulo iso, na ase abamwabo, na ase abasani baye, ko tinakobeka ase okoboko gwa Daudi, na bono aye gwansoeire na gonkora koba nokomocha ase engencho y’omokungu oyo.
english: Abner was very angry because of what Ish-Bosheth said and he answered, "Am I a dog's head-- on Judah's side? This very day I am loyal to the house of your father Saul and to his family and friends. I haven't handed you over to David. Yet now you accuse me of an offense involving this woman!

ekegusii: Na nyuma y’ensa eyemo, omonto onde akabetereria mono, akabora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge amo nere, ekiagera nere n’Omogalili.”
english: About an hour later another asserted, "Certainly this fellow was with him, for he is a Galilean."

ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abaaseri: “Abaaseri basesenigwe kobua ebisaku binde. Tiga barabwo banchwe nabamwabo; amagoro abo atache riroba rikomera amazeituni.
english: About Asher he said: "Most blessed of sons is Asher; let him be favored by his brothers, and let him bathe his feet in oil.

ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Ababenjamin: “Aba nabanchwa b’Omonene, mbamenye inse y’oborendi bwaye bare nobotoereru, Omonene nabagitere abaetanane botambe, barabwo mbamenye ase amareko aye.”
english: About Benjamin he said: "Let the beloved of the LORD rest secure in him, for he shields him all day long, and the one the LORD loves rests between his shoulders."

ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abadani: “Abadani nigo banga buna endo ensae egocharoka korwa Basani.”
english: About Dan he said: "Dan is a lion's cub, springing out of Bashan."

ekegusii: Agachia koba amatuko ang’e atano na atato nyuma ase amang’ana aya, akaira Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro gosaba.
english: About eight days after Jesus said this, he took Peter, John and James with him and went up onto a mountain to pray.

ekegusii: Abanto koreng’ana chilifu emerongo ene babogoretie ebirwanero, baare ang’e korwana esegi, bagaetera ebirubo ebiomo ang’e na Yeriko, ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: About forty thousand armed for battle crossed over before the LORD to the plains of Jericho for war.

ekegusii: Na barabwo nigo barenge ang’e chilifu inye.
english: About four thousand men were present. And having sent them away,

ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abagadi: “Omonene abakwe, oria okogareyia orogongo rw’Abagadi. Abagadi nigo barabe bakoramama inse buna endo, batandora okoboko amo nekeore ki’omotwe.
english: About Gad he said: "Blessed is he who enlarges Gad's domain! Gad lives there like a lion, tearing at arm or head.

ekegusii: Agakwana ogoro y’Abayusufu: “Ogosesenigwa kw’Omonene koe ase riroba riabo, abae ebiegwa ebiya bikorwa igoro, abae obotooru na ebinto ebiya bire ase riroba ime,
english: About Joseph he said: "May the LORD bless his land with the precious dew from heaven above and with the deep waters that lie below;

ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abalawi: “Omonene, obamaanorere babe nobomanyi goetera ase Tumimu na Urimu, ekiagera barabwo nabegenwa bao bare. Aye nkwabateemete aria Masa. Nkwaamereranetie nabarabwo ase amache a Meriba.
english: About Levi he said: "Your Thummim and Urim belong to the man you favored. You tested him at Massah; you contended with him at the waters of Meribah.

ekegusii: Korende ekero kia botuko gati Paulo na Sila nigo barenge gosaba Nyasae na komoterera amatera, na abasibwa bande nigo babategererete.
english: About midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.

ekegusii: Agakwana igoro y’Abanafutali: “Inwe Abanafutali nigo mwanyorire ogwancherawa okonge na ogosesenigwa kw’ogoisaneka korwa ase Omonene, moire orogongo rore ase enyancha ensemo ya irianyi,”
english: About Naphtali he said: "Naphtali is abounding with the favor of the LORD and is full of his blessing; he will inherit southward to the lake."

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, ekero baare kogenda, kobaikire ang’e nomochie, Petero akariina kerama igoro gochia gosaba koreng’ana chinsa isano nemo chia mobaso.
english: About noon the following day as they were on their journey and approaching the city, Peter went up on the roof to pray.

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti, ekero kia mobaso gati, kande enchera kogenda, nkarora amasase akorwa igoro abuete okobara kw’erioba, akambarera chinsemo chionsi amo nabaria barenge amo nainche.
english: About noon, O king, as I was on the road, I saw a light from heaven, brighter than the sun, blazing around me and my companions.

ekegusii: Naende nyuma y’amatuko ikomi kaerire Omonene agaaka Nabali, na ere agakwa.
english: About ten days later, the LORD struck Nabal and he died.

ekegusii: Na ase engaki eria, ekero Yeroboamu agendete isiko korwa Yerusalemu, omobani Ahiya korwa Silo akanyorana nere inchera. Ahiya igo ambarete egetambaa ekeyia; bono abanto aba babere bakaba boka aase aarabu.
english: About that time Jeroboam was going out of Jerusalem, and Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh met him on the way, wearing a new cloak. The two of them were alone out in the country,

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria akarwara, agakwa. Ekero bamosibirie bakamobeka akanyomba ka irongo.
english: About that time she became sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio eburu‐buru etai nke ekaimoka ase amang’ana ’enchera y’Omonene.
english: About that time there arose a great disturbance about the Way.

ekegusii: Goika chinsa ikomi nemo agasoka, akarora abande bateneine, akabatebia nabarabwo: Ninki mwatenenera aa bwaira, motari nemeremo?
english: About the eleventh hour he went out and found still others standing around. He asked them, 'Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?'

ekegusii: Chiachia koba ang’e chinsa kianda, Yeso, akarera neriogi rinene, okobora, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani?” Okoonchorwa kwaye, “Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire?”
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried out in a loud voice, "Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?"-- which means, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?"

ekegusii: Chinsoko abanene baremete, echio chiaremetwe nenyimbo y’omogambi, ne chinyimbo chiabo chi’ogotaarera.” Korwa agwo ase erooro bakagenda bagaika Matana,
english: about the well that the princes dug, that the nobles of the people sank-- the nobles with scepters and staffs." Then they went from the desert to Mattanah,

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, akagenda akarwania Gati, akayobua. Korende ekero Hasaeli aonchogete kogenda korwania Yerusalemu,
english: About this time Hazael king of Aram went up and attacked Gath and captured it. Then he turned to attack Jerusalem.

ekegusii: About three hours later his wife came in, not knowing what had happened.
english: Nyuma ye chinsa isato gachiaetire mokaye agasoa, ere tamanyete aya akoregete.

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma y’emetienyi etato Yuda agatebigwa ng’a Tamari, moka momura oye, okorire obotomani bw’obotayayi; amo nayio morito are ase obotayayi. Erio Yuda akabora, “Mosokie isiko, asambwe nomorero.”
english: About three months later Judah was told, "Your daughter-in-law Tamar is guilty of prostitution, and as a result she is now pregnant." Judah said, "Bring her out and have her burned to death!"

ekegusii: Musa agakwana igoro y’Abasabuloni: “Inwe Abasabuloni, mogoke ekero mogosoka isiko, nainwe Abaisakaru, mogoke ase chiema chiaino ime.
english: About Zebulun he said: "Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out, and you, Issachar, in your tents.

ekegusii: Above all else, guard your heart, for it is the wellspring of life.
english: Renda enkoro yao kobua ande onsi orendete, ekiagera nao chinsoko chi’obogima chikorua.

ekegusii: Kobua ase onsi mobe nomokia ase ogwanchana, ekiagera obwanchani nigo bogotuba obonge bw’ebibe.
english: Above all, love each other deeply, because love covers over a multitude of sins.

ekegusii: Korende abaminto, kobua ase onsi timotiana, ase igoro, gose ase ense, gose koria muma ende yonsi, korende “ee” yaino ebe “ee”, na “yaya” yaino ebe “yaya”, timocha kobekwa inse y’okogambigwa.
english: Above all, my brothers, do not swear-- not by heaven or by earth or by anything else. Let your "Yes" be yes, and your "No," no, or you will be condemned.

ekegusii: Ritang’ani momanye ring’ana eri, ng’a obobani bonde tibori ime ase amariko bwaorogetigwe koreng’ana buna omonto anchete omonyene,
english: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture came about by the prophet's own interpretation.

ekegusii: Goetanana ase Omonene, abaserafi mbateneine aroro; kera oyomo obo nigo abwate chimbaba isano nemo, na kera oyomo nigo atubete obosio bwaye ne chimbaba ibere, na amagoro aye ne chimbaba ibere, na akairurukera chimbaba chinde ibere.
english: Above him were seraphs, each with six wings: With two wings they covered their faces, with two they covered their feet, and with two they were flying.

ekegusii: Igoro ase omotwe oye bakabeka ogosoerwa kwaye, korikire, “OYO NERE YESO, OMORUOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI”.
english: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

ekegusii: Igoro yaye yarengeo emegwekano y’abakerubi y’obonene yare kobekera egeikaransero ki’amabera ekiriri. Bono titokonyara goteba amang’ana ’ebinto ebi ekemo ekemo.
english: Above the ark were the cherubim of the Glory, overshadowing the atonement cover. But we cannot discuss these things in detail now.

ekegusii: Igoro y’eaanga eria yarenge igoro y’emetwe yabo norengeo omogwekano bw’ekerogo ki’obonene keroisirie korwa ase safiro, rigena rikomeka‐meka; ase omogwekano oria bw’ekerogo ki’obonene naikaranseteo oyomo ekieni kiaye kiarenge buna eki’omonto.
english: Above the expanse over their heads was what looked like a throne of sapphire, and high above on the throne was a figure like that of a man.

ekegusii: Korwa ase Egeita gie Chibarasi na kogenderera abakuani bakaagacha, kera oyomo ensemo yarenge ang’e nenyomba yaye.
english: Above the Horse Gate, the priests made repairs, each in front of his own house.

ekegusii: Igoro y’oboroso narengeo amagena ande e rigori rinene, abaachetwe koreng’ana nekerengo, amo nemeriibo y’emecharake.
english: Above were high-grade stones, cut to size, and cedar beams.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu bagaancherana na Efuroni; na Ibrahimu akarengera Efuroni chifeta chiria atebete Abahiti kobaigwete, chisekeli chie chifeta amagana ane, koreng’ana nekerengo giancheranire nabaonchoreria.
english: Abraham agreed to Ephron's terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the weight current among the merchants.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Ibrahimu agasarwa amo na Isumaeli, omwana oye,
english: Abraham and his son Ishmael were both circumcised on that same day.

ekegusii: Bono Ibrahimu na Sara konya bagotire mono, baetanirie emiaka y’oboke, na Sara konya oeteire emiaka y’okonyora abana.
english: Abraham and Sarah were already old and well advanced in years, and Sarah was past the age of childbearing.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akamoiraneria, “Omwana one, Nyasae nenyorere emanwa y’eng’ondi ase ekeng’wanso eke.” Erio bakagenderera amo bonsi babere.
english: Abraham answered, "God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son." And the two of them went on together.

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu agatung’ama inse, agaseka, akabora ase omoyo oye ime, “Inee! Omonto ore nemiaka rigana nanyare koibora omwana?” Sara nere oyo ore nemiaka emerongo kianda aibore omwana?
english: Abraham fell facedown; he laughed and said to himself, "Will a son be born to a man a hundred years old? Will Sarah bear a child at the age of ninety?"

ekegusii: Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore him.
english: Omwana oyio Sara aiborerete Ibrahimu, Ibrahimu akamoroka Isaka.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akaa Isaka ebinto bionsi ebi abwate.
english: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.

ekegusii: Agwo akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora abanto batato bateneine bosio bwaye. Ekero abarora, akaminyoka korwa gesieri ki’eema, agachia kobarotota, agatung’ama inse,
english: Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he hurried from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora magega aye eng’ondi emingichi ebwatire chingunchara ase orosana nemerande. Ibrahimu akagenda, akarusia eng’ondi eyio, akayerua, ekaba ekeng’wanso ase ribaga ri’omwana oye.
english: Abraham looked up and there in a thicket he saw a ram caught by its horns. He went over and took the ram and sacrificed it as a burnt offering instead of his son.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu agasimeka omote onga buna ekerachuoki aria Beeri‐Seba, na agwo akarangeria erieta ri’Omonene Nyasae o kare na kare ase okomosasima.
english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called upon the name of the LORD, the Eternal God.

ekegusii: Akarengereria ng’a Nyasae nanyare komobokia korwa ase abakure. Ase ayio akamonyora agwo agwo, buna omogwekano.
english: Abraham reasoned that God could raise the dead, and figuratively speaking, he did receive Isaac back from death.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akamoiraneria, “Nabo nakorete igo, ekiagera naroche ng’a abamoirogete Nyasae tibari aase aa, na barabwo nigo barang’ite ase engencho ya mokane.
english: Abraham replied, "I said to myself, 'There is surely no fear of God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.'

ekegusii: Abraham said, "I swear it."
english: Ibrahimu agateba, “Ee, ninkoriere eira.”

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akabora, “Rora, ningendererete gokwana n’Omonene. Baise konyorekana rende emerongo ebere?” Omonene akairaneria, “Ase engencho y’abwo emerongo ebere, tingosaria omochie.”
english: Abraham said, "Now that I have been so bold as to speak to the Lord, what if only twenty can be found there?" He said, "For the sake of twenty, I will not destroy it."

ekegusii: Ibrahimu agaatanana chimanwa chisigiti isano na ibere, agachibeka ensemo.
english: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs from the flock,

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akanyuoma omokungu onde, ore korokwa Ketura.
english: Abraham took another wife, whose name was Keturah.

ekegusii: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them went on together,
english: Ibrahimu akaimokia chinko echi arenge gochia gosambera ekeng’wanso, agatweka Isaka omwana oye, na ere omonyene akaimokia omorero na omoyio. Bakagenda amo bonsi babere.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu nigo arenge nemiaka rigana erimo ekero Isaka, omwana oye, aiboretwe.
english: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.

ekegusii: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
english: Ibrahimu konya obeire nemiaka emerongo kianda, na kianda (99), ekero akebetwe, risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha.

ekegusii: Bono Ibrahimu konya obeire omogotu, akoorire emiaka emenge; na Omonene konya omosesenirie ase amang’ana onsi.
english: Abraham was now old and well advanced in years, and the LORD had blessed him in every way.

ekegusii: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers,
english: Ibrahimu akaibora Isaka, na Isaka akaibora Yakobo, na Yakobo akaibora Yuda na abamwabo,

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akaibora Isaka. Abana abamura ba Isaka nabwo Esau na Israeli.
english: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

ekegusii: ekero ndoche ng’a ngochia are koba egesaku ekenene gie chinguru, na ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe goetera asare?
english: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and all nations on earth will be blessed through him.

ekegusii: Aburamu na Nahori bakanyuoma abakungu. Moka Aburamu nigo arenge korokwa Sarai, na moka Nahori Milka, omwana omosubati o Harani; oyio nere ise Milka na Isika.
english: Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah; she was the daughter of Haran, the father of both Milcah and Iscah.

ekegusii: Aburamu nigo amwegenete Omonene, na ase engencho eyio akabarwa koba omonyene oboronge.
english: Abram believed the LORD, and he credited it to him as righteousness.

ekegusii: Akamorentera echio chionsi, agatandora kera eyemo chimbaara ibere, akabeka kera orobaara rogachikana norwamwabo, korende chinyoni chirochio tachitandora.
english: Abram brought all these to him, cut them in two and arranged the halves opposite each other; the birds, however, he did not cut in half.

ekegusii: Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,
english: Erio Aburamu agatung’ama inse akaumama, na Nyasae akamotebia,

ekegusii: Nabo Aburamu arenge omotenenku mono, nigo abwate etugo enyinge, ne chifeta, ne chitahabu.
english: Abram had become very wealthy in livestock and in silver and gold.

ekegusii: Aburamu akamenya ase ense ya Kanani, na Loti nere akamenya egati y’emechie agwo ase ense eria omweya, akang’anyia eema yaye gochia Sodomu.
english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain and pitched his tents near Sodom.

ekegusii: Ekero baigeteo, Aburamu agaeta gati y’ense eria goika aase aachenu agwo Shekemu, aase omote onga buna omotontera orenge, agwo More. Ase engaki eyio Abakanani nabwo bamenyete ase ense eyio.
english: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the great tree of Moreh at Shechem. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.

ekegusii: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore him Ishmael.
english: Aburamu konya obeire nemiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etano nomo (86), ekero Hagari amoiborerete Isumaeli.

ekegusii: Abisalomu na Abaisraeli bonsi bakabora, “Ogosemia kwa Husai Omoariki nokuya kobua koria kw’Ahitofeli.” Omonene nere ochigete ogosemia okwo okuya kw’Ahitofeli kwangwe, erinde arentere Abisalomu emechando.
english: Absalom and all the men of Israel said, "The advice of Hushai the Arkite is better than that of Ahithophel." For the LORD had determined to frustrate the good advice of Ahithophel in order to bring disaster on Absalom.

ekegusii: Abisalomu akaboria Husai, “Inee! Obo nabwo obwegenwa ore nabwo ase Daudi, omosani oo? Naki otatunyanete omosani oo?”
english: Absalom asked Hushai, "Is this the love you show your friend? Why didn't you go with your friend?"

ekegusii: Naboigo Abisalomu akorete Abaisraeli bonsi abwo barenge gocha ase omoruoti ase okogamberwa ebina biabo. Ase enchera eyio Abisalomu akang’usa Abaisraeli bonsi bakamwancha.
english: Absalom behaved in this way toward all the Israelites who came to the king asking for justice, and so he stole the hearts of the men of Israel.

ekegusii: Korende Abisalomu agatama, akagenda ase Talimai, mosinto bw’Amihudi, omoruoti bw’Abagesuri. Daudi akaba okoreera omwana oye rituko ase rituko.
english: Absalom fled and went to Talmai son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur. But King David mourned for his son every day.

ekegusii: Abisalomu konya obekire Amasa koba omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’esegi ribaga ria Yoabu. Amasa nigo arenge mosinto o Yitira Omoisumaeli. Yitira nere omenyanete n’Abigaeli, omoiseke o Nahasi, mosubati omwabo Seruya, oyorenge ng’ina Yoabu.
english: Absalom had appointed Amasa over the army in place of Joab. Amasa was the son of a man named Jether, an Israelite who had married Abigail, the daughter of Nahash and sister of Zeruiah the mother of Joab.

ekegusii: Abisalomu akamenya Yerusalemu emiaka ebere atana gochia kororana nomoruoti.
english: Absalom lived two years in Jerusalem without seeing the king's face.

ekegusii: Abisalomu tarenge gokwana n’Amunoni nonya ne ring’ana erimo; nigo amogechete ekiagera ere akorerete Tamari, omoiseke omwabo, obosooku.
english: Absalom never said a word to Amnon, either good or bad; he hated Amnon because he had disgraced his sister Tamar.

ekegusii: Abisalomu agachika abasomba baye, akabatebia, “Morigererie ekero Amunoni anyure atindire, na moigwe ekero ndabatebie ng’a moake Amunoni. Erio agwo momoake kegima, momoite akwe. Timwoboa! Inche nabachika ng’a mokore bo. Mobe abakong’u na abaremu.”
english: Absalom ordered his men, "Listen! When Amnon is in high spirits from drinking wine and I say to you, 'Strike Amnon down,' then kill him. Don't be afraid. Have not I given you this order? Be strong and brave."

ekegusii: Absalom said to Ahithophel, "Give us your advice. What should we do?"
english: Erio Abisalomu agatebia Ahitofeli, “Bono buna tore aa, tosemie eki togwenerete gokora.”

ekegusii: Abisalomu akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, ngatoma abanto asore ng’a oche ogende ase omoruoti, omotebie amang’ana aane. Inki rende narwerete Gesuri? Nanga mbuya nare komenya aroro goika rero iga. Bono ninganetie korora omoruoti. Onye obobe bore asende ang’ite.”
english: Absalom said to Joab, "Look, I sent word to you and said, 'Come here so I can send you to the king to ask, "Why have I come from Geshur? It would be better for me if I were still there!" 'Now then, I want to see the king's face, and if I am guilty of anything, let him put me to death."

ekegusii: Abisalomu akagenda ase omoruoti, akamotebia, “Rora bono, inche, omosomba oo, nimbwate abanto bakonacha ching’ondi chiane amarionya. Koranche, aye omoruoti, ochiche amo nabasomba bao.”
english: Absalom went to the king and said, "Your servant has had shearers come. Will the king and his officials please join me?"

ekegusii: Moroisie ere oyotari na nguru ase okwegena, motari koamererania.
english: Accept him whose faith is weak, without passing judgment on disputable matters.

ekegusii: Ancha amorokererio akorwa ase omonwa oye; gacha amang’ana aye ime ase enkoro yao.
english: Accept instruction from his mouth and lay up his words in your heart.

ekegusii: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring praise to God.
english: Naboigo moroisanie buna Kristo nere abaroisetie inwe, erinde Nyasae abakwe.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abera abanto bao Abaisraeli, aba kwabooretie; tobabarera okomocha oko kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’omonto otari na komocha. Naboigo baaberwe okomocha oko kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga.
english: Accept this atonement for your people Israel, whom you have redeemed, O LORD, and do not hold your people guilty of the blood of an innocent man." And the bloodshed will be atoned for.

ekegusii: Omonene, anchera ogosaba kwane kw’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, na inyorokererie aya gwachikire.
english: Accept, O LORD, the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me your laws.

ekegusii: Nabo kwarenge okorigia kwaye gwa kare na kare, okwo aikeranetie ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.
english: according to his eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ekegusii: Akabirua buna Musa achigete biruegwe ase kera Rituko Richenu: Chisabato, na Emetienyi Emeyia, na Amatuko Amanene ara gatato ase omwaka: Amatuko Amanene ay’Emegati etabekiri memera, na Amatuko Amanene e Chichuma, na Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.
english: according to the daily requirement for offerings commanded by Moses for Sabbaths, New Moons and the three annual feasts-- the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ’omoerio o Daudi, Abalawi bonsi bakarikwa, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania.
english: According to the last instructions of David, the Levites were counted from those twenty years old or more.

ekegusii: Naki aya twabatebirie ase ring’ana ri’Omonene, ng’a intwe abatore moyo, abatwatigaire goika ekero ki’ogocha kw’Omonene, titogotang’anera abwo baikire korara,
english: According to the Lord's own word, we tell you that we who are still alive, who are left till the coming of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.

ekegusii: Bakarua buna barenge konyara, bakabeka ase ekungo y’ogokorerwa emeremo ebisamunye bie chitahabu bikorokwa chidariki, chilifu emerongo etano nomo na eyemo (61,000), na ebie chifeta bikorokwa chimina, chilifu isano (5,000), ne chianga chi’abakuani, rigana erimo (100).
english: According to their ability they gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 drachmas of gold, 5,000 minas of silver and 100 priestly garments.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babwate abakungu abange babaiborerete abana abamura abange. Ase igo barwete korwa ase chinderia chiabo abarwani esegi abakong’u chilifu emerongo etato na isano nemo (36,000).
english: According to their family genealogy, they had 36,000 men ready for battle, for they had many wives and children.

ekegusii: Omonene nabaakane koreng’ana buna ogokora kwabo kore. Nabe nendamwamu ase abwo bakomoengereria, naakane ababisa baye koreng’ana nogokora kwabo; abanto b’ebisinka na abe chinse chire ang’e ne chinyancha nabaakane koreng’ana nogokora kwabo.
english: According to what they have done, so will he repay wrath to his enemies and retribution to his foes; he will repay the islands their due.

ekegusii: Akani akairaneria Yoshua, “Amaene, nakoreire Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ebibe, na aya nakorire naya:
english: Achan replied, "It is true! I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel. This is what I have done:

ekegusii: Akisi akamoiraneria, “Inche nimanyete buya ng’a nigo ore omoronge asende buna omomalaika bw’Omonene. Korende nonya nabo abanene b’Abafilisti bakanire ng’a aye Daudi tobaisa kogenda amo naintwe ase esegi.
english: Achish answered, "I know that you have been as pleasing in my eyes as an angel of God; nevertheless, the Philistine commanders have said, 'He must not go up with us into battle.'

ekegusii: Akisi agatebia abasomba baye, “Rora omonto oyo nebarimo. Nase ki mwamorenta asende?
english: Achish said to his servants, "Look at the man! He is insane! Why bring him to me?

ekegusii: Ase ayio Akisi akegena Daudi mono, akarengereria, “Bono Daudi okorire Abaisraeli bamwabo bamogeche kegima; ase igo ogenderere koba omosomba one botambe.”
english: Achish trusted David and said to himself, "He has become so odious to his people, the Israelites, that he will be my servant forever."

ekegusii: Ase ayio manya rituko ria rero, morengererie mono ng’a, Omonene nere Nyasae o igoro na ense; naende onde tari otatiga ere bweka.
english: Acknowledge and take to heart this day that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth below. There is no other.

ekegusii: Omonto ogwanchera omokori amabe ng’a nomonyakeene, na oria okonachera omonyakeene ekina, abwo bonsi nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene.
english: Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent-- the LORD detests them both.

ekegusii: Mokore koreng’ana buna barabatebererie, na buna baranache ekina asemore; timotiga ogosemia kwabo na koonchoka aande, gochia ase ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.
english: Act according to the law they teach you and the decisions they give you. Do not turn aside from what they tell you, to the right or to the left.

ekegusii: Ada akaiborera Esau Elifasi, na Basemati akaibora Reueli,
english: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath bore Reuel,

ekegusii: Ada akaibora Yabeli; oyo nere sokoro bw’abaare komenya ase chiema na babwate ching’iti chigotugwa.
english: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and raise livestock.

ekegusii: Naende Adaya, mosinto o Yerohamu o Pasuri, o Malikia; na Maasai, mosinto bw’Adieli o Yasera, o Mesulamu, o Mesilemiti, o Imeri.
english: Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer.

ekegusii: Adaya na Beraya, na Simurati; aba nigo baare abana abamura ba Simei.
english: Adaiah, Beraiah and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.

ekegusii: Adamu akaba na mokaye naende na ere akaibora omwana omomura, akamoroka Seti, agateba, “Bono Nyasae ong’eire omwana onde ribaga ri’Abeli, oria Kaini aitete.”
english: Adam lay with his wife again, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, "God has granted me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him."

ekegusii: Bono Adamu akaba na mokaye, na ere akaba morito, akaibora Kaini, akabora, “Nanyorire omonto ase ogokonywa kw’Omonene.”
english: Adam lay with his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. She said, "With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man."

ekegusii: Omonto oria akaroka mokaye Hawa, ekiagera ere nere ng’ina bw’abare moyo bonsi.
english: Adam named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.

ekegusii: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
english: Adamu akaibora Seti, na Seti akaibora Enosu;

ekegusii: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
english: na Adama, na Rama, na Hasori,

ekegusii: Adina, mosinto o Sisa bw’egesaku kia Reuben, omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku ekio, na amo nere abanto emerongo etato;
english: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, who was chief of the Reubenites, and the thirty with him,

ekegusii: Oyo obwatetie abwo koagacha, n’Yedaya, mosinto o Harumafu: ere akaagacha orwaki rwarochie mwaye. Oyomobwatetie koagacha, nere Hatusi, mosinto o Hasabineya.
english: Adjoining this, Jedaiah son of Harumaph made repairs opposite his house, and Hattush son of Hashabneiah made repairs next to him.

ekegusii: Adoni‐Bezeki agatama, korende Abayuda bakamobwatia, bakamobwata na komobutora ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko na ebi’amagoro.
english: Adoni-Bezek fled, but they chased him and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

ekegusii: Adonia na abageni bonsi baria barenge amo nere, ekero bakoorire omoyega obo, bakaigwa amariogi aria. Na ekero Yoabu ayaigwete amo nebiroria, akaboria, “Ninki engencho y’amariogi aya amanene are ase omochie?”
english: Adonijah and all the guests who were with him heard it as they were finishing their feast. On hearing the sound of the trumpet, Joab asked, "What's the meaning of all the noise in the city?"

ekegusii: Adonia agakwana na Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, na Abiatari omokuani; barabwo bagancherana komokonya.
english: Adonijah conferred with Joab son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest, and they gave him their support.

ekegusii: Adonia akanyenya ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chimori chinoru, chikaba ekeng’wanso agwo ang’e n’Egetare gie Ching’iti kere ase ensoko y’Eni‐Rogeli, akarangeria abamura bamwabo bonsi, abwo abamura b’omoruoti, na abanto bonsi abanene b’obogambi bwa Yuda.
english: Adonijah then sacrificed sheep, cattle and fattened calves at the Stone of Zoheleth near En Rogel. He invited all his brothers, the king's sons, and all the men of Judah who were royal officials,

ekegusii: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
english: Adonia, na Bigiwai, na Adini;

ekegusii: Adorama nigo abegetwe koba omoteneneri bw’emeremo ende yonsi. Yehosafati mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nigo arenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.
english: Adoniram was in charge of forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

ekegusii: na Adoraimu, na Lakisi, na Aseka,
english: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

ekegusii: Nyuma ase egeka egeke abateneine aroro bagacha, bagatebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye noyomo obo ore, ekiagera ogokwana kwao gwakoorokirie.”
english: After a little while, those standing there went up to Peter and said, "Surely you are one of them, for your accent gives you away."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’engaki entambe, ekero Omonene konya aeire Abaisraeli obotoereru korwa ase ababisa babo abwo babaetanaine, na Yoshua konya ogotire mono,
english: After a long time had passed and the LORD had given Israel rest from all their enemies around them, Joshua, by then old and well advanced in years,

ekegusii: Amatuko amange gaetire Batisua, moka Yuda, agakwa; Yuda gakoorire okomoreera, agatiira gochia Timuna ase abanachi amarionya be ching’ondi chiaye, amo nomosani oye Hira Omoadulamu.
english: After a long time Judah's wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had recovered from his grief, he went up to Timnah, to the men who were shearing his sheep, and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went with him.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko amange kaerire, ase omwaka o gatato, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija rikamotebia, “Genda bweorokie ase Ahabu, na inche nintome embura etwe igoro ase ense.”
english: After a long time, in the third year, the word of the LORD came to Elijah: "Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain on the land."

ekegusii: Abimeleki akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka etato.
english: After Abimelech had governed Israel three years,

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ogokwa kwa Ibrahimu, Nyasae agasesenia Isaka, omwana oye. Na Isaka akamenya ang’e nensoko yare korokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi.
english: After Abraham's death, God blessed his son Isaac, who then lived near Beer Lahai Roi.

ekegusii: Ekero Aburamu are koirana korwa ase ogoita Kedorilaoma amo nabaruoti baria barenge nere, omoruoti o Sodomu agasoka komorototera ase ense omweya ya Shawe, eyio n’Ense omweya y’Omoruoti.
english: After Abram returned from defeating Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom came out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King's Valley).

ekegusii: Ekero Abisalomu atamete, akagenda akamenya Gesuri ase engaki y’emiaka etato.
english: After Absalom fled and went to Geshur, he stayed there three years.

ekegusii: Abayuda bairirwe ase obosomba, babeire nemechando na obokong’u batari gotimoka. Nigo bamenyete ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku; abakobabwatia babaikereire kobare nemechando.
english: After affliction and harsh labor, Judah has gone into exile. She dwells among the nations; she finds no resting place. All who pursue her have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ogokwa kw’Ahabu abanto ba Moabu bakaanga koigwera Abaisraeli.
english: After Ahab's death, Moab rebelled against Israel.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio ay’obwegenwa gakorirwe, Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, agasoa ase ense y’Abayuda. Akanaaria emechie yagiteire chindwaki, akarengereria kobua emechie eyio ng’a ayebwate ebe eyaye.
english: After all that Hezekiah had so faithfully done, Sennacherib king of Assyria came and invaded Judah. He laid siege to the fortified cities, thinking to conquer them for himself.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya achia koera, Paulo akarengereria ase omoika oye ime goeta egati ya Makedonia na Akaya gochia Yerusalemu, ogoteba, “Nyuma konabeire agwo ningwenerete korora Rumi noro.”
english: After all this had happened, Paul decided to go to Jerusalem, passing through Macedonia and Achaia. "After I have been there," he said, "I must visit Rome also."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo ogochia gwetanga torora amang’ana aya? Inee! Nigo ogochia gokira‐kiri na gotochanda mono?
english: After all this, O LORD, will you hold yourself back? Will you keep silent and punish us beyond measure?

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio onsi Omonene agaaka Yehoramu noborwaire bw’enda botarenge kogwenigwa.
english: After all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio onsi, ekero Yosia konya aroisirie Hekalu, Neko, omoruoti o Misiri, agatiira kogenda korwana esegi agwo Karikemisi ase orooche rw’Eufarati, na Yosia akagenda korwana nere.
english: After all this, when Josiah had set the temple in order, Neco king of Egypt went up to fight at Carchemish on the Euphrates, and Josiah marched out to meet him in battle.

ekegusii: Naki onye aye kwanachetwe korwa ase omozeituni bw’orosana, ogachomwa ase ogochomwa gotanaretwe bo, ase omozeituni oyosimekire, tari kobua mono chinsagia chie ritina rinyene chichomwe ase omozeituni obo omonyene.
english: After all, if you were cut out of an olive tree that is wild by nature, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!

ekegusii: Naki omonto tari ogechete omobere oye omonyene, korende nigo akoyorageria na koyorenda, buna Kristo akorageria ekanisa,
english: After all, no one ever hated his own body, but he feeds and cares for it, just as Christ does the church--

ekegusii: Ekero arusetigwe inchera, abanto bonsi bagaeta, bagatunyana Yoabu, erinde babwatie Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, gochia komoita.
english: After Amasa had been removed from the road, all the men went on with Joab to pursue Sheba son of Bicri.

ekegusii: Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agakwana nabasemia baye, erio agatoma amang’ana ase Yehoasi, mosinto o Yehoahasi o Yehu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, agateba, “Inchuo, torigereranie obosio ase obosio.”
english: After Amaziah king of Judah consulted his advisers, he sent this challenge to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel: "Come, meet me face to face."

ekegusii: Obotuko obogima Yoshua agataara korwa Giligali, akaumokera Abaamori mobosokano.
english: After an all-night march from Gilgal, Joshua took them by surprise.

ekegusii: Akamobwata akamobeka echela ime. Akamobeka ase ebiombe bine bi’abarwani; kera ekeombe nigo kiare nabarwani bane. Barabwo bakamorenda. Akarigia komosokia ase abanto nyuma y’Epasaka.
english: After arresting him, he put him in prison, handing him over to be guarded by four squads of four soldiers each. Herod intended to bring him out for public trial after the Passover.

ekegusii: Ekero akoorire komotindeka agatebia abamura baye, “Ekero nainche ndakwe, montindeke ime ase embeera eyio ase omonto o Nyasae atindekire; mwarerie amauga aane mbarabare ase amauga aye.
english: After burying him, he said to his sons, "When I die, bury me in the grave where the man of God is buried; lay my bones beside his bones.

ekegusii: After burying his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, together with his brothers and all the others who had gone with him to bury his father.
english: Yusufu, ekero akoorire gotindeka ise, akairana Misiri amo nabamwabo na bonsi abatiirete amo nere.

ekegusii: Nyuma okobwatana kogwakorirwe nere, nakore ay’obong’ainereria, anyore okobua nonya obwate abanto abake boka.
english: After coming to an agreement with him, he will act deceitfully, and with only a few people he will rise to power.

ekegusii: Ekero akoorete gosemania nabanto, akabeka abanto baare gochia goterera Omonene na komotogia beboetie chianga chinchenu. Barabwo bagatang’ana abarwani esegi bagotera,” “Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bogendererete kare na kare.”
english: After consulting the people, Jehoshaphat appointed men to sing to the LORD and to praise him for the splendor of his holiness as they went out at the head of the army, saying: "Give thanks to the LORD, for his love endures forever."

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaamboka Yorodan, bagatoora Aroeri, na korwa ase omochie oyio agwo ase egati ye rikura bakagenda Gadi, naende gochia Yeseri,
english: After crossing the Jordan, they camped near Aroer, south of the town in the gorge, and then went through Gad and on to Jazer.

ekegusii: Daudi akeagachera chinyomba agwo ase Omochie o Daudi. Akaroisia aase ase Esanduku ya Nyasae yare kobekwa, naende akayeteneneria eema aroro.
english: After David had constructed buildings for himself in the City of David, he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.

ekegusii: Na ekero Daudi akoorire korua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na eki’omorembe agasesenia abanto ase erieta ri’Omonene.
english: After David had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: After David had finished talking with Saul, Jonathan became one in spirit with David, and he loved him as himself.
english: Ekero Daudi akoorire gokwana na Saulo, Yonathani akang’useka na Daudi akaba okomwancha mono, amwanchete buna eanchete ere omonyene.

ekegusii: Bono ekero Daudi amenyete ase enyomba yaye agakwana na Nathani omobani, agateba, “Rora inche nigo imenyete ase enyomba eagachire nemecharake, korende Esanduku ya Nyasae ero nigo ere ase eema ime.”
english: After David was settled in his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a palace of cedar, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under a tent."

ekegusii: Oyobwatetie Ehudi ase okogamba, nere Samigari, mosinto bw’Anati Ere agaita Abafilisti amagana atano na rimo nenyimbo are gotemera chieri. Nere boigo agatooria Abaisraeli.
english: After Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad. He too saved Israel.

ekegusii: Ekero Ehudi akure, Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe ase obosio bw’Omonene naende.
english: After Ehud died, the Israelites once again did evil in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero Ehudi aruete ebiegwa biria agatebia abanto baria babibogoretie bairane bagende,
english: After Ehud had presented the tribute, he sent on their way the men who had carried it.

ekegusii: Akeng’ata amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko. Nyuma ase aya enchara ekamoria.
english: After fasting forty days and forty nights, he was hungry.

ekegusii: Erio Festo agachia gokoora gokwana nabanto b’ekegambero, akairaneria, “Norigetie ekina kiao keirwe ase Kaisari, nabo oragende ase Kaisari.”
english: After Festus had conferred with his council, he declared: "You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you will go!"

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko emerongo ene kaerire Nuhu akaigora ekebao keria akorete ase obwato,
english: After forty days Noah opened the window he had made in the ark

ekegusii: Na ekero abanene baria babagosire naende, bakabasibora. Tibanyora enchera y’okobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’abanto, ekiagera abanto bonsi barenge komobaka Nyasae ase ayio akoregete.
english: After further threats they let them go. They could not decide how to punish them, because all the people were praising God for what had happened.

ekegusii: After going through Pisidia, they came into Pamphylia,
english: Bagaeta egati ya Pisidia, bagasoa Pamfulia.

ekegusii: Igo agaseria omonto oria, na ensemo ya moocha y’omogondo o Edeni akabeka omokerubi, na omoyio o birende ogwoka omorero okona‐koonchaonchoka chinsemo chionsi korenda enchera ekogenda ase omote bw’obogima.
english: After he drove the man out, he placed on the east side of the Garden of Eden cherubim and a flaming sword flashing back and forth to guard the way to the tree of life.

ekegusii: Na nyuma kaeire emeganda ribaga kogenda, akariina ebitunwa igoro ere bweka gochia gosaba. Riachia koba mogoroba akaba agwo bweka.
english: After he had dismissed them, he went up on a mountainside by himself to pray. When evening came, he was there alone,

ekegusii: Na ekero Daudi akoorire korua ebing’wanso biria, agasesenia abanto ase erieta ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda.
english: After he had finished sacrificing the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Ekero asokire, abasomba b’Egiloni bagacha, bakanyora ebisieri bisiekire bibungire, bakarengereria ng’a omoruoti nigo are ase akanyomba ka ime kogwekonya.
english: After he had gone, the servants came and found the doors of the upper room locked. They said, "He must be relieving himself in the inner room of the house."

ekegusii: Goika agachia gosoa nyomba, gatigire omoganda, aborokigwa baye bakamoboria amang’ana ’omoreng’anio oria.
english: After he had left the crowd and entered the house, his disciples asked him about this parable.

ekegusii: After he had said this, he dismissed the assembly.
english: Ekero akoorire gokwana aya, akaa omosangererekano ribaga ogende.

ekegusii: Agakwana aya; erio nyuma ase aya akabatebia, “Lazaro omosani oito orarire, korende nkogenda nde inyare komotura.”
english: After he had said this, he went on to tell them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going there to wake him up."

ekegusii: Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, Yeso agaichana ase omoika oye, akaorokia, agakwana, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyomo oino nandue.”
english: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, "I tell you the truth, one of you is going to betray me."

ekegusii: After he had sent them across the stream, he sent over all his possessions.
english: Akabaimokia, akabaambokia orooche, akaambokia na bionsi ebi arenge nabio.

ekegusii: Gakoorire bionsi, enchara enene egasoa ase ense eria, ere akaremerwa.
english: After he had spent everything, there was a severe famine in that whole country, and he began to be in need.

ekegusii: Erio agesibia obosio, agasoka oremereretie. Naende akabora, “Renta endagera!”
english: After he had washed his face, he came out and, controlling himself, said, "Serve the food."

ekegusii: Korende ekero omoruoti oyio aranyore chinguru chinene, oboruoti bwaye mbosareke bwatananeke ase chinsemo inye chi’ense, tibokoegwa abanto b’ororeria rwaye, tibokoba nokobua buna koria ere abwate. Oboruoti bwaye mbotegorwe boegwe abanto abaao.
english: After he has appeared, his empire will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven. It will not go to his descendants, nor will it have the power he exercised, because his empire will be uprooted and given to others.

ekegusii: Ekero omokuani oyio achenirwe nabarerwe amatuko atano na abere.
english: After he is cleansed, he must wait seven days.

ekegusii: Nyuma karure Heburoni, Daudi akamenta koira abakungu ba sere‐sere na abakungu bande korwa Yerusalemu; akaiborerwa abana bande abange, abamura na abaiseke.
english: After he left Hebron, David took more concubines and wives in Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.

ekegusii: Ekero Yehu aruete aase agwo akaumerana na Yehonadabu, mosinto o Rekabu, ogocha komorotota. Yehu akamokwania, akamoboria, “Enkoro yao nendonge ere asende buna eyane ere asore?” Yehonadabu akamoiraneria, “Ee, nendonge ere.” Yehu akamotebia, “Onye nabo, tobwatane amaboko.” Bakabwatana amaboko, na Yehu akamoriinia ase egari yaye ime.
english: After he left there, he came upon Jehonadab son of Recab, who was on his way to meet him. Jehu greeted him and said, "Are you in accord with me, as I am with you?" "I am," Jehonadab answered. "If so," said Jehu, "give me your hand." So he did, and Jehu helped him up into the chariot.

ekegusii: Gakwanire aya, akaborokia amaboko aye ne rikere riaye. Erio aborokigwa bakagoka kobachia korora Omonene.
english: After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.

ekegusii: Gakoorire gokwana aya, akabogoria omogati akairaneria ng’a mbuya mono ase Nyasae ase amasio abo bonsi, akayosamunyora, agachaka koria.
english: After he said this, he took some bread and gave thanks to God in front of them all. Then he broke it and began to eat.

ekegusii: Ekero akwanete aya, kobarigereretie, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, riire rikamoira korwa ase amaiso abo.
english: After he said this, he was taken up before their very eyes, and a cloud hid him from their sight.

ekegusii: Yeso akamwatanana korwa ase omoganda bobisi, akabeka ebiara biaye ase amato aye, agatwa amate, akamokuna oromeme.
english: After he took him aside, away from the crowd, Jesus put his fingers into the man's ears. Then he spit and touched the man's tongue.

ekegusii: Nabo ekero abogetigwe korwa ase abakure aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng’a nigo atebete ring’ana eri, bakegena ririko riria, ne ring’ana riria Yeso atebete.
english: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the Scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.

ekegusii: Ekero omwana oria atachirwe, Hana akamoira ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Silo, akaira na eeri yakoorire emiaka etato, na obosie ebimunu emerongo ebere, na ekerandi kiaroisirie korwa ase risankwa kere nedivai. Omwana oria omomura nigo arenge omoke.
english: After he was weaned, she took the boy with her, young as he was, along with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour and a skin of wine, and brought him to the house of the LORD at Shiloh.

ekegusii: Ekero Herode akure, rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akaorokera Yusufu aria Misiri ase chindoto, akamotebia,
english: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt

ekegusii: Herode akamorigia, tamonyora. Akana‐kounia abarendi, agachika ng’a baitwe. Erio agatirimboka korwa Boyahudi, akagenda Kaisaria, akamenya aroro.
english: After Herod had a thorough search made for him and did not find him, he cross-examined the guards and ordered that they be executed. Then Herod went from Judea to Caesarea and stayed there a while.

ekegusii: Nyuma Hezironi gakure agwo Kalebu‐Eufarata, Abiya moga Hezironi akamoiborera Asuri, ise abanto ba Tekoa.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah the wife of Hezron bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

ekegusii: After him, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, led Israel.
english: Nyuma y’Eloni, Abidoni, mosinto o Hileli, Omopiratori, akagambera Abaisraeli.

ekegusii: Nyuma ya Ibasani, Eloni, omwa Sabuloni, akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi.
english: After him, Elon the Zebulunite led Israel ten years.

ekegusii: After him, Ibzan of Bethlehem led Israel.
english: Nyuma ya Yefta, Ibasani o Bethlehemu akagambera Abaisraeli.

ekegusii: Nyuma yaye Yudas Omogalili nere akaimoka ase amatuko aria ekero abanto baare korikwa, akang’usa abanto abange bamotunyane. Nere boigo agasira, na bonsi abamotunyanete bagaserebekana.
english: After him, Judas the Galilean appeared in the days of the census and led a band of people in revolt. He too was killed, and all his followers were scattered.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ogochandwa kwaye akeorokia asebare ase ebiorokererio ebinge ng’a moyo are. Akaba okobaorokera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, na gokwana nabarabwo igoro y’oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
english: After his suffering, he showed himself to these men and gave many convincing proofs that he was alive. He appeared to them over a period of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.

ekegusii: Korende ninchiche asemore, nyuma konaetire egati ya Makedonia, ekiagera nindengereretie goeta egati ya Makedonia.
english: After I go through Macedonia, I will come to you-- for I will be going through Macedonia.

ekegusii: Ekero nakoorire gokwana, monto onde tarenge komenta ing’ana rinde, ekiagera amang’ana aane nigo arenge kobagwera buna amatoima ’embura.
english: After I had spoken, they spoke no more; my words fell gently on their ears.

ekegusii: Nkarigereria nkamanya buna amang’ana arenge, Erio ngakwana nabanene basikire, na abatang’ani, na abanto bande bonsi, nkabatebia, “Timobaisa kwoboa ababisa abwo; moinyore Omonene, oyore nokobua, naende oyo bw’okoondokia, morwanere abanto bamino, na abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, na abakungu baino, ne chinka chiaino.”
english: After I looked things over, I stood up and said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, "Don't be afraid of them. Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons and your daughters, your wives and your homes."

ekegusii: Ekero nagotigete nigo neitetie, nkaonchoka; nyuma konorokererigwe, nigo neagete ebachwa, ngatureka omotwe one nkarora obosooku, ekiagera nabogoretie obosooku bw’obosae bwane.
english: After I strayed, I repented; after I came to understand, I beat my breast. I was ashamed and humiliated because I bore the disgrace of my youth.'

ekegusii: Ekero Isaka akoorire gosesenia Yakobo, na Yakobo karure ase obosio bwa Isaka ise, Esau omwabo agacha korwa ase obotwari bwaye.
english: After Isaac finished blessing him and Jacob had scarcely left his father's presence, his brother Esau came in from hunting.

ekegusii: Yakobo kairanire korwa Padan‐Aramu, agaika buya ase omorembe ase Sekemu, omochie omonene bw’ense ya Kanani, agatenenia eema yaye isiko y’omochie oyio.
english: After Jacob came from Paddan Aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in Canaan and camped within sight of the city.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaorokera Yakobo naende, ekero ere are korwa Padan‐Aramu, akamosesenia.
english: After Jacob returned from Paddan Aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.

ekegusii: Nyuma Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, kairire Yekonia, mosinto o Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabanene b’oboruoti boria, na abaroisia b’ebinto, na abaturi b’ebioma, gochia Babeli, Omonene akanyorokia okorora oko: Bosio bwe Hekalu y’Omonene nkarora ebitonga bibere biarenge namako.
english: After Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and the officials, the craftsmen and the artisans of Judah were carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the LORD showed me two baskets of figs placed in front of the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Kobaikire Kapernaumu, abaare kobanga ebango ye Hekalu bagachiera Petero, bakamoboria, “Inee! Omworokia oino nkorua are ebango?”
