english: After Jesus and his disciples arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma tax came to Peter and asked, "Doesn't your teacher pay the temple tax?"

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire gochika aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere, akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda kworokereria na korandia ase emechie yabo.
english: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he went on from there to teach and preach in the towns of Galilee.

ekegusii: Gasoire ase enyomba, aborokigwa baye bakamoboria bobisi, “Naki intwe totanyara kogeseria?”
english: After Jesus had gone indoors, his disciples asked him privately, "Why couldn't we drive it out?"

ekegusii: After Jesus had said this, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
english: Gakoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, agatang’ana gotiira kogenda Yerusalemu.

ekegusii: Agatiga emeganda egende, akariina obwato ime, akagenda chinsemo chia Magadani.
english: After Jesus had sent the crowd away, he got into the boat and went to the vicinity of Magadan.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akwanete amang’ana ayio akaimokia amaiso aye, akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Tata, ensa yaikire. Mobake Omwana oo, erinde Omwana nere akobake aye,
english: After Jesus said this, he looked toward heaven and prayed: "Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aiboretwe aria Bethlehemu ya Boyahudi ase amatuko ’omoruoti Herode, rora, abanto abang’aini bakarwa ensemo ya moocha, bagacha Yerusalemu, bakaboria,
english: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east came to Jerusalem

ekegusii: Erio nyuma Ayubu gasabeire abasani baria baye, Omonene akairaneria Ayubu amaya aye, akamoa ebinto ara kabere kobua ebi abwate ritang’ani.
english: After Job had prayed for his friends, the LORD made him prosperous again and gave him twice as much as he had before.

ekegusii: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.
english: Goika nyuma Yohana kabekirwe echela ime, Yeso akagenda Galili, akarandia enchili ya Nyasae,

ekegusii: Na abatomwa baria ba Yohana bachia kogenda, agachaka gotebia omoganda igoro ya Yohana, “Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Egetonto gekonyegerigwa nembeo?
english: After John's messengers left, Jesus began to speak to the crowd about John: "What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed swayed by the wind?

ekegusii: Yoshua konya oeire Abaisraeli ribaga bagende, na kera oyomo akagenda koira omwando oye ase ense eria.
english: After Joshua had dismissed the Israelites, they went to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaimoka bakarua Sukoti, bagatoora agwo Etamu aase erooro echakerete.
english: After leaving Succoth they camped at Etham on the edge of the desert.

ekegusii: After leaving them, he went up on a mountainside to pray.
english: Goika agachia gokoora gokwana nabarabwo, akagenda egetunwa gosaba.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko amange aetire, Abayahudi bakamogamba, erinde banyare komoita,
english: After many days had gone by, the Jews conspired to kill him,

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko amange noche korootwa naende. Ase emiaka egochi‐gocha nogende ase ense eria yarenge nesegi, korende bono nigo ere nobotoereru, ense eria ase abanto basangereretigwe korwa ase ebisaku ebinge, agwo ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli biarenge bigendererete koba bosa botambe. Abanto bonsi b’aroro nigo barentetwe korwa ase ebisaku ao ao, na bono nao bamenyete bare nomorembe.
english: After many days you will be called to arms. In future years you will invade a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been desolate. They had been brought out from the nations, and now all of them live in safety.

ekegusii: Mikaya akabatebia amang’ana onsi aigwete ekero Baruku asomete ebuku eria ase abanto bategererete.
english: After Micaiah told them everything he had heard Baruch read to the people from the scroll,

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bakarua o Farao, na Musa akaboria Omonene arusie ebioto ebio amorenterete Farao.
english: After Moses and Aaron left Pharaoh, Moses cried out to the LORD about the frogs he had brought on Pharaoh.

ekegusii: Musa akarika amang’ana onsi ay’amachiko ayio ime ase ebuku.
english: After Moses finished writing in a book the words of this law from beginning to end,

ekegusii: Musa agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gochia ase abanto, akabachena, na barabwo bagasibia chianga chiabo.
english: After Moses had gone down the mountain to the people, he consecrated them, and they washed their clothes.

ekegusii: Erio Yetero agacha, akarentana Sipora, moka Musa. Musa konya omoiranirie ase ise.
english: After Moses had sent away his wife Zipporah, his father-in-law Jethro received her

ekegusii: Musa agatoma chirooti gochia koroota omochie o Yaeseri. Abaisraeli bakayorwania, bakayoira amo nebichie biaye, bagaseria Abaamori bamenyeteo.
english: After Moses had sent spies to Jazer, the Israelites captured its surrounding settlements and drove out the Amorites who were there.

ekegusii: Na nyuma y’okoamererania okonge Petero agatenena akabatebia, “Abaminto, inwe mwamanyire ng’a ase ekero giaetire Nyasae nakorete ogochora egati yaino, ng’a korwa ase omonwa one abanto b’Ebisaku baigwe ring’ana ri’enchili na koriegena.
english: After much discussion, Peter got up and addressed them: "Brothers, you know that some time ago God made a choice among you that the Gentiles might hear from my lips the message of the gospel and believe.

ekegusii: Erio Nathani akagenda bwoye. Omonene akarenta oborwaire ase omwana oria moka Uria aiborerete Daudi, na omwana oria akanyareka mono.
english: After Nathan had gone home, the LORD struck the child that Uriah's wife had borne to David, and he became ill.

ekegusii: Ekero Nuhu abeire nemiaka amagana atano (500), akaibora abana abamura, nabwo Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.
english: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Nuhu, Lameki nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano, na emerongo kianda, na etano (595), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: After Noah was born, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Na barabwo bagasoka korwa ase echela, bagasoa nyomba mwa Lidia. Aroro bakanyorana nabamwabo, bakabaremia. Erio bakaimoka, bakagenda.
english: After Paul and Silas came out of the prison, they went to Lydia's house, where they met with the brothers and encouraged them. Then they left.

ekegusii: Ekero arorire okorora koria, erio bwango tokarigia kogenda Makedonia, ekiagera twaroche ekeene ng’a Nyasae otorangeirie tobaranderie enchili.
english: After Paul had seen the vision, we got ready at once to leave for Macedonia, concluding that God had called us to preach the gospel to them.

ekegusii: Ekero akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, Abayahudi bakagenda, bakaamererania amang’ana amange barabwo ase barabwo.]
english: After Paul said this, the Jews left, arguing violently among themselves. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version.]

ekegusii: Korende mosubati o Farao akarua ase Omochie o Daudi, agatiira gochia komenya ase enyomba yaye eria Sulemani konya amoagacheire; nyuma y’ayio Sulemani akaagacha Milo.
english: After Pharaoh's daughter had come up from the City of David to the palace Solomon had built for her, he constructed the supporting terraces.

ekegusii: Ekero Raeli aiboire Yusufu, Yakobo agatebia Labani, “Ing’a ribaga ngende seito, ase ense yane.
english: After Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, "Send me on my way so I can go back to my own homeland.

ekegusii: Ekero obogambi bwa Rehoboamu bwanyorete chinguru, na ere omonyene abeire nokobua, agatiga amachiko ’Omonene, ere amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: After Rehoboam's position as king was established and he had become strong, he and all Israel with him abandoned the law of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero konya amorusirie oyo, akaimokereria Daudi igoro koba omoruoti obo. Akabatebia igoro yaye: Nanyorire Daudi, mosinto o Yese; nere omonto ongweneire ase enkoro yane, naende nere oranyare gokora ogwancha kwane gwonsi.
english: After removing Saul, he made David their king. He testified concerning him: 'I have found David son of Jesse a man after my own heart; he will do everything I want him to do.'

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo abeire omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, akaba okorwania ababisa baye bonsi abamenyete ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi: Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abaedomu, na abaruoti ba Soba, amo na Abafilisti. Akaba okobua abanto bonsi abwo arwanetie.
english: After Saul had assumed rule over Israel, he fought against their enemies on every side: Moab, the Ammonites, Edom, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines. Wherever he turned, he inflicted punishment on them.

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo airanete korwa ase okobwatia Abafilisti, agatebigwa ng’a Daudi nao are ase erooro ya Eni‐Gedi.
english: After Saul returned from pursuing the Philistines, he was told, "David is in the Desert of En Gedi."

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo akoorire kobaboka ase okobana, agatiira gochia ase ekegoro aase ebing’wanso biare koruerwa.
english: After Saul stopped prophesying, he went to the high place.

ekegusii: Gatwatebanirie ng’a motigare buya, intwe tokariina emeeri, na barabwo bakairana gochia sobo.
english: After saying good-by to each other, we went aboard the ship, and they returned home.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti arengereretie amang’ana ayio, akaroisia korwa ase etahabu emegwekano ebere ye chimori, agatebia abanto, “Igo mogochandeka mono kona kogenda Yerusalemu. Inwe Abaisraeli, rora aiga chinyasae chiaino, echi chiabarusetie ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: After seeking advice, the king made two golden calves. He said to the people, "It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem. Here are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa gwa Seti, Adamu nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato (800), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: After Seth was born, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: After she had given him a drink, she said, "I'll draw water for your camels too, until they have finished drinking."
english: Gakoorire komoa amache, akabora, “Ne chingamia chiao boigo ninchibuuchere, na chirochio chinywe.”

ekegusii: Ekero Gomeri atachire Lo‐Ruhama, akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana onde omoisia.
english: After she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, Gomer had another son.

ekegusii: After she left, she took off her veil and put on her widow's clothes again.
english: Erio akaimoka akagenda, akarusia egietubo, akabeka chianga chiaye chi’ogokobania.

ekegusii: Ekero twachia korora egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, tokagetiga ensemo y’okobee; tokagenda goika Siiria, togaika Turo; na agwo chigurube chikarusigwa ase emeeri.
english: After sighting Cyprus and passing to the south of it, we sailed on to Syria. We landed at Tyre, where our ship was to unload its cargo.

ekegusii: Na nyuma ase amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana, ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka, akaonchoka ekieni kiaye asebare.
english: After six days Jesus took Peter, James and John with him and led them up a high mountain, where they were all alone. There he was transfigured before them.

ekegusii: Na nyuma ase amatuko atano na rimo Yeso akaira Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo, akabaira igoro ase egetunwa egetambe barabwo boka.
english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’emiaka etari meke, omoruoti o irianyi nakore okobwatana nomoruoti o sugusu. Omoruoti o irianyi nasokie omoiseke oye ase omoruoti o sugusu ase ogokora okobwatana. Omokungu oyio takogenderera koba nokobua okwo araegwe, na omoruoti oria o sugusu takogenderera koba nokobua kwaye. Omokungu oria narusigweo aitwe, ere amo nabwo bamorentete, oyo omoiborete na oria omoete okobua ase engaki eria.
english: After some years, they will become allies. The daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North to make an alliance, but she will not retain her power, and he and his power will not last. In those days she will be handed over, together with her royal escort and her father and the one who supported her.

ekegusii: Ekero abeire amo nabarabwo tari kobua amatuko atano na atato gose ikomi, agatirimboka gochia Kaisaria; ne rituko ria kabere agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye gi’ekegambero, agachika Paulo arentwe.
english: After spending eight or ten days with them, he went down to Caesarea, and the next day he convened the court and ordered that Paul be brought before him.

ekegusii: Nyuma kamenyire amatuko atai make akaimoka, agaeta egati y’ense ya Galatia na Furugia, agasoa omochie ase omochie, na gokong’ia aborokigwa bonsi.
english: After spending some time in Antioch, Paul set out from there and traveled from place to place throughout the region of Galatia and Phrygia, strengthening all the disciples.

ekegusii: Nyuma kobamenyire agwo ase engaki etai nke, bakaegwa ribaga nabaminto bagende nomorembe ase baria babatomete. [
english: After spending some time there, they were sent off by the brothers with the blessing of peace to return to those who had sent them.

ekegusii: Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabora, “Bogoria eke, mwatanane inwe ase inwe;
english: After taking the cup, he gave thanks and said, "Take this and divide it among you.

ekegusii: After Terah had lived 70 years, he became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran.
english: Ekero Tera abeire nemiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70), akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani.

ekegusii: Erio eriogi riaye rikoruma, ere nigo akogukura neriogi ri’obonene, gose tari gotanga okomesa ekero eriogi riaye ri’okogukura riaigurwe.
english: After that comes the sound of his roar; he thunders with his majestic voice. When his voice resounds, he holds nothing back.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ekegori keria gionsi bagakwa bagasangererekana amo ne chisokoro chiabo, na abanto b’ekegori kiababwatetie tibamomanyete Omonene na eki akorerete Abaisraeli.
english: After that whole generation had been gathered to their fathers, another generation grew up, who knew neither the LORD nor what he had done for Israel.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire, “Nyuma y’ayio nimbeke Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, na abasomba baye, na abanto b’omochie oyo, baria bataitwe noborwaire, gose nemioro, gose nenchara, mbabeke ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, na ase amaboko ’ababisa babo. Abwo bakorigia obogima bwabo. Takobarorera amabeebe, gose kobatiga mobe moyo, gose kobarorera amabera.
english: After that, declares the LORD, I will hand over Zedekiah king of Judah, his officials and the people in this city who survive the plague, sword and famine, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to their enemies who seek their lives. He will put them to the sword; he will show them no mercy or pity or compassion.'

ekegusii: Nyuma akaorokera abaminto kobua amagana atano amo. Abange ase abwo moyo bare nonya mbono, abande bakure.
english: After that, he appeared to more than five hundred of the brothers at the same time, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.

ekegusii: Erio akabeka amache ase esani, agachaka gosibia aborokigwa baye amagoro abo, na koyatinyia negetambaa keria eboyetie.
english: After that, he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciples' feet, drying them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Abalawi bakagenda ase obokoreri bwabo ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano inse y’oborendi bwa Haroni na abamura baye. Buna Omonene konya achikire Musa igoro y’Abalawi nabo Abaisraeli babakorerete.
english: After that, the Levites came to do their work at the Tent of Meeting under the supervision of Aaron and his sons. They did with the Levites just as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio bagatirimboka korwania Abakanani abamenyete ase ense y’ebigoro, na gochia irianyi ase Negebu, na ase ense omweya.
english: After that, the men of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites living in the hill country, the Negev and the western foothills.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio abanto bakaimoka kogenda korwa ase Haseroti, bagaika ase erooro ya Parani, bagatoora aroro.
english: After that, the people left Hazeroth and encamped in the Desert of Paran.

ekegusii: Erio omokuani asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache. Ekero akoorire gokora bo achiche ase egetwori, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: After that, the priest must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water. He may then come into the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Amo nayio bakaba bakorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa bia botambe, na ebi’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ebi’Amatuko ande Amanene aatananetwe ase Omonene, amo nebing’wanso bi’ogwancha, ebio omonto arenge korua ase Omonene.
english: After that, they presented the regular burnt offerings, the New Moon sacrifices and the sacrifices for all the appointed sacred feasts of the LORD, as well as those brought as freewill offerings to the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio nyuma y’ayio intwe, abatore moyo, abatwatigaire, inatobogorigwe amo nabarabwo gochia ase amare, erio torototere Omonene igoro gati. Nabo inatobe amo n’Omonene botambe.
english: After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.

ekegusii: Omokuani arenge ekemoa ase egento keria nyuma kogiasibigwe. Kararore ng’a ekemoa keria tikeraonchoka, egento keria tigechenegeti, nonya ekemoa ekio tigiesiarereti. Egento keria gesambwe nomorero, ekiagera ekemoa keria negi’okoboosia, onye kere isiko gose ime ase egento ekio.
english: After the affected article has been washed, the priest is to examine it, and if the mildew has not changed its appearance, even though it has not spread, it is unclean. Burn it with fire, whether the mildew has affected one side or the other.

ekegusii: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they regrouped.
english: Ekero Abasiiria baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagasangererekana bonsi amo.

ekegusii: Ekero Abasiiria baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagatoma abanto korangeria Abasiiria, abarenge ng’umbu y’Eufarati, bache batang’anwe na Sofaki, omochiki bw’abarwani esegi ba Hadadeseri.
english: After the Arameans saw that they had been routed by Israel, they sent messengers and had Arameans brought from beyond the River, with Shophach the commander of Hadadezer's army leading them.

ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abakalidayo bagatiga Yerusalemu, ekero abarwani esegi ba Farao barenge nchera gocha.
english: After the Babylonian army had withdrawn from Jerusalem because of Pharaoh's army,

ekegusii: Ekero omwana oria achiire, Daudi akaoroka korwa ase etui aase ebisete, agatung’ama inse, akaumama na agekumba ara gatato. Erio Daudi na Yonathani bakanyunyuntana na korererana, korende Daudi akamenta korera mono.
english: After the boy had gone, David got up from the south side [of the stone] and bowed down before Jonathan three times, with his face to the ground. Then they kissed each other and wept together-- but David wept the most.

ekegusii: Korende ekero baria basangererekanete amo basogetigwe isiko, agasoa ime, akamobwata okoboko, na omoiseke oria akaimoka.
english: After the crowd had been put outside, he went in and took the girl by the hand, and she got up.

ekegusii: Nyuma Yehoyada gakure, abanene b’Abayuda bakagenda ase omoruoti bakoorokia amasikani asare, na omoruoti akabategerera.
english: After the death of Jehoiada, the officials of Judah came and paid homage to the king, and he listened to them.

ekegusii: Nyuma Yoshua gakure, Abaisraeli bakaboria Omonene, “Nabanto b’egesaku ki ase egati yaito barabe abe ritang’ani korwania Abakanani?”
english: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the LORD, "Who will be the first to go up and fight for us against the Canaanites?"

ekegusii: Ekero Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya akure, Omonene agakwana na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omokonyi o Musa,
english: After the death of Moses the servant of the LORD, the LORD said to Joshua son of Nun, Moses' aide:

ekegusii: Nyuma Saulo gakure, Daudi akairana korwa ase ogoita Abaameleki, akabeera agwo Sikilagi ase engaki y’amatuko abere.
english: After the death of Saul, David returned from defeating the Amalekites and stayed in Ziklag two days.

ekegusii: Na ekero omotengecho oerire, omorero ogoka, korende Omonene tarenge ime ase omorero oria, na nyuma y’ayio eriogi rike ri’obotoereru rigacha.
english: After the earthquake came a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a gentle whisper.

ekegusii: Na nyuma y’ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa gochia Babeli Yekonia akaibora Salatieli, na Salatieli akaibora Serubabeli,
english: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,

ekegusii: Ekero Epasaka yaera, ekero barenge koirana, omwana Yeso agatigara nyuma agwo Yerusalemu, na abaibori baye tibamanya.
english: After the Feast was over, while his parents were returning home, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem, but they were unaware of it.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’etoigo eria Nuhu nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atato, na emerongo etano (350).
english: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.

ekegusii: Nyuma omoruoti gasambire ebuku eria yabwate amang’ana aya Baruku arigete ekero Yeremia are koyakwana, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamotebia,
english: After the king burned the scroll containing the words that Baruch had written at Jeremiah's dictation, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti Daudi nigo amenyete ase enyomba yaye, na Omonene konya omoeire obotoereru korwa ase ababisa baye bonsi, abwo bamoetanaine.
english: After the king was settled in his palace and the LORD had given him rest from all his enemies around him,

ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo anyorete chinguru chi’oboruoti bwaye, agaita abasomba baye baria baitete omoruoti ise.
english: After the kingdom was firmly in his control, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.

ekegusii: Ekero oboruoti bwaye bwabete ne chinguru agaita abasomba baye baria baitete ise orenge omoruoti.
english: After the kingdom was firmly in his grasp, he executed the officials who had murdered his father the king.

ekegusii: Omonene gakwanire amang’ana ayio n’Ayubu, agakwana n’Elifasi Omotemani, akamotebia, “Nabeire nendamwamu asore na ase abasani bao baria babere, ekiagera inwe timokwaneti ayare ay’oboronge igoro yane buna Ayubu, omosomba one, akwanete.
english: After the LORD had said these things to Job, he said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "I am angry with you and your two friends, because you have not spoken of me what is right, as my servant Job has.

ekegusii: Nabo Omonene Yeso, gakwanire nabarabwo, akabogorigwa gochia igoro, agaikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
english: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabe oseririe abanto abwo korwa ase amasio aino, timobaisa gokwana ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Oboronge bwaito nabwo bwagera Omonene agatorenta toire ense eye. Taibo! Korende Omonene nigo araserie abanto abwo barue ase amasio aino, ase engencho y’obobe bwabo.
english: After the LORD your God has driven them out before you, do not say to yourself, "The LORD has brought me here to take possession of this land because of my righteousness." No, it is on account of the wickedness of these nations that the LORD is going to drive them out before you.

ekegusii: After the men had gone a long time without food, Paul stood up before them and said: "Men, you should have taken my advice not to sail from Crete; then you would have spared yourselves this damage and loss.
english: Bagachia koba ekero egetambe batari koria endagera, Paulo agatenena gati‐gati yabo, akabora, “Inwe abasacha, onye mwanyigwerete timorua Kirete, nanga titwanyora emechando na ogosira buna oko.

ekegusii: Nyuma barabwo kobachiire, baria babere bagasoka korwa ase engoro eria, bakaamboka orooche bwango, bakagenda ase omoruoti Daudi bakamotebia, “Imoka mwamboke orooche bwango, morue aa, naki aya na aya naro Ahitofeli arobeirie mamincha yaino.”
english: After the men had gone, the two climbed out of the well and went to inform King David. They said to him, "Set out and cross the river at once; Ahithophel has advised such and such against you."

ekegusii: Ekero abanto baria bachia korora egekone keria Yeso akorete, bakabora, “Oyo ekeene nomobani oria orenge gocha ase ense!”
english: After the people saw the miraculous sign that Jesus did, they began to say, "Surely this is the Prophet who is to come into the world."

ekegusii: Ekero Abafilisti bairete Esanduku eria ya Nyasae, bakayebogoria korwa Ebeni‐Eseri, bakayeira goika Asidodi,
english: After the Philistines had captured the ark of God, they took it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma amaakwa aria gaetire, Omonene agakwana na Musa na Eleazari, omomura o Haroni omokuani, akabatebia,
english: After the plague the LORD said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron, the priest,

ekegusii: Omokuani abeke omokungu oria ase obosio bw’Omonene, asansore etukia y’omotwe bw’omokungu oria, naende abeke okoruegwa koria gw’ekeinyorio ase amaboko ’omokungu oria. Omokuani omonyene abwate ase okoboko kwaye egetaabo kere namache amaroro, ayio akorenta okoragereria.
english: After the priest has had the woman stand before the LORD, he shall loosen her hair and place in her hands the reminder offering, the grain offering for jealousy, while he himself holds the bitter water that brings a curse.

ekegusii: Nyuma kabasomire amachiko na ebuku y’ababani, abatang’ani b’esinagogi bagatoma amang’ana asebare kobatebia, “Abaminto, onye more ne ring’ana ri’okoremia, rikwane!”
english: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue rulers sent word to them, saying, "Brothers, if you have a message of encouragement for the people, please speak."

ekegusii: Esabato egachia koera, kobogokiamoka rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, Mariamu Magidalena na oria Mariamu onde bakagenda korora oboina.
english: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.

ekegusii: Na ekero amoimogetie akamoira ase ng’ina, na omwana oria agaikaransa ase amaru a ng’ina goika mobaso gati, erio agakwa.
english: After the servant had lifted him up and carried him to his mother, the boy sat on her lap until noon, and then he died.

ekegusii: Nyuma ye chichuma echio emerongo etano nomo, na ibere, Omoakwa Amaguta oria naitwe, tari ase engencho yaye ere omonyene. Abanto b’omogambi orache mbasirie omochie oyo amo n’Obomenyo Obochenu. Omoerio oye noche buna chiooro, na goika omoerio esegi nebeo, ekiagera nigo ochikeretwe ogosirigwa korwa kare.
english: After the sixty-two 'sevens,' the Anointed One will be cut off and will have nothing. The people of the ruler who will come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. The end will come like a flood: War will continue until the end, and desolations have been decreed.

ekegusii: Ere narore okwama kw’emechando y’omoyo oye na goisaneka; ase obong’aini bwaye omosomba one omonyene oboronge nakore abanto abange babe abanyene oboronge, ekiagera nabogorie ebibe biabo.
english: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light [of life] and be satisfied; by his knowledge my righteous servant will justify many, and he will bear their iniquities.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’Abimeleki Tola, mosinto o Pua o Dodo, omonto bw’egesaku gia Isakaru, akaimoka gotooria Abaisraeli. Ere nigo amenyete Samiri, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu.
english: After the time of Abimelech a man of Issachar, Tola son of Puah, the son of Dodo, rose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir, in the hill country of Ephraim.

ekegusii: na ekero omokungu oria akoorire korera Daudi agatoma omonto komwoyia. Batiseba akaba moga Daudi, na nyuma y’ayio akamoiborera omwana omoisia. Korende amang’ana ayio Daudi akorete akagechia Omonene.
english: After the time of mourning was over, David had her brought to his house, and she became his wife and bore him a son. But the thing David had done displeased the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero bakorire okobwatana aria Beeri‐Seba, Abimeleki na Pikoli, oria omochiki omonene bw’abarwani baye, bakaimoka korwa agwo, bakairana ase ense y’Abafilisti.
english: After the treaty had been made at Beersheba, Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his forces returned to the land of the Philistines.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko abere akaimoka akagenda Galili.
english: After the two days he left for Galilee.

ekegusii: Ekero emetienyi ebere yaerete, omoiseke oria akairana ase ise, nere ise akamokora buna arierete Omonene eira ng’a akore. Omoiseke oria tabete nomosacha. Nyuma y’ayio okaba omogiro ase Abaisraeli,
english: After the two months, she returned to her father and he did to her as he had vowed. And she was a virgin. From this comes the Israelite custom

ekegusii: Bono ekero orwaki konya rwaerire koagachwa, nkabeka ebisieri, nkabeka nabarendi b’ebiita na abateri, na Abalawi.
english: After the wall had been rebuilt and I had set the doors in place, the gatekeepers and the singers and the Levites were appointed.

ekegusii: naende nkarora chiombe chinde isano na ibere, chimbe mono chindeu, chikorwa rooche, chigochitunyana korwa nyuma. Ase ense yonsi ya Misiri tinana korora chiombe chimbe buna echio.
english: After them, seven other cows came up-- scrawny and very ugly and lean. I had never seen such ugly cows in all the land of Egypt.

ekegusii: Naende akarora chiombe chinde isano na ibere, chimbe mono chindeu, chikorwa rooche, chigochitunyana korwa nyuma, chigatenena ase engegu y’orooche ang’e nase chiombe chiria chinde.
english: After them, seven other cows, ugly and gaunt, came up out of the Nile and stood beside those on the riverbank.

ekegusii: Nyuma yabo ebigara binde ebireu, ebiasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, bikaoroka.
english: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted-- thin and scorched by the east wind.

ekegusii: na ebigara ebiomo ebireu, ebiasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, bikaoroka korwa nyuma yabo,
english: After them, seven other heads sprouted-- withered and thin and scorched by the east wind.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, omoruoti Ahaswero agakinia Hamani, mosinto o Hamedata Omoagagi, akamoa obonene kobua abanene bande bonsi abarenge amo nere.
english: After these events, King Xerxes honored Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, elevating him and giving him a seat of honor higher than that of all the other nobles.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio onsi kaerire, abatang’ani bagacha asende, bagantebia, “Abaisraeli, amo n’abakuani, na Abalawi, tibeatananeti korwa ase abanto abamenyete ase chinse echio. Nigo bagokora okogechia okwo Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abayebusi, na Abaamoni, na Abamoabu, na Abamisiri, na Abaamori bagokora.
english: After these things had been done, the leaders came to me and said, "The people of Israel, including the priests and the Levites, have not kept themselves separate from the neighboring peoples with their detestable practices, like those of the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians and Amorites.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana aria kaerire ase engaki y’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, omoruoti bw’ense y’Ayemi, narengeo omonto okorokwa Ezara, mosinto o Seraya, bw’Asaria, o Hilikia,
english: After these things, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omosomba bw’Omonene, agakwa gakoorire emiaka rigana, na ikomi.
english: After these things, Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of a hundred and ten.

ekegusii: Ekero batirimbogete korwa aase aria ase ebing’wanso biare koruerwa, bakagenda mwa Samweli kerama igoro, na aroro agwo Samweli akagosoria na Saulo.
english: After they came down from the high place to the town, Samuel talked with Saul on the roof of his house.

ekegusii: Ase obwango boria basoete Samaria, Elisha akabora, “Aye Omonene, ramokia amaiso ’abanto aba, erinde banyare korora.” Omonene akaramokia amaiso abo, nabarabwo bakarora, bakenyora ng’a ngati‐gati ya Samaria baare.
english: After they entered the city, Elisha said, "LORD, open the eyes of these men so they can see." Then the LORD opened their eyes and they looked, and there they were, inside Samaria.

ekegusii: Kobabaakire amaakwa amange, bakabaruta echela ime, bagachika omorendi bw’echela abarende mono.
english: After they had been severely flogged, they were thrown into prison, and the jailer was commanded to guard them carefully.

ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi bakagenda ase emegondo y’emesabibu, bagatora amasabibu, bakayamita, bakaroisia edivai na gokora omoyega omonene. Bagasoa ase enyomba y’enyasae yabo, bakaria na bakanywa, erio bakaragereria Abimeleki.
english: After they had gone out into the fields and gathered the grapes and trodden them, they held a festival in the temple of their god. While they were eating and drinking, they cursed Abimelech.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’emetienyi kianda na amatuko emerongo ebere, ekero baetananire ense yonsi, bakairana Yerusalemu.
english: After they had gone through the entire land, they came back to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

ekegusii: Bagachia koigwa amang’ana ’omoruoti, bakagenda; na rora, eng’enang’eni eria baroche moocha ekabatang’ana, goika egatenena igoro aase omwana oria arenge.
english: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen in the east went ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.

ekegusii: Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eanga eria embariri, bakamobekera chianga chiaye omonyene, bakamoira isiko abambwe.
english: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.

ekegusii: Kobakoorire ogosaba, aase aria basangererekanete agatengechigwa, bonsi bagaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, bakagenderera gokwana ring’ana ria Nyasae noboremu.
english: After they prayed, the place where they were meeting was shaken. And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.

ekegusii: Abanene baria bakaira ebuku eria, bakayebeka ase eero eria y’Elisama omoriki, erio bakagenda ase omoruoti agwo ase egoora, bakamotebia amang’ana ayio onsi.
english: After they put the scroll in the room of Elishama the secretary, they went to the king in the courtyard and reported everything to him.

ekegusii: Bakamanora korwa Refidimu, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai, bagatoora kororia egetunwa gia Sinai.
english: After they set out from Rephidim, they entered the Desert of Sinai, and Israel camped there in the desert in front of the mountain.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda bagaika ase ense omweya y’Esikoli, na ekero baroche ense eria, bakairana bagaita Abaisraeli emioyo ase ogotagenda ase ense eria Omonene konya abaeire.
english: After they went up to the Valley of Eshcol and viewed the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land the LORD had given them.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya akagenda goika Kapernaumu, ere, na ng’ina, na abamwabo, na aborokigwa baye; bakamenya aroro amatuko amake.
english: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko aria mokaye Elisabeti akaba morito, akebisa emetienyi etano, ogoteba,
english: After this his wife Elizabeth became pregnant and for five months remained in seclusion.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya nkaigwa egento buna neriogi rinene ri’omoganda omonene igoro, rigoteba, “Haleluya! Ogotooreka, na obonene, na okobua, nebia Nyasae oito.
english: After this I heard what sounded like the roar of a great multitude in heaven shouting: "Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya nkarora Hekalu ya igoro, eyere Eema y’Oborori, ekoigorwa,
english: After this I looked and in heaven the temple, that is, the tabernacle of the Testimony, was opened.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya nkarigereria, nkarora omosangererekano omonene mono, oyo onde atarenge konyara kobara, korwa ase kera egesaku, na eamate, na abanto, na omonwa, bateneine bosio bw’ekerogo ki’obonene na ase obosio bw’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, babekeirwe chianga chindabu bare namato ’emekendo maboko abo,
english: After this I looked and there before me was a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language, standing before the throne and in front of the Lamb. They were wearing white robes and were holding palm branches in their hands.

ekegusii: Erio nyuma y’ayio nkarigereria, nkarora egesieri keigoire igoro. Na eriogi eri naigwete ritang’ani rigakwana nainche buna eriogi ri’egetureri, rikobora, “Tiira gocha aa, inche nkworokie amang’ana agwenerete gokoreka nyuma y’ayio.”
english: After this I looked, and there before me was a door standing open in heaven. And the voice I had first heard speaking to me like a trumpet said, "Come up here, and I will show you what must take place after this."

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya nkarora omomalaika onde ogoika korwa igoro. Oyo nigo arenge nokobua okonene, na ense ekamorekwa nobonene bwaye bokomeka‐meka.
english: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his splendor.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya nkarora abamalaika bane bateneine ase chinsemo inye chi’ense, bagotanga chimbeo inye chi’ense, erinde embeo tegusa igoro ase ense, nonya nigoro ase enyancha gose ase omote onde bwonsi.
english: After this I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth to prevent any wind from blowing on the land or on the sea or on any tree.

ekegusii: Rirube eri karirasomwe asemore, tiga risomwe naende ase ekanisa ya Laodikia; na riria rikorwa Laodikia risomwe asemore boigo.
english: After this letter has been read to you, see that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Omonene agachora abande emerongo etano na ebere, akabatoma babere babere bamotang’anere kogenda kera omochie na kera aase arengereretie kogenda ere omonyene.
english: After this the Lord appointed seventy-two others and sent them two by two ahead of him to every town and place where he was about to go.

ekegusii: Nairane agende ase chiburi chi’ense yaye omonyene, korende nagochwe agwe, takonyorekana naende.
english: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own country but will stumble and fall, to be seen no more.

ekegusii: Nyuma yaye oyomwabo agasoka, okoboko kwaye kobwatete egetingiro gia Esau na ere bakamoroka Yakobo. Isaka nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano nomo, ekero mokaye abaiborete.
english: After this, his brother came out, with his hand grasping Esau's heel; so he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah gave birth to them.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Yeso na aborokigwa baye bakagenda goika ense ya Boyahudi. Akabeera aroro amo nabarabwo, akabatisa.
english: After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya, akaba ngoetanana are ase emechie na ebichie, okorandia na kobatebia amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti bwa Nyasae. Na baria ikomi na babere nigo barenge amo nere,
english: After this, Jesus traveled about from one town and village to another, proclaiming the good news of the kingdom of God. The Twelve were with him,

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Yeso akaba ogotaara ase Galili; naki tarigetie gotaara ase Boyahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi nigo barenge korigia komoita.
english: After this, Jesus went around in Galilee, purposely staying away from Judea because the Jews there were waiting to take his life.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya akaimoka, akarora omobangi ebango, erieta riaye Lawi, oikaransete aase bakobangerwa ebango, akamotebia, “Ntunyana!”
english: After this, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector by the name of Levi sitting at his tax booth. "Follow me," Jesus said to him,

ekegusii: Na nyuma y’ayio Ayubu akagenderera koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, akarora abana baye, na abachokoro, na abachokororia, goika ekiaare gia kane.
english: After this, Job lived a hundred and forty years; he saw his children and their children to the fourth generation.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu agachaka gokwana, akaragereria rituko riria aiboretwe.
english: After this, Job opened his mouth and cursed the day of his birth.

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agatoma abanto gochia korangeria Yakobo ise, na eamate yaye yonsi, abanto emerongo etano na ebere na batano.
english: After this, Joseph sent for his father Jacob and his whole family, seventy-five in all.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Paulo akarua Atene, akagenda Korinto.
english: After this, Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma y’ayio, Abamoabu na Abaamoni, na abanto bande bamenyete amo n’Abaamoni bagacha korwania Yehosafati esegi.
english: After this, the Moabites and Ammonites with some of the Meunites came to make war on Jehoshaphat.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigachiera Aburamu ase okorora, rigoteba, “Aburamu, toiroka, Inche nenguba yao, na eng’eria yao nebe enene mono.”
english: After this, the word of the LORD came to Abram in a vision: "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Abalawi bakeroiseria chinyama, boigo bagachiroiseria na abakuani ab’ororeria rwa Haroni, ekiagera abakuani aba nigo barenge nemeremo emenge y’okorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa amo nebitinya bi’ebio goika botuko. Naboigo Abalawi beroiseretie chinyama, bakaroiseria nabakuani ab’ororeria rwa Haroni.
english: After this, they made preparations for themselves and for the priests, because the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were sacrificing the burnt offerings and the fat portions until nightfall. So the Levites made preparations for themselves and for the Aaronic priests.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase amatuko ayio tokebeka ang’e togatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.
english: After this, we got ready and went up to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atato kaerire abateneneri bagaeta ase ebitwori,
english: After three days the officers went throughout the camp,

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atato bakamonyora Hekalu ime, oikaransete gati ase aborokia, okobaigwa na kobaboria amaborio.
english: After three days they found him in the temple courts, sitting among the teachers, listening to them and asking them questions.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’emetienyi etato tokagenda nemeeri y’Aleksanderia, eyabegetwe kobeera aria ase egesinka ekero ki’obokendu, na ekemanyererio kiaye kiarenge Diosikuri (engencho yaye abamura chibarongo).
english: After three months we put out to sea in a ship that had wintered in the island. It was an Alexandrian ship with the figurehead of the twin gods Castor and Pollux.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko abere natokore tobe abayia. Ase rituko ria gatato natotenenie, na intwe ntogenderere koba moyo ase obosio bwaye.
english: After two days he will revive us; on the third day he will restore us, that we may live in his presence.

ekegusii: Gatwamenyire aroro amatuko atai make, omobani oyomo, erieta riaye Agabo, agatirimboka korwa Boyahudi.
english: After we had been there a number of days, a prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

ekegusii: Ekero twatananekire nabarabwo na komanora nemeeri, tokagenda boronge goika Kosi, na ase rituko ria kabere togaika Rodo, na korwa aroro togaika Patara.
english: After we had torn ourselves away from them, we put out to sea and sailed straight to Cos. The next day we went to Rhodes and from there to Patara.

ekegusii: “Komogochia koibora abana na abachokoro, naende komenya amatuko amange ase ense eyio; timokora ebibe na gwesaria ase okoroisia omogwekano onde bwensi mogosasima gose gokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino. Moise gokora ayio, rirorio nigo moramogechie abe nendamwamu asemore.
english: After you have had children and grandchildren and have lived in the land a long time-- if you then become corrupt and make any kind of idol, doing evil in the eyes of the LORD your God and provoking him to anger,

ekegusii: Ekero kwayerorire, aye nigo orasangererekane amo nabanto bao buna Haroni omino asangererekanete amo nabanto baye,
english: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was,

ekegusii: Morike mworokie omoroberio oyio bw’ogwaterana ense ase chinsemo isano na ibere, moyorente asende, na inche nimbaakere obomera ase okoboria Omonene, Nyasae oito.
english: After you have written descriptions of the seven parts of the land, bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you in the presence of the LORD our God.

ekegusii: Obekere Haroni, momura omino, amo nabamura baye, chianga echio. Erio obaake amaguta, obaatanane na kobachena, babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
english: After you put these clothes on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint and ordain them. Consecrate them so they may serve me as priests.

ekegusii: “Obogorie ritaana ri’emingichi eyio yarurwe ase ogwatanana Haroni, orisungusie ribe okoruegwa ase Omonene. Nerio naribe eriao, erigotungetie korwa ase eng’iti eyio.
english: After you take the breast of the ram for Aaron's ordination, wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your share.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Ibrahimu agatindeka Sara mokaye ase rikuruma ri’oboremo bware agwo Makipela, moocha ya Mamure, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kanani.
english: Afterward Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah near Mamre (which is at Hebron) in the land of Canaan.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bagacha ase Musa, na ere akabaa amachiko onsi aya Omonene konya amoeire ase egetunwa gia Sinai.
english: Afterward all the Israelites came near him, and he gave them all the commands the LORD had given him on Mount Sinai.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Manase akaroba orwaki rwa isiko rw’Omochie o Daudi, bosongo ya Gihoni, ase rikura gochia ase Egeita gie Chinswe, akaroetanania Ofeli, akaroagacha rokaba orotambe mono gochia igoro. Boigo akabeka abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda yagiteire chindwaki.
english: Afterward he rebuilt the outer wall of the City of David, west of the Gihon spring in the valley, as far as the entrance of the Fish Gate and encircling the hill of Ophel; he also made it much higher. He stationed military commanders in all the fortified cities in Judah.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Yeso akeorokia naende ase aborokigwa baye ase enyancha ya Tiberia. Ayio nigo akorekanete iga:
english: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Tiberias. It happened this way:

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya akaorokera abanto babere ase barabwo, ore nekieni kende ekeao, ekero barenge gotaara kogenda borabu.
english: Afterward Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking in the country.

ekegusii: Moredekai akairana geita ki’omoruoti, korende Hamani akaayerera gochia bwoye, oichanete na korera, bwetubete omotwe oye.
english: Afterward Mordecai returned to the king's gate. But Haman rushed home, with his head covered in grief,

ekegusii: Erio Musa na Haroni bakagenda ase Farao, bakamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende bankorere Rituko Rinene aaria ase erooro.”
english: Afterward Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Let my people go, so that they may hold a festival to me in the desert.'"

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Abaisraeli nabairane, barigie Omonene, Nyasae obo, na Daudi, omoruoti obo; mbamoiroke Omonene, barigie obuya bwaye ase amatuko ay’omoerio.
english: Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the LORD their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the LORD and to his blessings in the last days.

ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire buya ng’a ekero achiete korigia omwando bw’ogosesenigwa korwa nyuma, agakanigwa, naki tanyora ribaga ri’okoonchoka nonya oririgetie mono namariga.
english: Afterward, as you know, when he wanted to inherit this blessing, he was rejected. He could bring about no change of mind, though he sought the blessing with tears.

ekegusii: Korende nyuma y’ayio enkoro ya Daudi egachaka komogambia, ekiagera konya abutoire omokoba bw’eanga ya Saulo.
english: Afterward, David was conscience-stricken for having cut off a corner of his robe.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akabasomera amang’ana onsi ay’amachiko, ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa, buna arikire ase Ebuku y’Amachiko.
english: Afterward, Joshua read all the words of the law-- the blessings and the curses-- just as it is written in the Book of the Law.

ekegusii: Naende omobani oria agacha ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akamotebia, “Inchuo otimoke onyore chinguru, rengereria mono egento ogwenerete gokora, ekiagera ekero ebimeri bigochaka gosomoria, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria nagochere gokorwania.”
english: Afterward, the prophet came to the king of Israel and said, "Strengthen your position and see what must be done, because next spring the king of Aram will attack you again."

ekegusii: Abineri akamotebia eria kabere, “Gobera, tiga kombwatia. Nigo orabaise kogera ngoake nkobwateranie inse. Igo naki ndakore ng’oroke ase obosio bwa Yoabu omino?”
english: Again Abner warned Asahel, "Stop chasing me! Why should I strike you down? How could I look your brother Joab in the face?"

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu agatung’ama inse ase amasio ’abanto b’ense eria.
english: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land

ekegusii: Ong’akire amaakwa igoro ase amaakwa ande; nigo akondindokera buna omorwani esegi ore ne chinguru.
english: Again and again he bursts upon me; he rushes at me like a warrior.

ekegusii: Nabeire ngendererete gotoma abasomba baane ababani asemore kobatebia: Kera oyomo oino aonchoke, atige chinchera chiaye chimbe, na ogokora kwaye okobe, gose timobaisa korigia chinyasae ching’ao na gochikorera. Komorakore igo, mogenderere komenya ase ense eyio naete chisokoro chiaino. Korende timwategererete moigwe amang’ana aane, gose timwanyigwerete.
english: Again and again I sent all my servants the prophets to you. They said, "Each of you must turn from your wicked ways and reform your actions; do not follow other gods to serve them. Then you will live in the land I have given to you and your fathers." But you have not paid attention or listened to me.

ekegusii: “Korende nonya naboigo, inche nigo nagendererete gotoma abasomba baane ababani kobatebia: Timobaisa gokora amang’ana ’okogechia aya inche Omonene ngechete.
english: Again and again I sent my servants the prophets, who said, 'Do not do this detestable thing that I hate!'

ekegusii: Nigo babete bakomoteema naende naende, bakaba bakomogechia ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Again and again they put God to the test; they vexed the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Again and again they struck him on the head with a staff and spit on him. Falling on their knees, they paid homage to him.
english: Bakamoaka omotwe negetonto, bakamotwera amate, bakabeka amaru inse, bakamosasima.

ekegusii: Naende Daudi akamoboria, “Inee! Abanto ba Keila nigo bagochia kondua inche amo nabanto baane, erinde batobeke ase okoboko gwa Saulo?” Omonene, akamoiraneria, “Ee, nababarue.”
english: Again David asked, "Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me and my men to Saul?" And the LORD said, "They will."

ekegusii: Again he asked them, "Who is it you want?" And they said, "Jesus of Nazareth."
english: Akababoria eria kabere, “Ning’o mokorigia?” Bakabora, “Yeso Omonazareti.”

ekegusii: Agakwana eria kabere, “Ninki nkoreng’ania oboruoti bwa Nyasae?
english: Again he asked, "What shall I compare the kingdom of God to?

ekegusii: Agakana naende. Nyuma y’egeka egeke naende, baria bateneine ang’e bagatebia Petero, “Ekeene bori, naye noyomo obo ore, ekiagera nigo ore Omogalili.”
english: Again he denied it. After a little while, those standing near said to Peter, "Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean."

ekegusii: Agasaba naende, igoro ekarenta embura, na ense ekama okwama kwaye.
english: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth produced its crops.

ekegusii: Akagenderera kobora, “Ninki torabogwekanie oboruoti bwa Nyasae? Gose tobobeke ase moreng’anio ki?
english: Again he said, "What shall we say the kingdom of God is like, or what parable shall we use to describe it?

ekegusii: Agekumba naende, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.
english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.

ekegusii: Naende nkoboria nde: Inee! Abaisraeli tibamanyete? Agwo ritang’ani Musa nigo agoteba, “Nimbakore mobe ne ribero ase abanto batari egesaku, ase egesaku kere ekeriri nigo ndababeyie,”
english: Again I ask: Did Israel not understand? First, Moses says, "I will make you envious by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation that has no understanding."

ekegusii: Bono nkoboria nde, “Inee! Nigo bagochirwe goika bagure kegima?” Yaya, taibo! Korende ase ogosaria kwabo ogotooreka gwaikeire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde Abaisraeli bakorwe babe ne ribero.
english: Again I ask: Did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Not at all! Rather, because of their transgression, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel envious.

ekegusii: Nkamoboria okoboria gwa kabere, “Ninki engencho ye chinsagia echio ibere chi’emezeituni chire mbarabare ase emebirangwa eyio ebere eroiseirie etahabu, eyio amaguta agoetera?”
english: Again I asked him, "What are these two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out golden oil?"

ekegusii: Naende ngotebia nde kera omonto oyokwarokigwa, ng’a rirorio osibirwe ase ogoikerania amachiko onsi.
english: Again I declare to every man who lets himself be circumcised that he is obligated to obey the whole law.

ekegusii: Naende nkarigereria nkarora ogokora okobe kware gokorwa inse y’erioba. Nkarora abwo bagokorerwa bobe bakorera, na monto onde tarengeo okobaremia, ekiagera abwo barenge kobakorera bobe nigo barenge nokobua, na onde tarengeo okobaremia.
english: Again I looked and saw all the oppression that was taking place under the sun: I saw the tears of the oppressed-- and they have no comforter; power was on the side of their oppressors-- and they have no comforter.

ekegusii: Naende nkarora obosa kegima bore inse y’erioba:
english: Again I saw something meaningless under the sun:

ekegusii: Naende nabatebirie inwe, naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani, kobua omonto omonda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Agachaka kworokereria naende ase enyancha mbarabare, na omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera, goika ere akariina obwato, agaikaransa imeo igoro y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi nao orenge ase ense enyomo enyancha mbarabare.
english: Again Jesus began to teach by the lake. The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it out on the lake, while all the people were along the shore at the water's edge.

ekegusii: Akarangeria omoganda naende, akayotebia, “Nyigwe mwensi, naende manya:
english: Again Jesus called the crowd to him and said, "Listen to me, everyone, and understand this.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia eria kabere, “Omorembe obe asemore! Buna Tata antomete, naboigo nainche nabatomire inwe.”
english: Again Jesus said, "Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you."

ekegusii: Akamoboria eria kabere, “Simion mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete?” Akamoiraneria, “Ee, Omonene, aye nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Akamotebia, “Risia ching’ondi chiane.”
english: Again Jesus said, "Simon son of John, do you truly love me?" He answered, "Yes, Lord, you know that I love you." Jesus said, "Take care of my sheep."

ekegusii: Petero agakana naende. Erio kegima etuoni ekabuga.
english: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.

ekegusii: Naende akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora, “Bono engaki eye omosacha one nabwatane amo nainche, ekiagera namoiboreire abana abaisia batato.” Ase ayio akamoroka Lawi.
english: Again she conceived, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." So he was named Levi.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene igoro y’Abaisraeli, agasukia enkoro ya Daudi akamotebia, “Genda obare Abaisraeli na Abayuda.”
english: Again the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and he incited David against them, saying, "Go and take a census of Israel and Judah."

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene ng’a abatoorie, nere akabaa omonto kobatooria. Omonto oria nere Ehudi, mosinto o Gera, bw’egesaku kia Benjamin. Ehudi nigo arenge omonyakebee. Abaisraeli bagatoma Ehudi koirera Egiloni, omoruoti bw’ense ya Moabu, ebiegwa bi’amasikani.
english: Again the Israelites cried out to the LORD, and he gave them a deliverer-- Ehud, a left-handed man, the son of Gera the Benjamite. The Israelites sent him with tribute to Eglon king of Moab.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe naende ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Omonene akababeka ase amaboko ’Abamidiani ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere.
english: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD, and for seven years he gave them into the hands of the Midianites.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe naende ase obosio bw’Omonene; ere akabatiga, akababeka ase amaboko ’Abafilisti ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
english: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD, so the LORD delivered them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.

ekegusii: Naende Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe ase obosio bw’Omonene; bagasasima chinyasae chiria chiare korokwa Baali, na echinde chiare korokwa Asitaroti, amo ne chinyasae chi’Abasiiria na Abasidoni, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafilisti; naende bagatiga komokorera Omonene.
english: Again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD. They served the Baals and the Ashtoreths, and the gods of Aram, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the Ammonites and the gods of the Philistines. And because the Israelites forsook the LORD and no longer served him,

ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaimokia amagena naende, erinde bamoake.
english: Again the Jews picked up stones to stone him,

ekegusii: Omonene akarangeria Samweli naende; ere akaimoka akagenda ase Eli, akamotebia, “Nao inde aa. Aye nigo kwandangeria.” Korende Eli akamoiraneria, “Omwana one, tinkorangereti, genda orare.”
english: Again the LORD called, "Samuel!" And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." "My son," Eli said, "I did not call; go back and lie down."

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Ahasi naende, akamotebia,
english: Again the LORD spoke to Ahaz,

ekegusii: Naende oria ogwekaine mwanyabanto agankuna, na akambeka chinguru,
english: Again the one who looked like a man touched me and gave me strength.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: Again the word of the LORD Almighty came to me.

ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: Again the word of the LORD Almighty came to me.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: Again the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: Again the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Abaedomu bakairaneria naende, “Timori ne ribaga goeta ase ense yaito.” Bagacha nabarwani barenge ne chinguru gocha korwania Abaisraeli.
english: Again they answered: "You may not pass through." Then Edom came out against them with a large and powerful army.

ekegusii: Bakarigia eria kabere komobwata, korende akarua ase amaboko abo.
english: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.

ekegusii: Mosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo y’ebitunwa bia Samaria. Abwo barasimeke nabarie okwama okwo.
english: Again you will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria; the farmers will plant them and enjoy their fruit.

ekegusii: Naende agantebia, “Norore okogechia okonene kobua okwo barabwo bagokora.”
english: Again, he said, "You will see them doing things that are even more detestable."

ekegusii: Naende onye egetureri gekobugigwa na gosokia egeturi getamanyekaneti, ning’o orabe ang’e ase esegi?
english: Again, if the trumpet does not sound a clear call, who will get ready for battle?

ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteba, “Abanto b’Ebisaku, goka amo nabanto b’Omonene”;
english: Again, it says, "Rejoice, O Gentiles, with his people."

ekegusii: Naende oimokie inke igo korwa ase eyio, oyerute ase omorero oyesambe, na korwa ase eyio omorero norueo bwesiarere gochia ase Abaisraeli bonsi.”
english: Again, take a few of these and throw them into the fire and burn them up. A fire will spread from there to the whole house of Israel.

ekegusii: Naende Saitani akamoira ase ekegoro egetambe mono, akamworokia amaruoti onsi ay’ense, na obonene bwabo,
english: Again, the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their splendor.

ekegusii: Ekeegwa keria ki’amabera tikeri buna ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo, ekiagera ekina keria nigo giachete ase enchera y’ogosaria okomo, gekarenta okogambigwa, korende ekeegwa keria ki’amabera kegacha ase engencho y’ogosaria okonge, gekarenta oboronge.
english: Again, the gift of God is not like the result of the one man's sin: The judgment followed one sin and brought condemnation, but the gift followed many trespasses and brought justification.

ekegusii: Ere akeegena ase ogosemeria ase ayatanyare gosemerigwa, erinde abe ise bw’ebisaku ebinge, buna atebetigwe, “Naboigo oroiboro rwao rorabe.”
english: Against all hope, Abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as it had been said to him, "So shall your offspring be."

ekegusii: barwane na Kedorilaoma, omoruoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omoruoti o Goimu, na Amurafeli, omoruoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omoruoti o Eliesari. Abaruoti abwo bane bakarwania baria batano.
english: against Kedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar and Arioch king of Ellasar-- four kings against five.

ekegusii: Naende akaagacha chinyomba chinde inse, chinyasi chiaye chichomeranirie ne chinyasi chi’enyomba enyene ase amakere na nyuma, akanachana ebinyomba imeo.
english: Against the walls of the main hall and inner sanctuary he built a structure around the building, in which there were side rooms.

ekegusii: Nagokoreire ebibe aye omonyene bweka, nakorire amabe ase amaiso ao. Aye omanyekane ng’a mboronge ore ekero ogokwana, na mboronge ore ekero okonacha ekina.
english: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight, so that you are proved right when you speak and justified when you judge.

ekegusii: Agripa agatebia Festo, “Omonto oyo nanga nasiborwa onye atarigia ekina kiaye keirwe ase Kaisari.”
english: Agrippa said to Festus, "This man could have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar."

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino inwe egesaku kere nebibe ebinge, inwe abanto moritoeire nobobe, inwe oroiboro rw’abasaria, abanto abakorekanu, mogokora ogosaria. Mwangire Omonene, mwachayire Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, mwairanire nyuma na mwamotigire kegima.
english: Ah, sinful nation, a people loaded with guilt, a brood of evildoers, children given to corruption! They have forsaken the LORD; they have spurned the Holy One of Israel and turned their backs on him.

ekegusii: Ahabu akaroisia omote bw’Asera, enyasae enkungu; agakora bobe mono goetania abaruoti bonsi baria bamotang’anerete, akagechia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, goika akaba nendamwamu.
english: Ahab also made an Asherah pole and did more to provoke the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger than did all the kings of Israel before him.

ekegusii: Ahabu agatebia Obadia, “Togende toete ase ense yonsi na ase chinsoko chi’amache, na ase amagooko onsi; ande nabo torabaise konyora obonyansi, erinde totoorie chibarasi ne chiyombo chibe moyo, na titobaisa gosiria chitugo chinde.”
english: Ahab had said to Obadiah, "Go through the land to all the springs and valleys. Maybe we can find some grass to keep the horses and mules alive so we will not have to kill any of our animals."

ekegusii: Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, agakwana na Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akamoboria, “Nogende amo nainche korwania Ramoti o Gileadi?” Yehosafati akamoiraneria, “Inche nigo inde buna aye, na abanto baane nigo bare buna abanto bao. Intwe ntobe amo naye ase okorwana esegi.”
english: Ahab king of Israel asked Jehoshaphat king of Judah, "Will you go with me against Ramoth Gilead?" Jehoshaphat replied, "I am as you are, and my people as your people; we will join you in the war."

ekegusii: Ahabu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, na Ahasia, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Ahab rested with his fathers. And Ahaziah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ahabu agatebia Elija, “Inee! Aye omobisa one, nkwanyorire.” Elija akairaneria, “Ee, nakonyorire, ekiagera aye kweoonirie aye omonyene gokora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Ahab said to Elijah, "So you have found me, my enemy!" "I have found you," he answered, "because you have sold yourself to do evil in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ahabu agatebia Naboti, “Ing’a omogondo oyo oo bw’emesabibu, erinde nsimeke chinyeni, ekiagera nigo ore ang’e na mwane, nainche ninkoe omogondo onde omuya mono ribaga riaye, gose onye gokorora ng’a mbuya, ninkoe chibesa.”
english: Ahab said to Naboth, "Let me have your vineyard to use for a vegetable garden, since it is close to my palace. In exchange I will give you a better vineyard or, if you prefer, I will pay you whatever it is worth."

ekegusii: Ahabu, mosinto bw’Omuri, agakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene goetania bonsi abamotang’anerete.
english: Ahab son of Omri did more evil in the eyes of the LORD than any of those before him.

ekegusii: Ahasi agasangereria ebikorero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae, akabinachana ebing’ese, erio agasieka ebisieri bi’enyomba y’Omonene, akayeroiseria ebisasimero aase ande onsi agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Ahaz gathered together the furnishings from the temple of God and took them away. He shut the doors of the LORD's temple and set up altars at every street corner in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Yotamu akaibora Ahasi, na Ahasi akaibora Hezekia, na Hezekia akaibora Manase;
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

ekegusii: Ahasi akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, na abanto bakamotindeka ase omochie o Yerusalemu; tibamobegete ase chimbeera ase abaruoti b’Abaisraeli baare gotindekwa. Hezekia, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of Jerusalem, but he was not placed in the tombs of the kings of Israel. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ahasi akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa aase chiatindegetwe, ase Omochie o Daudi; na Hezekia, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Ahaz rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David. And Hezekiah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ahasi agatoma abanto ase Tigilati‐Pileseri, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, agateba, “Inche nomosomba oo, naende omwana oo. Inchuo ontoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, na okw’omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, aba bachire kondwania.”
english: Ahaz sent messengers to say to Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria, "I am your servant and vassal. Come up and save me out of the hand of the king of Aram and of the king of Israel, who are attacking me."

ekegusii: Ahasi akaurereria enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’omoruoti, na ey’abanene barenge nere, akaa omoruoti bw’Abaasuri ebango, korende ayio tamokonyete.
english: Ahaz took some of the things from the temple of the LORD and from the royal palace and from the princes and presented them to the king of Assyria, but that did not help him.

ekegusii: Ahaz was the father of Jadah, Jadah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
english: Ahasi akaibora Yara, na Yara akaibora Alemeti na Asimaweti, na Simuri; nere Simuri akaibora Moza.

ekegusii: Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah, Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth and Zimri, and Zimri was the father of Moza.
english: Ahasi akaibora Yehoada, na Yehoada akaibora Alemeti na Asimaweti, na Simuri, na Simuri akaibora Moza.

ekegusii: Ahasi nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka etano nomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ere takorete ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Daudi sokoro yaye akorete,
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD his God.

ekegusii: Ahasi nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ikomi na etano nomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Takorete ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene buna Daudi, sokoro yaye, akorete.
english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. Unlike David his father, he did not do what was right in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ahasia, mosinto bw’Ahabu, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli agwo Samaria ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kwa Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda; ere akagambera Abaisraeli emiaka ebere.
english: Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.

ekegusii: Ahasia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba omwaka oyomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Atalia; ere nigo arenge omochokoro bw’Omuri, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother's name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of Omri king of Israel.

ekegusii: Ahasia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba omwaka oyomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Atalia, omochokoro bw’Omuri.
english: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem one year. His mother's name was Athaliah, a granddaughter of Omri.

ekegusii: Ahasia akagenda amo na Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, korwania Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, agwo Ramoti o Gileadi. Abasiiria bagaaka Yoramu chingoma.
english: Ahaziah went with Joram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram;

ekegusii: Ahi son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, was head of their family.
english: Ahi, mosinto bw’Abidieli, o Guni, nere orenge omoteneneri bwe chiamate chiabo.

ekegusii: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
english: Ahiya, na Hanani, na Anani;

ekegusii: Ahiamu, mosinto o Sakari korwa Harari, na Elifali, mosinto o Uri;
english: Ahiam son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal son of Ur,

ekegusii: Ahieseri orenge omonene obo, naende Yoashi; aba babere mbasinto ba Semaa korwa Gibea; Yesieli na Peleti basinto b’Asimaweti; Beraka na Yehu korwa Anatoti;
english: Ahiezer their chief and Joash the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah, Jehu the Anathothite,

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Ahihudi, mosinto o Selomi;
english: Ahihud son of Shelomi, the leader from the tribe of Asher;

ekegusii: Ahimasi agatenenera orogongo rwa Nafutali (nere onyuomete Basemati, omoiseke o Sulemani);
english: Ahimaaz-- in Naphtali (he had married Basemath daughter of Solomon);

ekegusii: Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki, agatebia Yoabu eria kabere. “Ande onsi arabe, koranche ong’e ribaga iminyoke korwa nyuma y’Omoetiopia oria ng’irere omoruoti amang’ana.” Yoabu akamoboria, “Omwana one, gokominyoka, ninki orachie konyora? Ayio tari amang’ana amaya airwa.”
english: Ahimaaz son of Zadok again said to Joab, "Come what may, please let me run behind the Cushite." But Joab replied, "My son, why do you want to go? You don't have any news that will bring you a reward."

ekegusii: Ahimaaz the father of Azariah, Azariah the father of Johanan,
english: Ahimasi akaibora Asaria, na Asaria akaibora Yohanani;

ekegusii: Ahimeleki akairaneria omoruoti, “Ning’o ase abasomba bao ore omwegenwa buna Daudi? Naende aye omoruoti igo ore ise biara. Daudi boigo nomoteneneri bw’abarendi bao. Nigo asikire mono ase enyomba yao.
english: Ahimelech answered the king, "Who of all your servants is as loyal as David, the king's son-in-law, captain of your bodyguard and highly respected in your household?

ekegusii: Ahimeleki akamoboreria ase Omonene, akamoa endagera airane ase orogendo rwaye; boigo akamoa na omoyio oria o Goliato Omofilisti.”
english: Ahimelech inquired of the LORD for him; he also gave him provisions and the sword of Goliath the Philistine."

ekegusii: Ahinadab son of Iddo-- in Mahanaim;
english: Ahinadabu, mosinto o Ido, agatenenera orogongo rwa Mahanaimu;

ekegusii: Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,
english: Ahiyo na Sasaki, na Yeremoti,

ekegusii: Ahisari, nere otenenerete enyomba y’obogambi; Adoniramu, mosinto o Abuda, nere otenenerete emeremo yagwenerete gokorwa.
english: Ahishar-- in charge of the palace; Adoniram son of Abda-- in charge of forced labor.

ekegusii: Ahitofeli akairaneria Abisalomu, “Soa nyomba, momenyane nabakungu ba sere‐sere abwo iso atiga bakorenda enyomba. Igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakoigwa ng’a kwagechigwe na iso, na abwo bonsi bagokobwatia nigo barabekwe chinguru.”
english: Ahithophel answered, "Lie with your father's concubines whom he left to take care of the palace. Then all Israel will hear that you have made yourself a stench in your father's nostrils, and the hands of everyone with you will be strengthened."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Ahitofeli agatebia Abisalomu, “Tiga nchore abanto chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000), erinde mbwatie Daudi ase obotuko obo.
english: Ahithophel said to Absalom, "I would choose twelve thousand men and set out tonight in pursuit of David.

ekegusii: Yehoyada, mosinto o Benaya, na Abiatari bakabekwa ase ribaga ri’Ahitofeli gakure. Yoabu nere orenge omochiki bw’abarwani esegi b’omoruoti.
english: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah and by Abiathar. Joab was the commander of the royal army.

ekegusii: Ahitofeli nere orenge omosemia bw’omoruoti, na Husai Omoariki nomosani bw’omoruoti orenge.
english: Ahithophel was the king's counselor. Hushai the Arkite was the king's friend.

ekegusii: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Ahimaaz,
english: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Ahimasi;

ekegusii: Ahitub the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Shallum,
english: Ahitubu akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Salumu;

ekegusii: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands-- four towns.
english: na Ayaloni, na Gati‐Rimoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

ekegusii: Aijalon and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
english: Ayaloni na Gati‐Rimoni, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

ekegusii: na Aini, na Yuta, na Beti‐Semesi, emechie kianda, amo namarisio arengeo, korwa ase ebisaku ebio bibere.
english: Ain, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands-- nine towns from these two tribes.

ekegusii: Naende yarenge Aini, na Rimoni, na Eteri, na Asani, emechie ene, amo nebichie biabo.
english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether and Ashan-- four towns and their villages--

ekegusii: Erio Yehosafati akaba nobwoba, akarigia Omonene; akararia ng’a Abayuda bonsi beng’ate.
english: Alarmed, Jehoshaphat resolved to inquire of the LORD, and he proclaimed a fast for all Judah.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire ang’e, rirarente ogosirigwa korwa ase Omonguru.
english: Alas for that day! For the day of the LORD is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwane! Ninki kiagerete baba akanyibora? Nigo inde omonto okwomanigwa, nigo nkoamereranigwa ase ense eye yonsi. Tinana koa omonto onde egento singo, gose koegwa singo nonde, erinde inyore ebitoki, korende kera omonto nigo akondagereria.
english: Alas, my mother, that you gave me birth, a man with whom the whole land strives and contends! I have neither lent nor borrowed, yet everyone curses me.

ekegusii: Aleksanderi, omoturi bwe chitaai, agankorera amabe amange. Omonene namoakane koreng’ana nogokora kwaye.
english: Alexander the metalworker did me a great deal of harm. The Lord will repay him for what he has done.

ekegusii: Abamenyi mbabe bakobariseria amaicho aino, na abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao mbabe bakobaremera emegondo yaino na kobarendera emesabibu yaino.
english: Aliens will shepherd your flocks; foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.

ekegusii: Chinchera chionsi chi’omonto nigo chikororekana asare omonyene ng’a neching’ikeranu, korende Omonene nigo akorenga omoika o mwanyabanto.
english: All a man's ways seem innocent to him, but motives are weighed by the LORD.

ekegusii: Kera enchera y’omonto nigo ekororekana ng’a neya boronge asare, korende Omonene nigo akorenga chinkoro.
english: All a man's ways seem right to him, but the LORD weighs the heart.

ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo omomura oria agatunyana omokungu oria buna eng’ombe ekoirwa konyenywa, gose buna omosibwa obwatirwe ogochia kobekwa chingataare.
english: All at once he followed her like an ox going to the slaughter, like a deer stepping into a noose

ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera bori, tori na kemoa kende!
english: All beautiful you are, my darling; there is no flaw in you.

ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo achete ase engencho y’obonyaka obonge bw’omochie oyo. Oyio orenge omotayayi omonyakieni bwenaretie oborogi; nigo asiretie abanto b’ebisaku nobonyaka bwaye, ne chiamate chinyinge noborogi bwaye.
english: all because of the wanton lust of a harlot, alluring, the mistress of sorceries, who enslaved nations by her prostitution and peoples by her witchcraft.

ekegusii: Naki ense nigo ekwama enyene, ritang’ani rinyansi, naende ekegara, erio enyeke ase ekegara.
english: All by itself the soil produces grain-- first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.

ekegusii: Omonto omong’iti nigo akweganeria kera egento botambe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo akorua na tari kong’itia.
english: All day long he craves for more, but the righteous give without sparing.

ekegusii: Omobaso boira nabeire nkonyora amaakwa, na kera emambia nabeire nkonyora egesusuro gi’okondongeyia.
english: All day long I have been plagued; I have been punished every morning.

ekegusii: Omobaso boira nigo nabeire ndamborete amaboko aane korangeria abanto abasaria batari koigwera, abwo bakobwatia enchera etari engiya ey’emeroberio yabo abanyene.
english: All day long I have held out my hands to an obstinate people, who walk in ways not good, pursuing their own imaginations--

ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bagonchecheria omobaso boira; abwo bangechete, kobakoragereria nigo bagwatora erieta riane.
english: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.
