ekegusii: Esegi eria ekaba entindi mono ase rituko riria, na omoruoti agatenena ase egari yaye, origereretie Abasiiria, goika mogoroba; erio ekero erioba riabeire ang’e kogwa agakwa.
english: All day long the battle raged, and the king of Israel propped himself up in his chariot facing the Arameans until evening. Then at sunset he died.

ekegusii: Esegi eria ekaba entindi mono ase rituko riria, na omoruoti agatenenigwa na gosiirwa ase egari yaye, origereretie Abasiiria. Rigachia koba mogoroba agakwa, na amanyinga akarua ase orogoma ase abetetwe agaiteka gochia nyaro y’egari.
english: All day long the battle raged, and the king was propped up in his chariot facing the Arameans. The blood from his wound ran onto the floor of the chariot, and that evening he died.

ekegusii: Nigo ang’etanaine buna amache omobaso boira; abwatanire amo, na amigire inche.
english: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.

ekegusii: Omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakoonchorana amang’ana aane; ebirengererio biabo bionsi nigo bire ebibe igoro yane.
english: All day long they twist my words; they are always plotting to harm me.

ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera rirondia bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi ikomi na rimo abe ay’ekerengo ekemo.
english: All eleven curtains are to be the same size-- thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera rirondia nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Amarondia onsi aya ikomi na rimo nigo arenge ay’ekerengo ekemo.
english: All eleven curtains were the same size-- thirty cubits long and four cubits wide.

ekegusii: Chinyama chionsi tichiri echimo; korende echinde nechia mwanyabanto, echinde nechie ching’iti, echinde nechie chinyoni, na echinde nechie chinswe.
english: All flesh is not the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another and fish another.

ekegusii: all flocks and herds, and the beasts of the field,
english: ching’ondi chionsi ne chiombe, amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana,

ekegusii: “Ebisaku bionsi bi’ebitongwa ebisinini bikoiruruka ne chimbaba tibichenegeti asemore, timobiria.
english: All flying insects that swarm are unclean to you; do not eat them.

ekegusii: Omoiseke bw’omoruoti nigo are ime ase eero yaye ore nobonene, obegete eganchwa yaye eroiseirie etahabu.
english: All glorious is the princess within [her chamber]; her gown is interwoven with gold.

ekegusii: Mwanyabanto nigo bakogenda aase ching’iti chikogenda; mwanyabanto nigo baruete ase amaroba, ne ching’iti naboigo; nigo bakoirana ase amaroba, naboigo na chirochio.
english: All go to the same place; all come from dust, and to dust all return.

ekegusii: Ebitoki nigo bikonyorekana korwa ase emeremo ende yonsi, korende ogokwana amang’ana amasa, okwo nigo gokorenta okoremerwa.
english: All hard work brings a profit, but mere talk leads only to poverty.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi basirire enchera, bonsi amo bagundire; onde tari ogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.
english: All have turned aside, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

ekegusii: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one."
english: Bonsi bachiire bogeka, bonsi babeire bosa; onde tari oyogokora amaya, nonya noyomo.

ekegusii: Emegwekano yaye yonsi egosasimwa nesamunyoranwe; ebiegwa bionsi biaruetwe ase obonyaka mbisambwe nomorero. Ninsirie emegwekano yaye yonsi egosasimwa, ekiagera ebinto ebio nebiegwa biaruetwe ase obonyaka, ebio mbiiranigwe bibe ebiegwa bi’obonyaka.”
english: All her idols will be broken to pieces; all her temple gifts will be burned with fire; I will destroy all her images. Since she gathered her gifts from the wages of prostitutes, as the wages of prostitutes they will again be used."

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’omochie nigo baumatete, ekero barigereretie endagera; barabwo baoonirie chinibo chiabo bagore endagera barie, erinde banyore chinguru. “Aye Omonene, koranche ondigererie, ekiagera nachayirwe.”
english: All her people groan as they search for bread; they barter their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. "Look, O LORD, and consider, for I am despised."

ekegusii: Erio abamura bamwabo Ayubu, na abasubati bamwabo, na abasani baye bonsi abamomanyete agwo ritang’ani, bagacha asare, bakaragera amo nere nyomba mwaye. Bakamororera amabeebe na komoremia ase engencho y’amabe aria onsi Omonene amorerenterete, na kera oyomo akamoa chibesa na ebonyi eroisirie korwa ase etahabu.
english: All his brothers and sisters and everyone who had known him before came and ate with him in his house. They comforted and consoled him over all the trouble the LORD had brought upon him, and each one gave him a piece of silver and a gold ring.

ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi nigo abeire okoria endagera ore ase omosunte, obeire ogwechanda ore nobororo na okogechigwa.
english: All his days he eats in darkness, with great frustration, affliction and anger.

ekegusii: Nigo akoba nobokong’u ase amatuko aye onsi are moyo, na emeremo yaye emekong’u nigo ere ey’omoichano; nonya nase obotuko obogima ebirengererio biaye tibiri gotimoka. Ayio boigo mbosa.
english: All his days his work is pain and grief; even at night his mind does not rest. This too is meaningless.

ekegusii: “Omokori amabe nigo akogenderera gochandeka nobororo ase amatuko aye onsi, na omochandi boigo ase emiaka ere achikeretwe.
english: All his days the wicked man suffers torment, the ruthless through all the years stored up for him.

ekegusii: Abarwani baye b’esegi abaratame mbaitwe nemioro, na abatigari mbasiarerwe gochia ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense. Erio nario moramanye ng’a ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: All his fleeing troops will fall by the sword, and the survivors will be scattered to the winds. Then you will know that I the LORD have spoken.

ekegusii: Nabeire nkorenda amachiko aye onsi, na timbeti ngotiga emeroberio yaye echikire.
english: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.

ekegusii: Abasomba baye bonsi bagaetera ensemo, bakamoetania, amo n’Abakereti bonsi, na Abapeleti bonsi, na Abagiti amagana atano na rimo, abwo bamobwatetie korwa Gati; bonsi bagaetania omoruoti.
english: All his men marched past him, along with all the Kerethites and Pelethites; and all the six hundred Gittites who had accompanied him from Gath marched before the king.

ekegusii: Abana baye, abamura na abaiseke bonsi, bakaimoka gochia komoremia, korende akaanga, taremigwa, agateba, “Yaya, goika inkwe, ngende inse ase oboina nkona‐komoreera omwana one.” Ise akaba okona‐kweumia.
english: All his sons and daughters came to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. "No," he said, "in mourning will I go down to the grave to my son." So his father wept for him.

ekegusii: Na bonsi abare abaane nabao, na abare abao nabaane, na inche nabakirwe ime yabo.
english: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abamenyete ase ense mbayesasime, otatiga abwo amarieta abo arikire ase ebuku y’obogima y’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, oyoitetwe korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe.
english: All inhabitants of the earth will worship the beast-- all whose names have not been written in the book of life belonging to the Lamb that was slain from the creation of the world.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangerereka ase Daudi agwo Heburoni bakamotebia, “Naama! Intwe nigo tore abamo naye, aba amanyinga ayamo, na omobere oyomo.
english: All Israel came together to David at Hebron and said, "We are your own flesh and blood.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi basaririe amachiko ao, baonchokire tibari koigwera eriogi riao. Ase ayio okoragererigwa okwo gwatianete koumora igoro yaito, okwo korikire ase amachiko a Musa, omosomba oo, aye Nyasae, gwatocheire, ekiagera intwe twakorire ebibe asore.
english: All Israel has transgressed your law and turned away, refusing to obey you. "Therefore the curses and sworn judgments written in the Law of Moses, the servant of God, have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against you.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi nigo babaretwe na korikwa koreng’ana ne chinderia chiabo, na amang’ana abo nigo anyorekanete ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli. Abayuda nigo boosetwe bakairwa Babeli, ekiagera tibarenge abegenwa.
english: All Israel was listed in the genealogies recorded in the book of the kings of Israel. The people of Judah were taken captive to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi mbamoreere na komotindeka. Omwana oria bweka ase eamate ya Yeroboamu, nere oratindekwe ase embeera ime, ekiagera asere oyio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ororire egento kiamogokirie korwa ase enyomba ya Yeroboamu.
english: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. He is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will be buried, because he is the only one in the house of Jeroboam in whom the LORD, the God of Israel, has found anything good.

ekegusii: Omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli amo nabagaaka babo, na abatang’ani, na abagambi ebina, amo nabamenyi bonsi, abamenyete ase egati yabo, bagatenena ase chinsemo ibere chi’Esanduku y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, barigereretie abakuani Abalawi abayebogoretie. Ekeng’ese ki’abanto bakarigereria egetunwa kia Gerisimu, na ekeng’ese kende egetunwa ki’Ebali. Musa omosomba bw’Omonene, konya ochikire kare ng’a Abaisraeli banyore ogosesenigwa ritang’ani.
english: All Israel, aliens and citizens alike, with their elders, officials and judges, were standing on both sides of the ark of the covenant of the LORD, facing those who carried it-- the priests, who were Levites. Half of the people stood in front of Mount Gerizim and half of them in front of Mount Ebal, as Moses the servant of the LORD had formerly commanded when he gave instructions to bless the people of Israel.

ekegusii: Ebitinya biaye bionsi birusigwe na koruegwa; omokera na ebitinya bitubetechinyama chi’enda,
english: All its fat shall be offered: the fat tail and the fat that covers the inner parts,

ekegusii: Erio Abayuda bonsi bakarenta ase chikungo ensemo ya ikomi y’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni.
english: All Judah brought the tithes of grain, new wine and oil into the storerooms.

ekegusii: Abayuda bonsi bakaba nomochengo ase emuma eria bariete, ekiagera nigo batiananetie ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi, na bakarigia Omonene ase okogania kwabo gwonsi. Omonene akanyorekana asebare, na akabaa obotoereru ase chinsemo chiabo chionsi.
english: All Judah rejoiced about the oath because they had sworn it wholeheartedly. They sought God eagerly, and he was found by them. So the LORD gave them rest on every side.

ekegusii: Amaicho onsi e chitugo korwa ense ya Kedari nasangererigwe arentwe asore, chimingichi chia Nebayoti nchigokorere; nchichiche ase egesasimero kiane chiruegwe, nainche nchianchere, na igo ninkore enyomba yane y’obonene ebe nobonene goetania.”
english: All Kedar's flocks will be gathered to you, the rams of Nebaioth will serve you; they will be accepted as offerings on my altar, and I will adorn my glorious temple.

ekegusii: Naki kera egesaku gie ching’iti, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chigwekurura, na ebitongwa ebire amache ime, nigo bitugire, na birobio nigo biatugire na mwanyabanto.
english: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles and creatures of the sea are being tamed and have been tamed by man,

ekegusii: Ebikombe bionsi bi’okonywera bi’omoruoti Sulemani nigo biarenge ebie chitahabu, na ebikorero bionsi bi’enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni nigo biarenge bie chitahabu chichenire. Ase amatuko a Sulemani chifeta tichiabarire ng’a negento kie rigori rinene.
english: All King Solomon's goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon's day.

ekegusii: Ebikombe bionsi bi’okonywera bi’omoruoti Sulemani nigo biarenge ebie chitahabu, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni nigo biarenge bie chitahabu chichenire; binde tibiarenge bie chifeta. Ase amatuko a Sulemani efeta tiyabarire ng’a negento kie rigori.
english: All King Solomon's goblets were gold, and all the household articles in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon were pure gold. Nothing was made of silver, because silver was considered of little value in Solomon's days.

ekegusii: Abaruoti bonsi mbatung’ame ase obosio bwaye bamosike, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbamokorere.
english: All kings will bow down to him and all nations will serve him.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bayerorire, ee, mwanyabanto mbayerigereretie korwa aare.
english: All mankind has seen it; men gaze on it from afar.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi mbairoke, babe bakoraria emeremo ya Nyasae na komanya mono ayakorire.
english: All mankind will fear; they will proclaim the works of God and ponder what he has done.

ekegusii: mwanyabanto bonsi pi goika bakwe, bairane ase amaroba.
english: all mankind would perish together and man would return to the dust.

ekegusii: Emeremo yonsi omonto akwerosia gokora nokonyora egento akoria, korende nonya naboigo tari koigota.
english: All man's efforts are for his mouth, yet his appetite is never satisfied.

ekegusii: na inwe namogechwe nabanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane, korende oyoraremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.
english: All men will hate you because of me, but he who stands firm to the end will be saved.

ekegusii: Nainwe namogechwe nabanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane, korende oyoraremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.
english: All men will hate you because of me, but he who stands firm to the end will be saved.

ekegusii: Inamogechwe nabanto bonsi ase engencho y’erieta riane.
english: All men will hate you because of me.

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bangechete nigo bakomonyererana igoro yane, nigo bakorire omoroberio bw’ogonkora bobe.
english: All my enemies whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me, saying,

ekegusii: Ababisa baane bonsi mbarore obosooku, bagoswe na koondokigwa mono, mbairane gochia nyuma bwango bare nobosooku.
english: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.

ekegusii: Abaamate ba tata bonsi pi nigo barenge asore buna abagwenerete gokwa, korende okambeka inche, omosomba oo, ase egati y’abwo bakoragera mwao. Bono aye omoruoti, mboronge ki kobua ayio ngokoboria na korera asore?”
english: All my grandfather's descendants deserved nothing but death from my lord the king, but you gave your servant a place among those who sat at your table. So what right do I have to make any more appeals to the king?"

ekegusii: All my intimate friends detest me; those I love have turned against me.
english: Abasani abagisangio banyinyerire na kogechigwa nainche; nabwo nanchete bang’onchokeire na gonkora bobe.

ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo omanyete okogania kwane gwonsi, na ogochandeka kwane tikobisekaneti asore.
english: All my longings lie open before you, O Lord; my sighing is not hidden from you.

ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nabimokorere, naende bikorere omwana oye omomura, na omochokoro oye omomura, nabigenderere gokora boigo goika ekero engaki y’okogwa gw’ense yaye eraike; nyuma y’ayio ense yaye nebe ensomba ekorere ebisaku ebinge na abaruoti abanene bare ne chinguru.
english: All nations will serve him and his son and his grandson until the time for his land comes; then many nations and great kings will subjugate him.

ekegusii: Botuko ekero naraire borere bwane, nkamorigia oria omoyo one bwanchete, nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.
english: All night long on my bed I looked for the one my heart loves; I looked for him but did not find him.

ekegusii: na orogongo rwonsi rwa Nafutali, na orwa Efraimu, na orwa Manase, na orwa Yuda rwonsi goika Enyancha Enene ya bosongo,
english: all of Naphtali, the territory of Ephraim and Manasseh, all the land of Judah as far as the western sea,

ekegusii: “Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bagwoka buna omorero o riko, bagosiria abagambi babo b’ebina. Abaruoti babo bonsi bagure, na onde tari ase abwo okondangeria imokonye.
english: All of them are hot as an oven; they devour their rulers. All their kings fall, and none of them calls on me.

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo beboeranetie emeyio ya birende, na nigo bare abanto bamanyete korwana esegi. Kera oyomo nigo eboeranetie omoyio kenema, orendete ase okogoswa kwa botuko.
english: all of them wearing the sword, all experienced in battle, each with his sword at his side, prepared for the terrors of the night.

ekegusii: Bonsi bagaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, bagachaka gokwana ase emenwa emeao, buna Omoika obaete gwatora.
english: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them.

ekegusii: Ababwarete ase chiamate chi’Abasuhamu nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na inye, na amagana ane (64,400).
english: All of them were Shuhamite clans; and those numbered were 64,400.

ekegusii: Naboigo naintwe twensi twagendete agwo kare ase okogania gwe chingencho chiaito chimbe, togaikerania okogania kw’emebere yaito, na ebirengererio biaito, tokaba ase chingencho chiaito abanto abaragwe ase endamwamu ya Nyasae buna abwo bande.
english: All of us also lived among them at one time, gratifying the cravings of our sinful nature and following its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature objects of wrath.

ekegusii: Intwe twensi twabeire buna abatachenegeti; oboronge bwaito bwonsi nigo bore buna eanga ere ne riko. Nigo togosusana buna rito, na ebibe biaito nigo bigotoira aare buna omwaga okoira amato amomo.
english: All of us have become like one who is unclean, and all our righteous acts are like filthy rags; we all shrivel up like a leaf, and like the wind our sins sweep us away.

ekegusii: Gaki intwe abatore abaikeranu torengererie ayio. Komorabe mokorengereria ayande, ase ing’ana rinde rionsi, Nyasae nabamaanorere ayio naro.
english: All of us who are mature should take such a view of things. And if on some point you think differently, that too God will make clear to you.

ekegusii: “Rituko ria rero inwe mwensi igo moteneine aiga ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino; inwe abatang’ani b’ebisaku, na abagaaka, na abateneneri, inwe kera oyomo bw’Abaisraeli,
english: All of you are standing today in the presence of the LORD your God-- your leaders and chief men, your elders and officials, and all the other men of Israel,

ekegusii: Obogima bwaito bwonsi nigo bokoera bwango inse y’ekeririanda kiao, nigo togokoora emiaka yaito buna ogoita egekoe
english: All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.

ekegusii: Kera ririko riutire nomoika o Nyasae, nario riranyare gotworokereria, na gotokurera, na gotorongeyia, na gototang’ana ase oboronge,
english: All Scripture is God-breathed and is useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness,

ekegusii: Egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi, omonyene oboronge na omonyabibe, oyore omuya na ochenegete na oyo otachenegeti, oyo okorua ebing’wanso na oyo otari kobirua. Buna ekoba ase omonto omuya, naboigo ekoba nase omonyabibe; buna ekoba ase oria okoria eira y’ogotiana, naboigo ekoba nase oria otari koria eira y’ogotiana.
english: All share a common destiny-- the righteous and the wicked, the good and the bad, the clean and the unclean, those who offer sacrifices and those who do not. As it is with the good man, so with the sinner; as it is with those who take oaths, so with those who are afraid to take them.

ekegusii: Bono emeremo yonsi Sulemani akorete ase enyomba y’Omonene, korwa okobekwa kw’oboroso goika ogoikeranigwa kw’oboagacho, ekaera. Igo enyomba y’Omonene ekaba eikeranete.
english: All Solomon's work was carried out, from the day the foundation of the temple of the LORD was laid until its completion. So the temple of the LORD was finished.

ekegusii: Bonsi bakamokwana buya bagakumia amang’ana ’obuya aruete ase omonwa oye, bagatebania, “Oyo tari ere omwana o Yusufu?”
english: All spoke well of him and were amazed at the gracious words that came from his lips. "Isn't this Joseph's son?" they asked.

ekegusii: Chindooche chionsi nigo chikogenda ase enyancha, korende tiyana goichora. Amache ayio nigo akoirana gochia ase chindooche echio chiachakerete, naende agenderera kogenda.
english: All streams flow into the sea, yet the sea is never full. To the place the streams come from, there they return again.

ekegusii: Onsi ayare aya Tata nayane; ase ayio ngateba ng’a nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie.
english: All that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will take from what is mine and make it known to you.

ekegusii: Na ekero Abimeleki arwanetie omochie rituko riria rigima, akayobwata na agaita abanto abamenyeteo. Erio akayoiyeria na koyoitororera omonyo.
english: All that day Abimelech pressed his attack against the city until he had captured it and killed its people. Then he destroyed the city and scattered salt over it.

ekegusii: Abanto bakaimoka, bagasangereria chinkware chiria ase rituko riria rigima, na obotuko bwonsi, naende rituko ria kabere. Oyosangereretie chinke nigo asangereretie chiaisaine goetania ebitonga rigana erimo. Bagachikora emetanda aande onsi ase ebitwori.
english: All that day and night and all the next day the people went out and gathered quail. No one gathered less than ten homers. Then they spread them out all around the camp.

ekegusii: Abineri na abanto baye bakagenda ase obotuko boria obogima goetera ase Ekerubo Ekiomo; bakaamboka orooche rwa Yorodan, bagaeta egati ya Bitironi, bagaika Mahanaimu.
english: All that night Abner and his men marched through the Arabah. They crossed the Jordan, continued through the whole Bithron and came to Mahanaim.

ekegusii: Bonsi aba Tata akong’a nabache asende, na ere oyogocha asende tinkomotuguta isiko nonya ng’ake.
english: All that the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.

ekegusii: Na abamalaika bonsi bateneine baetanaine ase ekerogo keria ki’obonene, na abagaaka baria, ne ching’iti chiria inye chire moyo; bagatung’ama bosio bw’ekerogo ki’obonene, bagasasima Nyasae,
english: All the angels were standing around the throne and around the elders and the four living creatures. They fell down on their faces before the throne and worshiped God,

ekegusii: Na kera eng’iti, na kera eyekwagura, na kera enyoni, na ebitongwa binde bionsi bigotaara ase ense bigasoka amo noroiboro rwabo, korwa ase obwato.
english: All the animals and all the creatures that move along the ground and all the birds-- everything that moves on the earth-- came out of the ark, one kind after another.

ekegusii: Omoganda bw’abanto abegenete nigo orenge nenkoro eyemo na omoyo oyomo, na onde bwensi tarenge ore goteba ng’a gento kende gionsi eki arenge nakio nekia ye omonyene, korende bakaba nebinto bionsi ase obomo.
english: All the believers were one in heart and mind. No one claimed that any of his possessions was his own, but they shared everything they had.

ekegusii: Na bonsi abegenete nigo barenge aase amo, naende bakaba nebinto bionsi ase obomo;
english: All the believers were together and had everything in common.

ekegusii: Chinyoni chionsi chikaagacha ebiswa biabo ase chinsagia chiaye, ne ching’iti chikabiarera inse ye chinsagia chiaye; inse y’ekiriri kiaye abanto b’ebisaku bionsi ebinene bikamenyao.
english: All the birds of the air nested in its boughs, all the beasts of the field gave birth under its branches; all the great nations lived in its shade.

ekegusii: Ase ritina riaye, erio rirabe rigwete inse chinyoni chionsi nchiche chibeereo, na ase chinsagia chiaye ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana nchibeereo.
english: All the birds of the air settled on the fallen tree, and all the beasts of the field were among its branches.

ekegusii: Abaminto bonsi babakwanirie. Kwanania na konyunyuntana ase obochenu.
english: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

ekegusii: Aye kwabeire gokwerosia ase okorigia abasemia abange, abwo bakoringoria ayare igoro, tiga bache kogotooria, na abakomongera ching’enang’eni chia igoro, abwo bagokobanera aya agochia gokonyora ekero omotienyi oorokire, bateba ng’a mang’ana gete nabe asore.
english: All the counsel you have received has only worn you out! Let your astrologers come forward, those stargazers who make predictions month by month, let them save you from what is coming upon you.

ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane. Ebitambaa ebio bionsi bibe bi’ekerengo ekemo.
english: All the curtains are to be the same size-- twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

ekegusii: All the curtains around the courtyard were of finely twisted linen.
english: Ebitambaa bionsi ebieetanaine eraaro eria bikaroisigwa ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire.

ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera egetambaa nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere, na atano na atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane; bionsi nigo biarenge bi’ekerengo ekemo.
english: All the curtains were the same size-- twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko onsi Saulo arenge moyo akaba okorwana esegi entindi n’Abafilisti. Aande onsi Saulo arenge korora omonto orenge ne chinguru na orenge omoremu nigo amobegete kobeera amo nabarwani baye b’esegi.
english: All the days of Saul there was bitter war with the Philistines, and whenever Saul saw a mighty or brave man, he took him into his service.

ekegusii: Amatuko onsi ay’omonto ochandegete nigo are amabe, korende oyore nenkoro y’omosasoko nigo akogenderera koba nomoyega o botambe.
english: All the days of the oppressed are wretched, but the cheerful heart has a continual feast.

ekegusii: Ebisoero bionsi na ebibao nigo biarenge ne chikoona inye, na ebibao nigo biarigerereranetie bire ase chindwaro isato.
english: All the doorways had rectangular frames; they were in the front part in sets of three, facing each other.

ekegusii: Ense engima nigo ekogosasima na kogotogia, abanto bonsi nigo bagotera na gotogia erieta riao.
english: All the earth bows down to you; they sing praise to you, they sing praise to your name." Selah

ekegusii: Abanto be chinsemo chionsi chi’ense mbainyore Omonene, bamoonchokere; chiamate chionsi chi’ebisaku nchimosasime.
english: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD, and all the families of the nations will bow down before him,

ekegusii: na ogokora kwaye kwe ritang’ani goika okw’omoerio nigo korikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli na ab’Abayuda.
english: all the events, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

ekegusii: “Abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya ise, na abana baye, ne chinderia chiabo, mbabe bakomosemeria abakonye. Ebikorero bionsi, ebisinini na ebinene, mbimosung’unane.
english: All the glory of his family will hang on him: its offspring and offshoots-- all its lesser vessels, from the bowls to all the jars.

ekegusii: Chitahabu chionsi chiaruetwe ase Omonene, chiria abatang’ani baria b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana barentete, nigo chiarenge chi’oborito koreng’ana ne chikiro amagana abere.
english: All the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds that Moses and Eleazar presented as a gift to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, abarenge nogwancha korenta ebinto bi’emeremo eye Omonene achigete goetera ase Musa, bakarenta ebiegwa biabo ase Omonene.
english: All the Israelite men and women who were willing brought to the LORD freewill offerings for all the work the LORD through Moses had commanded them to do.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi bagakora buna Omonene achigete Musa na Haroni.
english: All the Israelites did just what the LORD had commanded Moses and Aaron.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bakwomania Musa na Haroni; bonsi bagakwana “Nigo anga yaba buya onye ntwakwerete Misiri, gose ase erooro eye.
english: All the Israelites grumbled against Moses and Aaron, and the whole assembly said to them, "If only we had died in Egypt! Or in this desert!

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi abarigetwe, enyomba ase enyomba, baria konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, naende baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: All the Israelites twenty years old or more who were able to serve in Israel's army were counted according to their families.

ekegusii: abaruoti bonsi b’Arabia na ab’ebisaku ebio bisang’anaine bimenyete ase erooro;
english: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the foreign people who live in the desert;

ekegusii: Abaruoti bonsi b’ense bagacha ase Sulemani, erinde baigwe obong’aini bwaye boria Nyasae abegete ime yaye.
english: All the kings of the earth sought audience with Solomon to hear the wisdom God had put in his heart.

ekegusii: “Abaruoti bonsi b’ebisaku nigo baraire nobonene bwabo, kera oyomo ase embeera yaye,
english: All the kings of the nations lie in state, each in his own tomb.

ekegusii: abaruoti bonsi ba Turo na Sidoni, na ab’ebisinka, na abe chinse chire ng’umbu mbarabare y’enyancha;
english: all the kings of Tyre and Sidon; the kings of the coastlands across the sea;

ekegusii: all the kings of Zimri, Elam and Media;
english: abaruoti bonsi ba Simuri, na Elamu, na Media;

ekegusii: naki ense eye yonsi oroche ninkoyee aye na ororeria rwao kare na kare.
english: All the land that you see I will give to you and your offspring forever.

ekegusii: Bono ense engima nigo etimogete na gotoerera. Abanto bagokire na gotera.
english: All the lands are at rest and at peace; they break into singing.

ekegusii: Okwama gwonsi kwe ritang’ani ase ebinto bionsi bigokina ase ense yabo, okwo bakondetera, nakobe okwao. Kera omonto ochenegete ore ase enyomba yao nanyare koria ebinto ebio.
english: All the land's firstfruits that they bring to the LORD will be yours. Everyone in your household who is ceremonially clean may eat it.

ekegusii: Ase amachiko aya abere amachiko onsi na ababani naro atenenerete.”
english: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments."

ekegusii: Abalawi bonsi abateri, nabwo Asafu, na Hemani, na Yedutuni, amo nabana babo abamura na abanto bamwabo babegete chianga chi’egatani engiya, babwate chisani barenge goakania na kwogia, na amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa, bagatenena ensemo ya moocha y’egesasimero, amo nabakuani rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, ababugia ebirombeta.
english: All the Levites who were musicians-- Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun and their sons and relatives-- stood on the east side of the altar, dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals, harps and lyres. They were accompanied by 120 priests sounding trumpets.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakoroisia emegwekano egosasimwa, mbasookigwe na gotantanigwa, ee, bonsi pi mbasookigwe na goichana mono.
english: All the makers of idols will be put to shame and disgraced; they will go off into disgrace together.

ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ase egati yabo oyo konya okoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo abaretwe. Barabwo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isato (23,000). Abanto aba tibabaretwe amo n’Abaisraeli bande, ekiagera tibaetwe omwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli.
english: All the male Levites a month old or more numbered 23,000. They were not counted along with the other Israelites because they received no inheritance among them.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi barikire, abare b’egetwori kia Dani, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na isano na ibere, na amagana atano na rimo (157,600). Aba nabwo barabe aba nyuma kegima komanora kogenda orogendo, babe inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo.”
english: All the men assigned to the camp of Dan number 157,600. They will set out last, under their standards.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi barikire, abare b’egetwori gi’Efraimu, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na isano na isato, ne rigana erimo (108,100). Aba nabwo barabe aba gatato komanora kogenda orogendo.
english: All the men assigned to the camp of Ephraim, according to their divisions, number 108,100. They will set out third.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi barikire, abare b’egetwori ki’Abayuda, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato na isano nemo, na amagana ane (186,400). Aba nabwo barabe bagotang’ana komanora kogenda orogendo.
english: All the men assigned to the camp of Judah, according to their divisions, number 186,400. They will set out first.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi barikire, abare b’egetwori kia Reuben, ase ebiombe biabo, nigo bare chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na eyemo, na amagana ane, na emerongo etano (151,450). Aba nabwo barabe aba kabere komanora kogenda orogendo.
english: All the men assigned to the camp of Reuben, according to their divisions, number 151,450. They will set out second.

ekegusii: Abwo abaare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na emerongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano,
english: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to do the work of serving and carrying the Tent of Meeting

ekegusii: Abanto abwo baare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na emerongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bakarikwa.
english: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting,

ekegusii: Abasacha abwo baare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na emerongo etano, naende barenge konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bakarikwa.
english: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting,

ekegusii: Bakarika abasacha bonsi abaare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na emerongo etano, abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: All the men from thirty to fifty years of age who came to serve in the work in the Tent of Meeting,

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’omochie bakarangerigwa kobabwatia, na kobabwatirie Yoshua, bakang’uswa gochia aare korwa ase omochie.
english: All the men of Ai were called to pursue them, and they pursued Joshua and were lured away from the city.

ekegusii: Igo Abaisraeli bonsi bagacha ase omoruoti Sulemani ase Amatuko Amanene ase omotienyi bw’Etanimu, noro omotienyi o gatano na kabere.
english: All the men of Israel came together to King Solomon at the time of the festival in the month of Ethanim, the seventh month.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi bakaimoka korwa ase barenge, erio bakeroberia agwo Baali‐Tamari, na baria baboete bakaoroka mobosokano korwa ase bebisete, ang’e na Gibea.
english: All the men of Israel moved from their places and took up positions at Baal Tamar, and the Israelite ambush charged out of its place on the west of Gibeah.

ekegusii: Abayuda bonsi bakairaneria Abaisraeli, “Nigo twakorete igo, ekiagera omoruoti nigo are bw’eamate yaito. Nase ki rende mokobeea ase amang’ana ayio? Inee! Twarire gento kende ki’omoruoti? Gose otoeire keegwa kende?”
english: All the men of Judah answered the men of Israel, "We did this because the king is closely related to us. Why are you angry about it? Have we eaten any of the king's provisions? Have we taken anything for ourselves?"

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abasacha bonsi b’Abayuda bagatenena ase obosio bw’Omonene: barabwo amo nabana babo ebing’werere, na abakungu babo, na abana babo bande.
english: All the men of Judah, with their wives and children and little ones, stood there before the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abamenyete ase omochie oria, bakaigwera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu, na kera omosacha oyomenyeteo akaarokigwa.
english: All the men who went out of the city gate agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male in the city was circumcised.

ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bache amo, ee, tiga abanto bonsi basangererekane bache. Ning’o ore ase egati yabo oranyare koraria amang’ana aya? Ning’o oranyare gotworokia amang’ana ayabete kare? Tiga barente birori biabo, erinde baorokie oboronge bwabo, na ekero baraigwe batebe: “Nekeene mogoteba.”
english: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble. Which of them foretold this and proclaimed to us the former things? Let them bring in their witnesses to prove they were right, so that others may hear and say, "It is true."

ekegusii: Kera egesaku nigo kerabwatie erieta ri’enyasae yaye, korende intwe nigo torabwatie erieta ri’Omonene Nyasae oito goika kare na kare.
english: All the nations may walk in the name of their gods; we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nigo bang’etananete kondwania, korende ase erieta ri’Omonene nkabasiria.
english: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abakomanyete nigo baragoichane. Aye gwaikire ase ogosirigwa gw’okoondokia, tokobao naende nonya ng’ake.”
english: All the nations who knew you are appalled at you; you have come to a horrible end and will be no more.'"

ekegusii: Ee, ebisaku bionsi mbiborie: Ninki kiagerete Omonene akorete ense eye ekaba iga? Naki endamwamu yaye yokire iga?
english: All the nations will ask: "Why has the LORD done this to this land? Why this fierce, burning anger?"

ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nabisangererie ase obosio bwaye; ere naatanane abaiga na aba buna omorisia agwatanana ching’ondi ne chimbori.
english: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi gwatongete mbichiche, bitung’ame ase obosio bwao kogosasima, mbitogie erieta riao, aye Omonene.
english: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, O Lord; they will bring glory to your name.

ekegusii: Abaraai bonsi, na abanto chituoni, amo nabamura bonsi ba Daudi omoruoti bakaria chiira ng’a mbabwatane nomoruoti Sulemani.
english: All the officers and mighty men, as well as all of King David's sons, pledged their submission to King Solomon.

ekegusii: Abatang’ani b’abanto, amo nabanto bonsi, bakabeka chibesa chiabo ime ase esanduku eria bare nomogoko, goika ebango yonsi ekarentwa.
english: All the officials and all the people brought their contributions gladly, dropping them into the chest until it was full.

ekegusii: Agwo abanene baria bonsi b’oboruoti bagacha ase Yeremia, bakamoboria amang’ana ayio, na Yeremia akabairaneria buna omoruoti konya amosemirie. Ase ayio abanene baria bagatiga amang’ana ayio, ekiagera konya taramanyekana.
english: All the officials did come to Jeremiah and question him, and he told them everything the king had ordered him to say. So they said no more to him, for no one had heard his conversation with the king.

ekegusii: Erio abanene abwo bonsi bagatoma Yehudi mosinto o Netania, omochokoro o Selemia, omocho kororia o Kusi, korangeria Baruku na komotebia, “Imokia ebuku eyio gwasoma ase abanto bategererete, ochiche nero.” Ase ayio Baruku, mosinto o Neria, akabogoria ebuku eria, aga cha asebare,
english: all the officials sent Jehudi son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to say to Baruch, "Bring the scroll from which you have read to the people and come." So Baruch son of Neriah went to them with the scroll in his hand.

ekegusii: Ebikorero bi’Obomenyo ebirabe bigokorerwa ase emeremo ende yonsi, amo nebirochi bi’ebitambaa na ebi’eraaro bionsi, nigo birabe ebie chitaai.”
english: All the other articles used in the service of the tabernacle, whatever their function, including all the tent pegs for it and those for the courtyard, are to be of bronze.

ekegusii: Ababani baria bonsi bakabana amang’ana ayio ayio, bagateba, “Genda Ramoti o Gileadi, noyobue. Omonene nayobeke ase okoboko kwao aye omoruoti.”
english: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. "Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious," they said, "for the LORD will give it into the king's hand."

ekegusii: Ababani baria bonsi bakabana amang’ana ayio ayio, bagateba, “Genda Ramoti o Gileadi, noyobue. Omonene nayobeke ase okoboko kwao, aye omoruoti.”
english: All the other prophets were prophesying the same thing. "Attack Ramoth Gilead and be victorious," they said, "for the LORD will give it into the king's hand."

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakairaneria, “Amanyinga aye, tiga abe igoro asetore, na ase abana baito!”
english: All the people answered, "Let his blood be on us and on our children!"

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto bonsi bakabwatana buna omonto oyomo, bagasangererekana ase eraaro agwo bosio bw’Egeita ki’Amache, bagatebia Ezara, oria orenge omworokia bw’amachiko, arente Ebuku y’Amachiko, a Musa, ayio Omonene aruete ase Abaisraeli.
english: all the people assembled as one man in the square before the Water Gate. They told Ezra the scribe to bring out the Book of the Law of Moses, which the LORD had commanded for Israel.

ekegusii: Bagachia koigwa aya, bonsi ase esinagogi bagaichorwa nendamwamu.
english: All the people in the synagogue were furious when they heard this.

ekegusii: Ase igo abwo bonsi Isumaeli konya arusirie Misipa na kobaira ase obosomba, bakairana, bagacha ase Yohanani, mosinto o Karea.
english: All the people Ishmael had taken captive at Mizpah turned and went over to Johanan son of Kareah.

ekegusii: Abanto aba Sulemani abetereretie gokora emeremo, nigo barenge abe chinderia chi’abanto b’ense ya Kanani, abwo Abaisraeli batanyarete kobua na gosiria kegima. Abanto abwo tibarenge Abaisraeli. Nigo barenge Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Abanto abwo bakagenderera koba abasomba, nabo bare goika rero iga.
english: All the people left from the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these peoples were not Israelites),

ekegusii: Abanto Sulemani abetereretie gokora emeremo nigo barenge abe chinderia chi’abanto b’ense ya Kanani, abwo Abaisraeli batanyarete kobua na gosiria. Abanto abwo tibarenge Abaisraeli. Nigo barenge Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Abanto abwo bakagenderera koba abasomba, nabo bare goika rero iga.
english: All the people left from the Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites (these peoples were not Israelites),

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi b’ense eria bakagenda ase enyomba ya Baali, bakayetagora bakayeiyeria inse; ebisasimero biaye na emegwekano yaye agosasima bakabinachana ebing’ese, bagaita Matani, omokuani o Baali, agwo bosio bw’ebisasimero. Na Yehoyada omokuani akabeka abarendi barende enyomba y’Omonene.
english: All the people of the land went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols to pieces and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars. Then Jehoiada the priest posted guards at the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ense eyio mbagenderere kobatindeka, na ayio abe ogotogigwa kwabo. Aya nigo arakoreke ase rituko riria ndaorokie obonene bwane. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: All the people of the land will bury them, and the day I am glorified will be a memorable day for them, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: “Abanto bonsi b’ense eye goika baire okoruegwa okwo ase omogambi ore ase Abaisraeli.
english: All the people of the land will participate in this special gift for the use of the prince in Israel.

ekegusii: Abanto bakaimoka, bakabwatana buna omonto oyomo, bagakwana, “Onde tarua asetore agende mwaye, ase eema yaye gose nyomba mwaye.
english: All the people rose as one man, saying, "None of us will go home. No, not one of us will return to his house.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bachia korora aya, bakemurungania bonsi, bakobora, “Osoire koba omogeni bw’omonyene ebibe.”
english: All the people saw this and began to mutter, "He has gone to be the guest of a 'sinner.'"

ekegusii: Abanto baria baruete Misiri konya barokigwe bonsi, korende ase abwo baiboreretwe ase orogendo rw’erooro, onde tarenge konya bwarokigwe, nonya noyomo.
english: All the people that came out had been circumcised, but all the people born in the desert during the journey from Egypt had not.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakarora ng’a ayio nigo abagweneire buna amang’ana onsi omoruoti are gokora abagwenerete.
english: All the people took note and were pleased; indeed, everything the king did pleased them.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakagenda ase hekalu ya Baali, bakayetagora bakayeiyeria inse. Ebisasimero biaye na emegwekano yaye bakabinachana ebing’ese, bagaitera Matani, omokuani o Baali, agwo bosio bw’egesasimero.
english: All the people went to the temple of Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.

ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ing’ana ki eri? Naki ase chinguru na okobua agochika ebirecha bi’eubi, na birobio biasoka.”
english: All the people were amazed and said to each other, "What is this teaching? With authority and power he gives orders to evil spirits and they come out!"

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagakumia, bakaborania, “Inee! Oyo nanyare koba omwana o Daudi?”
english: All the people were astonished and said, "Could this be the Son of David?"

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi baraigwe amang’ana ayio mbairoke, tibakora ogokora kw’obomwenu naende.
english: All the people will hear and be afraid, and will not be contemptuous again.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi mbarimanye, nonya nabamenyete ase ense y’Abaefraimu, na ey’Abasamaria, abwo bagokwana noboenenu na obomwenu bwe chinkoro, bateba,
english: All the people will know it-- Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria-- who say with pride and arrogance of heart,

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense nigo babarire ng’a nigo bare bosa. Ere nigo agokorera emeganda ya igoro buna anchete, akorera na mwanyabanto bare ase ense boigo. Onde tari oramotange, gose komoboria: Ngento ki ekio ogokora?”
english: All the peoples of the earth are regarded as nothing. He does as he pleases with the powers of heaven and the peoples of the earth. No one can hold back his hand or say to him: "What have you done?"

ekegusii: Chisiiro chionsi echietanaine eraaro nigo chirabe ne chinuga na ebigobanio bie chifeta, ne chinterekerero chiabo chibe chie chitaai.
english: All the posts around the courtyard are to have silver bands and hooks, and bronze bases.

ekegusii: Oyo ababani bonsi baberete birori, ng’a onde bwensi omwegenire nigo aranyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe ase erieta riaye.”
english: All the prophets testify about him that everyone who believes in him receives forgiveness of sins through his name."

ekegusii: Ee, abanto abatenenku bonsi bare ase ense goika batung’ame ase obosio bw’Omonene, abwo bonsi bakogenda ase chimbeera ime mbatung’ame ase obosio bwaye; naboigo nabwo batanyare korenda obogima bwabo bogenderere.
english: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before him-- those who cannot keep themselves alive.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akarua ogochika ng’a abasomba baye bonsi barenge kobeera ase egeita kiaye batung’ame bosio bwa Hamani ase okomosasima. Bonsi bagakora bo, otatiga Moredekai.
english: All the royal officials at the king's gate knelt down and paid honor to Haman, for the king had commanded this concerning him. But Mordecai would not kneel down or pay him honor.

ekegusii: Kera okoruegwa kw’ebinto ebichenu Abaisraeli bararente ase omokuani, ebinto ebio nabibe ebiaye.
english: All the sacred contributions the Israelites bring to a priest will belong to him.

ekegusii: Erio abagendia b’emeeri bakaondoka, na kera oyomo akarangeria enyasae yaye ng’a emokonye. Abanto abwo bakaimokia chigurube chiarenge ase emeeri ime, bagachituguta gochia ase enyancha ime, ng’a nario emeeri eragusue. Bono Yona ere konya otirimbokire gochia nyaro ime y’emeeri, na aroro nigo araire chitoro chinene mono.
english: All the sailors were afraid and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone below deck, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.

ekegusii: All the saints send their greetings.
english: Abachenu bonsi babakwanirie.

ekegusii: Abachenu bonsi babakwanirie, mono kobua abwo bare b’enyomba y’omoruoti omonene.
english: All the saints send you greetings, especially those who belong to Caesar's household.

ekegusii: Emebaso yonsi ya igoro ninyetube omosunte ase engencho yao, nindete omosunte nase ense yao. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you; I will bring darkness over your land, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Korende ebinto bionsi bie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu, na ebie chitaai, na ebi’ebioma, birobio nebi’Omonene, bibekwe ase ekungo yaye.”
english: All the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron are sacred to the LORD and must go into his treasury."

ekegusii: Abanyabibe bonsi b’abanto baane, abwo bagoteba ng’a amabe takobanyora gose kobakorera kende, mbaitwe nemioro.
english: All the sinners among my people will die by the sword, all those who say, 'Disaster will not overtake or meet us.'

ekegusii: Abaroisia bonsi abang’aini b’abakori emeremo bakaroisia eema y’Obomenyo. Bakayeroisia nebitambaa ikomi, biroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chimbariri Omoroisia omong’aini akabiroisia, bire nemegwekano y’abakerubi.
english: All the skilled men among the workmen made the tabernacle with ten curtains of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, with cherubim worked into them by a skilled craftsman.

ekegusii: Ogosikwa gwonsi kwarure ase abanto ba Sayoni; abagambi baye babeire buna chingabi chitabwati ase chikorisia; batamire korwa ase abakobabwatia, tibari ne chinguru.
english: All the splendor has departed from the Daughter of Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; in weakness they have fled before the pursuer.

ekegusii: Erioba, na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni mbisirigwe; igoro neringwe buna amakaratasi, ee, ebitongwa ebio bia igoro mbiiyerigwe inse buna amato amomo ay’emesabibu na ay’emeko akogwa.
english: All the stars of the heavens will be dissolved and the sky rolled up like a scroll; all the starry host will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like shriveled figs from the fig tree.

ekegusii: Chimesa chiabo chionsi chiaichoire namaroki, na aase ande tari atari nobonyinyeri.
english: All the tables are covered with vomit and there is not a spot without filth.

ekegusii: Ebirochi bionsi bi’eema y’Obomenyo na ebi’ebitambaa bi’eraaro nigo biarenge bie chitaai.
english: All the tent pegs of the tabernacle and of the surrounding courtyard were bronze.

ekegusii: Ekero ense eria egendererete koba amatongo netimoke ogotimoka okwo motayeete ekero mwamenyeteo.
english: All the time that it lies desolate, the land will have the rest it did not have during the sabbaths you lived in it.

ekegusii: Nabo abanto b’eamate ya Merari, abatigarete ase chiamate chi’Abalawi, baetwe emechie ikomi na ebere, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
english: All the towns allotted to the Merarite clans, who were the rest of the Levites, were twelve.

ekegusii: Emechie yonsi abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni baetwe nigo yarenge ikomi na etato; bakayeegwa, amo namarisio arengeo.
english: All the towns for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, were thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

ekegusii: Nabo abanto be chiamate chionsi chi’Abagerisoni baetwe emechie ikomi na etato, amo namarisio arengeo.
english: All the towns of the Gershonite clans were thirteen, together with their pasturelands.

ekegusii: Emete yonsi egokina korwa ase riroba nemanye ng’a ninche Omonene, ninche ngokeyia emete emetambe, naende nakinia eyere emieng’e. Nigo nkwomia emete ere emebese, naende nasebokia na koreeretia eyomire. “Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio, goika nyakore.”
english: All the trees of the field will know that I the LORD bring down the tall tree and make the low tree grow tall. I dry up the green tree and make the dry tree flourish. "'I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.'"

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli bakagenda ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, bakamotebia, “Naama! Intwe nigo tore abamo naye, aba amanyinga ayamo na omobere oyomo.
english: All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said, "We are your own flesh and blood.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abarenge na Yoabu bagacha Abeli Beti‐Maaka, bakamonaaria, bakaagacha eburi bosio bw’omochie kororia orwaki, na abanto bagachaka gotagora orwaki ng’a baroiyerie inse.
english: All the troops with Joab came and besieged Sheba in Abel Beth Maacah. They built a siege ramp up to the city, and it stood against the outer fortifications. While they were battering the wall to bring it down,

ekegusii: Chinchera chionsi chi’Omonene nigo chire echi’obwanchani, na echi’obwegenwa, ase abwo barendete okobwatana kwaye na oborori bwaye.
english: All the ways of the LORD are loving and faithful for those who keep the demands of his covenant.

ekegusii: Aye nigo obarete abakori amabe bonsi b’ense koba bosa buna amabiria; ase ayio inche nigo inyanchete oborori bwao.
english: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio naro aya: Abakungu bonsi barache gotigwa ase enyomba y’omoruoti bw’Abayuda mbairwe gochia ase abagambi bare inse y’omoruoti o Babeli. Nigo barabe bagokwana iga:” “Abasani bao kwegenete nigo bakong’ainete, barabwo bagakobua. Bono amagoro ao arateerire ase etintira, abwo beonchoire, bagotigire.
english: All the women left in the palace of the king of Judah will be brought out to the officials of the king of Babylon. Those women will say to you: "'They misled you and overcame you-- those trusted friends of yours. Your feet are sunk in the mud; your friends have deserted you.'

ekegusii: Amang’ana aane onsi ngokwana nigo are ay’oboronge, ande tari are ay’oborimo, gose ay’obokorekanu.
english: All the words of my mouth are just; none of them is crooked or perverse.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abamenyete amo nabarabwo bakabakonya ase okobaa ebikorero bie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu na ebinto binde, ne chitugo, na ebinto bie rigori rinene, amo nebinto baruete ase ogwancha.
english: All their neighbors assisted them with articles of silver and gold, with goods and livestock, and with valuable gifts, in addition to all the freewill offerings.

ekegusii: Haroni na abamura baye nabwo barachike Abagerisoni ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria, na onsi aya barakore; inwe mobatige batenenere ebinto bionsi barabe bakobogoria.
english: All their service, whether carrying or doing other work, is to be done under the direction of Aaron and his sons. You shall assign to them as their responsibility all they are to carry.

ekegusii: abanto bonsi chituoni bakaimoka, bakagenda ase obotuko obogima, bakarusia omobere o Saulo, na ey’abamura baye, korwa ase orwaki rwa Beti‐Sani, bakayerenta Yabesi, bakayesambera aroro.
english: all their valiant men journeyed through the night to Beth Shan. They took down the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth Shan and went to Jabesh, where they burned them.

ekegusii: abarwani bonsi chituoni bakagenda bakarusia omobere o Saulo na ey’abamura baye korwa ase yarenge, bakayerenta Yabesi. Erio bagatindeka amauga abo inse ase omote onga buna omotontera agwo Yabesi, erio bakeng’ata amatuko atano na abere.
english: all their valiant men went and took the bodies of Saul and his sons and brought them to Jabesh. Then they buried their bones under the great tree in Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.

ekegusii: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
english: Ayio onsi naro omochakano bw’obororo.

ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebisaku bia Israeli ikomi na bibere; naya naro ise abatebetie ekero are kobasesenia na koa kera oyomo ogosesenigwa kwaye.
english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them, giving each the blessing appropriate to him.

ekegusii: Korende ebiegwa ebi bionsi nigo bikorwa ase Omoika oyo oyomo, oria oria okogabera kera oyomo buna bwanchete.
english: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, and he gives them to each one, just as he determines.

ekegusii: Komoraigwere eriogi ri’ Omonene, Nyasae oino, rirorio nabae ogosesenigwa oko gwonsi kobe okwaino:
english: All these blessings will come upon you and accompany you if you obey the LORD your God:

ekegusii: Emechie eyio yonsi nigo yagiteire chindwaki chintambe gochia igoro, na ebiita biarenge gosiekwa nemekorogoto; naboigo ebichie ebinge mbiarengeo bitagiteire chindwaki.
english: All these cities were fortified with high walls and with gates and bars, and there were also a great many unwalled villages.

ekegusii: “Okoragererigwa okwo gwonsi nagoche asemore na kobabwatia goika kobasirie kegima, ekiagera motaigwerete Omonene, Nyasae oino, na kobwata amachiko aye, na emeroberio yaye echikire, ayio abaete.
english: All these curses will come upon you. They will pursue you and overtake you until you are destroyed, because you did not obey the LORD your God and observe the commands and decrees he gave you.

ekegusii: Aya onsi amabe nigo akorwa ime, naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka.”
english: All these evils come from inside and make a man 'unclean.'"

ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi konya banyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao, na abande b’abwo konya baiboire abana.
english: All these had married foreign women, and some of them had children by these wives.

ekegusii: Nabo Yoshua akabua abaruoti abwo bonsi, ne chinse chiabo, ase engaki eyemo, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo arwanerete Abaisraeli.
english: All these kings and their lands Joshua conquered in one campaign, because the LORD, the God of Israel, fought for Israel.

ekegusii: Abaruoti abwo bonsi bakabwatana, bakagenda bagatoora amo, ang’e ne chinsoko chia Meromu, ase okorwania Abaisraeli.
english: All these kings joined forces and made camp together at the Waters of Merom, to fight against Israel.

ekegusii: Aba bonsi bakabwatana, bagasangererekana ase ense omweya ya Sidimu, agwo nao Enyancha y’Omonyo ere.
english: All these latter kings joined forces in the Valley of Siddim (the Salt Sea).

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo barenge inse y’oboraai bwa ise ekero barenge gotera agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene na goakania chisani chikwoga, amo na kobugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Asafu na Yedutuni, na Hemani nigo barenge inse y’oboraai bw’omoruoti.
english: All these men were under the supervision of their fathers for the music of the temple of the LORD, with cymbals, lyres and harps, for the ministry at the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman were under the supervision of the king.

ekegusii: bakabwatana nabanto bamwabo basikire, bakaria eira bagatiana ng’a mbabwatie amachiko a Nyasae ayaruetwe goetera ase Musa, omosomba oye, naende ng’a mbarende na gokora amachiko onsi ay’Omonene, oyore Omonene oito, amo nemeroberio yaye yonsi echikire.
english: all these now join their brothers the nobles, and bind themselves with a curse and an oath to follow the Law of God given through Moses the servant of God and to obey carefully all the commands, regulations and decrees of the LORD our Lord.

ekegusii: Na abasomba aba bao bonsi nabatirimboke gocha asende na batung’ameo, bakobora: Genda, karue aa, aye na abanto bao bonsi bakobwatie. Nyuma y’ayio nindue aa!” Erio agwo Musa akarua o Farao ore nekeririanda ekenene.
english: All these officials of yours will come to me, bowing down before me and saying, 'Go, you and all the people who follow you!' After that I will leave." Then Moses, hot with anger, left Pharaoh.

ekegusii: ekiagera aba bonsi babekire korwa ase obonge bwe chinibo chiabo, korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obekire ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio.”
english: All these people gave their gifts out of their wealth; but she out of her poverty put in all she had to live on."

ekegusii: Aba bonsi bagakwa bare nokwegena, bataranyora ayabarieretwe eira, korende bakayarora korwa are, na koyakwania, bakaorokia ng’a nigo bare abamenyi na abaeti ase ense.
english: All these people were still living by faith when they died. They did not receive the things promised; they only saw them and welcomed them from a distance. And they admitted that they were aliens and strangers on earth.

ekegusii: Aba bonsi nabwo ab’ororeria rwa Yediaeli. Barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, naende nigo barenge abakong’u ase esegi. Omobaro obo nechilifu ikomi na isano na ibere, na amagana abere (17,200).
english: All these sons of Jediael were heads of families. There were 17,200 fighting men ready to go out to war.

ekegusii: Echio chionsi nigo chiagachetwe namagena amaya e rigori rinene, abaachetwe koreng’ana nekerengo, akanachwa nemesumeno chinsemo chionsi korwa oboroso goika rigasio ri’enyasi. Amagena onsi nigo aroisetigwe bo, nonya naya e risiko amo nay’orwaki rw’eraaro y’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: All these structures, from the outside to the great courtyard and from foundation to eaves, were made of blocks of high-grade stone cut to size and trimmed with a saw on their inner and outer faces.

ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate echio chi’Abakohati nigo baetwe emechie eyio ikomi, amo namarisio arengeo.
english: All these ten towns and their pasturelands were given to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaroisia ebinto ebi bionsi ebinge mono; ase igo oborito bwe chitaai chiria tibwarenge konyara korengeka na komanyekana buna bong’ana.
english: All these things that Solomon made amounted to so much that the weight of the bronze was not determined.

ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo barenge abanto b’ororeria rw’Aseri. Nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, abanto bamanyekanete ng’a nabakong’u ase esegi, abatang’ani b’abaraai. Abwo barigetwe korwa ase chinderia chiabo bagende korwana esegi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isano nemo (26,000).
english: All these were descendants of Asher-- heads of families, choice men, brave warriors and outstanding leaders. The number of men ready for battle, as listed in their genealogy, was 26,000.

ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo barenge b’ororeria rw’Obedi‐Edomu. Barabwo amo nabana babo abamura na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge abanto abakong’u, bamanyete gokora emeremo yabo. Bonsi abwo b’Obedi‐Edomu nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo na babere.
english: All these were descendants of Obed-Edom; they and their sons and their relatives were capable men with the strength to do the work-- descendants of Obed-Edom, 62 in all.

ekegusii: Aba bonsi nigo babaretwe na korikwa ekero omobaro bwe chinderia chiabo okoretwe ase amatuko ’okogamba kwa Yotamu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, na aya okwa Yeroboamu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: All these were entered in the genealogical records during the reigns of Jotham king of Judah and Jeroboam king of Israel.

ekegusii: Abarwani aba bonsi baisanerete ase okorwana esegi, na bagacha agwo Heburoni, bare nomoyo oyomo kobeka Daudi koba omoruoti igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi. Boigo Abaisraeli bande bonsi nigo barenge nebirengererio ebimo bi’okobeka Daudi abe omoruoti.
english: All these were fighting men who volunteered to serve in the ranks. They came to Hebron fully determined to make David king over all Israel. All the rest of the Israelites were also of one mind to make David king.

ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo ase ebiaare biabo; nigo barenge abaraai abanene. Abwo nigo bamenyete Yerusalemu.
english: All these were heads of families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo chi’Abalawi ase ebiaare biabo. Abwo nigo barenge abaraai baria bamenyete Yerusalemu.
english: All these were heads of Levite families, chiefs as listed in their genealogy, and they lived in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Hemani, omorori bw’omoruoti. Nyasae amorierete eira y’okomokong’ia; ase ayio akamoa abana abamura ikomi na bane, na abaiseke batato.
english: All these were sons of Heman the king's seer. They were given him through the promises of God to exalt him. God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

ekegusii: Aba bonsi nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Daudi, naende nabwate abamura bande b’abakungu ba sere‐sere. Tamari nere orenge omoiseke omwabo abamura abwo.
english: All these were the sons of David, besides his sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.

ekegusii: Ring’ana erimo barigetie torikore nario eri, ng’a toinyore abataka, ne ring’ana erio nigo narenge nomokia korikora.
english: All they asked was that we should continue to remember the poor, the very thing I was eager to do.

ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi agokorwa nigo akorenta omoroso otanyare gokwaneka. Amaiso tari goisaneka naya akorora, na amato tari goisaneka naya akoigwa.
english: All things are wearisome, more than one can say. The eye never has enough of seeing, nor the ear its fill of hearing.

ekegusii: Amorokererio ayio nigo akorwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere nigo are omosemia bw’ogokumia, na obong’aini bwaye nobonene mono.
english: All this also comes from the LORD Almighty, wonderful in counsel and magnificent in wisdom.

ekegusii: Ayio onsi akamonyora Nebukadinesaro omoruoti.
english: All this happened to King Nebuchadnezzar.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya onsi atonyorire, nonya intwe titoraba togokweba, gose titorasaria okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania.
english: All this happened to us, though we had not forgotten you or been false to your covenant.

ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo nayaroche ekero nabegete ebirengererio biane kwegera aya onsi agokorwa aiga inse y’erioba, ekero omonto oyomo akogambera omonto onde na komokorera bobe ase okomochanda.
english: All this I saw, as I applied my mind to everything done under the sun. There is a time when a man lords it over others to his own hurt.

ekegusii: Aya onsi ngateema koyaenekia ase enchera y’obong’aini, ngateba, “Goika imbe nobong’aini.” Korende obong’aini obwo bokabeera aare korwa asende.
english: All this I tested by wisdom and I said, "I am determined to be wise"-- but this was beyond me.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Yakobo, na ebibe b’Abaisraeli. Inee! Ogosaria okwo kore ase abanto ba Yakobo nkoroki? Tari okwo gwa Samaria? Na ogosaria okwo kw’ogosasimera aase aimokererete igoro kore ase Abayuda nkoroki? Tari okwo kwa Yerusalemu?
english: All this is because of Jacob's transgression, because of the sins of the house of Israel. What is Jacob's transgression? Is it not Samaria? What is Judah's high place? Is it not Jerusalem?

ekegusii: Eke nakio ekiorokererio, ng’a ekina kia Nyasae mboronge kere. Erio mobarwe koba abamwagweneire oboruoti bwa Nyasae, ekiagera ase engencho y’obwo mwachandirwe.
english: All this is evidence that God's judgment is right, and as a result you will be counted worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are suffering.

ekegusii: Naki amang’ana onsi nigo agokorwa ase engencho yaino, erinde obuya obwo bomentwe ase abwo abange, ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono komentwe, na Nyasae abakwe.
english: All this is for your benefit, so that the grace that is reaching more and more people may cause thanksgiving to overflow to the glory of God.

ekegusii: Korende bionsi nigo bikorwa ase Nyasae, oyotobwatanirie intwe amo nere omonyene ase Kristo, nere otoeire obosomba bw’okobwatanigwa,
english: All this is from God, who reconciled us to himself through Christ and gave us the ministry of reconciliation:

ekegusii: All this took about 450 years. "After this, God gave them judges until the time of Samuel the prophet.
english: koreng’ana engaki y’emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etano. Nyuma y’ayio akabaa abagambi goika ekero ki’omobani Samweli.

ekegusii: Aya igo akoregete, ekiagera Abaisraeli bakorete ebibe ase Omonene, Nyasae obo oyobarusetie ase ense ya Misiri na korwa ase okoboko gwa Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, na ekiagera bakorerete chinyasae ching’ao.
english: All this took place because the Israelites had sinned against the LORD their God, who had brought them up out of Egypt from under the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt. They worshiped other gods

ekegusii: Aya onsi nigo abeire, erinde riikerane eriakwanetwe n’Omonene ase omonwa bw’omobani,
english: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:

ekegusii: Boigo omoganda oyo bwonsi nomanye ng’a Omonene tari korenta obobui ase enchera y’emioro na amatimo. Esegi nigo ere ey’Omonene, nere nababeke inwe ase amaboko aito.”
english: All those gathered here will know that it is not by sword or spear that the LORD saves; for the battle is the LORD's, and he will give all of you into our hands."

ekegusii: Na bonsi abamoigwete bagakumia, bagateba, “Tari ere oyo orenge Yerusalemu goteema goita abare korangeria erieta eri? Naende aiga, erinde abasibe, abaire ase abakuani abanene?”
english: All those who heard him were astonished and asked, "Isn't he the man who raised havoc in Jerusalem among those who call on this name? And hasn't he come here to take them as prisoners to the chief priests?"

ekegusii: Na abanto bonsi abamenyete Lida na Saroni bakamorora, bakaonchokera Omonene.
english: All those who lived in Lydda and Sharon saw him and turned to the Lord.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagendete amo na Yakobo ase ense ya Misiri, abwo baiboretwe korwa asare, nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano nomo. Abakungu b’abana abamura ba Yakobo, barabwo tibabariri.
english: All those who went to Egypt with Jacob-- those who were his direct descendants, not counting his sons' wives-- numbered sixty-six persons.

ekegusii: Abanto bachandegete, na abwo babwate chisira, na abwo bataisanegete nobogima bwabo, bakamochera, nere akaba omotang’ani obo. Abanto abasacha abarenge amo nere nigo barenge koreng’ana amagana ane.
english: All those who were in distress or in debt or discontented gathered around him, and he became their leader. About four hundred men were with him.

ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge inde nobotoereru, korende ere agansenyenta, ee, Nyasae akambwata ebigoti, akambutorana ebing’ese, bono onkorire nabeire ekerenga kiaye gekoraswa.
english: All was well with me, but he shattered me; he seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has made me his target;

ekegusii: Bonsi abare inse y’obosibwa bw’obosomba babare abanene babo ng’a mbagwenerete ogosika gwonsi, erinde erieta ria Nyasae tiriramwa, gose okworokereria gwaito.
english: All who are under the yoke of slavery should consider their masters worthy of full respect, so that God's name and our teaching may not be slandered.

ekegusii: Kera omonto oyorarikwe, engencho yaye oyokoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, goika arue ekeegwa eke ase Omonene.
english: All who cross over, those twenty years old or more, are to give an offering to the LORD.

ekegusii: Bonsi abantang’anerete nabaibi na abakurumi, korende ching’ondi tichiabaigwete.
english: All who ever came before me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not listen to them.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagoata amache nemegango mbatige chimeeri chiabo; abagokora emeremo ase chimeeri amo nabagendia, mbagende ase engegu, bateneneo.
english: All who handle the oars will abandon their ships; the mariners and all the seamen will stand on the shore.

ekegusii: “Abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha baichanire ase engencho yao, na abaruoti bao bonsi baondokire mono, na obwoba nigo bwarorekanire ase amasio abo.
english: All who live in the coastlands are appalled at you; their kings shudder with horror and their faces are distorted with fear.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bonsi bakoroisia emegwekano y’ogosasimwa nigo bare bosa, na emegwekano eyio teri kobarentera buya bonde. Abwo bakoyebera birori tibakorora, gose tibakomanya gento kende; ase igo mbasookigwe.
english: All who make idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Those who would speak up for them are blind; they are ignorant, to their own shame.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagoetera aase agwo nigo bakomosakora, abamenyete ang’e nere nigo bakomochecheria.
english: All who pass by have plundered him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagoeta inchera nigo bagoaka chinkobi ase okogochaya, nigo bakobugia emeroria na gosingiseria omochie o Yerusalemu emetwe, bakobora: “Inee! Omochie oyio noro orenge korokwa omoikeranu bw’obosiani, na omogoko bw’ense yonsi?”
english: All who pass your way clap their hands at you; they scoff and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem: "Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?"

ekegusii: Naki baria bonsi basemeretie ogokora kw’amachiko, nigo bare inse y’okoragererigwa, ekiagera nerikire, “Kera omonto oyotari kobwata onsi ayarikire ase ebuku y’amachiko na koyakora oragererigwe.”
english: All who rely on observing the law are under a curse, for it is written: "Cursed is everyone who does not continue to do everything written in the Book of the Law."

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abakondora nigo bagonchecheria na gonsekerera; nigo bagoaka amariogi asende na gosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo,
english: All who see me mock me; they hurl insults, shaking their heads:

ekegusii: Kera omonto orabe ogokorora nigo aregose atenenere aare, atebe: Nineva otigirwe bosa, ning’o orayororere amabeebe? Ng’ai toranyore oyokoyoremia?”
english: All who see you will flee from you and say, 'Nineveh is in ruins-- who will mourn for her?' Where can I find anyone to comfort you?"

ekegusii: Naki bonsi abakorire ebibe batari namachiko, nabasire batari namachiko; na bonsi abakorire ebibe bare namachiko, nabo baranacherwe ekina ase amachiko.
english: All who sin apart from the law will also perish apart from the law, and all who sin under the law will be judged by the law.

ekegusii: Korende abaratigare bare moyo mbatame gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, babe buna amaruma are ase amakuruma, bonsi mbabe bakorera, kera oyomo ase engencho y’ebibe biaye.
english: All who survive and escape will be in the mountains, moaning like doves of the valleys, each because of his sins.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi, abaikaransete ase ekegambero eke, bakamobeta amaiso, bakarora obosio bwaye ng’a nigo bwabeire buna obosio bw’omomalaika.
english: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin looked intently at Stephen, and they saw that his face was like the face of an angel.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha, abasacha na abakungu, na ase ogwancha kwabo bakarenta amameka, na ebigera bi’amato abo, ne chibonyi chi’ebiara, ne chisonoi, na ebinto ao ao bie chitahabu bi’ogwechabera. Kera omonto akarenta ebinto bie chitahabu, ebi aatananete ase ogokorera Omonene.
english: All who were willing, men and women alike, came and brought gold jewelry of all kinds: brooches, earrings, rings and ornaments. They all presented their gold as a wave offering to the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abagosasima emegwekano nigo bagosookigwa, ee, abwo bagwetogeria emegwekano y’ogosasimwa ere bosa; inwe chinyasae chionsi, tung’ama ase obosio bwaye.
english: All who worship images are put to shame, those who boast in idols-- worship him, all you gods!

ekegusii: Bagatianania ng’a monto onde bwensi orenge kwanga korigia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, goika aitwe akwe, abe omwana gose omonto omonene, omosacha gose omokungu.
english: All who would not seek the LORD, the God of Israel, were to be put to death, whether small or great, man or woman.

ekegusii: Bionsi ebitari ebia boronge nebibe, korende mbireo ebibe bitari ebi’amakweri.
english: All wrongdoing is sin, and there is sin that does not lead to death.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ebitongwa biao bionsi nigo bikogoakere ng’a mbuya mono, na abachenu bao bonsi mbagotogie.
english: All you have made will praise you, O LORD; your saints will extol you.

ekegusii: Inwe mwensi ababiare b’ense, inwe abamomenyeteo, ekero ebendera ekoimokererigwa ase egetunwa igoro, morigererie! Ekero egetureri gekobugigwa, motegerere!
english: All you people of the world, you who live on the earth, when a banner is raised on the mountains, you will see it, and when a trumpet sounds, you will hear it.

ekegusii: All your allies have forgotten you; they care nothing for you. I have struck you as an enemy would and punished you as would the cruel, because your guilt is so great and your sins so many.
english: Abanchi baino bonsi babatigire, tibari kobechandera, ekiagera inche nabaakire inwe ogoakwa kw’obobisa. Nabaeire egesusuro ntari namabera, ekiagera okomocha kwaino nokonene, na ebibe biaino biamentekanire.

ekegusii: Abanto baria bonsi kwabwatanete nabarabwo bagoseririe gochia ase orobebe, abanto baria gwakorete omorembe nabarabwo bakong’ainire na gokobua. Abasani bao mokoria komo bagotegeire oboreba, bagoteba: Ng’ai obong’aini bwao bore?”
english: All your allies will force you to the border; your friends will deceive and overpower you; those who eat your bread will set a trap for you, but you will not detect it.

ekegusii: Amachiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene, korende abanto nigo bagonchanda engencho ende etaiyo. Koranche onkonye!
english: All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for men persecute me without cause.

ekegusii: Ababisa bao bonsi baasamirie emenwa yabo gokobugeria emeroria na gokoriananeria amaino, bakobora: “Twayosaririe! Ee, rituko eri nario twaganetie, bono twariikeire, twarirorire!”
english: All your enemies open their mouths wide against you; they scoff and gnash their teeth and say, "We have swallowed her up. This is the day we have waited for; we have lived to see it."

ekegusii: Chiburi chiao chionsi nigo chinga buna emeko ere nokwama kwe ritang’ani. Ekero egotengechigwa, amako abo nigo akoaroroka, agwa ase emenwa y’abanto baria bakoyaria.
english: All your fortresses are like fig trees with their first ripe fruit; when they are shaken, the figs fall into the mouth of the eater.

ekegusii: Abagambi bao bonsi batamire bare amo, nigo babwatirwe batararaswa chinsara. Abanto bao bonsi banyoretwe nigo babwatetwe, nonya konya batamire gochia aare.
english: All your leaders have fled together; they have been captured without using the bow. All you who were caught were taken prisoner together, having fled while the enemy was still far away.

ekegusii: Obonene bwao amo namariogi ’amakano ao biarentirwe aiga aase abakure; ebinyegera nabio ekerarero kiao na amakonde naro ekiebisio kiao.
english: All your pomp has been brought down to the grave, along with the noise of your harps; maggots are spread out beneath you and worms cover you.

ekegusii: Chiganchwa chiao nigo chikouboka rimisu ri’amaguta a manemane, na ay’omogaka, na aya kasia. Korwa ase chinyomba chichabeire amaino e chinchogu abanto nigo bakobugia amakano na gokogokia.
english: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces adorned with ivory the music of the strings makes you glad.

ekegusii: “Abana bao bonsi mbabe bakworokererigwa n’Omonene, na omorembe omonge nobe amo nabarabwo.
english: All your sons will be taught by the LORD, and great will be your children's peace.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ao onsi nay’ekeene, na okogamba kwao gwonsi kw’oboronge nogwa kare na kare.
english: All your words are true; all your righteous laws are eternal.

ekegusii: na Alameleki, na Amadi, na Misali. Ensemo ya bosongo orobebe rwabo rogatwomera Karimeli na Sihori‐Libinati.
english: Allammelech, Amad and Mishal. On the west the boundary touched Carmel and Shihor Libnath.

ekegusii: Allow no sleep to your eyes, no slumber to your eyelids.
english: Tobaisa korara gose gosundoka;

ekegusii: Obeke ubani echenire ase kera orwaro ebe ekemanyererio, ne ribaga ri’emegati eyio ubani eyio eruegwe buna okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene.
