english: Along each row put some pure incense as a memorial portion to represent the bread and to be an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Boigo ase ribebe ri’abanto ba Manase mbabwate Beti‐Sehani na ebichie biaye, na Taanaki na ebichie biaye, na Megido na ebichie biaye, na Dori na ebichie biaye. Ase emechie eyio na ebichie nao abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, mosinto o Israeli, bamenyete.
english: Along the borders of Manasseh were Beth Shan, Taanach, Megiddo and Dor, together with their villages. The descendants of Joseph son of Israel lived in these towns.

ekegusii: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
english: Asaria, na Ezara, na Mesulamu;

ekegusii: Along with his fellowship offering of thanksgiving he is to present an offering with cakes of bread made with yeast.
english: Amo nekeng’wanso kiaye ki’omorembe ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, arente emegati ebekire ememera.

ekegusii: Omobaro obo amo nabanto bamwabo borokereretigwe goterera Omonene, abamanyete gotera buya kegima, nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na batano na batato (288).
english: Along with their relatives-- all of them trained and skilled in music for the LORD-- they numbered 288.

ekegusii: Already you have all you want! Already you have become rich! You have become kings-- and that without us! How I wish that you really had become kings so that we might be kings with you!
english: Mwaikire koigota! Mwaikire konyora obotenenku! Mwanyorire oboruoti intwe totaiyo! Anga mbuya onye mwagambete, erinde naintwe togambe amo nainwe!

ekegusii: Gokaba okoamererania ase egati yabo, gose ning’o asebare obarirwe koba omonene kobua abande.
english: Also a dispute arose among them as to which of them was considered to be greatest.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aino ay’omogoko, na amatuko achikire abe Amatuko Amanene asemore, na ase omochakano bw’emetienyi namobe mokobugia ebirombeta igoro y’ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, na ebirombeta ebio bigere mobe mokoinyorwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae oino. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: Also at your times of rejoicing-- your appointed feasts and New Moon festivals-- you are to sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, and they will be a memorial for you before your God. I am the LORD your God."

ekegusii: na Basemati, omoiseke o Isumaeli, omoiseke omwabo Nebayoti,
english: also Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

ekegusii: Na bosio bw’ekerogo keria ki’obonene nigo arenge aase buna enyancha egwekaine ekerore gekomeka‐meka. Agwo gati‐gati goetanana ekerogo keria ki’obonene nchiarengeo ching’iti inye chire moyo, chiichire amaiso bosio na nyuma.
english: Also before the throne there was what looked like a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were four living creatures, and they were covered with eyes, in front and in back.

ekegusii: na orue edivai ebituba bibere ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.
english: Also bring half a hin of wine as a drink offering. It will be an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Also Conaniah along with Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel and Jozabad, the leaders of the Levites, provided five thousand Passover offerings and five hundred head of cattle for the Levites.
english: Konania, amo na Semaya na Netaneli, abamura bamwabo, na Hasabia, na Yeieli, na Yosabadi, abanene b’Abalawi, bakaa Abalawi chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na echie chimbori, chilifu isano (5,000), chibe ebing’wanso bi’Epasaka, ne chiombe amagana atano (500).

ekegusii: also Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
english: Elioenai na Yaakoba, Yesohaya na Asaia, Adieli na Yesimieli, na Benaya;

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Dani bakaegwa Eliteke, na Gibetoni,
english: Also from the tribe of Dan they received Eltekeh, Gibbethon,

ekegusii: Gomeri amo nomoganda oye bwonsi bw’esegi, na egesaku gia Togarima kemenyete aare, ensemo ya sugusu, amo nemeganda yaye yonsi, ee, abanto abange mbache amo naye.
english: also Gomer with all its troops, and Beth Togarmah from the far north with all its troops-- the many nations with you.

ekegusii: Naende nkabaa Chisabato chiane chikaba ekemanyererio ase egati yane na barabwo, erio banyare komanya ng’a ninche Omonene nkobachena.
english: Also I gave them my Sabbaths as a sign between us, so they would know that I the LORD made them holy.

ekegusii: Nkabogoria egento keria ki’ebibe, emori eria konya mwaroisirie, nkayesamba nomorero, nkayesunyunta, nkayesia ekaba orotu. Ngatuguta orotu orwo ase akarooche ’karenge gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa keria.
english: Also I took that sinful thing of yours, the calf you had made, and burned it in the fire. Then I crushed it and ground it to powder as fine as dust and threw the dust into a stream that flowed down the mountain.

ekegusii: Ase ense y’Abayuda okoboko kwa Nyasae nao kwarenge kobaa ebirengererio ebimo gokora ogwancha kw’Omonene, buna omoruoti na abagambi baria bachigete.
english: Also in Judah the hand of God was on the people to give them unity of mind to carry out what the king and his officials had ordered, following the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: Also make around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
english: Erio obeke orosingo robe nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na oroetananie omong’ororia bw’etahabu.

ekegusii: Amache orabe gokonywa naro goika arengwe, abe inse y’elita eyemo ase rituko erimo; naboigo orabe gokonywa rituko ase rituko.
english: Also measure out a sixth of a hin of water and drink it at set times.

ekegusii: “Korwa ase amaicho are ase amarisio ’Abaisraeli morue eng’ondi eyemo korwa ase ching’ondi amagana abere, ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase abanto. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: Also one sheep is to be taken from every flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel. These will be used for the grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the people, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Ababisa baito nigo bateba, “Abayahudi tibagotoigwa gose gotorora, goika tobabosokane, tobaite totange emeremo eyio.”
english: Also our enemies said, "Before they know it or see us, we will be right there among them and will kill them and put an end to the work."

ekegusii: “Obeke Urimu na Tumimu (engencho yaye omobaso na oboikeranu) ime y’egesembe gi’ekina bibe igoro y’enkoro ya Haroni, ekero akogenda ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ekero Haroni are ase obosio bw’Omonene abogorie ekiorokererio gi’ekina botambe ase engencho y’Abaisraeli.”
english: Also put the Urim and the Thummim in the breastpiece, so they may be over Aaron's heart whenever he enters the presence of the LORD. Thus Aaron will always bear the means of making decisions for the Israelites over his heart before the LORD.

ekegusii: Otebie Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteba: Aye gwasambire ebuku eye na koboria Yeremia ng’a nase ki arikire amang’ana imeo ng’a omoruoti o Babeli nachiche asarie ense eye na gosiria abanto bonsi ne ching’iti chionsi.
english: Also tell Jehoiakim king of Judah, 'This is what the LORD says: You burned that scroll and said, "Why did you write on it that the king of Babylon would certainly come and destroy this land and cut off both men and animals from it?"

ekegusii: Omogati one nakoete, na obosie obonuke, na amaguta amaya, na obooke, ebio okabirua ase emegwekano eyio koba rimisu rigiya rikoyegwenera; ee, nabo gwakorete.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: Also the food I provided for you-- the fine flour, olive oil and honey I gave you to eat-- you offered as fragrant incense before them. That is what happened, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Amaranya amo nemegondo ere mbarabare y’orooche rwa Naili mbiome bisareke kegima.
english: also the plants along the Nile, at the mouth of the river. Every sown field along the Nile will become parched, will blow away and be no more.

ekegusii: Mbarabare ase ekebekerero keria gie chitaya nereo emezeituni ebere, oyomo ensemo y’okorio na oyonde ensemo y’okobee.”
english: Also there are two olive trees by it, one on the right of the bowl and the other on its left."

ekegusii: Erio nkaria eira y’ogotiana, agwo ase erooro, ng’a mbasiarere ase egati y’ebisaku, na kobaserebania gochia ase chinse chionsi.
english: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the desert that I would disperse them among the nations and scatter them through the countries,

ekegusii: Naende nkaria eira y’ogotiana agwo ase erooro ng’a tinkobaira ase ense eria konya nabaeire, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, ense ere nobonene goetania chinse chinde chionsi.
english: Also with uplifted hand I swore to them in the desert that I would not bring them into the land I had given them-- a land flowing with milk and honey, most beautiful of all lands--

ekegusii: Boigo naende agatokania, agatotebia ng’a titobaisa koagacha chinyomba gose kobusura chimbusuro, gose gosimeka, gose gotwara emegondo y’emesabibu, korende ng’a tomenye ase chiema ase amatuko aito onsi, erio nario toragenderere koba moyo ase ense eye intwe tore abamenyi.
english: Also you must never build houses, sow seed or plant vineyards; you must never have any of these things, but must always live in tents. Then you will live a long time in the land where you are nomads.'

ekegusii: Naende Yehu, mosinto o Nimusi, omoake amaguta, omobeke abe omoruoti igoro y’Abaisraeli; na Elisha, mosinto o Safati, korwa Abeli‐Mehola omoake amaguta, abe omobani ase ribaga riao.
english: Also, anoint Jehu son of Nimshi king over Israel, and anoint Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel Meholah to succeed you as prophet.

ekegusii: Abanto babere kobararare amo mbaigwe riberera korende naki oyomo arakore aigwe riberera kare bweka?
english: Also, if two lie down together, they will keep warm. But how can one keep warm alone?

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio onsi abasike b’Abayuda nigo bagendererete konagotoma amarube amange ase Tobia, nere nabo agendererete kona-gotoma ayande ase okobairaneria.
english: Also, in those days the nobles of Judah were sending many letters to Tobiah, and replies from Tobiah kept coming to them.

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Sulemani nigo arenge korokwa Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, Omoefarati o Sereda. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Serua, ere nigo arenge omoboraka. Yeroboamu akaanga koigwera omoruoti.
english: Also, Jeroboam son of Nebat rebelled against the king. He was one of Solomon's officials, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, and his mother was a widow named Zeruah.

ekegusii: Morigerie omochie oyio ase nabatomire gochia amaya; sabera omochie oyio ase Omonene, ekiagera obuya bwaye nabwo bore obwaino.
english: Also, seek the peace and prosperity of the city to which I have carried you into exile. Pray to the LORD for it, because if it prospers, you too will prosper."

ekegusii: Egesasimero boigo kegatandoka, ne ribu rigaiteka koreng’ana buna ekemanyererio keria giatebetwe nomonto oria o Nyasae ase ogochika kw’Omonene.
english: Also, the altar was split apart and its ashes poured out according to the sign given by the man of God by the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende ebikorero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae biroisirie korwa ase chitahabu ne chifeta, biria Nebukadinesaro arusetie korwa ase Hekalu yare Yerusalemu, akabiira Babeli, bionsi biiranigwe bibekwe naende ime ase Hekalu ere Yerusalemu; mobibeke ime ase enyomba ya Nyasae, kera ekemo aase aye.”
english: Also, the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, are to be returned to their places in the temple in Jerusalem; they are to be deposited in the house of God.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Memifisi na aba Tapanesi baikaranseire emetwe yaino.
english: Also, the men of Memphis and Tahpanhes have shaved the crown of your head.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, abasomba b’omoruoti nigo bacha kogokera omonene oito, omoruoti Daudi, bagoteba: Nyasae oo akore erieta ria Sulemani rimanyekane mono kobua eriao, naende akore ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Sulemani kebue ekiao. Ere omoruoti nigo asasimete kare borere bwaye,
english: Also, the royal officials have come to congratulate our lord King David, saying, 'May your God make Solomon's name more famous than yours and his throne greater than yours!' And the king bowed in worship on his bed

ekegusii: Abaamate bamwabo abamenyete ang’e amo nabwo bamenyete ase chingongo chia Isakaru na Sabuloni, na Nafutali, abwo bakarenta chindagera baberegetie chitigere ne chingamia, ne chiyombo, ne chiombe; bakarenta chindagera chinyinge mono; obosie, na amabomba ’amako amomo na ay’amasabibu amomo, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ekiagera Abaisraeli nigo barenge nomogoko omonene.
english: Also, their neighbors from as far away as Issachar, Zebulun and Naphtali came bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules and oxen. There were plentiful supplies of flour, fig cakes, raisin cakes, wine, oil, cattle and sheep, for there was joy in Israel.

ekegusii: Omonto arenge goika asare na gotung’ama ase okoorokia amasikani, Abisalomu nigo arenge korambora okoboko kwaye obwata omonto oyio na komonyunyunta.
english: Also, whenever anyone approached him to bow down before him, Absalom would reach out his hand, take hold of him and kiss him.

ekegusii: Omonyabibe nakora ebibe ara rigana, naende agenderere koba moyo ase engaki entambe; nonya naboigo, nimanyete ng’a nigo erabe buya ase abwo bamoirogete Nyasae, ekiagera bamoirogete.
english: Although a wicked man commits a hundred crimes and still lives a long time, I know that it will go better with God-fearing men, who are reverent before God.

ekegusii: Korende aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa tarusetigwe korwa ase Abaisraeli. Korende nonya naboigo, Asa akaba omwegenwa ase Omonene amatuko aye onsi.
english: Although he did not remove the high places from Israel, Asa's heart was fully committed [to the LORD] all his life.

ekegusii: Korende aase aimokererete igoro tarusetigweo. Nonya naboigo, ase obogima bwaye bwonsi Asa nigo arenge nenkoro y’obwegenwa ase Omonene.
english: Although he did not remove the high places, Asa's heart was fully committed to the LORD all his life.

ekegusii: naende konya amochikire ase ring’ana erio, ng’a tabaisa gotunyana chinyasae chinde. Korende Sulemani tarenda amang’ana ayio Omonene amochigete.
english: Although he had forbidden Solomon to follow other gods, Solomon did not keep the LORD's command.

ekegusii: Nonya orenge Omwana akeorokereria okoigwera ase emechando eyio yamonyorete,
english: Although he was a son, he learned obedience from what he suffered

ekegusii: Inche inde omoke kobua abachenu bonsi; nonya nabo nkaegwa obuya bw’okoranderia abanto b’Ebisaku obonda bwa Kristo, obo botari korengeka.
english: Although I am less than the least of all God's people, this grace was given me: to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

ekegusii: Nonya inde omonyene oboronge, nabarirwe ng’a nomonyaborimo inde; amaote aane takonyara kogwena, nonya gosaria konde tikori ime asende.
english: Although I am right, I am considered a liar; although I am guiltless, his arrow inflicts an incurable wound.'

ekegusii: “Inche nigo naete Farao ribaga arente obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo; ase ayio ere amo nomoganda oye bwonsi barare ase egati y’abatarogeti, abwo baitetwe nemioro. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: Although I had him spread terror in the land of the living, Pharaoh and all his hordes will be laid among the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Nigo nakorikeire amang’ana aya, inde nogosemeria ng’a ninchiche asore bwango.
english: Although I hope to come to you soon, I am writing you these instructions so that,

ekegusii: (nonya Yeso omonyene tare kobatisa, otatiga aborokigwa baye),
english: although in fact it was not Jesus who baptized, but his disciples.

ekegusii: Nabo nekeene ng’a inche nomonyamwando o iso biara inde, korende nare omonyamwando onde omoao ore ang’e kombua.
english: Although it is true that I am near of kin, there is a kinsman-redeemer nearer than I.

ekegusii: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
english: Nonya Yusufu omanyete abamwabo, barabwo tibamomanyete ere.

ekegusii: Abanto abange korwa ase Abaefraimu, na Abamanase, na Abaisakaru, na Abasabuloni, konya tibarechena; korende nonya naboigo, bakaria chinyama chie ching’ondi chi’Epasaka buna ogochika gotarenge goteba. Hezekia konya obasabeire, ogoteba, “Omonene, ase obuya bwao ororere kera oyomo amabera,
english: Although most of the many people who came from Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun had not purified themselves, yet they ate the Passover, contrary to what was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, "May the LORD, who is good, pardon everyone

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, nonya ebibe biaito bigotosoera, otokonye ase engencho y’erieta riao; twairanire nyuma ara aange, twakorire ebibe asore.
english: Although our sins testify against us, O LORD, do something for the sake of your name. For our backsliding is great; we have sinned against you.

ekegusii: Abasiiria nigo bachete nabarwani abake mono, korende Omonene akabeka abarwani abange mono ase amaboko abo, ekiagera Abayuda konya batigire Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo. Igo Yoashi akaegwa egesusuro.
english: Although the Aramean army had come with only a few men, the LORD delivered into their hands a much larger army. Because Judah had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers, judgment was executed on Joash.

ekegusii: Nonya Omonene ogochia kobaa inwe omogati ekero more nemechando, na amache ekero more nobororo, aborokia baino tibakogenderera kwebisa, korende mobe mokobarora namaiso aino.
english: Although the Lord gives you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, your teachers will be hidden no more; with your own eyes you will see them.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Omonene agatoma ababani ase egati yabo, erinde babairanie asare; aba bakaba bakobakurera korende abanto tibabaigwerete.
english: Although the LORD sent prophets to the people to bring them back to him, and though they testified against them, they would not listen.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakomumura buna amache amange, korende Omonene nabatogonyere, nabarabwo batame gochia aare: mbaserigwe, babe buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga igoro ase ebitunwa, na buna orotu rokoirurukigwa nekembugu‐mbugu.
english: Although the peoples roar like the roar of surging waters, when he rebukes them they flee far away, driven before the wind like chaff on the hills, like tumbleweed before a gale.

ekegusii: Korende nonya abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa tibarenge ne ribaga gocha ase egesasimero ki’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, bakaba bakoria emegati etabekiri memera amo nabamwabo.
english: Although the priests of the high places did not serve at the altar of the LORD in Jerusalem, they ate unleavened bread with their fellow priests.

ekegusii: Bagateba ng’a mbare nobong’aini, korende bakaririeka.
english: Although they claimed to be wise, they became fools

ekegusii: Nabaisa kweng’ata, inche tinkoigwa okorera kwabo; gose nabaisa korua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, tingwanchera ebinto ebio. Goika mbaite nemioro, na enchara na amarwaire agoita, erinde mbasirie kegima.”
english: Although they fast, I will not listen to their cry; though they offer burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them. Instead, I will destroy them with the sword, famine and plague."

ekegusii: Ee, nonya benyoreire abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao ng’a babakonye, nimbasangererie amo bwango, mbakeyie babe inse y’ogochandwa kw’omoruoti oria bw’abagambi.
english: Although they have sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them together. They will begin to waste away under the oppression of the mighty king.

ekegusii: Barabwo abanyene mbamanyete mono ekina kia Nyasae kia boronge, ng’a abagokora ayaiga nebagwenerete amakweri; tibakorete aya oka, korende nigo bagwancherana nabwo bakoyakora.
english: Although they know God's righteous decree that those who do such things deserve death, they not only continue to do these very things but also approve of those who practice them.

ekegusii: Nonya bagokwana, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo,” nigo bagotiana ase obong’ainereria.
english: Although they say, 'As surely as the LORD lives,' still they are swearing falsely."

ekegusii: Bono emebere yaito nabo ere nengencho enene buna ey’abaminto, na abana baito nigo bare nengencho enene buna ababo, ko bono rora, yatobetereirie kobeka abana baito, abamura na abaiseke, ase obosomba. Abaiseke baito bande baikire koba abasomba, korende intwe titobwati okobua kw’ogotanga ring’ana erio tiriba bo, ekiagera abanto abaao nabwo babwate amaremo aito amo nemegondo yaito y’emesabibu.”
english: Although we are of the same flesh and blood as our countrymen and though our sons are as good as theirs, yet we have to subject our sons and daughters to slavery. Some of our daughters have already been enslaved, but we are powerless, because our fields and our vineyards belong to others."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba ng’a inwe moise kogenderera gokwana: Egurube y’Omonene, na kwanga koigwera, korende mogokwana amang’ana ayio Omonene abakanirie ng’a timobaisa gokwana bo,
english: Although you claim, 'This is the oracle of the LORD,' this is what the LORD says: You used the words, 'This is the oracle of the LORD,' even though I told you that you must not claim, 'This is the oracle of the LORD.'

ekegusii: Inwe namoisa gwesiberia esabuni ere ne chinguru chi’okorusia riko, ebimoa bi’okomocha kwaino nigo bigendererete koba ase obosio bwane.
english: Although you wash yourself with soda and use an abundance of soap, the stain of your guilt is still before me," declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: (Na ase emeeri ime nigo twarenge abanto amagana abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batano nomo.)
english: Altogether there were 276 of us on board.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na etano (175), ase obogima bwaye.
english: Altogether, Abraham lived a hundred and seventy-five years.

ekegusii: Adamu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etato (930), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Adam lived 930 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Enoku nigo abete nemiaka amagana atato, na emerongo etano nomo, ne etano (365),
english: Altogether, Enoch lived 365 years.

ekegusii: Enosu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na etano (905), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Enosh lived 905 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Isumaeli nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137), erio agakwa; agasangererekana amo nabanto baye.
english: Altogether, Ishmael lived a hundred and thirty-seven years. He breathed his last and died, and he was gathered to his people.

ekegusii: Yaredi nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na ebere (962), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Jared lived 962 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Kainani nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi (910), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Kenan lived 910 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Lameki nigo akoorete emiaka amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na etano na ebere (777), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Lamech lived 777 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Mahalaleeli nigo akoorete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo kianda, na etano (895), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Mahalalel lived 895 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Metusela nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano nomo, na kianda (969), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Methuselah lived 969 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Nuhu nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na emerongo etano (950), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Noah lived 950 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Seti nigo akoorete emiaka amagana kianda, na ikomi na ebere (912), erio agakwa.
english: Altogether, Seth lived 912 years, and then he died.

ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi amagana abere, na ikomi na babere (212) nigo bachoretwe bakaba abarendi b’ebisoero bi’ebiita. Bakabarwa na korikwa ase chinderia chiabo. Daudi na Samweli omorori bakababeka ase emeremo, ekiagera babegenete.
english: Altogether, those chosen to be gatekeepers at the thresholds numbered 212. They were registered by genealogy in their villages. The gatekeepers had been assigned to their positions of trust by David and Samuel the seer.

ekegusii: Tiga chianga chiao chibe chindabu botambe, na amaguta okweakwa tamocha ase omotwe oo.
english: Always be clothed in white, and always anoint your head with oil.

ekegusii: mokomoakera Nyasae Tata ng’a mbuya mono amatuko onsi, ase amang’ana onsi, ase erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakweorokereria botambe, korende tibakonyara goikera chisemi chi’ekeene.
english: always learning but never able to acknowledge the truth.

ekegusii: Inee! Inche tindi omosibore? Inche tindi omotomwa? Tinaroche Yeso, Omonene oito? Inwe timori okwama kw’emeremo yane ase Omonene?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Have I not seen Jesus our Lord? Are you not the result of my work in the Lord?

ekegusii: Bono inee! Nigo nkorigia ogwancherwa korwa ase mwanyabanto, gose korwa ase Nyasae? Gose nigo nkorigia kogwenera mwanyabanto? Onye nabete nkogwenera mwanyabanto goika bono, anga tinabete omosomba o Kristo.
english: Am I now trying to win the approval of men, or of God? Or am I trying to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.

ekegusii: Inee! Inche nigo mborire abanto chibarimo? Ninki kiagera mwarenta ebarimo eye gocha kogosoria obobarimo bwaye ase obosio bwane? Inee! Omonto buna oyo nanyore ribaga asoe nyomba mwane?”
english: Am I so short of madmen that you have to bring this fellow here to carry on like this in front of me? Must this man come into my house?"

ekegusii: Inee! Chinibo chi’obourereria nchigenderere kobeera ase chinyomba chi’abakori amabe? Na ebirengero bitaikeraneti biragereirie mbibeereo?
english: Am I still to forget, O wicked house, your ill-gotten treasures and the short ephah, which is accursed?

ekegusii: “Nase ki obegete oborendi igoro yane? Inche nenyancha inde, gose neng’iti enene mono ya nyancha?
english: Am I the sea, or the monster of the deep, that you put me under guard?

ekegusii: Amam, Shema, Moladah,
english: na Amamu, na Sema, na Molada,

ekegusii: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
english: Amaria, na Maluku, na Hatusi;

ekegusii: Na Amasa igo arenge kogara‐gara ase amanyinga, gati‐gati y’enchera enene. Ekero omosomba oria aroche ng’a abanto bonsi batenenire, akaimokia omobere bw’Amasa korwa inchera, akayoruta mogondo ime, akayobisia egetambaa.
english: Amasa lay wallowing in his blood in the middle of the road, and the man saw that all the troops came to a halt there. When he realized that everyone who came up to Amasa stopped, he dragged him from the road into a field and threw a garment over him.

ekegusii: Amasa teritete korwa ase omoyio oria Yoabu abwate koboko kwaye. Ase igo Yoabu akamobeta omoyio oria enda, na amara akagwa inse. Erio agwo Amasa agakwa, na Yoabu tamoaka eria kabere. Nyuma y’ayio Yoabu na Abisai, momura omwabo, bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, gochia komoita.
english: Amasa was not on his guard against the dagger in Joab's hand, and Joab plunged it into his belly, and his intestines spilled out on the ground. Without being stabbed again, Amasa died. Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued Sheba son of Bicri.

ekegusii: Bagakumia bonsi, bagaichana na koborania, “Amang’ana aya, engencho yaye ninki?”
english: Amazed and perplexed, they asked one another, "What does this mean?"

ekegusii: Amasia akaboria monto oria o Nyasae, “Ngento ki togokora ase chitalanta chiria rigana erimo naakanire abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli?” Omonto oria o Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Omonene nabwate okobua gokoa chinyinge mono goetania echio.”
english: Amaziah asked the man of God, "But what about the hundred talents I paid for these Israelite troops?" The man of God replied, "The LORD can give you much more than that."

ekegusii: Amasia agasangereria Abayuda, akabeka kera eamate y’Abayuda na ey’Ababenjamin inse y’abatang’ani be chilifu na ab’amagana. Akabara abanto barenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, akanyora ng’a nigo barenge chilifu amagana atato (300,000), abanto bachoretwe, bamanyete korwana esegi namatimo ne chinguba.
english: Amaziah called the people of Judah together and assigned them according to their families to commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds for all Judah and Benjamin. He then mustered those twenty years old or more and found that there were three hundred thousand men ready for military service, able to handle the spear and shield.

ekegusii: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
english: Yoashi akaibora Amasia, na Amasia akaibora Asaria, na Asaria akaibora Yotamu;

ekegusii: Amasia, mosinto o Yoashi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akagenderera koba moyo emiaka ikomi na etano nyuma y’ogokwa kwa Yehoasi, mosinto o Yehoahasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.

ekegusii: Amasia, mosinto o Yoashi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akagenderera koba moyo emiaka ikomi na etano nyuma y’ogokwa kwa Yehoasi mosinto o Yehoahasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah lived for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel.

ekegusii: Amasia akaba omoremu agatang’ana abanto baye, akagenda ase Riranya ri’Omonyo, agaita Abaseiri chilifu ikomi,
english: Amaziah then marshaled his strength and led his army to the Valley of Salt, where he killed ten thousand men of Seir.

ekegusii: Amasia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na etano, ekero achagete kogamba; ere akagamba emiaka emerongo ebere na kianda, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Yehoadani korwa Yerusalemu.
english: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother's name was Jehoaddin; she was from Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Korende Amasia tanchete gotegerera. Nyasae nigo achigete ng’a Abayuda babekwe ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, ekiagera barigetie chinyasae chi’Abaedomu.
english: Amaziah, however, would not listen, for God so worked that he might hand them over to [Jehoash], because they sought the gods of Edom.

ekegusii: Korende Amasia tanchete gotegerera. Ase ayio Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akagenda koumerana nere, na igo ere na Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, bakarigererania obosio ase obosio ase okorwana esegi agwo Beti‐Semesi, omochie bw’Abayuda.
english: Amaziah, however, would not listen, so Jehoash king of Israel attacked. He and Amaziah king of Judah faced each other at Beth Shemesh in Judah.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bararire chitoro chindito na inche narenge nebirengererio na korora amaroro,
english: Amid disquieting dreams in the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

ekegusii: Amieli oyo o gatano na rimo; Isakaru oyo o gatano na kabere; Peuletai oyo o gatano na gatato. Nyasae nigo asesenetie Obedi‐Edomu.
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh and Peullethai the eighth. (For God had blessed Obed-Edom.)

ekegusii: Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,
english: Aminadabu akaibora Nahesoni, na Nahesoni akaibora Salimoni;

ekegusii: Amunoni agachandeka mono ase okomogania Tamari, omoiseke omwabo, goika agekora buna nomorwaire are. Omoiseke oria nigo arenge omwekungi; Amunoni agasinywa komokorera buna aganetie.
english: Amnon became frustrated to the point of illness on account of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed impossible for him to do anything to her.

ekegusii: Manase akaibora Amoni, na Amoni akaibora Yosia.
english: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

ekegusii: Amoni nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ebere agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years.

ekegusii: Amoni nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ebere agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Mesulemeti, mosubati o Harusi korwa Yotiba.
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem two years. His mother's name was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz; she was from Jotbah.

ekegusii: Ase egati y’abanto aba nigo barenge abanto bachoretwe amagana atano na abere, barenge abanyakebee. Kera omonto obo nigo amanyete koruta rigena nenduruche, erio orenga agatukia akamo, ogaaka, tarenge gokamocha.
english: Among all these soldiers there were seven hundred chosen men who were left-handed, each of whom could sling a stone at a hair and not miss.

ekegusii: Okwemurungania okonene gokaba ase egati y’omoganda ase engencho yaye. Abande bakabora, “Nigo are omonto omuya,” na abande bakabora, “Taibo, korende nigo agotantania omoganda.”
english: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, "He is a good man." Others replied, "No, he deceives the people."

ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’abakuani konya banyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao nabwo aba: Ab’eamate ya Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, na abamwabo: Maaseya, na Eliezeri, na Yaribu, na Gedalia.
english: Among the descendants of the priests, the following had married foreign women: From the descendants of Jeshua son of Jozadak, and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib and Gedaliah.

ekegusii: Omonene, enyasae teri enga buna aye, gose emeremo ende teri enga buna eyao.
english: Among the gods there is none like you, O Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.

ekegusii: Among the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah (that is, Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah and Eliezer.
english: Abalawi nabwo aba: Yosabadi na Simei, Kelaya (nere Kelita) na Petahia, Yuda na Eliezeri.

ekegusii: Abande ba baria emerongo etato nabwo aba: Asaeli, momura omwabo Yoabu, na Elihanani, mosinto o Dodo korwa Bethlehemu;
english: Among the Thirty were: Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem,

ekegusii: Amo nabwo baitetwe nigo barenge abaruoti batano b’Abamidiani. Abaruoti abwo nabwo aba: Ebi, na Rekemu, na Suri, na Huri, na Reba. Boigo bagaita na Baalamu, mosinto o Beori nomoro.
english: Among their victims were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur and Reba-- the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.

ekegusii: Ase abwo mbareo Humenayo na Aleksanderi, abwo nabaeire Saitani, erinde borokererigwe tibarama Nyasae.
english: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.

ekegusii: Ase abwo nigo barenge Mariamu Magidalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na Yusufu, na ng’ina ’abana ba Zebedi.
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedee's sons.

ekegusii: Ase egati y’abwo bachoretwe, korwa ase Abayuda nabwo aba: Danieli, na Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria.
english: Among these were some from Judah: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.

ekegusii: “Ekero morabe more ase egati y’ebisaku ebio timokonyora obotoereru, gose amagoro aino takonyora aase agotimokera; korende aroro agwo Omonene nabae chinkoro chi’obwoba, na amasio agosunkera naende mobe nobogima bochandegete bw’okwerusia moyo.
english: Among those nations you will find no repose, no resting place for the sole of your foot. There the LORD will give you an anxious mind, eyes weary with longing, and a despairing heart.

ekegusii: Oyo orenge kobogoria egesibao ki’obokuani nere Ahia, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, momura omwabo Ikabodi. Ahitubu nere orenge mosinto o Finehasi o Eli, omokuani bw’Omonene agwo Silo. Abanto tibamanyete ng’a Yonathani konya ochiire.
english: among whom was Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod. He was a son of Ichabod's brother Ahitub son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the LORD's priest in Shiloh. No one was aware that Jonathan had left.

ekegusii: Abasomba baye bagakora omoroberio bw’okomoita na bakamoitera ase enyomba yaye ime.
english: Amon's officials conspired against him and assassinated him in his palace.

ekegusii: Abasomba b’Amoni bagakora omoroberio bw’okomoita, bakamoitera ase enyomba yaye ime.
english: Amon's officials conspired against him and assassinated the king in his palace.

ekegusii: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites and Jebusites."
english: na Abaamori, na Abakanani, na Abagirigasi, na Abayebusi.”

ekegusii: Erio Amosi akairaneria Amasia, akamotebia, “Inche tindi omobani, gose omwana bw’omobani bworokereretigwe obobani, nigo narenge omorisia, naende omorendi bw’emeko.
english: Amos answered Amaziah, "I was neither a prophet nor a prophet's son, but I was a shepherd, and I also took care of sycamore-fig trees.

ekegusii: Amuramu akanyuoma Yokebedi, omoiseke omwabo ise; na ere akamoiborera Haroni na Musa. Amuramu nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137).
english: Amram married his father's sister Jochebed, who bore him Aaron and Moses. Amram lived 137 years.

ekegusii: Omomalaika akamoorokera korwa, igoro, akamobeka chinguru.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.

ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene akabaorokera, obonene bw’Omonene bokababarera; bagasogwa nomoondoko omonge.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

ekegusii: Omonto obwate endamwamu nigo agoseegeta eriomana, na oyo okogechigwa nigo akorenta ogosaria okonge.
english: An angry man stirs up dissension, and a hot-tempered one commits many sins.

ekegusii: Ogoichana kore ase enkoro y’omonto nigo gokomoiyeria, korende ring’ana rigiya nigo rikomorentera omogoko.
english: An anxious heart weighs a man down, but a kind word cheers him up.

ekegusii: Ensemo ende eisaine obotambe bwe chimoti emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000), nebe ey’Abalawi, abwo bagokora emeremo ase Hekalu; eyio nebe omwando obo ase baraagache emechie bakomenya.
english: An area 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide will belong to the Levites, who serve in the temple, as their possession for towns to live in.

ekegusii: Nabo okoamererania gokaoroka ase egati y’aborokigwa ba Yohana na Omoyahudi oyomo ase amang’ana ogwesibia.
english: An argument developed between some of John's disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.

ekegusii: Okoengererania kogatuboka ase egati yabo ng’a ning’o asebare ore omonene kobua abande.
english: An argument started among the disciples as to which of them would be the greatest.

ekegusii: Oyo ogosiria oimokire gocha kobarwania. Renda chiburi chiaino more nebirwanero, morende ne chinchera; eboyie ebinema biaino mokong’e, mobe ne chinguru chinyinge.
english: An attacker advances against you, [Nineveh]. Guard the fortress, watch the road, brace yourselves, marshal all your strength!

ekegusii: Omonto orachorwe onye okonyorekana ng’a tari ne chingencho chimbe, onye ore nomokungu oyomo, na ore nabana begenete, batari gosoerwa ng’a nabanyaka bare, gose abatari koigwera.
english: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, a man whose children believe and are not open to the charge of being wild and disobedient.

ekegusii: Omonto omosaria nigo akonakorigia gokora amabe oka, natomerwe omonto omotindi amoe egesusuro.
english: An evil man is bent only on rebellion; a merciless official will be sent against him.

ekegusii: Omonto omonyabibe nigo agotegwa nobosareku bwaye, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agotera nomogoko na gochenga.
english: An evil man is snared by his own sin, but a righteous one can sing and be glad.

ekegusii: Omonto omobe nigo agotegwa nogosaria gokorwa ase ebikoba biaye, korende omonyene oboronge natooreke korwa ase emechando.
english: An evil man is trapped by his sinful talk, but a righteous man escapes trouble.

ekegusii: Omonto okoiraneria amairanerio amaronge nigo anga okonyunyuntwa kw’ebikoba.
english: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

ekegusii: Oise koba ne ribero ase okonyora omwando bwango korwa omochakano, omoerio oye tori gosesenigwa.
english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning will not be blessed at the end.

ekegusii: Chinse echio chikaba omwando bw’Abaisraeli, abasomba baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: an inheritance to his servant Israel; His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Omotebereria bw’abariri, na omworokia bw’abana abake, ekiagera kwanyorire okworokereria okuya gwe chisemi na ekeene bire ime ase amachiko.
english: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of infants, because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth--

ekegusii: Nigo ere aakong’u koirania ase obosani omonto omocheirwe, kobua koirania omochie omokong’u, na eriomana nigo ringa buna emekorogoto y’ebiita bi’orwaki orokong’u.
english: An offended brother is more unyielding than a fortified city, and disputes are like the barred gates of a citadel.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro y’Abaarabu. Inwe abagendi b’ense ya Dedani, mobe mokorara ase amanani ’ense y’Arabia.
english: An oracle concerning Arabia: You caravans of Dedanites, who camp in the thickets of Arabia,

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, aroche igoro ya Babeli:
english: An oracle concerning Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz saw:

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Damesiki: “Naama! Damesiki tokogenderera koba omochie; nosarigwe, otumbwe amo obe chitui.
english: An oracle concerning Damascus: "See, Damascus will no longer be a city but will become a heap of ruins.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Edomu. Omonto nkondangeria are korwa Seiri, okoboria, “Omorendi, mang’ana ki igoro y’obotuko? Omorendi, mang’ana ki igoro y’obotuko?”
english: An oracle concerning Dumah: Someone calls to me from Seir, "Watchman, what is left of the night? Watchman, what is left of the night?"

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Misiri: Rora, Omonene nigo ariinete riire rikominyoka bwango ogocha Misiri. Erio agwo emegwekano egosasimwa y’Abamisiri nenyegerigwe ase obosio bwaye, ne chinkoro chi’Abamisiri nigo chirairianyeke.
english: An oracle concerning Egypt: See, the LORD rides on a swift cloud and is coming to Egypt. The idols of Egypt tremble before him, and the hearts of the Egyptians melt within them.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro y’ense ya Moabu: Ari o Moabu nosarigwe ase obotuko obomo, nosirigwe kegima! Ee, na Kiri o Moabu osarigwe ase obotuko obomo, osirigwe kegima!
english: An oracle concerning Moab: Ar in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night! Kir in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night!

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana amakong’u igoro ya Nineva arikire ase ebuku y’okorora kwa Nahumu Omoelikosi.
english: An oracle concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ye ching’iti chia Irianyi. Abanto abwo nigo bagoeta ase ense ere nemechando na omoichano, ase chindo chiaberi ne chindo chinde chimenyete amo namarubi, ne chinchoka chikoiruruka. Nigo bakobeerekia chitigere chinibo chiabo, ne chikungo chiabo bachibeka ase chisukubi chie chingamia, bagenda ase abanto batabae bitoki binde.
english: An oracle concerning the animals of the Negev: Through a land of hardship and distress, of lions and lionesses, of adders and darting snakes, the envoys carry their riches on donkeys' backs, their treasures on the humps of camels, to that unprofitable nation,

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro y’erooro ere ang’e nenyancha. Koreng’ana buna ekembugu‐mbugu gekobongia ase ense ya irianyi naboigo na obobe bokorwa ase erooro, ense eyio ekoondokia mono.
english: An oracle concerning the Desert by the Sea: Like whirlwinds sweeping through the southland, an invader comes from the desert, from a land of terror.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ye Rikura ri’Amaroro. Mang’ana ki abeire inwe mwensi mwariinire gochia birama igoro?
english: An oracle concerning the Valley of Vision: What troubles you now, that you have all gone up on the roofs,

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana igoro ya Turo. Inwe abe chimeeri chia Tarisisi, rera, ekiagera Turo osarigwe, chinyomba tichiyo, gose ekiambokero. Abanto b’ense ya Kuporo babamanyirie amang’ana ayio.
english: An oracle concerning Tyre: Wail, O ships of Tarshish! For Tyre is destroyed and left without house or harbor. From the land of Cyprus word has come to them.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana amakong’u Omonene atomerete Abaisraeli goetera ase Malaki.
english: An oracle: The word of the LORD to Israel through Malachi.

ekegusii: gose ise moke, gose omwana o ise moke, gose omoamate omwabo ore ang’e, gose ere omonyene karabe nenibo, nabo areboorie ere omonyene.
english: An uncle or a cousin or any blood relative in his clan may redeem him. Or if he prospers, he may redeem himself.

ekegusii: Omonto bweanchete omonyene, nigo akweganeria ayaye oka; nigo akwanga otindia nonya nase onsi ayare amaya.
english: An unfriendly man pursues selfish ends; he defies all sound judgment.

ekegusii: na ekero omoiseke otanchiri akonyuomwa, na omoiseke omosomba akoba ribaga ri’omokungu oria agokorera emeremo.
english: an unloved woman who is married, and a maidservant who displaces her mistress.

ekegusii: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,
english: na Anabu, na Esitemoa, na Animu,

ekegusii: Anathoth and Almon, together with their pasturelands-- four towns.
english: na Anatoti, na Alamoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

ekegusii: na abanto chilifu ikomi na isano nemo (16,000).
english: and 16,000 people.

ekegusii: and 32,000 women who had never slept with a man.
english: na abaiseke abekungi chilifu emerongo etato; na ibere (32,000).

ekegusii: Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, ekiagera baroche ebikone abakorerete abarwaire.
english: and a great crowd of people followed him because they saw the miraculous signs he had performed on the sick.

ekegusii: Enchera enene eroisirie buya nebeo; eyio nigo erarokwe “Enchera Enchenu”. Abanto batachenegeti tibagoetao; enchera eyio nigo erabe ey’abanto aba boka. Abagoeta aroro, nonya bare abariri, tibagosira.
english: And a highway will be there; it will be called the Way of Holiness. The unclean will not journey on it; it will be for those who walk in that Way; wicked fools will not go about on it.

ekegusii: Na rora, narengeo omonto, okoboko kwaye kwagataete. Bakaboria Yeso, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri’Esabato?” Banyare komosoera.
english: and a man with a shriveled hand was there. Looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, they asked him, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?"

ekegusii: Ase okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa morue edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese ebe rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene.
english: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering. Offer it as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: na eriogi rikarwa igoro, rigateba, “Aye naye Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie naye.”
english: And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."

ekegusii: Na rora, eriogi rikorwa igoro rigateba, “Oyo nere Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere.”
english: And a voice from heaven said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased."

ekegusii: Naende rora, narengeo omokungu obwatire nekerecha ki’oboreu ase emiaka ikomi na etano na etato, na ere konya okogotaire, tare konyara kwerambora nonya ng’ake.
english: and a woman was there who had been crippled by a spirit for eighteen years. She was bent over and could not straighten up at all.

ekegusii: Naende omokungu oyomo oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, osiareire ebinto bionsi ebiarenge nabio ase abarwaria, tanyara kogwenigwa nonde.
english: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years, but no one could heal her.

ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere.
english: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years.

ekegusii: Haroni akabatebia amang’ana onsi Omonene atebetie Musa, na ere agakora ebikone biria ase amaiso ’abanto.
english: and Aaron told them everything the LORD had said to Moses. He also performed the signs before the people,

ekegusii: Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni, nere orenge omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin.
english: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.

ekegusii: Abiyamu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi, na Asa, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: And Abijah rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And Asa his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Abiya agakwa, akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi, na Asa, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye. Ase amatuko aye ense eria nigo yabete nobotoereru ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi.
english: And Abijah rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. Asa his son succeeded him as king, and in his days the country was at peace for ten years.

ekegusii: Abimeleki akaboria Ibrahimu, “Chimanwa echi chisigiti isano na ibere gwatanana, engencho yaye inki?”
english: and Abimelech asked Abraham, "What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs you have set apart by themselves?"

ekegusii: Naende Abimeleki akaboria Ibrahimu, “Inki kwarengereretie goika ogakora ring’ana eri?”
english: And Abimelech asked Abraham, "What was your reason for doing this?"

ekegusii: Abimeleki akamotebia, “Rora, ense yane nigo ere ase obosio bwao; menya aande onsi ase oranche komenya.”
english: And Abimelech said, "My land is before you; live wherever you like."

ekegusii: Nase amang’ana aria twakwanete, inche naye, tiga Omonene abe kirori ase egati yaito kogenderera botambe.”
english: And about the matter you and I discussed-- remember, the LORD is witness between you and me forever."

ekegusii: Na Ibrahimu akamwatanera ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto bionsi. Ritang’ani engencho y’erieta ria Melkizedeki nigo ere iga: “Omoruoti bw’Oboronge”, naende nigo are omoruoti o Salemu, engencho yaye: “Omoruoti bw’Omorembe”.
english: and Abraham gave him a tenth of everything. First, his name means "king of righteousness"; then also, "king of Salem" means "king of peace."

ekegusii: Ibrahimu agatebia Nyasae, “Koranche, Isumaeli abe moyo ase obosio bwao!”
english: And Abraham said to God, "If only Ishmael might live under your blessing!"

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akamenya buna omomenyi ase ense y’Abafilisti amatuko amange.
english: And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines for a long time.

ekegusii: and Abram (that is, Abraham).
english: na Aburamu nere Ibrahimu.

ekegusii: Aburamu akabora naende, “Rora, tong’eti abana, na omosomba oyoiboirwe aa bwone, nere oraire omwando o bwone.”
english: And Abram said, "You have given me no children; so a servant in my household will be my heir."

ekegusii: Naende Abisalomu obora, “Onye nabekwa imbe omogambi ase ense eye, kera omonto ore ne ring’ana gose ekina gete anga nacha asende, nainche anga namokonya na komonyorera oboronge.”
english: And Absalom would add, "If only I were appointed judge in the land! Then everyone who has a complaint or case could come to me and I would see that he gets justice."

ekegusii: Abisalomu, oyo twaaka amaguta akaba omoruoti oito, okure ase esegi. Na bono, naki motari goteba ng’a moiranie Daudi abe omoruoti naende?”
english: and Absalom, whom we anointed to rule over us, has died in battle. So why do you say nothing about bringing the king back?"

ekegusii: Na Adamu tang’ainetwe, korende nomokungu ong’ainetwe, na igo akaba omomochi.
english: And Adam was not the one deceived; it was the woman who was deceived and became a sinner.

ekegusii: Naende agateba, “Boazi nigo antebia ng’a tinkonyara koirana gocha asore namaboko amasa. Ase igo ong’a esairi eye ebitita bitano na ekemo.”
english: and added, "He gave me these six measures of barley, saying, 'Don't go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.'"

ekegusii: Nyuma y’engaki gete moka omonene oye akarigereria Yusufu ase okomogania, akamotebia, “Inchuo orare nainche!”
english: and after a while his master's wife took notice of Joseph and said, "Come to bed with me!"

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Arifaksadi, Shemu nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano (500), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Eberi, Sela nigo amenyete emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Enoku, Yaredi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato (800), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Enosu, Seti nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na etano na ebere (807), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Yaredi, Mahalaleeli nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo etato (830), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa gwa Kainani, Enosu nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na etano (815), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Lameki, Metusela nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na ebere, (782), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Mahalaleeli, Kainani nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atano na atato, na emerongo ene (840), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Enoku akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae. Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Metusela, Enoku nigo amenyete emiaka amagana atato (300), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Nahori, Serugi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana abere (200), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa gwa Pelegi, Eberi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana ane, na emerongo etato (430), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa kwa Reu, Pelegi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana abere, na kianda (209), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa gwa Serugi, Reu nigo amenyete emiaka amagana abere, na etano na ebere (207), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa gwa Sela, Arifaksadi nigo amenyete emiaka amagana ane, na etato (403), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’okoiborwa gwa Tera, Nahori nigo amenyete emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi na kianda (119), akaibora abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: And after he became the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Nigo okoba chinko orutwa riko. Ekero omorero osambire chinsinyo chiaye chionsi, na obogati bwaye bwarurirwe, Inee, bono moremo ki orakorerwe?
english: And after it is thrown on the fire as fuel and the fire burns both ends and chars the middle, is it then useful for anything?

ekegusii: Nyuma risankwa ri’omobere one korirabe riasarekire, erio nindore Nyasae ntari ase omobere one.
english: And after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God;

ekegusii: Naende gakwanire aya, akagenda, akarangeria Mariamu mosubati omwabo, agakwana ng’ora igo, “Omworokia ochire, ngokorangeria are.”
english: And after she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside. "The Teacher is here," she said, "and is asking for you."

ekegusii: akaragera, akanyora chinguru. Akaba agwo amatuko atai make amo naborokigwa abarenge Damesiki.
english: and after taking some food, he regained his strength. Saul spent several days with the disciples in Damascus.

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma y’amatuko atano na abere, etoigo egacha ase ense.
english: And after the seven days the floodwaters came on the earth.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi bakoorire gosarwa, bakabeera aase abo ase egetwori goika bakagwena.
english: And after the whole nation had been circumcised, they remained where they were in camp until they were healed.

ekegusii: mwerende timobaisa gotegwa nemeeto na kobwatia chingencho chiabo banarete gokora. Timorigia komanya igoro ye chinyasae chiabo na koboria: Naki ebisaku ebi biarenge gosasima chinyasae chiabo? Naboigo naintwe tochisasime.
english: and after they have been destroyed before you, be careful not to be ensnared by inquiring about their gods, saying, "How do these nations serve their gods? We will do the same."

ekegusii: “Nebe ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, nimbaiterere abanto bonsi Omoika one; abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inababane, na abagaaka baino nabarote chindoto, na abamura baino nabarore amaroro.
english: 'And afterward, I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, your young men will see visions.

ekegusii: Naende aiga nigo agoteba, “Tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane nonya ng’ake.”
english: And again in the passage above he says, "They shall never enter my rest."

ekegusii: Eria kabere bagateba, “Haleluya! Erioki ri’okoyia kwaye nigo rirachongororoke gochia igoro goika kare na kare.”
english: And again they shouted: "Hallelujah! The smoke from her goes up for ever and ever."

ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteba, “Nimosemerie.” Naende, “Rora, inche nao inde aiga amo nabana baria naetwe na Nyasae.”
english: And again, "I will put my trust in him." And again he says, "Here am I, and the children God has given me."

ekegusii: naende, “Abanto b’Ebisaku bionsi, motogie Omonene; abanto bonsi bamobake!”
english: And again, "Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and sing praises to him, all you peoples."

ekegusii: naende, “Omonene nigo amanyete okorengereria kw’abare nobong’aini ng’a nokwa bosa.”
english: and again, "The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are futile."

ekegusii: Naende Isaya nigo agokwana, “Ritina ria Yese nariche, ere naoroke kogambera abanto b’Ebisaku; nere abanto b’Ebisaku barasemerie.”
english: And again, Isaiah says, "The Root of Jesse will spring up, one who will arise to rule over the nations; the Gentiles will hope in him."

ekegusii: Naende ekero arentete omoiborwa oye bwe ritang’ani ase ense nigo atebete, “Abamalaika bonsi ba Nyasae bamosasime.”
english: And again, when God brings his firstborn into the world, he says, "Let all God's angels worship him."

ekegusii: Ahabu akarangeria Obadia, oria orenge omoteneneri igoro ase enyomba yaye. (Obadia nigo asigete Omonene mono.
english: and Ahab had summoned Obadiah, who was in charge of his palace. (Obadiah was a devout believer in the LORD.

ekegusii: Boigo Ahasi akaimokia chifeta ne chitahabu, echio chianyorekanete ase enyomba y’Omonene, na ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’omoruoti, agachitoma chikaba ekeegwa ase omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
english: And Ahaz took the silver and gold found in the temple of the LORD and in the treasuries of the royal palace and sent it as a gift to the king of Assyria.

ekegusii: Ahiya akabwata egetambaa keria ekeyia ambarete, akagetandora ebing’ese ikomi na bibere,
english: and Ahijah took hold of the new cloak he was wearing and tore it into twelve pieces.

ekegusii: na Ahira, mosinto bw’Enani, nere orenge omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku kia Nafutali.
english: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana onsi igoro y’ogokora kwaye gwonsi, na okobua kwaye, amo namang’ana onsi buna aimokereretie Moredekai igoro, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’abaruoti b’Abamedia na ab’Abaayemi.
english: And all his acts of power and might, together with a full account of the greatness of Mordecai to which the king had raised him, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Media and Persia?

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba bakamanya ng’a Samweli ekeene bwegenirwe koba omobani bw’Omonene.
english: And all Israel from Dan to Beersheba recognized that Samuel was attested as a prophet of the LORD.

ekegusii: na abanto bonsi nabarore ogotooreka gokorwa ase Nyasae.”
english: And all mankind will see God's salvation.'"

ekegusii: na buna akorete abaruoti b’Abaamori, moocha ya Yorodan, nabwo Sihoni, omoruoti o Hesiboni, na Ogi, oyo o Basani, oyio omenyete Asitaroti.
english: and all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of the Jordan-- Sihon king of Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

ekegusii: amo nabaminto bonsi abare amo nainche, nkobarikera tore inwe abanto be chikanisa chia Galatia:
english: and all the brothers with me, To the churches in Galatia:

ekegusii: Abanto be chinse chionsi bagacha Misiri kogora endagera korwa ase Yusufu, ekiagera enchara nigo yarenge endito ase ense engima.
english: And all the countries came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe in all the world.

ekegusii: Abamisiri bonsi bagakunya‐kunya mbarabare y’orooche ase okorigia amache bakonywa, ekiagera tibare konyara konywa amache a rooche.
english: And all the Egyptians dug along the Nile to get drinking water, because they could not drink the water of the river.

ekegusii: abanto bonsi abamenyete amo nabarabwo, na abaruoti bonsi b’ense ya Usi, na abaruoti b’Abafilisti baare ase emechie y’Asikeloni, na Gasa, na Ekironi, na abatigarete b’Asidodi;
english: and all the foreign people there; all the kings of Uz; all the kings of the Philistines (those of Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the people left at Ashdod);

ekegusii: abaruoti bonsi ba sugusu, abare aare na abare ang’e, kera oyomo nanywe edivai eria, na oyonde amobwatie. Amaruoti onsi pi are ase ense nanywe edivai eyio. Erio omoruoti o Sesaki, noro Babeli, nabe oyo bw’omoerio koyenywa.
english: and all the kings of the north, near and far, one after the other-- all the kingdoms on the face of the earth. And after all of them, the king of Sheshach will drink it too.

ekegusii: Abasacha bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagasangererekana agwo ase omoruoti ekero kie Rituko Rinene ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere.
english: And all the men of Israel came together to the king at the time of the festival in the seventh month.

ekegusii: Ase igo abanene bonsi be chingongo chiria, na abagavuna, na abagambi abanene bonsi b’oboruoti, baria baare gokora emeremo y’omoruoti, bagakonya Abayahudi, ekiagera boboete Moredekai.
english: And all the nobles of the provinces, the satraps, the governors and the king's administrators helped the Jews, because fear of Mordecai had seized them.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakamochiera mambia chuni aria Hekalu ime, erinde banyare komoigwa.
english: and all the people came early in the morning to hear him at the temple.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ense eria bakaba nomochengo; na omochie okaba omotoereru, ekiagera Atalia aitirwe nomoro, agwo ase enyomba y’omoruoti.
english: and all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword at the palace.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ense eria bakaba nomogoko, na omochie okaba omotoereru ekiagera Atalia konya aitirwe nomoro.
english: and all the people of the land rejoiced. And the city was quiet, because Athaliah had been slain with the sword.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagatiira bakamotunyana, bakobugia ebiroria, bakaba nomochengo omonene mono, goika riroba rigatitira ase amariogi abo.
english: And all the people went up after him, playing flutes and rejoicing greatly, so that the ground shook with the sound.

ekegusii: Bonsi, abake na abanene, bakamotegerera, bagateba, “Omonto oyo nigo are okobua koria kwa Nyasae gokorokwa Okobua Okonene.”
english: and all the people, both high and low, gave him their attention and exclaimed, "This man is the divine power known as the Great Power."

ekegusii: chiamate chionsi chiatigaire chieumie, kera eyemo ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo.
english: and all the rest of the clans and their wives.

ekegusii: amo nemechie yonsi ya Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, oria orenge kogambera Hesiboni, goikera orogongo rw’Abaamori.
english: and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who ruled in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites.

ekegusii: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath Beer (Ramah in the Negev). This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Simeonites, clan by clan.
english: Amo neyio bakanyora ebichie bionsi biaetanaine emechie eyio goika Baalati‐Beeri (noro Rama‐Negebu). Oyio noro orenge bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simeoni.

ekegusii: Boigo mbabwate ebichie biabo biaetanaine emechie eyio goikeera Baali. Obo nabwo bwarenge obomenyo bwabo. Barabwo bakarika omoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo.
english: and all the villages around these towns as far as Baalath. These were their settlements. And they kept a genealogical record.

ekegusii: Na abakungu bonsi, abasugetigwe ase emioyo yabo, naende bamanyete emeremo eye, bagasisa amanya e chimbori abe chiusi.
english: And all the women who were willing and had the skill spun the goat hair.

ekegusii: Bonsi abaigwete bagakumia ase aria batebetigwe nabarisia.
english: and all who heard it were amazed at what the shepherds said to them.

ekegusii: Naende mbarengeo Maaseya na Semaya, Eleazari na Usi, Yehohanani na Malikia, Elamu na Eseri. Abateri abwo bagatera, na Yesirahia nere orenge omoraai obo.
english: and also Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam and Ezer. The choirs sang under the direction of Jezrahiah.

ekegusii: Naende oirane ne chinyoni chikoiruruka, isano na ibere isano na ibere, chinsacha ne chinkungu. Okore ayio ase engencho y’okorenda kera egesaku kegenderere koba moyo ase ense.
english: and also seven of every kind of bird, male and female, to keep their various kinds alive throughout the earth.

ekegusii: na abakungu bande ababwatire nebirecha ebibe bakagwenigwa nere: Mariamu ore korokwa Magidalena, oria orusetigwe ebirecha bitano na bibere,
english: and also some women who had been cured of evil spirits and diseases: Mary (called Magdalene) from whom seven demons had come out;

ekegusii: ne chianga chingiya chinchenu chia Haroni omokuani, na echi’abamura baye, echi barabeke ekero bagokora emeremo y’obokuani,
english: and also the woven garments, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when they serve as priests,

ekegusii: na gati‐gati y’ebibekerero biria nkarora oyomo onga buna omwana o mwanyabanto, obekeire eanga entambe eigete inse ase ebisanyi bi’amagoro, na bweboeretie orokini rw’etahabu gekuba kiaye.
english: and among the lampstands was someone "like a son of man," dressed in a robe reaching down to his feet and with a golden sash around his chest.

ekegusii: And among the other Israelites: From the descendants of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malkijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malkijah and Benaiah.
english: Abaisraeli bande: Ab’eamate ya Parosi: Ramia na Isia, Malikia na Miyamini, Eleazari na Malikia na Benaya;

ekegusii: Korende narorire ababani ba Yerusalemu bakorire obobe goetania. Nigo bagokora obotomani na gosiarera oborimo. Nigo bakobeka abakori amabe chinguru, erinde onde taonchoka na gotiga ebibe biaye. Bonsi babeire asende buna abanto ba Sodomu, na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu babeire buna aba Gomora.”
english: And among the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen something horrible: They commit adultery and live a lie. They strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that no one turns from his wickedness. They are all like Sodom to me; the people of Jerusalem are like Gomorrah."

ekegusii: na eng’ombe amo nemingichi chibe ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase obosio bw’Omonene. Naboigo barue okoruegwa kw’endagera gwochoganirie namaguta, ekiagera ase rituko ria rero Omonene nabaorokere.”
english: and an ox and a ram for a fellowship offering to sacrifice before the LORD, together with a grain offering mixed with oil. For today the LORD will appear to you.'"

ekegusii: Naende monto onde bwensi otabogoreti omosalaba oye na gontunyana, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.
english: And anyone who does not carry his cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

ekegusii: and anyone who does not take his cross and follow me is not worthy of me.
english: Na oyo otabogoreti omosalaba oye na gontunyana, tangwenereti.

ekegusii: Ebinto binde bionsi biganeirie ase enyomba ya Nyasae oo, ebio ogwenerete korenta aroro, obigore ne chibesa chikorwa ase ekungo y’omoruoti.
english: And anything else needed for the temple of your God that you may have occasion to supply, you may provide from the royal treasury.

ekegusii: na ebinto binde bionsi bitanyare gosarigwa nomorero, ebio mobibeke ase omorero ime kobiteema, nabirobio nabicheneke. Nonya naboigo goika mobisibie namache agochena, na kera egento getanyare kobua omorero goika mogeetie ime ase amache ayio.
english: and anything else that can withstand fire must be put through the fire, and then it will be clean. But it must also be purified with the water of cleansing. And whatever cannot withstand fire must be put through that water.

ekegusii: Naende ochore omoraai oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku agokonye gwatanana ense eria.”
english: And appoint one leader from each tribe to help assign the land.

ekegusii: baeirwe oboronge buna ekeegwa ase obuya bwaye, ase enchera y’okoboorigwa kore ime ase Kristo Yeso.
english: and are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Inee! Na bono inwe motagete gotiga Omonene? Onye mokwanga rero koigwera Omonene, ekeene, ankio nigo arabe nekeririanda ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli.
english: And are you now turning away from the LORD? "'If you rebel against the LORD today, tomorrow he will be angry with the whole community of Israel.

ekegusii: Erio andetere inche Omonene emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye; ayerusie korwa ase riicho riaye rie ching’ondi, ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye; naye oyekorere rigori, na omonto oria ayeirere omokuani.
english: And as a penalty he must bring to the priest, that is, to the LORD, his guilt offering, a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value.

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana igoro ya Isumaeli nakoigure, rora, nimosesenie nimomentekanie mono, naibore abagambi ikomi na babere; ninkore egesaku ekenene kerue asare.
english: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you: I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and will greatly increase his numbers. He will be the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.

ekegusii: Abanto abarwete Kafitori, bagaita Abaavi abamenyete ase ebichie goikera Gasa, bakabakoora pi, bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo.)
english: And as for the Avvites who lived in villages as far as Gaza, the Caphtorites coming out from Caphtor destroyed them and settled in their place.)

ekegusii: Nase ki tore nemechando kera engaki?
english: And as for us, why do we endanger ourselves every hour?

ekegusii: Korende baminto, timorosa gokora amaya.
english: And as for you, brothers, never tire of doing what is right.

ekegusii: Akorokereria, okobatebia, “Inee! Terikiri iga: Enyomba yane nerokwe enyomba y’ogosaba ase ebisaku bionsi? Korende inwe mwayekorire koba ribwago ri’abauri.”
english: And as he taught them, he said, "Is it not written: "'My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations'? But you have made it 'a den of robbers.'"

ekegusii: Naende ring’ana eri tiriisaini kende asore, aye Nyasae. Boigo gwakwanire nainche omosomba oo, igoro y’enyomba yane na amang’ana akare bosio. Ee, Omonene Nyasae, gwankoreire koreng’ana nobomwanyabanto, kwanyimokereirie igoro.
english: And as if this were not enough in your sight, O God, you have spoken about the future of the house of your servant. You have looked on me as though I were the most exalted of men, O LORD God.

ekegusii: Naende ring’ana eri tiriisaini kende asore, aye Omonene Nyasae. Boigo gwakwanire igoro y’ororeria rwane, inche omosomba oo, na igoro y’ebiaare bigochi‐gocha. Ee, aye Omonene Nyasae, amang’ana ayio igo kwayakwanire ase mwanyabanto.
english: And as if this were not enough in your sight, O Sovereign LORD, you have also spoken about the future of the house of your servant. Is this your usual way of dealing with man, O Sovereign LORD?

ekegusii: agatenena korwa nyuma, ang’e namagoro aye, okorera. Agachaka komoiyereria amariga aye ase amagoro aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye, okonyunyunta amagoro aye, na koyaaka amaguta aria.
english: and as she stood behind him at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears. Then she wiped them with her hair, kissed them and poured perfume on them.

ekegusii: Ekero arenge koromwa mono, omoiboria akamotebia, “Toondoka, ekiagera naende nomwana omoisia oraibore.”
english: And as she was having great difficulty in childbirth, the midwife said to her, "Don't be afraid, for you have another son."

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi konya bambokire, Esanduku y’Omonene ekaambokigwa nabakuani, ekabekwa bosio bw’abanto.
english: and as soon as all of them had crossed, the ark of the LORD and the priests came to the other side while the people watched.

ekegusii: Igo erabe ekero abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduku eria y’Omonene bw’ense engima, baratache amache a Yorodan namagoro abo, amache akorwa rogoro ya Yorodan nanacheke, atenene buna enyasi.”
english: And as soon as the priests who carry the ark of the LORD-- the Lord of all the earth-- set foot in the Jordan, its waters flowing downstream will be cut off and stand up in a heap."

ekegusii: Ekero barenge konywa edivai ase rituko erio ria kabere, omoruoti akaboria Esteri naende, “Eting’ana Esteri, ninki origetie? Ekio nokeegwe. Ninki oganetie? Gokerabe nonya nekeng’ese ki’oboruoti bwane, nokeegwe.”
english: and as they were drinking wine on that second day, the king again asked, "Queen Esther, what is your petition? It will be given you. What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be granted."

ekegusii: Asa amo nabanto barenge nere bakabwatia Abaetiopia goika Gerari, na Abaetiopia bagaitwa, nonya noyomo tatigetwe ore moyo; ekiagera Omonene na abarwani baye b’esegi nigo bababuete kegima. Abayuda bagasakora ebinto ebinge bakabiira.
english: and Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. Such a great number of Cushites fell that they could not recover; they were crushed before the LORD and his forces. The men of Judah carried off a large amount of plunder.

ekegusii: akamoboria amoe amarube arikire ase chisinagogi chia Damesiki, erinde onye okonyora abanto b’Enchera eye, abasacha gose abakungu, abasibe na kobarenta Yerusalemu.
english: and asked him for letters to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he found any there who belonged to the Way, whether men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: akaboria omosomba oria, “Monto ki oria ogotaara ase omogondo, ogocha koumerana naintwe?” Omosomba oria akamoiraneria, “Oria nere omonene one.” Erio omoiseke oria akabwata egietubo kiaye, agetuba.
english: and asked the servant, "Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?" "He is my master," the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mwanyorete Omoika Omochenu ekero mwegenete?” Bakamoiraneria, “Yaya, titwana koigwa nonya ng’ake ng’a Omoika Omochenu noreo.”
english: and asked them, "Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?" They answered, "No, we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit."

ekegusii: akababoria, “Inki morang’e onye nkomorua asemore?” Bakamoa chibesa chie chifeta emerongo etato.
english: and asked, "What are you willing to give me if I hand him over to you?" So they counted out for him thirty silver coins.

ekegusii: “Ng’ai are oria oiborwa omoruoti bw’Abayahudi? Ekiagera eng’enang’eni yaye ntwayeroche moocha; nigo twachire komosasima.”
english: and asked, "Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him."

ekegusii: Otugute chitahabu chiao ime ase amaroba, ne chitahabu chikorwa Ofiri ochibeke ase egati y’amagena ’ebirooche,
english: and assign your nuggets to the dust, your gold of Ophir to the rocks in the ravines,

ekegusii: Na ekero engaki yaye yaigete akabomaanora ase ring’ana riaye, eri inche negenirwe korandia ase ogochika kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito.
english: and at his appointed season he brought his word to light through the preaching entrusted to me by the command of God our Savior,

ekegusii: Kera oyomo bw’abaagachi nigo eboeranetie omoyio oye o birende kenema kiaye ekero agendererete koagacha; na omobugia egetureri nigo ateneine ang’e nainche.
english: and each of the builders wore his sword at his side as he worked. But the man who sounded the trumpet stayed with me.

ekegusii: na kera oyomo orenge goita omobisa oye. Abasiiria bagatama, na Abaisraeli bakababwatia, korende Beni‐Hadadi, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, akariina ebarasi, agatama amo nabanto bande abariini be chibarasi.
english: and each one struck down his opponent. At that, the Arameans fled, with the Israelites in pursuit. But Ben-Hadad king of Aram escaped on horseback with some of his horsemen.

ekegusii: Na Eleazari, mosinto o Haroni, agakwa, agatindekwa Gibea, omochie oyio Finehasi, omwana oye, aetwe ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu.
english: And Eleazar son of Aaron died and was buried at Gibeah, which had been allotted to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim.

ekegusii: na Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni, nere orenge omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku gia Sabuloni.
english: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.

ekegusii: Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli, nere orenge omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi.
english: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.

ekegusii: And Elijah said to Ahab, "Go, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain."
english: Elija agatebia Ahabu, “Imoka, orie na onywe, ekiagera eriogi ri’embura riaigurwe rikogukura.”
