ekegusii: Erio Elisha agasaba, akabora, “Aye Omonene, nagosabire, ramokia amaiso aye, erinde arore.” Na Omonene akaramokia amaiso ’omosae oria, nere akarora chibarasi ne chigari chi’omorero nigo chiaichire ekegoro igoro, chietanaine Elisha.
english: And Elisha prayed, "O LORD, open his eyes so he may see." Then the LORD opened the servant's eyes, and he looked and saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha.

ekegusii: emoko, oboiti, ogotinda, chigosori chimbe, na amang’ana ande buna ayio. Nabakureire buna narenge kobakurera ritang’ani, ng’a abwo bagokora amang’ana anga buna ayio, tibakonyora omwando bw’oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
english: and envy; drunkenness, orgies, and the like. I warn you, as I did before, that those who live like this will not inherit the kingdom of God.

ekegusii: Nabo ekiagera aye kwamanyire mono chingencho chionsi na amaborio onsi Abayahudi bare naro, nagosabire ontegerere ase oboremereria.
english: and especially so because you are well acquainted with all the Jewish customs and controversies. Therefore, I beg you to listen to me patiently.

ekegusii: Korende onye enchili yaito yabisekanete, nigo yabisekanete ase abwo bagosira.
english: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.

ekegusii: Abayuda nabarabwo tibabwatete amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae obo, korende bakabwatia chingencho chiria Abaisraeli barentete.
english: and even Judah did not keep the commands of the LORD their God. They followed the practices Israel had introduced.

ekegusii: Korende nonya nechitukia chi’emetwe yaino chionsi chiabarirwe.
english: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

ekegusii: Naende nigo ateemete kogindia Hekalu riko. Ase ayio tokamobwata, [tokarigia komogambia ase amachiko aito.
english: and even tried to desecrate the temple; so we seized him.

ekegusii: Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera gwochoganirie namaguta, gose ogotari namaguta, abamura ba Haroni baegwe, baatananerwe bareng’anerigwe.
english: and every grain offering, whether mixed with oil or dry, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.

ekegusii: na abanto bonsi baiboire ase enka yaye, na abagorwa chibesa korwa ase abanto ba isiko, bagasarwa amo nere.
english: And every male in Abraham's household, including those born in his household or bought from a foreigner, was circumcised with him.

ekegusii: Egekorero kende gionsi kere ase eema eria ime, getabwati egekuneko, korende kere giasie, kiabeire egetachenegeti.
english: and every open container without a lid fastened on it will be unclean.

ekegusii: na kera oromeme narobe kirori ng’a Yeso Kristo n’Omonene, ase obonene bwa Nyasae Tata.
english: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

ekegusii: Korende kera omokungu kagosaba gose kobana na taboeti omotwe oye, igo tasigeti omotwe oye, nigo areng’aine nere oyokigitete etukia yaye.
english: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head-- it is just as though her head were shaved.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakagenda korikwa, kera omonto ase omochie oye.
english: And everyone went to his own town to register.

ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera oyorarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe.
english: And everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.'

ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera oyorarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe, ekiagera ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ime ya Yerusalemu, mbabe aroro abanto baratooreke, buna Omonene atebire, na ase egati y’abwo baratigare nigo barabe abwo Omonene arangeirie.”
english: And everyone who calls on the name of the LORD will be saved; for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be deliverance, as the LORD has said, among the survivors whom the LORD calls.

ekegusii: Na onde bwensi otigete chinyomba, gose bamura bamwabo, gose basubati bamwabo, gose ise, gose ng’ina, gose abana, gose emegondo ase engencho y’erieta riane, namenteranigwe ara rigana, na obogima bwa kare na kare nabonyore.
english: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or children or fields for my sake will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.

ekegusii: Na kera oyomo orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto, naaberwe; korende ere oyorarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa.
english: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

ekegusii: Naende bakairana kera oyomo buna enkoro yaye yamosugetie, na buna anchete ere omonyene, bakarentera Omonene ebiegwa biabo ase okoroisia Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebinto bionsi ebiaganeirie, ase emeremo eria na ase chianga chiria chinchenu.
english: and everyone who was willing and whose heart moved him came and brought an offering to the LORD for the work on the Tent of Meeting, for all its service, and for the sacred garments.

ekegusii: Naboigo, nebiegwa bionsi biria Samweli omorori, na Saulo, mosinto o Kisi, na Abineri, mosinto o Neri, na Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya baatananete. Ebinto bionsi bikabekwa inse y’oborendi bwa Selomiti na abamwabo.
english: And everything dedicated by Samuel the seer and by Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner and Joab son of Zeruiah, and all the other dedicated things were in the care of Shelomith and his relatives.

ekegusii: Bakaonchoreria obonene bwa Nyasae, oyotari nogosareka, ase omogwekano bw’ekieni kia mwanyabanto oyore nogosareka, na obwe chinyoni, na obwe ching’iti chire namagoro ane, na obwe ching’iti chikwagura.
english: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images made to look like mortal man and birds and animals and reptiles.

ekegusii: Oyabeke ase ebitwang’a bi’amareko bi’egesibao keria ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Naboigo Haroni abogorie amarieta abo ase amareko aye abere, abe ekeinyorio ase obosio bw’Omonene botambe.
english: and fasten them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear the names on his shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.

ekegusii: Teema mono komanya ekeragwenere Omonene.
english: and find out what pleases the Lord.

ekegusii: Erio omorero okarua ase Omonene, ogasamba abanto baria amagana abere, na emerongo etano, abwo konya barentire ubani.
english: And fire came out from the LORD and consumed the 250 men who were offering the incense.

ekegusii: Na abanto amagana atano b’egesaku gia Simeoni, bakagenda goika egetunwa gia Seiri, bakaba nabaraai babo: Pelatia na Nearia, Refaya na Usieli, basinto ba Ishi.
english: And five hundred of these Simeonites, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, invaded the hill country of Seir.

ekegusii: akabwatia omonto oria gochia ase akanyomba ka ime, akababeta ritimo bonsi babere, Omoisraeli oria amo nomokungu oria, ase chinda chiabo. Ase igo amaakwa aria agatiga goita Abaisraeli.
english: and followed the Israelite into the tent. He drove the spear through both of them-- through the Israelite and into the woman's body. Then the plague against the Israelites was stopped;

ekegusii: Boigo bakaba bakobwatia chingencho chi’abanto b’ebisaku biria Omonene aseretie korwa ase amasio abo, na echi’abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: and followed the practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before them, as well as the practices that the kings of Israel had introduced.

ekegusii: naende obobimbu bwe risankwa, na ebisambo, na ebimoa ebirabu.
english: and for a swelling, a rash or a bright spot,

ekegusii: Ase amatuko amange akarorekana ase abwo barenge gotiira komo korwa Galili goika Yerusalemu. Bono barabwo mbirori baye bare ase abanto.
english: and for many days he was seen by those who had traveled with him from Galilee to Jerusalem. They are now his witnesses to our people.

ekegusii: na ekiagera amagwa na amageri biamerire ase ense y’abanto baane, mweake‐ake ase engencho ye chinyomba chi’emegoko chire ase omochie oyio oichire nomochengo.
english: and for the land of my people, a land overgrown with thorns and briers-- yes, mourn for all houses of merriment and for this city of revelry.

ekegusii: Ase igo omogoko bw’obobui okaonchoka okaba omoichano ase abanto bonsi ba Daudi, ekiagera ase rituko riria abanto nigo baigwete ng’a Daudi nkona‐korera are ase engencho y’omwana oye.
english: And for the whole army the victory that day was turned into mourning, because on that day the troops heard it said, "The king is grieving for his son."

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio nkaragwa imbe omoraria, na omotomwa, erinde inyorokie abanto b’Ebisaku amang’ana ’okwegena na ekeene; nigo ngokwana ekeene, tindi gokwana oborimo.
english: And for this purpose I was appointed a herald and an apostle-- I am telling the truth, I am not lying-- and a teacher of the true faith to the Gentiles.

ekegusii: Amaene, amanyinga ’obogima bwaino ninyaganie ng’akanwe; korwa ase kera eng’iti ninyaganie, na korwa ase kera omonto oyogoita oyomwabo ninyaganie ng’akanwe obogima bw’omonto oyio.
english: And for your lifeblood I will surely demand an accounting. I will demand an accounting from every animal. And from each man, too, I will demand an accounting for the life of his fellow man.

ekegusii: Na inche nagokire ase engencho yaino, ekiagera ntarenge aroro, erinde monyare kwegena. Korende bono togende asare.”
english: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him."

ekegusii: Abamenyi nigo bebegete inse yane, na ekero baigure chinkuma chiane, banyigwera.
english: and foreigners come cringing to me; as soon as they hear me, they obey me.

ekegusii: “Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao barabwatane n’Omonene ase okomokorera, na banche erieta ri’Omonene, erinde babe abasomba baye, kera oyomo orarende Esabato na tayekora ebe eyetachenegeti, naende abwate okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania,
english: And foreigners who bind themselves to the LORD to serve him, to love the name of the LORD, and to worship him, all who keep the Sabbath without desecrating it and who hold fast to my covenant--

ekegusii: Bwabere abanto bao bakorire ebibe asore. Bwabere ogosaria kwabo gwonsi bakorire asore; okore ababisa babo, abwo baboosire babarorere amabeebe.
english: And forgive your people, who have sinned against you; forgive all the offenses they have committed against you, and cause their conquerors to show them mercy;

ekegusii: amo ne chinterekerero chie chifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere ase kera ebao.
english: and forty silver bases-- two under each frame.

ekegusii: ne chinterekerero chiaye chie chifeta emerongo ene, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.
english: and forty silver bases-- two under each frame.

ekegusii: naende asibore abwo bonsi barenge abasomba ase obogima bwabo bwonsi, ekiagera bairogete amakweri.
english: and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by their fear of death.

ekegusii: Ere nigo atotooretie korwa ase ababisa baito, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: and freed us from our enemies, His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Boigo nase abakuani: Abanto be chiamate chia Habaya, na Hakosi, na Barisilai, oyio onyuomete oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Barisilai Omogileadi, na akarokwa ase erieta riaye.
english: And from among the priests: The descendants of Hobaiah, Hakkoz and Barzillai (a man who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by that name).

ekegusii: Boigo nase abakuani aba: Abanto be chiamate chia Habaya, na Hakosi, na Barisilai, oyio onyuomete oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Barisilai Omogileadi na akarokwa ase erieta riabo Barisilai.
english: And from among the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah, Hakkoz and Barzillai (a man who had married a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by that name).

ekegusii: Bakarua Bamoti, bakagenda gochia ase rikura riarenge ase ense y’Abaamori, ase egetirimboko ki’egetunwa gia Pisiga, ekio kerochie maate ase erooro.
english: and from Bamoth to the valley in Moab where the top of Pisgah overlooks the wasteland.

ekegusii: Korwa ase Abareuben na Abagadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, abwo bamenyete ng’umbu ya Yorodan, abanto babwate ebirwanero bionsi bi’okorwana esegi, chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000).
english: and from east of the Jordan, men of Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, armed with every type of weapon-- 120,000.

ekegusii: Orusie boigo emegati etabekiri memera na amaandasi atabekiri memera, biroisirie namaguta, na emegati emeoo eakire amaguta. Emegati eyio yonsi eroisigwe korwa ase obosie obonuke bw’engano.
english: And from fine wheat flour, without yeast, make bread, and cakes mixed with oil, and wafers spread with oil.

ekegusii: Na korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Abakohati abatigarete bakaegwa Aneri na Bileamu amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
english: And from half the tribe of Manasseh the Israelites gave Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands, to the rest of the Kohathite clans.

ekegusii: na ense korwa Hesiboni goika Ramati‐Misipa na Betonimu, na korwa Mahanaimu goika orobebe rwa Debiri.
english: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir;

ekegusii: na korwa ase Yeso Kristo, oyore kirori omwegenwa, omoiborwa bwe ritang’ani oyobogete korwa ase abakure, omogambi bw’abaruoti b’ense. Asare ere oyotwanchete na agatobooria korwa ase ebibe biaito namanyinga aye ase ogotokwera,
english: and from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us and has freed us from our sins by his blood,

ekegusii: Korwa aroro rogenderere roike enchera ekogenda Hamati, erio naende rogenderere goikera Sedadi,
english: and from Mount Hor to Lebo Hamath. Then the boundary will go to Zedad,

ekegusii: Korwa ase rituko riria na kogenderera Saulo akarorera Daudi ribero.
english: And from that time on Saul kept a jealous eye on David.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamin bakaegwa Gibeoni, na Geba,
english: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave them Gibeon, Geba,

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamin bakaegwa Geba na Alemeti, na Anatoti, emechie eyio yonsi amo namarisio aetanaineo. Emechie yabo yonsi ase chiamate chiabo nigo yarenge ikomi na etato.
english: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. These towns, which were distributed among the Kohathite clans, were thirteen in all.

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti agwo Gileadi, na Mahanaimu,
english: and from the tribe of Gad they received Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim,

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi agwo Galili, na Hamoni, na Kiriataimu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
english: and from the tribe of Naphtali they received Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.

ekegusii: Ase ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee mbarengeo abamwabo b’ororeria rwa Merari: Etani, mosinto o Kisi bw’Abidi, o Maluku,
english: and from their associates, the Merarites, at his left hand: Ethan son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

ekegusii: Akaonchora na ense ere entobu ekaba ekerubo ki’omonyo, ase engencho y’obobe bw’abanto bamenyeteo.
english: and fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who lived there.

ekegusii: Korende bono nigo okorengereria ng’a Nyasae tari korua egesusuro ase engencho y’endamwamu yaye, naende ng’a ere tari gwechandera ogosaria.
english: and further, that his anger never punishes and he does not take the least notice of wickedness.

ekegusii: Naende orangerie omoganda bwonsi osangererekane ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.”
english: and gather the entire assembly at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting."

ekegusii: Akabaura chinse chiabo chikaba omwando bw’abanto baye, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: and gave their land as an inheritance, His love endures forever.

ekegusii: goika abe oiraneirie Yerusalemu amaya aye na koyokora obe ogotogigwa ase ense.
english: and give him no rest till he establishes Jerusalem and makes her the praise of the earth.

ekegusii: Oe Sulemani, omwana one, enkoro yeruete asore, erinde arende amachiko ao, na oborori bwao, na emeroberio yao echikire, akore aya onsi na aagache enyomba eria y’obonene nabeire nkobeka ebinto bionsi ang’e ase okoyeagacha.”
english: And give my son Solomon the wholehearted devotion to keep your commands, requirements and decrees and to do everything to build the palatial structure for which I have provided."

ekegusii: na kobaa inwe abamwachandirwe ogotimokigwa amo naintwe. Aya nigo arakoreke ekero Omonene Yeso agocha koorokigwa korwa igoro amo nabamalaika b’okobua kwaye ase ekebemberi ki’omorero,
english: and give relief to you who are troubled, and to us as well. This will happen when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven in blazing fire with his powerful angels.

ekegusii: goika ase Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu rire ase Egeita gie Chindogio, na aroro agwo orarie amang’ana inche ndagotebie,
english: and go out to the Valley of Ben Hinnom, near the entrance of the Potsherd Gate. There proclaim the words I tell you,

ekegusii: Nyasae agasesenia rituko ria gatano na kabere, akariatanana, akarikora richenu, ekiagera ase rituko erio Nyasae agatimoka korwa ase emeremo yaye yonsi, eye konya akorire ase obotongi.
english: And God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creating that he had done.

ekegusii: Na Nyasae nanyare kobaichoria nobuya bwonsi ase obonge, erinde monyare koba nogoisaneka gwonsi ase ebinto bionsi, monyare komenta mono ase ogokora okuya,
english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

ekegusii: And God permitting, we will do so.
english: Natokore ayio, Nyasae karatwanchere.

ekegusii: Naende akabeka ebinto bionsi inse y’amagoro aye, akamobeka abe omotwe igoro y’ebinto bionsi ase ekanisa,
english: And God placed all things under his feet and appointed him to be head over everything for the church,

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akarentera Sulemani omobisa onde, na omobisa oyio nere Resoni, mosinto bw’Eliada, oria konya otamire korwa ase omonene oye Hadadeseri, omoruoti o Soba.
english: And God raised up against Solomon another adversary, Rezon son of Eliada, who had fled from his master, Hadadezer king of Zobah.

ekegusii: Naende agatobokia amo nere, agatoikaransia amo nere aase a igoro ase Kristo Yeso,
english: And God raised us up with Christ and seated us with him in the heavenly realms in Christ Jesus,

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamotebia, “Inche Nyasae Omobui, genderera komenteka, obuche. Egesaku na emeganda y’ebisaku nigo erarue asore, na abaruoti mbarue asore.
english: And God said to him, "I am God Almighty; be fruitful and increase in number. A nation and a community of nations will come from you, and kings will come from your body.

ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Inche nimbe amo naye, na eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asore ng’a ninche omonyene nagotoma: Ekero orabe kwarusirie abanto abwo korwa Misiri inamobe mogonsasimera inche Nyasae oino ase egetunwa eke.”
english: And God said, "I will be with you. And this will be the sign to you that it is I who have sent you: When you have brought the people out of Egypt, you will worship God on this mountain."

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateba, “Tiga ense etware ebitongwa bire moyo, kera egesaku nengencho yaye: ching’iti chigotugwa, na echikwagura, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, kera egesaku nengencho yaye”; akaba boigo.
english: And God said, "Let the land produce living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, creatures that move along the ground, and wild animals, each according to its kind." And it was so.

ekegusii: Nyasae agateba, “Tiga amache atware obonge bw’ebitongwa bire moyo, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka igoro ase ense, chigoetanana inse y’eaanga ya igoro.”
english: And God said, "Let the water teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the expanse of the sky."

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateba, “Tiga amache ayare inse ya igoro asangererekane aase aamo, ense enyomo erorekane”; akaba boigo.
english: And God said, "Let the water under the sky be gathered to one place, and let dry ground appear." And it was so.

ekegusii: Nyasae agateba, “Tiga eaanga ebe egati‐gati y’amache, yaatanane amache korwa ase amache ande.”
english: And God said, "Let there be an expanse between the waters to separate water from water."

ekegusii: Nyasae agateba, “Tiga oborabu bobeo”, na oborabu bokabao.
english: And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateba, “Tiga emebaso ebe ase eaanga aaria igoro, yaatanane omobaso korwa ase obotuko; ero ebe ebimanyererio bikworokia Amatuko Amanene, na amatuko, na emiaka,
english: And God said, "Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to separate the day from the night, and let them serve as signs to mark seasons and days and years,

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateba, “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nakorire egati yane nainwe, na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo nainwe, na ase ebiaare bigochigocha:
english: And God said, "This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:

ekegusii: Nyasae agatoma omomalaika oye gochia ase Yerusalemu koyosaria; korende ekero omomalaika oria abete ang’e koyosaria, Omonene akaywechandera, akaonchoreria ebirengererio biaye igoro y’obobe boria, agatebia omomalaika oria ogendererete gosaria omochie, “Bono aisanire, ororobia okoboko kwao!” Omomalaika oria konya oikire ang’e nekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi.
english: And God sent an angel to destroy Jerusalem. But as the angel was doing so, the LORD saw it and was grieved because of the calamity and said to the angel who was destroying the people, "Enough! Withdraw your hand." The angel of the LORD was then standing at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

ekegusii: And God spoke all these words:
english: Nyasae agakwana amang’ana aya onsi, agateba,

ekegusii: Nyasae akarangeria Israeli ase okorora ekero kia botuko, akabora, “Yakobo! Yakobo!” Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa.”
english: And God spoke to Israel in a vision at night and said, "Jacob! Jacob!" "Here I am," he replied.

ekegusii: and goes home. Then he calls his friends and neighbors together and says, 'Rejoice with me; I have found my lost sheep.'
english: Na ekero akoirana inka, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abatebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire eng’ondi yane eria yasirete.

ekegusii: Agatoma omonto ase echela ime anache Yohana omotwe.
english: and had John beheaded in the prison.

ekegusii: Nigo abwate ebinto ebinge biagachire ase ense y’Abayuda. Naende nabwate abarwani esegi, abanto chituoni, agwo Yerusalemu.
english: and had large supplies in the towns of Judah. He also kept experienced fighting men in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: boosire abakungu na bonsi abarengeo, abake na abanene. Tibaitete monto onde, korende nigo babairete, bakagenda nabarabwo.
english: and had taken captive the women and all who were in it, both young and old. They killed none of them, but carried them off as they went on their way.

ekegusii: oyotokorete koba ab’oboruoti na abakuani ase Nyasae Ise oye asare ere obonene na okobua goika kare na kare. Amina.
english: and has made us to be a kingdom and priests to serve his God and Father-- to him be glory and power for ever and ever! Amen.

ekegusii: naende ere tari omogenki, omonto oyio tari gokorera monto onde bobe, gose tari gokwana onde bobe.
english: and has no slander on his tongue, who does his neighbor no wrong and casts no slur on his fellowman,

ekegusii: Boigo bagatoma Hasabia na Yesaia bw’ororeria rwa Merari, na abamwabo, na abana babo, bonsi nabanto emerongo ebere.
english: and Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and nephews, 20 men.

ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria nachorete abagambi bagambere abanto baane Abaisraeli. Ninkoe obotoereru korwa ase ababisa bao bonsi. Kobua ayio onsi, inche Omonene nigo nkogotebia ng’a ninkoroiserie enyomba.
english: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also give you rest from all your enemies. "'The LORD declares to you that the LORD himself will establish a house for you:

ekegusii: korwa engaki eria nachorete abagambi igoro ase abanto baane Abaisraeli. Boigo nimbue ababisa bao bonsi. Na bono nigo ngokomanyia ng’a inche Omonene ninkoagachere enyomba.
english: and have done ever since the time I appointed leaders over my people Israel. I will also subdue all your enemies. "'I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you:

ekegusii: Tari ayio oka, korende kwabekire ababani bakoraria agwo Yerusalemu ng’a naye omoruoti bw’Abayuda. Na bono omoruoti ngochia gotebigwa are amang’ana ayio; ase ayio inchuo toumerane naye tokwane komo.”
english: and have even appointed prophets to make this proclamation about you in Jerusalem: 'There is a king in Judah!' Now this report will get back to the king; so come, let us confer together."

ekegusii: Banorire na koneta. Tibari gotiga gokora amabe. Tibari kogambera chintakana ebina bi’oboronge bagere bakire, gose tibari gokorera abataka oboronge.”
english: and have grown fat and sleek. Their evil deeds have no limit; they do not plead the case of the fatherless to win it, they do not defend the rights of the poor.

ekegusii: mwamweboyirie omonto omoyia, oyo okorirwe omoyia ase okomanya gwonsi ase omogwekano oye ere oyomotongete.
english: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.

ekegusii: na goikaransa aase e ritang’ani ase chisinagogi, na aase e ritang’ani ase emeyega.
english: and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.

ekegusii: Erio kabakureirwe na Nyasae ase chindoto, tibairanera ase Herode, bakabwatia enchera eng’ao, bakagenda sobo.
english: And having been warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they returned to their country by another route.

ekegusii: Naboigo ekero aurire abagambi na abare nokobua ebirwanero biabo, akabasookia maiso marore, agachenga igoro asebare ase omosalaba.
english: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, he made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.

ekegusii: Naende akabora, “Aye omonene one, nase ki okona‐kondigia inche omosomba oo ng’a ong’ite? Ninki nakorire. Nkomocha ki inde nakwo?
english: And he added, "Why is my lord pursuing his servant? What have I done, and what wrong am I guilty of?

ekegusii: And he also had seven sons and three daughters.
english: Boigo akaegwa abamura batano na babere, na abaiseke batato.

ekegusii: Agachora abakuani baye b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na ab’ebirecha, na ab’emegwekano ye chimori chiria aroisetie.
english: And he appointed his own priests for the high places and for the goat and calf idols he had made.

ekegusii: and he asked them, "Whose portrait is this? And whose inscription?"
english: Yeso akababoria, “Ekieni eke na amariko aya nebia ng’o?”

ekegusii: Daudi akamentekana mono koba ne chinguru, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, arenge amo nere.
english: And he became more and more powerful, because the LORD God Almighty was with him.

ekegusii: Agachaka kobatebia, “Rero ririko eri riaikeranigwe ase amato aino.”
english: and he began by saying to them, "Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing."

ekegusii: and he began to teach them, saying:
english: Agachaka koborokereria, ogoteba,

ekegusii: Akamosorora mono tabiira isiko y’ense eria.
english: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.

ekegusii: Akamosesenia, akabora, “Aburamu asesenigwe na Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, oyotongete igoro na ense;
english: and he blessed Abram, saying, "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.

ekegusii: Akamoira ase Yeso. Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Aye Simion, omwana o Yohana, norokwe Kefa” (okoonchorwa kwaye Petero, gose egetare).
english: And he brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, "You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas" (which, when translated, is Peter).

ekegusii: Naende Sulemani akaagacha chindwaki chi’eraaro ya ime. Chindwaro isato chie chindwaki echio agachiagacha namagena abaachire, na orwaro oromo akaroagacha ne chibao chi’emecharake.
english: And he built the inner courtyard of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams.

ekegusii: Oboagacho bw’enyomba inse nigo bwatunyaine Hekalu, na kera rirongo nigo riarenge nobotambe gochia igoro ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Oboagacho obwo nigo bwabwateranetigwe ne Hekalu ne chibao chi’emecharake.
english: And he built the side rooms all along the temple. The height of each was five cubits, and they were attached to the temple by beams of cedar.

ekegusii: Akaroka aase aria Masa na Meriba, ase engencho y’eriomana ri’Abaisraeli, naende ekiagera abanto bateemete Omonene, bakobora, “Inee! Omonene nare aa ase egati yaito, gose taiyo?”
english: And he called the place Massah and Meribah because the Israelites quarreled and because they tested the LORD saying, "Is the LORD among us or not?"

ekegusii: Nigo nabogoretigwe n’Omoika, na omomalaika oria akang’ira gochia ase ekerogo ekenene, akanyorokia omochie oria omochenu, Yerusalemu, ogoika korwa igoro korwa ase Nyasae.
english: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the Holy City, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God.

ekegusii: Yehoyakimu agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna koreng’ana chisokoro chiaye chiakorete.
english: And he did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as his fathers had done.

ekegusii: And he did not do many miracles there because of their lack of faith.
english: Ere takorete ogokora gwe chinguru okonge agwo, ekiagera batarenge nokwegena.

ekegusii: Ere agakwa ase engencho ya bonsi, erio abare moyo tibaba moyo ase engencho yabo boka abanyene, korende nase engencho yaye ere oyokwete, naende akaboka ase engencho yabo.
english: And he died for all, that those who live should no longer live for themselves but for him who died for them and was raised again.

ekegusii: Agachika emeganda eikaranse inse ase obonyansi; akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati, akaa aborokigwa emegati eria, na aborokigwa bakayea emeganda.
english: And he directed the people to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.

ekegusii: akaira amaicho aye onsi, na enibo yaye yonsi eyio anyorete ase Padan‐Aramu, akagenda ase ense ya Kanani o Isaka ise.
english: and he drove all his livestock ahead of him, along with all the goods he had accumulated in Paddan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.

ekegusii: na akarera neriogi rinene ringa buna eri’endo ekoruma. Ekero achia korera chinkoba isano na ibere chigakwana neriogi riabo.
english: and he gave a loud shout like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the voices of the seven thunders spoke.

ekegusii: Naende akaa Abamerari chigari inye, ne chiombe isano na isato, buna emeremo yabo yarenge inse y’oboraai bwa Itamari, omomura o Haroni omokuani.
english: and he gave four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites, as their work required. They were all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

ekegusii: Agachika egari eria etenene, na bonsi babere, Filipo na oria omogomba, bagatirimboka gochia ase amache ime, erio Filipo akamobatisa.
english: And he gave orders to stop the chariot. Then both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water and Philip baptized him.

ekegusii: Ense y’Ebisaku ebio akayea Abaisraeli, abanto baye, ekaba omwando obo.
english: and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.

ekegusii: Ere konya oroiseirie Tobia enyomba engare agwo aase konya barenge kogacha okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ubani, na ebikorero, ne chinsemo chia ikomi chi’endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, ebinto biachikeretwe Abalawi, na abateri, na abarendi b’ebiita. Boigo ebiegwa biachikeretwe abakuani, nao biare kogachwa.
english: and he had provided him with a large room formerly used to store the grain offerings and incense and temple articles, and also the tithes of grain, new wine and oil prescribed for the Levites, singers and gatekeepers, as well as the contributions for the priests.

ekegusii: Aiga nigo are nokobua korwa ase abakuani abanene asibe bonsi abakorangeria erieta riao.”
english: And he has come here with authority from the chief priests to arrest all who call on your name."

ekegusii: Omoichoirie omoika o Nyasae, omoeire obong’aini ne chisemi anyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,
english: and he has filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability and knowledge in all kinds of crafts--

ekegusii: Omonene omoeire ere amo na Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, obong’aini bw’okworokereria abande oboroisia bwabo.
english: And he has given both him and Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach others.

ekegusii: Omoeire okobua kw’ogokora ekina, ekiagera ere n’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.
english: And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.

ekegusii: And he has given us this command: Whoever loves God must also love his brother.
english: Oko nakwo ogochika twaeirwe nere: Ere oyomwanchete Nyasae anche noyomwabo boigo.

ekegusii: Boigo agantebera oborimo asore aye omonene one, korende aye igo onga buna omomalaika o Nyasae: gaki kora aya oroche arabe amaya.
english: And he has slandered your servant to my lord the king. My lord the king is like an angel of God; so do whatever pleases you.

ekegusii: Saulo akarengereria ase enkoro yaye agetebia, “Nigo nkoruta ritimo, mbete Daudi imobwateranie enyasi.” Erio akamoruta Daudi ritimo ara kabere, korende Daudi akebacha.
english: and he hurled it, saying to himself, "I'll pin David to the wall." But David eluded him twice.

ekegusii: Agasoyia emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria esanduku eria.
english: And he inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry it.

ekegusii: Naboigo akaba ise bw’abarogete, tari ng’a barogete rioka, korende boigo abagotunyana chimbaratero chi’okwegena kwaye sokoro yaito Ibrahimu, oko arenge nakorokwo ekero konya atararoka.
english: And he is also the father of the circumcised who not only are circumcised but who also walk in the footsteps of the faith that our father Abraham had before he was circumcised.

ekegusii: gose tari gokorerwa namaboko a mwanyabanto, buna oyo oremeire gento, ekiagera nere okobaa bonsi obogima na omoika, na ebinto bionsi.
english: And he is not served by human hands, as if he needed anything, because he himself gives all men life and breath and everything else.

ekegusii: Ere nomotwe bw’omobere, engencho yaye ekanisa; naende ere nomochakano na omoiborwa bwe ritang’ani korwa ase abakure, erinde abe omotang’ani ase bonsi.
english: And he is the head of the body, the church; he is the beginning and the firstborn from among the dead, so that in everything he might have the supremacy.

ekegusii: Akaba nkorandia are ase chisinagogi chia Galili.
english: And he kept on preaching in the synagogues of Judea.

ekegusii: Yusufu akanyunyunta abamwabo bonsi, akarera asebare. Na nyuma y’ayio abamwabo bakagosoria nere.
english: And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. Afterward his brothers talked with him.

ekegusii: Akabatiga, agasoka korwa ase omochie, akagenda Bethania, akarara aroro.
english: And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.

ekegusii: Nyasae agatomanyia obobisi bw’ogwancha kwaye, koreng’ana nokogania kwaye buna aroberetie ase Kristo,
english: And he made known to us the mystery of his will according to his good pleasure, which he purposed in Christ,

ekegusii: Akarenga obotambe bw’akanyomba karia kare moino y’Aase Aachenu, bokaba obw’amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare bwaye bokaba amaboko emerongo ebere boigo. Omonto oria agantebia, “Aiga nao Aase Aachenu Mono.”
english: And he measured the length of the inner sanctuary; it was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits across the end of the outer sanctuary. He said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."

ekegusii: Erio agatebia abanto, “Genda moetanane omochie oria, na abanto babwate ebirwanero bi’esegi bagende bosio bw’Esanduku eria y’Omonene.”
english: And he ordered the people, "Advance! March around the city, with the armed guard going ahead of the ark of the LORD."

ekegusii: Naende nabwate ching’ondi chilifu isano na ibere, ne chingamia chilifu isato, ne chiombe elifu eyemo, ne chitigere chiaberi amagana atano; naende nabwate abasomba abange mono. Ase ayio omonto oyio nigo arenge omonda mono kobua abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense ya Moocha.
english: and he owned seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen and five hundred donkeys, and had a large number of servants. He was the greatest man among all the people of the East.

ekegusii: Omonene agaeta ase obosio bwa Musa, akeraria, “Omonene, Omonene, nere Nyasae omonyene amabera na obuya, tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu; nigo are nobwanchani botari koera, na obwegenwa.
english: And he passed in front of Moses, proclaiming, "The LORD, the LORD, the compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness,

ekegusii: Nero yakorire ebikone ebinene, goika yagerire omorero oike korwa igoro gocha ase ense ase amasio a mwanyabanto.
english: And he performed great and miraculous signs, even causing fire to come down from heaven to earth in full view of men.

ekegusii: Akamoriera eira, “Kende gionsi ekiorarigie korwa asende ninkoe, nonya nekeng’ese ki’oboruoti bwane.”
english: And he promised her with an oath, "Whatever you ask I will give you, up to half my kingdom."

ekegusii: Erio agasiekera bonsi amo echela ime ase amatuko atato.
english: And he put them all in custody for three days.

ekegusii: Erio akaminyoka gochia ase Eli, akamotebia, “Nao inde aa! Aye nigo kwandangeria.” Korende Eli akamoiraneria, “Inche tinkorangereti, genda orare.” Erio Samweli akairana gochia korara.
english: And he ran to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." But Eli said, "I did not call; go back and lie down." So he went and lay down.

ekegusii: Ere nigo anyorete ekiorokererio eke gi’okwaroka buna ekemanyererio ki’oboronge bw’okwegena arenge naborobwo rigoro atararoka, anyare koba ise o bonsi abegenete, nonya tibarogeti, erinde babarerwe oboronge.
english: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. So then, he is the father of all who believe but have not been circumcised, in order that righteousness might be credited to them.

ekegusii: Ere akaba okogamba ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina Asa nigo are korokwa Maaka, mosubati bw’Abisalomu.
english: and he reigned in Jerusalem forty-one years. His grandmother's name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.

ekegusii: akaba okogamba ase engaki y’emiaka etato agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Maaka, omosubati bw’Abisalomu.
english: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother's name was Maacah daughter of Abishalom.

ekegusii: Akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka etato agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Mikaya, mosubati o Urieli, korwa Gibea. Esegi yarenge gati y’Abiya na Yeroboamu.
english: and he reigned in Jerusalem three years. His mother's name was Maacah, a daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

ekegusii: Hanania agakwana ase abanto bategererete, agateba: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Emiaka ebere etaraika nabo ndabune rikorogoto ria Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, rirue ase amagoti ’ebisaku bionsi.” Korende Yeremia omobani akarua agwo, akagenda.
english: and he said before all the people, "This is what the LORD says: 'In the same way will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon off the neck of all the nations within two years.'" At this, the prophet Jeremiah went on his way.

ekegusii: Agatebia Efuroni ekero abanto b’ense eria bamotegererete, “Koranche, ntegerera! Inche nindue rigori ri’oboremo; naye obogorie chifeta korwa asende, na inche nintindeke mokane aroro.”
english: and he said to Ephron in their hearing, "Listen to me, if you will. I will pay the price of the field. Accept it from me so I can bury my dead there."

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Ninkoe okobua oko gwonsi, na obonene bwaye, ekiagera nabieirwe, na inche iga nkoa oyo ngwancha.
english: And he said to him, "I will give you all their authority and splendor, for it has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to.

ekegusii: agatebia abasomba baye, “Oyo nere Yohana Omobatisi, obokigwe korwa ase abakure, eke nakio gekogera chinguru echio chigokora emeremo asare.”
english: and he said to his attendants, "This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him."

ekegusii: “Erio Nyasae agatebia mwanyabanto: Naama! Okomoiroka Omonene, okwo nakwo obong’aini; na ogweatanana korwa ase ebibe, okwo nakwo okomanya.”
english: And he said to man, 'The fear of the Lord-- that is wisdom, and to shun evil is understanding.'"

ekegusii: Agantebia, “Soa gochia ime, erinde orore ebibe bi’okogechia okonene bagokorera aase aiga.”
english: And he said to me, "Go in and see the wicked and detestable things they are doing here."

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamboria, “Aye mwanyabanto, Inee, kwarorire egento Abaisraeli bagokora? Nigo bagokora ebibe ebinge bi’okogechia aase aiga, na bagonseria gochia aare korwa Aase aane Aachenu. Korende norore okogechia okonene kobua okwo.”
english: And he said to me, "Son of man, do you see what they are doing-- the utterly detestable things the house of Israel is doing here, things that will drive me far from my sanctuary? But you will see things that are even more detestable."

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, karie egento ekio kwaeirwe; karie ebuku eye, erio ogende gokwana n’Abaisraeli.”
english: And he said to me, "Son of man, eat what is before you, eat this scroll; then go and speak to the house of Israel."

ekegusii: Omonene akagenderera gokwana nainche, agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, amang’ana onsi nkogotebia oyagache ase enkoro yao ime, oyaigwe namato ao.
english: And he said to me, "Son of man, listen carefully and take to heart all the words I speak to you.

ekegusii: Erio agantebia, “Okwo nokoragererigwa gwachiereire ense yonsi. Kera oyokoiba narusigwe korwa aiga, buna koreng’ana arikire ase ebuku eyio, na kera oyogotiana narusigwe boigo korwa aiga, buna koreng’ana arikire ase ebuku eyio.
english: And he said to me, "This is the curse that is going out over the whole land; for according to what it says on one side, every thief will be banished, and according to what it says on the other, everyone who swears falsely will be banished.

ekegusii: Erio Haroni agatebia Musa, “Aye omonene one, koranche, tobaisa gotoa egesusuro, ekiagera intwe nigo twakorire egento ki’oboriri, na twakorire ebibe.
english: and he said to Moses, "Please, my lord, do not hold against us the sin we have so foolishly committed.

ekegusii: Agatebia omwana oria, “Minyoka origie emegwe eria nkoruta.” Ekero omwana oria arenge kominyoka, Yonathani akaruta omogwe, noro ogaeta igoro yaye, okagwa bosio bwaye.
english: and he said to the boy, "Run and find the arrows I shoot." As the boy ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

ekegusii: And he said to them, "I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.
english: Akabatebia, “Ninganetie mono mono koria Epasaka eye amo nainwe ritang’ani ntarachandwa,

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Mbare abanto bande ase aba bateneine aiga, abataigwe amakweri goika barore oboruoti bwa Nyasae bogocha ne chinguru.”
english: And he said to them, "I tell you the truth, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God come with power."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Mwangire richiko ria Nyasae ng’a monyare kobwata chingencho chiaino.
english: And he said to them: "You have a fine way of setting aside the commands of God in order to observe your own traditions!

ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Aye omosomba o Sarai, ng’ai okorwa, naende ng’ai okogenda?” Akamoiraneria, “Nigo ngotama korwa ase moibori ominto Sarai.”
english: And he said, "Hagar, servant of Sarai, where have you come from, and where are you going?" "I'm running away from my mistress Sarai," she answered.

ekegusii: Naende akabatebia, “Nkobasaba nde egento ekemo: Kera omonto asemore ang’e ebigera bire ase amato aye, biria asakorete.” (Abamidiani nigo babegete ebigera bie chitahabu, ekiagera n’Abaisumaeli barenge.)
english: And he said, "I do have one request, that each of you give me an earring from your share of the plunder." (It was the custom of the Ishmaelites to wear gold earrings.)

ekegusii: ogoteba, “Negwenerete Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, naende aitwe, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.”
english: And he said, "The Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law, and he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life."

ekegusii: na ere akabora, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Kunya chingoro chinyinge ase rigoko eri rikamoku.
english: and he said, "This is what the LORD says: Make this valley full of ditches.

ekegusii: Nyasae akamoboria, “Ing’o ogotebia ng’a ngetirianda ore? Inee! Nkwarire amatunda ’omote oria nagokanetie ng’a toria?”
english: And he said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?"

ekegusii: Agantebia: Imokia amaiso ao, origererie orore, ng’a chigoree echiaete amaicho amarieme nigo chiare namagwari, na ebisembe, ne chimechege, naki narorire onsi aya Labani abeire okogokorera.
english: And he said, 'Look up and see that all the male goats mating with the flock are streaked, speckled or spotted, for I have seen all that Laban has been doing to you.

ekegusii: akabora, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Motaonchogeti mobe buna abana, timogosoa ase oboruoti bwa igoro nonya ng’ake.
english: And he said: "I tell you the truth, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.

ekegusii: Naboigo akwanete aase aande, “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”
english: And he says in another place, "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

ekegusii: omonto oyio kararore omoro oyio ogocha igoro ase ense, abugie egetureri ki’ogokurera abanto.
english: and he sees the sword coming against the land and blows the trumpet to warn the people,

ekegusii: and he sent a man before them-- Joseph, sold as a slave.
english: konya otomire omonto agwo ritang’ani, nere Yusufu konya oonigwe obeire omosomba.

ekegusii: Agatoma abatomwa komotang’anera, bagende na gosoa ase agachie k’Abasamaria, bamoroiserie aase.
english: And he sent messengers on ahead, who went into a Samaritan village to get things ready for him;

ekegusii: Akabatoma korandia oboruoti bwa Nyasae na kogwenia abarwaire.
english: and he sent them out to preach the kingdom of God and to heal the sick.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotomete, akagochika ogende, osirie kegima Abaameleki, abanto abwo ababe, obarwanie goika obaite obakoore.
english: And he sent you on a mission, saying, 'Go and completely destroy those wicked people, the Amalekites; make war on them until you have wiped them out.'

ekegusii: Boigo agaita Omomisiri orenge omonene obwate ritimo. Akamochiera nenyimbo, akamoura ritimo riare koboko kwaye, akamoitera neritimo riria riaye omonyene.
english: And he struck down a huge Egyptian. Although the Egyptian had a spear in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian's hand and killed him with his own spear.

ekegusii: Naende agaita Omomisiri, omonto orenge nobotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Omomisiri oria nigo abwate ritimo koboko kwaye, riachomeire orotanga oronene buna omwaro, korende Benaya akamochiera nenyimbo, akamoura ritimo riarenge koboko kwaye, akamoitera ne ritimo riria riaye omonyene.
english: And he struck down an Egyptian who was seven and a half feet tall. Although the Egyptian had a spear like a weaver's rod in his hand, Benaiah went against him with a club. He snatched the spear from the Egyptian's hand and killed him with his own spear.

ekegusii: agatiana asere oyore moyo goika kare na kare, oyotongete igoro na ebinto bireo, na ense na ebinto bireo, na enyancha na ebinto bireo, agateba, “Engaki ende tekoba nyuma ase aya,
english: And he swore by him who lives for ever and ever, who created the heavens and all that is in them, the earth and all that is in it, and the sea and all that is in it, and said, "There will be no more delay!

ekegusii: achake goaka abasomba b’omonene oye, na koria na konywa amo nabagotinda,
english: and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.

ekegusii: akamotebia ng’a arente ebikorero ebio, abibeke ime ase Hekalu ere aiga Yerusalemu, naende atige enyomba ya Nyasae eagachwe aase yarenge.
english: and he told him, 'Take these articles and go and deposit them in the temple in Jerusalem. And rebuild the house of God on its site.'

ekegusii: And he told them this parable: "The ground of a certain rich man produced a good crop.
english: Akabatebia omoreng’anio, akabora, “Omogondo bw’omonto omonda okama mono.

ekegusii: Akabogoria omogati, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akayosamunyora, akabaa, akabora, “Oyo nomobere one orurwe ase engencho yaino. [Kora iga ase okong’inyora.”
english: And he took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to them, saying, "This is my body given for you; do this in remembrance of me."

ekegusii: Akabibogoria, akabiria ase amaiso abo.
english: and he took it and ate it in their presence.

ekegusii: Erio akabwata emori eria bakorete, akayesamba na koyesegenyia goika ekaba orotu, akaroitera ase amache ime, na akaa Abaisraeli amache ayio, na barabwo bakanywa.
english: And he took the calf they had made and burned it in the fire; then he ground it to powder, scattered it on the water and made the Israelites drink it.

ekegusii: Akabaimokia, akabaagata ase amaboko aye, akabasesenia, okobeka amaboko aye igoro asebare.
english: And he took the children in his arms, put his hands on them and blessed them.

ekegusii: and he uttered his oracle: "The oracle of Balaam son of Beor, the oracle of one whose eye sees clearly,
english: Agwo Baalamu agakwana obobani obo: “Amang’ana aya naro inche Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, ngokwana amang’ana aya nayane, inche omonto oramokigwe amaiso.

ekegusii: Agakumia ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo. Agaetanana ase ebichie biaetanaineo okworokereria.
english: And he was amazed at their lack of faith. Then Jesus went around teaching from village to village.

ekegusii: Erio bakabwata omoruoti oria, bakamoira ase omoruoti o Babeli agwo ase omochie o Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati, na ere akamonachera ekina.
english: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.

ekegusii: Erio bakabwata omoruoti bakamoira ase omoruoti o Babeli agwo Ribula, nere akamonachera ekina.
english: and he was captured. He was taken to the king of Babylon at Riblah, where sentence was pronounced on him.

ekegusii: Akaba ase erooro amatuko emerongo ene, ogoteemwa na Saitani; ere nigo arenge amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana; na abamalaika bakaba nkomokorera bare.
english: and he was in the desert forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and angels attended him.

ekegusii: Akagenda, akamenya omochie oyomo okorokwa Nazareti, rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nababani, “Igo ararokwe Omonazareti.”
english: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was said through the prophets: "He will be called a Nazarene."

ekegusii: Agasoa ase ekegambero, akaboria Yeso naende, “Ing’ai kwarure aye?” Korende Yeso tamoiraneria.
english: and he went back inside the palace. "Where do you come from?" he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.

ekegusii: Korwa aase agwo agatiira, akagenda goika egetunwa gia Karimeli, naende korwa aroro akairana gochia Samaria.
english: And he went on to Mount Carmel and from there returned to Samaria.

ekegusii: Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo.
english: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

ekegusii: Ase ayio akagenda amo nabarabwo, na ekero baigete Yorodan, bakagecha emete.
english: And he went with them. They went to the Jordan and began to cut down trees.

ekegusii: korende ekero aagete eriogi ase okorera, Abamisiri amo nabanto b’enka ya Farao bakamoigwa.
english: And he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh's household heard about it.

ekegusii: Na ere oyokoriga‐rigia chinkoro chi’abanto, namanyete okorengereria kw’Omoika, ekiagera Omoika oyo nigo ogosabera abachenu buna Nyasae anchete.
english: And he who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints in accordance with God's will.

ekegusii: Na oyo orarie emuma ase igoro, nigo ararie ase ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae na ase oyo ogeikaranserete.
english: And he who swears by heaven swears by God's throne and by the one who sits on it.

ekegusii: Na oyo orarie emuma ase Hekalu, nigo ararie ase eyio na ase oyo omenyete imeo.
english: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the one who dwells in it.

ekegusii: Ere nabe aase aino aachenu, korende ase ebisaku ebi bibere bi’Abaisraeli nabe rigena rikogocha, na egetare gekoiyeria inse, naende abe omoeto na oboreba ase abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu.
english: and he will be a sanctuary; but for both houses of Israel he will be a stone that causes men to stumble and a rock that makes them fall. And for the people of Jerusalem he will be a trap and a snare.

ekegusii: Omorisia oyio nabe omorembe oito. Ekero Abaasuri barache ase ense yaito gotorwania na basoe ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, intwe ntosokie abarisia batano na babere, na abagambi batano na batato, babatange.
english: And he will be their peace. When the Assyrian invades our land and marches through our fortresses, we will raise against him seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.

ekegusii: Omogoko oye nobe ase okomoiroka Omonene. Ere takogamba ebina buna amaiso aye ararore, gose takonacha ebina buna araigwe namato aye.
english: and he will delight in the fear of the LORD. He will not judge by what he sees with his eyes, or decide by what he hears with his ears;

ekegusii: Ere natige Abaisraeli ase engencho y’ebibe ebi Yeroboamu akorete, akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.”
english: And he will give Israel up because of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit."

ekegusii: Ere natang’ane bosio bwaye ase omoika ne chinguru chi’Elija, aonchore chinkoro chi’abaise ase abana babo, na aonchore abamochi ase obong’aini bw’abanyene oboronge, abekere ang’e Omonene abanto baroisigwe.”
english: And he will go on before the Lord, in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous-- to make ready a people prepared for the Lord."

ekegusii: Takobaa enyama y’emebere y’abanto baye eyio akoria ere omonyene, ekiagera tabwati kende kiamotigareire. Emechando buna eyio nero ababisa baino barabarentere ekero barasiongorokane emechie yaino yonsi.
english: and he will not give to one of them any of the flesh of his children that he is eating. It will be all he has left because of the suffering your enemy will inflict on you during the siege of all your cities.

ekegusii: nagambere enyomba ya Yakobo goika kare na kare; nonya noboruoti bwaye tibokoba nomoerio.”
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever; his kingdom will never end."

ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye basangererie abachore baye korwa chinsemo chie chinsinyo inye, na korwa chinsinyo chi’ense goika chinsinyo chia igoro.
english: And he will send his angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.

ekegusii: Erio natome abamalaika baye na egeturi ekenene ki’egetureri, na barabwo mbasangererie abachore baye korwa ase chinsinyo inye, korwa ensinyo eyemo ya igoro goika eyende.
english: And he will send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.

ekegusii: na Heburoni. Agatoma ebiegwa ase chinsemo echio chionsi ase arenge kona‐gotaarera amo nabanto baye.
english: and Hebron; and to those in all the other places where David and his men had roamed.

ekegusii: Oyo o kabere nere Asafu, oyo bw’eamate ya Hemani. Ere nigo arenge gotenena ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio. Asafu nigo arenge mosinto o Berekia, o Simea,
english: and Heman's associate Asaph, who served at his right hand: Asaph son of Berekiah, the son of Shimea,

ekegusii: na ise karaigwe igoro y’eira eria y’omoiseke oye, korende takwana ring’ana, eira eria negenderere kobao. Kera egento omoiseke oria akwanire goika ageikeranie.
english: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all her vows and every pledge by which she obligated herself will stand.

ekegusii: na omosacha oye oyaigure, korende takwana ring’ana rinde rionsi, gose komokania, omokungu oyio goika akore na goikerania kera egento akwanete.
english: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her and does not forbid her, then all her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

ekegusii: goika aikeranie onsi. Aya nigo arakoreke onye omosacha oye ase rituko riria aigwete amang’ana ’eira eria agakira, takwana ring’ana rinde rionsi.
english: and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her, then her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand.

ekegusii: na oyo nere amwange, amorikere rirube ri’ogotigana, amoserie korwa bwoye, gose omosacha oyio o kabere akwe.
english: and her second husband dislikes her and writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house, or if he dies,

ekegusii: Abanto b’emechie yaye emeke ere ase engegu mbaitwe nemioro. Erio nario baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: and her settlements on the mainland will be ravaged by the sword. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Naboigo akarentana Gerisomu na Elieseri, abana abamura babere ba Musa. (Musa nigo atebete, “Nabeire omomenyi ase ense engeni”, na akaroka omwana oyomo Gerisomu.
english: and her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses said, "I have become an alien in a foreign land";

ekegusii: Na inche ase ring’ana eri nabaeire ay’ogosemia kwane, mbuya asemore mokoore emeremo eyio eyio mwarenge abachaki koyekora omwaka oeta. Timware koyekora rioka, korende boigo mware nokogania gw’okoyekora.
english: And here is my advice about what is best for you in this matter: Last year you were the first not only to give but also to have the desire to do so.

ekegusii: Hezekia agasaba Omonene, agateba,
english: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD:

ekegusii: Aroro agwo agasaba ase obosio bw’Omonene, agateba, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aye omenyete nobonene bwao igoro y’Abakerubi, aye naye Nyasae, naye bweka ore igoro y’amaruoti onsi ay’ense; naye gwatongete igoro na ense.
english: And Hezekiah prayed to the LORD: "O LORD, God of Israel, enthroned between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

ekegusii: Naende Huramu akarika: “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe, oria okorete igoro na ense, oria oeire Daudi omoruoti omwana ore nobong’aini, omanyete gochora ayare amaya, oyio oraagachere Omonene Hekalu, naende eagachere enyomba y’oboruoti.
english: And Hiram added: "Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who made heaven and earth! He has given King David a wise son, endowed with intelligence and discernment, who will build a temple for the LORD and a palace for himself.

ekegusii: Huramu akamotomera chimeeri chiarenge kogendigwa nabagendia baye, amo nabanto bande bamanyete emeremo y’enyancha. Barabwo bakagenda goika Ofiri amo nabasomba ba Sulemani, bakarenta korwa aroro chitahabu chitalanta amagana ane, na emerongo etano, bakayeirera Sulemani omoruoti.
english: And Hiram sent him ships commanded by his own officers, men who knew the sea. These, with Solomon's men, sailed to Ophir and brought back four hundred and fifty talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.

ekegusii: Hiramu agatoma abanto baye baria bamanyete emeremo ye chinyancha, bagasang’ana nabanto ba Sulemani.
english: And Hiram sent his men-- sailors who knew the sea-- to serve in the fleet with Solomon's men.

ekegusii: Obwanchani bwaye bw’omoyo asemore bwamentekanire, ekero akoinyora okoigwera kwaino inwe mwensi, na buna mwamoroisetie ase okoiroka na okoiguswa.
english: And his affection for you is all the greater when he remembers that you were all obedient, receiving him with fear and trembling.

ekegusii: Abande b’eamate ya Zakaria: Semaya na Asareli, Milalai na Gilalai, Maai na Netaneli, Yuda na Hanani. Abwo nigo babwate ebinto biare kobugigwa, ebio Daudi, omonto o Nyasae, achigete. Ezara, omworokia bw’amariko, akaba otang’anete ekeombe ekio.
english: and his associates-- Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah and Hanani-- with musical instruments [prescribed by] David the man of God. Ezra the scribe led the procession.

ekegusii: na abamwabo, abanto abamanyete gokora emeremo buya, rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128). Omoteneneri obo nere Sabidieli, mosinto o Hagedolimu.
english: and his associates, who were able men-- 128. Their chief officer was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.

ekegusii: na abamwabo, abarenge abateneneri be chiamate, bonsi nabanto amagana abere na emerongo ene, na babere (242); Amasai, mosinto bw’Asareli, bw’Asai, o Mesilemoti, o Imeri,
english: and his associates, who were heads of families-- 242 men; Amashsai son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

ekegusii: and his firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
english: Omwana oye omomura omotangi nere Abidoni; na abande nabwo aba: Suri na Kisi, Baali na Nadabu,

ekegusii: and his firstborn son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
english: Abidoni nere orenge omwana oye omomura omotangi, na abande nabwo aba: Suri na Kisi, Baali na Neri, na Nadabu,

ekegusii: Na nyuma yaye Gabai na Salai. Bonsi nabanto amagana kianda, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (928).
english: and his followers, Gabbai and Sallai-- 928 men.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bansesenetie, ekiagera nabaete chingobo chi’amarionya e ching’ondi chikorwa ase amaicho aane.”
english: and his heart did not bless me for warming him with the fleece from my sheep,

ekegusii: Nasabire ng’a momanye obonene bw’okobua kwaye botari nekerengo, obo bwatoikeire intwe abatwegenire koreng’ana nogokora gw’okobua kwaye okonene.
english: and his incomparably great power for us who believe. That power is like the working of his mighty strength,

ekegusii: igo obeire nogwatananekana. Omoiseke omwekungi nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’Omonene, buna aranyare koba omochenu ase omobere na ase omoika, korende oyonyuomirwe nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’ense, buna aragwenere omosacha oye.
english: and his interests are divided. An unmarried woman or virgin is concerned about the Lord's affairs: Her aim is to be devoted to the Lord in both body and spirit. But a married woman is concerned about the affairs of this world-- how she can please her husband.

ekegusii: Na Isumaeli, omwana oye, nigo konya abeire nemiaka ikomi, na etato, ekero akebetwe risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha.
english: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;

ekegusii: Na ogosemeria tikori gotorentera obosooku, ekiagera obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaichorigwe ase chinkoro chiaito n’Omoika Omochenu, oyo twaetwe.
english: And hope does not disappoint us, because God has poured out his love into our hearts by the Holy Spirit, whom he has given us.

ekegusii: Naende naki bararandie batatomiri? Buna erikire, “Naki amagoro abo are amaseera, baria bakorandia amang’ana amaya!”
english: And how can they preach unless they are sent? As it is written, "How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!"

ekegusii: Naki korwa obwana bwao nomanyete amariko amachenu, ayaranyare gokong’ainiyia goika onyore ogotooreka ase okwegena kore ase Kristo Yeso.
english: and how from infancy you have known the holy Scriptures, which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Na inche nasemeirie ase Omonene ng’a inche omonyene boigo ninchiche bwango.
english: And I am confident in the Lord that I myself will come soon.

ekegusii: Erio ngatebia omoruoti, “Onye yakogweneire aye omoruoti, na inche, omosomba oo, nanyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, ong’e ribaga ngende ase ense y’Abayuda, ase omochie oria ase chisokoro chiane chiatindegetwe, erinde nyoagache naende.”
english: and I answered the king, "If it pleases the king and if your servant has found favor in his sight, let him send me to the city in Judah where my fathers are buried so that I can rebuild it."

ekegusii: Erio natung’ama inse nasasima Omonene. Naende namotogia Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Ibrahimu, oyontang’anete ase enchera endonge, erinde imorentere omwana bw’omonene one omokungu korwa ase eamate yaye.
english: and I bowed down and worshiped the LORD. I praised the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me on the right road to get the granddaughter of my master's brother for his son.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria ngachika abagambi baino, nkabatebia: Motegerera ebina bire ase egati y’Abaisraeli bamino. Monache ekina kia boronge, kerabe ase egati y’omonto na oyomwabo, gose ase egati yaye na omomenyi omenyete bwoye.
english: And I charged your judges at that time: Hear the disputes between your brothers and judge fairly, whether the case is between brother Israelites or between one of them and an alien.

ekegusii: And I confer on you a kingdom, just as my Father conferred one on me,
english: na inche nabaeire inwe oboruoti buna Tata ang’ete,

ekegusii: Nkarora ng’a nigo ere buya ase abakure kobua ase abare moyo.
english: And I declared that the dead, who had already died, are happier than the living, who are still alive.

ekegusii: “Nkaa abanto b’eamate ya Makiri, orogongo rwa Gileadi,
english: And I gave Gilead to Makir.

ekegusii: Erio nkaa Baruku, mosinto o Neria, o Maseya, okobwatana koria agwo ase obosio bwa Hanameli, momura o tata moke, na ase amasio a birori baria konya barikire amarieta abo ase okobwatana okwo, boigo nase amasio ’Abayahudi bonsi abwo baikaransete ase egoora y’enyomba y’abasibwa.
english: and I gave this deed to Baruch son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of my cousin Hanamel and of the witnesses who had signed the deed and of all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard.

ekegusii: Inche Nyasae namoichoirie omoika one, namoeire obong’aini ne chisemi amanye gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia,
english: and I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability and knowledge in all kinds of crafts--

ekegusii: na igo narengereirie kobang’anyia korwa Misiri ase mogochandwa, na kobaira ase ense y’Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke.
english: And I have promised to bring you up out of your misery in Egypt into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites-- a land flowing with milk and honey.'

ekegusii: Na bono nachorire Abalawi babe abaane ribaga ri’abana abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli.
english: And I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn sons in Israel.

ekegusii: Ninde nogosemeria ase Nyasae buna barabwo bare nakorokwo, ng’a okobokigwa kw’abakure nakobe ase abanyene oboronge, na ase abatari abanyene oboronge boigo.
english: and I have the same hope in God as these men, that there will be a resurrection of both the righteous and the wicked.

ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rinene rikorwa ase ekerogo keria ki’obonene rigoteba, “Rora obomenyo bwa Nyasae nigo bore amo na mwanyabanto. Ere namenye amo nabarabwo, na barabwo nababe abanto baye, na Nyasae omonyene nabe amo nabarabwo.
english: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, "Now the dwelling of God is with men, and he will live with them. They will be his people, and God himself will be with them and be their God.

ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi ri’omonto rikorangeria korwa gati‐gati y’orooche rwa Ulai, rigoteba, “Aye Gabirieli, momanyie omonto oyio engencho y’okorora okwo!”
english: And I heard a man's voice from the Ulai calling, "Gabriel, tell this man the meaning of the vision."

ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rikorwa igoro buna eriogi ri’amache amange akoeera, na buna eriogi ri’enkoba enene. Eriogi riria naigwete riarenge buna eriogi ri’abaare kobugia amakano abo.
english: And I heard a sound from heaven like the roar of rushing waters and like a loud peal of thunder. The sound I heard was like that of harpists playing their harps.

ekegusii: Naende nkaigwa eriogi korwa ase egesasimero rigoteba, “Ee, aye Omonene Nyasae, Omobui, okogamba kwao nogw’ekeene na okwa boronge!”
english: And I heard the altar respond: "Yes, Lord God Almighty, true and just are your judgments."

ekegusii: Korende inche nindore obosio bwao inde noboronge; ekero ndabokigwe ning’isaneke ase ogokorora.
english: And I-- in righteousness I will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.

ekegusii: Na inche namanyire omonto oyio, (onye orenge ase omobere tinkomanya, onye orenge isiko y’omobere tinkomanya, Nyasae nere omanyete);
english: And I know that this man-- whether in the body or apart from the body I do not know, but God knows--

ekegusii: Omonene otebire ng’a nere bweka omonyene orabe orwaki rw’omorero ase chinsemo chionsi chi’omochie oyio, ere neorokie imeo abe obonene bwaye.”
english: And I myself will be a wall of fire around it,' declares the LORD, 'and I will be its glory within.'

ekegusii: Nkabeka ebonyi ase emioro yao, na ebigera ase amato ao, na egutwa enseera ase omotwe oo.
english: and I put a ring on your nose, earrings on your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.

ekegusii: Nkabatebia iga: Kera oyomo oino tiga atugute korwa asare ebinto bi’okogechia ebio anchete korigereria, timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’emegwekano eyio Abamisiri bagosasima. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: And I said to them, "Each of you, get rid of the vile images you have set your eyes on, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt. I am the LORD your God."

ekegusii: Naende nkarora omomalaika bwe chinguru okoraria neriogi rinene, ogoteba, “Ning’o ogwenerete koigora ebuku, na gosansora ebimanyererio biaye?”
english: And I saw a mighty angel proclaiming in a loud voice, "Who is worthy to break the seals and open the scroll?"

ekegusii: Erio nkarora omomalaika ogoika korwa igoro ore nekeigorero ki’eora y’abakure na ekenyuri ekenene ase okoboko kwaye.
english: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key to the Abyss and holding in his hand a great chain.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora omomalaika oteneine ase erioba ime, okorera ase eriogi rinene, ogotebia chinyoni chiare koiruruka ase igoro gati, “Inchuo mosangererekane ase omoyega omonene o Nyasae.
english: And I saw an angel standing in the sun, who cried in a loud voice to all the birds flying in midair, "Come, gather together for the great supper of God,

ekegusii: Erio abanto batano nomo bagacha korwa ase egeita kia rogoro kerochie sugusu. Kera oyomo agacha obwate ekerwanero kiaye ki’ogoita koboko kwaye, bare amo nomonto obegete eanga y’egatani, bwebeoranetie ekaramu akorikera, ere kenema kiaye. Abanto abwo bagasoa ime, bagatenena ang’e negesasimero kiaroisirie korwa ase etaai.
english: And I saw six men coming from the direction of the upper gate, which faces north, each with a deadly weapon in his hand. With them was a man clothed in linen who had a writing kit at his side. They came in and stood beside the bronze altar.

ekegusii: Naende nkarora aiga inse y’erioba ng’a aase ekeene kegwenerete koba, nao obobe bore, na aase oboronge bogwenerete koba, nao boigo obobe bore.
english: And I saw something else under the sun: In the place of judgment-- wickedness was there, in the place of justice-- wickedness was there.

ekegusii: Nkarora emeremo eye emekong’u egokorwa, na omokia bwonsi bw’ogwechanda ase ogokora emeremo, ayio nigo agokorwa, ekiagera omonto akoba ne ribero ng’a abue oyonde. Ayio boigo mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
english: And I saw that all labor and all achievement spring from man's envy of his neighbor. This too is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

ekegusii: Naende nkarora abakure, abanene na abake, bateneneine ase ekerogo ki’obonene, ne chibuku chikaigorwa. Na ebuku ende ekaigorwa, eyio nero ebuku y’obogima. Abakure bakagambigwa ase amang’ana arikire ime ase chibuku echio koreng’ana buna ogokora kwabo kwarenge.
english: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged according to what they had done as recorded in the books.

ekegusii: Nkarora obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli bogocha korwa moocha; eriogi ri’ogocha kwaye nigo riarenge koeera buna eri’amache amange, na ense ekamorekwa nobonene bwaye.
english: and I saw the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. His voice was like the roar of rushing waters, and the land was radiant with his glory.

ekegusii: Agwo nkarora abamalaika batano na babere abateneine ase obosio bwa Nyasae, bakaegwa ebitureri bitano na bibere.
english: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and to them were given seven trumpets.

ekegusii: Naende nkarora aase arenge buna enyancha y’ekerore, esang’anaine nomorero. Naboigo nkarora abwo babuire eng’iti na omogwekano oye, na enamba y’erieta riaye. Barabwo nigo bateneine ensemo y’enyancha y’ekerore, mbabwate amakano aya baetwe na Nyasae.
english: And I saw what looked like a sea of glass mixed with fire and, standing beside the sea, those who had been victorious over the beast and his image and over the number of his name. They held harps given them by God

ekegusii: Ngatoma abanto abwo gochia ase Ido, omotang’ani bw’aase akorokwa Kasifa, bamotebie ere amo nabanto bamwabo, abarenge abakori emeremo be Hekalu abamenyete aroro ng’a batotomere abanto bache gokorera Nyasae oito ase enyomba yaye.
english: and I sent them to Iddo, the leader in Casiphia. I told them what to say to Iddo and his kinsmen, the temple servants in Casiphia, so that they might bring attendants to us for the house of our God.

ekegusii: Na inche nagotebirie, ng’a aye naye Petero, na ase egetare eke ning’agache ekanisa yane, ne chinguru chi’amakweri tichikoyebua.
english: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.

ekegusii: Erio ngatebia abanto abwo bonsi boosetwe amang’ana onsi aya Omonene konya anyorokirie.
english: and I told the exiles everything the LORD had shown me.

ekegusii: Inche nagotebirie: Moe omwana one ribaga agende gonkorera korende koraange, rirorio nigo ndaite omwana oo omotangi.”
english: and I told you, "Let my son go, so he may worship me." But you refused to let him go; so I will kill your firstborn son.'"

ekegusii: Korende nasemeirie ng’a namomanye ng’a intwe titwangiri.
english: And I trust that you will discover that we have not failed the test.

ekegusii: Bono nkabarengera chifeta, ne chitahabu; na ebikorero, ebio omoruoti, na abasemia baye, na abagambi bare komokonya, na Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge agwo, konya barure ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: and I weighed out to them the offering of silver and gold and the articles that the king, his advisers, his officials and all Israel present there had donated for the house of our God.

ekegusii: Naende inche ninsabe Tata, na ere nabae Omokonyi onde oyoramenye amo nainwe goika kare na kare,
english: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Counselor to be with you forever--

ekegusii: Nindete esegi asemore, inyeruserie egesiomba, ekiagera mwasaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania. Komorabe mogosangererekana ase emechie yaino korigia obotamero, nimbatomere amarwaire amabe abaite, goika mobekwe ase amaboko ’ababisa baino.
english: And I will bring the sword upon you to avenge the breaking of the covenant. When you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be given into enemy hands.

ekegusii: Nimbaire goika ense eria nariete eira inyimogetie okoboko kwane koa Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo. Nimbayee ebe omwando oino. Inche ninche Omonene.”
english: And I will bring you to the land I swore with uplifted hand to give to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob. I will give it to you as a possession. I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Inche nkerigeria abanto abegenwa babe birori, nabwo Uria omokuani, na Zakaria, mosinto o Yeberekia.
english: And I will call in Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah as reliable witnesses for me."

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ekeene nimbise obosio bwane korwa asebare, ekiagera bakorire amabe baonchokeire chinyasae ching’ao.
english: And I will certainly hide my face on that day because of all their wickedness in turning to other gods.

ekegusii: Ningotoorie aye amo nomochie oyo, korwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri; ning’egere omochie oyo.
english: And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city.

ekegusii: Kende gionsi morasabe ase erieta riane, ekio nangekore, erinde Tata abakwe ime ase Omwana.
english: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Son may bring glory to the Father.

ekegusii: Inche ning’ee birori baane babere okobua gw’okobana, na barabwo inababane ase engaki y’amatuko elifu eyemo na amagana abere, na emerongo etano nomo, babekeire chianga chie chigunia.”
english: And I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy for 1,260 days, clothed in sackcloth."

ekegusii: Inche ninkong’ie enkoro ya Farao, ache kobabwatia korwa nyuma yaino, na inche ninyenyorere ogotogigwa ase okobua Farao amo nomoganda oye bwonsi, na Abamisiri bamanye ng’a ninche Omonene.” Abaisraeli bagakora buna batebetigwe.
english: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and he will pursue them. But I will gain glory for myself through Pharaoh and all his army, and the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD." So the Israelites did this.

ekegusii: Ninachere Abamoabu ekina, erio bamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: and I will inflict punishment on Moab. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Korende eri ngokora, ningenderere korikora, erinde mbatange abakorigia ribaga tibanyora ribaga ri’ogwetogia barorekane koba buna intwe tore.
