english: And I will keep on doing what I am doing in order to cut the ground from under those who want an opportunity to be considered equal with us in the things they boast about.

ekegusii: Inche nigo ndamenye aroro ase egati y’Abaisraeli, tingotiga abanto baane Abaisraeli.”
english: And I will live among the Israelites and will not abandon my people Israel."

ekegusii: And I will make every effort to see that after my departure you will always be able to remember these things.
english: Na inche ninkore omokia ng’a botambe nyuma y’ogokwa kwane monyare koinyora amang’ana aya.

ekegusii: Ninsangererie abanto abange bache asemore bamenyeo, ee, Abaisraeli bonsi; emechie yaino nemenywe naende, na amatombe naro naagachwe naende.
english: and I will multiply the number of people upon you, even the whole house of Israel. The towns will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.

ekegusii: Ninyorere abanto baane Abaisraeli aase ndababeke bamenye ase obotoereru. Abanto ababe tibakobachanda naende, buna babachandete kare.
english: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning

ekegusii: Ninchorere abanto baane Abaisraeli aase ndababekere bamenye, aase abo abanyene, na abakori amabe tibakobachanda naende nonya ng’ake buna babachandete agwo ritang’ani
english: And I will provide a place for my people Israel and will plant them so that they can have a home of their own and no longer be disturbed. Wicked people will not oppress them anymore, as they did at the beginning

ekegusii: Inche nimbeke obobisa ase egati yao na omokungu oyo, na ase egati y’oroiboro rwao na oroiboro rwaye; rororwo narogosenyente omotwe oo, na aye nomorome egetingiro kiaye.”
english: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel."

ekegusii: Nimbeke omoika one ime yaino, erio mbaonchore mobwatie emeroberio yane echikire, morende amachiko aane na moyakore.
english: And I will put my Spirit in you and move you to follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire: “Nimbeke abande b’abwo babe abakuani na Abalawi.”
english: And I will select some of them also to be priests and Levites," says the LORD.

ekegusii: Nindambore okoboko kwane mbaake, insirie ense yabo nyetige bosa, ee, aase aande onsi bamenyete nabe bosa kobua erooro ya Dibula. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: And I will stretch out my hand against them and make the land a desolate waste from the desert to Diblah--wherever they live. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Omoamate bw’omonto oyio okure nache kobogoria amauga amo noyo ogochia koyasamba. Omoamate oria narangerie onde bwensi otigarete ase enyomba eria ime, amoborie, “Onde nare aa motigarete komo?” Omonto oria nairanerie, akane, “Yaya.” Erio omoamate oria namotebie “Kira‐kiri! Twerende titobaisa gwatora erieta ri’Omonene.”
english: And if a relative who is to burn the bodies comes to carry them out of the house and asks anyone still hiding there, "Is anyone with you?" and he says, "No," then he will say, "Hush! We must not mention the name of the LORD."

ekegusii: Korende oyonde oikaransete karaigorerwe ring’ana, oria bwe ritang’anitiga akire.
english: And if a revelation comes to someone who is sitting down, the first speaker should stop.

ekegusii: Na omokori amabe karaonchoke, atige amabe aye, erio akore ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge, nabe moyo ase engencho y’ayio.
english: And if a wicked man turns away from his wickedness and does what is just and right, he will live by doing so.

ekegusii: Na omokungu ore nomosacha otegeneti, na omosacha oyo bwanchire komenya nere, tamotiga.
english: And if a woman has a husband who is not a believer and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.

ekegusii: Naende nenyare koba ng’a omokungu oyio gatigire omosacha oria, agende anyuomwe nomosacha omoao,
english: and if after she leaves his house she becomes the wife of another man,

ekegusii: Kera omonto ore asemore, oyobogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi nigo aramboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodan, ase obosio bw’Omonene: mobeereo goika ere abue ababisa baye barue asare,
english: and if all of you will go armed over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven his enemies out before him--

ekegusii: Onye chinyama gose emegati bigotigara goika mambia, erio obisambe nomorero; tibibaisa koriegwa, ekiagera nebichenu.
english: And if any of the meat of the ordination ram or any bread is left over till morning, burn it up. It must not be eaten, because it is sacred.

ekegusii: Na kera aase abanto batabaroiseti inwe, gose kobaigwa, komokorua aroro, mokong’onte orotu rore inse ase amagoro aino, robe kirori asebare.”
english: And if any place will not welcome you or listen to you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave, as a testimony against them."

ekegusii: Naki onde bwensi oramoe oyomo obo bw’aba abake amache amakendu negekombe ekiagera ere nomworokigwa, nekeene nabatebirie: Tagosiria eng’eria yaye nonya ng’ake.”
english: And if anyone gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because he is my disciple, I tell you the truth, he will certainly not lose his reward."

ekegusii: Nigo erabe ng’a omonto aise kooroka kobana, ng’ina na ise abwo bamoiborete bamotebie, “Aye tokonyara koba moyo, ekiagera nigo okobana oborimo ase erieta ri’Omonene.” Ekero omonto oyio agendererete kobana, abaibori abwo baye mbamobete ritimo.
english: And if anyone still prophesies, his father and mother, to whom he was born, will say to him, 'You must die, because you have told lies in the LORD's name.' When he prophesies, his own parents will stab him.

ekegusii: na monto onde bwensi kararusie ensemo y’amang’ana ’obobani bw’ebuku eye, Nyasae narusie ensemo yaye ase omote oria bw’obogima, na ase omochie oria omochenu, ayarikire ase ebuku eye.
english: And if anyone takes words away from this book of prophecy, God will take away from him his share in the tree of life and in the holy city, which are described in this book.

ekegusii: Na engaki ende yonsi inche ndakwane igoro y’okoagacha na gokinia abanto b’egesaku gose oboruoti,
english: And if at another time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be built up and planted,

ekegusii: Korende onye nase obuya, rirorio tibokoba ase ogokora, onye taibo, obuya tibokoba obuya.
english: And if by grace, then it is no longer by works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace.

ekegusii: Naende onye Kristo tabogetigwe, rirorio okorandia gwaito nokwa bosa, na okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa.
english: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is useless and so is your faith.

ekegusii: Na onye Kristo tabogetigwe, okwegena kwaino nokwa bosa; nigo more nonya mbono ase ebibe biaino.
english: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.

ekegusii: Omosacha oye karabe nomoika bwe risemi akagere mokaye ng’a bwekorire omosaria, nere abe okorete ayio, gose tayakorete,
english: and if feelings of jealousy come over her husband and he suspects his wife and she is impure-- or if he is jealous and suspects her even though she is not impure--

ekegusii: Kayenyorire, nekeene nabatebirie: Nagoke ase eria kobua ase chiria emerongo kianda na kianda chitasirete.
english: And if he finds it, I tell you the truth, he is happier about that one sheep than about the ninety-nine that did not wander off.

ekegusii: Karamoake amogookore erino, goika amotige abe omosibore ase engencho y’erino riaye.”
english: And if he knocks out the tooth of a manservant or maidservant, he must let the servant go free to compensate for the tooth.

ekegusii: Korende agatooria Loti, omonyene oboronge, oyorenge goichanigwa ase orogendo rw’obonyaka rwa baria abasaria amachiko.
english: and if he rescued Lot, a righteous man, who was distressed by the filthy lives of lawless men

ekegusii: naende nimbaboria, timokong’iraneria.
english: and if I asked you, you would not answer.

ekegusii: Korende onye ngokora aya ntancheti, rirorio nanchire ng’a amachiko namaya.
english: And if I do what I do not want to do, I agree that the law is good.

ekegusii: Na inche, onye ngoseria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli, Inee, abana baino nase ng’o bakobiseria? Ase engencho eyio, barabwo nababe abagambi baino.
english: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your people drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

ekegusii: Kondagende kobaroiseria aase, ninchiche naende, nimbaroisie asende, erinde asende inche, nainwe mobeo.
english: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.

ekegusii: Onye nanga tinyigwera omoruoti, korende ing’ite omwana oye, ere anga naigwa amang’ana ayio, ekiagera nigo are komanya kera ring’ana. Inee! Aye omonyene ngonkengera kware?”
english: And if I had put my life in jeopardy--and nothing is hidden from the king-- you would have kept your distance from me."

ekegusii: Naende, kondatebie omokori amabe: Aye goika okwe, korende karaonchoke atige ebibe biaye, akore ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge,
english: And if I say to the wicked man, 'You will surely die,' but he then turns away from his sin and does what is just and right--

ekegusii: Komoratiane ase ekeene na oboronge, mogoteba: Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, rirorio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbesesenie ime yaye, naende mbetogie asare.”
english: and if in a truthful, just and righteous way you swear, 'As surely as the LORD lives,' then the nations will be blessed by him and in him they will glory."

ekegusii: na abanto abwo kobarakore ebibe ase obosio bwane baange konyigwera, inche ning’onchoke, ntige amaya aria narengereretie kobakorera.
english: and if it does evil in my sight and does not obey me, then I will reconsider the good I had intended to do for it.

ekegusii: Onye nomokungu nigo rirabe chisekeli emerongo etato.
english: and if it is a female, set her value at thirty shekels.

ekegusii: Na onye Saitani bweimokeire ere omonyene, na gweatanana, takonyara gotenena, korende nabe nomoerio.
english: And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.

ekegusii: na omokungu karatige omosacha oye, na konyuomwa nomonto onde, nere otomanire.”
english: And if she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery."

ekegusii: Onye ere okong’iraneria: Ee, kanywe, na nimbuuchere chingamia chiao nachirochio; otige oyio abe nere omokungu Omonene achoreire omwana bw’omonene one.
english: and if she says to me, "Drink, and I'll draw water for your camels too," let her be the one the LORD has chosen for my master's son.'

ekegusii: And if someone wants to sue you and take your tunic, let him have your cloak as well.
english: Na omonto karigetie kogosoera na koira eanga yao ya ime, omotigere neya isiko boigo.

ekegusii: na abanto b’oboruoti obwo nakwanire amang’ana aane igoro asebare, kobaraonchoke na batige ebibe biabo, na inche ning’onchoke ntige amabe aria nare gochia gokora asebare.
english: and if that nation I warned repents of its evil, then I will relent and not inflict on it the disaster I had planned.

ekegusii: na onye ekemoa gekororekana kere nekieni buna obonyansi, gose ekebariri, ase eanga, gose ase risankwa, gose ase egetambaa keria, gose ase egento kende keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, obwo noukoma bogwesiarera, na ebinto ebi biorokigwe ase omokuani.
english: and if the contamination in the clothing, or leather, or woven or knitted material, or any leather article, is greenish or reddish, it is a spreading mildew and must be shown to the priest.

ekegusii: Na onye ogoto kogoteba, “Ekiagera inche tindi eriso, inche tindi oyo bw’omobere”, Inee, igo tikori okw’omobere ase engencho eyio?
english: And if the ear should say, "Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body," it would not for that reason cease to be part of the body.

ekegusii: na amang’ana ayio aikeranigwe. Aise kobatebia: Togende tosasime chinyasae ching’ao, (echio motana gosasima agwo ritang’ani,) tochikorere,
english: and if the sign or wonder of which he has spoken takes place, and he says, "Let us follow other gods" (gods you have not known) "and let us worship them,"

ekegusii: Korende onye Omoika oye ere oyobogetie Yeso korwa ase abakure omenyete ime yaino, ere oyobogetie Kristo Yeso korwa ase abakure nabokie na emebere yaino eranyorekane namakweri, ase engencho y’Omoika oyomenyete ime yaino.
english: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit, who lives in you.

ekegusii: Onye bakoba nobosooku ase engencho y’amabe onsi bakorire, rirorio oborokie omogwekano bw’enyomba eyio buna erobeirie, na aase aye agosoerwa na aase agosokerwa, na okororekana kwaye, amo nemeroberio yaye yonsi, na amachiko aye. Oyarikere agwo ase amasio abo, erinde babwate emeroberio yaye yonsi na koyekora.
english: and if they are ashamed of all they have done, make known to them the design of the temple-- its arrangement, its exits and entrances-- its whole design and all its regulations and laws. Write these down before them so that they may be faithful to its design and follow all its regulations.

ekegusii: Barabwo kobarakoborie ng’a ng’ai bakogenda, obatebie: Aya naro Omonene agoteba:” “Abanto baria bagochia gokwa ase oborwaire bogoita, baitwe naborobwo, na abagochia goitwa nemioro, baitwe nero; baria bagochia gokwa ase enchara, bakwe nenchara, na baria bagochia gwoswa, booswe bairwe.
english: And if they ask you, 'Where shall we go?' tell them, 'This is what the LORD says: "'Those destined for death, to death; those for the sword, to the sword; those for starvation, to starvation; those for captivity, to captivity.'

ekegusii: Nonya nabwo bande, onye tibakogenderera ase ogotegena kwabo, rirorio nabachomwe, ekiagera Nyasae nare nokobua kobachoma naende.
english: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

ekegusii: kobararore okomocha kwabo ekero bare ase ense eria boosirwe gochia, kobareitie baonchoke, naende bakogosaba ase oboitongo na koorokia ng’a bakorire ebibe na obokayayu;
english: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their captivity and say, 'We have sinned, we have done wrong and acted wickedly';

ekegusii: Kobararore okomocha kwabo ekero bare ase ense eria boosirwe gochia, beitie na koonchoka, naende bakogosaba ase oboitongo na koorokia ng’a bakorire ebibe na obokayayu, obaigwe.
english: and if they have a change of heart in the land where they are held captive, and repent and plead with you in the land of their conquerors and say, 'We have sinned, we have done wrong, we have acted wickedly';

ekegusii: Onye ekero ekio abanto abwo bakweorokereria chinchera chi’abanto baane, na gotiana ase erieta riane, bagoteba: Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, buna abwo kare borokereretie abanto baane gotiana ase erieta ri’enyasae Baali, erio nario ndabasesenie na kobairaneria amaya abo, ase egati y’abanto baane.
english: And if they learn well the ways of my people and swear by my name, saying, 'As surely as the LORD lives'-- even as they once taught my people to swear by Baal-- then they will be established among my people.

ekegusii: onye bagweitia na koonchoka ase ebirengererio biabo bionsi na ase chinkoro chiabo chionsi, ekero bare ase ense eria ase boosetwe gochia, na aroro agwo bagosabe barigereretie gochia ase ense yabo, eria kwaete chisokoro chiabo, na barigererie omochie oyo gwachorire na enyomba eye naagachire ase ogosasima erieta riao,
english: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their captivity where they were taken, and pray toward the land you gave their fathers, toward the city you have chosen and toward the temple I have built for your Name;

ekegusii: Onye bagweitia na koonchoka ase ebirengererio biabo bionsi na ase chinkoro chiabo chionsi, ekero bare ase ense eria y’ababisa babo, baria baboosete, na aroro bagosabe barigereretie gochia ase ense yabo, eria kwaete chisokoro chiabo, na barigererie omochie oyo gwachorire na enyomba eye naagachire ase ogosasima erieta riao,
english: and if they turn back to you with all their heart and soul in the land of their enemies who took them captive, and pray to you toward the land you gave their fathers, toward the city you have chosen and the temple I have built for your Name;

ekegusii: Onye okomocha okwo gwakorirwe ase ogotancha, na ase ogotamanya kw’omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto, rirorio barue eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene. Amo nekio barente okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa, koreng’ana nomoroberio ochikire, amo negoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
english: and if this is done unintentionally without the community being aware of it, then the whole community is to offer a young bull for a burnt offering as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, along with its prescribed grain offering and drink offering, and a male goat for a sin offering.

ekegusii: Onye tokorenda na koigwera amachiko aya onsi, ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere atochikire, nigo torabarerwe oboronge.”
english: And if we are careful to obey all this law before the LORD our God, as he has commanded us, that will be our righteousness."

ekegusii: Na gatomanyete ng’a nigo agotoigwa ase kende gionsi togosaba, twamanyire ng’a twanyorire keria twasabire korwa asare.
english: And if we know that he hears us-- whatever we ask-- we know that we have what we asked of him.

ekegusii: Ekiagera onye boria bwaetete bwarenge nobonene bwaye, boria boreo botambe mbore nobonene kobua mono.
english: And if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which lasts!

ekegusii: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
english: Na inwe onye morigetie gwancha, ere nere Elija otebetwe ore gocha.

ekegusii: Oise kweboria ase enkoro yao ime ng’a nase ki amang’ana ayio agocheire, manya ng’a nase engencho y’ebibe biao ebinene. Ebibe ebio biagerire chianga chiao chiasiorigwe na obogetirianda bwao bwarorekanire.
english: And if you ask yourself, "Why has this happened to me?"-- it is because of your many sins that your skirts have been torn off and your body mistreated.

ekegusii: Obe gokorangeria korigia chisemi, naende osorore onyore okomanya.
english: and if you call out for insight and cry aloud for understanding,

ekegusii: Moise gokora ayio, ense eyio nigo erabaange morue aroro, buna yangete abanto b’ebisaku, abwo babatang’anete komenyao,
english: And if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it vomited out the nations that were before you.

ekegusii: And if you do good to those who are good to you, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' do that.
english: Komorabakorere amaya abwo abakobakorera inwe amaya, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nabo bagokora.

ekegusii: na mwangire koigwera amang’ana ’abasomba baane ababani, abwo nabete nkobatomera naende naende,
english: and if you do not listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I have sent to you again and again (though you have not listened),

ekegusii: Na inwe komorakwanie abamino boka, mbuya ki mwakora kobua abande? Nonya nabanto b’Ebisaku tibari gokora bo?
english: And if you greet only your brothers, what are you doing more than others? Do not even pagans do that?

ekegusii: Onye timobeti abegenwa ase ekio ki’omonto onde, ning’o oranyare kobaa ekio ekere kiaino abanyene?
english: And if you have not been trustworthy with someone else's property, who will give you property of your own?

ekegusii: Naende komorarue singo ase abanto mosemeretie konyora egento korwa asebare naende, imbuya ki moranyore? Ekiagera nonya nabanyene ebibe nigo bakorua singo ase abanyene ebibe, erinde banyore koreng’ana.
english: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even 'sinners' lend to 'sinners,' expecting to be repaid in full.

ekegusii: and if you look for it as for silver and search for it as for hidden treasure,
english: Origie obong’aini buna okorigia chifeta, obogira‐girie buna okoriga‐rigia chinibo chibisire.

ekegusii: na onye timokobwatia aya nachikire, naende komoraange emeroberio yane echikire, na timokora amachiko aane onsi, korende mobe mogosaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania,
english: and if you reject my decrees and abhor my laws and fail to carry out all my commands and so violate my covenant,

ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe nigo mogontebia ng’a nigo mosemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oino? Tari ere oria aase aye aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa amo nebisasimero biaye Hezekia atagoire, agatebia Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu: Mobe mogosasima bosio bw’egesasimero eke aiga Yerusalemu?
english: And if you say to me, "We are depending on the LORD our God"-- isn't he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, "You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem"?

ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe nigo mogontebia ng’a nigo mosemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oino? Tari ere oria aase aye aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa amo nebisasimero biaye Hezekia atagoire, agatebia Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu: Mobe mogosasima bosio bw’egesasimero eke!
english: And if you say to me, "We are depending on the LORD our God"-- isn't he the one whose high places and altars Hezekiah removed, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, "You must worship before this altar"?

ekegusii: naende moise goteba ng’a nigo moganetie kogenda ase ense ya Misiri ase motarore esegi, gose koigwa egetureri gi’esegi, gose ase motabe nenchara y’okoborwa endagera,
english: and if you say, 'No, we will go and live in Egypt, where we will not see war or hear the trumpet or be hungry for bread,'

ekegusii: korakonye abare nenchara na oe oyochandegete eki’aremeire, rirorio omobaso oo nobare ase omosunte, na obotuko bwao mbobe buna mobaso gati.
english: and if you spend yourselves in behalf of the hungry and satisfy the needs of the oppressed, then your light will rise in the darkness, and your night will become like the noonday.

ekegusii: Na korarende chinchera chiane, na emeroberio yane echikire, na amachiko aane amachenu, buna Daudi iso akorete, erio ningokore obe moyo amatuko amange.”
english: And if you walk in my ways and obey my statutes and commands as David your father did, I will give you a long life."

ekegusii: Onye neriso riao rikogera okore ebibe, orirusie, oritugute are; mbuya asore osoe ase obogima kore egetong’o kobua koba namaiso abere na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.
english: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.

ekegusii: Na onye neriso riao rikogera okore ebibe, orirusie oritugute; mbuya gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae kore egetong’o, kobua koba namaiso abere, na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare,
english: And if your eye causes you to sin, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,

ekegusii: Na onye okogoro kwao gokogera okore ebibe, konache; mbuya gosoa ase obogima kore egesegora, kobua koba namagoro abere, na gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare [
english: And if your foot causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.

ekegusii: Onye nokoboko kwao gw’okorio gokogera okore ebibe, konache, ogotugute are, ekiagera mbuya asore ekiimo kiao ekemo gesire, kobua omobere oo omogima gotugutwa ase omorero o kare na kare.
english: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to go into hell.

ekegusii: And I'll say to myself, "You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink and be merry."'
english: Erio nintebie omoyo one: Aye omoyo, nore nenibo enyinge kwegacheire emonga y’emiaka emenge; timoka, orie, onywe, ogoke.

ekegusii: Erio kegima bagatiga obwato boria, bagatiga na ise, bakamotunyana.
english: and immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.

ekegusii: na ase obong’ainereria bwonsi bw’ogotaba boronge ase abwo bagosira, ekiagera bangete konyora ekeene, na kogiancha erinde banyare gotoorigwa.
english: and in every sort of evil that deceives those who are perishing. They perish because they refused to love the truth and so be saved.

ekegusii: Naki ekeene, nigo mwanchete abamino bonsi abare Makedonia yonsi. Korende twabasoroire, baminto, momente ayio mono kobua.
english: And in fact, you do love all the brothers throughout Macedonia. Yet we urge you, brothers, to do so more and more.

ekegusii: Asere inwe boigo mwaagachirwe amo, mobe obomenyo bwa Nyasae, ase Omoika.
english: And in him you too are being built together to become a dwelling in which God lives by his Spirit.

ekegusii: na ase ogochandeka kwane ngateba, “Mwanyabanto bonsi nabanyaborimo.”
english: And in my dismay I said, "All men are liars."

ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’ekina, ekiagera omonene bw’ense eye okoorire kogambigwa.
english: and in regard to judgment, because the prince of this world now stands condemned.

ekegusii: Ekero engaki eyio eraike, engoma nebugigwe, na abanto abwo basirerete ase ense y’Abaasuri, na baria baseretigwe gochia ase ense ya Misiri, mbache gosasima Omonene ase egetunwa egechenu agwo Yerusalemu.
english: And in that day a great trumpet will sound. Those who were perishing in Assyria and those who were exiled in Egypt will come and worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: And in that place many believed in Jesus.
english: Abange bakamwegena aroro.

ekegusii: Na Nyasae obekire ase ekanisa ritang’ani abatomwa, eria kabere ababani, eria gatato aborokia. Naende akabeka abakori emeremo y’ebikone bie chinguru, abanyorire ebiegwa bi’okogwenia amarwaire, abakonyi, abagambi, naende abagokwana emenwa ao ao.
english: And in the church God has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, also those having gifts of healing, those able to help others, those with gifts of administration, and those speaking in different kinds of tongues.

ekegusii: Naende ase amatuko ’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, Bisilamu, na Mitiredati, na Tabeeli, na abanto bande babwataine komo, bakarikera Aritasasita rirube ase chinuguta chi’Ekearamaiki na ase omonwa oyio.
english: And in the days of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel and the rest of his associates wrote a letter to Artaxerxes. The letter was written in Aramaic script and in the Aramaic language.

ekegusii: naende ekero mwarenge ase erooro. Mwaroche buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, abaraaete, na ase chinchera chionsi echio mwaetete goika mogaika aase aa: ere nigo ababogoretie buna omonto akobogoria omwana oye.
english: and in the desert. There you saw how the LORD your God carried you, as a father carries his son, all the way you went until you reached this place."

ekegusii: Korwa ase egati y’omorero oria bikarorekanao ebitongwa bine bire moyo. Oko nakwo kwarenge okororekana kwabo: Nigo biagwekaine mwanyabanto,
english: and in the fire was what looked like four living creatures. In appearance their form was that of a man,

ekegusii: “na inche nigo natenenete komokonya na komobeka chinguru ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kwa Dario Omomedi.
english: And in the first year of Darius the Mede, I took my stand to support and protect him.)

ekegusii: na mambia inamorore obonene bw’Omonene, ekiagera ere oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Ee, ere mwamwemurunganeirie, tari intwe. Intwe inki toisaine?”
english: and in the morning you will see the glory of the LORD, because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we, that you should grumble against us?"

ekegusii: Na mambia mwabora: Rero netwe ey’omwaga, ekiagera amare abariirire na gosung’unana. Inwe imomanyete obosio bw’erioba, korende timomanyeti ebimanyererio bi’ebiro.
english: and in the morning, 'Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.' You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.

ekegusii: na aase agwe ase risankwa riarenge obobimbu oborabu bororekane, gose egesambo gekororekana kere nobobariri na oborabu, omonto oria goika agende ase omokuani.
english: and in the place where the boil was, a white swelling or reddish-white spot appears, he must present himself to the priest.

ekegusii: Agakwana ase amasio ’abanto bamwabo na ase abarwani esegi b’Abasamaria, agateba, “Ngento ki eke Abayahudi aba aboro abagundo bagokora? Inee! Mbanyare kweagachera naende omochie oyio? Mbarue ebing’wanso aase aa naende? Mbanyare gokoora emeremo eyio ase rituko erimo? Gose mbanyare koremora korwa ase chitui chi’amagena aya asambetwe bayakore abe amayia?”
english: and in the presence of his associates and the army of Samaria, he said, "What are those feeble Jews doing? Will they restore their wall? Will they offer sacrifices? Will they finish in a day? Can they bring the stones back to life from those heaps of rubble-- burned as they are?"

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwaye agakora omoyega omonene ase abanene bonsi amo nabatang’ani abarenge ase obogambi bwaye. Akarangeria abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi b’Abaayemi, na ab’Abamedia, na abanene amo nabagambi be chingongo chiaye.
english: and in the third year of his reign he gave a banquet for all his nobles and officials. The military leaders of Persia and Media, the princes, and the nobles of the provinces were present.

ekegusii: Ase riranya ria Yorodan orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie Beti‐Haramu na Beti‐Nimura, na Sukoti, na Safoni, na ensemo eye yatigarete ey’oboruoti bwa Sihoni o Hesiboni. Crooche rwa Yorodan narwo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo gochia sugusu goika enyancha ya Kinereti.
english: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth and Zaphon with the rest of the realm of Sihon king of Heshbon (the east side of the Jordan, the territory up to the end of the Sea of Kinnereth).

ekegusii: Na barabwo abanyene, kobakobasabera inwe, bare namaiga amange asemore, ekiagera ase obuya boria bwa Nyasae obwo bwamentekire mono ime asemore.
english: And in their prayers for you their hearts will go out to you, because of the surpassing grace God has given you.

ekegusii: na kobwatania baria babere na Nyasae ase omobere oyomo, ase omosalaba, aase aiterete obobisa boria.
english: and in this one body to reconcile both of them to God through the cross, by which he put to death their hostility.

ekegusii: Bakaira na Ekerubo Ekiomo moocha ya Yorodan goikera ase Enyancha y’Omonyo inse y’ebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga.
english: and included all the Arabah east of the Jordan, as far as the Sea of the Arabah, below the slopes of Pisgah.

ekegusii: naende tonyore omwando otagosareka, otari na komocha, otari gosiria obonene bwaye. Omwando oyo ogachire igoro ase engencho yaino,
english: and into an inheritance that can never perish, spoil or fade-- kept in heaven for you,

ekegusii: Amo nayio Ira Omoyairi nigo arenge omokuani ase Daudi.
english: and Ira the Jairite was David's priest.

ekegusii: Erio anyororokerie amanyinga make ay’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’ebibe ase egesasimero ensemo. Amanyinga agotigara ayanyititorere agwo inse ase egesasimero. Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
english: and is to sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering against the side of the altar; the rest of the blood must be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

ekegusii: Nemogwenerete gwatorwa ng’a nare nogokora okuya, buna oyo okinirie abana, oroisirie abageni, osibirie abachenu amagoro, okonyire abachandegete, na bweruete omonyene ase kera ogokora okuya.
english: and is well known for her good deeds, such as bringing up children, showing hospitality, washing the feet of the saints, helping those in trouble and devoting herself to all kinds of good deeds.

ekegusii: Isaka nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ene ekero anyuomete Rebeka, omoiseke o Betueli, Omoaramu o Padan‐Aramu, omoiseke omwabo Labani, Omoaramu.
english: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan Aram and sister of Laban the Aramean.

ekegusii: Na Isaya nare noboremu bw’ogoteba, “Nigo nanyorekanete nabatare kondigia; nkeorokia ase abatare kong’itaa.”
english: And Isaiah boldly says, "I was found by those who did not seek me; I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me."

ekegusii: na Isi‐Benobu, oyomo bw’amamonto, nabwate ritimo riare noborito bwe chikiro isato na ekeng’ese, naende nabwate omoro omoyia; ere akarigia goita Daudi.
english: And Ishbi-Benob, one of the descendants of Rapha, whose bronze spearhead weighed three hundred shekels and who was armed with a new [sword], said he would kill David.

ekegusii: Isimaya korwa Gibeoni, omonto etuoni naende omoraai ase egati y’abanto baria Emerongo Etato; Yeremia na Yehasieli, Yohanani na Yosabadi korwa Gedera;
english: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the Thirty, who was a leader of the Thirty; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, Jozabad the Gederathite,

ekegusii: Na Israeli akarangeria Yusufu, akamotebia, “Inee! Abamino tibakari korisia amaicho aaria Sekemu? Inchuo ngotome gochia ase bakare.” Ere akamoitabera, “Nao inde aa.”
english: and Israel said to Joseph, "As you know, your brothers are grazing the flocks near Shechem. Come, I am going to send you to them." "Very well," he replied.

ekegusii: Israeli akabora, “Ayio aisanire. Yusufu, omwana one, moyo are. Nigo ndagende komorora ritang’ani ntarakwa.”
english: And Israel said, "I'm convinced! My son Joseph is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."

english: and it sprouted and became a low, spreading vine. Its branches turned toward him, but its roots remained under it. So it became a vine and produced branches and put out leafy boughs.

english: And it will be like a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead that the LORD brought us out of Egypt with his mighty hand."

english: And it will be said: "Build up, build up, prepare the road! Remove the obstacles out of the way of my people."

english: And it will be: Like people, like priests. I will punish both of them for their ways and repay them for their deeds.

english: Yakobo akarora ng’a Labani oonchokire, tari komorigereria buya buna botambe.

english: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The years of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty. My years have been few and difficult, and they do not equal the years of the pilgrimage of my fathers."

english: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

english: and Jesus healed many who had various diseases. He also drove out many demons, but he would not let the demons speak because they knew who he was.

english: and Jesus was in the temple area walking in Solomon's Colonnade.

english: and Joelah and Zebadiah the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.

english: And Jonathan had David reaffirm his oath out of love for him, because he loved him as he loved himself.

english: And Jonathan made a covenant with David because he loved him as himself.

english: And Joseph made the sons of Israel swear an oath and said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up from this place."

ekegusii: Farao akang’anyia abanto abwo bamenye ase emechie, babe abasomba baye, bakore emeremo korwa ensemo eyemo ya Misiri goika eyende.
english: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude, from one end of Egypt to the other.

english: And Joseph took both of them, Ephraim on his right toward Israel's left hand and Manasseh on his left toward Israel's right hand, and brought them close to him.

ekegusii: Amauga a Yusufu, aya Abaisraeli barentete korwa Misiri, agatindekwa agwo Sekemu, ase oboremo bw’ense eria Yakobo agorete korwa ase basinto ba Hamori, ise Sekemu, ase rigori rie chifeta rigana erimo. Oboremo obo bokaba omwando bw’ororeria rwa Yusufu.
english: And Joseph's bones, which the Israelites had brought up from Egypt, were buried at Shechem in the tract of land that Jacob bought for a hundred pieces of silver from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem. This became the inheritance of Joseph's descendants.

ekegusii: Yoshua akarika amang’ana aria ase Ebuku y’amachiko a Nyasae. Erio agatenenia rigena rinene agwo inse y’omote onga buna omotontera, oteneine ang’e n’Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene.
english: And Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God. Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak near the holy place of the LORD.

ekegusii: Na Yoshua agasaba, akabora, “Ayee! Omonene Nyasae, nase ki kwambogetie abanto aba ase Yorodan? Inee! Nase ogotobeka ase amaboko ’Abakanani, batoite? Nanga mbuya, nonya tware kobeera ng’umbu ya Yorodan nanga nao tomenyete.
english: And Joshua said, "Ah, Sovereign LORD, why did you ever bring this people across the Jordan to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us? If only we had been content to stay on the other side of the Jordan!

english: Agwo Giligali Yoshua akabeka amo amagena aria ikomi na abere arusetigwe Yorodan.

english: And just as you saw the iron mixed with baked clay, so the people will be a mixture and will not remain united, any more than iron mixes with clay.

english: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.

english: and King Solomon and the entire assembly of Israel that had gathered about him were before the ark, sacrificing so many sheep and cattle that they could not be recorded or counted.

english: And King Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand head of cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the people dedicated the temple of God.

english: And may I have a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king's forest, so he will give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple and for the city wall and for the residence I will occupy?" And because the gracious hand of my God was upon me, the king granted my requests.

english: And my honesty will testify for me in the future, whenever you check on the wages you have paid me. Any goat in my possession that is not speckled or spotted, or any lamb that is not dark-colored, will be considered stolen."

english: And my master made me swear an oath, and said, 'You must not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

english: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior,

ekegusii: na Nebukadinesaro omonyene agacha ase omochie oyio ekero abasomba baye bayonaaririe.
english: and Nebuchadnezzar himself came up to the city while his officers were besieging it.

ekegusii: and Nebuchadnezzar said to them, "Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, that you do not serve my gods or worship the image of gold I have set up?
english: Nebukadinesaro akababoria, “Inwe Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, Inee, nekeene ng’a inwe timori gokorera chinyasae chiane, gose timori gosasima omogwekano oria bw’etahabu ntenenetie?

ekegusii: Gose omonto tari onyure edivai yaroisetigwe kare, naende arigie edivai enyia, ekiagera nigo agoteba: Eria ya kare nengiya kobua.”
english: And no one after drinking old wine wants the new, for he says, 'The old is better.'"

ekegusii: Naki monto onde taba okomoboria ring’ana nyuma ase aya.
english: And no one dared to ask him any more questions.

ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria enyia nayaate ebirandi biria; edivai enyene eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke.
english: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined.

ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose edivai eria nebiate ebirandi, edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bitandoke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia.”
english: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, he pours new wine into new wineskins."

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Omonene Nyasae atongete igoro na ense, kemeri kende tikiarenge komera korwa ase riroba, gose nyeni chinde, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae konya taratoma embura etwe ase ense, nonya monto onde tarengeo ore korema riroba.
english: and no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth and no plant of the field had yet sprung up, for the LORD God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no man to work the ground,

ekegusii: Nabo tari ogokumia, ekiagera Saitani omonyene nigo akweonchora bwekora buna omomalaika bw’omobaso.
english: And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.

ekegusii: Nuhu agasoa ase obwato ime amo nabana baye abamura, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye, ase ogwetooria korwa ase etoigo eria.
english: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons' wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.

ekegusii: Na Nuhu agakora ayio onsi buna Omonene amochigete.
english: And Noah did all that the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Na Noba nere akagenda akaumokera na koira Kenati amo nebichie biaetanaineo, nere akaroka Kenati Noba, erieta riaye omonyene.
english: And Nobah captured Kenath and its surrounding settlements and called it Nobah after himself.

ekegusii: Ase ense yaino mokungu onde tari oborito bwaye boragwe, gose onde takoba omogomba; nimbae obogima obotambe.
english: and none will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will give you a full life span.

ekegusii: Goika akore igo, erinde tabaisa koenena ase ogochaya abanto bande bamwabo, gose tabaisa koonchoka korwa ase amachiko na kogenda ase ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Karaigwere, ere amo nabana baye mbabe bakogambera Abaisraeli ase engaki entambe.
english: and not consider himself better than his brothers and turn from the law to the right or to the left. Then he and his descendants will reign a long time over his kingdom in Israel.

ekegusii: gose tari ase ogocha kwaye gwoka, korende nonya nase okoremigwa koria aremetigwe nainwe. Agatotebia amang’ana ’amaiga aino, na okweng’ereria kwaino, na omokia oino asende, goika nkamenta kogoka.
english: and not only by his coming but also by the comfort you had given him. He told us about your longing for me, your deep sorrow, your ardent concern for me, so that my joy was greater than ever.

ekegusii: gose tari ase engencho y’egesaku keria gioka, korende amo naya asangererie abana ba Nyasae baria baatananekire, babe abamo.
english: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.

ekegusii: tibaba abaganga, korende baorokie obwegenwa obuya ase onsi, erinde ase amang’ana onsi ogokora kwabo kobe ekiorokererio ekiya gi’okworokereria kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito.
english: and not to steal from them, but to show that they can be fully trusted, so that in every way they will make the teaching about God our Savior attractive.

ekegusii: Bono rora, narentire ogotongora gwe chindagera chiamire ase riroba ri’ense eye Omonene atoeire. “Erio obeke egetonga keria inse ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo, na osasime agwo ase obosio bwaye.
english: and now I bring the firstfruits of the soil that you, O LORD, have given me." Place the basket before the LORD your God and bow down before him.

ekegusii: Na bono ninteneine aiga ngambigwe ase engencho y’ogosemeria kw’eira eria chisokoro chiaito chiaetwe na Nyasae,
english: And now it is because of my hope in what God has promised our fathers that I am on trial today.

ekegusii: Ekerero ki’Abaisraeli giaikire asende, naende narorire buna Abamisiri babachandire.
english: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached me, and I have seen the way the Egyptians are oppressing them.

ekegusii: Omonene orentire amang’ana ayio amabe, ere okorire buna akwanete. Ekiagera mwakorete ebibe ase Omonene, gose timwamoigwerete, amang’ana aya amabe abanyorire.
english: And now the LORD has brought it about; he has done just as he said he would. All this happened because you people sinned against the LORD and did not obey him.

ekegusii: Natebigwe ring’ana n’Omonene, oria ontongete ase enda ya baba ng’a nimbe omosomba oye, erinde ng’iranie ororeria rwa Yakobo gochia asare, na nsangererie Abaisraeli gochia asare. Inche nanyorire amasikani ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae one obeire chinguru chiane.
english: And now the LORD says-- he who formed me in the womb to be his servant to bring Jacob back to him and gather Israel to himself, for I am honored in the eyes of the LORD and my God has been my strength--

ekegusii: Gaki bono biatigaire okwegena, na ogosemeria, na obwanchani, aya atato; erire rinene ase aya nobwanchani.
english: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.

ekegusii: Gaki bono, inki ogotebanera? Tenena obatiswe, bwesibie ebibe biao, orangerie erieta riaye.
english: And now what are you waiting for? Get up, be baptized and wash your sins away, calling on his name.'

ekegusii: Na bono nigo moganetie gokora Abayuda, na abanto ba Yerusalemu, abasacha na abakungu, babe abasomba baino. Inee! Inwe timori nebibe biaino abanyene mwakorire ase Omonene, Nyasae oino?
english: And now you intend to make the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem your slaves. But aren't you also guilty of sins against the LORD your God?

ekegusii: Na bono, erimotangete morimanyete, erio ekero engaki yaye eraike anyare koorokigwa.
english: And now you know what is holding him back, so that he may be revealed at the proper time.

ekegusii: Na bono aye nigo ogoteba ng’a ngende ntebie omonene one ng’a aye Elija nao ore aiga. Ere nigo arang’ite.”
english: And now you tell me to go to my master and say, 'Elijah is here.' He will kill me!"

ekegusii: Rora, aye nobe rimama, tonyara gokwana goika rituko riria ayio agocha kooroka, ekiagera otegena amang’ana aane; ayio naikeranigwe ekero kiaye.”
english: And now you will be silent and not able to speak until the day this happens, because you did not believe my words, which will come true at their proper time."

ekegusii: Bono, ekeene buna Omonene are moyo, oria ombekire ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi tata, na gonkong’ia, naende ong’eire oroiboro buna ariete eira, Adonia goika aitwe ase rituko ria rero.”
english: And now, as surely as the LORD lives-- he who has established me securely on the throne of my father David and has founded a dynasty for me as he promised-- Adonijah shall be put to death today!"

ekegusii: Bono nkobamanyia tore inwe abaminto amang’ana ’obuya bwa Nyasae, obo chikanisa chia Makedonia chiaetwe.
english: And now, brothers, we want you to know about the grace that God has given the Macedonian churches.

ekegusii: Na bono inwe abana baane, menya ime asare, erinde ekero akoorokigwa tobe noboremu, titoba nobosooku ase obosio bwaye ekero arachiche.
english: And now, dear children, continue in him, so that when he appears we may be confident and unashamed before him at his coming.

ekegusii: Na bono, omokungu, nakoboririe ng’a twanchane intwe ase intwe. Tari ng’a nogochika okoyia ngokorikera, korende nkoria twarenge nakorokwo korwa ritang’ani.
english: And now, dear lady, I am not writing you a new command but one we have had from the beginning. I ask that we love one another.

ekegusii: Korende timoichana, gose timwechanda ase emioyo yaino, ekiagera mwang’oonetie gocha aa. Naki Nyasae nere ontomete mbatang’anere gocha aa, erinde ntoorie obogima bw’abanto.
english: And now, do not be distressed and do not be angry with yourselves for selling me here, because it was to save lives that God sent me ahead of you.

ekegusii: Na bono Tata, ombake inche amo naye, ase obonene boria narenge nabwo amo naye ritang’ani ense etaratongwa.
english: And now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, mwana one, toiroka, ekiagera abanto bonsi ase omochie oyo nigo bamanyete ng’a aye nomokungu omweriti. Ningokorere ande onsi oraganie.
english: And now, my daughter, don't be afraid. I will do for you all you ask. All my fellow townsmen know that you are a woman of noble character.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, tiga ring’ana riao riria gwatebetie omosomba oo Daudi tata riikeranigwe.
english: And now, O God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David my father come true.

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, ngento ki Omonene, Nyasae oino, aganetie korwa asemore? Goika moiroke Omonene, Nyasae oino, momoigwere na kobwatia chinchera chiaye chionsi; momwanche na komokorera Omonene, Nyasae oino, ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi.
english: And now, O Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to love him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, tiga ring’ana riao riria gwatebetie omosomba oo Daudi ribe eri’ekeene.
english: And now, O LORD, God of Israel, let your word that you promised your servant David come true.

ekegusii: Obwate onsi aya Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochikire, otaare ase chinchera chiaye, na orende amachiko aye, na emeroberio yaye yonsi, orende noborori bwaye, buna arikire ase amachiko a Musa, erio nario orasesenigwe ase kende gionsi ogokora, na aande onsi ase okogenda.
english: and observe what the LORD your God requires: Walk in his ways, and keep his decrees and commands, his laws and requirements, as written in the Law of Moses, so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you go,

ekegusii: Naki ase enchili eye nkaragwa koba omoraria, na omotomwa, na omworokia.
english: And of this gospel I was appointed a herald and an apostle and a teacher.

ekegusii: akerue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera ase egesasimero. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria abe oyochenegete.
english: and offer it on the altar, together with the grain offering, and make atonement for him, and he will be clean.

ekegusii: Agaita na Ogi, omoruoti o Basani, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: and Og king of Bashan-- His love endures forever.

ekegusii: na Oholibama akaibora Yeusi, na Yalamu, na Kora. Aba nabwo abana abamura Esau aiboreretwe ase ense ya Kanani.
english: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in Canaan.

ekegusii: Ekero arenge koirana na oikaransete ase egari yaye, nigo arenge gosoma ebuku y’omobani Isaya.
english: and on his way home was sitting in his chariot reading the book of Isaiah the prophet.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria bakarua ebing’wanso ebinene, na bagachenga nomogoko omonene mono, ekiagera Nyasae abagogetie. Abakungu amo nabana boigo bagachenga, na omochengo oria orenge Yerusalemu okaigweka gochia aare.
english: And on that day they offered great sacrifices, rejoicing because God had given them great joy. The women and children also rejoiced. The sound of rejoicing in Jerusalem could be heard far away.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Omonene akang’anyia emeganda yonsi y’Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
english: And on that very day the LORD brought the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions.

ekegusii: Ase omorangwa bw’Aase Aachenu emegwekano y’abakerubi na ey’emekendo nigo yachabeire aroro yagwekaine eria yarenge ase chinyasi. Ekerama gie chibao nigo kiarenge bosio bw’egesona isiko.
english: And on the doors of the outer sanctuary were carved cherubim and palm trees like those carved on the walls, and there was a wooden overhang on the front of the portico.

ekegusii: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero keria ribe nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha.
english: And on the lampstand there are to be four cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms.

english: Ritina rinyene ri’ekebekerero keria rikaba nemegwekano ene y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi.

ekegusii: Na ase rituko ria kianda ri’omotienyi o kane bw’omwaka o ikomi nomo, bakabochora chindwaki chi’omochie oria.
english: And on the ninth day of the fourth month of Zedekiah's eleventh year, the city wall was broken through.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano na kabere, ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, obwato bogeterekerera ase egetunwa egetambe ki’Ararati.
english: and on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

ekegusii: Ebisieri ebio bionsi bibere bi’emezeituni bigachaberwa nemegwekano y’abakerubi, na ey’emekendo, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Akaooma bionsi netahabu; boigo agasiarera abakerubi amo ne chibao chi’emekendo netahabu.
english: And on the two olive wood doors he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid the cherubim and palm trees with beaten gold.

ekegusii: na omosabibu oyio nigo orenge ne chinsagia isato; bwango ogasomoria, ogasokia ebisicha, na okaama ebisago bi’amasabibu amatobu.
english: and on the vine were three branches. As soon as it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters ripened into grapes.

ekegusii: Oyomo obo agaaka omosomba bw’omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto gw’okorio.
english: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.

ekegusii: Amo nayio, ondoiserie aase ngocha komenya, naki nsemeretie ng’a goetera ase ogosaba kwaino nimbe nainwe.
english: And one thing more: Prepare a guest room for me, because I hope to be restored to you in answer to your prayers.

english: and onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

english: and ordered that the men of Judah be taught this lament of the bow (it is written in the Book of Jashar):

english: And our elders and all those living in our country said to us, 'Take provisions for your journey; go and meet them and say to them, "We are your servants; make a treaty with us."'

ekegusii: Na ogosemeria gwaito ase engencho yaino nigo goteneine bokong’u, ekiagera twamanyire ng’a buna more ababwatani b’emechando eria, naboigo morabe ababwatani ase okoremigwa koria.
english: And our hope for you is firm, because we know that just as you share in our sufferings, so also you share in our comfort.

ekegusii: Ne chingige chigasoka korwa ase erioki riria, chikagenda ase ense, chikaegwa okobua buna ebiuge bi’ense bire nakwo.
english: And out of the smoke locusts came down upon the earth and were given power like that of scorpions of the earth.

ekegusii: Kobua aya onsi, mweboyie obwanchani, nabwo egesibo gekobwatania kera egento ase oboikeranu bw’obuya.
english: And over all these virtues put on love, which binds them all together in perfect unity.

english: and Palal son of Uzai worked opposite the angle and the tower projecting from the upper palace near the court of the guard. Next to him, Pedaiah son of Parosh

ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, omokuani, agatebia Abareuben na Abagadi amo n’Abamanase, “Bono twamanyire ng’a Omonene nigo are ase egati yaito, ekiagera timwangete koba abegenwa ase Omonene. Igo mwatooririe Abaisraeli korwa ase egesusuro ki’Omonene.”
english: And Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, said to Reuben, Gad and Manasseh, "Today we know that the LORD is with us, because you have not acted unfaithfully toward the LORD in this matter. Now you have rescued the Israelites from the LORD's hand."

ekegusii: akayobeka ase oboina bwaye oboyia, obwabachete ase egetare; naende agaturunkania rigena rinene gochia ase egesieri ki’oboina, akagenda.
english: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.

ekegusii: akamosorora mono, akabora, “Omonene, omoiseke one omoke oisire gokwa. Nagosabire, oche obeke okoboko kwao igoro yaye, anyare kogwena, abe moyo.”
english: and pleaded earnestly with him, "My little daughter is dying. Please come and put your hands on her so that she will be healed and live."

ekegusii: erio obotaka mbogochere buna omouri agocha, na oboremerwa boche buna omonto obwate ebirwanero agocha.
english: and poverty will come on you like a bandit and scarcity like an armed man.

english: goika obotaka bogochere buna omouri, na okoremerwa kogochere buna omorwani esegi.
