english: And pray for us, too, that God may open a door for our message, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.

ekegusii: Mosabe botambe ase Omoika ase ogosaba gwonsi na ase okoboria kw’ogosorora, na gotagesia ase kera ring’ana. Mogenderere gosabera abachenu bonsi.
english: And pray in the Spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and requests. With this in mind, be alert and always keep on praying for all the saints.

ekegusii: ng’a totoorigwe korwa ase abanto batari abaronge, na abare ababe, ekiagera tai bonsi bare nokwegena.
english: And pray that we may be delivered from wicked and evil men, for not everyone has faith.

ekegusii: ngasaba, “Aye Nyasae one, nabeire nobosooku, na obosio bwane bwabeire nomoichano; tinkonyara gokorigereria aye Nyasae one. Ebibe biaito biabuchire gotoetania goika igoro, na okomocha gwaito gwaikire agwo igoro.
english: and prayed: "O my God, I am too ashamed and disgraced to lift up my face to you, my God, because our sins are higher than our heads and our guilt has reached to the heavens.

ekegusii: Ontomire ase abwo baichanete bare Sayoni, mbabekere chigutwa chi’ebisicha ase emetwe yabo ribaga rie ribu, na mbaake amaguta ay’omogoko ribaga ri’omoichano, naende mbabekere chingobo chi’amasikani ribaga ri’emeika yairianyekire. Erio barokwe “Emete y’oboronge”, mbabe ebimeri Omonene asimegete, erinde atogigwe.
english: and provide for those who grieve in Zion-- to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of gladness instead of mourning, and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They will be called oaks of righteousness, a planting of the LORD for the display of his splendor.

ekegusii: Onye kore nenchara, obeke omoyio ase ring’orong’oche riao.
english: and put a knife to your throat if you are given to gluttony.

ekegusii: Aonchorerie chianga chiria abegete ekero oosetwe, na agenderere kobeera agwo enka y’omonto oyio, abe okoreera ise na ng’ina ase engaki y’omotienyi omogima. Nyuma yaye omonto oria amotware abe mokaye.
english: and put aside the clothes she was wearing when captured. After she has lived in your house and mourned her father and mother for a full month, then you may go to her and be her husband and she shall be your wife.

ekegusii: Kwabekire ebinto bionsi inse y’amagoro aye.” Naki ase okobeka ebinto bionsi inse yaye tatigete gento kende atabegete inse yaye. Korende goika bono titorarora ebinto bionsi bibekire inse yaye.
english: and put everything under his feet." In putting everything under him, God left nothing that is not subject to him. Yet at present we do not see everything subject to him.

ekegusii: Obaboerie chinkini ebinema biabo, Haroni na abamura baye, na obabekere ebigogwa emetwe yabo. Ase enchera eyio bwatanane Haroni amo nabamura baye babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani kogenderera botambe.
english: and put headbands on them. Then tie sashes on Aaron and his sons. The priesthood is theirs by a lasting ordinance. In this way you shall ordain Aaron and his sons.

ekegusii: bagachibeka ase amagoro ’abatomwa; na kera omonto akagaberwa koreng’ana buna aremeire.
english: and put it at the apostles' feet, and it was distributed to anyone as he had need.

ekegusii: Akababeka barendwe ase enyomba yomotang’ani bw’abarendi, ase echela eyio Yusufu nere asibetwe.
english: and put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the same prison where Joseph was confined.

ekegusii: Agwo eriomana rigatuboka egati y’abarisia b’Aburamu, na abarisia ba Loti. Ase engaki eyio Abakanani na Abaperisi mbarabwo bamenyete ase ense eria.
english: And quarreling arose between Abram's herdsmen and the herdsmen of Lot. The Canaanites and Perizzites were also living in the land at that time.

ekegusii: and Racal; to those in the towns of the Jerahmeelites and the Kenites;
english: na Rakali; abwo b’emechie y’Abayerameli, na Abakeni,

ekegusii: na embura egatwa igoro ase ense ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.
english: And rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

ekegusii: na rinde rionsi togosaba nigo tokorinyora korwa asare, ekiagera ntobwatete amachiko aye, naende igo tokoyakora ayakomogwenera.
english: and receive from him anything we ask, because we obey his commands and do what pleases him.

ekegusii: Rehoboamu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa aase chiatindegetwe, ase omochie o Daudi. Ng’ina Rehoboamu nigo arenge korokwa Naama, omosubati bw’Abaamoni. Abiyamu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: And Rehoboam rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David. His mother's name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Agwo aase Omonene arachore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye, nao moragende na mogoke ase obosio bwaye, inwe na abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, na abasomba baino, abamura na abaiseke, na Abalawi bamenyete ase emechie yaino, na abamenyi, ne chintakana, na ababoraka bare ase egati yaino.
english: And rejoice before the LORD your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name-- you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, the Levites in your towns, and the aliens, the fatherless and the widows living among you.

ekegusii: na ebisaku bionsi mbiranderigwe ase erieta riaye okoonchoka na okorusigwa kw’ebibe, gochakera Yerusalemu.
english: and repentance and forgiveness of sins will be preached in his name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

ekegusii: akamorusia ase emechando yaye yonsi, akamoa ogwancherwa na obong’aini ase obosio bwa Farao, omoruoti o Misiri; ere akamobeka akaba gavuna igoro ya Misiri na enyomba yaye yonsi.
english: and rescued him from all his troubles. He gave Joseph wisdom and enabled him to gain the goodwill of Pharaoh king of Egypt; so he made him ruler over Egypt and all his palace.

ekegusii: na Reseni, omochie omonene oyorenge egati ya Nineva na Kala.
english: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and Calah; that is the great city.

ekegusii: akabwatia omonto oria o Nyasae, akamonyora oikaransete inse y’omote onga buna omotontera, akamoboria, “Naye omonto oria o Nyasae ochicha korwa ense ya Yuda?” Omoto oria akairaneria, “Ee, ninche.”
english: and rode after the man of God. He found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, "Are you the man of God who came from Judah?" "I am," he replied.

ekegusii: bakabwatana, bakaanga koigwera Musa. Amo nabwo mbarenge abanto bande b’Abaisraeli, amagana abere, na emerongo etano. Abwo barenge abaraai bachorire korwa ase omosangererekano, bamanyekanete, naende basikire.
english: and rose up against Moses. With them were 250 Israelite men, well-known community leaders who had been appointed members of the council.

ekegusii: Rutu, oria Omomoabu, agatebia Naomi, “Ntige ngende gochora ebigara ebitigari ase omogondo bw’omonto orang’e ribaga nkore bo.” Naomi akamoiraneria, “Genda, mwana one!”
english: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, "Let me go to the fields and pick up the leftover grain behind anyone in whose eyes I find favor." Naomi said to her, "Go ahead, my daughter."

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Ngoika ririri oragenderere gotinda? Tiga ogotinda kwao, otindoke!”
english: and said to her, "How long will you keep on getting drunk? Get rid of your wine."

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Yaya, titokogotiga! Nigo torigetie kogenda amo naye ase abanto baino.”
english: and said to her, "We will go back with you to your people."

ekegusii: bakamoboria, “Inee! Nomanyete ng’a Baalisi, omoruoti bw’Abaamoni, otomire Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, agoite?” Korende Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu, tegenete amang’ana ayio.
english: and said to him, "Don't you know that Baalis king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to take your life?" But Gedaliah son of Ahikam did not believe them.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Soa oete ase omochie o Yerusalemu bwonsi, obeke ekemanyererio ase obosio bwa kera omonto oichanete na korera ase engencho y’ebibe bi’okogechia bigokorwa ase omochie oyio.”
english: and said to him, "Go throughout the city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the foreheads of those who grieve and lament over all the detestable things that are done in it."

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Omonene one, tombarera obobe, gose toinyora aria nagokorerete ase rituko riria kwaruete Yerusalemu.
english: and said to him, "May my lord not hold me guilty. Do not remember how your servant did wrong on the day my lord the king left Jerusalem. May the king put it out of his mind.

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Omonene, intwe abasomba bao, twabarire abarwani b’esegi abarenge inse y’oborendi bwaito, na twanyorire ng’a mbonsi bare, onde tasireti korwa asetore.
english: and said to him, "Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one is missing.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Minyoka, otebie omomura oria obwate engori y’okorengera ng’a Yerusalemu nomenywe buna emechie etagiteiri chindwaki, ekiagera nobe nabanto abange ne chitugo chinyinge.
english: and said to him: "Run, tell that young man, 'Jerusalem will be a city without walls because of the great number of men and livestock in it.

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Omworokia, omokungu oyo nigo abwatwa kagokora obotomani.
english: and said to Jesus, "Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.

ekegusii: agantebia: Inche ninkomente, na oroiboro rwao robuche goika robe emeganda y’ebisaku. Ning’ee ororeria rwao rorache korwa nyuma yao ense eye ebe omwando obo kare na kare.
english: and said to me, 'I am going to make you fruitful and will increase your numbers. I will make you a community of peoples, and I will give this land as an everlasting possession to your descendants after you.'

ekegusii: Barabwo bagatebia Musa, “Kwana naintwe aye, na intwe inatotegerere, korende onye Nyasae ogokwana naintwe, nigo torakwe.”
english: and said to Moses, "Speak to us yourself and we will listen. But do not have God speak to us or we will die."

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Abanto barentire ebiegwa ebinge goetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eria Omonene achigete ekorwe.”
english: and said to Moses, "The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD commanded to be done."

ekegusii: bakabatebia, “Intwe nigo twabeire abatachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo. Inee! Ninki kiagera twatangirwe titorua okoruegwa ase Omonene ase engaki Abaisraeli bachikire komoruera okoruegwa kwabo?”
english: and said to Moses, "We have become unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be kept from presenting the LORD's offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?"

ekegusii: bagatebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, “Ense eria twataarete ase okoyeroota nigo ere ense engiya mono.
english: and said to the entire Israelite assembly, "The land we passed through and explored is exceedingly good.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Eta mogende bosio bw’Esanduku y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, goika gati‐gati ya Yorodan. Kera oyomo oino aimokie rigena erimo, aribeke ireko riaye, erimo ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli.
english: and said to them, "Go over before the ark of the LORD your God into the middle of the Jordan. Each of you is to take up a stone on his shoulder, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites,

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Namanyire ng’a Omonene obaeire ense eye. Amaene twoboire bori. Abanto bonsi b’ense eye baondokire ase engencho yaino.
english: and said to them, "I know that the LORD has given this land to you and that a great fear of you has fallen on us, so that all who live in this country are melting in fear because of you.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, otebire iga: Inche nigo nabang’anyetie korwa Misiri, nkabatooria korwa ase amaboko ’abanto b’amaruoti ande onsi, abwo barenge kobachanda.
english: and said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'I brought Israel up out of Egypt, and I delivered you from the power of Egypt and all the kingdoms that oppressed you.'

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Mwandeterete omonto oyo, buna oyobaonchoire abanto; naunirie amang’ana aye ase amasio aino, na tindochi bobe ase omonto oyo ase aria mwamosoerete,
english: and said to them, "You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined him in your presence and have found no basis for your charges against him.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Mwakorire amang’ana onsi Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abachigete mokore, na mwaigwereire amang’ana onsi aya nabachigete.
english: and said to them, "You have done all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded, and you have obeyed me in everything I commanded.

ekegusii: “Baminto, negwenerete ririko riikeranigwe, eri Omoika Omochenu okwanete kare ase omonwa o Daudi igoro ya Yudas, oyotang’anete abwo babwatete Yeso.
english: and said, "Brothers, the Scripture had to be fulfilled which the Holy Spirit spoke long ago through the mouth of David concerning Judas, who served as guide for those who arrested Jesus--

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Kera omonto ritang’ani nigo agochaka nedivai ere engiya, goika abanto kobanyure mono, erio orenta eyetari engiya; aye gese nigo ogachete edivai engiya goika bono.”
english: and said, "Everyone brings out the choice wine first and then the cheaper wine after the guests have had too much to drink; but you have saved the best till now."

ekegusii: “Imoka, oire omwana na ng’ina, mogende ase ense ya Israeli, ekiagera baria barenge korigia obogima bw’omwana bakure.”
english: and said, "Get up, take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel, for those who were trying to take the child's life are dead."

ekegusii: agateba, “Ing’a nainche okobua oko, ng’a kera omonto ndabekere amaboko aane anyore Omoika Omochenu.”
english: and said, "Give me also this ability so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit."

ekegusii: “Omonene otebire: Netianirie inche omonyene, ekiagera gwakorire ring’ana eri, gose tondineti omwana oo omomoima.
english: and said, "I swear by myself, declares the LORD, that because you have done this and have not withheld your son, your only son,

ekegusii: Erio ngateba: “Inche tinkobarisia inwe rinde. Oyo ogokwa, tiga akwe, na oyo ogosirigwa, tiga asirigwe, na abatigari babe bakorianana.”
english: and said, "I will not be your shepherd. Let the dying die, and the perishing perish. Let those who are left eat one another's flesh."

ekegusii: bakabora, “Onye aye naye Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi, etoorie.”
english: and said, "If you are the king of the Jews, save yourself."

ekegusii: okobora, “Onye nkwamanya rero ayare korenta omorembe! Korende bono abisekire ase amaiso ao!
english: and said, "If you, even you, had only known on this day what would bring you peace-- but now it is hidden from your eyes.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Baminto, nabasoroire, timokora bobe buna iga.
english: and said, "No, my friends. Don't do this wicked thing.

ekegusii: and said, "Prophesy to us, Christ. Who hit you?"
english: bakobora, “Kristo, tobanere! Ning’o ogoaka?”

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Aye ngwasoa ase abanto batarogeti, okaragera amo nabarabwo!”
english: and said, "You went into the house of uncircumcised men and ate with them."

ekegusii: Agantebia: Kornelio, ogosaba kwao kwaigurwe, na ebiegwa biao biainyoirwe ase Nyasae.
english: and said, 'Cornelius, God has heard your prayer and remembered your gifts to the poor.

ekegusii: natenenete ang’e nainche agantebia: Paulo toiroka, nogwenerete gotenena ase obosio bwa Kaisari. Naende rora, Nyasae okoeire abanto bonsi, abakogenda amo naye.
english: and said, 'Do not be afraid, Paul. You must stand trial before Caesar; and God has graciously given you the lives of all who sail with you.'

ekegusii: agateba: Ase engencho eyio omonto natige ise na ng’ina, abwatane na mokaye, na abwo babere nigo barabe omobere oyomo?
english: and said, 'For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh'?

ekegusii: agateba: Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyo oeire oyomo ase oroiboro rwane ribaga goikaransa ase ekerogo kiane ki’oboruoti rituko ria rero, nainche neroreire ayio namaiso aane.”
english: and said, 'Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who has allowed my eyes to see a successor on my throne today.'"

ekegusii: nkayotebia, “Intwe ase okonyara gwaito twabooririe Abayahudi baminto tokabairania korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku ebio ase baoonetigwe gochia, korende inwe nigo mokoonia abanto bamino, erinde intwe tobaboorie korwa asemore tobairanie.” Abanene baria tibabwate nonya nering’ana erimo baare kobairaneria, korende nigo bakirete-kiri.
english: and said: "As far as possible, we have bought back our Jewish brothers who were sold to the Gentiles. Now you are selling your brothers, only for them to be sold back to us!" They kept quiet, because they could find nothing to say.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Inwe Abalawi, inyigwere! Bono inwe echene, naende mochene enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, morusie korwa ase Obomenyo obo Obochenu kera egento kebokorete bokaba obotachenegeti.
english: and said: "Listen to me, Levites! Consecrate yourselves now and consecrate the temple of the LORD, the God of your fathers. Remove all defilement from the sanctuary.

ekegusii: agateba, “Nigo narwete ase enda ya baba inde getirianda, naende nigo ndairane korwa ase ense inde getirianda. Omonene nere oruete, naende oirire. Erieta riaye ritogigwe.”
english: and said: "Naked I came from my mother's womb, and naked I will depart. The LORD gave and the LORD has taken away; may the name of the LORD be praised."

ekegusii: agakwana, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, Nyasae ande tari akogwekaine, igoro nonya ninse aa ase ense, aye bweka nigo okorenda okobwatana kw’ogotianania, naende nigo okoorokia obwanchani botari koera ase abasomba bao baria bare abegenwa asore ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi.
english: and said: "O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven above or on earth below-- you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

ekegusii: agasaba,” “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, Inee, aye tori Nyasae ore igoro? Tari aye okogamba igoro y’amaruoti onsi ay’ebisaku? Ase okoboko kwao okobua ne chinguru mbireo, goika onde tari oranyare gokobua.
english: and said: "O LORD, God of our fathers, are you not the God who is in heaven? You rule over all the kingdoms of the nations. Power and might are in your hand, and no one can withstand you.

ekegusii: “Erieta ria Nyasae ritogigwe goika kare na kare! Obong’aini na okobua nebiaye.
english: and said: "Praise be to the name of God for ever and ever; wisdom and power are his.

ekegusii: And Samson's wife was given to the friend who had attended him at his wedding.
english: Erio moga Samison akaegwa omonto oria orenge omong’wansi o Samison, akaba mokaye.

ekegusii: Erio Samweli agatebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Onye mogochia koonchoka na koirana ase Omonene ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, morusie korwa asemore chinyasae chingeni chionsi, amo n’Asitaroti, mokorere Omonene bweka; erio nario arabatoorie korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.”
english: And Samuel said to the whole house of Israel, "If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then rid yourselves of the foreign gods and the Ashtoreths and commit yourselves to the LORD and serve him only, and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines."

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenda korwania Abafilisti. Barabwo bagatoora agwo Ebeni‐Eseri, na Abafilisti agwo Afeki.
english: And Samuel's word came to all Israel. Now the Israelites went out to fight against the Philistines. The Israelites camped at Ebenezer, and the Philistines at Aphek.

ekegusii: Na barabwo nigo baare gotera ogotera kwa Musa, omosomba o Nyasae, na ogotera kw’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, bagoteba, “Ogokora kwao nokonene na okw’ogokumia, aye Omonene Nyasae Omobui! Chinchera chiao nechi’oboronge na echi’ekeene, aye omoruoti bw’abanto b’ebisaku.
english: and sang the song of Moses the servant of God and the song of the Lamb: "Great and marvelous are your deeds, Lord God Almighty. Just and true are your ways, King of the ages.

ekegusii: Saulo akarangeria abanto bonsi bagende Keila koboera Daudi amo nabanto baye, na kobarwania esegi.
english: And Saul called up all his forces for battle, to go down to Keilah to besiege David and his men.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria emechando emenene egacha igoro ase ekanisa ya Yerusalemu; bonsi bagaserebanigwa gochia chinse chia Boyahudi na Samaria, otatiga abatomwa bataserebanetigwe.
english: And Saul was there, giving approval to his death. On that day a great persecution broke out against the church at Jerusalem, and all except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria.

ekegusii: Yonathani, mosinto o Saulo, akaimoka akagenda ase Daudi, aria Horesi, akamoremia na komobeka chinguru ase Nyasae.
english: And Saul's son Jonathan went to David at Horesh and helped him find strength in God.

ekegusii: bakarora Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Inse y’amagoro aye nigo arenge buna amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, are nobokenonoku buna obore igoro.
english: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something like a pavement made of sapphire, clear as the sky itself.

ekegusii: nkarora Omonene aroro, ogontebia: Ayerera, karue Yerusalemu bwango, ekiagera tibagwancha oborori bwao igoro yane.
english: and saw the Lord speaking. 'Quick!' he said to me. 'Leave Jerusalem immediately, because they will not accept your testimony about me.'

ekegusii: Agwo akarora abana b’Efraimu na abachokoro baye goika ekiaare kia gatato, akarora na abana ba Makiri, omwana o Manase, baiboreretwe ase Yusufu.
english: and saw the third generation of Ephraim's children. Also the children of Makir son of Manasseh were placed at birth on Joseph's knees.

ekegusii: Erio akarora abamalaika babere, barenge ne chianga chindabu, baikaransete, oyomo ase omotwe, naende oyomo ase amagoro, agwo aase omobere o Yeso obegetwe.
english: and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesus' body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot.

ekegusii: Naende motebie Amasa: Inee! Aye tori amanyinga aane ne chinyama chiane? Nyasae ang’e egesusuro bono na kogenderera onye aye tokoba omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’esegi botambe ribaga ria Yoabu.”
english: And say to Amasa, 'Are you not my own flesh and blood? May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if from now on you are not the commander of my army in place of Joab.'"

ekegusii: Otebie abanto b’ense eyio ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteba: Rora inche nigo inde mamincha yao, ninsomore omoyio one korwa ase ekeraaro, ninsirie korwa asore abanyaboronge amo nabakori amabe.
english: and say to her: 'This is what the LORD says: I am against you. I will draw my sword from its scabbard and cut off from you both the righteous and the wicked.

ekegusii: and say to the owner of the house, 'The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?'
english: motebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia nkoboria are: Ng’ai enyomba y’abageni ere, inyare koriera Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?

ekegusii: Agende ase omokuani oyo otenenerete ase engaki eyio, amotebie: Ase rituko ria rero naorokirie ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, ng’a naikire ase ense eye Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaito eira ng’a natoyee.
english: and say to the priest in office at the time, "I declare today to the LORD your God that I have come to the land the LORD swore to our forefathers to give us."

ekegusii: obatebie amang’ana aya: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Naboigo inche ndakore abanto aba amo nomochie oyo, buna omonto agwata enyongo etanyare koroisigwa naende. Abanto nabatindeke ebitondo biabo agwo Tofeti, goika aase ande abore barabitindeke.”
english: and say to them, 'This is what the LORD Almighty says: I will smash this nation and this city just as this potter's jar is smashed and cannot be repaired. They will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

ekegusii: Erio obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Naama! Nindusie Abaisraeli korwa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku agwo ase bairetwe, mbasangererie korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, mbarente ase ense yabo.
english: and say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will take the Israelites out of the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from all around and bring them back into their own land.

ekegusii: obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ase rituko riria nachorete Abaisraeli, nigo nariete eira y’ogotiana ase ororeria rwa Yakobo, nkeorokia na kwemanyekania asebare, agwo ase ense ya Misiri. Nigo natianete asebare, ngateba: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: and say to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: On the day I chose Israel, I swore with uplifted hand to the descendants of the house of Jacob and revealed myself to them in Egypt. With uplifted hand I said to them, "I am the LORD your God."

ekegusii: Okwane iga: Inwe abaruoti ba Yuda, na Abayuda mwensi, na abanto ba Yerusalemu, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene. Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Naama! Nkoreta nde amang’ana amabe mono igoro y’aase aiga, na kera oyomo orayaigwe nigo araichane.
english: and say, 'Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Listen! I am going to bring a disaster on this place that will make the ears of everyone who hears of it tingle.

ekegusii: mobatebie ng’a omoruoti otebire: Beka omonto oyio ime ase echela, momong’ate endagera na amache goika ing’irane ase omorembe.”
english: and say, 'This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.'"

ekegusii: mobatebie ng’a aya naro omoruoti atebire: Beka omonto oyio ime ase echela, momong’ate endagera na amache goika ing’irane inde nomorembe.”
english: and say, 'This is what the king says: Put this fellow in prison and give him nothing but bread and water until I return safely.'"

ekegusii: Tebia Yerusalemu ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae akoyotebia: “Aye nigo kwaiboreretwe ase ense ya Kanani. Iso nigo arenge Omoamori, na nyoko n’Omohiti orenge.
english: and say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says to Jerusalem: Your ancestry and birth were in the land of the Canaanites; your father was an Amorite and your mother a Hittite.

ekegusii: Obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Obobe nobwabo abakungu abwo bakobarera ebimoya bire namaebi, babisiba ase amaboko abo, naende babarera ebitambaa bagotuba emetwe y’abanto abake na abanene, erinde babarichania. Inee! Inwe abakungu aba, nigo mogochia korigia abanto baane na kobarichania, mobasirie, erinde inwe mogenderere koba moyo na kwenyorera ebitoki?
english: and say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the women who sew magic charms on all their wrists and make veils of various lengths for their heads in order to ensnare people. Will you ensnare the lives of my people but preserve your own?

ekegusii: otebe: “Nyoko naki arenge? Nigo arenge endo eaberi! Nigo arenge korara na koramama ase egati ye chindo, akaba okorera abana baye ase egati ye chindo chire ne chinguru.
english: and say: "'What a lioness was your mother among the lions! She lay down among the young lions and reared her cubs.

ekegusii: otebe: Inwe ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene Nyasae! Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agotebia inwe ebitunwa, na ebigoro, ne chindooche, na amakura: Rora, inche nindete omoro asemore na ninsarie aase aino aimokererete igoro mogosasimera.
english: and say: 'O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign LORD. This is what the Sovereign LORD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: I am about to bring a sword against you, and I will destroy your high places.

ekegusii: otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye Sidoni, rora, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, ning’orokie obonene bwane ase egati yao. Ekero ndakonachere ekina na nkworokie obochenu bwane, erio abanto mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'I am against you, O Sidon, and I will gain glory within you. They will know that I am the LORD, when I inflict punishment on her and show myself holy within her.

ekegusii: ogetebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba:” “Aye Egetunwa gia Seiri, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, nindambore okoboko kwane igoro yao, ngosarie obe bosa.
english: and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you and make you a desolate waste.

ekegusii: omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye Gogi, omogambi omonene bw’ense ya Rosi, na eya Meseki, na eya Tubali, inche nigo inde mamincha yao.
english: and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

ekegusii: oyotebie: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye omochie gwaiteire amanyinga ’abanto ase egati‐gati yao, na gwesoirie ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasima emegwekano, bono engaki yao yaikire.
english: and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: O city that brings on herself doom by shedding blood in her midst and defiles herself by making idols,

ekegusii: bakabora, “Ekeene, Omonene obokire, oorokeire Simion.”
english: and saying, "It is true! The Lord has risen and has appeared to Simon."

ekegusii: “Onchoka, ekiagera oboruoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e!”
english: and saying, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near."

ekegusii: “Aye oyogotagora Hekalu na koyeagacha ase amatuko atato, etoorie! Onye naye Omwana o Nyasae, ika korwa ase omosalaba.”
english: and saying, "You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!"

ekegusii: agatoma ekegonkoru, na kerokio gekairuruka gochia aaria na aaria goika amache agakamoka korwa ase ense.
english: and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth.

ekegusii: na akaroberia emegati igoro yaye ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikire.
english: and set out the bread on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Naende akabeka chitaya igoro y’ekebekerero ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ere konya amochikire.
english: and set up the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Naende akamotebia, “Seito obonyansi mboreo, na aase tokorisia aisaine, na enyomba y’abageni bakorara nereo.”
english: And she added, "We have plenty of straw and fodder, as well as room for you to spend the night."

ekegusii: Naende agateba, “Ning’o nanga ore komotebia Ibrahimu ng’a Sara nagonkie abana? Na bono namoiboreire omwana ase obogotu bwaye.”
english: And she added, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age."

ekegusii: Bilia akaba morito, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia.
english: and she became pregnant and bore him a son.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, na ekero aroche ng’a omwana oria nomuya mono, akamobisa ase engaki y’emetienyi etato.
english: and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him for three months.

ekegusii: Akaibora omwana oye omoisia omotangi, akamobekera chianga chi’obwana, akamwareria ase orotuba chiombe chiare koriera, ekiagera batanyorete ribaga ase enyomba y’abageni.
english: and she gave birth to her firstborn, a son. She wrapped him in cloths and placed him in a manger, because there was no room for them in the inn.

ekegusii: Erio eting’ana eria akaa omoruoti ebiegwa ebio arentete: Chitahabu chikiro chilifu isano (5,000), na ebinsari ebinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Naende ebinsari tibiarentetwe kero kende gionsi ebinge koreng’ana buna biria eting’ana ya Seba yarenterete omoruoti Sulemani.
english: And she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. Never again were so many spices brought in as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

ekegusii: Hana akaria eira, agakwana, “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, ondigererie inche omosomba oo ase emechando yane! Tonyeba! Korang’e omwana omomura, nigo ndamorue abe oyoo, aye Omonene; ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwaye takogingirwa etukia yaye.”
english: And she made a vow, saying, "O LORD Almighty, if you will only look upon your servant's misery and remember me, and not forget your servant but give her a son, then I will give him to the LORD for all the days of his life, and no razor will ever be used on his head."

ekegusii: Ase ayio agatebia Ibrahimu. “Moserie omokungu oyo omosomba amo nomwana oye, ekiagera omwana bw’omokungu oyo omosomba takoria omwando amo nomwana one Isaka.”
english: and she said to Abraham, "Get rid of that slave woman and her son, for that slave woman's son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac."

ekegusii: Hana agatebia Eli, “Omonene one, inyigwa. Amaene, buna ogendererete koba moyo, inche nomokungu oria natenenete aiga ase obosio bwao, narenge gosaba Omonene.
english: and she said to him, "As surely as you live, my lord, I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the LORD.

ekegusii: And Shechem said to his father Hamor, "Get me this girl as my wife."
english: Sekemu agakwana na Hamori ise, akamotebia, “Mborerie omoiseke oyo abe mokane!”

ekegusii: Korende Omonene konya tarateba ng’a nasirie erieta ri’Abaisraeli korwa ase ense. Ase ayio akabatooria goetera ase okoboko kwa Yeroboamu, mosinto o Yehoasi.
english: And since the LORD had not said he would blot out the name of Israel from under heaven, he saved them by the hand of Jeroboam son of Jehoash.

ekegusii: Naende ntore n’Omokuani Omonene igoro y’enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: and since we have a great priest over the house of God,

ekegusii: Ebio nabigenderere koba okogechia asemore, chinyama chiabo timochiria, na echikwete ase echio timochiria, ekiagera echio nokogechia asemore.
english: And since you are to detest them, you must not eat their meat and you must detest their carcasses.

ekegusii: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.
english: Erio bagaikaransa komorigereria aria.

ekegusii: amosoere ase amang’ana ’obonyaka, erio asarie erieta riaye, ogoteba: Nigo naira omokungu oyo, na ekero naba nere tindochi ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bwaye.
english: and slanders her and gives her a bad name, saying, "I married this woman, but when I approached her, I did not find proof of her virginity,"

ekegusii: Naboigo ase okoremereria Ibrahimu akanyora ayarieretwe eira.
english: And so after waiting patiently, Abraham received what was promised.

ekegusii: Na igo Abaisraeli bonsi nabatoorigwe, buna erikire, “Ere Omosibori nache korwa Sayoni. Narusie obobe bore ase Yakobo;
english: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: "The deliverer will come from Zion; he will turn godlessness away from Jacob.

ekegusii: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas and Luke, my fellow workers.
english: Mariko na Aristariko, na Dema, na Luka, abakori emeremo amo nainche, bagokwanirie boigo.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa ase omonto oria oyomo, nonya konya obeire buna oyokure, abanto bakaiborwa abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, na buna omokenye ore ase engegu y’enyancha, otanyare kobareka.
english: And so from this one man, and he as good as dead, came descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as countless as the sand on the seashore.

ekegusii: And so he died, old and full of years.
english: Na Ayubu agakwa kabeire omogotu mono.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nabatebirie, kera ebibe na okorama mwanyabanto nabaaberwe, korende onye bakorama Omoika tibakwaberwa.
english: And so I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.

ekegusii: Ninyeorokie ng’a inche nomonene na omochenu; ninyemanyekanie ase amasio ’ebisaku ebinge. Erio abanto mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: And so I will show my greatness and my holiness, and I will make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Yeso nere agachanderwa isiko y’egeita, erinde achene abanto namanyinga aye ere omonyene.
english: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to make the people holy through his own blood.

ekegusii: Erio Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka ase erooro, okorandia, okobatebia, “Onchoka, mobatiswe, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe.”
english: And so John came, baptizing in the desert region and preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

ekegusii: erinde bagambigwe bonsi abwo bategenete ekeene, korende baare kwegokia ase ayatari ay’oboronge.
english: and so that all will be condemned who have not believed the truth but have delighted in wickedness.

ekegusii: naende amatuko aino anyare koba amange ase ense eria Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nayee barabwo na ororeria rwabo, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke.
english: and so that you may live long in the land that the LORD swore to your forefathers to give to them and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bagatebia omonto oria ogwenetigwe, “Rero n’Esabato, tari boronge asore gwetweka egesero kiao.”
english: and so the Jews said to the man who had been healed, "It is the Sabbath; the law forbids you to carry your mat."

ekegusii: Ase enchera eye mbabe bakorenda Eema y’Omosangererekano na Aase Aachenu, na bakonye abanto bamwabo ab’ororeria rwa Haroni ase obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: And so the Levites carried out their responsibilities for the Tent of Meeting, for the Holy Place and, under their brothers the descendants of Aaron, for the service of the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio nario arabachere amanyinga onsi ayaboronge ayaitegete ase ense, korwa amanyinga ’Abeli, oria omonyene oboronge, goika amanyinga a Zakaria, omwana o Barakia, oria mwaiterete gati ye Hekalu na egesasimero.
english: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.

ekegusii: Na intwe twamanyire obwanchani obo Nyasae are naborobwo asetore, na kobwegena. Nyasae nobwanchani, na ere oyomenyete ase obwanchani nigo amenyete ime ase Nyasae, na Nyasae ime asare.
english: And so we know and rely on the love God has for us. God is love. Whoever lives in love lives in God, and God in him.

ekegusii: naboigo Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, abarenge ababwatani ba Simion. Yeso agatebia Simion, “Toiroka; korwa bono nobe omorubi bw’abanto.”
english: and so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, Simon's partners. Then Jesus said to Simon, "Don't be afraid; from now on you will catch men."

ekegusii: na igo mokaba ekiorokererio ekiya ase abegeni bonsi ba Makedonia na Akaya.
english: And so you became a model to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

ekegusii: Ekio gekagera mokabeera agwo Kadeshi ase amatuko amange.”
english: And so you stayed in Kadesh many days-- all the time you spent there.

ekegusii: erinde inyore ase enchera ende yonsi goikera okobokigwa korwa ase abakure.
english: and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead.

ekegusii: Erio akagenda amo nomosangererekano oyio bwonsi goika aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa arenge agwo Gibeoni, ekiagera Eema y’Omosangererekano ya Nyasae, eria Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, aroisetie aaria ase erooro, nao yarenge.
english: and Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon, for God's Tent of Meeting was there, which Moses the LORD's servant had made in the desert.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaa Hiramu obosie bw’engano ebitonga chilifu amagana abere (200,000) koba endagera ase abanto b’enyomba yaye, na amaguta amitire korwa ase amazeituni chilita chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana abere (7,200). Ebinto ebio Sulemani akaba okoa Hiramu ase kera omwaka.
english: and Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat as food for his household, in addition to twenty thousand baths of pressed olive oil. Solomon continued to do this for Hiram year after year.

ekegusii: Bono Sulemani akaagacha Geseri naende). Boigo akaagacha Beti‐Horoni ya maate,
english: And Solomon rebuilt Gezer.) He built up Lower Beth Horon,

ekegusii: Sulemani akaba okogambera amaruoti onsi, gochakera orooche rw’Eufarati na goikera ense y’Abafilisti, na goikera orobebe rwa Misiri. Abanto bonsi b’oboruoti bwaye nigo barenge komorentera ebango na bakaba bakomokorera ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
english: And Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt. These countries brought tribute and were Solomon's subjects all his life.

ekegusii: Boigo abana bande bao abamura, abwo kwaiboreirwe, inabairwe, bachie koba abakoreri ase enyomba y’omoruoti o Babeli.”
english: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood who will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."

ekegusii: Na abana bande bao abamura baria kwaiboreirwe nabairwe, babe abakoreri ase enyomba y’omoruotio Babeli.”
english: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood, that will be born to you, will be taken away, and they will become eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon."

ekegusii: Ogokwana kwao kobe okw’obogima, okwo gotanyare gosoerwa, erinde omoengereria onde bwensi asooke, taba ne ring’ana riibe agokwana igoro yaito.
english: and soundness of speech that cannot be condemned, so that those who oppose you may be ashamed because they have nothing bad to say about us.

ekegusii: Aro naminyoke ne chinguru igoro y’ense y’Abayuda, aichore, agenderere gochia bosio aike ase rigoti.” Ee, aye Imanueli, amache ayio nigo ararambore chimbaba chiaye atube obogare bw’ense yao.
english: and sweep on into Judah, swirling over it, passing through it and reaching up to the neck. Its outspread wings will cover the breadth of your land, O Immanuel!"

ekegusii: Erio arente okoruegwa okwo ase abakuani, abamura ba Haroni. Omokuani otenenerete aimokie obosie boichire roe, amo namaguta, na ubani yonsi, abisambere ase egesasimero bibe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
english: and take it to Aaron's sons the priests. The priest shall take a handful of the fine flour and oil, together with all the incense, and burn this as a memorial portion on the altar, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Orusie amanyinga make ayare ase egesasimero, na amaguta ayio akweakwa, onyororokerie Haroni ne chianga chiaye, na abamura baye, ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo Haroni na abamura baye baatananwe ase emeremo emechenu, amo ne chianga chiabo.
english: And take some of the blood on the altar and some of the anointing oil and sprinkle it on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. Then he and his sons and their garments will be consecrated.

ekegusii: mokoborokereria kobwata aya onsi nabachigete; na rora, inche nigo inde amo nainwe amatuko onsi goika omoerio bw’ense.”
english: and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age."

ekegusii: obachike baimokie amagena ikomi na abere, korwa agwo gati‐gati ya Yorodan aase abakuani bateneine namagoro abo, bayaire na bayabeke amo ase moratoore obotuko obo.”
english: and tell them to take up twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan from right where the priests stood and to carry them over with you and put them down at the place where you stay tonight."

ekegusii: And ten of Joab's armor-bearers surrounded Absalom, struck him and killed him.
english: Erio abamura ikomi ababogoreretie Yoabu ebirwanero, bagaetanana Abisalomu, bakamoaka na komoita.

ekegusii: naende akaorokera Kefa; naende na baria ikomi na babere.
english: and that he appeared to Peter, and then to the Twelve.

ekegusii: anyare gotoma Kristo, oria mwarageretwe korwa kare, nere Yeso.
english: and that he may send the Christ, who has been appointed for you-- even Jesus.

ekegusii: Bono onde tamochera oyomwabo na komong’aina ase ring’ana eri, ekiagera Omonene nere okorusia egesiomba ase aya onsi, buna twabamanyetie ritang’ani na kobakurera bokong’u.
english: and that in this matter no one should wrong his brother or take advantage of him. The Lord will punish men for all such sins, as we have already told you and warned you.

ekegusii: Ayio agakoreka asare, na abanto igo bamotindacherete agwo ase egeita, agakwa.
english: And that is exactly what happened to him, for the people trampled him in the gateway, and he died.

ekegusii: Ngakora aya aria Yerusalemu: Ngasiba abachenu abange ase echela, ekero naeirwe okobua nabakuani abanene; tari ayio oka, korende kobagoitwa, nigo narenge gwancha abe bo asebare.
english: And that is just what I did in Jerusalem. On the authority of the chief priests I put many of the saints in prison, and when they were put to death, I cast my vote against them.

ekegusii: And that is what happened. Gideon rose early the next day; he squeezed the fleece and wrung out the dew-- a bowlful of water.
english: Ayio akaba boigo. Ekero Gidioni abogete mambia chuni, akamita risankwa riria, akanyititora amache ’obotooru, egetaabo kegaichora.

ekegusii: Abande asemore nigo mwarenge abanto buna aba, korende mogasibigwa na mogachenwa, mwanyorire oboronge ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso Kristo, na ase Omoika o Nyasae oito.
english: And that is what some of you were. But you were washed, you were sanctified, you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the Spirit of our God.

ekegusii: Naende akarora ng’a Yakobo oigwereire ise na ng’ina ogendire Padan‐Aramu.
english: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene naikeranie ring’ana riaye, riria akwanete asende, agateba: Abana bao kobararende chinchera chiabo, na bataare ase obosio bwane ase obwegenwa ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi, na ase emioyo yabo yonsi, rirorio omonto takobora korwa ase ororeria rwao oyoraikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: and that the LORD may keep his promise to me: 'If your descendants watch how they live, and if they walk faithfully before me with all their heart and soul, you will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.'

ekegusii: naende ng’a ase engaki eyio goika bararie ase emechie yabo yonsi, na ase Yerusalemu, batebie abanto bagende ase ebigoro barente chinsagia chi’emezeituni, ere ase emegondo na eyere ase orosana, na echi’emeadasi, na echi’emekendo, na echi’emete ende ere namato amange, erio baagachere ebigutu buna erikire.
english: and that they should proclaim this word and spread it throughout their towns and in Jerusalem: "Go out into the hill country and bring back branches from olive and wild olive trees, and from myrtles, palms and shade trees, to make booths"-- as it is written.

ekegusii: erio banyare gotaboboka na korua ase omoeto o Saitani kobasakoirwe nere goika bakore ogwancha kwaye.
english: and that they will come to their senses and escape from the trap of the devil, who has taken them captive to do his will.

ekegusii: naende ng’a omonto onde bwensi otatung’ameti inse na koumama ase okoyosasima, oyio goika arutwe ase eriko ri’omorero ekebemberi.
english: and that whoever does not fall down and worship will be thrown into a blazing furnace.

ekegusii: Mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oino, momoigwere na mobe abegenwa asare. Ekero morakore ayio, rirorio namogenderere koba moyo na komenya ase ense eyio Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a nabayee.”
english: and that you may love the LORD your God, listen to his voice, and hold fast to him. For the LORD is your life, and he will give you many years in the land he swore to give to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nigo ore nobwanchani bogendererete botambe; aye nigo ogoakana omonto koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere.
english: and that you, O Lord, are loving. Surely you will reward each person according to what he has done.

ekegusii: Gati‐gati y’oboroso boria bwatichire na ebinyomba biaagachire ao bioka, ribaga ndiarengeo eri’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere riaetanaine Hekalu.
english: and the [priests'] rooms was twenty cubits wide all around the temple.

ekegusii: Abaamori bakabwaterera ensemo yabo y’egetunwa kia Heresi, na Ayaloni, na Shaalabimu, korende abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu bakabaengera, bakababetereria babakorere emeremo emekong’u.
english: And the Amorites were determined also to hold out in Mount Heres, Aijalon and Shaalbim, but when the power of the house of Joseph increased, they too were pressed into forced labor.

ekegusii: Na abamalaika baria batarendete okobua kwabo abanyene, korende bagatiga obomenyo bwabo, barendire nere ase ebisibo bia kare na kare inse y’omosunte omonene goika ekina geche koba ase rituko riria rinene.
english: And the angels who did not keep their positions of authority but abandoned their own home-- these he has kept in darkness, bound with everlasting chains for judgment on the great Day.

ekegusii: na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya esamberwe Aase Aachenu ime. Ase ogokora ebinto ebi bionsi goika bakore buna nagochikire kegima.”
english: and the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place. They are to make them just as I commanded you."

ekegusii: Erio abanto mbairanerie, batebe: Ayio igo akoregete, ekiagera abanto batigete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, okwo akorete amo nabarabwo, ekero abarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
english: And the answer will be: "It is because this people abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, the covenant he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Nabairanerigwe: Aya nigo akorekire, ekiagera abanto b’omochie oyo batigete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, Nyasae obo, bakaonchokera gosasima na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao.”
english: And the answer will be: 'Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD their God and have worshiped and served other gods.'"

ekegusii: na omonto oria okorusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo amonyore ore isiko y’omochie oria karamoite, rirorio takobarerwa okomocha ase okomoita.
english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside the city, the avenger of blood may kill the accused without being guilty of murder.

ekegusii: Orobebe rw’Abakanani rogachaka korwa ase Sidoni, rokagenda enchera ya Gerari, rogaika Gasa, naende ase enchera ya Sodomu, na Gomora, na Adima, na Seboimu, rogaika Lasa.
english: and the borders of Canaan reached from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.

ekegusii: Bono omwana oria Samweli akagenderera gokina ase omobere, akamogwenera Omonene na mwanyabanto.
english: And the boy Samuel continued to grow in stature and in favor with the LORD and with men.

ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko bakarigia enchera y’okomoita, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto.
english: and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were looking for some way to get rid of Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.

ekegusii: Omwana oria agakina, akamenteka chinguru ase omoika, akaba ase erooro goika rituko riria aorogete ase Abaisraeli.
english: And the child grew and became strong in spirit; and he lived in the desert until he appeared publicly to Israel.

ekegusii: Omwana oria agakina, akamenteka chinguru, agaichorwa nobong’aini ne chisemi; na obuya bwa Nyasae bokaba amo nere.
english: And the child grew and became strong; he was filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

ekegusii: Ne chiamate chia Kiriati‐Yearimu nachio echi: Abaitiri na Abaputi, Abasumati na Abamisira. Korwa ase abanto aba nao Abasori na Abaesitaoli barwete.
english: and the clans of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, Puthites, Shumathites and Mishraites. From these descended the Zorathites and Eshtaolites.

ekegusii: amo ne chiamate chi’abariki baria bamenyete agwo Yabesi, nabwo Abatirati, na Abasimeati, na Abasukati. Aba nabwo Abakeni abarwete ase Hamati, ise abanto b’enyomba ya Rekabu.
english: and the clans of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, Shimeathites and Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Recab.

ekegusii: And the cows that were ugly and gaunt ate up the seven sleek, fat cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.
english: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiria chingiya chinoru. Erio Farao akaboka.

ekegusii: Oria Omogenki, oyobagengete, akarutwa ase enyancha y’omorero na ekebiriti aase eng’iti eria yarenge amo nomobani oria bw’oborimo. Abwo nabachandwe omobaso na obotuko goika kare na kare.
english: And the devil, who deceived them, was thrown into the lake of burning sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet had been thrown. They will be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

ekegusii: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
english: Bagasangereria ebisamunye biasamunyogete, na ebio bigaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere, naboigo nebisamunye bie chinswe.

ekegusii: Na aborokigwa bagaichorwa nomogoko na Omoika Omochenu.
english: And the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora eng’iti egosoka korwa ase enyancha. Ero nigo yarenge ne chingunchara ikomi na emetwe etano na ebere. Igoro ase chingunchara chiaye nchiarengeo chigutwa ikomi, na ase emetwe yaye ndiarengeo erieta ri’okorama.
english: And the dragon stood on the shore of the sea. And I saw a beast coming out of the sea. He had ten horns and seven heads, with ten crowns on his horns, and on each head a blasphemous name.

ekegusii: Erio orotu ndoirane, ase riroba buna rwarenge, na omoika oirane gochia ase Nyasae oria oyoruete.
english: and the dust returns to the ground it came from, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.

ekegusii: Riroba rikabwereka, rikabamera, amo ne chiamate chiabo, na abanto bonsi ababwatetie Kora, amo nebinto biabo bionsi.
english: and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, with their households and all Korah's men and all their possessions.

ekegusii: Erio ense eiranerie erue endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na ebinto ebio mbiigwe ogosaba kwa Yesireeli.
english: and the earth will respond to the grain, the new wine and oil, and they will respond to Jezreel.

ekegusii: Ekero ndarambore okoboko kwane igoro y’Abamisiri, na korusia Abaisraeli korwa asebare, erio nario Abamisiri baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: And the Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I stretch out my hand against Egypt and bring the Israelites out of it."

ekegusii: Abagaaka b’omosangererekano oria bakaborania, “Naki torakore tonyorere abasacha baria batigarete abakungu, ekiagera abakungu bonsi baitirwe korwa ase Ababenjamin?”
english: And the elders of the assembly said, "With the women of Benjamin destroyed, how shall we provide wives for the men who are left?

ekegusii: Erio abagaaka b’omochie oria babwate omosacha oria, bamoake ebiranya.
english: and the elders shall take the man and punish him.

ekegusii: Omobisa oria oyasimegete nere Saitani; rigesa nomoerio bw’ense, na abarache kogesa nabamalaika.
english: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.

ekegusii: Nere Tata oyontomete obeire kirori asende. Eriogi riaye timwana koriigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timwana gokerora
english: And the Father who sent me has himself testified concerning me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,

ekegusii: Omoriri nigo are omonyamang’ana mange. Monto onde tamanyeti aya agochia koba. Ning’o oranyare komotebia ekegochia koba korwa nyuma yaye.
english: and the fool multiplies words. No one knows what is coming-- who can tell him what will happen after him?

ekegusii: Na abamalaika baria bane bagasiborwa, abwo babegetwe ang’e ase ensa eyio eyio, ne rituko, na omotienyi, na omwaka, erinde baite ensemo ya gatato ya mwanyabanto.
english: And the four angels who had been kept ready for this very hour and day and month and year were released to kill a third of mankind.

ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene bogacha bokabeera igoro y’egetunwa gia Sinai, ne riire rikagetuba ase engaki y’amatuko atano na rimo. Rituko ria gatano na kabere Omonene akarangeria Musa korwa riire ime.
english: and the glory of the LORD settled on Mount Sinai. For six days the cloud covered the mountain, and on the seventh day the LORD called to Moses from within the cloud.

ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene mboorokigwe, na mwanyabanto bonsi mbaborore bare amo. Omonene nere okwanire amang’ana ayio.”
english: And the glory of the LORD will be revealed, and all mankind together will see it. For the mouth of the LORD has spoken."

ekegusii: Na Nyasae bw’obuya bwonsi, oyo obarangeirie mosoe ase obonene bwaye bwa kare na kare ase Kristo, komwaikire gochandwa ase ekero egeke, ere omonyene nabaroisie, na abakong’ie, ababeke chinguru na kobabeka ase oboroso obuya.
english: And the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore you and make you strong, firm and steadfast.

ekegusii: Naende negwenerete enchili erandigwe ritang’ani ase ebisaku bionsi.
english: And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.

ekegusii: Na Abaisraeli bakaengera Yabini, omoruoti o Kanani goika bakamosiria kegima.
english: And the hand of the Israelites grew stronger and stronger against Jabin, the Canaanite king, until they destroyed him.

ekegusii: Igoro nigo chikoraria oboronge bwa Nyasae; Nyasae omonyene nere omonachi ebina.
english: And the heavens proclaim his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah

ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu ogaika igoro asare ase omogwekano bwe riruma, eriogi rikarwa igoro, rigoteba, “Aye naye Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie naye.”
english: and the Holy Spirit descended on him in bodily form like a dove. And a voice came from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased."

ekegusii: na Abahori ase egetunwa Seiri goika Eli‐Parani ore ang’e nerooro.
english: and the Horites in the hill country of Seir, as far as El Paran near the desert.

ekegusii: Emegwekano yonsi egosasimwa nesirigwe kegima.
english: and the idols will totally disappear.

ekegusii: Abanto b’omochie oyomo mbagende batebie ab’omochie onde: Inchuo togende bwango, torigie ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, ee, inchuo torigie Omonene bw’Emeganda! Nainche nkogenda inde.
english: and the inhabitants of one city will go to another and say, 'Let us go at once to entreat the LORD and seek the LORD Almighty. I myself am going.'

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarigia ogosemia korwa ase Omonene. (Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatanana kwa Nyasae nao yarenge ase amatuko aria,
english: And the Israelites inquired of the LORD. (In those days the ark of the covenant of God was there,

ekegusii: na Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku. Amache akaba agotenena buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi asebare.
english: and the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agakorera Esteri omoyega omonene bw’amasikani, akarangeria abanene bonsi b’obogambi na abasomba baye aroro. Boigo akarareria abanto bakeanerigwe ebango ase ense yaye, naende akarua ebiegwa ebinge buna omoruoti agwenerete akore.
english: And the king gave a great banquet, Esther's banquet, for all his nobles and officials. He proclaimed a holiday throughout the provinces and distributed gifts with royal liberality.

ekegusii: Ense eria ase Yehosafati arenge kogambera ekaba nobotoereru, ekiagera Nyasae oye amoete omorembe ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was at peace, for his God had given him rest on every side.

ekegusii: Bono ense ya Misiri nigo ere ase obosio bwao; bae iso na bamura bamino ribaga bamenye aase are aagiya. Tiga bamenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, naende onye komanyete bande ase egati yabo abamanyete mono emeremo y’obotugi, obabeke babe abateneneri ase chitugo chiane.”
english: and the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and your brothers in the best part of the land. Let them live in Goshen. And if you know of any among them with special ability, put them in charge of my own livestock."

ekegusii: Abamisiri mbabe bakoiroka abanto b’ense y’Abayuda; ekero Omomisiri araigwe ense y’Abayuda egwatorwa nabe nobwoba obonene, ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda okorire omoroberio ore mamincha y’Abamisiri.
english: And the land of Judah will bring terror to the Egyptians; everyone to whom Judah is mentioned will be terrified, because of what the LORD Almighty is planning against them.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’abateneneri b’Abalawi: Hasabia, na Serebia, na Yesua, mosinto o Kadimeli. Abwo amo nabamwabo bande nabwo babegetwe ase ebiombe biateneneretwe korigererania ase ogoitabererania amatera ay’ogotogia na koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, buna Daudi, omonto o Nyasae, achigete.
english: And the leaders of the Levites were Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their associates, who stood opposite them to give praise and thanksgiving, one section responding to the other, as prescribed by David the man of God.

ekegusii: Abalawi bakabogoria Esanduku eria ya Nyasae nemiaro igoro ase amareko abo, buna Musa abachigete koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: And the Levites carried the ark of God with the poles on their shoulders, as Moses had commanded in accordance with the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: Abalawi aba: Yesua na Kadimieli, Bani na Hasabineya, Serebia na Hodia, Sebania na Petahia, bagatebia abanto, “Tenena motogie Omonene, Nyasae oino, momotogie korwa bono goika kare na kare. Ogotogigwa kobe ase erieta riaye rinene riimokereirie igoro goetania ogosesesenigwa na ogotogigwa gwonsi.”
english: And the Levites-- Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah and Pethahiah-- said: "Stand up and praise the LORD your God, who is from everlasting to everlasting." "Blessed be your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.

ekegusii: “Naende Omonene agatotebia twensi: Abana baino abake abwo mwatebete ng’a nabooswe, abwo ase rituko ria rero bataramanya ayare amabe gose amaya, nabwo baraike ase ense eria, inche nimbayee ebe eyabo.
english: And the little ones that you said would be taken captive, your children who do not yet know good from bad-- they will enter the land. I will give it to them and they will take possession of it.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio ontengerete akarangeria neriogi buna eri’endo, “Aye Omonene, nigo ngotenena igoro ase egetengero omobaso boira; nigo inde ase emeremo yane ase obotuko bwonsi.
english: And the lookout shouted, "Day after day, my lord, I stand on the watchtower; every night I stay at my post.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nakengere abanto baye, barabwo mbasirie ababisa babo, batiringe amagena e chinduruche chiabo. Mbanywe batinde, baake amariogi, babe buna abanto batindire edivai. Mbaichorigwe buna ebitaabo bi’amanyinga ’ebing’wanso, na babe buna chikoona chi’egesasimero chiichire amanyinga.
english: and the LORD Almighty will shield them. They will destroy and overcome with slingstones. They will drink and roar as with wine; they will be full like a bowl used for sprinkling the corners of the altar.

ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Amosi, ngento ki eke oroche?” Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Eke nekebiro.” Erio Omonene agantebia, “Rora, nindenge abanto baane Abaisraeli nekebiro eke. Tinkobaetania nonya ng’ake.
english: And the LORD asked me, "What do you see, Amos?" "A plumb line," I replied. Then the Lord said, "Look, I am setting a plumb line among my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora omwaga okaba bwe chinguru, okagusa korwa bosongo, okaira chingige chionsi gochia ase Enyancha Embariri. Tiyatigara engige nonya neyemo ase ense ya Misiri engima.
english: And the LORD changed the wind to a very strong west wind, which caught up the locusts and carried them into the Red Sea. Not a locust was left anywhere in Egypt.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agakwana nenswe eria, akayechika; ero ekaroka Yona, ekamobeka ase engegu.
english: And the LORD commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.

ekegusii: Omonene akabeka Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro. Boigo akaa Nebukadinesaro ribaga aire ebikorero binde bi’enyomba ya Nyasae, na ere akabiira ase ense ya Shinari, ase enyomba y’enyasae yaye, akabibeka ase ekungo y’enyomba eria.
english: And the Lord delivered Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, along with some of the articles from the temple of God. These he carried off to the temple of his god in Babylonia and put in the treasure house of his god.

ekegusii: Omonene agakora ayio. Chingi chigacha ase obonge mono ase chinyomba chia Farao, na echi’abasomba baye, na ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Na ense eria egasarigwa ne chingi chiria.
english: And the LORD did this. Dense swarms of flies poured into Pharaoh's palace and into the houses of his officials, and throughout Egypt the land was ruined by the flies.

ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa amoboretie, na ebioto ebio biare ase chinyomba, na ase chigoora, na aande onsi isiko, bigakwa.
english: And the LORD did what Moses asked. The frogs died in the houses, in the courtyards and in the fields.

ekegusii: Omonene agakora buna Musa atebete, akarusia chingi chiria ase Farao, na ase abasomba baye, na ase abanto baye; tichiatigara nonya neyemo.
english: and the LORD did what Moses asked: The flies left Pharaoh and his officials and his people; not a fly remained.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo Omonene aganchika ng’a imborokererie amachiko ayio, na emeroberio echikire, erinde monyare koyaigwera ase ense eria mokogenda koira.
english: And the LORD directed me at that time to teach you the decrees and laws you are to follow in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess.

ekegusii: Omonene agatosereria Abaamori aba bonsi abamenyete ase ense eye. Ase ayio, ntorigetie komokorera Omonene. Ere nere Nyasae oito.”
english: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations, including the Amorites, who lived in the land. We too will serve the LORD, because he is our God."

ekegusii: Na Omonene akababeka ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakabaumokera na kobaseria gochia Sidoni, omochie omonene, na Misirefoti‐Maimu, na goika ebate ya Misipa, ensemo ya moocha. Bakabaita; monto tatigara nonya noyomo.
english: and the LORD gave them into the hand of Israel. They defeated them and pursued them all the way to Greater Sidon, to Misrephoth Maim, and to the Valley of Mizpah on the east, until no survivors were left.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae agachika omonto oria, akabora, “Amatunda a kera omote ore ase omogondo oyo nonyare koyaria,
english: And the LORD God commanded the man, "You are free to eat from any tree in the garden;

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae agakinia emete korwa ase riroba, emete yonsi egosanerwa ase okororwa, na egwansa ase okoriegwa. Egati‐gati y’omogondo oria akabeka omote bw’obogima na omote bw’okomanyera amaya na amabe.
english: And the LORD God made all kinds of trees grow out of the ground-- trees that were pleasing to the eye and good for food. In the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae agateba, “Rora, omonto oyo obeire buna oyomo oito ase okomanya amaya na amabe. Aande nabaise gochia korambora okoboko kwaye atwe amatunda ’omote bw’obogima arie, erinde abe moyo kare na kare.”
english: And the LORD God said, "The man has now become like one of us, knowing good and evil. He must not be allowed to reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life and eat, and live forever."

ekegusii: Omonene nere okwanire rituko ria rero ng’a inwe nabanto baye omonyene b’ekeene, buna abarierete eira, naende obachikire ng’a morende na kobwata amachiko aye onsi.
english: And the LORD has declared this day that you are his people, his treasured possession as he promised, and that you are to keep all his commands.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akaigwa ogosaba gwa Hezekia, akarorera abanto amabera.
english: And the LORD heard Hezekiah and healed the people.

ekegusii: na Omonene akamotebia,
english: and the LORD said to him,

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Tirimboka gochia inse ase abanto, obakurere tibatamboka orobebe bache kondora. Baise gokora igo, abange babo mbakwe.
english: and the LORD said to him, "Go down and warn the people so they do not force their way through to see the LORD and many of them perish.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Yoshua, “Rero ninkoimokererie igoro, ase amasio ’abanto, nabarabwo mbamanye ng’a buna narenge amo na Musa, nabo ndabe amo naye boigo.
english: And the LORD said to Joshua, "Today I will begin to exalt you in the eyes of all Israel, so they may know that I am with you as I was with Moses.

ekegusii: “Boigo Omonene agakwana nainche, agantebia: Narorire abanto aba ng’a nabanyabigoti bikong’u.
english: And the LORD said to me, "I have seen this people, and they are a stiff-necked people indeed!

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia “Chirute ase omokori chinyongo.” (Rigori eri rinene nakoreretwe nabanto baria.) Erio nkaimokia chibesa chiria chie chifeta emerongo etato, ngachiruta ase enyomba y’Omonene, ase omokori chinyongo oria.
english: And the LORD said to me, "Throw it to the potter"-- the handsome price at which they priced me! So I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them into the house of the LORD to the potter.

ekegusii: Na Omonene agatebia Musa,
english: and the LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Genda ase abanto aba, obachene rero na ankio. Obatebie basibie chianga chiabo,
english: And the LORD said to Moses, "Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. Have them wash their clothes

ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Ninkore erio kwamboria, ekiagera kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane, na inche ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa.”
english: And the LORD said to Moses, "I will do the very thing you have asked, because I am pleased with you and I know you by name."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao igoro y’ense ya Misiri, erinde chingige chichiche koria ebimeri binde bionsi ebitasaretigwe nembura y’amagena.”
english: And the LORD said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over Egypt so that locusts will swarm over the land and devour everything growing in the fields, everything left by the hail."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rora kwabereire ang’e gochia gokwa na ogende gotimoka ase chisokoro chiao chitimogete; nyuma y’ayio abanto aba nigo baratige koba abegenwa asende, bakorere chinyasae chingeni chi’ense eria ase bakogenda komenya; barabwo mbantige, naende basarie okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete amo nabarabwo.
english: And the LORD said to Moses: "You are going to rest with your fathers, and these people will soon prostitute themselves to the foreign gods of the land they are entering. They will forsake me and break the covenant I made with them.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Samweli, “Rituko erimo ninkore egento gete ase egati y’Abaisraeli, egento gi’okwoboyia, na kera omonto orakeigwe, amato aye nigo arabe akoeera.
english: And the LORD said to Samuel: "See, I am about to do something in Israel that will make the ears of everyone who hears of it tingle.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Naye ng’ai okorwa?” Saitani akamoiraneria, “Nigo nkorwa ase etaaro yane, nkona‐goetanana ase ense yonsi, naende nabo nkonagotiira na gotirimboka aroro.”
english: And the LORD said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Satan answered the LORD, "From roaming through the earth and going back and forth in it."

ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ninkore obosiani bwane bwonsi boete ase obosio bwao, na erieta riane, inche Omonene, nindirarie ase obosio bwao. Nimororere amabeebe oyio ndarorere amabeebe, na nimororere amabera oyio ndarorere amabera.”
english: And the LORD said, "I will cause all my goodness to pass in front of you, and I will proclaim my name, the LORD, in your presence. I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Igwa aya omogambi otari omoronge agoteba.
english: And the Lord said, "Listen to what the unjust judge says.

ekegusii: “Naende Omonene agatotebia: Bono imoka, mogende mwamboke gochia ng’umbu y’akarooche ga Seredi. Erio tokagenda, tokaamboka akarooche akwo.
english: And the LORD said, "Now get up and cross the Zered Valley." So we crossed the valley.

ekegusii: Na Omonene akaboria: Ning’o ogochia koebereria Ahabu, erinde agende Ramoti o Gileadi abuerwe aroro? Oyomo agakwana egento ekemo, na oyonde egento kende.
english: And the LORD said, 'Who will entice Ahab into attacking Ramoth Gilead and going to his death there?' "One suggested this, and another that.

ekegusii: Na Omonene akaboria: Ning’o ogochia koebereria Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, erinde agende Ramoti o Gileadi abugwe? Oyomo agakwana egento ekemo, na oyonde egento kende.

english: And the LORD sent an angel, who annihilated all the fighting men and the leaders and officers in the camp of the Assyrian king. So he withdrew to his own land in disgrace. And when he went into the temple of his god, some of his sons cut him down with the sword.
