english: and the woven garments worn for ministering in the sanctuary, both the sacred garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons when serving as priests.

ekegusii: na abamwabo abarenge gokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae, bonsi nabanto amagana atano na atato, na emerongo ebere, na babere (822); Adaya, mosinto o Yerohamu, o Pelalia, bw’Amusi, o Zakaria; o Pasuri, o Malikia,
english: and their associates, who carried on work for the temple-- 822 men; Adaiah son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malkijah,

ekegusii: and their associates: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
english: abamwabo: Sebania na Hodia; Kelita, na Pelaya, na Hanani;

ekegusii: Amaiso abo akaramokigwa. Yeso akabachika bokong’u, “Rigereria monto onde tabaisa komanya amang’ana aya.”
english: and their sight was restored. Jesus warned them sternly, "See that no one knows about this."

ekegusii: Chimbaba chiabo nigo chiakunaine, na ebitongwa biria tibiarenge koonchoka, korende bikaba bikogenda gochia bosio rioka.
english: and their wings touched one another. Each one went straight ahead; they did not turn as they moved.

ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo mokoyakora, naende mwachicha ase obosio bwane ase enyomba eye ekorokwa ase erieta riane mwateba: Twatoorigwe! Erio mogendererete gokora okogechia okwo?
english: and then come and stand before me in this house, which bears my Name, and say, "We are safe"-- safe to do all these detestable things?

ekegusii: Motabasereti, rirorio nimbakore inwe buna konya narengereirie gokora barabwo.”
english: And then I will do to you what I plan to do to them.'"

ekegusii: Erio agwo omosaria oria bw’amachiko aorokigwe, na Omonene Yeso namoite nomoika bw’omonwa oye, na komosiria ase amasase ’okoorokigwa kwaye.
english: And then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord Jesus will overthrow with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the splendor of his coming.

ekegusii: erio abarwani b’Abaisraeli bairane nyuma. Ababenjamin konya bachakire goita Abaisraeli, bagaita abanto koreng’ana emerongo etato. Erio bagateba, “Ekeene, Abaisraeli babuirwe ase obosio bwaito, buna chingaki chiria chinde.”
english: and then the men of Israel would turn in the battle. The Benjamites had begun to inflict casualties on the men of Israel (about thirty), and they said, "We are defeating them as in the first battle."

ekegusii: nonya noyo o gatato akamotwara. Naboigo bonsi batano na babere bagakwa, tibatiga abana.
english: and then the third married her, and in the same way the seven died, leaving no children.

ekegusii: Bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera motwe, na egetonto bakamobekera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio; bagatung’ama asare, bakamochecheria na kobora, “Masoge, Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi!”
english: and then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand and knelt in front of him and mocked him. "Hail, king of the Jews!" they said.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omoboraka bw’emiaka emerongo etano na etato na ene, atana korua ase Hekalu ime, korende akaba okweng’ata, na ogosaba, na ogosasima obotuko na omobaso.
english: and then was a widow until she was eighty-four. She never left the temple but worshiped night and day, fasting and praying.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu agakwana igoro ya Sara mokaye, “Oyo mosubati ominto.” Abimeleki, omoruoti o Gerari agatoma abanto kwoyia Sara.
english: and there Abraham said of his wife Sarah, "She is my sister." Then Abimelech king of Gerar sent for Sarah and took her.

ekegusii: Bakaorokerwa na Elija amo na Musa; na barabwo nigo barenge gokwana na Yeso.
english: And there appeared before them Elijah and Moses, who were talking with Jesus.

ekegusii: Naama! Obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli nao bwarenge, nkaborora buna naboroche ase ense omweya.
english: And there before me was the glory of the God of Israel, as in the vision I had seen in the plain.

ekegusii: Na aroro agwo mogoke ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, amo nabana baino, abamura na abaiseke, na Abalawi bamenyete amo nainwe ase emechie yaino, ekiagera Abalawi tibabwati egetari gose omwando bw’orogongo amo nainwe.
english: And there rejoice before the LORD your God, you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levites from your towns, who have no allotment or inheritance of their own.

ekegusii: Na ase omochie oyio narengeo omoboraka orenge komochiera botambe, ogoteba: Ngambera boronge ase omosira one.
english: And there was a widow in that town who kept coming to him with the plea, 'Grant me justice against my adversary.'

ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bokaba mambia, rituko ria gatano.
english: And there was evening, and there was morning-- the fifth day.

ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bokaba mambia, rituko ria kane.
english: And there was evening, and there was morning-- the fourth day.

ekegusii: Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bokaba mambia, rituko ria gatato.
english: And there was evening, and there was morning-- the third day.

ekegusii: Erio esegi yabete igoro. Mikaeli na abamalaika baye bakarwania enchoka. Na enchoka eria na abamalaika baye bakarwanera amo,
english: And there was war in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought back.

ekegusii: Naende mbarenge ase Abaisraeli abanto abange abaare noborwaire bwa ukoma ase ekero ki’omobani Elisha; onde tari osibegete otatiga Naamani, omonto o Siiria.”
english: And there were many in Israel with leprosy in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed-- only Naaman the Syrian."

ekegusii: Ase ense eyio mbarengeo abarisia baikaransete ase ebitii, bakorenda amaicho abo botuko.
english: And there were shepherds living out in the fields nearby, keeping watch over their flocks at night.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabarabwo batindire edivai; nigo bakoong’anya ase okonywa ebinyugwa bigotindia; abakuani na ababani batindire nebinyugwa bigotindia, na ekero bakorora amaroro nigo bakomocha, nigo bagotantana ekero bakonacha ebina.
english: And these also stagger from wine and reel from beer: Priests and prophets stagger from beer and are befuddled with wine; they reel from beer, they stagger when seeing visions, they stumble when rendering decisions.

ekegusii: Naama! Echi nechinsinyo chie chinchera chiaye, aya tokoiwga nokomonyerera ogosinini. Korende ning’o oranyare komanya okobua kwaye konga buna enkoba egoaka?”
english: And these are but the outer fringe of his works; how faint the whisper we hear of him! Who then can understand the thunder of his power?"

ekegusii: Na ebimanyererio ebi bie chinguru nabibatunyane abwo begenire: Ase erieta riane nabaserie ebirecha, nabakwane ase emenwa emeyia,
english: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;

ekegusii: Abanto baria batato: Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bakagwa ase eriko riria ri’omorero ekebemberi basibire.
english: and these three men, firmly tied, fell into the blazing furnace.

ekegusii: Na Abareuben na Abagadi, na Abaaseri, na Abasabuloni, na Abadani, na Abanafutali batenene igoro ase egetunwa ki’Ebali baragererie abanto.
english: And these tribes shall stand on Mount Ebal to pronounce curses: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali.

ekegusii: na abanene abarenge komokonya nabwo aba: Asaria, mosinto o Zadoki, nere orenge omokuani;
english: And these were his chief officials: Azariah son of Zadok-- the priest;

ekegusii: Aba nabwo baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu: Simea na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani. Aba nigo baiboretwe na Beti‐Sua, mosubati bw’Amieli.
english: and these were the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan and Solomon. These four were by Bathsheba daughter of Ammiel.

ekegusii: Ebirandi ebi bi’edivai bikorire korwa ase amasankwa nigo biarenge ebiyia ekero twabiichoretie edivai, na rora bono biatandokire. Ne chianga chiaito na ebikoroto boigo tobegete biagotire ase engencho y’orogendo rwaito orotambe.”
english: And these wineskins that we filled were new, but see how cracked they are. And our clothes and sandals are worn out by the very long journey."

ekegusii: Bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Ning’o oranyare gototigereria rigena riria korwa ase egesieri ki’oboina?”
english: and they asked each other, "Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?"

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Nase ki aborokia b’amariko bagoteba ng’a negwenerete Elija ache ritang’ani?”
english: And they asked him, "Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?"

ekegusii: Bagachaka komosoera, bakobora, “Twanyorire omonto oyo oonchoire egesaku giaito, otokanirie titoa Kaisari ebango, okobora ng’a ere omonyene nere Kristo omoruoti.”
english: And they began to accuse him, saying, "We have found this man subverting our nation. He opposes payment of taxes to Caesar and claims to be Christ, a king."

ekegusii: bagachaka komokwania, “Masoge, Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi!”
english: And they began to call out to him, "Hail, king of the Jews!"

ekegusii: Bikamosorora tabichika bigende goika ase eora entambe.
english: And they begged him repeatedly not to order them to go into the Abyss.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bakegena; na ekero baigwete ng’a Omonene bwechandeire Abaisraeli, na ororire emechando yabo, barabwo bagatung ama inse, bakamosasima.
english: and they believed. And when they heard that the LORD was concerned about them and had seen their misery, they bowed down and worshiped.

ekegusii: Bagasesenia Rebeka, bakamotebia, “Oyominto, obe ng’ina abanto chilifu ne chilifu; ororeria rwao inarobue emechie y’ababisa bao, royegambere!”
english: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, "Our sister, may you increase to thousands upon thousands; may your offspring possess the gates of their enemies."

ekegusii: bakayerenta amo n’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na ebikorero ebichenu bionsi biarenge ime ase Eema eria; abakuani Abalawi nabwo babirentete.
english: and they brought up the ark and the Tent of Meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The priests, who were Levites, carried them up;

ekegusii: bakayerenta amo n’Eema y’Omosangererekano na ebikorero bionsi ebichenu biarenge ime ase Eema eria. Abakuani na Abalawi nabwo barentete ebinto ebio.
english: and they brought up the ark of the LORD and the Tent of Meeting and all the sacred furnishings in it. The priests and Levites carried them up,

ekegusii: Abanto bakamotindeka ase orogongo rware omwando oye agwo Timunati‐Heresi, irianyi y’egetunwa kia Gaasi, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu.
english: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

ekegusii: Bakamotindeka ase omochie bw’omwando oye, agwo Timunati‐Sera, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, sugusu y’egetunwa kia Gaasi.
english: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio bakaroka aase aria Bokimu. Agwo bakamoruera Omonene ebing’wanso.
english: and they called that place Bokim. There they offered sacrifices to the LORD.

ekegusii: na ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o kabere bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto amo. Bakarika amarieta ’abanto abwo konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba, na omonto ase omonto.
english: and they called the whole community together on the first day of the second month. The people indicated their ancestry by their clans and families, and the men twenty years old or more were listed by name, one by one,

ekegusii: Naende tibagokwa, ekiagera nigo barabe koreng’ana buna abamalaika, na abana ba Nyasae bare, ekiagera nabana b’okobokigwa.
english: and they can no longer die; for they are like the angels. They are God's children, since they are children of the resurrection.

ekegusii: And they cannot prove to you the charges they are now making against me.
english: Gose tibakonyara koorokia amang’ana aya bansoera bono ng’a namaene are.

ekegusii: bakorera neriogi rinene, bakobora, “Ogotooreka nkorwa ase Nyasae oito, oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene, na korwa ase Emanwa y’Eng’ondi!”
english: And they cried out in a loud voice: "Salvation belongs to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb."

ekegusii: Bakamobamba, bagaatanana chianga chiaye, bagachiakera obomera eye kera omonto araire.
english: And they crucified him. Dividing up his clothes, they cast lots to see what each would get.

ekegusii: Naende bagakora buna totasemeretie; ritang’ani bakerua abanyene ase Omonene, erio asetore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae.
english: And they did not do as we expected, but they gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us in keeping with God's will.

ekegusii: Na abanto bagakora bo, bakarenda rituko riria rinene ri’Epasaka agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, ase omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, ase rituko ria ikomi na kane, chinsa chia mogoroba. Abaisraeli bagakora amang’ana onsi buna Omonene achigete Musa.
english: and they did so in the Desert of Sinai at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’ebiombe bi’abakuani nigo origetwe kobwatekana ne chiamate chiabo; na aba b’Abalawi barenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania bakarikwa kobwatekana nemeremo ase ebiombe biabo.
english: And they distributed to the priests enrolled by their families in the genealogical records and likewise to the Levites twenty years old or more, according to their responsibilities and their divisions.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibanyara komoiraneria ase amang’ana aria.
english: And they had nothing to say.

ekegusii: Boigo bakabeka abakuani ase ebiombe biabo, na Abalawi ase emeremo yabo, ase okomokorera Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu, koreng’ana buna erikire ase ebuku ya Musa.
english: And they installed the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their groups for the service of God at Jerusalem, according to what is written in the Book of Moses.

ekegusii: Omonto oria agasiekerwa aase gete akarendwa, ekiagera konya teramanyekana boronge egento agwenerete akorerwe.
english: and they kept him in custody, because it was not clear what should be done to him.

ekegusii: na barabwo tibamanya goika etoigo egacha, egasiria bonsi; naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto korache koba.
english: and they knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

ekegusii: Naende bagakora chindege chie chitahabu chichenire, bagachibeka gati y’emegwekano ye rikomomanga chietanane omoringero o inse ase eganchwa.
english: And they made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates.

ekegusii: Bakabaacha chisiiro isano amo nebigobanio biabo, bakaooma ebisure ne chinuga chiabo netahabu. Chinterekerero chiabo isano nigo chiakorire korwa ase chitaai.
english: and they made five posts with hooks for them. They overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold and made their five bases of bronze.

ekegusii: Agakora ebikorero biare kobekwa ase emesa igoro: chinteru na ebitaabo ase ubani, ne chisani, korwa ase ebio bagocha koumora ebinyugwa ebikoruegwa; akabiroisia bionsi korwa ase chitahabu chichenire.
english: And they made from pure gold the articles for the table-- its plates and dishes and bowls and its pitchers for the pouring out of drink offerings.

ekegusii: bagakora ekina barabwo ase barabwo, banyare komobwata Yeso nobong’ainereria, na komoita.
english: and they plotted to arrest Jesus in some sly way and kill him.

ekegusii: Bagatogia Nyasae ase engencho yane.
english: And they praised God because of me.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakang’usa Yeremia ne chingori chiria korwa ase engoro eria, bakamorusiao. Na Yeremia akagenderera kobeera ase egoora y’abarendi.
english: and they pulled him up with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern. And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.

ekegusii: Chibarasi chigatebia omomalaika bw’Omonene, oria oteneine ase egati y’emehadasi eria, “Twaetananire ase ense yonsi, twarorire ng’a ense yonsi nigo etoererete ekirete‐kiri.”
english: And they reported to the angel of the LORD, who was standing among the myrtle trees, "We have gone throughout the earth and found the whole world at rest and in peace."

ekegusii: And they said many other insulting things to him.
english: Bakamokwana bobe amang’ana ande amange ay’okomorama.

ekegusii: And they said to each other, "We should choose a leader and go back to Egypt."
english: Barabwo bagatebania, “Tochore omonto oyomo abe omoraai oito, toirane Misiri.”

ekegusii: bakabatebia, “Omonene abarigererie na konacha ekina, ekiagera mwatokorire koba rimisu riibe ase Farao na ase abasomba baye. Mwababekeire emioro maboko abo batoite.”
english: and they said, "May the LORD look upon you and judge you! You have made us a stench to Pharaoh and his officials and have put a sword in their hand to kill us."

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baare gotera ogotera okoyia bosio bw’ekerogo ki’obonene, na ase obosio bwe ching’iti chiria inye chire moyo, na ase obosio bw’abagaaka baria. Omonto onde tare ore konyara kwegera ogotera koria otatiga baria chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ene na inye (144,000) ababooretigwe korwa ase ense.
english: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baare gotera ogotera okoyia, bagoteba, “Kwagweneire aye kobogoria ebuku na gosansora ebimanyererio biaye, ekiagera aye nkwanyenyetwe, na ase amanyinga ao okamogorera Nyasae abanto ba kera eamate, na omonwa, na abanto, na egesaku,
english: And they sang a new song: "You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because you were slain, and with your blood you purchased men for God from every tribe and language and people and nation.

ekegusii: Erio bakwane amang’ana aya ase okoenekia oborori bwabo: Amaboko aito tari aro aitera amanyinga aya, gose amaiso aito taroche ayio kagokorwa.
english: and they shall declare: "Our hands did not shed this blood, nor did our eyes see it done.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bagosoa ase omokungu oyio buna abasacha bagosoa ase omokungu omotayayi. Ase igo abasacha abwo bagasoa ase Ohola na Oholiba bagakora obonyaka.
english: And they slept with her. As men sleep with a prostitute, so they slept with those lewd women, Oholah and Oholibah.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakarentera Abaisraeli amang’ana amabe igoro y’ense eria bagendete koroota, bagateba, “Ense eria twataara ime yaye koyeroota, nigo ere ense egoita abanto bamenyeteo. Abanto bonsi twarora nabatambe mono.
english: And they spread among the Israelites a bad report about the land they had explored. They said, "The land we explored devours those living in it. All the people we saw there are of great size.

ekegusii: bakaba botambe ime ase Hekalu, bakomotogia Nyasae.
english: And they stayed continually at the temple, praising God.

ekegusii: Bakaba agwo amatuko atai make amo naborokigwa.
english: And they stayed there a long time with the disciples.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebigwa, “Nathani omobani, oyo aiga.” Na ekero achete ase obosio bw’omoruoti, agatung’ama inse akaumama.
english: And they told the king, "Nathan the prophet is here." So he went before the king and bowed with his face to the ground.

ekegusii: bakamobwata, bakamoruta engoro ime. Engoro eyio nigo yarenge bosa, mache tarengeo.
english: and they took him and threw him into the cistern. Now the cistern was empty; there was no water in it.

ekegusii: Bakagechigwa asare. Korende Yeso akabatebia, “Omobani takomocha gosikwa otatiga ase ense yaye na mwaye.”
english: And they took offense at him. But Jesus said to them, "Only in his hometown and in his own house is a prophet without honor."

ekegusii: bagachiira ase okogora oboremo bw’omokori chinyongo, buna Omonene anchigete.”
english: and they used them to buy the potter's field, as the Lord commanded me."

ekegusii: Bakagenda, bakabeera ase enyomba y’abageni agwo Kimuhamu, ang’e na Bethlehemu, na korwa aroro mbaganetie kogenda ase ense ya Misiri
english: And they went on, stopping at Geruth Kimham near Bethlehem on their way to Egypt

ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto tachete gosiria obogima bw’abana ba mwanyabanto, korende kobotooria.”] Bakagenda ase agachie kande.
english: and they went to another village.

ekegusii: Ase ayio barabwo bakang’anya gochia ase omochie o Gedori, ensemo ya moocha ye rikura, korigia oborisia ase chitugo chiabo.
english: and they went to the outskirts of Gedor to the east of the valley in search of pasture for their flocks.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagakumia ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Korende ekero bonsi babete nogokumia ase amang’ana onsi akorete, agatebia aborokigwa baye,
english: And they were all amazed at the greatness of God. While everyone was marveling at all that Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

ekegusii: Bakarangerania, bagateba, “Omochenu, Omochenu, Omochenu, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda; obonene bwaye bwaichoire ase ense engima.”
english: And they were calling to one another: "Holy, holy, holy is the LORD Almighty; the whole earth is full of his glory."

ekegusii: Abwo mbarusie abanto bamino korwa ase ebisaku bionsi, erio babarente asende inche Omonene buna bakorenta okoruegwa kw’endagera. Nigo barabariinie chibarasi, ne chigari, na ebirogo bi’okobabogoreria, ne chiyombo, ne chingamia, mbabarente Yerusalemu, ase egetunwa kiane egechenu. Nigo barabarente buna Abaisraeli bakorenta okoruegwa kw’endagera kore ime ase ebikorero ebichenu, bakorenta ase enyomba yane.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: And they will bring all your brothers, from all the nations, to my holy mountain in Jerusalem as an offering to the LORD-- on horses, in chariots and wagons, and on mules and camels," says the LORD. "They will bring them, as the Israelites bring their grain offerings, to the temple of the LORD in ceremonially clean vessels.

ekegusii: Ekero emebere y’abanto baitirwe erabe eraire ase egati y’emegwekano yabo bagosasima eetanaine ebisasimero biabo igoro y’ebigoro bionsi, na igoro y’ebichuria bi’ebitunwa bionsi, na inse y’emete yonsi emebese, na inse ya kera omote onga buna omotontera, agwo aase aande onsi ase baruerete ebinto bigosokia rimisu rigiya ase emegwekano yabo bagosasima, erio nario baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: And they will know that I am the LORD, when their people lie slain among their idols around their altars, on every high hill and on all the mountaintops, under every spreading tree and every leafy oak-- places where they offered fragrant incense to all their idols.

ekegusii: Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Amang’ana nakwanete ng’a nimbarentere amabe ayio tarenge amang’ana a bosa.”
english: And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not threaten in vain to bring this calamity on them.

ekegusii: barabwo mbatebie abanto b’ense eye amang’ana ayio. Barabwo konya baigure ng’a aye Omonene nigo ore ase egati y’Abaisraeli, kwarorekanire asebare obosio ase obosio, ne riire riao nigo riteneine asebare, naende naye okobatang’ana, omobaso ase riire rire buna esiiro, na obotuko ase omorero ore buna esiiro.
english: And they will tell the inhabitants of this land about it. ekegusii: motengere mono ekero abaiseke ba Silo bagosoka gochia gotenga, erio moimoke korwa ase emegondo y’emesabibu, na kera omonto akurure omoiseke oyomo bw’abaiseke baria ba Silo, amoire ase orogongo rwa Benjamin abe mokaye.
english: and watch. When the girls of Shiloh come out to join in the dancing, then rush from the vineyards and each of you seize a wife from the girls of Shiloh and go to the land of Benjamin.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo togoakera Nyasae, ng’a mbuya mono, totari gotiga, ng’a ekero mwanyorete ring’ana ria Nyasae, eri mwaigwete korwa asetore, nigo mwarianchete, tari buna ring’ana ria mwanyabanto, korende buna rire ekeene ekeene, ring’ana ria Nyasae, erigokora emeremo ime yaino, inwe abamwegenire.
english: And we also thank God continually because, when you received the word of God, which you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it actually is, the word of God, which is at work in you who believe.

ekegusii: Intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one: Ee, ntokare na tata, ere ogotire, nakabwate omwana omomura bw’obogotu bwaye, korende momura omwabo nakwete, oyo nere otigarete bweka ase ng’ina, na ise nigo amwanchete mono.
english: And we answered, 'We have an aged father, and there is a young son born to him in his old age. His brother is dead, and he is the only one of his mother's sons left, and his father loves him.'

ekegusii: Amo nere twatomire oyominto oria omanyekanete ase chikanisa chionsi ase okorandia kwaye kw’amang’ana amaya.
english: And we are sending along with him the brother who is praised by all the churches for his service to the gospel.

ekegusii: Na intwe twarorire, naende twabeire birori ng’a Ise otomire Omwana oye koba Omotooria bw’ense.
english: And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

ekegusii: Intwe ntore ne ring’ana riria ri’obobani riteneine bokong’u kobua, na inwe inamokore buya komorategerere na koribwata buna etaya ekomoreka aase omosunte ore, goika ekero bogokia, na eng’enang’eni ya mambia eoroke ase chinkoro chiaino ime.
english: And we have the word of the prophets made more certain, and you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a light shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

ekegusii: Na twamanyire ng’a Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana onsi amo na baria bamwanchete, erio abanyorere amaya, baria barangerigwe ase omoroberio oye.
english: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

ekegusii: Mogenderere buna ebagwenerete ase Omonene, momogwenere kegima, mwame okwama okuya ase emeremo emiya, momenteke ase okomomanya Nyasae.
english: And we pray this in order that you may live a life worthy of the Lord and may please him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,

ekegusii: Na intwe togakoiraneria aye, omonene one, ng’a omosae oyo takonyara gotiga ise; aise komotiga, ise nigo arakwe.
english: And we said to my lord, 'The boy cannot leave his father; if he leaves him, his father will die.'

ekegusii: Twabasoroire, baminto, mokurere abwo bare aboro, moremie abwo berusirie moyo, mokonye abwo bare abareu, remereria nabanto bonsi.
english: And we urge you, brothers, warn those who are idle, encourage the timid, help the weak, be patient with everyone.

ekegusii: gatorabe ang’e korua egesusuro ase ogotaigwera gwonsi, ekero okoigwera kwaino gwaikeranire.
english: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience, once your obedience is complete.

ekegusii: Erio intwe natoteme emete ende yonsi oganetie korwa Lebanoni na toyetome gocha asore eboire amo, erentwe asore nenyancha, ebe echeng’enenete goika Yopa, na korwa aroro oyioyie oyeire Yerusalemu aye omonyene.”
english: and we will cut all the logs from Lebanon that you need and will float them in rafts by sea down to Joppa. You can then take them up to Jerusalem."

ekegusii: Korende intwe twensi abatokorigereria obonene bw’Omonene namaiso atatubiri, nigo tokorora buna ase ekerore obonene obwo. Nigo tokoonchorwa koba buna omogwekano oye, na kogenda korwa ase obonene goika ase obonene. Aya nigo agokorwa n’Omonene oyore Omoika.
english: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the Lord's glory, are being transformed into his likeness with ever-increasing glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

ekegusii: bakamochiera, bakabora, “Masoge, Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi!” Bakamoaka chindoe.
english: and went up to him again and again, saying, "Hail, king of the Jews!" And they struck him in the face.

ekegusii: Abanto anarete koboria botambe nabwo aba: Karisena na Setari, Adimata na Tarisisi, Meresi na Marisena, na Memukani. Aba batano na babere nigo barenge abagambi korwa ase ense y’Ayemi, na eya Media, naende nabwo barenge abanene ase obogambi bwaye.
english: and were closest to the king-- Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena and Memucan, the seven nobles of Persia and Media who had special access to the king and were highest in the kingdom.

ekegusii: Aya igo abete agwo moocha ya Yorodan ase rikura riarenge ensemo ekororia Beti‐Peori, ase orogongo rwa Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, oyio omenyete agwo Hesiboni. Nere oria Musa na Abaisraeli babuete ekero barwete Misiri,
english: and were in the valley near Beth Peor east of the Jordan, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon and was defeated by Moses and the Israelites as they came out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Moinyorete buna akorete Datani na Abiiramu, abana b’Eliabu, ab’ororeria rwa Reuben. Ase amasio ’Abaisraeli bonsi riroba rikabwereka, rikabamera, amo ne chiamate chiabo, ne chiema, ne chitugo, na abwo bonsi bababwatetie.
english: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab the Reubenite, when the earth opened its mouth right in the middle of all Israel and swallowed them up with their households, their tents and every living thing that belonged to them.

ekegusii: Naende inki ndakwane? Naki engaki tekong’isana gokwana igoro ya Gidioni, na Baraki, na Samson, na Yefita, na Daudi, na Samweli, na ababani.
english: And what more shall I say? I do not have time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel and the prophets,

ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki ekenene babwate amachiko amaronge na emeroberio emeronge, buna amachiko aya onsi inche naborokereirie rero?
english: And what other nation is so great as to have such righteous decrees and laws as this body of laws I am setting before you today?

ekegusii: Korende okoiraneria kwa Nyasae naki gokomotebia? “Ninde nabanto chilifu isano na ibere batabegete amaru inse ase Baali.”
english: And what was God's answer to him? "I have reserved for myself seven thousand who have not bowed the knee to Baal."

ekegusii: Kerabe omokuani onde oorokire oyore koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki amang’ana ayio nigo are maiso marore mono kobua.
english: And what we have said is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,

ekegusii: Na kera eki mogokora, ase amang’ana gose ase ogokora, mokore kera egento ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso, mokomoakera Nyasae Tata ng’a mbuya mono goetera asare.
english: And whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

ekegusii: omonto onde bwensi, gose abanto bao bonsi Abaisraeli kobaragosabe ase oboitongo, kera oyomo omanyete emechando ere ase enkoro yaye, na oboroso bwaye, na arambore amaboko aye gochia ase enyomba eye;
english: and when a prayer or plea is made by any of your people Israel-- each one aware of his afflictions and pains, and spreading out his hands toward this temple--

ekegusii: oigwe ogosaba kwabo. Omonto onde bwensi, gose abanto bao bonsi Abaisraeli kobaragosabe na gokoboria ase oboitongo, kera oyomo omanyete emechando ere ase enkoro yaye, naende barambore amaboko abo gochia ase enyomba eye,
english: and when a prayer or plea is made by any of your people Israel-- each one aware of the afflictions of his own heart, and spreading out his hands toward this temple--

ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae andusetie korwa ase omochie o tata kogenda gochia aaria na aaria ngatebia mokane: Aya naro amaya orankorere: kera aase toragende otebe igoro yane ng’a inche momura omino.”
english: And when God had me wander from my father's household, I said to her, 'This is how you can show your love to me: Everywhere we go, say of me, "He is my brother." '"

ekegusii: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders
english: Nabo kayenyorire ayebeka amareko aye nomogoko.

ekegusii: na ekero amonyorete akamorenta Antiokia. Ase engaki y’omwaka omogima bagasangererekana amo nekanisa na kworokereria abanto abange. Agwo Antiokia nao aborokigwa batang’anete korokwa Abakristo.
english: and when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. So for a whole year Barnabas and Saul met with the church and taught great numbers of people. The disciples were called Christians first at Antioch.

ekegusii: gakoorire koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, akayosamunyora, akabora, “Oyo noro omobere one orurwe ase engencho yaino; kora iga ase okong’inyora inche.”
english: and when he had given thanks, he broke it and said, "This is my body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of me."

ekegusii: Goika agachia kobogoria ebuku eria, ching’iti chiria inye chire moyo chigatung’ama amo nabagaaka baria emerongo ebere na bane ase obosio bw’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi. Kera oyomo obo narenge nobokano na ebitaabo bie chitahabu biichire ubani nero nogosaba kw’abachenu.
english: And when he had taken it, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp and they were holding golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

ekegusii: Ekero asabete igo, Nyasae aganchera ogosorora kwaye, akaigwa okoboria kwaye kw’oboitongo, na akamoirania Yerusalemu naende ase oboruoti bwaye. Erio Manase akamanya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae.
english: And when he prayed to him, the LORD was moved by his entreaty and listened to his plea; so he brought him back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD is God.

ekegusii: Inche ekero narenge amo nainwe ekero naremeretwe, timoraarereti monto onde, ekiagera abaminto bagachia gocha korwa Makedonia bagankonya ase okoremerwa kwane. Ase amang’ana onsi nkerenda inche omonyene timbaraarereria nonya ng’ake, naende ningenderere gokora bo.
english: And when I was with you and needed something, I was not a burden to anyone, for the brothers who came from Macedonia supplied what I needed. I have kept myself from being a burden to you in any way, and will continue to do so.

ekegusii: Yeso akarera naende neriogi rinene, erio agatweka mo.
english: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.

ekegusii: Ekero amabe amange na emechando birabe bikobachera, ogotera oko nakoborokererie na kobe kirori asebare, ekiagera tigokwebwa nonya nase chinderia chiabo. Nimanyete ebirengererio bare nabio bono, ritang’ani konya ntarabarenta ase ense eyio nariete eira ng’a nimbayee.”
english: And when many disasters and difficulties come upon them, this song will testify against them, because it will not be forgotten by their descendants. I know what they are disposed to do, even before I bring them into the land I promised them on oath."

ekegusii: Ekero abarenge abagambi inse ya Farao bachia korora omokungu oria, bakamotogia ase obosio bwa Farao. Na omokungu oria akairwa komenya mwa Farao.
english: And when Pharaoh's officials saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.

ekegusii: And when she finds it, she calls her friends and neighbors together and says, 'Rejoice with me; I have found my lost coin.'
english: Kayenyorire, narangerie abasani baye na abagisangio baye, abatebie: Goka amo nainche, ekiagera nanyorire esiringi eria nasiria.

ekegusii: Ekero amanyinga a Stefano, kirori oo, agoiterwa, inche nao narenge nateneine ang’e, ngancha aitwe, nkarenda chianga chiabo baria abamoitete.
english: And when the blood of your martyr Stephen was shed, I stood there giving my approval and guarding the clothes of those who were killing him.'

ekegusii: Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana ateneine amorigereretie, agachia korora ng’a otwekire mo, akabora, “Ekeene, omonto oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae.”
english: And when the centurion, who stood there in front of Jesus, heard his cry and saw how he died, he said, "Surely this man was the Son of God!"

ekegusii: Na Omorisia omonene karaoroke namonyore egutwa y’obonene etari gosareka.
english: And when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that will never fade away.

ekegusii: Ekero ekerecha giachia goserigwa, omonto oria rimama agakwana. Emeganda egakumia, ekabora, “Tana kororekana nonya ng’ake ase Abaisraeli amang’ana anga buna aya.”
english: And when the demon was driven out, the man who had been mute spoke. The crowd was amazed and said, "Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel."

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande bakaigwa amang’ana aya agokwanwa, “Naama! Abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase baagachire egesasimero aria Geliloti, ensemo ya bosio bw’ense ya Kanani, ang’e na Yorodan, erochie ensemo y’Abaisraeli.”
english: And when the Israelites heard that they had built the altar on the border of Canaan at Geliloth near the Jordan on the Israelite side,

ekegusii: Na ekero Abaisraeli baroche buna Omonene aorokirie okobua kwaye okonene igoro y’Abamisiri, bakamoiroka Omonene, bakamwegena Omonene na Musa, omosomba oye.
english: And when the Israelites saw the great power the LORD displayed against the Egyptians, the people feared the LORD and put their trust in him and in Moses his servant.

ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene abatomete korwa Kadeshi‐Barinea akabatebia: Genda moire ense eria nabaeire, korende inwe mogasaria timwaigwera ogochika kw’Omonene, Nyasae oino; timwamwegenete gose koigwera eriogi riaye.
english: And when the LORD sent you out from Kadesh Barnea, he said, "Go up and take possession of the land I have given you." But you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God. You did not trust him or obey him.

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabeke abanto abwo ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobabue, goika mobaite na kobasiria kegima, timobaisa gokora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, gose kobarorera amabera.
english: and when the LORD your God has delivered them over to you and you have defeated them, then you must destroy them totally. Make no treaty with them, and show them no mercy.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria aimogete naende ng’a agende, ise omosubati oria akamosorora arare agwo naende.
english: And when the man got up to go, his father-in-law persuaded him, so he stayed there that night.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’orogongo roria bachia komomanya, bagatoma abanto bagende chinsemo chionsi, bamorentere bonsi abarenge abarwaire;
english: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding country. People brought all their sick to him

ekegusii: Abanto baino kobarakoborie: Nase ki Omonene, Nyasae oito, atokoreire amang’ana aya onsi? Aye oiranerie ng’a inche natebire: Koreng’ana buna mwaonchokire mwantigire, naende mwasasimire chinyasae ching’ao aiga ase ense yaino, naboigo mogochia koba abasomba b’abanto abaao ase ense etari eyaino.”
english: And when the people ask, 'Why has the LORD our God done all this to us?' you will tell them, 'As you have forsaken me and served foreign gods in your own land, so now you will serve foreigners in a land not your own.'

ekegusii: Obotuki bogakorwa, na amang’ana akanyorekana ng’a namaene arenge; abanto baria babere bakabwatwa, bagatongwa ase chimbambo igoro. Amang’ana ayio akarikerwa ase obosio bw’omoruoti ase Ebuku y’amang’ana arenge gokoreka.
english: And when the report was investigated and found to be true, the two officials were hanged on a gallows. All this was recorded in the book of the annals in the presence of the king.

ekegusii: Ekero chinkoba echio isano na ibere chiare goaka eriogi nkaba ang’e korika. Erio nkaigwa eriogi rikorwa igoro rigoteba, “Mumeka amang’ana ayio atebwa ne chinkoba chiria isano na ibere, oyabeke ekemanyerio, toyarika.”
english: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from heaven say, "Seal up what the seven thunders have said and do not write it down."

ekegusii: Naende ekero mokorora embeo ekorwa irianyi mwabora. Nebe eguru‐gura; yaba bo.
english: And when the south wind blows, you say, 'It's going to be hot,' and it is.

ekegusii: Na omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto nigo orenge isiko gosaba ekero ki’ogosamba ubani.
english: And when the time for the burning of incense came, all the assembled worshipers were praying outside.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli baroche ng’a Haroni okure bakamoreera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato.
english: and when the whole community learned that Aaron had died, the entire house of Israel mourned for him thirty days.

ekegusii: Ekero barakoborie: Nase ki oichanete iga? Obairanerie, obatebie: Nase engencho y’amang’ana amabe agochi gocha. Ekero arache, kera omonto nairianyeke ase enkoro yaye, na amaboko ’abanto bonsi naborwe chinguru; kera omonto nakwe omoyo, na amaru ’abanto bonsi nororobe abe buna amache. Naama! Amabe ayio ngocha are, goika aikeranigwe. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: And when they ask you, 'Why are you groaning?' you shall say, 'Because of the news that is coming. Every heart will melt and every hand go limp; every spirit will become faint and every knee become as weak as water.' It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Ekero bachia koriina obwato ime, omwaga ogakira.
english: And when they climbed into the boat, the wind died down.

ekegusii: bakamonyora, bakamotebia, “Abanto bonsi ngokorigia bare.”
english: and when they found him, they exclaimed: "Everyone is looking for you!"

ekegusii: Kobamochecheirie, bakamorusia eanga eria emonyinga, bakamoboyia chianga chiaye omonyene. Bakamoira isiko komobamba.
english: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.

ekegusii: Na nyuma kobarandirie ring’ana ase Perga, bagatirimboka gochia Atalia,
english: and when they had preached the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

ekegusii: Korende ekero bayerengete ase ebirengo, oyosangereretie enyinge tatigaria kende, na ere oyosangereretie enke taremeretwe gento. Kera oyomo konya osangereirie buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana.
english: And when they measured it by the omer, he who gathered much did not have too much, and he who gathered little did not have too little. Each one gathered as much as he needed.

ekegusii: Inwe amo nabana baino komoramoiranere Omonene, Nyasae oino, na koigwera amang’ana aye ase chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na ase emioyo yaino yonsi, amang’ana ayio nabachikire rituko ria rero,
english: and when you and your children return to the LORD your God and obey him with all your heart and with all your soul according to everything I command you today,

ekegusii: Timobaisa konyuomeria abamura baino abaiseke b’abanto abwo, ekiagera abaiseke abwo, ekero baragende gokora obotomani ase ogosasima chinyasae chiabo mbabaise kogera abamura baino basasime chinyasae chiabo.
english: And when you choose some of their daughters as wives for your sons and those daughters prostitute themselves to their gods, they will lead your sons to do the same.

ekegusii: na komwaikire aroro ng’umbu, motenenie amagena aria ase egetunwa ki’Ebali, buna nabachikire rituko ria rero, erio moyaoomeranie.
english: And when you have crossed the Jordan, set up these stones on Mount Ebal, as I command you today, and coat them with plaster.

ekegusii: Ekero okorigereria gochia igoro, gokorora ebinto bitongire bireo buna erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, omoganda oyio bwonsi, tobaisa gotiga Omonene, erinde osasime na gokorera ebinto ebio, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oo, obirure ase ebisaku bionsi bire inse y’erioba.
english: And when you look up to the sky and see the sun, the moon and the stars-- all the heavenly array-- do not be enticed into bowing down to them and worshiping things the LORD your God has apportioned to all the nations under heaven.

ekegusii: “Ase ogosaba kwaino timogotererera amang’ana a bosa buna abanto b’Ebisaku; naki barabwo nigo bagokaga ng’a nabaigugwe ase obonge bw’amang’ana abo.
english: And when you pray, do not keep on babbling like pagans, for they think they will be heard because of their many words.

ekegusii: Ekero oramoe ribaga arue asore, tobaisa komotiga agende ore namaboko amasa.
english: And when you release him, do not send him away empty-handed.

ekegusii: Na inwe, ekero mogotenena na gosaba, onye more ne ring’ana ase omonto, mwabere, erinde na Iso oino ore igoro abaabere nainwe amamocho aino. [
english: And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive him, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins."

ekegusii: Na ekero mokoria na konywa, Inee, timori gokora ayio ase ogweisanekia inwe abanyene?
english: And when you were eating and drinking, were you not just feasting for yourselves?

ekegusii: Na agwo ekero abana baino barache kobaboria: Engencho y’amang’ana aya ninki?
english: And when your children ask you, 'What does this ceremony mean to you?'

ekegusii: na ekero amaicho aino e chiombe na aye ching’ondi arabe amentekanire, ne chifeta, ne chitahabu chiaino boigo, na ebinto binde bionsi mobwate biramentekane,
english: and when your herds and flocks grow large and your silver and gold increase and all you have is multiplied,

ekegusii: Nigo barenge gokonya ekero kende gionsi ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa biarenge koruegwa ase Omonene, ase Chisabato na ase Emetienyi Emeyia, na ase Amatuko Amanene ande. Nigo baroberetigwe gokora emeremo eyio koreng’ana nomobaro oganeirie, bakagenderera koyekora botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: and whenever burnt offerings were presented to the LORD on Sabbaths and at New Moon festivals and at appointed feasts. They were to serve before the LORD regularly in the proper number and in the way prescribed for them.

ekegusii: Engaki ende yonsi Musa arenge kogenda ase Eema eria, abanto bonsi nigo baare koimoka na gotenena, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye, na korigereria Musa goika osoire Eema eria ime.
english: And whenever Moses went out to the tent, all the people rose and stood at the entrances to their tents, watching Moses until he entered the tent.

ekegusii: agwo nao aase Aburamu aagachete egesasimero kie ritang’ani na korirangeria erieta ri’Omonene.
english: and where he had first built an altar. There Abram called on the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: Gaki, okorusigwa kw’ebibe gokorabeo, rirorio ekerugwa ase engencho y’ebibe tigekobao naende.
english: And where these have been forgiven, there is no longer any sacrifice for sin.

ekegusii: Kera aase are kogenda ase ebichie, gose emechie, gose emegondo, bakabeka abarwaire ase chichiiro, bakamosorora ng’a abae ribaga bakune nonya nomokoba bw’eanga yaye; na abwo bonsi abamokunete bakagwena.
english: And wherever he went-- into villages, towns or countryside-- they placed the sick in the marketplaces. They begged him to let them touch even the edge of his cloak, and all who touched him were healed.

ekegusii: Korende aase aande onsi bagendete ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebio, nigo bakorete erieta riane richenu rikaba eritachenegeti, na abanto bagakwana igoro yabo, bagateba: Aba nabwo abanto b’Omonene, nonya naboigo baserigwe korwa ase ense eyio yaye.
english: And wherever they went among the nations they profaned my holy name, for it was said of them, 'These are the LORD's people, and yet they had to leave his land.'

ekegusii: Naende timoria amanyinga e chinyoni, gose aye ching’iti aande onsi ase moramenye.
english: And wherever you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal.

ekegusii: Kobaraigwe, gose baange koigwa (ekiagera barabwo negesaku getari koigwera), mbamanye ng’a omobani obeire ase egati yabo.
english: And whether they listen or fail to listen-- for they are a rebellious house-- they will know that a prophet has been among them.

ekegusii: Ekero bataregena ase engencho y’omogoko, na ogokumia, akababoria, “More na gento mokoria aa?”
english: And while they still did not believe it because of joy and amazement, he asked them, "Do you have anything here to eat?"

ekegusii: And while they were eating, he said, "I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me."
english: Kobaikaransire koragera, akabora, “Nekeene nabatebirie: oyomo oino nandue.”

english: and who gives food to every creature. His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Ere Omonene oorokirie asende obwanchani bwaye botari koera ase obosio bw’omoruoti, na ase abasemia baye, na abanene bonsi bare gokonya omoruoti bare nokobua. Inche nkaba noboremu, ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene, Nyasae one, kwarenge amo nainche, na igo ngasangereria abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli batiire amo nainche.
english: and who has extended his good favor to me before the king and his advisers and all the king's powerful officials. Because the hand of the LORD my God was on me, I took courage and gathered leading men from Israel to go up with me.

ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki bare ase ense bare buna Abaisraeli bao, abwo aye Nyasae kwabooretie babe abanto bao, na igo gwakorire erieta riao rimanyekane. Ogakorera abanto bao abwo kwebooreretie korwa Misiri amang’ana amanene, na ay’ogokumia, ekiagera nigo gwaseretie korwa asebare abanto b’ebisaku amo ne chinyasae chiabo.
english: And who is like your people Israel-- the one nation on earth that God went out to redeem as a people for himself, and to make a name for himself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations and their gods from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?

ekegusii: Naende mbanto ba gesaku ki bare ase ense, bare buna abanto bao Abaisraeli, abwo aye Nyasae kwabooretie babe abanto bao, okenyorera erieta ase engencho y’amang’ana amanene na ay’ogokumia ase ogoseria abanto b’ebisaku bakarua ase obosio bw’abanto bao baria kwabooretie korwa Misiri?
english: And who is like your people Israel-- the one nation on earth whose God went out to redeem a people for himself, and to make a name for yourself, and to perform great and awesome wonders by driving out nations from before your people, whom you redeemed from Egypt?

ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete gose omonto oyio nigo arabe omong’aini, gose nigo arabe omoriri? Korende oyio goika aire ebinto ebio bionsi nechandeire inde nobong’aini kobinyora inse y’erioba. Ayio boigo mbosa.
english: And who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have control over all the work into which I have poured my effort and skill under the sun. This too is meaningless.

ekegusii: omokoreri bw’aase aachenu na obw’Eema y’ekeene, eye Omonene aagachete, gose tari mwanyabanto.
english: and who serves in the sanctuary, the true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.

ekegusii: naende ase okobokigwa korwa ase abakure na ase chinguru chi’Omoika bw’Obochenu akaorokigwa koba Omwana o Nyasae.
english: and who through the Spirit of holiness was declared with power to be the Son of God by his resurrection from the dead: Jesus Christ our Lord.

english: Na onde bwensi ore moyo na onyegenire, tagokwa nonya ng’ake. Inee! Kwegenire aya?”

english: and whoever touches any of the things that were under him will be unclean till evening; whoever picks up those things must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

english: and will give our attention to prayer and the ministry of the word."

english: and will go out to deceive the nations in the four corners of the earth-- Gog and Magog-- to gather them for battle. In number they are like the sand on the seashore.

english: and will have these measurements: the north side 4,500 cubits, the south side 4,500 cubits, the east side 4,500 cubits, and the west side 4,500 cubits.

ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae takobanyorera oboronge abachore baye, abakomorera omobaso na obotuko? Na ere takoba omoremereria asebare?
english: And will not God bring about justice for his chosen ones, who cry out to him day and night? Will he keep putting them off?

ekegusii: ribaga ri’ogotegerera emegano y’Abayahudi, gose amachiko ’abanto aba bakoonchorana ekeene.
english: and will pay no attention to Jewish myths or to the commands of those who reject the truth.

english: and will turn him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!"

english: and with each lamb, a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil. This is for a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

english: and with every living creature that was with you-- the birds, the livestock and all the wild animals, all those that came out of the ark with you-- every living creature on earth.

english: and with his right forefinger sprinkle some of the oil from his palm seven times before the LORD.

english: And with many other words John exhorted the people and preached the good news to them.

english: And with that he breathed on them and said, "Receive the Holy Spirit.

english: and with them their brothers next in rank: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.

ekegusii: Naende mbarabi abwo are agechetigwe nabarabwo ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene? Tari baria bakorete ebibe, abwo emebere yabo yagwete ase erooro?
english: And with whom was he angry for forty years? Was it not with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the desert?

ekegusii: na gosiberwa amagoro aino engencho y’okoba ang’e eyio twanyorire ase enchili y’omorembe.
english: and with your feet fitted with the readiness that comes from the gospel of peace.

english: And without doubt the lesser person is blessed by the greater.

english: And without faith it is impossible to please God, because anyone who comes to him must believe that he exists and that he rewards those who earnestly seek him.

english: And you and the Levites and the aliens among you shall rejoice in all the good things the LORD your God has given to you and your household.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo more abana b’ababani na ab’okobwatana koria Nyasae abwatanete ne chisokoro chiaino, ekero atebetie Ibrahimu: Ase oroiboro rwao ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe.
english: And you are heirs of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers. He said to Abraham, 'Through your offspring all peoples on earth will be blessed.'

english: na inwe naba Kristo, na Kristo noyo o Nyasae.

english: And you are proud! Shouldn't you rather have been filled with grief and have put out of your fellowship the man who did this?

english: and you present to the LORD offerings made by fire, from the herd or the flock, as an aroma pleasing to the LORD-- whether burnt offerings or sacrifices, for special vows or freewill offerings or festival offerings--

english: And you said, "The LORD our God has shown us his glory and his majesty, and we have heard his voice from the fire. Today we have seen that a man can live even if God speaks with him.

english: And you say, 'If we had lived in the days of our forefathers, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.'

english: And you say, 'What a burden!' and you sniff at it contemptuously," says the LORD Almighty. "When you bring injured, crippled or diseased animals and offer them as sacrifices, should I accept them from your hands?" says the LORD.

english: And you see and hear how this fellow Paul has convinced and led astray large numbers of people here in Ephesus and in practically the whole province of Asia. He says that man-made gods are no gods at all.

english: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to the skies? No, you will go down to the depths. If the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.

ekegusii: na omonwa oo obe buna edivai ere engiya mono. Ee, edivai eyio nigo egetirimboka gochia ime y’omwanchi one, naende yanyororoka ng’ora ng’ora, yakuna ebikoba bi’abwo baraire.
english: and your mouth like the best wine. May the wine go straight to my lover, flowing gently over lips and teeth.

ekegusii: Aya naro arabe ase abasubati bamino: Sodomu na abaiseke baye nabairanerigwe amaya abo, babe buna barenge ritang’ani, na Samaria na abaiseke baye mbairanerigwe amaya abo, babe buna barenge ritang’ani. Naye boigo na abaiseke bao moiranerigwe amaya aino, mobe buna mwarenge ritang’ani.
english: And your sisters, Sodom with her daughters and Samaria with her daughters, will return to what they were before; and you and your daughters will return to what you were before.

ekegusii: Zadoki omokuani na Nathani omobani bamoakire amaguta agwo Gihoni, nere obeire omoruoti. Barabwo batiirire korwa agwo, bagochenga, goika omochie bwonsi obeire namariogi amanene ay’omochengo; nayio naro kwaigure.
english: and Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon. From there they have gone up cheering, and the city resounds with it. That's the noise you hear.

ekegusii: na Zadoki, omomura etuoni, amo nabanto bamwabo abatang’ani b’esegi emerongo ebere, na babere (22).
english: and Zadok, a brave young warrior, with 22 officers from his family;

ekegusii: and Ziza son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.
english: Sisa, mosinto o Sifi bw’Aloni, o Yedaya, o Simuri, o Semaya.

ekegusii: naende, “Rigena erio nigo riragoche abanto, naende nigo rire egetare gekobaiyeria inse.” Nigo bakwegocha ase ring’ana, ekiagera tibari koriigwera. Naki naro ayio barageretwe.
english: and, "A stone that causes men to stumble and a rock that makes them fall." They stumble because they disobey the message-- which is also what they were destined for.

ekegusii: Na, buna erikire, “Onye ekoba aakong’u omonyene oboronge gotooreka, oria otamoirogeti Nyasae na omonyene ebibe, naki rende kerabe asare?”
english: And, "If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?"

ekegusii: “Nabe aase aria barabwo batebetigwe: Inwe timori abanto baane, abwo babarije ababa ba Nyasae ore moyo.”
english: and, "It will happen that in the very place where it was said to them, 'You are not my people,' they will be called 'sons of the living God.'"

ekegusii: Igo akwerigereria, naende ogenda ase agochia, erio kegima bweba buna erora arenge.
english: and, after looking at himself, goes away and immediately forgets what he looks like.

ekegusii: Naende andetere inche Omonene ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ase engencho y’ebibe ebio akorire; arente eng’iti eaberi, eng’ondi gose embori, ebe ekeng’wanso ekio ki’ebibe, na omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe ebibe biaye.
english: and, as a penalty for the sin he has committed, he must bring to the LORD a female lamb or goat from the flock as a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin.

ekegusii: Naende rituko rinde ribora, “Nabamorigererie oyobabetete.”
english: and, as another scripture says, "They will look on the one they have pierced."

ekegusii: na gaikeranigwe akaba engencho y’ogotooreka gwa kare na kare ase abanto bonsi abamoigwerete,
english: and, once made perfect, he became the source of eternal salvation for all who obey him

ekegusii: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot
english: Anderea na Filipo, na Baritholomayo, na Matayo, na Tomas, na Yakobo bw’Alufayo, na Tadayo, na Simion, oyomo bw’Abazelote,

ekegusii: Anderea, momura omwabo Simion Petero, nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria babere baigwete Yohana, na gotunyana Yeso.
english: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.

ekegusii: Endamwamu nentindi, na ekeririanda nigo kegosiria, korende ning’o oranyare koremereria ribero?
english: Anger is cruel and fury overwhelming, but who can stand before jealousy?

ekegusii: amo na Anasi, omokuani omonene, na Kayafa, na Yohana, na Aleksanderi, na bonsi abarenge b’eamate y’omokuani omonene.
english: Annas the high priest was there, and so were Caiaphas, John, Alexander and the other men of the high priest's family.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, raria ase abanto, obatebie: Onde bwensi ore nobwoba na omoondoko, airane gochia nka na arue egetunwa kia Gileadi.” Abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, bakairana, bakagenda, na abanto chilifu ikomi bagatigara.
english: announce now to the people, 'Anyone who trembles with fear may turn back and leave Mount Gilead.'" So twenty-two thousand men left, while ten thousand remained.

ekegusii: Oake egetuba amaguta amo nenterekerero yaye, na kogiatanana.
english: Anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate them.

ekegusii: obaake amaguta buna oraake ise, na barabwo nababe abakuani baane. Ogoakwa kw’amaguta kwabo nkobanyorere obokuani boragenderere botambe ase ororeria rwabo, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
english: Anoint them just as you anointed their father, so they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will be to a priesthood that will continue for all generations to come."

ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde agasoka korwa ase Hekalu ya igoro, nere boigo narenge nomoyio okogesa.
english: Another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he too had a sharp sickle.

ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde agatenena bosio bw’egesasimero ore negetaabo gi’etahabu; ere akaegwa ubani enyinge, anyare koyebeka amo nogosaba kw’abachenu bonsi igoro ase egesasimero gi’etahabu kere bosio bw’ekerogo ki’obonene.
english: Another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.

ekegusii: Na oyonde ase aborokigwa baye akamotebia, “Omonene, ritang’ani ing’a ribaga ngende gotindeka tata.”
english: Another disciple said to him, "Lord, first let me go and bury my father."

ekegusii: Another man dies in bitterness of soul, never having enjoyed anything good.
english: Omonto onde igo agokwa ore nobororo bw’omoyo oye, atana konyora amaya nonya ng’ake.

ekegusii: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, spoke up,
english: Oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, Anderea, momura omwabo Simion Petero, akamotebia,

ekegusii: Amang’ana ande mogokora naya: Nigo mogotuba egesasimero ki’Omonene namariga aino, mwaba mokorera na kweumia, na ase ayio Omonene tagwanchera ebing’wanso biaino nonya ng’ake, gose takogokigwa nabirobio korwa ase amaboko aino.
english: Another thing you do: You flood the LORD's altar with tears. You weep and wail because he no longer pays attention to your offerings or accepts them with pleasure from your hands.

ekegusii: Agasoa naende ase esinagogi. Narengeo omonto agwo, okoboko kwaye kwagataete.
english: Another time he went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.

ekegusii: na egia kabere gekagenda Beti‐Horoni, na ekende gochia ase orobebe rorochie Rikura ria Seboimu na erooro.
english: another toward Beth Horon, and the third toward the borderland overlooking the Valley of Zeboim facing the desert.

ekegusii: Moiranerie omonto omoriri buna oboriri bwaye bore, tabaisa gwekaga ng’a nomong’aini are.
english: Answer a fool according to his folly, or he will be wise in his own eyes.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’iranerie bwango! Omoika nkong’erera ore! Tombisa obosio bwao mbaise koba buna abwo bakogenda ase chimbeera.
english: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me or I will be like those who go down to the pit.

ekegusii: Answer me then, if you can; prepare yourself and confront me.
english: “Bono ing’iranerie onye gokonyara; beka amang’ana ao ang’e, otenene bokong’u!

ekegusii: Ing’iranerie, aye Omonene, ing’iranerie, erio abanto aba bamanye ng’a naye Omonene ore Nyasae, oranyare koonchora chinkoro chiabo chikoiranere.”
english: Answer me, O LORD, answer me, so these people will know that you, O LORD, are God, and that you are turning their hearts back again."

ekegusii: Omonene, ing’iranerie, ekiagera obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya, ing’iranere, ekiagera amabera ao namange mono.
english: Answer me, O LORD, out of the goodness of your love; in your great mercy turn to me.

ekegusii: Amage nigo are ebitongwa bitari ne chinguru, korende nigo akogacha endagera yabo agocha koria engaki y’egurugura.
english: Ants are creatures of little strength, yet they store up their food in the summer;

ekegusii: Ebirarero bionsi are korarera ekero agoiteka amanyinga, nigo birabe ebitachenegeti buna ebi akorarera ekero are nomotienyi, naboigo na kende gionsi araikaransere.
english: Any bed she lies on while her discharge continues will be unclean, as is her bed during her monthly period, and anything she sits on will be unclean, as during her period.

ekegusii: Abana bao bande baiboire nyuma y’aba, barabwo nabao barabe; korende nigo baratorwe ase amarieta ’abamwabo, na komenya ase omwando obo.
english: Any children born to you after them will be yours; in the territory they inherit they will be reckoned under the names of their brothers.

ekegusii: Eanga ende yonsi, na ebinto binde bionsi bi’amasankwa, embusuro eyio y’oroiboro eratonyere, goika bisibigwe namache, nabirobio nabibe ebitachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: Any clothing or leather that has semen on it must be washed with water, and it will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Endagera ende yonsi ekoriegwa nebe eyetachenegeti onye amache akoumorwa korwa ase enyongo buna eyio akoyekuna, na ekenyugwa kende gionsi kere ime y’enyongo buna eyio nkebe getachenegeti.
english: Any food that could be eaten but has water on it from such a pot is unclean, and any liquid that could be drunk from it is unclean.

ekegusii: “Ekero omonto agoteema igo, nigo ogosemeria kwaye kogosira kegima; nonya nase okoyerora rioka, omonto nigo akwerusia moyo.
english: Any hope of subduing him is false; the mere sight of him is overpowering.

ekegusii: Onye omonto onde bwensi okonyenyera eng’ombe, gose emanwa y’eng’ondi, gose embori, ase egetwori, gose isiko y’egetwori,
english: Any Israelite who sacrifices an ox, a lamb or a goat in the camp or outside of it

ekegusii: any kind of raven,
english: ebigonkoru na ebisaku biamwabo bionsi;

ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ase ororeria rwa Haroni nanyare koria endagera eyio. Ekio nkebe egetari kiabo kia botambe gi’okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene, ebiaare ase ebiaare. Monto onde bwensi orakune ebing’wanso ebio nigo arabe omochenu.”
english: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat it. It is his regular share of the offerings made to the LORD by fire for the generations to come. Whatever touches them will become holy.'"

ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha bw’enka y’omokuani nakeriere agwo aase achenire. Ekio negechenu mono.
english: Any male in a priest's family may eat it, but it must be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.

ekegusii: Kera omonto omosacha ore ase chinka chi’abakuani arie chinyama echio echire chinchenu mono.
english: Any male in a priest's family may eat it; it is most holy.

ekegusii: Chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso ekio chigotigara ase rituko ria gatato goika chisambwe nomorero chiyie chiere.
english: Any meat of the sacrifice left over till the third day must be burned up.

ekegusii: Emechie eyio nero yachoretwe ebe obotamero ase Abaisraeli, na ase abamenyi abaare ase egati yabo. Onde bwensi orenge goita omonto mosiabano atame gochia aroro, erinde taitwa noria oganetie korusia egesiomba, ataratenena ase omosangererekano amang’ana aye agambwe.
english: Any of the Israelites or any alien living among them who killed someone accidentally could flee to these designated cities and not be killed by the avenger of blood prior to standing trial before the assembly.

ekegusii: gose abanto baino tibarakora onsi aya Omonene achikire goetera ase Musa, gochakera rituko riria Omonene aruete amachiko, na kogenderera ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: any of the LORD's commands to you through him, from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come--

ekegusii: korende omosomba onde bwensi omogorwa chibesa ere ayerie gokwamwarokirie.
english: Any slave you have bought may eat of it after you have circumcised him,

ekegusii: Omosacha onde bwensi otakebiri risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto bamwabo, aserigwe gochia isiko, ekiagera osaririe okobwatana kwane.”
english: Any uncircumcised male, who has not been circumcised in the flesh, will be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant."

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi obwate amagena e rigori rinene akayarua, na amagena ayio akabekwa ase ekungo y’enyomba y’Omonene, inse y’oborendi bwa Yehieli Omogerisoni.
english: Any who had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the temple of the LORD in the custody of Jehiel the Gershonite.

ekegusii: gose bore ase egetambaa keroisirie ase chingencho ao ao korwa ase egatani, gose ase amarionya, gose ase rirondia rie risankwa, gose ase egento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa,
english: any woven or knitted material of linen or wool, any leather or anything made of leather--

ekegusii: Onde bwensi ore ase egati yaino, ore bw’abanto baye, tiga atiire gochia Yerusalemu, aaria ase ense y’Abayuda, erinde aagache enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na Nyasae oye abe amo nere. Ere nere Nyasae omenyete Yerusalemu.
english: Anyone of his people among you-- may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem in Judah and build the temple of the LORD, the God of Israel, the God who is in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ere oyomwegenire Omwana o Nyasae nare noborori obwo ime yaye. Ere oyotamwegeneti Nyasae omokorire koba omonyaborimo, ekiagera tegeneti oborori boria Nyasae aorokirie igoro y’Omwana oye.
english: Anyone who believes in the Son of God has this testimony in his heart. Anyone who does not believe God has made him out to be a liar, because he has not believed the testimony God has given about his Son.

ekegusii: Omonto orarame erieta ri’Omonene goika aitwe akwe; omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena. Karabe omomenyi gose omobiare, oyokorama Erieta ri’Omonene goika aitwe akwe.
english: anyone who blasphemes the name of the LORD must be put to death. The entire assembly must stone him. Whether an alien or native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, he must be put to death.

ekegusii: Gaki monto onde bwensi orasarie richiko erimo erire rike ase amachiko aya, na kworokereria abanto boigo, oyio narokwe omoke mono ase oboruoti bwa igoro, korende oyorayakore na koyorokereria, oyio nere orarokwe omonene ase oboruoti bwa igoro.
english: Anyone who breaks one of the least of these commandments and teaches others to do the same will be called least in the kingdom of heaven, but whoever practices and teaches these commands will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

ekegusii: Ere oyogoteba ng’a nigo are ase omobaso ime, naende ogechete oyomwabo, nigo are ase omosunte ime nonya mbono,
english: Anyone who claims to be in the light but hates his brother is still in the darkness.

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oteng’ate na gweitia ase rituko erio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
english: Anyone who does not deny himself on that day must be cut off from his people.

ekegusii: Naende nebe ng’a kera omonto otaigwereti omobani oyio nigo arasirigwe na gwatananwa korwa ase egati y’abanto.
english: Anyone who does not listen to him will be completely cut off from among his people.'

ekegusii: Onde bwensi orakore ebinto ebi nigo arabe okogechia ase Omonene; na ase engencho y’okogechia buna okwo Omonene, Nyasae oino, naserie abanto abwo konya bamenyete ase ense eria, barue ase amasio aino.
english: Anyone who does these things is detestable to the LORD, and because of these detestable practices the LORD your God will drive out those nations before you.

ekegusii: Naki oyorakore bobe, nigo araakanwe obobe bwaye obo akorire, na gwanchereria tikoiyo.
english: Anyone who does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orarie enyama y’eng’iti eyio ekwete nasibie chianga chiaye, naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio, na onde bwensi oraimokie eng’iti eyio ekwete, nasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.”
english: Anyone who eats some of the carcass must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening. Anyone who picks up the carcass must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orarie ebitinya bi’eng’iti yarurwe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene, oyio nigo eraatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
english: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal from which an offering by fire may be made to the LORD must be cut off from his people.

ekegusii: Kera omonto ogoika ang’e ase Obomenyo bw’Omonene, goika akwe. Inee! Ntwensi pi togochia gokwa?”
english: Anyone who even comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die. Are we all going to die?"

ekegusii: Naende akararigwa ng’a monto onde bwensi orenge kwanga, tacha ase engaki y’amatuko atato, buna abatang’ani na abagaaka bachigete, oyio aurwe ebinto biaye, naende arusananigwe tabaisa koba oyomo bw’omoganda bw’abanto abwo barwete ase obosomba.
english: Anyone who failed to appear within three days would forfeit all his property, in accordance with the decision of the officials and elders, and would himself be expelled from the assembly of the exiles.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogechete oyomwabo oyio nomoiti, na inwe momanyete ng’a omoiti tari nobogima bwa kare na kare ime yaye.
english: Anyone who hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life in him.

ekegusii: Korende omonto ore ase egati y’abare moyo nare nogosemeria, na esese ere moyo nigo ekonyora amaya kobua endo ekwete.
english: Anyone who is among the living has hope--even a live dog is better off than a dead lion!

ekegusii: Naki omonto karabe omoigwa bwe ring’ana, gose tari omorikori, oyio nigo anga buna omonto oyokwerigereria obosio bwaye omonyene ase ekerore.
english: Anyone who listens to the word but does not do what it says is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror

ekegusii: Naki oyokonyora amabeere oka tamanyeti mono ring’ana ri’oboronge, ekiagera nomwana omoke.
english: Anyone who lives on milk, being still an infant, is not acquainted with the teaching about righteousness.

ekegusii: Na monto onde bwensi oraimokie eyekwete ase echio nasibie chianga chiaye, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio. Ching’iti echio nachibe chitachenegeti asemore.”
english: Anyone who picks up their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening. They are unclean for you.

ekegusii: Oyobwanchire omobani ekiagera ere nomobani, nanyore eng’eria y’omobani; na oyo bwanchire omonto omoronge ekiagera ere nomonto omoronge, nanyore eng’eria y’omonto omoronge.
english: Anyone who receives a prophet because he is a prophet will receive a prophet's reward, and anyone who receives a righteous man because he is a righteous man will receive a righteous man's reward.

ekegusii: Korende ere oyokworokererigwa ring’ana, abwatane nere oyokomworokereria ase ebinto ebiya bionsi.
english: Anyone who receives instruction in the word must share all good things with his instructor.

ekegusii: Omonto oyorenge gochaya amachiko a Musa nigo arenge goitwa okwa, atari konyora amabera, ase okoberwa kirori nabanto babere gose batato.
english: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi oragenderere goetania, na tari gotenena ase okworokereria gwa Kristo, oyio tari na Nyasae. Ere oyogotenena ase okworokereria okwo, oyio nigo are nabwo babere, Ise na Omwana.
english: Anyone who runs ahead and does not continue in the teaching of Christ does not have God; whoever continues in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise korara ime ase enyomba eyio, gose koragerera aroro, goika asibie chianga chiaye.
english: Anyone who sleeps or eats in the house must wash his clothes.

ekegusii: Na omonto onde bwensi orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto, naaberwe; korende onde bwensi orakwane ring’ana riibe igoro ase Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa ase ense eye, nonya nase eria egochi‐gocha.
english: Anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come.

ekegusii: Anyone who takes the life of someone's animal must make restitution-- life for life.
english: Omonto oraite engi’ti etugire goika nayeakane. Obogima boakanwe nobogima.

ekegusii: Anyone who touches his bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.
english: Monto onde bwensi aise gokuna ebirarero bi’omonto oyio goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

ekegusii: Naki ere oyoramokwanie igo obwatanire nemeremo yaye emebe.
english: Anyone who welcomes him shares in his wicked work.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, oyomanyete gokora amaya, ko tayakora, asare ere nebibe.
english: Anyone, then, who knows the good he ought to do and doesn't do it, sins.

ekegusii: Kera egento kere ime ase chinyancha ne chindooche getabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaba, na amagoocho, ekio nokogechia asemore.”
english: Anything living in the water that does not have fins and scales is to be detestable to you.

ekegusii: Egento kende gionsi omonto oria otachenegeti arakune nakerokio nakebe egetachenegeti. Omonto onde bwensi orakune egento keria nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.”
english: Anything that an unclean person touches becomes unclean, and anyone who touches it becomes unclean till evening."

ekegusii: Gento kende gionsi keragwerwe neyemo ye ching’iti echio ekwete inakebe getachenegeti; onye ne riko rikoroisia emegati, gose neri’ endagera, erio riatwe, riabeire eritachenegeti asemore.
english: Anything that one of their carcasses falls on becomes unclean; an oven or cooking pot must be broken up. They are unclean, and you are to regard them as unclean.

ekegusii: Abwo barorekanete ase obonene, na gokwana amang’ana ay’ogokwa kwaye, aya agwenerete goikerania Yerusalemu.
english: appeared in glorious splendor, talking with Jesus. They spoke about his departure, which he was about to bring to fulfillment at Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Apply your heart to instruction and your ears to words of knowledge.
english: Karue enkoro yao oigwe amorokererio, na amato ao aigwe amang’ana e chisemi.

ekegusii: Obeke Haroni amo nabamura baye bakore emeremo y’obokuani, korende monto onde bwensi omoao aise gwesoyia ase emeremo eyio nigo araitwe akwe.”
english: Appoint Aaron and his sons to serve as priests; anyone else who approaches the sanctuary must be put to death."

ekegusii: Chora omonto omobe agambere omobisa one, na tiga oria omosoeri atenene ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio amosoere.
english: Appoint an evil man to oppose him; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

ekegusii: “Mochore abagambi na abateneneri korwa ase ebisaku biaino, babe bakogamba agwo ase emechie yaino, eyio Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa. Abwo babe bakogamba ebina bi’abanto ase oboronge.
english: Appoint judges and officials for each of your tribes in every town the LORD your God is giving you, and they shall judge the people fairly.

ekegusii: Nchorere abanto batato korwa ase kera egesaku, na inche nimbatome bataare ase ense enigma, bayiate na kworokia ase okorika chinsemo chigwenerete koba omwando bwa kera egesaku. Erio bandetere amang’ana.
english: Appoint three men from each tribe. I will send them out to make a survey of the land and to write a description of it, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me.

ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Arabu, na Duma, na Esani,
