english: Arab, Dumah, Eshan,

ekegusii: Abasiiria amo n’Abaefraimu, na mosinto o Remalia, bakorire emeroberio emebe igoro yao bagoteba:
english: Aram, Ephraim and Remaliah's son have plotted your ruin, saying,

ekegusii: Abasiiria bamenyete moocha, na Abafilisti bamenyete bosongo, baasamirie emenwa yabo bamere Abaisraeli. Nonya ayio are bo, Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
english: Arameans from the east and Philistines from the west have devoured Israel with open mouth. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

ekegusii: Erio Arauna akairaneria Daudi, “Omonene one omoruoti, ira eki oraganie ase ekeng’wanso. Rora chiombe echi ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ebikorero ebi bi’okoora amo namakorogoto bibe chinko okogesambera.”
english: Araunah said to David, "Let my lord the king take whatever pleases him and offer it up. Here are oxen for the burnt offering, and here are threshing sledges and ox yokes for the wood.

ekegusii: Erio Orinani agatebia Daudi, “Ira ekeooreri ekio! Aye omonene one omoruoti, kora eki oranche. Rora, narure chiombe chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebikorero ebi bi’okoorera bibe chinko, na engano ebe okoruegwa kw’endagera. Nakobieire bionsi.”
english: Araunah said to David, "Take it! Let my lord the king do whatever pleases him. Look, I will give the oxen for the burnt offerings, the threshing sledges for the wood, and the wheat for the grain offering. I will give all this."

ekegusii: Arauna akamoboria, “Omonene one, naki gwachire aa asende inche omosomba oo?” Daudi akamoiraneria, “Nigo nachire ngore ekeooreri kiao, ing’agachere Omonene egesasimero aiga, erinde amaakwa atangwe korwa ase abanto.”
english: Araunah said, "Why has my lord the king come to his servant?" "To buy your threshing floor," David answered, "so I can build an altar to the LORD, that the plague on the people may be stopped."

ekegusii: Abarwani baria bakabwata amata, bakarasa Yosia omoruoti. Erio omoruoti oria agatebia abasomba baye, “Indusie aiga, ekiagera nabetirwe bobe.”
english: Archers shot King Josiah, and he told his officers, "Take me away; I am badly wounded."

ekegusii: Inee! Bonsi nabatomwa? Bonsi nababani? Bonsi naborokia? Bonsi ngokora bare ebikone bie chinguru?
english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?

ekegusii: “Inee! Okoremia koria Nyasae akoeire tikogoisaini? Gose ring’ana ri’oboitongo agokwana naye nigo rire bosa asore?
english: Are God's consolations not enough for you, words spoken gently to you?

ekegusii: Inee! Chindooche chia Damesiki, Abaana na Faripari, tichiri chingiya kobua chindooche chi’ense y’Abaisraeli? Inee! Tinarenge gwesibia ase chirochio ncheneke?” Bono akaonchoka akagenda ore nokogechigwa.
english: Are not Abana and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than any of the waters of Israel? Couldn't I wash in them and be cleansed?" So he turned and went off in a rage.

ekegusii: Inee! Abamalaika bonsi tibari emeika y’ogokorera, batomire gokorera baria barache konyora omwando bw’ogotooreka?
english: Are not all angels ministering spirits sent to serve those who will inherit salvation?

ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro isano tichiri koonigwa ase chibesa ibere? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tikari kwebwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agoteba iga: Inee! Abachiki baane bonsi tibari abaruoti?
english: 'Are not my commanders all kings?' he says.

ekegusii: Inee! Amatuko ’obogima bwane tari amake? Intige, imbe nobotoereru ase engaki eye enke,
english: Are not my few days almost over? Turn away from me so I can have a moment's joy

ekegusii: Bionsi ebi abanto abwo basemeretie nigo bigosira kegima. Nigo bagokwa bataraikera komanya obong’aini bonde bwonsi.”
english: Are not the cords of their tent pulled up, so that they die without wisdom?'

ekegusii: Inee! Chinchiro ibere tichiri koonigwa ase ebesa eyemo? Naende nonya nakamo kabo tigakogwa inse, Iso oino atancheti.
english: Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? Yet not one of them will fall to the ground apart from the will of your Father.

ekegusii: “Inee! Amang’ana ayio agwenerete mono tari aro Omonene orenge gokwana goetera ase ababani ba kare, ekero ekio Yerusalemu omenyire nabanto, na igo orenge osesenirie ore nemechie yaye yayoetanaine, naende abanto bamenyete ase ense ya irianyi na ase ense omweya?”
english: Are these not the words the LORD proclaimed through the earlier prophets when Jerusalem and its surrounding towns were at rest and prosperous, and the Negev and the western foothills were settled?'"

ekegusii: Inee! Ekero bakorete ebinto ebi bi’okogechia, mbabete nobosooku? Yaya, tibabete nobosooku nonya ng’ake, gose tibaorogetie amasio are nobosooku. Ase engencho eyio nabagwe amo nabanto baria bande baragwe, ekero ndarue egesusuro asebare, nabarabwo nabagwe. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: Are they ashamed of their loathsome conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when I punish them," says the LORD.

ekegusii: Inee! Ekero bakorete ebinto ebi bi’okogechia, mbabete nobosooku? Yaya, tibabete nobosooku nonya ng’ake, gose tibaorogetie amasio are nobosooku. Ase engencho eyio nabagwe amo nabanto baria bande baragwe; ekero ndarue egesusuro asebare nabarabwo nabagwe. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: Are they ashamed of their loathsome conduct? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; they will be brought down when they are punished, says the LORD.

ekegusii: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they Abraham's descendants? So am I.
english: Barabwo n’Abaibirania? Nainche boigo. Barabwo n’Abaisraeli? Nainche boigo. Barabwo noroiboro rwa Ibrahimu? Nainche boigo.

ekegusii: “Ande, nigo banyorire ebisakorwa bakare gwatanana ase egati yabo, kera omonto aire omoiseke oyomo, gose babere; Sisera ere aire ebitambaa bi’ebieni ebiya, egetambaa keroisirie ekiya, ekemo gose bibere, bibe ebisakorwa ase rigoti riaye.”
english: 'Are they not finding and dividing the spoils: a girl or two for each man, colorful garments as plunder for Sisera, colorful garments embroidered, highly embroidered garments for my neck-- all this as plunder?'

ekegusii: Are they not the ones who are slandering the noble name of him to whom you belong?
english: Tari barabwo abwo bakorama erieta erio rigiya mwarokirwe inwe?

ekegusii: Inee! Barabwo nabasomba ba Kristo? (Bono nigo ngokwana buna ebarimo). Inche mbuya kobua; ase emeremo kobua mono, ase ogosibwa kobua mono, ase ogoakwa goetania ekerengo, ang’e namakweri ebiro ebinge.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I am out of my mind to talk like this.) I am more. I have worked much harder, been in prison more frequently, been flogged more severely, and been exposed to death again and again.

ekegusii: Inee! Ntwachakire naende gwetogia intwe abanyene? Gose intwe ntogwenerete, buna abande, konyora amarube are nogotogigwa gocha asemore, gose ayakorwa asemore?
english: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, like some people, letters of recommendation to you or from you?

ekegusii: Inee! Igo tokogera Omonene abe ne ribero? Gose ntore ne chinguru kobua ere?
english: Are we trying to arouse the Lord's jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

ekegusii: Bono aye nigo okorengereria ng’a nomuya ore kobua Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, omoruoti bw’Abamoabu? Inee! Ere nomanete n’Abaisraeli nonya ng’ake? Gose narwanete esegi nabarabwo?
english: Are you better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever quarrel with Israel or fight with them?

ekegusii: Aye Nineva, Inee, nomuya ore kobua Tebesi, omochie ore ase orooche rwa Naili oetananire namache? Enyancha nero yarenge egekengero kiaye, na amache naro arenge orwaki rwaye.
english: Are you better than Thebes, situated on the Nile, with water around her? The river was her defense, the waters her wall.

ekegusii: Aye nomonene kobua sokoro yaito Ibrahimu, oyokure? Naende nababani bakure. Naye kogwekora obe ng’o?”
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?"

ekegusii: Inee! Aye nomonene ore kobua sokoro yaito Yakobo, oyotoete ensoko eye, nere omonyene akanywa amache aya, na abana baye bonsi, na etugo yaye?”
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his flocks and herds?"

ekegusii: Inee! Gwasibirwe ase omokungu? Torigia gosiborwa. Nosiboire? Torigia omokungu.
english: Are you married? Do not seek a divorce. Are you unmarried? Do not look for a wife.

ekegusii: Nabo more abariri buna iga? Mogachaka ase Omoika, na bono morigetie goikeranigwa ase chingencho chiaino abanyene?
english: Are you so foolish? After beginning with the Spirit, are you now trying to attain your goal by human effort?

ekegusii: Ee, nigo ore omong’aini kobua Danieli, na obobisi tibori bobisekanete korwa asore.
english: Are you wiser than Daniel? Is no secret hidden from you?

ekegusii: Inee! Amatuko ao nabo ang’ana buna aya mwanyabanto, gose emiaka yao buna ey’omonto,
english: Are your days like those of a mortal or your years like those of a man,

ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ao ay’ogokumia namanyire agwo ase omosunte ime? Gose oboronge bwao mbomanyire agwo ase ense y’okwebwa?
english: Are your wonders known in the place of darkness, or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?

ekegusii: Aren't all his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all these things?"
english: Na basubati bamwabo bonsi tibari aa seito? Gaki oyo ng’ai ayanyorire aya onsi?”

ekegusii: Erio bwango Arioki akaira Danieli ase obosio bw’omoruoti, akamotebia, “Nanyorire omonto korwa ase egati y’abooswa baria b’Abayuda oranyare kogotebia aye omoruoti engencho ye chindoto chiao.”
english: Arioch took Daniel to the king at once and said, "I have found a man among the exiles from Judah who can tell the king what his dream means."

ekegusii: Imoka, orere botuko bokie! Ekero oborendi bw’obotuko bogochaka, oumore ayare ase enkoro yao ime ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna okoumora amache! Rambora amaboko ao asare osabere obogima bw’abana bao, abwo bagoyire nenchara ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.
english: Arise, cry out in the night, as the watches of the night begin; pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to him for the lives of your children, who faint from hunger at the head of every street.

ekegusii: Omonene, inchuo! Nyasae rambora okoboko kwao, na tibweba abanto bachandegete!
english: Arise, LORD! Lift up your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inchuo! Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie! Aye gwaakire ababisa baane bonsi ase chinsea, kwabunire amaino ’abakori amabe.
english: Arise, O LORD! Deliver me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka ochiche aase ao ogotimokera, aye amo n’Esanduku eria ekworokia okobua kwao.
english: arise, O LORD, and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, imoka kore nendamwamu yao, imokerera igoro orwanie ekeririanda ki’ababisa baane! Inchuo onkonye! Aye gwachikire ekina.
english: Arise, O LORD, in your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake, my God; decree justice.

ekegusii: Omonene, inchuo! Totiga abanto babue, tiga abanto b’Ebisaku banacherwe ekina ase obosio bwao.
english: Arise, O LORD, let not man triumph; let the nations be judged in your presence.

ekegusii: Orwaki nigo rwaetanaine kera ekemo ki’ebiooreri ebio bine. Inse ase orwaki mbarabare amariko akorugerwa naroisirieo.
english: Around the inside of each of the four courts was a ledge of stone, with places for fire built all around under the ledge.

ekegusii: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.
english: Arifaksadi akaibora Sela, na Sela akaibora Eberi.

ekegusii: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.
english: Arifakisadi akaibora Sela, na Sela akaibora Eberi.

ekegusii: Agacha Yerusalemu amo nabasomba baye abange barenge kogenda komo; boigo nabwate chingamia chiabogoretie ebinsari ne chitahabu chinyinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Na ekero aigete ase Sulemani, akamotebia amang’ana onsi arenge ase ebirengererio biaye.
english: Arriving at Jerusalem with a very great caravan-- with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones-- she came to Solomon and talked with him about all that she had on her mind.

ekegusii: Arrogant lips are unsuited to a fool-- how much worse lying lips to a ruler!
english: Amang’ana amaya tagwenereti omoriri, ne chinkwana chi’oborimo tichigwenereti omogambi nonya ng’ake.

ekegusii: Ensara tekoyioboyia etame; amagena ’enduruche akorutwa nigo anga buna amasakwe.
english: Arrows do not make him flee; slingstones are like chaff to him.

ekegusii: “Inche Aritasasita, omoruoti bw’abaruoti, ngokorikera inde aye Ezara omokuani, aye kwegerete amachiko a Nyasae o igoro. Amakwania amo nayakobwatia ayio.
english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, To Ezra the priest, a teacher of the Law of the God of heaven: Greetings.

ekegusii: Abaarivadi na Abasemari, na Abahamati.
english: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites.

ekegusii: na Abaarivadi, na Abaseremari, na Abahamati. Erio nyuma y’ayio eamate ya Kanani egesiarera.
english: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans scattered

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana riire rigokubakubana riasira, naboigo noyokogenda aase abakure atakoirana korwao.
english: As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so he who goes down to the grave does not return.

ekegusii: Omonto omoriri okoiranera gokora oboriri bwaye nigo anga esese ekoiranera amaroki aye enyene.
english: As a dog returns to its vomit, so a fool repeats his folly.

ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akonakweoncha‐onchora buna egesieri gekona‐koonchorwa ase chimbata gesibeire.
english: As a door turns on its hinges, so a sluggard turns on his bed.

ekegusii: Chindoto nigo chigocha korwa ase ogwechanda okonge, ne chinkwana chinyinge nigo chikorenta amang’ana ’oboriri.
english: As a dream comes when there are many cares, so the speech of a fool when there are many words.

ekegusii: Nigo banga buna chindoto omonto akweba mambia gakoboka. Aye Omonene, naboigo bare asore buna omogwekano okororwa ase okorota, ekero okoimoka nigo okweba ebieni biabo.
english: As a dream when one awakes, so when you arise, O Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.

ekegusii: Bono nigo ngokwana nainwe buna nabana baane more. Buna twabakoreire, nainwe motokorere bo, mogareyie chinkoro chiaino.
english: As a fair exchange-- I speak as to my children-- open wide your hearts also.

ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna ise abana akoba namabera asebare, naboigo n’Omonene akoba namabera ase abwo bamoirogete.
english: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him;

ekegusii: As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you; and you will be comforted over Jerusalem."
english: Buna ng’ina agochanchima omwana, naboigo nainche nkobachanchima inwe; ee, nabo morachanchimwe agwo Yerusalemu.”

ekegusii: Omwaga okogusa korwa sugusu nigo okorenta embura, naboigo nomonto omogenki akorenta okobeeana.
english: As a north wind brings rain, so a sly tongue brings angry looks.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche omosibwa ase engencho y’Omonene nabasoroire mogenderere buna egwenerete okorangerigwa kwaino mwarangeretigwe
english: As a prisoner for the Lord, then, I urge you to live a life worthy of the calling you have received.

ekegusii: Korwa bono ase amatuko aya atigarete more moyo, timogenderera koreng’ana nokogania okobe kwa mwanyabanto, korende koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae.
english: As a result, he does not live the rest of his earthly life for evil human desires, but rather for the will of God.

ekegusii: Ase igo amanyekanire ase abarendi bonsi b’omoruoti, na ase abande bonsi ng’a nasibirwe ase engencho ya Kristo.
english: As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.

ekegusii: nonya nase chinchera chinene bagasokia abarwaire isiko, bakabareria igoro ase amarere na emeito, erinde, ekero Petero agoeta, omorengari oye okune abande b’abwo.
english: As a result, people brought the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that at least Peter's shadow might fall on some of them as he passed by.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana omorisia akorigia ching’ondi chiaye chiaserebekanire, ochisangereria amo naende, naboigo nainche ndasangererie ching’ondi chiane, nchitoorie korwa ase chinsemo chionsi aase chiaserebekanete gochia ase rituko rie rirumbe na omosunte omonene.
english: As a shepherd looks after his scattered flock when he is with them, so will I look after my sheep. I will rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on a day of clouds and darkness.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana ensoko ekorua amache aye amakenonoku, naboigo na Yerusalemu ogendererete gokora obobe bwaye, obotindi na ogosaria nigo biichire imeo. Amarwaire na amaote aye nigo bire ase obosio bwane botambe.
english: As a well pours out its water, so she pours out her wickedness. Violence and destruction resound in her; her sickness and wounds are ever before me.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo twabete asore buna omokungu ore morito, okobina aibore, ekero engaki yaye yaikire, nigo akoromwa nobororo.
english: As a woman with child and about to give birth writhes and cries out in her pain, so were we in your presence, O LORD.

ekegusii: Buna omomura akonyuoma omoiseke omwekungi, naboigo na abamura bao barakonyuome; na buna omonyuomi akogokera omoriakari oye, naboigo Nyasae oo arakogokere.
english: As a young man marries a maiden, so will your sons marry you; as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so will your God rejoice over you.

ekegusii: buna omokuani omonene na abagaaka bonsi b’ekegambero bare birori asende. Naetwe amarube nabarabwo ing’ire ase abaminto abarenge Damesiki, erio mbarente abarenge agwo, mbaire Yerusalemu basibire erinde baegwe egesusuro.
english: as also the high priest and all the Council can testify. I even obtained letters from them to their brothers in Damascus, and went there to bring these people as prisoners to Jerusalem to be punished.

ekegusii: Morue eeri ensae eyemo, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimingichi isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
english: As an aroma pleasing to the LORD, prepare a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Omonyariomana ogoseegeta amariomana nigo anga buna amakara akogenderera koyia, gose chinko chikogera omorero ogenderera gwoka.
english: As charcoal to embers and as wood to fire, so is a quarrelsome man for kindling strife.

ekegusii: Chingi chikwete nigo chikogundia amaguta akweakwa atioka bobe; naboigo na oboriri obosinini bokobua obong’aini na amasikani.
english: As dead flies give perfume a bad smell, so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor.

ekegusii: Ebinyomba biaye bi’oborendi, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’amaagacho ande. Ebibao nigo biarenge ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.
english: as did its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico, and it had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

ekegusii: Ekero riachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakabora, “Aase aa negesomo, ngochia koira bore, batige abanto bagende ebichie begorere endagera.”
english: As evening approached, the disciples came to him and said, "This is a remote place, and it's already getting late. Send the crowds away, so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food."

ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, omonto omonda bw’Arimathaya, okorokwa Yusufu, agacha; ere nomworokigwa o Yeso orenge.
english: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.

ekegusii: Naende koreng’ana buna moocha ere aare mono korwa bosongo, naboigo Omonene akorusia ebibe biaito korwa asetore biabeera aare.
english: as far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

ekegusii: Naboigo ase amanag’ana ’enchili babeire ababisa ba Nyasae ase engencho yaino; korende ase ogochorwa babeire abanchwa ase engencho ye chisokoro chiabo.
english: As far as the gospel is concerned, they are enemies on your account; but as far as election is concerned, they are loved on account of the patriarchs,

ekegusii: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
english: Buna omorero ogokoora rinani, na buna ekebemberi ki’omorero kegosamba ebitunwa,

ekegusii: Ase ebigoro bionsi mwarenge korema namakombe, timokogendao korema naende, ekiagera nigo morairoke amageri na amagwa; aase agwo nabe ase chiombe chigochwarwa ne ching’ondi chiaatiringe.
english: As for all the hills once cultivated by the hoe, you will no longer go there for fear of the briers and thorns; they will become places where cattle are turned loose and where sheep run.

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Ahasia, na aya akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for all the other events of Ahaziah's reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Asa, okobua kwaye na onsi aya akorete na emechie aagachete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda. Korende ekero ki’obogotu bwaye akarwara amagoro.
english: As for all the other events of Asa's reign, all his achievements, all he did and the cities he built, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? In his old age, however, his feet became diseased.

ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa nigo okobombwa nomoroisia ebinto, erio omoturi oyooma netahabu, naende oyoroiseria ebinyuri bi’efeta.
english: As for an idol, a craftsman casts it, and a goldsmith overlays it with gold and fashions silver chains for it.

ekegusii: Enchera ya Nyasae neng’ikeranu, amang’ana aye ateemirwe na gotenena. Ere nenguba ase bonsi abakomotamera.
english: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield for all who take refuge in him.

ekegusii: Amo na Hemani nigo barenge abamura baye: Bukia na Matania, Usieli na Sebueli, Yerimoti na Hanania, Hanani na Eliata, Gidaliti na Romamuti‐Eseri, Yosibekasa na Maloti, Horiti na Mahasioti.
english: As for Heman, from his sons: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shubael and Jerimoth; Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-Ezer; Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir and Mahazioth.

ekegusii: Amo na Yedutuni nigo barenge abamura baye: Gedalia na Seri, Yesaia na Simei, Hesabia na Matitia. Abamura aba batano nomo bakaba inse y’oboraai bwa Yedutuni ise, oyorenge kobana ase okobugia obokano ase okoiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono na komotogia.
english: As for Jeduthun, from his sons: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah and Mattithiah, six in all, under the supervision of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied, using the harp in thanking and praising the LORD.

ekegusii: Chisese nachiriere Yesebeli ase oboremo agwo Yesireeli, na monto onde takomotindeka.” Erio akaigora egesieri agatama.
english: As for Jezebel, dogs will devour her on the plot of ground at Jezreel, and no one will bury her.'" Then he opened the door and ran.

ekegusii: Amatuko ’omonto nigo anga buna obonyansi, omonto nigo akoba buna egesicha gekoreereta ase omogondo;
english: As for man, his days are like grass, he flourishes like a flower of the field;

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio abe aare nainche ng’a ninkore ebibe ase Omonene ase ogotiga kobasabera inwe. Ribaga ri’ayio nimborokie enchera ere engiya na endonge.
english: As for me, far be it from me that I should sin against the LORD by failing to pray for you. And I will teach you the way that is good and right.

ekegusii: Korende asende inche, rora, nigo inde ase amaboko aino. Kora asende aya morarore are amaya na amaronge asemore.
english: As for me, I am in your hands; do with me whatever you think is good and right.

ekegusii: Korende inche nimbe nkona‐koraria obuya bw’Omonene kogenderera botambe; nimbe nkona‐gotera ogotera gw’okomotogia Nyasae o Yakobo.
english: As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.

ekegusii: Bono obobisi obo bwamaanoirwe asende, tari ng’a inche nigo imbwate obong’aini goetania abanto bande bonsi bare moyo, korende ng’a aye omoruoti omanyigwe engencho ye chindoto chiria, naende onyare komanya ebirengererio bire ase omoyo oo.
english: As for me, this mystery has been revealed to me, not because I have greater wisdom than other living men, but so that you, O king, may know the interpretation and that you may understand what went through your mind.

ekegusii: Isia, omoteneneri korwa ase ororeria rwa Rehabia;
english: As for Rehabiah, from his sons: Isshiah was the first.

ekegusii: As for the additional length of the tent curtains, the half curtain that is left over is to hang down at the rear of the tabernacle.
english: Ekeng’ese kie rirondia riria kementire kebekwe gesung’unane, getube magega y’Obomenyo.

ekegusii: Ase akanyomba kaagachire ensemo ya bosongo, abarendi bane nigo barenge agwo ase enchera, na babere ase akanyomba karia.
english: As for the court to the west, there were four at the road and two at the court itself.

ekegusii: Ande onsi abanto bagokora, na koreng’ana namang’ana ao natigire kobwatia chinchera chi’abasaria.
english: As for the deeds of men-- by the word of your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

ekegusii: Tochandeka ase engencho ye chitigere chiria chiasirete korwa ase amatuko atato aetire, ekiagera echio chianyorekanire. Inee! Ebinto bionsi ebiya bire ase egati y’Abaisraeli nase ng’o birabe? Nigo birabe asore na ase abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya iso.”
english: As for the donkeys you lost three days ago, do not worry about them; they have been found. And to whom is all the desire of Israel turned, if not to you and all your father's family?"

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana aria Daudi omoruoti akorete korwa omochakano goika omoerie nigo arikire ase chibuku chia Samweli omorori, na ase echia Nathani omobani, na ase echia Gadi omorori.
english: As for the events of King David's reign, from beginning to end, they are written in the records of Samuel the seer, the records of Nathan the prophet and the records of Gad the seer,

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana onsi igoro ya Rehoboamu, korwa omochakano goika omoerio, nigo arikire ase amariko a Semaya omobani, na ase aya Ido omorori, buna amang’ana e chinderia arikire. Esegi ekaba ekogenderera ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.
english: As for the events of Rehoboam's reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer that deal with genealogies? There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

ekegusii: Korende ase abanto b’Ebisaku abegenete, twatomire rirube buna twanacha, ng’a beatanane korwa ase ebinto birure ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, na korwa ase amanyinga, na korwa ase enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase obotomani.”
english: As for the Gentile believers, we have written to them our decision that they should abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality."

ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Yeria nere otenenerete abanto be chiamate chionsi chi’ororeria rwa Heburoni. (Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ene bw’okogamba gwa Daudi, obotuki bogakorwa, na abanto be chiamate echio abamanyete korwana esegi buya bakanyorekana agwo Yaeseri ya Gileadi).
english: As for the Hebronites, Jeriah was their chief according to the genealogical records of their families. In the fortieth year of David's reign a search was made in the records, and capable men among the Hebronites were found at Jazer in Gilead.

ekegusii: Omonene nasirie korwa ase chinyomba chia Yakobo onde bwensi ogokora amang’ana ayio karabe omworokia gose omworokigwa, nonya noyokorenta ekeng’wanso ase Omonene bw’Emeganda.
english: As for the man who does this, whoever he may be, may the LORD cut him off from the tents of Jacob--even though he brings offerings to the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Abiyamu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda. Na esegi nigo yarenge ase egati y’Abiyamu na Yeroboamu.
english: As for the other events of Abijah's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Ahabu, na aya onsi akorete, na enyomba y’amaino e chinchogu eria aagachete, na emechie yonsi eria aagachete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Ahab's reign, including all he did, the palace he built and inlaid with ivory, and the cities he fortified, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Amasia nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Amaziah's reign, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Amasia, korwa omochakano goika omoerio, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’Abaruoti b’Abayuda na ab’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Amaziah's reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Amoni na aya akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Amon's reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro y’Asaria, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Azariah's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Baasa, na aya onsi akorete, na okobua kwaye, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Baasha's reign, what he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Ela, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ime ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Elah's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Hezekia, na okobua kwaye gwonsi, na buna aroisetie ritibo na omotaro ase okorenta amache ase omochie ime, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Hezekiah's reign, all his achievements and how he made the pool and the tunnel by which he brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yehoyakimu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Jehoiakim's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yehoramu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Jehoram's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi Yehosafati akorete, na okobua kwaye aorogetie, naende buna arwanete chisegi, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Jehoshaphat's reign, the things he achieved and his military exploits, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yehu, na aya onsi akorete, na okobua kwaye gwonsi, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Jehu's reign, all he did, and all his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yeroboamu, na aya onsi akorete, na okobua kwaye, na buna arwanete, naende buna airanetie Damesiki na Hamati ase Abaisraeli, emechie konya yabeire ey’Abayuda, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Jeroboam's reign, all he did, and his military achievements, including how he recovered for Israel both Damascus and Hamath, which had belonged to Yaudi, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yosia, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Josiah's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yotamu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Jotham's reign, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Manase, na aya onsi akorete, na ebibe biria akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of Manasseh's reign, and all he did, including the sin he committed, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Menahemu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Menahem's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Nadabu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Nadab's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi Omuri akorete, na okobua okwo aorogetie, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Omri's reign, what he did and the things he achieved, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Peka, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Pekah's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Na bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Rehoboamu, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Rehoboam's reign, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana onsi igoro ya Sulemani, na aya onsi akorete, na obong’aini bwaye bwonsi nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora gwa Sulemani.
english: As for the other events of Solomon's reign-- all he did and the wisdom he displayed-- are they not written in the book of the annals of Solomon?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi Sulemani akorete, korwa omochakano goika omoerio, nigo arikire ase amariko a Nathani omobani, na ase obobani bw’Ahiya korwa Silo, na ase oborori bwa Ido omorori igoro ya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati.
english: As for the other events of Solomon's reign, from beginning to end, are they not written in the records of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi Ahasi akorete nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of the reign of Ahaz, and what he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yehoahasi, na aya onsi akorete, na okobua kwaye, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoahaz, all he did and his achievements, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Yehoasi, na aya onsi akorete, na okobua kwaye gw’okorwania Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, all he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi Yehoasi akorete, na okobua kwaye, na buna arwanete esegi n’Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of the reign of Jehoash, what he did and his achievements, including his war against Amaziah king of Judah, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana onsi igoro ya Yoashi, na aya onsi akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: As for the other events of the reign of Joash, and all he did, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Judah?

ekegusii: Bono amang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Simuri, na omoroberio bw’ogoita akorete, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’ogokora kw’Abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: As for the other events of Zimri's reign, and the rebellion he carried out, are they not written in the book of the annals of the kings of Israel?

ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’abakuani b’ororeria rwa Haroni, abamenyete ase amaremo aetanaine emechie yabo, ase kera omochie, abanto gete bagachorwa na korikwa amarieta abo. Barabwo bakaba bagwatanana ebiegwa biria ase kera omonto omosacha, ase egati y’abakuani, na ase kera Omolawi origetwe ase omoroberio.
english: As for the priests, the descendants of Aaron, who lived on the farm lands around their towns or in any other towns, men were designated by name to distribute portions to every male among them and to all who were recorded in the genealogies of the Levites.

ekegusii: As for the rest of the descendants of Levi: from the sons of Amram: Shubael; from the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.
english: Aba nabwo Abalawi bande: Subaeli bw’ororeria rw’Amuramu na Yehedia bw’ororeria rwa Subaeli;

ekegusii: Abanto abachenu bare ase ense nigo bare nobonene obonene; abwo nabwo bangogetie mono.
english: As for the saints who are in the land, they are the glorious ones in whom is all my delight.

ekegusii: Abayuda bande bakaba bamenyete ase ebichie ang’e namaremo abo. Abande bakamenya Kiriati-Ariba na ase ebichie biaye; abande bakamenya Diboni na ase ebichie biaye, na abande Yekabuseli na ase ebichie biaye;
english: As for the villages with their fields, some of the people of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its surrounding settlements, in Dibon and its settlements, in Jekabzeel and its villages,

ekegusii: Korende abakungu babo, na abana mobaire babe abaino, amo ne chitugo chionsi. Ebinto bionsi ebire ase omochie oyio mobisakore, mobiire bibe ebiaino, nainwe mogokere ebisakorwa bi’ababisa baino. Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere obabieire.
english: As for the women, the children, the livestock and everything else in the city, you may take these as plunder for yourselves. And you may use the plunder the LORD your God gives you from your enemies.

ekegusii: Amagoro aria ane nigo agwekaine, kera okogoro nigo kwaroisirie kogasoanigwa nokonde.
english: As for their appearance, the four of them looked alike; each was like a wheel intersecting a wheel.

ekegusii: As for those agitators, I wish they would go the whole way and emasculate themselves!
english: Anga nancha ng’a abwo bakobachanda begombayie abanyene.

ekegusii: Korende abwo babarire ng’a nabanene bare (tari gento asende nonya barenge nobonene bore naki; Nyasae tari nogwanchereria ase mwanyabanto), nakwanire ng’a abwo babarire ng’a nabanene bare tibamentereti gento asende.
english: As for those who seemed to be important-- whatever they were makes no difference to me; God does not judge by external appearance-- those men added nothing to my message.

ekegusii: Nabo omonto karaganie komanya amang’ana igoro ya Tito; ere nesemba yane, naende nomokori emeremo amo nainche ase okobakorera inwe; naende karaganie komanya amang’ana igoro y’abaminto barabwo nabatomwa be chikanisa, naende obonene bwa Kristo.
english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker among you; as for our brothers, they are representatives of the churches and an honor to Christ.

ekegusii: “Na inwe moibore, momenteke, mosarare, mobe abange ime ase ense.”
english: As for you, be fruitful and increase in number; multiply on the earth and increase upon it."

ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’amanyinga ’okobwatana okwo nakorire naye ninsibore abasibwa bao, mbarusie ase engoro etari namache.
english: As for you, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will free your prisoners from the waterless pit.

ekegusii: “Naye Omorobiri bw’Oborendi, aye ekegoro ki’omochie o Sayoni, obogambi bwao obokoro mbokoiranere, ee, obogambi bw’omochie o Yerusalemu.”
english: As for you, O watchtower of the flock, O stronghold of the Daughter of Zion, the former dominion will be restored to you; kingship will come to the Daughter of Jerusalem."

ekegusii: Gaki onkorere inche, omosomba oo, amaya, ekiagera gwakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo nainche ase obosio bw’Omonene. Korende onye okomocha kore asende, rirorio aye omonyene ong’ite? Nase ki okong’ira ase iso, erinde ere ang’ite?”
english: As for you, show kindness to your servant, for you have brought him into a covenant with you before the LORD. If I am guilty, then kill me yourself! Why hand me over to your father?"

ekegusii: Korende ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorete korwa ase Kristo nigo goikaransete ime yaino, na inwe timogwenereti monto onde aborokererie, ekiagera ogoakwa kw’amaguta okwo mwanyorire nkoborokererie amang’ana onsi, naende kore ogw’ekeene, gose tari oborimo. Na buna aborokereretie, menya ime ya Kristo.
english: As for you, the anointing you received from him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you about all things and as that anointing is real, not counterfeit-- just as it has taught you, remain in him.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwarenge mokwete ase ogosaria kwaino, na ebibe biaino.
english: As for you, you were dead in your transgressions and sins,

ekegusii: Korende torika ababoraka batari nemiaka emenge, ekiagera ekero baranyore ebirengererio ebire ao na Kristo, nigo baraganie konyuomwa.
english: As for younger widows, do not put them on such a list. For when their sensual desires overcome their dedication to Christ, they want to marry.

ekegusii: Korende abana baino, abwo mwatebete ng’a nabooswe, aba nabwo ndaire aroro, na barabwo mbamenye ase ense eria inwe mwangire.
english: As for your children that you said would be taken as plunder, I will bring them in to enjoy the land you have rejected.

ekegusii: Nkaba nomokia bw’ogochanda ekanisa, na ase amang’ana ’oboronge bokonyorekana ase amachiko tinarenge na komocha.
english: as for zeal, persecuting the church; as for legalistic righteousness, faultless.

ekegusii: Buna yabete ekero keria Nyasae asiretie emechie ya Sodomu na Gomora, amo nemechie yarenge ang’e neyio, naboigo monto onde takomenya Babeli, gose mwanyabanto onde takomenya aroro. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah along with their neighboring towns," declares the LORD, "so no one will live there; no man will dwell in it.

ekegusii: Na intwe gatogokora emeremo amo nere, twabasoroire timonyora obuya bwa Nyasae bosa.
english: As God's fellow workers we urge you not to receive God's grace in vain.

ekegusii: Ekero obotenenku bokomentekana, boigo nabwo bakoboria nigo bakomentekana; bono mbuya ki oria omonyene akonyora, otatiga akoborora namaiso rioka?
english: As goods increase, so do those who consume them. And what benefit are they to the owner except to feast his eyes on them?

ekegusii: Agwo igo egokwanwa, “Rero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye, timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino’ buna ekero keria gi’okogechia.”
english: As has just been said: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion."

ekegusii: Agachia goika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, agatoma babere b’aborokigwa baye,
english: As he approached Bethphage and Bethany at the hill called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, saying to them,

ekegusii: As he approached Jerusalem and saw the city, he wept over it
english: Ere agachia goika ang’e akarora omochie, akayoiyereria amariga,

ekegusii: Ekero aigete Lei, Abafilisti bakaminyoka gochia asare, bagaaka eriogi bagokuura, na omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro asare, okamobeka chinguru, ne chingori echio asiberetwe amaboko chikaba buna chiusi chi’egatani chiabwatirwe nomorero, chigasansoka korwa ase amaboko aye.
english: As he approached Lehi, the Philistines came toward him shouting. The Spirit of the LORD came upon him in power. The ropes on his arms became like charred flax, and the bindings dropped from his hands.

ekegusii: Nabo, agachia goika ang’e ase egeita ki’omochie, rora, agwo nkiarengeo egetondo kebogoirie gocha isiko, omwana omomoima ase ng’ina, na ng’ina nomoboraka orenge, na abanto abange b’omochie mbarenge amo nere.
english: As he approached the town gate, a dead person was being carried out-- the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. And a large crowd from the town was with her.

ekegusii: Ekero achakire gokora omobaro akarenterwa omosomba oyomo omoriete chitalanta chilifu ikomi.
english: As he began the settlement, a man who owed him ten thousand talents was brought to him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio agacha ang’e ase nateneine; ekero aigete asende nkaondoka, nkagwa inse maumama. Korende omonto oria agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, manya ng’a okorora koria nigo gokworokia chingaki chi’omoerio.”
english: As he came near the place where I was standing, I was terrified and fell prostrate. "Son of man," he said to me, "understand that the vision concerns the time of the end."

ekegusii: As he cursed, Shimei said, "Get out, get out, you man of blood, you scoundrel!
english: Simei gakoragereria, akabora, “Karue aa! Karue aa! Aye omoiteri amanyinga! Aye omosaria!

ekegusii: Ekero akoorire gokwana, abamura b’omoruoti bakaoroka, bagaaka amariogi abo bakorera; na omoruoti boigo akarera, na abasomba baye bonsi bakarera ekerero ekenene.
english: As he finished speaking, the king's sons came in, wailing loudly. The king, too, and all his servants wept very bitterly.

ekegusii: Yusufu agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora Benjamin omwabo, omwana omwabo baruete enda eyemo nere, akababoria, “Oyo nere oria omoke omino, oria mwantebia?” Akaonchokera Benjamin, akamotebia, “Nyasae akoe obuya, omwana one!”
english: As he looked about and saw his brother Benjamin, his own mother's son, he asked, "Is this your youngest brother, the one you told me about?" And he said, "God be gracious to you, my son."

ekegusii: Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora abanto abanda bakobeka ebiegwa biabo ase ekebekerero gi’esadaka.
english: As he looked up, Jesus saw the rich putting their gifts into the temple treasury.

ekegusii: Ekero arenge kogenda, gaikire ang’e na Damesiki, erio mobosokano amasase akarwa igoro, akamomesera chinsemo chionsi.
english: As he neared Damascus on his journey, suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.

ekegusii: Naboigo akwanete ase ebuku ya Hosea, “Abanto baria batarenge abanto baane, nimbaroke abanto baane; na oyotarenge omwanchwa one, nimoroke omwanchwa one.”
english: As he says in Hosea: "I will call them 'my people' who are not my people; and I will call her 'my loved one' who is not my loved one,"

ekegusii: Ekero akwanete nainche, Omoika ogasoa ime yane, ogantenenia, erio nkamotegerera oria orenge gokwana nainche.
english: As he spoke, the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet, and I heard him speaking to me.

ekegusii: Akabatebia ase okworokereria kwaye, “Mwerende korwa ase aborokia b’amariko, abwo banchete gotaara beboyetie chianga chintambe, na gokwanigwa ase chichiiro,
english: As he taught, Jesus said, "Watch out for the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and be greeted in the marketplaces,

ekegusii: Ekero achia goeta, akarora Lawi, omwana bw’Alufayo, oikaransete aase bakobangerwa ebango, akamotebia, “Ntunyana!” Akaimoka, akamotunyana.
english: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax collector's booth. "Follow me," Jesus told him, and Levi got up and followed him.

ekegusii: Kobaikire ang’e gosoa Misiri, agatebia Sarai mokaye, “Nimanyete ng’a nigo ore omokungu omonyakieni ase okororekana;
english: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, "I know what a beautiful woman you are.

ekegusii: Ekero are gosoa omochie oyomo, akaumerana nabanto ikomi abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma, bateneine are;
english: As he was going into a village, ten men who had leprosy met him. They stood at a distance

ekegusii: Goika agachia gosoka korwa Hekalu, oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye akamotebia, “Omworokia, rora buna amagena na amaagacho aya are amaya!”
english: As he was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, "Look, Teacher! What massive stones! What magnificent buildings!"

ekegusii: Ekaba kagosaba, ekieni ki’obosio bwaye gekaonchoka, ne chianga chiaye chikaba chindabu, chikameka‐meka.
english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face changed, and his clothes became as bright as a flash of lightning.

ekegusii: Ekero are kobusura, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigacha, chigachiria,
english: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.

ekegusii: Agachia koba nkobusura are, chimbusuro chinde chikagwa ase enchera ensemo, chinyoni chigacha chigachiria.
english: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi arenge gokwana nabarabwo, Goliato, etuoni eria, Omofilisti korwa Gati, akarua aase Abafilisti baroberete, akagenda bosio, agakwana amang’ana aria anarete gokwana botambe, na Daudi akayaigwa.
english: As he was talking with them, Goliath, the Philistine champion from Gath, stepped out from his lines and shouted his usual defiance, and David heard it.

ekegusii: Yeso agachia goeta akarora omonto orenge omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye.
english: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.

ekegusii: As he went along, people spread their cloaks on the road.
english: Ere gakogenda, bakaara chianga chiabo inchera.

ekegusii: Na ekero omobani oria orwete ense ya Yuda arenge ase orogendo inchera, akaumerana nendo, ero ekamoita agakwa. Omobere oye ogatugutwa ase enchera, na etigere na endo chigatenena mbarabare ase omobere oria.
english: As he went on his way, a lion met him on the road and killed him, and his body was thrown down on the road, with both the donkey and the lion standing beside it.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana egurugura ne riberera bigokoora amache ’amagena ’embura, naboigo nabanto bakorire ebibe barairwe gochia aase abakure.
english: As heat and drought snatch away the melted snow, so the grave snatches away those who have sinned.

ekegusii: Na Paulo, buna anarete, agasoa ime aase barenge. Agwo ase Chisabato isato agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana korwa ase amariko,
english: As his custom was, Paul went into the synagogue, and on three Sabbath days he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

ekegusii: As I have observed, those who plow evil and those who sow trouble reap it.
english: Aya naroche naya: Baria bakorema obosareku, na baria bagosimeka emechando, nabagese ayio ayio.

ekegusii: Nimbanachere inwe ekina buna nanacherete chisokoro chiaino ekina, agwo ase erooro y’ense ya Misiri. Nabo inche Omonene Nyasae natebire.
english: As I judged your fathers in the desert of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Nkaigwa ogotebia abanto baria bande, “Mobwatie omonto oyio korwa nyuma, moetanane ase omochie bwonsi, moite abanto; timoombia ng’a timobarochi, gose timobarorera amabera.
english: As I listened, he said to the others, "Follow him through the city and kill, without showing pity or compassion.

ekegusii: Ekero narigereretie ebitongwa biria, nkarora amagoro ’egari ane, kera okomo kore bosio bwa kera egetongwa goteneine inse.
english: As I looked at the living creatures, I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces.

ekegusii: Buna nakoboretie ekero nare kogenda Makedonia, otigare Efeso, erinde okanie abande tiborokereria okworokereria konde okoao,
english: As I urged you when I went into Macedonia, stay there in Ephesus so that you may command certain men not to teach false doctrines any longer

ekegusii: Ekero nare korwa Padan‐Aramu, Raeli nyoko agankwera inchera gonkogenda Kanani, ritang’ani ntaraika Efarati. Nkamotindeka agwo enchera ekogenda Efarati, nao Bethlehemu.”
english: As I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died in the land of Canaan while we were still on the way, a little distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath" (that is, Bethlehem).

ekegusii: Ekero narenge ndengereretie amang’ana ayio, nkarora egoree egocha korwa bosongo, egaeta ase ense engima etari gotacha inse. Nigo yabwate orogunchara rw’ogokumia gati‐gati y’amaiso aye.
english: As I was thinking about this, suddenly a goat with a prominent horn between his eyes came from the west, crossing the whole earth without touching the ground.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora ensoti ekoiruruka igoro gati, nkayeigwa egokwana neriogi rinene, egoteba, “Obobe, Obobe, Obobe nobwabo abamenyete ase ense ase engaki y’egeturi ki’ebitureri ebi bitigarete, ebi abamalaika batato bare ang’e kobugia!”
english: As I watched, I heard an eagle that was flying in midair call out in a loud voice: "Woe! Woe! Woe to the inhabitants of the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the other three angels!"

ekegusii: As I watched, this horn was waging war against the saints and defeating them,
english: “Buna nabete ndigereretie, nkarora orogunchara roria rokarwania abachenu esegi, rokababua,

ekegusii: Ekioma nigo kegotieria ekioma kende, naboigo nomonto agotieria omonto onde.
english: As iron sharpens iron, so one man sharpens another.

ekegusii: Buna erikire ase ebuku y’amang’ana ’omobani Isaya, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro, Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.
english: As is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet: "A voice of one calling in the desert, 'Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.

ekegusii: Buna erikire, “Ase engencho yao nigo togoitwa omobaso boira; twabarirwe koba buna ching’ondi chigocha konyenwa.”
english: As it is written: "For your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered."

ekegusii: buna erikiere, “Nyasae akabaa omoika bwe chitoro, na amaiso atanyare korora, na amato atanyare koigwa, goika rero iga,”
english: as it is written: "God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes so that they could not see and ears so that they could not hear, to this very day."

ekegusii: Naki amariko nigo agoteba, “Erieta ria Nyasae nigo rikoramwa ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku ase engencho yaino.”
english: As it is written: "God's name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you."

ekegusii: buna erikire, “Osiareire ebiegwa biaye, obieire abataka, oboronge bwaye nigo boikaransete goika kare na kare.”
english: As it is written: "He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever."

ekegusii: as it is written: "He who gathered much did not have too much, and he who gathered little did not have too little."
english: Buna erikire, “Oyosangereretie ebinge tamenteiri, nere oyosangereretie ebike taremeiri.”

ekegusii: buna erikire ng’a, “Nakobekire obe ise bw’ebisaku ebinge”. Eira eye nigo yaikeranire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ere oyo Ibrahimu egenete, Nyasae oyokobokia abakure, naende aatora ebinto bitaiyo buna mbireo.
english: As it is written: "I have made you a father of many nations." He is our father in the sight of God, in whom he believed-- the God who gives life to the dead and calls things that are not as though they were.

ekegusii: buna erikire, “Rigereria, nabekire ase Sayoni rigena riragoche abanto, na egetare kerabaiyerie inse, na onde bwensi oramwegene takorora obosooku.”
english: As it is written: "See, I lay in Zion a stone that causes men to stumble and a rock that makes them fall, and the one who trusts in him will never be put to shame."

ekegusii: As it is written: "There is no one righteous, not even one;
english: buna erikire ng’a, “Onde tari omonyene oboronge, nonya noyomo;

ekegusii: Onye totatebanire nanga twairanire chintunda ibere.”
english: As it is, if we had not delayed, we could have gone and returned twice."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, bono tari inche nkoyakora, korende nebibe biria bimenyete ime asende.
english: As it is, it is no longer I myself who do it, but it is sin living in me.

ekegusii: Bono ebiimo nebinge bire, korende omobere noyomo.
english: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.

ekegusii: Ekeene obokong’u mbore asetore, aande mbarigetie gotosoera ase engencho y’eburu‐buru eye ya rero. Karabe igo, rirorio titokonyara gwekengera ase engencho y’omosangererekano oyo.”
english: As it is, we are in danger of being charged with rioting because of today's events. In that case we would not be able to account for this commotion, since there is no reason for it."

ekegusii: Korende bono morigetie kong’ita, ninche oyo nabatebirie ekeene keria naigure korwa ase Nyasae. Ibrahimu takorete igo.
english: As it is, you are determined to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.

ekegusii: Korende bono iga mogwetogia ase oboenenu bwaino. Ogwetogia gwonsi konga buna okwo nokobe.
english: As it is, you boast and brag. All such boasting is evil.

ekegusii: Korende buna amatuko aria a Nuhu abete, naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto korache koba.
english: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.

ekegusii: Na buna Yehu abete ogosoa ase egeita, omokungu oria agakuura, “Aye Simuri, aye gwaitete omonene oo, mang’ana ki?”
english: As Jehu entered the gate, she asked, "Have you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?"

ekegusii: Ekero baare korua Yeriko, omoganda omonene okamotunyana.
english: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.

ekegusii: Bagachia koba nkogenda bare, agasoa ase agachie akamo, na omokungu oyomo, erieta riaye Martha, akamoroisia nyomba mwaye.
english: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, he came to a village where a woman named Martha opened her home to him.

ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ang’e na Yeriko omonto oyomo omouko naikaransete enchera ensemo ogosaba ebiegwa.
english: As Jesus approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.

ekegusii: Goika agachia koba ogosoka kogenda enchera, omonto oyomo agacha bwango, akamotung’amera, akamoboria, “Omworokia omuya, inki ndakore inyare koba nomwando bw’obogima bwa kare na kare?”
english: As Jesus started on his way, a man ran up to him and fell on his knees before him. "Good teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

ekegusii: Ere ekero are goeta ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora Simion na Anderea, momura omwabo Simion, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, ekiagera nabarubi barenge.
english: As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.

ekegusii: Erio kegima, kagotiira korwa ase amache, akarora igoro amaanokire, na Omoika buna riruma ogoika igoro asare,
english: As Jesus was coming up out of the water, he saw heaven being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

ekegusii: Agachia koriina obwato ime, oria obwatire nebirecha akamosorora ng’a abe amo nere.
english: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.

ekegusii: Ekero agokwana aya, omokungu oyomo ase omoganda agaaka eriogi, akamotebia, “Nesesenirie enda yakobogoretie, ne chimbeere kwagongete!”
english: As Jesus was saying these things, a woman in the crowd called out, "Blessed is the mother who gave you birth and nursed you."

ekegusii: Erio gaikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni korigereria Hekalu, Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana, na Anderea, bakamoboria bobisi,
english: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John and Andrew asked him privately,

ekegusii: Gaikaransire ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera bobisi, bakamoboria, “Totebie, aya indi arabe? Naende ninki ekemanyererio ki’ogocha kwao, na ay’omoerio bw’ense?”
english: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately. "Tell us," they said, "when will this happen, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?"

ekegusii: Ekero arenge gotaara ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akarora abamura babere ba ise omo, Simion oyokorokwa Petero, na Anderea omwabo, bakoruta ekeonga enyancha ime, ekiagera nabarubi barenge.
english: As Jesus was walking beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon called Peter and his brother Andrew. They were casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia goeta korwa aroro akarora omonto oyomo okorokwa Matayo, oikaransete aase bakobangerwa ebango, akamotebia, “Ntunyana!” Akaimoka, akamotunyana.
english: As Jesus went on from there, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at the tax collector's booth. "Follow me," he told him, and Matthew got up and followed him.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso arenge goeta korwa aase aria, abanto babere abarenge emeuko bakamotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Tororere amabera, aye omwana o Daudi!”
english: As Jesus went on from there, two blind men followed him, calling out, "Have mercy on us, Son of David!"

ekegusii: Ekero Yohana abeire ang’e gokoora orogendo rwaye akabora, Nigo mokagete ng’a ninche ng’o? Inche tari Kristo. Korende nyuma yane ngocha are oyomo, ere ntaisaini gosibora ebikoroto bi’amagoro aye.
english: As John was completing his work, he said: 'Who do you think I am? I am not that one. No, but he is coming after me, whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.'

ekegusii: Na ekero bachia kogenda, Yeso agachaka gokwana nemeganda igoro ya Yohana, “Inki mwachiete korora aria ase erooro? Negetonto gekonyegerigwa nembeo?
english: As John's disciples were leaving, Jesus began to speak to the crowd about John: "What did you go out into the desert to see? A reed swayed by the wind?

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti Daudi aigete Bahurimu, omonto bw’eamate ya Saulo ore korokwa Simei, mosinto o Gera, agasoka korwa ase omochie. Ere kagocha akana‐koragereria Daudi.
english: As King David approached Bahurim, a man from the same clan as Saul's family came out from there. His name was Shimei son of Gera, and he cursed as he came out.

ekegusii: Ere agenderere koba oyotachenegeti ekero are noborwaire boria, aatananwe amenye isiko y’egetwori, ao korwa ase abanto bande.
english: As long as he has the infection he remains unclean. He must live alone; he must live outside the camp.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aye onsi eatananete koba Omwerwa taria gento kende gionsi gekoroisigwa korwa ase emesabibu. Taria nonya ne chimbusururo gose amasabo ’amasabibu.
english: As long as he is a Nazirite, he must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.

ekegusii: naende omoika bw’obomoyo ogendererete koba ime yane, na omoika o Nyasae ore ase chimioro chiane,
english: as long as I have life within me, the breath of God in my nostrils,

ekegusii: Netogwenerete tokore emeremo yaye oyontomete ekero rire mobaso; obotuko ngocha bore, omonto atanyare gokora emeremo.
english: As long as it is day, we must do the work of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work.

ekegusii: Ekaba Musa kaimokirie amaboko aye igoro, rirorio Abaisraeli babua, na kayairanirie inse, Abaameleki babua.
english: As long as Moses held up his hands, the Israelites were winning, but whenever he lowered his hands, the Amalekites were winning.

ekegusii: Nomanyete ng’a ekero mosinto o Yese agendererete koba moyo ase ense, aye tokonyara koba nomorembe, gose oboruoti tibokoba obwao. Ase ayio, toma abanto bamondetere; ere goika akwe.”
english: As long as the son of Jesse lives on this earth, neither you nor your kingdom will be established. Now send and bring him to me, for he must die!"

ekegusii: Abakuani nigo banga buna ekeombe ki’abauri keboerete abanto, nigo bagoitera abanto ase enchera ekogenda Sekemu. Ee, nigo bagokora ayare amabe mono.
english: As marauders lie in ambush for a man, so do bands of priests; they murder on the road to Shechem, committing shameful crimes.

ekegusii: buna abanto bagosangereria amagena e chifeta, na aye chitaai, na ay’ebioma, na ay’amasasi, na ay’amabati, na bayabeka ase eriko ri’omorero ase okoyanyititora. Naboigo ndabasangererie inwe inde nendamwamu na ekeririanda, imbabeke imeo mbanyititore.
english: As men gather silver, copper, iron, lead and tin into a furnace to melt it with a fiery blast, so will I gather you in my anger and my wrath and put you inside the city and melt you.

ekegusii: Ekaba abanto bakaimoka kogenda orogendo gochia ensemo ya moocha, bakanyora ense omweya ase ense ya Shinari, bagachaka komenya aroro.
english: As men moved eastward, they found a plain in Shinar and settled there.

ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia abanto baria bakaegwa ribaga baimokie chitigere chiabo, bagende sobo.
english: As morning dawned, the men were sent on their way with their donkeys.

ekegusii: Na buna Musa atebete, Kalebu akaegwa omochie o Heburoni, nere agaseria abanto batato b’ororeria rw’Anaki korwao.
english: As Moses had promised, Hebron was given to Caleb, who drove from it the three sons of Anak.

ekegusii: Agakeagacha buna Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, achigete Abaisraeli, buna arikire ase Ebuku y’Amachiko a Musa: “Egesasimero keagacheire amagena atabaachetwe negekorero gi’ekioma.” Agwo bakaruera Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na eki’omorembe.
english: as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded the Israelites. He built it according to what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses-- an altar of uncut stones, on which no iron tool had been used. On it they offered to the LORD burnt offerings and sacrificed fellowship offerings.

ekegusii: Ekero Musa asoire Eema eria, riire riare buna esiiro riba rigoika na gotenena ase egesoero ki’Eema eria, na Omonene aba ogokwana na Musa.
english: As Moses went into the tent, the pillar of cloud would come down and stay at the entrance, while the LORD spoke with Moses.

ekegusii: Onye okoboko kwane kwaigete ase amaruoti arenge gosasima emegwekano, emegwekano eyio yabombire yarenge emenene kobua eya Yerusalemu na Samaria.
english: As my hand seized the kingdoms of the idols, kingdoms whose images excelled those of Jerusalem and Samaria--

ekegusii: Nimbamentekanie babe abange buna ching’ondi chichenegete chirabe echi’ebing’wanso agwo Yerusalemu, ase engaki y’Amatuko Amanene; barabwo mbaichore ase emechie yatigetwe ere amatombe. Erio nario baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: as numerous as the flocks for offerings at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts. So will the ruined cities be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

ekegusii: Ekero Obadia arenge inchera kogenda, rora, Elija akaumerana nere. Obadia akamomanya, agatung’ama inse, akaumama, agateba, “Inee! Oyo naye Elija, omonene one?”
english: As Obadiah was walking along, Elijah met him. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down to the ground, and said, "Is it really you, my lord Elijah?"

ekegusii: Buna abana abaigweri timwereng’ania nokogania kwaino okobe kwe ritang’ani, ekero mware motamanyete gento,
english: As obedient children, do not conform to the evil desires you had when you lived in ignorance.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana emechando eyio erabe ekona‐gocha nebanyore inwe, nebe ekona‐gocha emambia ase emambia, ee, omobaso na obotuko. Nigo erabe emechando emebe y’okoondokia ase okoigwa amang’ana ayio atomirwe.
english: As often as it comes it will carry you away; morning after morning, by day and by night, it will sweep through." The understanding of this message will bring sheer terror.

ekegusii: Korende ekero oyomo obo arenge kogecha omote, egesire kegasomoka korwa ase omote, gekagwa ase amache ime. Omonto oria akarera, “Obee, omonene one! Egesire eke nigo giasabetwe korwa ase omonto onde.”
english: As one of them was cutting down a tree, the iron axhead fell into the water. "Oh, my lord," he cried out, "it was borrowed!"

ekegusii: Okoboko kwane nigo kwairete chinibo chi’abanto buna ebiswa bie chinyoni bikoirwa. Nigo nkobongania ense yonsi buna amagena e chinyoni atigirwe akobonganigwa; onde tanyegeretie orobaba rwaye, gose komaanora omonwa oye, gose kwemunyia.”
english: As one reaches into a nest, so my hand reached for the wealth of the nations; as men gather abandoned eggs, so I gathered all the countries; not one flapped a wing, or opened its mouth to chirp.'"

ekegusii: Namanyire, naende naenekirie ase Omonene Yeso, ng’a gento kende tikeri ekebe ekenyene, korende nigo kere ekebe ase oyo okeroche ng’a negento ekebe.
english: As one who is in the Lord Jesus, I am fully convinced that no food is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.

ekegusii: As part of your equipment have something to dig with, and when you relieve yourself, dig a hole and cover up your excrement.
english: Mobe mokoimokia chinyimbo amo nebirwanero biaino; ekero mogochia rosana agwo isiko y’ebitwori, mokunye chingoro ne chinyimbo chiria, na ekero mwekonyire motube obonyira namaroba.

ekegusii: Kabasokire, abanto bakabasorora bache kobatebia amang’ana aya Esabato ya kabere.
english: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people invited them to speak further about these things on the next Sabbath.

ekegusii: Ekero Paulo are gokwana amang’ana igoro y’oboronge, na okwerita, na ekina kegochi‐gocha, Feliki akaba nobwoba, akamotebia, “Ase ekero eke bono, karagenda; ekero ndanyore ribaga, ninkorangerie naende.”
english: As Paul discoursed on righteousness, self-control and the judgment to come, Felix was afraid and said, "That's enough for now! You may leave. When I find it convenient, I will send for you."

ekegusii: Ekero Petero achia gosoa omochie, Kornelio agasoka komorotota, akagwa inse ase amagoro aye, akamosasima.
english: As Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him and fell at his feet in reverence.

ekegusii: Ekero Petero are goetanana ase chinsemo chionsi, agatirimboka gochia ase abachenu abamenyete Lida.
english: As Peter traveled about the country, he went to visit the saints in Lydda.

ekegusii: Ekero Farao abeire ang’e kobaikeera, Abaisraeli bakerigereria, bakarora Abamisiri bakobabwatia korwa nyuma. Erio agwo barabwo bakaba nobwoba obonene, bakarera ase Omonene.
english: As Pharaoh approached, the Israelites looked up, and there were the Egyptians, marching after them. They were terrified and cried out to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero Samweli arenge kweonchora kogenda, Saulo akabwata omokoba bw’eanga yaye y’okwambara, nero egatandoka.
english: As Samuel turned to leave, Saul caught hold of the hem of his robe, and it tore.

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Saulo eonchorete gotigana na Samweli, Nyasae akaa Saulo enkoro ere ne chingencho ching’ao, na ebimanyererio biria bionsi bigakoreka ase rituko riria.
english: As Saul turned to leave Samuel, God changed Saul's heart, and all these signs were fulfilled that day.

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo aroche Daudi okogenda korwania Omofilisti oria akaboria Abineri, omochiki bw’emeganda y’abarwani, “Abineri, omosae oyo, noyo ng’o”? Abineri akamoiraneria, “Aye omoruoti, ekeene buna ore moyo, inche timomanyeti.”
english: As Saul watched David going out to meet the Philistine, he said to Abner, commander of the army, "Abner, whose son is that young man?" Abner replied, "As surely as you live, O king, I don't know."

ekegusii: Agwo akaba okogireka ase ogokwa; na ekero arenge ang’e ase ogokwa, akaroka omwana oyio Ben‐Oni, korende ise akamoroka Benjamin.
english: As she breathed her last-- for she was dying-- she named her son Ben-Oni. But his father named him Benjamin.

ekegusii: Ekaba Abigaeli kariinire etigere yaye na ngoeta arenge ase egekengano kiarenge inse y’egetunwa, Daudi na abanto baye bagacha korwa bosio, ekaba goika aumerane nabarabwo.
english: As she came riding her donkey into a mountain ravine, there were David and his men descending toward her, and she met them.

ekegusii: Na ekero Rutu agendete gochora ebigara naende, Boazi agachika abasomba baye, akabatebia, “Momotige achore ebigara nonya nase egati y’emesaima, timomokania.
english: As she got up to glean, Boaz gave orders to his men, "Even if she gathers among the sheaves, don't embarrass her.

ekegusii: Buna omokungu oyio agendererete gosaba Omonene, Eli akaba origereretie omonwa oye.
english: As she kept on praying to the LORD, Eli observed her mouth.

ekegusii: Gasokigwe isiko agatoma abanto ase ise biara, bamotebie, “Omonto omonyene ebinto ebi, nere ong’ete oborito obo.” Naende akabora, “Manya ebonyi eyio ere nekemanyererio, na orokini oro, na enyimbo eye, gose nebia ng’o.”
english: As she was being brought out, she sent a message to her father-in-law. "I am pregnant by the man who owns these," she said. And she added, "See if you recognize whose seal and cord and staff these are."

ekegusii: Ekero arenge ang’e nogokwa, abakungu abarenge komokonya ase okomoiboria bakamotebia, “Toiroka, ekiagera kwaiboire omwana omomura.” Korende omokungu oria tabairaneria gento, gose tategerera amang’ana abo.
english: As she was dying, the women attending her said, "Don't despair; you have given birth to a son." But she did not respond or pay any attention.

ekegusii: As she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on his wrist and said, "This one came out first."
english: Ekero arenge koibora, omwana oyomo agatang’ania okoboko isiko, na omoiboria akamosibera okoboko okwo eusi embariri, agateba, “Oyo nere otanga gosoka isiko.”

ekegusii: Ekero omokungu oria arenge kogenda korenta amache, akamorangeria naende, akamotebia, “Ondetere negesamunye ki’omogati.”
english: As she was going to get it, he called, "And bring me, please, a piece of bread."

ekegusii: Buna efeta ekonyititorwa ase eriko ri’omorero naboigo nainwe moranyititorwe ase egati‐gati y’omochie oyio; erio momanye ng’a ninche Omonene naumoire endamwamu yane igoro asemore.”
english: As silver is melted in a furnace, so you will be melted inside her, and you will know that I the LORD have poured out my wrath upon you.'"

ekegusii: Na Simion Petero nigo arenge oteneine ogwota omorero. Bakamotebia, “Aye boigo tori oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye?” Ere agakana, akabora, “Tari inche.”
english: As Simon Peter stood warming himself, he was asked, "You are not one of his disciples, are you?" He denied it, saying, "I am not."

ekegusii: Tiga baserigwe gochia aare, buna erioki rikoirwa aare; abakori amabe tiga basirigwe barue ase obosio bwa Nyasae, basirigwe buna obochoe bokonyititoka ase omorero.
english: As smoke is blown away by the wind, may you blow them away; as wax melts before the fire, may the wicked perish before God.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba ng’a koreng’ana buna Sodomu na Gomora na emechie yarenge ang’e noro yasiretigwe, naboigo Edomu orasirigwe; monto onde takomenya aroro, gose omoeti takogobera aroro.
english: As Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown, along with their neighboring towns," says the LORD, "so no one will live there; no man will dwell in it.

ekegusii: Ee, ekero Sulemani konya agotire, abakungu baye bakaonchora enkoro yaye gochia ase chinyasae chinde, na ere tabete omwegenwa ase Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Daudi ise arenge nenkoro y’obwegenwa.
english: As Solomon grew old, his wives turned his heart after other gods, and his heart was not fully devoted to the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father had been.

ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi, ogachia komorora, ogakumia mono; abwo bakamochiera bwango, bakamokwania.
english: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were overwhelmed with wonder and ran to greet him.

ekegusii: Erio ekero Daudi arenge koirana ase egetwori gaitire Omofilisti oria, Abineri akamoira ase Saulo, Daudi nigo abogoretie omotwe o Goliato koboko kwaye.
english: As soon as David returned from killing the Philistine, Abner took him and brought him before Saul, with David still holding the Philistine's head.

ekegusii: Ekero achagete kogamba, ase obwango boria ere ebegete omonyene goikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti, agaita abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Baasa, tatigaretie omonto omosacha nonya noyomo ase eamate yaye gose ase abasani baye.
english: As soon as he began to reign and was seated on the throne, he killed off Baasha's whole family. He did not spare a single male, whether relative or friend.

ekegusii: Na obwango boria abete omoruoti, agaita abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yeroboamu, tatigaretie nonya nomonto oyomo ore moyo ase abanto baye, korende akabasiria kegima, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase omosomba oye Ahiya, omonto korwa Silo.
english: As soon as he began to reign, he killed Jeroboam's whole family. He did not leave Jeroboam anyone that breathed, but destroyed them all, according to the word of the LORD given through his servant Ahijah the Shilonite--

ekegusii: Bwango ekero Yoshua aramborete okoboko kwaye, abarwani baria bakaimoka korwa ase baboete bakaminyoka gochia ase omochie, bakayobwata. Erio bwango bakayosamba nomorero.
english: As soon as he did this, the men in the ambush rose quickly from their position and rushed forward. They entered the city and captured it and quickly set it on fire.

ekegusii: As soon as he finished saying all this, the ground under them split apart
english: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya onsi, riroba rigatandoka inse yabo.

ekegusii: Kondatome Artema gose Tukiko gocha asore, teema buna oranyare gocha asende aria Nikopoli bwango, naki nindengereretie komenya aroro ekero ki’obokendu.
english: As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis, because I have decided to winter there.

ekegusii: Erio bwango ase obotuko boria abaminto bagatoma Paulo na Sila gochia Beroya. Kobaikire aroro, bagasoa ase esinagogi y’Abayahudi.
english: As soon as it was night, the brothers sent Paul and Silas away to Berea. On arriving there, they went to the Jewish synagogue.
