ekegusii: Ekero Yehu akoorete korua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, agatebia abarendi na abatang’ani, “Soa ime, mobaite, timotiga onde atooreke.” Kobaitire nemioro, abarendi na abatang’ani bakabatuguta isiko. Erio bagasoa akanyomba ka ime k’enyomba ya Baali,
english: As soon as Jehu had finished making the burnt offering, he ordered the guards and officers: "Go in and kill them; let no one escape." So they cut them down with the sword. The guards and officers threw the bodies out and then entered the inner shrine of the temple of Baal.

ekegusii: Na Yeso, ekero abatisirwe, erio kegima agatiira korwa ase amache; na rora, igoro akamaanoka, na ere akarora Omoika o Nyasae ogoika buna riruma, ogocha igoro asare.
english: As soon as Jesus was baptized, he went up out of the water. At that moment heaven was opened, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and lighting on him.

ekegusii: Ase obwango ekero Yesebeli aigwete ng’a Naboti oakirwe amagena okure, agatebia Ahabu, “Imoka, oire omogondo bw’emesabibu o Naboti, Omoyesireeli, oria angete gokoa omoe chibesa, ekiagera bono tari moyo, okure.”
english: As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, "Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite that he refused to sell you. He is no longer alive, but dead."

ekegusii: Yusufu, ekero abarora, akabamanya, korende agekora buna tabamanyeti, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amakong’u. Akababoria, “Abanto aba, ng’ai mwarure?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Nigo twarure ase ense ya Kanani, twachire kogora endagera.”
english: As soon as Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he pretended to be a stranger and spoke harshly to them. "Where do you come from?" he asked. "From the land of Canaan," they replied, "to buy food."

ekegusii: Nabo oyo, kanyorire egesamunye keria agasoka bwango; na igo bwarenge botuko.
english: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.

ekegusii: Naende nyuma kanyorire egesamunye keria, Saitani akamosoa. Erio Yeso akamotebia, “Aya ogokora, yakore bwango.”
english: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. "What you are about to do, do quickly," Jesus told him,

ekegusii: As soon as Laban heard the news about Jacob, his sister's son, he hurried to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, and there Jacob told him all these things.
english: Ekero Labani achia koigwa amang’ana a Yakobo, omoigwa oye, akaminyoka gochia komorotota, akamoboania na komonyunyunta, akamoira nka bwoye. Yakobo agatebia Labani amang’ana onsi.

ekegusii: akaba nokogania okobe asebare, agatoma abanto ase ense ya Kalidayo ase abanene abwo konya arorire emegwekano yabo.
english: As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.

ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na abarendi bagachia komorora, bagaaka eriogi, bakobora, “Mobambe! Mobambe!” Pilato akabatebia, “Moire inwe, momobambe, ekiagera inche tindochi okomocha asare.”
english: As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, "Crucify! Crucify!" But Pilate answered, "You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him."

ekegusii: Erio ekero rirube ri’omoruoti Aritasasita riasometwe ase Rehumu, na ase Simusai omoriki, na ase abanto abwo babwatanete nabarabwo, barabwo bakagenda Yerusalemu bwango kegima ase Abayahudi, na ase chinguru bakababetereria ng’a tibagenderera koagacha.
english: As soon as the copy of the letter of King Artaxerxes was read to Rehum and Shimshai the secretary and their associates, they went immediately to the Jews in Jerusalem and compelled them by force to stop.

ekegusii: Na endagera koyamire, bwango nigo akoira omoyio okogesa, ekiagera rigesa riaikire ang’e.”
english: As soon as the grain is ripe, he puts the sickle to it, because the harvest has come."

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli asomete rirube riria, agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Inee! Inche Nyasae inde? Inde nokobua kw’ogoita na korenta moyo, erinde omonto oyo otoma amang’ana asende ng’a ngwenie omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma? Rigereria monyare korora ng’a omoruoti oyo nigo arigetie eriomana asende.”
english: As soon as the king of Israel read the letter, he tore his robes and said, "Am I God? Can I kill and bring back to life? Why does this fellow send someone to me to be cured of his leprosy? See how he is trying to pick a quarrel with me!"

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli baigwete amang’ana omoruoti achigete, bakaba abaango korenta okwama kwe ritang’ani gwe chindagera, na okw’edivai, na okw’amaguta ’amazeituni, na okw’amooke, na okwama konde gwonsi kw’emegondo. Boigo bakarenta ensemo ya ikomi ya kera egento ase obonge.
english: As soon as the order went out, the Israelites generously gave the firstfruits of their grain, new wine, oil and honey and all that the fields produced. They brought a great amount, a tithe of everything.

ekegusii: Ekiagera rora, eriogi ri’ogokwania kwao riachia gosoa ase amato aane, omwana omoke otuma ase omosasoko ase enda yane ime.
english: As soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.

ekegusii: Bagachia gosoka korwa ase obwato, abanto bakamomanya bwango,
english: As soon as they got out of the boat, people recognized Jesus.

ekegusii: Ekero babasokirie isiko, oyomo obo akabatebia, “Tama, motoorie obogima bwaino; timorigereria nyuma, gose timotenena aande onsi ase ense eraire. Motame gochia ase ebitunwa, timobaisa gosira.”
english: As soon as they had brought them out, one of them said, "Flee for your lives! Don't look back, and don't stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains or you will be swept away!"

ekegusii: Ekero baigure chinkuma chiane nigo bakonyigwera; abamenyi nigo bagocha bebeka inse yane.
english: As soon as they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cringe before me.

ekegusii: Erio agwo kobasokire korwa ase esinagogi, bagasoa nyomba mwa Simion na Anderea, amo na Yakobo na Yohana.
english: As soon as they left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.

ekegusii: Ekero gwachagete ogosorora kwao, ring’ana rikaruegwa, na bono inche nachire gokoritebia, ekiagera aye nigo bwanchire mono; ase ayio rengereria igoro ye ring’ana riria, na omanye engencho y’okorora koria.
english: As soon as you began to pray, an answer was given, which I have come to tell you, for you are highly esteemed. Therefore, consider the message and understand the vision:

ekegusii: Ekero mogosoa ase omochie namomonyore ritang’ani ataratiira gochia ase ekegoro koragera. Abanto tibakoragera ritang’ani ataraikao, ekiagera ere goika asesenie ekeng’wanso keria. Erio baria barangeirie banyare gochaka koragera. Ase ayio, genda bwango, ekiagera ase engaki eye nero moramonyore.”
english: As soon as you enter the town, you will find him before he goes up to the high place to eat. The people will not begin eating until he comes, because he must bless the sacrifice; afterward, those who are invited will eat. Go up now; you should find him about this time."

ekegusii: Na ekero oraigwe ebititiro bigoeta ase emete eyio igoro, erio ogende korwana esegi; omanye ng’a Nyasae ogotang’aneire kobua abarwani b’Abafilisti.”
english: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move out to battle, because that will mean God has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."

ekegusii: Ekero oraigwe eriogi ri’ebititiro bigoeta igoro ase emete eyio, erio bwebeke ang’e, omanye ng’a inche Omonene nasokire, nagotang’anire kobua abarwani b’Abafilisti.”
english: As soon as you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, move quickly, because that will mean the LORD has gone out in front of you to strike the Philistine army."

ekegusii: ng’a ekero moraigwe eriogi ri’ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amarandi, na amariogi a kera egento ki’amatera, goika motung’ame inse, mosasime omogwekano bw’etahabu, oria Nebukadinesaro omoruoti atenenirie.
english: As soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes and all kinds of music, you must fall down and worship the image of gold that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ching’ondi chiane chiabeire chigotwarwa na koba endagera ya kera eng’iti y’orosana, ekiagera omorisia ataiyo, naende abarisia baane tibagendeti korigia ching’ondi chiane, korende babeire bakwerageria boka abanyene, na tari ching’ondi chiane bakorageria.
english: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, because my flock lacks a shepherd and so has been plundered and has become food for all the wild animals, and because my shepherds did not search for my flock but cared for themselves rather than for my flock,

ekegusii: nonya Nuhu, na Danieli, na Ayubu barenge kobao, ekeene, buna inche Omonene Nyasae inde moyo, oboronge bwabo tibware gotooria abana bareo, abamura gose abaiseke, otatiga mbarabwo boka bware gotooria.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, even if Noah, Daniel and Job were in it, they could save neither son nor daughter. They would save only themselves by their righteousness.

ekegusii: nonya abanto abwo batato barenge koba ase ense eyio, ekeene, buna inche Omonene Nyasae inde moyo, tibare konyara gotooria abana bareo, abamura gose abaiseke. Mbarabwo boka baare gotoorigwa, korende ense ero esarigwe ebe bosa.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved, but the land would be desolate.

ekegusii: nonya abanto abwo batato barenge kobao, ekeene, buna inche Omonene Nyasae inde moyo, tibare konyara gotooria abana bareo, abamura gose abaiseke, korende mbarabwo boka baare gotoorigwa.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, even if these three men were in it, they could not save their own sons or daughters. They alone would be saved.

ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, nindambore okoboko kwane kore nokobua na ning’umore ekeririanda kiane, nimbe nkobagambera inwe.
english: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will rule over you with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.

ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, Sodomu, mosubati omino, na abaiseke baye, tibarakora buna aye gwakorire amo nabaiseke bao.
english: As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, your sister Sodom and her daughters never did what you and your daughters have done.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna obogima bwao bwabete obw’engencho enene asende rituko ria rero, naboigo obogima bwane bore ase obosio bw’Omonene; ere nantoorie korwa ase emechando yonsi.”
english: As surely as I valued your life today, so may the LORD value my life and deliver me from all trouble."

ekegusii: Naende Daudi akabora, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, Omonene omonyene nere oraite Saulo, gose rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye nariike, gose nagende ase esegi na goitwa akwe.
english: As surely as the LORD lives," he said, "the LORD himself will strike him; either his time will come and he will die, or he will go into battle and perish.

ekegusii: Ekeene, buna Omonene, are moyo, oyo ogotooria Abaisraeli, neba ng’a Yonathani, omwana one, okorire ebibe ebio, ere goika aitwe akwe.” Korende monto onde tamoiraneretie, nonya noyomo.
english: As surely as the LORD who rescues Israel lives, even if it lies with my son Jonathan, he must die." But not one of the men said a word.

ekegusii: Ekeene, buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, are moyo, gesaku kende tikeri, gose oboruoti, aase omonene one ataratoma abanto gochia gokorigia. Na ekero abanto b’aroro baare gokana bagoteba: Ere tari aiga, omoruoti nigo are kobaboria barie emuma y’ogwetiania, ng’a ekeene tibana gokorora.
english: As surely as the LORD your God lives, there is not a nation or kingdom where my master has not sent someone to look for you. And whenever a nation or kingdom claimed you were not there, he made them swear they could not find you.

ekegusii: Naende buna ekeene gia Kristo kere ime asende, omonto tari oranyare gontanga ase ogwetogia okwo ase chinsemo chi’Akaya.
english: As surely as the truth of Christ is in me, nobody in the regions of Achaia will stop this boasting of mine.

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene yare korentwa ase Omochie o Daudi, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Daudi omoruoti ogocharoka‐charoka na gotenga ore nomogoko, akamochaya ase omoyo oye ime.
english: As the ark of the covenant of the LORD was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David dancing and celebrating, she despised him in her heart.

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Esanduku eria y’Omonene yare korentwa ase Omochie o Daudi, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Daudi omoruoti ogocharoka‐charoka na gotenga ase obosio bw’Omonene, akamochaya ase omoyo oye ime.
english: As the ark of the LORD was entering the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul watched from a window. And when she saw King David leaping and dancing before the LORD, she despised him in her heart.

ekegusii: Naki buna omobere otari nomoika nigo okwete, naboigo nokwegena gotari nogokora nigo gokwete.
english: As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.

ekegusii: Ekero emeganda yamentekanete, agachaka gokwana, “Ekegori eke nekegori ekebe, gekorigia egekone buna ekemanyererio, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga eki’omobani Yona.
english: As the crowds increased, Jesus said, "This is a wicked generation. It asks for a miraculous sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.

ekegusii: Buna abanto b’ororeria rw’Esau, abamenyete Seiri, na Abamoabu, abamenyete Ari, bankorerete, naye onkorere boigo, goika imbe nambokire orooche rwa Yorodan, na nasoire ase ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oito, agochia gotoa.
english: as the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir, and the Moabites, who live in Ar, did for us-- until we cross the Jordan into the land the LORD our God is giving us."

ekegusii: Ekero Abasiiria bachete korwania Elisha, nere agasaba Omonene, akabora, “Nagosabire, oukorie abanto aba.” Ase ayio Omonene akabaukoria koreng’ana buna Elisha asabete.
english: As the enemy came down toward him, Elisha prayed to the LORD, "Strike these people with blindness." So he struck them with blindness, as Elisha had asked.

ekegusii: Rora buna abasomba basemeretie omonene obo, na abasomba abaiseke basemeretie omokungu ore omonene obo; naboigo naintwe tosemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oito, goika abe otororeire amabera.
english: As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD our God, till he shows us his mercy.

ekegusii: Ekero omorero orenge gwoka gochia igoro korwa ase egesasimero, Omomalaika bw’Omonene agatiirera ime y’omorero oria, na ekero Manoa na mokaye baroche ayio, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.
english: As the flame blazed up from the altar toward heaven, the angel of the LORD ascended in the flame. Seeing this, Manoah and his wife fell with their faces to the ground.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana igoro ere aare mono etatukwe emanywe, na ayare ase ense inse boigo, ne chinkoro chi’abaruoti tichigotukwa chimanywe.
english: As the heavens are high and the earth is deep, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli arenge gotaara ase orwaki igoro, omokungu oyomo akarera asare, agateba, “Aye omoruoti, omonene one, inkonye!”
english: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, "Help me, my lord the king!"

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti arenge goeta ase enchera eria, omobani oria akarera asare, akamotebia, “Inche omosomba oo nagendete ase esegi, na rora, omorwani bw’esegi agacha akarentana omonto asende, agantebia: Renda omonto oyo, aise gosira ase enchera ende yonsi, obogima bwao nabobe ribaga ri’obwaye, gose oakane rigori ri’etalanta eyemo y’efeta.
english: As the king passed by, the prophet called out to him, "Your servant went into the thick of the battle, and someone came to me with a captive and said, 'Guard this man. If he is missing, it will be your life for his life, or you must pay a talent of silver.'

ekegusii: Buna Omonene achigete Musa, omosomba oye, naboigo Musa achigete Yoshua. Na Yoshua agakora ayio onsi, tatigete kende gionsi ase ayio onsi Omonene achigete Musa.
english: As the LORD commanded his servant Moses, so Moses commanded Joshua, and Joshua did it; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Buna Omonene achigete Musa, naboigo Haroni ayebegete bosio bw’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, ekagachwao.
english: As the LORD commanded Moses, Aaron put the manna in front of the Testimony, that it might be kept.

ekegusii: Musa akabara abanto abwo na kobarika, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, buna Omonene konya amochikire.
english: as the LORD commanded Moses. And so he counted them in the Desert of Sinai:

ekegusii: Ekio nakebe ekemanyererio ki’ogokurera Abaisraeli, ng’a nonya noyomo otari omokuani, otari bw’ororeria rwa Haroni, tabaisa goika ang’e gosamba ubani ase obosio bw’Omonene. Aise gokora bo, nasire buna Kora amo nabanto baria bamobwatetie basirete. Aya onsi nigo akoretwe buna Omonene konya achikire Eleazari goetera ase Musa.
english: as the LORD directed him through Moses. This was to remind the Israelites that no one except a descendant of Aaron should come to burn incense before the LORD, or he would become like Korah and his followers.

ekegusii: Na buna Omonene achigete bakamoa omochie oria aboretie, noro Timunati‐Sera ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu. Erio Yoshua akaagacha omochie oria okaba omoyia, akamenya aroro.
english: as the LORD had commanded. They gave him the town he asked for-- Timnath Serah in the hill country of Ephraim. And he built up the town and settled there.

ekegusii: na buna Omonene atebete, agasakora chinibo chionsi chi’enyomba y’Omonene, na echi’enyomba y’omoruoti. Agaata ebikorero bionsi bie chitahabu ebiarenge ime ase Hekalu y’Omonene, biria Sulemani, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, aroisetie.
english: As the LORD had declared, Nebuchadnezzar removed all the treasures from the temple of the LORD and from the royal palace, and took away all the gold articles that Solomon king of Israel had made for the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana Omonene abeire amo naye, omonene one, naboigo abe amo na Sulemani, erio akore ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti kebe ekenene goetania ekerogo kiao aye omoruoti Daudi, omonene one.”
english: As the LORD was with my lord the king, so may he be with Solomon to make his throne even greater than the throne of my lord King David!"

ekegusii: Omonto oria nigo abwate emoti y’okorengera, akagenda, akabwatia orooche gochia moocha, akarenga obotambe bw’amaboko elifu eyemo, na agwo akanyambokia ase amache, na amache aria akaang’ika ase ebitarenge bi’amagoro.
english: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand, he measured off a thousand cubits and then led me through water that was ankle-deep.

ekegusii: Abanto aba bakagenda gwata ense buna Yoshua abachigete na kobatebereria, “Genda motaare ase ense engima, mworokie ase okorika buna ense eyio ere. Erio moirane asende, na inche nimbaakere obomera ase okoboria Omonene aiga Silo.”
english: As the men started on their way to map out the land, Joshua instructed them, "Go and make a survey of the land and write a description of it. Then return to me, and I will cast lots for you here at Shiloh in the presence of the LORD."

ekegusii: Ekero abanto aba baare korua asare, Petero agatebia Yeso, “Omonene, imbuya intwe koba aiga; tokore ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, na ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija”; tamanyete aya agokwana.
english: As the men were leaving Jesus, Peter said to him, "Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters-- one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah." (He did not know what he was saying.)

ekegusii: Buna ebitunwa bietanaine Yerusalemu, naboigo n’Omonene aetanaine abanto baye korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people both now and forevermore.

ekegusii: Abanto abakoro nigo bagokwana iga: Obobe nigo bogosoka korwa ase abakori amabe. Ase ayio amaboko aane takogokorera bobe bonde.
english: As the old saying goes, 'From evildoers come evil deeds,' so my hand will not touch you.

ekegusii: Omofilisti oria agachaka kogenda goikera Daudi ang’e, erio Daudi akaminyoka bwango gochia ase abarwani koumerana n’Omofilisti oria.
english: As the Philistine moved closer to attack him, David ran quickly toward the battle line to meet him.

ekegusii: Abanene b’Abafilisti bagacha bagaeta baare nebiombe biabo bi’abanto amagana ne chilifu. Daudi na abanto baye bakaba bakorwa nyuma amo n’Akisi.
english: As the Philistine rulers marched with their units of hundreds and thousands, David and his men were marching at the rear with Achish.

ekegusii: “Buna embura na amagena ’embura bigotwa korwa igoro, na tibikoirana gochia igoro, korende nigo bikonyiyia riroba, erinde ebimeri biamera na kwama, erio ense yama chimbusuro chikobusurwa, na endagera ekoriegwa,
english: As the rain and the snow come down from heaven, and do not return to it without watering the earth and making it bud and flourish, so that it yields seed for the sower and bread for the eater,

ekegusii: Amariko nigo agoteba, “Onde bwensi oramwegene takeorora obosooku.”
english: As the Scripture says, "Anyone who trusts in him will never be put to shame."

ekegusii: Na Paulo, ekero aikigwe ang’e gosoigwa ime ase enyomba y’abarwani, akaboria omotang’ani oria omonene, “Ninyore ribaga ngotebie ring’ana?” Omotang’ani oria akabora, “Inee! Nomanyete Ekegiriki?
english: As the soldiers were about to take Paul into the barracks, he asked the commander, "May I say something to you?" "Do you speak Greek?" he replied.

ekegusii: Na ekero erioba riabeire ang’e kogwa, okoraria gokaigugwa ase abarwani b’esegi, kogateba, “Kera omonto tiga agende ase omochie oye na ase ense yaye!”
english: As the sun was setting, a cry spread through the army: "Every man to his town; everyone to his land!"

ekegusii: Erioba koriabeire ang’e kogwa, Aburamu akabwatwa ne chitoro chindito, na obwoba obonene mono bokamosoa.
english: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a thick and dreadful darkness came over him.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye aika ang’e kogenda igoro, akamanora kogenda Yerusalemu.
english: As the time approached for him to be taken up to heaven, Jesus resolutely set out for Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Amatuko ayio naro Abayahudi barabe bakoinyora buna banyorete obotoereru na ogotooreka korwa ase ababisa babo, na buna omotienyi oyio emechando yabo yaonchoretwe ekaba omogoko, na omoichano obo okaba omochengo. Ase ayio babe bagokora amatuko ayio abe ay’omoyega na ay’omogoko, amatuko ay’ogotomerana ebiegwa bi’endagera babe bakoroisia naende bae abataka ebiegwa.
english: as the time when the Jews got relief from their enemies, and as the month when their sorrow was turned into joy and their mourning into a day of celebration. He wrote them to observe the days as days of feasting and joy and giving presents of food to one another and gifts to the poor.

ekegusii: Na buna ebiara bi’amagoro biarenge ekeng’ese ki’ebioma na ekeng’ese ki’amaroba, naboigo oboruoti boria borabe obokong’u ensemo eyemo, na ensemo ende obworo.
english: As the toes were partly iron and partly clay, so this kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage na Bethania, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, agatoma babere b’aborokigwa baye,
english: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples,

ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika ang’e na Yerusalemu, bagaika Betifage, ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni. Erio Yeso agatoma aborokigwa baye babere,
english: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,

ekegusii: Bagaika omochie oria ase baare kogenda, na ere agekora buna nigo arigetie kobaetania.
english: As they approached the village to which they were going, Jesus acted as if he were going farther.

ekegusii: Ekero bachagete gotera na gotogia, Omonene agatoma abanto bakaumokera Abaamoni, na Abamoabu, na abanto b’ebigoro bia Seiri abwo bachete korwania Abayuda bagasirigwa kegima.
english: As they began to sing and praise, the LORD set ambushes against the men of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir who were invading Judah, and they were defeated.

ekegusii: Abakungu bakaba bagotera, bakobora, “Saulo oitire chilifu chiaye, korende Daudi oitire chilifu chiaye emerongo na emerongo.”
english: As they danced, they sang: "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands."

ekegusii: Bakanywa edivai na bagatogia chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na ebioma, na emete, na amagena.
english: As they drank the wine, they praised the gods of gold and silver, of bronze, iron, wood and stone.

ekegusii: Bagasoa oboina ime, bakarora omomura oikaransete ensemo y’okorio, bweboyetie eanga endabu, bagaichana.
english: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaamori barenge gotama Abaisraeli, na kobaikire egetirimboko gekorua Beti‐Horoni, Nyasae akabaiyereria amagena ’embura amanene mono korwa igoro ase enchera yabo goika omochie bw’Aseka, nabarabwo bagakwa. Abwo baitetwe namagena ’embura nigo barenge abange kobua abwo baitetwe n’Abaisraeli.
english: As they fled before Israel on the road down from Beth Horon to Azekah, the LORD hurled large hailstones down on them from the sky, and more of them died from the hailstones than were killed by the swords of the Israelites.

ekegusii: Ekero abwo bakorigia abakwete, barabe bagoeta ase ense eyio, kobaranyore riuga ri’omonto okwete, goika batenenie ekemanyererio aroro goika abwo bagotindeka bachie koritindeka ase Rigoko ri’Emeganda ya Gogi.
english: As they go through the land and one of them sees a human bone, he will set up a marker beside it until the gravediggers have buried it in the Valley of Hamon Gog.

ekegusii: Korwa ekero keria nabarusetie Misiri goika rero iga bantigire inche, babeire bagokorera chinyasae ching’ao, na bono bagotigire aye buna bantigete inche.
english: As they have done from the day I brought them up out of Egypt until this day, forsaking me and serving other gods, so they are doing to you.

ekegusii: Bagachia komoira, bakabwata Simion Omokurene, oyorenge korwa borabu, bakamotweka omosalaba, ayobogorie nyuma ya Yeso.
english: As they led him away, they seized Simon from Cyrene, who was on his way in from the country, and put the cross on him and made him carry it behind Jesus.

ekegusii: Ekero bagotera na bagotenga nigo bagoteba, “Chinsoko chiaito chionsi nigo chire ime yao.”
english: As they make music they will sing, "All my fountains are in you."

ekegusii: Ekero amagoro ayio arenge kogenda, nigo arenge kogenda ase chinsemo inye chionsi, tarenge koonchoka, akaba akogenda gochia bosio rioka, korende ase okogoro kwa bosio kwarenge kogenda gochia, onsi nigo arenge kobwatia gochiao atari koonchoka ekero akogenda.
english: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the cherubim faced; the wheels did not turn about as the cherubim went. The cherubim went in whatever direction the head faced, without turning as they went.

ekegusii: Ekero amagoro ayio arenge kogenda, nigo arenge kogenda ase chinsemo inye chionsi, tarenge koonchoka, akaba akogenda gochia bosio rioka.
english: As they moved, they would go in any one of the four directions the creatures faced; the wheels did not turn about as the creatures went.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo bagoeta ase Rigoko ria Baka, nigo bakorikora riaba aase e chinsoko chi’amache; na embura ye ritang’ani nigo ekorirentera ogosesenigwa okonge.
english: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; the autumn rains also cover it with pools.

ekegusii: Kobachia kogenda, akarara chitoro; omwaga ogacha, na emerindo ase enyancha, obwato bogachaka goichorwa namache, bakaba ase emechando.
english: As they sailed, he fell asleep. A squall came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.

ekegusii: Erio bagaikaransa inse koragera; bagachia koimokia amaiso abo korigereria, bakarora omoganda bw’Abaisumaeli ogocha korwa Gileadi. Barabwo nigo baare ne chingamia chiabo, chibogoretie ubani, na amaguta akogwenia, na manemane, ase orogendo rwabo baare kogenda Misiri.
english: As they sat down to eat their meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were loaded with spices, balm and myrrh, and they were on their way to take them down to Egypt.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Mika bagaaka amariogi na gokuura. Abadani bakeonchora, bakaboria Mika, “Ninki gekogochanda goika ogotobwatia nomoganda ogokuura buna iga?”
english: As they shouted after them, the Danites turned and said to Micah, "What's the matter with you that you called out your men to fight?"

ekegusii: Korende ekero bamosibire engori, Paulo akaboria omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, oyo oteneine ang’e nere, “Inee! Mboronge kong’wania omonto Omorumi emecharichi, na ere ataranacherwa ekina?”
english: As they stretched him out to flog him, Paul said to the centurion standing there, "Is it legal for you to flog a Roman citizen who hasn't even been found guilty?"

ekegusii: As they talked and discussed these things with each other, Jesus himself came up and walked along with them;
english: Kabagokwana na koborania, Yeso omonyene agaika ang’e, akagenda amo nabarabwo.

ekegusii: Ekero bagendererete inchera, bagaika aase amache arenge. Oria omogomba akabora, “Rora amache aya! Inki kegontanga timbatiswa?” [
english: As they traveled along the road, they came to some water and the eunuch said, "Look, here is water. Why shouldn't I be baptized?"

ekegusii: Nabo ekero barenge goeta egati y’emechie eria, bakabaa amachiko aria ayachigetwe nabatomwa na abagaaka abarenge Yerusalemu, erinde bayabwate.
english: As they traveled from town to town, they delivered the decisions reached by the apostles and elders in Jerusalem for the people to obey.

ekegusii: Abatigarete bakeonchora, bagatama gochia erooro ase egetare kia Rimoni. Abanto chilifu isano bagaitwa ekero baare ase enchera gotama. Abaisraeli bakabwatia abatigarete naende goika Gidomi, na abanto chilifu ibere bagaitwa.
english: As they turned and fled toward the desert to the rock of Rimmon, the Israelites cut down five thousand men along the roads. They kept pressing after the Benjamites as far as Gidom and struck down two thousand more.

ekegusii: Ekero barabe bagokoreera, mbabokie amagombo ase engencho yao, babe bagoteba: Mochie ki onga buna Turo, oyo okirigwe bono agwo ase egati y’enyancha?
english: As they wail and mourn over you, they will take up a lament concerning you: "Who was ever silenced like Tyre, surrounded by the sea?"

ekegusii: Kabagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa akabakania tibatebia monto ayabaroche, goika Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto kabokire korwa ase abakure.
english: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus gave them orders not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

ekegusii: Kobagotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, Yeso akabachika, akabora, “Timotebia monto onde okorora oko goika Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto aboke korwa ase abakure.”
english: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus instructed them, "Don't tell anyone what you have seen, until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead."

ekegusii: Ekero baare konywa edivai, omoruoti akaboria Esteri, “Ninki origetie? Ekio nokeegwe. Ninki oganetie? Nakeba nonya nekeng’ese ki’oboruoti bwane, nokeegwe.”
english: As they were drinking wine, the king again asked Esther, "Now what is your petition? It will be given you. And what is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be granted."

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero baumorete endagera korwa ase chigunia, bakanyora kera oyomo esaro ye chibesa chiaye nao ere egunia yaye ime. Na ekero barabwo amo na ise baroche chisaro chie chibesa chiabo, bakaondoka.
english: As they were emptying their sacks, there in each man's sack was his pouch of silver! When they and their father saw the money pouches, they were frightened.

ekegusii: As they were going down to the edge of the town, Samuel said to Saul, "Tell the servant to go on ahead of us"-- and the servant did so-- "but you stay here awhile, so that I may give you a message from God."
english: Ekero baikire ang’e nensinyo y’omochie, Samweli agatebia Saulo, “Tebia omosomba oo aete atang’ane.” Omosomba oria akagenda bosio, na Samweli agatebia Saulo, “Beera aiga ake igo, na inche ningotebie amang’ana aya Nyasae akwanire.”

ekegusii: Kobagosoka korwa ase omochie, bakarora omonto oyomo, Omokurene, okorokwa Simion; bakabetereria omonto oyio abogorerie Yeso omosalaba.
english: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.

ekegusii: Ekero barenge gotiira ekegoro gochia ase omochie, bakaumerana nabaiseke baare kogenda kobuucha amache, bakababoria, “Inee! Omorori nao are aa?”
english: As they were going up the hill to the town, they met some girls coming out to draw water, and they asked them, "Is the seer here?"

ekegusii: Bagachia kona‐goaka egeturi na gotandora chianga chiabo na gosiara‐siara ebuse gochia igoro.
english: As they were shouting and throwing off their cloaks and flinging dust into the air,

ekegusii: Ekero baare gosibora emori eria y’etigere, abanyene bakababoria, “Nase ki mogosibora emori?”
english: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, "Why are you untying the colt?"

ekegusii: Buna barenge bagendererete ase orogendo rwabo, bakaba bagokwana amo, erio mobosokano egari y’omorero ne chibarasi chi’omorero chikabaatanana baria babere; na Elija akairwa igoro nekerambauti.
english: As they were walking along and talking together, suddenly a chariot of fire and horses of fire appeared and separated the two of them, and Elijah went up to heaven in a whirlwind.

ekegusii: Ekero baare kogenda nchera omonto oyomo akamotebia, “Ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”
english: As they were walking along the road, a man said to him, "I will follow you wherever you go."

ekegusii: Buna obokang’iti bokoba ase amaino na erioki rikoba ase amaiso, naboigo omonto omworo akoba ase abwo bakomotoma abakorere emeremo.
english: As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is a sluggard to those who send him.

ekegusii: Buna omonto oyo bw’amaroba arenge, naboigo nab’amaroba bare; na buna omonto o igoro are, naboigo naba igoro bare.
english: As was the earthly man, so are those who are of the earth; and as is the man from heaven, so also are those who are of heaven.

ekegusii: As water disappears from the sea or a riverbed becomes parched and dry,
english: “Buna koreng’ana amache e chinyancha agosira pi, naboigo naye chindooche agokama chioma pa,

ekegusii: Ekero okorigereria ase amache ime nigo okorora obosio bwao, naboigo nebirengererio bi’enkoro y’omonto bikororekana ase omonto onde.
english: As water reflects a face, so a man's heart reflects the man.

ekegusii: buna amache agwata amagena asamunyokana, ne chiooro chiaira amaroba aera, naboigo aye ogosiria ogosemeria kwa mwanyabanto.
english: as water wears away stones and torrents wash away the soil, so you destroy man's hope.

ekegusii: Buna konya twakwanire ritangani, bono ninkwane naende: Onye omonto okobaranderia enchili ende eng’ao, otatiga eria mwanyorete, aragererigwe.
english: As we have already said, so now I say again: If anybody is preaching to you a gospel other than what you accepted, let him be eternally condemned!

ekegusii: Amang’ana twaigwete, bono twayarorire agwo ase omochie bw’Omonene bw’Emeganda, omochie o Nyasae oito. Nyasae nigo ayorendete na koyokong’ia goika kare na kare.
english: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD Almighty, in the city of our God: God makes her secure forever. Selah

ekegusii: Togaeta togakengana ase egesinka egeke gekorokwa Kilaudia, tokanyara ase obokong’u kobogoria obwato oboke.
english: As we passed to the lee of a small island called Cauda, we were hardly able to make the lifeboat secure.

ekegusii: na emechie yonsi ye chikungo, eria Sulemani abwate, na emechie ye chigari chiaye, na eye chibarasi, na oboagacho bonde bwonsi Sulemani aganetie koagacha agwo Yerusalemu, na agwo Lebanoni na ase ense yonsi y’oboruoti bwaye.
english: as well as all his store cities and the towns for his chariots and for his horses--whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.

ekegusii: akaagacha na Baalati na emechie yaye yonsi ase ebinto biarenge kogachwa, na emechie yonsi ye chigari chiaye, na eye chibarasi chiaye chikoriinwa, na amaagacho ande onsi Sulemani aganetie koagacha agwo Yerusalemu na Lebanoni, na aande onsi ase obogambi bwaye.
english: as well as Baalath and all his store cities, and all the cities for his chariots and for his horses--whatever he desired to build in Jerusalem, in Lebanon and throughout all the territory he ruled.

ekegusii: Boigo ching’iti chitugire, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chire ase ense eyio nachirie okwama okwo kwemeretie.
english: as well as for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. Whatever the land produces may be eaten.

ekegusii: Nebo, na Baali‐Meoni (amarieta abo akaonchorwa), na Sibuma. Boigo bakaroka emechie eyio baagachete ase amarieta ande amayia.
english: as well as Nebo and Baal Meon (these names were changed) and Sibmah. They gave names to the cities they rebuilt.

ekegusii: Ababwatetie abwo n’Abakuani babwate ebirombeta, na Zakaria, mosinto o Yonathani, o Semaya, o Matania, o Mikaya, o Sakuri bw’Asafu.
english: as well as some priests with trumpets, and also Zechariah son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph,

ekegusii: na egetambaa keria ki’omotwe oye tikiabekire amo nebitambaa binde, korende nigo kiaringire, kebekire ao gioka.
english: as well as the burial cloth that had been around Jesus' head. The cloth was folded up by itself, separate from the linen.

ekegusii: Nabwo naende babegetwe korenda chisiiro chi’eraaro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo na ebirochi, ne chingori chiabo.
english: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs and ropes.

ekegusii: ne chisiiro chi’eraaro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo, na ebirochi, ne chingori, amo nebikorero bionsi bigokorerwao. Ewatore ebinto bionsi barabwo barache kobogoria.
english: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, ropes, all their equipment and everything related to their use. Assign to each man the specific things he is to carry.

ekegusii: Eliakimu na Maaseya, Miyamini na Mikaya, Elioenai na Zakaria, na Hanania, abarenge abakuani, bagatenena babwatete ebirombeta.
english: as well as the priests-- Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah and Hananiah with their trumpets--

ekegusii: Boigo omonto oria akarenga emeriibo ya inse y’ebisieri, na ebibao biasiekeire ebioma, na ebisona bi’amarongo atato bi’enyomba, na emeriibo y’ebisieri igoro yatubire ne chibao, na obotambe korwa inse goika ase ebibao. Ebibao ebio nigo biarenge bitubire.
english: as well as the thresholds and the narrow windows and galleries around the three of them-- everything beyond and including the threshold was covered with wood. The floor, the wall up to the windows, and the windows were covered.

ekegusii: Naende Sulemani nabwate abanto chilifu isato na amagana atato (3,300) batenenerete abanto barenge gokora emeremo.
english: as well as thirty-three hundred foremen who supervised the project and directed the workmen.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, abwo bakorwania Egetunwa gia Sayoni, nigo barabe buna omonto ore nenchara akorota ng’a nkoragera are, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nenchara, gose buna oyore nerang’o akorota ng’a nkonywa are amache, korende gakoboka bwenyora ore nerang’o.
english: as when a hungry man dreams that he is eating, but he awakens, and his hunger remains; as when a thirsty man dreams that he is drinking, but he awakens faint, with his thirst unquenched. So will it be with the hordes of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion.

ekegusii: Nigo yarenge koba buna omorero ogosamba chinsagia chi’emete, naende buna omorero okoberia amache, na igo ogere erieta riao rimanyekane ase ababisa bao, na abanto b’ebisaku batengechigwe ase obosio bwao.
english: As when fire sets twigs ablaze and causes water to boil, come down to make your name known to your enemies and cause the nations to quake before you!

ekegusii: Nabo ekero okogenda nomogosoeri oo ase omogambi, kora omokia kobwatana nere komore inchera, tachicha kogokurura ase omogambi, na omogambi oria akobeke ase amaboko ’omorendi bw’echela, na omorendi oria akorute echela.
english: As you are going with your adversary to the magistrate, try hard to be reconciled to him on the way, or he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge turn you over to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

ekegusii: Mochiere ere, oyore rigena rire moyo, riangetwe na mwanyabanto, korende ase obosio bwa Nyasae nerichore, rire rie rigori rinene.
english: As you come to him, the living Stone-- rejected by men but chosen by God and precious to him--

ekegusii: Buna otamanyeti ase embeo ekogusa gochia, gose buna amauga ’omwana ore ase enda ya ng’ina agokina, naboigo tokonyara komanya emeremo ya Nyasae oyio ogokora amang’ana onsi.
english: As you do not know the path of the wind, or how the body is formed in a mother's womb, so you cannot understand the work of God, the Maker of all things.

ekegusii: As you enter the home, give it your greeting.
english: Ekero mogosoa enyomba eria, yekwanie.

ekegusii: Na inwe ase okogenda kwaino, randia, motebe: Oboruoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e.
english: As you go, preach this message: 'The kingdom of heaven is near.'

ekegusii: Inwe Abayuda na Abaisraeli, buna koreng’ana abanto b’ebisaku barenge koragereria ase erieta riaino, bono ekero ndabatoorie, abanto mbabe bagosesenia ase erieta riaino, Timoiroka, korende mobe abaremu!
english: As you have been an object of cursing among the nations, O Judah and Israel, so will I save you, and you will be a blessing. Do not be afraid, but let your hands be strong."

ekegusii: buna motomanyete ensemo, ng’a intwe nigo tore ogwetogia kwaino, buna inwe more asetore ase rituko riria ri’Omonene Yeso.
english: as you have understood us in part, you will come to understand fully that you can boast of us just as we will boast of you in the day of the Lord Jesus.

ekegusii: ekero inwe boigo mogotokonya amo ase ogotosabera. Ase igo, abanto abange baakere Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaito, ase obuya obo twaeirwe, ekiagera abange bagotosabera.
english: as you help us by your prayers. Then many will give thanks on our behalf for the gracious favor granted us in answer to the prayers of many.

ekegusii: Bwata ring’ana ri’obogima, erinde inyore engencho y’ogwetogia ase rituko riria ria Kristo, ng’a tinaminyogete bosa, gose tinakorete emeremo bosa.
english: as you hold out the word of life-- in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor for nothing.

ekegusii: Inwe mwamanyire ng’a inabaranderetie enchili ritang’ani ase engencho y’oboreu bw’omobere one.
english: As you know, it was because of an illness that I first preached the gospel to you.

ekegusii: Buna momanyete, ebitunwa ebio bibere nigo bire bosongo y’orooche rwa Yorodan, ase Enchera ya Bosongo ase orogongo rw’Abakanani, baria bamenyete ase Ekerubo Ekiomo kororia Giligali, ang’e nemete eria enga buna emetontera agwo More.)
english: As you know, these mountains are across the Jordan, west of the road, toward the setting sun, near the great trees of Moreh, in the territory of those Canaanites living in the Arabah in the vicinity of Gilgal.

ekegusii: Rigereria, abwo baremereretie twababarire ng’a mbasesenirie. Mwaigwete amang’ana ’Ayubu buna aremereretie, na buna Omonene amokorerete ase omoerio. Naki Omonene nomonyene amabeebe amange na amabera.
english: As you know, we consider blessed those who have persevered. You have heard of Job's perseverance and have seen what the Lord finally brought about. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

ekegusii: Nebagwenerete gotengera na koayereria rituko ria Nyasae riche bwango. Ase rituko riria igoro nesirigwe na koyia, na ebitongwa bia igoro inabinyititoke nomorero omonene.
english: as you look forward to the day of God and speed its coming. That day will bring about the destruction of the heavens by fire, and the elements will melt in the heat.

ekegusii: Buna gwantomete inche ime ase ense, na inche naboigo nabatomire barabwo ase ense ime.
english: As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.

ekegusii: Asa agakora ayare amaya naende amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, Nyasae oye.
english: Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.

ekegusii: Asa agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, buna Daudi, sokororia yaye, akorete.
english: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, as his father David had done.

ekegusii: Asa nigo abwate abarwani esegi chilifu amagana atato (300,000) korwa ase Abayuda, mbabwate ching’aya na amatimo, na abarwani bande b’esegi chilifu amagana abere na emerongo etano na etato (280,000) korwa ase Ababenjamin mbabwate chinguba, bamanyete koruta emegwe. Abanto aba bonsi nigo barenge abe chinguru, chituoni ase okorwana esegi.
english: Asa had an army of three hundred thousand men from Judah, equipped with large shields and with spears, and two hundred and eighty thousand from Benjamin, armed with small shields and with bows. All these were brave fighting men.

ekegusii: Asa the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Jehoram, Jehoram the father of Uzziah,
english: na Asa akaibora Yehosafati, na Yehosafati akaibora Yoramu, na Yoramu akaibora Usia,

ekegusii: Erio Asa akarusia chifeta chionsi, ne chitahabu chionsi, echio chiatigarete ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene, na echi’enyomba y’omoruoti, agachibeka ase amaboko ’abasomba baye. Erio agatoma ebinto ebio gochia ase Damesiki ase Beni‐Hadadi, mosinto o Tabirimoni, o Hesioni, omoruoti o Siiria, amenyete, agateba,
english: Asa then took all the silver and gold that was left in the treasuries of the LORD's temple and of his own palace. He entrusted it to his officials and sent them to Ben-Hadad son of Tabrimmon, the son of Hezion, the king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.

ekegusii: Erio Asa akarusia chifeta ne chitahabu korwa ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene na korwa ase echi’enyomba y’omoruoti, agachitoma gochia ase Beni‐Hadadi, omoruoti o Siiria omenyete agwo Damesiki, agateba,
english: Asa then took the silver and gold out of the treasuries of the LORD's temple and of his own palace and sent it to Ben-Hadad king of Aram, who was ruling in Damascus.

ekegusii: Erio Asa akaba nendamwamu ase omorori oria, akamobwata, akamobeka ase echela, agasoyia amagoro aye ase rikorogoto. Nigo agechete omorori oria mono, ekiagera akwanete amang’ana aria. Boigo ase engencho eyio Asa akaba omotindi mono, agachanda abanto bande.
english: Asa was angry with the seer because of this; he was so enraged that he put him in prison. At the same time Asa brutally oppressed some of the people.

ekegusii: Asa akagenda koumerana nere ase okorwana esegi. Bagatenenera agwo ase rikura ria Sefata ang’e na Maresa.
english: Asa went out to meet him, and they took up battle positions in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah.

ekegusii: Asafu nere orenge omotang’ani obo. Abaare komobwatia nabwo aba: Zakaria na Yeieli, Semiramoti na Yehieli, Matitia na Eliabu, Benaya na Obedi‐Edomu, na Yeieli, baria barenge kobugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa. Asafu agaakania chisani chiarenge kwoga.
english: Asaph was the chief, Zechariah second, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel. They were to play the lyres and harps, Asaph was to sound the cymbals,

ekegusii: Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye; moche ase obosio bwaye morentane ebiegwa, mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu!
english: ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name. Bring an offering and come before him; worship the LORD in the splendor of his holiness.

ekegusii: Mobake Omonene ase obonene bw’erieta riaye, moche ase chigoora chiaye, morentane ebiegwa.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.

ekegusii: Togia erieta ri’Omonene rire nobonene obonge; mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due his name; worship the LORD in the splendor of his holiness.

ekegusii: Inwe abe chiamate chi’abanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye!
english: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength,

ekegusii: Inwe abe chiamate chi’abanto, togia Omonene! Motogie ase obonene bwaye na okobua kwaye.
english: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

ekegusii: Ashan, Juttah and Beth Shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
english: Asani na Beti‐Semesi amo namarisio aetanaineo.

ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Asidoli na Gasa amo nemechie na ebichie biabo, goika orooche orore orobebe rwa Misiri, naende goika engegu y’Enyancha Enene.
english: Ashdod, its surrounding settlements and villages; and Gaza, its settlements and villages, as far as the Wadi of Egypt and the coastline of the Great Sea.

ekegusii: Asuri ise abanto ba Tekoa, nabwate abakungu babere, Hela na Naara.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

ekegusii: Ekero Asikeloni orarore ayio, noiroke mono; Gasa boigo noro noiroke na goichana; naboigo n’Ekironi, ekiagera ogosemeria kwaye gwasirigwe. Omoruoti o Gasa nasirigwe, na abanto tibakomenya Asikeloni.
english: Ashkelon will see it and fear; Gaza will writhe in agony, and Ekron too, for her hope will wither. Gaza will lose her king and Ashkelon will be deserted.

ekegusii: Boria momanye; Inee, omosacha nabe morito aibore omwana? Nase ki rende narorire kera omosacha abwatete enda namaboko aye buna omokungu okobina aibore? Nase ki kera omonto aonchokire obosio bwaye?
english: Ask and see: Can a man bear children? Then why do I see every strong man with his hands on his stomach like a woman in labor, every face turned deathly pale?

ekegusii: “Bono boria, momanye korwa ase amatuko a kare, amatuko ayio arengeo ekero konya motaraiborwa, korwa rituko riria Nyasae atongete mwanyabanto ase ense, naende moborie momanye korwa ase ensemo eyemo y’ense goikera ensemo ende, gose amang’ana agwekaine buna aya ana koba, gose koigugwa.
english: Ask now about the former days, long before your time, from the day God created man on the earth; ask from one end of the heavens to the other. Has anything so great as this ever happened, or has anything like it ever been heard of?

ekegusii: Omborie, na inche ninkoe ebisaku bionsi bibe omwando oo, ne chinsemo chionsi chi’ense nchibe echiao.
english: Ask of me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.

ekegusii: Inwe saba Omonene abatwerie embura y’okwamia endagera ase engaki yaye. Omonene natonge amare akomesa, na atwerie abanto embura na koa kera oyomo endagera korwa mogondo.
english: Ask the LORD for rain in the springtime; it is the LORD who makes the storm clouds. He gives showers of rain to men, and plants of the field to everyone.

ekegusii: gaki mosabe Omonene bwe rigesa atome abakori emeremo ase rigesa riaye.”
english: Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field."

ekegusii: Boria abasomba bao, nabarabwo mbakoenekerie bo. Ngochia koba tore nomoyega bwe Rituko Rinene; ase ayio tiga abamura abwo natomire asore banyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao. Ase ayio, obae barabwo amo nainche Daudi, omwana oo, gento kende obwate ogotoa.”
english: Ask your own servants and they will tell you. Therefore be favorable toward my young men, since we come at a festive time. Please give your servants and your son David whatever you can find for them.'"

ekegusii: Asnah, Meunim, Nephussim,
english: Asina, na Meunimu, na Nefusimu;

ekegusii: Sangereria abagaaka bonsi b’ebisaku biaino, na abanene bonsi, obarente asende, erinde imbatebie amang’ana aya; inche nindangerie igoro na ense chibe birori asebare.
english: Assemble before me all the elders of your tribes and all your officials, so that I can speak these words in their hearing and call heaven and earth to testify against them.

ekegusii: Mosangererie abanto bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, na abana, na abamenyi bamenyete ase emechie yaino, erio bonsi baigwe na kweorokereria komoiroka Omonene, Nyasae oino, erinde babe abegenwa na bakore amang’ana onsi ay’amachiko aya.
english: Assemble the people-- men, women and children, and the aliens living in your towns-- so they can listen and learn to fear the LORD your God and follow carefully all the words of this law.

ekegusii: Abaasuri tibakonyara gototooria; titokoriina chibarasi gose titokogenderera koroka emeremo y’amaboko aito Nyasae oito. Aye Omonene nigo okoorokia amabera ase oyore entakana.”
english: Assyria cannot save us; we will not mount war-horses. We will never again say 'Our gods' to what our own hands have made, for in you the fatherless find compassion."

ekegusii: Kobare nchera kogenda, Omonene akaumerana na Musa aase baare gotimokera, akarigia komoita.
english: At a lodging place on the way, the LORD met [Moses] and was about to kill him.

ekegusii: Omonene akaondokia na gotantania Sisera amo ne chigari chiaye na omoganda bwonsi bw’abarwani. Erio abarwani abwo bagatama korwa ase omoro o Baraki, na Sisera omonyene agaika korwa ase egari yaye, agatama namagoro.
english: At Barak's advance, the LORD routed Sisera and all his chariots and army by the sword, and Sisera abandoned his chariot and fled on foot.

ekegusii: Ase Kaisaria narengeo omonto ore korokwa Kornelio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana bw’ekeombe ekemo ki’abarwani kiare korokwa eki’Abaitalia.
english: At Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, a centurion in what was known as the Italian Regiment.

ekegusii: Daudi akamorangeria ache mwaye koragera na konywa amo nere, na igo akagera Uria agatinda. Ekero kia mogoroba Uria akagenda korara borere bwaye amo nabasomba b’omonene oye, korende tagenda bwoye.
english: At David's invitation, he ate and drank with him, and David made him drunk. But in the evening Uriah went out to sleep on his mat among his master's servants; he did not go home.

ekegusii: Mambia chuni agasoa naende Hekalu ime. Abanto bonsi bakamochiera, na ere agaikaransa, akaborokereria.
english: At dawn he appeared again in the temple courts, where all the people gathered around him, and he sat down to teach them.

ekegusii: Goika ekaba mobaso, agasoka, akagenda aase atari nabanto. Na abanto bakamoriga‐rigia, bakamoikera, bakarigia komotanga taimoka korwa asebare.
english: At daybreak Jesus went out to a solitary place. The people were looking for him and when they came to where he was, they tried to keep him from leaving them.

ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagaaka b’abanto, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko bagasangererekana amo, bakamorenta ase ekegambero kiabo, bakobora,
english: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people, both the chief priests and teachers of the law, met together, and Jesus was led before them.

ekegusii: Ekero bwachia koba mambia, omokungu oria agacha, akagwa inse ase egesieri ki’enyomba y’omonto oria omosacha oye arenge, akarara aroro goika ense egakiamoka na koraba.
english: At daybreak the woman went back to the house where her master was staying, fell down at the door and lay there until daylight.

ekegusii: Na ekero bachia koigwa aya, bagasoa Hekalu ime ekero kia mambia, bakorokereria. Ekero omokuani omonene na abwo barenge komo bacha, bagasangereria abanto b’ekegambero na abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli, bagatoma abanto ase echela, erinde barente abatomwa baria.
english: At daybreak they entered the temple courts, as they had been told, and began to teach the people. When the high priest and his associates arrived, they called together the Sanhedrin-- the full assembly of the elders of Israel-- and sent to the jail for the apostles.

ekegusii: Bakaimoka mambia ense etarakiamoka, bakagenda ase egetwori ki’Abasiiria, korende ekero baigete ase omochakano bw’egetwori keria bakanyora ng’a monto taiyo.
english: At dusk they got up and went to the camp of the Arameans. When they reached the edge of the camp, not a man was there,

ekegusii: Ekero bwairiire na egeita kiarenge gosiekwa bagenda; timanyeti ase bagenda, korende ayerera, mobabwatie, nabo morabanyore.”
english: At dusk, when it was time to close the city gate, the men left. I don't know which way they went. Go after them quickly. You may catch up with them."

ekegusii: Agwo aase aimokererete igoro bagasamba ubani buna abanto b’ebisaku biria Omonene aseretie korwa asebare baare gokora. Bagakora ebinto bi’obokayayu, bakagechia Omonene goika akaba nendamwamu;
english: At every high place they burned incense, as the nations whom the LORD had driven out before them had done. They did wicked things that provoked the LORD to anger.

ekegusii: Bono igo yamogwenerete kobasiborera omonto oyomo ekero kie rituko rinene.
english: At every Passover Festival Pilate had to set free one prisoner for them. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version. See Mark 15:6.]

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya aborokigwa baye tibayamanyete agwo ritang’ani, korende nyuma Yeso gatogigwe, erio bakainyora ng’a narikeire aya, naende ng’a mbamokorete aya.
english: At first his disciples did not understand all this. Only after Jesus was glorified did they realize that these things had been written about him and that they had done these things to him.

ekegusii: Agwo Gibeoni Omonene akaorokera Sulemani ase chindoto botuko, Nyasae akamotebia, “Boria egento oganetie nkoe.”
english: At Gibeon the LORD appeared to Solomon during the night in a dream, and God said, "Ask for whatever you want me to give you."

ekegusii: Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde bamoe ensemo yaye y’amatunda ’emesabibu. Abaremi bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.
english: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants so they would give him some of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

ekegusii: Ekero kie rigesa agatoma omosomba ase abaremi baria, erinde anyore korwa ase abaremi ensemo y’amatunda ’emesabibu.
english: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants to collect from them some of the fruit of the vineyard.

ekegusii: Sisera akeringa akagwa inse, akagwa inse ase amagoro a Yaeli, akarambereria inse ase amagoro aye, agwo ase agwete agakwa.
english: At her feet he sank, he fell; there he lay. At her feet he sank, he fell; where he sank, there he fell-- dead.

ekegusii: Amare nigo agoetanana gochia aaria na aaria, akoraawga nere, goikerania aya onsi ere achikire akore ase ense.
english: At his direction they swirl around over the face of the whole earth to do whatever he commands them.

ekegusii: Na ase egesieri kiaye narengeo omonto oyomo omotaka, erieta riaye Lazaro, orenge namaote amange.
english: At his gate was laid a beggar named Lazarus, covered with sores

ekegusii: Abanto bakaroisia omogwekano bw’emori agwo Horebu, erio bagasasima omogwekano oria obombire.
english: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped an idol cast from metal.

ekegusii: Nonya nekero mwarenge agwo Horebu, mokagera Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene, ere akebeka ang’e kegima kobasiria.
english: At Horeb you aroused the LORD's wrath so that he was angry enough to destroy you.

ekegusii: Ase Ikonio Paulo na Barnaba bagasoa esinagogi amo, bagakwana goika abanto abange b’Abayahudi na Abagiriki bakeegena.
english: At Iconium Paul and Barnabas went as usual into the Jewish synagogue. There they spoke so effectively that a great number of Jews and Gentiles believed.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bachete koragera, Boazi agatebia Rutu, “Inchuo aa, orie omogati otongerie ase omosori ore nedivai.” Naboigo Rutu agaikaransa amo nabagesi baria, na Boazi akamoa ebigara bisambire. Rutu akaria, akaigota, naende eyende egatigara.
english: At mealtime Boaz said to her, "Come over here. Have some bread and dip it in the wine vinegar." When she sat down with the harvesters, he offered her some roasted grain. She ate all she wanted and had some left over.

ekegusii: Ekero kia mobaso inamotaba‐tabe buna emeuko egotabataba ase omosunte, timokonyara korora enchera. Timogosesenigwa ase emeremo ende yonsi morabe mogokora. Namobe mogochandwa na kourwa ebinto biaino botambe, na onde tari orabakonye.
english: At midday you will grope about like a blind man in the dark. You will be unsuccessful in everything you do; day after day you will be oppressed and robbed, with no one to rescue you.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoboka botuko gati kogoakera ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera okogamba kwao nokoronge.
english: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.

ekegusii: Bogachia koba botuko gati, Omonene agaita abana abatangi bonsi amo ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi ase ense ya Misiri, gochakera omwana omotangi o Farao oyoikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi, goika omwana omotangi bw’omonto osibire echela, ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi.
english: At midnight the LORD struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on the throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner, who was in the dungeon, and the firstborn of all the livestock as well.

ekegusii: Agwo ase egetunwa keria kia Hori, ase orobebe rw’ense ya Edomu, Omonene agakwana na Musa na Haroni, akabatebia,
english: At Mount Hor, near the border of Edom, the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

ekegusii: Ase ogwekengera kwane kwe ritang’ani onde tarenge otenenete amo nainche, korende bonsi bagantiga. Nasabire ng’a tibabarerwa ebibe ase ring’ana erio.
english: At my first defense, no one came to my support, but everyone deserted me. May it not be held against them.

ekegusii: Agwo ase emesa yane imorie chinyama chie chibarasi, na echi’abanto chituoni, na echi’abarwani bonsi b’esegi, erinde moigote kegima. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: At my table you will eat your fill of horses and riders, mighty men and soldiers of every kind,' declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Bwachia koba mobaso gati, Elija akabachecheria, akabatebia, “Aka eriogi rinene kobua, ekiagera ere nenyasae. Ande nigo akare namang’ana akorengereria, gose ngotimoka akare, gose norogendo akare, gose nigo araire, goika aturwe.”
english: At noon Elijah began to taunt them. "Shout louder!" he said. "Surely he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or busy, or traveling. Maybe he is sleeping and must be awakened."

ekegusii: Erio agwo kegima akamorandia Yeso ase chisinagogi, okobora, “Ere n’Omwana o Nyasae.”
english: At once he began to preach in the synagogues that Jesus is the Son of God.

ekegusii: Erio kegima, kambogoirie n’Omoika, nkarora ekerogo ki’obonene kebekire igoro, na oyomo oikaransete ase ekerogo keria.
english: At once I was in the Spirit, and there before me was a throne in heaven with someone sitting on it.

ekegusii: Erio agwo Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a chinguru chiarure asare, akeonchora gati ase omoganda, akabora, “Ning’o okuna chianga chiane?”
english: At once Jesus realized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and asked, "Who touched my clothes?"

ekegusii: Ababenjamin abwo baroberetigwe korwa ase emechie yabo ase rituko riria nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na isano nemo, abamanyete korwanera emioro. Amo nabwo mbarengeo abanto amagana atano na abere, abachoretwe korwa ase omochie o Gibea.
english: At once the Benjamites mobilized twenty-six thousand swordsmen from their towns, in addition to seven hundred chosen men from those living in Gibeah.

ekegusii: Erio kegima agasoa nomoayerero ase obosio bw’omoruoti, agasaba, akabora, “Nindigetie ong’e omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi bono iga ase esani.”
english: At once the girl hurried in to the king with the request: "I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptist on a platter."

ekegusii: Erio agwo Omonene agakwana na Musa, na Haroni, na Miriamu, akabatebia, “Nimbaganetie inwe batato mochiche agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Abwo batato bakagenda aroro.
english: At once the LORD said to Moses, Aaron and Miriam, "Come out to the Tent of Meeting, all three of you." So the three of them came out.

ekegusii: Erio kegima omonto oria akaba omogima, agetweka egesero kiaye, akagenda. Nabo yarenge Esabato rituko riria.
english: At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and walked. The day on which this took place was a Sabbath,

ekegusii: Abariki b’omoruoti bakarangerigwa agwo ase omotienyi o gatato, noro omotienyi o Siwani, rituko ri’emerongo ebere na gatato, na buna Moredekai achigete, amarube akarikwa gochia ase Abayahudi, na gochia ase abagambi abanene b’oboruoti na abagavuna, na abanene bonsi be chingongo chionsi korwa India goika Etiopia, chingongo rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na isano na ibere (127). Amarube ayio akarikwa ase kera orogongo ase okorikwa kw’engencho y’amariko abo, na ase kera egesaku ase omonwa obo na ase Abayahudi ase enchera yabo y’okorika ase omonwa obo.
english: At once the royal secretaries were summoned-- on the twenty-third day of the third month, the month of Sivan. They wrote out all Mordecai's orders to the Jews, and to the satraps, governors and nobles of the 127 provinces stretching from India to Cush. These orders were written in the script of each province and the language of each people and also to the Jews in their own script and language.

ekegusii: Erio kegima Omoika okamoira ase erooro.
english: At once the Spirit sent him out into the desert,

ekegusii: Erio kegima bagatiga ebionga biabo, bakamotunyana.
english: At once they left their nets and followed him.

ekegusii: Naki agwo ritang’ani intwe nigo twarenge abasomba b’okogania okobe gwe chingencho ao ao ase okwegokia. Twarenge kogenderera ase obobe na emoko, tware kogechigwa na kogechana.
english: At one time we too were foolish, disobedient, deceived and enslaved by all kinds of passions and pleasures. We lived in malice and envy, being hated and hating one another.

ekegusii: bagakwana nabarabwo agwo Silo, bakabatebia, “Omonene nigo achigete goetera ase Musa ng’a toegwe emechie ase tokomenya, amo namarisio, ase chitugo chiaito chirarisie.”
english: at Shiloh in Canaan and said to them, "The LORD commanded through Moses that you give us towns to live in, with pasturelands for our livestock."

ekegusii: Ekero erioba rikogwa Yoshua agachika ng’a ebitondo bi’abanto baria bisungorwe, bitugutwe ase rikuruma riria bebisete, na abanto bagakora bo. Naende bakabeka amagena amanene ase egesoero kie rikuruma, nao are goika rero iga.
english: At sunset Joshua gave the order and they took them down from the trees and threw them into the cave where they had been hiding. At the mouth of the cave they placed large rocks, which are there to this day.

ekegusii: Akabaroisia ensa eria ya botuko, akabasibia chingoma chiabo, akabatiswa ekero ekio, ere na abanto bonsi ba mwaye.
english: At that hour of the night the jailer took them and washed their wounds; then immediately he and all his family were baptized.

ekegusii: Erio kegima akagwa ase amagoro aye, agakwa. Abamura baria bagasoa, bakamonyora okure. Erio bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka ase omosacha oye ensemo.
english: At that moment she fell down at his feet and died. Then the young men came in and, finding her dead, carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

ekegusii: Na rora, egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere, ense egatengecha, ebitare bigatandoka.
english: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook and the rocks split.

ekegusii: Abande ase abanto ba Yerusalemu bakabora, “Oyo tari ere omonto oria bakorigia goita?
english: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, "Isn't this the man they are trying to kill?

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Abiya, omomura o Yeroboamu akarwara.
english: At that time Abijah son of Jeroboam became ill,

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abimeleki na Pikoli, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani baye, bagatebia Ibrahimu, “Nyasae nigo are amo naye ase ande onsi ogokora.
english: At that time Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his forces said to Abraham, "God is with you in everything you do.

ekegusii: Erio Ahasia, mosinto bw’Ahabu, agatebia Yehosafati, “Tiga abasomba baane bagende amo nabasomba bao ase chimeeri.” Korende Yehosafati akaanga.
english: At that time Ahaziah son of Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, "Let my men sail with your men," but Jehoshaphat refused.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Daudi nigo arenge ase eburi ime, na abarwani b’Abafilisti nigo barenge agwo Bethlehemu.
english: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Daudi nigo arenge ime ase eburi, na abarwani esegi b’Abafilisti nigo barenge Bethlehemu.
english: At that time David was in the stronghold, and the Philistine garrison was at Bethlehem.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene bw’Emeganda narenterwe ebiegwa nabanto abwo bare abatambe babwate emebere emeterere ekomeka‐meka, abwo bairokire nabanto bare ang’e na abare aare. Egesaku ekio nigo kere ne chinguru, naende nigo gekona‐kobua, na ense yabo nigo ere ne chindooche chinyinge. Ebiegwa ebio nigo birarentwe ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, agwo ase erieta ri’Omonene rimenyete.
english: At that time gifts will be brought to the LORD Almighty from a people tall and smooth-skinned, from a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers-- the gifts will be brought to Mount Zion, the place of the Name of the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Hanani omorori agacha ase Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akamotebia, “Ekiagera gwasemeretie omoruoti o Siiria, na tigwasemeria Omonene, Nyasae oo, abarwani esegi b’omoruoti o Siiria batamire betooririe korwa ase okoboko kwao.
english: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah and said to him: "Because you relied on the king of Aram and not on the LORD your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped from your hand.

ekegusii: Ekero keria omoruoti Herode akaigwa chinkuma igoro ya Yeso;
english: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus,

ekegusii: Na eriogi riaye ndiatengechetie ense ekero keria, korende bono orire eira, ogoteba, “Ara rimo naende nintengechie ense, gose tari ense yoka, korende na igoro boigo.”
english: At that time his voice shook the earth, but now he has promised, "Once more I will shake not only the earth but also the heavens."

ekegusii: Boigo ngatebia abanto ng’a kera omonto amo nomosomba oye babeere aiga Yerusalemu, babe bakorenda botuko, na mobaso babe bagokora emeremo y’okoagacha.
english: At that time I also said to the people, "Have every man and his helper stay inside Jerusalem at night, so they can serve us as guards by night and workmen by day."

ekegusii: “Ase ekero keria ngachika Yoshua, nkamotebia: Nkwaroche amang’ana onsi aya Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorerete abaruoti baria babere. Naboigo Omonene arakorere kera oboruoti ase orabe kogosoa.
english: At that time I commanded Joshua: "You have seen with your own eyes all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. The LORD will do the same to all the kingdoms over there where you are going.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria ngasaba Omonene, nkamotebia:
english: At that time I pleaded with the LORD:

ekegusii: Musa agakwana, “Ase engaki eria nigo nabatebetie ng’a inche bweka tinkonyara kobaraa.
english: At that time I said to you, "You are too heavy a burden for me to carry alone.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ning’ikeranie amang’ana onsi, korwa omochakano goika omoerio, ayio nakwanete ng’a ninyakore ase Eli na ase eamate yaye.
english: At that time I will carry out against Eli everything I spoke against his family-- from beginning to end.

ekegusii: Rora, ase engaki eyio ning’ee abakogochanda bonsi egesusuro. Nintoorie ebirema, na nsangererie abwo baseretigwe. Abwo mbabe bagotogigwa na komanyekana buya, agwo ase kera ense babeire bachayire.
english: At that time I will deal with all who oppressed you; I will rescue the lame and gather those who have been scattered. I will give them praise and honor in every land where they were put to shame.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio nimbarente inka, ee, ase engaki eyio nimbasangererie. Nimbae erieta rinene rimanyekane, mobe mogotogigwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi b’ense, ekero ndabairanerie amaya aino moyarore.” Nabo Omonene akwanire.
english: At that time I will gather you; at that time I will bring you home. I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your very eyes," says the LORD.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria nimbe nkorigarigia Yerusalemu ase okoyomoreka ne chitaya; nindue egesusuro ase abanto baria bamenyete bare nobotoereru, buna edivai ekirete ase eturubo, abwo bagwetebia ase chinkoro chiabo: Omonene takonyara gokora kende, amaya gose amabe.
english: At that time I will search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those who are complacent, who are like wine left on its dregs, who think, 'The LORD will do nothing, either good or bad.'

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria inche Danieli nigo narenge nkona‐kweumia ase engaki ye chichuma isato.
english: At that time I, Daniel, mourned for three weeks.

ekegusii: At that time if anyone says to you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'Look, there he is!' do not believe it.
english: Ekero ekio omonto karabatebie: Rora, oyo nere Kristo, gose: Oria aaria, timwegena,

ekegusii: At that time if anyone says to you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'There he is!' do not believe it.
english: Na ekero ekio omonto karabatebie: Rora, Kristo naa are! Gose: Naaria! Timwancha.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Yeso agacha korwa Nazareti ya Galili, akabatiswa na Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodan.
english: At that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

ekegusii: Ensa eria Yeso agatebia emeganda y’abanto, “Inee! Igo mwachire buna mokoimokera omouri nemioro ne chinungu gocha kong’ira? Kera rituko nigo narenge amo nainwe ase Hekalu ime kworokereria, ko timwambwata.
english: At that time Jesus said to the crowd, "Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me? Every day I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not arrest me.

ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso agakwana, “Nakobakire aye Tata, Omonene o igoro na ense, ng’a kwabisire amang’ana aya ase abare nobong’aini ne chisemi, na kwayamaanoire ase abana abake.
english: At that time Jesus said, "I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.

ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso ngoeta arenge ase emegondo ase rituko ri’Esabato, aborokigwa baye mbarenge nenchara, bagachaka kobutora ebigara, bakaria.
english: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick some heads of grain and eat them.

ekegusii: Ase ekero keria Yeso agasasoka ase Omoika Omochenu, akabora, “Nakobakire aye Tata, Omonene o igoro na ense, ng’a kwabisire amang’ana aya ase abare nobong’aini ne chisemi, na koyamaanora ase abana abake. Ee, Tata, oko nakwo kwarenge ogwancha kwao okuya.
english: At that time Jesus, full of joy through the Holy Spirit, said, "I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was your good pleasure.

ekegusii: Erio agwo Yoshua akaragereria omochie o Yeriko, agateba, “Omonene aragererie onde bwensi oraagache omochie oyo naende. “Oyo orabeke oboroso, omwana oye omomura omotangi akwe; na oyo oratenenie ebiita, omwana oye omomura omokogoti akwe.”
english: At that time Joshua pronounced this solemn oath: "Cursed before the LORD is the man who undertakes to rebuild this city, Jericho: "At the cost of his firstborn son will he lay its foundations; at the cost of his youngest will he set up its gates."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoshua akairana gochia Hasori, akayobwata, agaita omoruoti bw’aroro nomoro. (Engaki eria Hasori nigo orenge omochie omonene bw’amaruoti aria onsi).
english: At that time Joshua turned back and captured Hazor and put its king to the sword. (Hazor had been the head of all these kingdoms.)

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Yoshua akagenda gosiria Abaanaki, abamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, na ase Heburoni, na Debiri, na Anabu, na ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa bi ’Abayuda na ebi’Abaisraeli, Yoshua akabasiria kegima amo nemechie yabo.
english: At that time Joshua went and destroyed the Anakites from the hill country: from Hebron, Debir and Anab, from all the hill country of Judah, and from all the hill country of Israel. Joshua totally destroyed them and their towns.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Ahasi omoruoti agatoma amang’ana ase omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akamoboria amokonye.
english: At that time King Ahaz sent to the king of Assyria for help.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ekero Ahaswero omoruoti arenge goikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti aaria ase eburi ya Susa, amang’ana aya naro arenge gokoreka:
english: At that time King Xerxes reigned from his royal throne in the citadel of Susa,

ekegusii: Na ekero ekio abanto abange inabagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, inabasigaanane na kobekana ase ababisa babo, naende nabagechane,
english: At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,

ekegusii: Mariamu akaimoka ase amatuko ayio, akagenda bwango ase ebitunwa goika omochie oyomo o Yuda,
english: At that time Mary got ready and hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea,

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria abanto bagachorwa korenda ebinyomba biarenge chikungo aase ebiegwa, na okwama kwe ritang’ani, ne chinsemo chia ikomi, biarenge kogachwa. Abanto abwo nigo barenge gosangereria korwa ase emegondo yonsi y’emechie ebinto biachikire ase amachiko biegwe abakuani na Abalawi, ekiagera emeremo y’abakuani na ey’Abalawi nigo yagogetie Abayuda.
english: At that time men were appointed to be in charge of the storerooms for the contributions, firstfruits and tithes. From the fields around the towns they were to bring into the storerooms the portions required by the Law for the priests and the Levites, for Judah was pleased with the ministering priests and Levites.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Menahemu agasaria kegima omochie o Tifusa, agaita kera oyomo orenge imeo, na ase chingongo chionsi chiayoetanaine korwa Tirisa na kogenderera, ekiagera tibamoigorerete ebiita bi’omochie oria asoe. Boigo akoora abakungu bonsi b’aroro barenge barito.
