english: At that time Menahem, starting out from Tirzah, attacked Tiphsah and everyone in the city and its vicinity, because they refused to open their gates. He sacked Tiphsah and ripped open all the pregnant women.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omoruoti o Babeli, Merodaki‐Baladani, mosinto o Baladani, agatoma abanto bakaira ekeegwa ase Hezekia, ekiagera aigwete ng’a Hezekia nabete omorwaire.
english: At that time Merodach-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of Hezekiah's illness.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omoruoti o Babeli Merodaki‐Baladani, mosinto o Baladani, agatoma abanto bakaira rirube na ebiegwa ase Hezekia, ekiagera aigwete ng’a Hezekia nabete omorwaire, naende ng’a konya ogwenire.
english: At that time Merodach-Baladan son of Baladan king of Babylon sent Hezekiah letters and a gift, because he had heard of his illness and recovery.

ekegusii: Ekero keria abande b’Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamotebia, “Imoka korwa aa, ogende, ekiagera Herode narigetie kogoita.”
english: At that time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said to him, "Leave this place and go somewhere else. Herod wants to kill you."

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Tatenai, omogavuna bw’orogongo orwo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abande babwataine nabwo, bagacha, bakababoria, “Ning’o obaa ribaga mokoagacha enyomba eye na gokoora koagacha orwaki orwo?”
english: At that time Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and their associates went to them and asked, "Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?"

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria aborokigwa bagacha ase Yeso, bakamoboria, “Ning’o ore omonene kobua abande ase oboruoti bwa igoro?”
english: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?"

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Abaisraeli bakarua aase agwo, na kera omonto akagenda ase egesaku kiaye na ase eamate yaye, na ase omwando oye.
english: At that time the Israelites left that place and went home to their tribes and clans, each to his own inheritance.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene agatebia Yoshua, “Roisia emeyio emioge y’amagena ochake kwarokia Abaisraeli naende.”
english: At that time the LORD said to Joshua, "Make flint knives and circumcise the Israelites again."

ekegusii: “Erio naende Omonene agakwana nainche, agantebia: Baacha chibao chi’amagena ibere chire buna chiria chie ritang’ani. Oroisie na Esanduku ye chibao chi’emete. Erio otiire gocha aa asende egetunwa igoro.
english: At that time the LORD said to me, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones and come up to me on the mountain. Also make a wooden chest.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Omonene agaatanana abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi babe bakobogoria Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, naende akabakora bakaba bagotenena ase obosio bw’Omonene komokorera, na gosesenia abanto ase erieta riaye. Naboigo bagokora goika rero iga.
english: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister and to pronounce blessings in his name, as they still do today.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene agakwana na Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, akamotebia, “Genda orusie egunia obegete ase omobere oo, na ebikoroto obegete ase amagoro ao.” Isaya agakora bo, akaba ogotaara getirianda, na tabegete ebikoroto.
english: at that time the LORD spoke through Isaiah son of Amoz. He said to him, "Take off the sackcloth from your body and the sandals from your feet." And he did so, going around stripped and barefoot.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria abasomba ba Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, bakagenda Yerusalemu, bakanaaria omochie bwonsi,
english: At that time the officers of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon advanced on Jerusalem and laid siege to it,

ekegusii: Korende buna ase ekero keria oria oiboretwe koreng’ana buna onde bwensi nigo amochandete oria oiboretwe ase engencho y’Omoika, naboigo nonya ngoika bono.
english: At that time the son born in the ordinary way persecuted the son born by the power of the Spirit. It is the same now.

ekegusii: Mbabwate omosibwa oyomo omanyekanete, okorokwa Baraba.
english: At that time they had a notorious prisoner, called Barabbas.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria bakaruera Omonene ebing’wanso korwa ase chitugo boosete, bakarua chiombe amagana atano na abere (700), ne ching’ondi ne chimbori chilifu isano na ibere (7,000).
english: At that time they sacrificed to the LORD seven hundred head of cattle and seven thousand sheep and goats from the plunder they had brought back.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio bagaita Abamoabu koreng’ana chilifu ikomi. Abwo bonsi nigo barenge abanto abanene, naende barenge chituoni chi’esegi; onde tatooregete nonya noyomo.
english: At that time they struck down about ten thousand Moabites, all vigorous and strong; not a man escaped.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Yerusalemu norokwe Oboikaranso bw’Omonene. Ebisaku bionsi nabisangererekane agwo Yerusalemu, ase obosio bw’Omonene, na tibikogania gotunyana naende oboenenu bwe chinkoro chi’obobe.
english: At that time they will call Jerusalem The Throne of the LORD, and all nations will gather in Jerusalem to honor the name of the LORD. No longer will they follow the stubbornness of their evil hearts.

ekegusii: Erio nabanyare korora Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha‐ase riire ase chinguru na obonene obonge.
english: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto aba amo naba Yerusalemu mbatebigwe ring’ana eri: “Omwaga ogosamba buna omorero noguse korwa ase ebigoro bi’erooro gochia ase abanto baane. Omwaga oyio tokoba oyo bw’okoirurera gose bw’ogosonga,
english: At that time this people and Jerusalem will be told, "A scorching wind from the barren heights in the desert blows toward my people, but not to winnow or cleanse;

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria emebere y’abanto baraitwe n’Omonene, nesiarerwe korwa ase ensinyo eyemo y’ense goika eyende. Abwo tibakoreerwa, gose gosangererigwa na gotindekwa. Nababe buna obwoyo ase ense.
english: At that time those slain by the LORD will be everywhere-- from one end of the earth to the other. They will not be mourned or gathered up or buried, but will be like refuse lying on the ground.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio omochie o Turo mbwebwe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere, emiaka ereng’aine ey’obogima bw’omoruoti oyomo. Emiaka eyio emerongo etano na ebere ekoera, nebe ase Turo buna arikire ase ogotera kw’omotayayi;
english: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, the span of a king's life. But at the end of these seventy years, it will happen to Tyre as in the song of the prostitute:

ekegusii: Tokaira emechie yaye yonsi ase engaki eria. Titwatigete nonya nomochie oyomo totairete. Emechie yonsi twairete nigo yarenge emerongo etano nomo, tokaira orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu, ase Ogi, Omoruoti o Basani, arenge kogamba.
english: At that time we took all his cities. There was not one of the sixty cities that we did not take from them-- the whole region of Argob, Og's kingdom in Bashan.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria tokabwata emechie yaye yonsi, tokayesaria, togaita abasacha, na abakungu, na abana, titwatigaretie monto ore moyo, nonya noyomo.
english: At that time we took all his towns and completely destroyed them-- men, women and children. We left no survivors.

ekegusii: Erio omonwa oo nokunorwe ochake gokwana nomotami oria, tokogenderera koba rimama; ase igo aye nobe ekiorokererio ase abanto abwo, nabarabwo mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: At that time your mouth will be opened; you will speak with him and will no longer be silent. So you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD."

ekegusii: Ekaba ase engaki eria Yuda agatiga abamwabo, agatirimboka, agaika ase omonto gete Omoadulamu ore korokwa Hira, bakabwatana nere.
english: At that time, Judah left his brothers and went down to stay with a man of Adullam named Hirah.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Resini, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria akairania omochie o Elati ase Abasiiria ase ogoseria Abayuda korwa Elati. Nyuma y’ayio Abasiiria bagacha komenya Elati; nao bamenyete goika rero iga.
english: At that time, Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram by driving out the men of Judah. Edomites then moved into Elath and have lived there to this day.

ekegusii: Korwa ase engaki eria, ekero Daudi aroche ng’a Omonene oiraneirie ogosaba kwaye ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi, akarua ebing’wanso biaye aroro agwo.
english: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.

ekegusii: Na ase ensa eria ekaba omotengecho omonene bw’ense, na ensemo ya ikomi y’omochie ekagwa. Abanto chilifu isano na ibere bagaitwa ase omotengecho oria, na abwo batigarete bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagatogia obonene bwa Nyasae ore igoro.
english: At that very hour there was a severe earthquake and a tenth of the city collapsed. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the survivors were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria akagwenia abanto abange abarenge namarwaire, na emechando, na babwatire nebirecha ebibe; na abange abarenge emeuko akabaramokia amaiso abo, bakarora.
english: At that very time Jesus cured many who had diseases, sicknesses and evil spirits, and gave sight to many who were blind.

ekegusii: Erio Paulo akaimoka akabatiga.
english: At that, Paul left the Council.

ekegusii: Erio omonene bw’abarendi akagenda amo nabanto baye, bakabarenta, korende tari ase chinguru, ekiagera barenge nobwoba ng’a mbaakwe amagena nabanto.
english: At that, the captain went with his officers and brought the apostles. They did not use force, because they feared that the people would stone them.

ekegusii: Oyio omoriri nigo agochaka gokwana amang’ana ’oboriri, naende oyakoora nobobarimo.
english: At the beginning his words are folly; at the end they are wicked madness--

ekegusii: Ase omochakano bw’okogamba kw’Ahaswero, ababisa baria bakarika amang’ana ay’ogosoera abanto bamenyete ase orogongo rw’Abayuda, na ase Yerusalemu.
english: At the beginning of the reign of Xerxes, they lodged an accusation against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ekero egetureri gekobugigwa, nigo ekwana eriogi riaye ri’okoega‐ega. Nigo ekoigwa omonyonko bw’esegi korwa aare, na buna abachiki b’esegi bagochika, na okwoga gw’esegi.
english: At the blast of the trumpet he snorts, 'Aha!' He catches the scent of battle from afar, the shout of commanders and the battle cry.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaeyanera basira, na ase okogusa kw’endamwamu yaye baerigwa.
english: At the breath of God they are destroyed; at the blast of his anger they perish.

ekegusii: Ekero omochie o Yerusalemu orenge gwatananwa na gochenwa, Abalawi bakarentwa Yerusalemu korwa aase ande onsi ase bamenyete, erinde bache ase ogwatananwa okwo bare nomogoko, babe bakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono namatera, na goakania chisani chikwoga, na amakano ao ao.
english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem, the Levites were sought out from where they lived and were brought to Jerusalem to celebrate joyfully the dedication with songs of thanksgiving and with the music of cymbals, harps and lyres.

ekegusii: “Ase omoerio o kera omwaka o gatano na kabere mobae abwo bariete chisira obosibore tibaakana.
english: At the end of every seven years you must cancel debts.

ekegusii: Ase omoerio o kera emiaka etato morente ensemo ya ikomi ye chindagera chi’emegondo chi’omwaka oria, moyegache ase emechie yaino.
english: At the end of every three years, bring all the tithes of that year's produce and store it in your towns,

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko emerongo ene aerire, abanto baria chirooti bakairana korwa ase okoroota ense eria.
english: At the end of forty days they returned from exploring the land.

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma y’emiaka ene koyaerire, Abisalomu agatebia omoruoti, “Koranche ong’e ribaga ngende Heburoni goikerania eira yane narierete Omonene.
english: At the end of four years, Absalom said to the king, "Let me go to Hebron and fulfill a vow I made to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko atano na abere aerete, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: At the end of seven days the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Emiaka eyio emerongo etano na ebere koyaerire, Omonene nachiche korora omochie o Turo; omochie oyio noiranere chingencho chiaye chinkoro, ochake gokora obonyaka amo namaruoti onsi are ase ense.
english: At the end of seventy years, the LORD will deal with Tyre. She will return to her hire as a prostitute and will ply her trade with all the kingdoms on the face of the earth.

ekegusii: “Ekero engaki eyio yaerete, inche Nebukadinesaro nkarigereria gochia igoro, na obong’aini bwane bokang’iranera. Erio nkamotogia Oyore Igoro Mono, nkamobaka na komosika ere oyoreo goika kare na kare.” “Okogamba kwaye nigo kore ogwa kare na kare, na oboruoti bwaye nigo bogendererete ekiaare ase ekiaare.
english: At the end of that time, I, Nebuchadnezzar, raised my eyes toward heaven, and my sanity was restored. Then I praised the Most High; I honored and glorified him who lives forever. His dominion is an eternal dominion; his kingdom endures from generation to generation.

ekegusii: Emiaka eyio amagana ane, na emerongo etato, koyaerire, ase rituko erio erio emeganda yonsi y’Omonene ekang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
english: At the end of the 430 years, to the very day, all the LORD's divisions left Egypt.

ekegusii: Ase omoerio bw’amatuko aria emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, Omonene akang’a chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena echio chiarikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania.
english: At the end of the forty days and forty nights, the LORD gave me the two stone tablets, the tablets of the covenant.

ekegusii: Ase omoerio bw’emiaka eria etano na ebere, omokungu oria akairana korwa ase ense y’Abafilisti, akagenda ase omoruoti agasaba aegwe enyomba yaye, na oboremo bwaye.
english: At the end of the seven years she came back from the land of the Philistines and went to the king to beg for her house and land.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aria ikomi aerete, amasio abo akarorekana are amaya, na emebere yabo ere emeterere kobua ey’abamura bande, baria barenge koria endagera eria yare korwa ase omoruoti.
english: At the end of the ten days they looked healthier and better nourished than any of the young men who ate the royal food.

ekegusii: Ekero engaki eria yachigetwe nomoruoti Nebukadinesaro ng’a abamura baria bonsi barentwe asare yaigete, omoteneneri oria omonene akabaira ase omoruoti oria.
english: At the end of the time set by the king to bring them in, the chief official presented them to Nebuchadnezzar.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko ayio atano na abere aerire, rituko ria gatano na gatato na kogenderera abakuani mbabe bakorua igoro ase egesasimero ekio ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe; erio nario inche ndabanchere. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: At the end of these days, from the eighth day on, the priests are to present your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Na ase omoerio bw’omwaka o gatato Abaasuri bakayobua, bakayoira. Ase omwaka o gatano na rimo bw’okogamba kwa Hezekia, noro omwaka o kianda bw’okogamba kwa Hosea, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Samaria okairwa.
english: At the end of three years the Assyrians took it. So Samaria was captured in Hezekiah's sixth year, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase omoerio bw’emiaka emerongo ebere, eria Sulemani airete ase okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene na enyomba yaye omonyene,
english: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built the temple of the LORD and his own palace,

ekegusii: Sulemani akaira emiaka emerongo ebere ase okoagacha chinyomba chiria ibere, enyomba y’Omonene na ey’oboruoti.
english: At the end of twenty years, during which Solomon built these two buildings-- the temple of the LORD and the royal palace--

ekegusii: At the end of your life you will groan, when your flesh and body are spent.
english: Omoerio oye norere, obokie amagombo ekero chinyama chi’omobere oo chiaerire,

ekegusii: Agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Haroni na abamura baye barie chinyama chi’emingichi eria amo nemegati ere ase egetonga ime.
english: At the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, Aaron and his sons are to eat the meat of the ram and the bread that is in the basket.

ekegusii: Mambia kobogokiamoka omoruoti akaimoka akaayerera gochia ase engoro eria ye chindo.
english: At the first light of dawn, the king got up and hurried to the lions' den.

ekegusii: Agwo ase Egeita gi’Ensoko kiarenge bosio bwabo bakariina ase ebiriinero gochia ase Omochie o Daudi. Agwo bakariina ase orwaki rwarenge rogoro y’enyomba ya Daudi, gochia ase Egeita ki’Amache, ase ensemo ya moocha.
english: At the Fountain Gate they continued directly up the steps of the City of David on the ascent to the wall and passed above the house of David to the Water Gate on the east.

ekegusii: Ase kera amatabekania e chinchera kwaagachire aase aimokererete igoro ogosasimera, kwanyakairie oboseera bwao, gwechwarire ase onde bwensi ogoeta, na gwakorire obonyaka obonge.
english: At the head of every street you built your lofty shrines and degraded your beauty, offering your body with increasing promiscuity to anyone who passed by.

ekegusii: Nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase emseangererekano emenene y’abanto, naende ase ebiita bi’emechie, bwateba:
english: at the head of the noisy streets she cries out, in the gateways of the city she makes her speech:

ekegusii: korende Ehudi omonyene, ekero aigete ase amagena abaachire are emegwekano, ang’e na Giligali, akairana, akagenda naende ase Egiloni, akamotebia, “Omonene one omoruoti, nimbwate ring’ana ria bobisi nkogotebia.” Ase igo omoruoti agatebia abanto bonsi abateneine ang’e komokorera, “Toe ribaga, tobe intwe tweka!” Barabwo bonsi bagasoka.
english: At the idols near Gilgal he himself turned back and said, "I have a secret message for you, O king." The king said, "Quiet!" And all his attendants left him.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akabachika babaache amagena amanene aye rigori rinene, erinde oboroso bw’enyomba bobekwe amagena abaachire buya.
english: At the king's command they removed from the quarry large blocks of quality stone to provide a foundation of dressed stone for the temple.

ekegusii: Ase ayio buna omoruoti achigete, esanduku ekaroisigwa ekabekwa isiko ase egeita ki’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: At the king's command, a chest was made and placed outside, at the gate of the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto abaare abaango bakaegwa amarube korwa ase omoruoti na abagambi b’oboruoti, bakayaira ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli na ey’Abayuda, bagateba buna bachigetwe nomoruoti, bagateba, “Inwe Abaisraeli, moiranere Omonene, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Israeli, erio nere nabairanere inwe aba more abatigari mwatoorekire korwa ase amaboko ’abaruoti b’Abaasuri.
english: At the king's command, couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and from his officials, which read: "People of Israel, return to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, that he may return to you who are left, who have escaped from the hand of the kings of Assyria.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agachika ng’a abanto baria basoerete Danieli barentwe. Erio bakarutwa ase engoro eria ye chindo, barabwo amo nabana babo, na abakungu babo, na ekero bataragwa gochia inse y’engoro eria, chindo chiria chikabaumokera, chikabuna‐buna amauga onsi ay’emebere yabo.
english: At the king's command, the men who had falsely accused Daniel were brought in and thrown into the lions' den, along with their wives and children. And before they reached the floor of the den, the lions overpowered them and crushed all their bones.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano, omwaka bw’emerongo ene nyuma Abaisraeli kobarure ense ya Misiri, Haroni omokuani agatiira gochia igoro ase egetunwa kia Hori, buna Omonene konya amochikire, agakwera aroro.
english: At the LORD's command Aaron the priest went up Mount Hor, where he died on the first day of the fifth month of the fortieth year after the Israelites came out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Buna Omonene achigete Musa, nere akarika kera aase ase baare gotoora. Ebi nabio ebitwori biabo buna baare gotoora na koimoka kogenda:
english: At the LORD's command Moses recorded the stages in their journey. This is their journey by stages:

ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene nigo baare gochaka orogendo, na ase ogochika kwaye nigo baare gotoora. Engaki yonsi riire riria riagendererete kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria, abanto nigo baare kogenderera kobeera ase egetwori.
english: At the LORD's command the Israelites set out, and at his command they encamped. As long as the cloud stayed over the tabernacle, they remained in camp.

ekegusii: Buna Omonene arenge gochika nigo barenge gotoora, batiga orogendo, gose baimoka bachaka orogendo. Bakaba bakoigwera Omonene buna achigete goetera ase Musa.
english: At the LORD's command they encamped, and at the LORD's command they set out. They obeyed the LORD's order, in accordance with his command through Moses.

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo babaretwe buna Omonene achigete goetera ase Musa. Kera omonto agatebigwa emeremo arakore na ebinto arabogorie buna Omonene achigete Musa.
english: At the LORD's command through Moses, each was assigned his work and told what to carry. Thus they were counted, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Naende aase aria abamberetwe norengeo omogondo, na ime ase omogondo oboina oboyia, aase monto onde konya atarabekwa.
english: At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid.

ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase bakorara botuko, oyomo obo agasansora egunia yaye arusie endagera ae etigere yaye, akarora chibesa chiaye igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime,
english: At the place where they stopped for the night one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of his sack.

ekegusii: Ekero eke kia bono obonge bwaino bobakonye ase okoremerwa kwabo; ekero kende obonge bwabo bobakonye inwe ase okoremerwa kwaino; erio amang’ana abe areng’aine.
english: At the present time your plenty will supply what they need, so that in turn their plenty will supply what you need. Then there will be equality,

ekegusii: Naki ase okobokigwa tibakonyuoma gose tibakonyuomwa, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika ba Nyasae bare igoro.
english: At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.

ekegusii: Inee! Ase okobokigwa mokang’o arabe ase aba? Ekiagera bonsi batano na babere mbamotwarete.”
english: At the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?"

ekegusii: Imorie ebitinya goika moigote kegima, naende monywe amanyinga goika motinde; ekiagera oyio nomoyega bw’ekeng’wanso nabaroiseirie.
english: At the sacrifice I am preparing for you, you will eat fat till you are glutted and drink blood till you are drunk.

ekegusii: Amo nayio nigo asemeretie ng’a naegwe chifeta na Paulo. Nabo akana‐komorangeria ekero ase ekero gokwana nere.
english: At the same time he was hoping that Paul would offer him a bribe, so he sent for him frequently and talked with him.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio obong’aini bwane bokang’iranera, na obonene bw’oboruoti bwane, na obw’amasikani aane, bikang’iranera boigo. Abasemia baane, na abanto baane abanene bagacha kondigia, na inche nkairanerigwa oboruoti bwane, na nkamenterwa okobua okonene goetania.
english: At the same time that my sanity was restored, my honor and splendor were returned to me for the glory of my kingdom. My advisers and nobles sought me out, and I was restored to my throne and became even greater than before.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bagochirora nigo bagoichana, amaiso ’abanto bonsi nigo akoonchoka arachoka.
english: At the sight of them, nations are in anguish; every face turns pale.

ekegusii: Ekero chinsa isano nemo chiaika omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.
english: At the sixth hour darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

ekegusii: Ekero Babeli orabwatwe, ense netengechigwe, na eriogi riaye narigugwe ase egati y’ebisaku.”
english: At the sound of Babylon's capture the earth will tremble; its cry will resound among the nations.

ekegusii: Abanto ba kera omochie mbatame ekero baraigwe amariogi ’abariini chibarasi na ay’abwo babwate amata, mbatame gochia ase amanani, bebise ase ebitare ime. Emechie yonsi netigare bosa, nonya nomonto oyomo tagotigara aroro.
english: At the sound of horsemen and archers every town takes to flight. Some go into the thickets; some climb up among the rocks. All the towns are deserted; no one lives in them.

ekegusii: Ekero baraigwe amariogi ’ebititiro bi’ebitaago bie chibarasi, na okwoga kw’amagoro e chigari. Abaise tibakorigia nyuma barore ase abana babo bare; ekiagera amaboko abo nigo araborwe chinguru.
english: at the sound of the hoofs of galloping steeds, at the noise of enemy chariots and the rumble of their wheels. Fathers will not turn to help their children; their hands will hang limp.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’Edomu baragwe, eriogi riabo naritengechie ense; na eriogi ri’okorera kwabo narigugwe gochia ase Enyancha Embariri.
english: At the sound of their fall the earth will tremble; their cry will resound to the Red Sea.

ekegusii: Amariogi ay’okorangerania koria agatengechia oboroso bw’emetobwa ya inse y’ebisieri bie Hekalu, na erioki rigaichora ime ase enyomba eria.
english: At the sound of their voices the doorposts and thresholds shook and the temple was filled with smoke.

ekegusii: Naende ekero morabugie ekerombeta ase eriogi ri’ogotabobora eria kabere, abanto bare ase ebitwori bi’ensemo ya irianyi baimoke bachake orogendo. Ekerombeta goika kebugigwe ase eriogi erio ase chingaki chionsi abanto barabe bakomanora gochaka orogendo.
english: At the sounding of a second blast, the camps on the south are to set out. The blast will be the signal for setting out.

ekegusii: at the taunts of those who reproach and revile me, because of the enemy, who is bent on revenge.
english: ekero nkoigwa amang’ana ’abagonchecheria na gonkwana bobe, na ekero nkorora obosio bw’omobisa na obw’oyo okorusia egesiomba.

ekegusii: Ase Eema y’Omosangererekano Abagerisoni nabwo barabe bakorenda Obomenyo obonyene, na ebimumeko biaye, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’Eema eria.
english: At the Tent of Meeting the Gershonites were responsible for the care of the tabernacle and tent, its coverings, the curtain at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,

ekegusii: Ekero aye gwakanire neriogi ringa buna eri’okogukura, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bagotama, na ekero kwaimokereire igoro, barabwo nigo bagoserebekana.
english: At the thunder of your voice, the peoples flee; when you rise up, the nations scatter.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba, Elija omobani agacha ang’e, agasaba, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Israeli, tiga emanyekane ase rituko ria rero ng’a aye naye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, naende ng’a inche nigo inde omosomba oo, naende ng’a nigo ngokora amang’ana aya onsi ase ring’ana riao.
english: At the time of sacrifice, the prophet Elijah stepped forward and prayed: "O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant and have done all these things at your command.

ekegusii: Ekero ki’omoyega agatoma omosomba oye kogenda gotebia baria konya barangerigwe: Inchuo, ekiagera ebinto bionsi biabeire ang’e.
english: At the time of the banquet he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, 'Come, for everything is now ready.'

ekegusii: Ekero orabaorokere nobakore booke buna omorero ekebemberi. Omonene nabasirie nendamwamu yaye enene; omorero nobasambe, bayie baere.
english: At the time of your appearing you will make them like a fiery furnace. In his wrath the LORD will swallow them up, and his fire will consume them.

ekegusii: Igoro kegima ase kera ekebekerero nigo kiarenge orosingo rw’obogare bw’ekeng’ese gi’okoboko okomo; na igoro ase orosingo orwo nigo biarenge ebisiirero amo ne chinsingo chie chinsemo. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe bikaba egento ekemo nebisiirero.
english: At the top of the stand there was a circular band half a cubit deep. The supports and panels were attached to the top of the stand.

ekegusii: Ase omoerio bw’omwaka abarwani esegi b’Abasiiria bagacha korwania Yoashi. Bagacha ase Abayuda na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, bagaita abanene bonsi b’abanto abwo. Na ebisakorwa bionsi basakorete bakairera omoruoti o Damesiki.
english: At the turn of the year, the army of Aram marched against Joash; it invaded Judah and Jerusalem and killed all the leaders of the people. They sent all the plunder to their king in Damascus.

ekegusii: Ninde nobwoba ase engencho y’amariogi ’ababisa baane, na ase engencho y’obobe bw’abakori amabe. Abanto abwo nigo bakondetera amaakwa, bakongecha bare nendamwamu.
english: at the voice of the enemy, at the stares of the wicked; for they bring down suffering upon me and revile me in their anger.

ekegusii: Nigo narigereretie isiko goetera ase ekebao ki’enyomba yaane na ebichanga bi’aroro.
english: At the window of my house I looked out through the lattice.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge ang’e nabarabwo bagatama, bakarera, bakobora, “Boigo naintwe riroba ndibaise gotomera.”
english: At their cries, all the Israelites around them fled, shouting, "The earth is going to swallow us too!"

ekegusii: Kera ebao ase echio ibere ekabwatanigwa ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere; naboigo bakorete ase chibao echio ibere echiabegetwe ase chikoona ibere.
english: At these two corners the frames were double from the bottom all the way to the top and fitted into a single ring; both were made alike.

ekegusii: Kera ebao ase echio ibere ebwatanigwe ne chibao chie chinsinyo, korwa inse goika igoro ase ebonyi entang’ani ere. Ase enchera eyio chibao ibere chibekwe ase chikoona ibere.
english: At these two corners they must be double from the bottom all the way to the top, and fitted into a single ring; both shall be like that.

ekegusii: Erio gokaba naende ogwatananekana ase Abayahudi ase engencho y’amang’ana aya.
english: At these words the Jews were again divided.

ekegusii: (Aroro agwo nkaboka korwa ase chitoro, nkarigereria, ne chitoro chiane nigo chiarenge chingiya asende.)
english: At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been pleasant to me.

ekegusii: Erio ngatung’ama ase amagoro aye nkamosasima. Na ere agantebia, “Tokora igo! Inche nomosomba omogisangio oo na oyo bw’abamino abare noborori bwa Yeso. Osasime Nyasae! Naki oborori bwa Yeso nabwo omoika bw’obobani.”
english: At this I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said to me, "Do not do it! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers who hold to the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."

ekegusii: Ase ayio chibachwa chiane chianyegerigwe, obororo bwansoire, obororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore; naichanire mono, tindi koigwa; nabeire nobwoba obonene, tindi korora.
english: At this my body is racked with pain, pangs seize me, like those of a woman in labor; I am staggered by what I hear, I am bewildered by what I see.

ekegusii: Agachia gwekengera iga, Festo agakwana neriogi rinene, “Paulo, nebarimo ore! Ogosoma kwao okonge kwaonchoire obong’aini bwao.”
english: At this point Festus interrupted Paul's defense. "You are out of your mind, Paul!" he shouted. "Your great learning is driving you insane."

ekegusii: Anania, omokuani omonene, agachika baria bateneine ang’e nere bamoake omonwa oye.
english: At this the high priest Ananias ordered those standing near Paul to strike him on the mouth.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamwemurunganeria, ekiagera atebete, “Inche nomogati oigete korwa igoro.”
english: At this the Jews began to grumble about him because he said, "I am the bread that came down from heaven."

ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamotebia, “Bono twamanyire ng’a nigo obwatire nekerecha, Ibrahimu okure, na ababani, na aye nigo ogoteba: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takoigwa amakweri nonya ng’ake.
english: At this the Jews exclaimed, "Now we know that you are demon-possessed! Abraham died and so did the prophets, yet you say that if anyone keeps your word, he will never taste death.

ekegusii: Naende omoruoti agatoma omotang’ani onde bw’abarwani esegi emerongo etano, amo nabarwani baye emerongo etano. Nere agatiira, agatebia Elija, “Aye omonto o Nyasae, omoruoti ochikire ng’a otirimboke bwango, ogende asare.”
english: At this the king sent to Elijah another captain with his fifty men. The captain said to him, "Man of God, this is what the king says, 'Come down at once!'"

ekegusii: Korende ere abanyiria obosio ase ring’ana riria, akagenda nobororo, ekiagera arenge nenibo enyinge.
english: At this the man's face fell. He went away sad, because he had great wealth.

ekegusii: Erio agwo abanto baria bakairoka Omonene mono, bakamoruera ekeng’wanso na komoriera chiira.
english: At this the men greatly feared the LORD, and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows to him.

ekegusii: Korende bagaaka egeturi ase eriogi rinene, bagakuneka amato abo, bakamorindokera bonsi amo,
english: At this they covered their ears and, yelling at the top of their voices, they all rushed at him,

ekegusii: Igo bakarigia komobwata, korende onde tari oramborete okoboko kwaye, erinde amobwate, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika.
english: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.

ekegusii: Naende bagachaka korera mono goetania. Erio Oripa akanyunyunta ng’ina biara, akamotiga, korende Rutu akaanga komotiga.
english: At this they wept again. Then Orpah kissed her mother-in-law good-by, but Ruth clung to her.

ekegusii: Ekaba ase amatuko ’Amurafeli, omoruoti o Shinari, na Arioki, omoruoti o Eleasari, na Kedorilaoma, omoruoti o Elamu, na Tidali, omoruoti o Goimu,
english: At this time Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Kedorlaomer king of Elam and Tidal king of Goiim

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Hezekia akaomora chitahabu korwa ase ebisieri bie Hekalu y’Omonene, na korwa ase emetobwa y’ebisieri eria ere omonyene aoomete, agachia omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
english: At this time Hezekiah king of Judah stripped off the gold with which he had covered the doors and doorposts of the temple of the LORD, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

ekegusii: Bono abanto bande b’Abakalidayo bakagenda bagasoera Abayahudi.
english: At this time some astrologers came forward and denounced the Jews.

ekegusii: Erio abageni bonsi b’Adonia bakaiguswa ase omoondoko, bakaimoka, na kera omonto akagenda enchera yaye.
english: At this, all Adonijah's guests rose in alarm and dispersed.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi, abake na abanene, amo nabatang’ani b’abarwani esegi bakaimoka, bagatama gochia Misiri, ekiagera bairogete Abakalidayo.
english: At this, all the people from the least to the greatest, together with the army officers, fled to Egypt for fear of the Babylonians.

ekegusii: Danieli akagenda ase obosio bw’omoruoti, akamosaba amoe engaki achiche komotebia engencho ye chindoto chiria.
english: At this, Daniel went in to the king and asked for time, so that he might interpret the dream for him.

ekegusii: Ase igo akaimoka akabekera etigere yaye egeikaransero, akariina igoro asere, akagenda Gati ase Akisi korigia abasomba baye; akabanyora, akabairania inka.
english: At this, he saddled his donkey and went to Achish at Gath in search of his slaves. So Shimei went away and brought the slaves back from Gath.

ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akaimoka, agatandora eanga yaye, agakigita etukia yaye, erio agatung’ama inse, agasasima,
english: At this, Job got up and tore his robe and shaved his head. Then he fell to the ground in worship

ekegusii: At this, she bowed down with her face to the ground. She exclaimed, "Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you notice me-- a foreigner?"
english: Rutu agatung’ama inse akaumama, akaboria Boazi, “Naki gwakora kwanyechandera na gonkorera buya iga, na inche nomomenyi inde aa?”

ekegusii: Kagokwana aya akeonchora gochia nyuma, akarora Yeso oteneine, tamanya ng’a n’Yeso.
english: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.

ekegusii: Na rora, abande ase aborokia b’amariko bakabora ase emioyo yabo, “Omonto oyo nkorama are.”
english: At this, some of the teachers of the law said to themselves, "This fellow is blaspheming!"

ekegusii: Erio abanene baria na abagambi baria abanene bakarigia banyore okomocha ase okogamba kwa Danieli, erinde bagende komosoera, korende tibanyorete kende gionsi ekebe, gose okomocha asare, ekiagera ere nigo arenge omwegenwa; okomocha gose gento kende ekebe tibianyorekanete asare.
english: At this, the administrators and the satraps tried to find grounds for charges against Daniel in his conduct of government affairs, but they were unable to do so. They could find no corruption in him, because he was trustworthy and neither corrupt nor negligent.

ekegusii: At this, the kinsman-redeemer said, "Then I cannot redeem it because I might endanger my own estate. You redeem it yourself. I cannot do it."
english: Omonyamwando oria akairaneria, akabora, “Onye naboigo, tinkobogora, mbaise gosiria omwando one. Ribaga riane ri’okobogora, aye riire; tinkonyara kobogora.”

ekegusii: Bwango amato aye agatinoka, egesibo ki’oromeme rwaye gekororoba, agakwana buya.
english: At this, the man's ears were opened, his tongue was loosened and he began to speak plainly.

ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia amagena bamorute, korende Yeso akebisa, agasoka korwa ase Hekalu.
english: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.

ekegusii: Erio bonsi bagatandora chianga chiabo; kera omonto akabekera etigere yaye egurube, bakairana gochia ase omochie.
english: At this, they tore their clothes. Then they all loaded their donkeys and returned to the city.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia koyaigwa, bagasoka oyomo oyomo, abagaaka nabwo bachagete. Yeso bweka agatigara, na omokungu oria oteneine gati‐gati.
english: At this, those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left, with the woman still standing there.

ekegusii: at twilight, as the day was fading, as the dark of night set in.
english: mogoroba kobokomura‐mura, ekero ki’omosunte bw’obotuko.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae o Yakobo, ekero gwatogonyerete abanto bariinete chibarasi, barabwo nigo bagwete inse, bakaba buna nigo bakwete, amo ne chibarasi chiabo.
english: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still.

ekegusii: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
english: Ateri, na Hezekia, na Asuri;

ekegusii: Atroth Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
english: na Ataroti‐Shofani, na Yaeseri, ne Yogibea,

ekegusii: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
english: na Atai oyo o gatano na rimo, na Elieli oyo o gatano na kabere,

ekegusii: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan the father of Zabad,
english: Atai akaibora Nathani, na Nathani akaibora Sabadi,

ekegusii: na eatanane korwa ase obobe bwa kera engencho.
english: Avoid every kind of evil.

ekegusii: Bweatanane korwa ase amang’ana atari ay’obonyasae, na atari nengencho. Naki ase ayio abanto nigo baragenderere komenteka ase chingencho chitari chi’obonyasae.
english: Avoid godless chatter, because those who indulge in it will become more and more ungodly.

ekegusii: Bweatanane korwa ase enchera eyio, toyebwatia, korende ogobere oetere ensemo, ogende bosio.
english: Avoid it, do not travel on it; turn from it and go on your way.

ekegusii: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,
english: na Avimu, na Para, na Ofura,

ekegusii: Nyasae one ore Omonene one, tabobora, oimokerere igoro, erinde orwanerere oboronge bwane na amang’ana aane.
english: Awake, and rise to my defense! Contend for me, my God and Lord.

ekegusii: Aye okoboko kw’Omonene, imoka, bwebeke chinguru, imoka! Imoka buna kwaimogete ase amatuko a kare, ee, imoka buna kwaimogete ase ebiaare bia kare. Inee! Tari aye kwanachanete Rahabu, okabeta enchoka eria?
english: Awake, awake! Clothe yourself with strength, O arm of the LORD; awake, as in days gone by, as in generations of old. Was it not you who cut Rahab to pieces, who pierced that monster through?

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, boka, imoka motenene! Inwe mwanyure korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene egekombe ki’endamwamu yaye; inwe mwanyure korwa ase egekombe ekio, mwanyuereranirie eturubo mwatindire.
english: Awake, awake! Rise up, O Jerusalem, you who have drunk from the hand of the LORD the cup of his wrath, you who have drained to its dregs the goblet that makes men stagger.

ekegusii: Aye Sayoni, imoka, bwebeke chinguru, imoka! Ee, aye Yerusalemu, omochie omochenu, eboyie chianga chiao chinseera; korwa bono abanto batarogeti na abatachenegeti, tibagosoa ime yao nonya ng’ake.
english: Awake, awake, O Zion, clothe yourself with strength. Put on your garments of splendor, O Jerusalem, the holy city. The uncircumcised and defiled will not enter you again.

ekegusii: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
english: Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.

ekegusii: Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
english: Aye omoyo one, boka! Inwe amakano aane onsi, boka! Nainche nimboke mambia chuni.

ekegusii: Aye embeo ekorwa sugusu, imoka! Na aye eyekorwa irianyi, inchuo! Gusa igoro y’omogondo one, tiga rimisu riaye rigiya rirurukigwe rirande. Tiga omwanchi one ache ase omogondo oye, arie amatunda are amaya mono.
english: Awake, north wind, and come, south wind! Blow on my garden, that its fragrance may spread abroad. Let my lover come into his garden and taste its choice fruits.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, boka oimokerere igoro? Nase ki oraire? Boka, tototuguta kegima!
english: Awake, O Lord! Why do you sleep? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.

ekegusii: Yeso akamanya aya, akabatebia, “Naki mokoborania, ekiagera motari nemegati? Timokoinyora gose timekomanya? Chinkoro chiaino nigo chire chinkong’u goika bono?
english: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked them: "Why are you talking about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Are your hearts hardened?

ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabora, “Inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke, inki gekogera mokona‐koborania ng’a timori nemegati?
english: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked, "You of little faith, why are you talking among yourselves about having no bread?

ekegusii: Yeso, konya omanyire aya, akabatebia, “Nase ki mokorosia omokungu oyo? Ere onkoreire emeremo emiya,
english: Aware of this, Jesus said to them, "Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing to me.

ekegusii: Yeso konya omanyire aya, akarua aroro. Abanto abange bakamotunyana, akabagwenia bonsi.
english: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. Many followed him, and he healed all their sick,

ekegusii: Ko Yeso akamanya ase omoyo oye ng’a aborokigwa baye bemurunganeirie ring’ana eri, akababoria, “Ring’ana eri ndiabagochire?
english: Aware that his disciples were grumbling about this, Jesus said to them, "Does this offend you?

ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abakori amabe, karue asende, ekiagera Omonene oigure okorera kwane.
english: Away from me, all you who do evil, for the LORD has heard my weeping.

ekegusii: Inwe abakori amabe, karue asende, erinde inyare korenda amachiko a Nyasae one.
english: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!

ekegusii: Rusia korwa asende okwoga kwaino kw’amatera, tingwancha ntegerere amariogi ’amakano aino.
english: Away with the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

ekegusii: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,
english: na Asareli, Selemia na Semaria,

ekegusii: Asaria akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa aase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, agwo ase Omochie o Daudi, na Yotamu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Azariah rested with his fathers and was buried near them in the City of David. And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Asaria, mosinto o Hilikia o Mesulamu, o Zadoki, o Meraioti, bw’Ahitubu, omoteneneri omonene bw’enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: Azariah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the official in charge of the house of God;

ekegusii: Asaria, mosinto o Hosaya, na Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, amo nabanto abamwenu bonsi, bagatebia Yeremia, “Ayio noborimo ogokwana. Omonene Nyasae oito tagotometi ng’a otokanie titogenda Misiri komenyao.
english: Azariah son of Hoshaiah and Johanan son of Kareah and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, "You are lying! The LORD our God has not sent you to say, 'You must not go to Egypt to settle there.'

ekegusii: Asaria, mosinto o Nathani, nere orenge omoteneneri igoro ase abanene baria; Zabudi, mosinto o Nathani, nere orenge omokuani, naende nigo arenge omosani bw’omoruoti;
english: Azariah son of Nathan-- in charge of the district officers; Zabud son of Nathan-- a priest and personal adviser to the king;

ekegusii: Azariah the father of Amariah, Amariah the father of Ahitub,
english: Asaria akaibora Amaria, na Amaria akaibora Ahitubu;

ekegusii: Azariah the father of Helez, Helez the father of Eleasah,
english: Asaria akaibora Helesi, na Helesi akaibora Eleasa;

ekegusii: Azariah the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah the father of Jehozadak.
english: Asaria akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Yehosadaki.

ekegusii: Asaria amo nabakuani bande b’Omonene emerongo etano na etato barenge abaremu bagasoa Hekalu korwa nyuma yaye.
english: Azariah the priest with eighty other courageous priests of the LORD followed him in.

ekegusii: Aseli nabwate abana abamura batano nomo, naya naro amarieta abo: Asirikamu na Bokeru, Isumaeli na Searia, Obadia na Hanani. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura b’Aseli.
english: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

ekegusii: Aseli nabwate abana abamura batano nomo, na amarieta abo naro aya: Asirikamu, na Bokeru, na Isumaeli, na Searia, na Obadia, na Hanani. Aba nabwo abana abamura b’Aseli.
english: Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

ekegusii: Asimaweti, mosinto bw’Adieli, agatenenera chimonga chi’omoruoti; na Yonathani, mosinto bwa Usia, agatenenera chimonga chi’ense eria, ase emechie emenene na emeke, na ase emerobiri.
english: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses. Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the outlying districts, in the towns, the villages and the watchtowers.

ekegusii: Asimaweti korwa Gahurimu na Eliaba korwa Saalaboni;
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

ekegusii: Azor the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Akim, Akim the father of Eliud,
english: na Azoro akaibora Zadoki, na Zadoki akaibora Akimu, na Akimu akaibora Eliudi,

ekegusii: Baalah, Iim, Ezem,
english: na Baala, na Iyimu, na Esemu,

ekegusii: na Baalati, na Tamari ore ase erooro, ase ense eria,
english: Baalath, and Tadmor in the desert, within his land,

ekegusii: Baali‐Hanani Omogederi agatenenera emezeituni na emeko agwo ase ense omweya. Na Yoashi agatenenera ebigachero bi’amaguta ’amazeituni.
english: Baal-Hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore-fig trees in the western foothills. Joash was in charge of the supplies of olive oil.

ekegusii: Baana, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, agatenenera emechie ya Taanaki na Megido, na Beti‐Sehani yonsi, eyio eikerete Saretani, irianyi ya Yesireeli, na korwa Beti‐Sehani goika Abeli‐Mehola, na ng’umbu ya Yoki‐Meamu.
english: Baana son of Ahilud-- in Taanach and Megiddo, and in all of Beth Shan next to Zarethan below Jezreel, from Beth Shan to Abel Meholah across to Jokmeam;

ekegusii: Baana, mosinto o Husai, agatenenera orogongo rw’Aseri na omochie o Bealoti;
english: Baana son of Hushai-- in Asher and in Aloth;

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, noro Baasa, akamoita, naende akaba okogamba ribaga riaye.
english: Baasha killed Nadab in the third year of Asa king of Judah and succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akagenda korwania Abayuda, akagitera omochie o Rama chindwaki, ng’a nario ribaga ritabaisa gotoka ase omonto onde bwensi gosoka gose gosoa kogenda ase Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.

ekegusii: Baasa akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete agatindekwa agwo Tirisa, na Ela omwana oye omomura akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Baasha rested with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah. And Elah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya, omonto bw’enyomba ya Isakaru, agakora omoroberio bw’ogoita Nadabu, akamoaka, akamoitera agwo Gibetoni, omochie bw’Abafilisti. Nadabu na Abaisraeli bonsi nigo bebisete baboerete Gibetoni.
english: Baasha son of Ahijah of the house of Issachar plotted against him, and he struck him down at Gibbethon, a Philistine town, while Nadab and all Israel were besieging it.

ekegusii: Babeli nigo yarenge buna egekombe gi’etahabu ase okoboko kw’Omonene; ebisaku bionsi bi’ense bikanywera korwa ase kerokio bigatinda. Ebisaku bikanywa edivai ya Babeli, erio bigatinda, bikaba buna chibarimo.
english: Babylon was a gold cup in the LORD's hand; she made the whole earth drunk. The nations drank her wine; therefore they have now gone mad.

ekegusii: Babeli nosirigwe obe etui y’amatongo ase chisese chi’orosana chiramenye. Abanto tibakomenya aroro, korende nigo barabe bagoichanigwa na koyochecheria.
english: Babylon will be a heap of ruins, a haunt of jackals, an object of horror and scorn, a place where no one lives.

ekegusii: Babeli ogure mobosokano na gosirigwa, Yoreere mobogorie amaguta akogwenia amaote aye, ande nabo ense eria erabaise kogwenigwa.
english: Babylon will suddenly fall and be broken. Wail over her! Get balm for her pain; perhaps she can be healed.

ekegusii: Babeli oyio ore obonene bw’amaruoti, na obwari na obonene bw’Abakalidayo, nobe buna Sodomu na Gomora, ekero Nyasae konya ayosaririe.
english: Babylon, the jewel of kingdoms, the glory of the Babylonians' pride, will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah.

ekegusii: Abarwani chituoni ba Babeli batigire korwana esegi. Nigo bagendererete kobeera ase chiburi ime, ekiagera tibari ne chinguru, babeire buna abakungu. Chinyomba chia Babeli chiasambirwe, na emekorogoto yabo y’ebiita yabunirwe.
english: Babylon's warriors have stopped fighting; they remain in their strongholds. Their strength is exhausted; they have become like women. Her dwellings are set on fire; the bars of her gates are broken.

ekegusii: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal and Mattaniah son of Mica, the son of Zicri, the son of Asaph;
english: Bakibakari na Heresi, Galali na Matania, mosinto o Mika o Sikiri, bw’Asafu;

ekegusii: Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur,
english: Bakubuki, na Hakufa, na Harihuri;

ekegusii: Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur,
english: Bakibuki, na Hakufa, na Harihuri;

ekegusii: Bakibukia na Uno, abamwabo, bagatenena kororia asebare, ekero barenge gokora emeremo yabo ase Hekalu.
english: Bakbukiah and Unni, their associates, stood opposite them in the services.

ekegusii: Baalamu agatebia Balaki, “Inee! Tinatebetie abanto baria gwatomete asende ng’a
english: Balaam answered Balak, "Did I not tell the messengers you sent me,

ekegusii: Baalamu akayeiraneria, “Nekiagera gwankoreire echeche. Onye nabwate omoro ase okoboko kwane, nanga nigo narenge kogoita.”
english: Balaam answered the donkey, "You have made a fool of me! If I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now."

ekegusii: Korende Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Tinagotebia ng’a amang’ana onsi Omonene agontebia, ayio naro ndakore?”
english: Balaam answered, "Did I not tell you I must do whatever the LORD says?"

ekegusii: Baalamu akaimoka mambia rituko ria kabere, akaberekia etigere yaye egeikaransero, akagenda amo nabanene baria ba Moabu.
english: Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his donkey and went with the princes of Moab.

ekegusii: Baalamu agatebia Balaki, “Beera aa, otenene ensemo y’ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ogosambwa inche ngende aaria ng’umbu, toumerane n’Omonene.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, "Stay here beside your offering while I meet with him over there."

ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, omoruoti o Moabu, nere otomire abanto aba asende, ogoteba ng’a
english: Balaam said to God, "Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:

ekegusii: Erio Baalamu agatebia omomalaika bw’Omonene, “Inche nakorire ebibe, tinamanyete ng’a naye gwateneine gati y’enchera gontanga. Korende bono onye orogendo rokororekana ng’a norobe asore, tiga ing’irane.”
english: Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, "I have sinned. I did not realize you were standing in the road to oppose me. Now if you are displeased, I will go back."

ekegusii: Baalamu akamotebia Balaki, “Ng’agachere aiga ebisasimero bitano na bibere, naende ondetere chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere.”
english: Balaam said, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."

ekegusii: Balaam said, "Build me seven altars here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me."
english: Baalamu akamotebia, “Ng’agachere aiga ebisasimero bitano na bibere, na ondetere chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere.”

ekegusii: Balaki agakora buna atebetigwe, akarua eeri eyemo amo nemingichi eyemo ase kera egesasimero.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

ekegusii: Balaki agakora buna Baalamu amotebetie, na abwo babere bakarua ekeng’wanso igoro ase kera egesasimero, eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo.
english: Balak did as Balaam said, and the two of them offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

ekegusii: Balaki akanyenya chiombe ne ching’ondi, akaa Baalamu amo nabanene barenge amo nere.
english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and gave some to Balaam and the princes who were with him.

ekegusii: Balaki akaboria Baalamu, “Inee! Naki otachete ekero natomete abanto gokorangeria? Nase ki otachete? Nigo gwakagete ng’a tingocha gokoa ogosika kogoisaine?”
english: Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why didn't you come to me? Am I really not able to reward you?"

ekegusii: Balaki akaboria Baalamu, “Ngento ki eke aye gwankoreire? Nigo nakorangeretie ng’a oche obaragererie ababisa baane, na rora, ribaga ri’ayio kwabasesenirie.”
english: Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I brought you to curse my enemies, but you have done nothing but bless them!"

ekegusii: Engaki eria Baraki agacha, okobwatia Sisera, na Yaeli agasoka komorotota, akamotebia, “Inchuo, nkworokie omonto oria okorigia.” Agasoa amo na Yaeli, akanyora Sisera orambereretie inse, okwete, na ekerochi kere ase chintakunero chiaye ime.
english: Barak came by in pursuit of Sisera, and Jael went out to meet him. "Come," she said, "I will show you the man you're looking for." So he went in with her, and there lay Sisera with the tent peg through his temple-- dead.

ekegusii: Baraki akairaneria Debora, “Aye koragende amo nainche, rirorio ningende, korende otagendeti amo nainche, tinkogenda.”
english: Barak said to her, "If you go with me, I will go; but if you don't go with me, I won't go."

ekegusii: Barkos, Sisera, Temah,
english: Barikosi, na Sisera, na Tema;

ekegusii: Bakaroka Barnaba Zeu, na Paulo Herme, ekiagera nere orenge omonene ase ogokwana.
english: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes because he was the chief speaker.

ekegusii: Barnaba agancha koirana Yohana, ore korokwa Mariko, amo nabarabwo.
english: Barnabas wanted to take John, also called Mark, with them,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Baruku, mosinto o Neria, agakora onsi aya Yeremia konya amochikire, agasoma korwa ase ebuku amang’ana ’Omonene, agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Baruch son of Neriah did everything Jeremiah the prophet told him to do; at the LORD's temple he read the words of the LORD from the scroll.

ekegusii: Bono Barisilai Omogileadi nere konya ochire korwa Rogelimu gokooba omoruoti gochia Yorodan amboke amo nere.
english: Barzillai the Gileadite also came down from Rogelim to cross the Jordan with the king and to send him on his way from there.

ekegusii: Batiseba agatung’ama inse ase okoorokia amasikani ase omoruoti, na omoruoti akamoboria, “Ninki oganetie?”
english: Bathsheba bowed low and knelt before the king. "What is it you want?" the king asked.

ekegusii: Bazluth, Mehida, Harsha,
english: Basiluti, na Mehida, na Harisa;

ekegusii: Ase ayio, renda kera ekero na gosaba, monyore chinguru chi’ogoeta ase aya onsi arache koba, naende gotenena ase obosio bw’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.”
english: Be always on the watch, and pray that you may be able to escape all that is about to happen, and that you may be able to stand before the Son of Man."

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Inwe igoro chionsi, kumia ase ayio, kabe nobwoba, moiroke na koiguswa!
english: Be appalled at this, O heavens, and shudder with great horror," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Aye Sidoni, rora obosooku; enyancha ere neburi enkong’u y’enyancha yatebire iga: “Inche tinana kobina, gose koibora, tinana korera abana abamura, gose gokinia abaiseke abekungi.”
english: Be ashamed, O Sidon, and you, O fortress of the sea, for the sea has spoken: "I have neither been in labor nor given birth; I have neither reared sons nor brought up daughters."

ekegusii: Ekeene, amang’ana aane tari ay’oborimo; inche oyo nteneine aiga amo naye nomoikeranu inde ase okomanya.”
english: Be assured that my words are not false; one perfect in knowledge is with you.

ekegusii: Korende momanye ase ekeene ng’a mokong’ita, okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga ay’oyotari nokomocha nakobe igoro yaino, na ase omochie oyo, na ase abanto bonsi bareo, ekiagera ekeene, Omonene nere ontoma nkwane amang’ana ayio onsi ase moigwete.”
english: Be assured, however, that if you put me to death, you will bring the guilt of innocent blood on yourselves and on this city and on those who live in it, for in truth the LORD has sent me to you to speak all these words in your hearing."

ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, irana obe nobotoereru, ekiagera Omonene ogokoreire amaya amange.
english: Be at rest once more, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.

ekegusii: Moigwere na kwerenda, timobaisa kweba okobwatana kw’ogotianania, okwo Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorete nainwe; timobaisa koroisia omogwekano onde bwensi mogosasima. Omonene, Nyasae oino, obakanirie ayio.
english: Be careful not to forget the covenant of the LORD your God that he made with you; do not make for yourselves an idol in the form of anything the LORD your God has forbidden.

ekegusii: Mwerende mono, timobaisa kwanga koa omotaka oyio egento na goteba: Omwaka bw’okwabera chisira obeire ang’e. Timoa ebirengererio ebibe buna ebio ribaga ase chinkoro chiaino. Onye mokoba abang’iti na kwanga koa oyomino ore omotaka egento, ere narere ase Omonene, ekiagera mwamorinire eki aremeire, nainwe namobe nebibe.
english: Be careful not to harbor this wicked thought: "The seventh year, the year for canceling debts, is near," so that you do not show ill will toward your needy brother and give him nothing. He may then appeal to the LORD against you, and you will be found guilty of sin.

ekegusii: Bwerende, tobaisa gokora okobwatana nabanyene ense eria ase okogenda, babaise kobatega mogwe.
english: Be careful not to make a treaty with those who live in the land where you are going, or they will be a snare among you.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotiga gokonya Abalawi ase chingaki chionsi moragenderere komenya ase ense yaino.
english: Be careful not to neglect the Levites as long as you live in your land.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotebana ase amang’ana aya. Nase ki inche omoruoti ndanyore emechando?”
english: Be careful not to neglect this matter. Why let this threat grow, to the detriment of the royal interests?

ekegusii: Mwerende mono, timobaisa koruera ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa aase aande onsi mokorora na gochora inwe abanyene.
english: Be careful not to sacrifice your burnt offerings anywhere you please.

ekegusii: Bono erende, endamwamu tebaisa gokoebereria na kogokora obe omochecheria, tobaisa gwancha obonge bw’embooria bogosirie.
english: Be careful that no one entices you by riches; do not let a large bribe turn you aside.

ekegusii: “Mwerende mono, timobaisa kweba Omonene, Nyasae oino. Timobaisa gotiga kobwata amachiko aye, na emeroberio yaye yonsi echikire, aya nkobaa ase rituko ria rero.
english: Be careful that you do not forget the LORD your God, failing to observe his commands, his laws and his decrees that I am giving you this day.

ekegusii: Komoraikeo mwerende mono, timobaisa kweba Omonene oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase mwarenge abasomba.
english: be careful that you do not forget the LORD, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

ekegusii: “Moigwere amachiko aya onsi nabaeire ase rituko ria rero, moyabwate, erio nario morabe moyo na komentekana, erinde mogende moire ense eria Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabayee.
english: Be careful to follow every command I am giving you today, so that you may live and increase and may enter and possess the land that the LORD promised on oath to your forefathers.

ekegusii: Moigwere amang’ana aya onsi nabachikire, erio nario erabe buya asemore, na ase ororeria rwaino kare na kare; ekiagera ekero morakore igo, obwo nabwo oboronge na amaya ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: Be careful to obey all these regulations I am giving you, so that it may always go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and right in the eyes of the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Korende rigereria ng’a obosibore boria bwaino tibocha kobagocha baria bare abareu.
english: Be careful, however, that the exercise of your freedom does not become a stumbling block to the weak.

ekegusii: Mwerende mono chinkoro chiaino tichibang’ainereria. Timobaisa gotiga Omonene na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao, na gochisasima.
english: Be careful, or you will be enticed to turn away and worship other gods and bow down to them.

ekegusii: ase obokanyeku bwonsi na obwororo, na ase oboremereria mokobogorerania ase obwanchani.
english: Be completely humble and gentle; be patient, bearing with one another in love.

ekegusii: Obwanchani bw’obomino bobe ase egati yaino; mobe abe ritang’ani kworokia abamino amasikani.
english: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love. Honor one another above yourselves.

ekegusii: Orengererie ayio, bwerue kegima ase ayio, erio okogenderera kwao kobe maiso marore ase abanto bonsi.
english: Be diligent in these matters; give yourself wholly to them, so that everyone may see your progress.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi. Tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.
english: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, and let your glory be over all the earth.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokie ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi, tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.
english: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oorokia ng’a nigo ore omonene goetania igoro chionsi, tiga obonene bwao bororekane ase ense yonsi.
english: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene otogigwe ase engencho ye chinguru chiao, intwe ntobe togotera ogotera kw’ogotogia okobua kwao.
english: Be exalted, O LORD, in your strength; we will sing and praise your might.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, goka, mochenge ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekiagera obaeire embura entang’ani ebaisaine; nere okobatweria embura botambe, eye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.
english: Be glad, O people of Zion, rejoice in the LORD your God, for he has given you the autumn rains in righteousness. He sends you abundant showers, both autumn and spring rains, as before.

ekegusii: Aye omosae, gokera engaki y’obosae bwao, tiga enkoro yao ekorentere omogoko ase amatuko ’obosae bwao; bwatia chinchera chi’okogania gw’enkoro yao, na aya amaiso ao akorora. Korende oinyore ng’a ase ayio onsi Nyasae nakorangerie ase ekina.
english: Be happy, young man, while you are young, and let your heart give you joy in the days of your youth. Follow the ways of your heart and whatever your eyes see, but know that for all these things God will bring you to judgment.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, mobe abegi ba Nyasae, buna abana abanchwa;
english: Be imitators of God, therefore, as dearly loved children

ekegusii: Be joyful always;
english: Goka botambe!

ekegusii: Mogoke ase amatuko ayio, inwe amo nabana baino, abamura na abaiseke, na abasomba baino, abamura na abaiseke, na Abalawi, na abamenyi, ne chintakana, na ababoraka, abwo bamenyete ase emechie yaino.
english: Be joyful at your Feast-- you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levites, the aliens, the fatherless and the widows who live in your towns.

ekegusii: Mogoke ase ogosemeria, moremererie ase emechando, mogenderere nogosaba.
english: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

ekegusii: Mobe nobwororo inwe ase inwe, mororerane amabeebe, na kwaberana inwe ase inwe, buna Nyasae ase Kristo abaaberete inwe.
english: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.

ekegusii: Omonene, ndorera amabera, ekiagera inde omonyanyuru. Aye Omonene, ingwenie, ekiagera amauga aane nigo akonyegerigwa.
english: Be merciful to me, LORD, for I am faint; O LORD, heal me, for my bones are in agony.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ndorere amabera, ekiagera nigo mbwate emechando; amaiso aane arimeire ime ase engencho y’obororo, omoyo one ogoyire, naboigo nomobere one.
english: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes grow weak with sorrow, my soul and my body with grief.

ekegusii: Be merciful to those who doubt;
english: Mobarorere amabera abwo bagotiting’ara.

ekegusii: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
english: Mobe namabera, buna Iso oino are namabera.

ekegusii: Aye kabe egetare kiane ki’obotamero ase nkogenda botambe, aye gwanchire gontooria. Naki aye negetare kiane, na egekengero kiane egekong’u.
english: Be my rock of refuge, to which I can always go; give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

ekegusii: “Aye ense, toiroka! Aye orogongo, goka na gochenga, ekiagera Omonene okorire ayare amanene.
english: Be not afraid, O land; be glad and rejoice. Surely the LORD has done great things.

ekegusii: Inwe ching’iti chi’orosana, timoiroka, ekiagera amarisio are ase erooro amerire obonyansi; emete yamire amatunda, emeko na emesabibu yamire okwama kwabo okonene.”
english: Be not afraid, O wild animals, for the open pastures are becoming green. The trees are bearing their fruit; the fig tree and the vine yield their riches.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, tombeera aare, Nyasae one, inchuo bwango onkonye!
english: Be not far from me, O God; come quickly, O my God, to help me.

ekegusii: Be on guard! Be alert! You do not know when that time will come.
english: Rigereria, renda, saba, ekiagera timomanyeti engaki eria indi eranyare koba.

ekegusii: Renda, motenene bokong’u ase okwegena kwaino, mobe abasacha, mobe ne chinguru.
english: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be men of courage; be strong.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, baminto, remereria goika Omonene achiche. Rigereria, omoremi nigo akoganya okwama kw’omogondo okore ne rigori. Igo akoremereria ase ayio, goika anyore embura ye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera.
english: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord's coming. See how the farmer waits for the land to yield its valuable crop and how patient he is for the autumn and spring rains.

ekegusii: Gaki inwe mobe abaikeranu buna Iso oino ore igoro are omoikeranu.”
english: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.

ekegusii: Omonene, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!
english: Be pleased, O LORD, to save me; O LORD, come quickly to help me.

ekegusii: Oche bwebeke ang’e mambia, otiire gocha ase egetunwa gia Sinai, onganye aroro ase egechuria ki’egetunwa.
english: Be ready in the morning, and then come up on Mount Sinai. Present yourself to me there on top of the mountain.

ekegusii: Mobe aberiti na korenda! Naki omosoeri oino Saitani nigo agoetanana na koruma buna endo ekoruma, ekorigia omonto erie.
english: Be self-controlled and alert. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.

ekegusii: Risia riicho ria Nyasae eriabekirwe asemore, tari ase okobetererigwa korende ase ogwancha buna Nyasae anchete, tari ase okonyora kw’oborianania, korende ase omoyo bw’okwerwa.
english: Be shepherds of God's flock that is under your care, serving as overseers-- not because you must, but because you are willing, as God wants you to be; not greedy for money, but eager to serve;

ekegusii: Tegerera okire‐kiri ase obosio bw’Omonene Nyasae! Rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire ang’e; Omonene bwariganirie ekeng’wanso, bwatananire abwo arangeirie ase ekegeni kiaye na abasesenie.
english: Be silent before the Sovereign LORD, for the day of the LORD is near. The LORD has prepared a sacrifice; he has consecrated those he has invited.

ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase egesinka, tegerera mokire‐kiri! Abaonchoreria ba Sidoni, abwo bagotaara ne chimeeri, kare nigo baichorete ase ense yaino.
english: Be silent, you people of the island and you merchants of Sidon, whom the seafarers have enriched.

ekegusii: Obe nobotoereru ase obosio bw’Omonene, omoganye noboremereria. Togechigwa nomonto okogenderera buya ase enchera yaye, omonto oyio okoroberia ogosaria.
english: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for him; do not fret when men succeed in their ways, when they carry out their wicked schemes.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto bonsi, tegerera mokire‐kiri ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera otenenire ngosoka are korwa ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu.
english: Be still before the LORD, all mankind, because he has roused himself from his holy dwelling."

ekegusii: Motenene bokong’u, mobe abaremu, timobaisa kobairoka gose koboboa, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nagende amo nainwe, takobatiga mobugwe, gose takobatuguta.”
english: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the LORD your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you."

ekegusii: Otenene bokong’u obe omoremu! Torwanerere abanto baito na emechie ya Nyasae oito. Tiga Omonene akore ayaroche are amaya.”
english: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The LORD will do what is good in his sight."

ekegusii: Otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu! Torwanere abanto baito na emechie ya Nyasae oito. Na igo Omonene akore ayaroche are amaya.”
english: Be strong and let us fight bravely for our people and the cities of our God. The LORD will do what is good in his sight."

ekegusii: Inwe mwensi aba momosemeretie Omonene, kabe ne chinguru, mobe abaremu!
english: Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the LORD.

ekegusii: Otenene bokong’u rioka, na obe omoremu! Orende na obwate boronge amachiko onsi aya omosomba one Musa agochikerete. Tobaisa koyatiga, na koonchoka gochia aande onsi ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee; erio nario orasesenigwe aande onsi ase ogochia.
english: Be strong and very courageous. Be careful to obey all the law my servant Moses gave you; do not turn from it to the right or to the left, that you may be successful wherever you go.

ekegusii: Chinyasae echio nachio chiagete Abamisiri namaakwa amange aaria ase erooro. Korende inwe Abafilisti, motenene bokong’u buna abasacha, ede timoa abasomba b’Abaibirania baria, buna barabwo barenge abasomba baino. Ee, motenene buna abasacha, morwane!”
english: Be strong, Philistines! Be men, or you will be subject to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Be men, and fight!"

ekegusii: Tenena mokumie, ee, mokumie! Ekore mobe emeuko, mogenderere goukora! Etindie, korende tari ase okonywa edivai; ong’anya, korende tari ase okonywa ekenyugwa kegotindia.
english: Be stunned and amazed, blind yourselves and be sightless; be drunk, but not from wine, stagger, but not from beer.

ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonto omobe goika anyore egesusuro, korende oroiboro rw’abanyene oboronge ndotoorigwe.
english: Be sure of this: The wicked will not go unpunished, but those who are righteous will go free.

ekegusii: Ense yaatananwe ase ogoakerwa obomera. Abanto mbanyore omwando koreng’ana nomobaro bw’amarieta ’ebisaku bie chisokoro chiabo.
english: Be sure that the land is distributed by lot. What each group inherits will be according to the names for its ancestral tribe.

ekegusii: mwerende na mobwate amachiko na emeroberio yonsi echikire, aya nabekire ase amasio aino rituko ria rero.
english: be sure that you obey all the decrees and laws I am setting before you today.

ekegusii: Erio mobeke omoruoti oyo Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabachorere. Mobeke omonto bw’abanto bamino abe omoruoti igoro asemore, korende omonto otari bw’egesaku kiaino timomobeka abe omoruoti oino.
english: be sure to appoint over you the king the LORD your God chooses. He must be from among your own brothers. Do not place a foreigner over you, one who is not a brother Israelite.

ekegusii: Mobe abegenwa ase okobwata amachiko Omonene, Nyasae oino, na oborori bwaye, na emeroberio echikire, eyio abaeire.
english: Be sure to keep the commands of the LORD your God and the stipulations and decrees he has given you.

ekegusii: “Goika morue ensemo ya ikomi ye chindagera chi’emegondo yaino echi chikwama kera omwaka.
english: Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year.

ekegusii: Manya buya chingencho chie ching’ondi ne chimbori chiao, na orende riicho riao buya.
english: Be sure you know the condition of your flocks, give careful attention to your herds;

ekegusii: Korende abe bo, inche timbaraarereti, korende ekiagera inde omong’aini nkabanyora ase obong’ainereria.
english: Be that as it may, I have not been a burden to you. Yet, crafty fellow that I am, I caught you by trickery!

ekegusii: Ase ayio, rigereria mono buna mogotaara, tari buna abanto batari nobong’aini, korende buna abare nobong’aini.
english: Be very careful, then, how you live-- not as unwise but as wise,

ekegusii: Aye omwana one, kobua ase aya onsi, igwera ogokurerwa oko. Okorika ebitabu ebinge tikori nomoerio; ogosoma okonge nigo gokorosia omobere.
english: Be warned, my son, of anything in addition to them. Of making many books there is no end, and much study wearies the body.

ekegusii: Mogenderere ase obong’aini ase amasio ’abanto abare isiko, na renda engaki yaino.
english: Be wise in the way you act toward outsiders; make the most of every opportunity.

ekegusii: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart; then I can answer anyone who treats me with contempt.
english: Omwana one, kabe nobong’aini na ogokie enkoro yane, erio nario ndanyore ring’ana nkoiraneria omonto ogonchaya.

ekegusii: Na bara okoremereria kw’Omonene oito ng’a nogotooreka. Naboigo noyominto omwanchwa, Paulo, abarikerete koreng’ana nobong’aini aetwe.
english: Bear in mind that our Lord's patience means salvation, just as our dear brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom that God gave him.

ekegusii: Inyora ng’a inche Omonene nabaeire Esabato. Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo nkobaa endagera y’amatuko abere. Ase ayio, ase rituko eri ria gatano na kabere mobeere kera omonto aase aye, onde tabaisa korua inka.”
english: Bear in mind that the LORD has given you the Sabbath; that is why on the sixth day he gives you bread for two days. Everyone is to stay where he is on the seventh day; no one is to go out."

ekegusii: Bogorerania inwe ase inwe, na onye omonto ore ne ring’ana igoro ase omonto onde, mwaberane: buna Omonene abaaberete inwe, nainwe mwaberane bo.
english: Bear with each other and forgive whatever grievances you may have against one another. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

ekegusii: Bear with me while I speak, and after I have spoken, mock on.
english: Remereria, erinde nkwane; na ngokoora gokwana, mogenderere gonchecheria.

ekegusii: Bono aye bogoria obosooku bwao bw’ogochaywa, ekiagera kwagerire basubati bamino banyorire obotamero. Ebibe biao bi’okogechia biabeire ebinge kobua ebiabo; bono barabwo nigo bakororekana ng’a nabanyaboronge bare gokobua. Ase ayio, kabe nobosooku bw’ogochaywa, ekiagera kwagerire basubati bamino barorekanire bare abanyaboronge.
english: Bear your disgrace, for you have furnished some justification for your sisters. Because your sins were more vile than theirs, they appear more righteous than you. So then, be ashamed and bear your disgrace, for you have made your sisters appear righteous.

ekegusii: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vines
english: Moake‐ake ebikuba biaino, ekiagera emegondo yaino emiya, na emesabibu yaino ekwama mono, yasarigwe,

ekegusii: Tura amakombe aino abe emioro, na emeyio yaino chinkuro ebe amatimo! Tiga oyore omworo atebe, “Nainche nigo inde etuoni.”
english: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weakling say, 'I am strong!'

ekegusii: ekiagera omosani one ochire asende korwa orogendo, na inche tindi na gento nkomoa;
english: because a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I have nothing to set before him.'

ekegusii: naki naigoreirwe egesieri ekegare kerarente okwama, korende abange mbareo bakong’amereria.
english: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, and there are many who oppose me.

ekegusii: Naki okoriera kw’omwando nigo kogoikeranigwa ekero ki’amakweri, ekiagera onye oria oyoriete ore moyo, rirorio tikori na nguru.
english: because a will is in force only when somebody has died; it never takes effect while the one who made it is living.

ekegusii: ekiagera Ibrahimu naigwerete amang’ana aane, akabwata aya nachigete, na amachiko aane, na aya narigete, amo nogotebereria kwane.”
english: because Abraham obeyed me and kept my requirements, my commands, my decrees and my laws."

ekegusii: Naki ere oyokure osiboirwe korwa ase ebibe.
english: because anyone who has died has been freed from sin.

ekegusii: Ere oyogokorera Kristo ase amang’ana aya onsi nigo akogwenera Nyasae, naende nigo agwancherwa na mwanyabanto.
english: because anyone who serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by men.

ekegusii: Naki ase okoruegwa okomo obaikeranirie ase amatuko onsi abwo bachenirwe.
english: because by one sacrifice he has made perfect forever those who are being made holy.

ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae akonyete Abalawi baria babogoretie Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, bakarua ebing’wanso bie chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere.
english: Because God had helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, seven bulls and seven rams were sacrificed.
