ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero Nyasae arigetie koborokia mono kegima abaraire omwando oria abarierete eira buna atanyare koonchora ayaroberetie, akabeka emuma gati.
english: Because God wanted to make the unchanging nature of his purpose very clear to the heirs of what was promised, he confirmed it with an oath.

ekegusii: ekiagera ase engencho y’emeremo ya Kristo akaba ang’e ase ogokwa, tarendete obogima bwaye ase ogoisanera ayaremete ase ogokora kwaino asende.
english: because he almost died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for the help you could not give me.

ekegusii: Ekiagera arengereirie aya akorete na aonchokire korwa ase ogosaria kwaye gwonsi akorete, ekeene, nabe moyo, tagokwa.
english: Because he considers all the offenses he has committed and turns away from them, he will surely live; he will not die.

ekegusii: Yabini nigo abwate chigari chi’ebioma amagana kianda. Ere agachanda Abaisraeli mono ase obotindi obonene ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, na Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene abakonye.
english: Because he had nine hundred iron chariots and had cruelly oppressed the Israelites for twenty years, they cried to the LORD for help.

ekegusii: Oyio ochayire ring’ana ri’Omonene, naende osaririe ogochika kwaye, takororerwa amabera. Goika aatananwe kegima, nere abarerwe ebibe biaye.”
english: Because he has despised the LORD's word and broken his commands, that person must surely be cut off; his guilt remains on him.'"

ekegusii: Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.
english: Ekiagera ere omonyene achandetwe na goteemwa, nanyare gokonya abwo bagoteemwa.

ekegusii: Agancha chisokoro chiaino, na ase engencho eyio akabachora inwe, ororeria rwabo, mobe ribaga riabo, na ere omonyene akabang’anyia korwa Misiri ase okobua kwaye okonene.
english: Because he loved your forefathers and chose their descendants after them, he brought you out of Egypt by his Presence and his great strength,

ekegusii: ekiagera nanchete egesaku giaito, naende natoagacherete esinagogi yaito.”
english: because he loves our nation and has built our synagogue."

ekegusii: “Ere oramboire okoboko kwaye mamincha ya Nyasae, naende oba nomokia gokora ay’oboenenu ase obosio bw’Omonguru.
english: because he shakes his fist at God and vaunts himself against the Almighty,

ekegusii: Ekiagera ere namanyete emeremo yabo, nigo akobaonchorana botuko baitwa kegima.
english: Because he takes note of their deeds, he overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo arenge koborokereria buna oyore nokobua, na tari buna aborokia babo b’amariko.
english: because he taught as one who had authority, and not as their teachers of the law.

ekegusii: Ere ontegereire onyigure, ase ayio, ekero inde moyo nimbe nkona‐komorangeria ng’a ankonye.
english: Because he turned his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.

ekegusii: ekiagera arenge kworokereria aborokigwa baye, akabatebia ng’a, “Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nkogenda are kobekwa ase amaboko ’abanto, na barabwo nabamoite, na ekero aitirwe naboke nyuma y’amatuko atato.”
english: because he was teaching his disciples. He said to them, "The Son of Man is going to be betrayed into the hands of men. They will kill him, and after three days he will rise."

ekegusii: Samison akaba nerang’o y’amache enene mono, erio akarangeria Omonene, agateba, “Aye omonyene kwarua obobui goetera asende inche omosomba oo, na bono nigo ndakwe inde nerang’o, naende ngwe ase amaboko ’abanto batarogeti.”
english: Because he was very thirsty, he cried out to the LORD, "You have given your servant this great victory. Must I now die of thirst and fall into the hands of the uncircumcised?"

ekegusii: ekiagera Herode nairogete Yohana, konya omanyire ng’a nomonto omoronge, omochenu, akamorenda. Gachia komoigwa, agaichana mono; nonya nabo nigo arenge komoigwa nomogoko.
english: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing him to be a righteous and holy man. When Herod heard John, he was greatly puzzled; yet he liked to listen to him.

ekegusii: ekiagera nakio gioka abwate akwebisia. Eke nakio abwate gekomobekera riberera ase omobere oye. Inee! Otakemoeti, inki rende araraarere? Ere kararere asende, ekeene, nimoigwe, ekiagera inche nomonyamabera.
english: because his cloak is the only covering he has for his body. What else will he sleep in? When he cries out to me, I will hear, for I am compassionate.

ekegusii: ekiagera narenge nomoiseke, omwana omomoima, konya okoorire emiaka ikomi na ebere, na ere nigo arenge ang’e nogokwa. Ekero Yeso arenge kogenda abanto bakaba bakomomiga‐miga.
english: because his only daughter, a girl of about twelve, was dying. As Jesus was on his way, the crowds almost crushed him.

ekegusii: Ekiagera ninsirie korwa asore abanyaboronge amo nabakori amabe, omoyio one nosomorwe korwa ase ekeraaro kiaye, oite abanto bonsi korwa irianyi goika sugusu.
english: Because I am going to cut off the righteous and the wicked, my sword will be unsheathed against everyone from south to north.

ekegusii: Korende ekiagera nabatebirie aya, omoichano oichoire chinkoro chiaino.
english: Because I have said these things, you are filled with grief.

ekegusii: Ekiagera nakorire ebibe ase Omonene, nindemererie endamwamu yaye, goika ere agambe amang’ana aane na ang’e oboronge bwane. Ere nandete ase omobaso, na inche ningokere oboronge bwaye.
english: Because I have sinned against him, I will bear the LORD's wrath, until he pleads my case and establishes my right. He will bring me out into the light; I will see his righteousness.

ekegusii: ekiagera nkoigwa nde amang’ana igoro y’obwanchani bwao, na okwegena kwao obwate ase Omonene Yeso, na buna okobiorokia ase abachenu bonsi.
english: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.

ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a amatuko ng’ang’e are ndarue ase obomenyo obo. Aya naro Omonene oito Yeso Kristo anyorogetie.
english: because I know that I will soon put it aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.

ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nigo nyanchete amachiko ao kobua etahabu, ee, kobua etahabu echenire.
english: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabete ngotooria abataka abwo barenge korera, ne chintakana chitabwate onde ogochikonya.
english: because I rescued the poor who cried for help, and the fatherless who had none to assist him.

ekegusii: Tinairogete omoganda omonene bw’abanto, gose kwoboa abaamate abwo barenge gonchaya, erinde imbe nkirete na kobeera nyomba ime.”
english: because I so feared the crowd and so dreaded the contempt of the clans that I kept silent and would not go outside

ekegusii: Ekiagera narenge nobomaene obo nkarigia gocha asemore agwo ritang’ani, erinde monyore ogosesenigwa ara kabere.
english: Because I was confident of this, I planned to visit you first so that you might benefit twice.

ekegusii: Ekeene, inche nigo ngochia kogokorera aya arakorentere amasikani amanene, naende kende gionsi oramborie, ekio ningokorere; aye inchuo ondagererie abanto aba.”
english: because I will reward you handsomely and do whatever you say. Come and put a curse on these people for me."

ekegusii: Tibabarete obonyaka gose ngento; ase ayio bagakora ense eye ekaba entwambu ase ogotaba abegenwa asende, bakaba bagosasima amagena na emete.
english: Because Israel's immorality mattered so little to her, she defiled the land and committed adultery with stone and wood.

ekegusii: because it is consecrated by the word of God and prayer.
english: ekiagera giachenirwe ne ring’ana ria Nyasae na ogosaba.

ekegusii: because it is impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
english: Naki amanyinga e chieeri na aye chimbori takonyara korusia ebibe.

ekegusii: Na ase engencho y’Okwearigania kw’Abayahudi bakabeka Yeso aroro, ekiagera oboina boria bwarenge ang’e.
english: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.

ekegusii: Na omosacha oye Yusufu nigo arenge omonto omoronge, tarigetie komoa obosooku, akarengereria komotiga bobisi.
english: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and did not want to expose her to public disgrace, he had in mind to divorce her quietly.

ekegusii: Naki ekina tikeri namabera asere oyotari namabera. Amabera nigo agochenga igoro y’ekina.
english: because judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful. Mercy triumphs over judgment!

ekegusii: Ekiagera ogochika nakwo gokorenta endamwamu; na aase ogochika gotari, komocha tikoiyo.
english: because law brings wrath. And where there is no law there is no transgression.

ekegusii: Ababisa baane bonsi nigo bagonchecheria, na abasani baane boigo. Abanto baamanyete banyoboire; bonsi abakondora ase enchera nigo bagontama.
english: Because of all my enemies, I am the utter contempt of my neighbors; I am a dread to my friends-- those who see me on the street flee from me.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe bionsi bia Baasa, na ebia Ela, omwana oye. Barabwo bakagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe bikagechia Omonene bw’Abaisraeli, erinde akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’emegwekano yabo bagosasima.
english: because of all the sins Baasha and his son Elah had committed and had caused Israel to commit, so that they provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger by their worthless idols.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ogosaria kwaino gwonsi gw’okogechia nimbae egesusuro ntana korua kero kende gionsi, gose tinkonyara gokerua nonya ng’ake naende.
english: Because of all your detestable idols, I will do to you what I have never done before and will never do again.

ekegusii: Na abange ase abaminto abare ase Omonene babeire nokoremigwa ase engencho y’ogosibwa kwane, bamentekanire noboremu gokwana ring’ana ria Nyasae batari nobwoba.
english: Because of my chains, most of the brothers in the Lord have been encouraged to speak the word of God more courageously and fearlessly.

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo ngendererete korera na kweumia, amauga ’omobere one abwatanire ne chinyama chi’omobere one.
english: Because of my loud groaning I am reduced to skin and bones.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ebibe biaito obotenenku bw’ense eye bwairirwe nabaruoti abwo babekirwe gotogambera. Abwo mbabwate okobua igoro ase emebere yaito, na ase chitugo chiaito, batokorere buna banchete, na intwe nigo tore nemechando emenene.”
english: Because of our sins, its abundant harvest goes to the kings you have placed over us. They rule over our bodies and our cattle as they please. We are in great distress.

ekegusii: Omoganda oria amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko bikaruegwa na kobekwa ase okobua kw’orogunchara roria ase engencho y’ogosaria. Ekeene kegatugutwa inse, na orogunchara roria rokagenderera koba nokobua.
english: Because of rebellion, the host [of the saints] and the daily sacrifice were given over to it. It prospered in everything it did, and truth was thrown to the ground.

ekegusii: Agatebia aborokigwa baye bamobekere obwato ang’e ase engencho y’abanto; erio omoganda tomomiga.
english: Because of the crowd he told his disciples to have a small boat ready for him, to keep the people from crowding him.

ekegusii: ekiagera abanto nigo bakorete ebibe, bakangechia, na inche nkaba nendamwamu asebare, Barabwo nigo basambete ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao, naende bagachikorera. Chinyasae echio batamanyete, gose inwe timochimanyeti, nonya nechisokoro chiaino tichiachimanyete.
english: because of the evil they have done. They provoked me to anger by burning incense and by worshiping other gods that neither they nor you nor your fathers ever knew.

ekegusii: na ase engencho y’obonene obwo amoete, abanto bonsi, na ebisaku, na abanto b’emenwa ao ao, bakaba bagotengechigwa na koiroka ase obosio bwaye. Omonto onde bwensi ere aganetie goita, nigo arenge komoita, na oyo aganetie gotiga abe moyo, nigo arenge komotiga oba moyo; na oyo aganetie gokinia abe omonene, nigo arenge komokinia, na oyo aganetie gokeyia, nigo arenge komokeyia.
english: Because of the high position he gave him, all the peoples and nations and men of every language dreaded and feared him. Those the king wanted to put to death, he put to death; those he wanted to spare, he spared; those he wanted to promote, he promoted; and those he wanted to humble, he humbled.

ekegusii: Nase engencho y’okomenteka kw’ebibe, obwanchani bw’abange nabokende.
english: Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’endamwamu y’Omonene Babeli nosirigwe kegima, gose tokomenywa rinde. Kera omonto orabe ogoeta Babeli nakumie na goichana mono ase engencho y’amaakwa aye.
english: Because of the LORD's anger she will not be inhabited but will be completely desolate. All who pass Babylon will be horrified and scoff because of all her wounds.

ekegusii: Nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera ng’a titosiriri, ekiagera amabera aye tari koera;
english: Because of the LORD's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail.

ekegusii: Narorire ng’a ring’ana eri nerigiya ase engencho y’emechando eye tore nero, ng’a mbuya omonto abe buna are.
english: Because of the present crisis, I think that it is good for you to remain as you are.

ekegusii: Ekiagera mwaorokirie ng’a namotenene ase okorua okwo, nabamotogie Nyasae ase okoigwera kwaino ase ogwatora enchili ya Kristo, na ase okorua kwaino mwakoreire barabwo na abanto bonsi.
english: Because of the service by which you have proved yourselves, men will praise God for the obedience that accompanies your confession of the gospel of Christ, and for your generosity in sharing with them and with everyone else.

ekegusii: Na ase ebikone biria yaetwe ribaga kobikora ase obosio bw’eng’iti eria ye ritang’ani ekong’aina abwo bamenyete ase ense, egotebia abamenyete ase ense bakore omogwekano bw’eng’iti eria yaagetwe orogoma nomoyio o birende, nero ekaba moyo.
english: Because of the signs he was given power to do on behalf of the first beast, he deceived the inhabitants of the earth. He ordered them to set up an image in honor of the beast who was wounded by the sword and yet lived.

ekegusii: Ayio igo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe akorete ase obosio bw’Omonene, ase okobwatia chinchera chia Yeroboamu, na ase ebibe akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: because of the sins he had committed, doing evil in the eyes of the LORD and walking in the ways of Jeroboam and in the sin he had committed and had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Aya nigo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe bia Yeroboamu biria akorete, naende akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe, na ase engencho y’ayio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akaba nendamwamu.
english: because of the sins Jeroboam had committed and had caused Israel to commit, and because he provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger.

ekegusii: “Ekero ababisa baino barabamige na kobasiongorokana, nigo morabe nemechando emenene, goika morie emebere y’abana baino, baria Omonene, Nyasae oino, abaeire.
english: Because of the suffering that your enemy will inflict on you during the siege, you will eat the fruit of the womb, the flesh of the sons and daughters the LORD your God has given you.

ekegusii: Ase amabera aye Nyasae oito, ekero amasase a igoro aratochere,
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the rising sun will come to us from heaven

ekegusii: Twabanchire ase engencho y’ekeene eke geikaransete ime yaito, kerokio inakebe amo naintwe goika kare na kare.
english: because of the truth, which lives in us and will be with us forever:

ekegusii: “Ekiagera mwaureretie na goita abanto bamino b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, namosookigwe na gosirigwa goika kare na kare.
english: Because of the violence against your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame; you will be destroyed forever.

ekegusii: Ase engencho yabo abanto barusetigwe ase ense y’Abayuda, bakairwa Babeli ase obosomba, ekero barabe bakoragereria na gokwana amang’ana ’okoragererigwa okwo: Tiga Omonene agokore obe buna Zedekia na Ahabu, abwo omoruoti o Babeli agekerete ase omorero.
english: Because of them, all the exiles from Judah who are in Babylon will use this curse: 'The LORD treat you like Zedekiah and Ahab, whom the king of Babylon burned in the fire.'

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio endamwamu ya Nyasae nebachere abanto b’ogotaigwera.
english: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming.

ekegusii: Chimeme chi’abana bakogonka chiabwatanire namang’ang’ura ase engencho y’erang’o; abana abake nigo bagosaba endagera, korende monto onde tari okobaa.
english: Because of thirst the infant's tongue sticks to the roof of its mouth; the children beg for bread, but no one gives it to them.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nimbokie amagombo na korera. Ninyechabore chianga imbe getirianda, nyeumie buna ekebwe, na korera buna esagero,
english: Because of this I will weep and wail; I will go about barefoot and naked. I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.

ekegusii: Gaki, ase ekerengo eke Yeso obeire oyo bw’obomaene bw’okobwatana kore okuya kobua.
english: Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio chinkoro chiaito chiarwarire, na ase engencho y’ayio amaiso aito abeire orotutu.
english: Because of this our hearts are faint, because of these things our eyes grow dim

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ense nigo ekorera ase okweumia, na kera omonto omenyeteo nigo achandegete na kogoya; boigo ching’iti chi’orosana, ne chinyoni, ne chinswe ngokwa chire.
english: Because of this the land mourns, and all who live in it waste away; the beasts of the field and the birds of the air and the fish of the sea are dying.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, amaboko ’abanto bonsi nigo araborwe chinguru, ne chinkoro chiabo chirianyeke ase obwoba.
english: Because of this, all hands will go limp, every man's heart will melt.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio Nyasae akabatiga batunyane okogania kwabo kw’obosooku, goika abakungu babo bakaonchoreria okomenyana kw’omobere kwa boronge ase oko gotari kwa boronge.
english: Because of this, God gave them over to shameful lusts. Even their women exchanged natural relations for unnatural ones.

ekegusii: Nase ayio Obong’aini bwa Nyasae nigo bwatebete: Nintome asebare ababani na abatomwa; baite abande babo na kobachanda,
english: Because of this, God in his wisdom said, 'I will send them prophets and apostles, some of whom they will kill and others they will persecute.'

ekegusii: Erio ring’ana eri rigasarera ase abamwabo ng’a omworokigwa oria tagokwa, korende Yeso tamotebetie ng’a tagokwa, otatiga, “Kondarigie abeo goika inchiche, inki ogwechandera ayio?”
english: Because of this, the rumor spread among the brothers that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say that he would not die; he only said, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?"

ekegusii: Omonene nigo abete nendamwamu asende ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino, agateba: Nonya naye tokonyara gosoa ase ense eria.
english: Because of you the LORD became angry with me also and said, "You shall not enter it, either.

ekegusii: Nyasae o iso, nere oragokonye, Nyasae Omonguru, nere oragosesenie nogosesenigwa gokorwa igoro, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa chindiba inse, na ogosesenigwa gokorwa inda na ase chimbeere.
english: because of your father's God, who helps you, because of the Almighty, who blesses you with blessings of the heavens above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breast and womb.

ekegusii: ekiagera kwabeire nekeririanda na endamwamu asende. Aye kwambwatire na gwantugutire gochia aare.
english: because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.

ekegusii: ase engencho y’okobwaterana kwaino ase enchili korwa rituko rie ritang’ani goika rero iga.
english: because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,

ekegusii: Abaruoti nigo bagokorentera ebiegwa ime ase Hekalu yao ere agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring you gifts.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ekeririanda kiao omobere one bwensi orwarire, nase engencho y’ebibe biane amauga aane nigo akonyatia.
english: Because of your wrath there is no health in my body; my bones have no soundness because of my sin.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio okobwatanigwa ngokorwe asemore ase okobasibia korwa ase ebibe biaino bionsi, nainwe namocheneke ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
english: because on this day atonement will be made for you, to cleanse you. Then, before the LORD, you will be clean from all your sins.

ekegusii: Naki intwe titwabarenterete enchili yaito ase amang’ana oka, korende boigo nase chinguru, na ase Omoika Omochenu, na ase okobaraa gochia ase obomaene oboikeranu. Na inwe momanyete chingencho chiaito buna twarenge ase egati yaino ase engencho yaino.
english: because our gospel came to you not simply with words, but also with power, with the Holy Spirit and with deep conviction. You know how we lived among you for your sake.

ekegusii: buna oborori bwa Kristo bwabekirwe chinguru ase egati yaino.
english: because our testimony about Christ was confirmed in you.

ekegusii: Ekiagera omoruoti ekeetie na akaba omoitongo, endamwamu y’Omonene ekamotiga, erinde tebaisa komosiria kegima; ase igo amang’ana akaba amaya ase Abayuda.
english: Because Rehoboam humbled himself, the LORD's anger turned from him, and he was not totally destroyed. Indeed, there was some good in Judah.

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo atebete, “Kondakune chianga chiaye chioka, ningwene.”
english: because she thought, "If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed."

ekegusii: ekiagera abaiseke abwo b’ororeria rwa Manase nigo baetwe omwando ase egati y’abamura b’orororeria rwaye. Abana bande b’ororeria rwa Manase konya baeirwe ense ya Gileadi.
english: because the daughters of the tribe of Manasseh received an inheritance among the sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the descendants of Manasseh.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben na ab’egesaku kia Gadi amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, barabwo konya banyorire omwando obo.
english: because the families of the tribe of Reuben, the tribe of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

ekegusii: Nyasae oito nigo atokonyete nokoboko kwaye okuya, bagatotomera Serebia orenge omonto omong’aini bw’ororeria rwa Mali, mosinto o Lawi o Israeli, amo nabamura baye na abamwabo, bonsi abanto ikomi na batano na batato.
english: Because the gracious hand of our God was on us, they brought us Sherebiah, a capable man, from the descendants of Mahli son of Levi, the son of Israel, and Sherebiah's sons and brothers, 18 men;

ekegusii: ekiagera konya torabaikera nonya noyomo obo. Barabwo nigo babatisetwe rioka ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.
english: because the Holy Spirit had not yet come upon any of them; they had simply been baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.

ekegusii: Abwo nabanto bagonkorera, ninche nabarusetie ase ense ya Misiri. Abwo tibakoonigwa buna abasomba.
english: Because the Israelites are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt, they must not be sold as slaves.

ekegusii: Obomoyo bwa kera omobere nigo bore ase amanyinga. Ase engencho eyio natebirie Abaisraeli ng’a tibaria amanyinga ’eng’iti ende yonsi, ekiagera obomoyo bwa kera omobere nigo bore ase amanyinga aye. Omonto onde bwensi orarie amanyinga nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
english: because the life of every creature is its blood. That is why I have said to the Israelites, "You must not eat the blood of any creature, because the life of every creature is its blood; anyone who eats it must be cut off."

ekegusii: Naki ere oyo Omonene anchete nigo akomorongeyia, na kong’wania bororo omwana oyo obeire oyoye.”
english: because the Lord disciplines those he loves, and he punishes everyone he accepts as a son."

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi Omonene anchete nigo akomorongeyia, buna ise omwana akorongeyia omwana oria agokirie nere.
english: because the LORD disciplines those he loves, as a father the son he delights in.

ekegusii: Obotuko obwo nigo bwarenge obotuko bw’okorenda, ekero Omonene abeire ang’e ase okong’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Obwo nobotuko bw’Omonene, bogwenerete korendwa n’Abaisraeli ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: Because the LORD kept vigil that night to bring them out of Egypt, on this night all the Israelites are to keep vigil to honor the LORD for the generations to come.

ekegusii: Omonene akamanyia igoro y’ebibe ebio, nainche nkabimanya; nere akanyorokia aya barenge gokora.
english: Because the LORD revealed their plot to me, I knew it, for at that time he showed me what they were doing.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Beeroti konya batamire gochia Gitaimu, agwo nao bamenyete goika rero iga.
english: because the people of Beeroth fled to Gittaim and have lived there as aliens to this day.

ekegusii: Abamidiani nigo baengerete Abaisraeli, na ase engencho y’Abamidiani Abaisraeli bakabetererigwa korigia obotamero ase amakuruma na emetaro, na ase chingoro chiakunyire ase ebitunwa.
english: Because the power of Midian was so oppressive, the Israelites prepared shelters for themselves in mountain clefts, caves and strongholds.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nankonye; ase ayio tinkobugwa nogochaywa; na ase ayio nakorire obosio bwane bwabeire obokong’u buna rigena, nimanyete ng’a tingosookigwa.
english: Because the Sovereign LORD helps me, I will not be disgraced. Therefore have I set my face like flint, and I know I will not be put to shame.

ekegusii: Erio abamura ba Yakobo bakairaneria Sekemu na Hamori ise ase okong’ainereria, ekiagera konya osaririe Dina, omoiseke omwabo.
english: Because their sister Dinah had been defiled, Jacob's sons replied deceitfully as they spoke to Shechem and his father Hamor.

ekegusii: Ekiagera omogati noyomo, intwe abatore abange nigo tore omobere oyomo; naki intwe twensi nigo tokonyora ensemo yaito y’omogati oria oyomo.
english: Because there is one loaf, we, who are many, are one body, for we all partake of the one loaf.

ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi abamoroche mbaondogete. Bwango agakwana nabarabwo, akabatebia, “Remia chinkoro! Ninche. Timoiroka!”
english: because they all saw him and were terrified. Immediately he spoke to them and said, "Take courage! It is I. Don't be afraid."

ekegusii: because they could not bear what was commanded: "If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned."
english: Naki tibanyarete koremereria ring’ana riria riachigetwe, “Nonya neng’iti eise gokuna egetunwa nabo eraakwe amagena.”

ekegusii: Bagatiga Omonene na bagachaka gokorera chinyasae chiria chiare korokwa Baali, na echinde chiare korokwa Asitaroti.
english: because they forsook him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.

ekegusii: Ekiagera batabete abegenwa ase Omonene, Sisaki, omoruoti o Misiri, agacha akarwania Yerusalemu ase omwaka o gatano bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Rehoboamu.
english: Because they had been unfaithful to the LORD, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam.

ekegusii: ekiagera tibachiete korotota Abaisraeli na kobaa endagera na amache. Barabwo bakaa Baalamu eng’eria ng’a aragererie Abaisraeli, korende Nyasae akaonchora okoragereria koria gokaba ogosesenigwa.
english: because they had not met the Israelites with food and water but had hired Balaam to call a curse down on them. (Our God, however, turned the curse into a blessing.)

ekegusii: Nigo nakorete bo, ekiagera tibabwatete amachiko aane na tibayakorete, korende nigo baangete koigwera emeroberio yane echikire, na bagakora Chisabato chiane chikaba echitachenegeti, na amaiso abo nigo arigereretie emegwekano eyio chisokoro chiabo chiarenge gosasima.
english: because they had not obeyed my laws but had rejected my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths, and their eyes [lusted] after their fathers' idols.

ekegusii: ekiagera bakorire ayare amabe ase obosio bwane, na botambe nigo kongechia nabeire nendamwamu, korwa ase amatuko aria chisokoro chiabo chiarwete Misiri goika rero iga.”
english: because they have done evil in my eyes and have provoked me to anger from the day their forefathers came out of Egypt until this day."

ekegusii: Barabwo bantigire inche, na basambire ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao, na bangechirie nabeire nendamwamu ase engencho y’emeremo yonsi bakorire namaboko abo. Ase ayio endamwamu yane neiterwe igoro y’aase aiga, tegokendigwa.
english: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and provoked me to anger by all that their hands have made, my anger will be poured out on this place and will not be quenched.'

ekegusii: Barabwo bantigire inche na basambire ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao, na bangechirie goika nabeire nendamwamu ase engencho y’emeremo yonsi bakorire namaboko abo. Ase ayio, endamwamu yane neyoke igoro y’aase aiga, tegokendigwa.
english: Because they have forsaken me and burned incense to other gods and provoked me to anger by all the idols their hands have made, my anger will burn against this place and will not be quenched.'

ekegusii: Ekeene ase abanto bonsi baruete Misiri, aba bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, onde tari, nonya noyomo oranyare korora ense eria narierete Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a nimbae, ekiagera abanto aba bangire koba abegenwa asende.
english: 'Because they have not followed me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years old or more who came up out of Egypt will see the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob--

ekegusii: Aya nigo nayakorete, ekiagera baangete amachiko aane, bakaanga kobwatia emeroberio yane echikire; bagakora Chisabato chiane chikaba echitachenegeti. Chinkoro chiabo nigo chianchete emegwekano yabo barenge gosasima.
english: because they rejected my laws and did not follow my decrees and desecrated my Sabbaths. For their hearts were devoted to their idols.

ekegusii: ekiagera barabwo babachandire ase okobaebereria gosasima Peori, na ase amang’ana a Kosibi, omosubati oria bw’omonene bw’Abamidiani. Omosubati oria obo oitetwe ase rituko riria amaakwa achete ase engencho ya Peori.”
english: because they treated you as enemies when they deceived you in the affair of Peor and their sister Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite leader, the woman who was killed when the plague came as a result of Peor."

ekegusii: na ekiagera baonchokire na gotiga komobwatia, gose tibari korengereria igoro ye chinchera chiaye nonya ng’ake.
english: because they turned from following him and had no regard for any of his ways.

ekegusii: Naki bonsi abakoraagwa n’Omoika o Nyasae, abwo nabwo abana ba Nyasae.
english: because those who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

ekegusii: ekiagera amatuko aria nebe emechando, buna etana koba korwa omochakano bw’ogotonga oko Nyasae atongete, goika bono, gose tekoba bo naende nonya ng’ake.
english: because those will be days of distress unequaled from the beginning, when God created the world, until now-- and never to be equaled again.

ekegusii: Naki ogochika kw’Omoika bw’obogima boria bore ime ase Kristo Yeso gwansiboire korwa ase ogochika kw’ebibe na amakweri.
english: because through Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit of life set me free from the law of sin and death.

ekegusii: Naki intwe nigo twachire gosaria aase aa, ekiagera ekerero kiaye kiamentekire ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio Omonene ototomire tosarie aase aa.”
english: because we are going to destroy this place. The outcry to the LORD against its people is so great that he has sent us to destroy it."

ekegusii: ekiagera twaigure buna momwegenete Kristo Yeso, naende buna mwanchete abachenu bonsi,
english: because we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love you have for all the saints--

ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a ere oyobogetie Omonene Yeso natobokie naintwe amo na Yeso, na atorente amo nainwe ase obosio bwaye.
english: because we know that the one who raised the Lord Jesus from the dead will also raise us with Jesus and present us with you in his presence.

ekegusii: Ebi konya barentire nigo biabete ebinge, bigaetania ebiaganeirie ase emeremo eria yare gocha gokorwa.
english: because what they already had was more than enough to do all the work.

ekegusii: ekiagera arenge ase ekebono gia sokororia yaye, ekero Melkizedeki aumeranete na Ibrahimu.
english: because when Melchizedek met Abraham, Levi was still in the body of his ancestor.

ekegusii: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
english: Ekero twaboyigwe titokororekana tore getirianda.

ekegusii: Because you are my help, I sing in the shadow of your wings.
english: Aye kwabeire ogokonyeka kwane, na inse y’ekiriri gie chimbaba chiao nintere nomogoko.

ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe more abana baye, Nyasae agatoma Omoika bw’Omwana oye ase chinkoro chiaito, okorera, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata!”
english: Because you are sons, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, the Spirit who calls out, "Abba, Father."

ekegusii: nainwe komorarende na kobwata amachiko aya nabaeire ase rituko ria rero na komwancha Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase okobwatia chinchera chiaye botambe, erio nario moranyare komenta emechie ende etato.
english: because you carefully follow all these laws I command you today-- to love the LORD your God and to walk always in his ways-- then you are to set aside three more cities.

ekegusii: Tikwaigwerete eriogi ri’Omonene, gose goikerania egesusuro ki’endamwamu yaye entindi igoro y’Abaameleki. Ekio nakio kiagera Omonene akorire amang’ana ayio asore rero iga.
english: Because you did not obey the LORD or carry out his fierce wrath against the Amalekites, the LORD has done this to you today.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo abasesenetie, akabaa ebinto ebinge, na ebinto ebio bikagera timwamokorera nomogoko bwe chinkoro chiaino.
english: Because you did not serve the LORD your God joyfully and gladly in the time of prosperity,

ekegusii: “Ase engencho y’oborimo bwaino mwagerire abanyene oboronge baichanire ase chinkoro chiabo, abwo inche ntaichanetie. Nigo mwagerire abakori amabe koba noboremu, erinde tibaonchoka batige chinchera chiabo chi’obobe, erinde batoorie obogima bwabo.
english: Because you disheartened the righteous with your lies, when I had brought them no grief, and because you encouraged the wicked not to turn from their evil ways and so save their lives,

ekegusii: Amabe aya nigo abanyorire goika rituko eri ria rero, ekiagera inwe mwasambete ubani, naende mogakora ebibe ase Omonene, gose timwamoigwerete gose kobwatia amachiko aye, na emeroberio yaye echikire, na oborori bwaye.”
english: Because you have burned incense and have sinned against the LORD and have not obeyed him or followed his law or his decrees or his stipulations, this disaster has come upon you, as you now see."

ekegusii: Ekiagera aye gwasakoire ebisaku ebinge, abanto b’ebisaku ebitigari mbagosakore aye; gwaiteire amanyinga ’abanto abange, na ogakora ayare amabe ase ense na ase emechie, na ase bonsi abamenyeteo.
english: Because you have plundered many nations, the peoples who are left will plunder you. For you have shed man's blood; you have destroyed lands and cities and everyone in them.

ekegusii: Naende momanye ng’a ring’ana rigiya omonto agokora, naegwe erio erio n’Omonene, karabe omosomba, gose omosibore.
english: because you know that the Lord will reward everyone for whatever good he does, whether he is slave or free.

ekegusii: ekiagera momanyete ng’a ekero okwegena kwaino kogoteemwa nigo mokweorokereria oboremereria.
english: because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo arakoreke onye mokoigwera Omonene, Nyasae oino, na kobwata amachiko aye onsi, aya inche nabaeire ase rituko ria rero, na komorakore ayare amaronge ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: because you obey the LORD your God, keeping all his commands that I am giving you today and doing what is right in his eyes.

ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabeire na kerokio asende, na oboenenu bwao bwaikire ase amato aane, nimbeke ekegobanio ase chimioro chiao ime, na egento kiane ki’ogokoraa ase omonwa oo, ninkoiranie ogendere enchera eria gwacherete.
english: Because you rage against me and because your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.

ekegusii: Ekiagera kwabeire na kerokio asende, na oboenenu bwao bwaikire ase amato aane, nimbeke ekegobanio ase chimioro chiao ime na ekeokio kiane ki’ogokoraa ase omonwa oo; ninkoiranie ogende ase enchera eria gwacherete.
english: Because you rage against me and your insolence has reached my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, and I will make you return by the way you came.'

ekegusii: Ekiagera kwagokerete ogosarigwa kw’omwando bw’Abaisraeli, ningosarie aye obe bosa. Ee, ningosarie aye egetunwa gia Seiri obe bosa, aye Edomu engima. Erio nario abanto baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: Because you rejoiced when the inheritance of the house of Israel became desolate, that is how I will treat you. You will be desolate, O Mount Seir, you and all of Edom. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Nigo mogosukia chiria chindeu namakere aino, na amareko, naende mwachitwoma ne chingunchara chiaino, goika mwachisiarera gochia ase chinsemo chionsi chi’aare.
english: Because you shove with flank and shoulder, butting all the weak sheep with your horns until you have driven them away,

ekegusii: ekiagera aye nobe morito, na oibore omwana omomura. Onde tabaisa kogingira etukia y’omotwe oye, ekiagera omwana oria omomura naatananwe ase Nyasae, abe Omwerwa oye korwa ase enda ya ng’ina. Ere nachake gotooria Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.”
english: because you will conceive and give birth to a son. No razor may be used on his head, because the boy is to be a Nazirite, set apart to God from birth, and he will begin the deliverance of Israel from the hands of the Philistines."

ekegusii: Aye togontiga agwo aase abakure, gose togotiga omochenu oo arore ogosareka.
english: because you will not abandon me to the grave, nor will you let your Holy One see decay.

ekegusii: ekiagera aye togotiga omoyo one agwo aase abakure, gose togotiga Omochenu oo arore ogosareka.
english: because you will not abandon me to the grave, nor will you let your Holy One see decay.

ekegusii: aye ogekanya okaba omoitongo ase obosio bwane inche Nyasae, naende ekero kwaigwa amang’ana igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto bareo, ogatandora chianga chiao, naende okarera ase obosio bwane. Naboigo inche Omonene nkogotebia, ng’a nakoigure.
english: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before God when you heard what he spoke against this place and its people, and because you humbled yourself before me and tore your robes and wept in my presence, I have heard you, declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero kwaigwa amang’ana aria, naye ogekanya, okaba omoitongo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Na ekero kwaigwete buna nakwanete igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto b’aiga ng’a goika basirigwe na babe okoragererigwa, aye ogatandora chianga chiao, naende okarera ase obosio bwane. Naboigo inche Omonene nkogotebia ng’a nakoigure.
english: Because your heart was responsive and you humbled yourself before the LORD when you heard what I have spoken against this place and its people, that they would become accursed and laid waste, and because you tore your robes and wept in my presence, I have heard you, declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obuya kobua obogima, ase ayio nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one.
english: Because your love is better than life, my lips will glorify you.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo ase abaiseke abwo nigo abete okweroisia omobere oye ase engaki y’emetienyi ikomi na ebere. Ase engaki y’emetienyi etano nomo emetang’ani nigo baare koba bakweaka amaguta a manemane, na emetienyi etano nomo ende babe bakweaka amaguta ande agotioka buya ase okweroisia emebere yabo. Erio ekero engaki yaigete; kera omoiseke oyomo oyomo akaba okorentwa ase omoruoti Ahaswero.
english: Before a girl's turn came to go in to King Xerxes, she had to complete twelve months of beauty treatments prescribed for the women, six months with oil of myrrh and six with perfumes and cosmetics.

ekegusii: Nonya nekero ntarakwana ring’ana rinde rionsi, Naama, aye Omonene nigo orimanyete kegima.
english: Before a word is on my tongue you know it completely, O LORD.

ekegusii: Naki konya bataracha abanto baria barwete ase Yakobo, nigo arenge koragera amo nabanto b’Ebisaku; korende ekero bachete akairana nyuma, ageatanana, akairoka abarogete.
english: Before certain men came from James, he used to eat with the Gentiles. But when they arrived, he began to draw back and separate himself from the Gentiles because he was afraid of those who belonged to the circumcision group.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi abogete mambia, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigachera Gadi, omobani, oyorenge omorori o Daudi, rikamotebia,
english: Before David got up the next morning, the word of the LORD had come to Gad the prophet, David's seer:

ekegusii: Orokia chinguru chiao ase abanto b’Efraimu, na aba Benjamin, na aba Manase, na oche ototoorie!
english: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.

ekegusii: Ritang’ani atarakoora ogosaba kwaye, akarora Rebeka ogocha obogoretie enyongo yaye mareko. Ere nomoiseke o Betueli, na Betueli nomwana o Milka, moka Nahori, momura omwabo Ibrahimu.
english: Before he had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milcah, who was the wife of Abraham's brother Nahor.

ekegusii: ekero ataratonga ense ne riroba riaye, nonya norotu.
english: before he made the earth or its fields or any of the dust of the world.

ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi nigo bire bosa ase obosio bwaye, nigo abibarete buna negento bosa, bitaisaini kende.
english: Before him all the nations are as nothing; they are regarded by him as worthless and less than nothing.

ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’enkoro y’omonto nigo bogotang’anera ogosirigwa, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera ogosikwa.
english: Before his downfall a man's heart is proud, but humility comes before honor.

ekegusii: Naakanwe obosa obwo ritang’ani engaki yaye etaraika, na nigo arabe buna orosagia rwaye rotarasicha.
english: Before his time he will be paid in full, and his branches will not flourish.

ekegusii: ekero ntaragenda aase ntanyare koirana korwao rinde, ense eria y’omosunte ekerima na ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri,
english: before I go to the place of no return, to the land of gloom and deep shadow,

ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaramanya, omoyo one okang’ira, okambeka ase egari y’omogambi bw’abanto baane.
english: Before I realized it, my desire set me among the royal chariots of my people.

ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaraegwa egesusuro, nigo narenge omosiru, korende bono nigo indendete ring’ana riao.
english: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I obey your word.

ekegusii: Na ekero Isaya atarasoka korwa ase eraaro ya gati, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asare, rikamotebia,
english: Before Isaiah had left the middle court, the word of the LORD came to him:

ekegusii: Nkere ekero egeke, ense etandore naende; korende inwe namondore, ekiagera inche moyo inde, na inwe namobe moyo.
english: Before long, the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo aorogetie ebikone na amakumia amanene, naende ay’okoondokia, aaria ase ense ya Misiri, ase Farao, na ase abanto bonsi b’enyomba yaye, naintwe tokayarora.
english: Before our eyes the LORD sent miraculous signs and wonders-- great and terrible-- upon Egypt and Pharaoh and his whole household.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, ritang’ani erioba ritaragwa, abanto b’omochie oria bagatebia Samison, “Ninki kere egiansu kobua obooke? Ninki kere ne chinguru kobua endo?” Samison akabairaneria, “Onye motaremete ne ritororo riane, timware konyara komanya engencho y’omobayeno one.”
english: Before sunset on the seventh day the men of the town said to him, "What is sweeter than honey? What is stronger than a lion?" Samson said to them, "If you had not plowed with my heifer, you would not have solved my riddle."

ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani ase amatuko ayio, monto onde bwensi tarenge konyora eng’eria ende ase emeremo arenge gokora, gose ng’iti ende yonsi yarenge gokora emeremo tiyarenge goakanerwa. Ase engencho y’obobisa onde tarenge na morembe kagosoka gose gakoirana, ekiagera nigo naseegetete kera omonto kwomana noyomwabo.
english: Before that time there were no wages for man or beast. No one could go about his business safely because of his enemy, for I had turned every man against his neighbor.

ekegusii: ekero aya achigetwe ataraikeranigwa, ekero rituko riria rirairurwe buna omoiriro okoirurwa na endamwamu entindi y’Omonene etarabachera, ee, ekero rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene ritarabachera.
english: before the appointed time arrives and that day sweeps on like chaff, before the fierce anger of the LORD comes upon you, before the day of the LORD's wrath comes upon you.

ekegusii: Nebe ekero omwana oyio ataramanya gwatora Tata gose Baba, nonyore ng’a obotenenku bwonsi bwa Damesiki, na ebisakorwa bia Samaria, biaikire koirwa ase omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.”
english: Before the boy knows how to say 'My father' or 'My mother,' the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria."

ekegusii: Ritang’ani ere ataracha, Yohana konya obarandeirie abanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli ebatiso y’okoonchoka.
english: Before the coming of Jesus, John preached repentance and baptism to all the people of Israel.

ekegusii: Ritang’ani ebigoro bitarabao, gose konya otaratonga ense, korwa kare na kare aye naye Nyasae.
english: Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.

ekegusii: Nigo naiboretwe oboroso bw’ebitunwa botarabekwa, na ebigoro bitarabao,
english: before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was given birth,

ekegusii: Ritang’ani abanto baria chirooti batararara, Rahabu akariina asebare kerama igoro,
english: Before the spies lay down for the night, she went up on the roof

ekegusii: before the sun and the light and the moon and the stars grow dark, and the clouds return after the rain;
english: Omoinyore ekero erioba, na omobaso, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, bitarabekwa omosunte, gose amare atarairanerana embura koyature.

ekegusii: Ritang’ani emiaka eria y’enchara etaracha, Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, omokuani bw’Oni, akaiborera Yusufu abana abaisia babere.
english: Before the years of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.

ekegusii: Bosio bwabo omorero nigo ogosamba, na magega yabo chimeme chi’omorero nigo chigosamba boigo. Bosio bwabo ense eyio yarenge buna omogondo o Edeni, korende magega yabo ekaba buna erooro yatigaire bosa, korwa ase chingige echio onde tari oratame atooreke.
english: Before them fire devours, behind them a flame blazes. Before them the land is like the garden of Eden, behind them, a desert waste-- nothing escapes them.

ekegusii: Ense netengeche bosio bwabo, na igoro nchinyegerigwe. Erioba na omotienyi nabibekwe omosunte; ne ching’enang’eni tichikobara.
english: Before them the earth shakes, the sky trembles, the sun and moon are darkened, and the stars no longer shine.

ekegusii: Before they call I will answer; while they are still speaking I will hear.
english: Nebe ng’a ekero batarandangeria nimbairanerie, na ekero barabe bagenderere gokwana nimbaigwe.

ekegusii: Ritang’ani batarachia korara, abanto bonsi pi b’omochie oria o Sodomu, abamura na abagaaka, bagacha bagaetanana enyomba,
english: Before they had gone to bed, all the men from every part of the city of Sodom-- both young and old-- surrounded the house.

ekegusii: Korende ekero okwegena gotaracha, nigo twabwatire inse y’amachiko, twasibire goika okwegena goche koorokigwa.
english: Before this faith came, we were held prisoners by the law, locked up until faith should be revealed.

ekegusii: Ekero engaki eyio konya etaraika, Eliasibu omokuani oria ochoretwe akaba omoteneneri ase ebinyomba biarenge chikungo, agwo ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito, nigo abwatanete na Tobia.
english: Before this, Eliashib the priest had been put in charge of the storerooms of the house of our God. He was closely associated with Tobiah,

ekegusii: Nyuma ase ekero egeke omwaga bwe chinguru okorokwa Eurakilo, ore gocha buna ekembugu‐mbugu ogaaka emeeri.
english: Before very long, a wind of hurricane force, called the "northeaster," swept down from the island.

ekegusii: Omonene nabasirie bwango, ee, bwango kobua chinyongo chiaino chitarabwata riberera ri’omorero bw’amagwa, karabe amabese gose amasusanu.
english: Before your pots can feel [the heat of] the thorns-- whether they be green or dry-- the wicked will be swept away.

ekegusii: Ekero keria ebibe biao konya bitaraorokigwa maiso marore? Bono kwabeire buna ere. Abaiseke b’ense ya Edomu, na ab’Abafilisti, abwo bagoetanaine ase chinsemo chiao chionsi, nigo bagochayete.
english: before your wickedness was uncovered. Even so, you are now scorned by the daughters of Edom and all her neighbors and the daughters of the Philistines-- all those around you who despise you.

ekegusii: Begin the music, strike the tambourine, play the melodious harp and lyre.
english: Tera ogotera kw’ogotogia, mobugie chinchigiri amo namakano ’ebirigisa, na amakano ande.

ekegusii: korwa ase okobatisa kwa Yohana goika rituko riria abogoretigwe korwa asetore, negwenerete oyomo obo abe kirori bw’okoboka kwaye amo naintwe.”
english: beginning from John's baptism to the time when Jesus was taken up from us. For one of these must become a witness with us of his resurrection."

ekegusii: Enchera yaeteire nigo ekogenderera komesa, enyancha inse nigo egokagwa ng’a nechimbuche.
english: Behind him he leaves a glistening wake; one would think the deep had white hair.

ekegusii: Na moino y’etoto eria ya kabere yarengeo eema ende yare korokwa Aase Aachenu Mono.
english: Behind the second curtain was a room called the Most Holy Place,

ekegusii: Gwatenenia ekeinyorio kiao korwa ase egesieri moino y’emetobwa. Gwantigire inche, gwasioririe ekiebisio kiao, gwasoire aroro gwakegareeirie. Aye ogechorera oyomo, ogancha korara nere, ekero kwaroche okogosima nokoboko.
english: Behind your doors and your doorposts you have put your pagan symbols. Forsaking me, you uncovered your bed, you climbed into it and opened it wide; you made a pact with those whose beds you love, and you looked on their nakedness.

ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene, ng’a ere oyochagete emeremo emiya ase emioyo yaino ime nayeikeranie goika rituko riria ria Kristo Yeso.
english: being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Akamanya boronge ng’a Nyasae nanyare gokora aria arierete eira.
english: being fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaba bakorenda agwo ase Egeita ki’Omoruoti, ensemo ya moocha, goika engaki eye. Kare nabwo barenge abarendi b’egetwori ki’Abalawi.
english: being stationed at the King's Gate on the east, up to the present time. These were the gatekeepers belonging to the camp of the Levites.

ekegusii: Na inwe mobekwe chinguru ase okobua gwonsi, koreng’ana ne chinguru chi’obonene bwaye ase okoganya na oboremereria bwonsi amo nomogoko,
english: being strengthened with all power according to his glorious might so that you may have great endurance and patience, and joyfully

ekegusii: “Beli yagure inse, na Nebo yekumbire; emegwekano ye chinyasae chiria eberekire ne ching’iti ne chiombe; ebinto ebio bibogoirie nigo bire chigurube chindito ase ching’iti echio chiarosire.
english: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops low; their idols are borne by beasts of burden. The images that are carried about are burdensome, a burden for the weary.

ekegusii: Bela, mosinto o Beori, akaba okogamba ase ense y’Edomu, na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Dinihaba.
english: Bela son of Beor became king of Edom. His city was named Dinhabah.

ekegusii: Inyegene ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane; gose inyegene ase engencho y’emeremo emenyene.
english: Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the miracles themselves.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Ladani na Simei.
english: Belonging to the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

ekegusii: Ase rikere ri’egetuba keria kiarenge nobogare bw’amaboko ikomi emegwekano ye chiombe iyarengeo. Emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge ase chindwaro ibere, ekabombwa ekaba egento ekemo negetuba keria.
english: Below the rim, figures of bulls encircled it-- ten to a cubit. The bulls were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.

ekegusii: Ang’e nomogo emegwekano y’amasosa iyarengeo, ikomi ase kera ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, yarandete ekeringero ekegima. Emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge chindwaro ibere, yabombire ase egento ekemo negetuba keria.
english: Below the rim, gourds encircled it-- ten to a cubit. The gourds were cast in two rows in one piece with the Sea.

ekegusii: Ben-Abinadab-- in Naphoth Dor (he was married to Taphath daughter of Solomon);
english: Beni‐Abinadab agatenenera Nafati‐Dori yonsi (nere onyuomete Tafati, omoiseke o Sulemani);

ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akairaneria omoruoti, “Amina. Tiga Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one omoruoti, anchere ayio.
english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada answered the king, "Amen! May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, so declare it.

ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omochiki bw’abarwani esegi; Zadoki na Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani;
english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada-- commander in chief; Zadok and Abiathar-- priests;

ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omonto etuoni korwa Kabuseli. Ere agakora emeremo emenene, agaita abanto babere chituoni b’Abamoabu. Engaki ende, ekero ki’obokendu, na amagena ’embura yatwete, agasoa engoro agaita endo aroro.
english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, who performed great exploits. He struck down two of Moab's best men. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.

ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nigo arenge omonto etuoni korwa ase Kabuseli. Ere agakora emeremo emenene, agaita abanto babere chituoni b’Abamoabu. Engaki ende, ekero ki’obokendu na amagena ’embura yatwete, agasoa engoro agaita endo aroro.
english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was a valiant fighter from Kabzeel, who performed great exploits. He struck down two of Moab's best men. He also went down into a pit on a snowy day and killed a lion.

ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti na Abapeleti; na basinto ba Daudi nabwo barenge abanene bamoetanaine.
english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David's sons were chief officials at the king's side.

ekegusii: Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere orenge omoteneneri bw’Abakereti, na Abapeleti, na basinto ba Daudi nabwo barenge abakuani.
english: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites; and David's sons were royal advisers.

ekegusii: Benaya korwa Piratoni, na Hidai korwa ase amagoko ang’e na Gaasi;
english: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai from the ravines of Gaash,

ekegusii: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Keluhi,
english: na Benaya, Bedeya na Keluhi,

ekegusii: Ben-Deker-- in Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh and Elon Bethhanan;
english: Beni‐Dekeri agatenenera emechie ya Makasi, na Shaalabimu, na Beti‐Semesi, na Eloni, na Beti‐Hanani.

ekegusii: Beni‐Geberi agatenenera Ramoti o Gileadi, na Emechie ya Yairi Omomanase agwo Gileadi, na orogongo rw’Arigobu agwo Basani. Igo atenenerete emechie emerongo etano nomo emenene yagiteire chindwaki, na ebiita biabo nigo biarenge nemekorogoto.
english: Ben-Geber-- in Ramoth Gilead (the settlements of Jair son of Manasseh in Gilead were his, as well as the district of Argob in Bashan and its sixty large walled cities with bronze gate bars);

ekegusii: Beni‐Hadadi akaigwera Asa omoruoti, agatoma abatang’ani b’abarwani baye, bakagenda bakarwania emechie y’Abaisraeli, bakabua Iyoni na Dani, na Abeli‐Beti‐Maaka, na Kinereti, yonsi, amo nense yonsi ya Nafutali.
english: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. He conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maacah and all Kinnereth in addition to Naphtali.

ekegusii: Beni‐Hadadi akaigwera Asa omoruoti, agatoma abatang’ani b’abarwani baye, bakagenda bakarwania emechie y’Abaisraeli, bakabua Iyoni, na Dani, na Abeli‐Maimu, na emechie yonsi ase ebinto biagachire agwo ase orogongo rwa Nafutali.
english: Ben-Hadad agreed with King Asa and sent the commanders of his forces against the towns of Israel. They conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim and all the store cities of Naphtali.

ekegusii: Ekero Beni‐Hadadi aigwete ring’ana erio, ekero arenge konywa amo nabaruoti bande ase chiema, agatebia abanto baye, “Eroberie!” Barabwo bakeroberia gochia korwania omochie oria.
english: Ben-Hadad heard this message while he and the kings were drinking in their tents, and he ordered his men: "Prepare to attack." So they prepared to attack the city.

ekegusii: Beni‐Hesedi agatenenera emechie y’Aruboti na Soko, na ense yonsi ya Hefa;
english: Ben-Hesed-- in Arubboth (Socoh and all the land of Hepher were his);

ekegusii: Benjamin was the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second son, Aharah the third,
english: Benjamin nere orenge ise Bela, omwana oye omomura omotangi na Asibeli oyo o kabere, na Ahara oyo o gatato,

ekegusii: Benjamin, Malluch and Shemariah.
english: na Benjamin, Maluku na Semaria;

ekegusii: Berekia na Elikana babe abarendi b’egeita ase Esanduku eria y’Omonene.
english: Berekiah and Elkanah were to be doorkeepers for the ark.

ekegusii: na Hamati, na Berota, na Sibiraimu, eyio ere ase egati y’omochie o Damesiki, na oyo o Hamati. Naende rigenderere goika Haseri‐Atikoni ere ang’e ne ribebe ria Haurani.
english: Berothah and Sibraim (which lies on the border between Damascus and Hamath), as far as Hazer Hatticon, which is on the border of Hauran.

ekegusii: Besai, Meunim, Nephussim,
english: Besai, na Meunimu, na Nefusimu;

ekegusii: Mbarabare ase ebiita bosio bw’omochie ase ebisoero bi’ebiita nigo bogokwana neriogi rinene, bwateba;
english: beside the gates leading into the city, at the entrances, she cries aloud:

ekegusii: na bonsi ab’enka ya Yusufu, amo nabamwabo, na ab’enka ya ise. Abana babo boka bagatigara Goseni amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiabo.
english: besides all the members of Joseph's household and his brothers and those belonging to his father's household. Only their children and their flocks and herds were left in Goshen.

ekegusii: Kobua ase amang’ana onsi ayare korwa isiko naro okorigereria gwe chikanisa chionsi, ayare gonchichera kera rituko.
english: Besides everything else, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.

ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa, morue egoree eyemo ase Omonene, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
english: Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering.

ekegusii: amo nabasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana atato, na emerongo etato, na batano na babere (7,337). Boigo mbabwate abateri, abasacha na abakungu, amagana abere (200).
english: besides their 7,337 menservants and maidservants; and they also had 200 men and women singers.

ekegusii: amo na abasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana atato, na emerongo etato, na batano na babere (7,337). Boigo mbabwate abateri, abasacha na abakungu, amagana abere, na emerongo ene, na batano (245).
english: besides their 7,337 menservants and maidservants; and they also had 245 men and women singers.

ekegusii: Boigo naende ekiagera nanchire na kwerwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae one, narure ase enyomba eye enchenu chinibo chiane chionsi chie chitahabu ne chifeta komenta ase ebinto ebio bionsi konya narure.
english: Besides, in my devotion to the temple of my God I now give my personal treasures of gold and silver for the temple of my God, over and above everything I have provided for this holy temple:

ekegusii: Ere amaene nomoiseke ominto, tata noyomo, korende ng’ina nomoao, na inche nkamonyuoma.
english: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father though not of my mother; and she became my wife.

ekegusii: Amo nayio beorokereirie koba aboro, bagoetanana enyomba ase enyomba; tibari aboro rioka, korende nabatora‐toria, bakwerosia namang’ana ’abanto bande, bagokwana amang’ana atagwenereti.
english: Besides, they get into the habit of being idle and going about from house to house. And not only do they become idlers, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things they ought not to.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoa abwo banyanchete obotenenku na goichoria chikungo chiabo.
english: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries full.

ekegusii: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,
english: na Beti‐Araba, na Semaraimu, na Beteli,

ekegusii: Beth Lebaoth and Sharuhen-- thirteen towns and their villages;
english: na Beti‐Lebaoti, na Saruheni, emechie ikomi na etato, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Beti‐Marikaboti, na Hasari‐Susimu, na Beti‐Biri, na Saaraimu. Eye nero yarenge emechie yabo goika ekero Daudi abete omoruoti.
english: Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, Beth Biri and Shaaraim. These were their towns until the reign of David.

ekegusii: na Beti‐Nimura, na Beti‐Harani, emechie yagiteire chindwaki, naende yabwate ameri e ching’ondi.
english: Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran as fortified cities, and built pens for their flocks.

ekegusii: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth
english: Beti‐Peori amo nebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga, na Beti‐Yesimoti;

ekegusii: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,
english: na Beti‐Suri, na Soko, na Adulamu,

ekegusii: Bethania nigo orenge ang’e na Yerusalemu, koreng’ana chimaeli ibere.
english: Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,

ekegusii: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
english: Akaagacha Bethlehemu, na Etamu, na Tekoa,

ekegusii: Betueli nere omoiborete omoiseke ore korokwa Rebeka. Abwo batano na batato nabwo Milka aiborerete Nahori, momura omwabo Ibrahimu.
english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milcah bore these eight sons to Abraham's brother Nahor.

ekegusii: Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag,
english: Betueli, na Horima, na Sikilagi;

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya konyora ritonge eriomo ri’obokima na koba nobotoereru kobua kobeera ase enyomba eichire endagera y’omoyega ere neriomana.
english: Better a dry crust with peace and quiet than a house full of feasting, with strife.

ekegusii: Mbuya koba nebinto ebike amo noboronge kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge chikonyorwa ase oborianania.
english: Better a little with righteousness than much gain with injustice.

ekegusii: Mbuya koba nebinto ebike amo nokomoiroka Omonene, kobua koba ne chinibo chinyinge amo nemechando.
english: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great wealth with turmoil.

ekegusii: Mbuya koria chinyeni more nobwanchani, kobua koria chinyama chie chiombe chinoru na mogechaine.
english: Better a meal of vegetables where there is love than a fattened calf with hatred.

ekegusii: Omonto otari omwango ase okogechigwa nigo abuete omorwani etuoni, na oyomanyete kogambera enkoro yaye nigo abuete oyo okobua omochie na koyoira.
english: Better a patient man than a warrior, a man who controls his temper than one who takes a city.

ekegusii: Omwana omosae omotaka ore nobong’aini nigo’are omuya kobua omoruoti omogotu ore omoriri, otari gwancha gosemigwa;
english: Better a poor but wise youth than an old but foolish king who no longer knows how to take warning.

ekegusii: Omonto omotaka ore omwegenwa nigo are omuya kobua oyore omong’ainereria ase chinkwana chiaye naende omoriri.
english: Better a poor man whose walk is blameless than a fool whose lips are perverse.

ekegusii: Omonto omotaka okobwatia oboronge nigo are omuya kobua omonda ore omokorekanu.
english: Better a poor man whose walk is blameless than a rich man whose ways are perverse.

ekegusii: Mbuya kobeera ase enyomba yao rituko erimo rioka kobua kobeera amatuko chilifu chinyinge aande onsi; mbuya koba omorendi bw’egesieri ki’enyomba yao aye Nyasae one, kobua kobeera ase obomenyo bw’abakori amabe.
english: Better is one day in your courts than a thousand elsewhere; I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

ekegusii: Ogotogonyera kwa maiso marore nigo kore okuya kobua obwanchani bobisegete.
english: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

ekegusii: Mbuya koba negento geichire oroe oromo na koba nomorembe, kobua koba nebinto biichire chindoe ibere na koba nogwechanda na kominyokera konyora ebire buna embeo bosa.
english: Better one handful with tranquillity than two handfuls with toil and chasing after the wind.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebike omonto omonyaboronge abwate, nigo bire ebiya kobua ebinge biria abakori amabe abange babwate.
english: Better the little that the righteous have than the wealth of many wicked;

ekegusii: Omonto omoitongo ogwekorera emeremo yaye omonyene nigo are omuya kobua omonto ogwekora koba omonene, korende tabwati endagera.
english: Better to be a nobody and yet have a servant than pretend to be somebody and have no food.

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya koba nomoyo bw’oboitongo na komenya amo nabataka kobua gwatanana ebisakorwa amo nabaenenu.
english: Better to be lowly in spirit and among the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.

ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ense y’erooro, kobua komenya nomokungu omonyariomana, naende omonyandamwamu.
english: Better to live in a desert than with a quarrelsome and ill-tempered wife.

ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ekenunchi kia irongo, kobua komenya ase enyomba amo nomokungu omonyariomana.
english: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

ekegusii: Mbuya komenya ase ekenunchi kia irongo igoro, kobua komenya ase enyomba amo nomokungu omonyariomana.
english: Better to live on a corner of the roof than share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

ekegusii: Mbuya omonto aumerane neng’iti entindi ekorokwa edubu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye, kobua koumerana nomonto omoriri ase oboriri bwaye.
english: Better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool in his folly.

ekegusii: Eki amaiso aroche nigo kere buya kobua eki okogania ng’a okenyore. Ayio boigo mbosa, na okominyokia aya are buna embeo bosa.
english: Better what the eye sees than the roving of the appetite. This too is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

ekegusii: Abanto nabo baranyare koba moyo ase engaki ya mambia, korende omogoroba otaraika, kwanyora baitirwe, basirire goika kare na kare, na onde tari okobechandera.
english: Between dawn and dusk they are broken to pieces; unnoticed, they perish forever.

ekegusii: Bwerende, tobaisa koirana gokora amabe, ekiagera nigo gwanchire gokora ayio kobua konyora emechando.”
english: Beware of turning to evil, which you seem to prefer to affliction.

ekegusii: Naende ne ring’ana ritari koamereranigwa, ng’a obobisi bwe chingencho chi’obonyasae nobonene: Ere oyoorogetigwe ase omobere o mwanyabanto, akaorokigwa n’Omoika ng’a nomonyene oboronge, akarorwa nabamalaika, akarandigwa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, akegenwa ase ense, akabogorigwa gochia igoro ase obonene.
english: Beyond all question, the mystery of godliness is great: He appeared in a body, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was preached among the nations, was believed on in the world, was taken up in glory.

ekegusii: Oyobwatetie oyio, Nehemia, mosinto bw’Asubuki, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rwa Beti-Suri, akaagacha orwaki goikera ensemo yarochie chimbeera chia Daudi chiarenge ase ritibo riaremetwe, na goikera ase enyomba y’abanto abarenge nokobua.
english: Beyond him, Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of a half-district of Beth Zur, made repairs up to a point opposite the tombs of David, as far as the artificial pool and the House of the Heroes.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’abwo Benjamin na Hasubu bakaagacha ensemo y’enyomba yabo. Oyobwatetie abwo, n’Asaria, mosinto o Maaseya bw’Anania; ere akaagacha ensemo y’enyomba yaye.
english: Beyond them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs in front of their house; and next to them, Azariah son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made repairs beside his house.

ekegusii: Erio Besaleli akaroisia Esanduku ye chibao chi’emekonge. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro okoboko okomo, na ekeng’ese.
english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood-- two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

ekegusii: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran and Beera.
english: na Beseri, na Hodi, na Sama, na Silisa, na Itirani, na Beera.

ekegusii: Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad,
english: Bilaha, na Esemu, na Toladi;

ekegusii: Oyasibe ase ebiara bi’amaboko ao, na oyarike oyabeke ase enkoro yao.
english: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.

ekegusii: Yasibe, agenderere kobeera botambe ase enkoro yao, naende oyasibe ase rigoti riao.
english: Bind them upon your heart forever; fasten them around your neck.

ekegusii: Eboeranie oborori, na obeke amachiko aane ekemanyererio, ime ase chinkoro chi’aborokigwa baane.
english: Bind up the testimony and seal up the law among my disciples.

ekegusii: Nigo okorera nobororo botuko bokia, na amariga nigo agoiteka ase chimboto chiaye; ase abanchi baye bonsi onde tari okomoremia; abasani baye bamong’ainire, babeire ababisa baye.
english: Bitterly she weeps at night, tears are upon her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is none to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.

ekegusii: Omonene, obasesenie amo nebi bionsi babwate, bwanche emeremo eria bagokora, obune chibachwa chi’ababisa babo baria bagocha kobarwania, baria babagechete, tibabaisa gocha kobarwania naende.”
english: Bless all his skills, O LORD, and be pleased with the work of his hands. Smite the loins of those who rise up against him; strike his foes till they rise no more."

ekegusii: basesenie abwo bakobaragereria, basabere abwo bakobakorera bobe.
english: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.

ekegusii: Mosesenie abwo bakobachanda; basesenie, timobaragereria.
english: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyore omochenu, oyore nensemo y’okobokigwa kwe ritang’ani. Igoro ase abwo amakweri a kabere tari nokobua korende nababe abakuani ba Nyasae na aba Kristo, na barabwo nabagambe amo nere emiaka elifu eyemo.
english: Blessed and holy are those who have part in the first resurrection. The second death has no power over them, but they will be priests of God and of Christ and will reign with him for a thousand years.

ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abare noboitongo, ekiagera barabwo nabaire omwando bw’ense.
english: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.

ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abare namabera, ekiagera barabwo nabarorerwe amabera.
english: Blessed are the merciful, for they will be shown mercy.

ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abagokora omorembe, ekiagera barabwo nabarokwe abana ba Nyasae.
english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.

ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abanto bakonyora ogosesenigwa okwo. Ee, mbasesenirie abanto abwo Nyasae are Omonene obo.
english: Blessed are the people of whom this is true; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.

ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abare abachenu ase chinkoro, ekiagera barabwo nabarore Nyasae.
english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.

ekegusii: Mbasesenire abwo barendete oborori bwaye, abwo bakorigia Omonene ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi,
english: Blessed are they who keep his statutes and seek him with all their heart.

ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bagokora ekeene, abwo bagokora oboronge ase chingaki chionsi.
english: Blessed are they who maintain justice, who constantly do what is right.

ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abwo chinchera chiabo chire chindonge, abwo bagendererete kobwatia amachiko ’Omonene.
english: Blessed are they whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the LORD.

ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abachandekire ase engencho y’oboronge, ekiagera oboruoti bwa igoro nobwabo.
english: Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bamenyete ase enyomba yao, abwo bakona‐gotera botambe ase okogotogia.
english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house; they are ever praising you. Selah

ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bamanyete goaka eriogi ri’omogoko asore, abwo bagotaara ase oborabu bokorwa ase obosio bwao aye Omonene.
english: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, O LORD.

ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abare nenchara na erang’o y’okonyora oboronge, ekiagera barabwo nabaigotigwe.
english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.

ekegusii: “Mbasesenirie abaichanete, ekiagera nabache koremigwa.
english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abanto abwo bakonyora chinguru chiabo korwa asore; abwo chinkoro chiabo chiganetie kogenda Sayoni.
english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on pilgrimage.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio gwachorire na komoikia ang’e, amenye naye ase chigoora chiao. Intwe ntoisaneke nobuya bw’enyomba yao, Hekalu yao Enchenu.
english: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.

ekegusii: “Imosesenirie inwe ekero mwanyabanto bakobagecha, na kobarusanania, na kobachaya, na gosaria amarieta aino buna nababe more, ase engencho y’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.
english: Blessed are you when men hate you, when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil, because of the Son of Man.

ekegusii: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be satisfied. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
english: “Imosesenirie inwe abamore nenchara bono, ekiagera namoigotigwe.” “Imosesenirie inwe abamokorera bono, ekiagera namoseke.”

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, imosesenirie! Inwe nabanto mwatoorigwe n’Omonene. Nere enguba yaino ekobakengera; Nere omoro oino okobarentera obobui! Ababisa baino mbebeke inse asemore, nainwe motaare moete ebigoro biabo.”
english: Blessed are you, O Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD? He is your shield and helper and your glorious sword. Your enemies will cower before you, and you will trample down their high places."

ekegusii: Nosesenirie aye ense, ekero omoruoti oo are omonto omosike na omosibore; na abagambi bao bakoragera ase engaki egwenerete, ase okonyora chinguru, korende tari ase ogotinda.
english: Blessed are you, O land whose king is of noble birth and whose princes eat at a proper time-- for strength and not for drunkenness.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyio ogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Intwe nigo tokobasesenia korwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio Nyasae o Yakobo are ogokonywa kwaye, oyio osemeretie Omonene, Nyasae oye,
english: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD his God,

ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyobwegenete ng’a amang’ana ayio atebigwe n’Omonene naikeranigwe.”
english: Blessed is she who has believed that what the Lord has said to her will be accomplished!"

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto omoirogete Omonene botambe, korende oyo okong’etie enkoro yaye nanyore emechando eramosirie.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears the LORD, but he who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie onde bwensi otagochiri nainche.”
english: Blessed is the man who does not fall away on account of me."

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria otari gotunyana chingencho chi’abakori amabe, gose tari kobwatia chinchera chi’abanyabibe, gose tari gosanga amo nabagochecheria Nyasae,
english: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked or stand in the way of sinners or sit in the seat of mockers.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie oyo ogokora ayio, mwanyabanto oyo okoyabwata bokong’u, oyio okorenda Esabato, tayekora ebe eyetachenegeti, omonto oyio ogotanga okoboko kwaye tigokora amabe ande onsi.”
english: Blessed is the man who does this, the man who holds it fast, who keeps the Sabbath without desecrating it, and keeps his hand from doing any evil."

ekegusii: Nare nomogoko omonto oyio onyorire obong’aini naende ore nokomanya.
english: Blessed is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gains understanding,

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio okonyigwera; oyio okorenda ase ebiita biane kera rituko, oganyete ase ebisieri biane.
english: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at my doorway.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria omosemeretie Omonene, otari kweonchora gochia ase abanto abaenenu, gose ase abwo bagosira ase okoonchokera chinyasae chi’oborimo.
english: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, who does not look to the proud, to those who turn aside to false gods.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria oremereretie ogoteemwa, ekiagera ekero aikire gwancherwa nanyore obogima buna egutwa y’obobui, obogima obwo Nyasae abarierete eira abwo bamwanchete.
english: Blessed is the man who perseveres under trial, because when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life that God has promised to those who love him.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyo oichoretie esaro yaye ne chinsara echio. Oyio takobugwa ekero arabe okogamberana nababisa baye agwo ase egeita.
english: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their enemies in the gate.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyo Omonene atabarereti okomocha kwaye, oyo otari nobong’ainereria ase omoyo oye ime.
english: Blessed is the man whose sin the LORD does not count against him and in whose spirit is no deceit.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria Omonene atabarereti ebibe biaye.”
english: Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will never count against him."

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oyio aye Omonene okorongeyia na komworokereria amachiko ao,
english: Blessed is the man you discipline, O LORD, the man you teach from your law;

ekegusii: Ngesesenirie egesaku eke Omonene are Nyasae obo, abanto aba achorete babe omwando oye.
english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people he chose for his inheritance.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie ere oyogosoma, na abwo bakoigwa amang’ana ’obobani obo, na kobwata ayarikireo, ekiagera engaki ng’ang’e ere.
english: Blessed is the one who reads the words of this prophecy, and blessed are those who hear it and take to heart what is written in it, because the time is near.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto oria oraganye aikere amatuko elifu eyemo, na amagana atato, na emerongo etato na atano (1,335).
english: Blessed is the one who waits for and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.

ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa nigo gokobeera ase omotwe bw’omonyene oboronge, korende obochege nigo boichire ase emenwa y’abakori amabe.
