english: Blessings crown the head of the righteous, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.

ekegusii: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.
english: Aye Omofarisai omouko! Sibia ritang’ani egekombe na esani ime, erio nonya nisiko binyare koba ebirabu.

ekegusii: Abanto bare nerang’o y’ogoitera amanyinga nigo bakogecha oyo otari na komocha, korende abare ne chinkoro chindonge nigo bakomorenda.
english: Bloodthirsty men hate a man of integrity and seek to kill the upright.

ekegusii: Bugia egetureri ase Sayoni; raria engaki y’okweng’ata ogochenu, rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasima!
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion, declare a holy fast, call a sacred assembly.

ekegusii: Bugia egetureri ase Sayoni, ee, bugia egetureri ki’ogotabobora ase egetunwa kiane egechenu. Tiga abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense baiguswe, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ang’e.
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion; sound the alarm on my holy hill. Let all who live in the land tremble, for the day of the LORD is coming. It is close at hand--

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arabe namaakwa naende asirie amasikani onsi, obosooku bwaye tibogotinyigwa boeere.
english: Blows and disgrace are his lot, and his shame will never be wiped away;

ekegusii: Obororo bw’ogoakwa nenyimbo nigo bogosibia ebibe, boigo ogoakwa kw’ebiranya nigo kogosoa ase enkoro ime kwayesibia.
english: Blows and wounds cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the inmost being.

ekegusii: chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri; egatani engiya na amanya e chimbori;
english: blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen; goat hair;

ekegusii: Chimbeche chie rinani nigo chigosaria omosabibu oyio, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nigo chikoyotakuna.
english: Boars from the forest ravage it and the creatures of the field feed on it.

ekegusii: Boaz asked the foreman of his harvesters, "Whose young woman is that?"
english: Boazi akaboria omoteneneri bw’abagesi baye, “Inee! Omosubati oyo, noyo ng’o?”

ekegusii: Boazi akamoiraneria, “Natebigwe amang’ana onsi gwakoreire nyoko biara korwa ekero omosacha oye akwete. Namanyire buna gwatigire iso na nyoko, na ense yao kwaiboreretwe, ogacha komenya nabanto otamanyete agwo ritang’ani.
english: Boaz replied, "I've been told all about what you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband-- how you left your father and mother and your homeland and came to live with a people you did not know before.

ekegusii: Boaz the father of Obed and Obed the father of Jesse.
english: Boazi akaibora Obedi, na Obedi akaibora Yese.

ekegusii: Naende Boazi akarangeria abagaaka ikomi b’omochie baikaranse aroro. Ase igo bagaikaransa.
english: Boaz took ten of the elders of the town and said, "Sit here," and they did so.

ekegusii: okorandia amang’ana ’oboruoti bwa Nyasae, na kworokereria abanto amang’ana igoro y’Omonene Yeso Kristo noboremu obonge, takanigwa na monto.
english: Boldly and without hindrance he preached the kingdom of God and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bare nomokia gokora ayare amabe namaboko abo. Omogambi nigo anchete aegwe riaaki, na omogambi ebina boigo; omonto ore nokobua nigo agosaba aegwe ebi aganetie ase okogania kwaye okobe, na nigo babwateranete amo.
english: Both hands are skilled in doing evil; the ruler demands gifts, the judge accepts bribes, the powerful dictate what they desire-- they all conspire together.

ekegusii: Korwa aase atigire ataagachire arenge nobogare bw’amaboko emerongo ebere gochia ase eraaro ya isiko yatichire namagena, ebitambokero mbiarengeo biare gotirimbokerwa gochia ase amarongo atato ay’enyomba eria.
english: Both in the section twenty cubits from the inner court and in the section opposite the pavement of the outer court, gallery faced gallery at the three levels.

ekegusii: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which he will remove with the kidneys--
english: amo ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, na ebitinya bichitubete bire ang’e nomogongo; na ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo,

ekegusii: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins, and the covering of the liver, which is to be removed with the kidneys.
english: ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete bire ang’e nomogongo, na ebitinya bie riini birusigwe amo ne chinyigo.

ekegusii: both low and high, rich and poor alike:
english: inwe mwensi pi, abake na abanene, abanda na abataka amo!

ekegusii: Mahaloni na Kilioni nabarabwo bagakwa. Igo Naomi agakwerwa omosacha oye na abamura baye babere.
english: both Mahlon and Kilion also died, and Naomi was left without her two sons and her husband.

ekegusii: Na bonsi babere nabanyene oboronge baare ase obosio bwa Nyasae; nigo bagendererete ase amachiko ne chinchera chionsi chi’Omonene batari na komocha.
english: Both of them were upright in the sight of God, observing all the Lord's commandments and regulations blamelessly.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya abere nagochere mobosokano ase rituko erimo; abana bao mbakwe, na omosacha oo akwe, obe omoboraka; ayio onsi nagochere, nonya oborogi bwao, na oboringoria bwao, bire ebinge mono.
english: Both of these will overtake you in a moment, on a single day: loss of children and widowhood. They will come upon you in full measure, in spite of your many sorceries and all your potent spells.

ekegusii: Naki ere oyogochena amo nabwo bagochenwa nigo bakorwa ase oyomo. Ase ayio, takorora obosooku kobaroka abamwabo,
english: Both the one who makes men holy and those who are made holy are of the same family. So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.

ekegusii: Aase Aachenu amo n’Aase Aachenu Mono nigo abwate emerangwa ebere.
english: Both the outer sanctuary and the Most Holy Place had double doors.

ekegusii: Bakaminyoka chimbero bonsi babere amo. Omworokigwa oria onde akaminyoka bwango kobua Petero, akaba oyo bwe ritang’ani goika ase oboina,
english: Both were running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.

ekegusii: Ee, Omonene otebire iga: Nimbaakane ase engencho y’obobe bwabo, amo nobwe chisokoro chiabo, ekiagera basamberete ubani igoro ase ebitunwa, na igo bakandamera agwo ase ebigoro. Ritang’ani nimbarengere ogoakanwa kwabo ase ogokora kwabo, nkobeke ase ebikuba biabo.”
english: both your sins and the sins of your fathers," says the LORD. "Because they burned sacrifices on the mountains and defied me on the hills, I will measure into their laps the full payment for their former deeds."

ekegusii: Tenena okong’e buna omosacha, inche ninkoborie, naye ong’iranerie.
english: Brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer me.

ekegusii: Aye orute abanto abwo bakombwatia ritimo na esimisi! Ontebie ase omoyo one, “Ninche Omotooria oo.”
english: Brandish spear and javelin against those who pursue me. Say to my soul, "I am your salvation."

ekegusii: Bono imoka mochake orogendo rwaino. Moonchoke mogende gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaamori, na ase abanto be chinse chietanaineo. Abwo bamenyete ase Ekerubo Ekiomo, na ase ense y’ebitunwa, na ase ense omweya, na ase ense ya Negebu, na ase ense ere ang’e n’Enyancha Enene. Mogende ase ense y’Abakanani gochia ase egetunwa kia Lebanoni, na goikera ase orooche roria oronene rw’Eufarati.
english: Break camp and advance into the hill country of the Amorites; go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah, in the mountains, in the western foothills, in the Negev and along the coast, to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon, as far as the great river, the Euphrates.

ekegusii: Motagore ebisasimero biabo, mobutore chisiiro chiabo bagosasima, mosambe nomorero emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, mogeche na koiyeria emegwekano ye chinyasae chiabo ebachire. Mosirie amarieta e chinyasae echio chiebwe kegima, tichisasimwa naende aase agwo.
english: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and burn their Asherah poles in the fire; cut down the idols of their gods and wipe out their names from those places.

ekegusii: Inwe motagore ebisasimero biabo, mobiiyerie inse, na gosenyenta chisiiro chi’amagena ase bagosasimera, na emete y’enyasae enkungu Asera moyenache.
english: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones and cut down their Asherah poles.

ekegusii: Saria chinguru chi’abanto abakori amabe na abanyabibe, obae egesusuro ase amabe onsi bagokora goika toyarora naende.
english: Break the arm of the wicked and evil man; call him to account for his wickedness that would not be found out.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, obune amaino ’emenwa yabo; aye Omonene, gokora amagegu e chindo chinsae!
english: Break the teeth in their mouths, O God; tear out, O LORD, the fangs of the lions!

ekegusii: rirorio amoire nka bwoye, na omokungu oria akigite etukia y’omotwe oye naende aninte chinchara chiaye.
english: Bring her into your home and have her shave her head, trim her nails

ekegusii: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics
english: “Orente na abamura baye, obabekere chianga.

ekegusii: Bring his sons and dress them in tunics.
english: Orente na abamura baye, obabekere chianga chiabo,

ekegusii: Osoyie emesa, na obeke ebinto biaye igoro yaye; osoyie na ekebekerero gie chitaya, na obeke chitaya igoro yaye.
english: Bring in the table and set out what belongs on it. Then bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

ekegusii: Gokia omoyo one inche omosomba oo, ekiagera narentire omoyo one asore aye Omonene.
english: Bring joy to your servant, for to you, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

ekegusii: Ndetere chinyama chia borabu, ondoiserie endagera engiya indie, erio inyare kogosesenia ase obosio bw’Omonene, konde moyo, ntarakwa.
english: 'Bring me some game and prepare me some tasty food to eat, so that I may give you my blessing in the presence of the LORD before I die.'

ekegusii: Osoke amo na kera egetongwa kere moyo amo naye: chinyoni, ne ching’iti chigotaara, na echikwagura igoro ase ense, erinde chiibore chimenteke, chiichore ase ense.”
english: Bring out every kind of living creature that is with you-- the birds, the animals, and all the creatures that move along the ground-- so they can multiply on the earth and be fruitful and increase in number upon it."

ekegusii: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let's have a feast and celebrate.
english: Nyerente emori eria ere enoru, moyenyenye, torie na kogoka,

ekegusii: Ondetere inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera eroisirie ase enchera eyemo y’echio, na ekero okoruegwa okwo kwairirwe ase omokuani nere akorente ase egesasimero.
english: Bring the grain offering made of these things to the LORD; present it to the priest, who shall take it to the altar.

ekegusii: Bring the Levites to the front of the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole Israelite community.
english: Osangererie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli na orente Abalawi agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano.

ekegusii: Inwe renta ensemo ya ikomi eng’ikeranu ase ekungo y’enyomba yane, erinde endagera ebe ase enyomba yane. Ase enchera eyio inwe monteeme gose tinkobaigorera ebibao bia igoro mbaumorere ogosesenigwa okonge mono gotari korengeka. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteba.
english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house. Test me in this," says the LORD Almighty, "and see if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that you will not have room enough for it.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete ase ense ya Tema, abwo bare nerang’o, bae amache, na abwo bagotama, bae endagera.
english: bring water for the thirsty; you who live in Tema, bring food for the fugitives.

ekegusii: bring with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil.
english: orue amo neeri eria obosie obonuke ebimunu bitano na ekemo, bwochoganirie namaguta ebituba bibere,

ekegusii: Bring your fellow Levites from your ancestral tribe to join you and assist you when you and your sons minister before the Tent of the Testimony.
english: Renta Abalawi bamino, egesaku gia iso, barabwo bakore emeremo aroro amo naye. Abwo bagokorere aye amo nabamura bao, ekero mogokora emeremo agwo bosio bw’Eema eria ere noborori.

ekegusii: Abaminto, bwatia ababani baria bakwanete ase erieta ri’Omonene, babe ekiorokererio gi’okobogoria obokong’u, na eki’oboremereria.
english: Brothers, as an example of patience in the face of suffering, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

ekegusii: Gaki baminto, chora abanto batano na babere korwa ase egati yaino, abamanyekanete ng’a nabaya, baichire n’Omoika na obong’aini, erinde tobabeke ase emeremo eye.
english: Brothers, choose seven men from among you who are known to be full of the Spirit and wisdom. We will turn this responsibility over to them

ekegusii: Abaminto, timong’achana. Oyokong’acha oyomwabo, gose komogambia nigo akong’acha amachiko na koyagambia, korende onye gokogambia amachiko, rirorio tori omokori amachiko, korende omogambia amachiko.
english: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. When you judge the law, you are not keeping it, but sitting in judgment on it.

ekegusii: Kera omonto, baminto, buna arenge ekero arangeretigwe, tiga aikaranse boigo ase Nyasae.
english: Brothers, each man, as responsible to God, should remain in the situation God called him to.

ekegusii: Na inche, baminto, tinare konyara gokwana nainwe buna nabanto bare n’Omoika, korende buna abanto b’engencho ya kare, buna abana ebing’werere ase Kristo.
english: Brothers, I could not address you as spiritual but as worldly-- mere infants in Christ.

ekegusii: Abaminto, tinyekageti inche omonyene ng’a naikire koyabwata; korende ninkore egento ekemo gioka: kweba ayare nyuma, ndambaarie ayare bosio.
english: Brothers, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead,

ekegusii: Abaminto, nababoririe, moremererie ring’ana eri ri’ogosorora, ekiagera nabarikeire ase amang’ana amake.
english: Brothers, I urge you to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have written you only a short letter.

ekegusii: Korende baminto, onye inche ngendererete nonya mbono koraria amang’ana ’okwaroka, nase ki rende nkona‐gochandwa? Igo ekegocha ki’omosalaba kiarusigwe.
english: Brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.

ekegusii: Abaminto, onye omonto obuirwe nokomocha konde, inwe abamore ab’Omoika nebagwenerete koirania omonto oyio ase omoika bw’obwororo. Erigererie aye omonyene, tobaisa goteemwa.
english: Brothers, if someone is caught in a sin, you who are spiritual should restore him gently. But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.

ekegusii: Abaminto, ngokwana nde buna engencho ya mwanyabanto ere. Ekero okoriera kw’omwando bw’omonto kogoikerana, onde tari oranyare gokoonchora gose komenta ring’ana.
english: Brothers, let me take an example from everyday life. Just as no one can set aside or add to a human covenant that has been duly established, so it is in this case.

ekegusii: Baminto okogania gw’enkoro yane na ogosaba kwane ase Nyasae ase engencho y’Abaisraeli nakwo oko, ng’a batoorigwe.
english: Brothers, my heart's desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is that they may be saved.

ekegusii: Baminto, motosabere!
english: Brothers, pray for us.

ekegusii: Baminto, timoba buna abana abake ase ebirengererio biaino; ase obobe mobe abana ebing’werere, korende ase okomanya kwaino mobe abanto abanene.
english: Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be adults.

ekegusii: Naki baminto, rengereria nabanto b’engencho ki more aba Nyasae arangeirie; tari abange asemore bare nobong’aini bwa mwanyabanto, tari abange bare ne chinguru, tari abange baiboretwe nobonene.
english: Brothers, think of what you were when you were called. Not many of you were wise by human standards; not many were influential; not many were of noble birth.

ekegusii: Korende baminto, titorigeti ng’a timomanya amang’ana igoro y’abwo bararire, mobaise goichanigwa buna abande abatari nogosemeria.
english: Brothers, we do not want you to be ignorant about those who fall asleep, or to grieve like the rest of men, who have no hope.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakarenta ebirarero, ne chisani, na ebikorero biroisirie korwa ase amaroba. Boigo bakarenta engano, na esairi, na obosie, na ebigara bisambire, ne ching’ende ao ao,
english: brought bedding and bowls and articles of pottery. They also brought wheat and barley, flour and roasted grain, beans and lentils,

ekegusii: Erio abanto bamenyete ime yao mbaiyerigwe inse, babe bagokwana korwa riroba inse, na amang’ana abo naigweke korwa ase orotu ime ng’ora ng’ora, ee, amariogi abo narwe inse ye riroba buna eriogi ri’ekerecha, nigo barabe bakomonya korwa ase orotu ime.
english: Brought low, you will speak from the ground; your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will come ghostlike from the earth; out of the dust your speech will whisper.

ekegusii: Ase ayio agacha emechie ase abana baino baramenye na ameri ase ching’ondi chiaino, erio mokore buna mwarire chiira chiaino.”
english: Build cities for your women and children, and pens for your flocks, but do what you have promised."

ekegusii: Ense eyio Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, moyiate ase chinsemo isato, na moroisie chinchera chikogenda ase emechie eyio etato, erio omonto karaite oyonde mosiabano, abe ogotamera oyomo bw’emechie eyio.
english: Build roads to them and divide into three parts the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, so that anyone who kills a man may flee there.

ekegusii: Egesasimero keria ki’Omonene, Nyasae oino, mokeagachere amagena atabaachiri; na igoro yaye momoruere ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa,
english: Build the altar of the LORD your God with fieldstones and offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo moaagachere Omonene, Nyasae oino, egesasimero ki’amagena. Timobaisa gokorera emeremo na gekorero kende gionsi gi’ekioma.
english: Build there an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. Do not use any iron tool upon them.

ekegusii: mwaagachirwe igoro y’oboroso bw’abatomwa na ababani, na Kristo Yeso omonyene nere rigena rinene ri’ekoona.
english: built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus himself as the chief cornerstone.

ekegusii: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
english: na Buku omomura oye, na Usi omomura oye, na Seraya omomura oye,

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Dani, Buki, mosinto o Yogili;
english: Bukki son of Jogli, the leader from the tribe of Dan;

ekegusii: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
english: Buni, na Asigadi, na Bebai;

ekegusii: ogosambwa ase ogosambwa, na eriote ase eriote, naende ogosionorwa ase ogosionorwa.
english: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.

ekegusii: Mosambe emegati ebekire ememera ebe okoruegwa gw’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, mochike na koraria igoro y’okoruegwa kwaino kw’ogwancha, ekiagera ayio naro inwe Abaisraeli mwanchete gokora.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: Burn leavened bread as a thank offering and brag about your freewill offerings-- boast about them, you Israelites, for this is what you love to do," declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Inwe amatombe a Yerusalemu, tera amo namariogi amanene, ekiagera Omonene oremirie abanto baye, obooririe Yerusalemu.
english: Burst into songs of joy together, you ruins of Jerusalem, for the LORD has comforted his people, he has redeemed Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi babise ime ase amaroba; obwateranie bokong’u amasio abo ime y’ense inse.
english: Bury them all in the dust together; shroud their faces in the grave.

ekegusii: Abanto konya bakure nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na inye, na amagana atano na abere (14,700). Baria bakwete ase ogosaria gwa Kora tibarenge ase omobaro oyo.
english: But 14,700 people died from the plague, in addition to those who had died because of Korah.

ekegusii: Korende omonto oyomo o Nyasae agacha asare, akamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, tobaisa gotiga Abaisraeli, Abaefraimu aba, bagende amo naye, ekiagera Omonene tari amo nabarabwo.
english: But a man of God came to him and said, "O king, these troops from Israel must not march with you, for the LORD is not with Israel-- not with any of the people of Ephraim.

ekegusii: Omonto ogotomana nomokungu onde bwensi, oyio tabwati chisemi; oyo ogokora ayio nigo agwesaria ere omonyene.
english: But a man who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.

ekegusii: korende oyonyuomire nigo akorengereria amang’ana ’ense eye, buna aragwenere mokaye;
english: But a married man is concerned about the affairs of this world-- how he can please his wife--

ekegusii: Korende Omofarisai oyomo ore korokwa Gamalieli, oyomo bw’ekegambero, omworokia bw’amachiko, omonto osikire nabanto bonsi, agachika ng’a abanto aba babekwe isiko ake.
english: But a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, who was honored by all the people, stood up in the Sanhedrin and ordered that the men be put outside for a little while.

ekegusii: Omokungu oyomo agacha, oyorenge omoboraka na omotaka, akabeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai, rigori ri’ekeng’ese ki’ebesa eyemo.
english: But a poor widow came and put in two very small copper coins, worth only a fraction of a penny.

ekegusii: Odedi, omobani bw’Omonene, nao arenge. Ere akagenda korotota abarwani b’esegi, baria bachete Samaria, akabatebia, “Rora Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, nigo abete nendamwamu ase Abayuda, akababeka ase amaboko aino, korende inwe mwabaitire more nekeririanda, ekio kiamanyekanire igoro.
english: But a prophet of the LORD named Oded was there, and he went out to meet the army when it returned to Samaria. He said to them, "Because the LORD, the God of your fathers, was angry with Judah, he gave them into your hand. But you have slaughtered them in a rage that reaches to heaven.

ekegusii: Korende omobani oraenene, na gokwana ase erieta riane aya ntamochigeti akwane, gose oyio orakwane ase amarieta e chinyasae ching’ao, omobani oyio nigo araitwe akwe.
english: But a prophet who presumes to speak in my name anything I have not commanded him to say, or a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods, must be put to death."

ekegusii: Korende Omosamaria oyomo, kagoeta, agacha aase arenge; ere agachia komorora, akamororera amabera.
english: But a Samaritan, as he traveled, came where the man was; and when he saw him, he took pity on him.

ekegusii: Omogeni omenyete asemore, gose omonto orikire tibayeria Epasaka eyio.
english: but a temporary resident and a hired worker may not eat of it.

ekegusii: Onye omoriri okonyara koba omong’aini, rirorio emori y’etigere y’orosana nenyare koiborwa ebe omonto.
english: But a witless man can no more become wise than a wild donkey's colt can be born a man.

ekegusii: Korende rituko erimo omosae oyomo akabarora, agatebia Abisalomu amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio Yonathani na Ahimasi bakagenda ase enka y’omonto gete aaria Bahurimu. Omonto oyio nabwate engoro y’amache ase omochie oye, nabarabwo bakebisa imeo,
english: But a young man saw them and told Absalom. So the two of them left quickly and went to the house of a man in Bahurim. He had a well in his courtyard, and they climbed down into it.

ekegusii: Haroni amo nabamura b’ororeria rwaye bakaba bakorua ebing’wanso agwo ase egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na gosambera ubani ase egesasimero ki’ogosambera ubani. Bagakora emeremo yonsi ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono, naende bagakora ayaganetigwe ase okobwatania Abaisraeli na Nyasae, koreng’ana namang’ana onsi Musa, omosomba o Nyasae, achigete.
english: But Aaron and his descendants were the ones who presented offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense in connection with all that was done in the Most Holy Place, making atonement for Israel, in accordance with all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

ekegusii: Abeli nere akarenta chimanwa chintangi chinoru korwa ase riicho riaye. Na Omonene aganchera ekeegwa ki’Abeli,
english: But Abel brought fat portions from some of the firstborn of his flock. The LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering,

ekegusii: Korende Abiatari bweka ase basinto b’Ahimeleki bw’Ahitubu, nere agatooreka, agatama gochia ase Daudi.
english: But Abiathar, a son of Ahimelech son of Ahitub, escaped and fled to join David.

ekegusii: Abiya akanyora chinguru chinyinge, akanyuoma abakungu ikomi na bane; akaiborerwa abana abamura emerongo ebere na babere, na abaiseke ikomi na batano nomo.
english: But Abijah grew in strength. He married fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

ekegusii: Abimeleki akamotebia, “Inche timanyeti ning’o okorete ring’ana erio, gose tikwana gontebia; nonya nokoigwa, tinana koyaigwa otatiga rero rioka.”
english: But Abimelech said, "I don't know who has done this. You did not tell me, and I heard about it only today."

ekegusii: Korende Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, akamotooria, agaita Omofilisti oria. Erio abanto ba Daudi bagakania Daudi na gotiana ng’a, “Aye bono togosoka na kogenda ase esegi amo naintwe; aye nigo ore etaya y’Abaisraeli, toyerimia.”
english: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David's rescue; he struck the Philistine down and killed him. Then David's men swore to him, saying, "Never again will you go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel will not be extinguished."

ekegusii: Na ase okobokigwa kw’abakure timwana gosoma eri mwatebetigwe na Nyasae:
english: But about the resurrection of the dead-- have you not read what God said to you,

ekegusii: Korende igoro y’Omwana nigo agoteba, “Nyasae, ekerogo kiao ki’obogambi nkegenderere kobao kare na kare, na enyimbo y’okobua y’oboruoti bwao nigo ere ey’oboronge.
english: But about the Son he says, "Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever, and righteousness will be the scepter of your kingdom.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, nintome abasomba baane ankio, ase engaki buna eye, bariga‐rigie nyomba mwao, ne chinyomba chi’abasomba bao, erio baire kera egento ekerabagokie.”
english: But about this time tomorrow I am going to send my officials to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will seize everything you value and carry it away.'"

ekegusii: Korende Aburamu agatebia omoruoti o Sodomu, “Naimokirie okoboko kwane na gotiana ase Omonene Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, oyotongete igoro na ense,
english: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I have raised my hand to the LORD, God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth, and have taken an oath

ekegusii: Aburamu akamoboria, “Inee! Omonene Nyasae, naki ndakore imanye ng’a nebe omwando one?”
english: But Abram said, "O Sovereign LORD, how can I know that I will gain possession of it?"

ekegusii: Aburamu akamoboria, “Inee! Omonene Nyasae, ninki orang’e? Naki nigo ngendererete gochia gokwa ntari na mwana, na oyorache koira omwando o bwone n’Eliezeri, oyo Omodamesiki.”
english: But Abram said, "O Sovereign LORD, what can you give me since I remain childless and the one who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?"

ekegusii: But Absalom said, "Summon also Hushai the Arkite, so we can hear what he has to say."
english: Erio Abisalomu akabora, “Rangeria Husai Omoariki, toigwe nere, buna agototebia.”

ekegusii: Abisalomu agasorora omoruoti mono goika ere akamwanchera Amunoni amo nabamura bande bonsi baye bagende nere.
english: But Absalom urged him, so he sent with him Amnon and the rest of the king's sons.

ekegusii: korende ase kera egesaku omonto omoirogete na gokora oboronge nigo agwancherwa nere.
english: but accepts men from every nation who fear him and do what is right.

ekegusii: Adonia akoboa Sulemani mono, akaimoka, akagenda kobwata emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero.
english: But Adonijah, in fear of Solomon, went and took hold of the horns of the altar.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Ahabu akure, omoruoti bw’Abamoabu akaanga koigwera omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: But after Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.

ekegusii: Korende ekero arenge orengereretie aya, rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamochiera ase chindoto akamotebia. “Aye Yusufu, omwana o Daudi, toiroka koira Mariamu abe mokao, ekiagera oborito obwo bwatongirwe inda yaye nobw’Omoika Omochenu.
english: But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, "Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife, because what is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Korende nyuma y’okoboka kwane nimbatang’anere kogenda Galili.”
english: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee."

ekegusii: Korende nyuma y’okoboka kwane, nimbatang’anere kogenda Galili.”
english: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee."

ekegusii: Na nyuma y’ayio, ekero nabarusirie ase ense eyio, nimbarorere amabera naende, mbairanie naende kera omonto ase omwando oye, na ase ense yaye.
english: But after I uproot them, I will again have compassion and will bring each of them back to his own inheritance and his own country.

ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa bamoetananire ase chinsemo chionsi, agatenena, agasoa omochie ime, ne rituko ria kabere riaye agasoka, akagenda Deribe amo na Barnaba.
english: But after the disciples had gathered around him, he got up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas left for Derbe.

ekegusii: Korende nyuma y’amatuko atato na ekeng’ese omoika bw’obogima korwa ase Nyasae okabasoa, bagatenena namagoro abo, na obwoba bogasoa abanto baria babaroche.
english: But after the three and a half days a breath of life from God entered them, and they stood on their feet, and terror struck those who saw them.

ekegusii: Ekero bayeirireo, Omonene akarenta obotantanu obonene ase abanto b’omochie oria, agaaka abanto bonsi, abanene na abake, ase okobarentera amagumba.
english: But after they had moved it, the LORD's hand was against that city, throwing it into a great panic. He afflicted the people of the city, both young and old, with an outbreak of tumors.

ekegusii: Ekero abete nokobua okonene, akaenena goika agesiria. Akaba omong’ainereria ase Omonene, Nyasae oye: agasoa ase Hekalu y’Omonene gosamba ubani igoro ase egesasimero ki’ogosambera ubani.
english: But after Uzziah became powerful, his pride led to his downfall. He was unfaithful to the LORD his God, and entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.

ekegusii: Korende nyuma y’ayio abanto nigo baonchorete ebirengererio biabo, bakairania abasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, abwo konya basiboirwe, na bakababetereria koba abasomba.
english: But afterward they changed their minds and took back the slaves they had freed and enslaved them again.

ekegusii: Korende Ahasi akairaneria, “Tinkonyara koboria, na tinkonyara komoteema Omonene.”
english: But Ahaz said, "I will not ask; I will not put the LORD to the test."

ekegusii: Korende ebitongwa binde bionsi bire moyo ime ase chinyancha, gose ase chindooche, bigotaara bire amaicho bitabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaba, na amagoocho, timobiria; ebio nokogechia asemore.
english: But all creatures in the seas or streams that do not have fins and scales-- whether among all the swarming things or among all the other living creatures in the water-- you are to detest.

ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli na Abayuda bonsi bakamwancha Daudi mono, ekiagera arenge kobatang’ana kogenda aande onsi ase baare kogenda na koirana.
english: But all Israel and Judah loved David, because he led them in their campaigns.

ekegusii: Korende inwe abamwabete abegenwa ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, kera oyomo oino moyo are goika rero iga.
english: but all of you who held fast to the LORD your God are still alive today.

ekegusii: Korende ebinde bionsi ase ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaba na amagoro ane, ebio mbibe okogechia asemore.”
english: But all other winged creatures that have four legs you are to detest.

ekegusii: Korende abasaria mbasirigwe bonsi pi, na ororeria rw’abakori amabe tirokogenderera.
english: But all sinners will be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.

ekegusii: Korende abanto bande ababe abatagwenerete ase abwo bagendete na Daudi bakabora, “Ekiagera abanto aba tibagendete amo naintwe, titokobaa gento kende gionsi ase ebi twasakoire, otatiga kera omonto araegwe mokaye na abana baye, aire bwoye.”
english: But all the evil men and troublemakers among David's followers said, "Because they did not go out with us, we will not share with them the plunder we recovered. However, each man may take his wife and children and go."

ekegusii: Korende abatang’ani baria bakabairaneria. “Intwe ntwabarierete eira na gotiana ase erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ase igo titokonyara kobakorera bobe.
english: but all the leaders answered, "We have given them our oath by the LORD, the God of Israel, and we cannot touch them now.

ekegusii: Tokaira chitugo chionsi na gosakora ebinto biarenge ase emechie eyio bikaba ebiaito.
english: But all the livestock and the plunder from their cities we carried off for ourselves.

ekegusii: Korende amang’ana ayio onsi tang’isanegeti ekero nkorora Moredekai, Omoyahudi oria, oikaransete ase egeita ki’omoruoti.”
english: But all this gives me no satisfaction as long as I see that Jew Mordecai sitting at the king's gate."

ekegusii: Abasani baye bonsi na abakungu abamotunyanete korwa Galili, bagatenenera are, bakarora ayio.
english: But all those who knew him, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

ekegusii: korende nase engencho yaito boigo. Nonya nintwe ntoche kobarerwa boigo, intwe abatwamwegenire ere oyomobogetie Yeso, Omonene oito, korwwa ase abakure,
english: but also for us, to whom God will credit righteousness-- for us who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo nkoboria: Inee! Ninche bakogechia? Tibari gwekorera barabwo abanyene amabe na konyora obosooku?
english: But am I the one they are provoking? declares the LORD. Are they not rather harming themselves, to their own shame?

ekegusii: Korende ase Abaisraeli, nonya nesese tegokogera omonto gose etugo. Erio momanye ng’a Omonene okorire ogwatananeka ase Abamisiri na Abaisraeli.
english: But among the Israelites not a dog will bark at any man or animal.' Then you will know that the LORD makes a distinction between Egypt and Israel.

ekegusii: Korende obotomani na cubi yonsi, gose obwegimeria, tibiatorwa ase egati yaino nonya ng’ake, buna egwenerete abachenu.
english: But among you there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed, because these are improper for God's holy people.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero Saulo aikaransete nyomba mwaye, obwate ritimo ase okoboko kwaye, na Daudi nigo agendererete kobugia obokano, omoika omobe okorwa ase Nyasae ogaika igoro ase Saulo,
english: But an evil spirit from the LORD came upon Saul as he was sitting in his house with his spear in his hand. While David was playing the harp,

ekegusii: Korende ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, ekio amanyinga aye ararentwe ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ime y’Aase Aachenu tigekoriegwa, nigo kerasambwe nomorero.
english: But any sin offering whose blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place must not be eaten; it must be burned.

ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebichenegete bibwate chimbaba nabio moranyare kobiria.
english: But any winged creature that is clean you may eat.

ekegusii: Chinde chionsi chitabwati chingondo chinga buna chimbaba, na amagoocho, timochiria; echio nchibe echitachenegeti asemore.
english: But anything that does not have fins and scales you may not eat; for you it is unclean.

ekegusii: “Ekero kia mogoroba, esibie omobere namache, na ekero bwairiire kegima asoe ase egetwori.
english: But as evening approaches he is to wash himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.

ekegusii: Korende inche naichoirwe ne chinguru chi’Omoika bw’Omonene, na oboronge, na oboremu, erinde ntebie abanto ba Yakobo ogosaria kwabo, na Abaisraeli ebibe biabo.
english: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the LORD, and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression, to Israel his sin.

ekegusii: Korende inche omonyene nindigererie Omonene; ninganye inde nogosemeria ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane; Nyasae one nanyigwe.
english: But as for me, I watch in hope for the LORD, I wait for God my Savior; my God will hear me.

ekegusii: Korende inche nimbe nogosemeria botambe, na nimbe nkona‐kogotogia mono goetania.
english: But as for me, I will always have hope; I will praise you more and more.

ekegusii: Korende asende inche, nigo ere buya mono kobeera ang’e na Nyasae. Omonene Nyasae obeire obotamero bwane, ninyare koraria emeremo yaye yonsi.
english: But as for me, it is good to be near God. I have made the Sovereign LORD my refuge; I will tell of all your deeds.

ekegusii: But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.
english: Amagoro aane konya abeire ang’e kogochwa, konya nabeire ang’e gotererigwa,

ekegusii: Rehoboamu agatigwa okogambera Abaisraeli baria bamenyete ase emechie y’Abayuda yoka.
english: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.

ekegusii: Rehoboamu agatigwa okogambera Abaisraeli baria bamenyete ase emechie y’Abayuda boka.
english: But as for the Israelites who were living in the towns of Judah, Rehoboam still ruled over them.

ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo chinkoro chiabo chikobwatia emegwekano y’obosooku bagosasima, na okogechia, nimbaakane ogokora kwabo kobairanere.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae agoteba.
english: But as for those whose hearts are devoted to their vile images and detestable idols, I will bring down on their own heads what they have done, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Korende inwe mobe abaremu, timokwa emioyo; imonyore eng’eria y’emeremo yaino.”
english: But as for you, be strong and do not give up, for your work will be rewarded."

ekegusii: Korende aye, ogenderere ase ayakworokereretigwe na koyaenekia, gokomanya ng’a nkorwa ase ng’o kweorokereretie.
english: But as for you, continue in what you have learned and have become convinced of, because you know those from whom you learned it,

ekegusii: Korende inwe Omonene obarusirie ase eriko ri’ebioma rigosamba, nario Misiri, erinde mobe abanto baye ere omonyene buna more goika rero iga.
english: But as for you, the LORD took you and brought you out of the iron-smelting furnace, out of Egypt, to be the people of his inheritance, as you now are.

ekegusii: Korende inwe onchoka, mogende gochia ase erooro, gochia ase enchera ekogenda ase omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri.
english: But as for you, turn around and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea."

ekegusii: Korende ekero agotigana nabarabwo agateba, “Ning’irane asemore naende, Nyasae karanche.” Akamanora korwa Efeso, akagenda nemeeri.
english: But as he left, he promised, "I will come back if it is God's will." Then he set sail from Ephesus.

ekegusii: Korende nabatebirie ng’a mwandorire, ko timonyegeneti.
english: But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.

ekegusii: Korende ekero nachaka gokuura na goaka eriogi ontigera eanga yaye koboko kwane, otama gochia isiko.”
english: But as soon as I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."

ekegusii: Ekero Yeremia akoorete gokwana amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene amochigete akwane ase abanto bonsi, erio abakuani, na ababani, na abanto bonsi bakamobwata, bagateba, “Aye goika oitwe okwe!”
english: But as soon as Jeremiah finished telling all the people everything the LORD had commanded him to say, the priests, the prophets and all the people seized him and said, "You must die!

ekegusii: Korende buna Nyasae are omwegenwa, ring’ana riaito asemore tiriarenge “Ee” na “Taibo.”
english: But as surely as God is faithful, our message to you is not "Yes" and "No."

ekegusii: Korende Asaeli akaanga kogobera. Ase igo Abineri akamobeta enda nesimisi y’orotanga rwe ritimo, na rirorio rigasokera omogongo oye. Asaeli agaaka inse, agakwera agwo aase arenge, Abanto bonsi abachete agwo ase Asaeli akwerete, bagatenenao.
english: But Asahel refused to give up the pursuit; so Abner thrust the butt of his spear into Asahel's stomach, and the spear came out through his back. He fell there and died on the spot. And every man stopped when he came to the place where Asahel had fallen and died.

ekegusii: Korende rituko ria kabere mambia, Nyasae agachika rikonde rikaria omobono oria, erinde ogasusana.
english: But at dawn the next day God provided a worm, which chewed the vine so that it withered.

ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire emiaka emerongo etano batige batimoke korwa ase emeremo eria.
english: but at the age of fifty, they must retire from their regular service and work no longer.

ekegusii: ekero twairanete gochia seito, gotwaikire ase twararete botuko, togachia gosansora chigunia chiaito, tokanyora kera omonto chibesa chiaye nao chire igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime, chibesa chionsi pi. Bono chibesa echi chionsi ntwachirentana, naa tochibwate amo naintwe.
english: But at the place where we stopped for the night we opened our sacks and each of us found his silver-- the exact weight-- in the mouth of his sack. So we have brought it back with us.

ekegusii: Ekero gwatogonyerete amache ayio, nigo atamete, na ekero aigwete eriogi riao ri’okogukura, nigo aayererete agatama.
english: But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;

ekegusii: Korende aye, bweatanane korwa ase amaborio ’oboriri, ne chinderia chie chisokoro, na eriomana, na okoamererania igoro y’amachiko, ekiagera tibigokonya kende, naende tibiri nengencho.
english: But avoid foolish controversies and genealogies and arguments and quarrels about the law, because these are unprofitable and useless.

ekegusii: Korende Baalamu akairaneria abasomba baria ba Balaki, akabatebia, “Nonya Balaki arenge kong’a enyomba yaye eichire chifeta ne chitahabu, tintageti gosaria na kwanga koigwera amang’ana Omonene Nyasae anchikire, na gokora amang’ana ande ase ogwancha kwane, abe amake gose amanene.
english: But Balaam answered them, "Even if Balak gave me his palace filled with silver and gold, I could not do anything great or small to go beyond the command of the LORD my God.

ekegusii: Baraki akabwatia chigari na omoganda bw’abarwani goika Haroseti, omochie bw’ebisaku, na omoganda bwonsi bw’abarwani o Sisera ogaitwa. Monto onde tatigarete ore moyo, nonya noyomo.
english: But Barak pursued the chariots and army as far as Harosheth Haggoyim. All the troops of Sisera fell by the sword; not a man was left.

ekegusii: Korende Barnaba akamobwata okoboko, akamoira ase abatomwa, akabatebereria buna Saulo aroche Omonene nchera, naende ng’a Omonene nakwanete nere, na buna arandetie noboremu ase Damesiki ase erieta ria Yeso.
english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles. He told them how Saul on his journey had seen the Lord and that the Lord had spoken to him, and how in Damascus he had preached fearlessly in the name of Jesus.

ekegusii: Korende Baruku, mosinto o Neria, nere ogoseegetire obe mamincha yaito na gotobeka ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, erinde batoite gose batoire Babeli ase obosomba.”
english: But Baruch son of Neriah is inciting you against us to hand us over to the Babylonians, so they may kill us or carry us into exile to Babylon."

ekegusii: Korende Barisilai akamoiraneria, “Emiaka yane nerenga etigarete ngochia koba moyo, ng’a ngende amo naye Yerusalemu komenyao?
english: But Barzillai answered the king, "How many more years will I live, that I should go up to Jerusalem with the king?

ekegusii: Ase ayio manya bono ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyorabatang’ane inwe, nigo are buna omorero ogosamba. Ere nasirie abanto baria na kobabeka inse yaino, erio nario moranyare kobaseria na kobaita bwango ara rimo rioka, buna abarierete inwe eira.
english: But be assured today that the LORD your God is the one who goes across ahead of you like a devouring fire. He will destroy them; he will subdue them before you. And you will drive them out and annihilate them quickly, as the LORD has promised you.

ekegusii: Korende inwe mobe nomogoko na omochengo goika kare na kare ase engencho y’ayio ndatonge; rora, nintonge Yerusalemu obe oyo bw’omochengo, na abanto baye babe nomogoko.
english: But be glad and rejoice forever in what I will create, for I will create Jerusalem to be a delight and its people a joy.

ekegusii: Moiroke Omonene bweka, momokorere ase obwegenwa bwe chinkoro chiaino chionsi, mobe mokoinyora aya onsi amanene abakoreire.
english: But be sure to fear the LORD and serve him faithfully with all your heart; consider what great things he has done for you.

ekegusii: Mwerende timobaisa koria amanyinga, ekiagera obomoyo nigo bore ase amanyinga ime, timoria, obomoyo amo nenyama.
english: But be sure you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the meat.

ekegusii: Morende mono na koigwera amachiko aya Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete; mwanche Omonene, Nyasae oino, na motaare ase chinchera chiaye chionsi. Moigwere amachiko aye, mobe abegenwa asare, na momokorere ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi.”
english: But be very careful to keep the commandment and the law that Moses the servant of the LORD gave you: to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, to obey his commands, to hold fast to him and to serve him with all your heart and all your soul."

ekegusii: Korende ekiagera gwakorire ayio kwagerire ababisa b’Omonene bamochaye, omwana oria oraiborwe goika akwe.”
english: But because by doing this you have made the enemies of the LORD show utter contempt, the son born to you will die."

ekegusii: korende ere, ekiagera agendererete kare na kare, nare nobokuani botari koonchoka.
english: but because Jesus lives forever, he has a permanent priesthood.

ekegusii: Korende Kalebu, omosomba one, ekiagera abwate omoika ore nogwatananekana korwa ase oyo bwa baria bande, naende obeire okonyigwera buya ase amang’ana onsi, nimoire ase ense eria agendete koroota naende ning’ee abanto b’ororeria rwaye ense eria ebe eyabo.
english: But because my servant Caleb has a different spirit and follows me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he went to, and his descendants will inherit it.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae, oyore nobonge bw’amabera, ase obwanchani bwaye obonene atwanchete,
english: But because of his great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,

ekegusii: “Korende Omonene akaba nendamwamu asende ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino, tanchete koigwa okoboria kwane, agantebia: Ayio aisanire. Tobaisa gokwana nainche gento kende igoro ye ring’ana erio.
english: But because of you the LORD was angry with me and would not listen to me. "That is enough," the LORD said. "Do not speak to me anymore about this matter.

ekegusii: Korende ase obokong’u bwao na ankoro yao etari nokoonchoka, kwegacheire endamwamu ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu, ekero ekina kia boronge kia Nyasae kerache koorokigwa,
english: But because of your stubbornness and your unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of God's wrath, when his righteous judgment will be revealed.

ekegusii: Korende ekiagera chisokoro chiaito chiagerete Nyasae o igoro akaba nendamwamu, ere akabeka abanto baria ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro Omokalidayo, omoruoti o Babeli, oria osaretie enyomba eye na akaira abanto Babeli.
english: But because our fathers angered the God of heaven, he handed them over to Nebuchadnezzar the Chaldean, king of Babylon, who destroyed this temple and deported the people to Babylon.

ekegusii: Ekiagera abakuani abwo batenenete ase amasio ’abanto gokorera emegwekano yabo bagosasima, na igo bakaba ekegocha ase Abaisraeli, bakagera barabwo bagakora ebibe, ase ayio inche Omonene Nyasae natianire ng’a egesusuro ki’ogosaria kwabo goika kebairanere.
english: But because they served them in the presence of their idols and made the house of Israel fall into sin, therefore I have sworn with uplifted hand that they must bear the consequences of their sin, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero omwana oria ataramanya kwanga amabe, na gochora amaya, ense y’abaruoti abwo babere bagokogechia nebe yatigirwe bosa.
english: But before the boy knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right, the land of the two kings you dread will be laid waste.

ekegusii: Korende ekero chinyama chiarenge ase emenwa yabo bagendererete gochitakuna, naende konya bataraisanekia obogworu bwabo.
english: But before they turned from the food they craved, even while it was still in their mouths,

ekegusii: Korende ase oyo otaraiborwa, oyio otararora ogokora okobe kore aiga inse y’erioba, nigo ere buya asare kobua ase abwo bonsi bare moyo na abakure.
english: But better than both is he who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil that is done under the sun.

ekegusii: Korende amaiso aino nasesenirie, ekiagera nkorora are, na amato aino, ekiagera nkoigwa are.
english: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.

ekegusii: Genda mondetere oyio omino omoke, erio nario ndamanye ng’a timori chirooti, korende nabanto abaronge. Erio nimbairanerie oyomino, na inwe inamonyore ribaga mobe mokoonchoreria ase ense eye.”
english: But bring your youngest brother to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.'"

ekegusii: Korende chinyama chi’eeri eyio, ne risankwa, na eubi yonsi y’enda obisambere isiko y’egetwori. Ekio nekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe.
english: But burn the bull's flesh and its hide and its offal outside the camp. It is a sin offering.

ekegusii: Naki intwe ase Omoika ntoganyete oboronge boria tosemeretie ase enchera y’okwegena.
english: But by faith we eagerly await through the Spirit the righteousness for which we hope.

ekegusii: Korende ase obuya bwa Nyasae nabeire buna inde; na obuya bwaye bore asende tibwarenge bosa. Korende kobua mono nakorire emeremo goetania bonsi, gose tari inche, korende obuya bwa Nyasae obore amo nainche.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect. No, I worked harder than all of them-- yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere na etato bw’okogamba kwa Yoashi omoruoti, abakuani tibaroisetie enyomba y’Omonene ase yatagogete.
english: But by the twenty-third year of King Joash the priests still had not repaired the temple.

ekegusii: Korende bono nekeene ng’a Kristo obokigwe korwa ase abakure buna ogotongorwa kw’abakure.
english: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

ekegusii: korende Kristo nigo are omwegenwa buna Omwana igoro ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Intwe nenyomba yaye gatorabwate bokong’u oboremu na ogwetogia kw’ogosemeria goika omoerio.
english: But Christ is faithful as a son over God's house. And we are his house, if we hold on to our courage and the hope of which we boast.

ekegusii: Tebereria Yoshua, omoremie na omobeke chinguru, ekiagera nere oraraae abanto aba, abaambokie ng’umbu, naende abaatananere ense eyio orarore.
english: But commission Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, for he will lead this people across and will cause them to inherit the land that you will see."

ekegusii: Korende ase Abaisraeli nigo agoteba, “Omobaso boira nigo nare kobaramborera amaboko aane abanto batari abaigweri korende abaamereria.”
english: But concerning Israel he says, "All day long I have held out my hands to a disobedient and obstinate people."

ekegusii: Korende Danieli akanacha ase ebirengererio biaye ng’a tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase okoria endagera buna eria omoruoti are koria, gose konywa edivai buna eria omoruoti are konywa. Ase ayio agasaba omoteneneri oria omonene amoe ribaga tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka.
english: But Daniel resolved not to defile himself with the royal food and wine, and he asked the chief official for permission not to defile himself this way.

ekegusii: Daudi agatiira gochia ase Egetunwa ki’Emezeituni igoro okona‐korera otubete omotwe oye, tabegete bikoroto; na abanto abarenge amo nere bagetuba emetwe yabo bakorera kobagotiira.
english: But David continued up the Mount of Olives, weeping as he went; his head was covered and he was barefoot. All the people with him covered their heads too and were weeping as they went up.

ekegusii: Korende Daudi tagendete ase egesasimero keria koboria Nyasae, ekiagera nigo oboete omoyio oria bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene.
english: But David could not go before it to inquire of God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the LORD.

ekegusii: Daudi agakania Abisai, akamotebia, “Tokomoita, naki ning’o oranyare korambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene amoite, na taegwa egesusuro?”
english: But David said to Abishai, "Don't destroy him! Who can lay a hand on the LORD's anointed and be guiltless?

ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Saulo, “Inche ninki ng’isaine na obogima bwane ninki boisaine, gose eamate ya tata inki eisaine ase egati y’Abaisraeli, erinde aye omoruoti obe tata biara?”
english: But David said to Saul, "Who am I, and what is my family or my father's clan in Israel, that I should become the king's son-in-law?"

ekegusii: Korende Daudi agatebia Saulo, “Inche, omosomba oo, nabeire nkorisia ching’ondi chia tata, na ekero kende gionsi endo gose edubu yare gocha koira eng’ondi korwa ase riicho,
english: But David said to Saul, "Your servant has been keeping his father's sheep. When a lion or a bear came and carried off a sheep from the flock,

ekegusii: Daudi akarengereria ase enkoro yaye, akabora, “Rituko erimo ning’itwe na Saulo. Egento kerabe ekiya mono asende nogotama korwa aiga na kogenda ase ense y’Abafilisti. Erio nario Saulo ararusie moyo, tana kondigia naende aa ase chingongo chi’Abaisraeli, na nintooreke korwa ase okoboko kwaye.”
english: But David thought to himself, "One of these days I will be destroyed by the hand of Saul. The best thing I can do is to escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will give up searching for me anywhere in Israel, and I will slip out of his hand."

ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria ase ogotiana, agateba, “Iso igo amanyete buya ng’a aye nonyanchete mono, na ororire ng’a tari buya akomanyie ring’ana erio, ekiagera nigo riragoichanie mono. Korende ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye ore moyo, ngetigarete egetambokero ekemo gioka egati yane na amakweri.”
english: But David took an oath and said, "Your father knows very well that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said to himself, 'Jonathan must not know this or he will be grieved.' Yet as surely as the LORD lives and as you live, there is only a step between me and death."

ekegusii: Korende engaki ase engaki Daudi nigo arenge gotiga Saulo ogenda Bethlehemu korisia ching’ondi chia ise.
english: but David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father's sheep at Bethlehem.

ekegusii: Korende abanto ba Daudi konya baitire abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin amagana atato, na emerongo etano nomo, abwo barenge amo n’Abineri.
english: But David's men had killed three hundred and sixty Benjamites who were with Abner.

ekegusii: Korende abanto ba Daudi bakamotebia, “Rora ekero tore aiga ase ense ya Yuda nigo tokwoboa. Inee! Naki erabe rende onye tokogenda Keila korwania abarwani b’Abafilisti esegi? Titokwoboa kobua?”
english: But David's men said to him, "Here in Judah we are afraid. How much more, then, if we go to Keilah against the Philistine forces!"

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, bono amatuko ngocha are, ndatome abaumori babaumore, erinde ebibekerero ebio bitigare bibe bosa, erio biatwe.
english: But days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will send men who pour from jars, and they will pour her out; they will empty her jars and smash her jugs.

ekegusii: Ching’iti chi’orosana nchimenyeo, ne chinyakweumia nchiichore ase chinyomba chireo, chisagero nchibe chimenyeteo, na amarengari nabe akona‐gotenga aroro.
english: But desert creatures will lie there, jackals will fill her houses; there the owls will dwell, and there the wild goats will leap about.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aane na emeroberio yane echikire, ayio naruete goetera ase abasomba baane ababani nigo yasoete ase chinkoro chie chisokoro chiaino. Barabwo nigo beitetie bagateba: Buna Omonene bw’Emeganda arengereretie gotokorera ase engencho ye chinchera chiaito na ogokora gwaito, naboigo atokoreire.”
english: But did not my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, overtake your forefathers? "Then they repented and said, 'The LORD Almighty has done to us what our ways and practices deserve, just as he determined to do.'"

ekegusii: but didn't find his body. They came and told us that they had seen a vision of angels, who said he was alive.
english: na ekero batanyorete omobere oye, bakairana, bakabora ng’a baorokeirwe nabamalaika ababatebetie ng’a moyo are.

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe timwaseria abakuani b’Omonene, abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni, na Abalawi, na mwebekire abakuani baino, buna abanto be chinse chinde bagokora? Bono omonto onde bwensi okorenta eeri ensae, gose chimingichi isano na ibere, gwatananwa na gochenwa, oyio nigo akoba omokuani bwe chinyasae chitari Nyasae bori.
english: But didn't you drive out the priests of the LORD, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and make priests of your own as the peoples of other lands do? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams may become a priest of what are not gods.

ekegusii: Timobairoka, korende moinyore buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorete Farao na abanto bonsi ba Misiri.
english: But do not be afraid of them; remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt.

ekegusii: Korende abanchani, timweba ring’ana eri, ng’a ase Omonene rituko erimo nigo rire buna emiaka elifu, na emiaka elifu buna rituko erimo.
english: But do not forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, enguba yaito, tobaisa kobaita! Abanto baane nigo barabaise kweba. Obaomboganie ase chinguru chiao, erio omanye kobasiria.
english: But do not kill them, O Lord our shield, or my people will forget. In your might make them wander about, and bring them down.

ekegusii: Erio Doegi Omoedomu, oyo oteneine amo nabasomba ba Saulo, akairaneria, akabora, “Narora mosinto o Yese okogenda ase Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, agwo Nobu.
english: But Doeg the Edomite, who was standing with Saul's officials, said, "I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelech son of Ahitub at Nob.

ekegusii: Korende inwe abande, timobaisa kobeera aroro, mobwatie ababisa baino, mobaumokere korwa nyuma, na kobaita. Timobatiga basoe emechie yabo, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, obabekire ase amaboko aino.”
english: But don't stop! Pursue your enemies, attack them from the rear and don't let them reach their cities, for the LORD your God has given them into your hand."

ekegusii: Korende omomalaika bw’Omonene akaigora ebisieri bi’echela botuko, akabasokia, agateba,
english: But during the night an angel of the Lord opened the doors of the jail and brought them out.

ekegusii: korende omwaka o gatano na kabere otige omogondo otimoke, toremwa. Ebirakine na kwama ase omogondo obitigere abataka, na ebi baratigarie bibe endagera ye ching’iti chi’orosana. Okore boigo nomogondo oo bw’emesabibu na oyo bw’emezeituni.
english: but during the seventh year let the land lie unplowed and unused. Then the poor among your people may get food from it, and the wild animals may eat what they leave. Do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.

ekegusii: korende kera oyomo aase aye; Kristo agatongora, naende ekero arachiche, abare abaye nababe moyo.
english: But each in his own turn: Christ, the firstfruits; then, when he comes, those who belong to him.

ekegusii: korende kera ekemo nigo kiabwate amasio ane, ne chimbaba inye.
english: but each of them had four faces and four wings.

ekegusii: Korende kera omonto nigo agoteemwa ekero akong’uswa na kong’ainwa nokogania kwaye omonyene.
english: but each one is tempted when, by his own evil desire, he is dragged away and enticed.

ekegusii: Rigia mono ebiegwa ebiya kobua. Naende nimborokie enchera ere engiya mono.
english: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.

ekegusii: Ebedi‐Meleki Omoetiopia, omosomba bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, akaigwa ng’a abagambi baria babekire Yeremia ime ase engoro eria. Ekero ekio omoruoti nigo aikaransete ase Egeita kia Benjamin.
english: But Ebed-Melech, a Cushite, an official in the royal palace, heard that they had put Jeremiah into the cistern. While the king was sitting in the Benjamin Gate,

ekegusii: Korende omoruoti o Edomu akamoiraneria, “Timobaisa goeta ase egati y’ense yane; moise goeta, nigo ndabarwanie esegi imbaite nemioro.”
english: But Edom answered: "You may not pass through here; if you try, we will march out and attack you with the sword."

ekegusii: “Ense ya Misiri nesarigwe ebe bosa, na Edomu nero nebe erooro ere bosa, ekiagera abanto b’aroro mbakorerete Abayuda amabe; nigo baiterete ase ense yabo amanyinga ’abanto batarenge na komocha.
english: But Egypt will be desolate, Edom a desert waste, because of violence done to the people of Judah, in whose land they shed innocent blood.

ekegusii: but Eli called him and said, "Samuel, my son." Samuel answered, "Here I am."
english: Eli akamorangeria, akabora, “Samweli, omwana one!” Nere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa!”

ekegusii: Erio Elihu akaba nendamwamu ase Ayubu, ekiagera ekorete omonyakeene kobua Nyasae. Elihu oyio nigo arenge mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, na oyo bw’eamate ya Ramu.
english: But Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, became very angry with Job for justifying himself rather than God.

ekegusii: Korende Elisha akamotebia, “Inee! Tinagenda amo naye ase omoika, ekero omonto oria aonchoka korwa ase egari yaye oumerana naye? Inee! Eye nero engaki y’ogwancha chibesa, ne chianga, na emegondo y’emezeituni na ey’emesabibu, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, na abasomba, abasacha na abakungu?
english: But Elisha said to him, "Was not my spirit with you when the man got down from his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to take money, or to accept clothes, olive groves, vineyards, flocks, herds, or menservants and maidservants?

ekegusii: Korende Elima, oria omorogi (okoonchorwa kw’erieta riaye nakwo oko) akaamererania nabarabwo, akarigia koonchora gavuna oria atige okwegena.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for that is what his name means) opposed them and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith.

ekegusii: Korende moremanie inwe ase inwe kera rituko, ekero gekorokwa ekia Rero, erinde ase, more onde takorwa koba omokong’u ase obong’ainereria bw’ebibe.
english: But encourage one another daily, as long as it is called Today, so that none of you may be hardened by sin's deceitfulness.

ekegusii: Abaefraimu abwo bagechetie Omonene goika ere akaba nendamwamu enene mono; ase ayio Omonene obo nabeke okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kobe igoro yabo; nabairanerie okogechia kwabo.
english: But Ephraim has bitterly provoked him to anger; his Lord will leave upon him the guilt of his bloodshed and will repay him for his contempt.

ekegusii: Nere Eri, omomura omotangi o Yuda, nigo arenge omobe ase obosio bw’Omonene; ase ayio Omonene akamoita.
english: But Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the LORD's sight; so the LORD put him to death.

ekegusii: na nkaba ngechete Esau na ngasaria ense yaye y’ebitunwa ekaba erooro, na omwando oye nkaa chisese chi’orosana chikamenyao.”
english: but Esau I have hated, and I have turned his mountains into a wasteland and left his inheritance to the desert jackals."

ekegusii: Esau akaminyoka gochia komorotota, akamoboania rigoti riaye, na komonyunyunta, barabwo bakarererana.
english: But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept.

ekegusii: Esau akamoiraneria, “Oyominto, echi mbwate nching’isaine. Echire echiao, kabe nachirochio.”
english: But Esau said, "I already have plenty, my brother. Keep what you have for yourself."

ekegusii: Esteri konya taramanyia abanto b’ense eria ng’a ngesaku ki are, gose noyo bw’enyomba ki. Moredekai nigo amosemetie igo, na Esteri akamoigwera buna konya abeire okomoigwera ekero akinetigwe nere.
english: But Esther had kept secret her family background and nationality just as Mordecai had told her to do, for she continued to follow Mordecai's instructions as she had done when he was bringing her up.

ekegusii: korende ekero chiachirire tichiarorekana ng’a nchiachiria, nkarora nabo chire buna chiare ritang’ani. Erio nkaboka.
english: But even after they ate them, no one could tell that they had done so; they looked just as ugly as before. Then I woke up.

ekegusii: Amo nayio, ekero enyama enoru etarayia, omosomba bw’omokuani nigo arenge gocha otebia omonto oria orenge korua ekeng’wanso, “Kae omokuani enyama achie gosamba, ekiagera tagwancha enyama enyiyeke; igo anchete enyama embese.”
english: But even before the fat was burned, the servant of the priest would come and say to the man who was sacrificing, "Give the priest some meat to roast; he won't accept boiled meat from you, but only raw."

ekegusii: Korende nonya tagochia gototooria korwa asore aye omoruoti, goika omanye ng’a intwe titogwancha gokorera chinyasae chiao, gose gosasima omogwekano bw’etahabu, oyio gwatenenetie.”
english: But even if he does not, we want you to know, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the image of gold you have set up."

ekegusii: Ee, kondaumorwe igoro y’ekeng’wanso na ogokora gw’okwegena kwaino, nagokire; ee, nagokire amo nainwe mwensi.
english: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service coming from your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.

ekegusii: Korende onye nintwe, gose omomalaika korwa igoro, tokobaranderia enchili ende eng’ao, otatiga eria twabaranderetie, aragererigwe.
english: But even if we or an angel from heaven should preach a gospel other than the one we preached to you, let him be eternally condemned!

ekegusii: Korende onye mogochandwa ase engencho y’oboronge, more negesio. Timoiroka okoirokia kwabo, gose timoichana.
english: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. "Do not fear what they fear; do not be frightened."

ekegusii: Korende Mikaeli, omomalaika omonene, ekero riomanete na Saitani na koamererania nere igoro y’omobere o Musa, tarenge nomoyo bw’okomosoera ase amang’ana amabe, korende akamotebia, “Omonene nagotogonyere.”
english: But even the archangel Michael, when he was disputing with the devil about the body of Moses, did not dare to bring a slanderous accusation against him, but said, "The Lord rebuke you!"

ekegusii: Korende gese twatigete gosamba ubani na koumora okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa ase Eting’ana ya Igoro, twabeire tokoremerwa kera egento, naende twabeire togosirigwa ase ogoitwa nemioro na enchara.”
english: But ever since we stopped burning incense to the Queen of Heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have had nothing and have been perishing by sword and famine."

ekegusii: korende kera omoika otakoorokia Yeso igo, oyio tori oyo o Nyasae. Oyio noro omoika bw’omobisa o Kristo; oyio mwaigure ng’a ngocha are, na bono oikire gocha ase ense ime.
english: but every spirit that does not acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and even now is already in the world.

ekegusii: Na kera oyomo oyokoigwa amang’ana aya aane, go tayakora, nagwekanigwe nomonto omoriri, oagachete mwaye ase amaroba;
english: But everyone who hears these words of mine and does not put them into practice is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.

ekegusii: Korende ere oyokobana, nigo agokwana ase abanto amang’ana ay’okobaagacha, na kobaremia, na kobabeka chinguru.
english: But everyone who prophesies speaks to men for their strengthening, encouragement and comfort.

ekegusii: Korende onsi ayaorokigwe nomobaso nigo are maiso marore, ekiagera kera egento ekere maiso marore nigo kere omobaso.
english: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible,

ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi akoreke ase obuya na ase omoroberio.
english: But everything should be done in a fitting and orderly way.

ekegusii: Korende abanto ababe nigo bare buna amagwa atugutire, atari gokunwa namaboko.
english: But evil men are all to be cast aside like thorns, which are not gathered with the hand.

ekegusii: Na egoora eria ere isiko ye Hekalu oyetige, toyerenga, ekiagera abanto b’ebisaku bayeeirwe, na barabwo nabatache omochie omochenu ase engaki y’emetienyi emerongo ene na ebere.
english: But exclude the outer court; do not measure it, because it has been given to the Gentiles. They will trample on the holy city for 42 months.

ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani nagwenerete konyora ogochandwa okonge, na kwangwa nekegori eke.
english: But first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

ekegusii: “Nonya nabo ninkworokie aya arikire ase Ebuku y’Ekeene. Onde tari oranyare gonkonya otatiga Mikaeli, omogambi oino,
english: but first I will tell you what is written in the Book of Truth. (No one supports me against them except Michael, your prince.

ekegusii: Ayerera, bwetoorie, ekiagera tingokora ing’ana rinde rionsi goika gwasoire omochie oria ime.” Ase ayio, omochie oyio okarokwa Soari.
english: But flee there quickly, because I cannot do anything until you reach it." (That is why the town was called Zoar.)

ekegusii: Korende endagera tegotorenta ang’e ase Nyasae. Totarieti, titogosiria gento, na toisa koria, tegotomenta gento.
english: But food does not bring us near to God; we are no worse if we do not eat, and no better if we do.

ekegusii: korende namorie chinyama ase omotienyi omogima goika mochiroke chietere ase chimioro na kobagara‐garia moyo. Ayio nigo arakoreke, ekiagera mwangire Omonene oria omenyete ase egati yaino, mwarerire ase obosio bwaye na gokwana: Ninki kiagerete tokarua Misiri?”
english: but for a whole month-- until it comes out of your nostrils and you loathe it-- because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have wailed before him, saying, "Why did we ever leave Egypt?" '"

ekegusii: Korende nkanyora amabera ase engencho eyio, ng’a asende inche ritang’ani Yeso Kristo aorokie oboremereria bwaye bwonsi, erio imbe ekiorokererio ase abwo barache komwegena ase okonyora obogima bwa kare na kare.
english: But for that very reason I was shown mercy so that in me, the worst of sinners, Christ Jesus might display his unlimited patience as an example for those who would believe on him and receive eternal life.

ekegusii: Korende ayio nakorete nigo nayakorete ase okorenda erieta riane tirikorwa ribe eritachenegeti ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku, abwo ase narusetie Abaisraeli korwa.
english: But for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

ekegusii: Korende ayio nakorete nigo nayakorete ase okorenda erieta riane tirikorwa ribe eritachenegeti nebisaku ebio Abaisraeli bamenyete ase egati yabo. Ase amasio ’ebisaku ebio nemanyekanetie ase Abaisraeli ase okobarusia ase ense ya Misiri.
english: But for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations they lived among and in whose sight I had revealed myself to the Israelites by bringing them out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Korende Sulemani ere atware egesaku ekemo, ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, na ase engencho ya Yerusalemu, omochie oria nachorete korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli.
english: But for the sake of my servant David and the city of Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, he will have one tribe.

ekegusii: Ase engencho yabo ning’inyore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo, echio narusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri ase obosio bw’abanto b’ebisaku, erinde imbe Nyasae obo. Inche ninche Omonene.”
english: But for their sake I will remember the covenant with their ancestors whom I brought out of Egypt in the sight of the nations to be their God. I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Korende endamwamu na ekeririanda nabibe igoro ase baria beanchete abanyene, batari koigwera ekeene, korende bakoigwera ayatari boronge.
english: But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow evil, there will be wrath and anger.

ekegusii: Aye kwaeire abanto abwo bakoirogete ekemanyererio, kenyare koimokererigwa igoro ase ogotenenera ekeene.
english: But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner to be unfurled against the bow. Selah

ekegusii: Korende asemore inwe abamoirogete erieta riane, erioba ri’oboronge ndioroke rire nokogwenia inse ye chimbaba chiaye. Inwe imosoke mobe mogotiratiria buna chimori ekero chigosokigwa korwa ase obweri.
english: But for you who revere my name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings. And you will go out and leap like calves released from the stall.

ekegusii: Korwa kare goika kare na kare obwanchani bw’Omonene nigo bore ase abwo bamoirogete, na oboronge bwaye nigo borabe ase chinderia chiabo
english: But from everlasting to everlasting the LORD's love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children's children--

ekegusii: Oyio inche nabete ise korwa obosae bwaye, na korwa okoiborwa kwaye nkaba nkomorera na komoraa.”
english: but from my youth I reared him as would a father, and from my birth I guided the widow--

ekegusii: Korende korwa bono Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto naikaranse ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.”
english: But from now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the mighty God."

ekegusii: Gaali agakwana naende, agateba, “Yaya, rigereria, abanto ngotirimboka bare korwa ase esagamu eria gati‐gati, na abanto b’ekeombe kende nigo bagocha ase enchera ekorwa ase omote oria onga buna omotontera, oria bw’abaringoria.”
english: But Gaal spoke up again: "Look, people are coming down from the center of the land, and a company is coming from the direction of the soothsayers' tree."

ekegusii: Korende Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu, agatebia Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, “Tobaisa gokora egento buna ekio, ekiagera aye nigo ogokwana oborimo igoro ya Isumaeli.”
english: But Gedaliah son of Ahikam said to Johanan son of Kareah, "Don't do such a thing! What you are saying about Ishmael is not true."

ekegusii: Gidioni akabairaneria, “Inche tinkobagambera, gose omwana one takobagambera; Omonene nere orabagambere.”
english: But Gideon told them, "I will not rule over you, nor will my son rule over you. The LORD will rule over you."

ekegusii: Korende karue esadaka y’ebire ime; naende rora, ebinto bionsi nebichenu asemore.
english: But give what is inside [the dish] to the poor, and everything will be clean for you.

ekegusii: korende obonene na ogosika, na omorembe nigo bire ase kera oyomo oyogokora amaya, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo.
english: but glory, honor and peace for everyone who does good: first for the Jew, then for the Gentile.

ekegusii: Genda mweorokererie engencho yaye ninki: Inche nigo ndigetie amabera, gose tari ekeng’wanso. Naki tincheti korangeria ababoronge, korende abanyene ebibe.”
english: But go and learn what this means: 'I desire mercy, not sacrifice.' For I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners."

ekegusii: Korende ogende ase omochie o tata, ase eamate yane, orentere omwana one omokungu korwa aroro.
english: but go to my father's family and to my own clan, and get a wife for my son.'

ekegusii: Korende genda, motebie aborokigwa baye, na Petero, ng’a obatang’aneire kogenda Galili. Agwo nao moramorore, buna abatebetie.”
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, 'He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.'"

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaorokera Abimeleki botuko ase okorota, akamotebia, “Aye goika okwe, ekiagera omokungu oyo kwarentire nomokungu bw’omonto onde.”
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream one night and said to him, "You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken; she is a married woman."

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agachora ayare amariri ase ense, erinde asookie abare nobong’aini; naende Nyasae agachora ayare amareu ase ense, erinde abasookie abare ne chinguru.
english: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae oorokirie obwanchani bwaye asetore ase ogotoma Kristo gokwa ase engencho yaito, ekero twarenge abanyene ebibe.
english: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

ekegusii: Omonene tarambora okoboko kwaye kobakorera bobe abagaaka baria b’Abaisraeli. Barabwo kobarorire Nyasae, bakaria na konywa.
english: But God did not raise his hand against these leaders of the Israelites; they saw God, and they ate and drank.

ekegusii: otatiga amatunda ’omote ore mogondo gatigati. Nyasae nigo atotebetie: Moise koyaria gose koyakuna nigo morakwe.”
english: but God did say, 'You must not eat fruit from the tree that is in the middle of the garden, and you must not touch it, or you will die.'"

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Nyasae ase okobua kwaye nigo akoa omokori amabe chinguru; ekero erusirie moyo, nigo agotenena naende.
english: But God drags away the mighty by his power; though they become established, they have no assurance of life.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nigo akonyora okomocha ime yabo ekero agoteba “Omonene otebire iga: Rora, amatuko ngocha are ekero ndakorere abanto b’enyomba ya Israeli na ab’enyomba ya Yuda okobwatana okoyia.
english: But God found fault with the people and said: "The time is coming, declares the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae ayea ekieni buna anchete, na kera embusuro ayea ekieni kiaye.
english: But God gives it a body as he has determined, and to each kind of seed he gives its own body.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae otoyaorokeirie ase Omoika oye, naki Omoika nigo okorigia onsi, nonya nobobisi bwa Nyasae.
english: but God has revealed it to us by his Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.

ekegusii: Korende ekeene, Nyasae ontegereire; ee, oigure eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane.
english: but God has surely listened and heard my voice in prayer.

ekegusii: Omonene nere otongete ense ase okobua kwaye; agatonga ebinto bionsi bi’ense ase obong’aini bwaye, na akarambora igoro ase okomanya kwaye.
english: But God made the earth by his power; he founded the world by his wisdom and stretched out the heavens by his understanding.

ekegusii: korende Nyasae akamobokia ase rituko ria gatato, akamwanchera kooroka,
english: but God raised him from the dead on the third day and caused him to be seen.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakure.
english: But God raised him from the dead,

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akamobokia ekero ororobirie obororo bw’amakweri, ekiagera tare konyarekana abwatwe naro.
