english: But God raised him from the dead, freeing him from the agony of death, because it was impossible for death to keep its hold on him.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaba oinyorete Nuhu ne ching’iti chionsi, echi’orosana, na echiatugire, echiarenge amo nere ase obwato ime. Erio agwo Nyasae akagusia omwaga ase ense, na amache agachaka gokea.
english: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and the livestock that were with him in the ark, and he sent a wind over the earth, and the waters receded.

ekegusii: Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobaisa kogenda amo nabarabwo gose gochia koragereria Abaisraeli. Barabwo nigo basesenirie.”
english: But God said to Balaam, "Do not go with them. You must not put a curse on those people, because they are blessed."

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agatebia Ibrahimu, “Ring’ana eri tiriba riibe asore, ase engencho y’omwana oyo, na ase engencho y’omokungu oyo, omosomba oo. Rinde roinsi Sara akogotebia riigwere, ekiagera korwa ase Isaka ororeria rwao narwatorwe.
english: But God said to him, "Do not be so distressed about the boy and your maidservant. Listen to whatever Sarah tells you, because it is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaboria Yona, “Inee! Mboronge igo aye okogechigwa ase engencho y’omobono oyio?” Yona akairaneria, akamotebia, “Ee, nigo inde noboronge kogechigwa, nonya ngoika ogokwa.”
english: But God said to Jonah, "Do you have a right to be angry about the vine?" "I do," he said. "I am angry enough to die."

ekegusii: Korende Omonene Nyasae agankania, agantebia: Aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera kwarwanire chisegi na gwaiteire amanyinga ’abanto.
english: But God said to me, 'You are not to build a house for my Name, because you are a warrior and have shed blood.'

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo antomete mbatang’anere inwe, erinde motigare ase ense, na koba moyo ase ogotooreka kw’abange.
english: But God sent me ahead of you to preserve for you a remnant on earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

ekegusii: Omonene agaita abanto ba Beti‐Semesi emerongo etano na ebere korwa ase abanto chilifu emerongo etano, ekiagera barigereretie Esanduku eria. Abanto bakaba bakorera na kweumia, ekiagera Omonene aitete abanto abange ase egati yabo.
english: But God struck down some of the men of Beth Shemesh, putting seventy of them to death because they had looked into the ark of the LORD. The people mourned because of the heavy blow the LORD had dealt them,

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akeonchora korwa asebare, akabatiga basasime erioba na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni chia igoro, buna arikire ase ebuku y’ababani: “Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, eyio mwarenge ase erooro, mwandeterete ebing’wanso amo nokoruegwa konde?
english: But God turned away and gave them over to the worship of the heavenly bodies. This agrees with what is written in the book of the prophets: "'Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings forty years in the desert, O house of Israel?

ekegusii: Ekero Baalamu aimogete kogenda amo nabasomba baye babere oriinete etigere, Nyasae akaba nendamwamu enene asare; na omomalaika bw’Omonene agatenena ase enchera gati komotanga tagenda.
english: But God was very angry when he went, and the angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him. Balaam was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae naboorie omoyo one, ayorusie korwa ase okobua gw’aase abakure, erinde ang’ire imenye asare.
english: But God will redeem my life from the grave; he will surely take me to himself. Selah

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nabarase ensara yaye, na barabwo baraswe mobosokano.
english: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be struck down.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae, oyokoremia abaichanete, agatoremia ase ogocha gwa Tito,
english: But God, who comforts the downcast, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

ekegusii: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
english: Ekeene, okoba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae amo nogoisaneka nokonyora okonene,

ekegusii: Naende omoiseke oria akamotebia, “Inkorere egento ekemo gioka! Ing’a ribaga ri’emetienyi ebere, erinde ngende amo nabasani baane ase ebitunwa, na aroro toetanane na korera, ekiagera ningenderere koba omwekungi.”
english: But grant me this one request," she said. "Give me two months to roam the hills and weep with my friends, because I will never marry."

ekegusii: Korende mokine ase obuya na ase okomomanya Omonene na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo. Obonene nobwaye bono na goika kare na kare. Amina.
english: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and forever! Amen.

ekegusii: Korende Hadadi agatama gochia Misiri amo nabanto bande b’Edomu, abasomba ba ise. Na ekero keria Hadadi nigo arenge omosae omoke.
english: But Hadad, still only a boy, fled to Egypt with some Edomite officials who had served his father.

ekegusii: But Hamor said to them, "My son Shechem has his heart set on your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
english: Hamori agakwana nabarabwo, akabora, “Omomura one Sekemu omwanchire omoiseke oino, komoranche amonyuome.

ekegusii: Erio akaba okoirana Rama, ekiagera agwo nao bwoye orenge, na agwo akaba okogamba ebina bi’Abaisraeli, naende akaagachera Omonene egesasimero.
english: But he always went back to Ramah, where his home was, and there he also judged Israel. And he built an altar there to the LORD.

ekegusii: korende ere akamoiraneria: Rora, inche nagokoreire emiaka eye emenge, tinsareti ogochika kwao kero kende gionsi; korende tikwana kong’a emanwa y’embori, erinde ingoke amo nabasani baane.
english: But he answered his father, 'Look! All these years I've been slaving for you and never disobeyed your orders. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.

ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Ngento ki nakorire inche kegwekaine eki mwakorire inwe? Inee! Ogochora kw’amasabibu amatigari kw’Abaefraimu tikori okuya kobua rigesa ri’emesabibu nabanto b’Abieseri?
english: But he answered them, "What have I accomplished compared to you? Aren't the gleanings of Ephraim's grapes better than the full grape harvest of Abiezer?

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Inwe bae endagera.” Bakamoboria “Inee! Togende togore emegati ye chidinari amagana abere, tobae barie?”
english: But he answered, "You give them something to eat." They said to him, "That would take eight months of a man's wages! Are we to go and spend that much on bread and give it to them to eat?"

ekegusii: Naki abwo baare kobekwa ase obokuani tibare kobekwa amo nemuma, korende Yeso akabonyora amo nemuma goetera asare oyo omotebetie, “Omonene otianire, gose takoonchora ebirengererio biaye, Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare.”
english: but he became a priest with an oath when God said to him: "The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: 'You are a priest forever.'"

ekegusii: Erio akang’anyia abanto baye buna ching’ondi chikong’anyigwa, akabaraa ase erooro buna riicho rikoraagwa.
english: But he brought his people out like a flock; he led them like sheep through the desert.

ekegusii: Omonene agatorusia ase ense eria, erio agatorenta aa, agatoa ense eye arierete chisokoro chiaito eira ng’a nabayee.
english: But he brought us out from there to bring us in and give us the land that he promised on oath to our forefathers.

ekegusii: korende agachora abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda, na egetunwa gia Sayoni ekio anchete.
english: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inwe naba inse; inche noyo o igoro; inwe nab’ense eye; inche tindi oyo bw’ense eye.
english: But he continued, "You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.

ekegusii: Korende ere agakana ase amasio abo bonsi, akabora “Timanyeti ayio ogokwana.”
english: But he denied it before them all. "I don't know what you're talking about," he said.

ekegusii: But he denied it. "I don't know or understand what you're talking about," he said, and went out into the entryway.
english: Agakana, akabora, “Timanyeti, gose tinyigweti eki ogokwana.” Agasoka gesieri; etuoni ekabuga.

ekegusii: Agakana, akabora, “Omokungu, timomanyeti.”
english: But he denied it. "Woman, I don't know him," he said.

ekegusii: Korende tarangeretie Nathani omobani, gose Benaya, gose abanto baria barenge abarwani chituoni, gose Sulemani, momura omwabo.
english: but he did not invite Nathan the prophet or Benaiah or the special guard or his brother Solomon.

ekegusii: But he gave them strict orders not to tell who he was.
english: Akabikania mono tibimoorokia.

ekegusii: Korende obuya obo, ere atoeire, nobonge kobua. Naki amariko nigo agoteba, “Nyasae nigo akwanga abare abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya.”
english: But he gives us more grace. That is why Scripture says: "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble."

ekegusii: korende tiriaba komo goika kaiboire omwana omoisia; Yusufu akamoroka erieta riaye Yeso.
english: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a son. And he gave him the name Jesus.

ekegusii: korende omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati ere akamosunga ase omote igoro, buna Yusufu abanorete chingencho chie chindoto chiabo.
english: but he hanged the chief baker, just as Joseph had said to them in his interpretation.

ekegusii: Korende akabasorora mono, na barabwo bakagobera, bagasoa nyomba mwaye. Erio akabakorera endagera, akaroisia na emegati etabekiri memera, na barabwo bakaria.
english: But he insisted so strongly that they did go with him and entered his house. He prepared a meal for them, baking bread without yeast, and they ate.

ekegusii: Korende omosomba oyio karagenderere koba moyo rituko erimo gose abere, omonto oyio takoegwa egesusuro, ekiagera omosomba oyio nenibo yaye.
english: but he is not to be punished if the slave gets up after a day or two, since the slave is his property.

ekegusii: Korende ere namanyete chinchera chiane ngoetera. Ekero arakoore gonteema, nimbioke buna etahabu ekobioka korwa riko.
english: But he knows the way that I take; when he has tested me, I will come forth as gold.

ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akorusia abaremeire korwa ase emechando, na obuchia chiamate chiabo chiaba buna amaicho.
english: But he lifted the needy out of their affliction and increased their families like flocks.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio aakwe ebiranya emerongo ene, korende tari goetania ebio; aise kogenderera goakwa goetania, nigo arasookigwe ase obosio bwao. Takoegwa ogoakwa goetania okwo gochikire.
english: but he must not give him more than forty lashes. If he is flogged more than that, your brother will be degraded in your eyes.

ekegusii: Korende Amunoni tancha komoigwa. Ere akamobua chinguru, akamokorera obosooku ase okorara nere.
english: But he refused to listen to her, and since he was stronger than she, he raped her.

ekegusii: Korende ere akaanga, agatebia moka omonene oye, “Rora, omonene one techandereti gento kende gionsi ase enka yaye, na bionsi ebi abwate obibekire ase amaboko aane.
english: But he refused. "With me in charge," he told her, "my master does not concern himself with anything in the house; everything he owns he has entrusted to my care.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Omonene nigo inde ang’e kogenda amo naye echela, nonya nase ogokwa.”
english: But he replied, "Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death."

ekegusii: But he replied, "The man who made me well said to me, 'Pick up your mat and walk.'"
english: Akabairaneria, “Ere oyonkora koba omogima nere ontebia: Etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”

ekegusii: Agantebia, “Tokora igo! Inche nomosomba omogisangio oo, na oyo bw’abamino ababani, na obw’abwo barendete amang’ana ’ebuku eyio. Osasime Nyasae.”
english: But he said to me, "Do not do it! I am a fellow servant with you and with your brothers the prophets and of all who keep the words of this book. Worship God!"

ekegusii: Korende agantebia, “Obuya bwane bwagoisanire, ekiagera chinguru chiane chiaikeranirie ase oboreu.” Nabo ninyetogerie amareu aane ase omogoko, erio chinguru chia Kristo chiikaranse igoro asende.
english: But he said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ's power may rest on me.

ekegusii: Korende nigo antebia ng’a nimbe morito na ing’ibore omwana omoisia, naende ng’a timbaisa konywa edivai, gose ebinyugwa bigotindia, na timbaisa koria endagera ende yonsi etachenegeti, ekiagera omwana oria naatananwe ase Nyasae abe Omwerwa oye korwa okoiborwa kwaye.”
english: But he said to me, 'You will conceive and give birth to a son. Now then, drink no wine or other fermented drink and do not eat anything unclean, because the boy will be a Nazirite of God from birth until the day of his death.'"

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia, “Timobaisa gontebania, ekiagera Omonene onsesenirie ase orogendo rwane; ing’a ribaga ngende ase omonene one.”
english: But he said to them, "Do not detain me, now that the LORD has granted success to my journey. Send me on my way so I may go to my master."

ekegusii: But he said to them, "I have food to eat that you know nothing about."
english: Akabatebia, “Inche ninde nendagera nkoria, eye motamanyeti inwe.”

ekegusii: korende Yeso akabatebia, “Ninche. Timoiroka!”
english: But he said to them, "It is I; don't be afraid."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Nengwenerete korandia amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti bwa Nyasae ase emechie ende boigo, ekiagera natometwe ase engencho eyio.”
english: But he said, "I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns also, because that is why I was sent."

ekegusii: Korende Isaka akamoiraneria, “Oyomino nigo achicha nobong’ainereria, na ere oirire ogosesenigwa kwao.”
english: But he said, "Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko amake ngaetera aase agwo, korende tarengeo, nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora aande.
english: but he soon passed away and was no more; though I looked for him, he could not be found.

ekegusii: Korende ere agatenena, agaita Abafilisti goika okoboko kwaye gokarosa gokananterera ase omoro. Omonene akabanyorera obobui obonene mono ase rituko riria. Erio abanto bakairana bagatunyana Eleazari, bagasakora ebisakorwa.
english: but he stood his ground and struck down the Philistines till his hand grew tired and froze to the sword. The LORD brought about a great victory that day. The troops returned to Eleazar, but only to strip the dead.

ekegusii: Ere agasokia bonsi gochia isiko, akamobwata okoboko kwaye, agateba, “Omwana, imoka!”
english: But he took her by the hand and said, "My child, get up!"

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo nabechanderete ase emechando yabo, akaigwa ekerero kiabo.
english: But he took note of their distress when he heard their cry;

ekegusii: Korende ere agaeta egati‐gati yabo, akagenda.
english: But he walked right through the crowd and went on his way.

ekegusii: But he wanted to justify himself, so he asked Jesus, "And who is my neighbor?"
english: Omonto oria akarigia gwekora omonyene oboronge, akaboria Yeso, “Omogisangio one nere ng’o?”

ekegusii: Ekiagera Daudi arenge omobani, naende amanyete ng’a Nyasae namotianetie ase emuma ng’a ase oroiboro rwaye nabeke oyomo ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene,
english: But he was a prophet and knew that God had promised him on oath that he would place one of his descendants on his throne.

ekegusii: korende tibabua, nonya naase abo tanyorekana igoro naende.
english: But he was not strong enough, and they lost their place in heaven.

ekegusii: Korende nigo aagetwe chingoma ase engencho y’ogosaria gwaito, agakoborwa ase engencho y’obobe bwaito. Ere akaegwa egesusuro, erinde intwe tonyore omorembe, ase ogoakwa kwaye intwe twagwenigwe.
english: But he was pierced for our transgressions, he was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon him, and by his wounds we are healed.

ekegusii: Ere nigo atogonyeretwe ase ogosaria kwaye omonyene, ekero etigere etari gokwana egakwana ase eriogi ria mwanyabanto, egatanga obobarimo bw’omobani oria.
english: But he was rebuked for his wrongdoing by a donkey-- a beast without speech-- who spoke with a man's voice and restrained the prophet's madness.

ekegusii: agaika ase egeita ki’omoruoti. Tasoete, ekiagera monto onde tarenge gwancherwa asoe ase egeita ekio obegete chigunia.
english: But he went only as far as the king's gate, because no one clothed in sackcloth was allowed to enter it.

ekegusii: korende oyorankane ase mwanyabanto, nere nakanwe ase abamalaika ba Nyasae.
english: But he who disowns me before men will be disowned before the angels of God.

ekegusii: Korende oyoraremererie goika omoerio, oyio natooreke.
english: but he who stands firm to the end will be saved.

ekegusii: Korende ere oyobwatanigwe n’Omonene igo obeire omoika oyomo nere.
english: But he who unites himself with the Lord is one with him in spirit.

ekegusii: Korende inwe Abayuda mwensi momenyete ase ense ya Misiri, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene! Ere nigo agoteba iga: Naama! Netianirie ase erieta riane rinene ng’a, erieta erio tirigwatorwa nonya ng’ake naende nomonwa bw’Omoyuda onde bwensi aiga ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, atebe: Ekeene, buna Omonene Nyasae are moyo.
english: But hear the word of the LORD, all Jews living in Egypt: 'I swear by my great name,' says the LORD, 'that no one from Judah living anywhere in Egypt will ever again invoke my name or swear, "As surely as the Sovereign LORD lives."

ekegusii: Momura omwabo Rebeka na ng’ina bakamotebia, “Tiga omoiseke oyo arabeere aiga koreng’ana amatuko ikomi; nyuma y’ayio mogende komo.”
english: But her brother and her mother replied, "Let the girl remain with us ten days or so; then you may go."

ekegusii: Oyo noro omogati oikire korwa igoro ng’a monto onde bwensi orayorie, tagokwa.
english: But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which a man may eat and not die.

ekegusii: Herode agateba, “Yohana inamonachete omotwe, korende ning’o oyo rende naigure amang’ana are buna aya?” Akarigia komorora.
english: But Herod said, "I beheaded John. Who, then, is this I hear such things about?" And he tried to see him.

ekegusii: Korende ekiagera Hezekia arenge omonto omoenenu ase enkoro yaye tairaneretie ng’a mbuya mono ase amaya akoreretwe, Ase engencho eyio endamwanu y’Omonene egacha igoro asare, na ase Abayuda, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu.
english: But Hezekiah's heart was proud and he did not respond to the kindness shown him; therefore the LORD's wrath was on him and on Judah and Jerusalem.

ekegusii: korende obota bwaye tibogosukigwa. Amaboko aye nigo are ne chinguru, naende namaango, goetera ase amaboko ’Omonyene Chinguru o Yakobo, oyore Omorisia na Egetare gia Israeli.
english: But his bow remained steady, his strong arms stayed limber, because of the hand of the Mighty One of Jacob, because of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,

ekegusii: korende amachiko ’Omonene naro akomogokia mono, na amachiko ayio nigo akoyairanerera omobaso na obotuko.
english: But his delight is in the law of the LORD, and on his law he meditates day and night.

ekegusii: Korende ise akaanga, akabora, “Nimanyete, omwana one, nimanyete. Nere boigo nabe egesaku; ere boigo nabe omonene, korende oyomwabo omoke nabe omonene komobua, na oroiboro rwaye narobe egesaku kiabo ao boka.”
english: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know. He too will become a people, and he too will become great. Nevertheless, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his descendants will become a group of nations."

ekegusii: Ise ere ekiagera akorerete abanto bobe ase obotindi, na akaurereria oyomwabo, naende agakora aya atarenge amaya ase egati y’abanto baye, ekeene, ere goika akwe ase engencho y’ebibe biaye.
english: But his father will die for his own sin, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother and did what was wrong among his people.

ekegusii: Korende aborokigwa baye bakamoira botuko na komoikeria ase orwaki, ore egetonga ime.
english: But his followers took him by night and lowered him in a basket through an opening in the wall.

ekegusii: korende ng’ina akairaneria, akabora, “Taibo; nigo ararokwe Yohana.”
english: but his mother spoke up and said, "No! He is to be called John."

ekegusii: Korende abamura ba Samweli tibakorete buna ise arenge gokora ase okobwatia oboronge; bakabotiga na bakerigeria chinibo, bakarigia riaaki na bakaonchorana oboronge.
english: But his sons did not walk in his ways. They turned aside after dishonest gain and accepted bribes and perverted justice.

ekegusii: Korende mokaye akamoiraneria, “Onye Omonene nigo aganetie gotoita, nanga tare gwancha ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na okoruegwa kw’endagera korwa ase amaboko aito, gose gotworokia aya onsi atworokia, gose gototebia amang’ana aya twaigure.”
english: But his wife answered, "If the LORD had meant to kill us, he would not have accepted a burnt offering and grain offering from our hands, nor shown us all these things or now told us this."

ekegusii: Korende chinyomba chire ase ebichie bitagiteiri chindwaki, nachibarwe koba echi’emegondo y’ense eria; nabo chiranyare koboorigwa na koiranigwa ase abanyene ekero Omwaka bw’Omochengo oraike.
english: But houses in villages without walls around them are to be considered as open country. They can be redeemed, and they are to be returned in the Jubilee.

ekegusii: Korende naki ndakore inyare inche bweka kobogoria egurube enene y’emechando yaino na kobagayana?
english: But how can I bear your problems and your burdens and your disputes all by myself?

ekegusii: Naki omoyio orakore okire‐kiri na gotimoka, ekero Omonene ayochikire gokora emeremo? Oyochikire orwanie Asikeloni ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha.”
english: But how can it rest when the LORD has commanded it, when he has ordered it to attack Ashkelon and the coast?"

ekegusii: Naki abanto b’ororeria rwa Esau bakoriga‐rigigwa ne chinibo chiabo chibisire chiaorokigwe maiso marore!
english: But how Esau will be ransacked, his hidden treasures pillaged!

ekegusii: korende buna anyara korora bono, titomanyeti, gose ning’o omoramokia amaiso, titomanyeti. Ere nomonto omogima, moborie omonyene, nekwanere.”
english: But how he can see now, or who opened his eyes, we don't know. Ask him. He is of age; he will speak for himself."

ekegusii: Naki ngotogigwa ki more nakwo komoraremererie ase ogoakwa chinkundi ekero mogokora ebibe? Korende komoraremererie ogochandwa ekero mogokora amaya, oko nakwo ogwancherwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: But how is it to your credit if you receive a beating for doing wrong and endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.

ekegusii: Korende naki rende nanga amariko aikeranigwa, ng’a nabo egwenerete koba?”
english: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?"

ekegusii: Inche nerikonde, tindi omonto, nigo ngochecherigwa nabanto na gochaywa.
english: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.

ekegusii: Korende nairokire ng’a buna eng’iti eria, ase obong’ainereria bwaye, yang’ainete Hawa, naboigo ebirengererio biaino birasareke, na mobaise gotiga obwegenwa bwaino bw’ekeene more nabwo ase Kristo.
english: But I am afraid that just as Eve was deceived by the serpent's cunning, your minds may somehow be led astray from your sincere and pure devotion to Christ.

ekegusii: Ase ayio naichoirwe nendamwamu ekorwa ase Omonene, narosire ase okoyetanga. “Yeumore igoro ase abana bare ase enchera y’omochie, na igoro ase ebiombe bi’abasae. Omosacha na omokungu mbairwe, boigo abanto abagotu amo nabwo bagotire mono.
english: But I am full of the wrath of the LORD, and I cannot hold it in. "Pour it out on the children in the street and on the young men gathered together; both husband and wife will be caught in it, and the old, those weighed down with years.

ekegusii: Korende inche nigo inga buna omozeituni osebogete ase enyomba ya Nyasae ime. Nigo nsemeretie obwanchani bwa Nyasae botari koera goika kare na kare.
english: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in God's unfailing love for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Korende natomire abwo baminto, erinde ogwetogia gwaito igoro yaino tikobaisa koba okwa bosa ase ring’ana eri, erinde monyare kwebeka ang’e buna natebete.
english: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove hollow, but that you may be ready, as I said you would be.

ekegusii: Nigo ngechirie mono nabanto b’ebisaku ebio batoererete, bakirete‐kiri, ekiagera ekero nagechetigwe ake nabarabwo, nigo bamentete korenta emechando.
english: but I am very angry with the nations that feel secure. I was only a little angry, but they added to the calamity.'

ekegusii: Korende nkoboria nde: Inee! Barabwo tibaigwete? Ee, mbaigwete, “Eriogi riabo riagendire, riesiareire ase ense engima, na amang’ana abo aikire chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense aase abanto bamenyete,”
english: But I ask: Did they not hear? Of course they did: "Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world."

ekegusii: Korende inche nigo nkomorangeria Nyasae, nere Omonene nantoorie.
english: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore, onkonye, nonya nemambia ogosaba kwane nigo kogoika asore.
english: But I cry to you for help, O LORD; in the morning my prayer comes before you.

ekegusii: Korende nigo nganetie nkwane n’Omonguru; mbeke amang’ana aane ase Nyasae, erinde ng’amereranie nere,
english: But I desire to speak to the Almighty and to argue my case with God.

ekegusii: Korende tinegenete amang’ana ayio nare koigwa goika ekero nachicha aa na kwerorera namaiso aane inche omonyene. Bono narorire ng’a tinatebetigwe nonya nekeng’ese ki’amang’ana aya. Obong’aini bwao, na obotenenku bwao biaetanirie amang’ana konya nkoigwa.
english: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told me; in wisdom and wealth you have far exceeded the report I heard.

ekegusii: Korende tinegenete amang’ana ayio, goika ekero nachire aa na neroreire namaiso aane inche omonyene. Bono narorire ng’a tinatebetigwe nonya nekeng’ese ki’obonge bw’obong’aini bwao. Nigo bwaetanirie amang’ana konya nkoigwa.
english: But I did not believe what they said until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half the greatness of your wisdom was told me; you have far exceeded the report I heard.

ekegusii: Korende tinarigetie gokora ing’ana rinde rionsi otatiga gwanchire aye, erinde obuya bwao tiboba obw’okobetererigwa, korende ase ogwancha kwao aye omonyene.
english: But I did not want to do anything without your consent, so that any favor you do will be spontaneous and not forced.

ekegusii: Naki igo nkagete ng’a inche tindemeiri gento eki abatomwa baria abanene bare nakio.
english: But I do not think I am in the least inferior to those "super-apostles."

ekegusii: Onye noboete ng’a ababisa babo mbabaise gochia gwetogia na bangechie, mbabaise gochia goteba: Nintwe twababua, gose tari Omonene okorire ayio onsi.”
english: but I dreaded the taunt of the enemy, lest the adversary misunderstand and say, 'Our hand has triumphed; the LORD has not done all this.'"

ekegusii: Korende nkabachika, nkabatebia: Monyigwere, na inche nimbe Nyasae oino, na inwe mobe abanto baane. Mobwatie chinchera chionsi nabachikire, erio nario erabe buya asemore.
english: but I gave them this command: Obey me, and I will be your God and you will be my people. Walk in all the ways I command you, that it may go well with you.

ekegusii: Ninde nebatiso nkobatiswa, naende ninchandeke mono goika eikeranigwe!
english: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is completed!

ekegusii: Korende nainche nabo inde nokomanya buna inwe, gose timombueti. Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana buna ayio?
english: But I have a mind as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Who does not know all these things?

ekegusii: Goika rero iga nanyorire ogokonyeka gokorwa ase Nyasae. Ase igo ninteneine na koba kirori ase abake na abanene. Tindi gokwana amang’ana ande otatiga aria ababani na Musa bakwanete ng’a nabe,
english: But I have had God's help to this very day, and so I stand here and testify to small and great alike. I am saying nothing beyond what the prophets and Moses said would happen--

ekegusii: Korende tindakorera amang’ana aya nonya ndimo. Gose tinyarigeti aya erinde abe boigo asende; naki mbuya ninkwa kobua omonto onde bwensi kong’ura ogwetogia kwane.
english: But I have not used any of these rights. And I am not writing this in the hope that you will do such things for me. I would rather die than have anyone deprive me of this boast.

ekegusii: Na inche tindi ne ring’ana ri’ekeene nkorikera omonene one igoro asare. Ase ayio namorentire aiga ase obosio bwaino, kobua mono ase obosio bwao, aye omoruoti Agripa, erinde gotwakoorire komoboria, inyore ring’ana nkorika.
english: But I have nothing definite to write to His Majesty about him. Therefore I have brought him before all of you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, so that as a result of this investigation I may have something to write.

ekegusii: korende nagosabeire, erinde okwegena kwao tikoera, na aye gokwaonchokire, obeke abamino chinguru.”
english: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers."

ekegusii: Korende nagotigire obe moyo ase engencho eye inyare kworokia okobua kwane, na erieta riane nario rirararigwe ase ense yonsi.
english: But I have raised you up for this very purpose, that I might show you my power and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.

ekegusii: Korende inche nigo intoereretie omoyo one; buna omwana otigire okogonka oagatire koboko kwa ng’ina, ee, naboigo omoyo one ore ime yane.
english: But I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with its mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

ekegusii: Korende inche nimomanyete, ekiagera naruete asare, nere ontomire.”
english: but I know him because I am from him and he sent me."

ekegusii: Korende nonya mbono namanyire ng’a kende gionsi orasabe Nyasae, Nyasae nakoe.”
english: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask."

ekegusii: Korende inche omonyene nimanyete ng’a omoruoti o Misiri takobaa ribaga mogende atabetereirie nokoboko kwane gwe chinguru.
english: But I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless a mighty hand compels him.

ekegusii: Korende nimbamanyete inwe, aye na abasomba bao, ng’a timomoirogeti Omonene Nyasae nonya mbono.”
english: But I know that you and your officials still do not fear the LORD God."

ekegusii: Korende nabamanyire inwe ng’a timori nobwanchani bwa Nyasae ime yaino.
english: but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde norogendo rotari na komocha; indorere amabera na omboorie.
english: But I lead a blameless life; redeem me and be merciful to me.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ngosaba ase engaki yancheire. Aye Nyasae, inyigwere, ekiagera nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera, naende nigo ore omwegenwa ase ogotooria.
english: But I pray to you, O LORD, in the time of your favor; in your great love, O God, answer me with your sure salvation.

ekegusii: nkamoiraneria, “Aye omoruoti ochie kare! Inki keragere tindorekana inde nomoichano ekero omochie oria, aase chimbeera ohie chisokoro chiane chire, ogendererete koba ritombe, na ebiita biaye biasarigwe nomorero?”
english: but I said to the king, "May the king live forever! Why should my face not look sad when the city where my fathers are buried lies in ruins, and its gates have been destroyed by fire?"

ekegusii: Korende inabarierete inwe eira ng’a nimbae ense yabo ebe omwando oino, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabaatananire inwe korwa ase ebisaku binde.
english: But I said to you, "You will possess their land; I will give it to you as an inheritance, a land flowing with milk and honey." I am the LORD your God, who has set you apart from the nations.

ekegusii: Erio inche ngateba, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, Naama, ababani nigo bagotebia abanto ng’a tibakorora esegi ekobachera, gose enchara, ekiagera nkwabarierete eira ng’a omorembe nobe ase ense yabo.”
english: But I said, "Ah, Sovereign LORD, the prophets keep telling them, 'You will not see the sword or suffer famine. Indeed, I will give you lasting peace in this place.'"

ekegusii: Korende ngateba: “Nabeire ngokora emeremo emekong’u bosa, natugutire chinguru chiane bosa, ntanyoreti gento kende; nonya naboigo, ekeene, oboronge bwane nigo bokorwa ase Omonene, na eng’eria yane nigo ekorwa ase Nyasae one.”
english: But I said, "I have labored to no purpose; I have spent my strength in vain and for nothing. Yet what is due me is in the LORD's hand, and my reward is with my God."

ekegusii: Nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Inee! Omonto onga buna inche ningwenerete gotama? Omonto onga buna inche ninyare gotama gochia ase Hekalu ime, ase ogotooria obogima bwane? Tinkonyara kogenda aroro.”
english: But I said, "Should a man like me run away? Or should one like me go into the temple to save his life? I will not go!"

ekegusii: korende ase ebiimo biane narorire ogochika konde nkoreo, gokorwana esegi nogochika gw’okomanya kwane na kogonkora koba omosakorwa bw’ogochika koria kw’ebibe kore ase ebiimo biane.
english: but I see another law at work in the members of my body, waging war against the law of my mind and making me a prisoner of the law of sin at work within my members.

ekegusii: Korende inche nabatebirie, ng’a onde bwensi oratige mokaye, otatiga ase engencho y’obotomani, ogerire abe omotomani; na oyoranyuome oyotigirwe, oyio otomanire.
english: But I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for marital unfaithfulness, causes her to become an adulteress, and anyone who marries the divorced woman commits adultery.

ekegusii: Korende inche nabatebirie ng’a onde bwensi orageche oyomwabo, nabe omonto okonacherwa ekina, na oyoramogorere oyomwabo nabe omonto okoirwa ase ekegambero, na oyoramoroke oyonde Omoriri! Nagwenere omorero o kare na kare.
english: But I tell you that anyone who is angry with his brother will be subject to judgment. Again, anyone who says to his brother, 'Raca, 'is answerable to the Sanhedrin. But anyone who says, 'You fool!' will be in danger of the fire of hell.

ekegusii: Korende inche nabatebirie, ng’a onde bwensi orarigererie omokungu na korengereria gotomana nere otomanire ekero ekio ase enkoro yaye.
english: But I tell you that anyone who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

ekegusii: Korende nabatebirie inwe ng’a nebe aororo ase ense ya Sodomu ase rituko ri’ekina kobua asore.”
english: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you."

ekegusii: Korende nabatebirie, ng’a ase kera ring’ana ritari nengencho mwanyabanto barakwane, ase rituko ri’ekina nabache korua omobaro.
english: But I tell you that men will have to give account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.

ekegusii: Korende inche nabatebirie erire ri’ekeene: Nebe buya asemore inche ngende, ekiagera ntagendeti, Omokonyi oria tagocha asemore; korende kondagende, nimotome asemore.
english: But I tell you the truth: It is for your good that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Counselor will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

ekegusii: korende inche nabatebirie: Timobaisa koamererania noyore omobe. Korende omonto karagoake orosea rwa borio, omoonchorere norw’okobee.
english: But I tell you, Do not resist an evil person. If someone strikes you on the right cheek, turn to him the other also.

ekegusii: Korende inche nabatebirie: Totiana ase egento kende gionsi; nonya nase igoro, ekiagera nao ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae;
english: But I tell you, Do not swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God's throne;

ekegusii: Korende nabatebirie ng’a Elija oikire gocha; na barabwo tibamomanyete, korende bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie. Naboigo n’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nachie konyora emechando ase amaboko abo.”
english: But I tell you, Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him everything they wished. In the same way the Son of Man is going to suffer at their hands."

ekegusii: Korende nabatebirie: Elija oikire gocha, na barabwo bakamokorera onsi aya barigetie, buna arikeretwe.”
english: But I tell you, Elijah has come, and they have done to him everything they wished, just as it is written about him."

ekegusii: Korende nabatebirie inwe, nebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko ri’ekina kobua asemore.
english: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

ekegusii: Korende inche nabatebirie: Ancha ababisa baino, mosabere aba bakobachanda,
english: But I tell you: Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

ekegusii: Inche Omonene ninkwane ring’ana nganetie gokwana, na rirorio goika riikerane, tirigotebana nonya ng’ake. Inwe egesaku getari koigwera, ase amatuko aino ninkwane ring’ana ndiikeranie. Nabo inche Omonene Nyasae natebire.”
english: But I the LORD will speak what I will, and it shall be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, you rebellious house, I will fulfill whatever I say, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Korende nkarora ng’a ningwenerete gotoma Epafrodito oyominto, omokori emeremo amo nainche, omorwani amo nainche, oyo mwatomire gonkorera ase okoremerwa kwane.
english: But I think it is necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger, whom you sent to take care of my needs.

ekegusii: Korende inche nkarusia Ibrahimu, sokoro yaino, korwa ng’umbu y’orooche orwo, nkamotang’ana, ere agaeta ase ense engima ya Kanani; nkamenta oroiboro rwaye. Nkamoa Isaka,
english: But I took your father Abraham from the land beyond the River and led him throughout Canaan and gave him many descendants. I gave him Isaac,

ekegusii: Korende inche nigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene. Nigo ngoteba, “Aye naye Nyasae one.”
english: But I trust in you, O LORD; I say, "You are my God."

ekegusii: Ninsemerie obwanchani bwao botari koera, enkoro yane negokere ogotooreka gokorwa asore.
english: But I trust in your unfailing love; my heart rejoices in your salvation.

ekegusii: Korende nkabakurera na kobatebia, “Nase ki mobeerete isiko aa na korara aa ase enyasi? Moise gokora bo naende, goika mbakore bobe.” Korwa ase engaki eria na kogenderera tibarenge gocha ase rituko ri’Esabato.
english: But I warned them and said, "Why do you spend the night by the wall? If you do this again, I will lay hands on you." From that time on they no longer came on the Sabbath.

ekegusii: Korende nkabekwa ase egetonga ime, ngaikerigwa ase ekebao ase orwaki, ngatooreka korwa ase amaboko aye.
english: But I was lowered in a basket from a window in the wall and slipped through his hands.

ekegusii: Ning’iranie Abaisraeli gocha ase obomenyo bwabo naende. Nabarabwo nabarie chindagera chiabo agwo ase egetunwa gia Karimeli, na ase orogongo rwa Basani, na okogania kwabo nagoisanekigwe agwo ase ebigoro bi’Efraimu, na ase Gileadi.
english: But I will bring Israel back to his own pasture and he will graze on Carmel and Bashan; his appetite will be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and Gilead.

ekegusii: Korende ninchiche asemore bwango, Omonene karanche, na inche nimanye chinguru chiabo abwo bakoenena, gose tari ogokwana kwabo.
english: But I will come to you very soon, if the Lord is willing, and then I will find out not only how these arrogant people are talking, but what power they have.

ekegusii: Erio inche Omonene nindende enyomba yane, erinde abarwani b’esegi tibabaisa goeterao gose koiranerao; na abachandi b’abanto baane tibabaisa gochao, ekiagera bono inche ninyerigererie namaiso aane.
english: But I will defend my house against marauding forces. Never again will an oppressor overrun my people, for now I am keeping watch.

ekegusii: Korende ninkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania naye; aye nosoe ase obwato amo nabana bao abamura, na mokao, na baka bamura bao.
english: But I will establish my covenant with you, and you will enter the ark-- you and your sons and your wife and your sons' wives with you.

ekegusii: Korende ninkong’ie enkoro ya Farao; nonya nabo ninkore ebikone ebinge na amakumia amange ase ense ya Misiri.
english: But I will harden Pharaoh's heart, and though I multiply my miraculous signs and wonders in Egypt,

ekegusii: Nintige ase egati yaino abanto abaitongo abagwekeyia. Abwo mbabe bagotamera erieta riane inche Omonene.
english: But I will leave within you the meek and humble, who trust in the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: Rora, nakorire obosio bwao bobe obokong’u buna ayabo, na obosio bwao igoro bobe obokong’u buna ayabo.
english: But I will make you as unyielding and hardened as they are.

ekegusii: Tinkobaseria ase omwaka oyomo, ense ebaise koba bosa, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chimenteke chigochande.
english: But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals too numerous for you.

ekegusii: Korende obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe tinkoborusia asare, tingotiga koba omwegenwa asare.
english: but I will not take my love from him, nor will I ever betray my faithfulness.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku keria, barabakore babe abasomba babo, nimbagambie, na nyuma y’ayio nabaruo bare nenibo enyinge mono.
english: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will come out with great possessions.

ekegusii: Nyasae agateba: Ninkegambie ekina egesaku keria kerabakore babe abasomba babo, na nyuma y’ayio nabaruo, na barabwo nabansasimere aase aiga.
english: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves,' God said, 'and afterward they will come out of that country and worship me in this place.'

ekegusii: Nimbeke ebigobanio ase chinsea chiao, ntige chinswe chire ase chindooche chiao chibwaterere ase amagonko ao, erio nkong’use nkorusie ase chindooche chiao, amo ne chinswe chionsi chie chindooche chiao chibwatererete ase amagonko ao.
english: But I will put hooks in your jaws and make the fish of your streams stick to your scales. I will pull you out from among your streams, with all the fish sticking to your scales.

ekegusii: Korende inche Omonene ningotoorie ase rituko erio, gose tokonyara kobekwa ase amaboko ’abanto abwo aye bwoboete.
english: But I will rescue you on that day, declares the LORD; you will not be handed over to those you fear.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire iga: Inche nimbasebokie naende, ningwenie amaote aino, ekiagera abanto nigo babarogete inwe abamotugutire, na bateba ng’a Sayoni nomochie otigetwe, monto onde atayochandekereti.”
english: But I will restore you to health and heal your wounds,' declares the LORD, 'because you are called an outcast, Zion for whom no one cares.'

ekegusii: Korende nimbakurere oyo morairoke: Moiroke oria ore nokobua, nyuma ase ogoita omonto omoruta ase omorero o kare na kare. Ee, nabatebirie, moiroke oria!
english: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear him who, after the killing of the body, has power to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

ekegusii: Korende inche nintere igoro y’okobua kwao, kera emambia nintere neriogi rinene igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, ekiagera ase chingaki chi’emechando nigo kwabeire egekengero kiane na obotameru bwane.
english: But I will sing of your strength, in the morning I will sing of your love; for you are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.

ekegusii: Korende nintigarie abanto bake korwa ase egati yabo bataitwe nemioro, gose nenchara, gose noborwaire bogoita, erinde kobare agwo ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ase barairwe, banyare koorokia ebibe biabo bi’okogechia bakorire. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: But I will spare a few of them from the sword, famine and plague, so that in the nations where they go they may acknowledge all their detestable practices. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

ekegusii: Bono nimenye ase Efeso goika rituko rinene ria Pentekosti;
english: But I will stay on at Ephesus until Pentecost,

ekegusii: Nachoboire abanto b’Esau na kobatiga bosa; nasioririe aase bakwebisa, bono tibakonyora aase bakwebisa. Abanto b’ororeria rwabo na abamwabo basirigwe, boigo nabanto bamenyete ang’e, bonsi basirigwe gose nonya noyomo tatigareti.
english: But I will strip Esau bare; I will uncover his hiding places, so that he cannot conceal himself. His children, relatives and neighbors will perish, and he will be no more.

ekegusii: Korende tinakorete bo, ekiagera nigo narendete erieta riane tirikorwa ribe eritachenegeti ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku abwo ase narusetie Abaisraeli korwa.
english: But I withheld my hand, and for the sake of my name I did what would keep it from being profaned in the eyes of the nations in whose sight I had brought them out.

ekegusii: korende tinancha koigwera Baalamu. Ase ayio akabasesenia, nainche nkabatooria korwa ase amaboko a Balaki.
english: But I would not listen to Balaam, so he blessed you again and again, and I delivered you out of his hand.

ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’obonge bw’obwanchani bwao botari koera ninsoe ase enyomba yao; nigo ndasasime ndigereretie Hekalu yao Enchenu imbe ngokoiroka.
english: But I, by your great mercy, will come into your house; in reverence will I bow down toward your holy temple.

ekegusii: Na inche kondaimokererigwe igoro korwa ase ense, nimbang’use bonsi asende.”
english: But I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all men to myself."

ekegusii: Korende inche nindue ekeng’wanso gi’okogoakera ng’a mbuya mono, eki nariete eira ng’a ninkerue, ing’ikeranie. Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Omonene!”
english: But I, with a song of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to you. What I have vowed I will make good. Salvation comes from the LORD."

ekegusii: “Korende onye omonto ogechete omonto onde erinde amoboere na komoaka goika akwe, na nyuma y’ayio atamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio,
english: But if a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait for him, assaults and kills him, and then flees to one of these cities,

ekegusii: Korende omonto ogoita oyomwabo mweno ase obong’ainereria, nere goika arusigwe nonya nase egesasimero kiane, aitwe akwe.
english: But if a man schemes and kills another man deliberately, take him away from my altar and put him to death.

ekegusii: Korende omonto ochenegete gose o takari aare ase orogendo, oretange tarenda rituko ri’Epasaka, omonto oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye, ekiagera ere tarenteti okoruegwa kwaye ase Omonene ase engaki eria echikire. Okomocha kw’ebibe kw’omonto oria nkobe igoro yaye.
english: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and not on a journey fails to celebrate the Passover, that person must be cut off from his people because he did not present the LORD's offering at the appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.

ekegusii: “Omonto obeire oyotachenegeti, nere tancheti gwesibia, arusigwe ase omosangererekano bw’abanto. Ere okorire Aase Aachenu y’Omonene babeire atachenegeti, ekiagera amache aria ay’okomochena tanyororokeretigwe asare; ere nigo are oyotachenegeti.
english: But if a person who is unclean does not purify himself, he must be cut off from the community, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on him, and he is unclean.

ekegusii: Omosomba onde bwensi omokuani agorete ne chibesa chiaye omonyene, gose omosomba oiboreire ase enka yaye, abwo nabarie endagera eria omokuani akoegwa.
english: But if a priest buys a slave with money, or if a slave is born in his household, that slave may eat his food.

ekegusii: Korende omosubati bw’omokuani osogete otigirwe ore omoboraka, gose batiganire nomosacha oye, na tabwati omwana, na bono oiranire gocha o ise komenyao buna ekero arenge omoke, nanyare koria endagera eria ya ise. Korende omonto otari bw’eamate y’omokuani tabaisa koria endagera eria.
english: But if a priest's daughter becomes a widow or is divorced, yet has no children, and she returns to live in her father's house as in her youth, she may eat of her father's food. No unauthorized person, however, may eat any of it.

ekegusii: Korende omokori amabe karaonchoke atige ebibe akorire, na akore ayare amaya na ayare boronge, oyio natoorie omoyo oye.
english: But if a wicked man turns away from the wickedness he has committed and does what is just and right, he will save his life.

ekegusii: Korende onye omoboraka ore nabana gose abachokoro, tiga beorokererie ritang’ani ayabagwenerete bakorere abamwabo abanyene, na koiraneria abaibori babo ng’a mbuya mono ase ebibanyorire, ekiagera ring’ana eri ndiancheire ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, these should learn first of all to put their religion into practice by caring for their own family and so repaying their parents and grandparents, for this is pleasing to God.

ekegusii: Korende onye bonsi bakobana, omonto otegeneti ogocha, gose omonto o isiko, orokigwe na bonsi ng’a nomomochi are, agambigwe na bonsi;
english: But if an unbeliever or someone who does not understand comes in while everybody is prophesying, he will be convinced by all that he is a sinner and will be judged by all,

ekegusii: Korende onye egesaku kende gionsi kegochia kwanga konyigwera, rirorio ninkerusieo ngesirie kegima. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: But if any nation does not listen, I will completely uproot and destroy it," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende egesaku kende gionsi keranche gosoyia amagoti abo ase rikorogoto ri’omoruoti o Babeli na komokorera, inche ningetige kebeere ase ense yaye koyerema na koyemenya.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: But if any nation will bow its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serve him, I will let that nation remain in its own land to till it and to live there, declares the LORD." '"

ekegusii: “Oyo oragere oyomo bw’aba abake, abanyegenete, akore ebibe, anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe ase endiba y’enyancha.
english: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in me to sin, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.

ekegusii: Naki ere oyotari namang’ana ayio nomouko, takonyara korora amang’ana are bosio, na bwebire ogosibigwa kw’ebibe biaye bia kare.
english: But if anyone does not have them, he is nearsighted and blind, and has forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.

ekegusii: Korende ere oyobwatete ring’ana riaye, ime ase oyio obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwaikeranigwe ekeene ekeene. Ase eri ntore nobomaene ng’a nigo tore ime asare:
english: But if anyone obeys his word, God's love is truly made complete in him. This is how we know we are in him:

ekegusii: (Korende omonto karabatebie, “Egento ekio kiarurwe ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa”, timoria ase engencho yaye ere ayaborokia, na ase enkoro yaye, erinde techandeka.
english: But if anyone says to you, "This has been offered in sacrifice," then do not eat it, both for the sake of the man who told you and for conscience' sake--

ekegusii: korende oyotachenegeti takoria enyama y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa ase Omonene. Aise gokora igo, nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
english: But if anyone who is unclean eats any meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.

ekegusii: Na Kristo karabe ime yaino, nonya emebere yaino ekwete ase engencho y’ebibe, emeika yaino moyo ere ase engencho y’oboronge obo mwanyorete.
english: But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.

ekegusii: Korende aroro agwo, komorarigie Omonene, Nyasae oino, ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi, inamomonyore.
english: But if from there you seek the LORD your God, you will find him if you look for him with all your heart and with all your soul.

ekegusii: Korende omonto karaatanane omogondo oye nyuma y’Omwaka bw’Omochengo, erio omokuani akore rigori rie chibesa koreng’ana nemiaka yatigaire goika Omwaka onde bw’Omochengo, na igo nakeyie rigori.
english: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, the priest will determine the value according to the number of years that remain until the next Year of Jubilee, and its set value will be reduced.

ekegusii: Korende onye omonyene oria tabwati enibo eisaine akobooria omwando oye, nabo omwando oyio oratigare ase okoboko kw’omonto oria oyogorete goika Omwaka bw’Omochengo. Korende ase omwaka oria omwando oyio noiranigwe, na ere omonyene airane ase omwando oye.
english: But if he does not acquire the means to repay him, what he sold will remain in the possession of the buyer until the Year of Jubilee. It will be returned in the Jubilee, and he can then go back to his property.

ekegusii: Korende onye tagosibia chianga chiaye na gwesibia omobere, rirorio nabogorie obobe bwaye.”
english: But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe himself, he will be held responsible.'"

ekegusii: Korende onye ase risio ri’omotwe oye, magega gose bosio, obwate egesambo kere nobobariri na oborabu, obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma bwasokeire ase risio.
english: But if he has a reddish-white sore on his bald head or forehead, it is an infectious disease breaking out on his head or forehead.

ekegusii: “Inee! Nyasae karakire‐kiri ning’o oramonachere ekina? Karabise obosio bwaye, ning’o oranyare komorigereria, gokerabe egesaku gete gose omonto gete,
english: But if he remains silent, who can condemn him? If he hides his face, who can see him? Yet he is over man and nation alike,

ekegusii: Korende karantebie ng’a timogwenereti, inche nao inde aa, ankorere aya ararore are amaya asare.”
english: But if he says, 'I am not pleased with you,' then I am ready; let him do to me whatever seems good to him."

ekegusii: Korende atakoigwereti, ira omonto oyomo, gose babere, mogende asare mwensi, ng’a kera ring’ana rinyare gwancheranwa ase abarori babere gose batato.
english: But if he will not listen, take one or two others along, so that 'every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.'

ekegusii: Korende onye ise ase rituko riria araigwe ring’ana igoro y’eira eria na tayianchera, omoiseke oria tagwenereti koyeikerania. Omonene naabere omoiseke oria, ekiagera ise nangete ng’a eira eria tekobao.
english: But if her father forbids her when he hears about it, none of her vows or the pledges by which she obligated herself will stand; the LORD will release her because her father has forbidden her.

ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oye ase rituko riria araigwe amang’ana ’eira eria tayianchera, erio eira eria omokungu oyio ariete, na amang’ana aya akwanete atarengereretie buya, tagoikeranigwa, na Omonene naabere omokungu oyio.
english: But if her husband forbids her when he hears about it, he nullifies the vow that obligates her or the rash promise by which she obligates herself, and the LORD will release her.

ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oye okwanga eira yaye gose ogotiana kwaye, na kobikora bibe bosa ase rituko riria akoyaigwa, amang’ana omokungu oria akwanete tagoikeranigwa. Omonene naabere omokungu oria, ekiagera omosacha oye bwangire ng’a taikerania eira eria, gose ogotiana koria.
english: But if her husband nullifies them when he hears about them, then none of the vows or pledges that came from her lips will stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the LORD will release her.

ekegusii: Korende onye omosacha oria okirete goika rituko ria kabere, takwanete ring’ana igoro y’ayio, rirorio nayiancherete, na omokungu oria goika aikeranie chiira chiaye chionsi ariete, gose ogotiana kwaye kw’ogwetanga korwa ase egento gete. Omosacha oye nayianchete, ekiagera takwanete gento kende ase rituko riria ayaigwete.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her about it from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or the pledges binding on her. He confirms them by saying nothing to her when he hears about them.

ekegusii: Korende konda yekore, nonya timonyegeneti inche, egene emeremo eria, monyare komanya na kwegena ng’a Tata nigo are ime yane, na inche ime ase Tata.”
english: But if I do it, even though you do not believe me, believe the miracles, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father."

ekegusii: Naende ninsa kogamba, okogamba kwane nogw’ekeene, ekiagera tari inche bweka nkogamba, korende ninche na Tata oyontomete.
english: But if I do judge, my decisions are right, because I am not alone. I stand with the Father, who sent me.

ekegusii: Korende kondaserie ebirecha ase ekiara kia Nyasae, nabo oboruoti bwa Nyasae bwabacheire.
english: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come to you.

ekegusii: Korende onye ngoseria ebirecha ase Omoika o Nyasae, igo oboruoti bwa Nyasae bwabacheire.
english: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.

ekegusii: Korende onye ngotebia omwana oria: Rigereria, emegwe eyio bosio bwao aaria moino, rirorio aye Daudi otame, ekiagera n’Omonene okogotebia ogende.
english: But if I say to the boy, 'Look, the arrows are beyond you,' then you must go, because the LORD has sent you away.

ekegusii: Ekero natebete: “Bono tinkoinyora Omonene, gose gokwana ase erieta riaye nonya ng’ake,” rirorio rikaba ase enkoro yane na ase amauga aane buna omorero ogosamba osiekeireo. Nkarosa mono korikiria ime asende, tinanyarete gwetanga tindisokia.
english: But if I say, "I will not mention him or speak any more in his name," his word is in my heart like a fire, a fire shut up in my bones. I am weary of holding it in; indeed, I cannot.

ekegusii: korende onye neya Nyasae, timokonyara koyesaria nonya ng’ake; mobaise kororekana ng’a Nyasae mokorwania!”
english: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop these men; you will only find yourselves fighting against God."

ekegusii: Bono onye Kristo orandigwe asemore buna nabogetigwe korwa ase abakure, naki rende abande asemore bagoteba ng’a kobokigwa kw’abakure tikori?
english: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

ekegusii: Onye ekemoa gekororekana naende ase eanga eria, gose ase egetambaa keroisirie ase chingencho ao ao, gose ase gento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, igo nekemoa gia ukoma kiaorokeire. Egento keria goika gesambwe nomorero.
english: But if it reappears in the clothing, or in the woven or knitted material, or in the leather article, it is spreading, and whatever has the mildew must be burned with fire.

ekegusii: na onye bagosibwa chingataare na baba bare ase emechando, gose kobwatwa ase emeeto y’emechando,
english: But if men are bound in chains, held fast by cords of affliction,

ekegusii: Konye tata bwerure kogokorera bobe, rirorio Omonene ang’e inche Yonathani egesusuro onye tinkogotebia okogania gwa tata, na ngotige otame na bwetoorie. Omonene abe amo naye buna arenge na tata.
english: But if my father is inclined to harm you, may the LORD deal with me, be it ever so severely, if I do not let you know and send you away safely. May the LORD be with you as he has been with my father.

ekegusii: Onye tobwati kende, kira‐kiri ontegerere, na inche ninkworokererie obong’aini.”
english: But if not, then listen to me; be silent, and I will teach you wisdom."

ekegusii: Korende kerabe ng’a obobe bwaito bokoorokia oboronge bwa Nyasae, inki toratebe rende? Nyasae noyotari omoronge ekero akorenta endamwamu? (Nakwanire buna mwanyabanto).
english: But if our unrighteousness brings out God's righteousness more clearly, what shall we say? That God is unjust in bringing his wrath on us? (I am using a human argument.)

ekegusii: “Korende omonto karaumerane nomoiseke omwekungi oriereirwe boko nomonto omoao amobwate ne chinguru abe nere agwo ase orosana isiko y’omochie, omonto oria nere bweka oraitwe akwe.
english: But if out in the country a man happens to meet a girl pledged to be married and rapes her, only the man who has done this shall die.

ekegusii: Kerabe timogokiri gokorera Omonene, rirorio mwechorere rero oyo mwanchete gokorera, onye ne chinyasae chiria chisokoro chiaino chiakorerete ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Eufarati, gose chinyasae chi’Abaamori, baria momenyete ase ense yabo. Korende inche amo nabanto b’enyomba yane ntomokorere Omonene.”
english: But if serving the LORD seems undesirable to you, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your forefathers served beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you are living. But as for me and my household, we will serve the LORD."

ekegusii: (korende, karabe otiganire nere, atige tanyuomwa gose abwatane nomosacha oye naende), na omosacha tatiga mokaye.
english: But if she does, she must remain unmarried or else be reconciled to her husband. And a husband must not divorce his wife.

ekegusii: Korende onye omonto oria okure, naende omoamate oye tari okoiranerigwa egento ekio kiairetwe, rirorio kerentwe ase Omonene kebe eki’omokuani. Amo nayio omonto oyio amente emingichi erakorerwe okobwatanigwa asare.
english: But if that person has no close relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest, along with the ram with which atonement is made for him.

ekegusii: Onye aase agwo Omonene Nyasae achorire abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye are aare mono, motanyare kobogoria ensemo ya ikomi y’eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, abasesenirie nero,
english: But if that place is too distant and you have been blessed by the LORD your God and cannot carry your tithe (because the place where the LORD will choose to put his Name is so far away),

ekegusii: Korende onye nigo yaibwa korwa asare ere goika aakane omonyene oria.
english: But if the animal was stolen from the neighbor, he must make restitution to the owner.

ekegusii: Korende echiare chinyoro tare gochibekera ebite ebio. Ase igo echiare chinyoro nigo chiare koba echia Labani, na echiare ne chinguru chiba echia Yakobo.
english: but if the animals were weak, he would not place them there. So the weak animals went to Laban and the strong ones to Jacob.

ekegusii: Korende onye riire tiriare koimokerera igoro, barabwo tibaare koimoka kogenda goika rituko riria riire riare koimokerera igoro naende.
english: but if the cloud did not lift, they did not set out-- until the day it lifted.

ekegusii: Korende onye richoncho riria riesiareire ase risankwa nyuma gachenekire,
english: But if the itch does spread in the skin after he is pronounced clean,

ekegusii: Korende onye Omonene ogochia gokora egento ekeyia, erinde riroba ritandoke, rimere abanto abwo amo nebinto biabo bionsi, na barabwo barimere riroba ime bare moyo, bagende gochia aase abakure, erio namomanye ng’a abanto aba bachayire Omonene.”
english: But if the LORD brings about something totally new, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them, with everything that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the grave, then you will know that these men have treated the LORD with contempt."

ekegusii: Onye omonyene oria ore aroro ekero egoakwa gose egokwa, rirorio tagoakanwa. Onye etugo eyio egochia goakanerwa, ogoakanerwa okwo kobe kogoisanera ogosirerwa okwo.”
english: But if the owner is with the animal, the borrower will not have to pay. If the animal was hired, the money paid for the hire covers the loss.

ekegusii: Korende omokuani kararenge egesambo keria, na arore ng’a amarionya aria areo taonchogeti abe amarabu, naende egesambo tikerakora engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, korende giachakire gosira, erio omokuani amobeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: But if the priest examines it and there is no white hair in the spot and if it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to put him in isolation for seven days.

ekegusii: Korende egesambo keria gokerabe giesiareire ase risankwa nyuma omokuani karorire ng’a ochenekire, omonto oria goika airane ase omokuani naende,
english: But if the rash does spread in his skin after he has shown himself to the priest to be pronounced clean, he must appear before the priest again.

ekegusii: Korende onye egesambo keria tikeonchogeti na gwesiarera, eyio nenkoru ase rigumba riariete, na omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oria ochenekire.
english: But if the spot is unchanged and has not spread, it is only a scar from the boil, and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

ekegusii: Korende atanyorekaneti, erio oria omonyene enyomba arentwe ase obosio bwa Nyasae, erinde amanywe gose nere obiibete.
english: But if the thief is not found, the owner of the house must appear before the judges to determine whether he has laid his hands on the other man's property.

ekegusii: Korende oria otegeneti karaganie gotigana, tiga atigane. Oyominto omosacha gose oyominto omokungu tasibiri ase amang’ana buna ayio, korende Nyasae obarangeirie ase omorembe.
english: But if the unbeliever leaves, let him do so. A believing man or woman is not bound in such circumstances; God has called us to live in peace.

ekegusii: Korende omorendi oria kararore omoro ogocha, na tabugia egetureri, erinde abanto bakurerwe, na omoro oria ochiche oite omonto onde obo, omonto oyio nakwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende inche ninganie amanyinga ’omonto oyio korwa ase okoboko kw’omorendi oria.
english: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet to warn the people and the sword comes and takes the life of one of them, that man will be taken away because of his sin, but I will hold the watchman accountable for his blood.'

ekegusii: Bono onye ogosaria kwabo kwaeire abanto b’ense eye obonda, na onye okobugwa kwabo kwaeire abanto b’Ebisaku obonda, Inee, tari kobua mono oboikeranu bwabo?
english: But if their transgression means riches for the world, and their loss means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their fullness bring!

ekegusii: Korende omokungu oria karakwe, rirorio egesusuro kebe obogima ase obogima,
english: But if there is serious injury, you are to take life for life,

ekegusii: Korende onye tibakonyara gwetanga, tiga banyuome, ekiagera mbuya konyuoma kobua gosambwa nokogania.
english: But if they cannot control themselves, they should marry, for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.

ekegusii: Onye tibakwegena nonya nase ebikone ebio bibere, gose gwancha amang’ana ao, goika obuuche amache make korwa ase orooche rwa Naili, oyaitere ase ense enyomo; amache ayio orabuuche korwa ase orooche naonchoke abe amanyinga ase ense enyomo.”
english: But if they do not believe these two signs or listen to you, take some water from the Nile and pour it on the dry ground. The water you take from the river will become blood on the ground."

ekegusii: Korende onye tibakobogoria ebirwanero bi’esegi bamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodan, rirorio nigo baranyore orogongo rwabo amo nainwe agwo ase ense ya Kanani.”
english: But if they do not cross over with you armed, they must accept their possession with you in Canaan."

ekegusii: Korende onye tibakoigwera, nigo baraitwe nemioro, erio bakwe batamanyeti kende.”
english: But if they do not listen, they will perish by the sword and die without knowledge.

ekegusii: Korende onye ababani abwo mbaigwerete ogosemia kwane, nanga mbararetie amang’ana aane ase abanto baane, na nigo barenge gocha koonchora abanto batige ebibe biabo na ogokora kwabo okobe.
english: But if they had stood in my council, they would have proclaimed my words to my people and would have turned them from their evil ways and from their evil deeds.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo kobaraange kobogoria egekombe ekio korwa ase okoboko kwao na konywa edivai eria, obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire: Goika moyenywe.
english: But if they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink, tell them, 'This is what the LORD Almighty says: You must drink it!

ekegusii: Korende kobaratotebie: Inchuo, tiira gocha aa asetore, erio totiire, ekiagera ekio nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asetore ng’a Omonene obabekire ase amaboko aito.”
english: But if they say, 'Come up to us,' we will climb up, because that will be our sign that the LORD has given them into our hands."

ekegusii: Korende onye embusuro eyio yainekirwe ase amache ime, na egwerwe neyemo ye ching’iti echio ekwete, rirorio nebe etachenegeti.”
english: But if water has been put on the seed and a carcass falls on it, it is unclean for you.

ekegusii: Gaki, onye tore nendagera ne chianga, inatoisaneke nebinto ebio.
english: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with that.

ekegusii: Korende gatorasemerie egento totarakerora, nigo togokeganya ase oboremereria.
english: But if we hope for what we do not yet have, we wait for it patiently.

ekegusii: Korende gatoregambie buya intwe abanyene, anga titwagambigwa.
english: But if we judged ourselves, we would not come under judgment.

ekegusii: Naende toise goteba: Nase mwanyabanto yarwete, nkoiroka tore omoganda, ekiagera abanto bonsi banchete ng’a Yohana nomobani orenge.”
english: But if we say, 'From men'-- we are afraid of the people, for they all hold that John was a prophet."

ekegusii: Korende toise goteba: Nase mwanyabanto yarwete, abanto bonsi nabatoake amagena; ekiagera banchire ng’a Yohana nomobani orenge.”
english: But if we say, 'From men,' all the people will stone us, because they are persuaded that John was a prophet."

ekegusii: Gose toise goteba: Nase mwanyabanto yarwete?” — Bakairoka abanto, ekiagera abanto bonsi mbaroche ng’a Yohana nomobani bw’ekeene.
english: But if we say, 'From men'...." (They feared the people, for everyone held that John really was a prophet.)

ekegusii: Korende onye tokogenda ase omobaso, buna ere are ase omobaso, rirorio twabwatanire intwe ase intwe, na amanyinga a Yeso, Omwana oye, nigo agotosibia ebibe biaito bionsi.
english: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus, his Son, purifies us from all sin.

ekegusii: “Naende Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Monyigwere, timorenta egurube ende yonsi ase ebiita bi’omochie oyo ase rituko ri’Esabato; morende rituko ri’Esabato ribe richenu, na timokora emeremo ende yonsi ase rituko erio.
english: But if you are careful to obey me, declares the LORD, and bring no load through the gates of this city on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy by not doing any work on it,

ekegusii: Korende komokoraagwa n’Omoika, rirorio timori inse y’amachiko.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under law.

ekegusii: Korende koranyuome, tari ebibe gwakora; na omoiseke omwekungi karanyuomwe, tari ebibe akora. Korende abanto abwo nababe nemechando y’ense eye, na inche ninyanchete ng’a timosoa ase emechando eyio.
english: But if you do marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. But those who marry will face many troubles in this life, and I want to spare you this.

ekegusii: Korende motaabereti abanto ogosaria kwabo, na Iso oino takobaabera ogosaria kwaino.”
english: But if you do not forgive men their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins.

ekegusii: Korende onye timogotegerera, inche nindere bobisi ase engencho y’oboenenu bwaino. Nindere nobororo obonge, na amariga amange aiteke korwa ase amaiso aane, ekiagera riicho ri’Omonene rioosirwe na koirwa ase obosomba.
english: But if you do not listen, I will weep in secret because of your pride; my eyes will weep bitterly, overflowing with tears, because the LORD's flock will be taken captive.

ekegusii: Goika monyigwere, erinde morende rituko ri’Esabato ribe richenu, gose timobaisa gosoyia egurube ende yonsi ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu ase rituko erio. Onye timokonyigwera, rirorio inche nintongie omorero ase ebiita bi’omochie oyio, noro nosambe na osirie chinyomba chi’oboruoti chire agwo Yerusalemu, na omorero oyio tokorimigwa.”
english: But if you do not obey me to keep the Sabbath day holy by not carrying any load as you come through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle an unquenchable fire in the gates of Jerusalem that will consume her fortresses.'"

ekegusii: Motaigwereti eriogi ri’Omonene, korende mokwanga koigwera amachiko aya, rirorio okoboko kwaye nigo korabe mamincha yaino buna kwarenge mamincha ye chisokoro chiaino.
english: But if you do not obey the LORD, and if you rebel against his commands, his hand will be against you, as it was against your fathers.

ekegusii: Korende onye timokoigwera amang’ana aya, inche omonyene netianirie ng’a enyomba eye nebe bosa. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: But if you do not obey these commands, declares the LORD, I swear by myself that this palace will become a ruin.'"

ekegusii: Korende korakurere omonyaboronge ng’a takora ebibe, na ere abe takora ebibe, ekeene, ere nabe moyo, ekiagera aigwerete ogokurerwa, na aye nobe gwatooririe obogima bwao.”
english: But if you do warn the righteous man not to sin and he does not sin, he will surely live because he took warning, and you will have saved yourself."

ekegusii: Korende aye korakurere omokori amabe oyio, na ere aange koonchoka korwa ase ebibe biaye, ne chinchera chiaye chi’obobe, oyio goika akwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende aye omonyene nobe gwatooririe obogima bwao.
english: But if you do warn the wicked man and he does not turn from his wickedness or from his evil ways, he will die for his sin; but you will have saved yourself.

ekegusii: Korende korakurere omokori amabe ng’a aonchoke atige enchera yaye, na ere aange koyetiga, oyio nakwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende aye notoorie omoyo oo.
english: But if you do warn the wicked man to turn from his ways and he does not do so, he will die for his sin, but you will have saved yourself.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi oranyore obwate ebinyasae biao goika aitwe akwe. Tiga abaminto aba bare aa babe kirori. Rigia! Koranyore kende kiao kere asende, okeire.” Yakobo tamanyete ng’a Raeli obiibire.
english: But if you find anyone who has your gods, he shall not live. In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself whether there is anything of yours here with me; and if so, take it." Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the gods.

ekegusii: Korende onye more ne ribero rire nobororo, na okweancha ase chinkoro chiaino ime, timwetogia na gokwana oborimo igoro y’ekeene.
english: But if you harbor bitter envy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast about it or deny the truth.

ekegusii: Korende onye gwatomanire nomonto omoao ase ogotaba omwegenwa ase omosacha oo, na gwekorire omosaria,
english: But if you have gone astray while married to your husband and you have defiled yourself by sleeping with a man other than your husband"--

ekegusii: Korende onye taibo, tiga omorero osoke korwa ase Abimeleki obasambe inwe abamomenyete Sekemu na Beti‐Milo, obasirie; naende tiga omorero osoke korwa asemore inwe abamomenyete Sekemu na Beti‐Milo, osambe Abimeleki, omosirie.”
english: But if you have not, let fire come out from Abimelech and consume you, citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and let fire come out from you, citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo, and consume Abimelech!"

ekegusii: Korende koratige koria eira, tokobarerwa ebibe ase ayio.
english: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty.

ekegusii: Omonene onyorokirie amang’ana arabe asore onye gokwanga kwerua.
english: But if you refuse to surrender, this is what the LORD has revealed to me:

ekegusii: korende komoraange koigwera naende komorasarie, goika moitwe nemioro. Nabo inche Omonene natebire nomonwa one.”
english: but if you resist and rebel, you will be devoured by the sword." For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.

ekegusii: Korende komorang’iranere na kobwata amachiko aane, nonya mwaserigwe gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense, nigo ndabasangererie korwa aase agwo, mbarente aase nachorire kobeka erieta riane ribeereo.
english: but if you return to me and obey my commands, then even if your exiled people are at the farthest horizon, I will gather them from there and bring them to the place I have chosen as a dwelling for my Name.'

ekegusii: Korende oise koirana ase omochie na gotebia Abisalomu: Aye omoruoti, nigo ndabe omosomba oo buna narenge omosomba o iso agwo ritang’ani, naboigo bono ndabe omosomba oo, erio nario orankonye tosarie omoroberio bw’Ahitofeli.
english: But if you return to the city and say to Absalom, 'I will be your servant, O king; I was your father's servant in the past, but now I will be your servant,' then you can help me by frustrating Ahithophel's advice.

ekegusii: Korende onye more mogwanchereria abanto, mwakorire ebibe, na mwaenekigwe namachiko ng’a nabasaria more.
english: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as lawbreakers.

ekegusii: Korende komorantebie chindoto chiria amo nengencho yaye, rirorio nimbae ebiegwa, na eng’eria, na amasikani amanene. Bono ntebie chindoto chiria amo nengencho yaye.”
english: But if you tell me the dream and explain it, you will receive from me gifts and rewards and great honor. So tell me the dream and interpret it for me."

ekegusii: Korararire amang’ana aito na otosigaane, erio natosiborwe korwa ase eira twatianire.”
english: But if you tell what we are doing, we will be released from the oath you made us swear."

ekegusii: Korende aye korarigie Nyasae na gosaba ase oboitongo ere oyore Omonguru,
english: But if you will look to God and plead with the Almighty,

ekegusii: Korende motancheti mwarokigwe, rirorio nigo torarusie omoiseke ominto aa, togende nere.”
english: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, we'll take our sister and go."

ekegusii: Korende onye togotomoa togende komo, rirorio titokogenda, ekiagera omonto oria nigo atotebetie: Timokondora obosio bwane motacheti noyio omino.”
english: But if you will not send him, we will not go down, because the man said to us, 'You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.'"

ekegusii: Korende koraange kwerua ase abagambi baria b’omoruoti o Babeli, rirorio omochie oyo nobekwe ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, na barabwo mbayosambe nomorero, naye omonyene tokorua ase amaboko abo otooreke.”
english: But if you will not surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, this city will be handed over to the Babylonians and they will burn it down; you yourself will not escape from their hands.'"

ekegusii: korende onye eriso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi noichorwe nomosunte. Onye oborabu boria bore ime yao bwabeire omosunte, omosunte oyio nomonene mono.”
english: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!

ekegusii: Korende mogochia koonchoka ase chinkoro chiaino na komotiga timomoigwera, korende mong’uswe moonchoke gosasima chinyasae ching’ao na gochikorera,
english: But if your heart turns away and you are not obedient, and if you are drawn away to bow down to other gods and worship them,

ekegusii: “Korende omosomba oria karatebe ng’a tatageti kogotiga agende, ekiagera ogwanchire aye, amo neamate yao, naende igo aisanegete komenya bwoo,
english: But if your servant says to you, "I do not want to leave you," because he loves you and your family and is well off with you,
