ekegusii: Korende omokuani karamorenge na arore ng’a amarionya ’egesambo keria tari amarabu, na tigekoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende giachakire gosira, omokuani abeke omonto oria ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: But if, when the priest examines it, there is no white hair in it and it is not more than skin deep and has faded, then the priest is to put him in isolation for seven days.

ekegusii: Omokuani kararenge richoncho riria na arore ng’a tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, naende amarionya amamwamu tari aroro, erio omokuani amobeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: But if, when the priest examines this kind of sore, it does not seem to be more than skin deep and there is no black hair in it, then the priest is to put the infected person in isolation for seven days.

ekegusii: Korende titwaigete ang’e ase ense y’Abaamori, gose ase chingegu chi’orooche rwa Yaboki, na emechie y’ense y’ebitunwa, na aande onsi ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, atokanetie titogendao.”
english: But in accordance with the command of the LORD our God, you did not encroach on any of the land of the Ammonites, neither the land along the course of the Jabbok nor that around the towns in the hills.

ekegusii: Korende bono Nyasae obekire ebiimo, kera ekemo ase omobere buna arigetie.
english: But in fact God has arranged the parts in the body, every one of them, just as he wanted them to be.

ekegusii: Korende buna atorierete eira ntotengerete igoro enyia na ense enyia, ase ebio oboronge mboreo ime yabo.
english: But in keeping with his promise we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, the home of righteousness.

ekegusii: Korende tinkogochanda kobua, nagosoroire ototegerere ase amang’ana amake ase ogwancha kwao.
english: But in order not to weary you further, I would request that you be kind enough to hear us briefly.

ekegusii: Korende ase rituko erio oyio nakane bokong’u, atebe, “Inche tinkonyara koba omogwenia; ase enyomba yane endagera teiyo, gose eanga, ase ayio timokonyara kombeka imbe omoraai bw’abanto.”
english: But in that day he will cry out, "I have no remedy. I have no food or clothing in my house; do not make me the leader of the people."

ekegusii: Nonya Musa norokereretie ng’a abakure nkobokigwa bare. Ayio nabo atebete agwo ase ring’ana ri’egetutu, ekero agwatora Omonene ng’a nere Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo.
english: But in the account of the bush, even Moses showed that the dead rise, for he calls the Lord 'the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

ekegusii: korende nanchire gokwana amang’ana atano ase ekanisa ase obong’aini bwane, inyare kworokereria abande, kobua gokwana amang’ana chilifu ikomi ase emenwa etamanyekaneti.
english: But in the church I would rather speak five intelligible words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.

ekegusii: korende ekero omomalaika o gatano na kabere arabugie egetureri kiaye, obobisi bwa Nyasae naboikeranigwe, buna arareretie abasomba baye ababani.”
english: But in the days when the seventh angel is about to sound his trumpet, the mystery of God will be accomplished, just as he announced to his servants the prophets."

ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kwa Yosia, Rituko erio Rinene ri’Epasaka rikainyorwa na korendwa ase Omonene, agwo Yerusalemu.
english: But in the eighteenth year of King Josiah, this Passover was celebrated to the LORD in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Korende omoerio bw’omokungu oyio nigo ore omororo buna ekemeri ekeroro, na omwoge buna omoyio o birende otieririe chinsemo chionsi ibere.
english: but in the end she is bitter as gall, sharp as a double-edged sword.

ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka o gatano inamorie amatunda ’emete eyio. Komorakore igo, emete inayame amatunda amange asemore. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: But in the fifth year you may eat its fruit. In this way your harvest will be increased. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ororeria rwa Israeli mbanyore oboronge na gwetogia ase Omonene.”
english: But in the LORD all the descendants of Israel will be found righteous and will exult.

ekegusii: Korende omwaka o gatano na kabere obe omwaka bw’ogotimoka; ense etimokigwe kegima ase Esabato y’Omonene. Ase omwaka oyio timosimeka kende ase emegondo yaino, gose gochera emesabibu yaino.
english: But in the seventh year the land is to have a sabbath of rest, a sabbath to the LORD. Do not sow your fields or prune your vineyards.

ekegusii: Korende ase omwaka o gatato Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akagenda ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: But in the third year Jehoshaphat king of Judah went down to see the king of Israel.

ekegusii: Korende ekero babete nemechando bakairaneria Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na komorigia, na ere akaba okonyorekana asebare.
english: But in their distress they turned to the LORD, the God of Israel, and sought him, and he was found by them.

ekegusii: korende ase amatuko aya ay’omoerio okwanire naintwe goetera ase Omwana oye. Ere oyo Nyasae aragete koba omonyamwando bw’ebinto bionsi, na goetera asare agatonga ense.
english: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, and through whom he made the universe.

ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’amabera ao amange, tikwabasiretie gose kobatiga, ekiagera aye Nyasae oito nomuya ore, na omonyene amabera.”
english: But in your great mercy you did not put an end to them or abandon them, for you are a gracious and merciful God.

ekegusii: Tiga Omonene Kristo acheneke ase chinkoro chiaino ime. Botambe mobe ang’e koiraneria kera omonto oyokobaboria amang’ana ’ogosemeria okore ime yaino, korende kora ayio ase obwororo na ase okoiroka.
english: But in your hearts set apart Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have. But do this with gentleness and respect,

ekegusii: Korende oyomwabo nigo agosoera oyomwabo, na ayio nase obosio bw’abwo bategeneti.
english: But instead, one brother goes to law against another-- and this in front of unbelievers!

ekegusii: Korende Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, amo nabanto bande batano na batato, bagatama korwa ase Yohanani, bakagenda ase Abaamoni.
english: But Ishmael son of Nethaniah and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and fled to the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira chitugo na ebinto binde basakorete bikaba ebiabo, buna Omonene atebetie Yoshua.
english: But Israel did carry off for themselves the livestock and plunder of this city, as the LORD had instructed Joshua.

ekegusii: Barabwo bangire amang’ana are amaya, ase ayio ababisa mbababwatie.
english: But Israel has rejected what is good; an enemy will pursue him.

ekegusii: Israeli akarambora okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, agakobeka igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, nonya ere orenge omoke; agakorekania amaboko aye na kobeka okoboko kwaye gw’okobee igoro ase omotwe o Manase, nere orenge omotangi.
english: But Israel reached out his right hand and put it on Ephraim's head, though he was the younger, and crossing his arms, he put his left hand on Manasseh's head, even though Manasseh was the firstborn.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli mbatoorigwe n’Omonene ase ogotoorigwa gwa kare na kare, inwe Abaisraeli timogosookigwa, gose gotantanigwa kare na kare.
english: But Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation; you will never be put to shame or disgraced, to ages everlasting.

ekegusii: korende Abaisraeli abare korigia oboronge bokorwa ase amachiko, tibaikerete oboronge boria.
english: but Israel, who pursued a law of righteousness, has not attained it.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete ase engencho y’ebibe bi’ababani baye, na ebi’abakuani baye, abwo baiterete amanyinga ’abanyene oboronge, agwo ase omochie ime.
english: But it happened because of the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed within her the blood of the righteous.

ekegusii: bwaorokigwe bono ase okoorokigwa kw’Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso. Ere agasiria chinguru chi’amakweri, na akarenta obogima na ogotasareka goetera ase enchili.
english: but it has now been revealed through the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who has destroyed death and has brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nere okonacha ekina, okeyia oyomo, na oimokereria oyonde igoro.
english: But it is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.

ekegusii: Korende gotigara ase omobere nkogwenerete kobua ase engencho yaino.
english: but it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.

ekegusii: Korende omoika nore ime ase mwanyabanto, omoika oyio bw’Omonguru noro okobaa okomanya.
english: But it is the spirit in a man, the breath of the Almighty, that gives him understanding.

ekegusii: Korende bono naye ogonkorera bobe, aye oyo kwarenge obomo nainche, omosani tomanyaine.
english: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend,

ekegusii: Korende inwe more nengencho ng’a nabasiborera omonto oyomo ase ekero ki’Epasaka; nabo morigetie mbasiborere Omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?”
english: But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release 'the king of the Jews'?"

ekegusii: korende ekiagera nigo abanchete, naende akagania goikerania eira eria arierete chisokoro chiaino. Ayio akagera Omonene akabang’anyia nokoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru, na kobabooria korwa ase ense y’obosomba korwa ase okoboko gwa Farao, omoruoti o Misiri.
english: But it was because the LORD loved you and kept the oath he swore to your forefathers that he brought you out with a mighty hand and redeemed you from the land of slavery, from the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

ekegusii: Korende Sulemani nere omoagacherete enyomba.
english: But it was Solomon who built the house for him.

ekegusii: Korende omosabibu oria ogasimorwa ase engencho y’endamwamu, ogatugutwa inse; omwaga okagusa korwa moocha, okayuomia; amasabibu aye akang’urorwa korwao, ritina riaye rikong’u rikoma, rigasambwa nomorero rikaera.
english: But it was uprooted in fury and thrown to the ground. The east wind made it shrivel, it was stripped of its fruit; its strong branches withered and fire consumed them.

ekegusii: Inwe mwaroche namaiso aino emeremo yonsi emenene Omonene akorete.
english: But it was your own eyes that saw all these great things the LORD has done.

ekegusii: Korende nebe aororo ase Turo na Sidoni ase rituko riria ri’ekina kobua asemore.
english: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.

ekegusii: Korende abwo bakoa omomochi egesusuro mbanyore amaya amo nogosesenigwa okuya.
english: But it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and rich blessing will come upon them.

ekegusii: Korende Itai akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye omoruoti, omonene one, ore moyo, aande onsi ase ogochia, onye nase ogokwa, gose ase okoba moyo, agwo nao nainche, omosomba oo, ndabe.”
english: But Ittai replied to the king, "As surely as the LORD lives, and as my lord the king lives, wherever my lord the king may be, whether it means life or death, there will your servant be."

ekegusii: Korende Benjamin, omwabo Yusufu, Yakobo tamotiga agende amo nabarabwo, ekiagera nigo oboete ng’a aande nabaise gochia konyorwa namabe.
english: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph's brother, with the others, because he was afraid that harm might come to him.

ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, nomanyete ng’a abana nebing’werere mbwate, naende chimbori ne ching’ondi nigo chibwate chimanwa chikogonka, ne chiombe boigo. Ching’iti echio chiise koayererigwa ase rituko erimo, nigo chirakwe chionsi.
english: But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are tender and that I must care for the ewes and cows that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard just one day, all the animals will die.

ekegusii: Akamokania, “Omwana one tagotirimboka amo nainwe, ekiagera oyomwabo okure, na oyo nere otigarete bweka. Amabe aise gochia komonyora agwo inchera, nigo moragere ngende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiane inde nomoichano.”
english: But Jacob said, "My son will not go down there with you; his brother is dead and he is the only one left. If harm comes to him on the journey you are taking, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in sorrow."

ekegusii: Yakobo akamotebia, “Karatiana ritang’ani asende,” Esau agatiana, erio akaooneria Yakobo omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.
english: But Jacob said, "Swear to me first." So he swore an oath to him, selling his birthright to Jacob.

ekegusii: Sisera konya orosire mono, akarara chitoro chindito. Erio Yaeli, moka Heberi, akaimokia ekerochi ki’eema na ekegogi agachoba ng’ora ng’ora gochia ase Sisera, akamoaka ekerochi keria korwa chintakunero goetera ase omotwe gochia inse ase riroba, na ere agakwa.
english: But Jael, Heber's wife, picked up a tent peg and a hammer and went quietly to him while he lay fast asleep, exhausted. She drove the peg through his temple into the ground, and he died.

ekegusii: Na Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, agatoma amang’ana ase Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akamotebia, “Rigeri erimo ria Lebanoni rigatoma amang’ana ase omocharake ore Lebanoni, rigateba: Ing’a omoiseke oo, omwana one omomura amonyuome. Erio eng’iti y’orosana ya Lebanoni egaeta aase agwo egatiringera inse rigeri riria.
english: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: "A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, 'Give your daughter to my son in marriage.' Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.

ekegusii: Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, agatoma amang’ana ase Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agateba, “Rigeri ria Lebanoni rigatoma amang’ana ase omocharake ore Lebanoni, rigakwana: Karue omoiseke oo, omwana one omomura amonyuome. Erio eng’iti y’orosana ya Lebanoni egaeta aase agwo, egatiringera inse rigeri riria.
english: But Jehoash king of Israel replied to Amaziah king of Judah: "A thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar in Lebanon, 'Give your daughter to my son in marriage.' Then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle underfoot.

ekegusii: Naende akamotebia, “Ritang’ani tiga toborie Omonene igoro y’amang’ana ayio.”
english: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "First seek the counsel of the LORD."

ekegusii: Naende Yehosafati agatebia omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, “Ritang’ani toborie Omonene igoro y’amang’ana aya.”
english: But Jehoshaphat also said to the king of Israel, "First seek the counsel of the LORD."

ekegusii: Erio Yehosafati akaboria, “Inee! Omobani bw’Omonene tari aa toranyare koboria Omonene goetera asare?” Omosomba oyomo bw’omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akairaneria, “Elisha, mosinto o Safati, nao are aiga, oria oumorete amache ase amaboko ’Elija.”
english: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there no prophet of the LORD here, that we may inquire of the LORD through him?" An officer of the king of Israel answered, "Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He used to pour water on the hands of Elijah."

ekegusii: Korende Yehosafati akaboria, “Inee! Omobani onde bw’Omonene tari aiga, tonyare koboria goetera asare?”
english: But Jehoshaphat asked, "Is there not a prophet of the LORD here whom we can inquire of?"

ekegusii: Korende Yehoseba, mosubati o Yehoramu omoruoti, omosubati omwabo Ahasia, akaira Yoashi, mosinto bw’Ahasia, bobisi korwa ase egati y’abana b’omoruoti, baria barenge ang’e goitwa. Omoiseke oria akamobeka amo nomoreri oye ase akanyomba g’okorara. Ase enchera eye akabisa Yoashi ng’a Atalia tamoita.
english: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and sister of Ahaziah, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes, who were about to be murdered. She put him and his nurse in a bedroom to hide him from Athaliah; so he was not killed.

ekegusii: Korende Yehoseba, mosubati o Yehoramu omoruoti, akarusia Yoashi, omwana bw’Ahasia, bobisi, korwa ase egati y’abana b’omoruoti, abwo barenge ang’e goitwa, akamoira amo nomoreri oye, akamobisa ase akanyomba gakorarwa. Aroro Yehoseba, mosubati o Yehoramu omoruoti, oyorenge moka Yehoyada omokuani, akabisa Yoashi korwa ase Atalia, erinde tamoita. Ayio nigo ayakorete, ekiagera arenge omosubati omwabo Ahasia.
english: But Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram, took Joash son of Ahaziah and stole him away from among the royal princes who were about to be murdered and put him and his nurse in a bedroom. Because Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram and wife of the priest Jehoiada, was Ahaziah's sister, she hid the child from Athaliah so she could not kill him.

ekegusii: But Jeremiah answered them, "Tell Zedekiah,
english: Erio Yeremia akabairaneria, “Tebia Zedekia

ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tiga tokora igo.” Akamokuna ogoto, akamogwenia.
english: But Jesus answered, "No more of this!" And he touched the man's ear and healed him.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Yudas, nkomorua ore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ase okomonyunyunta?”
english: but Jesus asked him, "Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?"

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, ogoteba, “Batige abana bache asende, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oboruotibwa Nyasae nobwabo.
english: But Jesus called the children to him and said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso agacha akabakuna, akabora, “Imoka, timobaisa kwoboa.”
english: But Jesus came and touched them. "Get up," he said. "Don't be afraid."

ekegusii: Erio kegima Yeso agakwana nabarabwo, akabora, “Remia chinkoro! Ninche. Timoiroka!”
english: But Jesus immediately said to them: "Take courage! It is I. Don't be afraid."

ekegusii: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.
english: Akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, erinde arore oria okora ring’ana erio.

ekegusii: Korende akamanya ebirengererio biabo, agatebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Imoka, otenene gati aa!” Akaimoka agatenena.
english: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said to the man with the shriveled hand, "Get up and stand in front of everyone." So he got up and stood there.

ekegusii: Korende ere tairaneria rinde, nonya nase ring’ana erimo, na gavuna agakumia mono.
english: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge-- to the great amazement of the governor.

ekegusii: Korende ere akerusanania, akagenda aase atari nabanto, agasaba.
english: But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed.

ekegusii: Korende agakira, tairaneria ing’ana. Omokuani omonene akamoboria naende, akamotebia, “Aye naye Kristo, Omwana bw’Omosesenigwa?”
english: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. Again the high priest asked him, "Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed One?"

ekegusii: Korende Yeso agakira. Na omokuani omonene akamotebia, “Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ore moyo, ototebie gose naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae.”
english: But Jesus remained silent. The high priest said to him, "I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Christ, the Son of God."

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Naborokirie emeremo emiya emenge erwete ase Tata; nereri ase emeremo eyio mokong’akera amagena?”
english: but Jesus said to them, "I have shown you many great miracles from the Father. For which of these do you stone me?"

ekegusii: But Jesus said, "Someone touched me; I know that power has gone out from me."
english: Yeso agateba, “Omonto onkunire, ekiagera naigure ng’a chinguru chiandure.”

ekegusii: Korende Yeso tairaneria ing’ana rinde naende, goika Pilato agakumia.
english: But Jesus still made no reply, and Pilate was amazed.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamotebia, “Ntunyana, tiga abakure batindeke abakure babo.”
english: But Jesus told him, "Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead."

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamobwata okoboko, akamoimokia, na ere agatenena.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him to his feet, and he stood up.

ekegusii: Akeonchora, akabakania. [Akabora, “Timomanyeti nomoika ore naki more noro.
english: But Jesus turned and rebuked them,

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akagenda ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.
english: But Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso tegenete asebare, ekiagera nabamanyete bonsi,
english: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all men.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso, konya omanyire obong’ainereria bwabo, akabora, “Naki mogonteema, inwe abang’ainereria?
english: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, "You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?

ekegusii: Korenge Yoabu na Abisai bakabwatia Abineri. Ekero erioba rigochia kogwa bagaika ekegoro ki’Ama, kerochie Gia, ase enchera ekogenda erooro ya Gibeoni.
english: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner, and as the sun was setting, they came to the hill of Ammah, near Giah on the way to the wasteland of Gibeon.

ekegusii: Korende Yoabu tabarete Abalawi na Ababenjamin, ekiagera ogochika koria omoruoti aruete nigo kwamogechetie.
english: But Joab did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering, because the king's command was repulsive to him.

ekegusii: Korende Yoabu akairaneria omoruoti, “Omonene, Nyasae oo, amente abanto ara amagana atakobareka, na aye omonene one omoruoti obe moyo goika oyarore. Korende naki ring’ana eri riakogwenera aye omonene one omoruoti?”
english: But Joab replied to the king, "May the LORD your God multiply the troops a hundred times over, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it. But why does my lord the king want to do such a thing?"

ekegusii: Yoabu agateba, “Omonene amente abanto baye bamentekane ara rigana ase omobaro obo. Inee! Aye omoruoti, omonene one, abanto aba bonsi tibari abasomba bao? Nase ki aye omonene one okogania gokora ayio? Nase ki ogochia korenta okomocha igoro ase Abaisraeli?”
english: But Joab replied, "May the LORD multiply his troops a hundred times over. My lord the king, are they not all my lord's subjects? Why does my lord want to do this? Why should he bring guilt on Israel?"

ekegusii: Yoashi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akaimokia ebiegwa bionsi biria Yehosafati, na Yehoramu, na Ahasia, chisokoro chiaye, abaruoti b’Abayuda, baatananete koba ebichenu, amo nebiegwa biaye omonyene bi’ogwancha, ne chitahabu chionsi chianyoretwe ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene na ey’omoruoti, Erio agatoma ebinto biria bionsi ase Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria. Erio Hasaeli agatiga Yerusalemu.
english: But Joash king of Judah took all the sacred objects dedicated by his fathers-- Jehoshaphat, Jehoram and Ahaziah, the kings of Judah-- and the gifts he himself had dedicated and all the gold found in the treasuries of the temple of the LORD and of the royal palace, and he sent them to Hazael king of Aram, who then withdrew from Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Korende Yoashi agatebia abwo bonsi bachete koamererania nere, “Inee! Ninwe mokorwanerera Baali? Gose ninwe mokoyekengera? Onde bwensi okoyerwanerera goika aitwe ritang’ani emambia ende etaraika. Onye Baali nenyasae, tiga erwanerere ere bweka omonyene. Egesasimero kiaye nakio giatagoirwe.”
english: But Joash replied to the hostile crowd around him, "Are you going to plead Baal's cause? Are you trying to save him? Whoever fights for him shall be put to death by morning! If Baal really is a god, he can defend himself when someone breaks down his altar."

ekegusii: But Job has not marshaled his words against me, and I will not answer him with your arguments.
english: Ayubu takwanete nainche amang’ana ande ay’okweegerera, na inche tinkomoiraneria buna inwe.

ekegusii: Korende Yohana akarigia kwanga, agateba, “Inche ndigetie kobatiswa naye, na aye kogocha asende?”
english: But John tried to deter him, saying, "I need to be baptized by you, and do you come to me?"

ekegusii: Korende Yonadabu, mosinto o Simea omwabo Daudi, akabora, “Omonene one, tokaga ng’a mbonsi baitirwe; Amunoni nere bweka oitwa okwa. Aya igo Abisalomu ayaroberetie ase ebirengererio biaye korwa rituko riria Amunoni akorerete Tamari, omoiseke omwabo, amang’ana ’obosooku.
english: But Jonadab son of Shimeah, David's brother, said, "My lord should not think that they killed all the princes; only Amnon is dead. This has been Absalom's expressed intention ever since the day Amnon raped his sister Tamar.

ekegusii: Korende Yona akaimoka, agatama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio bw’Omonene. Agatirimboka gochia Yopa, na agwo akanyora emeeri ekogenda Tarisisi. Erio agaakana chibesa chi’orogendo, agasoa ime, akagenda amo nabanto bande gotama gochia Tarisisi ng’a arue ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: But Jonah ran away from the LORD and headed for Tarshish. He went down to Joppa, where he found a ship bound for that port. After paying the fare, he went aboard and sailed for Tarshish to flee from the LORD.

ekegusii: But Jonah was greatly displeased and became angry.
english: Yona akagechigwa namang’ana ayio, akaba nendamwamu.

ekegusii: Korende Yonathani taigwete ekero ise achigete abanto ase okobatiania ng’a tibaria kende. Ase ayio, akarambaria enyimbo yarenge koboko kwaye akayechobia ase eriana rire nobooke ime, akaribwata, akariria. Erio amaiso aye akarora buya.
english: But Jonathan had not heard that his father had bound the people with the oath, so he reached out the end of the staff that was in his hand and dipped it into the honeycomb. He raised his hand to his mouth, and his eyes brightened.

ekegusii: Korende Yusufu akabatebia, “Timoiroka! Inee! Inche inde ribaga ria Nyasae?
english: But Joseph said to them, "Don't be afraid. Am I in the place of God?

ekegusii: Yusufu akabora, “Yaya, taibo; tingokora bo. Omonto oyo bweka egekombe kianyorekana koboko kwaye, nere orabe omosomba one, korende inwe abande, genda nomorembe seino ase iso.”
english: But Joseph said, "Far be it from me to do such a thing! Only the man who was found to have the cup will become my slave. The rest of you, go back to your father in peace."

ekegusii: Yoshua agachika abanto baria, akabatebia, “Timoaka eriogi ri’esegi, gose gokwana ing’ana rinde nonya ng’ake goika rituko riria ndabatebie ng’a moake eriogi ri’esegi. Erio nario moraake eriogi ri’esegi.”
english: But Joshua had commanded the people, "Do not give a war cry, do not raise your voices, do not say a word until the day I tell you to shout. Then shout!"

ekegusii: Yoshua agatebia abanto b’ebisaku bi’Efraimu na Manase (abw’ororeria rwa Yusufu), “Amaene, inwe nabanto abange more, naende nigo more ne chinguru. Ase ayio, ensemo eyemo yoka tekobaisana ase okomenya.
english: But Joshua said to the house of Joseph-- to Ephraim and Manasseh-- "You are numerous and very powerful. You will have not only one allotment

ekegusii: Yoshua agatooria obogima bwa Rahabu, na obw’abanto b’enyomba ya ise, na obw’abanto baye bonsi, ekiagera abisete abanto baria batometwe nere koroota Yeriko. Ase ayio Rahabu, oria omotayayi, nigo amenyete amo n’Abaisraeli, ororeria rwaye nao romenyete goika rero iga.
english: But Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her family and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent as spies to Jericho-- and she lives among the Israelites to this day.

ekegusii: Korende Yuda akamotebia, “Omonto oria nigo atochigete bokong’u, agatotebia: Timogocha kondora obosio bwane oyio omino atacheti amo nainwe.
english: But Judah said to him, "The man warned us solemnly, 'You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.'

ekegusii: Buna Omonene, Nyasae oino aikeranetie amaya onsi aya abarierete eira ng’a nakore, naboigo araikeranie amabe onsi goika abasirie korwa ase ense eye engiya abaeire.
english: But just as every good promise of the LORD your God has come true, so the LORD will bring on you all the evil he has threatened, until he has destroyed you from this good land he has given you.

ekegusii: korende buna ere, oyobarangeirie, are omochenu, naboigo nainwe mobe abachenu ase orogendo rwaino rwonsi,
english: But just as he who called you is holy, so be holy in all you do;

ekegusii: Korende buna more nobonge bw’ebinto bionsi: okwegena, na ogokwana, na obong’aini, na omokia bwonsi, na obwanchani bwaino asetore buna tobanchete inwe, nabo mobe nobonge bw’obuya obo bwonsi.
english: But just as you excel in everything-- in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in complete earnestness and in your love for us--see that you also excel in this grace of giving.

ekegusii: Nainwe mwerende mono timoba nokogania koimokia gento kende kiaragererigwe na konyora emechando. Moise gokora bo, nigo moragere Abaisraeli bonsi baragererigwe na konyora emechando.
english: But keep away from the devoted things, so that you will not bring about your own destruction by taking any of them. Otherwise you will make the camp of Israel liable to destruction and bring trouble on it.

ekegusii: Erio moyerigererie. Onye ekogenda enchera ya boronge gochia ase ense yaye ya Beti‐Semesi, rirorio momanye ng’a n’Omonene otorentera obobe obwo obonene, korende onye taibo, rirorio tomanye ng’a tari okoboko kwaye gwatoaka; ande nigo twanyora emechando eye mosiabano.”
english: but keep watching it. If it goes up to its own territory, toward Beth Shemesh, then the LORD has brought this great disaster on us. But if it does not, then we will know that it was not his hand that struck us and that it happened to us by chance."

ekegusii: Omoruoti Daudi agakania Orinani, akamotebia, “Yaya taibo, korende nigo ndabiakanere rigori riikeranu; tinkoira ekere ekiao koa Omonene gose okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa eke ntaakanereti.”
english: But King David replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on paying the full price. I will not take for the LORD what is yours, or sacrifice a burnt offering that costs me nothing."

ekegusii: Korende Yoramu omoruoti konya oiranire gochia ase Yesireeli korwarigwa chingoma chiria Abasiiria bamoagete, ekero agendete korwania Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria. Ase ayio Yehu agateba, “Onye ebi nabio ebirengererio biaino, rirorio timotiga omonto onde bwensi asoke korwa ase omochie gochia goteba amang’ana ayio agwo Yesireeli.”
english: but King Joram had returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds the Arameans had inflicted on him in the battle with Hazael king of Aram.) Jehu said, "If this is the way you feel, don't let anyone slip out of the city to go and tell the news in Jezreel."

ekegusii: Korende inche omoruoti Sulemani ninsesenigwe, na ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi nagekorwe kebe ne chinguru kegenderere botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.”
english: But King Solomon will be blessed, and David's throne will remain secure before the LORD forever."

ekegusii: Erio Zedekia omoruoti agatiana bobisi ase Yeremia, akabora, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oria ototongete agatoa obogima obo, tinkonyara kogoita gose gokobeka ase amaboko ’abanto abwo bakorigia basirie obogima bwao.”
english: But King Zedekiah swore this oath secretly to Jeremiah: "As surely as the LORD lives, who has given us breath, I will neither kill you nor hand you over to those who are seeking your life."

ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria, “Nigo nganetie ogwancherwa korwa asore, nigo namanyire boronge ng’a Omonene onsesenirie mono ase engencho yao.
english: But Laban said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the LORD has blessed me because of you."

ekegusii: Korende korakinie amagwa na amageri, nigo oraangwe na koba ang’e nokorangererigwa, na omoerio oye nogosambwa.
english: But land that produces thorns and thistles is worthless and is in danger of being cursed. In the end it will be burned.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abakogotamera mbabe nomogoko, barabwo mbatere kogenderera botambe na gochenga. Aye igo orakengere abwo banchete erieta riao, erio banyare koba nomogoko omonene ase engencho yao.
english: But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.

ekegusii: Korende onye omonto origetie gwetogia, tiga etogie ng’a namanyete inche, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde nobwanchani botari koera. Ngokora ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge ase ense, ekiagera ayio naro akongokia. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: but let him who boasts boast about this: that he understands and knows me, that I am the LORD, who exercises kindness, justice and righteousness on earth, for in these I delight," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende tiga ekeene kegenderere buna amache amange, na oboronge bobe buna orooche amache aye atari koera nonya ng’ake.
english: But let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!

ekegusii: Korende kera omonto eboyie egunia, ne ching’iti boigo chitubwe chigunia. Kera oyomo arere ne chinguru ase Nyasae aonchoke atige obobe bwaye na obourereria bore ase amaboko aye.
english: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth. Let everyone call urgently on God. Let them give up their evil ways and their violence.

ekegusii: Korende otige egesike kere nemeri yaye ase riroba, kebe gesibire nekenyuri gi’ekioma na etaai, agwo ase obonyansi oborere bw’orosana. “Egesike ekio tiga kenyirirerwe ne riime rikorwa igoro, na egetari ki’omoruoti oyio kebe amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana, agwo ase egati y’ebimeri bi’ense.
english: But let the stump and its roots, bound with iron and bronze, remain in the ground, in the grass of the field. "'Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven, and let him live with the animals among the plants of the earth.

ekegusii: Korende koreng’ana buna omokungu otari omwegenwa agotiga omosacha oye, naboigo nainwe timori abegenwa asende, mogantiga. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: But like a woman unfaithful to her husband, so you have been unfaithful to me, O house of Israel," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende oyio ogosoa aroro tamanyeti ng’a amakweri nareo, naende ng’a abageni b’omokungu oyio nigo bare agwo aase abakure.
english: But little do they know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of the grave.

ekegusii: Erio bagateba, “Rora, ndire Rituko ri’Omonene ria kera omwaka agwo Silo, sugusu ya Beteli, irianyi ya Lebona, moocha y’enchera ere gati ya Beteli na Sekemu.”
english: But look, there is the annual festival of the LORD in Shiloh, to the north of Bethel, and east of the road that goes from Bethel to Shechem, and to the south of Lebonah."

ekegusii: “Bono inwe nigo mwegenete amang’ana ’obong’ainereria atari kobakonya.
english: But look, you are trusting in deceptive words that are worthless.

ekegusii: Loti akabakania, akabatebia, “Taibo, Omonene one;
english: But Lot said to them, "No, my lords, please!

ekegusii: Korende moka Loti nigo arenge korwa nyuma, akarigereria magega, akaonchoka, akooma, akaba buna rigena ri’omonyo.
english: But Lot's wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

ekegusii: Korende mwanche ababisa baino, bakorere amaya, na korua singo, motari korengereria konyora egento gi’okoiranerigwa, eng’eria yaino nebe enene, na inwe namobe abana b’Oyore Igoro Mono, ekiagera ere nomuya ase abanto batari nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, nonya nase abang’iti.
english: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them without expecting to get anything back. Then your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High, because he is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.

ekegusii: korende agekora buna tarenge nobonene, akaimokia ekieni ki’omosomba, akaba omogwekano o mwanyabanto.
english: but made himself nothing, taking the very nature of a servant, being made in human likeness.

ekegusii: Manya gaki ase emioyo yaino, ng’a timorengereria ritang’ani eki morairanerie,
english: But make up your mind not to worry beforehand how you will defend yourselves.

ekegusii: Korende omonto nigo agokwa, bwarerigwa riroba inse; omonto nigo agotweka mo, ng’ai agochia?
english: But man dies and is laid low; he breathes his last and is no more.

ekegusii: Korende mwanyabanto takonyara kogenderera koba nogosikwa, ere nigo anga buna ching’iti chigokwa chiasira.
english: But man, despite his riches, does not endure; he is like the beasts that perish.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Manase tibaseretie abanto bamenyete Beti‐Sehani, na Taanaki, na Dori, na Ibileamu, na Megido, amo nebichie biabo. Korende Abakanani baria mbagendererete komenya ase ense eria.
english: But Manasseh did not drive out the people of Beth Shan or Taanach or Dor or Ibleam or Megiddo and their surrounding settlements, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that land.

ekegusii: Manase akaebereria Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bagakora amabe goetania aria abanto b’ebisaku bakorete, baria Omonene aseretie korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli.
english: But Manasseh led Judah and the people of Jerusalem astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the LORD had destroyed before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Abange ase abakuani, na Abalawi, na abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, baria barenge abagotu, abaroche enyomba eria ye ritang’ani, bono ekero baroche oboroso bw’eyio enyia bwabekirwe, bakarera na koiyeria amariga. Korende abange bagaaka amariogi amanene ay’omogoko.
english: But many of the older priests and Levites and family heads, who had seen the former temple, wept aloud when they saw the foundation of this temple being laid, while many others shouted for joy.

ekegusii: Korende abange abare abe ritang’ani inababe abanyuma, na abanyuma inababe abe ritang’ani.
english: But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first.

ekegusii: Korende abange abare abe ritang’ani, nababe abanyuma; na abanyuma babe abe ritang’ani.”
english: But many who are first will be last, and the last first."

ekegusii: Korende abange ase abwo abaigwete amang’ana aya bakeegena; na omobaro bw’abasacha nigo obete koreng’ana chilifu isano.
english: But many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about five thousand.

ekegusii: Abanto bakabarora bakogenda, abange ase abwo bakabamanya, bakaminyoka bwango korwa ase emechie yonsi, batang’ane goika asare.
english: But many who saw them leaving recognized them and ran on foot from all the towns and got there ahead of them.

ekegusii: Gaki, manya ring’ana eri, ng’a ase amatuko ’omoerio inachibe chingaki chi’obokong’u.
english: But mark this: There will be terrible times in the last days.

ekegusii: Korende Martha nigo arenge gochandeka ase ogokora okonge, akamochiera, akabora, “Omonene, torochi aye buna oyominto antigire ngokora kera egento inche bweka? Motebie ankonye.”
english: But Martha was distracted by all the preparations that had to be made. She came to him and asked, "Lord, don't you care that my sister has left me to do the work by myself? Tell her to help me!"

ekegusii: Korende Mariamu nigo ateneine isiko ang’e noboina, okorera; nabo gakorera, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime ase oboina.
english: but Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb

ekegusii: Korende Mariamu akagacha amang’ana aya onsi, okoyarengereria ase enkoro yaye.
english: But Mary treasured up all these things and pondered them in her heart.

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bagokorigia, tiga bakogokere na kogochengera; abwo banchete ogotooreka kwao, tiga bagenderere goteba, “Nyasae atogigwe!”
english: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation always say, "Let God be exalted!"

ekegusii: Korende abwo bonsi bagokorigia, tiga bakogokere na kogochengera; abwo banchete ogotooreka kwao batebe botambe, “Omonene nigo are omonene!”
english: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation always say, "The LORD be exalted!"

ekegusii: Abanyabibe tiga basirigwe korwa ase ense, abakori amabe tibabaisa kobao. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, Motogie Omonene!
english: But may sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Praise the LORD, O my soul. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Tiga Omonene anyabere inche omosomba oo ase amang’ana aya: Ekero omonene one akogenda ase enyomba ya Rimoni gochia gosasima aroro ogwesiirera ase okoboko kwane, nainche boigo ekero keria nyekumbe ime ase enyomba ya Rimoni. Omonene anyabere inche, omosomba oo, ase ring’ana eri.”
english: But may the LORD forgive your servant for this one thing: When my master enters the temple of Rimmon to bow down and he is leaning on my arm and I bow there also-- when I bow down in the temple of Rimmon, may the LORD forgive your servant for this."

ekegusii: Korende abanyene oboronge tiga babe nomogoko omonene, tiga babe nomochengo ase obosio bwa Nyasae, babe bagotera bare nomogoko.
english: But may the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; may they be happy and joyful.

ekegusii: Korende inche, omosomba oo, na Zadoki omokuani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Sulemani, omosomba oo, intwe tatorangereti.
english: But me your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon he did not invite.

ekegusii: Korende Mikaya agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, ring’ana Omonene aranetbie, nario ndakwane.”
english: But Micaiah said, "As surely as the LORD lives, I can tell him only what my God says."

ekegusii: Korende Mikaya agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, ring’ana Omonene arantebie, nario ndakwane.”
english: But Micaiah said, "As surely as the LORD lives, I can tell him only what the LORD tells me."

ekegusii: Moredekai akamanya ayio, akayatebia Esteri eting’ana, nere akayatebia omoruoti ribaga ria Moredekai.
english: But Mordecai found out about the plot and told Queen Esther, who in turn reported it to the king, giving credit to Mordecai.

ekegusii: Naye Musa bweka orachiche ong’ike ang’e, korende abwo bande tibang’ika ang’e. Na abanto barabwo tibachicha amo naye nonya ng’ake.”
english: but Moses alone is to approach the LORD; the others must not come near. And the people may not come up with him."

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, bagateba, “Aye Nyasae, Nyasae okorua obogima ase abanto bonsi, Inee, omonto oyomo gakorire ebibe, naye igo okogechigwa nomoganda oyo bwonsi?”
english: But Moses and Aaron fell facedown and cried out, "O God, God of the spirits of all mankind, will you be angry with the entire assembly when only one man sins?"

ekegusii: Korende Musa akabarangeria, erio Haroni amo nabatang’ani bonsi b’omosangererekano bakairana asare, na Musa agakwana nabarabwo.
english: But Moses called to them; so Aaron and all the leaders of the community came back to him, and he spoke to them.

ekegusii: Korende Abakohati Musa tabaete gento kende, ekiagera barabwo nigo baetwe emeremo y’okobogoria ebinto ebichenu, na ebio goika bibogorigwe ase amareko.
english: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were to carry on their shoulders the holy things, for which they were responsible.

ekegusii: Musa akamoboria, “Aye nigo ore ne ribero ase engencho yane? Ninganetie ng’a Omonene ae abanto bonsi omoika oye, erinde babe ababani.”
english: But Moses replied, "Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD's people were prophets and that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!"

ekegusii: Korende Musa akamotebia Nyasae, “Inche ninche ng’o, ngende ase Farao ndusie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri?”
english: But Moses said to God, "Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh and bring the Israelites out of Egypt?"

ekegusii: Musa agakwana ase obosio bw’Omonene, agateba. “Onye Abaisraeli baanga konyigwera, naki rende Farao ere arakore anyigwere, inche omonto ebikoba biane bitarokiri.”
english: But Moses said to the LORD, "If the Israelites will not listen to me, why would Pharaoh listen to me, since I speak with faltering lips?"

ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Inche nomonto ebikoba biane bitarogeti, naki rende Farao arakore anyigwere?”
english: But Moses said to the LORD, "Since I speak with faltering lips, why would Pharaoh listen to me?"

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Omonene, “Abanto aba nkoraa, nigo bare abarwani chilifu amagana atano na rimo bagotaara namagoro, naye bono gwatebire ng’a nobae chinyama barie ase omotienyi omogima.
english: But Moses said, "Here I am among six hundred thousand men on foot, and you say, 'I will give them meat to eat for a whole month!'

ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Omonene, koranche, otome omonto onde omoao oyo oranche.”
english: But Moses said, "O Lord, please send someone else to do it."

ekegusii: Musa akamosorora, akamotebia, “Koranche tobaisa gototiga, ekiagera aye nomanyete buna togochia konagotoora ase erooro. Ase ayio nobe kogototang’ana.
english: But Moses said, "Please do not leave us. You know where we should camp in the desert, and you can be our eyes.

ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Titokonyara gokora igo, ekiagera intwe ntoruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ekeng’wanso ekeragechie Abamisiri. Na onye Abamisiri bagotorora tokorua ekeng’wanso buna ekio, Inee, tibagocha gotoaka amagena?
english: But Moses said, "That would not be right. The sacrifices we offer the LORD our God would be detestable to the Egyptians. And if we offer sacrifices that are detestable in their eyes, will they not stone us?

ekegusii: Korende Musa akabatebia, “Nase ki bono mogosaria ogochika kw’Omonene. Timokonyara konyora ogosesenigwa ase okogendao.
english: But Moses said, "Why are you disobeying the LORD's command? This will not succeed!

ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Yaya, goika otoe ching’iti togochia koruera Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebinde bi’okonyenywa.
english: But Moses said, "You must allow us to have sacrifices and burnt offerings to present to the LORD our God.

ekegusii: Korende Musa agasorora Omonene, Nyasae oye, akabora, “Omonene nase ki endamwamu yao egwoka igoro y’abanto bao, abakwang’anyetie korwa Misiri ase okobua okonene, na ase okoboko kwao gwe chinguru?
english: But Moses sought the favor of the LORD his God. "O LORD," he said, "why should your anger burn against your people, whom you brought out of Egypt with great power and a mighty hand?

ekegusii: Abaminto bakorire obong’ainereria babeire buna chintuboka chi’amache, na buna chiooro chi’emegoko chigoeta chiaera.
english: But my brothers are as undependable as intermittent streams, as the streams that overflow

ekegusii: Abanto baria twagendete komo bakagera abanto bakerusia moyo, korende inche nkaba omwegenwa ase okoigwera Omonene, Nyasae one.
english: but my brothers who went up with me made the hearts of the people melt with fear. I, however, followed the LORD my God wholeheartedly.

ekegusii: Korende ning’ikeranie okobwatana kwane na Isaka, oyo Sara araibore ase engaki buna eye iga, ase omwaka ogocha.”
english: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you by this time next year."

ekegusii: Korende oyomo bweka nere omwanchi one, nere riruma riane omoikeranu. Ere nigo are omwana omomoima ng’ina abwate, oyo omoiborete nigo amwanchete. Abaiseke abwo bakamorora, bakamoroka oyosesenirie; abakungu baria chiting’ana na baria ba sere‐sere boigo bakamorora, bakamotogia.
english: but my dove, my perfect one, is unique, the only daughter of her mother, the favorite of the one who bore her. The maidens saw her and called her blessed; the queens and concubines praised her.

ekegusii: Korende amaiso aane nigo arigereretie gocha asore, aye Omonene; naye ngotamera, tibwanga omoyo one.
english: But my eyes are fixed on you, O Sovereign LORD; in you I take refuge-- do not give me over to death.

ekegusii: Korende obwanchani bwane botari koera tinkoborusia asare buna naborusetie ase Saulo oyio natigeretie korwa ase obosio bwao.
english: But my love will never be taken away from him, as I took it away from Saul, whom I removed from before you.

ekegusii: Amang’ana nare ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one, nigo are kobabeka chinguru; ee, amabeebe ay’ebikoba igoro nigo are kobaremia.
english: But my mouth would encourage you; comfort from my lips would bring you relief.

ekegusii: Korende omogondo bw’emesabibu oyore oyone bori ninche omonyene nyorendete. Aye Sulemani, ira chilifu chiao, na abarendi b’amatunda baire amagana abere.
english: But my own vineyard is mine to give; the thousand shekels are for you, O Solomon, and two hundred are for those who tend its fruit.

ekegusii: korende omonyene oboronge one nabe moyo ase okwegena, na, karasukwane, omoyo one tokogokigwa nere.”
english: But my righteous one will live by faith. And if he shrinks back, I will not be pleased with him."

ekegusii: Naamani akagechigwa; erio akagenda, ogoteba, “Rora nigo narengereria ng’a ere nigo arenge gosoka gocha asende, atenene asabe ase erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye, naende abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase ndwarete, na agwenie oborwaire bwane bwa ukoma.
english: But Naaman went away angry and said, "I thought that he would surely come out to me and stand and call on the name of the LORD his God, wave his hand over the spot and cure me of my leprosy.

ekegusii: Korende Naboti akamotebia, “Tiga Omonene atange amang’ana ayio, timbaisa gokoa omwando one naetwe ne chisokoro chiane.”
english: But Naboth replied, "The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers."

ekegusii: Nadabu na Abihu bagakwa bagatiga ise ore moyo, barabwo tibabwate abana; na igo Eleazari na Itamari bakaba abakuani.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and they had no sons; so Eleazar and Ithamar served as the priests.

ekegusii: Korende Nadabu na Abihu bagakwa ekero baruete omorero bw’engencho eng’ao otachikiri ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died when they made an offering before the LORD with unauthorized fire.)

ekegusii: Nahasi akabairaneria, “Ninkore okobwatana nainwe komoranche ng’a ndusie eriso ria borio ria kera oyomo oino, erinde ndetere Abaisraeli bonsi obosooku.”
english: But Nahash the Ammonite replied, "I will make a treaty with you only on the condition that I gouge out the right eye of every one of you and so bring disgrace on all Israel."

ekegusii: Korende Naomi akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Abana baane, irana mogende seino! Nase ki moganetie kogenda amo nainche? Inee! Ninyare naende korwa ase enda yane koibora abana bagochia koba abasacha baino?
english: But Naomi said, "Return home, my daughters. Why would you come with me? Am I going to have any more sons, who could become your husbands?

ekegusii: Korende Nebusaradani oria omoteneneri bw’abarendi agatiga abanto bande barenge abataka mono b’ense eria babeere aroro. Abwo bakaba bakoroiseria emegondo y’emesabibu na gokora emeremo y’okorema.
english: But Nebuzaradan left behind the rest of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

ekegusii: Korende omochiki oyio omonene agatigaria abanto bande ase ense y’Abayuda; baria barenge abataka mono, batabwate gento kende, abwo akabaa emegondo y’emesabibu na ase ekero ekio akabaa nemegondo ende.
english: But Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard left behind in the land of Judah some of the poor people, who owned nothing; and at that time he gave them vineyards and fields.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Misiri agatoma abanto ase Yosia, agateba, “Aye omoruoti bw’Abayuda, inki inche naye togokorerana? Rituko ria rero tindi gocha korwana esegi naye, korende nobogambi nkorwania, inde nesegi naborobwo, na Nyasae ochikire ngende bwango. Aye tiga koamererania na Nyasae, oria ore amo nainche, nabaise kogoita.”
english: But Neco sent messengers to him, saying, "What quarrel is there between you and me, O king of Judah? It is not you I am attacking at this time, but the house with which I am at war. God has told me to hurry; so stop opposing God, who is with me, or he will destroy you."

ekegusii: Inee! Inche tingwenereti koba namabeebe ase Nineva, omochie oyio omonene, agwo ase abanto goetania chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere (120,000) bamenyeteo? Abanto abwo tibamanyete gwatanana ayare ensemo ya borio na ayare ase eya bomosi. Boigo omochie oyio nobwate ching’iti chinyinge mono chitugireo.”
english: But Nineveh has more than a hundred and twenty thousand people who cannot tell their right hand from their left, and many cattle as well. Should I not be concerned about that great city?"

ekegusii: Korende oromeme, onde tari ase mwanyabanto oranyare korotuga. Rororwo nobobe, rotari kogamberwa, roichire nobosongo bokorenta amakweri.
english: but no man can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

ekegusii: Onde tarenge ase baria baikaransete ase emesa omanyete engencho yagerete amotebetie iga.
english: but no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.

ekegusii: Na onde tarenge igoro, gose ase ense, gose inse y’ense oyogwenerete koigora ebuku, gose koyerigereria.
english: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll or even look inside it.

ekegusii: Korende monto onde tari okoboria: Ng’ai Nyasae, oria ontongete, are, oyio okogera amatera ay’ogotogia aterwa botuko?
english: But no one says, 'Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

ekegusii: Korende omonto tari omwatorete maiso marore ase engencho y’okoiroka Abayahudi.
english: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the Jews.

ekegusii: Nigo narenge koigorera abaeti ebisieri biane basoa; gose onde tabete okorara isiko botuko.
english: but no stranger had to spend the night in the street, for my door was always open to the traveler--

ekegusii: Korende Nuhu akanyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende nonya nagatukia akamo k’emetwe yaino tikagosira.
english: But not a hair of your head will perish.

ekegusii: Korende tari bonsi baigwerete enchili. Naki Isaya nigo agoteba, “Omonene, ning’o bwegenire aya aigure korwa asetore?”
english: But not all the Israelites accepted the good news. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our message?"

ekegusii: Korende obong’aini obo tibori ime ase abanto bonsi. Abande, ekiagera bakwenaria emegwekano y’ogosasimwa goika bono, bakoria endagera buna egento kiarurwe ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, na ekiagera chinkoro chiabo chikobugwa bwango, nigo chikobekwa ogotacheneka.
english: But not everyone knows this. Some people are still so accustomed to idols that when they eat such food they think of it as having been sacrificed to an idol, and since their conscience is weak, it is defiled.

ekegusii: Korende bono oboronge bwa Nyasae bwaorokigwe machiko ataiyo, obwaberetwe kirori namachiko na ababani,
english: But now a righteousness from God, apart from law, has been made known, to which the Law and the Prophets testify.

ekegusii: Na bono rora, Adonia bweeire oboruoti, na aye omonene one omoruoti, tomanyeti amang’ana ayio.
english: But now Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, do not know about it.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Aye Serubabeli, obe omokong’u na aye Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, obe omokong’u, nainwe abanto bonsi abamore ase ense eye, mobe abakong’u ase ogokora emeremo, ekiagera inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo inde amo nainwe.
english: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel,' declares the LORD. 'Be strong, O Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,' declares the LORD, 'and work. For I am with you,' declares the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Korende bono ndetere omobugia obokano.” Na ekero omobugia oria arenge kobugia obokano, chinguru chi’Omonene chigacha igoro y’Elisha,
english: But now bring me a harpist." While the harpist was playing, the hand of the LORD came upon Elisha

ekegusii: Korende bono Nyasae obabwatanirie inwe amo nere omonyene ase ogokwa gwa Kristo kw’omobere oye bwe chinyama, erio abarente ase obosio bwaye, more abachenu, motari na komocha gose na bobe bonde,
english: But now he has reconciled you by Christ's physical body through death to present you holy in his sight, without blemish and free from accusation--

ekegusii: Korende bono nabarikeire ng’a timosang’anana nomonto okorokwa oyomino, karabe omotomani, gose oyokwegimeria, gose oyogosaba emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, gose omorami, gose oyogotinda, gose omouri, omonto onga buna oyio, timwancha nonya nkoria nere.
english: But now I am writing you that you must not associate with anyone who calls himself a brother but is sexually immoral or greedy, an idolater or a slanderer, a drunkard or a swindler. With such a man do not even eat.

ekegusii: korende bono nachorire Yerusalemu, erinde erieta riane ribeere aroro, naende nachorire Daudi agambere abanto baane Abaisraeli.
english: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for my Name to be there, and I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.'

ekegusii: Bono nabatebirie, remia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera monto tagosira, otatiga emeeri yoka.
english: But now I urge you to keep up your courage, because not one of you will be lost; only the ship will be destroyed.

ekegusii: Korende bono tingokorera abatigari b’abanto aba buna nakorerete ab’amatuko aria a kare. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
english: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as I did in the past," declares the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Korende bono, ase Kristo Yeso, inwe abamwarenge aare agwo ritang’ani, mwarentirwe ang’e namanyinga a Kristo.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.

ekegusii: Bono abanto b’ebisaku ebinge basangererekanire amo babarwanie esegi, bagoteba: “Tiga omochie oyio okorwe obe oyotachenegeti, naintwe tobe torigereretie Sayoni.”
english: But now many nations are gathered against you. They say, "Let her be defiled, let our eyes gloat over Zion!"

ekegusii: korende bono bwaorokigwe ase amariko ’ababani, bwamanyekanire ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi buna Nyasae o kare na kare achigete, erinde baigwere na kwegena,
english: but now revealed and made known through the prophetic writings by the command of the eternal God, so that all nations might believe and obey him--

ekegusii: Korende bono okure, nase ki rende ndeng’ate? Inee! Ninyare komoirania abe moyo? Ninche ndagende aase agenda, korende ere takoirana asende.”
english: But now that he is dead, why should I fast? Can I bring him back again? I will go to him, but he will not return to me."

ekegusii: Korende bono tindi ne ribaga rinde ri’ogokora emeremo ase chinsemo echi, naende korwa emiaka emenge narenge namaiga gocha asemore.
english: But now that there is no more place for me to work in these regions, and since I have been longing for many years to see you,

ekegusii: Korende bono ekero mwasiboirwe korwa ase ebibe na gokorwa koba abasomba ba Nyasae, okwama kwaino more nakwo noko, ng’a mokorwe koba abachenu, na omoerio oye nobogima bwa kare na kare.
english: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the benefit you reap leads to holiness, and the result is eternal life.

ekegusii: Korende bono, komwaikire komomanya Nyasae, gose kobua, mwamanyekanire na Nyasae, nase ki rende mokoiranera amorokererio aye ritang’ani, ayare amoro na amataka? Nase ki morigetie koyakorera naende?
english: But now that you know God-- or rather are known by God-- how is it that you are turning back to those weak and miserable principles? Do you wish to be enslaved by them all over again?

ekegusii: Korende bono Omonene, Nyasae one, ong’eire obotoereru korwa ase kera ensemo; ababisa tibari aande, gose amabe ande onsi.
english: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or disaster.

ekegusii: Korende bono Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase engaki y’emiaka etato, emiaka buna ey’omorikwa emeremo, nonyore ng’a obonene bw’Abamoabu bwachayirwe amo nemegada yabo emenene boigo. Abatigari babo nigo barabe abake mono abataisanere gento kende.”
english: But now the LORD says: "Within three years, as a servant bound by contract would count them, Moab's splendor and all her many people will be despised, and her survivors will be very few and feeble."

ekegusii: Bono amaiso abo abeire amamwamuti kobua embiro, tibari komanywa agwo ase chinchera; amasankwa ’emebere yabo abwatanire namauga abo, omire pa buna amasabo amomo.
english: But now they are blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets. Their skin has shriveled on their bones; it has become as dry as a stick.

ekegusii: Korende aya naro amang’ana torakorere Gibea. Igo togoaka obomera, torore gose mbarabi bagochia koyorwania.
english: But now this is what we'll do to Gibeah: We'll go up against it as the lot directs.

ekegusii: But now trouble comes to you, and you are discouraged; it strikes you, and you are dismayed.
english: Bono naye emechando yacheire, na tori noboremu bonde bwonsi, yagokunire na aye kwegosire.

ekegusii: Bono nigo tokoroka abwo bare abaenenu ng’a mbasesenirie. Abakori amabe nabwo bagendererete konyora amaya; tari ayio oka, korende nonya nekero bagoteema Nyasae nigo bagokonywa.”
english: But now we call the arrogant blessed. Certainly the evildoers prosper, and even those who challenge God escape.'"

ekegusii: Na bono chinguru chiaito chiatoereire, titobwati endagera ende tokoria otatiga mana yoka.”
english: But now we have lost our appetite; we never see anything but this manna!"

ekegusii: Korende bono aye nigo okonacherwa ekina buna eki’abakori amabe, ekina na ayare ay’ekeene mbikonyore.
english: But now you are laden with the judgment due the wicked; judgment and justice have taken hold of you.

ekegusii: But now you have rejected and humbled us; you no longer go out with our armies.
english: Nonya naboigo gwatotigire na gotosookia, tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio mokaonchora ebirengererio biaino, mogakora erieta riane rikaba eritachenegeti, ekiagera kera oyomo oino nigo airania abasomba baye, abasacha na abakungu, abwo konya mwasiboire buna barabwo baganetie. Na bono mwabarentire na kobabetereria koba abasomba baino naende.
english: But now you have turned around and profaned my name; each of you has taken back the male and female slaves you had set free to go where they wished. You have forced them to become your slaves again.

ekegusii: Korende bono mobeke aare aya onsi: endamwamu, okobea, obobe, okorama, na ogokwana okobe gokorwa ase emenwa yaino.
english: But now you must rid yourselves of all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.

ekegusii: Na bono aye nigo ogoteba ng’a ngende ntebie omonene one ng’a aye Elija nao ore aiga.
english: But now you tell me to go to my master and say, 'Elijah is here.'

ekegusii: Korende bono oboruoti bwao tibokogenderera. Omonene bwerigeirie omonto onde omogokirie ase enkoro yaye, omochikire ng’a abe okogambera abanto baye, ekiagera aye toigwereti aya Omonene agochigete.”
english: But now your kingdom will not endure; the LORD has sought out a man after his own heart and appointed him leader of his people, because you have not kept the LORD's command."

ekegusii: Naama! Inwe mwensi aba mogouta omorero, na gwesiberania ebieri, genda mosambwe nomorero oino, na ase ebieri biaino mwatongirie! Aya naro moranyore korwa ase okoboko kwane, morare inse more nobororo.
english: But now, all you who light fires and provide yourselves with flaming torches, go, walk in the light of your fires and of the torches you have set ablaze. This is what you shall receive from my hand: You will lie down in torment.

ekegusii: Korende bono twasiboirwe korwa ase amachiko, twakwereire ayatosibete, erinde tonyare gokorera ase obogima oboyia bw’Omoika, tari inse y’amachiko a kare ayarikire.
english: But now, by dying to what once bound us, we have been released from the law so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, and not in the old way of the written code.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bono, tobaisa komobara ng’a tari na komocha, ekiagera aye nomonto omong’aini; nomanye aye omonyene eki ogwenerete gokora asare, motige agende aase abakure ore ne chimbuche, ase engencho y’okomocha kwaye kw’ogoitera amanyinga.”
english: But now, do not consider him innocent. You are a man of wisdom; you will know what to do to him. Bring his gray head down to the grave in blood."

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti, omonene one, tegerera oigwe; igwera ogosorora oko kwane kw’oboitongo nkogosorora. Bono tobaisa kong’irania gochia ase enyomba eria ya Yonathani omoriki; oise gokora bo, nigo ndabaise gochia gokwera aroro.”
english: But now, my lord the king, please listen. Let me bring my petition before you: Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the secretary, or I will die there."

ekegusii: Na bono, koranche, obaabere ebibe biabo. Onye taibo, rirorio otinyie erieta riane korwa ase ebuku eria kwarigete.”
english: But now, please forgive their sin-- but if not, then blot me out of the book you have written."

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, aya naro Omonene oria obatongete na kobabomba agoteba; “Timoiroka, ekiagera inche nababooririe; nabarangeirie ase amarieta aino; inwe nabaane.
english: But now, this is what the LORD says-- he who created you, O Jacob, he who formed you, O Israel: "Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have summoned you by name; you are mine.

ekegusii: Bono nase ki togwenerete gokwa? Omorero oyo omonene nigo ogochia gotosamba na gotosiria, onye naende togochia koigwa eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae oito, goika tokwe.
english: But now, why should we die? This great fire will consume us, and we will die if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any longer.

ekegusii: Omuri agakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, agakora amabe goetania baria barengeo ritang’ani riaye.
english: But Omri did evil in the eyes of the LORD and sinned more than all those before him.

ekegusii: Abanto abatunyanete Omuri bakabua abanto batunyanete Tibuni, mosinto o Ginati; na ekero Tibuni akure, Omuri akaba omoruoti.
english: But Omri's followers proved stronger than those of Tibni son of Ginath. So Tibni died and Omri became king.

ekegusii: Korende ekero abarendi bachia goika, tibabanyora echela ime. Bakairana, bagateba,
english: But on arriving at the jail, the officers did not find them there. So they went back and reported,

ekegusii: korende tancherete Kaini na ekeegwa kiaye. Ase ayio Kaini akagechigwa, na obosio bwaye bokaonchoka, bokairura.
english: but on Cain and his offering he did not look with favor. So Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

ekegusii: “Korende ase egetunwa gia Sayoni mbabe aroro abaratooreke na aase agwo nabe aachenu. Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo nabairanerigwe ense yabo.
english: But on Mount Zion will be deliverance; it will be holy, and the house of Jacob will possess its inheritance.

ekegusii: Korende Onani akamanya ng’a abana abwo agochia koibora tibari gochia korokwa abaye. Akaba ekero are koba na moka momura omwabo, oroiboro korwachire, arorusia aitera inse, ng’a tabaisa goteneneria oyomwabo egesaku.
english: But Onan knew that the offspring would not be his; so whenever he lay with his brother's wife, he spilled his semen on the ground to keep from producing offspring for his brother.

ekegusii: Korende Yudas Iskariota mosinto o Simion, oyomo bw’aborokigwa ba Yeso oyoramorue, akabora,
english: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was later to betray him, objected,

ekegusii: Korende eke totigaretie nobwoba bw’okoganya ekina, na omorero omotindi ogwoka, ogocha gosiria abwo bakoengereria.
english: but only a fearful expectation of judgment and of raging fire that will consume the enemies of God.

ekegusii: korende egento ekemo gioka keganeirie. Mariamu ochorire ensemo ere engiya, eye ataurwe nonde.”
english: but only one thing is needed. Mary has chosen what is better, and it will not be taken away from her."

ekegusii: Korende ekerecha kenga buna eke tikegosoka otatiga ase ogosaba na okweng’ata.”]
english: But only prayer and fasting can drive this kind out; nothing else can. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version. See Mark 9:29.]

ekegusii: korende Eema ya kabere Omokuani Omonene ore gosoa bweka ara rimo kera omwaka, na tare konyara gosoa atari namanyinga, ayare korua ase engencho yaye ere omonyene na ase engencho y’amamocho ’abanto.
english: But only the high priest entered the inner room, and that only once a year, and never without blood, which he offered for himself and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.

ekegusii: Aye amo nabamura bao, ninwe mweka morakore emeremo yonsi y’obokuani, na emeremo yonsi ase egesasimero, na eria ere moino y’etoto enachete Obomenyo Obochenu. Nabaeire obokuani buna ekeegwa kebe ekiaino. Onye omonto onde omoao otachikiri ogocha ang’e ase obokoreri obwo, goika aitwe akwe.”
english: But only you and your sons may serve as priests in connection with everything at the altar and inside the curtain. I am giving you the service of the priesthood as a gift. Anyone else who comes near the sanctuary must be put to death."

ekegusii: Abande bakabora “Amang’ana aya tari ay’omonto obwatire nekerecha. Inee! Ekerecha nkenyare koramokia amaiso ’emeuko?”
english: But others said, "These are not the sayings of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?"

ekegusii: Naki obobiare bwaito igoro, bore. Korwa agwo naende ntoganyete, Omotooria, Omonene Yeso Kristo,
english: But our citizenship is in heaven. And we eagerly await a Savior from there, the Lord Jesus Christ,

ekegusii: Paulo na Barnaba bakamenya agwo Antiokia amo nabanto bande abange, bakaba bakworokereria na korandia ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: But Paul and Barnabas remained in Antioch, where they and many others taught and preached the word of the Lord.

ekegusii: korende Paulo agachora Sila. Na ekero baria bamwabo bamobekire ase obuya bw’Omonene, akaimoka akagenda.
english: but Paul chose Silas and left, commended by the brothers to the grace of the Lord.

ekegusii: Korende Paulo tarora buya bairane oyio obatigete aaria Pamfulia, na tagendete amo nabarabwo gokora emeremo eria.
english: but Paul did not think it wise to take him, because he had deserted them in Pamphylia and had not continued with them in the work.

ekegusii: Korende Paulo akabatebia, “Bagatosusura maiso marore bataratogambia kina, na intwe n’Abarumi tore, naende bagatoruta echela ime. Inee! Bono barigetie gotosokia bobisi? Yaya! Tari bo; tiga bache abanyene batosokie.”
english: But Paul said to the officers: "They beat us publicly without a trial, even though we are Roman citizens, and threw us into prison. And now do they want to get rid of us quietly? No! Let them come themselves and escort us out."

ekegusii: Korende akayesamunsera riko, taba na bobe bonde.
english: But Paul shook the snake off into the fire and suffered no ill effects.

ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaaka eriogi rinene, agateba, “Tibweita, ekiagera intwe twensi nao tore aa.”
english: But Paul shouted, "Don't harm yourself! We are all here!"

ekegusii: Korende Petero na Yohana bakabairaneria, “Onye mboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae kobaigwera inwe kobua Nyasae, monache inwe abanyene,
english: But Peter and John replied, "Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God's sight to obey you rather than God.

ekegusii: But Peter declared, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you." And all the other disciples said the same.
english: Petero akamotebia, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na aborokigwa bonsi bagateba boigo.

ekegusii: Na Petero akamotunyana korwa nyuma ore egeka, goika ase egoora y’omokuani omonene, agasoa ime, agaikaransa amo nabasomba, erinde arore omoerio.
english: But Peter followed him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. He entered and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.

ekegusii: korende Petero agatenena gesieri isiko. Nabo omworokigwa oria onde, oyomanyekanete nomokuani omonene agasoka agakwana nomoiseke orenge korenda gesieri, akarenta Petero ime.
english: but Peter had to wait outside at the door. The other disciple, who was known to the high priest, came back, spoke to the girl on duty there and brought Peter in.

ekegusii: But Peter insisted emphatically, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you." And all the others said the same.
english: Na ere akamenta gokwana mono, “Nimba ngokwa amo naye, tinkogokana nonya ng’ake.” Na bonsi bagateba boigo.

ekegusii: But Peter kept on knocking, and when they opened the door and saw him, they were astonished.
english: Petero akagenderera gokong’onta egesieri. Erio bakamoigorera, bakamorora, bagakumia.

ekegusii: Korende Petero akamoimokia, akamotebia, “Tenena! Inche boigo mwanyabanto inde.”
english: But Peter made him get up. "Stand up," he said, "I am only a man myself."

ekegusii: Ase ayio chinguru chia Farao nchionchoke chibe obosooku bwaino; na obotamero bwaino ase ekiriri kia Misiri mbobarentere ogochaywa.
english: But Pharaoh's protection will be to your shame, Egypt's shade will bring you disgrace.

ekegusii: Erio Finehasi agatenena agaakanera amabe ayio akoretwe, na oborwaire boria bogatiga goita abanto.
english: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.

ekegusii: Korende abasaria na abanyabibe nigo barasirigwe amo; na abwo batigire Omonene mbasirigwe boigo.
english: But rebels and sinners will both be broken, and those who forsake the LORD will perish.

ekegusii: Korende Rehoboamu akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria na akarigia ogosemia korwa ase abamura baria bakinete komo, na bono barenge komokorera.
english: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.

ekegusii: Korende Rehoboamu akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria, akarigia ogosemigwa korwa ase abamura b’ekegori kiaye, abwo barenge komokorera.
english: But Rehoboam rejected the advice the elders gave him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and were serving him.

ekegusii: Korende ekiagera mwabwatanire nemechando ya Kristo, goka, erinde ase okomaanorwa kw’obonene bwaye monyare kogoka boigo, na gochenga.
english: But rejoice that you participate in the sufferings of Christ, so that you may be overjoyed when his glory is revealed.

ekegusii: Moinyore ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere okobaa chinguru chi’okonyora obotenenku, ekiagera aganetie gokong’ia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania okwo akorete ne chisokoro chiaino buna akorire goika rero iga.
english: But remember the LORD your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth, and so confirms his covenant, which he swore to your forefathers, as it is today.

ekegusii: Korende amang’ana ararwe moocha na sugusu namoichanie, erio asoke ore nekeririanda ekenene aite abanto abange abasirie kegima.
english: But reports from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will set out in a great rage to destroy and annihilate many.

ekegusii: Korende mobabetererie bakore omobaro bw’amatabori oyo baare gokora ritang’ani, batari koyokeyia. Barabwo naboro. Ase ayio nigo bakona‐koboria ng’a: Toe ribaga togende koruera Nyasae oito ekeng’wanso.
english: But require them to make the same number of bricks as before; don't reduce the quota. They are lazy; that is why they are crying out, 'Let us go and sacrifice to our God.'

ekegusii: Abanto abanyaboronge mbabanachere ekina buna ekio abakungu abatomani na abaiti bakonacherwa, ekiagera barabwo nigo bare abatomani, na baiteire amanyinga ’abanto namaboko abo.”
english: But righteous men will sentence them to the punishment of women who commit adultery and shed blood, because they are adulterous and blood is on their hands.

ekegusii: Korende Rutu akamoiraneria, “Tagonsorora ng’a ngotige. Tiga ngende amo naye. Aande onsi ase aye ogochia, nainche nao ndachie; na aande onsi ase aye oramenye, nainche nao ndamenye. Abanto bao mbabe abanto baane, na Nyasae oo nabe Nyasae one.
english: But Ruth replied, "Don't urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.

ekegusii: Korende Samison akarara goika botuko gati, erio akaimoka, akabwata ebisieri bibere bi’egeita ki’omochie amo nemetobwa yaye ebere; erio akabisimora amo nebioma na ebisiekero, akabibeka ase amareko aye, akabiira igoro ase egetunwa keria kerochie Heburoni.
english: But Samson lay there only until the middle of the night. Then he got up and took hold of the doors of the city gate, together with the two posts, and tore them loose, bar and all. He lifted them to his shoulders and carried them to the top of the hill that faces Hebron.

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akamotebia, “Inee! Igo okorengereria ng’a Omonene nagokerete ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde kobua okomoigwera? Naama! Okoigwera nokuya kobua ebing’wanso, na ogotegerera nokuya kobua ebitinya bie chimingichi.
english: But Samuel replied: "Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obeying the voice of the LORD? To obey is better than sacrifice, and to heed is better than the fat of rams.

ekegusii: Samweli agakania Saulo, akamotebia, “Tinkonyara koirana amo naye, ekiagera kwangire ring’ana ri’Omonene, na Omonene okwangire, toba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.”
english: But Samuel said to him, "I will not go back with you. You have rejected the word of the LORD, and the LORD has rejected you as king over Israel!"

ekegusii: Korende Samweli akamotebia, “Buna omoro oo otigire abakungu bare bosa batari nabana, naboigo nyoko agochia gotigwa bosa atari nomwana ase egati y’abakungu bande.” Na aroro agwo Samweli akanachana Agagi ebing’ese ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: But Samuel said, "As your sword has made women childless, so will your mother be childless among women." And Samuel put Agag to death before the LORD at Gilgal.

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akamoboria, “Naki ndakore ngende? Saulo aise koigwa amang’ana ayio, nigo arang’ite.” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Bwata ritororo, oriire, otebe ng’a: Nekeng’wanso nachire komoruera Omonene.
english: But Samuel said, "How can I go? Saul will hear about it and kill me." The LORD said, "Take a heifer with you and say, 'I have come to sacrifice to the LORD.'

ekegusii: Samweli akamoboria, “Inee! Eriogi eri ri’okwana gwe ching’ondi na ogwe chiombe inyigwete namato aane, neriaki?”
english: But Samuel said, "What then is this bleating of sheep in my ears? What is this lowing of cattle that I hear?"

ekegusii: Samweli akagenderera gokora emeremo ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ere nigo arenge omosae ore kobeka egesibao ki’egatani.
english: But Samuel was ministering before the LORD-- a boy wearing a linen ephod.

ekegusii: Korende Sara akarora omwana oria bwa Hagari Omomisiri, oyio aiborerete Ibrahimu, ogosekereria Isaka, omwana oye.
english: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking,

ekegusii: Saulo amo nabanto baye bagatiga Agagi ore moyo; boigo bagatiga ching’ondi chingiya, ne chiombe, ne chimori chinoru, ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na echi chionsi chiarenge chingiya. Echio chionsi tibanchete gochisiria, korende bagasiria chionsi echio chiarenge chindeu ne chimbe.
english: But Saul and the army spared Agag and the best of the sheep and cattle, the fat calves and lambs-- everything that was good. These they were unwilling to destroy completely, but everything that was despised and weak they totally destroyed.

ekegusii: Korende Saulo agasaria ekanisa, agasoa kera enyomba akaba ogokurura abasacha na abakungu, na kobaira ase echela.
english: But Saul began to destroy the church. Going from house to house, he dragged off men and women and put them in prison.

ekegusii: Saulo konya orure Mikali, omosubati oye, oyorenge moga Daudi, ase Paliti, mosinto o Laisi bw’omochie o Galimu.
english: But Saul had given his daughter Michal, David's wife, to Paltiel son of Laish, who was from Gallim.
