ekegusii: Agwo Saulo akaimokia ritimo akamoruta amobete. Bono Yonathani akamanya ng’a ise narigetie goita Daudi.
english: But Saul hurled his spear at him to kill him. Then Jonathan knew that his father intended to kill David.

ekegusii: korende okogamba kwabo gokamanyekana na Saulo. Bakamoboera ase ebiita omobaso na obotuko, erinde banyare komoita.
english: but Saul learned of their plan. Day and night they kept close watch on the city gates in order to kill him.

ekegusii: Korende Saulo agakana, agateba, “Monto onde tari oraitwe ase rituko ria rero, ekiagera Omonene orentire obobui ase Abaisraeli.”
english: But Saul said, "No one shall be put to death today, for this day the LORD has rescued Israel."

ekegusii: Korende abaiseke bonsi abekungi timobaisa kobaita, mobaire babe abaino.
english: but save for yourselves every girl who has never slept with a man.

ekegusii: Naende mobeke abanto babere abatagwenereti, bamosoere oborimo, batebe ng’a oragereirie Nyasae na omoruoti. Erio momosokie isiko, momoake amagena goika akwe.”
english: But seat two scoundrels opposite him and have them testify that he has cursed both God and the king. Then take him out and stone him to death."

ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ogokora igo mokagoka na gochenga; mokanyenya chiombe ne ching’ondi, mokaba mokoria chinyama na konywa edivai, mogateba, “Tiga torie na konywa, ekiagera ankio natokwe.”
english: But see, there is joy and revelry, slaughtering of cattle and killing of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine! "Let us eat and drink," you say, "for tomorrow we die!"

ekegusii: Korende ritang’ani rigia oboruoti bwa Nyasae na oboronge bwaye, na ebinto ebio bionsi namomenterwe.
english: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

ekegusii: Korende rigia oboruoti bwa Nyasae, na ebinto ebio namomenterwe inwe.
english: But seek his kingdom, and these things will be given to you as well.

ekegusii: Korende ochore abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, abegenwa, abatakorigia riaaki, abaranyare koba abaraai b’abanto b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.
english: But select capable men from all the people-- men who fear God, trustworthy men who hate dishonest gain-- and appoint them as officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.

ekegusii: korende nyuma y’ayio neche emiaka ende etano na ebere y’enchara; na omoigoto oria bwonsi nigo ogochia kwebwa ase ense ya Misiri, ekiagera enchara eria nigo erarie ense eye.
english: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will ravage the land.

ekegusii: korende Sama agatenena ase omogondo gati, akayorwanerera, agaita Abafilisti, na Omonene akarenta obobui obonene mono.
english: But Shammah took his stand in the middle of the field. He defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the LORD brought about a great victory.

ekegusii: Erio Raeli agasaba Lea amwatanere amasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana oye, korende Lea akamoiraneria, “Inee! Nering’ana rike kwang’urire omosacha one, na bono korigetie koira amasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana one boigo?” Raeli akamoiraneria, “Rero nache arare naye, korang’e amasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana oo.”
english: But she said to her, "Wasn't it enough that you took away my husband? Will you take my son's mandrakes too?" "Very well," Rachel said, "he can sleep with you tonight in return for your son's mandrakes."

ekegusii: Omokungu oyio tarenge omwegenwa ase omosacha oye, erio akamotiga, akairana gochia o ise, aaria Bethlehemu, akamenya aroro ase engaki y’emetienyi ene.
english: But she was unfaithful to him. She left him and went back to her father's house in Bethlehem, Judah. After she had been there four months,

ekegusii: Erio Shemu na Yafeti bakabogoria engobo, bakayebeka amareko abo igoro, bakagenda kenyuma‐nyuma, bakabisia ise obogetirianda bwaye. Amaiso abo nigo arigereretie aase bakorwa, na tibarora obogetirianda bwa ise.
english: But Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it across their shoulders; then they walked in backward and covered their father's nakedness. Their faces were turned the other way so that they would not see their father's nakedness.

ekegusii: Onye ngendererete koba moyo, oorokie obwanchani bw’Omonene asende, erinde tinkwa,
english: But show me unfailing kindness like that of the LORD as long as I live, so that I may not be killed,

ekegusii: Korende nigo nkoborokia obwanchani bwane botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu, ase abwo banyanchete na babwatete amachiko aane.
english: but showing love to a thousand [generations] of those who love me and keep my commandments.

ekegusii: “Korende Sihoni, omoruoti o Hesiboni, akaanga, tatoa ribaga toete ase ense yaye. Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo akong’etie enkoro yaye ekaba ey’ogotaigwera, akamobeka ase amaboko aino, na inwe mokamobua na mokaira ense yaye, buna ere bono.
english: But Sihon king of Heshbon refused to let us pass through. For the LORD your God had made his spirit stubborn and his heart obstinate in order to give him into your hands, as he has now done.

ekegusii: Korende Sihoni akaanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga baete ase ense yaye. Agasangereria abarwani baye b’esegi, akagenda agaika Yahasi ase erooro, na agwo akarwania Abaisraeli.
english: But Sihon would not let Israel pass through his territory. He mustered his entire army and marched out into the desert against Israel. When he reached Jahaz, he fought with Israel.

ekegusii: Korende Sila akarora buya atigare aroro.]
english: But Silas decided to stay there. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version.]

ekegusii: Korende ebibe bikanyora ribaga ase ogochika koria, bikabokia ime asende chingencho chionsi chi’okogania okobe. Ase amachiko atari, rirorio ebibe mbikwete.
english: But sin, seizing the opportunity afforded by the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire. For apart from law, sin is dead.

ekegusii: korende tari nemeri ime yaye, ogenderera ekero egeke; na ekero emechando egochi‐gocha, gose okorosigwa ase engencho ye ring’ana, erio bwango ogwa korwa ase okwegena kwaye.
english: But since he has no root, he lasts only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.

ekegusii: korende onye nokoboria igoro ase amang’ana, na amarieta, na amachiko aino, yarigererie inwe abanyene. Inche tindigeti koba omotorania bw’amang’ana ayio.”
english: But since it involves questions about words and names and your own law-- settle the matter yourselves. I will not be a judge of such things."

ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’amateemwa ay’ogokora obotomani kera omosacha abe na mokaye omonyene, na kera omokungu abe nomosacha oye omonyene.
english: But since there is so much immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman her own husband.

ekegusii: But since they could see the man who had been healed standing there with them, there was nothing they could say.
english: Ekero bachia korora omonto oria ogwenetigwe, oteneine amo nabarabwo, tibaba na ing’ana rinde bagokwana.

ekegusii: na abwo tibari nemeri ime yabo abanyene, korende bagenderera ekero egeke, na ekero emechando gose okorosigwa bikooroka ase engencho ye ring’ana riria, bwango bagwa.
english: But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.

ekegusii: Korende intwe abatore ab’omobaso, tobe aberiti, na tweboyie okwegena na obwanchani buna engobo y’ekioma ase ebikuba biaito, na ogosemeria kw’ogotooreka buna ekegogwa giaito gi’ekioma.
english: But since we belong to the day, let us be self-controlled, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

ekegusii: Korende onye timwegeneti amariko aye, naki moregene amang’ana aane?”
english: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how are you going to believe what I say?"

ekegusii: Nabeire nkobarangeria, korende mwangire konyigwera; nabeire nkorambora okoboko kwane, korende monto onde tari okorigereirie.
english: But since you rejected me when I called and no one gave heed when I stretched out my hand,

ekegusii: Korende abanto amagana atano na rimo bagatooreka, bakaonchoka, bagatama gochia ensemo y’erooro, ase egetare kie Rimoni, bakamenya ase egetare keria ase emetienyi ene.
english: But six hundred men turned and fled into the desert to the rock of Rimmon, where they stayed four months.

ekegusii: Korende egesieri gekogenda ase obogima nekegote, na enchera ekogendao nenyerere, na abakoyenyora nabake.
english: But small is the gate and narrow the road that leads to life, and only a few find it.

ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agatebia oria orenge rigata, “Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”
english: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...." Then he said to the paralytic, "Get up, take your mat and go home."

ekegusii: Korende endagera enkong’u ney’abanto abanene, ekiagera barabwo mbanaretie ebirengererio biabo, na igo mbamanye ogwatanana amaya na amabe.
english: But solid food is for the mature, who by constant use have trained themselves to distinguish good from evil.

ekegusii: Korende Sulemani takorete Abaisraeli bakaba abasomba. Barabwo nigo barenge abarwani b’esegi, na abakonyi b’oboruoti, na abachiki baye b’abarwani, na abatang’ani b’abarwani, na abachiki baye be chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa.
english: But Solomon did not make slaves of any of the Israelites; they were his fighting men, his government officials, his officers, his captains, and the commanders of his chariots and charioteers.

ekegusii: Korende Sulemani takorete Abaisraeli babe abasomba ase okomokorera emeremo. Barabwo nigo babete abarwani esegi, na abanene b’oboruoti, na abachiki baye be chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa.
english: But Solomon did not make slaves of the Israelites for his work; they were his fighting men, commanders of his captains, and commanders of his chariots and charioteers.

ekegusii: Abande b’abamura b’abakuani nigo babegetwe kwearigania na gwochogania ebinsari.
english: But some of the priests took care of mixing the spices.

ekegusii: Korende ekero abande bakong’etie chinkoro chiabo, na tibegena, na bagakwana bobe igoro y’Enchera y’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano, akaimoka akabatiga, akarusanania aborokigwa, akaba nkoborokereria are kera rituko ase enyomba y’amorokererio ya Tiriano.
english: But some of them became obstinate; they refused to believe and publicly maligned the Way. So Paul left them. He took the disciples with him and had discussions daily in the lecture hall of Tyrannus.

ekegusii: Korende mbarengeo abanto gete besoyirie ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna omobere bw’omonto okwete. Barabwo tibanyarete korenda rituko ri’Epasaka ase rituko riria. Ase ayio bakagenda ase Musa na Haroni ase rituko riria,
english: But some of them could not celebrate the Passover on that day because they were ceremonially unclean on account of a dead body. So they came to Moses and Aaron that same day

ekegusii: Abande babo bagateba, “Nase Beelizebuli, omonene bw’ebirecha, akorusia ebirecha.”
english: But some of them said, "By Beelzebub, the prince of demons, he is driving out demons."

ekegusii: Korende abande bakabora, “Inee! Oyo oramogetie amaiso ’omouko oria, tare konyara kogwenia oyo takwa?”
english: But some of them said, "Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?"

ekegusii: Korende abande babo bakagenda ase Abafarisai, bakabatebia aya Yeso akorete.
english: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.

ekegusii: Korende abanto bande abarenge ababe bakabora, “Naki oyo arakore atotoorie?” Barabwo bakamochaya, tibamoirera biegwa binde. Korende ere akaba buna taigwete aya bakwanete.
english: But some troublemakers said, "How can this fellow save us?" They despised him and brought him no gifts. But Saul kept silent.

ekegusii: Korende omonto oyomo akaruta omogwe ase okorengia, akarasa omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli ase ribaga riarenge gati y’engobo y’ekioma ase egekuba kiaye. Erio omoruoti agatebia omogendia bw’egari yaye, “Onchora egari ondusie aa ase esegi, ekiagera narasirwe mono omobere one.”
english: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the sections of his armor. The king told his chariot driver, "Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I've been wounded."

ekegusii: Korende omonto oyomo akaruta omogwe ase okorengia bosa igo, akabeta omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli ase ribaga riarenge gati y’engobo y’ekioma, ase egekuba kiaye. Erio omoruoti agatebia omogendia bw’egari yaye, “Onchora egari ondusie ase esegi, ekiagera nabetirwe mono.”
english: But someone drew his bow at random and hit the king of Israel between the sections of his armor. The king told the chariot driver, "Wheel around and get me out of the fighting. I've been wounded."

ekegusii: Korende omonto naborie, “Naki abakure baraboke? Naende mobere ki barache noro?”
english: But someone may ask, "How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?"

ekegusii: Aande gose omonto natebe, “Aye nore nokwegena, na inche ninde nogokora.” Nimoiranerie, “Nyorokia okwegena kwao gotari nogokora, na inche nkworokie okwegena kwane ase ogokora kwane.”
english: But someone will say, "You have faith; I have deeds." Show me your faith without deeds, and I will show you my faith by what I do.

ekegusii: korende akaba okorigia Nyasae o ise, na akabwata amachiko ’Omonene, na tabwatetie chinchera chi’Abaisraeli.
english: but sought the God of his father and followed his commands rather than the practices of Israel.

ekegusii: Korende ere oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akarigereria mono gochia igoro, akarora obonene bwa Nyasae, na Yeso oteneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
english: But Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit, looked up to heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing at the right hand of God.

ekegusii: korende mogache chinibo chiaino igoro, aase ebigwankwa na oboboosu bitagosaria, na abaibi batakobochora na koiba.
english: But store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not destroy, and where thieves do not break in and steal.

ekegusii: Korende obotooru nigo bware gotiira korwa inse na konyiyia riroba ri’ense yonsi.
english: but streams came up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground--

ekegusii: Bono aye rambora okoboko kwao, okune ebinto bionsi abwate obisirie, ekeene, ere goika akoragererie agwo ase obosio bwao.”
english: But stretch out your hand and strike everything he has, and he will surely curse you to your face."

ekegusii: Bono aye rambora okoboko kwao, okune amauga ’omobere oye, amo ne chinyama, omokore bobe, ekeene, ere nigo arakoragereria agwo ase obosio bwao.”
english: But stretch out your hand and strike his flesh and bones, and he will surely curse you to your face."

ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria omobe, karatebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire gocha,
english: But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, 'My master is staying away a long time,'

ekegusii: Korende omosomba oria karatebe ase omoyo oye ime: Omonene one otebanire gocha, naende achake goaka abasomba bande, abasacha na abakungu, na koria, na konywa, na gotinda,
english: But suppose the servant says to himself, 'My master is taking a long time in coming,' and he then begins to beat the menservants and maidservants and to eat and drink and get drunk.

ekegusii: Ere akarimeria Farao amo nemeganda yaye ase Enyancha Embariri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea; His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Oimokie etukia inke igo, oyesiberanie ase omokoba bw’eganchwa yao.
english: But take a few strands of hair and tuck them away in the folds of your garment.

ekegusii: But take this staff in your hand so you can perform miraculous signs with it."
english: Aye obogorie enyimbo eyio koboko kwao, nero orakorere ebikone.”

ekegusii: Ebinto biaino moraatanane bibe ebichenu amo nebi mwariete chiira ng’a mobirue, mobiire aase agwo Omonene arachore.
english: But take your consecrated things and whatever you have vowed to give, and go to the place the LORD will choose.

ekegusii: Korende mbarengeo abanto ikomi ase abwo, babatebetie Isumaeli, “Totoita, ntobwate engano, na esairi na amaguta, na obooke, tokabisete ase emegondo.” Ase ayio akabatiga, tabaita ekero aitete baria bande bamwabo.
english: But ten of them said to Ishmael, "Don't kill us! We have wheat and barley, oil and honey, hidden in a field." So he let them alone and did not kill them with the others.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera inwe, abamwarenge abasomba b’ebibe, mwabeire abaigweri ase chinkoro chiaino ase okworokereria koria mwaetwe,
english: But thanks be to God that, though you used to be slaves to sin, you wholeheartedly obeyed the form of teaching to which you were entrusted.

ekegusii: Korende mbuya mono ase Nyasae, ere oyogotoa okobua goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: But thanks be to God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, ere oyogotoraa ase okobua okonene botambe ase Kristo, naende oyogosokia rimisu rigiya goetera asetore, erinde bamomanye kera aase.
english: But thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumphal procession in Christ and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of the knowledge of him.

ekegusii: Ekero ki’omobaso chiasunkera chiakea; na omorakera ogocha chiasira kegima korwa aase abo.
english: but that cease to flow in the dry season, and in the heat vanish from their channels.

ekegusii: Rituko riria neri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda; rituko ri’okorusia egesiomba, eruserie egesiomba, ase ababisa baye. Omoro nobarie oigote kegima; nonywe amanyinga abo oichore. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabe nekeng’wanso ase ense ya sugusu, ang’e norooche rw’Eufarati.
english: But that day belongs to the Lord, the LORD Almighty-- a day of vengeance, for vengeance on his foes. The sword will devour till it is satisfied, till it has quenched its thirst with blood. For the Lord, the LORD Almighty, will offer sacrifice in the land of the north by the River Euphrates.

ekegusii: korende onye omokungu okoba netukia entambe nigo ere obonene bwaye? Ekiagera oeirwe etukia eria ase ogwetuba.
english: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.

ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agatebia oria orenge rigata,
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...." He said to the paralytic,

ekegusii: Korende monyare komanya ng’a Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nare nokobua ase ense gw’okwabera ebibe.” Erio agwo agatebia oria rigata, “Nagotebirie: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende bwoo.”
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins...." He said to the paralyzed man, "I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home."

ekegusii: Korende omomalaika bw’Omonene akamorangeria korwa igoro, akabora, “Ibrahimu, Ibrahimu!” Ere akamoitabera, “Nao inde aa.”
english: But the angel of the LORD called out to him from heaven, "Abraham! Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.

ekegusii: Korende omomalaika bw’Omonene agatebia Elija Omotisibi, “Imoka ogende, oumerane nabanto baria omoruoti o Samaria atomire, obaborie: Inee! Nase ki mokogenda koboria Baali‐Sebubu, enyasae y’Ekironi? Nekiagera mokagete ng’a Nyasae tari ase Abaisraeli?
english: But the angel of the LORD said to Elijah the Tishbite, "Go up and meet the messengers of the king of Samaria and ask them, 'Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going off to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron?'

ekegusii: Omomalaika akamotebia, “Toiroka Mariamu, ekiagera kwanyorire obuya ase Nyasae.
english: But the angel said to her, "Do not be afraid, Mary, you have found favor with God.

ekegusii: Korende omomalaika oria akamotebia, “Toiroka, Zakaria, ekiagera ogosaba kwao kwaigurwe, na mokao Elisabeti nakoiborere omwana omoisia, na erieta riaye nomoroke Yohana.
english: But the angel said to him: "Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to give him the name John.

ekegusii: Omomalaika akabatebia, “Timoiroka, ekiagera nabarenteire amang’ana amaya ay’omogoko omonene, orabe ase abanto bonsi,
english: But the angel said to them, "Do not be afraid. I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people.

ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abakalidayo bakabwatia Zedekia omoruoti, bakamoikeera agwo ase ense omweya ya Yeriko, ekero abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi konya bamotigire na goserebekana.
english: but the Babylonian army pursued King Zedekiah and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,

ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abakalidayo bakabwatia Zedekia omoruoti, bakamoikeera agwo ase ense omweya ya Yeriko ekero abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi konya bamotigire baserebekanire.
english: but the Babylonian army pursued the king and overtook him in the plains of Jericho. All his soldiers were separated from him and scattered,

ekegusii: Korende abarwani esegi b’Abakalidayo bakababwatia. Bagaikera Zedekia agwo ase ense eraire ya Yeriko. Ekero bamobwatete, bakamoira ase Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, agwo ase omochie o Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati, na Nebukadinesaro akamonachera ekina.
english: But the Babylonian army pursued them and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho. They captured him and took him to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, where he pronounced sentence on him.

ekegusii: Eng’iti eria ekabwatwa amo nomobani oria bw’oborimo, ere oyokorete ebikone ase obosio bwaye. Ase ebikone ebio nigo are kong’aina abanto baria baetwe ekemanyererio ki’engiti eria na gosasima omogwekano oye. Abwo babere bakarutwa bare moyo ase enyancha y’omorero egwoka ekebiriti.
english: But the beast was captured, and with him the false prophet who had performed the miraculous signs on his behalf. With these signs he had deluded those who had received the mark of the beast and worshiped his image. The two of them were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur.

ekegusii: Korendeobwato konya bwaikire enyancha gati bokorunda‐rundigwa nemerindo, ekiagera omwaga nigo obatangete.
english: but the boat was already a considerable distance from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.

ekegusii: Egesasimero gi’etaai keria Besaleli, mosinto o Uri o Huri, aroisetie nao kiarenge bosio bw’Eema y’Omonene, Sulemani amo nomosangererekano bwonsi bakaba bakogenda aroro koboria Omonene.
english: But the bronze altar that Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was in Gibeon in front of the tabernacle of the LORD; so Solomon and the assembly inquired of him there.

ekegusii: Korende ebiatigarete korwa ase eeri eria, riiyo riaye, ne chinyama, na esike, akabisokia isiko y’egetwori akabisambera aroro, buna Omonene amochigete.
english: But the bull with its hide and its flesh and its offal he burned up outside the camp, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani oria akarigia gotooria Paulo, akabatanga, tibakora buna barengereretie. Agachika baria baranyare kwerema berute nyancha ime, bagende ense enyomo.
english: But the centurion wanted to spare Paul's life and kept them from carrying out their plan. He ordered those who could swim to jump overboard first and get to land.

ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani oria akaigwera omoraai na omonyene emeeri kobua aya Paulo akwanete.
english: But the centurion, instead of listening to what Paul said, followed the advice of the pilot and of the owner of the ship.

ekegusii: Bono abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bakarua ogochika ng’a onye monto onde omanyete aase are, arente amang’ana, banyare komobwata.
english: But the chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that if anyone found out where Jesus was, he should report it so that they might arrest him.

ekegusii: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.
english: Bono abakuani abanene na abagaaka bakagenka emeganda ng’a baborie baegwe Baraba, na Yeso bamoite.

ekegusii: Abakuani abanene bakagenka abanto b’omoganda, erinde anche kobasiborera Baraba.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Pilate release Barabbas instead.

ekegusii: Ng’ina omwana oria agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, na buna aye ore moyo, tinkogotiga.” Ase ayio Elisha akaimoka akamotunyana.
english: But the child's mother said, "As surely as the LORD lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So he got up and followed her.

ekegusii: Korende omoteneneri oria bw’abarendi agatiga abanto bande baria barenge abataka mono, b’ense eria babeereo, babe bagokora emeremo ase emegondo y’emesabibu na gokora emeremo y’okorema.
english: But the commander left behind some of the poorest people of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

ekegusii: Omochiki oria omonene akabairaneria, “Inee! Omonene one nantoma nkwane amang’ana aya ase omonene oo na asore aye? Tantomete ase inwe mweka, korende nase abanto baikaransete ase orwaki igoro; abwo banacheirwe ekina amo nainwe bagochia koria obonyira bwabo na konywa amache abo bagoitera.”
english: But the commander replied, "Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the men sitting on the wall-- who, like you, will have to eat their own filth and drink their own urine?"

ekegusii: Rabi‐Sake agateba, “Inee! Omonene one nigo antoma nkwane amang’ana aya ase omonene oino na asemore mweka? Yaya, tantomete ase inwe mweka, korende nase abanto baikaransete ase orwaki igoro, abwo banacheirwe ekina amo nainwe bagochia koria obonyira bwabo na konywa amasinyoro abo bagoitera.”
english: But the commander replied, "Was it only to your master and you that my master sent me to say these things, and not to the men sitting on the wall-- who, like you, will have to eat their own filth and drink their own urine?"

ekegusii: Korende Omokonyi, Omoika Omochenu, oyo Tata aratome ase erieta riane, ere naborokererie onsi, na kobainyoria onsi aya nabatebirie.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.

ekegusii: Korende aboba, na abatari abegenwa, na abagechi, na abaiti, na abatomani, na abarogi, na abasasimi emegwekano na abanyaborimo bonsi; ensemo yabo nebe ase enyancha egwoka omorero na ekebiriti. Aya naro amakweri a kabere.”
english: But the cowardly, the unbelieving, the vile, the murderers, the sexually immoral, those who practice magic arts, the idolaters and all liars-- their place will be in the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death."

ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora, ekamotunyana, na ere akabaroisia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana ’oboruoti bwa Nyasae, akagwenia abarenge nokogania gw’okogwenigwa.
english: but the crowds learned about it and followed him. He welcomed them and spoke to them about the kingdom of God, and healed those who needed healing.

ekegusii: Korende ase rituko riria Loti aruete Sodomu omorero na ekebiriti bigatwa korwa igoro, bigasiria bonsi.
english: But the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.

ekegusii: Korende rituko ri’Omonene nigo rirache buna omoibi agocha. Ase rituko erio igoro neruo negeturi ekenene, na ebitongwa bia igoro inabisire nomorero ogotetenya, na ense na ebinto ebire aroro inabiyie.
english: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar; the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and everything in it will be laid bare.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Rora, amatuko ngocha are inche ndarente esegi, na ekerero gi’esegi keigugwe ase omochie o Raba, ase ense y’Abaamoni. Omochie oyio otigare amaturi ore bosa, na emechie yaye esambwe nomorero. Erio Abaisraeli mbaire omwando korwa ase abwo babayourete. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: But the days are coming," declares the LORD, "when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites; it will become a mound of ruins, and its surrounding villages will be set on fire. Then Israel will drive out those who drove her out," says the LORD.

ekegusii: korende riruma riria tirianyora aase rikogwa na gotacha namagoro aye, rikairana ase Nuhu obwato ime, ekiagera amache nao arenge igoro y’ense engima. Ase igo akarambora okoboko kwaye, akaribwata, akarisoyia obwato ime ase arenge.
english: But the dove could find no place to set its feet because there was water over all the surface of the earth; so it returned to Noah in the ark. He reached out his hand and took the dove and brought it back to himself in the ark.

ekegusii: Kera omogambi ontang’anerete kogamba nigo arenge kobeka egurube endito igoro ase abanto na kobaboria barue endagera, na edivai, amo ne chibesa chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo ene. Nonya nabasomba babo nabo bakorerete abanto. Inche tinakorete buna abagambi abwo, ekiagera nigo namoirogete Nyasae.
english: But the earlier governors-- those preceding me-- placed a heavy burden on the people and took forty shekels of silver from them in addition to food and wine. Their assistants also lorded it over the people. But out of reverence for God I did not act like that.

ekegusii: Korende ense egakonya omokungu oria, egaasamia omonwa, ekamera orooche roria enchoka yasiarete korwa ase omonwa oye.
english: But the earth helped the woman by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that the dragon had spewed out of his mouth.

ekegusii: Erio abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo. Farao akagenderera gokong’ia enkoro yaye, na buna Omonene konya atebire, tabaigwa.
english: But the Egyptian magicians did the same things by their secret arts, and Pharaoh's heart became hard; he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.

ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo bare mwanyabanto, tibari Nyasae; chibarasi chiabo nigo chire emebere, tichiri emeika. Ekero Omonene ararambore okoboko kwaye, abwo bagokonya mbagochwe, na abwo bagokonywa bagwe; bonsi nigo barasirigwe amo.
english: But the Egyptians are men and not God; their horses are flesh and not spirit. When the LORD stretches out his hand, he who helps will stumble, he who is helped will fall; both will perish together.

ekegusii: But the Egyptians mistreated us and made us suffer, putting us to hard labor.
english: Abamisiri bagatokora bobe, bakaba bagotochanda na gotokoria emeremo emekong’u.

ekegusii: Korende eriso ria Nyasae obo nigo riarenge ririgereretie abagaaka b’Abayahudi, na abanto baria tibabatangete goika amang’ana aria amoikere Dario. Nyuma y’ayio bairanerigwe ase rirube igoro y’amang’ana ayio.
english: But the eye of their God was watching over the elders of the Jews, and they were not stopped until a report could go to Darius and his written reply be received.

ekegusii: Rora amaiso ’Omonene nigo abarigereretie abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye botari koera.
english: But the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear him, on those whose hope is in his unfailing love,

ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbabe bakouna‐una ase omosunte, tibakorora omobaso. Tibagotooreka nonya ng’ake; ogosemeria kwabo ngosire pi.”
english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will elude them; their hope will become a dying gasp."

ekegusii: Ebitinya bi’eeri eyio, na omokera bw’emingichi na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, ne chinyigo, na ebitinya bie riini,
english: But the fat portions of the ox and the ram-- the fat tail, the layer of fat, the kidneys and the covering of the liver--

ekegusii: Korende emegondo amo nebichie bi’omochie oyio konya baeire Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, bikaba omwando oye.
english: But the fields and villages around the city they had given to Caleb son of Jephunneh as his possession.

ekegusii: Korende emegondo y’omochie amo nebichie b’omochie oyio bakaa Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune.
english: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato bagachia koboka mambia chuni, bakanyora naende Dagoni yagure inse maumama, bosio bw’Esanduku eria y’Omonene. Omotwe o Dagoni, na amaboko aye, konya biabutokire bire agwo ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri, ne rieene rioka nario riatigarete.
english: But the following morning when they rose, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the LORD! His head and hands had been broken off and were lying on the threshold; only his body remained.

ekegusii: Ense y’ebitunwa nabo erabe eyaino. Nonya ere ne rinani, genda moyerabie, moyeire engima ebe eyaino, korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende. Goika moserie Abakanani korwa aroro nonya babwate chigari chi’ebioma, naende bare ne chinguru.”
english: but the forested hill country as well. Clear it, and its farthest limits will be yours; though the Canaanites have iron chariots and though they are strong, you can drive them out."

ekegusii: Abalawi baria bane abarenge abateneneri b’emeremo y’okorenda ebiita nabwo batenenerete ebinyomba ne chikungo chi’enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: But the four principal gatekeepers, who were Levites, were entrusted with the responsibility for the rooms and treasuries in the house of God.

ekegusii: Korende okwama kw’Omoika nobwanchani, omogoko, omorembe, oboremereria, obwororo, obuya, obwegenwa,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

ekegusii: Korende ekeegwa keria ki’amabera tikeri buna ogosaria koria. Naki ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakwa, korende amabera a Nyasae na ekeegwa eke ki’amabera biamentekire kobua mono ase abange ase omonto oyomo Yeso Kristo.
english: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God's grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, overflow to the many!

ekegusii: Na egoree eria erabe yagwereirwe nobomera ase Asaseli ayerente ere moyo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, erinde akore okobwatanigwa asero, na koyetiga esiboire egende ase erooro ase Asaseli.
english: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD to be used for making atonement by sending it into the desert as a scapegoat.

ekegusii: Korende etukia yaye egachaka komera naende nyuma gakigitirwe.
english: But the hair on his head began to grow again after it had been shaved.

ekegusii: Korende rigereria, okoboko kwaye ere oyokondua nigo kore amo nainche ase emesa.
english: But the hand of him who is going to betray me is with mine on the table.

ekegusii: Abarisia b’ensemo ya Gerari bakaba bakwomana nabarisia ba Isaka, bagoteba, “Amache aya nayaito.” Ase igo Isaka akaroka entuboka eria Eseki, ekiagera bamwomaneretie aroro.
english: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac's herdsmen and said, "The water is ours!" So he named the well Esek, because they disputed with him.

ekegusii: Korende riiyo ri’eeri eyio amo ne chinyama chionsi, na omotwe, na ebirenge, na enda, na esike,
english: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh, as well as the head and legs, the inner parts and offal--

ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibagokoigwera aye, ekiagera tibari konyigwera inche; Abaisraeli bonsi bakong’irie amasio abo igoro, ne chinkoro chiabo boigo.
english: But the house of Israel is not willing to listen to you because they are not willing to listen to me, for the whole house of Israel is hardened and obstinate.

ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli tibabete abegenwa; bakaira ebinto biria biatananetwe ase ogosirigwa. Akani, mosinto o Karimi, o Sabidi, o Zera bw’egesaku kia Yuda, akaira ebinto binde biaragereretigwe: na Omonene akaba nekeririanda ekenene ase Abaisraeli.
english: But the Israelites acted unfaithfully in regard to the devoted things; Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of them. So the LORD's anger burned against Israel.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagatiga tibaita abanto baria, ekiagera abatang’ani babo konya barire eira ase ogotiana ase erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Abanto b’omoganda bakemurunganeria abatang’ani.
english: But the Israelites did not attack them, because the leaders of the assembly had sworn an oath to them by the LORD, the God of Israel. The whole assembly grumbled against the leaders,

ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibaseretie Abagesuri na Abamaaka: barabwo nigo bamenyete ase egati y’Abaisraeli goika rero iga.
english: But the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maacah, so they continue to live among the Israelites to this day.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatebia Omonene, “Twakorire ebibe, na bono tokorere buna oranche aye omonyene; twagosoroire, ototoorie rero, koranche.”
english: But the Israelites said to the LORD, "We have sinned. Do with us whatever you think best, but please rescue us now."

ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bakagenderera goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku, amache akaba ateneine buna orwaki ensemo ya borio na ensemo ya bomosi asebare.
english: But the Israelites went through the sea on dry ground, with a wall of water on their right and on their left.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagasarara na komenteka, bakaba abange mono, bakabucha kegima ase ense eria.
english: but the Israelites were fruitful and multiplied greatly and became exceedingly numerous, so that the land was filled with them.

ekegusii: Korende Yerusalemu ya igoro nomochie omosibore, noro baba oito.
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, and she is our mother.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaburukania abakungu abamoirogete Nyasae, abasikire nabanto, na abanene b’omochie, bakagenka abanto bachande Paulo na Barnaba, na kobaseria korwa ensemo yabo.
english: But the Jews incited the God-fearing women of high standing and the leading men of the city. They stirred up persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them from their region.

ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi bakaba ne ribero, bakaira abanto ababe korwa ase abaomboganu, bagasangereria omoganda, na bagakora eburu‐buru ase omochie. Bagachiera abanto b’enyomba ya Yasoni, bakarigia koira Paulo na Sila isiko ase abanto.
english: But the Jews were jealous; so they rounded up some bad characters from the marketplace, formed a mob and started a riot in the city. They rushed to Jason's house in search of Paul and Silas in order to bring them out to the crowd.

ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi abategenete bakaburukania emioyo y’abanto b’Ebisaku na gosaria emioyo yabo igoro ase abaminto.
english: But the Jews who refused to believe stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’engaki gete omoruoti bw’Abaasuri akamanya obobisi bwa Hosea buna konya atomire abanto ase So, omoruoti bw’Abamisiri, na buna atigete korua ebango ase omoruoti bw’Abaasuri buna arenge gokora omwaka ase omwaka. Ase ayio akamobwata akamosiba echela.
english: But the king of Assyria discovered that Hoshea was a traitor, for he had sent envoys to So king of Egypt, and he no longer paid tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore Shalmaneser seized him and put him in prison.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Misiri akabairaneria, “Musa na Haroni, nase ki mogotenenia abanto korwa ase emeremo yabo? Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino y’obosomba.”
english: But the king of Egypt said, "Moses and Aaron, why are you taking the people away from their labor? Get back to your work!"

ekegusii: Ere oyio agasaria okobwatana koria, agatoma abanto ase ense ya Misiri gosaba aegwe chibarasi na abarwani esegi abange. Inee! Omonto ogokora amang’ana buna ayio nasesenigwe? Natooreke? Omonto osaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania natooreke?
english: But the king rebelled against him by sending his envoys to Egypt to get horses and a large army. Will he succeed? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the treaty and yet escape?

ekegusii: Korende omoruoti akairaneria Arauna, “Yaya taibo, korende nigo nkobigora korwa asore ase rigori bikoonigwa: tinkoruera Omonene Nyasae ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nebinto ntagoreti ase rigori.” Igo Daudi akagora ekeooreri ekio amo ne chiombe ase chibesa, chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo etano.
english: But the king replied to Araunah, "No, I insist on paying you for it. I will not sacrifice to the LORD my God burnt offerings that cost me nothing." So David bought the threshing floor and the oxen and paid fifty shekels of silver for them.

ekegusii: na omoruoti agateba, “Tiga amenye ao ase enka yaye omonyene; tabaisa gocha ase obosio bwane.” Ase igo Abisalomu akamenya bwoye oka, taba okororana nomoruoti.
english: But the king said, "He must go to his own house; he must not see my face." So Absalom went to his own house and did not see the face of the king.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akabora, “Inki inde nainwe abamura b’omokungu Seruya? Onye okoragereria, ekiagera Omonene amotebirie ng’a andagererie inche Daudi, ning’o oranyare komoboria; Ninki kiagera ogokora iga?”
english: But the king said, "What do you and I have in common, you sons of Zeruiah? If he is cursing because the LORD said to him, 'Curse David,' who can ask, 'Why do you do this?'"

ekegusii: Korende omoruoti agatebia Ahimeleki, “Aye amo nabanto bonsi b’eamate ya iso goika mokwe.”
english: But the king said, "You will surely die, Ahimelech, you and your father's whole family."

ekegusii: korende akairera Arimoni na Mefiboseti, abana abamura babere abwo Risipa, omosubati o Aya aiborerete Saulo. Naende akairera abamura batano, aba Mikali, omosubati o Saulo, aiborerete Adirieli, mosinto o Barisilai Omomehola.
english: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons of Aiah's daughter Rizpah, whom she had borne to Saul, together with the five sons of Saul's daughter Merab, whom she had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo omoruoti nabe okogoka ase Nyasae, na abanto bonsi abagotiana asare mbabe bagwetogia, korende emenwa y’abanto bagokwana oborimo nekirigwe.
english: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by God's name will praise him, while the mouths of liars will be silenced.

ekegusii: Korende Abakohati baise gosoa na korora ebinto biria ebichenu, nonya netagika ensinini, nigo barakwe.”
english: But the Kohathites must not go in to look at the holy things, even for a moment, or they will die."

ekegusii: Ase igo ense eria tiyabaisana banyare komenya amo bonsi babere, ekiagera chinibo chiabo nechinyinge chiarenge, goika tibanyara komenya amo.
english: But the land could not support them while they stayed together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to stay together.

ekegusii: Korende ense eria mogochia gosoa moyeire nigo ere ense y’ebitunwa na amagoko, ense ekonyora embura egotwa korwa igoro.
english: But the land you are crossing the Jordan to take possession of is a land of mountains and valleys that drinks rain from heaven.

ekegusii: Togoosa chitugo chiabo, na gosakora ebinto biarenge ase emechie eyio bikaba ebiaito.
english: But the livestock and the plunder from the towns we had captured we carried off for ourselves.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo akoimokererigwa igoro goetera ase ekina gi’ekeene, na Nyasae ore Omochenu bweorokia ng’a nomochenu are ase oboronge bwaye.
english: But the LORD Almighty will be exalted by his justice, and the holy God will show himself holy by his righteousness.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agaika gocha inse arore omochie na omorobiri oyio mwanyabanto baagachire.
english: But the LORD came down to see the city and the tower that the men were building.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene antange; tindambora okoboko kwane ase ogoita omoakwa amaguta oye. Imokia ritimo erio rire ang’e ase omotwe oye amo nekerandi keria ki’amache, togende.”
english: But the LORD forbid that I should lay a hand on the LORD's anointed. Now get the spear and water jug that are near his head, and let's go."

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae akarangeria omonto oria, akamoboria, “Ng’ai ore?”
english: But the LORD God called to the man, "Where are you?"

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana n’Ahiya, akamotebia, “Rora, moka Yeroboamu ngocha are gokoboria amanye igoro y’omwana oye ore omorwaire. Aya na aya naro oramotebie.” Ekero omokungu oria achete asare agekora buna omokungu omoao.
english: But the LORD had told Ahijah, "Jeroboam's wife is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill, and you are to give her such and such an answer. When she arrives, she will pretend to be someone else."

ekegusii: Korende Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na buna Omonene konya atebirie Musa, Farao akaanga koigwa Musa na Haroni.
english: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart and he would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said to Moses.

ekegusii: Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na ere tancha kobaa ribaga bagende.
english: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he was not willing to let them go.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na ere akaanga koa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende.
english: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let the Israelites go.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene obeire egekengero kiane egekong’u, ee, Nyasae one negetare ngotamera.
english: But the LORD has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.

ekegusii: Omonene oseegetire na korenta ababisa ba Resini bache kobarwania.
english: But the LORD has strengthened Rezin's foes against them and has spurred their enemies on.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akarenta amaakwa amanene ase Farao na ase abanto baye ase engencho ya Sarai, moka Aburamu.
english: But the LORD inflicted serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household because of Abram's wife Sarai.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nomwegenwa, nere orababeke chinguru na kobarenda korwa ase oria omobe.
english: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen and protect you from the evil one.

ekegusii: “Korende Omonene nao are ase Hekalu yaye Enchenu; tiga ense yonsi ekire‐kiri ase obosio bwaye.”
english: But the LORD is in his holy temple; let all the earth be silent before him."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere obutoire chingori chi’abakori amabe.
english: But the LORD is righteous; he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nere Nyasae bw’ekeene, Nyasae ore moyo, Omoruoti o kare na kare. Ense nigo egotengechigwa ase endamwamu yaye, ebisaku tibikonyara koremereria ekeririanda kiaye.
english: But the LORD is the true God; he is the living God, the eternal King. When he is angry, the earth trembles; the nations cannot endure his wrath.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene ore Omobui bw’esegi nigo are amo nainche. Ase ayio, abachandi baane nabagochwe na kogwa; barabwo tibakombua. Nabarore obosooku obonene, ekiagera tibakonyara kobua. Ogochaywa kwabo kwa botambe tigokwebwa.
english: But the LORD is with me like a mighty warrior; so my persecutors will stumble and not prevail. They will fail and be thoroughly disgraced; their dishonor will never be forgotten.

ekegusii: Omonene nasekerere omokori amabe, ekiagera aroche ng’a rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwaye ndichiche.
english: but the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he knows their day is coming.

ekegusii: Bono Omonene agachika enswe enene ekamera Yona, na Yona akabeera ime ase enda y’enswe eria amatuko atato, omobaso na obotuko.
english: But the LORD provided a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish three days and three nights.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akamoboria, “Inee! Igo mboronge ogokora ase okogechigwa igo?”
english: But the LORD replied, "Have you any right to be angry?"

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamotebia, “Genda aye rioka, ekiagera oyio nomokoreri one omochore, aire erieta riane gochia ase abanto b’Ebisaku, na ase abaruoti, na ase Abaisraeli.
english: But the Lord said to Ananias, "Go! This man is my chosen instrument to carry my name before the Gentiles and their kings and before the people of Israel.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Nonya mbono abanto aba nigo bare abange mono; tiga batirimboke gochia rooche, na inche nkobaatananere aroro. Ase onde bwensi ndagotebie: Omonto oyo nanyare kogenda amo naye, oyio agende; na ase onde bwensi ndagotebie: Omonto oyo takogenda amo naye, oyio takogenda.”
english: But the LORD said to Gideon, "There are still too many men. Take them down to the water, and I will sift them for you there. If I say, 'This one shall go with you,' he shall go; but if I say, 'This one shall not go with you,' he shall not go."

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamotebia, “Taibo! Onde bwensi oraite Kaini nigo araakanigwe egesiomba ara gatano na kabere.” Na Omonene akabekera Kaini ekemanyererio ng’a onde bwensi oramoumere tabaisa komoita.
english: But the LORD said to him, "Not so; if anyone kills Cain, he will suffer vengeance seven times over." Then the LORD put a mark on Cain so that no one who found him would kill him.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamotebia, “Omorembe obe amo naye! Toiroka! Aye togokwa.”
english: But the LORD said to him, "Peace! Do not be afraid. You are not going to die."

ekegusii: Korende Omonene agantebia, “Tobaisa gokwana ng’a aye nomwana omoke ore, korende ase abanto bande bonsi ndagotome, goika ogende, na amang’ana ande onsi ndagochike, naro orabatebie.
english: But the LORD said to me, "Do not say, 'I am only a child.' You must go to everyone I send you to and say whatever I command you.

ekegusii: “Omonene agantebia: Bakanie, obatebie ng’a tibabaisa kogenda korwana esegi, ekiagera inche Omonene tindi amo nabarabwo. Kobaragende nigo bagochia kobugwa nababisa babo.
english: But the LORD said to me, "Tell them, 'Do not go up and fight, because I will not be with you. You will be defeated by your enemies.'"

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa na Haroni, “Ekiagera inwe motanyegenete na koorokia ase amasio ’Abaisraeli ng’a inche nomochenu inde, timokoraa na goikia omosangererekano oyio ase ense eria ebe eyabo.
english: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, "Because you did not trust in me enough to honor me as holy in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this community into the land I give them."

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamotebia: Buna kwarengereretie koagachera erieta riane enyomba, nigo gwakorete buya, okabeka amang’ana ayio ime ase enkoro yao.
english: But the LORD said to my father David, 'Because it was in your heart to build a temple for my Name, you did well to have this in your heart.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamotebia: Buna kwarengereretie koagachera erieta riane enyomba, nigo gwakorete buya kobeka amang’ana ayio ime ase enkoro yao.
english: But the LORD said to my father David, 'Because it was in your heart to build a temple for my Name, you did well to have this in your heart.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene agatebia Samweli, “Torigereria ekieni kiaye, gose obotambe na obuya bw’ogokina kwaye; oyio namwangire, ekiagera tindi korigereria buna mwanyabanto akorigereria. Mwanyabanto nigo akorora ekieni gia isiko, korende inche Omonene nigo nkorora ime y’enkoro.”
english: But the LORD said to Samuel, "Do not consider his appearance or his height, for I have rejected him. The LORD does not look at the things man looks at. Man looks at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart."

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Aye kwaroreire omobono oyo amabera, nonya tikwaywechanderete ase ogokora emeremo asoro, gose ase okoyokinia; nigo omerete ase obotuko obomo, naende ogasira ase obotuko obomo.
english: But the LORD said, "You have been concerned about this vine, though you did not tend it or make it grow. It sprang up overnight and died overnight.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene agatenena amo nainche, akambeka chinguru, erinde goetera asende okoraria kwe ring’ana goikeranigwe goika abanto bonsi b’Ebisaku bakoigwe. Na inche nigo natooretigwe korwa ase omonwa bw’endo.
english: But the Lord stood at my side and gave me strength, so that through me the message might be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles might hear it. And I was delivered from the lion's mouth.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akandusia korwa ase narenge korisia ching’ondi, agantebia: Genda obanere abanto baane Abaisraeli.
english: But the LORD took me from tending the flock and said to me, 'Go, prophesy to my people Israel.'

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo arenge nobwanchani asebare, na abarorerete amabera, akabairanera ase engencho y’okobwatana kw’ogotianania akorete na Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, na igo tabasiretie. Tabatugutete korwa ase obosio bwaye nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: But the LORD was gracious to them and had compassion and showed concern for them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. To this day he has been unwilling to destroy them or banish them from his presence.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nakore ogwatananeka egati ye chitugo chi’Abaisraeli na echi’Abamisiri. Ase echi’Abaisraeli ende tegokwa nonya neyemo.”
english: But the LORD will make a distinction between the livestock of Israel and that of Egypt, so that no animal belonging to the Israelites will die.'"

ekegusii: Omonene tagotiga omonto omoronge ase okobua kw’omokori amabe, gose takomotiga abugwe ekero asoeirwe ase ekegambero.
english: but the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned when brought to trial.

ekegusii: Korende rora, Omonene nayoure chinibo chiaye, na atugute okobua kwaye ase enyancha, na omochie oyio omonyene nosambwe nomorero.
english: But the Lord will take away her possessions and destroy her power on the sea, and she will be consumed by fire.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabeke ababisa baino ase amaboko aino, erio abatantanie, nainwe goika mobasirie kegima.
english: But the LORD your God will deliver them over to you, throwing them into great confusion until they are destroyed.

ekegusii: Korende mong’iroke inche Omonene. Nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri ase okobua okonene na ase okoboko koramboire; motung’ame monsasime inche bweka na monduere ebing’wanso.
english: But the LORD, who brought you up out of Egypt with mighty power and outstretched arm, is the one you must worship. To him you shall bow down and to him offer sacrifices.

ekegusii: Na abaringoria bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo, bakarenta ebioto igoro ase ense ya Misiri.
english: But the magicians did the same things by their secret arts; they also made frogs come up on the land of Egypt.

ekegusii: Omonto oria o Nyasae akairaneria omoruoti, “Noisa kong’a ekeng’ese ki’obotenenku bwao, tinkogenda amo naye, gose tinkoria endagera gose konywa amache aase aiga.
english: But the man of God answered the king, "Even if you were to give me half your possessions, I would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water here.

ekegusii: Omonto oria agatebia Yoabu, “Nonya kware kong’a chisekeli chie chifeta elifu eyemo, tinare korambora okoboko kwane igoro y’omwana bw’omoruoti, naki twensi ntwaigwete ekero omoruoti agochigete aye, na Abisai, na Itai, ogoteba: Ase engencho yane orende omosae oyio Abisalomu.
english: But the man replied, "Even if a thousand shekels were weighed out into my hands, I would not lift my hand against the king's son. In our hearing the king commanded you and Abishai and Ittai, 'Protect the young man Absalom for my sake.'

ekegusii: Korende oria oetwe etalanta eyemo akagenda, agakunya inse, akabisa ebesa y’omonene oye.
english: But the man who had received the one talent went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his master's money.

ekegusii: Korende oyore ne chitang’u‐tang’u onye okoria, onacheirwe ekina, ekiagera tarieti ase okwegena; na ogokora konde gwonsi gotarueti ase okwegena nebibe.
english: But the man who has doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and everything that does not come from faith is sin.

ekegusii: Korende oyotenenire noboremu ase enkoro yaye, na tari nokorigia, korende anyare kogambera okogania kwaye, naende orengereirie enkoro yaye ime amotige buna omoiseke oye omwekungi, nakore buya.
english: But the man who has settled the matter in his own mind, who is under no compulsion but has control over his own will, and who has made up his mind not to marry the virgin-- this man also does the right thing.

ekegusii: Korende oyorigereretie amachiko amaikeranu ay’obosibore, na goikaransa aroro, na taba oyokoigwa na kweba, korende abe omokori okoyakora, oyio nabe oyosesenirie ase ogokora kwaye.
english: But the man who looks intently into the perfect law that gives freedom, and continues to do this, not forgetting what he has heard, but doing it-- he will be blessed in what he does.

ekegusii: Korende omonto kamwanchete Nyasae, oyio omanyirwe nere.
english: But the man who loves God is known by God.

ekegusii: Abaitongo mbaire ense ebe eyabo, barabwo mbagoke na goisaneka ase obonge bw’omorembe.
english: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy great peace.

ekegusii: Korende abanto baria barenge ime bakarambora amaboko abo, bakang’usa Loti gochia nyomba ime, bagasieka egesieri.
english: But the men inside reached out and pulled Lot back into the house and shut the door.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli, bakeremia naende, bakaroberia abarwani barwanie aase aria ase beroberetie rituko rie ritang’ani.
english: But the men of Israel encouraged one another and again took up their positions where they had stationed themselves the first day.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bagatebia Saulo, “Inee! Yonathani, oyorentire obobui obonene iga, nere igo araitwe akwe? Yaya, taibo. Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, nonya nagatukia akamo k’omotwe oye tigakogwa inse ase riroba, ekiagera ase ogokonywa kwa Nyasae orentire obobui obwo ase rituko ria rero.” Ase igo abanto bagatooria Yonathani, takwa.
english: But the men said to Saul, "Should Jonathan die-- he who has brought about this great deliverance in Israel? Never! As surely as the LORD lives, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground, for he did this today with God's help." So the men rescued Jonathan, and he was not put to death.

ekegusii: Korende abanto bakamoiraneria, “Aye tobaisa kogenda amo naintwe. Naki gatoratame, barabwo tibagotoraara. Nonya abanto baito nabaisa goitwa ekeng’ese ki’omobaro, tobagotoraara. Aye nigo ore bw’engencho enene asetore kobua abanto baito chilifu ikomi. Ase ayio igo erabe buya obeere ase omochie na gotokonya korwa aroro.”
english: But the men said, "You must not go out; if we are forced to flee, they won't care about us. Even if half of us die, they won't care; but you are worth ten thousand of us. It would be better now for you to give us support from the city."

ekegusii: Abanto baria bagendete amo nere bagateba, “Intwe titokonyara korwania abanto baria tobabue; nigo bare ne chinguru gotobua.”
english: But the men who had gone up with him said, "We can't attack those people; they are stronger than we are."

ekegusii: Barabwo banchire komenya seito babe obomo naintwe, korende mbaganetie tokore ring’ana erimo, nario eri, ng’a kera omosacha ore asetore arokigwe buna barabwo barogete.
english: But the men will consent to live with us as one people only on the condition that our males be circumcised, as they themselves are.

ekegusii: Korende abanto baria tibamoigwera. Erio Omolawi oria akabwata omokungu oye o sere‐sere, akamoira isiko asebare. Barabwo bagakora obonyaka nere bakamokorera bobe ase obotuko obogima goika mambia; na ekero bwachia gokiamoka bakamotiga agende.
english: But the men would not listen to him. So the man took his concubine and sent her outside to them, and they raped her and abused her throughout the night, and at dawn they let her go.

ekegusii: Korende bono Kristo onyorire obokuani bore obuya kobua, koreng’ana buna ere are omobwatania bw’okobwatana okuya kobua, okwo kwagachetwe ase chiira chingiya kobua.
english: But the ministry Jesus has received is as superior to theirs as the covenant of which he is mediator is superior to the old one, and it is founded on better promises.

ekegusii: Buna bagendererete korangerigwa, nabo bagendererete kona‐kwerusanania. Nigo babete bakorua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae Baali, na bagasamba ubani ase emegwekano barenge gosasima.
english: But the more I called Israel, the further they went from me. They sacrificed to the Baals and they burned incense to images.

ekegusii: Korende buna Abamisiri bagendererete kobachanda mono, naboigo Abaisraeli bagendererete komenteka na gwesiarera, goika Abamisiri bakabagecha na kobairoka.
english: But the more they were oppressed, the more they multiplied and spread; so the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites

ekegusii: Abanto abaremerwa tibakwebwa kogenderera botambe, na ogosemeria kw’abagokorerwa bobe tikogosira nonya ng’ake.
english: But the needy will not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the afflicted ever perish.

ekegusii: Korende rituko ria kabere akabogoria ekiebisio ki’oborere akagetobeka ase amache ime, agatuba obosio bw’omoruoti nakerokio, gekamoguba goika agakwa. Erio Hasaeli akaba omoruoti ribaga ria Beni‐Hadadi.
english: But the next day he took a thick cloth, soaked it in water and spread it over the king's face, so that he died. Then Hazael succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kabere ri’omoyega bw’Omotienyi Omoyia, ekerogo gia Daudi nigo kiagendererete gotigara bosa, na Saulo akaboria Yonathani momura oye, “Nase ki momura o Yese atachete koragera igoro gose rero?”
english: But the next day, the second day of the month, David's place was empty again. Then Saul said to his son Jonathan, "Why hasn't the son of Jesse come to the meal, either yesterday or today?"

ekegusii: Korende omonto omosike nigo akoroberia ay’obosike, na nigo agotenena ase ay’obosike.
english: But the noble man makes noble plans, and by noble deeds he stands.

ekegusii: Omoteneneri oria agatebia Danieli, “Nairokire ng’a omonene one omoruoti, oyio obachikerete endagera yaino, na ebinyugwa biaino, ekero arabarore ng’a amasio aino anyirire kobua ay’abamura bande b’ekegori kiaino, nigo arambutore omotwe.”
english: but the official told Daniel, "I am afraid of my lord the king, who has assigned your food and drink. Why should he see you looking worse than the other young men your age? The king would then have my head because of you."

ekegusii: Korende abatang’ani ba Sukoti bagateba, “Naki rende torakore tobae abarwani bao emegati? Naye torabua Seba na Salimuna.”
english: But the officials of Succoth said, "Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your troops?"

ekegusii: korende oria otamanyeti, ko ere okorire ayagwenerete ogoakwa, naakwe ebiranya ebiororo. Kera oyoeirwe ebinge, korwa asare ere nabiganigwe ebinge; na ere oyoeirwe ebinge kobua, korwa asare nabiganigwe ebinge kobua.
english: But the one who does not know and does things deserving punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded; and from the one who has been entrusted with much, much more will be asked.

ekegusii: Nere oyokoigwa otari gokora iga, nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba igoro ase amaroba, etabegetwe oboroso. Nabo eooro ekayeaka ne chinguru, ekagwa bwango, na okogwa kw’enyomba eria gokaba okonene.”
english: But the one who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a man who built a house on the ground without a foundation. The moment the torrent struck that house, it collapsed and its destruction was complete."

ekegusii: na oyore omonda, nere agoke kairanigwe inse, ekiagera nigo arasire buna egesicha ki’obonyansi.
english: But the one who is rich should take pride in his low position, because he will pass away like a wild flower.

ekegusii: Na oyo obusuirwe ase amaroba amaya, nere oria okoigwa ring’ana, orimanya; nere ekeene bwama okwama. Oyomo bwama rigana, na oyonde emerongo etano nomo, na oyonde emerongo etato.”
english: But the one who received the seed that fell on good soil is the man who hears the word and understands it. He produces a crop, yielding a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown."

ekegusii: Korende oyo obogetigwe na Nyasae taroche ogosareka.
english: But the one whom God raised from the dead did not see decay.

ekegusii: Oyo o kabere akamokania, akabora, “Aye tori komoiroka nonya Nyasae, aye kore ase ekina keria keria?
english: But the other criminal rebuked him. "Don't you fear God," he said, "since you are under the same sentence?

ekegusii: Korende ebitii bi’oborisia bietanaine emechie yabo tibikoonigwa, ekiagera ebio nebiabo kogenderera botambe.
english: But the pastureland belonging to their towns must not be sold; it is their permanent possession.

ekegusii: Korende tibaigwerete, na Manase akabaebereria bagakora ayare amabe goetania aria abanto b’ebisaku bakorete, baria Omonene asiretie korwa ase amaiso ’Abaisraeli.
english: But the people did not listen. Manasseh led them astray, so that they did more evil than the nations the LORD had destroyed before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Abanto tibamoiranerete oria obaete egesusuro, gose tibamorigetie Omonene bw’Emeganda.
english: But the people have not returned to him who struck them, nor have they sought the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Korende abanto bakaanga gotegerera Samweli, bakabora, “Yaya, taibo! Nigo toganetie omoruoti atogambere.
english: But the people refused to listen to Samuel. "No!" they said. "We want a king over us.

ekegusii: Korende abanto bagakira‐kiri, tibamoiraneria nonya ne ring’ana erimo, ekiagera omoruoti konya abakanirie, “Timobaisa komoiraneria.”
english: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, "Do not answer him."

ekegusii: Korende abanto bagakira‐kiri, tibamoiraneria nonya ne ring’ana erimo, ekiagera omoruoti konya ochikire iga: “Timobaisa komoiraneria.”
english: But the people remained silent and said nothing in reply, because the king had commanded, "Do not answer him."

ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakamoiraneria, “Taibo! Intwe inatomokorere Omonene.”
english: But the people said to Joshua, "No! We will serve the LORD."

ekegusii: Abanto b’omochie oria tibamoroisia, ekiagera arenge kogenda Yerusalemu.
english: but the people there did not welcome him, because he was heading for Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Agwo bakaba nerang’o enene y’amache, bakemurunganeria Musa, bakabora, “Ninki gwatoruseria Misiri gocha aa, amo nabana baito ne chitugo chiaito, togokwa ase erang’o?”
english: But the people were thirsty for water there, and they grumbled against Moses. They said, "Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to make us and our children and livestock die of thirst?"

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, abanto bamenyeteo nigo bare ne chinguru, na emechie yabo nemenene mono, naende egitire buya ne chindwaki. Tari ayio oka, korende boigo ntwarora abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki bare aroro.
english: But the people who live there are powerful, and the cities are fortified and very large. We even saw descendants of Anak there.

ekegusii: But the Pharisee, noticing that Jesus did not first wash before the meal, was surprised.
english: Omofarisai oria agachia korora, agakumia ekiagera ataisabete ritang’ani atararagera.

ekegusii: korende Abafarisai na abanto b’amachiko bagakana omoroberio o Nyasae asebare abanyene, ekiagera tibabatisetwe na Yohana.)
english: But the Pharisees and experts in the law rejected God's purpose for themselves, because they had not been baptized by John.)

ekegusii: Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariko bakemurungania, bakabora, “Oyo nigo akoroisia abanyene ebibe, na koria amo nabarabwo.”
english: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law muttered, "This man welcomes sinners and eats with them."

ekegusii: Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariko babo bakemurunganeria aborokigwa baye, bakabora, “Nase ki mokoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”
english: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law who belonged to their sect complained to his disciples, "Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and 'sinners'?"

ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bakabora, “Nigo agoseria ebirecha ase chinguru chi’omonene bw’ebirecha.”
english: But the Pharisees said, "It is by the prince of demons that he drives out demons."

ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bagasoka isiko, bakagamba igoro ya Yeso buna barakore bamoite.
english: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.

ekegusii: Korende abanene b’Abafilisti bakaba nendamwamu enene ase Akisi, bakamotebia, “Irania omonto oyo agende aase kwamobegete amenye. Ere takogenda amo naintwe korwana esegi. Karaikeo nabo arabaise gotoonchokera, abe omobisa oito. Naki arakore anyore ogwancherwa ase omonene oye otatiga ase ogoita abanto baito.
english: But the Philistine commanders were angry with him and said, "Send the man back, that he may return to the place you assigned him. He must not go with us into battle, or he will turn against us during the fighting. How better could he regain his master's favor than by taking the heads of our own men?

ekegusii: Okogamba kw’Omonene nigo goteneine kare na kare; emeroberio yaye nigo egendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: But the plans of the LORD stand firm forever, the purposes of his heart through all generations.

ekegusii: Korende oria omotaka tarenge na gento, otatiga abwate akamanwa agasigiti, akwo agorete ng’a atuge. Akamanwa akwo gakaba gakomenya inka amo nabana baye, gakaba gakoria endagera abwate na konywera korwa ase egekombe kiaye. Nigo kanarete korara ase egekuba kiaye, gakaba asare buna omwana oye omoiseke.
english: but the poor man had nothing except one little ewe lamb he had bought. He raised it, and it grew up with him and his children. It shared his food, drank from his cup and even slept in his arms. It was like a daughter to him.

ekegusii: Enyongo y’amaroba arenge koroisia egasareka ase okoboko kwaye. Ase ayio akabomba esike eria naende, akaroisia enyongo ende buna aganetie ebe.
english: But the pot he was shaping from the clay was marred in his hands; so the potter formed it into another pot, shaping it as seemed best to him.

ekegusii: Omokuani oria akairaneria Daudi, “Timbwati emegati eria ya botambe aiga, korende emegati eria ere emechenu nereo, na nigo ndakoyee onye abamura abwo betangete na kwerita korwa ase abakungu.”
english: But the priest answered David, "I don't have any ordinary bread on hand; however, there is some consecrated bread here-- provided the men have kept themselves from women."

ekegusii: Omogambi bw’oboruoti bw’Abaayemi akaamererania nainche ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ebere, na rimo, korende Mikaeli, oyomo bw’abagambi baria abanene, agacha gonkonya, ekiagera konya nabeire nteneine inche bweka koamererania nabaruoti b’Abaayemi.
english: But the prince of the Persian kingdom resisted me twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, because I was detained there with the king of Persia.

ekegusii: Erio Gadi omobani agatebia Daudi, “Tokogenderera kobeera ase rikuruma eri; karueo, ogende ase ense ya Yuda.” Ase ayio Daudi akaruao akagenda ase rinani ria Hereti.
english: But the prophet Gad said to David, "Do not stay in the stronghold. Go into the land of Judah." So David left and went to the forest of Hereth.

ekegusii: Korende igoro ase omobani okobana ng’a omorembe nobe, amang’ana ’omobani oyio karaikeranigwe rirorio oyio nomonyakeene, naende namanyekanete ng’a ekeene Omonene nere omotomete.”
english: But the prophet who prophesies peace will be recognized as one truly sent by the LORD only if his prediction comes true."

ekegusii: Korenda oboronge boria bokonyorekana ase okwegena nigo bogoteba iga: Toteba ase enkoro yao ime, “Ning’o oragende gochia igore” (engencho yaye nokorenta Kristo inse aa);
english: But the righteousness that is by faith says: "Do not say in your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?'" (that is, to bring Christ down)

ekegusii: Korende abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono nabanyore oboruoti boragenderere goika kare na kare, ee goika kare na kare.
english: But the saints of the Most High will receive the kingdom and will possess it forever-- yes, for ever and ever.'

ekegusii: Korende amariko asiekeire bonsi inse y’okobua kw’ebibe, erinde abegenire baegwe ayio ariereretwe eira ase enchera y’okomwegena Yeso Kristo.
english: But the Scripture declares that the whole world is a prisoner of sin, so that what was promised, being given through faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who believe.

ekegusii: Na echinde chire ase amaroba amaya; aba nabwo bare ne chinkoro chingiya naende echi’ekeene, bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata, bama okwama noboremereria.
english: But the seed on good soil stands for those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, retain it, and by persevering produce a crop.

ekegusii: Omosomba oria akamoiraneria, “Rora, ase omochie oyo omonto o Nyasae nareo, ere nomonto osikire; amang’ana onsi agokwana nigo agoikerana. Eta togende aroro, ande nabo aratotebie amang’ana igoro y’orogendo rwaito.”
english: But the servant replied, "Look, in this town there is a man of God; he is highly respected, and everything he says comes true. Let's go there now. Perhaps he will tell us what way to take."

ekegusii: Abasomba b’Akisi bakamokwana, “Inee! Oyo tari Daudi Omoruoti? Abakungu tibaterete igoro yaye kobagotenga, bakobora; Saulo oitire chilifu chiaye, korende Daudi oitire chilifu chiaye emerongo na emerongo?”
english: But the servants of Achish said to him, "Isn't this David, the king of the land? Isn't he the one they sing about in their dances: "'Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands'?"

ekegusii: korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nerituko ri’Esabato, riatananetwe na Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye, gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya nomosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose chitugo chiao, gose omomenyi ore mwao.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your animals, nor the alien within your gates.

ekegusii: Korende rituko ria gatano na kabere, nerituko ri’Esabato riatananwe ase Nyasae oo. Ase rituko erio tokora emeremo ende yonsi, aye gose omwana oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nonya nomosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, gose eng’ombe yao, gose etigere yao, gose etugo yao ende yonsi egokora emeremo, gose omomenyi oyomenyete mwao. Omosomba oo, omomura gose omoiseke, nabarabwo batimoke buna aye ogotimoka.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. On it you shall not do any work, neither you, nor your son or daughter, nor your manservant or maidservant, nor your ox, your donkey or any of your animals, nor the alien within your gates, so that your manservant and maidservant may rest, as you do.

ekegusii: Bagaika aase chinsanganio chie chinyancha ibere, bakaroria emeeri aroro goika ekarateera; obosio bw’emeeri bogasensema omokenye, ekabwatwa kegima, korende korwa nyuma egatagorwa ne chinguru chi’emerindo.
english: But the ship struck a sandbar and ran aground. The bow stuck fast and would not move, and the stern was broken to pieces by the pounding of the surf.

ekegusii: korende abana b’oboruoti nabatugutwe isiko ase omosunte; na aroro abanto mbabe nekerero na okoriania amaino.”
english: But the subjects of the kingdom will be thrown outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth."

ekegusii: Korende amache are ase chitente chiaye, na amatibo aye, tagwansa abe amaya, korende nigo aragenderere koba nomonyo.
english: But the swamps and marshes will not become fresh; they will be left for salt.

ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akwanete igoro ye Hekalu y’omobere oye.
english: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.

ekegusii: Korende ebikorwa ase omonwa nigo bikorwa ase enkoro; nabio bikobekera omonto ogotacheneka.
english: But the things that come out of the mouth come from the heart, and these make a man 'unclean.'

ekegusii: Korende amatuko nache barache kourwa omonyuomi, erio nario barache kweng’ata ase rituko riria.
english: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.

ekegusii: Korende amatuko nache, barache kourwa omonyuomi, erio nario barache kweng’ata ase amatuko aria.”
english: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; in those days they will fast."

ekegusii: Enchera y’abakori amabe nigo enga buna omosunte ekerima; tibari komanya ebinto bikobagocha.
english: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.

ekegusii: Korende omoganda bwonsi ogaaka eriogi, ogateba ng’a baitwe namagena. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaoroka mobosokano agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ase Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: But the whole assembly talked about stoning them. Then the glory of the LORD appeared at the Tent of Meeting to all the Israelites.

ekegusii: “Korende abakori amabe nigo banga buna enyancha yaturubanigwe, etanyare gotoerera; amache aye nigo agosiara etintira na eubi gocha igoro.”
english: But the wicked are like the tossing sea, which cannot rest, whose waves cast up mire and mud.

ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbaitwe barue ase ense, na abasaria mbasirigwe kegima.
english: but the wicked will be cut off from the land, and the unfaithful will be torn from it.

ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe mbasirigwe; ababisa b’Omonene nigo bare buna obuya bw’ebisicha, nigo barasire, ee, mbasire buna erioki rigosira kegima.
english: But the wicked will perish: The LORD's enemies will be like the beauty of the fields, they will vanish-- vanish like smoke.

ekegusii: Korende ere, oyotari gwetanga ase okogania kwaye, okure nonya ore moyo.
english: But the widow who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.

ekegusii: Korende obong’aini bokorwa igoro ritang’ani nigo bore obochenu, naende obw’omorembe, na obwororo, na obokanyeku. Igo boichire namabera na okwama okuya, botari na gosiereria gose na bong’ainereria.
english: But the wisdom that comes from heaven is first of all pure; then peace-loving, considerate, submissive, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial and sincere.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaba morito na akaibora omwana omoisia, ase engaki eria eria Elisha konya amotebirie.
english: But the woman became pregnant, and the next year about that same time she gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had told her.

ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, omonene one, tiga inche na eamate ya tata tobogorie okomocha kw’ebibe ebio. Asore omoruoti, gose ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogambi, komocha tikobao.”
english: But the woman from Tekoa said to him, "My lord the king, let the blame rest on me and on my father's family, and let the king and his throne be without guilt."

ekegusii: Omokungu oria konya oirire abanto abwo babere, obabisire. Ase ayio akairaneria, “Amaene, abanto abwo mbacha aa mwane, korende timanyeti ase barwete.
english: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. She said, "Yes, the men came to me, but I did not know where they had come from.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Amaene, aye nomanyete aya Saulo akorire, buna asiririe korwa ase ense eye abakungu abakoboria emeika y’abanto bakure amo nabaringoria bonsi. Nase ki rende okombeka ase oboreba, mbwatwe na gokwa?”
english: But the woman said to him, "Surely you know what Saul has done. He has cut off the mediums and spiritists from the land. Why have you set a trap for my life to bring about my death?"
