ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rikagenderera komentekana.
english: But the word of God continued to increase and spread.

ekegusii: korende ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.” Ne ring’ana eri nario enchili eye mwaranderetigwe.
english: but the word of the Lord stands forever." And this is the word that was preached to you.

ekegusii: korende nigo ngokora buna Tata anchigete, erinde ense emanye ng’a nimwanchete Tata. Imoka, torue aa!
english: but the world must learn that I love the Father and that I do exactly what my Father has commanded me. "Come now; let us leave.

ekegusii: naende okorengereria gw’ense na obong’ainereria bw’enibo, na okogania kw’amang’ana ande kogosoa, biamiga ring’ana riria, riaba tirikwama.
english: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, making it unfruitful.

ekegusii: Emegwekano abanto abwo bagosasima nigo eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu, nigo ere emeremo y’amaboko a mwanyabanto.
english: But their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

ekegusii: Korende ebirengererio biabo bigakong’igwa. Naki nonya ngoika rituko ria rero, ekero amariko ’okobwatana ogokoro agosomwa, egietubo ekio ekio keba tigekorusigwa, ekiagera ase Kristo bweka kiarusigwe.
english: But their minds were made dull, for to this day the same veil remains when the old covenant is read. It has not been removed, because only in Christ is it taken away.

ekegusii: Rora, ogosesenigwa kwabo tikori ase amaboko abo; ogosemia kw’abakori amabe nigo kore aare nainche.
english: But their prosperity is not in their own hands, so I stand aloof from the counsel of the wicked.

ekegusii: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
english: Emeyio yabo nebete chinkoro chiabo abanyene, na amata abo nabunwe.

ekegusii: Korende nigo bakwanete amang’ana amansu ase okomong’aina, bagakwana oborimo nemenwa yabo.
english: But then they would flatter him with their mouths, lying to him with their tongues;

ekegusii: Korende abanto aba nabange mono, na engaki eye ney’embura enyinge, titokonyara kogenderera gotenena aa isiko ase eraaro. Emeremo eye teri eye rituko erimo, gose ey’amatuko abere, ekiagera twamochire mono ase ring’ana eri.
english: But there are many people here and it is the rainy season; so we cannot stand outside. Besides, this matter cannot be taken care of in a day or two, because we have sinned greatly in this thing.

ekegusii: Abwo mbagwenerete koba aiga ase obosio bwao na gonsoera, onye bare ne ring’ana igoro asende.
english: But there are some Jews from the province of Asia, who ought to be here before you and bring charges if they have anything against me.

ekegusii: Bono mbare aa abanto bande b’Abayahudi abwo gwachorete gotenenera amang’ana ’orogongo oro rwa Babeli: Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego. Aye omoruoti, abanto aba bachayire amachiko ao; barabwo tibari gokorera chinyasae chiao gose gotung’ama na koumama ase ogosasima omogwekano oria bw’etahabu aye gwatenenetie.”
english: But there are some Jews whom you have set over the affairs of the province of Babylon-- Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego-- who pay no attention to you, O king. They neither serve your gods nor worship the image of gold you have set up."

ekegusii: korende Nyasae ore igoro nere oranyare koorokia obobisi. Nere orakomanyie aye omoruoti Nebukadinesaro amang’ana agochia gokorekana ase amatuko agochi‐gocha. Chindoto chiao na okorora kwarora, ekero kwaraire borere, nachio echi:
english: but there is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries. He has shown King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in days to come. Your dream and the visions that passed through your mind as you lay on your bed are these:

ekegusii: Korende aase gete omonto oyomo naorogetie oborori, agateba, “Omonto inki aisaine aye ogendererete komorengereria? Mwanyabanto inki aisaine aye okomorenda?
english: But there is a place where someone has testified: "What is man that you are mindful of him, the son of man that you care for him?

ekegusii: Korende ababani b’oborimo mbaorogete ase egati y’abanto, buna aborokia b’oborimo barache kooroka ase egati yaino. Abwo barache gosoyia amorokererio ’ogosareka bobisi, na bagokana Omonene oyo obagorete, bakwerentera ogosareka gotari gotebana.
english: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the sovereign Lord who bought them-- bringing swift destruction on themselves.

ekegusii: Korende ebisaku bitano na bibere mbiatigarete bitaatananeretwe ensemo y’ense ebe omwando obo.
english: but there were still seven Israelite tribes who had not yet received their inheritance.

ekegusii: korende ebi biarikirwe, erinde monyare kwegena ng’a Yeso nere Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae; naende ase okwegena mobe nobogima ase erieta riaye.
english: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.

ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo nigo banga buna ching’iti chiatongetwe chitari nobong’aini, chiaiboretwe ase okobwatwa na gosirigwa. Barabwo nigo bakorama ase amang’ana batamanyeti. Ase ayio inabasirigwe ase ogosirigwa kwabo abanyene.
english: But these men blaspheme in matters they do not understand. They are like brute beasts, creatures of instinct, born only to be caught and destroyed, and like beasts they too will perish.

ekegusii: Korende abanto aba nigo bare ne chinkoro chinkong’u chi’ogotaigwera, baonchokire bantigire.
english: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts; they have turned aside and gone away.

ekegusii: But these you may not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,
english: Timoria chinyoni echi: ekeongo, na ensoti, na obotere;

ekegusii: Aba nabanto bao, na omwando oo, aba kwang’anyetie ne chinguru chinene, na ase okoboko kwao koramboire.
english: But they are your people, your inheritance that you brought out by your great power and your outstretched arm."

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo abanto abwo nigo bamentete gokora ebibe ase Omonene, agwo ase erooro nigo basaretie ase Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.
english: But they continued to sin against him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.

ekegusii: Korende tibanyara kobua obong’aini na Omoika oyo are gokwana noro.
english: but they could not stand up against his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke.

ekegusii: Erio chisokoro chiaino chikarera asende inche Omonene, mbakonye, na inche nkabeka omosunte ase egati yaino na Abamisiri. Nkaonchora enyancha egatuba Abamisiri ekabamera. Ee, mwaroche namaiso aino aya nakorete ase Abamisiri. Erio ase engaki entambe mokamenya ase erooro.
english: But they cried to the LORD for help, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians; he brought the sea over them and covered them. You saw with your own eyes what I did to the Egyptians. Then you lived in the desert for a long time.

ekegusii: Naki nigo bamiametie amaiso abo tibarora ng’a igoro nao yarenge korwa kare, na ense egatongwa korwa ase amache, na goetera ase amache, ase chinguru chie ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: But they deliberately forget that long ago by God's word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water.

ekegusii: Amang’ana abo akarorekana koba ng’a naya bosa asebare, gose tibayancha. [
english: But they did not believe the women, because their words seemed to them like nonsense.

ekegusii: korende nonya abarori abange b’oborimo bachete, tibayanyora. Omoerio abarori babere bagacha,
english: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward

ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo tibanyigwerete, korende bakabwatia ogosemania kwabo abanyene, na oboenenu bwe chinkoro chiabo chi’ebibe. Bakairana gochia nyuma, gose tibagendererete gochia bosio.
english: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubborn inclinations of their evil hearts. They went backward and not forward.

ekegusii: Korende tichianyigwerete gose gontegerera. Kera omonto nigo akong’etie enkoro yaye, akagenderera gokora ebibe. Nigo nachichigete chibwate okobwatana koria, korende chikaanga. Ase ayio nkabaikeraneria amang’ana onsi ay’okobwatana koria.”
english: But they did not listen or pay attention; instead, they followed the stubbornness of their evil hearts. So I brought on them all the curses of the covenant I had commanded them to follow but that they did not keep.'"

ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo tibaigwerete, gose gontegerera, erinde baonchoke korwa ase obobe, gose batige gosamba ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao.
english: But they did not listen or pay attention; they did not turn from their wickedness or stop burning incense to other gods.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo tibanyigwerete, gose gotegerera amang’ana aane, korende bakaba abanyabigoti bikong’u. Bakagenderera gokora amabe mono kobua chisokoro chiabo.
english: But they did not listen to me or pay attention. They were stiff-necked and did more evil than their forefathers.'

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, tibeatananete korwa ase ebibe bi’enyomba ya Yeroboamu, biria ere akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe, korende bakaba bakogenderera kobikora. Boigo omote bw’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, ogatigara agwo Samaria.
english: But they did not turn away from the sins of the house of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit; they continued in them. Also, the Asherah pole remained standing in Samaria.

ekegusii: Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, bakairoka komoboria.
english: But they did not understand what he meant and were afraid to ask him about it.

ekegusii: Tibamanya ring’ana riria abatebia.
english: But they did not understand what he was saying to them.

ekegusii: Korende tibamanya ring’ana riria, rikaba ndiabiseka asebare, erinde tibarimanya. Bakaba nobwoba komoboria engencho ye ring’ana riria.
english: But they did not understand what this meant. It was hidden from them, so that they did not grasp it, and they were afraid to ask him about it.

ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo tibamanyeti ebirengererio bi’Omonene, gose tibamanyeti omoroberio oye ng’a obasangereirie amo buna emesaima ere ase ekeooreri gi’okoorera.
english: But they do not know the thoughts of the LORD; they do not understand his plan, he who gathers them like sheaves to the threshing floor.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibari korengereria ng’a inche nigo ng’inyorete ogokora kwabo gwonsi okobe. Bono ogokora okwo kwabo okobe kwabaetananire onsi nigo kore ase obosio bwane.
english: but they do not realize that I remember all their evil deeds. Their sins engulf them; they are always before me.

ekegusii: Abasiiria bagatama korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli, na Daudi agaita Abasiiria abagendia chigari amagana atano na abere (700), na abariini chibarasi chilifu emerongo ene (40,000), naende agaaka Sobaki, omotang’ani bw’abarwani, goika agakwerao.
english: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven hundred of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also struck down Shobach the commander of their army, and he died there.

ekegusii: Abasiiria bagatama korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli; na Daudi agaita Abasiiria abagendia chigari chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), na abarwani barenge gotaara namagoro chilifu emerongo ene (40,000). Boigo agaita Sofaki, omochiki obo bw’abarwani esegi.
english: But they fled before Israel, and David killed seven thousand of their charioteers and forty thousand of their foot soldiers. He also killed Shophach the commander of their army.

ekegusii: But they found out about it and fled to the Lycaonian cities of Lystra and Derbe and to the surrounding country,
english: barabwo bakanyora amang’ana, bagatama gochia Listra na Deribe, emechie ya Lukania, ne chinsemo chionsi echiarenge ang’e.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibarenge nomwana, ekiagera Elisabeti nigo arenge omogomba, na barabwo bonsi babere konya bagotire mono.
english: But they had no children, because Elizabeth was barren; and they were both well along in years.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobetereria, bakabora, “Oburukanirie abanto, okoborokereria ase Boyahudi yonsi, gochakera Galili goika aiga.”
english: But they insisted, "He stirs up the people all over Judea by his teaching. He started in Galilee and has come all the way here."

ekegusii: Bagakira, ekiagera ekero barenge inchera baare koamererania barabwo ase barabwo ning’o ore omonene kobua abande.
english: But they kept quiet because on the way they had argued about who was the greatest.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Mobambe, mobambe!”
english: But they kept shouting, "Crucify him! Crucify him!"

ekegusii: Bakamosekerera. Korende gaikire kobasokia isiko bonsi, akaira ise omwana, na ng’ina, na baria barenge amo nere, agasoa ime ase omwana oria arenge.
english: But they laughed at him. After he put them all out, he took the child's father and mother and the disciples who were with him, and went in where the child was.

ekegusii: Korende nigo basang’ananete nabanto abwo bakeorokereria ogokora kwabo.
english: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

ekegusii: Korende bakagenderera gochecheria abatomwa ba Nyasae, bagachaya amang’ana aye, na bagachecheria ababani baye. Ase igo endamwamu y’Omonene ekaba enene igoro ase abanto baye, na gotooreka tikwanyorekana asebare.
english: But they mocked God's messengers, despised his words and scoffed at his prophets until the wrath of the LORD was aroused against his people and there was no remedy.

ekegusii: Korende timobaboria borokie omobaro bwe chibesa chirabekwe ase amaboko abo, ekiagera nigo barachikorere emeremo ase obwegenwa.”
english: But they need not account for the money entrusted to them, because they are acting faithfully."

ekegusii: Korende ekero bagendererete komoboria, ere akarosa, agateba, “Batome rende.” Barabwo bagatoma abanto emerongo etano, bagachia komorigia ase engaki y’amatuko atato, tibamonyora.
english: But they persisted until he was too ashamed to refuse. So he said, "Send them." And they sent fifty men, who searched for three days but did not find him.

ekegusii: Korende bagakora omoroberio bw’okomoita, na ase ogochika kw’omoruoti bakamoaka amagena ase eraaro y’enyomba y’Omonene goika agakwa.
english: But they plotted against him, and by order of the king they stoned him to death in the courtyard of the LORD's temple.

ekegusii: Erio bagateema Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, bakamogechia, tibabwatete amachiko aye.
english: But they put God to the test and rebelled against the Most High; they did not keep his statutes.

ekegusii: Bagakira. Akamobwata, akamogwenia, akamoa ribaga agende.
english: But they remained silent. So taking hold of the man, he healed him and sent him away.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Inee! Nabo barabwo bagwenerete bakorere omoiseke ominto buna omokungu omotayayi?”
english: But they replied, "Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?"

ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakairaneria, bakabora, “Intwe titokonywa edivai, ekiagera Yonadabu, mosinto o Rekabu, sokoro yaito, natokanetie ng’a titobaisa konywa edivai nonya ng’ake, intwe gose chinderia chiaito.
english: But they replied, "We do not drink wine, because our forefather Jonadab son of Recab gave us this command: 'Neither you nor your descendants must ever drink wine.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abamura ikomi na babere, abana b’omonto oyomo, ase ense ya Kanani; na bono omoke ominto tari aa, inka akare ase tata, na oyomo ere takaiyo.”
english: But they replied, "Your servants were twelve brothers, the sons of one man, who lives in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more."

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Naki aye, omonene oito, ogokwana amang’ana buna ayio?
english: But they said to him, "Why does my lord say such things? Far be it from your servants to do anything like that!

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamorora ere okare egeka, ritang’ani konya ataraika ang’e asebare, bakagamba buna bamoite.
english: But they saw him in the distance, and before he reached them, they plotted to kill him.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamobwata, bakamoaka, bakamoseria atari na gento.
english: But they seized him, beat him and sent him away empty-handed.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagaaka eriogi, “Morusie, morusie, mobambe!” Pilato akababoria, “Imobambe omoruoti oino?” Abakuani abanene bakairaneria, “Titori nomoruoti otatiga Kaisari.”
english: But they shouted, "Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!" "Shall I crucify your king?" Pilate asked. "We have no king but Caesar," the chief priests answered.

ekegusii: Korende ase obwango bakeba ogokora kwaye, tibaganyete Omonene abasemie.
english: But they soon forgot what he had done and did not wait for his counsel.

ekegusii: otatiga omoruoti o Ai. Ere akabwatwa, akarentwa ore moyo ase Yoshua.
english: But they took the king of Ai alive and brought him to Joshua.

ekegusii: Eleazari agatenena gati gati y’omogondo oria, akaba omokong’u akayoegera, agaaka Abafilisti, akabaita. Omonene akabaa obobui obonene.
english: But they took their stand in the middle of the field. They defended it and struck the Philistines down, and the LORD brought about a great victory.

ekegusii: Bakamosorora, bakabora, “Kabe amo naintwe, ekiagera bwairire, na omobaso oerire bono.” Agasoa koba amo nabarabwo.
english: But they urged him strongly, "Stay with us, for it is nearly evening; the day is almost over." So he went in to stay with them.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo bagasoka isiko, bagasareria amang’ana aye ase ense eria yonsi.
english: But they went out and spread the news about him all over that region.

ekegusii: Na barabwo bagaichorwa nokobea, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, buna baramokore Yeso.
english: But they were furious and began to discuss with one another what they might do to Jesus.

ekegusii: Amaiso abo agatubwa, tibanyara komomanya.
english: but they were kept from recognizing him.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo bakaba nobwoba obonene mono, bagateba, “Abaruoti babere tibanyarete kobua Yehu, naki intwe torakore tomobue?”
english: But they were terrified and said, "If two kings could not resist him, how can we?"

ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ebisaku bia moocha bagakora ogosaria ase Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, bagakora obotayai, bakabwatia chinyasae chi’abanto b’ense eria, abwo Nyasae asiretie korwa asebare.
english: But they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers and prostituted themselves to the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo nigo barache korua omobaro asare ere oyore ang’e kogambia abare moyo na abakure.
english: But they will have to give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

ekegusii: Omonto omoao tichikomotunyana nonya ng’ake, korende nigo chiramotame, ekiagera tichimanyeti eriogi ri’abanto abaao.”
english: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a stranger's voice."

ekegusii: korende tibakogenderera mono, ekiagera oboriri bwabo naboorokigwe maiso marore ase abanto bonsi, buna yabete ase baria babere.
english: But they will not get very far because, as in the case of those men, their folly will be clear to everyone.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo mbatebe: Ayio namang’ana a bosa. Ntoganetie tokore buna torengereretie, kera oyomo nigo arabwatie obomwenu bw’enkoro yaye embe.”
english: But they will reply, 'It's no use. We will continue with our own plans; each of us will follow the stubbornness of his evil heart.'"

ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ayio nigo barakwane: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyio orusetie na koraa ororeria rw’Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na korwa ase chinse chionsi agwo ase abaseretie gochia.” Erio mbamenye ase ense yabo abanyene.
english: but they will say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the descendants of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.' Then they will live in their own land."

ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ayio nigo barakwane: “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyio orusetie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na korwa ase chinse chionsi, agwo ase abaseretie gochia”. Ayio nakoreke, ekiagera inche nimbairanie, mbarente ase ense yabo abanyene, eyio naete chisokoro chiabo.
english: but they will say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites up out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had banished them.' For I will restore them to the land I gave their forefathers.

ekegusii: Korende tibaigwete; bagakong’ia ebigoti biabo buna chisokoro chiabo chiakorete, abwo batamwegenete Omonene, Nyasae obo.
english: But they would not listen and were as stiff-necked as their fathers, who did not trust in the LORD their God.

ekegusii: Korende aya onsi abeire, erinde amariko ’ababani aikeranigwe.” Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama.
english: But this has all taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled." Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.

ekegusii: Korende abanto aba baibirwe na gosakorwa, bonsi bategirwe na kogwa ase chiirima; nigo babisire ase chinyomba chi’obosibwa; bairirwe, onde tari orabatoorie, boosirwe, onde tari ogoteba: “Tiga bairanigwe.”
english: But this is a people plundered and looted, all of them trapped in pits or hidden away in prisons. They have become plunder, with no one to rescue them; they have been made loot, with no one to say, "Send them back."

ekegusii: Korende aya Nyasae akwanete ase emenwa y’ababani bonsi, ng’a Kristo oye nachandwe, oyaikeranirie ase enchera eye.
english: But this is how God fulfilled what he had foretold through all the prophets, saying that his Christ would suffer.

ekegusii: Korende ase Musa, omosomba one, taibo, ere nomwegenwa ase enyomba yane yonsi.
english: But this is not true of my servant Moses; he is faithful in all my house.

ekegusii: “Korende omoruoti bw’Abaasuri takagerete ayio, gose tayarengereretie. Ere nigo aganetie goita na gosiria ebisaku ebinge.
english: But this is not what he intends, this is not what he has in mind; his purpose is to destroy, to put an end to many nations.

ekegusii: Korende igo riikerane ring’ana eriarigetwe ase amachiko abo: Nigo bangechete bosa.
english: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: 'They hated me without reason.'

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire igoro y’omoruoti oikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi, na igoro y’abanto bonsi bamenyete ase omochie oyo, abamino baria batairetwe ase obosomba amo nainwe,
english: but this is what the LORD says about the king who sits on David's throne and all the people who remain in this city, your countrymen who did not go with you into exile--

ekegusii: Ee, aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Nonya nabasibwa b’oyore ne chinguru mbarusigweo, na egiasakoretwe noyore omotindi ngetoorigwe, inche Omonene ning’amereranie noyio ogokoamereria, nintoorie abana bao.
english: But this is what the LORD says: "Yes, captives will be taken from warriors, and plunder retrieved from the fierce; I will contend with those who contend with you, and your children I will save.

ekegusii: Korende Farao agakong’ia enkoro yaye nonya nengaki eyio, taa abanto ribaga bagende.
english: But this time also Pharaoh hardened his heart and would not let the people go.

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rigacha ase Semaya, omonto o Nyasae,
english: But this word of God came to Shemaiah the man of God:

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia: Aye gwaiteire amanyinga amange, naende kwarwanire chisegi chinene; na ase engencho y’amanyinga aya amange gwaiteire ase obosio bwane tokonyara koagacha enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane.
english: But this word of the LORD came to me: 'You have shed much blood and have fought many wars. You are not to build a house for my Name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae rigacha ase Semaya, omonto o Nyasae, rigateba,
english: But this word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God:

ekegusii: Korende baria ababisa baane batarigeti mbagambere, barente aiga, mobaite ase obosio bwane.”
english: But those enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them-- bring them here and kill them in front of me.'"

ekegusii: Korende ebing’wanso ebio nigo bikobainyoria igoro y’ebibe kera omwaka.
english: But those sacrifices are an annual reminder of sins,

ekegusii: korende barabwo ababarirwe bagwenerete konyora ense eria, na kobokigwa korwa ase abakure, tibakonyuoma, gose tibakonyuomwa.
english: But those who are considered worthy of taking part in that age and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage,

ekegusii: Korende abanto abakwete ase ogoakwa okwo nigo babete chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.

ekegusii: Taibo, korende abwo barayegese nabwo barayerie, erio batogie Omonene; na abwo baratore amasabibu nabwo baranywe edivai, agwo ase chigoora chi’Aase aane Aachenu.”
english: but those who harvest it will eat it and praise the LORD, and those who gather the grapes will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary."

ekegusii: Korende ere nigo akobaakana obobe baria bamogechete, na kobasiria. Tari gotebana koa omonto oria omogechete egesusuro.
english: But those who hate him he will repay to their face by destruction; he will not be slow to repay to their face those who hate him.

ekegusii: korende abwo baganyete na gosemeria Omonene mbaegwe chinguru chinyia, mbairuruke gochia igoro ne chimbaba buna echi’ebiongo; mbabe bakominyoka batari korosa, mbabe bagotaara batari kogoya.
english: but those who hope in the LORD will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

ekegusii: Korende abwo basiereretie ring’ana ri’Omonene, bagatiga abasomba babo ne chitugo chiabo isiko.
english: But those who ignored the word of the LORD left their slaves and livestock in the field.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka goetera ase emechando yabo, otinora amato abo goetera ase ogokorerwa bobe kwabo.
english: But those who suffer he delivers in their suffering; he speaks to them in their affliction.

ekegusii: Korende abanto basemeretie emegwekano egosasimwa mbairanigwe nyuma, basookigwe, ekiagera nigo bagotebia emegwekano eyio ebombire; Inwe ninwe chinyasae chiaito.”
english: But those who trust in idols, who say to images, 'You are our gods,' will be turned back in utter shame.

ekegusii: Korende abwo bakogobera gochia ase chinchera chiabo chi’obosiru, Omonene nabarusieo amo nabagokora amabe. Omorembe obe ase Abaisraeli!
english: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.

ekegusii: Korende ekaba ase omoerio bw’omwaka o gatato abasomba babere ba Simei bagatama, bakagenda ase Akisi, mosinto o Maaka, omoruoti o Gati. Simei agatebigwa ng’a abasomba baye nao bakare agwo Gati.
english: But three years later, two of Shimei's slaves ran off to Achish son of Maacah, king of Gath, and Shimei was told, "Your slaves are in Gath."

ekegusii: Korende bono ekero Timotheo achete asetore korwa seino agatorentera amang’ana amaya igoro y’okwegena kwaino na obwanchani bwaino, na buna motoinyorete buya botambe. Naende agatotebia ng’a more namaiga gotorora intwe, buna naintwe tore namaiga kobarora inwe.
english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you and has brought good news about your faith and love. He has told us that you always have pleasant memories of us and that you long to see us, just as we also long to see you.

ekegusii: Korende kera oyomo oito naetwe obuya koreng’ana nekerengo gi’ekeegwa gia Kristo.
english: But to each one of us grace has been given as Christ apportioned it.

ekegusii: Korende ase Hana nigo arenge komoa ebitari bibere, ekiagera nigo amwanchete nonya Omonene omotangete koibora abana.
english: But to Hannah he gave a double portion because he loved her, and the LORD had closed her womb.

ekegusii: korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio na okoboko kwane gw’okobee tinkonyara kobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire barariegwe.”
english: but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared."

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana eri tiricha gosiarerwa egati y’abanto; tiga tobagose, tibakwana na monto onde bwensi ase erieta eri.”
english: But to stop this thing from spreading any further among the people, we must warn these men to speak no longer to anyone in this name."

ekegusii: na abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben na ab’egesaku kia Gadi nkabaa orogongo gochakera Gileadi goikera orooche rw’Arinoni. Egati‐gati y’orooche orwo ekaba orobebe rwabo rw’ensemo ya irianyi, na orooche rwa Yaboki rokaba orobebe rwabo sugusu, orwarenge orobebe rw’Abaamori.
english: But to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory extending from Gilead down to the Arnon Gorge (the middle of the gorge being the border) and out to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Yoshua agatebia abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase,
english: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Lawi Musa tabaete ensemo ende yonsi ebe omwando obo. Barabwo nigo barabe bakonyora omwando obo obatungetie korwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, egekoruegwa ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene atebetie Musa.
english: But to the tribe of Levi he gave no inheritance, since the offerings made by fire to the LORD, the God of Israel, are their inheritance, as he promised them.

ekegusii: Korende Musa taete egesaku kia Lawi ensemo ende yonsi ebe omwando obo. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nere obete omwando obo, buna abatebetie.
english: But to the tribe of Levi, Moses had given no inheritance; the LORD, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he promised them.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo agotebia omokori amabe, “Naye mboronge ki obwate okonagwatora amachiko aane? Gose kona‐gokwana‐kwana okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania?
english: But to the wicked, God says: "What right have you to recite my laws or take my covenant on your lips?

ekegusii: korende goika rituko ria rero Omonene taraigora ebirengererio biaino, erinde monyare komanya buya; gose tarabaa amaiso akorora buya, gose amato akoigwa buya
english: But to this day the LORD has not given you a mind that understands or eyes that see or ears that hear.

ekegusii: Korende ase abwo barangeretigwe, Abayahudi na Abagiriki bonsi, Kristo nere chinguru chia Nyasae, na obong’aini bwa Nyasae.
english: but to those whom God has called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.

ekegusii: Rora, rituko ria rero nkorusia nde chingataare echio ase amaboko ao, nagosiboire. Korarore ng’a mbuya ogende amo nainche Babeli, inchuo togende, nainche ninkorende buya mono. Korende korarore ng’a tari buya kogenda amo nainche Babeli, tobaisa kogenda. Rigereria ense yonsi nigo ere ase obosio bwao; genda aase orarore are buya na boronge asore.”
english: But today I am freeing you from the chains on your wrists. Come with me to Babylon, if you like, and I will look after you; but if you do not want to, then don't come. Look, the whole country lies before you; go wherever you please."

ekegusii: Korende manya aya, onye omonyene enyomba namanyete ensa omoibi agocha, anga narendete, taiberwa.
english: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.

ekegusii: Korende manya aya, onye omonyene enyomba namanyete nkero ki ase obotuko omoibi agocha, anga narendete taiberwa.
english: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.

ekegusii: Ere tekeetie ase obosio bw’Omonene na koba omoitongo buna Manase akorete, korende Amoni oyio akagenderera gokora amamocho goetania.
english: But unlike his father Manasseh, he did not humble himself before the LORD; Amon increased his guilt.

ekegusii: Korende Uria akarara gesieri ki’enyomba y’omoruoti amo nabasomba bonsi b’omonene oye, tatirimboka gochia bwoye.
english: But Uriah slept at the entrance to the palace with all his master's servants and did not go down to his house.

ekegusii: Korende intwe titori ase abwo bagosukwana na gosira, korende ase abwo bare nokwegena ase okoegera emioyo yaito.
english: But we are not of those who shrink back and are destroyed, but of those who believe and are saved.

ekegusii: Erio intwe toimokie ebirwanero bi esegi, twebeke ang’e totang’ane Abaisraeli korwana esegi goika tobaikie aase abo. Korende abana baito batigare aa, bamenyete emechie egiteire chindwaki, erinde abanto b’ense eye tibabaisa kobakora bobe.
english: But we are ready to arm ourselves and go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them to their place. Meanwhile our women and children will live in fortified cities, for protection from the inhabitants of the land.

ekegusii: Korende intwe iga twasemeretie ng’a nere oraboorie Abaisraeli. Kobua aya onsi, rero nerituko ria gatato korwa ekero ayio akorekanete.
english: but we had hoped that he was the one who was going to redeem Israel. And what is more, it is the third day since all this took place.

ekegusii: But we had to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.'"
english: Mboronge gokora omogoko na gochenga, ekiagera oyo momura omino konya okure, na bono moyo are; konya osirire, na bono ororekanire.”

ekegusii: Korende ntore nobotenenku obo ime ase ebibekerero bi’amaroba, erinde aorokigwe ng’a okobua okonene gwe chinguru nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae, gose tikori korwa asetore intwe abanyene.
english: But we have this treasure in jars of clay to show that this all-surpassing power is from God and not from us.

ekegusii: Na oyo twamomanyire aase arure, korende Kristo karache, onde tari oramanye aase akorwa.”
english: But we know where this man is from; when the Christ comes, no one will know where he is from."

ekegusii: Korende baminto, netogwenerete koiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono botambe ase engencho yaino, inwe abamwanchire n’Omonene, ekiagera Nyasae abachorete korwa omochakano, erinde monyore ogotooreka ase ogochenwa kogokorwa n’Omoika, na kwegena ekeene.
english: But we ought always to thank God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because from the beginning God chose you to be saved through the sanctifying work of the Spirit and through belief in the truth.

ekegusii: Korende intwe togasaba Nyasae oito, tokabeka abanto barenge gotorenda omobaso na obotuko, ase engencho y’abanto abwo.
english: But we prayed to our God and posted a guard day and night to meet this threat.

ekegusii: korende intwe nigo tokomorandia Kristo oyobambetwe, ase Abayahudi nekegocha, na ase abanto b’Ebisaku noboriri.
english: but we preach Christ crucified: a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles,

ekegusii: Korende tokamotebia: Intwe nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.
english: But we said to him, 'We are honest men; we are not spies.

ekegusii: tokamoiraneria: Titokonyara gotirimboka gochia ase obosio bw’omonto oria, oyominto omoke atari amo naintwe, korende onye oyominto ogotirimboka amo naintwe, rirorio natogende.
english: But we said, 'We cannot go down. Only if our youngest brother is with us will we go. We cannot see the man's face unless our youngest brother is with us.'

ekegusii: Intwe tokarua Filipi nemeeri nyuma y’amatuko Emegati etabekiri memera, tokagenda orogendo rw’amatuko atano, tokabaikeera Teroa. Tokabeera aroro amatuko atano na abere.
english: But we sailed from Philippi after the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and five days later joined the others at Troas, where we stayed seven days.

ekegusii: Korende twarorire ere, oyokorirwe koba omoke kobua abamalaika ase ekero egeke, nere Yeso, obekeirwe egutwa y’obonene na amasikani ase engencho y’ogochandwa kwaye kw’amakweri, erio ase obuya bwa Nyasae aigwe amakweri ribaga ria kera omonto.
english: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor because he suffered death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.

ekegusii: Korende ntorigetie koigwa korwa asore buna oroche aye, ekiagera ase ekeombe keria twamanyire ng’a giakwanirwe bobe kera aase.”
english: But we want to hear what your views are, for we know that people everywhere are talking against this sect."

ekegusii: Buna abatomwa ba Kristo anga ntwabaritoerete, korende nigo tware abororo ase egati yaino, buna omokungu akorera abana baye.
english: but we were gentle among you, like a mother caring for her little children.

ekegusii: Inki bono ngokwana? Omonene nere okwanire nainche, nere omonyene okorire amang’ana aya. Ase igo nintaare inde nobokanyeku ase emiaka yane yonsi, ase engencho y’obororo bwonsi bw’omoyo one.
english: But what can I say? He has spoken to me, and he himself has done this. I will walk humbly all my years because of this anguish of my soul.

ekegusii: Ninki mwachiete korora? Omobani? Ee, nabatebirie: Oyore omonene kobua omobani,
english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

ekegusii: Inki rende? Nonya nabo, ase kera enchera Kristo nigo arararigwe, ase obong’ainereria gose ase ekeene, na ase ayio nagokire.
english: But what does it matter? The important thing is that in every way, whether from false motives or true, Christ is preached. And because of this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,

ekegusii: Korende, naki bogoteba? Ring’ana riria nigo rire ang’e naye, ase omonwa oo, na ime ase enkoro yao (eri nering’ana ri’okwegena, nidiria tokorandia).
english: But what does it say? "The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart," that is, the word of faith we are proclaiming:

ekegusii: Korende amariko naki agoteba? Igo agoteba, “Seria omosomba oria amo nomwana oye, ekiagera omwana bw’omokungu omosomba takonyora omwando nonya ng’ake amo nomwana bw’omokungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.”
english: But what does the Scripture say? "Get rid of the slave woman and her son, for the slave woman's son will never share in the inheritance with the free woman's son."

ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aria arenge okonyora asende nayabarire koba bosa ase engencho ya Kristo.
english: But whatever was to my profit I now consider loss for the sake of Christ.

ekegusii: Korende ekero oranyore amaya, ong’inyore nainche, ondorere amabera. Koranche nagosabire onyatore ase Farao, ondusie ase enyomba eye,
english: But when all goes well with you, remember me and show me kindness; mention me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison.

ekegusii: Amasa akagenda kobarangeria, korende agateba na, tairana ase engaki eria omoruoti, amobekerete.
english: But when Amasa went to summon Judah, he took longer than the time the king had set for him.

ekegusii: Nonya nekero abanto batometwe nabanene ba Babeli baborie komanya igoro y’egekone giakorekanete ase ense eria, Nyasae akaramotiga ake amoteeme amanye onsi ayarenge ime ase enkoro yaye.
english: But when envoys were sent by the rulers of Babylon to ask him about the miraculous sign that had occurred in the land, God left him to test him and to know everything that was in his heart.

ekegusii: But when evening came, he took his daughter Leah and gave her to Jacob, and Jacob lay with her.
english: Rigachia koba mogoroba akaimokia Lea, omoiseke oye, akamorentera Yakobo, na barabwo babere bakaba bakorara amo.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae oyonchorete ekero narenge ase enda ya baba na akandangeria ase obuya bwaye,
english: But when God, who set me apart from birth and called me by his grace, was pleased

ekegusii: Korende oyogosaba, tiga asabe ase okwegena, taba na tang’u‐tang’u, ekiagera oyore ne chitang’u‐tang’u nigo are buna emerindo y’enyancha ekona‐koirwa nomwaga gochia aaria na aaria.
english: But when he asks, he must believe and not doubt, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.

ekegusii: Kairanirie okoboko kwaye, rora, oyomwabo akaromeng’ana, agasoka isiko. Erio omoiboria agateba, “Naki okoromeng’ana ne chinguru iga?” Ase ayio bakamoroka Peresi.
english: But when he drew back his hand, his brother came out, and she said, "So this is how you have broken out!" And he was named Perez.

ekegusii: Korende agachia koigwa ng’a Arikelau obekirwe oboruoti Boyahudi ase ribaga ria Herode ise, akaba nokoiroka ase okogenda aroro, korende erio gakureirwe na Nyasae ase okorota, akagenda ensemo ya Galili.
english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. Having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,

ekegusii: Ekero Yeremia aigete ase Egeita kia Benjamin, akaumera omoteneneri bw’abarendi ore korokwa Iriya. Ere nigo arenge mosinto o Selemia bw’Anania. Oyio akabwata Yeremia omobani, akamotebia, “Aye nigo ogotama gochia kobwatana n’Abakalidayo.”
english: But when he reached the Benjamin Gate, the captain of the guard, whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah, arrested him and said, "You are deserting to the Babylonians!"

ekegusii: Agachia korora abanto abange ase Abafarisai na Abasadukai bakomochiera ase ebatiso, akabatebia, “Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti, ning’o obakureire ng’a motame korwa ase endamwamu egochi‐gocha?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to where he was baptizing, he said to them: "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

ekegusii: Na ekero aroche ng’a baria batato tibabwate ing’ana baare koiraneria, akaba nendamwamu.
english: But when he saw that the three men had nothing more to say, his anger was aroused.

ekegusii: Korende ekero achia korora omwaga bwe chinguru, akairoka, agachaka korimera amache ime, agaaka eriogi, agateba, “Omonene ntooria!”
english: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, "Lord, save me!"

ekegusii: Korende ekero arache ere, Omoika bw’Ekeene, nobaraae ase onsi ayare ay’ekeene, ere tagokwana ayare ayaye, korende onsi ayaranyare koigwa nayakwane, naende amang’ana agochi‐gocha nabatebie engencho yaye.
english: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.

ekegusii: Korende Herode agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oyo nere Yohana oria nanachete omotwe, obokire.”
english: But when Herod heard this, he said, "John, the man I beheaded, has been raised from the dead!"

ekegusii: Korende ekero Hiramu achete korwa Turo korora emechie eria, tiyamogogetie.
english: But when Hiram went from Tyre to see the towns that Solomon had given him, he was not pleased with them.

ekegusii: Korende ekero enkoro yaye yeimokereretie igoro, na omoika oye okong’ete na koenena, nigo aseretigwe korwa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti, akaurwa obonene bwaye.
english: But when his heart became arrogant and hardened with pride, he was deposed from his royal throne and stripped of his glory.

ekegusii: korende ekero ndakwe, tiga ndare ne chisokoro chiane. Ombogorie korwa aa Misiri, ontindeke aase barabwo batindegetwe.” Yusufu akamoiraneria, “Ninkore buna gwantebirie.”
english: but when I rest with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me where they are buried." "I will do as you say," he said.

ekegusii: Korende ekero ndakwane naye, nimaanore omonwa oo, na aye obatebie iga: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba. Omonto oganetie koigwera, tiga aigwere, na oyo otaganeti koigwera, tiga aange, ekiagera barabwo negesaku getari koigwera.
english: But when I speak to you, I will open your mouth and you shall say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says.' Whoever will listen let him listen, and whoever will refuse let him refuse; for they are a rebellious house.

ekegusii: Korende ekero narenge ase emechando, nigo basangererekanete amo bakagoka. Abanto batagwenerete, aba ntamanyeti bakaba bagonchecheria batari gotiga.
english: But when I stumbled, they gathered in glee; attackers gathered against me when I was unaware. They slandered me without ceasing.

ekegusii: Igo narenge nkirete‐kiri, tinare gokwana, tinaba na koremigwa konde, obororo bwane bokamenteka mono,
english: But when I was silent and still, not even saying anything good, my anguish increased.

ekegusii: Geise gosirigwa korwa aase aye, aase aria nigo aragekanie ng’a tana gokerora.
english: But when it is torn from its spot, that place disowns it and says, 'I never saw you.'

ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akarigereria aborokigwa baye, agatogonyera Petero, akabora, “Irana nyuma yane, Saitani, ekiagera tori ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase mwanyabanto.”
english: But when Jesus turned and looked at his disciples, he rebuked Peter. "Get behind me, Satan!" he said. "You do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men."

ekegusii: Korende Herode omoruoti, oyo okanetigwe nere ase engencho ya Herodia, moka momura omwabo, na ase engencho y’amabe onsi Herode akorire,
english: But when John rebuked Herod the tetrarch because of Herodias, his brother's wife, and all the other evil things he had done,

ekegusii: Korende ekero Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, achete korwania ense eye, tokairoka abarwani b’esegi b’Abakalidayo na aba b’Abasiiria erio togatebania; Inchuo, togende Yerusalemu. Bono Yerusalemu tomenyete.”
english: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded this land, we said, 'Come, we must go to Jerusalem to escape the Babylonian and Aramean armies.' So we have remained in Jerusalem."

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aito achia koera, tokaimoka, tokagenda ase orogendo rwaito; na abwo bonsi, na abakungu babo, na abana, bagatokooba goika isiko y’omochie; togatung’ama ase engegu y’enyancha, togasaba.
english: But when our time was up, we left and continued on our way. All the disciples and their wives and children accompanied us out of the city, and there on the beach we knelt to pray.

ekegusii: korende ekero oboikeranu bogocha, egetaikeraneti nagesire.
english: but when perfection comes, the imperfect disappears.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Farao aroche ng’a amang’ana abeire buya, agakong’ia enkoro yaye naende, na buna Omonene atebete, akaanga koigwa Musa na Haroni.
english: But when Pharaoh saw that there was relief, he hardened his heart and would not listen to Moses and Aaron, just as the LORD had said.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Sanibalati korwa Beti-Horoni, na Tobia, omonene bw’orogongo rw’Abaamoni, na Gesemu Omoarabu, baigwete amang’ana ayio, bagatosekerera na gotochecheria, bakaboria, “Ngento ki eke mogokora? Nigo mogochia kwanga timoigwera omoruoti?”
english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite official and Geshem the Arab heard about it, they mocked and ridiculed us. "What is this you are doing?" they asked. "Are you rebelling against the king?"

ekegusii: Korende ekero Sanibalati, na Tobia, na Abaarabu, na Abaamoni, na Abaasidodi baigwete ng’a oboagacho bwe chindwaki chia Yerusalemu nigo bogendererete buya, naende ng’a aase abochogete nkoiranerigwa are, bakaba nendamwamu enene.
english: But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites and the men of Ashdod heard that the repairs to Jerusalem's walls had gone ahead and that the gaps were being closed, they were very angry.

ekegusii: Ekero aroche ng’a takonyara komobisa goetania agwo, akaimokia ekebaari ki’amauncho, agakeooma esike, erio agaaka eramu korwa isiko. Erio akaareria omwana oria ase ekebaari ime, agakebeka ase amauncho ime y’orooche rwa Naili.
english: But when she could hide him no longer, she got a papyrus basket for him and coated it with tar and pitch. Then she placed the child in it and put it among the reeds along the bank of the Nile.

ekegusii: Ekero amoirerete emegati eyio ang’e ng’a arie, Amunoni akamobwata, akamotebia, “Inchuo torare komo, moiseke ominto.”
english: But when she took it to him to eat, he grabbed her and said, "Come to bed with me, my sister."

ekegusii: korende oyore ne chinguru kobua, ere karamochiere na komobua, nigo akomoura ebinto biaye bi’esegi bionsi ebiegenerete, na ebisakorwa biaye obiatanana.
english: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted and divides up the spoils.

ekegusii: Korende abatomwa Barnaba na Paulo, ekero bachia koigwa amang’ana ayio bagatandora chianga chiabo, bakaayerera, bagasoa ase omoganda, bagaaka egeturi, bagoteba,
english: But when the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of this, they tore their clothes and rushed out into the crowd, shouting:

ekegusii: Ekero omoganda oria konya osangererekanire amo ase okoba mamincha ya Musa na Haroni, barabwo bakeonchora bakarigereria Eema y’Omosangererekano bakarora riire riayetubire, na obonene bw’Omonene bokaoroka.
english: But when the assembly gathered in opposition to Moses and Aaron and turned toward the Tent of Meeting, suddenly the cloud covered it and the glory of the LORD appeared.

ekegusii: Abasomba baria b’omoruoti bakairera Vasti amang’ana ayio, korende ere akaanga koigwera ogochika kw’omoruoti. Ayio akagera omoruoti akaba nendamwamu enene mono yarenge gwoka ime yaye buna omorero.
english: But when the attendants delivered the king's command, Queen Vashti refused to come. Then the king became furious and burned with anger.

ekegusii: Korende abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko bakabea, ekero bachia korora ebirage bi’ogokumia akorete, na abana bagoaka eriogi ase Hekalu ime, bakobora, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi!”
english: But when the chief priests and the teachers of the law saw the wonderful things he did and the children shouting in the temple area, "Hosanna to the Son of David," they were indignant.

ekegusii: Korende ekero ekemanyererio keria kie rikundesi ri’erioki kiarorekanete korwa ase omochie oria, Ababenjamin bakarigereria magega, bagakumia korora omochie omogima okoyia, na erioki richongororogete gochia igoro.
english: But when the column of smoke began to rise from the city, the Benjamites turned and saw the smoke of the whole city going up into the sky.

ekegusii: Engaki ye rigesa moruserie Farao ensemo ya isano. Chinsemo inye chintigari inachibe echiaino ase chimbusuro na endagera yaino inwe abanyene, na ey’abare ase chinka chiaino, na ey’abana baino.”
english: But when the crop comes in, give a fifth of it to Pharaoh. The other four-fifths you may keep as seed for the fields and as food for yourselves and your households and your children."

ekegusii: Naende rituko rinene ri’Ebigutu ri’Abayahudi nigo riarenge ang’e.
english: But when the Jewish Feast of Tabernacles was near,

ekegusii: Korende ekero Abayahudi bangete aya, nkabetererigwa korigia ekina kiane keirwe ase Kaisari, tari ng’a narenge ne ring’ana ri’ogosoera abanto b’egesaku kiane.
english: But when the Jews objected, I was compelled to appeal to Caesar-- not that I had any charge to bring against my own people.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia koamererania nere na komorama, agasamunsa chianga chiaye, akabatebia, “Amayinga aino nabe igoro ase emetwe yaino! Inche tindi na komocha. Korwa bono ningende ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”
english: But when the Jews opposed Paul and became abusive, he shook out his clothes in protest and said to them, "Your blood be on your own heads! I am clear of my responsibility. From now on I will go to the Gentiles."

ekegusii: Korende ekero omogambi oria akure, abanto baba bakoonchoka na gokora amabe kobua aya chisokoro chiabo chiakorete. Naende baba bakobwatana ne chinyasae chinde ching’ao, bagachikorera na gochisasima. Tibatigete ogokora kwabo okobe okwo banarete gokora bare noboenenu.
english: But when the judge died, the people returned to ways even more corrupt than those of their fathers, following other gods and serving and worshiping them. They refused to give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.

ekegusii: Korende ekero obuya bwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito, na obwanchani bwaye ase mwanyabanto bwaorogetigwe
english: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior appeared,

ekegusii: Abaringoria nabarabwo bagateema korenta chinsona ase oborogi bwabo, korende tibanyara. Chinsona echio chikaba aande onsi, ase mwanyabanto na ase chitugo.
english: But when the magicians tried to produce gnats by their secret arts, they could not. And the gnats were on men and animals.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo basoete nyomba, bakarora omogwekano oria bw’ogosasimwa ore borere, na amanya e chimbori asisire abekire ase omotwe oye.
english: But when the men entered, there was the idol in the bed, and at the head was some goats' hair.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Abamoabu bachete ase egetwori ki’Abaisraeli, Abaisraeli bakaimoka, bakabarwania goika abanto abwo bagatama korwa asebare. Abaisraeli bakagenderera kobatunyana gochia ase ense yabo bakabaita.
english: But when the Moabites came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and fought them until they fled. And the Israelites invaded the land and slaughtered the Moabites.

ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai bagachia koyaigwa, bagateba, “Oyo tari korusia ebirecha otatiga ase Beelizebuli omonene bw’ebirecha.”
english: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, "It is only by Beelzebub, the prince of demons, that this fellow drives out demons."

ekegusii: Korende ekero omoruoti atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, akarua ogochika ase amarube ng’a omoroberio oria Hamani akorete mamincha y’Abayahudi omoiraneire ere omonyene, na ere na abamura baye bagatongwa ase chimbambo igoro.
english: But when the plot came to the king's attention, he issued written orders that the evil scheme Haman had devised against the Jews should come back onto his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

ekegusii: Omoigwa o Paulo akaigwa amang’ana igoro y’okoboera kwabo, akagenda, agasoa ime ase enyomba enene, akamanyia Paulo amang’ana ayio.
english: But when the son of Paul's sister heard of this plot, he went into the barracks and told Paul.

ekegusii: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
english: Omobaso ogachia kobara, chigasusana, na ekiagera chitarenge nemeri, chikoma.

ekegusii: Korende ekero engaki yaigete, Nyasae agatoma Omwana oye; ere akaiborwa nomokungu, akaiborerwa inse y’amachiko,
english: But when the time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under law,

ekegusii: Ekero bakobaira, timoichana buna mogochia koiraneria, gose eki mogochia gokwana, ekiagera ase ekero keria inamoegwe aya morakwane;
english: But when they arrest you, do not worry about what to say or how to say it. At that time you will be given what to say,

ekegusii: Korende ekero bachia kwegena Filipo, gakorandia amang’ana amaya igoro y’oboruoti bwa Nyasae na erieta ria Yeso Kristo, bakabatiswa, abasacha na abakungu.
english: But when they believed Philip as he preached the good news of the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

ekegusii: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
english: Bagachia gochiera Yeso, bakarora ng’a oikire gokwa, tibamobuna amagoro aye.

ekegusii: korende ekero barwete Misiri nigo baetete ase egati y’erooro gochia Enyancha Embariri, bagaika Kadeshi.
english: But when they came up out of Egypt, Israel went through the desert to the Red Sea and on to Kadesh.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene ng’a abatoorie, nere akabaa omonto abatoorie. Omonto oyio nere Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, omomura omoke omwabo Kalebu.
english: But when they cried out to the LORD, he raised up for them a deliverer, Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, who saved them.

ekegusii: Ekero batabanyora, bagakurura Yasoni na abande baminto gochia ase abanene b’omochie, bagaaka eriogi, bagateba, “Abanto aba abaonchoranire ense baikire nonya naa,
english: But when they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some other brothers before the city officials, shouting: "These men who have caused trouble all over the world have now come here,

ekegusii: korende ekero basoa, tibanyora omobere bw’Omonene Yeso.
english: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

ekegusii: Bagachia gouta omorero egati y’egoora, bagaikaransa amo, na Petero agaikaransa ase egati yabo.
english: But when they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat down with them.

ekegusii: Goika bagachia korigereria bakarora ng’a rigena riria riatigerigwe, na rirorio nigo riarenge rinene mono.
english: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had been rolled away.

ekegusii: Korende ekero bamomanya ng’a ere n’Omoyahudi, bagakuura bonsi amo ase egeka ki’ang’e chinsa ibere chingima, bakorera, “Aritemi y’Abaefeso nenene!”
english: But when they realized he was a Jew, they all shouted in unison for about two hours: "Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!"

ekegusii: Korende Samweli tancha amang’ana ayio bamotebetie, “Toe omoruoti atogambere.” Ase ayio Samweli agasaba Omonene.
english: But when they said, "Give us a king to lead us," this displeased Samuel; so he prayed to the LORD.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia komorora ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari, bagaaka eriogi,
english: but when they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost. They cried out,

ekegusii: Korende bakamotebia amang’ana onsi Yusufu abatebetie. Ere agachia korora chigari chiria Yusufu amotomerete chigocha komoimokia, omoyo oye okaba nobogima oboyia.
english: But when they told him everything Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the carts Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob revived.

ekegusii: Korende ekero bagendete komotindeka, tibanyorete gento kende ase omobere oye otatiga ekeore, na amagoro, na ebisanyi bi’amaboko aye.
english: But when they went out to bury her, they found nothing except her skull, her feet and her hands.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Kristo aruete ekeng’wanso ekemo gioka ase ebibe kerabe goika kare na kare, nigo aikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
english: But when this priest had offered for all time one sacrifice for sins, he sat down at the right hand of God.

ekegusii: Korende ochia gocha omwana oo oyo, orire ebinto biao nabakungu abatayayi, kwamonyenyeire emori enoru.
english: But when this son of yours who has squandered your property with prostitutes comes home, you kill the fattened calf for him!'

ekegusii: Ekero twarerete ase Omonene, ere akaigwa ebirero biaito, agatoma omomalaika agatorusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Bono nao tore aiga Kadeshi, omochie ore ase orobebe kegima rw’orogongo rwao.
english: but when we cried out to the LORD, he heard our cry and sent an angel and brought us out of Egypt. "Now we are here at Kadesh, a town on the edge of your territory.

ekegusii: Korende gokorangerigwa, genda oikaranse nyuma, erinde kagocha oyokorangeretie, agotebie: Mosani, tigera gocha aa aase e ritang’ani. Erio nobe nogosikwa ase amasio abo bonsi abaikaransete amo naye.
english: But when you are invited, take the lowest place, so that when your host comes, he will say to you, 'Friend, move up to a better place.' Then you will be honored in the presence of all your fellow guests.

ekegusii: Kero kende gionsi mogosoa omochie, na barabwo batabaroiseti, soka korwa aroro, eta ase chinchera chiaye, motebe:
english: But when you enter a town and are not welcomed, go into its streets and say,

ekegusii: Korende aye, gokweng’ata, eake amaguta omotwe oo, bwesibie obosio bwao,
english: But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face,

ekegusii: Korende kogokora omoyega, barangerie abataka, na ebirema, na amagata, na emeuko;
english: But when you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind,

ekegusii: Korende aye, gokorua ebiegwa, nonya nokoboko kwao gw’okobee tikomanya ekio okoboko kwao gw’okorio kogokora,
english: But when you give to the needy, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,

ekegusii: Korende aye ekero ogosaba, soa nyomba mwao ime, osieke egesieri, omosabe Iso oo ore bobisi; na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane.”
english: But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.

ekegusii: Korende ekero omonto akoonchokera Omonene egietubo keria nigo gekorusigwa.
english: But whenever anyone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi Musa are gosoa eema ase obosio bw’Omonene gokwana nere, nigo are korusia egietubo goika osoka korwa aroro. Ekero asokire aba ogotebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi aya achikirwe gokwana,
english: But whenever he entered the LORD's presence to speak with him, he removed the veil until he came out. And when he came out and told the Israelites what he had been commanded,

ekegusii: Korende onye enyama embariri yachakire gokina imeo, omonto oyio tachenegeti.
english: But whenever raw flesh appears on him, he will be unclean.

ekegusii: Ning’o ase egati y’ababani abwo otenenire ase ekegambero ki’Omonene koigwa na komanya ring’ana riaye? Gose ning’o otegereire ring’ana riaye na oriigure?
english: But which of them has stood in the council of the LORD to see or to hear his word? Who has listened and heard his word?

ekegusii: Inche tinarenge Yerusalemu ekero amang’ana ayio abete iga, ekiagera ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na ebere, bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, omoruoti o Babeli, nario nagendete ase omoruoti oyio. Nyuma y’engaki ende nkaegwa ribaga,
english: But while all this was going on, I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had returned to the king. Some time later I asked his permission

ekegusii: korende ekero abanto bararire, omobisa oye agacha akabusura amabanchore ime ase engano, akagenda.
english: But while everyone was sleeping, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and went away.

ekegusii: Korende abana b’abakungu baria ba sere‐sere Ibrahimu akabaa ebiegwa. Ekero are moyo, konya atarakwa, akabatebia barue ase omwana oye Isaka, bagende gochia moocha, ase ense ya Moocha.
english: But while he was still living, he gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto babekire chinyama menwa yabo, na konya batarachimera, Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene asebare, akabaita ase okobaaka namaakwa amanene mono.
english: But while the meat was still between their teeth and before it could be consumed, the anger of the LORD burned against the people, and he struck them with a severe plague.

ekegusii: Ekero bare ne ribero rinene, nimbakorere omoyega, erinde banywe, batinde na kogoka. Erio barare chitoro chintambe, tibaboka. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: But while they are aroused, I will set out a feast for them and make them drunk, so that they shout with laughter-- then sleep forever and not awake," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Mwanyabanto, aye naye ng’o okoiraneria Nyasae? Inee! Egento getongire nakemotebie oyogetongete, “Ninki gwankorerete iga?”
english: But who are you, O man, to talk back to God? "Shall what is formed say to him who formed it, 'Why did you make me like this?'"

ekegusii: Korende ning’o oranyare gotenena koremereria rituko ri’Omonene, na ning’o oranyare gotenena ase ogwekengera ekero akooroka? Ere nigo anga buna omorero bw’omoturi ebioma, na buna esabuni y’omosibia chianga.
english: But who can endure the day of his coming? Who can stand when he appears? For he will be like a refiner's fire or a launderer's soap.

ekegusii: Korende ning’o oranyare komoagachera enyomba? Rora igoro na igoro aare mono tekomoisana amenyeo. Inche inki ing’isaine ng’a imoagachere enyomba, otatiga imoagachere aase ubani egosamberwa oka?
english: But who is able to build a temple for him, since the heavens, even the highest heavens, cannot contain him? Who then am I to build a temple for him, except as a place to burn sacrifices before him?

ekegusii: korende monto onde bwensi orarame Omoika Omochenu takwaberwa nonya ng’ake, korende nigo arabe nebibe goika kare na kare.”
english: But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of an eternal sin."

ekegusii: korende oyorankane ase mwanyabanto, nainche nimokane ase Tata one ore igoro.
english: But whoever disowns me before men, I will disown him before my Father in heaven.

ekegusii: korende onde bwensi oyoranywe amache aria ndamoe inche, takorang’a nonya ng’ake; korende amache aria ndanyare komoa, nabe ime yaye ensoko y’amache agosoka na komoa obogima bwa kare na kare.”
english: but whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life."

ekegusii: Korende oyio otari nainche nigo akwenachera ekina ere omonyene. Bonsi abangechete nigo banchete amakweri.”
english: But whoever fails to find me harms himself; all who hate me love death."

ekegusii: Korende ere oyogechete oyomwabo nigo are ase omosunte ime, naende nigo akogenda ase omosunte, na tamanyeti nonya naase agochia, ekiagera omosunte omoukoirie amaiso aye.
english: But whoever hates his brother is in the darkness and walks around in the darkness; he does not know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded him.

ekegusii: Korende monto onde bwensi oranyigwere namenye ase omorembe, ere nabe nobotoereru na takoiroka bobe bonde.”
english: but whoever listens to me will live in safety and be at ease, without fear of harm."

ekegusii: Korende oyogokora ekeene nigo agocha ase omobaso, ogokora kwaye kororekane ng’a nigo gwakorirwe ase Nyasae.”
english: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what he has done has been done through God."

ekegusii: “Oyo okonyenya eng’ombe nere oyio ogoita na omonto, na oyo okorua emanwa y’eng’ondi koba ekeng’wanso nere oyio okobuna esese ebigoti; oyo okorua okoruegwa kw’endagera nere oyio okorua amanyinga ’embeche, na oyo ogosamba ubani nere oyio ogosesenia omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa. Abanto abwo bachorire chinchera chiabo abanyene, na emioyo yabo nigo egokerete ayio bagokora ay’okogechia.
english: But whoever sacrifices a bull is like one who kills a man, and whoever offers a lamb, like one who breaks a dog's neck; whoever makes a grain offering is like one who presents pig's blood, and whoever burns memorial incense, like one who worships an idol. They have chosen their own ways, and their souls delight in their abominations;

ekegusii: Ng’ai ring’ana eri riarure, ng’ina Omonene one anchicheire inche?
english: But why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

ekegusii: Korende ogende ase ense yane na ase eamate yane, orentere omwana one Isaka omokungu korwa aroro.”
english: but will go to my country and my own relatives and get a wife for my son Isaac."

ekegusii: Korende obong’aini bwa Nyasae bwamanyekanire koba oboronge ase abana baye bonsi.”
english: But wisdom is proved right by all her children."

ekegusii: Korende nasirie kegima aase omochie oria ore, narente eooro enene mono, nabwatie ababisa baye gochia ase omosunte.
english: but with an overwhelming flood he will make an end of [Nineveh]; he will pursue his foes into darkness.

ekegusii: korende bakore ogokora okuya, buna egwenerete abakungu abakoorokia ng’a mbare ne chingeneho chi’obonyasae.
english: but with good deeds, appropriate for women who profess to worship God.

ekegusii: Korende bakagenderera kobora ase eriogi rinene ng’a goika abambwe. Eriogi riabo rikabua.
english: But with loud shouts they insistently demanded that he be crucified, and their shouts prevailed.

ekegusii: Korende nigo arabae abataka oboronge bwabo ase okonacha ebina, tagokora ogwanchereria ase abaitongo b’ense. Naake ense nenyimbo y’omonwa oye, naite abakori amabe nomoika bw’omonwa oye.
english: but with righteousness he will judge the needy, with justice he will give decisions for the poor of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; with the breath of his lips he will slay the wicked.

ekegusii: korende ase amanyinga e rigori rinene, buna ay’emanwa y’eng’ondi etari na komocha, gose na kemoa, engencho yaye amanyinga a Kristo.
english: but with the precious blood of Christ, a lamb without blemish or defect.

ekegusii: Korende aye nigo ore omwaberi, erinde onyare koirokwa.
english: But with you there is forgiveness; therefore you are feared.

ekegusii: Korende omokungu natoorigwe goetera ase okoibora abana—onye okogenderera ase okwegena, na obwanchani, na obochenu amo nobweriti.
english: But women will be saved through childbearing-- if they continue in faith, love and holiness with propriety.

ekegusii: Korende ritaana rigosungusigwa, na ekenama gekoruegwa, aye amo nabana bao, abamura na abaiseke, mwaeirwe ribaga kobiriera agwo aase achenire. Ebinto ebio aye na abana bao mwabieirwe korwa ase ebing’wanso bi’omorembe bikoruegwa n’Abaisraeli.
english: But you and your sons and your daughters may eat the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. Eat them in a ceremonially clean place; they have been given to you and your children as your share of the Israelites' fellowship offerings.

ekegusii: Korende inwe nababiare abachore, abakuani b’Omoruoti, egesaku egechenu, abanto ba Nyasae omonyene, monyare koraria ogokora kwaye kw’obonene, oyobarangeretie korwa ase omosunte, gochia ase omobaso oye bw’ogokumia.
english: But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people belonging to God, that you may declare the praises of him who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, naye enguba yane, naye obonene bwane, nigo okong’iraneria oboremu.
english: But you are a shield around me, O LORD; you bestow glory on me and lift up my head.

ekegusii: Korende bono aye kwairirwe gochia aase abakure ase engoro entambe.
english: But you are brought down to the grave, to the depths of the pit.

ekegusii: korende aye totindekiri; nigo otugutire buna orosagia rotanchiri. Nigo oraire ase egati y’abanto baitetwe nemioro, bagatugutwa ase chingoro chi’amagena buna ebitondo bigotachwa namagoro.
english: But you are cast out of your tomb like a rejected branch; you are covered with the slain, with those pierced by the sword, those who descend to the stones of the pit. Like a corpse trampled underfoot,

ekegusii: Naama! Inwe nigo more bosa kegima, na emeremo yaino nero mbosa kegima; oyo obachorire inwe na kobasasima nigo are okogechia.
english: But you are less than nothing and your works are utterly worthless; he who chooses you is detestable.

ekegusii: Korende asemore inwe taibo, otatiga oyore omonene oino nabe buna oyore omoke; na ere oyokobatang’ana nabe buna omokoreri abande.
english: But you are not to be like that. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who rules like the one who serves.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye Tata oito; Ibrahimu tatomanyete, na Israeli boigo tatomanyete, korende aye Omonene, naye Tata oito. “Omobooria oito korwa kare,” nario erieta riao.
english: But you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us or Israel acknowledge us; you, O LORD, are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is your name.

ekegusii: Inwe mobe abegenwa ase Omonene, buna mwabeire goika rero iga.
english: But you are to hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have until now.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nachore aase aamo oka korwa ase ebisaku biaino bionsi, na aroro agwo nabeke erieta riaye, na obomenyo bwaye nao agwo borabe. Aase agwo nao inwe morarigie mogendeo.
english: But you are to seek the place the LORD your God will choose from among all your tribes to put his Name there for his dwelling. To that place you must go;

ekegusii: Naboigo ekero aye kwagusete buna omwaga, amache akabamera; bakamerwa buna embunde ekorimera ase amache amange ime, yarika inse.
english: But you blew with your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

ekegusii: erinde otoake na gototuguta ase chisese chi’orosana chimenyete, gose gototuba ekiriri ki’amakweri.
english: But you crushed us and made us a haunt for jackals and covered us over with deep darkness.

ekegusii: Korende inwe timori kwegena, ekiagera timori abamo ase ching’ondi chiane.
english: but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogosiria okomoiroka Nyasae, naende gwatanga ogosaba ase obosio bwaye.
english: But you even undermine piety and hinder devotion to God.

ekegusii: Korende naye gwatoete obobui igoro y’ababisa baito, abwo batogechete nigo kwabasoogetie.
english: but you give us victory over our enemies, you put our adversaries to shame.

ekegusii: Na inwe mwaakirwe amaguta nere oyore Omochenu, na mwamanyire onsi.
english: But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

ekegusii: Nainwe mwakorire amabe kobua chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera kera oyomo oino nigo akobwatia obomwenu bw’enkoro yaye embe, bwanga konyigwera.
english: But you have behaved more wickedly than your fathers. See how each of you is following the stubbornness of his evil heart instead of obeying me.

ekegusii: Korende inwe mwaikire egetunwa gekorokwa Sayoni, na omochie o Nyasae ore moyo, Yerusalemu ya igoro, na abamalaika abange batari kobareka,
english: But you have come to Mount Zion, to the heavenly Jerusalem, the city of the living God. You have come to thousands upon thousands of angels in joyful assembly,

ekegusii: Korende bono mwantigire inche na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao; ase ayio tintageti kobatooria naende.
english: But you have forsaken me and served other gods, so I will no longer save you.

ekegusii: Korende inwe mwachayire oria omotaka. Inee! Baria abanda, tari barabwo babaregete inwe, na kobakurura gochia ase ebigambero?
english: But you have insulted the poor. Is it not the rich who are exploiting you? Are they not the ones who are dragging you into court?

ekegusii: Korende bono mwangire Nyasae oino oria obatooretie korwa ase obokong’u bwonsi na ogochandwa, mwatebire ng’a: Tobekere omoruoti atogambere. Gaki bono sangererekana ase obosio bw’Omonene, egesaku ase egesaku, na eamate ase eamate.”
english: But you have now rejected your God, who saves you out of all your calamities and distresses. And you have said, 'No, set a king over us.' So now present yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans."

ekegusii: Mwasimekire ayare amabe, mwagesire aya atari ay’oboronge, mwarire ayare okwama kw’oborimo. “Nigo mwasemeretie ogokora kwaino, na obonge bw’abarwani esegi baino chituoni.
english: But you have planted wickedness, you have reaped evil, you have eaten the fruit of deception. Because you have depended on your own strength and on your many warriors,

ekegusii: Korende bono, aye Omonene kwangire omoakwa amaguta oo, kwabeire nendamwamu enene asare.
english: But you have rejected, you have spurned, you have been very angry with your anointed one.

ekegusii: Korende aye ngwantebetie: Ningokorere amaya, ninkore ororeria rwao robe buna omokenye o nyancha, otanyare kobareka, ekiagera nomonge.”
english: But you have said, 'I will surely make you prosper and will make your descendants like the sand of the sea, which cannot be counted.'"

ekegusii: Korende ndire ring’ana erimo rire rigiya asore, nario eri: Nogechete ogokora kw’Abanikolaiti, okwo nainche ngechete.
english: But you have this in your favor: You hate the practices of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

ekegusii: “Korende inwe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera, mwagerire abanto abange bagochirwe ase engencho y’amorokererio aino; ase igo mwasaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo nakorete na Lawi. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
english: But you have turned from the way and by your teaching have caused many to stumble; you have violated the covenant with Levi," says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ayio kwabwatirie chinchera chi’abaruoti b’Abaisraeli, na kwagerire Abayuda na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu babeire batari abegenwa, buna abanto b’enyomba y’Ahabu bagerete Abaisraeli tibaba abegenwa. Naende gwaitire abamura bamino, aba barenge ase enyomba ya iso, na barenge abaya gokobua.
english: But you have walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and you have led Judah and the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves, just as the house of Ahab did. You have also murdered your own brothers, members of your father's house, men who were better than you.

ekegusii: Na inwe mwamanyire ng’a Kristo nigo aorogetigwe erinde arusie ebibe biaito, na bibe tibiri ime yaye.
english: But you know that he appeared so that he might take away our sins. And in him is no sin.

ekegusii: Korende momanyete Timotheo na ogokora kwaye, buna akorerete enchili amo nainche. Igo are koreng’ana buna omwana okomokorera ise.
english: But you know that Timothy has proved himself, because as a son with his father he has served with me in the work of the gospel.

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nomanyete omoroberio obo bw’okong’ita. Tobaisa kobaabera ebibe biabo, gose tobitinyia birue ase obosio bwao. Obatige babugwe ase obosio bwao, obakorere ayio ekero ore nendamwamu.”
english: But you know, O LORD, all their plots to kill me. Do not forgive their crimes or blot out their sins from your sight. Let them be overthrown before you; deal with them in the time of your anger.

ekegusii: erio morente oria omino omoke asende. Igo amang’ana aino aenekigwe ng’a namaene are, na inwe timobaisa gokwa. Barabwo bagakora bo.”
english: But you must bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words may be verified and that you may not die." This they proceeded to do.

ekegusii: Ase igo inwe mwensi, ababiare gose abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino, goika morende amachiko aane na kobwata aya onsi nabachikire, gose timobaisa gokora kende gionsi gi’okogechia okwo abanto b’ebisaku bakorete.
english: But you must keep my decrees and my laws. The native-born and the aliens living among you must not do any of these detestable things,

ekegusii: korende amatunda ’omote bw’okomanyera amaya na amabe toyaria, ekiagera rituko riria orayarie goika okwe.”
english: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for when you eat of it you will surely die."

ekegusii: Korende timobaisa koria amanyinga; goika moyaitere ase riroba buna amache.
english: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

ekegusii: Timobaisa koria amanyinga abo, korende moyaitere ase riroba buna amache.
english: But you must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

ekegusii: Korende timobaisa gwatora nonya ng’ake ring’ana eri: Egurube y’Omonene, ekiagera ring’ana ri’omonto nario rire egurube asare ere omonyene. Inwe mwasaririe na koonchorana amang’ana a Nyasae ore moyo, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda. Nyasae oito.
english: But you must not mention 'the oracle of the LORD' again, because every man's own word becomes his oracle and so you distort the words of the living God, the LORD Almighty, our God.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye irana ase Nyasae oo. Obwatie obwanchani na oboronge, na obe komosemeretie Nyasae oo botambe.
english: But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and wait for your God always.

ekegusii: Korende aye naye oria oria, na emiaka yao tekoba nomoerio.
