english: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.

ekegusii: Korende inwe moteba: Oyoratebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa asende biaeirwe Nyasae, ere temogwenereti gosika ise.
english: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother, 'Whatever help you might otherwise have received from me is a gift devoted to God,'

ekegusii: Korende inwe moteba: Omonto karatebie ise gose ng’ina: Bionsi ebi anga kwanyora korwa asende nakio Korbani (engencho yaye: Ebiarurwe ase Nyasae) —
english: But you say that if a man says to his father or mother: 'Whatever help you might otherwise have received from me is Corban' (that is, a gift devoted to God),

ekegusii: Korende aye tigara aa asende, na inche ngotebie amachiko onsi, na emeroberio echikire, na onsi aya nachikire, ayio ogochia koborokia, erio bayarende na koyakora ase ense eria ngochia kobaa, ebe eyabo.
english: But you stay here with me so that I may give you all the commands, decrees and laws you are to teach them to follow in the land I am giving them to possess."

ekegusii: Naye ogatotebia intwe abasomba bao: Momura omino omoke atatirimbogeti amo nainwe, timogocha ase obosio bwane naende.
english: But you told your servants, 'Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.'

ekegusii: “Korende timwanchete kogenda ase ense eria, mokaanga koigwera ogochika Omonene, Nyasae oino, abaete.
english: But you were unwilling to go up; you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Korende ekero moramboke Yorodan na komenya ase ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino, naende ekero arabae obotoereru korwa ase ababisa baino bonsi babaetanaine, erio inamomenye ase omorembe ase motabe nobwoba.
english: But you will cross the Jordan and settle in the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, and he will give you rest from all your enemies around you so that you will live in safety.

ekegusii: Korende nigo morakwe buna mwanyabanto bande, na obogima bwaino boere buna obw’abanene b’ense.”
english: But you will die like mere men; you will fall like every other ruler."

ekegusii: Rora noiborerwe omwana omomura oyorabe omonto bw’omorembe; inche nimoe omorembe ase ababisa baye bonsi bamoetanaine. Nigo ararokwe Sulemani, na ase amatuko aye ning’ee Abaisraeli omorembe na obotoereru.
english: But you will have a son who will be a man of peace and rest, and I will give him rest from all his enemies on every side. His name will be Solomon, and I will grant Israel peace and quiet during his reign.

ekegusii: Ekero morasoke korwao, timokoayerera, gose timogotama, ekiagera Omonene natang’ane bosio bwaino; ee, ere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli nababwatie korwa nyuma abe obarendete.
english: But you will not leave in haste or go in flight; for the LORD will go before you, the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

ekegusii: Korende namonyore chinguru, ekero Omoika Omochenu obacheire, na inwe namobe birori baane ase Yerusalemu, na ase chinsemo chionsi chia Boyahudi na Samaria, na goika chinsinyo chi’ense.”
english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth."

ekegusii: Korende inwe nigo narenge gocha kobaa engano enoru, na kobaisanekia nobooke korwa ase egetare.”
english: But you would be fed with the finest of wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you."

ekegusii: Korende inwe nigo morakwere aiga ase erooro, na emebere yaino esirere aiga.
english: But you-- your bodies will fall in this desert.

ekegusii: Korende baminto, timori ase omosunte, goika rituko riria riche kobanyora mobosokano buna omoibi,
english: But you, brothers, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief.

ekegusii: “Korende aye Danieli, mumekeria amang’ana aya, obeke ebuku eye ekemanyererio goika engaki y’omoerio. Ase engaki eyio abanto abange nabaminyoke gochia aaria na aaria koriga‐rigia, na okomanya kwabo nkomentekane.”
english: But you, Daniel, close up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge."

ekegusii: Korende inwe, abanchani, mweagache ase okwegena kwaino kore ogochenu mono, na gosaba ase Omoika Omochenu.
english: But you, dear friends, build yourselves up in your most holy faith and pray in the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Korende aye, bwerite ase amang’ana onsi, oremererie emechando, kora emeremo y’oborandia, ikerania ogokora kw’obosomba bwao.
english: But you, keep your head in all situations, endure hardship, do the work of an evangelist, discharge all the duties of your ministry.

ekegusii: Korende aye, omonto o Nyasae, tama ayio onsi, rigia oboronge, ne chingencho chi’obonyasae, na okwegena, na obwanchani, na oboremereria na obwororo.
english: But you, man of God, flee from all this, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance and gentleness.

ekegusii: Nyasae, aye nigo ore omoruoti one, kwarengeo korwa kare, naye kwabeire kogokora emeremo y’ogotooria ense engima.
english: But you, O God, are my king from of old; you bring salvation upon the earth.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okorora abachandekire na komanya okwerera kwabo, amang’ana ayio nigo oyabegete ase amaboko ao. Omonto otari na gokonywa konde nigo akwerua asore, ekiagera naye botambe ogokonya chintakana.
english: But you, O God, do see trouble and grief; you consider it to take it in hand. The victim commits himself to you; you are the helper of the fatherless.

ekegusii: Korende abanto abaiti na abang’ainereria aye Nyasae nobaturunkanie gochia ase eoromomo, ekero bataraika ase ekeng’ese ki’obogima bwabo, korende inche nimbe nkwegenete aye Omonene.
english: But you, O God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of corruption; bloodthirsty and deceitful men will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore Nyasae bw’amabera na obuya; tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera, na obwegenwa.
english: But you, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omonene mono kare na kare.
english: But you, O LORD, are exalted forever.

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, tobeera aare korwa asende; aye ore chinguru chiane, ayerera onkonye!
english: But you, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.

ekegusii: Omonene, ndorera amabera, ngwenie, erinde ing’akane ababisa baane obobe bwabo.
english: But you, O LORD, have mercy on me; raise me up, that I may repay them.

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo okobasekerera, aye nigo ogochecheria abanto bonsi batakomanyeti.
english: But you, O LORD, laugh at them; you scoff at all those nations.

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore omogambi goika kare na kare; erieta riao nigo rigendererete ase ebiaare bionsi.
english: But you, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.

ekegusii: Korende aye Nyasae, Omonene one, ondwanerere ase engencho y’erieta riao, intoorie, ekiagera obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bore obuya.
english: But you, O Sovereign LORD, deal well with me for your name's sake; out of the goodness of your love, deliver me.

ekegusii: “Korende aye mwanyabanto, tegerera aya nkogotebia; tobaisa koba oyo otari koigwera buna egesaku eke getari koigwera. Asamia omonwa oo, orie egento eke ngokoa.”
english: But you, son of man, listen to what I say to you. Do not rebel like that rebellious house; open your mouth and eat what I give you."

ekegusii: Korende Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omokonyi oo, nere orasoe aroro. Mobeke chinguru, omoremie, ekiagera nere oraraae Abaisraeli bagende koira ense eria ebe omwando obo.
english: But your assistant, Joshua son of Nun, will enter it. Encourage him, because he will lead Israel to inherit it.

ekegusii: Abanto baino bakwete mbabe moyo naende; emebere y’abakwete neboke. Inwe abwo moraire ase amaroba ime, boka, motere nomogoko! Riime riao nigo rire eri’oborabu; riroba ndibairanie abakwete.
english: But your dead will live; their bodies will rise. You who dwell in the dust, wake up and shout for joy. Your dew is like the dew of the morning; the earth will give birth to her dead.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, tiga chinkoro chiaino chionsi chibe echi’ekeene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, mobwatie emeroberio yaye echikire na mobwate amachiko aye buna mwakorire ase rituko ria rero.”
english: But your hearts must be fully committed to the LORD our God, to live by his decrees and obey his commands, as at this time."

ekegusii: Taibo, obobe bwaino nabwo bwabaatananire korwa ase Nyasae oino. Ebibe biaino biagerire Omonene obisire obosio bwaye korwa asemore, ase igo tari koigwa ogosaba kwaino.
english: But your iniquities have separated you from your God; your sins have hidden his face from you, so that he will not hear.

ekegusii: Korende ababisa bao bare omoganda omonene mbairurukigwe buna orotu; na omoganda bw’abare abatindi noirurukigwe buna omoiriro gochia aare. Amang’ana ayio nigo arabe mobosokano, ee, nigo arabe mobosokano mono.
english: But your many enemies will become like fine dust, the ruthless hordes like blown chaff. Suddenly, in an instant,

ekegusii: Korende intwe abasomba bao, kera oyomo oito oyobogoretie ebirwanero bi’okorwana esegi agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene namboke gochia ng’umbu, buna aye omonene oito gwachikire.”
english: But your servants, every man armed for battle, will cross over to fight before the LORD, just as our lord says."

ekegusii: Zakayo agatenena, agatebia Omonene, “Rora, Omonene, ekeng’ese ki’enibo yane ning’ee abataka; naende onye naureretie omonto egento nimoiranerie ara kane.”
english: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, "Look, Lord! Here and now I give half of my possessions to the poor, and if I have cheated anybody out of anything, I will pay back four times the amount."

ekegusii: Korende Zadoki omokuani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Nathani omobani, na Simei, na Rei, na abarwani chituoni ba Daudi, barabwo tibabwatanete n’Adonia.
english: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei and Rei and David's special guard did not join Adonijah.

ekegusii: Korende Serubabeli, na Yesua, na abateneneri bande be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakabakania, bakabatebia, “Inwe timogwenereti motoagachisie enyomba ya Nyasae oito, korende nintwe tweka toraagachere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyomba, buna Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi atochigete.”
english: But Zerubbabel, Jeshua and the rest of the heads of the families of Israel answered, "You have no part with us in building a temple to our God. We alone will build it for the LORD, the God of Israel, as King Cyrus, the king of Persia, commanded us."

ekegusii: Korende abanto ba Sayoni nigo bagoteba: “Omonene ototigire, Omonene oito otwebire.”
english: But Zion said, "The LORD has forsaken me, the Lord has forgotten me."

ekegusii: Erio Sipora akaimokia rigena riare erioge, agasara omwana oye risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha akarikunia amagoro a Musa, akabora, “Amaene, nigo ore omonyuomi one bw’amanyinga.”
english: But Zipporah took a flint knife, cut off her son's foreskin and touched [Moses'] feet with it. "Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me," she said.

ekegusii: “Korende ere oyogwetogia tiga etogie ase Omonene.”
english: But, "Let him who boasts boast in the Lord."

ekegusii: Korende intwe, baminto, gatoraatananekane korwa asemore ase ekero egeke (ase obosio gose tari ase enkoro) tokarengereria mono kobua nokogania okonene kororana nainwe amasio ase amasio.
english: But, brothers, when we were torn away from you for a short time (in person, not in thought), out of our intense longing we made every effort to see you.

ekegusii: Korende inwe abanchani, moinyore amang’ana aria akwanetwe nabatomwa b’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: But, dear friends, remember what the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ foretold.

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda okonacha ebina ase oboronge; aye okoriga‐rigia ebirengererio bi’enkoro, tiga ndore gokorusia egesiomba asebare, ekiagera nabekire amang’ana aane asore.”
english: But, O LORD Almighty, you who judge righteously and test the heart and mind, let me see your vengeance upon them, for to you I have committed my cause.

ekegusii: Korende omonto oria tancha korara aroro ase obotuko boria. Ase igo akaimoka amo nomokungu oye o sere‐sere, bagachaka orogendo rwabo gochia Yebusi, (noro Yerusalemu), babwate chitigere chiabekire ebiikaransero.
english: But, unwilling to stay another night, the man left and went toward Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.

ekegusii: Naende akamokania, akamotebia, “Tokonyara korora obosio bwane, ekiagera mwanyabanto aise kondora, takonyara koba moyo.”
english: But," he said, "you cannot see my face, for no one may see me and live."

ekegusii: Buy the truth and do not sell it; get wisdom, discipline and understanding.
english: Gora ekeene, na tobaisa gokeoonia; boigo gora obong’aini, na amorokererio, na obomanyi.

ekegusii: Boigo togore abataka ase rigori rie chifeta, na abaremerwa ase rigori ri’ebikoroto bibere, na toonie engano embe ere namakoyo buna eyere engiya.”
english: buying the poor with silver and the needy for a pair of sandals, selling even the sweepings with the wheat.

ekegusii: ase enchera enyia ere moyo, eye atoigorerete, egoetera ase etoto, engencho yaye omobere oye.
english: by a new and living way opened for us through the curtain, that is, his body,

ekegusii: Ere ase omobere oye agasiria chinguru chi’amachiko na echi’emeroberio y’amachiko, erinde asere omonyene atonge omonto oyomo omoyia korwa ase baria babere, igo agakora omorembe,
english: by abolishing in his flesh the law with its commandments and regulations. His purpose was to create in himself one new man out of the two, thus making peace,

ekegusii: Naende nigo bakworokereria chingencho chitari boronge ng’a tochianche gose gochienaria, ekiagera intwe n’Abarumi tore.”
english: by advocating customs unlawful for us Romans to accept or practice."

ekegusii: Ase ayio twaremigwe. Na kobua ase okoremigwa okwo tokagokera mono omogoko o Tito, ekiagera omoyo oye otimokigwe nainwe mwensi.
english: By all this we are encouraged. In addition to our own encouragement, we were especially delighted to see how happy Titus was, because his spirit has been refreshed by all of you.

ekegusii: na igo bakogera abanto babogorie ebibe biabo, na okomocha kwabo, ase okoria ebinto ebichenu baruete. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
english: by allowing them to eat the sacred offerings and so bring upon them guilt requiring payment. I am the LORD, who makes them holy.'"

ekegusii: boigo baborie abakuani b’enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda na ababani. “Inee! Ntogenderere korera na kweng’ata ase omotienyi o gatano, buna twabeire togokora ase engaki y’emiaka emenge?”
english: by asking the priests of the house of the LORD Almighty and the prophets, "Should I mourn and fast in the fifth month, as I have done for so many years?"

ekegusii: Ase ogokwana igoro y’okobwatana okoyia nigo akorire koria kwe ritang’ani kobe ogokoro, na koria kwabeire ogokoro na kogota, ng’ang’e kore gosira.
english: By calling this covenant "new," he has made the first one obsolete; and what is obsolete and aging will soon disappear.

ekegusii: Ase omobaso Omonene nigo akong’a obwanchani bwaye botari koera, na ase obotuko nigo nkomotogia namatera na gosaba Nyasae oyore obogima bwane.
english: By day the LORD directs his love, at night his song is with me-- a prayer to the God of my life.

ekegusii: Omonene akaba okobatang’ana, omobaso ase riire riare buna esiiro aborokie enchera, na botuko ase omorero orenge buna esiiro abae oborabu, erio barore ase bakogenda, omobaso na obotuko.
english: By day the LORD went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them on their way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light, so that they could travel by day or night.

ekegusii: Ase omobaso okaraa Abaisraeli ne riire, na ase obotuko ne riire ri’omorero ase okobamorekera enchera baare goetera.
english: By day you led them with a pillar of cloud, and by night with a pillar of fire to give them light on the way they were to take.

ekegusii: By examining him yourself you will be able to learn the truth about all these charges we are bringing against him."
english: agachika abamosoeri baria bache asore.] Aye omonyene nonyare komoboria, onyore engencho y’amang’ana onsi twamosoeire intwe.”

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Abeli akaa Nyasae ekeng’wanso ekere ekiya kobua egia Kaini. Ase okwo akaberwa kirori ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge. Nyasae akamobera kirori ase ogwancha ebiegwa biaye. Abeli okure, korende ase okwegena ngokwana are nonya ngoika bono.
english: By faith Abel offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. By faith he was commended as a righteous man, when God spoke well of his offerings. And by faith he still speaks, even though he is dead.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Sara omonyene akanyora chinguru koba morito, nonya konya oeteire emiaka yaye, ekiagera amoroche ere oyomorierete eira, ng’a nomwegenwa are.
english: By faith Abraham, even though he was past age-- and Sarah herself was barren-- was enabled to become a father because he considered him faithful who had made the promise.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Ibrahimu akaigwera Nyasae ekero arangeretigwe kogenda goika aase aria achiete konyora abe omwando oye, akaimoka akagenda, tamanya aase agochia.
english: By faith Abraham, when called to go to a place he would later receive as his inheritance, obeyed and went, even though he did not know where he was going.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Ibrahimu, gachia goteemwa, akarua Isaka abe ekeng’wanso. Nere oyorieretwe chiira akarua omwana oye omomoima.
english: By faith Abraham, when God tested him, offered Isaac as a sacrifice. He who had received the promises was about to sacrifice his one and only son,

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Enoku akang’anyigwa, tacha korora amakweri. Tarorekanete, ekiagera Nyasae namong’anyetie. Naki ritang’ani atarang’anyigwa konya obereirwe kirori ng’a namogwenerete Nyasae.
english: By faith Enoch was taken from this life, so that he did not experience death; he could not be found, because God had taken him away. For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena akaroisia Epasaka na kogindia amanyinga, erinde oyorache goita abana abatangi tabakuna, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.
english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of blood, so that the destroyer of the firstborn would not touch the firstborn of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena akarua Misiri, tairoka endamwamu y’omoruoti, ekiagera aremereretie buna oyororire ere oyotari kororekana.
english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the king's anger; he persevered because he saw him who is invisible.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena akamenya ase ense eria engeni arieretwe eira, akamenya buna omomenyi ase chiema amo na Isaka na Yakobo, abarenge abanyamwando amo nere ase eira eria eria.
english: By faith he made his home in the promised land like a stranger in a foreign country; he lived in tents, as did Isaac and Jacob, who were heirs with him of the same promise.

ekegusii: Na ase okwegena kw’erieta riaye, erieta riaye riamobekire chinguru omonto oyo mwarorire aiga na komomanya; na okwegena koria kore ase enchera ya Yeso kwamonyoreire obogima oboikeranu, buna mwarorire mwensi.
english: By faith in the name of Jesus, this man whom you see and know was made strong. It is Jesus' name and the faith that comes through him that has given this complete healing to him, as you can all see.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Isaka agasesenia Yakobo na Esau ase amang’ana agochi‐gocha.
english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau in regard to their future.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Yakobo, ekero arenge ang’e nogokwa, agasesenia kera oyomo bw’abana ba Yusufu, agasasima bwesiirerete enyimbo yaye.
english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of Joseph's sons, and worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Yusufu, ekero abeire ang’e nomoerio bw’obogima bwaye, agakwana igoro y’okong’anyigwa kw’Abaisraeli, akabachikera amang’ana igoro y’amauga aye.
english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, spoke about the exodus of the Israelites from Egypt and gave instructions about his bones.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Musa, ekero aiboretwe, akabiswa ase engaki y’emetienyi etato nabaibori baye, ekiagera baroche ng’a nomwana omuya, gose tibairogete ogochika kw’omoruoti.
english: By faith Moses' parents hid him for three months after he was born, because they saw he was no ordinary child, and they were not afraid of the king's edict.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Musa, kabeire omonto omonene, akaanga tarokwa omwana bw’omoiseke o Farao,
english: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be known as the son of Pharaoh's daughter.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Nuhu, gaikire gokurerwa na Nyasae ase amang’ana atararorekana, ase okoba namasikani amaya asare akaroisia obwato, erinde atoorie abanto b’enyomba yaye. Ase ayio, akagambia ense ekina, na akaba omonyamwando bw’oboronge bokonyorekana ase okwegena.
english: By faith Noah, when warned about things not yet seen, in holy fear built an ark to save his family. By his faith he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness that comes by faith.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’Enyancha Embariri buna ase ense enyomo. Korende Abamisiri barabwo bagachia goteema gokora bo, bakamerwa nenyancha.
english: By faith the people passed through the Red Sea as on dry land; but when the Egyptians tried to do so, they were drowned.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena Rahabu, oria omotayayi, taitetwe amo nabwo bataigwerete, ekiagera aroisetie abanto baria chirooti nomorembe.
english: By faith the prostitute Rahab, because she welcomed the spies, was not killed with those who were disobedient.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena chindwaki chia Yeriko chikagwa gachiaetananirwe ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell, after the people had marched around them for seven days.

ekegusii: Ase okwegena twamanyire ng’a ense nigo yatongetwe ase chinguru chie ring’ana ria Nyasae, na igo ebinto bikororekana tibiakoretwe nebinto bire maiso marore.
english: By faith we understand that the universe was formed at God's command, so that what is seen was not made out of what was visible.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoeyana, na omoika oye omecheeria igoro, ere nigo aitete nokoboko kwaye engiti eria yare gotama.
english: By his breath the skies became fair; his hand pierced the gliding serpent.

ekegusii: Ase obong’aini bwaye chindiba nigo chikobochoria, na amare atonyia riime.
english: by his knowledge the deeps were divided, and the clouds let drop the dew.

ekegusii: Nyasae nabogetie Omonene, naintwe natobokie ase okobua kwaye.
english: By his power God raised the Lord from the dead, and he will raise us also.

ekegusii: Ere ase okobua kwaye nigo agoturubania enyancha, na ase chisemi chiaye akanachana Rahabu, eng’iti enene y’enyancha.
english: By his power he churned up the sea; by his wisdom he cut Rahab to pieces.

ekegusii: Hodesi mokaye akamoiborera abana abamura, nabwo aba: Yobabu na Zibia, na Mesa, na Malikamu,
english: By his wife Hodesh he had Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

ekegusii: Naende Husimu akamoiborera abamura babere, nabwo Abitubu na Elipali.
english: By Hushim he had Abitub and Elpaal.

ekegusii: Omoruoti ogokora ay’oboronge nigo akogera ense yaye yagenderera gotenena bokong’u, korende oyo okorigia amaaki nigo akoyeiyeria.
english: By justice a king gives a country stability, but one who is greedy for bribes tears it down.

ekegusii: Ase obokonyi bwane abaruoti nigo bakogamba, na abagambi nigo bakobeka amachiko ay’ekeene.
english: By me kings reign and rulers make laws that are just;

ekegusii: Ase obokonyi bwane abagambi nigo bakogamba, boigo nabanene na abanachi ebina bonsi.
english: by me princes govern, and all nobles who rule on earth.

ekegusii: “Inche omonyene tinkonyara gokora kende gionsi. Buna nkoigwa nabo nkogamba, na ekina kiane nigo kere boronge, ekiagera tindi korigia ogwancha kwane, korende nogwancha gwa Tata oyontomete.
english: By myself I can do nothing; I judge only as I hear, and my judgment is just, for I seek not to please myself but him who sent me.

ekegusii: Netianirie inche omonyene; ring’ana riarure ase omonwa one ase oboronge, tirikoonchoka. Kera riru naribekwe inse ase obosio bwane, na kera oromeme ndotiane asende.”
english: By myself I have sworn, my mouth has uttered in all integrity a word that will not be revoked: Before me every knee will bow; by me every tongue will swear.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo ngaetera ase Egeita kie Rikura, gochia ase Ensoko y’Enchoka, ngaika ase Egeita ki’Eubi, nkarata chindwaki chia Yerusalemu, echio chiatagoretwe, na ebiita biaye biria biasaretigwe nomorero.
english: By night I went out through the Valley Gate toward the Jackal Well and the Dung Gate, examining the walls of Jerusalem, which had been broken down, and its gates, which had been destroyed by fire.

ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Intwe abatwakure korwa ase ebibe, naki toranyare komenya ase ebibe naende?
english: By no means! We died to sin; how can we live in it any longer?

ekegusii: Korwa ase ogokorerwa bobe, na okonacherwa ekina, akaiiwa goitwa. Ning’o ase ekiaare kiaye orengereretie ng’a nigo arusetigwe ase ense y’abwo bare moyo, na goakwa ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto baane?
english: By oppression and judgment he was taken away. And who can speak of his descendants? For he was cut off from the land of the living; for the transgression of my people he was stricken.

ekegusii: Ekero mwarure ensemo engiya kobua korwa ase okoruegwa okwo, timokoba nokomocha ase okoria eria entigari. Timobaisa gokora ebinto ebichenu bi’Abaisraeli bibe ebitachenegeti, erinde timokwa.”
english: By presenting the best part of it you will not be guilty in this matter; then you will not defile the holy offerings of the Israelites, and you will not die.'"

ekegusii: Omonto omoao kararare nere ase obotomani, nonya ayio karabe abisekanete ase omosacha bw’omokungu oyio, omokungu oyio bwekorire omosaria, nonya kirori onde tari okomoteba ekiagera tabwatetwe okobokora.
english: by sleeping with another man, and this is hidden from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she has not been caught in the act),

ekegusii: Na ase okoremereria kwaino namonyore obogima bwaino.
english: By standing firm you will gain life.

ekegusii: Endamwamu yao entindi ekagera amache akaimoka, agatenena buna orwaki, enyancha egakamoka goika inse kegima.”
english: By the blast of your nostrils the waters piled up. The surging waters stood firm like a wall; the deep waters congealed in the heart of the sea.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’amagana atano na rimo, na oyomo, rituko rie ritangani ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, amache agasira korwa ase ense. Nuhu akarusia ekerama ki’obwato, akarigereria, akarora ng’a ense yakamokire.
english: By the first day of the first month of Noah's six hundred and first year, the water had dried up from the earth. Noah then removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

ekegusii: Koreng’ana nobuya bwa Nyasae naetwe inche, buna omonene bw’abaagachi, oyore ne chisemi, nabekire oboroso, na omonto onde nkoagacha are igoro yaye. Korende kera omonto tiga arigererie buna akoagacha igoro yaye.
english: By the grace God has given me, I laid a foundation as an expert builder, and someone else is building on it. But each one should be careful how he builds.

ekegusii: Omoroberio okabekwa buna ebinyugwa ebio biarenge konyugwa; monto onde tarenge kobetererigwa, ekiagera omoruoti nigo achigete abasomba baye, abatenenerete enyomba yaye, ng’a batige kera omonto anywe ebinyugwa buna aganetie.
english: By the king's command each guest was allowed to drink in his own way, for the king instructed all the wine stewards to serve each man what he wished.

ekegusii: Inche Paulo omonyene nabasoroire ase obwororo na oboitongo bwa Kristo, inche nigo inde omoitongo konde amo nainwe, korende ntari aroro ninde noboremu asemore.
english: By the meekness and gentleness of Christ, I appeal to you-- I, Paul, who am "timid" when face to face with you, but "bold" when away!

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kianda ri’omotienyi o kane enchara ekaba enene mono ase omochie oria goika endagera ekabora kegima ase abanto b’aroro.
english: By the ninth day of the [fourth] month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kianda ri’omotienyi o kane, enchera ekaba enene mono ase omochie oria ime, goika endagera akabora kegima ey’abanto bakoria.
english: By the ninth day of the fourth month the famine in the city had become so severe that there was no food for the people to eat.

ekegusii: Naende chimesa chinde ibere nchiarenge agwo isiko ase baare gotiirera gochia ase egeita kia ime ki’oboagacho bwarochie sugusu; boigo ase ensemo ende y’egesoero ekio nchiarengeo chimesa chinde ibere.
english: By the outside wall of the portico of the gateway, near the steps at the entrance to the north gateway were two tables, and on the other side of the steps were two tables.

ekegusii: ase chinguru chi’ebikone na amakumia, ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu. Naikire korandia enchili ya Kristo ase Yerusalemu ne chinsemo chionsi chietanaine goika Iluriko.
english: by the power of signs and miracles, through the power of the Spirit. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.

ekegusii: Nigo twarenge goikaransa ase chingegu chie chindooche chia Babeli, twaba tokorera ekero twarenge koinyora Sayoni.
english: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

ekegusii: Korende igoro ya bono amo na ense eye biagacheirwe omorero ase ring’ana erio erio, birendwe goika rituko ri’ogosirigwa kw’abanto abatamoirogeti Nyasae.
english: By the same word the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Nyasae agaikerania emeremo yaye yonsi, eye konya akorire; ase rituko ria gatano na kabere agatimoka korwa ase emeremo yaye yonsi, eye konya akorire.
english: By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested from all his work.

ekegusii: Noiteke ebigeri korwa ase obosio bwao omanye konyora endagera orie; goika oirane ase riroba, ekiagera agwo nao kwarwete. Naki aye norotu, naende noirane ase orotu.”
english: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your food until you return to the ground, since from it you were taken; for dust you are and to dust you will return."

ekegusii: By the time Lot reached Zoar, the sun had risen over the land.
english: Erioba konya riaorokire ekero Loti asoete Soari.

ekegusii: Rituko ri’emerongo ebere, na gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi o kabere, ense ekaba yakamokire kegima.
english: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was completely dry.

ekegusii: Abanto bakagechia Omonene agwo ase amache a Meriba, na ase engencho yabo Musa agasoa ase emechando.
english: By the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them;

ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteba ng’a ase enchera eria acherete, eyio nero arairanere, naende takonyara gosoa ase omochie oyo.
english: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city, declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteba ng’a enchera eria acherete, eyio nero arairanere, gose takonyara gosoa ase omochie oyo.
english: By the way that he came he will return; he will not enter this city," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene omonto o Nyasae akarua ase ense ya Yuda. Ere agacha Beteli ekero Yeroboamu ateneine ase egesasimero gosamba ubani.
english: By the word of the LORD a man of God came from Judah to Bethel, as Jeroboam was standing by the altar to make an offering.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’aborokigwa b’ababani agatebia omogisangio oye ase ogochikwa kw’Omonene, “Nagosabire, ing’ake ong’ite!” Korende omonto oria akaanga komoaka.
english: By the word of the LORD one of the sons of the prophets said to his companion, "Strike me with your weapon," but the man refused.

ekegusii: Ase chinguru chie ring’ana ri’Omonene igoro egatongwa, na ase okobua kwe ring’ana riaye erioba na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni bigatongwa.
english: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made, their starry host by the breath of his mouth.

ekegusii: Endamwamu y’Omonene bw’Emeganda yasambire ense; abanto nigo banga buna chinko chigwokia omorero, na monto onde takororera oyomwabo amabera.
english: By the wrath of the LORD Almighty the land will be scorched and the people will be fuel for the fire; no one will spare his brother.

ekegusii: Ase amaamo abo namobamanye. Inee! Abanto nigo bagotwa amasabibu korwa ase emetobo, gose amako korwa ase amageri?
english: By their fruit you will recognize them. Do people pick grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?

ekegusii: Amo nayio nigo ogokurera omosomba oo; oyio okoyarenda nigo akoegwa eng’eria enene y’obuya.
english: By them is your servant warned; in keeping them there is great reward.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ense eria y’ekero keria egasira ase etoigo ime.
english: By these waters also the world of that time was deluged and destroyed.

ekegusii: Igo abanto bonsi nabamanye ng’a naborokigwa baane more, komorabe nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.”
english: By this all men will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another."

ekegusii: na ase eyio mwatoorigwe, onye mwabwatire mono amang’ana nabaranderetie. Onye taibo, rirorio nigo mwegenete bosa.
english: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo arikwanete igoro y’Omoika, ekiagera baria bamwegenire nabayonyore nyuma, ekiagera Omoika Omochenu konya toraruegwa, ekiagera Yeso konya taraegwa obonene.
english: By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.

ekegusii: Goika chinsa chinyinge chi’omobaso chigaeta, aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakabora, “Aase aa negesomo, na bono riagorobire.
english: By this time it was late in the day, so his disciples came to him. "This is a remote place," they said, "and it's already very late.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo mbachenwe korwa ase ogosaria kwabo, na okorusigwa okwo kw’ebibe nkorente okwama ogoikeranu, ekero amagena onsi ay’ebisasimero arasenyentwe buna amagena ’echooka, na emete y’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, na ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani, biratagorwe bionsi.
english: By this, then, will Jacob's guilt be atoned for, and this will be the full fruitage of the removal of his sin: When he makes all the altar stones to be like chalk stones crushed to pieces, no Asherah poles or incense altars will be left standing.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaamereranetie nabarabwo okabaa egesusuro ase ekerengo, okarenta omwaga omotindi korwa moocha, okabaseria.
english: By warfare and exile you contend with her-- with his fierce blast he drives her out, as on a day the east wind blows.

ekegusii: Enyomba nigo ekoagachwa nobong’aini na yakong’igwa goetera ase okomanya.
english: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established;

ekegusii: Omonene nigo abegete oboroso bw’ense nobong’aini bwaye, na agakong’ia igoro nokomanya kwaye.
english: By wisdom the LORD laid the earth's foundations, by understanding he set the heavens in place;

ekegusii: Goetera ase obong’aini bwao bw’oboonchoreria, obotenenku bwao bwamentekanire; aye bono kwaenenire ase enkoro yao ase engencho y’obotenenku bwao obonge.
english: By your great skill in trading you have increased your wealth, and because of your wealth your heart has grown proud.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ebibe biao ebinge, na oboonchoreria bwao botari bw’oboronge, ogakora aase ao aachenegete akaba aatachenegeti. Ngasokia omorero korwa ase egati yao, na omorero oyio okagosiria, ngakoonchora okaba ribu igoro ase ense, agwo ase amaiso ’abanto bonsi bakoroche.
english: By your many sins and dishonest trade you have desecrated your sanctuaries. So I made a fire come out from you, and it consumed you, and I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who were watching.

ekegusii: Goetera ase abanto bao gwatomete kwamochecheirie Omonene, ekero gwatebire: Nase chigari chiane chinyinge nariinire goika ebichuria bi’ebitunwa, goika igoro kegima ya Lebanoni. Ngatema emecharake emetambe goetania eyende, na emetarakwa yaye emiya mono. Ngasoa ase ebinunchi biaye ime, na ime ase rinani riaye rinoru.
english: By your messengers you have heaped insults on the Lord. And you have said, "With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its pines. I have reached its remotest parts, the finest of its forests.

ekegusii: Goetera ase abasomba bao gwachecheirie Omonene ekero gwatebire iga: Nase chigari chiane chinyinge nariinire goika ebichuria bi’ebitunwa, goika igoro kegima ya Lebanoni. Ngatema emecharake yaye yare emetambe goetania eyende, na emetarakwa yaye emiya mono. Ngasoa ase ebinunchi biaye ime, na ime ase rinani rinoru.
english: By your messengers you have heaped insults on the Lord. And you have said, 'With my many chariots I have ascended the heights of the mountains, the utmost heights of Lebanon. I have cut down its tallest cedars, the choicest of its pines. I have reached its remotest heights, the finest of its forests.

ekegusii: Obong’aini bwao, na okomanya kwao, biakonyoreire obotenenku obonge; aye gwasangereirie chitahabu ne chifeta ase chikungo chiao.
english: By your wisdom and understanding you have gained wealth for yourself and amassed gold and silver in your treasuries.

ekegusii: Cabbon, Lahmas, Kitlish,
english: na Kaboni, na Lamasi, na Kitilisi,

ekegusii: Na Kayafa nere oete Abayahudi amang’ana ng’a negwenerete omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y’abanto.
english: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jews that it would be good if one man died for the people.

ekegusii: Cain lay with his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain was then building a city, and he named it after his son Enoch.
english: Kaini akaba na mokaye, na ere akaba morito, akaibora Enoku; na Kaini akaagacha omochie, akayoroka Enoku, erieta ri’omwana oye.

ekegusii: Erio Kaini agatebia Omonene, “Egesusuro kiane nekerito, tinkonyara gokebogoria.
english: Cain said to the LORD, "My punishment is more than I can bear.

ekegusii: Calamity is hungry for him; disaster is ready for him when he falls.
english: Enchara nemorie goika chinguru chiaye chiere, na emechando nemobeere ang’e komoiyeria.

ekegusii: Amaakwa nabe agotunyanwa na amaakwa ande, na amang’ana amabe nabe agotunyanwa nayande amabe. Abanto mbarigie amaroro korwa ase ababani; abakuani mbasinywe kworokereria amachiko, na abagaaka mbasinywe gosemia.
english: Calamity upon calamity will come, and rumor upon rumor. They will try to get a vision from the prophet; the teaching of the law by the priest will be lost, as will the counsel of the elders.

ekegusii: Kalebu, mosinto o Hezironi, akanyuoma Asuba. Asuba akamoiborera Yerioti omoiseke. Na abana abamura baye nabwo aba: Yeseri na Sobabu, na Aridoni.
english: Caleb son of Hezron had children by his wife Azubah (and by Jerioth). These were her sons: Jesher, Shobab and Ardon.

ekegusii: Boigo Efa, omokungu o sere‐sere o Kalebu, akaibora Harani, na Moza, na Gasesi; na Harani boigo nabwate omomura orenge korokwa Gasesi.
english: Caleb's concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.

ekegusii: Maaka, omokungu o sere‐sere o Kalebu, akaibora Seberi na Tirihana.
english: Caleb's concubine Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.

ekegusii: Ndangerie, nainche ninkoiranerie, ninkoorokerie amang’ana amanene abisekanete, ayio aye otana komanya.
english: 'Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.'

ekegusii: Akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabatebia, “Ekeene nabatebirie: Oyo omoboraka omotaka obekire chinyinge kobua bonsi ababeka ase ekebekerero gi’esadaka,
english: Calling his disciples to him, Jesus said, "I tell you the truth, this poor widow has put more into the treasury than all the others.

ekegusii: aba okorangeria abaeti bare ase orogendo rwabo,
english: calling out to those who pass by, who go straight on their way.

ekegusii: Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere, agachaka kobatoma babere babere, akabaa okobua igoro ase ebirecha bi’eubi;
english: Calling the Twelve to him, he sent them out two by two and gave them authority over evil spirits.

ekegusii: Inee! Abanto b’ekegambero egekorekanu mbabwatane naye? Abwo nigo bakorenta obokong’u ase okoonchorana amachiko.
english: Can a corrupt throne be allied with you-- one that brings on misery by its decrees?

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nabogorie omorero ayobeke ase egekuba kiaye, ne chianga chiaye tichiyia?
english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap without his clothes being burned?

ekegusii: Gose nataare ase rieera ri’omorero, na amagoro aye tayia?
english: Can a man walk on hot coals without his feet being scorched?

ekegusii: Inee! Mwanyabanto nanyare koba omoronge kobua Nyasae? Nanyare koba oyochenegete kobua Omotongi oye?
english: 'Can a mortal be more righteous than God? Can a man be more pure than his Maker?

ekegusii: Ning’o ase egati yaino okong’orokia ng’a ninde nebibe? Kongokwana ekeene, naki inwe motakonyegena?
english: Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why don't you believe me?

ekegusii: “Nyasae, ning’o oreo ogochia koamererania nainche? Onye oreo, rirorio inche nigo ndakire‐kiri inkwe.
english: Can anyone bring charges against me? If so, I will be silent and die.

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nanyare koyebwata ekero ere ase riraro riaye? Gose nabochore chimioro chiaye ayesibe nengori?”
english: Can anyone capture him by the eyes, or trap him and pierce his nose?

ekegusii: Naende inche Omonene nigo ngoteba: Inee! Omonto nanyare kwebisa aase are bobisi inche ntamorore? Tari inche oria inde aande onsi, igoro na ense?
english: Can anyone hide in secret places so that I cannot see him?" declares the LORD. "Do not I fill heaven and earth?" declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Inee! Ensoko nenyare ase entuboka eyemo korenta amache amaya, na amache amaroro?
english: Can both fresh water and salt water flow from the same spring?

ekegusii: Can he who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One?
english: Inee! Omonto ogechete ekeene nanyare kogamba? Nonachere ekina omonyene oboronge oyore nokobua?

ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o oranyare kobara emeganda yaye? Ning’o omobaso oye otari kobarera?
english: Can his forces be numbered? Upon whom does his light not rise?

ekegusii: “Inee! Amauncho nanyare komera ase entente etari? Gose ebitonto nabimere ase amache atari?
english: Can papyrus grow tall where there is no marsh? Can reeds thrive without water?

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto ore ne chinguru naurwe egiasakoire? Gose oyore noboronge naurwe abasibwa baye?
english: Can plunder be taken from warriors, or captives rescued from the fierce?

ekegusii: Inee! Omoetiopia nanyare koonchora ekieni kie risankwa riaye, gose engo nenyare koonchora amatonto aye? Onye naboigo, inwe aba mwanarire gokora ebibe rirorio monyare gokora amaya.
english: Can the Ethiopian change his skin or the leopard its spots? Neither can you do good who are accustomed to doing evil.

ekegusii: Nonyare koraa ching’enang’eni chioroke ase chingaki chiabo? Gose nonyare koraa egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Edubu ne chimanwa chiaye?
english: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear with its cubs?

ekegusii: Nonyare kobochora riiyo riaye ne ritimo rikobeta chinswe? Gose ritimo erio ndibete omotwe oye riyobochore?
english: Can you fill his hide with harpoons or his head with fishing spears?

ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare koyesiba ne chingori eete ase emeng’ororia ye chintinde? Gose ebutorane chintinde ase rikura riao?
english: Can you hold him to the furrow with a harness? Will he till the valleys behind you?

ekegusii: Inee! Nonyare korambora igoro buna ere ayeramborete, igoro eria ere enkong’u buna ekerore gi’ekioma?
english: can you join him in spreading out the skies, hard as a mirror of cast bronze?

ekegusii: Can you make a pet of him like a bird or put him on a leash for your girls?
english: Inee! Nokore egosori nero buna orakore nenyoni? Gose oyebeke ekorere abasomba bao abaiseke egosori?

ekegusii: Nonyare gosoyia engori ime ase chimioro chiaye, gose kobochora orosea rwaye nendobio?
english: Can you put a cord through his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook?

ekegusii: erinde ogende oyoire ase ribebe riaye? Naende nomanyete ebinchera bigochia ase enyomba yaye?
english: Can you take them to their places? Do you know the paths to their dwellings?

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo oyiegenete ng’a neirane na ekorentere endagera ase ekeooreri kiao?
english: Can you trust him to bring in your grain and gather it to your threshing floor?

ekegusii: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
english: Kanani akaibora Sidoni, omwana oye omotangi, na Heti,

ekegusii: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
english: Na Kanani akaibora Sidoni, omwana oye omotangi, na Heti,

ekegusii: Ekero abasibwa baikire aroro, nigo bakoba bagotimoka amo, tibari koigwa amariogi ’abarendi babo bakobabetereria nobotindi.
english: Captives also enjoy their ease; they no longer hear the slave driver's shout.

ekegusii: Bakaira ense yonsi y’Abaamori ekaba eyabo, korwa Arinoni goika Yaboki, na korwa erooro goika Yorodan.
english: capturing all of it from the Arnon to the Jabbok and from the desert to the Jordan.

ekegusii: Abagendi babwate chitugo chiabo nigo bakogobera korigia amache, tibakoyanyora; ase igo bakwera ase erooro.
english: Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go up into the wasteland and perish.

ekegusii: Dili teri koorerwa nekeoorero gi’ekioma, gose komini teri koorwa namagoro e chigari, korende bionsi bibere nigo bigosusurerwa omote.
english: Caraway is not threshed with a sledge, nor is a cartwheel rolled over cummin; caraway is beaten out with a rod, and cummin with a stick.

ekegusii: Ase ayio moigwere, mokore amang’ana onsi ay’okobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania erio nario morasesenigwe ase emeremo yonsi morabe mogokora.
english: Carefully follow the terms of this covenant, so that you may prosper in everything you do.

ekegusii: omodalasini, na ekarafuu, na manemane, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani na edivai, na amaguta, na obosie obonuke, na engano, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ne chibarasi, ne chigari, na emebere ya mwanyabanto na emioyo yabo.
english: cargoes of cinnamon and spice, of incense, myrrh and frankincense, of wine and olive oil, of fine flour and wheat; cattle and sheep; horses and carriages; and bodies and souls of men.

ekegusii: Ebinto bie chitahabu, na ebie chifeta na ebi’amagena e rigori rinene, na ebie chiruru; chianga chi’egatani, na echimonyinga, na echi’ariri, na echire chimbariri mono; kera omote bw’ogotioka okuya, na kera egento keroisirie korwa ase amaino ’enchogu, na kera egento ki’omote bwe rigori rinene, na egi’etaai, na egi’ekioma, na eki’amagena akomeka‐meka;
english: cargoes of gold, silver, precious stones and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk and scarlet cloth; every sort of citron wood, and articles of every kind made of ivory, costly wood, bronze, iron and marble;

ekegusii: Bogorerania chigurube inwe ase inwe, nario moraikeranie amachiko a Kristo.
english: Carry each other's burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

ekegusii: Ere agasoka bwebogoreretie omosalaba oye, goika aase akorokwa Ekeore; ase Ekeibirania akorokwa Gologotha.
english: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).

ekegusii: Motweke ogwechanda kwaino gwonsi, ekiagera ere nigo agwechanda mono ase engencho yaino.
english: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korigereria ebio bire bosa, ekiagera obonda nigo bogochoma chimbaba, bwairuruka buna ensoti ekoiruruka yarimera igoro.
english: Cast but a glance at riches, and they are gone, for they will surely sprout wings and fly off to the sky like an eagle.

ekegusii: Okore chibonyi inye chie chitahabu chinyititoire, ochibeke ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera rikere.
english: Cast four gold rings for it and fasten them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

ekegusii: Eteria endagera yao igoro ye chinyancha, na nyuma y’amatuko amange noyenyore.
english: Cast your bread upon the waters, for after many days you will find it again.

ekegusii: Motweke Omonene chigurube chiao, nere nakobwate nokoboko kwaye akorende; ere tagotiga omonyaboronge abugwe namabe.
english: Cast your cares on the LORD and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous fall.

ekegusii: Casting the lot settles disputes and keeps strong opponents apart.
english: Obomera nabwo bogokoora okoamererania na gwatanana abanene abwo bakoamererania.

ekegusii: “Tobwatere ebibwe, ebibwe biria ebike, ebio bigosaria emegondo y’emesabibu, korwa ekero emesabibu yaito yasichete.”
english: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that ruin the vineyards, our vineyards that are in bloom.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi oyo, chinsa chia mogoroba, namorende rituko erio ase engaki echikire koreng’ana nemeroberio eria yachigetwe.”
english: Celebrate it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with all its rules and regulations."

ekegusii: “Ekero mwaoorire chindagera chiaino naende mwamitire amasabibu aino inamobe n’Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: Celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days after you have gathered the produce of your threshing floor and your winepress.

ekegusii: Amatuko atano na abere ase kera omwaka morende Amatuko ayio Amanene ase Omonene. Okwo nogochika koragenderere botambe asemore, ebiaare ase ebiaare. Ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere namoyarende.
english: Celebrate this as a festival to the LORD for seven days each year. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come; celebrate it in the seventh month.

ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Onye nabo, naki rende Nyasae aranyare kogambia ense?
english: Certainly not! If that were so, how could God judge the world?

ekegusii: Menta obobe igoro ase obobe bwabo; tobatiga basoe ase oboronge bwao.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime; do not let them share in your salvation.

ekegusii: Chika chibarasi chigende bosio, ne chigari chigende ne chinguru. Tiga chituoni chi’esegi chigende bosio: Abaetiopia na Abaputi, nabwo ababogoria be chinguba, na Abaludi nabwo abarwaneri amata.”
english: Charge, O horses! Drive furiously, O charioteers! March on, O warriors-- men of Cush and Put who carry shields, men of Lydia who draw the bow.

ekegusii: Abariini be chibarasi nigo bakominyoka gochia bosio; emioro nigo ekomesigwa, na amatimo akobarigwa. Emeganda y’abanto yaitirwe, ebitondo nigo birorekanete aande onsi. Emebere y’abanto bakwete tekobareka, nigo ekogocha abanto aande onsi.
english: Charging cavalry, flashing swords and glittering spears! Many casualties, piles of dead, bodies without number, people stumbling over the corpses--

ekegusii: Naende Yusufu akaira amo nere chigari na abariini chibarasi; bakaba omoganda omonene mono.
english: Chariots and horsemen also went up with him. It was a very large company.

ekegusii: Obonyakieni nigo bokong’ainereria, na ekieni ekiya nigo kere bosa, korende omokungu omoirogete Omonene, oyio nere oranyare gotogigwa.
english: Charm is deceptive, and beauty is fleeting; but a woman who fears the LORD is to be praised.

ekegusii: Abwo baiboirwe, tari korwa ase amanyinga a mwanyabanto, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omobere, gose tari ase ogwancha kw’omonto, korende nigo baiboirwe na Nyasae.
english: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband's will, but born of God.

ekegusii: Na inwe abana, moigwere abaibori baino ase amang’ana onsi, ekiagera ring’ana eri nigo rikogwenera Omonene.
english: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this pleases the Lord.

ekegusii: Inwe abana, moigwere abaibori baino ase Omonene, ekiagera obo nabwo oboronge.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

ekegusii: Abachokoro nigo bare egutwa ye chisokoro chiabo, na obonene bw’abana nigo bore abaibori babo.
english: Children's children are a crown to the aged, and parents are the pride of their children.

ekegusii: Choose my instruction instead of silver, knowledge rather than choice gold,
english: Ancha amorokererio aane kobua efeta, ne chisemi kobua etahabu echenire.

ekegusii: Chora korwa ase kera egesaku kiaino abanto abang’aini, abare abamanyi, abanto bamanyekanete buya, na inche nimbabeke babe abatang’ani baino.
english: Choose some wise, understanding and respected men from each of your tribes, and I will set them over you."

ekegusii: mochore oyore omuya mono, naende oisanerete, korwa ase egati y’abana abamura b’omonene oino, erio momobeke aikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia ise. Erio morwanerere enyomba y’omonene oino.”
english: choose the best and most worthy of your master's sons and set him on his father's throne. Then fight for your master's house."

ekegusii: Christ is the end of the law so that there may be righteousness for everyone who believes.
english: Naki Kristo nere ore omoerio bw’amachiko, erinde onde bwensi oyoramwegene anyore oboronge.

ekegusii: Kristo natobooretie korwa ase okoragererigwa kw’amachiko, ekero akoretwe koba okoragererigwa ase engencho yaito, ekiagera nerikire, “Kera omonto oyobambirwe igoro ase omote oragererigwe.”
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, for it is written: "Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, arokia chinkoro chiaino na motige koba abanyabigoti bikong’u.
english: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and do not be stiff-necked any longer.

ekegusii: Inwe Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu, earokie inwe abanyene, mwerue ase Omonene! Arokia chinkoro chiaino! Motakoreti bo, rirorio endamwamu yane nigo eraoroke igoro asemore buna omorero, na omonto tari orayerimie. Ayio onsi nigo arabe nase engencho y’ogokora kwaino okobe.”
english: Circumcise yourselves to the LORD, circumcise your hearts, you men of Judah and people of Jerusalem, or my wrath will break out and burn like fire because of the evil you have done-- burn with no one to quench it.

ekegusii: ekiagera narogete ase rituko ria gatano na gatato, naende noyomo bw’Abaisraeli inde, oyo bw’ororeria rwa Benjamin, Omoibirania oiboretwe n’Abaibirania, na ase ogotunyana amachiko n’Omofarisai inde.
english: circumcised on the eighth day, of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; in regard to the law, a Pharisee;

ekegusii: Okwaroka nigo kogwenerete onye kore omoigweri bw’amachiko, korende onye kore omosaria bw’amachiko, okwaroka kwao kwabeire ogotaroka.
english: Circumcision has value if you observe the law, but if you break the law, you have become as though you had not been circumcised.

ekegusii: Okwaroka tai gento, na ogotaroka tai gento, korende nokobwata amachiko a Nyasae.
english: Circumcision is nothing and uncircumcision is nothing. Keeping God's commands is what counts.

ekegusii: “Ase omosike gavuna Feliki. Inche Klaudio Lisia, nagokwanirie.
english: Claudius Lysias, To His Excellency, Governor Felix: Greetings.

ekegusii: Onsibie ne chinsagia chia hisopo, na inche nimbe omochenu; onsibie imbe omorabu se goetania amagena ’embura.
english: Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

ekegusii: Bono nigo are maiso marore, ng’a onde tari oranyore oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase amachiko; ekiagera nigo arikire, “Omonyene oboronge nabe moyo ase okwegena.”
english: Clearly no one is justified before God by the law, because, "The righteous will live by faith."

ekegusii: Aye okaboyia omobere one risankwa okayobekera chinyama, okayobwatania namauga na emeki.
english: clothe me with skin and flesh and knit me together with bones and sinews?

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barenge abarwani esegi, barenge kobeka chianga chimonyinga, barenge abagambi na abachiki bonsi nigo barenge abamura abaya bagosanerwa, barenge abariini chibarasi.
english: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men, and mounted horsemen.

ekegusii: Amare na omosunte ekerima nigo bimoetanaine; oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.
english: Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

ekegusii: Inchuo morwanie ense eyio korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, moigore ebiage biaye; mobeke ebinto bire imeo amo, bibe buna chitui chi’endagera. Mosirie ense eyio kegima; timobaisa gotigaria nonya negento ekemo.
english: Come against her from afar. Break open her granaries; pile her up like heaps of grain. Completely destroy her and leave her no remnant.

ekegusii: Inwe mwensi aba moirogete Nyasae, inchuo moigwe, nainche nimbatebie aya Omonene ankoreire.
english: Come and listen, all you who fear God; let me tell you what he has done for me.

ekegusii: Inchuo morore aya Omonene akorire, orentire ogosirigwa ase ense.
english: Come and see the works of the LORD, the desolations he has brought on the earth.

ekegusii: Inchuo morore aya Nyasae akorire. Aya akorire ase egati ya mwanyabanto nigo are ay’okwoboyia.
english: Come and see what God has done, how awesome his works in man's behalf!

ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, minyoka bwango, obe buna engabi gose ensune ensae ekominyoka igoro ase ebitunwa bire nebimeri bigotioka buya.
english: Come away, my lover, and be like a gazelle or like a young stag on the spice-laden mountains.

ekegusii: Boka buna egwenerete ase oboronge, timokora ebibe naende. Naki abande tibamomanyeti Nyasae. Natebire aya ase okobasookia.
english: Come back to your senses as you ought, and stop sinning; for there are some who are ignorant of God-- I say this to your shame.

ekegusii: Irana! Irana, aye Omosulamiti! Irana! Irana, erinde tokorigererie! Nase ki mokondi gereria inche Omosulamiti, buna mokorigereria ogotenga kw’ebiombe bibere bi’abarwani esegi?
english: Come back, come back, O Shulammite; come back, come back, that we may gaze on you! Why would you gaze on the Shulammite as on the dance of Mahanaim?

ekegusii: etoorie, ika korwa ase omosalaba!”
english: come down from the cross and save yourself!"

ekegusii: Inchuo ang’e asende, omboorie, nsibore korwa ase ababisa baane!
english: Come near and rescue me; redeem me because of my foes.

ekegusii: Moike Nyasae ang’e, na ere nabaike ang’e inwe. Inwe abanyene ebibe, mochene amaboko aino; inwe abanyene emioyo ebere, mochene chinkoro chiaino.
english: Come near to God and he will come near to you. Wash your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku, inchuo ang’e, motegerere moigwe; inwe abanto, igwera! Tiga ense etegerere amo na bionsi ebireo, ee, oboiko bwonsi na ebigosoka korwao.
english: Come near, you nations, and listen; pay attention, you peoples! Let the earth hear, and all that is in it, the world, and all that comes out of it!

ekegusii: Inchuo bono, tokore okobwatana, aye nainche, na korokwo inakobe kirori egati yao nainche.”
english: Come now, let's make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between us."

ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Sayoni, inchuo morore Sulemani omoruoti obegete ekiore keria ng’ina amobekerete ase rituko riria Sulemani akoreretwe enyangi, rituko riria ri’omogoko bw’enkoro yaye.
english: Come out, you daughters of Zion, and look at King Solomon wearing the crown, the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding, the day his heart rejoiced.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene ore ogotooreka kwane, ayerera onkonye!
english: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku momenyete ase chinsemo chionsi, ayerera bwango mooche, sangererekana amo. Aye Omonene, renta abarwani bao b’esegi bare chituoni!
english: Come quickly, all you nations from every side, and assemble there. Bring down your warriors, O LORD!

ekegusii: Aye omoriakari one, togende torue aa Lebanoni, torue Lebanoni, togende komo. Otirimboke korwa ase egechuria ki’egetunwa ki’Amana, na ekia Seniri na Herimoni. Orue ase amakuruma e chindo, na ase ebitunwa chingo chimenyete.
english: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, come with me from Lebanon. Descend from the crest of Amana, from the top of Senir, the summit of Hermon, from the lions' dens and the mountain haunts of the leopards.

ekegusii: Come, all you beasts of the field, come and devour, all you beasts of the forest!
english: Inwe ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana, inwe ching’iti chionsi chi’amanani, inchuo morie!

ekegusii: Inchuo, twekumbe ase obosio bw’Omonene, totung’ame asare, ekiagera nere ototongete.
english: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;

ekegusii: Eta togende toike asebare, tobatantanie omonwa obo tibaigwana ase chinkwana barabwo ase barabwo, ase chinkwana chiabo.”
english: Come, let us go down and confuse their language so they will not understand each other."

ekegusii: Inchuo, tomoterere Omonene nomogoko, inchuo, tomochengere oyore egetare ki’ogotooreka gwaito!
english: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.

ekegusii: Inchuo togokanie ase obotuko bwonsi goika mambia; inchuo twegokie nobwanchani.
english: Come, let's drink deep of love till morning; let's enjoy ourselves with love!

ekegusii: Tiga tomoonie ase Abaisumaeli aba, erinde titobaisa komoita namaboko aito, ekiagera noyominto, toiboire komo.” Na abamwabo bagancherana nere.
english: Come, let's sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay our hands on him; after all, he is our brother, our own flesh and blood." His brothers agreed.

ekegusii: Abana baane, inchuo montegerere, mborokererie buna moramoiroke Omonene.
english: Come, my children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, inchuo togende ase amaremo aito, tobeere ase emechie botuko,
english: Come, my lover, let us go to the countryside, let us spend the night in the villages.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo inchuo totaare ase omobaso bw’Omonene.
english: Come, O house of Jacob, let us walk in the light of the LORD.

ekegusii: Torigie nsemi ki tokobakorera tobatange, tibabaisa komenteka. Toise gosoa esegi, barabwo mbabaise kobwatana nababisa baito batorwanie, erio bang’anye korwa ense yaito.”
english: Come, we must deal shrewdly with them or they will become even more numerous and, if war breaks out, will join our enemies, fight against us and leave the country."

ekegusii: Remia abanto baane! Ee, remia abanto baane! Nabo Nyasae oino atebire.
english: Comfort, comfort my people, says your God.

ekegusii: rikabeera gati y’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli na oyo bw’Abamisiri. Agwo riire riria rikabao amo nomosunte; korende ase obotuko riire rikarenta oborabu. Na ase obotuko obogima omoganda oyomo toikanete ang’e noyonde.
english: coming between the armies of Egypt and Israel. Throughout the night the cloud brought darkness to the one side and light to the other side; so neither went near the other all night long.

ekegusii: Agacha asetore, akabogoria orokini rwa Paulo, agesibera amagoro na amaboko, akabora, “Omoika Omochenu otebire iga: Naboigo Abayahudi ba Yerusalemu barache gosiba omonto omonyene orokini oro, na barabwo nabamobeke ase amaboko ’abanto b’Ebisaku.”
english: Coming over to us, he took Paul's belt, tied his own hands and feet with it and said, "The Holy Spirit says, 'In this way the Jews of Jerusalem will bind the owner of this belt and will hand him over to the Gentiles.'"

ekegusii: Agachia goika ense yaye omonyene, akaborokereria ase esinagogi yabo, goika bagakumia, bagatebania, “Oyo ng’ai anyorire obong’aini obo na ogokora oko gwe chinguru?
english: Coming to his hometown, he began teaching the people in their synagogue, and they were amazed. "Where did this man get this wisdom and these miraculous powers?" they asked.

ekegusii: Ase ekero keria ere akaoroka, agatogia Nyasae, agatebia abanto bonsi abarenge baganyete okoboorigwa kwa Yerusalemu amang’ana igoro y’Omwana oria.
english: Coming up to them at that very moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the child to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Command and teach these things.
english: Obachike na koborokereria amang’ana ayio.

ekegusii: Obachike naende bakore amaya, babe abanda ase ogokora okuya, babe ang’e korua chinibo chiabo, na gwatanera abande ase emioyo emiya,
english: Command them to do good, to be rich in good deeds, and to be generous and willing to share.

ekegusii: Obachike abwo bare abanda ase ense eye ya bono tibaenena, gose gosemeria obonda boria bogosira, korende bamosemerie Nyasae, oyogotoa ebinto bionsi ase obonge, tobikorere ase omogoko.
english: Command those who are rich in this present world not to be arrogant nor to put their hope in wealth, which is so uncertain, but to put their hope in God, who richly provides us with everything for our enjoyment.

ekegusii: Motweke Omonene emeremo yao, na emeroberio yao nesesenigwe.
english: Commit to the LORD whatever you do, and your plans will succeed.

ekegusii: Erue ase Omonene mosemerie, nere nagokonye.
english: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in him and he will do this:

ekegusii: Moite Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abakanani, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, mobasirie kegima buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, abachigete.
english: Completely destroy them-- the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites-- as the LORD your God has commanded you.

ekegusii: Amang’ana igoro ya Damesiki naro aya: “Abanto ba Hamati na ab’Aripadi basookire, ekiagera baigure amang’ana amabe; chinkoro chiabo chiabeire nobwoba. Nigo bachandegete babeire buna enyancha yaburukanigwe etanyare gotoerera.
english: Concerning Damascus: "Hamath and Arpad are dismayed, for they have heard bad news. They are disheartened, troubled like the restless sea.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba igoro y’Abaedomu: “Inee! Obong’aini mbwaerire korwa Temani? Ogosemia ngwasirire korwa ase abanyasemi? Obong’aini bwabo mbwasirire kegima?
english: Concerning Edom: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom decayed?

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rigakwanwa igoro ya Misiri, na igoro y’abarwani b’esegi ba Farao Neko, omoruoti o Misiri, abarenge ang’e norooche rw’Eufarati agwo Karikemisi, abwo Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, abuete ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kwa Yehoyakimu mosinto o Yosia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda:
english: Concerning Egypt: This is the message against the army of Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt, which was defeated at Carchemish on the Euphrates River by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro ya Kedari, na igoro y’amaruoti a Hasori, ayio Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, abuete: “Imoka, mogende Kedari! Mosirie abanto ba moocha.
english: Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked: This is what the LORD says: "Arise, and attack Kedar and destroy the people of the East.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba igoro y’Abamoabu: “Obobe nobwa Nebo, ekiagera osarigwe! Kiriataimu onyorire obosooku, ekiagera obwatirwe, chindwaki chiaye chiatagoirwe na obosooku bwachire,
english: Concerning Moab: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Woe to Nebo, for it will be ruined. Kiriathaim will be disgraced and captured; the stronghold will be disgraced and shattered.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’Abaamoni: “Inee! Abaisraeli tibabwati abana? Tibabwati abakoira omwando? Nase ki enyasae Milikomu yairire omwando o Gadi, na abanto baye bamenyete ase emechie ya Gadi?
english: Concerning the Ammonites: This is what the LORD says: "Has Israel no sons? Has she no heirs? Why then has Molech taken possession of Gad? Why do his people live in its towns?

ekegusii: Bono baminto, ase amang’ana ’ogocha kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, na ogosangererekana gwaito ase obosio bwaye, twababoririe,
english: Concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our being gathered to him, we ask you, brothers,

ekegusii: Amang’ana igoro y’ababani: Enkoro yane yairianyekire ime yane, amauga aane onsi atengechire; nabeire buna omonto otindire ase okonywa, na buna oyo edivai yabuire, ase engencho y’Omonene na ase amang’ana aye amachenu.
english: Concerning the prophets: My heart is broken within me; all my bones tremble. I am like a drunken man, like a man overcome by wine, because of the LORD and his holy words.

ekegusii: Igoro ase amang’ana ’ogotooreka okwo ababani, baria babanete obuya obo borache kobachera, bakariga‐rigia na kouna‐unia.
english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets, who spoke of the grace that was to come to you, searched intently and with the greatest care,

ekegusii: Ebisengi tibibwati chinguru, korende nigo bikoroisia ase bikomenya ase ebitare ime.
english: coneys are creatures of little power, yet they make their home in the crags;

ekegusii: Barabwo bakabatiswa nere ase orooche rwa Yorodan, bakoorokia ebibe biabo.
english: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.

ekegusii: Igo nakorikeire aya, ekiagera inde nobomaene ng’a nomoigweri ore, naende imanyete ng’a nokore goetania ayio nagotebirie.
english: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even more than I ask.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, saria emeroberio y’abanto abwo, otantanie chimeme chiabo tibaigwana. Narorire obotindi na amariomana bire agwo ase omochie,
english: Confuse the wicked, O Lord, confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.

ekegusii: Mwatanane omwaka oyio bw’emerongo etano, moyochene. Morarie obosibore ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense yaino. Omwaka oyio nobe omwaka bw’Omochengo asemore. Kera omonto ore asemore airanigwe ase omwando oye, na kera oyomo ase eamate yaye.
english: Consecrate the fiftieth year and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee for you; each one of you is to return to his family property and each to his own clan.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, okwegena nigo kogocha ase enchera y’okoigwa, na aya tokoigwa nigo agocha korwa ase ring’ana ria Kristo.
english: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word of Christ.

ekegusii: Naboigo oyotari koigwera oyore nokobua, nigo akoamererania naya Nyasae achikire; na barabwo abakoamererania nabenyorere ekina.
english: Consequently, he who rebels against the authority is rebelling against what God has instituted, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.

ekegusii: Naboigo, buna ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo abanto bonsi bakanacherwa ekina, ee, naboigo ase ogokora kw’oboronge kw’omonto oyoma, abanto bonsi bakaegwa oboronge na obogima.
english: Consequently, just as the result of one trespass was condemnation for all men, so also the result of one act of righteousness was justification that brings life for all men.

ekegusii: Gaki korwa bono inwe timori abamenyi gose abaeti, korende mwabeire ababiare amo nabachenu, abanto b’enyomba ya Nyasae,
english: Consequently, you are no longer foreigners and aliens, but fellow citizens with God's people and members of God's household,

ekegusii: Nabo “Ibrahimu nigo amwegenete Nyasae, na ase engencho eyio akabarwa koba omonyene oboronge.”
english: Consider Abraham: "He believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness."

ekegusii: Naama! Ense y’Abaasuri nigo yarenge buna omocharake o Lebanoni, obwate chinsagia chingiya chire nekiriri ekiya. Nigo okinete gochia igoro, ogaetania chinsagia chi’emete ende.
english: Consider Assyria, once a cedar in Lebanon, with beautiful branches overshadowing the forest; it towered on high, its top above the thick foliage.

ekegusii: Gaki, morengererie mono ere oyoremereretie oboengereria buna obwo bokorwa ase abanyene ebibe igoro yaye ere omonyene, timocha kwebutokania na gokwa emioyo yaino.
english: Consider him who endured such opposition from sinful men, so that you will not grow weary and lose heart.

ekegusii: Abaminto, bara ng’a nomogoko bwoka komorasoe ase amateemwa are ao ao,
english: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, whenever you face trials of many kinds,

ekegusii: Bono bwerende, ekiagera Omonene ogochorire oagache enyomba ebe Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu. Obe omokong’u na okore ayio.”
english: Consider now, for the LORD has chosen you to build a temple as a sanctuary. Be strong and do the work."

ekegusii: Rigereria omonto omoikeranu, ee, origererie omonto ore nenkoro endonge, norore ng’a omonto ogokora omorembe nere orachie kare.
english: Consider the blameless, observe the upright; there is a future for the man of peace.

ekegusii: Rigereria chingencho chi’Abaisraeli; abwo bakoria ebing’wanso ebio, Inee, tibari kobwatana negesasimero?
english: Consider the people of Israel: Do not those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

ekegusii: Rigereria ebigonkoru, tibiri gosimeka, tibiri kogesa, tibiri nemonga gose ekiage, korende Nyasae nigo akobirageria. Na inwe imobuete rigori rie chinyoni!
english: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storeroom or barn; yet God feeds them. And how much more valuable you are than birds!

ekegusii: Inyora obuya na obotindi bwa Nyasae, obotindi ase baria bagure; korende asore obuya bwa Nyasae, korabeere ase obuya bwaye. Onye taibo, naye boigo nonachwe korwa aroro.
english: Consider therefore the kindness and sternness of God: sternness to those who fell, but kindness to you, provided that you continue in his kindness. Otherwise, you also will be cut off.

ekegusii: Rigereria chindwaki chiaye, eta motaare ime ase chiburi chiaye; erio nario morache gotebia ebigori bigochi‐gocha:
english: consider well her ramparts, view her citadels, that you may tell of them to the next generation.

ekegusii: Rengereria emeremo ya Nyasae! Ning’o oranyare korongeyia egento Omonene akorire borogochi?
english: Consider what God has done: Who can straighten what he has made crooked?

ekegusii: Ase ayio, obasirie nendamwamu yao; basirie kegima, onde tanyorekana ore moyo nonya noyomo, erio abanto b’ense yonsi mbamanye ng’a Nyasae nere okogambera abanto ba Yakobo.
english: consume them in wrath, consume them till they are no more. Then it will be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah

ekegusii: naende rogenderere gochia Sifuroni, na korwa aroro roike Hasari‐Enani. Oro narwo orobebe rwaino rwa sugusu.
english: continue to Ziphron and end at Hazar Enan. This will be your boundary on the north.

ekegusii: Genderera koorokia obwanchani bwao obonene ase abwo bakomanyete, na oboronge bwao ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
english: Continue your love to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

ekegusii: Ekiagera inde nobomaene ase aya, namanyire ng’a nintigare na kogenderera amo nainwe mwensi, na inwe momenteke na kogoka ase okwegena,
english: Convinced of this, I know that I will remain, and I will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,

ekegusii: Amakorongote na ebirore bichenire tibigwatorwa. Rigori ri’obong’aini nigo rire rinene kobua eri’amagena e rigori rinene rikomeka‐meka.
english: Coral and jasper are not worthy of mention; the price of wisdom is beyond rubies.

ekegusii: Kornelio akamoiraneria, “Rero nerituko ria kane, korwa ekero narenge gosaba nyomba mwane chinsa buna echi, chinsa kianda. Ani! Omonto nateneine bosio bwane obekeire chianga chikomeka‐meka.
english: Cornelius answered: "Four days ago I was in my house praying at this hour, at three in the afternoon. Suddenly a man in shining clothes stood before me

ekegusii: Akamorigereria mono, akairoka, akamoboria, “Naki Omonene?” Akamoiraneria, “Ogosaba kwao na ebiegwa biao biaikire igoro, na biabeire ekeinyorio ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: Cornelius stared at him in fear. "What is it, Lord?" he asked. The angel answered, "Your prayers and gifts to the poor have come up as a memorial offering before God.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ondongeyie ase okong’a egesusuro, korende ase ekerengo kegwenerete gioka, gose tonkora bo ekero ore nendamwamu, ekiagera nigo orabaise gonsiria.
english: Correct me, LORD, but only with justice-- not in your anger, lest you reduce me to nothing.

ekegusii: Inche nigo nkorua ogosemia na obong’aini bw’ekeene; nigo inde nokomanya na okobua.
english: Counsel and sound judgment are mine; I have understanding and power.

ekegusii: Orike abasacha bonsi abare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na emerongo etano, abwo bonsi baranyare gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: abwo bare egati y’emiaka emerongo etato na emerongo etano, abwo bonsi baranyare gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Count all the men from thirty to fifty years of age who come to serve in the work in the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Rituko ri’emerongo etano, nario rituko nyuma y’Esabato ya gatano na kabere, erio morentere Omonene okoruegwa konde kw’endagera enyia.
english: Count off fifty days up to the day after the seventh Sabbath, and then present an offering of new grain to the LORD.

ekegusii: “Mobare chichuma isano na ibere, mochake korwa engaki eria mogochaka rigesa ase emegondo yaino.
english: Count off seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo barigetwe ase chiamate chiabo nigo barenge chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano (2,750).
english: counted by clans, were 2,750.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo barenge abanto chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etato (2,630).
english: counted by their clans and families, were 2,630.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo barenge abanto chilifu isato, na amagana abere (3,200).
english: counted by their clans, were 3,200.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kora amasio abo abe nobosooku obonene, erinde babe bakorigia erieta riao.
english: Cover their faces with shame so that men will seek your name, O LORD.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ontongere enkoro endabu, okore omoika ore ime yane obe omoyia na oyokong’ie.
english: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

ekegusii: Nimbeke ase ebikoba biabo okwama okuya, bikwane omorembe ase abwo bare aare na abare ang’e, na inche nimbagwenie.” Nabo Omonene agoteba.
english: creating praise on the lips of the mourners in Israel. Peace, peace, to those far and near," says the LORD. "And I will heal them."
