ekegusii: Krispo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, akamwegena Omonene amo nab’enyomba yaye bonsi; na Abakorinto abange kobachia koigwa Paulo, bakeegena, bakabatiswa.
english: Crispus, the synagogue ruler, and his entire household believed in the Lord; and many of the Corinthians who heard him believed and were baptized.

ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase egesinka, amboka, mogende Tarisisi, morere!
english: Cross over to Tarshish; wail, you people of the island.

ekegusii: Amboka gochia ase ebisinka bi’Abakuporo, morore, gose motome abanto gochia Kedari bauna‐unie buya, barore gose egento buna ekio kiana gokorekana aroro.
english: Cross over to the coasts of Kittim and look, send to Kedar and observe closely; see if there has ever been anything like this:

ekegusii: naende roonchoke gochia irianyi y’Egetunwa ki’Ebiuge roetere Sini, irianyi ya Kadeshi‐Barinea. Korwa agwo rogenderere roike Hasari‐Adari, naende roete roike Asimoni,
english: cross south of Scorpion Pass, continue on to Zin and go south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it will go to Hazar Addar and over to Azmon,

ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia irianyi y’Egetunwa ki’Ebiuge, na goetera Sini gochia irianyi ya Kadeshi‐Barinea, naende rogaeta Hezironi, rogatiira gochia Adari, rokaonchoka rogaika Karika,
english: crossed south of Scorpion Pass, continued on to Zin and went over to the south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it ran past Hezron up to Addar and curved around to Karka.

ekegusii: Nonya nabanto korwa ase emechie eria yaetanaine Yerusalemu bagesangereria, bakarenta abarwaire amo nabwo babwatire nebirecha bi’eubi, na bonsi bakagwenigwa.
english: Crowds gathered also from the towns around Jerusalem, bringing their sick and those tormented by evil spirits, and all of them were healed.

ekegusii: Oyesamunyorane, erio oumore amaguta igoro ase ebisamunye biria. Okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera.
english: Crumble it and pour oil on it; it is a grain offering.

ekegusii: Aye mwanyabanto, rera na goichana! Omoyio oyio orentirwe oite abanto baane, oite na abagambi b’Abaisraeli. Barabwo barurwe baitwe nomoyio amo nabanto baane. Ase ayio aka amariagati ao.
english: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it is against my people; it is against all the princes of Israel. They are thrown to the sword along with my people. Therefore beat your breast.

ekegusii: Kwana: Aye Nyasae, ogotooreka gwaito, totoorie, otosangererie amo, na otoboorie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, erinde totogie erieta riao richenu, na twetogerie ogotogigwa kwao.
english: Cry out, "Save us, O God our Savior; gather us and deliver us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name, that we may glory in your praise."

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Galimu, rera neriogi rinene! Inwe aba Laisa, tegerera moigwe! Obee! Inwe ab’Anatoti abaremerwa!
english: Cry out, O Daughter of Gallim! Listen, O Laishah! Poor Anathoth!

ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene nigo agoteba, “Ragereria Merosi, ragereria abanto bamenyeteo, ekiagera tibachete gokonya Omonene, komokonya korwania abare ne chinguru.”
english: 'Curse Meroz,' said the angel of the LORD. 'Curse its people bitterly, because they did not come to help the LORD, to help the LORD against the mighty.'

ekegusii: Riragererigwe rituko erio naiboretwe, rituko riria baba anyiborete ribe ritari nogosesenigwa.
english: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother bore me not be blessed!

ekegusii: Aragererigwe omonto oria orentete amang’ana ase tata, akamotebia, “Kwaiboreirwe omwana omoisia”, na nigo akamogokia mono.
english: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, who made him very glad, saying, "A child is born to you-- a son!"

ekegusii: Endamwamu yabo eragererigwe, ekiagera nigo yarenge entindi, na ekeririanda kiabo, ekiagera tikiarenge namabera. Nimbaatanane ase abana ba Yakobo, nimbasiarere ase abana ba Israeli.
english: Cursed be their anger, so fierce, and their fury, so cruel! I will scatter them in Jacob and disperse them in Israel.

ekegusii: Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bibe ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, bisiirwe ne chisiiro isato ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.
english: Curtains fifteen cubits long are to be on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

ekegusii: Ase ensemo eyemo y’egesoero bakaroisia ebitambaa bi’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi na atano, ne chisiiro isato amo ne chinterekerero chiabo isato.
english: Curtains fifteen cubits long were on one side of the entrance, with three posts and three bases,

ekegusii: Abaetiopia na Abamisiri batarenge korengeka nabwo barenge chinguru chiaye; Abaputi na Abalibia nabwo barenge koyokonya.
english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength; Put and Libya were among her allies.

ekegusii: “Abanto ba Etiopia, na aba Libia, na aba Ludi, na abanto bonsi bagasang’anana amo, na aba Kubu, na abanto b’ense y’okobwatana; abwo bonsi mbaitwe nemioro, bakwe amo n’Abamisiri.
english: Cush and Put, Lydia and all Arabia, Libya and the people of the covenant land will fall by the sword along with Egypt.

ekegusii: Kusi akaibora Nimurodi. Nimurodi akaba omonto bwe ritang’ani ore nokobua ase ense.
english: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who grew to be a mighty warrior on earth.

ekegusii: Kusi akaibora Nimurodi. Nimurodi akaba omonto bwe ritang’ani ore nokobua ase ense.
english: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who grew to be a mighty warrior on the earth.

ekegusii: Siria kegima korwa Babeli omobusuri na oyokoimokia omoyio bwe rigesa, ekero engaki eyio yaikire. Ase engencho y’obwoba bw’omochandi, kera omomenyi nairane ase abanto baye, kera oyomo natame gochia ase ense yaye omonyene.
english: Cut off from Babylon the sower, and the reaper with his sickle at harvest. Because of the sword of the oppressor let everyone return to his own people, let everyone flee to his own land.

ekegusii: “Kigita chitukia chiaino, mochitugute, aka eriogi ri’okweng’ereria agwo ase ebigoro bire bosa, ekiagera Omonene bwangire na otigire abanto b’ekegori eke, kiagerire ere abeire nendamwamu.
english: Cut off your hair and throw it away; take up a lament on the barren heights, for the LORD has rejected and abandoned this generation that is under his wrath.

ekegusii: Onache chinyama chi’emingichi eria chibe ebing’ese; osibie chinyama chi’enda eria amo nebirenge, na obibeke igoro y’ebing’ese biria na omotwe oye.
english: Cut the ram into pieces and wash the inner parts and the legs, putting them with the head and the other pieces.

ekegusii: Bakaruta ebirochi biria, bakabitiga nyancha ime, bakarorobia chingori chi’ebionchori, bagatiiria egetambaa kia bosio embeo ekeguserere, bakaonchora emeeri gochia engegu.
english: Cutting loose the anchors, they left them in the sea and at the same time untied the ropes that held the rudders. Then they hoisted the foresail to the wind and made for the beach.

ekegusii: Ebikorero ebio Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, akabia Mitiredati, omoteneneri bwe chikungo. Mitiredati akabibara, akabia Sesibasari, omogambi bw’Abayuda.
english: Cyrus king of Persia had them brought by Mithredath the treasurer, who counted them out to Sheshbazzar the prince of Judah.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Damesiki babeire aboro tibari na nguru; beonchoire gotama, ekiagera obwoba bwabasoire. Basoirwe nomoichano na ogochandeka buna omokungu okobina ase okoibora.
english: Damascus has become feeble, she has turned to flee and panic has gripped her; anguish and pain have seized her, pain like that of a woman in labor.

ekegusii: Dani na Nafutali, Gadi na Aseri.
english: Dan and Naphtali; Gad and Asher.

ekegusii: Dani nabe eng’iti ekweriba inchera, ring’ere ase oboeto, rikoroma egetingiro ki’ebarasi, goika oyoyeriinete agwe masogota.
english: Dan will be a serpent by the roadside, a viper along the path, that bites the horse's heels so that its rider tumbles backward.

ekegusii: Dani na Yusufu, Benjamin na Nafutali, Gadi na Aseri.
english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.

ekegusii: Erio Danieli akairaneria omoruoti, “Aye omoruoti, ochie kare!
english: Daniel answered, "O king, live forever!

ekegusii: Danieli akairaneria omoruoti, akamotebia, “Onde tari ase abanto abang’aini, gose abaragori, gose abaringoria, gose abanto bamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni oranyare koorokia obobisi obo aye omoruoti kwaboririe,
english: Daniel replied, "No wise man, enchanter, magician or diviner can explain to the king the mystery he has asked about,

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana Danieli atebete: “Ase okorora kwane kwa botuko nkarora chimbeo inye chia igoro chigocha ne chinguru, chigaturubania enyancha enene.
english: Daniel said: "In my vision at night I looked, and there before me were the four winds of heaven churning up the great sea.

ekegusii: Erio Danieli agakwana nomorendi oria obegetwe nomoteneneri oria omonene bw’abasomba b’omoruoti ng’a arende Danieli, na Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria, akamotebia,
english: Daniel then said to the guard whom the chief official had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah,

ekegusii: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
english: Danieli, na Ginetoni, na Baruku;

ekegusii: Dannah, Kiriath Sannah (that is, Debir),
english: na Dana, na Kiriati‐Sana (noro Debiri),

ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, inche nigo inde omomwamu ti, nonya naboigo nigo inde oyo bw’okogokia. Nigo inga buna chiema chia Kedari, naende buna ebitambaa bi’ogosungwa bia Sulemani.
english: Dark am I, yet lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem, dark like the tents of Kedar, like the tent curtains of Solomon.

ekegusii: Omosunte notube Tehafenehesi ekero ndabune rikorogoto ria Misiri, ne chinguru chi’obonene bwaye nchiere. Riire nditube Misiri, na abanto b’emechie yaye bairwe ase obosomba.
english: Dark will be the day at Tahpanhes when I break the yoke of Egypt; there her proud strength will come to an end. She will be covered with clouds, and her villages will go into captivity.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakobwatwa nomosunte mobaso gati, bataba‐taba mobaso gati buna nobotuko bore.
english: Darkness comes upon them in the daytime; at noon they grope as in the night.

ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora, nkobatiania ase chingabi ne chinsune chi’orosana ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani, gose koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene.
english: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you by the gazelles and by the does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.

ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora, nkobatiania ase chingabi na ase chinsune chi’orosana ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwa’nchani gose koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene.
english: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you by the gazelles and by the does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.

ekegusii: Inwe abakungu ba Yerusalemu, nigo nkobasorora na kobatiania ng’a timobaisa gotabobora obwanchani na koboichania, goika bobe bwancheranire obonyene.
english: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.

ekegusii: Abaiseke b’abaruoti nigo bare amo nabwo bakogokorera ase amasikani; eting’ana bwechaberete netahabu ekorwa Ofiri, nigo ateneine ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio.
english: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand is the royal bride in gold of Ophir.

ekegusii: Naende Daudi agasangereria abanto bonsi abachoretwe korwa ase Abaisraeli, chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).
english: David again brought together out of Israel chosen men, thirty thousand in all.

ekegusii: Naende akabua Abamoabu, na barabwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakorenta ebango asare.
english: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to him and brought tribute.

ekegusii: Naende akabua Abamoabu. Akabachika barare inse ase chindwaro. Erio akarenga chindwaro ibere chi’abanto, agachika abwo baitwe bakwe, na abanto b’orwaro oromo agachika batigwe babe moyo. Bono Abamoabu bakaba abasomba ba Daudi bakaba bakomo rentera ebango.
english: David also defeated the Moabites. He made them lie down on the ground and measured them off with a length of cord. Every two lengths of them were put to death, and the third length was allowed to live. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought tribute.

ekegusii: Naende Daudi agatebia Sulemani, omwana oye, “Obe omokong’u, naende omoremu, erio okore ayio. Toiroka, gose tokwa moyo, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae, oyore Nyasae one, nigo are amo naye. Omonene takogotiga obugwe, goika emeremo yonsi y’enyomba yaye eere.
english: David also said to Solomon his son, "Be strong and courageous, and do the work. Do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God, my God, is with you. He will not fail you or forsake you until all the work for the service of the temple of the LORD is finished.

ekegusii: Boigo akairana abanto baye bonsi amo ne chiamate chiabo komenya ase emechie ya Heburoni.
english: David also took the men who were with him, each with his family, and they settled in Hebron and its towns.

ekegusii: Daudi amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakagenda Yerusalemu, noro Yebusi, ase Abayebusi, abanto b’ense eria, barenge.
english: David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus). The Jebusites who lived there

ekegusii: Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bagochenga ase obosio bwa Nyasae ne chinguru chiabo chionsi, bagotera na kobugia amakano ’ebirigisa, na amakano ande, na ebikonu, ne chisani chigoakanigwa na kwoga, na ebirombeta.
english: David and all the Israelites were celebrating with all their might before God, with songs and with harps, lyres, tambourines, cymbals and trumpets.

ekegusii: Daudi amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakagenda Baala (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), orenge bw’Abayuda, korenta korwa aroro Esanduku ya Nyasae, eyio ekorokwa ase erieta ri’Omonene, oyio omenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’abakerubi.
english: David and all the Israelites with him went to Baalah of Judah (Kiriath Jearim) to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, who is enthroned between the cherubim-- the ark that is called by the Name.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato Daudi na abanto baye bagaika Sikilagi. Abaameleki konya bachakire esegi agwo Negebu na Sikilagi. Na bono konya babuire Sikilagi na koyosamba nomorero,
english: David and his men reached Ziklag on the third day. Now the Amalekites had raided the Negev and Ziklag. They had attacked Ziklag and burned it,

ekegusii: Daudi amo nabanto baye bakamenya amo n’Akisi agwo Gati. Kera omonto nigo amenyete amo nabanto b’eamate yaye, na Daudi amo nabakungu baye babere, Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli, na Abigaeli korwa Karimeli, oyio Nabali atigete ore omoboraka.
english: David and his men settled in Gath with Achish. Each man had his family with him, and David had his two wives: Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail of Carmel, the widow of Nabal.

ekegusii: Daudi akaimoka, akagenda nabanto baye, agaita Abafilisti amagana abere, akabutora amasankwa abo a isiko ay’ebiimo bi’obosacha, akayarenta onsi ase omoruoti, erinde omoruoti abe ise biara. Erio Saulo akaa Daudi Mikali, akaba mokaye.
english: David and his men went out and killed two hundred Philistines. He brought their foreskins and presented the full number to the king so that he might become the king's son-in-law. Then Saul gave him his daughter Michal in marriage.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi amo nabanto baye amagana atano na rimo bakagenda, bagaika ase akarooche ka Besori. Agwo abanto bande bagatigara nyuma.
english: David and the six hundred men with him came to the Besor Ravine, where some stayed behind,

ekegusii: Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bagochenga na gotera ase ogotogia Omonene; bakabugia amakano, na ebibangarara, ne chindege, na ebinto binde bi’ogochengera.
english: David and the whole house of Israel were celebrating with all their might before the LORD, with songs and with harps, lyres, tambourines, sistrums and cymbals.

ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Ahimeleki omokuani, “Omoruoti onchikire gokora omoremo gete; ere nigo antebia ng’a timbaisa gotebia monto onde, erinde amanye igoro y’omoremo oyio antomire na gonchika ng’a nkore. Naende onchikire ng’a ng’umerane nabasomba baane aase gete.
english: David answered Ahimelech the priest, "The king charged me with a certain matter and said to me, 'No one is to know anything about your mission and your instructions.' As for my men, I have told them to meet me at a certain place.

ekegusii: Korende Daudi akairaneria Rekabu na Baana omwabo, abarenge basinto ba Rimoni Omobeeroti, akabora, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oyo ontooretie korwa ase emechando emenge,
english: David answered Recab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, "As surely as the LORD lives, who has delivered me out of all trouble,

ekegusii: Daudi akaboria Ahimeleki, “Nobwate aa ritimo gose omoro? Inche tinarentanete omoro one, gose ebirwanero binde bionsi, ekiagera omoremo oyio omoruoti anchigete gokora nigo oganetie okorwe ase obwango.”
english: David asked Ahimelech, "Don't you have a spear or a sword here? I haven't brought my sword or any other weapon, because the king's business was urgent."

ekegusii: Daudi akamoboria, “Inee! Nonyare kong’ira na konyorokia aase abauri abwo bare?” Omomura oria akairaneria, “Tiana ase Nyasae ng’a tokong’ita, gose tokombeka ase okoboko kw’omonene one; rirorio ninkoire nkwoorokie aase omoganda oria ore.”
english: David asked him, "Can you lead me down to this raiding party?" He answered, "Swear to me before God that you will not kill me or hand me over to my master, and I will take you down to them."

ekegusii: Daudi akamoboria, “Noyo ng’o ore? Seino ng’ai?” Omosae oria akairaneria, “Inche nigo inde omomura bw’Abamisiri na omosomba bw’omonto oyomo Omoameleki. Bono amatuko atato aerire korwa ekero omonene one antigete, ekiagera nabete omorwaire.
english: David asked him, "To whom do you belong, and where do you come from?" He said, "I am an Egyptian, the slave of an Amalekite. My master abandoned me when I became ill three days ago.

ekegusii: Daudi akamoboria, “Naki yabete otairogete korambora okoboko kwao ase ogoita omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene?”
english: David asked him, "Why were you not afraid to lift your hand to destroy the LORD's anointed?"

ekegusii: Daudi akaboria Abagibeoni, “Ninki nkobakorera? Nindigetie gokora okobwatanigwa ase engencho y’obobe mwakoreretwe, erinde mosesenie abanto b’Omonene.”
english: David asked the Gibeonites, "What shall I do for you? How shall I make amends so that you will bless the LORD's inheritance?"

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agakwana nabanto bateneine ang’e nere, akababoria, “Inee! Omonto oraite Omofilisti oria, na koruseria Abaisraeli ogochaywa okwo, inki araegwe? Omofilisti oyo otarogeti, ninki aisaine goika are noboremu gochaya emeganda y’esegi ya Nyasae ore moyo?”
english: David asked the men standing near him, "What will be done for the man who kills this Philistine and removes this disgrace from Israel? Who is this uncircumcised Philistine that he should defy the armies of the living God?"

ekegusii: Rituko erimo Daudi akaboria, “Inee! Monto onde natigarete ase enka ya Saulo inyare komokorera amaya ase engencho ya Yonathani?”
english: David asked, "Is there anyone still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show kindness for Jonathan's sake?"

ekegusii: Daudi akamoboria, “Iso karakoiranerie amang’ana amakong’u, Inee, ning’o orache gontebia ayio?”
english: David asked, "Who will tell me if your father answers you harshly?"

ekegusii: Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Yerusalemu gochia korenta Esanduku eria y’Omonene gocha aase aye ayeroiseretie.
english: David assembled all Israel in Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.

ekegusii: Daudi akarenta amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, momura o Saulo; boigo agasangereria amauga ’abanto baria batano na babere konya batongirwe.
english: David brought the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from there, and the bones of those who had been killed and exposed were gathered up.

ekegusii: Daudi akaagachera Omonene egesasimero aroro, akarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’omorembe, agasaba Omonene, nere akamoiraneria ase ogotoma omorero korwa igoro gocha ase egesasimero keria gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
english: David built an altar to the LORD there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. He called on the LORD, and the LORD answered him with fire from heaven on the altar of burnt offering.

ekegusii: Na Daudi akaagachera Omonene egesasimero, akarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na eki’omorembe. Ase ayio Omonene akaigwa ogosaba gw’ense eria, na amarwaire agatangwa korwa ase Abaisraeli.
english: David built an altar to the LORD there and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then the LORD answered prayer in behalf of the land, and the plague on Israel was stopped.

ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaba nendamwamu enene ase engencho y’omonda oria, agatebia Nathani, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, omonto oyio okorete amang’ana ayio goika akwe.
english: David burned with anger against the man and said to Nathan, "As surely as the LORD lives, the man who did this deserves to die!

ekegusii: “Daudi nigo akomoroka Omonene, naki rende aba omwana oye?”
english: David calls him 'Lord.' How then can he be his son?"

ekegusii: David came to Saul and entered his service. Saul liked him very much, and David became one of his armor-bearers.
english: Daudi agacha o Saulo, agachaka komokorera. Saulo akaba omwanchete mono, goika Daudi akaba okomobogoreria ebirwanero.

ekegusii: Daudi agoosa abariini chibarasi elifu eyemo, na amagana atano na abere (1,700), na abarwani abaare kogendera amagoro chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000). Erio akabutora chibarasi chinteng’e, korende agatiga chibarasi rigana erimo chibe chikong’usa chigari.
english: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.

ekegusii: Daudi agoosa chigari elifu eyemo (1,000), na abariini chibarasi chilifu isano na ibere (7,000), na abarwani abaare kogenda namagoro chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000). Erio akabutora chibarasi chionsi chinteng’e otatiga chibarasi rigana erimo chikaba chikong’usa chigari.
english: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand charioteers and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He hamstrung all but a hundred of the chariot horses.

ekegusii: Daudi akaba ogosemania nabanene bonsi abarenge abatang’ani b’abarwani elifu eyemo na abe rigana erimo.
english: David conferred with each of his officers, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.

ekegusii: Daudi tabarete na korika abanto konya bataraika emiaka emerongo ebere, ekiagera Omonene nariete eira ng’a namente Abaisraeli babe abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro.
english: David did not take the number of the men twenty years old or less, because the LORD had promised to make Israel as numerous as the stars in the sky.

ekegusii: Daudi agaatanana Abalawi ase ebiombe kobwatekana nabamura ba Lawi: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.
english: David divided the Levites into groups corresponding to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

ekegusii: Daudi akeboerania ebirwanero ebio amo nomoyio o birende, agateema kogenda, ekiagera konya taranara kweboerania ebinto buna ebio. Erio agatebia Saulo, “Tinkonyara gotaara nyeboeranetie ebinto ebio, ekiagera timbinareti.” Akabirusia na kobitiga.
english: David fastened on his sword over the tunic and tried walking around, because he was not used to them. "I cannot go in these," he said to Saul, "because I am not used to them." So he took them off.

ekegusii: Daudi akabarwania korwa mogoroba kobokomura‐mura goika mogoroba rituko ria kabere. Agaita abanto bonsi otatiga abamura amagana ane abariinete chingamia batamete.
english: David fought them from dusk until the evening of the next day, and none of them got away, except four hundred young men who rode off on camels and fled.

ekegusii: Daudi konya onyuomire Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli; ase igo abwo babere bakaba abakungu baye.
english: David had also married Ahinoam of Jezreel, and they both were his wives.

ekegusii: Daudi konya otebire ng’a, “Amaene, mbosa narenge korenda enibo y’omonto oyo aiga ase erooro. Ende tiyasira nonya neyemo ase chinibo chiaye chionsi. Na bono ong’akanire amabe ase amaya.
english: David had just said, "It's been useless-- all my watching over this fellow's property in the desert so that nothing of his was missing. He has paid me back evil for good.

ekegusii: Daudi konya otebire, “Omonto onde bwensi orabe oyo bwe ritang’ani goita abanto ba Yebusi, ere oyio nabe omochiki omonene bw’abarwani.” Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, akaba oyo bwe ritang’ani kogenda aroro; ase ayio ere akaba omochiki.
english: David had said, "Whoever leads the attack on the Jebusites will become commander-in-chief." Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and so he received the command.

ekegusii: Daudi omonyene nigo akomoroka Omonene; naki rende aba omwana oye?” Na omoganda oria omonene nigo orenge komoigwa ase omogoko.
english: David himself calls him 'Lord.' How then can he be his son?" The large crowd listened to him with delight.

ekegusii: Naki Daudi nigo agoteba ase ebuku ya Zaburi, “Omonene agatebia Omonene one, Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio,
english: David himself declares in the Book of Psalms: "'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand

ekegusii: Daudi omonyene nigo atebete, buna arenge koraagwa n’Omoika Omochenu: “Omonene agatebia Omonene one: Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.
english: David himself, speaking by the Holy Spirit, declared: "'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet."'

ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agatiga Asafu na abanto bamwabo agwo bosio bw’Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene babe abakoreri asare botambe, buna okogania gwa kera rituko kwarenge.
english: David left Asaph and his associates before the ark of the covenant of the LORD to minister there regularly, according to each day's requirements.

ekegusii: Daudi akarua agwo, agatama gochia ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu. Ekero abamwabo, na eamate yaye bonsi, baigwete ayio, bakagenda agwo ase arenge.
english: David left Gath and escaped to the cave of Adullam. When his brothers and his father's household heard about it, they went down to him there.

ekegusii: Daudi agatiga endagera eyio ase omorendi bw’ebinto bi’esegi, akaminyoka gochia ase abarwani. Gaikireo agakwania abamwabo.
english: David left his things with the keeper of supplies, ran to the battle lines and greeted his brothers.

ekegusii: Daudi akabeka Zadoki omokuani amo nabakuani bande bamwabo, babe bagokorera Omonene ase Eema yaye agwo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa aaria Gibeoni.
english: David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place in Gibeon

ekegusii: Daudi akagenderera komenya ase ense y’Abafilisti ase engaki y’omwaka oyomo na emetienyi ene.
english: David lived in Philistine territory a year and four months.

ekegusii: Daudi akaba okogania amache anywe, akabora, “Ntare konyora omonto andetere amache inywe korwa ase ensoko eyio ere ase egeita kia Bethlehemu!”
english: David longed for water and said, "Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!"

ekegusii: Daudi akabora ase okogania okonene, “Ntare konyora omonto andetere amache inywe korwa ase ensoko eyio ere ase egeita kia Bethlehemu?”
english: David longed for water and said, "Oh, that someone would get me a drink of water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem!"

ekegusii: Daudi akarigereria akarora omomalaika oria bw’Omonene oteneine gati y’ense na igoro; ere nabwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye okoramborete gochia igoro ya Yerusalemu, na Daudi na abagaaka babegete chianga chie chigunia, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama.
english: David looked up and saw the angel of the LORD standing between heaven and earth, with a drawn sword in his hand extended over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell facedown.

ekegusii: Korwa ase rituko erio Daudi agakora ring’ana erio rikaba ogochika ase Abaisraeli. Naboigo rire nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: David made this a statute and ordinance for Israel from that day to this.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Daudi akaroberia abanto baye, akabaatanana ase ebiombe bi’elifu elifu, na ebie rigana rigana, akababekera abatang’ani
english: David mustered the men who were with him and appointed over them commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.

ekegusii: Korende Daudi akarora abasomba baye bakona‐komonyererana, akamanya ng’a omwana okure. Ase igo Daudi akababoria, “Inee! Omwana nakure?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee, okure.”
english: David noticed that his servants were whispering among themselves and he realized the child was dead. "Is the child dead?" he asked. "Yes," they replied, "he is dead."

ekegusii: Agwo Daudi agasaba Nyasae ng’a omwana agwene, akeng’ata, akagenda nyomba akarara inse ase obotuko obogima.
english: David pleaded with God for the child. He fasted and went into his house and spent the nights lying on the ground.

ekegusii: Daudi agatogia Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi, akabora, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae o Israeli, sokoro yaito, kware gotogigwa korwa kare na gochia kare na kare!
english: David praised the LORD in the presence of the whole assembly, saying, "Praise be to you, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.

ekegusii: Erio akaminyoka, agatenena ase omobere oye, agasomora omoyio oye korwa ase ekegocho, akamoita kegima ase okomobutora omotwe. Ekero Abafilisti baroche ng’a etuoni yabo yakure, bagatama.
english: David ran and stood over him. He took hold of the Philistine's sword and drew it from the scabbard. After he killed him, he cut off his head with the sword. When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they turned and ran.

ekegusii: Daudi akairania ebinto bionsi, na abanto bonsi, aba Abaameleki konya bairire, amo nabakungu baye babere.
english: David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.

ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaba okogambera Abaisraeli bonsi, akaba ogokorera abanto baye bonsi oboronge na ekeene.
english: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.

ekegusii: Bono Daudi akaba okogambera Abaisraeli bonsi na akaba ogokorera abanto baye bonsi ayare boronge na ekeene.
english: David reigned over all Israel, doing what was just and right for all his people.

ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria omokuani, akamotebia, “Ekeene, twabeire twetangete korwa ase abakungu ase amatuko atato aerire, buna engencho yaito ere botambe, ekero tokogenda gokora emeremo gete; boigo ebikorero bi’abamura aba nigo bire ebichenu botambe, ekero tokogenda ase orogendo. Onye ayio are bo, naki rende rero ebikorero biabo tibiri ebichenu goetania?”
english: David replied, "Indeed women have been kept from us, as usual whenever I set out. The men's things are holy even on missions that are not holy. How much more so today!"

ekegusii: Korende Daudi akabatebia, “Abaminto, timobaisa gokora igo nebinto ebi Omonene atoiraneirie. Ere ototooririe, obekire ase amaboko aito abanto baria abauri abwo batoumokerete.
english: David replied, "No, my brothers, you must not do that with what the LORD has given us. He has protected us and handed over to us the forces that came against us.

ekegusii: Korende Daudi akamotebia, “Ninki inde nainwe, abana b’omokungu Seruya? Nigo moganetie koba mamincha yane. Bono ninche inde omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, na onde tari ase Abaisraeli oraitwe rero.”
english: David replied, "What do you and I have in common, you sons of Zeruiah? This day you have become my adversaries! Should anyone be put to death in Israel today? Do I not know that today I am king over Israel?"

ekegusii: Naki igo Daudi agokwana igoro yaye: “Naroche Omonene ase obosio bwane botambe, ekiagera nigo are ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, erinde tinyoboa.
english: David said about him: "'I saw the Lord always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia Abigaeli, “Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyio ogotoma gwacha koumerana nainche ase rituko ria rero.
english: David said to Abigail, "Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who has sent you today to meet me.

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Abisai, “Bono Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, nigo agochia gotorentera emechando kobua eria Abisalomu atorenterete. Ira abasomba baane momobwatie, erinde tabaisa kwenyorera emechie ye chindwaki na gotokora bobe mono kobua.”
english: David said to Abishai, "Now Sheba son of Bicri will do us more harm than Absalom did. Take your master's men and pursue him, or he will find fortified cities and escape from us."

ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Gadi, “Inche nasoire ase emechando emenene. Gaki bono, tiga ingwe ase okoboko kw’Omonene, ekiagera amabera aye namanene mono; korende ase amaboko a mwanyabanto tintageti ingweo.”
english: David said to Gad, "I am in deep distress. Let me fall into the hands of the LORD, for his mercy is very great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men."

ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Gadi, “Inche nasoire ase emechando emenene. Gaki, bono, tiga togwe ase okoboko kw’Omonene, ekiagera amabera aye namanene; korende ase amaboko a mwanyabanto tintageti ingweo.”
english: David said to Gad, "I am in deep distress. Let us fall into the hands of the LORD, for his mercy is great; but do not let me fall into the hands of men."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia Nyasae, “Inee! Tari inche nachigete abanto bakabarwa? Ninche nakorire ebibe; nakorire amang’ana amabe mono. Korende ching’ondi echi, ninki chiakorire? Nagosabire aye Omonene, Nyasae one, tiga okoboko kwao kong’ake inche amo neamate ya tata; korende oborwaire tibobaisa goita abanto bao.”
english: David said to God, "Was it not I who ordered the fighting men to be counted? I am the one who has sinned and done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? O LORD my God, let your hand fall upon me and my family, but do not let this plague remain on your people."

ekegusii: Daudi akamotebia, “Oise kogenda amo nainche nigo orabe egurube asende.
english: David said to him, "If you go with me, you will be a burden to me.

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Orinani, “Ing’a ensemo eyio y’ekeooreri, ing’agachere Omonene egesasimero, erinde oborwaire botangwe korwa ase abanto. Inche ningoakanere rigori riaye rionsi.”
english: David said to him, "Let me have the site of your threshing floor so I can build an altar to the LORD, that the plague on the people may be stopped. Sell it to me at the full price."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabatebia, “Kera omonto eboeranie omoyio oye o birende.” Na kera oyomo akeboerania omoyio oye, na Daudi nere boigo. Abanto amagana aane bagatiira amo na Daudi, na abanto amagana abere bagatigara nyuma korenda ebinto.
english: David said to his men, "Put on your swords!" So they put on their swords, and David put on his. About four hundred men went up with David, while two hundred stayed with the supplies.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia Itai, “Gaki eta, ogende bosio.” Itai Omogiti agaeta gochia bosio amo nabanto baye bonsi, na abana abake bonsi, abarenge amo nere.
english: David said to Ittai, "Go ahead, march on." So Ittai the Gittite marched on with all his men and the families that were with him.

ekegusii: Daudi akairaneria Mikali, “Nigo narenge gotenga na kogoka ase obosio bw’Omonene, oyo onchorete inche ribaga ria iso, na enyomba yaye yonsi, nkaba omogambi igoro y’Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Ase ayio, goika ngenderere gochenga ase Omonene.
english: David said to Michal, "It was before the LORD, who chose me rather than your father or anyone from his house when he appointed me ruler over the LORD's people Israel-- I will celebrate before the LORD.

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Saulo, “Monto onde takwa omoyo ase okomwoboa Omofilisti oyio. Inche, omosomba oo, ningende komorwania.”
english: David said to Saul, "Let no one lose heart on account of this Philistine; your servant will go and fight him."

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Sulemani, “Omwana one, nigo biarenge ebirengererio biane ng’a ning’agachere erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae one, enyomba.
english: David said to Solomon: "My son, I had it in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God.

ekegusii: Daudi akamoiraneria, “Aye nigo ogonchichera kore nomoro, ne ritimo, na esimisi, korende inche nigo nkogochera ase erieta ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’emeganda y’esegi y’Abaisraeli, oyio gwachayire na komochecheria.
english: David said to the Philistine, "You come against me with sword and spear and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the LORD Almighty, the God of the armies of Israel, whom you have defied.

ekegusii: Daudi akaboria omomura oria omotebia amang’ana ayio, “Aye noyo o arari ore?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Inche nigo inde omwana bw’Omoameleki ore omomenyi aa.”
english: David said to the young man who brought him the report, "Where are you from?" "I am the son of an alien, an Amalekite," he answered.

ekegusii: Daudi nigo arengereretie ng’a Sulemani, omwana oye omoke otaramanya amange, na enyomba egochia koagachwa ase Omonene goika ebe engiya mono, naende eramanyekane ase ense yonsi ng’a nigo ere nobonene; na igo ere bweka goika abeke ebinto bionsi ang’e. Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria ebinto ebinge ekero atarakwa.
english: David said, "My son Solomon is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for the LORD should be of great magnificence and fame and splendor in the sight of all the nations. Therefore I will make preparations for it." So David made extensive preparations before his death.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabora, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, inche, omosomba oo, naigure ng’a Saulo ngocha are aiga Keila gosaria omochie ase engencho yane.
english: David said, "O LORD, God of Israel, your servant has heard definitely that Saul plans to come to Keilah and destroy the town on account of me.

ekegusii: Daudi agateba, “Abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000) ase aba mbabe bagotenenera emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene, na abanto chilifu isano nemo (6,000) nababe abateneneri na abagambi ebina;
english: David said, "Of these, twenty-four thousand are to supervise the work of the temple of the LORD and six thousand are to be officials and judges.

ekegusii: Daudi akamoiraneria, “Ayio mbuya kegima; aye nomanye egento inche, omosomba oo, ndakore.” Akisi agatebia Daudi, “Ningokore obe omorendi bw’obogima bwane kogenderera botambe.”
english: David said, "Then you will see for yourself what your servant can do." Achish replied, "Very well, I will make you my bodyguard for life."

ekegusii: Daudi akaboria Abineri, “Aye tori omonto etuoni? Ning’o ore omoremu buna aye ase egati y’Abaisraeli? Nase ki rende otarendete omonene oo omoruoti? Omonto oyomo nacheteo goita Omonene oo omoruoti.
english: David said, "You're a man, aren't you? And who is like you in Israel? Why didn't you guard your lord the king? Someone came to destroy your lord the king.

ekegusii: Oko nogotera Daudi atererete Omonene, ekero Omonene amotooretie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baye na aya Saulo.
english: David sang to the LORD the words of this song when the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul.

ekegusii: Naboigo Daudi agoteba, ng’a nasesenirie omonto oria ere Nyasae abarire koba noboronge atari nogokora kw’amachiko,
english: David says the same thing when he speaks of the blessedness of the man to whom God credits righteousness apart from works:

ekegusii: Erio agatoma abarwani bagende korwana esegi, bare ebiombe bitato, ekemo inse y’oboraai bwa Yoabu, ne egia kabere inse y’oboraai bw’Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, oyorenge ng’ina Yoabu boigo, na egia gatato inse y’oboraai bwa Itai korwa Gati. Omoruoti agatebia abanto baye, “Nigo nkogenda amo nainwe inche omonyene.”
english: David sent the troops out-- a third under the command of Joab, a third under Joab's brother Abishai son of Zeruiah, and a third under Ittai the Gittite. The king told the troops, "I myself will surely march out with you."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria Tamari korwa nyomba mwabo, akamotebia, “Genda nyomba mw’Amunoni, momura omino, omoroiserie endagera.”
english: David sent word to Tamar at the palace: "Go to the house of your brother Amnon and prepare some food for him."

ekegusii: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel.
english: Bono Daudi, mosinto o Yese, konya ogambeire Abaisraeli bonsi.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akagenderera komenya ase amabwago ’ebitunwa ase erooro ya Sifu; na Saulo akagenderera kona‐komorigia kera rituko, korende Omonene tabegete Daudi ase amaboko aye.
english: David stayed in the desert strongholds and in the hills of the Desert of Ziph. Day after day Saul searched for him, but God did not give David into his hands.

ekegusii: Daudi akarangeria abateneneri bonsi b’Abaisraeli bache Yerusalemu. Ase ayio abateneneri b’ebisaku, na ab’ebiombe biarenge gokorera omoruoti, na abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi chilifu na ab’amagana, na baria batenenerete chinibo chionsi chi’omoruoti ne chiombe chiaye, na echi’abana baye, amo nabateneneri b’enyomba y’omoruoti, na abanto bonsi chituoni, na abwo bonsi barenge abakong’u ase esegi, bagacha aroro.
english: David summoned all the officials of Israel to assemble at Jerusalem: the officers over the tribes, the commanders of the divisions in the service of the king, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of all the property and livestock belonging to the king and his sons, together with the palace officials, the mighty men and all the brave warriors.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaboria Ahimeleki Omohiti, na Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, “Ning’o oranche gotirimboka amo nainche gochia ase Saulo ase egetwori kiaye?” Abisai akamoiraneria, “Ninche ndagende amo naye.”
english: David then asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, "Who will go down into the camp with me to Saul?" "I'll go with you," said Abishai.

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Abisai na abasomba baye bonsi, “Rigereria, omwana one ndusetie ase enda yane, nere okondigia ang’ite. Bono omonto oyo bw’egesaku kia Benjamin, Inee, takondigia goetania? Motige andame. Omonene nere omotebirie ng’a andame.
english: David then said to Abishai and all his officials, "My son, who is of my own flesh, is trying to take my life. How much more, then, this Benjamite! Leave him alone; let him curse, for the LORD has told him to.

ekegusii: Daudi akamenya ase eburi eyio, akayeroka “Omochie o Daudi.” Agwo Daudi akaagacha omochie oyeetanaine, gochakera korwa Milo na goikera ime ase eburi yarenge.
english: David then took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David. He built up the area around it, from the supporting terraces inward.

ekegusii: Daudi akaba okomenya ase eburi eria enkong’u, ase ayio ekarokwa Omochie o Daudi.
english: David then took up residence in the fortress, and so it was called the City of David.

ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Goika inkorere Hanuni, omomura o Nahasi, amaya, ekiagera ise nigo arenge gonkorera amaya.” Ase igo Daudi agatoma abanto bagende komoremia ase engencho y’ogokwa gwa ise. Abasomba abwo ba Daudi bakagenda ase Hanuni agwo ase ense y’Abaamoni komoremia.
english: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David's men came to Hanun in the land of the Ammonites to express sympathy to him,

ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Goika imokorere Hanuni, omomura o Nahasi, amaya, buna ise arenge gonkorera amaya.” Ase igo Daudi agatoma abanto bagende komoremia ase engencho y’ogokwa gwa ise. Ekero abasomba ba Daudi baigete ase ense y’Abaamoni,
english: David thought, "I will show kindness to Hanun son of Nahash, just as his father showed kindness to me." So David sent a delegation to express his sympathy to Hanun concerning his father. When David's men came to the land of the Ammonites,

ekegusii: Boigo Daudi agachika abatang’ani b’Abalawi bachore abanto bamwabo babe abateri, baranyare kobugia ebinto bigoterera ase amariogi, ababugia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa, ne chisani chigoakanigwa na kwoga ase ogotera nomogoko.
english: David told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers to sing joyful songs, accompanied by musical instruments: lyres, harps and cymbals.

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia omotomwa oria, “Genda otebie Yoabu ng’a amang’ana ayio tabaisa komochanda, ekiagera omoro nigo ogoita oyo, oita noyonde. Omotebie ng’a abe ne chinguru, arwanie omochie oyio na koyosaria.”
english: David told the messenger, "Say this to Joab: 'Don't let this upset you; the sword devours one as well as another. Press the attack against the city and destroy it.' Say this to encourage Joab."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarusia egutwa y’etahabu korwa ase omotwe bw’omoruoti bw’aroro, akanyora ng’a oborito bw’egutwa eria nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etato na inye, naende nigo yachabeire amagena e rigori rinene. Egutwa eyio ekabekwa igoro y’omotwe o Daudi. Ere agasakora ebinto ebinge mono bi’omochie oria.
english: David took the crown from the head of their king--its weight was found to be a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones-- and it was placed on David's head. He took a great quantity of plunder from the city

ekegusii: David took the gold shields carried by the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
english: Daudi agasakora chinguba chie chitahabu chiria abasomba ba Hadadeseri babogoretie, agachiira Yerusalemu.

ekegusii: David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
english: Daudi agasakora chinguba chie chitahabu, echio abasomba ba Hadadeseri babogoretie, agachiira Yerusalemu.

ekegusii: Daudi akaimokia omotwe bw’Omofilisti oria akayoira Yerusalemu, korende ebirwanero bia Goliato akabigacha ase eema yaye omonyene.
english: David took the Philistine's head and brought it to Jerusalem, and he put the Philistine's weapons in his own tent.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigwete amang’ana ayio, akayabeka ase ebirengererio biaye, akairoka Akisi, omoruoti o Gati, mono.
english: David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish king of Gath.

ekegusii: David took up this lament concerning Saul and his son Jonathan,
english: Daudi akoreera Saulo na Yonathani, momura o Saulo, nogotera oko gw’okweumia.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Daudi akairoka Nyasae, akabora, “Naki rende ndakore imbe noboremu ndete Esanduku ya Nyasae nka bwone?”
english: David was afraid of God that day and asked, "How can I ever bring the ark of God to me?"

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Daudi akoboa Omonene, akaboria, “Naki rende ndakore imbe noboremu ndete Esanduku y’Omonene bwone?”
english: David was afraid of the LORD that day and said, "How can the ark of the LORD ever come to me?"

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi akoorire kobara abanto, enkoro yaye ekamogambia. Erio agatebia Omonene, “Nakorire ebibe ebinene ase aya nakorire; korende bono Omonene, nagosabire onyabere inche omosomba oo, naki nigo nakorire egento ki’oboriri mono.”
english: David was conscience-stricken after he had counted the fighting men, and he said to the LORD, "I have sinned greatly in what I have done. Now, O LORD, I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."

ekegusii: Daudi akaba nemechando emenene, ekiagera abanto nigo barengereretie komoaka amagena bamoite. Barabwo nigo barenge nobororo obonge ase engencho y’abana babo abamura na abaiseke. Korende Daudi akanyora chinguru korwa ase Omonene Nyasae oye.
english: David was greatly distressed because the men were talking of stoning him; each one was bitter in spirit because of his sons and daughters. But David found strength in the LORD his God.

ekegusii: Daudi nere orenge omoke ase bonsi. Abwo batato abanene bakaba bakomobwatia Saulo.
english: David was the youngest. The three oldest followed Saul,

ekegusii: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.
english: Daudi konya okoorire emiaka emerongo etato ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka emerongo ene.

ekegusii: Daudi agasoka kobarotota akabatebia, “Onye igo mwachire buna abasani baane monkonye, rirorio enkoro yane nebwatane nainwe, korende onye nigo mwachire monsigane na kondua ase ababisa baane, nonya amaboko aane takorete okomocha konde gwonsi, rirorio Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito arore amang’ana ayio abae egesusuro.”
english: David went out to meet them and said to them, "If you have come to me in peace, to help me, I am ready to have you unite with me. But if you have come to betray me to my enemies when my hands are free from violence, may the God of our fathers see it and judge you."

ekegusii: Daudi konya oikire Mahanaimu ekero Abisalomu ambogete Yorodan amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi barenge komo.
english: David went to Mahanaim, and Absalom crossed the Jordan with all the men of Israel.

ekegusii: Daudi akagenda ase Ahimeleki omokuani agwo Nobu. Ahimeleki agacha komorotota ore nobwoba na okoiguswa, akamoboria, “Nase ki ore aye bweka otari na monto onde?”
english: David went to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest. Ahimelech trembled when he met him, and asked, "Why are you alone? Why is no one with you?"

ekegusii: Daudi amo nabatang’ani abarenge komokonya bagaatanana ase obokoreri abamura bande b’Asafu, na aba Hemani, na aba Yedutuni, baria barenge gochia kobana ase okobugia amakano ao ao, na goakania chisani chikwoga. Omoroberio bw’abanto baria baetwe emeremo eria noro oyo:
english: David, together with the commanders of the army, set apart some of the sons of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun for the ministry of prophesying, accompanied by harps, lyres and cymbals. Here is the list of the men who performed this service:

ekegusii: Daudi akaba ogotenga ne chinguru chiaye chionsi ase obosio bw’Omonene, obegete egesibao kiaroisirie korwa ase egatani.
english: David, wearing a linen ephod, danced before the LORD with all his might,

ekegusii: David's men turned around and went back. When they arrived, they reported every word.
english: Abamura baria Daudi atomete bakairana gochia asare, bakamotebia amang’ana ayio onsi Nabali abatebetie.

ekegusii: Abakungu ba Daudi bonsi babere, Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli, na Abigaeli, oyotigetwe omoboraka orenge moka Nabali o Karimeli, konya bairirwe ase obosomba nabarabwo.
english: David's two wives had been captured-- Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.

ekegusii: Kera omokuani nigo are gotenena rituko ase rituko ase obokoreri bwaye na korua ebing’wanso biria, na birobio tibiare konyara korusia ebibe nonya ng’ake.
english: Day after day every priest stands and performs his religious duties; again and again he offers the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.

ekegusii: Rituko ase rituko abanto bakagenderera gocha ase Daudi komokonya, goika agatwara abarwani abange mono, buna abarwani esegi ba Nyasae.
english: Day after day men came to help David, until he had a great army, like the army of God.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo riatebia erinde obonene obo, na obotuko obomo bwarareria obotuko bonde ayio ayio.
english: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they display knowledge.

ekegusii: Bakaba bagokwana nere rituko ase rituko ng’a aigwere ogochika koria, korende tabete ogotegerera amang’ana abo. Ere nigo abatebetie ng’a n’Omoyahudi are. Ase ayio abasomba baria bagatebia Hamani, erinde barore gose amang’ana a Moredekai nancherwe.
english: Day after day they spoke to him but he refused to comply. Therefore they told Haman about it to see whether Mordecai's behavior would be tolerated, for he had told them he was a Jew.

ekegusii: Kera rituko, korwa erie ritang’ani goikera eri’omoerio, Ezara akaba okobasomera Ebuku eria yarikire amachiko a Nyasae. Abanto bakagenderera korenda Amatuko aria Amanene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, na ase rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaba nomosangererekano omonene bw’ogosasima, buna yachikire.
english: Day after day, from the first day to the last, Ezra read from the Book of the Law of God. They celebrated the feast for seven days, and on the eighth day, in accordance with the regulation, there was an assembly.

ekegusii: Na kera rituko, ase Hekalu ime na ase chinyomba chiabo tibatigete kworokereria na korandia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso, ng’a nere Kristo.
english: Day after day, in the temple courts and from house to house, they never stopped teaching and proclaiming the good news that Jesus is the Christ.

ekegusii: bikoyoetanana igoro ase chindwaki omobaso na obotuko; amabe a mobosokano na emechando bire ase omochie oyio.
english: Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoa endagera yaye, na kera egento kiaganeirie ase kera rituko ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
english: Day by day the king gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoa endagera yaye botambe na kera egento arenge kogania ase kera rituko ase obogima bwaye bwonsi goika ekero ki’ogokwa kwaye.
english: Day by day the king of Babylon gave Jehoiachin a regular allowance as long as he lived, till the day of his death.

ekegusii: Naboigo nabakonyi b’ekanisa babe abanto bateneneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, batari nemenwa ebere, abanto batari konywa edivai enyinge, abanto batari gwancha okonyora kw’oborianania.
english: Deacons, likewise, are to be men worthy of respect, sincere, not indulging in much wine, and not pursuing dishonest gain.

ekegusii: Aye okore onsi koreng’ana nobong’aini bwao, korende tobaisa komotiga agende ne chimbuche chiaye aase abakure ore nomorembe.
english: Deal with him according to your wisdom, but do not let his gray head go down to the grave in peace.

ekegusii: Nkorere amaya inche omosomba oo koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, naende onyorokererie imanye emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Deal with your servant according to your love and teach me your decrees.

ekegusii: Abana baane, monto onde tabaisa kobang’aina. Ere oyogokora oboronge nigo are omonyene oboronge, buna Kristo are omonyene oboronge.
english: Dear children, do not let anyone lead you astray. He who does what is right is righteous, just as he is righteous.

ekegusii: Abana baane, erende inwe abanyene korwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa.
english: Dear children, keep yourselves from idols.

ekegusii: Abana baane, titwancha ase amang’ana gose ase ogokwana, korende ase ogokora, na ase ekeene.
english: Dear children, let us not love with words or tongue but with actions and in truth.

ekegusii: Abana baane abake, engaki eye ney’omoerio. Na buna mwaigwete ng’a omobisa o Kristo ngocha are, nonya mbono ababisa ba Kristo nabange baimokire. Ase ayio twamanyire ng’a engaki eye ney’omoerio.
english: Dear children, this is the last hour; and as you have heard that the antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have come. This is how we know it is the last hour.

ekegusii: Omwanchani, tibwega obobe, korende bwege ekere ekiya. Ere oyogokora amaya noyo o Nyasae, korende ere oyogokora amabe tarochi Nyasae.
english: Dear friend, do not imitate what is evil but what is good. Anyone who does what is good is from God. Anyone who does what is evil has not seen God.

ekegusii: Omwanchani, nasabire ng’a ogenderere buya ase amang’ana onsi, naende obe nobogima obuya, buna omoyo oo ore buya.
english: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.

ekegusii: Omwanchani, igo ore omwegenwa ase onsi ayagwakoreire abwo bare abaminto, nonya bare abamenyi.
english: Dear friend, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, even though they are strangers to you.

ekegusii: Abanchani, ekero narenge gokora omokia mono kobarikera inwe amang’ana ’ogotooreka gwaito, okwo tosangete nainwe, nkarora ng’a negwenerete mbarikere na kobasorora morwanerere okwegena okwo abachenu baetwe ara rimo.
english: Dear friends, although I was very eager to write to you about the salvation we share, I felt I had to write and urge you to contend for the faith that was once for all entrusted to the saints.

ekegusii: Abanchani, timokumia ase obokong’u obore buna omorero, obwo bwabaikeire ase okobateema, buna namang’ana amageni abanyorire.
english: Dear friends, do not be surprised at the painful trial you are suffering, as though something strange were happening to you.

ekegusii: Abanchani, timwegena kera omoika, moteeme emeika onye neya Nyasae, ekiagera ababani b’oborimo abange basokire gochia ase ense.
english: Dear friends, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

ekegusii: Abanchani, timbarikereti ogochika okoyia, korende nkoria gwa kare mwarenge na korokwo korwa ritang’ani. Na ogochika koria gwa kare nakwo ring’ana riria mwaigwete.
english: Dear friends, I am not writing you a new command but an old one, which you have had since the beginning. This old command is the message you have heard.

ekegusii: Abanchani, nabasoroire inwe, ekiagera more abaeti ase ense engeni eatanane korwa ase okogania okobe kw’omobere okwo gokorwana nomoyo.
english: Dear friends, I urge you, as aliens and strangers in the world, to abstain from sinful desires, which war against your soul.

ekegusii: Abanchani, onye chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, rirorio ntore noboremu ase obosio bwa Nyasae,
english: Dear friends, if our hearts do not condemn us, we have confidence before God

ekegusii: Abanchani, twanchane, ekiagera obwanchani nigo bokorwa ase Nyasae, na kera oyobwanchire oiboirwe na Nyasae, naende namomanyete Nyasae.
english: Dear friends, let us love one another, for love comes from God. Everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

ekegusii: Abanchani, bono nabana ba Nyasae tore, korende teraorokigwa buna torache koba. Naki twamanyire ng’a ekero araorokigwe natogwekane nere, ekiagera natomorore buna are.
english: Dear friends, now we are children of God, and what we will be has not yet been made known. But we know that when he appears, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is.

ekegusii: Abanchani, onye Nyasae otwanchete igo, netogwenerete naintwe boigo gwanchana intwe ase intwe.
english: Dear friends, since God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.

ekegusii: Abanchani, rirube eri neria kabere nabarikeire inwe. Ase onsi abere nabokirie ebirengererio biaino ebiya ase okobainyoria,
english: Dear friends, this is now my second letter to you. I have written both of them as reminders to stimulate you to wholesome thinking.

ekegusii: Buna aase abakure na embeera bitari goisaneka, naboigo namaiso a mwanyabanto atari goisaneka.
english: Death and Destruction are never satisfied, and neither are the eyes of man.

ekegusii: Aase abakure ne chioora chi’obosiru nigo bire maiso marore ase Omonene. Inee! Tari mono kobua chinkoro chia mwanyabanto?
english: Death and Destruction lie open before the LORD-- how much more the hearts of men!

ekegusii: Amakweri aeteire ase ebibao biaito, asoire ase chinyomba chiaito chi’obonene, aitire abana ase chinchera, na abasae ase chichiiro.
english: Death has climbed in through our windows and has entered our fortresses; it has cut off the children from the streets and the young men from the public squares.

ekegusii: Aase ’abakure nigo aasie ase obosio bwa Nyasae; ee, aase agwo ogosiria tabwati kemumeko.
english: Death is naked before God; Destruction lies uncovered.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omobani Debora, moka Lapidoti, nigo arenge omogambi bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lappidoth, was leading Israel at that time.

ekegusii: Raria engaki y’okweng’ata ogochenu; rangeria omosangererekano bw’ogosasima! Sangereria abagaaka na abanto bonsi b’ense eye, bache ase enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, erinde morere ase Omonene.
english: Declare a holy fast; call a sacred assembly. Summon the elders and all who live in the land to the house of the LORD your God, and cry out to the LORD.

ekegusii: Raria obonene bwaye ase egati y’ebisaku, na ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ase abanto bonsi!
english: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, obae egesusuro ase ebibe biabo: emeroberio eyio bakorire tiga egere bagwe. Obaserie, ekiagera basaririe asore, na ekiagera bangire gokoigwera.
english: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.

ekegusii: Raria na morente amang’ana aino! Tiga bagambere amang’ana abo amo. Ning’o oyakwanete agwo kare? Ning’o oyararetie kare? Inee! Tari inche Omonene nayakwanete? Inche nigo inde Nyasae omonyene oboronge na Omotooria. Nyasae onde tari otatiga inche bweka.”
english: Declare what is to be, present it-- let them take counsel together. Who foretold this long ago, who declared it from the distant past? Was it not I, the LORD? And there is no God apart from me, a righteous God and a Savior; there is none but me.

ekegusii: emechie ya Dedani, na Tema, na Busi, na abanto bonsi abwo bakonacha chitukia chiabo;
english: Dedan, Tema, Buz and all who are in distant places;

ekegusii: Endiba y’amache nigo ekorangeria endiba ende, ekero amache ’ebieera akoeera; chiooro chiao chionsi na emerindo yao biantubire.
english: Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akaimoka, agasoa enyomba ende, ekiagera enkoro yaye nigo yare namaiga ase omwana omwabo, aroro ase enyomba eyio akarera amariga.
english: Deeply moved at the sight of his brother, Joseph hurried out and looked for a place to weep. He went into his private room and wept there.

ekegusii: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to your promise.
english: Indwanerere, omboorie, ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

ekegusii: Kae abataka ne chintakana oboronge bwabo; boigo nabwo bagokorerwa bobe, na abaremeire.
english: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

ekegusii: Igo okoa chintakana na abachandegete oboronge bwabo, erinde monto onde bw’ense tagenderera korenta okogosa naende.
english: defending the fatherless and the oppressed, in order that man, who is of the earth, may terrify no more.

ekegusii: Oyio nigo akobogoria ching’aya chiaye chikumbire, ominyoka ore nebigoti ebikong’u ochia korwania Omonene.
english: defiantly charging against him with a thick, strong shield.

ekegusii: Goka ase Omonene, ere nakoe okogania gw’enkoro yao.
english: Delight yourself in the LORD and he will give you the desires of your heart.

ekegusii: Naende Delila agatebia Samison, “Goika bono gwankoreire echeche, na gontebia oborimo. Ntebie buna oranyare gosibwa.” Samison akamoiraneria, “Korasiberanie ebikundo biria bitano na bibere bi’etukia yane ase egetambaa keria okoroisia na kobisiba bokong’u nekegobanio, tibikorusigwao, erio nimbe omworo, na imbe buna monto onde bwensi.” Ekero Samison ararete, Delila akabwata ebikundo biria bitano na bibere bi’etukia yaye,
english: Delilah then said to Samson, "Until now, you have been making a fool of me and lying to me. Tell me how you can be tied." He replied, "If you weave the seven braids of my head into the fabric [on the loom] and tighten it with the pin, I'll become as weak as any other man." So while he was sleeping, Delilah took the seven braids of his head, wove them into the fabric

ekegusii: Ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amaboko ’abanto be chinse chingeni, abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora ay’obong’ainereria.
english: Deliver me and rescue me from the hands of foreigners whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

ekegusii: Nkonye korwa ase abakori amabe; ntoorie korwa ase abaiteri amanyinga.
english: Deliver me from evildoers and save me from bloodthirsty men.

ekegusii: Gose natebirie onde ng’a antoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omobisa one? Gose natebirie onde ng’a amboorie korwa ase amaboko ’abachandi baane?”
english: deliver me from the hand of the enemy, ransom me from the clutches of the ruthless'?

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omokori amabe, indusie korwa ase okobua kw’oyo otari omoronge, na oyore omotindi.
english: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of evil and cruel men.

ekegusii: Ntoorie korwa ase ogoitwa nomoro, tooria obogima bwane korwa ase okobua gwe chisese chiria!
english: Deliver my life from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dogs.

ekegusii: Ebikorero ebio kwaeirwe gokorera emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae oo, obiire bionsi, obibeke ase obosio bwa Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles entrusted to you for worship in the temple of your God.

ekegusii: Erio abatooria mbariine ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, bagambere Egetunwa gia Esau. Omonene omonyene nere orabe omoruoti.”
english: Deliverers will go up on Mount Zion to govern the mountains of Esau. And the kingdom will be the LORD's.

ekegusii: Demeterio obereirwe kirori nabanto bonsi, naende nekeene ekenyene, ng’a nomuya are. Na intwe boigo twarorire, na aye kwamanyire ng’a oborori bwaito nobw’ekeene.
english: Demetrius is well spoken of by everyone-- and even by the truth itself. We also speak well of him, and you know that our testimony is true.

ekegusii: Inwe aba mokobogoria ebikorero bi’Omonene, imoka, morue aase aa, timobaisa gokuna egento getachenegeti, soka korwa ase egati y’omochie oyo, mwechene inwe abanyene.
english: Depart, depart, go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Come out from it and be pure, you who carry the vessels of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio rogatirimboka gochia ase ense y’Abayafeleti goika Beti‐Horoni ya maate, na goika Geseri, naende rogatwomera Enyancha Enene.
english: descended westward to the territory of the Japhletites as far as the region of Lower Beth Horon and on to Gezer, ending at the sea.

ekegusii: Aase agwo ching’iti chi’orosana nchiumeraneo ne chinyang’au ase obotuko amarengari nabe akorangerania, na ekerecha gete ngeche aroro kenyore aase kegotimokera.
english: Desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and wild goats will bleat to each other; there the night creatures will also repose and find for themselves places of rest.

ekegusii: “Mochore aase isiko y’ebitwori ase mogochia gwekonyera.
english: Designate a place outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself.

ekegusii: Inwe abaremi ichana na gosooka, nainwe abaroiseria b’emesabibu, rera, ekiagera engano na esairi biasirigwe amo nokwama gwonsi kw’emegondo.
english: Despair, you farmers, wail, you vine growers; grieve for the wheat and the barley, because the harvest of the field is destroyed.

ekegusii: “Nigo bakobarorera inwe amaroro ’oborimo, na kobaringorera ay’oborimo, bateba ng’a monyare koba abamogotacha ebigoti bi’abakori amabe abwo batachenegeti, ekiagera rituko riabo riachire baraegwe egesusuro ki’omoerio ki’ebibe biabo.
english: Despite false visions concerning you and lying divinations about you, it will be laid on the necks of the wicked who are to be slain, whose day has come, whose time of punishment has reached its climax.

ekegusii: Bakaagacha egesasimero keria aase aye, erinde bamoruere Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa mambia na morogoba, ekiagera nigo bairogete abanto bamenyete ase ense eria.
english: Despite their fear of the peoples around them, they built the altar on its foundation and sacrificed burnt offerings on it to the LORD, both the morning and evening sacrifices.

ekegusii: Ekero moraike ase ense eria y’ebisaku na koyeira, rirorio mosarie kegima aase onsi ase biarenge gosasimera chinyasae chiabo, kerabe ase ebitunwa ebitambe, gose ase ebigoro, gose inse y’emete emebese.
english: Destroy completely all the places on the high mountains and on the hills and under every spreading tree where the nations you are dispossessing worship their gods.

ekegusii: Aase ay’obosareku na amakweri nigo bigoteba: Intwe twaigure chinkuma chiaye.
english: Destruction and Death say, 'Only a rumor of it has reached our ears.'

ekegusii: Obosareku nigo boichire ime yaye, obong’ainereria na ogokorera abande bobe tibikorua ase chinchera chiaye.
english: Destructive forces are at work in the city; threats and lies never leave its streets.

ekegusii: Inchuo amo mosemanie, korende nigo korabe bosa; kwana ring’ana riaino, korende tirikoba, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naintwe.
english: Devise your strategy, but it will be thwarted; propose your plan, but it will not stand, for God is with us.

ekegusii: Mogenderere nogosaba, morende ase korokwo, na koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono;
english: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Diboni batiirire gochia aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, barereo. Nigo bakweumia ase engencho ya Nebo na Medeba; kera omonto okigitire etukia yaye, ogingire ne chinderu.
english: Dibon goes up to its temple, to its high places to weep; Moab wails over Nebo and Medeba. Every head is shaved and every beard cut off.

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto oyio tantebetie ere omonyene ng’a oyo mosubati omwabo? Na omokungu nere agantebia ng’a oyo momura omwabo? Ase enkoro etari na komocha, na ase amaboko amarabu nakorire ayio.”
english: Did he not say to me, 'She is my sister,' and didn't she also say, 'He is my brother'? I have done this with a clear conscience and clean hands."

ekegusii: Inee! Ninche naiborete abanto aba bonsi? Gose ninche nabatongete? Naki rende ogontebia ng’a mbabogorie na kobarera ase egekuba kiane, buna omoreri akobogoria omwana ekeng’werere okogonka, goika imbaikie ase ense eria kwarierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nobayee?”
english: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth? Why do you tell me to carry them in my arms, as a nurse carries an infant, to the land you promised on oath to their forefathers?

ekegusii: Inee! Nabaurete gento goetera ase onde bwensi natomete asemore?
english: Did I exploit you through any of the men I sent you?

ekegusii: Inee! Oyio ontongete ase enda ya baba, tari ere otongete oyio boigo? Tari ere oyomo otobombete ase enda ime?”
english: Did not he who made me in the womb make them? Did not the same one form us both within our mothers?

ekegusii: Inee! Hezekia oyo tari ere oria osaririe aase aimokererete igoro agwo ase Omonene agosasimerwa, amo nebisasimero biaye? Naende ere agachika Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu, ogoteba: Bosio bw’egesasimero ekemo nao morasasimere, na igoro ase kerokio mobe mokorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa.
english: Did not Hezekiah himself remove this god's high places and altars, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, 'You must worship before one altar and burn sacrifices on it'?

ekegusii: bakeba Omonene, Nyasae obo, oyobatooretie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo babaetanaine.
english: did not remember the LORD their God, who had rescued them from the hands of all their enemies on every side.

ekegusii: Inee! Tiyamogwenerete Kristo konyora emechando eye ritang’ani atarasoa ase obonene bwaye?”
english: Did not the Christ have to suffer these things and then enter his glory?"

ekegusii: Bono inee, riria erire rigiya ndiabeire amakweri asende? Yaya, taibo! Ebibe bikang’ita ase enchera y’erire rigiya, erio ebibe birorekane ng’a nebibe, erinde ase ogochika koria ebibe bimenteke koba bitari nekerengo.
english: Did that which is good, then, become death to me? By no means! But in order that sin might be recognized as sin, it produced death in me through what was good, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.

ekegusii: Inee! Chinyasae chi’ebisaku chiatooririe ebisaku biria chisokoro chiane chiasiretie, ebisaku bia Gosani, na Harani, na Resefu, na abanto ba Edeni, baria barenge agwo Telasari?
english: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my forefathers deliver them-- the gods of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?

ekegusii: Inee! Chinyasae chi’ebisaku chiatooririe ebisaku biria chisokoro chiane chiasiretie, ebisaku bia Gosani, na Harani, na Resefu, na abanto b’Edeni, baria barenge agwo Telasari?
english: Did the gods of the nations that were destroyed by my forefathers deliver them: the gods of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph and the people of Eden who were in Tel Assar?

ekegusii: Inee! Ring’ana ria Nyasae nasemore riarwete, gose ninwe mweka riaikerete?
english: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only people it has reached?

ekegusii: Inee! Tari aye kwang’umorete buna amabeere, na okambomba buna amabeere abwatanire?
english: Did you not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese,

ekegusii: Inee! Ekero otaraoonigwa, torenge oyoo? Naende ekero oonigwe, chibesa tichiarenge ase okobua kwao? Nase ki kwarengereretie ring’ana eri ase enkoro yao ime? Totebeti mwanyabanto oborimo, korende Nyasae.”
english: Didn't it belong to you before it was sold? And after it was sold, wasn't the money at your disposal? What made you think of doing such a thing? You have not lied to men but to God."

ekegusii: Titwagotebetie ayio aaria Misiri? Tokagotebia ng’a: Totige tokorere Abamisiri. Naki anga mbuya tware gokorera Abamisiri kobua gokwera aiga ase erooro.”
english: Didn't we say to you in Egypt, 'Leave us alone; let us serve the Egyptians'? It would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the desert!"

ekegusii: Inee! Chisokoro chiaino tichiakorete obobe buna obo, chikagera Nyasae oito akarenta amabe aya onsi asetore na ase omochie oyo? Bono nigo morigetie korentera Abaisraeli endamwamu ya Nyasae ere enene goetania, ase ogokora Esabato koba eyetachenegeti.”
english: Didn't your forefathers do the same things, so that our God brought all this calamity upon us and upon this city? Now you are stirring up more wrath against Israel by desecrating the Sabbath."

ekegusii: Ebirengero bi’oborito, na ebi’obonge, bire ara kabere, nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene.
english: Differing weights and differing measures-- the LORD detests them both.

ekegusii: Dilean, Mizpah, Joktheel,
english: na Diliani, na Misipe, na Yokiteli,

ekegusii: Okoboko kw’omonto omonyamokia nkogambe, korende oyore omworo nabetererigwe akore emeremo emekong’u.
english: Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

ekegusii: Dimnah and Nahalal, together with their pasturelands-- four towns;
english: na Dimuna, na Nahalali, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

ekegusii: Nonya nechindooche chia Dimoni chiaichoire namanyinga, ningenderere korenta amabe ande ase Dimoni. Nindete endo eite Abamoabu, abwo bagotama na abwo batigarete ase ense yabo.
english: Dimon's waters are full of blood, but I will bring still more upon Dimon--a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon those who remain in the land.

ekegusii: atobeke ekiara kiaye gi’okoraga gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio ime ase amaguta aria are roe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee, erio ayanyororokerie ara gatano na kabere, agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
english: dip his right forefinger into the oil in his palm, and with his finger sprinkle some of it before the LORD seven times.

ekegusii: Indaae imbwatie enchera y’amachiko ao, ekiagera inche nigo ingokirie naro.
english: Direct me in the path of your commands, for there I find delight.

ekegusii: Kong’ia orogendo rwane koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao, totiga obobe bongambere.
english: Direct my footsteps according to your word; let no sin rule over me.

ekegusii: Obobe nigo bokoromeng’ana obobe bonde, ense yonsi yasarigwe. Chiema chiane chiasarigwe mobosokano; ebietubo bie chiema chiane biatandoirwe.
english: Disaster follows disaster; the whole land lies in ruins. In an instant my tents are destroyed, my shelter in a moment.

ekegusii: Disaster will come upon you, and you will not know how to conjure it away. A calamity will fall upon you that you cannot ward off with a ransom; a catastrophe you cannot foresee will suddenly come upon you.
english: “Amabe nakonyore, ayio oborogi botanyare koyatanga, amaakwa nakonyore, ayio otanyore embooria ende ekoyarusiao. Ogosirigwa nkogochere mobosokano, amang’ana ayio otamanyete ng’a nabe bo.

ekegusii: Rongeyia omwana oo omomura, ere nakorentere ogotimoka, nigo ararente omosasoko omonge ase enkoro yao.
english: Discipline your son, and he will give you peace; he will bring delight to your soul.

ekegusii: Orokereria omwana oo omomura ase okomorongeyia ekero ogosemeria koreo, gose tobaisa komoganeria amakweri.
english: Discipline your son, for in that there is hope; do not be a willing party to his death.

ekegusii: Emeroberio y’ebirengererio ebiya nekorende, na okomanya okuya ngokorende boigo.
english: Discretion will protect you, and understanding will guard you.

ekegusii: na Disoni, na Eseri, na Disani. Aba nabwo barenge abagambi b’Abahori, basinto ba Seiri, ase ense y’Edomu.
english: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These sons of Seir in Edom were Horite chiefs.

ekegusii: na omogambi Disoni, na omogambi Eseri, na omogambi Disani. Aba nabwo abagambi b’Abahori, koreng’ana nebisaku biabo, ase ense ya Seiri.
english: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These were the Horite chiefs, according to their divisions, in the land of Seir.

ekegusii: Enibo enyorire ase obwango ase enchera y’obobe nigo egosira, korende ey’ekonyorekana ase okoyekorera emeremo nementekane.
english: Dishonest money dwindles away, but he who gathers money little by little makes it grow.

ekegusii: Amarube aria akaegwa abanto abaango bakayaminyokia gochia ase chingongo chionsi chiare ase oboruoti boria. Nigo arenge goteba ng’a ase rituko erimo rioka, rituko ria ikomi na gatato ri’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, noro Adari, Abayahudi bonsi, abanto abake na abagotu, abakungu na abana, baitwe basirigwe pi, na ebinto biabo bisakorwe.
english: Dispatches were sent by couriers to all the king's provinces with the order to destroy, kill and annihilate all the Jews-- young and old, women and little children-- on a single day, the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, and to plunder their goods.

ekegusii: Emechando na obwoba nigo bikomoondokia. Ebio nigo bikomorwania na komobua, ne chinguru buna echi’omoruoti bwebekire ang’e korwana esegi.
english: Distress and anguish fill him with terror; they overwhelm him, like a king poised to attack,

ekegusii: Abanto mbaetanane ase ense yonsi, bare nemechando emenene mono, na enchara, na ekero babeire nenchara mbabe nekeririanda ekenene, baragererie omoruoti obo na Nyasae obo. Mbaonchore amasio abo barigererie gochia igoro,
english: Distressed and hungry, they will roam through the land; when they are famished, they will become enraged and, looking upward, will curse their king and their God.

ekegusii: Mwatanane ense eria ase kera egesaku ase ogoaka obomera. Moe abanto b’egesaku ekenene orogongo oronene robe omwando obo, na abanto b’egesaku egeke orogongo oroke robe orwabo. Obomera koboragwere omonto, omwando oria nobe oyo bw’omonto oyio. Kera egesaku keegwe omwando buna obomera borakegwere. Inamoegwe emiando koreng’ana nebisaku bie chisokoro chiaino.
english: Distribute the land by lot, according to your clans. To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one. Whatever falls to them by lot will be theirs. Distribute it according to your ancestral tribes.

ekegusii: Erio bwatanane ebinto biasakorwa, na abanto booswa amo ne ching’iti ase chinsemo ibere. Ensemo eyemo ebe ey’abarwani b’esegi, na eyende ey’omoganda.
english: Divide the spoils between the soldiers who took part in the battle and the rest of the community.
