ekegusii: Agaatanana abanto baria baye amagana atato ase ebiombe bitato, akaa kera oyomo egetureri, na ekeguuru amo nekieri ki’omorero kere imeo.
english: Dividing the three hundred men into three companies, he placed trumpets and empty jars in the hands of all of them, with torches inside.

ekegusii: Bonsi mbare nebiegwa bi’okogwenia abarwaire? Bonsi ngokwana bare emenwa ao ao? Bonsi nkoonchora bare?
english: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?

ekegusii: Inee! Emegwekano y’ogosasimwa y’abanto b’ebisaku nenyare korenta embura? Gose igoro enyene enyare korenta embura? Inee! Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, tari aye tosemeretie? Nigo togosemeretie, ekiagera naye gwakorire aya onsi.
english: Do any of the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies themselves send down showers? No, it is you, O LORD our God. Therefore our hope is in you, for you are the one who does all this.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aino onsi akoreke ase obwanchani.
english: Do everything in love.

ekegusii: Do everything without complaining or arguing,
english: Mokore amang’ana onsi motari nokwemurungania na okoborania,

ekegusii: Kora omokia gokonya Zena, omomanyi bw’amachiko, na Apolo, ekero okobatoma ase orogendo rwabo, na origererie buya ng’a tibaremerwa kende gionsi.
english: Do everything you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their way and see that they have everything they need.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao gwankoreire inche omosomba oo obuya obonge.
english: Do good to your servant according to your word, O LORD.

ekegusii: Inkorera amaya, inche omosomba oo, erio nario ndabe moyo, mbwate ring’ana riao.
english: Do good to your servant, and I will live; I will obey your word.

ekegusii: Omonene, bakorere amaya abanto abwo bare abaya, abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge!
english: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.

ekegusii: Inee! Chibarasi nchinyare kominyoka igoro ase egetare? Gose omonto nanyare korema egetare ne chiombe? Korende inwe mwaonchoire ayare ay’oboronge abeire obosongo, na okwama kw’oboronge kwabeire obororo buna chinkama.
english: Do horses run on the rocky crags? Does one plow there with oxen? But you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness--

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Inee! Ninkore engaki y’okoibora eike, ko abana tibaiborwa? Naende Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Inee! Inche nimbe oyo okorua chinguru abana baiborwa, naende ninsieke enda teibora?”
english: Do I bring to the moment of birth and not give delivery?" says the LORD. "Do I close up the womb when I bring to delivery?" says your God.

ekegusii: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?
english: Inee! Inche ne chinyama chie chieri nkoria? Gose namanyinga e chimbori nkonywa?

ekegusii: Ekeene gokonywa konde gwonsi tikori ime yane, amagenderero nabwate naurirwe.”
english: Do I have any power to help myself, now that success has been driven from me?

ekegusii: Inee! Chinguru chiane nigo chire chinkong’u buna echi’amagena? Gose omobere one nigo ore omokong’u buna etaai?
english: Do I have the strength of stone? Is my flesh bronze?

ekegusii: Ninki ngokwana? Ng’a keria gekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa negento? Gose omogwekano oria negento?
english: Do I mean then that a sacrifice offered to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?

ekegusii: Omonene, Inee, tingecheti abwo bakogechete? Tinkonyinyeera abwo bagosaria asore?
english: Do I not hate those who hate you, O LORD, and abhor those who rise up against you?

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ngokwana aya buna mwanyabanto? Gose amachiko tari goteba boigo?
english: Do I say this merely from a human point of view? Doesn't the Law say the same thing?

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae akoboria; Inee! Aye nigo okagete ng’a inche nigo ingokirie nogokwa kw’omokori amabe? Yaya, nigo nganetie omokori amabe aonchoke, atige enchera yaye embe abe moyo.
english: Do I take any pleasure in the death of the wicked? declares the Sovereign LORD. Rather, am I not pleased when they turn from their ways and live?

ekegusii: Do men make their own gods? Yes, but they are not gods!"
english: Inee! Omonto nanyare kweroiseria chinyasae? Yaya, taibo. Echio tichiri Nyasae.”

ekegusii: Tibakora emeremo yabo ya kera rituko, nabanduere inche Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero.”
english: Do no regular work, but present an offering made to the LORD by fire.'"

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio timokora emeremo ende yonsi; rituko erio nario Rituko ri’Okobwatanigwa ekero okobwatanigwa kogokorwa asemore, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: Do no work on that day, because it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God.

ekegusii: “Timobaisa gochaya Abaedomu, barabwo nabanto bamino; gose timobaisa gochaya Abamisiri, ekiagera inwe agwo kare nao mwarenge abamenyi ase ense yabo.
english: Do not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother. Do not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as an alien in his country.

ekegusii: Do not accuse a man for no reason-- when he has done you no harm.
english: Tobaisa koamererania na monto onde engencho ende etaiyo, onye taragokorera bobe bonde.

ekegusii: Tobaisa komenta kende ase amang’ana aye, nigo arabaise kogotogonyera, naye obe omonyaborimo.”
english: Do not add to his words, or he will rebuke you and prove you a liar.

ekegusii: Timomenta ring’ana rinde rionsi ase aria nabachikire, gose timorusia gento aroro. Mobwate amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ayio inche nabaeire.
english: Do not add to what I command you and do not subtract from it, but keep the commands of the LORD your God that I give you.

ekegusii: Timotiga ayare amaya asemore atorwe ng’a namabe.
english: Do not allow what you consider good to be spoken of as evil.

ekegusii: Tobaisa koiraneria omonto omoriri buna oboriri bwaye bore, nigo orabaise koba omoriri buna are.
english: Do not answer a fool according to his folly, or you will be like him yourself.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gosanga nabanto aba b’ebisaku batigarete ase egati yaino, gose timwatora amarieta e chinyasae chiabo, gose gotiana ase chirochio. Timochikorera gose gochisasima.
english: Do not associate with these nations that remain among you; do not invoke the names of their gods or swear by them. You must not serve them or bow down to them.

ekegusii: Tobaisa koba oyomo bw’abanto abwo bakobwatana amaboko, gose bakwerua koba intenenera ase chisira chi’abanto bande.
english: Do not be a man who strikes hands in pledge or puts up security for debts;

ekegusii: Tobaisa kong’ondokia, ekiagera naye ore obotamero bwane ase rituko ri’emechando.
english: Do not be a terror to me; you are my refuge in the day of disaster.

ekegusii: Timobaisa koiroka omoruoti o Babeli, oyio mwoboete; timomoiroka, ekiagera inche nigo inde amo nainwe, mbatoorie na kobarusia korwa ase okoboko kwaye. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: Do not be afraid of the king of Babylon, whom you now fear. Do not be afraid of him, declares the LORD, for I am with you and will save you and deliver you from his hands.

ekegusii: Tobaisa kobairoka, ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye kogokonya. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: Do not be afraid of them, for I am with you and will rescue you," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Timobaisa kobairoka, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae oino, nere orabarwanere esegi.
english: Do not be afraid of them; the LORD your God himself will fight for you."

ekegusii: Timoiroka abagoita omobere, abatanyare goita omoyo; kobua moiroke oyo oranyare goita omobere na omoyo ase omorero o kare na kare.
english: Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Rather, be afraid of the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

ekegusii: Toiroka amang’ana ayio arache kogochanda. Rigereria, Saitani narute abande baino ase echela monyare goteemwa, na inwe namochandwe ase engaki y’amatuko ikomi. Obe omwegenwa goika ogokwa na inche ninkoe egutwa y’obogima.
english: Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer. I tell you, the devil will put some of you in prison to test you, and you will suffer persecution for ten days. Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you the crown of life.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, timoiroka, inche nigo inde amo nainwe. “Nindete abanto b’ororeria rwaino korwa moocha, na korwa bosongo nimbasangererie.
english: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your children from the east and gather you from the west.

ekegusii: “Inwe ororeria rwa Yakobo ronga buna rikonde, inwe ekeombe egeke ki’Abaisraeli, timoiroka! Inche Omonene nimbakonye. Ninche Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli inde Omobooria oino.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: Do not be afraid, O worm Jacob, O little Israel, for I myself will help you," declares the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toba nendamwamu enene mono, togenderera koinyora ebibe biaito botambe. Torigererie, otoinyore, twensi nigo tore abanto bao.
english: Do not be angry beyond measure, O LORD; do not remember our sins forever. Oh, look upon us, we pray, for we are all your people.

ekegusii: Timwechandera ing’ana rinde rionsi; korende ase kera ring’ana ase ogosaba na ogosorora amo nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, okorigia kwaino komanyekane ase Nyasae.
english: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

ekegusii: Timoirwa bogeka namorokererio ao ao, ayare ay’ekegeni, ekiagera mbuya chinkoro chibekwe chinguru ase obuya, gose tari ase emeroberio y’okoria endagera ase eyio barabwo bagendererete neyio tibanyora gokonywa konde.
english: Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings. It is good for our hearts to be strengthened by grace, not by ceremonial foods, which are of no value to those who eat them.

ekegusii: Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows.
english: Timong’aineka; Nyasae tagokorerwa echeche. Naki kende gionsi omonto agosimeka, nakio arache kogesa.

ekegusii: Tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende, ekiagera emechando nigo ere ange, na monto onde tari orankonye.
english: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

ekegusii: Tobekera omonto amaboko bwango, gose tosanga nebibe bi’abanto bande. Bwerende aye omonyene, obe omochenu.
english: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, and do not share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.

ekegusii: Gose timoba abasasimi emegwekano buna abande babo barenge; buna erikire, “Abanto nigo baikaransete koria na konywa, bagatenena gotenga.”
english: Do not be idolaters, as some of them were; as it is written: "The people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in pagan revelry."

ekegusii: Toayerera gotiga obokoreri ase obosio bwaye, na tobwatana nogokora okobe, ekiagera ere nigo agokora onsi ayanchete.
english: Do not be in a hurry to leave the king's presence. Do not stand up for a bad cause, for he will do whatever he pleases.

ekegusii: Titoba buna Kaini, oyorenge bw’oria omobe, agaita oyomwabo. Ere nigo amoitete ase ki? Igo amoitete ekiagera ogokora kwaye kwarenge okobe, na okw’oyomwabo nigo kwarenge okwa boronge.
english: Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did he murder him? Because his own actions were evil and his brother's were righteous.

ekegusii: Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle or they will not come to you.
english: Timoba buna chibarasi ne chiyombo chitari nobong’aini, echigwenerete chibekerwe chinkini na ebigobanio bi’ogochigambera.

ekegusii: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
english: Gaki timoba omogwekano oyomo nabarabwo, ekiagera Iso oino namanyete aya moganetie, ritang’ani motaramosaba.”

ekegusii: Timoba buna chisokoro chiaino na buna abanto bamino batarenge abegenwa ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, goika akabasiria buna moroche bono.
english: Do not be like your fathers and brothers, who were unfaithful to the LORD, the God of their fathers, so that he made them an object of horror, as you see.

ekegusii: Timobaisa koba buna chisokoro chiaino, abwo ababani ba kare barerete asebare, bakabatebia: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Onchoka, motige chinchera chiaino chimbe, na ogokora kwaino okobe. Korende chisokoro chiaino tichiategererete chinyigwere. Nabo Omonene agoteba.
english: Do not be like your forefathers, to whom the earlier prophets proclaimed: This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Turn from your evil ways and your evil practices.' But they would not listen or pay attention to me, declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Timong’aineka! “Egosori embe nigo egosaria chingencho chingiya.”
english: Do not be misled: "Bad company corrupts good character."

ekegusii: Tobaisa koiroka ekero omonto abeire omotenenku, na ebinto bire ase enyomba yaye biamentekanire.
english: Do not be overawed when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases;

ekegusii: Tobugwa nobobe, korende obue obobe ase obuya.
english: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omoronge goetania, gose koba omong’aini goetania. Nase ki okweita aye omonyene?
english: Do not be overrighteous, neither be overwise-- why destroy yourself?

ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omobe goetania, gose tobaisa koba omoriri. Nase ki oganetie gokwa engaki yao etaraika?
english: Do not be overwicked, and do not be a fool-- why die before your time?

ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omwango ase ogokwana amang’ana, gose enkoro yao teba enyango gokwana ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ekiagera ere nigo are igoro, naye nigo ore inse aa ase ense; ase ayio tiga amang’ana ogokwana abe amake.
english: Do not be quick with your mouth, do not be hasty in your heart to utter anything before God. God is in heaven and you are on earth, so let your words be few.

ekegusii: Tobaisa koba omwango ase okogechigwa, ekiagera okogechigwa nigo komenyete ase chinkoro chi’abariri.
english: Do not be quickly provoked in your spirit, for anger resides in the lap of fools.

ekegusii: Timoba abanyabigoti bikong’u buna chisokoro chiaino chiarenge, korende mwekeyie ase Omonene, moche Aase aye Aachenu achenire kare na kare, momokorere Omonene, Nyasae oino, erinde endamwamu yaye entindi ebatige.
english: Do not be stiff-necked, as your fathers were; submit to the LORD. Come to the sanctuary, which he has consecrated forever. Serve the LORD your God, so that his fierce anger will turn away from you.

ekegusii: Timokumia, baminto, onye ense ekobagecha.
english: Do not be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

ekegusii: Timoondoka ase engencho yabo, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo are egati yaino, ere nere Nyasae omonene, naende oyo bw’okoondokia.
english: Do not be terrified by them, for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a great and awesome God.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gwekora omong’aini ase okorora kwao omonyene; omoiroke Omonene na bweatanane korwa ase amabe.
english: Do not be wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and shun evil.

ekegusii: Timosiberanigwa rikorogoto amo nabategeneti. Naki nkobwatana ki kore ase egati y’oboronge na ogosaria? Gose ngosanga ki kore ase egati y’omobaso na omosunte?
english: Do not be yoked together with unbelievers. For what do righteousness and wickedness have in common? Or what fellowship can light have with darkness?

ekegusii: Do not believe me unless I do what my Father does.
english: Onye tindi gokora emeremo ya Tata one, timonyegena.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gwetogeria rituko ri’ankio, ekiagera tomanyeti aya rituko rikorenta.
english: Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring forth.

ekegusii: Tibwetogia igoro ase chinsagia chiria. Onye kogwetogia, inyora ng’a tari aye oimogetie ritina, korende neritina rikoimogetie aye.
english: do not boast over those branches. If you do, consider this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.

ekegusii: Tosasima chinyasae chiabo, gose gochikorera; na tokora buna abanto abwo bagokora, korende osirie kegima emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa na moyaiyerie inse amagena abo onsi are aase bagosasimera.
english: Do not bow down before their gods or worship them or follow their practices. You must demolish them and break their sacred stones to pieces.

ekegusii: Timobaisa korenta okogechia buna okwo ase chinyomba chiaino. Komorakore igo, nigo moraragererigwe. Mokogeche na kogochaya, ekiagera korokwo nigo koragereirie.”
english: Do not bring a detestable thing into your house or you, like it, will be set apart for destruction. Utterly abhor and detest it, for it is set apart for destruction.

ekegusii: Rituko ri’Esabato timobaisa gosokia egurube ende yonsi korwa ase chinyomba chiaino na koyebogoria, gose timobaisa gokora emeremo ende yonsi, korende morende rituko ri’Esabato ribe richenu, buna nachigete chisokoro chiaino.
english: Do not bring a load out of your houses or do any work on the Sabbath, but keep the Sabbath day holy, as I commanded your forefathers.

ekegusii: Timobaisa korua eng’iti ende yonsi ere na kemocho ase omobere oye, naki ase ekeng’wanso buna ekio timogwancherwa.
english: Do not bring anything with a defect, because it will not be accepted on your behalf.

ekegusii: Toba omwango kogenda ase ekegambero. Inee! Inki orakore ase omoerio, ekero omonto oyio gwasoerete arakobue nobe nobosooku?
english: do not bring hastily to court, for what will you do in the end if your neighbor puts you to shame?

ekegusii: Tobaisa kong’ira inche omosomba oo ase ekegambero, ekiagera ase abwo bare moyo onde tari ore omoronge asore.
english: Do not bring your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before you.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gonchwara ekero ndabe nagotire, tontiga ekero chinguru chirabe chiang’ereire.
english: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.

ekegusii: Tonyatanana korwa ase obosio bwao, nonya n’Omoika Omochenu toyorusia asende.
english: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.

ekegusii: Do not cause anyone to stumble, whether Jews, Greeks or the church of God--
english: Timogocha Abayahudi gose Abagiriki, gose ekanisa ya Nyasae.

ekegusii: Do not charge your brother interest, whether on money or food or anything else that may earn interest.
english: “Ekero okoa omonto bw’egesaku kiao chibesa singo, gose endagera, gose gento kende gionsi, tobaisa komoboria ebitoki ekero agokoiraneria egento keria airete singo.

ekegusii: Gose timwereng’ania ne chingencho chi’ense eye; korende moonchorwe, mokorwe koba abayia ase emioyo yaino, monyare korigia na komanya boronge ogwancha kwa Nyasae, na erire rigiya, na eriranchwe, na oboikeranu.
english: Do not conform any longer to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God's will is-- his good, pleasing and perfect will.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korora ng’a naakong’u komoa obosibore, ekiagera ase emiaka etano nomo ere nigo arenge kogokorera emeremo ara kabere buna omorikwa bw’eng’eria are kogokorera. Ase ayio Omonene, Nyasae oo, nagosesenie ase emeremo yao yonsi ogokora.
english: Do not consider it a hardship to set your servant free, because his service to you these six years has been worth twice as much as that of a hired hand. And the LORD your God will bless you in everything you do.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gotuba ebibe biabo, gose kobitinyia korwa ase obosio bwao, ekiagera bagerire kwabeire nendamwamu asetore intwe abaagachi.”
english: Do not cover up their guilt or blot out their sins from your sight, for they have thrown insults in the face of the builders.

ekegusii: Tobaisa kogania chindagera chiaye chinyansu, ekiagera nigo chire echi’obong’ainereria.
english: Do not crave his delicacies, for that food is deceptive.

ekegusii: Omonto tabaisa kweng’aina ere omonyene. Onye omonto ase egati yaino bwerorire ng’a nomonyasemi are ase ense eye, tiga ekore omoriri, erinde anyare koba omonyasemi.
english: Do not deceive yourselves. If any one of you thinks he is wise by the standards of this age, he should become a "fool" so that he may become wise.

ekegusii: Timokora ense eyio ase momenyete ebe etachenegeti, ekiagera inche nigo imenyete ase egati yaino. Inche ninche Omonene imenyete ase egati y’abanto baane Abaisraeli.”
english: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell, for I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.'"

ekegusii: Timobaisa gwekora okogechia ase engencho y’ebitongwa ebio bigoetanana, gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho ya birobio. Moise gokora igo, namobe abatachenegeti.
english: Do not defile yourselves by any of these creatures. Do not make yourselves unclean by means of them or be made unclean by them.

ekegusii: Timorinana otatiga mwancheranire ase egeka egeke, erinde monyare kwerua ase ogosaba; naende mobe amo, Saitani tacha kobateema ekiagera motanyare gwetanga.
english: Do not deprive each other except by mutual consent and for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again so that Satan will not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa korina omonto omomenyi, gose entakana, oboronge bwaye, na toira eanga y’omoboraka ebe intenenera.
english: Do not deprive the alien or the fatherless of justice, or take the cloak of the widow as a pledge.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’endagera tosaria emeremo ya Nyasae. Bionsi nebichenu; korende mbobe omonto oragere abande bagochwe ase engencho y’ebiakoria.
english: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for a man to eat anything that causes someone else to stumble.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gonsiria amo nabakori amabe na abasaria, abanto abagokwana amang’ana ’omorembe nabanto bande, korende ime ase chinkoro chiabo nigo babagechete.
english: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.

ekegusii: Do not eat any detestable thing.
english: “Timobaisa koria ng’iti ende yonsi y’okogechia.

ekegusii: “Eng’iti ekwete yoka enyene timoyeria. Monyare koyea omomenyi omenyete amo nainwe ase omochie oino, ayerie, gose moyeoonerie omonto bw’egesaku ekeao, korende inwe nabanto abachenu, mwatananire ase Omonene Nyasae oino. “Timobaisa koiyekera emanwa y’embori ime y’amabeere ’eng’ina.
english: Do not eat anything you find already dead. You may give it to an alien living in any of your towns, and he may eat it, or you may sell it to a foreigner. But you are a people holy to the LORD your God. Do not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.

ekegusii: Timobaisa koria ekeng’wanso ekio amo nemegati ebekire ememera; ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere morabe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera, eyio nemegati y’emechando, ekiagera ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri nigo mwaayererete gotama. Igo ase amatuko aino onsi more moyo mobe mokoinyora rituko mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri.
english: Do not eat it with bread made with yeast, but for seven days eat unleavened bread, the bread of affliction, because you left Egypt in haste-- so that all the days of your life you may remember the time of your departure from Egypt.

ekegusii: Mwerende, timoyaria. Ekero morakore ayare amaronge ase obosio bw’Omonene nigo erabe buya asemore na ase ororeria rwaino.
english: Do not eat it, so that it may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Do not eat the food of a stingy man, do not crave his delicacies;
english: Tobaisa koria endagera y’omonto ogokomogorera, gose tobaisa kogania chindagera chiaye chinyansu.

ekegusii: Timoria chinde imbese gose chiyekire ase amache, korende chionsi goika chisambwe nomorero amo nomotwe na ebirenge, ne chinyama chi’enda.
english: Do not eat the meat raw or cooked in water, but roast it over the fire-- head, legs and inner parts.

ekegusii: Tibwancha ogosoerwa igoro y’omogaaka otatiga, ase amang’ana ’abarori babere gose batato.
english: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder unless it is brought by two or three witnesses.

ekegusii: Tobaisa koba ne ribero ase omonto otari gokora ay’oboronge, gose tobaisa kwega chinchera chiaye,
english: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways,

ekegusii: Aye tobaisa koba ne ribero ase abakori amabe, gose togania koba amo nabarabwo,
english: Do not envy wicked men, do not desire their company;

ekegusii: Tobaisa gwetang’anania ase obosio bw’omoruoti, gose tobaisa kwebeka aase abanene bare.
english: Do not exalt yourself in the king's presence, and do not claim a place among great men;

ekegusii: Tobaisa koura omotaka ekiaye, ekiagera are omotaka, gose agwo ase egeita tobaisa gokorera bobe omonto ochandegete.
english: Do not exploit the poor because they are poor and do not crush the needy in court,

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abasomba baane, timoiroka, ekiagera inche nigo inde amo nainwe. Ninsirie kegima ebisaku bionsi ebio ase nabasiarerete gochia, korende inwe tinkobasiria kegima. Nimbae inwe egesusuro gi’okobarongeyia ase oboronge, tinkobatiga nonya ng’ake timbaa egesusuro.”
english: Do not fear, O Jacob my servant, for I am with you," declares the LORD. "Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only with justice; I will not let you go entirely unpunished."

ekegusii: Nigo babakanetie ng’a timobaisa koonchokera chinyasae ching’ao ase ogochikorera na gochisasima; mobaise kogechia Omonene abe nendamwamu ase emeremo y’amaboko aino. Moise koigwera amang’ana ayio, rirorio Omonene takobaa egesusuro.
english: Do not follow other gods to serve and worship them; do not provoke me to anger with what your hands have made. Then I will not harm you."

ekegusii: Timobaisa gosasima chinyasae chinde chionsi chiria chi’abanto babaetanaine.
english: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you;

ekegusii: na timobaisa kweba okobwatana kw’ogotianania koria nakorete nainwe. Timobaisa koiroka chinyasae chinde ching’ao,
english: Do not forget the covenant I have made with you, and do not worship other gods.

ekegusii: Timweba koroisia abageni, naki ase enchera eye abande mbaroisetie abamalaika, batamanyete.
english: Do not forget to entertain strangers, for by so doing some people have entertained angels without knowing it.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga obong’aini, ekiagera borobwo mbokorende. Obwanche, na borobwo mbogere ogenderere koba buya.
english: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will watch over you.

ekegusii: Tobaisa kweba omosani oo, na omosani o iso; rituko kwanyorire emechando togenda ase enka y’oyomino. Mbuya koba nomogisangio ase engaki eyio, kobua koba noyominto omenyete aare.
english: Do not forsake your friend and the friend of your father, and do not go to your brother's house when disaster strikes you-- better a neighbor nearby than a brother far away.

ekegusii: Aye togechigwa ase engencho y’abagokora amabe, gose tobaisa koba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.
english: Do not fret because of evil men or be envious of the wicked,

ekegusii: Tobaisa korigereria edivai koyabariirire, ekero ekobera ase egekombe na koirana inse ng’ora ng’ora.
english: Do not gaze at wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly!

ekegusii: Naende timotinda ase edivai, ekiagera ase eyio inamoirwe ase obonyaka, korende moichorwe n’Omoika.
english: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to debauchery. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.

ekegusii: Aye omobisa one, togokera okogwa kwane; ekero ndagwe, nintenene naende; ekero ndabe inde ase omosunte, Omonene nabe etaya yane.
english: Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will rise. Though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.

ekegusii: Do not gloat when your enemy falls; when he stumbles, do not let your heart rejoice,
english: Tobaisa kogoka ekero omobisa oo agure, na enkoro yao tebaisa gosasoka ekero agochirwe.

ekegusii: Timosoka isiko kogenda ase emegondo, gose timotaara ase enchera, ekiagera ababisa baino babwate emioro nao bare, na obwoba bwabeire ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: Do not go out to the fields or walk on the roads, for the enemy has a sword, and there is terror on every side.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gochora amasabibu atigarete, gose agwete inse, ase emegondo yaino y’emesabibu; ayio motigere abataka na abamenyi. Inche ninche Omonene Nyasae oino.
english: Do not go over your vineyard a second time or pick up the grapes that have fallen. Leave them for the poor and the alien. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Timobaisa kogenda; moise gokora igo, rirorio nigo mogochia goitwa nababisa baino, ekiagera Omonene tari amo nainwe.
english: Do not go up, because the LORD is not with you. You will be defeated by your enemies,

ekegusii: Omonene, tobaisa koa abakori amabe aya baganetie; tobaisa gosesenia emeroberio yabo emebe, babaise gwetogia.
english: do not grant the wicked their desires, O LORD; do not let their plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah

ekegusii: Tobaisa korua omoyo one, inche riruma riao, ase omoganda oria omobe; tibweba nonya ng’ake abanto bao abwo baregire.
english: Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts; do not forget the lives of your afflicted people forever.

ekegusii: Timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino, buna abakoro bakorete aaria Meriba; na buna bakorete ase rituko riria aaria Masa agwo ase erooro.
english: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the desert,

ekegusii: timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino, buna ekero keria gi’okogechia, ase rituko riria ri’ogoteemwa agwo ase erooro.
english: do not harden your hearts as you did in the rebellion, during the time of testing in the desert,

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotwara ebimunu bikorenga bibere ase chinyomba chiaino, ekemo ekenene, na ekende egeke.
english: Do not have two differing measures in your house-- one large, one small.

ekegusii: “Timobaisa koba nebirengo bibere ase chisaro chiaino, ekemo ekenene na ekende egeke.
english: Do not have two differing weights in your bag-- one heavy, one light.

ekegusii: Tobaisa kobisa obosio bwao korwa asende ase engaki inde nemechando, integerere onyigwe, ong’iranerie bwango ase rituko ngokorangeria.
english: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one ore ogotooreka kwane, tobisa obosio bwao korwa asende; tontiga kore nendamwamu. Aye kwabeire kogonkonya botambe, tontuguta gose tontiga.
english: Do not hide your face from me, do not turn your servant away in anger; you have been my helper. Do not reject me or forsake me, O God my Savior.

ekegusii: Tobisa obosio bwao korwa asende inche omosomba oo; inyigwe bwango, ekiagera inche nigo inde ase emechando emenene.
english: Do not hide your face from your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gotoa intwe egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe bie chisokoro chiaito; otorotote namabera ao bwango, ekiagera twabeire bosa kegima.
english: Do not hold against us the sins of the fathers; may your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are in desperate need.

ekegusii: Do not ignore the clamor of your adversaries, the uproar of your enemies, which rises continually.
english: Tobaisa kweba okwoga kw’ababisa bao, ne riroroche ri’abakogochecheria rigotiira botambe.

ekegusii: Inwe tiga emeremo egokorwa ase enyomba eyio ya Nyasae egenderere; tiga omogavuna bw’Abayahudi, na abagaaka babo bagenderere koagacha naende enyomba ya Nyasae aase yarenge.
english: Do not interfere with the work on this temple of God. Let the governor of the Jews and the Jewish elders rebuild this house of God on its site.

ekegusii: Timobaisa konyuomerana nabarabwo; timorua abana baino abaiseke ase abamura babo, gose timonyuomeria abana abamura baino abaiseke babo,
english: Do not intermarry with them. Do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons,

ekegusii: Tobaisa koba ase egati y’abagotinda nedivai, gose ase egati y’abakoria chinyama bobe,
english: Do not join those who drink too much wine or gorge themselves on meat,

ekegusii: Timotigaria gento kende goika mambia; onye kende kegotigara goika mambia mogesambe nomorero gesire.
english: Do not leave any of it till morning; if some is left till morning, you must burn it.

ekegusii: Inwe timobaisa gosoka isiko goetania egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, korende mobeereo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, goika amatuko ’ogwatanana kwaino aere.
english: Do not leave the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are completed, for your ordination will last seven days.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gosoka isiko goetania egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, ekiagera mwatananirwe ase ogoakwa amaguta ’Omonene.” Barabwo bagakora buna Musa abatebetie.
english: Do not leave the entrance to the Tent of Meeting or you will die, because the LORD's anointing oil is on you." So they did as Moses said.

ekegusii: Ogokwana okobe tikorua ase emenwa yaino, korende okore okuya na okoranyare kobaa obuya abwo bagokoigwa na koagacha abaganeirie koagachwa.
english: Do not let any unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building others up according to their needs, that it may benefit those who listen.

ekegusii: Timoa monto onde ribaga ri’okobaura inwe ekeegwa kiaino ase okorigia kwaye ase okweororobia na ase ogosasima abamalaika, na kwebeka ase amaroro aya arorire, na koenena bosa ase ebirengererio biaye bi’obobe,
english: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you for the prize. Such a person goes into great detail about what he has seen, and his unspiritual mind puffs him up with idle notions.

ekegusii: Totiga Miriamu abe buna oyokure, buna omonto oiboretwe ne chinyama ekeng’ese, chianiarokeire inda, chiaerire.”
english: Do not let her be like a stillborn infant coming from its mother's womb with its flesh half eaten away."

ekegusii: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abaebererie ng’a mosemerie Omonene, ekero agoteba: Ekeene, Omonene natotoorie, na omochie oyio tokobekwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
english: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says, 'The LORD will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.'

ekegusii: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abasirie ng’a mosemerie Omonene ekero agoteba: Ekeene, Omonene natotoorie, na omochie oyo tokobekwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
english: Do not let Hezekiah persuade you to trust in the LORD when he says, 'The LORD will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.'

ekegusii: Totiga emerindo entube, gose chindiba chimere, gose engoro emumekerie.
english: Do not let the floodwaters engulf me or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga abanto abwo bagokorerwa bobe basookigwe; tiga abanto abataka na abwo baremeire batogie erieta riao.
english: Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace; may the poor and needy praise your name.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibamenya ase ense yao, babaise kogera onkorere ebibe. Onye kogokorera chinyasae chiabo, chirochio nachinyare kogotega.”
english: Do not let them live in your land, or they will cause you to sin against me, because the worship of their gods will certainly be a snare to you."

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio tabaisa korua ase amaiso ao. Yagache ime ase enkoro yao.
english: Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart;

ekegusii: Tobatiga batebe, “Bono twamonyorire buna twaganetie.” Tobatiga batebe, “Bono twamobuire.”
english: Do not let them think, "Aha, just what we wanted!" or say, "We have swallowed him up."

ekegusii: Amang’ana ’ebuku eye y’amachiko oyakwane botambe nomonwa oo, oyairanerere omobaso na obotuko, obwate na okore onsi ayarikireo. Erio nario orasesenigwe mono ase chinchera chiao chionsi.
english: Do not let this Book of the Law depart from your mouth; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.

ekegusii: Enkoro yao tebaisa koba ne ribero ase abanyene ebibe, korende aye ogenderere komoiroka Omonene kera rituko.
english: Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always be zealous for the fear of the LORD.

ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaino tichibaisa koonchorwa na kobwatia chingencho chi’omokungu buna oyio; gose orogendo rwaye tirobaisa gosiria obogima bwaino.
english: Do not let your heart turn to her ways or stray into her paths.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga amang’ana ’omonwa oo agere okore ebibe, gose tobaisa gotebia omomalaika o Nyasae ng’a oko nokomocha gwakora. Nase ki oragere Nyasae agechigwe nogokwana kwao, na asarie emeremo y’amaboko ao?
english: Do not let your mouth lead you into sin. And do not protest to the [temple] messenger, "My vow was a mistake." Why should God be angry at what you say and destroy the work of your hands?

ekegusii: Aye omokori amabe, tobaisa koboera omonyene oboronge ase amenyete, tosaria aase aye agotimokera.
english: Do not lie in wait like an outlaw against a righteous man's house, do not raid his dwelling place;

ekegusii: Timotebania oborimo, inwe abamwarusirie obomwanyabanto bwa kare amo nogokora kwaye,
english: Do not lie to each other, since you have taken off your old self with its practices

ekegusii: Ee, timobaisa gochiimokereria igoro ase ogwekaga, gose gokwana amabe, inwe abamore abanyabigoti bikong’u.”
english: Do not lift your horns against heaven; do not speak with outstretched neck.'"

ekegusii: Timobaisa gouta omorero ase rituko ri’Esabato, aande onsi ase momenyete.”
english: Do not light a fire in any of your dwellings on the Sabbath day."

ekegusii: Timobaisa koigwera amang’ana ’ababani abwo bakobatebia ng’a: Timokorera omoruoti o Babeli. Ase ogoteba igo, obwo noborimo.
english: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who say to you, 'You will not serve the king of Babylon,' for they are prophesying lies to you.

ekegusii: Timobaisa kobaigwera; inwe korera omoruoti o Babeli, nario morabe moyo. Nase ki omochie oyo orasarigwe obe amaturi?
english: Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and you will live. Why should this city become a ruin?

ekegusii: Tobaisa kogania ng’a obotuko boria boche, obwo abanto baraitwe basirigwe.
english: Do not long for the night, to drag people away from their homes.

ekegusii: Timokwa emioyo, gose timoiroka, ekero moraigwe amang’ana agocha ase ense. Omwaka oyomo nigo moraigwe amang’ana gete, na omwaka onde moigwe ayande. Boigo obotindi nigo bore ase ense, na omogambi oyomo nigo akorwana noyonde.
english: Do not lose heart or be afraid when rumors are heard in the land; one rumor comes this year, another the next, rumors of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.

ekegusii: Do not love sleep or you will grow poor; stay awake and you will have food to spare.
english: Tobaisa gwancha chitoro, obaise koba omotaka; ramokia amaiso ao, naye nonyore endagera enyinge.

ekegusii: Timwancha ense eye, nonya nebinto bireo ase ense. Omonto karanche ense eye, obwanchani bwa Tata tibori ime yaye.
english: Do not love the world or anything in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

ekegusii: Tobaisa komogania ase enkoro yao ime ase engencho y’ekieni kiaye ekiya; amaiso aye tabaisa gokong’usa.
english: Do not lust in your heart after her beauty or let her captivate you with her eyes,

ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora okobwatana konde gwonsi nabarabwo, gose ne chinyasae chiabo.
english: Do not make a covenant with them or with their gods.

ekegusii: Do not make any gods to be alongside me; do not make for yourselves gods of silver or gods of gold.
english: Timwekorera chinyasae chinde chie chifeta gose echie chitahabu chi’ogosasimwa; monsasime inche bweka.

ekegusii: Timweroiseria amanukato ande onsi y’ogosambwa anga buna ayio. Abe asemore amachenu ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Do not make any incense with this formula for yourselves; consider it holy to the LORD.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gokora obosani nomonto ore omwango ase okobeea gose tobaisa kogenda amo nomonto ore nekeririanda.
english: Do not make friends with a hot-tempered man, do not associate with one easily angered,

ekegusii: Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says.
english: Mobe abakori be ring’ana; timoba abakoigwa rioka, na kweng’aina inwe abanyene.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gotumana orobebe orokoro, gose totumana osoe ase emegondo ye chintakana,
english: Do not move an ancient boundary stone or encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

ekegusii: Do not move an ancient boundary stone set up by your forefathers.
english: Tobaisa gotumana orobebe orokoro orwo chisokoro chiao chiabegete.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gotumana orobebe ronde rwonsi rw’omogisangio oo, orwo abanto ba kare babegete ase orogongo rw’omwando oria oraegwe ase ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, arakoe ebe eyao.
english: Do not move your neighbor's boundary stone set up by your predecessors in the inheritance you receive in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa kobekera eng’ombe ekeokio ekero ekoora endagera.
english: Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain.

ekegusii: Totiga gokorera ekeegwa keria kwaetwe ase enchera y’obobani, ekero ekeombe ki’abagaaka giakobekerete amaboko.
english: Do not neglect your gift, which was given you through a prophetic message when the body of elders laid their hands on you.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gosamba ubani eye etachikiri, gose ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timobaisa koumora okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa igoro yaye.
english: Do not offer on this altar any other incense or any burnt offering or grain offering, and do not pour a drink offering on it.

ekegusii: Timobaisa korua ebiimo biaino bikore ebibe buna ebikorero bi’obobe, korende mwerue abanyene ase Nyasae buna abanto barusetigwe korwa ase ogokwa na babekirwe ase obogima, na ebiimo biaino ase Nyasae bibe ebikorero bi’oboronge.
english: Do not offer the parts of your body to sin, as instruments of wickedness, but rather offer yourselves to God, as those who have been brought from death to life; and offer the parts of your body to him as instruments of righteousness.

ekegusii: Timobaisa konduera ching’iti chiukorete, gose chire ebisegora, gose ebirema, gose chire namaote akorua amaira, gose chibwate egesuneri, gose amaote, ng’a chibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende.
english: Do not offer to the LORD the blind, the injured or the maimed, or anything with warts or festering or running sores. Do not place any of these on the altar as an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Timokorera ababoraka bobe, gose chintakana, gose abamenyi bare ase egati yaino, gose abataka. Omonto tabaisa koroberia ase enkoro yaye akorere oyomwabo bobe.
english: Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the alien or the poor. In your hearts do not think evil of each other.'

ekegusii: Tobaisa gotegerera amang’ana onsi abanto bagokwana, nigo orabaise koigwa omosomba oo ogokoragereria.
english: Do not pay attention to every word people say, or you may hear your servant cursing you--

ekegusii: Timobaisa koonchorana oboronge, gose gwanchereria abanto, gose timoegwa riaaki, ekiagera riaaki nigo rikoukoria amaiso ’abang’aini, naende nigo rikoonchorana na korina abanyaboronge oboronge bwabo.
english: Do not pervert justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosimeka chimbusuro chi’ebisaku bibere ase omogondo oo bw’emesabibu; oise gokora bo okwama kwao gwonsi ogw’echio gwasimegete amo nokw’emesabibu nigo korairwe kobe ogw’Aase Aachenu.
english: Do not plant two kinds of seed in your vineyard; if you do, not only the crops you plant but also the fruit of the vineyard will be defiled.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gokora emeroberio emebe ase chinkoro chiaino ase ogokorerana bobe inwe ase inwe, gose timobaisa gwancha gotiana ogotiana kw’oborimo, ekiagera amang’ana ayio onsi nigo inyagechete. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: do not plot evil against your neighbor, and do not love to swear falsely. I hate all this," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Do not plot harm against your neighbor, who lives trustfully near you.
english: Tobaisa gokora emeroberio gokorera omonto omino bobe; oyio omenyete amo naye, ogosemeretie ng’a anyore oborendi obuya.

ekegusii: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together.
english: “Gokorema, tobaisa gosiberania eng’ombe na etigere ching’use obokombe amo.

ekegusii: Tabaisa goakwa ase emebere ya mwanyabanto. Timoroisia amaguta ande anga buna ayio. Ayio namachenu, nabe amachenu asemore.
english: Do not pour it on men's bodies and do not make any oil with the same formula. It is sacred, and you are to consider it sacred.

ekegusii: Timobaisa korentera erieta riane obosooku, korende nincheneke ase Abaisraeli. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.
english: Do not profane my holy name. I must be acknowledged as holy by the Israelites. I am the LORD, who makes you holy

ekegusii: timobaisa korwana nabarabwo, ekiagera tinkobaa inwe ense yabo nonya nensemo enke eisaine egesanyi gi’okogoro, ekiagera naeire abanto b’ororeria rw’Esau ense y’ebitunwa ya Seiri ebe eyabo.
english: Do not provoke them to war, for I will not give you any of their land, not even enough to put your foot on. I have given Esau the hill country of Seir as his own.

ekegusii: Timorimia Omoika!
english: Do not put out the Spirit's fire;

ekegusii: Timobaisa gosemeria abagambi, gose mwanyabanto abwo batanyare gokonya kende.
english: Do not put your trust in princes, in mortal men, who cannot save.

ekegusii: Timobaisa kogesa echikwemeria korwa ase chimbusuro chiagwete, gose timosangereria amasabibu ’emesabibu etacheretwe. Oyio nigo orabe omwaka bw’ogotimoka kegima gw’ense eyio.
english: Do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the grapes of your untended vines. The land is to have a year of rest.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gokurera omonto omochayi; oyio nigo arakogeche. Kurera omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo aragwanche.
english: Do not rebuke a mocker or he will hate you; rebuke a wise man and he will love you.

ekegusii: Totogonyera omogaaka, korende omosorore buna iso, abamura abake buna bamura bamino,
english: Do not rebuke an older man harshly, but exhort him as if he were your father. Treat younger men as brothers,

ekegusii: Inwe Abafilisti mwensi, timobaisa kogoka ng’a enyimbo eria yabaagete yabunirwe; korwa ase ritina ri’eng’iti eria ende ere nobosongo obotindi nesoke, na korwa ase eyio enchoka ekoiruruka netuboke.
english: Do not rejoice, all you Philistines, that the rod that struck you is broken; from the root of that snake will spring up a viper, its fruit will be a darting, venomous serpent.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, timobaisa kogoka gose gochenga buna abanto b’ebisaku bagokora, ekiagera inwe mwakorire obotomani, mwatigire Nyasae oino. Mwagokeire eng’eria y’obotomani ase kera ekeooreri gi’okoorera.
english: Do not rejoice, O Israel; do not be jubilant like the other nations. For you have been unfaithful to your God; you love the wages of a prostitute at every threshing floor.

ekegusii: Timoakana omonto obobe ase obobe, tang’ania ayere amaya ase amasio ’abanto bonsi.
english: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Be careful to do what is right in the eyes of everybody.

ekegusii: Timoakanana amabe ase amabe, gose okorama ase okorama, korende ribaga ri’ayio mobe abamogosesenania, ekiagera ayio naro mwarangererigwe, ng’a monyore omwando bw’ogosesenigwa.
english: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult, but with blessing, because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing.

ekegusii: Tobaisa koragereria omoruoti nonya nase ebirengererio biao, gose tobaisa koragereria omonto omonda ekero ore ase akanyomba kao g’okorara. Oise gokora bo, enyoni nebaise koira amang’ana ao, gose egetongwa kere ne chimbaba ngetebe amang’ana ayio.
english: Do not revile the king even in your thoughts, or curse the rich in your bedroom, because a bird of the air may carry your words, and a bird on the wing may report what you say.

ekegusii: Tobaisa kobagambera nobotindi, korende aye omoiroke Nyasae oo.
english: Do not rule over them ruthlessly, but fear your God.

ekegusii: Renda amagoro aino, timobaisa koba motari nebikoroto, naende timobaisa koba nerang’o. Korende inwe nigo mogoteba: Ayio namang’ana a bosa; nigo twanchete chinyasae chingeni, na echio chioka nachio torabe tokobwatia.
english: Do not run until your feet are bare and your throat is dry. But you said, 'It's no use! I love foreign gods, and I must go after them.'

ekegusii: “Timobaisa korua eng’iti ende yonsi, chiombe, gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori, eyere na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ase Omonene, Nyasae oino. Eyio nigo ere okogechia asare.
english: Do not sacrifice to the LORD your God an ox or a sheep that has any defect or flaw in it, for that would be detestable to him.

ekegusii: Ekero obwate egento ase engaki eyio kware koa omonto omino, tobaisa komotebia, “Genda ochiche ankio, nario ndagekoe.”
english: Do not say to your neighbor, "Come back later; I'll give it tomorrow"-- when you now have it with you.

ekegusii: Do not say, "I'll do to him as he has done to me; I'll pay that man back for what he did."
english: Tobaisa goteba, “Goika nainche imokorere buna ankorera; goika imoakane buna ogokora kwaye kore.”

ekegusii: Tobaisa goteba, “Goika ng’akane amabe nakoreirwe.” Oganye Omonene, nere oragokonye.
english: Do not say, "I'll pay you back for this wrong!" Wait for the LORD, and he will deliver you.

ekegusii: Tobaisa goteba, “Nase ki amatuko a kare arenge amaya kobua aya bono?” Okoboria okwo tikori okw’obong’aini.
english: Do not say, "Why were the old days better than these?" For it is not wise to ask such questions.

ekegusii: Inwe erende mono, timobaisa goteba: Intwe twanyorire obong’aini. Nyasae nere orabue Ayubu na amoiyerie, tari mwanyabanto.
english: Do not say, 'We have found wisdom; let God refute him, not man.'

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aino onsi more moyo, timobaisa kobarigeria omorembe, gose ogosesenigwa.
english: Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them as long as you live.

ekegusii: Korende timogenda Beteli, gose timosoa Giligali, gose timogenda goika Beeri‐Seba, ekiagera abanto ba Giligali mbairwe ase obosomba, na Beteli nosirigwe kegima.”
english: do not seek Bethel, do not go to Gilgal, do not journey to Beersheba. For Gilgal will surely go into exile, and Bethel will be reduced to nothing."

ekegusii: Tobaisa kobwatia enchera y’abakori amabe, gose tobwatia chinchera chi’abanto ababe.
english: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evil men.

ekegusii: “Timobaisa koremera Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, omote onde bwensi, komenta ase egesasimero moraagachere Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole beside the altar you build to the LORD your God,

ekegusii: Timoba nogwanchereria komokonacha ebina; mokore boronge, abe omonto omoke gose omonene. Timoiroka omonto onde bwensi, ekiagera ekina nekia Nyasae. Ekina kende gionsi kere egekong’u asemore, mokendetere, na inche ningetegerere.
english: Do not show partiality in judging; hear both small and great alike. Do not be afraid of any man, for judgment belongs to God. Bring me any case too hard for you, and I will hear it.

ekegusii: Timobaisa konyenya eng’ombe amo nemori yaye ase rituko erimo, gose eng’ondi, gose embori amo ne chimanwa chiabo ase rituko erimo.
english: Do not slaughter a cow or a sheep and its young on the same day.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korusia nonya ng’ake ring’ana ri’ekeene korwa ase omonwa one, ekiagera nigo nsemeretie aya gwachikire.
english: Do not snatch the word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in your laws.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gokwana amang’ana ao ase omonto omoriri aigwete, ekiagera nigo arachaye obong’aini bw’amang’ana ao.
english: Do not speak to a fool, for he will scorn the wisdom of your words.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gosireria chinguru chiao ase abakungu, gose chinchera chiao ase barabwo, ekiagera nigo bagosiria abaruoti.
english: do not spend your strength on women, your vigor on those who ruin kings.

ekegusii: Timobaisa kondigereria, ekiagera inde omomwamu ti; nomobaso bw’erioba onsambire. Abamura ba baba nigo bambeete, bakambeka korenda emegondo y’emesabibu, korende omogondo one bw’emesabibu tinarendete.
english: Do not stare at me because I am dark, because I am darkened by the sun. My mother's sons were angry with me and made me take care of the vineyards; my own vineyard I have neglected.

ekegusii: Togobera gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee. Rusia okogoro kwao korwa ase ebibe.
english: Do not swerve to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto okoa omonto onde egento singo, taira orogena gose ensio bibe intenenera, ekiagera igo nobogima bwaye akoira bobe intenenera.
english: Do not take a pair of millstones-- not even the upper one-- as security for a debt, because that would be taking a man's livelihood as security.

ekegusii: Do not take a purse or bag or sandals; and do not greet anyone on the road.
english: Timobogoria ekemoya, gose esaro, gose ebikoroto; gose timokwania monto nchera.

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gokorera bobe omonto omorikwa ore omotaka na oremeire, karabe omonto omino Omoisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase ense yaino.
english: Do not take advantage of a hired man who is poor and needy, whether he is a brother Israelite or an alien living in one of your towns.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gokorerana oborianania, korende moiroke Nyasae oino, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: Do not take advantage of each other, but fear your God. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Timobogoria chitahabu, gose chifeta, gose chitaai ase ebimoya biaino.
english: Do not take along any gold or silver or copper in your belts;

ekegusii: Tosiria omoyo one ekero ogosiria abanyabibe; gose obogima bwane ekero ogosiria abaiti.
english: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, my life with bloodthirsty men,

ekegusii: Tobaisa kwenyorera ebitoki, gose okomentekana konde korwa asare, korende aye omoiroke Nyasae oo, na otige omonto oyio omino amenye bwoo.
english: Do not take interest of any kind from him, but fear your God, so that your countryman may continue to live among you.

ekegusii: Abanchwa, timorigia kweruseria egesiomba, tiga ribaga ase endamwamu ya Nyasae, ekiagera nerikire, “Omonene otebire: Egesiomba nekiane; inche ning’akane.”
english: Do not take revenge, my friends, but leave room for God's wrath, for it is written: "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," says the Lord.

ekegusii: Tokaga ng’a inche, omosomba oo, nomokungu otagwenereti, naki ase engaki eye yonsi nabeire ngokwana ase engencho y’emechando yane na ogoichana kwane.”
english: Do not take your servant for a wicked woman; I have been praying here out of my great anguish and grief."

ekegusii: “Timobaisa goteema Omonene, Nyasae oino, buna mwamoteemete aaria Masa.
english: Do not test the LORD your God as you did at Massah.

ekegusii: Do not testify against your neighbor without cause, or use your lips to deceive.
english: Tobaisa koba kirori o bosa mamincha y’omonto onde, na tobaisa kong’ainereria nebikoba biao.

ekegusii: Do not those who plot evil go astray? But those who plan what is good find love and faithfulness.
english: Inee! Abwo bakoroberia ayare amabe tibari gosira? Na abwo bakoroberia amaya, Inee, tibari konyora amabera na ekeene?

ekegusii: do not treat prophecies with contempt.
english: Timochaya obobani,

ekegusii: Timoiroka, gose kwoboa! Inee! Tinabatebetie amang’ana ayio korwa kare na kobayamanyia? Inwe nigo more birori baane. Inee! Nyasae onde nareo, otatiga inche? Getare kende tikeri. Nimanyete ng’a kende tikeri.”
english: Do not tremble, do not be afraid. Did I not proclaim this and foretell it long ago? You are my witnesses. Is there any God besides me? No, there is no other Rock; I know not one."

ekegusii: Tobaisa kwegena omogisangio oo, gose gosemeria omosani oo. Orende amang’ana akorwa ase omonwa oo, nonya mokao tayamanya.
english: Do not trust a neighbor; put no confidence in a friend. Even with her who lies in your embrace be careful of your words.

ekegusii: Timobaisa kwegena amang’ana ’obong’ainereria ayio agotebwa: Mbuya tore. Eye nero Hekalu y’Omonene, eye nero Hekalu y’Omonene, eye nero Hekalu y’Omonene!
english: Do not trust in deceptive words and say, "This is the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD, the temple of the LORD!"

ekegusii: Timobaisa gosemeria obourereria, timobaisa koba nogosemeria kwa bosa ase ebinto bi’oboibi. Onye obotenenku bwaino bwabeire obonge, timobaisa kobosemeria.
english: Do not trust in extortion or take pride in stolen goods; though your riches increase, do not set your heart on them.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo arakoreke onye timokoonchoka aande, gochia ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee, timotiga nonya ne ring’ana erimo ri’ayio nabaeire ase rituko ria rero, erinde mogende gosasima chinyasae ching’ao na gochikorera.
english: Do not turn aside from any of the commands I give you today, to the right or to the left, following other gods and serving them.

ekegusii: Timoonchokera chinyasae chire bosa chitanyare kobakonya gose kobatooria, ekiagera nigo chire bosa.
english: Do not turn away after useless idols. They can do you no good, nor can they rescue you, because they are useless.

ekegusii: Tobaisa kondua ase ababisa baane bankore buna banchete; birori b’oborimo banyimokeire, bagontianera nobotindi.
english: Do not turn me over to the desire of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.

ekegusii: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.
english: “Tobaisa kobeka eanga eroiseranirie chiusi chi’amarionya na echi’egatani amo.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gwechanda mono ng’a obe omonda; tobaisa gosemeria obong’aini bwao omonyene.
english: Do not wear yourself out to get rich; have the wisdom to show restraint.

ekegusii: Timobaisa koreera omonto okure, gose komobokeria amagombo; korende momoreere mono oyochiire aare, ekiagera oyio takoirana naende korora ense yaye ase aiboreretwe.
english: Do not weep for the dead [king] or mourn his loss; rather, weep bitterly for him who is exiled, because he will never return nor see his native land again.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gotiga korongeyia omwana oo; koramoake ekeranya, tagochia gokwa.
english: Do not withhold discipline from a child; if you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

ekegusii: Tobaisa korina abaremerwa amaya aya bagwenerete konyora, onye ayio are ase okobua kwao kobak onya.
english: Do not withhold good from those who deserve it, when it is in your power to act.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tondina amabera ao! Obuya na obwegenwa bwao bindende botambe.
english: Do not withhold your mercy from me, O LORD; may your love and your truth always protect me.

ekegusii: Timokorera endagera egosareka korende, endagera ekobao goika obogima bwa kare na kare, eye Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto aranyare kobaa, ekiagera Nyasae Tata obekire ekemanyererio kiaye asare.”
english: Do not work for food that spoils, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. On him God the Father has placed his seal of approval."

ekegusii: “Tobaisa gosasima enyasae ende eng’ao, ekiagera Omonene nigo akorokwa Omonyaisemi, nere Nyasae bwe risemi.
english: Do not worship any other god, for the LORD, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.

ekegusii: do not yield to him or listen to him. Show him no pity. Do not spare him or shield him.
english: Tobaisa koebererigwa nere, gose komotegerera, gose komororera amabeebe, nonya nokomororera amabera gose komoegera.

ekegusii: Timokora ing’ana rinde rionsi ase okwegwenera na ase okweenenia, korende ase oboitongo kera omonto abare abande ng’a nabaya kobua ere omonyene.
english: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit, but in humility consider others better than yourselves.

ekegusii: Timokorera omoiseke oria ing’ana rinde; ere takorete okomocha kogwenerete aitwe, ekiagera amang’ana ayio nigo anga buna ekero omonto akorwania omonto onde omoao na komoita moeneno.
english: Do nothing to the girl; she has committed no sin deserving death. This case is like that of someone who attacks and murders his neighbor,

ekegusii: Naboigo orakore koranyore etigere yaye, gose eanga yaye, gose gento kende gionsi ki’oyomino gesirete; aye kogokenyora tobaisa koombia tomogekonyera.
english: Do the same if you find your brother's donkey or his cloak or anything he loses. Do not ignore it.

ekegusii: Ong’e boigo chimori chintangi chie chiombe, ne chimanwa chintangi chie ching’ondi. Ochitige chikoore amatuko atano na abere, ko rituko ria gatano na gatato ochindetere.
english: Do the same with your cattle and your sheep. Let them stay with their mothers for seven days, but give them to me on the eighth day.

ekegusii: Inee! Abwo batarogeti tibakorara amo ne chituoni chi’esegi chiagendete gochia aase abakure amo nebirwanero biabo bi’esegi, na emioro yabo ebekire inse y’emetwe yabo, na ebibe biabo bakorete tibiatubete amauga abo? Barabwo nigo barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo buna chituoni chi’esegi chigokora.
english: Do they not lie with the other uncircumcised warriors who have fallen, who went down to the grave with their weapons of war, whose swords were placed under their heads? The punishment for their sins rested on their bones, though the terror of these warriors had stalked through the land of the living.

ekegusii: Do this for each one, for as many as you prepare.
english: Buna koreng’ana omobaro bwe ching’iti echio chiraruegwe chibe ebing’wanso orabe, nokoruegwa kw’endagera naboigo korabe.

ekegusii: Komorakore ayio, amanyinga ’abanto batari na komocha atabaise goiterwa ase ense eye Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino, ase igo timokoba na komocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga.
english: Do this so that innocent blood will not be shed in your land, which the LORD your God is giving you as your inheritance, and so that you will not be guilty of bloodshed.

ekegusii: Kora iga: Rusia abaruoti, kera oyomo ase emeremo yaye, na ase amabaga abo obeke abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi.
english: Do this: Remove all the kings from their commands and replace them with other officers.

ekegusii: Naende buna morigetie abanto babakorere inwe, nainwe mobakorere bo.
english: Do to others as you would have them do to you.

ekegusii: Omonene, obakore buna gwakorete Abamidiani, na buna gwakorete Sisera na Yabini agwo ase orooche rwa Kisoni.
english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,

ekegusii: Inee! Abanto babere mbataarere amo onye tibabwataini?
english: Do two walk together unless they have agreed to do so?

ekegusii: Inee! Ntwaonchoire amachiko abe bosa ase okwegena okwo? Yaya, taibo! Nigo togwanchera amachiko.
english: Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? Not at all! Rather, we uphold the law.

ekegusii: Mokore ayare amaronge na amaya ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio nario erabe buya asemore, monyare gosoa na koira ense eria engiya Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabayee,
english: Do what is right and good in the LORD's sight, so that it may go well with you and you may go in and take over the good land that the LORD promised on oath to your forefathers,

ekegusii: Nonyare komanya omobaro bw’emetienyi chigokoora, naende nomanyete chingaki chikobiara?
english: Do you count the months till they bear? Do you know the time they give birth?

ekegusii: Inee! Aye nigo okorigereria omonto buna oyio? Nigo okondeta ase obosio bwao na kongambia ekina?
english: Do you fix your eye on such a one? Will you bring him before you for judgment?

ekegusii: Aye nobwate okoboko buna okwane inche Nyasae? Nonyare kogukura neriogi riao buna inche nkogukura?
english: Do you have an arm like God's, and can your voice thunder like his?

ekegusii: Do you have eyes but fail to see, and ears but fail to hear? And don't you remember?
english: More namaiso, ko timori korora? More namato, ko timori koigwa? Gose timoinyoreti?

ekegusii: Inee! Amaiso ao naya mwanyabanto are? Gose nigo okorora buna mwanyabanto akorora?
english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Do you see as a mortal sees?

ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete buna Nyasae agokora ochika ayio, naende buna agokora okomesa kwamoreka goetera ase amare,
english: Do you know how God controls the clouds and makes his lightning flash?

ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete buna areng’anetie amare, eyio ere emeremo y’ogokumia y’oria ore nobong’aini oboikeranu?
english: Do you know how the clouds hang poised, those wonders of him who is perfect in knowledge?

ekegusii: Nomanyete emeroberio ya igoro echikire? Nonyare koroberia okogamba kwabo igoro ase ense?
english: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set up [God's] dominion over the earth?

ekegusii: Inee! Kwana koigwa emeroberio y’obobisi bwa Nyasae? Aye nigo kwenyoreire obong’aini aye bweka?
english: Do you listen in on God's council? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

ekegusii: Naye oyeete chinguru egocharokera buna engige? Eriogi egochuria nigo rire ri’okoirokia.
english: Do you make him leap like a locust, striking terror with his proud snorting?

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mokorengereria ng’a amagn’ana ’omonto bwerusirie moyo nigo anga buna omwaga?
english: Do you mean to correct what I say, and treat the words of a despairing man as wind?

ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a ere oyobwatanigwe nomokungu omotayayi obeire omobere oyomo nere? Naki buna erikire, “Baria babere nababe omobere oyomo.”
english: Do you not know that he who unites himself with a prostitute is one with her in body? For it is said, "The two will become one flesh."

ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a abwo bakoamererania ase okominyoka chimbero, nigo bakominyoka bonsi, korende noyomo bweka okonyora eng’eria? Minyoka boigo, erinde moyenyore.
english: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.

ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a abachenu inabagambie ense? Na onye ense egocha kogambigwa nainwe, Inee, timoisaini kogamba ebina ebire ebike?
english: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?

ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a abatari noboronge tibakoira omwando bw’oboruoti bwa Nyasae? Timong’aineka; abanyaka tibakoira omwando bw’oboruoti bwa Nyasae, nonya nabasasimi emegwekano, gose abatomani, gose abakwerua ase okogania kw’omobere, gose abasacha abagwesaria nabasacha,
english: Do you not know that the wicked will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be deceived: Neither the sexually immoral nor idolaters nor adulterers nor male prostitutes nor homosexual offenders

ekegusii: Do you not know that we will judge angels? How much more the things of this life!
english: Timomanyeti ng’a ntogambie abamalaika? Tari kobua mono amang’ana ’obogima obo?

ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a emebere yaino nebiimo bia Kristo? Inee! Nimbogorie ebiimo bia Kirsto na kobikora bibe ebiimo bi’omokungu omotayayi? Yaya, nonya ng’ake!
english: Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ himself? Shall I then take the members of Christ and unite them with a prostitute? Never!

ekegusii: Gose timomanyeti ng’a emebere yaino ne Hekalu y’Omoika Omochenu ore ime yaino, oyo mwaeirwe na Nyasae? Na inwe timori abaino abanyene,
english: Do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit, who is in you, whom you have received from God? You are not your own;

ekegusii: Timomanyeti, baminto (inche nigo ngokwana nabwo bamanyete amachiko) ng’a amachiko nigo akogambera omonto ekero are moyo?
english: Do you not know, brothers-- for I am speaking to men who know the law-- that the law has authority over a man only as long as he lives?

ekegusii: Inee! Timwana komanya? Timwana koigwa? Timwana gotebigwa amang’ana ayio korwa omochakano? Timwana koyamanya korwa omochakano bw’oboroso bw’ense?
english: Do you not know? Have you not heard? Has it not been told you from the beginning? Have you not understood since the earth was founded?

ekegusii: Inee! Timwana komanya gose koigwa, ng’a Omonene nigo are Nyasae o kare na kare, na Omotongi bwe chinsinyo chi’ense? Ere tari kogoya gose korosa. Obong’aini bwaye tibokorigigwa bomanyekane buna bore.
english: Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary, and his understanding no one can fathom.

ekegusii: Inwe timori goteba: Yatigaire emetienyi ene, erio rigesa riche? Rora nabatebirie: Imokia amaiso aino, morigererie emegondo, ng’a yaikire koba emerabu ang’e ase rigesa.
english: Do you not say, 'Four months more and then the harvest'? I tell you, open your eyes and look at the fields! They are ripe for harvest.

ekegusii: Inee! Aye torochi amang’ana bagokora agwo ase emechie y’Abayuda, na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu?
english: Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

ekegusii: Oise korora omonto omanyete emeremo yaye buya, oyio natenene ase amasio ’abaruoti, tagokorera abanto bande bonsi emeremo.
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve before kings; he will not serve before obscure men.

ekegusii: Oise korora omonto ore omwango ase ogokwana, ogosemeria nkore ase omonto omoriri kobua ase oyio.
english: Do you see a man who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

ekegusii: Oise korora omonto ogwekora omong’aini, ogosemeria nkore ase omonto omoriri kobua ase oyio.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

ekegusii: Nonyare gotoma chinkoba chigende aase gete, erio chigotebie: Ee, nao tore aa?
english: Do you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, 'Here we are'?

ekegusii: Inee! Abakure nkobakorera ore amakumia? Inee! Abwo nkoimoka bare na kogotogia?
english: Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do those who are dead rise up and praise you? Selah

ekegusii: Timokomanya gose koinyora emegati eria etano ase baria chilifu isano, na ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie?
english: Do you still not understand? Don't you remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

ekegusii: Inee! Mokagete ng’a nigo nachire ng’ee ense omorembe? Nabatebirie, taibo, korende nogwatanana.
english: Do you think I came to bring peace on earth? No, I tell you, but division.

ekegusii: Do you think I cannot call on my Father, and he will at once put at my disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
english: Gose tomanyeti ng’a ninyare gosaba Tata, na ere nantomere abamalaika kobua emeganda ikomi na ebere?

ekegusii: Inee! Norigetie kong’ita buna gwaita Omomisiri oria igoro?
english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?'

ekegusii: Teema buna oranyare gocha asende bwango.
english: Do your best to come to me quickly,

ekegusii: Teema buna oranyare gocha ritang’ani obokendu botaracha. Eubulu ogokwanirie, naboigo Pudente na Lino, na Klaudia, na abaminto bonsi.
english: Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus greets you, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia and all the brothers.

ekegusii: Kora buna oranyare kweorokia ase obosio bwa Nyasae buna oyobwancheirwe nere, buna omokori emeremo oyotagwenereti gosookigwa, ogwatanana boronge ring’ana ri’ekeene.
english: Do your best to present yourself to God as one approved, a workman who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly handles the word of truth.

ekegusii: Inee! Enyoni nebwatwe onye tetegeiri obosugunia? Gose omoeto notegoke onye tobwateti gento?
english: Does a bird fall into a trap on the ground where no snare has been set? Does a trap spring up from the earth when there is nothing to catch?

ekegusii: Inee! Endo nerume ase rinani, onye teraita eke yare gotwara? Gose endo ensae nkoruma ere, onye terabwata kende ekoria?
english: Does a lion roar in the thicket when he has no prey? Does he growl in his den when he has caught nothing?

ekegusii: Inee! Omoiseke omwekungi nanyare kweba ebinto biaye bi’ogwechabera? Gose omoriakari nkweba are chianga chiaye chi’enyangi? Korende abanto baane banyebire ase amatuko amange mono.
english: Does a maiden forget her jewelry, a bride her wedding ornaments? Yet my people have forgotten me, days without number.

ekegusii: Does a wild donkey bray when it has grass, or an ox bellow when it has fodder?
english: Inee! Etigere y’orosana nkwana ere, ekero egotakuna obonyansi? Gose eng’ombe nkwana ere, ekero egendererete korisia?

ekegusii: Ere oyokobaa inwe Omoika na gokora ebikone bie chinguru egati yaino, Inee, igo agokora ayio ase ogokora kw’amachiko gose ase okwegena goetera ase okoigwa?
english: Does God give you his Spirit and work miracles among you because you observe the law, or because you believe what you heard?

ekegusii: Ekero emechando eramochere na ere arere ase Nyasae, Inee, namoigwe gose?
english: Does God listen to his cry when distress comes upon him?

ekegusii: Does God pervert justice? Does the Almighty pervert what is right?
english: Inee! Nyasae nanyare koonchorana ekeene? Gose Omonguru naonchorane ayare ay’oboronge?

ekegusii: Tatokorete buna abamenyi? Naki nigo atoonetie, naende akaria enibo eria yonsi.
english: Does he not regard us as foreigners? Not only has he sold us, but he has used up what was paid for us.

ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae tarochi chinchera chiane chionsi na kobara amatambokero aane onsi?”
english: Does he not see my ways and count my every step?

ekegusii: Oyo okorongeyia ebisaku, tari korua ebisusuro? Ere nigo akworokereria mwanyabanto bamanye obong’aini.
english: Does he who disciplines nations not punish? Does he who teaches man lack knowledge?

ekegusii: Does he who implanted the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?
english: Inee! Oyo otongete amato, tari koigwa? Ere oyo otongete amaiso, tari korora?

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ogokirie ase ogonchanda na gochaya emeremo y’amaboko ao, na gwanchera ogosemania kw’abakori amabe?
english: Does it please you to oppress me, to spurn the work of your hands, while you smile on the schemes of the wicked?

ekegusii: Does not the ear test words as the tongue tastes food?
english: Inee! Amang’ana ogoto gokoigwa, tikori koyateema buna oromeme rokomena rwaigwa endagera?”

ekegusii: Gose omokori chinyongo tari nokobua igoro ase esike, ase ribomba ri’esike gokora egento ekemo eki’ogosikwa, na ekende kebe getari nogosikwa?
english: Does not the potter have the right to make out of the same lump of clay some pottery for noble purposes and some for common use?

ekegusii: Ririko tiriri goteba ng’a Kristo nigo ararwe ase oroiboro rwa Daudi, naende ase Bethlehemu, agachie karia Daudi amenyete?”
english: Does not the Scripture say that the Christ will come from David's family and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?"

ekegusii: Inee! Engencho ya mwanyabanto teri kworokereria ng’a onye omosacha okoba netukia entambe nigo ere obosooku asare,
english: Does not the very nature of things teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,

ekegusii: Inee! Obong’aini tibori korangeria? Okomanya tikori goaka eriogi rinene?
english: Does not wisdom call out? Does not understanding raise her voice?

ekegusii: Inee! Egesire nkenyare gwetogia igoro y’oyio okogekorera emeremo? Gose omosumeno mbwekore koba nengencho enene kobua oyio okonacha noro? Aise koba bo, nanga nigo are gotebwa ng’a enyimbo nebogorie oyio oyebogoretie, gose egete nkebogorie oyio otari omote.
english: Does the ax raise itself above him who swings it, or the saw boast against him who uses it? As if a rod were to wield him who lifts it up, or a club brandish him who is not wood!

ekegusii: Inee! Naye ogochika ekeongo kiairuruka gochia igoro, kiaagacha egeswa kiaye aase a igoro mono?
english: Does the eagle soar at your command and build his nest on high?

ekegusii: Inee! Embura nebwate ise? Gose ning’o okoibora amatoima e riime?
english: Does the rain have a father? Who fathers the drops of dew?

ekegusii: Inee! Amagena ’embura a Lebanoni ana koruao atige ebitare bia igoro? Gose ebirooche bikorwa ase ebitare biana koborwa amache amakendu?
english: Does the snow of Lebanon ever vanish from its rocky slopes? Do its cool waters from distant sources ever cease to flow?

ekegusii: Chisese nigo ching’etanaine aande onsi, ee, ekeombe ki’abakori amabe nigo kere chinsemo chionsi; bambetire ebisanyi bi’amaboko, na ebi’amagoro boigo.
english: Dogs have surrounded me; a band of evil men has encircled me, they have pierced my hands and my feet.

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ore bw’enyomba ya Baasa orakwere ase omochie ime, chisese nachimorie, na onde bwensi orakwere isiko aarabu, chinyoni chia igoro nachimorie.”
english: Dogs will eat those belonging to Baasha who die in the city, and the birds of the air will feed on those who die in the country."

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi bw’enyomba ya Yeroboamu orakwere ase omochie ime, chisese nachimorie, na onde bwensi orakwere isiko aarabu, chinyoni chia igoro nachimorie, ekiagera Omonene nere okwanire ring’ana eri.
english: Dogs will eat those belonging to Jeroboam who die in the city, and the birds of the air will feed on those who die in the country. The LORD has spoken!'

ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, timong’aineka.
english: Don't be deceived, my dear brothers.

ekegusii: Gaki aye tibwancha, ekiagera abanto kobua emerongo ene bamoboeire, batiananirie ng’a tibakoria gose tibakonywa goika bamoitire; na barabwo nigo bare ang’e baganyete eira korwa asore.”
english: Don't give in to them, because more than forty of them are waiting in ambush for him. They have taken an oath not to eat or drink until they have killed him. They are ready now, waiting for your consent to their request."

ekegusii: Abaminto, timwemurunganerania, timocha kogambigwa. Rigereria, Omogambi nigo ateneine gesieri.
english: Don't grumble against each other, brothers, or you will be judged. The Judge is standing at the door!

ekegusii: Korende bwange amaborio ’oboriri atari aye chisemi. Kwamanyire ng’a ayio nigo ararente eriomana.
english: Don't have anything to do with foolish and stupid arguments, because you know they produce quarrels.

ekegusii: Inee! Tindi neribaga gokora buna ndigetie omonyene nebinto biane? Gose naki okorigereria neriso riibe, ekiagera inche inde omuya?
english: Don't I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Or are you envious because I am generous?'

ekegusii: Monto onde tabang’aina ase enchera ende yonsi, ekiagera rituko riria tirigocha ogwatananekana na ogotaigwera gotaracha, na omosaria bw’amachiko, omwana bw’obosiru, aorokigwe.
english: Don't let anyone deceive you in any way, for that day will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the man doomed to destruction.

ekegusii: Monto onde tagochaya ekiagera ore omosae, korende obe ekiorokererio ekiya ase abwo begenire, ase ogokwana, na ase orogendo, naende ase obwanchani, na okwegena, na obochenu.
english: Don't let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers in speech, in life, in love, in faith and in purity.
