ekegusii: Korende tobaisa kobanera aiga Beteli naende nonya ng’ake, ekiagera aiga naase aachenu a omoruoti, naende aa nao hekalu y’obogambi bwonsi.”
english: Don't prophesy anymore at Bethel, because this is the king's sanctuary and the temple of the kingdom."

ekegusii: Don't we have the right to food and drink?
english: Inee! Titori ne ribaga ri’okoria na konywa?

ekegusii: Titori ne ribaga koira amo naintwe omokungu ore oyominto ase okwegena buna abatomwa bande, na abamwabo Omonene, na Kefa bakorete?
english: Don't we have the right to take a believing wife along with us, as do the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Cephas?

ekegusii: Tibwegeneti ng’a inche nigo inde ime ya Tata, na Tata ime yane? Amang’ana aya inche nkobatebia, tindi gokwana ase okobua kwane, korende n’Tata ore ime yane nigo agokora emeremo yaye.
english: Don't you believe that I am in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words I say to you are not just my own. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work.

ekegusii: Inee! Timori ne chinyomba aase mokoragerera na konywera? Gose mwachayire ekanisa ya Nyasae na gosookia abwo batari na gento? Naki ndabatebie? Nimbatogie ase aya? Yaya, tinkobatogia.
english: Don't you have homes to eat and drink in? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What shall I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? Certainly not!

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe timomanyeti ng’a Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo aete Daudi, amo nororeria rwaye, oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli bobe asebare kare na kare, ase enchera y’okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’omonyo?
english: Don't you know that the LORD, the God of Israel, has given the kingship of Israel to David and his descendants forever by a covenant of salt?

ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a baria bagokora emeremo ase Hekalu nigo bakoria endagera korwa ase Hekalu, na baria bagokorera ase egesasimero mbare nensemo yabo ase ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso?
english: Don't you know that those who work in the temple get their food from the temple, and those who serve at the altar share in what is offered on the altar?

ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a onye mwerure ase omonto onde koba abasomba baye na komoigwera, nigo more abasomba baye ere oria moigwerete, onye nobosomba bw’ebibe obokoraa gochia ase amakweri, gose obosomba bw’okoigwera obokoraa gochia ase oboronge?
english: Don't you know that when you offer yourselves to someone to obey him as slaves, you are slaves to the one whom you obey-- whether you are slaves to sin, which leads to death, or to obedience, which leads to righteousness?

ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a inwe ne Hekalu ya Nyasae, na Omoika o Nyasae nigo omenyete ime yaino?
english: Don't you know that you yourselves are God's temple and that God's Spirit lives in you?

ekegusii: Don't you remember that when I was with you I used to tell you these things?
english: Inee! Timware koinyora ng’a ekero narenge amo nainwe inabatebetie ayio?

ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete ase ense eye, bono egeku nkobachera kere. Engaki yao yaikire; rituko ri’omoichano ngocha rire; tirikoba rituko ri’ogoaka amariogi ’omogoko igoro ase ebitunwa.
english: Doom has come upon you-- you who dwell in the land. The time has come, the day is near; there is panic, not joy, upon the mountains.

ekegusii: nigo rogoeta gati‐gati y’enchera enene y’omochie. Chinsemo chionsi ibere chi’orooche roria noreo omote bw’obogima, okwama amatunda aye ara ikomi na kabere; nigo okorua amatunda kera omotienyi, na amato ’omote oyio nigo akogwenia abanto b’ebisaku.
english: down the middle of the great street of the city. On each side of the river stood the tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, yielding its fruit every month. And the leaves of the tree are for the healing of the nations.

ekegusii: bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoaka amagena. Na abarori bakabeka chianga chiabo ase amagoro ’omomura oyomo, ore korokwa Saulo.
english: dragged him out of the city and began to stone him. Meanwhile, the witnesses laid their clothes at the feet of a young man named Saul.

ekegusii: Buucha amache oyagache, ekiagera noche koboerwa, okong’ie chiburi chiao. Soa ase engoro, otiringe esike, bwebeke ang’e obombe amatabori.
english: Draw water for the siege, strengthen your defenses! Work the clay, tread the mortar, repair the brickwork!

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, nigo baikaransete ase ebirogo biabo bi’oboruoti agwo ase ekeooreri ang’e negeita gia Samaria, babegete chianga chiabo chi’obonene, na ababani baria bonsi nigo barenge korua obobani bwabo ase amasio ’abaruoti baria.
english: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance of the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, nigo baikaransete ase ebirogo biabo bi’oboruoti, baikaransete agwo ase ekeooreri ang’e negeita gia Samaria, babegete chianga chiabo chi’obonene, na ababani baria bonsi nigo barenge korua obobani bwabo ase amaiso ’abaruoti baria.
english: Dressed in their royal robes, the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah were sitting on their thrones at the threshing floor by the entrance to the gate of Samaria, with all the prophets prophesying before them.

ekegusii: Kanywe amache okobucha korwa ase egesima kiao, na aya agosoka korwa ase ensoko yao.
english: Drink water from your own cistern, running water from your own well.

ekegusii: moserie abanto ababiare bonsi b’ense eria barue ase amasio aino. Naende mosarie emegwekano yabo eyio bagosasima eroisirie korwa ase ebioma binyititoire na kobombwa, motagore aase aimokererete igoro ase bagosasimera.
english: drive out all the inhabitants of the land before you. Destroy all their carved images and their cast idols, and demolish all their high places.

ekegusii: Drive out the mocker, and out goes strife; quarrels and insults are ended.
english: Seria omonyacheche, na eriomana ndiere, ee, eriomana na ogochaya mbisire.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo, ekero kie rigesa, abanto batato ase abwo abanene emerongo etato bakagenda ase Daudi maate ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu, na Abafilisti konya batoorire ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.
english: During harvest time, three of the thirty chief men came down to David at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

ekegusii: Ekero Abisalomu arenge moyo konya bweagacheire egento buna esiiro, agakebeka agwo ase Ense Omweya y’Omoruoti gekaba ekeinyorio ki’erieta riaye; akarengereria ng’a tari na monyamwando. Akayeroka ase erieta riaye omonyene; na goika rero iga nigo ekorokwa Ekeinyorio ki’Abisalomu.
english: During his lifetime Absalom had taken a pillar and erected it in the King's Valley as a monument to himself, for he thought, "I have no son to carry on the memory of my name." He named the pillar after himself, and it is called Absalom's Monument to this day.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ay’okogamba kwa Yehoyakimu, Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, agacha aroro, na Yehoyakimu akaba inse y’okogamba kwaye ase emiaka etato, korende nyuma y’ayio akaanga komoigwera.
english: During Jehoiakim's reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon invaded the land, and Jehoiakim became his vassal for three years. But then he changed his mind and rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Saulo arenge kogamba bakarwana esegi n’Abahagari, bakabaita, na barabwo bakamenya ase chiema chiabo agwo ase ense yonsi moocha ya Gileadi.
english: During Saul's reign they waged war against the Hagrites, who were defeated at their hands; they occupied the dwellings of the Hagrites throughout the entire region east of Gilead.

ekegusii: Abayuda na Abaisraeli nigo bamenyete nomorembe korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba; kera omonto nigo arenge nemezeituni yaye na emeko yaye, ase emiaka yonsi Sulemani abagamberete.
english: During Solomon's lifetime Judah and Israel, from Dan to Beersheba, lived in safety, each man under his own vine and fig tree.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’engaki entambe koyaetire omoruoti o Misiri agakwa. Abaisraeli bakaba bakwerera inse y’obosomba obwo, bakarera bakonywe, na ekerero kiabo kegaika igoro, ase Nyasae.
english: During that long period, the king of Egypt died. The Israelites groaned in their slavery and cried out, and their cry for help because of their slavery went up to God.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Imoka, otirimboke gochia ase egetwori kiabo obaumokere, ekiagera nakebekire ase amaboko ao.
english: During that night the LORD said to Gideon, "Get up, go down against the camp, because I am going to give it into your hands.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, ekero arenge ase omobere o mwanyabanto, Yeso agasaba na gosorora amo nokorera okonene, na amariga, asere oyorenge nokobua gw’okomotooria korwa ase amakweri, na akaigugwa ekiagera asigete Nyasae.
english: During the days of Jesus' life on earth, he offered up prayers and petitions with loud cries and tears to the one who could save him from death, and he was heard because of his reverent submission.

ekegusii: Osokie ebinto biao isiko mobaso kobaroche, ebinto buna ebi’oyo okong’anya korwa ase ense yaye, na rigoika mogoroba, ogende aye bweka kobaroche, buna oyo okong’anya korwa ase ense yaye.
english: During the daytime, while they watch, bring out your belongings packed for exile. Then in the evening, while they are watching, go out like those who go into exile.

ekegusii: Ase engaki yonsi y’emiaka emerongo ene Omonene abete okobaraa ase erooro. Chianga chiaino tichiabagoterete, gose ebikoroto biaino tibiabagoterete.
english: During the forty years that I led you through the desert, your clothes did not wear out, nor did the sandals on your feet.

ekegusii: Na ekero ki’oborendi bwa kane bwa botuko Yeso agacha asebare, ogotaara ase enyancha igoro.
english: During the fourth watch of the night Jesus went out to them, walking on the lake.

ekegusii: ekero ki’obokuani obonene bw’Anasi na Kayafa, ring’ana ria Nyasae rigaikera Yohana, omwana o Zakaria, ase erooro.
english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the desert.

ekegusii: Bwachia koba mambia, Omonene akaba origereretie omoganda bw’Abamisiri korwa ase esiiro y’omorero na eye riire, akabatantania.
english: During the last watch of the night the LORD looked down from the pillar of fire and cloud at the Egyptian army and threw it into confusion.

ekegusii: Bwachia koba botuko, Aburamu agaatanana abanto baye, erinde barwanie ababisa babo, akababua akabaseria goika Hoba, sugusu ya Damesiki.
english: During the night Abram divided his men to attack them and he routed them, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.

ekegusii: Nkarora ase okorora kwa botuko omonto oriinete ebarasi embariri. Omonto oyio nigo ateneine ase egati y’emete ekorokwa emehadasi yarenge ase rigoko. Na nyuma yaye nchiarengeo chibarasi chinde chimbariri, na echire chibarati, ne chindabu.
english: During the night I had a vision-- and there before me was a man riding a red horse! He was standing among the myrtle trees in a ravine. Behind him were red, brown and white horses.

ekegusii: During the night Paul had a vision of a man of Macedonia standing and begging him, "Come over to Macedonia and help us."
english: Paulo akaorokerwa nokorora botuko, akarora omonto o Makedonia oteneine okomosorora, okomotebia, “Amboka gocha aa Makedonia otokonye.”

ekegusii: Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni botuko, akabatebia, “Imoka, morue aa ase abanto baane, inwe na Abaisraeli bonsi! Genda mokorere Omonene buna mwabeire mokoboria!
english: During the night Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Up! Leave my people, you and the Israelites! Go, worship the LORD as you have requested.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Gibea bagacha kondwania, bagaetanana enyomba ase narenge botuko, bakagania bang’ite; nabarabwo bagakorera omokungu one o sere‐sere obonyaka goika agakwa.
english: During the night the men of Gibeah came after me and surrounded the house, intending to kill me. They raped my concubine, and she died.

ekegusii: Erio obobisi boria bokamaanorwa ase Danieli ase okorora kwa botuko. Ase ayio Danieli akamotogia Nyasae ore igoro, agateba:
english: During the night the mystery was revealed to Daniel in a vision. Then Daniel praised the God of heaven

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’obogambi bwa Daudi enchara nigo yarenge koba omwaka ase omwaka, ase engaki y’emiaka etato, na Daudi akaboria Omonene igoro y’ayio. Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ayio igo agokoreka ase engencho ya Saulo na enyomba yaye, ekiagera baiterete amanyinga ’abanto; ere naitete Abagibeoni.”
english: During the reign of David, there was a famine for three successive years; so David sought the face of the LORD. The LORD said, "It is on account of Saul and his blood-stained house; it is because he put the Gibeonites to death."

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti Yosia arenge kogamba, Omonene agakwana nainche, agantebia, “Kwarorire amang’ana aya Abaisraeli batari abegenwa bakorire? Nigo batiirire gochia ase kera ekegoro egetambe, na bakagenda inse ya kera omote omobese, bagakorera obonyaka aroro.
english: During the reign of King Josiah, the LORD said to me, "Have you seen what faithless Israel has done? She has gone up on every high hill and under every spreading tree and has committed adultery there.

ekegusii: Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto egaika, ense ekaama endagera enyinge,
english: During the seven years of abundance the land produced plentifully.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Moredekai arenge kobeera agwo ase egeita ki’enyomba y’oboruoti, abasomba babere b’omoruoti, Bigitani, na Teresi, abwo barenge korenda ase egesieri ki’enyomba, bakaba nendamwamu ase omoruoti, bakarigia enchera y’okomoita.
english: During the time Mordecai was sitting at the king's gate, Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's officers who guarded the doorway, became angry and conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.

ekegusii: Ekero esegi eyio yagendererete ase egati y’eamate ya Saulo na eya Daudi, Abineri akagenderera kwenyorera chinguru chinyinge ase egati y’eamate ya Saulo.
english: During the war between the house of Saul and the house of David, Abner had been strengthening his own position in the house of Saul.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ababani bagatirimboka korwa Yerusalemu gochia Antiokia.
english: During this time some prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na barabwo tibarenge na gento bakoria, Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye, akabatebia,
english: During those days another large crowd gathered. Since they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to him and said,

ekegusii: Na ase amatuko aria mwanyabanto nabarigie amakweri, na barabwo tibakoyanyora nonya ng’ake. Barabwo nababe namaiga ase amakweri, korende amakweri inabatame.
english: During those days men will seek death, but will not find it; they will long to die, but death will elude them.

ekegusii: Ase engaki ye rigesa ri’engano Reuben akagenda akanyora amasooni ng’ombe getii, akayatwa, akayarentera Lea ng’ina.
english: During wheat harvest, Reuben went out into the fields and found some mandrake plants, which he brought to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son's mandrakes."

ekegusii: “Ebinto ebi nabio biraruegwe amo na kera eeri, gose emingichi, gose kera emanwa y’eng’ondi gose ey’embori.
english: Each bull or ram, each lamb or young goat, is to be prepared in this manner.

ekegusii: Na kera rituko nigo arenge kworokereria Hekalu ime, korende botuko ogenda isiko obeera ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni.
english: Each day Jesus was teaching at the temple, and each evening he went out to spend the night on the hill called the Mount of Olives,

ekegusii: Kera rituko endagera narenge korua neng’ombe eyemo, ne ching’ondi chinoru isano nemo, amo ne chingoko; na kera rituko ria ikomi nigo narenge korua ebirandi ebinge biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, bire nedivai. Ase ebinto ebio bionsi tinarenge gosaba endagera eria abagambi bagwenerete koegwa, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo babogoretie egurube endito.
english: Each day one ox, six choice sheep and some poultry were prepared for me, and every ten days an abundant supply of wine of all kinds. In spite of all this, I never demanded the food allotted to the governor, because the demands were heavy on these people.

ekegusii: Kera egesieri nigo kiarenge nemerangwa ebere yare koigorwa korwa gati‐gati, yaringanigwa kera oyomo gochia ase ensemo yaye.
english: Each door had two leaves-- two hinged leaves for each door.

ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera ebao bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
english: Each frame is to be ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera ebao nigo bware obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obogare okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
english: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half wide,

ekegusii: Kera oyomo nigo abwate amasio ane, ne chimbaba inye, na inse ya kera orobaba egento nkiarengeo gekororekana buna okoboko kwa mwanyabanto.
english: Each had four faces and four wings, and under their wings was what looked like the hands of a man.

ekegusii: Enkoro enyene nigo emanyete obororo bwaye, na omonto omoao takonyara gwatanerwa omogoko bw’enkoro eyio.
english: Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can share its joy.

ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo agokonya omogisangio oye; oyomo otebia oyonde, “Kabe omoremu!”
english: each helps the other and says to his brother, "Be strong!"

ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna obomera boragwere abanto ba kera egesaku, ekenene gose egeke, nabo baranyore omwando obo.”
english: Each inheritance is to be distributed by lot among the larger and smaller groups."

ekegusii: Rigonko erimo nigo risoaine nerinde ang’e kegima, nonya nembeo tekonyara gosoera gati yabo.
english: each is so close to the next that no air can pass between.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino aimokie orogio rwaye rw’omorero, na arobekere ubani na kororenta ase obosio bw’Omonene. Chindogio chionsi nigo chirabe amagana abere, na emerongo etano; naye orente orwao, na Haroni nere arente orwaye.”
english: Each man is to take his censer and put incense in it-- 250 censers in all-- and present it before the LORD. You and Aaron are to present your censers also."

ekegusii: Kera omonto tiga arue buna arengereretie ase enkoro yaye, tari ase ogoichana, gose tari ase okobetererigwa, ekiagera Nyasae bwanchire ere oyokorua nomogoko.
english: Each man should give what he has decided in his heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo nabe buna obwebiso ekero omwaga okogusa, na buna ekeigamero ekero embura y’omoubera egotwa; boigo mbabe buna chindooche chire ase ense enyomo, na buna ekiriri ki’egetare ekenene ase ense etari namache.
english: Each man will be like a shelter from the wind and a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in the desert and the shadow of a great rock in a thirsty land.

ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi omonto araatanane koba ebichenu nigo birabe ebi’omokuani oyio okobiegwa.”
english: Each man's sacred gifts are his own, but what he gives to the priest will belong to the priest.'"

ekegusii: Ase igo kera emambia bakaba bagosangereria kera oyomo buna okoria kwaye kwang’ana; korende ekero omobaso oyesambire, yanyititoka.
english: Each morning everyone gathered as much as he needed, and when the sun grew hot, it melted away.

ekegusii: Kera omokerubi nigo abwate amasio ane; obosio bwe ritang’ani nigo bwarenge buna obw’omokerubi, na obwa kabere buna obwa mwanyabanto, na obwa gatato buna obw’endo, na obwa kane buna obw’ensoti.
english: Each of the cherubim had four faces: One face was that of a cherub, the second the face of a man, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

ekegusii: Ne ching’iti chiria inye chire moyo, kera eyemo niyo yarenge ne chimbaba isano nemo, naende chiichire amaiso ase chinsemo chionsi, ime na isiko. Na chirochio tichiri gotimoka mobaso gose botuko goteba, “Omochenu, Omochenu, Omochenu, Omonene Nyasae Omobui, oyorengeo, na oyoreo, na oyorache kobao!”
english: Each of the four living creatures had six wings and was covered with eyes all around, even under his wings. Day and night they never stop saying: "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty, who was, and is, and is to come."

ekegusii: Kera eyemo ye chisiiro chiria nigo yarenge nobotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na atano na atato, na engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na abere ekayeetanana. Nigo yaroisetigwe buna omobirangwa na obonetu bw’etaai yaroisetie omobirangwa oria nigo bwarenge obogare bw’ebiara bine.
english: Each of the pillars was eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits in circumference; each was four fingers thick, and hollow.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obomo bonsi babere, omoteneneri oria bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati b’omoruoti o Misiri, abwo basibetwe echela, bakaba bakorota chindoto. Kera oyomo akarota okorota kwaye okware nengencho eng’ao korwa ase okw’oyonde.
english: each of the two men-- the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were being held in prison-- had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.

ekegusii: Erio bagakora bwango, bagaikia kera omonto egunia yaye inse, na koyesansora.
english: Each of them quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.

ekegusii: Kera omochie bw’eyio nigo orenge namarisio aetanaineo, Nabo arenge ase emechie eyio yonsi.
english: Each of these towns had pasturelands surrounding it; this was true for all these towns.

ekegusii: intwe ase obotuko obomo tokarota chindoto twensi, kera oyomo okorota kwaye kore nengencho yaye eng’ao.
english: Each of us had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.

ekegusii: Kera omonto ore ase egati yaito tiga agwenere omogisangio oye, anyore obuya, erinde tonyare koagachana,
english: Each of us should please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.

ekegusii: Kera omonto arue ebinto koreng’ana buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, amosesenirie.
english: Each of you must bring a gift in proportion to the way the LORD your God has blessed you.

ekegusii: Kera omonto tarigereria ebinto biaye omonyene, korende arigererie ebinto bi’abande.
english: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others.

ekegusii: Kera omonto tiga abe buna arenge ekero arangeretigwe.
english: Each one should remain in the situation which he was in when God called him.

ekegusii: Korende kera omonto arenge emeremo yaye omonyene. Onye ore nengencho y’ogwetogia, tiga ayietogerie bweka omonyene, na tereng’ania nomogisangio oye.
english: Each one should test his own actions. Then he can take pride in himself, without comparing himself to somebody else,

ekegusii: Mokorerane inwe ase inwe, kera oyomo nekeegwa eke anyorete, buna abarendi abaya b’obuya bwa Nyasae, obore ne chingencho chinyinge.
english: Each one should use whatever gift he has received to serve others, faithfully administering God's grace in its various forms.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaruta enyimbo yaye inse, na chirochio chikaonchoka, chikaba ching’iti chinene; korende enyimbo ya Haroni ekamera chinyimbo chiabo.
english: Each one threw down his staff and it became a snake. But Aaron's staff swallowed up their staffs.

ekegusii: Kera ekemo gekaba gekogenda gochia bosio rioka; aase omoika orenge kogenda gochia, nao biarenge kogenda. Ekero biarenge kogenda tibiarenge koonchoka, korende bikaba bikogenda bosio rioka.
english: Each one went straight ahead. Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, without turning as they went.

ekegusii: Ase igo, kera omonto oyorache korikwa goika arue ekeng’ese gi’esekeli ase ekerengo gi’esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, ebe ekeegwa ase Omonene. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera emerongo ebere.)
english: Each one who crosses over to those already counted is to give a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.

ekegusii: Obotambe bw’esiiro eyemo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ikomi na atano na atato, na igoro ase esiiro egesure gi’etaai nkiarengeo; obotambe gochia igoro bw’egesure keria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atato. Egechanga na emegwekano y’amakomomanga biaetanaine egesure keria. Bionsi nigo biaroisirie korwa ase chitaai. Esiiro ya kabere nigo yarenge egwekaine eria entang’ani, yaetananirie nebichanga.
english: Each pillar was twenty-seven feet high. The bronze capital on top of one pillar was four and a half feet high and was decorated with a network and pomegranates of bronze all around. The other pillar, with its network, was similar.

ekegusii: Kera esani y’efeta nigo yarenge noborito bwe chisekeli rigana erimo na emerongo etato, na kera egetaabo gi’efeta noborito bwe chisekeli emerongo etano na ebere. Ase igo oborito bwonsi bwe chifeta chi’ebinto ebio nigo bwarenge chisekeli chilifu ibere, na amagana ane (2,400), koreng’ana nekerengo gi’esekeli yare gokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
english: Each silver plate weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each sprinkling bowl seventy shekels. Altogether, the silver dishes weighed two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

ekegusii: Abarwani b’esegi konya basakoire ebinto, na kera oyomo obo konya oirire ebiaye bweka omonyene.
english: Each soldier had taken plunder for himself.

ekegusii: Kera ekebekerero nigo kiarenge namagoro ane aroisetigwe korwa ase etaai. Ase chikoona chi’ekebekerero ebisiirero mbiarengeo. Ebisiirero ebio nigo biabombire nemegwekano y’ebisicha biaroisetigwe chingata ase kera ekemo.
english: Each stand had four bronze wheels with bronze axles, and each had a basin resting on four supports, cast with wreaths on each side.

ekegusii: Ebisiirero bine mbiarenge ase kera ekebekerero ase chikoona chiaye; biaroisetigwe bikaba egento ekemo nekebekerero.
english: Each stand had four handles, one on each corner, projecting from the stand.

ekegusii: Kera omote nigo okomanyekana ase amatunda aye. Naki ase emetobo abanto tibari gotwa amako, gose ase emenyenya tibari gotwa amasabibu.
english: Each tree is recognized by its own fruit. People do not pick figs from thornbushes, or grapes from briers.

ekegusii: Kera omwaka ng’ina nigo arenge komoroiseria eanga, omoirera ekero arenge kogenda amo nomosacha oye gochia korua ekeng’wanso gia kera omwaka.
english: Each year his mother made him a little robe and took it to him when she went up with her husband to offer the annual sacrifice.

ekegusii: Omwaka ase omwaka, inwe amo nabanto be chinka chiaino moriere chinyama chie chitugo echio chintangi ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, aase agwo arachore.
english: Each year you and your family are to eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place he will choose.

ekegusii: Ase engaki Daudi arenge agwo Edomu, Yoabu, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, akagenda gotindeka baria baitetwe. Ere na Abaisraeli bonsi barenge komo bagatigara agwo Edomu ase engaki y’emetienyi etano nomo, bagaita na gosiria kegima kera omosacha bw’aroro.
english: Earlier when David was fighting with Edom, Joab the commander of the army, who had gone up to bury the dead, had struck down all the men in Edom.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, mambia chuni, Daudi agatigera omonto onde okorisia ching’ondi, akaimokia chindagera chiria, akagenda buna Yese konya amochikire. Ekero aigete ensinyo y’egetwori ase chigari chiabekire chigekengerete, akanyora emeganda konya yarobeire gochia korwana esegi yarenge goaka eriogi ri’esegi.
english: Early in the morning David left the flock with a shepherd, loaded up and set out, as Jesse had directed. He reached the camp as the army was going out to its battle positions, shouting the war cry.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, mambia chuni, Yoshua amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakaimoka korwa Sitimu, bakagenda, bagaika orooche rwa Yorodan. Bagatoora agwo ritang’ani bataraamboka.
english: Early in the morning Joshua and all the Israelites set out from Shittim and went to the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Samweli akaimoka mambia chuni, agachia konyorana na Saulo, agateberigwa agwo ng’a Saulo nachicha Karimeli ase okweroiseria ekeinyorio, naende ogendire Giligali.
english: Early in the morning Samuel got up and went to meet Saul, but he was told, "Saul has gone to Carmel. There he has set up a monument in his own honor and has turned and gone on down to Gilgal."

ekegusii: Bakaimoka mambia chuni, bakagenda gochia ase erooro ya Tekoa; na ekero basogete isiko, Yehosafati agatenena agakwana, “Inwe Abayuda na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu inyigwe! Mwegene Omonene, Nyasae oino, monyore chinguru; egene nababani baye, na inwe inamobue.
english: Early in the morning they left for the Desert of Tekoa. As they set out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, "Listen to me, Judah and people of Jerusalem! Have faith in the LORD your God and you will be upheld; have faith in his prophets and you will be successful."

ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bonsi na abagaaka b’abanto bagakora ekina ase Yeso, bamoite.
english: Early in the morning, all the chief priests and the elders of the people came to the decision to put Jesus to death.

ekegusii: Early in the morning, as he was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.
english: Mambia gakoirana omochie, akaigwa enchara.

ekegusii: Yerubi‐Baali (nere Gidioni) amo nabanto abarenge komo bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagatoora ang’e nensoko ya Harodi. Abamidiani nigo batoorete ase ense omweya sugusu yabo, ang’e negetunwa kia More.
english: Early in the morning, Jerub-Baal (that is, Gideon) and all his men camped at the spring of Harod. The camp of Midian was north of them in the valley near the hill of Moreh.

ekegusii: Goika bogachia gokia mambia, Yeso agatenena ase engegu, korende aborokigwa tibamanya ng’a n’Yeso.
english: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.

ekegusii: Ekero Yehoyakimu, mosinto o Yosia, achagete kogambera Abayuda, ring’ana rigacha korwa ase Omonene, rigantebia,
english: Early in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came from the LORD:

ekegusii: Ekero Zedekia omoruoti, mosinto o Yosia, achagete kogambera Abayuda, ring’ana rigacha asende inche Yeremia korwa ase Omonene
english: Early in the reign of Zedekiah son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

ekegusii: Bono ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma Mariamu; Magidalena akagenda ase oboina kobogokia moka, ekero botarakiamoka buya, akarora ng’a rigena riarusigwe korwa ase oboina.
english: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere abanto bakaimoka mambia chuni bakeagachera egesasimero aroro. Erio bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe.
english: Early the next day the people built an altar and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings.

ekegusii: Abimeleki akaimoka mambia chuni akarangeria abasomba baye bonsi, akabatebia amang’ana aya onsi, na abanto abwo bakaondoka mono.
english: Early the next morning Abimelech summoned all his officials, and when he told them all that had happened, they were very much afraid.

ekegusii: Mambia kobwakia, Ibrahimu akagenda aase aria atenenete ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Early the next morning Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the LORD.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akaimoka mambia chuni, akabeka ebinto ase etigere yaye, akairana abamura babere amo nere, na Isaka omwana oye. Agaatia chinko agochia gosambera ekeng’wanso, akaimoka, akagenda gochia aase aria atebetigwe na Nyasae.
english: Early the next morning Abraham got up and saddled his donkey. He took with him two of his servants and his son Isaac. When he had cut enough wood for the burnt offering, he set out for the place God had told him about.

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu akaimoka mambia chuni, akaimokia omogati na ebirandi bikorire korwa ase amasankwa, bire namache, akabia Hagari, akamobibekera mareko. Akamorentera na omwana, akamotebia agende nere. Akagenda, akana‐koong’anya ase erooro ya Beeri‐Seba.
english: Early the next morning Abraham took some food and a skin of water and gave them to Hagar. He set them on her shoulders and then sent her off with the boy. She went on her way and wandered in the desert of Beersheba.

ekegusii: Yakobo akaboka mambia chuni, akaimokia rigena riria atoorerete omotwe oye, akaritenenia buna esiiro koba ekeinyorio, akaumora amaguta igoro yaye.
english: Early the next morning Jacob took the stone he had placed under his head and set it up as a pillar and poured oil on top of it.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, mambia chuni, Yoshua akarangeria Abaisraeli bache bosio, egesaku ase egesaku, na obomera bokagwera egesaku kia Yuda.
english: Early the next morning Joshua had Israel come forward by tribes, and Judah was taken.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, mambia chuni, Yoshua akaroberia abanto baye, ere amo nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli bagatang’ana abanto gochia Ai.
english: Early the next morning Joshua mustered his men, and he and the leaders of Israel marched before them to Ai.

ekegusii: Erio Hezekia omoruoti akaimoka mambia chuni, agasangereria abanene b’omochie, na barabwo bagatiira kogenda gochia ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Early the next morning King Hezekiah gathered the city officials together and went up to the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Mambia chuni Labani akaimoka, akanyunyunta abachokoro baye na abana baye abasubati, akabasesenia; erio akairana gocha bwoye.
english: Early the next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then he left and returned home.

ekegusii: Bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagatianania barabwo ase barabwo; na Isaka akabakooba, na barabwo bakarua asare, bakagenda nomorembe.
english: Early the next morning the men swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they left him in peace.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Elikana na abanto baye bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagasasima ase obosio bw’Omonene. Erio bakairana gochia nka sobo agwo Rama. Elikana akaba na Hana mokaye, na Omonene akaba omoinyorete.
english: Early the next morning they arose and worshiped before the LORD and then went back to their home at Ramah. Elkanah lay with Hannah his wife, and the LORD remembered her.

ekegusii: Ase emambia ye rituko ria kabere bakaimoka, bagatiira gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa, bagakwana, “Rora twachire, nao tore aa, bono twanchire kogenda ase ense eria Omonene atotebetie. Intwe twakorire ebibe.”
english: Early the next morning they went up toward the high hill country. "We have sinned," they said. "We will go up to the place the LORD promised."

ekegusii: Ogoto gokoigwa, na eriso rikorora, bionsi bibere n’Omonene obikorete.
english: Ears that hear and eyes that see-- the LORD has made them both.

ekegusii: gochakera moocha ya Yorodan na kogenderera gochia irianyi goika Aroeri, omochie ore ang’e nakarooche k’Arinoni. Eye nense ya Gileadi na Basani, ase ebisaku bia Gadi na Reuben na ekeng’ese gi’ekia Manase biamenyete.
english: east of the Jordan in all the land of Gilead (the region of Gad, Reuben and Manasseh), from Aroer by the Arnon Gorge through Gilead to Bashan.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto barenge ase ense ya Moabu, moocha ya Yorodan, Musa agachaka gotebereria abanto amachiko aya, ogoteba.
english: East of the Jordan in the territory of Moab, Moses began to expound this law, saying:

ekegusii: Karie kera egento egekoonigwa ase echiiro, timona koboraboria. Timotiga chinkoro chiaino chichandeke.
english: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,

ekegusii: Aye omwana one, karie obooke, ekiagera nobuya; obooke bogotonya korwa ase eriana nigo bore obwansu asore.
english: Eat honey, my son, for it is good; honey from the comb is sweet to your taste.

ekegusii: Noriere ebinto ebio aase gete are aachenu mono. Kera omonto omosacha ore asemore nanyare koria ebinto ebio. Ebio nebinto ebichenu asore.
english: Eat it as something most holy; every male shall eat it. You must regard it as holy.

ekegusii: Mokoriere agwo aase gete are aachenu. Ekio negetari kiao, na eki’abamura bao, gekorusigwa korwa ase okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene. Ayio naro Omonene anchigete.
english: Eat it in a holy place, because it is your share and your sons' share of the offerings made to the LORD by fire; for so I have been commanded.

ekegusii: Eat nothing made with yeast. Wherever you live, you must eat unleavened bread."
english: Timoria gento kende gionsi kebekire ememera; mobe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera aande onsi morabe momenyete.”

ekegusii: Oroisie endagera yao buna emegati y’esairi, oyeroiserie ase abanto baroche igoro y’omorero bw’obonyira obwomo bwa mwanyabanto.”
english: Eat the food as you would a barley cake; bake it in the sight of the people, using human excrement for fuel."

ekegusii: Agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, aase arachore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye, nao morariere ensemo ya ikomi ye chindagera chiaino, na edivai, na amaguta, ne chintangi chie chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori; erinde monyare kweorokereria komoiroka Omonene, Nyasae oino, botambe.
english: Eat the tithe of your grain, new wine and oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks in the presence of the LORD your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name, so that you may learn to revere the LORD your God always.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi, oyo otachenegeti na oyo ochenegete nabe ne ribaga ri’okoria chinyama echio, nigo morachirie buna chinyama chie chingabi gose echie chinsune chikoriegwa.
english: Eat them as you would gazelle or deer. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na abere emegati etabekiri memera eriegwe. Emegati ebekire ememera, gose ememera emenyene, tibirorekana ase ense yaino engima.
english: Eat unleavened bread during those seven days; nothing with yeast in it is to be seen among you, nor shall any yeast be seen anywhere within your borders.

ekegusii: Ebedi‐Meleki, Omoetiopia oria, agatebia Yeremia, “Agia chianga echio ase chintigatigi chiao, oagie ne chingori korwa inse.” Yeremia agakora bo.
english: Ebed-Melech the Cushite said to Jeremiah, "Put these old rags and worn-out clothes under your arms to pad the ropes." Jeremiah did so,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Ebedi‐Meleki akarua ase enyomba y’omoruoti, akagenda ase omoruoti arenge, agakwana nere, akamotebia,
english: Ebed-Melech went out of the palace and said to him,

ekegusii: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
english: na Eberi, na Pelegi, na Reu,

ekegusii: Edeni na Miniamini, Yesua na Semaya, Amaria na Sekania, aba nabwo barenge abegenwa ase okomokonya ase emechie y’abakuani. Barabwo bakaba bagwatanana ebiegwa ebio ase abanto bamwabo, abagotu na abake, koreng’ana nebiombe biabo.
english: Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah and Shecaniah assisted him faithfully in the towns of the priests, distributing to their fellow priests according to their divisions, old and young alike.

ekegusii: Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafilisti, na Abaameleki. Boigo agaatananera Omonene ebisakorwa arusetie korwa ase Hadadeseri, mosinto o Rehobu, omoruoti o Soba.
english: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek. He also dedicated the plunder taken from Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

ekegusii: Abaedomu kobaratebe: “Nonya twaakirwe, ngochia tore koagacha naende aase aria asaretigwe agatigara bosa.” Korende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: “Nabo baranyare koagacha naende, korende inche goika ntagore amaagacho ayio, erinde ense eyio erokwe ey’abakori amabe, abwo inche Omonene inde nendamwamu asebare kogenderera botambe.”
english: Edom may say, "Though we have been crushed, we will rebuild the ruins." But this is what the LORD Almighty says: "They may build, but I will demolish. They will be called the Wicked Land, a people always under the wrath of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ense y’Edomu nebugwe eirwe, Seiri nebugwe ebe eyabo, eyio nense y’ababisa babo. Abaisraeli mbagenderere koba nokobua.
english: Edom will be conquered; Seir, his enemy, will be conquered, but Israel will grow strong.

ekegusii: abanto ba Edomu na Moabu, na ab’Amoni;
english: Edom, Moab and Ammon;

ekegusii: Amache e chindooche chia Edomu naonchoke abe buna eramu, ne riroba ri’ense eyio ndibe buna eramu ekoyia omorero.
english: Edom's streams will be turned into pitch, her dust into burning sulfur; her land will become blazing pitch!

ekegusii: Misiri nigo ekoimokerera igoro buna orooche rwa Naili. Nigo ekoimokerera igoro buna chindooche chiaichoire amache. Misiri eria egateba,” “Ninyimokerere igoro ntube ense, ninsarie na gosiria emechie na abanto bamenyeteo.
english: Egypt rises like the Nile, like rivers of surging waters. She says, 'I will rise and cover the earth; I will destroy cities and their people.'

ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo babete nomogoko ekero Abaisraeli bang’anyete, ekiagera obwoba konya bwabagwereire ase engencho y’Abaisraeli.
english: Egypt was glad when they left, because dread of Israel had fallen on them.

ekegusii: Ense y’Abamisiri nesarigwe, ebe bosa; erio Abamisiri mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. “Aye Misiri nigo gwatebete: Orooche oro rwa Naili norwane, ninche narotongete.
english: Egypt will become a desolate wasteland. Then they will know that I am the LORD. "'Because you said, "The Nile is mine; I made it,"

ekegusii: Misiri nigo egochura neriogi ringa buna eri’eng’iti egwekurura. Ababisa ba Misiri nigo bagocha bare ne chinguru. Nigo bagocha bare nebisire buna abagochia kogecha chinko.
english: Egypt will hiss like a fleeing serpent as the enemy advances in force; they will come against her with axes, like men who cut down trees.

ekegusii: Tibokogenderera koba ogosemeria ase Abaisraeli. Onye Abaisraeli bagochia korigia ogokonywa korwa ase Abamisiri, rirorio mbabe bakoinyora ebibe biabo, na mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene Nyasae.”
english: Egypt will no longer be a source of confidence for the people of Israel but will be a reminder of their sin in turning to her for help. Then they will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nabwo aba: Abamisiri, na Abayuda, na Abaedomu, na Abaamoni, na Abamoabu, amo nabanto bonsi bamenyete ase erooro, abwo bakonacha chitukia chiabo mesia. Abanto aba bonsi b’ebisaku tibarogeti, boigo na Abaisraeli bonsi tibarogeti ase chinkoro chiabo ime.”
english: Egypt, Judah, Edom, Ammon, Moab and all who live in the desert in distant places. For all these nations are really uncircumcised, and even the whole house of Israel is uncircumcised in heart."

ekegusii: Ehudi akarambora okoboko kwaye gw’okobee, agasomora omoyio oye o birende, oyio eboeranetie ensemo yaye y’okorio, akabeta Egiloni enda yaye ime.
english: Ehud reached with his left hand, drew the sword from his right thigh and plunged it into the king's belly.

ekegusii: Ehudi akariina kerama igoro ase akanyomba kare nembeo engiya, ase omoruoti aikaransete, akamotebia, “Ninde namang’ana arure ase Omonene nkogotebia.” Omoruoti oria akaimoka korwa ase aikaransete.
english: Ehud then approached him while he was sitting alone in the upper room of his summer palace and said, "I have a message from God for you." As the king rose from his seat,

ekegusii: Eighteen thousand Benjamites fell, all of them valiant fighters.
english: Abarwani chituoni b’Ababenjamin chilifu ikomi na isano na isato bagaitwa.

ekegusii: abanto emerongo etano na etato bakarua Sekemu, na Silo, na Samaria, bakagenda ase enyomba y’Omonene, babwate okoruegwa kw’endagera na ubani. Abanto abwo nigo bagingerete chinderu chiabo, na batandorete chianga chiabo, na emebere yabo nigo yakeba‐kebire,
english: eighty men who had shaved off their beards, torn their clothes and cut themselves came from Shechem, Shiloh and Samaria, bringing grain offerings and incense with them to the house of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekron, with its surrounding settlements and villages;
english: Norengeo Ekironi, amo nemechie na ebichie biaye;

ekegusii: Abaelamu nigo babogoretie chinsara, bagacha amo nabariini chigari na abe chibarasi; na abanto ba Kiri bagasokia chinguba chiabo.
english: Elam takes up the quiver, with her charioteers and horses; Kir uncovers the shield.

ekegusii: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth and Eliehoenai the seventh.
english: Elamu oyo o gatano; Yehohanani oyo o gatano na rimo; Eliehoenai oyo o gatano na kabere.

ekegusii: Eleasah the father of Sismai, Sismai the father of Shallum,
english: Eleasa akaibora Sisimai, na Sisimai akaibora Salumu;

ekegusii: Eleazari nigo akwete atabwati abana abamura, korende nabwate abana abaiseke. Abanto bamwabo, abana abamura ba Kisi, bakanyuoma abaiseke baria.
english: Eleazar died without having sons: he had only daughters. Their cousins, the sons of Kish, married them.

ekegusii: Eleazari, omwana o Haroni, akanyuoma omoiseke oyomo bw’abaiseke ba Putieli, na ere akamoiborera Finehasi. Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chinyomba chi’Abalawi, eamate ase eamate.
english: Eleazar son of Aaron married one of the daughters of Putiel, and she bore him Phinehas. These were the heads of the Levite families, clan by clan.

ekegusii: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas the father of Abishua,
english: Eleazari akaibora Finehasi, na Finehasi akaibora Abisua;

ekegusii: Eli answered, "Go in peace, and may the God of Israel grant you what you have asked of him."
english: Erio Eli akamoiraneria, akamotebia, “Genda nomorembe, na Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli nakoe aya kwamosabire.”

ekegusii: Erio Eli akaigwa okorera kw’abanto, akaboria, “Eriogi eri ri’okorera okonene neria ki?” Erio omonto oria akaayerera gochia ase Eli komotebia amang’ana ayio.
english: Eli heard the outcry and asked, "What is the meaning of this uproar?" The man hurried over to Eli,

ekegusii: Erio Eli nigo arenge koba ogosesenia Elikana na mokaye, atebia Elikana, “Omonene asesenie omokungu oyo akoiborere abana bande babe ribaga ri’omwana oyo gwatananete ase Omonene.” Erio baba bakoirana gochia nka.
english: Eli would bless Elkanah and his wife, saying, "May the LORD give you children by this woman to take the place of the one she prayed for and gave to the LORD." Then they would go home.

ekegusii: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son and Samuel his son.
english: na Eliabu omomura oye, na Yerohamu omomura oye, na Elikana omomura oye.

ekegusii: Eliaba korwa Saalaboni, na basinto ba Yaseni, na Yonathani;
english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan

ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw’Asafu, oyorenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bagacha aroro.
english: Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to him.

ekegusii: Erio Eliasibu, omokuani omonene, amo nabakuani bande bamwabo, bakaagacha Egeita gie Ching’ondi, bakagiatanana ase okogechena, bakabeka ebisieri biaye. Bagaatanana orwaki goikera ase Omorobiri bwe Rigana, naende goikera ase Omorobiri o Hananeli, bakarochena.
english: Eliashib the high priest and his fellow priests went to work and rebuilt the Sheep Gate. They dedicated it and set its doors in place, building as far as the Tower of the Hundred, which they dedicated, and as far as the Tower of Hananel.

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamin, Elidadi, mosinto o Kisiloni;
english: Elidad son of Kislon, from the tribe of Benjamin;

ekegusii: Elieli korwa Mahawa Yeribai na Yosawia, basinto b’Elinamu, na Itima korwa Moabu;
english: Eliel the Mahavite, Jeribai and Joshaviah the sons of Elnaam, Ithmah the Moabite,

ekegusii: Elieli, na Obedi, na Yaasieli korwa Soba.
english: Eliel, Obed and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

ekegusii: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,
english: Elinai na Siletai, na Elieli,

ekegusii: Erio Eliezeri, mosinto o Dodawahu korwa Maresa, akabana amabe igoro ya Yehosafati, akamotebia, “Ekiagera kwabwatanire n’Ahasia, Omonene nasarie ebinto kwaroisirie.” Ne chimeeri chiria chikabochoka tichianyara kogenda Tarisisi.
english: Eliezer son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, "Because you have made an alliance with Ahaziah, the LORD will destroy what you have made." The ships were wrecked and were not able to set sail to trade.

ekegusii: Elihorefu na Ahiya, basinto ba Sisa, nabwo barenge abariki; Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka;
english: Elihoreph and Ahijah, sons of Shisha-- secretaries; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud-- recorder;

ekegusii: Elihu continued:
english: Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora,

ekegusii: Elija akairaneria omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani esegi emerongo etano, “Onye inche inde omonto o Nyasae, tiga omorero orwe igoro ogosambe na kogosiria, aye amo nabarwani bao emerongo etano.” Erio kegima omorero okarwa igoro, ogasamba omotang’ani oria amo nabarwani baye emerongo etano, okabasiria.
english: Elijah answered the captain, "If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven and consume you and your fifty men!" Then fire fell from heaven and consumed the captain and his men.

ekegusii: Elija akabogoria omwana oria, agatirimboka nere korwa ase akanyomba ka irongo, akamorenta enyomba ya inse, erio akamomoa ng’ina, akamotebia, “Rora omwana oo moyo are.”
english: Elijah picked up the child and carried him down from the room into the house. He gave him to his mother and said, "Look, your son is alive!"

ekegusii: Elija agatebia Elisha, “Aye beera aiga, ekiagera Omonene ontomire ngende Beteli.” Korende Elisha akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, naende buna aye ore moyo, tinkogotiga.” Ase igo bagatirimboka, bakagenda Beteli.
english: Elijah said to Elisha, "Stay here; the LORD has sent me to Bethel." But Elisha said, "As surely as the LORD lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So they went down to Bethel.

ekegusii: Elija agatebia omokungu oria, “Toiroka! Genda okore buna gwatebire, korende ritang’ani ondoiserie omogati omoke korwa ase obosio obwo, ondetere, erio nyuma yaye oroisie oyoo na oyo bw’omwana oo,
english: Elijah said to her, "Don't be afraid. Go home and do as you have said. But first make a small cake of bread for me from what you have and bring it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.

ekegusii: Erio Elija agatebia ababani ba Baali, “Echorere eeri eyemo, erio moyeroisie ritang’ani, ekiagera inwe nabange more; mosabe ase erieta ri’enyasae yaino, korende timobaisa gouta omorero aroro.”
english: Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, "Choose one of the bulls and prepare it first, since there are so many of you. Call on the name of your god, but do not light the fire."

ekegusii: Elija akairaneria, agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene bw’Emeganda are moyo, oria inche inteneine ase obosio bwaye, rero goika inyeorokie ase Ahabu.”
english: Elijah said, "As the LORD Almighty lives, whom I serve, I will surely present myself to Ahab today."

ekegusii: Elija akaimokia egetambaa kiaye gi’okwambara agakeringania, erio agaaka amache na kerokio. Amache agaatananekana gochia ensemo na ensemo, goika baria babere bagaeta aase aakamoku, bakaamboka ng’umbu.
english: Elijah took his cloak, rolled it up and struck the water with it. The water divided to the right and to the left, and the two of them crossed over on dry ground.

ekegusii: Elija akabogoria amagena ikomi na abere, koreng’ana nomobaro bw’ebisaku bi’abamura ba Yakobo, oyio ring’ana ri’Omonene riachete asare rigateba, “Israeli nario rirabe erieta riao.”
english: Elijah took twelve stones, one for each of the tribes descended from Jacob, to whom the word of the LORD had come, saying, "Your name shall be Israel."

ekegusii: Elija nigo arenge omonto bwe chingencho echimo naintwe, agasaba nomokia ng’a embura tetwa. Na embura tiyatwa igoro ase ense ase engaki y’emiaka etato na emetienyi etano nomo.
english: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.

ekegusii: Elija akoboa, akaimoka agatama ase ogotooria obogima bwaye, agaika Beeri‐Seba ase ense ya Yuda. Agatiga omosomba oye aroro,
english: Elijah was afraid and ran for his life. When he came to Beersheba in Judah, he left his servant there,

ekegusii: Elija agaika abanto bonsi ang’e, agakwana, “Ngoika ririri mogochia koba ne chitang’utang’u more nebirengererio bire ara kabere? Onye Omonene nere Nyasae, momobwatie, korende onye Baali, mobwatie ere.” Abanto bagakira kiri, tibamoiraneria nonya ne ring’ana erimo.
english: Elijah went before the people and said, "How long will you waver between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow him; but if Baal is God, follow him." But the people said nothing.

ekegusii: Elifeleti, mosinto bw’Ahasibai, omonto korwa Maaka; Eliamu, mosinto bw’Ahitofeli, korwa Gilo;
english: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maacathite, Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

ekegusii: Abamura ba Eli nigo barenge abanto ababe batarochi inchera. Tibasigete Omonene,
english: Eli's sons were wicked men; they had no regard for the LORD.

ekegusii: Elisha akamoiraneria, “Omonene nigo anyorokirie ng’a ere goika akwe, korende genda omotebie ng’a ekeene nagwene.”
english: Elisha answered, "Go and say to him, 'You will certainly recover'; but the LORD has revealed to me that he will in fact die."

ekegusii: Na Elisha agakwa, agatindekwa. Bono ebiombe bi’Abamoabu bikaba bigocha ase ense eria ase omochakano bwa kera omwaka.
english: Elisha died and was buried. Now Moabite raiders used to enter the country every spring.

ekegusii: Elisha akamotebia, “Ninki nkogokorera? Ntebie ngento ki obwate nyomba mwao.” Omokungu oria agateba, “Inche omosomba oo omokungu timbwati gento kende gionsi nyomba mwane otatiga amaguta make ase rikondo.”
english: Elisha replied to her, "How can I help you? Tell me, what do you have in your house?" "Your servant has nothing there at all," she said, "except a little oil."

ekegusii: Elisha akagenda naende Giligali ekero enchara yarenge ase ense eria. Na aborokigwa b’ababani kobaikaransire ase obosio bwaye, agatebia omosomba oye, “Tereka enyongo eria enene riko, oroiserie aborokigwa b’ababani omosori!”
english: Elisha returned to Gilgal and there was a famine in that region. While the company of the prophets was meeting with him, he said to his servant, "Put on the large pot and cook some stew for these men."

ekegusii: Elisha agatebia Gehasi, “Eboyie bwebeke ang’e, imokia enyimbo yane koboko kwao, ogende. Koraumerane na monto onde bwensi, tobaisa komokwania; na omonto onde bwensi karagokwanie, tobaisa goitaba; obeke enyimbo eye yane igoro ase obosio bw’omwana oria.”
english: Elisha said to Gehazi, "Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand and run. If you meet anyone, do not greet him, and if anyone greets you, do not answer. Lay my staff on the boy's face."

ekegusii: Elisha agatebia Gehasi, “Bono boria omokungu oyo inki aganetie imokorere ase emeremo eye yonsi akorete ase engencho yaito. Moborie ande gose naganetie ngende ase omoruoti, gose ase omochiki bw’abarwani esegi, nkwane obuya bwaye.” Omokungu oria akairaneria, “Inche nigo imenyete buya ase egati y’abanto baminto.”
english: Elisha said to him, "Tell her, 'You have gone to all this trouble for us. Now what can be done for you? Can we speak on your behalf to the king or the commander of the army?'" She replied, "I have a home among my own people."

ekegusii: Elisha agatebia omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, “Inki inde naye? Genda aye ase ababani ba iso na aba nyoko!” Korende omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akamotebia. “Tinkogendao. Omonene nere otobekire intwe abaruoti batato ase amaboko Abamoabu.”
english: Elisha said to the king of Israel, "What do we have to do with each other? Go to the prophets of your father and the prophets of your mother." "No," the king of Israel answered, "because it was the LORD who called us three kings together to hand us over to Moab."

ekegusii: Elisha akabora, “Ekeene, buna Omonene bw’Emeganda are moyo, oria inche ngokorera, onye ntasigeti Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, anga tinarenge gwancha gokorora, gose gokorigereria.
english: Elisha said, "As surely as the LORD Almighty lives, whom I serve, if I did not have respect for the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would not look at you or even notice you.

ekegusii: Elisha akamotebia, “Imokia obota na emegwe!” Ase ayio akaimokia ebinto ebio.
english: Elisha said, "Get a bow and some arrows," and he did so.

ekegusii: Elisha agateba, “Renta obosie!” Erio akabobeka ase enyongo ime, agateba, “Bekera abanto endagera eye barie.” Bono egento gi’okorenta amabe tikiarenge ase enyongo eria ime.
english: Elisha said, "Get some flour." He put it into the pot and said, "Serve it to the people to eat." And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

ekegusii: Elisha agatebia omokungu oria, “Genda ase emechie ase abagisangio bao, osabe oegwe ebibekerero ebinge bire bosa.
english: Elisha said, "Go around and ask all your neighbors for empty jars. Don't ask for just a few.

ekegusii: Elisha akamoiraneria, “Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene. Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ankio, engaki buna eye obosie obonuke bw’engano ebitita bibere nabionigwe ase rigori ri’esekeli eyemo, na obw’esairi ebitita bine ase esekeli eyemo, agwo ase egeita gia Samaria.”
english: Elisha said, "Hear the word of the LORD. This is what the LORD says: About this time tomorrow, a seah of flour will sell for a shekel and two seahs of barley for a shekel at the gate of Samaria."

ekegusii: Elisha akarora ekero Elija akoirwa igoro, akarera, “Tata ominto! Tata ominto! Aye nigo ore ase Abaisraeli buna chigari na abariini chibarasi.” Nyuma y’ayio tarora Elija naende nonya ng’ake. Erio Elisha akarusia chianga chiaye, agachitandorana ebing’ese bibere,
english: Elisha saw this and cried out, "My father! My father! The chariots and horsemen of Israel!" And Elisha saw him no more. Then he took hold of his own clothes and tore them apart.

ekegusii: Elisha agatoma omonto asare, akamotebia “Genda bwesibie ase orooche rwa Yorodan ara gatano na kabere, na omobere oo noirane obe buna orenge ritang’ani, naye nocheneke.”
english: Elisha sent a messenger to say to him, "Go, wash yourself seven times in the Jordan, and your flesh will be restored and you will be cleansed."

ekegusii: Elisha akarangeria Gehasi, akamotebia, “Rangeria Omosunemu oyio!” Gehasi akamorangeria, na ekero omokungu oria achete, Elisha akamotebia, “Imokia omwana oo!”
english: Elisha summoned Gehazi and said, "Call the Shunammite." And he did. When she came, he said, "Take your son."

ekegusii: Elisha agatiga chiombe chiria, akaminyoka gochia ase Elija, akamotebia, “Tiga ngende konyunyunta tata na baba ase okobatiga, erio nkobwatie.” Elija akamotebia, “Irana ogende, nomanyete aya nagokoreire.”
english: Elisha then left his oxen and ran after Elijah. "Let me kiss my father and mother good-by," he said, "and then I will come with you." "Go back," Elijah replied. "What have I done to you?"

ekegusii: Elisha agatebia abanto baria, “Eye tari ero enchera, na omochie tari oro oyo; intunyane, nainche nimborokie omonto oria mokorigia.” Erio akabatang’ana gochia Samaria.
english: Elisha told them, "This is not the road and this is not the city. Follow me, and I will lead you to the man you are looking for." And he led them to Samaria.

ekegusii: Elisha akaimoka, agataarataara nyomba ime ara kabere, naende akariina borere, akerambora igoro ase omwana, na omwana oria agasimora ara gatano na kabere, erio akaramokia amaiso aye.
english: Elisha turned away and walked back and forth in the room and then got on the bed and stretched out upon him once more. The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.

ekegusii: Elisha akagenda Damesiki, na Beni‐Hadadi, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, nigo arenge omorwaire. Ekero Beni‐Hadadi atebetigwe ng’a omonto oria o Nyasae ochire,
english: Elisha went to Damascus, and Ben-Hadad king of Aram was ill. When the king was told, "The man of God has come all the way up here,"

ekegusii: Elishama, Beeliada and Eliphelet.
english: Elisama na Beliada, na Elifeleti.

ekegusii: Elisama na Eliada, na Elifeleti; abwo nigo barenge kianda.
english: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet-- nine in all.

ekegusii: Elishama, Eliada and Eliphelet.
english: Elisama, na Eliada, na Elifeleti.

ekegusii: Eliud the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,
english: na Eliudi akaibora Eleazari, na Eleazari akaibora Matani, na Matani akaibora Yakobo,

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Elisafani, mosinto o Parinaki;
english: Elizaphan son of Parnach, the leader from the tribe of Zebulun;

ekegusii: Erio Elikana akamoboria, “Nase ki okona‐korera? Naki otari koria endagera? Naende oichanete iga? Inee! Inche tindi buya asore goetania abana abamura ikomi?”
english: Elkanah her husband would say to her, "Hannah, why are you weeping? Why don't you eat? Why are you downhearted? Don't I mean more to you than ten sons?"

ekegusii: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,
english: na Elikana omomura oye, na Ebiasafu omomura oye, na Asiri omomura oye,

ekegusii: Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son,
english: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Ahimoti: Elikana omomura oye, na Sofai omomura oye, na Nahati omomura oye,

ekegusii: Elikana na Isia, Asareli na Yoeseri, na Yasobeamu, abarenge Abakora;
english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer and Jashobeam the Korahites;

ekegusii: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
english: na Eloni, na Timuna, na Ekironi,

ekegusii: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
english: na Eliteke, na Gibetoni, na Baalati,

ekegusii: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
english: na Elitoladi, na Betuli, na Horima,

ekegusii: Eltolad, Kesil, Hormah,
english: na Elitoladi, na Kesili, na Horima,

ekegusii: Elusai na Yerimoti, Bealia na Semaria, na Sefatia korwa Harufi;
english: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite;

ekegusii: aremie chinkoro chiaino, na abakong’ie mokore ayare boronge ase kera ogokora okuya, na amang’ana amaya.
english: encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.

ekegusii: erinde mogenderere buna ebagwenerete ase Nyasae, oyokobarangeria mosoe ase oboruoti bwaye, na ase obonene bwaye.
english: encouraging, comforting and urging you to live lives worthy of God, who calls you into his kingdom and glory.

ekegusii: Ababisa baerire, basirigwe kegima, gwatagoire emechie yabo, barabwo bebirwe, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake.
english: Endless ruin has overtaken the enemy, you have uprooted their cities; even the memory of them has perished.

ekegusii: Ekero mokorongeigwa moremererie Nyasae nigo akobakorera buna abana baye. Naki, mwana ki otari korongeigwa na ise?
english: Endure hardship as discipline; God is treating you as sons. For what son is not disciplined by his father?

ekegusii: Endure hardship with us like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.
english: Nonya naye oremererie emechando buna omorwani omuya o Kristo Yeso.

ekegusii: Ase chisemi chi’omoroisia omanyete buya gotura na komang’a ekemanyererio, omang’e amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli ase amagena aria abere. Erio obeke amagena aria ase ebikonde bie chitahabu.
english: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings

ekegusii: Ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima obo bore bosa, obo Nyasae akoeire omenye aiga inse y’erioba, omenye nomogoko amo nomokungu oo bwanchete. Okomenya nomogoko, nakio egetari kiao ase obogima obo, ekero ogendererete gwechanda ase emeremo emekong’u inse y’erioba.
english: Enjoy life with your wife, whom you love, all the days of this meaningless life that God has given you under the sun-- all your meaningless days. For this is your lot in life and in your toilsome labor under the sun.

ekegusii: akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae. Erio tarorekana naende, ekiagera Nyasae nigo amoirete.
english: Enoch walked with God; then he was no more, because God took him away.

ekegusii: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah.
english: Yaredi akaibora Enoku, na Enoku akaibora Metusela, na Metusela akaibora Lameki;

ekegusii: Na Enoku, omonto o gatano na kabere korwa ase Adamu, nakwanete amang’ana ’obobani igoro y’abwo, ogoteba, “Rigereria, Omonene nache nabachenu baye chilifu ne chilifu,
english: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied about these men: "See, the Lord is coming with thousands upon thousands of his holy ones

ekegusii: Ontenenere inche omosomba oo inyore amaya; totiga abanto abamwenu bankore bobe.
english: Ensure your servant's well-being; let not the arrogant oppress me.

ekegusii: Soa ase ebiita biaye na komoakera ng’a mbuya mono, soa ase chigoora chiaye na komotogia! Moakere ng’a mbuya mono, motogie erieta riaye!
english: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

ekegusii: Abanto bare ne chinguru mbarue Misiri, na abanto b’Etiopia baayerere koramborera Nyasae amaboko abo.
english: Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will submit herself to God.

ekegusii: Epafara, oyosibetwe amo nainche ase engencho ya Kristo Yeso, ogokwanirie.
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings.

ekegusii: Epafara oyore oyomo oino, omosomba o Kristo Yeso, obakwanirie. Ere okorire omokia ase okobainyora ase ogosaba kwaye, erinde monyare gotenena more abaikeranu, abamanyete mono ogwancha gwonsi kwa Nyasae.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, that you may stand firm in all the will of God, mature and fully assured.

ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bagoteba, “Amaene twabeire abanda, twenyoreire obotenenku; ase emeremo yaito yonsi monto onde tari oranyare gotosoera ng’a nigo twanyorire obonda obo ase enchera y’ebibe bi’oborianania.”
english: Ephraim boasts, "I am very rich; I have become wealthy. With all my wealth they will not find in me any iniquity or sin."

ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo bakwerageria embeo, babwatia embeo ya moocha. Kera rituko nigo bakomenta gokwana oborimo, na gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakobwatana n’Abaasuri, babe bakoira amaguta ’amazeituni ase ense ya Misiri.
english: Ephraim feeds on the wind; he pursues the east wind all day and multiplies lies and violence. He makes a treaty with Assyria and sends olive oil to Egypt.

ekegusii: Abaefraimu bang’etananire namang’ana ’oborimo, na Abaisraeli boigo namang’ana ’obong’ainereria; na Abayuda nigo bagendererete gosaria ase Nyasae, oria ore Omochenu na Omwegenwa.
english: Ephraim has surrounded me with lies, the house of Israel with deceit. And Judah is unruly against God, even against the faithful Holy One.

ekegusii: “Abaefraimu nigo barenge buna ritororo riorokereretigwe buya, rianchete koora, inche nigo nabegete rikorogoto ase ebigoti biabo ebiya. Bono nimbekere Abaefraimu rikorogoto, nonya n’Abayuda goika babe bakorema, na aba Yakobo goika babe bakobosa.
english: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her fair neck. I will drive Ephraim, Judah must plow, and Jacob must break up the ground.

ekegusii: Abaefraimu baakirwe, omori obo bwomire, tibakonyara kwama okwama. Nabaisa koibora, goika ing’ite abana abwo banchete.”
english: Ephraim is blighted, their root is withered, they yield no fruit. Even if they bear children, I will slay their cherished offspring."

ekegusii: Egesaku gi’Efraimu kiabwatanire nemegwekano kegosasima, tiga getigweo.
english: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone!

ekegusii: Abaefraimu baregirwe na gotiringerwa inse ase ekina, ekiagera beruete ase okobwatia emeroberio ya bosa.
english: Ephraim is oppressed, trampled in judgment, intent on pursuing idols.

ekegusii: Abaefraimu mbasirigwe kegima ase rituko riria ri’egesusuro. Ase egati y’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli inche nararirie, ayarache goikeranigwa ekeene.
english: Ephraim will be laid waste on the day of reckoning. Among the tribes of Israel I proclaim what is certain.

ekegusii: Obonene bw’Abaefraimu mboiruruke buna enyoni bogende. Okoibora tigokoba asebare, gose abakungu tibakoba barito, bonsi mbagombae.
english: Ephraim's glory will fly away like a bird-- no birth, no pregnancy, no conception.

ekegusii: Ribero Abaefraimu babwate ndisire, na abwo bakwoboyia Abayuda mbasirigwe; Abaefraimu tibakogenderera koba ne ribero ase Abayuda, na Abayuda tibakogenderera kwoboyia Abaefraimu.
english: Ephraim's jealousy will vanish, and Judah's enemies will be cut off; Ephraim will not be jealous of Judah, nor Judah hostile toward Ephraim.

ekegusii: Ephron answered Abraham,
english: Efuroni akairaneria Ibrahimu,

ekegusii: Bono Efuroni nigo arenge oikaransete agwo ase egati y’Abahiti. Ere Efuroni, Omohiti, akairaneria Ibrahimu ekero Abahiti bonsi, abaare goetera egeita ki’omochie oye, bamotegererete,
english: Ephron the Hittite was sitting among his people and he replied to Abraham in the hearing of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.

ekegusii: ere abakore mobe abaikeranu ase kera ogokora okuya, monyare gokora obwanchani bwaye, naende akore ime yaino ayagwenerete ase obosio bwaye goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene bwa kare na kare. Amina.
english: equip you with everything good for doing his will, and may he work in us what is pleasing to him, through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

ekegusii: Basinto ba Yuda, Eri na Onani, bagakwera agwo ase ense ya Kanani.
english: Er and Onan were sons of Judah, but they died in Canaan.

ekegusii: Erasto nigo atigarete Korinto, korende Torofimo nkamotiga Mileto orwarete.
english: Erastus stayed in Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.

ekegusii: Naende Esau akamoboria, “Emeganda eye yonsi twaumerana gochia aa, neya ki?” Yakobo akamoiraneria, “Engencho yaye inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, aye omonene one.”
english: Esau asked, "What do you mean by all these droves I met?" "To find favor in your eyes, my lord," he said.

ekegusii: Esau akagecha Yakobo ase engencho y’ogosesenigwa okwo ise amosesenetie, agateba ase omoyo oye ime, “Amatuko ay’okomoreera tata ng’ang’e are; erio nario ndaite Yakobo.”
english: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. He said to himself, "The days of mourning for my father are near; then I will kill my brother Jacob."

ekegusii: Esau akaboria ise, “Ogosesenia nokomo gwoka kwabwate, tata? Nsesenia inche nainche boigo, tata ominto.” Esau agaaka eriogi, akarera nobororo.
english: Esau said to his father, "Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, my father!" Then Esau wept aloud.

ekegusii: Esau akabora, “Inee! Tari korokwa Yakobo ase oboronge? Naki eye nengaki ya kabere ang’ainereirie. Ritang’ani akaira omwando one bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi, naende bono oirire ogosesenigwa kwane.” Naende akamoboria, “Tontigereti inche gosesenigwa konde?”
english: Esau said, "Isn't he rightly named Jacob? He has deceived me these two times: He took my birthright, and now he's taken my blessing!" Then he asked, "Haven't you reserved any blessing for me?"

ekegusii: Erio Esau akamotebia, “Ningotigere abanto bande ase aba inde nabwo.” Korende Yakobo akairaneria, “Bakore ki? Otatiga ndore ng’a nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, omonene one.”
english: Esau said, "Then let me leave some of my men with you." "But why do that?" Jacob asked. "Just let me find favor in the eyes of my lord."

ekegusii: Ase igo ekero Esau aroche ng’a Isaka ise tancheti abaiseke b’Abakanani,
english: Esau then realized how displeasing the Canaanite women were to his father Isaac;

ekegusii: Erio Esau akaimokia abakungu baye, na abamura na abaiseke baye, na abanto bonsi ababwate bwoye, ne chiombe chiaye, ne ching’iti chiaye chionsi echi atugete, na enibo yaye yonsi eyaniberete ase ense ya Kanani; akagenda agaika ase ense ere aare korwa ase Yakobo omwabo.
english: Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the members of his household, as well as his livestock and all his other animals and all the goods he had acquired in Canaan, and moved to a land some distance from his brother Jacob.

ekegusii: Esau akanyuoma abakungu baye korwa ase Abakanani: Ada, omoiseke o Eloni, Omohiti, na Oholibama, omoiseke o Ana, mosinto o Sibeoni, Omohivi,
english: Esau took his wives from the women of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite--

ekegusii: Timuna nigo arenge omokungu o sere‐sere o Elifasi, mosinto bw’Esau. Ere akaiborera Elifasi Amaleki. Aba nabwo barenge abachokoro abamura b’Ada moga Esau.
english: Esau's son Eliphaz also had a concubine named Timna, who bore him Amalek. These were grandsons of Esau's wife Adah.

ekegusii: Esitoni akaibora Beti‐Rafa na Pasea, na Tehina, ise abanto b’omochie o Nahasi. Aba nabanto bamenyete Reka.
english: Eshton was the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These were the men of Recah.

ekegusii: Obobare koba nengencho enene, naborobwo mbogokinie; koraboboanie nigo borakorentere ogosikwa.
english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you; embrace her, and she will honor you.

ekegusii: Erio Esteri agakwana naende nomoruoti, agatung’ama inse ase amagoro aye, akamosorora mono ase ogoitekia amariga ng’a asarie omoroberio bw’ogosiria Abayahudi, oria Hamani Omoagagi aruete.
english: Esther again pleaded with the king, falling at his feet and weeping. She begged him to put an end to the evil plan of Haman the Agagite, which he had devised against the Jews.

ekegusii: Bono Moredekai konya osemirie Esteri, omokanirie ng’a tabaisa kwemanyekania ase abanto b’ense eria amenyete ng’a ngesaku ki are, gose noyo bw’enyomba ki.
english: Esther had not revealed her nationality and family background, because Mordecai had forbidden her to do so.

ekegusii: Esther replied, "My petition and my request is this:
english: Esteri akairaneria, “Ogosaba kwane na okogania kwane noko:

ekegusii: Esteri akairaneria, akamotebia “Omochandi na omobisa oyo, nere oyo Hamani, omonto omobe kegima.” Hamani agasogwa nomoondoko ase obosio bw’omoruoti na obw’eting’ana.
english: Esther said, "The adversary and enemy is this vile Haman." Then Haman was terrified before the king and queen.

ekegusii: Ogochika okwo gw’Esteri eting’ana kogakong’ia amang’ana a Purimu, na ayio akarikwa ase ebuku.
english: Esther's decree confirmed these regulations about Purim, and it was written down in the records.

ekegusii: Nonya nomwana nigo amanyekanete ase ogokora kwaye, gose orogendo rwaye nigo rorabe ororonge na orw’ekeene.
english: Even a child is known by his actions, by whether his conduct is pure and right.

ekegusii: Nonya nomonto omoriri, ekero agokira, nigo akobarwa ng’a nomong’aini are; gakomumeka omonwa oye nigo akorokwa omong’aini.
english: Even a fool is thought wise if he keeps silent, and discerning if he holds his tongue.

ekegusii: Nonya okorete ebikone ebinge ase amasio abo, tibamwegenete,
english: Even after Jesus had done all these miraculous signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.

ekegusii: Nonya ayio onsi abete, Yeroboamu taonchogete korwa ase chinchera chiaye chimbe, korende akagenderera kobeka abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa korwa ase egati y’abanto bande bonsi. Omonto onde bwensi arigetie, nigo amwatananete koba omokuani bw’aase aria aimokererete igoro.
english: Even after this, Jeroboam did not change his evil ways, but once more appointed priests for the high places from all sorts of people. Anyone who wanted to become a priest he consecrated for the high places.

ekegusii: Even as he spoke, many put their faith in him.
english: Gakwanire aya, abange bakamwegena.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto omoriri agotaara inchera nigo akoborwa okomanya, na igo omanyia kera omonto ng’a ere nomoriri.
english: Even as he walks along the road, the fool lacks sense and shows everyone how stupid he is.

ekegusii: Even as he was speaking, Jonathan son of Abiathar the priest arrived. Adonijah said, "Come in. A worthy man like you must be bringing good news."
english: Ekero agendererete gokwana, rora, Yonathani, mosinto bw’Abiatari omokuani, agacha agwo. Adonia akamotebia, “Inchuo aiga ime, ekiagera aye nomonto bw’amasikani ore, okorenta amang’ana amaya.”

ekegusii: Mobe buna inche; nkogwenera abanto bonsi ase chinchera chionsi. Tinkorigia kwegwenera inche omonyene, korende ngwenere abwo bare abange, erinde banyare gotoorigwa.
english: even as I try to please everybody in every way. For I am not seeking my own good but the good of many, so that they may be saved.

ekegusii: Boigo Abaasuri babwatanire nabwo ase ogokonya abanto b’ororeria rwa Loti.
english: Even Assyria has joined them to lend strength to the descendants of Lot. Selah

ekegusii: Rora, Elisabeti omoamate oo, nere boigo nare noborito bw’omwana omoisia ase obogotu bwaye; na omotienyi oyo noyo bw’etano nomo asare ere oyorogetwe omogomba.
english: Even Elizabeth your relative is going to have a child in her old age, and she who was said to be barren is in her sixth month.

ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo basirete korwa chinda chi’abang’ina, abanyaborimo nigo bakoba abatantanu korwa engaki y’okoiborwa kwabo.
english: Even from birth the wicked go astray; from the womb they are wayward and speak lies.

ekegusii: naende korwa ase egati yaino abanto mbaimoke bagokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria, bang’use aborokigwa babatunyane.
english: Even from your own number men will arise and distort the truth in order to draw away disciples after them.

ekegusii: Babeli, noisa gotiira gochia igoro, noisa kwegitera chindwaki chinkong’u, ne chintambe gochia igoro, inche nintome abagosiria bayosirie. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: Even if Babylon reaches the sky and fortifies her lofty stronghold, I will send destroyers against her," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Balaki naisa kong’a enyomba yaye eichire ne chifeta, ne chitahabu, tinkonyara kwanga koigwera amang’ana Omonene anchikire, na tingokora gento kende ase ogwancha kwane, abe amabe, gose amaya. Aya Omonene agoteba, ayio naro ngwenerete nkore.
english: 'Even if Balak gave me his palace filled with silver and gold, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the LORD-- and I must say only what the LORD says'?

ekegusii: nonya omonto oria ogochia komenya emiaka chilifu ibere, korende tanyora omogoko ase obogima bwaye. Inee! Abwo bonsi babere tibakogenda aase amo?
english: even if he lives a thousand years twice over but fails to enjoy his prosperity. Do not all go to the same place?

ekegusii: Ise nakwa, gose ng’ina, gose momura omwabo, gose omoiseke omwabo, tagenda ang’e negetondo na gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka. Ere nigo abwate ase omotwe oye ekemanyererio ng’a bweatananire koba Omwerwa o Nyasae oye.
english: Even if his own father or mother or brother or sister dies, he must not make himself ceremonially unclean on account of them, because the symbol of his separation to God is on his head.

ekegusii: Naki nonya nabaichanetie ase rirube riria tinkweitia (nonya neitetie ritang’ani), ekiagera narorire ng’a rirube riria ndiabaichanetie, korende nase ekero egeke gioka.
english: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Though I did regret it-- I see that my letter hurt you, but only for a little while--

ekegusii: Naki onye ndigetie gwetogia anga tinaba omoriri, ekiagera nintebe ekeene. Korende ninyetange, omonto tambarera kobua aya aroche asende, gose koyaigwa korwa asende.
