english: For anyone who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men but to God. Indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries with his spirit.

ekegusii: Buna orokini rokweboerigwa rokwomerera omobere bw’omonto, naboigo nakorete abanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli na bonsi b’Abayuda, erinde banyomerere, babe abanto baane na korenta ogotogigwa na ogosika ase erieta riane, korende barabwo tibanyigwerete. Nabo inche Omonene ngoteba.”
english: For as a belt is bound around a man's waist, so I bound the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to me,' declares the LORD, 'to be my people for my renown and praise and honor. But they have not listened.'

ekegusii: Amabeere agotundwa nigo akorua amaguta, na okomintontoria emioro, amanyinga nigo ararueo. Naboigo ogoseegeta na koba nendamwamu, ayio nigo akorenta okorwana.
english: For as churning the milk produces butter, and as twisting the nose produces blood, so stirring up anger produces strife."

ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna igoro ere aare mono korwa ase ense, naboigo obwanchani bwaye bore obonene ase abanto bamoirogete.
english: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him;

ekegusii: ekiagera ekero narenge goetanana aria na aria, na korora ebisasimero biaino, nkarora egesasimero kerikire amang’ana aya: Ase Nyasae oria otamanyekaneti. Gaki inche nigo nkobarareria chingencho chiaye ere oria inwe mogosasima motamanyeti.
english: For as I walked around and looked carefully at your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. Now what you worship as something unknown I am going to proclaim to you.

ekegusii: Ekiagera buna ase Adamu bonsi bagokwa, naboigo nase Kristo bonsi nababe moyo,
english: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.

ekegusii: Aye kwabunire rikorogoto riarenge ririto asebare, kwabunire enyimbo eria yarenge goaka amareko abo, enyimbo eyio yarenge ey’abachandi babo, buna gwakorete ase engaki y’Abamidiani.
english: For as in the day of Midian's defeat, you have shattered the yoke that burdens them, the bar across their shoulders, the rod of their oppressor.

ekegusii: Naki buna Yona abete ekemanyererio ase abanto ba Nineva, naboigo Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arache koba ase ekegori eke.
english: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so also will the Son of Man be to this generation.

ekegusii: Naki buna Yona abete ime ase enda y’enswe enene ase engaki y’emebaso etato na amatuko atato, nabo na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere arabe ime ase enkoro y’ense emebaso etato na amatuko atato.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a huge fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

ekegusii: Naki buna okomesa gokorwa moocha kwabara gochia bosongo, naboigo ogocha kw’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto korache koba.
english: For as lightning that comes from the east is visible even in the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

ekegusii: Naki buna Tata are nobogima ime yaye omonyene; naboigo oeire na Omwana koba nobogima ime yaye omonyene.
english: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son to have life in himself.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana ebimeri bikomera korwa riroba ime, na buna ebisimekire ase omogondo bigokina, naboigo Omonene Nyasae ararente oboronge na ogotogia, bibe ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
english: For as the soil makes the sprout come up and a garden causes seeds to grow, so the Sovereign LORD will make righteousness and praise spring up before all nations.

ekegusii: Naki buna omokungu arwete ase omosacha, naboigo na omosacha nere akoiborwa nomokungu, korende bionsi nigo bikorua ase Nyasae.)
english: For as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.

ekegusii: naki kera oyomo nigo agotang’ana kobogoria endagera yaye ase okoria, oyomo nare nenchara, na oyonde otindete.
english: for as you eat, each of you goes ahead without waiting for anybody else. One remains hungry, another gets drunk.

ekegusii: Emereng’anio eyio eragere abanto bamanye obong’aini na amorokererio ay’okorongeyia, naende bamanye amang’ana are nengencho.
english: for attaining wisdom and discipline; for understanding words of insight;

ekegusii: Naki ebibe nao biarenge ase ense amachiko atarabekwa, korende ebibe tibikobarwa amachiko ataiyo.
english: for before the law was given, sin was in the world. But sin is not taken into account when there is no law.

ekegusii: Ime yaye ebinto bionsi bigatongwa, ebire igoro na ebire ase ense, ebikororekana na ebitakororekana, onye nebirogo bi’obogambi, gose amaruoti, gose abagambi, gose abare nokobua; ebinto, bionsi nigo biatongetwe goetera asare na ase engencho yaye.
english: For by him all things were created: things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or powers or rulers or authorities; all things were created by him and for him.

ekegusii: Naki ase engaki eye nanga narambora okoboko kwane ngoake aye amo nabanto bao namarwaire amabe abaite, aye nanga ngwasira korwa ase ense eye.
english: For by now I could have stretched out my hand and struck you and your people with a plague that would have wiped you off the earth.

ekegusii: Naki ase obuya naetwe nigo ngotebia kera omonto oyore asemore, tabaisa kweenenia ere omonyene ase ebirengererio biaye kobua buna emogwenerete korengereria; korende abe nebirengererio ebironge koreng’ana buna Nyasae aeire kera omonto ekerengo gi’okwegena.
english: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but rather think of yourself with sober judgment, in accordance with the measure of faith God has given you.

ekegusii: Naki ase amang’ana ao noegwe oboronge, na ase amang’ana ao nogambigwe.”
english: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned."

ekegusii: Naki mbare abanto besoirie bobisi, abwo barikeretwe kare okogambigwa oko, abanto batari ne chingencho chi’obonyasae. Barabwo nigo bakoonchorana obuya bwa Nyasae oito ase okobiserera ogokora kwabo kw’obonyaka, naende bagokana Omonene oito ore bweka, oyore Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: For certain men whose condemnation was written about long ago have secretly slipped in among you. They are godless men, who change the grace of our God into a license for immorality and deny Jesus Christ our only Sovereign and Lord.

ekegusii: Naki Kristo tasoete Aase Aachenu akoretwe namaboko, naro omogwekano bw’Aachenu a ekeene, korende agasoa igoro aanyene, na bono nao akororekana ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase engencho yaito intwe.
english: For Christ did not enter a man-made sanctuary that was only a copy of the true one; he entered heaven itself, now to appear for us in God's presence.

ekegusii: Naki Kristo tantomete ng’a mbatise, korende ndandie enchili, tari ase obong’aini bw’amang’ana, erinde omosalaba o Kristo tokorwa koba egento kia bosa.
english: For Christ did not send me to baptize, but to preach the gospel-- not with words of human wisdom, lest the cross of Christ be emptied of its power.

ekegusii: Ekiagera Kristo nere agakwa ara rimo ase engencho y’ebibe. Ere oyorenge omonyene oboronge agachandwa ase engencho y’abatari abaronge, erinde atorente ase Nyasae. Omobere oye ogaitwa, korende omoika oye ogakorwa koba moyo.
english: For Christ died for sins once for all, the righteous for the unrighteous, to bring you to God. He was put to death in the body but made alive by the Spirit,

ekegusii: Naki obwanchani bwa Kristo nigo bogotobetereria, ekiagera twamanyire ekeene ng’a onye oyomo okure ase engencho ya bonsi, nabo bonsi bakure.
english: For Christ's love compels us, because we are convinced that one died for all, and therefore all died.

ekegusii: Ekiagera Daudi tagendete igoro, korende ere omonyenye nigo agoteba: “Omonene agatebia Omonene one, Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio,
english: For David did not ascend to heaven, and yet he said, "'The Lord said to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand

ekegusii: Aya igo akoregete, ekiagera Daudi nigo akorete ayare amaronge ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ase obogima bwaye bwonsi, tamochete gokora kende gionsi Omonene amochigete, otatiga ase amang’ana a Uria Omohiti oka amochete.
english: For David had done what was right in the eyes of the LORD and had not failed to keep any of the LORD's commands all the days of his life-- except in the case of Uriah the Hittite.

ekegusii: ekiagera Daudi konya otebirie Omoameleki oria, “Okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ao, tiga kobarwe igoro yao, ekiagera kwebereire kirori aye omonyene, ekero gwateba ng’a gwaitire omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.”
english: For David had said to him, "Your blood be on your own head. Your own mouth testified against you when you said, 'I killed the LORD's anointed.'"

ekegusii: Daudi akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oeire abanto baye obotoereru, na bono ere nigo amenyete Yerusalemu kare na kare.
english: For David had said, "Since the LORD, the God of Israel, has granted rest to his people and has come to dwell in Jerusalem forever,

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakondigia kera rituko, na nigo bagokirie bamanye chinchera chiane. Nigo banga buna egesaku kegokora oboronge getana gotiga amachiko a Nyasae obo. Barabwo nigo bakomboria mbagambie ebina bi’oboronge, nigo baganetie Nyasae abaike ang’e.”
english: For day after day they seek me out; they seem eager to know my ways, as if they were a nation that does what is right and has not forsaken the commands of its God. They ask me for just decisions and seem eager for God to come near them.

ekegusii: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer. Selah
english: Omobaso na obotuko okoboko kwao gokanditoera negesusuro; chinguru chiane chikaera buna amache akoera ekero ki’egurugura.

ekegusii: Naki Dema ontigire, na gwancha ense eye ya bono; ochiire Tesaloniki. Keresike ochiire Galatia na Tito Dalamatia.
english: for Demas, because he loved this world, has deserted me and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

ekegusii: Obogambi nobw’Omonene, nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku bionsi.
english: for dominion belongs to the LORD and he rules over the nations.

ekegusii: ekiagera abagotinda, na abaria bobe, mbabe abataka; na obogondereria bwe chitoro nigo boraboyie omonto amachanchabe.
english: for drunkards and gluttons become poor, and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

ekegusii: Naki kera omonto nebogorererie egurube yaye omonyene.
english: for each one should carry his own load.

ekegusii: Naki Kristo tegwenerete ere omonyene; korende buna erikire, “Emerumi yabo bakoramete nigo yangwerete inche.”
english: For even Christ did not please himself but, as it is written: "The insults of those who insult you have fallen on me."

ekegusii: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.
english: Naki nonya mbamura bamwabo tibamwegenete.

ekegusii: Naki ninsa gwetogia kobua ake ase engencho y’okobua gwaito okwo twaeirwe n’Omonene, tonyare kobaagacha inwe, gose tari okobaiyeria, tinkobekwa ase obosooku.
english: For even if I boast somewhat freely about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than pulling you down, I will not be ashamed of it.

ekegusii: Gaki, nonya chire echinde chikorokwa chinyasae igoro gose ense (buna chire “chinyasae” chinyinge, na “abanene” abange)
english: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as indeed there are many "gods" and many "lords"),

ekegusii: Naki Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto tachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y’abange.”
english: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."

ekegusii: Naki nonya nase Tesaloniki mwandeterete ogokonywa ase okoremerwa kwane ara kabere, tari rimo rioka.
english: for even when I was in Thessalonica, you sent me aid again and again when I was in need.

ekegusii: For even when we were with you, we gave you this rule: "If a man will not work, he shall not eat."
english: Ekiagera nonya nekero keria twarenge amo nainwe ntwabachigete ring’ana eri, ng’a onye omonto tarigeti gokora emeremo, taegwa endagera.

ekegusii: ekiagera ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana nechiane, ne chiombe chilifu chire ase ebigoro nechiane.
english: for every animal of the forest is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.

ekegusii: (Kera enyomba nigo ekoagachwa nomonto, korende Nyasae nere omoagachi bw’ebinto bionsi.)
english: For every house is built by someone, but God is the builder of everything.

ekegusii: Naama! Emioyo y’abanto bonsi neyane; koreng’ana buna omoyo o ise ore oyone, boigo noyo bw’omwana ore oyone. Omonto oyio ogokora ebibe, nere orakwe.
english: For every living soul belongs to me, the father as well as the son-- both alike belong to me. The soul who sins is the one who will die.

ekegusii: for every lofty tower and every fortified wall,
english: na emerobiri yonsi emetambe, ne chindwaki chinkong’u,

ekegusii: ne chimeeri chionsi chia Tarisisi, na ebinto ebiya biroisirie ase obong’aini.
english: for every trading ship and every stately vessel.

ekegusii: Kera oyoiboirwe na Nyasae nigo akobua ense, na oko nakwo okobua korabue ense, okwegena gwaito.
english: for everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi nigo bakorigia ebinto biabo abanyene, gose tari ebia Kristo Yeso.
english: For everyone looks out for his own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Ekiagera kera oyogosaba nigo akoegwa, na ere oyokorigia nigo akonyora, na ere oyogotura nigo akoigorerwa.
english: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.

ekegusii: Ekiagera kera oyogosaba, nigo akoegwa, na ere oyokorigia, nigo akonyora, na ere oyogotura, nigo akoigorerwa.
english: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.

ekegusii: Ekiagera kera oyokweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.”
english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted."

ekegusii: Naki kera oyore negento naegwe, naende amenteranigwe; korende ere oyotari negento, nonya nkeria abwate naurwe.
english: For everyone who has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from him.

ekegusii: Kera egento egiatongetwe na Nyasae nekiya na tikegwenereti kwangwa, korende, nkegwenerete konyorwa amo nokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono,
english: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,

ekegusii: Naki bionsi ebire ase ense eye, okogania okobe kw’omobere, na okogania okobe kw’amaiso, na oboenenu bw’obogima obo, tibiri korua ase Tata, korende nigo bikorua ase ense.
english: For everything in the world-- the cravings of sinful man, the lust of his eyes and the boasting of what he has and does-- comes not from the Father but from the world.

ekegusii: Naki onsi ayatang’anete korikwa korwa kare nigo arigetwe ase ogotworokereria intwe, erinde ase oboremereria na ase okoremigwa tokonyora korwa ase amariko, tonyare koba nogosemeria.
english: For everything that was written in the past was written to teach us, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

ekegusii: Abanyabibe mbasirigwe kegima, korende abamoganyete Omonene mbaire ense ebe eyabo.
english: For evil men will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.

ekegusii: Naki omokungu onyuomire igo asibire namachiko ase omosacha oye, ekero ere are moyo, korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe korwa ase amachiko aria amosibete ase omosacha oria.
english: For example, by law a married woman is bound to her husband as long as he is alive, but if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.

ekegusii: Ezara konya orure enkoro yaye kweorokereria amachiko ’Omonene na koyakora, naende nigo arenge kworokereria Abaisraeli emeroberio yaye, na okogamba kwaye kwa boronge.
english: For Ezra had devoted himself to the study and observance of the Law of the LORD, and to teaching its decrees and laws in Israel.

ekegusii: Naki nabaoroke amakristo ’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo, nabaorokie ebikone ebinene na amakumia, goika keranyarekane, nabang’aine nonya nabachore.
english: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and miracles to deceive even the elect-- if that were possible.

ekegusii: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and miracles to deceive the elect-- if that were possible.
english: ekiagera amakristo ’oborimo, na ababani b’oborimo nabaorokie ebikone na amakumia, banyare gosiria nonya nabachore.

ekegusii: Ninkore ayio, erinde baborwe endagera na amache, na baichanerane omonto noyomwabo, na barabwo nigo bararee na kogireka ase engencho y’egesusuro ki’obobe bwabo.
english: for food and water will be scarce. They will be appalled at the sight of each other and will waste away because of their sin.

ekegusii: Etoigo eria ekagenderera igoro y’ense ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, naro amache akamentekana, agacheng’enenia obwato na koboimokereria igoro mono korwa ase ense.
english: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and as the waters increased they lifted the ark high above the earth.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, chimambia na emegoroba, Omofilisti oria nigo arenge gocha bosio, otenenao.
english: For forty days the Philistine came forward every morning and evening and took his stand.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nigo nagechetigwe nekiaare keria, ngateba, “Abanto aba nabasareku ase chinkoro chiabo ime, tibaraareti chinchera chiane.”
english: For forty years I was angry with that generation; I said, "They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known my ways."

ekegusii: Inwe nigo morachandeke ase emiaka emerongo ene, omwaka oyomo ase kera rituko mwarenge koroota ense eria, nainwe namonyare komanya ng’a inki gekoba ekero nkoba mamincha yaino.
english: For forty years-- one year for each of the forty days you explored the land-- you will suffer for your sins and know what it is like to have me against you.'

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene bagendererete kobeera ase erooro okabarenda, barabwo tibaremeretwe gento kende, nonya ne chianga chiabo tichiagotete, gose amagoro abo tabimbete.”
english: For forty years you sustained them in the desert; they lacked nothing, their clothes did not wear out nor did their feet become swollen.

ekegusii: Ekiagera ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa asare, nigo bire ase okobua kwaye, naende nigo biteneine asare. Ogotogigwa nokwaye goika kare na kare. Amina.
english: For from him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory forever! Amen.

ekegusii: Ekiagera ime ase chinkoro chi’abanto nigo bikorwao ebirengererio ebibe, obonyaka, oboibi, oboiti, obotomani,
english: For from within, out of men's hearts, come evil thoughts, sexual immorality, theft, murder, adultery,

ekegusii: Emereng’anio eyio nigo erae abatamanyeti amange bamanye chisemi, naende nigo erorokererie ekegori egeke getware okomanya na emeroberio emiya.
english: for giving prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young--

ekegusii: Ekiagera Nyasae tatoragerete endamwamu, korende agatoragera tonyore ogotooreka goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo,
english: For God did not appoint us to suffer wrath but to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tatorangereti tobe ase ogotacheneka, korende ase obochenu.
english: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.

ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nigo ayerinete obong’aini, gose tayeete okomanya.
english: for God did not endow her with wisdom or give her a share of good sense.

ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae tatoeti omoika bw’obwoba, korende oyo bwe chinguru na obwanchani, na oyo bw’okwerenga intwe abanyene.
english: For God did not give us a spirit of timidity, but a spirit of power, of love and of self-discipline.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tatomete Omwana oye ase ense agambie ense, korende ense etoorigwe nere.
english: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.

ekegusii: Ekiagera gwanchereria tikori ase Nyasae.
english: For God does not show favoritism.

ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae nigo agokwana ase enchera eyemo, gose ibere; nonya nabo monto onde tari okomotegerera.
english: For God does speak-- now one way, now another-- though man may not perceive it.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae osibire bonsi ase ogotaigwera, erinde aborokie bonsi amabera.
english: For God has bound all men over to disobedience so that he may have mercy on them all.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae obekire ase chinkoro chiabo okogania kw’ogokora ogwancha kwaye ase okoba nokorengereria okomo, na koa eng’iti eria oboruoti bwabo, goika amang’ana a Nyasae aikeranigwe.
english: For God has put it into their hearts to accomplish his purpose by agreeing to give the beast their power to rule, until God's words are fulfilled.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tari Nyasae bw’eburuburu, korende oyo bw’omorembe. Buna ere ase chikanisa chionsi chi’abachenu,
english: For God is not a God of disorder but of peace. As in all the congregations of the saints,

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are omoruoti bw’ense yonsi, motogie namatera are nengencho.
english: For God is the King of all the earth; sing to him a psalm of praise.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nigo achigete, agateba: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng’ina, ogokwa nakwe.
english: For God said, 'Honor your father and mother' and 'Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.'

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae agancha ng’a oboikeranu bwaye bwonsi bomenye ime asare.
english: For God was pleased to have all his fullness dwell in him,

ekegusii: Nyasae narente kera ogokora ase ekina ekero aranachere obobisi bwonsi ekina, karabe amaya gose amabe.
english: For God will bring every deed into judgment, including every hidden thing, whether it is good or evil.

ekegusii: Nyasae natoorie Sayoni na aagache emechie y’Abayuda naende, abasomba baye mbayeire ebe eyabo na komenya aroro.
english: for God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae oyotebete, “Omobaso nobare korwa ase omosunte”, nere obarire ase chinkoro chiaito ime, atoe omobaso bwe chisemi chi’obonene bwa Nyasae ase obosio bwa Kristo.
english: For God, who said, "Let light shine out of darkness," made his light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Christ.

ekegusii: (Naki ere oyoete Petero chinguru koba omotomwa bw’abarogete, nere ong’ete inche chinguru koba omotomwa bw’abanto b’Ebisaku.)
english: For God, who was at work in the ministry of Peter as an apostle to the Jews, was also at work in my ministry as an apostle to the Gentiles.

ekegusii: for God's gifts and his call are irrevocable.
english: Naki Nyasae tari gweiteria ebiegwa biaye na okorangeria kwaye.

ekegusii: Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bore obonene asetore, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogenderete goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!
english: For great is his love toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe, na airokwe goetania chinyasae chinde.
english: For great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene mono, goika atogigwe, goika airokwe goetania chinyasae chinde.
english: For great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

ekegusii: Naki obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo bore obonene asende; aye kwabooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakure.
english: For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths of the grave.

ekegusii: Amabera ao nigo are amanene aigete aaria igoro, obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete igoro ase amare.
english: For great is your love, higher than the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

ekegusii: Amabera ao nigo are amanene aigete aaria igoro; obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete igoro ase amare.
english: For great is your love, reaching to the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

ekegusii: Hamani Omoagagi mosinto o Hamedata, omobisa bw’Abayahudi bonsi, konya orobeirie igoro y’Abayahudi ng’a abasirie, na konya oakire obomera bokorokwa Puri ase okoumokera Abayahudi mobosokano na kobasiria.
english: For Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them and had cast the pur (that is, the lot) for their ruin and destruction.

ekegusii: Obobe tibori korwa ase riroba, gose emechando teri korwa inse ase riroba,
english: For hardship does not spring from the soil, nor does trouble sprout from the ground.

ekegusii: “Naki Nyasae obekire ebinto bionsi inse ase amagoro aye.” Korende ekero agoteba, “Bionsi biabekirwe inse asare”, nigo amanyekanete ng’a Nyasae, oyobegete ebinto bionsi inse asare, tabariri ase ebinto ebio.
english: For he "has put everything under his feet." Now when it says that "everything" has been put under him, it is clear that this does not include God himself, who put everything under Christ.

ekegusii: Naki igo akumetie, ere na bonsi abarenge amo nere, ase oborubi bwe chinswe barubete;
english: For he and all his companions were astonished at the catch of fish they had taken,

ekegusii: Ere nigo abunete ebisiekero bie chitaai, na akabuna emekorogoto y’ebioma ekaba ebing’ese.
english: for he breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.

ekegusii: buna atochorete asere ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, erinde tobe abachenu, totari na komocha ase obosio bwaye.
english: For he chose us in him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in his sight. In love

ekegusii: ekiagera tang’itete ekero narenge ase enda ya baba. Onye nabete bo anga baba nere obete embeera yane, enda yaye nanga nigo yagendererete koba enene botambe.
english: For he did not kill me in the womb, with my mother as my grave, her womb enlarged forever.

ekegusii: Ere tari gwancha gochanda mwanyabanto, gose kobaichania.
english: For he does not willingly bring affliction or grief to the children of men.

ekegusii: Nigo abegete oboroso bwaye igoro ase chinyancha, akabokong’ia igoro ase chindooche.
english: for he founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.

ekegusii: Nigo arendete chinchera chi’abagokora ekeene, naende orenda chinchera chi’abamoirogete.
english: for he guards the course of the just and protects the way of his faithful ones.

ekegusii: Ekiagera agwenetie abanto, bonsi abarenge nemechando bakamosongerera, banyare komokuna.
english: For he had healed many, so that those with diseases were pushing forward to touch him.

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo arenge konya osibirwe ara aange ne chingataare na ebinyuri, abutora ebinyuri biria, na kobuna‐buna chingataare chiria, na onde tarenge ore ne chinguru chi’okomobua.
english: For he had often been chained hand and foot, but he tore the chains apart and broke the irons on his feet. No one was strong enough to subdue him.

ekegusii: ekiagera origereirie obwororo bw’omoiseke omosomba oye. Naki ekeene, korwa rero ebigori bionsi nabindoke omosesenigwa,
english: for he has been mindful of the humble state of his servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed,

ekegusii: Aye gwantooririe ase emechando yonsi, na amaiso aane nigo arigereretie ababisa baane inde nomochengo.
english: For he has delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.

ekegusii: Ere tari gochaya emechando y’abwo bachandegete, gose koyegecha, tabisete obosio bwaye asebare; ekero bamorangeretie nigo abaigwete.
english: For he has not despised or disdained the suffering of the afflicted one; he has not hidden his face from him but has listened to his cry for help.

ekegusii: Ekiagera obeire ogokorera abataka bobe na kobatiga bare bosa, naende obeire okoira ne chinguru enyomba ende yonsi ere ataagachete.
english: For he has oppressed the poor and left them destitute; he has seized houses he did not build.

ekegusii: Nere otosiborete korwa ase okobua kw’omosunte na agatong’anyia na gotosoyia ase oboruoti bw’Omwana oye omwanchwa.
english: For he has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son he loves,

ekegusii: ekiagera obekire rituko eri agocha konachera abanto b’ense ekina ase oboronge ase omonto oria aragete. Ase ayio oeire abanto bonsi ogosemeria ase okomobokia korwa ase abakure.”
english: For he has set a day when he will judge the world with justice by the man he has appointed. He has given proof of this to all men by raising him from the dead."

ekegusii: Naki ere nomorembe oito, otokorete intwe, abatwarenge babere, koba oyomo, agatagora etoto eria yatwatananete, engencho yaye obobisa.
english: For he himself is our peace, who has made the two one and has destroyed the barrier, the dividing wall of hostility,

ekegusii: Naki oyore nokobua, ere nomokoreri o Nyasae ase ogokonyorera amaya. Korende korakore amabe nekogwenerete oiroke; naki ere tabogoreti omoro bosa, ekiagera nomokoreri o Nyasae ase ogoakana egesiomba ase omokori amabe na komoa egesusuro.
english: For he is God's servant to do you good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not bear the sword for nothing. He is God's servant, an agent of wrath to bring punishment on the wrongdoer.

ekegusii: Ere nere Nyasae oito, na intwe nigo tore abanto b’oborisia bwaye, nigo tore ching’ondi chire ase oborendi bwaye. Naki yare koba buya onye rituko ria rero mwategerera eriogi riaye!
english: for he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if you hear his voice,

ekegusii: Buna omonto akorengereria ime ase enkoro yaye, naboigo are. Nigo akogotebia, “Karie na konywa”, korende enkoro yaye tegwancheti.
english: for he is the kind of man who is always thinking about the cost. "Eat and drink," he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

ekegusii: Ekiagera konya omanyire ng’a nigo bamorure ase obogechi.
english: For he knew it was out of envy that they had handed Jesus over to him.

ekegusii: Naki amomanyete oyogocha komorua; ase ayio agateba, “Timori abachenu mwensi.”
english: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.

ekegusii: Ere nigo amanyete buna totongire, nigo akoinyora ng’a nigo tore orotu bosa.
english: for he knows how we are formed, he remembers that we are dust.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge namaiga asemore mwensi, naende agaichana mono, ekiagera mwaigwete ng’a nigo arenge omorwaire.
english: For he longs for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.

ekegusii: Naki negwenerete ere agambe, goika abeke ababisa bonsi inse ase amagoro aye.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio tainyorete koorokia amabera, korende abataka, na abaremerwa, na abasionoire chinkoro chiabo, nigo abachandete goika ogokwa kwabo.
english: For he never thought of doing a kindness, but hounded to death the poor and the needy and the brokenhearted.

ekegusii: Naki ere nigo anyorete ogosikwa na obonene korwa ase Nyasae Tata, na eriogi riachete asare korwa ase obonene bw’Obonene, rigoteba, “Oyo nere Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere.”
english: For he received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, saying, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased."

ekegusii: Omonene akainyora eira eria enchenu ariete, boigo akainyora Ibrahimu, omosomba oye.
english: For he remembered his holy promise given to his servant Abraham.

ekegusii: Sulemani nigo arenge kogambera chinse chionsi chiare bosongo y’Eufarati, korwa Tifusa goika Gasa. Ase igo nigo arenge kogambera abaruoti bonsi abarenge bosongo y’Eufarati, nigo arenge nomorembe ne chinse chionsi chiamoetanaine.
english: For he ruled over all the kingdoms west of the River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and had peace on all sides.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoisanekia oyore nerang’o, na oyore nenchara omoigotia namaya.
english: for he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

ekegusii: Naki nigo atebetie Musa, “Nimororere amabera ere oyo ndarorere amabera, na nimororere amabeebe ere oyo ndarorere amabeebe.”
english: For he says to Moses, "I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion."

ekegusii: Naki igo agoteba, “Ase engaki yancheire nakoiraneretie ogosaba kwao, rituko ri’ogotooreka nagokonyete.” Rora, bono nario engaki y’ogwancherwa; rora, bono nario rituko ri’ogotooreka.
english: For he says, "In the time of my favor I heard you, and in the day of salvation I helped you." I tell you, now is the time of God's favor, now is the day of salvation.

ekegusii: Naende ere otebire ng’a kobwatana na Nyasae, ayio tari komokonya gento kende.
english: For he says, 'It profits a man nothing when he tries to please God.'

ekegusii: Omoruoti oyio nigo agoteba: “Ase chinguru chi’amaboko aane nakorire ayio, boigo nase obong’aini bwane, ekiagera nimbwate okomanya. Nasukirie chimbebe chi’abanto na kobaura chinibo chiabo, na ase chinguru chiane chire buna echi’eeri nabeire nkoiyeria abagambi korwa ase ebirogo biabo.
english: For he says: "'By the strength of my hand I have done this, and by my wisdom, because I have understanding. I removed the boundaries of nations, I plundered their treasures; like a mighty one I subdued their kings.

ekegusii: Ere agachika ekembugu‐mbugu gekaimoka, kerokio gekaimokereria igoro emerindo y’enyancha,
english: For he spoke and stirred up a tempest that lifted high the waves.

ekegusii: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.
english: Naki ere agakwana, na ayio agakoreka; agachika, na ayio akabao.

ekegusii: Omonene nateneine ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’omotaka, ase okomotooria korwa ase abwo bakomonachera ekina ki’ogokwa.
english: For he stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save his life from those who condemn him.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agokong’ia emekorogoto y’ebiita biaino; nigo agosesenia abana bamenyete ime yao.
english: for he strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your people within you.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arigereretie goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense, aroche kera egento kere inse y’erioba.
english: for he views the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens.

ekegusii: ekiagera abuete Abayahudi kegima maiso marore, okoborokia korwa ase amariko ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.
english: For he vigorously refuted the Jews in public debate, proving from the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

ekegusii: For he was looking forward to the city with foundations, whose architect and builder is God.
english: Naki igo aganyete omochie ore namaroso, oyo Nyasae arosete na koagacha.

ekegusii: Ere oyo okorusia egesiomba ase okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga na koinyora abaichanete, tari kweba ekerero ki’abwo bagokorerwa bobe.
english: For he who avenges blood remembers; he does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.

ekegusii: Naki ere oyotebete, “Totomana”, nere boigo agateba, “Toita”. Gaki, onye totomaneti, korende gwaitire, igo kwabeire omosaria amachiko.
english: For he who said, "Do not commit adultery," also said, "Do not murder." If you do not commit adultery but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.

ekegusii: Naki oyorangeretigwe ase Omonene kare omosomba, nomosibore ase Omonene. Naboigo noyorangeretigwe osiboire, nomosomba o Kristo.
english: For he who was a slave when he was called by the Lord is the Lord's freedman; similarly, he who was a free man when he was called is Christ's slave.

ekegusii: ekiagera nabe omonene ase obosio bw’Omonene. Takonywa edivai gose ekenyugwa kegotindia; ere naichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu, nonya nkorwa enda ya ng’ina.
english: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He is never to take wine or other fermented drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from birth.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende ase chinchera chiao chionsi.
english: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;

ekegusii: Ere nigo agotooria oyoremeire gakorangeria, naboigo nomotaka na oyotabwati onde okomokonya.
english: For he will deliver the needy who cry out, the afflicted who have no one to help.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto oyio arakwe, takoira gento kende, obonene bwaye tibokomotunyana bogende inse aaria amo nere.
english: for he will take nothing with him when he dies, his splendor will not descend with him.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorenta amaote, naende oyaboa; ere nigo agoaka chingoma, naende okoboko kwaye kwagwenia.
english: For he wounds, but he also binds up; he injures, but his hands also heal.

ekegusii: Ere amo nab’enyomba yaye nigo bagotirimboka gochia ase amakweri, ne chinchera chiaye nigo chikobaraa gochia aase abakure.
english: For her house leads down to death and her paths to the spirits of the dead.

ekegusii: Naki ebibe biaye biaikire igoro, na Nyasae oinyoire obobe bwaye.
english: for her sins are piled up to heaven, and God has remembered her crimes.

ekegusii: Abasomba bao nigo banchete amagena aye, na nigo bare namabeebe ase orotu rwaye.
english: For her stones are dear to your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.

ekegusii: ekiagera chingoma chiaye tichikogwenigwa. Obobe buna obwo bwaikire ase Abayuda, bwaikire nase ebiita bia Yerusalemu ase abanto baane bamenyete.
english: For her wound is incurable; it has come to Judah. It has reached the very gate of my people, even to Jerusalem itself.

ekegusii: ekiagera aiga titori nomochie oragenderere, korende nigo tokorigia oria orache gocha.
english: For here we do not have an enduring city, but we are looking for the city that is to come.

ekegusii: Naki Herode omonyene nigo atomete abanto kobwata Yohana, akamosiba echela ase engencho ya Herodia moka Filipo momura omwabo, oria Herode amotwarete,
english: For Herod himself had given orders to have John arrested, and he had him bound and put in prison. He did this because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, whom he had married.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoba nendamwamu ase engaki ensinini yoka, korende obuya bwaye nigo bokoba ase obogima bw’omonto. Ekerero nabo keranyare kobao ase omogoroba, korende mambia omogoko na omochengo nigo bigocha.
english: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may remain for a night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

ekegusii: Naki ndakore ndemererie ndore amabe ayio akobachera abaminto? Gose naki ndakore ndemererie ndore abanto b’egesaku kiane bagosirigwa.”
english: For how can I bear to see disaster fall on my people? How can I bear to see the destruction of my family?"

ekegusii: Inche nabeereire ang’e kogwa, na obororo bwane nigo bogendererete kobeera asende.
english: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

ekegusii: Naki nairokire, ng’a inse gocha timbanyora buna ndigetie kobanyora; naende ndorekane asemore, tari buna morigetie inwe. Aande gose mbanyore more neriomana, ne ribero, na endamwamu, na okweancha, na ogoitania, na okogenkana, na oboenenu, ne riroroche.
english: For I am afraid that when I come I may not find you as I want you to be, and you may not find me as you want me to be. I fear that there may be quarreling, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, gossip, arrogance and disorder.

ekegusii: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time has come for my departure.
english: Naki inche bono naikire koumorwa buna okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa na engaki yane y’ogokwa yaikire.

ekegusii: Ninde nobomaene bw’okomanya, ng’a nonya namakweri, nonya nobogima, nonya nabamalaika, nonya nabare ne chinguru, nonya nebinto ebireo, nonya nebi gochi‐gocha, nonya nokobua,
english: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,

ekegusii: Inche nimbwate amang’ana amange nganetie gokwana, ekiagera omoika ore ime yane onsukirie.
english: For I am full of words, and the spirit within me compels me;

ekegusii: Rora, nkorenta nde omorisia ase ense eye oyio otari gwechandera ching’ondi echio chigochia gokwa, gose korigia chinsiru, gose korwaria echiabunekire, gose korageria echire buya, korende nigo ararie chinyama chi’echire chinoru na achimiora‐miorie nonya nebitaago biabo.
english: For I am going to raise up a shepherd over the land who will not care for the lost, or seek the young, or heal the injured, or feed the healthy, but will eat the meat of the choice sheep, tearing off their hoofs.

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omotaka oremeire mono, na nigo inde nobororo ase enkoro yane ime.
english: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

ekegusii: Naki inche nomoke ase abatomwa, ntagwenereti korokwa omotomwa, ekiagera nachandete ekanisa ya Nyasae.
english: For I am the least of the apostles and do not even deserve to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oo, nigo ngoturubania enyancha, emerindo yaye yaba ekoeera. Omonene bw’Emeganda, nario erieta riane.
english: For I am the LORD your God, who churns up the sea so that its waves roar-- the LORD Almighty is his name.

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ninche Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, ninche Omotooria oino. Nigo naruete Abamisiri bakaba embooria ase engencho yaino, nkarua Abaetiopia na Abaseba ribaga riaino.
english: For I am the LORD, your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your stead.

ekegusii: Ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nimbabwate amaboko aino a borio. Ninche nkobatebia inwe: Timoiroka, nimbakonye.
english: For I am the LORD, your God, who takes hold of your right hand and says to you, Do not fear; I will help you.

ekegusii: Rora, nigo mbarigereretie korwa igoro ase okobarentera amabe, gose tari amaya. Abayuda bonsi abare ase ense ya Misiri mbasirigwe ase ogoitwa nemioro, na enchara, goika baere kegima.
english: For I am watching over them for harm, not for good; the Jews in Egypt will perish by sword and famine until they are all destroyed.

ekegusii: ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye, nonya monto onde tari oragochere, erinde agokore bobe. Naki inche nigo inde nabanto abange ase omochie oyo.”
english: For I am with you, and no one is going to attack and harm you, because I have many people in this city."

ekegusii: Inche na abanto baane twaoonigwe, tosirigwe ase ogoitwa. Onye nigo twaoonigwa tochie koba abasomba, abasacha na abakungu, nanga nigo nakira tinkwana, ekiagera amang’ana ayio tare goisana gochanda omoruoti.”
english: For I and my people have been sold for destruction and slaughter and annihilation. If we had merely been sold as male and female slaves, I would have kept quiet, because no such distress would justify disturbing the king."

ekegusii: Naki nababereire kirori, ng’a mbare nomokia ase Nyasae, korende ase omokia obo tibari nobong’ani.
english: For I can testify about them that they are zealous for God, but their zeal is not based on knowledge.

ekegusii: Komoraigwere amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae oino, aya inche nkobaa ase rituko ria rero, ase okomwancha na gotaara ase chinchera chiaye na kobwata amachiko aye, na emeroberio yaye echikire, erio inwe namobe moyo na komentekana, nere nabasesenie ase ense eyio mogochia gosoa na koira ebe eyaino.
english: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commands, decrees and laws; then you will live and increase, and the LORD your God will bless you in the land you are entering to possess.

ekegusii: Naki nanga naganetie ng’a ndagererigwe inche omonyene na gwatananwa korwa ase Kristo ase engencho y’abaminto abare b’eamate yane ase egesaku giaito.
english: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, those of my own race,

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde nomogoko ase amachiko ao, ekiagera ayio ninyanchete.
english: for I delight in your commands because I love them.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo nkogokigwa nobwanchani kobua kogokigwa nebing’wanso; nigo nkogokigwa ng’a imomanye inche Nyasae kobua kogokigwa nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa.
english: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and acknowledgment of God rather than burnt offerings.

ekegusii: Naki tinakwanete ase okobua kwane omonyene, korende Tata oyontomete onchikire aya ngokwana.
english: For I did not speak of my own accord, but the Father who sent me commanded me what to say and how to say it.

ekegusii: Baminto, tindigeti momoche komanya ng’a chisokoro chiaito chionsi nigo chiarenge inse ye riire. Barabwo bonsi bagaeta egati y’enyancha;
english: For I do not want you to be ignorant of the fact, brothers, that our forefathers were all under the cloud and that they all passed through the sea.

ekegusii: Nigo nare kocha kwoboigwa nemechando korwa ase Nyasae; na tinare konyara gotenena bosio bw’obonene bwaye.”
english: For I dreaded destruction from God, and for fear of his splendor I could not do such things.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoria ribu buna nkoria endagera, na ekenyugwa kiane nigo ngokeburukania namariga,
english: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears

ekegusii: Inche nigo nachayirwe ase engencho yao, obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane.
english: For I endure scorn for your sake, and shame covers my face.

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo nabete ne ribero ase abanto abaenenu, ekero naroche ng’a abwo ababe nigo basesenirie.
english: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

ekegusii: Naki amang’ana kwang’ete nabayaeire, na barabwo bayabwatire, mbamanyete ekeene ng’a nigo narure asore, bakeegena ng’a naye gwantomete.
english: For I gave them the words you gave me and they accepted them. They knew with certainty that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.

ekegusii: Naki nimomanyete, ng’a nachike abana baye na abwo b’enka yaye, abarache koiborwa korwa nyuma yaye, babwatie enchera y’Omonene, bakore oboronge na ekeene, erinde Omonene aikeranerie Ibrahimu aya amorierete eira.”
english: For I have chosen him, so that he will direct his children and his household after him to keep the way of the LORD by doing what is right and just, so that the LORD will bring about for Abraham what he has promised him."

ekegusii: Naki naikire korwa igoro, tari ase ogokora ogwancha kwane omonyene, korende ogwancha kwaye oyontomete.
english: For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.

ekegusii: For I have come to turn "'a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law--
english: Eke nacheire nakio eke: nogwatanana omonto na ise, omwana omoiseke na ng’ina, na moka momura na ng’ina biara.

ekegusii: ekiagera ninkare nabamura baminto batano; tiga agende abakurere, erinde barabwo tibacha aa ase emechando.
english: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also come to this place of torment.'

ekegusii: Inche nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chi’Omonene, tintigeti Nyasae one ase ogokora amabe.
english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD; I have not done evil by turning from my God.

ekegusii: Inche nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chi’Omonene, tintigeti Nyasae one ase ogokora obonyaka.
english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD; I have not done evil by turning from my God.

ekegusii: For I have not hesitated to proclaim to you the whole will of God.
english: ekiagera tinangete kobaranderia amang’ana ’okworokereria gwonsi kwa Nyasae.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoigwa ababisa baane bakomonyererana; okogosa nigo kong’etanaine. Abwo nigo bagosangererekana amo kogamba, bagokora omoroberio bw’okong’ita.
english: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side; they conspire against me and plot to take my life.

ekegusii: Nigo namanyete ng’a inwe nabamwenu more, naende nigo mobwate ebigoti ebikong’u binga buna ekioma, na amasio aino namakong’u buna etaai.
english: For I knew how stubborn you were; the sinews of your neck were iron, your forehead was bronze.

ekegusii: Inche nimanyete ogosaria kwaino ng’a nokonene na ebibe biaino ng’a nebinene mono. Nigo mogochanda omonyaboronge, boigo mokoegwa riaaki, erio mwaseria abataka korwa ase ekegambero kere geita tibakonyora oboronge bwabo.
english: For I know how many are your offenses and how great your sins. You oppress the righteous and take bribes and you deprive the poor of justice in the courts.

ekegusii: Inche nimanyete ng’a timori abaigweri, korende nigo more abanyabigoti bikong’u. Rora bono, ekero inde moyo amo nainwe, mwasaririe ase Omonene, Inee, ekero ndabe nakure timogosaria mono kobua?
english: For I know how rebellious and stiff-necked you are. If you have been rebellious against the LORD while I am still alive and with you, how much more will you rebel after I die!

ekegusii: Inche namanyire ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane nigo bire bosio bwane botambe.
english: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

ekegusii: Namanyire ng’a nyuma inche konakure, ekeene inwe nigo morakore amabe, naende nigo moraonchoke na gotiga enchera eye nabachikire. Ase ayio, ase amatuko agocha obobe nabobanyore, ekiagera nigo mogochia gokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio momogechie abe nendamwamu goetera ase emeremo ende yonsi morabe mogokora.”
english: For I know that after my death you are sure to become utterly corrupt and to turn from the way I have commanded you. In days to come, disaster will fall upon you because you will do evil in the sight of the LORD and provoke him to anger by what your hands have made."

ekegusii: Ee, ningoke, ekiagera namanyire ng’a aya nang’onchokere koba ase ogotooreka kwane, goetera ase ogosaba kwaino na ase ogokonya kw’Omoika o Yeso Kristo.
english: for I know that through your prayers and the help given by the Spirit of Jesus Christ, what has happened to me will turn out for my deliverance.

ekegusii: Naki inche nimanyete emeroberio mbwate asemore, emeroberio y’obuya na omorembe, gose tari ey’amabe, na emeroberio y’okobaa ogosemeria ase amatuko aino agochi‐gocha.
english: For I know the plans I have for you," declares the LORD, "plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

ekegusii: Naki namanyire okwebeka ang’e kwaino, okwo netogeretie ase Abamakedonia, ngoteba ng’a abanto b’Akaya nigo bebegete ang’e korwa omwaka oeta, na omokia oino osukirie abange asebare.
english: For I know your eagerness to help, and I have been boasting about it to the Macedonians, telling them that since last year you in Achaia were ready to give; and your enthusiasm has stirred most of them to action.

ekegusii: Naki inche nomonto inde inse ase okobua, naende ninde nabarwani inse asende. Kondatebie oyo: Genda, ogenda; na oyonde: Inchuo, ocha; na omosomba one: Kora iga, okora.”
english: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and that one, 'Come,' and he comes. I say to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."

ekegusii: Naki inche nomonto mbekire inse ase okobua, naende ninde nabarwani inse yane. Kondatebie oyo: Genda, ogenda, na oyonde: Inchuo, ocha; na omosomba one: Kora iga, okora.”
english: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and that one, 'Come,' and he comes. I say to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it."

ekegusii: Naki inche nkanyora korwa ase Omonene ayanabaeire inwe, ng’a Omonene Yeso obotuko boria aruetwe akabogoria omogati,
english: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night he was betrayed, took bread,

ekegusii: Naki nigo narengereretie ng’a timanya ing’ana rinde rionsi asemore otatiga Yeso Kristo, na nere obambetwe.
english: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

ekegusii: Nigo nkogosaba ng’a ababisa baane tibagokera emechando yane; na tibetogeria okogwa kwane.
english: For I said, "Do not let them gloat or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips."

ekegusii: Naki nakororire ng’a nore nobororo buna endorwe, naende nigo ore ase egesibo ki’ebibe.”
english: For I see that you are full of bitterness and captive to sin."

ekegusii: Inche tingokiri nogokwa kw’omonto onde bwensi; ase ayio oonchoka mobe moyo. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: For I take no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Sovereign LORD. Repent and live!

ekegusii: naki nabatebirie, korwa bono tinkonywa okwama kw’omosabibu goika oboruoti bwa Nyasae boche.”
english: For I tell you I will not drink again of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God comes."

ekegusii: Naki nabatebirie inwe, ng’a Kristo akaba omosomba bw’abarogete ase okoorokia ng’a Nyasae noyo bw’ekeene, erinde aikeranie chiira echi abagaaka baito ba kare baetwe.
english: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the Jews on behalf of God's truth, to confirm the promises made to the patriarchs

ekegusii: For I tell you that many prophets and kings wanted to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it."
english: Naki nabatebirie, ababani abange na abaruoti bakarigia korora aya mwarorire inwe, tibayarora, na koigwa aya mwaigure, tibayaigwa.”

ekegusii: Naki nabatebirie inwe, onye oboronge bwaino tibokobua obw’aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, timogosoa nonya ng’ake ase oboruoti bwa igoro.
english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness surpasses that of the Pharisees and the teachers of the law, you will certainly not enter the kingdom of heaven.

ekegusii: For I tell you the truth, many prophets and righteous men longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.
english: Nekeene nabatebirie: Ababani abange na abanyene oboronge mbaganetie korora aya moroche inwe, tibayarora, na koigwa aya mokoigwa inwe, tibayaigwa.

ekegusii: ekiagera nabatebirie, tinkoyeria naende goika yaikeranigwe ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: For I tell you, I will not eat it again until it finds fulfillment in the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Na inche nabatebirie, timokondora naende nonya ng’ake goika ekero keria morache goteba: Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene.”
english: For I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.'"

ekegusii: Naki nababereire kirori ng’a nigo baruete ase omoyo bw’ogwancha, ase okonyara kwabo, na goetania okonyara kwabo.
english: For I testify that they gave as much as they were able, and even beyond their ability. Entirely on their own,

ekegusii: Naki narorire ng’a nering’ana ritari boronge koira omosibwa otatiga koorokia amasoerwa aria asoeire.”
english: For I think it is unreasonable to send on a prisoner without specifying the charges against him."

ekegusii: Namotebetie ng’a nabeire ang’e koa eamate yaye egesusuro kogenderera botambe, ekiagera okorire ebibe. Ere nigo amanyete ng’a abamura baye mbabete bakorama erieta riane, korende tabakania batige.
english: For I told him that I would judge his family forever because of the sin he knew about; his sons made themselves contemptible, and he failed to restrain them.

ekegusii: Naboigo nachikwa n’Omonene goetera ase ring’ana riaye. Ere agantebia: Tobaisa koria endagera ende yonsi, gose konywa amache, gose tobaisa koiranera ase enchera eria gwachiereteo.”
english: For I was commanded by the word of the LORD: 'You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.'"

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo naibetwe korwa ase ense y’Abaibirania, nonya naa tinkoreti ing’ana rinde riibe riagwenerete kombeka ase echela.”
english: For I was forcibly carried off from the land of the Hebrews, and even here I have done nothing to deserve being put in a dungeon."

ekegusii: For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,
english: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, timwang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, timwang’a inywe.

ekegusii: For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in,
english: ekiagera inarenge nenchara, mokang’a endagera; inarenge nerang’o, mokang’a nkanywa; inarenge omogeni, mokandoisia;

ekegusii: Nimbe buna endo ase Abaefraimu, na buna endo ensae ase Abayuda. Inche omonyene nimbwate eke natwarire nkeire; ee, nkeire, na onde tari oragetoorie.
english: For I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a great lion to Judah. I will tear them to pieces and go away; I will carry them off, with no one to rescue them.

ekegusii: Naki nimbaabere obobe bwabo, na ebibe biabo tinkobiinyora naende.”
english: For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more."

ekegusii: For I will give you words and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
english: ekiagera inche nimbae chinkwana na obong’aini, abachandi baino batanyare gokana gose koamererania nabio.

ekegusii: “Bono tinkogenderera kororera abanto b’ense eye amabera. Naama! Nindue kera oyomo agwe ase okoboko kw’oyomwabo, na ase okoboko kw’omoruoti oye; abaruoti babo mbasarie ense, na inche tingotooria nonya nomonto oyomo korwa ase amaboko abo.” Nabo Omonene agoteba.
english: For I will no longer have pity on the people of the land," declares the LORD. "I will hand everyone over to his neighbor and his king. They will oppress the land, and I will not rescue them from their hands."

ekegusii: “Ning’umore amache ase abare nerang’o, nintubokie chindooche ase ense enyomo. Ning’umore Omoika one igoro ase abanto b’ororeria rwao, ninsesenie abana bao.
english: For I will pour water on the thirsty land, and streams on the dry ground; I will pour out my Spirit on your offspring, and my blessing on your descendants.

ekegusii: Naama! Inche ngoseegeta nde omoganda bw’ebisaku ebinene, korwa ase ense ya sugusu, na barabwo bebeke ang’e korwania Babeli bayobue korwa ensemo eria ya sugusu. Chinsara chiabo nigo chinga buna omorwani omong’aini ore neganga otari koirana bosa.
english: For I will stir up and bring against Babylon an alliance of great nations from the land of the north. They will take up their positions against her, and from the north she will be captured. Their arrows will be like skilled warriors who do not return empty-handed.

ekegusii: Naki ase emechando emenge na ase obororo bw’enkoro, naende ase amariga amange nigo nabarikerete, tari ng’a moichanigwe, korende monyare komanya obwanchani bwane obonge inde nabwo asemore.
english: For I wrote you out of great distress and anguish of heart and with many tears, not to grieve you but to let you know the depth of my love for you.

ekegusii: Inche, omosomba oo, namanyire ng’a nakorete ebibe ekero keria, ayio naro agera naba oyo bwe ritang’ani korwa ase enyomba ya Yusufu gocha gokorotota aye omoruoti aiga rero.”
english: For I your servant know that I have sinned, but today I have come here as the first of the whole house of Joseph to come down and meet my lord the king."

ekegusii: Onye Abamakedonia bande bagocha amo nainche na tobanyore timorebeka ang’e, titocha gosooka, ekero tobasemeretie inwe. Titokwana igoro y’obosooku bwaino.
english: For if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared, we-- not to say anything about you-- would be ashamed of having been so confident.

ekegusii: Naki omonto karakorore aye, omonto ore nobong’aini, goikaransete ase endagera ime ase hekalu y’emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, Inee, onye enkoro yaye ekobugwa bwango, takonyora oboremu goika arie ebinto bikoruegwa ebingwanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa?
english: For if anyone with a weak conscience sees you who have this knowledge eating in an idol's temple, won't he be emboldened to eat what has been sacrificed to idols?

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tabarorerete amabera abamalaika baria bakorete ebibe, korende akabaruta ase eoromomo y’omosunte aase barendire goika ekina geche.
english: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned, but sent them to hell, putting them into gloomy dungeons to be held for judgment;

ekegusii: Naki onye Nyasae tarorerete chinsagia chi’omote omonyene amabera, nonya naye tagokororera amabera.
english: For if God did not spare the natural branches, he will not spare you either.

ekegusii: Aise gosinywa gokoora oboagacho boria kabekire oboroso, abanto bonsi bachake komosekerera,
english: For if he lays the foundation and is not able to finish it, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,

ekegusii: Naki onye inche nkobaichania, gaki ning’o orangokie, otatiga oria naichanirie?
english: For if I grieve you, who is left to make me glad but you whom I have grieved?

ekegusii: Naki kondasabe ase omonwa otamanyekaneti omoika one nigo ogosaba, korende obong’aini bwane tibori kwama.
english: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

ekegusii: Inche timanyeti gokwana amang’ana ’okweansia, inse gokora bo, Omotongi one nigo aransirie bwango.”
english: for if I were skilled in flattery, my Maker would soon take me away.

ekegusii: Naki onye Yoshua nabaete ogotimoka, anga Nyasae nyuma yaye tare gokwana igoro ye rituko rinde.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.

ekegusii: For if men do these things when the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?"
english: Onye bagokora aya ekero omote ore omobese, naki erabe ekero bwomire?”

ekegusii: Naki onye omonto ogocha okorandia Yeso onde omoao, otatiga oyo twarandetie intwe, gose mwanche omoika onde omoao oyomotanyorete, gose enchili ende eng’ao eyemotanchete, igo moremereretie buya nayio.
english: For if someone comes to you and preaches a Jesus other than the Jesus we preached, or if you receive a different spirit from the one you received, or a different gospel from the one you accepted, you put up with it easily enough.

ekegusii: Naki onye abakure tibakobokigwa, rirorio Kristo nere tabogetigwe.
english: For if the dead are not raised, then Christ has not been raised either.

ekegusii: Naki omwando korabe ase amachiko, tokoba naende ase eira; korende Nyasae akayoa Ibrahimu ase eira.
english: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God in his grace gave it to Abraham through a promise.

ekegusii: Naki onye ring’ana riria riakwanetwe nabamalaika nigo riarenge riteneine bokong’u, na kera okomocha na ogotaigwera mbianyorete ogoakanwa kwa boronge,
english: For if the message spoken by angels was binding, and every violation and disobedience received its just punishment,

ekegusii: Naki aase ogwancha kore, iga bigwancherwa koreng’ana nebi omonto are nabio, tari ase ebi atabwati.
english: For if the willingness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.

ekegusii: Naki onye okwangwa kwabo gokorenta okobwatania ase ense, Inee, ogwancherwa kwabo inki korarente? Nigo gokorenta obogima ribaga ri’ogokwa.
english: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?

ekegusii: Naki onye okobwatana koria kwe ritang’ani kwarenge tikori na komocha, anga ribaga tiriarigetigwe ase koria gwa kabere.
english: For if there had been nothing wrong with that first covenant, no place would have been sought for another.

ekegusii: Naki onye baria b’amachiko mbarabwo abanyamwando, rirorio okwegena kwabeire okwa bosa, na eira yabeire teri gento.
english: For if those who live by law are heirs, faith has no value and the promise is worthless,

ekegusii: Ekeene, komoraigwe ring’ana eri, abaruoti mbagenderere goikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi, mbabe bagosoera ebiita bi’omochie bariinete chigari ne chibarasi, barabwo amo nabasomba babo, na abanto babo.
english: For if you are careful to carry out these commands, then kings who sit on David's throne will come through the gates of this palace, riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by their officials and their people.

ekegusii: Naki inwe kamoraabere abanto ogosaria kwabo, naboigo na Iso oino ore igoro nabaabere inwe.
english: For if you forgive men when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

ekegusii: naki komoratunyane chingencho chi’ebibe, nigo morakwe, korende komoraite ogokora kw’omobere ase chinguru chi’Omoika, namobe moyo.
english: For if you live according to the sinful nature, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the misdeeds of the body, you will live,

ekegusii: Naki amang’ana aya karabe ime yaino na komenteka, nabakore timoba aboro gose abanto motari nokwama, ase okomomanya Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: For if you possess these qualities in increasing measure, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Naki onye aye kogokira‐kiri kegima ase engaki eye, ogokonywa na ogotooreka nigo korache ase Abayahudi korwa ensemo ende, korende aye na abanto b’enyomba ya iso mosirigwe. Ande, ning’o omanyete gose nase engencho y’engaki buna eye kwabeire eting’ana y’omoruoti?”
english: For if you remain silent at this time, relief and deliverance for the Jews will arise from another place, but you and your father's family will perish. And who knows but that you have come to royal position for such a time as this?"

ekegusii: Onye ase ogosaria kw’omonto oyomo amakweri agambete ase engencho y’omonto oria oyomo, kobua mono abwo banyorire amabera amange na ekeegwa ki’oboronge nabagambe ase obogima goetera ase omonto oyomo, Yeso Kristo.
english: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive God's abundant provision of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Naki ekero twarenge ababisa ba Nyasae, tokabwatanigwa nere ase amakweri ’Omwana oye. Kobua mono, nyuma gatwabwatanigwe natotoorigwe ase obogima bwaye;
english: For if, when we were God's enemies, we were reconciled to him through the death of his Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through his life!

ekegusii: Naki ime yaye nao oboikeranu bwonsi bw’obonyasae bomenyete ase ekieni ki’omobere.
english: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity lives in bodily form,

ekegusii: Naki ase Kristo Yeso okwaroka tikogokonyorera kende, gose ogotaroka, korende okwegena okwo nakwo kogokora emeremo ase obwanchani.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any value. The only thing that counts is faith expressing itself through love.

ekegusii: ekiagera: “Ime asare nigo tore moyo, na togotaara, naende nigo tore nobogima bwaito; koreng’ana buna abarenti chingero bande baino bakwanete: Naki intwe twensi nigo tore ababiare baye.
english: 'For in him we live and move and have our being.' As some of your own poets have said, 'We are his offspring.'

ekegusii: Ase kera enchera mogatenenkigwa ime asare ase chinkwana chionsi, ne chisemi chionsi,
english: For in him you have been enriched in every way-- in all your speaking and in all your knowledge--

ekegusii: Omonto oyo nigo akweremia omonyene ase okweng’aina, ng’a ebibe biaye tibikomanyekana bigechwe.
english: For in his own eyes he flatters himself too much to detect or hate his sin.

ekegusii: For in just a very little while, "He who is coming will come and will not delay.
english: “Naki nkere ekero egeke mono, ere oyore gocha nachiche, gose tagotebana gocha,

ekegusii: Naki nigo ngosasoka mono ase omoyo one ase engencho y’amachiko a Nyasae,
english: For in my inner being I delight in God's law;

ekegusii: Ekiagera erikire ase amariko, “Rigereria, nabekire ase Sayoni rigena richore, rigena rinene ri’ekoona, naende nigo rire rie rigori rinene, na onde bwensi oyoramwegene takorora obosooku.”
english: For in Scripture it says: "See, I lay a stone in Zion, a chosen and precious cornerstone, and the one who trusts in him will never be put to shame."

ekegusii: Naki ase amatuko atano na rimo naro Omonene atongete igoro na ense, ne chinyancha, na bionsi ebire imeo; agatimoka ase rituko ria gatano na kabere. Ase ayio Omonene agasesenia rituko ri’Esabato, akariatanana ribe richenu.
english: For in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, the sea, and all that is in them, but he rested on the seventh day. Therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day and made it holy.

ekegusii: Engaki ngocha ere kera omonto aratugute emegwekano yaye agosasima eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu, eyio mwaroisetie namaboko aino, na igo mogakora ebibe.
english: For in that day every one of you will reject the idols of silver and gold your sinful hands have made.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emechando nantube ase ekiriri kiaye; nambise ase eema yaye ime, Nanyimokie ambeke ase egetare igoro.
english: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his tabernacle and set me high upon a rock.

ekegusii: Naki buna barenge ase amatuko aria etoigo etaracha, baare koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato,
english: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark;

ekegusii: Ekiagera ime yaye oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae bwaorokigwe korwa okwegena goika okwegena, buna erikire, “Omonyene oboronge nabe moyo ase okwegena.”
english: For in the gospel a righteousness from God is revealed, a righteousness that is by faith from first to last, just as it is written: "The righteous will live by faith."

ekegusii: For in the same way you judge others, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
english: Naki ekina mokonacha, nakio morache konacherwa. Na ekerengo keria mokorengera, nakio morache korengerwa.

ekegusii: Naki nigo twatooretigwe ase ogosemeria. Korende egento keria gesemeirie gokiarorekanire, rirorio gosemeria tikori. Naki ning’o orasemerie eki aroche?
english: For in this hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what he already has?

ekegusii: Nebe ng’a omonto ogendire amo noyonde ase rinani kogecha emete, na ekero aimokirie egesire, na egesire ekio gesomoke korwa ase omote, gecharare, geite omonto oria onde, omoiti oria nabo aratamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio ase ogotooria obogima bwaye.
english: For instance, a man may go into the forest with his neighbor to cut wood, and as he swings his ax to fell a tree, the head may fly off and hit his neighbor and kill him. That man may flee to one of these cities and save his life.

ekegusii: Nyasae, Omonene bw’Emeganda, tatigeti Abaisraeli na Abayuda, nonya ense yabo yabeire nebibe ebinge ase Omonene ore omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: For Israel and Judah have not been forsaken by their God, the LORD Almighty, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: ekiagera borobwo tibwatangete baba tanyibora, gose tibwatangete emechando korwa ase amaiso aane.”
english: for it did not shut the doors of the womb on me to hide trouble from my eyes.

ekegusii: ekiagera tigekomosoa enkoro, otatiga ase enda yoka, erio kiagwa kebaara?” (Ase ogoteba igo, osibirie chindagera chionsi.)
english: For it doesn't go into his heart but into his stomach, and then out of his body." (In saying this, Jesus declared all foods "clean.")

ekegusii: Ekiagera ase engencho ya Kristo mwaeirwe, tari okomwegena gwoka korende nogochandwa boigo ase engencho yaye.
english: For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for him,

ekegusii: Omwaka oyio noyo bw’Omochengo. Nobe omochenu asemore. Inamorie chindagera chiemeretie chinyene korwa ase riroba.
english: For it is a jubilee and is to be holy for you; eat only what is taken directly from the fields.

ekegusii: Naki mwatoorigwe ase obuya, ase enchera y’okwegena; ayio tarwete asemore abanyene, korende nekeegwa kia Nyasae;
english: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith-- and this not from yourselves, it is the gift of God--

ekegusii: Naki igo are maiso marore ng’a ere nigo arwete ase ororeria rwa Yuda. Na ekero Musa akwanete igoro y’ororeria orwo takwanete ing’ana rinde igoro y’abakuani.
english: For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah, and in regard to that tribe Moses said nothing about priests.

ekegusii: Naki aya namaya mono omonto kararemererie ogoichana ase okoinyora Nyasae, na kobogoria ogochandwa gotari kwa boronge.
english: For it is commendable if a man bears up under the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God.

ekegusii: Naki obereirwe kirori ng’a. “Aye n’Omokuani o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”
english: For it is declared: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nere ogokora emeremo ime yaino ase okorigia, naende ase ogokora ogwancha kwaye okuya.
english: for it is God who works in you to will and to act according to his good purpose.

ekegusii: ekiagera oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ng’a ase ogokora kwaino okuya mokirie abanto abariri ase ogotamanya kwabo.
english: For it is God's will that by doing good you should silence the ignorant talk of foolish men.

ekegusii: Ase ayio otebire, “Boka aye osundogete, boka korwa ase abakure, na Kristo nakobarerie.”
english: for it is light that makes everything visible. This is why it is said: "Wake up, O sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."

ekegusii: Naki omonto bwancheirwe tari ere ogwetogia omonyene, korende noyo ogotogigwa n’Omonene.
english: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved, but the one whom the Lord commends.

ekegusii: Naki tari abwo bakoigwa amachiko bare abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende mbaria bagoikerania amachiko, nabwo baraegwe oboronge.
english: For it is not those who hear the law who are righteous in God's sight, but it is those who obey the law who will be declared righteous.

ekegusii: Nigo erabe buya korayarende ime yao, erinde abe ang’e ase ebikoba biao koyakwana.
english: for it is pleasing when you keep them in your heart and have all of them ready on your lips.

ekegusii: ekiagera nobosooku nonya nogokwana amang’ana ayio agokorwa nabarabwo bobisi.
english: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.

ekegusii: Naki engaki yaikire ekina gechakere ase enyomba ya Nyasae na gakerachake asetore, omoerio obo abwo bataigwereti enchili ya Nyasae, naki orabe?
english: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who do not obey the gospel of God?

ekegusii: Naki intwe naba twarogete, abatogosasima Nyasae ase Omoika oye, na gwetogia ase Kristo Yeso, na titosemereti ebia omobere.
english: For it is we who are the circumcision, we who worship by the Spirit of God, who glory in Christ Jesus, and who put no confidence in the flesh--

ekegusii: Naki ase enkoro omonto nigo akwegena, erio onyora oboronge; na ase omonwa oorokia, erio onyora ogotooreka.
english: For it is with your heart that you believe and are justified, and it is with your mouth that you confess and are saved.

ekegusii: Naki ase amachiko a Musa nigo arikire, “Tobaisa kobekera entang’ana ekeokio ekero ekoora endagera.” Inee! Nyasae narengereretie amang’ana e chintang’ana?
english: For it is written in the Law of Moses: "Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain." Is it about oxen that God is concerned?

ekegusii: Naki nerikire, ng’a Ibrahimu nigo arenge nabana babere abamura, oyomo bw’omokungu omosomba, na oyomo bw’omokungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the slave woman and the other by the free woman.

ekegusii: Naki nerikire, “Aye ore omogomba, otari koibora, goka! Aye otari nokobina ase okoibora, aka eriogi, orere nomogoko, ekiagera abana baye oria otigetwe nigo bare abange kobua abaye oyore nomosacha.”
english: For it is written: "Be glad, O barren woman, who bears no children; break forth and cry aloud, you who have no labor pains; because more are the children of the desolate woman than of her who has a husband."

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo erikire, “Nebagwenerete mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu.”
english: for it is written: "Be holy, because I am holy."

ekegusii: ekiagera nerikire, “Ere nagochikere abamalaika baye bakorende,”
english: For it is written: "'He will command his angels concerning you to guard you carefully;

ekegusii: Naki nerikire, “Ninsarie obong’aini bw’abang’aini, na okomanya kw’abamanyi ninkwange.”
english: For it is written: "I will destroy the wisdom of the wise; the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate."

ekegusii: Nigo agotoa ogochika igoro ase ogochika, ee, ogochika igoro ase ogochika; ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana, ee, ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana; aiga make, na aaria make.”
english: For it is: Do and do, do and do, rule on rule, rule on rule; a little here, a little there."

ekegusii: Naki nigo ndoche ng’a Nyasae otobekire intwe abatomwa tobe ab’omoerio ase bonsi, buna abanto bagambetigwe ng’a baitwe, ekiagera twabeire ekiorokererio ki’ogosekererwa ase ense, na ase abamalaika, na ase mwanyabanto.
english: For it seems to me that God has put us apostles on display at the end of the procession, like men condemned to die in the arena. We have been made a spectacle to the whole universe, to angels as well as to men.

ekegusii: Omonene nere okong’etie chinkoro chiabo ng’a barwanie Abaisraeli, erinde barabwo abanyene basirigwe kegima batari kororerwa amabera. Nabo Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: For it was the LORD himself who hardened their hearts to wage war against Israel, so that he might destroy them totally, exterminating them without mercy, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Naki naboigo eranyare gochera abanto bonsi abamenyete igoro ase ense yonsi.
english: For it will come upon all those who live on the face of the whole earth.

ekegusii: naki tari inwe morakwane, korende n’Omoika o Iso oino orakwane goetera ime yaino.
english: for it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.

ekegusii: Risemi nigo rigokora omosacha oba nekeririanda, na takoba namabera ekero akorusia egesiomba.
english: for jealousy arouses a husband's fury, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.

ekegusii: Naki konya ochikire ekerecha keria ki’eubi gesoke korwa ase omonto oria. (Ekiagera ebiro ebinge nigo kiare komobwata; nonya orenge gosibwa nebinyuri ne chingataare na korendwa, nigo arenge kobutora ebisibo biria oirwa nekerecha keria goika ase erooro.)
english: For Jesus had commanded the evil spirit to come out of the man. Many times it had seized him, and though he was chained hand and foot and kept under guard, he had broken his chains and had been driven by the demon into solitary places.

ekegusii: ekiagera Yeso konya ogetebirie, “Aye ekerecha ki’eubi, karwe ase omonto oyo!”
english: For Jesus had said to him, "Come out of this man, you evil spirit!"

ekegusii: Yohana nigo arenge kobatisa ase amache, korende inwe inamobatiswe ase Omoika Omochenu nyuma y’amatuko amake.”
english: For John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit."

ekegusii: Naki Yohana nigo achete, tare koria gose tare konywa: bagateba; Nare nekerecha.
