english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, 'He has a demon.'

ekegusii: Naki Yohana achete asemore ase enchera y’oboronge, timwamwegena; korende abarusia ebango na abakungu abatayayi bakamwegena; na inwe nonya nekero mwaroche ayio, timwaonchoka na komwegena.
english: For John came to you to show you the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.

ekegusii: For John had been saying to Herod, "It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife."
english: ekiagera Yohana amokanetie Herode, “Tai boronge asore komenyana na moka momura omino.”

ekegusii: for John had been saying to him: "It is not lawful for you to have her."
english: ekiagera Yohana amotebetie, “Tai boronge asore komenyana nere.”

ekegusii: Naki Yohana Omobatisi nigo achete, tare koria omogati, gose tare konywa edivai; na inwe mogoteba: Nabwatire nekerecha.
english: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, 'He has a demon.'

ekegusii: Yoshua taringete okoboko kwaye, okwo kwabwatete ritimo goika ekero abanto bonsi ba Ai baitetwe.
english: For Joshua did not draw back the hand that held out his javelin until he had destroyed all who lived in Ai.

ekegusii: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son gives life to whom he is pleased to give it.
english: Na buna Tata akobokia ebitondo obia obogima, naboigo n’Omwana akobaa obogima aba arigetie.

ekegusii: Naki buna emechando ya Kristo yatobucheire, naboigo okoremigwa gwaito gwatobucheire ase enchera ya Kristo.
english: For just as the sufferings of Christ flow over into our lives, so also through Christ our comfort overflows.

ekegusii: Naki buna ase ogotaigwera kw’omonto oyomo abange bagakorwa koba abanyene ebibe, naboigo ase okogwera kw’omonto oyomo abange nabakorwe koba abanyene oboronge.
english: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.

ekegusii: ase engencho y’abaruoti, na bonsi abaeire okobua, erinde tonyare koba nobogima bw’oboitongo na obw’omorembe, na ase amang’ana onsi koba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae, na echi’ogosikana.
english: for kings and all those in authority, that we may live peaceful and quiet lives in all godliness and holiness.

ekegusii: Ase ogosemia okuya gotari, egesaku nigo gekogwa, korende ase abasemia abange abaya bare, oborendi obuya mboreo.
english: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but many advisers make victory sure.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbasirigwe bwango, basire buna obonyansi basusane buna ebimeri ebibese.
english: for like the grass they will soon wither, like green plants they will soon die away.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria a kare, aya Daudi na ay’Asafu, mbarengeo abaraai b’abateri, na abateri nigo barenge gotera amatera ay’ogotogia Nyasae na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
english: For long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there had been directors for the singers and for the songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

ekegusii: Rigereria abakori amabe buna bagotinga amata abo, babeka chinsara chiabo ang’e ase chingori chi’amata, erinde barase abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
english: For look, the wicked bend their bows; they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.

ekegusii: Naki agweneire abanto ba Makedonia na Akaya gosangereria ebiegwa bi’ogokonya abachenu ba Yerusalemu, baria bare abataka.
english: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: (Naki omosacha tarwete ase omokungu, korende nomokungu orwete ase omosacha.
english: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man;

ekegusii: ekiagera endamwamu ya mwanyabanto teri gokora ayare boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: for man's anger does not bring about the righteous life that God desires.

ekegusii: Abanto abange b’ense ya Yuda konya babwatanire na Tobia ase ogotianania, ekiagera ere nigo anyuomete omoiseke o Sekania, mosinto bw’Ara; boigo Yehohanani, momura oye, konya onyuomire omoiseke o Mesulamu, mosinto o Berekia.
english: For many in Judah were under oath to him, since he was son-in-law to Shecaniah son of Arah, and his son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berekiah.

ekegusii: Naki abange nabache ase erieta riane, babore: Inche ninche Kristo; baraae abange na kobasiria.
english: For many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am the Christ,' and will deceive many.

ekegusii: Ase emiaka emenge okabaremereria, okabakurera n’Omoika oo goetera ase ababani bao. Nonya naboigo tibaigwerete; erio okababeka ase amaboko ’abanto b’ebisaku ebiao.
english: For many years you were patient with them. By your Spirit you admonished them through your prophets. Yet they paid no attention, so you handed them over to the neighboring peoples.

ekegusii: Omonene tagotuguta omonto goika kare na kare.
english: For men are not cast off by the Lord forever.

ekegusii: (ekiagera abanto inabaigwe igoro y’erieta riao rinene, naende baigwe igoro y’okoboko kwao kore ne chinguru koramboire,) onye omogeni oyio ogocha aa kogosaba origereretie enyomba eye,
english: for men will hear of your great name and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm-- when he comes and prays toward this temple,

ekegusii: na ukoma bore ase chianga, gose ase chinyomba,
english: for mildew in clothing or in a house,

ekegusii: Naki korwa ebigori bia kare Musa narenge nabanto baare korandia amang’ana aye, na ase kera omochie nigo are gosomwa kera Esabato ase chisinagogi.”
english: For Moses has been preached in every city from the earliest times and is read in the synagogues on every Sabbath."

ekegusii: Naki Musa nigo atebete: Sika iso na nyoko, na: Oyorakwane bobe ase ise, gose ase ng’ina, ogokwa nakwe.
english: For Moses said, 'Honor your father and your mother,' and, 'Anyone who curses his father or mother must be put to death.'

ekegusii: Musa natebete: Omonene Nyasae nabaimokerie omobani onga buna inche korwa ase egati y’abamino. Momoigwere ase amang’ana onsi arabatebie.
english: For Moses said, 'The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.

ekegusii: Ekiagera egetunwa gia Sayoni giatigaire kere bosa, chisese chi’orosana nao chigotaara.
english: for Mount Zion, which lies desolate, with jackals prowling over it.

ekegusii: Amatuko ’obogima bwane nigo agoeta bwango na gosira buna erioki, amauga ’omobere one nigo akoyia buna omorero bw’amakara.
english: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.

ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bakongamba, basangererekanire gokora omoroberio bw’ogonsiria,
english: For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.

ekegusii: For my eyes have seen your salvation,
english: Ekiagera amaiso aane arorire ogotooreka kwao,

ekegusii: Nogwancha kwaye oyontomete nakwo oko, ng’a kera oyokorigereria Omwana na komwegena, nabe nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio.”
english: For my Father's will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day."

ekegusii: For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.
english: ekiagera omobere one nendagera y’ekeene, na amanyinga aane nekenyugwa gi’ekeene.

ekegusii: Natebanirie endamwamu yane ase engencho y’erieta riane, na ase engencho y’ogotogigwa kwane nayetangire, timbaisa kobasiria.
english: For my own name's sake I delay my wrath; for the sake of my praise I hold it back from you, so as not to cut you off.

ekegusii: Nigo nakorire ayio ase engencho yane, ee, ase engencho yane inche omonyene, tingotiga erieta riane rikorwe ribe eritachenegeti. Tinkoa onde obonene bwane.”
english: For my own sake, for my own sake, I do this. How can I let myself be defamed? I will not yield my glory to another.

ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oichire nemechando, na obogima bwane bwaikire ang’e kogenda aase abakure.
english: For my soul is full of trouble and my life draws near the grave.

ekegusii: For my yoke is easy and my burden is light."
english: ekiagera rikorogoto riane neriororo, na egurube yane nengusu.”

ekegusii: Naki chiira chionsi chia Nyasae nigo chire “Ee” ime asare; nakio gekogera togokwana “Amina” asare, ase okoa Nyasae obonene.
english: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are "Yes" in Christ. And so through him the "Amen" is spoken by us to the glory of God.

ekegusii: Naki boroso bonde tibori omonto aranyare kobeka, otatiga boria bwaikire kobekwa, nabwo Yeso Kristo.
english: For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Mobani onde tari okorete ogokora gwe chinguru chinene, na ogokora okonene, na ogw’okoondokia okwo Musa aorogetie ase amaiso ’Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: For no one has ever shown the mighty power or performed the awesome deeds that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

ekegusii: Ekiagera onde tari ase egati yaito ore moyo ase engencho yaye omonyene; na onde tari ogokwa ase engencho yaye omonyene.
english: For none of us lives to himself alone and none of us dies to himself alone.

ekegusii: Naki ing’ana tiriri ritanyarekane ase Nyasae.”
english: For nothing is impossible with God."

ekegusii: For now I would be lying down in peace; I would be asleep and at rest
english: Onye nakwete, anga nindaire ntoererete, anga nindaire chitoro ntimogete,

ekegusii: Naki bono nigo torabe moyo, komorabe moteneine bokong’u ase Omonene.
english: For now we really live, since you are standing firm in the Lord.

ekegusii: Naki ring’ana eri mwarimanyire kegima, ng’a omotomani, gose oyo otachenegeti, gose omonto omwegimeria (engencho yaye omosasimi emegwekano) takonyora omwando ase oboruoti bwa Kristo na Nyasae.
english: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure or greedy person-- such a man is an idolater-- has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

ekegusii: ekiagera ase engencho yaye abange b’Abayahudi bakagenda bakamwegena Yeso.
english: for on account of him many of the Jews were going over to Jesus and putting their faith in him.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngoteba iga: Agwo ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, egetunwa egetambe ki’Abaisraeli, nao Abaisraeli bonsi bare ase ense barabe bagonkorera. Aroro agwo nimbanchere, na aroro agwo ninyanchere okoruegwa kwaino, na ebiegwa biaino bire ebiya mono, amo nebinto bionsi morabe mogwatanana bibe ebichenu.
english: For on my holy mountain, the high mountain of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD, there in the land the entire house of Israel will serve me, and there I will accept them. There I will require your offerings and your choice gifts, along with all your holy sacrifices.

ekegusii: for our "God is a consuming fire."
english: Naki Nyasae oito nomorero okoria na gosiria.

ekegusii: Naki emechando yaito eyere y’ekero egeke gioka nemegusu, egotoroiseria obonene bwa kare na kare obore obonge mono kobua.
english: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

ekegusii: Ogosaria gwaito kwamentekanire na kwabuchire ase obosio bwao, na ebibe biaito biatobereire birori. Ogosaria gwaito nigo kore amo naintwe, twamanyire obobe bwaito.
english: For our offenses are many in your sight, and our sins testify against us. Our offenses are ever with us, and we acknowledge our iniquities:

ekegusii: Naki okoamererania gwaito tikori ase abare namanyinga ne chinyama, korende igoro y’abagambi na abare nokobua, igoro y’abanene b’omosunte bw’ense eye, na igoro y’emeganda y’ebirecha ebibe bire igoro.
english: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.

ekegusii: ekiagera abatigari mbache korwa ase Yerusalemu na korwa ase egetunwa gia Sayoni ekeombe ki’abanto baratooreke. Risemi ri’Omonene ndiikeranie ring’ana erio.
english: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. The zeal of the LORD Almighty will accomplish this.

ekegusii: ekiagera abatigari mbache korwa Yerusalemu, na korwa ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, ekeombe ki’abanto baratooreke. Risemi ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda ndiikeranie amang’ana ayio.
english: For out of Jerusalem will come a remnant, and out of Mount Zion a band of survivors. The zeal of the LORD Almighty will accomplish this.

ekegusii: Naki ase enkoro nao bikorwa ebirengerio ebibe, oboiti, obotomani, obonyaka, oboibi, amang’ana ’oborimo, na okorama.
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, slander.

ekegusii: Naki okwenaria kw’omobere nokonyora ogoke, korende okwenaria gwe chingencho chi’obonyasae nokonyora ase amang’ana onsi, ekiagera nkore neira ase obogima bwa bono, na ase boria bogochi‐gocha.
english: For physical training is of some value, but godliness has value for all things, holding promise for both the present life and the life to come.

ekegusii: ekiagera obobani tibwarentetwe engaki ende yonsi ase ogwancha kwa mwanyabanto, korende abanto abachenu ba Nyasae nigo baare gokwana batang’anire n’Omoika Omochenu.
english: For prophecy never had its origin in the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Ogosaria kw’ogotaigwera nigo konga buna ebibe bi’oborogi, na oboenenu nigo bonga buna ebibe bi’ogosasima emegwekano. Ekiagera kwangire ring’ana ri’Omonene, nere boigo okwangire, tokogenderera koba omoruoti.”
english: For rebellion is like the sin of divination, and arrogance like the evil of idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of the LORD, he has rejected you as king."

ekegusii: Obonda tibori kogenderera kobao botambe, na egutwa y’obogambi teri kogenderera kobao ekiaare ase ekiaare.
english: for riches do not endure forever, and a crown is not secure for all generations.

ekegusii: Naki abakogamba tibari kogosa abanto ase engencho y’ogokora okuya, korende nase engencho y’ogokora okobe. Inee! Torigeti komoiroka oyore nokobua? Kora ayare amaya, na aye nonyore ogotogigwa ase amaya aria.
english: For rulers hold no terror for those who do right, but for those who do wrong. Do you want to be free from fear of the one in authority? Then do what is right and he will commend you.

ekegusii: Namorende Amatuko Amanene ay’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere; moyarende aase agwo Omonene arachore, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nasesenie okwama kw’emegondo yaino amo nemeremo yaino yonsi. Ase ayio monyare kogoka mwensi amo.
english: For seven days celebrate the Feast to the LORD your God at the place the LORD will choose. For the LORD your God will bless you in all your harvest and in all the work of your hands, and your joy will be complete.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere mobe mokoria emegati etabekiri memera; ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ribe Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.
english: For seven days eat bread made without yeast and on the seventh day hold a festival to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere obe gokogenderera gokora okobwatanigwa ase egesasimero na kogechena mono; na kera egento kerabe gekogekuna, nigo kerabe egechenu.”
english: For seven days make atonement for the altar and consecrate it. Then the altar will be most holy, and whatever touches it will be holy.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere ememera terorekana ase chinyomba chiaino nonya ng’ake; naki onde bwensi orarie egento kebekire ememera naatananwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, onye ore omomenyi gose omobiare.
english: For seven days no yeast is to be found in your houses. And whoever eats anything with yeast in it must be cut off from the community of Israel, whether he is an alien or native-born.

ekegusii: korende namorue okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere namobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko.”
english: For seven days present an offering made to the LORD by fire. And on the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.'"

ekegusii: Kera rituko ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere namobe mokoruera Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero. Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima moruere Omonene ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero. Oyio nomosangererekano bw’engencho enene bwatananire ase ogosasima; timokora emeremo yaino ya kera rituko.
english: For seven days present offerings made to the LORD by fire, and on the eighth day hold a sacred assembly and present an offering made to the LORD by fire. It is the closing assembly; do no regular work.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, mobe mogokorera egesasimero okobwatanigwa na kogechena, mogiatanane kebe egechenu.
english: For seven days they are to make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; thus they will dedicate it.

ekegusii: Ase igo abarwani bonsi bagatoora bakarigererania ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere. Erio ase rituko riria ria gatano na kabere bagachakana esegi, na ase rituko erimo Abaisraeli bagaita abarwani b’Abasiiria abaare gotaara namagoro, chilifu rigana erimo (100,000).
english: For seven days they camped opposite each other, and on the seventh day the battle was joined. The Israelites inflicted a hundred thousand casualties on the Aramean foot soldiers in one day.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere bakaba barendete Rituko riria Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera bare nomogoko. Omonene nigo abarenterete omogoko oyio ase okoonchora enkoro y’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, erinde akabancha akabakonya mono ase emeremo y’enyomba ya Nyasae oyore Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: For seven days they celebrated with joy the Feast of Unleavened Bread, because the LORD had filled them with joy by changing the attitude of the king of Assyria, so that he assisted them in the work on the house of God, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere goika morie emegati etabekiri memera. Rituko rie ritang’ani morusie ememera korwa chinyomba chiaino kegima, ekiagera monto onde bwensi orarie omogati obekire ememera korwa rituko rie ritang’ani goika eria gatano na kabere, nigo araatananwe korwa ase obomo bw’Abaisraeli.
english: For seven days you are to eat bread made without yeast. On the first day remove the yeast from your houses, for whoever eats anything with yeast in it from the first day through the seventh must be cut off from Israel.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bobwate ebitoki ebinge kobua ebie chifeta na ebie chitahabu.
english: for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

ekegusii: Obororo bw’emechando yane bwabeire buna endagera nkoria, na ebirero biane nigo bigoiteka buna amache.
english: For sighing comes to me instead of food; my groans pour out like water.

ekegusii: Naki ebibe tibikobagambera inwe, ekiagera timori inse y’amachiko korende inse y’amabera.
english: For sin shall not be your master, because you are not under law, but under grace.

ekegusii: Naki ebibe bikanyora ribaga ase ogochika koria, bikang’aina, na ase korokwo bikang’ita.
english: For sin, seizing the opportunity afforded by the commandment, deceived me, and through the commandment put me to death.

ekegusii: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.
english: Naki buna amakweri arentetwe nomonto, naboigo nokobokigwa kw’abakure kwarentirwe nomonto.

ekegusii: Ekiagera ase obong’aini bwaye Nyasae akaroberia, ng’a ense tekonyara komomanya ase enchera y’obong’aini, agancha kobatooria abamwegenete ase oboriri bwe ring’ana riria rikorandigwa.
english: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not know him, God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe.

ekegusii: Naki chingencho chiaye, echi chitari kororekana, engencho yaye okobua kwaye gwa kare na kare, na obonyasae bwaye, nchimanyekanete korwa ase ogotongwa gw’ense ase ebinto atongete. Ase igo tibari naya bagotaamera.
english: For since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities-- his eternal power and divine nature-- have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made, so that men are without excuse.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo morie emegati etabekiri memera, na ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, mobe nomosangererekano bw’engencho enene bw’okomosasima Omonene, Nyasae oino. Ase rituko erio timokora meremo ende yonsi.
english: For six days eat unleavened bread and on the seventh day hold an assembly to the LORD your God and do no work.

ekegusii: Mokore emeremo amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato Enchenu, rituko ri’ogotimoka, richenu ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.
english: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of rest, holy to the LORD. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must be put to death.

ekegusii: Mokore emeremo ase amatuko atano na rimo, korende rituko ria gatano na kabere nigo rirabe richenu asemore, rituko ri’Esabato, riatananwe ase Omonene. Onde bwensi aise gokora emeremo ase rituko erio goika aitwe akwe.
english: For six days, work is to be done, but the seventh day shall be your holy day, a Sabbath of rest to the LORD. Whoever does any work on it must be put to death.

ekegusii: Namosimeke emegondo yaino na gochera emesabibu yaino, naende mogese okwama kw’emegondo y’ense eyio ase emiaka etano nomo.
english: For six years sow your fields, and for six years prune your vineyards and gather their crops.

ekegusii: Naki mbare abagomba abaiboretwe bo, naende mbare abagomba aba abanto bagombaetie, naende mbare abagomba abekorete abanyene koba abagomba ase engencho y’oboruoti bwa igoro. Oyoranyare gwancha ring’ana eri, tiga arianche.”
english: For some are eunuchs because they were born that way; others were made that way by men; and others have renounced marriage because of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it."

ekegusii: Naki barabwo bateba, “Amarube aye namarito, naende nigo are amakong’u, korende ekero are amo naintwe ere omonyene nigo are omoreu, na amang’ana aye tari gento.”
english: For some say, "His letters are weighty and forceful, but in person he is unimpressive and his speaking amounts to nothing."

ekegusii: Naki nigo atebete aase gete igoro ye rituko ria gatano na kabere, “Nyasae nigo atimogete rituko ria gatano na kabere, agatiga emeremo yaye yonsi.”
english: For somewhere he has spoken about the seventh day in these words: "And on the seventh day God rested from all his work."

ekegusii: Naki abwo nabatomwa b’oborimo, bagokora emeremo ase obong’ainereria, bakweonchora babe omogwekano bw’abatomwa ba Kristo.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workmen, masquerading as apostles of Christ.

ekegusii: Naki abanto banga buna abwo tibari gokorera Omonene oito Kristo, korende nechinda chiabo bagokorera abanyene; na ase amang’ana amororo na ay’okwegwenia bang’aina emioyo y’abanto batetenenereti ase ebirengererio biabo.
english: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the minds of naive people.

ekegusii: Naki ayio namaene, ere tagwechandera abamalaika, korende nigo agwechandera oroiboro rwa Ibrahimu.
english: For surely it is not angels he helps, but Abraham's descendants.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Naama! Ababisa bao mbasirigwe; na abakori ebibe bonsi mbasiarerwe gochia aande onsi.
english: For surely your enemies, O LORD, surely your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ogosesenia omonyene oboronge na komotuba nobuya bwao bw’amabera bonga buna enguba.
english: For surely, O LORD, you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

ekegusii: Okwo nigo kware koba ogosaria okobe mono goetania, na kware koegwa egesusuro nabagambi ebina bonsi.
english: For that would have been shameful, a sin to be judged.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo bosio bwaino Abaameleki na Abakanani mbareo. Nigo bagochia kobarwania bababue na kobaita nemioro, ekiagera inwe mwaonchokire, mwangire koigwera Omonene; nere takonyara koba amo nainwe.”
english: for the Amalekites and Canaanites will face you there. Because you have turned away from the LORD, he will not be with you and you will fall by the sword."

ekegusii: Naki ogosorora gwaito tikori ogw’okobasiria, gose ogw’okobabeka ase eubi, gose ogw’okobang’aina,
english: For the appeal we make does not spring from error or impure motives, nor are we trying to trick you.

ekegusii: Naki omogati o Nyasae noria ogoika korwa igoro na koa ense obogima.”
english: For the bread of God is he who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world."

ekegusii: “Chibesa echio chiraruegwe ase engencho y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na okoruegwa kw’endagera kwa botambe, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kia botambe, na ebie Chisabato, na Emetienyi Emeyia, na Amatuko Amanene achikire, na ebing’wanso ebichenu, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe bigokora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli, na ase engencho y’emeremo yonsi y’enyomba ya Nyasae oito.
english: for the bread set out on the table; for the regular grain offerings and burnt offerings; for the offerings on the Sabbaths, New Moon festivals and appointed feasts; for the holy offerings; for sin offerings to make atonement for Israel; and for all the duties of the house of our God.

ekegusii: Bagakora ebichanga bie chitahabu chichenire bisisire, bikabekwa ase egesembe keria.
english: For the breastpiece they made braided chains of pure gold, like a rope.

ekegusii: Ebiombe bi’abatamoirogete Nyasae nigo biragombae, na omorero nosambe emechie y’abanchete amaaki.
english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of those who love bribes.

ekegusii: Naki ebitongwa bionsi nigo biabegetwe inse y’engencho ya bosa, tari ase ogwancha kwabo, korende ase ogwancha kwaye ere oyobibegete ase ogosemeria,
english: For the creation was subjected to frustration, not by its own choice, but by the will of the one who subjected it, in hope

ekegusii: Chinyasae abanto b’ebisaku bagosasima nigo chire echi’oborimo. Omote ore rinani ime nigo okogechwa, na omoroisia omong’aini oyobaacha nekoyo na oroisia emegwekano.
english: For the customs of the peoples are worthless; they cut a tree out of the forest, and a craftsman shapes it with his chisel.

ekegusii: Rituko ngocha rire ekero Abafilisti bonsi barasirigwe, na abatigarete gokonya Turo na Sidoni basirigwe boigo. Omonene nasirie Abafilisti, abare abatigari ase egesinka gia Kafitori.
english: For the day has come to destroy all the Philistines and to cut off all survivors who could help Tyre and Sidon. The LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor.

ekegusii: “Rituko riria riaikire ang’e, ee, rituko ri’Omonene riaikire ang’e. Nigo rirabe rituko ri’amare, engaki y’okogambigwa kw’abanto b’ebisaku.
english: For the day is near, the day of the LORD is near-- a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.

ekegusii: Rituko ri’okorusia egesiomba nigo riarenge ase enkoro yane ime, na omwaka bw’okobooria abanto oikire.
english: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and the year of my redemption has come.

ekegusii: Na ase ogwatanana enyomba eye na koyechena, bakarua chieri rigana erimo, ne chimingichi amagana abere, ne chimanwa chimingichi chie ching’ondi amagana ane, chikaba ebing’wanso. Boigo bakarua chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ebibe ase engencho y’Abaisraeli. Echio nigo chiaruetwe koreng’ana nomobaro bw’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.
english: For the dedication of this house of God they offered a hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred male lambs and, as a sin offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, one for each of the tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gw’Asafu) Aye Nyasae, nigo togokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende mbuya mono, ekiagera erieta riao nigo rire ang’e, nigo tokorareria emeremo yao y’ogokumia.
english: For the director of music. [To the tune of] "Do Not Destroy." A psalm of Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, O God, we give thanks, for your Name is near; men tell of your wonderful deeds.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Inwe abamokogamba, Inee, ngokwana more amang’ana ’ekeene? Inee! Nkonachera more abanto ebina bire boronge?
english: For the director of music. [To the tune of] "Do Not Destroy." Of David. A miktam. Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge uprightly among men?

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi ekero atamete Saulo na akabisa ase rikuruma) Aye Nyasae, indorera amabera, indorera amabera, ekiagera naye natameire nomoyo one. Nintame nyebise inse ase ekiriri gie chimbaba chiao, goika omwaga bw’ogosiria oete.
english: For the director of music. [To the tune of] "Do Not Destroy." Of David. A miktam. When he had fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me, for in you my soul takes refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi ekero Saulo atomete abanto bamoite) Aye Nyasae one, ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane, indende korwa ase abanto aba banyimokeire gonkora bobe.
english: For the director of music. [To the tune of] "Do Not Destroy." Of David. A miktam. When Saul had sent men to watch David's house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O God; protect me from those who rise up against me.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi ekero Doegi Omoedomu achierete Saulo komotebia ng’a Daudi ochire mw’Abimeleki) Aye omonto ore nokobua, nase ki ogwetogeria amabe aya ogokora? Obwanchani bwa Nyasae nigo bogendererete kare na kare.
english: For the director of music. A maskil of David. When Doeg the Edomite had gone to Saul and told him: "David has gone to the house of Ahimelech." Why do you boast of evil, you mighty man? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?

ekegusii: For the director of music. A maskil of the Sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, O God.
english: (Ogotera kwa basinto ba Kora) Buna koreng’ana engabi ekogania amache a rooche, naboigo omoyo one okoganetie aye Nyasae.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae o Sayoni, ogotogigwa nokwao; goika togoikeranerie chiira chiaito.
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits you, O God, in Zion; to you our vows will be fulfilled.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Nasesenirie omonto oyo ogwechandera abataka. Ekero aranyorwe nemechando, Omonene namokonye.
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. Blessed is he who has regard for the weak; the LORD delivers him in times of trouble.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, igwa eriogi riane ekero nkorera; renda obogima bwane korwa ase omobisa oyo okongosa.
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. Hear me, O God, as I voice my complaint; protect my life from the threat of the enemy.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere konyeba? Ngoika kare na kare? Ngoika ririri orabe kobisete obosio bwao ng’a tondora?
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, naye ngotamera, tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe; ntoorie goetera ase oboronge bwao!
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. In you, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Tiga Omonene aigwe ogosaba kwao ase engaki y’emechando. Erieta ria Nyasae o Yakobo rikorende.
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. May the LORD answer you when you are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, omoruoti nigo agokerete chinguru chiao, na gochengera obobui kwamoeire.
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in your strength. How great is his joy in the victories you give!

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ntoorie korwa ase abanto ababe; indende korwa ase abanto abatindi!
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men; protect me from men of violence,

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Igoro nigo chikoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae; na eaanga ya igoro eraria emeremo y’amaboko aye.
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

ekegusii: (Ogosaba kwa Daudi nyuma y’ogocherwa na Natani ase engencho y’ogosaria kwaye na Batiseba) Aye Nyasae, ondorere amabera koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao botari koera; ase engencho y’obonge bw’amabera ao otinyie ogosaria kwane.
english: For the director of music. A psalm of David. When the prophet Nathan came to him after David had committed adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi, ase omoteria) Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogoko ase Nyasae;
english: For the director of music. A song. A psalm. Shout with joy to God, all the earth!

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, aye Omonene oito, erieta riao naki rire nobonene obonge ase ense yonsi! Obonene bwao nigo bogotogigwa nonya ngoika igoro.
english: For the director of music. According to gittith. A psalm of David. O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gw’Asafu) Moterere Nyasae neriogi rinene, ekiagera nere chinguru chiaito, aka eriogi ri’omogoko ase Nyasae o Yakobo.
english: For the director of music. According to gittith. Of Asaph. Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob!

ekegusii: (Ogotera kwa basinto ba Kora) Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, naki obomenyo bwao bore oboseera!
english: For the director of music. According to gittith. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. How lovely is your dwelling place, O LORD Almighty!

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Abanto abariri nigo bagwetebia ase chinkoro chiabo ime, “Nyasae tari.” Barabwo nabasareku, nigo bagokora amang’ana amabe ay’okogechia; onde tari ogokora ayare amaya, nonya noyomo.
english: For the director of music. According to mahalath. A maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and their ways are vile; there is no one who does good.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Omonene, totoorie! Abakoirogete aye Nyasae baerire, abegenwa tibari konyorekana ase mwanyabanto.
english: For the director of music. According to sheminith. A psalm of David. Help, LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane; orengererie mono amang’ana ayio ankong’erete.
english: For the director of music. For flutes. A psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my sighing.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Ngateba, “Nindende orogendo rwane, timbaisa gokora ebibe ekero ngokwana. Nimbeke omonwa one ekeokio ekero abakori amabe bare ase obosio bwane.”
english: For the director of music. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David. I said, "I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth as long as the wicked are in my presence."

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Omoyo one nigo oganyete Nyasae bweka ase okonyora obotoereru; ogotooreka kwane nigo gokorwa asare.
english: For the director of music. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David. My soul finds rest in God alone; my salvation comes from him.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gw’Asafu) Nkorera nde ase Nyasae neriogi rinene, nigo nkorera mono asare ng’a anyigwe.
english: For the director of music. For Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A psalm. I cried out to God for help; I cried out to God to hear me.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi, omosomba bw’Omonene) Ebibe nigo bigokwana nomonto omokori amabe ase enkoro yaye ime; okomoiroka Nyasae tikori ase obosio bwaye.
english: For the director of music. Of David the servant of the LORD. An oracle is within my heart concerning the sinfulness of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

ekegusii: (Ogotera Daudi, omosomba bw’Omonene, atererete Omonene, ekero Omonene amotooretie korwa ase Saulo na ababisa bande) Aye Omonene chinguru chiane, ningwanchete mono!
english: For the director of music. Of David the servant of the LORD. He sang to the LORD the words of this song when the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love you, O LORD, my strength.

ekegusii: (Ogosaba gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, koranche ontoorie! Omonene, oche bwango onkonye!
english: For the director of music. Of David. A petition. Hasten, O God, to save me; O LORD, come quickly to help me.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Tiga Nyasae aimokerere igoro, na ababisa baye basiarerwe, abanto abwo bamogechete, tiga batame barue asare.
english: For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. A song. May God arise, may his enemies be scattered; may his foes flee before him.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Nkaba imoganyete Omonene ase okoremereria, na ere akanyeonchorera akaigwa ekerero kiane.
english: For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. I waited patiently for the LORD; he turned to me and heard my cry.

ekegusii: For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. O God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,
english: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae ningotogie, tobaisa gokira‐kiri.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene kwariga‐rigirie ime yane, kwamanyire inche.
english: For the director of music. Of David. A psalm. O LORD, you have searched me and you know me.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Omonene nere obotamero bwane. Nase ki rende mogontebia: “Iruruka buna enyoni gochia ase ebitunwa?
english: For the director of music. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: "Flee like a bird to your mountain.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Abanto abariri nigo bagoteba ase chinkoro chiabo ime, “Nyasae tari.” Barabwo nabasareku, bagokora amang’ana ay’okogechia; onde tari ogokora ayare amaya, nonya noyomo.
english: For the director of music. Of David. The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.

ekegusii: (Ogotera kwa basinto ba Kora) Nyasae, intwe tweigwereire namato aito, chisokoro chiaito nchiatotebetie amang’ana gwakorete ase amatuko a kare.
english: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A maskil. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us what you did in their days, in days long ago.

ekegusii: (Ogotera kwa basinto ba Kora) Inwe abanto bonsi, aka chinkobi, moterere Nyasae amatera ’omogoko neriogi rinene!
english: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.

ekegusii: (Ogotera kwa basinto ba Kora) Inwe abanto bonsi, igwa amang’ana aya! Tegerera moigwe, inwe mwensi momenyete ase ense,
english: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in this world,

ekegusii: (Ogotera kwa basinto ba Kora) Omonene, kare nigo kwarenge namabera ase ense yao, nigo kwairaneretie abanto ba Yakobo amaya abo.
english: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. You showed favor to your land, O LORD; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.

ekegusii: (Ogotera kwa basinto ba Kora) Nyasae nobotamero bwaito, ne chinguru chiaito, botambe nigo are ang’e gotokonya ase engaki y’emechando.
english: For the director of music. Of the Sons of Korah. According to alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi ekero Abafilisti bamobwatete agwo Gati) Aye Nyasae, indorere amabera, ekiagera abanto nigo baganetie ng’a bang’ite bansirie kegima; omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakondwania esegi.
english: For the director of music. To [the tune of] "A Dove on Distant Oaks." Of David. A miktam. When the Philistines had seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men hotly pursue me; all day long they press their attack.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Nyasae, intoorie, ekiagera amache aichoire, aikire ase omoyo one.
english: For the director of music. To [the tune of] "Lilies." Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.

ekegusii: (Ogotera kw’obwanchani korikire na basinto ba Kora) Enkoro yane nigo eichire namang’ana amaya, engero yane nigo ere igoro y’omoruoti; oromeme rwane nigo rore buna ekaramu y’omoriki omuya.
english: For the director of music. To [the tune of] "Lilies." Of the Sons of Korah. A maskil. A wedding song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ningoakere ng’a mbuya mono nenkoro yane yonsi. Nindarie emeremo yao yonsi y’ogokumia.
english: For the director of music. To [the tune of] "The Death of the Son." A psalm of David. I will praise you, O LORD, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonders.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Nyasae one, Nyasae one, naki gwantigire? Nabeire nkorera ng’a ontoorie, korende kwambeereire aare.
english: For the director of music. To [the tune of] "The Doe of the Morning." A psalm of David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from the words of my groaning?

ekegusii: (Ogotera gw’Asafu) Aye omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, tegerera oigwe, aye okoraa abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu buna riicho rikoraagwa! Aye oyore ase oboikaranso bw’obonene igoro y’abakerubi, tomorekere!
english: For the director of music. To [the tune of] "The Lilies of the Covenant." Of Asaph. A psalm. Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock; you who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi gw’okworokereria, ekero arwanete n’Abaaramu korwa Naharimu na Soba, na Yoabu akairana goita Abaedomu 12,000 ase Riranya ri’Omonyo) Nyasae, aye gwatwangire na gwatosiareire, kwabeire kore nendamwamu, toiranerie amaya aito.
english: For the director of music. To [the tune of] "The Lily of the Covenant." A miktam of David. For teaching. When he fought Aram Naharaim and Aram Zobah, and when Joab returned and struck down twelve thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt. You have rejected us, O God, and burst forth upon us; you have been angry-- now restore us!

ekegusii: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;
english: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, tobaisa kwebisa toigwa ogosaba kw’ogosorora kwane.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi ekero omonto oyomo korwa Sifu achierete Saulo komotebia ng’a Daudi nsobo ebisete) Aye Nyasae, ntoorie ase engencho y’erieta riao, ong’e oboronge bwane goetera ase okobua kwao.
english: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A maskil of David. When the Ziphites had gone to Saul and said, "Is not David hiding among us?" Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gw’Asafu) Nyasae nigo amanyekanete ase Abayuda, erieta riaye rire rinene mono ase Abaisraeli.
english: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph. A song. In Judah God is known; his name is great in Israel.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae, aye okong’a oboronge, ong’iranerie ekero ngokorangeria! Ekero narenge nkomiga‐migwa nobokong’u nigo kwang’ete ribaga rigare. Indorera amabera, na oigwe ogosaba kwane!
english: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A psalm of David. Answer me when I call to you, O my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; be merciful to me and hear my prayer.

ekegusii: (Ase omoteria) Nyasae atororere amabera, atosesenie, atoraberie obosio bwaye.
english: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. A psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face shine upon us, Selah

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Omonene, tontogonyera ekero ore nendamwamu; tong’a egesusuro gi’okondongeyia ekero ore nekeririanda.
english: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. According to sheminith. A psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.

ekegusii: For the director of music. With stringed instruments. Of David. Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.
english: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Nyasae one, igwa ekerero kiane; tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane.

ekegusii: Amang’ana amato akoigwa, nigo akoyateema, buna oromeme rokomena endagera.
english: For the ear tests words as the tongue tastes food.

ekegusii: Ense neichorigwe nokomanya kw’obonene bw’Omonene buna chinyancha chiichire namache.
english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, as the waters cover the sea.

ekegusii: Ebisieri bibere bikaroisigwa korwa ase chibao chi’emezeituni bikabekwa ase egesoero gi’akanyomba ka ime. Emetobwa nigo yatenenirie ensemo eyemo ya isano y’enyasi.
english: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary he made doors of olive wood with five-sided jambs.

ekegusii: Na ase egesoero ki’Eema bakaroisia egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani, keroisirie nomoroisia omong’aini.
english: For the entrance to the tent they made a curtain of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen-- the work of an embroiderer;

ekegusii: Abagokora amabe tibakonyora amaya ase amatuko agochi‐gocha; etaya y’abakori amabe nerimigwe.
english: for the evil man has no future hope, and the lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

ekegusii: Naki amaiso ’Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ogosaba kwabo. Korende obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore igoro ase abwo bagokora amabe.”
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer, but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil."

ekegusii: Amaiso ’Omonene nigo origereretie aande onsi ase ense yonsi ase okoorokia okoboko kwaye kw’ogokonya abanto baria chinkoro chiabo chire chinyegenwa asare. Aye gwakorire amang’ana ’oboriri ase ogokora egento eke; na korwa bono na kogenderera nobe ne chisegi.”
english: For the eyes of the LORD range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him. You have done a foolish thing, and from now on you will be at war."

ekegusii: Tata nigo amwanchete Omwana, na komworokia onsi ayagokora omonyene; na emeremo emenene kobua eye iga namworokie, erinde inwe monyare gokumia.
english: For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, to your amazement he will show him even greater things than these.

ekegusii: Omonto omoriri nigo agokwana amang’ana ’oboriri; ebirengererio biaye nigo bigokora emeroberio y’ogokora ebibe; nigo akwenaria gokora aya atari e chingencho chinchenu; nigo agokwana bobe igoro y’Omonene, na otiga korageria abare nenchara, na orina abare nerang’o amache.
english: For the fool speaks folly, his mind is busy with evil: He practices ungodliness and spreads error concerning the LORD; the hungry he leaves empty and from the thirsty he withholds water.

ekegusii: Ekiagera oboriri bwa Nyasae mbore nobong’aini kobua obongaini bwa mwanyabanto, na oboreu bwa Nyasae mbore ne chinguru kobua echia mwanyabanto.
english: For the foolishness of God is wiser than man's wisdom, and the weakness of God is stronger than man's strength.

ekegusii: Ekiaare ase ekiaare kera omwana omoisia ore ase egati yaino goika arokigwe ekero akoorire amatuko atano na atato, omobiare o inka amo nomogorwa chibesa korwa ase abanto ba isiko, otari bw’ororeria rwao.
english: For the generations to come every male among you who is eight days old must be circumcised, including those born in your household or bought with money from a foreigner-- those who are not your offspring.

ekegusii: Onye omogeni ore amo nainwe, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino, nere oganetie korenta okoruegwa kwaye kogosambwa nomorero, kobe rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera Omonene, nigo arabwatie omoroberio oria oria obekirwe asemore.
english: For the generations to come, whenever an alien or anyone else living among you presents an offering made by fire as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, he must do exactly as you do.

ekegusii: na ase emeremo ende yonsi egochia gokorwa nabaroisia ebinto, chitahabu ase ebinto bie chitahabu, ne chifeta ase ebinto bie chifeta. Ning’o ogochia kwerua ase ogwancha? Oyio tiga eatanane bweka omonyene ase Omonene rituko ria rero.”
english: for the gold work and the silver work, and for all the work to be done by the craftsmen. Now, who is willing to consecrate himself today to the LORD?"

ekegusii: Naki obuya bwa Nyasae bwaorokigwe nogotooreka ase abanto bonsi.
english: For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men.

ekegusii: Abare aase abakure tibagokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, abwo bakure tibakogotogia; abwo bakogenda ase chimbeera ime tibagosemeria obwegenwa bwao.
english: For the grave cannot praise you, death cannot sing your praise; those who go down to the pit cannot hope for your faithfulness.

ekegusii: ekiagera rituko rinene ri’endamwamu yabo riaikire. Ning’o oranyare gotenena?”
english: For the great day of their wrath has come, and who can stand?"

ekegusii: ekiagera Damesiki noro omochie omonene bw’Abasiiria, na Resini nere omogambi o Damesiki; na ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano, Abaefraimu mbasenyentwe basirigwe kegima, tibagenderera koba egesaku.
english: for the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is only Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim will be too shattered to be a people.

ekegusii: ekiagera Omoika Omochenu noborokererie ensa eyio eyio ayamogwenerete gokwana.”
english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say."

ekegusii: Naki omosacha nomotwe bw’omokungu, buna Kristo are omotwe bw’ekanisa; ere omonyene n’Omotooria bw’omobere oye, engencho yaye ekanisa.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, his body, of which he is the Savior.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli nabasomba baane, ee, barabwo nabasomba baane aba narusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: for the Israelites belong to me as servants. They are my servants, whom I brought out of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Naboigo Abaisraeli baragenderere komenya ase amatuko amange batabwati omoruoti gose omogambi, batari korua ebing’wanso, gose gosasima amagena atenenirie, gose koba negesibao ki’obokuani, gose ebinyasae bibekire ase chinyomba.
english: For the Israelites will live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred stones, without ephod or idol.

ekegusii: Obosie bwarenge ase ekegancha keria tibwaerete, gose amaguta arenge ase echuba eria taerete, koreng’ana buna ring’ana ri’Omonene, riria riakwanetwe n’Elija.
english: For the jar of flour was not used up and the jug of oil did not run dry, in keeping with the word of the LORD spoken by Elijah.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakaba noborabu na omogoko, amo nomochengo na ogosikwa.
english: For the Jews it was a time of happiness and joy, gladness and honor.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Babeli nigo ateneine ase amatabekania e chinchera chiria ibere ogokora oboringoria; nigo agotierania chinsara, na okoboria korwa ase ebinyasae biaye, naende nigo akorigereria riini.
english: For the king of Babylon will stop at the fork in the road, at the junction of the two roads, to seek an omen: He will cast lots with arrows, he will consult his idols, he will examine the liver.

ekegusii: “Omoruoti o sugusu nasangererie omoganda omonene bw’abarwani esegi obuete oria bwe ritang’ani, erio nyuma y’emiaka emeke nairane ore nomoganda omonene na ebinto ebinge biganeirie ase esegi.
english: For the king of the North will muster another army, larger than the first; and after several years, he will advance with a huge army fully equipped.

ekegusii: Omoruoti nigo asemeretie Omonene, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bw’Omonene Ore Igoro bogendererete botambe ere takonyara kwoboa.
english: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the unfailing love of the Most High he will not be shaken.

ekegusii: Naki oboruoti bwa Nyasae tari okoria na okonywa, korende oboronge, na omorembe, na omogoko bikorwa ase Omoika Omochenu.
english: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit,

ekegusii: Naki oboruoti bwa Nyasae tibori ase ogokwana, korende ase chinguru.
english: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of talk but of power.

ekegusii: ekiagera Emanwa y’Eng’ondi oyore gati‐gati y’ekerogo ki’obonene nabarisie, ere nabaraae gochia ase chinsoko chi’amache are moyo, na Nyasae natinyie amariga onsi korwa ase amaiso abo.”
english: For the Lamb at the center of the throne will be their shepherd; he will lead them to springs of living water. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."

ekegusii: Ense eria netigwe nabarabwo, erinde egokere engaki y’ogotimoka kwaye ekero etari nabanto. Abanto abwo nabanyore egesusuro, ekiagera bangete kobwata amachiko aane, na bakaanga kobwatia emeroberio yane nachigete.
english: For the land will be deserted by them and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them. They will pay for their sins because they rejected my laws and abhorred my decrees.

ekegusii: Naki amachiko nigo are kobeka abanto abare noboreu babe abakuani abanene, korende ring’ana ri’emuma, eriachete nyuma y’amachiko, riabekire Omwana, oyoikeranetigwe kare na kare.
english: For the law appoints as high priests men who are weak; but the oath, which came after the law, appointed the Son, who has been made perfect forever.

ekegusii: Naki amachiko arwerete ase amaboko a Musa, obuya na ekeene nigo biachete goetera ase Yeso Kristo.
english: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Obomoyo bwa kera omobere nigo bore ime ase amanyinga; nabaeire amanyinga moyanyororokererie ase egesasimero akore okobwatanigwa ase obomoyo bwaino; amanyinga naro agokora okobwatanigwa, ekiagera obomoyo bore imeo.
english: For the life of a creature is in the blood, and I have given it to you to make atonement for yourselves on the altar; it is the blood that makes atonement for one's life.

ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omokungu omonyaka nigo bigotonyia ayare amansu buna obooke, na omonwa oye nigo ore omoterere kobua amaguta akweakwa.
english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey, and her speech is smoother than oil;

ekegusii: Ee, abare moyo mbamanyete ng’a mbakwe, korende abakure tibamanyeti gento kende, na tibagenderereti konyora eng’eria; tibakoinyorwa nonya ndinde.
english: For the living know that they will die, but the dead know nothing; they have no further reward, and even the memory of them is forgotten.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda ochikire gokora amang’ana ayio, ning’o oranyare koyatanga taba? Oramboire okoboko kwaye, ning’o oranyare gokoringa?
english: For the LORD Almighty has purposed, and who can thwart him? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?

ekegusii: ekiagera abanto abasareku nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende obobisi bwaye nigo bore ase abwo bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
english: for the LORD detests a perverse man but takes the upright into his confidence.

ekegusii: Omonene nere okoa abanto obong’aini; chisemi na okomanya nigo bikorwa ase omonwa oye.
english: For the LORD gives wisdom, and from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, agoteba: “Inwe Abaisraeli rora, nimbarentere abanto b’egesaku gete; barabwo mbabachande gochakera ase egesoero kia Hamati goikera ase akarooche g’Ekerubo Ekiomo.”
english: For the LORD God Almighty declares, "I will stir up a nation against you, O house of Israel, that will oppress you all the way from Lebo Hamath to the valley of the Arabah."

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo are erioba na enguba, ere nigo agotoa amabera na obonene; ere takorina abare ne chinkoro chindonge gento kende gionsi kere ekiya.
english: For the LORD God is a sun and shield; the LORD bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

ekegusii: Omonene ogerire omoganda bw’abarwani esegi b’Abasiiria baigure ebititiro bie chigari, ne chibarasi, na eriogi ri’omoganda omonene bw’abarwani esegi. Ase ayio konya batebanirie, “Ekeene, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli osabire abaruoti b’Abahiti na baria b’Abamisiri bache gotorwania.”
english: for the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots and horses and a great army, so that they said to one another, "Look, the king of Israel has hired the Hittite and Egyptian kings to attack us!"

ekegusii: Naki Omonene konya ogombairie chinda chi’abanto bonsi b’enka y’Abimeleki, tibaibora, ase engencho ya Sara moka Ibrahimu.
english: for the LORD had closed up every womb in Abimelech's household because of Abraham's wife Sarah.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Kera rituko omotang’ani oyomo oyomo arue okoruegwa kwaye ase ogwatananwa kw’egesasimero.”
english: For the LORD had said to Moses, "Each day one leader is to bring his offering for the dedication of the altar."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa “Batebie Abaisraeli: Inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u. Inse kogenda amo nainwe, nonya netagika eyemo, nigo ndabasirie kegima. Gaki bono rusia ebinto biaino ebi mwechaberete, erio ndore inki ndabakorere.”
english: For the LORD had said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites, 'You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go with you even for a moment, I might destroy you. Now take off your ornaments and I will decide what to do with you.'"

ekegusii: Omonene nakwanete igoro y’abwo, “Barabwo nigo barakwere ase erooro.” Omonto onde tagotigara ore moyo nonya noyomo, otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.
english: For the LORD had told those Israelites they would surely die in the desert, and not one of them was left except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

ekegusii: erio nerituko ri’Omonene ri’ogoakana egesiomba, ee, oyio nomwaka bw’ogoakana amabe akoretwe ase Sayoni.
english: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of retribution, to uphold Zion's cause.

ekegusii: Omonene bwechoreire Yakobo, bwechoreire Abaisraeli koba abaye bori.
english: For the LORD has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his treasured possession.

ekegusii: Omonene ochorire Sayoni; nigo aganetie obe obomenyo bwaye, otebire,
english: For the LORD has chosen Zion, he has desired it for his dwelling:

ekegusii: Ase ayio rora, Omonene narue ogochika ng’a chinyomba chire chinene na echire chinke chiiyerigwe inse chisamunyokane.
english: For the LORD has given the command, and he will smash the great house into pieces and the small house into bits.

ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene omonyene naike korwa igoro neriogi rie ring’ana ri’ogochika amo neriogi ri’omomalaika omonene, na egeturi ki’egetureri kia Nyasae. Na abwobakwete ase Kristo nababoke ritang’ani.
english: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

ekegusii: Naki Omonene nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nobwa kare na kare, na obwegenwa bwaye nigo bogendererete ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: For the LORD is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.

ekegusii: Omonene nere omonachi ebina oito, nere omogambi oito. Omonene nere omoruoti oito, natotoorie.
english: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; it is he who will save us.

ekegusii: Omonene nomonyene oboronge, nigo anchete ogokora kw’oboronge; abanto abare ne chinkoro chindonge mbarore obosio bwaye.
english: For the LORD is righteous, he loves justice; upright men will see his face.

ekegusii: Naki Omonene nere Nyasae ore omonene, nere Omoruoti omonene obuete chinyasae chionsi.
english: For the LORD is the great God, the great King above all gods.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo anchete oboronge; tagotiga abachenu baye. Barabwo mbarendwe goika kare na kare, korende ororeria rw’abakori amabe ndosirigwe kegima.
english: For the LORD loves the just and will not forsake his faithful ones. They will be protected forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off;

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agokirie nabanto baye; abwo bare abaitongo nigo akobachabera ogotooreka.
english: For the LORD takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with salvation.

ekegusii: Omonene namanyete enchera y’abanyene oboronge, korende enchera y’abakori amabe nesire.
english: For the LORD watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.

ekegusii: Omonene nabe ogosemeria kwao, ere narende okogoro kwao tikobaisa kobwatwa ase oboreba.
english: for the LORD will be your confidence and will keep your foot from being snared.

ekegusii: naki Omonene nache ase ense agambe ekina, akenache na kogekoora.”
english: For the Lord will carry out his sentence on earth with speed and finality."

ekegusii: Omonene tagotuguta abanto baye, takonyara gotiga abwo bare omwado oye.
english: For the LORD will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance.

ekegusii: Omonene obooririe abanto ba Yakobo, obatooririe korwa ase amaboko ’abanto bare ne chinguru kobabua.
english: For the LORD will ransom Jacob and redeem them from the hand of those stronger than they.

ekegusii: Omonene naagache Sayoni naende, nere orarorekane aroro ore ase obonene bwaye.
english: For the LORD will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.

ekegusii: Omonene narwanerere abataka, na abwo bakobaurereria Omonene nabasirie.
english: for the LORD will take up their case and will plunder those who plunder them.

ekegusii: Omonene narwanerere abanto baye, narorere abasomba baye amabera.
english: For the LORD will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagokora oborianania buna obwo, nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: For the LORD your God detests anyone who does these things, anyone who deals dishonestly.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo akamogetie amache a Yorodan bosio bwaino goika mokaamboka, naboigo buna akamogetie Enyancha Embariri bosio bwaito goika tokaamboka.
english: For the LORD your God dried up the Jordan before you until you had crossed over. The LORD your God did to the Jordan just what he had done to the Red Sea when he dried it up before us until we had crossed over.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, ochorire Lawi na ororeria rwaye ase egati y’ebisaku biaino bionsi, babe bagokora emeremo ase erieta riaye, ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: for the LORD your God has chosen them and their descendants out of all your tribes to stand and minister in the LORD's name always.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo are omorero ogosamba na gosiria; ere nere Nyasae bwe risemi.
english: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, takobatiga, ekiagera ere noyo bw’amabera. Takobasiria, gose takweba okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania akorete ne chisokoro chiaino.
english: For the LORD your God is a merciful God; he will not abandon or destroy you or forget the covenant with your forefathers, which he confirmed to them by oath.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nkobaira are ase ense engiya ebwate chindooche ne chinsoko, ne chintuboka chigosokia amache gochia ase amagoko na ase ebitunwa.
english: For the LORD your God is bringing you into a good land-- a land with streams and pools of water, with springs flowing in the valleys and hills;

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere Nyasae oyobuete chinyasae, na Omonene bw’abanene, nere Nyasae bw’obonene, na bw’okobua, na bw’okoirokia; tari nogwanchereria, na tari gwancha riaaki.
english: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality and accepts no bribes.

ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nagende amo nainwe, erio arwanie ababisa baino na kobarentera obobui.
english: For the LORD your God is the one who goes with you to fight for you against your enemies to give you victory."

ekegusii: Ebitwori biaino goika bibe ebichenu, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo agotaara ase ebitwori biaino, erinde abakonye, na abeke ababisa baino ase amaboko aino. Omonene tabaisa korora obonyinyeru asemore; aise koborora, nigo arabatige.
english: For the LORD your God moves about in your camp to protect you and to deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, so that he will not see among you anything indecent and turn away from you.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabasesenie buna abarierete eira. Inwe inamoe ebisaku ebinge ebinto singo, korende inwe timokoremerwa erinde mogende gosaba ebinto moegwe singo; naende inwe namogambere ebisaku ebinge, korende birobio tibikobagambera inwe.
english: For the LORD your God will bless you as he has promised, and you will lend to many nations but will borrow from none. You will rule over many nations but none will rule over you.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyomenyete ase egati yaino, nigo are Nyasae bwe risemi; mwerende, erinde endamwamu yaye tebaisa gwoka igoro asemore na kobasiria korwa ase ense.
english: for the LORD your God, who is among you, is a jealous God and his anger will burn against you, and he will destroy you from the face of the land.

ekegusii: Omonene bwechoreire abanto baye babe egetari kiaye, abanto ba Yakobo nabwo barurwe babe omwando oye.”
english: For the LORD's portion is his people, Jacob his allotted inheritance.

ekegusii: Naki omochakano bw’amabe onsi nogwancha chibesa. Abande kobakogania ayio, nigo bakweatanana korwa ase okwegena, na kwebeka abanyene ase obororo obonge.
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people, eager for money, have wandered from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo amonyorete agwo ase orosana, akamorwania ne chinguru. Nonya omoiseke oria okuurete akonywe, monto onde tarengeo okomokonya.
english: for the man found the girl out in the country, and though the betrothed girl screamed, there was no one to rescue her.

ekegusii: Emiaka y’omonto oria egekone gi’okogwenigwa giakoregete asare nigo yarenge goetania emerongo ene.
english: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.

ekegusii: Ekeene, amang’ana aria araretie buna achigetwe n’Omonene, agasoera egesasimero agwo Beteli, naende agasoera aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa aria ase emechie ya Samaria, goika aikeranigwe.”
english: For the message he declared by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the towns of Samaria will certainly come true."

ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ri’omosalaba noboriri ase abwo bagosira, korende asetore intwe abatwabeire togotoorigwa nigo rire chinguru chia Nyasae.
english: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

ekegusii: ekiagera ere oyore ne chinguru onkoreire amanene, na erieta riaye nerichenu.
english: for the Mighty One has done great things for me-- holy is his name.

ekegusii: Ebigwankwa mbirie abanto abwo buna bikoria chianga, na amakonde nabarie buna akoria amarionya e ching’ondi; korende oboronge bwane nigo boragenderere kobao kare na kare, na ogotooreka kwane ase ebiaare bionsi.”
english: For the moth will eat them up like a garment; the worm will devour them like wool. But my righteousness will last forever, my salvation through all generations."

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku na ab’amaruoti abaraange kogokorera mbasirigwe, ee, abanto abwo nigo barasirigwe kegima.”
english: For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly ruined.

ekegusii: Naki ere oyotometwe na Nyasae nigo agokwana amang’ana a Nyasae; naki Nyasae tari komoa Omoika ase ekerengo.
english: For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.

ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya sugusu y’Obomenyo oroisie chibao emerongo ebere,
english: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, make twenty frames

ekegusii: Nase ensemo ya kabere, nero ya sugusu y’Obomenyo, bakaroisia chibao emerongo ebere,
english: For the other side, the north side of the tabernacle, they made twenty frames

ekegusii: Naki abanto b’ebisaku bi’ense nigo bakorigia ebinto ebio bionsi, korende Iso oino omanyire ng’a moganetie ebio bionsi,
english: For the pagan world runs after all such things, and your Father knows that you need them.

ekegusii: Naki abanto b’Ebisaku nigo bakorigia ebio bionsi; korende Iso oino ore igoro omanyire ng’a moganetie ebinto ebio bionsi.
english: For the pagans run after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.

ekegusii: For the perishable must clothe itself with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.
english: Naki ogosareka kwagweneire koboigwe ogotasareka, na ogokwa koboigwe ogotakwa.

ekegusii: Abakori amabe mbaurwe chinguru echi babwate, korende Omonene nagenderere koa abanyaboronge chinguru.
english: for the power of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omokungu omotayayi omonto nigo akoremerwa oborwa nonya negesamunye ki’omogati, na omokungu bw’omonto omoao nigo akorigia obogima bw’omonto obosaria.
english: for the prostitute reduces you to a loaf of bread, and the adulteress preys upon your very life.

ekegusii: Ogokora oko eting’ana yakorire goise komanyekana ase abakungu bonsi, nigo koragere abakungu bande bachaye abasacha babo, batebe: Omoruoti Ahaswero nachika abasomba baye barente Vasti eting’ana asare, korende Vasti akaanga, tacha ase omoruoti.
english: For the queen's conduct will become known to all the women, and so they will despise their husbands and say, 'King Xerxes commanded Queen Vashti to be brought before him, but she would not come.'

ekegusii: Okorora okwo nigo koganyete engaki yaye eike. Nigo gokoayerera goikerane, tigokomocha goikerana. Nonya gokororekana ng’a gwatebanire, ekeene goika goikerane, tikogotebana.
english: For the revelation awaits an appointed time; it speaks of the end and will not prove false. Though it linger, wait for it; it will certainly come and will not delay.

ekegusii: Ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba oo, tobaisa kwanga korigereria omoakwa amaguta oo.
english: For the sake of David your servant, do not reject your anointed one.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’erieta riaye Omonene takobaanga inwe abanto baye, ekiagera nigo anchete kobakora mobe abaye.
english: For the sake of his great name the LORD will not reject his people, because the LORD was pleased to make you his own.

ekegusii: Nigo ngokorangeria ase erieta riao ase engencho ya Yakobo, omosomba one, ee, ase engencho ya Israeli, omochore one. Nakoeire erieta ri’amasikani, nonya aye tomanyeti inche.”
english: For the sake of Jacob my servant, of Israel my chosen, I summon you by name and bestow on you a title of honor, though you do not acknowledge me.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’abaminto na abagisangio baane, nigo ngokoganeria omorembe.
english: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, "Peace be within you."

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae oito ninkorigerie amaya.
english: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’erieta riao, koranche tototuguta. Totiga ekerogo kiao ki’obonene gechaywe. Inyora okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete naintwe, gose togosaria.
english: For the sake of your name do not despise us; do not dishonor your glorious throne. Remember your covenant with us and do not break it.

ekegusii: Omonene, ase engencho y’erieta riao onyabere ogosaria kwane, ekiagera nokonene.
english: For the sake of your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, though it is great.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’eira yao na koreng’ana nogwancha kwao, aye Omonene, gwakorire amanene ayio onsi, naende kwayamanyekanirie asende, inche omosomba oo.
english: For the sake of your word and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made it known to your servant.

ekegusii: Naki amariko nigo agoteba ase Farao, “Nigo nagotenenetie, erinde nyorokie okobua kwane asore, na erieta riane nario rirararigwe ase ense yonsi.”
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh: "I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display my power in you and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth."

ekegusii: Naki amariko nigo agoteba, “Tobaisa kobekera entang’ana ekeokio ekero ekoora endagera”, na “Omokori emeremo nagwenerete koegwa eng’eria yaye.”
english: For the Scripture says, "Do not muzzle the ox while it is treading out the grain," and "The worker deserves his wages."

ekegusii: Naki obobisi boria bw’ogosaria amachiko bwachakire gokora emeremo bono, na oria ore kobotanga bono goika arusigweo.
english: For the secret power of lawlessness is already at work; but the one who now holds it back will continue to do so till he is taken out of the way.

ekegusii: Naki okogania gwe chingencho chi’ebibe nigo gokoamererania n’Omoika na okogania kw’Omoika nigo gokoamererania ne chingencho chi’ebibe; naki ebi iga bikorwana goika timokonyara gokora ayamorigetie gokora.
english: For the sinful nature desires what is contrary to the Spirit, and the Spirit what is contrary to the sinful nature. They are in conflict with each other, so that you do not do what you want.

ekegusii: Ebibe nigo bire ase emenwa yabo, na amang’ana bagokwana namabe. Ase igo, tiga oboenenu bwabo bobabwate buna oboreba bokobwata. Barabwo nigo bakoragereria na gokwana amang’ana ’oborimo.
english: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride. For the curses and lies they utter,

ekegusii: Naki Omwana o Nyasae, Yeso Kristo, oyo inche na Silivano, na Timotheo, twarandetie ase egati yaino tabete “Ee” na “Taibo”, korende asare “Ee” nero ereo botambe.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by me and Silas and Timothy, was not "Yes" and "No," but in him it has always been "Yes."

ekegusii: Naki Omwana‐o‐mwanya banto nigo achete gotooria egiasirete.]
english: For the Son of Man came to save the lost. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version. See Luke 19:10.]

ekegusii: Naki Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nigo achete korigia egiasirete na kogetooria.”
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save what was lost."

ekegusii: Naki buna okomesa gokomesa korwa ensemo eyemo goika ensemo ende, nabo Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arache koba ase rituko riaye.
english: For the Son of Man in his day will be like the lightning, which flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other.

ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto naoroke nabamalaika baye ore nobonene bwa Ise, na ekero ekio ng’ae kera omonto koreng’ana buna are gokora.
english: For the Son of Man is going to come in his Father's glory with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to what he has done.

ekegusii: ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.”
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."

ekegusii: Ororeria rwa Yusufu nigo rwarenge ebisaku bibere: Manase na Efraimu. Abalawi tibaetwe orogongo, otatiga baetwe emechie bakomenya, amo nebitii ase chitugo chiabo chiare korisia na ase baare kobeka ebinto biabo.
english: for the sons of Joseph had become two tribes-- Manasseh and Ephraim. The Levites received no share of the land but only towns to live in, with pasturelands for their flocks and herds.

ekegusii: Naki erioba korikooroka nomobaso omororo, nigo rigosamba na kwomia obonyansi. Egesicha ki’obonyansi kiaroroka, na obuya bw’ekieni kiaye bwasira. Naboigo nomonda nere arasire kagendererete kwerigeria.
english: For the sun rises with scorching heat and withers the plant; its blossom falls and its beauty is destroyed. In the same way, the rich man will fade away even while he goes about his business.

ekegusii: for the sun stopped shining. And the curtain of the temple was torn in two.
english: ekero omobaso orimire. Na egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatandoka gati‐gati.

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia eria gatato, “Nase ki? Mbobe ki akorete oyo? Tindochi nonya ne ring’ana erimo asare rigwenerete akwe. Ase igo, nanchire komoaka na komosibora.”
english: For the third time he spoke to them: "Why? What crime has this man committed? I have found in him no grounds for the death penalty. Therefore I will have him punished and then release him."

ekegusii: Na engaki neche, ekero abanto baraange okworokereria kw’obogima, na ase okogania kwabo okobe benyorere aborokia abange mono, ekiagera amato abo are nebiagaso.
english: For the time will come when men will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.

ekegusii: Naki amatuko nache ekero abanto baratebe: Mbasesenirie abare abagomba, ne chinda chitaiboreti, ne chimbeere chitana kogonkwa!
english: For the time will come when you will say, 'Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore and the breasts that never nursed!'

ekegusii: Ase ayio, amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndarente egesusuro ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa ya Babeli. Ense eyio yonsi nenyore obosooku, na abanto baye mbaiterwe aroro agwo.
english: For the time will surely come when I will punish the idols of Babylon; her whole land will be disgraced and her slain will all lie fallen within her.

ekegusii: Naki omosacha oria otegeneti ochenirwe ase engencho ya mokaye, na omokungu oria otegeneti ochenirwe ase engencho y’omosacha oye. Onye taibo, abana baino anga tibaba abachenu; korende buna ere bono, babeire abachenu.
english: For the unbelieving husband has been sanctified through his wife, and the unbelieving wife has been sanctified through her believing husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are holy.

ekegusii: Ekiagera abare ne chinkoro chindonge mbamenye ase ense, na abaikeranu mbagenderere komenya aroro.
english: For the upright will live in the land, and the blameless will remain in it;

ekegusii: Naki eng’eria y’ebibe namakweri, korende ekeegwa kia Nyasae nobogima bwa kare na kare ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ekegusii: Okoirana nyuma kw’abwo batamanyeti amange nkobaite, na ogoisaneka kw’abariri nkobasirie barabwo abanyene.
english: For the waywardness of the simple will kill them, and the complacency of fools will destroy them;

ekegusii: Naki obong’aini bw’ense eye noboriri ase Nyasae, ekiagera nerikire, “Ere okobwata abare nobong’aini ase obong’ainereria bwabo”,
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness in God's sight. As it is written: "He catches the wise in their craftiness";
