ekegusii: Buna ere ase omonto omong’aini, naboigo ere nase omoriri, onde takogenderera koinyorwa; bonsi nigo barabe bebirwe kegima ase amatuko agochi‐gocha. Inee! Omonto omong’aini tagokwa buna oria omoriri agokwa?
english: For the wise man, like the fool, will not be long remembered; in days to come both will be forgotten. Like the fool, the wise man too must die!

ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rire moyo, naende ndire ne chinguru, nigo rire nobwoge kobua omoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere. Nigo rikobeta ime na gwatanana omoyo na omoika, chinengo na emeseto, naende ndinyare komanya ebirengererio na okogania bire ime ase enkoro.
english: For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword, it penetrates even to dividing soul and spirit, joints and marrow; it judges the thoughts and attitudes of the heart.

ekegusii: Naki ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rire boronge, na ogokora kwaye gwonsi nigo agokora ase obwegenwa.
english: For the word of the LORD is right and true; he is faithful in all he does.

ekegusii: ekiagera Omobooria obo nigo are ne chinguru, ere nachirwanerere akorwanie aye.
english: for their Defender is strong; he will take up their case against you.

ekegusii: ekiagera amagoro abo nigo akominyoka gochia ase ogokora amabe, na nigo bare abaango ase ogoitera amanyinga.
english: for their feet rush into sin, they are swift to shed blood.

ekegusii: ekiagera ebirengererio biabo nigo bikoroberia ay’ogosiria, na ebikoba biabo nigo bigokwama ayakorenta emechando.
english: for their hearts plot violence, and their lips talk about making trouble.

ekegusii: For their rock is not like our Rock, as even our enemies concede.
english: Egetare kiabo tikere buna Egetare giaito, nonya nababisa baito mbamanyete amang’ana ayio.

ekegusii: Ase engencho yabo nigo ainyorete okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera are nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.
english: for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.

ekegusii: Na ase engencho yabo nechenire, erinde nabarabwo bachenwe ase ekeene.
english: For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.

ekegusii: ekiagera agwo nebe emechando emenene, etana koba korwa omochakano bw’ense goika bono, gose tekoba bo naende nonya ng’ake.
english: For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now-- and never to be equaled again.

ekegusii: Naki mbare abange batari koigwera, abagokwana amang’ana atari nengencho, abang’ainereria, mono baria b’okwaroka.
english: For there are many rebellious people, mere talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision group.

ekegusii: Na Omoika noro obeire kirori, ekiagera Omoika noro ekeene.
english: For there are three that testify:

ekegusii: Kera ring’ana ndibwate engaki yaye na enchera yaye y’okonacha boronge, na emechando y’omonto nigo ekomoritoera.
english: For there is a proper time and procedure for every matter, though a man's misery weighs heavily upon him.

ekegusii: Naki gwatananeka tikori ase Abayahudi na Abagiriki, ekiageai ase Abayahudi na Abaginiki, ekiagera Omonene nigo are Omonene o bonsi, na obonda bwaye nigo akoa abanto bonsi abakomorangeria.
english: For there is no difference between Jew and Gentile-- the same Lord is Lord of all and richly blesses all who call on him,

ekegusii: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be known or brought out into the open.
english: Ekiagera ring’ana tiriri ribisegete, ritache koorokigwa, gose eria bobisi ritache komanyekana maiso marore.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae noyomo, na omobwatania egati ya Nyasae na mwanyabanto noyomo, omonto oria Kristo Yeso
english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

ekegusii: Abanto baria batwosete bakagania tobaterere, abachandi abwo baito bakagania tobagokie, bagateba, “Toterere ogotera gwa Sayoni.”
english: for there our captors asked us for songs, our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"

ekegusii: “Amaroro ’obobani ay’okong’ainereria, gose oboringoria bw’okweansia, tibikoba ase egati y’Abaisraeli nonya ng’ake.
english: For there will be no more false visions or flattering divinations among the people of Israel.

ekegusii: Amachiko nigo are etaya, na amorokererio nigo are oborabu; ogokurera gw’okorongeigwa nigo kore enchera y’obogima.
english: For these commands are a lamp, this teaching is a light, and the corrections of discipline are the way to life,

ekegusii: Ayio nigo are obogima ase oyio oyanyorire, naende nigo akogwenia omobere oye bwonsi.
english: for they are life to those who find them and health to a man's whole body.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabanto bao, na omwando oo, oria kwarusetie korwa Misiri, ense eria yarenge buna eriko ri’ekebemberi ki’omorero.
english: for they are your people and your inheritance, whom you brought out of Egypt, out of that iron-smelting furnace.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari korara goika barore ng’a bakorire amabe. Onye tibarakorera omonto amabe, tibari korara chitoro.
english: For they cannot sleep till they do evil; they are robbed of slumber till they make someone fall.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete, ekiagera tibamwegenete Nyasae, naende tibegenete ng’a ere nanyare kobatooria.
english: for they did not believe in God or trust in his deliverance.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibabarototete na kobarentera endagera na amache ekero mwarenge ase orogendo korwa Misiri, naende nigo barangeretie Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, korwa Petori ya Mesopotamia achiche kobaragereria inwe.
english: For they did not come to meet you with bread and water on your way when you came out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram Naharaim to pronounce a curse on you.

ekegusii: ekiagera tibamanyete amang’ana ’emegati eria, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chiarenge chinkong’u.
english: for they had not understood about the loaves; their hearts were hardened.

ekegusii: ekiagera bangete koigwera ring’ana ria Nyasae, bagachaya ogosemia kw’Oyore Igoro Mono.
english: for they had rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakorire obotomani, na baiteire amanyinga ’abanto namaboko abo; bakorire obotomani nemegwekano yabo bagosasima. Basambire abana babo banyiborerete babeire endagera y’emegwekano eyio.
english: for they have committed adultery and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their idols; they even sacrificed their children, whom they bore to me, as food for them.

ekegusii: Naki abanto abwo basiririe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, naende basaririe aase bamenyete.
english: for they have devoured Jacob and destroyed his homeland.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakorire obonyaka ase egati y’Abaisraeli, ekiagera batomanire nabakungu b’abagisangio babo, naende bakwanire amang’ana ’oborimo ase erieta riane, ayio inche ntabachigete. Ninche omonyene imanyete ayio, naende ninche inde kirori. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: For they have done outrageous things in Israel; they have committed adultery with their neighbors' wives and in my name have spoken lies, which I did not tell them to do. I know it and am a witness to it," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninkore ayio, ekiagera abanto bantigire na bakorire aase aiga abeire aya atachenegeti ase ogosamba ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao, chiria barabwo, gose chisokoro chiabo, gose abaruoti b’Abayuda, batamanyete, Naende baichoirie aase aiga namanyinga ’abanto batari na komocha.
english: For they have forsaken me and made this a place of foreign gods; they have burned sacrifices in it to gods that neither they nor their fathers nor the kings of Judah ever knew, and they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.

ekegusii: For they have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has sold herself to lovers.
english: Bagendire Asuri, babeire buna etigere y’orosana ere ao yoka; ee, Abaefraimu benyoreire abanchi.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo arakoreke, ekiagera bangete koigwera amang’ana aane goetera ase abasomba baane ababani, abwo nabete ngotoma asebare naende naende. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: For they have not listened to my words," declares the LORD, "words that I sent to them again and again by my servants the prophets. And you exiles have not listened either," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: for they have shed the blood of your saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink as they deserve."
english: Ekiagera barabwo baiterete amanyinga ’abachenu na ay’ababani, aye kwabaeire amanyinga banywe. Barabwo banyorire ayabagweneire!”

ekegusii: Naki babaigwete bagokwana ase emenwa, bagotogia Nyasae. Erio Petero akabora,
english: For they heard them speaking in tongues and praising God. Then Peter said,

ekegusii: ekiagera mbanchete ogotogia kw’abanto kobua ogotogia kwa Nyasae.
english: for they loved praise from men more than praise from God.

ekegusii: Nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu atari nengencho, na ase okogania okobe kw’omobere na obonyaka bakogenka abwo bachakire gotama baria bagendererete gochia gosira.
english: For they mouth empty, boastful words and, by appealing to the lustful desires of sinful human nature, they entice people who are just escaping from those who live in error.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bachandete omonto oria kwaagete, na bagokwana igoro y’obororo bw’oyio kwabetete.
english: For they persecute those you wound and talk about the pain of those you hurt.

ekegusii: Nigo bagechetie enkoro ya Musa, goika agakwana amang’ana nobororo, ase ogotarengereria buya.
english: for they rebelled against the Spirit of God, and rash words came from Moses' lips.

ekegusii: Naki mbansasogetie ase omoika one, na emeika yaino yonsi. Gaki bainyore mono abanto buna abwo.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours also. Such men deserve recognition.

ekegusii: Naki barabwo abanyene baorokirie amang’ana igoro yaito, buna twasoete ase egati yaino, na buna inwe mwaonchokerete Nyasae korwa ase emegwekano y’osasimwa, erinde mokorere Nyasae ore moyo, oyo bw’ekeene,
english: for they themselves report what kind of reception you gave us. They tell how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,

ekegusii: Ayio nagere omenye amatuko amange, na emiaka emenge, naende ogendererete koba nomorembe.
english: for they will prolong your life many years and bring you prosperity.

ekegusii: ekiagera barabwo nigo baraonchore abana baino abamura batige gosasima Omonene, erio bakorere chinyasae ching’ao. Erio Omonene abaise koba nendamwamu asemore, abasirie ara rimo rioka.
english: for they will turn your sons away from following me to serve other gods, and the LORD's anger will burn against you and will quickly destroy you.

ekegusii: “Nyasae oyo nere Nyasae oito o kare na kare. Ere nabe omoraai oito kogenderera botambe.”
english: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide even to the end.

ekegusii: Nakio kiagerete abakure bakaranderigwa enchili, erinde bagambigwe ase omobere koreng’ana buna mwanyabanto bakogambigwa, na babe moyo ase omoika, koreng’ana buna Nyasae are moyo.
english: For this is the reason the gospel was preached even to those who are now dead, so that they might be judged according to men in regard to the body, but live according to God in regard to the spirit.

ekegusii: ekiagera aya namatuko ’egesiomba, onsi ayarigetwe anyare goikerana.
english: For this is the time of punishment in fulfillment of all that has been written.

ekegusii: Naki oko nakwo kware ogwechabera kw’abakungu abachenu ba kare, abamosemeretie Nyasae, abwo baigwerete abasacha babo,
english: For this is the way the holy women of the past who put their hope in God used to make themselves beautiful. They were submissive to their own husbands,

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro akwanire: Yeroboamu naitwe nemioro, na Abaisraeli mbarusigwe ase ense yabo bairwe ase obosomba.”
english: For this is what Amos is saying: "'Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their native land.'"

ekegusii: Aya naro Oyio ore Igoro Mono, Oyio oragambe goika kare na kare, Oyio erieta riaye n’Omochenu, agoteba: “Inche nigo imenyete aase aachenu are igoro mono, boigo nigo imenyete amo noyio enkoro yaye yeitirie na gwekeyia, erinde ninkore omoika bw’oyore omoitongo obe omoyia, na koa obogima ase oyio enkoro yaye yeitirie.
english: For this is what the high and lofty One says-- he who lives forever, whose name is holy: "I live in a high and holy place, but also with him who is contrite and lowly in spirit, to revive the spirit of the lowly and to revive the heart of the contrite.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba igoro ye chisiiro, na egetuba keria ekenene, na ebibekerero binde biatigarete ase omochie oyo,
english: For this is what the LORD Almighty says about the pillars, the Sea, the movable stands and the other furnishings that are left in this city,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Ere oyontomire ase abanto b’ebisaku abwo babasakorete ing’orokie obonene bwaye, ekiagera oyo orabakune inwe, oyio nabe okunire endorero y’eriso riaye.
english: For this is what the LORD Almighty says: "After he has honored me and has sent me against the nations that have plundered you-- for whoever touches you touches the apple of his eye--

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Ase engaki yaino ekero morigereretie ninsirie eriogi ri’omogoko, na erie chigosori, na eri’omonyuomi, na eri’omoriakari.
english: For this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Before your eyes and in your days I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in this place.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli agoteba: Chinyomba na emegondo, amo nemegondo y’emesabibu nabigorwe naende ase ense eye.”
english: For this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields and vineyards will again be bought in this land.'

ekegusii: Nabo twachigetwe n’Omonene, “Nakobekire obe omobaso ase abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde ogotooreka kwane kogende, goike ase chinsinyo chi’ense.”
english: For this is what the Lord has commanded us: "'I have made you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring salvation to the ends of the earth.'"

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro ya Salumu, mosinto o Yosia, Salumu oria ogamberete Abayuda ribaga ria ise na akagenda agatiga aase aa: “Ere takoirana aiga nonya ng’ake,
english: For this is what the LORD says about Shallum son of Josiah, who succeeded his father as king of Judah but has gone from this place: "He will never return.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’enyomba y’oboruoti bw’Abayuda: “Aye nigo ore asende buna Gileadi, na buna egetunwa kia Lebanoni, korende nonya naboigo, ekeene, ningokore obe buna erooro, na buna omochie otamenyiri nabanto.
english: For this is what the LORD says about the palace of the king of Judah: "Though you are like Gilead to me, like the summit of Lebanon, I will surely make you like a desert, like towns not inhabited.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’abana, abamura na abaiseke, abwo baiboreire aiga, naboigo igoro y’abang’ina na abaise babaiborerete aiga ase ense eye:
english: For this is what the LORD says about the sons and daughters born in this land and about the women who are their mothers and the men who are their fathers:

ekegusii: Omonene oyio otongete igoro chionsi, nere Nyasae, nere otongete ense akayebeka oboroso obokong’u. Tayetongete ng’a ebe bosa, nigo ayetongete emenywe. Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Inche ninche Omonene, onde tari.
english: For this is what the LORD says-- he who created the heavens, he is God; he who fashioned and made the earth, he founded it; he did not create it to be empty, but formed it to be inhabited-- he says: "I am the LORD, and there is no other.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Ase engaki eye ninserie ne chinguru abwo bonsi bamenyete ase ense eye, nimbarentere ogoichana goika baigwe obororo.”
english: For this is what the LORD says: "At this time I will hurl out those who live in this land; I will bring distress on them so that they may be captured."

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Tobaisa gosoa ase enyomba ase abanto bakorera gose kobokia amagombo, na tobaisa koreera onde bwensi, gose kobaichanera. Inche narusirie omorembe one na obwanchani bwane bwa botambe, na amabera aane korwa ase abanto aba.
english: For this is what the LORD says: "Do not enter a house where there is a funeral meal; do not go to mourn or show sympathy, because I have withdrawn my blessing, my love and my pity from this people," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Naama! Nimente ogosesenigwa ase Yerusalemu kobe buna orooche, ninyorentere na obotenenku bw’ebisaku bobe orooche rwaichoire amache, erinde mogonke, naende moimokigwe mobekwe kwaa, moagatwe na gochanchimwa.
english: For this is what the LORD says: "I will extend peace to her like a river, and the wealth of nations like a flooding stream; you will nurse and be carried on her arm and dandled on her knees.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Abanto abagomba abarendete Chisabato chiane, abwo bachorire gokora ogwancha kwane, naende babwatete okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania,
english: For this is what the LORD says: "To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths, who choose what pleases me and hold fast to my covenant--

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Inwe nigo mwaoonetigwe timwaakaneretwe kende, na nigo moraboorigwe motari goakanerwa chibesa.
english: For this is what the LORD says: "You were sold for nothing, and without money you will be redeemed."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba, “Omonto takobora ase ororeria rwa Daudi oraikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: For this is what the LORD says: 'David will never fail to have a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,

ekegusii: Naki Omonene otebire ng’a nagokore obe omwoboyia ase aye omonyene, na ase abasani bao bonsi, na ababisa babo mbabaite nemioro ase obosio bwao. Omonene nabeke Abayuda bonsi ase okoboko kw’omoruoti o Babeli, nabaire gochia Babeli ase obosomba na abaite nemioro,
english: For this is what the LORD says: 'I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends; with your own eyes you will see them fall by the sword of their enemies. I will hand all Judah over to the king of Babylon, who will carry them away to Babylon or put them to the sword.

ekegusii: Naende aya naro Omonene agoteba: Nonya timokorora omwaga, gose embura, rigoko eri nariichore amache, erinde monywe, inwe ne chiombe chiaino, ne ching’ondi chiaino.
english: For this is what the LORD says: You will see neither wind nor rain, yet this valley will be filled with water, and you, your cattle and your other animals will drink.

ekegusii: Naende aya naro inche Omonene bw’Abaisraeli ngoteba igoro ye chinyomba chi’omochie oyo, na igoro ye chinyomba chi’abaruoti b’Abayuda, chiria chiatagoretwe nabwo baagachete chindwaki chi’ogwekengera, naende bakorwana esegi:
english: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says about the houses in this city and the royal palaces of Judah that have been torn down to be used against the siege ramps and the sword

ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, otebire iga: Obosie bore ase ekegancha kiao tibokoera, na amaguta are ase echuba yao takoera, goika rituko riria Omonene aratome embura ase ense.”
english: For this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'The jar of flour will not be used up and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the LORD gives rain on the land.'"

ekegusii: Ee, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Abanto baane nigo bagendete Misiri agwo kare, bakaba abamenyi aroro, na Abaasuri bakabachanda engencho ende etarengeo.
english: For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "At first my people went down to Egypt to live; lately, Assyria has oppressed them.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe nigo mwaagete chinkobi, naende mogatinera amagoro aino inse, mokagoka ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi ase engencho y’amabe anyorete ense y’Abaisraeli.
english: For this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you have clapped your hands and stamped your feet, rejoicing with all the malice of your heart against the land of Israel,

ekegusii: “Nigo erabe buna mwaboretie Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase rituko riria mwasangererekanete agwo Horebu, mogakwana: Tototiga toigwe eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae oito, kagokwana, gose titogenderera korora omorero oyio omonene. Toise koriigwa na koyorora, nigo torakwe.
english: For this is what you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said, "Let us not hear the voice of the LORD our God nor see this great fire anymore, or we will die."

ekegusii: Naki chinkoro chi’abanto aba chiabeire chinyoro, na amato abo nigo are amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo bayamiamirie, tibacha korora namaiso abo gose baigwe namato abo, gose bamanye ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, na inche mbagwenie.
english: For this people's heart has become calloused; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts and turn, and I would heal them.'

ekegusii: Naki chinkoro chi’abanto aba chiabeire chinyoro, na amato abo nigo are amarito ase okoigwa, na amaiso abo bayamiamirie, tibacha korora namaiso abo, gose baigwe namato abo, gose bamanye ne chinkoro chiabo, baonchoke, na inche mbagwenie.
english: For this people's heart has become calloused; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts and turn, and I would heal them.'

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio omonto natige ise na ng’ina, abwatane na mokaye,
english: 'For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, omonto natige ise na ng’ina, abwatane na mokaye, na abwo babere nababe omobere oyomo.
english: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they will become one flesh.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ere oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti tiga asabe aegwe ekeegwa gi’okoonchora.
english: For this reason anyone who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret what he says.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eye ere nomobwatania bw’okobwatana okoyia, erinde abwo barangerigwe banyore omwando oria o kare na kare, oyo barieretwe eira, ekiagera amakweri aikire gokoreka ase okobabooria barabwo korwa ase ogosaria koria bakorete ase okobwatana kwe ritang’ani.
english: For this reason Christ is the mediator of a new covenant, that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance-- now that he has died as a ransom to set them free from the sins committed under the first covenant.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Nyasae nabatomere obotantanu bwe chinguru, abakore begene ayare ay’oborimo,
english: For this reason God sends them a powerful delusion so that they will believe the lie

ekegusii: Ase ayio, yamogwenerete agwekanigwe nabamwabo ase amang’ana onsi, erinde anyare koba Omokuani omonene, Omonyene amabera, na omwegenwa ase ogokorera Nyasae, na koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe bia mwanyabanto.
english: For this reason he had to be made like his brothers in every way, in order that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in service to God, and that he might make atonement for the sins of the people.

ekegusii: Ase ayio natomire Timotheo asemore, oyore omwana one omwanchwa, na omwegenwa ase Omonene. Nere orabainyorie buna chingencho chiane chire ase Kristo, buna nkoborokereria kera aase ase kera ekanisa,
english: For this reason I am sending to you Timothy, my son whom I love, who is faithful in the Lord. He will remind you of my way of life in Christ Jesus, which agrees with what I teach everywhere in every church.

ekegusii: Nabo ase engencho eyio nero nabarangereirie, erinde mbarore, na gokwana nainwe, ekiagera nasibirwe ase ekenyuri eke ase engencho y’ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli.”
english: For this reason I have asked to see you and talk with you. It is because of the hope of Israel that I am bound with this chain."

ekegusii: Ase ayio namobekeire Tata amaru aane inse,
english: For this reason I kneel before the Father,

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ngokoinyoria, oigererie ekeegwa ekiarure ase Nyasae, ekere ime yao, ekio kwaetwe ekero nakobekerete amaboko aane,
english: For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

ekegusii: Naki ase ayio inche Paulo nabeire omosibwa o Kristo Yeso ase engencho yaino, inwe abanto b’Ebisaku.
english: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for the sake of you Gentiles--

ekegusii: Nabo ekiagera ase aya Abayahudi bakamenta korigia komoita, ekiagera tasaretie Esabato yoka, korende amo naya narogete Nyasae ng’a n’Ise, ogwekora koreng’ana buna Nyasae.
english: For this reason the Jews tried all the harder to kill him; not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was even calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

ekegusii: Nakio kiagerete tibanyara kwegena. Naki Isaya nigo atebete naende,
english: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:

ekegusii: Ase ayio negwenerete omokungu abe nekemanyererio gi’okobua ase omotwe oye ase engencho y’abamalaika.
english: For this reason, and because of the angels, the woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ekero naigwete amang’ana ’okwegena kwaino more nakorokwo ase Omonene Yeso, na obwanchani bwaino ase abachenu bonsi,
english: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa rituko riria twaigwete amang’ana ayio, titwatigete kobasabera inwe. Igo twasabete ng’a moichorwe ne chisemi chi’ogwancha kwaye ase obong’aini bwonsi na okomanya gwonsi kw’omoika.
english: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of his will through all spiritual wisdom and understanding.

ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio, ekero ntanyarete koremereria kobua, ngatoma Timotheo, erinde inyare komanya okwegena kwaino. Noboire ng’a omoteemi oria obateemire inwe na emeremo yaito ebe eya bosa.
english: For this reason, when I could stand it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith. I was afraid that in some way the tempter might have tempted you and our efforts might have been useless.

ekegusii: ekiagera oyo omwana one konya okure, naende moyo are; konya osirire, korende bono ororekanire. Bagachaka gochenga.
english: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.' So they began to celebrate.

ekegusii: Naki Kristo nigo akwete, naende akaba moyo, erinde abe Omonene ase abare moyo na ase abakure boigo.
english: For this very reason, Christ died and returned to life so that he might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.

ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio eyio kora omokia mono, erinde ase okwegena kwaino momente obuya, na ase obuya chisemi,
english: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith goodness; and to goodness, knowledge;

ekegusii: Nake ring’ana ri’eira neri, “Ekero kenga buna eke ninchiche, inyore ng’a Sara onyorire omwana omoisia.”
english: For this was how the promise was stated: "At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son."

ekegusii: Naki baria amanyete korwa kare akabachora korwa kare, bareng’anigwe nomogwekano bw’Omwana oye, erinde ere abe omotangi bw’abamwabo abange.
english: For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the likeness of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo baranyore emechando ya mobosokano, na ning’o oranyare komanya ogosirigwa kwabo?
english: for those two will send sudden destruction upon them, and who knows what calamities they can bring?

ekegusii: Naki abwo bakorara chitoro nigo bakorara botuko, na abwo bagotinda nigo bagotinda botuko.
english: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akogwa ara gatano na kabere, naende oboka, korende abakori amabe nigo bagosira ekero banyorire emechando.
english: for though a righteous man falls seven times, he rises again, but the wicked are brought down by calamity.

ekegusii: Naki nonya tindi nainwe ase omobere, nigo inde amo nainwe ase omoika. Nigo nkogoka ekero nkorora omoroberio oino omuya, na ogwetenenera gw’okwegena kwaino ase Kristo.
english: For though I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit and delight to see how orderly you are and how firm your faith in Christ is.

ekegusii: Naki nonya tomenyete ase ense eye, titori korwana esegi y’okogania gw’ense eye.
english: For though we live in the world, we do not wage war as the world does.

ekegusii: Na abanto ba kera egesaku, na eamate, na omonwa, na abe chinse chionsi, nabarigererie ebitondo ebio ase engaki y’amatuko atato na ekeng’ese, na tibakobitiga bitindekwe.
english: For three and a half days men from every people, tribe, language and nation will gaze on their bodies and refuse them burial.

ekegusii: Akaba omouko amatuko atato, atari koria, nonya nkonywa.
english: For three days he was blind, and did not eat or drink anything.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’emiaka amagana atato Abaisraeli nigo bamenyete Hesiboni na Aroeri, amo nebichie bionsi biaetanaine emechie eyio, na emechie yonsi yare ase chingegu chi’Arinoni. Nase ki motairete chinse echio ase engaki eyio yonsi?
english: For three hundred years Israel occupied Heshbon, Aroer, the surrounding settlements and all the towns along the Arnon. Why didn't you retake them during that time?

ekegusii: Abasiiria na Abaisraeli bakagenderera ase emiaka etato batarenge nesegi barabwo ase barabwo.
english: For three years there was no war between Aram and Israel.

ekegusii: Naki goetera asare intwe twensi twanyorire enchera y’okomoika ang’e Tata, ase Omoika oyomo.
english: For through him we both have access to the Father by one Spirit.

ekegusii: Ase ogokonywa kwane amatuko ao nabe amange, na emiaka y’obogima bwao nementwe.
english: For through me your days will be many, and years will be added to your life.

ekegusii: Naki inche goetera ase amachiko nakwereire amachiko, erinde imbe moyo ase Nyasae.
english: For through the law I died to the law so that I might live for God.

ekegusii: Naki igo abwatete ogosorora gwaito; kobua ayio, ere akamenta koba nomokia gocha asemore ase ogwancha kwaye omonyene.
english: For Titus not only welcomed our appeal, but he is coming to you with much enthusiasm and on his own initiative.

ekegusii: Naki igo abambetwe ase oboreu, korende moyo are ase okobua kwa Nyasae. Naki intwe nigo tore abareu asare; korende natobe moyo amo nere ase okobua kwa Nyasae gocha asemore.
english: For to be sure, he was crucified in weakness, yet he lives by God's power. Likewise, we are weak in him, yet by God's power we will live with him to serve you.

ekegusii: Naki asende inche, okoba moyo n’Kristo, na ogokwa nokonyora amange.
english: For to me, to live is Christ and to die is gain.

ekegusii: Omwana oiboirwe ase engencho yaito, intwe twaeirwe omwana omomura; obogambi mbobe ase amareko aye, ere nigo ararokwe: “Omosemia bw’Ogokumia, Nyasae bw’Okobua, Tata o Kare na Kare, Omogambi bw’Omorembe.”
english: For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

ekegusii: Inee! Momalaika ki otebetigwe na Nyasae kero kende gionsi, “Aye, naye Omwana one, rero nakoiboire”? Gose naende, “Inche nimbe asare ise, nere asende nabe omwana one”?
english: For to which of the angels did God ever say, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father"? Or again, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son"?

ekegusii: Amabe amange atari kobareka nigo ang’etanaine. Ebibe biane biambuire, goika tinkonyara korora; biabeire ebinge kobua etukia y’omotwe one, goika nerusirie moyo.
english: For troubles without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails within me.

ekegusii: Okogamba kwaye nogw’ekeene, na okw’oboronge, naki omogambirie oria omotayayi omonene, oyosaririe ense ase obotomani bwaye. Nyasae orusirie egesiomba ki’amanyinga ’abasomba baye korwa ase amaboko ’omotayayi oria”
english: for true and just are his judgments. He has condemned the great prostitute who corrupted the earth by her adulteries. He has avenged on her the blood of his servants."

ekegusii: Konya bamokoreire Kedorilaoma emiaka ikomi na ebere, korende omwaka o ikomi na gatato bakaanga, tibamokorera naende.
english: For twelve years they had been subject to Kedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere na etato, gochakera omwaka o ikomi na gatato bw’okogamba kwa Yosia mosinto bw’Amoni, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, goika rituko ria rero, ring’ana ri’Omonene riabeire rigochicha asende, na inche nabeire nkoribatebia inwe ntari gotiga, korende inwe mwabeire mokwanga koriigwera.
english: For twenty-three years-- from the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah until this very day-- the word of the LORD has come to me and I have spoken to you again and again, but you have not listened.

ekegusii: Daudi amo nabanto amagana ane bakagenderera kobwatia ababisa baria. Abanto baria bande amagana abere bakarosa mono, bagasinywa kwamboka; ase igo bagatigara ase akarooche karia Besori.
english: for two hundred men were too exhausted to cross the ravine. But David and four hundred men continued the pursuit.

ekegusii: Paulo akamenya engaki y’emiaka ebere ase enyomba amenyete, eye are goakanera, akaba okoroisia abanto bonsi abarenge komochiera,
english: For two whole years Paul stayed there in his own rented house and welcomed all who came to see him.

ekegusii: Omwaka oyo noyo o kabere enchara ere ase ense, naende netigarete emiaka etano abanto batareme gose kogesa.
english: For two years now there has been famine in the land, and for the next five years there will not be plowing and reaping.

ekegusii: Korwa ase emereng’anio eyio abanto mbanyare kweorokereria emereng’anio na eki egoteba; boigo mbamanye amang’ana ’abanto abang’aini na emebayeno yabo.
english: for understanding proverbs and parables, the sayings and riddles of the wise.

ekegusii: Ase ogosemia kw’obong’aini kore, nonyare korwana esegi, na ase abasemia abange abaya bare, obobui nigo bokonyorekanao.
english: for waging war you need guidance, and for victory many advisers.

ekegusii: Naki ekeene, intwe twaranderigwe amang’ana amaya buna barabwo. Korende ring’ana riria baigwete tiriabakonyete, ekiagera ekero baare koriigwa tiriasang’ananete nabarabwo ase okwegena.
english: For we also have had the gospel preached to us, just as they did; but the message they heard was of no value to them, because those who heard did not combine it with faith.

ekegusii: Naki intwe nabakori emeremo amo na Nyasae; inwe nomogondo o Nyasae, na oboagacho bwa Nyasae.
english: For we are God's fellow workers; you are God's field, God's building.

ekegusii: Naki igo tore emeremo y’amaboko aye, togatongwa ase Kristo Yeso, erinde tokore ogokora okuya oko Nyasae aroisetie ritang’ani, erio totaare ime ase okwo.
english: For we are God's workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

ekegusii: ekiagera nigo tore ebiimo bi’omobere oye.
english: for we are members of his body.

ekegusii: Gatoraganie korengereria ayare amaya, tari ase obosio bw’Omonene bweka, korende nonya nase obosio bwa mwanyabanto.
english: For we are taking pains to do what is right, not only in the eyes of the Lord but also in the eyes of men.

ekegusii: Naki intwe nigo tore ogotioka okuya gwa Kristo ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ase abwo bagotoorigwa, na ase abwo bagosira;
english: For we are to God the aroma of Christ among those who are being saved and those who are perishing.

ekegusii: inaki titwachete na gento ase ense, naende titokoira gento korwa ase ense.
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.

ekegusii: Naki titokonyara gokora ring’ana mamincha y’ekeene, korende ase ekeene.
english: For we cannot do anything against the truth, but only for the truth.

ekegusii: ekiagera titokonyara gotiga gokwana ayatwaroche na koyaigwa.”
english: For we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard."

ekegusii: Naki titori n’Omokuani Omonene oyotanyare gotobogoreria oboreu bwaito, korende oyoteemetwe koreng’ana buna intwe ase amang’ana onsi, atakoreti ebibe.
english: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who has been tempted in every way, just as we are-- yet was without sin.

ekegusii: Naki titori kwerandia intwe abanyene, korende Kristo Yeso buna Omonene, na intwe abanyene buna abasomba baino ase engencho ya Yeso.
english: For we do not preach ourselves, but Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake.

ekegusii: Naki titobarikereti inwe kende, otatiga ring’ana eri rioka moranyare gosoma na komanya. Na inche nasemeirie ng’a omoerio namonyare korimanya,
english: For we do not write you anything you cannot read or understand. And I hope that,

ekegusii: Naki ntwamoigwa ogoteba ng’a Yeso oyio o Nazareti inasarie aase aa, na koonchora chingencho echi twaetwe na Musa.”
english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses handed down to us."

ekegusii: Naki ntomanyete ere oyokwanete, “Egesiomba nekiane, inche ning’akane,” naende, “Omonene nere oragambie abanto baye.”
english: For we know him who said, "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," and again, "The Lord will judge his people."

ekegusii: Naki okomanya gwaito tikori okw’oboikeranu, na obobani bwaito tibori obw’oboikeranu;
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,

ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a obomwanyabanto bwaito bwa kare nigo bwabambetwe amo nere, erinde omobere bw’ebibe osirigwe, titoba abasomba b’ebibe naende.
english: For we know that our old self was crucified with him so that the body of sin might be done away with, that we should no longer be slaves to sin--

ekegusii: Twamanyire ng’a Kristo oyobogetigwe korwa ase abakure tagokwa naende; amakweri takomogambera naende.
english: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, he cannot die again; death no longer has mastery over him.

ekegusii: Naki abaminto, abamwanchire na Nyasae, twamanyire ng’a ere obachorire.
english: For we know, brothers loved by God, that he has chosen you,

ekegusii: Naboigo, tokobara ng’a omonto nigo akoegwa oboronge ase okwegena kore ao nogokora kw’amachiko.
english: For we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from observing the law.

ekegusii: Naki netogwenerete intwe twensi koorokigwa ase obosio bw’ekerogo gi’ekina gia Kristo; erio kera omonto anyore koreng’ana buna are gokora ase omobere, onye bire ebiya gose onye bire ebibe.
english: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive what is due him for the things done while in the body, whether good or bad.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ntwaganetie gocha asemore (inche Paulo nonya ng’ara kabere) korende Saitani agatotanga.
english: For we wanted to come to you-- certainly I, Paul, did, again and again-- but Satan stopped us.

ekegusii: Naki ase Omoika oyomo intwe twensi tokabatiswa, tokaba omobere oyomo, nonya tore Abayahudi, gose tore Abagiriki, onye tore abasomba, gose tore abasibore; intwe twensi nigo twanyoisetigwe Omoika oyomo.
english: For we were all baptized by one Spirit into one body-- whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free-- and we were all given the one Spirit to drink.

ekegusii: Intwe nigo tonga buna abaiborwa igoro totamanyeti kende, naki amatuko aito tomenyete ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari ogosira.
english: for we were born only yesterday and know nothing, and our days on earth are but a shadow.

ekegusii: Naki intwe ekero tore moyo, amatuko onsi nigo tokoruegwa tokwe ase engencho ya Yeso, erinde obogima bwa Yeso boorokigwe ase emebere yaito eyekonyorwa namakweri.
english: For we who are alive are always being given over to death for Jesus' sake, so that his life may be revealed in our mortal body.

ekegusii: For what does he care about the family he leaves behind when his allotted months come to an end?
english: Ekero emetienyi yabo yaerire na bakure, Inee, mbabe bagwechandera chinka chiabo?

ekegusii: Ngosemeria ki omonto otamoirogete Nyasae abwate, ekero arakwe, ekero Nyasae aramoure obogima.
english: For what hope has the godless when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

ekegusii: Naki keria kere ekiya nyanchete, tindi kogekora, korende keria kere ekebe ntancheti, nakio ngokora.
english: For what I do is not the good I want to do; no, the evil I do not want to do-- this I keep on doing.

ekegusii: Naki ritang’ani nabarenterete amang’ana aya nanyorete inche omonyene, ng’a Kristo nigo akwete ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, buna amariko agoteba;
english: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

ekegusii: Naki rende egetari kiane gekorwa ase Nyasae o igoro kerabe? Na omwando one okorwa ase Omonguru ore igoro, naki orabe?
english: For what is man's lot from God above, his heritage from the Almighty on high?

ekegusii: Ogosemeria gwaito ninki, gose omogoko oito, gose egutwa yaito eragere twetogie ase obosio bw’Omonene oito Yeso ekero ki’ogocha kwaye? Inee! Tari inwe?
english: For what is our hope, our joy, or the crown in which we will glory in the presence of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Is it not you?

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto nareo obeire okoigwa Nyasae ore moyo kagokwana korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, buna intwe twamoigure, na omonto oyio ogendererete koba moyo?
english: For what mortal man has ever heard the voice of the living God speaking out of fire, as we have, and survived?

ekegusii: Naki aya amachiko atare konyara gokora, ekiagera nigo arenge amareu ase engencho y’ebibe bi’emebere ya mwanyabanto, Nyasae agakora ase ogotoma Omwana oye omonyene ase omogwekano bw’engencho yaito y’ebibe, na ase engencho y’ebibe, akagambia ebibe ase omobere oye o mwanyabanto,
english: For what the law was powerless to do in that it was weakened by the sinful nature, God did by sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful man to be a sin offering. And so he condemned sin in sinful man,

ekegusii: Naki keria kiarenge nobonene tikegwatorwa bono ng’a nkere nobonene ase engencho y’obonene boria bore obonene kobua.
english: For what was glorious has no glory now in comparison with the surpassing glory.

ekegusii: For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.
english: Naki ring’ana tiriri ribisegete ritache koorokigwa, gose eria bobisi ritache koorokigwa maiso marore.

ekegusii: Rituko riria narusetie chisokoro chiaino korwa ase ense ya Misiri, tinabatebetie gose tinabachigete igoro ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde.
english: For when I brought your forefathers out of Egypt and spoke to them, I did not just give them commands about burnt offerings and sacrifices,

ekegusii: Ekero Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi baroche ng’a abwo baboete babwatire omochie na koyosamba, bakairana, bagachaka goita abanto ba Ai.
english: For when Joshua and all Israel saw that the ambush had taken the city and that smoke was going up from the city, they turned around and attacked the men of Ai.

ekegusii: Ekiagera ekero omonto oyomo akobora, “Inche noyo o Paulo,” na oyonde, “Inche noyo bw’Apolo.” Inee, inwe timori mwanyabanto?
english: For when one says, "I follow Paul," and another, "I follow Apollos," are you not mere men?

ekegusii: ekiagera ekero abateneneri be chigari baroche ng’a ere tarenge omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, bakaonchoka, bagatiga komobwatia.
english: for when the chariot commanders saw that he was not the king of Israel, they stopped pursuing him.

ekegusii: ekiagera timwaigwerete ring’ana riane agwo ase erooro ya Sini, rituko riria omoganda bwonsi bwemurunganetie, gose timwaorogetie ng’a inche nomochenu inde, ekero mware kobochorera abanto amache.” (Aya namache a Meriba ya Kadeshi ase erooro ya Sini).
english: for when the community rebelled at the waters in the Desert of Zin, both of you disobeyed my command to honor me as holy before their eyes." (These were the waters of Meribah Kadesh, in the Desert of Zin.)

ekegusii: For when there is a change of the priesthood, there must also be a change of the law.
english: Naki obokuani koboraonchorwe, goika okoonchorwa kw’amachiko boigo kobeo.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto baare koroberigwa na goitaagwa, bakanyora ng’a onde tacheteo nonya noyomo korwa ase abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi,
english: For when they counted the people, they found that none of the people of Jabesh Gilead were there.

ekegusii: Naki nonya nekero twaigete Makedonia, emebere yaito tiyanyorete ogotimoka, korende togachandwa chinsemo chionsi; isiko ekaba esegi, na ime bokaba obwoba.
english: For when we came into Macedonia, this body of ours had no rest, but we were harassed at every turn-- conflicts on the outside, fears within.

ekegusii: Naki ekero twarenge ime y’engencho yaito y’ebibe okogania gwaito kw’ebibe gokaboka ase engencho y’amachiko, kogakora emeremo ase ebiimo biaito goika tokaamera amakweri okwama.
english: For when we were controlled by the sinful nature, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in our bodies, so that we bore fruit for death.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwakorete amang’ana ’ogokumia totakagerete ng’a nabe, ogacha inse aa, na ebitunwa bigatengechigwa ase obosio bwao.
english: For when you did awesome things that we did not expect, you came down, and the mountains trembled before you.

ekegusii: Naki kera ekero mokoria omogati oyo na konywera egekombe eke, nigo mokoraria amakweri ’Omonene goika achiche.
english: For whenever you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.

ekegusii: Naki asebare babere gose batato basangererekanire ase erieta riane, nainche nao inde agwo gati‐gati yabo.”
english: For where two or three come together in my name, there am I with them."

ekegusii: ekiagera agwo ase ribero rire, na okweancha, agwo moroberio toiyo, korende kera ogokora okobe.
english: For where you have envy and selfish ambition, there you find disorder and every evil practice.

ekegusii: Ekiagera aase enibo yao ere, nao nenkoro yao ekoba.”
english: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

ekegusii: Ekiagera aase chinibo chiaino chire nao chinkoro chiaino chikoba.
english: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo inde oyo otometwe nsibire ebinyuri, inyore oboremu bw’ogokwana amang’ana buna ngwenerete gokwana.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains. Pray that I may declare it fearlessly, as I should.

ekegusii: Ase enchili eyio ngachandwa goika ngasibwa ne chingataare buna omokori amabe. Korende ring’ana ria Nyasae tirikobegeka chingataare.
english: for which I am suffering even to the point of being chained like a criminal. But God's word is not chained.

ekegusii: Naki intwe, abatore ase enyomba eye ere buna eema, nigo togwechanda, toritoerwa, tari ng’a igo torigetie korusigwa ase enyomba eye, korende ntorigetie okoboyigwa konde, erinde egekonyorekana namakweri kemerwe nobogima.
english: For while we are in this tent, we groan and are burdened, because we do not wish to be unclothed but to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling, so that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

ekegusii: Naki ning’o ore ase mwanyabanto omanyete ebirengererio bi’omonto, otatiga omoika bw’omonto ore ime yaye? Naboigo nonde tari omanyete ebirengererio bia Nyasae otatiga Omoika o Nyasae.
english: For who among men knows the thoughts of a man except the man's spirit within him? In the same way no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.

ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore agwo igoro oranyare koreng’anigwa n’Omonene? Nkereki ase ebitongwa bia Nyasae kenga buna ere?
english: For who in the skies above can compare with the LORD? Who is like the LORD among the heavenly beings?

ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore Nyasae, otatiga Omonene? Ning’o ore egetare, otatiga Nyasae oito?
english: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o ore omonene, noyoikaransete ase endagera, gose noyogokorera? Tari ere oyogoikaransa ase endagera? Korende inche nigo inde ase egati yaino buna omobakoreri.
english: For who is greater, the one who is at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who is at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete egento kere ekiya ase omonto, ekero amenyete amatuko amake ase obogima bore bosa, agoeta buna omorengari? Ning’o oranyare gotebia omonto amang’ana arabe korwa nyuma yaye aiga inse y’erioba?
english: For who knows what is good for a man in life, during the few and meaningless days he passes through like a shadow? Who can tell him what will happen under the sun after he is gone?

ekegusii: For who makes you different from anyone else? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?
english: Naki ning’o ogwatananire aye noyonde? Inki ore nakio otanyoreti buna ekeegwa? Onye gwakenyorire buna ekeegwa, inki rende ogwetogeria buna tikiarenge ekeegwa?

ekegusii: Ekiagera oyorakore ogwancha gwa Tata one ore igoro, oyio nere momura ominto, na mosubati ominto, na baba.”
english: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother."

ekegusii: na oyo okweimokereria igoro nairanigwe inse, na ere oyokweirania inse naimokererigwe igoro.
english: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

ekegusii: Omonto onyorire inche, oyio onyorire obogima; naende nancherwe n’Omonene.
english: For whoever finds me finds life and receives favor from the LORD.

ekegusii: ekiagera oyo otari mamincha yaito, oyio nensemo yaito are.
english: for whoever is not against us is for us.

ekegusii: Naki monto onde bwensi obwatete amachiko onsi, korende asarie erimo rioka, obeire omomochi ase onsi.
english: For whoever keeps the whole law and yet stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it.

ekegusii: Naki onde bwensi orarigie koegera obogima bwaye, oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho yane, na ase engencho y’enchili, oyio naboegere.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for me and for the gospel will save it.

ekegusii: Naki onde bwensi orarigie koegera obogima bwaye, oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho yane, oyio naboegere.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for me will find it.

ekegusii: Naki onde bwensi orarigie koegera obogima bwaye oyio nabosirie; na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho yane, oyio naboegere.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for me will save it.

ekegusii: Abakori amabe abare abang’ainereria nigo bagokwana igoro yane, ee, nigo bagokwana oborimo igoro yane.
english: for wicked and deceitful men have opened their mouths against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obuya kobua amagena akomeka‐meka aye rigori rinene, tibokoreng’anigwa nebinto bionsi bire ebiya biganeirie.
english: for wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire can compare with her.

ekegusii: na obong’aini mbosoe ase nekoro yao, ne chisemi nigo chiragokie omoyo oo.
english: For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

ekegusii: Omonene nanachere abanto ekina na kobaa egesusuro ki’ogosambwa nomorero na goitwa nemioro, na abwo baraitwe n’Omonene nigo barabe abange.
english: For with fire and with his sword the LORD will execute judgment upon all men, and many will be those slain by the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekiagera ase obong’aini obonge bore, nao omoichano omonge ore, na omonto okomenta chisemi, nigo akomenta obororo.
english: For with much wisdom comes much sorrow; the more knowledge, the more grief.

ekegusii: Naye ore ensoko y’obogima, na ase omobaso oo nigo tokorora omobaso.
english: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koria, gose konyora omogoko, onye tari amo n’Omonene?
english: for without him, who can eat or find enjoyment?

ekegusii: ekiagera inwe nabanto abachenu ase Omonene, Nyasae oino. Ere obachorire mobe abanto baye, mwaatananegete korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku binde bionsi bire ase ense.
english: for you are a people holy to the LORD your God. Out of all the peoples on the face of the earth, the LORD has chosen you to be his treasured possession.

ekegusii: ekiagera inwe nabanto mwatananetwe koba abachenu ase Omonene, Nyasae oino. Ere obachorire mobe abanto baye omonyene kobua abanto bande bonsi bare ase ense.”
english: For you are a people holy to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you out of all the peoples on the face of the earth to be his people, his treasured possession.

ekegusii: Aye naye ore omonene, nigo ogokora amakumia; aye naye bweka ore Nyasae.
english: For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.

ekegusii: ekero moranyore oboikeranu bw’okwegena kwaino, engencho yaye ogotooreka kw’emioyo yaino.
english: for you are receiving the goal of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ore obonene bwabo ne chinguru chiabo; ase engencho y’ogwancherwa kwao chingunchara chiaito chiakinire.
english: For you are their glory and strength, and by your favor you exalt our horn.

ekegusii: Naki inwe mwensi namonyare kobana oyomo ase oyomo, erinde bonsi banyare kweorokereria, na bonsi baremigwe.
english: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.

ekegusii: Naye gwatongete ebire ase enda yane ime, nigo kwambwatanetie amo ase enda ya baba.
english: For you created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother's womb.

ekegusii: Naki timwanyorete omoika oyo obakorire koba abasomba na korenta obwoba, korende nigo mwanyorete Omoika oyo obakorire koba abana ba Nyasae. Igo torera, “Abba!” Engencho yaye “Tata!”
english: For you did not receive a spirit that makes you a slave again to fear, but you received the Spirit of sonship. And by him we cry, "Abba, Father."

ekegusii: Naki inwe mwakure, na obogima bwaino nigo bobisire amo na Kristo ase Nyasae.
english: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

ekegusii: buna kwamoete okobua igoro ase mwanyabanto bonsi, erinde bonsi aba kwamoeire, abae obogima bwa kare na kare.
english: For you granted him authority over all people that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.

ekegusii: ekiagera mwaiboirwe eria kabere, tari ase embusuro egosareka, korende ase eyetari gosareka, goetera ase ring’ana ria Nyasae rinyene obogima, erikobao goika kare na kare.
english: For you have been born again, not of perishable seed, but of imperishable, through the living and enduring word of God.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, naye ogosemeria kwane, nabeire nkwegenete korwa obwana bwane.
english: For you have been my hope, O Sovereign LORD, my confidence since my youth.

ekegusii: Aye naye obotamero bwane, eburi enkong’u egonkengera korwa ase ababisa baane.
english: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.

ekegusii: Aye gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase amakweri, ee, gwatangire amagoro aane tagwa, erinde inyare gotaara ase obosio bwao, aye Nyasae, ase oborabu bw’abwo bare moyo.
english: For you have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae kwaigure chiira chiane narire ase ogotiana, abanto bairogete erieta riao kwabaeire omwando obo.
english: For you have heard my vows, O God; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

ekegusii: Naki mwaigwete amang’ana ’orogendo rwane ase amatuko aetire ase edini y’Abayahudi buna nachandete ekanisa ya Nyasae goetania ekerengo, na buna nateemete koyesaria.
english: For you have heard of my previous way of life in Judaism, how intensely I persecuted the church of God and tried to destroy it.

ekegusii: Naki engaki yaino eye yaetire yaisanire ase ogokora aya abanto b’Ebisaku banchete gokora. Igo mwagendererete ase obonyaka, na okogania okobe, na okonywa, na emeyega y’okoria bobe na gotinda, na mware gosasima emegwekano, ogosasima gotarenge okoronge.
english: For you have spent enough time in the past doing what pagans choose to do-- living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing and detestable idolatry.

ekegusii: Aye kwanachire ekina kiane ase oboronge; noikaransete ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kore omonachi ebina omoronge.
english: For you have upheld my right and my cause; you have sat on your throne, judging righteously.

ekegusii: Aye omonyene nomanyete ase enkoro yao ng’a ase chingaki chinyinge kwabeire gokoragereria abanto bande.
english: for you know in your heart that many times you yourself have cursed others.

ekegusii: Momanye ng’a nigo mwaboorigwe korwa ase orogendo rwaino rotagwenereti, orwo mwanyorete korwa ase chisokoro chiaino, tari ase ebinto bigosareka, buna chifeta gose chitahabu,
english: For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life handed down to you from your forefathers,

ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire buna tware gosemia kera oyomo oino buna ise agosemia abana baye, na tokabaremia, na kobasorora, na kobakurera,
english: For you know that we dealt with each of you as a father deals with his own children,

ekegusii: Naki mwamanyire obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo buna ekorete omotaka ase engencho yaino, nonya orenge omonda, erinde inwe monyare koba abanda ase obotaka bwaye.
english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, so that you through his poverty might become rich.

ekegusii: Naki inwe abanyene mwamanyire buya kegima, ng’a rituko ri’Omonene nigo rirache buna omoibi agocha botuko.
english: for you know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

ekegusii: Naki momanyete amachiko ki twabaete korwa ase Omonene Yeso.
english: For you know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ogokora kwao nigo kongogetie; ninchenge ase engencho y’emeremo y’amaboko ao.
english: For you make me glad by your deeds, O LORD; I sing for joy at the works of your hands.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, nigo kwabaatananete korwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi b’ense babe omwando oo, buna gwatebete goetera ase Musa, omosomba oo, ekero keria kwarusetie chisokoro chiaito korwa Misiri.”
english: For you singled them out from all the nations of the world to be your own inheritance, just as you declared through your servant Moses when you, O Sovereign LORD, brought our fathers out of Egypt."

ekegusii: Amaroro ayio onsi ay’obobani ebei re asemore buna amang’ana ’ebuku emumekeirie na kobekwa ekemanyererio. Ekero abanto bakoira ebuku eyio ase omonto omanyete gosoma, bamotebia: “Soma amang’ana ’ebuku eye,” ere nigo agokana oteba: “Tinkonyara, ekiagera amang’ana aya nigo abeire buna ay’ebuku emumekeire ebekire ekemanyererio.”
english: For you this whole vision is nothing but words sealed in a scroll. And if you give the scroll to someone who can read, and say to him, "Read this, please," he will answer, "I can't; it is sealed."

ekegusii: Inwe mwaimokirie chifeta ne chitahabu chiane, na mwairire ebinto biane ebiya bingwenerete gochia ase chihekalu chiaino.
english: For you took my silver and my gold and carried off my finest treasures to your temples.

ekegusii: Naki nigo mware buna ching’ondi chiasirire, korende bono mwairanire ase Omorisia na Omorendi bw’emioyo yaino.
english: For you were like sheep going astray, but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

ekegusii: Naki kare nigo mwarenge omosunte, korende bono mwabeire omobaso ase Omonene. Mogenderere buna abana b’omobaso
english: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light

ekegusii: Nonya namagena are mogondo, nobwatane naro, ne ching’iti chi’orosana nobe nomorembe nachirochio.
english: For you will have a covenant with the stones of the field, and the wild animals will be at peace with you.

ekegusii: ekiagera nobaserie batame, nobarenge emegwe ase amasio abo.
english: for you will make them turn their backs when you aim at them with drawn bow.

ekegusii: Bono gonka na moisaneke namabeere aye, monyore okoremigwa ase egekuba kiaye; ee, gonka mono na mogokere obonge bw’obonene bwaye!”
english: For you will nurse and be satisfied at her comforting breasts; you will drink deeply and delight in her overflowing abundance."

ekegusii: Aye norande gochia ensemo y’okorio na ey’okobee, na oroiboro rwao ndoire chinse chi’ebisaku na gokora emechie yasaretigwe emenywe naende.”
english: For you will spread out to the right and to the left; your descendants will dispossess nations and settle in their desolate cities.

ekegusii: “Ekiagera gwanchikeire amang’ana ’obororo, naende kwang’akanire amabe ’obosae bwane.
english: For you write down bitter things against me and make me inherit the sins of my youth.

ekegusii: Naki inwe abanyene momanyete buna ebagwenerete motwege; titwabete aboro ekero twarenge amo nainwe,
english: For you yourselves know how you ought to follow our example. We were not idle when we were with you,

ekegusii: Naki baminto, inwe nigo mwarenge ababwatani be chikanisa chia Nyasae ase Kristo Yeso, echire ase ense ya Boyahudi, ekiagera nigo mwanyorete emechando eria eria korwa ase abanto b’egesaku kiaino, buna baria banyorete korwa ase Abayahudi,
english: For you, brothers, became imitators of God's churches in Judea, which are in Christ Jesus: You suffered from your own countrymen the same things those churches suffered from the Jews,

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae gwatoteemire, ee, gwatoteemire buna efeta egoteemwa ase omorero.
english: For you, O God, tested us; you refined us like silver.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye ore omonene goetania ense yonsi, aye kwaimokererigwe igoro kobua chinyasae chionsi.
english: For you, O LORD, are the Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwarusirie omoyo one ase amakweri, gwatinyirie amariga korwa ase amaiso aane, kwarendire amagoro aane tingochiri ingwe.
english: For you, O LORD, have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling,

ekegusii: For your arrows have pierced me, and your hand has come down upon me.
english: Kwandasire emegwe yao yasoeire ime yane, kwanyiyeirie inse nokoboko kwao.

ekegusii: Amaboko aino abeire ayatachenegeti ase ogoitera amanyinga ’abanto, na ebiara biaino biabeire ebitachenegeti ase engencho y’obobe, Nigo mogokwana oborimo nebikoba biaino, ne chimeme chiaino chisokia aya atari ay’oboronge.
english: For your hands are stained with blood, your fingers with guilt. Your lips have spoken lies, and your tongue mutters wicked things.

ekegusii: Nigo ndigereretie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe na gotaara ase obwegenwa bwao.
english: for your love is ever before me, and I walk continually in your truth.

ekegusii: Omotongi oo nere omosacha oo, Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye. Ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nere Omobooria oo; nigo akorokwa Nyasae bw’ense engima.”
english: For your Maker is your husband-- the LORD Almighty is his name-- the Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer; he is called the God of all the earth.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’erieta riao; na ase engencho y’oboronge bwao rusia omoyo one korwa ase emechando.
english: For your name's sake, O LORD, preserve my life; in your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.

ekegusii: Risemi ri’enyomba yao riandire, emerumi y’abwo bakoramete nigo yangwerete.
english: for zeal for your house consumes me, and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.

ekegusii: Ase engencho ya Sayoni tinkonyara gokira, na ase engencho ya Yerusalemu tingotimoka, goika oboronge bwaye bororekane buna okobara kwe risase, na ogotooreka kwaye kororekane kore buna ekemore kegwoka.
english: For Zion's sake I will not keep silent, for Jerusalem's sake I will not remain quiet, till her righteousness shines out like the dawn, her salvation like a blazing torch.

ekegusii: Naki igo erikire, “Mwanyabanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi, na obonene bwabo nigo bonga buna ebisicha bire mogondo. Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo,
english: For, "All men are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers of the field; the grass withers and the flowers fall,

ekegusii: Ekiagera, “Onde bwensi orarangerie erieta ri’Omonene natoorigwe.”
english: for, "Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved."

ekegusii: “Naki ense ney’Omonene, amo na bionsi ebireo.”
english: for, "The earth is the Lord's, and everything in it."

ekegusii: Naki nigo erikire “Oyorigetie gwancha obogima na korora amatuko amaya, tiga atange oromeme rwaye tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biaye tibikwana obong’ainereria.
english: For, "Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech.

ekegusii: Naki abange nigo bakogenderera bare ababisa b’omosalaba o Kristo. Nabatebirie amang’ana abo ara aange, nonya mbono nigo nkobatebia aya ase amariga.
english: For, as I have often told you before and now say again even with tears, many live as enemies of the cross of Christ.

ekegusii: Ekero chindagera chiakoorire gosicha ne rigesa ritaraika, na amasabibu achakire kwama, Omonene nasose chinsagia nomoyio enkuro, na ebisebo bigokina abirusieo.
english: For, before the harvest, when the blossom is gone and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the shoots with pruning knives, and cut down and take away the spreading branches.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni bakoorire chinguru chiaye, na ere tamanyeti amang’ana ayio; chimbuche chiamerire ase omotwe oye, nere tamanyeti ayio.
english: Foreigners sap his strength, but he does not realize it. His hair is sprinkled with gray, but he does not notice.

ekegusii: Asidodi nomenywe nabanto batarochi inchera, na inche Omonene ninsirie kegima oboenenu bw’Abafilisti.
english: Foreigners will occupy Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

ekegusii: Forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
english: Otwabere ebibe biaito, Buna intwe tokobaabera abagotokorera bobe.

ekegusii: Otwabere ebibe biaito, ekiagera intwe tokwabera kera oyomo otokorire bobe. Totoira ase ogoteemwa, [Korende ototoorie korwa ase oria omobe.”]
english: Forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation. '"

ekegusii: (Ere agwo kare tarenge kogokonya kende, korende bono nigo aranyare gotokonya mono, aye nainche.)
english: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.

ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani, ekero motamomanyete Nyasae, inwe nigo mwarenge abasomba ase chinyasae chitare chinyasae bori.
english: Formerly, when you did not know God, you were slaves to those who by nature are not gods.

ekegusii: Ching’iti chinene inye chigatiira korwa ase enyancha ime; okororekana kwabo nigo kwarenge ao ao.
english: Four great beasts, each different from the others, came up out of the sea.

ekegusii: abanto chilifu inye (4,000) nababe abarendi b’ebiita na abanto chilifu inye (4,000) babe bagotogia Omonene nebinto ebio bikobugigwa naroisirie ase okomotogeria.”
english: Four thousand are to be gatekeepers and four thousand are to praise the LORD with the musical instruments I have provided for that purpose."

ekegusii: Bagatoma abanto asende chintunda inye, bagokwana amang’ana aria aria, na inche nkaba nkobairaneria amang’ana aria aria konya nabatebirie ritang’ani.
english: Four times they sent me the same message, and each time I gave them the same answer.

ekegusii: Korende nyuma y’emiaka ikomi na ene ngatiira naende kogenda Yerusalemu amo na Barnaba, nkairana Tito agende amo nainche.
english: Fourteen years later I went up again to Jerusalem, this time with Barnabas. I took Titus along also.

ekegusii: Oyokobuna riuga ri’omonto onde, nere eriaye naribunwe; oyogwata eriso ri’omonto onde, nere eriaye nariaatwe; oyokogookora omonto onde erino, nere eriaye ndigookorwe; oyoraremarie omonto onde, nere goika aremarigwe.
english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. As he has injured the other, so he is to be injured.

ekegusii: Indusie korwa ase oboreba bobisire bombwate, aye naye egekengero kiane.
english: Free me from the trap that is set for me, for you are my refuge.

ekegusii: minyoka buna engabi egotama erue ase omotwari, na buna enyoni egotama erue ase omotegi.
english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo akong’aina omogisangio oye; nonya noyomo tari gokwana ekeene, ekiagera banaririe chimeme chiabo gokwana oborimo. Nigo bagokwana oborimo goika berosirie ase ogokora amabe.
english: Friend deceives friend, and no one speaks the truth. They have taught their tongues to lie; they weary themselves with sinning.

ekegusii: 'Friend,' he asked, 'how did you get in here without wedding clothes?' The man was speechless.
english: Akamotebia: Mosani, naki gwakorete ogasoa aiga, na aye otari neanga y’enyangi? Agakira‐kiri.

ekegusii: Korwa Aroeri, omochie oria ore ase engegu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, goika Gileadi, amo nomochie ore ase rikura, omochie onde torenge ne chindwaki chinkong’u totanyarete gotagora. Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo abegete emechie yonsi ase amaboko aito.
english: From Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the gorge, even as far as Gilead, not one town was too strong for us. The LORD our God gave us all of them.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani.
english: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;

ekegusii: na korwa agwo bakairwa nemeeri ase enyancha, bagaika Antiokia. Agwo nao babekeretwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae ase emeremo eria banyarete goikerania.
english: From Attalia they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work they had now completed.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamin, Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni.
english: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;

ekegusii: Korwa ase Ababenjamin nigo arenge Eliada, omonto etuoni; ere nigo abwate abarwani chilifu amagana abere (200,000), babwate amata ne chinguba.
english: From Benjamin: Eliada, a valiant soldier, with 200,000 men armed with bows and shields;

ekegusii: Boigo bagasangererigwa korwa Beti-Giligali na korwa ase orogongo rwa Geba, na Asimaweti, ekiagera abateri abwo konya baagachire emechie yabo goetanana Yerusalemu.
english: from Beth Gilgal, and from the area of Geba and Azmaveth, for the singers had built villages for themselves around Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Nonya nkorwa ng’umbu ye chindooche chi’Etiopia abanto baane abwo bagonsasima, abwo basiareretwe, mbandetere ebing’wanso.
english: From beyond the rivers of Cush my worshipers, my scattered people, will bring me offerings.

ekegusii: Kwabeire gontenenerete korwa ekero ntaraiborwa, naye kwandusetie korwa ase enda ya baba. Naye ndabe nkona‐gotogia botambe.
english: From birth I have relied on you; you brought me forth from my mother's womb. I will ever praise you.

ekegusii: Nigo narutetwe asore korwa ase okoiborwa kwane, na korwa ekero narenge ase enda ya baba naye kwarenge Nyasae one.
english: From birth I was cast upon you; from my mother's womb you have been my God.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Dani, Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai.
english: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;

ekegusii: Ababani abwo bagotang’anerete aye na inche ase chingaki chia kare nigo babanete igoro y’esegi, na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita, ng’a mbichiche ase chinse chinyinge na ase amaruoti are ne chinguru.
english: From early times the prophets who preceded you and me have prophesied war, disaster and plague against many countries and great kingdoms.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi, Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli.
english: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;

ekegusii: Na korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakaegwa Taanaki na Gati‐Rimoni, emechie ebere, amo namarisio arengeo.
english: From half the tribe of Manasseh they received Taanach and Gath Rimmon, together with their pasturelands-- two towns.

ekegusii: Akabakora mokaigwa eriogi riaye riarwete igoro, erinde anyare koborokereria; na ase ense akaborokia omorero omonene, nainwe mokaigwa amang’ana aye korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero oria.
english: From heaven he made you hear his voice to discipline you. On earth he showed you his great fire, and you heard his words from out of the fire.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo arigereretie korwa igoro, oroche mwanyabanto bonsi.
english: From heaven the LORD looks down and sees all mankind;

ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro, nigo kwamanyetie ense ebina biao; na ense ekoboa egakira‐kiri,
english: From heaven you pronounced judgment, and the land feared and was quiet--

ekegusii: Kalebu agaseria abanto batato b’ororeria rw’Anaki korwa ase omochie oyio. Abaanaki abwo nabwo aba: Sesai, na Ahimani, na Talimai.
english: From Hebron Caleb drove out the three Anakites-- Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai-- descendants of Anak.

ekegusii: Asare ere omobere bwonsi onyare gokina ogokina kw’omobere na kweagacha omonyene ase obwanchani, korasang’ananigwe na kobwatanigwa ase ogokonywa gwa kera ekiimo koreng’ana nemeremo ya kera ensemo.
english: From him the whole body, joined and held together by every supporting ligament, grows and builds itself up in love, as each part does its work.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo ase aikaransete, nigo akobagambera bonsi abamenyete ase ense.
english: from his dwelling place he watches all who live on earth--

ekegusii: Ekero Yona arenge ime ase enda y’enswe eria, agasaba Omonene, Nyasae oye, agateba,
english: From inside the fish Jonah prayed to the LORD his God.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Netaneli, mosinto o Suari.
english: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;

ekegusii: Rigena ri’ekoona narinyorekane korwa ase abanto abwo. Boigo korwa asebare ekerochi ki’eema na obota bw’esegi mbinyorekane, naende kera omogambi nanyorekane korwa asebare.
english: From Judah will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu.
english: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;

ekegusii: Abanto bakarua Kibiroti‐Hatawa, bakagenda bagaika Haseroti, bakabeera aroro.
english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth and stayed there.

ekegusii: From Kish: the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.
english: Yerameeli nomwana omomura o Kisi.

ekegusii: Omwana o Mali n’Eleazari; ere tabwate abana abamura.
english: From Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

ekegusii: na korwa Matana bakagenda bagaika Nahalieli, na korwa agwo bakagenda bagaika Bamoti.
english: from Mattanah to Nahaliel, from Nahaliel to Bamoth,

ekegusii: Korwa Mileto Paulo agatoma abanto kogenda Efeso barangerie abagaaka b’ekanisa.
english: From Miletus, Paul sent to Ephesus for the elders of the church.

ekegusii: Akaira ense eria yonsi gochakera egetunwa kia Halaki agwo irianyi, kegotiirerwa gochia Seiri na goikera Baali‐Gadi agwo sugusu ase ebate ya Lebanoni, inse y’egetunwa kia Herimoni. Agoosa abaruoti bonsi b’agwo, akabaaka na kobaita.
english: from Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir, to Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all their kings and struck them down, putting them to death.

ekegusii: Korwa obwana bwane nabeire inde nemechando, nabeire ang’e nogokwa, ndemereretie okogosa kwao, tindi nogokonywa konde nonya nogoke.
english: From my youth I have been afflicted and close to death; I have suffered your terrors and am in despair.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Ahira, mosinto bw’Enani.”
english: from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan."

ekegusii: Korwa bono na kogenderera Abaisraeli bande tibabaisa goika ang’e n’Eema eria. Baise gokora bo, nigo barabe nebibe, erio bakwe.
english: From now on the Israelites must not go near the Tent of Meeting, or they will bear the consequences of their sin and will die.

ekegusii: Naki korwa bono ase enyomba nababe abanto batano baatananeke, batato ase babere, naende babere ase batato.
english: From now on there will be five in one family divided against each other, three against two and two against three.

ekegusii: Korwa ase omonto oyomo nere otongete kera egesaku kia mwanyabanto kemenye ase ense engima, akababekera chingaki ne chimbebe chi’obomenyo bwabo,
english: From one man he made every nation of men, that they should inhabit the whole earth; and he determined the times set for them and the exact places where they should live.

ekegusii: “Korwa omoyega bw’Omotienyi Omoyia goika oyo bw’Omotienyi onde Omoyia, na korwa Esabato goika Esabato ende, abanto bonsi mbache gosasima ase obosio bwane.
english: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come and bow down before me," says the LORD.

ekegusii: Korwa amatuko a kare ay’obwana bwaito, enyasae eria y’obosooku yasiririe emeremo eye chisokoro chiaito chiakorete; yasiririe chitugo chiabo, na abana babo, abamura na abaiseke.
english: From our youth shameful gods have consumed the fruits of our fathers' labor-- their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Erio Paulo na abamwabo bakamanora nemeeri korwa Pafo, bagaika Perga ase Pamfulia. Yohana akabatiga, akairana Yerusalemu,
english: From Paphos, Paul and his companions sailed to Perga in Pamphylia, where John left them to return to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: korende barabwo bakarua Perga, bakagenda Antiokia, omochie o Pisidia. Rituko ri’Esabato bagasoa ase esinagogi, bagaikaransa aroro.
english: From Perga they went on to Pisidian Antioch. On the Sabbath they entered the synagogue and sat down.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Simeoni, Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai.
english: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;

ekegusii: Ere nagotoorie korwa ase emechando etano nomo, ee, nonya nkorwa ase etano na ebere, na amabe tagokonyora.
english: From six calamities he will rescue you; in seven no harm will befall you.

ekegusii: Korwa Tapua rokagenderera gochia bosongo, rogaika akarooche ga Kana, naende rogaika Enyancha Enene ase rwatwomerete. Oro narwo orogongo chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Efraimu chianyorete, rokaba omwando obo,
english: From Tappuah the border went west to the Kanah Ravine and ended at the sea. This was the inheritance of the tribe of the Ephraimites, clan by clan.

ekegusii: Naende omoruoti Daudi akaira chitaai chinyinge mono korwa Bera na Berotai, emechie Hadadeseri arenge kogambera.
english: From Tebah and Berothai, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, King David took a great quantity of bronze.
