ekegusii: Naende akaira chitaai chinyinge korwa Tibati na Kuni, emechie ya Hadadeseri. Korwa ase chitaai echio Sulemani akaroiseria egetuba ekenene, ne chisiiro, na ebikorero binde bie chitaai.
english: From Tebah and Cun, towns that belonged to Hadadezer, David took a great quantity of bronze, which Solomon used to make the bronze Sea, the pillars and various bronze articles.

ekegusii: Ee, akamorusia korwa ase arenge gotunyana ching’ondi chiare ne chimanwa chikogonka, akamokora akaba omorisia bw’ororeria rwa Yakobo, abanto baye, nabwo Abaisraeli omwando oye.
english: from tending the sheep he brought him to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, of Israel his inheritance.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio na kogenderera botambe, Abaisraeli mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.
english: From that day forward the house of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.

ekegusii: Ekaba korwa ase engaki eyio na kogenderera ng’a ekeng’ese ki’abasomba baane bakagenderera koagacha, na ekeng’ese kende bakabeka chianga chi’ebioma, babogoretie amatimo, ne chinguba, na amata; na abatang’ani bagatenenera Abayuda bonsi,
english: From that day on, half of my men did the work, while the other half were equipped with spears, shields, bows and armor. The officers posted themselves behind all the people of Judah

ekegusii: Korwa rituko riria Saulo akaa Daudi ribaga komenya asare, gose tamotigete airane gochia nka o ise.
english: From that day Saul kept David with him and did not let him return to his father's house.

ekegusii: Akarua ase ense eria, akagenda goika Asuri, akaagacha Nineva, na Rehoboti‐Iri, na Kala,
english: From that land he went to Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah

ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio Yeso agachaka kworokereria aborokigwa baye ng’a nemogwenerete kogenda Yerusalemu, anyare gochandwa nabagaaka, na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, ase chinchera chinyinge, na goitwa; ase rituko ria gatato naboke.
english: From that time on Jesus began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.

ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio Yeso agachaka korandia, ogoteba, “Onchoka, ekiagera oboruoti bwa igoro bwaikire ang’e.”
english: From that time on Jesus began to preach, "Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is near."

ekegusii: Ase ebiombe bie chinderia chi’Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli:
english: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites and the Uzzielites:

ekegusii: Orusie omogati oyomo, ne rindasi erimo riroisirie namaguta, na omogati oyomo omoo, ebio bitabekiri memera, bire ase egetonga ime, bibekire ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: From the basket of bread made without yeast, which is before the LORD, take a loaf, and a cake made with oil, and a wafer.

ekegusii: korwa amanyinga ’Abeli goika amanyinga a Zakaria; oria oiteretwe gati y’egesasimero ne Hekalu. Ee, nabatebirie, narigigwe ase ekegori eke.
english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, this generation will be held responsible for it all.

ekegusii: Obota bwa Yonathani nigo bwaitete abanto abange, nigo bwaiterete amanyinga, bogaita abanto chituoni abarenge abanoru; naboigo omoro o Saulo torenge koirana bosa.”
english: From the blood of the slain, from the flesh of the mighty, the bow of Jonathan did not turn back, the sword of Saul did not return unsatisfied.

ekegusii: Korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, bakaroisia chianga chinseera chi’ogokorera emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu. Bakaroisia chianga chinchenu chia Haroni, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: From the blue, purple and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for ministering in the sanctuary. They also made sacred garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Korwa engaki omochie oyo oagachetwe goika rero iga, abanto baye babeire bakongechia na kogera endamwamu yane yoke. Bono goika nyosirie orue ase obosio bwane,
english: From the day it was built until now, this city has so aroused my anger and wrath that I must remove it from my sight.

ekegusii: Korwa amatuko a Yohana Omobatisi goika bono oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogosogwa ne chinguru, na abwo abanyanguru nigo bakobosoa ne chinguru.
english: From the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven has been forcefully advancing, and forceful men lay hold of it.

ekegusii: Korwa amatuko e chisokoro chiaito goika rero iga twabeire tore nokomocha okonene, na ase engencho y’ebibe biaito intwe, na abaruoti baito, twabeire tokobekwa ase amaboko ’abaruoti be chinse, na goitwa nemioro, na gwoswa, naende togasakorwa na twabeire tokonyora obosooku, buna ere goika rero iga.
english: From the days of our forefathers until now, our guilt has been great. Because of our sins, we and our kings and our priests have been subjected to the sword and captivity, to pillage and humiliation at the hand of foreign kings, as it is today.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’Aseri bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Asher: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: From the descendants of Bani: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
english: ab’eamate ya Bani: Maadai na Amuramu, Ueli

ekegusii: From the descendants of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal and Jeremoth.
english: ab’eamate ya Bani: Mesulamu na Maluku, Adaya na Yasubu, Seali na Yeremoti;

ekegusii: From the descendants of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai and Athlai.
english: ab’eamate ya Bebai; Yehohanani na Hanania, Sabai na Atilai;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamin bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Benjamin: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: Ab’ororeria rwa Benjamin nabwo aba: Salu, mosinto o Mesulamu, o Yoedi, o Pedaya, o Kolaya, o Maaseya, o Itieli, o Yesaia.
english: From the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah,

ekegusii: From the descendants of Binnui: Shimei,
english: ab’eamate ya Binui: Simei

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Dani bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Dan: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: From the descendants of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth and Elijah.
english: ab’eamate ya Elamu: Matania na Zakaria, Yehieli na Abidi, Yeremoti na Elija;

ekegusii: korwa ase eamate y’Elisafani: Semaya, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo amagana abere (200);
english: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the leader and 200 relatives;

ekegusii: Korwa ase chiamate chi’Elisafani; Simuri na Yeieli; na korwa ase chiamate chi’Asafu: Zakaria na Matania.
english: from the descendants of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; from the descendants of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Gadi bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Gad: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Gerisomu: Yoeli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na emerongo etato (130);
english: from the descendants of Gershon, Joel the leader and 130 relatives;

ekegusii: From the descendants of Harim: Eliezer, Ishijah, Malkijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
english: ab’eamate ya Harimu: Eliezeri na Isia, Malikia na Semaya, Simeoni

ekegusii: ab’eamate ya Harimu: Maaseya na Elija, Semaya na Yehieli, na Usia;
english: From the descendants of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel and Uzziah.

ekegusii: ab’eamate ya Hasumu; Matenai na Matata, Sabadi na Elifeleti, Yeremia na Manase, na Simei;
english: From the descendants of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh and Shimei.

ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Heburoni Elieli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo emerongo etano na etato (80);
english: from the descendants of Hebron, Eliel the leader and 80 relatives;

ekegusii: Na korwa ase chiamate chia Hemani: Yehieli na Simei; na korwa ase chiamate chia Yedutuni: Semaya na Usieli.
english: from the descendants of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; from the descendants of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

ekegusii: From the descendants of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
english: Ab’eamate ya Imeri: Hanani na Sebadia;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Isakaru bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Issachar: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Judah: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: Korwa ase eamate ya Kohati: Urieli, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere (120);
english: From the descendants of Kohath, Uriel the leader and 120 relatives;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Manase bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Manasseh: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Merari: Asaia, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo amagana abere, na emerongo ebere (220);
english: from the descendants of Merari, Asaiah the leader and 220 relatives;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Nafutali bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Naphtali: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: From the descendants of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel and Benaiah.
english: ab’eamate ya Nebo: Yeieli na Matitia, Sabadi na Sebina, Yadai na Yoeli, na Benaya.

ekegusii: ab’eamate ya Pahati‐Moabu: Adina na Kelali, Benaya na Maaseya, Matania na Besaleli, Binui na Manase;
english: From the descendants of Pahath-Moab: Adna, Kelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui and Manasseh.

ekegusii: ab’eamate ya Pasuri: Elioenai na Maaseya, Isumaeli na Netaneli, Yosabadi na Elasa.
english: From the descendants of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad and Elasah.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Reuben, omotangi o Israeli, bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Simeoni bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Simeon: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were counted and listed by name, one by one, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: korwa ase eamate ya Usieli: Aminadabu, omotang’ani obo, amo nabamwabo rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112).
english: from the descendants of Uzziel, Amminadab the leader and 112 relatives.

ekegusii: From the descendants of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad and Aziza.
english: ab’eamate ya Satu: Elioenai na Eliasibu, Matania na Yeremoti, Sabadi na Asisa;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Sabuloni bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the descendants of Zebulun: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: “Erio ngatoma abanto korwa ase erooro ya Kedemoti, bakagenda ase Sihoni, omoruoti o Hesiboni, nkamotomera amang’ana ’omorembe, ngateba:
english: From the desert of Kedemoth I sent messengers to Sihon king of Heshbon offering peace and saying,

ekegusii: Nindangerie ensoti eche korwa moocha, na omonto okorwa ense y’aare nache akore aya naroberetie. Aya nakwanire, goika nyaikeranie, na aya narobeirie, goika nyakore.
english: From the east I summon a bird of prey; from a far-off land, a man to fulfill my purpose. What I have said, that will I bring about; what I have planned, that will I do.

ekegusii: Ekero enkoro yane yarusirie moyo, nigo ngokorangeria korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Aye ondaae gochia egetare keria kere egetambe mono kombua.
english: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

ekegusii: Korwa chinsinyo chi’ense twaigure amatera ay’ogotogia obonene bw’Oyore Omonyene Oboronge. Korende nigo ngoteba, “Naki nachandekire! Naki nachandekire! Obobe nobwane! Abakorekanu nigo bagendererete gokorekania, ee, nigo bagendererete gokorekania mono.”
english: From the ends of the earth we hear singing: "Glory to the Righteous One." But I said, "I waste away, I waste away! Woe to me! The treacherous betray! With treachery the treacherous betray!"

ekegusii: Korwa ase eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe arusie ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, na ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime, amo ne chinyigo chionsi ibere na ebitinya bichitubete; na ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi abirue bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene.
english: From the fellowship offering he is to bring a sacrifice made to the LORD by fire: all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe arue ebitinya, na omokera bwonsi ayobutore kegima korwa ase riuga ri’omogongo, na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chionsi chi’enda, na ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete; na ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene.
english: From the fellowship offering he is to bring a sacrifice made to the LORD by fire: its fat, the entire fat tail cut off close to the backbone, all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa n’Abaisraeli narusirie ritaana rigosungusigwa amo nekenama kia borio, nabieire Haroni omokuani na abamura baye. Ebio nabio Abaisraeli barabe bakoa abakuani, bibe ebitari biabo botambe.
english: From the fellowship offerings of the Israelites, I have taken the breast that is waved and the thigh that is presented and have given them to Aaron the priest and his sons as their regular share from the Israelites.'"

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’abanto baria abatangi b’Abaisraeli, akanyora chibesa chie chisekeli elifu eyemo, na amagana atato, na emerongo etano nomo, na isano (1,365), koreng’ana ne chisekeli chigokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
english: From the firstborn of the Israelites he collected silver weighing 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

ekegusii: Emegwekano eyio y’abakerubi na ey’emekendo nigo yachabeire korwa inse goika ase egesieri igoro ase enyasi ye Hekalu ime.
english: From the floor to the area above the entrance, cherubim and palm trees were carved on the wall of the outer sanctuary.

ekegusii: Okwama kw’amang’ana omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya, korende okogania kw’abatari abegenwa nigo kore okw’obotindi.
english: From the fruit of his lips a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful have a craving for violence.

ekegusii: Okwama kw’amang’ana omonto agokwana nigo gokomorentera amaya akomoisanekia, na emeremo y’amaboko ’omonto nigo ekomoiranera.
english: From the fruit of his lips a man is filled with good things as surely as the work of his hands rewards him.

ekegusii: Omonto nigo agoisanekia enda yaye nogokwana kw’omonwa oye, akoigotigwa nokwama kw’omonwa oye.
english: From the fruit of his mouth a man's stomach is filled; with the harvest from his lips he is satisfied.

ekegusii: Na ase oboikeranu bwaye intwe twensi twanyorire obuya igoro ase obuya.
english: From the fullness of his grace we have all received one blessing after another.

ekegusii: Korwa enterekerero inse goika egetambokero kie ritang’ani ki’egesasimero ekenyene nigo kiarenge obotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere gochia igoro, na obogare gochia ime okoboko okomo; na korwa ase egetambokero keria egeke gochia ase ekere ekenene, nigo bwarenge obotambe bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ane, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo.
english: From the gutter on the ground up to the lower ledge it is two cubits high and a cubit wide, and from the smaller ledge up to the larger ledge it is four cubits high and a cubit wide.

ekegusii: Korwa igoro esegi ekarwana, ching’enang’eni chikarwania Sisera ekero chiare ase orogendo rwabo.
english: From the heavens the stars fought, from their courses they fought against Sisera.

ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaheburoni, Hasabia na abanto b’eamate yaye, elifu eyemo na amagana atano na abere (1,700), abanto abamanyete buya gokora emeremo yabo, bakabekwa ensemo ya bosongo ya Yorodan gotenenera Abaisraeli ase emeremo yonsi y’Omonene na ey’omoruoti.
english: From the Hebronites: Hashabiah and his relatives-- seventeen hundred able men-- were responsible in Israel west of the Jordan for all the work of the LORD and for the king's service.

ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera na rokaonchoka gochia irianyi, bosongo y’egetunwa keria kerochie Beti‐Horoni, rogaika Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), omochie bw’egesaku kia Yuda. Oro nigo rwarenge orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo.
english: From the hill facing Beth Horon on the south the boundary turned south along the western side and came out at Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim), a town of the people of Judah. This was the western side.

ekegusii: Korwa egetunwa igoro orobebe rogatirimboka gochia ensoko ya Nefitoa, na korwa agwo rogaikera emechie ang’e negetunwa gia Efuroni. Agwo rokaonchoka gochia Baala, (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu),
english: From the hilltop the boundary headed toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, came out at the towns of Mount Ephron and went down toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath Jearim).

ekegusii: “Erio Haroni aegwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli chigoree ibere chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
english: From the Israelite community he is to take two male goats for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese egiatungete omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, Musa agaatanana oyomo bw’abanto emerongo etano, na eyemo ye ching’iti emerongo etano, akaa Abalawi baria barenge gokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: From the Israelites' half, Moses selected one out of every fifty persons and animals, as the LORD commanded him, and gave them to the Levites, who were responsible for the care of the LORD's tabernacle.

ekegusii: Naende korwa ase ekeng’ese egetungetie omoganda bw’Abaisraeli bwatanane omonto oyomo bw’abanto emerongo etano, na eyemo ye chiombe emerongo etano, naboigo ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori. Abanto abwo amo ne ching’iti echio chionsi oe Abalawi abwo bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu bw’Omonene.”
english: From the Israelites' half, select one out of every fifty, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep, goats or other animals. Give them to the Levites, who are responsible for the care of the LORD's tabernacle."

ekegusii: Korwa ase Abaisari, Kenania na abamura baye bagachorwa gokora emeremo ya isiko buna abatang’ani b’emeremo ao ao, na abagambi ebina.
english: From the Izharites: Kenaniah and his sons were assigned duties away from the temple, as officials and judges over Israel.

ekegusii: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.
english: Selomoti bw’ororeria rwa Isari, na Yahati bw’ororeria rwa Selomoti.

ekegusii: From the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;
english: Abalawi nabwo aba: Semaya, mosinto o Hasubu, bw’Asirikamu, o Hasabia, o Buni.

ekegusii: Ase emenwa y’abana na ey’abakogonka nigo kweagacheire eburi bosio bw’ababisa bao, erinde okoiyeria inse ababisa bao na abakorusia egesiomba.
english: From the lips of children and infants you have ordained praise because of your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.

ekegusii: Ogotooreka nigo gokorwa asore aye Omonene; ase ayio, sesenia abanto bao.
english: From the LORD comes deliverance. May your blessing be on your people. Selah

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Negebu, akagenda agaika Beteli, agwo aase atenenetie eema yaye ritang’ani, gati ya Beteli na Ai,
english: From the Negev he went from place to place until he came to Bethel, to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had been earlier

ekegusii: From the priests: Jedaiah; the son of Joiarib; Jakin;
english: Abakuani nabwo aba: Yedaya, mosinto o Yoyaribu, na Yakini;

ekegusii: Ekeng’ese egetigari ki’omote oria nigo agokebaacha ogekora enyasae, omogwekano agosasima; nigo agotung’ama bosio bwaye oyosasima oteba, “Ntoorie, ekiagera naye enyasae yane!”
english: From the rest he makes a god, his idol; he bows down to it and worships. He prays to it and says, "Save me; you are my god."

ekegusii: Erieta ri’Omonene ribe rigotogigwa korwa ekero erioba rikooroka goika ekero rikogwa!
english: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the LORD is to be praised.

ekegusii: Korwa aiga ase ebitare igoro nimbaroche, na korwa aiga ase ebitunwa nimbarigereretie. Abwo nabanto bamenyete boka, beatananire korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku.
english: From the rocky peaks I see them, from the heights I view them. I see a people who live apart and do not consider themselves one of the nations.

ekegusii: Erio agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene, ekero abanto bonsi bategererete, Baruku agasoma amang’ana a Yeremia arikire ase ebuku eria abwate. Ayio nigo akorete ase eero ya Gema ria, mosinto o Safani omoriki. Eero eria nigo yarenge ase egoora ya rogoro agwo ase egesoero ki’Egeita Ekeyia ki’Omonene.
english: From the room of Gemariah son of Shaphan the secretary, which was in the upper courtyard at the entrance of the New Gate of the temple, Baruch read to all the people at the LORD's temple the words of Jeremiah from the scroll.

ekegusii: (Ense yonsi gochakera orooche rwa Sihori, moocha ya Misiri, goikera orobebe rw’Ekironi aria sugusu nigo ebarire ng’a ney’Abakanani. Abagambi batano b’Abafilisti nigo bamenyete Gasa, na Asidodi, na Asikeloni, na Gati, na Ekironi.) Naende nero ense y’Abaavi,
english: from the Shihor River on the east of Egypt to the territory of Ekron on the north, all of it counted as Canaanite (the territory of the five Philistine rulers in Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron-- that of the Avvites);

ekegusii: Oyo bw’abateri: Eliasibu, Abwo b’abarendi b’ebiita: Salumu, na Telemu, na Uri.
english: From the singers: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem and Uri.

ekegusii: Bono korwa chinsa isano nemo omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda.
english: From the sixth hour until the ninth hour darkness came over all the land.

ekegusii: Amagena ’embura amanene, ayare noborito koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etano, akagwera mwanyabanto korwa igoro, na mwanyabanto bakaragereria Nyasae ase engencho y’ogoakwa okwo kw’amagena ’embura ekiagera ogoakwa okwo nokonene mono kwarenge.
english: From the sky huge hailstones of about a hundred pounds each fell upon men. And they cursed God on account of the plague of hail, because the plague was so terrible.

ekegusii: Korwa ase ensemo eyetungetie abarwani orusie omonto oyomo korwa ase abanto amagana atano aboosetwe abe oyo bw’Omonene. Naboigo orusie eng’iti eyemo korwa ase ching’iti amagana atano ase chiombe, ne chitigere ne ching’ondi ne chimbori, chibe echi’Omonene.
english: From the soldiers who fought in the battle, set apart as tribute for the LORD one out of every five hundred, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep or goats.

ekegusii: Korwa egesanyi gi’okogoro inse goika omotwe igoro, aande tari are buya. Chingoma nchireo, na obobimbu, na amaote akorua amaira. Amaote ayio tasibiri na kobogwa, gose taakiri amaguta ororobe.
english: From the sole of your foot to the top of your head there is no soundness-- only wounds and welts and open sores, not cleansed or bandaged or soothed with oil.

ekegusii: Ase abana abamura b’Asafu nabwo aba: Sakuri na Yusufu, Netania na Asarela. Abamura aba bakaba inse y’oboraai bw’Asafu ise, oyorenge kobana inse y’oboraai bw’omoruoti.
english: From the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah and Asarelah. The sons of Asaph were under the supervision of Asaph, who prophesied under the king's supervision.

ekegusii: Korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu: ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, na ase egesaku kia Manase, Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri.
english: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, narwo orw’Efraimu, bakarikwa, omonto ase omonto, ase chiamate chiabo ne chinyomba chiabo. Abanto bonsi abasacha, aba konya bakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, abwo baare konyara korwana esegi,
english: From the sons of Joseph: From the descendants of Ephraim: All the men twenty years old or more who were able to serve in the army were listed by name, according to the records of their clans and families.

ekegusii: na gochia irianyi ense yonsi y’Abakanani, korwa Meara eyare kogamberwa n’Abasidoni, goika Afeki na goika orobebe rw’Abaamori;
english: from the south, all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah of the Sidonians as far as Aphek, the region of the Amorites,

ekegusii: Na korwa ase ekerogo keria ki’obonene bikaruao okomesa na okogukura, na ogoaka gw’enkoba. Bosio bw’ekerogo keria ki’obonene chitaya isano na ibere chiare gwoka, na chirochio nemeika etano na ebere ya Nyasae.
english: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder. Before the throne, seven lamps were blazing. These are the seven spirits of God.

ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio amobegete abe omoteneneri igoro y’enka yaye, na bionsi ebi abwate. Omonene agasesenia Omomisiri oria ase engencho ya Yusufu, na ogosesenia kw’Omonene gokaba ase ebinto bionsi abwate ase enyomba na emegondo.
english: From the time he put him in charge of his household and of all that he owned, the LORD blessed the household of the Egyptian because of Joseph. The blessing of the LORD was on everything Potiphar had, both in the house and in the field.

ekegusii: Ekero narusetie chisokoro chiaino korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nigo nachikurerete mono ng’a chinyigwere, nonya ngoika rituko ria rero ningendererete gochikurera.
english: From the time I brought your forefathers up from Egypt until today, I warned them again and again, saying, "Obey me."

ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria Amasia atigete Omonene, abanto ba Yerusalemu bagakora omoroberio bw’okomoita. Ere agatama gochia Lakisi, na abanto bagatomwa aroro, bakamoita.
english: From the time that Amaziah turned away from following the LORD, they conspired against him in Jerusalem and he fled to Lachish, but they sent men after him to Lachish and killed him there.

ekegusii: Korwa engaki eria chisokoro chiaino chiaruete ase ense ya Misiri goika rituko ria rero nabeire nkogenderera gotoma abasomba baane ababani asemore, rituko ase rituko.
english: From the time your forefathers left Egypt until now, day after day, again and again I sent you my servants the prophets.

ekegusii: ab’egesaku gi’Aseri chilifu ikomi na ibere, ab’egesaku kia Nafutali chilifu ikomi na ibere. Ab’egesaku kia Manase chilifu ikomi na ibere,
english: from the tribe of Asher 12,000, from the tribe of Naphtali 12,000, from the tribe of Manasseh 12,000,

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri bakaegwa Masali na Abidoni,
english: from the tribe of Asher they received Mashal, Abdon,

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri bakaegwa Misali, na Abidoni,
english: from the tribe of Asher, Mishal, Abdon,

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi’Aseri, Seturi, mosinto o Mikaeli;
english: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Benjamin, Paliti, mosinto o Rafu;
english: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Dani, Amieli, mosinto o Gemali;
english: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, Hosea, mosinto o Nuni;
english: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi, Geueli, mosinto o Maki.
english: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Maki.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Gadi bakaegwa Ramoti o Gileadi, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Mahanaimu,
english: from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Mahanaim,

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kedesi na Daberati,
english: from the tribe of Issachar they received Kedesh, Daberath,

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Igali, mosinto o Yusufu;
english: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru bakaegwa Kisioni, na Daberati,
english: from the tribe of Issachar, Kishion, Daberath,

ekegusii: Ab’egesaku kia Yuda nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na ibere ababekirwe ekemanyererio, ab’egesaku kia Reuben chilifu ikomi na ibere, ab’egesaku kia Gadi chilifu ikomi na ibere,
english: From the tribe of Judah 12,000 were sealed, from the tribe of Reuben 12,000, from the tribe of Gad 12,000,

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune;
english: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Yusufu (nakio ekia Manase), Gadi, mosinto o Susi;
english: from the tribe of Manasseh (a tribe of Joseph), Gaddi son of Susi;

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali bakaegwa Kedesi o Galili, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Hamoti‐Dori, na Karitani, emechie etato, amo namarisio arengeo.
english: from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Hammoth Dor and Kartan, together with their pasturelands-- three towns.

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Nabi, mosinto o Bofasi;
english: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;

ekegusii: Na ng’umbu ya Yorodan, ensemo ya moocha ya Yeriko, bakaegwa korwa ase egesaku kia Reuben: Beseri agwo aase aateremu, na Yahasi,
english: from the tribe of Reuben across the Jordan east of Jericho they received Bezer in the desert, Jahzah,

ekegusii: Na korwa ase egesaku kia Reuben bakaegwa Beseri, na Yahasi,
english: from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer, Jahaz,

ekegusii: from the tribe of Simeon 12,000, from the tribe of Levi 12,000, from the tribe of Issachar 12,000,
english: ab’egesaku gia Simeoni chilifu ikomi na ibere, ab’egesaku kia Lawi chilifu ikomi na ibere, ab’egesaku gia Isakaru chilifu ikomi na ibere,

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Simeoni, Safati, mosinto o Hora;
english: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;

ekegusii: from the tribe of Zebulun 12,000, from the tribe of Joseph 12,000, from the tribe of Benjamin 12,000.
english: ab’egesaku gia Sabuloni chilifu ikomi na ibere, ab’egesaku kia Yusufu chilifu ikomi na ibere, ab’egesaku kia Benjamin chilifu ikomi na ibere.

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Gadieli, mosinto o Sodi;
english: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simeoni bakarua emechie eyio egwatorwa aiga.
english: From the tribes of Judah and Simeon they allotted the following towns by name

ekegusii: Emechie eyio yatoire bakabayea korwa ase ebisaku bia Yuda, na Simeoni, na Benjamin ase okoyeakera obomera.
english: From the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin they allotted the previously named towns.

ekegusii: Abanto ba bosongo mbairoke erieta ri’Omonene, na aba moocha bairoke obonene bwaye. Ekero ababisa barachiche buna orooche rokominyoka, omwaga bw’Omonene nobaserie.
english: From the west, men will fear the name of the LORD, and from the rising of the sun, they will revere his glory. For he will come like a pent-up flood that the breath of the LORD drives along.

ekegusii: mbise korwa ase abakori amabe, abarigetie gonsiria, korwa ase ababisa bang’etanaine bang’ite.
english: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

ekegusii: Amaiso abo nigo akogirigenta nobonoru, obotantanu bw’ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo nobonge mono.
english: From their callous hearts comes iniquity; the evil conceits of their minds know no limits.

ekegusii: korende bakarua emechie yabo, bagacha agwo Gibea, erinde barwanie Abaisraeli.
english: From their towns they came together at Gibeah to fight against the Israelites.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nabatere amatera ay’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, mbaake amariogi ’omochengo. Nimbamentekanie babuche, na omobaro obo tokoba omoke. Ningere basikwe na tibakobarwa ng’a tibaisaini gento.
english: From them will come songs of thanksgiving and the sound of rejoicing. I will add to their numbers, and they will not be decreased; I will bring them honor, and they will not be disdained.

ekegusii: Korwa ekero ekio akaba nkorigia are ribaga ri’okomorua.
english: From then on Judas watched for an opportunity to hand him over.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo Pilato akarigia komosibora, korende Abayahudi bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Koramosibore, aye tori omosani o Kaisari; kera oyogwekora koba omoruoti nigo are mamincha ase Kaisari.”
english: From then on, Pilate tried to set Jesus free, but the Jews kept shouting, "If you let this man go, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who claims to be a king opposes Caesar."

ekegusii: Naende Daudi akarua agwo, akagenda Misipa o Moabu; agatebia omoruoti o Moabu, “Koranche oe tata na baba ribaga bache kobeera aa, goika imanye aya Nyasae arankorere.”
english: From there David went to Mizpah in Moab and said to the king of Moab, "Would you let my father and mother come and stay with you until I learn what God will do for me?"

ekegusii: Akarua aroro agwo, akagenda Beteli. Na ekero arenge ase orogendo rwaye, abana abamura abake bakarua ase omochie, bakamosekereria, bagaaka eriogi, bagateba, “Tiira gocha aa, aye nyaisio! Tiira gocha aa, aye nyaisio!”
english: From there Elisha went up to Bethel. As he was walking along the road, some youths came out of the town and jeered at him. "Go on up, you baldhead!" they said. "Go on up, you baldhead!"

ekegusii: Korwa agwo agatiira kogenda korwania abanto ba Debiri. (Kare omochie oyio nigo ore korokwa Kiriati‐Seferi).
english: From there he marched against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

ekegusii: Korwa aaria igoro nigo kegotengera ebi kegotwara, amaiso aye nigo akobirora korwa aare.
english: From there he seeks out his food; his eyes detect it from afar.

ekegusii: Erio akarua agwo, akagenda ebitunwa ebire ensemo ya moocha ya Beteli, agatenenia eema yaye aroro. Korwa aase agwo Beteli nigo orenge ensemo ya bosongo, na Ai ensemo ya moocha. Na agwo akaagachera Omonene egesasimero akarangeria erieta ri’Omonene.
english: From there he went on toward the hills east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: From there he went up to Beersheba.
english: Isaka akarua aroro, agatiira gochia Beeri‐Seba.

ekegusii: Erio Gidioni agatiga Sukoti, akagenda gochia Penueli na agwo akaboria abanto amang’ana aria aria, korende abanto ba Penueli bakamoiraneria buna abanto ba Sukoti bamoiraneretie.
english: From there he went up to Peniel and made the same request of them, but they answered as the men of Succoth had.

ekegusii: Na korwa aroro rokagenderera goika ebitirimboko bia Lusu (noro Beteli), rogatirimboka goika Ataroti Adari ase egetunwa kere, irianyi ya Beti‐Horoni maate.
english: From there it crossed to the south slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth Addar on the hill south of Lower Beth Horon.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo Abayuda bakagenda korwania abanto b’omochie o Debiri, oyio orenge korokwa Kiriati‐Seferi agwo ritang’ani.
english: From there they advanced against the people living in Debir (formerly called Kiriath Sepher).

ekegusii: Na korwa ase Arinoni bakagenderera norogendo rwabo, bagaika Beeri. Eyio nensoko eria aase Omonene atebetie Musa, “Sangereria abanto, na inche nimbae amache banywe.”
english: From there they continued on to Beer, the well where the LORD said to Moses, "Gather the people together and I will give them water."

ekegusii: Na korwa aroro bakagenda bagaika ase Rikura ria Seredi, bagatoora aroro.
english: From there they moved on and camped in the Zered Valley.

ekegusii: Bakarua aroro, bakagenda bagaika Gudigoda, naende bakarua Gudigoda, bakagenda bagaika Yotibata, ense yabwate ebirooche ebinge.
english: From there they traveled to Gudgodah and on to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.

ekegusii: Korwa aroro bakagenda gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, bagaika ase enyomba ya Mika.
english: From there they went on to the hill country of Ephraim and came to Micah's house.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo tokagenda ase enyancha, togakengana ase egesinka gekorokwa Kuporo, ekiagera chimbeo chiarenge korua bosio.
english: From there we put out to sea again and passed to the lee of Cyprus because the winds were against us.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo togaetanana, togaikera Regio. Nyuma ye rituko erimo embeo ya irianyi ekagusa; rituko ria kabere togaika Puteoli.
english: From there we set sail and arrived at Rhegium. The next day the south wind came up, and on the following day we reached Puteoli.

ekegusii: na korwa aroro togaika Filipi, omochie ore omonene ase ensemo ya Makedonia, ense yare kogamberwa n’Abarumi. Tokamenya ase omochie oyo amatuko amake.
english: From there we traveled to Philippi, a Roman colony and the leading city of that district of Macedonia. And we stayed there several days.

ekegusii: Korwa rituko ria rero, rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, ekero oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene bwabegetwe, na kogenderera, morengererie buna arabe!
english: 'From this day on, from this twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, give careful thought to the day when the foundation of the LORD's temple was laid. Give careful thought:

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio abange ase aborokigwa baye bakairana nyuma, tibamotunyana naende.
english: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.

ekegusii: Tokamanoria emeeri korwa Teroa, tokagenda boronge goika Samotraki. Rituko ria kabere togaika Neapoli,
english: From Troas we put out to sea and sailed straight for Samothrace, and the next day on to Neapolis.

ekegusii: Agaita Abafilisti, akaira ense yabo goikera Gasa na orogongo rw’aroro, akaira onsi, emerobiri y’okorenda amo nemechie yagiteire chindwaki.
english: From watchtower to fortified city, he defeated the Philistines, as far as Gaza and its territory.

ekegusii: Erio korwa ase ekeng’wanso ekio arue ebitinya bionsi ebire ase enda ime, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, na ebitinya bie riini abirusie amo ne chinyigo. Ebinto ebio bionsi abirue bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene.
english: From what he offers he is to make this offering to the LORD by fire: all the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

ekegusii: Moruere Omonene ebiegwa. Kera omonto oyore nomoyo bw’ogwancha aruere Omonene ebinto ebi: Etahabu, na efeta, na etaai;
english: From what you have, take an offering for the LORD. Everyone who is willing is to bring to the LORD an offering of gold, silver and bronze;

ekegusii: Korwa ase kera enka morente emegati ebere eroisirie korwa ase obosie obonuke ebimunu bine amo nememera erabe okoruegwa kw’endagera entang’ani y’okwama, kogosungusigwa ase Omonene.
english: From wherever you live, bring two loaves made of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with yeast, as a wave offering of firstfruits to the LORD.

ekegusii: ekiagera bonsi abakorwa ase Tata, abare igoro na abare ase ense, nigo bakorokwa ase erieta riaye.
english: from whom his whole family in heaven and on earth derives its name.

ekegusii: Nkorwa ase enda ya ng’o obokeng’entu bokorwa? Ning’o okoibora obokendu bokorwa igoro?
english: From whose womb comes the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the heavens

ekegusii: Korwa agwo aase abakure abare ne chinguru ase egati ye chituoni mbakwane igoro y’Abamisiri na abakonyi babo, batebe: Baria batarogeti baitirwe nemioro, bachiire inse aa korara.
english: From within the grave the mighty leaders will say of Egypt and her allies, 'They have come down and they lie with the uncircumcised, with those killed by the sword.'

ekegusii: Kera omwaka akaba okogenda goika Beteli, na Giligali, na Misipa, akaba okogambera Abaisraeli ebina ase emechie eyio yonsi.
english: From year to year he went on a circuit from Bethel to Gilgal to Mizpah, judging Israel in all those places.

ekegusii: Ekero inde ase omosangererekano omonene ningotogie. Chiira nariete ning’ikerane agwo ase obosio bw’abanto bamoirogete Omonene.
english: From you comes the theme of my praise in the great assembly; before those who fear you will I fulfill my vows.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo naruete asore, akaroberia amabe igoro y’Omonene, akarua ogosemia okobe kw’ogosiria.
english: From you, [O Nineveh,] has one come forth who plots evil against the LORD and counsels wickedness.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egesaku gia Sabuloni, Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni.
english: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;

ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni, omochie omoikeranu bw’oboseera, Nyasae omorekire korwao.
english: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.

ekegusii: Ase chingegu chi’orooche orwo chinsemo chionsi ibere emete y’ebisaku ao ao ekwama amatunda akoriegwa nemereo. Amato ’emete eyio tagosusana, gose emete eyio tekomocha kwama amatunda. Kera omotienyi nigo erame amatunda amayia, ekiagera amache agocha ase emete eyio nigo arabe akorua ase Hekalu. Ase ayio amatunda ’emete eyio nabe endagera, na amato abo nabe eriogo rikogwenia abanto.”
english: Fruit trees of all kinds will grow on both banks of the river. Their leaves will not wither, nor will their fruit fail. Every month they will bear, because the water from the sanctuary flows to them. Their fruit will serve for food and their leaves for healing."

ekegusii: Ikerania asende, inche omosomba oo, eira kwandierete, eira eyio okoa abakoirogete.
english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, so that you may be feared.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Nebukadinesaro akaba nekeririanda egetindi, agachika ng’a Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, barentwe asare, na abamura baria batato bakarentwa ase obosio bwaye.
english: Furious with rage, Nebuchadnezzar summoned Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego. So these men were brought before the king,

ekegusii: Abayahudi amo nabatang’ani babo abarenge koragera amo nainche nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Naende abanto b’ebisaku binde abamenyete ase chinsemo chiaito chionsi nigo barenge gocha baragera amo nainche.
english: Furthermore, a hundred and fifty Jews and officials ate at my table, as well as those who came to us from the surrounding nations.

ekegusii: Korende Ahikamu, mosinto o Safani, akarenda Yeremia tabekwa ase amaboko ’abanto bamoite.
english: Furthermore, Ahikam son of Shaphan supported Jeremiah, and so he was not handed over to the people to be put to death.

ekegusii: Abakuani bonsi baria barenge abatang’ani babo, na abanto boigo bagasaria mono, tibaba abegenwa, bakabwatia okogechia gwonsi kw’abanto b’ebisaku, na enyomba y’Omonene eyio akorete ekaba enchenu agwo Yerusalemu, bakayekora ekaba eyetachenegeti.
english: Furthermore, all the leaders of the priests and the people became more and more unfaithful, following all the detestable practices of the nations and defiling the temple of the LORD, which he had consecrated in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mokagete ng’a inche nigo nachire korwania ense eye na koyesaria Omonene atancheti? Taibo; Omonene nere ontebia: Genda orwanie ense eria oyesarie!”
english: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this land without the LORD? The LORD himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.'"

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo okagete ng’a inche nigo nachire korwania aase aiga na koasaria Omonene atancheti? Taibo. Omonene nere ontebia: Genda orwanie ense eria, oyesarie!”
english: Furthermore, have I come to attack and destroy this place without word from the LORD? The LORD himself told me to march against this country and destroy it.'"

ekegusii: Boigo nachikire ng’a, monto onde bwensi oraonchore ring’ana eri, omwamba osomorwe korwa ase enyomba yaye, na ere omonyene atongwe ase oro, na enyomba yaye ekorwe ebe etui y’eubi.
english: Furthermore, I decree that if anyone changes this edict, a beam is to be pulled from his house and he is to be lifted up and impaled on it. And for this crime his house is to be made a pile of rubble.

ekegusii: Boigo Yosia akarusia abanto bonsi barenge koboria ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, na abarogi, na ebinyasae, na emegwekano ende y’ogosasimwa, na okogechia gwonsi kwarorekanete ase ense y’Abayuda na ase Yerusalemu. Nigo akorete ayio, erinde akore amang’ana onsi ay’amachiko aria arikire ase ebuku eria Hilikia omokuani anyorete agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Furthermore, Josiah got rid of the mediums and spiritists, the household gods, the idols and all the other detestable things seen in Judah and Jerusalem. This he did to fulfill the requirements of the law written in the book that Hilkiah the priest had discovered in the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekiagera batabarete ng’a ngento komomanya Nyasae, Nyasae akabatiga ase ebirengererio bie chingencho chiabo chimbe, bakore ayatagwenereti.
english: Furthermore, since they did not think it worthwhile to retain the knowledge of God, he gave them over to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti, manya ng’a onye omochie oyo okoagachwa naende, ne chindwaki chiere koagachwa, rirorio abanto aba tibakorua ebango, gose echogo y’ebinto babwate, gose ebango ye chinchera, na ebitoki bi’omoruoti nigo birakee.
english: Furthermore, the king should know that if this city is built and its walls are restored, no more taxes, tribute or duty will be paid, and the royal revenues will suffer.

ekegusii: Naende ning’o ngwenerete nkorere? Tengwenereti nkorere aye, omwana oye? Ee, buna narenge gokorera iso, naboigo naye ndagokorere.”
english: Furthermore, whom should I serve? Should I not serve the son? Just as I served your father, so I will serve you."

ekegusii: Gayo, oyokondoisia inche na ekanisa engima, obakwanirie. Erasto, omogachi bwe chibesa, chi’omochie, na Kwarito oyominto, babakwanirie.
english: Gaius, whose hospitality I and the whole church here enjoy, sends you his greetings. Erastus, who is the city's director of public works, and our brother Quartus send you their greetings.

ekegusii: Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri, nere orenge omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku kia Manase.
english: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,

ekegusii: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
english: na Gati, na Maresa, na Sifu,

ekegusii: Mosangererie ebisakorwa bi’omochie oyio, mobibeke bibe etui agwo ase eraaro aarabu, erio mosambe nomorero omochie amo nebisakorwa bionsi, bibe ekeng’wanso ekegima ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, Nyasae oino. Noro obe ritombe goika kare na kare, tokoagachwa naende.
english: Gather all the plunder of the town into the middle of the public square and completely burn the town and all its plunder as a whole burnt offering to the LORD your God. It is to remain a ruin forever, never to be rebuilt.

ekegusii: Sangereria abanto amo, ochene omosangererekano oyio; sangereria abagaaka, sangereria nabana, nonya nabakogonka. Tiga omonyuomi asoke korwa mwaye, na omoriakari korwa eero mwaye.
english: Gather the people, consecrate the assembly; bring together the elders, gather the children, those nursing at the breast. Let the bridegroom leave his room and the bride her chamber.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’egesaku getari korora obosooku, esangererie inwe abanyene, mweborie,
english: Gather together, gather together, O shameful nation,

ekegusii: Inwe abwo mwaetananirwe nababisa, sangereria ebinto biaino morue aase agwo.
english: Gather up your belongings to leave the land, you who live under siege.

ekegusii: Omochie o Gasa nong’anyigwe, na oyo bw’Asikeloni notigwe ore bosa; abanto b’Asidodi nabaserigwe, na omochie bw’Ekironi notagorwe.
english: Gaza will be abandoned and Ashkelon left in ruins. At midday Ashdod will be emptied and Ekron uprooted.

ekegusii: Gasa yatigaire bosa, Asikeloni osirire kegima. Inwe abatigari ase rikura riria, ngoika ririri moragenderere gwekeba?
english: Gaza will shave her head in mourning; Ashkelon will be silenced. O remnant on the plain, how long will you cut yourselves?

ekegusii: Gasamu, na Usa, na Pasea;
english: Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah,

ekegusii: Gebal, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.
english: Abagebali, na Abaamoni, na Abaamaleki; Abafilisti amo nabamenyete Turo.

ekegusii: Geberi, mosinto bwa Uri, agatenenera ense ya Gileadi yarenge kogamberwa na Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omoruoti o Basani. Nigo arenge omoteneneri oyomo bweka ase ense eyio yonsi.
english: Geber son of Uri-- in Gilead (the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and the country of Og king of Bashan). He was the only governor over the district.

ekegusii: Gedalia mosinto bw’Ahikamu, mochokoro o Safani, akariera abachiki baria amo nabanto babo eira na gotiana, akabatebia, “Timobaisa kwoboa gokorera Abakalidayo mobeere ase ense eye, mobe mokomokorera omoruoti o Babeli, nainwe namomenye buya motari na bokong’u.
english: Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, took an oath to reassure them and their men. "Do not be afraid to serve the Babylonians," he said. "Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you.

ekegusii: Gedalia agatiana ase abateneneri baria amo nabanto akabatebia, “Timoiroka ase engencho y’abatang’ani b’Abakalidayo; menya ase ense eye, mokorere omoruoti o Babeli, na amang’ana nabo arabe amaya asemore.”
english: Gedaliah took an oath to reassure them and their men. "Do not be afraid of the Babylonian officials," he said. "Settle down in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you."

ekegusii: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah and Makkedah-- sixteen towns and their villages.
english: na Gederoti, na Beti‐Dagoni, na Naama, na Makeda, emechie ikomi, na etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah and Mikloth.
english: Gedori na Ahiyo, Zakaria na Mikiloti.

ekegusii: Gedor, Ahio, Zeker
english: Gedori na Ahiyo, na Sekeri,

ekegusii: Gehasi agatang’ana akagenda bosio, akabeka enyimbo eria igoro ase obosio bw’omwana oria, korende nonya neriogi gose ekemanyererio kende tikiarengeo ng’a omwana nabe moyo. Ase ayio akairana, akaumerana n’Elisha, akamotebia, “Omwana tacheti moyo.”
english: Gehazi went on ahead and laid the staff on the boy's face, but there was no sound or response. So Gehazi went back to meet Elisha and told him, "The boy has not awakened."

ekegusii: Gehasi, omosomba bw’Elisha omonto oria o Nyasae, agateba, “Rigereria, omonene one otigire Naamani, Omosiiria oria, ogendire, na tancheti koegwa egento ase ebio arentire. Ekeene buna Omonene are moyo, inche iminyoke imobwatie, inyore egento korwa asare.”
english: Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said to himself, "My master was too easy on Naaman, this Aramean, by not accepting from him what he brought. As surely as the LORD lives, I will run after him and get something from him."

ekegusii: Ekegori ekemo nigo kegoeta, na ekende giacha, korende ense nigo egendererete kobao.
english: Generations come and generations go, but the earth remains forever.

ekegusii: oboitongo, okwerita ase onsi; machiko ande tari arange amang’ana buna ayio.
english: gentleness and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

ekegusii: Gera, Shephuphan and Huram.
english: Gera na Sefufani, na Huramu.

ekegusii: Ira Haroni na Eleazari, momura oye, igoro ase egetunwa kia Hori.
english: Get Aaron and his son Eleazar and take them up Mount Hor.

ekegusii: Obororo bwonsi, na endamwamu, na okobea, na eriomana, na emerumi birusigwe asemore, amo nobobe bwonsi.
english: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, brawling and slander, along with every form of malice.

ekegusii: Rusia kegima ememera eria ya kare, erinde mobe ribomba riyia, buna more motabekiri memera. Naki Emanwa yaito y’Eng’ondi y’Epasaka yaikire koruegwa ekeng’wanso, nere Kristo.
english: Get rid of the old yeast that you may be a new batch without yeast-- as you really are. For Christ, our Passover lamb, has been sacrificed.

ekegusii: Renta chieri ibere motoe. Tiga ababani abwo bechorere eeri eyemo, bayenachane ebitari, babibeke igoro ase chinko, korende tibabaisa gouta omorero aroro. Inche omonyene nindoisie eeri eyio ende, inyebeke igoro ase chinko, korende ting’uta omorero.
english: Get two bulls for us. Let them choose one for themselves, and let them cut it into pieces and put it on the wood but not set fire to it. I will prepare the other bull and put it on the wood but not set fire to it.

ekegusii: Inwe imoka morue aa, ekiagera aase aino mogotimokera tari aa. Ase engencho y’ogotacheneka kwaino aase aa nasarigwe nogosaria okonene.
english: Get up, go away! For this is not your resting place, because it is defiled, it is ruined, beyond all remedy.

ekegusii: Enyorere obong’aini na okomanya, tobaisa kobieba! Tibwanga koigwera amang’ana ngokwana korwa ase omonwa one.
english: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or swerve from them.

ekegusii: Egiloni akabwatana n’Abaamori na Abaameleki; barabwo bakarwania Abaisraeli, bakababua, bakaira Omochie bw’Emekendo.
english: Getting the Ammonites and Amalekites to join him, Eglon came and attacked Israel, and they took possession of the City of Palms.

ekegusii: Naende yarenge Gibeoni, na Rama, na Beroti,
english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

ekegusii: Giddel, Gahar, Reaiah,
english: Gideli, na Gahari, na Reaya:

ekegusii: Bono Gidioni amo nabanto baye amagana atato bagacha Yorodan, bakaamboka. Nonya konya bagoyire, bakagenderera kobwatia ababisa babo.
english: Gideon and his three hundred men, exhausted yet keeping up the pursuit, came to the Jordan and crossed it.

ekegusii: Bono Gidioni na abanto baria rigana erimo barenge amo nere bagaika ensinyo y’egetwori ki’Abamidiani ase engaki abarendi ba botuko gati bachagete korenda. Erio bakabugia ebitureri biria na bagaata ebiguuru biria babwate ase amaboko abo.
english: Gideon and the hundred men with him reached the edge of the camp at the beginning of the middle watch, just after they had changed the guard. They blew their trumpets and broke the jars that were in their hands.

ekegusii: Ekero Gidioni aigeteo, akaigwa omonto oyomo ogotebia omogisangio oye buna arotire, ogoteba, “Nigo narota okorota, narora omogati bw’esairi ogoturunkana gocha aiga ase egetwori giaito, oaka eema, oyeonchorana, oyeiyeria inse.”
english: Gideon arrived just as a man was telling a friend his dream. "I had a dream," he was saying. "A round loaf of barley bread came tumbling into the Midianite camp. It struck the tent with such force that the tent overturned and collapsed."

ekegusii: Gidioni akaroisia egesibao ki’obokuani korwa ase chitahabu chiria, agakebeka ase omochie oye Ofura; na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiga koba abegenwa ase Omonene, bagasasima egesibao keria. Kerokio gekaba kegotega Gidioni amo neamate yaye.
english: Gideon made the gold into an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his town. All Israel prostituted themselves by worshiping it there, and it became a snare to Gideon and his family.

ekegusii: Gidioni akamotebia, “Omonene, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa asore, inyorokie ekemanyererio ng’a aye naye ogokwana nainche.
english: Gideon replied, "If now I have found favor in your eyes, give me a sign that it is really you talking to me.

ekegusii: Gidioni akabatebia, “Baria nigo barenge bamura baminto, abamura ba baba. Amaene, buna Omonene are moyo, onye mwabatigete babe moyo, inche nanga tinabaita inwe!”
english: Gideon replied, "Those were my brothers, the sons of my own mother. As surely as the LORD lives, if you had spared their lives, I would not kill you."

ekegusii: Gidioni agatebia Nyasae, “Aye gwatebire ng’a norigetie gotooria Abaisraeli goetera ase okoboko kwane. Onye naboigo,
english: Gideon said to God, "If you will save Israel by my hand as you have promised--

ekegusii: Gidioni agatoma abanto ase ense yonsi y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu batebe, “Tirimboka gochia maate, morwanie Abamidiani; mobwate ebiambokero bie chindooche goikera Beti‐Bara, amo nebia Yorodan.” Ase igo abanto b’Efraimu bagasangererigwa amo, bakabwata ebiambokero goikera Beti‐Bara, na ebia Yorodan boigo.
english: Gideon sent messengers throughout the hill country of Ephraim, saying, "Come down against the Midianites and seize the waters of the Jordan ahead of them as far as Beth Barah." So all the men of Ephraim were called out and they took the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth Barah.

ekegusii: Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, agakwa ore nobogotu obuya, agatindekwa ase embeera ya Yoashi ise yarenge agwo Ofura, omochie bw’egesaku ki’Abieseri.
english: Gideon son of Joash died at a good old age and was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

ekegusii: Ekero Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, airanete korwa ase esegi agaetera ebitirimboko bia Heresi,
english: Gideon son of Joash then returned from the battle by the Pass of Heres.

ekegusii: Erio Gidioni akagenda nyomba mwaye, akanyenya emanwa y’embori, akayeroisia; naende korwa ase obosie bw’ekerengo ki’ebimunu bibere akaroisia emegati etabekiri memera. Akabeka chinyama ase egetonga, na omosori akayoumora ase enyongo, akairera omomalaika oria orenge inse y’omote onga buna omotontera endagera eyio.
english: Gideon went in, prepared a young goat, and from an ephah of flour he made bread without yeast. Putting the meat in a basket and its broth in a pot, he brought them out and offered them to him under the oak.

ekegusii: Gidioni agatiirera enchera abagendi banarete goeta, moocha ya Noba na Yogibea, akaumokera omoganda bw’abarwani ekero orenge nobotoereru.
english: Gideon went up by the route of the nomads east of Nobah and Jogbehah and fell upon the unsuspecting army.

ekegusii: Omochie o Gileadi nigo oichire nabanto abakori amabe, chimbaratero chiabo nigo chiichire amanyinga.
english: Gilead is a city of wicked men, stained with footprints of blood.

ekegusii: Gileadi neyane, na Manase neyane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogambi.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my scepter.

ekegusii: Gileadi neyane, na Manase neyane; Efraimu nekegogwa kiane gi’ekioma, na Yuda nenyimbo yane y’obogambi.
english: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my scepter.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Gileadi, moocha ya Yorodan, mbaikaranseteo. Na abanto b’egesaku kia Dani, nase ki babeerete ase chimeeri chiabo? Abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri bagaikaransa enyancha mbarabare, bagakira‐kiri, bakabeera ase emesomo yabo.
english: Gilead stayed beyond the Jordan. And Dan, why did he linger by the ships? Asher remained on the coast and stayed in his coves.

ekegusii: Omokungu omonyuome o Gileadi nere boigo akamoiborera abana abamura, na ekero barabwo babete abanto abanene bagaseria Yefta korwa inka, bakamotebia, “Aye tokonyara konyora omwando ase enyomba ya tata, ekiagera nigo ore omwana bw’omokungu omoao.”
english: Gilead's wife also bore him sons, and when they were grown up, they drove Jephthah away. "You are not going to get any inheritance in our family," they said, "because you are the son of another woman."

ekegusii: Aye omobui, eboeranie omoyio o birende ase ekenema kiao, aye nigo ore nobonene na ogosikwa okonene.
english: Gird your sword upon your side, O mighty one; clothe yourself with splendor and majesty.

ekegusii: Gaki, origererie orore ng’a chitugo chiao chiarenterwe inka, naboigo na kende kiao gionsi kere isiko. Onye abanto bonsi abare isiko tibakorentwa ase chinyomba ime, embura y’amagena nebaite bakwe, ne chitugo chionsi boigo.”
english: Give an order now to bring your livestock and everything you have in the field to a place of shelter, because the hail will fall on every man and animal that has not been brought in and is still out in the field, and they will die.'"

ekegusii: Mokorere buna ere abakorerete inwe, moakane ara kabere koreng’ana nogokora kwaye. Ase ekenyugwa ekio ere abasang’ananeirie, mosang’anerie na ere ara kabere.
english: Give back to her as she has given; pay her back double for what she has done. Mix her a double portion from her own cup.

ekegusii: Bono rituko ria rero bairanerie ebio bionsi baboreretigwe baakane: amaremo abo, na emegondo y’emesabibu na ey’emezeituni, ne chinyomba amo nebitoki bie chibesa mwabeire mokoboria.”
english: Give back to them immediately their fields, vineyards, olive groves and houses, and also the usury you are charging them-- the hundredth part of the money, grain, new wine and oil."

ekegusii: Oyo ogochia gosira moe ekenyugwa kegotindia, na edivai ase oyo oichanete ase omoyo oye.
english: Give beer to those who are perishing, wine to those who are in anguish;

ekegusii: “Tegerera moigwe, erio moche asende. Igwa! Erio nario moranyare koba moyo. Ninkore nainwe okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwa kare na kare, naende nimbaorokerie obwanchani bwane bwa botambe obo narierete Daudi eira.
english: Give ear and come to me; hear me, that your soul may live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, my faithful love promised to David.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, tegerera oigwe, rigereria orore ogosirigwa gwaito, na omochie oyo okorokwa ase erieta riao. Intwe titori korenta ogosaba gwaito asore ng’a nabanyaboronge tore, korende nase engencho y’amabera ao amange.
english: Give ear, O God, and hear; open your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears your Name. We do not make requests of you because we are righteous, but because of your great mercy.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe! Aye Omonene, rigereria orore! Oigwe amang’ana onsi a Senakeribu, aya atomire ase ogokorama aye Nyasae ore moyo.
english: Give ear, O LORD, and hear; open your eyes, O LORD, and see; listen to all the words Sennacherib has sent to insult the living God.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tegerera oigwe! Aye Omonene, rigereria orore! Oigwe amang’ana a Senakeribu, aya atomire ase ogokorama aye Nyasae ore moyo.
english: Give ear, O LORD, and hear; open your eyes, O LORD, and see; listen to the words Sennacherib has sent to insult the living God.

ekegusii: Bae bonsi ebia boronge biabo: omonto bw’ebango, ebango; na omonto bw’ogochoga, ogochoga; oyogwenerete koirokwa, tiga airokwe; na oyogwenerete gosikwa, tiga asikwe.
english: Give everyone what you owe him: If you owe taxes, pay taxes; if revenue, then revenue; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

ekegusii: Momoe ebinto ase ogwancha, na timoba ne ribero ekero mokomoa. Ekero morarue igo, Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabasesenie ase emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora.
english: Give generously to him and do so without a grudging heart; then because of this the LORD your God will bless you in all your work and in everything you put your hand to.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, Nyasae oino, ritang’ani atararenta omosunte nainwe mogochwe amagoro, ekero rikogoroba ase ebitunwa. Ase engaki eria morabe mosemeretie konyora oborabu, naonchore oborabu obwo bobe obomwamu na abokore bobe omosunte omonene.
english: Give glory to the LORD your God before he brings the darkness, before your feet stumble on the darkening hills. You hope for light, but he will turn it to thick darkness and change it to deep gloom.

ekegusii: Na buna ere etogirie na kwegokia atari gwetanga ase okorigia kwaye, moe obororo na ogoichana koreng’ana boigo. Nigo agoteba ase enkoro yaye ime: Inche ning’ikaransete eting’ana, tindi omoboraka, gose tinkoba nomoichano nonya ng’ake!
english: Give her as much torture and grief as the glory and luxury she gave herself. In her heart she boasts, 'I sit as queen; I am not a widow, and I will never mourn.'

ekegusii: Kae omokungu oyio okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko aye, na tiga atogigwe agwo ase ebiita ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
english: Give her the reward she has earned, and let her works bring her praise at the city gate.

ekegusii: Give him some of your authority so the whole Israelite community will obey him.
english: Omoe okobua buna okwao, erio nario omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli oramoigwere.

ekegusii: Orente eng’ombe eria, oyee Eleazari omokuani; na eng’ombe eria eirwe isiko y’egetwori, erio enyenyerweo ase obosio bwaye.
english: Give it to Eleazar the priest; it is to be taken outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.

ekegusii: Inyorokie ekemanyererio ki’obuya bwao, erinde abanto bangechete bakerore na gosookigwa, ekiagera aye Omonene gwankonyire na kondemia.
english: Give me a sign of your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.

ekegusii: Ing’a abakungu baane na abana baane, aba nabeire nkogokorera, ontige ngende seito; naki nomanyete obokoreri nabeire nkogokorera.”
english: Give me my wives and children, for whom I have served you, and I will be on my way. You know how much work I've done for you."

ekegusii: Imanyie amachiko ao, erinde inyabwate na koyarenda nenkoro yane yonsi.
english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law and obey it with all my heart.

ekegusii: Bono ing’a obong’aini ne chisemi imanye koraa na gotang’ana abanto aba, ekiagera ning’o rende oranyare kogambera abanto aba bao abange buna aba?”
english: Give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may lead this people, for who is able to govern this great people of yours?"

ekegusii: Nkwanerie abaminto abare Laodikia, na Nimfa, na ekanisa ere ase enyomba yaye.
english: Give my greetings to the brothers at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the church in her house.

ekegusii: Atanana ebi obwate oe abanto batano na babere, gose batano na batato, ekiagera tomanyeti amabe agochia konyora ense.
english: Give portions to seven, yes to eight, for you do not know what disaster may come upon the land.

ekegusii: Osike ababoraka abare ababoraka bori.
english: Give proper recognition to those widows who are really in need.

ekegusii: Iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase amang’ana onsi! Naki oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae asemore ase Kristo Yeso.
english: give thanks in all circumstances, for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Moakere Nyasae, oyobuete chinyasae, ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Give thanks to the God of gods. His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Moakere Nyasae o igoro ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Moakere Omonene bw’abanene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords: His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono! Rangeria erieta riaye ase ogokonywa, tebia abanto b’ebisaku ogokora kwaye.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

ekegusii: Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, rangeria erieta riaye ase ogokonywa, tebia abanto b’ebisaku ogokora kwaye.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good. His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Iraneria Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete kare na kare.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya; obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

ekegusii: Haroni amo nabamura baye baegwe Abalawi buna ekeegwa korwa ase Abaisraeli.
english: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to him.

ekegusii: Give the money for the redemption of the additional Israelites to Aaron and his sons."
english: Omoe Haroni amo nabamura baye chibesa echio chi’okobooria abatangi abwo baetanetie Abalawi.”

ekegusii: Give the people these instructions, too, so that no one may be open to blame.
english: Obachike ayio, erinde babe batari na komocha.

ekegusii: Naende agantebia: Bachike abanto, obatebie ng’a mbare ang’e goeta ase orogongo rw’abanto bamwabo, abanto b’ororeria rw’Esau, abwo bamenyete Seiri. Barabwo nigo barabairoke. Ase ayio mwerende mono,
english: Give the people these orders: 'You are about to pass through the territory of your brothers the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. They will be afraid of you, but be very careful.

ekegusii: Aye ochike abatomwa abwo batebie abanene babo ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Aya naro amang’ana aane moratebie abanene baino:
english: Give them a message for their masters and say, 'This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Tell this to your masters:

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, bae eki ogwenerete kobaa, ogombayie chinda chiabo, ne chimbeere chiabo chiome pa.
english: Give them, O LORD-- what will you give them? Give them wombs that miscarry and breasts that are dry.

ekegusii: Etato ebe moocha ya Yorodan, na etato ebe ase ense ya Kanani. Eyio ebe emechie y’obotamero.
english: Give three on this side of the Jordan and three in Canaan as cities of refuge.

ekegusii: Moe kera oyokogosaba; na oyogokoura ebinto biao tomoboria naende.
english: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what belongs to you, do not demand it back.

ekegusii: Give to the one who asks you, and do not turn away from the one who wants to borrow from you.
english: Oyokogosaba, moe; na oyorigetie singo, tomorina.

ekegusii: Tokonye torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokonywa kwa mwanyabanto mbosa.
english: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

ekegusii: Tokonye, torwanie ababisa baito tobabue, ekiagera ogokonywa gokorwa ase mwanyabanto mbosa.
english: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

ekegusii: Otoe kera rituko endagera yaito.
english: Give us each day our daily bread.

ekegusii: Give us today our daily bread.
english: Otoe intwe rero endagera yaito.

ekegusii: karue, nainwe namoegwe. Ekerengo ekiya keigateire, keinyageire, geichire, nakio abanto barabae inwe ase amaboko aino, ekiagera ekerengo keria mokorengera, nakio morache korengerwa nainwe.”
english: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over, will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you."

ekegusii: bagatebia abanto, “Ekero morarore Esanduku y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ere ne chibao chirikire oborori bw’okobwatana, ekobogorigwa nabakuani Abalawi, morue aase aa, moyetunyane.
english: giving orders to the people: "When you see the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, and the priests, who are Levites, carrying it, you are to move out from your positions and follow it.

ekegusii: mokomoakera Tata ng’a mbuya mono, oyobaikeranetie mobe ababwatani b’omwando bw’abachenu ase omobaso.
english: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the kingdom of light.

ekegusii: Erio akamaga‐maga chinsemo chionsi, na ekero arora ng’a monto onde tari aande, agaita Omomisiri oria, akabisa omobere oye ase omokenye ime.
english: Glancing this way and that and seeing no one, he killed the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.

ekegusii: Raria obonene bw’Omonene amo nainche toimokererie erieta riaye igoro twensi amo.
english: Glorify the LORD with me; let us exalt his name together.

ekegusii: Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okw’ogosikwa okonene na obonene, na oboronge bwaye nigo bogendererete kobao goika kare na kare.
english: Glorious and majestic are his deeds, and his righteousness endures forever.

ekegusii: Aye omochie o Nyasae, amang’ana ’obonene nigo agokwanwa igoro yao.
english: Glorious things are said of you, O city of God: Selah

ekegusii: Etogerie erieta riaye richenu, abanto bonsi abakorigia Omonene basasoke ase chinkoro chiabo ime.
english: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

ekegusii: Etogerie erieta riaye richenu, abanto bonsi abakorigia Omonene basasoke ase chinkoro chiabo.
english: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

ekegusii: Genda, morere ase chinyasae chiria mogokorera, tiga chirochio chibatoorie bono ekero more ase emechando.”
english: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them save you when you are in trouble!"

ekegusii: Genda inwe mweka mwerigerie chimboba aande onsi morachinyore; korende goika mokore omobaro bw’amatabori oria o botambe, timokoyokeyia nonya ng’ake.”
english: Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it, but your work will not be reduced at all.'"

ekegusii: Genda morore na koenekia ase amenyete, naende ng’a ning’o omororire oreo. Natebigwe ng’a ere nigo are omwoge mono ase okong’ainereria.
english: Go and make further preparation. Find out where David usually goes and who has seen him there. They tell me he is very crafty.

ekegusii: Imoka, ogende Padan‐Aramu ase omochie o Betueli, sokoro yao, onyuome omokungu oyomo korwa ase abaiseke ba Labani, nyoko rome.
english: Go at once to Paddan Aram, to the house of your mother's father Bethuel. Take a wife for yourself there, from among the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother.

ekegusii: Bono genda, osoe ara rimo ase omoruoti Daudi, omoborie: Inee! Aye omonene one omoruoti, tikwandierete inche, omosomba oo, eira y’ogotiana, ogateba: Sulemani, omwana oo omomura, nere oragambe nyuma yane; ere naikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oboruoti? Nase ki rende Adonia abeire omoruoti?
english: Go in to King David and say to him, 'My lord the king, did you not swear to me your servant: "Surely Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne"? Why then has Adonijah become king?'

ekegusii: Inwe soa ase egetare ime, moreme chingoro mwebiseo, motame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene.
english: Go into the rocks, hide in the ground from dread of the LORD and the splendor of his majesty!

ekegusii: Naende mogantebia: Aye genda ang’e, oigwe amang’ana onsi Omonene, Nyasae oito, agokwana. Erio oche ototebie onsi ayio Omonene, Nyasae oito, aragotebie, naintwe natoyaigwe na koyakora.
english: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then tell us whatever the LORD our God tells you. We will listen and obey."

ekegusii: Oimoke ogende ase abanto bamino abwo boosetwe, obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba, kobaragotegerere gose baange kogotegerera.”
english: Go now to your countrymen in exile and speak to them. Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says,' whether they listen or fail to listen."

ekegusii: Bono genda, orike amang’ana ayio ase ebao agwo ase amasio abo, na oyarike ime ase ebuku, erinde abe kirori ase amatuko agochi‐gocha goika kare na kare.
english: Go now, write it on a tablet for them, inscribe it on a scroll, that for the days to come it may be an everlasting witness.

ekegusii: Genda getii ase riicho, ondetere chimanwa chie chimbori ibere chingiya, na inche nimoroiserie iso endagera engiya, eria anchete.
english: Go out to the flock and bring me two choice young goats, so I can prepare some tasty food for your father, just the way he likes it.

ekegusii: korende mbuya mochiere ching’ondi chinsiru chi’enyomba ya Israeli.
english: Go rather to the lost sheep of Israel.

ekegusii: Genda goika Kaline, moyorore, naende mogende goika Hamati, oyio ore omochie omonene, naende motirimboke gochia Gati bw’Abafilisti. Inee! Barabwo nigo bare buya kobua abanto b’amaruoti aya are aiga? Gose chingongo chiabo nechinene kobua orogongo rwaino?
english: Go to Calneh and look at it; go from there to great Hamath, and then go down to Gath in Philistia. Are they better off than your two kingdoms? Is their land larger than yours?

ekegusii: Ankio mambia, ekero Farao aragende rooche, naye ogende otenene ase engegu, omoganye aroro. Enyimbo eria yaonchogete ekaba eng’iti, oyebogorie koboko kwao.
english: Go to Pharaoh in the morning as he goes out to the water. Wait on the bank of the Nile to meet him, and take in your hand the staff that was changed into a snake.

ekegusii: Aye ore omworo, genda ase amage, origererie orore buna agokora emeremo nomokia onyore obong’aini.
english: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider its ways and be wise!

ekegusii: mogende ase abakuani Abalawi na ase omogambi bw’engaki eyio. Mobatebie amang’ana ayio amakong’u, nabarabwo nabanache ekina kia boronge.
english: Go to the priests, who are Levites, and to the judge who is in office at that time. Inquire of them and they will give you the verdict.
