ekegusii: Gaki, genda ase amatabekania e chinchera, bonsi aba moranyore mobarangerie gocha ase omoyega bw’enyangi.
english: Go to the street corners and invite to the banquet anyone you find.'

ekegusii: Tiira gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, morente emete moagachere enyomba eye, erio nario ndagokigwe nero, naende inyeorokie ng’a inche ninde nobonene.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: Go up into the mountains and bring down timber and build the house, so that I may take pleasure in it and be honored," says the LORD.

ekegusii: Nimbaire ase ense ere entenenku y’amabeere na amooke. Inche omonyene tinkogenda amo nainwe, mbaise kobaitera inchera, ekiagera inwe nabanyabigoti bikong’u.”
english: Go up to the land flowing with milk and honey. But I will not go with you, because you are a stiff-necked people and I might destroy you on the way."

ekegusii: Tiira gochia igoro ase egentunwa gia Pisiga, otenene ase egechuria kiaye, oimokie amaiso ao, origererie gochia ensemo ya bosongo, na sugusu, na irianyi, na moocha, origererie buya ense eria orarore, ekiagera tokonyara kwamboka ng’umbu ya Yorodan.
english: Go up to the top of Pisgah and look west and north and south and east. Look at the land with your own eyes, since you are not going to cross this Jordan.

ekegusii: Bwatia enchera; rigereria, nabatomire inwe buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi gati‐gati ye chisese chi’orosana.
english: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.

ekegusii: Aye bono genda, orie endagera yao nomogoko, na onywe edivai yao kore nomosasoko ase enkoro yao, ekiagera Nyasae bwanchire emeremo yao.
english: Go, eat your food with gladness, and drink your wine with a joyful heart, for it is now that God favors what you do.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, inchuo mosoe ase chiero chiaino mwesiekere aroro; mwebise aroro ase engaki enke, goika endamwamu eyio ebe yaetire.
english: Go, my people, enter your rooms and shut the doors behind you; hide yourselves for a little while until his wrath has passed by.

ekegusii: Genda orarie amang’ana aya gochia sugusu, obatebie ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Inwe Abaisraeli motari abegenwa, ing’iranere; tinkogenderera koba nendamwamu asemore ekiagera ninde namabera. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.
english: Go, proclaim this message toward the north: "'Return, faithless Israel,' declares the LORD, 'I will frown on you no longer, for I am merciful,' declares the LORD, 'I will not be angry forever.

ekegusii: Genda otebie Yeroboamu: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Nakoimokereretie igoro korwa ase egati y’abanto, naende ngakobeka okaba omoraai bw’abanto baane Abaisraeli.
english: Go, tell Jeroboam that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'I raised you up from among the people and made you a leader over my people Israel.

ekegusii: Bono imoka, otaare ense eye, orore obotambe na obogare bwaye, ekiagera ninkoe aye ense eyio.”
english: Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you."

ekegusii: ekiagera ere nache komoa kera omonto koreng’ana nogokora kwaye;
english: God "will give to each person according to what he has done."

ekegusii: Nyasae akagera abanto ba Sekemu bakanyora egesusuro ase engencho y’obonyaka babwo. Naboigo okoragereria kwa Yotamu, mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali, kogaikeranigwa igoro yabo.
english: God also made the men of Shechem pay for all their wickedness. The curse of Jotham son of Jerub-Baal came on them.

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agatebia Ibrahimu, “Sarai mokao, tobaisa komoroka naende Sarai, korende erieta riaye nigo rirabe Sara.
english: God also said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you are no longer to call her Sarai; her name will be Sarah.

ekegusii: Nyasae agakwana na Musa, akamotebia, “Inche ninche Omonene.
english: God also said to Moses, "I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamotebia, “Goika otebie Abaisraeli: Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo ontomire asemore; erio nario erieta riane kare na kare; ase erio nigo ndabe nkoinyorwa nebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: God also said to Moses, "Say to the Israelites, 'The LORD, the God of your fathers-- the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob-- has sent me to you.' This is my name forever, the name by which I am to be remembered from generation to generation.

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae akamenta oborori bwaye nebimanyererio, na amakumia, na ebikone bie chinguru ao ao amo na kogabera abanto ebiegwa bi’Omoika Omochenu koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye.
english: God also testified to it by signs, wonders and various miracles, and gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to his will.

ekegusii: “Omonene obeire nendamwamu asende, ontandoranire, naende ongechire; oromananirie amaino aye asende; omochandi one omogoreirie inche amaiso bobe.
english: God assails me and tears me in his anger and gnashes his teeth at me; my opponent fastens on me his piercing eyes.

ekegusii: Nyasae akabasesenia, akabatebia, “Moibore, momenteke, moichore ase ense, na moyegambere. Mogambere ne chinswe chia nyancha, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka, na kera egetongwa kere moyo kegotaara igoro ase ense,”
english: God blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and over every living creature that moves on the ground."

ekegusii: Erio agwo Nyasae akabisesenia, agateba, “Ibora, momenteke, moichore ime ase chinyancha, ne chinyoni chibuche ase ense.”
english: God blessed them and said, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the water in the seas, and let the birds increase on the earth."

ekegusii: Nyasae nere obarentire korwa Misiri; barabwo nigo babwate chinguru buna echi’eng’era.
english: God brought them out of Egypt; they have the strength of a wild ox.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaroka eria enyomo ense, na amache aria asangererekanete amo akayaroka chinyancha. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.
english: God called the dry ground "land," and the gathered waters he called "seas." And God saw that it was good.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaroka eaanga eria igoro. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bokaba mambia, rituko ria kabere.
english: God called the expanse "sky." And there was evening, and there was morning-- the second day.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaroka oborabu boria omobaso, na omosunte akayoroka obotuko. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bokaba mambia, rituko rie ritang’ani.
english: God called the light "day," and the darkness he called "night." And there was evening, and there was morning-- the first day.

ekegusii: Nyasae ngocha are korwa Temani ee, Ere oyore Omochenu ngocha are korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani. Obonene bwaye mbotube igoro chionsi, na ense neichorwe nogotogigwa kwaye.
english: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah His glory covered the heavens and his praise filled the earth.

ekegusii: Nyasae agacha ase Baalamu, akamoboria, “Abanto aba more komo mbarabi?”
english: God came to Balaam and asked, "Who are these men with you?"

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae nere kirori one, buna inde namaiga ase inwe mwensi nobwanchani bokorwa ase Kristo Yeso.
english: God can testify how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Nyasae agakora ebikone ebinene mono ase amaboko a Paulo,
english: God did extraordinary miracles through Paul,

ekegusii: Nyasae tangeti abanto baye baria amanyete korwa kare. Gose timomanyeti aya amariko agoteba igoro y’Elija, buna akweng’ereria ase Nyasae igoro y’Abaisraeli?
english: God did not reject his people, whom he foreknew. Don't you know what the Scripture says in the passage about Elijah-- how he appealed to God against Israel:

ekegusii: Aya nigo abete bo, erinde obotindi obwo bwakoreretwe abana abamura baria ba Yerubi‐Baali emerongo etano na ebere baakanerwe egesiomba. Ase igo okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga abo kogaakanerwa igoro y’Abimeleki, oyio obaitete, naende igoro y’abanto ba Sekemu, abwo bamobegete chinguru chi’ogokora ayio.
english: God did this in order that the crime against Jerub-Baal's seventy sons, the shedding of their blood, might be avenged on their brother Abimelech and on the citizens of Shechem, who had helped him murder his brothers.

ekegusii: erinde barigie Nyasae, nonya nase ogotaba‐taba bamonyore. Nonya nigo tari are korwa ase kera oyomo oito,
english: God did this so that men would seek him and perhaps reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

ekegusii: Ase igo, ase ebinto bibere bitanyare koonchorwa, ime ase ebio Nyasae takonyara gokwana oborimo, intwe, abatwatameire obotamero, tonyore okoremigwa ogokong’u kobwata ogosemeria koria kwabekirwe bosio bwaito.
english: God did this so that, by two unchangeable things in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled to take hold of the hope offered to us may be greatly encouraged.

ekegusii: Nyasae tari gotigeria endamwamu yaye, abanto abagokonya Rahabu, nigo bagotung’ama inse asare baumama.
english: God does not restrain his anger; even the cohorts of Rahab cowered at his feet.

ekegusii: Nyasae akamoimokereria igoro ase ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio abe Omoraai na Omotooria, erinde aonchore Abaisraeli, abae okwaberwa kw’ebibe.
english: God exalted him to his own right hand as Prince and Savior that he might give repentance and forgiveness of sins to Israel.

ekegusii: Nyasae obekire Orebu na Seebu, abagambi b’Abamidiani, ase amaboko aino. Inche ngento ki nakorire kegwekaine eki mwakorire inwe?” Ekero baigwete aya Gidioni akwanete, endamwamu yabo y’okomobea egakenda.
english: God gave Oreb and Zeeb, the Midianite leaders, into your hands. What was I able to do compared to you?" At this, their resentment against him subsided.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaa Sulemani obong’aini ne chisemi goetania ekerengo; okomanya kwaye nigo kwarenge okonge, koreng’ana buna obonge bw’omokenye ore ase engegu y’enyancha.
english: God gave Solomon wisdom and very great insight, and a breadth of understanding as measureless as the sand on the seashore.

ekegusii: Nyasae oeire omonto obotenenku, ne chinibo, na ogosikwa, na omonto oyio taremeiri gento kende ase ebio bionsi aganetie, korende Nyasae tamoeti okobua gw’okwegokia ase ebinto ebio; omonto omoao nigo akobiira bwegokia nabirobio. Ayio naro mbosa, naende nogwechanda okobe.
english: God gives a man wealth, possessions and honor, so that he lacks nothing his heart desires, but God does not enable him to enjoy them, and a stranger enjoys them instead. This is meaningless, a grievous evil.

ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae natang’anete gotogachera intwe egento kere ekiya kobua, naki barabwo tibaikeranetigwe intwe totaiyo.
english: God had planned something better for us so that only together with us would they be made perfect.

ekegusii: Nyasae otiirire namariogi ay’ogochengerwa, Omonene nigo akobugerigwa ebirombeta.
english: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD amid the sounding of trumpets.

ekegusii: God has made my heart faint; the Almighty has terrified me.
english: Nyasae ogoyirie omoyo one, ee, Omonguru ongosire,

ekegusii: Nyasae taganeti engaki entambe korigereria, goika abeke omonto ase ekina.
english: God has no need to examine men further, that they should come before him for judgment.

ekegusii: Oyo Yeso Nyasae akamobokia na ase aya intwe twensi nigo tore abarori.
english: God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of the fact.

ekegusii: Nyasae okwanire korwa ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu, ogoteba, “Ase omochengo ninyatanane Sekemu, na ense omweya ya Sukoti inyiate chincherere.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.

ekegusii: Nyasae orire eira korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, ogoteba, “Ase omochengo ninyatanane Sekemu, na ense omweya ya Sukoti inyiate chincherere.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.

ekegusii: Nyasae ondure ase abanto batamoirogeti, ombekire ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.
english: God has turned me over to evil men and thrown me into the clutches of the wicked.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa ogosaba kwa Manoa, na omomalaika o Nyasae agacha naende ase omokungu oria ekero aikaransete mogondo. Manoa, omosacha oye, tarenge amo nere.
english: God heard Manoah, and the angel of God came again to the woman while she was out in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa okorera kw’omwana, na omomalaika o Nyasae akarangeria Hagari korwa igoro, akamotebia, “Hagari, inki okorera? Tibwoboa, ekiagera Nyasae oigure okorera kw’omwana agwo ase araire.
english: God heard the boy crying, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, "What is the matter, Hagar? Do not be afraid; God has heard the boy crying as he lies there.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa ekerero kiabo, akaba okoinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, okwo akorete na Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo;
english: God heard their groaning and he remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac and with Jacob.

ekegusii: Nyasae akamokonya, erinde akabua Abafilisti, amo n’Abaarabu abamenyete ase Guru‐Baali, na Abameuni.
english: God helped him against the Philistines and against the Arabs who lived in Gur Baal and against the Meunites.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are omogambi omoronge, na kera rituko nigo akoba nekeririanda ase abakori amabe.
english: God is a righteous judge, a God who expresses his wrath every day.

ekegusii: Agwo ase chiburi chi’omochie oyio, Nyasae bweorokirie ng’a nere obotamero bw’ogwekengera,
english: God is in her citadels; he has shown himself to be her fortress.

ekegusii: God is just: He will pay back trouble to those who trouble you
english: Naki Nyasae ororire boronge kobaakana emechando baria bakobachanda inwe,

ekegusii: Nyasae tari omonto, erinde akwane oborimo, gose tari mwanyabanto, erinde anyare koonchoka. Inee! Aya akwanire, takonyara koyakora? Gose, aya atebire, takonyara koyaikerania?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should change his mind. Does he speak and then not act? Does he promise and not fulfill?

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae tari buna oyotari omoronge, goika eebe emeremo yaino, na obwachani boria mwaorogetie ase engencho y’erieta riaye ekero mwakorerete abachenu, na nonya mbono nkobakorera more.
english: God is not unjust; he will not forget your work and the love you have shown him as you have helped his people and continue to help them.

ekegusii: Nyasae n’Omoika, na abwo bakomosasima nebagwenerete komosasima ase omoika na ekeene.”
english: God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in spirit and in truth."

ekegusii: Rora Nyasae nigo are amo naintwe, nere ototang’aine, na abakuani baye nigo babwate ebirombeta biabo bi’esegi bakobibugia, bagotorangeria tobarwanie inwe esegi. Inwe Abaisraeli, timobaisa korwana n’Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera timokonyara kobua.”
english: God is with us; he is our leader. His priests with their trumpets will sound the battle cry against you. Men of Israel, do not fight against the LORD, the God of your fathers, for you will not succeed."

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo amenyete imeo, tokonyegerigwa, ere nayokonye kobogokia mambia.
english: God is within her, she will not fall; God will help her at break of day.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaigwa Lea, na ere akaba morito, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o gatano.
english: God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo arigereretie mwanyabanto korwa igoro arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.
english: God looks down from heaven on the sons of men to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

ekegusii: Nyasae omokorire ere, oyotamanyeti ebibe, koba ebibe ase engencho yaito, erio asare intwe tobe noboronge ase Nyasae.
english: God made him who had no sin to be sin for us, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

ekegusii: Nyasae agakora ching’iti chi’orosana, kera egesaku nengencho yaye, ne ching’iti chigotugwa, kera egesaku nengencho yaye, ne ching’iti chikwagura, kera egesaku nengencho yaye. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.
english: God made the wild animals according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and all the creatures that move along the ground according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.

ekegusii: Nyasae agakora emebaso emenene ebere. Omobaso oria omonene ase eyio ebere ogambere ekero kia mobaso, na oria omoke ekero kia botuko; agakora ne ching’enang’eni boigo.
english: God made two great lights-- the greater light to govern the day and the lesser light to govern the night. He also made the stars.

ekegusii: Nyasae agaika korwa igoro, akaumerana na Baalamu. Baalamu akamotebia, “Naagachire ebisasimero bitano na bibere, naende narure igoro ase kera ekemo eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo.”
english: God met with him, and Balaam said, "I have prepared seven altars, and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram."

ekegusii: Ere Nyasae omobekire koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase amanyinga aye, erinde tomonyore ase enchera y’okwegena. Igo Nyasae aorokirie oboronge bwaye, ekiagera ase okoremereria kwaye atigete ebibe biria biatang’anete.
english: God presented him as a sacrifice of atonement, through faith in his blood. He did this to demonstrate his justice, because in his forbearance he had left the sins committed beforehand unpunished--

ekegusii: Nyasae nere okogamba igoro ase ebisaku; ere nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kere egechenu.
english: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on his holy throne.

ekegusii: Agwo Nyasae akamotebia, “Erieta riao n’Yakobo, bono tokorokwa naende Yakobo, korende nigo orarokwe Israeli.” Ase igo akamoroka Israeli.
english: God said to him, "Your name is Jacob, but you will no longer be called Jacob; your name will be Israel." So he named him Israel.

ekegusii: Nyasae akairaneria Musa, “INCHE NINCHE INDE BUNA INDE. Obatebie Abaisraeli: INCHE INDE ontomire asemore.”
english: God said to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM. This is what you are to say to the Israelites: 'I AM has sent me to you.'"

ekegusii: Nyasae akairaneria Sulemani, “Ekiagera okogania okwo kore ime ase enkoro yao, naende toboreti oegwe obotenenku, gose obonda, gose ogosikwa, gose ogosirigwa kw’obogima bw’abanto baria bakogechete, gose toboreti oegwe obogima obotambe, korende kwaboririe oegwe obong’aini ne chisemi, erinde omanye kogambera abanto baane abwo nakobekire obe omoruoti obo,
english: God said to Solomon, "Since this is your heart's desire and you have not asked for wealth, riches or honor, nor for the death of your enemies, and since you have not asked for a long life but for wisdom and knowledge to govern my people over whom I have made you king,

ekegusii: Nyasae akarigereria ebinto ebio bionsi akorete, na birobio nigo biarenge ebiya mono. Erio agwo rikaba mogoroba, naende bokaba mambia, rituko ria gatano na rimo.
english: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning-- the sixth day.

ekegusii: Nyasae akarora ng’a ense yasarekire, ekiagera kera omonto obwatirie chinchera chi’obosareku ase ense.
english: God saw how corrupt the earth had become, for all the people on earth had corrupted their ways.

ekegusii: Nyasae akarora oborabu obwo ng’a nobuya, agaatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte.
english: God saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agatoma omoika omobe ase ogwatanana Abimeleki na abanto ba Sekemu, na abanto aba bagakorera Abimeleki obong’ainereria.
english: God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the citizens of Shechem, who acted treacherously against Abimelech.

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akayebeka ase eaanga aaria igoro, eyee ense omobaso na oborabu,
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth,

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoa abatigirwe bosa chinka ase bakomenya. Nigo agosibora abanto basibire baseseneka, korende abasaria nigo bakomenya ase ense enyomo pa.
english: God sets the lonely in families, he leads forth the prisoners with singing; but the rebellious live in a sun-scorched land.

ekegusii: Nyasae agakwana iga: Oroiboro rwa Ibrahimu inababe abamenyi ase ense y’abanto bande, na barabwo inababakore babe abasomba babo, na kobakorera bobe, ase engaki y’emiaka amagana ane.
english: God spoke to him in this way: 'Your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.

ekegusii: “Nyasae bweka namanyete enchera y’obong’aini, namanyete aase aye.
english: God understands the way to it and he alone knows where it dwells,

ekegusii: Nyasae akaba amo nomwana oria. Ere akamenya ase erooro, akaba omomanyi bw’okorasa nemegwe.
english: God was with the boy as he grew up. He lived in the desert and became an archer.

ekegusii: Nyasae otosesenirie; ase igo, tiga abanto bare ase ense engima bamoiroke!
english: God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear him.

ekegusii: Korende abwo bare isiko, Nyasae nabagambie, “Seria omonto oyio omobe arue asemore.”
english: God will judge those outside. "Expel the wicked man from among you."

ekegusii: Nyasae nomwegenwa, oyobarangeirie mosoe ase obomo bw’Omwana oye, Yeso Kristo Omonene oito.
english: God, who has called you into fellowship with his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, is faithful.

ekegusii: Nyasae oyio obeire okogamba korwa kare, nanyigwe inche, erio abue abanto abwo, ekiagera abwo tibari koonchoka na komoiroka Nyasae.
english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear them and afflict them-- Selah men who never change their ways and have no fear of God.

ekegusii: Na Nyasae, oyomanyete chinkoro chi’abanto, akabanchera, akabaa Omoika Omochenu, koreng’ana buna atoete intwe,
english: God, who knows the heart, showed that he accepted them by giving the Holy Spirit to them, just as he did to us.

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae, oyo ngokorera ase omoika one korandia enchili y’Omwana oye, nere kirori one ng’a tintigeti kobaatora botambe ase ogosaba kwane.
english: God, whom I serve with my whole heart in preaching the gospel of his Son, is my witness how constantly I remember you

ekegusii: Abanto abegeni bagatindeka Stefano, bakamoreera okorera okonene.
english: Godly men buried Stephen and mourned deeply for him.

ekegusii: Naki ogoichanigwa okore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae nigo gokorenta okoonchoka gokoraa gochia ase ogotooreka, gotari na kweitia; korende ogoichanigwa gw’ense nigo gokorenta amakweri.
english: Godly sorrow brings repentance that leads to salvation and leaves no regret, but worldly sorrow brings death.

ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene asebare, agaita abanto abwo barenge ne chinguru goetania abande, agakoora kegima abamura b’Abaisraeli.
english: God's anger rose against them; he put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.

ekegusii: Oyomo obo nanyare gokoebereria osasime chinyasae chinde chi’abanto abwo bagoetanaine, bamenyete aare korwa asore, gose ang’e, korwa ensinyo eyemo y’ense goika eyende.
english: gods of the peoples around you, whether near or far, from one end of the land to the other),

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akogukura neriogi riaye ase enchera y’ogokumia mono, nigo agokora amang’ana amanene, ayio totanyare komanya.
english: God's voice thunders in marvelous ways; he does great things beyond our understanding.

ekegusii: Going a little farther, he fell to the ground and prayed that if possible the hour might pass from him.
english: Akagenderera bosio ake, akagwa maumama, ogosaba ng’a onye ekonyarekana, ensa eye emoetere.

ekegusii: Akagenderera ake, akagwa maumama, agasaba, “Tata one, onye ekonyarekana, tiga egekombe eke kerusigwe asende; korende taba buna nyanchete inche, korende buna bwanchete aye.”
english: Going a little farther, he fell with his face to the ground and prayed, "My Father, if it is possible, may this cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will."

ekegusii: Erio kegima agachiera Yeso, agateba, “Masoge, Omonene!” Akamonyunyunta.
english: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Greetings, Rabbi!" and kissed him.

ekegusii: Agachia gocha bwango, akamochiera, akabora, “Rabii!” Akamonyunyunta.
english: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, "Rabbi!" and kissed him.

ekegusii: Akarua aroro, agasoa ase esinagogi yabo.
english: Going on from that place, he went into their synagogue,

ekegusii: Naende gakogenda korwa aroro, akarora abamura babere bande ba ise omo, Yakobo omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana omwabo, barenge obwato ime amo na Zebedi ise bakoroisia ebionga biabo, nabarabwo akabarangeria.
english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James son of Zebedee and his brother John. They were in a boat with their father Zebedee, preparing their nets. Jesus called them,

ekegusii: Oyio akagenda ase Pilato, akarigia omobere o Yeso. Erio Pilato agachika ayoegwe.
english: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus' body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.

ekegusii: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesus' body.
english: Omonto oyo agachiera Pilato, akamosaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rwabo rogatiira gochia bosongo, rogaika Marala, rogatwomera Dabeseti ne rigoko rire moocha ya Yokinamu.
english: Going west it ran to Maralah, touched Dabbesheth, and extended to the ravine near Jokneam.

ekegusii: chibakuri chiroisirie korwa ase chitahabu, emerongo etato (30), na echiroisirie korwa ase chifeta, amagana ane, na ikomi (410), naende ebikorero binde, elifu eyemo (1,000).
english: gold bowls 30 matching silver bowls 410 other articles 1,000

ekegusii: Etahabu nere, na amagena amange e rigori rinene, korende ebikoba bigokwana ay’obong’aini nigo binga buna amagena e rigori rinene akomeka‐meka.
english: Gold there is, and rubies in abundance, but lips that speak knowledge are a rare jewel.

ekegusii: Gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, lead
english: Etahabu, na efeta, na etaai, na ebioma ao ao,

ekegusii: Goliato agacha bosio, agaaka eriogi ase abarwani b’Abaisraeli, akabora, “Nase ki mwachire na korobera ase okorwana esegi? Inee! Inche tindi Omofilisti, nainwe nabasomba ba Saulo? Chora omonto oyomo oino ache aa asende.
english: Goliath stood and shouted to the ranks of Israel, "Why do you come out and line up for battle? Am I not a Philistine, and are you not the servants of Saul? Choose a man and have him come down to me.

ekegusii: Naende Gomeri akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoiseke. Erio Omonene agatebia Hosea, “Moroke Lo‐Ruhama, ekiagera tinkonyara kogenderera koba namabera ase Abaisraeli, gose tinkobaabera nonya ng’ake.
english: Gomer conceived again and gave birth to a daughter. Then the LORD said to Hosea, "Call her Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer show love to the house of Israel, that I should at all forgive them.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya na omonyene oboronge, ase ayio nigo akworokereria abanyabibe enchera bagwenerete kobwatia.
english: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.

ekegusii: Okomanya okuya nigo gokorenta ogwancherwa, korende enchera y’abatari abegenwa nigo ekoraa gochia ase obosiru.
english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omonto ore namabera na okorua ebinto singo, boigo ogokora amang’ana aye onsi ase oboronge.
english: Good will come to him who is generous and lends freely, who conducts his affairs with justice.

ekegusii: Goshen, Holon and Giloh-- eleven towns and their villages.
english: na Goseni, na Holoni, na Gilo, emechie ikomi nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Obuya na omorembe bimenteke asemore ase okomomanya Nyasae na Yeso, Omonene oito.
english: Grace and peace be yours in abundance through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.

ekegusii: Obuya bobe asemore na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo,
english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ,

ekegusii: Obuya bobe asemore, na omorembe, bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.
english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Obuya bobe asemore na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.
english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Obuya bobe asemore na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.
english: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Obuya bobe asemore na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.
english: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Grace be with you all.
english: Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.

ekegusii: Obuya bobe amo na bonsi abamwanchete Omonene oito Yeso Kristo nobwanchani botari gosareka.
english: Grace to all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.

ekegusii: Obuya bobe asemore na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Obuya, na amabera, na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata na ase Yeso Kristo, Omwana o Tata, nigo birabe amo naintwe ase ekeene na ase obwanchani.
english: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and from Jesus Christ, the Father's Son, will be with us in truth and love.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoora engano, Inee, nkoyesunyunta are? Yaya, tari kogenderera koyeoora naende naende, nigo arabaise koyesenyenta namagoro ’egari ekong’uswa ne chibarasi chiaye.
english: Grain must be ground to make bread; so one does not go on threshing it forever. Though he drives the wheels of his threshing cart over it, his horses do not grind it.

ekegusii: Okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biatangirwe, tibirentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene. Abakuani abare abakoreri b’Omonene nigo bakorera.
english: Grain offerings and drink offerings are cut off from the house of the LORD. The priests are in mourning, those who minister before the LORD.

ekegusii: Ee, ayio namaene. Barabwo mbabunegete ase ogotegena kwabo, korende aye nigo oteneine ase okwegena kwao. Ase igo toenena, korende oiroke.
english: Granted. But they were broken off because of unbelief, and you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but be afraid.

ekegusii: Chimbuche chire ase omotwe negutwa y’obonene, eyio nigo ekonyorekana ase enchera y’oboronge.
english: Gray hair is a crown of splendor; it is attained by a righteous life.

ekegusii: Ogokora kw’Omonene nigo kore okonene, Abwo bagokogokera nigo bagokweorokereria erinde bakomanye.
english: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omonene bw’ogosemia, na omobui ase ogokora kwao. Amaiso ao nigo arigereretie chinchera chionsi chia mwanyabanto; naye okoa kera omonto eng’eria yaye koreng’ana ne chinchera chiaye, na okwama kw’ogokora kwaye.
english: great are your purposes and mighty are your deeds. Your eyes are open to all the ways of men; you reward everyone according to his conduct and as his deeds deserve.

ekegusii: Emeganda emenene ekamochiera, ekarenta amagata, na ebirema, na emeuko, na amamama, na abande abange, bakababeka ase amagoro a Yeso, na ere akabagwenia.
english: Great crowds came to him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute and many others, and laid them at his feet; and he healed them.

ekegusii: Omoondoko omonene okabwata ab’ekanisa yonsi na abanto bonsi abaigwete aya.
english: Great fear seized the whole church and all who heard about these events.

ekegusii: Omonene oito nigo are omonene mono, ne chinguru chiaye nechinyinge; obong’aini bwaye tibokorengeka.
english: Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene, nagwenerete atogigwe mono; obonene bwaye tibokomanyekana buna bore.
english: Great is the LORD and most worthy of praise; his greatness no one can fathom.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene ase Sayoni, oimokererigwe igoro kobua abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
english: Great is the LORD in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.

ekegusii: Abwo banchete amachiko ao nigo bare nomorembe omonene mono, kende tikeri gekobagocha.
english: Great peace have they who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.

ekegusii: Onde tari ore nobwanchani obonene kobua obo, obw’omonto akorua obogima bwaye ase engencho y’abasani baye.
english: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.

ekegusii: greed, malice, deceit, lewdness, envy, slander, arrogance and folly.
english: okogania okobe, obobe, obong’ainereria, oboenenu, ribero, oborami, obwerori, oboriri.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie abaminto bonsi ase okobanyunyunta ase obochenu.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

ekegusii: Monkwanerie kera omochenu ase Kristo Yeso. Abaminto abare amo nainche babakwanirie.
english: Greet all the saints in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send greetings.

ekegusii: Greet all your leaders and all God's people. Those from Italy send you their greetings.
english: Nkwanerie abwo bonsi bakobatang’ana, na abachenu bonsi. Abwo baruete Italia babakwanirie.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie boigo ekanisa ere ase enyomba yabo. Nkwanerie Epaineto omwanchwa one, nere orenge bwe ritang’ani ase Asia koonchoka ase Kristo.
english: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my dear friend Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Ampiliato, omwanchwa one ase Omonene.
english: Greet Ampliatus, whom I love in the Lord.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Androniko na Yunia, abaamate baane, abasibetwe abatomwa ng’a nabaya; barabwo nigo bantang’anerete koba ime ase Kristo.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junias, my relatives who have been in prison with me. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Apele oyo bwancheretwe ase Kristo. Nkwanerie abanto b’enyomba y’Aristobulu.
english: Greet Apelles, tested and approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Asunkrito, Felegoni, Herme, Patiroba, Herama na abaminto abare amo nabarabwo.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas and the brothers with them.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Herodioni, omoamate one. Nkwanerie abanto b’enyomba ya Narikiso bare ase Omonene.
english: Greet Herodion, my relative. Greet those in the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Mariamu oyokorete emeremo emekong’u ase egati yaino.
english: Greet Mary, who worked very hard for you.

ekegusii: Kwanania ase okonyunyuntana ase obochenu.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

ekegusii: Kwanania na konyunyuntana ase obochenu. Chikanisa chionsi chia Kristo chiabakwanirie.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send greetings.

ekegusii: Kwanania ase okonyunyuntana ase obwanchani. Omorembe obe amo nainwe mwensi, abamore ase Kristo Yeso.
english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Fililogo, Yuli, Nereu na mosubati omwabo, Olimpa na abachenu bonsi abare amo nabarabwo.
english: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the saints with them.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Priska na Akwila, na abanto b’enyomba y’Onesiforo.
english: Greet Priscilla and Aquila and the household of Onesiphorus.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Priska na Akwila, abakori emeremo amo nainche ase Kristo Yeso,
english: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Rufo omochorwa ase Omonene, na ng’ina ore buna baba asende.
english: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me, too.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Turufena na Turufosa, abakori emeremo ase Omonene. Nkwanerie Perisi omwanchwa, oyokorire omokia mono ase Omonene.
english: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, those women who work hard in the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis, another woman who has worked very hard in the Lord.

ekegusii: Nkwanerie Urubano omokori emeremo amo nainche ase Kristo, na Staku omwanchwa one.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.

ekegusii: Grieve, mourn and wail. Change your laughter to mourning and your joy to gloom.
english: Eichanie na kweng’ereria, na korera. Ogoseka kwaino koonchorwe kobe okweng’ereria, na omogoko oino obe omoichano.

ekegusii: Orusie bike, erio obiswage bibe obosie. Obeke boke bosio bw’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, aase ndaumerane naye. Amanukato ayio abe amachenu mono asemore.
english: Grind some of it to powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.

ekegusii: Oichane, korende oremererie torera; tobaisa koreera oria okure. Bwetube egetambaa ase omotwe oo, obeke ebikoroto ase amagoro ao. Tobaisa gotuba obosio bwao, gose tobaisa koria endagera y’ebirero.”
english: Groan quietly; do not mourn for the dead. Keep your turban fastened and your sandals on your feet; do not cover the lower part of your face or eat the customary food [of mourners]."

ekegusii: Renda omoyo one na ontoorie; naye ngotamera tobaisa gontiga nsookigwe.
english: Guard my life and rescue me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.

ekegusii: Orende omoyo one, ekiagera nigo nkoirogete; aye Nyasae one, intoorie inche omosomba oo, ekiagera nigo ngosemeretie.
english: Guard my life, for I am devoted to you. You are my God; save your servant who trusts in you.

ekegusii: Renda keria ekiya kwaetwe, okegache, okerende ase chinguru chi’Omoika Omochenu, oyomenyete ime yaito.
english: Guard the good deposit that was entrusted to you-- guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

ekegusii: Chigache na gochirenda goika ekero morachirenge ase obosio bw’abakuani abanene na Abalawi, na ase abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bare Yerusalemu ime ase ebinyomba bi’enyomba y’Omonene.”
english: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in the chambers of the house of the LORD in Jerusalem before the leading priests and the Levites and the family heads of Israel."

ekegusii: Orende amagoro ao ekero ogosoa ase enyomba ya Nyasae; mbuya kogenda aroro ase ogotegerera kobua korua ebing’wanso ebi abariri bakorua, ekiagera abwo tibamanyeti ng’a nigo bagokora ebibe.
english: Guard your steps when you go to the house of God. Go near to listen rather than to offer the sacrifice of fools, who do not know that they do wrong.

ekegusii: Ondaae ase ekeene kiao na onyorokererie, ekiagera aye Nyasae nogotooreka kwane, aye nigo ngosemeretie.
english: guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagatenenera ababogoretie chigurube, naende bakaba abatebereria b’abakori emeremo ao ao. Abande b’Abalawi bakaba abariki, na abande abateneneri ao ao, na abande abarendi b’ebiita.
english: had charge of the laborers and supervised all the workers from job to job. Some of the Levites were secretaries, scribes and doorkeepers.

ekegusii: Hadad also died. The chiefs of Edom were: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
english: Na Hadadi agakwa. Abagambi b’Abaedomu nabwo aba: Timuna na Alifa, na Yeteti,

ekegusii: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah.
english: na Hadadi, na Tema, na Yeturi, na Nafisi, na Kedema.

ekegusii: Hadadeseri agatoma abanto barente Abasiiria abwo barenge moocha y’orooche rw’Eufarati. Barawo bagacha Helamu, na Sobaki, omotang’ani bw’abarwani ba Hadadeseri, akabatang’ana.
english: Hadadezer had Arameans brought from beyond the River; they went to Helam, with Shobach the commander of Hadadezer's army leading them.

ekegusii: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
english: na Hadoramu, na Usali, na Dikila,

ekegusii: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
english: Hadoramu na Usali, na Dikila;

ekegusii: Hagab, Shalmai, Hanan,
english: Hagabu, na Salimai na Hanani;

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’okoremerwa na enchara babeire ebigonkobe, nigo bakona‐kogokona namaino abo riroba eriomo pa, erio riasaregete.
english: Haggard from want and hunger, they roamed the parched land in desolate wastelands at night.

ekegusii: Embura enene y’amagena egatwa, na okomesa gw’enkoba gokagenderera amo nembura eyio. Na embura y’amagena eria yarenge endito mono, eyio omogwekano oye etana gotwa ase ense ya Misiri korwa ekero egesaku ekio giachagete komenyao.
english: hail fell and lightning flashed back and forth. It was the worst storm in all the land of Egypt since it had become a nation.

ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie naende ekeng’ese kia Gileadi amo n’Asitaroti, na Edirei, emechie emenene y’oboruoti bw’Ogi, omoruoti o Basani. Eyio nigo yarwetwe ase kera eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Makiri, mosinto o Manase, ekaba omwando obo.
english: half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei (the royal cities of Og in Bashan). This was for the descendants of Makir son of Manasseh-- for half of the sons of Makir, clan by clan.

ekegusii: Ase ekeng’ese kende omonto oria nigo agoutera omorero, osambera chinyama, ochiria na koigota, na ekero autire omorero oria nigo agoteba, “Ee, bono nabeire ne riberera; omorero oyo nomuya!”
english: Half of the wood he burns in the fire; over it he prepares his meal, he roasts his meat and eats his fill. He also warms himself and says, "Ah! I am warm; I see the fire."

ekegusii: Ekeng’ese ki’abana babo nigo barenge gokwana omonwa bw’Egesidodi gose oyo bw’egesaku kende, korende tibamanyete gokwana omonwa bw’Ekeyuda.
english: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or the language of one of the other peoples, and did not know how to speak the language of Judah.

ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Halihuli, na Beti‐Suri, na Gedori,
english: Halhul, Beth Zur, Gedor,

ekegusii: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
english: Halohesi, na Pila, na Sobeki;

ekegusii: Hamu, ise Kanani, akamorora ore getirianda, agatebia bamura bamwabo babere barenge isiko amang’ana aya aroche.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father's nakedness and told his two brothers outside.

ekegusii: Hamani agetogia asebare, agakwana igoro y’obonge bw’obotenenku bwaye, na igoro y’abana baye abange, naende igoro y’obonene bwonsi omoruoti konya amoeire, na buna amokinetie kobua abagambi bonsi, na abasomba bonsi b’omoruoti.
english: Haman boasted to them about his vast wealth, his many sons, and all the ways the king had honored him and how he had elevated him above the other nobles and officials.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Hamani akarua ase endagera eria, ore nomogoko na omosasoko. Korende ekero aroche Moredekai ase egeita ki’enyomba y’omoruoti, na Moredekai taimogete atenene amworokie amasikani, agaichorwa nekeririanda asare.
english: Haman went out that day happy and in high spirits. But when he saw Mordecai at the king's gate and observed that he neither rose nor showed fear in his presence, he was filled with rage against Mordecai.

ekegusii: Eyio nefeta eturire ekorwa Tarisisi, na etahabu ekorwa Ufasi. Nigo ere emeremo y’omoroisia omong’aini na omoturi bw’etahabu. Chianga emegwekano eyio ekobekerwa nigo chire chimbariri ne chimonyinga, chiroisirie nabanto abang’aini.
english: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz. What the craftsman and goldsmith have made is then dressed in blue and purple-- all made by skilled workers.

ekegusii: Naama! Hanameli, mosinto o Salumu iso moke, nache asore, agotebie ng’a ogore omogondo oye ore agwo Anatoti, ekiagera omwando oyo naye otungetie, oyogore na koyobooria.”
english: Hanamel son of Shallum your uncle is going to come to you and say, 'Buy my field at Anathoth, because as nearest relative it is your right and duty to buy it.'

ekegusii: Hanani, mosinto o Maaka na Yosafati korwa Mitani;
english: Hanan son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

ekegusii: Hanan, Giddel, Gahar,
english: Hanani, na Gideli, na Gahari;

ekegusii: Hanani, oyomo bw’abaminto, agacha amo nabanto bande korwa ase ense y’Abayuda. Nkababoria igoro y’Abayahudi bande batigarete aroro bare moyo, abwo konya batoorekire korwa ase obosomba, naende nkababoria amang’ana igoro ya Yerusalemu.
english: Hanani, one of my brothers, came from Judah with some other men, and I questioned them about the Jewish remnant that survived the exile, and also about Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,
english: Hanania na Elamu, na Anitotia,

ekegusii: mogwenerete koa Saitani omonto oyio, omobere oye osarigwe, erinde omoika oye oche gotoorigwa ase rituko ri’Omonene Yeso.
english: hand this man over to Satan, so that the sinful nature may be destroyed and his spirit saved on the day of the Lord.

ekegusii: Osunge etoto eria y’egetambaa ase chisiiro inye chi’emekonge chioomire netahabu, chire nebigobanio bie chitahabu, chiratenene ase chinterekerero inye chie chifeta.
english: Hang it with gold hooks on four posts of acacia wood overlaid with gold and standing on four silver bases.

ekegusii: Osunge etoto eria inse y’ebigobanio, obeke Esanduku eyere ne chibao chirikire oborori moino y’etoto. Etoto eria yaatanane Aase Aachenu korwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono.
english: Hang the curtain from the clasps and place the ark of the Testimony behind the curtain. The curtain will separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place.

ekegusii: Korende ase engaki eyio Hana tagendeteo, agatebia omosacha oye, “Ninganye goika ntache omwana, erio nario ndamoire imoorokie ase obosio bw’Omonene, erinde imotige amenye aroro botambe.”
english: Hannah did not go. She said to her husband, "After the boy is weaned, I will take him and present him before the LORD, and he will live there always."

ekegusii: Hana nigo arenge gosabera enkoro yaye ime bokiriru; akaba okomonya‐monyia ebikoba biaye rioka, korende riogi tiriare koigweka. Ase ayio Eli agakaga ng’a nigo atindire,
english: Hannah was praying in her heart, and her lips were moving but her voice was not heard. Eli thought she was drunk

ekegusii: korwa ase basinto ba Yusufu; ase egesaku kia Manase, Hanieli, mosinto o Efodi;
english: Hanniel son of Ephod, the leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;

ekegusii: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
english: na Hafaraimu, na Sihoni, na Anaharati,

ekegusii: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
english: Harimu, na Meremoti, na Obadia;

ekegusii: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
english: Harifu, na Anatoti, na Nebai;

ekegusii: Inwe abariini chibarasi beka chibarasi ang’e mochiriine. Beka ebigogwa biaino bi’ebioma, mwebeke ang’e, tieria amatimo aino. Beka chigoti chiaino chi’ebioma.
english: Harness the horses, mount the steeds! Take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears, put on your armor!

ekegusii: Inee! Omonene naagete Abaisraeli buna aagete ababisa babo? Gose Abaisraeli mbaitetwe buna ababisa babo baitetwe?
english: Has [the LORD] struck her as he struck down those who struck her? Has she been killed as those were killed who killed her?

ekegusii: Inee! Gesaku kende kiana koonchoreria chinyasae chiaye, nonya tichiri echi’ekeene? Korende abanto baane bang’onchoreirie inche inde obonene bwabo, banchire egento getari kobakonya.
english: Has a nation ever changed its gods? (Yet they are not gods at all.) But my people have exchanged their Glory for worthless idols.

ekegusii: Gose enyasae ende kero kende gionsi yana korenta egesaku kende korwa ase egati y’ebisaku binde, erinde agekore kebe abanto baye omonyene, buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, abakorererete inwe agwo Misiri? Ase amaiso aino nigo arentete amateemwa, na ebikone, na amakumia, na esegi, na ase okoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire akarenta okoondokia okonene.
english: Has any god ever tried to take for himself one nation out of another nation, by testings, by miraculous signs and wonders, by war, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, or by great and awesome deeds, like all the things the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your very eyes?

ekegusii: Inee! Abanto bande bana koigwa Nyasae ogokwana korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero buna inwe mwaigure, naende mogendererete koba moyo?
english: Has any other people heard the voice of God speaking out of fire, as you have, and lived?

ekegusii: Gose onye omonto ore aiga, oriereire omoiseke boko, ko taramorenta nka bwoye, tiga oyio airane agende nka, tabaisa gochia gokwera ase esegi, na omonto omoao achie koira omoiseke oria.
english: Has anyone become pledged to a woman and not married her? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else marry her."

ekegusii: Gose onye omonto ore aiga osimegete emesabibu ase omogondo oye, nere tararia amatunda korwao, tiga airane agende nka, tabaisa gochia gokwera ase esegi, na omonto omoao achie koria amatunda ’omogondo oye.
english: Has anyone planted a vineyard and not begun to enjoy it? Let him go home, or he may die in battle and someone else enjoy it.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo ebire koba omonyamabera? Inee! Nigo abeire nendamwamu, goika osiekire amabeebe?”
english: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has he in anger withheld his compassion?" Selah

ekegusii: Inee! Obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe mbwaerire kegima? Chiira chiaye nchiaikire omoerio?
english: Has his unfailing love vanished forever? Has his promise failed for all time?

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo takorete bo, oria omoika ogendererete gotigara ime yaye. Ninki oria oyomo aganetie? Nigo aganetie ororeria rwatananwe robe orwa Nyasae. Ase engencho eyio, mwerende mono, erinde onde tabaisa koba oyo otari omwegenwa ase omokungu bw’oboke bwaye.
english: Has not [the LORD] made them one? In flesh and spirit they are his. And why one? Because he was seeking godly offspring. So guard yourself in your spirit, and do not break faith with the wife of your youth.

ekegusii: 'Has not Calno fared like Carchemish? Is not Hamath like Arpad, and Samaria like Damascus?
english: Inee! Omochie o Kalino tobuetwe buna Kari‐Kemisi, na Hamati buna Aripadi, na Samaria buna Damesiki?

ekegusii: Inee! Musa tabaete amachiko? Korende onde oino tari oyobwatete amachiko. Nase ki mokorigia kong’ita?”
english: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?"

ekegusii: Ebinto ebi bionsi ninche nabitongete, ase ayio bionsi pi bikabao. Korende omonto ore omoitongo, ore nomokia bw’ogweitia ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na okoiguswa ase ring’ana riane, oyio nere ndarigererie.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: Has not my hand made all these things, and so they came into being?" declares the LORD. "This is the one I esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit, and trembles at my word.

ekegusii: Inee! Tari okoboko kwane gwakorete ebinto ebi bionsi?
english: Has not my hand made all these things?'

ekegusii: Inee! Abanto bare omwando one nigo babeire buna enyoni ere enkanga ekorigia endagera eetananire ne chinde chire ase orotwari? Genda osangererie ching’iti chi’orosana chionsi chiche koria!
english: Has not my inheritance become to me like a speckled bird of prey that other birds of prey surround and attack? Go and gather all the wild beasts; bring them to devour.

ekegusii: Inee! Endagera tesiriri korwa ase amaiso aito na omogoko na omochengo korwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito?
english: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes-- joy and gladness from the house of our God?

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo eyio erasambwe nomorero, na abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakwerosia gokora emeremo ere bosa. Rora, ayio nigo arure ase Omonene.
english: Has not the LORD Almighty determined that the people's labor is only fuel for the fire, that the nations exhaust themselves for nothing?

ekegusii: Inee! Enyasae ende yonsi y’ebisaku yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane inche omoruoti bw’Abaasuri?
english: Has the god of any nation ever delivered his land from the hand of the king of Assyria?

ekegusii: Inee! Enyomba eye ekorokwa ase erieta riane iyabeire rikuruma ri’abauri asemore? Inche omonyene narorire amang’ana ayio mogokora. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: Has this house, which bears my Name, become a den of robbers to you? But I have been watching! declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Gecha ayare amabe, na mwanche ayare amaya. Motenenere oboronge agwo ase ekegambero kere geita. Komorakore bo, ande nabo Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ararorere abatigari ba Yusufu amabera.
english: Hate evil, love good; maintain justice in the courts. Perhaps the LORD God Almighty will have mercy on the remnant of Joseph.

ekegusii: Hathach went back and reported to Esther what Mordecai had said.
english: Hataki akagenda, agatebia Esteri amang’ana onsi Moredekai atebete.

ekegusii: Obogechi nigo bokorenta eriomana, korende obwanchani nigo bogotuba ebibe bionsi.
english: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers over all wrongs.

ekegusii: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
english: Hatusi, na Sebania, na Maluki;

ekegusii: Amaiso are noboenenu, na enkoro y’obomwenu, ebio nigo bire etaya y’abakori amabe, bikobaraa bakora ebibe.
english: Haughty eyes and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, are sin!

ekegusii: haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,
english: Okorigereria kw’oboenenu, na oromeme rogokwana oborimo, na amaboko agoitera amanyinga atari na komocha;

ekegusii: biakorenteire amang’ana ayio, ekiagera gwakorire obonyaka nabanto b’ebisaku, na ogwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasima emegwekano yabo.
english: have brought this upon you, because you lusted after the nations and defiled yourself with their idols.

ekegusii: Omorente atenene ase obosio bw’Eleazari omokuani, na ase amasio ’omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto, erio ase amasio abo omorarie ng’a nere oirire ribaga riao.
english: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the entire assembly and commission him in their presence.

ekegusii: Inee! Inche natebirie onde ng’a andetere ekeegwa? Gose naboririe onde ng’a arue embooria korwa ase chinibo chiaye?
english: Have I ever said, 'Give something on my behalf, pay a ransom for me from your wealth,

ekegusii: Inee! Tari inche nagochikire ng’a otenene bokung’u, obe omoremu? Ase ayio, toondoka, tobaisa gokwa omoyo, ekiagera inche Omonene, Nyasae oo, nigo inde amo naye aande onsi orabe gokogenda.”
english: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be terrified; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God will be with you wherever you go."

ekegusii: Inee! Tinarerete ase engencho y’abwo barenge ase emechando? Omoyo one tochandekerete abataka?
english: Have I not wept for those in trouble? Has not my soul grieved for the poor?

ekegusii: Have I not written thirty sayings for you, sayings of counsel and knowledge,
english: Inee! Tinkorikereti amang’ana amanene ay’ogosemia na ay’amorokererio?

ekegusii: Have I now become your enemy by telling you the truth?
english: Inee! Nabeire omobisa oino, ekiagera nabatebirie ayare ay’ekeene?

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, indorera amabera, ekiagera nigo nkorera asore omobaso boira.
english: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I call to you all day long.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otororere amabera, koranche otororere amabera, ekiagera twabeire togochecherigwa mono goetania.
english: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

ekegusii: Have no fear of sudden disaster or of the ruin that overtakes the wicked,
english: Tobaisa kwoboa okogosa kogocha mobosokano, gose ogosirigwa kw’abanyabibe kogocha buna omoubera.

ekegusii: Bwetange kegima korwa ase oborimo. Tobaisa kogera omonto omoronge aitwe, ekiagera inche Omonene tingotiga koa omomochi egesusuro.
english: Have nothing to do with a false charge and do not put an innocent or honest person to death, for I will not acquit the guilty.

ekegusii: Korende bwange emegano etari ne chingencho chi’obonyasae eyio yanchire nabakungu abagotu. Bwenarie aye omonyene chingencho chi’obonyasae.
english: Have nothing to do with godless myths and old wives' tales; rather, train yourself to be godly.

ekegusii: Timosanga nogokora kw’omosunte ogotakwama, korende ribaga ri’ayio mokoorokie,
english: Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

ekegusii: Oinyore okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete naintwe; ense nigo eichire nobobe ase kera ensemo y’omosunte.
english: Have regard for your covenant, because haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

ekegusii: Abakuani batano na babere babogorie ebitureri bi’omochengo na bagende bosio bw’Esanduku eria. Rituko ria gatano na kabere motaare, moetanane omochie oyio ara gatano na kabere, na abakuani babugie ebitureri biria.
english: Have seven priests carry trumpets of rams' horns in front of the ark. On the seventh day, march around the city seven times, with the priests blowing the trumpets.

ekegusii: Have the gates of death been shown to you? Have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
english: Kwana kworokigwa ebiita bi’amakweri, gose korora ebisieri bi’ekiriri ki’amakweri?

ekegusii: “Obeke Abalawi babe bagokonya Haroni na abamura baye, obaatanane babe buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa asende inche Omonene.
english: Have the Levites stand in front of Aaron and his sons and then present them as a wave offering to the LORD.

ekegusii: goika arenterwe eanga y’oboruoti, eyio omoruoti anarete kobeka, na ebarasi eyio omoruoti anarete koriina ebekeire egutwa y’oboruoti ase omotwe oye.
english: have them bring a royal robe the king has worn and a horse the king has ridden, one with a royal crest placed on its head.

ekegusii: Chibesa echi chiegwe abateneneri b’emeremo egokorwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, na barabwo bachiee abakori emeremo b’enyomba eyio, baria bakoyeroisia,
english: Have them entrust it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. And have these men pay the workers who repair the temple of the LORD--

ekegusii: Otige barabwo babe bakogambera abanto ebina bia botambe. Ebina ebikong’u birobio bakobirentere, korende ebire ebike babigambe barabwo boka. Ase enchera eyio egurube yao tekoba endito mono, ekiagera barabwo mbayebogorie amo naye.
english: Have them serve as judges for the people at all times, but have them bring every difficult case to you; the simple cases they can decide themselves. That will make your load lighter, because they will share it with you.

ekegusii: Naende barente eeri ensae amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera kw’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta. Naye oire eeri ende ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
english: Have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil; then you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.

ekegusii: Nabwo abaroisia bachiroisie korwa ase chiusi chie chitahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.
english: Have them use gold, and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.

ekegusii: Inee! Intwe twensi titobwati Tata oyomo? Tari ere Nyasae oyomo ototongete? Nase ki rende totari abegenwa intwe ase intwe? Nase ki togosaria okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo Nyasae akorete ne chisokoro chiaito?
english: Have we not all one Father? Did not one God create us? Why do we profane the covenant of our fathers by breaking faith with one another?

ekegusii: Inee! Mokagete ng’a iga togwekengera asemore naende? Ase obosio bwa Nyasae nigo togokwana ase Kristo. Na aya onsi akorirwe ase okobaagacha inwe abanchwa.
english: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? We have been speaking in the sight of God as those in Christ; and everything we do, dear friends, is for your strengthening.

ekegusii: Kwana korengereria igoro y’obogare bw’ense? Onye komanyete ayio onsi, yararie!
english: Have you comprehended the vast expanses of the earth? Tell me, if you know all this.

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo mwebire obobe bwe chisokoro chiaino na obw’abaruoti b’Abayuda, na obw’abakungu babo, na obwaino, na obw’abakungu baino, obwo bwakoretwe ase ense y’Abayuda na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu?
english: Have you forgotten the wickedness committed by your fathers and by the kings and queens of Judah and the wickedness committed by you and your wives in the land of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem?

ekegusii: “Inee! Inwe timori koboria abaeti chinchera, naende mwanchera oborori bwabo,
english: Have you never questioned those who travel? Have you paid no regard to their accounts--

ekegusii: Inee! Tari inwe abanyene mwerenteire emechando eye, ekiagera mwantigire inche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekero naganetie kobaraa ase orogendo rwaino?
english: Have you not brought this on yourselves by forsaking the LORD your God when he led you in the way?

ekegusii: Inee, timokoreti ogwatananeka ase egati yaino inwe abanyene, na mwabeire abagambi, more nebirengererio ebibe?
english: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts?

ekegusii: “Na bono iga mwachakire kondangeria mogoteba: Aye tata, aye naye gwatwanchete korwa obwana bwaito.
english: Have you not just called to me: 'My Father, my friend from my youth,

ekegusii: Inee! Tari amaroro ’obong’ainereria barorire, naende nigo bakoringoria oboringoria bw’oborimo, ekero bagokwana ng’a Omonene otebire bo, na inche Omonene tinkwaneti ayio?
english: Have you not seen false visions and uttered lying divinations when you say, "The LORD declares," though I have not spoken?

ekegusii: Inee! Nkwangire Abayuda kegima? Nigo kwagechire Sayoni? Nase ki gwatoakire, na onde tari ogotogwenia? Nigo twasemeretie konyora omorembe, korende titori koyonyora. Togasemeria okogwenigwa, korende tokaba nomoondoko.
english: Have you rejected Judah completely? Do you despise Zion? Why have you afflicted us so that we cannot be healed? We hoped for peace but no good has come, for a time of healing but there is only terror.

ekegusii: Have you suffered so much for nothing-- if it really was for nothing?
english: Inee! Igo mwanarete emechando emenge enga buna eye bosa? Aande gose tiyarenge bosa.

ekegusii: Inee! Aye omonene one tikwana gotebigwa eke nakorete ekero Yesebeli aitete ababani b’Omonene, buna nabisete ababani b’Omonene rigana erimo ase ebiombe bi’emerongo etano etano ase rikuruma ime, naende nkaba nkobarageria na kobaa amache?
english: Haven't you heard, my lord, what I did while Jezebel was killing the prophets of the LORD? I hid a hundred of the LORD's prophets in two caves, fifty in each, and supplied them with food and water.

ekegusii: Haven't you read this scripture: "'The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone;
english: Nonya neririko eri timorarisoma: “Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.

ekegusii: abakororekana ng’a mbare ne chingencho chi’obonyasae, korende bakaana okobua gwe chingencho echio. Bweatanane korwa ase abwo.
english: having a form of godliness but denying its power. Have nothing to do with them.

ekegusii: ekiagera mwatindegetwe amo nere ase ebatiso. Ase ero boigo mokabokigwa amo nere ase okwegena chinguru chia Nyasae oyomobogetie korwa ase abakure.
english: having been buried with him in baptism and raised with him through your faith in the power of God, who raised him from the dead.

ekegusii: Ekero babarentire bakababeka ase ekegambero. Omokuani omonene akababoria,
english: Having brought the apostles, they made them appear before the Sanhedrin to be questioned by the high priest.

ekegusii: Ere agatinyia ririko riria riarigetwe ase amachiko, riare gotosoera, eriarenge nobobisa asetore; akaritigeria ensemo, akariakerania ase omosalaba.
english: having canceled the written code, with its regulations, that was against us and that stood opposed to us; he took it away, nailing it to the cross.

ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo chiabeire namagandi, bebekire ase chingencho chimbe chi’omobere banyare gokora kera engencho y’eubi ase obwegimeria.
english: Having lost all sensitivity, they have given themselves over to sensuality so as to indulge in every kind of impurity, with a continual lust for more.

ekegusii: Bono Delila akaareria Samison ase amagoro aye, akarangeria omonto ache agingire ebikundo biria bitano na bibere bi’etukia ya Samison. Erio Delila agachaka komotura, korende chinguru chia Samison konya chiarure asare.
english: Having put him to sleep on her lap, she called a man to shave off the seven braids of his hair, and so began to subdue him. And his strength left him.

ekegusii: Erio ekero amoete ribaga, Paulo agatenena ase ebiriinero igoro, akabakiria nokoboko abanto baria. Kabakiririe kegima, agakwana nabarabwo ase omonwa bw’Ekeibirania, agateba,
english: Having received the commander's permission, Paul stood on the steps and motioned to the crowd. When they were all silent, he said to them in Aramaic:

ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nchiayenyorete buna omwando, chikayesoyia amo na Yoshua, ekero bairete ense y’ebisaku biria Nyasae aseretie korwa ase obosio bwe chisokoro chiaito. Nigo babete nero goika amatuko a Daudi,
english: Having received the tabernacle, our fathers under Joshua brought it with them when they took the land from the nations God drove out before them. It remained in the land until the time of David,

ekegusii: Agachia gokoora gokwana aya, agatwera amate inse, agakora etintira ase amate aria, agaaka omouko oria amaiso netintira eria,
english: Having said this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the man's eyes.

ekegusii: Agachia gokoora kobatebia aya, agatigara Galili.
english: Having said this, he stayed in Galilee.

ekegusii: Ekero Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, akwete, Beni‐Hadadi, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Hazael king of Aram died, and Ben-Hadad his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, akaba ogochanda Abaisraeli ase amatuko onsi ay’okogamba kwa Yehoahasi.
english: Hazael king of Aram oppressed Israel throughout the reign of Jehoahaz.

ekegusii: Hasaeli agateba, “Inche omosomba oo, inki ing’isaine? Inche inga buna esese. Naki ndanyare gokora egento buna ekio.” Elisha akamoiraneria, “Omonene onyorokirie ng’a aye nobe omoruoti bw’Abasiiria.”
english: Hazael said, "How could your servant, a mere dog, accomplish such a feat?" "The LORD has shown me that you will become king of Aram," answered Elisha.

ekegusii: Ase igo Hasaeli akagenda korotota Elisha, akamoirera ebiegwa, ebinto ebiya mono bia Damesiki, ebinto biisaine kobogorigwa ne chingamia emerongo ene. Ekero aigete asare, agatenena ase obosio bwaye, agateba, “Omwana oo Beni‐Hadadi, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, ontomire gocha asore gokoboria gose nagwene korwa ase oborwaire bwaye.”
english: Hazael went to meet Elisha, taking with him as a gift forty camel-loads of all the finest wares of Damascus. He went in and stood before him, and said, "Your son Ben-Hadad king of Aram has sent me to ask, 'Will I recover from this illness?'"

ekegusii: Hazar Gaddah, Heshmon, Beth Pelet,
english: na Hasari‐Gada, na Hesimoni, na Beti‐Peleti,

ekegusii: Hazar Shual, Balah, Ezem,
english: na Hasari‐Suali, na Bala, na Esemu,

ekegusii: Hazar Shual, Beersheba, Biziothiah,
english: na Hasari‐Sauli, na Beeri‐Seba, na Bisiotia,

ekegusii: Hazor Hadattah, Kerioth Hezron (that is, Hazor),
english: na Hasori‐Hadata, na Kerioti‐Hezironi (noro Hasari),

ekegusii: Omonene akaanga eema yaye yarenge Silo, eema eria akorete obomenyo bwaye ase egati y’abanto.
english: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent he had set up among men.

ekegusii: Korende akaba omong’aini, akabeka abamura baye bande bakaba abateneneri ase chingongo chionsi chi’Abayuda na echi’Ababenjamin, na ase emechie yonsi yagiteire chindwaki; akabaa endagera na ebinto binde ase obonge, naende akabanyuomeria abakungu abange.
english: He acted wisely, dispersing some of his sons throughout the districts of Judah and Benjamin, and to all the fortified cities. He gave them abundant provisions and took many wives for them.

ekegusii: Naende agatebia omosomba oye, “Eta togende, torore gose ntoike Gibea gose Rama, erio torare aroro ase obotuko obo.”
english: He added, "Come, let's try to reach Gibeah or Ramah and spend the night in one of those places."

ekegusii: He added, "Name your wages, and I will pay them."
english: Bono ntebia eng’eria yao oganetie, na inche ninkoyee.”

ekegusii: Naende agachabera enyomba eria namagena e rigori rinene. Chitahabu chiria nigo chiarwete Parawaimu.
english: He adorned the temple with precious stones. And the gold he used was gold of Parvaim.

ekegusii: Gachia gwancherana nabaremi rituko erimo edinari eyemo, akabaira ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.
english: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.

ekegusii: Akabwatana nere ase okoagacha chimeeri chikogenda Tarisisi. Bagachiagachera agwo Esioni‐Geberi.
english: He agreed with him to construct a fleet of trading ships. After these were built at Ezion Geber,

ekegusii: Omonene oakeire ebitongwa ebio obomera, na okoboko kwaye kwabiatananeire ense nekerengero, ebe eyabo kogenderera botambe, mbigenderere komenya aroro ekiaare ase ekiaare.
english: He allots their portions; his hand distributes them by measure. They will possess it forever and dwell there from generation to generation.

ekegusii: Nyasae tatigete abanto bande babachande; agatogonyera abaruoti ase engencho yabo,
english: He allowed no man to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

ekegusii: Nyasae tatigete abanto bande babachande; agatogonyera abaruoti ase engencho yabo,
english: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

ekegusii: He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.
english: Ere nere bweka egetare kiane, na ogotooreka kwane, nere orwaki rwane, tinkonyegerigwa mono.

ekegusii: He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will not be shaken.
english: Ere bweka negetare kiane, na ogotooreka kwane, na egekengero kiane egekong’u; tinkonyegerigwa.

ekegusii: Nere bweka oramborete igoro chionsi, agachiaara, nere ogotaara igoro ase emerindo y’enyancha.
english: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea.

ekegusii: Akarenta okoruegwa kw’endagera, akaimokia obosie boichire roe, akabosambera ase egesasimero amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kia mambia.
english: He also brought the grain offering, took a handful of it and burned it on the altar in addition to the morning's burnt offering.

ekegusii: Naende akaagacha emerobiri ase erooro, na agakunya chinsoko chinyinge, ekiagera nigo abwate amaicho amange agwo ase ense omweya na ase ense eimokererete igoro eraire, Boigo nabwate abaremi abange, na abakori emeremo b’emegondo y’emesabibu agwo ase chinse chi’ebigoro na ase chinse chintobu, ekiagera nigo anchete oboremi.
english: He also built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns, because he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain. He had people working his fields and vineyards in the hills and in the fertile lands, for he loved the soil.

ekegusii: akaagacha Tadimori agwo ase erooro, amo nemechie yonsi ase baare koagacha ebinto agwo Hamati.
english: He also built up Tadmor in the desert and all the store cities he had built in Hamath.

ekegusii: Inse ase ebinyomba ebio bibere akaooma netahabu.
english: He also covered the floors of both the inner and outer rooms of the temple with gold.

ekegusii: Akaigwera ogosemigwa kwabo, akagenda amo na Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, korwania Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, agwo Ramoti o Gileadi. Abasiiria bagaaka Yoramu chingoma.
english: He also followed their counsel when he went with Joram son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead. The Arameans wounded Joram;

ekegusii: Naboigo ekagera abanto bonsi, abake na abanene, abanda na abataka, abatari abasomba na abasomba, babekwe ekemanyererio ase amaboko abo a borio gose amasio abo igoro,
english: He also forced everyone, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on his right hand or on his forehead,

ekegusii: He also gathered together all the leaders of Israel, as well as the priests and Levites.
english: Daudi agasangereria abaraai bonsi b’Abaisraeli amo nabakuani na Abalawi.

ekegusii: Boigo Moredekai akaa Hataki rirube ririkire amang’ana ’ogochika koria kwaruetwe Susa igoro y’ogosirigwa kw’Abayahudi, erinde orokie Esteri na amotebie amang’ana onsi, boigo amotebie ng’a agende ase omoruoti komosaba amabera ase abanto baye.
english: He also gave him a copy of the text of the edict for their annihilation, which had been published in Susa, to show to Esther and explain it to her, and he told him to urge her to go into the king's presence to beg for mercy and plead with him for her people.

ekegusii: Agasaba abarwani chituoni chilifu rigana erimo (100,000) korwa ase Abaisraeli, akabaakanera chifeta chitalanta rigana erimo.
english: He also hired a hundred thousand fighting men from Israel for a hundred talents of silver.

ekegusii: Agachika naende oyo o kabere, na oyo o gatato, na abande bonsi abaare gotunyana amaicho, akabatebia, “Motebie Esau amang’ana ayio ayio ekero mokoumerana nere.
english: He also instructed the second, the third and all the others who followed the herds: "You are to say the same thing to Esau when you meet him.

ekegusii: Obedi‐Edomu na abanto bamwabo nigo barenge emerongo etano nomo, na batano na batato. Ere Obedi‐Edomu mosinto o Yedutuni, na Hosea, bakabekwa bakaba abarendi b’egeita.
english: He also left Obed-Edom and his sixty-eight associates to minister with them. Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun, and also Hosah, were gatekeepers.

ekegusii: He also made buildings to store the harvest of grain, new wine and oil; and he made stalls for various kinds of cattle, and pens for the flocks.
english: Boigo akeagachera ebiage bie chindagera chiagesetwe, na ebigachero bi’edivai na ebi’amaguta ’amazeituni, na ameri e chitugo ao ao, amo naye ching’ondi.

ekegusii: Naende Hiramu akaroisia ebibekerero ikomi bi’ebituba korwa ase chitaai. Obotambe bwa kera ekebekerero nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ane, na obogare bwaye amaboko ane, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko atato.
english: He also made ten movable stands of bronze; each was four cubits long, four wide and three high.

ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia ebituba, na ebichiko, na ebitaabo. Naboigo agakoora emeremo yonsi eyaetwe na Sulemani ng’a akore ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: He also made the basins and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished all the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of the LORD:

ekegusii: Huramu akaroisia chindogio na ebichiko, ne chisani. Naboigo Huramu agakoora emeremo aetwe na Sulemani akore ase enyomba ya Nyasae:
english: He also made the pots and shovels and sprinkling bowls. So Huram finished the work he had undertaken for King Solomon in the temple of God:

ekegusii: Naende akagoncha chinguba chinke amagana atato, agachioma ne chitahabu chisunyuntire, na kera enguba ekaira etahabu ang’e chikiro inye. Omoruoti agachibeka ime ase enyomba ekarokwa Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni.
english: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three hundred bekas of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.

ekegusii: Naende akagoncha chinguba amagana atato agachiooma ne chitahabu chisunyuntire, na kera enguba nigo yarenge koira chitahabu ang’e chikiro ibere. Omoruoti agachibeka ime ase Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni.
english: He also made three hundred small shields of hammered gold, with three minas of gold in each shield. The king put them in the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon.

ekegusii: Naende akaroisia ebisure bibere bi’etaai enyititoire na kobombwa, akabibeka igoro ye chisiiro; obotambe gochia igoro bwa kera egesure nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano.
english: He also made two capitals of cast bronze to set on the tops of the pillars; each capital was five cubits high.

ekegusii: na ebisieri bibere bi’emetarakwa; kera egesieri nigo kiarenge ebing’ese bibere biare konyara koigorwa biaringanigwa.
english: He also made two pine doors, each having two leaves that turned in sockets.

ekegusii: Boigo akarenta chibao chi’emecharake chitare kobareka, ekiagera Abasidoni nigo barenterete Daudi emecharake emenge mono.
english: He also provided more cedar logs than could be counted, for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought large numbers of them to David.

ekegusii: He also pulled down the tower of Peniel and killed the men of the town.
english: Erio agatagora omorobiri agwo Penueli, na agaita abasacha b’omochie oria.

ekegusii: Boigo Saulo agaita nomoro abanto bonsi barenge agwo Nobu, omochie bw’abakuani. Agaita abasacha, na abakungu, na abana amo nabwo bakogonka, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi.
english: He also put to the sword Nob, the town of the priests, with its men and women, its children and infants, and its cattle, donkeys and sheep.

ekegusii: Zedekia akaanga koigwera Nebukadinesaro omoruoti, oria omoboretie gotiana ase erieta ria Nyasae. Agekora omonyabigoti bikong’u, na enkoro yaye ekaenena, tancha komoiranera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: He also rebelled against King Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him take an oath in God's name. He became stiff-necked and hardened his heart and would not turn to the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Naende akaba okogamba ase Ekerubo Ekiomo, moocha y’enyancha ya Kinereti goika Beti‐Yesimoti, ensemo ya moocha y’Enyancha y’Omonyo, eyere ase Ekerubo Ekiomo, gochia irianyi goika ebitirimboko bi’egetunwa gia Pisiga.
english: He also ruled over the eastern Arabah from the Sea of Kinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea), to Beth Jeshimoth, and then southward below the slopes of Pisgah.

ekegusii: Erio akamotebia, “Inche ninche Omonene, nakorusetie korwa ase Uru y’Abakalidayo, ninkoe ense eye ebe omwando oo.”
english: He also said to him, "I am the LORD, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to take possession of it."

ekegusii: Naende agateba, “Omonene, Nyasae o Shemu, nasesenigwe, na Kanani abe omosomba oye.
english: He also said, "Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem! May Canaan be the slave of Shem.

ekegusii: Naende Boazi akamotebia, “Renta egetambaa ekio bwambarete, okiaare.” Na Rutu agakiaara. Erio Boazi akamorengera esairi eisaine ebitita bitano na ekemo, akamoyetweka. Erio omokungu oria akairana gochia ase omochie.
english: He also said, "Bring me the shawl you are wearing and hold it out." When she did so, he poured into it six measures of barley and put it on her. Then he went back to town.

ekegusii: Erio akabora, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro ase riroba.
english: He also said, "This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.

ekegusii: Akarora omoboraka oyomo omotaka, okobeka ebisabwa bibere bie chitaai.
english: He also saw a poor widow put in two very small copper coins.

ekegusii: Naende, “Naye Omonene, kwabegete oboroso bw’ense korwa omochakano, na igoro chionsi nemeremo y’amaboko ao.
english: He also says, "In the beginning, O Lord, you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

ekegusii: Akagenda, agatoma amang’ana gochia ase Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agateba, “Omoruoti bw’Abamoabu bwangire konyigwera. Inee! Aye nogende amo nainche torwanie abanto ba Moabu?” Yehosafati akairaneria, “Ee, ningende amo naye, na abanto baane amo nabanto bao, ne chibarasi chiane amo ne chibarasi chiao.”
english: He also sent this message to Jehoshaphat king of Judah: "The king of Moab has rebelled against me. Will you go with me to fight against Moab?" "I will go with you," he replied. "I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."
