ekegusii: Akabeka abarendi bakorenda ebiita bi’enyomba y’Omonene na gotanga omonto onde bwensi otachenegete tasoa ime.
english: He also stationed doorkeepers at the gates of the LORD's temple so that no one who was in any way unclean might enter.

ekegusii: Akabatebia omoreng’anio, “Inee! Omouko nonyare koraa omouko onde? Tibakogwa bonsi babere ase engoro?
english: He also told them this parable: "Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?

ekegusii: Erio Musa akaimokia ritaana, akarisungusia ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene. Nigo riabete egetari kiaye kiarusetiwge korwa ase emingichi eria yaruetwe ase ogwatanana abakuani. Ase igo Musa agakora buna Omonene amochigete.
english: He also took the breast-- Moses' share of the ordination ram-- and waved it before the LORD as a wave offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Agatagora na koiyeria inse chinyomba chi’abasacha abanyaka baare korigania ase obosooku, echio chiarenge ase enyomba y’Omonene. (Ime ase chinyomba chiria abakungu barenge koroiseria Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, chiema.)
english: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes, which were in the temple of the LORD and where women did weaving for Asherah.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bagasangereria omoganda bwonsi bosio bw’egetare keria, akabatebia, “Igwa inwe abasaria aba! Inee! Nkobasokeria tore amache korwa ase egetare eke?”
english: He and Aaron gathered the assembly together in front of the rock and Moses said to them, "Listen, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?"

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omonto omuya, omoirogete Nyasae, ere amo nab’enyomba yaye bonsi. Nigo are koa abanto ebiegwa ebinge na kogenderera gosaba Nyasae botambe.
english: He and all his family were devout and God-fearing; he gave generously to those in need and prayed to God regularly.

ekegusii: Ere na abanto abwo bonsi barenge komo bakagenda Baala‐Yuda kwoyia Esanduku ya Nyasae, eyio ekorokwa ase erieta ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda, oyomenyete nobonene igoro y’abakerubi.
english: He and all his men set out from Baalah of Judah to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the Name, the name of the LORD Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim that are on the ark.

ekegusii: Erio agatiirera egetunwa gia Salimoni amo nabanto baye bonsi, akaimokia egesire, akagecha chinsagia chi’emete, agachibeka ase amareko aye. Naende agatebia abanto baye, “Aya morarore inche ngokora, nainwe mokore boigo, na moyakore bwango!”
english: he and all his men went up Mount Zalmon. He took an ax and cut off some branches, which he lifted to his shoulders. He ordered the men with him, "Quick! Do what you have seen me do!"

ekegusii: Omoruoti oyio amo nabanto baye, abanto abatindi mono goetania ab’ebisaku binde, mbarentwe basarie Misiri kegima. Nigo baraite abanto b’aroro nemioro, na ense eyio eichorwe nebitondo.
english: He and his army-- the most ruthless of nations-- will be brought in to destroy the land. They will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.

ekegusii: Ere amo noria omogorete babare emiaka gochakera korwa ekero eoonetie goika ekero ki’Omwaka bw’Omochengo oraike, erio bakore rigori ri’okoboorigwa kwaye, koreng’ana nemiaka eyio na koreng’ana neng’eria y’omonto orikire.
english: He and his buyer are to count the time from the year he sold himself up to the Year of Jubilee. The price for his release is to be based on the rate paid to a hired man for that number of years.

ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo kw’omorembe nkobe asare ere, na ase ororeria rwaye, okobwatana kwa botambe kw’obokuani, ekiagera abete ne risemi ase engencho yane, inche Nyasae oye, naende agakora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli.”
english: He and his descendants will have a covenant of a lasting priesthood, because he was zealous for the honor of his God and made atonement for the Israelites."

ekegusii: Naama! Abatunyani bonsi b’emegwekano eyio mbasookigwe, na abakoyeroisia nigo bare mwanyabanto. Abwo bonsi tiga basangererekane amo, bache bosio; bonsi amo nigo baraondoke, basooke.
english: He and his kind will be put to shame; craftsmen are nothing but men. Let them all come together and take their stand; they will be brought down to terror and infamy.

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti oria amo nabanto baye bakaondoka mono; ekiagera Gibeoni nigo orenge omochie omonene buna omochie onde bwonsi obwate omoruoti; nomonene orenge kobua Ai, na abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi nigo barenge ne chinguru chi’okorwana.
english: He and his people were very much alarmed at this, because Gibeon was an important city, like one of the royal cities; it was larger than Ai, and all its men were good fighters.

ekegusii: Ere akairaneria mokaye, “Nekiagera nakwana na Naboti Omoyesireeli, nkamoteiba ng’a ang’e omogondo oye bw’emesabibu, na inche imoe omogondo onde bw’emesabibu ribaga ri’oyoye, gose onye ogwancha imoe chibesa, korende akaanga, tancha kong’a omogondo oye bw’emesabibu.”
english: He answered her, "Because I said to Naboth the Jezreelite, 'Sell me your vineyard; or if you prefer, I will give you another vineyard in its place.' But he said, 'I will not give you my vineyard.'"

ekegusii: Omonene akang’iraneria, agantebia, “Ebibe bi’Abaisraeli na Abayuda nigo bire ebinene mono. Ense nigo eichire nogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, na omochie nigo oichire nobokorekanu bw’ogosaria amachiko, ekiagera abanto nigo bagoteba: Omonene otigire ense eye, ere tari korora kende.
english: He answered me, "The sin of the house of Israel and Judah is exceedingly great; the land is full of bloodshed and the city is full of injustice. They say, 'The LORD has forsaken the land; the LORD does not see.'

ekegusii: Korende akabairaneria, “Ekegori ekebe ki’obotomani kerigetie egekone, korende tigekoegwa egekone otatiga eki’omobani Yona.
english: He answered, "A wicked and adulterous generation asks for a miraculous sign! But none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Kera omonto oratige mokaye, na kunyuoma oyonde, otomanire igoro asare:
english: He answered, "Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.

ekegusii: Erio akang’iraneria, akamboria, “Inee! Tomanyeti engencho y’ebinto ebi?” Nkamoiraneria, “Yaya, omonene one, timanyeti.”
english: He answered, "Do you not know what these are?" "No, my lord," I replied.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete ekero aremeretwe endagera, akaba nenchara, ere na abwo barenge amo nere,
english: He answered, "Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete, ekero arenge nenchara, ere na abarenge amo nere,
english: He answered, "Haven't you read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Inche n’Omoibirania inde, na nigo inyirogete Omonene, Nyasae o igoro, oyo otongete enyancha na ense enyomo.”
english: He answered, "I am a Hebrew and I worship the LORD, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the land."

ekegusii: He answered, "I have told you already and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples, too?"
english: Akabairaneria, “Naikire kobatebia, ko timontegerereti. Naki morigetie koyaigwa eria kabere? Inwe boigo morigetie koba aborokigwa baye?”

ekegusii: Ere akamoiraneria, “Nigo naigwa eriogi riao kogotaara ase omogondo, noboa ekiagera ngetirianda nare; ase ayio nebisa.”
english: He answered, "I heard you in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid."

ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nigo natometwe ase ching’ondi chinsiru chi’enyomba ya Israeli chioka.”
english: He answered, "I was sent only to the lost sheep of Israel."

ekegusii: Baalamu akamoiraneria, “Inee! Tiyangwenerete inyigwere na gokwana amang’ana aria Omonene agontebia nkwane?”
english: He answered, "Must I not speak what the LORD puts in my mouth?"

ekegusii: Korende Hobabu akairaneria, “Tinkogenda amo nainwe; inche nigo nkoirana ngende ase ense yane, na ase abanto b’eamate yane.”
english: He answered, "No, I will not go; I am going back to my own land and my own people."

ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Oyogosimeka embusuro engiya n’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto;
english: He answered, "The one who sowed the good seed is the Son of Man.

ekegusii: Omogendi oria akamoiraneria, “Igo tokorwa Bethlehemu o Yuda, tokogenda rogoro kegima ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, nao seito. Igo nagenda Bethlehemu o Yuda, na bono nkogenda inde ase enyomba ya Nyasae. Onde tari bwanchire gonsoyia nyomba mwaye.
english: He answered, "We are on our way from Bethlehem in Judah to a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim where I live. I have been to Bethlehem in Judah and now I am going to the house of the LORD. No one has taken me into his house.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Ee, ekero omwana arenge moyo, nabo neng’atete na korera, nigo narengereretie ng’a ande Omonene nandorere amabera, erinde omwana abe moyo.
english: He answered, "While the child was still alive, I fasted and wept. I thought, 'Who knows? The LORD may be gracious to me and let the child live.'

ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Mwanche Omonene Nyasae oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, ne chinguru chiao chionsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi, na omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”
english: He answered: "'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind'; and, 'Love your neighbor as yourself.'"

ekegusii: Agachora abagambi ebina ase ense eria yonsi, akababeka ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda yagiteire chindwaki, omochie ase omochie,
english: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.

ekegusii: Akabeka abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi igoro ase abanto, akabasangereria amo agwo ase eraaro ase egeita ki’omochie, agakwana nabarabwo, akabaremia, ogoteba,
english: He appointed military officers over the people and assembled them before him in the square at the city gate and encouraged them with these words:

ekegusii: Naende agachora abanto bande b’Abalawi bakaba abakoreri bosio bw’Esanduku eria y’Omonene, bakaba bagotogia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono na komobaka.
english: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, to make petition, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:

ekegusii: Akabeka abakuani ase emeremo yabo na akabaseegeta bakore emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: He appointed the priests to their duties and encouraged them in the service of the LORD's temple.

ekegusii: Agachora ikomi na babere, banyare, koba amo nere, erinde anyare kobatoma bagende korandia,
english: He appointed twelve-- designating them apostles--that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach

ekegusii: Agachoka chinko, akanachana eeri eria ebitari, akabibeka igoro ase chinko. Erio akabatebia, “Ichoria chinyongo inye namache, na moyaumore igoro ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na igoro ase chinko.”
english: He arranged the wood, cut the bull into pieces and laid it on the wood. Then he said to them, "Fill four large jars with water and pour it on the offering and on the wood."

ekegusii: Ere akaboria Amunoni, “Aye omwana bw’omoruoti, naki okana‐korea iga nomoichano, rituko ase rituko? Togontebia rende?” Amunoni akamoiraneria, “Nigo imwanchete Tamari, omoiseke omwabo Abisalomu, momura ominto.”
english: He asked Amnon, "Why do you, the king's son, look so haggard morning after morning? Won't you tell me?" Amnon said to him, "I'm in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister."

ekegusii: Agasaba ebao y’okorika, akarika “Yohana, nario erieta riaye.” Bagakumia bonsi.
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and to everyone's astonishment he wrote, "His name is John."

ekegusii: Sisera agasaba amache, erio Yaeli akamoa amabeere, akamoa amaguta amabeere are ase egetaabo ekiya.
english: He asked for water, and she gave him milk; in a bowl fit for nobles she brought him curdled milk.

ekegusii: Erio akamboria, “Aye mwanyabanto, amauga aya nanyare koba moyo?” Nkairaneria, nkamotebia: “Aye Omonene Nyasae, naye omanyete.”
english: He asked me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" I said, "O Sovereign LORD, you alone know."

ekegusii: Omonto oria akamboria, “Aye mwanyabanto, kwarorire aya?” Erio akang’irania, akang’etia mbarabare ase engegu y’orooche orwo.
english: He asked me, "Son of man, do you see this?" Then he led me back to the bank of the river.

ekegusii: Omomalaika oria akamboria, “Ninki oroche?” Nkairaneria, nkamotebia, “Nigo ndoche ebuku eringanirie ekoiruruka; obotambe bwaye nobw’amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare bwaye amaboko ikomi.”
english: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a flying scroll, thirty feet long and fifteen feet wide."

ekegusii: Ere akamboria, “Ninki oroche?” Nkairaneria, nkamotebia, “Nigo ndoche ekebekerero gie chitaya keroiseirie etahabu yoka, na igoro yaye egetaabo ki’amaguta ngeterekereireo, ne chitaya isano na ibere nchireo, na emebirangwa etano na ebere ekorenta amaguta nigo esoete ase kera etaya ebekire igoro yaye.
english: He asked me, "What do you see?" I answered, "I see a solid gold lampstand with a bowl at the top and seven lights on it, with seven channels to the lights.

ekegusii: akamoboria, “Nase ki omoruoti arure ogochika ogotindi iga?” Erio Arioki agatebia Danieli amang’ana onsi.
english: He asked the king's officer, "Why did the king issue such a harsh decree?" Arioch then explained the matter to Daniel.

ekegusii: Ere akamotebia Omonene, “Nase ki gwankoreire inche, omosomba oo, obobe obo iga? Naende ntanyoreti ogwancherwa asore. Nase ki kwang’eire emeremo emenene ase okoraa abanto aba?
english: He asked the LORD, "Why have you brought this trouble on your servant? What have I done to displease you that you put the burden of all these people on me?

ekegusii: Omoadulamu oria akaboria abanto b’aase aria, “Ng’ai are omokungu oria omotayayi, oyorenge aa Enaimu enchera ensemo?” Bakamokania, “Omokungu omotayayi tana koba aa.”
english: He asked the men who lived there, "Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?" "There hasn't been any shrine prostitute here," they said.

ekegusii: He asked them how they were, and then he said, "How is your aged father you told me about? Is he still living?"
english: Akabakwania, akababoria, “Inee! Iso mbuya are, omogaaka oria mwantebia? Moyo are?”

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mang’ana ki aya mokoborania ase orogendo rwaino?” Bagatenena, baichanete.
english: He asked them, "What are you discussing together as you walk along?" They stood still, their faces downcast.

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ngosemia ki morang’e? Ninki ndairanerie abanto aba bamboretie ng’a inyororobie chigurube chiria tata ababekerete?”
english: He asked them, "What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, 'Lighten the yoke your father put on us'?"

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ngosemia ki morang’e? Ninki ndairanerie abanto aba bamboretie ng’a nyororobie rikorogoto riria tata ababekerete?”
english: He asked them, "What is your advice? How should we answer these people who say to me, 'Lighten the yoke your father put on us'?"

ekegusii: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.
english: Igo amoboretie aya, erinde amoteeme, ekiagera namanyete ere omonyene eki arakore.

ekegusii: Akagosaba ng’a omoe obogima, naye okabomoa; okamoa amatuko amange amenye kogenderera botambe.
english: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him-- length of days, for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Akabeka abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bakaba bakobogoria chigurube, ne chilifu emerongo etano na etato (80,000) bakaba bakobaacha amagena ase ebitunwa, ne chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600) bakaba bagotebereria abanto bakore emeremo.
english: He assigned 70,000 of them to be carriers and 80,000 to be stonecutters in the hills, with 3,600 foremen over them to keep the people working.

ekegusii: Erio bwango akaira abarwani na abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akaminyoka gochia asebare. Na barabwo bagachia korora omotang’ani oria omonene na abarwani, bagatiga goaka Paulo.
english: He at once took some officers and soldiers and ran down to the crowd. When the rioters saw the commander and his soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.

ekegusii: Akabasanyorera, akabaaka bobe mono, agaita abange. Erio agatirimboka, akagenda komenya ase rikuruma ri’egetare gi’Etamu.
english: He attacked them viciously and slaughtered many of them. Then he went down and stayed in a cave in the rock of Etam.

ekegusii: agaaka abachandi baye bagatama gochia ase barwete, akababeka ase obosooku goika kare na kare.
english: He beat back his enemies; he put them to everlasting shame.

ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli, akababeka ase amaboko ’Abafilisti na ay’Abaamoni,
english: he became angry with them. He sold them into the hands of the Philistines and the Ammonites,

ekegusii: Akaba nenchara, akagania endagera arie. Korende ekero barenge koyeroisia, akabwatwa nobogondereria,
english: He became hungry and wanted something to eat, and while the meal was being prepared, he fell into a trance.

ekegusii: Agachaka koagacha ase rituko ria kabere ri’omotienyi o kabere bw’omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kwaye.
english: He began building on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.

ekegusii: He began to call down curses on himself, and he swore to them, "I don't know this man you're talking about."
english: Agachaka kweragereria na gotiana, “Timanyeti omonto oyio mogoteba.”

ekegusii: Agachaka gokwana noboremu ase esinagogi. Korende ekero Priskila na Akwila bachia komoigwa bakamoira mwabo, bakamworokia enchera ya Nyasae boronge kegima.
english: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they invited him to their home and explained to him the way of God more adequately.

ekegusii: Agakora kera okogechia ase ogotunyana emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, buna Abaamori bakorete, baria Omonene aseretie korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli.
english: He behaved in the vilest manner by going after idols, like the Amorites the LORD drove out before Israel.)

ekegusii: agatung’ama, akarora ebitambaa bireo, korende tasoa ime.
english: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.

ekegusii: Nigo akorua embura yatwa igoro ase ense, na emegondo yanyora amache.
english: He bestows rain on the earth; he sends water upon the countryside.

ekegusii: Rituko erio akabasesenia, akabora, “Ekero ogosesenigwa kogokwanwa ase Abaisraeli, abanto baatore amarieta aino na goteba: Nyasae abakore mobe buna Efraimu na Manase.” Agwo agwo agatang’ania Efraimu ase obosio bwa Manase.
english: He blessed them that day and said, "In your name will Israel pronounce this blessing: 'May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.'" So he put Ephraim ahead of Manasseh.

ekegusii: Omonene akabasesenia bakabucha mono, tatigete omobaro bwe chitugo chiabo okee.
english: he blessed them, and their numbers greatly increased, and he did not let their herds diminish.

ekegusii: Omonto omokori ebibe nigo agwetogeria okogania okobe gw’enkoro yaye; na omonto ore ne ribero nigo akoragereria Omonene na komochaya.
english: He boasts of the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.

ekegusii: Akagora egetunwa gia Samaria korwa ase Semeri ase rigori rie chitalanta ibere chie chifeta, akaagacha omochie igoro yaye, akayogitera chindwaki, akaroka omochie oria aagachete Samaria, erieta ria Semeri, oyio orenge omonyene egetunwa keria.
english: He bought the hill of Samaria from Shemer for two talents of silver and built a city on the hill, calling it Samaria, after Shemer, the name of the former owner of the hill.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agokeyia abare abaenenu ase ense, abaruoti bonsi b’ense nigo bamwoboete.
english: He breaks the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agokeyia abagambi baba bosa, na abagambi ebina b’ense boigo baba bosa.
english: He brings princes to naught and reduces the rulers of this world to nothing.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokora ayio aba bo, ase okorua ebisusuro bi’okorongeyia, gose ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye.
english: He brings the clouds to punish men, or to water his earth and show his love.

ekegusii: Egatagora chiburi chiabo chinkong’u, egasiria emechie yabo ekaba bosa. Ekero endo eyio yarenge koruma, ense yonsi ekaba egoichana amo nabanto bonsi bamenyeteo.
english: He broke down their strongholds and devastated their towns. The land and all who were in it were terrified by his roaring.

ekegusii: Erio gekabutora nenkoro y’omote oria mesia, gekayeira gochia ase ense y’oboonchoreria, gekayebeka ase omochie bw’abaonchoreria.
english: he broke off its topmost shoot and carried it away to a land of merchants, where he planted it in a city of traders.

ekegusii: Akarenta abakuani na Abalawi, akabasangereria amo agwo ase eraaro, ensemo ya moocha,
english: He brought in the priests and the Levites, assembled them in the square on the east side

ekegusii: Akarenta ase enyomba ya Nyasae ebiegwa ebi ise na ere omonyene baatananete koba ebichenu, chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebikorero.
english: He brought into the temple of God the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.

ekegusii: Akarenta ase enyomba y’Omonene ebiegwa ebi ise na ere omonyene baatananete bikaba ebichenu, chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebikorero.
english: He brought into the temple of the LORD the silver and gold and the articles that he and his father had dedicated.

ekegusii: Akang’ira aase arenge aagare, agantooria, ekiagera namogogetie.”
english: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

ekegusii: Akang’ira aase arenge aagare; agantooria, ekiagera namogogetie.
english: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

ekegusii: Erio akang’ira ase egesona gie Hekalu, akarenga emetobwa yabekireo, na kera oyomo okaba obogare bw’amaboko atano. Obogare bw’egeita nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atato ensemo eyemo, na atato ensemo ende.
english: He brought me to the portico of the temple and measured the jambs of the portico; they were five cubits wide on either side. The width of the entrance was fourteen cubits and its projecting walls were three cubits wide on either side.

ekegusii: Ase igo akang’anyia abanto baye korwa ase ense eria bakaba bagochenga, abanto abwo baye achorete bakaba bagotera nomogoko.
english: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa aroro bare ne chifeta ne chitahabu, monto onde tarenge ase abanto baye oborire chinguru.
english: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.

ekegusii: Agatubokia chindooche korwa ase ebitare ime, na amache agatirimboka buna aye chindooche chinene.
english: he brought streams out of a rocky crag and made water flow down like rivers.

ekegusii: Naende akarenta eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, akayerua buna konya achikirwe.
english: He brought the burnt offering and offered it in the prescribed way.

ekegusii: Akabarusia korwa ase omosunte ekerima, akabutora chingataare basibeire.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the deepest gloom and broke away their chains.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akarenta omoruoti bw’Abakalidayo oyobarwanetie, agaita abana babo abamura nomoro, agwo ase Hekalu yabo Enchenu, na tabete namabera ase onde bwensi, abamura gose abaiseke abekungi, ase abagotu gose abare ne chinguru. Bonsi bakabekwa ase amaboko ’omoruoti bw’Abakalidayo.
english: He brought up against them the king of the Babylonians, who killed their young men with the sword in the sanctuary, and spared neither young man nor young woman, old man or aged. God handed all of them over to Nebuchadnezzar.

ekegusii: Agatorenta ase ense eye entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, agatoyea.
english: He brought us to this place and gave us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey;

ekegusii: Naende akaagacha ebisasimero ase enyomba y’Omonene ime, agwo ase Omonene akwanete igoro yaye agateba, “Ase Yerusalemu nao ndabeke erieta riane.”
english: He built altars in the temple of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, "In Jerusalem I will put my Name."

ekegusii: Naende akaagacha ebisasimero ase enyomba y’Omonene ime, agwo ase Omonene akwanete igoro yaye, “Ase Yerusalemu nao ndabeke erieta riane kare na kare.”
english: He built altars in the temple of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, "My Name will remain in Jerusalem forever."

ekegusii: Aroro akaagacha obomenyo bwaye obochenu bobeere igoro mono, nabobe obokong’u buna ense ekong’irie kogenderera botambe.
english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he established forever.

ekegusii: Akaroisia Aase Aachenu Mono, akanyomba karia ka ime. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwareng’aine na obogare bw’enyomba, amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare boigo amaboko emerongo ebere; agakaooma ne chitahabu chingiya chie chitalanta amagana atano na rimo.
english: He built the Most Holy Place, its length corresponding to the width of the temple-- twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide. He overlaid the inside with six hundred talents of fine gold.

ekegusii: Akaagacha enyomba ekorokwa Enyomba ye Rinani ria Lebanoni. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato. Ero nigo yaagachetwe amo ne chisiiro chi’emecharake chindwaro inye. Igoro ase chisiiro echio emiamba y’emecharake yabaachetwe ekabekwa.
english: He built the Palace of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty wide and thirty high, with four rows of cedar columns supporting trimmed cedar beams.

ekegusii: Naende akaagacha Enyomba y’Ekerogo ki’Oboruoti, eye ekarokwa naende Enyomba y’Ekegambero aase arenge kogambera ebina. Eye nigo yatubetwe ne chibao chi’emecharake korwa inse goika igoro.
english: He built the throne hall, the Hall of Justice, where he was to judge, and he covered it with cedar from floor to ceiling.

ekegusii: Boigo akaagacha emechie ase ense y’ebigoro, na ase amanani akaagacha chiburi na emerobiri.
english: He built towns in the Judean hills and forts and towers in the wooded areas.

ekegusii: Erio akaagacha omochie goetanana onsi korwa Milo, okaba egesingo kegima; na Yoabu akaroisia omochie ase konya otagokire.
english: He built up the city around it, from the supporting terraces to the surrounding wall, while Joab restored the rest of the city.

ekegusii: Akaagacha emechie yagiteire chindwaki agwo ase ense ya Yuda, ekiagera ense eria nigo yarenge nobotoereru; tabwate chisegi ase amatuko aria, ekiagera Omonene amoete omorembe.
english: He built up the fortified cities of Judah, since the land was at peace. No one was at war with him during those years, for the LORD gave him rest.

ekegusii: He built villages and acquired great numbers of flocks and herds, for God had given him very great riches.
english: Akenyorera emechie emenge, na amaicho amange, ekiagera Nyasae konya omoeire obotenenku obonge mono.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotindeka agwo ase rikura ri’ense ya Moabu kororia Beti‐Peori; korende goika rero iga monto onde tari omanyete embeera yaye.
english: He buried him in Moab, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, but to this day no one knows where his grave is.

ekegusii: Agasamba ubani agwo ase Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu. Naende agasamba abana baye bakaba ekeng’wanso, koreng’ana nogokora gw’okogechia okwo abanto banarete gokora, baria Omonene aseretie korwa ase amasio ’Abaisraeli.
english: He burned sacrifices in the Valley of Ben Hinnom and sacrificed his sons in the fire, following the detestable ways of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Agasambera amauga ’abakuani babo igoro ase ebisasimero biabo, agachena ense y’Abayuda na Yerusalemu.
english: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and so he purged Judah and Jerusalem.

ekegusii: He called a little child and had him stand among them.
english: Akarangeria omwana, akamobeka gati‐gati yabo,

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arentete enchara ase ense, na asiretie chindagera chiabo chionsi,
english: He called down famine on the land and destroyed all their supplies of food;

ekegusii: Amunoni akarangeria omomura ore komokorera, akamotebia, “Rusia omokungu oyo aa asende, omoire isiko, osieke egesieri bokung’u.”
english: He called his personal servant and said, "Get this woman out of here and bolt the door after her."

ekegusii: Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere bache asare, akabaa okobua ase ebirecha ebibe na kobiseria, na kogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi.
english: He called his twelve disciples to him and gave them authority to drive out evil spirits and to heal every disease and sickness.

ekegusii: Ere agaaka eriogi rinene, agateba: Gecha omote oyio na onache chinsagia chiaye, osose amato aye na osiarere amatunda aye; ching’iti chi’orosana chitame korwa aroro, ne chinyoni chirue ase chinsagia chiaye.
english: He called in a loud voice: 'Cut down the tree and trim off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Let the animals flee from under it and the birds from its branches.

ekegusii: Ere akayeroka Seba; na ase engencho eyio omochie oyio nigo okorokwa Beeri‐Seba goika rero iga.
english: He called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the town has been Beersheba.

ekegusii: Daudi akarangeria abarwani abwo b’esegi, na Abineri, mosinto o Neri, akabora, “Abineri, tori goitaba?” Abineri akairaneria, “Naye ng’o okorangeria omoruoti?”
english: He called out to the army and to Abner son of Ner, "Aren't you going to answer me, Abner?" Abner replied, "Who are you who calls to the king?"

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akababoria, “Abana, more neki mokoria?” Bakamoiraneria, “Yaya.”
english: He called out to them, "Friends, haven't you any fish?" "No," they answered.

ekegusii: He called out, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
english: Agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorera amabera!”

ekegusii: Aase aria akaaroka Beteli. Korende ritang’ani omochie oria nigo ore korokwa Lusu.
english: He called that place Bethel, though the city used to be called Luz.

ekegusii: Akabasangereria abwo amo nabande ab’emeremo eria, akabora, “Inwe abasacha, mwamanyire ng’a obotenenku bwaito nigo bokorwa ase emeremo eye.
english: He called them together, along with the workmen in related trades, and said: "Men, you know we receive a good income from this business.

ekegusii: Naende agasangereria amo abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni na Abalawi.
english: He called together the descendants of Aaron and the Levites:

ekegusii: Agasangereria abakuani na Abalawi, akabatebia, “Kera omwaka, genda ase emechie y’Abayuda, mosangererie chibesa korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, chibe ase okoroiseria enyomba ya Nyasae oino; mokore ayio ase obwango.” Korende Abalawi tibakorete ring’ana erio ase obwango.
english: He called together the priests and Levites and said to them, "Go to the towns of Judah and collect the money due annually from all Israel, to repair the temple of your God. Do it now." But the Levites did not act at once.

ekegusii: Ase aya naro abarangereretie inwe goetera ase enchili eye twabaranderetie, erinde monyore obonene bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: He called you to this through our gospel, that you might share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Agacha korandia omorembe asemore abamwarenge are, na ase abwo barenge ang’e.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far away and peace to those who were near.

ekegusii: Emanwa y’Eng’ondi agacha, akabogoria ebuku eria korwa ase okoboko gw’okorio kw’oyoikaransete ase ekerogo keria ki’obonene.
english: He came and took the scroll from the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

ekegusii: Oyo nigo achete abe kirori, erinde aorokie omobaso, bonsi banyare kwegena goetera asere.
english: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all men might believe.

ekegusii: Agaika Deribe na Listra. Narengeo omworokigwa oyomo, erieta riaye Timotheo, omwana bw’omokungu Omoyahudi, korende ise n’Omogiriki orenge.
english: He came to Derbe and then to Lystra, where a disciple named Timothy lived, whose mother was a Jewess and a believer, but whose father was a Greek.

ekegusii: Oyo igo achete ase Yeso botuko, akamotebia, “Rabii twamanyire ng’a nomworokia ore, kwarure ase Nyasae, ekiagera omonto onde tari oranyare gokora ebikone ebi ogokora aye, otatiga Nyasae abe amo nere.”
english: He came to Jesus at night and said, "Rabbi, we know you are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the miraculous signs you are doing if God were not with him."

ekegusii: Nabo agaika ase Simion Petero, Oyo akamotebia, “Omonene! Aye ngosibia ore amagoro aane?”
english: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, "Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"

ekegusii: Agacha ase abaye, na barabwo abare abaye tibamwancha.
english: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.

ekegusii: Agaika ase amakuruma e ching’ondi agwo ase enchera, na agwo ase rikuruma erimo agasoa ase ogwekonya. Daudi amo nabanto baye nao baikaransete ime y’ekenunchi kie rikuruma erio.
english: He came to the sheep pens along the way; a cave was there, and Saul went in to relieve himself. David and his men were far back in the cave.

ekegusii: Egachiera emingichi eria yabwate chingunchara ibere, eria naroche eteneine ase engegu y’orooche, ekarindokera emingichi eria ere nekeririanda ekenene.
english: He came toward the two-horned ram I had seen standing beside the canal and charged at him in great rage.

ekegusii: Sisaki akaira emechie eria y’Abayuda yagiteire chindwaki, agaikera Yerusalemu.
english: he captured the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Agoosa na koira abanto bonsi ba Yerusalemu, abanene bonsi, na bonsi abarenge ne chinguru chi’okorwana esegi, na abaroisia ebinto bonsi, na abaturi ebioma. Abanto bonsi bairetwe nigo barenge chilifu ikomi, abanto bande tibatigetwe aroro otatiga abwo barenge abataka mono b’ense eria.
english: He carried into exile all Jerusalem: all the officers and fighting men, and all the craftsmen and artisans-- a total of ten thousand. Only the poorest people of the land were left.

ekegusii: Abanto baria batooregete bataitetwe nemioro akabang’anyia gochia Babeli, barabwo bakaba abasomba asare na ase abanto b’ororeria rwaye, goika ekero oboruoti bw’Abaayemi bwabete ne chinguru.
english: He carried into exile to Babylon the remnant, who escaped from the sword, and they became servants to him and his sons until the kingdom of Persia came to power.

ekegusii: Akaira chikungo chionsi chi’enyomba y’Omonene na echi’enyomba y’omoruoti, akaira kera egento. Boigo akaira chinguba chionsi chi’etahabu, chiria Sulemani aroisetie.
english: He carried off the treasures of the temple of the LORD and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including all the gold shields Solomon had made.

ekegusii: Ebikorero bionsi bi’enyomba ya Nyasae, ebinene na ebike, ne chinibo chionsi chiarenge ase enyomba y’Omonene na ase enyomba y’omoruoti, na ase echi’abagambi barenge amo nere, ebinto ebio bionsi akabiira Babeli.
english: He carried to Babylon all the articles from the temple of God, both large and small, and the treasures of the LORD's temple and the treasures of the king and his officials.

ekegusii: Aya achikire igoro yane, goika ayaikeranie, na amange buna ayio nigo agachire ase ebirengererio biaye.
english: He carries out his decree against me, and many such plans he still has in store.

ekegusii: Ebisieri ebio bigachaberwa nemegwekano y’abakerubi, na ey’emekendo na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio, bikaoomwa buya netahabu igoro y’emegwekano eyio.
english: He carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers on them and overlaid them with gold hammered evenly over the carvings.

ekegusii: Agakora chibonyi inye korwa ase etahabu enyititoire, agachibeka ase amagoro aye ane, ibere ase kera rikere.
english: He cast four gold rings for it and fastened them to its four feet, with two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia chisiiro ibere chi’etaai; obotambe bwa kera esiiro eyemo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ikomi na atato, na engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi na abere egaetanana kera esiiro.
english: He cast two bronze pillars, each eighteen cubits high and twelve cubits around, by line.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akobwata abare nobong’aini ase obong’ainereria bwabo, emeroberio yabo y’ogotega nigo egosirigwa bwango.
english: He catches the wise in their craftiness, and the schemes of the wily are swept away.

ekegusii: akabwata omomura omosae oyomo o Sukoti, akamobora‐boria amang’ana, akamotebia amorikere amarieta ’abanto abanene, na abagaaka ba Sukoti, emerongo etano na ebere, na batano na babere.
english: He caught a young man of Succoth and questioned him, and the young man wrote down for him the names of the seventy-seven officials of Succoth, the elders of the town.

ekegusii: Nigo agerete abwo babagoosete bakabarorera amabera.
english: He caused them to be pitied by all who held them captive.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akoonchora ebiro ne chingaki; nigo akorusia abaruoti, naende obeka abande; nigo akoa abang’aini obong’aini bwabo, na abamanyi okomanya kwabo.
english: He changes times and seasons; he sets up kings and deposes them. He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to the discerning.

ekegusii: Ere agachaka kobwatia Abineri, na ekero arenge komobwatia taonchogete gochia aande, ensemo ya borio gose eya bomosi.
english: He chased Abner, turning neither to the right nor to the left as he pursued him.

ekegusii: Agachora abanto b’Abaisraeli abaranyare gokora emeremo eyio, akababeka babe abaraai b’Abaisraeli, b’emeganda elifu, ne rigana, na emerongo etano, na ikomi.
english: He chose capable men from all Israel and made them leaders of the people, officials over thousands, hundreds, fifties and tens.

ekegusii: Agachora Daudi omosomba oye, akamorusia korwa ase arenge korisia ching’ondi.
english: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheep pens;

ekegusii: Agachora abamwambo batano, akabaira ase obosio bwa Farao.
english: He chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.

ekegusii: Nigo atochorerete omwando, oyio ore obwari bwa Yakobo, oria Omonene anchete.
english: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved. Selah

ekegusii: Bagechorera abanyene orogongo rwarenge oruya, ekiagera agwo nao egetari ki’omogambi kiagachetwe. Bakaba amo nabatang’ani b’abanto, bakaba bagokora oboronge bw’Omonene na konacha ebina bi’ekeene ase Abaisraeli.”
english: He chose the best land for himself; the leader's portion was kept for him. When the heads of the people assembled, he carried out the LORD's righteous will, and his judgments concerning Israel."

ekegusii: Nyasae agachora ayare amasinini ase ense na ayachayire, nonya nebinto bire bosa, erinde akeyie biria bire nengencho, bibe bosa.
english: He chose the lowly things of this world and the despised things-- and the things that are not-- to nullify the things that are,

ekegusii: agachora ng’a mbuya konyora emechando amo nabanto ba Nyasae kobua kwegokia ase ebibe ase ekero egeke.
english: He chose to be mistreated along with the people of God rather than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a short time.

ekegusii: Ase ogwancha kwaye ere omonyene agatoibora ase ring’ana riaye ri’ekeene, erinde tobe buna ogotongorwa konde kw’ebitongwa biaye.
english: He chose to give us birth through the word of truth, that we might be a kind of firstfruits of all he created.

ekegusii: Agachika Abayuda barigie Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, naende akabachika barende amachiko na emeroberio ende echikire.
english: He commanded Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to obey his laws and commands.

ekegusii: Akabachika, akabora, “Eke nakio egento morakore: Ensemo eyemo ya isato yaino, baria bakorenda ase rituko ri’Esabato, barende enyomba y’Omoruoti,
english: He commanded them, saying, "This is what you are to do: You who are in the three companies that are going on duty on the Sabbath-- a third of you guarding the royal palace,

ekegusii: Agatochika toranderie abanto, na tobe birori ng’a nere ochoretwe na Nyasae abe omogambi bw’abare moyo na abakure.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that he is the one whom God appointed as judge of the living and the dead.

ekegusii: Abiyamu akabwatia chingencho chia ise ase ogokora ebibe, na tarenge nobwegenwa bw’enkoro ase Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Daudi, sokororia yaye arenge.
english: He committed all the sins his father had done before him; his heart was not fully devoted to the LORD his God, as the heart of David his forefather had been.

ekegusii: Eira eyio aenegetie koba ase Yakobo buna ogochika, ee, ase Israeli okobwatana gwa kare na kare,
english: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo akagokong’ia gokaba ogochika ase Yakobo, ee, ase Israeli okobwatana gwa kare na kare,
english: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

ekegusii: Ase ayio akabeka abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bakaba bakobogoria chigurube, na abanto chilifu emerongo etano na etato (80,000) bakaba bakobaacha amagena agwo ase ebitunwa, na abanto chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600) bakaba abateneneri b’abanto abwo bonsi.
english: He conscripted seventy thousand men as carriers and eighty thousand as stonecutters in the hills and thirty-six hundred as foremen over them.

ekegusii: Agancha, akarigia ribaga akomoruera asebare emeganda etaiyo.
english: He consented, and watched for an opportunity to hand Jesus over to them when no crowd was present.

ekegusii: agasemania nabanene b’oboruoti bwaye, na abanto baye chituoni batiche chintuboka na batange amache korwa ase chinsoko chiarenge isiko y’omochie, nabarabwo bakamokonya.
english: he consulted with his officials and military staff about blocking off the water from the springs outside the city, and they helped him.

ekegusii: Naende akabatebia, “Naigure ng’a endagera nekare Misiri, tirimboka gochiao, motogorere endagera toche koria, tobe moyo, titokwa.”
english: He continued, "I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die."

ekegusii: Gose tanyara gokora ogokora gwe chinguru aroro, otatiga abegete amaboko aye igoro ase abarwaire bake, akabagwenia.
english: He could not do any miracles there, except lay his hands on a few sick people and heal them.

ekegusii: Nigo atubete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akagetuba namare aye.
english: He covers the face of the full moon, spreading his clouds over it.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotuba igoro namare, bwariganeria ense embura, nigo akomeria obonyansi ase ebitunwa.
english: He covers the sky with clouds; he supplies the earth with rain and makes grass grow on the hills.

ekegusii: Ere akabatonga omosacha na omokungu, akabasesenia, akabaroka mwanyabanto, ekero ekio abatongete.
english: He created them male and female and blessed them. And when they were created, he called them "man."

ekegusii: Na ase ogochika kw’Omonene omonto oria agaaka eriogi, akarera mamincha y’egesasimero, agateba, “Obee! Aye egesasimero, aye egesasimero! Omonene otebire iga: Rora, omwana omomura naiborwe ase enyomba ya Daudi, erieta riaye Yosia; ere nang’wansere igoro yao aye egesasimero, abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro, baria bagosambera ubani igoro yao na amauga ’abanto nasamberwe igoro yao.”
english: He cried out against the altar by the word of the LORD: "O altar, altar! This is what the LORD says: 'A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David. On you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who now make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on you.'"

ekegusii: ere agaaka eriogi, akarera ase omonto oria o Nyasae orwete ense ya Yuda, akabora, “Omonene otebire ng’a kwangire koigwera ring’ana riaye, naende torendeti ogochika koria Omonene, Nyasae oo, agochigete.
english: He cried out to the man of God who had come from Judah, "This is what the LORD says: 'You have defied the word of the LORD and have not kept the command the LORD your God gave you.

ekegusii: Omonto nigo akogenda ase rinani ogecha emecharake, gose bwechorera emete ao ao enga buna emetontera, oyetiga egokina agwo ase rinani, gose bwesimekera omobunduki, embura yaba ekoyokinia.
english: He cut down cedars, or perhaps took a cypress or oak. He let it grow among the trees of the forest, or planted a pine, and the rain made it grow.

ekegusii: Kera orosagia ime asende orotameti, nigo akoronacha, na kera orokwama nigo akorososa, erinde romente kwama.
english: He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit, while every branch that does bear fruit he prunes so that it will be even more fruitful.

ekegusii: Oyio agakorera egesaku giaito obong’ainereria, na agakorera chisokoro chiaito amabe, na barabwo bagachikwa ng’a batugute abana babo ebing’werere, erinde tibaba moyo.
english: He dealt treacherously with our people and oppressed our forefathers by forcing them to throw out their newborn babies so that they would die.

ekegusii: Omonene akaborokereria okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, akabachika mokobwate; okwo nakwo amachiko aye ikomi. Akayarika ase chibao ibere chi’amagena.
english: He declared to you his covenant, the Ten Commandments, which he commanded you to follow and then wrote them on two stone tablets.

ekegusii: Ere nigo abegete oborori bwaye ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, na akaa Abaisraeli amachiko, ayio achigete chisokoro chiaito chiorokererie abana babo.
english: He decreed statutes for Jacob and established the law in Israel, which he commanded our forefathers to teach their children,

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge konacha ebina ebironge ase abataka na ase abaremerwa, ase igo amang’ana akaba amaya asare. Inee! Ase ogokora igo tari rirorio okomanya inche? Nabo Omonene akwanire.
english: He defended the cause of the poor and needy, and so all went well. Is that not what it means to know me?" declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Nigo akonacha ekina kia boronge ase chintakana, na ase ababoraka; ere nigo anchete omomenyi, amoa endagera ne chianga.
english: He defends the cause of the fatherless and the widow, and loves the alien, giving him food and clothing.

ekegusii: Agakana naende, na gotiana, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.”
english: He denied it again, with an oath: "I don't know the man!"

ekegusii: Ere nigo akorusia obong’aini ase abatang’ani b’abanto bare ase ense, erio obatiga bakoombogana erooro bosa.
english: He deprives the leaders of the earth of their reason; he sends them wandering through a trackless waste.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge goteba igoro y’emete yonsi, emenene buna emecharake ya Lebanoni na ebimeri ebike buna hisopo eyekomera ase chindwaki. Boigo agateba igoro ye ching’iti, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chikwagura, ne chinswe.
english: He described plant life, from the cedar of Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of walls. He also taught about animals and birds, reptiles and fish.

ekegusii: Boigo omoruoti agasaria Tofeti, aase agosasimerwa agwo ase Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, agaakora aatachenegeti ng’a onde tasambera omwana oye, omomura gose omoiseke, aroro abe ekeng’wanso ase enyasae eria Moleki.
english: He desecrated Topheth, which was in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, so no one could use it to sacrifice his son or daughter in the fire to Molech.

ekegusii: Akamotebereria igoro y’oborito bwe chitahabu na obwe chifeta chikoroiserigwa kera egekorero kegokorerwa ase Hekalu,
english: He designated the weight of gold for all the gold articles to be used in various kinds of service, and the weight of silver for all the silver articles to be used in various kinds of service:

ekegusii: Ere tari koba nogosemeria ng’a gose narue ase omosunte naende, ekiagera omoro nigo omoganetie.
english: He despairs of escaping the darkness; he is marked for the sword.

ekegusii: Takonyara gotooreka abe moyo, ekiagera achayete eira yaye atianete, na agasaria okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.
english: He despised the oath by breaking the covenant. Because he had given his hand in pledge and yet did all these things, he shall not escape.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo arentete amagena ’embura agasaria emesabibu yabo, agasaria nemeko yabo.
english: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamore-figs with sleet.

ekegusii: Nigo amanyete omobaro bwe ching’enang’eni chionsi; boigo kera eyemo nigo ayerogete erieta.
english: He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.

ekegusii: Ere akabaita korwa Aroeri goika chinsemo chia Miniti, akaira emechie emerongo ebere goikera Abeli‐Keramimu, akabaita ogoita okonene. Abaamoni bakabugwa, bakabekwa inse y’obogambi bw’Abaisraeli.
english: He devastated twenty towns from Aroer to the vicinity of Minnith, as far as Abel Keramim. Thus Israel subdued Ammon.

ekegusii: Naende akarusia abakuani barenge gosasima emegwekano, baria abaruoti b’Abayuda babegete gosambera ubani agwo aase aimokererete igoro ase emechie y’Abayuda na goetanana Yerusalemu; naboigo nabaria barenge gosamba ubani ase Baali, na erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni chionsi chia igoro.
english: He did away with the pagan priests appointed by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the towns of Judah and on those around Jerusalem-- those who burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations and to all the starry hosts.

ekegusii: Rehoboamu agakora ayare amabe, ekiagera tarwete enkoro yaye ase okomorigia Omonene.
english: He did evil because he had not set his heart on seeking the LORD.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene; teatananete korwa ase ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Nere agakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, teatananete korwa ase ekemo ki’ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe, korende akagenderera kobikora.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD and did not turn away from any of the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he continued in them.

ekegusii: Ere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene; akabwatia chingencho chia Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, ase ogokora ebibe biria ere akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe; teatananete korwa ase birobio.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD by following the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit, and he did not turn away from them.

ekegusii: Nere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oye, ekiagera tekeetie abe omoitongo ase obosio bwa Yeremia omobani, oria okwanete aya Omonene atebete.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD his God and did not humble himself before Jeremiah the prophet, who spoke the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: Amoni agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna ise akorete.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as his father Manasseh had done.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna Manase ise akorete; akarua ebing’wanso ase emegwekano yonsi eria Manase ise aroisetie, naende akayekorera.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as his father Manasseh had done. Amon worshiped and offered sacrifices to all the idols Manasseh had made.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase amaiso ’Omonene, buna chisokoro chiaye chiakorete. Teatananete korwa ase ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as his fathers had done. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna abanto b’enyomba y’Ahabu bakorete, ekiagera ekero ise akwete, abanto abwo bakaba abasemia baye, goika agaikera ogosirigwa kwaye.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as the house of Ahab had done, for after his father's death they became his advisers, to his undoing.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase amaiso ’Omonene, akabwatia chinchera chia ise, na echia ng’ina, na echia Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, abwo bagerete Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, because he walked in the ways of his father and mother and in the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin.

ekegusii: Yoramu agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, nonya takorete buna ise na ng’ina bakorete, ekiagera narusetie esiiro y’enyasae Baali, eria ise aroisetie.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, but not as his father and mother had done. He got rid of the sacred stone of Baal that his father had made.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende takorete amabe buna abaruoti b’Abaisraeli, abwo bamotang’anerete, bakorete.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, but not like the kings of Israel who preceded him.

ekegusii: Manase agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana ne chingencho chi’okogechia chi’ebisaku biria Omonene aseretie korwa ase Abaisraeli.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, following the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana ne chingencho chi’okogechia chi’ebisaku biria Omonene aseretie korwa ase Abaisraeli.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, following the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Yehoyakini agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana naya onsi ise akorete.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father had done.

ekegusii: Yehoahasi agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana buna aya onsi chisokoro chiaye chiakorete.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as his fathers had done.

ekegusii: Zedekia agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana buna onsi aria Yehoyakimu akorete.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.

ekegusii: Zedekia oyio agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, koreng’ana buna aria onsi Yehoyakimu akorete.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, just as Jehoiakim had done.

ekegusii: Ere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabwatia chinchera chia ise ase ogokora ebibe ebio bikagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, walking in the ways of his father and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabwatia chinchera chia Yeroboamu ase ogokora ebibe ebio bikagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD, walking in the ways of Jeroboam and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Nere agakora ayare amabe ase amaiso ’Omonene; ase amatuko aye onsi teatananete korwa ase ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD. During his entire reign he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Peka agakora ayare amabe ase amaiso ’Omonene. Teatananete korwa ase ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: He did evil in the eyes of the LORD. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Ekero ekeiga oorokirie ng’a ere nomonyene oboronge, naende nere okomoa oboronge oyo okomwegena Yeso.
english: he did it to demonstrate his justice at the present time, so as to be just and the one who justifies those who have faith in Jesus.

ekegusii: Ase amasio e chisokoro chiabo Nyasae nigo akorete amakumia agwo ase ense ya Misiri, ase orogongo rwa Soani.
english: He did miracles in the sight of their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.

ekegusii: Ere tasoete namanyinga e chimbori na eye chimori, korende namanyinga aye omonyene, agasoa ara rimo rioka Aase Aachenu, na agatonyorera okoboorigwa gwa kare na kare.
english: He did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; but he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, having obtained eternal redemption.

ekegusii: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, "I am not the Christ."
english: Ere akaorokia, takana, agateba, “Inche tari Kristo.”

ekegusii: Daudi tarenge gotiga nonya nomonto oyomo, omosacha gose omokungu, ore moyo, ekiagera nigo arengereretie ng’a onde tabaisa kogenda Gati atebe ng’a, “Aya naro Daudi agotokorera.” Naboigo yarenge engencho ya Daudi ekero agendererete komenya ase ense y’Abafilisti.
english: He did not leave a man or woman alive to be brought to Gath, for he thought, "They might inform on us and say, 'This is what David did.'" And such was his practice as long as he lived in Philistine territory.

ekegusii: Gose tanchete monto onde amotunyane, otatiga Petero, na Yakobo, na Yohana momura omwabo Yakobo.
english: He did not let anyone follow him except Peter, James and John the brother of James.

ekegusii: naende ekiagera tarigetie onde amobere kirori igoro ya mwanyabanto; naki ere omonyene amanyete ayare ime ya mwanyabanto.
english: He did not need man's testimony about man, for he knew what was in a man.

ekegusii: Na ise tamomanya, ekiagera amaboko aye nigo arenge namarionya buna aya Esau omwabo. Ase igo akamosesenia.
english: He did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he blessed him.

ekegusii: gose tare kobatebia ring’ana otatiga ase omoreng’anio, korende agatebereria aborokigwa baye amang’ana onsi bobisi.
english: He did not say anything to them without using a parable. But when he was alone with his own disciples, he explained everything.

ekegusii: Aya igo akwanete, tari ng’a arorerete abataka amabera, korende nekiagera arenge omoibi, naende abwate esanduku ye chisiringi, na igo anarete korusia echiabekire aroro.
english: He did not say this because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief; as keeper of the money bag, he used to help himself to what was put into it.

ekegusii: Naende eri takwanete ase omoyo oye omonyene, korende ekiagera arenge omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabana ng’a Yeso nakwe ase engencho y’egesaku keria;
english: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi tairete Esanduku eria mwaye ase omochie okorokwa Omochie o Daudi, korende akayebogoria akayebeka nyomba mw’Obedi‐Edomu, Omogiti.
english: He did not take the ark to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

ekegusii: Naboigo aroiseretie abakungu baye bonsi baria anyuomete korwa ase ebisaku ebiaao; barabwo bagasamba ubani na bakarua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae chiabo.
english: He did the same for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and offered sacrifices to their gods.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto bonsi b’ense engima mbamanye ng’a okoboko kw’Omonene nkore ne chinguru, erinde bamoiroke Omonene, Nyasae oino, botambe.”
english: He did this so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the LORD is powerful and so that you might always fear the LORD your God."

ekegusii: Yosia agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, akabwatia chinchera chionsi chia Daudi sokoro yaye; taonchogete gochia aande onsi, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in all the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene; akabwatia chinchera chionsi chia Daudi, sokoro yaye; taonchogete gochia aande onsi, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father David, not turning aside to the right or to the left.

ekegusii: Amasia agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, korende nonya naboigo takorete buna Daudi, sokoro yaye, akorete. Nigo akorete onsi buna aya Yoashi ise akorete.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not as his father David had done. In everything he followed the example of his father Joash.

ekegusii: Amasia agakora ayare amaronge ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende tarenge nomoyo omoikeranu.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, but not wholeheartedly.

ekegusii: Asaria agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, koreng’ana buna aya onsi Amasia ise akorete.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.

ekegusii: Usia agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, buna Amasia ise akorete.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.

ekegusii: Hezekia agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, buna Daudi, sokoro yaye, akorete.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father David had done.

ekegusii: Hesekia agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene koreng’ana buna aya onsi Daudi, sokoro yaye, akorete.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father David had done.

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, koreng’ana buna aria onsi Usia ise akorete. Amo nayio tasoete ime ase Hekalu y’Omonene. Korende abanto bakagenderera gokora obobe obwo banarete gokora.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Uzziah had done, but unlike him he did not enter the temple of the LORD. The people, however, continued their corrupt practices.

ekegusii: Ere agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene, buna aya onsi Usia ise akorete.
english: He did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Uzziah had done.

ekegusii: Daudi agakwa ore omogotu mono bw’amatuko amange, nigo arenge omonto omonda osikire; na Sulemani, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: He died at a good old age, having enjoyed long life, wealth and honor. His son Solomon succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: oyokwete ase engencho yaito, erinde tobe moyo amo nere, kerabe tokorenda, gose tokorara chitoro.
english: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo aatananete amache ’enyancha, akaambokeria chisokoro chiabo aroro, agakora amache ayio agatenena buna orwaki.
english: He divided the sea and led them through; he made the water stand firm like a wall.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakorera, korende Nyasae tari koiraneria, ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe kw’oboenenu.
english: He does not answer when men cry out because of the arrogance of the wicked.

ekegusii: Ere tari koria ebing’wanso bikoruegwa igoro ase ebitunwa, gose tari korigereria emegwekano Abaisraeli bagosasima; tari gokora obonyaka nomokungu bw’omonto onde, gose tari koba nomokungu ekero are nomotienyi,
english: He does not eat at the mountain shrines or look to the idols of the house of Israel. He does not defile his neighbor's wife or lie with a woman during her period.

ekegusii: Ere tagotiga omokori amabe agenderere koba moyo, korende nigo akoa abachandire oboronge bwabo.
english: He does not keep the wicked alive but gives the afflicted their rights.

ekegusii: Ekero akorua singo tari kwementera gento gose koboria ebitoki. Nigo agotanga amaboko aye takora obobe; nigo akonacha ekina kia boronge ase egati y’omonto na omonto onde.
english: He does not lend at usury or take excessive interest. He withholds his hand from doing wrong and judges fairly between man and man.

ekegusii: tagokorera monto onde bobe, gose takoira egento koba intenenera, gose takourereria omonto enibo yaye, korende nigo arabe okoa oyore nenchara endagera, na oyore getirianda amobekere eanga.
english: He does not oppress anyone or require a pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.

ekegusii: gose tari gokorera monto onde bobe, korende nigo akoirania egento omonto amoete koba intenenera ase esira. Ere tari koura onde gento kiaye, korende nigo akoa oyore nenchara endagera, na oyore getirianda omobekera eanga.
english: He does not oppress anyone, but returns what he took in pledge for a loan. He does not commit robbery but gives his food to the hungry and provides clothing for the naked.

ekegusii: Tari gotiga korigereria abanyene oboronge, korende nigo akobabeka amo nabaruoti ase ebirogo bi’obonene. Ee, nigo akobakinia bagenderera kobeera aroro,
english: He does not take his eyes off the righteous; he enthrones them with kings and exalts them forever.

ekegusii: Omonene tari gotokorera aya togwenerete ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, gose tari gotoa egesusuro koreng’ana nobobe bwaito.
english: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.

ekegusii: Oonchoranire chinchera chiane na kombutorana ebing’ese, ontigire ntang’ang’ete bosa.
english: he dragged me from the path and mangled me and left me without help.

ekegusii: Otingire obota bwaye, na ombekire imbe ekerenga akoruta chinsara.
english: He drew his bow and made me the target for his arrows.

ekegusii: Agaseria abanto b’ebisaku korwa bosio bwabo. Nigo abaatananerete ense eyio ekaba emiando yabo, akabeka Abaisraeli bakamenya ase chiema chiabo.
english: He drove out nations before them and allotted their lands to them as an inheritance; he settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.

ekegusii: Akayorema, agachora amagena ase okoyobonga, akarigia emesabibu emiya akayesi meka aroro; ase egati yaye akaagacha omorobiri bw’okoyorendera, agakunya egeteera gi’okomitera amasabibu. Erio akaganya ore nogosemeria ng’a omogondo mbwame amasabibu amaya, korende okama amasabibu amegarori.
english: He dug it up and cleared it of stones and planted it with the choicest vines. He built a watchtower in it and cut out a winepress as well. Then he looked for a crop of good grapes, but it yielded only bad fruit.

ekegusii: Ekeongo nigo gekomenya ase egetare; ase omwenya bw’egetare, aase gekonyora oborendi obuya.
english: He dwells on a cliff and stays there at night; a rocky crag is his stronghold.

ekegusii: na koreng’ana engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene akaremereria nabarabwo ase erooro.
english: he endured their conduct for about forty years in the desert,

ekegusii: Ase ebisiirero na ase chinsingo emegwekano y’abakerubi, na eye chindo, na ey’emekendo, amo ney’ebisicha, ekamang’wa, buna ribaga riarenge ase kera ensemo.
english: He engraved cherubim, lions and palm trees on the surfaces of the supports and on the panels, in every available space, with wreaths all around.

ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akaria emegati yarenge korugwa ase Nyasae, nero tiyarenge boronge asare ayerie, gose ase abwo barenge amo nere, otatiga ase abakuani boka?
english: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread-- which was not lawful for them to do, but only for the priests.

ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akabogoria na koria emegati yarenge koruegwa ase Nyasae, etare boronge koriegwa nonde otatiga nabakuani boka, naende akaa abwo barenge amo nere?”
english: He entered the house of God, and taking the consecrated bread, he ate what is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions."

ekegusii: Rirube erio rikaegwa Elasa, mosinto o Safani, na Gemaria, mosinto o Hilikia, abwo Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, atomete Babeli ase Nebukadinesaro omoruoti. Aya naro amang’ana arikire ase rirube erio:
english: He entrusted the letter to Elasah son of Shaphan and to Gemariah son of Hilkiah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to King Nebuchadnezzar in Babylon. It said:

ekegusii: Hiramu akabeka chisiiro chiria ase enyomba bosio bwe Hekalu; esiiro yabegetwe ensemo ya borio akayeroka Yakini, na eyabegetwe ensemo ya bomosi akayeroka Boasi.
english: He erected the pillars at the portico of the temple. The pillar to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.

ekegusii: Agatenenia chisiiro chiria bosio bwe Hekalu, eyemo ensemo ya irianyi na eyende ensemo ya sugusu. Eria yarenge ensemo ya irianyi akayeroka Yakini, na eria yarenge ensemo ya sugusu akayeroka Boasi.
english: He erected the pillars in the front of the temple, one to the south and one to the north. The one to the south he named Jakin and the one to the north Boaz.

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene aetete ense ya Misiri, agachika omoroberio oyio ase abanto ba Yusufu. Nkaigwa enkwana y’omonwa ntamanyete egoteba:
english: He established it as a statute for Joseph when he went out against Egypt, where we heard a language we did not understand.

ekegusii: Boigo Asa akarusia Maaka ng’ina taba eting’ana, ekiagera nabwate omogwekano orenge okogechia oroiseretigwe Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, akabutora na akaiyeria inse omogwekano oria ng’ina abwate, akayosambera agwo ase akarooche ga Kidironi.
english: He even deposed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive Asherah pole. Asa cut the pole down and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

ekegusii: Na ebikorero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae biaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu ne chifeta, ebio Nebukadinesaro arusetie korwa ase Hekalu yarenge aiga Yerusalemu, akabiira akabibeka ase hekalu yare Babeli. Ebikorero ebio omoruoti Koresi akabirusia ase hekalu ya Babeli, akabia omonto okorokwa Sesibasari oyo abegete koba omogavuna,
english: He even removed from the temple of Babylon the gold and silver articles of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to the temple in Babylon. "Then King Cyrus gave them to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he had appointed governor,

ekegusii: Nigo ekwenaria okobua gwonsi kw’eng’iti eria ye ritang’ani ase obosio bwaye, na kogera ense na bonsi abamenyete aroro basasime eng’iti eria ye ritang’ani, ero eyio orogoma rwaye rw’amakweri rwagwenetigwe.
english: He exercised all the authority of the first beast on his behalf, and made the earth and its inhabitants worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.

ekegusii: Agasiria korwa ase ense eria abasacha baria abanyaka barenge korigania ase obosooku, naende akarusia aroro emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, eria chisokoro chiaye chiaroisetie.
english: He expelled the male shrine prostitutes from the land and got rid of all the idols his fathers had made.

ekegusii: Osoirie amagoro aane ase rikorogoto, na nigo akoba ondigereretie ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.”
english: He fastens my feet in shackles; he keeps close watch on all my paths.'

ekegusii: Oyio nigo asemeretie ayare buna ribu; enkoro yaye yang’ainekire, yamosiririe, takonyara gwetooria na goteba, “Egento eke mbwate koboko kwane gw’okorio neki’oborimo.”
english: He feeds on ashes, a deluded heart misleads him; he cannot save himself, or say, "Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?"

ekegusii: Ere nigo akoigwa obororo ase omobere oye, na oba okona‐kwereera omonyene.”
english: He feels but the pain of his own body and mourns only for himself."

ekegusii: Akarara naende, akarota eria kabere, akarora ebigara bitano na bibere ebinene ebinoru, bikinete ase oroboba oromo.
english: He fell asleep again and had a second dream: Seven heads of grain, healthy and good, were growing on a single stalk.

ekegusii: Akagwa inse, akaigwa eriogi rikomotebia, “Saulo, Saulo, nase ki gwanchandire?”
english: He fell to the ground and heard a voice say to him, "Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?"

ekegusii: Ere nigo amumegete amaboko aye ase okomesa, erio ochika goake ase ekerenga kere.
english: He fills his hands with lightning and commands it to strike its mark.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenta ogosiria kwa mobosokano ase abwo bare ne chinguru, boigo nagere ogosareka gochere chiburi chinkong’u.
english: he flashes destruction on the stronghold and brings the fortified city to ruin),

ekegusii: korende ere agatiga egetambaa keria ki’egatani, agatama ore getirianda.
english: he fled naked, leaving his garment behind.

ekegusii: He followed Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, and Molech the detestable god of the Ammonites.
english: Sulemani igo atunyanete na gokorera Asitaroti, enyasae enkungu y’Abasidoni, na Milikomu, okogechia kw’Abaamoni.

ekegusii: Agakwana nabarabwo buna abamura baria bamosemetie, agateba, “Tata nigo akorete rikorogoto riaino rikaba ririto, korende inche nimbamentere ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabang’wanie ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”
english: he followed the advice of the young men and said, "My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions."

ekegusii: Agakwana nabarabwo buna abamura baria bamosemetie, agateba, “Tata nigo akorete rikorogoto riaino rikaba ririto, korende inche nimbamentere ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabang’wanie ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi chinyoge chinga amagwa.”
english: he followed the advice of the young men and said, "My father made your yoke heavy; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions."

ekegusii: Omonto oyio aise gokora bo, na abwatie emeroberio yane echikire, na abwate amachiko aane, na akore ayare boronge, oyio nigo are omonyaboronge; ekeene, nabe moyo. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: He follows my decrees and faithfully keeps my laws. That man is righteous; he will surely live, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Agatiga Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaye, tabwatetie enchera yaye.
english: He forsook the LORD, the God of his fathers, and did not walk in the way of the LORD.

ekegusii: Akarwana noboremu, akabua nonya n’Abaameleki, na agatooria Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko abwo konya babasakoire.
english: He fought valiantly and defeated the Amalekites, delivering Israel from the hands of those who had plundered them.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoikeraneria abamoirogete okogania kwabo; boigo nigo akoigwa ekerero kiabo na kobatooria.
english: He fulfills the desires of those who fear him; he hears their cry and saves them.

ekegusii: Agwo kare ekero Daudi akoorire ogoita koria okonene ase egati yabo, oyio Resoni agasangereria abanto asare, na akaba omotang’ani bw’ekeombe keria ki’abaomboganu. Barabwo bakagenda Damesiki, bakaba bakogambera abanto b’aroro.
english: He gathered men around him and became the leader of a band of rebels when David destroyed the forces [of Zobah]; the rebels went to Damascus, where they settled and took control.

ekegusii: Igo agosangereria amache ’enyancha, buna amache are enyongo ime, obeka chindiba aase abo.
english: He gathers the waters of the sea into jars; he puts the deep into storehouses.

ekegusii: Boigo akamoa emeroberio y’ebiombe bi’abakuani na Abalawi buna barache gokora emeremo yonsi y’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene, na obw’ebinto bionsi bi’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: He gave him instructions for the divisions of the priests and Levites, and for all the work of serving in the temple of the LORD, as well as for all the articles to be used in its service.

ekegusii: Tamoete omwando ime aa, nonya koreng’ana ase akobeka okogoro, korende akamoriera eira ng’a namoe ense eria ebe obomenyo bwaye, na obw’oroiboro rwaye nyuma yaye, nonya tarenge nomwana.
english: He gave him no inheritance here, not even a foot of ground. But God promised him that he and his descendants after him would possess the land, even though at that time Abraham had no child.

ekegusii: Naende akamoa omogwekano bw’ebinto bionsi arengereretie igoro y’okoagacha chiraaro chi’enyomba y’Omonene, na obw’ebinyomba bionsi biraetanane Hekalu biagachwe ase chimonga chi’enyomba ya Nyasae chiragachwe, amo ne chikungo chi’ebiegwa biare gocha gwatananwa bibe ebichenu.
english: He gave him the plans of all that the Spirit had put in his mind for the courts of the temple of the LORD and all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the temple of God and for the treasuries for the dedicated things.

ekegusii: Ere nigo abete nendamwamu ase abanto abwo barenge omwando oye, akabarua bagaitwa nemioro.
english: He gave his people over to the sword; he was very angry with his inheritance.

ekegusii: Akarenta amagena ’embura agaita chiombe chiabo, ne chinkoba chigaita ching’ondi ne chimbori chiabo.
english: He gave over their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.

ekegusii: Yeso akabakurera ng’a monto onde tamanya amang’ana ayio, akabachika bae omoiseke oria endagera arie.
english: He gave strict orders not to let anyone know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.

ekegusii: Akarenta chingeeti chigasaria ebimeri biabo, naende akarenta chingige chikaria endagera y’emegondo yabo bechanderete.
english: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, their produce to the locust.

ekegusii: Akabia ribaga. Ebirecha biria bi’eubi bigasoka, bigasoa ase chimbeche chiria; riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano, goika chikagwa enyancha ime. Igo chiarenge koreng’ana chilifu ibere, chikarimera nyancha ime.
english: He gave them permission, and the evil spirits came out and went into the pigs. The herd, about two thousand in number, rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

ekegusii: Akabaa chinse chi’abanto b’ebisaku chikaba echiabo, akabaa nebinto abanto abwo konya bechandeire.
english: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they fell heir to what others had toiled for--

ekegusii: akabachika, akabora, “Nigo morakore emeremo ase okomoiroka Omonene na ase obwegenwa, na ase chinkoro chiaino chionsi.
english: He gave them these orders: "You must serve faithfully and wholeheartedly in the fear of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio agachika Hilikia omokuani, na Ahikamu, mosinto o Safani, na Akibori, mosinto o Mikaya, na Safani omoriki, na Asaia, omokoreri bw’omoruoti, akabatebia,
english: He gave these orders to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Acbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king's attendant:

ekegusii: Agachika Hilikia, na Ahikamu, mosinto o Safani, na Abidoni, mosinto o Mika, na Safani omoriki, na Asaia, omosomba bw’omoruoti, akabatebia,
english: He gave these orders to Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, Shaphan the secretary and Asaiah the king's attendant:

ekegusii: Erio agachika Abalawi baria barenge kobogoria Esanduku eria y’Omonene, eyere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania, agateba,
english: he gave this command to the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD:

ekegusii: He gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites, as their work required,
english: Akaa Abagerisoni chigari ibere ne chiombe inye, buna emeremo yabo yarenge.

ekegusii: Agwo ase erooro akabaa mana mokaria, endagera chisokoro chiaino chitamanyete, anyare kobakora mobe abaitongo na kobateema, erinde ase omoerio oino abakorere amaya.
english: He gave you manna to eat in the desert, something your fathers had never known, to humble and to test you so that in the end it might go well with you.
