ekegusii: Nyasae ong’eire inche, omoruoti oye, obobui obonene, oorokirie obwanchani botari koera asende, inche omoakwa amaguta oye. Inche Daudi, na ororeria rwane, goika kare na kare.
english: He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.

ekegusii: Nyasae ong’eire inche, omoruoti oye, obobui obonene, oorokirie obwanchani botari koera asende, inche omoakwa amaguta oye, inche Daudi, na ororeria rwane, goika kare na kare.”
english: He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever."

ekegusii: Ere nigo akoa omonto oyo ogoyire chinguru, na oyo otari na nguru nigo akomomentera chinguru.
english: He gives strength to the weary and increases the power of the weak.

ekegusii: Akariina obwato obomo obwarenge bwa Simion akamoboria abotigerie are ake korwa ase engegu. Agaikaransa, akorokereria omoganda korwa ase obwato.
english: He got into one of the boats, the one belonging to Simon, and asked him to put out a little from shore. Then he sat down and taught the people from the boat.

ekegusii: Akabaa ribaga bagende, na erio bwango akariina obwato amo naborokigwa baye, akagenda chinsemo chia Dalumanuta.
english: he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the region of Dalmanutha.

ekegusii: Akarusia chinyasae chingeni na emegwekano eria y’ogosasimwa korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene; boigo akarusia ebisasimero konya aagachire ase egetunwa igoro, ase enyomba y’Omonene yarenge agwo Yerusalemu, akabituguta gochia isiko y’omochie.
english: He got rid of the foreign gods and removed the image from the temple of the LORD, as well as all the altars he had built on the temple hill and in Jerusalem; and he threw them out of the city.

ekegusii: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, "Quiet! Be still!" Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.
english: Akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga, agatebia enyancha, “Kira, otoerere!” Omwaga okaera; gokaba ogotoerera okonene.

ekegusii: Erio kegima akaimoka, agetweka oborere bwaye, akarua ase amasio abo bonsi; goika bagakumia bonsi, bagatogia Nyasae, bakobora, “Ayare buna aya, titwana koyarora rinde nonya ng’ake!”
english: He got up, took his mat and walked out in full view of them all. This amazed everyone and they praised God, saying, "We have never seen anything like this!"

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobeka omorembe oba ase chimbebe chiao, naende nigo agoichoria engano ere engiya mono.
english: He grants peace to your borders and satisfies you with the finest of wheat.

ekegusii: Omosomba oyio nigo akinete ase obosio bwaye buna ekemeri ekerere, na buna egesabo ki’omote kegokina korwa ase riroba eriomo, tabwate ekieni ekiya, gose obonene bw’omobere; ekero twamorigereretie, titwaroche buya bonde asare bogotong’usa.
english: He grew up before him like a tender shoot, and like a root out of dry ground. He had no beauty or majesty to attract us to him, nothing in his appearance that we should desire him.

ekegusii: Akabaraa na kobarenda buya, na tibabete nobwoba, korende enyancha ekamera ababisa babo.
english: He guided them safely, so they were unafraid; but the sea engulfed their enemies.

ekegusii: Ase chingaki chia mobaso nigo arenge kobaraa ne riire, na ase chingaki chia botuko abaraa ne riire ri’omorero.
english: He guided them with the cloud by day and with light from the fire all night.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akoraa abanto bare abaitongo ase enchera endonge, naende aborokereria komanya enchera yaye.
english: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them his way.

ekegusii: Nigo abegete ekegogwa gi’etaai na egoti yaroisirie korwa ase ebioma, na oborito bw’egoti eyio nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etano, na isano na ibere (57).
english: He had a bronze helmet on his head and wore a coat of scale armor of bronze weighing five thousand shekels;

ekegusii: Akarota, akarora ekeriinero getenenirie korwa inse riroba, keigete igoro, na abamalaika ba Nyasae bagokeriinera na goikera.
english: He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

ekegusii: Nabwate omwana omomura ore korokwa Saulo. Ere nigo arenge omonyakieni mono. Momura onde tarenge ase egati y’Abaisraeli obwate ekieni ekiya komobua. Ere nigo aetanetie abanto bande bonsi ase obotambe bw’omotwe korwa ase amareko gochia igoro.
english: He had a son named Saul, an impressive young man without equal among the Israelites-- a head taller than any of the others.

ekegusii: Akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo ase ense y’ebigoro ya Yuda, naende akagera abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu bakaba abategenwa, na akagera Abayuda bagatiga chinchera chindonge.
english: He had also built high places on the hills of Judah and had caused the people of Jerusalem to prostitute themselves and had led Judah astray.

ekegusii: Semaya nigo aetwe chibesa ng’a anyoboyie, nainche nyancherane nere, na ase enchera eyio nkore ebibe; erio bakwane amang’ana amabe igoro y’erieta riane, na gonchecheria ase ogonchaya.
english: He had been hired to intimidate me so that I would commit a sin by doing this, and then they would give me a bad name to discredit me.

ekegusii: Omonto oyo konya bworokererigwe enchera y’Omonene. Ase ayio omoika oye nigo orenge gwoka, agakwana na kworokereria boronge amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, korende ere nigo amanyete ebatiso ya Yohana yoka.
english: He had been instructed in the way of the Lord, and he spoke with great fervor and taught about Jesus accurately, though he knew only the baptism of John.

ekegusii: Herode nigo abeete mono abanto ba Turo na Sidoni. Korende barabwo bakamochiera ase obomo, na ekero baebereirie Blasto, oyorenge korenda enyomba y’omoruoti, bakarigia omorembe, ekiagera ense yabo nigo yare konyora endagera korwa ase ense y’omoruoti.
english: He had been quarreling with the people of Tyre and Sidon; they now joined together and sought an audience with him. Having secured the support of Blastus, a trusted personal servant of the king, they asked for peace, because they depended on the king's country for their food supply.

ekegusii: Nigo achagete orogendo rwaye korwa Babeli ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, na agaika Yerusalemu rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano, ekiagera okoboko kwa Nyasae oye kwarenge amo nere ase okomokonya.
english: He had begun his journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was on him.

ekegusii: Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo ene, na abana abamura abachokoro emerongo etato. Barabwo nigo baare koriina chitigere emerongo etano na ebere. Abidoni akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka etano na etato.
english: He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode on seventy donkeys. He led Israel eight years.

ekegusii: He had four unmarried daughters who prophesied.
english: Omonto oyo narenge nabaiseke bane abekungi, baare kobana.

ekegusii: Akamoriinia ase egari yaye ya kabere y’oboruoti. Abanto bagaaka eriogi, bakobora, “Tung’ama inse!” Naboigo akamobeka abe omogambi bw’ense yonsi ya Misiri.
english: He had him ride in a chariot as his second-in-command, and men shouted before him, "Make way!" Thus he put him in charge of the whole land of Egypt.

ekegusii: He had James, the brother of John, put to death with the sword.
english: Agaita Yakobo omwabo Yohana nomoyio o birende.

ekegusii: agaaka Yeremia omobani, akamosiba ase rikorogoto ang’e n’Egeita kia Rogoro kia Benjamin, agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: he had Jeremiah the prophet beaten and put in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin at the LORD's temple.

ekegusii: Engaki Daudi agamberete Abaisraeli nigo yarenge emiaka emerongo ene; akagamba emiaka etano na ebere agwo Heburoni, na agwo Yerusalemu emiaka emerongo etato, na etato.
english: He had reigned forty years over Israel-- seven years in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Igo anyuomete abakungu amagana atano na abere, naende nabwate abakungu ba sere‐sere amagana atato. Abakungu baria baye bakaonchora enkoro yaye, erinde agatiga Omonene.
english: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines, and his wives led him astray.

ekegusii: Ere nabwate abana abamura batano na babere, na abaiseke batato.
english: He had seven sons and three daughters,

ekegusii: Gidioni oyio nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etano na ebere, ekiagera nigo abwate abakungu abange.
english: He had seventy sons of his own, for he had many wives.

ekegusii: Nigo abete nenibo y’amaicho e ching’ondi ne chiombe, na abasomba abange. Ase igo Abafilisti bakamororera ribero.
english: He had so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.

ekegusii: Agwo agatimokeria chingamia isiko y’omochie ang’e nensoko y’amache engaki ya mogoroba, ekero abakungu bagocha kobuucha amache.
english: He had the camels kneel down near the well outside the town; it was toward evening, the time the women go out to draw water.

ekegusii: Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etato, na abaiseke emerongo etato. Agasokia abana baye abaiseke ase abaamate abaao, naende akarenta abaiseke ba isiko emerongo etato, abana baye abamura bakabanyuoma. Ibasani akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere.
english: He had thirty sons and thirty daughters. He gave his daughters away in marriage to those outside his clan, and for his sons he brought in thirty young women as wives from outside his clan. Ibzan led Israel seven years.

ekegusii: Ere nigo abwate abana abamura emerongo etato, baare koriina chitigere emerongo etato. Boigo bakaba bakogambera emechie emerongo etato agwo ase ense ya Gileadi. Emechie eyio nigo ekorokwa Hawoti‐Yairi (Emechie ya Yairi) nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: He had thirty sons, who rode thirty donkeys. They controlled thirty towns in Gilead, which to this day are called Havvoth Jair.

ekegusii: He had told Rachel that he was a relative of her father and a son of Rebekah. So she ran and told her father.
english: Agatebia Raeli, “Inche nomoigwa o iso inde, omwana o Rebeka.” Raeli akaminyoka, agatebia ise amang’ana ayio.

ekegusii: Elikana nabwate abakungu babere, Hana na Penina. Penina nabwate abana, korende Hana tabwate bana.
english: He had two wives; one was called Hannah and the other Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah had none.

ekegusii: Akababeka ase amaboko ’Abagibeoni, na barabwo bakabasunga ase egetunwa igoro, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Bonsi batano na babere bagaiterwa amo. Bagaitwa ase amatuko amatang’ani e rigesa, ekero bachakire kogesa endagera ekorokwa esairi.
english: He handed them over to the Gibeonites, who killed and exposed them on a hill before the LORD. All seven of them fell together; they were put to death during the first days of the harvest, just as the barley harvest was beginning.

ekegusii: Akababeka ase amaboko ’abanto b’ebisaku, erinde abanto abwo babagechete bakaba bakobagambera.
english: He handed them over to the nations, and their foes ruled over them.

ekegusii: Oribirie chinchera chiane namagena abaachire, oonchoranire oboeto bwane.
english: He has barred my way with blocks of stone; he has made my paths crooked.

ekegusii: Onsibire ase eburi ime na ong’etananeirie obororo na obokong’u.
english: He has besieged me and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

ekegusii: Nyasae oagachire orwaki aase ngoeta, obekire omosunte ase ebinchera ngoeta.
english: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; he has shrouded my paths in darkness.

ekegusii: Obunire amaino aane ase ogontakunia chinche chi’amagena, ontubire neribu.
english: He has broken my teeth with gravel; he has trampled me in the dust.

ekegusii: Okeeirie abanene korwa ase ebirogo biabo bi’obonene, oimokereirie igoro abaitongo.
english: He has brought down rulers from their thrones but has lifted up the humble.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoete aye amo n’Abalawi bamino ribaga mobeere ang’e nere. Inee! Igo mokorigia obokuani boigo?
english: He has brought you and all your fellow Levites near himself, but now you are trying to get the priesthood too.

ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia kobe gokoinyorwa, ere nigo are nobuya na amabera.
english: He has caused his wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.

ekegusii: Nabakore mobe abanene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi biria atongete; nabakore momanyekane ase ogotogigwa okuya na ogosikwa, nainwe namobe abanto bare abachenu ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, buna atebire.”
english: He has declared that he will set you in praise, fame and honor high above all the nations he has made and that you will be a people holy to the LORD your God, as he promised.

ekegusii: oyototooretie korwa ase amakweri amanene buna aria, naende natotoorie ase ekero kegochi‐gocha. Ere ntomosemeretie ng’a nagenderere gototooria,
english: He has delivered us from such a deadly peril, and he will deliver us. On him we have set our hope that he will continue to deliver us,

ekegusii: Omonene tana‐gokorera abanto b’ebisaku binde amang’ana buna ayio, barabwo tibamanyeti amachiko aye. Motogie Omonene!
english: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know his laws. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Ontang’anire na kong’etia ase omosunte, gose tari ase omobaso
english: He has driven me away and made me walk in darkness rather than light;

ekegusii: He has filled me with bitter herbs and sated me with gall.
english: Ong’ichoirie nobororo, ong’eire ekenyugwa ekeroro nanyure.

ekegusii: Abare nenchara obaigotirie amaya; abanyene enibo obaseririe bare namaboko amasa.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things but has sent the rich away empty.

ekegusii: Obaichoirie obong’aini ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi buna okomang’a, na okoroberia, na koroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, na echi’egatani engiya, na koroisia ebitambaa binde bionsi. Banyare gokora emeremo ende yonsi na bamanye koroberia oboroisia bonde bwonsi.”
english: He has filled them with skill to do all kinds of work as craftsmen, designers, embroiderers in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen, and weavers-- all of them master craftsmen and designers.

ekegusii: Aya Nyasae atoikeraneirie intwe abana babo ase okobokia Yeso. Naende buna arikire ase Zaburi ibere: “Aye naye Omwana one, rero nakoiboire.
english: he has fulfilled for us, their children, by raising up Jesus. As it is written in the second Psalm: "'You are my Son; today I have become your Father.'

ekegusii: Okonyire Israeli, omosomba oye, ase okoinyora amabera aye,
english: He has helped his servant Israel, remembering to be merciful

ekegusii: Ere oiyeirie inse orobago rwaye rore buna orw’omogondo, ee, osaririe aase emesangererekano y’ogosasima ekobeera. Omonene otigire abanto bebire Amatuko Amanene ne Chisabato agwo Sayoni, na ase okogechigwa kwaye okonene bwangire omoruoti na omokuani.
english: He has laid waste his dwelling like a garden; he has destroyed his place of meeting. The LORD has made Zion forget her appointed feasts and her Sabbaths; in his fierce anger he has spurned both king and priest.

ekegusii: na tabwataini nere oyore Omotwe. Korwa asere omobere bwonsi nigo ogokina ase ogokina gokorwa ase Nyasae, ase okonyora chinguru na kobwatanigwa ase chinengo na emeki.
english: He has lost connection with the Head, from whom the whole body, supported and held together by its ligaments and sinews, grows as God causes it to grow.

ekegusii: Okorire kera egento kiabeire egeseera ase engaki yaye, naende obekire ime ase chinkoro chia mwanyabanto engaki etabe nomoerio. Korende nonya naboigo tibakonyara komanya aya Nyasae akorete korwa omochakano goika omoerio.
english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men; yet they cannot fathom what God has done from beginning to end.

ekegusii: Ombekire imenye ase omosunte, buna abanto baria bakwete kare.
english: He has made me dwell in darkness like those long dead.

ekegusii: He has made my skin and my flesh grow old and has broken my bones.
english: Otigire chinyama chi’omobere one, ne risankwa, bigosareka; obunire amauga aane.

ekegusii: oyotoisaneirie koba abasomba b’okobwatana okoyia; tari ase ririko, korende ase Omoika. Naki ririko nigo rigoita, korende Omoika orua obogima.
english: He has made us competent as ministers of a new covenant-- not of the letter but of the Spirit; for the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

ekegusii: Takoba nomwana gose abanto b’ororeria rwaye ase egati y’abanto bamwabo, gose monto onde oye tagotigara ore moyo agwo ase amenyete.
english: He has no offspring or descendants among his people, no survivor where once he lived.

ekegusii: Okorire ogokora gwe chinguru, oserebanirie abaenenu ase ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo.
english: He has performed mighty deeds with his arm; he has scattered those who are proud in their inmost thoughts.

ekegusii: Oroisirie ebirwanero biaye ase ogoita omonto oyio, akore emegwe yaye esambe buna omorero.
english: He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes ready his flaming arrows.

ekegusii: Omonene nere otorendete tore moyo, tatotigeti totererigwe amagoro.
english: he has preserved our lives and kept our feet from slipping.

ekegusii: Naende ototeneneirie Omotooria bw’okobua ase eamate ya Daudi, omosomba oye.
english: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

ekegusii: Omonene omeririe abanto baye chingunchara, erinde abachenu baye bonsi bamotogie; ee, Abaisraeli abwo bare ang’e nere bamotogie! Motogie Omonene!
english: He has raised up for his people a horn, the praise of all his saints, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: oinyoire obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe, na obwegenwa bwaye, obwo aorogetie ase Abaisraeli. Chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense chiarorire ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.
english: He has remembered his love and his faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akomanyia abanto ba Yakobo ring’ana riaye, ee, Abaisraeli emeroberio yaye na amachiko aye.
english: He has revealed his word to Jacob, his laws and decrees to Israel.

ekegusii: Okorire ekeng’wanso, onyenyire chiombe, ne chimori chinoru; ne ching’ondi, ase obonge; naende orangeirie abana abamura bonsi b’omoruoti, na Abiatari omokuani, na Yoabu, omochiki bw’abarwani b’esegi, korende tarangereti Sulemani, omosomba oo.
english: He has sacrificed great numbers of cattle, fattened calves, and sheep, and has invited all the king's sons, Abiathar the priest and Joab the commander of the army, but he has not invited Solomon your servant.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akoa abataka ebiegwa ore nomoyo omorabu; oboronge bwaye mbogenderere kobao kare na kare; orogunchara rwaye ndokine ase ogosikwa.
english: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor, his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.

ekegusii: Yeremia otomire amang’ana gocha aiga Babeli, ogoteba: Namobeere ase obosomba ase engaki entambe; ase ayio agacha chinyomba momenye, moreme emegondo na mosimeke chindagera, morie okwama kwabo.”
english: He has sent this message to us in Babylon: It will be a long time. Therefore build houses and settle down; plant gardens and eat what they produce.'"

ekegusii: Aye mwanyabanto, Omonene okworokirie ayare amaya. Ninki Omonene aganetie korwa asore otatiga okore ayare ay’oboronge, na bwanche gokora ayare ay’obwanchani, naende otaare ase oboitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oo.
english: He has showed you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

ekegusii: Oorokeirie abanto baye okobua kw’ogokora kwaye ase okobaa emiando y’abanto b’ebisaku.
english: He has shown his people the power of his works, giving them the lands of other nations.

ekegusii: Ong’urire obonene bwane. Orusirie egutwa korwa ase omotwe one.
english: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.

ekegusii: Ere akang’ira ase enyomba y’omoyega, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bore buna ebendera igoro yane.
english: He has taken me to the banquet hall, and his banner over me is love.

ekegusii: Onsiekeire ase chinsemo chionsi, tinkonyara gosoka; onsibeire ebinyuri ebirito.
english: He has walled me in so I cannot escape; he has weighed me down with chains.

ekegusii: Nigo akogwenia abwo chinkoro chiabo chiasionoirwe, na koboa amaote abo.
english: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

ekegusii: Akaba omwegenwa ase Omonene, tatigete komoigwera, korende akabwata amachiko onsi aria Omonene achigete Musa.
english: He held fast to the LORD and did not cease to follow him; he kept the commands the LORD had given Moses.

ekegusii: Ere omonyene akabogoria ebibe biaito ase omobere oye igoro ase omote, erinde intwe tokwe korwa ase amang’ana ’ebibe, tobe moyo ase amang’ana ’oboronge. Ase amaote aye inwe mwagwenigwe.
english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.

ekegusii: Oyio tarenge omobaso oria, korende nigo achete aorokie omobaso.
english: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.

ekegusii: Ere omonyene agatang’ana bosio bwabo, akaba okona‐gotung’ama inse chintunda isano na ibere goika agaika ase oyomwabo.
english: He himself went on ahead and bowed down to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.

ekegusii: Ere naboorie Abaisraeli korwa ase ebibe biabo bionsi.
english: He himself will redeem Israel from all their sins.

ekegusii: Abare ne chinkoro chindonge Omonene nigo abagacherete obong’aini oboikeranu. Ere nigo are enguba ase abanto abwo bagotaara ase oboronge.
english: He holds victory in store for the upright, he is a shield to those whose walk is blameless,

ekegusii: Akabakora mokaba abaitongo, akabatiga mokaba nenchara. Erio akabaa mana, endagera eyio gete inwe motamanyete, nonya ne chisokoro chiaino chitamanyete, erinde monyare komanya ng’a omonto takonyara koba moyo ase endagera yoka, korende nigo akoba moyo ase kera ring’ana rikorwa ase omonwa bw’Omonene.
english: He humbled you, causing you to hunger and then feeding you with manna, which neither you nor your fathers had known, to teach you that man does not live on bread alone but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ere okeeirie abanto abwo beimokereretie igoro, otagoire omochie oria ochongororogete gochia igoro, oyoiyeirie inse kegima, ee, oyoiyeirie inse ase riroba.
english: He humbles those who dwell on high, he lays the lofty city low; he levels it to the ground and casts it down to the dust.

ekegusii: Agatonga omoruoti o Ai ase omote igoro, akamotigao goika mogoroba. Ekero erioba rikogwa Yoshua agachika ng’a egetondo gesungorwe, getugutwe ase egeita ki’omochie; na abanto bagakora bo. Erio bakagetuba amagena, akaba etui eyereo goika rero iga.
english: He hung the king of Ai on a tree and left him there until evening. At sunset, Joshua ordered them to take his body from the tree and throw it down at the entrance of the city gate. And they raised a large pile of rocks over it, which remains to this day.

ekegusii: Nigo agosiarera amagena ayio buna amaemba enkomba. Ning’o oraremererie obokendu bwaye?
english: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can withstand his icy blast?

ekegusii: Saulo akaboria komanya korwa ase Omonene, korende Omonene tamoiraneretie gento kende, nonya goetera ase chindoto, gose goetera ase Urimu, gose goetera ase ababani.
english: He inquired of the LORD, but the LORD did not answer him by dreams or Urim or prophets.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi akaboria Omonene, “Nkogenda nde korwania Abafilisti abwo esegi?” Na Omonene akamotebia, “Genda obarwanie, na otoorie Keila.”
english: he inquired of the LORD, saying, "Shall I go and attack these Philistines?" The LORD answered him, "Go, attack the Philistines and save Keilah."

ekegusii: Yeroboamu agachika Rituko Rinene ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi o gatano na gatato, buna omogwekano bwe Rituko Rinene ase Abayuda. Ase egesasimero agwo Beteli ere omonyene akarua ebing’wanso ase emegwekano eria ye chimori aroisetie. Naende agwo Beteli akabeka abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa konya aroisirie.
english: He instituted a festival on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, like the festival held in Judah, and offered sacrifices on the altar. This he did in Bethel, sacrificing to the calves he had made. And at Bethel he also installed priests at the high places he had made.

ekegusii: Akanyorokereria, agantebia, “Aye Danieli, bono nigo nachire nkoe obong’aini na okomanya.
english: He instructed me and said to me, "Daniel, I have now come to give you insight and understanding.

ekegusii: Agatebereria omotomwa oria, “Ekero gwatebirie omoruoti amang’ana onsi ay’esegi,
english: He instructed the messenger: "When you have finished giving the king this account of the battle,

ekegusii: Agachika omosomba oria bwe ritang’ani, akamotebia, “Esau ominto, ekero araumerane naye, na gokoboria: Noyo ng’o ore? Ng’ai ogochia? Etugo eye otang’anetie, neya ng’o?
english: He instructed the one in the lead: "When my brother Esau meets you and asks, 'To whom do you belong, and where are you going, and who owns all these animals in front of you?'

ekegusii: Akabachika batebie Esau omonene oye iga, “Aya naro Yakobo, omosomba oo, agokwana: Nabeire nkomenya ase ense y’obogeni, ense ya Labani goika rero iga;
english: He instructed them: "This is what you are to say to my master Esau: 'Your servant Jacob says, I have been staying with Laban and have remained there till now.

ekegusii: Yeso nere rigena riangetwe na inwe abaagachi, korende obeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.
english: He is "'the stone you builders rejected, which has become the capstone.'

ekegusii: ere nigo are nemioyo ebere, na gotiting’ara ase chinchera chiaye chionsi.
english: he is a double-minded man, unstable in all he does.

ekegusii: Na ere oranyare kobabogoreria ase obwororo abwo batamanyeti gento na batantanire, ekiagera nere omonyene nigo abuire noboreu.
english: He is able to deal gently with those who are ignorant and are going astray, since he himself is subject to weakness.

ekegusii: Ere nao arenge ritang’ani ri’ebinto bionsi, na ebinto bionsi biabwatanigwe ime asare.
english: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.

ekegusii: Ekero arabekwe ase oboina, oboina boria nigo borarendwe.
english: He is carried to the grave, and watch is kept over his tomb.

ekegusii: Amo nere natomire Onesimo, oyominto omwegenwa, omwanchwa, oyore oyomo oino. Barabwo nababamanyie onsi ayare aiga asetore.
english: He is coming with Onesimus, our faithful and dear brother, who is one of you. They will tell you everything that is happening here.

ekegusii: ere oenenire, na tamanyeti ing’ana rinde rionsi. Ere nigo are omonto ore noborwaire bw’omoyo ase amaborio na okoamererania kw’amang’ana. Ase amang’ana aya nigo bikorwao emoko, na eriomana, na oborami, na ogokagera okobe,
english: he is conceited and understands nothing. He has an unhealthy interest in controversies and quarrels about words that result in envy, strife, malicious talk, evil suspicions

ekegusii: Ere obekeire eganchwa etobekire ase amanyinga, na erieta riaye are korokwa Ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and his name is the Word of God.

ekegusii: Ere narusigwe korwa ase oborabu arutwe gochia ase omosunte; naende aserigwe korwa ase ense.
english: He is driven from light into darkness and is banished from the world.

ekegusii: Nigo agwekaine nomonto oagachete enyomba, agakunya gochia inse mono, akabeka oboroso bwaye igoro ase egetare. Ekero etoigo yachia gocha, eooro egaaka enyomba eria ne chinguru, tiyanyara koyenyegeria, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.
english: He is like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock. When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.

ekegusii: Ere nigo anga buna omote osimekire rooche mbarabare, oyokwama okwama kwaye ekero engaki yaye egoika, na amato aye tari kwoma, na rinde rionsi agokora nigo agosesenigwa.
english: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither. Whatever he does prospers.

ekegusii: “Nabo akoreereta buna ekemeri kere ase omobaso, ekio gekoranda ase omogondo bwonsi;
english: He is like a well-watered plant in the sunshine, spreading its shoots over the garden;

ekegusii: nigo anga buna omobaso o mambia asebare, buna erioba rikobara emambia etari namare. Nigo anga buna obonyansi bogokina nyuma embura koyature.”
english: he is like the light of morning at sunrise on a cloudless morning, like the brightness after rain that brings the grass from the earth.'

ekegusii: Ere nigo are nobwanchani asende, naende orwaki rwane, obwebiso bwane obokong’u na Omobooria one. Ere nenguba yane, nere ngotamera, ekiagera nabeke abanto baane inse yane banyigwere.
english: He is my loving God and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.

ekegusii: He is not here; he has risen! Remember how he told you, while he was still with you in Galilee:
english: Inyora buna abatebetie ekero arenge Galili,

ekegusii: Tari aiga, ekiagera obokire, buna atebete. Inchuo, morigererie aase Omonene araire.
english: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.

ekegusii: Nabo ere tari Nyasae bw’abakure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo, ekiagera bonsi nigo bare moyo asare.”
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to him all are alive."

ekegusii: Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakure, korende bw’abare moyo; ase ayio nigo mogosira mono.”
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!"

ekegusii: Ase chingencho chiaino chia kare nigo mogosaria ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: he is not to 'honor his father 'with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.

ekegusii: Ere nomogeni bw’omonto oyomo okorokwa Simion, omoroisia bw’amao; enyomba yaye nigo ere ang’e nengegu y’enyancha.”
english: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea."

ekegusii: Ere nigo are inse y’abareri na abarendi goika engaki eria yachigetwe na ise eike.
english: He is subject to guardians and trustees until the time set by his father.

ekegusii: Ere nekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito, gose tari ase ebibe biaito bioka, korende nase ebibe bi’ense yonsi.
english: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akonduseria egesiomba, nabeke abanto b’ebisaku inse yane.
english: He is the God who avenges me, who puts the nations under me,

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akonduseria egesiomba, nabeke abanto b’ebisaku inse yane.
english: He is the God who avenges me, who subdues nations under me,

ekegusii: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
english: Ere nomogwekano o Nyasae oyotari kororekana, omoiborwa bwe ritang’ani bw’ebitongwa bionsi.

ekegusii: Ere nere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebina biaye nigo bire ase ense yonsi.
english: He is the LORD our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

ekegusii: Nyasae nere otongete egetuse gie ching’enang’eni gekorokwa Edubu. Na ekende gekorokwa Orioni, na ekende gekorokwa Abaiseke batano na babere bamwabo, na ebinde Amakundia a irianyi.
english: He is the Maker of the Bear and Orion, the Pleiades and the constellations of the south.

ekegusii: He is the one who comes after me, the thongs of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie."
english: Nere oyorache nyuma yane, inche tinyisaini nyesibore enuga y’egekoroto kiaye.”

ekegusii: He is the one who will build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.
english: Oyio nere orang’agachere enyomba; nainche ninkong’ie ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti kebeo kogenderera botambe.

ekegusii: Ere naagachere erieta riane enyomba, nainche ninkong’ie oboruoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru kogenderera botambe.
english: He is the one who will build a house for my Name, and I will establish the throne of his kingdom forever.

ekegusii: Ere naagache enyomba ase engencho y’erieta riane. Ere nabe omwana one, nainche nimbe ise, na inche ninkore ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli kebe ne chinguru goika kare na kare.
english: He is the one who will build a house for my Name. He will be my son, and I will be his father. And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.'

ekegusii: “Omonene nere Egetare giaito, emeremo yaye nemeikeranu, ekiagera chinchera chiaye chionsi nechi’ekeene. Nyasae nomwegenwa otari nobobe; ere nigo are omonyene ekeene na oboronge.
english: He is the Rock, his works are perfect, and all his ways are just. A faithful God who does no wrong, upright and just is he.

ekegusii: Naende aimokie enyoni eria ere moyo amo noroko rw’omocharake, na eusi eyio embariri, na orosagia orwo rwa hisopo, abitobeke ime ase amanyinga ’enyoni eria yanyenyeretwe igoro y’amache aria amaya a rooche.
english: He is then to take the live bird and dip it, together with the cedar wood, the scarlet yarn and the hyssop, into the blood of the bird that was killed over the fresh water.

ekegusii: Nabeere asore buna omonto orikire, na buna omomenyi oo, abe okogokorera goika ekero Omwaka bw’Omochengo oraike.
english: He is to be treated as a hired worker or a temporary resident among you; he is to work for you until the Year of Jubilee.

ekegusii: Omonene oye amokorere buna akomokorera omonto orikire ase okomokorera emeremo omwaka ase omwaka. Aye goika origererie orore ng’a onde tari okomogambera ase obotindi.
english: He is to be treated as a man hired from year to year; you must see to it that his owner does not rule over him ruthlessly.

ekegusii: Arente obosie obwo ase omokuani, na omokuani aimokie obosie obwo boichire rce bobe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo kwarurwe asende inche Omonene, erio abosambere ase egesasimero, igoro ase ebing’wanso bigosamberwa nomorero asende. Okwo nokoruegwa gw’okorusia ebibe.
english: He is to bring it to the priest, who shall take a handful of it as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar on top of the offerings made to the LORD by fire. It is a sin offering.

ekegusii: Korwa ase okoruegwa okwo arue omogati oyomo bwa kera egesaku, ebe ekeegwa ase Omonene. Eyio ebe ey’omokuani oyio ogosiarera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso keria ase egesasimero.
english: He is to bring one of each kind as an offering, a contribution to the LORD; it belongs to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the fellowship offerings.

ekegusii: Arente amaruma ayio ase omokuani, nere arue ritang’ani riruma erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, amine ebigoti bie riruma erio, korende tabutora omotwe korwa ase ebigoti.
english: He is to bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one for the sin offering. He is to wring its head from its neck, not severing it completely,

ekegusii: Ase ayio arente korwa ase riicho riaye emingichi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha. Naye oyekorere rigori. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’okomocha koria akorire mosiabano atancheti, na omonto oria naaberwe.
english: He is to bring to the priest as a guilt offering a ram from the flock, one without defect and of the proper value. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the wrong he has committed unintentionally, and he will be forgiven.

ekegusii: Agwo Haroni aake obomera igoro ye chigoree chiria ibere, obomera obomo asende, na obonde ase Asaseli.
english: He is to cast lots for the two goats-- one lot for the LORD and the other for the scapegoat.

ekegusii: Naende anachane eng’iti eria ebitari, na omokuani oria otenenerete abichoke buya, amo nomotwe na ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasimero,
english: He is to cut it into pieces, and the priest shall arrange them, including the head and the fat, on the burning wood that is on the altar.

ekegusii: rirorio omonyene oyio aboorie omwando oye, na abare emiaka gochakera engaki eria ayoonetie, erio aakane omonto oria onde korwa ekero keria goika ase omwaka bw’omochengo. Erio airanerigwe omwando oye.
english: he is to determine the value for the years since he sold it and refund the balance to the man to whom he sold it; he can then go back to his own property.

ekegusii: Naende atobeke ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga ayio, ayanyororokerie ara gatano na kabere bosio bw’etoto eyio enachete Obomenyo Obochenu, agwo ase obosio bwane.
english: He is to dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD, in front of the curtain of the sanctuary.

ekegusii: Karayerenge na arore ng’a egetamase nkere ase enyasi y’enyomba eyio kere nekieni buna obonyansi, gose ekebariri, naende giakorire engoro gochia ime goetania rioomo,
english: He is to examine the mildew on the walls, and if it has greenish or reddish depressions that appear to be deeper than the surface of the wall,

ekegusii: Erio goika abeke amaboko aye abere ase omotwe bw’embori eria ere moyo, aorokie igoro ase embori eyio obobe bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli na ogosaria kwabo gwonsi, na ebibe biabo bionsi. Ase enchera eyio ang’anyie ebio bionsi, abibeke igoro ase omotwe bw’embori eyio. Naende embori eyio eirwe ase erooro nomonto obekirwe ang’e.
english: He is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the wickedness and rebellion of the Israelites-- all their sins-- and put them on the goat's head. He shall send the goat away into the desert in the care of a man appointed for the task.

ekegusii: Ere abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’emanwa eria, ayenyenyere agwo ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa bikonyenyerwa, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
english: He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it for a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.

ekegusii: na omonto oyio goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’embori eyio, erio ayenyenyere agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Abamura ba Haroni basiarere amanyinga aye ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Ere goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’egoree eyio, ayenyenyere agwo aase abanto bakonyenyera ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene. Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
english: He is to lay his hand on the goat's head and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the LORD. It is a sin offering.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’iti eyio ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso, erio ayenyenyere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na abakuani, abamura ba Haroni, basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Ere goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’ondi eyio akorua ebe ekeng’wanso, erio ayenyenyere agwo bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Abamura ba Haroni basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: He is to lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it in front of the Tent of Meeting. Then Aaron's sons shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Omonto oria goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, erinde yancherwe ase okobwatania omonto oria na Nyasae.
english: He is to lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it will be accepted on his behalf to make atonement for him.

ekegusii: Erio abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’embori eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na ayenyenyere agwo ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa bikonyenyerwa.
english: He is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.

ekegusii: achike ng’a amagena aria asoirwe na ukoma atagorwe, atugutwe ase eubi egotugutwa, isiko y’omochie.
english: he is to order that the contaminated stones be torn out and thrown into an unclean place outside the town.

ekegusii: Boigo arue emingichi eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe ase Omonene, ayerue amo nemegati etabekiri memera ere egetonga ime, na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa gochikire amo.
english: He is to present the basket of unleavened bread and is to sacrifice the ram as a fellowship offering to the LORD, together with its grain offering and drink offering.

ekegusii: Arente eeri eria ase obosio bwane agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Erio goika abeke okoboko kwaye igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eria, na ayenyenyere agwo ase obosio bwane.
english: He is to present the bull at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD. He is to lay his hand on its head and slaughter it before the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende arue okoruegwa kw’endagera, egetonga ekemo amo na kera eeri, na egetonga ekemo amo na kera emingichi, na amaguta ebituba bine amo na kera egetonga ekemo gi’okoruegwa kw’endagera.
english: He is to provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

ekegusii: Amo neeri eria arue okoruegwa kw’endagera egetonga ekemo na amo nemingichi eria boigo, na amo ne chimanwa chiria chie ching’ondi arue okoruegwa kw’endagera ase ekerengo aranyare korua; boigo amo na kera egetonga gi’okoruegwa kw’endagera arue ebituba bine bi’amaguta.
english: He is to provide as a grain offering one ephah with the bull, one ephah with the ram, and with the lambs as much as he wants to give, along with a hin of oil with each ephah.

ekegusii: “Ritang’ani Haroni atarasoa Aase Aachenu Mono, goika esibie omobere oye namache, amanye kobeka chianga chiria chinchenu: Eganchwa erobekanirie eigete inse, ne chisirwari, na orokini, na ekegogwa, bionsi biroisirie korwa ase egatani.
english: He is to put on the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments next to his body; he is to tie the linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are sacred garments; so he must bathe himself with water before he puts them on.

ekegusii: agindie amanyinga make ase emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero kere ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, agwo ase obosio bwane, korende amanyinga onsi aya agotigara ayaumore agwo inse ase egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosamba kere ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: He is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. The rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: ayebeke ase omorero igoro, agwo ase obosio bwane, erinde erioki ria ubani eyio ritube Oboikaranso bw’Amabera obore ekemumeko gi’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori. Atakoreti bo, nigo arakwe.
english: He is to put the incense on the fire before the LORD, and the smoke of the incense will conceal the atonement cover above the Testimony, so that he will not die.

ekegusii: korende embochero yaye, amo neubi ere imeo, abitugute ensemo ya moocha y’egesasimero, ase ribu rigotugutwa.
english: He is to remove the crop with its contents and throw it to the east side of the altar, where the ashes are.

ekegusii: Nere oyio naatananerwe egetari kiaye ki’endagera kereng’aine neki’Abalawi bande, nonya okonyora egento ase okoonia omwando atigeretwe nabaibori baye.
english: He is to share equally in their benefits, even though he has received money from the sale of family possessions.

ekegusii: Naende arusie riiyo ri’eng’iti eria ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso, ayenachane ebitari,
english: He is to skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

ekegusii: Erio ayenyenyere ase ensemo ya sugusu y’egesasimero, agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Haroni, basiarere amanyinga aria ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: He is to slaughter it at the north side of the altar before the LORD, and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle its blood against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Anyenyere emanwa eria agwo aase achenire, ase ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na eki’ogosambwa bikonyenyerwa, ekiagera ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha neki’omokuani; ekio negechenu mono.
english: He is to slaughter the lamb in the holy place where the sin offering and the burnt offering are slaughtered. Like the sin offering, the guilt offering belongs to the priest; it is most holy.

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria anyenyere eeri eria ensae agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, na abakuani, abamura ba Haroni, barente amanyinga bayasiarere chinsemo chionsi chi’egesasimero kere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: He is to slaughter the young bull before the LORD, and then Aaron's sons the priests shall bring the blood and sprinkle it against the altar on all sides at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Yoshua abe ogotenena ase obosio bw’Eleazari omokuani, na Eleazari abe okomoboreria goetera ase Urimu, agwo ase obosio bwane amanye ogwancha kwane. Yoshua amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli nigo barakore emeremo yabo yonsi buna Eleazari arabachike.”
english: He is to stand before Eleazar the priest, who will obtain decisions for him by inquiring of the Urim before the LORD. At his command he and the entire community of the Israelites will go out, and at his command they will come in."

ekegusii: Omonto oria namenye ase omochie oria goika gee arentwe bosio bw’omosangererekano agambigwe na goika omokuani bw’engaki eria akwe. Nyuma y’ayio arue ase omochie oria atamerete, airane nka ase omochie oye.”
english: He is to stay in that city until he has stood trial before the assembly and until the death of the high priest who is serving at that time. Then he may go back to his own home in the town from which he fled."

ekegusii: Erio aimokie orogio roichire omorero bw’amakara korwa ase egesasimero kere ase obosio bwane, na ubani eichire chindoe ibere, ayerente moino y’etoto eria enachete Obomenyo Obochenu,
english: He is to take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the LORD and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense and take them behind the curtain.

ekegusii: Aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri eyio, ayanyororokerie ase Oboikaranso bw’Amabera bosio, na bosio bw’Oboikaranso boria bw’Amabera ara gatano na kabere nekiara kiaye.
english: He is to take some of the bull's blood and with his finger sprinkle it on the front of the atonement cover; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the atonement cover.

ekegusii: korende chinyama chi’enda na ebirenge bisibigwe namache. Erio omokuani arue bionsi na kobisambera ase egesasimero. Ekio nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.
english: He is to wash the inner parts and the legs with water, and the priest is to bring all of it and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende chinyama chi’enda, amo nebirenge, bisibigwe namache. Omokuani oria otenenerete asambe eng’iti eria yonsi ase egesasimero, ebe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.
english: He is to wash the inner parts and the legs with water, and the priest is to burn all of it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rigotunyana eri’Esabato ere asungusie riboa erio ase obosio bwane, erio monyore ogwancherwa.
english: He is to wave the sheaf before the LORD so it will be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.

ekegusii: Nataboranwa ne chinguru korwa ase obomenyo konya asemeretie, erio airwe ase omoruoti bw’okwoboyia okonge.
english: He is torn from the security of his tent and marched off to the king of terrors.

ekegusii: Ere nere ogotogia kwaino, nere Nyasae oino, okorire ebinto ebinene na amakumia asemore, ebio mwarorire.
english: He is your praise; he is your God, who performed for you those great and awesome wonders you saw with your own eyes.

ekegusii: Akaimoka bwango, agatenena, agachaka kogenda, agasoa Hekalu ime amo nabarabwo, ogotaara na gotuma‐tuma, na komotogia Nyasae.
english: He jumped to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and jumping, and praising God.

ekegusii: He keeps company with evildoers; he associates with wicked men.
english: Ere oyio ogosanga nabanyabibe na gotaara nabakori amabe.

ekegusii: Ero nigo egosekerera obwoba, teri koondokigwa na kende; gose teri koonchoka etame korwa ase emioro.
english: He laughs at fear, afraid of nothing; he does not shy away from the sword.

ekegusii: Ero nigo egochaya eriogi rire ase omochie, teri koigwa okwoga kw’omotemi onde bwensi.
english: He laughs at the commotion in the town; he does not hear a driver's shout.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoombogania abare abasemia obatiga getirianda, nigo agokora abagambi ebina baba abariri.
english: He leads counselors away stripped and makes fools of judges.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akoombogania abakuani, obatiga getirianda, na oonchorana abanto bare nokobua.
english: He leads priests away stripped and overthrows men long established.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agwesiirera ase enyomba yaye, korende tekogenderera gotenena, nigo ayesemeretie, korende tekogenderera kobao.
english: He leans on his web, but it gives way; he clings to it, but it does not hold.

ekegusii: Erio akaraa Daudi gochiao. Abauri abwo nigo baserebekanete aande onsi bakoria, bakonywa na kwegokia, ekiagera konya banyorire ebisakorwa ebinge korwa ase ense y’Abafilisti na ense ya Yuda.
english: He led David down, and there they were, scattered over the countryside, eating, drinking and reveling because of the great amount of plunder they had taken from the land of the Philistines and from Judah.

ekegusii: Ere akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, na etato. Erio agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Samiri.
english: He led Israel twenty-three years; then he died, and was buried in Shamir.

ekegusii: Akang’etia ase egati y’amauga aria, nkarora ng’a nigo arenge amange mono ase rikura riria, naende nkarora ng’a nigo arenge amomo pa.
english: He led me back and forth among them, and I saw a great many bones on the floor of the valley, bones that were very dry.

ekegusii: Akabaraa ase enchera endonge, goika akabaikia ase omochie banyarete komenya.
english: He led them by a straight way to a city where they could settle.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nere obarusetie korwa aroro nyuma gakorire amakumia na ebikone ase ense ya Misiri, na ase Enyancha Embariri, naende ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
english: He led them out of Egypt and did wonders and miraculous signs in Egypt, at the Red Sea and for forty years in the desert.

ekegusii: Akabaraa na kobaetia ase erooro enene eyarenge ey’okoondokia, eyarenge ne ching’iti chingenda inse chire nobosongo, na ebiuge boigo: ase erooro eria enyomo etabwate amache ere akababochorera amache korwa ase egetare keria egekong’u.
english: He led you through the vast and dreadful desert, that thirsty and waterless land, with its venomous snakes and scorpions. He brought you water out of hard rock.

ekegusii: Ekero akorua singo nigo akwementera egento ase okoboria ebitoki. Inee! Omonto buna oyio nabe moyo? Yaya takoba moyo. Ekiagera akorire okogechia okwo gwonsi goika akwe. Okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye nkobe igoro yaye.
english: He lends at usury and takes excessive interest. Will such a man live? He will not! Because he has done all these detestable things, he will surely be put to death and his blood will be on his own head.

ekegusii: Akarenta omwaga o moocha okagusa igoro, na ase okobua kwaye akagusia omwaga korwa irianyi.
english: He let loose the east wind from the heavens and led forth the south wind by his power.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenda korara ore omonda, korende takoba bo rende; ekero akoramokia amaiso kabokire anyore obotenenku bwaye bwasirire.
english: He lies down wealthy, but will do so no more; when he opens his eyes, all is gone.

ekegusii: nigo akwebisa aase are bobisi, buna endo ere ase egetutu eboete, oganya ase okobwata abaremerwa; nigo akobabwata ekero akobakurura ase omoeto oye.
english: He lies in wait like a lion in cover; he lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.

ekegusii: Nigo akwebisa ase emechie oboera abanto, oganya agwo ase ogoita abanto batari na komocha. Nigo agotengera konyora abatari na gokonywa konde,
english: He lies in wait near the villages; from ambush he murders the innocent, watching in secret for his victims.

ekegusii: Ere akandusia korwa ase engoro y’obosareku, korwa ase etintira na esike; agatenenia amagoro aane ase egetare igoro, agankong’ia ase ngoeta.
english: He lifted me out of the slimy pit, out of the mud and mire; he set my feet on a rock and gave me a firm place to stand.

ekegusii: Omonene natenenie ekemanyererio gi’okorangeria egesaku kemenyete aare, nabugie omororia akerangerie geche korwa ensinyo y’ense, na rora, nkeminyoke geche bwango.
english: He lifts up a banner for the distant nations, he whistles for those at the ends of the earth. Here they come, swiftly and speedily!

ekegusii: Agatuba chinyasi chia ime y’enyomba yonsi korwa inse goika igoro ne chibao chi’emecharake, na inse y’enyomba akayetuba ne chibao chi’emetarakwa.
english: He lined its interior walls with cedar boards, paneling them from the floor of the temple to the ceiling, and covered the floor of the temple with planks of pine.

ekegusii: He listened to Paul as he was speaking. Paul looked directly at him, saw that he had faith to be healed
english: Omonto oyio akaigwa Paulo kagokwana. Paulo akamobeta amaiso, akarora ng’a nare nokwegena gw’okogwenigwa,

ekegusii: Nigo agoichoria amare amarito namache, amare nigo agosiarera chinkoba chiaye.
english: He loads the clouds with moisture; he scatters his lightning through them.

ekegusii: Akaba nkogania are koigotia enda yaye ase amasabo aria chimbeche chiarenge koria; monto onde tarenge komoa gento.
english: He longed to fill his stomach with the pods that the pigs were eating, but no one gave him anything.

ekegusii: Akabarigereria bonsi, agatebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakora bo; okoboko kwaye gokagwenigwa.
english: He looked around at them all, and then said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He did so, and his hand was completely restored.

ekegusii: Akabamogoreria amaiso chinsemo chionsi ase okobea, akaigwa obororo ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiabo, agatebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao!” Agakorambora, na okoboko kwaye gokagwena.
english: He looked around at them in anger and, deeply distressed at their stubborn hearts, said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." He stretched it out, and his hand was completely restored.

ekegusii: Ere akarigereria, akarora ang’e nase omotwe oye omogati ogekeire igoro ase omorero bw’amakara na amache are ase egetoono. Akaria na akanywa, erio akarara.
english: He looked around, and there by his head was a cake of bread baked over hot coals, and a jar of water. He ate and drank and then lay down again.

ekegusii: He looked David over and saw that he was only a boy, ruddy and handsome, and he despised him.
english: Ekero Omofilisti oria aroche Daudi oyorenge omosae omobariri na omonyakieni, akamochaya mono.

ekegusii: Ere akarigereria maate gochia ensemo ya Sodomu na Gomora, na ense yonsi eraire, na agwo akarora erioki rigotiira korwa inse, buna erioki rikorwa ase eriko rinene.
english: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah, toward all the land of the plain, and he saw dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.

ekegusii: Akarigereria igoro, akabora, “Narorire abanto, ko nigo banga buna emete bakogenda.”
english: He looked up and said, "I see people; they look like trees walking around."

ekegusii: Yehu akarigereria gochia ase ekebao, akaboria, “Ning’o ore ase ensemo yane? Ning’o?” Abasacha bagombaetigwe babere, gose batato, bakamorigereria gochia isiko.
english: He looked up at the window and called out, "Who is on my side? Who?" Two or three eunuchs looked down at him.

ekegusii: Erio akarigereria gochia igoro, agaita egekoe, akamotebia, “Efatha,” engencho yaye, “Igoreka.”
english: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, "Ephphatha!" (which means, "Be opened!").

ekegusii: Nigo ekorigereria kera egento kere igoro mono etari gokioboa, nigo ere omoruoti bw’ebitongwa bionsi bire noboenenu.”
english: He looks down on all that are haughty; he is king over all that are proud."

ekegusii: Ere nigo anchete koragereria, bono tiga okoragereria okwo komoiranere. Ere tanchete gosesenia, ase ayio ogosesenigwa kobe aare asare.
english: He loved to pronounce a curse-- may it come on him; he found no pleasure in blessing-- may it be far from him.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaagacha egesasimero gi’etaai. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo ebere, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko ikomi.
english: He made a bronze altar twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.

ekegusii: Boigo akaagacha omwaraache bwe chisiiro. Obotambe bwaye nobw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etato. Bosio bw’enyomba eyio akaagacha egesona, na bosio aroro chisiiro chire nekerama.
english: He made a colonnade fifty cubits long and thirty wide. In front of it was a portico, and in front of that were pillars and an overhanging roof.

ekegusii: He made darkness his canopy around him-- the dark rain clouds of the sky.
english: Agetuba ere omonyene nomosunte, na amare amarito aichire amache.

ekegusii: He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him-- the dark rain clouds of the sky.
english: Agetuba ere omonyenye nomosunte, na amare amarito aichire amache.

ekegusii: akamobeka koba omoruoti igoro ase abanto ba Gileadi, na Asuri, na Yesireeli, na Efraimu, na Benjamin, na igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: He made him king over Gilead, Ashuri and Jezreel, and also over Ephraim, Benjamin and all Israel.

ekegusii: Akamobeka akaba omoteneneri bw’enyomba yaye, amo nebinto bionsi abwate,
english: He made him master of his household, ruler over all he possessed,

ekegusii: “Akabakinia na kobatiiria ase ebitunwa igoro, akabarageria okwama kw’emegondo, na obooke korwa ase egetare ime, na amaguta ’amazeituni korwa ase egetare egekong’u.
english: He made him ride on the heights of the land and fed him with the fruit of the fields. He nourished him with honey from the rock, and with oil from the flinty crag,

ekegusii: Akaroisia ebinyuri, akabibeka igoro ase chisiiro chiria; akaroisia nemegwekano y’amakomomanga rigana erimo, akayebeka igoro ase ebinyuri biria.
english: He made interwoven chains and put them on top of the pillars. He also made a hundred pomegranates and attached them to the chains.

ekegusii: Nere omanyekanetie chinchera chiaye ase Musa, naboigo nogokora kwaye ase Abaisraeli.
english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel:

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Babeli akabeka Matania ise moke Yehoyakini akaba omoruoti ase ribaga riaye; akaonchora erieta riaye, akamoroka Zedekia.
english: He made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin's uncle, king in his place and changed his name to Zedekiah.

ekegusii: Agatieria omonwa one okaba buna omoro omwoge, akambisa ime ase ekiriri gi’okoboko kwaye; agantieria nkaba buna ensara enyoge, agansoyia ase omobirangwa ime, akambisa aroro.
english: He made my mouth like a sharpened sword, in the shadow of his hand he hid me; he made me into a polished arrow and concealed me in his quiver.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaroisia ase enyomba eria ebibao bi’emete; ebibao ebio tibiarenge koigorwa.
english: He made narrow clerestory windows in the temple.

ekegusii: gose takorete gwatananekana ase egati yaito na barabwo, korende agasibia chinkoro chiabo ase okwegena.
english: He made no distinction between us and them, for he purified their hearts by faith.

ekegusii: oyomo ase kera ensinyo, akayekora ekaba egento ekemo n’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera.
english: He made one cherub on one end and the second cherub on the other; at the two ends he made them of one piece with the cover.

ekegusii: Akarosia emegwekano y’amakomomanga, akayebeka ase chindwaro ibere igoro y’ebichanga biarenge ase ebisure biria.
english: He made pomegranates in two rows encircling each network to decorate the capitals on top of the pillars. He did the same for each capital.

ekegusii: Naende akaroisia ebibekerero bie chitaya korwa ase chitahabu buna atebereretigwe, akabibeka ime ase Hekalu, bitano ensemo ya irianyi, na bitano ensemo ya sugusu.
english: He made ten gold lampstands according to the specifications for them and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.

ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chimesa ikomi, agachibeka ime ase Hekalu isano ensemo ya borio, na isano ensemo ya bomosi; akaroisia ne chisani rigana erimo korwa ase chitahabu.
english: He made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north. He also made a hundred gold sprinkling bowls.

ekegusii: Akaroisia ekemumeko gi’etahabu echenire ebe Oboikaranso bw’Amabera. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere na ekeng’ese, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
english: He made the atonement cover of pure gold-- two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.

ekegusii: He made the courtyard of the priests, and the large court and the doors for the court, and overlaid the doors with bronze.
english: Akaroisia neraaro y’abakuani, na eraaro ende enene, akaroisia nebisieri bie chiraaro chiria, akabiooma ne chitaai.

ekegusii: Akaroisia etoto y’egetambaa korwa ase chiusi chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo ne chiusi chi’egatani engiya, akayeroisia ebe nemegwekano y’abakerubi.
english: He made the curtain of blue, purple and crimson yarn and fine linen, with cherubim worked into it.

ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia egetuba ekenene korwa ase etaai enyititoire na kobombwa, ekaba egesingo. Ekerengo korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende nigo kiarenge eki’amaboko ikomi. Obotambe gochia igoro nigo bwarenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Engori y’obotambe bw’amaboko emerongo etato ekanyara goetanana egetuba ekio.
english: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.

ekegusii: Naende akaroisia egetuba ekenene mono korwa ase etaai enyititoire na kobombwa, ekaba egesingo. Ekerengo korwa ensemo eyemo goika eyende nigo kiarenge eki’amaboko ikomi. Obotambe gochia igoro nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano. Engori yaetananetigweo nigo yarenge ey’obotambe bw’amaboko emerongo etato.
english: He made the Sea of cast metal, circular in shape, measuring ten cubits from rim to rim and five cubits high. It took a line of thirty cubits to measure around it.

ekegusii: Omonene akagokora amagoro e chigari chiabo, goika bagasinywa kogenda bosio. Erio Abamisiri bagateba, “Tiga totame korwa ase Abaisraeli, ekiagera Omonene nkobarwanera are mamincha yaito intwe Abamisiri.”
english: He made the wheels of their chariots come off so that they had difficulty driving. And the Egyptians said, "Let's get away from the Israelites! The LORD is fighting for them against Egypt."

ekegusii: agatiga chinyoni echio chikagwa gati‐gati y’egetwori kiabo, chigaetanana chiema chiabo.
english: He made them come down inside their camp, all around their tents.

ekegusii: Nere okorenta amare korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense; nere okorenta chinkoba chire nembura, na omwaga okogusa korwa ase ebigancha biaye.
english: He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth; he sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

ekegusii: Nigo okomeria obonyansi ching’iti chikorisia, naende kwanyorera abanto ebimeri bagokorera, na igo kwabanyorera chindagera korwa ase riroba.
english: He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for man to cultivate-- bringing forth food from the earth:

ekegusii: Nigo agotira‐tiria emete eyio buna emori egotiria, na ebitunwa bia Lebanoni na Sirioni buna eng’era ensae.
english: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, Sirion like a young wild ox.

ekegusii: Nigo agontimokeria ase obonyansi obobese na kondaa gochia ase amache amakenonoku akwongora ng’ora.
english: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters,

ekegusii: Ere okorire amagoro aane abeire buna ay’egesia, onkong’irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.
english: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he enables me to stand on the heights.

ekegusii: Ere okorire amagoro aane abeire buna ey’egesia, onkong’irie na gontenenia ase ebitunwa.
english: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he enables me to stand on the heights.

ekegusii: Nigo agokinia ebisaku, naende obisiria; nigo akobikora biabucha, naende obing’anyia.
english: He makes nations great, and destroys them; he enlarges nations, and disperses them.

ekegusii: Nigo ogotubokia chinsoko ase amagoko, amache aba agoeta ase egati y’ebitunwa.
english: He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.

ekegusii: Nigo egoserokia amache korwa ase chindiba inse, nigo egokora amache ’enyancha aba buna amaguta aburukanirie.
english: He makes the depths churn like a boiling caldron and stirs up the sea like a pot of ointment.

ekegusii: Nigo agotinora amato abo baigwa ogokurerwa, na obachika baonchoke, batige gokora amabe.
english: He makes them listen to correction and commands them to repent of their evil.

ekegusii: Otangire chisegi ase ense engima, obunire amata, osenyentire amatimo, osambire chigari nomorero.
english: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear, he burns the shields with fire.

ekegusii: He makes winds his messengers, flames of fire his servants.
english: Gwakorire abamalaika bao babeire chimbeo, na abasomba bao babeire ebibemberi bi’omorero.

ekegusii: Ong’ororirie ekeringerera kere orobebe rw’amache ase ogwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte.
english: He marks out the horizon on the face of the waters for a boundary between light and darkness.

ekegusii: Ere nabe ne ribaga ri’okoria okoruegwa kw’endagera gokoruegwa asende inche Nyasae oye, okoruegwa okore ogochenu, amo nokore ogochenu mono.
english: He may eat the most holy food of his God, as well as the holy food;

ekegusii: Nabo Nyasae akomorenda buya na komokonya, na nigo akoba origereretie mono chinchera chiaye.
english: He may let them rest in a feeling of security, but his eyes are on their ways.

ekegusii: Ere nabe ogokora emeremo ase erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye, buna Abalawi bande bamwabo bagotenena gokora emeremo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: he may minister in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who serve there in the presence of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio agwo otinora amato ’abanto, na obarentera ogokurera gw’okoondokia
english: he may speak in their ears and terrify them with warnings,

ekegusii: Akarenga chindwaro chie chisiiro chiarenge ase chinsemo ibere ime y’egesoero, na obotambe obwo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na isiko goetanana chisiiro echio amabaga narengeo.
english: He measured along the faces of the projecting walls all around the inside of the gateway-- sixty cubits. The measurement was up to the portico facing the courtyard.

ekegusii: Naende akarenga orwaki rwaye. Orwo nigo rwarenge ase ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo na emerongo ene, na ane, ase ekerengo kia mwanyabanto, na eki’abamalaika boigo.
english: He measured its wall and it was 144 cubits thick, by man's measurement, which the angel was using.

ekegusii: Naende akabwatia orooche roria, akarenga obotambe bw’amaboko ande elifu eyemo, akanyambokia ase amache aria, naro akang’ika ase amaru. Naende akarenga amaboko elifu eyemo ende, akanyambokia ase amache, naro akang’ika ase ekenema.
english: He measured off another thousand cubits and led me through water that was knee-deep. He measured off another thousand and led me through water that was up to the waist.

ekegusii: Naende akarenga amaboko elifu eyemo ende, bono konya rwabeire orooche oronene ntare konyara gotaara imeo. Amache aria konya aichoire mono, tinare konyara kwamboka otatiga ase ogoaka entimbu.
english: He measured off another thousand, but now it was a river that I could not cross, because the water had risen and was deep enough to swim in-- a river that no one could cross.

ekegusii: Akaimokia emoti, akarengera ensemo ya moocha, ekaba chimoti amagana atano.
english: He measured the east side with the measuring rod; it was five hundred cubits.

ekegusii: Erio akaonchoka, akarenga ensemo ya sugusu, ekaba chimoti amagana atano.
english: He measured the north side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

ekegusii: Akarenga ensemo ya irianyi, ekaba chimoti amagana atano.
english: He measured the south side; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

ekegusii: akaumerana nabamwabo Ahasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akaboria, “Inwe mbarabi?” Nabarabwo bakairaneria, “Intwe nigo tore abamwabo Ahasia, nigo tokogenda gokwania abana b’omoruoti, na ab’eting’ana, ng’ina omoruoti.”
english: he met some relatives of Ahaziah king of Judah and asked, "Who are you?" They said, "We are relatives of Ahaziah, and we have come down to greet the families of the king and of the queen mother."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agochecheria abwo bagochecheria, korende abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya na amabera.
english: He mocks proud mockers but gives grace to the humble.

ekegusii: Akariina omokerubi, akairuruka; akarorekana igoro ye chimbaba chi’embeo.
english: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

ekegusii: Akariina omokerubi, akairuruka, agacha ng’ora igoro ye chimbaba chi’embeo.
english: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, akagenda akarema akanyora entuboka ende; eyio ero tibayiomanera. Ase ayio akayeroka Reoboti, akabora, “Naki bono Omonene otoeire ense engare, na toragenderere komenteka ase ense eye.”
english: He moved on from there and dug another well, and no one quarreled over it. He named it Rehoboth, saying, "Now the LORD has given us room and we will flourish in the land."

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoba nendamwamu nigo akoonchorana ebitunwa, obitigeria korwa aase abo, na abanto tibari komanya ayio.
english: He moves mountains without their knowing it and overturns them in his anger.

ekegusii: goika eatanane korwa ase edivai amo nebinyugwa bigotindia. Tabaisa konywa ebinyugwa binde bionsi bikoroisigwa korwa ase amasabibu, gose taria amasabibu, amabese gose amomo.
english: he must abstain from wine and other fermented drink and must not drink vinegar made from wine or from other fermented drink. He must not drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins.

ekegusii: Goika amoe omomura oye omotangi chinibo ara kabere, nonya ore omwana bw’omokungu atancheti. Omomura oyio nere omotangi; omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi noyoye.
english: He must acknowledge the son of his unloved wife as the firstborn by giving him a double share of all he has. That son is the first sign of his father's strength. The right of the firstborn belongs to him.

ekegusii: Nagwenerete gwatorwa ng’a nomuya nabanto bare isiko, erinde tabaisa kogwa ase ogosoerwa, na ase omoeto o Saitani.
english: He must also have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he will not fall into disgrace and into the devil's trap.

ekegusii: omonto oyio akigite etukia, korende takigita ase richoncho rire, na omokuani amwatanane, amobeke ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.
english: he must be shaved except for the diseased area, and the priest is to keep him in isolation another seven days.

ekegusii: Ere goika amenteke, korende inche nkee.
english: He must become greater; I must become less.

ekegusii: naende ekero arabe ogwokia chitaya engaki ya mogoroba. Ogosambwa okwo kwa ubani nigo koragenderere botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene, ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: He must burn incense again when he lights the lamps at twilight so incense will burn regularly before the LORD for the generations to come.

ekegusii: Ase igo egento ekio gesambwe nomorero, gokerabe eanga, gose egetambaa kende gionsi, keroisirie korwa ase amarionya, gose korwa ase egatani, gose gento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa kere noborwaire obwo ime yaye. Obwo noborwaire obobe bwa ukoma; ebinto ebio goika bisambwe nomorero.
english: He must burn up the clothing, or the woven or knitted material of wool or linen, or any leather article that has the contamination in it, because the mildew is destructive; the article must be burned up.

ekegusii: na eatanane ase Omonene naende, ase engaki eng’ana buna eria ariete eira koba Omwerwa agwo ritang’ani. Erio arente emanwa emingichi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha kwaye ekiagera amatuko aria aye amatang’ani eatananete ase Omonene buna Omwerwa oye takobarwa korende nigo arabe bosa, ekiagera okwerwa kwaye gwakorirwe ogotachenegeti.
english: He must dedicate himself to the LORD for the period of his separation and must bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. The previous days do not count, because he became defiled during his separation.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio chinyasi chionsi chia ime chiomorwe, erio amaoomo atugutwe aase are neubi isiko y’omochie.
english: He must have all the inside walls of the house scraped and the material that is scraped off dumped into an unclean place outside the town.

ekegusii: Ere nigo emogwenerete abwate ring’ana ri’ekeene buna riorokereretigwe, erinde anyare koremia abanto ase okworokereria kw’obogima, na koebereria abakoengererania nere.
english: He must hold firmly to the trustworthy message as it has been taught, so that he can encourage others by sound doctrine and refute those who oppose it.

ekegusii: Omonto oria naakane egento keria egechenu ataruete, naende goika amente ensemo ya isano ye rigori ri’egento ekio, ayee omokuani. Erio omokuani arue emingichi eyio y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha na akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.
english: He must make restitution for what he has failed to do in regard to the holy things, add a fifth of the value to that and give it all to the priest, who will make atonement for him with the ram as a guilt offering, and he will be forgiven.

ekegusii: Naende nemogwenerete abe omonto omanyete kogambera ab’enyomba yaye omonyene buya, na kworokereria abana baye baigwere ase ogosika gwonsi,
english: He must manage his own family well and see that his children obey him with proper respect.

ekegusii: Ere taba omonto oonchoka rero iga, abaise gocha koenena na kogwa ase okogambigwa gwa Saitani.
english: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall under the same judgment as the devil.

ekegusii: Taria enyama y’eng’iti ekwete yoka enyene, gose eye eitire neng’iti ende y’orosana. Aise koria enyama buna eyio, nigo arabe oyotachenegeti. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: He must not eat anything found dead or torn by wild animals, and so become unclean through it. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Tabaisa gosoa enyomba ase abanto babekire omobere bw’omonto okure, gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka, naba ise gose ng’ina.
english: He must not enter a place where there is a dead body. He must not make himself unclean, even for his father or mother,

ekegusii: Omonto oria takoba ne ribaga koonchoreria eng’iti eria arente eng’iti eng’ao, takoonchoreria eng’iti engiya arente eyere embe, gose eng’iti embe arente eyere engiya. Onye omonto okoonchoreria ching’iti, erio chionsi ibere nachibe chiatananirwe asende.
english: He must not exchange it or substitute a good one for a bad one, or a bad one for a good one; if he should substitute one animal for another, both it and the substitute become holy.

ekegusii: Ekiagera omokuani are omotang’ani ase abanto baye, tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka.
english: He must not make himself unclean for people related to him by marriage, and so defile himself.

ekegusii: Tabaisa konyuoma omokungu omoboraka, gose oyobatiganire nomosacha oye, gose oyotari omwekungi, gose ore omotayayi, korende anyuome omoiseke omwekungi korwa ase abanto b’egesaku kiaye.
english: He must not marry a widow, a divorced woman, or a woman defiled by prostitution, but only a virgin from his own people,

ekegusii: Omonyene eng’iti eria takoriga‐rigereria, onye ere engiya gose embe, na takoyeonchoreria. Onye omonto okoonchoreria ching’iti echio, erio chionsi ibere nchibe chinchenu, tichikoboorigwa.”
english: He must not pick out the good from the bad or make any substitution. If he does make a substitution, both the animal and its substitute become holy and cannot be redeemed.'"

ekegusii: Omoruoti oria taba na bakungu abange, ekiagera ayio nigo aragere enkoro yaye eonchoke etige Omonene, gose takorigia kwementera chitahabu ne chifeta.
english: He must not take many wives, or his heart will be led astray. He must not accumulate large amounts of silver and gold.

ekegusii: Ere goika amoiranerie akamanwa karia ara kane, ekiagera akora ring’ana erio, na ekiagera atabwate amabera.”
english: He must pay for that lamb four times over, because he did such a thing and had no pity."

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato, naende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, omonto oria goika esibie namache, nabe ochenekire; korende onye tagwesibia ase amatuko aya abere takoba oyochenekire.
english: He must purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third and seventh days, he will not be clean.

ekegusii: Ere igoro yagwenerete komonyora, goika chichiche chingaki chi’ebinto bionsi bigokorwa ebiyia, ebiakwanetwe na Nyasae ase emenwa y’ababani baye abachenu korwa kare.
english: He must remain in heaven until the time comes for God to restore everything, as he promised long ago through his holy prophets.

ekegusii: Tiga atige amabe, akore amaya, arigie omorembe na koyotunyana mono.
english: He must turn from evil and do good; he must seek peace and pursue it.

ekegusii: akamoroka Nuhu agateba, “Oyo nere oratoremie intwe ase emeremo yaito, na obokong’u bwaito, ase riroba eri Omonene aragereretie.”
english: He named him Noah and said, "He will comfort us in the labor and painful toil of our hands caused by the ground the LORD has cursed."

ekegusii: Ere akarora ng’a namang’ana amagusu kobwatia chingencho chia Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, na agakora ebibe buna ebiaye; amo nayio akanyuoma Yesebeli, omoiseke bw’Etabali, omoruoti bw’Abasidoni. Boigo agakorera enyasae Baali na koyesasima.
english: He not only considered it trivial to commit the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, but he also married Jezebel daughter of Ethbaal king of the Sidonians, and began to serve Baal and worship him.

ekegusii: Naki omonene oito, amang’ana aya akwanetwe igoro yaye, nigo arenge bw’ororeria ronde oroao, na onde tarenge korwa ase ororeria orwo ore gokorera ase egesasimero.
