english: He of whom these things are said belonged to a different tribe, and no one from that tribe has ever served at the altar.

ekegusii: Yakobo akarua ekeng’wanso agwo ase egetunwa, akarangeria abanto baye bache koragera amo nere, bakaba aroro ase egetunwa obotuko obwo bwonsi.
english: He offered a sacrifice there in the hill country and invited his relatives to a meal. After they had eaten, they spent the night there.

ekegusii: Boigo akarua ebing’wanso na agasambera ubani agwo aase aimokererete igoro, na igoro ase ebigoro, na inse ya kera omote omobese.
english: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.

ekegusii: Akarua ebing’wanso na gosambera ubani agwo aase aimokererete igoro, na ase ebigoro, na inse ya kera omote omobese.
english: He offered sacrifices and burned incense at the high places, on the hilltops and under every spreading tree.

ekegusii: Akarua ebing’wanso ase chinyasae chia Damesiki, chiria konya chiamobuire, agateba, “Chinyasae chi’abaruoti b’Abasiiria nachio chiabakonyete bakabua, goika nchiruere ebing’wanso, erinde chinkonye nainche.” Korende chirochio chikarenta ogosirigwa kwaye na okw’Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: He offered sacrifices to the gods of Damascus, who had defeated him; for he thought, "Since the gods of the kings of Aram have helped them, I will sacrifice to them so they will help me." But they were his downfall and the downfall of all Israel.

ekegusii: Akarua ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kwaye kw’endagera, naende akaumora okoruegwa kwaye gw’ekenyugwa, na akanyororokeria amanyinga ’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe igoro ase egesasimero.
english: He offered up his burnt offering and grain offering, poured out his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his fellowship offerings on the altar.

ekegusii: Na igo egachaka korama Nyasae, ekarama na erieta riaye, na obomenyo bwaye, na abwo bamenyete igoro,
english: He opened his mouth to blaspheme God, and to slander his name and his dwelling place and those who live in heaven.

ekegusii: Akabochora egetare, na amache agasoka korwao, akaminyoka ase erooro buna orooche.
english: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; like a river it flowed in the desert.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agokorera abataka na abaremerwa bobe, na kourereria abanto ebinto biabo, gose tari koirania egento aetwe koba intenenera, ere nigo akorigereria emegwekano egosasimwa na gokora ay’okogechia.
english: He oppresses the poor and needy. He commits robbery. He does not return what he took in pledge. He looks to the idols. He does detestable things.

ekegusii: Agachika omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana arende Paulo, korende amoe ribaga rike, gose tamokania nonya noyomo bw’abasani baye komokorera, gose gocha komorora.
english: He ordered the centurion to keep Paul under guard but to give him some freedom and permit his friends to take care of his needs.

ekegusii: Naende agachika abanto abamenyete Yerusalemu barue ebing’wanso ebi Abalawi bachikeretwe koegwa, erinde barabwo banyare kwerua ase obokoreri bw’amachiko ’Omonene.
english: He ordered the people living in Jerusalem to give the portion due the priests and Levites so they could devote themselves to the Law of the LORD.

ekegusii: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
english: Akayeooma netahabu echenire, ime na isiko, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etahabu.

ekegusii: Akaooma enyomba yonsi ne chitahabu; emiamba, na emetobwa, ne chinyasi, na ebisieri, ebinto ebio bionsi akabiooma ne chitahabu, akabaacha emegwekano y’abakerubi ase chinyasi.
english: He overlaid the ceiling beams, doorframes, walls and doors of the temple with gold, and he carved cherubim on the walls.

ekegusii: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
english: Abakerubi bonsi babere bakaoomwa netahabu.

ekegusii: Agasiria ebisaku bitano na bibere ase ense ya Kanani, na ense yabo akabaa ebe omwando obo,
english: he overthrew seven nations in Canaan and gave their land to his people as their inheritance.

ekegusii: Chinyasi chia ime chie Hekalu enyene agachituba ne chibao chi’emetarakwa, naende agachiooma ne chitahabu chingiya, agachichabera nemegwekano y’emekendo na ey’ebinyuri.
english: He paneled the main hall with pine and covered it with fine gold and decorated it with palm tree and chain designs.

ekegusii: Akang’usa igoro gocha inse aa, nere agacha, riire rimwamu rikaba inse y’amagoro aye.
english: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.

ekegusii: Akang’usa igoro gocha inse aa, agacha; riire rimwamu rikaba inse y’amagoro aye.
english: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.

ekegusii: Akaagacha akanyomba ka ime bosio kegima ase Hekalu ime, kabe Aase Aachenu Mono. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere; akanyomba karia akagatuba ne chibao chi’emecharake, korwa inse goika igoro.
english: He partitioned off twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.

ekegusii: Nigo egokura‐kura riroba ase ense omweya, yagokera chinguru chiaye. Erio yaminyoka koumerana nabare nebirwanero bi’esegi.
english: He paws fiercely, rejoicing in his strength, and charges into the fray.

ekegusii: Akaba okoruta amagena ase Daudi omoruoti na ase abasomba baye bonsi, nonya abanto bonsi, amo nabaria chituoni, bamoetanaine, ase ensemo ya borio na eya bomosi.
english: He pelted David and all the king's officials with stones, though all the troops and the special guard were on David's right and left.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokora amang’ana amanene atari komanyekana buna are, boigo namakumia atanyare kobareka.
english: He performs wonders that cannot be fathomed, miracles that cannot be counted.

ekegusii: Nigo agokora amang’ana amanene aetanetie obomanyi bwonsi, na amakumia amange atari kobareka.
english: He performs wonders that cannot be fathomed, miracles that cannot be counted.

ekegusii: na akaimokia egetambaa gi’okwambara ki’Elija keria kiagwete korwa asare, akairana, agatenena ase engegu ya Yorodan.
english: He picked up the cloak that had fallen from Elijah and went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan.

ekegusii: Ere ondasire ne chinsara chi’egochi yaye, chiasoire ase chinyigo chiane.
english: He pierced my heart with arrows from his quiver.

ekegusii: Akabeka ebibekerero bitano ensemo ya irianyi ye Hekalu, na bitano ensemo ya sugusu, na egetuba keria ekenene agakebeka ensemo ya irianyi ya moocha.
english: He placed five of the stands on the south side of the temple and five on the north. He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner of the temple.

ekegusii: Akabeka egetuba ase egati y’Eema y’Omosangererekano na egesasimero, akabeka amache ogwesibia imeo.
english: He placed the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing,

ekegusii: Erio akamobekera egesembe, na ime ase egesembe ekio akabeka Urimu na Tumimu (omobaso na oboikeranu).
english: He placed the breastpiece on him and put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.

ekegusii: Abakerubi abwo bakabekwa ase akanyomba karia bosio ime ye Hekalu. Chimbaba chiabo nigo chiaramboire; orobaba oromo rw’omokerubi oyomo rogaika enyasi ensemo eyemo, na oromo rw’oyonde rogaika enyasi ensemo ende; gati‐gati y’enyomba orobaba ronde rwa kera omokerubi rogakunana.
english: He placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple, with their wings spread out. The wing of one cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the other touched the other wall, and their wings touched each other in the middle of the room.

ekegusii: Akabeka ekebekerero gie chitaya ase Obomenyo ime, ensemo ya irianyi, kororia ase emesa.
english: He placed the lampstand in the Tent of Meeting opposite the table on the south side of the tabernacle

ekegusii: Akabeka egetuba keria ekenene ensemo ya borio gochia irianyi ya moocha.
english: He placed the Sea on the south side, at the southeast corner.

ekegusii: Akamoboria amang’ana amange, korende ere tamoiraneria rinde rionsi.
english: He plied him with many questions, but Jesus gave him no answer.

ekegusii: Akaumora amaguta akweakwa igoro ase omotwe o Haroni, na akamoaka amaguta ase okomwatanana na komochena.
english: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him to consecrate him.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorentera abagambi ogochaywa, na abanto bare nokobua nigo akobaura chinguru.
english: He pours contempt on nobles and disarms the mighty.

ekegusii: Erio agasaba Omonene, agateba, “Aye Omonene, Inee, amang’ana aya tari aro natebete ekero narenge ase ense yane? Naende nakio kiagerete ngatama gochia Tarisisi, ekiagera nigo namanyete ng’a aye nigo ore Nyasae oichire nobuya na amabera; tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, na obwanchani bwao obonene nigo bogendererete botambe, naende nigo okoonchora ebirengererio biao, tokobakorera amabe.
english: He prayed to the LORD, "O LORD, is this not what I said when I was still at home? That is why I was so quick to flee to Tarshish. I knew that you are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger and abounding in love, a God who relents from sending calamity.

ekegusii: Ekero arabe ogosaba Nyasae, nere namororere amabera; omonto oyio nachiche ase obosio bwaye ore nomogoko, na Nyasae nairanie oboronge bw’omonto oyio.
english: He prays to God and finds favor with him, he sees God's face and shouts for joy; he is restored by God to his righteous state.

ekegusii: Ase obwanchani bwaye Nyasae atochorete korwa kare, erinde tokorwe koba abana baye ase enchera ya Yeso Kristo, koreng’ana nokogania kw’ogwancha kwaye,
english: he predestined us to be adopted as his sons through Jesus Christ, in accordance with his pleasure and will--

ekegusii: Ere akaroiseria endamwamu yaye enchera; akabeka emioyo yabo ase amakweri, akabarentera oborwaire bokabaita.
english: He prepared a path for his anger; he did not spare them from death but gave them over to the plague.

ekegusii: Ime ye Hekalu bosio kegima nigo aroisetie akanyomba aase Esanduku y’Okobwatana y’Omonene yarenge kobekwa.
english: He prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple to set the ark of the covenant of the LORD there.

ekegusii: Erio akairera Egiloni, omoruoti bw’ense ya Moabu, ebiegwa biria. Egiloni nigo arenge omonto omonetu mono.
english: He presented the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was a very fat man.

ekegusii: nigo akorenda amauga aye onsi, rinde tiribunwa nonya nerimo.
english: he protects all his bones, not one of them will be broken.

ekegusii: Naende Daudi akarenta ebioma ebinge bi’okoroisigwa emesumari y’ebisieri bi’ebiita amo nebibwatero, akarenta ne chitaai chinyinge chitare korengeka.
english: He provided a large amount of iron to make nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, and more bronze than could be weighed.

ekegusii: Ere otomeire abanto baye okoboorigwa, na ochikire okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania kobeo goika kare na kare. Erieta riaye nigo rire richenu na eri’okoirokwa.
english: He provided redemption for his people; he ordained his covenant forever-- holy and awesome is his name.

ekegusii: Nere okoa ching’iti chionsi endagera yabo, naende orageria amage ’ebigonkoru ekero akorera.
english: He provides food for the cattle and for the young ravens when they call.

ekegusii: Nigo akoa abanto abwo bamoirogete endagera; nabe ogendererete koinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania goika kare na kare.
english: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.

ekegusii: Ero ekaba egotaara ase egati ye chindo, ee, ekaba endo ere ne chinguru, ekeorokereria gotwara, nero ekaba ekoria abanto.
english: He prowled among the lions, for he was now a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he devoured men.

ekegusii: Agatagora na akaiyeria inse ebisasimero biarenge igoro ase ekerama ang’e nakanyomba ka igoro k’Ahasi, biria abaruoti b’Abayuda baagachete, na biria Manase aagachete ase chiraaro ibere chi’enyomba y’Omonene. Akabinachana ebing’ese, erio akaruta orotu rwabo ase akarooche ga Kidironi.
english: He pulled down the altars the kings of Judah had erected on the roof near the upper room of Ahaz, and the altars Manasseh had built in the two courts of the temple of the LORD. He removed them from there, smashed them to pieces and threw the rubble into the Kidron Valley.

ekegusii: Ensara eyio eng’uswe korwa ase omobere oye, ee, ensonga ekomesa nesokere ase endorwe yaye, erio ekeondogo ki’amakweri nakemosoe.
english: He pulls it out of his back, the gleaming point out of his liver. Terrors will come over him;

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaita maiso marore, ase engencho y’ebibe biabo,
english: He punishes them for their wickedness where everyone can see them,

ekegusii: Nigo akobabwatia, oeta na orendire buya, ase chinchera atana goeta rinde.
english: He pursues them and moves on unscathed, by a path his feet have not traveled before.

ekegusii: Akanyorokereria gotera ogotera okoyia, ogotera gw’okomotogia Nyasae oito. Abange nabayarore na koiroka, na igo mbamosemerie Omonene.
english: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.

ekegusii: Akabeka ebinto ebio bionsi ase amaboko a Haroni, na ay’abamura baye, akabisungusia bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them before the LORD as a wave offering.

ekegusii: Daudi akabeka abarwani aande onsi ase egati y’Abaedomu, na Abaedomu bonsi bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, na Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana esegi.
english: He put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The LORD gave David victory everywhere he went.

ekegusii: Erio akabeka abarwani esegi ase egati y’Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Na Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana.
english: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought tribute. The LORD gave David victory everywhere he went.

ekegusii: Erio akabeka abarwani ase egati y’Abasiiria agwo Damesiki, na Abasiiria abwo bakaba abasomba ba Daudi bakaba bakomorentera ebango. Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase are kogenda korwana.
english: He put garrisons in the Aramean kingdom of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to him and brought tribute. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.

ekegusii: Daudi akabeka abarwani aande onsi ase egati y’Abaedomu, na barabwo bonsi bakaba abasomba ba Daudi, na Omonene akaa Daudi obobui aande onsi ase arenge kogenda korwana.
english: He put garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites became subject to David. The LORD gave David victory wherever he went.

ekegusii: Omonene akeboyia oboronge bokaba buna engobo y’ekioma ase egekuba kiaye, akabeka ogotooreka gokaba buna ekegogwa gi’ekioma ase omotwe oye, akeboyia egesiomba gekaba eanga yaye, naende akeboyia ekeririanda gekaba ekiambaro kiaye.
english: He put on righteousness as his breastplate, and the helmet of salvation on his head; he put on the garments of vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal as in a cloak.

ekegusii: Akabeka chinguba na amatimo ase emechie eyio yonsi, na akayekora ekaba emekong’u mono. Ase enchera eyio akagenderera kogambera Abayuda na Ababenjamin.
english: He put shields and spears in all the cities, and made them very strong. So Judah and Benjamin were his.

ekegusii: Akabeka abakungu baria abasomba amo nabana babo batang’ane, na Lea amo nabana baye korwa nyuma yabo, na Raeli na Yusufu akababeka nyuma kegima.
english: He put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph in the rear.

ekegusii: Abanto bande abatigari akababeka inse y’oboteneneri bw’Abisai, momura omwabo, akabaroberia barwane n’Abaamoni.
english: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother and deployed them against the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Abanto bande abatigari akababeka inse y’oboteneneri bw’Abisai momura omwabo, akaroberia barwane n’Abaamoni.
english: He put the rest of the men under the command of Abishai his brother, and they were deployed against the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Akabekera Haroni eganchwa erobekanire eigete inse, na eganchwa eria ende, akamoboeria norokini. Naende akamobekera egesibao ki’obokuani, akamoboeria norokini rw’egesibao roroisirie nomonto omong’aini.
english: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe and put the ephod on him. He also tied the ephod to him by its skillfully woven waistband; so it was fastened on him.

ekegusii: Akabeka ching’iti echio ase amaboko ’abasomba baye, kera riicho akaribeka ao, agatebia abasomba baye, “Eta motang’ane, na egati ya kera riicho motige ribaga.”
english: He put them in the care of his servants, each herd by itself, and said to his servants, "Go ahead of me, and keep some space between the herds."

ekegusii: akabatweria endagera ekorokwa mana, bakaba bakoyeria; ee, akabaa endagera korwa igoro.
english: he rained down manna for the people to eat, he gave them the grain of heaven.

ekegusii: Erio akabarentera chinyama chinyinge buna orotu, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka chinyinge buna omokenye ore ase enyancha;
english: He rained meat down on them like dust, flying birds like sand on the seashore.

ekegusii: Nigo akoimokia omotaka korwa ase obotaka obwere, na koimokia omoremerwa korwa ase ribu,
english: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap;

ekegusii: Nigo akoimokia omotaka korwa ase obotaka obweere, na omoremerwa korwa ase ribu, obabeka baikaransa amo nabwo bare nokobua, na kobaa omwando bw’ebirogo bi’obonene. Oboroso bw’ense nobw’Omonene, na igoro y’oboroso obwo oterekereire enseo.
english: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap; he seats them with princes and has them inherit a throne of honor. "For the foundations of the earth are the LORD's; upon them he has set the world.

ekegusii: Nigo ekona‐kogenda aaria na aaria ase ebitunwa ekorisia, yaba ekorigia kera ekemeri ekebese.
english: He ranges the hills for his pasture and searches for any green thing.

ekegusii: He ranks first among the works of God, yet his Maker can approach him with his sword.
english: “Ero negetongwa ki’ogokumia inche Nyasae natongete; inche nayetongete, nayeete amaino anga buna emioro.

ekegusii: Ere nantoorie, andende buya korwa ase esegi eyio nkorwana, ekiagera ababisa abange banyimokeire.
english: He ransoms me unharmed from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.

ekegusii: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa igoro, akambwata, akandusia ase amache amange.
english: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.

ekegusii: Agatenena bosio bw’Egeita ki’Amache, origereretie eraaro eria, na korwa mambia chuni goika mobaso gati akaba ogosomera abasacha na abakungu, na abwo bonsi barenge konyara komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio. Abanto bonsi bagategerera koigwa ayarenge ase Ebuku eyio y’Amachiko.
english: He read it aloud from daybreak till noon as he faced the square before the Water Gate in the presence of the men, women and others who could understand. And all the people listened attentively to the Book of the Law.

ekegusii: Akaagacha naende aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, aria Hezekia ise atagorete. Naende agatenenia ebisasimero bia Baali, akaroisia emete y’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, na agasasima erioba na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni chionsi, ebitongwa biria bia igoro, na akabikorera.
english: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had demolished; he also erected altars to the Baals and made Asherah poles. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.

ekegusii: Akaagacha naende aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, aria Hezekia ise asaretie. Naende agatenenia ebisasimero bia Baali, na akaroisia omote bw’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, buna Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akorete. Agasasima erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, ebitongwa bia igoro, akabikorera.
english: He rebuilt the high places his father Hezekiah had destroyed; he also erected altars to Baal and made an Asherah pole, as Ahab king of Israel had done. He bowed down to all the starry hosts and worshiped them.

ekegusii: Boigo naende akaagacha Beti‐Horoni ya rogoro, na Beti‐Horoni ya maate, akayegitera chindwaki na koyeroiseria ebiita amo nemekorogoto,
english: He rebuilt Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon as fortified cities, with walls and with gates and bars,

ekegusii: Nigo atogonyerete Enyancha eria Embariri egakamoka, erio agaetia Abaisraeli aroro buna nase ense enyomo.
english: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led them through the depths as through a desert.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agotogonyera enyancha, amache asira, nigo agosiria amache e chindooche chionsi. Ense ya Basani nigo egosusana, na egetunwa gia Karimeli boigo; oboseera bwa Lebanoni nigo bokogoyana.
english: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither and the blossoms of Lebanon fade.

ekegusii: Yakobo akayemanya, akabora, “Neanga y’omwana one, amaene neching’iti chi’orosana chiamoitire; Yusufu orirwe.”
english: He recognized it and said, "It is my son's robe! Some ferocious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces."

ekegusii: Erio akairania enibo yonsi, na akairania boigo Loti omwabo amo nenibo yaye, na abakungu, na abanto bande abasakoretwe.
english: He recovered all the goods and brought back his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the other people.

ekegusii: Ere obooririe omoyo one togenda ase oboina, bono obogima bwane mborore oborabu.
english: He redeemed my soul from going down to the pit, and I will live to enjoy the light.'

ekegusii: Igo ogosesenigwa okwo Ibrahimu anyorete goikera abanto b’Ebisaku goetera ase Kristo Yeso, erinde tonyare konyora Omoika ase enchera y’okwegena, buna twarieretwe eira.
english: He redeemed us in order that the blessing given to Abraham might come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, so that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit.

ekegusii: Ere akaanga, akabora, “Tinganeti koria,” korende abasomba baye amo nomokungu oria bakamosorora goika akaigwera amang’ana abo. Erio akaimoka korwa inse agwo, agaikaransa borere.
english: He refused and said, "I will not eat." But his men joined the woman in urging him, and he listened to them. He got up from the ground and sat on the couch.

ekegusii: Ere nigo abarete ogochaywa ase engencho ya Kristo ng’a nobonda kobua chinibo chia Misiri, ekiagera arigereretie eng’eria ere bosio.
english: He regarded disgrace for the sake of Christ as of greater value than the treasures of Egypt, because he was looking ahead to his reward.

ekegusii: Yeroboamu akaba okogamba ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, na ebere. Erio akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, na Nadabu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: He reigned for twenty-two years and then rested with his fathers. And Nadab his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Agasibora ere oyobegetwe echela ase eriomana na oboiti, oyobarigetie; akarua Yeso asebare buna ogwancha kwabo kwarenge.
english: He released the man who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, the one they asked for, and surrendered Jesus to their will.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoashi akaba okomenya amo na Yehoseba ase enyomba y’Omonene, ase abisetwe ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo, ekero Atalia agendererete kogambera ense eria.
english: He remained hidden with his nurse at the temple of the LORD for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.

ekegusii: Yoashi akaba amo nabarabwo ase emiaka etano nomo, abisire ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ekero Atalia arenge kogamba igoro ase ense eria.
english: He remained hidden with them at the temple of God for six years while Athaliah ruled the land.

ekegusii: Nigo ainyorete ng’a barabwo mwanyabanto bagosira, nigo banga buna embeo egoeta na tekoirana.
english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

ekegusii: Inyora botambe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, goika ebiaare elifu mobe mokoinyora ring’ana achigete,
english: He remembers his covenant forever, the word he commanded, for a thousand generations,

ekegusii: Botambe nigo akoinyora okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, boigo goika ebiare elifu eyemo nigo akoinyora ring’ana achigete,
english: He remembers his covenant forever, the word he commanded, for a thousand generations,

ekegusii: Naende akarusia chibarasi chiria abaruoti b’Abayuda babegete ase egesoero ki’enyomba y’Omonene, echio baruete ase ogosasima erioba. Nigo chiarenge ang’e nakanyomba ka Nathani‐Meleki, omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, ime ase enyomba gete ensemo ya bosongo; agasamba chigari chiria chiatananetwe ase erioba.
english: He removed from the entrance to the temple of the LORD the horses that the kings of Judah had dedicated to the sun. They were in the court near the room of an official named Nathan-Melech. Josiah then burned the chariots dedicated to the sun.

ekegusii: Akarusia ebisasimero ebigeni na agasaria aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, agatagora chisiiro, akanacha emete y’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu.
english: He removed the foreign altars and the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles.

ekegusii: Akarusia korwa ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na ebisasimero bi’ogosamba ubani. Na oboruoti boria bokaba bore nobotoereru inse yaye.
english: He removed the high places and incense altars in every town in Judah, and the kingdom was at peace under him.

ekegusii: Agasaria aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, na agatagora chisiiro chigosasimerwa amo nomote bw’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu. Akabutorana ebing’ese eng’iti y’etaai eria Musa aroisetie, ekiagera goika ase amatuko aria Abaisraeli igo bagendererete koyesambera ubani; bakayeroka Nehusitani.
english: He removed the high places, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. He broke into pieces the bronze snake Moses had made, for up to that time the Israelites had been burning incense to it. (It was called Nehushtan.)

ekegusii: Ere nigo agoakana omonto koreng’ana buna emeremo yaye ere; nabo akoa omonto eng’eria buna orogendo rwaye rore.
english: He repays a man for what he has done; he brings upon him what his conduct deserves.

ekegusii: Korende akairaneria oria omotebetie, akabora, “Baba nere ng’o? Na bamura baminto mbarabi?”
english: He replied to him, "Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?"

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akamoiraneria, “Chimanwa echi chisigiti isano na ibere nigo nagochieire korwa ase okoboko kwane, erinde chibe kirori asende, ng’a ensoko eye ninche nayeremete.”
english: He replied, "Accept these seven lambs from my hand as a witness that I dug this well."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Rora, ekero mwasoire omochie, namoumerane nomosacha obogoretie enyongo ere namache; momotunyane goika enyomba agosoa,
english: He replied, "As you enter the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him to the house that he enters,

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Nase engencho y’okwegena kwaino kore ogoke. Ekeene nabatebirie: Moise koba nokwegena koreng’aine buna entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi, namotebie egetunwa eke: Karue agwo, ogende aaria, na kerokio nakeruo, tirikoba ring’ana ritanyarekane asemore. [
english: He replied, "Because you have so little faith. I tell you the truth, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there' and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you."

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabora, “Mbuya kobua, basesenirie abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na koribwata!”
english: He replied, "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it."

ekegusii: Akairaneria, akamboria, “Inee! Tomanyeti engencho y’ebinto ebi?” Nkamokania, “Yaya, omonene one, timanyeti.”
english: He replied, "Do you not know what these are?" "No, my lord," I said.

ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Kera ekemeri getasimekiri na Tata one ore igoro ngesimorwe.
english: He replied, "Every plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by the roots.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Genda ase omochie ase omonto gete, momotebie: Omworokia otebire: Engaki yane yaikire ang’e; nyomba mwao nao ndariere Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane.”
english: He replied, "Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, 'The Teacher says: My appointed time is near. I am going to celebrate the Passover with my disciples at your house.'"

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Genda motebie ekebwe ekio: Rora ngoseria nde ebirecha, ngokora nde emeremo y’okogwenia abanto rero na ankio, ne rituko ria gatato ninkoore emeremo yane.
english: He replied, "Go tell that fox, 'I will drive out demons and heal people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach my goal.'

ekegusii: He replied, "Go your way, Daniel, because the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end.
english: Akairaneria agantebia, “Aye Danieli, karue aa ogende, ekiagera amang’ana aya amumekerigwe na kobekwa ekemanyererio goika engaki y’omoerio.

ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nabeire ne risemi asore aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ekiagera Abaisraeli batigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania, batagoire ebisasimero biao, naende baitire ababani bao nemioro. Inche bweka natigaire; na bono nigo bakorigia basirie obogima bwane.”
english: He replied, "I have been very zealous for the LORD God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, broken down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too."

ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Nabeire ne risemi asore aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, ekiagera Abaisraeli batigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania, batagoire ebisasimero biao, na baitire ababani bao nomoro, na inche bweka natigaire, nabarabwo igo bakorigia obogima bwane babosirie.”
english: He replied, "I have been very zealous for the LORD God Almighty. The Israelites have rejected your covenant, broken down your altars, and put your prophets to death with the sword. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me too."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Naroche Saitani okogwa korwa igoro buna okomesa.
english: He replied, "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.

ekegusii: He replied, "I will also ask you a question. Tell me,
english: Akabatebia, “Nainche nkobaboria nde inwe ring’ana erimo, montebie:

ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Onye mwarenge nokwegena koreng’aine buna entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi, anga mwatebia omokenene oyo: Simoka, bwesimeke nyancha, noro anga nobaigwera.
english: He replied, "If you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, 'Be uprooted and planted in the sea,' and it will obey you.

ekegusii: Akamoiraneria, “Nabaminto nkorigia; koranche ontebie aase bakorisia amaicho.”
english: He replied, "I'm looking for my brothers. Can you tell me where they are grazing their flocks?"

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia “Isaya nigo abanete buya igoro yaino, inwe abang’ainereria, buna erikire; “Abanto aba nigo bansigete ase ebikoba biabo igoro, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa asende.
english: He replied, "Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you hypocrites; as it is written: "'These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.

ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Tari buya kobogoria obokima bw’abana na koborutera chisese.”
english: He replied, "It is not right to take the children's bread and toss it to their dogs."

ekegusii: Korende akabatebia, “Baba na bamura baminto nabwo aba abakoigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae na korikora.”
english: He replied, "My mother and brothers are those who hear God's word and put it into practice."

ekegusii: Samison akabatebia, “Korwa ase eyekoria, endagera y’okoria ekarwao, na korwa ase eyere ne chinguru, egento egiansu gekarwao.” Na ase amatuko atato tibanyara komotebia engencho y’omobayeno oria.
english: He replied, "Out of the eater, something to eat; out of the strong, something sweet." For three days they could not give the answer.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oboruoti bwa igoro, korende barabwo tibaeiri.
english: He replied, "The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.

ekegusii: Ere akairaneria, “Omonto okorokwa Yeso okorete etintira, akang’aka amaiso aane, agantebia: Genda ase ritibo ria Siloamu, bwesibie; nabo nkagenda ngesibia, nkanyara korora.”
english: He replied, "The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ekerecha kenga buna eke tigekonyara korwa ase ring’ana rinde rionsi, otatiga ase ogosaba na okweng’ata.”
english: He replied, "This kind can come out only by prayer."

ekegusii: Akairaneria, agantebia, “Nigo bagokeira ase ense ya Sinari, na aroro agwo baagachere omokungu oria enyomba, erinde ekoera bamobekeo, abeere aase aye.”
english: He replied, "To the country of Babylonia to build a house for it. When it is ready, the basket will be set there in its place."

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Rikoba mogoroba, mwabora: Rero nerakeere, ekiagera igoro abariirire.
english: He replied, "When evening comes, you say, 'It will be fair weather, for the sky is red,'

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akairaneria, “Onye ere nomonyene ebibe, timanyeti; ring’ana erimo namanyire, inche nigo narenge omouko, korende bono nkorora nde.”
english: He replied, "Whether he is a sinner or not, I don't know. One thing I do know. I was blind but now I see!"

ekegusii: Omomalaika oria akamoboria, “Nase ki otagete komanya erieta riane? Erieta riane neri’ogokumia.”
english: He replied, "Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding."

ekegusii: Korende Ayubu akairaneria mokaye, akamotebia, “Aye nigo ogokwana buna omokungu omoriri agokwana. Onye tokonyora amaya korwa ase Nyasae, Inee, titokonyora amabe naro korwa asare?” Ase amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe ase ogokwana kwaye.
english: He replied, "You are talking like a foolish woman. Shall we accept good from God, and not trouble?" In all this, Job did not sin in what he said.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inwe bae endagera!” Bakabora, “Titobwati kende kobua emegati etano ne chinswe ibere. Gose togende kogorera abanto aba bonsi endagera?”
english: He replied, "You give them something to eat." They answered, "We have only five loaves of bread and two fish-- unless we go and buy food for all this crowd."

ekegusii: He replied, "You of little faith, why are you so afraid?" Then he got up and rebuked the winds and the waves, and it was completely calm.
english: Akabatebia, “Naki mokwoboa, inwe abamore nokwegena ogoke?” Erio akaimoka, agatogonyera omwaga na enyancha; gokaba ogotoerera okonene.

ekegusii: Mika akabairaneria, “Mwairire ebinyasae biane neroiseretie, na omokuani one mwamoirire. Ngento ki natigaire nakio? Naki rende moranyare komboria: Ninki gekogochanda?”
english: He replied, "You took the gods I made, and my priest, and went away. What else do I have? How can you ask, 'What's the matter with you?'"

ekegusii: Akabora, “Mwerende, timong’ainwa, ekiagera abange nabache ase erieta riane babore: Ninche ere! Nengaki yaikire! Nabo, timobabwatia abwo.
english: He replied: "Watch out that you are not deceived. For many will come in my name, claiming, 'I am he,' and, 'The time is near.' Do not follow them.

ekegusii: Agantooria korwa ase ababisa baane bare ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo barenge ne chinguru kombua.
english: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

ekegusii: Agantooria korwa ase omobisa one ore ne chinguru, na korwa ase abwo bangechete; barabwo nigo barenge ne chinguru kombua.
english: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agokonya na gotooria, nigo agokora ebikone na amakumia igoro na ase ense; ere otooririe Danieli korwa ase chinguru chie chindo.”
english: He rescues and he saves; he performs signs and wonders in the heavens and on the earth. He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions."

ekegusii: Akairania omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa ase emeremo yaye y’obonyoisia, na ere akaba okomoa Farao egekombe ase okoboko kwaye;
english: He restored the chief cupbearer to his position, so that he once again put the cup into Pharaoh's hand,

ekegusii: Ere nigo agokora omoyo one koba omoyia na kondaa ase chinchera chiaye chia boronge, ase engencho y’erieta riaye.
english: he restores my soul. He guides me in paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

ekegusii: nyuma yaye omonto oyio nabo aranyare koboorigwa. Omonto omwabo nabo aramoboorie,
english: he retains the right of redemption after he has sold himself. One of his relatives may redeem him:

ekegusii: Nigo akoorokia ay’obobisi bwa ime, nigo amanyete ayare ime ase omosunte; na omobaso nigo ore amo nere.
english: He reveals deep and hidden things; he knows what lies in darkness, and light dwells with him.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akoorokia obobisi ase omosunte, erio okora obobisi boria bore ase omosunte bwaba oborabu.
english: He reveals the deep things of darkness and brings deep shadows into the light.

ekegusii: Agasiria korwa ase ense eria abasacha baria abanyaka barenge korigania ase obosooku, baria batigarete ase amatuko ’Asa.
english: He rid the land of the rest of the male shrine prostitutes who remained there even after the reign of his father Asa.

ekegusii: Akagambera abaruoti bonsi babegetwe kogamba korwa orooche rw’Eufarati goika ase ense y’Abafilisti, na goika orobebe rw’Abamisiri.
english: He ruled over all the kings from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the border of Egypt.

ekegusii: He ruled over Israel forty years-- seven in Hebron and thirty-three in Jerusalem.
english: Akagambera Abaisraeli emiaka emerongo ene, emiaka etano na ebere agwo Heburoni, na emiaka emerongo etato na etato agwo Yerusalemu.

ekegusii: akaba okogamba ase egetunwa kia Herimoni, na ase Saleka, na ase Basani engima goika orobebe rw’Abagesuri na Abamaaka, amo nekeng’ese kende kia Gileadi goika orogongo rwa Sihoni, omoruoti o Hesiboni.
english: He ruled over Mount Hermon, Salecah, all of Bashan to the border of the people of Geshur and Maacah, and half of Gilead to the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.

ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba ase okobua kwaye kare na kare; amaiso aye nigo arigereretie ebisaku bionsi, ase igo abasaria tibabaisa kweimokereria igoro.
english: He rules forever by his power, his eyes watch the nations-- let not the rebellious rise up against him. Selah

ekegusii: Agasamba omwana oye omomura akamokora ekeng’wanso; akaba ogokora oborogi na oboragori, na akaboria ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, na akenaria oborogi bonde. Agakora amabe amange ase obosio bw’Omonene, akamogechia goika akaba nendamwamu.
english: He sacrificed his own son in the fire, practiced sorcery and divination, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the LORD, provoking him to anger.

ekegusii: Agakora amabe amange ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Omonene akagechigwa goika akaba nendamwamu. Agasamba abana baye abamura bakaba ebing’wanso agwo ase Rikura ria basinto ba Hinomu, agakora oborogi, na oboragori, na oboriori, na akarigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakwete, na akenaria oborogi bonde obonge.
english: He sacrificed his sons in the fire in the Valley of Ben Hinnom, practiced sorcery, divination and witchcraft, and consulted mediums and spiritists. He did much evil in the eyes of the LORD, provoking him to anger.

ekegusii: Ere agateba neriogi rinene, “Moiroke Nyasae na komotogia, ekiagera ensa yaye y’okogambia yaikire, mosasime ere oyotongete igoro na ense, na enyancha, ne chinsoko chi’amache.”
english: He said in a loud voice, "Fear God and give him glory, because the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heavens, the earth, the sea and the springs of water."

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakwanete igoro y’abaise na abang’ina, ng’a tibabaroche, bagatigana nabamwabo, gose tibabarete abana babo ng’a mbare nengencho asebare, ekiagera baigwete ring’ana riao, bakabwata okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwakorete nabarabwo.
english: He said of his father and mother, 'I have no regard for them.' He did not recognize his brothers or acknowledge his own children, but he watched over your word and guarded your covenant.

ekegusii: Nigo abatebetie ayio ekiagera batebete, “Nabwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.”
english: He said this because they were saying, "He has an evil spirit."

ekegusii: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.
english: Agakwana aya, erinde aorokie imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nigo ayakwanete ase esinagogi, kaare kworokereria aria Kapernaumu.
english: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.

ekegusii: Naende agatebia Haroni, “Chora eeri ensae na emingichi, chionsi ibere chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, ochirue ase Omonene. Eeri eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi ebe eki’ogosambwa.
english: He said to Aaron, "Take a bull calf for your sin offering and a ram for your burnt offering, both without defect, and present them before the LORD.

ekegusii: Agwo Musa akaboria Haroni, “Naki abanto aba bagokorete goika okagera bagakora ebibe ebinene buna ebi?”
english: He said to Aaron, "What did these people do to you, that you led them into such great sin?"

ekegusii: Agatebia oyonde, “Ntunyana!” Ere akabora, “Omonene, ritang’ani ing’a ribaga ngende gotindeka tata.”
english: He said to another man, "Follow me." But the man replied, "Lord, first let me go and bury my father."

ekegusii: Erio agatebia Daudi, “Inee! Nesese inde? Ogonchichera nenyimbo?” Agatiana ase chinyasae chiaye, akaragereria Daudi.
english: He said to David, "Am I a dog, that you come at me with sticks?" And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.

ekegusii: agatebia Hasaeli, “Imokia ekeegwa, ogende orotote omonto oria o Nyasae, oborie Omonene goetera asare, omanye gose ningwene korwa ase oborwaire obo.”
english: he said to Hazael, "Take a gift with you and go to meet the man of God. Consult the LORD through him; ask him, 'Will I recover from this illness?'"

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie, genda nomorembe, ogwene korwa ase oborwaire bwao.”
english: He said to her, "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering."

ekegusii: Omonto oria akamotebia, “Imoka, tochake orogendo!” Korende omokungu oria tamoiraneria. Erio akamoimokia, akamobeka ase etigere igoro, agachaka orogendo rwaye gochia inka bwoye.
english: He said to her, "Get up; let's go." But there was no answer. Then the man put her on his donkey and set out for home.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Inche ninche Omonene. Otebie Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, amang’ana onsi nkogotebia.”
english: he said to him, "I am the LORD. Tell Pharaoh king of Egypt everything I tell you."

ekegusii: Ere akamotebia, “Rora, nagwancheire ase ring’ana erio boigo. Tingosaria omochie oyio gwateba.
english: He said to him, "Very well, I will grant this request too; I will not overthrow the town you speak of.

ekegusii: He said to his disciples, "Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?"
english: Akabatebia, “Naki mokwoboa inwe? Timori nokwegena?”

ekegusii: Agatebia abanto baye, “Tiga Omonene antange, timbaisa gokora obobe obwo ase omonene one, ekiagera ere nigo are omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.”
english: He said to his men, "The LORD forbid that I should do such a thing to my master, the LORD's anointed, or lift my hand against him; for he is the anointed of the LORD."

ekegusii: Yakobo agatebia abamwabo, “Sangereria amagena”, na barabwo bakayasangereria, bakayakora etui, bakariera endagera ase etui eyio.
english: He said to his relatives, "Gather some stones." So they took stones and piled them in a heap, and they ate there by the heap.

ekegusii: agatebia Gehasi, omosomba oye, “Rangeria omokungu oria Omosunemu.” Ekero amorangeretie, omokungu oria agacha, agatenena ase obosio bw’Elisha.
english: He said to his servant Gehazi, "Call the Shunammite." So he called her, and she stood before him.

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu agatebia abamura abarenge komo, “Ikaransa inwe aiga amo netigere! Inche amo nomwana oyo one nkogenda tore gochia aria, tosasime, erio toirane asemore naende.”
english: He said to his servants, "Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you."

ekegusii: Na Esau agasaba Yakobo, “Koranche, ong’e endagera eyio embariri indie, ekiagera nanyarekire.” Ase ayio bakamoroka Edomu (engencho yaye, omobariri).
english: He said to Jacob, "Quick, let me have some of that red stew! I'm famished!" (That is why he was also called Edom.)

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akamboria, “Aye mwanyabanto, kwarorire amang’ana aya? Norore okogechia okonene kobuete oko.”
english: He said to me, "Do you see this, son of man? You will see things that are even more detestable than this."

ekegusii: Erio akamboria, “Aye mwanyabanto, kwarorire amang’ana aya? Inee! Aya namang’ana amagusu mono ase Abayuda ng’a bakore ebibe bi’okogechia, ebio bagokorera aase aiga? Nigo bagochia goichoria ense yonsi nobobe na bangechie imbe nendamwamu naende naende? Rora buna babekire orosagia rw’omosabibu ase chimioro chiabo.
english: He said to me, "Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a trivial matter for the house of Judah to do the detestable things they are doing here? Must they also fill the land with violence and continually provoke me to anger? Look at them putting the branch to their nose!

ekegusii: Omochenu oria bwe ritang’ani akang’iraneria, “Nase engaki ye chimogoroba ne chimambia chilifu ibere, na amagana atato (2,300); nyuma y’ayio Obomenyo Obochenu mbochenwe.”
english: He said to me, "It will take 2,300 evenings and mornings; then the sanctuary will be reconsecrated."

ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Aye mwanyabanto, kwarorire egento abagaaka b’Abaisraeli bagokora ase omosunte, kera oyomo ase akanunchi kaye k’emegwekano y’ogosasimwa? Barabwo nigo bagoteba: Omonene tatorochi. Ere otigire ense eye.”
english: He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the darkness, each at the shrine of his own idol? They say, 'The LORD does not see us; the LORD has forsaken the land.'"

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, bochora enyasi eyio.” Ekero nabochorete gochia ime, nkarora egesieri.
english: He said to me, "Son of man, now dig into the wall." So I dug into the wall and saw a doorway there.

ekegusii: Ere agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, tenena namagoro ao, inche nkwane naye.”
english: He said to me, "Son of man, stand up on your feet and I will speak to you."

ekegusii: Omonto oria agantebia, “Akanyomba aka karochie irianyi nak’abakuani bagokora emeremo ase Hekalu,
english: He said to me, "The room facing south is for the priests who have charge of the temple,

ekegusii: Omonto oria agantebia: “Aya namariko ase abwo bagokora emeremo ye Hekalu bakoiyekera ebing’wanso abanto bakorua.”
english: He said to me, "These are the kitchens where those who minister at the temple will cook the sacrifices of the people."

ekegusii: Naende agantebia, “Aase aiga nao abakuani baraiyekere ebing’wanso bi’okomocha, na ebi’ebibe, naende nao bararugere okoruegwa kw’endagera, erinde tibabaisa korenta ebinto ebio ase eraaro ya isiko, babaise gocha gochena abanto.”
english: He said to me, "This is the place where the priests will cook the guilt offering and the sin offering and bake the grain offering, to avoid bringing them into the outer court and consecrating the people."

ekegusii: Omonto oria agantebia, “Amache aya nigo akogenda ase ensemo ya moocha gochia riranya ria Yorodan, na ekero arasoe ase enyancha ere namache are nomonyo nansie amache ayio abe amaya.
english: He said to me, "This water flows toward the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah, where it enters the Sea. When it empties into the Sea, the water there becomes fresh.

ekegusii: Erio agantebia: “Aye nomosomba one Israeli, ase engencho yao nintogigwe.”
english: He said to me, "You are my servant, Israel, in whom I will display my splendor."

ekegusii: Naende agantebia, “Aikire gokoreka. Inche n’Alifa na Omega, Omochakano na Omoerio. Oyore nerang’o nimoe bosa anywe korwa ase ensoko y’amache ’obogima.
english: He said to me: "It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To him who is thirsty I will give to drink without cost from the spring of the water of life.

ekegusii: “Omonene agakwana agantebia: Sulemani, omomura oo, nere oraagache enyomba yaane ne chiraaro chiane, ekiagera namochorire abe omwana one, na inche nimbe ise.
english: He said to me: 'Solomon your son is the one who will build my house and my courts, for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

ekegusii: Erio agatebia Nathani, omobani, “Rora, inche nigo imenyete ase enyomba eagachire nemecharake korende Esanduku ya Nyasae ero nigo emenyete ime ase eema.”
english: he said to Nathan the prophet, "Here I am, living in a palace of cedar, while the ark of God remains in a tent."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaboria Saulo, “Nase ki okoigwera amang’ana abanto bagoteba ng’a inche Daudi ngokorigia inde ngokore bobe?
english: He said to Saul, "Why do you listen when men say, 'David is bent on harming you'?

ekegusii: He said to Seraiah, "When you get to Babylon, see that you read all these words aloud.
english: Yeremia agatebia Seraya, “Ekero oraike Babeli, orore ng’a gwasomire amang’ana aya onsi.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akarangeria omosomba oye oyorenge konya omokoreire ase emiaka emenge mono, na orendete enibo yaye yonsi, akamotebia, “Beka okoboko kwao inse y’ekebono kiane,
english: He said to the chief servant in his household, the one in charge of all that he had, "Put your hand under my thigh.

ekegusii: Naende agatebia emeganda, “Ekero mokorora riire rikoimoka bosongo, erio mwateba bwango: Embura netwe; yaba bo.
english: He said to the crowd: "When you see a cloud rising in the west, immediately you say, 'It's going to rain,' and it does.

ekegusii: Agatebia abagaaka baria, “Motoganye aiga goika ekero torairane asemore. Rora Haroni na Huri nao bare aiga amo nainwe; onye omonto ore nobokong’u bonde, agende ababorie.”
english: He said to the elders, "Wait here for us until we come back to you. Aaron and Hur are with you, and anyone involved in a dispute can go to them."

ekegusii: Agatebia Abaisraeli, “Ase engaki egochi‐gocha abana be chinderia chiaino kobaraborie abaise engencho y’amagena aya,
english: He said to the Israelites, "In the future when your descendants ask their fathers, 'What do these stones mean?'

ekegusii: Omobani oria agatebia omoruoti, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ekiagera gwatigire omonto orure ase okoboko kwao, oria naruete ase ogosirigwa, bono obogima bwao nabobe ribaga ri’obwaye, na abanto bao nababe ribaga ri’abanto baye.”
english: He said to the king, "This is what the LORD says: 'You have set free a man I had determined should die. Therefore it is your life for his life, your people for his people.'"

ekegusii: Agatebereria Abalawi baria barenge aborokia b’Abaisraeli, naende baatananetwe ase Omonene, akabora, “Beka Esanduku eyio enchenu ase enyomba eyio Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, aagachete. Korwa bono timogwenereti koyebogoria igoro ase amareko aino. Bono mokorere Omonene, Nyasae oino, mobakorere na abanto baye Abaisraeli.
english: He said to the Levites, who instructed all Israel and who had been consecrated to the LORD: "Put the sacred ark in the temple that Solomon son of David king of Israel built. It is not to be carried about on your shoulders. Now serve the LORD your God and his people Israel.

ekegusii: Gidioni agatebia abanto ba Sukoti, “Komoranche moe abanto aba bagontunyana emegati. Barabwo bagoyire, nainche nkobwatia inde Seba na Salimuna, abaruoti b’Abamidiani, mbarwanie.”
english: He said to the men of Succoth, "Give my troops some bread; they are worn out, and I am still pursuing Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Korende bono oyore nekemoya akebogorie, na esaro boigo, na ere oyotari nomoyio o birende aoonie eganchwa yaye, agore oyomo.
english: He said to them, "But now if you have a purse, take it, and also a bag; and if you don't have a sword, sell your cloak and buy one.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Etaya nigo ekorentwa erinde yamumekwa negetonga gose yabekwa nyaro y’oborere? Teri kobekwa igoro ase ekebekerero?
english: He said to them, "Do you bring in a lamp to put it under a bowl or a bed? Instead, don't you put it on its stand?

ekegusii: Naende akababoria, “Inee! Momanyete Labani, mochokoro o Nahori?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Ee, ntomomanyete.”
english: He said to them, "Do you know Laban, Nahor's grandson?" "Yes, we know him," they answered.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Naki motaramanya?”
english: He said to them, "Do you still not understand?"

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Genda ase ense yonsi, morandie enchili ase kera egetongwa.
english: He said to them, "Go into all the world and preach the good news to all creation.

ekegusii: Akabitebia, “Genda!” Bigasoka, bigasoa ase chimbeche. Na rora, riicho rionsi rigatirimboka, rigasoa enyancha ime, rigasirera aroro.
english: He said to them, "Go!" So they came out and went into the pigs, and the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and died in the water.

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia, “Inwe abanto abariri, nabanyene chinkoro chinyoro ase okwegena onsi aya ababani batebete.
english: He said to them, "How foolish you are, and how slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken!

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Inki rende gekogera Daudi, akoraagwa n’Omoika, akamoroka Omonene, okobora:
english: He said to them, "How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls him 'Lord'? For he says,

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia, “Narotete chindoto, na ebirengererio biane nigo bichandegete, Ninganetie montebie chindoto chiria.”
english: he said to them, "I have had a dream that troubles me and I want to know what it means."

ekegusii: Agwo akabatebia, “Narorire ng’a iso tari kondigereria buya rero buna botambe. Korende Nyasae o tata obeire ore amo nainche.
english: He said to them, "I see that your father's attitude toward me is not what it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.

ekegusii: Nere akababoria, “Ning’o asemore ore neng’ondi eyemo, na eng’ondi eyio onye yagure ime ase engoro rituko ri’Esabato, takoyebwata ayerusieo?
english: He said to them, "If any of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will you not take hold of it and lift it out?

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Onye Abagadi na Abareuben, abwo bonsi babogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi, bakwamboka Yorodan amo nainwe korwana esegi ase obosio bw’Omonene, na inwe mobue ense eria, na koyeira, erio mobae ense ya Gileadi ebe eyabo.
english: He said to them, "If the Gadites and Reubenites, every man armed for battle, cross over the Jordan with you before the LORD, then when the land is subdued before you, give them the land of Gilead as their possession.

ekegusii: Ere agakwana nabarabwo, akabora, “Komoranche mong’e ribaga ntindeke omokungu one, imorusie ase obosio bwane, monyigwe na monsabere ase Efuroni, omwana o Sohari,
english: He said to them, "If you are willing to let me bury my dead, then listen to me and intercede with Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf

ekegusii: “Inee! Omonene, Nyasae oino, tari amo nainwe? Naende tabaete omorembe ase chinsemo chiaino chionsi? Ere obekire abanto abanyene ense eye ase okoboko kwane; na ense eye nkogambera yabekirwe inse y’Omonene na inse y’abanto baye.
english: He said to them, "Is not the LORD your God with you? And has he not granted you rest on every side? For he has handed the inhabitants of the land over to me, and the land is subject to the LORD and to his people.

ekegusii: He said to them, "Listen to this dream I had:
english: Akabatebia, “Montegerere, moigwe okorota oko narotete.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Renda na koigwera amang’ana onsi aya nabekire abe kirori asemore ase rituko ria rero, mochike abana baino babwate na gokora amang’ana onsi ay’amachiko ayio.
english: he said to them, "Take to heart all the words I have solemnly declared to you this day, so that you may command your children to obey carefully all the words of this law.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ase engencho eyio kera omworokia bw’amariko oyokorirwe koba omworokigwa bw’oboruoti bwa igoro, obeire omogwekano bw’omonyene enyomba, oyokorua ase emonga yaye ebinto ebiyia na ebikoro.”
english: He said to them, "Therefore every teacher of the law who has been instructed about the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Aya naro amang’ana aane nare kona‐kobatebia ekero narenge amo nainwe, buna onsi agwenerete goikeranigwa, ayarigetwe igoro yane ase amachiko a Musa, na ase ababani, na ase Zaburi.”
english: He said to them, "This is what I told you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets and the Psalms."

ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Ring’ana erio nario Omonene konya atebire: Ankio nerituko richenu ri’ogotimoka, Esabato Enchenu yaatananirwe ase Omonene. Mosambe eki moganetie gosamba, na moiyeke eki moganetie koiyeka, na ebiratigare mobigache goika ankio.”
english: He said to them, "This is what the LORD commanded: 'Tomorrow is to be a day of rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. So bake what you want to bake and boil what you want to boil. Save whatever is left and keep it until morning.'"

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyio ase mwantomete erinde ng’ire ogosaba kwaino ase obosio bwaye, agoteba:
english: He said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your petition, says:

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Komogosaba, teba iga:” “Tata [oito ore igoro], Erieta riao risikwe, Oboruoti bwao boche,
english: He said to them, "When you pray, say: "'Father, hallowed be your name, your kingdom come.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inaki mogoichana? Naende inaki ogosiereria kwaimokire ase chinkoro chiaino?
english: He said to them, "Why are you troubled, and why do doubts rise in your minds?

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Inwe nabateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi, echene inwe abanyene amo nabanto bamino, mochie kwoyia Esanduku eria y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, moyebeke aase agwo inche nayeroiseirie.
english: He said to them, "You are the heads of the Levitical families; you and your fellow Levites are to consecrate yourselves and bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inwe nabanto mogwetogia ng’a nigo more abanyene oboronge ase obosio bwa mwanyabanto, korende Nyasae omanyire chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ekeimokererete igoro ase mwanyabanto, Nyasae nigo akegechete.
english: He said to them, "You are the ones who justify yourselves in the eyes of men, but God knows your hearts. What is highly valued among men is detestable in God's sight.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Tari igoro yaino komanya ebiro gose chingaki. Tata obibekire ase okobua kwaye omonyene.
english: He said to them: "It is not for you to know the times or dates the Father has set by his own authority.

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia, “Imoka mogende nabasomba baane, moriinie Sulemani, omwana one, ase eyombo yane, erio momotirimbokie gochia Gihoni.
english: he said to them: "Take your lord's servants with you and set Solomon my son on my own mule and take him down to Gihon.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Mwamanyire ng’a tari boronge omonto Omoyahudi abwatane nomonto ore bw’egesaku ekeao, nonya nokomochiera, korende Nyasae onyorokirie ng’a timoroka onde bwensi ng’a tari omochenu, gose tachenegeti.
english: He said to them: "You are well aware that it is against our law for a Jew to associate with a Gentile or visit him. But God has shown me that I should not call any man impure or unclean.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Amina. Tiga Omonene akore ayio. Ee, tiga akore amang’ana ayio kwabanire aikerane, erio airanie korwa Babeli ebikorero bi’enyomba y’Omonene na abanto bairetwe obosomba.
english: He said, "Amen! May the LORD do so! May the LORD fulfill the words you have prophesied by bringing the articles of the LORD's house and all the exiles back to this place from Babylon.

ekegusii: Ahimasi akamoiraneria, “Ayio tari mang’ana, ing’a ribaga ngende.” Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Minyoka rende.” Erio Ahimasi akaminyoka agaetania Omoetiopia oria agwo ase ense omweya ya Yorodan.
english: He said, "Come what may, I want to run." So Joab said, "Run!" Then Ahimaaz ran by way of the plain and outran the Cushite.

ekegusii: agateba, “Kanani aragererigwe; nigo arabe omosomba bw’abasomba ase abamwabo.”
english: he said, "Cursed be Canaan! The lowest of slaves will he be to his brothers."

ekegusii: Omonto oria agantebia, “Aye Danieli, omonto bwanchire mono, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aya ngokwana naye, imoka otenene boronge, ekiagera bono natomirwe asore.” Ekero agendererete gokwana ring’ana erio nainche, ngatenena boronge nkoiguswa.
english: He said, "Daniel, you who are highly esteemed, consider carefully the words I am about to speak to you, and stand up, for I have now been sent to you." And when he said this to me, I stood up trembling.

ekegusii: agateba, “Ninyimokie okoboko kwane igoro, kobe ekemanyererio ki’Omonene, na gotiana ng’a Omonene nigo aragenderere korwania Abaameleki ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
english: He said, "For hands were lifted up to the throne of the LORD. The LORD will be at war against the Amalekites from generation to generation."

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Genda otebie abanto aba: Okoigwa, nkoigwa more, korende timori komanya gento, na okorora, nkorora more, korende timori korengereria.
english: He said, "Go and tell this people: "'Be ever hearing, but never understanding; be ever seeing, but never perceiving.'

ekegusii: he said, "Go away. The girl is not dead but asleep." But they laughed at him.
english: Akabatebia, “Karuo aa! Omoiseke oyo takweti, okorara araire gwoka.” Bakamosekerera.

ekegusii: “Ninche nyigwe amang’ana ao ekero abagosoeri bao barache.” Agachika arendwe ase enyomba y’ekegambero kia Herode.
english: he said, "I will hear your case when your accusers get here." Then he ordered that Paul be kept under guard in Herod's palace.

ekegusii: He said, "If anyone ties me securely with new ropes that have never been used, I'll become as weak as any other man."
english: Samison akamotebia, “Kobaransibe ne chingori chinyia chitarakorerwa emeremo, erio nimbe omworo, na imbe buna monto onde bwensi.”

ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene one, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, tong’etania inche, omosomba oo.
english: He said, "If I have found favor in your eyes, my lord, do not pass your servant by.

ekegusii: Nere akabatebia, “Onye igo bachire nomorembe, mobabwate, mobatige babe moyo; gose onye igo bachire korwana esegi, mobabwate, mobatige babe moyo.”
english: He said, "If they have come out for peace, take them alive; if they have come out for war, take them alive."

ekegusii: Akabora, “Oise koigwera aya inche Omonene Nyasae oo ngokwana, na koyakora ayare boronge ase amaiso aane, na gotegerera amachiko aane, na kobwata emeroberio yane yonsi, rirorio inche tingokobekera amarwaire ande onsi buna aria nabekerete Abamisiri; naki ninche Omonene oo, oyogokogwenia.”
english: He said, "If you listen carefully to the voice of the LORD your God and do what is right in his eyes, if you pay attention to his commands and keep all his decrees, I will not bring on you any of the diseases I brought on the Egyptians, for I am the LORD, who heals you."

ekegusii: agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Inee! Oyo tari Babeli omochie omonene, oyo inche naagachire ne chinguru chiane, na okobua kwane, obe obomenyo bw’omoruoti, erinde obe ogotogigwa kw’obonene bwane?”
english: he said, "Is not this the great Babylon I have built as the royal residence, by my mighty power and for the glory of my majesty?"

ekegusii: na Omonene akabatebia, “Igwa amang’ana aane: Onye omobani ore ase egati yaino, inche Omonene nigo nkwemanyekania asare ase okorora, naende nakwana nere ase chindoto.
english: he said, "Listen to my words: "When a prophet of the LORD is among you, I reveal myself to him in visions, I speak to him in dreams.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Na bono nindoche abanto bane basiboire, bagotaara ime ase omorero, na barabwo tibayieti aande nonya ng’ake; omonto oria o kane nigo akororekana buna omwana bw’enyasae.”
english: He said, "Look! I see four men walking around in the fire, unbound and unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of the gods."

ekegusii: Na igo akabora, “Tiga Nyasae ang’e egesusuro bono na kogenderera onye omotwe bw’Elisha, mosinto o Safati, ogotigara igoro ase amareko aye rituko ria rero ritaraera.”
english: He said, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if the head of Elisha son of Shaphat remains on his shoulders today!"

ekegusii: Mefiboseti akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, nomanyete ng’a nekerema inde. Nigo natebetie omosomba one, ng’a abekere etigere yane egeikaransero, nainche ndiine ngende nomoruoti, korende ere akang’aina.
english: He said, "My lord the king, since I your servant am lame, I said, 'I will have my donkey saddled and will ride on it, so I can go with the king.' But Ziba my servant betrayed me.

ekegusii: Ere agateba, “Aye omochie o Sidoni orenge buna omoiseke omwekungi, korende bono gwakoreirwe bobe, tokonyara koba nomogoko naende. Imoka ogende Kuporo, nonya naroro tokonyara gotimoka.”
english: He said, "No more of your reveling, O Virgin Daughter of Sidon, now crushed! "Up, cross over to Cyprus; even there you will find no rest."

ekegusii: akabora, “Omonene atogigwe, oyo obatooretie abanto baye korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri, na korwa ase Farao, obatooretie korwa ase obosomba obwo.
english: He said, "Praise be to the LORD, who rescued you from the hand of the Egyptians and of Pharaoh, and who rescued the people from the hand of the Egyptians.

ekegusii: agachika, agateba, “Turunkania amagena amanene, mosieke egesoero kie rikuruma, naende mobeke abanto barende aroro.
english: he said, "Roll large rocks up to the mouth of the cave, and post some men there to guard it.

ekegusii: Omonene agateba: “Ekeene, aba nabanto baane, abanto batakore amang’ana ’obong’ainereria,” akaba Omotooria obo.
english: He said, "Surely they are my people, sons who will not be false to me"; and so he became their Savior.

ekegusii: Agateba, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oboruoti bwa Nyasae; korende abande nabatebigwe ase emereng’anio, erinde okorora barore, korende tibarora, naende okoigwa baigwe, korende tibamanya.
english: He said, "The knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, "'though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.'

ekegusii: ogoteba, “Aya namanyinga ’okobwatana oko Nyasae abachikerete inwe.”
english: He said, "This is the blood of the covenant, which God has commanded you to keep."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Aya naro omoruoti oyio orabagambere arabakorere: Naire abana baino abamura, ababeke ase chigari chiaye, na abande ababeke babe abariini be chibarasi chiaye bamokorere. Abande babetererigwe baminyoke bosio bwe chigari chiaye.
english: He said, "This is what the king who will reign over you will do: He will take your sons and make them serve with his chariots and horses, and they will run in front of his chariots.

ekegusii: Omomalaika oria agateba, “Obo nabwo Obobe.” Erio akaigatera omokungu oria ime ase egetonga keria, agakong’ontera ekemumeko igoro ase omonwa bw’egetonga keria.
english: He said, "This is wickedness," and he pushed her back into the basket and pushed the lead cover down over its mouth.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ruta ekeonga ensemo ya borio y’obwato, na inwe namonyore chinswe.” Erio bagakeruta, korende tibanyara gokeng’usa ase engencho y’obonge bwe chinswe.
english: He said, "Throw your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some." When they did, they were unable to haul the net in because of the large number of fish.

ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Ngento ki origetie nkoe kebe intenenera?” Akamoiraneria, “Ebonyi yao ere nekemanyererio, na orokini rwao, na enyimbo yao obwate koboko.” Erio akamobia, akarara nere, na ere akaba morito.
english: He said, "What pledge should I give you?" "Your seal and its cord, and the staff in your hand," she answered. So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.

ekegusii: agateba: Abanto b’eamate yane ngochia bare korua ekeng’wanso agwo ase omochie, na momura ominto onchikire ng’a imbeo. Ase ayio, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa asore, ing’a ribaga ngende korora abaminto. Aya naro agera atachicha ase endagera yao, aye omoruoti.”
english: He said, 'Let me go, because our family is observing a sacrifice in the town and my brother has ordered me to be there. If I have found favor in your eyes, let me get away to see my brothers.' That is why he has not come to the king's table."

ekegusii: He said:
english: Ayubu agateba,

ekegusii: Nabo akabora, “Omonto oyomo omosike akagenda ense y’aare, erinde anyare kwenyorera oboruoti, naende airane.
english: He said: "A man of noble birth went to a distant country to have himself appointed king and then to return.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio agantebia, “Rora, ningotebie aya agochia koba ase omoerio bw’endamwamu y’Omonene, ekiagera okorora okwo nigo gokworokia igoro y’engaki y’omoerio.
english: He said: "I am going to tell you what will happen later in the time of wrath, because the vision concerns the appointed time of the end.

ekegusii: akabora, “Narenge omogambi ase omochie gete, otasigete Nyasae, gose taare koyiera monto.
english: He said: "In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor cared about men.

ekegusii: “Ekero narenge ase emechando, nigo nasabete Omonene, na ere akang’iraneria. Korwa ime ase enda y’aase abakure nigo narerete, aye Omonene okaigwa eriogi riane.
english: He said: "In my distress I called to the LORD, and he answered me. From the depths of the grave I called for help, and you listened to my cry.

ekegusii: Ere agakwana, “Igwa inwe Abayuda mwensi, na abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, na aye omoruoti Yehosafati. Aya naro Omonene akobatebia: Timoiroka gose gokwa emioyo ase engencho y’omoganda oyo omonene; esegi teri eyaino, korende neya Nyasae.
english: He said: "Listen, King Jehoshaphat and all who live in Judah and Jerusalem! This is what the LORD says to you: 'Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army. For the battle is not yours, but God's.

ekegusii: agakwana, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, enyasae ende teri ekogwekaine, igoro gose inse aa ase ense, aye bweka nigo okorenda okobwatana kw’ogotianania, naende nigo okoorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera ase abasomba bao, baria bare abegenwa asore ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi.
english: He said: "O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth-- you who keep your covenant of love with your servants who continue wholeheartedly in your way.

ekegusii: Ere agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, nkogotoma inde gochia ase Abaisraeli, egesaku ekio getari koigwera, ekio giantigire inche. Abanto abwo amo ne chisokoro chiabo babeire bagosaria asende nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: He said: "Son of man, I am sending you to the Israelites, to a rebellious nation that has rebelled against me; they and their fathers have been in revolt against me to this very day.

ekegusii: agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, aase aiga nao ekerogo kiane ki’obonene kere, naende nao amagoro aane agotacha. Aiga nimenye ase egati y’Abaisraeli kogenderera botambe. Na Abaisraeli gose abaruoti babo tibakogenderera gokora erieta riane richenu ribe eritachenegeti, goetera ase obonyaka bwabo bw’ogosasima emegwekano, na emebere ekwete y’abaruoti babo, na aase abo aimokererete igoro.
english: He said: "Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place for the soles of my feet. This is where I will live among the Israelites forever. The house of Israel will never again defile my holy name-- neither they nor their kings-- by their prostitution and the lifeless idols of their kings at their high places.

ekegusii: Akabora, “Abayahudi babwatanire kogosaba otirimbokie Paulo gochia bosio bw’ekegambero ankio, buna igo barigetie komanya chingencho chiaye buya kobua.
english: He said: "The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul before the Sanhedrin tomorrow on the pretext of wanting more accurate information about him.

ekegusii: Akabora: “Omonene agacha korwa Sinai, akabamorekera korwa Seiri, akabara buna risase korwa ase egetunwa gia Parani; agacha ore amo nabachenu chilifu ikomi, ogochika kore buna chinsase chi’omorero gokabachera korwa ase ensemo yaye y’okorio.
english: He said: "The LORD came from Sinai and dawned over them from Seir; he shone forth from Mount Paran. He came with myriads of holy ones from the south, from his mountain slopes.

ekegusii: Agateba: “Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi yane enkong’u; nere Omotooria one.
english: He said: "The LORD is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer;

ekegusii: Amosi agateba, “Omonene natogonye korwa Sayoni, aake eriogi riaye korwa Yerusalemu. Amarisio ’abarisia naichane, obonyansi bw’egetunwa gia Karimeli igoro mbwome.”
english: He said: "The LORD roars from Zion and thunders from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds dry up, and the top of Carmel withers."

ekegusii: Omoruoti agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye, ang’e nenyasi, buna botambe; na Yonathani agatenena bosio bwaye, na Abineri agaikaransa ensemo ya Saulo. Korende ekerogo gia Daudi kegatigara bosa.
english: He sat in his customary place by the wall, opposite Jonathan, and Abner sat next to Saul, but David's place was empty.

ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akabatooria korwa ase amaboko ay’ababagechete na kobabooria korwa ase chinguru chi’ababisa babo.
english: He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.

ekegusii: agatotooria, tari ase ogokora kw’oboronge twakorete intwe, korende ase amabera aye ase ogosibigwa goetera ase okoiborwa gwa kabere. Nabo agatokora abayia n’Omoika Omochenu,
english: he saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy. He saved us through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit,

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae nigo agotooria abataka korwa ase emenwa egoita, na abaremeire korwa ase abwo bare ne chinguru.
english: He saves the needy from the sword in their mouth; he saves them from the clutches of the powerful.

ekegusii: Akarora amaato abere ateneine engegu y’enyancha, na abarubi basokire korwa aroro, ngosibia bare ebionga biabo.
english: he saw at the water's edge two boats, left there by the fishermen, who were washing their nets.

ekegusii: akarora igoro amaanokire, na egento kegoika, kere buna egetambaa ekenene, kebwatire emekoba ene, kegoikigwa gocha inse.
english: He saw heaven opened and something like a large sheet being let down to earth by its four corners.

ekegusii: He saw one of them being mistreated by an Egyptian, so he went to his defense and avenged him by killing the Egyptian.
english: Akarora oyomo obo ogokorerwa bobe n’Omomisiri, akamokonya; agaakanera oria orenge gochandwa egesiomba, agaaka Omomisiri oria akamoita.

ekegusii: Omonene akarora ng’a monto onde tarenge aande, agakumia ng’a onde tarenge gwesoyia gokonya. Erio okoboko kwaye omonyene gokamorentera ogotooreka, na oboronge bwaye bokamokonya.
english: He saw that there was no one, he was appalled that there was no one to intervene; so his own arm worked salvation for him, and his own righteousness sustained him.

ekegusii: Akabarora bagwechanda bagoata amache nemegango, ekiagera omwaga nigo obatangete. Koreng’ana ekero ki’oborendi bwa kane bwa botuko agacha asebare, ogotaara igoro ase enyancha, akarigia kobaetania.
english: He saw the disciples straining at the oars, because the wind was against them. About the fourth watch of the night he went out to them, walking on the lake. He was about to pass by them,

ekegusii: Korende akamanya obong’ainereria bwabo, akabatebia,
english: He saw through their duplicity and said to them,

ekegusii: Igo akorengereria ase enkoro yaye ime, “Nyasae tagwechandera kende, obisire obosio bwaye ng’a tayarora nonya ng’ake.”
english: He says to himself, "God has forgotten; he covers his face and never sees."

ekegusii: Nigo akorengereria ase enkoro yaye ime: “Tinkwoboa gento kende, tinkonyorwa na bobe bonde nonya ng’ake.”
english: He says to himself, "Nothing will shake me; I'll always be happy and never have trouble."

ekegusii: Ere nigo agotebia amagena ’embura: Kagwe igoro ase ense; na otoma omonyirira na embura enene ere ne chinguru.
english: He says to the snow, 'Fall on the earth,' and to the rain shower, 'Be a mighty downpour.'

ekegusii: “Ninche narusetie chigurube korwa ase amareko aino, na ngasibora amaboko aino korwa ase ebitonga bi’okobogoria chigurube.
english: He says, "I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket.

ekegusii: akabora, “Nindarie erieta riao ase abaminto, ase egati y’omosangererekano ningotogie ase ogotera.”
english: He says, "I will declare your name to my brothers; in the presence of the congregation I will sing your praises."

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oyio ogokwana: “Ninyeagachere enyomba enene, enachanire chiero chinene ase rirongo riaye. Nigo akobochora chitirisa chingare ase enyomba eria, naende ochabera chinyasi nemecharake na oyeaka erangi embariri ye rigori rinene.
english: He says, 'I will build myself a great palace with spacious upper rooms.' So he makes large windows in it, panels it with cedar and decorates it in red.

ekegusii: Nigo agoteba iga: “Ayio tagoisana asore obe omosomba one ase okoiraneria ab’ebisaku bia Yakobo amaya abo, na koirania abatigari b’Abaisraeli boka. Boigo ningokore obe omobaso bw’abanto b’ebisaku; erinde ogotooreka kwane kogende goike ase chinsinyo chi’ense.”
english: he says: "It is too small a thing for you to be my servant to restore the tribes of Jacob and bring back those of Israel I have kept. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles, that you may bring my salvation to the ends of the earth."

ekegusii: Nigo akogita chindooche, oochania amache tagoeta, erio egento kebisekanete ime, okerenta aase aarabu.
english: He searches the sources of the rivers and brings hidden things to light.

ekegusii: obabeka baikaransa amo nabwo bare nokobua, baria bakogambera abanto baye.
english: he seats them with princes, with the princes of their people.

ekegusii: Ere akabwata enchoka, eng’iti eria ya kare, ero n’Omogenki na Saitani, akamosiba ase engaki y’emiaka elifu eyemo,
english: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent, who is the devil, or Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio takogenderera koinyora amatuko aetire ay’obogima bwaye, ekiagera Nyasae nigo akomoa omogoko ase enkoro yaye.
english: He seldom reflects on the days of his life, because God keeps him occupied with gladness of heart.
