ekegusii: Omonene nantomere ogotooreka korwa igoro, nababue abwo bagonkorera bobe babe nobosooku. Nyasae naorokie amabera aye na ekeene kiaye.
english: He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me; Selah God sends his love and his faithfulness.

ekegusii: Nigo agotoma amachiko aye gocha ase ense, ne ring’ana riaye riaranda bwango.
english: He sends his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.

ekegusii: Nigo agotoma ring’ana riaye, na amagena ayio amakendu anyititoke. Erio ogusia embeo amache agenda.
english: He sends his word and melts them; he stirs up his breezes, and the waters flow.

ekegusii: Nigo atigete eke kiarenge chinguru chiaye kegasakorwa, ekio kiarenge obonene bwaye agakerua ase amaboko ’ababisa.
english: He sent [the ark of] his might into captivity, his splendor into the hands of the enemy.

ekegusii: Naende agatoma omosomba onde; bakamoaka oyio boigo, bakamokora bobe, bakamoseria atari na gento.
english: He sent another servant, but that one also they beat and treated shamefully and sent away empty-handed.

ekegusii: akamotomera abanto nokoiraneria oko: “Tokaga ng’a ekiagera ore ase enyomba y’omoruoti aye notooreke kobua Abayahudi bande.
english: he sent back this answer: "Do not think that because you are in the king's house you alone of all the Jews will escape.

ekegusii: Omonene agatoma omosunte, na ense eria ekamwama ti. Barabwo tibangete koigwera amang’ana aye.
english: He sent darkness and made the land dark-- for had they not rebelled against his words?

ekegusii: Erio agatoma amarube gochia ase chingongo chionsi chi’obogambi bwaye. Amarube ayio akarikwa ase kera orogongo ase okorikwa kw’engencho y’amariko abo, ase kera egesaku ase omonwa obo, goteba ng’a kera omosacha abe okogamba ase enka yaye, naende abe ogokwana nabanto baye ase omonwa bw’egesaku kiaye.
english: He sent dispatches to all parts of the kingdom, to each province in its own script and to each people in its own language, proclaiming in each people's tongue that every man should be ruler over his own household.

ekegusii: Agatoma Eliakimu, oria orenge omoteneneri bw’enyomba yaye, na Sebuna omoriki, na abakuani abagaaka, beboyetie chianga chie chigunia, bakagenda ase Isaya omobani mosinto bw’Amosi.
english: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

ekegusii: Agatoma Eliakimu, oria orenge omoteneneri bw’enyomba yaye, na Sebuna omoriki, na abakuani abagaaka, beboyetie chianga chie chigunia, bagende ase Isaya omobani, mosinto bw’Amosi.
english: He sent Eliakim the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and the leading priests, all wearing sackcloth, to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz.

ekegusii: Akabatomera ring’ana riaye, akabagwenia, akabatooria korwa ase chimbeera.
english: He sent forth his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.

ekegusii: Agatoma abasomba baye batebie baria konya barangerigwe ase enyangi, korende barabwo bakaanga gocha.
english: He sent his servants to those who had been invited to the banquet to tell them to come, but they refused to come.

ekegusii: Nere okorete ebikone na amakumia ase egati yao, aye Misiri, na ase Farao amo nabasomba baye.
english: He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

ekegusii: agatoma Hadoramu, omomura oye, ase omoruoti Daudi komokwania na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri na omobuire. Hadadeseri nigo abete okonakorwania Tou. Boigo Tou agatoma ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu, na ebie chitaai.
english: he sent his son Hadoram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Hadoram brought all kinds of articles of gold and silver and bronze.

ekegusii: agatoma Yoramu, momura oye, ase omoruoti Daudi amokwanie na komosesenia, ekiagera ere konya arwanirie Hadadeseri omobuirie. Hadadeseri nigo abete okona‐korwania Toi. Boigo Yoramu akairera Daudi ebinto bi’etahabu, na ebi’efeta, na ebi’etaai.
english: he sent his son Joram to King David to greet him and congratulate him on his victory in battle over Hadadezer, who had been at war with Tou. Joram brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze.

ekegusii: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, Ramoth Negev and Jattir;
english: Naboigo abitomerete abagaaka ba Beteli na Ramoti agwo Negebu, na abwo b’emechie ya Yatiri,

ekegusii: Beni‐Hadadi agatoma abanto gochia ase omochie ase Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akamotebia, “Aya naro inche Beni‐Hadadi ngoteba:
english: He sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel, saying, "This is what Ben-Hadad says:

ekegusii: Naende agatoma abanto ase orogongo rwonsi rw’abanto b’egesaku kia Manase barangerie abanto b’aroro bamobwatie. Naboigo akarangeria abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri, na egia Sabuloni, na ekia Nafutali; barabwo bakaimoka, bakagenda bakamobwatia.
english: He sent messengers throughout Manasseh, calling them to arms, and also into Asher, Zebulun and Naphtali, so that they too went up to meet them.

ekegusii: agatoma amang’ana gochia Yabesi o Gileadi gotebia abanto b’aroro, “Omonene abasesenie, ekiagera mwaorogetie obuya bwaino ase Saulo, omonene oino, ase okomotindeka.
english: he sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead to say to them, "The LORD bless you for showing this kindness to Saul your master by burying him.

ekegusii: Omonene agatoma Musa, omosomba oye, na Haroni, oyio konya achorire.
english: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

ekegusii: agatoma chirooti na igo akamanya na koenekia ng’a Saulo konya oikireo.
english: he sent out scouts and learned that Saul had definitely arrived.

ekegusii: Agatoma naende oyo o gatato, bakamoaka chingoma, bakamotuguta isiko.
english: He sent still a third, and they wounded him and threw him out.

ekegusii: Naende agatoma oyonde, na oyio bakamoita. Naboigo babakorerete abande abange; bagaaka abande, na abande bakabaita.
english: He sent still another, and that one they killed. He sent many others; some of them they beat, others they killed.

ekegusii: Nigo arentete chingi chinyinge chikabachanda, na akabarentera ebioto bigasaria ense yabo.
english: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.

ekegusii: Omonene akabatomera omobani, na ere akabarentera amang’ana korwa ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Ninche nabarusetie Miisiri, ense eria ase mwarenge abasomba.
english: he sent them a prophet, who said, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I brought you up out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

ekegusii: Agaatanana abanto aba ase ebiombe bitato, kera ekeombe gekaba abanto chilifu ikomi. Kera ekeombe gekaba kegokora emeremo agwo Lebanoni ase omotienyi oyomo na kobeera inka ase emetienyi ebere. Adoniramu akabekwa gotenenera emeremo eyio yagwenerete gokorwa.
english: He sent them off to Lebanon in shifts of ten thousand a month, so that they spent one month in Lebanon and two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.

ekegusii: Akabatoma goika Bethlehemu, akabatebia “Genda morigie mono omwana oyio; kamoramonyore moche gontebia, nainche boigo ngende komosasima.”
english: He sent them to Bethlehem and said, "Go and make a careful search for the child. As soon as you find him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship him."

ekegusii: Yohana akarangeria babere ase aborokigwa baye, akabatoma ase Omonene komoboria, “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”
english: he sent them to the Lord to ask, "Are you the one who was to come, or should we expect someone else?"

ekegusii: Agatoma abanto babere korwa ase baria baare komokonya bagende Makedonia, nabwo Timotheo na Erasto. Ere omonyene agatigara Asia ase engaki enke.
english: He sent two of his helpers, Timothy and Erastus, to Macedonia, while he stayed in the province of Asia a little longer.

ekegusii: Agakorera Baali, akayesasima, na buna ise akorete, akagechia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, goika ere akaba nendamwamu.
english: He served and worshiped Baal and provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger, just as his father had done.

ekegusii: Ere agasamba enyomba y’Omonene na enyomba y’omoruoti, ne chinyomba chionsi chia Yerusalemu; agasamba kera enyomba enene.
english: He set fire to the temple of the LORD, the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.

ekegusii: Ere agasamba enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’Omoruoti, ne chinyomba chionsi chia Yerusalemu; agasamba kera enyomba enene.
english: He set fire to the temple of the LORD, the royal palace and all the houses of Jerusalem. Every important building he burned down.

ekegusii: Na egesasimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe akabeka ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Igoro yaye akarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, buna Omonene konya amochikire.
english: He set the altar of burnt offering near the entrance to the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it burnt offerings and grain offerings, as the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Aye nigo otenenetie ense bokong’u igoro ase amaroso aye, tebaisa konyegerigwa nonya ng’ake.
english: He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.

ekegusii: Omonene obibekire bigenderere kobao goika kare na kare; nigo abibekerete ogochika okwo gotaetanigwe.
english: He set them in place for ever and ever; he gave a decree that will never pass away.

ekegusii: Agatenenia egesasimero kia Baali ime ase enyomba ya Baali, eria aagachete agwo Samaria.
english: He set up an altar for Baal in the temple of Baal that he built in Samaria.

ekegusii: Nigo akoa omokungu omogomba chinguru chi’okoibora, oba nomogoko ase enka yaye. Omonene atogigwe!
english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a happy mother of children. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Nigo agotengechia ense yarwa aase aye, erio chintenenero chiaye chianyegerigwa.
english: He shakes the earth from its place and makes its pillars tremble.

ekegusii: Naende asambere ebitinya bi’ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe ase egesasimero.
english: He shall also burn the fat of the sin offering on the altar.

ekegusii: Erio esibie omobere oye namache agwo aase gete are aachenu, naende abeke chianga chiaye chia botambe. Nyuma y’ayio asoke, arue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase engencho yaye ere omonyene amo nebi’abanto bonsi na akore okobwatanigwa asere omonyene na ase abanto.
english: He shall bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his regular garments. Then he shall come out and sacrifice the burnt offering for himself and the burnt offering for the people, to make atonement for himself and for the people.

ekegusii: Ebitinya biaye bionsi abisambere ase egesasimero buna ebi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bigosambwa. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omogambi oria ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na omogambi oria naaberwe.
english: He shall burn all the fat on the altar as he burned the fat of the fellowship offering. In this way the priest will make atonement for the man's sin, and he will be forgiven.

ekegusii: Erio atobeke ekiara kiaye ime ase amanyinga na anyororokererie ara gatano na kabere ase obosio bwane agwo bosio bw’etoto eria y’egetambaa,
english: He shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle it before the LORD seven times in front of the curtain.

ekegusii: Erio ae omokungu oria amache ayio anywe, na ekero amache aya amaroro asoire ase enda yaye arente okoragererigwa na obororo.
english: He shall have the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and this water will enter her and cause bitter suffering.

ekegusii: Erio anyenyere enyoni eyemo igoro ase egetega keroiseirie amaroba kere namache amaya a rooche.
english: He shall kill one of the birds over fresh water in a clay pot.

ekegusii: Omokuani oria arue eng’ondi eyio, gose riruma erio ase obosio bw’Omonene, na akore okobwatanigwa ase omokungu oyio, na igo nabe ochenekire korwa ase ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye. Oko nakwo ogochika ase omokungu oiborete omwana, omoisia gose egesagane.
english: He shall offer them before the LORD to make atonement for her, and then she will be ceremonially clean from her flow of blood. "'These are the regulations for the woman who gives birth to a boy or a girl.

ekegusii: rirorio achike ng’a egento ekio giasarekire, tiga gesibigwe na kebekwe ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.
english: he shall order that the contaminated article be washed. Then he is to isolate it for another seven days.

ekegusii: rirorio omonto oria naae ise omoiseke oria chibesa, chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo etano, atwaare omoiseke oria abe mokaye, ekiagera omosareirie obwekungi bwaye; takoba neribaga komotiga ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
english: he shall pay the girl's father fifty shekels of silver. He must marry the girl, for he has violated her. He can never divorce her as long as he lives.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio omokuani nachene enyomba eyio namanyinga ’enyoni eria, amo namache aria amaya a rooche, na enyoni eria ere moyo, na oroko rw’omocharake, na orosagia rwa hisopo, na eusi eria embariri.
english: He shall purify the house with the bird's blood, the fresh water, the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the scarlet yarn.

ekegusii: Naende ebitinya bionsi bi’eeri eyio abirusie na kobisambera ase egesasimero.
english: He shall remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar,

ekegusii: Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’eeri eria y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na ebitinya bitubete chinyama chi’enda, na ebitinya binde bionsi bire ase enda ime,
english: He shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering-- the fat that covers the inner parts or is connected to them,

ekegusii: Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’embori eyio buna ebitinya bi’eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bikorusigwa, na omokuani asambere ebitinya ebio ase egesasimero bibe rimisu rigiya rikongwenera. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria, na omonto oria naaberwe.
english: He shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar as an aroma pleasing to the LORD. In this way the priest will make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

ekegusii: Erio arusie ebitinya bionsi bi’eng’ondi eyio, buna ebitinya bi’emanwa y’eng’ondi y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe bikorusigwa, na omokuani abisambere ase egesasimero, igoro ase ekeng’wanso kegosamberwa nomorero asende. Ase enchera eyio omokuani nakore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’ebibe biaye, na omonto oria naaberwe.
english: He shall remove all the fat, just as the fat is removed from the lamb of the fellowship offering, and the priest shall burn it on the altar on top of the offerings made to the LORD by fire. In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.

ekegusii: abatebie: Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera! Bono mwabeire ang’e kogenda korwania ababisa baino. Timobaisa gokwa emioyo, timoiroka gose koiguswa, gose timoboboa,
english: He shall say: "Hear, O Israel, today you are going into battle against your enemies. Do not be fainthearted or afraid; do not be terrified or give way to panic before them.

ekegusii: He shall slaughter the lamb for the guilt offering and take some of its blood and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
english: Erio anyenye emanwa eria ebe ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, na omokuani aimokie amanyinga make ay’ekeng’wanso ekio, ayagindie mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa, na ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio.

ekegusii: naende anyororokerie egesasimero namanyinga ayio nekiara kiaye ara gatano na kabere. Ase enchera eyio agesibie na kogechena korwa ase ogotacheneka kore ase Abaisraeli.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and to consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

ekegusii: Okoboko kw’omonto onde tigokuna omonto orakore ayio, korende nigo araakwe amagena gose araswe nemegwe. Aya achikirwe ase mwanyabanto na ase ching’iti, korende ekero egetureri kerabugigwe eriogi ri’ekerondereria, erio nario abanto baratiire gocha ase egetunwa.”
english: He shall surely be stoned or shot with arrows; not a hand is to be laid on him. Whether man or animal, he shall not be permitted to live.' Only when the ram's horn sounds a long blast may they go up to the mountain."

ekegusii: Omokuani arusie ensemo y’okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera ebe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene, ayesambere ase egesasimero. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
english: He shall take out the memorial portion from the grain offering and burn it on the altar as an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio atandorane egekuba, korende tarusia chimbaba, ayesambere ase egesasimero, igoro ye chinko chiria chire ase omorero. Ekio nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera inche Omonene.
english: He shall tear it open by the wings, not severing it completely, and then the priest shall burn it on the wood that is on the fire on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Akaruta emegwe, agaserebania ababisa baye, akabaaka nokomesa.
english: He shot arrows and scattered [the enemies], bolts of lightning and routed them.

ekegusii: Akaruta emegwe yaye, agaserebania ababisa baye; akamesia chinkoba, akabatantania.
english: He shot his arrows and scattered [the enemies], great bolts of lightning and routed them.

ekegusii: agaaka eriogi, okobora, “Inaki inde naye Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae ore Igoro Mono? Nagotianirie ase Nyasae ng’a tonchanda”,
english: He shouted at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? Swear to God that you won't torture me!"

ekegusii: Agaichana ase omoika oye, akabora, “Naki ekegori eke gekorigia egekone? Ekeene nabatebirie: Ekegori eke tigekoegwa egekone buna eke.”
english: He sighed deeply and said, "Why does this generation ask for a miraculous sign? I tell you the truth, no sign will be given to it."

ekegusii: Abanto abwo basemeirie nigo akobaura amang’ana bagokwana, na oura abanto abagotu ogosemia.
english: He silences the lips of trusted advisers and takes away the discernment of elders.

ekegusii: Ere nere oikaransete ase orosingo rw’ense, na abamenyete ase ense nigo banga buna ebisase; nere okorambora igoro chionsi buna egetambaa gekoramborwa, ee, nigo agochirambora buna eema ekomenywa ekoramborwa.
english: He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth, and its people are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a canopy, and spreads them out like a tent to live in.

ekegusii: Akanyenya boigo eeri amo nemingichi, chikaba ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase engencho y’abanto. Abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ’ebing’wanso ebio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: He slaughtered the ox and the ram as the fellowship offering for the people. His sons handed him the blood, and he sprinkled it against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: He slept with Hagar, and she conceived. When she knew she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.
english: Erio bakamenyana na Hagari, na ere akaba morito. Ekero arora ng’a obeire morito, akaba ogochaya moibori omwabo.

ekegusii: Usia akaba okorigia Nyasae nenkoro yaye ase amatuko a Zakaria, oyorenge komworokereria amoiroke Nyasae. Na ekero arenge komorigia Omonene, Nyasae akaba okomosesenia.
english: He sought God during the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God. As long as he sought the LORD, God gave him success.

ekegusii: Nigo agochika erioba tirigosoka; ne ching’enang’eni ochibeka ekemanyererio.
english: He speaks to the sun and it does not shine; he seals off the light of the stars.

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akarara aroro ase obotuko obwo; agachora korwa ase etugo eria abwate, echio aranyare koa Esau omwabo ebiegwa.
english: He spent the night there, and from what he had with him he selected a gift for his brother Esau:

ekegusii: Ere agatandora ebitare agwo ase erooro, agasokeria abanto amache amange mono buna aye chindooche chinene.
english: He split the rocks in the desert and gave them water as abundant as the seas;

ekegusii: Ewili‐Merodaki agakwana amang’ana ’obwororo nere, naende akamoa amasikani amanene kobua ayio aete abaruoti bande barenge amo nere agwo Babeli.
english: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor higher than those of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

ekegusii: Agakwana amang’ana aya maiso marore. Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaka komokania.
english: He spoke plainly about this, and Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya Yeso nigo ayakwanete, gakworokereria ase Hekalu, ase enyomba y’ekebekerero gi’esadaka; omonto tari omobwatete, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika.
english: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple area near the place where the offerings were put. Yet no one seized him, because his time had not yet come.

ekegusii: Boigo nakwanete emereng’anio chilifu isato; na amatera aye nigo arenge elifu eyemo, na atano.
english: He spoke three thousand proverbs and his songs numbered a thousand and five.

ekegusii: Nigo akwanete nabarabwo, ore ime ase riire. Abanto abwo nigo babwatete oborori bwaye, na amachiko abaete.
english: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.

ekegusii: He spoke, and the locusts came, grasshoppers without number;
english: Agakwana, ne chingige chigacha, chirochio chikabiara chikaba chinyinge,

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana, ne chingi chinyinge mono chigacha, ne chinsona boigo ase ense eria yonsi.
english: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.

ekegusii: Omonene akarambora riire rigatuba abanto baye, na omorero okaba okobamorekera botuko.
english: He spread out a cloud as a covering, and a fire to give light at night.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo aramborete ensemo ya sugusu aase arenge bosa, nigo asungete ense aase bosa etabwateti aande.
english: He spreads out the northern [skies] over empty space; he suspends the earth over nothing.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenta amagena ’embura agwekaine amarionya amarabu, oyasiarera buna agosiara ribu.
english: He spreads the snow like wool and scatters the frost like ashes.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akororekana buna egesicha giasichire na giasira bwango, nigo agoeta bwango buna omorengari, tari kogenderera kobao.
english: He springs up like a flower and withers away; like a fleeting shadow, he does not endure.

ekegusii: Akanyororokeria egesasimero namaguta akweakwa ara gatano na kabere, naende agaaka egesasimero amaguta aria, agaaka nebikorero bionsi, na egetuba amo nenterekerero yaye ase okobiatanana bibe ebichenu.
english: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.

ekegusii: Naende akarigereria omonto oria namaiso amomo pa goika omonto oria agaichana. Na Elisha, omonto o Nyasae, agachaka korera.
english: He stared at him with a fixed gaze until Hazael felt ashamed. Then the man of God began to weep.

ekegusii: Akabeka abanto bonsi korenda omoruoti, kera omonto akaba obwate ebirwanero biaye koboko kwaye, bagatenena korwa ensemo ya irianyi y’enyomba goika ensemo ya sugusu, bagaetanana egesasimero na enyomba eria.
english: He stationed all the men, each with his weapon in his hand, around the king-- near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.

ekegusii: Ase enyomba y’Omonene omoruoti akabeka Abalawi barenge goakania chisani chikwoga, na amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa, koreng’ana nogochika kwa Nyasae goetera ase Daudi, na Gadi omorori bw’omoruoti, na Nathani omobani.
english: He stationed the Levites in the temple of the LORD with cymbals, harps and lyres in the way prescribed by David and Gad the king's seer and Nathan the prophet; this was commanded by the LORD through his prophets.

ekegusii: Akabeka abarwani esegi ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda yagiteire chindwaki, na ase ense y’Abayuda, na ase emechie y’Efraimu eyio Asa ise abwate.
english: He stationed troops in all the fortified cities of Judah and put garrisons in Judah and in the towns of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

ekegusii: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.
english: Agachika ekembugu‐mbugu keria, kegakira‐kiri, na emerindo y’enyancha egatoerera.

ekegusii: agatenena agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, agakwana neriogi rinene, akabora,
english: He stood and blessed the whole assembly of Israel in a loud voice, saying:

ekegusii: aganchichera agatenena ang’e nainche, agantebia: Oyominto Saulo, nyora okorora. Ase ensa eria eria nkanyora okorora, nkamorora.
english: He stood beside me and said, 'Brother Saul, receive your sight!' And at that very moment I was able to see him.

ekegusii: Ekero Haroni atenenete gati gati ya baria bakwete na baria barenge moyo, amaakwa aria agatiga goita abanto.
english: He stood between the living and the dead, and the plague stopped.

ekegusii: Ekero agotenena, ense nigo agotengechigwa, na ekero akorigereria, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakonyegerigwa. Ebitunwa biarengeo korwa kare nigo bikorimera gochia inse. Ere nigo agotaara ase chinchera chiaye chia kare.
english: He stood, and shook the earth; he looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains crumbled and the age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

ekegusii: He strengthened their defenses and put commanders in them, with supplies of food, olive oil and wine.
english: Akaagacha chiburi chiabo chikaba chinkong’u, akabeka abateneneri imeo, na akagacha chindagera na amaguta ’emezeituni aroro.

ekegusii: Akarambora omogwekano onga buna okoboko, akabwata etukia y’omotwe one. Erio Omoika okanyimokereria igoro ase egati y’ense na igoro, na ase okorora gokorwa ase Nyasae Omoika okang’ira Yerusalemu. Okang’ira goika ase egesoero ki’eraaro ya ime, goetera ase egeita kiarochie sugusu. Aroro agwo nao omogwekano obekire, oyio obogetie risemi ria Nyasae.
english: He stretched out what looked like a hand and took me by the hair of my head. The Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven and in visions of God he took me to Jerusalem, to the entrance to the north gate of the inner court, where the idol that provokes to jealousy stood.

ekegusii: Ere boigo akarusia chianga chiaye akababoka ase okobana ase obosio bwa Samweli, akagwa inse, akarara agwo rituko rigima, omobaso na obotuko, ore getirianda. Ase ayio amang’ana nigo agotebwa: “Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”
english: He stripped off his robes and also prophesied in Samuel's presence. He lay that way all that day and night. This is why people say, "Is Saul also among the prophets?"

ekegusii: Agaita abana abatangi bonsi aaria Misiri, abwo barenge abatangi be chinguru chiabo ase chiema chia Hamu.
english: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo asiretie ebisaku ebinge, na agaita abaruoti barenge ne chinguru;
english: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings--

ekegusii: Nere oitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo.
english: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of men and animals.

ekegusii: Agasaria emesabibu na emeko yabo, emete y’ense eria ekabunwa.
english: he struck down their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.

ekegusii: Ee, nigo akinanete nomomalaika, akamobua; akarera, akamosorora ng’a amororere amabera. Agwo Beteli Yakobo akaumerana na Nyasae, na Ere agakwana naintwe.
english: He struggled with the angel and overcame him; he wept and begged for his favor. He found him at Bethel and talked with him there--

ekegusii: Omonene obekire abanto inse yaito, otoeire okobua kogambera abanto b’ebisaku.
english: He subdued nations under us, peoples under our feet.

ekegusii: Ere nigo ainyorete abarwani baye b’esegi abanene, korende ekero bagocha nigo barabe bakona‐kogochwa. Barabwo nigo bakoayerera gochia ase chindwaki, na gotenenia ebiekengero.
english: He summons his picked troops, yet they stumble on their way. They dash to the city wall; the protective shield is put in place.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akorangeria igoro na ense chibe birori, ekero akonachera abanto baye ekina, ogoteba,
english: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that he may judge his people:

ekegusii: Oinyore buna ariete eira na gotiana asore aye Omonene ore Chinguru chia Yakobo, agateba,
english: He swore an oath to the LORD and made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

ekegusii: Nigo agosibora chinkini chi’abaruoti, erio obaboyia ebibarachi.
english: He takes off the shackles put on by kings and ties a loincloth around their waist.

ekegusii: akarandia noboremu ase erieta ri’Omonene. Agakwana na koamererania n’Abayahudi abarenge gokwana Ekegiriki, korende barabwo bakarigia komoita.
english: He talked and debated with the Grecian Jews, but they tried to kill him.

ekegusii: Ere akorokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, ogotogigwa nabanto bonsi.
english: He taught in their synagogues, and everyone praised him.

ekegusii: Tata akanyorokereria, agantebia, “Tiga amang’ana aane abeere ase enkoro yao ime; orende amachiko aane, erio nario orabe moyo.”
english: he taught me and said, "Lay hold of my words with all your heart; keep my commands and you will live.

ekegusii: Akaborokereria amang’ana amange ase emereng’anio, akabatebia ase okworokereria kwaye,
english: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:

ekegusii: Barabwo mborokererie Abayakobo emeroberio yao echikire na Abaisraeli amachiko ao, mbarente ubani ase obosio bwao, naende mbasambere ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase egesasimero kiao.
english: He teaches your precepts to Jacob and your law to Israel. He offers incense before you and whole burnt offerings on your altar.

ekegusii: Korwa ase chinsemo chionsi ong’iyeirie, bono inche nasirigwe; osimoire ogosemeria kwane buna omote ogosimorwa.
english: He tears me down on every side till I am gone; he uproots my hope like a tree.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akobaorokeria aya bakorire, na ogosaria kwabo, naende ng’a nigo bare abaenenu.
english: he tells them what they have done-- that they have sinned arrogantly.

ekegusii: Narisie riicho riaye buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye, nasangererie chimanwa chie ching’ondi achiagate, nachibogorie ase egekuba kiaye, na echi chire ne chimanwa ching’are nachiraae ng’ora ng’ora.
english: He tends his flock like a shepherd: He gathers the lambs in his arms and carries them close to his heart; he gently leads those that have young.

ekegusii: Nigo akoba kirori ase aya arorire na koyaigwa; gose onde tari oyobwanchire oborori bwaye.
english: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.

ekegusii: Omonto orabe okare aare, oborwaire mbomoite, na oyore ang’e naitwe nomoro, na oyo otigaire na orendire, enchara nemoite. Ase enchera eyio inche Omonene ning’umore ekeririanda kiane igoro yabo.
english: He that is far away will die of the plague, and he that is near will fall by the sword, and he that survives and is spared will die of famine. So will I spend my wrath upon them.

ekegusii: Abamotebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Inamorore igoro akoigoka, na abamalaika ba Nyasae bakoriina na goika igoro ase Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.”
english: He then added, "I tell you the truth, you shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man."

ekegusii: Agachaka gokwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio. “Omonto naremete omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, agaetanania orobago, agakunya egetera akomitera amasabibu, akaagacha orwaki, akaywatananera abaremi, akamanora akagenda orogendo.
english: He then began to speak to them in parables: "A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a pit for the winepress and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and went away on a journey.

ekegusii: Agachaka koborokereria, ng’a negwenerete Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto anyore ogochandeka ase chinchera chinyinge, na kwangwa nabagaaka na abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, na goitwa, na nyuma y’amatuko atato naboke.
english: He then began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, chief priests and teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and after three days rise again.

ekegusii: Naende akang’ira ase eraaro ya ime y’enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo ase egesieri gie Hekalu y’Omonene egati y’enyomba ya bosio na egesasimero, nkarora abasacha koreng’ana emerongo ebere, na batano. Barabwo nigo baete Hekalu y’Omonene amagega, barigereretie gochia moocha. Abwo nigo barenge gosasima erioba barigereretie gochia moocha.
english: He then brought me into the inner court of the house of the LORD, and there at the entrance to the temple, between the portico and the altar, were about twenty-five men. With their backs toward the temple of the LORD and their faces toward the east, they were bowing down to the sun in the east.

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agansokia isiko akang’eteria ase egeita gia isiko kiarochie sugusu, akang’etanania gochia ase egeita kiarochie moocha; aroro agwo nkarora amache akorwa ensemo ya irianyi y’egeita.
english: He then brought me out through the north gate and led me around the outside to the outer gate facing east, and the water was flowing from the south side.

ekegusii: Naende akang’ira ase eraaro ya isiko, akang’etia ase chikoona chiaye inye, na nkarora ase kera ekoona ekeooreri nkiarengeo.
english: He then brought me to the outer court and led me around to its four corners, and I saw in each corner another court.

ekegusii: Akabogoria amaguta, na amabeere, ne chinyama chi’emori eria aroisetie, agaterekera abageni baria. Ere agatenena asebare ensemo ase ekiriri ki’omote, ekero baare koragera.
english: He then brought some curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and set these before them. While they ate, he stood near them under a tree.

ekegusii: akabarenta isiko, akababoria, “Abanene baane, inki ndakore ntooreke?”
english: He then brought them out and asked, "Sirs, what must I do to be saved?"

ekegusii: agateba, “Butorane omwana oyo ore moyo ebing’ese bibere, ekeng’ese ekemo keegwe omokungu oyomo, na ekende keegwe oyonde.”
english: He then gave an order: "Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other."

ekegusii: Boigo akaroisia ebituba bi’ogwesiberia, akabeka bitano ensemo ya irianyi, na bitano ensemo ya sugusu. Ime ase ebituba ebio nigo barenge gosiberia chinyama chi’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa; na abakuani barabwo nigo barenge gwesiberia ime ase egetuba keria ekenene.
english: He then made ten basins for washing and placed five on the south side and five on the north. In them the things to be used for the burnt offerings were rinsed, but the Sea was to be used by the priests for washing.

ekegusii: Hiramu akaroisia na ebituba ikomi bie chitaai. Obogare bwa kera egetuba nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ane, na nigo kiare koira amache aisaine ang’e ne chilita amagana kianda. Naboigo aroisetie ebituba ikomi, ekemo ase kera ekebekerero.
english: He then made ten bronze basins, each holding forty baths and measuring four cubits across, one basin to go on each of the ten stands.

ekegusii: Musa akarenta eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, erio Haroni amo nabamura baye bakabeka amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio.
english: He then presented the bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

ekegusii: Musa akarenta emingichi ya kabere, eyio yaruetwe ase ogwatanana abakuani ase emeremo emechenu, Haroni na abamura baye bakabeka amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’emingichi eyio.
english: He then presented the other ram, the ram for the ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

ekegusii: Erio akarenta emingichi ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na Haroni amo nabamura baye bakabeka amaboko abo ase omotwe bw’emingichi eyio.
english: He then presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, imoka ogende ase Abaisraeli, okwane nabarabwo amang’ana aane.
english: He then said to me: "Son of man, go now to the house of Israel and speak my words to them.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, ngochia inde gokeyia endagera ase Yerusalemu. Nigo bararengerwe endagera bakoria, na bayerie bare nobwoba. Boigo goika barengerwe amache bakonywa, na bayanywe bare nomoichano.
english: He then said to me: "Son of man, I will cut off the supply of food in Jerusalem. The people will eat rationed food in anxiety and drink rationed water in despair,

ekegusii: Erio agakwana n’Abaisraeli bonsi basangererekanete, akabatebia, “Onye ekororekana buya asemore, naende onye kore ogwancha kw’Omonene, Nyasae oito, tiga totome abanto gochia aaria na aaria barangerie abaminto baria batigarete ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli, na abakuani na Abalawi bakare ase emechie eria ere namarisio, erinde bachiche babe amo naintwe.
english: He then said to the whole assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you and if it is the will of the LORD our God, let us send word far and wide to the rest of our brothers throughout the territories of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites who are with them in their towns and pasturelands, to come and join us.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Nebukadinesaro agatoma abanto basangererie amo abagambi abanene b’oboruoti bwaye, na abagambi be chingongo chiaye, na abagavuna, na abasemia, na abagachi be chikungo, na abagambi ebina, na abamanyi b’amachiko, na abanene bande bonsi b’oboruoti bwaye. Abwo bonsi nigo barangereretigwe ase ogwatanana na gosesenia omogwekano oria Nebukadinesaro omoruoti konya atenenirie.
english: He then summoned the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates and all the other provincial officials to come to the dedication of the image he had set up.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akeonchora gochia ase omonto onde akaboria amang’ana aria konya aboririe, na abanto bakamoiraneria buna konya bamoiraneirie ritang’ani.
english: He then turned away to someone else and brought up the same matter, and the men answered him as before.

ekegusii: Naende akarigia Ahasia. Nere akanyorekana bwebisete agwo Samaria, akarentwa ase Yehu, erio agaitwa. Abanto bakamotindeka, ekiagera nigo batebete, “Oyio nigo arenge omochokoro o Yehosafati, oria omorigetie Omonene nenkoro yaye yonsi.” Nyuma y’ayio omonto tarenge ase enyomba y’Ahasia oyo onyarete kogamba ase oboruoti boria.
english: He then went in search of Ahaziah, and his men captured him while he was hiding in Samaria. He was brought to Jehu and put to death. They buried him, for they said, "He was a son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the LORD with all his heart." So there was no one in the house of Ahaziah powerful enough to retain the kingdom.

ekegusii: Omonto oria akagenda ase ense y’Abahiti, akaagacha omochie aroro, akayoroka Lusu, buna ore korokwa goika rero iga.
english: He then went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a city and called it Luz, which is its name to this day.

ekegusii: Agachaka korengereria ase omoyo oye ime: Inki ngokora, ekiagera tindi naase nkobeka okwama kwane?
english: He thought to himself, 'What shall I do? I have no place to store my crops.'

ekegusii: akarengereria ng’a, “Esau karache aumokere ekeombe kie ritang’ani na kogesiria, keria kende nagetooreke.”
english: He thought, "If Esau comes and attacks one group, the group that is left may escape."

ekegusii: akamotuguta ase eora y’abakure, akayesieka, na akabeka ekemanyererio igoro asere, erinde tagenka abanto b’ebisaku naende, goika emiaka eria elifu eyemo eere. Nyuma ase aya nemogwenerete asiborwe ase ekero egeke.
english: He threw him into the Abyss, and locked and sealed it over him, to keep him from deceiving the nations anymore until the thousand years were ended. After that, he must be set free for a short time.

ekegusii: akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, okomoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, na ere n’Omosamaria orenge.
english: He threw himself at Jesus' feet and thanked him-- and he was a Samaritan.

ekegusii: Nyasae ontugutire ase etintira ime, nabeire buna orotu ne ribu.
english: He throws me into the mud, and I am reduced to dust and ashes.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agosaria emeroberio y’abang’ainereria, erinde emeremo bagokora namaboko abo tegoikerana buna baganetie.
english: He thwarts the plans of the crafty, so that their hands achieve no success.

ekegusii: Abiatari agatebia Daudi ng’a Saulo oitire abakuani b’Omonene.
english: He told David that Saul had killed the priests of the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonto oria agatebia Eli, “Ninche narua ase esegi, natama korwao ase rituko ria rero.” Erio Eli akamoboria, “Omwana one, naki esegi yagenderera?”
english: He told Eli, "I have just come from the battle line; I fled from it this very day." Eli asked, "What happened, my son?"

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Genda, orangerie omosacha oo, oche nere aiga.”
english: He told her, "Go, call your husband and come back."

ekegusii: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.
english: Agachika omoganda oikaranse inse.

ekegusii: Agachika omoganda oikaranse inse, akabogoria emegati eria etano na ebere. Kayesesenirie, akayesamunyora, akaa aborokigwa baye bayetereke, na barabwo bakayeterekera omoganda.
english: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground. When he had taken the seven loaves and given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to set before the people, and they did so.

ekegusii: Elija agatebia omoruoti, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ekiagera aye gwatomire abanto koboria korwa ase Baali‐Sebubu, enyasae y’Ekironi, okarengereria ng’a Nyasae tari ase Abaisraeli okoboria amang’ana, aye togoika korwa ase oborere obwo kwariina, korende ekeene, goika okwe.”
english: He told the king, "This is what the LORD says: Is it because there is no God in Israel for you to consult that you have sent messengers to consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron? Because you have done this, you will never leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!"

ekegusii: Akabatebia omoreng’anio onde, agateba, “Oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nentetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye;
english: He told them another parable: "The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his field.

ekegusii: akabatebereria amang’ana onsi, akabatoma Yopa.
english: He told them everything that had happened and sent them to Joppa.

ekegusii: Akabatebia omoreng’anio onde, “Oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nememera omokungu abogoretie, akayebeka ase ebirengo bitato bi’obosie, goika bionsi bikabota.”
english: He told them still another parable: "The kingdom of heaven is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into a large amount of flour until it worked all through the dough."

ekegusii: He told them this parable: "Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
english: Akabatebia omoreng’anio, “Rigereria omoko na emete ende yonsi;

ekegusii: Akabatebia omoreng’anio: “Onde tari ogotandora ekeraka ki’eanga enyia na gokebeka ase eanga engotu; aise gokora bo, natandore eria enyia, na ekeraka keria ki’eanga enyia tigekobwatana neanga eria engotu.
english: He told them this parable: "No one tears a patch from a new garment and sews it on an old one. If he does, he will have torn the new garment, and the patch from the new will not match the old.

ekegusii: Ere akabairaneria, “Aya naro Mika ankoreire: Nigo andigete, akong’a eng’eria, na inche nigo inde omokuani oye.”
english: He told them what Micah had done for him, and said, "He has hired me and I am his priest."

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Rengereria egento mogokora, ekiagera timori gokorera mwanyabanto ase okogamba, korende n’Omonene mogokorera; ere nigo are amo nainwe ase okogamba na konacha ebina.
english: He told them, "Consider carefully what you do, because you are not judging for man but for the LORD, who is with you whenever you give a verdict.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Rigesa nerinene, korende abakori emeremo nabake; gaki mosabe Omonene bwe rigesa atome abakori emeremo ase rigesa riaye.
english: He told them, "The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inwe mwaeirwe komanya obobisi bw’oboruoti bwa Nyasae, korende ase abanto bare isiko, amang’ana onsi nigo are emereng’anio asebare,
english: He told them, "The secret of the kingdom of God has been given to you. But to those on the outside everything is said in parables

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Naboigo yarigetwe ng’a nemogwenerete Kristo gochandwa, na koboka korwa ase abakure ase rituko ria gatato;
english: He told them, "This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,

ekegusii: akabatebia nabarabwo: Genda nainwe ase omogondo one bw’emesabibu na inche nimbae ekere kia boronge. Bakagenda.
english: He told them, 'You also go and work in my vineyard, and I will pay you whatever is right.'

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Timobogoria gento ase orogendo rwaino, nonya nenyimbo, gose esaro, gose omogati, gose chibesa; naende timoba ne chianga ibere.
english: He told them: "Take nothing for the journey-- no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no extra tunic.

ekegusii: ere agatotebia buna aroche omomalaika oteneine mwaye, na komotebia: Toma abanto bagende Yopa, barangerie Simion, oyokorokwa Petero.
english: He told us how he had seen an angel appear in his house and say, 'Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter.

ekegusii: Nere boigo akaroisia endagera engiya, akarentera ise, akamotebia, “Tata, inchuo orie endagera y’obotwari bwane, inche omwana oo, erinde onsesenie.”
english: He too prepared some tasty food and brought it to his father. Then he said to him, "My father, sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing."

ekegusii: Nere boigo akabwatia chinchera chi’enyomba y’Ahabu, ekiagera ng’ina nere orenge komosemia akore ayare amabe.
english: He too walked in the ways of the house of Ahab, for his mother encouraged him in doing wrong.

ekegusii: He took a little child and had him stand among them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,
english: Akabogoria omwana, akamobeka gati‐gati yabo, akamoagata, akabatebia,

ekegusii: Akabwata chiombe ibere, agachinachana ebing’ese, erio akaa abanto ebing’ese biria, nabarabwo bakabiira ase chingongo chionsi chi’Abaisraeli, bagateba amang’ana aye, “Omonto onde bwensi otambwateti inche Saulo amo na Samweli, chiombe chiaye nabo chiranachanwe iga.” Erio omoondoko bw’Omonene okabwata abanto, nabarabwo bagacha amo buna omonto oyomo.
english: He took a pair of oxen, cut them into pieces, and sent the pieces by messengers throughout Israel, proclaiming, "This is what will be done to the oxen of anyone who does not follow Saul and Samuel." Then the terror of the LORD fell on the people, and they turned out as one man.

ekegusii: Akabwata Agagi, omoruoti bw’Abaameleki, akamotiga ore moyo, korende abande bonsi pi akabaita nemioro.
english: He took Agag king of the Amalekites alive, and all his people he totally destroyed with the sword.

ekegusii: Boigo Daudi akairania ching’ondi, ne chimbori, ne chiombe. Abanto baye bagachitang’ania bosio bwaye, bagateba, “Ebi nebisakorwa bia Daudi.”
english: He took all the flocks and herds, and his men drove them ahead of the other livestock, saying, "This is David's plunder."

ekegusii: Akaira chitahabu chionsi, ne chifeta, na ebikorero bionsi bianyorekanete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, biria Obedi‐Edomu arendete; boigo akaira chinibo chi’enyomba y’omoruoti, agoosa nabanto abarengeo. Erio akairana Samaria.
english: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of God that had been in the care of Obed-Edom, together with the palace treasures and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.

ekegusii: Akaira chitahabu chionsi, ne chifeta, na ebikorero bionsi bianyorekanete ase enyomba y’Omonene, na ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’omoruoti, agoosa nabanto abarengeo. Erio akairana Samaria.
english: He took all the gold and silver and all the articles found in the temple of the LORD and in the treasuries of the royal palace. He also took hostages and returned to Samaria.

ekegusii: Oboeto bw’Egesona gi’Esabato bwatubire nekerama, obwo bwaagachire ase enyomba eria, na egesoero gia isiko ki’omoruoti, akabirusia korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, ase engencho y’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
english: He took away the Sabbath canopy that had been built at the temple and removed the royal entryway outside the temple of the LORD, in deference to the king of Assyria.

ekegusii: Petero akamoa okoboko kwaye, akamoimokia. Erio akarangeria abachenu baria na ababoraka, akamorenta asebare ore moyo.
english: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Then he called the believers and the widows and presented her to them alive.

ekegusii: Akamobwata okoboko omoiseke oria omoke, akamotebia, “Talitha kumi”, okoonchorwa kwaye, “Omoiseke, nagotebirie, imoka.”
english: He took her by the hand and said to her, "Talitha koum!" (which means, "Little girl, I say to you, get up!").

ekegusii: Omonene akamosokia isiko, akamotebia, “Rigereria gochia igoro, na obare ching’enang’eni, gose nonyare gochibara.” Erio akamotebia, “Ororeria rwao naboigo rorabe.”
english: He took him outside and said, "Look up at the heavens and count the stars-- if indeed you can count them." Then he said to him, "So shall your offspring be."

ekegusii: Ere taboraarete obogima bwaye, ekero aitete Omofilisti oria, na Omonene akanyorera Abaisraeli obobui obonene mono. Aye nkwaroche amang’ana ayio, na okagoka ase ayio. Nase ki rende orakore ebibe na goitera amanyinga omonto otari na komocha, ase ogoita Daudi?”
english: He took his life in his hands when he killed the Philistine. The LORD won a great victory for all Israel, and you saw it and were glad. Why then would you do wrong to an innocent man like David by killing him for no reason?"

ekegusii: Nigo aira chibesa chire omobuko na nigo arairane omotienyi kobeire omonene,”
english: He took his purse filled with money and will not be home till full moon."

ekegusii: Aburamu akaira Sarai mokaye, na Loti, omwana omomura omwabo, na ebinto bionsi ebi babwate, ebio konya benyoreire abanyene, na abanto babo bonsi babwate agwo Harani, bakaimoka, bakagenda ense ya Kanani.
english: He took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, all the possessions they had accumulated and the people they had acquired in Haran, and they set out for the land of Canaan, and they arrived there.

ekegusii: Omonene akang’ira aase agwo, nkarora omonto, na okororekana kwaye nigo kwarenge buna ogw’etaai; omonto oyio nigo abwate engori y’egatani na emoti y’okorengera ase okoboko kwaye; ere nigo ateneine ang’e negeita.
english: He took me there, and I saw a man whose appearance was like bronze; he was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand.

ekegusii: Akaira Petero na abana baria ba Zebedi babere, agachaka goichana na gwechanda mono.
english: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.

ekegusii: He took Peter, James and John along with him, and he began to be deeply distressed and troubled.
english: Akaira Petero na Yakobo na Yohana amo nere, agachaka goichana na gwechanda mono.

ekegusii: Naende akaira chigari amagana atano na rimo, echi achorete, amo ne chigari chinde chionsi, na abariini chituoni bachiriinete.
english: He took six hundred of the best chariots, along with all the other chariots of Egypt, with officers over all of them.

ekegusii: Boigo akarenta omote oria bw’Asera korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, akayosokia isiko ya Yerusalemu, akayoira gochia ase Rikura ria Kidironi, akayosamunyorera aroro, akayosia okaba orotu; erio akaruta orotu orwo igoro ase chimbeera agwo ase abanto baare gotindekwa.
english: He took the Asherah pole from the temple of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem and burned it there. He ground it to powder and scattered the dust over the graves of the common people.

ekegusii: Akabwata omouko oria okoboko, akamoira isiko y’agachie, Kamotwereire amate ase amaiso, akabeka amaboko aye igoro asare, akamoboria, “Kwarorire gento?”
english: He took the blind man by the hand and led him outside the village. When he had spit on the man's eyes and put his hands on him, Jesus asked, "Do you see anything?"

ekegusii: Omote oria bw’Asera obaachire akayobeka ime ase enyomba y’Omonene, eyio Omonene akwanete igoro yaye, agatebia Daudi na Sulemani, omwana oye omomura, “Ase enyomba eye na ase Yerusalemu, omochie oyio nachorire korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, nao ndabeke erieta riane ribe aroro kogenderera botambe.
english: He took the carved Asherah pole he had made and put it in the temple, of which the LORD had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.

ekegusii: Omogwekano oria bw’ogosasimwa abaachete akayobeka ime ase enyomba ya Nyasae, enyomba eyio igoro yaye Nyasae atebetie Daudi na Sulemani, omwana oye omomura, “Ase enyomba eye, na ase Yerusalemu, omochie oyio nachorire korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, nao ndabeke erieta riane ribe aroro kogenderera botambe.
english: He took the carved image he had made and put it in God's temple, of which God had said to David and to his son Solomon, "In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my Name forever.

ekegusii: Erio akarusia egutwa y’etahabu korwa ase omotwe bw’omoruoti bw’aroro. Oborito bw’egutwa eria nigo bwarenge koreng’ana chikiro emerongo etato na inye naende nigo yachabeire amagena e rigori rinene. Egutwa eyio ekabekerwa Daudi ase omotwe oye igoro. Ere agasakora ebinto ebinge mono bi’omochie oria:
english: He took the crown from the head of their king--its weight was a talent of gold, and it was set with precious stones-- and it was placed on David's head. He took a great quantity of plunder from the city

ekegusii: He took the elders of the town and taught the men of Succoth a lesson by punishing them with desert thorns and briers.
english: Akaimokia amagwa ’orosana na amageri akabaaria abagaaka b’omochie oria.

ekegusii: Akaimokia ebitinya, na omokera, na ebitinya bionsi bie chinyama chi’enda, na ebitinya bie riini, ne chinyigo ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete, na ekenama kia borio.
english: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, both kidneys and their fat and the right thigh.

ekegusii: Akaimokia chibao chirikire oborori, agachibeka ase Esanduku ime, agasoyia emiaro ase chibonyi, akamumeka Esanduku eria n’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera.
english: He took the Testimony and placed it in the ark, attached the poles to the ark and put the atonement cover over it.

ekegusii: Ere akanyora ebinto ebi korwa ase amaboko abo, akanyititora chitahabu chiria. Ekero yabwatanire, akayebomba, ekaba omogwekano bw’emori eeri. Abanto bagateba, “Abaisraeli aba, eye nero enyasae yaino, eyabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: He took what they handed him and made it into an idol cast in the shape of a calf, fashioning it with a tool. Then they said, "These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you up out of Egypt."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio akaira abatang’ani baria b’amagana, na abarendi b’omoruoti, na abarendi b’enyomba y’omoruoti, na abanto bonsi b’ense eria, na barabwo bakarusia omoruoti korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, bakamoetia ase Egeita ki’Abarendi gochia ase enyomba y’omoruoti. Erio omoruoti agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti.
english: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the Carites, the guards and all the people of the land, and together they brought the king down from the temple of the LORD and went into the palace, entering by way of the gate of the guards. The king then took his place on the royal throne,

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio akagenda amo nabatang’ani b’abarwani esegi b’amagana na abanto basikire, na abagambi b’abanto, na abanto bonsi b’ense eria, akarusia omoruoti korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, bakamoetia ase Egeita kia Rogoro gochia ase enyomba y’omoruoti. Bakamoikaransia ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti.
english: He took with him the commanders of hundreds, the nobles, the rulers of the people and all the people of the land and brought the king down from the temple of the LORD. They went into the palace through the Upper Gate and seated the king on the royal throne,

ekegusii: abana baye abamura na abamura babo; na abana baye abaiseke, na abaiseke b’abamura babo. Naboigo akaira oroiboro rwaye rwonsi, akagenda nabarabwo goika Misiri.
english: He took with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons and his daughters and granddaughters-- all his offspring.

ekegusii: agatagora ebisasimero, akanachana emete y’Asera, na emegwekano y’ogosasimwa akabisia bikaba orotu. Ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli agatagora na koiyeria inse ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani ase erioba. Erio akairana gochia Yerusalemu.
english: he tore down the altars and the Asherah poles and crushed the idols to powder and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout Israel. Then he went back to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Akamokuna okoboko kwaye. Esosera ekamotiga, na ere akaimoka akamokorera.
english: He touched her hand and the fever left her, and she got up and began to wait on him.

ekegusii: Ere bworokereirie amaboko aane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko aane anyare gokumba obota bw’etaai.”
english: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

ekegusii: Ere bworokereirie amaboko aane korwana esegi, erinde amaboko aane anyare gotinga obota bw’etaai.
english: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

ekegusii: Erio gaetire chinsemo chiria na gokwana amang’ana amange ase okobaremia, agaika Bogiriki.
english: He traveled through that area, speaking many words of encouragement to the people, and finally arrived in Greece,

ekegusii: Farao agakorera Aburamu buya ase engencho ya Sarai, na Aburamu nigo anyorete ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke, ne chitigere chiaberi, ne chingamia.
english: He treated Abram well for her sake, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, menservants and maidservants, and camels.

ekegusii: Nigo asemeretie Nyasae, tiga Nyasae amotoorie bono, onye omoganetie, ekiagera natebete: Inche n’Omwana o Nyasae.”
english: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, 'I am the Son of God.'"

ekegusii: Nigo akorema emetaro ime ase ebitare, na amaiso aye arora aroro kera egento kie rigori rinene.
english: He tunnels through the rock; his eyes see all its treasures.

ekegusii: Elisha akeonchora, na ekero abaroche, akabaragereria ase erieta ri’Omonene; ne chidubu ibere chiaberi chikarwa ase rinani, chigatandora abana baria abamura emerongo ene, na babere.
english: He turned around, looked at them and called down a curse on them in the name of the LORD. Then two bears came out of the woods and mauled forty-two of the youths.

ekegusii: Erio akarua asebare, akagenda ensemo, akarera amariga; naende akairana, agakwana nabarabwo. Akarusia Simeoni korwa asebare, akamosiba ase amasio abo.
english: He turned away from them and began to weep, but then turned back and spoke to them again. He had Simeon taken from them and bound before their eyes.

ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora chindooche chikaba erooro, ne chinsoko chikaba ense enyomo.
english: He turned rivers into a desert, flowing springs into thirsty ground,

ekegusii: Boigo akaonchora erooro ekaba ritibo riichire amache, na ense enyomo egatuboka chinsoko chi’amache.
english: He turned the desert into pools of water and the parched ground into flowing springs;

ekegusii: Ere akaonchora enyancha ekaba ense enyomo, erio abanto bakambokera aroro namagoro. Aroro agwo tokagoka mono asare.
english: He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot-- come, let us rejoice in him.

ekegusii: Akarenta amagena ’embura ribaga ri’embura, chinkoba chikamesa aande onsi ase ense eria.
english: He turned their rain into hail, with lightning throughout their land;

ekegusii: Aroro aaria Omonene nigo aonchorete amache e chindooche akaba amanyinga, abanto tibanyara koyanywa.
english: He turned their rivers to blood; they could not drink from their streams.

ekegusii: He turned their waters into blood, causing their fish to die.
english: Akaonchora amache abo akaba amanyinga, na ayio akagera chinswe chiabo chigakwa.

ekegusii: Omonene akabatomera endamwamu yaye enene, na ekeririanda kiaye, na okogechigwa kwaye na emechando yonsi, ekeombe ekio ki’abamalaika b’ogosiria.
english: He unleashed against them his hot anger, his wrath, indignation and hostility-- a band of destroying angels.

ekegusii: Nigo agotoma okoruma okwo korwa igoro gocha ase ense yonsi; okomesa kwaye gwe chinkoba nigo kogochera chinsinyo chi’ense.
english: He unleashes his lightning beneath the whole heaven and sends it to the ends of the earth.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoa abwo bagokorerwa bobe oboronge bwabo, na abare nenchara nigo akobaa endagera. Omonene nigo agosibora abwo basibire.
english: He upholds the cause of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets prisoners free,

ekegusii: akabatebia ng’a basabe Nyasae ore igoro abarorere amabera, aborokie obobisi boria, erinde ere omonyene na baria bamwabo tibasirigwa amo nabanto baria abang’aini bande ba Babeli.
english: He urged them to plead for mercy from the God of heaven concerning this mystery, so that he and his friends might not be executed with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

ekegusii: Saulo akaganya Samweli amatuko atano na abere, buna Samweli konya amotebirie, na ekiagera Samweli atebanete abanto bagachaka goserebekana na gotiga Saulo.
english: He waited seven days, the time set by Samuel; but Samuel did not come to Gilgal, and Saul's men began to scatter.

ekegusii: Erio akaganya amatuko ande atano na abere, naende agatoma riruma riria korwa ase obwato.
english: He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.

ekegusii: Naende akaganya amatuko ande atano na abere, agatoma riruma riria, na rirorio tiriairana asare naende.
english: He waited seven more days and sent the dove out again, but this time it did not return to him.

ekegusii: Akabwatia chinchera chionsi chiria ise abwatetie. Agakorera emegwekano eria ise akorerete, na akayesasima.
english: He walked in all the ways of his father; he worshiped the idols his father had worshiped, and bowed down to them.

ekegusii: Ere nigo abwatetie chinchera chia Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, agakora ebibe buna ebiaye, boigo akagera Abaisraeli bakabikora. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akagechigwa, akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’emegwekano yabo bagosasima.
english: He walked in all the ways of Jeroboam son of Nebat and in his sin, which he had caused Israel to commit, so that they provoked the LORD, the God of Israel, to anger by their worthless idols.

ekegusii: Yehosafati akabwatia chinchera chia Asa ise, taonchogete na gochitiga. Agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene.
english: He walked in the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ahasia akaba omoko bw’enyomba y’Ahabu, na igo akabwatia chinchera chi’abanto b’enyomba yaye. Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, buna abanto b’enyomba y’Ahabu bakorete.
english: He walked in the ways of the house of Ahab and did evil in the eyes of the LORD, as the house of Ahab had done, for he was related by marriage to Ahab's family.

ekegusii: Akabwatia chinchera chi’abaruoti b’Abaisraeli, naende akaroisia emegwekano ya Baali yanyititoire na kobombwa akayesasima.
english: He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and also made cast idols for worshiping the Baals.

ekegusii: korende akabwatia chinchera chi’abaruoti b’Abaisraeli. Boigo agasamba omwana oye omomura akaba ekeng’wanso, koreng’ana nogokora gw’okogechia okwo abanto b’ebisaku banarete gokora, baria Omonene aseretie korwa ase Abaisraeli.
english: He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and even sacrificed his son in the fire, following the detestable ways of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Ere akanyuoma omoiseke bw’Ahabu, na buna abanto b’enyomba y’Ahabu bakorete, ere boigo akabwatia chinchera chi’abaruoti b’Abaisraeli. Agakora ayarenge amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for he married a daughter of Ahab. He did evil in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Akabwatia chinchera chi’abaruoti b’Abaisraeli, buna abanto b’enyomba y’Ahabu bakorete, ekiagera ere nigo anyuomete omoiseke o Ahabu. Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: He walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done, for he married a daughter of Ahab. He did evil in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akoba okoombogana korigia endagera, oboria: Ng’ai ere? Nigo amanyete ng’a rituko ri’omosunte riamoikeire ang’e.
english: He wanders about-- food for vultures; he knows the day of darkness is at hand.

ekegusii: Akarigia korora Yeso, gose monto ki; ko tanyara ase engencho y’omoganda, ekiagera arenge omweng’e.
english: He wanted to see who Jesus was, but being a short man he could not, because of the crowd.

ekegusii: Erio agatebia omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto, “Eatanane, nabasoroire, morue ase chiema chi’abanto aba abakori amabe. Timobaisa gokuna gento kende gionsi kiabo; moise kogekuna nigo mogochia gosirigwa ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bionsi.”
english: He warned the assembly, "Move back from the tents of these wicked men! Do not touch anything belonging to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins."

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge bw’ororeria rwa Peresi, na orenge omochiki bw’abatang’ani bonsi b’abarwani esegi ase omotienyi bwe ritang’ani.
english: He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army officers for the first month.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omonto omuya, oichire n’Omoika Omochenu na okwegena. Abanto abange bakamenteka ase Omonene.
english: He was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and faith, and a great number of people were brought to the Lord.

ekegusii: Nigo arenge omotwari ching’iti omokong’u, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ase ayio abanto nigo banarete goteba igoro y’omonto, “Nigo anga buna Nimurodi, omotwari ching’iti omokong’u, ase obosio bw’Omonene.”
english: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD; that is why it is said, "Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD."

ekegusii: Na Nikodemo oria omochierete botuko agwo ritang’ani, nere akagenda boigo, akarenta ebinto bisang’ananirie manemane na uudi, oborito bwaye chiratili rigana erimo.
english: He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.

ekegusii: Abanto aba bakagenda nere: Sopater Omoberoya, mosinto o Piro, Aristarko na Sekundo, abanto ba Tesaloniki, na Gayo, omonto o Deribe, na Timotheo, na abanto b’Asia, Tukiko na Torofimo.
english: He was accompanied by Sopater son of Pyrrhus from Berea, Aristarchus and Secundus from Thessalonica, Gaius from Derbe, Timothy also, and Tychicus and Trophimus from the province of Asia.

ekegusii: Ere akoboa, akabora, “Aa naase okoirokia! Aa takomocha koba enyomba ya Nyasae, aa nao egeita kia igoro.”
english: He was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven."

ekegusii: Boigo akaba nendamwamu ase abasani baria batato b’Ayubu, ekiagera batanyorete amang’ana bakoiraneria, nonya batebete ng’a Ayubu nomomochi.
english: He was also angry with the three friends, because they had found no way to refute Job, and yet had condemned him.

ekegusii: Akaroiserigwa embeera amo nechi’abakori amabe, korende gakure, agatindekwa ase abanda bagotindekwa, ekiagera takorete amabe, gose obong’ainereria tibwaruete ase omonwa oye.
english: He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death, though he had done no violence, nor was any deceit in his mouth.

ekegusii: Bakabogoria omobere oye ne chibarasi, bakayoira Yerusalemu, bakayotindeka aroro ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, ase Omochie o Daudi.
english: He was brought back by horse and was buried in Jerusalem with his fathers, in the City of David.

ekegusii: Bakabogoria omobere oye ne chibarasi, bakayoira ase Omochie o Daudi, bakamotindeka ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe.
english: He was brought back by horse and was buried with his fathers in the City of Judah.

ekegusii: Amoni agatindekwa ase embeera yaye ase omogondo o Usa; na Yosia, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: He was buried in his grave in the garden of Uzza. And Josiah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Abanto bakamotindeka agwo ase Omochie o Daudi, aase abaruoti barenge gotindekwa, ekiagera nigo akorete ayare amaya ase Abaisraeli, na ase Nyasae, na ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: He was buried with the kings in the City of David, because of the good he had done in Israel for God and his temple.

ekegusii: Ere igo amanyekanete korwa kare, ritang’ani ense etarabekwa oboroso, korende oorokigwe ase amatuko aya ay’omoerio ase engencho yaino.
english: He was chosen before the creation of the world, but was revealed in these last times for your sake.

ekegusii: kobwatekana nengencho y’obokuani, obomera bokamogwera asoe ase Hekalu y’Omonene asambe ubani.
english: he was chosen by lot, according to the custom of the priesthood, to go into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

ekegusii: oyoruetwe ase ogokwa ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, na akabokigwa ekiagera otorenteire oboronge.
english: He was delivered over to death for our sins and was raised to life for our justification.

ekegusii: Ere nigo achayetwe, akaangwa nabanto; ere nigo arenge omonto bw’obororo, naende onarete omoichano. Abanto nigo batubete amasio abo ng’a tibamorora; nigo achayetwe, naintwe tokamobara ng’a oyotagwenereti kende.
english: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, and familiar with suffering. Like one from whom men hide their faces he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

ekegusii: Ase baria Batato ere nigo abwate ogosikwa okuya goetania abande, akaba omoraai obo, korende tareng’anetie na baria Batato be ritang’ani.
english: He was doubly honored above the Three and became their commander, even though he was not included among them.

ekegusii: Nigo aseretigwe korwa ase mwanyabanto, na enkoro yaye ekaonchorwa ekaba buna eye ching’iti, akabetererigwa komenya amo ne chitigere chi’orosana na korisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe; omobere oye okanyirirerwa ne riime rikorwa igoro, goika ekereo amanyete ng’a Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono nere okogambera oboruoti bwa mwanyabanto, na nere okobeka onde bwensi anchire abe omogambi.
english: He was driven away from people and given the mind of an animal; he lived with the wild donkeys and ate grass like cattle; and his body was drenched with the dew of heaven, until he acknowledged that the Most High God is sovereign over the kingdoms of men and sets over them anyone he wishes.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge omwegenwa asare ere oyomochorete, buna Musa boigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae.
english: He was faithful to the one who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in all God's house.

ekegusii: Nyuma yaye Yairi Omogileadi akaimoka. Nere akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, na ebere.
english: He was followed by Jair of Gilead, who led Israel twenty-two years.

ekegusii: Ere oyio akaegwa okobua gw’okogamba, na obonene, na oboruoti, erinde abanto bonsi, na ebisaku, na abanto b’emenwa ao ao, bamokorere. Obogambi bwaye nobwa kare na kare, tibokoera, na oboruoti bwaye tibokobugwa.
english: He was given authority, glory and sovereign power; all peoples, nations and men of every language worshiped him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and his kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.

ekegusii: Ekaegwa ribaga kobekera omogwekano bw’eng’iti eria omoika, goika omogwekano oria okwane, na ogere abanto bonsi abatasasimete omogwekano oria bw’eng’iti baitwe.
english: He was given power to give breath to the image of the first beast, so that it could speak and cause all who refused to worship the image to be killed.

ekegusii: naende ekaegwa ribaga korwania abachenu na kobabua. Ekaegwa okobua igoro ya kera eamate, na abanto, na omonwa, na egesaku.
english: He was given power to make war against the saints and to conquer them. And he was given authority over every tribe, people, language and nation.

ekegusii: Oyio nigo arenge goeta ase enchera yarenge ang’e nekoona agwo ase omokungu oria omonyaka amenyete agechoba‐chobania gochia ase enyomba yaye
english: He was going down the street near her corner, walking along in the direction of her house

ekegusii: Akanyora ogosikwa okuya ase egati ya baria emerongo etato, korende tareng’anetie na Baria Batato be ritang’ani. Daudi akamobeka akaba omorendi bw’obogima bwaye.
english: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

ekegusii: Nonya osikire kobua baria Emerongo Etato, tareng’anirie na baria Batato. Daudi akamobeka akaba omoteneneri bw’abarendi b’obogima bwaye.
english: He was held in greater honor than any of the Thirty, but he was not included among the Three. And David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

ekegusii: Narenge nebuku enke yaigoire ase okoboko kwaye. Akabeka okogoro kwaye gw’okorio igoro ase enyancha na ogw’okobee igoro ase ense enyomo,
english: He was holding a little scroll, which lay open in his hand. He planted his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,

ekegusii: Naende nere orenge ase baria basangererekanete ase erooro amo nomomalaika oyokwanete nere ase egetunwa gia Sinai, naende amo ne chisokoro chiaito; nere oetwe amang’ana ’obogima atoe.
english: He was in the assembly in the desert, with the angel who spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers; and he received living words to pass on to us.

ekegusii: Nao arenge ase ense ime, ense egatongwa goetera asere, na abanto b’ense tibamomanya.
english: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.

ekegusii: Omonene akaba omoruoti o Yesuruni, ekero abatang’ani b’abanto basangererekanete amo nabanto b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.”
english: He was king over Jeshurun when the leaders of the people assembled, along with the tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: tari ase abanto bonsi, korende nasetore, abatwachoretwe na Nyasae tobe abarori. Intwe nigo tware koria na konywa amo nere nyuma y’okoboka kwaye.
english: He was not seen by all the people, but by witnesses whom God had already chosen-- by us who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi tancha koira Esanduku eria y’Omonene ase omochie okorokwa Omochie o Daudi, korende akayebogoria na koyebeka nyomba mwa’Obedi‐Edomu o Gati.
english: He was not willing to take the ark of the LORD to be with him in the City of David. Instead, he took it aside to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

ekegusii: Naki ere konya obarirwe amo naintwe, akanyora ensemo y’oboteneneri bwabo.
english: he was one of our number and shared in this ministry."

ekegusii: Agakorerwa bobe na gochandwa, nonya naboigo tamaanorete omonwa oye. Buna emanwa y’eng’ondi ekoirwa konyenywa, na buna eng’ondi etari kwana ase omonachi bw’amarionya, naboigo ere tamaanorete omonwa oye.
english: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet he did not open his mouth; he was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent, so he did not open his mouth.

ekegusii: Nigo arenge nemiaka ikomi na etano nomo ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka emerongo etano, na ebere, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Yekolia o Yerusalemu.
english: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother's name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Amasia agaita Abaedomu chilifu ikomi agwo ase Riranya ri’Enyancha y’Omonyo; akaira omochie o Sela ase okorwana esegi, akayoroka Yokiteli; naboigo okorokwa goika rero iga.
english: He was the one who defeated ten thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt and captured Sela in battle, calling it Joktheel, the name it has to this day.

ekegusii: Ekero Amasia, omoruoti araire ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, Asaria akaagacha Elati, naende akayoirania ase Abayuda.
english: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his fathers.

ekegusii: Erio nyuma Amasia omoruoti kararire ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, Usia akagitera omochie bw’Eloti chindwaki, akayoirania ase Abayuda.
english: He was the one who rebuilt Elath and restored it to Judah after Amaziah rested with his fathers.

ekegusii: Akairania orogongo rw’Abaisraeli korwa ase egesoero kia Hamati, goikera ase Enyancha y’Ekerubo Ekiomo koreng’ana buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atebete goetera ase omosomba oye Yona mosinto bw’Amitai, omobani oria orwete Gati-Heferi.
english: He was the one who restored the boundaries of Israel from Lebo Hamath to the Sea of the Arabah, in accordance with the word of the LORD, the God of Israel, spoken through his servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath Hepher.

ekegusii: Nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato, na ebere, ekero abete omoruoti, akagamba emiaka etano na etato, agwo Yerusalemu.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.

ekegusii: Nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na etano, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ikomi na etano nomo agwo Yerusalemu.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years.

ekegusii: Nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, na etano, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ikomi na etano nomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Yerusa, omosubati o Zadoki.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother's name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.

ekegusii: Nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, na etano, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka emerongo ebere, na kianda, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Abia, mosubati o Zakaria.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother's name was Abijah daughter of Zechariah.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na etano ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka emerongo ebere na kianda, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Yehoadini o Yerusalemu.
english: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-nine years. His mother's name was Jehoaddin; she was from Jerusalem.
