ekegusii: Igo arenge omong’aini kobua abanto bonsi, kobua Etani Omoezara, na Hemani, na Kalikoli, na Darida, basinto ba Maholi; ne chinkuma chiaye chikagenda goika ase ebisaku bionsi biamoetanaine.
english: He was wiser than any other man, including Ethan the Ezrahite-- wiser than Heman, Calcol and Darda, the sons of Mahol. And his fame spread to all the surrounding nations.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge amo na Daudi agwo Pasi‐Damimu ekero Abafilisti basangererekanete amo, barwane esegi aase omogondo bw’esairi orenge. Ekero abanto batamete korwa ase Abafilisti,
english: He was with David at Pas Dammim when the Philistines gathered there for battle. At a place where there was a field full of barley, the troops fled from the Philistines.

ekegusii: Oyio agwo omochakano nigo arenge amo na Nyasae.
english: He was with God in the beginning.

ekegusii: Agasibia chinyama chi’enda amo nebirenge, erio akabisambera amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase egesasimero.
english: He washed the inner parts and the legs and burned them on top of the burnt offering on the altar.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo igoro ase omenyete, nigo ogotweria ebitunwa embura, na ense nigo egoisaneka nokwama kw’emeremo yao.
english: He waters the mountains from his upper chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of his work.

ekegusii: akagenda akoyia amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, momura o Saulo, korwa ase abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi. (Abanto abwo konya baibire emebere eyio korwa ase ekeooreri agwo Bati‐Sani aase Abafilisti babasungete, aase rituko riria baitete Saulo aaria Giliboa.)
english: he went and took the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from the citizens of Jabesh Gilead. (They had taken them secretly from the public square at Beth Shan, where the Philistines had hung them after they struck Saul down on Gilboa.)

ekegusii: Naende akagenda eria kabere, agasaba, “Tata one, onye tekonyarekana egekombe eke keng’etere ntakenywereti, abe buna bwanchete aye.”
english: He went away a second time and prayed, "My Father, if it is not possible for this cup to be taken away unless I drink it, may your will be done."

ekegusii: akeonchora gochia ase abamwabo, akabatebia, “Omwana timonyoreti ase engoro. Ng’ai rende nkogenda?”
english: He went back to his brothers and said, "The boy isn't there! Where can I turn now?"

ekegusii: agatirimboka gochia ase enyomba y’omoruoti, agasoa ase eero y’omoriki. Aroro agwo nao abanene aba bonsi b’oboruoti barenge baikaransete: Elisama omoriki, na Delaya, mosinto o Semaya, na Elinatani, mosinto bw’Akibori, na Geramia, mosinto o Safani, na Zedekia, mosinto o Hanania, amo nabanene bonsi.
english: he went down to the secretary's room in the royal palace, where all the officials were sitting: Elishama the secretary, Delaiah son of Shemaiah, Elnathan son of Acbor, Gemariah son of Shaphan, Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the other officials.

ekegusii: Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agatenena aase aateremu, amo nomoganda bw’aborokigwa baye; na omoganda bw’abanto abaruete Boyahudi yonsi, na Yerusalemu, na engegu ya Turo na Sidoni, bagacha komoigwa na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.
english: He went down with them and stood on a level place. A large crowd of his disciples was there and a great number of people from all over Judea, from Jerusalem, and from the coast of Tyre and Sidon,

ekegusii: Agachia gosoa, akabatebia, “Naki mogokora riroroche na korera? Omwana takweti, korende nigo araire.”
english: He went in and said to them, "Why all this commotion and wailing? The child is not dead but asleep."

ekegusii: Agasoa nyomba, agasieka egesieri; ere na omwana boka bakaba nyomba ime. Erio Elisha agasaba Omonene,
english: He went in, shut the door on the two of them and prayed to the LORD.

ekegusii: Akagenda chinse chionsi chi’ensemo ya Yorodan, okorandia ebatiso y’okoonchoka ekorenta okwaberwa kw’ebibe.
english: He went into all the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.

ekegusii: Akabora, “Eke nakio gekogera nabatebia, ng’a omonto onde tari oranyare gocha asende, otatiga oeirwe na Tata one.”
english: He went on to say, "This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled him."

ekegusii: Agachaka gotebia abanto omoreng’anio oyo: “Omonto akarema omogondo, agasimeka emesabibu imeo, akaywatananera abaremi, akagenda orogendo ase engaki entambe.
english: He went on to tell the people this parable: "A man planted a vineyard, rented it to some farmers and went away for a long time.

ekegusii: Akabora “Ekegosoka korwa ase omonto nakio gekomobekera ogotacheneka.
english: He went on: "What comes out of a man is what makes him 'unclean.'

ekegusii: Ere akagenda korotota Asa, akamotebia, “Aye Asa, nainwe mwensi Abayuda na Ababenjamin, ntegerera moigwe! Omonene nigo are amo nainwe, ekero inwe more amo nere. Komoramorigie rirorio momonyore, korende komoramotige rirorio nere nabatige inwe.
english: He went out to meet Asa and said to him, "Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin. The LORD is with you when you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you, but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

ekegusii: Isaka nigo agendete mogondo ekero kia mogoroba, akaba ore nebirengererio. Agwo akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora chingamia chigocha.
english: He went out to the field one evening to meditate, and as he looked up, he saw camels approaching.

ekegusii: erinde arikwe amo na Mariamu, ekiagera omoriereire boko, na Mariamu nigo arenge morito.
english: He went there to register with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him and was expecting a child.

ekegusii: Agaeta ase Siiria na Kilikia, akabeka chikanisa chinguru.
english: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the churches.

ekegusii: Nabo akamoika ang’e, akamoboa chingoma chiaye, akamoaka amaguta na edivai; akamoriinia ase etigere yaye igoro, akamoira ase enyomba y’abageni, akamorwaria.
english: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put the man on his own donkey, took him to an inn and took care of him.

ekegusii: Yakobo akagenda ase ise, akamotebia, “Tata!” Nere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa. Naye ng’o, mwana one?”
english: He went to his father and said, "My father." "Yes, my son," he answered. "Who is it?"

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio akagenda nyomba mwa ise agwo Ofura, na igoro ase rigena erimo agaitera abamura bamwabo aroro, abana ba Yerubi‐Baali, emerongo etano na ebere. Yotamu bweka, omomura omoke kegima o Yerubi‐Baali, nere otigarete ore moyo. Ere konya bwebisire.
english: He went to his father's home in Ophrah and on one stone murdered his seventy brothers, the sons of Jerub-Baal. But Jotham, the youngest son of Jerub-Baal, escaped by hiding.

ekegusii: Akagenda Nazareti, aria ase arereretwe; na ase rituko ri’Esabato agasoa ase esinagogi yabo, buna engencho yaye yarenge, agatenena gosoma.
english: He went to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue, as was his custom. And he stood up to read.

ekegusii: Usia akagenda akarwania Abafilisti esegi; agatagora orwaki rwa Gati, na orwa Yabune, na orw’Asidodi. Akaagacha naende emechie ase orogongo rw’Asidodi na aande onsi ase egati y’Abafilisti.
english: He went to war against the Philistines and broke down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. He then rebuilt towns near Ashdod and elsewhere among the Philistines.

ekegusii: Yoabu agasuka gochia ang’e asare, na omokungu oria akamoboria, “Naye Yoabu?” Akairaneria, “Ee, ninche.” Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Tegerera amang’ana aane, inche omosomba oo omokungu.” Yoabu akairaneria, “Nintegererete.”
english: He went toward her, and she asked, "Are you Joab?" "I am," he answered. She said, "Listen to what your servant has to say." "I'm listening," he said.

ekegusii: na agatiira gochia ase enyomba y’Omonene, amo n’Abayuda bonsi na bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, na abakuani, na Abalawi, ee, abanto bonsi, abanene na abake. Na aroro omoruoti akabasomera amang’ana onsi arikire ase Ebuku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Ogotianania, yanyorekanete ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: He went up to the temple of the LORD with the men of Judah, the people of Jerusalem, the priests and the Levites-- all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Na omoruoti agatiira gochia ase enyomba y’Omonene amo n’Abayuda bonsi na abanto bonsi bamenyete Yerusalemu, na abakuani, na ababani, abanto bonsi, abake na abanene. Erio akabasomera amang’ana onsi aria arikire ase Ebuku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Ogotianania yanyorekanete ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: He went up to the temple of the LORD with the men of Judah, the people of Jerusalem, the priests and the prophets-- all the people from the least to the greatest. He read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant, which had been found in the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonto okoiraneria ring’ana atarariigwa buya, obwo noboriri asare, na nigo akonyora obosooku.
english: He who answers before listening-- that is his folly and his shame.

ekegusii: Oyore o Nyasae nigo akoigwa amang’ana a Nyasae; nakio gekogera inwe motari koyaigwa: nekiagera motari aba Nyasae.”
english: He who belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God."

ekegusii: Omonto okorenta emechando ase enyomba yaye nigo aranyore ayare buna embeo bosa; oyore omoriri nigo arabe omosomba bw’omonto ore nenkoro y’obong’aini.
english: He who brings trouble on his family will inherit only wind, and the fool will be servant to the wise.

ekegusii: Oria okoagacha chiero chiaye aaria igoro, na obeka obokumbe bwaye igoro y’ense na kobokong’ia, oria okorangeria amache ’enyancha, oyaumora igoro ase ense, Omonene nario erieta riaye.
english: he who builds his lofty palace in the heavens and sets its foundation on the earth, who calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out over the face of the land-- the LORD is his name.

ekegusii: Omonto obisete okogecha ime yaye nigo agokwana oborimo korwa ase omonwa oye, na oyo ogotaaria obogenki nigo are omoriri.
english: He who conceals his hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.

ekegusii: Omonto okobisa ebibe biaye tagosesenigwa, korende oyo okobiorokia na kobitiga narorerwe amabera.
english: He who conceals his sins does not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

ekegusii: Omonto okwabera aya akomocherwa nigo akorigia obwanchani, korende oria okona‐koinyora nigo agosarania abasani.
english: He who covers over an offense promotes love, but whoever repeats the matter separates close friends.

ekegusii: Oyoigete nere oyio ogendete boigo igoro ya igoro, erinde ebinto bionsi biichorwe nere.)
english: He who descended is the very one who ascended higher than all the heavens, in order to fill the whole universe.)

ekegusii: Omonto ogochaya omonto onde nigo agokora ebibe, korende oyokororera abachandegete amabera nasesenigwe.
english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who is kind to the needy.

ekegusii: Ere otarorerete Omwana oye amabera, korende akamorua ase engencho yaito intwe twensi, naki aramoche gotoa ebinto bionsi amo nere?
english: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all-- how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo agokunya eirima entambe, erio ogwa ere omonyene ase eirima eyio.
english: He who digs a hole and scoops it out falls into the pit he has made.

ekegusii: Oyotanyancheti, tabwateti amang’ana aane; naende ring’ana mwaigure tari eriane, korende neria Tata oyontomete.
english: He who does not love me will not obey my teaching. These words you hear are not my own; they belong to the Father who sent me.

ekegusii: Ere oyogokora ebibe noyo o Saitani, ekiagera Saitani nigo akorete ebibe korwa omochakano. Ekiagerete Omwana o Nyasae akaorokigwa neke, ng’a asarie emeremo ya Saitani.
english: He who does what is sinful is of the devil, because the devil has been sinning from the beginning. The reason the Son of God appeared was to destroy the devil's work.

ekegusii: Ere oyomenyete inse y’oborendi bw’Oyore Igoro Mono, na otimogete ase ekiriri ki’oyore Omobui,
english: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

ekegusii: Oyoragwe igoro ase rigena eri nabunanekane, na ere oyo rigena riria riragwere inarimosenyente.]”
english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed."

ekegusii: Oyo okomoiroka Omonene nigo are nogosemeria gw’okorendwa bokong’u, na abana baye mbanyore aase bagotamera.
english: He who fears the LORD has a secure fortress, and for his children it will be a refuge.

ekegusii: Omonto onyorire omokungu omuya, oyio onyorire ekeegwa ekiya na ay’ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene.
english: He who finds a wife finds what is good and receives favor from the LORD.

ekegusii: Nere otongete chinkoro chi’abanto bonsi, namanyete korenga ogokora kwabo gwonsi.
english: he who forms the hearts of all, who considers everything they do.

ekegusii: Rora, oria otongete ebitunwa na embeo, oria okoorokeria mwanyabanto ebirengererio biabo bamanya buna bire, oria okoonchora emambia yaba omosunte, oria ogoeta otacha ebitunwa bi’ense, Omonene Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nario erieta riaye.
english: He who forms the mountains, creates the wind, and reveals his thoughts to man, he who turns dawn to darkness, and treads the high places of the earth-- the LORD God Almighty is his name.

ekegusii: Omwana omomura ogosangereria chindagera engaki ye rigesa nigo are omong’aini, korende oyo okorara engaki eyio nigo akorenta obosooku.
english: He who gathers crops in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.

ekegusii: Omonto okonyora obong’aini, oyio nere obwanchire obogima bwaye, na oyo okorenda obomanyi bwaye nanyore amaya.
english: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul; he who cherishes understanding prospers.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokonya abataka takoremerwa, korende oyo ogotuba amaiso aye ng’a tarora abataka nanyore okoragererigwa okonge.
english: He who gives to the poor will lack nothing, but he who closes his eyes to them receives many curses.

ekegusii: Nigo bagosoka bakoiyeria amariga, babogoretie chimbusuro gochia kobusura mbairane bare nomochengo, babogoretie emesaima yabo bagesire.
english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with him.

ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyogokwana amang’ana ateriteti, goika asirigwe.
english: He who guards his lips guards his life, but he who speaks rashly will come to ruin.

ekegusii: Omonto orendete omonwa oye, na oromeme rwaye, oyio nigo etangerete emechando.
english: He who guards his mouth and his tongue keeps himself from calamity.

ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring’ana eri Omoika ogotebia chikanisa.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches.

ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring’ana eri Omoika ogotebia chikanisa. Ere oyorabue takonyora obororo bw’amakweri a kabere nonya ng’ake.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes will not be hurt at all by the second death.

ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring’ana eri Omoika ogotebia chikanisa. Ere oyorabue nimoe ensemo ya mana ebisire, naende nimoe rigena rirabu, na ase rigena erio ndirikireo erieta riyia, eritamanywe na monto onde otatiga ere oyo orariegwe.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone with a new name written on it, known only to him who receives it.

ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring’ana eri Omoika ogotebia chikanisa. Ere oyorabue nimoe ribaga arie amatunda ’omote bw’obogima, oyio ore ase Paradiso ya Nyasae.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes, I will give the right to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God.

ekegusii: Ere oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe ring’ana eri Omoika ogotebia chikanisa.”
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."

ekegusii: Omonto kare namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe:
english: He who has an ear, let him hear.

ekegusii: Omoibi taiba naende; mbuya akore emeremo ase omokia namaboko aye na gokora ayare amaya, erinde abe negento akomwatanera oyoremeire.
english: He who has been stealing must steal no longer, but must work, doing something useful with his own hands, that he may have something to share with those in need.

ekegusii: Nomonto oria obwate amaboko atari na komocha, na enkoro echenegete, noria otari gosasima chinyasae chi’oborimo, gose gotiana ase obong’ainereria.
english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear by what is false.

ekegusii: Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.
english: He who has ears, let him hear.

ekegusii: Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
english: He who has ears, let him hear."

ekegusii: He who has the Son has life; he who does not have the Son of God does not have life.
english: Ere oyore n’Omwana, nare nobogima; ere oyotari n’Omwana o Nyasae, tari nobogima.

ekegusii: Oyongechete inche, nigo amogechete na Tata one.
english: He who hates me hates my Father as well.

ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera ogokurerwa nigo abwatetie enchera egochia ase obogima, korende oyo okwanga koigwera ogokurerwa nigo agosira.
english: He who heeds discipline shows the way to life, but whoever ignores correction leads others astray.

ekegusii: Omonto okwanga koigwera amorokererio akomorongeyia, obotaka na obosooku nigo biramonyore, korende oyokoigwera ogokurerwa nanyore amasikani.
english: He who ignores discipline comes to poverty and shame, but whoever heeds correction is honored.

ekegusii: Omonto okwanga ogokurera, oyio nigo agochaya obogima bwaye omonyene, korende oyokoigwera ogokurerwa nigo akoba nokomanya.
english: He who ignores discipline despises himself, but whoever heeds correction gains understanding.

ekegusii: Omonto okomenta chinibo chiaye ase enchera etari ey’ekeene ase okogania ebitoki, oyio nigo agochisangereria chibe echi’omonto okororera abataka amabera.
english: He who increases his wealth by exorbitant interest amasses it for another, who will be kind to the poor.

ekegusii: Omonto oria oranyorwe obwate ebinto biria biragereirie, goika asambwe nomorero amo nebinto bionsi are nabio, ekiagera osaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwane inche Omonene, naende orentire obosooku obonene ase egati y’Abaisraeli.”
english: He who is caught with the devoted things shall be destroyed by fire, along with all that belongs to him. He has violated the covenant of the LORD and has done a disgraceful thing in Israel!'"

ekegusii: Omonto oigotete nigo agochaya nonya nobooke, korende oyore nenchara nonya nendagera ere endoro nigo ekomwansera.
english: He who is full loathes honey, but to the hungry even what is bitter tastes sweet.

ekegusii: Omonto okororera omotaka amabera, oyio nigo akorua singo ase Omonene, na Omonene namoakane ase ogokora okwo kwaye.
english: He who is kind to the poor lends to the LORD, and he will reward him for what he has done.

ekegusii: Omonyabibe nigo aichire nobobe, nigo are inda nogosaria na koibora oborimo.
english: He who is pregnant with evil and conceives trouble gives birth to disillusionment.

ekegusii: Nyasae, oyore Obonene bw’Abaisraeli, tagokwana oborimo, gose takweitia. Ere tari mwanyabanto erinde eitie.”
english: He who is the Glory of Israel does not lie or change his mind; for he is not a man, that he should change his mind."

ekegusii: Omonene oria ore egetari kia Yakobo tagwekaini emegwekano eyio. Ere nere otongete ebinto bionsi. Abaisraeli nigo bare egesaku kere omwando oye; Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye.
english: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including Israel, the tribe of his inheritance-- the LORD Almighty is his name.

ekegusii: Korende oyore egetari o Yakobo tagwekaini emegwekano eyio; nere otongete ebinto bionsi. Abaisraeli nigo bare egesaku ki’omwando oye; Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye.”
english: He who is the Portion of Jacob is not like these, for he is the Maker of all things, including the tribe of his inheritance-- the LORD Almighty is his name.

ekegusii: Omwana orendete amachiko nigo are omong’aini, korende oyore omogisangio bw’abaria bobe nigo akorenta obosooku ase ise.
english: He who keeps the law is a discerning son, but a companion of gluttons disgraces his father.

ekegusii: Omonto ogosiria abare ne chinkoro chindonge, na kobaraa ase enchera ende, oyio nagwe ase eirima eria aremire ere omonyene, korende abwo batari na komocha mbanyore omwando omuya.
english: He who leads the upright along an evil path will fall into his own trap, but the blameless will receive a good inheritance.

ekegusii: Omonto ogotegerera na koigwera ogokurerwa gokorenta obogima namenye amo nabanto abang’aini.
english: He who listens to a life-giving rebuke will be at home among the wise.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akorigereria ense, nero yatengecha, nigo agokuna ebitunwa, na birobio biasokia erioki.
english: he who looks at the earth, and it trembles, who touches the mountains, and they smoke.

ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete enkoro echenegete, na ebikoba biaye bigokwana ayare ay’obuya, omoruoti nabe omosani oye.
english: He who loves a pure heart and whose speech is gracious will have the king for his friend.

ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete eriomana nigo anchete ogosaria, na oyokoimokereria egesieri kiaye igoro nigo akwerigeria ogosirigwa.
english: He who loves a quarrel loves sin; he who builds a high gate invites destruction.

ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete emegoko goika abe omotaka; na oyobwanchete kwegokia nedivai na amaguta takoba omonda.
english: He who loves pleasure will become poor; whoever loves wine and oil will never be rich.

ekegusii: Omonto ogochecheria omotaka nigo agochaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oyio, na oyokogokera emechando yanyorire abande, takomocha konyora egesusuro.
english: He who mocks the poor shows contempt for their Maker; whoever gloats over disaster will not go unpunished.

ekegusii: Omonto orendete amachiko, oyio nigo arendete obogima bwaye, korende oyo otari korenda chinchera chiaye nigo arakwe.
english: He who obeys instructions guards his life, but he who is contemptuous of his ways will die.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokorera omotaka bore nigo agochaya Omotongi bw’omotaka oyio, korende oyore omwororo ase oria oremeire nigo asigete Omotongi.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for their Maker, but whoever is kind to the needy honors God.

ekegusii: Ere oyo ogokorera abataka bobe ase ogwetenenkia ere omonyene, gose okorua ebiegwa ase abanda, goika aremerwe.
english: He who oppresses the poor to increase his wealth and he who gives gifts to the rich-- both come to poverty.

ekegusii: He who overcomes will inherit all this, and I will be his God and he will be my son.
english: Ere oyorabue nanyore omwando oyo, na inche nimbe Nyasae oye, na ere nabe omwana one.

ekegusii: Ere oyorabue nabekerwe chianga chindabu, na inche tingotinyia erieta riaye korwa ase ebuku y’obogima nonya ng’ake, naende ninyatore erieta riaye ase obosio bwa Tata one, na ase obosio bw’abamalaika baye.
english: He who overcomes will, like them, be dressed in white. I will never blot out his name from the book of life, but will acknowledge his name before my Father and his angels.

ekegusii: He who plots evil will be known as a schemer.
english: Ere oyokoroberia gokora amabe narokwe omonto okorenta emechando.

ekegusii: Omonene agachaya abanene baria babachandete, bakaba bakoong’anya ase chirooro chitari ne chinchera.
english: he who pours contempt on nobles made them wander in a trackless waste.

ekegusii: He who pursues righteousness and love finds life, prosperity and honor.
english: Omonto okorigia oboronge na obwororo, oyio nanyore obogima, na amasikani, na oboronge.

ekegusii: Omonto okwerua koba intenenera ase omonto omoao nigo agwesoyia ase emechando, korende oyo okwanga koba intenenera nigo erendete buya.
english: He who puts up security for another will surely suffer, but whoever refuses to strike hands in pledge is safe.

ekegusii: Omonto ogotogonyera oyo oiranire nyuma ase okomorongeyia nanyore ogwancherwa kobua oria okomong’aina namang’ana amansu.
english: He who rebukes a man will in the end gain more favor than he who has a flattering tongue.

ekegusii: Ere oyokorenda rituko, nigo akorirenda ase Omonene, na ere oyokoria, nigo akoria ase Omonene, ekiagera nigo agoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono; ere oyotari koria, nigo agokora bo ase Omonene, na aakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono.
english: He who regards one day as special, does so to the Lord. He who eats meat, eats to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and he who abstains, does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God.

ekegusii: Omwana ore omotindi ase ise na ogoseria ng’ina, nigo akorenta obosooku na ogochaya.
english: He who robs his father and drives out his mother is a son who brings shame and disgrace.

ekegusii: Omonto okoura ise gose ng’ina enibo yabo, erio oteba, “Ebi tibiri ebibe,” oyio nigo are omogisangio bw’oyogosiria.
english: He who robs his father or mother and says, "It's not wrong"-- he is partner to him who destroys.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi okong’iraneria ng’a mbuya mono, okwo nakwo ekeng’wanso ki’ogonsika, na onde bwensi okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge, oyio nimorentere ogotooreka kwane inche Nyasae.”
english: He who sacrifices thank offerings honors me, and he prepares the way so that I may show him the salvation of God."

ekegusii: Omonto ogochaya Ring’ana nigo arasirigwe narirorio, korende oyokoiroka ogochika nanyore eng’eria y’obuya.
english: He who scorns instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command is rewarded.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokora omokia korigia ayare amaya, oyio nigo akonyora ayare amaya, korende oyokorigia ay’obobe, obobe nigo bokomonyora.
english: He who seeks good finds goodwill, but evil comes to him who searches for it.

ekegusii: Nabe negesio omonto oyio ogochia koira abana baino abake na kobaakera ase amagena ’Ebitare.
english: he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.

ekegusii: Oyogosimeka obobe, nagese ogosareka, na enyimbo y’endamwamu yaye nigo erasire bosa.
english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

ekegusii: Omonto okorina omwana oye ekeranya nigo amogechete, korende oyo omwanchete tari gotebana okomorongeyia.
english: He who spares the rod hates his son, but he who loves him is careful to discipline him.

ekegusii: Oyogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti nigo akweagacha ere omonyene; korende oyokobana nigo akoagacha ekanisa.
english: He who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the church.

ekegusii: Ere oyogokwana ase okobua kwaye omonyene nigo akorigia obonene bwaye omonyene; korende ere oyokorigia obonene bw’oria omotomete, nigo are oyo bw’ekeene, na asare obong’ainereria tiboiyo.
english: He who speaks on his own does so to gain honor for himself, but he who works for the honor of the one who sent him is a man of truth; there is nothing false about him.

ekegusii: Omonto okorenda omoko narie okwama kw’omoko oyio, na oyio okorenda omonene oye, oyio nanyore ogosikwa.
english: He who tends a fig tree will eat its fruit, and he who looks after his master will be honored.

ekegusii: Ere oyokorenta oborori obo, nigo agoteba, “Ee, ninchiche bwango!” Amina. Inchuo Omonene Yeso!
english: He who testifies to these things says, "Yes, I am coming soon." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.

ekegusii: Oyobwesemeretie ere omonyene, oyio nomoriri, korende oyo okobwatia obong’aini natoorigwe.
english: He who trusts in himself is a fool, but he who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

ekegusii: Ere oyokong’a oboronge bwane nigo are ang’e nainche. Onye nabo, ning’o oranyare koamererania nainche? Tiga ache totenene amo. Oyo ogonsoera, ng’ai are? Tiga ache ang’e nainche.
english: He who vindicates me is near. Who then will bring charges against me? Let us face each other! Who is my accuser? Let him confront me!

ekegusii: Omonto okobwatia oboronge na gokwana amang’ana ’oboronge, oyio ogechete okonyora kw’ogokorera abande bobe na otangete amaboko aye tabwata riaaki, oyio otichete amato aye tabaisa koigwa amang’ana igoro y’ogoitera amanyinga, naende otari korigereria amang’ana ’obobe,
english: He who walks righteously and speaks what is right, who rejects gain from extortion and keeps his hand from accepting bribes, who stops his ears against plots of murder and shuts his eyes against contemplating evil--

ekegusii: Omonto ogotaara nabanto abang’aini nigo arabe omong’aini, korende oyo ogosanga nabariri nanyorwe namabe.
english: He who walks with the wise grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

ekegusii: Na ere oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene agateba, “Rora, nakorire onsi koba amayia.” Agantebia, “Rika aya, ekiagera amang’ana aya nay’obwegeni na ay’ekeene.”
english: He who was seated on the throne said, "I am making everything new!" Then he said, "Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true."

ekegusii: Omonto ogosimera amaiso ase okogenka nigo akorenta emechando, na oyogokwana amang’ana atagwenereti nigo arasirigwe.
english: He who winks maliciously causes grief, and a chattering fool comes to ruin.

ekegusii: Omonto ogosimera ebioge bi’amaiso aye nigo akoroberia amabe, na oyo ogotakuna omonwa oye nigo agoikerania amabe.
english: He who winks with his eye is plotting perversity; he who purses his lips is bent on evil.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo ase omogondo oye nanyore endagera enyinge, korende oyo okobwatia amang’ana atagwenereti, oyio tamanyeti kende.
english: He who works his land will have abundant food, but he who chases fantasies lacks judgment.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo ase omogondo oye nanyore endagera enyinge, korende oyokobwatia emeroberio etagwenereti nigo arabe omotaka omorabu se.
english: He who works his land will have abundant food, but the one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

ekegusii: Nomonto oria orogendo rwaye rore oroikeranu, oria ogokora kwaye kore okuya, na amang’ana agokwana korwa ase enkoro yaye nay’ekeene,
english: He whose walk is blameless and who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from his heart

ekegusii: Omonto otari na komocha ase chinchera chiaye natoorigwe; korende oyore omokorekanu ase chinchera chiaye nasire ase eyemo y’echio.
english: He whose walk is blameless is kept safe, but he whose ways are perverse will suddenly fall.

ekegusii: Omonto omoirogete Omonene nigo akobwatia enchera y’oboronge, korende oyo omochayete nigo are omokorekanu ase chinchera chiaye.
english: He whose walk is upright fears the LORD, but he whose ways are devious despises him.

ekegusii: “Boigo nasoe ase ense eria engiya, nasirie chinse chinyinge, korende Abaedomu na Abamoabu, na abanto abange b’Abaamoni, barabwo mbatoorigwe korwa ase okoboko kwaye.
english: He will also invade the Beautiful Land. Many countries will fall, but Edom, Moab and the leaders of Ammon will be delivered from his hand.

ekegusii: Ere nasakore chinyasae chiabo, na emegwekano yabo bagosasima ebombire, na ebikorero biabo ebiya biroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu, abiire Misiri. Erio ase emiaka emeke natige korwania omoruoti o sugusu.
english: He will also seize their gods, their metal images and their valuable articles of silver and gold and carry them off to Egypt. For some years he will leave the king of the North alone.

ekegusii: Erio ekero morabe mogosimeka chimbusuro chiaino, Omonene nachitwerie embura, erinde chindagera chiaino chiame, nainwe monyore chindagera chinyinge chingiya. Ekero ekio chitugo chiaino nchinyore amarisio amagare.
english: He will also send you rain for the seed you sow in the ground, and the food that comes from the land will be rich and plentiful. In that day your cattle will graze in broad meadows.

ekegusii: Ase ogokonywa kw’enyasae engeni nekorere chiburi chinkong’u buna anchete. Abanto baria baranche ng’a nomogambi are, nabae obonene bw’ogosikwa. Nababeke babe abagambi igoro ase abanto abange na nabaatananere ense ebe eng’eria yabo.
english: He will attack the mightiest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him. He will make them rulers over many people and will distribute the land at a price.

ekegusii: “Aye nobe nomogoko na ogosasoka, na abanto abange nabagokere okoiborwa kwaye,
english: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice because of his birth,

ekegusii: naende nabe omoika bw’ogokora ayare ay’ekeene ase abwo bakogamba ekina, naende nabe chinguru chiabo abwo bagoseria ababisa agwo ase egeita.
english: He will be a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, a source of strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arabe buna etigere y’orosana ase egati y’abanto, na okoboko kwaye nigo korabe igoro y’abanto bonsi, na amaboko ’abanto bonsi nigo arabe igoro yaye; ere nigo aramenye bosio bw’abamwabo bonsi.”
english: He will be a wild donkey of a man; his hand will be against everyone and everyone's hand against him, and he will live in hostility toward all his brothers."

ekegusii: “Oyio nabe omonene, narokwe Omwana bw’Oyore Igoro Mono; na Omonene Nyasae namoe ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi sokoro yaye;
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

ekegusii: Naki nabekwe ase amaboko ’abanto b’Ebisaku, nakorerwe echeche, na gokorerwa bobe, na gotwerwa amate;
english: He will be handed over to the Gentiles. They will mock him, insult him, spit on him, flog him and kill him.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo anga buna egetutu ki’erooro kiomire, takorora amang’ana ande onsi amaya akomochera. Namenye aase aomo agwo ase erooro, ase ense ere nomonyo etamenyiri na onde.
english: He will be like a bush in the wastelands; he will not see prosperity when it comes. He will dwell in the parched places of the desert, in a salt land where no one lives.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo anga buna omote osimekire ase orooche mbarabare, na emeri yaye nigo ekoranda gochia ase orooche ime. Omote oyio tori kwoboa eguru‐gura, ekiagera amato aye nigo akogenderera koba amabese; tori gochandeka ase engencho y’eguru‐gura, tori gotiga kwama okwama kwaye.
english: He will be like a tree planted by the water that sends out its roots by the stream. It does not fear when heat comes; its leaves are always green. It has no worries in a year of drought and never fails to bear fruit."

ekegusii: Oyio nigo arabe buna omosabibu okoarora amasabibu ataratoba, na buna omozeituni okoarora ebisicha biaye.
english: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree shedding its blossoms.

ekegusii: Ere tiga aike korwa igoro buna embura egotwa ase obonyansi oborere, na buna omonyirira ogotwa igoro ase riroba.
english: He will be like rain falling on a mown field, like showers watering the earth.

ekegusii: Ase chingaki chiaino Omonene nabae oborendi obuya, na obonge bw’ogotooreka, na obong’aini, na okomanya; okomoiroka Omonene nakwo korabe enibo yaino.
english: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a rich store of salvation and wisdom and knowledge; the fear of the LORD is the key to this treasure.

ekegusii: Ere nabe nokobua okonene mono, korende tari ase chinguru chiaye ere omonyene. Narente ogosiria okonene gw’okoondokia, nabue ase kende gionsi arakore. Nasirie abanto bare nokobua amo nabanto abachenu.
english: He will become very strong, but not by his own power. He will cause astounding devastation and will succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy the mighty men and the holy people.

ekegusii: Ere nasesenie bonsi abamoirogete, nasesenie abake na abanene.
english: he will bless those who fear the LORD-- small and great alike.

ekegusii: Natagore emerobiri emetambe y’ogwekengera ere ase chindwaki chiabo, nayeiyerie inse kegima, ee, negwe inse ase riroba.
english: He will bring down your high fortified walls and lay them low; he will bring them down to the ground, to the very dust.

ekegusii: He will bring glory to me by taking from what is mine and making it known to you.
english: Ere nambake inche, ekiagera nabogorie ayare ayane, nabayaorokerie.

ekegusii: Naende abarentere amarwaire onsi buna aria arenterete Abamisiri, ayio moirogete, naro nagenderere kobeera asemore.
english: He will bring upon you all the diseases of Egypt that you dreaded, and they will cling to you.

ekegusii: He will bring you a message through which you and all your household will be saved.'
english: Nere oragotebie amang’ana ayarakorentere ogotooreka, aye na ab’enyomba yao yonsi.

ekegusii: na kobairania gochia ase ense eria chisokoro chiaino chiairete ekaba eyabo, erio nainwe moyeire ebe eyaino. Ere nabakorere amaya, naende ababuchie mobe abange goetania chisokoro chiaino.
english: He will bring you to the land that belonged to your fathers, and you will take possession of it. He will make you more prosperous and numerous than your fathers.

ekegusii: Ere nabe okorera asende na goteba; Aye naye Tata, naye Nyasae one, na Egetare kiane ki’ogotooreka.
english: He will call out to me, 'You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior.'

ekegusii: Ekero arandangerie, inche nimoitabere, inche nigo inde amo nere ase engaki y’emechando. Nimotoorie, naende nimoe ogosika.
english: He will call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.

ekegusii: Ase obong’aini bwaye bw’obong’ainereria nagenderere konyora okobua ase kende gionsi arakore, na ase ebirengererio biaye ere omonyene nekinie na koenena. Naite abanto abange mobosokano batakureiri. Naimokerere igoro koamererania n’Omogambi bw’abagambi. Erio nasenyentwe, korende tari nokoboko kwa mwanyabanto.
english: He will cause deceit to prosper, and he will consider himself superior. When they feel secure, he will destroy many and take his stand against the Prince of princes. Yet he will be destroyed, but not by human power.

ekegusii: Ere nache aake ense ya Misiri, erio abanto bagochia goitwa noborwaire bogoita, baitwe naborobwo; na abagochia gwoswa bairwe; na abagochia goitwa nemioro, baitwe nero.
english: He will come and attack Egypt, bringing death to those destined for death, captivity to those destined for captivity, and the sword to those destined for the sword.

ekegusii: Nachiche asirie abaremi baria, na omogondo oria bw’emesabibu nayoe abande.” Bagachia koigwa aya, bakabora, “Taba bo.”
english: He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others." When the people heard this, they said, "May this never be!"

ekegusii: Ere nakore okobwatana ogokong’u kw’ogotianania nabanto abange ase echuma eyemo; na ase egati‐gati y’echuma eyio nakoore ebing’wanso na okoruegwa gwonsi tibiruegwa naende. Oyokorenta obobe bw’okogechia nigo arache okoiruruka gosiria. Ayio nigo aragenderere goika egesusuro ki’ogosirigwa achikeretwe korwa kare geikeranigwe.”
english: He will confirm a covenant with many for one 'seven.' In the middle of the 'seven' he will put an end to sacrifice and offering. And on a wing [of the temple] he will set up an abomination that causes desolation, until the end that is decreed is poured out on him."

ekegusii: Ere nagotube namarionya aye, ase chimbaba chiaye ime nonyore obotamero. Obwegenwa bwaye nenguba na eng’aya asore.
english: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

ekegusii: He will cut down the forest thickets with an ax; Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One.
english: Naimokie egesire agechere emete ye rinani rire rinoru, na Lebanoni amo nemete ereo neiyerigwe inse ne chinguru chi’Oyore Omobui.

ekegusii: ere namonachane abe ebing’ese namobeke amo nabang’ainereria. Aroro abanto mbabe nekerero na okoriania amaino.
english: He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

ekegusii: Tiga omoruoti abe okorwanerera abataka, na atoorie abana b’abaremeire, korende asenyente abanto bagokorera abande bobe.
english: He will defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; he will crush the oppressor.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agotooria omonto ore nokomocha, omonto buna oyio nigo aratoorigwe goetera ase amaboko ao achenegete.”
english: He will deliver even one who is not innocent, who will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands."

ekegusii: “Omoruoti oyio o sugusu nakore omoroberio, ache nokobua kw’oboruoti bwaye bwonsi, Natoeme gokora okobwatana nomoruoti o irianyi ase okomoa omoiseke oye abe mokaye, erinde asarie oboruoti boria kegima, korende amang’ana ayio tagosesenigwa, gose komokonya ere omonyene.
english: He will determine to come with the might of his entire kingdom and will make an alliance with the king of the South. And he will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom, but his plans will not succeed or help him.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arakwe, ekiagera angete ogokurerwa, na ase engencho y’oboriri bwaye obonene nasire.
english: He will die for lack of discipline, led astray by his own great folly.

ekegusii: korende aase airetwe obosomba, nao arakwere, gose takoirana gocha aa ase ense ayerore naende.”
english: He will die in the place where they have led him captive; he will not see this land again."

ekegusii: He will direct the blows of his battering rams against your walls and demolish your towers with his weapons.
english: Natege egekorero ki’ogotagorera chindwaki chiao achisarie, natagore emerobiri y’ogotengera nebisire biaye.

ekegusii: Nabe okonywa amache ’ensoko ekero are ase orogendo rwaye, ase ayio naimokererie omotwe oye igoro kabuire.
english: He will drink from a brook beside the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

ekegusii: He will eat curds and honey when he knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right.
english: Ekero omwana oyio arabe omanyire kwanga amabe na gochora amaya, nabe okoria amaguta ’amabeere na obooke.

ekegusii: Abanto mbakoiroke, koreng’ana buna erioba na omotienyi bigendererete kobao, ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: He will endure as long as the sun, as long as the moon, through all generations.

ekegusii: Narambore okoboko kwaye asirie chinse chinyinge, na ense ya Misiri tegotooreka.
english: He will extend his power over many countries; Egypt will not escape.

ekegusii: Nabe nokobua igoro ye chikungo chie chitahabu ne chifeta, na igoro y’ebinto bie rigori rinene bia Misiri. Abanto ba Libia na ab’Etiopia mbabe bakobwatia chimbaratero chiaye.
english: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and all the riches of Egypt, with the Libyans and Nubians in submission.

ekegusii: Nabeke abaruoti babo ase amaboko aino, erio mobaite na kobasiria nonya namarieta abo tainyorwa ase ense. Omonto onde tari, nonya noyomo, oranyare korwana nainwe na kobabua; goika mobasirie kegima.
english: He will give their kings into your hand, and you will wipe out their names from under heaven. No one will be able to stand up against you; you will destroy them.

ekegusii: “Narende amagoro ’abegenwa baye, korende abakori amabe nigo barasirigwe ase omosunte, onde tari orabue ase chinguru chiaye ere omonyene.
english: He will guard the feet of his saints, but the wicked will be silenced in darkness. "It is not by strength that one prevails;

ekegusii: Takwoboa amang’ana amabe akoigwa, enkoro yaye nigo ere endemu esemeretie Omonene.
english: He will have no fear of bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

ekegusii: Ere nigo aratindekwe buna etigere egotindekwa. Nigo arakururwe atugutwe isiko y’ebiita bia Yerusalemu.”
english: He will have the burial of a donkey-- dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem."

ekegusii: “Oyio obeire omenyete ase emechie yasaretigwe agwo ase chinyomba chitamenyiri nonde, echio konya chiarurwe ase ogosarigwa chibe amatombe.
english: he will inhabit ruined towns and houses where no one lives, houses crumbling to rubble.

ekegusii: ere goika akwe, asangerereke ase chisokoro chiaye chire, echio chitarore oborabu naende.
english: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light [of life].

ekegusii: Erio Omonene nanache ekina ase egati y’abanto abange, nagambie boronge ebisaku bire ne chinguru bimenyete aare. Abanto mbature emioro yabo y’esegi ebe amakombe, na amatimo abo abe emeyio chinkuro. Egesaku ekemo tigekoimoka korwania ekende, gose abanto tibakweorokereria korwana esegi nonya ng’ake.
english: He will judge between many peoples and will settle disputes for strong nations far and wide. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene nanache ekina ase egati y’ebisaku, nae abanto abange oboronge bwabo, barabwo mbature emioro yabo ebe amakombe akorema, na amatimo abo abe emeyio chinkuro; egesaku tigekoimokera egesaku kende nemioro, gose abanto tibakweorokereria korwana esegi naende.
english: He will judge between the nations and will settle disputes for many peoples. They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not take up sword against nation, nor will they train for war anymore.

ekegusii: Nanachere abanto b’ebisaku ekina, ense neichore nebitondo; nasenyente emetwe y’abagambi b’ense engima.
english: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.

ekegusii: Nigo aragambie ense ase oboronge na konachera abanto ekina gi’ekeene atari gwanchereria.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness; he will govern the peoples with justice.

ekegusii: Erio amanye konachera abanto bao ebina bi’oboronge na gokora ekeene ase abataka.
english: He will judge your people in righteousness, your afflicted ones with justice.

ekegusii: Nere orabakong’ie goika omoerio, erinde timocha koba nokomocha ase rituko riria ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: He will keep you strong to the end, so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe nebinto ebinge barabae inwe singo, korende inwe nigo moraremerwe, timokoba nebinto morabae singo. Barabwo mbabe ab’omotwe, na inwe mobe ab’ekemincha.
english: He will lend to you, but you will not lend to him. He will be the head, but you will be the tail.

ekegusii: Ere nabanche na kobasesenia, nabamentekanie. Boigo nasesenie oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, na okwama kw’emegondo yaino, na endagera yaino, na edivai yaino, na amaguta aino ay’amazeituni; chiombe chiaino chimentekane, amo ne ching’ondi ne chimbori chiaino, ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabayee.
english: He will love you and bless you and increase your numbers. He will bless the fruit of your womb, the crops of your land-- your grain, new wine and oil-- the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks in the land that he swore to your forefathers to give you.

ekegusii: Omonene naorokie oboronge bwao buna akoorokia oborabu, na ekeene kiao buna amasase a mobaso gati.
english: He will make your righteousness shine like the dawn, the justice of your cause like the noonday sun.

ekegusii: Oyio takoirana gocha mwaye, na aase aye taakomonyora naende.
english: He will never come to his house again; his place will know him no more.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio takoba omonda, obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera kobao, gose tibokobucha ase ense.
english: He will no longer be rich and his wealth will not endure, nor will his possessions spread over the land.

ekegusii: He will not accept any compensation; he will refuse the bribe, however great it is.
english: Ere tagwancha embooria ende yonsi, naegwa ebiegwa ebinge takobiancha.

ekegusii: Ere tari kona‐gotogonyera ase chingaki chionsi, gose takogenderera kogacha endamwamu yaye botambe.
english: He will not always accuse, nor will he harbor his anger forever;

ekegusii: Ere takwegokia ase okorora chindooche, chindooche chiichire namooke na amaguta ’amabeere.
english: He will not enjoy the streams, the rivers flowing with honey and cream.

ekegusii: Tagotooreka korwa ase omosunte; omorero mbwomie emeseboka egoseboka, ere omonyene nasire ase omoika bw’Omonene.
english: He will not escape the darkness; a flame will wither his shoots, and the breath of God's mouth will carry him away.

ekegusii: Ere takorosa gose gokwa omoyo; goika abe orentire oboronge ase ense na kobokong’ia, na ebisinka, ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha nchibe chiganyete amachiko aye.”
english: he will not falter or be discouraged till he establishes justice on earth. In his law the islands will put their hope."

ekegusii: Ere tagotiga okogoro kwao gotererigwe; oyokorendete tagosundoka.
english: He will not let your foot slip-- he who watches over you will not slumber;

ekegusii: Korende Farao takobaigwa. Inche nindambore okoboko kwane igoro y’Abamisiri na kobaa ebisusuro ebinene, na nindusie emeganda yane, abanto baane Abaisraeli, korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
english: he will not listen to you. Then I will lay my hand on Egypt and with mighty acts of judgment I will bring out my divisions, my people the Israelites.

ekegusii: Takwomana, gose tagoaka eriogi; nonya nomonto takoigwa eriogi riaye ase chinchera chinene.
english: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear his voice in the streets.

ekegusii: Ere takorera, gose tagoaka eriogi rinene, gose takoritiga riigugwe ase chinchera.
english: He will not shout or cry out, or raise his voice in the streets.

ekegusii: Ere nomoengereria, omweimokereria igoro omonyene, igoro ya kera egekorokwa Nyasae, na ekegosasimwa. Naende nigo agoikaransa ase Hekalu ya Nyasae, okweraria omonyene ng’a nere Nyasae.
english: He will oppose and will exalt himself over everything that is called God or is worshiped, so that he sets himself up in God's temple, proclaiming himself to be God.

ekegusii: goika asire kare na kare, buna obonyira bwaye bogosira. Abwo bamoroche mbaborie; Omonto oria, ng’ai are?
english: he will perish forever, like his own dung; those who have seen him will say, 'Where is he?'

ekegusii: Natenenie eema yaye y’oboruoti ebe ase egati y’enyancha na egetunwa keria egechenu ki’obonene. Korende nonya naboigo naikere omoerio oye, na monto onde tari oramokonye.
english: He will pitch his royal tents between the seas at the beautiful holy mountain. Yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.

ekegusii: na kobaakana egesiomba abwo batamomanyeti Nyasae, na bataigwereti enchili y’Omonene oito Yeso.
english: He will punish those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.

ekegusii: Mobetwe chinsara chinyoge chi’omorwani etuoni, na mosambwe nomorero bw’amakara ’omote okorokwa omoretemu.
english: He will punish you with a warrior's sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom tree.

ekegusii: Ching’ondi nachibeke ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, korende chimbori ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.
english: He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.

ekegusii: Natenenie ekemanyererio ase abanto b’ebisaku, na asangererie Abaisraeli abwo baseretigwe, naende asangererie Abayuda bonsi besiarerete ase chinsinyo inye chi’ense.
english: He will raise a banner for the nations and gather the exiles of Israel; he will assemble the scattered people of Judah from the four quarters of the earth.

ekegusii: Omoruoti oyio naite nemioro abanto b’emechie yao emeke ere ase ense yao. Ere nigo araagache orwaki rw’ogwekengera rogoetanane, na areme eburi bosio bwao, naende aagache ekerama kebe eng’aya agwekengera.
english: He will ravage your settlements on the mainland with the sword; he will set up siege works against you, build a ramp up to your walls and raise his shields against you.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nonyore ogosesenigwa korwa ase Omonene; boigo nanyore oboronge korwa ase Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwaye.
english: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from God his Savior.

ekegusii: Nere oragotimokie, abe chinguru chiao abe ogokorageria ase obogotu bwao. Moka momura oo nigo agwanchete; ere ogokoreire amaya kobua abamura batano na babere, na bono oiboire omwana oyio.”
english: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and who is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth."

ekegusii: Ere nabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, na abasirie ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo; ee, Omonene, Nyasae oito, nabasirie kegima.
english: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them for their wickedness; the LORD our God will destroy them.

ekegusii: Nigo akobooria emioyo yabo korwa ase abachandi babo na korwa ase obotindi. Amanyinga abo nigo are nengencho enene asare.
english: He will rescue them from oppression and violence, for precious is their blood in his sight.

ekegusii: Nabe okoigwa ogosaba kw’abanto batigirwe bosa, tagochaya ogosorora kwabo.
english: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their plea.

ekegusii: Nigo arakoborongose buna omopira, akorute gochia ase ense ere engare; agwo nao orakwere. Naende nao chigari chiao chi’obonene chirabe, ekiagera aye kwabeire omonto bw’obosooku ase enyomba y’omonene oo.
english: He will roll you up tightly like a ball and throw you into a large country. There you will die and there your splendid chariots will remain-- you disgrace to your master's house!

ekegusii: Tiga omoruoti abe okogamba korwa ase enyancha eyemo goika eyende, na korwa ase orooche rw’Eufarati goika ase ensinyo y’ense.
english: He will rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

ekegusii: 'He will rule them with an iron scepter; he will dash them to pieces like pottery'--just as I have received authority from my Father.
english: ere nabagambere nenyimbo y’okobua y’ekioma, na kobaata buna chinyongo.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo nigo arakane atebe: “Inche tindi omobani, korende nigo inde omoremi, ekiagera korwa obwana bwane nigo nagoretwe ngakorwa omosomba.
english: He will say, 'I am not a prophet. I am a farmer; the land has been my livelihood since my youth.'

ekegusii: Erio naborie: Ng’ai chinyasae chiabo chire? Egetare ekio basemeretie na kogetamera, ng’ai kere?
english: He will say: "Now where are their gods, the rock they took refuge in,

ekegusii: Ere natongie chihekalu chie chinyasae chiria. Ase enchera eyio nachene ense ya Misiri buna omorisia akorusia chinda chire ase eanga yaye akwambara. Nebukadinesaro gakoorire gokora ayio, nairane ase ense yaye nomorembe.
english: He will set fire to the temples of the gods of Egypt; he will burn their temples and take their gods captive. As a shepherd wraps his garment around him, so will he wrap Egypt around himself and depart from there unscathed.

ekegusii: Omoruoti oria tagosika chinyasae chie chisokoro chiaye, gose eye abakungu banchete, gose enyasae ende yonsi, ekiagera neimokererie igoro ase chionsi.
english: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers or for the one desired by women, nor will he regard any god, but will exalt himself above them all.

ekegusii: He will show you a large upper room, all furnished. Make preparations there."
english: Omonto oria naborokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo karoisirie; agwo mwariganie.”

ekegusii: Na ere omonyene naborokie akanyomba akanene ka irongo igoro, karoisigwe kabeire ang’e; agwo motoroiserie.”
english: He will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there."

ekegusii: Ere naikaranse buna oyo ogosamba na gosibia chifeta. Ere nachene Abalawi, abasibie buna chitahabu ne chifeta chigosibigwa, erinde banyare korua ebing’wanso bi’oboronge ase Omonene.
english: He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; he will purify the Levites and refine them like gold and silver. Then the LORD will have men who will bring offerings in righteousness,

ekegusii: Ere nakwane amang’ana are mamincha y’Oyore Igoro Mono, naende narosie abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono na kobachanda; narengererie koonchora ebiro, na amachiko. Abachenu mbabekwe ase okoboko kwaye ase ekero ekemo, na ebiro bibere, na ekeng’ese gi’ekero.
english: He will speak against the Most High and oppress his saints and try to change the set times and the laws. The saints will be handed over to him for a time, times and half a time.

ekegusii: Nere orabe ogokwana nabanto ribaga riao; ere abe omokwani oo, na aye obe ribaga ria Nyasae asare.
english: He will speak to the people for you, and it will be as if he were your mouth and as if you were God to him.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nagenderera gosesenigwa, na ororeria rwaye ndoire ense.
english: He will spend his days in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akomera chinibo, naende ochiroka; Nyasae nigo agochiseria korwao.
english: He will spit out the riches he swallowed; God will make his stomach vomit them up.

ekegusii: Ekero oyio oraiborwe arache, narisie riicho riaye ore ne chinguru chi’Omonene, ee, narisie nobonene bw’erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oye. Riicho riaye ndibe rirendire buya, ekiagera bono ere nabe omonene goika chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense.
english: He will stand and shepherd his flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD his God. And they will live securely, for then his greatness will reach to the ends of the earth.

ekegusii: Omonene narambore okoboko kwaye gochia sugusu asirie Abaasuri; nasirie na Nineva obe bosa, na ayuomie obe erooro.
english: He will stretch out his hand against the north and destroy Assyria, leaving Nineveh utterly desolate and dry as the desert.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo aranyunyunte obosongo bw’eng’iti nomonwa, na obosongo bokorwa ase oromeme rw’eng’iti eria mbomoite.
english: He will suck the poison of serpents; the fangs of an adder will kill him.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nasirie amakweri goika kare na kare, natinyie amariga korwa ase amaiso ’abanto bonsi, nasirie ogochaywa kw’abanto baye korwa ase ense yonsi. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: he will swallow up death forever. The Sovereign LORD will wipe away the tears from all faces; he will remove the disgrace of his people from all the earth. The LORD has spoken.

ekegusii: Naende arusie ensemo ya ikomi y’amaicho aino, nainwe abanyene mobe abasomba baye.
english: He will take a tenth of your flocks, and you yourselves will become his slaves.

ekegusii: Narusie ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase rigesa riaino ri’emegondo y’endagera, na ey’emesabibu, ayee abwo bakomorenda, na abasomba baye.
english: He will take a tenth of your grain and of your vintage and give it to his officials and attendants.

ekegusii: Nigo are omwororo ase omoremerwa na ase omotaka, boigo nigo agotooria emioyo y’abaremeire.
english: He will take pity on the weak and the needy and save the needy from death.

ekegusii: He will take the best of your fields and vineyards and olive groves and give them to his attendants.
english: Naire na emegondo yaino y’endagera, na ey’emesabibu, na ey’emezeituni eyere emiya mono, ayee abasomba baye.

ekegusii: He will take your daughters to be perfumers and cooks and bakers.
english: Naire abaiseke baino bachie koba abaroisia amaguta akweakwa, abande babe bakoruga endagera na koroisia emegati.

ekegusii: Oyio naire Zedekia Babeli, nere agenderere komenya aroro goika inche Omonene imochiere. Namoisa korwania Abakalidayo timokobabua. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: He will take Zedekiah to Babylon, where he will remain until I deal with him, declares the LORD. If you fight against the Babylonians, you will not succeed.'"

ekegusii: Nigo arasibe etigere yaye ase omote bw’omosabibu, na emori y’etigere yaye ase chinsagia chi’omosabibu omuya. Nigo arasibie egetambaa kiaye akwambara nedivai, ne chianga chiaye namache amonyinga ’amasabibu.
english: He will tether his donkey to a vine, his colt to the choicest branch; he will wash his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

ekegusii: Ere nairanie chinkoro chi’abaise gochia ase abana babo, na echi’abana gochia ase abaise, erinde ekero ndache timbaisa goaka ense eye nokoragererigwa.”
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to their children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers; or else I will come and strike the land with a curse."

ekegusii: Nasirie abanto abwo ase engencho y’amang’ana amabe bagokwana; bonsi abarabe bakobarora mbasingisie emetwe yabo ase ogoichana.
english: He will turn their own tongues against them and bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.

ekegusii: Ere natinyie kera ririga korwa ase amaiso abo; amakweri takobao nonya ng’ake, nonya nokweumia, gose okorera, gose obororo tibikobao, ekiagera amang’ana e ritang’ani aikire goeta.”
english: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the old order of things has passed away."

ekegusii: Ekeene, nagoichorie namaseko, na omonwa oo otere nomochengo.
english: He will yet fill your mouth with laughter and your lips with shouts of joy.

ekegusii: Ageatanana korwa asebare, ekerengo gi’okoruta rigena, akabeka amaru inse, agasaba,
english: He withdrew about a stone's throw beyond them, knelt down and prayed,

ekegusii: Naende nigo aratange okoboko kwaye takorera oyochandegete bobe, na abe tari koboria ebitoki gose kwementera egento, korende nigo arendete amachiko aane na kobwatia emeroberio yane echikire. Oyio tagokwa ase engencho y’ebibe bia ise, korende ekeene, goika abe moyo.
english: He withholds his hand from sin and takes no usury or excessive interest. He keeps my laws and follows my decrees. He will not die for his father's sin; he will surely live.

ekegusii: He won over the hearts of all the men of Judah as though they were one man. They sent word to the king, "Return, you and all your men."
english: Abayuda bonsi bagancha amang’ana a Daudi mono, bakamotomera amang’ana ng’a airane amo nabasomba baye bonsi.

ekegusii: Nigo ambarerete okoragererigwa buna egoti yaye akwambara; bono tiga konywere ase omobere oye buna amache akonywera ase omobere, na buna amaguta akweakwa akonywera aika ase amauga aye.
english: He wore cursing as his garment; it entered into his body like water, into his bones like oil.

ekegusii: He would crush me with a storm and multiply my wounds for no reason.
english: Ere ong’akire nomwaga ore nomoubera, na omentire amaote aane ngencho ende etaiyo.

ekegusii: Ase kera rituko Abisalomu nigo anarete koimoka mambia chuni, otenena enchera ensemo ase egeita ki’omochie. Na ekero omonto onde bwensi are gocha ore ne ring’ana akoira ase omoruoti agamberwe, Abisalomu omorangeria gocha asare, omoboria, “Aye mochie ki kwarwa?” Ekero omonto oyio amoiraneirie nase gesaku ki ki’Abaisraeli arwa,
english: He would get up early and stand by the side of the road leading to the city gate. Whenever anyone came with a complaint to be placed before the king for a decision, Absalom would call out to him, "What town are you from?" He would answer, "Your servant is from one of the tribes of Israel."

ekegusii: Tang’eti ribaga nkoeyanera, korende omenteire obororo obonge mono.
english: He would not let me regain my breath but would overwhelm me with misery.

ekegusii: omosomba oria aba ogosoyia euma eria ime ase esuguria, gose enyongo, gose ase gento kende enyama ekoiyekerwa ime yaye, ne chinyama chionsi arenge korusia neuma eria nigo chiarenge koirerwa omokuani. Naboigo abakuani abwo barenge gokorera Abaisraeli bonsi barenge gocha agwo Silo.
english: He would plunge it into the pan or kettle or caldron or pot, and the priest would take for himself whatever the fork brought up. This is how they treated all the Israelites who came to Shiloh.

ekegusii: Onye mogokora ogwanchereria ekero more ase obobisi, Omonene goika abatogonyere.
english: He would surely rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.

ekegusii: Aye nigo bwetubete oborabu buna ogwetuba egetambaa gi’okwambara, kwaramboire igoro buna eema eramboire.
english: He wraps himself in light as with a garment; he stretches out the heavens like a tent

ekegusii: Ere nigo aochanetie amache amo, akayaboerania amare amanetu ime; na amare ayio tari gotandoka.
english: He wraps up the waters in his clouds, yet the clouds do not burst under their weight.

ekegusii: Igoro y’amang’ana ayio arikire ase amarube aye onsi. Imeo nare amang’ana ande ayare amakong’u koyamanya, ayio abanto batorokereretigwe buya na batateneini bokong’u bakoonchorana, buna bakoonchorana amariko ande, na igo bakwerentera ogosira.
english: He writes the same way in all his letters, speaking in them of these matters. His letters contain some things that are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

ekegusii: He wrote a letter as follows:
english: Akarika rirube iga:

ekegusii: ere nanywe edivai y’endamwamu ya Nyasae yaroisigwe, etasang’aniri kende, ase egekombe ki’endamwamu yaye. Naende nachandwe nomorero na ekebiriti ase amasio ’abamalaika abachenu, na ase obosio bw’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi.
english: he, too, will drink of the wine of God's fury, which has been poured full strength into the cup of his wrath. He will be tormented with burning sulfur in the presence of the holy angels and of the Lamb.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ingwenie, nainche ningwene; intoorie, nainche nintooreke, ekiagera naye ngotogia.
english: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me and I will be saved, for you are the one I praise.

ekegusii: Mogwenie abarwaire abareo, batebie: Oboruoti bwa Nyasae bwabaikeire ang’e.
english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, 'The kingdom of God is near you.'

ekegusii: Abarwaire bagwenie, abakure babokie, abare noborwaire bwa ukoma basibie, na ebirecha birusie. Mwaeirwe bosa, nainwe karue bosa.
english: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse those who have leprosy, drive out demons. Freely you have received, freely give.

ekegusii: Inwe igwa, motegerere; timobaisa koenena, ekiagera Omonene nere okwanire.
english: Hear and pay attention, do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.

ekegusii: Inyigwe na ong’iranerie; inche nigo nkona‐korera na kweumia inde nobororo.
english: hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught

ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’ogosaba kwane, ekero nkorera asore onkonye, ekero ndamborete amaboko aane igoro gocha ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.
english: Hear my cry for mercy as I call to you for help, as I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

ekegusii: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
english: Nyasae, igwa ogosaba kwane; tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane ngokwana.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, igwa ogosaba kwane, tegerera onyigwe, aye Nyasae o Yakobo.
english: Hear my prayer, O LORD God Almighty; listen to me, O God of Jacob. Selah

ekegusii: Omonene, tegerera oigwe ogosaba kwane, igwa ekerero ki’ogosorora kwane.
english: Hear my prayer, O LORD; listen to my cry for mercy.

ekegusii: Omonene, igwa eriogi riane ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nokogamba kwao.
english: Hear my voice in accordance with your love; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your laws.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oigwe okorera kwane, indorere amabera na oiranerie ogosaba kwane.
english: Hear my voice when I call, O LORD; be merciful to me and answer me.

ekegusii: “Bono tegerera moigwe amang’ana ngwekwanera, naende tegerera moigwe ogosorora gokorwa ase omonwa one.
english: Hear now my argument; listen to the plea of my lips.

ekegusii: Naende Musa agakwana, “Inwe Abaisraeli, bono igwera amachiko na emeroberio nkoborokereria, moyakore, erio nario morabe moyo, erinde mogende moire ense eria, Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, agochia kobaa.
english: Hear now, O Israel, the decrees and laws I am about to teach you. Follow them so that you may live and may go in and take possession of the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, is giving you.

ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe okwoga kore ase omochie ime. Igwa eriogi rikorwa ase Hekalu! Erio neriogi ri’Omonene ekero akoa ababisa baye egesusuro.
english: Hear that uproar from the city, hear that noise from the temple! It is the sound of the LORD repaying his enemies all they deserve.

ekegusii: Igwa eriogi ri’okorera kw’abarisia, na okobokia kw’amagombo kw’abanene be riicho. Omonene osaririe oborisia bwabo.
english: Hear the cry of the shepherds, the wailing of the leaders of the flock, for the LORD is destroying their pasture.

ekegusii: Naende aye oigwe okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo inche, omosomba oo, na okw’abanto bao Abaisraeli ekero bagosaba barigereretie aase aiga. Ee, oigwe aye korwa igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore, na ekero okoigwa bwabere.
english: Hear the supplication of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and when you hear, forgive.

ekegusii: Naende aye oigwe okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, inche omosomba oo, na okw’abanto bao Abaisraeli ekero bagosaba barigereretie aase aiga. Ee, oigwe aye korwa igoro agwo ase obomenyo bwao bore, na ekero okoigwa bwabere.
english: Hear the supplications of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place. Hear from heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo ne chiamate chionsi chi’Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: Hear the word of the LORD, O house of Jacob, all you clans of the house of Israel.

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti bw’Abayuda oikaransete ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi, aye amo nabasomba bao, na abanto bao mogosoera ebiita ebi, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: 'Hear the word of the LORD, O king of Judah, you who sit on David's throne-- you, your officials and your people who come through these gates.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene, ekiagera obeeigwe nabamenyete ase ense eye: “Obwegenwa gose obwanchani tibori aroro, na abanto b’ense eye tibamomanyeti Nyasae.
english: Hear the word of the LORD, you Israelites, because the LORD has a charge to bring against you who live in the land: "There is no faithfulness, no love, no acknowledgment of God in the land.

ekegusii: Inwe abagambi ba Sodomu, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene! Inwe abanto ba Gomora, tegerera moigwe amorokererio a Nyasae oito!
english: Hear the word of the LORD, you rulers of Sodom; listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

ekegusii: Inwe aba mokoiguswa ase ring’ana ri’Omonene, igwa ring’ana riaye: “Abamino ababagechete na kobaseria ase engencho y’erieta riane batebire iga: Tiga Omonene aegwe obonene, erinde torore omogoko oino. Korende barabwo abanyene mbasookigwe.
english: Hear the word of the LORD, you who tremble at his word: "Your brothers who hate you, and exclude you because of my name, have said, 'Let the LORD be glorified, that we may see your joy!' Yet they will be put to shame.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya Omonene akwanire igoro yaino, ee, igoro y’egesaku eke gionsi narusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri:
english: Hear this word the LORD has spoken against you, O people of Israel-- against the whole family I brought up out of Egypt:

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa amang’ana ’okorera kwane gw’okobokia amagombo ase engencho yaino:
english: Hear this word, O house of Israel, this lament I take up concerning you:

ekegusii: Igwa ring’ana eri inwe chiombe chia Basani, inwe abamomenyete ase Egetunwa gia Samaria, inwe abamochandete abataka na gokorera abaremeire bobe, inwe abamogotebia abasacha baino: “Torentere egento tonywe!”
english: Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy and say to your husbands, "Bring us some drinks!"

ekegusii: Inwe abagaaka, igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe abanto bonsi abamomenyete ase ense eye, tegerera moigwe! Inee! Amang’ana buna aya anagokorekana ase amatuko aino, gose ase amatuko e chisokoro chiaino?
english: Hear this, you elders; listen, all who live in the land. Has anything like this ever happened in your days or in the days of your forefathers?

ekegusii: Inwe abanto abariri motari nobong’aini, igwa amang’ana aya, mobwate amaiso, ko timori korora, mobwate amato, ko timori koigwa.
english: Hear this, you foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear:

ekegusii: Inwe abatang’ani b’abanto ba Yakobo, abagambi b’Abaisraeli, igwa amang’ana aya! Inwe nigo mogechete ayare ay’ekeene, na mogokorekania onsi ayare amaronge;
english: Hear this, you leaders of the house of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel, who despise justice and distort all that is right;

ekegusii: Inwe aba mokourereria abaremeire na gosiria abataka bare ase ense, igwa amang’ana aya.
english: Hear this, you who trample the needy and do away with the poor of the land,

ekegusii: Ngasaba, “Aye Nyasae oito, igwa buna twachayirwe. Tiga ogochaya kwabo kobairanere, baurwe ebinto biabo, nabarabwo abanyene boswe bairwe ase obosomba.
english: Hear us, O our God, for we are despised. Turn their insults back on their own heads. Give them over as plunder in a land of captivity.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa amang’ana Omonene agoteba.
english: Hear what the LORD says to you, O house of Israel.

ekegusii: Aye ense, igwa! Naama! Nkorenta inde obobe igoro ase abanto aba, obobe obwo bore okwama kw’emeroberio yabo emebe, ekiagera bangire koigwa amang’ana aane; na ogochika kwane bakwangire.
english: Hear, O earth: I am bringing disaster on this people, the fruit of their schemes, because they have not listened to my words and have rejected my law.

ekegusii: Inwe igoro, na aye ense, tegerera moigwe, ekiagera Omonene okwanire, ogoteba: “Abana nabeire nkorera na kobakinia basaririe asende.
english: Hear, O heavens! Listen, O earth! For the LORD has spoken: "I reared children and brought them up, but they have rebelled against me.

ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe, monyare koyarenda; erio nario erabe buya asemore, naende momentekane mono ase ense eria entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, buna Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, abarierete eira.
english: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to obey so that it may go well with you and that you may increase greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, promised you.

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe! Ase rituko ria rero mwabeire ang’e kwamboka Yorodan kogenda koira ense y’ebisaku bire ebinene mono, naende bire ne chinguru kobabua. Emechie yabo nemenene, naende egiteire chindwaki chintambe gochia igoro.
english: Hear, O Israel. You are now about to cross the Jordan to go in and dispossess nations greater and stronger than you, with large cities that have walls up to the sky.

ekegusii: “Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera moigwe! Omonene, Nyasae oito, nere bweka Omonene.
english: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is one.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyigwe, ondorere amabera! Omonene, inkonye!
english: Hear, O LORD, and be merciful to me; O LORD, be my help."

ekegusii: “Inwe ebitunwa, nainwe ebitare, ninwe more oboroso bw’ense, tegerera moigwe ogosoera kw’Omonene! Ere nabwate amang’ana nabanto baye, nare nekina n’Abaisraeli.
english: Hear, O mountains, the LORD's accusation; listen, you everlasting foundations of the earth. For the LORD has a case against his people; he is lodging a charge against Israel.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, igwa amang’ana aya! Aye ense na ebinto bionsi bireo, tegerera moigwe amang’ana aya! Omonene Nyasae, oyore ase Hekalu yaye enchenu, tiga abe kirori igoro yaino.
english: Hear, O peoples, all of you, listen, O earth and all who are in it, that the Sovereign LORD may witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

ekegusii: Korende Abafarisai, ekero bachia koigwa ng’a Yeso obakiririe Abasadukai, bagasangererekana amo.
english: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.

ekegusii: Abafilisti bagachia koigwa amariogi aria agoakwa bakaborania, “Ninki engencho y’ogoakwa kw’amariogi ayio amanene ase egetwori ki’Abaibirania?” Ekero banyorete amang’ana ng’a n’Esanduku y’Omonene yarentirwe ase egetwori,
english: Hearing the uproar, the Philistines asked, "What's all this shouting in the Hebrew camp?" When they learned that the ark of the LORD had come into the camp,

ekegusii: Hearing this, Jesus said to Jairus, "Don't be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed."
english: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, erio akamoiraneria, “Toiroka; egene rioka, ere nagwenigwe.”

ekegusii: Igoro na ense nabiete, korende amang’ana aane takonyara goeta nonya ng’ake.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

ekegusii: Heber was the father of Japhlet, Shomer and Hotham and of their sister Shua.
english: Heberi nere orenge ise Yafileti, na Someri, na Hotamu, na ise omoiseke omwabo Sua.

ekegusii: Helebu, mosinto o Baana, korwa Netofa, na Itai, mosinto o Ribai, korwa Gibea, bw’egesaku kia Benjamin.
english: Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin,

ekegusii: Helesi korwa Peleti, na Ira, mosinto o Ikesi, korwa Tekoa;
english: Helez the Paltite, Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa,

ekegusii: Helkath and Rehob, together with their pasturelands-- four towns;
english: na Helikati, na Rehobo, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, inkonye! Intoorie, ekiagera aye nigo obwate amabera amange!
english: Help me, O LORD my God; save me in accordance with your love.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase engencho y’obonene bw’erieta riao, tokonye; naende ase engencho y’erieta riao otoboorie, otwabere ebibe biaito!
english: Help us, O God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name's sake.

ekegusii: Hemani na Yedutuni nigo bagachete ebirombeta ne chisani chiarenge kwoga ekero chiare goakanigwa, amo nebinto binde biare kobugigwa ekero amatera amachenu agoterwa. Abanto b’eamate ya Yedutuni bagachorwa korenda egeita.
english: Heman and Jeduthun were responsible for the sounding of the trumpets and cymbals and for the playing of the other instruments for sacred song. The sons of Jeduthun were stationed at the gate.

ekegusii: Heferi korwa Mekera na Ahiya korwa Peloni
english: Hepher the Mekerathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

ekegusii: Erio Abisalomu omwabo akamoboria, “Inee! Amunoni omino nagokoreire amang’ana ’obosooku? Aye moiseke ominto, kirakiri; oyio noyomino, toichana ase enkoro yao. Tamari akamenya bw’Abisalomu omwabo, akaba otang’ang’ete na goichana mono.”
english: Her brother Absalom said to her, "Has that Amnon, your brother, been with you? Be quiet now, my sister; he is your brother. Don't take this thing to heart." And Tamar lived in her brother Absalom's house, a desolate woman.

ekegusii: Abana baye nigo bakoboka bamoroka “Oyosesenirie”, naboigo nomosacha oye nigo akomotogia, oteba:
english: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her:

ekegusii: Amagoro aye nigo akoraa gochia ase amakweri, na amatambokero aye araa gochia aase abakure.
english: Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.
