ekegusii: Ngoika ririri ense erabe ekorera, na obonyansi bw’ebitii bobe bogendererete kwoma? Ching’iti ne chinyoni chiasirigwe ase engencho y’obobe bw’abanto bamenyeteo, abwo bagoteba: “Omonene takorora amatuko aito ay’omoerio.”
english: How long will the land lie parched and the grass in every field be withered? Because those who live in it are wicked, the animals and birds have perished. Moreover, the people are saying, "He will not see what happens to us."

ekegusii: Omonene, ngoika ririri abanyabibe barag nderere gwetogia? Ngoika ririri?
english: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked be jubilant?

ekegusii: Inee! Ngoika ririri oborimo boragenderere koba ime ase chinkoro chi’ababani abwo bakobana obong’ainereria bwe chinkoro chiabo?
english: How long will this continue in the hearts of these lying prophets, who prophesy the delusions of their own minds?

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe mwensi, ngoika ririri moragenderere korwania omonto ore bweka, erinde momoakere inse, inwe mwensi amo, buna nigo are enyasi ere ang’e kogwa na orwaki rwatandokire?
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down-- this leaning wall, this tottering fence?

ekegusii: Aye omworo, ngoika ririri oragenderere korara? Ndiriri oraboke korwa ase chitoro chiao?
english: How long will you lie there, you sluggard? When will you get up from your sleep?

ekegusii: Ngoika ririri oragenderere konakoong’anya, aye omoiseke one otari omwegenwa? Omonene natonge ring’ana riyia ase ense, omokungu nabe okorenda omosacha.”
english: How long will you wander, O unfaithful daughter? The LORD will create a new thing on earth-- a woman will surround a man."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri ndabe nkorera ng’a onkonye, naye tori konyigwa? Gose ngoika ririri ndabe ngokorangeria ase engencho y’obotindi, naye tori gontooria?
english: How long, O LORD, must I call for help, but you do not listen? Or cry out to you, "Violence!" but you do not save?

ekegusii: Aye Omonene ngoika ririri oragenderere koba nendamwamu asetore? Inee! Ribero riao, ngoika ririri rigochia gwoka buna omorero?
english: How long, O LORD? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri oragenderere kwebisete? Inee! Ngoika ririri endamwamu yao eragenderere gwoka buna omorero?
english: How long, O LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?

ekegusii: Inwe mwanyabanto, ngoika ririri moragenderere korentera obonene bwane echayo? Ngoika ririri moragenderere gwancha amang’ana a bosa na korigia ay’oborimo?
english: How long, O men, will you turn my glory into shame? How long will you love delusions and seek false gods? Selah

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naki ogokora kwao kore okonene! Okwo gwonsi nigo okogokora nobong’aini, ense nigo eichire nebitongwa biao.
english: How many are your works, O LORD! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

ekegusii: How many wrongs and sins have I committed? Show me my offense and my sin.
english: Amamocho aane, na ebibe biane, mbirenga bire? Imanyie ogosaria kwane, na ebibe biane.

ekegusii: Naki nanga yare gocha koba buya rituko ria rero, onye abanto mbabete ne ribaga ri’okoria na koigota ase ebisakorwa basakorete korwa ase ababisa babo. Nanga nigo twabua Abafilisti mono kobua.”
english: How much better it would have been if the men had eaten today some of the plunder they took from their enemies. Would not the slaughter of the Philistines have been even greater?"

ekegusii: Konyora obong’aini, ayio namaya kobua konyora etahabu, na okoba nobomanyi nigo kogwenerete kobua koba nefeta.
english: How much better to get wisdom than gold, to choose understanding rather than silver!

ekegusii: Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio onga buna rikonde; na mwanyabanto oyio onga buna enyongore?”
english: how much less man, who is but a maggot-- a son of man, who is only a worm!"

ekegusii: Onye nabo, naki rende ase omonto oyio ogokora ay’okogechia na gosaria, oyio okonywa ebibe buna amache?
english: how much less man, who is vile and corrupt, who drinks up evil like water!

ekegusii: “Nonya kogoteba ng’a tori komorora, ere tagokoigwa; ekina kiao nigo kere ase obosio bwaye, bono nigo omoganyete nogosemeria.
english: How much less, then, will he listen when you say that you do not see him, that your case is before him and you must wait for him,

ekegusii: Inee! Naki moroche? Omonto oria otachete Omwana o Nyasae, na kobara amanyinga ’okobwatana, achenetwe naro, koba egento kia bosa, oria okoreire Omoika bw’amabera obogechi, tiyamogwenerete ere anyore egesusuro ekenene kobua?
english: How much more severely do you think a man deserves to be punished who has trampled the Son of God under foot, who has treated as an unholy thing the blood of the covenant that sanctified him, and who has insulted the Spirit of grace?

ekegusii: Onye naboigo, naki rende arasemerie abwo bamenyete ase chinyomba chi’amaroba, abwo amaroso abo abekire ase riroba? Barabwo nigo bagoakwa na komionogorwa buna ebigwankwa.
english: how much more those who live in houses of clay, whose foundations are in the dust, who are crushed more readily than a moth!

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto tabueti rigori ri’eng’ondi? Ase igo mboronge gokora amaya ase rituko ri’Esabato.”
english: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath."

ekegusii: Inee! Tari bobe mono kobua, ekero abanto ababe baitire omonto omoronge karaire borere nyomba mwaye? Tinkomoruseria egesiomba na gosiria abwo bamoitire korwa ase ense?”
english: How much more-- when wicked men have killed an innocent man in his own house and on his own bed-- should I not now demand his blood from your hand and rid the earth of you!"

ekegusii: tari mono kobua amanyinga a Kristo, ere ase Omoika o kare na kare akerua ere omonyene ase Nyasae koba ekeng’wanso getari na komocha, anyare gochena okomanya gwe chinkoro chiaito ime korwa ase emeremo ekwete, erinde tokorere Nyasae ore moyo?
english: How much more, then, will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself unblemished to God, cleanse our consciences from acts that lead to death, so that we may serve the living God!

ekegusii: Gose barabwo nkoirurukigwa bare buna chimboba, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga?
english: How often are they like straw before the wind, like chaff swept away by a gale?

ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinyinge nigo babete bagosaria ase Omonene agwo ase erooro; bakaba bakomoichania aroro agwo.
english: How often they rebelled against him in the desert and grieved him in the wasteland!

ekegusii: Naki amang’ana ’ekeene agwansa! Korende amang’ana ayio aino ay’obong’ainereria, inki agokonya?
english: How painful are honest words! But what do your arguments prove?

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ebirengererio biao nigo bire ebikong’u asende kobimanya, naende nebinge mono bitanyare kobareka.
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, O God! How vast is the sum of them!

ekegusii: Nyasae, naki obwanchani bwao bwa botambe bore obonene! Mwanyabanto nigo bagotamera ekiriri gie chimbaba chiao.
english: How priceless is your unfailing love! Both high and low among men find refuge in the shadow of your wings.

ekegusii: Rirorio nanga nabuete ababisa babo bwango, na okoboko kwane nkoba kware mamincha yabo.
english: how quickly would I subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes!

ekegusii: Inee, naki intwe toranyare gwetooria onye twangire ogotooreka okonene buna oko? Ritang’ani Omonene nararetie ogotooreka oko, naende baria bamoigwete batobereire kirori.
english: how shall we escape if we ignore such a great salvation? This salvation, which was first announced by the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard him.

ekegusii: Imomanyete buya mono korigia abanchi, nonya nabakungu abanyaka begire chinchera chiaino chimbe.
english: How skilled you are at pursuing love! Even the worst of women can learn from your ways.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagosirigwa rioka, omoerio obo nomoondoko okobasiria.
english: How suddenly are they destroyed, completely swept away by terrors!

ekegusii: Amang’ana ao naki are amansu asende! Ee, nigo are amansu ase omonwa one kobua obooke.
english: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai, abang’ainereria! Ekiagera mokourereria chinyomba chi’ababoraka, na ase obong’ainereria mwasaba ogosaba ogotambe. Ase ayio, inamonyore ekina ekere ekenene kobua.]
english: How terrible for you, teachers of the Law and Pharisees! You hypocrites! You take advantage of widows and rob them of their homes, and then make a show of saying long prayers! Because of this your punishment will be all the worse! [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version. See Mark 12:40.]

ekegusii: Chitugo chirochio nigo chikonakwana, amaicho e chiombe achandekire, ekiagera obonyansi bwaborire chikorisia, nonya namaicho e ching’ondi achandekire.
english: How the cattle moan! The herds mill about because they have no pasture; even the flocks of sheep are suffering.

ekegusii: Naki etahabu yasiririe obomeka‐meku bwaye! Naki etahabu echenire yaonchokire! Amagena ay’Aase Aachenu asiareirwe ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi.
english: How the gold has lost its luster, the fine gold become dull! The sacred gems are scattered at the head of every street.

ekegusii: Naki Omonene atubire omochie o Sayoni nomosunte, ekero arenge nendamwamu! Otugutire obonene bokomeka‐meka bw’Abaisraeli korwa igoro gocha inse aa. Ere tainyoreti egeteni ki’amagoro aye, ase rituko ri’endamwamu yaye.
english: How the Lord has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of his anger! He has hurled down the splendor of Israel from heaven to earth; he has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

ekegusii: Abamura ba Sayoni abare nengencho enene, abwo bareng’anirie ne chitahabu chingiya, naki yabeire ng’a bareng’anigwe ne chinyongo chi’amaroba, echire emeremo y’amaboko ’abakori chinyongo?
english: How the precious sons of Zion, once worth their weight in gold, are now considered as pots of clay, the work of a potter's hands!

ekegusii: Naki rende omonto aranyare koba omonyaboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae? Naki omonto oiboire nomokungu aranyare koba oyochenegete?
english: How then can a man be righteous before God? How can one born of woman be pure?

ekegusii: Naki moranyare kobua omoteneneri oyomo ore omoke ase egati y’abasomba b’omonene one, ekero mosemeretie ense ya Misiri ase okonyora chigari na abariini chibarasi?
english: How then can you repulse one officer of the least of my master's officials, even though you are depending on Egypt for chariots and horsemen?

ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa gotegera chinyoni ebisugunia ekero chibiroche.
english: How useless to spread a net in full view of all the birds!

ekegusii: Naki ngento ki moremeire kobua chikanisa chinde, otatiga inche timbaraarereti? Monyabere okomocha okwo!
english: How were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was never a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

ekegusii: Naki eramanyekane ng’a inche na abanto bao twanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, onye tokogenda amo naintwe? Koragende amo naintwe, natororekane ng’a twachorirwe korwa ase abanto bande b’ense eye.”
english: How will anyone know that you are pleased with me and with your people unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people from all the other people on the face of the earth?"

ekegusii: “Aye eng’enang’eni ya mambia, omwana bw’ogokiamoka, naki kwagure korwa igoro! Aye oria kwaiyeretie ebisaku, naki gwatugutetwe gocha inse?
english: How you have fallen from heaven, O morning star, son of the dawn! You have been cast down to the earth, you who once laid low the nations!

ekegusii: Inee! Naki baramorangerie ere bataramwegena? Naende naki baramwegene oyo batana koigwa amang’ana igoro yare? Naende naki baraigwe batari nomorandia?
english: How, then, can they call on the one they have not believed in? And how can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?

ekegusii: Abana b’omokori amabe nabaisa komentekana, nigo bareo ase ogocha goitwa nomoro, abanto b’ororeria rwaye tibakonyora endagera eisaine.
english: However many his children, their fate is the sword; his offspring will never have enough to eat.

ekegusii: Omonto karagenderere koba moyo ase engaki y’emiaka emenge, tiga agokere engaki eyio yonsi, korende goika ainyore ng’a amatuko ’omosunte nabe amange mono. Onsi aya agochi‐gocha nigo are bosa.
english: However many years a man may live, let him enjoy them all. But let him remember the days of darkness, for they will be many. Everything to come is meaningless.

ekegusii: Goika ekero abamwabo bachia gotiira, nere boigo agatiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, tari maiso marore, korende ase bobisi.
english: However, after his brothers had left for the Feast, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.

ekegusii: Ninkobeke ogambe igoro ase bionsi buna omoyo oo oganetie, naye nobe omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.
english: However, as for you, I will take you, and you will rule over all that your heart desires; you will be king over Israel.

ekegusii: korende buna erikire, “Aya eriso ritaroche, gose ogoto gotaigwete, gose aya atarengereirie ase enkoro y’omonto, ayio Nyasae aroiseretie abamwanchete.”
english: However, as it is written: "No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no mind has conceived what God has prepared for those who love him"--

ekegusii: Ekero Yeremia atarairana kogenda, omochiki oria akamotebia, “Irana ogende komenya ase Gedalia mosinto bw’Ahikamu, mochokoro o Safani, oyio omoruoti o Babeli achorete koba omogambi ase emechie y’Abayuda. Nomenye amo nere na amo nabanto bande, gose genda aande onsi ase oranche.” Erio omochiki oria akamoa endagera amo nebiegwa binde, akamotiga agende aase aganetie.
english: However, before Jeremiah turned to go, Nebuzaradan added, "Go back to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has appointed over the towns of Judah, and live with him among the people, or go anywhere else you please." Then the commander gave him provisions and a present and let him go.

ekegusii: Nonya nabo timogoka ase aya, ng’a ebirecha biabaigwereire, korende goka ekiagera amarieta aino arikirwe igoro.”
english: However, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven."

ekegusii: Korende kera omonto anche mokaye buna eanchete ere omonyene; na omokungu tamocha gosika omosacha oye.
english: However, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.

ekegusii: Korende Yusufu tagorete amaremo ’abakuani, ekiagera abwo konya bachikeirwe endagera baare konyora korwa ase Farao, nero baare koria. Ase igo tibagwenerete koonia amaremo abo.
english: However, he did not buy the land of the priests, because they received a regular allotment from Pharaoh and had food enough from the allotment Pharaoh gave them. That is why they did not sell their land.

ekegusii: Korende tatigete kobwatia chinchera chia Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati; agakora ebibe biria Yeroboamu akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe. Tatigete emegwekano ye chimori chi’etahabu eria yarenge agwo Beteli na Dani.
english: However, he did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit-- the worship of the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana eri ndaorokie asore, ng’a ase enchera eyio bakoroka ensemo y’ogweatanana, inche nigo nkomosasima Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, na kwegena ayarikire ase amachiko na ase chibuku chi’ababani.
english: However, I admit that I worship the God of our fathers as a follower of the Way, which they call a sect. I believe everything that agrees with the Law and that is written in the Prophets,

ekegusii: Korende obogima bwane timbobareti ng’a negento kie rigori rinene asende, erinde nkoore orogendo rwane, na obosomba boria nanyorete ase Omonene Yeso koorokia enchili y’amabera a Nyasae.
english: However, I consider my life worth nothing to me, if only I may finish the race and complete the task the Lord Jesus has given me-- the task of testifying to the gospel of God's grace.

ekegusii: Korende onye omonto oria okwanga gotwara moka momura omwabo, rirorio omokungu oria agende ase abagaaka bare agwo ase egeita ki’omochie, akwane amang’ana aya: Omomura omwabo omosacha one bwangire goteneneria oyomwabo egesaku, erinde erieta riaye tirisira korwa ase Abaisraeli.
english: However, if a man does not want to marry his brother's wife, she shall go to the elders at the town gate and say, "My husband's brother refuses to carry on his brother's name in Israel. He will not fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to me."

ekegusii: Korende onye tamong’erete otatiga Nyasae omobegete ase amaboko aye, erio ninkworokie aase omoiti oria aratamere.
english: However, if he does not do it intentionally, but God lets it happen, he is to flee to a place I will designate.

ekegusii: Korende onye emanyekanete ng’a eng’ombe eria nigo enarete goita abanto, na omonyene tayesibeti, goika aakane omonyene eng’ombe eria yakure ase okomoa eng’ombe eria ere moyo; na eria yakure ebe eyaye.”
english: However, if it was known that the bull had the habit of goring, yet the owner did not keep it penned up, the owner must pay, animal for animal, and the dead animal will be his.

ekegusii: Onye embooria ekoborigwa korwa asare, goika arue chionsi echi chiraganigwe, chibe embooria ase obogima bwaye.
english: However, if payment is demanded of him, he may redeem his life by paying whatever is demanded.

ekegusii: “Korende onye timokoigwera Omonene, Nyasae oino, gose onye timokoba abegenwa na gokora amachiko aye onsi, na emeroberio yaye echikire, ayio inche nabaeire ase rituko ria rero, rirorio okoragererigwa oko gwonsi nagoche asemore na kobanyore:
english: However, if you do not obey the LORD your God and do not carefully follow all his commands and decrees I am giving you today, all these curses will come upon you and overtake you:

ekegusii: Korende onye omonto ogochandwa ekiagera are Omokristo tarora obosooku, korende atogie Nyasae ase erieta eri.
english: However, if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but praise God that you bear that name.

ekegusii: “Korende ase emechie y’abanto b’ense eyio Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino, timotiga getongwa kende gionsi kereo kebe moyo.
english: However, in the cities of the nations the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance, do not leave alive anything that breathes.

ekegusii: Ase ching’iti echio chikoria eng’ang’ura gose chibwate ebitaago biatananegete, timoria echio: engamia, na egesusu, na egesengi. Echio nigo chikoria eng’ang’ura, korende tichibwati ebitaago biatananegete, ase ayio tichichenegeti.
english: However, of those that chew the cud or that have a split hoof completely divided you may not eat the camel, the rabbit or the coney. Although they chew the cud, they do not have a split hoof; they are ceremonially unclean for you.

ekegusii: Korende tibaigwera Musa; abande bagatigaria eyende goika rituko ria kabere, na mambia yaye bakayenyora yagundire na yasoirwe namakonde, na Musa akababea mono.
english: However, some of them paid no attention to Moses; they kept part of it until morning, but it was full of maggots and began to smell. So Moses was angry with them.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Omonene, Nyasae oino, taigwerete Baalamu, korende akaonchora okoragereria koria gokaba ogosesenigwa asemore, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo abanchete.
english: However, the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam but turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loves you.

ekegusii: “Omonto onde takoba omotaka ase egati yaino, ekiagera Omonene nabasesenie ase ense eyio agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino,
english: However, there should be no poor among you, for in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess as your inheritance, he will richly bless you,

ekegusii: Ase omonto otari gosemeria ogokora kw’emeremo yaye, korende nigo egenete ere oria okoa abanyabibe oboronge, okwegena kwaye omonto oyio kwamobarire ng’a nare noboronge.
english: However, to the man who does not work but trusts God who justifies the wicked, his faith is credited as righteousness.

ekegusii: Bono abanto babere, Elidadi na Medadi, barabwo bagatigara ase egetwori, na omoika ogacha igoro asebare. Igo barenge abamo b’abwo bachoretwe, korende tibagenda agwo ase Eema, na barabwo bakabanera agwo ase egetwori.
english: However, two men, whose names were Eldad and Medad, had remained in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but did not go out to the Tent. Yet the Spirit also rested on them, and they prophesied in the camp.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babete ne chinguru kobua bakaa Abakanani baria emeremo emekong’u, korende tibabaseretie kegima.
english: However, when the Israelites grew stronger, they subjected the Canaanites to forced labor but did not drive them out completely.

ekegusii: However, when the people of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
english: Ekero Abagibeoni baigwete buna Yoshua akorete emechie ya Yeriko na Ai,

ekegusii: Mogeche emete eria yoka momanyete ng’a teri kwama amatunda akoriegwa. Moyekorere emeremo y’okoagachera aase mogokengana korwa ase omochie oria mokorwania esegi, goika obugwe.
english: However, you may cut down trees that you know are not fruit trees and use them to build siege works until the city at war with you falls.

ekegusii: “Korende abakungu baino na abana, barabwo batigare amo ne chitugo chiaino ase emechie eyio nabaeire. (Nimanyete ng’a nigo mobwate chitugo chinyinge.)
english: However, your wives, your children and your livestock (I know you have much livestock) may stay in the towns I have given you,

ekegusii: Hukok and Rehob, together with their pasturelands;
english: na Hukoki na Rebobu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

ekegusii: Mwekeyie ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ere nabaimokererie igoro.
english: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekeyie inse y’okoboko kwa Nyasae okore nokobua, erinde ere abaimokererie igoro ase ekero kiaye.
english: Humble yourselves, therefore, under God's mighty hand, that he may lift you up in due time.

ekegusii: Abare abaitongo bamoirogete Omonene nigo bakonyora obotenenku, na ogosikwa, na obogima.
english: Humility and the fear of the LORD bring wealth and honor and life.

ekegusii: Humtah, Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) and Zior-- nine towns and their villages.
english: na Humuta, na Kiriati‐Ariba (noro Heburoni), na Sihori, emechie kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Hur was the father of Uri, and Uri the father of Bezalel.
english: Huri akaibora Uri, na Uri akaibora Besaleli.

ekegusii: Hurai korwa ase amakura ang’e na Gaasi, na Abieli korwa Ariba;
english: Hurai from the ravines of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarangeria omosae obogoretie ebirwanero biaye, akamotebia, “Somora omoyio oo o birende, ong’ite, abanto tibabaisa goteba ng’a: Nomokungu omoita.” Erio omosae oria akamobeta omoyio oye, akamoita.
english: Hurriedly he called to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and kill me, so that they can't say, 'A woman killed him.'" So his servant ran him through, and he died.

ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe abasacha, momenye nabakungu baino ase chisemi. Moe omokungu ogosika buna oyo otari ne chinguru, ekiagera nigo more abanyamwando amo ase okonyora obuya obokorenta obogima. Erio ogosaba kwaino tigotangwa.
english: Husbands, in the same way be considerate as you live with your wives, and treat them with respect as the weaker partner and as heirs with you of the gracious gift of life, so that nothing will hinder your prayers.

ekegusii: Na inwe abasacha, mwanche abakungu baino, timoba nobororo asebare.
english: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.

ekegusii: Na inwe abasacha, mwanche abakungu baino, buna Kristo anchete ekanisa, naende akerua omonyene ase engencho yaye,
english: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her

ekegusii: Husai akairaneria Abisalomu, “Ogosemia okwo Ahitofeli abaeire tikori okuya ase ekero eke.”
english: Hushai replied to Absalom, "The advice Ahithophel has given is not good this time.

ekegusii: Husai akamoiraneria, “Yaya, taibo. Korende oyo Omonene achorire, na abanto abwo, na Abaisraeli bonsi, bachorire, inche nimbe oyoye, mbeere asare.
english: Hushai said to Absalom, "No, the one chosen by the LORD, by these people, and by all the men of Israel-- his I will be, and I will remain with him.

ekegusii: Husai agatebia Zadoki na Abiatari, abakuani, “Ahitofeli osemirie Abisalomu na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli amang’ana aya na aya, korende inche nabasemia iga na iga.
english: Hushai told Zadok and Abiathar, the priests, "Ahithophel has advised Absalom and the elders of Israel to do such and such, but I have advised them to do so and so.

ekegusii: Chinyang’au nchibe chikwamuma ase emerobiri yabo, ne chisese chi’orosana nchibe chikorera ase chinyomba chiabo chi’obonene. Engaki yaye yaikire ang’e; amatuko aye tagotambeeigwa.
english: Hyenas will howl in her strongholds, jackals in her luxurious palaces. Her time is at hand, and her days will not be prolonged.

ekegusii: Inwe abang’ainereria! Imomanyete ense na erioba, buna bikororekana, korende naki rende, motamanyeti ekero eke?
english: Hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky. How is it that you don't know how to interpret this present time?

ekegusii: Inche nigo ngechete gosanga nabanto bagokora amabe, na tingwancha goikaransa amo nabanto abakayayu.
english: I abhor the assembly of evildoers and refuse to sit with the wicked.

ekegusii: Nkagochabera nebinto bi’obwari, na ase amaboko ao ngakobekera chibangiri, ne chisonoi igoti riao.
english: I adorned you with jewelry: I put bracelets on your arms and a necklace around your neck,

ekegusii: Natang’anete kobamanyia, ekero narenge seino eria kabere, naboigo bono ntaracha natang’anire komanyia abwo bakorete ebibe kare, na abande bonsi, ng’a tinkobaabera,
english: I already gave you a warning when I was with you the second time. I now repeat it while absent: On my return I will not spare those who sinned earlier or any of the others,

ekegusii: Onye ndiria obogima bwaino bware koba ribaga ri’obwane, nanga nigo nakwana buna inwe; nigo nare gokwana amang’ana amange mamincha yaino na gosingisia omotwe one ase okobachaya.
english: I also could speak like you, if you were in my place; I could make fine speeches against you and shake my head at you.

ekegusii: Ninche nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ng’a nimbae ense ya Kanani, ense eria barenge buna abamenyi.
english: I also established my covenant with them to give them the land of Canaan, where they lived as aliens.

ekegusii: “Erio nkabaa emeroberio echikire etarenge emiya, na amachiko atarenge kobarentera obogima.
english: I also gave them over to statutes that were not good and laws they could not live by;

ekegusii: Naende nkanyora ng’a Abalawi na abateri konya batamire korwao, na kera oyomo konya ogendire ase omogondo oye, ekiagera tibaetwe chinsemo chiabo chiabatungetie.
english: I also learned that the portions assigned to the Levites had not been given to them, and that all the Levites and singers responsible for the service had gone back to their own fields.

ekegusii: Erio nkaroberia ng’a chinko chi’ogosambera ebing’wanso chirentwe ase chingaki chichikire, na amatunda ’okwama kwe ritang’ani arentwe. Aye Nyasae one, ing’inyore ase amang’ana aya, inkorere amaya.
english: I also made provision for contributions of wood at designated times, and for the firstfruits. Remember me with favor, O my God.

ekegusii: Erio ngachora abana baino bande bakaba ababani, na abamura bande nkabaatanana bakaba Aberwa baane. Inwe Abaisraeli, Inee, amang’ana ayio tari bo are?” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: I also raised up prophets from among your sons and Nazirites from among your young men. Is this not true, people of Israel?" declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende ngatebia omoruoti, “Onye kwanyancheire, indikere amarube ng’irere abagambi b’orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, erinde bang’e ribaga ng’eteo ngende ase ense y’Abayuda.
english: I also said to him, "If it pleases the king, may I have letters to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, so that they will provide me safe-conduct until I arrive in Judah?

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro naroche igoro y’obong’aini aiga inse y’erioba, naro akarorekana asende ng’a namanene;
english: I also saw under the sun this example of wisdom that greatly impressed me:

ekegusii: Erio ngasamunsa omoringo bw’omwambaro one, ngateba, “Naboigo kera oyomo oyotaikerania eira yaye, Nyasae amosamunse korwa ase abanto b’enyomba yaye, na korwa ase ebinto babwate. Ee, asamunswe abe bosa.” Omoganda bwonsi okairaneria, ogateba, “Amina,” na bakamotogia Omonene. Abanto baria bagakora buna bariete eira ng’a mbakore.
english: I also shook out the folds of my robe and said, "In this way may God shake out of his house and possessions every man who does not keep this promise. So may such a man be shaken out and emptied!" At this the whole assembly said, "Amen," and praised the LORD. And the people did as they had promised.

ekegusii: Naende ngateba ase enkoro yane ime ng’a Nyasae nigo agoteema mwanyabanto kobaenekia ng’a barabwo nigo banga buna ching’iti.
english: I also thought, "As for men, God tests them so that they may see that they are like the animals.

ekegusii: Naende nkabatebia ng’a okoboko kwa Nyasae one nigo kwarenge amo nainche gonkorera amaya, boigo nkabatebia amang’ana ’Aritasasita omoruoti antebetie. Barabwo bakabora, “Tochake koagacha omochie naende.” Ase ayio bakabekana chinguru gokora emeremo eyio emiya.
english: I also told them about the gracious hand of my God upon me and what the king had said to me. They replied, "Let us start rebuilding." So they began this good work.

ekegusii: I also want women to dress modestly, with decency and propriety, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
english: Naboigo nabakungu beboyie chianga chi’ogosika, babe aberiti abaya na abegiti, tari abakomina chitukia, gose kobeka etahabu ne chiruru, gose chianga chie rigori rinene,

ekegusii: Naende nkagania komanya igoro ye chingunchara chiria ikomi chiarenge ase omotwe oye, na igoro y’orogunchara roria ronde oroke rwamerete korwa nyuma, orwo bosio bwaye isato ase chiria ikomi chiagweteo. Orogunchara orwo nigo rwabwate amaiso, na omonwa orenge gokwana amang’ana ’oboenenu, naende rokarorekana nigo rore oronene kobua echinde chiamwabo.
english: I also wanted to know about the ten horns on its head and about the other horn that came up, before which three of them fell-- the horn that looked more imposing than the others and that had eyes and a mouth that spoke boastfully.

ekegusii: Botambe nigo nkomoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino, ase engencho y’obuya bwa Nyasae mwaetwe ase Kristo Yeso.
english: I always thank God for you because of his grace given you in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Botambe nigo ngoakera Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono ekero ngokoinyora ase ogosaba kwane,
english: I always thank my God as I remember you in my prayers,

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omogisangio bw’abwo bonsi bakoirogete, abwo barendete amachiko ao.
english: I am a friend to all who fear you, to all who follow your precepts.

ekegusii: Inche nigo ngokora omorembe, korende ekero ngokwana, barabwo nigo baganetie esegi.
english: I am a man of peace; but when I speak, they are for war.

ekegusii: Inche nigo inga egesicha gia Saroni gekorokwa rosi, naende egesicha ekiya kie rikura.
english: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys.

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omoeti ase ense, tobaisa kombisa amachiko ao.
english: I am a stranger on earth; do not hide your commands from me.

ekegusii: Inche nabeire omogeni ase abanto baminto, na omoeti ase abaminto twaiboretwe korwa ase enda eyemo.
english: I am a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my own mother's sons;

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde orwaki, ne chimbeere chiane nigo chinga buna emerobiri; ase ayio nkaba ase amaiso aye buna oyo onyorire omorembe.
english: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers. Thus I have become in his eyes like one bringing contentment.

ekegusii: I am about to open my mouth; my words are on the tip of my tongue.
english: Rora, bono namumoire omonwa one, na oromeme rwane rwachakire gokwana.

ekegusii: “Bono yatigaire engaki enke, inche ng’umore okogechigwa kwane na goikerania endamwamu yane igoro asemore. Nimbanachere ekina koreng’ana nogokora kwaino, nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’okogechia kwaino gwonsi.
english: I am about to pour out my wrath on you and spend my anger against you; I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.

ekegusii: Rora, inche Omonene nigo ngoteba: Nkorangeria nde ebisaku bionsi bi’amaruoti a sugusu bichiche aa. Abaruoti babo mbatenenie ebirogo biabo bi’obonene agwo ase abanto bagosoera ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu, na ase chindwaki chiaye chinsemo chionsi, boigo nase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda.
english: I am about to summon all the peoples of the northern kingdoms," declares the LORD. "Their kings will come and set up their thrones in the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem; they will come against all her surrounding walls and against all the towns of Judah.

ekegusii: Naende nairokire, ng’a inse gocha naende, Nyasae one nankeyie inse asemore, nimbaichanere mono ase abwo bamochete kare, abataonchogete korwa ase eubi, na obotomani, na obonyaka obwo bare kwenaria.
english: I am afraid that when I come again my God will humble me before you, and I will be grieved over many who have sinned earlier and have not repented of the impurity, sexual sin and debauchery in which they have indulged.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete ase rikura, nainwe aba momenyete ase amabwago ’ebitare bi’omweya, inche nabangire. Nabo inche Omonene natebire. Inwe nigo mogokwana iga: Ning’o oranyare gotirimboka gocha aa gotorwania, gose ning’o oranyare gosoa aa ase tomenyete?
english: I am against you, [Jerusalem,] you who live above this valley on the rocky plateau, declares the LORD-- you who say, "Who can come against us? Who can enter our refuge?"

ekegusii: Nabeire omonto ogosekererwa nabansoeri; ekero bakondora, nigo bagokumia basingisia emetwe yabo.
english: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.

ekegusii: Nakumirie ekiagera mokomotiga iga bwango ere oyobarangeretie ase obuya bwa Kristo, na koonchokera enchili ende eng’ao.
english: I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting the one who called you by the grace of Christ and are turning to a different gospel--

ekegusii: Igo ng’umaime na koumata, nigo ingendererete korera na goichana omobaso boira.
english: I am bowed down and brought very low; all day long I go about mourning.

ekegusii: Narentire oboronge bwane ang’e, tibori aare, na ogotooreka kwane tikogotebana; nimbeke ogotooreka ase Sayoni; ning’ee Abaisraeli obonene bwane.”
english: I am bringing my righteousness near, it is not far away; and my salvation will not be delayed. I will grant salvation to Zion, my splendor to Israel.

ekegusii: Ninchiche bwango. Bwata mono eki ore nakio, erinde monto onde tacha aire egutwa yao.
english: I am coming soon. Hold on to what you have, so that no one will take your crown.

ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo inde ase ensemo yaino, nimbairanere, inwe namoremwe na kobusurwa.
english: I am concerned for you and will look on you with favor; you will be plowed and sown,

ekegusii: Ase Omonene ninde nogosemeria asemore ng’a timokoba nebirengererio binde ebiao, korende ere oyokobachanda nabogorie okogambigwa kwaye, naba onde bwensi.
english: I am confident in the Lord that you will take no other view. The one who is throwing you into confusion will pay the penalty, whoever he may be.

ekegusii: Inche nabareranigwe amo nabwo bakogenda ase embeera, chinguru chiang’ereire.
english: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like a man without strength.

ekegusii: Chinguru chiane chionsi chiaerire, nasenyentekire, nigo nkona‐kweumia ase engencho y’obororo bw’enkoro yane.
english: I am feeble and utterly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

ekegusii: Abanto banyebire buna bakweba omonto okure; nabeire buna enyongo yatekire.
english: I am forgotten by them as though I were dead; I have become like broken pottery.

ekegusii: Nagokire, ekiagera ase kera ring’ana ninde nomoyo bw’oboremu ase engencho yaino.
english: I am glad I can have complete confidence in you.

ekegusii: Rora, inche nindete amabe igoro yao; ningosirie kegima orueo, ninsirie korwa asore Ahabu kera omonto omosacha, omosomba na oyotari omosomba.
english: 'I am going to bring disaster on you. I will consume your descendants and cut off from Ahab every last male in Israel-- slave or free.

ekegusii: Naki rora, nindete etoigo igoro y’ense, ninsirie mwanyabanto na binde bionsi bire moyo; kera egento kere ase ense goika gekwe.
english: I am going to bring floodwaters on the earth to destroy all life under the heavens, every creature that has the breath of life in it. Everything on earth will perish.

ekegusii: ninkorentere abanto b’egesaku ekegeni, egetindi kebuete ebisaku binde bionsi. Abwo mbakorwanie esegi, erinde basarie obwari obwo kwenyoreire ase obong’aini bwao, na bakore obonene bwao bokomeka‐meka bobe obotachenegeti.
english: I am going to bring foreigners against you, the most ruthless of nations; they will draw their swords against your beauty and wisdom and pierce your shining splendor.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga:” “Naama! Ninchike abanto abwo bairane ase omochie oyo. Nabayorwanie na koyobwata, naende bayosambe nomorero. Ninsarie emechie y’Abayuda ebe bosa temenywa nonde.”
english: I am going to give the order, declares the LORD, and I will bring them back to this city. They will fight against it, take it and burn it down. And I will lay waste the towns of Judah so no one can live there."

ekegusii: Rigereria, nintome asemore aya Tata abarierete eira, korende ikaransa ase omochie oyo Yerusalemu goika mobekwe chinguru chikorwa igoro.”
english: I am going to send you what my Father has promised; but stay in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high."

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde ase emechando na obororo; aye Nyasae, ogotooreka kwao konyimokererie igoro.
english: I am in pain and distress; may your salvation, O God, protect me.

ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oetananire ne chindo, nigo ndaire ase egati ya mwanyabanto bagoutoka omorero, amaino abo nigo are amoge buna amatimo ne chinsara, chimeme chiabo nigo chire emioro emioge.
english: I am in the midst of lions; I lie among ravenous beasts-- men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

ekegusii: Naki nabaroreire ribero, na eri neribero ria Nyasae; naki nabariereire boko ase omosacha oyomo, erinde nyare kobarenta buna omoiseke omwekungi omochenu ase Kristo.
english: I am jealous for you with a godly jealousy. I promised you to one husband, to Christ, so that I might present you as a pure virgin to him.

ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo inde buna aye ase obosio bwa Nyasae; inche boigo nigo natongetwe korwa ase riroba.
english: I am just like you before God; I too have been taken from clay.

ekegusii: Omoyo one otiringeirwe ase riroba, ing’a obogima oboyia koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.
english: I am laid low in the dust; preserve my life according to your word.

ekegusii: Korende inche nabeire buna omotino, tindi koigwa, nabeire buna omonto rimama, tindi gokwana.
english: I am like a deaf man, who cannot hear, like a mute, who cannot open his mouth;

ekegusii: Inche nigo inga buna etekere ere ase erooro, gose buna enyakweumia etigarete komenya aase amaturi.
english: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nimbe buna ekegwankwa kegosaria ase Abaefraimu, na buna obogundo ase Abayuda.
english: I am like a moth to Ephraim, like rot to the people of Judah.

ekegusii: Gose tari nainwe mweka ngokora okobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania,
english: I am making this covenant, with its oath, not only with you

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, nere nigo are oyone; nigo akorisia riicho riaye agwo ase ebisicha ebiya bire.
english: I am my lover's and my lover is mine; he browses among the lilies.

ekegusii: tingwenereti naende ndokwe omwana oo, tiga imbe buna oyomo bw’abasomba bao b’eng’eria.
english: I am no longer worthy to be called your son; make me like one of your hired men.'

ekegusii: Inche tindi nendamwamu. Nonya amagwa na amageri are gocha kondwania nigo nare koyarwania na koyasambera amo.
english: I am not angry. If only there were briers and thorns confronting me! I would march against them in battle; I would set them all on fire.

ekegusii: Naki tinkororera enchili obosooku, ekiagera ero nokobua kwa Nyasae gokorenta ogotooreka ase onde bwensi oyoregene, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo.
english: I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God for the salvation of everyone who believes: first for the Jew, then for the Gentile.

ekegusii: Tinkwaneti aya ase okobachika, korende ase omokia bw’abanto bande nteeme ekeene ki’obwanchani bwaino.
english: I am not commanding you, but I want to test the sincerity of your love by comparing it with the earnestness of others.

ekegusii: Tari ng’a ngokwana aya ekiagera inde nokoremerwa, naki neorokereirie goisaneka ase engencho ende yonsi inde nero.
english: I am not saying this because I am in need, for I have learned to be content whatever the circumstances.

ekegusii: Inche tindi korigia obonene bwane; nare oyomo oyokoborigia, nere orabe omogambi.
english: I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.

ekegusii: Tinyarigeti aya ase okobasookia, korende nkobakurera buna abana nyanchete.
english: I am not writing this to shame you, but to warn you, as my dear children.

ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one atongororire ase risankwa ne chinyama, natigeirwe egesabo getubete amaino gioka.
english: I am nothing but skin and bones; I have escaped with only the skin of my teeth.

ekegusii: Nakoorire emiaka emerongo etano na etato, Inee, ninyare gwatanana ayare ay’okogokia na ayatari ay’okogokia? Ninyare koigwa obwansu bw’eki nkoria na eki nkonywa? Ninyare koigwa na kogokera eriogi ri’abateri, abasacha gose abakungu? Nase ki inche, omosomba oo, ngochia gokoraarereria aye, omonene one, omoruoti?
english: I am now eighty years old. Can I tell the difference between what is good and what is not? Can your servant taste what he eats and drinks? Can I still hear the voices of men and women singers? Why should your servant be an added burden to my lord the king?

ekegusii: Ase ayio ninde nesira ase Abagiriki na ase abatari Abagiriki, ase abanyasemi na ase abariri.
english: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks, both to the wise and the foolish.

ekegusii: Inche ninche nkweorokia omonyene, nere Tata oyontomete nigo akong’orokia.”
english: I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me."

ekegusii: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart has turned to wax; it has melted away within me.
english: Nabeire buna amache aiteirwe inse; amauga onsi ay’omobere one achoga‐chogire; enkoro yane yabeire buna obochoe, yanyititokire ime yane.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoteba iga: Inche nigo nchenegete, tindi nogosaria konde, na bibe tibiri ime yane.
english: 'I am pure and without sin; I am clean and free from guilt.

ekegusii: Naama! Nindete Abakalidayo, egesaku keria kere egetindi, naende kere ne chinkoro chigwoka, kegoeta ase chinse chionsi kemenye ase obomenyo botari obwabo.
english: I am raising up the Babylonians, that ruthless and impetuous people, who sweep across the whole earth to seize dwelling places not their own.

ekegusii: Natebire aya ase okobakonya; tari ng’a nkobabekera nde egetango, korende ase engencho y’ayio abagwenerete, erinde monyare gokorera Omonene motang’usiri namang’ana ande.
english: I am saying this for your own good, not to restrict you, but that you may live in a right way in undivided devotion to the Lord.

ekegusii: Namotomire ere asemore ase engencho eyio eyio, erinde momanye amang’ana aito, naende ere naremie chinkoro chiaino.
english: I am sending him to you for the express purpose that you may know about our circumstances and that he may encourage your hearts.

ekegusii: Namotomire asemore ase engencho eyio eyio, erinde monyare komanya buna tore; na ere naremie chinkoro chiaino.
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that you may know how we are, and that he may encourage you.

ekegusii: Ere namotomire gocha asore, na nigo enga buna ninche omonyene netoma.
english: I am sending him-- who is my very heart-- back to you.

ekegusii: “Rigereria, nabatomire inwe buna ching’ondi gati‐gati ye chisese chi’orosana. Ase ayio mobe abang’aini buna ching’iti, na abororo buna amaruma.
english: I am sending you out like sheep among wolves. Therefore be as shrewd as snakes and as innocent as doves.

ekegusii: Natigirwe inde buna oyomo bw’abakure, buna abwo baitetwe, bono bare ase chimbeera ime. Nabeire buna abwo aye otainyoreti nonya ng’ake, kwabaatananire korwa ase okoboko kwao.
english: I am set apart with the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, who are cut off from your care.

ekegusii: na inche nigo inde ne chinguru ching’ana buna chiria nabwate rituko riria Musa antomete. Nonya ndero nabo inde ne chinguru chi’okogenda korwana esegi na echi’okoirana.
english: I am still as strong today as the day Moses sent me out; I'm just as vigorous to go out to battle now as I was then.

ekegusii: Naenekirie ng’a nindore obuya bw’Omonene; ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.
english: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

ekegusii: Bono ngokwana nde nainwe abanto b’Ebisaku. Koreng’ana buna inde omotomwa bw’abanto b’Ebisaku, nabarire ng’a obosomba bwane negento ekenene,
english: I am talking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I make much of my ministry

ekegusii: Aya narorire ase Tata naro ngokwana; nainwe naboigo ayamwarorire ase iso oino, naro mogokora.”
english: I am telling you what I have seen in the Father's presence, and you do what you have heard from your father."

ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, ase engencho ntabatisete monto onde, asemore otatiga Krispo na Gayo,
english: I am thankful that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,

ekegusii: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
english: Inche n’Alifa na Omega, Oyo bwe Ritang’ani na Oyo bw’Omoerio, Omochakano na Omoerio.”

ekegusii: I am the bread of life.
english: Inche nomogati bw’obogima.

ekegusii: Ninche inde egesieri; omonto karasoe goetera asende, natooreke, nasoe na gosoka, na konyora oborisia.
english: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. He will come in and go out, and find pasture.

ekegusii: Inche ninche Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo? Ere tari Nyasae bw’abakure, korende Nyasae bw’abare moyo.”
english: 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'? He is not the God of the dead but of the living."

ekegusii: Inche ninche Nyasae oria kwaroche aria Beteli, aria ase kwaumorerete rigena amaguta rikaba esiiro y’ekeinyorio, na okandiera eira. Bono imoka korwa ase ense eye, oirane gochia ase ense eria kwaiboreretwe.”
english: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and where you made a vow to me. Now leave this land at once and go back to your native land.'"

ekegusii: 'I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.' Moses trembled with fear and did not dare to look.
english: Ninche Nyasaye bwe chisokoro chiao, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo. Musa akaiguswa, tarenge na boremu bw’okorigereria.

ekegusii: Inche nomogati bw’obogima oyoigete korwa igoro; omonto kararie omogati oyio, nabe moyo goika kare na kare; na omogati ndarue inche, ase engencho y’obogima bw’ense, nomobere one.”
english: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world."

ekegusii: na oyore moyo. Inche konya nakure, na rigereria, nigo inde moyo goika kare na kare, ninde nebigorero bi’amakweri na ebi’aase abakure.
english: I am the Living One; I was dead, and behold I am alive for ever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and Hades.

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri imbe Nyasae oino. Ase ayio, mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu inde.”
english: I am the LORD who brought you up out of Egypt to be your God; therefore be holy, because I am holy.

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde timobaisa koba abasomba aroro; inche nasaretie chinguru chi’Abamisiri, nkabuna amakorogoto barabwo babegete ase amareko aino, nkabatiga mokaruao mogwesigoria.
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt so that you would no longer be slaves to the Egyptians; I broke the bars of your yoke and enabled you to walk with heads held high.

ekegusii: Ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe Nyasae oino. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD your God.'"

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde mbae ense ya Kanani, na inche imbe Nyasae oino.
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ase ayio, asamia emenwa yaino ebe yasie, na inche imbaragerie.
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino; ase ayio mweatanane inwe abanyene, mobe abachenu, ekiagera inche nomochenu inde. Timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase engencho y’egetongwa kende gionsi egeke ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense.
english: I am the LORD your God; consecrate yourselves and be holy, because I am holy. Do not make yourselves unclean by any creature that moves about on the ground.

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino; mobwatie emeroberio yane echikire. Mobwatie amachiko aane na koyakora!
english: I am the LORD your God; follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws.

ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, onde tari; Nyasae onde tari otatiga inche bweka. Nigo nakoboyirie chinguru nonya aye tomanyeti inche.
english: I am the LORD, and there is no other; apart from me there is no God. I will strengthen you, though you have not acknowledged me,

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene, Omochenu oino, ninche omotongi oino inwe Abaisraeli, ninche inde omoruoti oino.”
english: I am the LORD, your Holy One, Israel's Creator, your King."

ekegusii: Inche nomonto narorire emechando inse y’endamwamu y’Omonene ere buna enyimbo.
english: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

ekegusii: Nimigire mono ase egati y’amang’ana aya abere. Okogania kwane nigo kore ng’a ngende komenya amo na Kristo; ekiagera aya namaya kobua.
english: I am torn between the two: I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is better by far;

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, goika ng’ikeranie chiira nakorierete; naende ninkoruere ebing’wanso bi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
english: I am under vows to you, O God; I will present my thank offerings to you.

ekegusii: Inche tingwenereti nonya ng’ake obuya na obwegenwa bwonsi gwankorerete inche, omosomba oo, naki engaki naambogete orooche rwa Yorodan nigo nabwate enyimbo yoka koboko kwane, na bono nabeire ebiombe bibere.
english: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness you have shown your servant. I had only my staff when I crossed this Jordan, but now I have become two groups.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire: “Inche nigo inde amo nainwe mbatoorie, ninsirie kegima ebisaku bionsi, ebio ase nabasiarerete gochia, korende inwe tinkobasiria kegima. Nimbae egesusuro gi’okobarongeyia ase oboronge, tinkobatiga nonya ng’ake timbaa egesusuro.”
english: I am with you and will save you,' declares the LORD. 'Though I completely destroy all the nations among which I scatter you, I will not completely destroy you. I will discipline you but only with justice; I will not let you go entirely unpunished.'

ekegusii: Rora, inche nimbe amo naye, ninkorende aande onsi orabe gokogenda, naende ninkoiranie gocha ase ense eye; naki tinkogotiga goika nagokoreire ayio nagotebirie.”
english: I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you."

ekegusii: I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
english: Narosire ekiagera nkona‐korera, emioyo yane yomire pa. Amaiso aane abeire orotutu, nganyete Nyasae one.

ekegusii: Nanyarekire ase okwerera kwane kw’obororo, kera obotuko nigo ngoteremia oborere bwane namariga, ebirarero biane biaichoirwe namariga.
english: I am worn out from groaning; all night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

ekegusii: Nabarikeire amang’ana aya igoro y’abwo bakorigia kobasiria.
english: I am writing these things to you about those who are trying to lead you astray.

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omosomba oo, ing’a okomanya, erinde imanye oborori bwao.
english: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.

ekegusii: Boigo ngasangereria chifeta ne chitahabu, amo ne chimonga chi’abaruoti na echie chingongo chi’oboruoti bwane; ngatwara abateri, abasacha na abakungu, naende ngatwara abakungu abange mwanyabanto bagosanera.
english: I amassed silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and provinces. I acquired men and women singers, and a harem as well-- the delights of the heart of man.

ekegusii: Inche amo nabarwani bonsi tore komo natoumokere omochie. Ekero abanto ba Ai barasoke gotorwania, buna bakorete engaki eria ye ritang’ani, intwe ntotame.
english: I and all those with me will advance on the city, and when the men come out against us, as they did before, we will flee from them.

ekegusii: Inche omonyene amo nabaminto, na abasomba baane, twarure chibesa na endagera singo; bono totige koboria ebinto ebio, titoakanwa.
english: I and my brothers and my men are also lending the people money and grain. But let the exacting of usury stop!

ekegusii: Inche na Tata nigo tore oyomo.”
english: I and the Father are one."

ekegusii: Erio nkairaneria, nkabatebia, “Nyasae o igoro natosesenie togenderere ase obuya; ase ayio intwe, abasomba baye, nkoagacha tore omochie oyo naende; korende inwe timobwati egetari kende gionsi aiga, gose timobwati oboronge gose okoinyorwa konde gwonsi ase Yerusalemu.”
english: I answered them by saying, "The God of heaven will give us success. We his servants will start rebuilding, but as for you, you have no share in Jerusalem or any claim or historic right to it."

ekegusii: Nkamotebia, “Omonene one, aye nomanyete aya.” Ere agantebia, “Aba nabwo barure ase emechando emenene, basibirie chianga chiabo, bachikorire chindabu ase amanyinga ’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi.
english: I answered, "Sir, you know." And he said, "These are they who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.

ekegusii: Nagosoroire ase engencho y’omwana one, oyo naiborete ekero nare ase ebisibo biane, nere Onesimo.
english: I appeal to you for my son Onesimus, who became my son while I was in chains.

ekegusii: Nabasoroire inwe, baminto, ase erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, mokwane mwensi ayamo, erinde ogwatananekana tikoba asemore; korende mobe nokobwatana ase ebirengererio ebimo na okogamba okomo.
english: I appeal to you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that all of you agree with one another so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be perfectly united in mind and thought.

ekegusii: Naorokerete Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo buna Nyasae Omobui. Korende ase erieta riane Yahwe, gose Omonene, tinamanyekanete asebare.
english: I appeared to Abraham, to Isaac and to Jacob as God Almighty, but by my name the LORD I did not make myself known to them.

ekegusii: Nkayorigereria na korengereria mono igoro y’omogondo oyio, nkanyora amorokererio aya:
english: I applied my heart to what I observed and learned a lesson from what I saw:

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nkabeka abarendi igoro asemore, nkabachika ng’a bategerere eriogi ri’egetureri, korende barabwo bakaanga, bakabora: Titokoritegerera.”
english: I appointed watchmen over you and said, 'Listen to the sound of the trumpet!' But you said, 'We will not listen.'

ekegusii: Ngachiera oyomo bw’abanto baria bateneine aroro, nkamoboria antebie ekeene gionsi igoro y’amang’ana aria. Omonto oria agantebia na komanyia engencho y’amang’ana aria onsi iga:
english: I approached one of those standing there and asked him the true meaning of all this. "So he told me and gave me the interpretation of these things:

ekegusii: Nkaimoka gochia koigorera omwanchi one, amaboko aane akanyororokia manemane, na ebiara biane bigatonyia manemane ase obobwato bw’egesiekero.
english: I arose to open for my lover, and my hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh, on the handles of the lock.

ekegusii: Ase igo nkoboria nde: Inee! Nyasae igo aangete abanto baye? Yaya, taibo! Inche omonyene n’Omoisraeli nde, oyomo bw’oroiboro rwa Ibrahimu, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Benjamin.
english: I ask then: Did God reject his people? By no means! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.

ekegusii: Momoroisie ase Omonene, buna egwenerete abachenu, momokonye ase ring’ana rinde rionsi araganie asemore, ekiagera ere obeire ogokonya abanto abange, nonya ninche omonyene nankonyete.
english: I ask you to receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints and to give her any help she may need from you, for she has been a great help to many people, including me.

ekegusii: Gaki nabasabire, timokwa emioyo ase engencho y’ogochandwa kwane inde nakwo ase engencho yaino, okore obonene bwaino.
english: I ask you, therefore, not to be discouraged because of my sufferings for you, which are your glory.

ekegusii: Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria okwanete nainche, “Omonene one, ninki engencho y’ebinto ebi?”
english: I asked the angel who talked with me, "What are these, my lord?"

ekegusii: Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria orenge gokwana nainche, “Omonene one, ninki engencho ye chibarasi echi?”
english: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, "What are these, my lord?"

ekegusii: Erio nkaboria omomalaika oria konya okwanire nainche, “Ninki engencho ye chingunchara echi?” Ere akairaneria, agantebia, “Chingunchara echi nachio chiasiarerete Abayuda, na Abaisraeli, na abanto ba Yerusalemu.”
english: I asked the angel who was speaking to me, "What are these?" He answered me, "These are the horns that scattered Judah, Israel and Jerusalem."

ekegusii: Naende nkaboria, “Abanto aba, ninki bacha gokora aa?” Ere akairaneria, agantebia, “Chingunchara chiria chiasiarerete Abayuda gochia aaria na aaria, goika monto onde tanyarete koimokia omotwe oye igoro. Bono abanto aba bachire gochiondokia na kobutora chingunchara chi’abanto b’ebisaku, baria baimokereretie chingunchara chiabo igoro y’ense y’Abayuda, chigasiarera abamenyeteo.”
english: I asked, "What are these coming to do?" He answered, "These are the horns that scattered Judah so that no one could raise his head, but the craftsmen have come to terrify them and throw down these horns of the nations who lifted up their horns against the land of Judah to scatter its people."

ekegusii: Erio nkaboria Omonene one, ninki engencho ye chibarasi echi? Omomalaika oria okwanete nainche, agantebia. “Ninkworokie engencho ye chibarasi echi.”
english: I asked, "What are these, my lord?" The angel who was talking with me answered, "I will show you what they are."

ekegusii: Nkamoboria, “Ngento ki keria?” Akang’iraneria agantebia, “Keria negetonga gi’okorenga kegocha; kerokio nigo getenenerete obobe bw’abanto b’ense yonsi.”
english: I asked, "What is it?" He replied, "It is a measuring basket." And he added, "This is the iniquity of the people throughout the land."

ekegusii: Erio nkamoboria, “Ng’ai okogenda?” Ere akairaneria agantebia, “Yerusalemu ngochia korenga, erinde imanye obogare bwaye, na obotambe bwaye.”
english: I asked, "Where are you going?" He answered me, "To measure Jerusalem, to find out how wide and how long it is."

ekegusii: Bono ngasangereria abanto abwo ase orooche rogotirimbokera gochia ase Ahawa, na agwo togatoora, tokabeera aroro ase amatuko atato. Ekero naitaaete abanto amo nabakuani, tinanyorete Abalawi aroro nonya noyomo.
english: I assembled them at the canal that flows toward Ahava, and we camped there three days. When I checked among the people and the priests, I found no Levites there.

ekegusii: (Ayio nkobarikera, rigereria, ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tindi gokwana oborimo!)
english: I assure you before God that what I am writing you is no lie.

ekegusii: Korende ekeene nabatebirie ng’a mbarenge ababoraka abange ase Israeli ase amatuko ’Elija, ekero igoro yasiegetwe emiaka etato na emetienyi etano nomo, ekero enchara enene yasoete ase ense yonsi;
english: I assure you that there were many widows in Israel in Elijah's time, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and there was a severe famine throughout the land.

ekegusii: Tinarenge koria endagera engiya, gose koria enyama, gose konywa edivai. Tinarenge kweaka amaguta nonya ng’ake ase chichuma chiria isato.
english: I ate no choice food; no meat or wine touched my lips; and I used no lotions at all until the three weeks were over.

ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobabatisa ase amache, korende ere nababatise ase Omoika Omochenu.”
english: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit."

ekegusii: Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ekoirurukigwa nomwaga; nkabatuguta buna ngotuguta esike ase enchera.
english: I beat them as fine as dust borne on the wind; I poured them out like mud in the streets.

ekegusii: Nkabasunyunta bakaba ebuse ye riroba, nkabamionogora na kobatiringa buna esike ere ase chinchera.”
english: I beat them as fine as the dust of the earth; I pounded and trampled them like mud in the streets.

ekegusii: Nabo ngakorwa koba omosomba bw’enchili eye koreng’ana nekeegwa ki’obuya bwa Nyasae obo naetwe ase ogokora gw’okobua kwaye.
english: I became a servant of this gospel by the gift of God's grace given me through the working of his power.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkaba omonto bw’amasikani amanene, nkabua abwo bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu; boigo obong’aini bwane bokagenderera kobeera ime yane.
english: I became greater by far than anyone in Jerusalem before me. In all this my wisdom stayed with me.

ekegusii: Inche nabeire oyo ogosekererwa nabanto baane bonsi, na engeero y’ogochaya kwabo omobaso boira.
english: I became the laughingstock of all my people; they mock me in song all day long.

ekegusii: Ee, nabasabire ng’a kondeo timba omokong’u ase ogokwana noboremu, ekiagera nebarire koba noboremu igoro ase baria bakagete ng’a intwe nigo togotaara ase engencho y’okogania kw’omobere.
english: I beg you that when I come I may not have to be as bold as I expect to be toward some people who think that we live by the standards of this world.

ekegusii: Nasaba aborokigwa bao bageserie, korende tibanyara.”
english: I begged your disciples to drive it out, but they could not."

ekegusii: Nigo negenete, na ase engencho eyio ngakwana, “Inche nigo nchandegete mono”
english: I believed; therefore I said, "I am greatly afflicted."

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, ere nigo are namaiga asende.
english: I belong to my lover, and his desire is for me.

ekegusii: Nkagora abasomba, abasacha na abakungu; abwo bakanyiborera abasomba bande ase enka yane; nigo nabwate amaicho amange e chiombe, ne chimbori, ne ching’ondi, nkabua abwo bonsi bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu.
english: I bought male and female slaves and had other slaves who were born in my house. I also owned more herds and flocks than anyone in Jerusalem before me.

ekegusii: Nigo nabunete chinsea chi’abatari abanyaboronge, ngatooria korwa ase emenwa yabo abwo konya babwatirwe.
english: I broke the fangs of the wicked and snatched the victims from their teeth.

ekegusii: Nkamorenta ase aborokigwa bao, tibanyara komogwenia.”
english: I brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him."

ekegusii: Nkabarenta ase enyomba y’Omonene ase eero y’abana ba Hanani, mosinto o Igidalia, omonto o Nyasae. Eero eyio nigo yarenge ang’e neria y’abanene b’obogambi eyarenge irongo y’eria ya Maaseya mosinto o Salumu, omorendi bw’egesieri.
english: I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the room of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah the man of God. It was next to the room of the officials, which was over that of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper.

ekegusii: Nkabarenta ase ense y’omoigoto, monyare kogoka ase okwama kwaye na ebinto biaye ebiya. Korende ekero mwachete, mogakora ense yane ekaba entwambu, mogakora omwando one nabaete okaba okogechia.
english: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and rich produce. But you came and defiled my land and made my inheritance detestable.

ekegusii: Nigo nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri; nkababooria korwa ase ense y’obosomba, inche ngatoma Musa, na Haroni, na Miriamu, bakaba bakobaraa.
english: I brought you up out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery. I sent Moses to lead you, also Aaron and Miriam.

ekegusii: Korende inche nigo nkorigia Nyasae ambere kirori, ng’a ase okobarorera inwe amabera tindagenda Korinto.
english: I call God as my witness that it was in order to spare you that I did not return to Corinth.

ekegusii: Onye timokoigwera, inche nkorangeria inde igoro na ense chibe birori asemore rero ng’a, goika mosire kegima ase obwango. Timokomenya amatuko amange ase ense eyio mogochia koira, ekero moramboke Yorodan.
english: I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day that you will quickly perish from the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess. You will not live there long but will certainly be destroyed.

ekegusii: Nyasae, nigo ngokorangeria ng’a onkonye, ekiagera aye nong’itabere; tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane ngokoboria.
english: I call on you, O God, for you will answer me; give ear to me and hear my prayer.

ekegusii: Nigo nkorera asore, ontoorie, erinde mbwate oborori bwao.
english: I call out to you; save me and I will keep your statutes.

ekegusii: Nindangerie Omonene, oyo ogwenerete gotogigwa, nigo arantoorie korwa ase ababisa baane.”
english: I call to the LORD, who is worthy of praise, and I am saved from my enemies.

ekegusii: Nindangerie Omonene, oyo ogwenerete gotogigwa, nigo arantoorie korwa ase ababisa baane.
english: I call to the LORD, who is worthy of praise, and I am saved from my enemies.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ngokorangeria nenkoro yane yonsi, inyigwe, na inche nimbwate emeroberio yao echikire.
english: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD, and I will obey your decrees.

ekegusii: Narentire eguru‐gura ase ense, na ase ebitunwa, na ase endagera, na ase emesabibu, na ase emezeituni, na ase kende gionsi kegokina ase riroba. Boigo nayerentire ase abanto, na ase emeremo yonsi abanto bagokora.”
english: I called for a drought on the fields and the mountains, on the grain, the new wine, the oil and whatever the ground produces, on men and cattle, and on the labor of your hands."

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, nigo narangeretie erieta riao korwa ase engoro entambe,
english: I called on your name, O LORD, from the depths of the pit.

ekegusii: Narwete ase Tata, ngacha ase ense; naende ngotiga nde ense na nkoirana nde ase Tata.”
english: I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father."

ekegusii: Ngaika Telabibu ase abanto baria boosetwe bamenyete, ang’e norooche rwa Kebari; nkagenderera kobeera amo nabarabwo aase agwo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere inde nomoichano omonene.
english: I came to the exiles who lived at Tel Abib near the Kebar River. And there, where they were living, I sat among them for seven days-- overwhelmed.

ekegusii: Na inche nigo narenge amo nainwe ase oboreu na okoiroka, na okoiguswa okonge.
english: I came to you in weakness and fear, and with much trembling.

ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one atongororire ninyare koyabara; abanto nigo bakondigereria na kogokera obobe bwane.
english: I can count all my bones; people stare and gloat over me.

ekegusii: Ninyare gokora amang’ana onsi asere oyokombeka chinguru.
english: I can do everything through him who gives me strength.

ekegusii: Inche bweka tinkonyara koraa abanto aba, egurube eye nendito mono asende.
english: I cannot carry all these people by myself; the burden is too heavy for me.

ekegusii: Asende inche, tai gento ngambigwe nainwe, gose na kegambero kende gionsi kia mwanyabanto. Nonya ninche omonyene tinkwegambia.
english: I care very little if I am judged by you or by any human court; indeed, I do not even judge myself.

ekegusii: Ninche nabarendete ase erooro, ense eria enyomo pa egosamba.
english: I cared for you in the desert, in the land of burning heat.

ekegusii: Nabatianirie ase Omonene, ng’a rirube eri risomwe ase abaminto bonsi.
english: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers.

ekegusii: Nagochikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na obwa Kristo Yeso, na obw’abamalaika abachore, obwate amang’ana ayio, na tonacha ring’ana ritang’ani otaramanya buna rire; tokora ing’ana rinde rionsi ase ogwanchereria.
english: I charge you, in the sight of God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels, to keep these instructions without partiality, and to do nothing out of favoritism.

ekegusii: Inche nigo nachorete enchera bagwenerete kobwatia, naende nkabeera egati yabo buna omogambi; nigo namenyete asebare buna omoruoti akomenya nabarwani baye b’esegi, naende buna omonto okoremia baria bakorera.”
english: I chose the way for them and sat as their chief; I dwelt as a king among his troops; I was like one who comforts mourners.

ekegusii: Tinabachorete inwe korwa ase ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli mobe abakuani baane, na morue ebing’wanso ase egesasimero kiane, naende mosambe ubani na mobe mokobeka egesibao ki’obokuani komogocha ase obosio bwane? Tinaete abanto b’ororeria rwa sokororia yao baire ebing’wanso bionsi Abaisraeli baare gosamba nomorero?
english: I chose your father out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, and to wear an ephod in my presence. I also gave your father's house all the offerings made with fire by the Israelites.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoboyia igoro nomosunte, erio nayetuba neanga y’okweumia.”
english: I clothe the sky with darkness and make sackcloth its covering."

ekegusii: Ngakobekera eanga eroisirie ere nebieni ao ao, ngakobekera na ebikoroto bie risankwa riterere ri’eng’iti ya rooche. Ngakoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani engiya, naende ngakobekera egietubo ki’ariri.
english: I clothed you with an embroidered dress and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you in fine linen and covered you with costly garments.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria inche nkabachika, nkabatebia: Omonene, Nyasae oino, obaeire ense eye, ebe eyaino. Ase ayio abarwani baino bonsi, baria bare chituoni, baimokie ebirwanero biabo bi’esegi, bagende bamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodan, batang’anere Abaisraeli bamwabo.
english: I commanded you at that time: "The LORD your God has given you this land to take possession of it. But all your able-bodied men, armed for battle, must cross over ahead of your brother Israelites.

ekegusii: Nabekire oyominto Febe ase amaboko aino. Ere nomosubati omokoreri ore ase ekanisa ya Kenkerea.
english: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church in Cenchrea.

ekegusii: Bono nigo nkoorokia ogosaria kwane, neitirie ase engencho y’ebibe biane.
english: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

ekegusii: Nabarire emechando y’ekero kia bono, ng’a teri gento onye ekoreng’anigwa nobonene boria bogocha koorokigwa asetore.
english: I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ningosemie, ogore korwa asende etahabu yasibigwe ase omorero onyare koba omonda, ne chianga chindabu onyare kweboyia, erinde obosooku bwao bw’okoba getirianda tibobaisa kororekana. Ogore eriogo ri’amaiso okweaka amaiso ao, onyare korora.
english: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined in the fire, so you can become rich; and white clothes to wear, so you can cover your shameful nakedness; and salve to put on your eyes, so you can see.

ekegusii: Nigo nkorera buna egesingororo gose ebarara; nigo nkweumia buna riruma. Amaiso aane arosire ase okorigereria gochia igoro. Aye Omonene, nigo inde nemechando emenene, indwanerere!”
english: I cried like a swift or thrush, I moaned like a mourning dove. My eyes grew weak as I looked to the heavens. I am troubled; O Lord, come to my aid!"

ekegusii: Inche nigo narerete neriogi rinene asare, na ogotogigwa kwaye nigo kwarenge ase oromeme rwane.
english: I cried out to him with my mouth; his praise was on my tongue.

ekegusii: Nkabaaka inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro aane, bakabugwa.
english: I crushed them completely, and they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

ekegusii: Nkabaaka inse nkabasenyenta, tibanyara koimoka, bakagwa inse y’amagoro aane, bakabugwa.
english: I crushed them so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

ekegusii: Inche nigo nkorera ase Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, ase Nyasae oria okong’ikeraneria onsi.
english: I cry out to God Most High, to God, who fulfills [his purpose] for me.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nkorera asore; nigo ngoteba: Naye ore obotamero bwane, na egetare kiane aiga ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.
english: I cry to you, O LORD; I say, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."

ekegusii: Nigo nabakorerete ayio koreng’ana nogotacheneka kwabo, na ogosaria kwabo, naende nkabisa obosio bwane korwa asebare.
english: I dealt with them according to their uncleanness and their offenses, and I hid my face from them.

ekegusii: nabaorokeirie ase rituko ria rero ng’a goika mosire. Timogochia komenya engaki entambe ase ense eria ere ng’umbu ya Yorodan, eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
english: I declare to you this day that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to enter and possess.

ekegusii: Abaminto, aya nkobatebia naya, ng’a omobere na amanyinga tibikonyora omwando bw’oboruoti bwa Nyasae; gose ogosareka tigokonyora omwando bw’ogotasareka.
english: I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.

ekegusii: Ningoke mono ase Omonene, omoyo one nochenge ase Nyasae one, ere omboyirie chianga chi’ogotooreka, ontubire nomwambaro bw’oboronge, buna omonyuomi akobeka ekiore ekero ki’enyangi, na buna omoriakari agwechabera ebinto bie rigori rinene.
english: I delight greatly in the LORD; my soul rejoices in my God. For he has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom adorns his head like a priest, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

ekegusii: I delight in your decrees; I will not neglect your word.
english: Ningokere emeroberio yao echikire; tinkweba ring’ana riao.

ekegusii: Egento kende gionsi narenge korora na gokegania tinare gwetanga gokenyora, gose tinarinete enkoro yane omogoko onde bwensi, ekiagera enkoro yane nigo yagokerete aya onsi nechanderete, na omogoko oyio noro orenge eng’eria yane y’emeremo yonsi nechanderete.
english: I denied myself nothing my eyes desired; I refused my heart no pleasure. My heart took delight in all my work, and this was the reward for all my labor.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ninganetie nkore ogwancha kwao, amachiko ao nigo are ase enkoro yane ime.”
english: I desire to do your will, O my God; your law is within my heart."

ekegusii: Nagechire obogima bwane; tinganeti kogenderera koba moyo. Takondosia namange; amatuko aane nigo are buna embeo bosa.
english: I despise my life; I would not live forever. Let me alone; my days have no meaning.

ekegusii: Nkerua nenkoro yane korigia na komanya ase obong’aini amang’ana onsi agokoreka inse y’erioba. Nigo ere emeremo etari y’omogoko Nyasae aeire mwanyabanto bechande ase okoyekora.
english: I devoted myself to study and to explore by wisdom all that is done under heaven. What a heavy burden God has laid on men!

ekegusii: Echiaitetwe ne chinyang’au tingochirentereti, ninche omonyene nachiakanete. Echiaibetwe mobaso gose botuko ogachinsaba korwa ase amaboko aane.
english: I did not bring you animals torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for whatever was stolen by day or night.

ekegusii: Naki tinayenyorete korwa ase mwanyabanto, gose tinorokereretigwe na monto, korende nigo nayenyorete ase okomaanorerwa korwa ase Yeso Kristo.
english: I did not receive it from any man, nor was I taught it; rather, I received it by revelation from Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Na inche tinarora Hekalu imeo, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae Omobui na Emanwa y’Eng’ondi nabwo bare Hekalu yaye.
english: I did not see a temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

ekegusii: “Inche tinatomete ababani abwo, korende nigo baminyogete boka abanyene; tinakwanete nabarabwo, korende nigo bagendererete kobana.
english: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.

ekegusii: Ekeene baminto, ase ogwetogia kwane inde nakwo asemore ase Kristo Yeso Omonene oito, nigo n gokwa kera rituko.
english: I die every day-- I mean that, brothers-- just as surely as I glory over you in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ekegusii: Nkabasiarera gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, bakaba besiarerete ase chinse ao ao. Nkabanachera ekina koreng’ana norogendo rwabo, na ogokora kwabo.
english: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered through the countries; I judged them according to their conduct and their actions.

ekegusii: Na inche nigo ngokora aya onsi ase engencho y’enchili, erinde inyare koba oyomo obo bw’abakonyora ogosesenigwa kwaye.
english: I do all this for the sake of the gospel, that I may share in its blessings.

ekegusii: Tinyegachereti inche bweka oboronge bwao ase enkoro yane ime; korende nararirie obwegenwa bwao, na ogotooreka kwao. Timbiseti obuya bwao, na obwegenwa bwao, korwa ase omosangererekano omonene.
english: I do not hide your righteousness in my heart; I speak of your faithfulness and salvation. I do not conceal your love and your truth from the great assembly.

ekegusii: Ting’eti omokungu ribaga ri’okworokereria, gose kogambera omosacha, korende nemogwenerete akire,
english: I do not permit a woman to teach or to have authority over a man; she must be silent.
