They were made responsible for distributing the supplies to their brothers.

ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana buna engencho ya mwanyabanto ase engencho y’oboreu bwaino bwa mwanyabanto, Naki koreng’ana buna inwe ritang’ani mwaruete ebiimo biaino bibe ebisomba bi’obonyaka na ase ogosaria okonene mono, naboigo na bono karue ebiimo biaino bikorere oboronge, monyare gokorwa koba abachenu.
english: I put this in human terms because you are weak in your natural selves. Just as you used to offer the parts of your body in slavery to impurity and to ever-increasing wickedness, so now offer them in slavery to righteousness leading to holiness.

ekegusii: Inche nkamanya ng’a tari Nyasae omotomete, korende Tobia na Sanibalati bamoete chibesa akwane amang’ana arache konyora inche.
english: I realized that God had not sent him, but that he had prophesied against me because Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

ekegusii: Erio inche nkomana nabanene b’Abayuda, nkabatebia, “Mbibe ki ebi mogokora ase ogokora rituko ri’Esabato koba eritachenegeti?
english: I rebuked the nobles of Judah and said to them, "What is this wicked thing you are doing-- desecrating the Sabbath day?

ekegusii: Erio nkomania abanto abwo, nkabaragereria; ngaaka abande abwo na gosunyora chitukia chiabo. Nkabatiania ase erieta ria Nyasae, nkabatebia, “Timobaisa gosokia abaiseke baino ase abamura b’ebisaku ebio, gose konyuomeria abamura baino abaiseke babo; gose inwe abanyene timobaisa konyuoma korwa aroro.
english: I rebuked them and called curses down on them. I beat some of the men and pulled out their hair. I made them take an oath in God's name and said: "You are not to give your daughters in marriage to their sons, nor are you to take their daughters in marriage for your sons or for yourselves.

ekegusii: Ekero naorogetie onsi aya konya nakorire, nigo kwanyigwete; inyorokererie emeroberio yao echikire!
english: I recounted my ways and you answered me; teach me your decrees.

ekegusii: I refuse to touch it; such food makes me ill.
english: Chindagera echio omoyo one ochiangire, chiabeire chindagera chikongechia.”

ekegusii: Nagokire mono ase Omonene, ekiagera bono ase omoerio mwairanire ase ebirengererio biaino igoro y’okoremerwa kwane; nabo mwarenge kondengereria ritang’ani, korende timwanyora ribaga.
english: I rejoice greatly in the Lord that at last you have renewed your concern for me. Indeed, you have been concerned, but you had no opportunity to show it.

ekegusii: Nigo inde nomogoko omonene ase okorenda oborori bwao; kobua koba nobotenenku obonene.
english: I rejoice in following your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.

ekegusii: Nigo nkogokera ring’ana riao, naba buna oyo onyorire ebisakorwa ebinge.
english: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds great spoil.

ekegusii: Inyora emechando yane, na obokong’u bwane, buna nanyure ay’obororo na obosongo.
english: I remember my affliction and my wandering, the bitterness and the gall.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoinyora amatuko a kare, na korengereria igoro y’ogokora kwao gwonsi, naba nkona‐koiranerera emeremo y’amaboko ao.
english: I remember the days of long ago; I meditate on all your works and consider what your hands have done.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero nkoinyora okogamba kwao korwa kare, nigo nkoba nokoremigwa.
english: I remember your ancient laws, O LORD, and I find comfort in them.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obogima nigo nkoinyora amatera aane: nigo nkoba nkorengereria ase enkoro yane ime, neriga‐rigia na kweboria:
english: I remembered my songs in the night. My heart mused and my spirit inquired:

ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora Nyasae, nigo nkorera, na ekero nkomorengereria, nigo ngokwa omoyo.
english: I remembered you, O God, and I groaned; I mused, and my spirit grew faint. Selah

ekegusii: Nakwanire naende, omonto takaga ng’a inche nomoriri inde; korende namonkagera bo, monyanche buna omonto omoriri, erinde nainche boigo ninyare gwetogia ake.
english: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me just as you would a fool, so that I may do a little boasting.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoboka mambia chuni gokorangeria ng’a onkonye, ninsemeretie amang’ana ao.
english: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word.

ekegusii: Naurire abanto be chikanisa chinde enibo yabo ase okorusia eng’eria yane asebare, erinde mbakorere inwe.
english: I robbed other churches by receiving support from them so as to serve you.

ekegusii: Ekero oramanyie enkoro yane obuya bwao, niminyoke inyigwere amachiko ao.
english: I run in the path of your commands, for you have set my heart free.

ekegusii: Ngateba: Nigo narenge gochia kobasiarera gochia aare, erio mbasirie kegima, tibabaisa koinyorwa ase egati ya mwanyabanto.
english: I said I would scatter them and blot out their memory from mankind,

ekegusii: Nigo natebetie abanto b’omochie oyo ng’a goika banyiroke na banche amorokererio ay’okobarongeyia, erinde tinsiria aase abo bamenyete, buna nabachikerete. Korende nigo bagendererete koba ababe goetania ase ogokora kwabo gwonsi.”
english: I said to the city, 'Surely you will fear me and accept correction!' Then her dwelling would not be cut off, nor all my punishments come upon her. But they were still eager to act corruptly in all they did.

ekegusii: Nigo ngotebia Omonene, “Aye naye Omonene one, obuya bwonsi inde nabwo nigo bokorwa asore.”
english: I said to the LORD, "You are my Lord; apart from you I have no good thing."

ekegusii: Nigo nakurerete abana babo agwo ase erooro, nkabatebia: Inwe timobaisa kobwatia emeroberio eyio chisokoro chiaino chiachigete, gose timobaisa konara chingencho chiabo, gose timobaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasima emegwekano yabo.
english: I said to their children in the desert, "Do not follow the statutes of your fathers or keep their laws or defile yourselves with their idols.

ekegusii: Nkabatebia, “Timobaisa koigora ebiita bia Yerusalemu, goika ekero omobaso obarire buya, na ekero abarendi batarainoka goika basieke ebisieri bokong’u nemekorogoto. Mochore abarendi korwa ase abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, kera omonto abekwe aase aye ang’e nenyomba yaye.”
english: I said to them, "The gates of Jerusalem are not to be opened until the sun is hot. While the gatekeepers are still on duty, have them shut the doors and bar them. Also appoint residents of Jerusalem as guards, some at their posts and some near their own houses."

ekegusii: Ngatebia abakuani, “Inwe nigo more abachenekire ase Omonene, na ebikorero nabirobio biachenekire. Chifeta ne chitahabu echio nigo chiarurwe chire ebiegwa bi’ogwancha ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito.
english: I said to them, "You as well as these articles are consecrated to the LORD. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to the LORD, the God of your fathers.

ekegusii: Nkabatebia: Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, timobaisa koiroka chinyasae chi’Abaamori, abwo momenyete ase ense yabo. Korende timwaigwerete amang’ana aane.”
english: I said to you, 'I am the LORD your God; do not worship the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you live.' But you have not listened to me."

ekegusii: Aye Beli‐Tesasari, omonene bw’abaringoria, namanyire ng’a omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu nigo ore ime yao, naende namanyire ng’a obobisi tibori bore obokong’u asore. Chindoto narotete nachio echi, na aye intebie engencho yaye.
english: I said, "Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and no mystery is too difficult for you. Here is my dream; interpret it for me.

ekegusii: Nkarengereria: Nkoriina inde omokendo oyo, imbwaterere chinsagia chiaye. Naki yare koba buya onye chimbeere chiao nchiaba buna ebisago bi’amasabibu, ne rimisu ri’omonwa oo ribe buna eri’amapera,
english: I said, "I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its fruit." May your breasts be like the clusters of the vine, the fragrance of your breath like apples,

ekegusii: Ngateba, “Tinkorora Omonene naende ase ense y’abare moyo, gose korora monto onde bwensi ase aba bamenyete ase ense eye y’obosiru.
english: I said, "I will not again see the LORD, the LORD, in the land of the living; no longer will I look on mankind, or be with those who now dwell in this world.

ekegusii: Nigo narengereretie ng’a ngochia gokwa inde ase emiaka y’oboke bwane; ningende ase ebiita bi’aase abakure, naurirwe emiaka yane yatigarete.
english: I said, "In the prime of my life must I go through the gates of death and be robbed of the rest of my years?"

ekegusii: Inche nigo natebete, “Omonene, indorera amabera, ingwenie omoyo one, ekiagera nakorire ebibe asore.”
english: I said, "O LORD, have mercy on me; heal me, for I have sinned against you."

ekegusii: Bono nigo ngoteba, “Onye ndiria nabwate chimbaba buna riruma, nanga nigo nare koiruruka ngende gotimoka.
english: I said, "Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest--

ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nkarengereria ng’a natugutirwe korwa ase obosio bwao, korende nindigererie naende gochia ase Hekalu yao Enchenu.
english: I said, 'I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.'

ekegusii: Nkarora orwaki rwaetanaine eraaro y’enyomba eria chinsemo chionsi. Emoti yarenge ase okoboko kw’omonto oria nigo yarenge nobotambe bw’amaboko atano na rimo, na kera ekerengo gi’okoboko gekamentwa eki’egesanyi ekemo. Omonto oria akarenga orwaki. Obogare bwaye bokaba emoti eyemo, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro emoti eyemo.
english: I saw a wall completely surrounding the temple area. The length of the measuring rod in the man's hand was six long cubits, each of which was a cubit and a handbreadth. He measured the wall; it was one measuring rod thick and one rod high.

ekegusii: Ase egati y’abanto batamanyeti amange, nkarora omomura ore ase egati y’abamura bande otabwati chisemi.
english: I saw among the simple, I noticed among the young men, a youth who lacked judgment.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora igoro amaanokire. Agwo nkarora ebarasi endabu, na ere oyoyeriinete okorokwa Omwegenwa na Omonyakeene; ere nigo are kogamba na gokora esegi ase oboronge.
english: I saw heaven standing open and there before me was a white horse, whose rider is called Faithful and True. With justice he judges and makes war.

ekegusii: Nkarora egosuka gochia ang’e ase emingichi eria; egatwoma emingichi eria, ere nekeririanda ekenene ekayeiyeria inse, ekabuna chingunchara chiaye ibere. Emingichi eria tiyarenge ne chinguru chi’okorwana negoree eria, korende ekaiyerigwa inse na gotiringwa negoree eria. Onde tarenge konyara gotooria emingichi eria korwa ase okobua kw’egoree eria.
english: I saw him attack the ram furiously, striking the ram and shattering his two horns. The ram was powerless to stand against him; the goat knocked him to the ground and trampled on him, and none could rescue the ram from his power.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora egekone kende igoro, ekenene na eki’ogokumia. Abamalaika batano na babere baare namaakwa atano na abere, ayio nay’omoerio, ekiagera ase ayio endamwamu ya Nyasae yaikeranigwe.
english: I saw in heaven another great and marvelous sign: seven angels with the seven last plagues-- last, because with them God's wrath is completed.

ekegusii: Korende tinaroche motomwa onde otatiga Yakobo, momura omwabo Omonene.
english: I saw none of the other apostles-- only James, the Lord's brother.

ekegusii: Nkarora abanto bonsi abamenyete inse y’erioba bakobwatia omosae oria ogochia kobekwa oboruoti ribaga ri’oria orengeo.
english: I saw that all who lived and walked under the sun followed the youth, the king's successor.

ekegusii: Korwa ase ensemo ekororekana buna nekebono ki’omogwekano oyio na gochia igoro nkarora obomeka‐meku buna obw’etaai boetananire negento kenga buna omorero, na korwa ase ekebono kiaye gochia inse nkarora egento kenga omorero. Omogwekano oria nigo oetananire noborabu bware komoreka.
english: I saw that from what appeared to be his waist up he looked like glowing metal, as if full of fire, and that from there down he looked like fire; and brilliant light surrounded him.

ekegusii: Nkamorora bwesoirie ase ogotacheneka; bonsi babere, ogokora kwabo nigo kwarenge okomo.
english: I saw that she too defiled herself; both of them went the same way.

ekegusii: Nkarora oboroso bwaetanaine Hekalu bwatichire; obotambe bw’oboroso boria bw’ebinyomba biria biaagachire amo, nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano na rimo gochia igoro.
english: I saw that the temple had a raised base all around it, forming the foundation of the side rooms. It was the length of the rod, six long cubits.

ekegusii: Nkarora omokungu oria, otindire ase amanyinga ’abachenu, na ase amanyinga a birori ba Yeso. Na inche ngachia komorora ngakumia ogokumia okonene.
english: I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints, the blood of those who bore testimony to Jesus. When I saw her, I was greatly astonished.

ekegusii: Erio nkamanya ng’a obong’aini nigo bobuete oboriri, buna oborabu bobuete omosunte.
english: I saw that wisdom is better than folly, just as light is better than darkness.

ekegusii: Nkarora omochie oria omochenu, Yerusalemu omoyia, ogoika korwa igoro korwa ase Nyasae, obekirwe ang’e buna omoriakari ochabeirwe gochia ase omosacha oye.
english: I saw the Holy City, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.

ekegusii: Nkarora Omonene oteneine ang’e negesasimero, ere agateba, “Aka ebisure bie chisiiro goika emeriibo y’emetobwa y’egesieri inse etengeche; ebisure bibunanekane bigwere emetwe y’abanto bonsi. Abaratigare nimbaite nemioro. Onde tari oratame, gose oratooreke, nonya noyomo.
english: I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and he said: "Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake. Bring them down on the heads of all the people; those who are left I will kill with the sword. Not one will get away, none will escape.

ekegusii: Nkarora chinyomba chire Kusani chichandegete, ne chieema chi’ense ya Midiani chikanyegerigwa.
english: I saw the tents of Cushan in distress, the dwellings of Midian in anguish.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora ebirogo bi’obonene, na igoro ase ebio mbaikaranseteo abwo baeirwe okobua gw’okogamba. Naende nkarora emioyo y’abwo banachetwe emetwe ekiagera barenge birori ba Yeso, na baare koraria ring’ana ria Nyasae, na batasasimete eng’iti, nonya nomogwekano oye, gose tibanyorete ekemanyererio kiaye ase amasio abo igoro, gose ase amaboko abo. Barabwo bakaba moyo na bakagamba amo na Kristo ase engaki y’emiaka elifu eyemo.
english: I saw thrones on which were seated those who had been given authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of their testimony for Jesus and because of the word of God. They had not worshiped the beast or his image and had not received his mark on their foreheads or their hands. They came to life and reigned with Christ a thousand years.

ekegusii: Aya nigo nkobatebia buna ndoche; tindi korua ogochika.
english: I say this as a concession, not as a command.

ekegusii: Natebire aya ase okobasookia. Inee! Onde tari ase egati yaino ore ne chisemi chiisaine oranyare konacha amang’ana are ase egati y’abamwabo?
english: I say this to shame you. Is it possible that there is nobody among you wise enough to judge a dispute between believers?

ekegusii: Nigo ngotebia Nyasae ore egetare kiane, “Nase ki aye kwanyebire? Nase ki ngendererete korera ngochandwa nababisa baane?”
english: I say to God my Rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?"

ekegusii: Omonene nere egetari kiane, ayio naro omoyo one ontebirie, ase ayio nimosemeretie.
english: I say to myself, "The LORD is my portion; therefore I will wait for him."

ekegusii: Nabatebirie ng’a abange nabache korwa moocha na bosongo, nabaikaranse amo na Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, ase oboruoti bwa igoro,
english: I say to you that many will come from the east and the west, and will take their places at the feast with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo ndarente ekembugu‐mbugu mbasiarere gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku, abwo batabamanyeti. Ense eye egatigwa ere bosa, na omonto onde tarenge goeta ase egati yaye, gose koiranao, ekiagera ense eyio engiya nigo egotigwa ere bosa.”
english: 'I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations, where they were strangers. The land was left so desolate behind them that no one could come or go. This is how they made the pleasant land desolate.'"

ekegusii: Inche nigo ngokorigia nenkoro yane yonsi; ondende timbaisa gotiga amachiko ao.
english: I seek you with all my heart; do not let me stray from your commands.

ekegusii: Nimbatome gochia korwania egesaku ekio giasaririe ase Nyasae, ee, nimbachike bagende korwania abanto abwo nabeire nendamwamu asebare, mbasakore ebinto bi’abanto abwo bibe ebiabo, naende mbabatiringere inse buna esike ere ase chinchera.
english: I send him against a godless nation, I dispatch him against a people who anger me, to seize loot and snatch plunder, and to trample them down like mud in the streets.

ekegusii: Erio ngatoma amang’ana gochia asare, nkamoiraneria, “Amang’ana buna ayio tari ay’ekeene, ayio namang’ana ao aye omonyene okorengereria korwa ase enkoro yao na koyaroisia boigo.”
english: I sent him this reply: "Nothing like what you are saying is happening; you are just making it up out of your head."

ekegusii: Ngatoma ebiaramba bikabarasa, na ase ebio abaruoti babere b’Abaamori bagasirigwa bosio bwaino, tari ase emioro yaino, gose ase amata aino.
english: I sent the hornet ahead of you, which drove them out before you-- also the two Amorite kings. You did not do it with your own sword and bow.

ekegusii: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
english: Tukiko namotomire Efeso.

ekegusii: Inche nabatomete mogese aya motakorerete emeremo; abande bakorire emeremo, na inwe mwasoire ase emeremo yabo.”
english: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor."

ekegusii: buna nakorerete Omonene ase obokanyeku bwonsi, na ase amariga, na ase amateemwa nanyorete ase ogotega kw’Abayahudi.
english: I served the Lord with great humility and with tears, although I was severely tested by the plots of the Jews.

ekegusii: Aye Babeli, nagotegire noboreba, kwabwatirwe, nonya tikwamanyete ayio; kwanyorirwe na kobwatwa, ekiagera nkwamorwanetie Omonene.
english: I set a trap for you, O Babylon, and you were caught before you knew it; you were found and captured because you opposed the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio nkaimoka botuko amo nabanto bande bake. Tinatebetie monto onde amang’ana Nyasae konya abekire ime ase enkoro yane, ayio narenge gochia gokorera Yerusalemu. N’giti ende yonsi tiyarenge nainche otatiga eria nariinete ekero nachete.
english: I set out during the night with a few men. I had not told anyone what my God had put in my heart to do for Jerusalem. There were no mounts with me except the one I was riding on.

ekegusii: Nkarika ekaratasi y’okoyogora, nkayebeka ekemanyererio kiane nkayemumeka; nkarangeria birori, naende nkarenga chibesa chiria ase ekerengo ki’oborito.
english: I signed and sealed the deed, had it witnessed, and weighed out the silver on the scales.

ekegusii: Nigo ngendererete korimera ase etintira ime, aase tari ase ndanyare gotacha namagoro. Narimeire ase amache ase endiba entambe, na emerindo yantubire.
english: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.

ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge indaire, korende enkoro yane nigo yategesetie. Igwa! Omwanchi one oyio ogontura. Moiseke ominto, omwanchi one, riruma riane na omoikeranu one, inyigorere! Inyigorere, ekiagera omotwe one otoorire riime, na etukia yane yanyiire nembura ya botuko.
english: I slept but my heart was awake. Listen! My lover is knocking: "Open to me, my sister, my darling, my dove, my flawless one. My head is drenched with dew, my hair with the dampness of the night."

ekegusii: Nkabatooria korwa ase Abamisiri, na korwa ase abanto bonsi babachandete ase ense eye. Nkabaseria, bakarua ase obosio bwaino, erio nkabaa inwe ense yabo.
english: I snatched you from the power of Egypt and from the hand of all your oppressors. I drove them from before you and gave you their land.

ekegusii: Nkarangeria Omonene, nere akang’iraneria, akandusia korwa ase obwoba bwane bwonsi.
english: I sought the LORD, and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana ekeene ase Kristo, tindi goteba oborimo. Okomanya gw’enkoro yane ime, gokwamorekirwe n’Omoika Omochenu, kwambereire korori,
english: I speak the truth in Christ-- I am not lying, my conscience confirms it in the Holy Spirit--

ekegusii: Igo ngokwana asemore buna ase abanto bare nobong’aini; morenge aya ngokwana.
english: I speak to sensible people; judge for yourselves what I say.

ekegusii: Inche nakwanire rimo, tinkomenta gento; ee, nakwanire kabere, korende tinkogenderera goetania ayio.”
english: I spoke once, but I have no answer-- twice, but I will say no more."

ekegusii: “Nigo narenge gokwana nababani, nkaba nkobaorokeria amaroro amange ao ao, na goetera ase ababani nkaba ngokwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio.
english: I spoke to the prophets, gave them many visions and told parables through them."

ekegusii: Nigo nkorambora amaboko aane gocha asore, omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore, buna riro ba rirang’ete embura.
english: I spread out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a parched land. Selah

ekegusii: nigo ndabe nobwoba igoro y’emechando yane yonsi, ekiagera nimanyete ng’a aye goika ombare ng’a nomomochi inde.
english: I still dread all my sufferings, for I know you will not hold me innocent.

ekegusii: korende tinanyora ogotimoka ase omoyo one, ekiagera ntanyorete oyominto Tito aroro. Erio nkabatebia ng’a batigare buya, nkaimoka nkagenda Makedonia.
english: I still had no peace of mind, because I did not find my brother Titus there. So I said good-by to them and went on to Macedonia.

ekegusii: Nigo nabaagete ase okobarentera oborwaire enyagetabo, na obw’okorigisia, na embura y’amagena ase chindagera chiaino mwakorerete emeremo. Nonya naboigo timwang’iranerete. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: I struck all the work of your hands with blight, mildew and hail, yet you did not turn to me,' declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero nkorangeria omosomba one, ere tari kong’itabera, otatiga ekero namosoroire, nario rioka agocha.
english: I summon my servant, but he does not answer, though I beg him with my own mouth.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Inche omonyene natianire ng’a omochie o Bosira nobe bosa. Ekero abanto bakoyorora mbaondoke na koyochecheria, naende babe bakoragereria ase erieta riaye. Na emechie yaye yonsi nesirigwe ebe amaturi kogenderera botambe.”
english: I swear by myself," declares the LORD, "that Bozrah will become a ruin and an object of horror, of reproach and of cursing; and all its towns will be in ruins forever."

ekegusii: Korende inche nabatebirie, oyoratige mokaye, otatiga ase engencho y’obotomani, na konyuoma oyonde, oyio otomanire; naende oyoranyuome omokungu oyotigirwe, otomanire.”
english: I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for marital unfaithfulness, and marries another woman commits adultery."

ekegusii: Naboigo nabatebirie, nobe omogoko igoro ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire, kobua ase abanyene oboronge emerongo kianda na kianda, abatarigeti okoonchoka.
english: I tell you that in the same way there will be more rejoicing in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous persons who do not need to repent.

ekegusii: I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.
english: Inche nabatebirie, nkere aiga egento ekenene kobua Hekalu.

ekegusii: I tell you the truth, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.
english: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ensa ngocha ere, na bono nereo, ebitondo biraigwe eriogi ri’Omwana o Nyasae, na baria barariigwe nababe moyo.

ekegusii: “Ekeene nabatebirie: Ebibe bionsi mwanyabanto nabaaberwe, na okorama gwonsi bararame,
english: I tell you the truth, all the sins and blasphemies of men will be forgiven them.

ekegusii: Ekeene nabatebirie ng’a amang’ana aya onsi nache igoro ase ekegori eke.
english: I tell you the truth, all this will come upon this generation.

ekegusii: Naki onde bwensi orabae inwe amache negekombe ase erieta riane, ekiagera inwe more abanto ba Kristo, nekeene nabatebirie: Tagosiria eng’eria yaye nonya ng’ake.
english: I tell you the truth, anyone who gives you a cup of water in my name because you belong to Christ will certainly not lose his reward.

ekegusii: “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Oyoranyegene inche, emeremo ngokora inche, nere nayekore; nakore naende emenene kobua eye, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata.
english: I tell you the truth, anyone who has faith in me will do what I have been doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

ekegusii: Ekeene nabatebirie: Onde bwensi otancheti oboruoti bwa Nyasae buna omwana omoke, takobosoa nonya ng’ake.”
english: I tell you the truth, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it."

ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ere oyonyegenete inche nare nobogima bwa kare na kare.
english: I tell you the truth, he who believes has everlasting life.

ekegusii: Nekeene nabatebirie ng’a namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.
english: I tell you the truth, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

ekegusii: Ekeene nabatebirie, namobeke igoro ase ebi abwate bionsi.
english: I tell you the truth, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.

ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Omonto karabwate ring’ana riane, takorora amakweri nonya ng’ake.”
english: I tell you the truth, if anyone keeps my word, he will never see death."

ekegusii: Nekeene nabatebirie: Nebe aororo ase Sodomu na Gomora ase rituko ri’ekina kobua ase omochie oria.
english: I tell you the truth, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of judgment than for that town.

ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye, gose omotomwa tari omonene kobua ere oyomotomete.
english: I tell you the truth, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.

ekegusii: Korende nabatebirie ekeene, mbare abanto ase aba bateneine aa, abataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake, goika barore oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: I tell you the truth, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Nekeene nabatebirie: Abanto mbare aiga ase aba bateneine, barabwo bataigwe amakweri nonya ng’ake goika barore Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ogocha ase oboruoti bwaye.”
english: I tell you the truth, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom."

ekegusii: I tell you the truth, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
english: Nekeene nabatebirie: Ekegori eke tikegoeta nonya ng’ake goika aya onsi anyare koba.

ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie; Enyeke y’engano etagweti esoe inse ase riroba ekwe, nigo ekobao yoka; korende kerakwe, nigo ekwama okwama okonge.
english: I tell you the truth, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single seed. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.

ekegusii: Ekeene nabatebirie ng’a, goika igoro na ense nabiete, tegoeta enuguta eyemo gose aganto agake akamo ase amachiko, goika bionsi biikerane.
english: I tell you the truth, until heaven and earth disappear, not the smallest letter, not the least stroke of a pen, will by any means disappear from the Law until everything is accomplished.

ekegusii: Ekeene, nagotebirie: Eri tomanyete nario togokwana, na eri toroche twariorokia; na oborori bwaito timori kobwancha.
english: I tell you the truth, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.

ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Ekero kwarenge omosae, nigo kwarenge kweboyia, kwagenda aase origetie, korende ekero orache koba omogaaka, norambore amaboko ao, na oyonde nagosibe, akoire aase otancheti.”
english: I tell you the truth, when you were younger you dressed yourself and went where you wanted; but when you are old you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go."

ekegusii: Nekeene nabatebirie: Kera aase enchili erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.”
english: I tell you the truth, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her."

ekegusii: Nekeene nabatebirie: Kera aase enchili eye erarandigwe ase ense yonsi, neri akora oyo nariatorwe ase okomoinyora.”
english: I tell you the truth, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her."

ekegusii: I tell you the truth, whoever accepts anyone I send accepts me; and whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me."
english: Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ere oyoramwanche onde bwensi oyo ndatome, onyanchire inche; nere oyoranyanche inche omwanchire ere oyontomete.”

ekegusii: Nekeene nagotebirie: Tokorwa aroro nonya ng’ake goika oakane ebesa y’omoerio.
english: I tell you the truth, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny.

ekegusii: Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Inwe namorere na kweng’ereria, korende ense negoke; inwe namoichanigwe, korende ogoichana kwaino nakoonchoke koba omogoko.
english: I tell you the truth, you will weep and mourn while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.

ekegusii: Nekeene nabatebirie inwe ng’a ase baria baiboire nabakungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana Omobatisi; korende oyore omoke ase oboruoti bwa igoro nomonene komobua.
english: I tell you the truth: Among those born of women there has not risen anyone greater than John the Baptist; yet he who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana ring’ana eri, ng’a monto onde tacha kobang’aina ase amang’ana ’okoebereria.
english: I tell you this so that no one may deceive you by fine-sounding arguments.

ekegusii: Nigo nkobatebia: Ase baria baiboire nabakungu, mobani onde taratoka ore omonene kobua Yohana, korende oyore omoke ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae nomonene komobua.”
english: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John; yet the one who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he."

ekegusii: Nabatebirie nabanyorere oboronge ase obwango. Korende Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto kagocha, Inee, nanyore okwegena ase ense?”
english: I tell you, he will see that they get justice, and quickly. However, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?"

ekegusii: Nabatebirie, tinkonywa naende okwama oko kw’emesabibu goika rituko riria ndache gokonywa okoyia amo nainwe ase oboruoti bwa Tata.”
english: I tell you, I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father's kingdom."

ekegusii: Nabatebirie, nabe aororo ase Sodomu ase rituko riria kobua omochie oria.”
english: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.

ekegusii: Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi namosire boigo.
english: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish.

ekegusii: Nabatebirie, taibo; korende motaonchogeti mwensi, namosire boigo.”
english: I tell you, no! But unless you repent, you too will all perish."

ekegusii: Ekiagera nagotebirie ng’a ase abanto baria barangeretigwe onde tari nonya noyomo oranyare koigwa omoyega one.”
english: I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will get a taste of my banquet.'"

ekegusii: Nabatebirie, obotuko boria abanto babere nababe ase oborere obomo, oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.
english: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed; one will be taken and the other left.

ekegusii: Nabatebirie, nataimoka amoe ekiagera nomosani oye, korende ekiagera oria tari gotiga ogosaba, naimoke na komoa ebio bionsi arigetie.
english: I tell you, though he will not get up and give him the bread because he is his friend, yet because of the man's boldness he will get up and give him as much as he needs.

ekegusii: “Nkobatebia nde inwe: Ekorere abasani nenibo y’ense eye etari boronge, erinde ekero egochia gokea, babaroisie inwe ase obomenyo bwa kare na kare.
english: I tell you, use worldly wealth to gain friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, you will be welcomed into eternal dwellings.

ekegusii: Nagotebirie, tokorwa agwo nonya ng’ake goika oakane kegima ebesa y’omoerio.”
english: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the last penny."

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiane, nagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono na kogotogia, ekiagera aye kwang’eire obong’aini ne chinguru, bono kwamanyirie inche aya twagosabete, ekiagera gwatoorokeirie aya omoruoti aganetie komanya.”
english: I thank and praise you, O God of my fathers: You have given me wisdom and power, you have made known to me what we asked of you, you have made known to us the dream of the king."

ekegusii: Namoakeire Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito, oyombegete chinguru, ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera andoche ng’a nigo inde omwegenwa. Akambeka ase obosomba bwaye,
english: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me strength, that he considered me faithful, appointing me to his service.

ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ngokwana ase emenwa kobua inwe mwensi;
english: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono, oyobekire enkoro ya Tito omokia gocha asemore.
english: I thank God, who put into the heart of Titus the same concern I have for you.

ekegusii: Igo nkomoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, oyo ngokorera nenkoro etari kongambia, buna chisokoro chiane chiare gokora, nigo ngokoinyora botambe ase ogosaba kwane obotuko na omobaso.
english: I thank God, whom I serve, as my forefathers did, with a clear conscience, as night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.

ekegusii: Igo nkomoakera Nyasae one ng’a mbuya mono ekero nkobainyora,
english: I thank my God every time I remember you.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nimbe Nyasae obo; na Daudi, omosomba one, abe omogambi ase egati yabo. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.
english: I the LORD will be their God, and my servant David will be prince among them. I the LORD have spoken.

ekegusii: Inche narorire ng’a mboronge kobatura ase okobainyoria ayio ekero imenyete ase obomenyo obo bw’omobere.
english: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of this body,

ekegusii: Nigo nkoba nkorengereria igoro y’amatuko a kare, nkoinyora emiaka ya kare buna yarenge.
english: I thought about the former days, the years of long ago;

ekegusii: Inche nigo narengereretie gokomanyia amang’ana aya. Bono nonyare kobogora aiga ase amasio ’abagaaka aba, na ase aba bonsi baikaransete igaa. Onye kogwancha kobogora, bogore, korende onye taibo, ntebie imanye, ekiagera naye ore omonyamwando ore ang’e, na nyuma yao ninche.” Omonto oria akairaneria, “Ee, nimbogore.”
english: I thought I should bring the matter to your attention and suggest that you buy it in the presence of these seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you will redeem it, do so. But if you will not, tell me, so I will know. For no one has the right to do it except you, and I am next in line." "I will redeem it," he said.

ekegusii: Ngakwana nenkoro yane, ngateba, “Bono ninteeme ndore naki omogoko ore, imbe nkwegokia omonyene.” Korende nonya nayio onsi nigo arenge bosa.
english: I thought in my heart, "Come now, I will test you with pleasure to find out what is good." But that also proved to be meaningless.

ekegusii: Erio ngateba ase enkoro yane ime ng’a Nyasae nanachere abanyaboronge ekina, na abanyabibe boigo, ekiagera obekire engaki ase kera ring’ana, na ase kera emeremo.
english: I thought in my heart, "God will bring to judgment both the righteous and the wicked, for there will be a time for every activity, a time for every deed."

ekegusii: Inche nigo narengereretie ng’a ekero bakoorire gokora amang’ana ayio onsi, nigo barang’iranere, korende tibang’iranereti; na Abayuda, abwo batarenge abegenwa, abare buna abasubati bamwabo Abaisraeli, mbaroche amang’ana ayio.
english: I thought that after she had done all this she would return to me but she did not, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it.

ekegusii: Nkerengereria inche omonyene, “Nenyoreire obong’aini obonge kobua abwo bonsi bantang’anerete kogamba agwo Yerusalemu. Enkoro yane yanyorire obong’aini obonge na okomanya okonge.”
english: I thought to myself, "Look, I have grown and increased in wisdom more than anyone who has ruled over Jerusalem before me; I have experienced much of wisdom and knowledge."

ekegusii: Erio nkarengereria, “Abanto aba nabataka. Barabwo tibari nobong’aini, ekiagera tibamanyeti enchera y’Omonene, gose ogochika kwa Nyasae obo.
english: I thought, "These are only the poor; they are foolish, for they do not know the way of the LORD, the requirements of their God.

ekegusii: Korende ngateba: Tiga abanto b’amatuko amange bakwane, abanyamiaka menge borokererie obong’aini.
english: I thought, 'Age should speak; advanced years should teach wisdom.'

ekegusii: Erio nkarengereria: Bono Abafilisti mbabaise gocha asende aa Giligali ritang’ani ntaraboria ogwancherwa korwa ase Omonene. Ase igo ayio akambetereria korua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.”
english: I thought, 'Now the Philistines will come down against me at Gilgal, and I have not sought the LORD's favor.' So I felt compelled to offer the burnt offering."

ekegusii: Erio ngatebia abanto baria: “Onye moroche ng’a mbuya, ing’a eng’eria yane; onye taibo, yegache.” Barabwo bakarenga chibesa chie chifeta emerongo etato chikaba eng’eria yane.
english: I told them, "If you think it best, give me my pay; but if not, keep it." So they paid me thirty pieces of silver.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nabatebia ng’a namokwe ase ebibe biaino. Onye timokwegena ng’a inche nere, namokwe ase ebibe biaino.”
english: I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am [the one I claim to be], you will indeed die in your sins."

ekegusii: Inche ngokwana inde ayane, erinde ng’orokie ayare ase ebirengererio biane.
english: I too will have my say; I too will tell what I know.

ekegusii: Inche boigo ning’ake chinkobi, ing’isanekie ekeririanda kiane. Ninche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: I too will strike my hands together, and my wrath will subside. I the LORD have spoken."

ekegusii: Inche nkabogoria omokungu one o sere‐sere, nkanachana omobere oye ebing’ese, ngatoma abanto, nabarabwo bakaira ebing’ese biria ase ense yonsi y’omwando bw’Abaisraeli, ekiagera Abagibea bakorete ebibe bi’obonyaka ase egati y’Abaisraeli.
english: I took my concubine, cut her into pieces and sent one piece to each region of Israel's inheritance, because they committed this lewd and disgraceful act in Israel.

ekegusii: Nkabogoria okobwatana koria gw’okogora omogondo komumekire, korikire emeroberio na amang’ana achikire, amo nokonde kogwekaine koria, korende gotamumekeirie.
english: I took the deed of purchase-- the sealed copy containing the terms and conditions, as well as the unsealed copy--

ekegusii: Nkabogoria ebuku eria enke korwa ase okoboko kw’omomalaika oria, nkayeria. Ase omonwa one ekaba enyansu buna obooke, korende ase enda yane ekambekera obororo.
english: I took the little scroll from the angel's hand and ate it. It tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach turned sour.

ekegusii: Nigo nabarusetie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense, nkabarangeria korwa ase chinsinyo chi’aare mono, nkabatebia: Inwe nabasomba baane, nabachorire, timbaangeti.
english: I took you from the ends of the earth, from its farthest corners I called you. I said, 'You are my servant'; I have chosen you and have not rejected you.

ekegusii: Naende ngatandorana oboruoti, nkaborusia korwa ase enyomba ya Daudi, ngakoboa aye, korende aye tobeti buna Daudi, omosomba one arenge, oria orendete amachiko aane, na agantunyana nenkoro yaye yonsi. Ere agakora onsi ayare amaronge ase amaiso aane.
english: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you, but you have not been like my servant David, who kept my commands and followed me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes.

ekegusii: Nonya naborokereretie na gokong’ia amaboko abo, nigo bagendererete koroberia amabe igoro yane.
english: I trained them and strengthened them, but they plot evil against me.

ekegusii: Ngatindachera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi inse, inde nendamwamu, nkabatindia inde nekeririanda, nkaumora amanyinga abo ase riroba.”
english: I trampled the nations in my anger; in my wrath I made them drunk and poured their blood on the ground."

ekegusii: Ekero ebirengererio biane biarenge koraagwa nobong’aini, nkagania kogokia omobere one nekenyugwa ki’edivai, nkarigia kobwatia oboriri obwo, erinde ndore ayare amaya agwenerete mwanyabanto bakore inse y’erioba, ase amatuko ayio amake bagendererete koba moyo.
english: I tried cheering myself with wine, and embracing folly-- my mind still guiding me with wisdom. I wanted to see what was worthwhile for men to do under heaven during the few days of their lives.

ekegusii: I turned around to see the voice that was speaking to me. And when I turned I saw seven golden lampstands,
english: Nkeonchora ndore eriogi riria rigokwana nainche. Ngachia kweonchora nkarora ebibekerero bie chitaya bitano na bibere bie chitahabu,

ekegusii: Ngakora emeremo emenene; nkeagachera chinyomba na gwesimekera emesabibu ase emegondo.
english: I undertook great projects: I built houses for myself and planted vineyards.

ekegusii: Nabasoroire baminto ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo na ase obwanchani bw’Omoika Omochenu, mobe nomokia amo nainche ase ogosaba kwaino ase engencho yane ase obosio bwa Nyasae;
english: I urge you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.

ekegusii: Nabasoroire baminto, morigererie baria bakorenta ogwatananekana ne chingencho chikogera abanto bagwe korwa ase okwegena kwabo, chire mamincha y’okworokererigwa mworokereretigwe; mweatanane korwa asebarabwo.
english: I urge you, brothers, to watch out for those who cause divisions and put obstacles in your way that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Keep away from them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nabasoroire momworokie obwanchani bwaino.
english: I urge you, therefore, to reaffirm your love for him.

ekegusii: Gaki, ritang’ani ase amang’ana onsi nabasoroire ng’a okoboria, na ogosaba, na okogaramera amo nokoiraneria Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono, bikoreke ase engencho y’abanto bonsi,
english: I urge, then, first of all, that requests, prayers, intercession and thanksgiving be made for everyone--

ekegusii: Ngasorora Tito agende; ngatoma oyominto oria amo nere. Inee! Tito nabaurete gento? Titwagendete ase Omoika oria oria? Titwataarete ase chimbaratero chiria chiria?
english: I urged Titus to go to you and I sent our brother with him. Titus did not exploit you, did he? Did we not act in the same spirit and follow the same course?

ekegusii: Naki namobereire kirori, ng’a nare nomokia omonge mono ase engencho yaino, na ase engencho y’abwo bare Laodikia na Hieropoli.
english: I vouch for him that he is working hard for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.

ekegusii: Inche nigo nganyete Omonene, ee, omoyo one nigo omoganyete; nigo nsemeretie ring’ana riaye.
english: I wait for the LORD, my soul waits, and in his word I put my hope.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene, naye nsemereretie. Omonene, Nyasae one, naye oranyare koiraneria.
english: I wait for you, O LORD; you will answer, O Lord my God.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nganyete ng’a ontoorie, naende nigo ngokora buna amachiko ao agoteba.
english: I wait for your salvation, O LORD, and I follow your commands.

ekegusii: Nigo nkorera ase obotuko bwonsi ng’a nkonywe; Omonene obunire amauga aane buna endo ekobuna ebi yaitire; ekero botaraira ere nigo akoeria obogima bwane.
english: I waited patiently till dawn, but like a lion he broke all my bones; day and night you made an end of me.

ekegusii: “Naama! Nigo nategererete mono ekero mwarenge gokwana; nkaba ndemereretie koigwa chinkwana chiaino chi’obong’aini, ekero mwarenge koriga‐rigia ng’a mang’ana ki mwagwenerete gokwana.
english: I waited while you spoke, I listened to your reasoning; while you were searching for words,

ekegusii: Nigo nkobwatia enchera y’oboronge, naba ngotaara ase oboeto bw’ekeene.
english: I walk in the way of righteousness, along the paths of justice,

ekegusii: Nigo nganetie abasacha basabe kera aase, bakoimokia amaboko amachenu, batari nendamwamu, gose na tang’u‐tang’u.
english: I want men everywhere to lift up holy hands in prayer, without anger or disputing.

ekegusii: Nindigetie komomanya Kristo ne chinguru chi’okobokigwa kwaye, inyare kobwatana nogochandwa kwaye, ngwekanigwe nere ase ogokwa kwaye;
english: I want to know Christ and the power of his resurrection and the fellowship of sharing in his sufferings, becoming like him in his death,

ekegusii: Nigo nanchire ng’a momanye omokia one inde noro ase engencho yaino, na ase baria bare Laodikia na baria bonsi batarandora obosio bwane,
english: I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me personally.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, tingokora amaya ayio ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino; momanye amang’ana ayio buya kegima. Inwe goika mosookigwe ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: I want you to know that I am not doing this for your sake, declares the Sovereign LORD. Be ashamed and disgraced for your conduct, O house of Israel!

ekegusii: Manya ng’a oyominto Timotheo oikire gosiborwa. Amo nere ntoche kobarora karache bwango.
english: I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been released. If he arrives soon, I will come with him to see you.

ekegusii: Naki baminto, nimbamanyie ng’a enchili eye nabaranderetie tiyarwetwe na mwanyabanto.
english: I want you to know, brothers, that the gospel I preached is not something that man made up.

ekegusii: monyare koinyora amang’ana aria akwanetwe kare nababani abachenu, na ogochika oko Omonene na Omotooria abarenterete goetera ase abatomwa baino.
english: I want you to recall the words spoken in the past by the holy prophets and the command given by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.

ekegusii: na inche ninkoborie otiane ase Omonene Nyasae o igoro na ense, ng’a tokorigeria omwana one omokungu korwa ase abaiseke b’Abakanani, aba imenyete ase egati yabo.
english: I want you to swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of earth, that you will not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I am living,

ekegusii: Naende nkarigia komanya engencho yaye bakomosoera, nkamotirimbokia na komobeka bosio bw’ekegambero kiabo.
english: I wanted to know why they were accusing him, so I brought him to their Sanhedrin.

ekegusii: Inche igo ngokurera kera omonto oyokoigwa amang’ana ’obobani bw’ebuku eye: Omonto onde bwensi karayamente, Nyasae namomentere amaakwa ayarikire ase ebuku eye;
english: I warn everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: If anyone adds anything to them, God will add to him the plagues described in this book.

ekegusii: Inche nigo nakwanete naye, ekero kwarenge nogosesenigwa, korende ogakana ogateba: “Inche tinkogotegerera.” Ayio naro kwabeire kogokora korwa oboke bwao; tikwarenge konyigwera.
english: I warned you when you felt secure, but you said, 'I will not listen!' This has been your way from your youth; you have not obeyed me.

ekegusii: Ninche narenge ise bw’abataka: na omonto ochandegete ntamanyete, nigo namwechanderete.
english: I was a father to the needy; I took up the case of the stranger.

ekegusii: I was a stranger and you did not invite me in, I needed clothes and you did not clothe me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after me.'
english: Inarenge omogeni, timwandoisia; inarenge getirianda, timwamboyia; inarwarete, narenge echela ime, timwacha kondora.

ekegusii: Na inche natang’anete ase edini y’Abayahudi, nkabua abange abarenge b’ekegori kiane ase egesaku kiane, ngakora omokia mono ase okobwata chingencho chie chisokoro chiane.
english: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many Jews of my own age and was extremely zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

ekegusii: nigo nakoirogete, ekiagera aye nigo ore omonto omokong’u. Nigo okobogoria eki otagachete, na kogesa eki otasimegete.
english: I was afraid of you, because you are a hard man. You take out what you did not put in and reap what you did not sow.'

ekegusii: Inche nigo nabete nendamwamu ase abanto baane, ngakora omwando one okaba oyo otachenegeti. Nkababeka ase okoboko kwao, aye tikwabete namabera asebare, korende nigo gwakorerete abanto abagotu bobe, okabaa chigurube chindito mono.
english: I was angry with my people and desecrated my inheritance; I gave them into your hand, and you showed them no mercy. Even on the aged you laid a very heavy yoke.

ekegusii: nao narenge korwa agwo kare na kare, nonya nense konya etarabao.
english: I was appointed from eternity, from the beginning, before the world began.

ekegusii: Nigo nabete nobosooku kobooria omoruoti atoe ekeombe ki’abarwani esegi, na eki’abariini chibarasi ng’a bache gotorenda ase orogendo rwaito, ng’a titokorerwa bobe nababisa baito, ekiagera konya namotebirie ng’a okoboko kwa Nyasae oito nigo gokorenta amaya ase abwo bonsi bakomorigia, naende ng’a endamwamu yaye ere nokobua nigo ekoba igoro y’abwo bonsi bakomotiga.
english: I was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers and horsemen to protect us from enemies on the road, because we had told the king, "The gracious hand of our God is on everyone who looks to him, but his great anger is against all who forsake him."

ekegusii: Inche ngasinywa komanya buna nkorigia ekeene ki’amang’ana aya, nkamoboria gose narigetie kogenda Yerusalemu agamberigwe aroro ase amang’ana aya.
english: I was at a loss how to investigate such matters; so I asked if he would be willing to go to Jerusalem and stand trial there on these charges.

ekegusii: Ekero narenge gokora aya, bakaanyora ime ase Hekalu nesibirie, timbeti nomoganda gose riroroche. Korende Abayahudi bande, abarwete Asia mbarengeo.
english: I was ceremonially clean when they found me in the temple courts doing this. There was no crowd with me, nor was I involved in any disturbance.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo babwate okogania okobe kwe ribero; ase ayio nigo bagokora ebibe bikagera nkaba nendamwamu asebare, nkabaaka. Nigo nabisete obosio bwane, nkaba nendamwamu, korende barabwo nigo bagendererete gotiga obwegenwa na kobwatia chinchera chie chinkoro chiabo.
english: I was enraged by his sinful greed; I punished him, and hid my face in anger, yet he kept on in his willful ways.

ekegusii: Ninche narenge eriso ase emeuko, na okogoro ase ebirema.
english: I was eyes to the blind and feet to the lame.

ekegusii: Inche konya nakoorire emiaka emerongo ene ekero Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, antomete korwa Kadeshi‐Barinea koroota ense eye, na inche nkamorentera amang’ana ’ekeene.
english: I was forty years old when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadesh Barnea to explore the land. And I brought him back a report according to my convictions,

ekegusii: Inche nkaegwa emoti y’okorenga enga buna enyimbo, ngatebigwa, “Imoka, orenge Hekalu ya Nyasae amo negesasimero na obare abwo bagosasimera aroro.
english: I was given a reed like a measuring rod and was told, "Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the worshipers there.

ekegusii: Inche nagokire ase ogocha gwa Stefana na Fortunato, na Akaiko, ekiagera bamentete amange aya naremeire korwa asemore.
english: I was glad when Stephanas, Fortunatus and Achaicus arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkaba nendamwamu enene ngatuguta ebinto bia nyomba bia Tobia korwa ase enyomba eria.
english: I was greatly displeased and threw all Tobiah's household goods out of the room.

ekegusii: Na inche tinamanyekanete ase chikanisa chia Kristo chiare Boyahudi.
english: I was personally unknown to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.

ekegusii: Nigo natwometwe bokong’u ng’a ingwe, korende Omonene agankonya.
english: I was pushed back and about to fall, but the LORD helped me.

ekegusii: nigo nabete omoriri mono, tinamanya gento; nkaba buna eng’iti y’orosana ase obosio bwao.
english: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before you.

ekegusii: Nigo nkirete‐kiri, tindi komumora omonwa one, ekiagera aye naye gwakorete ayio.
english: I was silent; I would not open my mouth, for you are the one who has done this.

ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nigo narenge omotang’ani gotebia Sayoni: Rigereria, morore abwo! Ninche narenterete Yerusalemu abwo bararetie amang’ana amaya.
english: I was the first to tell Zion, 'Look, here they are!' I gave to Jerusalem a messenger of good tidings.

ekegusii: Ekero atongete igoro chionsi nao narenge, boigo nekero abekerete amache chimbebe.
english: I was there when he set the heavens in place, when he marked out the horizon on the face of the deep,

ekegusii: Nigo narenge omwana, bono nagotire, korende tinana‐korora omonto omoronge ogotigwa bosa, gose abana baye bakoborwa endagera.
english: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.

ekegusii: Nigo ngoisaba amaboko aane ase okoorokia ng’a tindi na komocha, erio naetanana egesasimero kiao, aye Omonene,
english: I wash my hands in innocence, and go about your altar, O LORD,

ekegusii: Nkarora ekero achia gosansora ekemanyererio kia gatano na rimo omotengecho omonene okaba ase ense, erioba rikaba rimwamu buna egetambaa ki’egunia ekemwamu, omotienyi bwonsi okaba buna amanyinga.
english: I watched as he opened the sixth seal. There was a great earthquake. The sun turned black like sackcloth made of goat hair, the whole moon turned blood red,

ekegusii: I watched as the Lamb opened the first of the seven seals. Then I heard one of the four living creatures say in a voice like thunder, "Come!"
english: Erio nkarora Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ogosansora ekemanyererio ekemo kia bitano na bibere, nkaigwa eyemo ye ching’iti chiria chire moyo egokwana neriogi buna eri’enkoba, egoteba, “Inchuo!”

ekegusii: Nkarora emingichi eria egotwoma gochia ensemo ya bosongo, na eya sugusu, na eya irianyi; eng’itiende tiyarenge konyara gotenena ase obosio bwaye, gose onde tarenge konyara gotooria korwa ase okobua kwaye. Nigo yarenge gokora buna yanchete, naende ekaba egokora amang’ana amanene.
english: I watched the ram as he charged toward the west and the north and the south. No animal could stand against him, and none could rescue from his power. He did as he pleased and became great.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sibuma, nimbareere mono kobua koreera abanto ba Yaeseri. Aye omochie o Sibuma nigo onga buna omosabibu, ne chinsagia chiao chiarandire gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha, chiaikire enyancha ya Yaeseri. Korende ekero kie rigesa omosaria ochire gosaria emesabibu na okwama kwabo.
english: I weep for you, as Jazer weeps, O vines of Sibmah. Your branches spread as far as the sea; they reached as far as the sea of Jazer. The destroyer has fallen on your ripened fruit and grapes.

ekegusii: Ebi nabio nabaete: Chitalanta chie chifeta amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano (650), na ebikorero biaroisirie korwa ase chifeta bie rigori rie chitalanta rigana erimo (100), ne chitahabu chitalanta rigana erimo (100),
english: I weighed out to them 650 talents of silver, silver articles weighing 100 talents, 100 talents of gold,

ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ogendererete koyainyora, na bwekeeirie ime yane.
english: I well remember them, and my soul is downcast within me.

ekegusii: Nkabechandera buna nigo barenge abasani baane gose abaminto; nigo nabegete eanga y’okweumia, nturegete omotwe buna omonto okweumia ekero ng’ina akure.
english: I went about mourning as though for my friend or brother. I bowed my head in grief as though weeping for my mother.

ekegusii: nigo nare koyeromeng’ana na koyeaka inse, naende natooria eng’ondi eria korwa ase omonwa oye, na onye endo gose edubu yare korindokera, nigo nare koyebwata chinderu, erinde nayeaka nayeita.
english: I went after it, struck it and rescued the sheep from its mouth. When it turned on me, I seized it by its hair, struck it and killed it.

ekegusii: Ekero nagendete nigo narenge omonda, korende Omonene ong’iranirie inde namaboko amasa. Nase ki rende mokondoka Naomi bono, ekero Omonene Omobui ang’onchokeire na ondeteire amaakwa?”
english: I went away full, but the LORD has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? The LORD has afflicted me; the Almighty has brought misfortune upon me."

ekegusii: Inche nigo natirimbogete gochia ase omogondo bw’emete enga buna emelozi; nkagenda ase rikura korora ebimeri ebiya buna bikoreereta, na korora gose emesabibu yachakire goseboka. Na emekomomanga gose yachakire gosicha.
english: I went down to the grove of nut trees to look at the new growth in the valley, to see if the vines had budded or the pomegranates were in bloom.

ekegusii: Na inche ngatiira ekiagera namaanoreretwe; nkabatebia enchili eria nkorandia ase abanto b’Ebisaku (korende ase obobisi ase abwo basikire). Aande teba ng’a nigo nkominyoka bosa, gose nigo naminyogete bosa.
english: I went in response to a revelation and set before them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. But I did this privately to those who seemed to be leaders, for fear that I was running or had run my race in vain.

ekegusii: Ngaeta ase omogondo bw’omonto omworo, na ase omogondo bw’emesabibu bw’omonto otari nobong’aini.
english: I went past the field of the sluggard, past the vineyard of the man who lacks judgment;

ekegusii: Ase igo ngacha Yerusalemu, nkabeerao ase engaki y’amatuko atato.
english: I went to Jerusalem, and after staying there three days

ekegusii: Na inche nkarera mono, ekiagera onde tarorekanete ogwenerete koigora ebuku eria, na koyerigereria.
english: I wept and wept because no one was found who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside.

ekegusii: Tinkoira gento otatiga endagera eyio abamura abwo bariete, na ensemo y’abwo bagendete amo nainche; tiga Aneri, na Esikoli, na Mamure, barabwo baire ebiabo.”
english: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share that belongs to the men who went with me-- to Aner, Eshcol and Mamre. Let them have their share."

ekegusii: Ekero ndabe nabarusirie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku na kobasangereria korwa ase chinse echio nabasiarerete gochia, erio nimbanchere buna ogotioka kwe rimisu rigiya. Ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku ninyeorokie asemore inde omochenu.
english: I will accept you as fragrant incense when I bring you out from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will show myself holy among you in the sight of the nations.

ekegusii: Nimente emiaka ikomi na etano ase obogima bwao. Ningotoorie aye, amo nomochie oyo, korwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri; ning’egere omochie oyo ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one.”
english: I will add fifteen years to your life. And I will deliver you and this city from the hand of the king of Assyria. I will defend this city for my sake and for the sake of my servant David.'"

ekegusii: I will allow no sleep to my eyes, no slumber to my eyelids,
english: tingwancha korara chitoro, gose gosundoka,

ekegusii: Erio inche nimokore abe omwana one omotangi, abe omoruoti ore omonene kobua abaruoti bande bonsi b’ense.
english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the most exalted of the kings of the earth.

ekegusii: Boigo ning’iranie Yekonia mosinto o Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabanto bonsi bairetwe Babeli ase obosomba korwa ase ense y’Abayuda, ekiagera nimbune rikorogoto ri’omoruoti o Babeli.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: I will also bring back to this place Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah and all the other exiles from Judah who went to Babylon,' declares the LORD, 'for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.'"

ekegusii: Nabo buna inche nanyorete korwa ase Tata one. Naende nimoe eng’enang’eni ya mambia.
english: I will also give him the morning star.

ekegusii: Nimbe nkoigwera amachiko ao botambe goika kare na kare.
english: I will always obey your law, for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Nintiire ngende ng’etanie amare are igoro mono, ninyekore imbe buna Oyore Igoro Mono.
english: I will ascend above the tops of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High."

ekegusii: Nimbabekere emeki, mbabekere ne chinyama, nimbatube ne risankwa, naende mbautere omoika bw’obomoyo, na inwe mobe moyo naende. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: I will attach tendons to you and make flesh come upon you and cover you with skin; I will put breath in you, and you will come to life. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Ninsirie korwa asebare eriogi ri’omogoko na eri’omochengo, na eriogi ri’omonyuomi na eri’omoriakari. Eriogi ri’orogena rogosia tirikoigugwa, gose oborabu bwe chitaya tibokobao.
english: I will banish from them the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and bridegroom, the sound of millstones and the light of the lamp.

ekegusii: Nigo nganetie na korenda enchera y’oboronge. Inee! Ndiriri orache asende? Nigo nganetie imbe norogendo ororonge ase enyomba yane imenyete.
english: I will be careful to lead a blameless life-- when will you come to me? I will walk in my house with blameless heart.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene natebire iga: Namondigie monyoore, nainche nimbairanerie amaya aino. Nimbasangererie korwa ase ebisaku bionsi ne chinsemo chionsi ase nabaseretie gochia, mbarente gocha aase nabarusetie nkabaira ase obosomba.
english: I will be found by you," declares the LORD, "and will bring you back from captivity. I will gather you from all the nations and places where I have banished you," declares the LORD, "and will bring you back to the place from which I carried you into exile."

ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga mono ase engencho yao, nintere na gotogia erieta riao, aye Omonene Ore Igoro Mono.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

ekegusii: Ningoke na gochenga ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera; aye igo ogwechandera emechando yane, na kondengereria mono ase ogochandwa kwane.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction and knew the anguish of my soul.

ekegusii: Inche nimbe ise, nere nabe omwana one; tinkorusia obwanchani bwane botari koera korwa asare, buna naborusetie korwa ase oria orengeo ritang’ani asore.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will never take my love away from him, as I took it away from your predecessor.

ekegusii: Inche nimbe ise, nere nabe omwana one. Ekero arakore ebibe nimoe egesusuro nenyimbo na amaakwa aya mwanyabanto bakoegwa.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I will punish him with the rod of men, with floggings inflicted by men.

ekegusii: Nimbe buna riime ase Abaisraeli, na barabwo mbasiche buna ebisicha ebiya, mbakinie emeri buna emete ya Lebanoni.
english: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like a lily. Like a cedar of Lebanon he will send down his roots;

ekegusii: Naende ninganetie nyekeyie goetania buna nakora aiga rero, imbe omoitongo. Nonya aye kogonchaya, abaiseke abwo b’abasomba gwakwana, barawo mbansike mono.”
english: I will become even more undignified than this, and I will be humiliated in my own eyes. But by these slave girls you spoke of, I will be held in honor."

ekegusii: Nakumbire Abayuda buna nkumbete obota bwane, naagirie Abaefraimu buna ensara ng’agetie ase obota bwane. Aye Sayoni, ninkore abana bao abamura babe buna amatimo, barwanerie abamura b’Abagiriki; ningokore obe buna omoro bw’omorwani esegi etuoni.”
english: I will bend Judah as I bend my bow and fill it with Ephraim. I will rouse your sons, O Zion, against your sons, O Greece, and make you like a warrior's sword.

ekegusii: Ee, ninkoriere boko ase obwegenwa, naye omanye ng’a ninche Omonene.
english: I will betroth you in faithfulness, and you will acknowledge the LORD.

ekegusii: “Ninkoriere boko nkonyuome obe oyone goika kare na kare; ee, ninkoriere boko ase oboronge na ekeene, na ase obwanchani botari koera, na ase amabera.
english: I will betroth you to me forever; I will betroth you in righteousness and justice, in love and compassion.

ekegusii: Nimosesenie, nkonyorere omwana omomura korwa asare, nimosesenie, abe ng’ina bw’ebisaku; na abaruoti b’abanto inabaiborwe korwa asare.”
english: I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her so that she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will come from her."

ekegusii: Ninsesenie omochie oyo obe nebinto bionsi biganeirie, abaremeire endagera nimbaigotie.
english: I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor will I satisfy with food.

ekegusii: “Nimbasesenie barabwo abanyene, na nigo ndasesenie aase onsi aetanaine egetunwa kiane. Nimbatwerie embura ase chingaki chindonge; embura eyio nebe ey’ogosesenia.
english: I will bless them and the places surrounding my hill. I will send down showers in season; there will be showers of blessing.

ekegusii: “Nimbasesenie abwo baragosesenie, nere oyorakoragererie nimoragererie, na goetera asore aye ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe.”
english: I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you."

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omonto oyio ninyetogie; korende ase engencho yane tingwetogia, otatiga ase oboreu bwane.
english: I will boast about a man like that, but I will not boast about myself, except about my weaknesses.

ekegusii: Nigo ngosasima ndigereretie gochia ase Hekalu yao Enchenu, naaka ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, na ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase obwegenwa bwao. Aye gwakorire eira yao koba enene goetania onsi aya erieta riao riatotebetie.
english: I will bow down toward your holy temple and will praise your name for your love and your faithfulness, for you have exalted above all things your name and your word.

ekegusii: Nimbune emekorogoto y’ebiita bia Damesiki; ninsirie abanto bamenyete ase ense omweya y’Aveni, na oyio obwate enyimbo y’omogambi agwo Beti‐Edeni. Abanto ba Siiria mbairwe ase obosomba gochia ase ense ya Kiri.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: I will break down the gate of Damascus; I will destroy the king who is in the Valley of Aven and the one who holds the scepter in Beth Eden. The people of Aram will go into exile to Kir," says the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninsarie chinguru chi’oboenenu, ninkore igoro oome pa, abe buna ekioma, embura tetwa, ne riroba ri’ense yaino rioome pa, ribe buna etaai.
english: I will break down your stubborn pride and make the sky above you like iron and the ground beneath you like bronze.

ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete Maresa, nimbarentere oyorababue. Oyore Obonene bw’Abaisraeli naike Adulamu.
english: I will bring a conqueror against you who live in Mareshah. He who is the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

ekegusii: Nindete chimbeo inye korwa ase chinsemo inye chia igoro, erinde nsiarere abanto b’Elamu bagende ase chinsinyo echio chionsi; gose egesaku tikeri keratigare ekio abanto b’Elamu batatamere.
english: I will bring against Elam the four winds from the four quarters of the heavens; I will scatter them to the four winds, and there will not be a nation where Elam's exiles do not go.

ekegusii: Ase emechie y’Abayuda na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu ninsirie eriogi ri’omogoko na eri’omochengo, na eriogi ri’omonyuomi na eri’omoriakari, ekiagera ense yabo nebe bosa.”
english: I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and gladness and to the voices of bride and bridegroom in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem, for the land will become desolate.

ekegusii: Ning’iranie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa ase obosomba. Barabwo mbaagache naende emechie eyio yasiretigwe bamenyeo, mbasimeke emesabibu na konywa edivai yaye; boigo mbareme emegondo, basimeke chindagera na koria okwama kw’emegondo eyio.
english: I will bring back my exiled people Israel; they will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them. They will plant vineyards and drink their wine; they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

ekegusii: “Nindete emechando emenene igoro ya mwanyabanto goika babe bagotaba‐taba buna emeuko, ekiagera bakorire ebibe asende inche Omonene. Amanyinga abo naumorwe buna eogoto, na emebere yabo netugutwe buna esike.”
english: I will bring distress on the people and they will walk like blind men, because they have sinned against the LORD. Their blood will be poured out like dust and their entrails like filth.

ekegusii: Nindete omoiborwa korwa ase Yakobo, na omonyamwando korwa ase Yuda oraire ebitunwa biane; abachore baane mbaire ense, na abasomba baane mbamenye aroro.
english: I will bring forth descendants from Jacob, and from Judah those who will possess my mountains; my chosen people will inherit them, and there will my servants live.

ekegusii: Ning’iranerie Abayuda na Abaisraeli amaya abo, mbaagache babe buna barenge agwo ritang’ani.
english: I will bring Judah and Israel back from captivity and will rebuild them as they were before.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, otebire iga: Rora, nindete omoondoko igoro asemore korwa ase abanto bonsi babaetanaine. Inwe moserigwe, na kera omonto atame gochia bosio rioka, gose monto onde tagotoka orasangererie abwo batamire.
english: I will bring terror on you from all those around you," declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty. "Every one of you will be driven away, and no one will gather the fugitives.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nindete ebisaku bire ebibe mono biire chinyomba chiabo. Ninsirie obomwenu bw’abare ne chinguru, na aase abo aachenu abe atachenegeti.
english: I will bring the most wicked of the nations to take possession of their houses; I will put an end to the pride of the mighty, and their sanctuaries will be desecrated.

ekegusii: Ning’iranie Abamisiri, mbarente bamenye ase ense ya Patirosi, ensemo ya irianyi, ense eyio yarenge eyabo. Aroro agwo mbabe noboruoti botari ne chinguru.
english: I will bring them back from captivity and return them to Upper Egypt, the land of their ancestry. There they will be a lowly kingdom.

ekegusii: Nimbairanie inka korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nimbasangererie korwa ase ense y’Asuri; mbabeke ase ense ya Gileadi na ase Lebanoni, mbaichore aroro goika baborwe aase bakomenya.
english: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria. I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon, and there will not be room enough for them.

ekegusii: Ekero nabarentire, nabamenye ase egati‐gati ya Yerusalemu babe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo ase obwegenwa na oboronge.
english: I will bring them back to live in Jerusalem; they will be my people, and I will be faithful and righteous to them as their God."

ekegusii: Ninchirusie korwa ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku binde, nchisangererie korwa ase chinse ao ao, erio nchirente ase ense yabo abanyene. Nimbe ngochirisia igoro ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, na ase chindooche, na ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eyio chimenyire nabanto.
english: I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their own land. I will pasture them on the mountains of Israel, in the ravines and in all the settlements in the land.

ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi nakwanete igoro ya Babeli, ayarikire ase ebuku eye, ayio Yeremia abanete mamincha y’ebisaku bionsi, ninyarente igoro ase ense eria.
english: I will bring upon that land all the things I have spoken against it, all that are written in this book and prophesied by Jeremiah against all the nations.

ekegusii: Inche nindete igoro asemore ogochaywa, na obosooku, ebio bigenderere koba asemore kare na kare.”
english: I will bring upon you everlasting disgrace-- everlasting shame that will not be forgotten."

ekegusii: Ee, ase okoboko kwane kore nokobua koramboire, na ase okoumora ekeririanda kiane, nimbarusie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, mbasangererie korwa ase chinse echio mwasiareretwe gochia.
english: I will bring you from the nations and gather you from the countries where you have been scattered-- with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with outpoured wrath.

ekegusii: Erio mbarente ase erooro y’abanto b’ebisaku, na aroro agwo nimbanachere ekina obosio ase obosio.
english: I will bring you into the desert of the nations and there, face to face, I will execute judgment upon you.

ekegusii: Ningosirie ase enchera y’okoondokia mono, tokogenderera kobao; abanto mbakorigie, korende tibagokonyora naende nonya ng’ake. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: I will bring you to a horrible end and you will be no more. You will be sought, but you will never again be found, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Naende inwe Abaisraeli, abamore asende buna omoiseke omwekungi, nimbaagache nainwe moagacheke, mokong’e. Inwe namwechabere chinchigiri naende, erio mochenge mogotenga amo nabwo bagochenga.
english: I will build you up again and you will be rebuilt, O Virgin Israel. Again you will take up your tambourines and go out to dance with the joyful.

ekegusii: Nindusie egesiomba ekenene mono asebare, nimbe nendamwamu y’okobaa egesusuro. Erio bamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, ekero ndarusie egesiomba asebare.”
english: I will carry out great vengeance on them and punish them in my wrath. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I take vengeance on them.'"

ekegusii: Ning’ichanie abanto abange na abaruoti babo mboboe mono ase engencho yao, ekero ndabe nkomesia omoro one ase amasio abo. Ee, ase rituko ri’okogwa kwao mbabe bakonakoiguswa kera engaki, kera omonto ase engencho y’obogima bwaye.
english: I will cause many peoples to be appalled at you, and their kings will shudder with horror because of you when I brandish my sword before them. On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life.

ekegusii: Nindete Abaisraeli, abanto baane, bataare igoro yaino, mbabaire inwe, na inwe mobe omwando obo. Timokogenderera goita abana babo.
english: I will cause people, my people Israel, to walk upon you. They will possess you, and you will be their inheritance; you will never again deprive them of their children.

ekegusii: Nindete abarwani chituoni, abare abatindi goetania ebisaku bionsi, abwo mbaite emeganda yao nemioro. Barabwo mbasirie obonene bwa Misiri bobe bosa, na emeganda yaye yonsi nesirigwe.
english: I will cause your hordes to fall by the swords of mighty men-- the most ruthless of all nations. They will shatter the pride of Egypt, and all her hordes will be overthrown.

ekegusii: Nimbachene korwa ase okomocha kwabo, na korwa ase ebibe bionsi bakorire asende; nimbaabere ebibe biabo bionsi na ogosaria bakorire asende.
english: I will cleanse them from all the sin they have committed against me and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against me.

ekegusii: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will ever sing for joy.
english: Nimboyie abakuani b’omochie oyo nogotooreka, na abachenu baye mbabe bagoaka amariogi ’omogoko.

ekegusii: imobekere eganchwa yao y’obogambi, naende imoboerie orokini rwao. Nimbeke obogambi bwao ase okoboko kwaye, ere nabe ise bw’abanto ba Yerusalemu na Abayuda.
english: I will clothe him with your robe and fasten your sash around him and hand your authority over to him. He will be a father to those who live in Jerusalem and to the house of Judah.

ekegusii: Ninsookie ababisa baye kegima, korende egutwa y’omotwe oye omonyene negenderere komekameka.”
english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown on his head will be resplendent."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae, nimbe nkoraria ogokora kwao okonene, nimbe nkona‐gotogia oboronge bwao, ee, ningotogie aye bweka.
english: I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, O Sovereign LORD; I will proclaim your righteousness, yours alone.

ekegusii: Inche ning’ike korwa igoro, nkwane naye aroro agwo. Naende ning’ee barabwo korwa ase omoika oria ore ime asore. Erio barabwo bakore emeremo amo naye, erinde tobaisa kobogoria obokong’u bw’okoraa abanto aba aye bweka.
english: I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take of the Spirit that is on you and put the Spirit on them. They will help you carry the burden of the people so that you will not have to carry it alone.

ekegusii: Ninchiche ase enyomba yao, indetane ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa. Ning’ikeranie chiira nakorierete ase ogotiana,
english: I will come to your temple with burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you--

ekegusii: Inche ninkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati yane naye, ninkomentekanie mono.”
english: I will confirm my covenant between me and you and will greatly increase your numbers."

ekegusii: Ninsenyente ababisa baye ase obosio bwaye, abwo bamogechete nimbae amaakwa.
english: I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.

ekegusii: Ninsenyente Abaasuri aiga ase ense yane, nimbatiringere inse agwo ase ebitunwa biane. Ase enchera eyio amakorogoto abo narusigwe ase amagoti ’Abaisraeli, ne chigurube chiabo chirusigwe ase amareko abo.”
english: I will crush the Assyrian in my land; on my mountains I will trample him down. His yoke will be taken from my people, and his burden removed from their shoulders."

ekegusii: Omonene nabune kegima chingunchara chi’abakori amabe, korende echi’abanyaboronge nachiimokererie igoro.
english: I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.

ekegusii: Ninkwane ng’a obwanchani bwao mbogendererete botambe bwakorirwe kobao goika kare na kare; aaria igoro nigo okong’etie obwegenwa bwao.
english: I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you established your faithfulness in heaven itself.

ekegusii: Nindarie erieta riao ase abaminto, ase egati y’omosangererekano ningotogie.
english: I will declare your name to my brothers; in the congregation I will praise you.

ekegusii: Inche ning’egere omochie oyo na inyotoorie, ase engencho yane inche omonyene, na ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one.”
english: I will defend this city and save it, for my sake and for the sake of David my servant."

ekegusii: Inche Omonene ninkorusie orue ase emeremo yao, naende nkoiyerie korwa aase ao.
english: I will depose you from your office, and you will be ousted from your position.

ekegusii: Ninchike emioro ebaite, nainwe mwensi mobe mogwekumba na gotung’ama moitwe, ekiagera ekero nabarangeretie, timwaitabete, na ekero nare gokwana, timwategererete, korende nigo mwakorete ayarenge amabe ase obosio bwane, mogachora gokora aya atangogeti.”
english: I will destine you for the sword, and you will all bend down for the slaughter; for I called but you did not answer, I spoke but you did not listen. You did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me."

ekegusii: Ning’ite ching’iti chionsi chikorisia mbarabare ase amache amange are; amagoro a mwanyabanto, gose ebitaago bie ching’iti, tibikogenderera goturubania amache ayio biyasarie.
