english: I will destroy all her cattle from beside abundant waters no longer to be stirred by the foot of man or muddied by the hoofs of cattle.

ekegusii: Na monto onde bwensi orakore emeremo ende yonsi ase rituko erio, oyio inche Omonene nimosirie korwa ase abanto baye.
english: I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on that day.

ekegusii: Ninsirie omogambi ebina korwa ase egati yabo, nimoite amo nabagambi b’aroro.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: I will destroy her ruler and kill all her officials with him," says the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninsarie emechie yonsi ere ase ense yaino, naende nintagore chindwaki chiaino echio mogwekengera.
english: I will destroy the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.

ekegusii: Sayoni oria ogwekaine omoiseke omuya, naende omwereria, ninyosarie.
english: I will destroy the Daughter of Zion, so beautiful and delicate.

ekegusii: Ninsirie abanto bamenyete Asidodi, na oyo obwate enyimbo y’obogambi agwo Asikeloni. Ning’onchore okoboko kwane kobe mamincha ya Ekironi, na abatigari b’Abafilisti mbasirigwe.” Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon. I will turn my hand against Ekron, till the last of the Philistines is dead," says the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Ninsirie emegwekano yaino yonsi amo, ne chisiiro chiaino, ebinto ebio mogosasima, na inwe timokogenderera gosasima emeremo y’amaboko aino.
english: I will destroy your carved images and your sacred stones from among you; you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands.

ekegusii: Ninsarie obotunwa bwaino ase mogosasimera, nintagore ebisasimero biaino ase mogosambera amanukato, erio intugute emebere yaino ekwete igoro y’emegwekano yaino mogosasima etari moyo. Inche nimbaange kegima.
english: I will destroy your high places, cut down your incense altars and pile your dead bodies on the lifeless forms of your idols, and I will abhor you.

ekegusii: Ninsirie oborogi korwa ase amaboko aino, na abaringoria tibakonyorekana asemore nonya ng’ake.
english: I will destroy your witchcraft and you will no longer cast spells.

ekegusii: Ning’onchore omochie oyo osareke kegima, oichanerwe. Kera omonto orabe ogoeta ase egati yaye naichanigwe mono na gokumia ase engencho y’ogosareka kwaye.
english: I will devastate this city and make it an object of scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will scoff because of all its wounds.

ekegusii: Inche goika nkwere aiga ase orogongo oro: ting’eiri ribaga kwamboka Yorodan, korende ninwe moramboke, erinde moire ense eria engiya.
english: I will die in this land; I will not cross the Jordan; but you are about to cross over and take possession of that good land.

ekegusii: Nimbe nekeririanda asore, ng’ee barabwo ribaga babe abatindi mono asore. Mbakobutore chimioro na amato, na abatigari babo mbaitwe nemioro. Abanto abwo mbaire abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, na abatigari bao mbasambwe nomorero.
english: I will direct my jealous anger against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your noses and your ears, and those of you who are left will fall by the sword. They will take away your sons and daughters, and those of you who are left will be consumed by fire.

ekegusii: Ninserie Abamisiri gochia ase ebisaku binde, mbasiarere gochia ase chinse ao ao.
english: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

ekegusii: Ninserie Abamisiri gochia ase ebisaku, mbasiarere gochia ase chinse ao ao. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

ekegusii: Ninsiarere abanto bao gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, na gochia ase chinse chinde. Ninsirie ogokora okobe korwa asore.
english: I will disperse you among the nations and scatter you through the countries; and I will put an end to your uncleanness.

ekegusii: Aya nigo arakoreke, ekiagera bantigire na basasimire Asitaroti, enyasae enkungu y’Abasidoni, na Kemosi, enyasae y’Abamoabu, na Milikomu, enyasae y’Abaamoni, gose tibabwateti chinchera chiane na tibakorete ayare amaronge ase obosio bwane ase okorenda emeroberio yane echikire na amachiko aane, buna Daudi ise akorete.
english: I will do this because they have forsaken me and worshiped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Molech the god of the Ammonites, and have not walked in my ways, nor done what is right in my eyes, nor kept my statutes and laws as David, Solomon's father, did.

ekegusii: Erio nario ndanyare koirania chinkoro chi’Abaisraeli gocha asende, abwo baatananirwe korwa asende ase engencho y’emegwekano yabo bagosasima.
english: I will do this to recapture the hearts of the people of Israel, who have all deserted me for their idols.'

ekegusii: rora, ninkore koreng’ana buna kwamboria. Ninkoe enkoro y’okomanya okonene kw’obong’aini, okwo monto onde atana koba nakwo, gose oyorache nyuma yao takoba nakwo.
english: I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart, so that there will never have been anyone like you, nor will there ever be.

ekegusii: Ninyoisie ense nemegoko y’amanyinga ao, aichore aike ase ebitunwa igoro, ne chindooche chiichorwe naro.
english: I will drench the land with your flowing blood all the way to the mountains, and the ravines will be filled with your flesh.

ekegusii: Nimokong’ontere akong’e buna omosumari okong’onteire ase enyasi enkong’u, na ere nabe ekerogo ki’amasikani ase enyomba ya ise.
english: I will drive him like a peg into a firm place; he will be a seat of honor for the house of his father.

ekegusii: Nyuma konaseririe abanto b’ebisaku korwa asore na kogareyia orogongo rwao, onde tari orakoroure ase chingaki echi isato kera omwaka, ekero orabe kogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Nyasae oo.
english: I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your territory, and no one will covet your land when you go up three times each year to appear before the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Ninserie omoganda okorwa sugusu orue asemore, obeere are, ninyoserie ogende ase ense enyomo ere bosa, ensemo etang’aine egende gochia ase Enyancha ya Moocha, na ensemo ekorwa nyuma egende gochia ase Enyancha ya Bosongo. Ogotioka kw’obogundo bwaye nkoimokerere igoro, ekiagera okorire ayare amanene mono.”
english: 'I will drive the northern army far from you, pushing it into a parched and barren land, with its front columns going into the eastern sea and those in the rear into the western sea. And its stench will go up; its smell will rise.' Surely he has done great things.

ekegusii: Nimbarusie ase omochie oyo, mbabeke ase amaboko ’abanto abaao, na mbanachere ekina.
english: I will drive you out of the city and hand you over to foreigners and inflict punishment on you.

ekegusii: Inche ninkamie chindooche chiome pa, na ng’oonie ense eyio ase amaboko ’abanto ababe. Nindete abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni basarie ense na kera egento kere imeo. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.
english: I will dry up the streams of the Nile and sell the land to evil men; by the hand of foreigners I will lay waste the land and everything in it. I the LORD have spoken.

ekegusii: Nintoore asore ngoetanane, ng’agache chiburi chi’okoboera na gokorwania.
english: I will encamp against you all around; I will encircle you with towers and set up my siege works against you.

ekegusii: Nimbakore mobe abasomba mokorere ababisa baino ase ense inwe motamanyeti, ekiagera endamwamu yane nigo ere buna omorero outirwe, noro nosambe kogenderera botambe.”
english: I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for my anger will kindle a fire that will burn against you."

ekegusii: Ninkore oboruoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru kare na kare karagenderere bokong’u kobwata na koigwera amachiko aane, na emeroberio yane echikire, buna agokora ase engaki eye.
english: I will establish his kingdom forever if he is unswerving in carrying out my commands and laws, as is being done at this time.'

ekegusii: Ninkore oroiboro rwaye rogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao buna igoro erabe ereo.
english: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

ekegusii: “Ning’ikeranie okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati yane naye, na ororeria rwao korwa nyuma yao, kogenderere ekiaare ase ekiaare, kobe okobwatana gwa kare na kare; imbe Nyasae oo, na oyo bw’ororeria rwao korwa nyuma yao.
english: I will establish my covenant as an everlasting covenant between me and you and your descendants after you for the generations to come, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.

ekegusii: Ninkore oroiboro rwao rogenderere koba ne chinguru botambe, nintenenie ekerogo kiao ki’obonene kebe ase ebiaare bionsi.”
english: 'I will establish your line forever and make your throne firm through all generations.'" Selah

ekegusii: rirorio inche ninkong’ie ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli kare na kare, buna narierete Daudi iso eira, ngateba: Takobora nonya ng’ake korwa ase ororeria rwao omonto oraikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli.
english: I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised David your father when I said, 'You shall never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.'

ekegusii: rirorio ninkore ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti kebe ne chinguru, buna nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania na Daudi iso, nkamotebia: Omonto takobora korwa asore, oyio oragambere Abaisraeli.
english: I will establish your royal throne, as I covenanted with David your father when I said, 'You shall never fail to have a man to rule over Israel.'

ekegusii: Nimonachere ekina goetera ase oborwaire bogoita, na ogoiteka kw’amanyinga; nindete igoro yaye, na igoro y’emeganda yaye y’esegi, na abanto abange bare amo nere, embura ere nomoubera, na amagena are nomorero mbibaite.
english: I will execute judgment upon him with plague and bloodshed; I will pour down torrents of rain, hailstones and burning sulfur on him and on his troops and on the many nations with him.

ekegusii: Ningotebie buna oboronge bwao bore na buna ogokora kwao kore, birobio tibikonyara kogokonya.
english: I will expose your righteousness and your works, and they will not benefit you.

ekegusii: Ning’ichorie ebitunwa biao nabanto baraitwe nemioro; ee, abwo baraitwe nemioro mbagwe ase ebigoro biao, na ase amakura ao, na ase chindooche chiao.
english: I will fill your mountains with the slain; those killed by the sword will fall on your hills and in your valleys and in all your ravines.

ekegusii: Nimbatugute abatigari b’omwando one, imbabeke ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na barabwo babe abooswa bairwe nababisa babo,
english: I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance and hand them over to their enemies. They will be looted and plundered by all their foes,

ekegusii: Ning’ikeranie chiira chiane ase Omonene agwo ase amasio ’abanto baye bonsi.
english: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people,

ekegusii: Ning’ikeranie chiira chiane ase Omonene agwo ase amasio ’abanto baye bonsi.
english: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all his people.

ekegusii: Ninsangererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, mbatirimbokie gochia ase Rikura ria Yehosafati; aroro agwo nimbanachere ekina, ekiagera mbasiarerete Abaisraeli, abwo bare omwando one, gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, naende baatananire ense yane.
english: I will gather all nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. There I will enter into judgment against them concerning my inheritance, my people Israel, for they scattered my people among the nations and divided up my land.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene ninsangererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bache korwania Yerusalemu. Omochie oyio nobugwe, ne chinyomba chisakorwe, na abakungu bakorerwe ay’obosooku. Ekeng’ese ki’abanto b’omochie oyio mbairwe ase obosomba, korende abaratigare tibagosirigwa korwa ase omochie oyio.
english: I will gather all the nations to Jerusalem to fight against it; the city will be captured, the houses ransacked, and the women raped. Half of the city will go into exile, but the rest of the people will not be taken from the city.

ekegusii: I will gather you and I will blow on you with my fiery wrath, and you will be melted inside her.
english: Ee, nimbasangererie mbautere omorero bw’endamwamu yane, na inwe monyititokere imeo.

ekegusii: “Bono nigo nkoimoka ngende ase omochie, ng’ete ase chinchera chiaye na ase ebiooreri biaye, ndigie omwanchi bw’omoyo one.” Nkamorigia, korende tinamonyora.
english: I will get up now and go about the city, through its streets and squares; I will search for the one my heart loves. So I looked for him but did not find him.

ekegusii: Nimbeke ense eria amo nense y’Abaamoni ase amaboko ’abanto ba Moocha, chibe echiabo, na Abaamoni abwo tibakoba bakoinyorwa nabanto b’ebisaku binde nonya ng’ake.
english: I will give Moab along with the Ammonites to the people of the East as a possession, so that the Ammonites will not be remembered among the nations;

ekegusii: korende omwana oye nimoe egesaku ekemo, erio Daudi, omosomba one, botambe atware etaya ekomoreka ase obosio bwane agwo Yerusalemu, omochie nachorire mbeke erieta riane aroro.
english: I will give one tribe to his son so that David my servant may always have a lamp before me in Jerusalem, the city where I chose to put my Name.

ekegusii: Ning’akere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye; nintere ogotera kw’ogotogia erieta ri’Omonene, oyore Igoro Mono.
english: I will give thanks to the LORD because of his righteousness and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

ekegusii: Nimbae chinkoro chi’okomanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene; nababe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo, ekiagera barabwo nabang’iranere ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi.”
english: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the LORD. They will be my people, and I will be their God, for they will return to me with all their heart.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio nimbae enkoro eyemo, naende mbeke omoika omoyia ime yabo. Nindusie korwa asebare chinkoro chire chinkong’u buna rigena, erio mbae echire chinyororo buna chinyama.
english: I will give them an undivided heart and put a new spirit in them; I will remove from them their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh.

ekegusii: Nimbakore babe nomoyo oyomo, erinde babe bakobwatia enchera eyemo; erio nario barang’iroke kogenderera botambe, ase engencho y’obuya bwabo, na obw’abana babo bararwe nyuma yabo.
english: I will give them singleness of heart and action, so that they will always fear me for their own good and the good of their children after them.

ekegusii: Nimbae chinkoro chinyia, na mbeke omoika omoyia ime yaino; nindusie korwa ase emebere yaino chinkoro echio chire chinkong’u buna rigena, naende mbae echire chinyororo buna chinyama.
english: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit in you; I will remove from you your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.

ekegusii: Nabaeire aase onsi morataare namagoro aino, buna narierete Musa eira ng’a nimbayee.
english: I will give you every place where you set your foot, as I promised Moses.

ekegusii: Erio ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono agwo ase omosangererekano omonene, ningotogie ase omoganda omonene bw’abanto.
english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among throngs of people I will praise you.

ekegusii: I will give you thanks, for you answered me; you have become my salvation.
english: Nagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera kwanyigure, aye kwabeire ogotooreka kwane.

ekegusii: Inche ninkoe ebigorero bi’oboruoti bwa igoro, na ande onsi orasibe ase ense nabe asibirwe na igoro, na ande onsi orasibore ase ense nabe asiboirwe na igoro.”
english: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven."

ekegusii: Ninkoe chinibo chibisire ase omosunte, na obotenenku bore aase a bobisi, erinde onyare komanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ngokorangeria ase erieta riao.
english: I will give you the treasures of darkness, riches stored in secret places, so that you may know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who summons you by name.

ekegusii: I will give your servants, the woodsmen who cut the timber, twenty thousand cors of ground wheat, twenty thousand cors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine and twenty thousand baths of olive oil."
english: Ning’ee abasomba bao endagera, baria bagotema emete na gotandora chibao. Nimbae engano esenyentire ebitonga chilifu amagana abere (200,000), na esairi ebitonga chilifu amagana abere (200,000), na edivai chilita chilifu amagana atano na abere na emerongo ebere (720,000), na amaguta ’amazeituni chilita chilifu amagana atano na abere na emerongo ebere (720,000).”

ekegusii: “Inche nintang’ane bosio bwao, ninyaranie ebitunwa na ebigoro, nimbuna‐bune ebiita bie chitaai, nimbutorane emekorogoto y’ebioma.
english: I will go before you and will level the mountains; I will break down gates of bronze and cut through bars of iron.

ekegusii: Inche nintirimboke amo naye goika Misiri, naende tinkomocha gokoirania; na Yusufu nabe okoirania amaiso ao kogwakure.”
english: I will go down to Egypt with you, and I will surely bring you back again. And Joseph's own hand will close your eyes."

ekegusii: Inche ningende ntenene ang’e ase tata ase egetii, aria ase orabeere, nkwane nere igoro yao, kondanyore amang’ana buna are, ningotebie.”
english: I will go out and stand with my father in the field where you are. I'll speak to him about you and will tell you what I find out."

ekegusii: “Inche nindete abanto abaao basakore ebinto ebio, na abakori amabe b’ense mbabiegwe, babikore bibe ebitachenegeti.
english: I will hand it all over as plunder to foreigners and as loot to the wicked of the earth, and they will defile it.

ekegusii: Nindue obotenenku bw’omochie oyio, ne chinibo chiaye chionsi, na ebinto bi’amagori amanene bireo ne chikungo chionsi chi’abaruoti b’Abayuda, mbibeke ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na abwo babisakore na kobiira Babeli.
english: I will hand over to their enemies all the wealth of this city-- all its products, all its valuables and all the treasures of the kings of Judah. They will take it away as plunder and carry it off to Babylon.

ekegusii: nimbabeke ase amaboko ’ababisa babo na ase amaboko ’abanto bakorigia gosiria obogima bwabo. Nabaitwe bakwe, na emebere yabo ebe endagera ye chinyoni ne ching’iti chi’orosana.
english: I will hand over to their enemies who seek their lives. Their dead bodies will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth.

ekegusii: Nimbeke Abamisiri ase amaboko ’omonene ore omotindi; omoruoti bw’okobaondokia nabagambere.” Nabo Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, atebire.
english: I will hand the Egyptians over to the power of a cruel master, and a fierce king will rule over them," declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Nimbabeke ase amaboko abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwabo, na ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, na ase abasomba baye. Korende nyuma y’ayio abanto nabamenye ase ense ya Misiri, buna engaki ya kare. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: I will hand them over to those who seek their lives, to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and his officers. Later, however, Egypt will be inhabited as in times past," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende ninkobeke ase amaboko abanto abwo bakorigia obogima bwao, abwo oirogete. Ninkobeke ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, na ase okoboko kw’Abakalidayo.
english: I will hand you over to those who seek your life, those you fear-- to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and to the Babylonians.

ekegusii: Rora, ninkore chinkoro chi’Abamisiri chibe chinkong’u, barabwo mbababwatie korwa nyuma. Nabo inche inyenyorere ogotogigwa ase okobua Farao amo nemeganda yaye yonsi, ne chigari chiaye, na abariini chibarasi chiaye.
english: I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians so that they will go in after them. And I will gain glory through Pharaoh and all his army, through his chariots and his horsemen.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoayerera, tingotebana koigwera amachiko ao.
english: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ninchande abanto b’ororeria rwa Daudi, korende tekoba igo kogenderera botambe.”
english: I will humble David's descendants because of this, but not forever.'"

ekegusii: Ningoserie ne chinguru amo na nyoko okoiborete, erinde mogende ase ense eng’ao ase motaiboreretwe, mokwereo.
english: I will hurl you and the mother who gave you birth into another country, where neither of you was born, and there you both will die.

ekegusii: Nimente amatunda ase emete, na emegondo yame chindagera chinyinge, nario abanto b’ebisaku batabaise kobasekerera ase engencho y’enchara.
english: I will increase the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field, so that you will no longer suffer disgrace among the nations because of famine.

ekegusii: Ninsangererie gocha asemore abanto abange, ne ching’iti chinyinge. Abanto mbamentekane babuche, ne ching’iti boigo. Nintige momenywe buna engaki eria ya kare, na nimbakorere amaya abuete aria amatang’ani. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I will increase the number of men and animals upon you, and they will be fruitful and become numerous. I will settle people on you as in the past and will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninkworokererie na gokoraa ase enchera ogwenerete kogenda; ningosemie, na amaiso aane nakorigererie.
english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you and watch over you.

ekegusii: I will lay the dead bodies of the Israelites in front of their idols, and I will scatter your bones around your altars.
english: Nimbeke emebere ekwete y’Abaisraeli bosio bw’emegwekano yabo bagosasima, na amauga aino ninyasiarere chinsemo chionsi chiebisasimero biaino.

ekegusii: Ninsarie nsarie ense yaino kegima goika ababisa baino bache komenya imeo bakumie buna esaregete.
english: I will lay waste the land, so that your enemies who live there will be appalled.

ekegusii: Ninsarie kegima ebitunwa na ebigoro, ninyomie ebimeri biabo bionsi; ning’onchore chindooche chibe ense enyomo, ninkamie amatibo.”
english: I will lay waste the mountains and hills and dry up all their vegetation; I will turn rivers into islands and dry up the pools.

ekegusii: Ninsarie ense ya Patirosi esire ebe bosa, ninsambe Soani nomorero, na inachere omochie okorokwa No ekina.
english: I will lay waste Upper Egypt, set fire to Zoan and inflict punishment on Thebes.

ekegusii: “Nindaae abanto bare emeuko ase enchera batana komanya, nimbatang’ane ase oboeto batana komanya. Ning’onchore omosunte ore bosio bwabo obe oborabu, aase atareng’aini naaranigwe. Ayio naro ndabakorere, tingotiga goikerania amang’ana aane.
english: I will lead the blind by ways they have not known, along unfamiliar paths I will guide them; I will turn the darkness into light before them and make the rough places smooth. These are the things I will do; I will not forsake them.

ekegusii: Ningotugute ase erooro, aye amo ne chinswe chionsi chie chindooche chiao. Omobere oo nogwe ase egetii aarabu. Aye tokorusigwao oirwe; ninkorue obe endagera ye ching’iti chi’orosana na eye chinyoni.
english: I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams. You will fall on the open field and not be gathered or picked up. I will give you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the air.

ekegusii: Ekero ngochia gwetoora, nigo nkorara chitoro inde nomorembe, ekiagera aye Omonene, naye okogera imenye ase okorendwa okuya.
english: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for you alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.

ekegusii: Ninyimokie egekombe ki’ogotooreka, ndangerie erieta ri’Omonene.
english: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: Nimbe nkoigwa amang’ana Omonene Nyasae agokwana; ere nigo agokwana amang’ana ’omorembe ase abanto baye abachenu, tobatiga baonchokere oboriri naende.
english: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; he promises peace to his people, his saints-- but let them not return to folly.

ekegusii: Inche ning’use Sisera, omotang’ani bw’emeganda y’esegi, amo ne chigari chiaye na emeganda yaye, gocha asore, ase orooche rwa Kisoni, na aroro nimobeke ase amaboko ao.”
english: I will lure Sisera, the commander of Jabin's army, with his chariots and his troops to the Kishon River and give him into your hands.'"

ekegusii: Obwanchani bwane botari koera nimoborendere kare na kare, na okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nkorete nere ngotenene bokong’u.
english: I will maintain my love to him forever, and my covenant with him will never fail.

ekegusii: Nimbwaterere bokong’u oboronge bwane, tinkobotiga, enkoro yane tekongambia ase amatuko ande inde moyo.”
english: I will maintain my righteousness and never let go of it; my conscience will not reproach me as long as I live.

ekegusii: Ninkore okobwatana kw’omorembe amo nabarabwo; okwo nigo korabe ogwa kare na kare. Nimbabeke aroro, mbamentekanie. Nimbeke Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe ase egati yabo kogenderera botambe.
english: I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant. I will establish them and increase their numbers, and I will put my sanctuary among them forever.

ekegusii: Ninkore ogwatananeka egati y’abanto baane na abao. Ankio egekone eke nagekoreke.”
english: I will make a distinction between my people and your people. This miraculous sign will occur tomorrow.'"

ekegusii: Ninkore amo nabarabwo okobwatana kw’ogotianania kogenderera botambe, erinde tinkoonchoka ntige kobakorera amaya. Nimbeke obwoba ime ase chinkoro chiabo banyiroke, erinde tibabaisa koonchoka bantige.
english: I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never stop doing good to them, and I will inspire them to fear me, so that they will never turn away from me.

ekegusii: Nigo agoteba: “Nimbeke abasae babe abanene babo, na abataraisana kogamba babagambere.”
english: I will make boys their officials; mere children will govern them.

ekegusii: Ninyoisie na gotindia abanene b’oboruoti bwa Babeli na abanto baye abang’aini; na abagambi baye, na abachiki baye, na abarwani baye chituoni. Barabwo mbarare chitoro chintambe, tibaboka. Nabo inche omoruoti inde Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteba.”
english: I will make her officials and wise men drunk, her governors, officers and warriors as well; they will sleep forever and not awake," declares the King, whose name is the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Ninyotige ogenderere gosareka; emesabibu tegososwa gose koburugerwa; amageri na amagwa mbikineo na koyotuba; boigo ninchike amare tayotweria embura.
english: I will make it a wasteland, neither pruned nor cultivated, and briers and thorns will grow there. I will command the clouds not to rain on it."

ekegusii: Ninkore ekeene kebe ekerengo gi’okorenga, na oboronge bobe ekebiro gekorenga. “Nindete embura y’amagena yabuse kegima oborimo bore obotamero bwaino, na emegoko ebonganie obwebiso bwaino.”
english: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the plumb line; hail will sweep away your refuge, the lie, and water will overflow your hiding place.

ekegusii: Ninkore omobaro o mwanyabanto obe omoke kobua oyo bw’etahabu echenire, ee, omobaro obo nobe omoke kobua oyo bw’etahabu ekorwa Ofiri.
english: I will make man scarcer than pure gold, more rare than the gold of Ophir.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eye ninsarie kegima Egetunwa gia Seiri kebe bosa tikemenywa naende, ng’ite kera omonto oyogosoa aroro, na oyogosoka korwao.
english: I will make Mount Seir a desolate waste and cut off from it all who come and go.

ekegusii: Nintindie emegwe yane namanyinga, omoro one oite abanto, oigote chinyama chi’abwo baitirwe, na amanyinga ’abooswa na emetwe y’abatang’ani b’ababisa.”
english: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, while my sword devours flesh: the blood of the slain and the captives, the heads of the enemy leaders."

ekegusii: Nindete chindooche korwa ase ebigoro ebiomo, ne chinsoko nchituboke ase amagoko ime; ning’onchore erooro ebe ritibo ri’amache, na ense enyomo ebe ne chinsoko chire namache.
english: I will make rivers flow on barren heights, and springs within the valleys. I will turn the desert into pools of water, and the parched ground into springs.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana emeganda ye ching’enang’eni chia igoro na omokenye ore nyancha bitanyare kobarwa, naboigo ororeria rwa Daudi, omosomba one, na orw’Abalawi abakuani bagonkorera, rotanyare kobarwa, ekiagerainche nindomente na korobuchia.”
english: I will make the descendants of David my servant and the Levites who minister before me as countless as the stars of the sky and as measureless as the sand on the seashore.'"

ekegusii: I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah.
english: Ninkore ab’enyomba y’Ahabu buna ab’enyomba ya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, na buna ab’enyomba ya Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya.

ekegusii: Nintige abare ebirema babe abatigari, na abwo baseretigwe babe egesaku kere ne chinguru. Omonene nabagambere agwo ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, korwa bono na goika kare na kare.
english: I will make the lame a remnant, those driven away a strong nation. The LORD will rule over them in Mount Zion from that day and forever.

ekegusii: Ninsarie ense eyio ebe bosa kegima, ne chinguru chiabo echio chibaenenetie nchiere pi. Ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli mbitigare bosa, monto onde takoba ogoetera aroro.
english: I will make the land a desolate waste, and her proud strength will come to an end, and the mountains of Israel will become desolate so that no one will cross them.

ekegusii: Ninsirie ense eyio ebe bosa, ekiagera bakorire aya atari ay’obwegenwa. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: I will make the land desolate because they have been unfaithful, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Ninsarie ense ya Misiri kegima ebe bosa ase egati ye chinse chinde chisaregete. Emechie yao negenderere koba esaregete ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene agwo ase egati y’emechie ende eng’anyire egatigwa ere bosa. Ninsiarere Abamisiri gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, mbaserie gochia ase chinse ao ao.
english: I will make the land of Egypt desolate among devastated lands, and her cities will lie desolate forty years among ruined cities. And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them through the countries.

ekegusii: Rora, ase ekerengero gie chinsa ki’Ahasi ninkore omorengari oria otambeire ekero erioba riereerire oirane gochia nyuma ebitambokero ikomi.” Ase ayio erioba rikairania omorengari oye ebitambokero ikomi ase ekerengero keria.
english: I will make the shadow cast by the sun go back the ten steps it has gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.'" So the sunlight went back the ten steps it had gone down.

ekegusii: Nere omwana bw’omokungu oyo omosomba nimokore abe egesaku ekenene, ekiagera nere oyio nomwana oo.”
english: I will make the son of the maidservant into a nation also, because he is your offspring."

ekegusii: Abakungu ababoraka batigaire abange mono kobua omokenye o nyancha; narentire abaiti baitire abamura mobaso gati na batigire abang’ina bare bosa; narentire obororo na omoondoko gocha igoro asebare mobosokano.
english: I will make their widows more numerous than the sand of the sea. At midday I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of their young men; suddenly I will bring down on them anguish and terror.

ekegusii: Nindete amabe amanene igoro asebare, na abanto b’amaruoti onsi mbaichanigwe na koondoka ekero barabarore, ekiagera nimbatige bachaywe na gosekererwa, naende babe omorabaaro ne ring’ana rigokwanwa bobe, na abanto mbabe bakoragereria ase erieta riabo.
english: I will make them abhorrent and an offense to all the kingdoms of the earth, a reproach and a byword, an object of ridicule and cursing, wherever I banish them.

ekegusii: Ninkore amagambi onsi are ase ense aichanigwe na koondoka ase amang’ana arabanyore ase engencho y’obobe obwo Manase, mosinto bwa Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akorete agwo Yerusalemu.
english: I will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth because of what Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah did in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Nintige abanto barie emebere y’abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, ee, kera omonto narie omobere bw’omogisangio oye ase engaki eyio y’emechando eria ababisa babo na abanto baria bakorigia gosiria obogima bwabo bararente asebare.”
english: I will make them eat the flesh of their sons and daughters, and they will eat one another's flesh during the stress of the siege imposed on them by the enemies who seek their lives.'

ekegusii: Nimbakore babe egesaku ekemo ase ense eyio, agwo ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli. Omoruoti oyomo nabe okogambera bonsi. Tibakogenderera koba ebisaku bibere, gose gwatananeka babe amaruoti abere.
english: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. There will be one king over all of them and they will never again be two nations or be divided into two kingdoms.

ekegusii: Rora, nakoeire abande b’esinagogi ya Saitani, abwo bagoteba ng’a n’Abayahudi bare, ko tibari bo, korende nabanyaborimo. Rora, nimbarente bache batung’ame ase amagoro ao, na bamanye ng’a ningwanchete.
english: I will make those who are of the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews though they are not, but are liars-- I will make them come and fall down at your feet and acknowledge that I have loved you.

ekegusii: Ninkoonchore obe egetare gioka ase abarubi bakwanekera ebionga biabo. Aye Turo tokoagachwa naende, ekiagera ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: I will make you a bare rock, and you will become a place to spread fishnets. You will never be rebuilt, for I the LORD have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Inche ningokore obe orwaki orokong’u rw’etaai ase abanto aba. Barabwo mbakorwanie esegi, korende tibagokobua, ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye, ngokonye na kogotooria. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: I will make you a wall to this people, a fortified wall of bronze; they will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you to rescue and save you," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninkoonchore ogenderere koba bosa botambe, na emechie yao tekomenywa naende. Erio nario moramanye ng’a ninche Omonene.
english: I will make you desolate forever; your towns will not be inhabited. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: I will make you very fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.
english: Ninkomente obe nororeria oronge mono, ninkore ebisaku ebinge birue asore, na abaruoti nabarue asore boigo.

ekegusii: Ning’agache emerobiri yao namagena akorokwa agati, na ebiita biao mbiagache namagena akorokwa sumaridi, ne chindwaki chiao chionsi nchiagache namagena ande e rigori rinene.”
english: I will make your battlements of rubies, your gates of sparkling jewels, and all your walls of precious stones.

ekegusii: Nimente ororeria rwao robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro; ne chinse echi chionsi ninchiee ororeria rwao; na ase ororeria rwao ebisaku bionsi bi’ense inabisesenigwe,
english: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed,

ekegusii: Ee, nakorire obosio bwao igoro bobe obokong’u buna rigena rikorokwa elimasi, rire rikong’u kobua amagena ande. Tobairoka gose koboboa ekero orarore amasio abo, ekiagera abwo nigo bare egesaku getari koigwera.”
english: I will make your forehead like the hardest stone, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or terrified by them, though they are a rebellious house."

ekegusii: Ninkore enyomba yao ebe buna eya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, naende ebe buna enyomba ya Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya, ekiagera kwangechirie goika nabeire nendamwamu, naende kwagerire Abaisraeli bakorire ebibe.
english: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and that of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have provoked me to anger and have caused Israel to sin.'

ekegusii: Ninkore ororeria rwao robe buna orotu rw’ense rotanyare kobareka; onye omonto okonyara kobara orotu rw’ense, rirorio nanyare kobara ororeria rwao narororwo.
english: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust, then your offspring could be counted.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakogochanda nimbabetererie barie chinyama chi’emebere yabo abanyene, na banywe amanyinga abo, abatindie buna edivai egotindia. Erio abanto bonsi mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene inde Omotooria oo, na Omobooria oo, Omonguru o Yakobo.”
english: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine. Then all mankind will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob."

ekegusii: Inche nimbwatanie oromeme rwao namang’ang’ura, na aye obe rimama osinywe kobakurera; barabwo nigo bare egesaku getari koigwera.
english: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth so that you will be silent and unable to rebuke them, though they are a rebellious house.

ekegusii: Nimbe nkorengereria igoro y’emeremo yao yonsi, na imbe nkona‐koiranerera ogokora kwao gwe chinguru.
english: I will meditate on all your works and consider all your mighty deeds.

ekegusii: Abe aare korwa asende kobabara ng’a nabanyaboronge more; goika ogokwa kwane ningenderere goteba ng’a tindi nokomocha.
english: I will never admit you are in the right; till I die, I will not deny my integrity.

ekegusii: Inche tinkonyara kweba amachiko ao, ekiagera aye kwang’eire obogima oboyia goetera ase aro.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.

ekegusii: I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.
english: inche tingoseria nonya nomonto oyomo bw’ebisaku ebio Yoshua atasaretie ritang’ani atarakwa.

ekegusii: Bono tinkobisa obosio bwane naende korwa asebare. Ning’umore omoika one igoro y’Abaisraeli. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: I will no longer hide my face from them, for I will pour out my Spirit on the house of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Tinkogenderera koamererania gose koba nendamwamu kare na kare. Inse gokora bo, emeika yabo amo nemioyo eyio natongete, nigo eragireke ase obosio bwane.
english: I will not accuse forever, nor will I always be angry, for then the spirit of man would grow faint before me-- the breath of man that I have created.

ekegusii: Onye Abaisraeli bagochia korenda na gokora onsi aya nabachigete, na babwate amachiko onsi na emeroberio yonsi echikire goetera ase Musa, rirorio tingotiga Abaisraeli barue ase ense eye naete chisokoro chiabo.”
english: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites leave the land I assigned to your forefathers, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them concerning all the laws, decrees and ordinances given through Moses."

ekegusii: Onye Abaisraeli bagochia korenda na gokora aya onsi nabachigete koreng’ana namachiko ayio Musa, omosomba one, abaete, rirorio tingotiga naende Abaisraeli barue ase ense eye naete chisokoro chiabo.”
english: I will not again make the feet of the Israelites wander from the land I gave their forefathers, if only they will be careful to do everything I commanded them and will keep the whole Law that my servant Moses gave them."

ekegusii: Tinkobaa egesusuro konde nendamwamu egwoka, gose tingosiria Abaefraimu naende, ekiagera inche nigo inde Nyasae, tindi mwanyabanto. Inche nigo inde Omochenu imenyete ase egati yaino, na tingocha asemore inde nekeririanda.
english: I will not carry out my fierce anger, nor will I turn and devastate Ephraim. For I am God, and not man-- the Holy One among you. I will not come in wrath.

ekegusii: Inche tingokwa, korende nimbe moyo, erinde ndarie ogokora kw’Omonene.
english: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the LORD has done.

ekegusii: Tindi koiroka ababisa chilifu chinyinge, abwo bakonyimokera ase chinsemo chiane chionsi.
english: I will not fear the tens of thousands drawn up against me on every side.

ekegusii: “Tinkobatiga inwe buna chintakana; ninchiche asemore.
english: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.

ekegusii: Tinkoombia ng’a timbarochi, gose tinkobarorera amabera, korende nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino, na ogokora kwaino gw’okogechia nkobairanere. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene nabaakire.
english: I will not look on you with pity or spare you; I will repay you in accordance with your conduct and the detestable practices among you. Then you will know that it is I the LORD who strikes the blow.

ekegusii: Tinkoombia ng’a tinkorochi, gose tingokororera amabera, korende ninkoe egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwao, na ogokora kwao gw’okogechia ngokoiranere. Erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: I will not look on you with pity or spare you; I will surely repay you for your conduct and the detestable practices among you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Tinkororera abana baye amabera, ekiagera nigo bare abana b’omokungu omotayayi.
english: I will not show my love to her children, because they are the children of adultery.

ekegusii: Tingokwana nainwe amana’ana amange naende, ekiagera omonene bw’ense ngocha are. Tari nokobua asende;
english: I will not speak with you much longer, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no hold on me,

ekegusii: Naki tinkonyara gwatora ring’ana rinde otatiga eri Kristo akorete goetera ase emeremo yane, erinde abanto b’Ebisaku banyare koigwera ase engencho ye ring’ana na ogokora,
english: I will not venture to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obey God by what I have said and done--

ekegusii: Tinkonyara gosaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, gose tinkoonchora ring’ana nakwanire nomonwa one.
english: I will not violate my covenant or alter what my lips have uttered.

ekegusii: Ninyigwere amachiko ao; tobaisa gontiga.
english: I will obey your decrees; do not utterly forsake me.

ekegusii: Inche ninkwane ase omoreng’anio, nigo ndakwane ase emebayeno ya kare,
english: I will open my mouth in parables, I will utter hidden things, things from of old--

ekegusii: Ning’onchorane ebirogo bi’obonene bw’abaruoti, ninsirie chinguru chi’amaruoti ’abanto b’ebisaku. Ning’onchorane chigari na abachiriini; chibarasi nchigwe amo nabachiriinete, kera omonto naite oyomwabo nomoro.
english: I will overturn royal thrones and shatter the power of the foreign kingdoms. I will overthrow chariots and their drivers; horses and their riders will fall, each by the sword of his brother.

ekegusii: I will pelt you with filth, I will treat you with contempt and make you a spectacle.
english: “Ningosiarere eubi y’okogechia, ningotige ochaywe, nobe gokorigererigwa na gosekererigwa.

ekegusii: Ninkore erieta riao ribe rikoinyorwa nebiaare bionsi; ase ayio, abanto b’ebisaku mbabe bakogotogia goika kare na kare.
english: I will perpetuate your memory through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Nimbeke ekeigorero ki’enyomba ya Daudi ase amareko aye; ere nabe okoigora, na onde tari oranyare gosieka; nabe ogosieka na onde tari oranyare koigora.
english: I will place on his shoulder the key to the house of David; what he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

ekegusii: I will place over them one shepherd, my servant David, and he will tend them; he will tend them and be their shepherd.
english: Ninchibekere omorisia oyomo achirisie, nere Daudi, omosomba one. Ere nachirisie, abe omorisia obo.

ekegusii: Nimbabekere abarisia, abwo barabarende, na abanto baane tibakoba nobwoba nonya ng’ake, gose tibakoondoka, gose onde takonyara gosira. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: I will place shepherds over them who will tend them, and they will no longer be afraid or terrified, nor will any be missing," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Nimosimeke ase ense eye abe oyone. Nimororere amabera oyio otaroreretwe amabera, nintebie abwo batarenge abanto baane: Bono inwe nabanto baane, na barabwo mbatebe: Aye naye Nyasae oito.”
english: I will plant her for myself in the land; I will show my love to the one I called 'Not my loved one. 'I will say to those called 'Not my people, ''You are my people'; and they will say, 'You are my God.'"

ekegusii: Nimbairanie mbabeke bamenye ase ense yabo, tibagotegorwa korwa ase ense eyio nabaete.” Nabo Omonene, Nyasae oino, atebire.
english: I will plant Israel in their own land, never again to be uprooted from the land I have given them," says the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Norengererie gochia gosakora na kwenyorera ebinto ase okorambora okoboko kwao gochia aase arenge bosa na bono amenyirwe nabanto. Ee, norambore okoboko kwao gochia ase abanto basangereretigwe korwa ase ebisaku ao ao, na bono mbabwate chitugo na ebinto ebinge, agwo ase bamenyete egati‐gati y’ense.
english: I will plunder and loot and turn my hand against the resettled ruins and the people gathered from the nations, rich in livestock and goods, living at the center of the land."

ekegusii: Ning’umore ekeririanda kiane igoro y’omochie o Sini, oria ore obotamero obokong’u bwa Misiri; ninsirie emeganda ya No.
english: I will pour out my wrath on Pelusium, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the hordes of Thebes.

ekegusii: Nimbaumorere ekeririanda kiane, na mbautere omorero bw’endamwamu yane; nimbabeke ase amaboko ’abanto abatindi, abamanyete goita na gosiria kegima.
english: I will pour out my wrath upon you and breathe out my fiery anger against you; I will hand you over to brutal men, men skilled in destruction.

ekegusii: Nintogie erieta ria Nyasae ase okomoterera; nindarie obonene bwaye ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
english: I will praise God's name in song and glorify him with thanksgiving.

ekegusii: Nimbe ngotogia Omonene kongendererete koba moyo, ninterere Nyasae one ase okomotogia kondagenderere kobao.
english: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

ekegusii: Nigo ngotogia Omonene oyo ogonsemia, ase obotuko enkoro yane nigo egontebereria gokora igo.
english: I will praise the LORD, who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.

ekegusii: Nimbe nkona‐kogotogia ase obogima bwane bwonsi, ase erieta riao nindambore amaboko aane gochia igoro.
english: I will praise you as long as I live, and in your name I will lift up my hands.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ngokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kare na kare, ekiagera gwakorire ayio. Ase amasio ’abanto bao bare abegenwa nindarie erieta riao, ekiagera nerigiya.
english: I will praise you forever for what you have done; in your name I will hope, for your name is good. I will praise you in the presence of your saints.

ekegusii: Ekero ndabe neorokereirie okogamba kwao kw’oboronge, rirorio nimbe nkona‐kogotogia nenkoro endonge.
english: I will praise you with an upright heart as I learn your righteous laws.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, nimbe nkobugia obokano ase okogotogia, ekiagera aye nigo ore omwegenwa. Nimbe nkogoterera ase okobugia obokano bw’ebirigisa, aye Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: I will praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to you with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae one, nigo nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono nenkoro yane yonsi, nindarie obonene bw’erieta riao goika kare na kare.
english: I will praise you, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify your name forever.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase egati y’abanto ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, nimbe ngotera amatera ay’okogotogia ase egati y’ebisaku.
english: I will praise you, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono ase egati y’abanto, nimbe ngotera amatera ay’okogotogia ase egati y’ebisaku.
english: I will praise you, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

ekegusii: Nintogonyere ebigosaria okwama kwe riroba riaino, tibigosaria, gose amasabibu aino takoaroroka kare amarere. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteba.
english: I will prevent pests from devouring your crops, and the vines in your fields will not cast their fruit," says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Omoruoti otebire, “Nindarie amang’ana Omonene aroberetie. Ere agantebia: Aye naye Omwana one, rero nakoiboire.
english: I will proclaim the decree of the LORD: He said to me, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father.

ekegusii: Inche nindarie erieta ri’Omonene. Inwe motogie Nyasae oito!”
english: I will proclaim the name of the LORD. Oh, praise the greatness of our God!

ekegusii: Ninachere abanto b’aroro ekina mbae egesusuro ase engencho y’obobe bwabo, ekiagera bantigire inche, basambeire chinyasae ching’ao ubani, naende basasimire emeremo y’amaboko abo.
english: I will pronounce my judgments on my people because of their wickedness in forsaking me, in burning incense to other gods and in worshiping what their hands have made.

ekegusii: Nimbamererie ebimeri bibe ogotogigwa okuya; barabwo mbamenye ase ense eyio, na enchara tekobaria ebaite, gose tibakoba bagochaywa nabanto batamomanyeti Nyasae.
english: I will provide for them a land renowned for its crops, and they will no longer be victims of famine in the land or bear the scorn of the nations.

ekegusii: Agwo inche ninkoragerie, erinde tobaisa gocha gosoa ase okoremerwa, aye amo nabanto bao, na bionsi ebi ore nabio, ekiagera emiaka etano y’enchara netigarete.
english: I will provide for you there, because five years of famine are still to come. Otherwise you and your household and all who belong to you will become destitute.'

ekegusii: Nabae obonyansi ase ebitii ase chitugo chiaino chikorisia. Inwe nigo moranyore endagera mokoria, moigote.
english: I will provide grass in the fields for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied.

ekegusii: Inche omonyene nimbasiorie chianga chiaino chiike amasio aino igoro, erinde obogetirianda bwaino bororekane.
english: I will pull up your skirts over your face that your shame may be seen--

ekegusii: Ning’ee enyasae Beli ya Babeli egesusuro, nindusie korwa ase omonwa oye ebi yamerete. Ebisaku tibikogenderera gocha ase enyasae eyio. “Chindwaki chia Babeli chiagure.
english: I will punish Bel in Babylon and make him spew out what he has swallowed. The nations will no longer stream to him. And the wall of Babylon will fall.

ekegusii: Ning’ee omokungu oyio egesusuro ase engencho y’amatuko ayio akorerete chinyasae chiria Baali emeyega, agachisambera ubani, naende agechabera ebigera bi’amato na ebinto binde bi’ogwechabera, ekero arenge gotunyana abanchi baye, korende akanyeba.” Nabo Omonene agoteba.
english: I will punish her for the days she burned incense to the Baals; she decked herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers, but me she forgot," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ere amo nororeria rwaye na abasomba baye nimbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo. Nindete igoro asebare, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, na Abayuda, amabe onsi aria nakwanete ng’a nimbayarentere, nonya nabo bakaanga koigwera.”
english: I will punish him and his children and his attendants for their wickedness; I will bring on them and those living in Jerusalem and the people of Judah every disaster I pronounced against them, because they have not listened.'"

ekegusii: Inche Omonene ning’ee ense egesusuro ase engencho y’obobe bwaye, na abanyabibe ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo. Ninsirie obomwenu bw’abwo bare abatindi, ninkeyie oboenenu bw’abaichire nobochege.
english: I will punish the world for its evil, the wicked for their sins. I will put an end to the arrogance of the haughty and will humble the pride of the ruthless.

ekegusii: rirorio nimbae egesusuro, mbaake nenyimbo ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo, na mbang’wanie ebiranya ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
english: I will punish their sin with the rod, their iniquity with flogging;

ekegusii: Nindue egesusuro ase abanto bamenyete ase ense ya Misiri, buna nakorete ase abanto ba Yerusalemu; nimbasirie ase ogoitwa nemioro, na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita.
english: I will punish those who live in Egypt with the sword, famine and plague, as I punished Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Inche nimbae egesusuro koreng’ana nokwama kw’ogokora kwaino. Nabo inche Omonene natebire. Nintongie omorero ase rinani ri’omochie oyio, ninsambe ebinto bionsi biyoetanaine.”
english: I will punish you as your deeds deserve, declares the LORD. I will kindle a fire in your forests that will consume everything around you.'"

ekegusii: Ninyatanane korwa asemore abatari koigwera, na abasaririe asende. Nimbarusie korwa ase ense eria bare abamenyi, korende barabwo tibagosoa ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I will purge you of those who revolt and rebel against me. Although I will bring them out of the land where they are living, yet they will not enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Nimbatunyanerie esegi na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita. Nimbakore babe okoirokia ase amaruoti onsi are ase ense na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi ase ndabe nabaseririe gochia. Abanto nigo barabe bakoragereria ase erieta riaino, naende babe bagoichana na gokumia, babachaye.
english: I will pursue them with the sword, famine and plague and will make them abhorrent to all the kingdoms of the earth and an object of cursing and horror, of scorn and reproach, among all the nations where I drive them.

ekegusii: Ninsirie amariogi ’amatera are ime yao, na ay’amakano naro, taigugwa naende.
english: I will put an end to your noisy songs, and the music of your harps will be heard no more.

ekegusii: Nimerie emecharake ase erooro, boigo nimerie aroro emekonge, na emeadasi, na emezeituni. Ee, nimerie emetarakwa na emete
english: I will put in the desert the cedar and the acacia, the myrtle and the olive. I will set pines in the wasteland, the fir and the cypress together,

ekegusii: Egekombe ekio ninkebeke ase amaboko ay’abakogochanda, abwo bagotebirie: Ekumbe, toete igoro yao. Aye gwakorire omogongo oo koba buna riroba rigotachwa, naende buna enchera ase abanto bagoeta.”
english: I will put it into the hands of your tormentors, who said to you, 'Fall prostrate that we may walk over you.' And you made your back like the ground, like a street to be walked over."

ekegusii: Nimenye ase egati yaino ase Obomenyo bwane Obochenu; tinkobatiga nonya ng’ake.
english: I will put my dwelling place among you, and I will not abhor you.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Nimbeke omoika one ime yaino, na inwe mobe moyo. Nimbarente, mbabeke ase ense yaino. Erio momanye ng’a ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio, boigo nayakorire.”
english: I will put my Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I the LORD have spoken, and I have done it, declares the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Inche Omonene naimokirie Koresi ase oboronge, nindongeyie chinchera chiaye chionsi; ere naagache omochie one, nasibore abanto baane boosetwe barue ase obosomba, tagoakanwa kende, gose koegwa ng’eria ende.” Omonene bw’Emeganda nere otebire ayio.
english: I will raise up Cyrus in my righteousness: I will make all his ways straight. He will rebuild my city and set my exiles free, but not for a price or reward, says the LORD Almighty."

ekegusii: Ninyechorere omokuani omwegenwa, oyorabe ogokora ogwancha kwane na onsi aya nganetie. Oyio nere ndae ororeria rwaye rorabe rogotenena bokong’u, na abanto b’ororeria rwaye mbagenderere gokora emeremo y’obokuani ase obosio bw’omoakwa amaguta one.
english: I will raise up for myself a faithful priest, who will do according to what is in my heart and mind. I will firmly establish his house, and he will minister before my anointed one always.

ekegusii: Korwa ase egati y’abamwabo nimbaimokerie omobani onga buna aye, nimbeke amang’ana aane ase omonwa oye, nere nabatebie ayio onsi ndamochike.
english: I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brothers; I will put my words in his mouth, and he will tell them everything I command him.

ekegusii: Nintimokie na goisanekia abanto abwo barosire; na kera omonto ogoyire nimoisanekie na komoigotia.”
english: I will refresh the weary and satisfy the faint."

ekegusii: Nimbe nomogoko omonene ase okobakorera amaya, nimbasimeke ase ense eye imbe nobwegenwa bw’enkoro yane yonsi na omoyo one bwonsi.”
english: I will rejoice in doing them good and will assuredly plant them in this land with all my heart and soul.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene ninchengere Yerusalemu na kogokera abanto baane; eriogi ri’ebirero tirikoigugwa ase Yerusalemu nonya ng’ake, gose okorera kw’emechando.
english: I will rejoice over Jerusalem and take delight in my people; the sound of weeping and of crying will be heard in it no more.

ekegusii: Inche tinkoba ase ense ime naende, korende aba nao bare ase ense ime, na inche ngocha nde asore. Tata Omochenu, obarende ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete, babe abamo buna intwe tore oyomo.
english: I will remain in the world no longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by the power of your name-- the name you gave me-- so that they may be one as we are one.

ekegusii: erio nimbe nkoinyora okobwatana kwane, okwo nakorire egati yane nainwe, amo na kera egetongwa kere moyo. Amache takoba naende etoigo egosaria ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo.
english: I will remember my covenant between me and you and all living creatures of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.

ekegusii: erio nario ndainyore okobwatana kwane k’wogotianania okwo nakorete na Yakobo, na Isaka, na Ibrahimu, naende ning’inyore ense eria nabaete.
english: I will remember my covenant with Jacob and my covenant with Isaac and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

ekegusii: Ning’inyore ogokora kwao aye Omonene; ee, ning’inyore amakumia ao a kare.
english: I will remember the deeds of the LORD; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

ekegusii: Nindusie amarieta e chinyasae Baali korwa ase omonwa bw’omokungu oyio, tichiatorwa nonya ng’ake ase amarieta abo.
english: I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips; no longer will their names be invoked.

ekegusii: Nimbae egesusuro ara kabere ase engencho y’obobe na ebibe biabo, ekiagera bakorire ense ere omwando one koba eyetachenegeti ase okoyeichoria nemegwekano y’okogechia etari moyo.”
english: I will repay them double for their wickedness and their sin, because they have defiled my land with the lifeless forms of their vile images and have filled my inheritance with their detestable idols."

ekegusii: Nimbairanerie ebi’emiaka eria biasaretigwe ne chinyanchaba, ne chingige, na ebisase, ne chingeeti, omoganda oyio omonene natomete gocha ase egati yaino.
english: 'I will repay you for the years the locusts have eaten-- the great locust and the young locust, the other locusts and the locust swarm--my great army that I sent among you.

ekegusii: Ningotoorie korwa ase abanto bao, na korwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku, ase abwo ndagotome.
english: I will rescue you from your own people and from the Gentiles. I am sending you to them

ekegusii: Nimbae naende abagambi ebina buna baria be ritang’ani, na abasemia buna baria ba kare. Nyuma y’ayio norokwe Omochie bw’Oboronge, na Omochie bw’Obwegenwa.”
english: I will restore your judges as in days of old, your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you will be called the City of Righteousness, the Faithful City."

ekegusii: Ninsirie emesabibu yaye, na emeko yaye, ebio akwanete igoro yabo, agateba ng’a eyio nero eng’eria yaye abanchi baye bamoete. Inche ninsirie emete eyio ebe orosana, ne ching’iti chi’orosana chiyerie.
english: I will ruin her vines and her fig trees, which she said were her pay from her lovers; I will make them a thicket, and wild animals will devour them.

ekegusii: Omonene, ninkoruere ekeng’wanso inde nenkoro y’ogwancha, nimbe nkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, ekiagera nerigiya.
english: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you; I will praise your name, O LORD, for it is good.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nindue asore ekeng’wanso ki’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, naende ndangerie erieta ri’Omonene nkonywe.
english: I will sacrifice a thank offering to you and call on the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninkorentere ching’iti chire chinoru chibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ninchirue amo nekeng’wanso gie chimingichi kere ne rimisu rigiya. Nindue ne chieri ne chimbori chibe ebing’wanso.
english: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah

ekegusii: Ninyigotie na goisanekia abakuani nebinto ebinoru; abanto baane mbaisaneke nobuya bwane. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: I will satisfy the priests with abundance, and my people will be filled with my bounty," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nintoorie ching’ondi chiane, gose tichikoba chigotwarwa buna ching’iti. Ninache ekina ase egati y’eng’ondi na eng’ondi ende.
english: I will save my flock, and they will no longer be plundered. I will judge between one sheep and another.

ekegusii: Nimbatoorie korwa ase ogotacheneka kwaino gwonsi. Nimbarentere endagera, inyementekanie mono, tingotiga enchara eche asemore.
english: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will call for the grain and make it plentiful and will not bring famine upon you.

ekegusii: Ekeene, inche ningotoorie togoitwa nomoro. Aye notooreke togoitwa ase esegi, ekiagera aye nigo onsemeretie inche. Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: I will save you; you will not fall by the sword but will escape with your life, because you trust in me, declares the LORD.'"

ekegusii: oyio nigo aranyare goteba, “Omonene nere obotamero bwane, na orwaki rwane, nere Nyasae one oyo nsemeretie.”
english: I will say of the LORD, "He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust."

ekegusii: I will say to God: Do not condemn me, but tell me what charges you have against me.
english: Ninkwane, ntebie Nyasae: Tobaisa kongambia; imanyie egekogera aye okondwania iga.

ekegusii: Nintebie chinse chia sugusu: Tiga abanto baane barue agwo, ne chinse chia irianyi: Timobatanga! Renta abamura baane korwa aare, na abaiseke baane korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
english: I will say to the north, 'Give them up!' and to the south, 'Do not hold them back.' Bring my sons from afar and my daughters from the ends of the earth--

ekegusii: Nimbaserie gochia ase ebisaku ebio barabwo gose chisokoro chiabo chitabimanyete, nimbatomere abarwani esegi bare nemioro babaite babasirie kegima.”
english: I will scatter them among nations that neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will pursue them with the sword until I have destroyed them."

ekegusii: Ninsiarere gochia ase chinsemo chionsi abanto bonsi abamoetanaine ase okomokonya, na abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi boigo, naende nimbabwatie nomoro one.
english: I will scatter to the winds all those around him-- his staff and all his troops-- and I will pursue them with drawn sword.

ekegusii: Nimbaserebanie mogende komenya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, nimbatunyanerie esegi, naende ninsarie ense yaino ebe bosa, na emechie ebe amatongo.
english: I will scatter you among the nations and will draw out my sword and pursue you. Your land will be laid waste, and your cities will lie in ruins.

ekegusii: “Echiasirete ninchirigie nchinyore, na echio chiaserebekanete nchiiranie asende; echibunegete ninchiboere ebitete, na echire chindeu ninchibeke chinguru; korende echire chinoru naende chire ne chinguru ninchisirie, ee, ninchigambie ekina kia boronge.
english: I will search for the lost and bring back the strays. I will bind up the injured and strengthen the weak, but the sleek and the strong I will destroy. I will shepherd the flock with justice.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene, ning’oonie abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, ase Abayuda, na barabwo babaoonie ase abanto ba Seba, abwo bamenyete aare mono. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.”
english: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, a nation far away.' The LORD has spoken.

ekegusii: Nindete oborwaire bogoita ime yao, na amanyinga aiteke ase chinchera chiao. Norwanigwe esegi korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, na abanto baitwe bakwere ase egati yao. Erio abanto mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I will send a plague upon her and make blood flow in her streets. The slain will fall within her, with the sword against her on every side. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Nintome omomalaika agotang’ane, aserie Abakanani, na Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi na Abayebusi.
english: I will send an angel before you and drive out the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

ekegusii: Nintome abanto bache kogosiria; kera oyomo agochere obwate ebirwanero biaye bi’esegi, nabarabwo nabageche emete y’emecharake, eria ere emiya mono asemore, na bayerute ase omorero.
english: I will send destroyers against you, each man with his weapons, and they will cut up your fine cedar beams and throw them into the fire.

ekegusii: Nintome enchara ne ching’iti chi’orosana asore, ebio mbiite abana bao; boigo ningotomere amarwaire agoita na ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga amo nomoro. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.”
english: I will send famine and wild beasts against you, and they will leave you childless. Plague and bloodshed will sweep through you, and I will bring the sword against you. I the LORD have spoken."

ekegusii: Nintome omorero osambe ense ya Magogi amo nabanto abwo begaarete bare nobotoereru, agwo ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I will send fire on Magog and on those who live in safety in the coastlands, and they will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase ense y’Abayuda; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Yerusalemu.”
english: I will send fire upon Judah that will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem."

ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase ense ya Moabu; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Kerioti. Abamoabu mbakwe ase ebikuuro bi’esegi, na ase eriogi ri’ebitureri bi’esegi.
english: I will send fire upon Moab that will consume the fortresses of Kerioth. Moab will go down in great tumult amid war cries and the blast of the trumpet.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase omochie o Temani; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chia Bosira.”
english: I will send fire upon Teman that will consume the fortresses of Bozrah."

ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase enyomba ya Hasaeli; oro nosambe osirie kegima chinyomba chinkong’u chia Beni‐Hadadi.
english: I will send fire upon the house of Hazael that will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase chindwaki chia Gasa; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro.
english: I will send fire upon the walls of Gaza that will consume her fortresses.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nintome omorero ase chindwaki chia Turo; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro.”
english: I will send fire upon the walls of Tyre that will consume her fortresses."

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ri’emechando nintomere abanto ba Babeli abairuri babairure, batige ense yabo ebe bosa.
english: I will send foreigners to Babylon to winnow her and to devastate her land; they will oppose her on every side in the day of her disaster.

ekegusii: Nintome ebiaramba birase na goseria Abahivi, na Abakanani, na Abahiti, korwa ase Kanani bosio bwao.
english: I will send the hornet ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of your way.

ekegusii: Nimbatomere chisegi, baitwe nemioro, na abande bakwe nenchara na amarwaire. Mbasirigwe kegima, barue ase ense eyio nabaete barabwo ne chisokoro chiabo.”
english: I will send the sword, famine and plague against them until they are destroyed from the land I gave to them and their fathers.'"

ekegusii: Nabakwe ase engencho y’enchara ne riberera rikorura, nabariegwe namarwaire amabe agoita. Nimbatomere ching’iti chi’orosana chire namaino amooge chibarwanie, ne ching’iti chingenda inse chire nobosongo, chibarome.
english: I will send wasting famine against them, consuming pestilence and deadly plague; I will send against them the fangs of wild beasts, the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

ekegusii: Nimbatomere ching’iti chintindi chi’orosana chiite abana baino, ne chitugo chiaino, chibakeyie mobe abake goika chinchera chiaino chibe bosa.
english: I will send wild animals against you, and they will rob you of your children, destroy your cattle and make you so few in number that your roads will be deserted.

ekegusii: erio nimbatwerie embura ase engaki egwenerete, na ense inayaame endagera, na emete y’emegondo yaame amatunda.
english: I will send you rain in its season, and the ground will yield its crops and the trees of the field their fruit.

ekegusii: Momanye ng’a ninche Omonene ndasesenie ense yaino ase omwaka o gatano na rimo, erinde yaame endagera eraisane ase engaki y’emiaka etato.
english: I will send you such a blessing in the sixth year that the land will yield enough for three years.

ekegusii: Ninkonachere ekina buna abakungu basaririe chiira chi’okonyuomana kwabo na buna abaiteri amanyinga bakonacherwa ekina; amanyinga ao ninyaitere inde nendamwamu ne risemi.
english: I will sentence you to the punishment of women who commit adultery and who shed blood; I will bring upon you the blood vengeance of my wrath and jealous anger.

ekegusii: Tinkobeka ase obosio bwane ing’ana rinde rionsi ri’obobe; nigo ngechete ogokora kw’abanto bagotiga obwegenwa, tinkonyara kobwatwa ne chingencho chiabo.
english: I will set before my eyes no vile thing. The deeds of faithless men I hate; they will not cling to me.

ekegusii: Ninsambe Misiri nomorero; obororo obonge mboichanie Sini. No notagorwe ogwe inse, na Memifisi noumokerwe nababisa ekero kia mobaso.
english: I will set fire to Egypt; Pelusium will writhe in agony. Thebes will be taken by storm; Memphis will be in constant distress.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nintongie omorero ase chindwaki chia Raba; oro nosambe osirie chinyomba chinkong’u chi’aroro. Ase rituko erio ebikuuro bi’esegi mbiigugwe, boigo ndibe rituko ri’omwaga na ekembugu‐mbugu.
english: I will set fire to the walls of Rabbah that will consume her fortresses amid war cries on the day of battle, amid violent winds on a stormy day.

ekegusii: Korende nimokore agenderere kobeerao botambe ase enyomba yane, na ase oboruoti bwane, na obogambi bwaye bokong’igwe kobao botari nomoerio.”
english: I will set him over my house and my kingdom forever; his throne will be established forever.'"

ekegusii: I will set his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.
english: Nimbeke enyancha inse y’okoboko kwaye, ne chindooche nchibe inse y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.

ekegusii: erio inche omonyene nimbe nendamwamu ase omonto oyio na eamate yaye. Nimwatanane amo nabanto bonsi bamobwatirie, ekiagera bakoonchokera enyasae eria Moleki, ase okoyesasima, bakaba abatari abegenwa asende; nimbasirie korwa ase abanto baye.
english: I will set my face against that man and his family and will cut off from their people both him and all who follow him in prostituting themselves to Molech.

ekegusii: Inche omonyene nimbe nendamwamu ase omonto oyio, ekiagera orure omwana onde oye ase enyasae Moleki. Nimwatanane korwa ase abanto baye, ekiagera ogerire Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe obotachenegeti, na orenteire erieta riane richenu obosooku.
english: I will set my face against that man and I will cut him off from his people; for by giving his children to Molech, he has defiled my sanctuary and profaned my holy name.

ekegusii: Nigo ndamobee, erinde abe ekiorokererio na omobayeno ogokwanwa nabanto, naende imwatanane kegima korwa ase abanto baane. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I will set my face against that man and make him an example and a byword. I will cut him off from my people. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Nigo ndababee; nonya bagochia gotooreka korwa ase omorero, naende omorero noro orabasirie. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, nababeeire.
english: I will set my face against them. Although they have come out of the fire, the fire will yet consume them. And when I set my face against them, you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Nimbe mamincha yaino, na inwe namobugwe nababisa baino. Abanto babagechete nabwo barabagambere, na inwe namobugwe nababisa baino. Abanto babagechete nabwo barabagambere, na inwe mobe mogotama nonya monto onde tari okobabwatia.
english: I will set my face against you so that you will be defeated by your enemies; those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee even when no one is pursuing you.

ekegusii: Nimbeke oboikaranso bwane bw’obonene agwo ase ense y’Abaelamu, nsirie omoruoti obo amo nabanene babo b’oboruoti. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: I will set my throne in Elam and destroy her king and officials," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninyimoke, ngende ase tata, imotebie: Tata, namochire ase oyore igoro na ase obosio bwao,
english: I will set out and go back to my father and say to him: Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Boigo nintengechie ebisaku bionsi, erinde ayaganeirie nabanto b’ebisaku bionsi aoroke, na inche ing’ichorie enyomba yane nobonene.
english: I will shake all nations, and the desired of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory,' says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Ningere abanto b’Elamu boboe ababisa babo, boigo boboe nabanto baria bakorigia basirie obogima bwabo. Nimbarentere amabe, na endamwamu yane yoke igoro yabo. Nimbatunyanerie emioro, baitwe basirigwe kegima.
english: I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who seek their lives; I will bring disaster upon them, even my fierce anger," declares the LORD. "I will pursue them with the sword until I have made an end of them.

ekegusii: I will shoot three arrows to the side of it, as though I were shooting at a target.
english: Nindute emegwe etato gochia ang’e netui eria, buna negento nkorasa.

ekegusii: Inche nimworokie onsi ayaramogwenere gochandwa ase engencho y’erieta riane.”
english: I will show him how much he must suffer for my name."

ekegusii: I will show partiality to no one, nor will I flatter any man;
english: Inche tinkonyara gwanchereria monto onde bwensi, gose gokwana amang’ana ay’okweansia.’

ekegusii: Ninchene erieta riane rinene, erio riakoretwe rikaba eritachenegeti ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, erieta erio inwe mwakorete rikaba eritachenegeti ase egati yabo. Ekero ndeorokie ase amaiso abo ng’a nomochenu inde ase egati yaino, erio nario abanto b’ebisaku baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: I will show the holiness of my great name, which has been profaned among the nations, the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Sovereign LORD, when I show myself holy through you before their eyes.

ekegusii: Ning’orokie amakumia ase igoro, na ebikone ase ense inse, amanyinga na omorero, ne rikundesi ri’erioki.
english: I will show wonders in the heaven above and signs on the earth below, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

ekegusii: “Ning’orokie ebikone igoro na ase ense; amanyinga, na omorero, ne rikundesi ri’erioki.
english: I will show wonders in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and billows of smoke.

ekegusii: Nimbarorere amabera, ngere nere abarorere amabera, erinde abatige mogenderere komenya ase ense yaino.
english: I will show you compassion so that he will have compassion on you and restore you to your land.'

ekegusii: Kera omonto ogocha asende, na koigwa amang’ana aane, na koyakora, nimborokie buna are:
english: I will show you what he is like who comes to me and hears my words and puts them into practice.

ekegusii: “Nimbasime, mbasangererie amo, ekiagera nababooririe, na barabwo mbamentekane babe abange buna barenge kare.
english: I will signal for them and gather them in. Surely I will redeem them; they will be as numerous as before.

ekegusii: I will sing a new song to you, O God; on the ten-stringed lyre I will make music to you,
english: Aye Nyasae, ningoterere ogotera okoyia, ninkobugerie obokano bore ne chinga ikomi.

ekegusii: Bono nimoterere omwanchi one, nintere igoro y’omwanchi one na igoro y’omogondo oye bw’emesabibu. Omwanchi one nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu ase ekegoro egetobu.
english: I will sing for the one I love a song about his vineyard: My loved one had a vineyard on a fertile hillside.

ekegusii: Ninterere Omonene ase obogima bwane bwonsi, nimbe ngotera ase ogotogia Nyasae one ekero inde moyo.
english: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

ekegusii: Ningoterere aye Omonene, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya amange.
english: I will sing to the LORD, for he has been good to me.

ekegusii: Nimbatwomanie omonto ase omonto. Nintwomanie abaise na abana babo abamura, gose tinkobarorera amabeebe gose amabera ande onsi ng’a timbaita.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: I will smash them one against the other, fathers and sons alike, declares the LORD. I will allow no pity or mercy or compassion to keep me from destroying them.'"

ekegusii: Nindarie oborori bwao ase amasio ’abaruoti ntari nobosooku.
english: I will speak of your statutes before kings and will not be put to shame,

ekegusii: Nimobekere ekeonga kiane, abwatwe ase oboreba bwane; erio imoire Babeli, na aroro agwo imonachere ekina ase engencho y’okomocha kw’ogotaba omwegenwa asende.
english: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon and execute judgment upon him there because he was unfaithful to me.

ekegusii: Nimobekere ekeonga kiane abwatwe ase oboreba bwane; erio imoire Babeli, ase ense y’Abakalidayo; nonya naboigo takoyerora namaiso aye, korende nao arakwere.
english: I will spread my net for him, and he will be caught in my snare; I will bring him to Babylonia, the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it, and there he will die.

ekegusii: Nintugute chinyama chi’omobere oo ase ebitunwa igoro, na obogundo bwao boichore ase amagoko.
english: I will spread your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains.

ekegusii: Nimbanyororokerie amache amakenonoku, na inwe mocheneke korwa ase ogotacheneka kwaino gwonsi, na korwa ase emegwekano yaino mogosasima. Ee, nimbachene.
english: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean; I will cleanse you from all your impurities and from all your idols.

ekegusii: Inche nintenene korenda, ee, nintenene igoro ase omorobiri bw’ogotengera, ndore aya Omonene arantebie, na buna ndairanerie igoro y’okorera kwane.
english: I will stand at my watch and station myself on the ramparts; I will look to see what he will say to me, and what answer I am to give to this complaint.

ekegusii: Nondore inteneine agwo ase egetare kia Horebu, nkoganyete. Oake egetare, na amache arwe aroro, erinde abanto banyore banywe.” Musa agakora bo ase amasio ’abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.
