english: I will stand there before you by the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink." So Moses did this in the sight of the elders of Israel.

ekegusii: Ninsirie kegima omogoko oye bwonsi, na Amatuko aye Amanene ay’Emetienyi Emeyia, ne Chisabato chiaye, na emeyega yaye echikire.
english: I will stop all her celebrations: her yearly festivals, her New Moons, her Sabbath days-- all her appointed feasts.

ekegusii: Ninkong’ie amaboko ’omoruoti o Babeli, mbeke omoro one ase okoboko kwaye, korende amaboko a Farao ninyabune, erinde achandeke ase obosio bw’omoruoti o Babeli, abe okona‐kweumia ore buna omonto oakire chingoma chikomoita.
english: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before him like a mortally wounded man.

ekegusii: Ee, ninkong’ie amaboko ’omoruoti o Babeli, korende aya Farao naborwe chinguru. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Ekero ndabeke omoro one ase okoboko kw’omoruoti o Babeli, ere nayorage gochia ase ense ya Misiri.
english: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon and he brandishes it against Egypt.

ekegusii: Inche nimbeke abanto baane chinguru ime yane inche Omonene, barabwo mbabe bagotaara ase erieta riane.” Omonene okwanire ayio.
english: I will strengthen them in the LORD and in his name they will walk," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Nindambore igoro ase Yerusalemu ekerengo keria ki’egesusuro kiarengete Samaria, na ekebiro keria kiarengete enyomba y’Ahabu. Nintinyie Yerusalemu buna omonto agotinyia esani na koyeumamia ebe bosa.
english: I will stretch out over Jerusalem the measuring line used against Samaria and the plumb line used against the house of Ahab. I will wipe out Jerusalem as one wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.

ekegusii: Ning’ite abanto abamenyete ase omochie oyio, ng’ite ne ching’iti chireo. Oborwaire bogoita mboite mwanyabanto ne ching’iti.”
english: I will strike down those who live in this city-- both men and animals-- and they will die of a terrible plague.

ekegusii: Inche ning’ite abana baye bakwe. Na abanto be chikanisa chionsi mbamanye ng’a inche nigo nkoriga‐rigia ebirengererio bie chinkoro, na inche nimoe kera oyomo oino koreng’ana nogokora kwaye.
english: I will strike her children dead. Then all the churches will know that I am he who searches hearts and minds, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.

ekegusii: Nkobaaka inde noborwaire bogoita erinde imbasirie, na aye ngokore obe egesaku ekenene, naende kere nokobua goetania abanto aba.”
english: I will strike them down with a plague and destroy them, but I will make you into a nation greater and stronger than they."

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Nindete omoro orwanie Gogi agwo ase ebitunwa biane bionsi, erio kera omonto aite oyomwabo nomoro.
english: I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains, declares the Sovereign LORD. Every man's sword will be against his brother.

ekegusii: nindangerie ebisaku bionsi bia sugusu, na Nebukadinesaro, omosomba one, omoruoti o Babeli. Barabwo nimbarente barwanie ense eye na abanto bareo, naende barwanie ebisaku bionsi bietanaine aiga. Ninsirie abanto b’aiga kegima, nimbakore babe egento ki’ogoichanerwa na eki’ogosekererigwa, na ense eye nebe bosa kogenderera botambe.
english: I will summon all the peoples of the north and my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon," declares the LORD, "and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants and against all the surrounding nations. I will completely destroy them and make them an object of horror and scorn, and an everlasting ruin.

ekegusii: Ase ogosesenia ningosesenie, na ase okomenta nimente ororeria rwao, robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro na buna omokenye ore engegu y’enyancha, na ororeria rwao inarobue emechie y’ababisa babo,
english: I will surely bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will take possession of the cities of their enemies,

ekegusii: buna nakorierete eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ngateba: Sulemani omwana oo, nere oragambe nyuma yane, na rero boigo ngokoriera inde eira eyio eyio.”
english: I will surely carry out today what I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel: Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne in my place."

ekegusii: “Naama! Ninsangererie abanto abwo korwa ase chinse chionsi ase nabaseretie gochia, ekero narenge nendamwamu, na ekeririanda, na okogechigwa. Nimbairanie aase aiga, naende mbabeke bamenye ase obotoereru.
english: I will surely gather them from all the lands where I banish them in my furious anger and great wrath; I will bring them back to this place and let them live in safety.

ekegusii: Rora, ninsamunse amaboko aane igoro yabo, barabwo mbabe abasomba b’abwo barenge kobakorera.” Erio nario moramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda ontomire.
english: I will surely raise my hand against them so that their slaves will plunder them. Then you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me.

ekegusii: Ninsirie chigari chi’esegi korwa ase abanto ba Efraimu, ne chibarasi chi’esegi korwa Yerusalemu. Ninsirie na amata ’esegi. Omoruoti oyio nararerie abanto b’ebisaku omorembe. Obogambi bwaye nabobe korwa enyancha eyemo goika eyende, na korwa ase Orooche rwa Eufarati goika ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
english: I will take away the chariots from Ephraim and the war-horses from Jerusalem, and the battle bow will be broken. He will proclaim peace to the nations. His rule will extend from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

ekegusii: Nindusie abatigari b’Abayuda, abwo babekire ebirengererio biabo gochia komenya buna abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri, mbasirie bonsi pi. Mbakwere agwo ase ense ya Misiri ase ogoitwa nemioro na enchara. Ee, mbasirigwe ase ogoitwa nemioro na enchara, korwa omonto omoke goika omonene. Nababe bagokwanwa ekero abanto bakoragereria, na ekero abanto bakobarora nigo barakumie na goichana, naende babe bakoragererigwa na gochecherigwa.
english: I will take away the remnant of Judah who were determined to go to Egypt to settle there. They will all perish in Egypt; they will fall by the sword or die from famine. From the least to the greatest, they will die by sword or famine. They will become an object of cursing and horror, of condemnation and reproach.

ekegusii: “Nimbaetie inwe inse y’enyimbo yane y’oborisia, mbasoyie ase egesibo gi’okobwatana.
english: I will take note of you as you pass under my rod, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

ekegusii: Nindusie amanyinga ’ebing’wanso korwa ase emenwa yabo, na okogechia koria korwa ase amaino abo; na barabwo nababe abatigari ba Nyasae oito, nababe buna abagambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda, abanto b’Ekironi nababe abatigari ba Nyasae oito, nababe buna abagambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda, abanto b’Ekironi nababe buna Abayebusi.
english: I will take the blood from their mouths, the forbidden food from between their teeth. Those who are left will belong to our God and become leaders in Judah, and Ekron will be like the Jebusites.

ekegusii: Nindusie oboruoti korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oye; aye noegwe ebisaku ikomi,
english: I will take the kingdom from his son's hands and give you ten tribes.

ekegusii: Ninyeruserie egesiomba ase abanto b’ebisaku, abwo batari koigwera, inde nendamwamu na ekeririanda.”
english: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed me."

ekegusii: Nindusie egesiomba kiane ase ense y’Abaedomu goetera ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, abanto baane. Barabwo mbakorere Abaedomu koreng’ana nendamwamu yane, na ekeririanda kiane. Erio Abaedomu mbanyare komanya egesiomba kiane. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: I will take vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will deal with Edom in accordance with my anger and my wrath; they will know my vengeance, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Nimbakore mobe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae oino. Inwe namomanye ng’a ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyokobarusia korwa ase emeremo emerito inse y’Abamisiri.
english: I will take you as my own people, and I will be your God. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.

ekegusii: Erio inyiyerie inse orwaki orwo mwaagete echooka, erinde oboroso bwaye botuborwe. Ekero orwaki orwo roragwe, inwe imoitwe mokwereo. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I will tear down the wall you have covered with whitewash and will level it to the ground so that its foundation will be laid bare. When it falls, you will be destroyed in it; and you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Nintagore chinyomba ase mokobeera ekero ki’obokendu amo nechio mokobeera ekero ki’egurugura; boigo ninsarie chinyomba chichabeire amaino e chinchogu, ne chinyomba chinene nchisirigwe kegima.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: I will tear down the winter house along with the summer house; the houses adorned with ivory will be destroyed and the mansions will be demolished," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Boigo nintandore ebietubo biaino, ndusie abanto baane korwa ase amaboko aino, tibakogenderera koba abooswa asemore. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I will tear off your veils and save my people from your hands, and they will no longer fall prey to your power. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninyatore obwanchani bw’Omonene bogendererete botambe. Nintogie Omonene ase engencho y’amang’ana amaya onsi atokoreire, na obuya obonene akoreire Abaisraeli, koreng’ana na amabera aye na obonge bw’obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.
english: I will tell of the kindnesses of the LORD, the deeds for which he is to be praised, according to all the LORD has done for us-- yes, the many good things he has done for the house of Israel, according to his compassion and many kindnesses.

ekegusii: Ninchirisie ase oborisia obuya. Ee, nchibe chikorisia ase oborisia obonoru bw’ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli.
english: I will tend them in a good pasture, and the mountain heights of Israel will be their grazing land. There they will lie down in good grazing land, and there they will feed in a rich pasture on the mountains of Israel.

ekegusii: Erio ngotugute igoro ase ense enyomo, na nkorute aase aarabu, agwo ndangerie chinyoni chionsi chikogwere, ne ching’iti chire ase ense engima chikorie chiigote.
english: I will throw you on the land and hurl you on the open field. I will let all the birds of the air settle on you and all the beasts of the earth gorge themselves on you.

ekegusii: Nimbaserie morue ase obosio bwane, buna naseretie abanto bamino, ororeria rwonsi rw’Efraimu.
english: I will thrust you from my presence, just as I did all your brothers, the people of Ephraim.'

ekegusii: Ningosibe ne chingori, erinde tonyara koonchoka gochia ensemo ende yonsi goika obe gwakoorire amatuko ao ay’okoyoboera.
english: I will tie you up with ropes so that you cannot turn from one side to the other until you have finished the days of your siege.

ekegusii: “Ekero ndarentere abanto b’ebisaku amang’ana igoro y’ogosirigwa kwao, ning’ichanie chinkoro chi’abanto abange ase chinse echio otamanyeti.
english: I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring about your destruction among the nations, among lands you have not known.

ekegusii: “Nindoisie chinchera ase ebitunwa biane bionsi, ne chinchera chiane chinene nchiroisigwe chiimokerere igoro.
english: I will turn all my mountains into roads, and my highways will be raised up.

ekegusii: Nintegerere amang’ana agokwanwa ase omoreng’anio, ning’orokie engencho yaye ase okobugia obokano.
english: I will turn my ear to a proverb; with the harp I will expound my riddle:

ekegusii: Ning’o nchore obosio bwane korwa asebare, erinde bakore ekungo yane ebe eyetachenegeti; abauri mbasoe aroro na koyekora ebe eyetachenegeti.
english: I will turn my face away from them, and they will desecrate my treasured place; robbers will enter it and desecrate it.

ekegusii: Ning’onchore okoboko kwane kobe igoro yao, konyititore, korusie amabiria ao buna ogosisikerigwa kwe ribu na korusia ayatakogwenereti.
english: I will turn my hand against you; I will thoroughly purge away your dross and remove all your impurities.

ekegusii: Nindue omochie o Raba obe oborisia bwe chingamia, na emechie y’Abaamoni ebe ameeri ’amaicho. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I will turn Rabbah into a pasture for camels and Ammon into a resting place for sheep. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninkoonchore na gokoraa korwa sugusu y’aare mono, nkorente ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli.
english: I will turn you around and drag you along. I will bring you from the far north and send you against the mountains of Israel.

ekegusii: Ninkoonchore gochia nyuma, ning’agie ebigobanio ase chintakunero chiao erinde nkorente aye amo nabarwani bao bonsi b’esegi, ne chibarasi, na abariini be chibarasi, bonsi ababogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi; omoganda oyio omonene nigo orabe obogoretie ching’aya, ne chinguba, na emioro.
english: I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws and bring you out with your whole army-- your horses, your horsemen fully armed, and a great horde with large and small shields, all of them brandishing their swords.

ekegusii: Nintagore emechie yaino ebe amatombe, ninsarie kegima aase aino ase mogosasimera; tingwanchera ebing’wanso biaino, ebio tibikoba rimisu rikongwenera.
english: I will turn your cities into ruins and lay waste your sanctuaries, and I will take no delight in the pleasing aroma of your offerings.

ekegusii: Ning’onchore emeyega yaino ebe ebirero, na amatera aino abe okorera gw’okobokia amagombo. Nindete omoichano ase abanto bonsi, erio beboyie chigunia, na kera omonto akigite etukia y’omotwe oye. Mbatige mobe buna omonto okoreera omwana oye omomoima, na omoerio oye nobe rituko ri’obororo.”
english: I will turn your religious feasts into mourning and all your singing into weeping. I will make all of you wear sackcloth and shave your heads. I will make that time like mourning for an only son and the end of it like a bitter day.

ekegusii: Nintagore emechie yao ebe amaturi, na ebe ense esaregete kegima ere bosa; erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: I will turn your towns into ruins and you will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Ninsimore emete y’Asera eyio mogosasima, ninyerusie korwa asemore, ninkore emechie yaino ebe bosa.
english: I will uproot from among you your Asherah poles and demolish your cities.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ninteeme Abaisraeli, ndore gose nabarende chinchera chiane inche Omonene, na gochitunyana, buna chisokoro chiabo chiakorete, gose taibo.”
english: I will use them to test Israel and see whether they will keep the way of the LORD and walk in it as their forefathers did."

ekegusii: Naama! Inche nigo nkoganyera ase ebiambokero bi’orooche aiga ase erooro goika inyore amang’ana korwa asemore.”
english: I will wait at the fords in the desert until word comes from you to inform me."

ekegusii: Nimoganyete Omonene, oyio otubire obosio bwaye korwa ase ororeria rwa Yakobo; nimbe imosemeretie.
english: I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding his face from the house of Jacob. I will put my trust in him.

ekegusii: Nimbe ngotaara ase obosibore, ekiagera neorokereirie amachiko ao.
english: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.

ekegusii: Nintaare amo nainwe; inche nimbe Nyasae oino, na inwe mobe abanto baane.
english: I will walk among you and be your God, and you will be my people.

ekegusii: “Nindere ase engencho y’ebitunwa, ninyeumie ase engencho y’amarisia e chirooro, ekiagera biomire na gosareka. Monto onde tagoeta ase egati yabo, na amariogi e chiombe chikwana tari koigugwa; chinyoni ne ching’iti chi’orosana chiatamire chiachiire.
english: I will weep and wail for the mountains and take up a lament concerning the desert pastures. They are desolate and untraveled, and the lowing of cattle is not heard. The birds of the air have fled and the animals are gone.

ekegusii: Inche nabasongire ase emechie yonsi y’ense yabo. Naitire abana babo; nasiririe abanto baane, ekiagera tibang’onchokereti batige chinchera chiabo.
english: I will winnow them with a winnowing fork at the city gates of the land. I will bring bereavement and destruction on my people, for they have not changed their ways.

ekegusii: Inche nindike ase chibao echio amang’ana aria aria arenge ase chibao chiria chie ritang’ani gwatete, naye ochibeke ime y’Esanduku eria.
english: I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke. Then you are to put them in the chest."

ekegusii: Ayanyanchete naro aya, ng’a abanto bonsi babe buna inche omonyene inde. Korende kera omonto nare nekeegwa kiaye omonyene gekorwa ase Nyasae, oyomo iga, na oyonde iga.
english: I wish that all men were as I am. But each man has his own gift from God; one has this gift, another has that.

ekegusii: Inche imochiere mobosokano imogose ekero arosire na erusirie moyo. Abanto abwo bonsi bare komo mbatame, nainche ninyare goita omoruoti kare bweka.
english: I would attack him while he is weary and weak. I would strike him with terror, and then all the people with him will flee. I would strike down only the king

ekegusii: Igo nigo nare komanya eki akong’iraneria, na komanya ayarenge gontebia.
english: I would find out what he would answer me, and consider what he would say.

ekegusii: Ee, nigo nanga nare kogenda aare, imbe ntoorete ase erooro.
english: I would flee far away and stay in the desert; Selah

ekegusii: Nanga namotebia igoro y’orogendo rwane rwonsi; nigo nare komochiera inde buna omogambi.”
english: I would give him an account of my every step; like a prince I would approach him.)--

ekegusii: Naki inche nigo ndigetie abeere aiga amo nainche, erinde anyare gonkorera ribaga riao, ekero nsibire ase engencho y’enchili.
english: I would have liked to keep him with me so that he could take your place in helping me while I am in chains for the gospel.

ekegusii: Nigo nare kominyoka chimbero, erinde inyenyorere aase nkwebisa, korwa ase omwaga omotindi na ekembugu‐mbugu.”
english: I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm."

ekegusii: Nigo nanga nakorentete mwa baba, obe gokonyorokereria. Nigo nare gocha gokoa onywe edivai yochoganirie ebinsari, naende nkoe amache amitire korwa ase amakomomanga aane.
english: I would lead you and bring you to my mother's house-- she who has taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.

ekegusii: Inche nigo ndigetie inwe mwensi mokwane ase emenwa, korende kobua mono ng’a monyare kobana. Ere oyokobana nomonene kobua oyogokwana ase emenwa, otatiga omonto aonchore, erinde ekanisa eagachwe.
english: I would like every one of you to speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets, so that the church may be edified.

ekegusii: Tiga mbaborie ring’ana eri rioka: Igo mwanyorete Omoika ase ogokora kw’amachiko, gose ase okwegena goetera ase okoigwa?
english: I would like to learn just one thing from you: Did you receive the Spirit by observing the law, or by believing what you heard?

ekegusii: Korende nindigetie ng’a timoba nogwechanda. Oyotaranyuoma nigo arengereretie amang’ana ’Omonene, buna aragwenere Omonene:
english: I would like you to be free from concern. An unmarried man is concerned about the Lord's affairs-- how he can please the Lord.

ekegusii: Na inche tinamomanya, korende ere oyontomete kobatisa ase amache, oyio nere ontebetie: Ere oyo oranyare korora Omoika ogoika na goikaransa igoro yaye, oyio nere okobatisa n’Omoika Omochenu.
english: I would not have known him, except that the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, 'The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is he who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.'

ekegusii: Tinaigwerete amorokererio ’aborokia baane, gose tinategererete koigwera abarenge konyorokereria.
english: I would not obey my teachers or listen to my instructors.

ekegusii: Nigo narenge komotebia amang’ana aane, ing’ichorie omonwa one namang’ana nkoamererania nere.
english: I would state my case before him and fill my mouth with arguments.

ekegusii: Nabarikeire inwe amang’ana aya, erinde momanye ng’a more nobogima bwa kare na kare, inwe abwo mwariegenire erieta ri’Omwana o Nyasae.
english: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God so that you may know that you have eternal life.

ekegusii: Nkobarikera nde inwe, abana baane, ekiagera ebibe biaino biaabeirwe ase engencho y’erieta riaye.
english: I write to you, dear children, because your sins have been forgiven on account of his name.

ekegusii: Nabarikerete inwe, abaise, ekiagera momomanyete ere oyorenge korwa omochakano. Nabarikerete inwe, abamura, ekiagera more ne chinguru, ne ring’ana ria Nyasae ndire ime yaino, na mwabuire oria omobe.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you have known him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God lives in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

ekegusii: Nkobarikera nde inwe abaise, ekiagera momomanyete ere oyorengeo korwa omochakano. Nkobarikera nde inwe, abamura, ekiagera mwamobuire oria omobe. Nabarikerete inwe, abana abake, ekiagera momomanyete Tata.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you have known him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, dear children, because you have known the Father.

ekegusii: Inche nigo nabarikerete ring’ana eri, erinde ngocha ting’ichanigwa na baria bagwenerete kongokia, naki ninsemeretie igoro yaino inwe mwensi, ng’a omogoko one noro oyoino mwensi.
english: I wrote as I did so that when I came I should not be distressed by those who ought to make me rejoice. I had confidence in all of you, that you would all share my joy.

ekegusii: Nonya nare korika amachiko aane asebare ara chilifu ikomi, tibaare koyancha, korende bayabarire koba egento ekegeni asebare.
english: I wrote for them the many things of my law, but they regarded them as something alien.

ekegusii: Nabarikerete ab’ekanisa amang’ana, korende Dioterefe, oyobwanchete koba oyo bwe ritang’ani asebare, tatwancheti.
english: I wrote to the church, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will have nothing to do with us.

ekegusii: Inche, omosomba oo omokungu, nigo nabwate abana abamura babere, nabarabwo bagachaka kwomana kobare mogondo, gose onde tarengeo ore kobatoorania, na oyomo agaita oria, onde omwabo.
english: I your servant had two sons. They got into a fight with each other in the field, and no one was there to separate them. One struck the other and killed him.

ekegusii: Inche Danieli nkaborwa chinguru, nkaba omorwaire ase amatuko amake. Nyuma y’ayio nkaimoka gochia gokora emeremo ase omoruoti, korende ngaichanigwa ase engencho y’okorora okwo, na onde tarenge omanyete engencho yaye.
english: I, Daniel, was exhausted and lay ill for several days. Then I got up and went about the king's business. I was appalled by the vision; it was beyond understanding.

ekegusii: Ninche bweka Danieli naroche okorora koria abanto baria barenge amo nainche tibakoroche, korende obwoba obonene bokabasoa, erio bagatama bakebisa.
english: I, Daniel, was the only one who saw the vision; the men with me did not see it, but such terror overwhelmed them that they fled and hid themselves.

ekegusii: “Inche ninche Omonene, ninche bweka inde Omotooria, naende onde tari.
english: I, even I, am the LORD, and apart from me there is no savior.

ekegusii: Inche ninche nakwanire na komorangeria, namorentire, nimosesenie ase ogokora kwaye.”
english: I, even I, have spoken; yes, I have called him. I will bring him, and he will succeed in his mission.

ekegusii: I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. And when I had heard and seen them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel who had been showing them to me.
english: Ninche Yohana naigwete amang’ana aya na nkayarora. Ngachia koyaigwa na koyarora nkagwa inse nsasime bosio bw’amagoro ’omomalaika oria onyorogetie aya.

ekegusii: Inche Yohana, momura omino, na omobwatani amo nainwe ase emechando, na ase oboruoti, na ase okoremereria amo na Yeso, nigo narenge ase egesinka gekorokwa Patimo, ekiagera nigo narenge koraria ring’ana ria Nyasae na komobera Yeso kirori.
english: I, John, your brother and companion in the suffering and kingdom and patient endurance that are ours in Jesus, was on the island of Patmos because of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

ekegusii: “Inche Nebukadinesaro nigo namenyete nomogoko ase enyomba yane, nkaba ngendererete goseseneka ase enyomba yane y’oboruoti.
english: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at home in my palace, contented and prosperous.

ekegusii: Inche Paulo narikire aya nokoboko kwane omonyene, ning’akane. Amaene, ninyare kogotebia, ng’a nore nesira asende, engencho yaye aye bweka omonyene.
english: I, Paul, am writing this with my own hand. I will pay it back-- not to mention that you owe me your very self.

ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane inche Paulo ase okoboko kwane omonyene. Eke nakio ekemanyerio ase kera rirube riane; naboigo nkorika.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand, which is the distinguishing mark in all my letters. This is how I write.

ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane inche Paulo ase okoboko kwane omonyene.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand.

ekegusii: Oko nogokwania kwane, inche Paulo, ase okoboko kwane omonyene. Moinyore ebisibo biane. Obuya bobe amo nainwe.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting in my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.

ekegusii: Inche Teretio, omoriki bwe rirube eri, nabakwanirie ase Omonene.
english: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.

ekegusii: Ninche Omonene nakwanire. Ekeene ninkore egento eke ase omoganda oyo omobe osangererekanire amo, na obeire mamincha yane. Aiga ase erooro ninsirie abanto aba, aa ase erooro nao barakwere.”
english: I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this whole wicked community, which has banded together against me. They will meet their end in this desert; here they will die."

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene, ninche inde omorendi bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu, nigo nkoyoitororera amache kera engaki; nigo inyorendete obotuko na omobaso, erinde onde tabaisa koyosaria.
english: I, the LORD, watch over it; I water it continually. I guard it day and night so that no one may harm it.

ekegusii: Inche omorandia nigo narenge omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, agwo Yerusalemu.
english: I, the Teacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,
english: Ibuhari na Eliasama, na Elifeleti,

ekegusii: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,
english: Ibuhari na Elisua, Nefegi na Yafia;

ekegusii: naende Ibunia, mosinto o Yerohamu, na Ela, mosinto o Usi o Mikiri, na Mesulamu, mosinto o Sefatia o Reueli, o Ibunia,
english: Ibneiah son of Jeroham; Elah son of Uzzi, the son of Micri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah.

ekegusii: Iddo, Ginnethon, Abijah,
english: Ido, na Ginetoi, na Abiya;

ekegusii: idolatry and witchcraft; hatred, discord, jealousy, fits of rage, selfish ambition, dissensions, factions
english: ogosasima emegwekano, oborogi, obobisa, eriomana, ribero, endamwamu, obong’iti, okwerusanania, ogweatanana,

ekegusii: Onye eng’iti eyemo y’echio ekwete keragwere embusuro egosimekwa, embusuro eyio negenderere koba echenegete.
english: If a carcass falls on any seeds that are to be planted, they remain clean.

ekegusii: “Onye Omoibirania omino, omosacha gose omokungu, oonigwe asore, nigo aragokorere emeremo ase emiaka etano nomo, korende ase omwaka o gatano na kabere, goika omoe ribaga arue asore.
english: If a fellow Hebrew, a man or a woman, sells himself to you and serves you six years, in the seventh year you must let him go free.

ekegusii: Na enyomba keraatananeke enyene, enyomba eria tekonyara gotenena.
english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

ekegusii: Omoruoti okogambera abataka ase oboronge, obogambi bwaye mbogenderere gotenena bokong’u.
english: If a king judges the poor with fairness, his throne will always be secure.

ekegusii: Na oboruoti kaboraatananeke ase borobwo obonyene, oboruoti boria tibokonyara gotenena.
english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

ekegusii: “Omolawi onde bwensi orabe omenyete ase emechie ende yonsi y’Abaisraeli karaganie koruao, nabo aranyare gocha aase agwo Omonene arachore.
english: If a Levite moves from one of your towns anywhere in Israel where he is living, and comes in all earnestness to the place the LORD will choose,

ekegusii: “Omonto omonyaborimo aise gokwana amang’ana a bosa na ay’obong’ainereria, atebe: Inche nigo nkobabanera igoro y’edivai na ebinyugwa binde bigotindia, omobani oyio nere abanto aba baranche.
english: If a liar and deceiver comes and says, 'I will prophesy for you plenty of wine and beer,' he would be just the prophet for this people!

ekegusii: Onye omonto onde okoba kirori bw’oborimo ase okogania gokorera omonto onde bobe, na komosoera,
english: If a malicious witness takes the stand to accuse a man of a crime,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye omonto origetie gwesibia ere omonyene ase ogweatanana korwa ase ebinto buna ebio, nabe egento ki’ogosika, giancheirwe, keragwenere Omonene, kiaroisigwe ase kera emeremo emiya.
english: If a man cleanses himself from the latter, he will be an instrument for noble purposes, made holy, useful to the Master and prepared to do any good work.

ekegusii: Omonto oraragererie ise, gose ng’ina, oyio etaya yaye nerimigwe ekero ki’omosunte ekerima.
english: If a man curses his father or mother, his lamp will be snuffed out in pitch darkness.

ekegusii: Omonto ogosigaana abasani ase okwenyorera chinibo chiabo, abana baye amaiso abo nigo araukore.
english: If a man denounces his friends for reward, the eyes of his children will fail.

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto gakure, nairane koba moyo naende? Inche ase amatuko aane onsi inchikeire, nimbe nganyete, goika ogosiborwa kwane goche.
english: If a man dies, will he live again? All the days of my hard service I will wait for my renewal to come.

ekegusii: If a man digs a pit, he will fall into it; if a man rolls a stone, it will roll back on him.
english: Omonto okorema eirima, nere omonyene oragwe imeo; na omonto ogoturunkania rigena, nere omonyene rirairanere rimogwere.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto okorire ebibe na koegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa, asungwe ase omote.
english: If a man guilty of a capital offense is put to death and his body is hung on a tree,

ekegusii: “Omonto karaumerane nomoiseke omwekungi otararierwa boko, na komobwata ne chinguru, abe nere, nabarabwo babere banyorwe,
english: If a man happens to meet a virgin who is not pledged to be married and rapes her and they are discovered,

ekegusii: “Omoiseke omwekungi oriereirwe boko nomonto, karaumerane nomosacha omoao agwo ase omochie, na omosacha oyio abe nere,
english: If a man happens to meet in a town a virgin pledged to be married and he sleeps with her,

ekegusii: “Nenyare koba ng’a omonto nabwate omwana omomura omobe, omoenenu, otari koigwera ise gose ng’ina, nonya bateemire komoa egesusuro ase okomorongeyia, ere tari kobaigwera.
english: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey his father and mother and will not listen to them when they discipline him,

ekegusii: “Onye omonto onyuomire omokungu tagenda ase esegi amo nabarwani bande, gose taegwa emeremo ende yonsi akorere egesaku, korende nigo araegwe ribaga abeere nka bwoye ase omwaka oyomo kogokia mokaye.
english: If a man has recently married, he must not be sent to war or have any other duty laid on him. For one year he is to be free to stay at home and bring happiness to the wife he has married.

ekegusii: “Nenyare koba ng’a omonto nabwate abakungu babere; ere nigo anchete oyomo na bwangete oria onde. Abakungu abwo bonsi babere baiboreire omosacha oyio abana, korende omwana omoisia omotangi nigo are oyo bw’omokungu oria angete.
english: If a man has two wives, and he loves one but not the other, and both bear him sons but the firstborn is the son of the wife he does not love,

ekegusii: “Omonto karanyorekane oibire Omoisraeli omwabo amokore buna omosomba, gose amoonie, omoibi oria goika aitwe akwe. Goika morusie obobe korwa asemore.
english: If a man is caught kidnapping one of his brother Israelites and treats him as a slave or sells him, the kidnapper must die. You must purge the evil from among you.

ekegusii: “Omonto karanyorekane oitirwe okure ore orosana ime agwo ase ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, na onye omonto omoita tamanyekaneti,
english: If a man is found slain, lying in a field in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess, and it is not known who killed him,

ekegusii: “Omonto omosacha aise konyorekana oraire nomokungu bw’omonto onde, bonsi babere, omosacha oria amo nomokungu oria, goika baitwe bakwe. Goika morusie obobe borue ase Abaisraeli.
english: If a man is found sleeping with another man's wife, both the man who slept with her and the woman must die. You must purge the evil from Israel.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto are omworo ekerama ki’enyomba yaye nigo gekogwa, na ase engencho y’obworo obwo embura nigo egotwa imeo.
english: If a man is lazy, the rafters sag; if his hands are idle, the house leaks.

ekegusii: Omonto okoboka mambia chuni oaka eriogi gosesenia omogisangio oye, oyio nabarerwe okoragererigwa.
english: If a man loudly blesses his neighbor early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse.

ekegusii: “Nenyare koba ng’a omonto onyuomire omokungu, na nyuma y’ayio amwange, ekiagera anyorire ring’ana asare ritamogogeti. Erio amorikere rirube ri’ogotigana nere, ae omokungu oria na komoseria korwa bwoye.
english: If a man marries a woman who becomes displeasing to him because he finds something indecent about her, and he writes her a certificate of divorce, gives it to her and sends her from his house,

ekegusii: Onye omonto bw’omorembe oreo, omorembe oino noikaranse asare; korende onye taibo, nobairanere inwe.
english: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.

ekegusii: “Nenyare koba ng’a agwo ase omochie onde oino ase eyio Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabae, omonto, omosacha gose omokungu, anyorekane okorire amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase ogosaria okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania,
english: If a man or woman living among you in one of the towns the LORD gives you is found doing evil in the eyes of the LORD your God in violation of his covenant,

ekegusii: Omonto ogotuga omosomba oye na omoa ebinto bionsi aganetie korwa obwana bwaye, omosomba oyio nabo araire omwando oye.
english: If a man pampers his servant from youth, he will bring grief in the end.

ekegusii: Omonto ogoakana amabe ase amaya, obobe tibokorua ase enyomba yaye.
english: If a man pays back evil for good, evil will never leave his house.

ekegusii: Onye omonto oganetie kobooria ensemo yaye ya ikomi, nigo aramente eyemo ya isano ase rigori riaye.
english: If a man redeems any of his tithe, he must add a fifth of the value to it.

ekegusii: If a man shuts his ears to the cry of the poor, he too will cry out and not be answered.
english: Omonto oria ogosieka amato aye ng’a taigwa ekerero ki’omotaka, nere ekero ararere takoigugwa.

ekegusii: Omonto karakore ebibe ase omonto onde, Nyasae nabe omobwatania, korende omonto karakore ebibe ase Nyasae, ning’o oranyare koba omobwatania?” Korende barabwo tibaigwerete ise, ekiagera Omonene konya oganirie kobaita.
english: If a man sins against another man, God may mediate for him; but if a man sins against the LORD, who will intercede for him?" His sons, however, did not listen to their father's rebuke, for it was the LORD's will to put them to death.

ekegusii: “Nenyare koba ng’a omonto onyuomire omokungu bamenyane, na nyuma y’ayio amwange,
english: If a man takes a wife and, after lying with her, dislikes her

ekegusii: Omonto aise kobogoria enyama enchenu ase omogo bw’eanga yaye akwambara, na akune nomogo bw’eanga eria omogati, gose endagera eiyekire, gose edivai, gose amaguta ’amazeituni, gose endagera ende yonsi, Inee, ekio giakunwa nkebe egechenu?” Abakuani bakairaneria, “Yaya.”
english: If a person carries consecrated meat in the fold of his garment, and that fold touches some bread or stew, some wine, oil or other food, does it become consecrated?'" The priests answered, "No."

ekegusii: Omoiseke bw’omokuani karanyuomwe nomonto otari omokuani tabaisa koria ebinto ebichenu bikoruegwa bibe ebing’wanso.
english: If a priest's daughter marries anyone other than a priest, she may not eat any of the sacred contributions.

ekegusii: Omobani, gose omokuani, gose omonto onde bwensi bw’abanto aba karakwane Egurube y’Omonene, inche nimoe egesusuro, ere amo neamate yaye.
english: If a prophet or a priest or anyone else claims, 'This is the oracle of the LORD,' I will punish that man and his household.

ekegusii: “Nenyare koba ng’a ase egati yaino omobani, gose omonyandoto, oratuboke na koorokia ebikone na amakumia,
english: If a prophet, or one who foretells by dreams, appears among you and announces to you a miraculous sign or wonder,

ekegusii: Ekero omonto omonyaboronge akoonchoka otiga gokora ay’oboronge, erio okora ebibe, oyio goika akwe ase engencho y’ayio; ee, ase engencho y’ebibe akorire goika akwe.
english: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits sin, he will die for it; because of the sin he has committed he will die.

ekegusii: Ekero omonyaboronge aratige oboronge bwaye akore aya atari ay’oboronge, oyio nakwe ase engencho y’ayio.
english: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and does evil, he will die for it.

ekegusii: Omogambi aise gwancha amang’ana ’oborimo, abasomba baye bonsi nigo barabe abakori amabe.
english: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials become wicked.

ekegusii: Omogambi karabe nendamwamu asore, tobaisa gotiga emeremo yao, ekiagera oboremereria nigo boragere ebibe ebinene biaberwe.
english: If a ruler's anger rises against you, do not leave your post; calmness can lay great errors to rest.

ekegusii: “Onye omosomba otamire korwa ase omonene oye, ochire asemore, timobaisa komoirania gochia ase omonene oye naende.
english: If a slave has taken refuge with you, do not hand him over to his master.

ekegusii: Omoebia ching’iti chingenda inse aise gotiga eng’iti emorome ritang’ani atarayeebia, rirorio omoebia oyio nigo arabe bosa.
english: If a snake bites before it is charmed, there is no profit for the charmer.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto omong’aini akoamererania nomoriri, oria omoriri nigo akogechigwa na goseka, tari gokirakiri.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a fool, the fool rages and scoffs, and there is no peace.

ekegusii: Naki onye omokungu tarigeti kweboa, tiga akigite etukia yaye; korende onye nobosooku ase omokungu konachwa etukia yaye gose gokigitwa tiga eboe.
english: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off; and if it is a disgrace for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.

ekegusii: Korende echire na bimocho ase emebere yabo, onye chire ebisegora, gose emeuko, gose na kemocho kende gionsi, timobaisa gochirua chibe ekeng’wanso ase Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: If an animal has a defect, is lame or blind, or has any serious flaw, you must not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Onye nomobisa ore gonchecheria, nanga nigo nare koremereria; naende onye nomobisa ore gonkorera bobe ase oboenenu, nanga nigo nare kwebisa.
english: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were raising himself against me, I could hide from him.

ekegusii: Korende onye abanto b’enyomba eyemo bare abake, batanyare koria emanwa eria bayekoore, rirorio ere na omogisangio oye, oyobasinyaine, basangere emanwa eyemo, koreng’ana buna omobaro bw’abanto bareo. Ase kera emanwa goika mobare abanto abarache koyeria koreng’ana buna kera oyomo aranyare koria.
english: If any household is too small for a whole lamb, they must share one with their nearest neighbor, having taken into account the number of people there are. You are to determine the amount of lamb needed in accordance with what each person will eat.

ekegusii: Korende omonto karaagache igoro ase oboroso obwo netahabu, gose efeta, gose amagena e rigori rinene, gose emete, gose obonyansi, gose chinsiaga-
english: If any man builds on this foundation using gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay or straw,

ekegusii: Onye enyama ende yonsi y’ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’omorembe ekoriegwa ase rituko ria gatato, ekeng’wanso ekio tikegwancherwa, gose oyo okeruete takobarerwa ekeng’wanso ekio. Ekio nakebe okogechia, na onde bwensi orarie enyama y’ekeng’wanso ekio nabarerwe obobe bwaye.
english: If any meat of the fellowship offering is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted. It will not be credited to the one who offered it, for it is impure; the person who eats any of it will be held responsible.

ekegusii: Chiise koriegwa ase rituko ria gatato, ekeng’wanso ekio inakebe okogechia, tikegwancherwa.
english: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is impure and will not be accepted.

ekegusii: Onye abanto b’egesaku kende gionsi kere ase ense bakwanga kogenda Yerusalemu gosasima Omoruoti, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda, rirorio embura tegotwa ase ense yabo.
english: If any of the peoples of the earth do not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD Almighty, they will have no rain.

ekegusii: Omonto onde oino karabe ne ring’ana ase oyomwabo, Inee, nare noboremu amosoere ase abwo batari abaronge? Inki rende atari komosoera ase obosio bw’abachenu?
english: If any of you has a dispute with another, dare he take it before the ungodly for judgment instead of before the saints?

ekegusii: Korende onye monto onde oino oremeire obong’aini, tiga asabe Nyasae, ere nabomoe, ekiagera nigo akoa abanto bonsi ase obonge, gose tari gotogonyera onde.
english: If any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.

ekegusii: Oyoranyorekane ore negekombe ekio ase egati yaito intwe abasomba bao, oyio akwe, naintwe boigo rirorio tobe abasomba bao, omonene oito.”
english: If any of your servants is found to have it, he will die; and the rest of us will become my lord's slaves."

ekegusii: Onye omosacha gose omokungu, oyobwegenete, ore nababoraka bamwabo, tiga abakonye, ekanisa teraarerigwa, erinde ebakonye baria bare ababoraka bori.
english: If any woman who is a believer has widows in her family, she should help them and not let the church be burdened with them, so that the church can help those widows who are really in need.

ekegusii: Omonto karerore ng’a nomobani are, gose noyo bw’Omoika, tiga amanye ng’a aya nabarikeire namachiko ’Omonene.
english: If anybody thinks he is a prophet or spiritually gifted, let him acknowledge that what I am writing to you is the Lord's command.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi okoorokia ng’a Yeso n’Omwana o Nyasae, Nyasae nigo amenyete ime asare, na ere ime ase Nyasae.
english: If anyone acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God lives in him and he in God.

ekegusii: Na omonto karababorie: Naki mogokora iga? Momotebie: Omonene nayeganetie, na bwango nayeiranie naende aa.”
english: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you doing this?' tell him, 'The Lord needs it and will send it back here shortly.'"

ekegusii: Naende omonto karababorie: Naki, mokoyesibora? Momotebie iga, Omonene nayeganetie.”
english: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you untying it?' tell him, 'The Lord needs it.'"

ekegusii: Omonto karanche gokora ogwancha kwaye, namanye gose okworokereria oko nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae, gose nigo ngokwana ase okobua kwane omonyene.
english: If anyone chooses to do God's will, he will find out whether my teaching comes from God or whether I speak on my own.

ekegusii: Omonto karache asemore, na ere tarenteti okworokereria okwo, timomoroisia ase enyomba yaino, gose timomokwania.
english: If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not take him into your house or welcome him.

ekegusii: Omonto karekage ng’a nkomokorera are Nyasae, na ere tagambereti oromeme rwaye, korende nenkoro yaye akong’aina, igo okomokorera Nyasae kwaye nigo kore okwa bosa.
english: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not keep a tight rein on his tongue, he deceives himself and his religion is worthless.

ekegusii: If anyone destroys God's temple, God will destroy him; for God's temple is sacred, and you are that temple.
english: Onye omonto ogosaria Hekalu ya Nyasae, Nyasae nasarie omonto oyio; naki Hekalu ya Nyasae nenchenu, nero ninwe.

ekegusii: Omonto oraseegete esegi, tari inche ndamotome; onde bwensi oraseegete esegi asore, nigo aragwe ekero agokorwania.
english: If anyone does attack you, it will not be my doing; whoever attacks you will surrender to you.

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amang’ana aane ayio ndachike omobani oyio ayakwane ase erieta riane, inche bweka omonyene ning’ee omonto oyio egesusuro.
english: If anyone does not listen to my words that the prophet speaks in my name, I myself will call him to account.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi otamwancheti Omonene nabe oragererigwe. Inchuo, Omonene oito!
english: If anyone does not love the Lord-- a curse be on him. Come, O Lord!

ekegusii: Onye monto onde bwensi okwanga koigwera ring’ana eri tokwanete ase rirube eri, erusananie korwa ase omonto oyio, na timosanga nere; tiga arore obosooku.
english: If anyone does not obey our instruction in this letter, take special note of him. Do not associate with him, in order that he may feel ashamed.

ekegusii: Onye omonto takorenda abare abamwabo, mono baria b’enyomba yaye, okanire okwegena, naende nomobe kobua oyotegeneti.
english: If anyone does not provide for his relatives, and especially for his immediate family, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

ekegusii: Omonto otamenyeti ime yane, nigo aratugutwe isiko buna orosagia rwomete. Chinsagia chiomete nigo chigosangererigwa, na korutwa ase omorero, na koyia.
english: If anyone does not remain in me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers; such branches are picked up, thrown into the fire and burned.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orarie amanyinga ande onsi, oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.”
english: If anyone eats blood, that person must be cut off from his people.'"

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi orasoke korwa mwao na konyorwa namakweri, okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga aye nigo korabe okwaye ere omonyene, na intwe titokoba nokomocha; korende onde bwensi orabe mwao ime, na omonto oito amoite, okomocha nakobe ogwaito.
english: If anyone goes outside your house into the street, his blood will be on his own head; we will not be responsible. As for anyone who is in the house with you, his blood will be on our head if a hand is laid on him.

ekegusii: Korende onye omonto orentire ogoichania, tang’ichaneti inche bweka, korende ase ensemo obaichanirie nainwe mwensi. Ase ogokwana igo, tinkoyakong’ia mono.
english: If anyone has caused grief, he has not so much grieved me as he has grieved all of you, to some extent-- not to put it too severely.

ekegusii: Omonto kare namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
english: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear."

ekegusii: Korende oyore nebinto bi’ense, na arore oyomwabo oremeire, gotamororera amabera, Inee, naki obwanchani bwa Nyasae borabe ime asare oyio?
english: If anyone has material possessions and sees his brother in need but has no pity on him, how can the love of God be in him?

ekegusii: If anyone injures his neighbor, whatever he has done must be done to him:
english: “Omonto karaake omonto onde asarie omobere oye, buna omonto oria akorera oyonde, nere naboigo arakorerwe.

ekegusii: Naki oyio oranyare kondorera obosooku inche, na amang’ana aane, ase ekegori eke ki’obotomani na ebibe, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto namororere obosooku ere, ekero agocha nobonene bwa Ise amo nabamalaika abachenu.”
english: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father's glory with the holy angels."

ekegusii: Naki kera omonto orandorere obosooku inche na amang’ana aane, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto kagocha ase obonene bwaye, namororere obosooku ase Ise na ase abamalaika abachenu.
english: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when he comes in his glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.

ekegusii: Omonto kare nenchara, tiga arie mwaye, timobaisa gosangererekana amo ase okonyora okogambigwa. Na aya atigaire ninyaroisie ekero ndache.
english: If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you meet together it may not result in judgment. And when I come I will give further directions.

ekegusii: If anyone is to go into captivity, into captivity he will go. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, with the sword he will be killed. This calls for patient endurance and faithfulness on the part of the saints.
english: Omonto gachoreirwe ogwoswa, goika oswe. Omonto gachoreirwe ogoitwa nomoyio o birende, goika aitwe nomoyio o birende. Aiga nao abachenu barabe nokoremereria na obwegenwa.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto oria orieretwe eira nigo are omotaka mono otanyare goakana rigori riria riabekirwe, rirorio omonto oria nigo ararentwe ase omokuani, nere amokorere rigori koreng’ana nokonyara kw’omonto oyio oriete eira.
english: If anyone making the vow is too poor to pay the specified amount, he is to present the person to the priest, who will set the value for him according to what the man making the vow can afford.

ekegusii: Na omonto karabatebie ring’ana, momotebie: Omonene nachiganetie; erio kegima nachitome.”
english: If anyone says anything to you, tell him that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away."

ekegusii: Omonto karatebe, “Nimwanchete Nyasae,” naende ogechete oyomwabo, oyio nomonyaborimo. Ere oyotamwancheti oyomwabo oyio aroche, takonyara komwancha Nyasae oyio atarochi.
english: If anyone says, "I love God," yet hates his brother, he is a liar. For anyone who does not love his brother, whom he has seen, cannot love God, whom he has not seen.

ekegusii: Omonto kararore oyomwabo ogokora ebibe bitari bi’amakweri, amosabere, na Nyasae namoe obogima; aya nase abwo bagokora ebibe bitari bi’amakweri. Mbireo ebibe bi’amakweri; tintebeti ng’a asabe ase engencho y’ebio.
english: If anyone sees his brother commit a sin that does not lead to death, he should pray and God will give him life. I refer to those whose sin does not lead to death. There is a sin that leads to death. I am not saying that he should pray about that.

ekegusii: Onye omonto ogokwana ase omonwa otamanyekaneti, bakwane babere gose batato boka, korende kera omonto ase ribaga riaye, na oyomo aonchore.
english: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two-- or at the most three-- should speak, one at a time, and someone must interpret.

ekegusii: Omonto karakwane, tiga akwane amang’ana a Nyasae. Omonto karabe omokoreri, tiga akorere ne chinguru echio Nyasae amoeire, erinde Nyasae atogigwe ase amang’ana onsi goetera ase Yeso Kristo. Asare ere obonene na okobua kare na kare. Amina.
english: If anyone speaks, he should do it as one speaking the very words of God. If anyone serves, he should do it with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be praised through Jesus Christ. To him be the glory and the power for ever and ever. Amen.

ekegusii: Onye omonto okworokereria okworokereria konde okoao, na tabwataini namang’ana ’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, ayare ay’obogima, na okworokereria kobwataine ne chingencho chi’obonyasae,
english: If anyone teaches false doctrines and does not agree to the sound instruction of our Lord Jesus Christ and to godly teaching,

ekegusii: Korende monto onde bwensi kararore ng’a takorereti omoiseke oye omwekungi ayamogwenerete, na onye omoiseke oyio oeteire obuya bw’obosae bwaye, onye negwenerete, tiga omonto oyio akore buna arigetie; tari ebibe akora, amotige anyuomwe.
english: If anyone thinks he is acting improperly toward the virgin he is engaged to, and if she is getting along in years and he feels he ought to marry, he should do as he wants. He is not sinning. They should get married.

ekegusii: Naki omonto karekage ng’a ere naisaine, ere taisaini kende; igo akweng’aina ere omonyene.
english: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

ekegusii: “Naende omonto karakune egento getachenegeti, gokerabe egetachenegeti kere ase omonto, gose ase eng’iti, gose okogechia konde gwonsi, na arie enyama y’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe gekoruegwa ase Omonene, omonto oyio nigo araatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.”
english: If anyone touches something unclean-- whether human uncleanness or an unclean animal or any unclean, detestable thing-- and then eats any of the meat of the fellowship offering belonging to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.'"

ekegusii: Na omonto kararigie kobachanda, omorero norue ase emenwa yabo, orie ababisa babo. Omonto kararigie kobachanda, nemogwenerete aitwe.
english: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes from their mouths and devours their enemies. This is how anyone who wants to harm them must die.

ekegusii: Omonto okoonchora ogoto kwaye taigwera amachiko, nonya nogosaba kwaye nigo kore okogechia.
english: If anyone turns a deaf ear to the law, even his prayers are detestable.

ekegusii: Korende onye monto onde bwensi origetie korenta amang’ana ’okoamererania ase engencho eyio, intwe titori nengencho buna eyio, nonya ne chikanisa chia Nyasae.
english: If anyone wants to be contentious about this, we have no other practice-- nor do the churches of God.

ekegusii: If anyone will not welcome you or listen to your words, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that home or town.
english: Onye onde tari orabaroisie inwe, gose koigwa amang’ana aino, kamokorua enyomba eria gose omochie oria, mokong’onteo orotu rw’amagoro aino.

ekegusii: “Onye omonto ogechete oyonde na komoita ase okomotwoma, gose komoruta egento moeneno, na komoita,
english: If anyone with malice aforethought shoves another or throws something at him intentionally so that he dies

ekegusii: Na onye omonto tarorekaneti orikire ase ebuku y’obogima akarutwa ase enyancha y’omorero.
english: If anyone's name was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.

ekegusii: Engaki ende yonsi ndakwane igoro y’egesaku, gose oboruoti, ng’a ngochia koborusia inde aroro, mbotagore na kobasiria kegima,
english: If at any time I announce that a nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down and destroyed,

ekegusii: “Onye abamura babere ba ise omo bamenyete aase aamo, na oyomo akwe, nere tabwate omwana, omokungu bw’omonto oria takonyuomwa nomonto bw’eamate eng’ao, korende omomura omwabo omosacha oye nere oratware omokungu oria abe ribaga ria momura omwabo.
english: If brothers are living together and one of them dies without a son, his widow must not marry outside the family. Her husband's brother shall take her and marry her and fulfill the duty of a brother-in-law to her.

ekegusii: If Cain is avenged seven times, then Lamech seventy-seven times."
english: Onye Kaini ogoakanerwa egesiomba ara gatano na kabere, amaene, Lameki ere naakanerwe ara emerongo etano na ebere, na gatano na kabere.”

ekegusii: Obobe koborachiche igoro asetore, gose esegi, gose egesusuro, gose oborwaire bogoita, gose enchara, natotenene bosio bw’enyomba eye ase obosio bwao, ekiagera erieta riao nao rire ase enyomba eye. Igo ntonyare korera asore ase engencho y’emechando yaito, aye noigwe ototoorie.
english: 'If calamity comes upon us, whether the sword of judgment, or plague or famine, we will stand in your presence before this temple that bears your Name and will cry out to you in our distress, and you will hear us and save us.'

ekegusii: Onye amang’ana arentirwe asemore, ayare amakong’u koyanacha, karabe amang’ana ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, gose ay’ogokora oboronge ase omonto, gose obobe omonto akoreire omonto onde, gose ekina kende gionsi kere egekong’u asemore agwo ase emechie yaino, erio moimoke mogende aase agwo Omonene, Nyasae oino, arachore,
english: If cases come before your courts that are too difficult for you to judge-- whether bloodshed, lawsuits or assaults-- take them to the place the LORD your God will choose.

ekegusii: Amare gaichoire nembura, nigo embura eyio egotwa igoro ase ense, na omote koragwe ororie ensemo ya irianyi gose eya sugusu, nigo oragenderere kobeera inse agwo ase ogwete.
english: If clouds are full of water, they pour rain upon the earth. Whether a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where it falls, there will it lie.

ekegusii: Rora, nonya nomotienyi tori noborabu asare, gose ching’enang’eni tichiikeraneti ase amaiso aye.
english: If even the moon is not bright and the stars are not pure in his eyes,

ekegusii: Onye Nyasae okobakwa ime yaye, Nyasae boigo namobake ime yaye omonyene, na komobaka erio kegima.
english: If God is glorified in him, God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.

ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabachenu baye, na igoro chionsi tichichenegeti ase obosio bwaye.
english: If God places no trust in his holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in his eyes,

ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae tari gosemeria nonya nabasomba baye; ere nigo akobabekera abamalaika baye obobe.
english: If God places no trust in his servants, if he charges his angels with error,

ekegusii: Inee! Abasangereria amasabibu baare gocha asemore, tibarenge kobatigera nonya naria agotigara? Na abaibi bagocha botuko tibarenge gosakora ebi baganetie bioka?
english: If grape pickers came to you, would they not leave a few grapes? If thieves came during the night, would they not steal only as much as they wanted?

ekegusii: If he called them 'gods,' to whom the word of God came-- and the Scripture cannot be broken--
english: Onye orogete baria chinyasae, abacheretwe ne ring’ana ria Nyasae (na amariko takonyara gosareka),

ekegusii: Onye ochete bwoo tarenge na mokungu, rirorio nabo aragende bweka, korende onye orenge nomokungu, omokungu oye nigo aragende amo nere.
english: If he comes alone, he is to go free alone; but if he has a wife when he comes, she is to go with him.

ekegusii: If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.
english: tacha ababosokane, abanyore mwararire.

ekegusii: Ase ogosamba emechie eria yare korokwa Sodomu na Gomora ekaba ribu, akayegambia esarigwe, akayekora ekaba ekiorokererio ki’ogokurera abanto abatarengereretie komoiroka Nyasae.
english: if he condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and made them an example of what is going to happen to the ungodly;

ekegusii: Omonto karaatanane oboremo bwaye korwa ase engaki y’Omwaka bw’Omochengo, rigori erio nario rirabe buna aye kwarikora.
english: If he dedicates his field during the Year of Jubilee, the value that has been set remains.

ekegusii: Tabarorerete amabera abanto b’ense eria ya kare, korende akarenda Nuhu, oyorenge omoraria bw’oboronge, amo nabanto bande batano na babere, ekere arentete etoigo igoro ase ense y’abanto abatamoirogete Nyasae.
english: if he did not spare the ancient world when he brought the flood on its ungodly people, but protected Noah, a preacher of righteousness, and seven others;

ekegusii: If he does not provide her with these three things, she is to go free, without any payment of money.
english: Atamokorereti amang’ana aya atato, goika aegwe ribaga arue bwoye ataakaneiri embooria.”

ekegusii: Omonto karaange gweitia, Nyasae natierie omoro oye, natinge obota bwaye na abobeke ang’e.
english: If he does not relent, he will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.

ekegusii: ere karairanie egento airete gekaba intenenera, naende airanie eki aureretie, na abwatie emeroberio echikire ey’obogima atari gokora ebibe, omonto oyio, ekeene nabe moyo, tagokwa.
english: if he gives back what he took in pledge for a loan, returns what he has stolen, follows the decrees that give life, and does no evil, he will surely live; he will not die.

ekegusii: Onye okomocheire kende, gose okoriete esira, oyeborie korwa asende.
english: If he has done you any wrong or owes you anything, charge it to me.

ekegusii: If he has lost his hair from the front of his scalp and has a bald forehead, he is clean.
english: na onye osunyokire etukia y’omotwe bosio, boigo ere ochenekire.

ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati abamura bamwabo, omwando oye oirwe nabamura bamwabo ise.
english: If he has no brothers, give his inheritance to his father's brothers.

ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio tabwati nonya nomwana omoiseke, omwando oye abamura bamwabo bayoire.
english: If he has no daughter, give his inheritance to his brothers.

ekegusii: Aise gotanga amache, ense igo erome pa, na ekero akoyarenta nigo akoonchorana ense.”
english: If he holds back the waters, there is drought; if he lets them loose, they devastate the land.

ekegusii: Onye omonto tarigeti koyamanya, tiga abe omoriri.
english: If he ignores this, he himself will be ignored.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio karanyare korwana nainche na kong’ita, rirorio intwe natobe abasomba baino, korende kondamobue na komoita, rirorio inwe mobe abasomba baito, motokorere.”
english: If he is able to fight and kill me, we will become your subjects; but if I overcome him and kill him, you will become our subjects and serve us."

ekegusii: Onye taibo, nigo agotoma abanto korigia enchera y’omorembe, omonto oria gakare aare.
english: If he is not able, he will send a delegation while the other is still a long way off and will ask for terms of peace.

ekegusii: Onye omonto oyio okonyuoma omokungu o kabere, takorina oria omotang’ani endagera yaye, ne chianga chiaye na kende gionsi aganetie buna mokaye.
english: If he marries another woman, he must not deprive the first one of her food, clothing and marital rights.

ekegusii: Onye okorua eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso kiaye, erio ayerue ase obosio bwane.
english: If he offers a lamb, he is to present it before the LORD.

ekegusii: Ere atabaigwereti abwo, tebia ekanisa; naende ataigwereti ekanisa nero, asore aye tiga abe buna omonto bw’Ebisaku, na buna omorusia ebango.
english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the church; and if he refuses to listen even to the church, treat him as you would a pagan or a tax collector.

ekegusii: If he said, 'The speckled ones will be your wages,' then all the flocks gave birth to speckled young; and if he said, 'The streaked ones will be your wages,' then all the flocks bore streaked young.
english: Ekero atebete: Echire nebisembe chibe eng’eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire nebisembe, na ekero atebete: Echire namagwari chibe eng’eria yao, amaicho onsi akabiara echire namagwari.

ekegusii: Aise goteba: Ayio mbuya, rirorio inche, omosomba oo, ninyare koba nomorembe, korende karabe nendamwamu ase ayio, rirorio omanye ng’a bwerure gokora amabe.
english: If he says, 'Very well,' then your servant is safe. But if he loses his temper, you can be sure that he is determined to harm me.

ekegusii: Onye okomoa omomura oye abe mokaye, rirorio amwanche buna omwana oye omoiseke.
english: If he selects her for his son, he must grant her the rights of a daughter.

ekegusii: Naende karakore ebibe asore ara gatano na kabere ase rituko erimo, karakoiranere ara gatano na kabere na goteba: Naonchokire, mwabere.”
english: If he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times comes back to you and says, 'I repent,' forgive him."

ekegusii: Ere nigo akoira eki aganetie. Ning’o oranyare komotanga? Ning’o oranyare komoboria ng’a ninki ekio agokora?
english: If he snatches away, who can stop him? Who can say to him, 'What are you doing?'

ekegusii: Onye nabete ase ense, anga tabeti omokuani, ekiagera mbareo abare korua ebiegwa buna amachiko achigete.
english: If he were on earth, he would not be a priest, for there are already men who offer the gifts prescribed by the law.

ekegusii: Aise gosoa ase omochie onde bwensi, Abaisraeli bonsi nigo bararente chingori bachietananie omochie oyio, bayokurure gochia rooche ime, gose igena rinde tirigotigara nonya nerimo.”
english: If he withdraws into a city, then all Israel will bring ropes to that city, and we will drag it down to the valley until not even a piece of it can be found."

ekegusii: Korende onye ise omoiseke okwanga, tamomoa, omonto oyio goika aakane chibesa chireng’aine rigori ri’omoiseke omwekungi.
english: If her father absolutely refuses to give her to him, he must still pay the bride-price for virgins.

ekegusii: Na onye omonto oyio tabwati abamura bamwabo ise, omwando oye oirwe nomoamate oye ore ang’e. Okwo nigo korabe ogochika kw’oboronge ase Abaisraeli, buna inche Omonene nagochikire.”
english: If his father had no brothers, give his inheritance to the nearest relative in his clan, that he may possess it. This is to be a legal requirement for the Israelites, as the LORD commanded Moses.'"

ekegusii: Onye omonene oye omonyuomeretie omokungu, na ere omoiboreire abana, abamura gose abaiseke, omokungu oria na abana baye nigo barabe enibo y’omonene oye; omosacha oria nigo ararueo ere bweka,
english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the woman and her children shall belong to her master, and only the man shall go free.

ekegusii: Abana baye nigo bakoegwa ogosikwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio; nigo bakourwa ogosikwa kwabo na gokeeigwa, korende ere tari komanya ayio.
english: If his sons are honored, he does not know it; if they are brought low, he does not see it.

ekegusii: Korende inse gotebana, erio omanye buna abanto bagwenerete kogenderera ase enyomba ya Nyasae, eyere ekanisa ya Nyasae ore moyo, naende ere esiiro na oboroso ebire bi’ekeene.
english: if I am delayed, you will know how people ought to conduct themselves in God's household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwane onye inde omokori amabe; na onye inde omonyaboronge tinkonyara gwetogia; nigo ing’ichire nobosooku, ase ayio aye origererie emechando yane.
english: If I am guilty-- woe to me! Even if I am innocent, I cannot lift my head, for I am full of shame and drowned in my affliction.

ekegusii: Korende onye nkoba moyo ase omobere, aya nigo akondetera okwama kw’emeremo yane; gaki eri ndigetie gochora, tindimanyeti.
english: If I am to go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. Yet what shall I choose? I do not know!

ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, inse gokweba, rirorio okoboko kwane gw’okorio kogatae.
english: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand forget [its skill].

ekegusii: Onye, nase engencho ya mwanyabanto, nkarwana ne ching’iti chintindi aaria Efeso, inki erangwenere? Onye abakure tibakoboka, “Tiga torie na konywa, ekiagera ankio natokwe.”
english: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for merely human reasons, what have I gained? If the dead are not raised, "Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die."

ekegusii: Naende ningabera abataka ebinto biane bionsi, naende nindua omobere one oyie ase omorero, onye tindi nobwanchani, ayio takongwenera gento.
english: If I give all I possess to the poor and surrender my body to the flames, but have not love, I gain nothing.

ekegusii: Ekero ngosoka gochia ase ebitii, nigo nkorora ebitondo biaitirwe nemioro, na ekero ngosoa ase omochie, nigo nkorora abanto bachandegete nenchara. Ababani amo nabakuani nigo bakona‐goetanana, korende tibamanyeti ense eye bakogenda.”
english: If I go into the country, I see those slain by the sword; if I go into the city, I see the ravages of famine. Both prophet and priest have gone to a land they know not.'"

ekegusii: Ninsa koriina gochia igoro, aye nao ore; ninsa kwara ekerarero kiane agwo aase abakure, aye nao ore.
english: If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in the depths, you are there.

ekegusii: Onye nabete ndengereretie amabe ase enkoro yane, Omonene anga tantegererete.
english: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened;

ekegusii: Onye ntachete gokwana nabarabwo, anga tibarenge nebibe, korende bono tibari nogwekengera ase ebibe biabo.
english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.

ekegusii: Onye ntakorete emeremo asebare eye monto onde atakoreti, anga tibabete nebibe, korende bono barorire, naende batogechire inche na Tata.
english: If I had not done among them what no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have seen these miracles, and yet they have hated both me and my Father.

ekegusii: Onye nakwanete amang’ana buna ayio, nigo narenge gocha koba oyotari omwegenwa ase ebiaare bi’abanto bao.
english: If I had said, "I will speak thus," I would have betrayed your children.

ekegusii: Tinatubete ogosaria kwane buna engencho ya mwanyabanto ere, gose ebibe biane ase egekuba kiane ime.
english: if I have concealed my sin as men do, by hiding my guilt in my heart

ekegusii: if I have devoured its yield without payment or broken the spirit of its tenants,
english: Onye nabeire nkoria okwama kwaye ntari goakana na kogera abanyene bakwe,

ekegusii: onye naakanire omosani one amabe, gose nasakoire ebinto bi’omobisa one engencho ende etaiyo,
english: if I have done evil to him who is at peace with me or without cause have robbed my foe--

ekegusii: tinarenge koria endagera yane inche bweka, nigo naete nentakana nero, ekayeria.
english: if I have kept my bread to myself, not sharing it with the fatherless--

ekegusii: “Onye nakorerete entakana bobe ekiagera namanyete ng’a ekegambero agwo ase egeita ngenkonye,
english: if I have raised my hand against the fatherless, knowing that I had influence in court,

ekegusii: Tinarigereretie erioba ekero riabarete, gose omotienyi ekero omesete,
english: if I have regarded the sun in its radiance or the moon moving in splendor,

ekegusii: tinagokerete gose gochengera obotenenku bwane obonge, gose ebinto nenyorerete namaboko aane.
english: if I have rejoiced over my great wealth, the fortune my hands had gained,

ekegusii: “Inee! Monto onde nare ochandegete ase okoborwa chianga, gose omotaka otabwati ekiebisio, ntakonyete?
english: if I have seen anyone perishing for lack of clothing, or a needy man without a garment,

ekegusii: Aye omorigereria bw’abanto, onye ngokora ebibe, ninki nagokoreire? Nase ki gwankorire nabeire ekerenga kiao? Nase ki nabeire buna egurube endito asore?
english: If I have sinned, what have I done to you, O watcher of men? Why have you made me your target? Have I become a burden to you?

ekegusii: Naende ninsa koba nekeegwa gi’okobana, na komanya obobisi bwonsi, ne chisemi chionsi; nimba nokwegena gwonsi oko koranyare kong’anyia ebitunwa, korende onye tindi nobwanchani, inche tindi gento.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have a faith that can move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.

ekegusii: Kondaimokererie omotwe one igoro, aye nigo okondigia buna endo egotwara orotwari, erinde ogenderere koorokia amakumia ao igoro yane.
english: If I hold my head high, you stalk me like a lion and again display your awesome power against me.

ekegusii: Onye ngwenerete gwetogia, ninyetogerie amang’ana ’oboreu bwane.
english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.

ekegusii: Naki onye ngokora emeremo eye ase ogwancha kwane, ninde neng’eria; korende onye tari ase ogwancha kwane, nonya nabo negenirwe noborendi.
english: If I preach voluntarily, I have a reward; if not voluntarily, I am simply discharging the trust committed to me.

ekegusii: Korende kondaagache naende aria natagorete, neorokirie inche omonyene ng’a nomomochi inde.
english: If I rebuild what I destroyed, I prove that I am a lawbreaker.

ekegusii: Ninsa koirurukigwa namasase a mambia, ingende komenya ase chinsinyo chi’enyancha,
english: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle on the far side of the sea,

ekegusii: Nintebie oboina: Naye tata. Nintebie amakonde: Ninwe baba na abaiseke baminto.
english: if I say to corruption, 'You are my father,' and to the worm, 'My mother' or 'My sister,'

ekegusii: Ninsa goteba, “Tiga omosunte ontube kegima, na oborabu bong’etanaine boonchoke bobe omosunte”,
english: If I say, "Surely the darkness will hide me and the light become night around me,"

ekegusii: If I say, 'I will forget my complaint, I will change my expression, and smile,'
english: Inse goteba ng’a nyebe ogwechanda kwane, na ntige omoichano one inyeremie,

ekegusii: ninsa koa abanto aba ribaga bagende chinsobo nenchara, nabagoye inchera, na abande ase egati yabo ng’are barwete.”
english: If I send them home hungry, they will collapse on the way, because some of them have come a long distance."

ekegusii: Inse gokora ebibe, aye nigo ondigereretie, na totiga kong’a egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biane.
english: If I sinned, you would be watching me and would not let my offense go unpunished.

ekegusii: Ninsa gokwana ase emenwa ya mwanyabanto na ey’abamalaika, onye tindi nobwanchani, nabeire buna etaai ekwoga gose endege ekobuga.
english: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a resounding gong or a clanging cymbal.

ekegusii: Kondarie ensemo yane ase ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, nase ki nkoramwa ase egento nasabeire?
english: If I take part in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of something I thank God for?

ekegusii: Kondatebie omonyaboronge ng’a nabe moyo, korende ere asemerie oboronge bwaye na akore aya atari ay’oboronge, rirorio ogokora kwaye konde gwonsi kw’oboronge akorete tigokoinyorwa; ere nakwe ase engencho y’ayio atari oboronge akorire.
english: If I tell the righteous man that he will surely live, but then he trusts in his righteousness and does evil, none of the righteous things he has done will be remembered; he will die for the evil he has done.

ekegusii: “Onye narenge nenchara, tinare kogotebia, ekiagera ense, na ebinto bionsi bireo nebiane.
english: If I were hungry I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

ekegusii: Inwe onye mogwetogia ng’a nabaya more kombua na kong’enekeria igo kobwatekana nogochaywa kwane,
english: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my humiliation against me,

ekegusii: If it bears fruit next year, fine! If not, then cut it down.'"
english: Noro korame amatunda, mbuya; onye taibo, erio oyonache.”

ekegusii: Onye mbianyarete, Inee, anga tibiatigetwe, tibikoruegwa? Naki onye abwo baare kobirua bakoorire gochenwa ara rimo, anga tibare kwerora ng’a mbare nebibe naende.
english: If it could, would they not have stopped being offered? For the worshipers would have been cleansed once for all, and would no longer have felt guilty for their sins.

ekegusii: Onye namang’ana e chinguru, rora ere nigo are ne chinguru. Onye igoro y’oboronge, monto ki oranyare koamererania nere?
english: If it is a matter of strength, he is mighty! And if it is a matter of justice, who will summon him?

ekegusii: Onye nomwana bw’omotienyi oyomo goika emiaka etano, rigori riaye nigo rirabe, ase omomura chisekeli isano, na ase omoiseke chisekeli isato.
english: If it is a person between one month and five years, set the value of a male at five shekels of silver and that of a female at three shekels of silver.

ekegusii: Onye nomonto omoke bw’emiaka etano goika emerongo ebere, rigori riaye nigo rirabe, ase omomura chisekeli emerongo ebere, na ase omoiseke chisekeli ikomi.
english: If it is a person between the ages of five and twenty, set the value of a male at twenty shekels and of a female at ten shekels.

ekegusii: Onye nomonto omogotu bw’emiaka emerongo etano nomo na goetania, rigori riaye nigo rirabe, ase omogaaka chisekeli ikomi na isano, na ase omong’ina chisekeli ikomi.
english: If it is a person sixty years old or more, set the value of a male at fifteen shekels and of a female at ten shekels.

ekegusii: Emeremo y’omonto kerayie, takonyora eng’eria, korende ere omonyene natoorigwe, korende buna oyo ogotaborigwa korwa ase omorero.
english: If it is burned up, he will suffer loss; he himself will be saved, but only as one escaping through the flames.

ekegusii: oyo okoremia abe ase okoremia kwaye; oyo okorua arue ase omoyo omorabu; oyo ogotenenera atenenere ase omokia; oyo okororera amabera arorere amabera nomogoko.
english: if it is encouraging, let him encourage; if it is contributing to the needs of others, let him give generously; if it is leadership, let him govern diligently; if it is showing mercy, let him do it cheerfully.

ekegusii: Onye enyomba eria tekoboorigwa ase engaki eria y’omwaka omogima, rirorio enyomba eria nigo erabe ey’omonto oria oyegorete, amo ney’ororeria rwaye kogenderera botambe. Enyomba eria tekoiranigwa ase omonyene ekero Omwaka bw’Omochengo oraike.
english: If it is not redeemed before a full year has passed, the house in the walled city shall belong permanently to the buyer and his descendants. It is not to be returned in the Jubilee.

ekegusii: Korende onye eng’iti eria entangi techenegeti, rirorio omonto oria ayeboorie koreng’ana ne rigori rirabekwe, naende amente ensemo ya isano ase rigori erio, gose onye tekoboorigwa rirorio eoonigwe ase rigori erabekerwe.
english: If it is one of the unclean animals, he may buy it back at its set value, adding a fifth of the value to it. If he does not redeem it, it is to be sold at its set value.

ekegusii: Keranyarekane ase ensemo yaino, mobe nomorembe nabanto bonsi.
english: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

ekegusii: onye nogokorera, tobeo ase ogokorera gwaito; oyo okworokereria abe ase okworokereria kwaye;
english: If it is serving, let him serve; if it is teaching, let him teach;

ekegusii: Onye oborwaire obwo bwesiareire ase risankwa, erio omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti, risankwa rianyorire oborwaire.
english: If it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is infectious.

ekegusii: If it is true that I have gone astray, my error remains my concern alone.
english: Ee, nonya ekeene nakorire okomocha, okomocha okwo nokwane.

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti, amang’ana aya karakogwenere, karue ogochika ng’a abanto aba baitwe basirigwe kegima. Onye nabo nindete chifeta chitalanta chilifu ikomi (10,000) ase abanto abwo bagokora emeremo yao, aye omoruoti; ne chifeta echio nigo chirabekwe ase ekungo yao, aye omoruoti.”
english: If it pleases the king, let a decree be issued to destroy them, and I will put ten thousand talents of silver into the royal treasury for the men who carry out this business."

ekegusii: Onye ngwenerete ngende inche, rirorio nabagende amo nainche.
english: If it seems advisable for me to go also, they will accompany me.

ekegusii: If it was not useful for anything when it was whole, how much less can it be made into something useful when the fire has burned it and it is charred?
