english: In a similar way, Sodom and Gomorrah and the surrounding towns gave themselves up to sexual immorality and perversion. They serve as an example of those who suffer the punishment of eternal fire.

ekegusii: Ekero nabete nekeririanda ekenene, nigo nabisete obosio bwane korwa asore ase engaki enke, korende ase obwanchani bwa kare na kare ninkororere amabera.” Nabo Omonene, oyore Omobooria oo atebire.
english: In a surge of anger I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you," says the LORD your Redeemer.

ekegusii: Engaki netigarete enke, erio rinani ria Lebanoni riraonchorwe ribe omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge; na omogondo oria orenge kwama chindagera chinyinge oonchorwe obe rinani.
english: In a very short time, will not Lebanon be turned into a fertile field and the fertile field seem like a forest?

ekegusii: Na ere ase okorora ororire omonto okorokwa Anania ogosoa, okomobekera amaboko, anyare korora.”
english: In a vision he has seen a man named Ananias come and place his hands on him to restore his sight."

ekegusii: Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, akaegwa orogongo rwaye ase egati y’abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda, buna Omonene achigete Yoshua. Akaegwa Kiriati‐Ariba, (nao Heburoni). Ariba nere orenge sokoro y’Anaki.
english: In accordance with the LORD's command to him, Joshua gave to Caleb son of Jephunneh a portion in Judah-- Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron. (Arba was the forefather of Anak.)

ekegusii: Ase ayio nagosabire, bwabere ebibe bi’abanto aba koreng’ana nobonene bw’obwanchani bwao botari koera, koreng’ana buna aye kwabaaberete korwa ekero barenge Misiri goika rero iga.”
english: In accordance with your great love, forgive the sin of these people, just as you have pardoned them from the time they left Egypt until now."

ekegusii: Kobua onsi bogoria enguba y’okwegena, ase eyio namonyare korimia emegwe yonsi y’omorero y’oria omobe.
english: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

ekegusii: Inwe mwarentire ime ase enyomba yane enchenu abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni abatarogeti ase chinkoro chiabo, na ase emebere yabo, kobeera ime ase enyomba yane na mwayekorire yabeire eyetachenegeti, ekero mokorua asende okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya, na amanyinga. Inwe mwasaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, boigo mwakorire ogokora konde gwonsi gw’okogechia.
english: In addition to all your other detestable practices, you brought foreigners uncircumcised in heart and flesh into my sanctuary, desecrating my temple while you offered me food, fat and blood, and you broke my covenant.

ekegusii: Baalamu, omoringoria, mosinto o Beori, nigo arenge oyomo bw’abwo Abaisraeli baitete nemioro.
english: In addition to those slain in battle, the Israelites had put to the sword Balaam son of Beor, who practiced divination.

ekegusii: Naende abakungu bande ba seito nigo batoichanetie. Abwo barenge ase oboina mambia,
english: In addition, some of our women amazed us. They went to the tomb early this morning

ekegusii: Amo nayio bagaatananera abana abamura b’emiaka etato na goetania ebiegwa, abwo babarirwe na korikwa. Naende bagaatananera abwo babegetwe gokora emeremo yaganeirie ase enyomba y’Omonene kera rituko, koreng’ana nemeroberio y’ebiombe biabo.
english: In addition, they distributed to the males three years old or more whose names were in the genealogical records-- all who would enter the temple of the LORD to perform the daily duties of their various tasks, according to their responsibilities and their divisions.

ekegusii: Amo nabarabwo twatomire oyominto oyotwarorire ara aange ase amang’ana amange ng’a nare nomokia, na bono nare nomokia kobua, ekiagera ase ogosemeria are nakorokwo asemore.
english: In addition, we are sending with them our brother who has often proved to us in many ways that he is zealous, and now even more so because of his great confidence in you.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ’okogamba kwaye, Hieli o Beteli akaagacha Yeriko. Ekero abegete oboroso bw’omochie oyio, Abiiramu omwana oye omomura omotangi, agakwa; naende ekero atenenetie ebiita, Segubu, omwana oye omomura omokogoti, agakwa. Ayio igo akoregete koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene, riria riakwanetwe na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.
english: In Ahab's time, Hiel of Bethel rebuilt Jericho. He laid its foundations at the cost of his firstborn son Abiram, and he set up its gates at the cost of his youngest son Segub, in accordance with the word of the LORD spoken by Joshua son of Nun.

ekegusii: “Eriomana rinde rionsi riise gotuboka, onye igoro y’eng’ombe, gose etigere, gose eng’ondi, gose eanga, gose gento kende gionsi kerasire, na omonto oyomo aamererie ng’a nekiaye, ekina ekio ki’abanto abwo babere nigo kerarentwe ase obosio bwa Nyasae. Ere oyo Nyasae araorokie ng’a nomomochi, goika aakane oria onde ara kabere.
english: In all cases of illegal possession of an ox, a donkey, a sheep, a garment, or any other lost property about which somebody says, 'This is mine,' both parties are to bring their cases before the judges. The one whom the judges declare guilty must pay back double to his neighbor.

ekegusii: Bono ase egati y’Abaisraeli bonsi monto onde tarenge orenge nogotogigwa ase ekieni kiaye buna Abisalomu. Nigo arenge omonyakieni mono; korwa ebisanyi bi’amagoro goika omotwe oye tarenge na kemocho kende.
english: In all Israel there was not a man so highly praised for his handsome appearance as Absalom. From the top of his head to the sole of his foot there was no blemish in him.

ekegusii: ekiagera botambe ase ogosaba kwane nigo nkobasabera inwe mwensi nomogoko,
english: In all my prayers for all of you, I always pray with joy

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, aye nigo ore omonyene oboronge ase amang’ana aya onsi abeire agotonyora; aye nigo ore omwegenwa, korende intwe twakorire ayare amabe.
english: In all that has happened to us, you have been just; you have acted faithfully, while we did wrong.

ekegusii: Na ekero kende gionsi riire riare koimokerera igoro korwa ase Obomenyo obwo, Abaisraeli nigo baare koimoka kogenda orogendo rwabo. Naboigo baare gokora ase orogendo rwabo rwonsi.
english: In all the travels of the Israelites, whenever the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle, they would set out;

ekegusii: Ase ogochandwa kwabo gwonsi nere ochandegete, na omomalaika orwete ase obosio bw’Omonene akabatooria. Ekiagera abanchete, na abarorerete amabera, akabatooria. Nigo abete okobabogoria na kobarenda ase amatuko onsi a kare.
english: In all their distress he too was distressed, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and mercy he redeemed them; he lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio onsi Ayubu takorete ebibe, gose tabekerete Nyasae obobe.
english: In all this, Job did not sin by charging God with wrongdoing.

ekegusii: Emechie yonsi morabae nigo erabe emerongo ene, na etano na etato, amo nebitii bi’oborisia bietanaine emechie eyio.
english: In all you must give the Levites forty-eight towns, together with their pasturelands.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio kwarenge gokora ebibe bi’okogechia, na obotayayi, tikwainyorete amatuko aria ay’oboke bwao, ekero kwarenge getirianda otabegete kende, na kwarenge kwegaragaria ime ase amanyinga ao.”
english: In all your detestable practices and your prostitution you did not remember the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, kicking about in your blood.

ekegusii: Orengererie Omonene, omoorokie ase chinchera chiao chionsi, nere narongeyie oboeto bwao.
english: in all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

ekegusii: Ebikorero bionsi biaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu ne chifeta nigo biarenge chilifu isano, na amagana ane (5,400). Ebio bionsi Sesibasari akabiira Yerusalemu; ekero abanto baria barenge ase obosomba baruete Babeli, bakagenda Yerusalemu.
english: In all, there were 5,400 articles of gold and of silver. Sheshbazzar brought all these along when the exiles came up from Babylon to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Naende abagendia bagachia korigia gotama na gotiga emeeri, bagaikia obwato oboke gochia nyancha, bakang’ainereria buna mbarigetie koruta ebirochi korwa bosio bw’emeeri.
english: In an attempt to escape from the ship, the sailors let the lifeboat down into the sea, pretending they were going to lower some anchors from the bow.

ekegusii: in Anathoth, Nob and Ananiah,
english: Anatoti, na Nobu, na Anania;

ekegusii: Omonene oye akabea mono, akamobeka ase abarendi b’echela, goika aakane ebi ariete bionsi.
english: In anger his master turned him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should pay back all he owed.

ekegusii: Esegi ende yarenge n’Abafilisti agwo Gobu. Elihanani, mosinto o Yaare‐Oregimu korwa Bethlehemu, agaita Goliato korwa Gati. Orotanga rwe ritimo ria Goliato nigo rwarenge buna omwaro omonene.
english: In another battle with the Philistines at Gob, Elhanan son of Jaare-Oregim the Bethlehemite killed Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver's rod.

ekegusii: Naende esegi ekaba n’Abafilisti; Elihanani, mosinto o Yairi, agaita Lahami, omomura omwabo Goliato korwa Gati, oria orotanga rwe ritimo riaye rwareng’aine omwaro omonene.
english: In another battle with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver's rod.

ekegusii: Korende ningwenerete kobwatia enchera yane rero, na ankio, na ankio ende, naki temogwenereti omobani asirere isiko ya Yerusalemu.
english: In any case, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day-- for surely no prophet can die outside Jerusalem!

ekegusii: ase ogoakwa, ase ogosibwa, ase ogokorerwa riroroche, ase emeremo, ase okorenda, ase enchara,
english: in beatings, imprisonments and riots; in hard work, sleepless nights and hunger;

ekegusii: Akaagachera ebitongwa biria bionsi bia igoro ebisasimero agwo ase chiraaro ibere chi’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: In both courts of the temple of the LORD, he built altars to all the starry hosts.

ekegusii: Naki ase engencho ya Nyasae, na ase okobua kwaye, ebinto bionsi mbireo. Ase ayio yamogwenerete ere goikerania Omochaki bw’ogotooreka gwaito goetera ase emechando, erio aire abana abange ase obonene.
english: In bringing many sons to glory, it was fitting that God, for whom and through whom everything exists, should make the author of their salvation perfect through suffering.

ekegusii: Ekero enyomba yaagachetwe, igo yaagachetwe namagena aseneirie agwo aase arenge kobaacherwa, erinde eriogi ri’enyundo, gose eri’egesire, gose eri’egekorero kende gionsi gi’ekioma tikeigugwa ase Hekalu ekero yaagachetwe.
english: In building the temple, only blocks dressed at the quarry were used, and no hammer, chisel or any other iron tool was heard at the temple site while it was being built.

ekegusii: “Mwerende mono ekero mwarwarire oborwaire bwa ukoma, mokore buna abakuani Abalawi barabatebie.
english: In cases of leprous diseases be very careful to do exactly as the priests, who are Levites, instruct you. You must follow carefully what I have commanded them.

ekegusii: Dodadi bw’ororeria rw’Ahohi nere otenenerete ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000). Mikiloti nere orenge omokonyi oye.
english: In charge of the division for the second month was Dodai the Ahohite; Mikloth was the leader of his division. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Yasobeamu, mosinto o Sabidieli, nere otenenerete ekeombe egetang’ani, ase omotienyi bwe ritang’ani; ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: In charge of the first division, for the first month, was Jashobeam son of Zabdiel. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: amo nabarenge kobaraa: Serubabeli, na Yesua, Nehemia na Asaria, Raamia na Nahamani, Moredekai na Bilisani, Misipereti na Bigiwani, Nehumu na Baana): Omobaro bw’abasacha baria b’Abaisraeli noro oyo:
english: in company with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum and Baanah): The list of the men of Israel:

ekegusii: amo nabarenge kobaraa: Serubabeli na Yesua, Nehemia na Seraya, Reelaya na Moredekai, Bilisani na Misipari, Bigiwai na Rehumu, na Baana). Omobaro bw’abasacha baria b’Abaisraeli noro oyo:
english: in company with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum and Baanah): The list of the men of the people of Israel:

ekegusii: Aaria Damesiki gavuna, oyorenge inse y’omoruoti Areta, nigo arenge korenda omochie o Damesiki, akarigia kombwata.
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas had the city of the Damascenes guarded in order to arrest me.

ekegusii: Ase Damesiki narengeo omworokigwa ore korokwa Anania. Omonene akamotebia ase okorora, “Anania!” Ere akairaneria, “Omonene nao inde aiga.”
english: In Damascus there was a disciple named Ananias. The Lord called to him in a vision, "Ananias!" "Yes, Lord," he answered.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko agochi‐gocha Omonene nae abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo ribaga baseboke, ee, Abaisraeli mbasokie ebisicha na ebisebo, mbaame amatunda aichore ase ense yonsi.
english: In days to come Jacob will take root, Israel will bud and blossom and fill all the world with fruit.

ekegusii: Igo nobeke omorero bw’amakara ase omotwe oye, na Omonene nakoe eng’eria yao.
english: In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head, and the LORD will reward you.

ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, nere orenge omogambi agwo kare, na Omonene nigo arenge amo nere.
english: In earlier times Phinehas son of Eleazar was in charge of the gatekeepers, and the LORD was with him.

ekegusii: Yusufu akaiborerwa Manase na Efraimu, ase ense ya Misiri. Asenati, mosubati o Potifera, omokuani bw’Oni, akamoiborera abana abwo abamura.
english: In Egypt, Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.

ekegusii: Nigo akoirwa ase omoruoti obegete chiganchwa chi’ebieni ao ao, nigo agotunyanwa nabaiseke abekungi abare abagisangio baye; bonsi nigo bakoirwa ase omoruoti.
english: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her and are brought to you.

ekegusii: in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth,
english: abande bakamenya Eni-Rimoni, na Sora, na Yarimuti;

ekegusii: Ekero kende gionsi ebina bikorentwa asemore korwa ase abanto bamino, baria bamenyete ase emechie yabo, onye nigoro y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga, gose nigoro y’amang’ana ande onsi ay’amachiko na emeroberio yonsi echikire, rirorio mobakurere ng’a tibabaisa gokora okomocha ase Omonene, erinde endamwamu yaye tebaisa gocha igoro asemore na ase abanto baria bamino. Moise gokora bo, rirorio timokoba abamochi.
english: In every case that comes before you from your fellow countrymen who live in the cities-- whether bloodshed or other concerns of the law, commands, decrees or ordinances-- you are to warn them not to sin against the LORD; otherwise his wrath will come on you and your brothers. Do this, and you will not sin.

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ande onsi omoruoti ababoretie igoro y’obong’aini na obomanyi, akabanyora ng’a nigo bamanyete ara ikomi goetania abaringoria na abaragori barenge ase oboruoti bwaye bwonsi.
english: In every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king questioned them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his whole kingdom.

ekegusii: Ase kera orogongo na omochie, aande onsi ogochika kw’omoruoti kwararetigwe, Abayahudi bakaba nomogoko na omochengo, bagakora omoyega na bakaba ne Rituko Rinene. Abanto abange b’ebisaku binde bagekora koba Abayahudi ase okwoboa Abayahudi.
english: In every province and in every city, wherever the edict of the king went, there was joy and gladness among the Jews, with feasting and celebrating. And many people of other nationalities became Jews because fear of the Jews had seized them.

ekegusii: Ase ande onsi ase amang’ana ’ogochika koria kw’omoruoti konya ararigwe, Abayahudi bakaba nekerero ekenene mono; bakaba bakweng’ata, bakorera na kobokia amagombo. Abange babo bakaba beboyetie chigunia na beagete ribu.
english: In every province to which the edict and order of the king came, there was great mourning among the Jews, with fasting, weeping and wailing. Many lay in sackcloth and ashes.

ekegusii: Ase kera omochie bw’Abayuda akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro ogosambera ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao; Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaye, akagechigwa goika akaba nendamwamu.
english: In every town in Judah he built high places to burn sacrifices to other gods and provoked the LORD, the God of his fathers, to anger.

ekegusii: Daudi nigo arenge konyora obobui ase chinchera chiaye chionsi, ekiagera Omonene nigo arenge amo nere.
english: In everything he did he had great success, because the LORD was with him.

ekegusii: Yehosafati akabwatia chinchera chionsi chi’Asa ise, taonchogete na gochitiga; agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene. Korende nonya naboigo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa tatagoretwe, na abanto bakagenderera korua ebing’wanso na gosamba ubani aroro.
english: In everything he walked in the ways of his father Asa and did not stray from them; he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD. The high places, however, were not removed, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana aya onsi nabaorokeirie ng’a ase ogokora emeremo iga, nebagwenerete mokonye abatari ne chinguru, na koinyora amang’ana ’Omonene Yeso, buna akwanete omonyene: Nasesenirie oyokorua kobua oyokonyora.”
english: In everything I did, I showed you that by this kind of hard work we must help the weak, remembering the words the Lord Jesus himself said: 'It is more blessed to give than to receive.'"

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana onsi bweorokie aye omonyene koba ekiorokererio ki’ogokora okuya, na ase okworokereria kwao obe oyotagosaria, korende oyosikire.
english: In everything set them an example by doing what is good. In your teaching show integrity, seriousness

ekegusii: Ere agasesenigwa, ekiagera emeremo ende yonsi akorete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ase okobwata amachiko onsi, na komorigia Nyasae oye, nigo ayakorete nenkoro yaye yonsi.
english: In everything that he undertook in the service of God's temple and in obedience to the law and the commands, he sought his God and worked wholeheartedly. And so he prospered.

ekegusii: Erio agwo omokungu oyomo, omwana oye enyaroka obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi, akaigwa amang’ana aye, agacha akamogwera ase amagoro aye.
english: In fact, as soon as she heard about him, a woman whose little daughter was possessed by an evil spirit came and fell at his feet.

ekegusii: Ekeene, aba bonsi baganetie koba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae ase Kristo Yeso nabachandwe.
english: In fact, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will be persecuted,

ekegusii: Omonto takonyara gosoa ase enyomba y’omonto omonyene chinguru na gosakora ebinto biaye, atamosibeti ritang’ani oria omonyene chinguru; nario aranyare gosakora enyomba yaye.
english: In fact, no one can enter a strong man's house and carry off his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man. Then he can rob his house.

ekegusii: Bonsi batano na babere bakamotwara, tibatiga abana. Omoerio o bonsi omokungu oria nere agakwa.
english: In fact, none of the seven left any children. Last of all, the woman died too.

ekegusii: Amachiko nigo are goteba ng’a ang’e ebinto bionsi bichenwe namanyinga, na amanyinga ataiteiri, okwaberwa kw’ebibe tigokobao.
english: In fact, the law requires that nearly everything be cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

ekegusii: Naki ekeene, inwe anga mwabeire aborokia, ekiagera ebiro ebinge biaetire, korende nebagwenerete oyonde aborokererie amorokererio e ritang’ani ay’amang’ana a Nyasae. Inwe nebagwenerete moegwe amabeere, gose tari endagera enkong’u.
english: In fact, though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you the elementary truths of God's word all over again. You need milk, not solid food!

ekegusii: In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that we would be persecuted. And it turned out that way, as you well know.
english: Naki ekero twarenge amo nainwe ntwatang’anete kobatebia ng’a ntonyore emechando, buna yabete agwo, na inwe moyemanyete.

ekegusii: Naki iga mokoremereria nomonto, karabakore mobe abasomba, kararie ebiaino, abasakore, kareimokererie igoro, karabaake inwe ase obosio.
english: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or pushes himself forward or slaps you in the face.

ekegusii: Ekero ki’enchara nagotoorie korwa ase amakweri, na ekero gi’esegi korwa ase abwo bagoita nemioro.
english: In famine he will ransom you from death, and in battle from the stroke of the sword.

ekegusii: Obutoire chingunchara chionsi chi’Abaisraeli ore nendamwamu yaye entindi, orusirie okoboko kwaye gw’okorio korwa asebare ase amasio ’ababisa babo: ere osambire abanto ba Yakobo buna omorero ekebemberi ogosamba ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: In fierce anger he has cut off every horn of Israel. He has withdrawn his right hand at the approach of the enemy. He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it.

ekegusii: Nigo egotitiria riroba ere nobotindi na ekeririanda, gose teri gotegerera ekire, ekero egetureri gekobugigwa.
english: In frenzied excitement he eats up the ground; he cannot stand still when the trumpet sounds.

ekegusii: Abateri nigo batang’aine bosio, nyuma yabo abakobugia amakano, na ase egati yabo abaiseke bakobugia chinchigiri:
english: In front are the singers, after them the musicians; with them are the maidens playing tambourines.

ekegusii: Orosenge ndwarenge bosio bw’ebinyomba biria bi’oborendi, na obogare bw’egesona keria nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo. Ebisona bi’ebinyomba ebio bie chinsemo chionsi ibere nigo biareng’aine. Kera akanyomba nigo karenge nobogare bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na rimo, na obotambe bwaye boigo.
english: In front of each alcove was a wall one cubit high, and the alcoves were six cubits square.

ekegusii: Bosio bw’ebinyomba biria aase arenge goeterwa narengeo; obogare bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obotambe bwaye amaboko rigana erimo. Ebisieri bi’ebinyomba biria nigo biarochie sugusu.
english: In front of the rooms was an inner passageway ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long. Their doors were on the north.

ekegusii: Abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etano na ebere, amo na Yasania, mosinto o Safania, nigo bateneine ase egati y’emegwekano eyio y’ogosasimwa. Kera oyomo nigo abwate ase amaboko aye egetaabo ki’ogosambera ubani, na erioki ria ubani richongororogete gochia igoro.
english: In front of them stood seventy elders of the house of Israel, and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was standing among them. Each had a censer in his hand, and a fragrant cloud of incense was rising.

ekegusii: Ase endamwamu yaye enene, na obotindi, ne risemi rinene, Omonene akabaseria korwa ase ense yabo, akabasiarera gochia ase ense eng’ao; nao bare goika rero iga.
english: In furious anger and in great wrath the LORD uprooted them from their land and thrust them into another land, as it is now."

ekegusii: In Galilee these women had followed him and cared for his needs. Many other women who had come up with him to Jerusalem were also there.
english: Aba nabwo bamotunyanete ekero arenge Galili na komokorera, amo nabande abange abakungu abatiirete amo nere goika Yerusalemu.

ekegusii: Nigo nsemeretie Nyasae ntari nobwoba. Inee! Mwanyabanto inki aranyare gonkorera?
english: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

ekegusii: Intwe ntogenderere gwetogia asore aye Nyasae, ntobe tokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao kogenderera botambe.
english: In God we make our boast all day long, and we will praise your name forever. Selah

ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring’ana riaye, ninsemeretie Nyasae ntari nobwoba. Inee! Mwanyabanto inki baranyare gonkorera?
english: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can mortal man do to me?

ekegusii: Ase okobua kwa Nyasae nintogie ring’ana riaye; ee, ase okobua kw’Omonene nintogie ring’ana riaye.
english: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise--

ekegusii: ase chitahabu, ne chifeta, na ebioma. Imoka, ochake gokora emeremo! Omonene abe amo naye.”
english: in gold and silver, bronze and iron-- craftsmen beyond number. Now begin the work, and the LORD be with you."

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaondoka mono na koumata, agaatanana abanto baria barenge amo nere, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chingamia, bikaba ebiombe bibere,
english: In great fear and distress Jacob divided the people who were with him into two groups, and the flocks and herds and camels as well.

ekegusii: in Hadid, Zeboim and Neballat,
english: Hadidi, na Seboimo na Nebalati;

ekegusii: na Hasani-Suali, na Beeri-Seba, na ase ebichie biaye;
english: in Hazar Shual, in Beersheba and its settlements,

ekegusii: in Hazor, Ramah and Gittaim,
english: Hasori, na Rama, na Gitaimu;

ekegusii: Agwo Heburoni akagambera Abayuda ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere, na emetienyi etano nomo, naende agwo Yerusalemu akagambera Abaisraeli bonsi amo n’Abayuda ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etato, na atato.
english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned over all Israel and Judah thirty-three years.

ekegusii: na ekero aare agwo aase abakure akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora Ibrahimu okare aare, na Lazaro ore ase egekuba kiaye.
english: In hell, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham far away, with Lazarus by his side.

ekegusii: Nigo abwate egekorero akoroiseria chiusi namaboko aye na egete agochiranderera nebiara biaye.
english: In her hand she holds the distaff and grasps the spindle with her fingers.

ekegusii: Ime y’omochie oria akanyorekanao amanyinga ’ababani, na ay’abachenu, na aya baria bonsi abaitetwe ase ense.”
english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of the saints, and of all who have been killed on the earth."

ekegusii: Asere ntore noboremu na ogosemeria kw’ogosoa ase enchera y’okomwegena.
english: In him and through faith in him we may approach God with freedom and confidence.

ekegusii: Ee, chinkoro chiaito nchimogokerete, ekiagera tosemeretie erieta riaye richenu.
english: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.

ekegusii: Asare ere oboagacho bwonsi bwabwatanigwe amo, na gokina, bobe Hekalu Enchenu ase Omonene.
english: In him the whole building is joined together and rises to become a holy temple in the Lord.

ekegusii: Ime yaye nao bwarenge obogima; na obogima obwo nigo bwarenge omobaso ase abanto.
english: In him was life, and that life was the light of men.

ekegusii: Asare ere ntore nokoboorigwa ase amanyinga aye, na okwaberwa kw’ebibe biaito ase obonge bw’obuya bwaye,
english: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace

ekegusii: Ime yaye twanyorire omwando, koreng’ana buna twachoretwe korwa kare ase okorigia kwaye ere oyokorete onsi koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye,
english: In him we were also chosen, having been predestined according to the plan of him who works out everything in conformity with the purpose of his will,

ekegusii: Asare boigo mwarokigwe okwaroka gotakoriri namaboko, ase okorusia okobua kw’ebibe ase omobere, engencho yaye okwaroka gokorwa ase Kristo,
english: In him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of the sinful nature, not with a circumcision done by the hands of men but with the circumcision done by Christ,

ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene akaba nendamwamu entindi ase Abaisraeli, akababeka ase amaboko ’abanto abaurereria. Naende akababeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, baria babaetanaine, na Abaisraeli bakabugwa nababisa baria.
english: In his anger against Israel the LORD handed them over to raiders who plundered them. He sold them to their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.

ekegusii: Abakori amabe baenenire na gokorera abaremerwa bobe. Tiga babwatwe abanyene ase emeroberio yabo y’obobe.
english: In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak, who are caught in the schemes he devises.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aye Abayuda nabatoorigwe na Abaisraeli bamenye ase obotoereru, na oyio narokwe: Omonene Nere Oboronge Bwaito.”
english: In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. This is the name by which he will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.

ekegusii: Tiga omonyaboronge asesenigwe ase amatuko aye, na omorembe ogenderere kobao goika ekero omotienyi otabeo.
english: In his days the righteous will flourish; prosperity will abound till the moon is no more.

ekegusii: Ekero arenge ase emechando emenene, agasaba Omonene Nyasae oye, akamosorora; agekeyia ase oboitongo obonene ase obosio bwa Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaye.
english: In his distress he sought the favor of the LORD his God and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

ekegusii: Oborwaire bwane bwabeire ne chinguru bwaonchoire risankwa ri’omobere one, bono nigo ring’usererete buna rigoti ri’eanga yane.
english: In his great power [God] becomes like clothing to me; he binds me like the neck of my garment.

ekegusii: Ere nigo abwatete amakura ’ense ase okoboko kwaye, naboigo nebitunwa ebitambe bire ebiaye.
english: In his hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to him.

ekegusii: Obogima bwa kera egetongwa kere moyo na omoika o mwanyabanto, nigo bire ase okoboko kwaye.
english: In his hand is the life of every creature and the breath of all mankind.

ekegusii: Ase enkoro yaye ime omonto nigo akoroberia chinchera chiaye, korende Omonene nere okoraa amatambokero aye.
english: In his heart a man plans his course, but the LORD determines his steps.

ekegusii: Ase ogwekeyia kwaye ekina kiaye gekarusigwa. Ning’o oranyare gototebia ororeria rwaye? Ekiagera obogima bwaye bwarusigwe ase ense.”
english: In his humiliation he was deprived of justice. Who can speak of his descendants? For his life was taken from the earth."

ekegusii: na ase erieta riaye abanto b’Ebisaku inabarisemerie.”
english: In his name the nations will put their hope."

ekegusii: Omokori amabe ase oboenenu bwaye nigo agoteba ng’a Nyasae takomoa egesusuro. Nigo akorengereria ng’a Nyasae tari.
english: In his pride the wicked does not seek him; in all his thoughts there is no room for God.

ekegusii: Ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio nigo abwate ching’enang’eni isano na ibere, na ase omonwa oye okaruao omoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere, na obosio bwaye nigo bware kobara buna erioba rikobara ne chinguru chiaye.
english: In his right hand he held seven stars, and out of his mouth came a sharp double-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining in all its brilliance.

ekegusii: Ahasi omoruoti oria oria akamenta gotaba omwegenwa ase Omonene, ase engaki eria anyorete emechando.
english: In his time of trouble King Ahaz became even more unfaithful to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na gatato, bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro Nebusaradani, omoteneneri bw’abarendi, akaira Abayahudi amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ene na batano (745); bonsi Abanto abairetwe nigo barenge chilifu inye, na amagana atano na rimo (4,600).
english: in his twenty-third year, 745 Jews taken into exile by Nebuzaradan the commander of the imperial guard. There were 4,600 people in all.

ekegusii: ase obochenu na ase oboronge ase obosio bwaye amatuko aito onsi.
english: in holiness and righteousness before him all our days.

ekegusii: Ase rirube erio nigo arigete iga: “Otang’anie Uria bosio bw’abarwani aase esegi ere entindi Erio morueo, momotige aroro aitwe akwe.”
english: In it he wrote, "Put Uriah in the front line where the fighting is fiercest. Then withdraw from him so he will be struck down and die."

ekegusii: Boigo agwo Yerusalemu, Yehosafati akabeka Abalawi bande, na abakuani, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakaba bakogamba ebina ribaga ri’Omonene, naende bagatorania amariomana. Ekero abagambi baria barenge koba bairanire agwo Yerusalemu,
english: In Jerusalem also, Jehoshaphat appointed some of the Levites, priests and heads of Israelite families to administer the law of the LORD and to settle disputes. And they lived in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Daudi akanyuoma abakungu bande agwo Yerusalemu, na abwo bakamoiborera abana abange, abamura na abaiseke.
english: In Jerusalem David took more wives and became the father of more sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Akabeka abanto agwo Yerusalemu koroisia ebikorero bi’okorutera emegwe na amagena amanene. Ebikorero ebio bikabekwa ase emerobiri igoro na ase chikoona chie chindwaki, erinde emegwe na amagena amanene biraserwe nabirobio. Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera gochia aare, ekiagera nigo akonyetwe ase enchera y’ogokumia, goika akaba nokobua okonene.
english: In Jerusalem he made machines designed by skillful men for use on the towers and on the corner defenses to shoot arrows and hurl large stones. His fame spread far and wide, for he was greatly helped until he became powerful.

ekegusii: in Jeshua, in Moladah, in Beth Pelet,
english: abande bakamenya Yesua, na Molada, na Beti-Peleti,

ekegusii: Ase Yopa narengeo omworokigwa oyomo ore korokwa Tabitha, engencho yaye Dorika, gose Engabi. Omokungu oyio nigo arenge oichire nogokora okuya na ebiegwa ebi arenge korua.
english: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha (which, when translated, is Dorcas), who was always doing good and helping the poor.

ekegusii: Akabwatia omoroberio o Daudi ise, akabeka ebiombe bi’abakuani ase ogokora emeremo yabo, na Abalawi ase emeremo yabo y’ogokonya abakuani na ase ogotera amatera ’ogotogia, na emeremo ende buna yaganeirie kera rituko. Boigo akabeka ebiombe bi’abarendi b’ebiita gokora emeremo yabo ase kera egeita buna yaganeirie kera rituko, buna Daudi, omonto oria o Nyasae, achigete ekorwe.
english: In keeping with the ordinance of his father David, he appointed the divisions of the priests for their duties, and the Levites to lead the praise and to assist the priests according to each day's requirement. He also appointed the gatekeepers by divisions for the various gates, because this was what David the man of God had ordered.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kwa Hezekia omoruoti, noro omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kwa Hosea, mosinto o Ela, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Salimaneseri, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akagenda korwania Samaria, akayoboera.
english: In King Hezekiah's fourth year, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marched against Samaria and laid siege to it.

ekegusii: Inwe abakungu motechandereti kende, ekero amatuko aetanetie omwaka aerire mobe mogochandeka, ekiagera emesabibu tekwama, ne rigesa rie chindagera tirikoba.
english: In little more than a year you who feel secure will tremble; the grape harvest will fail, and the harvest of fruit will not come.

ekegusii: Lodi, na Ono, na ase Rikura ri’Abaroisia Ebinto.
english: in Lod and Ono, and in the Valley of the Craftsmen.

ekegusii: Erio ekerogo ki’obonene ngetenenigwe ase obwanchani bogendererete botambe. Oyomo ore omwegenwa naikaransere ekerogo ekio, oyomo korwa ase obomenyo bwa Daudi. Ere nabe okogamba ase ekeene, na gokora ayare ay’oboronge.”
english: In love a throne will be established; in faithfulness a man will sit on it-- one from the house of David-- one who in judging seeks justice and speeds the cause of righteousness.

ekegusii: Agwo Listra narengeo omonto oyomo ekerema. Ere nigo arenge rigata korwa ase okoiborwa kwaye, tana kogenda nonya ng’ake.
english: In Lystra there sat a man crippled in his feet, who was lame from birth and had never walked.

ekegusii: Omotangi oye nigo are nobonene bwe chinguru buna echi’eeri, ne cingunchara chiaye nigo chire buna echi’eng’era, ase chirochio naserie abanto goikera ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense. Echio nachio chilifu ikomi chi’Abaefraimu, naende echio nachio chilifu chinyinge chi’Abamanase.”
english: In majesty he is like a firstborn bull; his horns are the horns of a wild ox. With them he will gore the nations, even those at the ends of the earth. Such are the ten thousands of Ephraim; such are the thousands of Manasseh."

ekegusii: Ninsirie Abamoabu, abwo bakorua ebing’wanso agwo aase aimokererete igoro na gosamba ubani ase enyasae yabo.
english: In Moab I will put an end to those who make offerings on the high places and burn incense to their gods," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero narenge nobwoba nigo narengereretie, ngateba; “Bono naserigwe gochia aare korwa ase obosio bwao!” Korende nigo kwaigwete okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, ekero narerete asore ng’a onkonye.
english: In my alarm I said, "I am cut off from your sight!" Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.

ekegusii: Ekero narenge nemechando nkamorangeria Omonene; nere akang’iraneria, akambeka aase aagare.
english: In my anguish I cried to the LORD, and he answered by setting me free.

ekegusii: Ase emechando yane nkarangeria Omonene; nkarera ase Nyasae one. Korwa ase Hekalu yaye akaigwa eriogi riane, ekerero kiane gekamoikera, ere agakeigwa.”
english: In my distress I called to the LORD; I called out to my God. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came to his ears.

ekegusii: Ase emechando yane nkarangeria Omonene, nkarera ase Nyasae one ng’a ankonye. Korwa ase Hekalu yaye akaigwa eriogi riane, ekerero kiane gekamoikera, ere agakeigwa.
english: In my distress I called to the LORD; I cried to my God for help. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came before him, into his ears.

ekegusii: Ase enyomba ya Tata nere nobomenyo obonge; onye taibo, anga nabatebia. Nkogenda nde kobaroiseria aase.
english: In my Father's house are many rooms; if it were not so, I would have told you. I am going there to prepare a place for you.

ekegusii: Aye Theofilo, ase ebuku eria ye ritang’ani narigete igoro ase onsi aya Yeso akorete na kworokereria korwa omochakano,
english: In my former book, Theophilus, I wrote about all that Jesus began to do and to teach

ekegusii: Aye gwankonyire, ekiagera tindi na komocha, kwambekire gotenena ase obosio bwao kogenderera botambe.
english: In my integrity you uphold me and set me in your presence forever.

ekegusii: Korende anga mbuya kobua karabe buna are. Nigo ndoche inche; na inche narengereirie ng’a ninde n’Omoika o Nyasae.
english: In my judgment, she is happier if she stays as she is-- and I think that I too have the Spirit of God.

ekegusii: Botambe nigo ngosaba ng’a Nyasae karanche konyigorera enchera engiya, inchiche asemore.
english: in my prayers at all times; and I pray that now at last by God's will the way may be opened for me to come to you.

ekegusii: Ase okorora kwane nkarora ng’a nigo narenge ase eburi y’omochie o Susa, agwo ase orogongo rwa Elamu. Ekero narengeo ase okorora kwane, nkarora inde ang’e norooche rwa Ulai.
english: In my vision I saw myself in the citadel of Susa in the province of Elam; in the vision I was beside the Ulai Canal.

ekegusii: Nakwanire inde nerisemi na ekeririanda kenga omorero ng’a ekeene ase rituko erio omotengecho omonene nobe ase ense y’Abaisraeli.
english: In my zeal and fiery wrath I declare that at that time there shall be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato. Nebukadinesaro akaira korwa Yerusalemu abanto amagana atano na atato, na emerongo etato na babere (832).
english: in Nebuchadnezzar's eighteenth year, 832 people from Jerusalem;

ekegusii: Ase rituko erimo Peka, mosinto o Remalia, agaita abanto chituoni chilifu rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere (120,000) agwo ase ense ya Yuda. Aya nigo akoregete bo, ekiagera Abayuda batigete Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo.
english: In one day Pekah son of Remaliah killed a hundred and twenty thousand soldiers in Judah-- because Judah had forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers.

ekegusii: Naki ase ensa eyemo yoka obotenenku obonge buna iga bwabeire bosa.” Na abateneneri bonsi be chimeeri, na bonsi ababogorigwa ne chimeeri, na abagendia be chimeeri, na abwo bonsi bagokora emeremo ase enyancha bagatenena are,
english: In one hour such great wealth has been brought to ruin!' "Every sea captain, and all who travel by ship, the sailors, and all who earn their living from the sea, will stand far off.

ekegusii: Ngasiria abarisia batato ase omotienyi oyomo. Erio nkagechigwa ne ching’ondi chiane, nachirochio chikangecha.
english: In one month I got rid of the three shepherds. The flock detested me, and I grew weary of them

ekegusii: Abanto ba Sekemu bakabeka abanto ase ebitunwa igoro baboere abanto bonsi barenge goeta ase chinchera chiria na kobaura ebinto biabo. Abimeleki agatebigwa amang’ana ayio.
english: In opposition to him these citizens of Shechem set men on the hilltops to ambush and rob everyone who passed by, and this was reported to Abimelech.

ekegusii: erinde ase ebiro birache naorokie obonda bw’obuya bwaye, obo boetete ekerengo, ase obwororo asetore ime ase Kristo Yeso.
english: in order that in the coming ages he might show the incomparable riches of his grace, expressed in his kindness to us in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Saitani tabaisa gotobua; naki intwe titokomocha komanya obong’ainereria bwaye.
english: in order that Satan might not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.

ekegusii: erinde ekerigirie ime ase amachiko geikeranigwe ime yaito, aba totari gotunyana chingencho chiaito chi’ebibe, korende chingencho chi’Omoika.
english: in order that the righteous requirements of the law might be fully met in us, who do not live according to the sinful nature but according to the Spirit.

ekegusii: erinde intwe abatwatang’anete komosemeria Kristo togere obonene bwaye botogigwe.
english: in order that we, who were the first to hope in Christ, might be for the praise of his glory.

ekegusii: Engencho yaye, tari abana b’ororeria bare abana ba Nyasae, korende nabana b’eira bakobarwa ng’a noroiboro rwaye.
english: In other words, it is not the natural children who are God's children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as Abraham's offspring.

ekegusii: ase obochenu, ase okomanya, ase oboremereria, ase obwororo, ase Omoika Omochenu, ase obwanchani botari nobong’ainereria,
english: in purity, understanding, patience and kindness; in the Holy Spirit and in sincere love;

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero morayasome, namonyare korora okomanya kwane kw’obobisi bwa Kristo.
english: In reading this, then, you will be able to understand my insight into the mystery of Christ,

ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’oboronge, ekiagera nkogenda nde ase Tata, gose timokondora naende;
english: in regard to righteousness, because I am going to the Father, where you can see me no longer;

ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’ebibe, ekiagera tibanyegeneti inche;
english: in regard to sin, because men do not believe in me;

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri eria kabere, takonyara korora oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: In reply Jesus declared, "I tell you the truth, no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again."

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Narenge omonto ore gotirimboka korwa Yerusalemu kogenda Yeriko. Ere akaumera abauri, na barabwo bakamoumokera, bakamorusia chianga, bakamoaka chingoma, bakagenda, bakamotiga oisire gokwa.
english: In reply Jesus said: "A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, when he fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him of his clothes, beat him and went away, leaving him half dead.

ekegusii: Nonya inche mbanchete, barabwo nigo bangechete, ee, nonya ngendererete kobasabera.
english: In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

ekegusii: Goetera ase oboronge nokong’igwe; ogokorerwa bobe tigokogoika ang’e, ekiagera gento kende tikeri kerakoirokie; tokoba nobwoba, ekiagera eke gekwoboyia tigekogoika ang’e.
english: In righteousness you will be established: Tyranny will be far from you; you will have nothing to fear. Terror will be far removed; it will not come near you.

ekegusii: Igoro y’abamalaika nigo agoteba, “Ere ogokora abamalaika baye koba chimbeo, na abasomba baye koba ebibemberi b’omorero.”
english: In speaking of the angels he says, "He makes his angels winds, his servants flames of fire."

ekegusii: Amo nayio onsi Abayuda, abwo bare buna abasubati bamwabo Abaisraeli, batarenge abegenwa, tibang’iranerete ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi, korende ase okong’ainereria gwoka.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: In spite of all this, her unfaithful sister Judah did not return to me with all her heart, but only in pretense," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, abanto abwo nigo bagendererete gokora ebibe, nonya ere okorete amakumia, tibamwegenete.
english: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; in spite of his wonders, they did not believe.

ekegusii: Korende nonya okorete ayio onsi, timwamwegenete Omonene, Nyasae oino,
english: In spite of this, you did not trust in the LORD your God,

ekegusii: Naende esegi yarenge Gati. Omonto omotambe narengeo. Nigo arenge nebiara bitano na ekemo ase kera okoboko, na bitano na ekemo ase kera okogoro; bionsi nigo biarenge emerongo ebere na bine. Ere boigo noyomo bw’amamonto orenge.
english: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot-- twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.

ekegusii: Naende esegi ekaba agwo Gati. Omonto omotambe narengeo, oyorenge nebiara bitano na ekemo ase kera okoboko, na bitano na ekemo ase kera okogoro; bionsi nigo biarenge emerongo ebere na bine. Ere boigo noyomo bw’amamonto orenge.
english: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot-- twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.

ekegusii: Ekero barenge agwo Tapanesi, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamotebia,
english: In Tahpanhes the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio omogondo bw’emesabibu ore nedivai enyinge nobeo. Notererwe ogotera oko:
english: In that day-- "Sing about a fruitful vineyard:

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto b’emechie etano y’ense ya Misiri mbabe bagokwana omonwa bw’Abakanani, naende babe bakobwatana n’Omonene bw’Emeganda na gotiana ase erieta riaye. Oyomo bw’emechie eyio nigo orarokwe Omochie bw’Erioba.
english: In that day five cities in Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and swear allegiance to the LORD Almighty. One of them will be called the City of Destruction.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio nimbune amata ’Abaisraeli agwo ase ense omweremo ya Yesireeli.”
english: In that day I will break Israel's bow in the Valley of Jezreel."

ekegusii: “Ase rituko riria, ninkore okobwatana ne ching’iti chi’orosana, ne chinyoni, ne ching’iti chikwagura inse, ase engencho y’abanto baane. Ninsirie korwa ase ense eye amata, na emioro, na esegi, ntige batimoke bare nobotoereru.
english: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of the air and the creatures that move along the ground. Bow and sword and battle I will abolish from the land, so that all may lie down in safety.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli mbabwatane n’Abamisiri na Abaasuri, na ebisaku ebio bitato mbibe ogosesenigwa ase ense engima,
english: In that day Israel will be the third, along with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing on the earth.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto mbarigie ogokonywa korwa ase Omotongi obo, mbabe namasikani ase Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: In that day men will look to their Maker and turn their eyes to the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abanto mbatonge omorabaaro igoro yaino, babe bakobabokeria amagombo ’omoichano bagotera: “Twasirigwe kegima, Omonene oeire abanto abaao egetari ki’abanto baane, ee, ekeene okerusirie korwa asende, ogabeire abasaria emegondo yaito.”
english: In that day men will ridicule you; they will taunt you with this mournful song: 'We are utterly ruined; my people's possession is divided up. He takes it from me! He assigns our fields to traitors.'"

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abanto mbatugute emegwekano yabo ye chifeta na eye chitahabu, ebinto ebio beroiseretie ase okobisasima, mbabitugutere ching’uko na ebitabora mato.
english: In that day men will throw away to the rodents and bats their idols of silver and idols of gold, which they made to worship.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abanto mbagochere korwa Asuri na korwa ase emechie ya Misiri, ee, korwa Misiri goika orooche rwa Eufarati, na korwa ase enyancha eyemo goika ase eyende, na korwa ase egetunwa ekemo goika ase ekende.
english: In that day people will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, even from Egypt to the Euphrates and from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abakungu batano na babere mbabwate omosacha oyomo, bamotebie, “Intwe abanyene ntwenyorere endagera tokoria ne chianga tokobeka, korende tiga rioka torokwe abakungu bao, erinde otoruserie obosooku.”
english: In that day seven women will take hold of one man and say, "We will eat our own food and provide our own clothes; only let us be called by your name. Take away our disgrace!"

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omoseboka bw’Omonene noseboke ore omoseera na ore nobonene, na okwama gw’ense nkobe obonene na obosiani bw’Abaisraeli abaratooreke.
english: In that day the Branch of the LORD will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and glory of the survivors in Israel.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio emetino nebe ekoigwa amang’ana arikire ase ebuku, na emeuko yarenge ekorora buna rikongori na omosunte, nerore buya namaiso abo.
english: In that day the deaf will hear the words of the scroll, and out of gloom and darkness the eyes of the blind will see.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abamisiri mbabe buna abakungu, baiguswe bare nobwoba ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’Emeganda, ekero ararambore okoboko kwaye agosungusie igoro yabo.
english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will shudder with fear at the uplifted hand that the LORD Almighty raises against them.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene bw’Emeganda nabe egutwa y’obonene, na ekiore ki’obwari ase abanto baye abatigari,
english: In that day the LORD Almighty will be a glorious crown, a beautiful wreath for the remnant of his people.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene narue egesusuro ase emeganda ere igoro, aaria igoro, narue egesusuro ase abaruoti b’ense, aiga ase ense.
english: In that day the LORD will punish the powers in the heavens above and the kings on the earth below.

ekegusii: Nebe ase engaki eyio Omonene narambore okoboko kwaye eria kabere koirania abatigari b’abanto baye korwa Asuri, na Misiri, na Patirosi, na Etiopia, na Elamu, na Shinari, na Hamati, na korwa ase ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha.
english: In that day the Lord will reach out his hand a second time to reclaim the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Lower Egypt, from Upper Egypt, from Cush, from Elam, from Babylonia, from Hamath and from the islands of the sea.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Omonene nabaure ebinto bionsi bechaberete: ebitange bi’amagoro, na ebitinti, ne chisonoi chi’amagoti,
english: In that day the Lord will snatch away their finery: the bangles and headbands and crescent necklaces,

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene nabaswage inwe Abaisraeli buna chinyeke chi’endagera na kobachora oyomo oyomo. Nigo arachakere ase orooche rwa Eufarati na goikera ase akarooche ka Misiri.
english: In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt, and you, O Israelites, will be gathered up one by one.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene narente omoyio o tukia korwa ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Eufarati, noro omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akigitere chitukia chi’emetwe yabo, na agingire amarionya ’amagoro ne chinderu chiabo.
english: In that day the Lord will use a razor hired from beyond the River--the king of Assyria-- to shave your head and the hair of your legs, and to take off your beards also.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eye Omonene nabugie omororia, arangerie chingi echio chimenyete ase omochakano bw’ebirooche bia Misiri, naende arangerie chinchoke chire ase ense y’Abaasuri.
english: In that day the LORD will whistle for flies from the distant streams of Egypt and for bees from the land of Assyria.

ekegusii: “Ase rituko erio ebitunwa mbitonyie edivai enyansu, na ebigoro mbiichore amabeere, ne chindooche chionsi chi’Abayuda nachiichorwe namache. Ensoko netuboke korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, enyiyie ense omweya ya Sitimu.
english: 'In that day the mountains will drip new wine, and the hills will flow with milk; all the ravines of Judah will run with water. A fountain will flow out of the LORD's house and will water the valley of acacias.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abanto bamenyete ase ense ere ang’e nenyancha mbakwane, batebe: Rora amang’ana abanyorire abanto abwo intwe twasemeretie na kobatamera ng’a batokonye korwa ase omoruoti bw’Abaasuri! Bono, naki intwe toranyare gotooreka?”
english: In that day the people who live on this coast will say, 'See what has happened to those we relied on, those we fled to for help and deliverance from the king of Assyria! How then can we escape?'"

ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko ayio abatigari b’Abaisraeli na abwo b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baratooreke, tibakogenderera kweegeka ase egesaku ekio kiabaagete, korende ase obwegenwa nigo bareegeke ase Omonene, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: In that day the remnant of Israel, the survivors of the house of Jacob, will no longer rely on him who struck them down but will truly rely on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Oyore Egesebo kie ritina ria Yese natenene abe ekemanyererio ase abanto; abanto b’ebisaku mbamorigie, na obomenyo bwaye mbobe nobonene obonge.
english: In that day the Root of Jesse will stand as a banner for the peoples; the nations will rally to him, and his place of rest will be glorious.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio chigurube Abaasuri babegete ase amareko aino nchirusigweo, na amakorogoto babegete ase amagoti aino nabunwe ase obonetu bwaino.”
english: In that day their burden will be lifted from your shoulders, their yoke from your neck; the yoke will be broken because you have grown so fat.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio emechie yabo egiteire chindwaki nebe buna amatombe are ase amanani na ase ebitunwa igoro, ayio atigetwe ekero Abaisraeli bachete aroro. Emechie eyio nesarigwe etigare ere bosa.
english: In that day their strong cities, which they left because of the Israelites, will be like places abandoned to thickets and undergrowth. And all will be desolation.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio enchera enene nebeo ekorwa Misiri goika Asuri. Abaasuri mbabe bakogenda Misiri, na Abamisiri babe bakogenda Asuri; Abamisiri na Abaasuri mbabe bagosasimera amo.
english: In that day there will be a highway from Egypt to Assyria. The Assyrians will go to Egypt and the Egyptians to Assyria. The Egyptians and Assyrians will worship together.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio egesasimero nkeagacherwe Omonene agwo ase egatigati ya Misiri, boigo rigena rire buna esiiro nditenenerigwe Omonene agwo ase ribebe ri’ense eyio.
english: In that day there will be an altar to the LORD in the heart of Egypt, and a monument to the LORD at its border.

ekegusii: Ee, ase rituko erio nigo bararumere abanto buna enyancha ekoruma. Omonto kararigererie ense, nigo ararore omosunte na emechando, na oborabu mbotubwe nomosunte.
english: In that day they will roar over it like the roaring of the sea. And if one looks at the land, he will see darkness and distress; even the light will be darkened by the clouds.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio mbatebe iga: “Rora, oyo nere Nyasae oito; oyo nere twakaganyire, erinde anyare gototooria. Oyo nere Omonene, twakaganyire; tiga togoke na gochenga, ekiagera otorenteire ogotooreka.”
english: In that day they will say, "Surely this is our God; we trusted in him, and he saved us. This is the LORD, we trusted in him; let us rejoice and be glad in his salvation."

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ogotera oko ngoterwe ase ense y’Abayuda; “Intwe nigo tomenyete ase omochie omokong’u. Omonene otoeire ogotooreka kobe chindwaki ne chiburi chiaito.
english: In that day this song will be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; God makes salvation its walls and ramparts.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria namosabe ase erieta riane; tinkobatebia ng’a nimbasabere ase Tata,
english: In that day you will ask in my name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria timokomboria ring’ana. Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Komorasabe Tata kende gionsi ase erieta riane nabae.
english: In that day you will no longer ask me anything. I tell you the truth, my Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria motebe: “Moiranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, rangeria erieta riaye; raria ogokora kwaye ase egati y’ebisaku, raria ng’a erieta riaye nerinene mono.”
english: In that day you will say: "Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name; make known among the nations what he has done, and proclaim that his name is exalted.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio notebe: “Aye Omonene, ninkoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, nonya kwarenge nendamwamu asende, bono endamwamu eyio yantigire, na aye kwandemirie.
english: In that day you will say: "I will praise you, O LORD. Although you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you have comforted me.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio omonto nabe otugete ritororo erimo, ne ching’ondi ibere;
english: In that day, a man will keep alive a young cow and two goats.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, aase arenge kwama emesabibu elifu eyemo, aisanete chisekeli chie chifeta elifu eyemo, namere amageri na amagwa.
english: In that day, in every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, there will be only briers and thorns.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene nae Leviatani, eng’iti eria y’okwoboyia, enyango ekwemiina, egesusuro. Nayeite nomoro oye ore omokong’u na omonene, na ore ne chinguru; boigo naite enchoka eria ere ime ase enyancha.
english: In that day, the LORD will punish with his sword, his fierce, great and powerful sword, Leviathan the gliding serpent, Leviathan the coiling serpent; he will slay the monster of the sea.

ekegusii: Ase ogoita okwo kwe ritang’ani, okwo Yonathani na omomura oria bakorete, nigo baitete abanto koreng’ana emerongo ebere ase egetii kiarenge keng’ana ekeng’ese ki’omogondo oremire ne chiombe ibere ase rituko erimo.
english: In that first attack Jonathan and his armor-bearer killed some twenty men in an area of about half an acre.

ekegusii: Agwo Omochakano Nyasae nigo atongete igoro na ense.
english: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

ekegusii: Agwo omochakano ndiarengeo Ring’ana, ne Ring’ana nigo riarenge amo na Nyasae, na rirorio Ring’ana nigo riarenge Nyasae.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

ekegusii: Agwo kare nigo kwabegete oboroso bw’ense, na igoro chionsi nigo chire emeremo y’amaboko ao.
english: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

ekegusii: Nigo bakona‐gosangereria ebimeri bie chinsana, na baremora emeri y’emete enga buna ebisanka.
english: In the brush they gathered salt herbs, and their food was the root of the broom tree.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’egetwori babete ne ribero ase Musa, na ase Haroni, oyio orenge omochenu o Nyasae,
english: In the camp they grew envious of Moses and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the LORD.

ekegusii: Naki aase okoriera kw’omwando kore, goika amakweri aye, oyoriete, abeo.
english: In the case of a will, it is necessary to prove the death of the one who made it,

ekegusii: Ase ekanisa y’Antiokia mbarengeo ababani na aborokia: Barnaba na Simeoni, oyo ore korokwa Nigeri, na Lukio Omokurene, na Manaeni oyo orereretwe amo nomoruoti Herode, na Saulo.
english: In the church at Antioch there were prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen (who had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch) and Saul.

ekegusii: Agwo ase eburi ya Susa, Abayahudi bagaita abanto amagana atano, bakabasiria.
english: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

ekegusii: Ere nigo are Nyasae oirokire ase ekegambero ki’abachenu, bonsi abamoetanaine nigo bamoirogete.
english: In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared; he is more awesome than all who surround him.

ekegusii: Ere okeeirie chinguru chiane konde ase orogendo, bweng’eirie amatuko aane.
english: In the course of my life he broke my strength; he cut short my days.

ekegusii: Engaki egaika Kaini akarenta okwa ma kw’omogondo kobe ekeegwa ase Omonene.
english: In the course of time Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the LORD.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Abisalomu akenyorera egari, ne chibarasi, na abanto emerongo etano barabe bakominyoka bosio bwaye.
english: In the course of time, Absalom provided himself with a chariot and horses and with fifty men to run ahead of him.

ekegusii: Bono Abisalomu, mosinto o Daudi, narenge nomoiseke omwabo ore korokwa Tamari. Tamari nigo arenge omonyakieni mono. Omomura onde o Daudi ore korokwa Amunoni akaba omwanchete Tamari.
english: In the course of time, Amnon son of David fell in love with Tamar, the beautiful sister of Absalom son of David.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atari make, ase omoerio bw’omwaka o kabere, amara aye agasoka ase engencho y’oborwaire boria; ere agakwa ase ogochandeka kw’obororo obonene. Abanto tibautete omorero bw’okworokia amasikani ase engencho yaye, buna bakorete ase engencho ye chisokoro chiaye.
english: In the course of time, at the end of the second year, his bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great pain. His people made no fire in his honor, as they had for his fathers.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Daudi akarwania Abafilisti, akababua, akaira omochie o Gati amo nebichie biaye korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.
english: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its surrounding villages from the control of the Philistines.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Daudi akarwania Abafilisti, akababua, akabua nomochie obo omonene akayobeka inse y’obogambi bwaye.
english: In the course of time, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Metheg Ammah from the control of the Philistines.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Daudi akaboria Omonene, “Inee! Ndagenda ase omochie onde bw’Abayuda inyoire?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda.” Naende Daudi akamoboria, “Norori?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Heburoni.”
english: In the course of time, David inquired of the LORD. "Shall I go up to one of the towns of Judah?" he asked. The LORD said, "Go up." David asked, "Where shall I go?" "To Hebron," the LORD answered.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Nahasi, omoruoti bw’Abaamoni, agakwa, na omomura oye akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: In the course of time, Nahash king of the Ammonites died, and his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio omoruoti bw’Abaamoni agakwa, na Hanuni, omomura oye, akaba omoruoti ribaga riaye.
english: In the course of time, the king of the Ammonites died, and his son Hanun succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: In the course of time, there was another battle with the Philistines, at Gob. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, one of the descendants of Rapha.
english: Nyuma y’ayio esegi yarenge n’Abafilisti aria Gobu, na Sibekai Omohusa agaita Safu, oyomo bw’amamonto.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio esegi ekaba ase egati y’Abaisraeli na Abafilisti agwo Geseri. Sibekai Omohusa agaita Sipai, omonto bw’ororeria rw’amamonto; na igo Abafilisti bakabugwa na kogamberwa.
english: In the course of time, war broke out with the Philistines, at Gezer. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the Rephaites, and the Philistines were subjugated.

ekegusii: Ninchiikeranie ase chigoora chi’enyomba y’Omonene gati‐gati yao aye Yerusalemu. Omonene atogigwe!
english: in the courts of the house of the LORD-- in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Omosunte gosoire, abaibi nigo bakobochora chinyomba basoa ime. Barabwo mobaso nigo bagwesiekerera bebisa; tibancheti oborabu.
english: In the dark, men break into houses, but by day they shut themselves in; they want nothing to do with the light.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ekero ogoitwa okonene korabe, ne chindwaki chinkong’u chiraiyerigwe, chindooche nchituboke korwa ase ebitunwa ebitambe bionsi na ebigoro biimokererete igoro.
english: In the day of great slaughter, when the towers fall, streams of water will flow on every high mountain and every lofty hill.

ekegusii: Ekero inde nemechando nigo ngokorangeria, ekiagera aye nigo okonyigwa na kong’iraneria.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call to you, for you will answer me.

ekegusii: buna asoete ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ekero Abiatari arenge omokuani omonene, akaria emegati yarenge korugwa ase Nyasae, etare boronge koriegwa nonde otatiga nabakuani, naende akaa abarenge amo nere?”
english: In the days of Abiathar the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions."

ekegusii: Ekero abanto ba Yerusalemu barenge nemechando na obokong’u, bakaba bakoinyora ebinto ebiya mono barenge nabio ase amatuko a kare. Agwo ekero bagwete ase amaboko ’abachandi, onde tarenge ore kobakonya, abachandi babo bakobachecheria ase engencho y’okogwa kwabo.
english: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands, there was no one to help her. Her enemies looked at her and laughed at her destruction.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko a Yoyakimu abateneneri be chiamate chi’abakuani nabwo aba: Meraya ase eamate ya Seraya, na Hanania ase eamate ya Yeremia;
english: In the days of Joiakim, these were the heads of the priestly families: of Seraiah's family, Meraiah; of Jeremiah's, Hananiah;

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ekero abagambi ebina barenge kogambera Abaisraeli, enchara enene ekaba ase ense yabo. Ase ayio, omonto oyomo o Bethlehemu, ase ense y’Abayuda, akaimoka amo na mokaye na abamura baye babere, akagenda komenya ase ense y’Abamoabu ase engaki gete.
english: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land, and a man from Bethlehem in Judah, together with his wife and two sons, went to live for a while in the country of Moab.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi bakemurunganeria Musa na Haroni aaria ase erooro,
english: In the desert the whole community grumbled against Moses and Aaron.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babete nobotoonu bw’okogania endagera. Bagateema Nyasae agwo ase erooro.
english: In the desert they gave in to their craving; in the wasteland they put God to the test.

ekegusii: Na aria ase erooro nigo yarengeo: Beti‐Araba, na Midini, na Sekaka,
english: In the desert: Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah,

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano ase okogamba kwa Yosia omoruoti agatoma Safani omoriki, mosinto bw’Asalia o Mesulamu, ase enyomba y’Omonene, agateba,
english: In the eighteenth year of his reign, King Josiah sent the secretary, Shaphan son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, to the temple of the LORD. He said:

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kwaye, ekero konya achenire ense eria na enyomba y’Omonene, Yosia agatoma Safani, mosinto bw’Asalia, na Maaseya, omogambi bw’omochie, na Yoa, mosinto o Yoahasi, omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, koroisia enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oye, ebe enyia.
english: In the eighteenth year of Josiah's reign, to purify the land and the temple, he sent Shaphan son of Azaliah and Maaseiah the ruler of the city, with Joah son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the temple of the LORD his God.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, Abiyamu agachaka kogambera Abayuda,
english: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam son of Nebat, Abijah became king of Judah,

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Yeroboamu, Abiya agachaka kogambera Abayuda.
english: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Jeroboam, Abijah became king of Judah,

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Dario ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase omobani Zakaria, mosinto o Berekia o Ido, rikamotebia,
english: In the eighth month of the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo:

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kwaye, ekero arenge omomura omoke, agachaka komorigia Nyasae o Daudi, sokoro yaye. Ase omwaka o ikomi na kabere bw’okogamba kwaye agachaka gosaria aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa na agachena ense y’Abayuda na Yerusalemu. Akanachana emete y’Asera amo nemegwekano yabaachire, na eyanyititoire na kobombwa.
english: In the eighth year of his reign, while he was still young, he began to seek the God of his father David. In his twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of high places, Asherah poles, carved idols and cast images.

ekegusii: Na ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omotienyi o Bulu, ase omwaka o ikomi nomo, oboagacho bwe Hekalu bokaera buna yaroberetigwe. Ase igo Sulemani akaira emiaka etano na ebere ase okoagacha enyomba eria.
english: In the eleventh year in the month of Bul, the eighth month, the temple was finished in all its details according to its specifications. He had spent seven years building it.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, omwaka o ikomi nomo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: In the eleventh year, in the first month on the seventh day, the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi o gatato, omwaka o ikomi nomo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: In the eleventh year, in the third month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi, omwaka o ikomi nomo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Omoerio nigo ekoroma buna eng’iti na korasa buna rirubi.
english: In the end it bites like a snake and poisons like a viper.

ekegusii: Nigo arenge kogenda ase omoruoti chingaki chia mogoroba, erio ase rituko ria kabere mambia oirana gochia ase enyomba ende y’abakungu inse y’oborendi bwa Saasigasi, oyorenge omoteneneri bw’abakungu ba sere‐sere b’omoruoti. Tarenge koirana gochia ase omoruoti eria kabere, otatiga onye omoruoti ogogetigwe nere, naende aba okomorangeria ase ogwatora erieta riaye.
english: In the evening she would go there and in the morning return to another part of the harem to the care of Shaashgaz, the king's eunuch who was in charge of the concubines. She would not return to the king unless he was pleased with her and summoned her by name.

ekegusii: In the evening, sudden terror! Before the morning, they are gone! This is the portion of those who loot us, the lot of those who plunder us.
english: Ekero kia mogoroba, rora, obwoba mboreo, na mambia botarakiamoka, abakwoboyia tibaiyo. Eke nakio egetari ki’abachandi baito, abwo bagotosakora.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano bw’okogamba kw’Amasia, mosinto o Yoashi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Yeroboamu, mosinto o Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, agachaka kogamba agwo Samaria; ere akagamba emiaka emerongo ene nomo.
english: In the fifteenth year of Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel became king in Samaria, and he reigned forty-one years.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano bw’okogamba gwa Kaisari Tiberio, Pontio Pilato orenge gavuna o Boyahudi, na Herode omoruoti o Galili, na Filipo momura omwabo omoruoti o Iturea na ense ya Tarakoniti, na Lusania omoruoti o Abileni,
english: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar-- when Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea, Herod tetrarch of Galilee, his brother Philip tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene--

ekegusii: Ekaba ase omwaka oyio, ekero Zedekia achagete kogamba, ase omotienyi o gatano bw’omwaka o kane, omobani korwa omochie o Gibeoni, Hanania, mosinto bw’Asuri, agakwana nainche ime ase enyomba y’Omonene. Ekero abakuani na abanto bonsi baigwete, agantebia ng’a,
english: In the fifth month of that same year, the fourth year, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur, who was from Gibeon, said to me in the house of the LORD in the presence of the priests and all the people:

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano bw’okogamba kwa Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, ekero Yehosafati arenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Yehoramu, mosinto o Yehosafati, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the fifth year of Joram son of Ahab king of Israel, when Jehoshaphat was king of Judah, Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat began his reign as king of Judah.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano bw’okogamba kwa Rehoboamu, Sisaki, omoruoti o Misiri, agacha, akarwania Yerusalemu.
english: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etano bw’okogamba gw’Asaria, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Pekahia, mosinto o Menahemu, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli agwo Samaria, akagamba emiaka ebere.
english: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned two years.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etano, na ebere, bw’okogamba gw’Asaria, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Peka, mosinto o Remalia, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli, agwo Samaria, akagamba emiaka emerongo ebere.
english: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned twenty years.

ekegusii: Abanto ngocha bare korwania Abakalidayo baichorie chinyomba nemebere ekwete y’abanto abwo ndaite nendamwamu yane enene na ekeririanda kiane. Nabisire obosio bwane ase omochie oyo ase engencho y’obobe bwabo.
english: in the fight with the Babylonians: 'They will be filled with the dead bodies of the men I will slay in my anger and wrath. I will hide my face from this city because of all its wickedness.

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba gwa Hezekia, akaigora ebisieri bi’enyomba y’Omonene, naende akabiroisia bikaba ebiyia.
english: In the first month of the first year of his reign, he opened the doors of the temple of the LORD and repaired them.

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bwe ritang’ani omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bagaika ase erooro ya Sini, bagatoora agwo Kadeshi. Miriamu agakwa na agatindekwa aroro.
english: In the first month the whole Israelite community arrived at the Desert of Zin, and they stayed at Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.

ekegusii: “Goika morie emegati etabekiri memera, gochakera omogoroba bwe rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani goika omogoroba bwe rituko ri’emerongo ebere na rimo.
english: In the first month you are to eat bread made without yeast, from the evening of the fourteenth day until the evening of the twenty-first day.

ekegusii: Naki ritang’ani naigure ng’a ekero mogosangerereka ase ekanisa ogwatananekana nkore asemore. Ayande aya naigure negenire ng’a namaene.
english: In the first place, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and to some extent I believe it.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kwa Belisasari, omoruoti o Babeli, Danieli akarota chindoto, akarora amaroro ekero araire borere bwaye. Erio akarika akaorokia amang’ana aroche ase chindoto chiria.
english: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream, and visions passed through his mind as he was lying on his bed. He wrote down the substance of his dream.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba gwa Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, Omonene agaikerania ayakwanete goetera ase Yeremia. Agaseegeta na koberora omoika o Koresi, omoruoti oria, akamosukia arike ring’ana na koriraria ase chinsemo chionsi chi’oboruoti bwaye, ogoteba:
english: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, in order to fulfill the word of the LORD spoken by Jeremiah, the LORD moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to make a proclamation throughout his realm and to put it in writing:

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba gwa Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, Omonene agaikerania ayakwanete goetera ase Yeremia. Agaseegeta na koberora omoika bw’omoruoti oria, akamosukia arike ring’ana na koriraria ase chinsemo chionsi chi’oboruoti bwaye, ogoteba:
english: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, in order to fulfill the word of the LORD spoken by Jeremiah, the LORD moved the heart of Cyrus king of Persia to make a proclamation throughout his realm and to put it in writing:

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kwa Dario, mosinto bw’Ahaswero bw’ororeria rw’Abamedi, oyobegetwe akaba omoruoti kogambera Abakalidayo,
english: In the first year of Darius son of Xerxes (a Mede by descent), who was made ruler over the Babylonian kingdom--

ekegusii: ee, ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kwaye, inche Danieli nkamanya korwa ase Amariko Amachenu igoro y’omobaro bw’emiaka eria ring’ana ri’Omonene riatebetie Yeremia omobani, ng’a emiaka emerongo etano na ebere nigo yarenge gocha koera, Yerusalemu ogendererete koba rituuri.
english: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood from the Scriptures, according to the word of the LORD given to Jeremiah the prophet, that the desolation of Jerusalem would last seventy years.

ekegusii: “Ase omwaka bwe ritang’ani bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Koresi, ere akarua ogochika okwo: Enyomba ya Nyasae ere Yerusalemu, tiga eagachwe naende, na oboroso bwaye bokong’igwe, erinde ebing’wanso bionsi, amo na biria bi’ogosambwa, birentwe aroro na koruegwa. Obotambe bw’enyomba eyio gochia igoro bobe obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bobe obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo.
english: In the first year of King Cyrus, the king issued a decree concerning the temple of God in Jerusalem: Let the temple be rebuilt as a place to present sacrifices, and let its foundations be laid. It is to be ninety feet high and ninety feet wide,

ekegusii: Korende ase okobaa amachiko akobwatia ayio tinkobatogia, ekiagera timori gosangererekana ase amaya korende ase ogosaria.
english: In the following directives I have no praise for you, for your meetings do more harm than good.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi nomo, omwaka bw’emerongo ene, Musa agatebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi ayio Omonene konya amochikire abatebie.
english: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses proclaimed to the Israelites all that the LORD had commanded him concerning them.

ekegusii: Ebiooreri ebio bine biare ase chikoona chi’eraaro nigo biagiteire. Obotambe bwabo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo ene, na obogare amaboko emerongo etato, bionsi nigo biareng’aine.
