english: In the four corners of the outer court were enclosed courts, forty cubits long and thirty cubits wide; each of the courts in the four corners was the same size.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’amagana ane, na emerongo etano na etato, nyuma Abaisraeli kobarure ense ya Misiri, noro omwaka o kane bw’okogamba gwa Sulemani igoro y’Abaisraeli, ase omotienyi o Sivu, omotienyi o kabere, Sulemani agachaka koagacha enyomba y’Omonene.
english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites had come out of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon's reign over Israel, in the month of Ziv, the second month, he began to build the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kane bw’okogamba kwa Hezekia omoruoti, Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akagenda korwania emechie yonsi y’Abayuda, yagiteire chindwaki, akayeira.
english: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah's reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kane bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Hezekia, Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akagenda, akarwania emechie yonsi y’Abayuda yagiteire chindwaki, akayebua.
english: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah's reign, Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.

ekegusii: Na omwaka o ikomi na kane Kedorilaoma na abaruoti baria babwataine nere bagacha, bakarwania na kobua Abarefai ase Asteroti‐Karinaimu, na Abasusi ase Hamu, na Abaemi ase Shawe‐Kiriataimu,
english: In the fourteenth year, Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh Kiriathaim

ekegusii: Barabwo bagoika ase ekiaare gia kane inabairane gocha aa, ekiagera obobe bw’Abaamori tiboraikerana goika bono.”
english: In the fourth generation your descendants will come back here, for the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure."

ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi abekwe ase ebikonde bie chitahabu.
english: in the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx and a jasper. Mount them in gold filigree settings.

ekegusii: na ase oyo o kane kurusolito, na oiniki, na berulo. Amagena ayio onsi bakayabeka ase ebikonde bie chitahabu.
english: in the fourth row a chrysolite, an onyx and a jasper. They were mounted in gold filigree settings.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kane amatunda ’emete eyio aatananwe abe amachenu asende inche Omonene, moyang’e ase okong’iraneria ng’a mbuya mono na gontogia.
english: In the fourth year all its fruit will be holy, an offering of praise to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kwa Yehoyakimu, mosinto o Yosia, igoro y’Abayuda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamotebia,
english: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kane, omotienyi o kianda noro Kisilewi, omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende inche Zakaria.
english: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Kislev.

ekegusii: Bosio bw’enyomba akaroisia chisiiro ibere chire nobotambe gochia igoro bw’amaboko emerongo etato, na atano, na igoro ase kera eyemo akabeka egesure ki’obotambe bw’amaboko atano.
english: In the front of the temple he made two pillars, which [together] were thirty-five cubits long, each with a capital on top measuring five cubits.

ekegusii: “Ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha ekero abana baino barababorie: Ninki engencho y’oborori obo, na amachiko aya, na emeroberio eye, ebi Omonene, Nyasae oito, abachigete? Nase ki Omonene, Nyasae oito, abachigete amachiko aya na emeroberio eye?
english: In the future, when your son asks you, "What is the meaning of the stipulations, decrees and laws the LORD our God has commanded you?"

ekegusii: Ase okobua kwao okonene nigo okobaiyeria inse abagokoimokera; endamwamu yao egwoka, nigo ekobasamba buna chimboba chinyomo.
english: In the greatness of your majesty you threw down those who opposed you. You unleashed your burning anger; it consumed them like stubble.

ekegusii: Omonene nabwate egekombe ase okoboko kwaye, geichire nedivai entindi yochoganirie, nayeumorere abakori amabe bonsi b’ense na kobabetereria bayenywe, bayekoore amo neturubo yaye.
english: In the hand of the LORD is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs.

ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie oyomo abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na Geseri,
english: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Gezer,

ekegusii: Bakaegwa Sekemu, omochie bw’obotamero ase ense y’Efraimu na Geseri,
english: In the hill country of Ephraim they were given Shechem (a city of refuge), and Gezer,

ekegusii: Na ase ense y’ebitunwa nigo yarengeo: Samiri, na Yatiri, na Soko,
english: In the hill country: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh,

ekegusii: erinde inyare kobeka abare amanyinga ayamo nainche ribero, na gotooria abande babo.
english: in the hope that I may somehow arouse my own people to envy and save some of them.

ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akorenda chinibo chi’engencho enene amo namaguta ase enka yaye, korende omoriri nigo agochiria bobe chiaera.
english: In the house of the wise are stores of choice food and oil, but a foolish man devours all he has.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaroisia emegwekano y’abakerubi babere korwa ase emete y’emezeituni, akayebeka agwo ase akanyomba ka ime.
english: In the inner sanctuary he made a pair of cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.

ekegusii: Ase ense ya Usi narengeo omonto ore korokwa Ayubu. Omonto oyio nigo arenge omwegenwa, na nigo abwate enkoro endonge; nigo amoirogete Nyasae, agetanga korwa ase ogokora amabe.
english: In the land of Uz there lived a man whose name was Job. This man was blameless and upright; he feared God and shunned evil.

ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio, ng’a egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene ngekong’igwe kebe eki’engencho enene kobua ebinde; naende keimokererigwe igoro geetanie ebigoro, na ebisaku bionsi mbiendoke gochiao.
english: In the last days the mountain of the LORD's temple will be established as chief among the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and all nations will stream to it.

ekegusii: Nebe ase amatuko ’omoerio ng’a egetunwa ki’enyomba y’Omonene ngekong’igwe, kebe ekenene goetania ebitunwa binde, nkeimokererigwe igoro goetania ebigoro binde; abanto abange mbaendoke gochiao.
english: In the last days the mountain of the LORD's temple will be established as chief among the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and peoples will stream to it.

ekegusii: Ase amachiko nigo arikire, “Omonene otebire: Ase abanto b’emenwa etamanyekaneti, na ase ebikoba bi’emenwa y’abageni ninkwane nabanto aba. Nonya nabo tibakonyigwera.”
english: In the Law it is written: "Through men of strange tongues and through the lips of foreigners I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to me," says the Lord.

ekegusii: Nabo ase amachiko Musa atochigete kobaaka amagena abakungu banga buna oyo, naki aye ogoteba igoro asare?”
english: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say?"

ekegusii: (Korende ase Omonene omokungu takoba omosacha ataiyo, gose omosacha takoba omokungu ataiyo.
english: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.

ekegusii: Na kobwabeire botuko gati, Boazi agataboboka. Ani! Omokungu naraire magoro aye maate.
english: In the middle of the night something startled the man, and he turned and discovered a woman lying at his feet.

ekegusii: Nebe ekero agendererete gotenenka mono nachandwe, na obokong’u obonge mbomochere.
english: In the midst of his plenty, distress will overtake him; the full force of misery will come upon him.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erimo, ase omotienyi o Nisani, omwaka bw’emerongo ebere bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, edivai ekarentwa asare, na inche nkayeimokia, nkamoyea. Inche konya tinana koba nomoichano ase obosio bwaye ase engaki ende yonsi.
english: In the month of Nisan in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when wine was brought for him, I took the wine and gave it to the king. I had not been sad in his presence before;

ekegusii: Ankio mambia, ekero erioba rigosoka, moimoke bwango, moumokere omochie. Erio ekero Gaali na abanto baria bare komo bakobachera kobarwania, mobakore buna moranyare ekero ekio!”
english: In the morning at sunrise, advance against the city. When Gaal and his men come out against you, do whatever your hand finds to do."

ekegusii: Bogakia mambia, Daudi akarikera Yoabu rirube, akaa Uria amoirere.
english: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it with Uriah.

ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia mambia, akaba oichanete, agatoma abanto barangerie abaringoria bonsi ba Misiri na abanto abang’aini bonsi abarengeo. Farao akabatebia chindoto chiaye, korende onde tatogete ore konyara komotebia engencho ye chindoto echio.
english: In the morning his mind was troubled, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.

ekegusii: Emambia ya kabere, Yonathani amo nomwana oria omomura, bakagenda mogondo, ase engaki konya bachikanire na Daudi.
english: In the morning Jonathan went out to the field for his meeting with David. He had a small boy with him,

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere mambia, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: In the morning the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, ekero abanto babogete mambia chuni, bakanyora ng’a egesasimero kia Baali giatagoirwe amo nomote oria bw’Asera orenge ensemo yaye, naende bakarora ng’a eeri eria ya kabere yarusigwe yakoreirwe ekeng’wanso igoro ase egesasimero keria konya kiaagachirwe.
english: In the morning when the men of the town got up, there was Baal's altar, demolished, with the Asherah pole beside it cut down and the second bull sacrificed on the newly built altar!

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’omoondoko bwe chinkoro chirabe nobwoba, na ase amakumia ay’okoirokia, na ase aya morarore namaiso aino, nigo mora tebe ase engaki ya mambia: Naki yare koba buya onye yaba mogoroba, na ase engaki ya mogoroba motebe: Naki yare koba buya onye yaba mambia.
english: In the morning you will say, "If only it were evening!" and in the evening, "If only it were morning!"-- because of the terror that will fill your hearts and the sights that your eyes will see.

ekegusii: Na mambia kobagoeta, bakarora omoko oria bwomire bwonsi korwa ase emeri yaye.
english: In the morning, as they went along, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.

ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba kwane ase engaki ya mambia; kobogokiamoka nigo nkobeka okogania kwane ase obosio bwao, erio naganya ndendete.
english: In the morning, O LORD, you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait in expectation.

ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia abarendi bagasogwa nomoondoko omonge igoro ya Petero, naki abete.
english: In the morning, there was no small commotion among the soldiers as to what had become of Peter.

ekegusii: Ime y’Aase Achenu Mono akaroisia emegwekano ebere y’abakerubi, akayeooma ne chitahabu.
english: In the Most Holy Place he made a pair of sculptured cherubim and overlaid them with gold.

ekegusii: Bono baminto, twabachikire ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso Kristo, mweatanane korwa ase oyomino oyore omworo, oyotabwateti chingencho echio mweorokereretie korwa asetore.
english: In the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, we command you, brothers, to keep away from every brother who is idle and does not live according to the teaching you received from us.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo nkoinyora erieta riao botuko, nigo ndendete amachiko ao.
english: In the night I remember your name, O LORD, and I will keep your law.

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o kianda, omwaka o gatano bw’okogamba kwa Yehoyakimu mosinto o Yosia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu, na bonsi abaruete ase emechie y’Abayuda, bagacha Yerusalemu, bakararia ng’a abanto beng’ate ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: In the ninth month of the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, a time of fasting before the LORD was proclaimed for all the people in Jerusalem and those who had come from the towns of Judah.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kianda bw’okogamba kwa Hosea, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri akabwata Samaria, agoosa Abaisraeli, akabaira Asuri; akabeka abande ase omochie o Hala, na abande ang’e na Habori, orooche rwa Gosani, na abande ase emechie y’Abamedi.
english: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria captured Samaria and deported the Israelites to Assyria. He settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in the towns of the Medes.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi, omotienyi o ikomi, omwaka o kianda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: In the ninth year, in the tenth month on the tenth day, the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Na ase ororeria rwa Lawi mwanyabanto, abakonyorekana namakweri, nkonyora bare ensemo ya ikomi, korende aiga ere oyogwatorwa ng’a moyo are nkoyenyora are.
english: In the one case, the tenth is collected by men who die; but in the other case, by him who is declared to be living.

ekegusii: amarieta atano na rimo ase rigena erimo, na atano na rimo ase rigena rinde, ase omoroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo.
english: in the order of their birth-- six names on one stone and the remaining six on the other.

ekegusii: Ebiro biria bi’ogotamanya Nyasae nigo aombetie buna tarochi, korende bono nkoranderia are abanto bonsi ba kera aase baonchoke,
english: In the past God overlooked such ignorance, but now he commands all people everywhere to repent.

ekegusii: Ase ebiro ebinge ne chinchera chinyinge Nyasae agwo kare nigo arenge gokwana ne chisokoro chiaito goetera ase ababani,
english: In the past God spoke to our forefathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

ekegusii: Ase engaki yaetire, nonya nekero Saulo arenge omoruoti, naye kwarenge gotang’ana Abaisraeli kobaare korwana esegi naende kobakoirana. Na Omonene, Nyasae oo, akagotebia ng’a naye orabe omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na koba omogambi igoro yabo.”
english: In the past, even while Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the LORD your God said to you, 'You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.'"

ekegusii: Kare ase ebigori biaetire nigo atigete ebisaku bionsi bitaare ase chinchera chiabo abanyene,
english: In the past, he let all nations go their own way.

ekegusii: Ase engaki yaetire, ekero Saulo arenge omoruoti igoro yaito, naye kwarenge gotang’ana Abaisraeli kobakogenda korwana esegi, naende kobakoirana. Omonene konya ogotebirie ng’a naye orabe omorisia bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na obe omogambi igoro yabo.”
english: In the past, while Saul was king over us, you were the one who led Israel on their military campaigns. And the LORD said to you, 'You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will become their ruler.'"

ekegusii: Amagwa na emeeto nigo bitegire ase chinchera chi’abanto abakorekanu, korende oyo orendete omoyo oye goika eatanane korwa ase birobio.
english: In the paths of the wicked lie thorns and snares, but he who guards his soul stays far from them.

ekegusii: Agwo ase rikere ri’oboagacho obwo ime, chimesa ibere nchiarengeo ase kera ensemo. Igoro ase chimesa echio nao ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’ebibe, na ebi’okomocha, biarenge konyenyerwa.
english: In the portico of the gateway were two tables on each side, on which the burnt offerings, sin offerings and guilt offerings were slaughtered.

ekegusii: Nagochikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na obwa Kristo Yeso, oyorache kogambia abare moyo na abakure, na ase okooroka kwaye, na oboruoti bwaye.
english: In the presence of God and of Christ Jesus, who will judge the living and the dead, and in view of his appearing and his kingdom, I give you this charge:

ekegusii: Ase oboremo obwo obochenu mwatanane ensemo ere nobotambe bwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), na obogare bwe chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000), agwo nao moraagache Aase Aachenu Mono.
english: In the sacred district, measure off a section 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide. In it will be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.

ekegusii: Naende emetobwa y’egesieri gie Hekalu enyene ekaroisigwa korwa ase chibao chi’emezeituni ere ne chikoona inye,
english: In the same way he made four-sided jambs of olive wood for the entrance to the main hall.

ekegusii: Naboigo nabakuani abanene bakamosekereria barabwo ase barabwo, amo naborokia b’amariko, bagateba, “Natooretie abande, ere omonyene takonyara gwetooria.
english: In the same way the chief priests and the teachers of the law mocked him among themselves. "He saved others," they said, "but he can't save himself!

ekegusii: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.
english: Na baria abakuani abanene bagakora boigo, bakamokorera echeche amo naborokia b’amariko na abagaaka, bakobora,

ekegusii: Na abasacha boigo bagatiga okomenyana nabakungu kwa boronge, bagasambwa ase okorigania abasacha ase abasacha, bagakora ogokora kw’obosooku, bakanyora abanyene ogoakanwa kwa boronge kw’ogosaria kwabo.
english: In the same way the men also abandoned natural relations with women and were inflamed with lust for one another. Men committed indecent acts with other men, and received in themselves the due penalty for their perversion.

ekegusii: In the same way the robbers who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.
english: Na baria abauri, ababambetwe amo nere, bakamorama boigo.

ekegusii: Naboigo, tari ogwancha gwa Tata one ore igoro ng’a oyomo bw’aba abake asire.
english: In the same way your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should be lost.

ekegusii: Naboigo akabogoria egekombe nyuma y’okoria, akabora, “Egekombe eke nokobwatana okoyia ase amanyinga aane; kora iga kera ekero mogokenywera ase okong’inyora inche.”
english: In the same way, after supper he took the cup, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood; do this, whenever you drink it, in remembrance of me."

ekegusii: Naboigo akabogoria egekombe nyuma ase okoria, akabora, “Egekombe eke nokobwatana okoyia ase amanyinga aane, aitekire ase engencho yaino.]
english: In the same way, after the supper he took the cup, saying, "This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

ekegusii: Nabo kera oyomo oino otatigeti ebinto bionsi are nabio, takonyara koba omworokigwa one.
english: In the same way, any of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be my disciple.

ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe mwebare ng’a mwabeire abakure ase ebibe, korende mwabeire moyo ase Nyasae ime ase Kristo Yeso.
english: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Naboigo nokwegena gwoka gotari nogokora, nigo gokwete.
english: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.

ekegusii: Naboigo, ogokora okuya nigo kore maiso marore, na koria gotari maiso marore tigokogenderera kobisekana.
english: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even those that are not cannot be hidden.

ekegusii: Eema amo nebinto bionsi biare gokorerwa ase ogosasima naboigo are kobinyororokeria amanyinga.
english: In the same way, he sprinkled with the blood both the tabernacle and everything used in its ceremonies.

ekegusii: Naboigo, nabatebirie, nore omogoko ase abamalaika ba Nyasae ase omonyene ebibe oyomo oonchokire.”
english: In the same way, I tell you, there is rejoicing in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents."

ekegusii: Na omobaso oino obare boigo ase abanto, goika barore emeremo yaino emiya, batogie Iso oino ore igoro.
english: In the same way, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good deeds and praise your Father in heaven.

ekegusii: Nainwe nabo more, isiko mwarorekana ase abanto ng’a nabaronge more, korende ime yaino mwaichoirwe nobong’ainereria na ebibe ebinge.
english: In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

ekegusii: Na Omonene naboigo ochikire ng’a baria bakorandia enchili banyore ebibagwenerete korwa ase enchili.
english: In the same way, the Lord has commanded that those who preach the gospel should receive their living from the gospel.

ekegusii: Naboigo n’Omoika noro nigo ogotokonya ase oboreu bwaito. Naki titomanyeti gosaba buna etogwenerete, korende Omoika omonyene nigo ogotosabera ase ogwechanda ogotanyare gokwanwa.
english: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groans that words cannot express.

ekegusii: Naboigo nabakungu babo bateneine boronge ase ogokora okuya, tari abang’achi, babe aberiti na abegenwa ase amang’ana onsi.
english: In the same way, their wives are to be women worthy of respect, not malicious talkers but temperate and trustworthy in everything.

ekegusii: Naboigo na Rahabu, oria omotayayi, Inee, taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aroisetie baria batometwe, akabasokia isiko ase enchera ende eng’ao?
english: In the same way, was not even Rahab the prostitute considered righteous for what she did when she gave lodging to the spies and sent them off in a different direction?

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o kabere, omwaka o kabere, nyuma abanto kobairanire gocha ase enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, emeremo egachakwa. Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, bagachaka emeremo amo nabanto bamwabo, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na bonsi abachete Yerusalemu korwa ase obosomba. Abalawi bonsi abarenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania bagachorwa gotenenera emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: In the second month of the second year after their arrival at the house of God in Jerusalem, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Jeshua son of Jozadak and the rest of their brothers (the priests and the Levites and all who had returned from the captivity to Jerusalem) began the work, appointing Levites twenty years of age and older to supervise the building of the house of the LORD.

ekegusii: na ase oyo o kabere alimasi, na safiro, na yasipi;
english: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire and an emerald;

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro ere akarota chindoto; ase ayio agachandeka ase ebirengererio biaye, tarara chitoro.
english: In the second year of his reign, Nebuchadnezzar had dreams; his mind was troubled and he could not sleep.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kabere ase okogamba kwa Yehoasi, mosinto o Yehoahasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Amasia, mosinto o Yoashi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the second year of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel, Amaziah son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere, ekero Dario arenge omoruoti, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigatomwa goetera ase Hagai omobani, rigacha ase Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogavuna bw’Abayuda, na ase Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki.
english: In the second year of King Darius, on the first day of the sixth month, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest:

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba gwa Peka, mosinto o Remalia, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Yotamu, mosinto bwa Usia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the second year of Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel, Jotham son of Uzziah king of Judah began to reign.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na kabere bw’okogamba gwa Peka, mosinto o Remalia, Ahasi mosinto o Yotamu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah son of Remaliah, Ahaz son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign.

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere ase omwaka oria, Isumaeli mosinto o Netania, mochokoro bw’Elisama, oyorenge omonto bw’enyomba y’obogambi na omoteneneri omonene igoro ase abanene barenge gokorera omoruoti, amo nabanto bande ikomi, bagacha ase Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu, agwo Misipa. Ekero barenge koria endagera amo bonsi agwo Misipa,
english: In the seventh month Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood and had been one of the king's officers, came with ten men to Gedaliah son of Ahikam at Mizpah. While they were eating together there,

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere ase omwaka oria Hanania omobani agakwa.
english: In the seventh month of that same year, Hananiah the prophet died.

ekegusii: Korende ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, bw’Elisama bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, agacha amo nabanto ikomi, agaaka Gedalia, akamoita. Boigo agaita Abayuda na Abakalidayo baria barenge amo nere agwo Misipa.
english: In the seventh month, however, Ishmael son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, who was of royal blood, came with ten men and assassinated Gedaliah and also the men of Judah and the Babylonians who were with him at Mizpah.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere, Yehoyada agatoma amang’ana korenta abatang’ani b’abarendi amagana b’omoruoti, na ab’enyomba y’omoruoti, akabairana ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, na akagera bakaria chimuma agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene. Erio akaborokia omwana oria bw’omoruoti.
english: In the seventh year Jehoiada sent for the commanders of units of a hundred, the Carites and the guards and had them brought to him at the temple of the LORD. He made a covenant with them and put them under oath at the temple of the LORD. Then he showed them the king's son.

ekegusii: Ase owaka o gatano na kabere Yehoyada akaba omoremu, akarangeria abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi b’amagana, agakora okobwatana nabarabwo. Abatang’ani aba nabwo aba: Asaria, mosinto o Yerohamu, na Isumaeli, mosinto o Yehohanani, na Asaria, mosinto bw’Obedi, na Maaseya, mosinto bw’Adaya, na Elisafati, mosinto o Sikiri.
english: In the seventh year Jehoiada showed his strength. He made a covenant with the commanders of units of a hundred: Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zicri.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kwa Yehu, Yoashi agachaka kogamba, na akagamba emiaka emerongo ene agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Sibia korwa Beeri‐Seba.
english: In the seventh year of Jehu, Joash became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother's name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi, omotienyi o gatano, omwaka o gatano na kabere, abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli bagacha koboria amang’ana korwa ase Omonene, bagaikaransa ase obosio bwane.
english: In the seventh year, in the fifth month on the tenth day, some of the elders of Israel came to inquire of the LORD, and they sat down in front of me.

ekegusii: Nigo okobabisa agwo asore, ase okobarenda korwa ase emeroberio emebe y’abanto; nigo okobarenda ase ekiriri kiao korwa ase abanto abang’achi.
english: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from the intrigues of men; in your dwelling you keep them safe from accusing tongues.

ekegusii: Nagochikire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, oyokoa ebinto bionsi obogima, na ase Kristo Yeso, oyoruete oborori obuya ase Pontio Pilato,
english: In the sight of God, who gives life to everything, and of Christ Jesus, who while testifying before Pontius Pilate made the good confession, I charge you

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria ekero Nuhu akoorire emiaka amagana atano na rimo (600), ase rituko ria ikomi, na gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi o kabere, chinsoko chionsi chi’amache chikabera ne chinguru korwa inse, na ebibao bia igoro bikaigoka,
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, on the seventeenth day of the second month-- on that day all the springs of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.

ekegusii: Omotienyi bw’etano nomo omomalaika Gabirieli agatomwa na Nyasae kogenda omochie o Galili, okorokwa Nazareti,
english: In the sixth month, God sent the angel Gabriel to Nazareth, a town in Galilee,

ekegusii: Ekaba ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o gatano na rimo, ekero narenge ng’ikaransete nyomba mwane amo nabagaaka b’Abayuda, okoboko kw’Omonene Nyasae kogacha igoro yane.
english: In the sixth year, in the sixth month on the fifth day, while I was sitting in my house and the elders of Judah were sitting before me, the hand of the Sovereign LORD came upon me there.

ekegusii: Igoro y’ebisieri na ime y’enyomba, na isiko, ne chinyasi chionsi ime na isiko, mbiabwate ebirengo biabo.
english: In the space above the outside of the entrance to the inner sanctuary and on the walls at regular intervals all around the inner and outer sanctuary

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’ogosimeka, ekero abaruoti baare koba bakogenda korwana esegi, Daudi agatoma Yoabu na abasomba baye, amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi. Barabwo bagaita Abaamoni, bakanaaria omochie o Raba. Korende Daudi akabeera agwo Yerusalemu.
english: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, David sent Joab out with the king's men and the whole Israelite army. They destroyed the Ammonites and besieged Rabbah. But David remained in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’ogosimeka ekero abaruoti baare koba bakogenda korwana esegi, Yoabu agatang’ana abarwani b’esegi, agasaria ense y’Abaamoni, akagenda koboera omochie o Raba, korende Daudi akabeera agwo Yerusalemu. Yoabu akarwania Raba, akayobua akayosaria.
english: In the spring, at the time when kings go off to war, Joab led out the armed forces. He laid waste the land of the Ammonites and went to Rabbah and besieged it, but David remained in Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah and left it in ruins.

ekegusii: Ekero ki’ogoseboka kw’ebimeri, Nebukadinesaro omoruoti agatoma abanto bakamoira Babeli; akaira nebikorero bie rigori rinene bi’enyomba y’Omonene, erio akabeka Zedekia, omomura omwabo Yehoyakini, akaba omoruoti igoro ase Abayuda na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu.
english: In the spring, King Nebuchadnezzar sent for him and brought him to Babylon, together with articles of value from the temple of the LORD, and he made Jehoiachin's uncle, Zedekiah, king over Judah and Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ekero abana babo bare isiko mbaitwe nemioro, ekero bare ime ase chinyomba obwoba mbobaite; ebio mbiite abamura, na abaiseke, na abana bakogonka, amo nabanto abagotu.
english: In the street the sword will make them childless; in their homes terror will reign. Young men and young women will perish, infants and gray-haired men.

ekegusii: Okorera okonene kwaigwekanire ase chinchera, ekiagera edivai teiyo; omogoko bwonsi oerire, na omochengo bw’ense osirire.
english: In the streets they cry out for wine; all joy turns to gloom, all gaiety is banished from the earth.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo beboyetie chigunia baichanete agwo ase chinchera, abande nigo bariinete ebirama igoro, na abande bare ase ebiraario; kera omonto nigo akweumia na koiyeria amariga.
english: In the streets they wear sackcloth; on the roofs and in the public squares they all wail, prostrate with weeping.

ekegusii: Naende ase esinagogi narengeo omonto obwatire nomoika bw’ekerecha ki’eubi. Ere agaaka eriogi ase chinguru, akabora,
english: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by a demon, an evil spirit. He cried out at the top of his voice,

ekegusii: Akarora ase Hekalu ime abanto barenge koonia chiombe, ne ching’ondi, na amaruma, na abaare koonchora chifeta, baikaransete.
english: In the temple courts he found men selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.

ekegusii: Ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, isiko y’etoto eria ekengete aase chibao chirikire oborori chibekire, Haroni na abamura baye inababe bakorenda chitaya chiria chigwoka korwa mogoroba goika mambia, ase obosio bw’Omonene. Okwo nigo korabe ogochika ase Abaisraeli ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
english: In the Tent of Meeting, outside the curtain that is in front of the Testimony, Aaron and his sons are to keep the lamps burning before the LORD from evening till morning. This is to be a lasting ordinance among the Israelites for the generations to come.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na kabere, omotienyi o ikomi, omwaka o ikomi, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: In the tenth year, in the tenth month on the twelfth day, the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatato nyuma Abaisraeli kobarure ase ense ya Misiri, bagaika ase erooro ya Sinai.
english: In the third month after the Israelites left Egypt-- on the very day-- they came to the Desert of Sinai.

ekegusii: na ase oyo o gatato hiakinto, na agati, na ametisito;
english: in the third row a jacinth, an agate and an amethyst;

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Baasa, mosinto bw’Ahiya, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Tirisa, na akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere na ene.
english: In the third year of Asa king of Judah, Baasha son of Ahijah became king of all Israel in Tirzah, and he reigned twenty-four years.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba gwa Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi, Danieli oria orogetwe Beli‐Tesasari akamaanorerwa komanya ring’ana, ne ring’ana erio nigo riarenge eri’ekeene, rikararia ng’a emechando emenene neche. Danieli akamanya engencho ye ring’ana riria, na ey’okorora koria.
english: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a revelation was given to Daniel (who was called Belteshazzar). Its message was true and it concerned a great war. The understanding of the message came to him in a vision.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwaye, agatoma abanene b’obogambi bwaye, Beni‐Haili, na Obadia, na Zakaria, na Netaneli, na Mikaya, kworokereria ase emechie y’Abayuda.
english: In the third year of his reign he sent his officials Ben-Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel and Micaiah to teach in the towns of Judah.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwa Hosea, mosinto o Ela, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Hezekia, mosinto bw’Ahasi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Hezekiah son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwa Belisasari omoruoti, inche Danieli nkarora okorora konde nyuma ya koria kwe ritang’ani.
english: In the third year of King Belshazzar's reign, I, Daniel, had a vision, after the one that had already appeared to me.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatato bw’okogamba kwa Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, agacha Yerusalemu akayoboera.
english: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o kane, omwaka bw’emerongo etato, ekero inche Ezekieli namenyete ang’e norooche rwa Kebari amo nabooswa bande, igoro ekamaanoka, nkarora amaroro akorwa ase Nyasae.
english: In the thirtieth year, in the fourth month on the fifth day, while I was among the exiles by the Kebar River, the heavens were opened and I saw visions of God.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Ahabu, mosinto bw’Omuri, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli, agwo Samaria; ere akagamba emiaka emerongo ebere na ebere.
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria over Israel twenty-two years.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na etano na etato bw’okogamba gw’Asaria omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Zakaria, mosinto o Yeroboamu, akagambera Abaisraeli agwo Samaria ase engaki y’emetienyi etano nomo.
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Azariah king of Judah, Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned six months.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato nomo bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Omuri agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli, akagamba emiaka ikomi na ebere; akagamba agwo Tirisa ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo.
english: In the thirty-first year of Asa king of Judah, Omri became king of Israel, and he reigned twelve years, six of them in Tirzah.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na kianda, bw’okogamba gw’Asaria, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Menahemu, mosinto o Gadi, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli, akagamba emiaka ikomi agwo Samaria.
english: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah king of Judah, Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel, and he reigned in Samaria ten years.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato na kianda bw’okogamba kwaye, Asa akanyora oborwaire ase amagoro aye, na oborwaire obo bokaba obonene; korende nonya obete omorwaire, tarigetie Omonene, korende akarigia ogokonywa korwa ase abarwaria.
english: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign Asa was afflicted with a disease in his feet. Though his disease was severe, even in his illness he did not seek help from the LORD, but only from the physicians.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na gatano na kabere, bw’okogamba kwa Yoashi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Yehoasi, mosinto o Yehoahasi, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli agwo Samaria, na akagamba emiaka ikomi na etano nomo.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah, Jehoash son of Jehoahaz became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned sixteen years.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria Ewili‐Merodaki, omoruoti o Babeli, achagete kogamba akaba namabera ase Yehoyakini, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akamosibora korwa ase echela. Ayio nigo akoregete ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na gatano na kabere, omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na gatano na kabere nyuma Yehoyakini omoruoti bw’Abayuda goosirwe,
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Evil-Merodach became king of Babylon, he released Jehoiachin from prison on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria Ewili‐Merodaki akaba omoruoti o Babeli akarorera Yehoyakini amabera na ogosika, akamorusia echela. Ayio nigo akoregete ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na gatano na kabere, omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na gatano na kabere, nyuma Yehoyakini goosirwe.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the year Evil-Merodach became king of Babylon, he released Jehoiachin king of Judah and freed him from prison on the twenty-fifth day of the twelfth month.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na etano nomo, bw’okogamba gwa Asa, Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akagenda korwania Abayuda, akaagacha na kogitera omochie o Rama chindwaki ng’a nario ribaga ritabaise gotoka ase omonto onde bwensi gosoka, gose gosoa kogenda ase Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: In the thirty-sixth year of Asa's reign Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent anyone from leaving or entering the territory of Asa king of Judah.

ekegusii: Ekero Herode arenge omoruoti o Boyahudi, narenge omokuani oyomo, erieta riaye Zakaria, oyo bw’ensemo y’Abiya. Mokaye nomoiseke bw’ororeria rwa Haroni orenge, erieta riaye Elisabeti.
english: In the time of Herod king of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah, who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah; his wife Elizabeth was also a descendant of Aaron.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ay’okogamba kwa Yehoramu, Abaedomu bagasaria, bakaanga koigwera Abayuda, bakebekera omoruoti.
english: In the time of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against Judah and set up its own king.

ekegusii: Ekero Yehoramu arenge kogamba, Abaedomu bagasaria, bakaanga kogamberwa n’Abayuda, bakebekera omoruoti obo abanyene.
english: In the time of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against Judah and set up its own king.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’okogamba gwa Peka, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Tigilati‐Pileseri, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, agacha akabwata Iyoni, na Abeli‐Beti‐Maaka, na Yanoa, na Kedesi, na Hasori, na orogongo rwa Gileadi, na orwa Galili, na ense yonsi ya Nafutali. Boigo agoosa abanto, akabaira ase ense y’Abaasuri.
english: In the time of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came and took Ijon, Abel Beth Maacah, Janoah, Kedesh and Hazor. He took Gilead and Galilee, including all the land of Naphtali, and deported the people to Assyria.

ekegusii: Ase oroteru rwa igoro kegima yarengeo emegati y’ebisaku ao ao yaroiseretigwe Farao, korende chinyoni chigacha chikayeria korwa ase oroteru igoro, oro netwegete ase omotwe one.”
english: In the top basket were all kinds of baked goods for Pharaoh, but the birds were eating them out of the basket on my head."

ekegusii: Na ase emechie y’orogongo rwa Manase, na orw’Efraimu, na orwa Simeoni, na goika ase orogongo rwa Nafutali ase amatongo abo aande onsi,
english: In the towns of Manasseh, Ephraim and Simeon, as far as Naphtali, and in the ruins around them,

ekegusii: Ase emechie y’ense y’ebigoro, na ey’ense omweya, na eya Irianyi, na ey’orogongo rwa Benjamin, na ase chinsemo chionsi chia Yerusalemu, na ase emechie y’Abayuda, amaicho nabe agoeta inse y’okoboko kw’oyomo okoyabara.” Nabo Omonene agoteba.
english: In the towns of the hill country, of the western foothills and of the Negev, in the territory of Benjamin, in the villages around Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah, flocks will again pass under the hand of the one who counts them,' says the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kabere bw’okogamba kw’Ahasi, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Hosea, mosinto o Ela, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli agwo Samaria, na akagamba emiaka kianda.
english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned nine years.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kabere bw’okogamba kwa Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, ekero arenge omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Ahasia, mosinto o Yehoramu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the twelfth year of Joram son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na kabere bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Ahaswero, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani okorokwa Nisani, abanto bakaba bagoaka obomera bware korokwa Puri, agwo ase obosio bwa Hamani, igoro ya kera rituko, na kera omotienyi, bagaikera omotienyi o ikomi na kabere okorokwa Adari.
english: In the twelfth year of King Xerxes, in the first month, the month of Nisan, they cast the pur (that is, the lot) in the presence of Haman to select a day and month. And the lot fell on the twelfth month, the month of Adar.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano, omotienyi o ikomi, omwaka o ikomi na kabere, nyuma gotwairirwe ase obosomba, omonto konya otamire korwa Yerusalemu, agacha asende, agantebia, “Omochie oria obuirwe.”
english: In the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth month on the fifth day, a man who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me and said, "The city has fallen!"

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, omwaka o ikomi na kabere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, omwaka o ikomi na kabere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere bw’okogamba kwa Yeroboamu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Asa agachaka kogambera Abayuda.
english: In the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Asa became king of Judah,

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano, bw’okong’anyigwa gwaito, ase omochakano bw’omwaka, ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi, ase omwaka o ikomi na kane nyuma omochie kobuirwe, ee, ase rituko riria riria okoboko kw’Omonene gokaba igoro yane gokang’ira aaria.
english: In the twenty-fifth year of our exile, at the beginning of the year, on the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after the fall of the city-- on that very day the hand of the LORD was upon me and he took me there.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere, bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Simuri akagamba ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere agwo Tirisa. Emeganda y’esegi egatoora korwania Gibetoni, omochie bw’Abafilisti.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah, Zimri reigned in Tirzah seven days. The army was encamped near Gibbethon, a Philistine town.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere, bw’okogamba kwa Yeroboamu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, Asaria, mosinto bw’Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agachaka kogamba.
english: In the twenty-seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel, Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah began to reign.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: In the twenty-seventh year, in the first month on the first day, the word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere na etano nomo bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Ela, mosinto o Baasa, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli agwo Tirisa, akagamba emiaka ebere.
english: In the twenty-sixth year of Asa king of Judah, Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel, and he reigned in Tirzah two years.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere na gatato bw’okogamba kwa Yoashi, mosinto bw’Ahasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Yehoahasi, mosinto o Yehu, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli agwo Samaria, na akagamba emiaka ikomi na etano na ebere.
english: In the twenty-third year of Joash son of Ahaziah king of Judah, Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in Samaria, and he reigned seventeen years.

ekegusii: In the very same way, these dreamers pollute their own bodies, reject authority and slander celestial beings.
english: Naboigo nabwo abanyandoto bakobeka emebere yabo riko bagochaya okobua, na korama abwo b’obonene.

ekegusii: Ase enchera y’oboronge obogima mboreo, na amakweri tari ase enchera eyio.
english: In the way of righteousness there is life; along that path is immortality.

ekegusii: Ase ense omweya nero Esitaoli, na Sora, na Asina,
english: In the western foothills: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah,

ekegusii: Ee, inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: “Nigo erabe ng’a chinsemo ibere ase isato chi’abwo bamenyete ase ense eria mbaitwe basirigwe, korende ensemo eyemo y’abwo netigare ere moyo.
english: In the whole land," declares the LORD, "two-thirds will be struck down and perish; yet one-third will be left in it.

ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo arenge inda ya ng’ina, nigo abwatete egetingiro kia momura omwabo, na ekero abete omonto omonene, agakinana na Nyasae.
english: In the womb he grasped his brother's heel; as a man he struggled with God.

ekegusii: Ase Omwaka oria bw’Omochengo oboremo boria boiranerigwe omonyene oria oboonetie, oyio oboremo bwarenge ensemo y’omwando oye.
english: In the Year of Jubilee the field will revert to the person from whom he bought it, the one whose land it was.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria omoruoti Usia akwete, nkarora Omonene oikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene kiaimokererete igoro. Egesicho kiaye nigo kiarenge kegokurura inse nigo giaichorete ase Hekalu yonsi.
english: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and exalted, and the train of his robe filled the temple.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria Taritani, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani b’Abaasuri, atometwe na Sarigoni, omoruoti obo, agende ase omochie bw’Asidodi; ere akayorwania esegi, akayobua.
english: In the year that the supreme commander, sent by Sargon king of Assyria, came to Ashdod and attacked and captured it--

ekegusii: Abwo bagatotanga titokwana nabanto b’Ebisaku amang’ana ayaranyare kobarentera ogotooreka. Ase enchera eyio baikeranie botambe ekerengo ki’ebibe biabo. Korende endamwamu ya Nyasae yabaikeire omoerio.
english: in their effort to keep us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved. In this way they always heap up their sins to the limit. The wrath of God has come upon them at last.

ekegusii: Abakungu baria bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagatung’ama inse. Abanto baria bakabatebia, “Nase ki mokorigia oyore moyo ase ebitondo? [Tari aa, korende obokire.]
english: In their fright the women bowed down with their faces to the ground, but the men said to them, "Why do you look for the living among the dead?

ekegusii: Ase obwegimeria na amang’ana ’obong’ainereria nabenyorere abanyene ebitoki korwa asemore. Korende ekina kiabo, egiachikire korwa kare, tikegotebana, gose ogosira kwabo tigokorara.
english: In their greed these teachers will exploit you with stories they have made up. Their condemnation has long been hanging over them, and their destruction has not been sleeping.

ekegusii: “Ekero barenge nenchara, okabarentera endagera korwa igoro, na ekero barenge nerang’o, okabasokeria amache korwa ase egetare, naende okabatebia bagende koira ense eyio konya kwarire eira y’ogotiana ng’a nobayee.
english: In their hunger you gave them bread from heaven and in their thirst you brought them water from the rock; you told them to go in and take possession of the land you had sworn with uplifted hand to give them.

ekegusii: Ase barabwo obobani bwa Isaya bwaikeranire, obogoteba: “Okoigwa namoigwe, korende timokomanya nonya ng’ake, na okorora namorore, korende timokorora nonya ng’ake.
english: In them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah: "'You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.

ekegusii: Ekiagera mwemurunganirie asende, inwe mwensi abamwabarirwe na korikwa, abamwakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, nigo morakwe, na emebere yaino ekwete ebeere aiga ase erooro.
english: In this desert your bodies will fall-- every one of you twenty years old or more who was counted in the census and who has grumbled against me.

ekegusii: Ase obogima obo bwane obore bosa narorire kera egento; narorire omonto omonyaboronge ogosira ore ase oboronge bwaye, na omonyabibe okogenderera koba moyo amatuko amange ore ase ebibe biaye.
english: In this meaningless life of mine I have seen both of these: a righteous man perishing in his righteousness, and a wicked man living long in his wickedness.

ekegusii: Naboigo egwenerete abasacha banche abakungu babo buna emebere yabo abanyene. Oyobwanchete mokaye bweanchire ere omonyene.
english: In this same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

ekegusii: (Eri ngokwana tindi korikwana ase okobua kw’Omonene, korende buna omoriri ase oboremu obo bw’ogwetogia
english: In this self-confident boasting I am not talking as the Lord would, but as a fool.

ekegusii: Naboigo akore okobwatanigwa ase Aase Aachenu Mono ase engencho y’ogotacheneka kw’Abaisraeli amo nogosaria kwabo, na ebibe biabo bionsi. Naende akore okobwatanigwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, eyio ere amo nabarabwo na ase egati y’ogotacheneka kwabo.
english: In this way he will make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the uncleanness and rebellion of the Israelites, whatever their sins have been. He is to do the same for the Tent of Meeting, which is among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

ekegusii: In this way Hiram kept Solomon supplied with all the cedar and pine logs he wanted,
english: Hiramu akaa Sulemani emete, emecharake na emetarakwa buna Sulemani aganetie.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio kera rituko, ase amatuko atano na abere, mobe mokoruera Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera. Morue okoruegwa okwo amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochikire.
english: In this way prepare the food for the offering made by fire every day for seven days as an aroma pleasing to the LORD; it is to be prepared in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

ekegusii: In this way the man grew exceedingly prosperous and came to own large flocks, and maidservants and menservants, and camels and donkeys.
english: Naboigo Yakobo akaba okomenteka koba omotenenku, akaba namaicho amange, na abasomba, abaiseke na abamura, ne chingamia, ne chitigere.

ekegusii: Omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oyio ase obosio bwane, na omonto oyio naaberwe ase kende gionsi akorire na kwerentera okomocha.”
english: In this way the priest will make atonement for him before the LORD, and he will be forgiven for any of these things he did that made him guilty."

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’ebibe akorire ase ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’ayio, na omonto oria naaberwe. Oboratigare bobe obw’omokuani, buna obw’okoruegwa kw’endagera bokoba obwaye.”
english: In this way the priest will make atonement for him for any of these sins he has committed, and he will be forgiven. The rest of the offering will belong to the priest, as in the case of the grain offering.'"

ekegusii: Nabo ririko rigaikerana, erigoteba, “Obareranigwe amo nabasaria.”]
english: In this way the scripture came true which says, "He shared the fate of criminals" [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version. See Luke 22:37.]

ekegusii: Nabo ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaranda, rikabua.
english: In this way the word of the Lord spread widely and grew in power.

ekegusii: begacheire abanyene oboroso obuya ase ekero kegochigocha erinde babwate obogima obore obogima bw’ekeene.
english: In this way they will lay up treasure for themselves as a firm foundation for the coming age, so that they may take hold of the life that is truly life.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eye nainwe morentere Omonene okoruegwa kwaino, okwo mokorusia korwa ase ensemo ya ikomi eria mokonyora korwa ase Abaisraeli. Na okoruegwa okwo gw’ensemo ya ikomi okore kw’Omonene, moe Haroni omokuani.
english: In this way you also will present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites. From these tithes you must give the LORD's portion to Aaron the priest.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio obaatanane Abalawi korwa ase Abaisraeli, barabwo mbabe abaane.
english: In this way you are to set the Levites apart from the other Israelites, and the Levites will be mine.

ekegusii: Ase eri obwanchani bwaikeranigwe ime yaito, erinde tobe noboremu ase rituko ri’ekina, ekiagera buna ere are, naboigo naintwe tore ase ense eye.
english: In this way, love is made complete among us so that we will have confidence on the day of judgment, because in this world we are like him.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio monyare kogoka mono, nonya mbono ase ekero egeke inamochandeke ase amateemwa a kera engencho, onye egwenerete.
english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in all kinds of trials.

ekegusii: “Rora, ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, inche Omonene ning’iranerie Abayuda, na abanto ba Yerusalemu, bare ase obosomba, amaya abo.
english: 'In those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria, ogochika gokarua ase Kaisari Augusto, ng’a omobaro bw’abanto orikwe ase ense yonsi.
english: In those days Caesar Augustus issued a decree that a census should be taken of the entire Roman world.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Hezekia akarwara, akaba ang’e nogokwa. Agasaba Omonene, na ere akamoiraneria ase okomworokia ekemanyererio.
english: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. He prayed to the LORD, who answered him and gave him a miraculous sign.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Hezekia akarwara, akaba ang’e nogokwa. Isaya omobani mosinto bw’Amosi, agacha asare, akamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ebeke ang’e amo nenyomba yao, ekiagera aye goika okwe, tokogwena.”
english: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, "This is what the LORD says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover."

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Hezekia akarwara, akaba ang’e nogokwa. Isaya omobani, mosinto bw’Amosi, agacha asare, akamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ebeke ang’e, amo nenyomba yao, ekiagera aye goika okwe, tokogwena.”
english: In those days Hezekiah became ill and was at the point of death. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to him and said, "This is what the LORD says: Put your house in order, because you are going to die; you will not recover."

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio nkarora agwo ase ense y’Abayuda abanto barenge komita edivai ase rituko ri’Esabato. Boigo bakarenta endagera na bakabekera chitigere chigurube; naende nigo barenge korenta edivai, na amasabibu, na amako, ne chigurube chinde ao ao ase Yerusalemu ase rituko ri’Esabato. Nkabakurera bokong’u tibabaisa koonia endagera ase rituko erio.
english: In those days I saw men in Judah treading winepresses on the Sabbath and bringing in grain and loading it on donkeys, together with wine, grapes, figs and all other kinds of loads. And they were bringing all this into Jerusalem on the Sabbath. Therefore I warned them against selling food on that day.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria omoruoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli; na ase engaki eria abanto b’egesaku kia Dani nigo barenge kwerigeria orogongo ase baranyare komenya, ekiagera goika ase engaki eria konya tibaranyora omwando ase egati y’ebisaku binde bi’Abaisraeli.
english: In those days Israel had no king. And in those days the tribe of the Danites was seeking a place of their own where they might settle, because they had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria ekero omoruoti atarenge ase Abaisraeli, narengeo omonto gete Omolawi omenyete buna omomenyi rogoro kegima ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu. Ere agatwara omokungu o sere‐sere korwa Bethlehemu o Yuda.
english: In those days Israel had no king. Now a Levite who lived in a remote area in the hill country of Ephraim took a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria omoruoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli; kera omonto nigo arenge gokora kende gionsi aroche kere ekeronge.
english: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as he saw fit.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria omoruoti tarenge ase Abaisraeli, kera omonto nigo arenge gokora kende gionsi aroche kere ekeronge asare.
english: In those days Israel had no king; everyone did as he saw fit.

ekegusii: Ase chingaki chiria chintambe morembe torenge ase monto onde bwensi, oria orenge gosoka isiko, gose oyorenge koirana, ekiagera abanto bonsi be chinse chiria nigo barenge nemechando emenge.
english: In those days it was not safe to travel about, for all the inhabitants of the lands were in great turmoil.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Yohana Omobatisi akaoroka. Nkorandia arenge ase erooro ya Boyahudi, ogoteba,
english: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the Desert of Judea

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio Abayuda mbatoorigwe, na abanto ba Yerusalemu bamenye ase obotoereru. Na Omoseboka oyio nigo orarokwe: Omonene Nere Oboronge Bwaito.”
english: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety. This is the name by which it will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.'

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio Petero agatenena gati y’abamwabo (omobaro bw’abanto nigo orenge ang’e rigana erimo na emerongo ebere) akabora,
english: In those days Peter stood up among the believers (a group numbering about a hundred and twenty)

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ayio, Abayuda na Abaisraeli nababe amo nabarabwo, bachiche korwa ase ense ya sugusu goika ase ense eria naete chisokoro chiaino ekaba omwando obo.”
english: In those days the house of Judah will join the house of Israel, and together they will come from a northern land to the land I gave your forefathers as an inheritance.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria Omonene agachaka gokeyia ense y’Abaisraeli. Hasaeli akababua ase chinsemo chiabo chionsi,
english: In those days the LORD began to reduce the size of Israel. Hazael overpowered the Israelites throughout their territory

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abafilisti bagasangereria abarwani babo amo, erinde barwanie Abaisraeli, na Akisi agatebia Daudi, “Goika omanye ng’a aye amo nabanto bao nigo mogochia kondwanesia esegi.”
english: In those days the Philistines gathered their forces to fight against Israel. Achish said to David, "You must understand that you and your men will accompany me in the army."

ekegusii: Bono ase amatuko aria, ekero aborokigwa barenge komentekana omobaro obo, nkwabete okwemurungania kw’Abayahudi abarenge gokwana Ekegiriki igoro ase Abayahudi baria barenge gokwana Ekearamaiki, ekiagera ababoraka babo bebetwe ase okogaberwa gwa kera rituko.
english: In those days when the number of disciples was increasing, the Grecian Jews among them complained against the Hebraic Jews because their widows were being overlooked in the daily distribution of food.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Ase amatuko ayio, na ase engaki eyio, ogosaria nakorigigwe ase Abaisraeli, ko tigokonyorekana, na ebibe ase Abayuda, ko tibikonyorekana, ekiagera inche Omonene ninyabere abanto abwo ndatigarie koba abatigari.”
english: In those days, at that time," declares the LORD, "search will be made for Israel's guilt, but there will be none, and for the sins of Judah, but none will be found, for I will forgive the remnant I spare.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba ng’a ase amatuko ayio, ekero morabuche na komentekana ase ense eyio, abanto tibagokwana nonya ng’ake igoro y’Esanduku y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene. Eyio tekoinyorwa naende, gose korengererigwa; gose eyende tekoroisigwa.
english: In those days, when your numbers have increased greatly in the land," declares the LORD, "men will no longer say, 'The ark of the covenant of the LORD.' It will never enter their minds or be remembered; it will not be missed, nor will another one be made.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akarika ase amarube aria, “Raria okweng’ata gokorwe, na mobeke Naboti ase amasio ’abanto ase okomoa amasikani.
english: In those letters she wrote: "Proclaim a day of fasting and seat Naboth in a prominent place among the people.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibari gosookigwa ase chingaki chi’amabe, ase chingaki chi’enchara nigo bakoigota.
english: In times of disaster they will not wither; in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.

ekegusii: ase amang’ana ’ekeene, ase chinguru chia Nyasae. Nigo tore nebirwanero bi’oboronge ase okoboko gw’okorio na ase okoboko gw’okobee.
english: in truthful speech and in the power of God; with weapons of righteousness in the right hand and in the left;

ekegusii: Nigo ere bosa asemore koboka mambia chuni na gokora emeremo emekong’u ase okonyora endagera, naende mwanyorwa gochia korara. Korende Omonene nigo agwechandera abanto baye anchete, nonya nekero baraire chitoro.
english: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat-- for he grants sleep to those he loves.

ekegusii: Erio ase okorora naetwe na Nyasae, ere akang’ira gochia ase ense y’Abaisraeli, akambeka igoro ase egetunwa egetambe mono. Aroro agwo nkarora egento kenga oboagacho bw’omochie ore ensemo ya irianyi.
english: In visions of God he took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very high mountain, on whose south side were some buildings that looked like a city.

ekegusii: Omomenyi goika aegwe omwando oye agwo ase egesaku ekio ase amenyete. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: In whatever tribe the alien settles, there you are to give him his inheritance," declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Nigo riarikire iga: “Abanto b’ebisaku amo na Gesemu batebire ng’a aye amo n’Abayahudi bande nigo moganetie kwanga koigwera; naende ng’a nakio gekogera mokoagacha orwaki; na koreng’ana namang’ana ayio, aye noganetie koba omoruoti obo.
english: in which was written: "It is reported among the nations-- and Geshem says it is true-- that you and the Jews are plotting to revolt, and therefore you are building the wall. Moreover, according to these reports you are about to become their king

ekegusii: Ime ase ebio nigo mwabigenderete kare ase ogotunyana chingencho chi’ense eye, na gotunyana omogambi bw’okobua kwa igoro gati, oyore omoika oria ogokora emeremo ase abanto bataigwereti Nyasae.
english: in which you used to live when you followed the ways of this world and of the ruler of the kingdom of the air, the spirit who is now at work in those who are disobedient.

ekegusii: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
english: Ime asare chinibo chionsi chi’obong’aini na echie chisemi nao chibisire.

ekegusii: Ime ase Omwana oria ntore nokoboorigwa na okwaberwa kw’ebibe.
english: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagokora emeroberio y’obonyaka, na amaboko abo a borio nigo aichire namaaki.
english: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwaetete ase ense kore nekeririanda, okamionogorera abanto b’ebisaku inse kore nendamwamu.
english: In wrath you strode through the earth and in anger you threshed the nations.

ekegusii: Abang’achi bande bamenyete ime yao bakogera amanyinga aiteka. Abanto bao bande nigo bakoriera ebing’wanso igoro ase ebitunwa; na abande nigo bare abatomani,
english: In you are slanderous men bent on shedding blood; in you are those who eat at the mountain shrines and commit lewd acts.

ekegusii: na abande nigo bagotomana nabakungu b’abaise, na abande nigo bakoba nabakungu kobare nomotienyi.
english: In you are those who dishonor their fathers' bed; in you are those who violate women during their period, when they are ceremonially unclean.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, naye nsemeretie, tontiga nsookigwe; totiga ababisa baane bagokere okobugwa kwane.
english: in you I trust, O my God. Do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies triumph over me.

ekegusii: Abanto bao bande nigo bakoegwa riaaki baita abande. Aye nigo okorua singo gwasaba ebitoki ase okwementera, aye nigo okwenyorera ebitoki ase okorianania omogisangio oo, naende kwanyebire inche. Nabo Omonene Nyasae agoteba.
english: In you men accept bribes to shed blood; you take usury and excessive interest and make unjust gain from your neighbors by extortion. And you have forgotten me, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo nigo agokora ebibe bi’okogechia ase ogotomana nomokungu bw’omonto onde, na oyonde okora ay’okogechia ase okoba na moka momura oye, na oyonde okora ay’okogechia ase okoba nomoiseke omwabo, omwana o ise.
english: In you one man commits a detestable offense with his neighbor's wife, another shamefully defiles his daughter-in-law, and another violates his sister, his own father's daughter.

ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiagosemeretie, ee, nigo chiagosemeretie, naye ogachitooria.
english: In you our fathers put their trust; they trusted and you delivered them.

ekegusii: Aye omochie, abaise na abang’ina abare ime yao bachayirwe, na abamenyi bamenyete ime yao bakoreirwe bobe, ne chintakana na ababoraka boigo.
english: In you they have treated father and mother with contempt; in you they have oppressed the alien and mistreated the fatherless and the widow.

ekegusii: Omonene, naye natameire, tontiga nsookigwe.
english: In you, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

ekegusii: Mobee, korende timokora ebibe; morengereria mono amang’ana ayio ekero mokorara ase amarere aino, na mobe abatoereru.
english: In your anger do not sin; when you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent. Selah

ekegusii: Ekero mwarenge nemechando nigo mwandangeretie, na inche nkabatooria, nigo nabairaneretie korwa ime y’enkoba ase nebisete, nkabateema agwo ase amache a Meriba.
english: In your distress you called and I rescued you, I answered you out of a thundercloud; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah

ekegusii: Okorere Sayoni amaya ase amabera ao; oagache chindwaki chia Yerusalemu.
english: In your good pleasure make Zion prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: naende obekire mwanyabanto ase amaboko ao obagambere aande onsi ase bamenyete; okobekire ogambere boigo ching’iti chi’ense ne chinyoni chionsi; na omotwe oria bw’etahabu kwaroche noro aye.
english: in your hands he has placed mankind and the beasts of the field and the birds of the air. Wherever they live, he has made you ruler over them all. You are that head of gold.

ekegusii: In your majesty ride forth victoriously in behalf of truth, humility and righteousness; let your right hand display awesome deeds.
english: Genda bosio nobobui na obonene! Okengere ekeene, na obwororo, na oboronge; na okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngokworokererie amang’ana ’ogokumia.

ekegusii: In your marketplace they traded with you beautiful garments, blue fabric, embroidered work and multicolored rugs with cords twisted and tightly knotted.
english: Abwo bagakorentera chianga chingiya mono, na ebitambaa bire buru na ebiroisirie ebieni ao ao, na emegeke y’ebieni ao ao, ne chingori chinkong’u.

ekegusii: Naende ase amachiko aino nigo arikire ng’a oborori bw’abanto babere nobw’ekeene,
english: In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two men is valid.

ekegusii: Timorarwana esegi goika mwaiteire amanyinga aino ase okoamererania nebibe,
english: In your struggle against sin, you have not yet resisted to the point of shedding your blood.

ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaino nchirengererie igoro y’obwoba boria na goteba: “Inee! Oria orenge kobeka ebango, ng’ai are? Oria orenge korusia ebango, ng’ai are? Oria orenge kobara emerobiri, ng’ai are?”
english: In your thoughts you will ponder the former terror: "Where is that chief officer? Where is the one who took the revenue? Where is the officer in charge of the towers?"

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, siria ababisa baane; siria kegima abwo bonsi bagochanda omoyo one, ekiagera inche nigo inde omosomba oo.
english: In your unfailing love, silence my enemies; destroy all my foes, for I am your servant.

ekegusii: abande bakamenya Sikilagi, na Mekona na ase ebichie biaye;
english: in Ziklag, in Meconah and its settlements,

ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asemore.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekengwanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asemore.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.

ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochikire amo nabirobio.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochikire amo nabirobio.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochikire amo nabirobio.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko. Morue nokoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa gochikire amo nabirobio.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, kementwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogokora okobwatanigwa, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochikire amo nabirobio.
english: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering for atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.

ekegusii: Naende morue egoree eyemo ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asemore.
english: Include one male goat to make atonement for you.

ekegusii: Amo neyio orogongo rwabo rokabwaterania Katati, na Nahalali, na Simuroni, na Idala, na Bethlehemu, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.
english: Included were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah and Bethlehem. There were twelve towns and their villages.

ekegusii: amo na Yehoyada, omoteneneri bw’eamate ya Haroni, na amo nere abanto chilifu isato, na amagana atano na abere (3,700);
english: including Jehoiada, leader of the family of Aaron, with 3,700 men,

ekegusii: mono ekiagera aiterete amanyinga ’abanto batari na komocha. Igo aichoretie Yerusalemu namanyinga ’abanto baria, na Omonene tarenge komwabera.
english: including the shedding of innocent blood. For he had filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD was not willing to forgive.

ekegusii: Omentere omoruoti amatuko agenderere koba moyo; emiaka yaye ebe ey’ebiaare ebinge.
english: Increase the days of the king's life, his years for many generations.

ekegusii: Ere nomorwaire arenge ekeene, ang’e nogokwa, korende Nyasae akamororera amabera, gose tari ere bweka, korende nonya ninche boigo, timba nomoichano igoro ase omoichano.
english: Indeed he was ill, and almost died. But God had mercy on him, and not on him only but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.

ekegusii: Naki ekeene, ase omochie oyo Herode na Pontio Pilato amo nabanto b’Ebisaku, na Abaisraeli, bagasangererekana igoro y’Omosomba oo omochenu, Yeso, oyokwaagete amaguta koba Masihi,
english: Indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel in this city to conspire against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed.

ekegusii: Na rora, mbare ab’omoerio barache koba abe ritang’ani, naende mbare abe ritang’ani barache koba ab’omoerio.”
english: Indeed there are those who are last who will be first, and first who will be last."

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abwo bamanoire kogenda Misiri komenya aroro goika baitwe nemioro na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita. Onde tari oranyare gotigara tanyorwa nobobe obwo inche ngochia korenta igoro asebare.”
english: Indeed, all who are determined to go to Egypt to settle there will die by the sword, famine and plague; not one of them will survive or escape the disaster I will bring on them.'

ekegusii: Indeed, God does not listen to their empty plea; the Almighty pays no attention to it.
english: Ekeene, Nyasae tari koigwa okorera gotari ogw’ekeene, gose ere Omonguru takogwechandera.”

ekegusii: Ekeene, nigo akona‐koonchora okoboko kwaye igoro yane, ekero ase ekero omobaso boira.
english: indeed, he has turned his hand against me again and again, all day long.

ekegusii: indeed, he who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
english: Ee, ere omorendi bw’Abaisraeli tagosundoka, gose takorara.

ekegusii: Naende nigo inde mamincha y’ababani abwo bakobana chindoto chi’oborimo, naende bachitebia abanto baane na igo babasiria. Ase ayio tibari gokonya abanto aba nonya ng’ake. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: Indeed, I am against those who prophesy false dreams," declares the LORD. "They tell them and lead my people astray with their reckless lies, yet I did not send or appoint them. They do not benefit these people in the least," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ee, intwe abanyene nigo twarenge nekina ki’amakweri ase emioyo yaito, erinde titwesemeria intwe abanyene, korende tosemerie Nyasae oyokobokia abakure;
english: Indeed, in our hearts we felt the sentence of death. But this happened that we might not rely on ourselves but on God, who raises the dead.

ekegusii: Naki naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani, kobua omonda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Igoro ya Sayoni amang’ana aya nakwanwe. “Omonto oyo na oria nao baiboreretwe ime yaye,” na Omonene ore Igoro Mono nere orabe okoyokong’ia.
english: Indeed, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her."

ekegusii: Oyore enguba yaito noyo bw’Omonene, ee, omoruoti oito noyo bw’Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Indeed, our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Nonya nechitukia chi’emetwe yaino chiabarirwe chionsi. Timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.
english: Indeed, the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Don't be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

ekegusii: Ayio nabe ogotooreka kwane ng’a omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae tagocha ase obosio bwaye.
english: Indeed, this will turn out for my deliverance, for no godless man would dare come before him!

ekegusii: Naama! Aye kwabeire asebare buna omonto obwate eriogi rigiya ogotera amatera ay’okogokia, naende okobugia obokano buya. Nigo bakoigwa amang’ana ayio ao, korende tibari koyakorera.
english: Indeed, to them you are nothing more than one who sings love songs with a beautiful voice and plays an instrument well, for they hear your words but do not put them into practice.

ekegusii: “Edivai nigo ere buna omoonchoreria omong’ainereria; omonto omwerori tari kogenderera koba nobotoereru. Okogania kwaye nigo gokogarea kwaba buna aase abakure; nigo konga buna amakweri atari goisaneka. Nigo agosangereria abanto b’ebisaku bionsi gocha asare na gokora abanto be chinse chionsi koba abaye.”
english: indeed, wine betrays him; he is arrogant and never at rest. Because he is as greedy as the grave and like death is never satisfied, he gathers to himself all the nations and takes captive all the peoples.

ekegusii: Ee, inwe nobonene bwaito, na omogoko oito.
english: Indeed, you are our glory and joy.

ekegusii: Korende omotang’ani bw’esinagogi eria akabea, ekiagera Yeso agwenia omonto ase rituko ri’Esabato, agatebia abanto, “Nare amatuko atano na rimo agwenerete mwanyabanto bakore emeremo; ase ayio, inchuo ase amatuko ayio mogwenigwe, korende tari ase rituko ri’Esabato.”
english: Indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, the synagogue ruler said to the people, "There are six days for work. So come and be healed on those days, not on the Sabbath."

ekegusii: Nigo inde nokogechigwa okonene ase engencho y’abakori amabe, ekiagera bagosaria amachiko ao.
english: Indignation grips me because of the wicked, who have forsaken your law.

ekegusii: Osoyie emiaro eyio ase chibonyi ime ase okobogoreria Esanduku eria.
english: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the chest to carry it.

ekegusii: Rora, enda yane nigo enga buna edivai ekunekire mono, buna ebirandi biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa amayia bire ang’e kworeka.
english: inside I am like bottled-up wine, like new wineskins ready to burst.

ekegusii: Korende omorobiri omokong’u norenge ase omochie oria ime, na abanto bonsi b’omochie, abasacha na abakungu, bagatama gochiao, bagesiekera imeo. Erio bakariina gochia kerama igoro.
english: Inside the city, however, was a strong tower, to which all the men and women-- all the people of the city-- fled. They locked themselves in and climbed up on the tower roof.
