ekegusii: Oboagacho obwo bw’egeita kia moocha nigo bwarenge nebinyomba bi’oborendi, bitato ensemo eyemo, na bitato ensemo ende; bionsi nigo biarenge nekerengo ekemo, ne chisiiro chie chinsemo chionsi ibere nigo chiarenge echi’ekerengo ekemo.
english: Inside the east gate were three alcoves on each side; the three had the same measurements, and the faces of the projecting walls on each side had the same measurements.

ekegusii: Korende agasoka, agachaka korandia amang’ana aya na gosareria ring’ana riria, goika Yeso tanyara naende gosoa ase omochie ime maiso marore, korende akabeera isiko aase atari nabanto; na abanto bakamochiera korwa kera aase.
english: Instead he went out and began to talk freely, spreading the news. As a result, Jesus could no longer enter a town openly but stayed outside in lonely places. Yet the people still came to him from everywhere.

ekegusii: atayerenteti agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano ebe ekeng’wanso asende, bosio bw’Obomenyo bwane, rirorio okomocha kw’ogoitera amanyinga nakobarerwe omonto oyio. Ere oiteire amanyinga, ase igo naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
english: instead of bringing it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to the LORD in front of the tabernacle of the LORD-- that man shall be considered guilty of bloodshed; he has shed blood and must be cut off from his people.

ekegusii: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and silver in place of iron. Instead of wood I will bring you bronze, and iron in place of stones. I will make peace your governor and righteousness your ruler.
english: “Ninkorentere chitahabu ribaga rie chitaai, ne chifeta ribaga ri’ebioma, ne chitaai ribaga rie chibao, na ebioma ribaga ri’amagena. Ninkore abateneneri bao babe ab’omorembe, na abwo bagokogambera babe bakogokorera ay’oboronge.

ekegusii: Inwe abanyene timobeti mogokorera ebinto biane ebichenu, korende mwabekire abanto abaao bakaba bakobikorera ase enyomba yane enchenu ribaga riaino.
english: Instead of carrying out your duty in regard to my holy things, you put others in charge of my sanctuary.

ekegusii: Instead of fragrance there will be a stench; instead of a sash, a rope; instead of well-dressed hair, baldness; instead of fine clothing, sackcloth; instead of beauty, branding.
english: Ribaga ri’ogotioka okuya nobogundo borabeo, ne ribaga ri’orokini nengori erabeo, ne ribaga ri’etukia eroisirie buya nerisio rirabeo, ne ribaga ri’okobeka chiganchwa chi’emeyega mweboyie chigunia, ne ribaga ri’oboseera mbabe namasambo are ekemanyererio gi’okobugwa.

ekegusii: Aase amagwa are, emetarakwa nemereo, na aase amageri are emeadasi nemereo. Eyio nebe ekoraria obonene bw’Omonene na ekemanyererio gia kare na kare getasarigwe nonya ng’ake.”
english: Instead of the thornbush will grow the pine tree, and instead of briers the myrtle will grow. This will be for the LORD's renown, for an everlasting sign, which will not be destroyed."

ekegusii: Ribaga ri’obosooku bwaino monyore egetari ara kabere, na abwo bachayetwe mbanyore omogoko ase ebitari biabo; na igo barabwo mbanyore ebitari ara kabere agwo ase ense yabo, mbabe nomogoko o kare na kare.
english: Instead of their shame my people will receive a double portion, and instead of disgrace they will rejoice in their inheritance; and so they will inherit a double portion in their land, and everlasting joy will be theirs.

ekegusii: Ase ribaga riabo nasike enyasae ekorenda chiburi; enyasae eye chisokoro chiaye chitamanyete nigo arayesike ase okoyeruera chitahabu, ne chifeta, na amagena e rigori rinene, na ebiegwa ebiya mono.
english: Instead of them, he will honor a god of fortresses; a god unknown to his fathers he will honor with gold and silver, with precious stones and costly gifts.

ekegusii: korende tobarikere rirube ng’a beatanane korwa ase ebinto bitachenegeti bi’emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, na obotomani, na enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase amanyinga.
english: Instead we should write to them, telling them to abstain from food polluted by idols, from sexual immorality, from the meat of strangled animals and from blood.

ekegusii: Obeke Abalawi babe bakorenda Obomenyo Obochenu obwo bore noborori, naende babe bakorenda ebinto bire ase Obomenyo boria ime, na ebikorero biaye. Nababe bakobobogoria amo nebinto biaye bionsi, na gokora emeremo imeo. Barabwo nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chi’okomenya chietanane Obomenyo obwo.
english: Instead, appoint the Levites to be in charge of the tabernacle of the Testimony-- over all its furnishings and everything belonging to it. They are to carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they are to take care of it and encamp around it.

ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo arakwe ase engencho y’obobe bwaye omonyene. Kera omonto orarie amasabibu amaroro, amaino aye nabe nobokang’iti.”
english: Instead, everyone will die for his own sin; whoever eats sour grapes-- his own teeth will be set on edge.

ekegusii: Farao akairana kogenda bwoye, amang’ana aria tayabeka ase omoyo oye.
english: Instead, he turned and went into his palace, and did not take even this to heart.

ekegusii: Inche nigo nakorete omokia, nkagenderera koagacha orwaki, gose titwagorete oboremo bonde, na abasomba baane nigo babete amo nainche ase ogokora emeremo eria.
english: Instead, I devoted myself to the work on this wall. All my men were assembled there for the work; we did not acquire any land.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya ikomi eye Abaisraeli bakondetera buna okoruegwa kwabo nayeire Abalawi ebe eyabo. Ase ayio, nabatebirie ng’a tibakoba nomwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli bande.”
english: Instead, I give to the Levites as their inheritance the tithes that the Israelites present as an offering to the LORD. That is why I said concerning them: 'They will have no inheritance among the Israelites.'"

ekegusii: korende kobe ogw’enkoro y’omonto o ime otari kororekana, ogwechabera okwo gotari gosareka, ase omoika bw’obwororo na obokanyeku. Oko nakwo kore kwe rigori rinene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: Instead, it should be that of your inner self, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great worth in God's sight.

ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ayio Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, amo nabachiki baria bonsi, bakaira Misiri Abayuda bonsi abatigari, abwo bairanete komenya ase ense y’Abayuda, abwo baruete korwa ase ebisaku ebio ase baseretigwe gochia.
english: Instead, Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers led away all the remnant of Judah who had come back to live in the land of Judah from all the nations where they had been scattered.

ekegusii: Korende oyomo bw’abarwani akamobeta ritimo rikere riaye, akaruao bwango amanyinga na amache.
english: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesus' side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.

ekegusii: Korende tokwane ekeene ase obwanchani, tokine goika toikere Kristo ase chinchera chionsi; nere ore omotwe.
english: Instead, speaking the truth in love, we will in all things grow up into him who is the Head, that is, Christ.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agachika Yerameeli, momura oye, na Seraya, mosinto bw’Asirieli, na Selemia, mosinto bw’Abudeeli, ng’a babwate Baruku omoriki amo na Yeremia omobani, korende Omonene konya obabisire.
english: Instead, the king commanded Jerahmeel, a son of the king, Seraiah son of Azriel and Shelemiah son of Abdeel to arrest Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet. But the LORD had hidden them.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo abanto baria bagateema ne chinguru gosukia emeeri eria gochia ase engegu, korende tibanyarete, ekiagera ekembugu‐mbugu keria nigo kiagendererete koburukania enyancha mono goetania.
english: Instead, the men did their best to row back to land. But they could not, for the sea grew even wilder than before.

ekegusii: korende iga barenge namaborio gete, okoamererania igoro asare ase edini yabo abanyene, na ase amang’ana igoro y’omonto oyomo, Yeso, oyoikire gokwa, korende oyo Paulo akona‐goteba ng’a moyo are.
english: Instead, they had some points of dispute with him about their own religion and about a dead man named Jesus who Paul claimed was alive.

ekegusii: Basaririe na babwatirie ebirengererio bie chisokoro chiabo, batunyanire chinyasae chikorokwa Baali, buna chisokoro chiabo chiaborokereretie.
english: Instead, they have followed the stubbornness of their hearts; they have followed the Baals, as their fathers taught them."

ekegusii: Korende bono mbaganetie ense ere engiya kobua, engencho yaye ense ya igoro. Ase ayio Nyasae takorora obosooku korokwa Nyasae obo, ekiagera obaroiseirie omochie.
english: Instead, they were longing for a better country-- a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

ekegusii: Korende mbamokorere Omonene, Nyasae obo, bamokorere na Daudi, omoruoti obo, oyio ndabatenenerie.”
english: Instead, they will serve the LORD their God and David their king, whom I will raise up for them.

ekegusii: Korende moriere ebinto ebio ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, agwo aase arachore. Mobirie inwe amo nabana baino, abamura na abaiseke, na abasomba baino, abamura na abaiseke, na Abalawi bamenyete amo nainwe ase emechie yaino. Na igo mogoke ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase kera egento morabe mogokora.
english: Instead, you are to eat them in the presence of the LORD your God at the place the LORD your God will choose-- you, your sons and daughters, your menservants and maidservants, and the Levites from your towns-- and you are to rejoice before the LORD your God in everything you put your hand to.

ekegusii: korende kweimokereirie igoro mamincha y’Omonene ore igoro. Ebikorero bi’enyomba yaye biarentirwe ase obosio bwao; aye amo nabanto b’oboruoti bwao, na abakungu bao, na abakungu bao ba sere‐sere, babinywereire edivai. Aye kwabeire kogotogia chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na ebioma, na emete na amagena, echio chitari korora, gose koigwa, gose chitamanyeti gento, korende Nyasae oria obomoyo bwao bore ase okoboko kwaye, ne chinchera chiao chionsi chire ase okobua kwaye, tomotogeti.
english: Instead, you have set yourself up against the Lord of heaven. You had the goblets from his temple brought to you, and you and your nobles, your wives and your concubines drank wine from them. You praised the gods of silver and gold, of bronze, iron, wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or understand. But you did not honor the God who holds in his hand your life and all your ways.

ekegusii: Ayamogwenerete goteba naya, “Omonene karanche, natobe moyo, naende tokore iga gose iga”.
english: Instead, you ought to say, "If it is the Lord's will, we will live and do this or that."

ekegusii: Korende inwe abanyene mwakoreire abanto bobe, na kobaura ebi babwate, ee nonya nase abamino.
english: Instead, you yourselves cheat and do wrong, and you do this to your brothers.

ekegusii: Orokereria omonto omong’aini, oyio nigo aragenderere koba omong’aini goetania. Orokereria omonto omoronge, oyio namente koba ne chisemi.
english: Instruct a wise man and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man and he will add to his learning.

ekegusii: na okworokereria gwe chibatiso, na okobekerwa kw’amaboko, na okobokigwa kw’abakure, na okogambigwa gwa kare na kare.
english: instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

ekegusii: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.
english: Tonyuomerane intwe nainwe, motoe abaiseke baino, naintwe tobae abaito.

ekegusii: Ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio obomera nigo bokogwera Yerusalemu, erinde abekeo ebikorero bi’ogotagorera, arere okorera kw’ogoita na goaka eriogi ri’esegi. Nigo arabekeo ebikorero bi’ogotagorera ebiita, na koagacha chiburi ne chindwaki chi’ogwekengera.
english: Into his right hand will come the lot for Jerusalem, where he is to set up battering rams, to give the command to slaughter, to sound the battle cry, to set battering rams against the gates, to build a ramp and to erect siege works.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae omwegenwa, naye kwambooririe.
english: Into your hands I commit my spirit; redeem me, O LORD, the God of truth.

ekegusii: Orangerie Yese ache ase ekeng’wanso, nainche ninkworokie aya orakore, erio oake omonto oyo ndagotebie amaguta.”
english: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will show you what to do. You are to anoint for me the one I indicate."

ekegusii: Ifudia na Penueli; aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Sasaki.
english: Iphdeiah and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.

ekegusii: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
english: na Yifuta, na Asina, na Nesibu,

ekegusii: Ira, mosinto o Ikesi korwa Tekoa, na Abieseri korwa Anatoti;
english: Ira son of Ikkesh from Tekoa, Abiezer from Anathoth,

ekegusii: Ira na Garebu korwa Itiri;
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite

ekegusii: Ira na Garebu korwa Itiri;
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

ekegusii: Ekioma nigo kenga risakwe asere, na etaai nigo enga omote ogundire.
english: Iron he treats like straw and bronze like rotten wood.

ekegusii: Ebioma nigo bigokunywa korwa riroba inse, ne chitaai nigo chikonyorwa ase amagena ’ebitare anyititorwa.
english: Iron is taken from the earth, and copper is smelted from ore.

ekegusii: Iron, Migdal El, Horem, Beth Anath and Beth Shemesh. There were nineteen towns and their villages.
english: na Yironi, na Migidali‐Eli, na Horemu, na Beti‐Anati, na Beti‐Semesi, emechie ikomi na kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Omonto onde oino karanyorekane nemechando, tiga asabe. Onde omo oino, onye ore nomoyo bw’ogosasoka, tiga atogie ase ogotera.
english: Is any one of you in trouble? He should pray. Is anyone happy? Let him sing songs of praise.

ekegusii: Onye omonto onde oino obeire omorwaire, tiga arangerie abagaaka b’ekanisa bamosabere na bamoake amaguta ase erieta ri’Omonene.
english: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.

ekegusii: Ing’ana ki rire rikong’u riramosinye Omonene? Engaki ndairane asore ase omwaka ogocha, engaki enga buna eye, ninyore ng’a Sara onyorire omwana omoisia.”
english: Is anything too hard for the LORD? I will return to you at the appointed time next year and Sarah will have a son."

ekegusii: Inee! Kristo naatananekire? Gose Paulo nere obambetwe ase engencho yaino? Gose igo mwabatisetwe ase erieta ria Paulo?
english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized into the name of Paul?

ekegusii: Onye ebibe bire ime ya Gileadi, abanto b’aroro goika basire. Onye abanto ba Giligali bakoruera ebing’wanso bie chieri aroro ase ebisasimero biabo, birobio mbisarigwe bibe buna chitui chi’amagena ase emetaro y’emegondo.”
english: Is Gilead wicked? Its people are worthless! Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal? Their altars will be like piles of stones on a plowed field.

ekegusii: Gose Nyasae nigo are Nyasae bw’Abayahudi boka? Tari Nyasae bw’Ebisaku boigo? Ee, Nyasae bw’Ebisaku boigo.
english: Is God the God of Jews only? Is he not the God of Gentiles too? Yes, of Gentiles too,

ekegusii: Nonyare gotebia omoruoti: Aye nigo ore omonto bosa, gose notebie abanene basikire: Inwe nabakori amabe?
english: Is he not the One who says to kings, 'You are worthless,' and to nobles, 'You are wicked,'

ekegusii: Inee! Abwo nigo bagochia konakorusia abanto b’ebisaku ase ekeonga kiabo babasirie batari namabera?
english: Is he to keep on emptying his net, destroying nations without mercy?

ekegusii: “Inee! Abaisraeli nabasomba bare? Gose nigo baiboretwe bare abasomba? Onye taibo, nase ki rende bakoirwa ase obosomba?
english: Is Israel a servant, a slave by birth? Why then has he become plunder?

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo are amang’ana amagusu asemore ng’a komwanyorire oborisia obuya, mwatiringera inse namagoro aino obonyansi obwatigaire? Naende komwanyure amache amakenonoku, mwaturubania namagoro aino ayatigaire?
english: Is it not enough for you to feed on the good pasture? Must you also trample the rest of your pasture with your feet? Is it not enough for you to drink clear water? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?

ekegusii: Inee! Amabe na amaya, tari korwa ase omonwa bw’Oyore Igoro Mono?
english: Is it not from the mouth of the Most High that both calamities and good things come?

ekegusii: Is it not ruin for the wicked, disaster for those who do wrong?
english: Inee! Emechando teri konyora abatari abanyaboronge, na ogosirigwa gwachera abagokora ebibe?

ekegusii: Mwatananere abare nenchara endagera yaino; abanto abataka batabwati chinka, mobarente ase chinyomba chiaino; ekero mokorora omonto ore getirianda, momoboyie. Timobaisa kwanga gokonya abare nomobere na amanyinga buna inwe.”
english: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter-- when you see the naked, to clothe him, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?

ekegusii: Inee! Bono tari engaki ye rigesa ri’engano? Nonya nabo nimosabe Omonene arente enkoba na embura, erinde momanye ng’a mwakorire obobe obonene ase okoboria ng’a moegwe omoruoti.”
english: Is it not wheat harvest now? I will call upon the LORD to send thunder and rain. And you will realize what an evil thing you did in the eyes of the LORD when you asked for a king."

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Inee, ngwatotigire kegima? Aye tori kogenda amo nabarwani baito b’esegi.
english: Is it not you, O God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

ekegusii: Is it right for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
english: Inee! Mboronge koa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo?”

ekegusii: Nomanyete ng’a Boazi, oria ase konya ogokora emeremo nabasomba baye, nigo are omonyamwando ominto? Naama! Ase omogoroba o rero nache abe okoora esairi ase ekeooreri kiaye.
english: Is not Boaz, with whose servant girls you have been, a kinsman of ours? Tonight he will be winnowing barley on the threshing floor.

ekegusii: “Inee! Efraimu tari omwana one nyanchete? Ere nere ongogetie mono. Nonya nkomotianera, nigo imorengereretie botambe. Enkoro yane nigo emwechanderete, ekeene, nimororere amabera.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: Is not Ephraim my dear son, the child in whom I delight? Though I often speak against him, I still remember him. Therefore my heart yearns for him; I have great compassion for him," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Egekombe keria ki’ogosesenigwa togosesenia, Inee, tikeri okobwatana namanyinga a Kristo? Omogati oria togosamunyora, tori okobwatana nomobere o Kristo?
english: Is not the cup of thanksgiving for which we give thanks a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?

ekegusii: Inee! Ense eye yonsi teri ase obosio bwao? Tiga twatananeke. Koragende ensemo ya bomosi, inche ningende eya borio; koragende ensemo ya borio, inche ningende eya bomosi.”
english: Is not the whole land before you? Let's part company. If you go to the left, I'll go to the right; if you go to the right, I'll go to the left."

ekegusii: “Obong’aini nigo bore ase abanto abanene, na okomenya emiaka emenge nakwo okomanya.
english: Is not wisdom found among the aged? Does not long life bring understanding?

ekegusii: Is not your wickedness great? Are not your sins endless?
english: Inee! Amabe gwakorire tari amanene? Ekeene, ebibe biao tibiri nomoerio.

ekegusii: Onye endagera tebekiri omonyo okoyiansia, neriegwe? Inee! Omochununu bwe rigena ri’engoko nobwate obwansu?
english: Is tasteless food eaten without salt, or is there flavor in the white of an egg?

ekegusii: Ayio naro agerire inwe mwensi mwakorire emeroberio ya bobisi ere mamincha yane? Onde tari ogontebia ng’a omwana one okorire okobwatana na mosinto o Yese, gose onde tari okondorera amabera antebie ng’a omwana one oseegetire abasomba baane babeire mamincha yane, erio bamboere buna ere rero iga.”
english: Is that why you have all conspired against me? No one tells me when my son makes a covenant with the son of Jesse. None of you is concerned about me or tells me that my son has incited my servant to lie in wait for me, as he does today."

ekegusii: Inee! Amachiko nigo are mamincha e chiira chia Nyasae? Yaya, taibo! Naki onye amachiko aruetwe ayaranyare koa abanto obogima, anga oboronge nigo bwanyorekanete ase amachiko.
english: Is the law, therefore, opposed to the promises of God? Absolutely not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come by the law.

ekegusii: Is there any wickedness on my lips? Can my mouth not discern malice?
english: Inee! Amang’ana aane ngokwana nay’oborimo? Inee! Tinkonyara gokwana inyatanane ayare amabe?”

ekegusii: Inee! Ing’ana rinde ndireo rigokwanwa ng’a neriyia? Yaya. Kera ring’ana nao riarenge korwa kare, intwe konya totarabao.
english: Is there anything of which one can say, "Look! This is something new"? It was here already, long ago; it was here before our time.

ekegusii: Inee! Amaguta akogwenia naborire Gileadi? Omorwaria tari aroro? Nase ki abanto baane bataragwenigwa?
english: Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? Why then is there no healing for the wound of my people?

ekegusii: Inee! Chimbusuro nchire ase ebiage? Inee! Emesabibu, na emeko, na emekomomanga, na emezeituni tiyangeti kwama? Korende korwa rituko ria rero nimbasesenie.”
english: Is there yet any seed left in the barn? Until now, the vine and the fig tree, the pomegranate and the olive tree have not borne fruit. "'From this day on I will bless you.'"

ekegusii: Inee! Ogosesenigwa oko nigo kore ase abwo barogete, gose nase abwo batarogeti boigo? Nigo togoteba, ng’a Ibrahimu ase okwegena kwaye akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge.
english: Is this blessedness only for the circumcised, or also for the uncircumcised? We have been saying that Abraham's faith was credited to him as righteousness.

ekegusii: Inee! Omonto oyo Konia nigo abeire buna enyongo yatekire, egekorero onde ataganeti? Nase ki rende ere amo nabana baye barutirwe gochia ase ense batamanyeti?
english: Is this man Jehoiachin a despised, broken pot, an object no one wants? Why will he and his children be hurled out, cast into a land they do not know?

ekegusii: Inee! Ring’ana eri igo riakorirwe, naye omonene one omoruoti toratotebia intwe abasomba bao ng’a ning’o oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiao abe omoruoti nyuma yao?”
english: Is this something my lord the king has done without letting his servants know who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?"

ekegusii: Inee! Oko nakwo okweng’ata inche nganetie? Inee! Eye nero enchera endonge omonto agwekeyia? Ogwekumba omotwe buna risakwe, na kweboyia chigunia amo nokweaka ribu? Inee! Ayio naro mokoroka okweng’ata ne rituko rikomogwenera Omonene?”
english: Is this the kind of fast I have chosen, only a day for a man to humble himself? Is it only for bowing one's head like a reed and for lying on sackcloth and ashes? Is that what you call a fast, a day acceptable to the LORD?

ekegusii: Inwe abanto abariri motari nobong’aini, Inee, eye nero enchera mogoakanera Omonene? Inee, ere tari iso, oria obatongete, na obakorire mwabeire ne chinguru?”
english: Is this the way you repay the LORD, O foolish and unwise people? Is he not your Father, your Creator, who made you and formed you?

ekegusii: Inee! Oyo nomochie oria oino oichire nomogoko, omochie oyio oagachetwe ase chingaki chia kare, oyio amagoro ’abanto baye abogoretie gochia komenya ase chinse chi’aare?
english: Is this your city of revelry, the old, old city, whose feet have taken her to settle in far-off lands?

ekegusii: Inee! Omote oyio nonachwe okorerwe moremo onde? Gose abanto mbaroisie egekongo korwa ase omote oyio basungere egento kende gionsi.
english: Is wood ever taken from it to make anything useful? Do they make pegs from it to hang things on?

ekegusii: Inee! Obwanchani bwao ngokwanwa bore ime ase chimbeera, gose obwegenwa bwao agwo aase aasareku?
english: Is your love declared in the grave, your faithfulness in Destruction?

ekegusii: Isaka akamoiraneria, “Rora, namokorire abe omonene oo, na abamwabo bonsi babe abasomba baye, naende namoeire endagera y’omogondo na edivai. Inki rende ndanyare kogokorera aye, omwana one?”
english: Isaac answered Esau, "I have made him lord over you and have made all his relatives his servants, and I have sustained him with grain and new wine. So what can I possibly do for you, my son?"

ekegusii: Isaka akamoboria, “Omwana one, naki gwakora kwanyora ching’iti iga bwango?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, Nyasae oo, nere ochindetera.”
english: Isaac asked his son, "How did you find it so quickly, my son?" "The LORD your God gave me success," he replied.

ekegusii: Na Isaka akababoria, “Inki mwacha korigia aa bwone? Nainwe nigo mongechete, naende mwanseretie korwa seino.”
english: Isaac asked them, "Why have you come to me, since you were hostile to me and sent me away?"

ekegusii: Isaka agasoyia Rebeka ase eema ya ng’ina ime, akaba omonyuomire, naende akaba omwanchete. Ase igo Isaka akaremigwa korwa ase omoichano bw’ogokwa kwa ng’ina.
english: Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah, and he married Rebekah. So she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted after his mother's death.

ekegusii: Na Isaka akaagacha egesasimero aroro, akarangeria erieta ri’Omonene, agatenenia chiema chiaye aroro. Na agwo abasomba baye bakarema, bakanyora entuboka.
english: Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the LORD. There he pitched his tent, and there his servants dug a well.

ekegusii: Isaka nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na etato (180).
english: Isaac lived a hundred and eighty years.

ekegusii: Isaka agasimeka endagera ase ense eria, akagesa ase omwaka oyio ara rigana, na Omonene akamosesenia.
english: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the LORD blessed him.

ekegusii: Isaka agasabera mokaye ase Omonene, ekiagera nigo arenge omogomba. Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kwaye, na Rebeka mokaye akaba morito.
english: Isaac prayed to the LORD on behalf of his wife, because she was barren. The LORD answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.

ekegusii: Isaka akarubora chinsoko chiria naende, echio chiaremetwe ase engaki ya Ibrahimu ise, ekiagera Abafilisti konya bachitichire nyuma Ibrahimu gakure. Isaka agachiroka buna ise achirogete ritang’ani.
english: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the time of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died, and he gave them the same names his father had given them.

ekegusii: Isaac said, "I am now an old man and don't know the day of my death.
english: Akamotebia, “Rora bono inche nagotire, gose timanyeti engaki y’ogokwa kwane.

ekegusii: Isaka agakwana na Ibrahimu ise, agateba, “Tata!” Ise akamoitabera, “Nao inde aa, omwana one.” Isaka akamoboria, “Rora, omorero ne chinko ntobwate, korende ng’ai emanwa y’engondi ere togochia gokorera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa?”
english: Isaac spoke up and said to his father Abraham, "Father?" "Yes, my son?" Abraham replied. "The fire and wood are here," Isaac said, "but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?"

ekegusii: Isaac then made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
english: Erio Isaka akabakorera omoyega, bakaria na bakanywa.

ekegusii: Isaac trembled violently and said, "Who was it, then, that hunted game and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came and I blessed him-- and indeed he will be blessed!"
english: Erio Isaka agakumia mono na koiguswa, akabora, “Ning’o oria ocha ondetera endagera engiya, na inche naria yonsi ekero otaracha, namosesenia?—Ee, nere nabe osesenirie.”

ekegusii: Isaka nigo amwanchete Esau, ekiagera arenge komorentera chinyama chi’obotwari bwaye; korende Rebeka nigo amwanchete Yakobo.
english: Isaac, who had a taste for wild game, loved Esau, but Rebekah loved Jacob.

ekegusii: Abasomba ba Isaka bakarema agwo ase ense eraire, bakanyora entuboka y’amache.
english: Isaac's servants dug in the valley and discovered a well of fresh water there.

ekegusii: Isaya akamoiraneria, “Omonene nakoe ekemanyererio, erinde omanye ng’a nakore egento keria arire eira akore. Inee! Nigo oganetie omorengari bw’okorengera chinsa otambee ebitambokero ikomi gochia bosio gose gochia nyuma.”
english: Isaiah answered, "This is the LORD's sign to you that the LORD will do what he has promised: Shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or shall it go back ten steps?"

ekegusii: Isaya nere ogoaka eriogi riaye igoro y’Abaisraeli, ogoteba, “Omobaro bw’Abaisraeli nonya bare buna omokenye ore nyancha, abatigarete nabwo boka barache gotoorigwa;
english: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: "Though the number of the Israelites be like the sand by the sea, only the remnant will be saved.

ekegusii: Bono Isaya konya otebire iga: “Tiga baimokie ribomba ri’amako, baribeke ase rigumba ria Hezekia, erinde agwene.”
english: Isaiah had said, "Prepare a poultice of figs and apply it to the boil, and he will recover."

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio Isaya nigo ayakwanete, ekiagera aroche obonene bwaye; agaatora amang’ana aye.
english: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus' glory and spoke about him.

ekegusii: Isaya akabatebia, “Genda motebie omonene oino ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteba: Tobaisa koiroka ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio kwaigure abasomba b’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri batebire ase okondama.
english: Isaiah said to them, "Tell your master, 'This is what the LORD says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard-- those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

ekegusii: Isaya akabatebia, “Motebie omonene oino ng’a Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Tobaisa kwoboa ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio kwaigure abasomba b’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri batebire na kondama.
english: Isaiah said to them, "Tell your master, 'This is what the LORD says: Do not be afraid of what you have heard-- those words with which the underlings of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

ekegusii: Ish-Bosheth did not dare to say another word to Abner, because he was afraid of him.
english: Na Isi‐Boseti tanyara koiraneria Abineri ring’ana nonya nerimo, ekiagera amoirogete.

ekegusii: Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, konya okoorire emiaka emerongo ene ekero abegetwe koba omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli; akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka ebere. Korende abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda bakaba bakobwatia Daudi.
english: Ish-Bosheth son of Saul was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he reigned two years. The house of Judah, however, followed David.

ekegusii: Naende Isumaeli agaita Abayahudi bonsi barenge amo na Gedalia agwo Misipa, agaita nabarwani esegi b’Abakalidayo abwo banyorekanete bare aase agwo.
english: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, as well as the Babylonian soldiers who were there.

ekegusii: Erio Isumaeli akaira ase obosomba abanto batigarete agwo Misipa, akaira nabaiseke b’omoruoti, na abanto bonsi batigarete, abwo Nebusaradani, omochiki bw’abarendi, atigete ase okoboko kwa Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu. Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, akabaira ase obosomba, akagenda gochia ase ense y’Abaamoni.
english: Ishmael made captives of all the rest of the people who were in Mizpah-- the king's daughters along with all the others who were left there, over whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam. Ishmael son of Nethaniah took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, amo nabanto baria ikomi barenge komo, bagatenena bagaaka Gedalia mosinto bw’Ahikamu, mochokoro o Safani, nomoro, bakamoita. (Gedalia oria omoruoti o Babeli konya abekire koba omogambi ase ense eria.)
english: Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men who were with him got up and struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, with the sword, killing the one whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.

ekegusii: Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, agacha korwa Misipa gocha kobarotota okorera. Ekero aumeranete nabarabwo, akabatebia, “Inchuo ase Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu.”
english: Ishmael son of Nethaniah went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went. When he met them, he said, "Come to Gedaliah son of Ahikam."

ekegusii: Isimerai na Isilia, na Yobabu; aba nigo barenge abana abamura b’Elipali.
english: Ishmerai, Izliah and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.

ekegusii: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,
english: Isipani na Eberi, na Elieli,

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo moroche ng’a negento egesinini asemore ng’a Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli obaatananire inwe korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, na kobarenta mobe ang’e nere, na komokorera Omonene ase Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu, na gotenenera omoganda bw’abanto, na kobakorera?
english: Isn't it enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the rest of the Israelite community and brought you near himself to do the work at the LORD's tabernacle and to stand before the community and minister to them?

ekegusii: Inee! Aya namang’ana amagusu asore ng’a gwatorusetie korwa ase ense eria entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, na ogatorenta aa, erinde otoite tokwere aa ase erooro eye? Na bono aye nigo ogwekora koba omonene igoro asetore?
english: Isn't it enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the desert? And now you also want to lord it over us?

ekegusii: Isn't this the carpenter? Isn't this Mary's son and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas and Simon? Aren't his sisters here with us?" And they took offense at him.
english: Oyo tari oria omobaachi, omwana o Mariamu, momura omwabo Yakobo, na Yose, na Yuda, na Simion, na basubati bamwabo tibari aiga seito?” Bakagechigwa nere.

ekegusii: Inee! Egekombe eke mwaibete, tai kerokio omonene one akonywera? Naende nakio agokorera oboringoria. Mwakorire bobe ase ogokora iga.”
english: Isn't this the cup my master drinks from and also uses for divination? This is a wicked thing you have done.'"

ekegusii: Inee! Daudi tari ere oria abakungu baterete igoro yaye kobagotenga, bakabora: Saulo oitire chilifu chiaye, korende Daudi oitire chilifu chiaye emerongo na emerongo.”
english: Isn't this the David they sang about in their dances: "'Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands'?"

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakeroberia ase okorwana na Abafilisti boigo, na emeganda eyio ebere nigo yarigereranetie.
english: Israel and the Philistines were drawing up their lines facing each other.

ekegusii: Israeli akababoria, “Ninki mwankorera igo na gonchanda, goika mogatebia omonto oria ng’a mokare noyomino onde inka?”
english: Israel asked, "Why did you bring this trouble on me by telling the man you had another brother?"

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira emechie yonsi y’Abaamori, bakaira na Hesiboni, erio bakamenya ase emechie eyio amo nebichie bi’emechie eyio.
english: Israel captured all the cities of the Amorites and occupied them, including Heshbon and all its surrounding settlements.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli nigo bakorera asende, kera oyomo oteba: Aye Nyasae one, intwe Abaisraeli ntokomanyete.
english: Israel cries out to me, 'O our God, we acknowledge you!'

ekegusii: “Abaisraeli bebire Omotongi obo, baagachire chinyomba chi’obonene, na Abayuda baagachire emechie emenge egiteire chindwaki, korende nindete omorero ase emechie eyio, na oro nosambe amaagacho abo bagwekengera.”
english: Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; Judah has fortified many towns. But I will send fire upon their cities that will consume their fortresses."

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakorire ebibe. Basaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania okwo nabachigete ng’a babwate. Barusirie ebinto biragereirie. Baibire, batebire oborimo, babisire ebinto ebio ase egati y’ebiabo.
english: Israel has sinned; they have violated my covenant, which I commanded them to keep. They have taken some of the devoted things; they have stolen, they have lied, they have put them with their own possessions.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bamerirwe. Bono nigo bare ase egati y’ebisaku babarire koba buna egekorero getagwenereti kende.
english: Israel is swallowed up; now she is among the nations like a worthless thing.

ekegusii: Erio Israeli akaimoka, akagenda, agatenenia eema yaye ng’umbu y’omorobiri o Ederi.
english: Israel moved on again and pitched his tent beyond Migdal Eder.

ekegusii: Erio Israeli agatebia Yusufu, “Tinasemeretie ng’a kaa ninche korora obosio bwao naende, na bono Nyasae onyancheire narorire abana bao nabarabwo,”
english: Israel said to Joseph, "I never expected to see your face again, and now God has allowed me to see your children too."

ekegusii: Israeli agatebia Yusufu, “Bono tiga inkwe, ekiagera nakororire obosio bwao, naende narorire ng’a moyo ore.”
english: Israel said to Joseph, "Now I am ready to die, since I have seen for myself that you are still alive."

ekegusii: Korwa aroro agwo Abasiraeli bagatoma abanto ase Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori bakwane nere, bamoborie,
english: Israel sent messengers to say to Sihon king of the Amorites:

ekegusii: Ase amatuko a Yoshua Abaisraeli bakaba bagokorera Omonene, naende bagakora boigo ase amatuko ’abagaaka baria batigarete nyuma y’ogokwa kwa Yoshua, abwo bamanyete amang’ana aya Omonene akorete ase Abaisraeli.
english: Israel served the LORD throughout the lifetime of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him and who had experienced everything the LORD had done for Israel.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli nigo banga buna omosabibu okororekana ore omuya mono okwama amasabibu. Buna koreng’ana okwama kwabo kwamentekanete, naboigo bagendererete koagacha ebisasimero ebinge; na buna bagendererete gotenenka, naboigo bagendererete gotenenia chisiiro bagosasima.
english: Israel was a spreading vine; he brought forth fruit for himself. As his fruit increased, he built more altars; as his land prospered, he adorned his sacred stones.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, nigo mwaatananetwe koba abachenu asende inche Omonene, ogotongora gw’okwama kwane. Abanto bonsi abariete ogotongora okwo nigo babete nokomocha; amabe nigo abanyorete. Nabo inche Omonene ngoteba.”
english: Israel was holy to the LORD, the firstfruits of his harvest; all who devoured her were held guilty, and disaster overtook them,'" declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli batasang’anaine n’Ababenjamin, bakaroberia abanto chilifu amagana ane babogoretie emioro; abanto aba nigo bamanyete korwana esegi.
english: Israel, apart from Benjamin, mustered four hundred thousand swordsmen, all of them fighting men.

ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli bagaita abanto abange nemioro, bakaira ense ya Sihoni, korwa orooche rw’Arinoni goika orooche rwa Yaboki ase ense y’Abaamoni. Ribebe ri’Abaamoni nigo riarendire ne chinguru.
english: Israel, however, put him to the sword and took over his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, but only as far as the Ammonites, because their border was fortified.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli korwa egesaku kia Nafutali na egi’Aseri, amo nekia Manase gionsi bakarangerigwa gocha amo kobwatia Abamidiani.
english: Israelites from Naphtali, Asher and all Manasseh were called out, and they pursued the Midianites.

ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’Abaisraeli bwababereire kirori. Nonya naboigo, tibari komoiranera Omonene, Nyasae obo, gose komorigia.
english: Israel's arrogance testifies against him, but despite all this he does not return to the LORD his God or search for him.

ekegusii: Oboenenu bw’Abaisraeli nigo bobaberete kirori. Abaisraeli na Abaefraimu mbagochwe bagwe ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, na Abayuda mbagwe amo nabarabwo.
english: Israel's arrogance testifies against them; the Israelites, even Ephraim, stumble in their sin; Judah also stumbles with them.

ekegusii: Abarendi b’abanto aba nigo bare emeuko, bonsi pi tibari nokomanya, bonsi nigo bare chisese chinkubu chitanyare gokoga; nigo chiraire inse chikorota, chianchete obogondereria.
english: Israel's watchmen are blind, they all lack knowledge; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they lie around and dream, they love to sleep.

ekegusii: Issachar, Zebulun and Benjamin;
english: Isakaru na Sabuloni, na Benjamin;

ekegusii: Obogare bw’aase aria atichire nigo bwareng’aine nobwe rikere ri’amaagacho are biita. Aase aria atichire nigo arenge aase are inse.
english: It abutted the sides of the gateways and was as wide as they were long; this was the lower pavement.

ekegusii: amo nemechie na ebichie barabwo baatananeretwe, ebiarenge ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Manase.
english: It also included all the towns and their villages that were set aside for the Ephraimites within the inheritance of the Manassites.

ekegusii: Naende ekabwaterania Gileadi na orogongo rw’Abagesuri na orw’Abamaaka, amo negetunwa gionsi kia Herimoni, na Basani yonsi goika Saleka,
english: It also included Gilead, the territory of the people of Geshur and Maacah, all of Mount Hermon and all Bashan as far as Salecah--

ekegusii: Obwanchani nigo bokoremereria onsi, bwegena onsi, bosemeria onsi, bobogoria onsi.
english: It always protects, always trusts, always hopes, always perseveres.

ekegusii: Emegati eyio nigo erabe eya Haroni amo nabamura baye, na barabwo nabayeriere aase achenire, ekiagera nemechenu mono, ebe egetari kiabo botambe gi’okoruegwa okwo kogosambwa nomorero asende.”
english: It belongs to Aaron and his sons, who are to eat it in a holy place, because it is a most holy part of their regular share of the offerings made to the LORD by fire."

ekegusii: Tibokogorwa chitahabu, gose chifeta tichikorengwa koba rigori riaye.
english: It cannot be bought with the finest gold, nor can its price be weighed in silver.

ekegusii: Tibokoreng’anigwa ne chitahabu chikorwa Ofiri, gose namagena e rigori rinene akorokwa oiniki na safiro.
english: It cannot be bought with the gold of Ophir, with precious onyx or sapphires.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagoaka chinkobi igoro yaye, bamoseria neriogi ri’okomwogerera, orua aase aye.”
english: It claps its hands in derision and hisses him out of his place.

ekegusii: Omwana oyio okwete nigo achete egento bosa, naende nigo akogenda gochia ase omosunte, na omosunte oyio otuba erieta riaye.
english: It comes without meaning, it departs in darkness, and in darkness its name is shrouded.

ekegusii: Ime yaye nigo biarengeo ebisaku bionsi bie ching’iti chire namagoro ane, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, na echikwagura, ne chinyoni chia igoro.
english: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals, as well as reptiles of the earth and birds of the air.

ekegusii: rogaeta sugusu y’esagamo ere igoro y’Ekerubo Ekiomo, naende rogatirimboka goika Ekerubo keria Ekiomo.
english: It continued to the northern slope of Beth Arabah and on down into the Arabah.

ekegusii: Naki amaguta aya anga naoonigwa chidinari amagana atato na kobua, abataka baegwe.” Bakamwemurunganeria omokungu oria mono.
english: It could have been sold for more than a year's wages and the money given to the poor." And they rebuked her harshly.

ekegusii: Ase igo, tari ng’a nigo ere ase ogwancha kw’omonto, gose nokw’oria ogokora omokia, korende nokw’oria okororera amabera, nere Nyasae.
english: It does not, therefore, depend on man's desire or effort, but on God's mercy.

ekegusii: Oborwaire mbokoore risankwa ri’omobere oye, oborwaire obotang’ani bw’amakweri mbogundie ebiimo biaye.
english: It eats away parts of his skin; death's firstborn devours his limbs.

ekegusii: emeri yaye nigo egwesiserania ase etui y’amagena; buna eyekwemigereria ase egati y’amagena ’egetare.
english: it entwines its roots around a pile of rocks and looks for a place among the stones.

ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo yachakerete korwa Aroeri, ang’e ne rigoko ri’Arinoni, na omochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko riria, ekabwaterania nense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, korwa Medeba goika Diboni,
english: It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and included the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon,

ekegusii: Naki igo nagogete mono ekero abaminto bachete bagantebia igoro y’obwegenwa bwao ore nabwo ase ekeene, na buna ogendererete ase ekeene.
english: It gave me great joy to have some brothers come and tell about your faithfulness to the truth and how you continue to walk in the truth.

ekegusii: Orogunchara orwo rogakina mono, rogaika ase emeganda ya igoro, rokaiyeria emeganda ende ne ching’enang’eni gocha inse aa, rogachitiringerao.
english: It grew until it reached the host of the heavens, and it threw some of the starry host down to the earth and trampled on them.

ekegusii: Omochie oyio nigo orenge norwaki oronene, orotambe, ore nebiita ikomi na bibere. Ase ebiita biria mbarengeo abamalaika ikomi na babere, na amarieta ’ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli arikire aroro.
english: It had a great, high wall with twelve gates, and with twelve angels at the gates. On the gates were written the names of the twelve tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: Korende omosabibu oyio konya osimekirwe ase riroba ritobu, ase amache amange arenge, erinde onyare gosokia chinsagia, bwame amasabibu na obe omosabibu omuya.
english: It had been planted in good soil by abundant water so that it would produce branches, bear fruit and become a splendid vine.'

ekegusii: Ere nigo aorokereretigwe n’Omoika Omochenu, ng’a takorora amakweri atararora Kristo bw’Omonene.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he would not die before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

ekegusii: Nigo abete buna omonto oria o Nyasae atebetie omoruoti, “Engaki buna eye ankio agwo ase egeita gia Samaria obosie bw’esairi ebitita bine na bioonigwe ase esekeli eyemo, na obosie obonuke bw’engano ebitita bibere ase esekeli eyemo.”
english: It happened as the man of God had said to the king: "About this time tomorrow, a seah of flour will sell for a shekel and two seahs of barley for a shekel at the gate of Samaria."

ekegusii: Naboigo nakorete omokia one korandia enchili, korende tari aase erieta ria Kristo riaikire koigugwa, erinde timbaisa koagacha ase oboroso bw’omonto onde,
english: It has always been my ambition to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else's foundation.

ekegusii: Inche nabeire nkwerosia ngokora emeremo bosa. Oboboosu bw’enyongo eyio tibokoruao neisa gosambwa nomorero.
english: It has frustrated all efforts; its heavy deposit has not been removed, not even by fire.

ekegusii: Nagokire mono ekiagera narorire abande ase abana bao bagendererete ase ekeene, buna Tata atochikerete.
english: It has given me great joy to find some of your children walking in the truth, just as the Father commanded us.

ekegusii: It has laid waste my vines and ruined my fig trees. It has stripped off their bark and thrown it away, leaving their branches white.
english: Giasaririe emesabibu yane, kiabunire emeko yane; kiayesaboire, na gotuguta amasabo inse, ne chinsagia chi’emete eyio chiarabire se.

ekegusii: Ayio tabwati omogambi, gose omoteneneri, gose omoraai,
english: It has no commander, no overseer or ruler,

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akomoruta emegwe atari namabera, nere otama bokong’u korua ase okoboko kwaye.
english: It hurls itself against him without mercy as he flees headlong from its power.

ekegusii: Emechie banyorete ase omwando obo nero: Beeri‐Seba, na Seba, na Molada,
english: It included: Beersheba (or Sheba), Moladah,

ekegusii: obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma obokoro bogendererete ase engaki entambe ase risankwa ri’omobere bw’omonto oria. Omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti; bono tamobeka ase egesomo, ekiagera tachenegeti.
english: it is a chronic skin disease and the priest shall pronounce him unclean. He is not to put him in isolation, because he is already unclean.

ekegusii: Okogwa ase amaboko a Nyasae ore moyo, eri nering’ana ri’okondokia.
english: It is a dreadful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

ekegusii: Boigo nigo kware koba omorero ogosamba gochia aase ay’ogosiria na koria ebinto biane bionsi kobikoora.”
english: It is a fire that burns to Destruction; it would have uprooted my harvest.

ekegusii: Ekio nekeng’wanso gi’okomocha. Omonto oria nigo arenge nokomocha ase obosio bw’Omonene.”
english: It is a guilt offering; he has been guilty of wrongdoing against the LORD."

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo agwechandera ense eyio. Amaiso ’Omonene, Nyasae oino, botambe nigo ayerigereretie korwa omochakano bw’omwaka na goika omoerio oye.
english: It is a land the LORD your God cares for; the eyes of the LORD your God are continually on it from the beginning of the year to its end.

ekegusii: Rituko erio naribe asemore rituko ri’Esabato, rituko ri’ogotimoka kegima, na inwe namweng’ate na gweitia. Ase rituko ria kianda ase omotienyi oyio, chinsa chia mogoroba, mochake korenda Esabato yaino, na mogenderere goika omogoroba onde.”
english: It is a sabbath of rest for you, and you must deny yourselves. From the evening of the ninth day of the month until the following evening you are to observe your sabbath."

ekegusii: Rituko erio naribe richenu mono asemore, rituko ri’ogotimoka, na inwe namweng’ate. Oyio nomoroberio ochikirwe oragenderere botambe.
english: It is a sabbath of rest, and you must deny yourselves; it is a lasting ordinance.

ekegusii: Nigo ekoba omoeto ase omonto karabe omwango ase ogwatanana egento kebe egechenu, na nyuma yaye oba okorengereria aya arierete eira.
english: It is a trap for a man to dedicate something rashly and only later to consider his vows.

ekegusii: Amang’ana akwanirwe kera aase ng’a obotomani mbore ase egati yaino, naende obotomani buna obwo tibwana kororekana nonya nase abanto b’Ebisaku, ng’a oyomo oino namenyaine na moga ise,
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and of a kind that does not occur even among pagans: A man has his father's wife.

ekegusii: Haroni ninki aisaine inwe mwamwemurunganeirie mamincha yaye? Ase ayio, mwerende, aye amo na bonsi abagokobwatia. Igo mwasangererekanire mamincha y’Omonene.”
english: It is against the LORD that you and all your followers have banded together. Who is Aaron that you should grumble against him?"

ekegusii: Mang’ana taiyo. Ase ayio nigo ngoteba: Ere nigo agosiria omonyaboronge na omokori amabe amo.
english: It is all the same; that is why I say, 'He destroys both the blameless and the wicked.'

ekegusii: Naende nigo anga buna riime ria Herimoni, rigotonya igoro y’ebitunwa bia Sayoni. Aroro agwo Omonene ochikire ogosesenigwa na obogima botari nomoerio.
english: It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the LORD bestows his blessing, even life forevermore.

ekegusii: Sayoni, egetunwa kia Nyasae egeseera, keimokererete igoro agwo sugusu, nigo kere omogoko bw’ense engima; omochie oyio noyo bw’omoruoti omonene.
english: It is beautiful in its loftiness, the joy of the whole earth. Like the utmost heights of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the Great King.

ekegusii: Korende nogokora kwa Nyasae, ng’a inwe imore ime ase Kristo Yesu, oyo Nyasae akorete koba obong’aini bwaito na oboronge bwaito, naende ogochenwa gwaito na okoboorigwa gwaito.
english: It is because of him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God-- that is, our righteousness, holiness and redemption.

ekegusii: Nigo erabe buya mono ekero oratebigwe, “Inchuo gocha aa”, kobua gokoiranigwa gochia goikaransa nyuma ribaga ri’abanto abasike.
english: it is better for him to say to you, "Come up here," than for him to humiliate you before a nobleman. What you have seen with your eyes

ekegusii: Mbuya gotaria enyama, nonya nkonywa edivai, gose gokora gento kende gionsi keragoche oyomino.
english: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything else that will cause your brother to fall.

ekegusii: Mbuya toria eira kobua koria eira na toyeikerania.
english: It is better not to vow than to make a vow and not fulfill it.

ekegusii: Mbuya kogenda ase enyomba y’ebirero kobua kogenda ase enyomba y’omoyega bw’okwegokia, ekiagera oyio noro omoerio o kera omonto, na abare moyo mbabeke amang’ana aya ase chinkoro chiabo.
english: It is better to go to a house of mourning than to go to a house of feasting, for death is the destiny of every man; the living should take this to heart.

ekegusii: Mbuya omonto gotegerera ogotogonyerwa kw’omonto omong’aini kobua gotegerera ogotera kw’abariri.
english: It is better to heed a wise man's rebuke than to listen to the song of fools.

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya komotamera Omonene, kobua gosemeria mwanyabanto.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya komotamera Omonene kobua gosemeria abagambi.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.

ekegusii: Naki mbuya gochandwa ase ogokora amaya kobua gochandwa ase ogokora amabe, onye gokoba ogwancha kwa Nyasae.
english: It is better, if it is God's will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

ekegusii: “Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Rora, amang’ana ayio ngocha are, aikeranigwe ase rituko riria nakwanete ng’a ayio nabe.
english: It is coming! It will surely take place, declares the Sovereign LORD. This is the day I have spoken of.

ekegusii: Eting’ana goika echaborwe chianga eirwe; abaiseke baye abasomba nigo bakorera na kweumia buna amaruma, bagoaka‐aka ebikuba biabo.
english: It is decreed that [the city] be exiled and carried away. Its slave girls moan like doves and beat upon their breasts.

ekegusii: Naororo engamia goeta ase ekebao gi’esindani kobua omonda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Korende naango kobua igoro na ense goeta, kobua enuguta eyemo y’amachiko korua aroro.
english: It is easier for heaven and earth to disappear than for the least stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.

ekegusii: Yamoisanire omworokigwa koba buna omworokia oye, na omosomba buna omonene oye. Inee! Onye barogete omonyene enyomba Beelizebuli, tibakoroka baria b’enyomba yaye bo kobua ere?
english: It is enough for the student to be like his teacher, and the servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebub, how much more the members of his household!

ekegusii: Korende mbuya botambe korigia omokia ase ring’ana rire rigiya, na tari ekero inde amo nainwe rioka.
english: It is fine to be zealous, provided the purpose is good, and to be so always and not just when I am with you.

ekegusii: Togwenereti riroba gose etui; abanto nigo bakoyotuguta isiko. Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile; it is thrown out. "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

ekegusii: Kristo agatosibora, erinde tomenye ase obosibore; gaki tenena bokong’u, timobwatwa naende ase obosibwa bw’obosomba.
english: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free. Stand firm, then, and do not let yourselves be burdened again by a yoke of slavery.

ekegusii: Nyasae nere eburi yane ye chinguru, nigo akoraa omonto omoronge ase enchera agoeta.
english: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way perfect.

ekegusii: Nyasae nere okomboyia chinguru na kondenda ase enchera yane.
english: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way perfect.

ekegusii: Naki oko nakwo ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ng’a mobe abachenu, na mweatanane korwa ase obotomani.
english: It is God's will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality;

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ase omonto okobogoria rikorogoto ekero are omoke.
english: It is good for a man to bear the yoke while he is young.

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ng’a obwate ring’ana eri erimo, na totiga neria kabere, ekiagera omonto omoirogete Nyasae namanye eki agokora ase kera ring’ana.
english: It is good to grasp the one and not let go of the other. The man who fears God will avoid all [extremes].

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya ase omonto okoba nobotoereru na koganya ogotooreka gokorwa ase Omonene.
english: it is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ee, ere naagache Hekalu y’Omonene, abe omoruoti osikire, aikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti. Naende nere orabe omokuani ase ekerogo kiaye; na abwo babere mbaigwane babe bakogamba amang’ana ay’omorembe.
english: It is he who will build the temple of the LORD, and he will be clothed with majesty and will sit and rule on his throne. And he will be a priest on his throne. And there will be harmony between the two.'

ekegusii: Nigo bobisire korwa ase amaiso ’ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo; ee, nigo botubire chinyoni tichiborora.
english: It is hidden from the eyes of every living thing, concealed even from the birds of the air.

ekegusii: Ninche natongete ense, ngatonga na abanto, nkababeka aroro; amaboko aane naro aramborete igoro, erio ngachika erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni, kera ekemo kebeere aase aye.
english: It is I who made the earth and created mankind upon it. My own hands stretched out the heavens; I marshaled their starry hosts.

ekegusii: Abwo baikire konyora omobaso, na koigwa ekeegwa gekorwa igoro, na babeire ababwatani b’Omoika Omochenu,
english: It is impossible for those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, who have shared in the Holy Spirit,

ekegusii: Naende buna Isaya atang’anete gokwana. “Onye Omonene bw’Emeganda atatotigerete oroiboro, nanga nigo twabete buna Sodomu, na koreng’anigwa na Gomora.”
english: It is just as Isaiah said previously: "Unless the Lord Almighty had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah."

ekegusii: Mboreng’anie nentetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi omonto abogoretie, akayesimeka ase omogondo oye; egakina, ekaba omote. Chinyoni chia igoro chikaroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”
english: It is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air perched in its branches."

ekegusii: Nigo bonga entetere y’omote onga buna omosabisabi, ekero egosimekwa ase amaroba nenke kobua chimbusuro chionsi ase ense,
english: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest seed you plant in the ground.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo anga buna amaguta akweakwa are amaya mono, akonyororoka gochia ase chinderu chia Haroni, aitekera omokoba bwe rigoti ri’eganchwa yaye.
english: It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard, running down on Aaron's beard, down upon the collar of his robes.

ekegusii: Igo boreng’anirie nememera omokungu abogoretie, akayebeka ase ebirengo bitato bi’obosie, goika bionsi bikabota.”
english: It is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into a large amount of flour until it worked all through the dough."

ekegusii: Omote oria gokinire nigo okoba chinko chi’omonto oria; ere nigo akonyonacha ekeng’ese outera omorero agwota na korugera endagera, na ekeng’ese kende okebacha kiaba enyasae agosasima, nigo gekoba omogwekano ere oba okoyosasima.
english: It is man's fuel for burning; some of it he takes and warms himself, he kindles a fire and bakes bread. But he also fashions a god and worships it; he makes an idol and bows down to it.

ekegusii: Egesiomba nekiane, ninche ndaakane, kegachire goika amagoro abo atererigwe, ekiagera rituko ri’emechando yabo riaikire ang’e, na ogosirigwa kwabo nigo kogocha bwango.
english: It is mine to avenge; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; their day of disaster is near and their doom rushes upon them."

ekegusii: Inche narorire ng’a mbuya ing’orokie ebimanyererio na amakumia Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono ankoreire.”
english: It is my pleasure to tell you about the miraculous signs and wonders that the Most High God has performed for me.

ekegusii: Tari ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae ndiasinyire goikeranigwa. Naki tari bonsi abare ab’egesaku ki’Abaisraeli bare Abaisraeli b’ekene;
english: It is not as though God's word had failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.

ekegusii: Inwe timori gochia koira ense eria yabo ekiagera more abanyene oboronge, gose ab’ekeene ase chinkoro chiaino. Taibo! Korende obobe bw’ebisaku ebio nabwo bwagerire Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabaserie korwa ase amasio aino, crinde anyare goikerania eira ariete na gotiana ase chisokoro chiaino, Ibrahimu, na Isaka na Yakobo.
english: It is not because of your righteousness or your integrity that you are going in to take possession of their land; but on account of the wickedness of these nations, the LORD your God will drive them out before you, to accomplish what he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

ekegusii: Tari buya omonto omoriri amenye ase obogima bw’okwegokia; onye ere bo, tari buya omosomba agambere abagambi nonya ng’ake.
english: It is not fitting for a fool to live in luxury-- how much worse for a slave to rule over princes!

ekegusii: It is not good to be partial to the wicked or to deprive the innocent of justice.
english: Tari buya gwanchereria omokori amabe na gosaria ekina ki’omonyene oboronge.

ekegusii: Tari buya koria obooke obonge, na abwo bakwerigeria obonene, obonene bwabo nigo borabe bosa.
english: It is not good to eat too much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one's own honor.

ekegusii: Tari buya omonto aborwe okomanya ase omoyo oye, na oyore namagoro amaango, nigo agosira.
english: It is not good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty and miss the way.

ekegusii: Tari buya korua egesusuro ase omonto omoronge, boigo tari buya goaka abanto abasike ase engencho y’oboronge bwabo.
english: It is not good to punish an innocent man, or to flog officials for their integrity.

ekegusii: Bono tari ng’a nabanto b’emiaka emenge bare abang’aini, gose tari ng’a nabagotu bamanyete ayare boronge.
english: It is not only the old who are wise, not only the aged who understand what is right.

ekegusii: tibokomocha koba nogosika, tibokorigia ayare ayaye, tibori kobeeigwa, tibori kobara amabe;
english: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no record of wrongs.

ekegusii: Ase ayio tari ring’ana rigeni ng’a abasomba baye nabarabwo bakweonchora bekora buna abasomba b’oboronge. Omoerio obo nobe koreng’ana nemeremo yabo.
english: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will be what their actions deserve.

ekegusii: Abakure tibari gotogia Omonene, na ase abwo bagendire aase aakiriru onde tari okomotogia.
english: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, those who go down to silence;

ekegusii: Naki tari inse y’abamalaika Nyasae abegete ense eria egochi‐gocha, eyio togokwana.
english: It is not to angels that he has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.

ekegusii: Tigokari aaria igoro, erinde moborie: Ning’o oranyare koriina gochia aaria igoro agotorentere korwa aroro, erinde tokoigwe na kogokora?
english: It is not up in heaven, so that you have to ask, "Who will ascend into heaven to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"

ekegusii: Igo bore boronge asende korengereria aya igoro asemore mwensi, ekiagera nababogoirie inwe ase enkoro yane ime. Naki ase ogosibwa kwane na ase emeremo y’okorwanerera enchili na koyeorokia ng’a ero nechinguru, na inwe mwensi mwabwatanire nainche ase obuya obo naeirwe.
english: It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart; for whether I am in chains or defending and confirming the gospel, all of you share in God's grace with me.

ekegusii: Omobere o mwanyabanto osimekwa, korende omobere bw’omoika obokigwa. Onye omobere o mwanyabanto oreo, naboigo noyo bw’omoika noreo.
english: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

ekegusii: Osimekwa ase obosooku, obokigwa ase obonene; osimekwa ase oboreu, obokigwa ase chinguru.
english: it is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;

ekegusii: Nigo bore obonene bwa Nyasae kobisa amang’ana; korende nobonene bw’abaruoti gokora obotuki ase amang’ana.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.

ekegusii: Korende Abalawi barabwo nigo barakore emeremo ase Eema y’Oniosangererekano, okomocha kw’ebibe gokorabeo nakobarwe igoro asebare. Okwo nakwo korabe ogochika asebare kogenderera ebiaare ase ebiaare. Barabwo tibakoba nomwando ase egati y’Abaisraeli.
english: It is the Levites who are to do the work at the Tent of Meeting and bear the responsibility for offenses against it. This is a lasting ordinance for the generations to come. They will receive no inheritance among the Israelites.

ekegusii: Mobwatie Omonene, Nyasae oino, na momoiroke. Mobwate amachiko aye na moigwere eriogi riaye, momokorere na komobwatia.
english: It is the LORD your God you must follow, and him you must revere. Keep his commands and obey him; serve him and hold fast to him.

ekegusii: Naama! Omonene Nyasae nankonye; monto ki oranyare konachera ekina ng’a nomomochi inde? Rora, abwo bonsi nabagote buna eanga, mbariegwe buna eanga ekoriegwa nebigwankwa.
english: It is the Sovereign LORD who helps me. Who is he that will condemn me? They will all wear out like a garment; the moths will eat them up.

ekegusii: Engaki yaikire aye Omonene ogwenerete gokora ogokora kwao, ekiagera basaririe amachiko ao.
english: It is time for you to act, O LORD; your law is being broken.

ekegusii: Nigo are amasikani ase omonto ogwetanga korwa ase eriomana, korende kera omonto ore omoriri nigo akona‐kwomana.
english: It is to a man's honor to avoid strife, but every fool is quick to quarrel.

ekegusii: Egesembe keria kebe keringire rimo. Obotambe bwaye bobe chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo.
english: It is to be square-- a span long and a span wide-- and folded double.

ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye bobe obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo, na obogare bwaye okoboko okomo; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chibe chireng’aine; na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro bobe amaboko abere. Emegwekano yaye ye chingunchara nigo eraroisigwe ebe egento ekemo negesasimero.
english: It is to be square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high--its horns of one piece with it.

ekegusii: Ere natware ebuku eyio abe ogosoma amachiko ayio onsi ase amatuko ’obogima bwaye bwonsi, erio neorokererie komoiroka Omonene, Nyasae oye, na korenda amang’ana onsi ay’ogochika okwo na ay’emeroberio echikire, na koyakora.
english: It is to be with him, and he is to read it all the days of his life so that he may learn to revere the LORD his God and follow carefully all the words of this law and these decrees

ekegusii: Egesibao ekio ki’obokuani kebe nebitwanga bibere bi’amareko, aase gekobwateranigwa.
english: It is to have two shoulder pieces attached to two of its corners, so it can be fastened.

ekegusii: Abande nigo bakorandia Kristo bare nemoko na eriomana, korende abande ase omoyo omuya,
english: It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.

ekegusii: It is unthinkable that God would do wrong, that the Almighty would pervert justice.
english: Ekeene, Nyasae tagokora ayare amabe; ee, ere Omonguru tari gosaria ayare ay’ekeene.

ekegusii: Korende intwe ntogenderere gotogia Omonene, korwa bono goika kare na kare. Motogie Omonene!
english: it is we who extol the LORD, both now and forevermore. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende omonto karagende botuko, igo akogochwa, ekiagera omobaso tori ime yaye.”
english: It is when he walks by night that he stumbles, for he has no light."

ekegusii: buna erikire ase ebuku y’omobani Isaya. “Rora, natomire omotomwa one agotang’anere, oyo oraroisie enchera yao;
english: It is written in Isaiah the prophet: "I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way"--

ekegusii: Nerikire nababani: Bonsi naborokererigwe na Nyasae. Kera oyoigure na kworokererigwa na Tata, nigo agocha asende.
english: It is written in the Prophets: 'They will all be taught by God.' Everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him comes to me.

ekegusii: Naki nerikire, “Omonene otebire: Amaene buna inde moyo, kera riru naribekwe inse ase obosio bwane, na kera oromeme naromobere Nyasae kirori.”
english: It is written: "'As surely as I live,' says the Lord, 'every knee will bow before me; every tongue will confess to God.'"

ekegusii: Naboigo naintwe, ekiagera tore nomoika oria oria bw’okwegena buna erikire, “Negenete, na ase engencho eyio ngakwana”, igo twegenire, na ase engencho eyio nigo togokwana.
english: It is written: "I believed; therefore I have spoken." With that same spirit of faith we also believe and therefore speak,

ekegusii: Naki nabatebirie, eriarigetwe ndigwenerete goikeranigwa asende. Ere nigo abareranetigwe amo nabasaria, ekiagera ayarigetwe igoro asende aikeranigwe.”
english: It is written: 'And he was numbered with the transgressors'; and I tell you that this must be fulfilled in me. Yes, what is written about me is reaching its fulfillment."

ekegusii: Ande Omonene ororire amabe anyorete, nere ang’akane amaya ribaga ri’okoragererigwa okwo kwanyorire rero.”
english: It may be that the LORD will see my distress and repay me with good for the cursing I am receiving today."

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaasuri natoma omochiki oye omonene korama Nyasae ore moyo. Omonene, Nyasae oo, naigwe amang’ana ayio onsi na amoe egesusuro ase ayio. Bono aye sabera abanto batigarete.”
english: It may be that the LORD your God will hear all the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the LORD your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives."

ekegusii: Ande nabo erabe ng’a ekero omoruoti bw’Abaasuri atomete Rabi‐Sake korama Nyasae ore moyo, ere Omonene, Nyasae oino naigwete ayio. Ere nabae egesusuro ase amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio sabera abanto abwo batigarete bare moyo.”
english: It may be that the LORD your God will hear the words of the field commander, whom his master, the king of Assyria, has sent to ridicule the living God, and that he will rebuke him for the words the LORD your God has heard. Therefore pray for the remnant that still survives."

ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ekio keriegwe keere ase rituko erio erio, tigetigara nonya ngesinini goika rituko ria kabere. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: It must be eaten that same day; leave none of it till morning. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Enyomba eria etagorwe, na amagena onsi amo nemete ne rioomo riaye rionsi biimokigwe, bionsi biirwe ase eubi egotugutwa isiko y’omochie.
english: It must be torn down-- its stones, timbers and all the plaster-- and taken out of the town to an unclean place.

ekegusii: Tebaisa koroiseranigwa nememera. Inche nabaeire endagera eyio ebe egetari kiabo gi’okoruegwa kwane kogosambwa nomorero. Ekio negechenu mono koreng’ana buna ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe na egi’okomocha bire.
english: It must not be baked with yeast; I have given it as their share of the offerings made to me by fire. Like the sin offering and the guilt offering, it is most holy.

ekegusii: Dario akarora ng’a mbuya abeke abagambi abanene b’oboruoti rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, babe bakogamba ase oboruoti bwaye bwonsi.
english: It pleased Darius to appoint 120 satraps to rule throughout the kingdom,

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’oboronge bwaye Omonene nigo agogete koa amachiko aye okobua na ogosikwa.
english: It pleased the LORD for the sake of his righteousness to make his law great and glorious.

ekegusii: Nigo rigosoka korwa ensemo eyemo ya igoro, naende riekumba riagenda gochia ensemo ende; gento kende tikeri gekobisekana korwa ase riberera riaye.
english: It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other; nothing is hidden from its heat.

ekegusii: rigotebia omomalaika o gatano na rimo, oyorenge negetureri, “Sibora abamalaika baria bane, abwo basibire ase orooche roria oronene rokorokwa Eufarati.”
english: It said to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."

ekegusii: Iga yarorekanete buya ase Omoika Omochenu amo naintwe, titobatweka egurube ende otatiga eyio egwenerete:
english: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us not to burden you with anything beyond the following requirements:

ekegusii: Chinsagia echio chikaranda chigaikeera Enyancha Enene, na emeseboka yaye gochia ase orooche rw’Eufarati.
english: It sent out its boughs to the Sea, its shoots as far as the River.

ekegusii: Ee, orogunchara roria rogekinia na gwetogia igoro y’Omogambi bw’emeganda eria, rokarusia korwa ase Omogambi oria ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, rogatagora Obomenyo bwaye Obochenu.
english: It set itself up to be as great as the Prince of the host; it took away the daily sacrifice from him, and the place of his sanctuary was brought low.

ekegusii: Chinyama chi’ekengw’anso ekio chiriegwe ase rituko erio erio eng’iti yanyenywa, gose rituko ria kabere, korende echiratigare ase rituko ria gatato chisambwe nomorero.
english: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it or on the next day; anything left over until the third day must be burned up.

ekegusii: Oyio nigo orenge nobonene bwa Nyasae; okomekameka kwaye nigo kwarenge buna rigena rie rigori rinene ria yasipi, rirabu buna ekerore gekomeka‐meka.
english: It shone with the glory of God, and its brilliance was like that of a very precious jewel, like a jasper, clear as crystal.

ekegusii: Gaki, ase ayio ring’ana ndireo, ng’a mbare abanto barache gosoa. Abwo baranderetigwe amang’ana amaya ritang’ani bakamocha gosoa ase engencho y’ogotaigwera kwabo.
english: It still remains that some will enter that rest, and those who formerly had the gospel preached to them did not go in, because of their disobedience.

ekegusii: Omogwekano bw’egento gete ogatenena ase obosio bwane, korende tinanyarete komanya ng’a ngento ki gose nkieni ki; erio nkaigwa eriogi eriororo rigoteba:
english: It stopped, but I could not tell what it was. A form stood before my eyes, and I heard a hushed voice:

ekegusii: Obo nigo bogotworokereria okwanga amang’ana atari ay’obonyasae, na okogania okobe gw’ense eye, erinde tonyare kwerenda ase onsi, na koba noboronge amo ne chingencho chi’obonyasae ase ense eye ya bono,
english: It teaches us to say "No" to ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live self-controlled, upright and godly lives in this present age,

ekegusii: Naende rokagenderera gochia sugusu rogaika Eni‐Semesi, naende goika Geliloti kororia egetirimboko ki’Adumimi. Erio rogatirimboka gochia Rigena ria Bohani, mosinto o Reuben,
english: It then curved north, went to En Shemesh, continued to Geliloth, which faces the Pass of Adummim, and ran down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

ekegusii: rokagenderera gochia Asimoni rokabwatia orooche rw’orobebe rwa Misiri goika Enyancha Enene ase rwatwomerete. Oro narwo orobebe rw’Abayuda, ensemo ya irianyi.
english: It then passed along to Azmon and joined the Wadi of Egypt, ending at the sea. This is their southern boundary.

ekegusii: Erio rokaonchoka gochia moocha, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Dagoni, rogatwomera Sabuloni na ense omweremo ya Ifuta‐Eli, ensemo ya sugusu, rogaika Beti‐Emeki na Neieli. Erio rokagenderera gochia sugusu goika Kabuli,
english: It then turned east toward Beth Dagon, touched Zebulun and the Valley of Iphtah El, and went north to Beth Emek and Neiel, passing Cabul on the left.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo orobebe rokagenderera gochia esagamo ya Beti‐Hogila, rogaika ensemo ya sugusu y’Enyancha y’Omonyo ase orooche rwa Yorodan ronuchete. Oro narwo orobebe rwa irianyi.
english: It then went to the northern slope of Beth Hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan in the south. This was the southern boundary.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaira emiaka ikomi na etato ase okoagacha enyomba yaye omonyene na koyekoora.
english: It took Solomon thirteen years, however, to complete the construction of his palace.

ekegusii: Korwa Saridi rokagenderera goika Kisiloti‐Tabori, naende goika Daberati, erio rogatiira goika Yafia.
english: It turned east from Sarid toward the sunrise to the territory of Kisloth Tabor and went on to Daberath and up to Japhia.

ekegusii: Obonetu bw’etaai yaroiseretigwe egetuba keria nigo bwarenge buna obogare bw’egesanyi gi’okoboko, na omogo okaroisigwa buna oyo bw’egekombe, gose obw’egesicha. Egetuba keria nigo kiarenge kobekwa koira amache aisaine chilita chilifu emerongo etano nomo na isano na ibere, na amagana atano (67,500).
english: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held three thousand baths.

ekegusii: Obonetu bw’etaai yaroiseretigwe egetubwa keria, nigo bwarenge obw’obogare bw’egesanyi gi’okoboko, na omogo okaroisigwa buna oyo bw’egekombe, gose obw’egesicha. Egetuba keria nigo kiarenge kobekwa amache aisaine ang’e chilita chilifu emerongo etano (50,000).
english: It was a handbreadth in thickness, and its rim was like the rim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It held two thousand baths.

ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio Esanduku eria y’Omonene ekabeera agwo Kiriati-Yearimu ase engaki entambe, emiaka emerongo ebere. Ase engaki eyio yonsi, Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba bakorera ase Omonene ng’a abakonye.
english: It was a long time, twenty years in all, that the ark remained at Kiriath Jearim, and all the people of Israel mourned and sought after the LORD.

ekegusii: Nabo ase engaki eria, omoruoti Herode akarambora amaboko aye agachanda abanto bande b’ekanisa.
english: It was about this time that King Herod arrested some who belonged to the church, intending to persecute them.

ekegusii: Naende ekarokwa Misipa, naki nigo atebete, “Omonene nere orabe ogotorigereria aye nainche, ekero torabe totarochaini.
english: It was also called Mizpah, because he said, "May the LORD keep watch between you and me when we are away from each other.

ekegusii: Endamwamu y’Omonene ase Yerusalemu na Abayuda nigo yagerete akabarusia ase obosio bwaye. Zedekia akaanga koigwera omoruoti o Babeli.
english: It was because of the LORD's anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

ekegusii: Ekeene, endamwamu y’Omonene ase Yerusalemu na ase Abayuda nigo yagerete akabarusia ase obosio bwaye. Ase engaki eyio Zedekia akaanga koigwera omoruoti o Babeli.
english: It was because of the LORD's anger that all this happened to Jerusalem and Judah, and in the end he thrust them from his presence. Now Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

ekegusii: Ekiagera inwe timwayebogoretie engaki eria entang’ani, Omonene, Nyasae oito, atoete egesusuro; titwamorigetie buna atochigete.”
english: It was because you, the Levites, did not bring it up the first time that the LORD our God broke out in anger against us. We did not inquire of him about how to do it in the prescribed way."

ekegusii: Abasomba baria na abarwani nigo barenge bateneine, bautete omorero bw’amakara, ekiagera obokendu mbwarenge, bakaba ngwota bare omorero. Petero nere nigo arenge amo nabarabwo, ogwota omorero.
english: It was cold, and the servants and officials stood around a fire they had made to keep warm. Peter also was standing with them, warming himself.

ekegusii: Boigo akarenga obogare bw’egesona keria, borobwo bokaba obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na atato, ne chisiiro chiaye nigo chiarenge echi’ekerengo ki’amaboko abere. Egesona keria nigo kiarochie ase enyomba.
english: it was eight cubits deep and its jambs were two cubits thick. The portico of the gateway faced the temple.

ekegusii: Naki ase engencho y’erieta ria Yeso bagasoka isiko, tibaira gento korwa ase abanto b’Ebisaku.
