english: It was for the sake of the Name that they went out, receiving no help from the pagans.

ekegusii: Amang’ana akarorekana arikire ng’a Moredekai natebete igoro ya Bigitana na Teresi, abasomba babere b’omoruoti, abwo barenge korenda egesieri ki’omoruoti, ng’a mbarigetie goita omoruoti Ahaswero.
english: It was found recorded there that Mordecai had exposed Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's officers who guarded the doorway, who had conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.

ekegusii: Nigo yabete buya mono asende konyora egesusuro keria, ekiagera ayio naro agerete neorokereirie emeroberio yao echikire.
english: It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn your decrees.

ekegusii: Ere akarua abande babe abatomwa, na abande ababani, na abande abarandia, na abande abarisia, na abande aborokia.
english: It was he who gave some to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists, and some to be pastors and teachers,

ekegusii: Hezekia oyo nere oria otichete chintuboka chia rogoro chi’amache a Gihoni, erio akayagoberia gochia ase ensemo ya bosongo y’Omochie o Daudi. Akanyora ogosesenigwa ase emeremo yaye yonsi.
english: It was Hezekiah who blocked the upper outlet of the Gihon spring and channeled the water down to the west side of the City of David. He succeeded in everything he undertook.

ekegusii: Ninche norokereretie Abaefraimu gotaara, nkababogoria namaboko aane, korende abanto abwo tibamanyete ng’a nigo naganetie kobagwenia.
english: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms; but they did not realize it was I who healed them.

ekegusii: Ekero rituko rinene ri’Epasaka ritaraba, Yeso akamanya ng’a ensa yaye yaikire akorua ase ense eye na kogenda ase Ise, akaba nanchete abanto baye abarenge ase ense, naboigo akabancha goika omoerio.
english: It was just before the Passover Feast. Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he now showed them the full extent of his love.

ekegusii: Emiaka eye emeronge ebere imenyete bwoo, nabeire nkogokorera emiaka ikomi na ene ase okonyora abaiseke bao babere, na emiaka etano nomo ase okonyora amaicho ao, na aye kwabeire gokoonchora eng’eria yane ara ikomi.
english: It was like this for the twenty years I was in your household. I worked for you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks, and you changed my wages ten times.

ekegusii: Omote oria okaba omuya mono ase obonene bwaye na ase chinsagia chiaye chintambe, ekiagera emeri yaye yaigete inse ase amache amange arenge.
english: It was majestic in beauty, with its spreading boughs, for its roots went down to abundant waters.

ekegusii: Na baria batebetie abatomwa amang’ana aya nabwo aba: Mariamu Magidalena, na Yoana, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo na abakungu bande abarenge amo nabarabwo.
english: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the others with them who told this to the apostles.

ekegusii: Gaki, yagwenerete emegwekano y’ebinto bire igoro bichenwe ase ebing’wanso buna ebio, korende ebinto bia igoro ebinyene bichenwe nebing’wanso bire ebiya kobua ebi.
english: It was necessary, then, for the copies of the heavenly things to be purified with these sacrifices, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

ekegusii: Abanto bao tibairete ense eria ase okoyerwania nemioro, gose tari chinguru chi’amaboko abo chiabarenterete obobui, korende nokoboko kwao gw’okorio ne chinguru chi’amaboko ao, amo noborabu bwaruete ase obosio bwao, ekiagera aye nigo kwagogetigwe nabarabwo.
english: It was not by their sword that they won the land, nor did their arm bring them victory; it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.

ekegusii: Naki eira eria Ibrahimu aetwe amo noroiboro rwaye ng’a naire omwando bw’ense, tiyarwete ase amachiko korende ase oboronge obwo anyorete ase okwegena.
english: It was not through law that Abraham and his offspring received the promise that he would be heir of the world, but through the righteousness that comes by faith.

ekegusii: Omonene takorete okobwatana okwo ne chisokoro chiaito, korende nigo akorete okobwatana okwo naintwe abanyene, intwe twensi abatore moyo rituko ria rero.
english: It was not with our fathers that the LORD made this covenant, but with us, with all of us who are alive here today.

ekegusii: Momanyete buna Omonene abakorerete, ekero mwarenge ase erooro, goika mogacha aase aa.
english: It was not your children who saw what he did for you in the desert until you arrived at this place,

ekegusii: Bono nigo chiarenge ang’e chinsa isano nemo, omosunte okaba igoro ase ense yonsi goika chinsa kianda,
english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour,

ekegusii: ekiagera chionsi chiaruetwe ase abakori emeremo abarenge koroisia enyomba ase echio.
english: it was paid to the workmen, who used it to repair the temple.

ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, ekiagera nerituko ri’okwebeka ang’e, nario rituko ri’ogotang’anera eri’Esabato,
english: It was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath). So as evening approached,

ekegusii: Nigo riarenge rituko ri’Okwearigania, na Esabato egachaka gosoa.
english: It was Preparation Day, and the Sabbath was about to begin.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaasuri atebigwa ng’a abanto b’ebisaku biria arentete na akabeka ase emechie ya Samaria, tibamanyete amachiko a Nyasae bw’ense eria. Na bono Nyasae oria otomire chindo ase egati yabo, ne chindo chiria chiaitire abanto bande babo, ekiagera tibamanyeti amachiko a Nyasae bw’ense eria.
english: It was reported to the king of Assyria: "The people you deported and resettled in the towns of Samaria do not know what the god of that country requires. He has sent lions among them, which are killing them off, because the people do not know what he requires."

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bamaanoreretwe ng’a babakorere inwe ase amang’ana ayio, gose tari barabwo abanyene. Ayio bono araretigwe asemore nabaria babaranderetie inwe enchili ase Omoika Omochenu, oyotometwe korwa igoro. Amang’ana ayio abamalaika bare namaiga kona‐koyasiomeria.
english: It was revealed to them that they were not serving themselves but you, when they spoke of the things that have now been told you by those who have preached the gospel to you by the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even angels long to look into these things.

ekegusii: Ase ayio okobwatana koria kogasarigwa ase rituko riria, ne ching’ondi chiria chiachandegete, chiria chiansemeretie chikamanya ng’a ring’ana riria riakoretwe nigo riarwete ase Omonene.
english: It was revoked on that day, and so the afflicted of the flock who were watching me knew it was the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: Enyomba nigo yarenge nekerama ki’emecharake igoro y’emiamba yabegetwe ase chisiiro chiria emerongo ene na isano, ikomi na isano ase kera orwaro.
english: It was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the columns-- forty-five beams, fifteen to a row.

ekegusii: Bakaroisia egesembe keria keringire rimo; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge chisentimita emerongo ebere, na ibere, na obogare bwaye boigo. Chinsemo chiaye inye nigo chiarenge chireng’aine.
english: It was square-- a span long and a span wide-- and folded double.

ekegusii: Nigo yarenge Okwearigania kw’Epasaka; naende nigo yarenge koreng’ana chinsa isano nemo. Agatebia Abayahudi, “Rora omoruoti oino!”
english: It was the day of Preparation of Passover Week, about the sixth hour. "Here is your king," Pilate said to the Jews.

ekegusii: Naki Omonene, Nyasae oito, nere otong’anyetie intwe amo ne chisokoro chiaito korwa Misiri, ense eria ase twarenge abasomba. Nere okorete ebikone ebinene ase amasio aito, naende nere otorendete aande onsi twaetete ase egati y’abanto aba bonsi.
english: It was the LORD our God himself who brought us and our fathers up out of Egypt, from that land of slavery, and performed those great signs before our eyes. He protected us on our entire journey and among all the nations through which we traveled.

ekegusii: Engaki eria ase omotienyi o kianda nigo yarenge ey’obokendu, na omoruoti nigo aikaransete ase enyomba amenyete ekero keria, na omorero nigo ore gwoka ase eriko bosio bwaye.
english: It was the ninth month and the king was sitting in the winter apartment, with a fire burning in the firepot in front of him.

ekegusii: Nigo chiare chinsa isato ekero bamobambete.
english: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

ekegusii: It was there that they found Adoni-Bezek and fought against him, putting to rout the Canaanites and Perizzites.
english: Bakanyora Adoni‐Bezeki agwo, bakamorwania, na bakabua Abakanani na Abaperisi.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bambogete Yorodan ase omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, ekero orooche orwo rwaichorete goetania chingegu chinsemo chionsi, bagaseria abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense y’amaranya, ensemo ya moocha na eya bosongo.
english: It was they who crossed the Jordan in the first month when it was overflowing all its banks, and they put to flight everyone living in the valleys, to the east and to the west.

ekegusii: Haroni oria oria amo na Musa nabwo baria Omonene atebetie, “Barusie Abaisraeli ase ense ya Misiri, omoganda ase omoganda.”
english: It was this same Aaron and Moses to whom the LORD said, "Bring the Israelites out of Egypt by their divisions."

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasenyentete emetwe ya Leviatani, eng’iti eria enene y’okwoboyia, erio omobere oye okayoa ching’iti chi’erooro chikayoria.
english: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave him as food to the creatures of the desert.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatubogetie chinsoko ne chindooche; boigo ogasiria amache e chindooche chinene, chigakamoka.
english: It was you who opened up springs and streams; you dried up the ever flowing rivers.

ekegusii: Naye gwachigete aase chimbebe chionsi chi’ense chikobeera, naende ogakora chingaki chie riberera na echi’obokendu.
english: It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth; you made both summer and winter.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatananete enyancha ase okobua kwao, ogasenyenta emetwe ye chinchoka chi’enyancha.
english: It was you who split open the sea by your power; you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.

ekegusii: Korwa Beteli rokagenda Lusu, rogatiira gochia Ataroti ase Abaariki bamenyete.
english: It went on from Bethel (that is, Luz), crossed over to the territory of the Arkites in Ataroth,

ekegusii: na Eburoni, na Rehobu, na Hamoni, na Kana, rogaika Sidoni, Omochie omonene.
english: It went to Abdon, Rehob, Hammon and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon.

ekegusii: Orobebe rokagenderera gochia sugusu ase egetunwa gi’Ekironi, rokaonchoka gochia Sikironi, rokabwatia egetunwa kia Baala, naende rogaika Yabuneli, na omoerio rogaika Enyancha Enene,
english: It went to the northern slope of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, passed along to Mount Baalah and reached Jabneel. The boundary ended at the sea.

ekegusii: Ekiriri nkebeo ki’ogokenderera korwa ase omobaso, naende kebe obotamero na oborendi bw’ogwekengera korwa ase embura y’omoubera.
english: It will be a shelter and shade from the heat of the day, and a refuge and hiding place from the storm and rain.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebio mbibe ekemanyererio na kirori ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, agwo ase ense ya Misiri. Ekero abanto ba Misiri barabe bakorera ase Omonene kobagokorerwa bobe, ere nabatomere omotooria abarwanerere abatoorie.
english: It will be a sign and witness to the LORD Almighty in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, he will send them a savior and defender, and he will rescue them.

ekegusii: Rituko erio ribe ekemanyererio keragenderere egati yane na Abaisraeli, ekiagera ase amatuko atano na rimo inche Omonene natongete igoro na ense, korende ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ngatiga emeremo yane yonsi, na gotimoka.”
english: It will be a sign between me and the Israelites forever, for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day he abstained from work and rested.'"

ekegusii: Orogongo orwo nigo rorabe aase mokoruera okoruegwa ogochenu aatananire korwa ase ensemo eria ere enchenu. Nigo rorabe orochenu mono robebekane norw’Abalawi.
english: It will be a special gift to them from the sacred portion of the land, a most holy portion, bordering the territory of the Levites.

ekegusii: Naribe rituko ritari buna amatuko ande, rimanyekanete n’Omonene, tirikoba omobaso gose obotuko. Ase rituko erio oborabu nabobe ekero kia mogoroba.
english: It will be a unique day, without daytime or nighttime-- a day known to the LORD. When evening comes, there will be light.

ekegusii: Nigo erabe buna ekero omonto agotama korwa ase endo, aumerane nedubu, gose ekero agosoa mwaye atoorera okoboko kwaye ase enyasi, na eng’iti emorome.
english: It will be as though a man fled from a lion only to meet a bear, as though he entered his house and rested his hand on the wall only to have a snake bite him.

ekegusii: Nigo erabe buna ekero omogesi akogesa namaboko aye ebigara bi’endagera eteneine, na buna ekero omonto agochora ebigara bi’endagera ase ense omweremu y’Abarefai.
english: It will be as when a reaper gathers the standing grain and harvests the grain with his arm-- as when a man gleans heads of grain in the Valley of Rephaim.

ekegusii: Omogwekano oyio noirwe Asuri, oegwe omoruoti Yarebu buna ekeegwa. Abaefraimu mbabe nobosooku, na Abaisraeli mbasookigwe boigo ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.
english: It will be carried to Assyria as tribute for the great king. Ephraim will be disgraced; Israel will be ashamed of its wooden idols.

ekegusii: Nkegenderere kobao buna omotienyi, oborori obwo bwa igoro nigo bore obwegenwa.”
english: it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omosomba oria ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.
english: It will be good for that servant whom the master finds doing so when he returns.

ekegusii: Nasesenirie omosomba oria, ekero omonene oye arache amonyore ogokora bo.
english: It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.

ekegusii: Naende karache ase oborendi bwa kabere gose oborendi bwa gatato, abanyore barendete, mbasesenirie abasomba baria.
english: It will be good for those servants whose master finds them ready, even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night.

ekegusii: Mbasesenirie abasomba baria ekero omonene obo agocha abanyore barendete. Ekeene nabatebirie: Neboyie, abaikaransie ase endagera, ache abakorere.
english: It will be good for those servants whose master finds them watching when he comes. I tell you the truth, he will dress himself to serve, will have them recline at the table and will come and wait on them.

ekegusii: Abanto mbamenye Yerusalemu, okoragererigwa tigokobao, ekiagera omochie oyio nigo orabe nobotoereru.
english: It will be inhabited; never again will it be destroyed. Jerusalem will be secure.

ekegusii: Bayotigire ore bosa, na ekiagera otigirwe ore bosa, nkorera ore asende. Ense yonsi yabeire erooro, korende omonto tari okorengereria amang’ana ayio.
english: It will be made a wasteland, parched and desolate before me; the whole land will be laid waste because there is no one who cares.

ekegusii: Haroni ayebogorie ase obosio bwaye igoro. Ase igo abogoreranie na korusia amamocho are nebiegwa ebiraatananwe, ebi Abaisraeli barabe bakoruera Omonene. Haroni nigo arabe okoyebogoria botambe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: It will be on Aaron's forehead, and he will bear the guilt involved in the sacred gifts the Israelites consecrate, whatever their gifts may be. It will be on Aaron's forehead continually so that they will be acceptable to the LORD.

ekegusii: Nigo erabe emeremo y’omogambi arue ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa, ase Amatuko Amanene, na ase emeyega y’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ase Chisabato, engencho yaye Amatuko Amanene achikire ase Abaisraeli. Ere narue ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ase Abaisraeli.”
english: It will be the duty of the prince to provide the burnt offerings, grain offerings and drink offerings at the festivals, the New Moons and the Sabbaths-- at all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He will provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel.

ekegusii: Oboruoti obwo mbobe oboke goetania amaruoti ande onsi. Tibokonyara kweimokereria igoro boetanie ebisaku binde. Nimbokeyie bobe oboke kegima, erinde tibobaisa kogambera ay’ebisaku binde.
english: It will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the other nations. I will make it so weak that it will never again rule over the nations.

ekegusii: Oboremo obwo mbobe ensemo enchenu y’ense eye, bobe obw’abakuani abwo bare abakoreri b’Aase Aachenu bagotenena ase obosio bw’Omonene. Nao baraagache chinyomba chiabo, naende nao arabe aase aachenu ase Hekalu eraagachwe.
english: It will be the sacred portion of the land for the priests, who minister in the sanctuary and who draw near to minister before the LORD. It will be a place for their houses as well as a holy place for the sanctuary.

ekegusii: Amang’ana nayamo arabanyorere abanto bonsi; buna arabe ase abanto, naboigo arabe ase abakuani; buna arabe ase omosomba, naboigo arabe ase omonene oye; buna arabe ase omosomba omokungu, naboigo arabe ase omokungu ore omonene oye; buna arabe ase oyokogora, naboigo arabe ase oyokoonia; buna arabe ase oyokorua singo, naboigo arabe ase oyokoegwa singo; buna arabe ase oyogotura esira, naboigo arabe ase oyogoturwa esira.
english: it will be the same for priest as for people, for master as for servant, for mistress as for maid, for seller as for buyer, for borrower as for lender, for debtor as for creditor.

ekegusii: Narirorio rionchoke ribe orotu, roirurukigwe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, rorente amagumba na amaote amabe, ase mwanyabanto ne chitugo.”
english: It will become fine dust over the whole land of Egypt, and festering boils will break out on men and animals throughout the land."

ekegusii: Ense eyio nebe egetari ki’abatigari b’Abayuda, nao barabe bakorisia chitugo chiabo na korara ase chinyomba chire agwo Asikeloni chingaki chia mogoroba. Omonene, Nyasae obo, nabainyore, abarusie ase obosibwa bwabo.
english: It will belong to the remnant of the house of Judah; there they will find pasture. In the evening they will lie down in the houses of Ashkelon. The LORD their God will care for them; he will restore their fortunes.

ekegusii: Okogwa okwo nkobe buna ogwatwa kw’enyongo y’omokori chinyongo egotinerwa inse, nonya norogio oromo rw’enyongo eyio tirori gotoka omonto araancharere omorero, gose arabuchere amache korwa ase ensoko.”
english: It will break in pieces like pottery, shattered so mercilessly that among its pieces not a fragment will be found for taking coals from a hearth or scooping water out of a cistern."

ekegusii: Nigo erasiche ebisicha ebinge, erio echenge na gotera nomogoko. Neegwe obonene buna obw’ebitunwa bia Lebanoni, na obwari buna obwa Karimeli na Saroni. Abanto mbarore obonene bw’Omonene, ee, mbarore obonene bwa Nyasae oito na obonguru bwaye.
english: it will burst into bloom; it will rejoice greatly and shout for joy. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon; they will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.

ekegusii: Okobwatana okwo tigokoba buna koria nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo, ekero nabarusetie nokoboko kwane korwa ase ense ya Misiri, okwo basaretie nonya inche narenge buna omosacha obo.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: It will not be like the covenant I made with their forefathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they broke my covenant, though I was a husband to them," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Okobwatana oko tigokoba buna koria nakorete ne chisokoro chiabo, ase rituko riria nababwatete amaboko abo ase okobarusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Ekiagera tibagendererete ase okobwatana kwane, inche tinabechanderete, Omonene otebire.
english: It will not be like the covenant I made with their forefathers when I took them by the hand to lead them out of Egypt, because they did not remain faithful to my covenant, and I turned away from them, declares the Lord.

ekegusii: Omorero oyio nogenderere koyia obotuko na omobaso, tokorimigwa; erioki riaye ndichongororoke gochia igoro kogenderera botambe. Ense eyio nebe esaregete ekiaare ase ekiaare; monto onde tari oraete ase egati y’ense eyio nonya ndinde.
english: It will not be quenched night and day; its smoke will rise forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will ever pass through it again.

ekegusii: It will produce thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
english: Riroba narikwamere amagwa na amageri, na aye norie okwama kw’ebimeri bi’orosana.

ekegusii: Obong’aini obwo mbogotoorie korwa ase omokungu onde bwensi omotayayi, oyio ogokwana amang’ana okweansia korwa ase omonwa oye,
english: It will save you also from the adulteress, from the wayward wife with her seductive words,

ekegusii: Korende ase abanto ba Yerusalemu amang’ana ayio nigo ararorekane koba oboringoria bw’oborimo, ekiagera bariereranete eira y’ogotianania. Korende nigo aragere ebibe biabo biinyorwe, erinde babwatwe.
english: It will seem like a false omen to those who have sworn allegiance to him, but he will remind them of their guilt and take them captive.

ekegusii: Anga mbuya kobua ase omonto oria asungerwe orogena rogosia ase rigoti riaye, arutwe enyancha ime, kobua aragere oyomo bw’aba abake akore ebibe.
english: It would be better for him to be thrown into the sea with a millstone tied around his neck than for him to cause one of these little ones to sin.

ekegusii: Naki anga nigo yabete buya onye tibamanyete enchera y’oboronge, kobua koyemanya naende koirana nyuma korwa ase ogochika ogochenu okwo baetwe.
english: It would have been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than to have known it and then to turn their backs on the sacred command that was passed on to them.

ekegusii: Ebio nigo biare ebirito kobua omokenye ore ase enyancha; ase ayio nabeire omwango ase ogokwana ayio.
english: It would surely outweigh the sand of the seas-- no wonder my words have been impetuous.

ekegusii: Itai, mosinto o Ribai korwa Gibea o Benjamin, na Benaya korwa Piratoni;
english: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah in Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

ekegusii: Ebinyomba bi’oborendi ebiarenge ime y’oboagacho boria, bitato ase ensemo eyemo, na bitato ase ensemo ende, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’oboagacho bware geita kie ritang’ani. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye nobw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.
english: Its alcoves-- three on each side-- its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as those of the first gateway. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

ekegusii: Ebinyomba biaye bi’oborendi, ne chisiiro, na egesona, nigo biareng’aine nebi’amaagacho ande. Boigo ebibao mbiarengeo ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, na ase egesona. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.
english: Its alcoves, its projecting walls and its portico had the same measurements as the others. The gateway and its portico had openings all around. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

ekegusii: Omosabibu oyio ogakinia chinsagia chinkong’u, chiaisanete gokorwa chinyimbo chi’abagambi. Ritina riaye rigatambea gochia igoro ase egati ye chinsagia chiaye chinyinge mono. Omote oyio okarorekana gochia aare ore ritutu rinene.
english: Its branches were strong, fit for a ruler's scepter. It towered high above the thick foliage, conspicuous for its height and for its many branches.

ekegusii: Amato aye nigo arenge amaya, na amatunda aye nigo arenge amange; ase omote oria endagera nao yarenge goisanekia abanto bonsi. Ching’iti chi’orosana nao chiare konyora ekiriri chigokenderera inse yaye, ne chinyoni chikaba chikomenya ime ase chinsagia chiaye, na kera egetongwa kere moyo gekanyora endagera yaye korwao.
english: Its leaves were beautiful, its fruit abundant, and on it was food for all. Under it the beasts of the field found shelter, and the birds of the air lived in its branches; from it every creature was fed.

ekegusii: Amagoro aye nigo aroisetigwe korwa ase ebioma, na ebisanyi bi’amagoro nigo biarenge ekeng’ese ki’ebioma, na ekeng’ese ki’amaroba.
english: its legs of iron, its feet partly of iron and partly of baked clay.

ekegusii: Igo enga buna omonto ore kogenda ense eng’ao konya otigire enyomba yaye, oeire abasomba baye okobua, na kera omonto emeremo yaye; agachika omorendi bw’egesieri arende.
english: It's like a man going away: He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge, each with his assigned task, and tells the one at the door to keep watch.

ekegusii: Ebibao biaye, na egesoero kiaye, na emegwekano eria y’emekendo, bionsi ebio nigo biareng’aine na biria bi’oboagacho bware geita kiarochie moocha. Ekeriinero kiare nebitambokero bitano na bibere nkiarengeo kiare koriinerwa gochiao, na egesona kiaye nigo kiarenge ime y’oboagacho obwo.
english: Its openings, its portico and its palm tree decorations had the same measurements as those of the gate facing east. Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them.

ekegusii: Egesona kiaye kiarochie ase eraaro ya isiko, na emegwekano y’emekendo nigo yachabeire ase chisiiro chiaye, na ekeriinero kiaye nigo kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na bitato biare koriinerwa gochiao.
english: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated its jambs, and eight steps led up to it.

ekegusii: Egesona kiaye nigo kiarochie ase eraaro ya isiko, na emegwekano y’emekendo nigo yachabeire ase chisiiro chiaye chiarenge ase chinsemo ibere, na ekeriinero kiaye nigo kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na bitato biare koriinerwa gochiao.
english: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.

ekegusii: Chisiiro chiaye nigo chiarochie ase eraaro ya isiko, na emegwekano y’emekendo nigo yachabeire ase chisiiro chiria chiarenge ase chinsemo ibere, na ekeriinero kiaye nigo kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na bitato biare koriinerwa gochiao.
english: Its portico faced the outer court; palm trees decorated the jambs on either side, and eight steps led up to it.

ekegusii: Amatenenerio aye nigo aroiseirie chifeta, na ekiegeko kiaye nigo kiaroiseirie chitahabu; egeikaransero kiaye nigo giatubire negetambaa kemonyinga. Abakungu ba Yerusalemu nigo bagechaberete ime, bare nomoyo bw’ogwancha.
english: Its posts he made of silver, its base of gold. Its seat was upholstered with purple, its interior lovingly inlaid by the daughters of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Emeri y’omote oyio neisa kogota ime ase riroba, na egetugi kiaye nkegote gesire ime ase riroba,
english: Its roots may grow old in the ground and its stump die in the soil,

ekegusii: Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao ekio amo robe rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao, keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chie chitahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire.
english: Its skillfully woven waistband is to be like it-- of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen.

ekegusii: Orokini rw’okobwataneria egesibao rokaroisigwa rw’egetambaa keria ki’egesibao keroisirie korwa ase chiusi chi’etahabu, na echi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya chisisire. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: Its skillfully woven waistband was like it-- of one piece with the ephod and made with gold, and with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and with finely twisted linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Bakanyora Ekerubo Ekiomo goikera orooche rwa Yorodan. Orwo rokaba orobebe rwabo rwa bosongo, korwa ase enyancha ya Kinereti, ensemo ya sugusu, goika enyancha y’Ekerubo Ekiomo, nero Enyancha y’Omonyo, ensemo ya irianyi inse y’ebitirimboko bia Pisiga, ensemo ya moocha.
english: Its western border was the Jordan in the Arabah, from Kinnereth to the Sea of the Arabah (the Salt Sea), below the slopes of Pisgah.

ekegusii: Ebinachi ne chindogio chiaye biroisigwe korwa ase chitahabu chichenire.
english: Its wick trimmers and trays are to be of pure gold.

ekegusii: Enyomba eyio nigo yarenge nebibao bire ase chindwaro isato, kera ekebao kerigereretie ekende.
english: Its windows were placed high in sets of three, facing each other.

ekegusii: Jaala, Darkon, Giddel,
english: Yaala, na Darikoni, na Gideli;

ekegusii: Yaresia na Elija, na Sikiri; aba nigo barenge abana abamura ba Yerohamu.
english: Jaareshiah, Elijah and Zicri were the sons of Jeroham.

ekegusii: Yabesi akarangeria Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, akabora, “Onye aye ndiria kwarenge gonsesenia naende ogareyie obomenyo bwane, naende okoboko kwao kobe amo nainche, na ondende korwa ase obororo tibobaisa gonkora bobe.” Nyasae akamwanchera aya aganetie.
english: Jabez cried out to the God of Israel, "Oh, that you would bless me and enlarge my territory! Let your hand be with me, and keep me from harm so that I will be free from pain." And God granted his request.

ekegusii: Yabesi nigo arenge namasikani amanene kobua abamura bamwabo. Ng’ina akamoroka Yabesi, ekiagera amoiborete ase obororo.
english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, "I gave birth to him in pain."

ekegusii: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
english: Erio Yakobo akagenderera norogendo rwaye, bakaumerana nabamalaika ba Nyasae.

ekegusii: Yakobo amo nabwo bonsi barenge nere bagaika Lusu, noro Beteli, ase ense ya Kanani.
english: Jacob and all the people with him came to Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.

ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria, akamotebia, “Nigo nobcete, nkarengereria ng’a nobaise kong’ura abana bao abasubati.
english: Jacob answered Laban, "I was afraid, because I thought you would take your daughters away from me by force.

ekegusii: Yakobo akababoria, “Baminto, ng’ai seino?” Bakamoiraneria, “Seito naiga Harani.”
english: Jacob asked the shepherds, "My brothers, where are you from?" "We're from Haran," they replied.

ekegusii: Yakobo akabea Raeli mono, akamoboria, “Inee! Ninche inde ribaga ria Nyasae, oyogotangete tikwanyora abana?”
english: Jacob became angry with her and said, "Am I in the place of God, who has kept you from having children?"

ekegusii: Igo Yakobo akaroka aase aria Nyasae akwanerete nere Beteli.
english: Jacob called the place where God had talked with him Bethel.

ekegusii: Yakobo agaika ase omochie o Isaka ise aaria Mamure, ang’e na Kiriati‐Ariba, nao Heburoni, agwo ase Ibrahimu na Isaka bamenyete buna abamenyi.
english: Jacob came home to his father Isaac in Mamre, near Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.

ekegusii: Yakobo nigo atamete gochia ase ense y’Aramu, ere Israeli agakora emeremo ase okonyora omokungu, ee, akarisia ching’ondi ase okonyora omokungu.
english: Jacob fled to the country of Aram; Israel served to get a wife, and to pay for her he tended sheep.

ekegusii: Ekero Labani aikeereire Yakobo ang’e, Yakobo nere konya otenenirie eema yaye agwo ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi. Labani nere amo nabamwabo bagatenenia chiema chiabo agwo.
english: Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there too.

ekegusii: Bono Yakobo akaigwa aya basinto ba Labani bagoteba ng’a, “Yakobo oirire enibo yonsi ya tata; na ase enibo ya tata onyorire obotenenku obwo bwonsi abwate.”
english: Jacob heard that Laban's sons were saying, "Jacob has taken everything our father owned and has gained all this wealth from what belonged to our father."

ekegusii: Jacob lay with Rachel also, and he loved Rachel more than Leah. And he worked for Laban another seven years.
english: Yakobo akaba na Raeli; agancha Raeli mono kobua Lea. Erio Yakobo agakorera Labani emiaka etano na ebere ende.

ekegusii: Yakobo akaimoka korwa Beeri‐Seba kogenda Harani.
english: Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran.

ekegusii: Yakobo akamenya ase ense ya Misiri emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere. Ase igo agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, na etano na ebere (147) ase obogima bwaye.
english: Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years, and the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.

ekegusii: Yakobo akaba okomenya ase ense eyio ise amenyete buna omomenyi, ense y’Abakanani.
english: Jacob lived in the land where his father had stayed, the land of Canaan.

ekegusii: Yakobo akaimokia amaiso aye, akarigereria, akarora Esau ogocha amo nabanto amagana ane. Erio agaatanana abana, akaa kera omokungu abaye, Lea, na Raeli, na abakungu baria babere abasomba.
english: Jacob looked up and there was Esau, coming with his four hundred men; so he divided the children among Leah, Rachel and the two maidservants.

ekegusii: Jacob replied, "First sell me your birthright."
english: Yakobo akamoiraneria, “Ritang’ani ng’ooneria omwando oo bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.”

ekegusii: Yakobo akamoiraneria, “Aye omonyene nomanyete buna nabeire nkogokorera, na amaicho ao buna abeire ase oborendi bwane.
english: Jacob said to him, "You know how I have worked for you and how your livestock has fared under my care.

ekegusii: Yakobo akairaneria ise, “Ninche Esau, omwana oo omotangi. Nakorire buna gwantebetie; boka, oikaranse orie enyama y’obotwari bwane, erio onsesenie.”
english: Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game so that you may give me your blessing."

ekegusii: Yakobo agatebia Yusufu, “Nyasae Omobui nang’orokerete aaria Lusu ase ense ya Kanani, agansesenia,
english: Jacob said to Joseph, "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there he blessed me

ekegusii: Korende Yakobo agatebia Rebeka ng’ina, “Noroche Esau ominto nomonto obwate amarionya ase omobere oye, korende inche omobere one nomoterere.
english: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, "But my brother Esau is a hairy man, and I'm a man with smooth skin.

ekegusii: Yakobo akamoboria, “Koranche, ontebie erieta riao.” Korende akamotebia, “Nase ki okomboria erieta riane?” Agwo akamosesenia.
english: Jacob said, "Please tell me your name." But he replied, "Why do you ask my name?" Then he blessed him there.

ekegusii: Yakobo agatoma abatomwa batang’ane kogenda ase Esau omwabo, baike ensemo ya Seiri, ase ense y’Edomu.
english: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

ekegusii: Jacob set apart the young of the flock by themselves, but made the rest face the streaked and dark-colored animals that belonged to Laban. Thus he made separate flocks for himself and did not put them with Laban's animals.
english: Na Yakobo agaatanana ching’ondi chimingichi, ne ching’ondi chinkungu agachisang’anania ne chimingichi chie riicho ria Labani echiarenge namagwari, na echiare chimwamu. Naboigo akenyorera amaicho aye ere omonyene, ayio atabegete amo naya Labani.

ekegusii: Yakobo agatenenia rigena buna esiiro aase aria Nyasae akwanerete nere, akaumora ekeng’wanso gi’ekenyugwa amo namaguta igoro yaye.
english: Jacob set up a stone pillar at the place where God had talked with him, and he poured out a drink offering on it; he also poured oil on it.

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akabea mono, akomania Labani ase okomotogonyera na goteba, “Nkomocha ki nakorire? Nebibe biane nakorire mbiribi, goika kwambwatirie nobororo engencho enga buna eye?
english: Jacob was angry and took Laban to task. "What is my crime?" he asked Laban. "What sin have I committed that you hunt me down?

ekegusii: Yakobo konya omwanchire Raeli, na ase ayio agatebia Labani, “Ningokorere emiaka etano na ebere, erinde ong’e Raeli, omoiseke oo omoke.”
english: Jacob was in love with Rachel and said, "I'll work for you seven years in return for your younger daughter Rachel."

ekegusii: Yakobo akagenda akamoika ise ang’e, na ere akamotaba‐taba, akabora, “Eriogi rirorio neria Yakobo, korende amaboko naya Esau.”
english: Jacob went close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, "The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau."

ekegusii: Yakobo agatwa ebite ebibese bi’emete gete enga buna omosobeti, na omolozi, na omouru, akabisata chinsemo, erinde emeng’ororia emerabu ekarorekana ase ebite biria.
english: Jacob, however, took fresh-cut branches from poplar, almond and plane trees and made white stripes on them by peeling the bark and exposing the white inner wood of the branches.

ekegusii: Korende Yakobo akagenderera, agaika Sukoti, akeagachera enyomba, akaagachera na amaicho aye ebigutu. Ase igo aase aria akarokwa Sukoti.
english: Jacob, however, went to Succoth, where he built a place for himself and made shelters for his livestock. That is why the place is called Succoth.

ekegusii: agwo yarengeo ensoko ya Yakobo. Nabo Yeso, konya orosire ase orogendo rwaye, agaikaransa iga ase ensoko. Konya chiabeire ang’e chinsa isano nemo.
english: Jacob's well was there, and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

ekegusii: Yaeli agasoka korotota Sisera, akamotebia, “Omonene one, gobera gocha aa, soa ime aa, toba nobwoba!” Erio Sisera agasoa ase eema ya Yaeli, na Yaeli akamobisia egetambaa.
english: Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, "Come, my lord, come right in. Don't be afraid." So he entered her tent, and she put a covering over him.

ekegusii: Yahati nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Sisa oyo o kabere, korende Yeusi na Beria tibabwate abana abamura abange; ase ayio bakabekeranigwa amo ase okobarwa, bakaba eamate eyemo.
english: Jahath was the first and Ziza the second, but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons; so they were counted as one family with one assignment.

ekegusii: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
english: Yahasi na Kedemoti, na Mefaati;

ekegusii: Yairi, mosinto o Manase, akagenda, akaumokera na koira emechie emeke y’ense ya Gileadi, akayeroka Emechie ya Yairi.
english: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured their settlements and called them Havvoth Jair.

ekegusii: Yairi, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Manase, akaira orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu, narwo Basani, goikera orogongo rw’Abagesuri na Abamaaka. Akaroka emechie yarengeo ase erieta riaye, Emechie ya Yairi, nabo ekorokwa goika rero iga.)
english: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, took the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites; it was named after him, so that to this day Bashan is called Havvoth Jair.)

ekegusii: Jakim, Zicri, Zabdi,
english: Yakimu na Sikiri, na Sabidi,

ekegusii: na Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana, momura omwabo Yakobo, akabaroka erieta Boanergi, engencho yaye: Abana b’enkoba;
english: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (to them he gave the name Boanerges, which means Sons of Thunder);

ekegusii: Inche Yakobo, omosomba o Nyasae na obw’Omonene Yeso Kristo, nabakwanirie inwe ab’ebisaku ikomi na bibere, abamwatananekire gochia chinse chire ao ao.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes scattered among the nations: Greetings.

ekegusii: Naende ekero bachia komanya obuya boria naeirwe, Yakobo na Kefa, na Yohana, abasikire bare buna chisiiro, bagatoa inche na Barnaba okoboko gw’okorio gw’okobwatana, erinde intwe togende ase abanto b’Ebisaku, na barabwo bagende ase abanto b’okwaroka.
english: James, Peter and John, those reputed to be pillars, gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship when they recognized the grace given to me. They agreed that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the Jews.

ekegusii: Janim, Beth Tappuah, Aphekah,
english: na Yanumu, na Beti‐Tapua, na Afeka,

ekegusii: Jarmuth and En Gannim, together with their pasturelands-- four towns;
english: na Yarimuti na Eni‐Ganimu, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

ekegusii: na Yarimuti, na Adulamu, na Soko, na Aseka,
english: Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah,

ekegusii: Jattir, Eshtemoa,
english: na Yatiri, na Esitemoa,

ekegusii: Yasisi Omohagari agatenenera ching’ondi ne chimbori. Abe bonsi nigo barenge abateneneri ba chinibo chia Daudi omoruoti.
english: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these were the officials in charge of King David's property.

ekegusii: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
english: na Abayebusi, na Abaamori, na Abagirigasi,

ekegusii: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
english: Abayebusi na Abaamori, na Abagirigasi;

ekegusii: Jediael son of Shimri, his brother Joha the Tizite,
english: Yediaeli, mosinto o Simuri, na Yoha, momura omwabo, omonto o Tisi;

ekegusii: Korende Yehieli na Asasia, Nahati na Asaeli, Yerimoti na Yosabadi, Elieli na Isimakia, Mahati na Benaya, abwo nabwo barenge abakonyi ba Konania na Simei, momura omwabo. Nigo bachoretwe na Hezekia omoruoti na Asaria oyo otenenerete enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismakiah, Mahath and Benaiah were supervisors under Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by appointment of King Hezekiah and Azariah the official in charge of the temple of God.

ekegusii: Yehoahasi akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa agwo Samaria, na Yehoasi, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Jehoahaz rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoash his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Yehoahasi nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na etato, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emetienyi etato agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months.

ekegusii: Yehoahasi nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emetienyi etato agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Hamutali, mosubati o Yeremia korwa Libuna.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother's name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

ekegusii: Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, mosinto o Yoashi bw’Ahasia, akabwatwa na Yehoasi omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, agwo Beti‐Semesi, akarentwa Yerusalemu. Yehoasi karentire Amasia agwo Yerusalemu, agatagora orwaki rwa Yerusalemu korwa Egeita gi’Efraimu goika Egeita gi’Ekoona, obotambe bw’amaboko amagana ane.
english: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash brought him to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate-- a section about six hundred feet long.

ekegusii: Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akabwatera Amasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agwo Beti‐Semesi. Amasia nigo arenge mosinto o Yoashi bw’Ahasia. Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akagenda Yerusalemu, agatagora orwaki rw’aroro ase obotambe bw’amaboko amagana ane, korwa Egeita gi’Efraimu goika Egeita gi’Ekoona.
english: Jehoash king of Israel captured Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh. Then Jehoash went to Jerusalem and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the Ephraim Gate to the Corner Gate-- a section about six hundred feet long.

ekegusii: Yehoasi akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa agwo Samaria ase abaruoti b’Abaisraeli batindegetwe, na Yeroboamu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Jehoash rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel. And Jeroboam his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Yehoasi akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa agwo Samaria aase abaruoti b’Abaisraeli batindegetwe. Yeroboamu agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti kia Yehoasi.
english: Jehoash rested with his fathers, and Jeroboam succeeded him on the throne. Jehoash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel.

ekegusii: Erio Yehoyakini, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akerua ase omoruoti o Babeli, ere omonyene, na ng’ina, na abasomba baye, na abanene baria bare komokonya, na abanene b’enyomba yaye. Ase omwaka o gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kwaye, omoruoti o Babeli akaira Yehoyakini akamosiba,
english: Jehoiachin king of Judah, his mother, his attendants, his nobles and his officials all surrendered to him. In the eighth year of the reign of the king of Babylon, he took Jehoiachin prisoner.

ekegusii: Yehoyakini nigo arenge nemiaka etano na etato ekero achagete kogamba; akagamba emetienyi etato na amatuko ikomi, agwo Yerusalemu. Nere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months and ten days. He did evil in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Yehoyakini nigo arenge nemiaka ikomi na etato, ekero abete omoruoti; akagamba emetienyi etato agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Nehusita, mosubati bw’Elianatani korwa Yerusalemu.
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother's name was Nehushta daughter of Elnathan; she was from Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Erio akarenta omwana oria bw’omoruoti isiko, akamobekera egutwa ase omotwe oye, naende akamoa Ebuku y’Oborori. Yoashi akararigwa koba omoruoti, na Yehoyada na abamura baye bakamoaka amaguta, bagateba, “Omoruoti ochie kare!”
english: Jehoiada and his sons brought out the king's son and put the crown on him; they presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him and shouted, "Long live the king!"

ekegusii: Erio Yehoyada akarenta omwana oria omomura bw’omoruoti isiko, akamobekera egutwa ase omotwe oye, naende akamoa Ebuku y’Oborori. Erio Yoashi akararigwa ng’a obeire omoruoti, na agaakwa amaguta. Abanto bagaaka chinkobi, bagateba, “Omoruoti ochie kare!”
english: Jehoiada brought out the king's son and put the crown on him; he presented him with a copy of the covenant and proclaimed him king. They anointed him, and the people clapped their hands and shouted, "Long live the king!"

ekegusii: Yehoyada akamonyuomeria abakungu babere, na barabwo bakamoiborera abana, abamura na abaiseke.
english: Jehoiada chose two wives for him, and he had sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Yehoyada omokuani agachika abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi amagana, akabatebia, “Mosokie isiko, momobeke ase egati y’abarendi, na moite nomoro onde bwensi okomotunyana.” Omokuani tanchete omokungu oria aiterwe ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Jehoiada the priest ordered the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops: "Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest had said, "She must not be put to death in the temple of the LORD."

ekegusii: Yehoyada omokuani agasokia abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi b’amagana, akabatebia, “Mosokie isiko, mobeke ase egati y’abarendi, na moite nomoro onde bwensi okomotunyana.” Omokuani nigo atebete ng’a tibabaisa komoitera ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Jehoiada the priest sent out the commanders of units of a hundred, who were in charge of the troops, and said to them: "Bring her out between the ranks and put to the sword anyone who follows her." For the priest had said, "Do not put her to death at the temple of the LORD."

ekegusii: Erio Yehoyada omokuani akarenta esanduku enkong’u akayebochora akabao ase ekemumeko kiaye, akayebeka mbarabare y’egesasimero ensemo y’okorio, ase abanto bare gosoera enyomba y’Omonene. Na abakuani baria barendete agwo ase egesieri ki’enyomba, akabeka ime ase esanduku eria chibesa chionsi chiarentetwe ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Jehoiada the priest took a chest and bored a hole in its lid. He placed it beside the altar, on the right side as one enters the temple of the LORD. The priests who guarded the entrance put into the chest all the money that was brought to the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Yehoyada agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati y’Omonene na omoruoti amo nabanto, ng’a barabwo babe abanto b’Omonene; boigo agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati y’omoruoti na abanto.
english: Jehoiada then made a covenant between the LORD and the king and people that they would be the LORD's people. He also made a covenant between the king and the people.

ekegusii: Yehoyada agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania egati yaye omonyene na abanto bonsi amo nomoruoti, ng’a babe abanto b’Omonene.
english: Jehoiada then made a covenant that he and the people and the king would be the LORD's people.

ekegusii: Yehoyakimu akaa Farao chifeta ne chitahabu chiria, korende eyio nigo yamobetereretie kobekera ense eria ebango ase ogochinyora na goakana Farao echi achigete. Akarusia ebango ye chifeta ne chitahabu korwa ase abanto b’ense eria; kera omonto akarua ekerengo abekeretwe.
english: Jehoiakim paid Pharaoh Neco the silver and gold he demanded. In order to do so, he taxed the land and exacted the silver and gold from the people of the land according to their assessments.

ekegusii: Yehoyakimu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete na Yehoyakini, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Jehoiakim rested with his fathers. And Jehoiachin his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Yehoyakimu nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, na etano, ekero achagete kogamba, akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Nere agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oye.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. He did evil in the eyes of the LORD his God.

ekegusii: Yehoyakimu nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere, na etano, ekero achagete kogamba; akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Sebida, mosubati o Pedaya korwa Ruma.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother's name was Zebidah daughter of Pedaiah; she was from Rumah.

ekegusii: Jehoram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
english: Yehosafati akaibora Yehoramu, na Yehoramu akaibora Ahasia, na Ahasia akaibora Yoashi;

ekegusii: Elija omobani agatomera Yehoramu rirube rigoteba, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae o Daudi sokoro yao, agoteba: Aye tobwateti chinchera chia Yehosafati iso, gose echi’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet, which said: "This is what the LORD, the God of your father David, says: 'You have not walked in the ways of your father Jehoshaphat or of Asa king of Judah.

ekegusii: Yehoramu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa aase chiatindegetwe, ase Omochie o Daudi, na Ahasia, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Jehoram rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David. And Ahaziah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Yehoramu nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato, na ebere, ekero abete omoruoti; akagamba emiaka etano na etato, agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years.

ekegusii: Yehoramu nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato na ebere, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka etano na etato, agwo Yerusalemu. Ekero akwete, omonto onde tamoichanerete. Abanto bakamotindeka ase Omochie o Daudi, korende tari ase chimbeera chi’abaruoti.
english: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years. He passed away, to no one's regret, and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

ekegusii: Yehoramu nabwate abamura bamwabo, abana ba Yehosafati: Asaria na Yehieli, Zakaria na Asariahu, Mikaeli na Sefatia. Aba bonsi nigo barenge basinto ba Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Jehoram's brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat, were Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael and Shephatiah. All these were sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel.

ekegusii: Yehosafati akamenta koba ne chinguru, na agwo ase ense y’Abayuda akaagacha chiburi na emechie, ase arenge kogacha ebinto.
english: Jehoshaphat became more and more powerful; he built forts and store cities in Judah

ekegusii: Erio Yehosafati na Abayuda bonsi, amo nabanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, bagatung’ama bakaumama ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakamosasima.
english: Jehoshaphat bowed with his face to the ground, and all the people of Judah and Jerusalem fell down in worship before the LORD.

ekegusii: Yehosafati, omwana omomura bw’Asa, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye. Agakong’ia oboruoti bwaye ase ogwekengera ase Abaisraeli.
english: Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king and strengthened himself against Israel.

ekegusii: Yehosafati akaba okomenya agwo Yerusalemu; akagenda ase abanto bamenyete gochakera Beeri‐Seba goikeera ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, akabairania ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo.
english: Jehoshaphat lived in Jerusalem, and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

ekegusii: Yehosafati agateba, “Ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rire amo nere.” Ase igo omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, na Yehosafati, na omoruoti bw’Abaedomu bakagenda asare.
english: Jehoshaphat said, "The word of the LORD is with him." So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

ekegusii: Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Asa, agachaka kogambera Abayuda ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kw’Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

ekegusii: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah-- in Issachar;
english: Yehosafati, mosinto o Parua, agatenenera orogongo rwa Isakaru;

ekegusii: Boigo Yehosafati agakora omorembe nomoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Jehoshaphat was also at peace with the king of Israel.

ekegusii: Yehosafati nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato, na etano, ekero achagete kogamba; ere akagamba emiaka emerongo ebere na etano agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Asuba, mosubati o Silihi.
english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years. His mother's name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

ekegusii: Yehosadaki agooswa akairwa ense eng’ao, ekero Omonene aruete Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bagooswa, bakairwa na Nebukadinesaro.
english: Jehozadak was deported when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

ekegusii: Yehu akaimoka, agasoa enyomba, na omobani oria omosae akaumora amaguta aria igoro ase omotwe o Yehu, akabora, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Inche nagoakire amaguta obe omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baane.
english: Jehu got up and went into the house. Then the prophet poured the oil on Jehu's head and declared, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'I anoint you king over the LORD's people Israel.

ekegusii: Na Yehu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa agwo Samaria, na Yehoahasi, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Jehu rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria. And Jehoahaz his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Yehu agatebia Bidikari, omorwani oye ore komorenda, “Moimokie, omotugute ase omogondo o Naboti Omoyesireeli. Inyora ekero aye na inche toriinete chibarasi, togatunyana Ahabu ise, buna Omonene akwanete amang’ana mamincha yaye.
english: Jehu said to Bidkar, his chariot officer, "Pick him up and throw him on the field that belonged to Naboth the Jezreelite. Remember how you and I were riding together in chariots behind Ahab his father when the LORD made this prophecy about him:

ekegusii: Yehu agachika, agateba, “Rangeria abanto babe nomosangererekano omochenu ase Baali!” Ase ayio, barabwo bakararia amang’ana ayio.
english: Jehu said, "Call an assembly in honor of Baal." So they proclaimed it.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Inchuo amo nainche, orore risemi riane na omokia one ase Omonene!” Erio bakagenda komo ase egari ya Yehu.
english: Jehu said, "Come with me and see my zeal for the LORD." Then he had him ride along in his chariot.

ekegusii: Yehu omorori, mosinto o Hanani, akagenda korotota Yehosafati omoruoti, akamoboria, “Inee! Nabo ekogwenerete gokonya abanto ababe, naende gwancha baria bagechete Omonene? Ase engencho eyio endamwamu y’Omonene yagocheire.
english: Jehu the seer, the son of Hanani, went out to meet him and said to the king, "Should you help the wicked and love those who hate the LORD? Because of this, the wrath of the LORD is upon you.

ekegusii: Yehu akaimoka, akagenda Samaria. Ekero arenge inchera, agaika Beti‐Ekedi aase abarisia barenge konachera ching’ondi amarionya,
english: Jehu then set out and went toward Samaria. At Beth Eked of the Shepherds,

ekegusii: Yehu agasoa nyomba, akaragera akanywa. Erio agateba, “Bono tindeka omokungu oyo oragereirie, ekiagera ere nigo arenge omosubati bw’omoruoti.”
english: Jehu went in and ate and drank. "Take care of that cursed woman," he said, "and bury her, for she was a king's daughter."

ekegusii: Na onde bwensi oratame atooreke korwa ase omoro bwa Hasaeli naitwe na Yehu; na onde bwensi oratame atooreke korwa ase omoro o Yehu naitwe n’Elisha.
english: Jehu will put to death any who escape the sword of Hazael, and Elisha will put to death any who escape the sword of Jehu.

ekegusii: Jehud, Bene Berak, Gath Rimmon,
english: na Yehudi, na Bene‐Beraki, na Gati‐Rimoni,

ekegusii: Ise Abagibeoni nigo amenyete agwo Gibeoni; omokungu oye nigo arenge korokwa Maaka.
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife's name was Maacah,

ekegusii: Yeieli ise Abagibeoni, nigo amenyete agwo Gibeoni na mo kaye nigo arenge korokwa Maaka.
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon. His wife's name was Maacah,

ekegusii: Yefta akabairaneria, “Inche na abanto baane nigo twabwate eriomana ri’obobisa obonene n’Abaamoni. Inche nabarangeretie, korende timwanchete gontooria korwa ase amaboko abo.
english: Jephthah answered, "I and my people were engaged in a great struggle with the Ammonites, and although I called, you didn't save me out of their hands.

ekegusii: Yefta agatebia abagaaka baria, “Onye mokong’irania inka naende ngende korwania Abaamoni, na Omonene karabeke abanto abwo ase amaboko aane, inche nimbe omotang’ani oino.”
english: Jephthah answered, "Suppose you take me back to fight the Ammonites and the LORD gives them to me-- will I really be your head?"

ekegusii: Yefta akagambera Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka etano nomo. Erio Yefta, Omogileadi, agakwa, agatindekwa ase omochie oye agwo Gileadi.
english: Jephthah led Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in a town in Gilead.

ekegusii: Korende Yefta akabairaneria, “Inwe mwanyangete na moganseria korwa ase enyomba ya tata. Nase ki mwachire asende bono, ekero mwanyorire emechando?”
english: Jephthah said to them, "Didn't you hate me and drive me from my father's house? Why do you come to me now, when you're in trouble?"

ekegusii: Naende Yefta agatoma abanto eria kabere ase omoruoti bw’Abaamoni,
english: Jephthah sent back messengers to the Ammonite king,

ekegusii: Yefta Omogileadi nigo arenge omorwani etuoni. Ere nigo arenge omwana bw’omokungu omotayayi, na ise Yefta nigo arenge korokwa Gileadi.
english: Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty warrior. His father was Gilead; his mother was a prostitute.

ekegusii: Erio Yefta agasangereria abanto bonsi ba Gileadi, bakarwania Abaefraimu, bakababua. Abaefraimu konya batebire, “Inwe Abagileadi, nigo morwete ase Abaefraimu na ase Abamanase, nigo mwatamete korwa ase Abaefraimu.”
english: Jephthah then called together the men of Gilead and fought against Ephraim. The Gileadites struck them down because the Ephraimites had said, "You Gileadites are renegades from Ephraim and Manasseh."

ekegusii: Boigo Yerameeli nabwate omokungu onde orenge korokwa Atara; nere orenge ng’ina Onamu.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

ekegusii: Yeremia akaroisia ogotera kw’amagombo igoro ya Yosia, na abateri bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, babeire bagwatora Yosia ase amatera abo ay’amagombo nonya ngoika rero iga. Ayio akaba engencho Abaisraeli benaretie. Ogotera okwo nigo korikire ase Ebuku y’Amatera ’Amagombo.
english: Jeremiah composed laments for Josiah, and to this day all the men and women singers commemorate Josiah in the laments. These became a tradition in Israel and are written in the Laments.

ekegusii: Yeremia akarika ase ebuku obobe bwonsi bware gocha konyora Babeli, amo namang’ana ande onsi igoro ya Babeli.
english: Jeremiah had written on a scroll about all the disasters that would come upon Babylon-- all that had been recorded concerning Babylon.

ekegusii: Yeremia akairaneria Zedekia, akabora, “Ndagotebia ring’ana erio, Inee, nobe nobomaene ng’a tokong’ita? Naende ndagotebia amang’ana ay’okogosemia, nontegerere?”
english: Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, "If I give you an answer, will you not kill me? Even if I did give you counsel, you would not listen to me."

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia agateba, “Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende, rigantebia:
english: Jeremiah said, "The word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Yeremia akarua Yerusalemu, akagenda ase ense y’Ababenjamin, erinde anyore oboremo obo bwamotungetie ase egati y’abanto bande.
english: Jeremiah started to leave the city to go to the territory of Benjamin to get his share of the property among the people there.

ekegusii: bagakwana na Yeremia omobani, bakamotebia, “Nigo togokoboria otoigwe, koranche otosabere intwe abatigari ase Omonene, Nyasae oito. Nigo twarenge abange, korende bono twatigaire abake mono ase omobaro, buna otoroche igaa.
english: Jeremiah the prophet and said to him, "Please hear our petition and pray to the LORD your God for this entire remnant. For as you now see, though we were once many, now only a few are left.

ekegusii: Jeremiah the tenth and Macbannai the eleventh.
english: na Yeremia oyo o ikomi, na Makibani oyo o ikomi na rimo.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia akairana korwa Tofeti ase Omonene konya amotomire gochia koraria amang’ana ’obobani obwo; agacha agatenena ase eraaro ye Hekalu y’Omonene, agatebia abanto bonsi:
english: Jeremiah then returned from Topheth, where the LORD had sent him to prophesy, and stood in the court of the LORD's temple and said to all the people,

ekegusii: Yeremia nigo asiekeretwe ase akanunchi gakunyire ase enyomba inse, akaba omenyete aroro ase amatuko amange.
english: Jeremiah was put into a vaulted cell in a dungeon, where he remained a long time.

ekegusii: Abanto baria abamwabo Yeria nigo barenge chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na abere (2,700), abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, bamanyete korwana esegi buya. Barabwo Daudi omoruoti akababeka bakaba abateneneri b’abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, na ab’ekia Gadi, na ab’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ase emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae na ey’omoruoti.
english: Jeriah had twenty-seven hundred relatives, who were able men and heads of families, and King David put them in charge of the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

ekegusii: Naende Yeroboamu akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, agachora abakuani korwa ase egati y’abanto bonsi abwo batarenge Abalawi.
english: Jeroboam built shrines on high places and appointed priests from all sorts of people, even though they were not Levites.

ekegusii: Yeroboamu tanyorete chinguru chi’okoirania oboruoti bwaye ase amatuko Abiya arenge kogamba, korende Omonene akamoaka erinde agakwa.
english: Jeroboam did not regain power during the time of Abijah. And the LORD struck him down and he died.

ekegusii: Yeroboamu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiarenge abaruoti b’Abaisraeli chiararete. Na Zakaria, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Jeroboam rested with his fathers, the kings of Israel. And Zechariah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Yeroboamu akarengereria ase enkoro yaye ime, “Bono oboruoti igo borabaise koirana bogende ase enyomba ya Daudi.
english: Jeroboam thought to himself, "The kingdom will now likely revert to the house of David.

ekegusii: Yerubi‐Baali, mosinto o Yoashi, akairana nka, akamenya ase enyomba yaye omonyene.
english: Jerub-Baal son of Joash went back home to live.

ekegusii: Yerusalemu na emechie yonsi y’Abayuda, amo nabaruoti na abanene b’oboruoti bwabo, bakaegwa bakanywa edivai eria, erinde ense yabo esarigwe ebe bosa, na abanto bakorora ayio mbakumie babachaye, na baragererie ase erieta riabo, buna ere goika rero iga.
english: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, its kings and officials, to make them a ruin and an object of horror and scorn and cursing, as they are today;

ekegusii: Abaruoti barenge nokobua babeire bakogambera Yerusalemu na orogongo rwonsi rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na abwo babeire bakorenterwa ebango na echogo y’ebinto na eye chinchera.
english: Jerusalem has had powerful kings ruling over the whole of Trans-Euphrates, and taxes, tribute and duty were paid to them.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Yerusalemu bakorire ebibe ebinene; ase ayio babeire okogechia, bonsi ababasigete babachayire, ekiagera barorire obogetirianda bwabo. Ee, omochie omonyene nkweumia ore, bweonchoire gochia nyuma.
english: Jerusalem has sinned greatly and so has become unclean. All who honored her despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns away.

ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu kwaagachirwe naende, aye nomochie obwateranirie amo.
english: Jerusalem is built like a city that is closely compacted together.

ekegusii: Yerusalemu otagoirwe, na Abayuda bagure, ekiagera chinkwana chiabo na ogokora kwabo biabeire mamincha y’Omonene, na ase engencho eyio bagechirie amaiso ’Omonene ore nobonene.
english: Jerusalem staggers, Judah is falling; their words and deeds are against the LORD, defying his glorious presence.

ekegusii: Yesua na abamura baye amo nabamwabo, na Kadimeli na abamura baye, abanto b’ororeria rwa Hodawia, bakaba bagotenenera abakori emeremo b’enyomba ya Nyasae. Barabwo bakaba bagokonywa nabanto b’eamate ya Henadadi na abana babo, abarenge Abalawi.
english: Jeshua and his sons and brothers and Kadmiel and his sons (descendants of Hodaviah) and the sons of Henadad and their sons and brothers-- all Levites-- joined together in supervising those working on the house of God.

ekegusii: Jeshua was the father of Joiakim, Joiakim the father of Eliashib, Eliashib the father of Joiada,
english: Yesua akaibora Yoyakimu, na Yoyakimu akaibora Eliasibu, na Eliasibu akaibora Yoyada,

ekegusii: “Korende Yesuruni akanora, akaenena. Akanora na koneta, akagirigenta; erio akaanga Nyasae oria omotongete; agachecheria Egetare keria kiarenge ogotooreka kwaye.
english: Jeshurun grew fat and kicked; filled with food, he became heavy and sleek. He abandoned the God who made him and rejected the Rock his Savior.

ekegusii: Yese akarenta abamura baye batano na babere bagaeta ase obosio bwa Samweli, korende Samweli akamotebia, “Omonene tachoreti onde omo ase aba.”
english: Jesse had seven of his sons pass before Samuel, but Samuel said to him, "The LORD has not chosen these."

ekegusii: Yese akarenta Sama. Boigo Samweli agateba, “Omonene tamochoreti oyo.”
english: Jesse then had Shammah pass by, but Samuel said, "Nor has the LORD chosen this one."

ekegusii: Jesse was the father of Eliab his firstborn; the second son was Abinadab, the third Shimea,
english: Yese akaibora Eliabu, omwana oye omomura omotangi, na Abinadabu oyo o kabere, na Simea oyo o gatato,

ekegusii: Abamura baye batato abanene konya bachiire korwana esegi amo na Saulo. Omomura oria omotangi nigo are korokwa Eliabu na oyo o kabere Abinadabu, na oyo o gatato Sama.
english: Jesse's three oldest sons had followed Saul to the war: The firstborn was Eliab; the second, Abinadab; and the third, Shammah.

ekegusii: Yeso agasoka amo naborokigwa baye, bakagenda ebichie bia Kaisaria Filipi. Ekero baare nchera akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”
english: Jesus and his disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked them, "Who do people say I am?"

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Onye nkwamanya ekeegwa kia Nyasae, naende nere ng’o okogosaba amache anywe, anga nkwamosaba ere, na ere anga nakoa amache are moyo.”
english: Jesus answered her, "If you knew the gift of God and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him and he would have given you living water."

ekegusii: Jesus answered him, "I tell you the truth, today you will be with me in paradise."
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Ekeene nagotebirie: Rero nobe amo nainche Paradiso.”

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Naende nerikire: Toteema Omonene, Nyasae oo.”
english: Jesus answered him, "It is also written: 'Do not put the Lord your God to the test.'"

ekegusii: Jesus answered him, "Simon, I have something to tell you." "Tell me, teacher," he said.
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Simion, ninde ne ring’ana nkogotebia.” Akabora, “Omworokia, kwana.”

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tagora Hekalu eye, na inche ase amatuko atato ninyetenenie.”
english: Jesus answered them, "Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days."

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Timwana gosoma aya Daudi akorete, ekero arenge nenchara, ere na abarenge amo nere,
english: Jesus answered them, "Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tarikiri ase amachiko aino ng’a: Inche natebete ng’a inwe nigo more chinyasae?
english: Jesus answered them, "Is it not written in your Law, 'I have said you are gods'?

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Abare buya tibari korigia omorwaria, otatiga abarwarete.
english: Jesus answered them, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Oyoikire gwesibia tagwenereti gwesibia naende, otatiga amagoro oka, korende obeire omochenu omobere bwonsi; na inwe mwabeire abachenu, korende tai mwensi.”
english: Jesus answered, "A person who has had a bath needs only to wash his feet; his whole body is clean. And you are clean, though not every one of you."

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Chinsa chi’omobaso tichiri ikomi na ibere? Omonto karagende mobaso takogochwa, ekiagera aroche omobaso bw’ense eye.
english: Jesus answered, "Are there not twelve hours of daylight? A man who walks by day will not stumble, for he sees by this world's light.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Inamonyare gotiga abarangerigwa b’enyangi beng’ate ekero omonyuomi are amo nabarabwo?
english: Jesus answered, "Can you make the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them?

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Mokagete ng’a Abagalili abwo nigo barenge abanyene ebibe kobua Abagalili bande bonsi, ekiagera banyorete emechando buna eyio?
english: Jesus answered, "Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans because they suffered this way?

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Nonya ngwekwana inche omonyene, oborori bwane nobw’ekeene, ekiagera namanyire aase narure, na aase nkogenda; korende inwe timomanyeti aase narure, gose aase ngochia.
english: Jesus answered, "Even if I testify on my own behalf, my testimony is valid, for I know where I came from and where I am going. But you have no idea where I come from or where I am going.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Kera oyokonywa amache aya naigwe erang’o naende;
english: Jesus answered, "Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,

ekegusii: Jesus answered, "How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? They cannot, so long as they have him with them.
english: Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Abarangerigwa b’enyangi inabanyare kweng’ata ekero omonyuomi are amo nabarabwo? Ekero omonyuomi are amo na barabwo, tibakonyara kweng’ata.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia,” “Inee! Abarangerigwa b’enyangi inabanyare korera ekero omonyuomi are amo nabarabwo? Korende amatuko nache, barache kourwa omonyuomi; erio nario barache kweng’ata.
english: Jesus answered, "How can the guests of the bridegroom mourn while he is with them? The time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inche ninche enchera, na ekeene, na obogima; monto onde tagocha ase Tata otatiga goetera asende.
english: Jesus answered, "I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nabatebirie, na inwe timori kwegena; emeremo eye ngokora ase erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori.
english: Jesus answered, "I did tell you, but you do not believe. The miracles I do in my Father's name speak for me,

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Omonto ataiboiri ase amache na Omoika, takonyara gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
english: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Iga mokondigia, tari ekiagera mwaroche ebikone, korende nekiagera mwariete emegati eria, mokaigota.
english: Jesus answered, "I tell you the truth, you are looking for me, not because you saw miraculous signs but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.

ekegusii: Jesus answered, "I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times.
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Tingotebeti komwabera chintunda isano na ibere, mwabere nonya ne chintunda isano na ibere ara emerongo etano na ebere.

ekegusii: Jesus answered, "I tell you, Peter, before the rooster crows today, you will deny three times that you know me."
english: Akabora, “Nagotebirie Petero, rero etuoni etarabuga nonkane ara gatato ng’a tomanyeti.”

ekegusii: Jesus answered, "If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? You must follow me."
english: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Kondarigie oyo abeo goika inchiche, inki ogwechandera ayio? Aye ntunyane inche.”

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Onye korigetie koba omoikeranu, gachie, oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi, oe abataka, na aye nobe nenibo igoro; erio oche ontunyane.”
english: Jesus answered, "If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."

ekegusii: Jesus answered, "It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it in the dish." Then, dipping the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, son of Simon.
english: Erio Yeso akairaneria, “Nomonto oria ngotongereria egesamunye ki’omogati na komoa.” Agatongereria Yudas, mosinto o Simion Iskariota, egesamunye, agakemoa.

ekegusii: Korende ere akairaneria, “Nerikire: Omonto takoba moyo ase omogati bwoka, korende ase kera ring’ana rikorwa ase omonwa o Nyasae.”
english: Jesus answered, "It is written: 'Man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.'"

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Nerikire. Omonto takoba moyo ase omogati bwoka.”
english: Jesus answered, "It is written: 'Man does not live on bread alone.'"

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Nerikire: Mosasime Omonene Nyasae oo, omokorere ere bweka.”
english: Jesus answered, "It is written: 'Worship the Lord your God and serve him only.'"

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Netebire, Toteema Omonene Nyasae oo.”
english: Jesus answered, "It says: 'Do not put the Lord your God to the test.'"

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Okworokereria kwane tari okwane, korende nokwaye ere oyontomete.
english: Jesus answered, "My teaching is not my own. It comes from him who sent me.

ekegusii: Jesus answered, "The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent."
english: Yeso akabairaneria, “Eye nero emeremo ya Nyasae, ng’a momwegene ere oyotomirwe nere.”

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Anga tori nokobua konde gwonsi, onye otaeiri korwa igoro; ase ayio ere oyombegete ase amaboko ao nare nebibe ebinene kobua.”
english: Jesus answered, "You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin."

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Nabeire amo nainwe amatuko aya onsi, na aye tomanyeti, Filipo? Oyondorire inche, ororire na Tata; naki aye ogoteba: Tworokie Tata?
english: Jesus answered: "Don't you know me, Philip, even after I have been among you such a long time? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, 'Show us the Father'?

ekegusii: Jesus answered: "Watch out that no one deceives you.
english: Yeso akabairaneria, “Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoboria, “Naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Elegioni”, ekiagera ebirecha ebinge biamosoete.
english: Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" "Legion," he replied, because many demons had gone into him.

ekegusii: Yeso akaboria ise, “Nkorwa kero ki anyoretwe naya?” Agateba, “Nkorwa obwana bwaye.
english: Jesus asked the boy's father, "How long has he been like this?" "From childhood," he answered.

ekegusii: Yeso agatebia abanto b’amachiko na Abafarisai, akababoria, “Inee! Mboronge kogwenia ase rituko ri’Esabato, gose taibo?”
english: Jesus asked the Pharisees and experts in the law, "Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?"

ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tari bonsi ikomi basibeka? Baria kianda, ng’ai bare?
english: Jesus asked, "Were not all ten cleansed? Where are the other nine?

ekegusii: Bamura bamwabo bakamotebia, “Imoka korwa aiga, ogende Boyahudi, erinde aborokigwa bao banyare korora emeremo yao ogokora.
english: Jesus' brothers said to him, "You ought to leave here and go to Judea, so that your disciples may see the miracles you do.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akarangeria aborokigwa baye bache asare, akabora, “Inche naroreire emeganda amabera, ekiagera babeire amo nainche amatuko atato, batari nendagera; na tindigeti kobatiga bagende nenchara, babaise kogoya inchera.”
english: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, "I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may collapse on the way."

ekegusii: Yeso akarera ase eriogi rinene, akabora, “Tata, ase amaboko ao nabekire omoika one!” Nyuma gakwanire aya agatweka mo.
english: Jesus called out with a loud voice, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit." When he had said this, he breathed his last.

ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto bache asare, akabatebia, “Igwa na manya:
english: Jesus called the crowd to him and said, "Listen and understand.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarangeria bache asare, akabora, “Mwamanyire ng’a abagambi b’Ebisaku bakogambera abanto, na abanene babo nigo bare nokobua igoro asebare.
english: Jesus called them together and said, "You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.

ekegusii: Yeso akabarangeria, akabatebia, “Mwamanyire ng’a baria babarirwe koba abagambi b’abanto b’Ebisaku nigo bakobagambera ne chinguru, na abanene babo nigo bakobachika.
english: Jesus called them together and said, "You know that those who are regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.

ekegusii: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.
english: Yeso akagenda akabogoria omogati, akabaa, ne chinswe boigo.

ekegusii: Yeso Kristo buna arenge igoro, na buna are rero, nabo arabe goika kare na kare.
