english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatebia Petero, “Irania omoyio oo ase ekerende kiaye. Inee! Egekombe eke Tata ang’eire, tinkenywera?”
english: Jesus commanded Peter, "Put your sword away! Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?"

ekegusii: Yeso akabachika tibatebia monto, korende buna amentete kobakania, naboigo bamentete koraria amang’ana aya.
english: Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone. But the more he did so, the more they kept talking about it.

ekegusii: Naende agateba, “Omonto oyomo narenge nabamura babere.
english: Jesus continued: "There was a man who had two sons.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Aye omokungu, inyegene, ensa neche, motamosasime Tata ase egetunwa eke, nonya nase Yerusalemu.
english: Jesus declared, "Believe me, woman, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Nabo mbire ebikone binde ebinge Yeso akorete ase amasio ’aborokigwa baye bitarikiri ase ebuku eye,
english: Jesus did many other miraculous signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.

ekegusii: Nare naende ayande amange aya Yeso akorete; naro kararikwe erimo erimo, nigo ngokaga ng’a nonya nense yonsi tegoisana chibuku echiranyare korikwa chibekwe.
english: Jesus did many other things as well. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the whole world would not have room for the books that would be written.

ekegusii: Korende tamoiraneria ing’ana. Aborokigwa baye bagacha, bakamosorora, bakabora, “Mokanie, agende, ekiagera akona‐gototunyana ogotoakera eriogi.”
english: Jesus did not answer a word. So his disciples came to him and urged him, "Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us."

ekegusii: Yeso tamwanchera, korende akamotebia, “Genda nka bwoo ase abamino, obatebie amang’ana amanene aya Omonene agokoreire, naende buna akororeire amabera.”
english: Jesus did not let him, but said, "Go home to your family and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you."

ekegusii: Yeso agasoa Yeriko, akaba ngoeta are egati‐gati yaye.
english: Jesus entered Jericho and was passing through.

ekegusii: Yeso agasoa Yerusalemu agaika ase Hekalu ime; gachia korigereria chinsemo chionsi, ekiagera nigo kiarenge ekero kia mogoroba, agasoka, akagenda Bethania amo na baria ikomi na babere.
english: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went to the temple. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ya Nyasae, akabasokia isiko bonsi abarenge koonia na kogora ime ase Hekalu, akaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare koonchoreria chibesa, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma.
english: Jesus entered the temple area and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.

ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Hekalu ime na kworokereria, agachierwa nabakuani abanene na abagaaka b’abanto, bakamoboria, “Nase okobua ki ogokora amang’ana aya? Ning’o okoete okobua oko?”
english: Jesus entered the temple courts, and, while he was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. "By what authority are you doing these things?" they asked. "And who gave you this authority?"

ekegusii: Jesus found a young donkey and sat upon it, as it is written,
english: Yeso akanyora emori y’etigere, akayeriina, buna yarigetwe,

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Omwana takonyara gokora ring’ana ere bweka, otatiga riria aroche Ise agokora; naki onsi aya agokora ere, ayio naro n’Omwana agokora.
english: Jesus gave them this answer: "I tell you the truth, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.

ekegusii: Jesus got up and went with him, and so did his disciples.
english: Yeso akaimoka agatunyana omonto oria, ere na aborokigwa baye.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso nigo akwanete amang’ana ’amakweri aye; na barabwo bagakaga ng’a nigo agokwana amang’ana ’okorara chitoro.
english: Jesus had been speaking of his death, but his disciples thought he meant natural sleep.

ekegusii: Yeso agasogwa namabera, agakuna amaiso abo. Erio kegima bakaba nkorora bare, bakamotunyana.
english: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.

ekegusii: Naki Yeso nigo abarirwe ng’a nemogwenerete abe nobonene mono kobua Musa, buna omoagachi enyomba are nogosikwa kobua enyomba enyene.
english: Jesus has been found worthy of greater honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.

ekegusii: Yeso akaigwa ng’a bamosokirie isiko, akamorora, akamoboria, “Aye kwamwegenire Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto?”
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and when he found him, he said, "Do you believe in the Son of Man?"

ekegusii: Yeso omanyete ng’a Ise omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye, naende ng’a nigo arwete ase Nyasae, naende nkoirana are ase Nyasae.
english: Jesus knew that the Father had put all things under his power, and that he had come from God and was returning to God;

ekegusii: Konya omanyire ebirengererio biabo, akabatebia, “Kera oboruoti kobwatananekanire borobwo obonyene tibogotenena; na kera omochie na enyomba kobiatananekanire, birobio ebinyene tibigotenena;
english: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.

ekegusii: Ere konya omanyire ebirengererio biabo, akabatebia, “Kera oboruoti kobwatananekanire borobwo obonyene nigo bogosareka, na enyomba yaatananekire ero enyene nigo ekogwa.
english: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them: "Any kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and a house divided against itself will fall.

ekegusii: Yeso namanyete ebirengererio biabo, akairaneria, “Naki mokorengereria ase chinkoro chiaino?
english: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, "Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa aria, akagenda goika chimbebe chia Turo na Sidoni. Agasoa ase enyomba, akarigia tamanyekana na monto, korende tanyara kobiseka.
english: Jesus left that place and went to the vicinity of Tyre. He entered a house and did not want anyone to know it; yet he could not keep his presence secret.

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase esinagogi, agasoa ase enyomba ya Simion. Nabo ng’ina biara Simion konya orwarire esosera; bakamosaba ase engencho yaye.
english: Jesus left the synagogue and went to the home of Simon. Now Simon's mother-in-law was suffering from a high fever, and they asked Jesus to help her.

ekegusii: Yeso agatiga Hekalu, akaba nkogenda are, na aborokigwa baye bakamochiera komworokia amaagacho e Hekalu.
english: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came up to him to call his attention to its buildings.

ekegusii: Yeso akarua aroro akagenderera, agacha ensemo y’enyancha ya Galili, akariina ebitunwa igoro, agaikaransa aroro.
english: Jesus left there and went along the Sea of Galilee. Then he went up on a mountainside and sat down.

ekegusii: Akarua agwo, agaika ase ense yaye omonyene; aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.
english: Jesus left there and went to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.

ekegusii: Yeso akarigereria chinsemo chionsi, agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!"

ekegusii: Yeso akamobeta amaiso, akamwancha, akamotebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremerete; genda, oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi, oe abataka, na aye nobe nenibo igoro; erio oche ontunyane.”
english: Jesus looked at him and loved him. "One thing you lack," he said. "Go, sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."

ekegusii: Nabo Yeso akamorigereria, akabora, “Nabe aakong’u ase abare abanda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae!
english: Jesus looked at him and said, "How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!

ekegusii: Yeso akabarigereria, akabora, “Ase mwanyabanto takonyarekana, korende ase Nyasae taibo, ekiagera onsi nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”
english: Jesus looked at them and said, "With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God."

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabarigereria, akabatebia, “Ase mwanyabanto takonyarekana, korende ase Nyasae onsi nigo akonyarekana.”
english: Jesus looked at them and said, "With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible."

ekegusii: Akabarigereria, akabora, “Engencho yaye ninki, ring’ana eri ririkeire: “Rigena abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona?”
english: Jesus looked directly at them and asked, "Then what is the meaning of that which is written: "'The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone'?

ekegusii: Na Yeso nigo anchete Martha, na mosubati omwabo, na Lazaro.
english: Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.

ekegusii: Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamotebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bokamorua.
english: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. "I am willing," he said. "Be clean!" And immediately the leprosy left him.

ekegusii: Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akamokuna, akamotebia, “Nanchire; sibeka.” Erio agwo oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma bogasibigwa.
english: Jesus reached out his hand and touched the man. "I am willing," he said. "Be clean!" Immediately he was cured of his leprosy.

ekegusii: Yeso agatogonyera ekerecha, na kerokio kegatiga omwana oria na ere akagwenigwa ekero keria.
english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed from that moment.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, “Nase ki inwe mogosaria ogochika kwa Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino?
english: Jesus replied, "And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?

ekegusii: Agateba, “Nainwe abanto b’amachiko, obobe nobwaino! Ekiagera mogotweka abanto chigurube chindito, na inwe abanyene timori gokuna chigurube echio nonya nase ekemo ki’ebiara biaino.
english: Jesus replied, "And you experts in the law, woe to you, because you load people down with burdens they can hardly carry, and you yourselves will not lift one finger to help them.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Inee! Timori gosira ase aya, ekiagera timomanyeti amariko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae?
english: Jesus replied, "Are you not in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Nosesenirie aye Simion, mosinto o Yona, ekiagera eri tomaanoreiri nomobere na amanyinga, korende na Tata one ore igoro.
english: Jesus replied, "Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for this was not revealed to you by man, but by my Father in heaven.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Ebibwe mbire namakuruma, ne chinyoni chia igoro nchire nebiswa, korende Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto tari naase akobeka omotwe oye.”
english: Jesus replied, "Foxes have holes and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head."

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Mosani, nase ki gwacha aa?” Erio bagacha, bakamobwata Yeso, bakamoira.
english: Jesus replied, "Friend, do what you came for." Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus and arrested him.

ekegusii: Jesus replied, "Go back and report to John what you hear and see:
english: Yeso akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Genda motebie Yohana ayamwaigwa na ayamwarora:

ekegusii: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
english: Yeso akabairaneria, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Onde bwensi ogokora ebibe, oyio nomosomba bw’ebibe,

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nekeene nabatebirie; Komorabe nokwegena motabeti na gosiereria konde, tari erio ri’omote rioka morakore, korende nonya namotebie egetunwa eke: Tegoka, otugutwe enyancha ime, narikoreke.
english: Jesus replied, "I tell you the truth, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, 'Go, throw yourself into the sea,' and it will be done.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nainche boigo nimbaborie ring’ana erimo, komorang’iranerie, nainche boigo nimbatebie nase okobua ki ngokora aya.
english: Jesus replied, "I will also ask you one question. If you answer me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Nainche nimbaborie ring’ana erimo, nainwe mong’iranerie, erio nimbatebie ase okobua ki ngokorera aya.
english: Jesus replied, "I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Omonto karanyanche, abwate ring’ana riane, naende Tata one namwanche, na intwe natoche asare, tokore obomenyo bwaito amo nere.
english: Jesus replied, "If anyone loves me, he will obey my teaching. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Kondetogie inche omonyene, obonene bwane tibori gento; oyogontogia n’Tata one, oyo mogoteba ng’a nere Nyasae oino.
english: Jesus replied, "If I glorify myself, my glory means nothing. My Father, whom you claim as your God, is the one who glorifies me.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akamoiraneria, “Ancha iga bono, ekiagera naboigo etogwenerete goikerania oboronge bwonsi.” Erio agwo akamwanchera.
english: Jesus replied, "Let it be so now; it is proper for us to do this to fulfill all righteousness." Then John consented.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Togende aase aande goika ebichie bire ang’e, ninyare korandia na aroro boigo, ekiagera ase ayio naro nachicheire.”
english: Jesus replied, "Let us go somewhere else-- to the nearby villages-- so I can preach there also. That is why I have come."

ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Omonto oyo, ning’o ombekire koba omogambi gose omwatanani igoro asemore?”
english: Jesus replied, "Man, who appointed me a judge or an arbiter between you?"

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Nase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiaino Musa abaerete ribaga gotiga abakungu baino, korende korwa omochakano ayio tarenge bo.
english: Jesus replied, "Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because your hearts were hard. But it was not this way from the beginning.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Omonto tari orabeke okoboko kwaye ase obokombe bwe chieri, naende arigererie nyuma, oragwenere ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: Jesus replied, "No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for service in the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Korende akabatebia, “Tari bonsi baranyare gwancha ring’ana eri, otatiga abwo baeirwe.
english: Jesus replied, "Not everyone can accept this word, but only those to whom it has been given.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, akabora, “Ensa yaikire, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto abakwe.
english: Jesus replied, "The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

ekegusii: Akairaneria, “Oyo ogotobeka okoboko kwaye amo nainche ase esani, oyio nere orandue.
english: Jesus replied, "The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Abana b’ense eye nigo bakonyuoma na konyuomwa;
english: Jesus replied, "The people of this age marry and are given in marriage.

ekegusii: Jesus replied, "They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat."
english: Yeso akabora, “Tibagwenereti kogenda; inwe bae endagera barie.”

ekegusii: Jesus replied, "To be sure, Elijah comes and will restore all things.
english: Yeso akairaneria, “Nekeene, n’Elija ore gocha ritang’ani, na ere naroisie onsi.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Nekeene n’Elija ore gocha ritang’ani, na koroisia onsi; korende amo naya, ekiagera arikire ng’a Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nachandwe namange na gochaywa?
english: Jesus replied, "To be sure, Elijah does come first, and restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer much and be rejected?

ekegusii: Akabora, “Aya takonyarekana ase mwanyabanto, nigo akonyarekana ase Nyasae.”
english: Jesus replied, "What is impossible with men is possible with God."

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akabairaneria, “Mwasirire inwe, ekiagera timomanyeti amariko, nonya nokobua kwa Nyasae.
english: Jesus replied, "You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akamotebia, “Aya ngokora inche, tokoyamanya bono, korende noyamanye nyuma.”
english: Jesus replied, "You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand."

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Genda, omwana oo nabe moyo.” Omonto oria akegena ring’ana riria atebetigwe na Yeso, akabwatia enchera yaye.
english: Jesus replied, "You may go. Your son will live." The man took Jesus at his word and departed.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Omonto oyomo okorete omoyega omonene; akarangeria abanto abange.
english: Jesus replied: "A certain man was preparing a great banquet and invited many guests.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Mwanche Omonene Nyasae oo nenkoro yao yonsi, na omoyo oo bwonsi, na obong’aini bwao bwonsi.
english: Jesus replied: "'Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.'

ekegusii: Yeso akairana gochia Galili ne chinguru chi’Omoika, chinkuma chigasarera ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense eria.
english: Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and news about him spread through the whole countryside.

ekegusii: (Agakwana eri ase okworokia imakweri ki aramotogie Nyasae). Erio gakoorire gokwana aya, akamotebia, “Ntunyana?”
english: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. Then he said to him, "Follow me!"

ekegusii: Jesus said to her, "I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will live, even though he dies;
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Inche ninche okobokigwa na obogima; oyonyegenire inche, naisa gokwa, nabe moyo.

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Mariamu.” Ere akeonchora, akamotebia ase Ekeibirania, “Raboni!” (Okoonchorwa kwaye, Omworokia).
english: Jesus said to her, "Mary." She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, "Rabboni!" (which means Teacher).

ekegusii: Jesus said to her, "Your brother will rise again."
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Momura omino naboke.”

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamotebia, “Karue aa, Saitani! Ekiagera nerikire: “Osasime Omonene, Nyasae oo, omokorere ere bweka.”
english: Jesus said to him, "Away from me, Satan! For it is written: 'Worship the Lord your God, and serve him only.'"

ekegusii: Jesus said to him, "I will go and heal him."
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Ninchiche komogwenia.”

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Tiga abakure batindeke abakure babo, korende aye genda orandie oboruoti bwa Nyasae.”
english: Jesus said to him, "Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Jesus said to him, "Receive your sight; your faith has healed you."
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Oegwe okorora; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.”

ekegusii: Jesus said to him, "Today salvation has come to this house, because this man, too, is a son of Abraham.
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Rero ogotooreka gwaikire enyomba eye, ekiagera oyo boigo nomwana o Ibrahimu.

ekegusii: Yeso agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Amang’ana ’okogocha takomocha kooroka, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okoyarenta!
english: Jesus said to his disciples: "Things that cause people to sin are bound to come, but woe to that person through whom they come.

ekegusii: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, "Stand up in front of everyone."
english: Agatebia omonto oria okoboko kwaye kwagataete, “Tenena gati aa!”

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Ichoria chinsiongo echi amache.” Bagachiichoria goika igoro.
english: Jesus said to the servants, "Fill the jars with water"; so they filled them to the brim.

ekegusii: Agatebia omokungu oria, “Okwegena kwao kwagotooririe; genda nomorembe.”
english: Jesus said to the woman, "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Renta aiga echinde chie chinswe echi mwarubire bono.”
english: Jesus said to them, "Bring some of the fish you have just caught."

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Inchuo morie!” Gose onde tarenge ase aborokigwa baria orenge na boremu komoboria, “Aye naye ng’o?” Ekiagera mbamanyete ng’a n’Omonene.
english: Jesus said to them, "Come and have breakfast." None of the disciples dared ask him, "Who are you?" They knew it was the Lord.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Timwana gosoma ase amariko: “Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona. Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?
english: Jesus said to them, "Have you never read in the Scriptures: "'The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes'?

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Nakorete ogokora okomo, na inwe mwensi nigo mogokumetie.
english: Jesus said to them, "I did one miracle, and you are all astonished.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Nekeene nabatebirie: Ase ense enyia, ekero Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto agochi‐gocha goikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, inwe abamwantunyanire namoche goikaransera ebirogo bi’obonene ikomi na bibere, mokogambera ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.
english: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Tari Musa obaete omogati oria orwete igoro, korende n’Tata one ore kobaa omogati bw’ekeene okorwa igoro.
english: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, it is not Moses who has given you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Ekeene, ekeene nabatebirie: Motarieti omobere oye Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto na konywa amanyinga aye, timori nobogima ime yaino.
english: Jesus said to them, "I tell you the truth, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Onye Nyasae n’Iso oino are, anga monyanchete inche; naki narure ase Nyasae, na igo nachire; gose tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende nere ontomire.
english: Jesus said to them, "If God were your Father, you would love me, for I came from God and now am here. I have not come on my own; but he sent me.

ekegusii: Jesus said to them, "My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I, too, am working."
english: Yeso akabairaneria, “Tata ngokora are emeremo nonya ngoika bono, na inche ngokora nde emeremo.”

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Omobani takomocha gosikwa, otatiga ase ense yaye, na ase eamate yaye, na ase enyomba yaye.”
english: Jesus said to them, "Only in his hometown, among his relatives and in his own house is a prophet without honor."

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ekeene, namontebie omoreng’anio oyo: Omogwenia, egwenie aye omonyene; amang’ana onsi twaigure akorekire Kapernaumu, yakore aiga ase ense yao.”
english: Jesus said to them, "Surely you will quote this proverb to me: 'Physician, heal yourself! Do here in your hometown what we have heard that you did in Capernaum.'"

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Abaruoti b’abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakogambera abanto; naende abare nokobua igoro asebare barokwa Abakori Abaya.
english: Jesus said to them, "The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them; and those who exercise authority over them call themselves Benefactors.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Egekombe nkonywera inche, namokenywere, korende ribaga ri’ogoikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio na ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okobee, tindi nokobua gw’okobaa, otatiga abwo bagacheire na Tata one nabwo barariegwe.”
english: Jesus said to them, "You will indeed drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared by my Father."

ekegusii: Jesus said to them: "Watch out that no one deceives you.
english: Yeso agachaka kobatebia, “Mwerende, monto onde tabang’aina na kobasiria,

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Tonkuna, ekiagera tindagenda ase Tata one, korende genda ase abaminto, obatebie, ng’a nkogenda nde ase Tata one oyore Iso oino, ase Nyasae one oyore Nyasae oino.”
english: Jesus said, "Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet returned to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, 'I am returning to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'"

ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Tata, baabere, ekiagera tibamanyeti eke bagokora.” Bakagabana chianga chiaye, bagachiakera obomera.
english: Jesus said, "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing." And they divided up his clothes by casting lots.

ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Inche nigo nachire ase ense eye ase ekina, erinde abatari korora barore, na barabwo abakorora babe emeuko.”
english: Jesus said, "For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind will see and those who see will become blind."

ekegusii: Yeso akabora, “Ikaransia abanto.” Mbwarenge aroro obonyansi obonge aase aria. Igo abasacha bagaikaransa, barabwo nigo barenge chilifu isano.
english: Jesus said, "Have the people sit down." There was plenty of grass in that place, and the men sat down, about five thousand of them.

ekegusii: Jesus said, "I am with you for only a short time, and then I go to the one who sent me.
english: Erio Yeso akabora, “Nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe, erio ningende asare ere oyontomete.

ekegusii: Yeso akabairaneria, “Onye mwarenge emeuko, anga timori nebibe; korende bono nigo mogoteba: Nkorora tore; gaki ebibe biaino biagendereire kobao.
english: Jesus said, "If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin; but now that you claim you can see, your guilt remains.

ekegusii: korende Yeso agateba, “Batige abana bache asende, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oboruoti bwa igoro nobwabo.”
english: Jesus said, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these."

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, “Oboruoti bwane tibori obw’ense eye. Onye oboruoti bwane mbwarenge obw’ense eye, abasomba baane anga mbandwanerera, tinyara kobekwa ase amaboko ’Abayahudi, korende bono oboruoti bwane ti bori obw’aa.”
english: Jesus said, "My kingdom is not of this world. If it were, my servants would fight to prevent my arrest by the Jews. But now my kingdom is from another place."

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobatebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.”
english: Jesus said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things."

ekegusii: Yeso akairaneria, akabora, “Eriogi eri tiricheti ase engencho yane, korende nase engencho yaino.
english: Jesus said, "This voice was for your benefit, not mine.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Kwegenire ekiagera nagotebia ng’a nakoroche inse ase omoko? Norore amang’ana amanene kobua aya.”
english: Jesus said, "You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You shall see greater things than that."

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Kwamororire, naende nere oyogokwana naye nere oyio.”
english: Jesus said, "You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you."

ekegusii: Yeso agaikaransa korigereria ekebekerero gi’esadaka, akarigereria buna omoganda okobeka chibesa ase ekebekerero. Abande abarenge abanda bakabeka chinyinge.
english: Jesus sat down opposite the place where the offerings were put and watched the crowd putting their money into the temple treasury. Many rich people threw in large amounts.

ekegusii: Yeso akamanya ng’a mbarigetie komoboria, akabatebia, “Inee! Nigo mokoborania inwe ase inwe ase erio natebire: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore, naende nkere ekero egeke morandore?
english: Jesus saw that they wanted to ask him about this, so he said to them, "Are you asking one another what I meant when I said, 'In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me'?

ekegusii: Jesus sent him away at once with a strong warning:
english: Akamokania bokong’u, akamosokia agende,

ekegusii: Jesus sent him home, saying, "Don't go into the village."
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Genda bwoo, tosoa nonya nagachie!”

ekegusii: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, "Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover."
english: Erio Yeso agatoma Petero na Yohana, akabora, “Genda motoroiserie Epasaka, erinde toyerie.”

ekegusii: Aya onsi Yeso nigo ayakwanete ase emeganda eria ase emereng’anio; na tabatebetie ring’ana otatiga ase emereng’anio,
english: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowd in parables; he did not say anything to them without using a parable.

ekegusii: Naende Yeso agakwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio akabora,
english: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying:

ekegusii: Agasoa obwato, akaamboka, agaika omochie oye.
english: Jesus stepped into a boat, crossed over and came to his own town.

ekegusii: Jesus stopped and called them. "What do you want me to do for you?" he asked.
english: Yeso agatenena, akabarangeria, akababoria, “Ninki morigetie mbakorere?”

ekegusii: Yeso agatenena, agachika arentwe asare. Agachia komoika ang’e, akamoboria,
english: Jesus stopped and ordered the man to be brought to him. When he came near, Jesus asked him,

ekegusii: Jesus stopped and said, "Call him." So they called to the blind man, "Cheer up! On your feet! He's calling you."
english: Yeso agatenena, akabora, “Morangerie!” Bakarangeria omouko oria, bakamotebia, “Remia enkoro yao, imoka, okorangeirie.”

ekegusii: Yeso akagororoka tarora monto onde otatiga omokungu oria, akamoboria, “Omokungu, ng’ai abagosoeri bao bare? Onde tari ogokogambia?”
english: Jesus straightened up and asked her, "Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?"

ekegusii: Jesus strictly warned them not to tell this to anyone.
english: Akabachika na kobakania tibatebia monto ring’ana eri,

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, agaika chimbebe chia Boyahudi, ng’umbu ya Yorodan. Abanto abange bakamosangererekera naende; akaborokereria aroro, buna anarete botambe.
english: Jesus then left that place and went into the region of Judea and across the Jordan. Again crowds of people came to him, and as was his custom, he taught them.

ekegusii: Jesus then took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted. He did the same with the fish.
english: Yeso akabogoria emegati; kayesesenirie, akagabera abaikaransete; naboigo ne chinswe chiria, koreng’ana buna barigetie.

ekegusii: Naende agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Narenge omonto omonda, orenge nomorendi. Oyio agasoerwa asare ng’a osiareire enibo yaye.
english: Jesus told his disciples: "There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.

ekegusii: Akabatebia omoreng’anio onde, agateba, “Oboruoti bwa igoro nigo bogwekaine nomonto obusurete embusuro engiya ase omogondo oye;
english: Jesus told them another parable: "The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akaira baria ikomi na babere, akabatebia, “Rora, ngotiira tore kogenda Yerusalemu, naende amang’ana onsi ayarikeretwe Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nababani naikeranigwe.
english: Jesus took the Twelve aside and told them, "We are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written by the prophets about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.

ekegusii: Korende Yeso akeonchora, agatebia Petero, “Irana nyuma yane, Saitani! Aye nigo origetie gontanga, ekiagera aye tori ase ensemo ya Nyasae, korende nase mwanyabanto.”
english: Jesus turned and said to Peter, "Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me; you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of men."

ekegusii: Yeso akabeonchorera, akabora, “Abaiseke ba Yerusalemu, timondeera inche, korende ereere inwe abanyene, na abana baino.
english: Jesus turned and said to them, "Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for me; weep for yourselves and for your children.

ekegusii: Yeso akeonchora, akamorora, akamotebia, “Moiseke one, remia enkoro; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.” Omokungu oria akagwena erio kegima.
english: Jesus turned and saw her. "Take heart, daughter," he said, "your faith has healed you." And the woman was healed from that moment.

ekegusii: Omoreng’anio oyo Yeso akabatebia, korende barabwo tibamanyete amang’ana ayio abatebetie.
english: Jesus used this figure of speech, but they did not understand what he was telling them.

ekegusii: Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about him.
english: Akabakania tibatebia monto amang’ana aye.

ekegusii: Bono ngoseria arenge ekerecha rimama. Ekero ekerecha keria giasokire, omonto oria rimama agakwana; abanto bagakumia.
english: Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute. When the demon left, the man who had been mute spoke, and the crowd was amazed.

ekegusii: Ere omonyene nigo arenge ase obwato ime magega oraire igoro ase omoito. Bakamotura, bakamotebia, “Omworokia, tari gento asore gatogosira?”
english: Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on a cushion. The disciples woke him and said to him, "Teacher, don't you care if we drown?"

ekegusii: Agasoka, akagenda goika egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, buna engencho yaye yarenge, na aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.
english: Jesus went out as usual to the Mount of Olives, and his disciples followed him.

ekegusii: Yeso agaetanana emechie yonsi na ebichie, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti na kogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi.
english: Jesus went through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the good news of the kingdom and healing every disease and sickness.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso nigo arenge konagoetanana ase ense engima ya Galili, okworokereria ase chisinagogi chiabo, okorandia amang’ana amaya ay’oboruoti, okogwenia amarwaire onsi na oboreu bwonsi obwarenge ase abanto.
english: Jesus went throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and sickness among the people.

ekegusii: Agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akarangeria abwo arigetie ere omonyene; na barabwo bakamochiera.
english: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.

ekegusii: Jesus wept.
english: Yeso akaiyeria amariga.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso ageatanana amo naborokigwa baye, bakagenda nyancha. Omoganda omonene korwa Galili okabatunyana, naboigo korwa ase Boyahudi,
english: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the lake, and a large crowd from Galilee followed.

ekegusii: Na Yeso oichire n’Omoika Omochenu, akairana korwa Yorodan, agatang’anwa n’Omoika kogenda ase erooro,
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit in the desert,

ekegusii: Jesus, knowing all that was going to happen to him, went out and asked them, "Who is it you want?"
english: Nabo Yeso, kamanyete onsi ayagochia komonyora, akaoroka, akababoria, “Ning’o mokorigia?”

ekegusii: Nabo Yeso namanyete ng’a mbarigetie gocha komoira, erinde bamobeke abe omoruoti. Ase ayio akerusanania, akagenda naende egetunwa ere bweka.
english: Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by himself.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Yeso achia komanya ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo, akabogoria omwana, akamobeka ang’e asare,
english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, took a little child and had him stand beside him.

ekegusii: Nabo Yeso oichanete naende ase omoyo oye, agaika ase embeera. Ero nigo yarenge rikuruma, naende rigena ndiabegetwe igoro yaye.
english: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.

ekegusii: Naende Yeso, oyokorokwa Yusto, obakwanirie. Abwo nabwo boka ase abarogete bare abakori emeremo amo nainche ase engencho y’oboruoti bwa Nyasae; na barabwo nigo barenge kondemia.
english: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have proved a comfort to me.

ekegusii: Agatoma amang’ana ase Musa, okomotebia, “Inche Yetero, iso biara, nachire amo na mokao na abana baye babere.”
english: Jethro had sent word to him, "I, your father-in-law Jethro, am coming to you with your wife and her two sons."

ekegusii: Yetero akagoka ase amaya onsi Nyasae akorerete Abaisraeli ase okobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri,
english: Jethro was delighted to hear about all the good things the LORD had done for Israel in rescuing them from the hand of the Egyptians.

ekegusii: Nabo Yetero, ise biara Musa, amo na moka Musa na abana baye babere, bagacha ase erooro aase Musa konya atoorire ase egetunwa kia Nyasae.
english: Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, together with Moses' sons and wife, came to him in the desert, where he was camped near the mountain of God.

ekegusii: Yeturi na Nafisi, na Kedema. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Isumaeli.
english: Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.

ekegusii: Yeusi na Sakia, na Mirima. Abana aba baye nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.
english: Jeuz, Sakia and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.

ekegusii: Abayahudi nigo bakonakoboria barore ebikone, na Abagiriki bakorigia obong’aini,
english: Jews demand miraculous signs and Greeks look for wisdom,

ekegusii: Yesebeli mokaye akamotebia, “Inee! Naye okogambera Abaisraeli, gose tari aye? Imoka! Orie endagera, tiga enkoro yao ebe nomosasoko; ninkonyorere omogondo bw’emesabibu o Naboti Omoyesireeli.”
english: Jezebel his wife said, "Is this how you act as king over Israel? Get up and eat! Cheer up. I'll get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite."

ekegusii: Na omobere o Yesebeli okwete nobe buna esike igoro ase oboremo bore Yesireeli, goika monto onde tari orayomanyererie ng’a oyo nomobere o Yesebeli.”
english: Jezebel's body will be like refuse on the ground in the plot at Jezreel, so that no one will be able to say, 'This is Jezebel.'"

ekegusii: Jezreel, Jokdeam, Zanoah,
english: na Yesireeli, na Yokidamu, na Sanoa,

ekegusii: Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Nyasae are moyo, onye otakwana, abanto baane anga nigo barenge kobabwatia goika mambia.”
english: Joab answered, "As surely as God lives, if you had not spoken, the men would have continued the pursuit of their brothers until morning."

ekegusii: Yoabu agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase omoruoti ase okomosika na komosesenia. Naende akabora, “Rero inche, omosomba oo, namanyire ng’a nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, aye omoruoti, omonene one, ekiagera kwang’ikeraneirie okogania kwane.”
english: Joab fell with his face to the ground to pay him honor, and he blessed the king. Joab said, "Today your servant knows that he has found favor in your eyes, my lord the king, because the king has granted his servant's request."

ekegusii: Yoabu akaa Daudi omobaro bw’abanto. Ase Abaisraeli bonsi abwo barenge komanya korwana esegi nemioro nigo barenge abanto emilioni eyemo, ne chilifu rigana erimo (1,100,000), na ase Abayuda abanto chilifu amagana ane na emerongo etano na ebere (470,000).
english: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to David: In all Israel there were one million one hundred thousand men who could handle a sword, including four hundred and seventy thousand in Judah.

ekegusii: Yoabu akaa omoruoti omobaro bw’abanto abaare konyara korwana esegi nemioro. Ase Abaisraeli nigo barenge abanto chilifu amagana atano na atato (800,000), na ase Abayuda chilifu amagana atano (500,000).
english: Joab reported the number of the fighting men to the king: In Israel there were eight hundred thousand able-bodied men who could handle a sword, and in Judah five hundred thousand.

ekegusii: Yoabu agakwania Amasa, “Mbuya ore oyominto?” Erio akamobwata chinderu nokoboko gw’okorio buna nigo arigetie komonyunyunta.
english: Joab said to Amasa, "How are you, my brother?" Then Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.

ekegusii: Joab said to the man who had told him this, "What! You saw him? Why didn't you strike him to the ground right there? Then I would have had to give you ten shekels of silver and a warrior's belt."
english: Yoabu akamoiraneria, “Onye kwamorora, ninki kiaba tikwamoita ara rimo? Inche anga naba nomogoko inkoe chibesa chisekeli chie chifeta ikomi, amo norokini.”

ekegusii: Erio agatebia Abisai, “Onye Abasiiria bakombua, rirorio oche onkonye; korende onye Abaamoni bagokobua, rirorio inche ninchiche ngokonye.
english: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to come to my rescue; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will come to rescue you.

ekegusii: Erio agatebia Abisai, “Onye Abasiiria bakombua, rirorio oche onkonye, korende onye Abaamoni bagokobua, rirorio inche inchiche ngokonye.
english: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, then you are to rescue me; but if the Ammonites are too strong for you, then I will rescue you.

ekegusii: Erio Yoabu akabora, “Tinkora gosaria chingaki gokwana naye boire.” Akaimokia amatimo atato, akabeta Abisalomu egekuba igoro, agachia konacha enkoro, ekero Abisalomu asung’unanete ase omote igoro ore moyo.
english: Joab said, "I'm not going to wait like this for you." So he took three javelins in his hand and plunged them into Absalom's heart while Absalom was still alive in the oak tree.

ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu aroche ng’a esegi nigo ere bosio bwaye na nyuma, agachora abanto abakong’u abamanyete korwana esegi, akabaroberia barwane n’Abasiiria.
english: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.

ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu aroche ng’a esegi nigo ere bosio na nyuma, agachora abanto abakong’u, abamanyete korwana esegi, akabaroberia barwane n’Abasiiria.
english: Joab saw that there were battle lines in front of him and behind him; so he selected some of the best troops in Israel and deployed them against the Arameans.

ekegusii: Yoabu agatoma amang’ana onsi ase Daudi, buna esegi egendererete.
english: Joab sent David a full account of the battle.

ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, na abanto ba Daudi bakagenda, bakaumerana nabarabwo ase ritibo ria Gibeoni. Abanto aba bakabeera ensemo eyemo ye ritibo riria, na abwo bande ensemo ende.
english: Joab son of Zeruiah and David's men went out and met them at the pool of Gibeon. One group sat down on one side of the pool and one group on the other side.

ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, agachaka kobara Abaisraeli, korende takoorete emeremo eyio. Nyasae akaba nendamwamu ase Abaisraeli ase engencho y’okobarwa koria, na omobaro oyio tobekiri ase Ebuku y’ogokora gwa Daudi.
english: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count the men but did not finish. Wrath came on Israel on account of this numbering, and the number was not entered in the book of the annals of King David.

ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, akamanya ng’a omoruoti nigo aganetie Abisalomu mono.
english: Joab son of Zeruiah knew that the king's heart longed for Absalom.

ekegusii: Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, nere orenge omochiki bw’emeganda y’abarwani, na Yehosafati, mosinto bw’Ahiludi, nere orenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka.
english: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was recorder;

ekegusii: Yoabu karure ase Daudi agatoma abanto babwatie Abineri bamwoyie korwa ase engoro y’amache ya Sira, korende Daudi tamanyete amang’ana ayio.
english: Joab then left David and sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah. But David did not know it.

ekegusii: Erio Yoabu agatoma abanto gochia ase Daudi komotebia, “Narwanirie Raba, nabwatire ensemo y’omochie ase amache aochaine.
english: Joab then sent messengers to David, saying, "I have fought against Rabbah and taken its water supply.

ekegusii: Yoabu nigo arenge omochiki bw’abarwani bonsi b’esegi ase Abaisraeli, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, nere igo arenge igoro y’Abakereti na Abapeleti.
english: Joab was over Israel's entire army; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Kerethites and Pelethites;

ekegusii: Yoabu agatebigwa ng’a omoruoti Daudi nkorera are na kweumia ase engencho y’Abisalomu.
english: Joab was told, "The king is weeping and mourning for Absalom."

ekegusii: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son and Jeatherai his son.
english: na Yoa omomura oye, na Ido omomura oye, na Zera omomura oye, na Yeateri omomura oye.

ekegusii: na Yoana moka Kusa, omorendi bwe Herode, na Susana, na abande abange. Abwo nigo barenge kobakorera ne chinibo chiabo.
english: Joanna the wife of Cuza, the manager of Herod's household; Susanna; and many others. These women were helping to support them out of their own means.

ekegusii: Yoashi agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene ase amatuko aye onsi, ekiagera Yehoyada omokuani abete okomosemia.
english: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the years Jehoiada the priest instructed him.

ekegusii: Yoashi agakora ayare amaronge ase amaiso ’Omonene ase amatuko onsi Yehoyada omokuani arenge moyo.
english: Joash did what was right in the eyes of the LORD all the years of Jehoiada the priest.

ekegusii: Yoashi agatebia abakuani, “Chibesa chionsi chi’ebinto ebichenu chikorentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene, ne chibesa kera omonto arageire korua, ne chibesa chikoruegwa ase okobooria abanto koreng’ana ne rigori richikire, ne chibesa omonto akorua ase ogwancha,
english: Joash said to the priests, "Collect all the money that is brought as sacred offerings to the temple of the LORD-- the money collected in the census, the money received from personal vows and the money brought voluntarily to the temple.

ekegusii: Yoashi agachaka kogamba ekero arenge nemiaka etano na ebere, na akagamba emiaka emerongo ene agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Sibia korwa Beeri‐Seba.
english: Joash was seven years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem forty years. His mother's name was Zibiah; she was from Beersheba.

ekegusii: Yoashi nigo arenge nemiaka etano na ebere ekero achagete kogamba.
english: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign.

ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akagenderera gokwana emerabaaro yaye, akabora:
english: Job continued his discourse:

ekegusii: Ayubu nigo agokwana atari na semi; na amang’ana aye tari ay’obong’aini.
english: 'Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.'

ekegusii: Yoeli, mosinto o Sikiri, nere orenge omoteneneri obo; na Yuda, mosinto o Hasenua, akaba omoteneneri o kabere ase omochie oria.
english: Joel son of Zicri was their chief officer, and Judah son of Hassenuah was over the Second District of the city.

ekegusii: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar son of Hagri,
english: Yoeli, momura omwabo Nathani, na Mibihari, mosinto o Hagiri.

ekegusii: Yoeli nere orenge omonene, na Safamu oyo o kabere, naende Yanai na Safati bakaba agwo Basani.
english: Joel was the chief, Shapham the second, then Janai and Shaphat, in Bashan.

ekegusii: Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
english: Yoeli, na Yehu, mosinto o Yosibia o Seraya bw’Asieli;

ekegusii: Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, na abaraai bonsi b’abarwani esegi, abwo barenge ase chinsemo chinde chi’ense eria, bagacha ase Gedalia agwo Misipa
english: Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers still in the open country came to Gedaliah at Mizpah

ekegusii: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
english: na Yohanani oyo o gatano na gatato, na Elisabadi oyo o kianda,

ekegusii: Yohanani akaibora Asaria (oyo nere orenge omokuani ase enyomba eria Sulemani aagachete agwo Yerusalemu);
english: Johanan the father of Azariah (it was he who served as priest in the temple Solomon built in Jerusalem),

ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria abwo bonsi, “Inche nigo nkobabatisa ase amache, korende oyore ne chinguru kombua ngocha are, tinyisaini gosibora chinuga chi’ebikoroto biaye; oyio nere orababatise ase Omoika Omochenu na ase omorero.
english: John answered them all, "I baptize you with water. But one more powerful than I will come, the thongs of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.

ekegusii: John answered, "The man with two tunics should share with him who has none, and the one who has food should do the same."
english: Akabairaneria, “Oyore ne chianga ibere ae ere oyotari nero; na oyore nendagera akore boigo.”

ekegusii: Akabora, “Inche neriogi ri’oyo ogoaka eriogi ase erooro: Rongeyia enchera y’Omonene, buna omobani Isaya atebete.”
english: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, "I am the voice of one calling in the desert, 'Make straight the way for the Lord.'"

ekegusii: Nabo agatebia emeganda eyachete, erinde ebatiswe nere, “Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti, ning’o obakureire ng’a motame korwa ase endamwamu egochi‐gocha?
english: John said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him, "You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?

ekegusii: Yohana akamwatora, agaaka egeturi, akabora, “Oyo nere natebete igoro yaye ng’a: Oyorache nyuma yane nigo are omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani asende.”
english: John testifies concerning him. He cries out, saying, "This was he of whom I said, 'He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.'"

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge etaya egwoka na komoreka, na inwe mwanchire gosasokera omobaso oye ase ekero egeke.
english: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you chose for a time to enjoy his light.

ekegusii: Na Yohana nigo arenge kobeka chianga chi’amarionya ’engamia, na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenema kiaye. Nigo arenge koria chingige na obooke bw’orosana.
english: John wore clothing made of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.

ekegusii: Inche Yohana nkobarikera nde inwe abanto be chikanisa isano na ibere chi’Asia: Obuya bobe asemore na omorembe bikorwa asare ere oyoreo, na oyorengeo, na oyorache kobao, na korwa ase emeika etano na ebere ere bosio bw’ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene,
english: John, To the seven churches in the province of Asia: Grace and peace to you from him who is, and who was, and who is to come, and from the seven spirits before his throne,

ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, nigoro yarwete, gose nase mwanyabanto? Ng’iranerie.”
english: John's baptism-- was it from heaven, or from men? Tell me!"

ekegusii: Ebatiso ya Yohana, nigoro yarwete, gose nase mwanyabanto?”
english: John's baptism-- was it from heaven, or from men?"

ekegusii: Inee! Ebatiso ya Yohana, ng’ai yarwete? Igoro yarwete, gose nase mwanyabanto?” Bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, bakabora, “Toise goteba: Nigoro yarwete, igo aratoborie: Naki rende motamwegenete?
english: John's baptism-- where did it come from? Was it from heaven, or from men?" They discussed it among themselves and said, "If we say, 'From heaven,' he will ask, 'Then why didn't you believe him?'

ekegusii: Ere Yohana nigo arenge kobeka chianga chi’amarionya ’engamia na kweboeria orokini rwe riiyo kenema kiaye, na endagera yaye nigo yarenge chingige na obooke bw’orosana.
english: John's clothes were made of camel's hair, and he had a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

ekegusii: John's disciples came and took his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
english: Aborokigwa baye bagachia bakabogoria omobere, bakayotindeka, bakagenda, bagatebia Yeso amang’ana ayio.

ekegusii: John's disciples told him about all these things. Calling two of them,
english: Aborokigwa ba Yohana bakamotebia aya onsi.

ekegusii: Joiada the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan the father of Jaddua.
english: na Yoyada akaibora Yonathani, na Yonathani akaibora Yadua.

ekegusii: Obwatanie amarondia atano amo, na amarondia ande atano na rimo oyabwateranie ao. Erio oringe erimo rirondia ria gatano na rimo igoro y’egesoero ki’eema.
english: Join five of the curtains together into one set and the other six into another set. Fold the sixth curtain double at the front of the tent.

ekegusii: Ebitambaa bitano bibwatanigwe bibe rirondia erimo. Naboigo nebitambaa binde bitano.
english: Join five of the curtains together, and do the same with the other five.

ekegusii: Chinyimbo echio ochibwatanie amo chibe enyimbo eyemo ere ase okoboko kwao.
english: Join them together into one stick so that they will become one in your hand.

ekegusii: Abaminto, mobe abegi baane, morigererie abwo bakogenda ase ogotunyana omogwekano oria oria twabaete.
english: Join with others in following my example, brothers, and take note of those who live according to the pattern we gave you.

ekegusii: naende Yokimu na abanto ba Koseba, Yoashi na Sarafu, abwo barenge kogambera Abamoabu, naende Yasubi‐Lehemu. (Korende amang’ana aya namakoro.)
english: Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi Lehem. (These records are from ancient times.)

ekegusii: Jokmeam, Beth Horon,
english: Yokimeamu na Beti‐Horoni,

ekegusii: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan; the descendants of Dedan were the Asshurites, the Letushites and the Leummites.
english: Yokisani akaibora Seba na Dedani. Na basinto ba Dedani nabwo aba: Ashuri, na Letusi, na Leumi.

ekegusii: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
english: Yokitani akaibora Alimodadi, na Selefu, na Hasarmaweti, na Yera,

ekegusii: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
english: Yokitani akaibora Alimodadi na Selefu, Hasarmaweti na Yera;

ekegusii: Yonadabu agatebia omoruoti, “Rigereria, abamura bao abwo bagocha, buna inche, omosomba oo, nagotebia.”
english: Jonadab said to the king, "See, the king's sons are here; it has happened just as your servant said."

ekegusii: Amang’ana aria Yonadabu, mosinto o Rekabu, achigete abana baye ng’a tibabaisa konywa edivai, nigo aigwereire na korendwa goika rituko ria rero. Onde tari bw’ororeria roria okonywa edivai, ekiagera baigwerete ogochika gwa sokoro yabo. Inche nabeire ngokwana nainwe kogenderera botambe, korende mwangire konyigwera.
english: 'Jonadab son of Recab ordered his sons not to drink wine and this command has been kept. To this day they do not drink wine, because they obey their forefather's command. But I have spoken to you again and again, yet you have not obeyed me.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Yona akaimoka, akagenda Nineva buna Omonene amochigete. Omochie oria nigo orenge omonene mono, oisaine orogendo rw’amatuko atato ase okoyobutokania.
english: Jonah obeyed the word of the LORD and went to Nineveh. Now Nineveh was a very important city-- a visit required three days.

ekegusii: Bono Yona agasoka korwa ase omochie oria, agaikaransa ase ensemo ya moocha y’omochie. Agwo akeagachera ekegutu, agaikaransa imeo gokenderera koganya arore ayare gochia gokorekana ase omochie oria.
english: Jonah went out and sat down at a place east of the city. There he made himself a shelter, sat in its shade and waited to see what would happen to the city.

ekegusii: Bono Yonathani na Ahimasi nigo barenge baganyete ase ensoko y’Eni‐Rogeli, ekiagera boboete gosoa omochie ime babaise kororwa. Omoiseke omosomba oyomo nigo arenge okona‐kobairera amang’ana, nabarabwo bayairera omoruoti Daudi.
english: Jonathan and Ahimaaz were staying at En Rogel. A servant girl was to go and inform them, and they were to go and tell King David, for they could not risk being seen entering the city.

ekegusii: Yonathani akairaneria Saulo, “Daudi nigo amboria ribaga agende Bethlehemu,
english: Jonathan answered, "David earnestly asked me for permission to go to Bethlehem.

ekegusii: Yonathani agaita omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’Abafilisti agwo Gibea, na Abafilisti bakaigwa amang’ana ayio. Saulo akabugia egetureri ase ense eria yonsi, agateba, “Tiga Abaibirania baigwe.”
english: Jonathan attacked the Philistine outpost at Geba, and the Philistines heard about it. Then Saul had the trumpet blown throughout the land and said, "Let the Hebrews hear!"

ekegusii: Bono Yonathani akagura gotiira namaboko na amagoro, na omobogoreria bw’ebirwanero biaye akamobwatia korwa nyuma, Yonathani agaakera Abafilisti inse, na omomura oria orenge komobwatia korwa nyuma, akabaita.
english: Jonathan climbed up, using his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer right behind him. The Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer followed and killed behind him.

ekegusii: Yonathani akaimoka korwa ase emesa ore nendamwamu enene na tariete gento ase rituko erio ria kabere ri’Omotienyi Omoyia. Nigo abete oichanete ase engencho y’obosooku ise amokorerete ase okogania goita Daudi.
english: Jonathan got up from the table in fierce anger; on that second day of the month he did not eat, because he was grieved at his father's shameful treatment of David.

ekegusii: Erio Yonathani akamotebia, “Genda nomorembe, na abe buna twatiananirie ase erieta ri’Omonene togateba: Omonene abe kirori ase egati yao nainche, na ase egati y’ororeria rwao na orwane, kogenderera botambe.”
english: Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, for we have sworn friendship with each other in the name of the LORD, saying, 'The LORD is witness between you and me, and between your descendants and my descendants forever.'" Then David left, and Jonathan went back to the town.

ekegusii: Jonathan said to David, "Whatever you want me to do, I'll do for you."
english: Erio Yonathani akamotebia, “Gento kende gionsi oganetie ningokorere.”

ekegusii: Yonathani agatebia omomura oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero. “Inchuo togende gochia ng’umbu ase eburi y’abanto aba batarogeti. Ande nabo Omonene arakore egento asetore. Kende tikeri keratange Omonene tatokonya tobue, gatorabe abake gose abange.”
english: Jonathan said to his young armor-bearer, "Come, let's go over to the outpost of those uncircumcised fellows. Perhaps the LORD will act in our behalf. Nothing can hinder the LORD from saving, whether by many or by few."

ekegusii: Erio Yonathani akamotebia, “Twamboke gochia aroro, tweorokie ase abanto aba.
english: Jonathan said, "Come, then; we will cross over toward the men and let them see us.

ekegusii: Erio Yonathani akairaneria, akabora, “Tata ochandire ense eye. Rora bono nkorora inde buya, ekiagera naria obooke boke.
english: Jonathan said, "My father has made trouble for the country. See how my eyes brightened when I tasted a little of this honey.

ekegusii: Yonathani agakwana na Saulo ise amang’ana amaya igoro ya Daudi, akamotebia “Aye omoruoti, tobaisa gokorera Daudi, omosomba oo, bobe, ekiagera ere tana gokomochera, korende ase aya onsi abeire ogokora nigo agokonyete mono.
english: Jonathan spoke well of David to Saul his father and said to him, "Let not the king do wrong to his servant David; he has not wronged you, and what he has done has benefited you greatly.

ekegusii: Jonathan took off the robe he was wearing and gave it to David, along with his tunic, and even his sword, his bow and his belt.
english: Yonathani akarusia egetambaa kiaye gi’okwambara agakea Daudi, akamoa nebirwanero biaye, na omoyio o birende, na obota, na orokini.

ekegusii: Yonathani, ise moke Daudi, nere orenge omosemia; nigo arenge omonto omong’aini naende omonyasemi. Ere na Yehieli, mosinto o Hakimoni, nigo barenge abateneneri b’abana abamura b’omoruoti.
english: Jonathan, David's uncle, was a counselor, a man of insight and a scribe. Jehiel son of Hacmoni took care of the king's sons.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kwa Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli, agwo Samaria, akagamba emiaka ikomi na ebere.
english: Joram son of Ahab became king of Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned twelve years.

ekegusii: Yoramu akaonchora egari yaye agatama, ogokurera Ahasia, “Ayee Ahasia, nigo totegire ase okong’ainwa!”
english: Joram turned about and fled, calling out to Ahaziah, "Treachery, Ahaziah!"

ekegusii: Nere Yusufu akaba okorenda ise amo nabamwabo bonsi, akabaa endagera buna kera omonto abwate abanto baye bang’ana.
english: Joseph also provided his father and his brothers and all his father's household with food, according to the number of their children.

ekegusii: na Yusufu agasangereria endagera yonsi ase emiaka eria etano na ebere, ase ense ya Misiri, akayegacha ase emechie. Ase kera omochie akagacha endagera yonsi y’emegondo eria yayoetanaine.
english: Joseph collected all the food produced in those seven years of abundance in Egypt and stored it in the cities. In each city he put the food grown in the fields surrounding it.

ekegusii: Yusufu agasangereria chibesa chionsi echianyorekanete korwa ase ense ya Misiri na eya Kanani ase okooneria abanto endagera, agachibeka ase ekungo ya Farao.
english: Joseph collected all the money that was to be found in Egypt and Canaan in payment for the grain they were buying, and he brought it to Pharaoh's palace.

ekegusii: Ase igo Yusufu akanyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bw’omonene oye ng’a amokorere; na ere akamobeka abe omoteneneri bw’enka yaye yonsi, na omorigereria bw’ebinto bionsi ebi abwate.
english: Joseph found favor in his eyes and became his attendant. Potiphar put him in charge of his household, and he entrusted to his care everything he owned.

ekegusii: Yusufu agachika abanto baichorie chigunia chiabo endagera, na kera oyomo airanerigwe chibesa chiaye, chibekwe egunia yaye ime, na aegwe endagera agochia koria inchera. Naboigo babakorerete.
english: Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to put each man's silver back in his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. After this was done for them,

ekegusii: Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him all the more.
english: Yusufu akarota chindoto, na ekero atebetie abamwabo chindoto echio, barabwo bakamenta mono komogecha.

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akabeka egari yaye ang’e, akayeriina, akagenda korotota Israeli aria Goseni. Ekero achia goika asare akamoboania rigoti riaye engaki etari nke.
english: Joseph had his chariot made ready and went to Goshen to meet his father Israel. As soon as Joseph appeared before him, he threw his arms around his father and wept for a long time.

ekegusii: Yusufu akaroka omwana oria omotangi Manase, agateba, “Nyasae ogerire inyebe obokong’u bwonsi na abanto b’enka ya tata.”
english: Joseph named his firstborn Manasseh and said, "It is because God has made me forget all my trouble and all my father's household."

ekegusii: Yusufu omonto bw’Arimathaya agacha, oyorenge omosike, omonto bw’ekegambero. Ere omonyene nigo aganyete oboruoti bwa Nyasae; agasoa noboremu ase obosio bwa Pilato, agasaba aegwe omobere o Yeso.
english: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent member of the Council, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, went boldly to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.

ekegusii: Yusufu agatebia ise, “Taibo, tata, naki oyo nere omotangi; beka okoboko kwao gw’okorio ase omotwe oye.”
english: Joseph said to him, "No, my father, this one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head."

ekegusii: Yusufu agatebia bamura bamwabo, “Ninche Yusufu. Tata moyo are?” Korende bamura bamwabo tibanyara komoiraneria, ekiagera basoetwe nobwoba obonene.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph! Is my father still living?" But his brothers were not able to answer him, because they were terrified at his presence.

ekegusii: Yusufu agatebia abanto, “Igwa! Rero nabagorire inwe amo namaremo aino, mobe enibo ya Farao. Bwata chimbusuro chiaino echi, chiire mochisimeke ase emegondo.
english: Joseph said to the people, "Now that I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh, here is seed for you so you can plant the ground.

ekegusii: Korende Yusufu akabatebia “Nabo ere buna konya naikire kobatebia, ng’a inwe nechirooti more.
english: Joseph said to them, "It is just as I told you: You are spies!

ekegusii: Yusufu akababoria, “Ing’ana ki eri mwakorire? Timomanyeti ng’a omonto buna inche nigo ndanyare gokora oboringoria imanye?”
english: Joseph said to them, "What is this you have done? Don't you know that a man like me can find things out by divination?"

ekegusii: Yusufu akamenya Misiri, ere amo nabanto bamwabo, agakoora emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi (110).
english: Joseph stayed in Egypt, along with all his father's family. He lived a hundred and ten years

ekegusii: Yusufu akagacha endagera ase obonge mono, ekaba enyinge buna omokenye bw’enyancha, goika agatiga koyerenga, ekiagera tiyare konyara korengeka.
english: Joseph stored up huge quantities of grain, like the sand of the sea; it was so much that he stopped keeping records because it was beyond measure.

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akamogwera ise obosio bwaye, akarera na komonyunyunta.
english: Joseph threw himself upon his father and wept over him and kissed him.

ekegusii: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
english: Yusufu akaimokia omobere, akayoboyia egetambaa ekiya ki’egatani,

ekegusii: Yuda na abamwabo, ekero bairanete ase omochie, bakanyora Yusufu nao are nyomba, barabwo bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, ase obosio bwaye.
english: Joseph was still in the house when Judah and his brothers came in, and they threw themselves to the ground before him.

ekegusii: Agwo Yusufu, ekero asoete gokorera Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etato. Na Yusufu akarua ase obosio bwa Farao, agaetanana ase ense yonsi ya Misri.
english: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from Pharaoh's presence and traveled throughout Egypt.

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akagenda agatebia Farao, “Tata na bamura baminto bachire korwa ase ense ya Kanani, amo ne chitugo chiabo, ching’ondi ne chiombe, na binde bionsi bare nabio; barabwo nao bare ase ensemo ya Goseni.”
english: Joseph went and told Pharaoh, "My father and brothers, with their flocks and herds and everything they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen."

ekegusii: Na Yusufu ore korokwa nabatomwa Barnaba (engencho yaye, “Omwana bw’Oboremia”), Omolawi, omonto o Kuporo,
english: Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus, whom the apostles called Barnabas (which means Son of Encouragement),

ekegusii: Omonene oyio akabwata Yusufu, akamobeka echela ime, aase abasomba b’omoruoti basibire, na ere akaba agwo echela ime.
english: Joseph's master took him and put him in prison, the place where the king's prisoners were confined. But while Joseph was there in the prison,

ekegusii: Yoshua amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bagekora buna babuirwe, bagatama gochia erooro.
english: Joshua and all Israel let themselves be driven back before them, and they fled toward the desert.

ekegusii: Yoshua akabakora buna Omonene amochigete; akanacha chibarasi chiabo chinteng’e agasamba chigari chiabo nomorero.
english: Joshua did to them as the LORD had directed: He hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Yoshua akaimoka mambia chuni, na abakuani bakaimokia Esanduku eria y’Omonene.
english: Joshua got up early the next morning and the priests took up the ark of the LORD.

ekegusii: Joshua had his family come forward man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zimri, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
english: Akarangeria enyomba ya Sabidi, omonto oyomo oyomo, na obomera bokagwera Akani, mosinto o Karimi, o Sabidi o Zera bw’egesaku kia Yuda.

ekegusii: Yoshua agachora abarwani chilifu isano, akababisa bosongo y’omochie, ase egati ya Beteli na Ai.
english: Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agakwana nabanto bonsi, akabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli; agokwana: Agwo kare chisokoro chiaino amo na Tera, ise Ibrahimu, na Nahori, nigo bamenyete ng’umbu y’orooche rw’Eufarati bakaba bagokorera chinyasae ching’ao.
english: Joshua said to all the people, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Long ago your forefathers, including Terah the father of Abraham and Nahor, lived beyond the River and worshiped other gods.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agatebia Abaisraeli, “Inchuo ang’e aiga, motegerere amang’ana aya Omonene, Nyasae oino, akobatebia.”
english: Joshua said to the Israelites, "Come here and listen to the words of the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Yoshua agatebia abanto, “Timokonyara komokorera Omonene. Ere Nyasae omochenu, na Nyasae bwe risemi; takobaabera ogosaria kwaino na ebibe biaino.
english: Joshua said to the people, "You are not able to serve the LORD. He is a holy God; he is a jealous God. He will not forgive your rebellion and your sins.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio agatebia abakuani, “Imokia Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana, mogende motang’ane abanto.” Erio barabwo bakayeimokia, bakagenda, bagatang’ana abanto.
english: Joshua said to the priests, "Take up the ark of the covenant and pass on ahead of the people." So they took it up and went ahead of them.

ekegusii: Yoshua agatebia abanto baria, babere batometwe koroota ense eria, “Soa nyomba mw’omotayayi oria, momosokie amo nabanto baye bonsi, buna mwamorierete eira na gotiana.”
english: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, "Go into the prostitute's house and bring her out and all who belong to her, in accordance with your oath to her."

ekegusii: Naende Yoshua agatebia abatang’ani baria b’abarwani, “Timoiroka, timokwa emioyo; mobe noboremu na gotenena bokong’u, ekiagera naboigo Omonene arakore ababisa bonsi morarwanie.”
english: Joshua said to them, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Be strong and courageous. This is what the LORD will do to all the enemies you are going to fight."

ekegusii: Joshua said, "Open the mouth of the cave and bring those five kings out to me."
english: Erio Yoshua agateba, “Igora egesoero kie rikuruma na mondetere abaruoti baria batano.”

ekegusii: Agwo Yoshua akamotebia, “Naki gwatorenteire emechando iga? Bono naye Omonene okorenteire emechando.” Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagaaka Akani amagena goika agakwa; bagaaka na baria bande amagena, bakabasamba nomorero.
english: Joshua said, "Why have you brought this trouble on us? The LORD will bring trouble on you today." Then all Israel stoned him, and after they had stoned the rest, they burned them.

ekegusii: Yoshua akabeka amo amagena ande ikomi na abere gati‐gati ya Yorodan, aase abakuani batenenete, abwo babogoretie Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana. Amagena aria nao are goika rero iga.
english: Joshua set up the twelve stones that had been in the middle of the Jordan at the spot where the priests who carried the ark of the covenant had stood. And they are there to this day.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, baria barenge abamo be chirooti chiria chiarootete ense eria, bagatandora chianga chiabo,
english: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, who were among those who had explored the land, tore their clothes

ekegusii: Yoshua mosinto o Nuni, omosomba bw’Omonene, agakwa ekero akoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na ikomi.
english: Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of a hundred and ten.

ekegusii: Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, nigo arenge omokoreri o Musa korwa ekero arenge omosae. Ere agakwana na Musa, akamotebia, “Omonene one, bakanie.”
english: Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses' aide since youth, spoke up and said, "Moses, my lord, stop them!"

ekegusii: Yoshua akabua abanto bonsi korwa Kadeshi‐Barinea goika Gasa, na akaira ense yonsi ya Goseni goika Gibeoni.
english: Joshua subdued them from Kadesh Barnea to Gaza and from the whole region of Goshen to Gibeon.

ekegusii: Yoshua akabaakera obomera ase okoboria Omonene aria Silo, agaatananera Abaisraeli ense eyio, kera egesaku ensemo yaye.
english: Joshua then cast lots for them in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD, and there he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their tribal divisions.

ekegusii: Yoshua agatebia abanto, “Mwechene, ekiagera ankio Omonene nakore amakumia ase egati yaino.”
english: Joshua told the people, "Consecrate yourselves, for tomorrow the LORD will do amazing things among you."

ekegusii: Nabo Yoshua akaira emechie yonsi y’abaruoti baria, na abaruoti abanyene amo na bonsi abarengeo akabaita nemioro, akabasiria kegima, buna Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya achikire.
english: Joshua took all these royal cities and their kings and put them to the sword. He totally destroyed them, as Moses the servant of the LORD had commanded.

ekegusii: Yoshua konya obeire okorwania abaruoti abwo ase engaki entambe.
english: Joshua waged war against all these kings for a long time.

ekegusii: Akarenta abakuani bonsi korwa ase emechie y’Abayuda, na ase ense yonsi korwa Geba goika Beeri‐Seba agakora aase onsi aimokererete igoro agwo ase abakuani barenge gosambera ubani akaba aatachenegeti. Na ebisasimero bi’aase aimokererete igoro arenge agwo ase ebiita bi’omochie, keria kiarenge ase egesoero ki’Egeita kia Yoshua, omotang’ani bw’omochie, na keria kiarenge ensemo y’okobee y’oyo ogosoera omochie, omoruoti akabitagora akabiyeria inse.
english: Josiah brought all the priests from the towns of Judah and desecrated the high places, from Geba to Beersheba, where the priests had burned incense. He broke down the shrines at the gates-- at the entrance to the Gate of Joshua, the city governor, which is on the left of the city gate.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yosia akaba okorenda Rituko Rinene ri‐Epasaka ase Omonene, agwo Yerusalemu, na abanto bakanyenya chimanwa chie ching’ondi chi’Epasaka ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani.
english: Josiah celebrated the Passover to the LORD in Jerusalem, and the Passover lamb was slaughtered on the fourteenth day of the first month.

ekegusii: Erio Yosia akaa abanto barenge agwo ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso bi’Epasaka. Akarusia korwa ase amaicho aye omonyene chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na echie chimbori, chilifu emerongu etato (30,000), ne chiombe chilifo isato (3,000).
english: Josiah provided for all the lay people who were there a total of thirty thousand sheep and goats for the Passover offerings, and also three thousand cattle-- all from the king's own possessions.

ekegusii: Yosia akarusia okogechia gwonsi korwa ase orogongo rw’Abaisraeli, agachika Abaisraeli bonsi bakorere Omonene, Nyasae obo. Abanto tibaonchogete korwa ase Omonene bwe chisokoro chiabo ase obogima bwonsi bwa Yosia.
english: Josiah removed all the detestable idols from all the territory belonging to the Israelites, and he had all who were present in Israel serve the LORD their God. As long as he lived, they did not fail to follow the LORD, the God of their fathers.

ekegusii: Agaitera abakuani bonsi b’aase aimokererete igoro, ase ebisasimero biarenge, na agasambera amauga ’abanto igoro yabo. Erio akairana gochia Yerusalemu.
english: Josiah slaughtered all the priests of those high places on the altars and burned human bones on them. Then he went back to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Akanachana chisiiro chi’ogosasimerwa chikaba ebing’ese, na akanacha emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, agaichoria aase abo namauga ’abanto.
english: Josiah smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles and covered the sites with human bones.

ekegusii: Yosia nigo arenge nemiaka etano na etato, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka emerongo etato nomo, agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years.

ekegusii: Yosia nigo arenge nemiaka etano na etato, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka emerongo etato nomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Yedida, mosubati bw’Adaya korwa Bosikati.
english: Josiah was eight years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem thirty-one years. His mother's name was Jedidah daughter of Adaiah; she was from Bozkath.

ekegusii: Korende Yosia tanchete koonchoka korwa ase Neko. Agekona ase ogwetuba ng’a tamanyekana, akagenda korwana na Neko agwo ase ense omweya ya Megido, taigwete amang’ana aye ayaruete ase Nyasae.
english: Josiah, however, would not turn away from him, but disguised himself to engage him in battle. He would not listen to what Neco had said at God's command but went to fight him on the plain of Megiddo.

ekegusii: Abasomba baye bakamorusia Megido, bakabogoria omobere oye okwete ore ase egari ime, bakayoira Yerusalemu. Erio bakamotindeka ase embeera yaye omonyene. Abanto b’ense eria bakarenta Yehoahasi, omwana omomura o Yosia, bakamoaka amaguta, akaba omoruoti ase ribaga ria ise.
english: Josiah's servants brought his body in a chariot from Megiddo to Jerusalem and buried him in his own tomb. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz son of Josiah and anointed him and made him king in place of his father.

ekegusii: Ekiagera Yotamu abwatetie chinchera chi’Omonene, Nyasae oye, akaba nokobua okonene.
english: Jotham grew powerful because he walked steadfastly before the LORD his God.

ekegusii: Akarwana nomoruoti bw’Abaamoni, akamobua, na ase omwaka oria Abaamoni bakaba bakomoa chifeta chiisaine chitalanta rigana erimo, na engano ebitonga chilifu rigana erimo (100,000), na esairi ebitonga chilifu rigana erimo (100,000). Abaamori bakaba bakomoa ebinto ebio ebirengo bireng’aine buna biria ase omwaka o kabere, na oyo o gatato.
english: Jotham made war on the king of the Ammonites and conquered them. That year the Ammonites paid him a hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat and ten thousand cors of barley. The Ammonites brought him the same amount also in the second and third years.

ekegusii: Yotamu akaagacha Egeita kia Rogoro ki’enyomba y’Omonene, naende agakora emeremo emenene ase okoagacha orwaki rw’Ofeli.
english: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the LORD and did extensive work on the wall at the hill of Ophel.

ekegusii: Yotamu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete; abanto bakamotindeka ase Omochie o Daudi. Ahasi, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Yotamu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa aase chiatindegetwe, agwo ase Omochie o Daudi, sokoro yaye, na Ahasi omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Jotham rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David, the city of his father. And Ahaz his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Yotamu nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na etano ekero achagete kogamba na akagamba emiaka ikomi na etano nomo, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Yerusa, omosubati o Zadoki.
english: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem sixteen years. His mother's name was Jerusha daughter of Zadok.

ekegusii: Omogoko na omochengo biarusigwe korwa ase ense ya Moabu eyio ekwama ase obonge. Nasiririe edivai korwa ase ebimitero; monto onde tari okomita edivai ogotera ore nomochengo. Eriogi rigoakwa tiriri eri’omogoko.
english: Joy and gladness are gone from the orchards and fields of Moab. I have stopped the flow of wine from the presses; no one treads them with shouts of joy. Although there are shouts, they are not shouts of joy.

ekegusii: Omogoko na omochengo biasirigwe korwa ase emegondo ekwama mono; bono amatera tari goterwa ase emegondo y’emesabibu, amariogi ’omogoko tari goakwa aroro; monto onde tari okomita amasabibu ase ebiteera bi’okomitera. Nasiririe amariogi ’omochengo e rigesa.
english: Joy and gladness are taken away from the orchards; no one sings or shouts in the vineyards; no one treads out wine at the presses, for I have put an end to the shouting.

ekegusii: Joy is gone from our hearts; our dancing has turned to mourning.
