english: Omogoko bwe chinkoro chiaito osirire; ogotenga gwaito kwaonchokire kwabeire ebirero.

ekegusii: Abayuda bakaba aase aachenu ay’Omonene, na Abaisraeli bakaba ab’obogambi bwaye.
english: Judah became God's sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

ekegusii: Korende Abayuda tibanyarete goseria Abayebusi, abamenyete Yerusalemu. Ase igo Abayebusi nigo bamenyete amo n’Abayuda goika rero iga.
english: Judah could not dislodge the Jebusites, who were living in Jerusalem; to this day the Jebusites live there with the people of Judah.

ekegusii: Abayuda bagakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakagera akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bakorete ebinge goetania ebi bionsi chisokoro chiabo chiakorete.
english: Judah did evil in the eyes of the LORD. By the sins they committed they stirred up his jealous anger more than their fathers had done.

ekegusii: Na Yuda akanyuomeria Eri, omwana oye omotangi, omokungu ore korokwa Tamari.
english: Judah got a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

ekegusii: Abayuda bakorire aya atari ay’obwegenwa, na ay’okogechia akorirwe ase egati y’Abaisraeli, na ase Yerusalemu, ekiagera Abayuda bakorire Obomenyo Obochenu obwo Omonene anchete bwabeire obotachenegeti, banyuomire abaiseke b’abanto bagosasima enyasae engeni.
english: Judah has broken faith. A detestable thing has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem: Judah has desecrated the sanctuary the LORD loves, by marrying the daughter of a foreign god.

ekegusii: Erio Yuda akabimanya, akabora, “Ere nomoronge kombua, nigo akora ayio, ekiagera ntamoete Sela, omwana one, amotware.”
english: Judah recognized them and said, "She is more righteous than I, since I wouldn't give her to my son Shelah." And he did not sleep with her again.

ekegusii: Agwo Yuda agatebia abamwabo, “Inki eratogwenere toite oyominto na kobisa ogokwa kwaye?
english: Judah said to his brothers, "What will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?

ekegusii: na Yuda akaibora Peresu na Zera ase Tamari, na Peresu akaibora Hezironi, na Hezironi akaibora Aramu,
english: Judah the father of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, Hezron the father of Ram,

ekegusii: Erio Yuda agatebia Tamari, moka momura oye, “Genda omenye buna omoboraka ase omochie o iso goika Sela omwana one akine”; naki nigo oboete ng’a nere nabaise gocha gokwa, buna abamwabo bakwete. Ase igo Tamari akagenda akamenya o ise.
english: Judah then said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, "Live as a widow in your father's house until my son Shelah grows up." For he thought, "He may die too, just like his brothers." So Tamar went to live in her father's house.

ekegusii: Nonya n’Abayuda mbarwanie abanto ba Yerusalemu. Obotenenku obonge bwe chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chianga, mbosangererigwe korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bamenyete ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: Judah too will fight at Jerusalem. The wealth of all the surrounding nations will be collected-- great quantities of gold and silver and clothing.

ekegusii: Ekero Abayuda barigereretie bakarora ng’a esegi nigo yarenge bosio bwabo na magega abo, na igo bakarera ase Omonene, na abakuani bakabugia ebirombeta biria.
english: Judah turned and saw that they were being attacked at both front and rear. Then they cried out to the LORD. The priests blew their trumpets

ekegusii: Abayuda bakabugwa n’Abaisraeli, bagatama, kera omonto gochia ase enka yaye.
english: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.

ekegusii: Abayuda bakabugwa n’Abaisraeli, na kera omonto agatama, akagenda nka bwoye.
english: Judah was routed by Israel, and every man fled to his home.

ekegusii: Korende ense y’Abayuda nemenywe kare na kare, na Yerusalemu boigo, ekiaare ase ekiaare.
english: Judah will be inhabited forever and Jerusalem through all generations.

ekegusii: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
english: Yuda na Benjamin, na Semaya, na Yeremia.

ekegusii: “Abagambi b’Abayuda nigo babeire buna abwo bagotumana chimbebe; ase ayio nimbaumorere ekeririanda kiane buna amache.
english: Judah's leaders are like those who move boundary stones. I will pour out my wrath on them like a flood of water.

ekegusii: Yuda na Sila, ekiagera nababani barenge, bakaremia emioyo y’abaminto ase amang’ana amange, bakababeka chinguru.
english: Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, said much to encourage and strengthen the brothers.

ekegusii: Judas son of James, and Judas Iscariot, who became a traitor.
english: na Yuda o Yakobo, na Yudas Iskariota, nere oyo omoruete.

ekegusii: Inche Yuda, omosomba o Yeso Kristo, oyomwabo Yakobo, nkobarikera nde inwe abamwarangerigwe, abamwanchire na Nyasae Tata, na morendire na Yeso Kristo.
english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James, To those who have been called, who are loved by God the Father and kept by Jesus Christ:

ekegusii: Egambie inwe abanyene. Inee! Mboronge omokungu asabe Nyasae atatubeti omotwe oye?
english: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?

ekegusii: “Ekina kianachirwe igoro y’ense eraire eimokererete igoro ya Holoni, na Yahasa, na Mefaati,
english: Judgment has come to the plateau-- to Holon, Jahzah and Mephaath,

ekegusii: Ebina mbinachwe ase oboronge naende, na abanto bonsi bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbabobwatie.
english: Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.

ekegusii: Naki buna ase omobere tore nebiimo ebinge, na birobio tibiri gokora omoremo oyomo;
english: Just as each of us has one body with many members, and these members do not all have the same function,

ekegusii: Na ekero Gehasi agendererete gotebia omoruoti buna Elisha abogetie omonto okwete akaba moyo, akarora omokungu oria Elisha abogetie omwana oye akaba moyo ogocha gosaba omoruoti ng’a aegwe enyomba yaye, na oboremo bwaye. Gehasi akamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, omonene one, omokungu oria nere oyo, na omwana oria oye Elisha abogetie akaba moyo nere oyo.”
english: Just as Gehazi was telling the king how Elisha had restored the dead to life, the woman whose son Elisha had brought back to life came to beg the king for her house and land. Gehazi said, "This is the woman, my lord the king, and this is her son whom Elisha restored to life."

ekegusii: Just as he finished making the offering, Samuel arrived, and Saul went out to greet him.
english: Erio agwo ekero akoorire korua ekeng’wanso keria, Samweli agacha. Saulo akagenda komorotota na komokwania.

ekegusii: Yosia agatagora ne chinyomba chionsi chi’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, echiarenge ase emechie ya Samaria, chiria abaruoti b’Abaisraeli baagachete bakagechia Omonene goika akaba nendamwamu. Agachikora buna akorete agwo Beteli.
english: Just as he had done at Bethel, Josiah removed and defiled all the shrines at the high places that the kings of Israel had built in the towns of Samaria that had provoked the LORD to anger.

ekegusii: Erio kegima, kagokwana, Yudas, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agaika, na omoganda ore amo nere nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, na abagaaka.
english: Just as he was speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, appeared. With him was a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, the teachers of the law, and the elders.

ekegusii: Buna nabeire mbarigereretie ase okobasimora, na kobatagora, na kobaonchorana, na kobasiria, na kobarentera amabe, naboigo ndabarigererie ase okobaagacha na kobasimeka. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: Just as I watched over them to uproot and tear down, and to overthrow, destroy and bring disaster, so I will watch over them to build and to plant," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Koreng’ana buna arikire ase amachiko a Musa, amaakwa ayio onsi atocheire. Nonya nabo titwasabete Omonene, Nyasae oito, atororere amabera; titwaonchogete korwa ase amabe aito na titwaigwete ekeene kiao.
english: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come upon us, yet we have not sought the favor of the LORD our God by turning from our sins and giving attention to your truth.

ekegusii: Naki igo erikire, “Namwanchire Yakobo, korende namogechire Esau.”
english: Just as it is written: "Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated."

ekegusii: Nigo erabe ng’a buna Omonene agogetigwe ase okobakorera amaya, akagera mokamentekana ase enchera buna eyio, naboigo agochia kogokigwa ase okorenta ogosirigwa asemore na kobaseria kegima, nainwe morusigweo, moere kegima korwa ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
english: Just as it pleased the LORD to make you prosper and increase in number, so it will please him to ruin and destroy you. You will be uprooted from the land you are entering to possess.

ekegusii: Naboigo buna Yane na Yambare baengereranetie na Musa, na aba nabo bakoengererania nekeene. Ebirengererio biabo biasarekire, na okwegena kwabo kwangirwe,
english: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so also these men oppose the truth-- men of depraved minds, who, as far as the faith is concerned, are rejected.

ekegusii: Buna abanto bagacheirwe ogokwa ara rimo, na nyuma y’ogokwa ekina,
english: Just as man is destined to die once, and after that to face judgment,

ekegusii: Naende buna Musa aimokereretie eng’iti ase erooro, naboigo na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto goika aimokererigwe igoro;
english: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the desert, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,

ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo achia korigia komaanora omonwa oye, Galio agatebia Abayahudi, “Inwe Abayahudi, onye ring’ana ri’okorega gose okong’ainereria okobe ndiakoregete, rirorio anga naremereria nainwe,
english: Just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio said to the Jews, "If you Jews were making a complaint about some misdemeanor or serious crime, it would be reasonable for me to listen to you.

ekegusii: koreng’ana buna akobirusia korwa ase eng’ombe eria ekonyenywa ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe. Erio abisambere ase egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso.
english: just as the fat is removed from the ox sacrificed as a fellowship offering. Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

ekegusii: buna Tata amanyete inche, na inche nimomanyete Tata, na obogima bwane naborure ase engencho ye ching’ondi.
english: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father-- and I lay down my life for the sheep.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti airanete korwa ase egeticha aria isiko gochia ase enyomba eria ase barenge konywera edivai, Hamani nigo araire inse oumaime ase egeikaransero gi’Esteri. Omoruoti akaboria, “Inee! Nigo aganetie gokorera eting’ana obonyaka ase obosio bwane aa nyomba mwane ime?” Na ekero ring’ana riasogete korwa ase omonwa bw’omoruoti, abasomba bagatuba Hamani obosio.
english: Just as the king returned from the palace garden to the banquet hall, Haman was falling on the couch where Esther was reclining. The king exclaimed, "Will he even molest the queen while she is with me in the house?" As soon as the word left the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.

ekegusii: Buna Tata are moyo antomete, na inche inde moyo ase engencho ya Tata, naboigo oyokondia, nabe moyo ase engencho yane.
english: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.

ekegusii: buna Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto atachete gokorerwa, korende gokorera, na korua obogima bwaye, erinde bobe embooria y’abange.”
english: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many."

ekegusii: Abanto abange nigo baichanete ase engencho yaye, ekiagera ekieni kiaye nigo giasaretigwe bobe goetania eki’onde bwensi, omobere oye tororekanete buna oyo o mwanyabanto.
english: Just as there were many who were appalled at him--his appearance was so disfigured beyond that of any man and his form marred beyond human likeness--

ekegusii: Nigo barigete buna abwo barenge abarori korwa omochakano na abakori emeremo be ring’ana batorenteire.
english: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the first were eyewitnesses and servants of the word.

ekegusii: Buna tware koigwera Musa, naye natokoigwere. Omonene, Nyasae oo, abe amo naye buna abete na Musa.
english: Just as we fully obeyed Moses, so we will obey you. Only may the LORD your God be with you as he was with Moses.

ekegusii: Buna mwabeire mokonywera igoro ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, naboigo nabanto b’ebisaku bionsi baragenderere konywa botambe, ee, mbanywe bakoore nonya neturubo yonsi, na babe buna tibarengeo.”
english: Just as you drank on my holy hill, so all the nations will drink continually; they will drink and drink and be as if they had never been.

ekegusii: Na buna kwaroche ebisanyi na ebiara bi’amagoro biarenge ekeng’ese ki’amaroba na ekeng’ese ki’ebioma, engencho yaye nero eye: Oboruoti obwo mbwatananekane. Korende chinsemo chinde chire chinkong’u buna ekioma nachibe ime ase oboruoti obwo, buna koreng’ana kwarora ekioma keburukaine namaroba.
english: Just as you saw that the feet and toes were partly of baked clay and partly of iron, so this will be a divided kingdom; yet it will have some of the strength of iron in it, even as you saw iron mixed with clay.

ekegusii: Naki buna inwe kare motarenge koigwera Nyasae, korende bono mwanyorire amabera ase engencho y’ogotaigwera kwabo,
english: Just as you who were at one time disobedient to God have now received mercy as a result of their disobedience,

ekegusii: Bogachia gokiamoka Paulo agasorora bonsi barie endagera, akabora, “Rero nerituko ria ikomi na kane moganyete na mogendererete motana koria gento.
english: Just before dawn Paul urged them all to eat. "For the last fourteen days," he said, "you have been in constant suspense and have gone without food-- you haven't eaten anything.

ekegusii: Erio kegima narengeo ase esinagogi yabo omonto obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi. Ere agaaka eriogi,
english: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an evil spirit cried out,

ekegusii: Na rora, omokungu oyomo oyorenge noborwaire bw’okorua amanyinga ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, akamochiera korwa nyuma, agakuna omokoba bw’eanga yaye.
english: Just then a woman who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak.

ekegusii: Erio agwo Boazi agacha aroro korwa Bethlehemu, agakwania abagesi, ogoteba, “Omonene abe amo nainwe!” Nabarabwo bakairaneria, “Omonene agosesenie!”
english: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem and greeted the harvesters, "The LORD be with you!" "The LORD bless you!" they called back.

ekegusii: Kobachiire, Yoabu agacha korwa ase achiete gosakora amo nabasomba ba Daudi, nabarabwo mbabwate ebisakorwa ebinge. Korende Abineri konya ochiire, tarenge amo na Daudi agwo Heburoni, ekiagera Daudi konya omoeire ribaga, nere ogendire nomorembe.
english: Just then David's men and Joab returned from a raid and brought with them a great deal of plunder. But Abner was no longer with David in Hebron, because David had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

ekegusii: Erio kegima aborokigwa baye bagacha. Bagakumia ekiagera arenge gokwana nomokungu; korende onde tamoboretie, “Inki okorigia?” Gose, “Naki ogokwana nere?”
english: Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked, "What do you want?" or "Why are you talking with her?"

ekegusii: Ase ekero ekio Saulo nigo arenge ogocha korwa mogondo ogotema chiombe chiaye, akaboria, “Inki kiaba abanto aba bakorera iga?” Ase ayio bakamotebia amang’ana aria abanto ba Yabesi barentete.
english: Just then Saul was returning from the fields, behind his oxen, and he asked, "What is wrong with the people? Why are they weeping?" Then they repeated to him what the men of Jabesh had said.

ekegusii: Na rora, Musa na Elija bakabaorokera, bagakwana nere.
english: Just then there appeared before them Moses and Elijah, talking with Jesus.

ekegusii: Gaki, rigereria buna omonto oyo arenge omonene! Ibrahimu, omogaaka oito o kare, akamoa ensemo ya ikomi y’ebinto asakorete.
english: Just think how great he was: Even the patriarch Abraham gave him a tenth of the plunder!

ekegusii: Erio ekeene ngekorwe ase ense y’erooro, na oboronge bokorwe ase omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge.
english: Justice will dwell in the desert and righteousness live in the fertile field.

ekegusii: Kain, Gibeah and Timnah-- ten towns and their villages.
english: na Kaini, na Gibea, na Timuna, emechie ikomi, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands-- four towns;
english: na Kedemoti, na Mefaati, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

ekegusii: Kedemoth and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands;
english: na Kedemoti, na Mefati, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

ekegusii: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor,
english: na Kedesi na Edirei, na Eni‐Hasori,

ekegusii: Kedesh, Hazor, Ithnan,
english: na Kedesi, na Hazori, na Itinani,

ekegusii: Orusie korwa asende ayare a bosa na oborimo. Tobaisa kong’a obotaka gose obotenenku, korende ong’e endagera engwenerete.
english: Keep falsehood and lies far from me; give me neither poverty nor riches, but give me only my daily bread.

ekegusii: Inwe goika morende emeroberio yaye echikire na amachiko aye, ayio inche nkobaa rituko ria rero, erio nario erabe buya asemore, naboigo nase abana baino, naende amatuko aino nabe amange ase ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe eyaino kogenderera.”
english: Keep his decrees and commands, which I am giving you today, so that it may go well with you and your children after you and that you may live long in the land the LORD your God gives you for all time.

ekegusii: Indende buna orendete endorero y’eriso riao; intube ase ekiriri gie chimbaba chiao;
english: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings

ekegusii: Tiga chinchera chi’obong’ainereria chibe aare asende, ase obuya bwao inyorokererie amachiko ao.
english: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me through your law.

ekegusii: Indende korwa ase emeeto bantegeire; na korwa ase amareba ’abakori amabe.
english: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, from the traps set by evildoers.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, indende korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe; intoorie korwa ase abanto abatindi, abwo barobeirie kobeka ebigocha ase ngoeta.
english: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; protect me from men of violence who plan to trip my feet.

ekegusii: Bwata amachiko aane, erinde obe moyo; orende amorokererio aane buna orendete endorero y’eriso riao.
english: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.

ekegusii: Mobwate amachiko aane na koyakora; inche ninche Omonene, nkobachena.
english: Keep my decrees and follow them. I am the LORD, who makes you holy.

ekegusii: Ee, mokore aya nkobachika, na mobwate amachiko aane. Omonto karakore amang’ana ayio nabe moyo. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: Keep my decrees and laws, for the man who obeys them will live by them. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, moigwere amang’ana aya onsi nabachikire, na moyakore. Timobasia kwenaria chingencho chi’okogechia chiakoretwe nabanto abwo babatang’anete komenya ase ense eyio. Moise gokora igo, inamwesoyie ase ogotacheneka ase chingencho echio. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: Keep my requirements and do not follow any of the detestable customs that were practiced before you came and do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.'"

ekegusii: Morende Chisabato chiane chibe chinchenu, erinde chibe ekemanyererio ase egati yane nainwe; erio nario moranyare komanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: Keep my Sabbaths holy, that they may be a sign between us. Then you will know that I am the LORD your God."

ekegusii: Mogenderere nobwanchani inwe ase inwe.
english: Keep on loving each other as brothers.

ekegusii: Obainyorie ayio, na kobakurera ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tibaba nokoamererania ase amang’ana, okwo gotanyare gokonya kende, korende nigo gokobasiria abagokoigwa.
english: Keep reminding them of these things. Warn them before God against quarreling about words; it is of no value, and only ruins those who listen.

ekegusii: Erende obeere aare korwa ase omokungu oyio; tobaisa goika ang’e negesieri ki’enyomba yaye.
english: Keep to a path far from her, do not go near the door of her house,

ekegusii: Mwerende inwe abanyene amo ne riicho riria Omoika Omochenu obabegete mobe abarendi korisia ekanisa y’Omonene, eye enyorerete namanyinga aye omonyene.
english: Keep watch over yourselves and all the flock of which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers. Be shepherds of the church of God, which he bought with his own blood.

ekegusii: Timoba abanchi chibesa, moisaneke nebi more nabio, ekiagera ere omonyene otebire, “Tinkogotiga nonya ng’ake, gose tingokoremera.”
english: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, because God has said, "Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you."

ekegusii: Ontange inche, omosomba oo, tinkora ebibe bi’obomwenu; tobitiga ebio bingambere! Rirorio nimbe ntari na komocha, nimbe omosibore korwa ase ogosaria okonene.
english: Keep your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then will I be blameless, innocent of great transgression.

ekegusii: Rirorio tanga oromeme rwao tirokwana amabe, na ebikoba biao tibikwana obong’ainereria.
english: keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking lies.

ekegusii: Mwerende ase obwanchani bwa Nyasae, mobe moganyete amabera ’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo goika monyore obogima bwa kare na kare.
english: Keep yourselves in God's love as you wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to bring you to eternal life.

ekegusii: Na inwe renda chinkoro chiaino tichibagambia, erinde ekero mogokwanwa bobe, abwo bakobarama ase orogendo rwaino oruya ase Kristo, basookigwe.
english: keeping a clear conscience, so that those who speak maliciously against your good behavior in Christ may be ashamed of their slander.

ekegusii: Erio bakamoboera Yeso, bagatoma chirooti, na barabwo bagekora buna nabanyene oboronge, erinde bamobwate ase ogokwana kwaye, bamobeke ase okobua kwa gavuna na obogambi bwaye.
english: Keeping a close watch on him, they sent spies, who pretended to be honest. They hoped to catch Jesus in something he said so that they might hand him over to the power and authority of the governor.

ekegusii: Nigo korakorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka, na korwa ase amang’ana ’oromeme rwaye oroterere rokoebereria.
english: keeping you from the immoral woman, from the smooth tongue of the wayward wife.

ekegusii: Keilah, Aczib and Mareshah-- nine towns and their villages.
english: na Keila, na Akisibu, na Maresa, emechie kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Kelub, Shuhah's brother, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
english: Kelubu, omomura omwabo o Suba, nere akaibora Mehiri, oria orenge ise Esitoni.

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, Kemueli, mosinto o Sifutani;
english: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, the leader from the tribe of Ephraim son of Joseph;

ekegusii: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
english: Enosu akaibora Kenani, na Kenani akaibora Mahalaleli, na Mahalaleli akaibora Yaredi;

ekegusii: Kenania, omoraai bw’Abalawi ase amatera, abe omoteria, ekiagera namanyete emeremo eyio.
english: Kenaniah the head Levite was in charge of the singing; that was his responsibility because he was skillful at it.

ekegusii: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
english: na omogambi Kenasi, na omogambi Temani, na omogambi Mibusari,

ekegusii: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
english: Kenasi na Temani, na Mibusari,

ekegusii: Kephar Ammoni, Ophni and Geba-- twelve towns and their villages.
english: na Kefari‐Amoni, na Ofuni, na Geba, emechie ikomi na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Emechie amo ne chindwaki chire chinkong’u mbibwatwe. Ase rituko erio chinkoro chi’abarwani esegi ba Moabu bare chituoni nachiondoke; barabwo babe buna abakungu bakobina ase okoibora.
english: Kerioth will be captured and the strongholds taken. In that day the hearts of Moab's warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.

ekegusii: Keros, Sia, Padon,
english: Kerosi, na Sia, na Padoni;

ekegusii: Keros, Siaha, Padon,
english: Kerosi, na Sia, na Padoni;

ekegusii: Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph and Bethuel."
english: na Kesedi, na Haso, na Pilidasi, na Yidilafu, na Betueli.”

ekegusii: Kibzaim and Beth Horon, together with their pasturelands-- four towns.
english: na Kibusaimu, na Beti‐Horoni, emechie ene, amo namarisio arengeo.

ekegusii: Moite abarwani babo b’esegi banga buna chieri, mobaite bonsi pi. Obobe nobwabo, ekiagera rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwabo riachire, eyio nengaki yabo y’okonyora egesusuro.
english: Kill all her young bulls; let them go down to the slaughter! Woe to them! For their day has come, the time for them to be punished.

ekegusii: Kinah, Dimonah, Adadah,
english: Na Kina, na Dimona, na Adada,

ekegusii: Omoruoti Agripa, Inee, mbwegenete ababani? Namanyire ng’a nobegenete.”
english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know you do."

ekegusii: Ahasi omoruoti agachika Uria omokuani, akamotebia, “Igoro ase egesasimero keria ekenene asambere ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kia mambia, na okoruegwa kw’endagera kwa mogoroba, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ki’omoruoti, na okoruegwa kwaye kw’endagera, amo nebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa bi’abanto bonsi b’ense eye, na okoruegwa kwabo kw’endagera amo nokw’ebinyugwa. Naende onyororokerie amanyinga onsi ay’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ay’ebing’wanso binde igoro yaye. Korende egesasimero keria gi’etaai ogentigere indore inki ndagekorere.”
english: King Ahaz then gave these orders to Uriah the priest: "On the large new altar, offer the morning burnt offering and the evening grain offering, the king's burnt offering and his grain offering, and the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their grain offering and their drink offering. Sprinkle on the altar all the blood of the burnt offerings and sacrifices. But I will use the bronze altar for seeking guidance."

ekegusii: Ahasi omoruoti akabutora emetobwa y’ebibekerero bi’ebituba, akarusia ebituba korwa aroro, akarusia negetuba keria ekenene giaterekereretwe igoro ase emegwekano ye chiombe yaroisirie korwa ase etaai akageterekerera inse aase atichire namagena.
english: King Ahaz took away the side panels and removed the basins from the movable stands. He removed the Sea from the bronze bulls that supported it and set it on a stone base.

ekegusii: Asa omoruoti akarusia Maaka ng’ina taba eting’ana, ekiagera konya otenenirie omote bw’okogechia, oroiseretigwe Asera, enyasae eria enkungu. Asa akayobutorana akayoiyeria inse, akayosenyenta na akayosambera agwo ase akarooche ga Kidironi.
english: King Asa also deposed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother, because she had made a repulsive Asherah pole. Asa cut the pole down, broke it up and burned it in the Kidron Valley.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Belisasari agakora omoyega omonene, akarangeria abanto abanene koreng’ana elifu eyemo b’oboruoti bwaye, akaba okonywa edivai amo nabanto abwo elifu.
english: King Belshazzar gave a great banquet for a thousand of his nobles and drank wine with them.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Dario agachika, na obotuki bogakorwa ase chibuku chiagachire agwo Babeli ase amagachero ay’oboruoti.
english: King Darius then issued an order, and they searched in the archives stored in the treasury at Babylon.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebio omoruoti Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chitaai ne chitahabu chiria arusetie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku biria abuete:
english: King David dedicated these articles to the LORD, as he had done with the silver and gold from all the nations he had subdued:

ekegusii: Ebinto ebio boigo Daudi akabiatananera Omonene, buna akorete ne chifeta ne chitahabu biria asakorete korwa ase ebisaku binde bionsi, korwa ase Abaedomu, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abafilisti, na Abaameleki.
english: King David dedicated these articles to the LORD, as he had done with the silver and gold he had taken from all these nations: Edom and Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines, and Amalek.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Daudi agatenena, agakwana, “Inwe baminto na abanto baane, inyigwe. Nigo narengereretie koagacha enyomba ase Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene erabekwe, eyio ere egeteni ki’amagoro ’Omonene, Nyasae oito, nkabeka ebinto ang’e ase okoagacha enyomba eyio.
english: King David rose to his feet and said: "Listen to me, my brothers and my people. I had it in my heart to build a house as a place of rest for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, for the footstool of our God, and I made plans to build it.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agateba, “Indangererie Zadoki omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada.” Erio abanto abwo bagacha ase obosio bw’omoruoti.
english: King David said, "Call in Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet and Benaiah son of Jehoiada." When they came before the king,

ekegusii: Daudi omoruoti agatoma abanto gochia ase Zadoki na Abiatari, abakuani, agateba, “Kwana nabagaaka b’Abayuda, mobamborerie: Naki rende mokoba abanto b’omoerio ase okong’irania inche omoruoti inka bwone, bono ekero amang’ana onsi aya Abaisraeli bakwanete aikerete nyomba mwane?
english: King David sent this message to Zadok and Abiathar, the priests: "Ask the elders of Judah, 'Why should you be the last to bring the king back to his palace, since what is being said throughout Israel has reached the king at his quarters?

ekegusii: Omoruoti Herode akaigwa amang’ana, ekiagera erieta ria Yeso konya riakumire, akabora, “Yohana Omobatisi obokire korwa ase abakure, nakio gekogera chinguru echi chigokora emeremo ime asare.”
english: King Herod heard about this, for Jesus' name had become well known. Some were saying, "John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him."

ekegusii: Hezekia omoruoti amo nabagambi b’oboruoti bagachika Abalawi batere amatera ay’ogotogia Omonene ase amang’ana a Daudi na ay’Asafu omorori. Barabwo bagatera, bakaba bagotogia nomogoko, bagekumba na gosasima.
english: King Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to praise the LORD with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness and bowed their heads and worshiped.

ekegusii: Korende Hezekia omoruoti na Isaya omobani, mosinto bw’Amosi, bagasaba ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio na bakarera ase Nyasae o igoro ng’a abakonye.
english: King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz cried out in prayer to heaven about this.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Yehoyakimu agatoma Elinatani, mosinto bw’Akibori, amo nabanto bande bakagenda Misiri,
english: King Jehoiakim, however, sent Elnathan son of Acbor to Egypt, along with some other men.

ekegusii: Yoashi omoruoti tainyorete obuya obo Yehoyada, ise Zakaria, konya amokoreire, korende agaita omwana oye. Ekero Zakaria arenge gokwa agateba, “Tiga Omonene arore aya na arusie egesiomba.”
english: King Joash did not remember the kindness Zechariah's father Jehoiada had shown him but killed his son, who said as he lay dying, "May the LORD see this and call you to account."

ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro omoruoti akaroisia omogwekano korwa ase etahabu; obotambe bw’omogwekanooria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko atano na rimo; akayotenenia ase ense omweya ya Dura, agwo ase orogongo rwa Babeli.
english: King Nebuchadnezzar made an image of gold, ninety feet high and nine feet wide, and set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Nebukadinesaro agatoma amang’ana gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, na ab’emenwa yonsi, baria bamenyete ase ense yonsi, akabatebia: “Omorembe omentekane asemore!
english: King Nebuchadnezzar, To the peoples, nations and men of every language, who live in all the world: May you prosper greatly!

ekegusii: Rehoboamu omoruoti akenyorera chinguru chi’okogamba agwo Yerusalemu. Nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ene nomo, ekero achagete kogamba, na akagamba emiaka ikomi na etano na ebere, agwo Yerusalemu, omochie oria Omonene achorete korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, erinde erieta riaye ribeere aroro. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Naama, omosubati bw’Abaamoni.
english: King Rehoboam established himself firmly in Jerusalem and continued as king. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother's name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Rehoboamu agatoma Adorama, oria otenenerete emeremo y’okobetererigwa, gochia ase Abaisraeli, na barabwo bonsi bakamoaka amagena, agakwa; na Rehoboamu akaimoka bwango, akariina egari yaye, agatama gochia Yerusalemu.
english: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but all Israel stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Rehoboamu agatoma Hadoramu, oria otenenerete emeremo y’okobetererigwa, korende Abaisraeli bakamoaka amagena agakwa. Na Rehoboamu akaimoka bwango, akariina egari yaye, agatama gochia Yerusalemu.
english: King Rehoboam sent out Adoniram, who was in charge of forced labor, but the Israelites stoned him to death. King Rehoboam, however, managed to get into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani akaroisia chimeeri agwo Esioni‐Geberi ere ang’e na Eloti, ase omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri, ase ense ya Edomu.
english: King Solomon also built ships at Ezion Geber, which is near Elath in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani akairaneria ng’ina, “Nase ki okoboria ng’a Abisagi, Omosunemu oria, aegwe Adonia abe mokaye? Moborerie aegwe noboruoti boigo, ekiagera ere momura ominto omonene; na Abiatari omokuani, na Yoabu, omwana bw’omokungu Seruya, babwatanire nere.”
english: King Solomon answered his mother, "Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? You might as well request the kingdom for him-- after all, he is my older brother-- yes, for him and for Abiathar the priest and Joab son of Zeruiah!"

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani agakora omoroberio bw’abanto chilifu emerongo etato (30,000) korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, akababeka bakore emeremo yagwenerete gokorwa.
english: King Solomon conscripted laborers from all Israel-- thirty thousand men.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani akaa eting’ana ya Seba ebinto bionsi aganetie na aboretie aegwe. Amo nebinto ebio Sulemani akamoa ebinto binde ebinge buna omoruoti anarete korua ebiegwa. Erio eting’ana eria akairana, akagenda ase ense yaye amo nabasomba baye.
english: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for, besides what he had given her out of his royal bounty. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani akaa eting’ana ya Seba ebinto bionsi aganetie, na ebio asabete aegwe, goetania ekerengo ki’ebio ere arenterete omoruoti. Erio eting’ana eria akairana, akagenda ase ense yaye amo nabasomba baye.
english: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all she desired and asked for; he gave her more than she had brought to him. Then she left and returned with her retinue to her own country.

ekegusii: Hiramu, omoruoti o Turo, konya oeire Sulemani chibao chi’emecharake, na echi’emetarakwa, amo ne chitahabu ase ekerengo aganetie. Nyuma y’ayio omoruoti Sulemani akaa Hiramu emechie emerongo ebere yarenge ase ense ya Galili.
english: King Solomon gave twenty towns in Galilee to Hiram king of Tyre, because Hiram had supplied him with all the cedar and pine and gold he wanted.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani nigo eroiseretie ekerogo keria korwa ase emete ya Lebanoni.
english: King Solomon made for himself the carriage; he made it of wood from Lebanon.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani akagoncha ching’aya amagana abere, agachiooma ne chitahabu chisunyuntire, na kera eng’aya nigo yarenge koira chitahabu chikiro isato na ekeng’ese.
english: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred bekas of gold went into each shield.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani akagoncha ching’aya amagana abere, agachiooma ne chitahabu chisunyuntire, na kera eng’aya ekaira etahabu esunyuntire ang’e chikiro isano na ibere.
english: King Solomon made two hundred large shields of hammered gold; six hundred bekas of hammered gold went into each shield.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani akarangeria Hiramu achiche korwa Turo.
english: King Solomon sent to Tyre and brought Huram,

ekegusii: Ase igo omoruoti Sulemani akaba omonene kobua abaruoti bonsi b’ense ase obonda na obong’aini.
english: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.

ekegusii: Ase igo omoruoti Sulemani akaba omonene kobua abaruoti bonsi b’ense, ase obonda na obong’aini.
english: King Solomon was greater in riches and wisdom than all the other kings of the earth.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani agatebigwa, “Yoabu otamire gochia ase Eema y’Omonene, na rora, nao are ase egesasimero.” Erio agatoma Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akamotebia, “Genda oake Yoabu, omoite.”
english: King Solomon was told that Joab had fled to the tent of the LORD and was beside the altar. Then Solomon ordered Benaiah son of Jehoiada, "Go, strike him down!"

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani nigo anchete abakungu abange b’abanto b’ebisaku bitamomanyete Nyasae. Amo nomosubati o Farao naende nigo anchete abakungu b’Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, na Abaedomu, na Abasidoni, na Abahiti,
english: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women besides Pharaoh's daughter-- Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians and Hittites.

ekegusii: Usia nigo abete noborwaire bwa ukoma goika ogokwa kwaye, na ase engencho y’ayio akamenya ao ere bweka, akarusananigwa korwa ase enyomba y’Omonene. Yotamu, omomura oye, akaba omoteneneri ase enyomba y’omoruoti, naende akaba okogambera abanto b’ense eria.
english: King Uzziah had leprosy until the day he died. He lived in a separate house--leprous, and excluded from the temple of the LORD. Jotham his son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Ahaswero akaboria eting’ana Esteri, “Ning’o ore na boremu gokora ayare buna ayio? Monto ki oyio?”
english: King Xerxes asked Queen Esther, "Who is he? Where is the man who has dared to do such a thing?"

ekegusii: Omoruoti Ahaswero akarusia ebango ase abanto b’ense yaye, na ase ebisinka bie chinyancha.
english: King Xerxes imposed tribute throughout the empire, to its distant shores.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Ahaswero agatebia Esteri eting’ana na Moredekai Omoyahudi, “Rora, naeire Esteri enyomba ya Hamani, na Hamani otongirwe igoro ase orobambo roria, ekiagera arigetie goita Abayahudi.
english: King Xerxes replied to Queen Esther and to Mordecai the Jew, "Because Haman attacked the Jews, I have given his estate to Esther, and they have hanged him on the gallows.

ekegusii: Zedekia omoruoti akairaneria Yeremia, akamotebia, “Noboire Abayahudi baria batamete bakabwatana n’Abakalidayo. Inse kwerua, nigo ndabaise gochia kobekwa ase amaboko abo, na barabwo banchecherie ase ogonchanda.”
english: King Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, "I am afraid of the Jews who have gone over to the Babylonians, for the Babylonians may hand me over to them and they will mistreat me."

ekegusii: Erio Zedekia omoruoti agachika ng’a Yeremia abekwe ase egoora y’abarendi, naende agachika ng’a kera rituko Yeremia aegwe omogati orenge koroisigwa agwo ase Enchera y’Abaroisia Emegati. Nigo agendererete koegwa omogati goika ekero emegati yonsi yaerete ase omochie. Ase ayio Yeremia akagenderera kobeera ase egoora eria y’abarendi.
english: King Zedekiah then gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed in the courtyard of the guard and given bread from the street of the bakers each day until all the bread in the city was gone. So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Zedekia agatoma Yehukali, mosinto o Selemia, na Zefania omokuani, mosinto o Maaseya, gochia ase Yeremia komotebia, “Otosabere ase Omonene, Nyasae oito.”
english: King Zedekiah, however, sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah with the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to Jeremiah the prophet with this message: "Please pray to the LORD our God for us."

ekegusii: Ekero abaruoti bagokora amabe nigo bakorenta ay’okogechia, ekiagera goetera ase oboronge ekerogo ki’obogambi nigo kegokong’igwa.
english: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.

ekegusii: Motogie inwe abaruoti b’ense na abanto bonsi, nainwe abagambi na abanachi ebina mwensi,
english: kings of the earth and all nations, you princes and all rulers on earth,

ekegusii: Amang’ana amaronge agokwanwa nigo akogokia omoruoti, nere nigo abanchete abwo bagokwana ay’oboronge.
english: Kings take pleasure in honest lips; they value a man who speaks the truth.

ekegusii: Abaruoti mbabe abareri b’abana bao, ne chiting’ana chiabo chibe chikobarageria. Abwo mbatung’ame inse, baumame ase obosio bwao, bamene ebuse y’amagoro ao. Erio nonyare komanya ng’a ninche Omonene; abwo bansemeretie tibagosookigwa.”
english: Kings will be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down before you with their faces to the ground; they will lick the dust at your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD; those who hope in me will not be disappointed."

ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Kiriati‐Baali (noro Kiriati‐Yearimu), na Raba, emechie ebere, amo nebichie biabo.
english: Kiriath Baal (that is, Kiriath Jearim) and Rabbah-- two towns and their villages.

ekegusii: Kiriataimu, na Sibuma, na Sereti‐Sahari, oyore ase ekegoro kie rigoko;
english: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley,

ekegusii: Tung’ama inse na koorokia amasikani ase Omwana oye. Motakoreti bo, nigo arabe nendamwamu, abasirie ase chinchera chiaino, ekiagera endamwamu yaye nigo egwoka bwango. Mbasesenirie abanto bonsi bakomotamera.
english: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry and you be destroyed in your way, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.

ekegusii: Manya ng’a obong’aini buna obwo mboganeirie ase omoyo oo, korabonyore, rirorio nonyore amaya ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, na ogosemeria kwao tikogosira bosa.
english: Know also that wisdom is sweet to your soul; if you find it, there is a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

ekegusii: korende ntomanyete ng’a omonto takonyora oboronge ase ogokora kw’amachiko, korende ase okomwegena Kristo Yeso. Nonya nintwe twamwegenire Kristo Yeso, erinde tonyore oboronge ase okomwegena Kristo, tari ase ogokora kw’amachiko, ekiagera ase ogokora kw’amachiko onde tari ase mwanyabanto oranyare konyora oboronge.
english: know that a man is not justified by observing the law, but by faith in Jesus Christ. So we, too, have put our faith in Christ Jesus that we may be justified by faith in Christ and not by observing the law, because by observing the law no one will be justified.

ekegusii: Manya ng’a Omonene bwechoreire omonyene oboronge. Omonene nigo akonyigwa ekero nkomosaba.
english: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for himself; the LORD will hear when I call to him.

ekegusii: Manya ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae. Nere ototongete, na intwe nabaye tore; nigo tore abanto baye, ne ching’ondi chie riicho riaye.
english: Know that the LORD is God. It is he who made us, and we are his; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.

ekegusii: Momanye ng’a, buna omonto akoa omwana oye egesusuro ase okomorongeyia, naboigo n’Omonene, Nyasae oino, akobaa egesusuro ase okobarongeyia.
english: Know then in your heart that as a man disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, manya ng’a ring’ana ri’Omonene tirikogwa inse bosa, riria Omonene akwanete igoro y’enyomba y’Ahabu. Ekeene, Omonene okorire aya akwanete goetera ase omosomba oye Elija.”
english: Know then, that not a word the LORD has spoken against the house of Ahab will fail. The LORD has done what he promised through his servant Elijah."

ekegusii: Gaki manya ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere bweka Nyasae bw’ekeene, naende Nyasae bw’obwegenwa, oyokorenda okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, na koorokia obwanchani bwaye botari koera goika ebiaare chilifu ase baria bamwanchete na babwatete amachiko aye.
english: Know therefore that the LORD your God is God; he is the faithful God, keeping his covenant of love to a thousand generations of those who love him and keep his commands.

ekegusii: Ekiagera amanyete ng’a abakuani abanene nigo bamorure ase obogechi.
english: knowing it was out of envy that the chief priests had handed Jesus over to him.

ekegusii: Yeso namanyete ebirengererio biabo, akababoria, “Nase ki inwe mokorengereria ebirengererio ebibe ase chinkoro chiaino?
english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said, "Why do you entertain evil thoughts in your hearts?

ekegusii: buna abatamanyekaneti, korende nigo tomanyekanete buya; buna abagokwa, na rora moyo tore. Twasusuirwe, korende titoitiri;
english: known, yet regarded as unknown; dying, and yet we live on; beaten, and yet not killed;

ekegusii: Korah son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and certain Reubenites-- Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On son of Peleth-- became insolent
english: Kora, mosinto o Isari, Omolawi bw’eamate ya Kohati, na Datani, na Abiiramu, basinto b’Eliabu, na Oni, mosinto o Peleti bw’egesaku kia Reuben,

ekegusii: na omogambi Kora, na omogambi Gatamu, na omogambi Amaleki. Aba nabwo barenge abagambi korwa ase ororeria rw’Elifasi, ase ense y’Edomu. Barabwo nabachokoro abamura b’Ada.
english: Korah, Gatam and Amalek. These were the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in Edom; they were grandsons of Adah.

ekegusii: Kore, mosinto o Imuna Omolawi, nigo arenge omorendi bw’egeita ki’ensemo ya moocha. Nere otenenerete ebiegwa bi’ogwancha biare koruegwa ase Nyasae; nigo arenge gwatanana ebiaruetwe ase Omonene amo nebiegwa biarenge ebichenu mono.
english: Kore son of Imnah the Levite, keeper of the East Gate, was in charge of the freewill offerings given to God, distributing the contributions made to the LORD and also the consecrated gifts.

ekegusii: Laban also said to Jacob, "Here is this heap, and here is this pillar I have set up between you and me.
english: Erio Labani agatebia Yakobo, “Rigereria etui eye na esiiro eye, natenenirie egati yao nainche.

ekegusii: Erio Labani na Betueli bakamoiraneria, bakamotebia, “Amang’ana aya nigo arure ase Omonene; intwe titokonyara gokwana ande, amabe gose amaya.
english: Laban and Bethuel answered, "This is from the LORD; we can say nothing to you one way or the other.

ekegusii: Labani akairaneria Yakobo, akamotebia, “Abasubati aba nabana baane, na abana babo nabarabwo nabana baane, na amaicho aya, naro nayane, na bionsi ebio oroche nebiane. Bono ninki ndanyare gokorera abana baane na abana babo baiboire?
english: Laban answered Jacob, "The women are my daughters, the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks. All you see is mine. Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine, or about the children they have borne?

ekegusii: Labani akayeroka Yegari‐Sahaduta, korende Yakobo akayeroka Galeedi.
english: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.

ekegusii: Laban gave his servant girl Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her maidservant.
english: Labani akamoa Raeli, omwana oye, omokoreri, nere Bilia, omosomba oye omoiseke.

ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria, “Aiga seito intwe titori gokora bo, gosokia omoiseke omoke, na gotiga omonene.
english: Laban replied, "It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older one.

ekegusii: Laban said to him, "Just because you are a relative of mine, should you work for me for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be."
english: Erio Labani agakwana na Yakobo, akamotebia, “Nonya kore omoigwa one, tegwenereti onkorere bosa. Ntebia eng’eria yao ninki ndakoe!”

ekegusii: Labani akamoiraneria, “Ayio mbuya. Tiga nkomoe aye kobua nkomoa omonto onde; menya aa bwone.”
english: Laban said, "It's better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me."

ekegusii: Labani akabora, “Etui eye nero kirori egati yane naye rero iga.” Ase ayio akayeroka Galeedi.
english: Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me today." That is why it was called Galeed.

ekegusii: Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon,
english: na Lakisi, na Bosikati, na Egiloni,

ekegusii: Abataka baria bakona‐koong’anya bare getirianda, nigo bakobogoria emesaima bare nenchara.
english: Lacking clothes, they go about naked; they carry the sheaves, but still go hungry.

ekegusii: Nigo bakorara gesobono ase obotuko bwonsi, batabwati eki bakwebisia, gose tibabwati eki bakobeka ekero ki’embeo.
english: Lacking clothes, they spend the night naked; they have nothing to cover themselves in the cold.

ekegusii: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
english: na Ladani omomura oye, na Amihudi omomura oye, na Elisama omomura oye,

ekegusii: Lameki akanyuoma abakungu babere. Omokungu bwe ritang’ani nigo are korokwa Ada, na oyo o kabere Zila.
english: Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.

ekegusii: Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, listen to me; wives of Lamech, hear my words. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for injuring me.
english: Lameki agatebia abakungu baye, “Ada na Zila, igwa eriogi riane, inwe abakungu ba Lameki, tegerera ogokwana kwane, igo ndaite omonto karanyate orogoma, naisa koba omwana omomura karang’ake.

ekegusii: Naki omogondo oyokonywa embura egotwa engaki ase engaki, na gokinia chinyeni, chigokonya abwo bakoyorema, nigo okonyora ogosesenigwa gokorwa ase Nyasae.
english: Land that drinks in the rain often falling on it and that produces a crop useful to those for whom it is farmed receives the blessing of God.

ekegusii: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.
english: na emeganda emenene ekamotunyana, akabagwenia aroro.

ekegusii: Emeganda emenge ekamotunyana korwa Galili, na Dekapoli, na Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi, na ng’umbu ya Yorodan.
english: Large crowds from Galilee, the Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and the region across the Jordan followed him.

ekegusii: Emeganda emenge nigo yarenge amo na Yeso; ere akeonchora, akabatebia,
english: Large crowds were traveling with Jesus, and turning to them he said:

ekegusii: Ekiagera obotuko obo bwa rero omomalaika o Nyasae, oria inche inde omonto oye, naende nere ngosasima,
english: Last night an angel of the God whose I am and whom I serve stood beside me

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio agatoma omwana oye asebare, ogoteba: Inabasike omwana one.
english: Last of all, he sent his son to them. 'They will respect my son,' he said.

ekegusii: Rigachaka kogoroba, na baria ikomi na babere bakamochiera, bakamotebia, “Tiga omoganda ogende goika ase ebichie ne chinsemo chietanaine, banyore aase bakorara amo nendagera, ekiagera aiga nigo tore aase egesomo.”
english: Late in the afternoon the Twelve came to him and said, "Send the crowd away so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside and find food and lodging, because we are in a remote place here."

ekegusii: “Korende ase amatuko aya mwaimokeire abanto baane buna ababisa. Nigo mokwaboria ebiambaro bi’abwo bagotaara bare nomorembe bataganeti esegi.
english: Lately my people have risen up like an enemy. You strip off the rich robe from those who pass by without a care, like men returning from battle.

ekegusii: Later I went to Syria and Cilicia.
english: Erio nyuma nkagenda chinsemo chia Siiria na Kilikia.

ekegusii: Naende akaorokera baria ikomi nomo, ekero barenge koragera; akabatogonyera ase ogotegena kwabo na obokong’u bw’emioyo yabo, ekiagera bategenete abamoroche kabokire.
english: Later Jesus appeared to the Eleven as they were eating; he rebuked them for their lack of faith and their stubborn refusal to believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Yeso akamonyora ore Hekalu ime, akamotebia. “Rora, kwabeire omogima; tokora ebibe naende, ring’ana rire riibe kobua tiricha gokonyora.”
english: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, "See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you."

ekegusii: Engaki enke ekaera, na ekero kie rigesa ri’engano kegaika, Samison akagenda gokwania mokaye, akamoirera emanwa y’embori buna ekeegwa, agateba, “Ninganetie gosoa nyomba mwa mokane.” Korende ise biara tamoa ribaga.
english: Later on, at the time of wheat harvest, Samson took a young goat and went to visit his wife. He said, "I'm going to my wife's room." But her father would not let him go in.

ekegusii: Naende akaibora Abeli omwabo. Abeli akaba omorisia bwe ching’ondi, na Kaini akaba omoremi bw’omogondo.
english: Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the soil.

ekegusii: Later they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Jesus to catch him in his words.
english: Bagatoma asare abande b’Abafarisai na Abaherodiani, erinde bamotege a se amang’ana.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, ekero endamwamu y’omoruoti Ahaswero yakendire, akaba okorengereria igoro ya Vasti, buna akorete, naende buna ogochika kwaruetwe igoro yaye.
english: Later when the anger of King Xerxes had subsided, he remembered Vashti and what she had done and what he had decreed about her.

ekegusii: Ekero Hezironi arenge nemiaka emerongo etano nomo, akanyuoma omoiseke o Makiri, ise Gileadi, Omokungu oria akamoiborera Segubu.
english: Later, Hezron lay with the daughter of Makir the father of Gilead (he had married her when he was sixty years old), and she bore him Segub.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akabwatana n’Ahasia, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, nonya omoruoti oria okorete amang’ana amabe mono.
english: Later, Jehoshaphat king of Judah made an alliance with Ahaziah king of Israel, who was guilty of wickedness.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Yusufu bw’Arimathaya agasaba Pilato ribaga arusie omobere o Yeso. Ere nigo arenge omworokigwa o Yeso, korende bobisi, ekiagera airogete Abayahudi. Pilato akamoa ribaga. Igo agacha, akarusia omobere oye.
english: Later, Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Now Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because he feared the Jews. With Pilate's permission, he came and took the body away.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Yeso, kamanyete ng’a onsi aikire gokorwa, erinde ririko riikeranigwe, akabora, “Ninde nerang’o.”
english: Later, knowing that all was now completed, and so that the Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, "I am thirsty."

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigwete amang’ana ayio, akabora, “Omonene namanyete ng’a inche na abanto baane titori na komocha ase obosio bwaye ase ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’Abineri, mosinto o Neri.
english: Later, when David heard about this, he said, "I and my kingdom are forever innocent before the LORD concerning the blood of Abner son of Ner.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio, Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, oria onaaretie Lakisi amo nabarwani baye bonsi b’esegi, agatoma abasomba baye Yerusalemu ase Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, na ase Abayuda bonsi abwo barenge Yerusalemu, agateba,
english: Later, when Sennacherib king of Assyria and all his forces were laying siege to Lachish, he sent his officers to Jerusalem with this message for Hezekiah king of Judah and for all the people of Judah who were there:

ekegusii: Obworo nigo bokorentera omonto chitoro chindito, na omonto buna oyio goika abe nenchara.
english: Laziness brings on deep sleep, and the shiftless man goes hungry.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo namaboko amoro nigo akoba omotaka, korende amaboko are nomokia nigo akorenta obotenenku.
english: Lazy hands make a man poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo mbwate ababisa abange, ase ayio, ondaae ase oboronge bwao; roisia enchera yao ase ngoetera ebe endonge.
english: Lead me, O LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies-- make straight your way before me.

ekegusii: Renta abanto bonsi bare emeuko nonya babwate amaiso, na abare emetino nonya babwate amato.
english: Lead out those who have eyes but are blind, who have ears but are deaf.

ekegusii: Lea akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Reuben, naki nigo atebete, “Omonene nigo aroche buna nchayire. Bono omosacha one nanyanche.”
english: Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben, for she said, "It is because the LORD has seen my misery. Surely my husband will love me now."

ekegusii: Lea akaba morito naende, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o gatano na rimo.
english: Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.

ekegusii: Lea amaiso aye nigo arenge amatu, korende Raeli nigo arenge omonyakieni, naende omwasioku.
english: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel was lovely in form, and beautiful.

ekegusii: Silpa, omosomba o Lea, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o kabere.
english: Leah's servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.

ekegusii: Erio Silpa, omosomba omoiseke o Lea, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia.
english: Leah's servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.

ekegusii: Ere oria akamweegeka buna arenge ase egekuba kia Yeso, akamoboria, “Omonene, ning’o?”
english: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, "Lord, who is it?"

ekegusii: Mweorokererie gokora ayare amaya, rigia ay’oboronge; bakonye abwo bagokorerwa bobe; rwanerera chintakana, na monyorere ababoraka oboronge bwabo.”
english: learn to do right! Seek justice, encourage the oppressed. Defend the cause of the fatherless, plead the case of the widow.

ekegusii: Soka korwa Babeli, tama korwa ase ense y’Abakalidayo; raria amang’ana aya neriogi ri’omogoko, ee, moyararie! Toma amang’ana ayio gochia ase chinsinyo chi’ense, motebe, “Omonene obooririe abanto ba Yakobo, omosomba oye.”
english: Leave Babylon, flee from the Babylonians! Announce this with shouts of joy and proclaim it. Send it out to the ends of the earth; say, "The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob."

ekegusii: Batige; barabwo nabaraai emeuko. Omouko oise koraa omouko onde, nigo baragwe ase engoro bonsi babere.”
english: Leave them; they are blind guides. If a blind man leads a blind man, both will fall into a pit."

ekegusii: Karue inchera, gobera korwa ase oboeto, morusie asetore Oyio ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.”
english: Leave this way, get off this path, and stop confronting us with the Holy One of Israel!"

ekegusii: akamotebia: Karue ase ense yao, na ase eamate yao, ogende goika ase ense ndakworokie.
english: 'Leave your country and your people,' God said, 'and go to the land I will show you.'

ekegusii: otige esadaka yao agwo ase egesasimero ogende, ritang’ani mwanchane noyomino, erio oirane orue esadaka yao.
english: leave your gift there in front of the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.

ekegusii: Batige abana abwo batabwati abaise, inche nimbarende bagenderere koba moyo, na ababoraka baino, tiga bansemerie.”
english: Leave your orphans; I will protect their lives. Your widows too can trust in me."

ekegusii: Tiga oboriri bwao, erinde obe moyo! Obwatie enchera y’okonyora okomanya!”
english: Leave your simple ways and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa Nazareti, akagenda, akamenya Kapernaumu, omochie ore ang’e nenyancha ase chimbebe chia Sabuloni na Nafutali,
english: Leaving Nazareth, he went and lived in Capernaum, which was by the lake in the area of Zebulun and Naphtali--

ekegusii: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the region of Tyre and Sidon.
english: Yeso akarua aroro, akagenda chinsemo chia Turo na Sidoni.

ekegusii: Bagatiga omoganda, bakamoira amo nabarabwo, buna arenge, ase obwato boria. Na amaato ande narenge amo nere
english: Leaving the crowd behind, they took him along, just as he was, in the boat. There were also other boats with him.

ekegusii: Mambia yaye tokaimoka tokagenda Kaisaria, togasoa enyomba ya Filipo, omorandia bw’enchili. Nere orenge oyomo bwa baria batano na babere; tokamenya bwoye.
english: Leaving the next day, we reached Caesarea and stayed at the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven.

ekegusii: Lebana, Hagaba, Shalmai,
english: Lebana, na Hagaba, na Salimai;

ekegusii: Lebanah, Hagabah, Akkub,
english: Lebana, na Hagaba, na Akubu;

ekegusii: Emete ye rinani ria Lebanoni tegoisana ebe chinko chigouterwa omorero, ne ching’iti chionsi chireo tichigoisana chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
english: Lebanon is not sufficient for altar fires, nor its animals enough for burnt offerings.

ekegusii: Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain and Rimmon-- a total of twenty-nine towns and their villages.
english: na Lebaoti, na Silihimu, na Aini, na Rimoni, emechie emerongo ebere na kianda, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Omosae oria konya orure Bethlehemu ogendire korigia aase akomenya. Na ase orogendo rwaye agaika ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, ase enyomba ya Mika.
english: left that town in search of some other place to stay. On his way he came to Micah's house in the hill country of Ephraim.

ekegusii: Naende abanto abaao nigo baraire chinibo chiao chionsi, na bionsi ebi gwakoreire emeremo biirwe nabanto abwo.
english: lest strangers feast on your wealth and your toil enrich another man's house.

ekegusii: Baise konywa, nigo barebe amachiko, na baonchorane oboronge bwa bonsi abachandegete.
english: lest they drink and forget what the law decrees, and deprive all the oppressed of their rights.

ekegusii: Oise gokora bo, nigo orae abanto abaao amasikani ao, na emiaka yao ebaise konachwa nabanto batari namabera.
english: lest you give your best strength to others and your years to one who is cruel,

ekegusii: Obarentere abauri mobosokano, erinde ebirero biigugwe korwa ase chinyomba chiabo, ekiagera bakunyire eirima, erinde basirie obogima bwane: babekire oboreba ng’a amagoro aane abwatwe.
english: Let a cry be heard from their houses when you suddenly bring invaders against them, for they have dug a pit to capture me and have hidden snares for my feet.

ekegusii: Tiga morenterwe amache make, mwesibie amagoro, na motimokere aa ase ekiriri ki’omote oyo.
english: Let a little water be brought, and then you may all wash your feet and rest under this tree.

ekegusii: Tiga oyore omonyaboronge ang’ake na antogonyere ase obwanchani, okwo nigo konga buna amaguta akweakwa, na omotwe one toyaanga. Botambe nigo ogosaba kwane kore mamincha y’abakori amabe.
english: Let a righteous man strike me-- it is a kindness; let him rebuke me-- it is oil on my head. My head will not refuse it. Yet my prayer is ever against the deeds of evildoers;

ekegusii: Ense yonsi neiroke Omonene, na bonsi abamenyete ase ense bamwoboe.
english: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere him.

ekegusii: Aye omonyene tobaisa gwetogia, korende tiga omonto onde agotogie; tiga omonto omoao agotogie, korende tari ebikoba biao omonyene.
english: Let another praise you, and not your own mouth; someone else, and not your own lips.

ekegusii: Bitige bikine bionsi bibere goika rigesa, na ekero kie rigesa nintebie abakogesa: Ritang’ani sangereria amabanchore, moyaboe emesaima monyare koyasamba; korende engano moyesangererie gochia kiage kiane.”
english: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat and bring it into my barn.'"

ekegusii: Tiga omorero bw’amakara obagwere, barabwo batugutwe ase omorero, barutwe ase chingoro chintambe tibaruao.
english: Let burning coals fall upon them; may they be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, never to rise.

ekegusii: Tiga amakweri abachere ababisa baane mobosokano, bagende gochia aase abakure bare moyo; obobe nigo bore ase obomenyo bwabo, na ase chinkoro chiabo.
english: Let death take my enemies by surprise; let them go down alive to the grave, for evil finds lodging among them.

ekegusii: tiga abakuani bachibogorie, kera oyomo korwa ase abanto baye. Erio barabwo baroiserie enyomba aande onsi eganirie koroisigwa.”
english: Let every priest receive the money from one of the treasurers, and let it be used to repair whatever damage is found in the temple."

ekegusii: Tiga ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo bitogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene!
english: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Nairanerie ababisa baane obobe bwabo. Aye Omonene, obasirie, ekiagera igo ore omwegenwa.
english: Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in your faithfulness destroy them.

ekegusii: Tiga ndengwe ase ekerengo ekeronge, na Nyasae amanye oboikeranu bwane.
english: let God weigh me in honest scales and he will know that I am blameless--

ekegusii: Tiga endagera yame enyinge ase ense, nonya nase ebitunwa igoro. Chindagera echio tiga china‐konyegerigwa buna emete ya Lebanoni. Abanto b’emechie tiga babuche babe buna obonyansi bw’ense.
english: Let grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. Let its fruit flourish like Lebanon; let it thrive like the grass of the field.

ekegusii: Tiga igoro na ense chitogie Omonene, naboigo na enyancha, na ebitongwa bionsi bire imeo.
english: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and all that move in them,

ekegusii: Tiga abete omonwa oye ase riroba akire‐kiri, aande nabo ogosemeria korabeo.
english: Let him bury his face in the dust-- there may yet be hope.

ekegusii: Tiga anyunyunte nokonyunyunta kw’omonwa oye. Obwanchani bwao nobuya kobua edivai.
english: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth-- for your love is more delightful than wine.

ekegusii: Motige amenye amo nainwe ase omochie arachore, oyio oramogokie agwo ase emechie yaino. Timobaisa komokorera bobe.
english: Let him live among you wherever he likes and in whatever town he chooses. Do not oppress him.

ekegusii: Tabaisa kweng’aina ase ogosemeria amang’ana a bosa, ekiagera obosa obwo nabwo borabe eng’eria yaye.
english: Let him not deceive himself by trusting what is worthless, for he will get nothing in return.

ekegusii: Tiga aonchore orosea rwaye gochia ase oyio okomoaka, na oyio aisaneke noborami.
english: Let him offer his cheek to one who would strike him, and let him be filled with disgrace.

ekegusii: Tiga aikaranse ao bweka akire‐kiri, ekiagera Omonene nere omotwekire egurube eyio.
english: Let him sit alone in silence, for the LORD has laid it on him.

ekegusii: Oyogokora ayatari boronge, tiga agenderere gokora ayatari boronge, na oyotachenegeti, tiga agenderere koba oyotachenegeti, na oyore omoronge, tiga agenderere gokora oboronge, na oyore omochenu agenderere gochenwa.”
english: Let him who does wrong continue to do wrong; let him who is vile continue to be vile; let him who does right continue to do right; and let him who is holy continue to be holy."

ekegusii: Enkoro yaye neonchorwe teba eya mwanyabanto naende; naegwe enkoro buna eye ching’iti ase ebiro bitano na bibere.
english: Let his mind be changed from that of a man and let him be given the mind of an animal, till seven times pass by for him.

ekegusii: Tiga barore ogosirigwa kwabo namaiso abo, naende banyoosigwe endamwamu y’Omonguru.
english: Let his own eyes see his destruction; let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli bagokere Omotongi obo; abanto ba Sayoni tiga bachengere Omoruoti obo!
english: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.

ekegusii: Tiga Abaisraeli batebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”
english: Let Israel say: "His love endures forever."

ekegusii: Totiga obuya na ekeene birue asore; obisibe ase rigoti riao, na obirike ase enkoro yao.
english: Let love and faithfulness never leave you; bind them around your neck, write them on the tablet of your heart.

ekegusii: Tobaisa goteema gontanga, ntige imbasirie naende intinyie amarieta abo, nimbakore bebwe kegima, tibabaisa koinyorwa ase ense, erio ngokore aye obe egesaku ekenene, naende kere ne chinguru kobabua.
english: Let me alone, so that I may destroy them and blot out their name from under heaven. And I will make you into a nation stronger and more numerous than they."

ekegusii: Inche imbarentere endagera inke morie, erio monyore chinguru; nyuma yaye mogenderere ase mware kogenda, naki aase aiga mwaeta naase aane inche omosomba oino.” Bakamotebia, “Gaki, kora buna gwateba.”
english: Let me get you something to eat, so you can be refreshed and then go on your way-- now that you have come to your servant." "Very well," they answered, "do as you say."

ekegusii: Nagosabire, koranche ong’e ribaga nyamboke gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodan, indore ense eria engiya y’ebitunwa amo na Lebanoni.
english: Let me go over and see the good land beyond the Jordan-- that fine hill country and Lebanon."

ekegusii: Tiga ng’ete rero ase amaicho ao onsi, ndusie korwao kera eng’ondi emechege na egesembe, na emanwa y’eng’ondiemwamu, na kera embori nyankororo na nyankanga. Echio nachio chirabe eng’eria yane.
english: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb and every spotted or speckled goat. They will be my wages.

ekegusii: Onkore imbe nomogoko na omochengo, amauga aane aya gwasenyentete agoke.
english: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.

ekegusii: Tiga omoyo one obe moyo, erinde ngotogie, na aya gwachikire, tiga ankonye.
english: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tontiga nsookigwe, ekiagera nigo ngokorangeria. Tiga abakori amabe basookigwe, bagende aase abakure babe amamama.
english: Let me not be put to shame, O LORD, for I have cried out to you; but let the wicked be put to shame and lie silent in the grave.

ekegusii: Omoyo one tosoa ase obobisi bwabo, gose enkoro yane tesanga ase omosangererekano obo; naki ase endamwamu yabo mbaitete abanto, na ase obomwenu bwabo bakanacha chinteng’e chie chintang’ana.
english: Let me not enter their council, let me not join their assembly, for they have killed men in their anger and hamstrung oxen as they pleased.

ekegusii: Inyorokererie, erinde imanye chinchera chi’amachiko ao, nimbe nkona koiranerera ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.
english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts; then I will meditate on your wonders.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagonchanda tiga barenterwe obosooku, korende inche timbaisa korenterwa obosooku. Barabwo tiga baichanigwe, korende inche ting’ichanigwa. Rituko ri’emechando tiga richiche igoro asebare, basirigwe nogosirigwa ara kabere.
english: Let my persecutors be put to shame, but keep me from shame; let them be terrified, but keep me from terror. Bring on them the day of disaster; destroy them with double destruction.

ekegusii: Amorokererio aane tiga atwe buna embura, na enkwana yane etoore buna riime ri’embura, buna omonyirira okonyirira igoro ase obonyansi obobese, na buna embura engiya egotwa igoro ase ebimeri ebirere.
english: Let my teaching fall like rain and my words descend like dew, like showers on new grass, like abundant rain on tender plants.

ekegusii: Timoba nesira ase onde bwensi otatiga ogwanchana, ekiagera oyomwanchete omogisangio oye oikeranirie amachiko.
english: Let no debt remain outstanding, except the continuing debt to love one another, for he who loves his fellowman has fulfilled the law.

ekegusii: Omonto bw’egesaku ekeao obwatanire n’Omonene tabaisa goteba iga: “Ekeene, Omonene nigo aranyatanane korwa ase abanto baye”, na oyo ore omogomba tateba iga: “Rora, inche nigo inde omote omwomo.”
english: Let no foreigner who has bound himself to the LORD say, "The LORD will surely exclude me from his people." And let not any eunuch complain, "I am only a dry tree."

ekegusii: Monto onde oino tabaisa korua omwana oye, omomura gose omoiseke, asambwe ase omorero ime abe ekeng’wanso. Onde taba ase egati yaino oyogokora oboringoria, gose oborogi, gose koruta chinche, gose oyogokora oboragori,
english: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire, who practices divination or sorcery, interprets omens, engages in witchcraft,

ekegusii: Monto onde tabang’aina ase amang’ana atari nengencho, ekiagera ase aya endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo egochera abanto b’ogotaigwera.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things God's wrath comes on those who are disobedient.

ekegusii: na ere oyore mogondo tairana nyomba kobogoria eanga yaye.
english: Let no one in the field go back to get his cloak.

ekegusii: na ere oyore kerama igoro taika gosoa nyomba ime, gose tasoa kobogoria egento korwa mwaye;
english: Let no one on the roof of his house go down or enter the house to take anything out.

ekegusii: Ere oyore kerama igoro taika kogenda kobogoria gento ekere nyomba mwaye,
english: Let no one on the roof of his house go down to take anything out of the house.

ekegusii: Ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, ememera tenyorekana ase ense yaino yonsi, na enyama y’ekeng’wanso kiaruetwe ase omogoroba bwe rituko rie ritang’ani tetigarigwa ebeo ase obotuko bwonsi goika rituko ria kabere.
english: Let no yeast be found in your possession in all your land for seven days. Do not let any of the meat you sacrifice on the evening of the first day remain until morning.

ekegusii: Totiga enkoro yane egobere yanche amang’ana amabe. Tontiga inare gokora ayare amabe amo nabwo bagokora ebibe; tingosanga amo nabarabwo ase emeyega.
english: Let not my heart be drawn to what is evil, to take part in wicked deeds with men who are evildoers; let me not eat of their delicacies.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gotiga abarwani bakumbe amata na korasa chinsara chiabo, gose kobeka chigoti chi’ebioma. Timororera abamura b’aroro amabera. Mosirie abarwani baye b’esegi bonsi pi.
english: Let not the archer string his bow, nor let him put on his armor. Do not spare her young men; completely destroy her army.

ekegusii: Totiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane engencho ende etaiyo; totiga abwo bangechete bosa bagosimanera amaiso bankore bobe.
english: Let not those gloat over me who are my enemies without cause; let not those who hate me without reason maliciously wink the eye.

ekegusii: Gaki, omonene oito, tochike intwe abasomba bao, tokorigerie omonto omanyete kobugia obokano buya, na ekero omoika oyio omobe okorwa ase Nyasae ogocha igoro asore, omonto oyio nabe okobugia obokano, erinde aye obe buya naende.”
english: Let our lord command his servants here to search for someone who can play the harp. He will play when the evil spirit from God comes upon you, and you will feel better."

ekegusii: Gaki tiga abatang’ani baito batenenere omoganda bwonsi. Erio abanto bonsi bare ase emechie yaito banyuomire abakungu abwo b’ebisaku ebiao bache ase chingaki barachikwe; bachiche bare amo nabagaaka na abagambi ebina ba kera omochie. Ase enchera eyio nabakendie endamwamu ya Nyasae oito igoro ye ring’ana eri, erinde ebe yaonchokire etotige.”
english: Let our officials act for the whole assembly. Then let everyone in our towns who has married a foreign woman come at a set time, along with the elders and judges of each town, until the fierce anger of our God in this matter is turned away from us."

ekegusii: Na bono Farao, aya naro ogwenerete okore: Obeke abateneneri igoro y’ense eye bachoge ensemo ya isano y’endagera ase ense ya Misiri ase emiaka eye etano na ebere y’omoigoto.
english: Let Pharaoh appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, tiga toegwe abamura batano na babere b’ororeria rwaye, erinde tobasunge ase obosio bw’Omonene aiga Gibea aase Saulo, omochore bw’Omonene, amenyete.” Omoruoti akabairaneria, “Nimbarue.”
english: let seven of his male descendants be given to us to be killed and exposed before the LORD at Gibeah of Saul-- the Lord's chosen one." So the king said, "I will give them to you."

ekegusii: Totiga abagenki bagenderere koba ase ense. Obobe nigo bogotwara abanto abatindi ase omoayerero bwabasiria.
english: Let slanderers not be established in the land; may disaster hunt down men of violence.

ekegusii: Agakwana, “Baria bare nokobua ase egati yaino, tiga batirimboke amo nainche, onye ring’ana rire riibe ase omonto oria, bamosoere.”
english: Let some of your leaders come with me and press charges against the man there, if he has done anything wrong."

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi tiga basangererekane bagoetanane, obagambere korwa ase ekerogo kiao ki’obonene aaria igoro.
english: Let the assembled peoples gather around you. Rule over them from on high;

ekegusii: Tiga erooro na emechie ereo biake amariogi, na abamenyete ase emechie ya Kedari boigo. Abanto bamenyete ase omochie o Sela mbatere nomogoko, baake eriogi korwa ase ebichuria bi’ebitunwa igoro.
english: Let the desert and its towns raise their voices; let the settlements where Kedar lives rejoice. Let the people of Sela sing for joy; let them shout from the mountaintops.

ekegusii: Emegondo echenge amo nebinto bionsi bire ime yabo! Erio emete yonsi ye rinani netere nomogoko
english: let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy;

ekegusii: Totiga ababisa abwo bang’etananire babue, tiga obobe bw’amang’ana bagokwana bobairanere abanyene.
english: Let the heads of those who surround me be covered with the trouble their lips have caused.

ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogoko, tiga enyancha echenge ase okoeera, amo na bionsi ebire ime yaye!
english: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it;

ekegusii: Tiga igoro chibe nomogoko na ense echenge, abanto b’ebisaku batebigwe: “Omonene nere okogamba.”
english: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let them say among the nations, "The LORD reigns!"

ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’enyomba ya Haroni batebe, “Obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.”
english: Let the house of Aaron say: "His love endures forever."

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti, chika abanene bare ase chingongo chionsi chi’obogambi bwao basangererie abaiseke abekungi abare abanyabieni, babarente ase enyomba y’abakungu ere agwo ase eburi ya Susa. Barabwo babekwe inse y’oborendi bwa Hegai, omokoreri oria ogombaetigwe, oyio otenenerete abakungu bamenyete ase enyomba yao. Abaiseke abwo baegwe amaguta abo bakweaka.
english: Let the king appoint commissioners in every province of his realm to bring all these beautiful girls into the harem at the citadel of Susa. Let them be placed under the care of Hegai, the king's eunuch, who is in charge of the women; and let beauty treatments be given to them.

ekegusii: Omonene, naye okonachera abanto bonsi ekina. Aye Omonene, onachere inche ekina koreng’ana noboronge bwane, na buna ntari na komocha.
english: let the LORD judge the peoples. Judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, according to my integrity, O Most High.

ekegusii: Tiga Abamoabu, abanto baito, abwo baserigwe bamenye amo nainwe; kabe obotamero bwabo korwa ase abwo bakogania kobasiria, goika abachandi babo babe basirire, na abwo barenge kobatiringera inse babe basirigwe korwa ase ense eyio.
english: Let the Moabite fugitives stay with you; be their shelter from the destroyer." The oppressor will come to an end, and destruction will cease; the aggressor will vanish from the land.

ekegusii: Kera emambia omanyie obwanchani bwao bogenderere botambe, ekiagera naye nyegenete. Inyorokererie enchera ngwenerete kobwatia, ekiagera narure omoyo one asore.
english: Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love, for I have put my trust in you. Show me the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul.
