ekegusii: Moredekai akarua ase omoruoti, obegete chianga chi’oboruoti chire nekieni kere buru na ekerabu, obegete egutwa enene y’etahabu na egetambaa gi’okwambara ki’egatani engiya kere monyinga, na abanto b’omochie o Susa bagaaka eriogi, bagochenga.
english: Mordecai left the king's presence wearing royal garments of blue and white, a large crown of gold and a purple robe of fine linen. And the city of Susa held a joyous celebration.

ekegusii: Moredekai akarika amang’ana ayio, na agatoma amarube ase Abayahudi bonsi abarenge ang’e na aare ase chingongo chionsi chi’oboruoti bw’Ahaswero,
english: Mordecai recorded these events, and he sent letters to all the Jews throughout the provinces of King Xerxes, near and far,

ekegusii: Moredekai, Omoyahudi oria, nere orenge oyo o kabere ase omoruoti Ahaswero. Nigo arenge omonene ase Abayahudi, osikire nabamwabo bonsi, ekiagera nigo arenge korigia amaya ase abanto baye, na akerua ase okobarentera omorembe.
english: Mordecai the Jew was second in rank to King Xerxes, preeminent among the Jews, and held in high esteem by his many fellow Jews, because he worked for the good of his people and spoke up for the welfare of all the Jews.

ekegusii: Moredekai akamotebia amang’ana onsi amonyorete; boigo akamotebia omobaro bwe chibesa Hamani arire eira kobeka ase ekungo y’omoruoti, ng’a Abayahudi bonsi baitwe basirigwe kegima.
english: Mordecai told him everything that had happened to him, including the exact amount of money Haman had promised to pay into the royal treasury for the destruction of the Jews.

ekegusii: Moredekai nigo arenge omonene ase enyomba y’omoruoti, na akamenta koba nokobua, na igo chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase chingongo chionsi chi’oboruoti boria.
english: Mordecai was prominent in the palace; his reputation spread throughout the provinces, and he became more and more powerful.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo arigetwe na kobekwa erieta ri’omoruoti Ahaswero, na akabekwa ekemanyererio ki’ebonyi yaye. Erio amarube ayio akairwa nabariini be chibarasi chiare kominyoka bwango chiarwete ase obweri bwe chibarasi chi’omoruoti.
english: Mordecai wrote in the name of King Xerxes, sealed the dispatches with the king's signet ring, and sent them by mounted couriers, who rode fast horses especially bred for the king.

ekegusii: Abwo batiananetie nigo barenge abanto kobua emerongo ene.
english: More than forty men were involved in this plot.

ekegusii: Ee, naintwe rirorio twarorekanire koba birori b’oborimo ba Nyasae, ekiagera twatebete ng’a Nyasae nigo abogetie Kristo, oyo rirorio tamobogetie, onye abakure tibakobokigwa.
english: More than that, we are then found to be false witnesses about God, for we have testified about God that he raised Christ from the dead. But he did not raise him if in fact the dead are not raised.

ekegusii: Na inwe Abafilipi abanyene mwamanyire ng’a ase omochakano bw’enchili, ekero naruete Makedonia, ekanisa ende tiyarenge yabwatanete nainche ase amang’ana ’okorua na okonyora, otatiga inwe mweka.
english: Moreover, as you Philippians know, in the early days of your acquaintance with the gospel, when I set out from Macedonia, not one church shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving, except you only;

ekegusii: Danieli akaboria Nebukadinesaro, na ere akabeka Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bakaba abanene igoro ase amang’ana ’orogongo rwa Babeli, korende Danieli akabeera ase enyomba y’omoruoti.
english: Moreover, at Daniel's request the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego administrators over the province of Babylon, while Daniel himself remained at the royal court.

ekegusii: Naende Daudi akabua Hadadeseri, omoruoti o Soba, agwo Hamati, ekero omoruoti oria agendete gokong’ia oboruoti bwaye aaria ase orooche rw’Eufarati.
english: Moreover, David fought Hadadezer king of Zobah, as far as Hamath, when he went to establish his control along the Euphrates River.

ekegusii: Naende Daudi akabua Hadadeseri mosinto o Rehobu, omoruoti o Soba, ekero ere agendete kogareyia obogambi bwaye gochia ase orooche rw’Eufarati.
english: Moreover, David fought Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when he went to restore his control along the Euphrates River.

ekegusii: Ebirecha bigasoka korwa ase abange, bigaaka eriogi, bikabora, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabitogonyera, tabitiga bikwane, ekiagera biamanyete ng’a nere Kristo.
english: Moreover, demons came out of many people, shouting, "You are the Son of God!" But he rebuked them and would not allow them to speak, because they knew he was the Christ.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria yonsi y’emiaka ikomi na ebere, ekero narenge omogambi bw’ense ya Yuda, korwa omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, goika omwaka bw’emerongo etato na ebere, bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita, inche gose abanto baminto titwariete endagera omogambi agwenerete koegwa.
english: Moreover, from the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes, when I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, until his thirty-second year-- twelve years-- neither I nor my brothers ate the food allotted to the governor.

ekegusii: Nachorire Oholiabu, mosinto bw’Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani amokonye ase emeremo eyio. Nabaeire abaroisia bande bonsi obong’aini, erinde banyare gokora ebinto bionsi ebi nagochikire.
english: Moreover, I have appointed Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, to help him. Also I have given skill to all the craftsmen to make everything I have commanded you:

ekegusii: Na bono naigure okwerera kw’Abaisraeli abwo Abamisiri babegete inse y’obosomba, naende ning’inyorete okobwatana koria kwane.
english: Moreover, I have heard the groaning of the Israelites, whom the Egyptians are enslaving, and I have remembered my covenant.

ekegusii: Amo nayio nachikire amang’ana morakorere abagaaka abwo b’Abayahudi ase okoagacha enyomba eyio ya Nyasae naende. Emeremo yonsi nigo eraakanerwe korwa ase chibesa chi’ekungo y’oboruoti, echikorwa ase ebango eria ekorusigwa korwa ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati; mobe mokobaakana motari gotebana.
english: Moreover, I hereby decree what you are to do for these elders of the Jews in the construction of this house of God: The expenses of these men are to be fully paid out of the royal treasury, from the revenues of Trans-Euphrates, so that the work will not stop.

ekegusii: Naende ninkoe boigo ebinto binde otaboria; ninkoe obotenenku obonge na obonene bw’ogosikwa, na omoruoti onde tari orareng’anigwe naye ase amatuko ao onsi.
english: Moreover, I will give you what you have not asked for-- both riches and honor-- so that in your lifetime you will have no equal among kings.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria boigo nkarora Abayuda bande banyuomete abakungu korwa ase chinse chi’Abaasidodi na Abaamoni, na Abamoabu.
english: Moreover, in those days I saw men of Judah who had married women from Ashdod, Ammon and Moab.

ekegusii: Yakobo nigo agendete bobisi korwa o Labani Omoaramu, tamotebetie ng’a nkogenda are sobo.
english: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away.

ekegusii: Boigo omoruoti Koresi akairania ebikorero bi’enyomba y’Omonene, biria Nebukadinesaro arusetie Yerusalemu na akabigacha ase enyomba ye chinyasae chiaye.
english: Moreover, King Cyrus brought out the articles belonging to the temple of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had carried away from Jerusalem and had placed in the temple of his god.

ekegusii: Amo nayio Manase naiterete amanyinga ay’abange batarenge na komocha, goika agaichora Yerusalemu ase chinsemo chionsi namanyinga ayio, komenta nebibe biria akorete akagera Abayuda bagakora ebibe na gokora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Moreover, Manasseh also shed so much innocent blood that he filled Jerusalem from end to end-- besides the sin that he had caused Judah to commit, so that they did evil in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Amo nayio mwanyabanto onde tamanyeti engaki yaye. Buna koreng’ana chinswe chikobwatwa ase ekeonga ase egesio ekebe, ne chinyoni ase obosugunia, naboigo na mwanyabanto bakonyorwa nengaki embe, babwatwa mobosokano.
english: Moreover, no man knows when his hour will come: As fish are caught in a cruel net, or birds are taken in a snare, so men are trapped by evil times that fall unexpectedly upon them.

ekegusii: Amaiso aito arosire ase okorigereria, na okoganya bosa ng’a natokonywe; korwa ase ebitengero biaito, nigo twaganyete egesaku getanyare gototooria.
english: Moreover, our eyes failed, looking in vain for help; from our towers we watched for a nation that could not save us.

ekegusii: Sulemani nere oikaransire ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti.
english: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.

ekegusii: Naki Tata tari kogambia monto onde bwensi, korende oeire Omwana obogambi bwonsi,
english: Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,

ekegusii: Naende Omonene natome ebiaramba ase egati yabo bibarase, baria abatigari barebise korwa asemore, basire kegima.
english: Moreover, the LORD your God will send the hornet among them until even the survivors who hide from you have perished.

ekegusii: Naboigo ring’ana ri’Omonene rikarentwa nomobani Yehu, mosinto o Hanani, igoro ya Baasa na abanto b’enyomba yaye, ase engencho y’amabe onsi akorete ase amaiso ’Omonene. Omonene akagechigwa goika akaba nendamwamu ase engencho y’ayio onsi Baasa akorete ase okoba buna abanto b’enyomba ya Yeroboamu; boigo ekiagera asiretie abanto abwo.
english: Moreover, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Jehu son of Hanani to Baasha and his house, because of all the evil he had done in the eyes of the LORD, provoking him to anger by the things he did, and becoming like the house of Jeroboam-- and also because he destroyed it.

ekegusii: Abayahudi abwo nigo barenge gotogia Tobia ase obosio bwane, na abwo nigo barenge komoirera amang’ana aane. Tobia omonyene akaba ogontomera amarube ay’okonyoboyia.
english: Moreover, they kept reporting to me his good deeds and then telling him what I said. And Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.

ekegusii: Amo nayio ntwarenge nabatata baito b’ense eye, baare gotorongeyia, na barabwo ntwabasigete. Inee! Tari buya mono kobua kwebeka inse ya Tata bw’emeika yaito, na koba moyo?
english: Moreover, we have all had human fathers who disciplined us and we respected them for it. How much more should we submit to the Father of our spirits and live!

ekegusii: Onye Nyasae oeire omonto obotenenku ne chinibo, naende omoeire okobua gw’okwegokia ase ebinto ebio na kobikorera ase obuya bwaye, boigo koba nomogoko ase emeremo yaye, ayio onsi nigo are ebiegwa bia Nyasae.
english: Moreover, when God gives any man wealth and possessions, and enables him to enjoy them, to accept his lot and be happy in his work-- this is a gift of God.

ekegusii: Naende oire chifeta ne chitahabu chiria inche omoruoti, na abasemia baane, twarure nogwancha ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyio obomenyo bwaye bore Yerusalemu.
english: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his advisers have freely given to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,

ekegusii: Naende nonya naboigo, aye totorenteti ase ense eria entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, gose totoeti emiando y’amaremo na emegondo y’emesabibu. Inee! Igo ogochia kobaukoria abanto aba bonsi? Intwe titogocha.”
english: Moreover, you haven't brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you gouge out the eyes of these men? No, we will not come!"

ekegusii: Moses agreed to stay with the man, who gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses in marriage.
english: Musa agancha komenya bw’omonto oria na ere akaa Musa Sipora, omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.

ekegusii: Boigo abamura ba Haroni bakarentwa na Musa akagindia amanyinga mesia y’amato abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amagoro abo a borio. Erio amanyinga aria atigarete akayasiarera ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: Moses also brought Aaron's sons forward and put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet. Then he sprinkled blood against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Moses also said to Korah, "Now listen, you Levites!
english: Musa akagenderera gokwana na Kora, agateba, “Bono inwe Abalawi, igwa!

ekegusii: Naende Musa agateba, “Erio nario moramanye obonene bw’Omonene ekero arabae chinyama morie mogoroba, na mambia abae omogati morie, moigote. Naki Omonene oigure buna mwamwemurunganeirie. Intwe titoisaini gento. Tari intwe mwemurunganeirie, korende n’Omonene.”
english: Moses also said, "You will know that it was the LORD when he gives you meat to eat in the evening and all the bread you want in the morning, because he has heard your grumbling against him. Who are we? You are not grumbling against us, but against the LORD."

ekegusii: Akaimokia ebitinya bionsi biarenge ase chinyama chi’enda, na ebitinya bie riini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere amo nebitinya bichitubete, Erio Musa akabisambera ase egesasimero.
english: Moses also took all the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it on the altar.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni amo nabamura baye mbabe bagotoora kororia Obomenyo Obochenu ensemo ya moocha, bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Barabwo nigo barabe bagokora emeremo eganeirie gokorwa ime y’Aase Aachenu, na gotenenera emeremo ende yonsi erakorerwe Abaisraeli. Omonto onde bwensi otaatananiri gokora emeremo eyio, korende aike ang’e ase Obomenyo Obochenu, nigo araitwe akwe.
english: Moses and Aaron and his sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, in front of the Tent of Meeting. They were responsible for the care of the sanctuary on behalf of the Israelites. Anyone else who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.

ekegusii: Moses and Aaron brought together all the elders of the Israelites,
english: Musa na Haroni bakagenda, bagasangereria abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete.
english: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD commanded them.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bagakora buna Omonene abachigete. Haroni akaimokia enyimbo yaye, agaaka orooche bosio bwa Farao na bw’abasomba baye, na amache ayare imeo akaonchoka, akaba amanyinga.
english: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD had commanded. He raised his staff in the presence of Pharaoh and his officials and struck the water of the Nile, and all the water was changed into blood.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bagakora amakumia ayio onsi ase obosio bwa Farao, korende Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, na ere taa Abaisraeli ribaga barue ase ense yaye.
english: Moses and Aaron performed all these wonders before Pharaoh, but the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart, and he would not let the Israelites go out of his country.

ekegusii: Erio Musa na Haroni bagasoa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime, naende ekero basokire korwa aroro, bagasesenia abanto, na obonene bw’Omonene bokaorokera abanto bonsi.
english: Moses and Aaron then went into the Tent of Meeting. When they came out, they blessed the people; and the glory of the LORD appeared to all the people.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bakaira abanto abwo baatoretwe ase amarieta abo,
english: Moses and Aaron took these men whose names had been given,

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bakarua agwo ase omoganda oria, bakagenda ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama agwo ase egesoero. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokabaorokera.
english: Moses and Aaron went from the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni nigo barenge abamo b’abakuani b’Omonene, boigo Samweli nigo arenge oyomo bw’abanto barenge korangeria erieta riaye. Abanto abwo nigo barangeretie Omonene ng’a abakonye, nere akabaigwa.
english: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the LORD and he answered them.

ekegusii: Erio Musa, na Haroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka baria emerongo etano na ebere b’Abaisraeli bagatiira gochia egetunwa igoro,
english: Moses and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and the seventy elders of Israel went up

ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari omokuani bakanyora korwa ase abatang’ani abwo chitahabu chiria chiaroisetigwe ebinto bi’ogwechabera.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted from them the gold-- all the crafted articles.

ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari omokuani bakanyora chitahabu chiria korwa ase abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana, bagachiira ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Abaisraeli bakainyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted the gold from the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.

ekegusii: Musa, ekero arenge nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli, agachika abanto akabatebia, “Mobwate amachiko onsi aya nabachikire rituko ria rero.
english: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people: "Keep all these commands that I give you today.

ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Nekiagera abanto bagonchichera, bakorigia oboraai bwa Nyasae.
english: Moses answered him, "Because the people come to me to seek God's will.

ekegusii: Musa akairaneria abanto, “Timwoboa, motenene bokong’u! Igo namorore buna Omonene arabatoorie rero; naki Abamisiri aba moroche rero iga, timokobarora naende nonya ng’ake.
english: Moses answered the people, "Do not be afraid. Stand firm and you will see the deliverance the LORD will bring you today. The Egyptians you see today you will never see again.

ekegusii: Musa akabatebia, “Ganya, inyigwe aya Omonene arachike igoro asemore.”
english: Moses answered them, "Wait until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you."

ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Bono buna nkorua asore nimosabe Omonene arusie chingi korwa asore aye Farao, na ase abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, ankio mambia. Korende aye Farao, tokora obong’ainereria naende, na kwanga koa abanto ribaga bagende baruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.”
english: Moses answered, "As soon as I leave you, I will pray to the LORD, and tomorrow the flies will leave Pharaoh and his officials and his people. Only be sure that Pharaoh does not act deceitfully again by not letting the people go to offer sacrifices to the LORD."

ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Nigo toragende twensi, abake na abagotu, na abana baito, abamura na abaiseke, ching’ondi ne chitugo chiaito chinde chionsi, ekiagera ntobwate Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene.”
english: Moses answered, "We will go with our young and old, with our sons and daughters, and with our flocks and herds, because we are to celebrate a festival to the LORD."

ekegusii: Erio Musa akairaneria, “Korerende onye barabwo bakwanga konyegena, gose koigwa amang’ana aane, inki rende ndakore? Aande nigo baratebe: Omonene takoorokereti.”
english: Moses answered, "What if they do not believe me or listen to me and say, 'The LORD did not appear to you'?"

ekegusii: Musa akarangeria omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli amo, akabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene achikire morakore:
english: Moses assembled the whole Israelite community and said to them, "These are the things the LORD has commanded you to do:

ekegusii: Erio bwango Musa agatung’ama inse, agasasima,
english: Moses bowed to the ground at once and worshiped.

ekegusii: Musa akaagacha egesasimero agwo, agakeroka “Yahwe Nisi”, engencho yaye, “Omonene nebendera yane y’esegi”,
english: Moses built an altar and called it The LORD is my Banner.

ekegusii: Musa ekero arenge na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, agacha agakwana amang’ana onsi ay’ogotera okwo, ekero abanto bategererete.
english: Moses came with Joshua son of Nun and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.

ekegusii: Musa agachika Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Eyio nero ense morarie ebe omwando oino ase ogoaka obomera, ense eria Omonene achikire ng’a ebe ey’ebisaku kianda na ekeng’ese.
english: Moses commanded the Israelites: "Assign this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has ordered that it be given to the nine and a half tribes,

ekegusii: Musa tanyara gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, ekiagera riire riria riabete igoro yaye, na obonene bogaichora ime ase Obomenyo.
english: Moses could not enter the Tent of Meeting because the cloud had settled upon it, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

ekegusii: Naki Musa nigo arigete igoro y’oboronge obo bokorua ase amachiko, ng’a omonto oyorakore aya nabe nobogima ase aya.
english: Moses describes in this way the righteousness that is by the law: "The man who does these things will live by them."

ekegusii: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochigete, na ekero omoganda bwonsi osangererekanete ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano,
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Musa akaira Yoshua buna Omonene konya amochikire, akamorenta ase obosio bw’Eleazari na obw’omoganda bwonsi.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole assembly.

ekegusii: Musa agakora buna Omonene amochigete. Barabwo bagatiira gochia igoro as egetunwa keria kia Hori, ekero omoganda bwonsi origereretie.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded: They went up Mount Hor in the sight of the whole community.

ekegusii: Musa agakora onsi buna Omonene konya amochikire.
english: Moses did everything just as the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Naboigo Musa akorete buna Omonene amochigete.
english: Moses did just as the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Moses' father-in-law replied, "What you are doing is not good.
english: Yetero agatebia Musa, “Enchera eye y’okobagambera ebina biabo teri engiya.

ekegusii: Musa akaa Haroni amo nabamura baye chibesa chiria chi’okobooria, buna Omonene amochigete.
english: Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons, as he was commanded by the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: Musa akaa Eleazari omokuani ensemo eria yaruetwe ase Omonene, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as the LORD's part, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Musa akaimoka amo nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli, bakagenda ase Datani na Abiiramu.
english: Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel followed him.

ekegusii: Naki Musa konya oeire ebisaku binde bibere na ekeng’ese ense ere ng’umbu, moocha ya Yorodan, ebe omwando obo, korende Abalawi barabwo tibaetwe ense ase egati yabo, ebe omwando obo.
english: Moses had granted the two-and-a-half tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan but had not granted the Levites an inheritance among the rest,

ekegusii: Musa akaigwa abanto bakwereera ase chiamate chiabo, kera omonto ase egesoero ki’eema yaye. Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene asebare; ase ayio Musa akagechigwa.
english: Moses heard the people of every family wailing, each at the entrance to his tent. The LORD became exceedingly angry, and Moses was troubled.

ekegusii: Musa akariga‐rigereria ebinto bionsi ebiakoretwe, akarora ng’a abanto babikorire boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achikire. Erio Musa akabasesenia.
english: Moses inspected the work and saw that they had done it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.

ekegusii: Moses listened to his father-in-law and did everything he said.
english: Musa agancha amang’ana aya ise biara amosemetie.

ekegusii: Akabeka na egesasimero gi’etahabu ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime, bosio bw’etoto,
english: Moses placed the gold altar in the Tent of Meeting in front of the curtain

ekegusii: Musa akaira chinyimbo chiria ime ase Eema y’Oborori, agachibekao ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Moses placed the staffs before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.

ekegusii: Akabeka emesa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime, isiko y’etoto, ensemo ya sugusu,
english: Moses placed the table in the Tent of Meeting on the north side of the tabernacle outside the curtain

ekegusii: Musa akarusia Haroni chianga chiria chi’obokuani, agachibekera Eleazari, momura o Haroni. Haroni agakwera ase egetunwa keria, na Musa na Eleazari bagatirimboka korwao.
english: Moses removed Aaron's garments and put them on his son Eleazar. And Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain,

ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Ekero nkorua ase omochie oo ninyimokie amaboko aane nsabe Omonene. Chinkoba echi nachisire, na embura y’amagena tegotwa goetania. Erio aye onyare komanya ng’a ense ney’Omonene.
english: Moses replied, "When I have gone out of the city, I will spread out my hands in prayer to the LORD. The thunder will stop and there will be no more hail, so you may know that the earth is the LORD's.

ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Eriogi eri tiriri eri’abanto babuire esegi, gose eri’okorera kw’abanto babuirwe, korende eriogi naigure neri’abanto bagotera.”
english: Moses replied: "It is not the sound of victory, it is not the sound of defeat; it is the sound of singing that I hear."

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Abaisraeli amang’ana ayio, korende barabwo tibancha gotegerera, ekiagera tibare konyara koremereria, ase engencho y’emeremo y’obosomba obotindi.
english: Moses reported this to the Israelites, but they did not listen to him because of their discouragement and cruel bondage.

ekegusii: Erio Musa akairana gochia ase Omonene, akamotebia, “Omonene, nase ki ogokorera abanto aba amabe buna aya? Inki rende gwantomera inche?
english: Moses returned to the LORD and said, "O Lord, why have you brought trouble upon this people? Is this why you sent me?

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Haroni na abamura baye abatigarete, Eleazari na Itamari, “Imokia okoruegwa kw’endagera, okwo gotigarete korwa ase okwo gwasambirwe nomorero ase Omonene, mokorie gotabekiri memera, agwo ase egesasimero ensemo, ekiagera okoruegwa okwo nogochenu mono.
english: Moses said to Aaron and his remaining sons, Eleazar and Ithamar, "Take the grain offering left over from the offerings made to the LORD by fire and eat it prepared without yeast beside the altar, for it is most holy.

ekegusii: Erio Musa agatebia Haroni, “Suka gochia ang’e ase egesasimero, na orue ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ebibe na eki’ogosambwa, okore okobwatanigwa asore aye omonyene, na ase abanto, erinde mwaberwe. Naende orue ekeng’wanso ekio abanto barentire, na okore okobwatanigwa asebare, buna Omonene achigete.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, "Come to the altar and sacrifice your sin offering and your burnt offering and make atonement for yourself and the people; sacrifice the offering that is for the people and make atonement for them, as the LORD has commanded."

ekegusii: Erio Musa agatebia Nyasae, “Kondagende ase Abaisraeli na kobatebia: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino ontomire asemore, amaene, barabwo baramboria: Erieta riaye, nere ng’o? Inaki rende ndabatebie?”
english: Moses said to God, "Suppose I go to the Israelites and say to them, 'The God of your fathers has sent me to you,' and they ask me, 'What is his name?' Then what shall I tell them?"

ekegusii: Erio Musa agatebia Yoshua, “Tochorere abanto bagende korwana n’Abaameleki ankio; inche ninche ntenene ekegoro igoro, na enyimbo ya Nyasae inyebwate koboko kwane.”
english: Moses said to Joshua, "Choose some of our men and go out to fight the Amalekites. Tomorrow I will stand on top of the hill with the staff of God in my hands."

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Kora, “Ankio aye amo na bonsi abagokobwatia mochiche ase obosio bw’Omonene. Haroni nere nache boigo.
english: Moses said to Korah, "You and all your followers are to appear before the LORD tomorrow-- you and they and Aaron.

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Farao, “Ase amasikani ao, naye orantebie ngaki ki ndagosabere aye amo nabasomba bao, na abanto bao, erinde ebioto birue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, bitigare koba ase orooche rwa Naili oka.”
english: Moses said to Pharaoh, "I leave to you the honor of setting the time for me to pray for you and your officials and your people that you and your houses may be rid of the frogs, except for those that remain in the Nile."

ekegusii: Musa akayotebia. “Aya naro Omonene achikire akorwe.”
english: Moses said to the assembly, "This is what the LORD has commanded to be done."

ekegusii: Musa agakwana nabanto ba Gadi na aba Reuben, akabora, “Inee! Abanto bamino nigo bakogenda korwana esegi, nainwe mobe motigarete aase aa?
english: Moses said to the Gadites and Reubenites, "Shall your countrymen go to war while you sit here?

ekegusii: Musa agakwana nabatang’ani b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene achikire:
english: Moses said to the heads of the tribes of Israel: "This is what the LORD commands:

ekegusii: Musa agakwana n’Omonene akabora,
english: Moses said to the LORD,

ekegusii: Erio Musa akamotebia, “Koranche, Omonene, inche tindi omonto omanyete gokwana buya, nonya nkorwa kare, gose korwa riria gwachagete gokwana nainche, omosomba oo. Tindi omwango bw’ogokwana, na oromeme rwane nororito.”
english: Moses said to the LORD, "O Lord, I have never been eloquent, neither in the past nor since you have spoken to your servant. I am slow of speech and tongue."

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Omonene, “Abanto aba tibakonyara gotiira gocha aa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ekiagera aye omonyene ngwatokania, ogatotebia: Beka orobebe roetanane egetunwa, na ogiatanane kebe egechenu.”
english: Moses said to the LORD, "The people cannot come up Mount Sinai, because you yourself warned us, 'Put limits around the mountain and set it apart as holy.'"

ekegusii: Korende Musa akamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwarusetie abanto aba korwa ase ense ya Misiri ne chinguru chinene. Ekero Abamisiri bonsi baraigwe aya gwakorire ase abanto aba,
english: Moses said to the LORD, "Then the Egyptians will hear about it! By your power you brought these people up from among them.

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Omonene, “Rora, aye nigo gwantebetie: Baire abanto aba, korende tigwantebia ng’a ning’o oratome agende amo nainche. Naende ogantebia: Ninkomanyete buya kegima, na buna okorokwa; naye kwanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwane.
english: Moses said to the LORD, "You have been telling me, 'Lead these people,' but you have not let me know whom you will send with me. You have said, 'I know you by name and you have found favor with me.'

ekegusii: Musa akabairaneria, “Timoondoka! Naki Nyasae nigo achire kobateema inwe, erio agere mogenderere komoiroka, erinde timokora ebibe.”
english: Moses said to the people, "Do not be afraid. God has come to test you, so that the fear of God will be with you to keep you from sinning."

ekegusii: Musa agatebia omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, “Aya naro Omonene achikire:
english: Moses said to the whole Israelite community, "This is what the LORD has commanded:

ekegusii: Musa akabatebia, “Ring’ana eri nario Omonene achigete: Ebimunu bibere bi’endagera eye egachwe ase engencho ye chinderia chiaino, erinde banyare gocha korora omogati oyo nabaete mokoria ase erooro, ekero nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: Moses said, "This is what the LORD has commanded: 'Take an omer of manna and keep it for the generations to come, so they can see the bread I gave you to eat in the desert when I brought you out of Egypt.'"

ekegusii: Musa akarora abanto bakoonchobana, na buna Haroni abatigete baonchobane na gosasima omogwekano oria, ase amasio ’ababisa babo.
english: Moses saw that the people were running wild and that Aaron had let them get out of control and so become a laughingstock to their enemies.

ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa Kadeshi gochia ase omoruoti o Edomu bamotebie, “Amang’ana aya naro intwe Abaisraeli bamino togoteba: Nomanyete emechando yonsi yatonyorire,
english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: "This is what your brother Israel says: You know about all the hardships that have come upon us.

ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto aba, elifu eyemo korwa ase kera egesaku, bakagenda korwana esegi. Amo nabarabwo agatoma Finehasi, mosinto o Eleazari omokuani. Ere akaira ebikorero bi’Obomenyo Obochenu na ebirombeta bi’okobugigwa.
english: Moses sent them into battle, a thousand from each tribe, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, who took with him articles from the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.

ekegusii: Eeri eyio ekanyenywa, erio Musa agatobeka ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga ’eeri eyio, akayagindia ase emegwekano yonsi ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero, na agachena egesasimero; na amanyinga aria atigarete akayaumora ase egesasimero inse, akagiatanana na kogechena, na igo akagekorera okobwatanigwa.
english: Moses slaughtered the bull and took some of the blood, and with his finger he put it on all the horns of the altar to purify the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar. So he consecrated it to make atonement for it.

ekegusii: Moses slaughtered the ram and took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
english: Emingichi eyio ekanyenywa, na Musa akaimokia amanyinga make, akagindia mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kwa Haroni, na ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio.

ekegusii: Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha, na ekero bogokiamoka, amache akairana ase konya are botambe. Abamisiri bagachaka gotama, bakamerwa naro. Naboigo Omonene akabasiria ase enyancha gati‐gati.
english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea went back to its place. The Egyptians were fleeing toward it, and the LORD swept them into the sea.

ekegusii: Musa akarangeria Abaisraeli bonsi gocha amo, akabatebia, “Inwe Abaisraeli, igwa amachiko na emeroberio echikire nkobatebia rituko ria rero, moyeorokererie, mobe nobomaene ng’a moyakore.
english: Moses summoned all Israel and said: Hear, O Israel, the decrees and laws I declare in your hearing today. Learn them and be sure to follow them.

ekegusii: Musa agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, akabatebia, “Mwaroche namaiso aino amang’ana aya Omonene akorete ase ense ya Misiri, na buna akorete Farao amo nabanene b’ense yaye, na ense yaye yonsi.
english: Moses summoned all the Israelites and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in Egypt to Pharaoh, to all his officials and to all his land.

ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Mishaeli na Elisafani, basinto ba Usieli, ise moke Haroni, akabatebia, “Inchuo mobogorie emebere y’abamino, abana ba iso moke, moyerusie korwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, moyeire isiko y’egetwori.”
english: Moses summoned Mishael and Elzaphan, sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel, and said to them, "Come here; carry your cousins outside the camp, away from the front of the sanctuary."

ekegusii: Musa akarua o Farao, agasaba Omonene.
english: Moses then left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio Musa agatebia Haroni na abamura baye, “Iyekera enyama eyio agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na moyeriere aroro, moyerie amo nemegati eria ere ime ase egetonga gi’okoruegwa ase ogwatananwa kw’abakuani! Naboigo inche nachigete, ngateba: Haroni amo nabamura baye mbayerie.
english: Moses then said to Aaron and his sons, "Cook the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it there with the bread from the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, 'Aaron and his sons are to eat it.'

ekegusii: Erio Musa agatebia Haroni, “Aya naro Omonene atebire, ng’a ere neorokie koba omochenu ase abanto abwo bakomoika ang’e, na ase amaiso ’abanto bonsi naorokie obonene bwaye.” Haroni agakira‐kiri.
english: Moses then said to Aaron, "This is what the LORD spoke of when he said: "'Among those who approach me I will show myself holy; in the sight of all the people I will be honored.'" Aaron remained silent.

ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amanyinga aria arenge egetaabo ime, akanyororokeria abanto, akabora, “Aya namanyinga ’okobwatana okwo Omonene akorire ase ogotianania nainwe ase okobaa amachiko aya onsi.”
english: Moses then took the blood, sprinkled it on the people and said, "This is the blood of the covenant that the LORD has made with you in accordance with all these words."

ekegusii: Erio Musa akarika amachiko onsi ay’Omonene. Akaimoka mambia chuni, akaagacha egesasimero egetunwa mbarabare, agatenenia amagena ikomi na abere abe ekeinyorio ki’ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli.
english: Moses then wrote down everything the LORD had said. He got up early the next morning and built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up twelve stone pillars representing the twelve tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: Nigo akagete ng’a abamwabo mbamanye ng’a Nyasae nabae obosibore goetera ase okoboko kwaye, korende tibamanya.
english: Moses thought that his own people would realize that God was using him to rescue them, but they did not.

ekegusii: Musa agatebia ise biara aya onsi Omonene akorerete Farao amo n’Abamisiri ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, na obokong’u bwonsi obwo banyorete inchera, naende buna Omonene abatooretie.
english: Moses told his father-in-law about everything the LORD had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel's sake and about all the hardships they had met along the way and how the LORD had saved them.

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi buna Omonene konya amochikire.
english: Moses told the Israelites all that the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Moses took half of the blood and put it in bowls, and the other half he sprinkled on the altar.
english: Musa akabogoria ekeng’ese ki’amanyinga aya, akayabeka egetaabo ime, na ekeng’ese kende akanyororokeria egesasimero.

ekegusii: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him because Joseph had made the sons of Israel swear an oath. He had said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up with you from this place."
english: Musa akairana amauga a Yusufu, ekiagera Yusufu konya otianirie Abaisraeli, agateba, “Ekero Nyasae arabachere abakonye, goika moire amauga aane, mogende naro.”

ekegusii: Musa akeonchora, agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, na ase amaboko aye obwate chibao ibere chi’amagena chirikire oborori chinsemo chionsi ibere, bosio na nyuma.
english: Moses turned and went down the mountain with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands. They were inscribed on both sides, front and back.

ekegusii: Musa ekero akwete konya okoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, korende amaiso aye konya tarasareka, gose chinguru chiaye konya tichiramoerera
english: Moses was a hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyes were not weak nor his strength gone.

ekegusii: Musa akagechigwa nabanene b’abarwani, abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na ab’amagana, baria bairanete korwa ase okorwana esegi,
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army-- the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds-- who returned from the battle.

ekegusii: Musa akorokererigwa chisemi chionsi chia Misiri, akaba omokong’u ase amang’ana na ase ogokora.
english: Moses was educated in all the wisdom of the Egyptians and was powerful in speech and action.

ekegusii: Ekero keria bakwanete na Farao, Musa nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano na etato (80), na Haroni emiaka emerongo etano na etato, na etato (83).
english: Moses was eighty years old and Aaron eighty-three when they spoke to Pharaoh.

ekegusii: Na Musa nigo arenge omwegenwa ase enyomba yonsi ya Nyasae buna omokoreri, erinde abe kirori ase amang’ana arache gokwanwa,
english: Moses was faithful as a servant in all God's house, testifying to what would be said in the future.

ekegusii: Musa akabeera n’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, tare koria kende, gose konywa, akarika ase chibao echi ibere amang’ana ’okobwatana koria, Amachiko ayio ikomi.
english: Moses was there with the LORD forty days and forty nights without eating bread or drinking water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant-- the Ten Commandments.

ekegusii: Musa, na Haroni, na abaraai b’omoganda bagakora omobaro bw’ororeria rwa Kohati, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.
english: Moses, Aaron and the leaders of the community counted the Kohathites by their clans and families.

ekegusii: Naboigo Musa, na Haroni, amo nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakaba bagokorera Abalawi. Abaisraeli bakabakorera kera ring’ana Omonene konya achikire Musa babakorere.
english: Moses, Aaron and the whole Israelite community did with the Levites just as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Musa na Eleazari omokuani, na abaraai bonsi b’omoganda bw’abanto, bagasoka korwa ase ebitwori, bakagenda korotota abarwani baria b’esegi.
english: Moses, Eleazar the priest and all the leaders of the community went to meet them outside the camp.

ekegusii: Abaruoti abwo konya babuirwe na Musa amo n’Abaisraeli. Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, konya oeire Abareuben na Abagadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ense eria ebe eyabo.
english: Moses, the servant of the LORD, and the Israelites conquered them. And Moses the servant of the LORD gave their land to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh to be their possession.

ekegusii: Egetunwa gionsi gia Sinai kegatubwa nerioki, ekiagera Omonene aigete aroro ore ase omorero ime; na erioki rigachongororoka gochia igoro buna eri’eriko rinene ri’oboturi, na egetunwa ekegima gekanyegerigwa mono.
english: Mount Sinai was covered with smoke, because the LORD descended on it in fire. The smoke billowed up from it like smoke from a furnace, the whole mountain trembled violently,

ekegusii: Tiga abanto b’egetunwa gia Sayoni bagoke; boigo nab’emechie y’Abayuda, ekiagera aye nigo okonacha ebina bia boronge.
english: Mount Zion rejoices, the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments.

ekegusii: “Inwe abwo momenyete ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi, nainwe abwo momanyete erieta riaye, morere! Motebe: Naki enyimbo eria ere nokobua na obonene yabunirwe!
english: Mourn for her, all who live around her, all who know her fame; say, 'How broken is the mighty scepter, how broken the glorious staff!'

ekegusii: Rera na kobokia amagombo buna omoiseke omwekungi obegete chianga chie chigunia, okwereirwe nomosacha bw’oboke bwaye.
english: Mourn like a virgin in sackcloth grieving for the husband of her youth.

ekegusii: Nabo akaraagwa n’Omoika gocha ase Hekalu ime; na ekero abaibori bachia korenta omwana Yeso, bamokorere buna yarenge engencho y’amachiko,
english: Moved by the Spirit, he went into the temple courts. When the parents brought in the child Jesus to do for him what the custom of the Law required,

ekegusii: Moza akaibora Binea; Rafa nigo arenge omomura oye, na Eleasa omomura oye, na Aseli omomura oye.
english: Moza was the father of Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.

ekegusii: Moza akaibora Binea, na Binea akaibora Refaya, na Refaya akaibora Eleasa, na Eleasa akaibora Aseli.
english: Moza was the father of Binea; Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son and Azel his son.

ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana atari nengencho amentekanire, ne chindoto chiamentekanire, obobe nigo bokoba obonge; korende aye omoiroke Nyasae.
english: Much dreaming and many words are meaningless. Therefore stand in awe of God.

ekegusii: Nkogwenerete mono ase kera enchera. Ritang’ani, Abayahudi mbegenetwe konyora ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: Much in every way! First of all, they have been entrusted with the very words of God.

ekegusii: Naende ekero ekenge konya giaetire, na orogendo rwabeire nobokong’u, ekiagera amatuko ’okweng’ata konya aetire, Paulo akabatebia,
english: Much time had been lost, and sailing had already become dangerous because by now it was after the Fast. So Paul warned them,

ekegusii: Abange b’abwo baraire ase riroba ime mbaboke, abande banyore obogima bwa kare na kare, na abande banyore obosooku na ogochaywa gwa kare na kare.
english: Multitudes who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake: some to everlasting life, others to shame and everlasting contempt.

ekegusii: Emeganda na emeganda nigo ere ase Rikura ri’Ekina, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene ng’ang’e rire agwo ase Rikura ri’Ekina.
english: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.

ekegusii: Inee! Nainche nigo nkogenderera koganya, ekiagera tibari gokwana, na ekiagera bateneine agwo batari koiraneria?
english: Must I wait, now that they are silent, now that they stand there with no reply?

ekegusii: Inee! Ching’ondi chiane nigo chirabe chikorisia obonyansi mwatiringire namagoro aino, naende chinywe amache ayio mwaturubanirie namagoro aino?
english: Must my flock feed on what you have trampled and drink what you have muddied with your feet?

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo toragenderere koigwera amang’ana aino na tokore ebibe ebinene, naende tobe abatari abegenwa ase Nyasae oito, ase okonyuoma abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao?”
english: Must we hear now that you too are doing all this terrible wickedness and are being unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women?"

ekegusii: Abanto aba tibanyoreti nkoamererania na monto, gose koburukania omosangererekano ase Hekalu ime, nonya nase chisinagogi gose ase omochie ime.
english: My accusers did not find me arguing with anyone at the temple, or stirring up a crowd in the synagogues or anywhere else in the city.

ekegusii: Tiga abansoeri baboigwe ogochaywa, tiga obosooku obwo bobatube buna egetambaa gi’okwambara.
english: My accusers will be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.

ekegusii: Naki omomalaika one nagotang’ane akoire na kogoikia ase ense y’Abaamori, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abakanani, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi, na inche nimbasirie.
english: My angel will go ahead of you and bring you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.

ekegusii: Endamwamu yane inayoke, na inche mbaite nomoro, na abakungu baino nababe ababoraka, na abana baino babe chintakana batari nabaise.
english: My anger will be aroused, and I will kill you with the sword; your wives will become widows and your children fatherless.

ekegusii: Chibachwa chiane nigo chikoyia buna omorero, omobere one bwonsi orwarire.
english: My back is filled with searing pain; there is no health in my body.

ekegusii: Amakonde ne riko biatubire omobere one; omobere one nigo okona‐gosaboka amasabo, erio otandoka, na obogundo bwaruao.
english: My body is clothed with worms and scabs, my skin is broken and festering.

ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baane bagonchecheria, nigo nkoigwa buna amauga aane akonyatia. Nigo bagendererete kona‐komboria, “Nyasae oo, ng’ai are?”
english: My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

ekegusii: Omoika okorwa ase omonwa one nigo ogotiokera omokungu one bobe; nigo inde okogechia ase abamura baminto torwete enda eyemo.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife; I am loathsome to my own brothers.

ekegusii: Abaminto, komorabe mwegenete Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Omonene bw’obonene, timoba mogwanchereria abanto.
english: My brothers, as believers in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, don't show favoritism.

ekegusii: Abaminto, Inee, omoko nonyare kwama amazeituni, gose omosabibu bwame amako? Naboigo nensoko y’amache are nomonyo tekonyara korenta amache atari nomonyo.
english: My brothers, can a fig tree bear olives, or a grapevine bear figs? Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water.

ekegusii: Abaminto, onye omonto onde oino oteanire korwa ase ekeene, na monto onde amoiranie,
english: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,

ekegusii: Naki baminto, natebigwe nabanto ba nyomba mwa Kloe, ng’a eriomana ndire ase egati yaino.
english: My brothers, some from Chloe's household have informed me that there are quarrels among you.

ekegusii: Egekondemia ase emechando yane neke: Ring’ana riao nigo rigonkora naba omoyia.
english: My comfort in my suffering is this: Your promise preserves my life.

ekegusii: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.
english: “Richiko riane nario eri: Mwanchane buna nabanchete inwe.

ekegusii: Oyorenge omosani one nigo aramborete okoboko kwaye, akore bobe ase abakorete omorembe nere, osaririe okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.
english: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.

ekegusii: Na ekero nasinyetwe korora ase engencho y’oborabu bw’amasase aria, nkaraagwa namaboko abo abarenge amo nainche, ngaika Damesiki.
english: My companions led me by the hand into Damascus, because the brilliance of the light had blinded me.

ekegusii: Na baria barenge amo nainche mbaroche amasase aria, korende tibaigwete eriogi ri’oria ore gokwana nainche.
english: My companions saw the light, but they did not understand the voice of him who was speaking to me.

ekegusii: Naki timanyeti engencho y’ogwesoera inche omonyene, korende timbareiri oboronge ase engencho y’ayio. Omonene nere orangambie.
english: My conscience is clear, but that does not make me innocent. It is the Lord who judges me.

ekegusii: Amatuko aane nigo agoeta buna omorengari o mogoroba; nasusanire buna obonyansi.
english: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.

ekegusii: Amatuko aane aetire, emeroberio yane yasarekire, nonya nokogania gw’enkoro yane.
english: My days have passed, my plans are shattered, and so are the desires of my heart.

ekegusii: Abaminto abanchani, momanye ring’ana eri: Kera omonto abe omwango ase okoigwa, korende abe bwe ng’ora ase ogokwana, na bwe ng’ora ase okoba nendamwamu,
english: My dear brothers, take note of this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry,

ekegusii: Abana baane abake, ninde nokoromwa gw’okobina gw’okobaibora naende, goika Kristo arorekane ime yaino.
english: My dear children, for whom I am again in the pains of childbirth until Christ is formed in you,

ekegusii: Abana baane abake, nkobarikera nde aya, erinde timokora ebibe. Korende onye omonto okorire ebibe, ntore n’Omosaberi ase Tata, nere Yeso Kristo, Omonyene Oboronge.
english: My dear children, I write this to you so that you will not sin. But if anybody does sin, we have one who speaks to the Father in our defense-- Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

ekegusii: Ogochaywa kwane nigo kogendererete asende omobaso boira, na obosooku bwatubire obosio bwane
english: My disgrace is before me all day long, and my face is covered with shame

ekegusii: Aye riruma riane ore ase omwenya bw’egetare, agwo ase obwebiso bw’egetare, tiga indore obosio bwao, naende inyigwe eriogi riao, ekiagera eriogi riao neriansu, na obosio bwao noboseera.
english: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places on the mountainside, show me your face, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet, and your face is lovely.

ekegusii: Obomenyo bwane mbobe amo nabarabwo, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto baane.
english: My dwelling place will be with them; I will be their God, and they will be my people.

ekegusii: Nabeire nkoigwa igoro yao ase okoigwa namato rioka, korende bono amaiso aane akororire.
english: My ears had heard of you but now my eyes have seen you.

ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bagokwana amang’ana amabe igoro yane, bateba, “Omonto oyo indi arakwe na erieta riaye riebwe kegima?”
english: My enemies say of me in malice, "When will he die and his name perish?"

ekegusii: Ababisa baane nigo bakoirana nyuma, bagwe inse na gosirigwa ase obosio bwao.
english: My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before you.

ekegusii: Totiga omobisa one atebe ng’a ombuire, na ababisa baane bonsi bachengere okogwa kwane.
english: my enemy will say, "I have overcome him," and my foes will rejoice when I fall.

ekegusii: Amaiso aane amwamire ase okweumia; Aye Omonene, kera rituko nigo ngokorangeria, ndamborete amaboko aane gocha asore.
english: my eyes are dim with grief. I call to you, O LORD, every day; I spread out my hands to you.

ekegusii: Botambe nigo nkoba imorigeretie Omonene, nere orarusie amagoro aane ase oboreba.
english: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for only he will release my feet from the snare.

ekegusii: Amaiso aane nigo aroche chinchera chiabo chionsi. Tibakonyara kwebisa korwa asende. Nigo ndoche ebibe biabo.
english: My eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from me, nor is their sin concealed from my eyes.

ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoiyeria amariga, omoyo one oonchokanire, na enkoro yane yachandekire ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’omochie bw’abanto baane, ekiagera abana, nonya nabakogonka, nigo bakona‐kogireka ase chinchera chi’omochie.
english: My eyes fail from weeping, I am in torment within, my heart is poured out on the ground because my people are destroyed, because children and infants faint in the streets of the city.

ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoganya ring’ana riao, nigo nkoboria, “Indi aye orache kondemia?”
english: My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, "When will you comfort me?"

ekegusii: Amaiso aane arosire ase okoganya ogotooreka gokorwa asore, amo nogoikeranigwa kw’eira yao y’oboronge.
english: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.

ekegusii: Obosio bwane bwomire pa ase engencho y’emechando, bwareeire ase engencho y’ababisa baane bonsi.
english: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.

ekegusii: My eyes have grown dim with grief; my whole frame is but a shadow.
english: Emechando yagerire amaiso aane abeire orotutu, na ebiimo biane bionsi biabeire buna omorengari bosa.

ekegusii: Narorire namaiso aane ababisa baane bakobugwa, naigure namato aane igoro y’abakori amabe abanyimokerete.
english: My eyes have seen the defeat of my adversaries; my ears have heard the rout of my wicked foes.

ekegusii: Nigo nkogeesa botuko bokia, mbe nkona‐koiranerera ring’ana riao.
english: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promises.

ekegusii: Amaiso aane narigereretie abegenwa bare ase ense, abwo mbamenye amo nainche. Omonto okobwatia chinchera chi’oboronge, oyio nabe ogonkorera.
english: My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; he whose walk is blameless will minister to me.

ekegusii: My eyes will flow unceasingly, without relief,
english: “Amaiso aane abeire agoitera amariga atari gokama, gose korosa,

ekegusii: Nimbarende na kobakorera amaya goika mbairanie naende ase ense eye. Nimbatenenie gose tinkobatagora, nimbasimeke gose tinkobasimora.
english: My eyes will watch over them for their good, and I will bring them back to this land. I will build them up and not tear them down; I will plant them and not uproot them.

ekegusii: Amaiso aane abariirire ase obosio bwane, na ekiriri kiarorekanire ase obosio bwane,
english: My face is red with weeping, deep shadows ring my eyes;

ekegusii: Obwegenwa na obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe mbibe amo nere; ase erieta riane orogunchara rwaye ndokine.
english: My faithful love will be with him, and through my name his horn will be exalted.

ekegusii: Na bono rikorogoto riria rikong’u tata ababekerete, inche nigo ndarimente ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabe nkobang’wania ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi mesia.”
english: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.'"

ekegusii: Na bono rikorogoto riria rikong’u tata ababekerete, inche nigo ndarimente ribe ririto goetania. Tata nigo arenge kobang’wania ebiranya, korende inche nigo ndabang’wanie ne chinkini chichomire chibonyi chinyoge chinga amagwa.”
english: My father laid on you a heavy yoke; I will make it even heavier. My father scourged you with whips; I will scourge you with scorpions.'"

ekegusii: ng’a tata nandierete omwando ogoteba: Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, ong’ire ontindeke ase oboina boria naremete ase ense ya Kanani. Momonsabere ribaga ngende gotindeka tata, erio ning’irane.”
english: 'My father made me swear an oath and said, "I am about to die; bury me in the tomb I dug for myself in the land of Canaan." Now let me go up and bury my father; then I will return.'"

ekegusii: Tata one oching’eire nomonene kobua bonsi, na onde takonyara gochitaboria korwa ase okoboko gwa Tata.
english: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all; no one can snatch them out of my Father's hand.

ekegusii: Inche natachire bokong’u ase amabarato aye, nabeire ndendete chinchera chiaye, gose tindi koonchoka nchitige.
english: My feet have closely followed his steps; I have kept to his way without turning aside.

ekegusii: Amagoro aane nigo agotenena aase aateremu; nintogie Omonene ase egati y’omosangererekano omonene.
english: My feet stand on level ground; in the great assembly I will praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Aristariko, oyosibetwe amo nainche, obakwanirie, na Mariko, omoigwa o Barnaba (mwanyorire ogotebererigwa igoro yaye; karaike seino momoroisie).
english: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you his greetings, as does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. (You have received instructions about him; if he comes to you, welcome him.)

ekegusii: Omobere one na enkoro yane nabo biranyare koborwa chinguru, korende aye Nyasae, naye ore egetare gi’enkoro yane, naende naye egetare kiane goika kare na kare.
english: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

ekegusii: Omobere one nigo okoiguswa ore nobwoba asore, naende nairokire ebina biao.
english: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws.

ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one tabisekanete asore, ekero natongetwe bobisi, ekero nabombetwe ase ense ime.
english: My frame was not hidden from you when I was made in the secret place. When I was woven together in the depths of the earth,

ekegusii: Abanchi na abasani baane babeereire aare korwa ase amaakwa aane, na abanto baminto boigo bambeereire aare.
english: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.

ekegusii: Okwama nkorua nigo kore okuya kobua etahabu, ee, kobua etahabu engiya, na ebitoki nkorua mbibuete efeta enchore.
english: My fruit is better than fine gold; what I yield surpasses choice silver.

ekegusii: obonene bwane nigo bwarenge kona‐koba oboyia asende, na obota bwane bokona‐konyora chinguru chinyia ase amaboko aane.
english: My glory will remain fresh in me, the bow ever new in my hand.'

ekegusii: Nyasae one nere egetare kiane, asare nao nyebisete, ere nenguba yane enkengerete, na orogunchara rwane rwandeterete ogotooreka, naende nere eburi yane enkong’u, na obotamero bwane. Ere n’Omotooria one, oyogontooria korwa ase obotindi.
english: my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation. He is my stronghold, my refuge and my savior-- from violent men you save me.

ekegusii: Nyasae one natomete omomalaika oye, agasieka emenwa ye chindo, na chirochio tichiankorerete bobe bonde, ekiagera nigo nanyorekanete ng’a tindi na komocha ase obosio bwaye; naboigo nase obosio bwao, aye omoruoti, tinkoreti komocha konde.”
english: My God sent his angel, and he shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, because I was found innocent in his sight. Nor have I ever done any wrong before you, O king."

ekegusii: Nyasae one nabaange, ekiagera baangete komoigwera; mbabe bakonagotayaya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku.
english: My God will reject them because they have not obeyed him; they will be wanderers among the nations.

ekegusii: Nyasae one, enkoro yane yabeire nomoichano, ase ayio, nakoinyoire ekero inde ase ense ya Yorodani, na ase egetunwa kia Herimoni na ekia Misari.
english: my God. My soul is downcast within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon-- from Mount Mizar.

ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete mwane banyebire; na abasomba baane abaiseke bambarire buna omoeti; nabeire omomenyi ase amaiso abo.
english: My guests and my maidservants count me a stranger; they look upon me as an alien.

ekegusii: My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.
english: Ebibe biane biantubire nonya nomotwe bwonsi, bianditoeire na kombua.

ekegusii: Okoboko kwane ngoake ababani abwo bakorora amaroro ’obong’ainereria, naende nigo bakoringoria oboringoria bw’oborimo. Barabwo tibakobeera ase omosangererekano bw’abanto baane, gose tibakorikwa amo n’Abaisraeli, gose tibagosoa ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene Nyasae.
english: My hand will be against the prophets who see false visions and utter lying divinations. They will not belong to the council of my people or be listed in the records of the house of Israel, nor will they enter the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: My hand will sustain him; surely my arm will strengthen him.
english: Okoboko kwane nkobe amo nere botambe, ee, okoboko kwane nkomobeke chinguru.

ekegusii: Obokano bwane bw’ebirigisa nigo bokominwa bwaba obw’ebirero, na ekeroria kiane kiaonchoiwe kobugigwa ase abanto bakorera.”
english: My harp is tuned to mourning, and my flute to the sound of wailing.

ekegusii: Enkoro yane nkoreera ere ense ya Moabu. Abanto baye ngotamera bare Soari na Egilati‐Selisia; nigo bagotiira gochia Luhiti bakorera. Nigo bagoaka amariogi ay’okorera kw’ogosirigwa agwo ase enchera ekogenda Horonaimu.
english: My heart cries out over Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath Shelishiyah. They go up the way to Luhith, weeping as they go; on the road to Horonaim they lament their destruction.

ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, omoondoko ombwatire; engaki ya mogoroba eyio naganyete yang’onchokeire na kondetera obwoba.
english: My heart falters, fear makes me tremble; the twilight I longed for has become a horror to me.

ekegusii: My heart grew hot within me, and as I meditated, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:
english: enkoro yane ekaba ekoyia ime yane. Ekero naare ndengereretie aya, omorero ogoka, tinare konyara gwetanga ogokwana kwane.

ekegusii: Enkoro yane yaakirwe yabeire buna obonyansi bwagekirwe na kwoma; nigo nkweba koria endagera yane,
english: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.

ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo ere nomoichano, nasoirwe nokogoswa kw’amakweri.
english: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death assail me.

ekegusii: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end.
english: Narure enkoro yane korenda amachiko ao, botambe goika omoerio.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, enkoro yane nigo ere noboremu, ee, nigo ere noboremu; nintere na gochenga.
english: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.

ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo ere amo nabatang’ani b’Abaisraeli, na ase abanto abwo beruete ase ogwancha. Motogie Omonene!
english: My heart is with Israel's princes, with the willing volunteers among the people. Praise the LORD!

ekegusii: Ase ayio, enkoro yane nigo ekoreera Abamoabu neriogi buna eri’obokano, nkoreera nde aba Kiri‐Heresi ase omoyo one ime.
english: My heart laments for Moab like a harp, my inmost being for Kir Hareseth.

ekegusii: Enkoro yane nigo egotiesana, chinguru chiang’ereire; amaiso aane asoirwe orotutu, tindi korora.
english: My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light has gone from my eyes.

ekegusii: Aye gwatebire, “Indigie ondore obosio bwane.” Na enkoro yane nigo ekogotebia, “Omonene, inche igo nkorigia obosio bwao.”
english: My heart says of you, "Seek his face!" Your face, LORD, I will seek.

ekegusii: Ogokonywa kwane nigo korarwe ase Omonene, oyotongete igoro na ense.
english: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

ekegusii: Omosacha one taiyo, ochiire orogendo orotambe.
english: My husband is not at home; he has gone on a long journey.

ekegusii: Abanto bare omwando one babeire buna endo ere ase rinani. Baakire amariogi abo mamincha yane. Ase engencho eyio nabagechire.
english: My inheritance has become to me like a lion in the forest. She roars at me; therefore I hate her.

ekegusii: Ekero ebikoba biao birakwane amang’ana amaronge, nigo ndabe nomogoko ime yane.
english: my inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

ekegusii: Nonya nabasani baane nigo bagonsekerera, inche nigo nkoiyeria amariga ndigererete Nyasae.
english: My intercessor is my friend as my eyes pour out tears to God;

ekegusii: Abanto baminto bantigire, na abasani twanchaine mono banyebire.
english: My kinsmen have gone away; my friends have forgotten me.

ekegusii: Amaru aborirwe chinguru ase engencho y’okweng’ata, na omobere one oreeire mono.
english: My knees give way from fasting; my body is thin and gaunt.

ekegusii: Ase obogima bwane bwonsi nabeire inde nemechando; na ase emiaka yane yonsi nabeire inde nomoichano; chinguru chiane chiaerire ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane; amauga ’omobere one omire pa.
english: My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones grow weak.

ekegusii: my lips will not speak wickedness, and my tongue will utter no deceit.
english: omonwa one togokwana aya atari a boronge, gose oromeme rwane ay’obong’ainereria.

ekegusii: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praise to you-- I, whom you have redeemed.
english: Ning’ake eriogi rinene ri’omogoko nomonwa one, ekero ndabe ngotera amatera akogotogia. Nintere nomoyo one boigo, ekiagera aye gwantooririe.

ekegusii: Aye omonene one, nigo gwatoboretie intwe abasomba bao: Inee! Mokare na iso gose onde omino?
english: My lord asked his servants, 'Do you have a father or a brother?'

ekegusii: Gaki aye omoruoti, omonene one, tobaisa kwegena amang’ana ayio ng’a abamura bao bonsi mbaitire; Amunoni bweka nere okure.”
english: My lord the king should not be concerned about the report that all the king's sons are dead. Only Amnon is dead."

ekegusii: Na bono, omonene one omoruoti, amaiso ’abanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli naye arigereretie, obatebie ng’a ning’o oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti, aye omoruoti one, nyuma gokwarureo.
english: My lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, to learn from you who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.

ekegusii: Obwanchani bwane bobe amo nainwe mwensi ase Kristo Yeso.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

ekegusii: Omwanchi one mogondo agenda, ogendire ase ebigondo bi’ebimeri bi’ebinsari. Ogendire korisia riicho riaye ase emegondo, naende nao akare kona‐gosangereria ebisicha ebiya.
english: My lover has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to browse in the gardens and to gather lilies.

ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo anga engabi gose ensune ensae. Rora, bono nigo ateneine magega y’enyasi y’enyomba yaito. Origereretie gocha ime goetera ase chitirisa, goetera ase ekebao kiabekire ebitange.
english: My lover is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look! There he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattice.

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde oyo bw’omwanchi one, nere noyone; nigo akorisia riicho riaye ase egati y’ebisicha ebiya.
english: My lover is mine and I am his; he browses among the lilies.

ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are omorabu se okomeka‐meka, naende omobariri; nigo are nogwatananekana korwa ase abanto chilifu ikomi.
english: My lover is radiant and ruddy, outstanding among ten thousand.

ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are asende buna egesago ki’ebisicha bikorokwa hena, bire ase emegondo y’emesabibu y’Eni‐Gedi.
english: My lover is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi.

ekegusii: Omwanchi one nigo are asende buna omobuko o manemane, oyo nkobeka ase egekuba kiane.
english: My lover is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.

ekegusii: Omwanchi ngokwana are na gontebia: “Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omuya, imoka, inchuo togende,
english: My lover spoke and said to me, "Arise, my darling, my beautiful one, and come with me.

ekegusii: Erio omwanchi one akabeka okoboko kwaye ase ekebao, erio nkaba nomosasoko omonene ime ase enkoro yane.
english: My lover thrust his hand through the latch-opening; my heart began to pound for him.

ekegusii: Nyasae one nigo agonchichera nobwanchani bwaye botari koera, Nyasae one nankore nchenge igoro y’ababisa baane.
english: my loving God. God will go before me and will let me gloat over those who slander me.

ekegusii: aye, omonene one, tokoba nomoichano gose nenkoro egokogambia, ng’a ngwaiterete amanyinga ’abanto batari na komocha, gose ng’a nkweruseretie egesiomba. Bono kerabe Omonene ogokoreire amaya ayio, ong’inyore inche omosomba oo.”
english: my master will not have on his conscience the staggering burden of needless bloodshed or of having avenged himself. And when the LORD has brought my master success, remember your servant."

ekegusii: Na Sara, moka omonene one, akamoiborera omwana omomura ekero abeire omogotu; na omonene one oeire omwana oyio bionsi ebiabwate.
english: My master's wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and he has given him everything he owns.

ekegusii: Abasomba baane mbayetirimbokie korwa ase Lebanoni gochia ase enyancha, nainche ninyebeke amo inyesibe, eirwe nenyancha echeng’enenete, goika aase oganetie. “Aase agwo nao erasansorerwe, na aye oyerusieo. Erio ong’isanekerie okogania kwane ase okobaa abanto baane endagera yabo.”
english: My men will haul them down from Lebanon to the sea, and I will float them in rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate them and you can take them away. And you are to grant my wish by providing food for my royal household."

ekegusii: Enkwana yane na okorandia kwane tibiarenge amang’ana ay’okoebereria obong’aini bwa mwanyabanto, korende ase ekiorokererio ki’Omoika ne chinguru,
english: My message and my preaching were not with wise and persuasive words, but with a demonstration of the Spirit's power,

ekegusii: na ase ebitunwa bire ase egetii aarabu. Nindue obotenenku bwaino ne chinibo chiaino, bisakorwe biirwe, na nigo moegwe egesusuro ki’ebibe biaino mwakorire ase ense yaino yonsi.
english: My mountain in the land and your wealth and all your treasures I will give away as plunder, together with your high places, because of sin throughout your country.

ekegusii: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.
english: Omonwa one noichorigwe nogotogigwa kwao, na omobaso boira ninkobake.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ngokwana nay’ekeene; amang’ana ’obobe nigo are okogechia ase ebikoba biane.
english: My mouth speaks what is true, for my lips detest wickedness.

ekegusii: Omonwa one nobe ogokwana ogotogigwa kw’Omonene; tiga ebitongwa bionsi bitogie erieta riaye richenu bono na goika kare na kare.
english: My mouth will speak in praise of the LORD. Let every creature praise his holy name for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Omonwa one nokwane amang’ana ’obong’aini, na ebirengererio bi’enkoro yane nigo birabe ebi’okomanya.
english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom; the utterance from my heart will give understanding.

ekegusii: My mouth will tell of your righteousness, of your salvation all day long, though I know not its measure.
english: Nimbe nkoraria ogokora kwao kw’oboronge nomonwa one. Omobaso boira nimbe nkonagwatora ogotooreka kwao; okwo kore okonene ntanyare gokorenga.

ekegusii: Korwa ekero erioba rigosoka goika ekero rikorimera, erieta riane nigo rigendererete koba rinene ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, na ase kera aase ubani nigo egosamberwa ase erieta riane, na okoruegwa gochenegete nigo gokorentwa. Ee, erieta riane nigo rigendererete koba rinene ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
english: My name will be great among the nations, from the rising to the setting of the sun. In every place incense and pure offerings will be brought to my name, because my name will be great among the nations," says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Ogosaria kwane kware komumekerigwa egunia ime, aye nigo kware gotuba ebibe biane.
english: My offenses will be sealed up in a bag; you will cover over my sin.

ekegusii: Okoboko kwane nakwo kwabegete oboroso bw’ense, na okoboko kwane gw’okorio gokarambora igoro chionsi; ekero nkorangeria igoro na ense, nigo chigotenena amo.”
english: My own hand laid the foundations of the earth, and my right hand spread out the heavens; when I summon them, they all stand up together.

ekegusii: Abanto baane nigo bagosirigwa, ekiagera batari nokomanya. Ekiagera aye kwangire komanya inche, nainche ninkwange, toba omokuani one. Ekiagera kwangire koigwera amachiko aane inche Nyasae oo, boigo nainche ninyange abana bao.
english: my people are destroyed from lack of knowledge. "Because you have rejected knowledge, I also reject you as my priests; because you have ignored the law of your God, I also will ignore your children.

ekegusii: Abanto baane nigo banchete gontiga, nonya bakorangerigwa gochia ase Oyore Igoro Mono, onde tari okomotogia, nonya noyomo.”
english: My people are determined to turn from me. Even if they call to the Most High, he will by no means exalt them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo bagocha asore buna abagocha ase omosangererekano, baikaransa ase obosio bwao buna abanto baane, barabwo baigwa amang’ana ogokwana, korende tibari koyakorera. Nigo bakworokia obwanchani obonge ase ebikoba igoro, korende ime ase chinkoro chiabo nigo bakwerigeria ebitoki.
english: My people come to you, as they usually do, and sit before you to listen to your words, but they do not put them into practice. With their mouths they express devotion, but their hearts are greedy for unjust gain.

ekegusii: Abanto baane mbamenye ase chinyomba chire nomorembe babe barendire buya, mbabe batimogete ase obotoereru.
english: My people will live in peaceful dwelling places, in secure homes, in undisturbed places of rest.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, inyora egento Balaki, omoruoti o Moabu, aroberetie gokora, na buna Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, amoiraneretie. Boigo inyora amang’ana akoregete ekero mwarenge ase orogendo korwa Sitimu gochia Giligali, erinde monyare komanya ogokora kw’oboronge kwane inche Omonene.”
english: My people, remember what Balak king of Moab counseled and what Balaam son of Beor answered. Remember [your journey] from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of the LORD."

ekegusii: Tinsabeti ng’a obarusie korwa ase ense, korende obarende korwa ase oria omobe.
english: My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.

ekegusii: erinde baremigwe ase chinkoro chiabo, kobarabwatanigwe ase obwanchani, banyore obonda bwonsi ase okomanya gwonsi gw’ekeene, banyare komanya obobisi bwa Nyasae engencho yaye Kristo.
english: My purpose is that they may be encouraged in heart and united in love, so that they may have the full riches of complete understanding, in order that they may know the mystery of God, namely, Christ,

ekegusii: Oboronge bwane nigo bore ang’e, ogotooreka kwane ngocha kore, amaboko aane nagambie abanto bonsi ekina kia boronge; abanto bamenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha nigo banganyete, basemerie okoboko kwane.
english: My righteousness draws near speedily, my salvation is on the way, and my arm will bring justice to the nations. The islands will look to me and wait in hope for my arm.

ekegusii: Nigo narenge buna omote emeri yaye ekoranda yaika ase chindooche; chinsagia chiane chikagenderera gotoora riime ase obotuko bwonsi;
english: My roots will reach to the water, and the dew will lie all night on my branches.

ekegusii: Ogotooreka kwane, na obonene bwane, nigo bikonyorekana ase Nyasae. Nyasae negetare kiane gie chinguru, na obotamero bwane.
english: My salvation and my honor depend on God; he is my mighty rock, my refuge.

ekegusii: Ee, abasomba baane mbabe bagotera bare nomosasoko ase chinkoro chiabo, korende inwe mobe mokorera more nobororo ase chinkoro chiaino, mobe mokweng’ereria ase omoika bw’omoichano.
english: My servants will sing out of the joy of their hearts, but you will cry out from anguish of heart and wail in brokenness of spirit.

ekegusii: Ching’ondi chiane nigo chikoigwa eriogi riane, na inche ninchimanyete, na chirochio nigo chigontunyana;
english: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.

ekegusii: Bono ching’ondi chiane nigo chigotayaya ase ebitunwa bionsi, na ase kera ekegoro egetambe. Ching’ondi chiane chiaserebekanire gochia aande onsi ase ense, na onde tari ogochirigia gose gochiitaa.
english: My sheep wandered over all the mountains and on every high hill. They were scattered over the whole earth, and no one searched or looked for them.

ekegusii: Nyasae nere enguba yane, ere nigo agotooria abare ne chinkoro chindonge.
english: My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.

ekegusii: Risankwa riane riaonchokire riamwamire ti, na nigo rikona‐kobutoka, na amauga aane nigo akoyia buna omorero.
english: My skin grows black and peels; my body burns with fever.

ekegusii: Omobaso boira ababisa baane nigo bakondigia baamere, ee, mbare abange mono bakondwania ase oboenenu.
english: My slanderers pursue me all day long; many are attacking me in their pride.

ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa kwanga gose gochaya ogoaka kw’Omonene kw’ogokorongeyia.
english: My son, do not despise the LORD's discipline and do not resent his rebuke,

ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa kweba amorokererio aane, korende tiga enkoro yao ebwate amachiko aane.
english: My son, do not forget my teaching, but keep my commands in your heart,

ekegusii: Omwana one, tobaisa gotaara amo nabarabwo. Otange okogoro kwao tikobaisa gotacha ase bagoeta,
english: my son, do not go along with them, do not set foot on their paths;

ekegusii: Omwana one, ing’a enkoro yao, na amaiso ao tiga agokere chinchera chiane.
english: My son, give me your heart and let your eyes keep to my ways,

ekegusii: Omwana one, abanyabibe kobarakoebererie ng’a mobwatane nabarabwo, tobaisa gwancha.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, do not give in to them.

ekegusii: Omwana one, ancha amang’ana aane, ogache amachiko aane ase enkoro yao,
english: My son, if you accept my words and store up my commands within you,

ekegusii: Omwana one, ande kwerure koba intenenera ase omonto omino, na kwarire eira ase omonto omoao na kobwatana nere amaboko.
english: My son, if you have put up security for your neighbor, if you have struck hands in pledge for another,

ekegusii: Omwana one, onye enkoro yao ekoba nobong’aini, rirorio enkoro yane nigo eragoke.
english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad;

ekegusii: My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.
english: Omwana one, renda amang’ana aane, na obeke amachiko aane abeere ime yao.

ekegusii: Omwana one, igwera aya inche iso nkogochika, na totiga amorokererio a nyoko.
english: My son, keep your father's commands and do not forsake your mother's teaching.

ekegusii: Omwana one, tegerera oigwe obong’aini bwane! Igwera okomanya kwane!
english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom, listen well to my words of insight,

ekegusii: My son, pay attention to what I say; listen closely to my words.
english: Omwana one, tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane! Igwera amang’ana nkogotebia.

ekegusii: Omwana one, bwata bokong’u obong’aini obuya na okomanya; tobaisa gotiga ebio birue ase obosio bwao.
english: My son, preserve sound judgment and discernment, do not let them out of your sight;

ekegusii: Abana baane, timobaisa koba abakoombia, ekiagera Omonene obachorire mobe mogotenena ase obosio bwaye momokorere; inwe mobe abasomba baye, momosambere ubani.”
