english: My sons, do not be negligent now, for the LORD has chosen you to stand before him and serve him, to minister before him and to burn incense."

ekegusii: Omoyo one nokobwaterere mono, ekiagera aye nonsiirete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio.
english: My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me.

ekegusii: Omoyo one ogoyire ase okogania ogotooreka kwao, nigo nsemeretie ring’ana riao.
english: My soul faints with longing for your salvation, but I have put my hope in your word.

ekegusii: Enkoro yane yasionoirwe namaiga, chingaki chionsi nigo eganetie komanya ebina biao.
english: My soul is consumed with longing for your laws at all times.

ekegusii: Omoyo one ochandekire nomoondoko. Omonene, ngoika ririri oraganye otarankonya?
english: My soul is in anguish. How long, O LORD, how long?

ekegusii: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.
english: Omoyo one obuirwe nemechando, imbeke chinguru koreng’ana ne ring’ana riao.

ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ore nerang’o asore aye Nyasae ore moyo. Ndiriri ndachiche ndore obosio bwao, aye Nyasae?
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When can I go and meet with God?

ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo oganyete Omonene, kobua abarendi baganyete ng’a bokie, ee, kobua abarendi baganyete ng’a bokie.
english: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen wait for the morning.

ekegusii: My soul will be satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.
english: Omoyo one oisanekire buna oyorire obonoru bw’emeseto na ebitinya, nimbe nkogotogia nomonwa one ore nebikoba bire nomogoko.

ekegusii: Ase omoyo one ninyetogerie Omonene, abwo bachayire tiga bayaigwe bagoke.
english: My soul will boast in the LORD; let the afflicted hear and rejoice.

ekegusii: Omoyo one nigo ogokogania ase obotuko, omoika ore ime yane nigo ogokorigia kobogokiamoka. Ekero orarente ebina biao igoro ase ense, abanto bamenyeteo nigo bakweorokereria oboronge.
english: My soul yearns for you in the night; in the morning my spirit longs for you. When your judgments come upon the earth, the people of the world learn righteousness.

ekegusii: Omoyo one nore namaiga amange kobeera ase chigoora chi’Omonene; enkoro yane na omobere one nigo bigoterera Nyasae ore moyo nomogoko omonene.
english: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

ekegusii: “Omoika ong’ereire, amatuko aane aikeire omoerio; oboina mbonganyete.
english: My spirit is broken, my days are cut short, the grave awaits me.

ekegusii: Nabeire nkobwatia chinchera chiao botambe; amagoro aane tana‐gotererigwa.
english: My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not slipped.

ekegusii: Chinguru chiane chiang’ereire, nabeire buna ekegionkorio ekiomo pa, oromeme rwane rwabwatanire namang’ang’ura; aye kwanyareirie ase amaroba nkwete.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me in the dust of death.

ekegusii: Omoro one onyure na koigota aiga igoro; rora, ngotirimboka ore oe Abaedomu egesusuro, abanto abwo nanacheire ekina.
english: My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens; see, it descends in judgment on Edom, the people I have totally destroyed.

ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko nigo nkorera, na amariga abeire endagera yane; botambe abanto nigo bakomboria, “Nyasae oo ng’ai are?”
english: My tears have been my food day and night, while men say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

ekegusii: Chiema chiaito chiasarekire; Chingori chi’ogochisibera chiabutoirwe. Abana baito basirire, tibari aande. Omonto tari ogotenenia chiema naende. Onde tari oratosungere ebitambaa bie chiema chiaito.
english: My tent is destroyed; all its ropes are snapped. My sons are gone from me and are no more; no one is left now to pitch my tent or to set up my shelter.

ekegusii: Obogima bwane nigo bore ase amaboko ao; ntoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baane na ay’abachandi baane.
english: My times are in your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

ekegusii: Erio oromeme rwane ndogenderere koraria oboronge bwao, na ogotogigwa kwao, omobaso boira.
english: My tongue will speak of your righteousness and of your praises all day long.

ekegusii: Omobaso boira oromeme rwane ndobe rokona‐gokwana igoro y’oboronge bwao, erinde abwo barigetie gonkora bobe basookigwe na gochaywa.
english: My tongue will tell of your righteous acts all day long, for those who wanted to harm me have been put to shame and confusion.

ekegusii: Amauga onsi ay’omobere one natebe, “Aye Omonene, ning’o onga buna aye? Aye ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru korwa ase oyore ne chinguru komobua, ee, nigo ogotooria oyo otari ne chinguru naende omoremerwa, korwa ase oyo okomochanda.”
english: My whole being will exclaim, "Who is like you, O LORD? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them."

ekegusii: Amang’ana aane nigo akoorokia oboronge bore ime ase enkoro yane, na ase omonwa one nigo ngokwana aya imanyete.
english: My words come from an upright heart; my lips sincerely speak what I know.

ekegusii: Amaote aane agundire atiokire bobe ase engencho y’oboriri bwane.
english: My wounds fester and are loathsome because of my sinful folly.

ekegusii: Risemi riane riandire, ekiagera ababisa baane bebire ring’ana riao.
english: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Naamani akagenda agatebia omonene oye amang’ana aya omwana oria omoiseke bw’Abaisraeli amotebetie.
english: Naaman went to his master and told him what the girl from Israel had said.

ekegusii: Abamura abwo nabwo aba: Naamani na Ahiya, na Gera, oyio obairete aroro. Abana abamura baye nabwo Usa na Ahihudi.
english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who deported them and who was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, oborwaire bwa ukoma bwa Naamani nabokobwate aye na ororeria rwao kogenderera botambe.” Gehasi akarua ase obosio bw’Elisha, akagenda ore noborwaire bwa ukoma, orabete se.
english: Naaman's leprosy will cling to you and to your descendants forever." Then Gehazi went from Elisha's presence and he was leprous, as white as snow.

ekegusii: Korende abasomba baye bakamochiera, bakamotebia, “Tata, onye omobani oyo nagotebia okore egento kere egekong’u, Inee, tikwarenge kogekora? Korende bono, nase ki otakomoigwera ekero agotebia: Genda bwesibie, naye nocheneke?”
english: Naaman's servants went to him and said, "My father, if the prophet had told you to do some great thing, would you not have done it? How much more, then, when he tells you, 'Wash and be cleansed'!"

ekegusii: Naara akamoiborera Ahusamu na Heferi, Temeni na Hahasitari. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Naara.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.

ekegusii: Nabali akabairaneria, agateba, “Daudi oyio, nere ng’o? Oyio omwana o Yese, nere ng’o? Ase amatuko aya abasomba abange nigo bagotama korwa ase abanene babo.
english: Nabal answered David's servants, "Who is this David? Who is this son of Jesse? Many servants are breaking away from their masters these days.

ekegusii: Korende Nadabu na Abihu, barabwo bagakwera ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekero bamoruerete omorero bw’engencho eng’ao etachikiri, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai. Barabwo tibabwate abana. Ase ayio Eleazari na Itamari bakagenderera gokora emeremo y’obokuani ase amatuko onsi Haroni ise arenge moyo.
english: Nadab and Abihu, however, fell dead before the LORD when they made an offering with unauthorized fire before him in the Desert of Sinai. They had no sons; so only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.

ekegusii: Nadabu, mosinto o Yeroboamu, agachaka kogambera Abaisraeli ase omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akagamba ase engaki y’emiaka ebere.
english: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and he reigned over Israel two years.

ekegusii: Nahasi Omoamoni akagenda, agaetanana Yabesi ase ense ya Gileadi koyorwania esegi. Abanto bonsi ba Yabesi bakamotebia, “Kora okobwatana naintwe, erio tobe inse asore togokorere.”
english: Nahash the Ammonite went up and besieged Jabesh Gilead. And all the men of Jabesh said to him, "Make a treaty with us, and we will be subject to you."

ekegusii: Nahshon was the father of Salmon, Salmon the father of Boaz,
english: Nahasoni akaibora Salima, na Salima akaibora Boazi,

ekegusii: Buna aiboretwe ore getirianda korwa ase enda ya ng’ina, naboigo aragende ore getirianda buna achete, gose takoira kende ase ebio echandeire mono kobinyora.
english: Naked a man comes from his mother's womb, and as he comes, so he departs. He takes nothing from his labor that he can carry in his hand.

ekegusii: Erio Naomi agetebia Rutu, “Ee, omwana one, mbuya mono kobua asore okore emeremo nabaiseke abwo bakomokorera Boazi. Oise kogenda ase omogondo bw’omonto omoao, abanto bare aroro mbabaise kogokorera bobe.”
english: Naomi said to Ruth her daughter-in-law, "It will be good for you, my daughter, to go with his girls, because in someone else's field you might be harmed."

ekegusii: nard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree, with myrrh and aloes and all the finest spices.
english: na ebimeri bigosegwa safarani; boigo kalamusi, na omodalasini, na emete yonsi ya ubani, na manemane, na omogaka, amo nebinsari ebiya mono.

ekegusii: Nathani agatebia Daudi, “Kora ande onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naye.”
english: Nathan replied to David, "Whatever you have in mind, do it, for God is with you."

ekegusii: Nathani agatebia omoruoti, “Genda okore ande onsi ayare ase ebirengererio biao, ekiagera Omonene nigo are amo naye.”
english: Nathan replied to the king, "Whatever you have in mind, go ahead and do it, for the LORD is with you."

ekegusii: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.
english: Nathani agatebia Daudi amang’ana ayio onsi buna ayaigwete na koyarora.

ekegusii: Nathan reported to David all the words of this entire revelation.
english: Nathani agatebia Daudi amang’ana ayio onsi buna ayaigwete na korora.

ekegusii: Nathani agakwana, akamoboria, “Omonene one omoruoti, Inee, nabo gwatebete ng’a, Adonia nere oragambe nyuma yao, aikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti?
english: Nathan said, "Have you, my lord the king, declared that Adonijah shall be king after you, and that he will sit on your throne?

ekegusii: Naki egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oboruoti naborwane noboruoti bonde. Emetengecho y’ense nebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara. Noyio noro omochakano bw’obororo.
english: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.

ekegusii: Naki egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oboruoti naborwane noboruoti bonde; enchara na emetengecho y’ense nabibe ase chinsemo ne chinsemo.
english: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku babeire neburuburu, amagambi aiyerigwe; Nyasae ogoaka eriogi riaye, ense nenyititoke.
english: Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall; he lifts his voice, the earth melts.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku mbang’uswe nomobaso oo, na abaruoti mbache, bang’uswe namasase akobara korwa asore.”
english: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your dawn.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’ebisaku bararore ayio mbasooke, ekiagera chinguru chiabo chiabuirwe. Mbatube emenwa yabo namaboko abo, na amato abo natine.
english: Nations will see and be ashamed, deprived of all their power. They will lay their hands on their mouths and their ears will become deaf.

ekegusii: Ebisaku binde mbikonye Abaisraeli koirana ase ense yabo, na Abaisraeli mbabakore babe abasomba babo, abasacha na abakungu, mbabe bakobakorera agwo ase ense y’Omonene. Abaisraeli mboose abwo baboosete kare, na bagambere abwo barenge kobakorera bobe.
english: Nations will take them and bring them to their own place. And the house of Israel will possess the nations as menservants and maidservants in the LORD's land. They will make captives of their captors and rule over their oppressors.

ekegusii: Naboigo abarwani bakorete. Korende ase omosalaba o Yeso ng’ina, na ng’ina moke, Mariamu moga Kiliopa, na Mariamu Magidalena bagatenenao.
english: Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother, his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

ekegusii: Nchiarenge aroro chinsiongo isano nemo chi’amagena, chiabekire aroro ase engencho y’ogwesiberia kw’Abayahudi; kera eyemo nigo yarenge ekerengo gie chigalani emerongo ebere gose etato.
english: Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.

ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro boigo akaira ebikorero binde bi’enyomba y’Omonene goika Babeli, akabibeka ase hekalu yaye agwo Babeli.
english: Nebuchadnezzar also took to Babylon articles from the temple of the LORD and put them in his temple there.

ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, akabeka Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu o Safani, akaba okogambera abanto batigarete ase ense y’Abayuda.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to be over the people he had left behind in Judah.

ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, agacha akarwana nere, akamobwata akamosiba ne chingataare, akamoira Babeli.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon attacked him and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Nebukadinesaro akagenda ang’e nomonwa bw’eriko riria ri’omorero ekebemberi, agaaka eriogi, akarangeria, “Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, inwe abasomba ba Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, soka korwa ime agwo, moche aiga!” Erio Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bagasoka korwa ase omorero oria.
english: Nebuchadnezzar then approached the opening of the blazing furnace and shouted, "Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, servants of the Most High God, come out! Come here!" So Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego came out of the fire,

ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro akaira Yehoyakini goika Babeli. Boigo agoosa ng’ina omoruoti, na abakungu b’omoruoti, na abasomba b’enyomba yaye, na abatang’ani bande b’ense eria, akabarusia Yerusalemu, akabaira Babeli.
english: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin captive to Babylon. He also took from Jerusalem to Babylon the king's mother, his wives, his officials and the leading men of the land.

ekegusii: Erio Nebusaradani, omochiki bw’abarendi, akabwata abanto batigarete ase omochie amo na baria batamete gochia asare, akabaira Babeli ase obosomba.
english: Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard carried into exile to Babylon the people who remained in the city, along with those who had gone over to him, and the rest of the people.

ekegusii: Erio Nebusaradani, omoteneneri oria bw’abarendi, agoosa akaira ase obosomba abanto bande baria barenge abataka mono, amo nabanto bande konya batigaire ase omochie; boigo akaira abanto baria konya batameire omoruoti o Babeli bamokorere, akaira nabaroisia b’ebinto abatigarete.
english: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest people and those who remained in the city, along with the rest of the craftsmen and those who had gone over to the king of Babylon.

ekegusii: Nebusaradani omoteneneri bw’abarendi, agoosa na koira abanto aba konya batigaire ase omochie, na bonsi aba konya berure ase oyogokorera omoruoti o Babeli, akaira nabatigari bonsi b’omoganda.
english: Nebuzaradan the commander of the guard carried into exile the people who remained in the city, along with the rest of the populace and those who had gone over to the king of Babylon.

ekegusii: Nebusaradani, omoteneneri bw’abarendi, akababwata, akabaira ase omoruoti o Babeli agwo Ribula.
english: Nebuzaradan the commander took them all and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

ekegusii: Erio Nehemia agatebia abanto, “Genda ase chinka chiaino, morie ebinoru biaino, monywe edivai enyansu, naende mobaatanere chindagera chiaino abwo batabwati, ekiagera rituko eri nerichenu ase Omonene oito. Timobaisa koba nomoichano, ekiagera omogoko bw’Omonene noro chinguru chiaino.”
english: Nehemiah said, "Go and enjoy choice food and sweet drinks, and send some to those who have nothing prepared. This day is sacred to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength."

ekegusii: Moruoti onde tabete agwo ritang’ani orenge buna Yosia, oria omobwatetie Omonene nenkoro yaye yonsi, na omoyo oye bwonsi, ne chinguru chiaye chionsi, koreng’ana namachiko onsi a Musa; gose moruoti onde tanyorekanete buna ere ase abwo bamobwatetie korwa nyuma.
english: Neither before nor after Josiah was there a king like him who turned to the LORD as he did-- with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his strength, in accordance with all the Law of Moses.

ekegusii: Naki okwaroka tai gento, gose ogotaroka tai gento, korende negento koba egetongwa ekeyia.
english: Neither circumcision nor uncircumcision means anything; what counts is a new creation.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Nafutali tibaseretie abanto bamenyete ase emechie ya Beti‐Semesi na Beti‐Anati. Ase igo bakaba bakomenya ase egati y’Abakanani, ababiare b’ense eria, bakabetereria abanto ba Beti‐Semesi na Beti‐Anati kobakorera emeremo emekong’u.
english: Neither did Naphtali drive out those living in Beth Shemesh or Beth Anath; but the Naphtalites too lived among the Canaanite inhabitants of the land, and those living in Beth Shemesh and Beth Anath became forced laborers for them.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku gia Sabuloni tibaseretie abanto bamenyete ase emechie ya Kitironi na Nahalali. Ase ayio Abakanani baria bakagenderera komenya agwo ase egati yabo, korende bakabetererigwa kobakorera emeremo emekong’u.
english: Neither did Zebulun drive out the Canaanites living in Kitron or Nahalol, who remained among them; but they did subject them to forced labor.

ekegusii: Gose onde tari okobeka edivai enyia ase ebirandi ebigotu biroisirie korwa ase amasankwa. Eise kobekwa bo, ebirandi biria nigo biratandoke, na edivai eiteke, na ebirandi bisareke; korende edivai enyia nigo ekobekwa ase ebirandi ebiyia, bionsi bibere biasirana.”
english: Neither do men pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst, the wine will run out and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved."

ekegusii: Nonya nabanto tibagotongia etaya na koyemumeka negetonga, korende nigo bakoyebeka igoro ase ekebekerero, ebae oborabu bonsi abare nyomba ime.
english: Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl. Instead they put it on its stand, and it gives light to everyone in the house.

ekegusii: Titori gwetogia kobua ekerengo ase emeremo y’abanto bande; korende ogosemeria gwaito nigo kore ng’a koreng’ana buna okwegena kwaino gokomenteka, na emeremo yaito asemore ementeke.
english: Neither do we go beyond our limits by boasting of work done by others. Our hope is that, as your faith continues to grow, our area of activity among you will greatly expand,

ekegusii: Chitahabu na ebirore ebiya tibikoreng’anigwa naborobwo, gose tibokoonchorerigwa nebinto bi’ogwechabera, biroisirie korwa ase chitahabu chichenire.
english: Neither gold nor crystal can compare with it, nor can it be had for jewels of gold.

ekegusii: nonya n’Herode tarochi, ekiagera omoiranirie gocha asetore. Rora, ere takorete gento kemogwenerete akwe.
english: Neither has Herod, for he sent him back to us; as you can see, he has done nothing to deserve death.

ekegusii: Korende Zedekia amo nabasomba baye, na abanto b’ense eria, tibaigwerete amang’ana Omonene atomete goetera ase Yeremia omobani.
english: Neither he nor his attendants nor the people of the land paid any attention to the words the LORD had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.

ekegusii: nonya nayare igoro, nonya nayare inse, nonya negetongwa kende gionsi, tibikonyara gotwatanana korwa ase obwanchani bwa Nyasae obore ime ase Kristo Yeso Omonene oito.
english: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

ekegusii: Ase igo inche, gose abaminto, gose abasomba baane, gose abarendi abarenge amo nainche, onde tarenge korusia chianga chia mobere; kera oyomo nigo abwate ekerwanero kiaye nonya nekero akogenda kobuucha amache.
english: Neither I nor my brothers nor my men nor the guards with me took off our clothes; each had his weapon, even when he went for water.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibarenge na gento bagoakana. Akabaabera bonsi babere. Gaki, ase abwo, ning’o oramwanche kobua?”
english: Neither of them had the money to pay him back, so he canceled the debts of both. Now which of them will love him more?"

ekegusii: Riire riria riare kobaraa mobaso, na omorero botuko, tibiare korua ase amasio abo.
english: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place in front of the people.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu y’Omonene chifeta chiabo ne chitahabu chiabo tibikonyara kobatooria. Ense yonsi nesambwe esirigwe nomorero bwe risemi riaye. Mobosokano narente omoerio bw’okoondokia ase abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense.
english: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to save them on the day of the LORD's wrath. In the fire of his jealousy the whole world will be consumed, for he will make a sudden end of all who live in the earth."

ekegusii: Gose omosacha tatongetwe ase engencho y’omokungu, korende nomokungu ase engencho y’omosacha.)
english: neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.

ekegusii: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish the father of Saul, and Saul the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab and Esh-Baal.
english: Neri akaibora Kisi, na Kisi akaibora Saulo, na Saulo akaibora Yonathani na Malikisua, na Abinadabu, na Esi‐Baali.

ekegusii: Ner was the father of Kish, Kish the father of Saul, and Saul the father of Jonathan, Malki-Shua, Abinadab and Esh-Baal.
english: Neri akaibora Kisi, na Kisi akaibora Saulo, na Saulo akaibora Yonathani na Malikisua, Abinadabu na Esi‐Baali.

ekegusii: Netaneli, mosinto o Suari, nere orenge omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku gia Isakaru,
english: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,

ekegusii: Barabwo tibakoigwa enchara naende, nonya nerang’o; erioba tirikobasamba, nonya nomobaso omororo,
english: Never again will they hunger; never again will they thirst. The sun will not beat upon them, nor any scorching heat.

ekegusii: Ase omokia oino timoba aboro; mobe nomoika ogwoka, mogokorera Omonene.
english: Never be lacking in zeal, but keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.

ekegusii: Timochandekera ebinto biaino, ebi moratige nyuma, ekiagera bionsi ebire ebiya mono ase ense ya Misiri nebiaino.”
english: Never mind about your belongings, because the best of all Egypt will be yours.'"

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, igo abwatanete nebibe bia Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, biria akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe; teatananete korwa ase birobio.
english: Nevertheless he clung to the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit; he did not turn away from them.

ekegusii: Korende ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, naende buna ense yonsi eraichorwe nobonene bwane,
english: Nevertheless, as surely as I live and as surely as the glory of the LORD fills the whole earth,

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Omonene tanchete gosiria enyomba ya Daudi, ekiagera nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania na Daudi, naende nariete eira ng’a Daudi abe etaya ekomoreka botambe kogenderera, ere amo nororeria rwaye.
english: Nevertheless, because of the covenant the LORD had made with David, the LORD was not willing to destroy the house of David. He had promised to maintain a lamp for him and his descendants forever.

ekegusii: Korende Daudi akabua eburi ya Sayoni, oyo noro Omochie o Daudi.
english: Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion, the City of David.

ekegusii: Korende amakweri nigo agambete korwa Adamu goika Musa, nonya nigoro y’abwo batakorete ebibe koreng’ana nogosaria kw’Adamu, oyorenge omogwekano bw’oyio ogochi‐gocha.
english: Nevertheless, death reigned from the time of Adam to the time of Moses, even over those who did not sin by breaking a command, as did Adam, who was a pattern of the one to come.

ekegusii: Korende nonya nabo abanto ba kera egesaku bakaroisia chinyasae chiabo abanyene, bagachibeka ase chinyomba chi’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, echio abanto ba Samaria baagachete; abanto ba kera egesaku bagakora igo ase emechie eria bamenyete.
english: Nevertheless, each national group made its own gods in the several towns where they settled, and set them up in the shrines the people of Samaria had made at the high places.

ekegusii: Kera omonto agenderere ase obogima obwo Omonene amogabeire na ase obwo Nyasae amorangereirie. Naboigo nachigete ase chikanisa chionsi.
english: Nevertheless, each one should retain the place in life that the Lord assigned to him and to which God has called him. This is the rule I lay down in all the churches.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, ase engencho ya Daudi Omonene, Nyasae oye, akamoa etaya agwo Yerusalemu ase ogotenenia omwana oye agambe, naende agakong’ia Yerusalemu.
english: Nevertheless, for David's sake the LORD his God gave him a lamp in Jerusalem by raising up a son to succeed him and by making Jerusalem strong.

ekegusii: Korende ase engencho ya Daudi ise tingokora ayio ase amatuko ao, korende nigo ndabotandorane korwa ase okoboko kw’omwana oo.
english: Nevertheless, for the sake of David your father, I will not do it during your lifetime. I will tear it out of the hand of your son.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba bw’Omonene, Omonene tanchete gosiria enyomba ya Yuda, ekiagera ariete eira ng’a Daudi abe etaya kogenderera botambe, ere amo nororeria rwaye.
english: Nevertheless, for the sake of his servant David, the LORD was not willing to destroy Judah. He had promised to maintain a lamp for David and his descendants forever.

ekegusii: Korende abange babo Nyasae tagweneretwe nabarabwo, nakio kiagerete emebere yabo ekwete yasiareretwe ase erooro.
english: Nevertheless, God was not pleased with most of them; their bodies were scattered over the desert.

ekegusii: Korende oboroso obo Nyasae abegete bore ne chinguru, boteneine boronge, bore nekemanyererio eke: “Omonene namanyete abare abaye”, naende, “Kera oyogwatora erieta ri’Omonene, tiga eatanane korwa ase obobe.”
english: Nevertheless, God's solid foundation stands firm, sealed with this inscription: "The Lord knows those who are his," and, "Everyone who confesses the name of the Lord must turn away from wickedness."

ekegusii: Korende agetanga ase okoremereria, akagenda inka bwoye. Erio akarangeria abasani baye, na Seresi mokaye, bache mwaye.
english: Nevertheless, Haman restrained himself and went home. Calling together his friends and Zeresh, his wife,

ekegusii: Korende ninde namang’ana make igoro asore: Nore nabanto agwo babwatete okworokereria kwa Baalamu, ere oyio bworokereretie Balaki abeke ekegocha ase Abaisraeli, ng’a barie ebinto biare korugwa ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, na gokora obotomani.
english: Nevertheless, I have a few things against you: You have people there who hold to the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to entice the Israelites to sin by eating food sacrificed to idols and by committing sexual immorality.

ekegusii: Korende ninde ne ring’ana eri igoro asore: Tibwangeti omokungu oria Yesebeli ere oyokweroka omobani. Ere nigo akworokereria na kong’aina abasomba baane bakore obotomani, na koria ebinto bikoruegwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa.
english: Nevertheless, I have this against you: You tolerate that woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. By her teaching she misleads my servants into sexual immorality and the eating of food sacrificed to idols.

ekegusii: Korende bagekora abaremu, bagatiira gochia ase ense y’ebitunwa, nonya Esanduku eria yare ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene yatigarete ase egetwori, na Musa nao atigarete.
english: Nevertheless, in their presumption they went up toward the high hill country, though neither Moses nor the ark of the LORD's covenant moved from the camp.

ekegusii: Korende tegerera oigwe amang’ana aya ngokwana naye aiga ekero abanto bonsi baigwete.
english: Nevertheless, listen to what I have to say in your hearing and in the hearing of all the people:

ekegusii: Abamwegenete Omonene bakagenderera komenteka koba abange, abasacha na abakungu;
english: Nevertheless, more and more men and women believed in the Lord and were added to their number.

ekegusii: Abanto abake boka b’Aseri, na aba Manase, na aba Sabuloni bagekeyia, bagacha Yerusalemu.
english: Nevertheless, some men of Asher, Manasseh and Zebulun humbled themselves and went to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere abande ase abanto baria bakagenda koyesangereria, tibayenyora.
english: Nevertheless, some of the people went out on the seventh day to gather it, but they found none.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Omonene taonchogete atige obotindi obonene bw’endamwamu yaye yogete igoro ase Abayuda ase engencho y’okogechia gwonsi Manase konya akorire amogechirie.
english: Nevertheless, the LORD did not turn away from the heat of his fierce anger, which burned against Judah because of all that Manasseh had done to provoke him to anger.

ekegusii: Korende omonyene oboronge nabwaterere enchera yaye, na oyio obwate amaboko achenegete nagenderere koba ne chinguru.
english: Nevertheless, the righteous will hold to their ways, and those with clean hands will grow stronger.

ekegusii: Omosunte tokogenderera koba ase ogochandeka kore bono. Amatuko a kare Omonene nigo atigete ense ya Sabuloni, na eya Nafutali, na chirochio chigachaywa, korende ase amatuko agochi‐gocha narente obonene bw’ogosikwa ase ense ere ang’e nenchera ekogenda ase enyancha, ng’umbu ya Yorodan, nero Galili, ense y’abanto b’ebisaku.
english: Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those who were in distress. In the past he humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future he will honor Galilee of the Gentiles, by the way of the sea, along the Jordan--

ekegusii: Korende netogwenerete goikigwa ase egesinka gete.”
english: Nevertheless, we must run aground on some island."

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba eyio, otatiga omwana oo omomura oria oraiborwe korwa ase enda yao, nere oraagachere erieta riane enyomba.
english: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, who is your own flesh and blood-- he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.'

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aye tokonyara koagacha enyomba eyio otatiga omwana oo, omomura oria oraiborwe korwa ase enda yao, nere oraagachere erieta riane enyomba.
english: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build the temple, but your son, who is your own flesh and blood-- he is the one who will build the temple for my Name.'

ekegusii: “Korende agwo ase emechie yaino nabo moranyare konyenya ching’iti chiaino na koria chinyama buna moganetie koreng’ana buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, abasesenirie. Onde bwensi, oyo otachenegeti na oyo ochenegete, nabe ne ribaga ri’ogochiria buna mokoria chinyama chie chingabi, na echie chinsune.
english: Nevertheless, you may slaughter your animals in any of your towns and eat as much of the meat as you want, as if it were gazelle or deer, according to the blessing the LORD your God gives you. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it.

ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Siiria; bakamorentera abarwaire bonsi ababwatire namarwaire ao ao, na obororo, na ababwatire nebirecha, na abaare ne chindurume, na abarenge amagata, akabagwenia.
english: News about him spread all over Syria, and people brought to him all who were ill with various diseases, those suffering severe pain, the demon-possessed, those having seizures, and the paralyzed, and he healed them.

ekegusii: Erio chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ensemo ya Galili.
english: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ekanisa ya Yerusalemu bakaigwa amang’ana aya, bagatoma Barnaba agende Antiokia.
english: News of this reached the ears of the church at Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya agasarera ase ense eria yonsi.
english: News of this spread through all that region.

ekegusii: Next Abimelech went to Thebez and besieged it and captured it.
english: Nyuma y’ayio Abimeleki akagenda Tebesi, akayonaria na koyoira.

ekegusii: Ase ensemo ya irianyi akaroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chindabu chi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bwabo nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo.
english: Next they made the courtyard. The south side was a hundred cubits long and had curtains of finely twisted linen,

ekegusii: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men.
english: Na oyo o kabere bw’abwo Batato n’Eleazari, mosinto o Dodo, Omoahohi.

ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere bw’Abwo Batato n’Eleazari, mosinto o Dodai bw’eamate y’Ahohi. Ere nigo arenge na Daudi ekero baramete Abafilisti aase basangererekanete amo barwane esegi, na Abaisraeli bakairana nyuma.
english: Next to him was Eleazar son of Dodai the Ahohite. As one of the three mighty men, he was with David when they taunted the Philistines gathered [at Pas Dammim] for battle. Then the men of Israel retreated,

ekegusii: Na oyo o gatato ase abwo nere Sama, mosinto bw’Agee korwa Harari. Abafilisti konya basangererekanire agwo, Lehi, ase omogondo orenge oichire ne ching’ende chi’egatani. Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase Abafilisti,
english: Next to him was Shammah son of Agee the Hararite. When the Philistines banded together at a place where there was a field full of lentils, Israel's troops fled from them.

ekegusii: Oyobwatetie oyio, m’Baruki, mosinto o Sabai; ere agakora omokia akaagacha ensemo ende, gochakera ase Chinsanganio goikera ase egesieri ki’enyomba y’Eliasibu, omokuani omonene.
english: Next to him, Baruch son of Zabbai zealously repaired another section, from the angle to the entrance of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

ekegusii: Oyobwatetie oyio, m’Binui, mosinto o Henadadi; ere akaagacha ensemo ende gochakera korwa ase enyomba y’Asaria goikera ase Chinsanganio naende oikera ase Ekoona.
english: Next to him, Binnui son of Henadad repaired another section, from Azariah's house to the angle and the corner,

ekegusii: Oyobwatetie oyio, n’Eseri, mosinto o Yesua, omogambi o Misipa; ere akaagacha korwa ensemo ende yarochie egetiiro gochia aase ebirwanero biarenge kogachwa goikera ase Chinsanganio.
english: Next to him, Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section, from a point facing the ascent to the armory as far as the angle.

ekegusii: Hanania, mosinto o Selemia, na Hanuni, omomura o gatano na rimo o Salafu, abwo bakaagacha ensemo ende. Oyobwatetie abwo, i’Mesulamu, mosinto o Berekia; ere akaagacha ensemo ende yarenge ang’e nakanyomba kaye.
english: Next to him, Hananiah son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section. Next to them, Meshullam son of Berekiah made repairs opposite his living quarters.

ekegusii: Nyuma yaye, Malikia, oyomo bw’abaturi chifeta, akaagacha ensemo ende goikera ase enyomba y’abakori emeremo be Hekalu, na ey’abaonchoreria, agwo ang’e n’Egeita gi’Okorobera, na kogenderera goika ase akanyomba ka irongo agwo ase Ekoona.
english: Next to him, Malkijah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Inspection Gate, and as far as the room above the corner;

ekegusii: Oyobwatetie oyio, i’Meremoti, mosinto o Uria o Hakosi; ere akaagacha ensemo ende, gochakera ase egesieri ki’enyomba y’Eliasibu goikera ase ensinyo y’enyomba eria.
english: Next to him, Meremoth son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, repaired another section, from the entrance of Eliashib's house to the end of it.

ekegusii: Ababwatetie Nehemia koagacha n’Abalawi inse y’oboteneneri bwa Rehemu, mosinto o Bani. Oyo omobwatetie, nere Hasabia, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rwa Keila; ere akaagacha ase orogongo rwaye.
english: Next to him, the repairs were made by the Levites under Rehum son of Bani. Beside him, Hashabiah, ruler of half the district of Keilah, carried out repairs for his district.

ekegusii: Nyuma yaye abamwabo bakaagacha, bare inse y’oboteneneri bwa Bawai, mosinto o Henadadi, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rwa Keila.
english: Next to him, the repairs were made by their countrymen under Binnui son of Henadad, ruler of the other half-district of Keilah.

ekegusii: Ababwatetie abwo koagacha, i’Melatia Omogibeoni, na Yadoni Omomeroni, na abanto ba Gibeoni, na aba Misipa, abwo barenge inse y’obogambi bw’omogavuna bw’orogongo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati.
english: Next to them, repairs were made by men from Gibeon and Mizpah-- Melatiah of Gibeon and Jadon of Meronoth-- places under the authority of the governor of Trans-Euphrates.

ekegusii: Abanto korwa Tekoa bakabwatia abwo, bakaagacha ensemo yarochie omorobiri oria omotambe, bagaikera orwaki rw’Ofeli.
english: Next to them, the men of Tekoa repaired another section, from the great projecting tower to the wall of Ophel.

ekegusii: Oyobwatetie abwo, n’Zadoki, mosinto o Imeri; ere akaagacha ensemo yarenge ang’e nenyomba yaye, na nyuma yaye, Semaya, mosinto o Sekania, omorendi bw’Egeita kia Moocha.
english: Next to them, Zadok son of Immer made repairs opposite his house. Next to him, Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, the guard at the East Gate, made repairs.

ekegusii: “Nyuma y’ayio tokaonchoka, togatiira gochia sugusu gochia ase orogongo rwa Basani. Ogi, omoruoti o Basani, amo nabanto baye bonsi, bagacha gotorwania esegi agwo ase omochie o Edirei.
english: Next we turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan with his whole army marched out to meet us in battle at Edrei.

ekegusii: na oyo o gatato Amasia, mosinto o Sikiri, oyo bweruete ase ogwancha gokora emeremo y’Omonene; ere nigo abwate abarwani chituoni chilifu amagana abere (200,000).
english: next, Amasiah son of Zicri, who volunteered himself for the service of the LORD, with 200,000.

ekegusii: next, Jehohanan the commander, with 280,000;
english: Na oyo o kabere Yehohanani omochiki amo nabarwani baye chituoni chilifu amagana abere na emerongo etano na etato (280,000);

ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere, Yehosabadi, obwate abarwani chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato (180,000), babwate ebirwanero ase okorwana esegi.
english: next, Jehozabad, with 180,000 men armed for battle.

ekegusii: Lea nere boigo agasuka gochia ang’e amo nabana baye, nabarabwo bagatung’ama inse. Nyuma kegima Yusufu na Raeli bagasuka gochia ang’e, nabarabwo boigo bagatung’ama inse.
english: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down. Last of all came Joseph and Rachel, and they too bowed down.

ekegusii: Neziah and Hatipha
english: Nesia na Hatifa.

ekegusii: Nibshan, the City of Salt and En Gedi-- six towns and their villages.
english: na Nibusani, na Omochie bw’Omonyo, na Eni‐Gedi, emechie etano nomo, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Nikodemo, oria omochierete botuko, oyorenge oyomo asebare, akababoria,
english: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,

ekegusii: Na botambe, botuko na mobaso, nao arenge ase chimbeera na ebitunwa, okona‐korera na gwekeba‐keba namagena.
english: Night and day among the tombs and in the hills he would cry out and cut himself with stones.

ekegusii: Ase engaki yonsi twarenge amo nabarabwo korisia ching’ondi, barabwo nigo barenge asetore buna orwaki, omobaso na obotuko.
english: Night and day they were a wall around us all the time we were herding our sheep near them.

ekegusii: Obotuko na omobaso nigo tokona‐gosaba ng’a tororane nainwe amasio ase amasio, na koroisia ekebaremete ase okwegena kwaino.
english: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you again and supply what is lacking in your faith.

ekegusii: Night and day, whether he sleeps or gets up, the seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.
english: Akaba okorara na koboka, botuko na mobaso, na embusuro eyio ekamera na gokina, ere atamanyeti buna egokoreka.

ekegusii: Amauga ’omobere one nigo akonyatia botuko bokia, na obororo bokondia tibori gokenda.
english: Night pierces my bones; my gnawing pains never rest.

ekegusii: Korwa kare Nineva nigo orenge buna ritibo riichire amache, korende bono abanto ngotama bare. Nigo bagotebigwa: “Tenena! Tenena!” Korende onde tari okorigereria nyuma.
english: Nineveh is like a pool, and its water is draining away. "Stop! Stop!" they cry, but no one turns back.

ekegusii: “Abaamori, gose Abamoabu, gose ororeria rwabo, nonya ngoika ekiaare gia ikomi, tibabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano bw’Omonene nonya ng’ake.
english: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of his descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD, even down to the tenth generation.

ekegusii: Abaanaki bande tibatigarete ase ense y’Abaisraeli nonya noyomo. Ase Gati, na Asidodi nao bake batigarete’.
english: No Anakites were left in Israelite territory; only in Gaza, Gath and Ashdod did any survive.

ekegusii: Enchera ekogenda aase agwo enyoni ende yonsi egotwara orotwari teyemanyeti, gose ekebaki tikiana koyerora.
english: No bird of prey knows that hidden path, no falcon's eye has seen it.

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ase ororeria rwa Haroni omokuani ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tabaisa goika ang’e kondetera inche Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero, ekiagera oyio ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tagoika ang’e andetere inche, Nyasae oye, okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero.
english: No descendant of Aaron the priest who has any defect is to come near to present the offerings made to the LORD by fire. He has a defect; he must not come near to offer the food of his God.

ekegusii: Kera okorongeigwa ase engaki yaye gokororekana ng’a tikori egento ki’omogoko, korende neki’omoichano. Korende nyuma yaye abakonarire banyore okwama kw’omorembe na okw’oboronge.
english: No discipline seems pleasant at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it produces a harvest of righteousness and peace for those who have been trained by it.

ekegusii: Naki ogwatananekana nkogwenerete kobe ase egati yaino, erinde abwo abancheirwe bamanyekane maiso marore asemore.
english: No doubt there have to be differences among you to show which of you have God's approval.

ekegusii: Ababisa tibakomobwata mobosokano, na abakori amabe tibakomochanda.
english: No enemy will subject him to tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.

ekegusii: No fear of me should alarm you, nor should my hand be heavy upon you.
english: Rora, inche tindi kende ogwenerete konyoboa; gose tindi gochia koba buna egurube endito asore.”

ekegusii: Monto onde tagotaara ase ense eyio, gose eng’iti tegotaara goeterao. Ense eyio nebe etamenyiri nabanto ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
english: No foot of man or animal will pass through it; no one will live there for forty years.

ekegusii: Amabe takobanyora abanyene oboronge, korende abakori amabe mbanyorwe namabe amange.
english: No harm befalls the righteous, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.

ekegusii: Omwando bw’egesaku ekemo ki’Abaisraeli tokonyara koonchorwa koirwa ase egesaku kende. Kera omonto ore bw’Abaisreali nigo arabe nomwando bw’egesaku kiaye.
english: No inheritance in Israel is to pass from tribe to tribe, for every Israelite shall keep the tribal land inherited from his forefathers.

ekegusii: Omwando onde tokonyara koonchorwa korwa ase egesaku ekemo na koirwa ase ekende. Kera omonto ore ase ebisaku bi’Abaisreali nig arabe nomwando ore ase egesaku kiaye.”
english: No inheritance may pass from tribe to tribe, for each Israelite tribe is to keep the land it inherits."

ekegusii: “Onde taba ase Abaisraeli, omokungu gose omosacha, okwebeka ase obonyaka bwe chihekalu.
english: No Israelite man or woman is to become a shrine prostitute.

ekegusii: Omoruoti tari orabue nomoganda oye omonene bw’abarwani, gose etuoni teri eratoorigwe ne chinguru chiaye chinyinge.
english: No king is saved by the size of his army; no warrior escapes by his great strength.

ekegusii: na ase emenwa yabo borimo bonde tibwanyorekanete, ekiagera barabwo tibari na komocha.
english: No lie was found in their mouths; they are blameless.

ekegusii: Endo tekobao ase enchera eyio, gose eng’iti ende y’orosana tegochao, chirochio tichikonyorekana aroro, korende abanto baboorigwe nabwo barataare ase enchera eyio.
english: No lion will be there, nor will any ferocious beast get up on it; they will not be found there. But only the redeemed will walk there,

ekegusii: korwa bono tari buna omosomba, korende goetania omosomba, buna oyominto omwanchwa, asende inche mono, na asore mono kobua, buna mwanyabanto, naende buna oyo bw’Omonene.
english: no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a dear brother. He is very dear to me but even dearer to you, both as a man and as a brother in the Lord.

ekegusii: Bono abanto tibagenderereti gotera ekero bakonywa edivai; ebinyugwa bigotindia biabeire ebiroro ase abwo bakobinywa.
english: No longer do they drink wine with a song; the beer is bitter to its drinkers.

ekegusii: Engaki eyio tibakogenderera kworokererania, kera omonto ogotebia omogisangio oye, gose oyomwabo: Manya Omonene, ekiagera bonsi pi nabamanye inche, korwa omonto omoke mono goika omonene mono. Inche nimbaabere obobe bwabo; tinkoinyora ebibe biabo nonya ng’ake,” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: No longer will a man teach his neighbor, or a man his brother, saying, 'Know the LORD,' because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest," declares the LORD. "For I will forgive their wickedness and will remember their sins no more."

ekegusii: Barabwo tibakworokererania kera omonto nomogisangio oye, gose kera omonto noyomwabo, ogoteba: Momanye omonene, ekiagera bonsi pi mbamanye inche, korwa omoke mono goika omonene mono.
english: No longer will a man teach his neighbor, or a man his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' because they will all know me, from the least of them to the greatest.

ekegusii: Tinkogotiga osekererwe nabanto b’ebisaku nonya ng’ake, gose togochaywa nabanto. Aye togotiga egesaku kiao kegwe. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: No longer will I make you hear the taunts of the nations, and no longer will you suffer the scorn of the peoples or cause your nation to fall, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio omonto omoriri takorokwa omosike, gose omong’ainereria takorokwa omonto omwegenwa.
english: No longer will the fool be called noble nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

ekegusii: No longer will there be any curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his servants will serve him.
english: Okoragererigwa konde gwonsi tigokobao nonya ng’ake. Ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae neki’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi nakebe imeo, na abasomba baye nabamokorere.

ekegusii: Tibakoba bakoagacha chinyomba, na abanto abaao bachimenye; tibakoba bagosimeka endagera na abanto abaao bayerie. Buna koreng’ana obogima bw’omote bore, naboigo nobogima bw’abanto baane borabe, na abachore baane mbabe bakogokera emeremo y’amaboko abo ase engaki entambe.
english: No longer will they build houses and others live in them, or plant and others eat. For as the days of a tree, so will be the days of my people; my chosen ones will long enjoy the works of their hands.

ekegusii: Tokogenderera korokwa “Oyotigetwe”, na ense yao tekogenderera korokwa “Eyetigire bosa”, korende norokwe “Oyo inche Omonene nagokigwe nere”, na ense yao nerokwe “Eye enyuomire”, ekiagera Omonene nigo agokirie naye, na ense yao nenyuomwe.
english: No longer will they call you Deserted, or name your land Desolate. But you will be called Hephzibah, and your land Beulah; for the LORD will take delight in you, and your land will be married.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ’obotindi takoigugwa ase ense yao, gose ay’ogosaria na ogosiria ase chimbebe chiao ime. Nigo oraroke chindwaki chiao” “Ogotooreka”, na ebiita biao “Ogotogigwa.”
english: No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders, but you will call your walls Salvation and your gates Praise.

ekegusii: Bono erieta riao tirikoba naende Aburamu, korende nigo orarokwe Ibrahimu, ekiagera nagokorire obe sokoro bw’ebisaku ebinge.
english: No longer will you be called Abram; your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.

ekegusii: Ekeene, omonto tari oranyare kobooria oyomwabo, gose koa Nyasae embooria y’ogotooria obogima bwaye.
english: No man can redeem the life of another or give to God a ransom for him--

ekegusii: Monto onde tari obwate okobua igoro y’omoika, gose igoro ye rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye; ogotooreka tikori ase esegi, gose obobe tibogotooria abwo bakobokora.
english: No man has power over the wind to contain it; so no one has power over the day of his death. As no one is discharged in time of war, so wickedness will not release those who practice it.

ekegusii: Omonto ore na kemocho ase omobere oye tabaisa goika ang’e, onye ore omouko, gose rigata, gose ore na kemocho ase obosio bwaye, gose ore nekiimo ekemo egetambe goetania ekende,
english: No man who has any defect may come near: no man who is blind or lame, disfigured or deformed;

ekegusii: Omonto onde tari oranyare kobarwania na kobabua, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nakore abanto babairoke inwe ase ense yonsi ase moraete. Naboigo abarierete eira.
english: No man will be able to stand against you. The LORD your God, as he promised you, will put the terror and fear of you on the whole land, wherever you go.

ekegusii: gose omonto ore na kemocho ase okoboko gose ase okogoro,
english: no man with a crippled foot or hand,

ekegusii: “Ekerentane, gose omonto bw’ororeria rwaye, nonya ngoika ekiaare gia ikomi, tabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano bw’Omonene.
english: No one born of a forbidden marriage nor any of his descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD, even down to the tenth generation.

ekegusii: Onde tari ogokwana ay’oboronge, onde tari omonyakeene ase ekegambero. Abanto abwo nigo begenete amang’ana a bosa na gokwana oborimo; nigo bakoba barito b’ayare amabe, baibora ogosirigwa.
english: No one calls for justice; no one pleads his case with integrity. They rely on empty arguments and speak lies; they conceive trouble and give birth to evil.

ekegusii: Monto onde tari okorangeria erieta riao akonywe, onde tari ogotaboboka akobwate bokong’u; aye kwabisire obosio bwao titoborora, na igo gwatigire ebibe biaito bigotokoora.
english: No one calls on your name or strives to lay hold of you; for you have hidden your face from us and made us waste away because of our sins.

ekegusii: Abanto tibanyarete gwatanana amariogi ’omogoko are goakwa korwa ase aria ay’okorera. Nigo baagete amariogi amanene mono akaigweka gochia aare mono.
english: No one could distinguish the sound of the shouts of joy from the sound of weeping, because the people made so much noise. And the sound was heard far away.

ekegusii: Onde tarenge ore konyara komoiraneria ing’ana; nonya nkorwa rituko riria monto onde tarenge na boremu komoboria maborio ande.
english: No one could say a word in reply, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.

ekegusii: Abanto tibanyara kororana; ase amatuko atato onde tarenge gosuka kogenda aande. Korende Abaisraeli barabwo mbabwate omobaso aase onsi ase bamenyete.
english: No one could see anyone else or leave his place for three days. Yet all the Israelites had light in the places where they lived.

ekegusii: Onde tarenge korwa isiko obete noboremu kobwatana nabarabwo, korende abanto bakabasika ogosika okonene.
english: No one else dared join them, even though they were highly regarded by the people.

ekegusii: Obonene tibori korwa moocha, gose korwa bosongo, gose tibori korwa ase ebitunwa bi’erooro.
english: No one from the east or the west or from the desert can exalt a man.

ekegusii: Naende monto onde tari ogendete igoro, otatiga ere oyoigete korwa igoro, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto.
english: No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven-- the Son of Man.

ekegusii: Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi; Omwana omomoima ore ase egekuba gia Tata, nere omoorokirie.
english: No one has ever seen God, but God the One and Only, who is at the Father's side, has made him known.

ekegusii: Monto onde tari ororire Nyasae kero kende gionsi. Gatoranchane intwe ase intwe, Nyasae nigo amenyete ime asetore, na obwanchani bwaye bwaikeranigwe ime yaito.
english: No one has ever seen God; but if we love one another, God lives in us and his love is made complete in us.

ekegusii: Tari ng’a monto ororire Tata, otatiga ere oyorure ase Nyasae, oyio nere ororire Tata.
english: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.

ekegusii: Onde tari ore omotindi oraremererie ayechegie. Ning’o rende oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwane?
english: No one is fierce enough to rouse him. Who then is able to stand against me?

ekegusii: Onde tari ase enyomba yaye oeire okobua kobua inche, gose tantangeti gento kende gionsi otatiga aye bweka, ekiagera aye mokaye ore. Naki rende ndanyare gokora ebibe ebinene buna ebi, imomochere Nyasae?”
english: No one is greater in this house than I am. My master has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. How then could I do such a wicked thing and sin against God?"

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, onde tari okogwekaine; aye naye Omonene, na erieta riao nigo rire nokobua okonene.
english: No one is like you, O LORD; you are great, and your name is mighty in power.

ekegusii: Monto onde tatigara ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano korwa ekero Haroni agosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono akore okobwatanigwa goika arueo, gakoorire gokora okobwatanigwa asere omonyene, na ase abanto b’enka yaye, na ase omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisareli.
english: No one is to be in the Tent of Meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he comes out, having made atonement for himself, his household and the whole community of Israel.

ekegusii: Monto onde tatiira amo naye, gose monto onde tarorekana aande onsi ase egetunwa eke, gose ching’ondi ne chiombe tichiba chikorisia ang’e negetunwa eke.”
english: No one is to come with you or be seen anywhere on the mountain; not even the flocks and herds may graze in front of the mountain."

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi tabaisa gosoa enyomba y’Omonene otatiga abakuani na Abalawi abwo bare ab’ekerisio. Abwo mbanyare gosoa, ekiagera bachenekire, korende abanto bande goika babwate omoroberio ochikire n’Omonene.
english: No one is to enter the temple of the LORD except the priests and Levites on duty; they may enter because they are consecrated, but all the other men are to guard what the LORD has assigned to them.

ekegusii: Onde tari bw’omochie oyio oratebe: “Inche nigo nindwarete”, ekiagera abanto abamenyete aroro mbabe baabeirwe obobe bwabo.
english: No one living in Zion will say, "I am ill"; and the sins of those who dwell there will be forgiven.

ekegusii: Monto onde takororerete amabeebe agokorere ring’ana nonya nerimo ase ayio, gose gokororera amabera; korende nigo gwatugutetwe isiko aarabu, ekiagera rituko erio kwaiboretwe nigo kwagechetwe.
english: No one looked on you with pity or had compassion enough to do any of these things for you. Rather, you were thrown out into the open field, for on the day you were born you were despised.

ekegusii: Ase abwo bakure onde tari oranyare gokoinyora. Inee! Ning’o oranyare kogotogia korwa aase abakure?
english: No one remembers you when he is dead. Who praises you from the grave?

ekegusii: Morwani onde tari, oyokogenda ase esegi, orebeke ase amang’ana ande onsi ay’ense eye, erinde amogwenere ere oyomorigete.
english: No one serving as a soldier gets involved in civilian affairs-- he wants to please his commanding officer.

ekegusii: Monto onde tari ase abwo okorengereria mono, gose ore nobong’aini na okomanya erinde atebe, “Ekeng’ese ki’omote oyio nageutera omorero, nkayorugera endagera, boigo nkayosambera chinyama nkaria. Inee! Korwa ase ekio egetigari ningekore egento gi’okogechia? Ningekore enyasae ngosasima, eroisirie korwa ase omote?”
english: No one stops to think, no one has the knowledge or understanding to say, "Half of it I used for fuel; I even baked bread over its coals, I roasted meat and I ate. Shall I make a detestable thing from what is left? Shall I bow down to a block of wood?"

ekegusii: Tari omonto okobonduera, korende ninche omonyene naborure. Ninde nokobua koborua; naende ninde nokobua koboirania. Ogochika oko nigo nakonyorire ase Tata one.”
english: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father."

ekegusii: Monto onde tari bwenyoreire amasikani ayio ere omonyene, korende abe orangerigwe na Nyasae, buna Haroni arangeretigwe.
english: No one takes this honor upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Aaron was.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi ogokana Omwana tari na Ise. Ere oyokomobera Omwana kirori nigo are na Ise boigo.
english: No one who denies the Son has the Father; whoever acknowledges the Son has the Father also.

ekegusii: “Omosacha ogombairie, gose ekiimo kiaye ki’obosacha kebutogete, tabaisa gosoa ase omosangererekano bw’Omonene.
english: No one who has been emasculated by crushing or cutting may enter the assembly of the LORD.

ekegusii: Kera omonto oiboirwe na Nyasae tagokora ebibe, ekiagera oroiboro rwa Nyasae ndotigarete ime yaye, gose takonyara gokora ebibe, ekiagera oiboirwe na Nyasae.
english: No one who is born of God will continue to sin, because God's seed remains in him; he cannot go on sinning, because he has been born of God.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi omenyete ime asare tagokora ebibe; onde bwensi ogokora ebibe tamorochi, nonya nkomomanya tamomanyeti.
english: No one who lives in him keeps on sinning. No one who continues to sin has either seen him or known him.

ekegusii: Omonto okwenaria obong’ainereria takomenya ase enyomba yane, oyo ogoteba oborimo takobeera ase obosio bwane.
english: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.

ekegusii: Naki monto onde tari ogokora ring’ana bobisi onye ere omonyene origetie komanyekana. Kogokora aya eorokie ase ense.”
english: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world."

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi ogosemeretie totiga asookigwe; korende abwo batigire obwegenwa engencho ende etaiyo basookigwe.
english: No one whose hope is in you will ever be put to shame, but they will be put to shame who are treacherous without excuse.

ekegusii: Ase obogima bwao bwonsi, omonto tari orakobue. Buna narenge amo na Musa, naboigo ndabe amo naye, tinkogotiga nonya ng’ake.
english: No one will be able to stand up against you all the days of your life. As I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will never leave you nor forsake you.

ekegusii: Monto onde takoa oria okwereire endagera ase okomoremia; na oria okoreera ise gose ng’ina takoremigwa ase okoegwa ekenyugwa.
english: No one will offer food to comfort those who mourn for the dead-- not even for a father or a mother-- nor will anyone give them a drink to console them.

ekegusii: Gaki monto onde tamochaya, korende momokoobe ase omorembe, erinde airane asende, ekiagera nimoganyete amo nabaminto.
english: No one, then, should refuse to accept him. Send him on his way in peace so that he may return to me. I am expecting him along with the brothers.

ekegusii: Omokuani onde bwensi takonywa edivai ekero agochia gosoa ase eraaro ya ime.
english: No priest is to drink wine when he enters the inner court.

ekegusii: Igena rinde tirikorusigwa asore ribe eri’ekoona, gose kobekwa ase oboroso, korende aye nosarigwe ogenderere koba ritongo kogenderera botambe.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: No rock will be taken from you for a cornerstone, nor any stone for a foundation, for you will be desolate forever," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo banga buna ebimeri bisimekire masomberera, bitaireti emeri inse. Omonene nigo akobaguseria embeo, boma, na omoubera noro obairurukia buna okoirurukia obonyansi obwomo.
english: No sooner are they planted, no sooner are they sown, no sooner do they take root in the ground, than he blows on them and they wither, and a whirlwind sweeps them away like chaff.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ogokwa kwa Gidioni, Abaisraeli bagatiga koba abegenwa ase Omonene, na bagasasima chinyasae chiria Baali. Bagachora Baali‐Beriti ekaba enyasae yabo,
english: No sooner had Gideon died than the Israelites again prostituted themselves to the Baals. They set up Baal-Berith as their god and

ekegusii: Ogoteemwa tikwabanyorete inwe, otatiga okore kw’engencho ya mwanyabanto. Nyasae nomwegenwa, takobatiga moteemwe goetania buna chinguru chiaino ching’ana, korende amo nogoteemwa nakore egesieri mogosokera, erinde monyare gokoremereria.
english: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; he will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, he will also provide a way out so that you can stand up under it.

ekegusii: Ebirwanero biaroisigwe ase ogokorwania, tibikonyora okobua, kera oromeme rorakoimokere kogosoera, aye norobue ase ekina. Oyo noro omwando bw’abasomba baane inche Omonene, na oboronge bwabo obokorwa asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: no weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and this is their vindication from me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Omoboraka anyare korikwa onye okoorire emiaka emerongo etano nomo, naende onye orenge omokungu bw’omosacha oyomo.
english: No widow may be put on the list of widows unless she is over sixty, has been faithful to her husband,

ekegusii: Korende omoganda oyio, otamanyeti amachiko, oragererigwe.”
english: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law-- there is a curse on them."

ekegusii: Yaya, taibo, genda inwe mweka abasacha, mokorere Omonene. Naki ayio naro konya moganetie.” Erio bagaserigwa korwa ase Farao.
english: No! Have only the men go; and worship the LORD, since that's what you have been asking for." Then Moses and Aaron were driven out of Pharaoh's presence.

ekegusii: Korende twegenire ng’a ase amabera ’Omonene Yeso intwe natotoorigwe, buna barabwo.”
english: No! We believe it is through the grace of our Lord Jesus that we are saved, just as they are."

ekegusii: Korende ere n’Omoyahudi bw’ekeene oyore Omoyahudi o ime, na okwaroka gw’ekeene nogw’enkoro. Eye nemeremo y’Omoika, teri ey’amariko. Ogotogigwa kwaye tikorueti ase mwanyabanto, korende nase Nyasae.
english: No, a man is a Jew if he is one inwardly; and circumcision is circumcision of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code. Such a man's praise is not from men, but from God.

ekegusii: Taibo, korende ebinto biria abanto b’Ebisaku bakorua buna ebing’wanso nigo bakoruera ebirecha, gose tari Nyasae. Inche tinyancheti inwe mobwatane nebirecha.
english: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God, and I do not want you to be participants with demons.

ekegusii: Korende nigo ngochanda omobere one na koyokoria buna omosomba, erinde konarandeirie abande, inche timba omonto ogocha kwangwa.
english: No, I beat my body and make it my slave so that after I have preached to others, I myself will not be disqualified for the prize.

ekegusii: Korende ase amang’ana aya onsi twabeire ababui, na goetania ababui, goetera asare oyotwanchete.
english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

ekegusii: Yaya, nigo more nemeroberio emekorekanu ime ase chinkoro chiaino, amaboko aino nigo agokora obotindi bw’oborianania ase ense.
english: No, in your heart you devise injustice, and your hands mete out violence on the earth.

ekegusii: Abana baane, tiga timokora bo. Chinkuma echio naigure ase egati y’abanto b’Omonene tichiri chingiya.
english: No, my sons; it is not a good report that I hear spreading among the LORD's people.

ekegusii: Korende edivai enyia negwenerete ebekwe ase ebirandi ebiya.
english: No, new wine must be poured into new wineskins.

ekegusii: ekiagera Tata omonyene nigo abanchete inwe, ekiagera inwe mwanyanchire inche, na mwegenire ng’a inche nigo narwete ase Tata.
english: No, the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.

ekegusii: Taibo! Ring’ana riria nigo rire ang’e nainwe ase emenwa yaino, na ase chinkoro chiaino, erinde monyare korikora.
english: No, the word is very near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart so you may obey it.

ekegusii: korende ring’ana eri ndiria riakwanetwe nomobani Yoeli:
english: No, this is what was spoken by the prophet Joel:

ekegusii: korende nigo togokwana obong’aini bw’obobisi bwa Nyasae, obwo bwabisetwe, obwo Nyasae aroberetie korwa omochakano, erinde atoeire bobe obonene bwaito.
english: No, we speak of God's secret wisdom, a wisdom that has been hidden and that God destined for our glory before time began.

ekegusii: Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
english: Naboigo Nuhu akorete; agakora ayio onsi Nyasae amochigete.

ekegusii: Akaibora abana abamura batato, nabwo Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.
english: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth.

ekegusii: Nuhu nigo arenge nemiaka amagana atano na rimo (600) engaki etoigo yachete ase ense.
english: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.

ekegusii: Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
english: Nuhu akaba omoremi, akaba oyo bwe ritang’ani gosimeka emesabibu, nero ekoroisigwa edivai.

ekegusii: Korwa omochakano teraigugwa ng’a omonto oramokirie amaiso ’omouko oiboretwe engencho eye.
english: Nobody has ever heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.

ekegusii: Omonto terigeria kwenyorera ebiya, korende arigerie omogisangio oye ebiya.
english: Nobody should seek his own good, but the good of others.

ekegusii: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
english: Noga na Nefegi, na Yafia;

ekegusii: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,
english: Noga na Nefegi, na Yafia,

ekegusii: Nohah the fourth and Rapha the fifth.
english: na Noha oyo o kane, na Rafa oyo o gatano.

ekegusii: Ebibe biaye bionsi akorete tibikoinyorwa, erinde agambigwe, korende nabe moyo, ekiagera akorire ayare ay’oboronge.
english: None of the offenses he has committed will be remembered against him. Because of the righteous things he has done, he will live.

ekegusii: Nonya nomonto oyomo ase abatigari b’Abayuda abwo bachete komenya ase ense ya Misiri tagotooreka, gose koirana gochia ase ense y’Abayuda, eyio baganetie bairane gochia komenyao. Tibakonyara koirana, otatiga abanto bake abaratooreke.”
english: None of the remnant of Judah who have gone to live in Egypt will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, to which they long to return and live; none will return except a few fugitives."

ekegusii: Abagambi b’ense eye tibabomanyete, nonya noyomo obo; naki onye mbabomanyete, anga tibabambete Omonene bw’obonene;
english: None of the rulers of this age understood it, for if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

ekegusii: Ase ebibe ebio akorete takobarerwa nonya nekemo; ere okorire ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge, ekeene goika abe moyo.
english: None of the sins he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done what is just and right; he will surely live.

ekegusii: Timobaisa koira gento kende gionsi keragereirie. Erio nario Omonene aratige endamwamu yaye enene, erinde abarorere amabera. Ere igo arabe namabeebe asemore, abakore momentekane, buna arierete chisokoro chiaino eira.
english: None of those condemned things shall be found in your hands, so that the LORD will turn from his fierce anger; he will show you mercy, have compassion on you, and increase your numbers, as he promised on oath to your forefathers,

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi ogochiera omokungu oyio tari koirana naende, takoiranera chinchera chi’obogima.
english: None who go to her return or attain the paths of life.

ekegusii: Gose timobaisa korokwa abanene, ekiagera Omonene oino noyomo, nere Kristo.
english: Nor are you to be called 'teacher,' for you have one Teacher, the Christ.

ekegusii: gose tari bonsi bare abana ba Ibrahimu ekiagera baruete ase oroiboro rwaye, otatiga, “Ase Isaka oroiboro rwao narwatorwe.”
english: Nor because they are his descendants are they all Abraham's children. On the contrary, "It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned."

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri tibaseretie abanto bamenyete ase emechie y’Ako, na Sidoni, na Alabu, na Akisibu, na Heliba, na Afeki, na Rehobu.
english: Nor did Asher drive out those living in Acco or Sidon or Ahlab or Aczib or Helbah or Aphek or Rehob,

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku ki’Efraimu tibaseretie Abakanani abamenyete ase omochie o Geseri. Ase igo Abakanani bakagenderera komenya ase egati yabo.
english: Nor did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, but the Canaanites continued to live there among them.

ekegusii: Ere terua omonyene ekero ase ekero, buna omokuani omonene are gosoa Aase Aachenu kera omwaka amo namanyinga atari ayaye.
english: Nor did he enter heaven to offer himself again and again, the way the high priest enters the Most Holy Place every year with blood that is not his own.

ekegusii: gose tinatiirete kogenda Yerusalemu ase abwo barenge abatomwa be ritang’ani asende, korende nkagenda Arabia, naende nkairana Damesiki.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to see those who were apostles before I was, but I went immediately into Arabia and later returned to Damascus.

ekegusii: Na barabwo tibaonchogete korwa ase ogoita kwabo, gose oborogi bwabo, gose obotomani bwabo, gose okoiba kwabo.
english: Nor did they repent of their murders, their magic arts, their sexual immorality or their thefts.

ekegusii: gose titwariete endagera ya monto onde bwensi bosa, totaakaneti, korende nase obokong’u amo nogwechanda togakora emeremo obotuko na omobaso, erinde titoraarereria monto onde oino.
english: nor did we eat anyone's food without paying for it. On the contrary, we worked night and day, laboring and toiling so that we would not be a burden to any of you.

ekegusii: naende ring’ana riaye timori narirorio ime yaino, ekiagera timomwegeneti ere oyotomirwe nere.
english: nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.

ekegusii: Nor is it beyond the sea, so that you have to ask, "Who will cross the sea to get it and proclaim it to us so we may obey it?"
english: Gose tigokari ng’umbu y’enyancha, erinde moborie: Ning’o oranyare kwamboka gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha agotorentere, erinde tokoigwe na togokore?

ekegusii: Tasoka korwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu, gose gokora Obomenyo obo Obochenu bwa Nyasae oye bobe obotachenegeti, ekiagera amaguta aagetwe nigo amwatananete ere agenderere koba oyone, inche Nyasae oye. Inche ninche Omonene.
english: nor leave the sanctuary of his God or desecrate it, because he has been dedicated by the anointing oil of his God. I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Motige kegima amang’ana amabe, gose ay’oboriri, gose obosekereria, ayatagwenereti; korende mbuya kobua koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
english: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk or coarse joking, which are out of place, but rather thanksgiving.

ekegusii: nonya namarwaire amabe agoeta ase omosunte, gose amabe ande onsi agoita mobaso.
english: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the plague that destroys at midday.

ekegusii: nor thieves nor the greedy nor drunkards nor slanderers nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.
english: gose abaibi, gose abegimeria, gose abagotinda, gose abarami, gose abauri.

ekegusii: gose tibategerera emegano ao ao, gose chinderia chie chisokoro, chitari nomoerio. Ayio onsi nigo akorenta okobora‐boria, gose tari gokorera oboagacho bwa Nyasae ase okwegena.
english: nor to devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies. These promote controversies rather than God's work-- which is by faith.

ekegusii: gose tibakobora: Rora naiga bore, gose: Naaria! Rora, oboruoti bwa Nyasae nigo bore ime asemore.”
english: nor will people say, 'Here it is,' or 'There it is,' because the kingdom of God is within you."

ekegusii: Boigo omonto takobora korwa ase egesaku ki’Abalawi orarue ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase obosio bwane, na ogosamba okoruegwa kw’endagera, na korua ebing’wanso binde kogenderera botambe.”
english: nor will the priests, who are Levites, ever fail to have a man to stand before me continually to offer burnt offerings, to burn grain offerings and to present sacrifices.'"

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omoturi ebioma tarenge ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli, ekiagera Abafilisti nigo boboete ng’a Abaisraeli mbabaise gweturera emioro gose amatimo.
english: Not a blacksmith could be found in the whole land of Israel, because the Philistines had said, "Otherwise the Hebrews will make swords or spears!"

ekegusii: Kera omonto agatiga omochie ase okobwatia Abaisraeli. Onde tatigarete ime ya Ai, gose Beteli; omochie ogatigwa bosa otari na getango.
english: Not a man remained in Ai or Bethel who did not go after Israel. They left the city open and went in pursuit of Israel.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ababisa baane bagokwana nay’oborimo, chinkoro chiabo nigo chire nemeroberio y’ogosiria kegima; emioyo yabo noboina bwasie, chimeme chiabo nigo chigokwana amang’ana amansu ay’ogosiria.
english: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with destruction. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongue they speak deceit.

ekegusii: Tintebeti ng’a timosang’anana nabatomani b’ense eye, gose abegimeria, gose abauri, gose abagosaba emegwekano y’ogosasimwa; onye nabo anga mwarua ase ense.
english: not at all meaning the people of this world who are immoral, or the greedy and swindlers, or idolaters. In that case you would have to leave this world.

ekegusii: Yaya, taibo! Goika Nyasae amanyekane ng’a nomonyene ekeene, nonya nkera omonto ore omorimo, buna erikire, “Erinde omanyekane ng’a mboronge ore ase amang’ana ao, na obue ekero ogosoa ase ekina.”
english: Not at all! Let God be true, and every man a liar. As it is written: "So that you may be proved right when you speak and prevail when you judge."

ekegusii: gose tari ase ogokora, monto onde tacha gwetogia.
english: not by works, so that no one can boast.

ekegusii: Gose monto onde obo nonya noyomo tagotigara ore moyo, ekiagera ase omwaka bw’egesusuro kiabo nindetere abanto b’Anatoti amabe.”
english: Not even a remnant will be left to them, because I will bring disaster on the men of Anathoth in the year of their punishment.'"

ekegusii: Naki nonya mbarabwo abanyene abarogete tibabwateti amachiko, korende mbarigetie inwe mwarokigwe, erinde banyare gwetogeria emebere yaino.
english: Not even those who are circumcised obey the law, yet they want you to be circumcised that they may boast about your flesh.

ekegusii: tari omonto onarete edivai, gose omonto bwanchete goaka abanto, abe omonto omoremereria, otari gwancha eriomana, gose otari omwegimeria.
english: not given to drunkenness, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money.

ekegusii: tari ase okogania okobe buna abanto b’Ebisaku abatamomanyeti Nyasae.
english: not in passionate lust like the heathen, who do not know God;

ekegusii: Boigo chitahabu chikaba chikorentwa nabaonchoreria b’ebinto, na baria barenge korenta ebinto korwa ase chinse chia isiko, naende chikarentwa nabaruoti b’Arabia na abagambi bande abarenge goakana ebango ase omoruoti.
english: not including the revenues brought in by merchants and traders. Also all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the land brought gold and silver to Solomon.

ekegusii: Boigo chitahabu chikarentwa korwa ase abaonchoreria b’ebinto, na baria barenge korenta ebinto korwa ase chinse chia isiko, na korwa ase abaruoti bonsi b’Arabia na abagambi bande barenge goakana ebango ase omoruoti.
english: not including the revenues from merchants and traders and from all the Arabian kings and the governors of the land.

ekegusii: Timoba abagwekora abanene igoro ase abwo mwaeirwe, korende mobe ekiorokererio ekiya ase riicho riria.
english: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but being examples to the flock.

ekegusii: Abaminto, tegwenereti abange asemore babe aborokia, ekiagera momanyete ng’a intwe aborokia inatogambigwe ekina egekong’u kobua.
english: Not many of you should presume to be teachers, my brothers, because you know that we who teach will be judged more strictly.

ekegusii: Ase barabwo onde tari oranyare goika aroro otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune Omokenisi, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni. Barabwo nabaike aroro, ekiagera babeire abegenwa asende, inche Omonene.
english: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, for they followed the LORD wholeheartedly.'

ekegusii: Nabo Omonene aikeranetie chiira chionsi chingiya echi abarierete Abaisraeli. Ende teri etaikeranetigwe.
english: Not one of all the LORD's good promises to the house of Israel failed; every one was fulfilled.

ekegusii: onde tari ase abanto aba orasoe ense eria. Aba barorire obonene bwane na ebikone biria nakorete aaria Misiri, na ase erooro eye, korende nonya naboigo babeire bagonteema ase chingaki echi chionsi, nonya ng’ara ikomi, bangire konyigwera.
english: not one of the men who saw my glory and the miraculous signs I performed in Egypt and in the desert but who disobeyed me and tested me ten times--

ekegusii: Ase abanto abwo onde takorosa, gose kogochwa, gose gosundoka, gose korara chitoro, gose orokini rwa kenema tirokonyanyoka, gose chinuga chi’ebikoroto tichikobutoka.
english: Not one of them grows tired or stumbles, not one slumbers or sleeps; not a belt is loosened at the waist, not a sandal thong is broken.

ekegusii: Korende ase egati y’abanto aba onde tarengeo, nonya noyomo, ase baria Musa na Haroni omokuani babarete agwo ase erooro ya Sinai.
english: Not one of them was among those counted by Moses and Aaron the priest when they counted the Israelites in the Desert of Sinai.

ekegusii: Ase barabwo onde tari nonya noyomo, oranyare korora ense eria narierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nimbayee. Onde tari ase abwo banchayete oranyare koyerora.
english: not one of them will ever see the land I promised on oath to their forefathers. No one who has treated me with contempt will ever see it.

ekegusii: Ase ense eria nabarierete eira na gotiana ng’a nimbayee, onde tari asemore orachie komenyao, otatiga Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni.
english: Not one of you will enter the land I swore with uplifted hand to make your home, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

ekegusii: gose tari igo rioka, korende nigo tokogoka ase Nyasae ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo ere asare twanyorire okobwatanigwa.
english: Not only is this so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
