ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende nigo tokogoka nonya nase emechando yaito, ekiagera ntomanyete ng’a emechando nigo ekorenta oboremereria;
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;

ekegusii: gose tari igo rioka, korende nonya nintwe abanyene abatore nogotongorwa kw’Omoika, nigo togwechanda ase emioyo yaito, gatoganyete gokorwa koba abana ba Nyasae, engencho yaye okoboorigwa kw’emebere yaito.
english: Not only so, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.

ekegusii: Gose tari igo rioka, korende Rebeka nere nabogoretie oborito ase omosacha oyomo, nere Isaka sokoro yaito.
english: Not only that, but Rebekah's children had one and the same father, our father Isaac.

ekegusii: Ekiagera omorandia oria arenge omong’aini, akagenderera kworokereria abanto chisemi na korua ogosemia okuya. Agasangereria na gotuka, naende akaroisia emereng’anio emenge.
english: Not only was the Teacher wise, but also he imparted knowledge to the people. He pondered and searched out and set in order many proverbs.

ekegusii: Yuda akagobera gochia asare enchera ensemo, akamotebia, “Inyanchere insoe asore,” naki tamanyete gose moka momura oye orenge. Tamari akamoboria, “Inki orang’e, erinde osoe asende?”
english: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her by the roadside and said, "Come now, let me sleep with you." "And what will you give me to sleep with you?" she asked.

ekegusii: Rituko ri’Epasaka buna eri konya tiriana koinyorwa korwa ase amatuko ’abagambi, baria bagamberete Abaisraeli, gose ase amatuko onsi ay’abaruoti b’Abaisraeli, gose ay’abaruoti b’Abayuda.
english: Not since the days of the judges who led Israel, nor throughout the days of the kings of Israel and the kings of Judah, had any such Passover been observed.

ekegusii: Abakori amabe tibari bo, korende nigo banga buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga.
english: Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.

ekegusii: Korende ayio takoba bo asemore inwe, korende oyorarigie koba omonene asemore goika abe omokoreri oino;
english: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

ekegusii: Korende takoba bo asemore. Omonto origetie koba omonene asemore, nabe omokoreri oino.
english: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,

ekegusii: Korende inche tindi konyora oborori korwa ase abanto; korende nigo ngokwana aya, erinde inwe motooreke.
english: Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.

ekegusii: Tari ng’a nindigetie ekeegwa keria, korende nigo ndigetie okwama koria gokomenteka koba okonge asemore.
english: Not that I am looking for a gift, but I am looking for what may be credited to your account.

ekegusii: Tari ng’a naikire konyora aya, gose naikire koba omoikeranu, korende nakong’irie orogendo inyabwate, ekiagera nabwatirwe na Kristo Yeso.
english: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.

ekegusii: tari ng’a ntweisanerete intwe abanyene korengereria ring’ana rinde rionsi rikorwa asetore abanyene, korende ogoisanera gwaito nigo gokorwa ase Nyasae,
english: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim anything for ourselves, but our competence comes from God.

ekegusii: Tari ng’a nkogambera tore okwegena kwaino; korende nigo togokora emeremo amo nainwe ase omogoko oino, ekiagera moteneine bokong’u ase okwegena.
english: Not that we lord it over your faith, but we work with you for your joy, because it is by faith you stand firm.

ekegusii: timotengechigwa bwango na gotiga ebirengererio biaino, gose timoichanigwa na moika onde, gose namang’ana, gose ne rirube rigokagwa ng’a nkorwa asetore riarure, erigoteba ng’a rituko ri’Omonene riaikire kobao.
english: not to become easily unsettled or alarmed by some prophecy, report or letter supposed to have come from us, saying that the day of the Lord has already come.

ekegusii: Gose tindi kogotoma ase abanto b’ebisaku ebinge bagokwana emenwa emekong’u, abwo ogokwana kwabo otanyare komanya. Ekeene, onye narenge kogotoma gochia ase abanto buna abwo, nigo barenge gokoigwera.
english: not to many peoples of obscure speech and difficult language, whose words you cannot understand. Surely if I had sent you to them, they would have listened to you.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, intwe titobaisa gotogigwa, korende erieta riao rioka ritogigwe, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, na ase obwegenwa bwao.
english: Not to us, O LORD, not to us but to your name be the glory, because of your love and faithfulness.

ekegusii: Goika egachia koba gati‐gati ye Rituko Rinene Yeso agatiira, agasoa Hekalu ime akorokereria.
english: Not until halfway through the Feast did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.

ekegusii: Okogwenigwa tikori ase ogoakwa kwao, eriote riao riabeire riibe, tirikogwena. Abanto bonsi abaraigwe aya akonyorire nigo baraake chinkobi ase engencho y’okogwa kwao. Inee! Onde nare otanyoretwe nobobe bwao bwa botambe?
english: Nothing can heal your wound; your injury is fatal. Everyone who hears the news about you claps his hands at your fall, for who has not felt your endless cruelty?

ekegusii: Yehoahasi tatigareretigwe abarwani esegi otatiga abariini chibarasi emerongo etano, ne chigari ikomi, na abanto barenge gotaara namagoro chilifu ikomi, ekiagera omoruoti bw’Abasiiria aitete abanto bonsi bakaba buna orotu rw’ekeooreri rogotiringwa.
english: Nothing had been left of the army of Jehoahaz except fifty horsemen, ten chariots and ten thousand foot soldiers, for the king of Aram had destroyed the rest and made them like the dust at threshing time.

ekegusii: Na imeo tikegosoa nonya ng’ake kende gionsi kere egetachenegeti, gose oyogokora okogechia, gose oyogoteba oborimo, otatiga baria barikire ase ebuku y’obogima y’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi.
english: Nothing impure will ever enter it, nor will anyone who does what is shameful or deceitful, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life.

ekegusii: Naki getongwa kende tikeri getari maiso marore asare, korende ebinto bionsi nigo bire aarabu naende bimaanoire ase amaiso aye, ere oyo torache koa omobaro.
english: Nothing in all creation is hidden from God's sight. Everything is uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of him to whom we must give account.

ekegusii: Ekero arageire tari gotigaria kende, ase ayio obotenenku bwaye tibokogenderera.
english: Nothing is left for him to devour; his prosperity will not endure.

ekegusii: Getongwa kende tikeri igoro ase ense kenga ero, ekio giatongetwe getari kwoboa.
english: Nothing on earth is his equal-- a creature without fear.

ekegusii: Tari egento kere isiko y’omonto, na gekomosoa, keranyare komobekera ogotacheneka, korende ebikorwa ase omonto nabio bikomobekera ogotacheneka. [
english: Nothing outside a man can make him 'unclean' by going into him. Rather, it is what comes out of a man that makes him 'unclean.'"

ekegusii: Onde tasirete nonya noyomo, omoke gose omonene. Kera omwana, omomura gose omoiseke, o kera omonto nigo atooretigwe, na ebinto bionsi boigo. Daudi akairania abanto bonsi, na ebinto bionsi pi.
english: Nothing was missing: young or old, boy or girl, plunder or anything else they had taken. David brought everything back.

ekegusii: Kende tikegotigara otatiga moragwe inse, mweringanie ase egati y’abasibwa, gose mogwe ase egati y’ebitondo. Nonya ayio are bo, Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
english: Nothing will remain but to cringe among the captives or fall among the slain. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

ekegusii: Ekeombe ki’abarwani b’Abafilisti kegatomwa korenda enchera egochia ase Mikimasi.
english: Now a detachment of Philistines had gone out to the pass at Micmash.

ekegusii: Na rora, omonto oyomo akamochiera, akamoboria, “Omworokia ngokora ki okuya ndakore nyore obogima bwa kare na kare?”
english: Now a man came up to Jesus and asked, "Teacher, what good thing must I do to get eternal life?"

ekegusii: Na omonto oyomo, orenge rigata korwa okoiborwa kwaye, ore kobogorigwa nabanto na kobekwa kera rituko ase egesieri gie Hekalu kiare korokwa Egesieri Ekiya, erinde asabe ebiegwa ase abwo baare gosoa ase Hekalu.
english: Now a man crippled from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful, where he was put every day to beg from those going into the temple courts.

ekegusii: Korende narenge omonto oyomo ore korokwa Anania. Amo na Safira mokaye akaoonia omogondo oye,
english: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sold a piece of property.

ekegusii: Nabo omonto gete narenge omorwaire, erieta riaye Lazaro o Bethania, omonto bw’omochie o Mariamu na Martha mosubati omwabo.
english: Now a man named Lazarus was sick. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

ekegusii: Ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu narengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Mika.
english: Now a man named Micah from the hill country of Ephraim

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo o Nyasae agacha ase Eli, akamotebia, “Amang’ana aya naro Omonene akwanire: Inee! Inche tineorogetie ase sokororia yao na ase ororeria rwaye, ekero barenge abasomba ba Farao agwo ase ense ya Misiri?
english: Now a man of God came to Eli and said to him, "This is what the LORD says: 'Did I not clearly reveal myself to your father's house when they were in Egypt under Pharaoh?

ekegusii: Now a man of the house of Levi married a Levite woman,
english: Omonto oyomo bw’enyomba ya Lawi akanyuoma omoiseke o Lawi.

ekegusii: Narengeo omokuani o Midiani obwate abaiseke batano na babere. Barabwo bagacha kobuucha amache; bagaichoria chintuba amache banyoisie riicho ria ise.
english: Now a priest of Midian had seven daughters, and they came to draw water and fill the troughs to water their father's flock.

ekegusii: naende omosomba tari komenya nyomba botambe, korende omobiare nigo akomenya botambe.
english: Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.

ekegusii: Ekaba ng’a narenge agwo Giligali omonto omoomboganu, ore korokwa Seba, mosinto o Bikiri bw’egesaku kia Benjamin. Ere akabugia egetureri, akabora, “Ngetari ki tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese! Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye!”
english: Now a troublemaker named Sheba son of Bicri, a Benjamite, happened to be there. He sounded the trumpet and shouted, "We have no share in David, no part in Jesse's son! Every man to his tent, O Israel!"

ekegusii: Omonene akarenta omwaga, na omwaga oyio okarenta chinkware korwa ase enyancha, ogachiruta igoro y’ebitwori gochia ase oboare bw’orogendo rwe rituko erimo goetania ebitwori chigatorerekana, chikaba chinduenyi gocha igoro koreng’ana ekerengo ki’amaboko abere.
english: Now a wind went out from the LORD and drove quail in from the sea. It brought them down all around the camp to about three feet above the ground, as far as a day's walk in any direction.

ekegusii: Agwo amo naintwe narengeo omomura oyomo Omoibirania, omosomba bw’omotang’ani bw’abarendi. Tokamotebia chindoto chiaito, na ere agatotebia engencho ye chindoto chiria, agatobanorera kera oyomo engencho y’okorota kwaye.
english: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams, and he interpreted them for us, giving each man the interpretation of his dream.

ekegusii: Abimeleki konya taraba nere, akabora, “Aye Omonene, Inee, nigo oraite nonya nabanto abanyene oboronge?
english: Now Abimelech had not gone near her, so he said, "Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation?

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana’obwanchani bw’obomino, tari nengencho asemore ng’a mbarikere, ekiagera inwe abanyene mworokererigwe na Nyasae, ng’a mwanchane inwe ase inwe.
english: Now about brotherly love we do not need to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love each other.

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ’ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng’a “intwe twensi ntore ne chisemi.” “Chisemi” nigo chikorenta oboenenu, korende obwanchani nigo bokoagacha.
english: Now about food sacrificed to idols: We know that we all possess knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

ekegusii: Korende ase amang’ana ’Apolo oyominto, nigo namosorora mono achiche asemore amo nabwo baminto bande, korende ere tarigeti gocha bono. Nachiche karanyore ribaga.
english: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was quite unwilling to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ’ebiegwa ebikorwa ase Omoika, baminto, tindigeti momoche komanya.
english: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be ignorant.

ekegusii: Bono ase amang’ana ’ogosangererigwa kw’ebiegwa ase abachenu, buna nachigete abanto be chikanisa chia Galatia, nainwe mokore boigo.
english: Now about the collection for God's people: Do what I told the Galatian churches to do.

ekegusii: Nase amang’ana ’abakure, buna bakobokigwa, timwana gosoma ase ebuku ya Musa, ase ring’ana ri’egetutu, buna Nyasae amotebetie, akabora: Inche ninche Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na Nyasae o Isaka, na Nyasae o Yakobo?
english: Now about the dead rising-- have you not read in the book of Moses, in the account of the bush, how God said to him, 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'?

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ’abaiseke abekungi, tindi nogochika korwa ase Omonene, korende nabatebirie buna ndoche inche, buna oyonyorire amabera korwa ase Omonene koba omwegenwa.
english: Now about virgins: I have no command from the Lord, but I give a judgment as one who by the Lord's mercy is trustworthy.

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu akaimoka korwa agwo, akagenda gochia ense ya Negebu, akamenya buna omomenyi aria Gerari, egati ya Kadeshi na Suri.
english: Now Abraham moved on from there into the region of the Negev and lived between Kadesh and Shur. For a while he stayed in Gerar,

ekegusii: Abisalomu akaumerana nabasomba ba Daudi mobosokano. Nigo ariinete eyombo yaye, nero egaeta inse y’omote onga buna omotontera ore ne chinsagia chinetu, na omotwe bw’Abisalomu okaaga ase omote oria igoro, nere agatigara osung’unaneteo, na eyombo yaye egaeta akaminyoka.
english: Now Absalom happened to meet David's men. He was riding his mule, and as the mule went under the thick branches of a large oak, Absalom's head got caught in the tree. He was left hanging in midair, while the mule he was riding kept on going.

ekegusii: Adonia, omomura o Hagiti, akagenda ase Batiseba, ng’ina Sulemani. Omokungu oria akamoboria, “Igo gwachire nomorembe?” Adonia akairaneria, “Ee, nachire nomorembe.”
english: Now Adonijah, the son of Haggith, went to Bathsheba, Solomon's mother. Bathsheba asked him, "Do you come peacefully?" He answered, "Yes, peacefully."

ekegusii: Adonia, omwana omomura bwa Hagiti, moga Daudi, akeimokereria igoro omonyene, ogoteba, “Ninche ndabe omoruoti.” Akenyorera chigari na abanto abariini chibarasi, na abanto emerongo etano barabe bagotang’ana bosio bwaye.
english: Now Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, put himself forward and said, "I will be king." So he got chariots and horses ready, with fifty men to run ahead of him.

ekegusii: Adoni‐Sedeki, omoruoti o Yerusalemu, akaigwa ng’a Yoshua obuire omochie o Ai na oyosiririe kegima, oitire na omoruoti bw’aroro, buna akorete Yeriko na omoruoti bw’aroro. Naboigo akaigwa buna Abagibeoni bakorire omorembe na kobwatana n’Abaisraeli, naende ng’a banyorire ribaga komenya ase egati yabo.
english: Now Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had taken Ai and totally destroyed it, doing to Ai and its king as he had done to Jericho and its king, and that the people of Gibeon had made a treaty of peace with Israel and were living near them.

ekegusii: Now Ahab told Jezebel everything Elijah had done and how he had killed all the prophets with the sword.
english: Ahabu agatebia Yesebeli amang’ana onsi Elija akorete, buna aitete ababani bonsi nomoro.

ekegusii: Ahasia omoruoti akagwa goetera ase etirisa korwa ase akanyomba ka irongo k’enyomba yaye agwo Samaria, na akaba orwarete. Ase ayio agatoma abanto, akabatebia, “Genda ase Baali‐Sebubu, enyasae y’Ekironi, moyeborie gose ningwene korwa ase oborwaire obo.”
english: Now Ahaziah had fallen through the lattice of his upper room in Samaria and injured himself. So he sent messengers, saying to them, "Go and consult Baal-Zebub, the god of Ekron, to see if I will recover from this injury."

ekegusii: Ahimasi, mosinto o Zadoki, agatebia Yoabu, “Tiga iminyoke ntebie omoruoti amang’ana, buna Omonene amotooririe korwa ase ababisa baye.”
english: Now Ahimaaz son of Zadok said, "Let me run and take the news to the king that the LORD has delivered him from the hand of his enemies."

ekegusii: Amang’ana onsi aigurwe, Omoerio bw’amang’ana onsi noyo: Omoiroke Nyasae na obwate amachiko aye, ekiagera ayio naro abanto bonsi bagwenerete bakore.
english: Now all has been heard; here is the conclusion of the matter: Fear God and keep his commandments, for this is the whole [duty] of man.

ekegusii: Erio Abamidiani na Abaameleki, na abanto ba moocha bagasangererekana amo, na ekero bambokire Yorodan bagatoora ase ense omweremo ya Yesireeli.
english: Now all the Midianites, Amalekites and other eastern peoples joined forces and crossed over the Jordan and camped in the Valley of Jezreel.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi ba Moabu baigwete ng’a abaruoti bachire korwana nabarabwo, bonsi abarenge ne chinguru kobogoria ebirwanero bakarangerigwa batang’ane bosio, abake na abanene.
english: Now all the Moabites had heard that the kings had come to fight against them; so every man, young and old, who could bear arms was called up and stationed on the border.

ekegusii: Korende ere nabwate omosani oyomo ore korokwa Yonadabu, mosinto o Simea, momura omwabo Daudi. Yonadabunigo arenge omong’aini mono bw’obong’ainereria.
english: Now Amnon had a friend named Jonadab son of Shimeah, David's brother. Jonadab was a very shrewd man.

ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene agatebia Filipo, “Imoka ogende ensemo ya irianyi goika enchera eria egotirimboka korwa Yerusalemu ekogenda Gasa.” Eye nenchera y’erooro.
english: Now an angel of the Lord said to Philip, "Go south to the road-- the desert road-- that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza."

ekegusii: Ekero nagendererete kobana, Pelatia, mosinto o Benaya, agakwa. Erio ngatung’ama inse nkaumama, nkarera neriogi rinene, nkabora, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, Inee, nigo ogochia goita osirie kegima abatigari b’Abaisraeli?”
english: Now as I was prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah died. Then I fell facedown and cried out in a loud voice, "Ah, Sovereign LORD! Will you completely destroy the remnant of Israel?"

ekegusii: Na Yeso, ekero arenge gotiira gochia Yerusalemu, akabaira ensemo aborokigwa baye ikomi na babere.
english: Now as Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside and said to them,

ekegusii: Korende buna ekanisa eigwerete Kristo, naboigo nabakungu baigwere abasacha babo ase kera ring’ana.
english: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.

ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamorigia ase rituko erio bakobora, “Ng’ai are oyio?”
english: Now at the Feast the Jews were watching for him and asking, "Where is that man?"

ekegusii: Omoruoti Balaki, mosinto o Sipori, akaigwa amang’ana onsi Abaisraeli konya bakoreire Abaamori.
english: Now Balak son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites,

ekegusii: Engaki eyemo, ekero Abasiiria bagendete gosakora, bagoosa omoiseke omoke korwa ase ense y’Abaisraeli, na ere akaba ogokorera moka Naamani emeremo.
english: Now bands from Aram had gone out and had taken captive a young girl from Israel, and she served Naaman's wife.

ekegusii: Barisilai nigo arenge omogotu mono, konya okoorire emiaka emerongo etano na etato. Ere nigo arenge omonda mono, akaba okorageria omoruoti ekero ere arenge agwo Mahanaimu.
english: Now Barzillai was a very old man, eighty years of age. He had provided for the king during his stay in Mahanaim, for he was a very wealthy man.

ekegusii: Gaki bono, koranche osesenie enyomba yane, inche omosomba oo, erinde egenderere kare na kare ase obosio bwao. Aye Omonene Nyasae, kwariete eira eyio. Ase igo enyomba yane, inche omosomba oo, esesenigwe kare na kare nogosesenigwa kwao.”
english: Now be pleased to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever in your sight; for you, O Sovereign LORD, have spoken, and with your blessing the house of your servant will be blessed forever."

ekegusii: Beni‐Hadadi, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, agasangereria abarwani baye b’esegi amo. Abaruoti emerongo etato na babere boigo barenge amo nere, ne chibarasi ne chigari. Barabwo bakagenda bakaboera omochie o Samaria, bakayorwania esegi.
english: Now Ben-Hadad king of Aram mustered his entire army. Accompanied by thirty-two kings with their horses and chariots, he went up and besieged Samaria and attacked it.

ekegusii: Erio Kaini agatebia Abeli omwabo, “Inchuo, togende getii borabu.” Ekero baare agwo borabu, Kaini akaimokera Abeli omwabo, akamoita.
english: Now Cain said to his brother Abel, "Let's go out to the field." And while they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

ekegusii: Bono inchuo obandagererie, ekiagera barabwo nigo bare ne chinguru chinyinge gotobua. Gokobaragereria, ande nabo ndabaise kobarwania mbabue na kobaseria, barabwo barue ase ense yane. Nimanyete ng’a oyo aye ogosesenia, nigo agoseseneka, na oyo aye okoragereria, nigo akoragerereka.”
english: Now come and put a curse on these people, because they are too powerful for me. Perhaps then I will be able to defeat them and drive them out of the country. For I know that those you bless are blessed, and those you curse are cursed."

ekegusii: Danieli akamanyekana kobua abanene baria bande, na kobua abagambi baria abanene, ekiagera abwate omoika omuya mono ime yaye; na omoruoti akarengereria komobeka igoro y’oboruoti bwonsi.
english: Now Daniel so distinguished himself among the administrators and the satraps by his exceptional qualities that the king planned to set him over the whole kingdom.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Daudi na abanto baye bakaba bakogenda korwania Abagesuri, na Abagirisi, na Abaameleki. Abwo nigo barenge ababiare b’ense eyio korwa kare; nigo bamenyete goika Suri na goika orobebe rw’ense ya Misiri.
english: Now David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites and the Amalekites. (From ancient times these peoples had lived in the land extending to Shur and Egypt.)

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe ng’a Ahitofeli nere nao akare ase abwo babwatanire n’Abisalomu, agasaba, “Omonene, onchora omoroberio bw’Ahitofeli obe bosa.”
english: Now David had been told, "Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom." So David prayed, "O LORD, turn Ahithophel's counsel into foolishness."

ekegusii: Korende Esanduku eria ya Nyasae Daudi konya oyerentire korwa ase Kiriati‐Yearimu, goika aase aria ayeroiseretie, ekiagera konya oyeteneneirie eema agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Now David had brought up the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim to the place he had prepared for it, because he had pitched a tent for it in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Now David was clothed in a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and as were the singers, and Kenaniah, who was in charge of the singing of the choirs. David also wore a linen ephod.
english: Daudi akabeka eanga engiya y’egatani, boigo n’Abalawi baria bonsi babogoretie Esanduku eria bakabeka, na abateri boigo, na Kenania, omoteria bw’abateri. Daudi akabeka negesibao ki’egatani.

ekegusii: Daudi nigo arenge omwana o Yese, Omoefarati korwa Bethlehemu ase orogongo rwa Yuda. Yese nigo abwate abamura batano na batato, na ase amatuko aria Saulo arenge omoruoti, Yese konya ogotire mono.
english: Now David was the son of an Ephrathite named Jesse, who was from Bethlehem in Judah. Jesse had eight sons, and in Saul's time he was old and well advanced in years.

ekegusii: Agwo Debora, omoreri o Rebeka, agakwa, agatindekwa inse y’omote onga buna omotontera. Aase agwo akarokwa Aloni‐Bakuti.
english: Now Deborah, Rebekah's nurse, died and was buried under the oak below Bethel. So it was named Allon Bacuth.

ekegusii: Bono beka ebirengererio biaino ne chinkoro chiaino ase okomorigia Omonene, Nyasae oino. Imoka moagache obomenyo Obochenu ase Omonene Nyasae, erinde Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene na ebikorero ebichenu bia Nyasae birentwe ime ase enyomba eye eraagachwe ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene.”
english: Now devote your heart and soul to seeking the LORD your God. Begin to build the sanctuary of the LORD God, so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the sacred articles belonging to God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD."

ekegusii: Dina, omoiseke o Lea, oyio Lea aiborerete Yakobo, akagenda kororana nabaiseke b’ense eria.
english: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the women of the land.

ekegusii: Gaki bono, kora bo, ekiagera Omonene nariete eira igoro ya Daudi, agateba: Nintoorie Abaisraeli, abanto baane, goetera ase okoboko gwa Daudi, omosomba one. Nimbarusie korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti, na korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo bande bonsi.”
english: Now do it! For the LORD promised David, 'By my servant David I will rescue my people Israel from the hand of the Philistines and from the hand of all their enemies.'"

ekegusii: Ase ayio, timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abang’aine, gose abasirie ase enchera eyio, na timobaisa komwegena, ekiagera enyasae ende y’egesaku kende gionsi, gose ey’oboruoti bonde, tiyana konyara gotooria abanto baye korwa ase okoboko kwane, gose korwa ase amaboko e chisokoro chiane. Nyasae oino nigo are bosa goetania chinyasae chiria; takonyara kobatooria korwa ase okoboko kwane!”
english: Now do not let Hezekiah deceive you and mislead you like this. Do not believe him, for no god of any nation or kingdom has been able to deliver his people from my hand or the hand of my fathers. How much less will your god deliver you from my hand!"

ekegusii: Gaki bono, totiga amanyinga aane aiteke aare korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli ochire kondigia inche inde ensona, buna omonto okorigia chinkware ase ebitunwa.”
english: Now do not let my blood fall to the ground far from the presence of the LORD. The king of Israel has come out to look for a flea-- as one hunts a partridge in the mountains."

ekegusii: Ehudi ageturera omoyio o birende ore nobwoge chinsemo ibere; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo; akayweboerania ensemo yaye y’okorio, ime ye chianga chiaye.
english: Now Ehud had made a double-edged sword about a foot and a half long, which he strapped to his right thigh under his clothing.

ekegusii: Bono Eli konya ogotire mono. Ere nigo abete okona‐koigwa amang’ana onsi abamura baye baare gokora ase Abaisraeli bonsi, na buna baare gotomana nabakungu abarenge gokora emeremo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Now Eli, who was very old, heard about everything his sons were doing to all Israel and how they slept with the women who served at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Elihu akaba okoganya baria batato barakwana n’Ayubu, ekiagera ere arenge omoke ase emiaka.
english: Now Elihu had waited before speaking to Job because they were older than he.

ekegusii: Elija, Omotisibi, omomenyi okorwa Gileadi, agatebia Ahabu, “Ekeene, buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, are moyo, ere oria ase obosio bwaye nteneine, riime gose embura tibikoba ase emiaka eye, otatiga ase ring’ana riane rioka.”
english: Now Elijah the Tishbite, from Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, "As the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, whom I serve, there will be neither dew nor rain in the next few years except at my word."

ekegusii: Elimeleki agakwa, agatiga Naomi ore omoboraka, ore nabamura baye babere.
english: Now Elimelech, Naomi's husband, died, and she was left with her two sons.

ekegusii: Elisha agatebia omokungu oria konya abokeirie omwana oye koba moyo, “Imoka aye amo nabanto b’enyomba yao mong’anye korwa aase aiga, mogende momenye ase ense engeni aande onsi orarore, ekiagera Omonene ochikire enchara echiche ase ense eye, nero egenderere ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere.”
english: Now Elisha had said to the woman whose son he had restored to life, "Go away with your family and stay for a while wherever you can, because the LORD has decreed a famine in the land that will last seven years."

ekegusii: Elisha nigo aikaransete nyomba mwaye ime, na abagaaka nigo baikaransete amo nere. Bono omoruoti agatoma omonto korwa ase obosio bwaye atang’ane, korende ekero omonto oria ataraikao, Elisha agatebia abagaaka baria, “Mwarorire buna omoiti oria atomire omonto ache abutore omotwe one? Ekero omonto oria agocha mosieke egesieri, mokebwate bokong’u tabaisa gosoa nyomba. Inee! Ebititiro bi’amagoro ’omonene oye tibiri komotunyana?” Ekero agendererete gokwana nabarabwo, omotomwa oria agacha asare, agateba,
english: Now Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him. The king sent a messenger ahead, but before he arrived, Elisha said to the elders, "Don't you see how this murderer is sending someone to cut off my head? Look, when the messenger comes, shut the door and hold it shut against him. Is not the sound of his master's footsteps behind him?"

ekegusii: Ekero Elisha arenge noborwaire bw’amakweri Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, akagenda komorora. Gaikireo agachaka korera, “Tata ominto! Tata ominto! Aye nigo ore ase Abaisraeli buna chigari na abariini chibarasi.”
english: Now Elisha was suffering from the illness from which he died. Jehoash king of Israel went down to see him and wept over him. "My father! My father!" he cried. "The chariots and horsemen of Israel!"

ekegusii: Bono Esau akarora buna Isaka asesenirie Yakobo na komotoma agende Padan‐Aramu anyuome omokungu korwa aroro, ekiagera ekero amosesenetie, akamokania tabaisa konyuoma moiseke onde bwensi bw’Abakanani!
english: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and had sent him to Paddan Aram to take a wife from there, and that when he blessed him he commanded him, "Do not marry a Canaanite woman,"

ekegusii: Gaki, okwegena nakwo okoba nobomaene ase amang’ana ayio asemeirie, nonya nekeene ki’ayio atari kororekana.
english: Now faith is being sure of what we hope for and certain of what we do not see.

ekegusii: Bono moikeranie ogokora okwo, erinde buna mwarenge nokogania koroisia omoroberio, naboigo mobe ang’e koyoikerania ase ebi more nabio.
english: Now finish the work, so that your eager willingness to do it may be matched by your completion of it, according to your means.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ore korokwa Simion, agwo ritang’ani nigo arenge gokora oborogi ase omochie oria; abanto ba Samaria bakamokumia, ekero are goteba ng’a ere omonyene nomonto omonene.
english: Now for some time a man named Simon had practiced sorcery in the city and amazed all the people of Samaria. He boasted that he was someone great,

ekegusii: Gaki ase amang’ana aya mwandikerete, mbuya omosacha takuna omokungu.
english: Now for the matters you wrote about: It is good for a man not to marry.

ekegusii: Gaki bono nasabire, monyabere ebibe biane ekero eke gioka. Monsabere ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, ng’a anduserie ogoakwa oko tikong’ita.”
english: Now forgive my sin once more and pray to the LORD your God to take this deadly plague away from me."

ekegusii: Gaali agasoka, agatenena ase egeita ki’omochie, na erio agwo Abimeleki amo nabanto baye bakaimoka korwa ase baboete.
english: Now Gaal son of Ebed had gone out and was standing at the entrance to the city gate just as Abimelech and his soldiers came out from their hiding place.

ekegusii: Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, agacha Sekemu amo nabamura bamwabo, na abanto ba Sekemu bakamwegena na komosemeria.
english: Now Gaal son of Ebed moved with his brothers into Shechem, and its citizens put their confidence in him.

ekegusii: Irana gochia ase emeremo yaino. Timokorenterwa chimboba, korende goika mokore omobaro bw’amatabori, oria oria mochikire gokora.”
english: Now get to work. You will not be given any straw, yet you must produce your full quota of bricks."

ekegusii: Korende imoka, otenene namagoro ao, ekiagera nakoorokeire ase engencho eye: nkobeke obe omokori na kirori bw’amang’ana aya kwarora, na amang’ana ayio ndeorokerie asore.
english: 'Now get up and stand on your feet. I have appeared to you to appoint you as a servant and as a witness of what you have seen of me and what I will show you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye amo nabasomba bande b’Omonene oo baria bachete amo naye, moche moimoke mambia chuni erio mochake kogenda kobogokiamoka.”
english: Now get up early, along with your master's servants who have come with you, and leave in the morning as soon as it is light."

ekegusii: Ase igo, bono ing’a ense eye y’ebitunwa, eye Omonene andierete eira ase rituko riria ng’a nang’e. Nkwaigwete aye omonyene ng’a Abaanaki nigo bamenyeteo, na buna emechie yabo yarenge emenene, naende yagiteire chindwaki. Aande nabo Omonene arabe amo nainche, erinde imbaserie, buna Omonene atebete.”
english: Now give me this hill country that the LORD promised me that day. You yourself heard then that the Anakites were there and their cities were large and fortified, but, the LORD helping me, I will drive them out just as he said."

ekegusii: Gaki bono koranche, oimoke osoke isiko, okwane nabasomba bao, oremie chinkoro chiabo. Ase igo natianire ase Omonene ng’a otasogeti, monto onde tagotigara orabe amo naye goika mambia, na amang’ana ayio nigo arabe amabe kobua ayakonyorete korwa ekero kwarenge omosae goika rero iga.”
english: Now go out and encourage your men. I swear by the LORD that if you don't go out, not a man will be left with you by nightfall. This will be worse for you than all the calamities that have come upon you from your youth till now."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, genda oite Abaameleki, obasirie kegima, osirie nebinto bionsi babwate. Tobaisa kobatiga babe moyo, korende oite bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, abana na ebing’werere; oite ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ne chingamia ne chitigere.”
english: Now go, attack the Amalekites and totally destroy everything that belongs to them. Do not spare them; put to death men and women, children and infants, cattle and sheep, camels and donkeys.'"

ekegusii: Korende bono genda, oraae abanto abwo goika aase aria nagotebetie; omomalaika one nagotang’ane. Korende rituko ndiche ekero ndabae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.”
english: Now go, lead the people to the place I spoke of, and my angel will go before you. However, when the time comes for me to punish, I will punish them for their sin."

ekegusii: Now go; I will help you speak and will teach you what to say."
english: Bono genda! Ninkoe amang’ana ogochia gokwana na gokworokereria aya ogochia goteba.”

ekegusii: Nyasae akaa Danieli ogwancherwa na obuya ase obosio bw’omoteneneri oria omonene.
english: Now God had caused the official to show favor and sympathy to Daniel,

ekegusii: Naki Hagari, engencho yaye egetunwa Sinai ekere Arabia, kegwekanirie na Yerusalemu ya bono, ekiagera nigo are ase obosomba amo nabana baye.
english: Now Hagar stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and corresponds to the present city of Jerusalem, because she is in slavery with her children.

ekegusii: Bono ekaba ng’a ase erieta ria Nyasae, oyore Omonene obo, ababani Hagai na Zakaria bw’ororeria rwa Ido mbabanete ase Abayahudi abamenyete ase ense ya Yuda na Yerusalemu.
english: Now Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the prophet, a descendant of Iddo, prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them.

ekegusii: Sulemani konya oroisirie egetenenero korwa ase etaai; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko atano, na konya okebekire gati y’eraaro enene; agatenena igoro ase kerokio. Erio agatung’ama namaru aye bosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye gochia igoro,
english: Now he had made a bronze platform, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and had placed it in the center of the outer court. He stood on the platform and then knelt down before the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands toward heaven.

ekegusii: Naende yamogwenerete goika aete Samaria.
english: Now he had to go through Samaria.

ekegusii: Boigo osoeire omoiseke oyo one na omorenteire obosooku ogoteba ng’a tarochi ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bwaye. Korende rora aa, egetambaa eke nkebwate ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bwaye. Erio barambore egetambaa keria ase amaiso ’abagaaka b’omochie oria.
english: Now he has slandered her and said, 'I did not find your daughter to be a virgin.' But here is the proof of my daughter's virginity." Then her parents shall display the cloth before the elders of the town,

ekegusii: Nere oyokorua chimbusuro na koa oyo okobusura, naende arua omogati ase okoria, nabae inwe chimbusuro, naende nachibuchie, ere nabamenteranie okwama kw’oboronge bwaino.
english: Now he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will also supply and increase your store of seed and will enlarge the harvest of your righteousness.

ekegusii: Bono Heberi Omokeni agatenenia eema yaye ang’e nomote oria onga buna omotontera ase Sananimu, ang’e na Kedesi. Ere konya bweatananire korwa ase Abakeni bande. Abakeni nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Hobabu, mokoyoye Musa.
english: Now Heber the Kenite had left the other Kenites, the descendants of Hobab, Moses' brother-in-law, and pitched his tent by the great tree in Zaanannim near Kedesh.

ekegusii: “Gaki bono morigererie omoruoti oino mwachorire, oyo mwaboria moegwe. Rora, Omonene obekire omoruoti abagambere.
english: Now here is the king you have chosen, the one you asked for; see, the LORD has set a king over you.

ekegusii: Naki Herode konya obwatire Yohana, omosibire, omobekire echela ase engencho ya Herodia, moka Filipo, momura omwabo,
english: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife,

ekegusii: Bono Herode omoruoti akaigwa onsi ayakorekire, agaichanigwa mono, ekiagera abande baare goteba ng’a Yohana obokigwe korwa ase abakure,
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard about all that was going on. And he was perplexed, because some were saying that John had been raised from the dead,

ekegusii: Hiramu konya otomeire omoruoti chitahabu chikiro chilifu inye (4,000).
english: Now Hiram had sent to the king 120 talents of gold.

ekegusii: Hiramu, omoruoti o Turo, agatoma abanto ase Daudi. Abwo bakamoirera emete y’emecharake. Boigo agatoma ababaachi, na abaagachi, na barabwo bakamoagachera enyomba.
english: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar logs and carpenters and stonemasons, and they built a palace for David.

ekegusii: Hiramu, omoruoti o Turo, agatoma abanto ase Daudi, akamotomera nemete y’emecharake na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, erinde baagachere Daudi enyomba.
english: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, along with cedar logs, stonemasons and carpenters to build a palace for him.

ekegusii: Now his brothers had gone to graze their father's flocks near Shechem,
english: Erio abamwabo bakagenda korisia amaicho a ise ang’e na Sekemu.

ekegusii: Now his father went down to see the woman. And Samson made a feast there, as was customary for bridegrooms.
english: Ise Samison akagenda gochia korora omoiseke oria, na Samison agakora omoyega aroro aaria. Nabo yarenge engencho y’abamura gokora.

ekegusii: “Ayerera bwango, moirane gochia ase tata, momotebie iga: Aya naro omwana oo Yusufu agoteba: Nyasae ombekire koba omonene ase ense yonsi ya Misiri; tirimboka gocha asende, totebana.
english: Now hurry back to my father and say to him, 'This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; don't delay.

ekegusii: Rora, inche nabeire ang’e koagachera erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae one, enyomba. Na enyomba eye nigo ndayiatanane na koyechena ase Omonene, erinde tonyare gosambera ubani ere nogotioka okuya asare, na kobeka emegati ebe ekoruegwa ase Nyasae kogenderera botambe. Boigo tobe tokorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa bia mambia na ebia mogoroba, na ebie Chisabato na ebi’Emetienyi Emeyia, na ebi’Amatuko Amanene ay’Omonene, Nyasae oito. Ebing’wanso ebio nigo biachikeretwe Abaisraeli babe bakobirua botambe.
english: Now I am about to build a temple for the Name of the LORD my God and to dedicate it to him for burning fragrant incense before him, for setting out the consecrated bread regularly, and for making burnt offerings every morning and evening and on Sabbaths and New Moons and at the appointed feasts of the LORD our God. This is a lasting ordinance for Israel.

ekegusii: “Bono nkoirana inde gochia ase abanto baane. Inchuo nkomanyie egento Abaisraeli barakore ase abanto bao ase amatuko agochi gocha.”
english: Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you of what this people will do to your people in days to come."

ekegusii: Rora, ekero eke nekia gatato inche nabeire ang’e gocha asemore. Tinkobaraarereria, naki tindi korigia ebinto biaino, korende inwe abanyene, ekiagera abana tibagwenereti kobagachera abaibori enibo, korende abaibori bagachere abana.
english: Now I am ready to visit you for the third time, and I will not be a burden to you, because what I want is not your possessions but you. After all, children should not have to save up for their parents, but parents for their children.

ekegusii: Gaki bono nagosabire, onyabere ebibe biane, oirane amo nainche, erinde inyare gosasima Omonene.”
english: Now I beg you, forgive my sin and come back with me, so that I may worship the LORD."

ekegusii: “Nachikire ng’a monto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli, gose oyo bw’abakuani babo, gose oyo bw’Abalawi, oyomenyete ase oboruoti bwane, karanche kogenda Yerusalemu amo naye, tiga agende.
english: Now I decree that any of the Israelites in my kingdom, including priests and Levites, who wish to go to Jerusalem with you, may go.

ekegusii: “Nkagenderera kobeera igoro ase egetunwa ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, buna ekero keria kie ritang’ani, na Omonene akanyigwa ase engaki eyio boigo, agatiga tabasiria.
english: Now I had stayed on the mountain forty days and nights, as I did the first time, and the LORD listened to me at this time also. It was not his will to destroy you.

ekegusii: Bono inche nachire gokworokia aya agochia konyora abanto bao ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, ekiagera okorora okwo nigo gokworokia ay’amatuko akare bosio.”
english: Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the future, for the vision concerns a time yet to come."

ekegusii: Korende naigure ng’a aye nonyare koorokia engencho y’amang’ana, na korongeyia obokong’u. Bono koranyare gosoma amariko ayio na komanyia engencho yaye, rirorio nobekerwe eanga emonyinga, na obekerwe chisonoi chie chitahabu igoti riao, aye nobe omogambi o gatato ase oboruoti obo.”
english: Now I have heard that you are able to give interpretations and to solve difficult problems. If you can read this writing and tell me what it means, you will be clothed in purple and have a gold chain placed around your neck, and you will be made the third highest ruler in the kingdom."

ekegusii: Na bono nimbwate okoboria okomo ngokoboria, tonkania.” Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Boria.”
english: Now I have one request to make of you. Do not refuse me." "You may make it," she said.

ekegusii: “Bono nigo kore okogania kwane ng’a nkore okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, erinde endamwamu yaye entindi etotige.
english: Now I intend to make a covenant with the LORD, the God of Israel, so that his fierce anger will turn away from us.

ekegusii: Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nomonene kobua chinyasae chinde chionsi, ekiagera atooririe abanto baye korwa ase Abamisiri abwo babaenenerete.”
english: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all other gods, for he did this to those who had treated Israel arrogantly."

ekegusii: Bono namanyire ng’a Omonene nae omoakwa amaguta oye obobui, namoiranerie korwa aase aye aachenu aaria igoro, namoe obobui goetera ase okoboko kwaye gw’okorio.
english: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed; he answers him from his holy heaven with the saving power of his right hand.

ekegusii: Bono nagokeire ogochandwa kwane inde nakorokwo ase engencho yaino; naende ase omobere one nkoyaikerania nde aria aremete ase ogochandwa gwa Kristo ase engencho y’omobere oye, engencho yaye ekanisa.
english: Now I rejoice in what was suffered for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is still lacking in regard to Christ's afflictions, for the sake of his body, which is the church.

ekegusii: Korende inwe abande abamore Tiatira, inwe mwensi motari nokworokereria okwo, inwe abamotamanyeti eri abande bakoroka obobisi bwa Saitani, nabatebirie ng’a tinkobatweka egurube ende.
english: Now I say to the rest of you in Thyatira, to you who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned Satan's so-called deep secrets (I will not impose any other burden on you):

ekegusii: Gaki nabasoroire morie endagera, nebe ase ogotooreka kwaino; naki tikagosira nonya nagatukia akamo k’omotwe bw’oyomo oino.”
english: Now I urge you to take some food. You need it to survive. Not one of you will lose a single hair from his head."

ekegusii: Korende baminto, nimbamanyie ng’a amang’ana aria onsi anyorete, abeire ase okogendereria gw’enchili.
english: Now I want you to know, brothers, that what has happened to me has really served to advance the gospel.

ekegusii: Korende nindigetie momanye ng’a Kristo nere omotwe o kera omosacha; na omosacha nere omotwe bw’omokungu; na Nyasae nere omotwe o Kristo.
english: Now I want you to realize that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

ekegusii: Bono nimbutore amakorogoto aria ababisa bababekerete, naende mbutorane chingataare babasiberete.”
english: Now I will break their yoke from your neck and tear your shackles away."

ekegusii: Rora, ningosangererie ase chisokoro chiao chiachiete; aye nobekwe ase embeera yao kore nomorembe, na amaiso ao takorora obobe boria bwonsi ndarete igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto bareo.” Ase igo barabwo bakairera omoruoti amang’ana ayio.
english: Now I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place and on those who live here.'" So they took her answer back to the king.

ekegusii: Bono narure chinse echio chionsi nachibekire ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, omosomba one. Boigo nabekire ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana ase okoboko kwaye chimokorere.
english: Now I will hand all your countries over to my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; I will make even the wild animals subject to him.

ekegusii: Bono nkobatebia inde eki ngochia gokora ase omogondo oyio one bw’emesabibu: Nintagore orobago rwaye, ntagore na orwaki rwaye, na omogondo oyio obe okorisigwa na gotiringwa.
english: Now I will tell you what I am going to do to my vineyard: I will take away its hedge, and it will be destroyed; I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled.

ekegusii: “Naende inche omoruoti Aritasasita narure ogochika ase abagachi bonsi be chikungo bare ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati ng’a, gento kende gionsi Ezara omokuani oyo bwegerete amachiko a Nyasae o igoro araganie korwa asemore, mogekorere ase oboronge.
english: Now I, King Artaxerxes, order all the treasurers of Trans-Euphrates to provide with diligence whatever Ezra the priest, a teacher of the Law of the God of heaven, may ask of you--

ekegusii: Bono inche Nebukadinesaro nigo nkomotogia Omoruoti ore igoro na komobaka, ekiagera ogokora kwaye gwonsi nokwa boronge, ne chinchera chiaye boigo, na abwo bare abaenenu nigo akobakeyia.
english: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and exalt and glorify the King of heaven, because everything he does is right and all his ways are just. And those who walk in pride he is able to humble.

ekegusii: Gaki onye omonto ogosarwa rituko ri’Esabato, erinde amachiko a Musa tasareka; naki mokombea ekiagera nakora omobere bwonsi bw’omonto koba omogima kegima rituko ri’Esabato?
english: Now if a child can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me for healing the whole man on the Sabbath?

ekegusii: Onye ngokora keria ntancheti, bono tari inche nkogekora, korende nebibe biria bimenyete ime asende.
english: Now if I do what I do not want to do, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.

ekegusii: Na inche onye ngoseria ebirecha ase Beelizebuli, Inee, abana baino nase ng’o bakobiseria? Ase engencho eyio, barabwo nababe abagambi baino.
english: Now if I drive out demons by Beelzebub, by whom do your followers drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.

ekegusii: “Gaki bono, aye omoruoti, onye amang’ana aya agokogwenera, ochike obotuki bokorwe ase amagachero e chibuku chi’oboruoti bwa Babeli, omanye gose Koresi omoruoti naruete ogochika ng’a enyomba ya Nyasae ere Yerusalemu eagachwe naende. Aye omoruoti ototomere aya orengereretie igoro y’amang’ana aya.”
english: Now if it pleases the king, let a search be made in the royal archives of Babylon to see if King Cyrus did in fact issue a decree to rebuild this house of God in Jerusalem. Then let the king send us his decision in this matter.

ekegusii: Bono onye ogokora kw’amakweri kore ase amariko, ayarikire chinuguta na komang’erwa ase amagena, gwachete ase obonene, goika Abaisraeli tibanyara korigereria obosio bwa Musa, ase engencho y’obonene bw’obosio bwaye; na obonene obwo bogaeta,
english: Now if the ministry that brought death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with glory, so that the Israelites could not look steadily at the face of Moses because of its glory, fading though it was,

ekegusii: Inee! Aba bakobatiswa ase engencho y’abakure, naki rende bagokora? Onye abakure tibakoboka nonya ng’ake, nase ki bakobatiswa ase engencho yabo?
english: Now if there is no resurrection, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?

ekegusii: Onye tore abana, naboigo tore abanyamwando, abanyamwando ba Nyasae, abaraire omwando amo na Kristo, gatorachandwe amo nere, erinde tonyore obonene amo nere.
english: Now if we are children, then we are heirs-- heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ, if indeed we share in his sufferings in order that we may also share in his glory.

ekegusii: Korende onye twakwete amo na Kristo, twegenire ng’a natobe moyo amo nere.
english: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him.

ekegusii: Bono komoranyigwere na kobwata okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, rirorio inamobe abanto baane. Naki ense yonsi neyane, korende inwe inamobe abanto baane abachore kobua abanto b’ebisaku binde.
english: Now if you obey me fully and keep my covenant, then out of all nations you will be my treasured possession. Although the whole earth is mine,

ekegusii: Bono rende, onye morigetie gokorera omonene one amaya, na ayare boronge, montebie; onye taibo, montebie, ngende ensemo ende eng’ao korigia.”
english: Now if you will show kindness and faithfulness to my master, tell me; and if not, tell me, so I may know which way to turn."

ekegusii: Nigo agosioma‐siomia aande onsi ase chinchera na ase chichiiro, na ase kera amatabekania oba oganyete.
english: now in the street, now in the squares, at every corner she lurks.)

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria ogosemia kw’Ahitofeli gokaba ase abanto buna amairanerio omonto akonyora korwa ase Nyasae. Naboigo ogosemia kw’Ahitofeli kwabete ase Daudi na ase Abisalomu.
english: Now in those days the advice Ahithophel gave was like that of one who inquires of God. That was how both David and Absalom regarded all of Ahithophel's advice.

ekegusii: Now instead, you ought to forgive and comfort him, so that he will not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
english: Ribaga ri’aya mbuya mwabere omonto buna oyio na komoremia, tabaisa kobugwa nogoichana, erinde erusie moyo.

ekegusii: Bono ekina gi’ense eye nkere; bono omogambi bw’ense eye natugutwe isiko.
english: Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.

ekegusii: Bono Isaka konya orure ase ensoko ya Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi, ekiagera nigo amenyete ase ense ya Negebu.
english: Now Isaac had come from Beer Lahai Roi, for he was living in the Negev.

ekegusii: Bono Israeli nigo anchete Yusufu kobua abana baye bande bonsi, ekiagera nigo arenge omwana oye bw’obogotu. Akamoroiseria eanga engiya entambe.
english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any of his other sons, because he had been born to him in his old age; and he made a richly ornamented robe for him.

ekegusii: Bono amaiso a Israeli konya abeire chinchingori ase engencho y’obogotu, tare korora buya. Igo Yusufu akamorentera abana abwo, na ere akabanyunyunta na kobaboania.
english: Now Israel's eyes were failing because of old age, and he could hardly see. So Joseph brought his sons close to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe karue ogochika ng’a abanto abwo batangwe batige gokora emeremo, erinde omochie oyio otigwe, toagachwa naende goika ekero inche ndarue ogochika.
english: Now issue an order to these men to stop work, so that this city will not be rebuilt until I so order.

ekegusii: Gaki ere oyotoroisetie ase amang’ana aya nere Nyasae, oyotoete Omoika buna ekebwaterero giantenenera.
english: Now it is God who has made us for this very purpose and has given us the Spirit as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

ekegusii: Gaki Nyasae oyotokong’irie amo nainwe ase Kristo; nere otochorete,
english: Now it is God who makes both us and you stand firm in Christ. He anointed us,

ekegusii: Bono omote oyio osimekirwe ase erooro, ense enyomo etari namache.
english: Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and thirsty land.

ekegusii: Agwo naende ayarigirie ase abarendi naro aya: banyorekane ng’a nabegenwa bare.
english: Now it is required that those who have been given a trust must prove faithful.

ekegusii: Nabo ase rituko rinene nigo anarete kobasiborera omosibwa oyomo, oyobarigetie.
english: Now it was the custom at the Feast to release a prisoner whom the people requested.

ekegusii: Igo riarenge rituko ri’Okwearigania, na Abayahudi tibarigetie emebere ebe ase emesalaba igoro ase rituko ri’Esabato, ekiagera Esabato eria nigo yarenge enene. Ase ayio bagasaba Pilato ng’a amagoro ’abanto abwo babambetwe abunwe, na emebere yabo erusigweo.
english: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the next day was to be a special Sabbath. Because the Jews did not want the bodies left on the crosses during the Sabbath, they asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies taken down.

ekegusii: Bono ekero kie rituko rinene nigo yarenge engencho ya gavuna kobasiborera omosibwa oyomo oyo barigetie.
english: Now it was the governor's custom at the Feast to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.

ekegusii: na tibare gokora buna abakuani bagwenerete gokora ase abanto. Ribaga ri’ayio, ekero omonto arure ekeng’wanso kiaye, omosomba bw’omokuani nigo arenge gocha abwate euma ere namaino atato, na ekero enyama egendererete koiyekwa,
english: Now it was the practice of the priests with the people that whenever anyone offered a sacrifice and while the meat was being boiled, the servant of the priest would come with a three-pronged fork in his hand.

ekegusii: Yakobo agatoma Yuda amotang’anere kogenda ase Yusufu, erinde aoroke ase obosio bwaye agwo Goseni, Naboigo bagaika ase ensemo ya Goseni.
english: Now Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When they arrived in the region of Goshen,

ekegusii: Abamura ba Yakobo, ekero bachia koigwa ayio, bagacha korwa getii, bakaigwa obororo, bakaba nekeririanda ekenene mono, ekiagera Sekemu akorete obokayayu ase Abaisraeli ase okorara nomoiseke o Yakobo, ring’ana ritagwenerete gokoreka.
english: Now Jacob's sons had come in from the fields as soon as they heard what had happened. They were filled with grief and fury, because Shechem had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter-- a thing that should not be done.

ekegusii: Now Jehoiada was old and full of years, and he died at the age of a hundred and thirty.
english: Yehoyada akaba omogotu mono, agakwa ekero akoorire emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato.

ekegusii: Yehosafati akaroisia chimeeri chia Tarisisi, chiarenge kogenda Ofiri korenta chitahabu, korende tichiagendete, ekiagera chiasarekerete agwo Esioni‐Geberi.
english: Now Jehoshaphat built a fleet of trading ships to go to Ophir for gold, but they never set sail-- they were wrecked at Ezion Geber.

ekegusii: Ekero Yehosafati abete omonda mono naende asikire, akanyuoma omokungu korwa ase enyomba y’Ahabu.
english: Now Jehoshaphat had great wealth and honor, and he allied himself with Ahab by marriage.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Yeremia nabwate ribaga ri’ogotaara egati y’abanto, ekiagera konya tarabekwa ase echela.
english: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people, for he had not yet been put in prison.

ekegusii: Ebiita bia Yeriko nigo biasiekire bokong’u ng’a Abaisraeli tibabaisa gosoa aroro. Onde tarenge gosoka gose gosoa imeo.
english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the Israelites. No one went out and no one came in.

ekegusii: Yeroboamu konya otomire abarwani baetanane na koumokera Abayuda korwa magega; igo abarwani baye b’esegi bakaba bosio bw’Abayuda na baria batometwe nigo barenge magega yabo.
english: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah the ambush was behind them.

ekegusii: Omonto oria Yeroboamu nigo arenge omonto ore nomokia mono, na ekero Sulemani amoroche ng’a nigo arenge omokong’u ase emeremo yaye, akamobeka akaba omoteneneri igoro ase emeremo eria abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu barenge kobetererigwa gokora.
english: Now Jeroboam was a man of standing, and when Solomon saw how well the young man did his work, he put him in charge of the whole labor force of the house of Joseph.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo Yese agatebia Daudi, omwana oye, “Imokia ebigara ebi bisambire, ebitonga bibere, oimokie nemegati eye ikomi ogende bwango, obiirere bamura bamino aaria ase egetwori.
english: Now Jesse said to his son David, "Take this ephah of roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread for your brothers and hurry to their camp.

ekegusii: Na Yeso konya taraika omochie ime, korende nigo arenge aase aria arototeretwe na Martha.
english: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.

ekegusii: Yeso nere ekero achagete kworokereria, emiaka yaye iga yarenge ang’e emerongo etato, agakagwa ng’a mosinto o Yusufu, o Eli,
english: Now Jesus himself was about thirty years old when he began his ministry. He was the son, so it was thought, of Joseph, the son of Heli,

ekegusii: Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo bakamochiera, korende tibanyara komoika ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda.
english: Now Jesus' mother and brothers came to see him, but they were not able to get near him because of the crowd.

ekegusii: Yetero, omokuani o Midiani, ise biara Musa, akaigwa amang’ana onsi aya Nyasae akoreire Musa na Abaisraeli, abanto baye, na buna Omonene abang’anyetie korwa Misiri.
english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian and father-in-law of Moses, heard of everything God had done for Moses and for his people Israel, and how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Yohana nere nigo arenge kobatisera aria Ainon, ang’e na Salimu, ekiagera amache amange narengeo. Abanto bakamochiera bakabatiswa.
english: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were constantly coming to be baptized.

ekegusii: Aborokigwa ba Yohana na Abafarisai nigo barenge kweng’ata. Abanto bande bagacha, bakamoboria, “Nase ki aborokigwa ba Yohana na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai bakweng’ata, ko aborokigwa bao tibari kweng’ata?”
english: Now John's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came and asked Jesus, "How is it that John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees are fasting, but yours are not?"

ekegusii: Yusufu agakwera aroro, na bamura bamwabo bonsi, na abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria.
english: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died,

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agachika omoteneneri bw’enka yaye, “Ichoria chigunia chi’abanto aba endagera, koreng’ana buna baranyare kobogoria, obeke ne chibesa chia kera omonto igoro y’endagera ase egunia yaye ime.
english: Now Joseph gave these instructions to the steward of his house: "Fill the men's sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each man's silver in the mouth of his sack.

ekegusii: Bono Yusufu agatirimbokigwa gochia Misiri; na Potifari, omoteneneri bw’enka ya Farao na omotang’ani bw’abarendi baye bande, omonto o Misiri, akamogora korwa ase Abaisumaeli, abwo bamotirimbogetie gochia aroro.
english: Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt. Potiphar, an Egyptian who was one of Pharaoh's officials, the captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.

ekegusii: Yusufu nere orenge gavuna igoro y’ense yonsi ya Misiri, naende nere orenge kooneria abanto bonsi b’ense eria endagera. Na abamwabo Yusufu, ekero baigete asare, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.
english: Now Joseph was the governor of the land, the one who sold grain to all its people. So when Joseph's brothers arrived, they bowed down to him with their faces to the ground.

ekegusii: Yoshua agatoma abanto korwa Yeriko gochia Ai, omochie ore moocha ya Beteli, ang’e na Beti‐Aveni, bagende baroote ense eria. Erio bagatiira kogenda koroota Ai.
english: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth Aven to the east of Bethel, and told them, "Go up and spy out the region." So the men went up and spied out Ai.

ekegusii: Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, nigo aichire nomoika bw’obong’aini, ekiagera Musa konya omobekeire amaboko aye na Abaisraeli bakaba bakomoigwera, bagakora buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: Now Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him. So the Israelites listened to him and did what the LORD had commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Bono Yoshua nigo ateneine ase obosio bw’omomalaika, obegete chianga chire ne riko.
english: Now Joshua was dressed in filthy clothes as he stood before the angel.

ekegusii: Na Yudas, oria omoruete naamanyete aase aria, ekiagera Yeso are kogenda aroro ekero ase ekero amo naborokigwa baye.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with his disciples.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bono ita kera omwana omomura, na moite kera omokungu obeire nomosacha.
english: Now kill all the boys. And kill every woman who has slept with a man,

ekegusii: Daudi agatebigwa ng’a, ase engencho y’Esanduku eria ya Nyasae Omonene osesenirie abanto b’enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, amo nebinto bionsi abwate. Erio akagenda akoyia Esanduku eria korwa ase enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, akayerenta ase omochie oye ore nomochengo omonene.
english: Now King David was told, "The LORD has blessed the household of Obed-Edom and everything he has, because of the ark of God." So David went down and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom to the City of David with rejoicing.

ekegusii: Bono Labani nigo abwate abaiseke babere; omoiseke oria omonene nigo are korokwa Lea, na oria omoke Raeli.
english: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

ekegusii: Bono irana gochia bwoo. Inche igo narengereretie gokoa ogosika okonene, korende Omonene okorinire, tonyora ogosikwa okwo.”
english: Now leave at once and go home! I said I would reward you handsomely, but the LORD has kept you from being rewarded."

ekegusii: Bono tiga endamwamu yane yoke igoro asebare, erinde mbasirie, erio ngokore aye obe egesaku ekenene.”
english: Now leave me alone so that my anger may burn against them and that I may destroy them. Then I will make you into a great nation."

ekegusii: Bono aye omoruoti, omonene one, igwa amang’ana aane, inche omosomba oo. Onye n’Omonene ogoseegetire ondigia ase ogonsiria, rirorio tiga anchere ekeng’wanso ekio, korende onye nabanto bakogoseegeta igoro asende, rirorio Omonene abaragererie, ekiagera rero iga banseririe ng’a tinyora omwando korwa ase Omonene, bagantebia: Genda okorere chinyasae ching’ao.
english: Now let my lord the king listen to his servant's words. If the LORD has incited you against me, then may he accept an offering. If, however, men have done it, may they be cursed before the LORD! They have now driven me from my share in the LORD's inheritance and have said, 'Go, serve other gods.'

ekegusii: Bono moiroke Omonene. Mwerende na momanye eki mogokora, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oito, tari koonchorana oboronge, gose tari gwanchereria abanto, gose tari koegwa riaaki.”
english: Now let the fear of the LORD be upon you. Judge carefully, for with the LORD our God there is no injustice or partiality or bribery."

ekegusii: Tiga barusie korwa asende obonyaka bwabo bw’ogosasima emegwekano, na emebere ekwete y’abaruoti babo, erio nario ndamenye ase egati yabo kogenderera botambe.
english: Now let them put away from me their prostitution and the lifeless idols of their kings, and I will live among them forever.

ekegusii: Bono tokore okobwatana kw’ogotianania na Nyasae oito, erinde toserie abakungu abwo bonsi amo nabana babo. Tokore igo ase okobwatia ogosemia kwao, aye omonene one, na okw’abanto abwo babeire nobwoba na koiguswa ase engencho y’amachiko a Nyasae oito. Tiga ring’ana erio rikorwe koreng’ana namachiko.
english: Now let us make a covenant before our God to send away all these women and their children, in accordance with the counsel of my lord and of those who fear the commands of our God. Let it be done according to the Law.

ekegusii: Bono inyigwere, irania abanto abwo mwosete korwa ase abanto bamino, ekiagera endamwamu entindi y’Omonene nigo ere igoro yaino.”
english: Now listen to me! Send back your fellow countrymen you have taken as prisoners, for the LORD's fierce anger rests on you."

ekegusii: Gaki bono, igwera amang’ana abo, korende obakurere mono, obatebie aya omoruoti orache kobagambera arabe ogokora.”
english: Now listen to them; but warn them solemnly and let them know what the king who will reign over them will do."

ekegusii: Igwa bono, abamore abanda, rera na goaka egeturi ase engencho y’emechando yaino eyekobachera.
english: Now listen, you rich people, weep and wail because of the misery that is coming upon you.

ekegusii: Now listen, you who say, "Today or tomorrow we will go to this or that city, spend a year there, carry on business and make money."
english: Igwa bono inwe abamogoteba, “Rero gose ankio inatogende omochie gete, na tobeere aroro omwaka omogima na kogora, na koonia, na konyora ebitoki.”

ekegusii: Na Loti, nere oyogendete amo n’Aburamu, nigo abwate ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chiema.
english: Now Lot, who was moving about with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.

ekegusii: Gaki bono oorokia okomocha okwo ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, naende mokore ogwancha kwaye. Mweatanane korwa ase abanto b’ense eye na motige abakungu abwo b’ebisaku ebiao.”
english: Now make confession to the LORD, the God of your fathers, and do his will. Separate yourselves from the peoples around you and from your foreign wives."

ekegusii: Bono Nyasae Tata oito omonyene, na Omonene oito Yeso atotang’ane ase enchera yaito, toike seino.
english: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus clear the way for us to come to you.

ekegusii: Bono Omonene bw’omorembe omonyene abae omorembe ase chingaki chionsi, na ase chinchera chionsi. Omonene abe amo nainwe mwensi.
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

ekegusii: Bono Mesha, omoruoti o Moabu, nigo arenge omotugi bwe ching’ondi, na kera omwaka nigo arenge korua ebango ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, chimanwa chie ching’ondi chilifu rigana erimo (100,000), naende amarionya e chimingichi chilifu rigana erimo (100,000).
english: Now Mesha king of Moab raised sheep, and he had to supply the king of Israel with a hundred thousand lambs and with the wool of a hundred thousand rams.

ekegusii: Musa agakwana na Hobabu, mosinto o Reueli Omomidiani, akamotebia, “Intwe nkogenda tore aase aaria ase Omonene atotebetie ng’a natoe. Inchuo ogende amo naintwe, na intwe natogokorere amaya, ekiagera Omonene orire eira ng’a nasesenie Abaisraeli.”
english: Now Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place about which the LORD said, 'I will give it to you.' Come with us and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel."

ekegusii: Musa nigo anarete koira eema na koyetenenia are ake korwa ase egetwori akayeroka “Eema y’Omosangererekano.” Na onde bwensi oganetie koboria Omonene ring’ana, goika agende ase Eema eria, isiko y’egetwori.
english: Now Moses used to take a tent and pitch it outside the camp some distance away, calling it the "tent of meeting." Anyone inquiring of the LORD would go to the tent of meeting outside the camp.

ekegusii: Musa nigo arenge korisia riicho ria Yetero ise biara, omokuani o Midiani, akariraa gochia bosongo y’erooro, agaika Horebu, egetunwa kia Nyasae.
english: Now Moses was tending the flock of Jethro his father-in-law, the priest of Midian, and he led the flock to the far side of the desert and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.

ekegusii: “Gaki bono sangereria abanto abwo batigarete oetanane omochie, aye omonyene oyoire, inche timbaisa koyoira na igo orokwe ase erieta riane.”
english: Now muster the rest of the troops and besiege the city and capture it. Otherwise I will take the city, and it will be named after me."

ekegusii: Bono amaiso aane narigererie, na amato aane nategerere aigwe ogosaba kogosabwa aase aiga.
english: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to the prayers offered in this place.

ekegusii: Naamani, omochiki bw’abarwani esegi b’omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, nigo arenge omonto bw’engencho enene ase obosio bw’omonene oye, na omonene oye nigo amosigete mono, ekiagera ase engencho ya Naamani Omonene aete Abasiiria obobui. Ere nigo arenge omonto etuoni y’esegi, korende oborwaire bwa ukoma mbwamoriete.
english: Now Naaman was commander of the army of the king of Aram. He was a great man in the sight of his master and highly regarded, because through him the LORD had given victory to Aram. He was a valiant soldier, but he had leprosy.

ekegusii: Naomi nabwate omoam ate oyomo ore korokwa Boazi, omonto bw’eamate y’Elimeleki, omosacha oye. Ere nigo arenge omonto omonene, naende omonda.
english: Now Naomi had a relative on her husband's side, from the clan of Elimelech, a man of standing, whose name was Boaz.

ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, agachika Nebusaradani, omochiki bw’abarendi, igoro ya Yeremia, akamotebia,
english: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had given these orders about Jeremiah through Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard:

ekegusii: “Abanto tibakonyara korigereria amasase ’erioba, kabarire igoro ekero amare abusirwe nomwaga.
english: Now no one can look at the sun, bright as it is in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.

ekegusii: Ase enchera ekogenda Yerusalemu Yeso ngoeta arenge egati ya Samaria na Galili.
english: Now on his way to Jerusalem, Jesus traveled along the border between Samaria and Galilee.

ekegusii: Bono ase rituko erio omonto oyomo bw’Edomu, okorokwa Doegi, nao arenge ase obosio bw’Omonene osiekeireo. Ere nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’abarisia ba Saulo.
english: Now one of Saul's servants was there that day, detained before the LORD; he was Doeg the Edomite, Saul's head shepherd.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’Abafarisai akamogania ache koria endagera amo nere. Agasoa ase enyomba y’Omofarisai oria, agaikaransa ase endagera.
english: Now one of the Pharisees invited Jesus to have dinner with him, so he went to the Pharisee's house and reclined at the table.

ekegusii: Bono Petero nigo aikaransete egoora isiko. Omoiseke oyomo akamochiera, akabora, “Aye naye kwarenge amo na Yeso Omogalili.”
english: Now Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came to him. "You also were with Jesus of Galilee," she said.

ekegusii: Gaki bono koranche inyigwe inche omosomba oo omokungu, tiga nkorentere endagera orie, erinde onyore chinguru, ogenderere norogendo rwao.”
english: Now please listen to your servant and let me give you some food so you may eat and have the strength to go on your way."

ekegusii: Korende Raeli konya obisire ebinyasae ebio ase egeikaransero kiaye igoro y’engamia, akaba obiikaranserete. Labani akariga‐rigia eema ime, tabinyora.
english: Now Rachel had taken the household gods and put them inside her camel's saddle and was sitting on them. Laban searched through everything in the tent but found nothing.

ekegusii: Rebeka nabwate momura omwabo ore korokwa Labani. Ekero Labani aroche ekegera na ebitange ase amaboko ’omoiseke omwabo, na kaigure amang’ana omonto oria atebetie Rebeka, agasoka, akaminyoka gochia ase ensoko ase omonto oria arenge, akamorora oteneine ase chingamia chiaye,
english: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring.

ekegusii: Bono Rebeka nigo arenge otegererete ekero Isaka are gokwana nomwana oye Esau. Ase igo, ekero Esau agendete borabu gotwara ching’iti amorentere ise,
english: Now Rebekah was listening as Isaac spoke to his son Esau. When Esau left for the open country to hunt game and bring it back,

ekegusii: Rekabu na Baana, basinto ba Rimoni Omobeeroti, bagachaka orogendo rwabo, na ekero kia mobaso gati bagaika ase enyomba ya Isi‐Boseti, bakamonyora otimogete nyomba mwaye okendererete.
english: Now Recab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, set out for the house of Ish-Bosheth, and they arrived there in the heat of the day while he was taking his noonday rest.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, onchora chinchera chiaino, na ogokora kwaino, momoigwere Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere natige tarenta igoro asemore amabe ayio konya akwanire.
english: Now reform your ways and your actions and obey the LORD your God. Then the LORD will relent and not bring the disaster he has pronounced against you.

ekegusii: Bono moiranerie omonto oria mokaye, ekiagera ere nomobani, nagosabere onyare koba moyo. Korende otamoiranereti, manya amaene, goika okwe, aye amo na abanto bao bonsi ore nabarabwo.”
english: Now return the man's wife, for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not return her, you may be sure that you and all yours will die."

ekegusii: Bono Samweli konya taramanyereria eriogi ri’Omonene, ne ring’ana ri’Omonene konya tiriraorokigwa asare.
english: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD: The word of the LORD had not yet been revealed to him.

ekegusii: Samweli agakwa, na Abaisraeli bagasangererekana, bakagenda komoreera; bakamotindeka ase enka yaye agwo Rama. Erio Daudi akaimoka, agatirimboka gochia ase erooro ya Parani.
english: Now Samuel died, and all Israel assembled and mourned for him; and they buried him at his home in Ramah. Then David moved down into the Desert of Maon.

ekegusii: Bono Samweli konya okure, na Abaisraeli bonsi konya bamoreereire, bamotindekire ase omochie oye Rama. Boigo Saulo konya oseririe abanto barenge koboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakure, amo nabaringoria bonsi.
english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel had mourned for him and buried him in his own town of Ramah. Saul had expelled the mediums and spiritists from the land.

ekegusii: Korende Sarai nigo arenge omogomba, tabwate mwana.
english: Now Sarai was barren; she had no children.

ekegusii: Bono Sarai, moka Aburamu, tamoiborerete bana. Ere narenge nomoiseke omosomba Omomisiri, ore korokwa Hagari.
english: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, had borne him no children. But she had an Egyptian maidservant named Hagar;

ekegusii: Saulo nabwate omokungu o sere‐sere ore korokwa Risipa, mosubati bw’Aya. Isi‐Boseti akaboria Abineri, “Nase ki mwamenyanire nomokungu o sere‐sere o tata?”
english: Now Saul had had a concubine named Rizpah daughter of Aiah. And Ish-Bosheth said to Abner, "Why did you sleep with my father's concubine?"

ekegusii: Rituko erimo Saulo nigo aikaransete inse y’omote onga buna ekerachuoki ase ekegoro agwo Gibea, obwate ritimo ase okoboko kwaye, na abasomba baye nigo bateneine bamoetanaine. Erio agatebigwa ng’a Daudi amo nabanto barenge komo barorekanire.
english: Now Saul heard that David and his men had been discovered. And Saul, spear in hand, was seated under the tamarisk tree on the hill at Gibeah, with all his officials standing around him.

ekegusii: Now Saul's daughter Michal was in love with David, and when they told Saul about it, he was pleased.
english: Mikali, omoiseke o Saulo, agancha Daudi, na ekero Saulo aigwete amang’ana ayio akagokigwa mono.

ekegusii: Mosinto oria o Saulo nabwate abanto babere abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi, abarenge abasakori. Oyomo nigo are korokwa Baana, na oria onde Rekabu. Barabwo nigo barenge basinto ba Rimoni o Beeroti, omochie bw’orogongo rwa Benjamin. (Beeroti nigo obaretwe koba bw’orogongo rwa Benjamin.)
english: Now Saul's son had two men who were leaders of raiding bands. One was named Baanah and the other Recab; they were sons of Rimmon the Beerothite from the tribe of Benjamin-- Beeroth is considered part of Benjamin,

ekegusii: Ise moke Saulo akaboria Saulo na omosomba oye, “Ng’ai mwachiete?” Saulo akairaneria, “Nechitigere twagendete korigia, na ekero totachinyorete, tokagenda ase Samweli.”
english: Now Saul's uncle asked him and his servant, "Where have you been?" "Looking for the donkeys," he said. "But when we saw they were not to be found, we went to Samuel."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, bwerite, tobaisa konywa edivai, gose ebinyugwa ebigotindia, na tobaisa koria endagera ende yonsi ere etachenegeti,
english: Now see to it that you drink no wine or other fermented drink and that you do not eat anything unclean,

ekegusii: Bono toma amang’ana bwango, mokurere Daudi ng’a tabaisa korara ase obotuko obo ase ebiambokero agwo ase erooro, korende goika amboke orooche, erinde tabaisa gosirigwa amo nabanto baye bonsi.”
english: Now send a message immediately and tell David, 'Do not spend the night at the fords in the desert; cross over without fail, or the king and all the people with him will be swallowed up.'"

ekegusii: Gaki bono toma abanto Yopa barangerie Simion, oyokorokwa Petero.
english: Now send men to Joppa to bring back a man named Simon who is called Peter.

ekegusii: Na ekero omoruoti bw’Abaasuri aigwete amang’ana ng’a Tirihaka, omoruoti bw’Abaetiopia, ochire korwana esegi nere, agatoma abanto ase Hezekia naende, akabatebia,
english: Now Sennacherib received a report that Tirhakah, the Cushite king [of Egypt], was marching out to fight against him. So he again sent messengers to Hezekiah with this word:
