ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kae omoruoti oo gwachorire obobui; otoiranerie ekero togokorangeria!
english: O LORD, save the king! Answer us when we call!

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, twagosabire ototoorie! Omonene, twagosoroire, tiga abe buya asetore!
english: O LORD, save us; O LORD, grant us success.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene ndorere amabera! Rigereria orore emechando eye abanto bangechete bakondetera. Aye kwandusirie korwa ase ebiita bi’amakweri,
english: O LORD, see how my enemies persecute me! Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,

ekegusii: Aye Omonene Nyasae ogoakana egesiomba, aye Nyasae ogoakana egesiomba, oorokia oborabu bwao.
english: O LORD, the God who avenges, O God who avenges, shine forth.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene ore ogosemeria kw’Abaisraeli, abanto abwo bagotigire nigo banyorire obosooku; ee, abwo baonchokire na kogotiga nigo barasire buna ririko ririkire ase riroba, ekiagera bagotigire aye Omonene ore ensoko y’amache are moyo.
english: O LORD, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you will be put to shame. Those who turn away from you will be written in the dust because they have forsaken the LORD, the spring of living water.

ekegusii: Omonene, inche nigo inde omosomba oo; nigo inde omosomba oo, omwana bw’omokungu ore omosomba oo. Aye gwasiboire chingataare chiansibete.
english: O LORD, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of your maidservant; you have freed me from my chains.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, twamanyire obobe bwaito na ebibe bie chisokoro chiaito, twakorire ebibe asore.
english: O LORD, we acknowledge our wickedness and the guilt of our fathers; we have indeed sinned against you.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obosooku nigo bore asetore, na ase abaruoti baito, na ase abagambi baito, na ase chisokoro chiaito, ekiagera twakorire ebibe asore.
english: O LORD, we and our kings, our princes and our fathers are covered with shame because we have sinned against you.

ekegusii: Omonene, inki ndakwane bono, ekero Abaisraeli batamire korwa ase ababisa babo?
english: O Lord, what can I say, now that Israel has been routed by its enemies?

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, omonto ninki aisaine goika okomwechandera, gose mwanyabanto ninki are, aye okomorengereria?
english: O LORD, what is man that you care for him, the son of man that you think of him?

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase engencho y’obuya bwao ogakora egetunwa kiane kegatenena bokong’u, korende ekero kwabisete obosio bwao nkaba nobwoba.
english: O LORD, when you favored me, you made my mountain stand firm; but when you hid your face, I was dismayed.

ekegusii: Omonene, ng’ai obwanchani bwao bwa kare na kare bore, obwo ase obwegenwa bwao kwarierete Daudi eira?
english: O Lord, where is your former great love, which in your faithfulness you swore to David?

ekegusii: Na bono, aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae, kwandiereire inche, omosomba oo, eira gonkorera ring’ana eri rigiya.
english: O LORD, you are God! You have promised these good things to your servant.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naye Nyasae one; ninkoimokererie igoro, nintogie erieta riao; aye gwakorire amang’ana ’ogokumia emeroberio yao korwa kare nigo ere ey’obwegenwa na ekeene.
english: O LORD, you are my God; I will exalt you and praise your name, for in perfect faithfulness you have done marvelous things, things planned long ago.

ekegusii: Omonene, gwatooririe omoyo one korwa aase abakure, kwang’iraneirie obogima tingenda ase oboina ime.
english: O LORD, you brought me up from the grave; you spared me from going down into the pit.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo kwang’ebereretie, okambua, na inche nkeeberereka. Igo ore ne chinguru kombua. Aye kwambuire. Abanto nigo bagonsekerera ase rituko rigima; kera omonto nigo agonchecheria.
english: O LORD, you deceived; me, and I was deceived you overpowered me and prevailed. I am ridiculed all day long; everyone mocks me.

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, noigwete okorama kwabo, na emeroberio yabo yonsi igoro yane.
english: O LORD, you have heard their insults, all their plots against me--

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, kwarorire amang’ana ayio, tokira‐kiri. Omonene, tobaisa kobeera aare korwa asende!
english: O LORD, you have seen this; be not silent. Do not be far from me, O Lord.

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, kwarwanereire omoyo one na gwatooririe obogima bwane.
english: O Lord, you took up my case; you redeemed my life.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otorende! Otokengere botambe korwa ase obobe bw’ekegori eke.
english: O LORD, you will keep us safe and protect us from such people forever.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwaramboire okoboko kwao, korende barabwo tibagokorora. Tiga barore risemi obwate ase abanto bao, erinde basooke; omorero osambete ababisa bao, tiga obasambe nabarabwo.
english: O LORD, your hand is lifted high, but they do not see it. Let them see your zeal for your people and be put to shame; let the fire reserved for your enemies consume them.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase engencho yane inche, omosomba oo, na koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao aye omonyene, gwakorire amanene aya onsi, naende kwayakorire amanyekanire.
english: O LORD. For the sake of your servant and according to your will, you have done this great thing and made known all these great promises.

ekegusii: Obororo bwane nobonene mono, tibokogwenigwa. Narwarire ase enkoro yane ime.
english: O my Comforter in sorrow, my heart is faint within me.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one! Nigo nkorera ase omobaso, korende tori kong’iraneria; nase obotuko boigo, korende tindi konyora ogotimoka.
english: O my God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, by night, and am not silent.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, aba mwaoorirwe ase ekeooreri buna obori na koirurwa, amang’ana naigure korwa ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, naro nkobarareria.
english: O my people, crushed on the threshing floor, I tell you what I have heard from the LORD Almighty, from the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, eboyie chigunia, egara‐garie ase ribu, morere na kobokia amagombo buna omonto okoreera omwana oye omomoima okure. Morere mono, ekiagera oria ogosiria nigo aratochere mobosokano.
english: O my people, put on sackcloth and roll in ashes; mourn with bitter wailing as for an only son, for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us.

ekegusii: O my Strength, I sing praise to you; you, O God, are my fortress, my loving God.
english: Aye Nyasae ore chinguru chiane, nintere ogotera gw’okogotogia; aye naye egekengero kiane, aye naye Nyasae onyanchete mono.

ekegusii: O my Strength, I watch for you; you, O God, are my fortress,
english: Aye Nyasae ore chinguru chiane, nimbe nkoganyete, ekiagera naye ore obotamero obokong’u.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae oito, tigwaseretie abanto ababiare b’ense eye ase amasio ’abanto bao Abaisraeli, okayea ororeria rwa Ibrahimu, omosani oo, ense eye ekaba eyabo kogenderera botambe?
english: O our God, did you not drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel and give it forever to the descendants of Abraham your friend?

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae oito, Inee, aye tokobanachera ekina? Intwe titobwati chinguru chi’okorwana nomoganda oyo omonene, ogocha gotorwania. Titomanyeti eki togokora, korende nigo tokorigereretie aye ase okonyora ogokonyeka.”
english: O our God, will you not judge them? For we have no power to face this vast army that is attacking us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are upon you."

ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete Sayoni agwo Yerusalemu, timokogenderera korera naende. Ekeene, Omonene nabakorere amaya ekero mokorera asare; ekero araigwe eriogi ri’okorera kwaino nabairanerie.
english: O people of Zion, who live in Jerusalem, you will weep no more. How gracious he will be when you cry for help! As soon as he hears, he will answer you.

ekegusii: Tiga ebibe bi’abakori amabe biere, korende omonto omoronge omotenenie bokong’u. Aye Nyasae omonyene oboronge nigo okorenga chinkoro na emioyo.
english: O righteous God, who searches minds and hearts, bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Omonene one, Omotooria one omokong’u, aye nigo ogotuba omotwe one ase engaki y’esegi.
english: O Sovereign LORD, my strong deliverer, who shields my head in the day of battle--

ekegusii: “Na bono, aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae, na amang’ana ao naro ekeene, na kwandiereire inche, omosomba oo, eira ng’a onkorere ring’ana eri rigiya.
english: O Sovereign LORD, you are God! Your words are trustworthy, and you have promised these good things to your servant.

ekegusii: Ebeke ang’e oetere, orenge ensemo ya borio na eya bomosi, aande onsi ase obwoge bochigete.
english: O sword, slash to the right, then to the left, wherever your blade is turned.

ekegusii: Aye omochie oichire neburu‐buru na okwogana, aye ore nomochengo bw’obobe, abanto bao abaitirwe tibaitiri nemioro, gose tibakweti ase esegi.
english: O town full of commotion, O city of tumult and revelry? Your slain were not killed by the sword, nor did they die in battle.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okoigwa ogosaba, ase ayio abanto bonsi mbache asore.
english: O you who hear prayer, to you all men will come.

ekegusii: Obadia, mosinto o Semaya o Galali, o Yedutuni; na Berekia, mosinto bw’Asa bw’Elikana, oyomenyete ase emechie y’Abanetofa.
english: Obadiah son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berekiah son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

ekegusii: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
english: na Obali, na Abimaeli, na Seba,

ekegusii: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
english: Ebali na Abimaeli, na Seba;

ekegusii: Obed the father of Jehu, Jehu the father of Azariah,
english: Obedi akaibora Yehu, na Yehu akaibora Asaria;

ekegusii: Obed the father of Jesse, and Jesse the father of David.
english: Obedi akaibora Yese, na Yese akaibora Daudi.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Obedi‐Edomu nabwo aba: Semaya omwana oye omotangi; Yehosabadi oyo o kabere; Yoa oyo o gatato; Sakari oyo o kane; Netaneli oyo o gatano;
english: Obed-Edom also had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

ekegusii: Inche nigo nkogosemia: Oigwere amang’ana omoruoti achikire, ekiagera nkwarierete Nyasae eira.
english: Obey the king's command, I say, because you took an oath before God.

ekegusii: Ase ayio moigwere Omonene, Nyasae oino, mobwate amachiko aye, na emeroberio yaye echikire, ayio inche nkobaa rituko ria rero.”
english: Obey the LORD your God and follow his commands and decrees that I give you today."

ekegusii: gose tari ase obosomba bw’okwegwenia ase amaiso a mwanyabanto, korende buna abasomba ba Kristo, mogokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae ase chinkoro chiaino;
english: Obey them not only to win their favor when their eye is on you, but like slaves of Christ, doing the will of God from your heart.

ekegusii: Obwate amachiko ayio ndakoe rero. Norore ase obosio bwao ngoseria Abaamori, na Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.
english: Obey what I command you today. I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

ekegusii: Moigwere abwo bakobatang’ana, na mobasike, ekiagera barabwo nigo barendete emioyo yaino buna abanto barache korua omobaro, erinde banyare gokora ayio ase omogoko. Onye bagocha koyakora ase okweumia anga taba na gokonywa konde asemore.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to their authority. They keep watch over you as men who must give an account. Obey them so that their work will be a joy, not a burden, for that would be of no advantage to you.

ekegusii: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels. Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.
english: Obili Omoisumaeli agatenenera chingamia, na Yedaya Omomeroni agatenenera chitigere, na

ekegusii: Ase ayio mobwate amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase ogotaara ase chinchera chiaye na komoiroka.
english: Observe the commands of the LORD your God, walking in his ways and revering him.

ekegusii: “Mobe mokorenda Epasaka y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase omotienyi bw’Abibu, ekiagera ase obotuko obomo bw’omotienyi oyio, nario Omonene, Nyasae oino abarusetie Misiri.
english: Observe the month of Abib and celebrate the Passover of the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib he brought you out of Egypt by night.

ekegusii: Moyabwate na koyaigwera, ekiagera aro naro arorokererie abanto b’ebisaku binde ng’a more nobong’aini. Barabwo kobaraigwe amachiko aya onsi mbatebe: Ekeene, abanto b’egesaku eke ekenene nigo bare abang’aini, naende abamanyi!
english: Observe them carefully, for this will show your wisdom and understanding to the nations, who will hear about all these decrees and say, "Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people."

ekegusii: “Mobwate amachiko onsi ayio inche nkobaa rituko ria rero; erio nario morabe ne chinguru, erinde mosoe ase ense eria mogochia koira, ebe eyaino,
english: Observe therefore all the commands I am giving you today, so that you may have the strength to go in and take over the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

ekegusii: Sikiri ase eamate y’Abiya, na Pilitai ase eamate ya Miniamini, na eya Moadiya;
english: of Abijah's, Zicri; of Miniamin's and of Moadiah's, Piltai;

ekegusii: Omonene ong’eire abamura abange, na ase abwo bonsi ochorire Sulemani aikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli abwo Omonene akogambera.
english: Of all my sons-- and the LORD has given me many-- he has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

ekegusii: Ching’iti chiria chikogendera ebisonsogoro ase echio chibwate amagoro ane tichichenegeti asemore. Monto onde bwensi orakune echikwete ase echio nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: Of all the animals that walk on all fours, those that walk on their paws are unclean for you; whoever touches their carcasses will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: “Ase echio chionsi chire ase amache ime monyare koria chinswe chibwate chingondo chinga buna chimbaba, na amagoocho.
english: Of all the creatures living in the water, you may eat any that has fins and scales.

ekegusii: Narure Abalawi babe ekeegwa ase Haroni na abamura baye korwa ase Abaisraeli, erinde bakore emeremo ase engencho y’Abaisraeli, agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Boigo bakore okobwatanigwa asebare, erinde nintange amaakwa tabanyora ekero bagoika ang’e n’Aase Aachenu.”
english: Of all the Israelites, I have given the Levites as gifts to Aaron and his sons to do the work at the Tent of Meeting on behalf of the Israelites and to make atonement for them so that no plague will strike the Israelites when they go near the sanctuary."

ekegusii: Ase abamura bonsi aiborete onde tari okomoraa, ase abwo arerete, onde tari okomobwata okoboko.
english: Of all the sons she bore there was none to guide her; of all the sons she reared there was none to take her by the hand.

ekegusii: Ase ching’iti echio chinke echio nchibe chitachenegeti asemore. Monto onde bwensi orachikune ekero chiakure nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: Of all those that move along the ground, these are unclean for you. Whoever touches them when they are dead will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: of Ater (through Hezekiah) 98
english: aba orw’Ateri b’eamate ya Hezekia: emerongo kianda, na batano na batato (98);

ekegusii: abanto b’Asimaweti: emerongo ene, na babere (42);
english: of Azmaveth 42

ekegusii: abanto ba Beti-Asimaweti; emerongo ene, na babere (42);
english: of Beth Azmaveth 42

ekegusii: abanto ba Beteli na Ai: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batato (123);
english: of Bethel and Ai 123

ekegusii: abanto ba Beteli na Ai: amagana abere, na emerongo ebere, na batato (223);
english: of Bethel and Ai 223

ekegusii: Samua ase eamate ya Biliga, na Yehonathani ase eamate ya Semaya;
english: of Bilgah's, Shammua; of Shemaiah's, Jehonathan;

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Nasesenirie omonto oyo bwabeirwe ogosaria kwaye, na ebibe biaye biatubirwe.
english: Of David. A maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

ekegusii: (Ogosaba gwa Daudi) Nintere igoro y’amabera ao na oboronge bwao; ningoterere aye Omonene.
english: Of David. A psalm. I will sing of your love and justice; to you, O LORD, I will sing praise.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Ense na ebinto bire aroro nebi’Omonene; oboiko bwonsi nobwaye, amo nabanto bamenyeteo.
english: Of David. A psalm. The earth is the LORD's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Omonene agatebia Omonene one, “Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.”
english: Of David. A psalm. The LORD says to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet."

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, engereria abanto abwo bakoengererania nainche, rwania abwo bakondwania!
english: Of David. Contend, O LORD, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Togechigwa ase engencho y’abakori amabe, toba ne ribero ase abakori amabe.
english: Of David. Do not fret because of evil men or be envious of those who do wrong;

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, nigo nkogoakera ng’a mbuya mono nenkoro yane yonsi, ningoterere na kogotogia ase obosio bwe chinyasae.
english: Of David. I will praise you, O LORD, with all my heart; before the "gods" I will sing your praise.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Atogigwe Omonene, oyore egetare kiane; bworokereirie amaboko aane amanye korwana esegi, ne ebiara bimanye korwana.
english: Of David. Praise be to the LORD my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, na bionsi ebire ime yane bitogie erieta riaye richenu.
english: Of David. Praise the LORD, O my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Omonene nere omobaso one, na ogotooreka kwane, ning’o ndanyare koiroka? Omonene nere eburi ekengerete obogima bwane, monto ki ndanyare kwoboa?
english: Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation-- whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life-- of whom shall I be afraid?

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, egetare kiane, naye nkorangeria, tibwanga konyigwa. Oise gokira, inche nigo ndabe oyomo bw’abakogenda ase chimbeera.
english: Of David. To you I call, O LORD my Rock; do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you remain silent, I will be like those who have gone down to the pit.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ngocha nde asore nomoyo one bwonsi.
english: Of David. To you, O LORD, I lift up my soul;

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Aye Omonene, ing’a oboronge bwane; ekiagera nabeire ntari na komocha; naboigo ngosemeretie aye Omonene ntari ne chitang’u‐tang’u.
english: Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD, for I have led a blameless life; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Daudi) Nimbake Omonene chingaki chionsi, ase omonwa one nimotogie botambe.
english: Of David. When he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he left. I will extol the LORD at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.

ekegusii: Mesulamu ase eamate y’Ezara, na Yehohanani ase eamate y’Amaria;
english: of Ezra's, Meshullam; of Amariah's, Jehohanan;

ekegusii: Of Gershon: Libni his son, Jehath his son, Zimmah his son,
english: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Gerisomu: Libini omomura oye, na Yahati omomura oye, na Sima omomura oye,

ekegusii: of Gibbar 95
english: aba orwa Gibari: emerongo kianda, na batano (95).

ekegusii: of Gibeon 95
english: aba orwa Gibeoni: emerongo kianda, na batano (95).

ekegusii: of Harim 1,017
english: aba orwa Harimu: elifu eyemo, na ikomi na batano na babere (1,017);

ekegusii: of Harim 1,017
english: aba orwa Harimu: elifu eyemo, na ikomi na batano na babere (1,017).

ekegusii: Adina ase eamate ya Harimu, na Helikai ase eamate ya Merayoti;
english: of Harim's, Adna; of Meremoth's, Helkai;

ekegusii: of Hariph 112
english: aba orwa Harifu: rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112);

ekegusii: Hasabia ase eamate ya Hilikia, na Netaneli ase eamate ya Yedaya.
english: of Hilkiah's, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah's, Nethanel.

ekegusii: Zakaria ase eamate ya Ido, na Mesulamu ase eamate ya Ginetoni;
english: of Iddo's, Zechariah; of Ginnethon's, Meshullam;

ekegusii: of Immer 1,052
english: aba orwa Imeri: elifu eyemo, na emerongo etano, na babere (1,052);

ekegusii: of Immer 1,052
english: aba orwa Imeri: elifu eyemo, na emerongo etano, na babere (1,052).

ekegusii: Matenai ase eamate ya Yoyaribu, na Usi ase eamate ya Yedaya;
english: of Joiarib's, Mattenai; of Jedaiah's, Uzzi;

ekegusii: of Jorah 112
english: aba orwa Yora: rigana erimo, na ikomi na babere (112);

ekegusii: abanto ba Kiriati‐Arimu, na Kefira, na Beroti: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ene, na batato (743);
english: of Kiriath Jearim, Kephirah and Beeroth 743

ekegusii: abanto ba Kiriati-Yearimu, na Kefira, na Beeroti: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ene, na batato (743);
english: of Kiriath Jearim, Kephirah and Beeroth 743

ekegusii: abanto ba Lodi, na Hadidi, na Ono: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ebere, na oyomo (721);
english: of Lod, Hadid and Ono 721

ekegusii: abanto ba Lodi, na Hadidi, na Ono: amagana atano na abere, na emerongo ebere, na batano (725);
english: of Lod, Hadid and Ono 725

ekegusii: Yonathani ase eamate ya Maluki, na Yosefu ase eamate ya Sebania;
english: of Malluch's, Jonathan; of Shecaniah's, Joseph;

ekegusii: Abanto baane nigo bakorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase ekeengwe ki’omote, na enyimbo yabo nigo ekobaorokeria aya baganetie komanya. Omoika bw’obotomani obasiririe, barabwo batigire Nyasae obo bachiire gotayaya.
english: of my people. They consult a wooden idol and are answered by a stick of wood. A spirit of prostitution leads them astray; they are unfaithful to their God.

ekegusii: abanto ba Netofa: emerongo etano, na batano nomo (56);
english: of Netophah 56

ekegusii: Bakaroisia emegango korwa ase emete enga emetontera ya Basani. Bakaroisia risang’ina riao korwa ase chibao chi’emete emiya barusetie ase engegu ya Kuporo, chiachabeire amaino e chinchogu.
english: Of oaks from Bashan they made your oars; of cypress wood from the coasts of Cyprus they made your deck, inlaid with ivory.

ekegusii: of Pahath-Moab (through the line of Jeshua and Joab) 2,812
english: aba orwa Pahati‐Moabu be chiamate chia Yesua na Yoabu: chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na babere (2,812);

ekegusii: of Pahath-Moab (through the line of Jeshua and Joab) 2,818
english: aba orwa Pahati-Moabu, be chiamate chia Yesua na Yoabu: chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na atato, na ikomi na batano na batato (2,818);

ekegusii: abanto ba Rama na Geba: amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ebere, na oyomo (621);
english: of Ramah and Geba 621

ekegusii: Kalai ase eamate ya Salai, na Eberi ase eamate y’Amoki;
english: of Sallu's, Kallai; of Amok's, Eber;

ekegusii: of Shephatiah 372
english: aba orwa Sefatia: amagana atato, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (372);

ekegusii: (Ogotera gwa Sulemani) Nyasae, kae omoruoti okobua gw’okogamba buna aye okogamba, na omwana bw’omoruoti agambe ase oboronge buna aye.
english: Of Solomon. Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with your righteousness.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamin nabwo aba: Salu, mosinto o Mesulamu o Hodawia, o Hasenua;
english: Of the Benjamites: Sallu son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

ekegusii: korwa ase orw’Adini, Ebedi, mosinto o Yonathani, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano (50);
english: of the descendants of Adin, Ebed son of Jonathan, and with him 50 men;

ekegusii: korwa ase orw’Adonikamu, abachete nyuma y’abande nabwo aba: Elifeleti, na Yeueli, na Semaya, na amo nabarabwo abasacha emerongo etano nomo (60);
english: of the descendants of Adonikam, the last ones, whose names were Eliphelet, Jeuel and Shemaiah, and with them 60 men;

ekegusii: korwa ase orw’Asigadi, Yohanani, mosinto o Hakatani, na amo nere abasacha rigana erimo, na ikomi (110);
english: of the descendants of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him 110 men;

ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Bani, Selomiti, mosinto o Yosifia, na amo nere abasacha rigana erimo, na emerongo etano nomo (160);
english: of the descendants of Bani, Shelomith son of Josiphiah, and with him 160 men;

ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Bebai, Zakaria, mosinto o Bebai, na amo nere abasacha emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (28);
english: of the descendants of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him 28 men;

ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Bigiwai, Utai na Sabudi, na amo nabarabwo abasacha emerongo etano na ebere (70).
english: of the descendants of Bigvai, Uthai and Zaccur, and with them 70 men.

ekegusii: korwa ase orw’Elamu, Yesaia, mosinto bw’Atalia, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano na ebere (70);
english: of the descendants of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him 70 men;

ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Yoabu, Obadia, mosinto o Yehieli, na amo nere abasacha amagana abere, na ikomi na batano na batato (218);
english: of the descendants of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him 218 men;

ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Pahati‐Moabu, Eliehoenai, mosinto o Seraya, na amo nere abasacha amagana abere (200);
english: of the descendants of Pahath-Moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and with him 200 men;

ekegusii: Korwa ase ororeria rwa Finehasi, Gerisomu; korwa ase orwa Itamari, Danieli; korwa ase orwa Daudi, Hatusi
english: of the descendants of Phinehas, Gershom; of the descendants of Ithamar, Daniel; of the descendants of David, Hattush

ekegusii: orwa Sekania; korwa ase orwa Parosi, Zakaria, amo nabwo barigetwe amo nere, abasacha rigana erimo, na emerongo etano (150);
english: of the descendants of Shecaniah; of the descendants of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him were registered 150 men;

ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Sefatia, Sebadia, mosinto o Mikaeli, na amo nere abasacha emerongo etano na etato (80);
english: of the descendants of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him 80 men;

ekegusii: korwa ase orwa Satu, Sekania, mosinto o Yahasieli, na amo nere abasacha amagana atato (300);
english: of the descendants of Zattu, Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and with him 300 men;

ekegusii: Obogambi bwaye nigo borabe obonene, na omorembe oye tokoba nomoerio igoro ase ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi na ase oboruoti bwaye. Obwo nigo borakong’igwe ase ekeene na oboronge, korwa bono na goika kare na kare. Risemi ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda ndikore amang’ana ayio.
english: Of the increase of his government and peace there will be no end. He will reign on David's throne and over his kingdom, establishing and upholding it with justice and righteousness from that time on and forever. The zeal of the LORD Almighty will accomplish this.

ekegusii: “Ekero twairete ense eria ekaba eyaito, nkaa abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, na ekia Gadi, orogongo roria rogochakera ase omochie bw’Aroeri, rore ang’e norooche rw’Arinoni amo nekeng’ese gi’ense y’ebitunwa ya Gileadi, na emechie yarengeo.
english: Of the land that we took over at that time, I gave the Reubenites and the Gadites the territory north of Aroer by the Arnon Gorge, including half the hill country of Gilead, together with its towns.

ekegusii: Abalawi aba nabwo bamenyete Yerusalemu: Semaya, mosinto o Hasubu bw’Asirikamu, o Hasabia korwa ase eamate y’Abamerari;
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, a Merarite;

ekegusii: Korende Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, barabwo boka bagatigwa bare moyo korwa ase abanto baria bagendete koroota ense eria.
english: Of the men who went to explore the land, only Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh survived.

ekegusii: abanto ba Elamu o kabere: elifu eyemo, na amagana abere, na emerongo etano, na bane (1,254);
english: of the other Elam 1,254

ekegusii: abanto ba Nebo o kabere: emerongo etano, na babere (52);
english: of the other Nebo 52

ekegusii: Of the priests: Jedaiah; Jehoiarib; Jakin;
english: Abakuani aba nabwo bamenyete Yerusalemu: Yedaya na Yehoyaribu, na Yakini;

ekegusii: na korwa Silo Asaia, omwana omotangi amo nabana baye abamura.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

ekegusii: (Ogotera kwa basinto ba Kora) Omochie oria obegetwe oboroso n’Omonene nigo oteneine igoro ase ebitunwa ebichenu.
english: Of the Sons of Korah. A psalm. A song. He has set his foundation on the holy mountain;

ekegusii: Ase ororeria rwa Zera Yeueli amo nabanto bamwabo. Bonsi nigo barenge abanto amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo kianda (690).
english: Of the Zerahites: Jeuel. The people from Judah numbered 690.

ekegusii: Barabwo omoreng’anio oria bw’ekeene obaikeire, oria ogoteba, “Esese yairaneire amaroki aye enyene,” na “Embeche eyasibigwe ekwegara‐garia ase etintira ime.”
english: Of them the proverbs are true: "A dog returns to its vomit," and, "A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud."

ekegusii: Ebisaku bionsi bie chingige, na ebi’amabururu, na ebisase, ebio nabio morarie.
english: Of these you may eat any kind of locust, katydid, cricket or grasshopper.

ekegusii: Korwa ase oboremo obwo mwatanane aase Hekalu eraagachwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo borabe obwe chimoti amagana atano (500), na obogare bwaye chimoti amagana atano (500) boigo. Eraaro eetanaineo nigo erabe nobogare bw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.
english: Of this, a section 500 cubits square is to be for the sanctuary, with 50 cubits around it for open land.

ekegusii: Naende akaira korwa ase omochie oria omonto oyomo orenge omoteneneri bw’abarwani esegi, na abanto batano b’ekegambero ki’omoruoti abanyoretwe ase omochie ime; na omoriki bw’abarwani esegi, oria orenge gokora omobaro bw’abanto b’ense eria amo nabanto emerongo etano nomo b’ense eria abanyorekanete ase omochie ime.
english: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men and five royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land and sixty of his men who were found in the city.

ekegusii: Naende akaira korwa ase omochie oria omonto oyomo orenge omochiki bw’abarwani esegi, na abanto batano na babere b’ekegambero ki’omoruoti, abanyoretwe ase omochie ime, na omoriki bw’omochiki oria bw’abarwani esegi, oria orenge gokora omobaro bw’abanto b’ense eria, amo nabanto emerongo etano nomo b’ense eria, abanyorekanete ase omochie ime.
english: Of those still in the city, he took the officer in charge of the fighting men, and seven royal advisers. He also took the secretary who was chief officer in charge of conscripting the people of the land and sixty of his men who were found in the city.

ekegusii: Inee! Chibesa omonto omoriri abwate ase okoboko kwaye agochia kogora obong’aini nechia ki, na ere tari nokomanya?
english: Of what use is money in the hand of a fool, since he has no desire to get wisdom?

ekegusii: Abanto abwo chinguru chiabo chiaerire ase obogotu, ngokonywa ki ndanyore korwa ase amaboko abo?
english: Of what use was the strength of their hands to me, since their vigor had gone from them?

ekegusii: Ebango y’Omonene yarusetigwe korwa ase ching’ondi echio, amo ne chimbori, nigo yarenge amagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na isano (675).
english: of which the tribute for the LORD was 675;

ekegusii: Mobe abamokoroisania inwe ase inwe motari kwemurungania.
english: Offer hospitality to one another without grumbling.

ekegusii: Offer one in the morning and the other at twilight.
english: Emanwa eyemo y’echio oyerue mambia na eria ende mogoroba.

ekegusii: Karue ebing’wanso bi’oboronge, na mosemerie Omonene.
english: Offer right sacrifices and trust in the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende moruere ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa aase aria Omonene arachore korwa ase orogongo rw’ebisaku biaino; agwo nao morakorere aya onsi nabachikire.
english: Offer them only at the place the LORD will choose in one of your tribes, and there observe everything I command you.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria nakinete inde ne chinguru, na obosani bwa Nyasae bwagendererete kobeera ase obomenyo bwane.
english: Oh, for the days when I was in my prime, when God's intimate friendship blessed my house,

ekegusii: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.
english: Aa! Naki inyanchete amachiko ao! Naro nkona‐koiranerera omobaso boira.

ekegusii: Korende onye ndiria Nyasae are gokwana na akoorokie buna ore,
english: Oh, how I wish that God would speak, that he would open his lips against you

ekegusii: Obee! Obee! Obororo bw’enda yane bwabeire obonene. Enkoro yane nigo egontwoma mono, tinkonyara gokira; naigure eriogi ri’egetureri, ogotaboborwa gw’esegi.
english: Oh, my anguish, my anguish! I writhe in pain. Oh, the agony of my heart! My heart pounds within me, I cannot keep silent. For I have heard the sound of the trumpet; I have heard the battle cry.

ekegusii: Onye ndiria nare konyora aase ngotimokera ase erooro, anga nagenda aare, ntige abanto baane, ekiagera bonsi nabatomani, bagosasima emegwekano; barabwo nomoganda bw’abasigaani.
english: Oh, that I had in the desert a lodging place for travelers, so that I might leave my people and go away from them; for they are all adulterers, a crowd of unfaithful people.

ekegusii: Nigo yagwenerete Ayubu ateemwe goika omoerio, ekiagera nigo akoiraneria buna abakori amabe bakoiraneria.
english: Oh, that Job might be tested to the utmost for answering like a wicked man!

ekegusii: Onye ndiria omotwe one ore koba buna ensoko y’amache, na amaiso aane buna orooche rw’amariga, nigo nare korera omobaso na obotuko ase engencho y’ogoitwa kw’abanto baane bakwete.
english: Oh, that my head were a spring of water and my eyes a fountain of tears! I would weep day and night for the slain of my people.

ekegusii: Nigo nganetie ng’a chinchera chiane chibe chindonge, erinde ndende emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Oh, that my ways were steadfast in obeying your decrees!

ekegusii: Naki yare koba buya onye ogotooreka ngwachera Abaisraeli korwa Sayoni! Ekero Nyasae arairanerie abanto baye amaya abo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo mbachenge, ee, Abaisraeli mbabe nomogoko.
english: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

ekegusii: Naki yare koba buya onye ogotooreka ngwachera Abaisraeli korwa Sayoni! Ekero Omonene arairanerie abanto baye amaya abo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo mbachenge, ee, Abaisraeli mbabe nomogoko.
english: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

ekegusii: Onye ndiria baare koba nomoyo oyio botambe, na kong’iroka na korenda amachiko aane onsi, nanga kera egento nigo kiare koba buya asebare, na ase ororeria rwabo, kare na kare.
english: Oh, that their hearts would be inclined to fear me and keep all my commands always, so that it might go well with them and their children forever!

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, naki otari gotandora igoro oike gocha inse aa, erinde ebitunwa bitengechigwe ase obosio bwao?
english: Oh, that you would rend the heavens and come down, that the mountains would tremble before you!

ekegusii: Aa! Obonge bw’obonda, na obong’aini, ne chisemi bire ase Nyasae! Tibikorengeka. Ebina biaye tibikomanyekana ne chinchera chiaye tichikorigeka!
english: Oh, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable his judgments, and his paths beyond tracing out!

ekegusii: Obee! Okwogana okwo kw’abanto abange nogwa ki? Nigo bakwogana buna amache ’enyancha. Okomumura okwo kw’ebisaku nogwa ki? Nigo bakomumura buna amache are ne chinguru.
english: Oh, the raging of many nations-- they rage like the raging sea! Oh, the uproar of the peoples-- they roar like the roaring of great waters!

ekegusii: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
english: na omogambi Oholibama, na omogambi Ela, na omogambi Pinoni,

ekegusii: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
english: Oholibama na Ela, na Pinoni,

ekegusii: abakungu abagotu buna abanyoko, na abakungu abasubati buna basubati bamino, ase obochenu bwonsi.
english: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.

ekegusii: amaguta e chitaya, na ebinto bi’okoroisia amaguta akweakwa, na ebi’okoroisia ubani;
english: olive oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense;

ekegusii: Omuri akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete agatindekwa agwo Samaria, na Ahabu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Omri rested with his fathers and was buried in Samaria. And Ahab his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Moocha ya Yerusalemu Sulemani akaroisia aase aimokererete igoro ase Kemosi, okogechia kw’Abamoabu, na ase Moleki, okogechia kw’Abaamoni, chinyasae chiria, chiarenge agosasimerwa.
english: On a hill east of Jerusalem, Solomon built a high place for Chemosh the detestable god of Moab, and for Molech the detestable god of the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Akaba okworokereria ase esinagogi eyemo ase rituko ri’Esabato.
english: On a Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,

ekegusii: Ase chinyomba chionsi chi’ense ya Moabu, na ase chinchera chiaye, okorera gw’okweumia gwoka nakoigweke aroro, ekiagera naatire ense ya Moabu buna enyongo egwatwa, eyio monto onde atari gwechandera. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: On all the roofs in Moab and in the public squares there is nothing but mourning, for I have broken Moab like a jar that no one wants," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende ekaba ng’a rituko erimo, ekero abana ba Nyasae bachete kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene, Saitani nere agacha agwo ase barenge kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: On another day the angels came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came with them to present himself before him.

ekegusii: Esabato ende agasoa ase esinagogi, akorokereria. Narengeo omonto agwo, okoboko kwaye gw’okorio kwagataete.
english: On another Sabbath he went into the synagogue and was teaching, and a man was there whose right hand was shriveled.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia goika aroro bagasangereria ekanisa amo, bakaorokia amang’ana onsi Nyasae akorete nabarabwo, na buna aigoreire abanto b’Ebisaku egesieri gi’okwegena.
english: On arriving there, they gathered the church together and reported all that God had done through them and how he had opened the door of faith to the Gentiles.

ekegusii: Kirori one nansororere ase Nyasae, buna omonto agosororera omonto onde.
english: on behalf of a man he pleads with God as a man pleads for his friend.

ekegusii: Bagachia gosoa nyomba bakarora omwana amo na Mariamu ng’ina, bagatung’ama inse, bakamosasima; bagakunora chinibo chiabo, bakamokwaneria ebinto ebiya, etahabu, na ubani, na manemane.
english: On coming to the house, they saw the child with his mother Mary, and they bowed down and worshiped him. Then they opened their treasures and presented him with gifts of gold and of incense and of myrrh.

ekegusii: Agwo ase Yonathani arigetie goetera ase ogoika eburi y’Abafilisti mbiarengeo ebitare bibere ebioge, ekemo kera ensemo y’oboeto. Ekemo kiarenge korokwa Bosesei na ekende Sene.
english: On each side of the pass that Jonathan intended to cross to reach the Philistine outpost was a cliff; one was called Bozez, and the other Seneh.

ekegusii: Nabo abanto bande ase omoganda bagachia koigwa amang’ana ayio, bakabora, “Oyo ase ekeene nomobani oria.”
english: On hearing his words, some of the people said, "Surely this man is the Prophet."

ekegusii: Abange ase aborokigwa baye ekero bariigwa, bakabora, “Ring’ana eri nerikong’u, ning’o oranyare koritegerera?”
english: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, "This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?"

ekegusii: On hearing of this, John's disciples came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.
english: Aborokigwa baye bagachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bakagenda bakabogoria egetondo, bakagetindeka.

ekegusii: On hearing the Philistine's words, Saul and all the Israelites were dismayed and terrified.
english: Ekero Saulo amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi baigwete amang’ana ’Omofilisti oria, bagaichana na kwoboa mono.

ekegusii: Na ekero omonene bw’abarendi be Hekalu na abakuani abanene bachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagasogwa nomoichano omonene ase engencho yabo, naki arabe amang’ana aya.
english: On hearing this report, the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests were puzzled, wondering what would come of this.

ekegusii: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.
english: Ekero Daudi aigwete ayio, agatoma Yoabu amo ne chituoni chionsi chi’esegi.

ekegusii: On hearing this, David sent Joab out with the entire army of fighting men.
english: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, agatoma Yoabu amo nabarwani bonsi chituoni b’esegi.

ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, akabatebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omorwaria, otatiga abarwarete; tincheti korangeria ababoronge, korende abanyene ebibe.”
english: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners."

ekegusii: Agachia koyaigwa, akabatebia, “Abare buya tibari korigia omorwaria, otatiga abarwarete.
english: On hearing this, Jesus said, "It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.

ekegusii: On hearing this, Pilate asked if the man was a Galilean.
english: Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana eri, akaboria, “Omonto oyo n’Omogalili?”

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi b’Omorobiri o Sekemu baigwete amang’ana ayio, bakebisa ime ase ekenunchi kiarenge obotamero obokong’u agwo ase hekalu y’Eli‐Beriti.
english: On hearing this, the citizens in the tower of Shechem went into the stronghold of the temple of El-Berith.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya, bakabatiswa ase erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.
english: On hearing this, they were baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.

ekegusii: Rigachia goika rituko ri’okoinyora okoiborwa kwaye Herode, omoiseke bwe Herodia agatenga gati‐gati y’abanto, akagokia Herode.
english: On Herod's birthday the daughter of Herodias danced for them and pleased Herod so much

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia goika aroro akanyora Lazaro ng’a oikire koba ase embeera amatuko ane.
english: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.

ekegusii: Ase amagoro aye nigo anaarete ebitange bi’etaai, boigo nabwate esimisi y’etaai abegete ireko.
english: on his legs he wore bronze greaves, and a bronze javelin was slung on his back.

ekegusii: Naende nare nerieta ase eganchwa yaye na ase eriagati riaye ririkire iga: Omoruoti bw’abaruoti na Omonene bw’abanene.
english: On his robe and on his thigh he has this name written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.

ekegusii: Na inwe namoirwe ase abagavuna na ase abaruoti ase engencho yane, koba kirori asebare na ase abanto b’Ebisaku.
english: On my account you will be brought before governors and kings as witnesses to them and to the Gentiles.

ekegusii: Ekero indaire ase oborere bwane, nigo nkoba nkorengereretie, ase obotuko obogima ebirengererio biane nigo bikona‐gokoiranerera.
english: On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night.

ekegusii: Abasae abwo abasaria nigo bagontubokera korwa ensemo yane ya borio, erio baminyokia gonseria; nigo bagokora emeroberio emenge y’ogonsiria.
english: On my right the tribe attacks; they lay snares for my feet, they build their siege ramps against me.

ekegusii: Inee! Nabatooreke korwa ase obobe buna obwo? Taibo. Aye Nyasae, basirie abanto abwo kegima nendamwamu yao entindi.
english: On no account let them escape; in your anger, O God, bring down the nations.

ekegusii: Ebiita bi’omochie oria tibigosiekwa ase omobaso nonya ng’ake, na obotuko tibokoba aroro.
english: On no day will its gates ever be shut, for there will be no night there.

ekegusii: Na rora, omworokia bw’amachiko agatenena okomoteema, okobora, “Omworokia, inki ndakore nyore obogima bwa kare na kare?”
english: On one occasion an expert in the law stood up to test Jesus. "Teacher," he asked, "what must I do to inherit eternal life?"

ekegusii: Ekero asangererekanete amo nabarabwo, akabachika tibabaisa korua Yerusalemu, akabatebia, “Moganye eira ya Tata, eria mwaigwete korwa asende.
english: On one occasion, while he was eating with them, he gave them this command: "Do not leave Jerusalem, but wait for the gift my Father promised, which you have heard me speak about.

ekegusii: Bagaika Yerusalemu. Yeso agasoa ase Hekalu ime, agachaka goseria abanto abarenge koonia na kogora aroro, akaonchorana chimesa chi’abaare koonchoreria chibesa, na ebirogo bi’abaare koonia amaruma;
english: On reaching Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple area and began driving out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves,

ekegusii: Agachia goika aase aria akabatebia, “Saba, erinde timosoa ase ogoteemwa.”
english: On reaching the place, he said to them, "Pray that you will not fall into temptation."

ekegusii: ase rituko erio omonto oratooreke natame gochia asore, akorentere amang’ana.
english: on that day a fugitive will come to tell you the news.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Debora na Baraki, mosinto bw’Abinoamu, bagatera ogotera oko:
english: On that day Deborah and Barak son of Abinoam sang this song:

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi, akamotebia, “Imoka oagachere Omonene egesasimero agwo ase ekeooreri ki’Arauna Omoyebusi.”
english: On that day Gad went to David and said to him, "Go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite."

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Nyasae akaa Abaisraeli chinguru bakabua Yabini, omoruoti o Kanani.
english: On that day God subdued Jabin, the Canaanite king, before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Omonene natenene ase Egetunwa ki’Emezeituni kerochie Yerusalemu ensemo ya moocha. Egetunwa ekio ngetandoke ase chinsemo ibere korwa moocha goika bosongo, ne rikura rigare naribe ase egati‐gati; agwo ekeng’ese ekemo ki’egetunwa ekio ngesuke gochia sugusu, na ekende gochia irianyi.
english: On that day his feet will stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem, and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, forming a great valley, with half of the mountain moving north and half moving south.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio chindege chisungeire chibarasi nchirikwe amang’ana aya: “Chinchenu, chiatananirwe ase Omonene,” ne chinyongo chire ase enyomba y’Omonene nchibe chinchenu buna ebitaabo bire ase egesasimero.
english: On that day HOLY TO THE LORD will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, and the cooking pots in the LORD's house will be like the sacred bowls in front of the altar.

ekegusii: Rituko riria nigo natianete asebare, nkabatebia ng’a nimbarusie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, mbaire ase ense konya nabanyoreire, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, ense ere nobonene goetania chinse chionsi.
english: On that day I swore to them that I would bring them out of Egypt into a land I had searched out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the most beautiful of all lands.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria endamwamu yane nebe enene igoro asebare, inche imbatige na imbise obosio bwane, tibandora, barabwo mbasirigwe. Amabe amange na emechando emenge nabichiche igoro asebare, erio baborie ase rituko erio: Inee! Amabe aya onsi tari igo achire igoro asetore, ekiagera Nyasae oito atari ase egati yaito?
english: On that day I will become angry with them and forsake them; I will hide my face from them, and they will be destroyed. Many disasters and difficulties will come upon them, and on that day they will ask, 'Have not these disasters come upon us because our God is not with us?'

ekegusii: “Boigo rituko erio nindue egesusuro ase bonsi abwo bagotamboka ase omoriibo bw’egesieri inse, na ase baria baichoirie ase chinyomba chi’abanene nebinto bi’obourereria, na ebi’obong’ainereria.”
english: On that day I will punish all who avoid stepping on the threshold, who fill the temple of their gods with violence and deceit.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio ninganie gosiria abanto b’ebisaku bionsi barache korwania Yerusalemu.
english: On that day I will set out to destroy all the nations that attack Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio nindutere kera ebarasi omoondoko, na omonto oyeriinete abe ebarimo. Korende nimbe ndigereretie na korenda Abayuda, ekero ndaukorie chibarasi chi’abanto b’ebisaku.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: On that day I will strike every horse with panic and its rider with madness," declares the LORD. "I will keep a watchful eye over the house of Judah, but I will blind all the horses of the nations.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Yoshua agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabanto abwo, na agwo Sekemu akabaa amachiko na emeroberio barabwatie.
english: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people, and there at Shechem he drew up for them decrees and laws.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio amache are moyo nasoke korwa Yerusalemu. Ekeng’ese ki’amache ayio agende gochia ase Enyancha ya Moocha, na ekeng’ese kende gochia ase Enyancha ya Bosongo. Nagenderere goeta ase chingaki chie riberera na echi’obokendu.
english: On that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half to the eastern sea and half to the western sea, in summer and in winter.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene nabarentere obotantanu, abanto mbaonchokerane, baitane kera oyomo noyomwabo.
english: On that day men will be stricken by the LORD with great panic. Each man will seize the hand of another, and they will attack each other.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria oyore kerama igoro, na ebinto biaye bire nyomba ime, taika abibogorie; nere oyore mogondo naboigo tairana inka.
english: On that day no one who is on the roof of his house, with his goods inside, should go down to get them. Likewise, no one in the field should go back for anything.

ekegusii: Aye ase rituko erio otebie omwana oo: Aya nigo nkoyakora ase okoinyora aya Omonene ankorerete ekero ang’anyetie korwa Misiri.
english: On that day tell your son, 'I do this because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.'

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria abanto bagasomerwa amang’ana korwa ase Ebuku ya Musa, na ekanyorekana erikire ng’a Abaamoni na Abamoabu tibakobarwa ase omosangererekano bw’abanto ba Nyasae nonya ng’ake,
english: On that day the Book of Moses was read aloud in the hearing of the people and there it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever be admitted into the assembly of God,

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Omonene agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Aburamu, agateba, “Ororeria rwao nabaeire ense eye gochakera ase orooche orwo oronene rokorokwa Eufarati,
english: On that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram and said, "To your descendants I give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates--

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Omonene nakengere abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu, erinde oyore omworo mono ase egati yabo abe buna Daudi, na abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi babe buna Nyasae, ee, buna omomalaika bw’Omonene oyo obatang’aine.
english: On that day the LORD will shield those who live in Jerusalem, so that the feeblest among them will be like David, and the house of David will be like God, like the Angel of the LORD going before them.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio omogambi arue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho yaye omonyene, na ase engencho y’abanto bonsi b’ense eyio.
english: On that day the prince is to provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio, ebirero ebirabe ime ya Yerusalemu mbibe ebinene buna ebio biabete igoro ya Hadadi‐Rimoni agwo ase ense omweya ya Megido.
english: On that day the weeping in Jerusalem will be great, like the weeping of Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio omobaso tokobara, obokendu mbobeo.
english: On that day there will be no light, no cold or frost.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria amang’ana aya nakwanwe ase Yerusalemu: “Aye Sayoni, toiroka; totiga amaboko ao abe amoro.
english: On that day they will say to Jerusalem, "Do not fear, O Zion; do not let your hands hang limp.

ekegusii: Ababenjamin abaitetwe ase rituko riria nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere, na isano. Abanto abwo bamanyete korwana esegi y’emioro, naende nigo barenge abakong’u b’esegi.
english: On that day twenty-five thousand Benjamite swordsmen fell, all of them valiant fighters.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio inwe timogosookigwa ase engencho y’ogosaria gwonsi okwo mwakorete asende. Ekero ekio nindusie korwa ase egati yaino abanto baria abaenenu abeimokereria igoro, na inwe timokogenderera kweimokereria igoro mamincha y’egetunwa kiane egechenu.
english: On that day you will not be put to shame for all the wrongs you have done to me, because I will remove from this city those who rejoice in their pride. Never again will you be haughty on my holy hill.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ime ase Tata, na inwe ime yane, na inche ime yaino.
english: On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.

ekegusii: Daudi agakwana ase rituko riria, “Onde bwensi otagete goita Abayebusi, tiga atiire gochia ase omotarobw’amache, aite emeuko eyio na ebirema ebio inche Daudi ngechete.” Ase ayio abanto nigo bagoteba, “Emeuko na ebirema tibakonyara gosoa ase enyomba.”
english: On that day, David said, "Anyone who conquers the Jebusites will have to use the water shaft to reach those 'lame and blind' who are David's enemies." That is why they say, "The 'blind and lame' will not enter the palace."

ekegusii: Ekero engaki eyio eraike, ninkore Yerusalemu obe buna rigena ririto ase abanto bonsi; bonsi abarateeme korietweka mbateke chingoma abanyene. Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bi’ense nabasangererekane amo bayoumokere.
english: On that day, when all the nations of the earth are gathered against her, I will make Jerusalem an immovable rock for all the nations. All who try to move it will injure themselves.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria omoruoti agaatanana na gochena obogati‐gati bw’eraaro eria yarenge bosio bw’enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo nao aruerete ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, ekiagera egesasimero gi’etaai ekiarenge ase obosio bw’Omonene nigo kiarenge egeke mono, tikiare goisana koira ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe.
english: On that same day the king consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the LORD, and there he offered burnt offerings, grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar before the LORD was too small to hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Omonene agatebia Musa,
english: On that same day the LORD told Moses,

ekegusii: Rituko erio goika morarie na mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima; timokora emeremo yaino ya kera rituko. Okwo nogochika koragenderere asemore ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase moramenye.
english: On that same day you are to proclaim a sacred assembly and do no regular work. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu akabwata Isumaeli omwana oye, na abasomba aba baiboire ase enka yaye, na abagorwa chibesa, kera omonto omosacha ore ase abanto b’enka ya Ibrahimu, akabakeba risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiabo ki’obosacha, ase rituko riria riria, buna Nyasae amotebetie.
english: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or bought with his money, every male in his household, and circumcised them, as God told him.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Nuhu agasoa ase obwato ime amo na Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti, bamura baye, na mokaye, na baka bamura baye batato.
english: On that very day Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, together with his wife and the wives of his three sons, entered the ark.

ekegusii: Ebitinya ne chinyigo, na ebitinya bie riini, ebiarusetie ase ekeng’wanso keria ki’ebibe, akabisambera ase egesasimero, buna Omonene achigete Musa.
english: On the altar he burned the fat, the kidneys and the covering of the liver from the sin offering, as the LORD commanded Moses;

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Omonene igoro ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, keria aagachete agwo ang’e nenyomba yaagachetwe bosio bwe Hekalu ekabwateranigwa nero.
english: On the altar of the LORD that he had built in front of the portico, Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings to the LORD,

ekegusii: Ase rituko erimo eriabekire, Herode akeboyia chianga chi’oboruoti, agaikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti, agakwana asebare.
english: On the appointed day Herod, wearing his royal robes, sat on his throne and delivered a public address to the people.

ekegusii: Ebisure ebio nigo biarenge igoro ase chisiiro chiria ibere na igoro ye chinsemo chiatambeete gochia isiko. Emegwekano y’amakomomanga amagana abere yarenge ase chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure.
english: On the capitals of both pillars, above the bowl-shaped part next to the network, were the two hundred pomegranates in rows all around.

ekegusii: otatiga ase okoba kirori egati yaito nainwe, na egati y’ororeria rwaito na orwaino, ng’a nigo tokomokorera Omonene ase okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ekeng’wanso kende amo neki’omorembe ase obosio bwaye. Aya nigo twakorire ase ogotanga abana b’ororeria rwaino tibabaisa gocha gotebia ab’orwaito ng’a: Timori negetari ase Omonene.
english: On the contrary, it is to be a witness between us and you and the generations that follow, that we will worship the LORD at his sanctuary with our burnt offerings, sacrifices and fellowship offerings. Then in the future your descendants will not be able to say to ours, 'You have no share in the LORD.'

ekegusii: Korende bakarora ekeene, ng’a inche negenirwe koranderia abatarogeti enchili, buna Petero egenetwe koyeranderia baria barogete.
english: On the contrary, they saw that I had been entrusted with the task of preaching the gospel to the Gentiles, just as Peter had been to the Jews.

ekegusii: Korende kobua mono, ebiimo biria bi’omobere bigokagerwa ng’a tibiri ne chinguru, nigo biganeirie kobua.
english: On the contrary, those parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,

ekegusii: korende buna twancheirwe na Nyasae koba abatwegenirwe koegwa enchili, nabo togokwana, tari ase okogwenera abanto, korende ase okogwenera Nyasae, oyokorenga chinkoro chiaito.
english: On the contrary, we speak as men approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel. We are not trying to please men but God, who tests our hearts.

ekegusii: Korende ekero aigete Rumi akandigia nomokia, akaanyora.
english: On the contrary, when he was in Rome, he searched hard for me until he found me.

ekegusii: Naboigo, “Omobisa oo karabe nenchara, moragerie, karabe nerang’o, moe anywe, ekiagera korakore ayio, nomobekere amakara ’omorero ase omotwe oye.”
english: On the contrary: "If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink. In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head."

ekegusii: ekero arache ase rituko riria, erinde atogigwe ase egati y’abachenu baye, na gokumigwa ase egati ya bonsi abamwegenire, ekiagera mwegenire oborori bwaito obo twabarenteire.
english: on the day he comes to be glorified in his holy people and to be marveled at among all those who have believed. This includes you, because you believed our testimony to you.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria arasoe ase eraaro ya ime ase obokoreri bwaye agwo Aase Aachenu, goika arue ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ebibe. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: On the day he goes into the inner court of the sanctuary to minister in the sanctuary, he is to offer a sin offering for himself, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rinene ri’omoruoti oito abagambi bakanywa edivai endoro goika ekabarwaria, na ere omonyene akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabwatana nabanyacheche.
english: On the day of the festival of our king the princes become inflamed with wine, and he joins hands with the mockers.

ekegusii: Nigo agoteba iga: “Ase rituko riria ri’ekeng’wanso kiane inche Omonene nindue egesusuro ase abagambi, na ase abamura b’omoruoti, na ase bonsi ababegete chianga chie chinse chingeni.
english: On the day of the LORD's sacrifice I will punish the princes and the king's sons and all those clad in foreign clothes.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Omotienyi Omoyia arue eeri ensae eyemo, ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi isano nemo, na emingichi eyemo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: On the day of the New Moon he is to offer a young bull, six lambs and a ram, all without defect.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Omonene abegete Abaamori ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, Yoshua agakwana n’Omonene. Ekero Abaisraeli bategererete, akabora, “Aye erioba, tenena, okire‐kiri igoro ya Gibeoni, naye omotienyi boigo, igoro ye Rikura ri’Ayaloni!”
english: On the day the LORD gave the Amorites over to Israel, Joshua said to the LORD in the presence of Israel: "O sun, stand still over Gibeon, O moon, over the Valley of Aijalon."

ekegusii: Nebe ekero Omonene abaeire ogotimoka korwa ase emechando yaino, na obokong’u, na emeremo emekong’u mwarenge gokorigwa,
english: On the day the LORD gives you relief from suffering and turmoil and cruel bondage,

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Obomenyo boria Obochenu bwatenenetigwe, riire rigatuba Obomenyo obwo, engencho yaye Eema y’Oborori. Na korwa mogoroba goika mambia riire riria rikarorekana rire buna omorero.
english: On the day the tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony, was set up, the cloud covered it. From evening till morning the cloud above the tabernacle looked like fire.

ekegusii: Rituko riria baagetwe amaguta inche ngachika ng’a egetari ekio korwa ase Abaisraeli kebe ekiabo kogenderera botambe, ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
english: On the day they were anointed, the LORD commanded that the Israelites give this to them as their regular share for the generations to come.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwatenenete ensemo ase rituko riria, ekero abanto b’ense engeni bairete chinibo chiabo, bagasoa ebiita bia Yerusalemu, bakayoakera obomera. Naboigo nainwe mwarenge buna barabwo.
english: On the day you stood aloof while strangers carried off his wealth and foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Jerusalem, you were like one of them.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riboa erio rigosungusigwa inamorue boigo emanwa emingichi yakoorire omwaka oyomo, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa asende.
english: On the day you wave the sheaf, you must sacrifice as a burnt offering to the LORD a lamb a year old without defect,

ekegusii: Rituko kwaiboretwe ororera rwao tirwanachetwe, gose tigwasibetigwe namache orabe, gose tikwaagetwe omonyo, gose tikwabekeretwe eanga y’obwana.
english: On the day you were born your cord was not cut, nor were you washed with water to make you clean, nor were you rubbed with salt or wrapped in cloths.

ekegusii: Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, bobe obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.
english: On the east end, toward the sunrise, the courtyard shall also be fifty cubits wide.

ekegusii: Moocha ya Yorodan ase erooro, ase ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, bagachora Beseri ase orogongo rwa Reuben, na Ramoti o Gileadi, ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Gadi, na Golani o Basani ase orogongo rw’egesaku kia Manase.
english: On the east side of the Jordan of Jericho they designated Bezer in the desert on the plateau in the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead in the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan in the tribe of Manasseh.

ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya moocha n’Abayuda, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu, nere orabe omotang’ani obo,
english: On the east, toward the sunrise, the divisions of the camp of Judah are to encamp under their standard. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato Gamalieli, mosinto o Pedasuri bw’egesaku kia Manase, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the eighth day Gamaliel son of Pedahzur, the leader of the people of Manasseh, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato aire amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, ase obosio bwane inche Omonene agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, ayae omokuani.
english: On the eighth day he must take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the LORD to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and give them to the priest.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato Musa akarangeria Haroni amo nabamura baye, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli.
english: On the eighth day Moses summoned Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato aire amaruma abere gose amage ’amaruma abere ase omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: On the eighth day she must take two doves or two young pigeons and bring them to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Omwana oria omoisia asarwe ase rituko ria gatano na gatato.
english: On the eighth day the boy is to be circumcised.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaira omwana komosara, bakarigia bamoroke erieta ria ise, Zakaria,
english: On the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to name him after his father Zechariah,

ekegusii: Na ase rituko ria gatano na gatato bakaba nomosangererekano bw’ogosasima, ekiagera konya babeire barendete amatuko atano na abere ay’ogwatanana egesasimero, amo n’Amatuko Amanene atano na abere.
english: On the eighth day they held an assembly, for they had celebrated the dedication of the altar for seven days and the festival for seven days more.

ekegusii: Rigachia goika rituko ria gatano na gatato, rituko ri’okomosara, akarokwa erieta riaye Yeso, riria riatoretwe nomomalaika ritang’ani atarabogorigwa oborito.
english: On the eighth day, when it was time to circumcise him, he was named Jesus, the name the angel had given him before he had been conceived.

ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na rimo Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani bw’egesaku gi’Aseri, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the eleventh day Pagiel son of Ocran, the leader of the people of Asher, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Ase omogoroba bwe rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, na ebisieri kobiasiekirwe aase agwo aborokigwa barenge, ekiagera bairogete Abayahudi, Yeso agacha, agatenena gati‐gati akabatebia, “Omorembe obe asemore!”
english: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the disciples were together, with the doors locked for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them and said, "Peace be with you!"

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli batoorete Giligali ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Yeriko bakaba bakorenda rituko rinene ri’Epasaka chinsa chia mogoroba, ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi.
english: On the evening of the fourteenth day of the month, while camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho, the Israelites celebrated the Passover.

ekegusii: Na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi oyio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omonene, rituko ri’Emegati etabekiri memera; inamorie emegati etabekiri memera ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: On the fifteenth day of that month the LORD's Feast of Unleavened Bread begins; for seven days you must eat bread made without yeast.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano, ase omotienyi o gatano na gatato, omotienyi achorete ere omonyene, akagenda ase egesasimero aroisetie, agatwara Rituko Rinene ase Abaisraeli na akariina ase egesasimero gosamba ubani.
english: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month, a month of his own choosing, he offered sacrifices on the altar he had built at Bethel. So he instituted the festival for the Israelites and went up to the altar to make offerings.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano ri’omotienyi oyio nario Rituko Rinene. Ase amatuko atano na abere morie emegati etabekiri memera.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a festival; for seven days eat bread made without yeast.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai bw’egesaku gia Simeoni, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the fifth day Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai, the leader of the people of Simeon, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Ee, ase rituko ria gatano ase omotienyi oyio, omwaka o gatano bw’ogwoswa kwa Yehoyakimu omoruoti,
english: On the fifth of the month-- it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin--

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima, na timobaisa gokora emeremo ya kera rituko,
english: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.
english: On the first day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani inamobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima, na ase rituko ria gatano na kabere boigo mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Ase amatuko ayio timokora meremo ende yonsi, otatiga okoroisia endagera ase kera omonto; ayio oka naro morakore.
english: On the first day hold a sacred assembly, and another one on the seventh day. Do no work at all on these days, except to prepare food for everyone to eat-- that is all you may do.

ekegusii: Ase kera rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, kera oyomo asemore abe okogacha mwaye ensemo ase eki anyorire, koreng’ana buna aranyare, erinde ebiegwa tibisangererigwa ekero nachire.
english: On the first day of every week, each one of you should set aside a sum of money in keeping with his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will have to be made.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso, bakamoboria, “Ng’ai origetie tokoroiserie oriere Epasaka?”
english: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, "Where do you want us to make preparations for you to eat the Passover?"

ekegusii: Goika rituko rie ritang’ani ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ekero gi’okonyenya emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka, aborokigwa baye bakamoboria, “Ng’ai origetie togende tokoroiserie oriere Epasaka?”
english: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, when it was customary to sacrifice the Passover lamb, Jesus' disciples asked him, "Where do you want us to go and make preparations for you to eat the Passover?"

ekegusii: Abanto bagachaka korua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Omonene ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, korende oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene konya tiborabekwa.
english: On the first day of the seventh month they began to offer burnt offerings to the LORD, though the foundation of the LORD's temple had not yet been laid.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, ekero twasangererekanete ase ogosamunyora omogati, Paulo agakwana nabarabwo, agachiererera namang’ana aye goika botuko gati, ekiagera arengereretie komanora rituko ria kabere.
english: On the first day of the week we came together to break bread. Paul spoke to the people and, because he intended to leave the next day, kept on talking until midnight.

ekegusii: Korende rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, kobogokiamoka, abakungu baria bakagenda ase oboina, bakaira amanukato aria, ayababegete ang’e.
english: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women took the spices they had prepared and went to the tomb.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani namoimokie amatunda amaya korwa ase emete yaino emiya, ne chinsagia chi’emekendo, ne chinsagia chibwate amato amange, na echi’emete enga buna emesobeti, na inwe namobe nomochengo ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: On the first day you are to take choice fruit from the trees, and palm fronds, leafy branches and poplars, and rejoice before the LORD your God for seven days.

ekegusii: Yona agachaka goeta ase omochie oria, akaira rituko erimo, agaaka eriogi agateba, “Atigaire amatuko emerongo ene oka, erio Nineva oonchoranwe.”
english: On the first day, Jonah started into the city. He proclaimed: "Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned."

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato agatiga abanto bakagenda, na barabwo bagasesenia omoruoti, bakagenda chinka chiabo bare nomogoko na omosasoko ase chinkoro chiabo ase engencho y’obuya bwonsi boria Omonene akorerete Daudi, omosomba oye, na Abaisraeli, abanto baye.
english: On the following day he sent the people away. They blessed the king and then went home, joyful and glad in heart for all the good things the LORD had done for his servant David and his people Israel.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, abanto baria bairanete korwa ase obosomba bakarenda Epasaka.
english: On the fourteenth day of the first month, the exiles celebrated the Passover.

ekegusii: Goika obotuko bwa ikomi na kane bogachia goika tokairwa gochia aria na aria ase enyancha y’Adiria. Botuko gati abagendia b’emeeri bagakaga ng’a baikire ang’e ase ense enyomo.
english: On the fourteenth night we were still being driven across the Adriatic Sea, when about midnight the sailors sensed they were approaching land.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kane Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri bw’egesaku kia Reuben, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the fourth day Elizur son of Shedeur, the leader of the people of Reuben, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kane bagasangererekana ase Ebate ya Beraka, ekiagera agwo nao batogeretie Omonene. Aase agwo abeire akorokwa Ebate ya Beraka goika rero iga.
english: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Beracah, where they praised the LORD. This is why it is called the Valley of Beracah to this day.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kane bakaboka mambia chuni, na Omolawi oria akebeka ang’e kogenda, korende ise omosubati oria akamotebia, “Kararia endagera onyore chinguru, erio mogende.”
english: On the fourth day they got up early and he prepared to leave, but the girl's father said to his son-in-law, "Refresh yourself with something to eat; then you can go."

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kane togasoa ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito; erio chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebikorero biria, bikarengwa bikabekwa ase amaboko a Meremoti omokuani, mosinto o Uria, oyorenge amo na Eleazari, mosinto o Finehasi, na ase Abalawi aba: Yosabadi, mosinto o Yesua, na Noadia, mosinto o Binui.
english: On the fourth day, in the house of our God, we weighed out the silver and gold and the sacred articles into the hands of Meremoth son of Uriah, the priest. Eleazar son of Phinehas was with him, and so were the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kane bagatebia moga Samison, “Ebereria omosacha oo atotebie engencho y’omobayeno oyo. Onye taibo, rirorio nigo tokogosamba nomorero, tosambe nenyomba ya iso boigo. Inee! Inwe nigo mwatorangeretie gocha aa, erinde motourererie ebinto biaito, tobe abataka?”
english: On the fourth day, they said to Samson's wife, "Coax your husband into explaining the riddle for us, or we will burn you and your father's household to death. Did you invite us here to rob us?"

ekegusii: Nigo bataarete ase chinyancha chinene, na ebitoki biaino nigo biarenge chimbusuro chia Sihori, na okwama kwe riranya ri’Orooche rwa Naili. Ninwe mwarenge abaonchoreria b’ebisaku bionsi.
english: On the great waters came the grain of the Shihor; the harvest of the Nile was the revenue of Tyre, and she became the marketplace of the nations.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogotenena aase aimokererete igoro, ang’e nenchera engendi, nigo bokobeera ase amatabekania e chinchera.
english: On the heights along the way, where the paths meet, she takes her stand;

ekegusii: Omonwa bw’ekebekerero nigo orenge igoro ime y’orosingo rw’obotambe gochia igoro okoboko okomo. Omonwa oyio orenge egesingo otambeete gochia inse, obotambe bw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, nao ebiechabero biarenge. Emetobwa yaye nigo yarenge ne chikoona, tiyarenge egesingo.
english: On the inside of the stand there was an opening that had a circular frame one cubit deep. This opening was round, and with its basework it measured a cubit and a half. Around its opening there was engraving. The panels of the stands were square, not round.

ekegusii: Nase rituko ri’omoerio, Rituko riria Rinene, Yeso agatenena, agakwana neriogi rinene akabora, “Onye omonto ore nerang’o, tiga ache asende anywe!
english: On the last and greatest day of the Feast, Jesus stood and said in a loud voice, "If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Omonene nigo nabogoretigwe n’Omoika, nkaigwa korwa magega aane eriogi rinene, buna eriogi ri’egetureri,
english: On the Lord's Day I was in the Spirit, and I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet,

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano, mambia chuni, akaimoka agachaka kogenda. Korende ise omosubati oria akamotebia, “Karie endagera onyore chinguru. Ganya goika omobaso orakenda.” Ase ayio bakaragera amo bonsi babere.
english: On the morning of the fifth day, when he rose to go, the girl's father said, "Refresh yourself. Wait till afternoon!" So the two of them ate together.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato ekero kia mambia bikaba enkoba na okomesa, ne riire ririto rigaika ase egetunwa, na eriogi ri’egetureri rikooga mono. Abanto bonsi ase egetwori bakaondoka na koiguswa.
english: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning, with a thick cloud over the mountain, and a very loud trumpet blast. Everyone in the camp trembled.

ekegusii: Ningesimeke igoro ase egetunwa egetambe ki’Abaisraeli, na omote oria nosokie chinsagia na kwama amatunda, obe omocharake omuya. Chinyoni chia kera egesaku nchimenye ase chinsagia chiaye na gokenderera ase ekiriri kiaye.
english: On the mountain heights of Israel I will plant it; it will produce branches and bear fruit and become a splendid cedar. Birds of every kind will nest in it; they will find shelter in the shade of its branches.

ekegusii: Nokwere igoro ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, aye amo nemeganda yao yonsi y’esegi, na abanto abwo bare amo naye. Erio nindangerie chinyoni chia kera egesaku, ne ching’iti chi’orosana, chiche chirie chinyama chi’emebere yaino.
english: On the mountains of Israel you will fall, you and all your troops and the nations with you. I will give you as food to all kinds of carrion birds and to the wild animals.

ekegusii: Ase Esabato ya kabere abanto abange, ang’e omochie bwonsi, bagasangererekana baigwe ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: On the next Sabbath almost the whole city gathered to hear the word of the Lord.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kianda Abidani, mosinto o Gidioni bw’egesaku kia Benjamin, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the ninth day Abidan son of Gideoni, the leader of the people of Benjamin, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rwabo rogachakera orooche rwa Yorodan, rogatiira gochia egetirimboko sugusu ya Yeriko, naende gochia bosongo goetera ense y’ebitunwa, rogaika erooro ya Beti‐Aveni.
english: On the north side their boundary began at the Jordan, passed the northern slope of Jericho and headed west into the hill country, coming out at the desert of Beth Aven.

ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya sugusu n’Abadani, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai, nere orabe omotang’ani obo,
