english: On the north will be the divisions of the camp of Dan, under their standard. The leader of the people of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

ekegusii: Ase chinsingo echio yarengeo emegwekano ye chindo, na eye chieri, na ey’abakerubi; naboigo nase chinsingo chie chikoona igoro. Igoro na inse y’emegwekano eyio nigo yarenge emegwekano y’ebisicha biaroisirie chingata.
english: On the panels between the uprights were lions, bulls and cherubim-- and on the uprights as well. Above and below the lions and bulls were wreaths of hammered work.

ekegusii: Agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, ang’e na Yorodan, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
english: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho the LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, ang’e na Yorodan, kororia Yeriko, Omonene agkwana na Musa, akamotebia,
english: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho, the LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakona‐gotaboria ebinto ase ensemo ya borio, korende nigo bagendererete koba nenchara; nigo bakwenyorera ebinto korwa ase ensemo ya bomosi, korende tibari koigota. Kera oyomo nigo akoria chinyama chi’omobere bw’oyomwabo.
english: On the right they will devour, but still be hungry; on the left they will eat, but not be satisfied. Each will feed on the flesh of his own offspring:

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’Esabato togasoka isiko y’egeita ase orooche mbarabare, ase ensemo twarengereretie ng’a tonyore aase togosabera. Togaikaransa, togakwana nabakungu abasangererekanete aria.
english: On the Sabbath we went outside the city gate to the river, where we expected to find a place of prayer. We sat down and began to speak to the women who had gathered there.

ekegusii: Kera Esabato, na kera Omotienyi Omoyia, abanto b’ense eyio goika babe bagosasimera agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo ase egesoero ki’egeita ekio.
english: On the Sabbaths and New Moons the people of the land are to worship in the presence of the LORD at the entrance to that gateway.

ekegusii: Musa agachika abanto ase rituko erio erio, agakwana,
english: On the same day Moses commanded the people:

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Netaneli, mosinto o Suari bw’egesaku gia Isakaru, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the second day Nethanel son of Zuar, the leader of Issachar, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere, abateneneri be chiamate chiabo chionsi amo nabakuani na Abalawi, bagacha ase Ezara, omworokia bw’amariko, erinde beorokererie amang’ana ’amachiko aria.
english: On the second day of the month, the heads of all the families, along with the priests and the Levites, gathered around Ezra the scribe to give attention to the words of the Law.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na kabere Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, bw’egesaku gi’Efraimu, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the seventh day Elishama son of Ammihud, the leader of the people of Ephraim, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani akerenge naende. Kararore ng’a ogosareka koria gwesiareire ase eanga, gose ase egetambaa keroisirie ase chingencho ao ao, gose ase risankwa, gose ase egento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, nigo kiabwatetwe na ukoma obobe mono; egento ekio tigechenegeti.
english: On the seventh day he is to examine it, and if the mildew has spread in the clothing, or the woven or knitted material, or the leather, whatever its use, it is a destructive mildew; the article is unclean.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere naende akigite etukia yaye yonsi y’omotwe, ne chinderu, na ebioge bi’amaiso, na amarionya ande onsi are ase omobere oye. Erio asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, na igo nabe ochenekire.
english: On the seventh day he must shave off all his hair; he must shave his head, his beard, his eyebrows and the rest of his hair. He must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water, and he will be clean.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere mobe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima. Timokora emeremo ya kera rituko ase rituko erio.
english: On the seventh day hold a sacred assembly and do no regular work.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi o gatano ase omwaka o ikomi na kianda bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, Nebusaradani, oyorenge omoteneneri bw’abarendi na omosomba bw’omoruoti o Babeli, agacha Yerusalemu.
english: On the seventh day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, an official of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omwana oria agakwa. Abasomba ba Daudi bakoboa komotebia ng’a omwana okure, naki nigo batebete, “Ekero omwana arenge moyo, togachia gokwana nere, korende tanchete gotoigwa. Naki rende toranyare komotebia ng’a omwana okure? Nigo arabaise gwekora bobe.”
english: On the seventh day the child died. David's servants were afraid to tell him that the child was dead, for they thought, "While the child was still living, we spoke to David but he would not listen to us. How can we tell him the child is dead? He may do something desperate."

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a egesambo keria giachakire gosira, na oborwaire boria tibwesiarereti ase risankwa erio omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oria ochenekire, namaote oka abwate. Omonto oria asibie chianga chiaye, erio abe oyochenegete kegima.
english: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him again, and if the sore has faded and has not spread in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean; it is only a rash. The man must wash his clothes, and he will be clean.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani amorenge naende, na kararore ng’a oborwaire boria tibwesiarereti ase risankwa, erio amobeke naende ase egesomo ase engaki y’amatuko ande atano na abere.
english: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him, and if he sees that the sore is unchanged and has not spread in the skin, he is to keep him in isolation another seven days.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani amorenge naende. Kararore ng’a egesambo keria giesiareire ase risankwa, erio atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.
english: On the seventh day the priest is to examine him, and if it is spreading in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him unclean; it is an infectious skin disease.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani amorenge naende, na onye richoncho riria tiriesiarereti ase risankwa, na tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa, omokuani atebe ng’a omonto oyio ochenekire, ase igo asibie chianga chiaye, abe oyochenegete kegima.
english: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the itch, and if it has not spread in the skin and appears to be no more than skin deep, the priest shall pronounce him clean. He must wash his clothes, and he will be clean.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani arenge naende oborwaire boria, na onye tibwesiarereti, naende amarionya amonuri tario, naende richoncho tirikoreti engoro gochia ime goetania risankwa,
english: On the seventh day the priest is to examine the sore, and if the itch has not spread and there is no yellow hair in it and it does not appear to be more than skin deep,

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere omokuani airaneo, ayerenge naende. Kararore ng’a ukoma boria bwesiareire ase enyasi y’enyomba eria,
english: On the seventh day the priest shall return to inspect the house. If the mildew has spread on the walls,

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere mosibie chianga chiaino, nainwe namobe abachenekire; nyuma y’ayio monyare gosoa ase ebitwori.”
english: On the seventh day wash your clothes and you will be clean. Then you may come into the camp."

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na kabere bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagataara na goetanana omochie ara gatano na kabere igo igo, korende ase rituko erio rioka bakayoetanana ara gatano na kabere.
english: On the seventh day, they got up at daybreak and marched around the city seven times in the same manner, except that on that day they circled the city seven times.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ri’omoyega oyio, omoruoti kanyure edivai akaba nomosasoko ase enkoro yaye. Ase ayio akarangeria Mehumani na Bisita, Haribona na Bigita, Abagita na Setari, na Karikasi, abasomba baye batano na babere abagombaetigwe, abwo barenge komokorera ase enyomba yaye,
english: On the seventh day, when King Xerxes was in high spirits from wine, he commanded the seven eunuchs who served him-- Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar and Carcas--

ekegusii: Agwo ase chinyasi chi’egesona, na echi’ebinyomba biaagachire ase amakere ensemo na ensemo, ebibao biasiekeire ebioma na emegwekano y’emekendo mbiarengeo.
english: On the sidewalls of the portico were narrow windows with palm trees carved on each side. The side rooms of the temple also had overhangs.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatano na rimo Eliasafu, mosinto o Deueli bw’egesaku kia Gadi, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the sixth day Eliasaph son of Deuel, the leader of the people of Gad, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Korende rituko ria gatano na rimo goika basangererie na koroisia ara kabere buna bagosangereria amatuko ande.”
english: On the sixth day they are to prepare what they bring in, and that is to be twice as much as they gather on the other days."

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na rimo baba bagosangereria endagera eria ekerengo ara kabere, ase kera omonto ebimunu bine. Abagaaka bonsi b’omoganda bakagenda gotebia Musa amang’ana ayio.
english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much-- two omers for each person-- and the leaders of the community came and reported this to Moses.

ekegusii: Enyomba eria rirondo yanachanire ebinyomba yarenge ang’e norwaki oronetu rwarenge irianyi, egati y’aase atigire ataagachire na oboagacho bwa irianyi.
english: On the south side along the length of the wall of the outer court, adjoining the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall, were rooms

ekegusii: Ensemo ya irianyi nense y’Efraimu, na ensemo ya sugusu neya Manase yarenge. Enyancha Enene nero yarenge orobebe rwabo ensemo ya bosongo. Ensemo ya sugusu bagasinyana nabanto b’Aseri, na ensemo ya moocha naba Isakaru.
english: On the south the land belonged to Ephraim, on the north to Manasseh. The territory of Manasseh reached the sea and bordered Asher on the north and Issachar on the east.

ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya irianyi n’Abareuben, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri, nere orabe omotang’ani obo,
english: On the south will be the divisions of the camp of Reuben under their standard. The leader of the people of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur.

ekegusii: Orike erieta ria Haroni ase enyimbo y’egesaku kia Lawi. Kera omotang’ani bwe chiamate chia kera egesaku abe nenyimbo eyemo.
english: On the staff of Levi write Aaron's name, for there must be one staff for the head of each ancestral tribe.

ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi Ahieseri, mosinto bw’Amisadai bw’egesaku kia Dani, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the tenth day Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, the leader of the people of Dan, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi o gatano, ase omwaka o ikomi na kianda bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, Nebusaradani, oyorenge omoteneneri bw’abarendi na omosomba bw’omoruoti o Babeli, agacha Yerusalemu.
english: On the tenth day of the fifth month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard, who served the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaamboka Yorodan rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, bagatoora Giligali, ase orobebe rwa moocha ya Yeriko.
english: On the tenth day of the first month the people went up from the Jordan and camped at Gilgal on the eastern border of Jericho.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo araitwe ase oborori bw’abanto babere gose batato, korende tagoitwa ase oborori bw’omonto oyomo.
english: On the testimony of two or three witnesses a man shall be put to death, but no one shall be put to death on the testimony of only one witness.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato omonto agacha korwa ase egetwori gia Saulo; chianga chiaye nigo chiatandoire, na amaroba are ase omotwe oye. Ekero aigete ase Daudi, agekumba gochia inse ase okoorokia amasikani.
english: On the third day a man arrived from Saul's camp, with his clothes torn and with dust on his head. When he came to David, he fell to the ground to pay him honor.

ekegusii: Naende rituko ria gatato yarenge enyangi agwo Kana ya Galili, na ng’ina Yeso nao arenge.
english: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesus' mother was there,

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Ibrahimu akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora aase aria akare are.
english: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato Esteri akabeka chianga chiaye chi’oboting’ana, akagenda agatenena ase egoora ya ime, ase enyomba y’omoruoti erochie enyomba enene y’omoruoti. Omoruoti nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti kerochie gesieri ki’enyomba yaye.
english: On the third day Esther put on her royal robes and stood in the inner court of the palace, in front of the king's hall. The king was sitting on his royal throne in the hall, facing the entrance.

ekegusii: naende inabamoake emecharichi na komoita, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.”
english: On the third day he will rise again."

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato Labani agatebigwa ng’a Yakobo otamire.
english: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Eliabu, mosinto o Heloni bw’egesaku gia Sabuloni, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the third day, Eliab son of Helon, the leader of the people of Zebulun, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato Yusufu akabatebia, “Mokore iga buna ndabatebie, nario morabe moyo; naki inche nomonto imoirogete Nyasae.
english: On the third day, Joseph said to them, "Do this and you will live, for I fear God:

ekegusii: Rituko ria gatato bagatuguta ebinto bi’emeeri namaboko abo abanyene.
english: On the third day, they threw the ship's tackle overboard with their own hands.

ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na gatato ri’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere, noro omotienyi bw’Adari, rigaika. Ase rituko riria ogochika kw’omoruoti kware gocha goikeranigwa, ababisa b’Abayahudi nigo basemeretie ng’a mbababue, korende amang’ana konya aonchokire ng’a Abayahudi mbabue ababisa babo.
english: On the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, the edict commanded by the king was to be carried out. On this day the enemies of the Jews had hoped to overpower them, but now the tables were turned and the Jews got the upper hand over those who hated them.

ekegusii: Rituko ria ikomi na kabere Ahira, mosinto bw’Enani bw’egesaku kia Nafutali, akarenta okoruegwa kwaye.
english: On the twelfth day Ahira son of Enan, the leader of the people of Naphtali, brought his offering.

ekegusii: Bono ase rituko ria ikomi na kabere ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani tokarua agwo ase orooche rw’Ahawa kogenda Yerusalemu. Okoboko kwa Nyasae oito nigo kwarenge amo naintwe gototooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito, na korwa ase abanto barenge gotoboera inchera.
english: On the twelfth day of the first month we set out from the Ahava Canal to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was on us, and he protected us from enemies and bandits along the way.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere ri’omotienyi o kabere, ase omwaka o kabere, riire riria rikaimokerera igoro korwa ase Obomenyo bore noborori.
english: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud lifted from above the tabernacle of the Testimony.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na rimo, omotienyi o gatano na kabere, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rigateba:
english: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai:

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o ikomi nomo, noro okorokwa Sebati, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asende inche omobani Zakaria, mosinto o Berekia o Ido.
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Zechariah son of Berekiah, the son of Iddo.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, ekero nateneine ase engegu y’orooche roria oronene rwa Tigirisi,
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was standing on the bank of the great river, the Tigris,

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o kianda, omwaka o kabere, bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Dario, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Hagai omobani, rikamotebia:
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the LORD came to the prophet Haggai:

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane ri’omotienyi oyio, Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangererekana amo, beng’atete na beboyetie chigunia, bageaka ebundo ase emetwe yabo.
english: On the twenty-fourth day of the same month, the Israelites gathered together, fasting and wearing sackcloth and having dust on their heads.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo akorekanete ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na kane, omotienyi o gatano na rimo, omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Dario.
english: on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of King Darius.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’emerongo ebere na gatato ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere agatiga abanto bakagenda ase chinka chiabo bare nomochengo na omogoko ase chinkoro chiabo, ase engencho y’obuya boria Omonene aorogetie ase Daudi na ase Sulemani, na ase Abaisraeli, abanto baye.
english: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people to their homes, joyful and glad in heart for the good things the LORD had done for David and Solomon and for his people Israel.

ekegusii: Nigo banyenyete abana babo bakaba ebing’wanso ase emegwekano yabo bagosasima ase rituko erio bachete Aase aane Aachenu, bagaakora akaba aatachenegeti. Rora, amang’ana ayio naro bakorete ase enyomba yane ime.
english: On the very day they sacrificed their children to their idols, they entered my sanctuary and desecrated it. That is what they did in my house.

ekegusii: Sulemani agachabera chinyasi chionsi chie Hekalu, na echi’akanyomba ka ime, nemegwekano y’abakerubi, na ey’emekendo, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio.
english: On the walls all around the temple, in both the inner and outer rooms, he carved cherubim, palm trees and open flowers.

ekegusii: “Abanto abaratoore ensemo ya bosongo n’Abaefraimu, inse y’ebendera y’ekeombe kiabo. Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, nere orabe omotang’ani obo,
english: On the west will be the divisions of the camp of Ephraim under their standard. The leader of the people of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud.

ekegusii: Natwerie abakori amabe omorero bw’amakara, amagena agosamba na omwaga ore ne riberera ritindi, nigo birabe egesusuro kiabo.
english: On the wicked he will rain fiery coals and burning sulfur; a scorching wind will be their lot.

ekegusii: Ekero basiboirwe bakagenda ase abasani babo, bakabatebia aya onsi abakuani abanene na abagaaka babatebetie.
english: On their release, Peter and John went back to their own people and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said to them.

ekegusii: Ase orogendo rwa kabere Yusufu akemanyekania ase bamura bamwabo, na eamate ya Yusufu egacha, ekamanyekana ase Farao.
english: On their second visit, Joseph told his brothers who he was, and Pharaoh learned about Joseph's family.

ekegusii: bagatoora bosongo ya Kiriati‐Yearimu, ase ense ya Yuda. Ase engencho eyio aase aria akarokwa Egetwori kia Dani, naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: On their way they set up camp near Kiriath Jearim in Judah. This is why the place west of Kiriath Jearim is called Mahaneh Dan to this day.

ekegusii: Aiga ase egetunwa eke Omonene nasarie na korusia egietubo getubete abanto bonsi, ee, egietubo ekio keramboire igoro y’ebisaku bionsi.
english: On this mountain he will destroy the shroud that enfolds all peoples, the sheet that covers all nations;

ekegusii: Aiga ase egetunwa eke Omonene bw’Emeganda naroiserie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi omoyega bw’ebinto ebinoru, omoyega bw’edivai engiya mono, ee, oyo bw’ebinto ebinoru biichire emeseto, na edivai engiya ekenonoire.
english: On this mountain the LORD Almighty will prepare a feast of rich food for all peoples, a banquet of aged wine-- the best of meats and the finest of wines.

ekegusii: Ng’ai amaroso aye aterekereretwe? Gose ning’o obegete rigena riaye ri’ekoona,
english: On what were its footings set, or who laid its cornerstone--

ekegusii: Chianga chiano nigo chibwate ebimoa bi’amanyinga ’abanto abataka batari nokomocha. Ekero mwabaitete timwabanyorete bakobochora chinyomba chiaino, korende nase okogania kwaino mwabaitete.
english: On your clothes men find the lifeblood of the innocent poor, though you did not catch them breaking in. Yet in spite of all this

ekegusii: Ara rimo kera omwaka Haroni akore okobwatanigwa ase emegwekano ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero. Naboigo ara rimo kera omwaka nakorere egesasimero okobwatanigwa namanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Ayio nigo arakorerwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Egesasimero ekio nagiatananwe kebe egechenu mono ase Omonene.”
english: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on its horns. This annual atonement must be made with the blood of the atoning sin offering for the generations to come. It is most holy to the LORD."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaboria Omonene naende, na Omonene akamoiraneria, “Imoka, ogende Keila, ekiagera nimbeke Abafilisti ase okoboko kwao.”
english: Once again David inquired of the LORD, and the LORD answered him, "Go down to Keilah, for I am going to give the Philistines into your hand."

ekegusii: Akagenderera naende gokwana nere, “Aande baraisa kororekana rende emerongo ene?” Ere akairaneria, “Ase engencho y’abwo emerongo ene, tingosaria omochie.”
english: Once again he spoke to him, "What if only forty are found there?" He said, "For the sake of forty, I will not do it."

ekegusii: Agasoka naende, akagenda ensemo y’enyancha. Omoganda bwonsi okamochiera, ere akaborokereria.
english: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.

ekegusii: Naende Abaisraeli bagakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, na ase engencho y’ayio Omonene akabarentera Egiloni, omoruoti bw’ense ya Moabu, nere akabarwania, akababua.
english: Once again the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD, and because they did this evil the LORD gave Eglon king of Moab power over Israel.

ekegusii: Esegi ekaba naende ase egati y’Abafilisti na Abaisraeli, na Daudi agatirimboka amo nabarwani baye korwania Abafilisti. Daudi akaba orosire,
english: Once again there was a battle between the Philistines and Israel. David went down with his men to fight against the Philistines, and he became exhausted.

ekegusii: “Ase obochenu bwane natianire rimo ng’a tingokwana oborimo ase Daudi.
english: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness-- and I will not lie to David--

ekegusii: Inche iga narenge moyo agwo ritang’ani ekero ntarenge namachiko, korende ekero ogochika koria gwachete, ebibe bikaboka, na inche ngakwa.
english: Once I was alive apart from law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.

ekegusii: Na abatigari b’enyomba ya Yuda abaratooreke mbaame buna ebimeri biirete emeri inse mono bikinete gochia igoro, bikwama amatunda,
english: Once more a remnant of the house of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.

ekegusii: Na abatigari b’enyomba ya Yuda abaratooreke mbaame babe buna ebimeri biirete emeri inse mono na gokina gochia igoro, bikwama amatunda,
english: Once more a remnant of the house of Judah will take root below and bear fruit above.

ekegusii: Ense eye abanto bagokwana ng’a yasarigwe, yabeire erooro ase abanto batanyare komenya, gose ching’iti, naende ng’a yabekirwe ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, rora, emegondo negorwe naende aiga.
english: Once more fields will be bought in this land of which you say, 'It is a desolate waste, without men or animals, for it has been handed over to the Babylonians.'

ekegusii: Agaika naende Kana ya Galili, agwo ase aonchorete amache koba edivai. Narengeo omonto omosike ase Kapernaumu, oyorenge nomwana omorwaire.
english: Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.

ekegusii: Akagenda naende, agasaba, ogokwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.
english: Once more he went away and prayed the same thing.

ekegusii: Erio naende akabeka amaboko aye igoro ase amaiso aye. Omouko oria akarigereria mono, akagwena, akarora ebinto bionsi buya.
english: Once more Jesus put his hands on the man's eyes. Then his eyes were opened, his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia naende, “Inche nkogenda nde, na inwe namondigie, namokwe ase ebibe biaino; aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao.”
english: Once more Jesus said to them, "I am going away, and you will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where I go, you cannot come."

ekegusii: Pilato akaoroka naende isiko, akabatebia, “Rora, inche namorentire asemore, monyare komanya ng’a tindochi komocha konde asare.”
english: Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews, "Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him."

ekegusii: Erio abanto abaitongo nabanyore omogoko omoyia kobare ime ase Omonene, na abataka bare ase mwanyabanto mbagokere Omonene ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Once more the humble will rejoice in the LORD; the needy will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Naende Abafilisti bakagendao eria kabere, bagesiarera ase rikura ri’Abarefai.
english: Once more the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim;

ekegusii: Naende Abafilisti bakagenda aroro eria kabere bagasakora.
english: Once more the Philistines raided the valley;

ekegusii: Bakairaneria omoruoti eria kabere, “Aye omoruoti, tobebie intwe abasomba bao chindoto chiria, na intwe ntogotebie engencho yaye.”
english: Once more they replied, "Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will interpret it."

ekegusii: Esegi egatuboka naende, na Daudi akagenda korwania Abafilisti, akababua obobui obonene mono. Barabwo bagatama korwa asare.
english: Once more war broke out, and David went out and fought the Philistines. He struck them with such force that they fled before him.

ekegusii: Abaonchoreria na abaoonia bande bonsi nigo barenge korara isiko ya Yerusalemu ase rituko rigima, gose abere.
english: Once or twice the merchants and sellers of all kinds of goods spent the night outside Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Gatwatoorekire twensi, erio tokamanya ng’a egesinka keria nigo kiare korokwa Melita.
english: Once safely on shore, we found out that the island was called Malta.

ekegusii: Once the crowd realized that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum in search of Jesus.
english: Ekero omoganda ochia korora ng’a Yeso tari aroro, nonya naborokigwa baye, barabwo abanyene bagasoa amaato ime, bakagenda Kapernaumu, bakorigia Yeso.

ekegusii: Ekero omonyene enyomba araimoke na gosieka egesieri, inwe namochake gotenena isiko na gotura gesieri, mokobora, Omonene, toigorere, na ere nabairanerie: Timbamanyeti aase mokorwa.
english: Once the owner of the house gets up and closes the door, you will stand outside knocking and pleading, 'Sir, open the door for us.' "But he will answer, 'I don't know you or where you come from.'

ekegusii: Ekero abakuani barabe bagosoa Aase Aachenu tibagosoka korwa agwo gocha ase eraaro ya isiko bataruseti chianga chi’obokoreri bwabo, bachitige ase ebinyomba, ebio, ekiagera nebichenu bire. Goika babeke chianga ching’ao ekero bagosoka gochia aase abanto bare.”
english: Once the priests enter the holy precincts, they are not to go into the outer court until they leave behind the garments in which they minister, for these are holy. They are to put on other clothes before they go near the places that are for the people."

ekegusii: Bono ekero ebimanyererio ebio birakoreke asore, okore rinde rionsi orarore, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo naye.
english: Once these signs are fulfilled, do whatever your hand finds to do, for God is with you.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo Yakobo naiyegete omosori gete. Esau agacha korwa orosana, konya orosire mono, ogoyire ase engencho y’enchara.
english: Once when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the open country, famished.

ekegusii: Agachia koba ngosaba are ere bweka, aborokigwa baye nigo barenge amo nere, akababoria, “Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a ninche ng’o?”
english: Once when Jesus was praying in private and his disciples were with him, he asked them, "Who do the crowds say I am?"

ekegusii: Rituko erimo nyuma kobakoorire koragera na konywa aaria Silo, Hana akaimoka, na ase emechando yaye akarera mono ore nobororo, agasaba Omonene. Eli nao aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ang’e nomotobwa bw’egesieri gie Hekalu y’Omonene.
english: Once when they had finished eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah stood up. Now Eli the priest was sitting on a chair by the doorpost of the LORD's temple.

ekegusii: Ekero tware kogenda aase aria tware gosabera, tokaumerana nomoiseke omosomba oyobwatire nekerecha ki’oboringoria. Ere nigo arenge konyorera abanene baye enibo enyinge ase oboringoria bwaye.
english: Once when we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a slave girl who had a spirit by which she predicted the future. She earned a great deal of money for her owners by fortune-telling.

ekegusii: Na ekero rika ria Zakaria ri’ogokora emeremo y’obokuani ase obosio bwa Nyasae riarenge,
english: Once when Zechariah's division was on duty and he was serving as priest before God,

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero omonto oyomo akwete arenge gotindekwa, ekeombe ekemo kia biria kegacha, na abanto babogoretie omobere oria, bakayoruta ase oboina bw’Elisha. Ekero ogweteo ogakuna amauga ’Elisha, okaboka na koba moyo, agatenena namagoro aye.
english: Once while some Israelites were burying a man, suddenly they saw a band of raiders; so they threw the man's body into Elisha's tomb. When the body touched Elisha's bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet.

ekegusii: Kare ngwakwanete nabegenwa bao ase okorora, okabatebia, “Narentire ogokonywa goetera ase oyomo ore nokobua, naimokereirie igoro oyomo nachorire korwa ase egati y’abanto.
english: Once you spoke in a vision, to your faithful people you said: "I have bestowed strength on a warrior; I have exalted a young man from among the people.

ekegusii: Na inwe agwo ritang’ani nigo mwarenge mwatananire korwa ase Nyasae, mwarenge nobobisa ase ebirengererio biaino ase ogokora kwaino okobe.
english: Once you were alienated from God and were enemies in your minds because of your evil behavior.

ekegusii: Inwe agwo kare timwarenge abanto ba Nyasae, korende bono mwabeire abanto baye; ritang’ani timwanyorete amabera, korende bono mwanyorire amabera.
english: Once you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; once you had not received mercy, but now you have received mercy.

ekegusii: Yeso agachia koborigwa n’Abafarisai, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae indi borache?” Akabairaneria, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae tibori gocha ase ebimanyererio bikororekana,
english: Once, having been asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus replied, "The kingdom of God does not come with your careful observation,

ekegusii: Nigo morabe nogochika okomo ase oyio okorire ebibe mosiabano, atancheti, karabe omobiare bw’Abaisraeli, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yaino.
english: One and the same law applies to everyone who sins unintentionally, whether he is a native-born Israelite or an alien.

ekegusii: Erimo ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na erinde eki’ogosambwa, ayarue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase obosio bwane ase omonto oria ogochia gochenwa.”
english: one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, together with the grain offering. In this way the priest will make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the one to be cleansed."

ekegusii: Egetonga ekemo nigo kiarenge namako amaya mono amatobu, aya atongoretwe, na egetonga kende nigo kiarenge namako amabe mono atarenge konyara koriegwa.
english: One basket had very good figs, like those that ripen early; the other basket had very poor figs, so bad they could not be eaten.

ekegusii: Kera omonto oyorigetwe, oyokoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, akarua ebeka eyemo, engencho yaye ekeng’ese gi’esekeli ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu. Abanto abwo nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano na rimo na isato, na amagana atano, na emerongo etano (603,550).
english: one beka per person, that is, half a shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, from everyone who had crossed over to those counted, twenty years old or more, a total of 603,550 men.

ekegusii: Rimumu erimo ribe inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio amamumu abe inse ye chinsagia echio isano nemo, chiroisigwe chibe egento ekemo ne ritina.
english: One bud shall be under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair-- six branches in all.

ekegusii: Rimumu erimo rikaba inse ya kera chinsagia ibere chigosoka korwa ase ritina. Ase ayio rikaba rimumu erimo inse ya kera orosagia rw’echio isano nemo chiroisirie chikaba egento ekemo ne ritina.
english: One bud was under the first pair of branches extending from the lampstand, a second bud under the second pair, and a third bud under the third pair-- six branches in all.

ekegusii: Egetare ekemo nigo giachongororogete ensemo ya sugusu kororia Mikimasi, na ekende ensemo ya irianyi kororia Geba.
english: One cliff stood to the north toward Micmash, the other to the south toward Geba.

ekegusii: Omominyoki oyomo naminyoke aumerane noyonde, na omotomwa oyomo naminyoke aumerane noyonde, kogenda gotebia omoruoti o Babeli ng’a omochie obwatirwe ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi,
english: One courier follows another and messenger follows messenger to announce to the king of Babylon that his entire city is captured,

ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero Yeso arenge kworokereria abanto Hekalu ime, na korandia enchili, abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko amo nabagaaka bakamoorokera,
english: One day as he was teaching the people in the temple courts and preaching the gospel, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, together with the elders, came up to him.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo ri’amatuko aria ekero arenge kworokereria, Abafarisai na aborokia b’amachiko barenge aroro baikaransete. Abwo baruete ase kera omochie o Galili na Boyahudi, na korwa Yerusalemu. Na okobua kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge amo nere anyare kogwenia.
english: One day as he was teaching, Pharisees and teachers of the law, who had come from every village of Galilee and from Judea and Jerusalem, were sitting there. And the power of the Lord was present for him to heal the sick.

ekegusii: Ekaba abanto nkomomiga baare, erinde baigwe ring’ana ria Nyasae, agatenena ase engegu y’enyancha ya Genesareti,
english: One day as Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret, with the people crowding around him and listening to the word of God,

ekegusii: Ang’e ne chinsa kianda chia mobaso akarora ase okorora maiso marore omomalaika o Nyasae akomochera, akamotebia, “Kornelio!”
english: One day at about three in the afternoon he had a vision. He distinctly saw an angel of God, who came to him and said, "Cornelius!"

ekegusii: Rituko erimo Elisha akagenda Sunemu, agwo ase omokungu omonda amenyete. Nere omosororerete arie endagera. Ase ayio, kero kende gionsi Elisha arenge goeta ase enchera eria nigo arenge gosoa enyomba eria oria endagera.
english: One day Elisha went to Shunem. And a well-to-do woman was there, who urged him to stay for a meal. So whenever he came by, he stopped there to eat.

ekegusii: Ekaba rituko erimo, ekero Yusufu asoete nyomba gokora emeremo yaye, gose monto onde bw’abanto b’enyomba eria tarengeo,
english: One day he went into the house to attend to his duties, and none of the household servants was inside.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo nkagenda ase enyomba ya Semaya, mosinto o Delaya o Mehetabeli, oyio osiekeire mwaye. Ere agantebia, “Togende komo ase enyomba ya Nyasae, ase Hekalu eria ime, tosieke ebisieri bie Hekalu, ekiagera abanto abwo ngocha bare kogoita. Nigo barache ase obotuko bwa rero, bagoite bagosirie.”
english: One day I went to the house of Shemaiah son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home. He said, "Let us meet in the house of God, inside the temple, and let us close the temple doors, because men are coming to kill you-- by night they are coming to kill you."

ekegusii: Rituko erimo akariina obwato, ere na aborokigwa baye, akabatebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu y’enyancha.” Bakamanora.
english: One day Jesus said to his disciples, "Let's go over to the other side of the lake." So they got into a boat and set out.

ekegusii: Ngosaba arenge aase gete. Gakoorire, oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye akamotebia, “Omonene, tworokie ogosaba buna Yohana orokereretie aborokigwa baye.”
english: One day Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he finished, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."

ekegusii: Rituko erimo Yonathani, omomura o Saulo, agatebia omomura oyorenge komobogoreria ebirwanero. “Inchuo togende gochia ase eburi y’abarwani b’Abafilisti korwa ensinyo ngumbu.” Korende tatebetie ise amang’ana ayio.
english: One day Jonathan son of Saul said to the young man bearing his armor, "Come, let's go over to the Philistine outpost on the other side." But he did not tell his father.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo Naomi agatebia Rutu, moka momura oye, “Narorire ng’a mbuya nkonyorere omosacha, erinde onyore enka yao.
english: One day Naomi her mother-in-law said to her, "My daughter, should I not try to find a home for you, where you will be well provided for?

ekegusii: Petero na Yohana nigo barenge gotiira gochia ase Hekalu chinsa chi’ogosaba, chinsa kianda.
english: One day Peter and John were going up to the temple at the time of prayer-- at three in the afternoon.

ekegusii: Samison akagenda Gasa, na aroro akarora omokungu omotayayi, akagenda akarara nere.
english: One day Samson went to Gaza, where he saw a prostitute. He went in to spend the night with her.

ekegusii: Bono ekaba ng’a rituko erimo ekero abana ba Nyasae bachete kweorokia ase obosio bw’Omonene, Saitani nere agacha agwo ase baare.
english: One day the angels came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came with them.

ekegusii: Omoiseke oye omotangi agatebia oyomwabo omoke, “Tata ogotire, gose monto onde tari ase ense oyorache gotonyuoma buna engencho y’ense yonsi ere.
english: One day the older daughter said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is no man around here to lie with us, as is the custom all over the earth.

ekegusii: Agwo kare ekaba ng’a emete ekagenda gochora eruoti ekoyegambera. Egatebia omozeituni: Togambere!
english: One day the trees went out to anoint a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, 'Be our king.'

ekegusii: Rituko erimo Elisha agacha aase aria, agasoa akanyomba karia, agatimokera aroro,
english: One day when Elisha came, he went up to his room and lay down there.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo ekero abana b’Ayubu, abamura na abaiseke, babwate omoyega bw’okoria na konywa edivai ase enyomba ya momura omwabo omonene,
english: One day when Job's sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother's house,

ekegusii: Ekero Asika achete bw’Otinieli, akamoboria asabe ise amoe oboremo. Asika akaayerera goika korwa ase etigere igoro. Erio Kalebu akamoboria, “Inki otagete?”
english: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"

ekegusii: Ekero Asika aigete bw’Otinieli, akamoboria asabe ise amoe oboremo. Erio agwo Asika agaika korwa etigere igoro, na Kalebu akamoboria, “Ninki oganetie?”
english: One day when she came to Othniel, she urged him to ask her father for a field. When she got off her donkey, Caleb asked her, "What can I do for you?"

ekegusii: Egachia koba ekero Musa abeire omonto omonene, rituko erimo akagenda gokwania Abaibirania bamwabo, akarora buna baare gokorigwa emeremo emekong’u. Agwo akarora Omomisiri ogoaka oyomo bw’Abaibirania bamwabo.
english: One day, after Moses had grown up, he went out to where his own people were and watched them at their hard labor. He saw an Egyptian beating a Hebrew, one of his own people.

ekegusii: Ekero arenge gosasima ime ase enyomba ya Nisiroki, enyasae yaye, Adarameleki na Sareseri, abamura baye, bakamoita nemioro; erio bagatama gochia ase ense y’Ararati, na Esara‐Hadoni, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer cut him down with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ekero arenge gosasima ime ase enyomba ya Nisiroki, enyasae yaye, Adarameleki na Sareseri, abamura baye, bakamoita nemioro, erio bagatama gochia ase ense y’Ararati. Ezara‐Hadoni, omomura oye, akaba omoruoti ribaga riaye.
english: One day, while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer cut him down with the sword, and they escaped to the land of Ararat. And Esarhaddon his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ekaba ase rituko erimo chinsa chia mogoroba, Daudi akaimoka korwa borere bwaye, akariina kerama igoro, ase enyomba yaye y’oboruoti. Ekero arenge gotaarao, akarora omokungu ogwesibia, na omokungu oyio nigo arenge omonyakieni mono.
english: One evening David got up from his bed and walked around on the roof of the palace. From the roof he saw a woman bathing. The woman was very beautiful,

ekegusii: Emeremo yao netogigwe ebiaare ase ebiaare. Mbirarie ogokora kwao kore okonene.
english: One generation will commend your works to another; they will tell of your mighty acts.

ekegusii: Nyasae oyomo, nere Tata o bonsi, oyore igoro ase bonsi, goetera ase bonsi, na ime ase bonsi.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.

ekegusii: Naende akarua egetaabo ekemo gi’etahabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli ikomi, giaichire na ubani.
english: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;

ekegusii: Naende akarua egetaabo ekemo gi’etahabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli ikomi giaichire na ubani.
english: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;

ekegusii: Naende akarua egetaabo ekemo gi’etahahu y’oborito bwe chisekeli ikomi, giaichire na ubani.
english: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;

ekegusii: One he set up in Bethel, and the other in Dan.
english: Akabeka eyemo Beteli na eya kabere agwo Dani.

ekegusii: Omonene oyomo, okwegena okomo, ebatiso eyemo,
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;

ekegusii: one male goat for a sin offering;
english: na egoree eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

ekegusii: one male goat for a sin offering;
english: na egoree eyemo ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo narengereretie ng’a rituko erimo nerinene kobua erinde, na oyonde arora ng’a amatuko onsi nigo areng’aine. Tiga kera omonto aisaneke ase aya amanyete omonyene.
english: One man considers one day more sacred than another; another man considers every day alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.

ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo nigo agokwa ore nobotenenku obonge, ore nobotoereru bwonsi na orendire buya,
english: One man dies in full vigor, completely secure and at ease,

ekegusii: Naende mochore korwa ase kera egesaku omonto oyomo ore omoteneneri obo. Barabwo babe amo nainwe ase okobakonya.
english: One man from each tribe, each the head of his family, is to help you.

ekegusii: Nare omonto okorua ebinto ebinge, ere nigo akomenteranigwa ebinge goetania, na nare oyonde ore omogoko otari korua, ere nigo akogenderera kona‐koremerwa.
english: One man gives freely, yet gains even more; another withholds unduly, but comes to poverty.

ekegusii: Omonto nare ogwekora ng’a nomonda are, korende nigo are omotaka, na oyonde bwekora ng’a nomotaka are, korende nigo are omonda mono.
english: One man pretends to be rich, yet has nothing; another pretends to be poor, yet has great wealth.

ekegusii: Omonto akaminyoka bwango, akaimokia esifunchi, akayeichoria chinkama, akayebeka igoro ase egetonto, akamoa anywe, okobora, “Tiga torore gose Elija ngocha are komoikia.”
english: One man ran, filled a sponge with wine vinegar, put it on a stick, and offered it to Jesus to drink. "Now leave him alone. Let's see if Elijah comes to take him down," he said.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bwegenete ng’a nanyare koria bionsi, korende ere oyotari na nguru nigo akoria chinyeni.
english: One man's faith allows him to eat everything, but another man, whose faith is weak, eats only vegetables.

ekegusii: Igo nenyare gotebwa, ng’a goetera ase Ibrahimu nonya Lawi, oyore konyora ensemo ya ikomi, nere naruete ensemo ya ikomi,
english: One might even say that Levi, who collects the tenth, paid the tenth through Abraham,

ekegusii: Egesaku gekaba gekorwana negesaku kende, na omochie okaba okorwana nomochie onde, ekiagera Nyasae nigo abarenterete emechando emenge ere ao ao goika bagasirania.
english: One nation was being crushed by another and one city by another, because God was troubling them with every kind of distress.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria amaiso a Eli konya achakire koba chinchingori, tare korora buya. Ase obotuko obomo ere nigo arenge oraire aase aye a botambe,
english: One night Eli, whose eyes were becoming so weak that he could barely see, was lying down in his usual place.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Paulo botuko ase okorora, “Toiroka, korende kwana, tokira,
english: One night the Lord spoke to Paul in a vision: "Do not be afraid; keep on speaking, do not be silent.

ekegusii: Peka, mosinto o Remalia, omotang’ani bw’abarwani esegi baye, agakora omoroberio amo n’Abagileadi emerongo etano bw’ogoita Pekahia, barabwo bakamoitera agwo Samaria, agaita n’Arigobu na Arie, ase enyomba enene y’omoruoti.
english: One of his chief officers, Pekah son of Remaliah, conspired against him. Taking fifty men of Gilead with him, he assassinated Pekahiah, along with Argob and Arieh, in the citadel of the royal palace at Samaria. So Pekah killed Pekahiah and succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba baye agateba, “Tiga totome abanto bagende boyie chibarasi isano korwa ase echio chitigarete ase omochie, baroote tomanye amang’ana buna are. Emechando erabanyore abanto abwo tekoba emebe kobua ey’abwo batigarete ase omochie, gose ey’Abaisraeli bonsi basiririe obogima bwabo.
english: One of his officers answered, "Have some men take five of the horses that are left in the city. Their plight will be like that of all the Israelites left here-- yes, they will only be like all these Israelites who are doomed. So let us send them to find out what happened."

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Yoabu agatenena ang’e nomobere bw’Amasa akabora, “Oyo omwanchete Yoabu na oyore o Daudi, tiga atunyane Yoabu.”
english: One of Joab's men stood beside Amasa and said, "Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, let him follow Joab!"

ekegusii: Oyomo bwa baria abasaria babambetwe akamorama, akabora, “Inee! Tari aye Kristo? Etoorie aye omonyene, naintwe ototoorie.”
english: One of the criminals who hung there hurled insults at him: "Aren't you the Christ? Save yourself and us!"

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’amachiko akairaneria, akamotebia, “Omworokia, kogoteba aya, nigo ogotochaya naintwe.”
english: One of the experts in the law answered him, "Teacher, when you say these things, you insult us also."

ekegusii: Omotwe oyomo bw’emetwe y’eng’iti eria okarorekana buna nore norogoma rw’amakweri, korende orogoma rwaye rw’amakweri rokagwenigwa, na ense yonsi egakumia ase eng’iti eria na koyetunyana.
english: One of the heads of the beast seemed to have had a fatal wound, but the fatal wound had been healed. The whole world was astonished and followed the beast.

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba b’omokuani, omoamate bw’oria onachetwe ogoto na Petero, akabora, “Inche tinakoroche ime ase omogondo amo nere?”
english: One of the high priest's servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged him, "Didn't I see you with him in the olive grove?"

ekegusii: Erio oyomo bw’abasomba baye akamotebia, “Yese, omonto o Bethlehemu, nabwate omomura omanyete kobugia obokano buya. Ere nigo are omonto omoremu, omanyete korwana esegi; amo nayio nigo are omonyakieni, omanyete gokwana buya, na Omonene nigo are amo nere.”
english: One of the servants answered, "I have seen a son of Jesse of Bethlehem who knows how to play the harp. He is a brave man and a warrior. He speaks well and is a fine-looking man. And the LORD is with him."

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abasomba ba Nabali agatebia Abigaeli, moka Nabali, amang’ana ng’a, “Daudi natoma abanto korwa ase erooro gocha gokwania omonene oito, korende ere akabatogonyera.
english: One of the servants told Nabal's wife Abigail: "David sent messengers from the desert to give our master his greetings, but he hurled insults at them.

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abamalaika baria batano na babere, abarenge nebitaabo bitano na bibere, agacha, agakwana nainche, agantebia, “Inchuo aiga, nkworokie okogambigwa kw’omotayayi oria omonene oikaransete igoro ase amache amange.
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and said to me, "Come, I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute, who sits on many waters.

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abamalaika baria batano na babere, abarenge nebitaabo bitano na bibere biichire amaakwa aria atano na abere ay’omoerio, agacha, agakwana nainche na goteba, “Inchuo aiga, na inche ninkworokie omoriakari, omokungu bw’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi.”
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came and said to me, "Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."

ekegusii: Oyomo bw’abamura ba Yoyada, mosinto bw’Eliasibu, omokuani omonene, konya onyuomire omoiseke o Sanibalati Omohoroni; ase ayio nkamoseria korwa asende.
english: One of the sons of Joiada son of Eliashib the high priest was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite. And I drove him away from me.

ekegusii: Oyomo ase aborokia b’amariko agacha akabaigwa bakoamererania nere, akamanya ng’a obairaneirie buya, akamoboria, “Ase amachiko onsi ndiriri rire rie ritang’ani?”
english: One of the teachers of the law came and heard them debating. Noticing that Jesus had given them a good answer, he asked him, "Of all the commandments, which is the most important?"

ekegusii: Oyomo akaboria omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani oteneine ase amache a rooche igoro, “Nengaki eng’ana naki erabe goika omoerio oche, na amakumia aya abe?”
english: One of them said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, "How long will it be before these astonishing things are fulfilled?"

ekegusii: Omokungu oyomo agakwana, agateba, “Aye omonene one, inche amo nomokungu oyo nigo tomenyete ase enyomba eyemo; nkaibora omwana ekero ere arenge ase enyomba eria.
english: One of them said, "My lord, this woman and I live in the same house. I had a baby while she was there with me.

ekegusii: Oyomo nigo ansirerete, na inche ngateba: Tekomocha koba ng’a neching’iti chi’orosana chiamoitete, tinana komorora goika rero iga.
english: One of them went away from me, and I said, "He has surely been torn to pieces." And I have not seen him since.

ekegusii: Oyomo obo akagenda mogondo kwaa chinyeni, na agwo akanyora ekemeri ki’orosana gekoranda, nere agatwa emiongo y’orosana korwa ase ekemeri keria, agaichoria egetambaa kiaye. Erio akayenachana, akayebeka ase omosori ime; tamanyete ng’a miongo ki yarenge.
english: One of them went out into the fields to gather herbs and found a wild vine. He gathered some of its gourds and filled the fold of his cloak. When he returned, he cut them up into the pot of stew, though no one knew what they were.

ekegusii: Oyomo ase barabwo, omonto bw’amachiko, akamoboria ase okomoteema,
english: One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question:

ekegusii: Oyomo obo, ore korokwa Agabo, agatenena akabana ase Omoika Omochenu, ng’a enchara enene nechiche ase ense engima; ero ekaba ekero Klaudio are kogamba.
english: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and through the Spirit predicted that a severe famine would spread over the entire Roman world. (This happened during the reign of Claudius.)

ekegusii: Oyomo obo, erieta riaye Kiliopa, akamoiraneria, “Inee! Naye bweka ore omogeni ase Yerusalemu, otamanyeti ayare ime yaye amatuko aya?”
english: One of them, named Cleopas, asked him, "Are you only a visitor to Jerusalem and do not know the things that have happened there in these days?"

ekegusii: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.
english: Narenge aroro oyomo bw’aborokigwa baye, oyobweegegete Yeso egekuba kiaye, oyo Yeso anchete.

ekegusii: Oyomo obo agachia korora ng’a osibekire, akairana okomobaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene,
english: One of them, when he saw he was healed, came back, praising God in a loud voice.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria akaimoka akagenda ase egetunwa gosaba; akabao obotuko bwonsi ase ogosaba Nyasae.
english: One of those days Jesus went out to a mountainside to pray, and spent the night praying to God.

ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu oyomo ore korokwa Lidia; ere nigo arenge omosasimi Nyasae. Nigo arwete omochie o Tiatira; naende nigo arenge omoonia bw’ebitambaa bimonyinga. Ere agatotegerera. Omonene akaigora enkoro yaye, erinde akaigwa amang’ana Paulo arenge gokwana.
english: One of those listening was a woman named Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who was a worshiper of God. The Lord opened her heart to respond to Paul's message.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo oino nanyare goseria abanto elifu eyemo, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere okobarwanera esegi, buna abarierete eira.
english: One of you routs a thousand, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as he promised.

ekegusii: Aande gose nontebie, “Nase ki nonya mbono Nyasae akonyora okomocha ase mwanyabanto? Naki ning’o oranyare koamereria okorigia kwaye?”
english: One of you will say to me: "Then why does God still blame us? For who resists his will?"

ekegusii: Yeso agachia koba ngoeta arenge ase emegondo y’engano ase rituko ri’Esabato; aborokigwa baye bagachaka kobutora ebigara kobakogenda.
english: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and as his disciples walked along, they began to pick some heads of grain.

ekegusii: Rituko ri’Esabato Yeso ngoeta arenge ase emegondo y’engano; aborokigwa baye bakabutora ebigara, bakabibunga namaboko abo, bakabiria.
english: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and his disciples began to pick some heads of grain, rub them in their hands and eat the kernels.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo ri’Esabato, ekero asoete ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo, omonene bw’Abafarisai, arie endagera, nigo barenge bamorigereretie.
english: One Sabbath, when Jesus went to eat in the house of a prominent Pharisee, he was being carefully watched.

ekegusii: One thing God has spoken, two things have I heard: that you, O God, are strong,
english: Nyasae okwanire ara rimo, ee, nabeire nkoyaigwa chintunda ibere, ng’a Nyasae nere omonyene okobua.

ekegusii: Nasabire ring’ana erimo korwa ase Omonene. Erio nario nganetie: Imenye ase enyomba y’Omonene ase amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane, erinde ndore oboseera bw’Omonene na kona‐koboiranerera ase Hekalu yaye.
english: One thing I ask of the LORD, this is what I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze upon the beauty of the LORD and to seek him in his temple.

ekegusii: “Oyo okobaatera enchera nabatang’ane; barabwo mbagareyie, baetere ase egeita, basoke isiko. Omoruoti obo nabaraae, ee, Omonene nabatang’ane bosio bwabo.”
english: One who breaks open the way will go up before them; they will break through the gate and go out. Their king will pass through before them, the LORD at their head."

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo, oyotamete korwa ase abooswa, akagenda agatebia Aburamu Omoibirania, oyomenyete ase akanani k’emete enga buna emetontera ka Mamure, oria Omoamori, momura omwabo Esikoli na Aneri. Abwo konya bakorire okobwatana na Aburamu.
english: One who had escaped came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the great trees of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshcol and Aner, all of whom were allied with Abram.

ekegusii: Ere igo obeire omokuani, tari ase ogochika kw’omoroberio bw’ogotunyana ororeria, korende nase chinguru chi’obogima botari nomoerio.
english: one who has become a priest not on the basis of a regulation as to his ancestry but on the basis of the power of an indestructible life.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokora emeremo yaye nobworo nigo are oyomwabo omosaria.
english: One who is slack in his work is brother to one who destroys.

ekegusii: Narenge aroro omonto gete oyorenge noborwaire bw’emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato.
english: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.

ekegusii: Oyomo natebe ng’a noyo bw’Omonene are, na oyonde eroke erieta ria Yakobo, na oyonde arike ase okoboko kwaye ng’a ere noyo bw’Omonene, erio eroke Omoisraeli, erieta ri’ogosikwa.”
english: One will say, 'I belong to the LORD'; another will call himself by the name of Jacob; still another will write on his hand, 'The LORD's,' and will take the name Israel.

ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera orobaba rwa kera oyomo nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano; korwa ensinyo y’orobaba oromo goika ey’oronde nigo bwarenge obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi.
english: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing five cubits-- ten cubits from wing tip to wing tip.

ekegusii: “Omonto oyomo bweka tagoisana koba kirori igoro ase omonto onde okorire ogosaria, gose ebibe binde bionsi akorire; korende ekina nigo keranachwe ekero birori babere gose batato bakwanire oborori bwabo.
english: One witness is not enough to convict a man accused of any crime or offense he may have committed. A matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.

ekegusii: Boigo akarua eeri ensae, na emingichi eyemo, na emanwa emingichi eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo, chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa,
english: one young bull, one ram and one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

ekegusii: Boigo akarua eeri ensae, na emingichi eyemo, na emanwa emengichi eyemo yakoorire omwaka oyomo, chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa,
english: one young bull, one ram and one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

ekegusii: Inwe ancha rioka ng’a nabamochi more, naende ng’a mwasaririe asende inche Omonene, Nyasae oino; mwabeire mokogenda gochia aaria na aaria inse y’emete yonsi emebese mogosasima chinyasae ching’ao, timwaigwerete eriogi riane.” Omonene otebire ayio.
english: Only acknowledge your guilt-- you have rebelled against the LORD your God, you have scattered your favors to foreign gods under every spreading tree, and have not obeyed me,'" declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Mwerende! Morende chinkoro chiaino, erinde timobaisa kweba aya mwarorire namaiso aino, gose koyatiga arue ase chinkoro chiaino ase amatuko onsi more moyo. Boigo moyorokererie abana baino na abachokoro baino,
english: Only be careful, and watch yourselves closely so that you do not forget the things your eyes have seen or let them slip from your heart as long as you live. Teach them to your children and to their children after them.

ekegusii: Timobaisa kwanga koigwera Omonene, na timobaisa kwoboa ababiare b’ense eria; abwo nigo barabe asetore buna endagera. Baurirwe okorendwa kwabo; Omonene nigo are amo naintwe; timobairoka.”
english: Only do not rebel against the LORD. And do not be afraid of the people of the land, because we will swallow them up. Their protection is gone, but the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them."

ekegusii: Korende eki more nakio kebwate goika nchiche.
english: Only hold on to what you have until I come.

ekegusii: Yonathani, mosinto bw’Asaeli, na Yaseya, mosinto o Tikiwa, barabwo tibanchete amang’ana aria, na Mesulamu na Sabetai Omolawi bakababwatisia.
english: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah, supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite, opposed this.

ekegusii: Korende togenderere ase ayio ayio twaigete konyora.
english: Only let us live up to what we have already attained.

ekegusii: Luka bweka ore aiga amo nainche. Orentane Mariko, moche komo, ekiagera ere nigo aranyare gonkonya mono.
english: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is helpful to me in my ministry.

ekegusii: Inyigorere ebiita bi’oboronge, erio nsoere aroro imbe ngoaka ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene.
english: Open for me the gates of righteousness; I will enter and give thanks to the LORD.

ekegusii: Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in your law.
english: Indamokie amaiso, inyare korora amang’ana ’ogokumia ay’amachiko ao.

ekegusii: Open the gates that the righteous nation may enter, the nation that keeps faith.
english: Igora ebiita bi’omochie oyio, erinde egesaku kere noboronge na obwegenwa kenyare gosoa imeo.

ekegusii: Open your doors, O Lebanon, so that fire may devour your cedars!
english: Aye Lebanoni, igora ebisieri biao, erinde omorero osambe emecharake yao.

ekegusii: na Ofiri, na Havila, na Yobabu. Abwo bonsi nabwo abana ba Yokitani.
english: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

ekegusii: Ofiri na Havila, na Yobabu. Abwo bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura ba Yokitani.
english: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

ekegusii: Korende abanto bande b’esinagogi yare korokwa Esinagogi y’Abasibore, aba nigo barenge Abakurene na Abaaleksanderia, na baria korwa ase Kilikia na Asia, bakaimoka bakaamererania na Stefano.
english: Opposition arose, however, from members of the Synagogue of the Freedmen (as it was called)-- Jews of Cyrene and Alexandria as well as the provinces of Cilicia and Asia. These men began to argue with Stephen,

ekegusii: Omonto nigo akonyora egesusuro gi’okomorongeyia, ekero are nobororo ase oborere bwaye, na amauga aye agendererete komwatia.
english: Or a man may be chastened on a bed of pain with constant distress in his bones,

ekegusii: boigo na omoiseke omwabo ore omwekungi, oyo otaraba nomosacha; asare nigo are ne ribaga gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka.
english: or an unmarried sister who is dependent on him since she has no husband-- for her he may make himself unclean.

ekegusii: Intwe titoagacheti chinyomba chi’okomenya, gose titobwati emegondo y’emesabibu, gose ey’okobusura, gose chimbusuro.
english: or built houses to live in or had vineyards, fields or crops.

ekegusii: gose ase ense, ekiagera nao egeteni kiaye gi’okobekera amagoro; gose ase Yerusalemu, ekiagera noro omochie bw’Omoruoti omonene.
english: or by the earth, for it is his footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the Great King.

ekegusii: gose oyokorangeria ebirecha, gose okorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abakure, gose oborogi bonde bwonsi.
english: or casts spells, or who is a medium or spiritist or who consults the dead.

ekegusii: Gose ngwachayire obonge bw’obuya bwaye, na oboremereria bwaye, na okoganya kwaye, na tomanyeti ng’a obuya bwa Nyasae nigo borigetie gokoraa gochia ase okoonchoka?
english: Or do you show contempt for the riches of his kindness, tolerance and patience, not realizing that God's kindness leads you toward repentance?

ekegusii: Gose nigo mokagete ng’a namang’ana a bosa, ekero amariko agoteba iga, “Omoika oyomenyete ime yaito nigo okogania ore ne risemi.”
english: Or do you think Scripture says without reason that the spirit he caused to live in us envies intensely?

ekegusii: Timomanyeti ng’a intwe twensi abatwabatisetwe ase Kristo Yeso nigo twabatisetwe ase amakweri aye?
english: Or don't you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

ekegusii: Tiga abanto babwaterere oborendi bwane mbarende ne chinguru chiane; tiga bakore omorembe nainche, ee, barabwo mbabe nomorembe nainche.”
english: Or else let them come to me for refuge; let them make peace with me, yes, let them make peace with me."

ekegusii: Gose timwana gosoma ase amachiko buna ase rituko ri’ Esabato abakuani be Hekalu nigo bagosaria Esabato, na barabwo tibakoba nokomocha?
english: Or haven't you read in the Law that on the Sabbath the priests in the temple desecrate the day and yet are innocent?

ekegusii: Oise koboorokia, na omonto onde aise koigwa ayio, nigo aragosookie, na erieta riao risareke kogenderera botambe.
english: or he who hears it may shame you and you will never lose your bad reputation.

ekegusii: Boigo onye omonto obwate rigena ase okoboko kwaye oakire omonto onde, na omonto oria okure, omoiti oyio nere goika aitwe akwe, ekiagera ere nomoiti omoenenu.
english: Or if anyone has a stone in his hand that could kill, and he strikes someone so that he dies, he is a murderer; the murderer shall be put to death.

ekegusii: Gose onye omonto oakire omonto onde nomote abwate ase okoboko kwaye, erinde omonto oria akwe, omoiti oyio nigo aita oria moeneno, nere goika aitwe akwe.
english: Or if anyone has a wooden object in his hand that could kill, and he hits someone so that he dies, he is a murderer; the murderer shall be put to death.

ekegusii: Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake?
english: Gose karamosabe enswe, namoe eng’iti?

ekegusii: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
english: Gose karamosabe rigena ri’engoko namoe ekeuge?

ekegusii: gose onyorire egento giasirete, naende akane na gotiana ng’a takenyorete, bibe ebibe binde bionsi abanto bagokora,
english: or if he finds lost property and lies about it, or if he swears falsely, or if he commits any such sin that people may do--

ekegusii: or if he touches any crawling thing that makes him unclean, or any person who makes him unclean, whatever the uncleanness may be.
english: na onde bwensi orakune eng’iti ekwagura, eye eramokore abe oyotachenegeti, gose akune omonto oragere abe oyotachenegeti, ogotacheneka kwaye gakorabe okw’engencho ende yonsi.

ekegusii: gose ase engencho y’obobisa bwarengeo agaaka oyonde nokoboko kwaye na komoita, rirorio omonto oria oaka oyonde na komoita, nere goika aitwe akwe. Ere nomoiti. Omonto oria okogania korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo, nere oramoite aande onsi ase araumerane nere.
english: or if in hostility he hits him with his fist so that he dies, that person shall be put to death; he is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

ekegusii: Naende bayea oyotamanyeti gosoma, bamotebia: “Soma amang’ana ’ebuku eye,” nere nigo agokana, oteba, “Timanyeti gosoma.”
english: Or if you give the scroll to someone who cannot read, and say, "Read this, please," he will answer, "I don't know how to read."

ekegusii: Gose ninche bweka na Barnaba totari ne ribaga ri’ogotiga emeremo ya kera rituko?
english: Or is it only I and Barnabas who must work for a living?

ekegusii: gose omogwekano ogwekaine eng’iti ende yonsi ere ase ense, gose oyo bw’enyoni ebwate chimbaba ekoiruruka igoro,
english: or like any animal on earth or any bird that flies in the air,

ekegusii: gose oyo bw’eng’iti ekwagura ase riroba, gose oyo bw’enswe ende yonsi ere ime ase amache inse y’ense.
english: or like any creature that moves along the ground or any fish in the waters below.

ekegusii: or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish of the sea inform you.
english: gose kwana ne riroba, ndikworokererie, ne chinswe chia nyancha, nchikorarerie.

ekegusii: Morigererie chimeeri boigo, nonya chire chinene mono, na chikoirwa nomwaga omotindi, nigo chikoonchorwa nekeonchori egeke mono, aande onsi omogendia aganetie kogenda.
english: Or take ships as an example. Although they are so large and are driven by strong winds, they are steered by a very small rudder wherever the pilot wants to go.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo ararore okogoka okwo agechigwe, erio aonchore endamwamu yaye erue ase omobisa oo.
english: or the LORD will see and disapprove and turn his wrath away from him.

ekegusii: Nonya nemegati eria etano na ebere ase baria chilifu inye, na ebitonga mbirenga mwasangereretie?
english: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?

ekegusii: Gose abanto aba bare aa abanyene batebe nkomocha ki banyorete asende ekero natenena ase ekegambero,
english: Or these who are here should state what crime they found in me when I stood before the Sanhedrin--

ekegusii: Onye taibo, nigo barantaborane bare buna chindo, bankurure gochia aase omonto onde atache gontooria.
english: or they will tear me like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

ekegusii: Engaki eye nindete amaakwa aane onsi igoro yao aye omonyene, na igoro y’abasomba bao, na ase abanto bao, erinde omanye ng’a onde tari, nonya noyomo, ore buna inche, ase ense engima.
english: or this time I will send the full force of my plagues against you and against your officials and your people, so you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

ekegusii: Gose baria ikomi na batano na batato bagweretwe norwaki orotambe ase Siloam, rokabaita, mokagete ng’a nigo barenge abasaria kobua abanto bonsi abamenyete Yerusalemu?
english: Or those eighteen who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them-- do you think they were more guilty than all the others living in Jerusalem?

ekegusii: gose abagavuna, abatomirwe nere, erinde bae abakori amabe egesusuro, na gotogia abakori amaya,
english: or to governors, who are sent by him to punish those who do wrong and to commend those who do right.

ekegusii: Chinibo echio nigo chigosira ase egesio ekebe, na ekero omonto oyio aiboire omwana omomura nigo akonyorekana ore bosa, tabwati kende akomoa.
english: or wealth lost through some misfortune, so that when he has a son there is nothing left for him.

ekegusii: Or what can a man give in exchange for his soul?
english: Gose inki omonto ararue ribaga ri’omoyo oye?

ekegusii: gose egento kende gionsi keria atianete ase okong’ainereria; goika akeiranie gionsi, naende amente ensemo ya isano ase rigori riaye akee omonyene ase rituko riria akorua ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha.
english: or whatever it was he swore falsely about. He must make restitution in full, add a fifth of the value to it and give it all to the owner on the day he presents his guilt offering.

ekegusii: Naboigo ekero omosacha arabe nomoika bwe risemi na gokagera mokaye ng’a nomotomani, omosacha oria amorente ase obosio bw’Omonene, na omokuani akore onsi aya achikire.
english: or when feelings of jealousy come over a man because he suspects his wife. The priest is to have her stand before the LORD and is to apply this entire law to her.

ekegusii: gose omonto ore nesukubi ase omogongo oye, gose ore oboengere, gose oyore na kemocho ase eriso, gose oyo obosisa boriete, gose oborwaire bonde ase risankwa, gose omosacha chingetia chiaye chisaregete.
english: or who is hunchbacked or dwarfed, or who has any eye defect, or who has festering or running sores or damaged testicles.

ekegusii: Nigo nanga nabete buna enda erekeire egatindekwa, na buna abana bataroche omobaso.
english: Or why was I not hidden in the ground like a stillborn child, like an infant who never saw the light of day?

ekegusii: Oise kobwatana noyio, nigo orenarie chinchera chiaye, erio obwatwe ase oboreba.
english: or you may learn his ways and get yourself ensnared.

ekegusii: gose omonto oria nigo arutete rigena, tamoroche, korende akamoaka akamoita atamogechete, gose taganetie komokorera bobe.
english: or, without seeing him, drops a stone on him that could kill him, and he dies, then since he was not his enemy and he did not intend to harm him,

ekegusii: Abanto bande b’egesaku kia Benjamin, na ekia Yuda, bagacha ase eburi agwo ase Daudi arenge.
english: Other Benjamites and some men from Judah also came to David in his stronghold.

ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakina, agachimiga, tichiama amatunda.
english: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants, so that they did not bear grain.

ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakina, agachimiga.
english: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants.

ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amagwa ime, na amagwa aria agakina amo na chirochio, agachimiga.
english: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the plants.

ekegusii: Korende abande bakabora, “N’Elija.” Na abande bakabora, “Oyo nomobani, gose nigo anga buna oyomo bw’ababani.”
english: Others said, "He is Elijah." And still others claimed, "He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of long ago."

ekegusii: Abande bakabora, “Oyo nere Kristo.” Korende abande bakabora, “Inee! Kristo nigo ararwe Galili?
english: Others said, "He is the Christ." Still others asked, "How can the Christ come from Galilee?

ekegusii: Abande ase okomoteema bakarigia aborokie egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa igoro.
english: Others tested him by asking for a sign from heaven.

ekegusii: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the prophets of long ago had come back to life.
english: na abande ng’a n’Elija oorokire, na abande ng’a noyomo bw’ababani abakoro obokire.

ekegusii: Abwo bagendete ne chimeeri ase enyancha, bagakora oboonchoreria ase chinyancha chinene,
english: Others went out on the sea in ships; they were merchants on the mighty waters.

ekegusii: Abande babo bagachorwa gotenenera chimesa na ebinto binde, na ebikorero ebichenu, na obosie obonuke, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na ubani, na ebinsari.
english: Others were assigned to take care of the furnishings and all the other articles of the sanctuary, as well as the flour and wine, and the oil, incense and spices.

ekegusii: Others were saying, "We are mortgaging our fields, our vineyards and our homes to get grain during the famine."
english: Boigo abande bagateba, “Intwe nkobeka tore amaremo aito, na emegondo yaito y’emesabibu, ne chinyomba chiaito, bionsi bibe intenenera; bono otoe endagera, ekiagera tore nenchara.”

ekegusii: Naende aba nabwo babusuirwe ase amaroba amaya, abwo nabanto baria bakoigwa ring’ana riria, na koribwata, na kwama okwama, oyomo emerongo etato, oyomo emerongo etano nomo, na oyonde rigana.”
english: Others, like seed sown on good soil, hear the word, accept it, and produce a crop-- thirty, sixty or even a hundred times what was sown."

ekegusii: Naboigo koreng’ana nabwo babusuirwe ase egetare, ekiagera kobaigure ring’ana riria, erio kegima baribwata nomogoko;
english: Others, like seed sown on rocky places, hear the word and at once receive it with joy.

ekegusii: Atakoreti bo, nimochabore chianga chiaye, imotige getirianda abe bosa buna ase rituko riria aiboretwe. Nimokore abe buna erooro, na buna ense enyomo, nimotige akwe ase engencho y’erang’o.
english: Otherwise I will strip her naked and make her as bare as on the day she was born; I will make her like a desert, turn her into a parched land, and slay her with thirst.

ekegusii: Onye taibo, nebe ekero aye, omonene one omoruoti, gwakure na korarare ase chisokoro chiao chiararete, inche na omwana one Sulemani toche kobarwa koba abamochi abanene.”
english: Otherwise, as soon as my lord the king is laid to rest with his fathers, I and my son Solomon will be treated as criminals."

ekegusii: Ekeene buna Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, are moyo, oyontangire tinakora amabe asore, onye otaimogete bwango na koumerana nainche, monto onde tarenge nonya noyomo bw’abasacha b’enyomba ya Nabali anga ore gocha koba moyo goika mambia kobogokiamoka.”
english: Otherwise, as surely as the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, who has kept me from harming you, if you had not come quickly to meet me, not one male belonging to Nabal would have been left alive by daybreak."

ekegusii: Oise konyigotia mono, nigo ndakwange ntebe, “Omonene nere ng’o?” Gose inse koba omotaka nigo ndabaisa koiba na ndetere erieta ria Nyasae one obosooku.
english: Otherwise, I may have too much and disown you and say, 'Who is the LORD?' Or I may become poor and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

ekegusii: Nenyare koba ng’a orogendo rogochia ase omochie bw’obotamero nigo rore orotambe, na omonto oria oganetie korusia egesiomba abwatie omoiti oria, na komoikeera nchera, na ase endamwamu yaye amoite, nonya omoiti oria tagwenerete goitwa, ekiagera aitete omonto mosiabano atamogechete agwo ritang’ani.
english: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue him in a rage, overtake him if the distance is too great, and kill him even though he is not deserving of death, since he did it to his neighbor without malice aforethought.

ekegusii: Abamisiri nigo barabaise gokwana: Omonene nigo asinyetwe kobaira na kobaikia ase ense eria konya arire eira ng’a abayee, naende nigo abagechete, nakio kiagerete akabarusia aiga, erinde agachia kobaitera agwo ase erooro.
english: Otherwise, the country from which you brought us will say, 'Because the LORD was not able to take them into the land he had promised them, and because he hated them, he brought them out to put them to death in the desert.'

ekegusii: Erio nario batabaise koborokereria inwe gokora okogechia kwabo, okwo banarete ase ogosasima chinyasae chiabo na gochikorera, na kogera inwe mokore ebibe ase Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: Otherwise, they will teach you to follow all the detestable things they do in worshiping their gods, and you will sin against the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Ekero morabe mwanyorire endagera ebaisaine na koigota, naende mwaagachire chinyomba chingiya na komenyao,
english: Otherwise, when you eat and are satisfied, when you build fine houses and settle down,

ekegusii: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.
english: Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, momura omwabo Kalebu, akaira omochie oyio, na Kalebu akamoa omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.

ekegusii: Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, omomura omoke omwabo Kalebu, akabua omochie oyio. Erio Kalebu akamoa Asika, omoiseke oye, akaba mokaye.
english: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it; so Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.

ekegusii: Tiga ebiage biaito biichore chindagera, bigaache chindagera ao ao, ne ching’ondi chiaito chire ase ebitii chibiare chilifu ne chilifu.
english: Our barns will be filled with every kind of provision. Our sheep will increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields;

ekegusii: Abana baito na abakungu barabwo tiga batigare amo ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiaito aiga ase emechie ya Gileadi.
english: Our children and wives, our flocks and herds will remain here in the cities of Gilead.

ekegusii: Our dear friend Luke, the doctor, and Demas send greetings.
english: Luka, oria omorwaria omwanchwa, na Dema babakwanirie.
