ekegusii: Naki tindi goteba aya, erinde abande babatigere na inwe moritoerwe, korende amang’ana abe areng’aine.
english: Our desire is not that others might be relieved while you are hard pressed, but that there might be equality.

ekegusii: Naki ekeene, abatata baito b’ense nigo batorongeetie ase amatuko amake buna baroche buya, korende ere nigo agotorongeyia ase ogotokonya, erinde tobe ababwatani b’obochenu bwaye.
english: Our fathers disciplined us for a little while as they thought best; but God disciplines us for our good, that we may share in his holiness.

ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiakorete ebibe, bono tichiyo; goika tobogorie egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo.
english: Our fathers sinned and are no more, and we bear their punishment.

ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito tichiabete chinyegenwa; nigo chiakorete ayare amabe ase amaiso ’Omonene, Nyasae oito, chikamotiga. Barabwo bakaonchora amasio abo korwa ase Obomenyo bw’Omonene, bakaa Omonene amagega.
english: Our fathers were unfaithful; they did evil in the eyes of the LORD our God and forsook him. They turned their faces away from the LORD's dwelling place and turned their backs on him.

ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nigo chiarenge gosasima ase egetunwa eke, na inwe nigo mogoteba ng’a Yerusalemu nao aase atogwenerete togosasimera.”
english: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place where we must worship is in Jerusalem."

ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, bono amagoro aito nigo ateneine aa ase ebiita biao.
english: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaito nchiariete mana ase erooro, buna yarigetwe: Nabaete omogati korwa igoro bakaria.”
english: Our forefathers ate the manna in the desert; as it is written: 'He gave them bread from heaven to eat.'"

ekegusii: buna chisokoro chiaito chiagendete ase ense ya Misiri, chikamenyao emiaka emenge. Abamisiri bagachichanda ase obotindi obobe, bagatochanda naintwe.
english: Our forefathers went down into Egypt, and we lived there many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers,

ekegusii: Nyasae oito ngocha are, tagokirakiri; omorero okoria nigo otang’aine bosio bwaye, omwaga omotindi nigo omoetanaine.
english: Our God comes and will not be silent; a fire devours before him, and around him a tempest rages.

ekegusii: Nyasae oito nigo are Nyasae ogotooria. Nyasae ore Omonene nigo agototooria korwa ase amakweri.
english: Our God is a God who saves; from the Sovereign LORD comes escape from death.

ekegusii: Nyasae oito nigo are igoro, na nigo agokora rinde rionsi agwancha.
english: Our God is in heaven; he does whatever pleases him.

ekegusii: Chinkoro chiaito tichionchogeti chigotige, gose titotigeti kobwatia enchera yao,
english: Our hearts had not turned back; our feet had not strayed from your path.

ekegusii: Ogokonywa gwaito nigo gokorwa ase erieta ri’Omonene, oyio otongete igoro na ense.
english: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

ekegusii: Enyomba yaito enchenu naende engiya mono, agwo ase chisokoro chiaito chiasoete ime kogotogia, bono yasambirwe nomorero; aase aito onsi arenge akogokia abeire amaturi.
english: Our holy and glorious temple, where our fathers praised you, has been burned with fire, and all that we treasured lies in ruins.

ekegusii: Omwando oito oeirwe abanto abaao, chinyomba chiaito chiaeirwe abamenyi.
english: Our inheritance has been turned over to aliens, our homes to foreigners.

ekegusii: Abaruoti baito, na abanene baito, na abakuani baito, ne chisokoro chiaito, tibabwatete amachiko ao, gose tibaigwerete ogokurera kwao kwabakurerete.
english: Our kings, our leaders, our priests and our fathers did not follow your law; they did not pay attention to your commands or the warnings you gave them.

ekegusii: Naende ntoire chitugo chiaito chionsi, ende teri eratigare nyuma nonya neyemo. Korwa ase echio nao togochia korusia echi torakorere Omonene, Nyasae oito; intwe titomanyeti buna togochia gokorera Omonene goika toraika aroro.”
english: Our livestock too must go with us; not a hoof is to be left behind. We have to use some of them in worshiping the LORD our God, and until we get there we will not know what we are to use to worship the LORD."

ekegusii: Erio emenwa yaito egaichorwa namaseko, ne chimeme chiaito chigatera nomogoko. Erio abanto b’ebisaku bagatebania, “Omonene okoreire abanto abwo amang’ana amanene.”
english: Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, "The LORD has done great things for them."

ekegusii: Tiga chiombe chiaito chibe ne chinguru, ende tebaisa korekera, gose gochia bogima. Ekerero kende gionsi tikeba ase chinchera chiaito.
english: our oxen will draw heavy loads. There will be no breaching of walls, no going into captivity, no cry of distress in our streets.

ekegusii: Na abanto baito tiga beorokererie kwerua ase ogokora okuya, na gokonya aase oboremerwa bore, erinde tibaba batari nokwama.
english: Our people must learn to devote themselves to doing what is good, in order that they may provide for daily necessities and not live unproductive lives.

ekegusii: Abachandi baito nigo baare abaango kobua chinsoti chikoiruruka, nigo batoseretie gochia ase ebitunwa igoro, bagatoboera ase erooro
english: Our pursuers were swifter than eagles in the sky; they chased us over the mountains and lay in wait for us in the desert.

ekegusii: Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nere Omobooria oito; Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye.
english: Our Redeemer-- the LORD Almighty is his name-- is the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Amasankwa ’emebere yaito nigo are ne riberera buna erie riko, ekiagera enchara nigo egotosamba buna omorero.
english: Our skin is hot as an oven, feverish from hunger.

ekegusii: Omochie oyio nobe aase abarubi bakwanekera ebionga biabo agwo ase egati y’enyancha. Ninche Omonene Nyasae nakwanire. Omochie oyo nosakorwe nabanto b’ebisaku.
english: Out in the sea she will become a place to spread fishnets, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD. She will become plunder for the nations,

ekegusii: Korwa ase omonwa oye okaruao omoyio o birende ore omwoge, na ase oyio naake abanto b’ebisaku. Ere nabagambere nenyimbo y’ekioma, naende natiringe ekemitero ki’edivai y’endamwamu entindi ya Nyasae Omobui.
english: Out of his mouth comes a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations. "He will rule them with an iron scepter." He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God Almighty.

ekegusii: Korwa ase oromo rw’echio orogunchara ronde rokamera korwao; orwo rogakina mono gochia irianyi, na gochia moocha, na gochia ase ense eria engiya mono.
english: Out of one of them came another horn, which started small but grew in power to the south and to the east and toward the Beautiful Land.

ekegusii: Korwa ase obomeka‐meku obwo bwarenge bosio bwaye okomesa gokaruta ebibemberi bi’omorero.”
english: Out of the brightness of his presence bolts of lightning blazed forth.

ekegusii: Korwa ase obomeka‐meku obwo bwarenge bosio bwaye amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigasoka goetera ase amare aye.
english: Out of the brightness of his presence clouds advanced, with hailstones and bolts of lightning.

ekegusii: Naki baria bateemetwe nemechando emenge. Nonya barenge abataka mono, omogoko obo omonge okagera bakamenta okorua kwabo.
english: Out of the most severe trial, their overflowing joy and their extreme poverty welled up in rich generosity.

ekegusii: Oborabu bokomeka‐meka nigo bokorwa sugusu; ee, Nyasae nigo eboetie nobonene bw’ogosikwa gw’okoondokia.
english: Out of the north he comes in golden splendor; God comes in awesome majesty.

ekegusii: Omonwa oria oria orua ogosesenia na okoragereria. Abaminto, amang’ana aya tagwenereti koba bo.
english: Out of the same mouth come praise and cursing. My brothers, this should not be.

ekegusii: na abamalaika baria batano na babere, abaare namaakwa atano na abere, bagasoka korwa ase Hekalu. Barabwo nigo babekeire chianga chi’egatani endabu, ekomeka‐meka, na ase ebikuba biabo nigo beboeretie chinkini chie chitahabu.
english: Out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues. They were dressed in clean, shining linen and wore golden sashes around their chests.

ekegusii: Korende agwo isiko nchireo chisese, naende mbareo abarogi, na abatomani, na abaiti, na abasasimi emegwekano na kera omonto oyobwanchete oborimo na kobokora.
english: Outside are the dogs, those who practice magic arts, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

ekegusii: Agwo isiko y’etoto eye ekengete chibao chirikire oborori chibekire ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, Haroni abe okorenda chitaya korwa mogoroba goika mambia ase obosio bwane, incne Omonene. Okwo nogochika asemore koragenderere ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: Outside the curtain of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron is to tend the lamps before the LORD from evening till morning, continually. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come.

ekegusii: Isiko y’oboagacho bw’egeita kia ime gochia ase eraaro ya ime, ebinyomba bibere bi’abateri mbiarengeo, akamo kaare ang’e negeita gia sugusu karochie irianyi, na akande ensemo y’egeita kia moocha karochie sugusu.
english: Outside the inner gate, within the inner court, were two rooms, one at the side of the north gate and facing south, and another at the side of the south gate and facing north.

ekegusii: Naende mobare isiko y’omochie, ensemo ya moocha ekerengo ki’amaboko chilifu ibere, na ensemo ya irianyi, na eya sugusu, na eya bosongo boigo, amaboko chilifu ibere; omochie obe gati‐gati. Ebitii ebi bi’oborisia Abalawi baegwe amo nemechie yabo.
english: Outside the town, measure three thousand feet on the east side, three thousand on the south side, three thousand on the west and three thousand on the north, with the town in the center. They will have this area as pastureland for the towns.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaruta amagena igoro y’Akani goika amagena ayio akaba etui eyere aroro goika rero iga. Erio Omonene agatiga ekeririanda kiaye kegakenda. Ase ayio aase aria akarokwa Ebate y’Akori buna akorokwa nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: Over Achan they heaped up a large pile of rocks, which remains to this day. Then the LORD turned from his fierce anger. Therefore that place has been called the Valley of Achor ever since.

ekegusii: Abasaria batiirire gochia ase ebigoro bi’erooro. Omoro bw’Omonene nigo ogoita na gosaria korwa ensinyo eyemo y’ense goika ensinyo ende. Onde tari omenyete nomorembe.
english: Over all the barren heights in the desert destroyers will swarm, for the sword of the LORD will devour from one end of the land to the other; no one will be safe.

ekegusii: Asareli, mosinto o Yerohamu, ase Abadani. Aba nabwo barenge abaraai b’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.
english: over Dan: Azarel son of Jeroham. These were the officers over the tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: Na Yakobo agatenenia rigena ri’ekeinyorio ase embeera ya Raeli, nao rire goika rero iga.
english: Over her tomb Jacob set up a pillar, and to this day that pillar marks Rachel's tomb.

ekegusii: Elihu, oyomo bw’abamura bamwabo Daudi, ase Abayuda; Omuri, mosinto o Mikaeli, ase Abaisakaru;
english: over Judah: Elihu, a brother of David; over Issachar: Omri son of Michael;

ekegusii: Hasabia, mosinto o Kemueli, ase Abalawi; Zadoki ase abanto ba Haroni;
english: over Levi: Hashabiah son of Kemuel; over Aaron: Zadok;

ekegusii: Hosea, mosinto bw’Asasia, ase Abaefraimu; Yoeli, mosinto o Pedaya, ase ekeng’ese kende ki’egesaku kia Manase;
english: over the Ephraimites: Hoshea son of Azaziah; over half the tribe of Manasseh: Joel son of Pedaiah;

ekegusii: Naende togaetera Egeita gi’Efraimu, na Egeita Egekoro, na Egeita gie Chinswe, na Omorobiri o Hananeli, na Omorobiri bwe Rigana, goika ase Egeita gie Ching’ondi. Togakoorera orogendo rwaito agwo ase Egeita ki’Abarendi.
english: over the Gate of Ephraim, the Jeshanah Gate, the Fish Gate, the Tower of Hananel and the Tower of the Hundred, as far as the Sheep Gate. At the Gate of the Guard they stopped.

ekegusii: Ido, mosinto o Zakaria, ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, keria kiarenge agwo Gileadi; Yaasieli, mosinto bw’Abineri ase Ababenjamin;
english: over the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead: Iddo son of Zechariah; over Benjamin: Jaasiel son of Abner;

ekegusii: Baare egetambaa ekebariri igoro ase ebinto ebio, bagetube ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche, na basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria emesa eria.
english: Over these they are to spread a scarlet cloth, cover that with hides of sea cows and put its poles in place.

ekegusii: Isimaya, mosinto bw’Obadia, ase Abasabuloni; Yerimoti, mosinto bw’Asirieli, ase Abanafutali;
english: over Zebulun: Ishmaiah son of Obadiah; over Naphtali: Jerimoth son of Azriel;

ekegusii: Overlay it with pure gold and make a gold molding around it.
english: Oyeoome netahabu echenire, oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etahabu.

ekegusii: Overlay it with pure gold, both inside and out, and make a gold molding around it.
english: Oyeoome netahabu echenire ime na isiko, oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etahabu.

ekegusii: Oome chibao echio netahabu na okore chibonyi chie chitahabu ase emeriibo erasoigwe, na emeriibo eria oyeoome netahabu.
english: Overlay the frames with gold and make gold rings to hold the crossbars. Also overlay the crossbars with gold.

ekegusii: Oyeoome netahabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye inye, amo ne chingunchara chiaye; oyeetananie omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
english: Overlay the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Misiri, beka chigurube chiaino ang’e, mong’anye mogende ase obosomba, ekiagera Memifisi nosirigwe otigare bosa, otamenyiri na monto.
english: Pack your belongings for exile, you who live in Egypt, for Memphis will be laid waste and lie in ruins without inhabitant.

ekegusii: Pagieli, mosinto bw’Okirani, nere orenge omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku gi’Aseri,
english: Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,

ekegusii: Obororo bonga buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore mbobachere, nigo bonga buna omwana otari nokomanya osinyirwe gosoka korwa ase enda ya ng’ina ekero engaki yaye yaikire.
english: Pains as of a woman in childbirth come to him, but he is a child without wisdom; when the time arrives, he does not come to the opening of the womb.

ekegusii: Na chirochio chionsi echiare moyo chigasoa ase obwato amo na Nuhu, ibere ibere.
english: Pairs of all creatures that have the breath of life in them came to Noah and entered the ark.

ekegusii: Na ase ching’iti chichenegete chirabe ekeng’wanso, ne ching’iti chitachenegeti, ne chinyoni, na echi chionsi chikwagura igoro ase ense,
english: Pairs of clean and unclean animals, of birds and of all creatures that move along the ground,

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Isakaru, Palitieli, mosinto bw’Asani;
english: Paltiel son of Azzan, the leader from the tribe of Issachar;

ekegusii: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai and Vaizatha,
english: Parimasita, na Arisai, na Aridai, na Waisata,

ekegusii: naende bakamoa amako amomo, na amabomba abere ay’amasabibu amomo, na ekero arire, akanyora chinguru. Ase engaki y’amatuko atato konya atana koria gento, gose konywa.
english: part of a cake of pressed figs and two cakes of raisins. He ate and was revived, for he had not eaten any food or drunk any water for three days and three nights.

ekegusii: Omonene, kumba igoro chiao ochiche inse aa! Kuna ebitunwa, erinde bisokie erioki.
english: Part your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, so that they smoke.

ekegusii: Parthians, Medes and Elamites; residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
english: Abapariti, Abamedi na Abaelamiti, na abwo bamenyete Mesopotamia, Boyahudi na Kapadokia, Ponto na Asia,

ekegusii: Pashhur, Amariah, Malkijah,
english: Pasuri, na Amaria, na Malikia;

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Safiri, eta mogende more getirianda, mobe nobosooku. Abanto ba Saanani tibasogete isiko. Okorera kwa Beti‐Hasaeli tigokobatiga mobeere aroro.
english: Pass on in nakedness and shame, you who live in Shaphir. Those who live in Zaanan will not come out. Beth Ezel is in mourning; its protection is taken from you.

ekegusii: Eta, eta, mosoere ase ebiita, moroiserie abanto enchera; ticha enchera eyio eimokerere igoro, rusia amagena korwa aroro; tenenia ekemanyererio abanto bakerore.
english: Pass through, pass through the gates! Prepare the way for the people. Build up, build up the highway! Remove the stones. Raise a banner for the nations.

ekegusii: na Abapaturusi, Abakasiluhi, (korwa asebare nao Abafilisti barwete), na Abakafitori.
english: Pathrusites, Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.

ekegusii: Abapaturusi na Abakasiluhi (korwa asebare nao Abafilisti barwete), na Abakafitori.
english: Pathrusites, Casluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.

ekegusii: Erio kobachorire abagaaka ase kera ekanisa ase ogosaba na okweng’ata, bakababeka ase amaboko ’Omonene, oyio begenete.
english: Paul and Barnabas appointed elders for them in each church and, with prayer and fasting, committed them to the Lord, in whom they had put their trust.

ekegusii: Bagaeta ase ense ya Furugia na Galatia, ekiagera bakanetigwe n’Omoika Omochenu, ng’a tibarandia ring’ana agwo Asia.
english: Paul and his companions traveled throughout the region of Phrygia and Galatia, having been kept by the Holy Spirit from preaching the word in the province of Asia.

ekegusii: Inche Paulo na Timotheo, abasomba ba Kristo Yeso, nkobarikera tore inwe abachenu bonsi abamore ase Kristo Yeso, abamomenyete Filipi, amo nabatang’ani na abakonyi ase ekanisa.
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:

ekegusii: Paulo akamoiraneria, “Inche n’Omoyahudi, omonto o Tariso, omochie o Kilikia, omobiare bw’omochie otari moke; nagosabire ong’e ribaga nkwane nabanto aba.”
english: Paul answered, "I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no ordinary city. Please let me speak to the people."

ekegusii: Korende Paulo agateba, “Inche nigo nteneine aiga bosio bw’ekegambero gia Kaisari, ase ngwenerete kogamberigwa; timochereti Abayahudi ring’ana buna aye omanyete buya.
english: Paul answered: "I am now standing before Caesar's court, where I ought to be tried. I have not done any wrong to the Jews, as you yourself know very well.

ekegusii: Agasoa ase esinagogi ime, agakwana noboremu, akorokereria abanto engaki y’emetienyi etato, okobaebereria ase amang’ana ’oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
english: Paul entered the synagogue and spoke boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God.

ekegusii: Paulo nigo arenge gosangereria chinko na gochibeka ase omorero, eng’iti egasoka ase engencho y’omorero oria, ekamwenarerera okoboko kwaye.
english: Paul gathered a pile of brushwood and, as he put it on the fire, a viper, driven out by the heat, fastened itself on his hand.

ekegusii: Kabakwanirie, akaborokia amang’ana onsi erimo erimo, aya Nyasae akorire ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku ase obosomba bwaye.
english: Paul greeted them and reported in detail what God had done among the Gentiles through his ministry.

ekegusii: Naki Paulo nigo arengereretie goeta Efeso mbarabare, tabaisa gotebana ase Asia, ekiagera nigo are koayerera kogenda Yerusalemu rituko ria Pentekosti, keranyarekane.
english: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, for he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.

ekegusii: Paulo akarigereria mono abanto b’ekegambero, akabora, “Baminto, nabeireo ase obosio bwa Nyasae goika rero iga, na enkoro yane tekongambia.”
english: Paul looked straight at the Sanhedrin and said, "My brothers, I have fulfilled my duty to God in all good conscience to this day."

ekegusii: Paulo agateba ng’a, “Tinamanyete baminto ng’a ere nomokuani omonene, naki narikire: Tokwana bobe omogambi bw’abanto bao.”
english: Paul replied, "Brothers, I did not realize that he was the high priest; for it is written: 'Do not speak evil about the ruler of your people.'"

ekegusii: Paulo akamoiraneria, “Nasabire Nyasae ng’a ase amang’ana amake, gose amange, tari aye bweka, korende naba bonsi abantegererete rero, babe buna inche otatiga ase ebinyuri ebi.”
english: Paul replied, "Short time or long-- I pray God that not only you but all who are listening to me today may become what I am, except for these chains."

ekegusii: Paulo akabatebia, “Yohana nigo are kobatisa ebatiso y’okoonchoka, ogotebia abanto bamwegene ere oyorache gocha nyuma yaye, oyio nere Yeso.”
english: Paul said, "John's baptism was a baptism of repentance. He told the people to believe in the one coming after him, that is, in Jesus."

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Paulo a kamenta komenya agwo amatuko amange, erio agatigana nabamwabo, akamanora agasoa emeeri, akagenda Siiria, na Priskila na Akwila bakagenda amo nere. Ase Kenkrea agakigita etukia yaye, ekiagera ariete eira gete.
english: Paul stayed on in Corinth for some time. Then he left the brothers and sailed for Syria, accompanied by Priscilla and Aquila. Before he sailed, he had his hair cut off at Cenchrea because of a vow he had taken.

ekegusii: Paulo agatenena gati‐gati y’Areopago, akabora, “Inwe abasacha b’Atene! Narorire ng’a nigo more abanto abamorengereretie mono amang’ana e chinyasae,
english: Paul then stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and said: "Men of Athens! I see that in every way you are very religious.

ekegusii: Na Paulo akarigia gosoa ase egati y’abanto, korende aborokigwa tibamwanchera.
english: Paul wanted to appear before the crowd, but the disciples would not let him.

ekegusii: Paulo agancha Timotheo agende nere, akamoira, akamosara ase engencho y’Abayahudi abarenge chinsemo chiria, ekiagera bonsi mbamanyete ng’a ise n’Omogiriki orenge.
english: Paul wanted to take him along on the journey, so he circumcised him because of the Jews who lived in that area, for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

ekegusii: Korende Paulo agaika, akamoumamera, akamoagata, akabora, “Timoichana, ekiagera obogima bwaye nao bore ime yaye.”
english: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. "Don't be alarmed," he said. "He's alive!"

ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omosibwa o Kristo Yeso, amo noyominto Timotheo, ngokorikera tore aye Filemoni, omwanchwa oito, omokori emeremo amo naintwe.
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our dear friend and fellow worker,

ekegusii: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, called to be an apostle and set apart for the gospel of God--
english: Inche Paulo, omosomba o Kristo Yeso, narangeretigwe koba omotomwa, nachoretwe korandia enchili ya Nyasae,

ekegusii: Inche Paulo nomosomba o Nyasae, na omotomwa o Yeso Kristo ase engencho y’okwegena kw’abachore ba Nyasae, erinde bamanye onsi ayare ay’ekeene, ayakorenta chingencho chi’obonyasae,
english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ for the faith of God's elect and the knowledge of the truth that leads to godliness--

ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogochika kwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito, na Kristo Yeso, ogosemeria gwaito,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,

ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, ase engencho y’eira y’obogima bore ase Kristo Yeso,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus,

ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, amo noyominto Timotheo,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, amo noyominto Timotheo nkobarikera tore inwe ab’ekanisa ya Nyasae ere ase Korinto amo nabachenu bonsi abare ase ense yonsi y’Akaya.
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth, together with all the saints throughout Achaia:

ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, nkobarikera nde inwe abachenu abamomenyete Efeso, abegeni ba Kristo Yeso:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus:

ekegusii: Inche Paulo, omotomwa, tinatometwe korwa ase mwanyabanto gose goetera ase omonto, korende goetera ase Yeso Kristo, na Nyasae Tata oyomobogetie korwa ase abakure,
english: Paul, an apostle-- sent not from men nor by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead--

ekegusii: Inche Paulo narangeretigwe koba omotomwa o Kristo Yeso ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae. Inche amo noyominto Sostene
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

ekegusii: Inche Paulo amo na Silivano na Timotheo nkobarikera tore inwe ab’ekanisa y’Abatesaloniki, abamore ase Nyasae Tata oito na Omonene Yeso Kristo:
english: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

ekegusii: Inche Paulo amo na Silivano na Timotheo nkobarikera tore inwe ab’ekanisa y’Abatesaloniki, abamore ase Nyasae Tata na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo: Obuya bobe asemore na omorembe.
english: Paul, Silas and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace and peace to you.

ekegusii: Tega ogoto kwao oigwe amang’ana abanto abang’aini bagokwana, na obeke amorokererio aane ime ase enkoro yao.
english: Pay attention and listen to the sayings of the wise; apply your heart to what I teach,

ekegusii: Mwerende ase obosio bwaye, oigwere aya aragotebie. Tobaisa kwanga komoigwera, ekiagera erieta riane nigo rire ime yaye, ere takomororera amabera oyoramoche koigwera.
english: Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Do not rebel against him; he will not forgive your rebellion, since my Name is in him.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, abanto abwo bamenyete ang’e bagochecheirie na kogochaya, obairanerie amabe ayio abo ara gatano na kabere.
english: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the reproach they have hurled at you, O Lord.

ekegusii: Rituko riria akorete emeremo, omoe eng’eria yaye ritang’ani erioba ritaragwa, ekiagera ere nomotaka, nigo asemeretie konyora eng’eria yaye. Onye tokomoakana nigo arabaise korera ase Omonene igoro yao, naende ayio nigo arabe ebibe asore.
english: Pay him his wages each day before sunset, because he is poor and is counting on it. Otherwise he may cry to the LORD against you, and you will be guilty of sin.

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, nobaakane koreng’ana nogokora kw’amaboko abo.
english: Pay them back what they deserve, O LORD, for what their hands have done.

ekegusii: Omorembe na amabera bibe amo na bonsi abaragenderere ase ogochika oko, na amo n’Abaisraeli ba Nyasae.
english: Peace and mercy to all who follow this rule, even to the Israel of God.

ekegusii: Omorembe nabatigeire; omorembe one nabaeire; tinkoyobaa buna ense ekoyobaa. Timoichana ase chinkoro chiaino, gose timoba nobwoba.
english: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.

ekegusii: Omorembe obe ase abaminto, na obwanchani amo nokwegena bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.
english: Peace to the brothers, and love with faith from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Okwama kw’oboronge nigo kogosimekwa ase omorembe na baria bagokora omorembe.
english: Peacemakers who sow in peace raise a harvest of righteousness.

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali, Pedaheli, mosinto bw’Amihudi.
english: Pedahel son of Ammihud, the leader from the tribe of Naphtali."

ekegusii: Agakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene; teatananete korwa ase ebibe biria Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, akorete akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: Pekahiah did evil in the eyes of the LORD. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat, which he had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
english: Pelatia, na Hanani, na Anaya;

ekegusii: Ekina ki’abanyacheche nigo kenachire, na abariri mbang’wanigwe ebiranya ase emegongo yabo.
english: Penalties are prepared for mockers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

ekegusii: Penueli nigo arenge ise Abagedori, na Eseri ise Abahusa. Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura ba Huri, omwana omotangi o Efarata, ise abanto ba Bethlehemu.
english: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and father of Bethlehem.

ekegusii: Omonto oria okwegachera endagera ase obong’iti, nigo akoragererigwa nabanto, korende ogosesenigwa nigo kore igoro ase omotwe bw’oria okoyeoonia.
english: People curse the man who hoards grain, but blessing crowns him who is willing to sell.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ense ya Negebu mbaire Egetunwa gia Esau, na ab’ense omweya mbaire ense y’Abafilisti. Mbaire na ense y’Abaefraimu na ey’Abasamaria chibe echiabo; na abanto ba Benjamin mbaire Gileadi ebe eyabo.
english: People from the Negev will occupy the mountains of Esau, and people from the foothills will possess the land of the Philistines. They will occupy the fields of Ephraim and Samaria, and Benjamin will possess Gilead.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio abanto b’emechie ebere, gose etato, bakaba bakona‐goetanana gochia ase omochie oyomo korigia amache banywe, korende tibanyora ayakobaisana. Nonya naboigo timwairanete gocha asende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: People staggered from town to town for water but did not get enough to drink, yet you have not returned to me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto ba Yerusalemu, na Boyahudi yonsi, ne chinsemo chionsi chia Yorodan bakamochiera.
english: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region of the Jordan.

ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana ebing’werere, erinde abakune; korende aborokigwa baye bagachia kobarora, bakabatanga.
english: People were also bringing babies to Jesus to have him touch them. When the disciples saw this, they rebuked them.

ekegusii: Bakamorentera abana abake, erinde anyare kobakuna; aborokigwa baye bakabatanga.
english: People were bringing little children to Jesus to have him touch them, but the disciples rebuked them.

ekegusii: Barenge koria, bakonywa, bakonyuoma, bakonyuomerigwa, goika rituko riria Nuhu asoete ase obwato; etoigo egacha, egasiria bonsi.
english: People were eating, drinking, marrying and being given in marriage up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.

ekegusii: Bagakumia mono kobua, bakabora, “Okorire onsi buya. Abarenge emetino obatinoire, na abarenge amamama bakwane.”
english: People were overwhelmed with amazement. "He has done everything well," they said. "He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak."

ekegusii: Naki abagokwana amang’ana buna ayio nkoorokia bare maiso marore, ng’a nkorigia bare ense yabo abanyene.
english: People who say such things show that they are looking for a country of their own.

ekegusii: Korende abwo barigetie koba abanda nigo bakogwa ase ogoteemwa na omoeto, na okogania okonge gotari nengencho, kore okw’ogosaria, okwo gokorimeria mwanyabanto bachie gosira na gosareka.
english: People who want to get rich fall into temptation and a trap and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge men into ruin and destruction.

ekegusii: Nigo barairanerie: Nekiagera barabwo batigete Omonene, Nyasae obo, oria orusetie chisokoro chiabo korwa ase ense ya Misiri, naende bakabwatana ne chinyasae ching’ao, bagachisasima na gochikorera. Amang’ana ayio agerire Omonene orentire amabe aya onsi igoro asebare.”
english: People will answer, 'Because they have forsaken the LORD their God, who brought their fathers out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them-- that is why the LORD brought all this disaster on them.'"

ekegusii: Erio nairanerigwe: Nekiagera batigete Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Nigo babwatanete ne chinyasae ching’ao, bagachisasima na gochikorera; ayio naro agerire Omonene arentire amabe aya onsi igoro asebare.”
english: People will answer, 'Because they have forsaken the LORD, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them-- that is why he brought all this disaster on them.'"

ekegusii: Naki abanto inababe bakweancha barabwo abanyene, abanchete chibesa, abetogia, abaenenu, abarami, abatari koigwera abaibori babo, abatari koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, abatari abachenu,
english: People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy,

ekegusii: Naende mbache abanto korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na irianyi, na barabwo mbaikaranse ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
english: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will take their places at the feast in the kingdom of God.

ekegusii: Abanto nabachiche korwa ase emechie y’Abayuda, na korwa ase chinsemo chionsi chiaetanaine Yerusalemu, na korwa ase ense ya Benjamin na ense omweya, na korwa ase ense y’ebitunwa, na Negebu. Barabwo mbarente ase enyomba y’Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ubani, na okuruegwa gw’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
english: People will come from the towns of Judah and the villages around Jerusalem, from the territory of Benjamin and the western foothills, from the hill country and the Negev, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings, incense and thank offerings to the house of the LORD.

ekegusii: Abayuda mbamenye ase emechie yabo yonsi amo. Boigo abaremi na abarisia baria bakona‐koong’anya mbamenyeo.
english: People will live together in Judah and all its towns-- farmers and those who move about with their flocks.

ekegusii: Abanto mbachandane, kera omonto nabe ogochanda oyonde, na kera omonto nabe ogochanda omogisangio oye; omwana omoke naenenere omonto omogotu, na omonto otarochi nchera nachaye omonto osikire.
english: People will oppress each other-- man against man, neighbor against neighbor. The young will rise up against the old, the base against the honorable.

ekegusii: PARISINI, engencho yaye: oboruoti bwao bwatananirwe, bwaeirwe Abamedi na Abaayemi.”
english: Peres: Your kingdom is divided and given to the Medes and Persians."

ekegusii: Amaguta akweakwa na amanukato nigo bikogokia enkoro, naboigo bore obwororo bw’omosani oyo okorua ogosemia okuya.
english: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart, and the pleasantness of one's friend springs from his earnest counsel.

ekegusii: Aande gose nimenye amo nainwe, gose nimenye seino ekero ki’obokendu, monyare gonkooba ekero kende gionsi aase ndigetie kogenda.
english: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.

ekegusii: Ee, omoruoti, nonyigwe na ontoorie inche, omosomba oo, korwa ase okoboko kw’omonto oyo origetie gonsiria inche amo nomwana one na gotorusia korwa ase omwando o Nyasae.
english: Perhaps the king will agree to deliver his servant from the hand of the man who is trying to cut off both me and my son from the inheritance God gave us.'

ekegusii: Aande nakio kiagerete agaatananwa korwa asore ase ekero egeke, erinde obe nere kare na kare,
english: Perhaps the reason he was separated from you for a little while was that you might have him back for good--

ekegusii: Ande nebe ng’a abanto abwo nabasabe Omonene na komosorora, na kera oyomo aonchoke atige chinchera chiaye chimbe, ekiagera Omonene okwanire ng’a narente endamwamu yaye enene, na ekeririanda igoro ase abanto aba.”
english: Perhaps they will bring their petition before the LORD, and each will turn from his wicked ways, for the anger and wrath pronounced against this people by the LORD are great."

ekegusii: Ande ekero barayaigwe, nabo barabaise koigwera, na kera omonto aonchoke na atige chinchera chiaye chimbe, erinde agere nainche ng’onchoke ntige amabe aria narengereirie kobakorera ase engencho y’ogokora kwabo okobe.”
english: Perhaps they will listen and each will turn from his evil way. Then I will relent and not bring on them the disaster I was planning because of the evil they have done.

ekegusii: Ande nebe ng’a Abayuda mbaigwe amang’ana aria amabe naganirie gokora asebare, kera omonto nabaise koonchoka atige chinchera chiaye chimbe, na ase ayio, inche nimbaabere ogosaria kwabo na ebibe biabo.”
english: Perhaps when the people of Judah hear about every disaster I plan to inflict on them, each of them will turn from his wicked way; then I will forgive their wickedness and their sin."

ekegusii: iga togochandwa, korende titori gotigwa; iga togoakwa inse, korende titori gosirigwa.
english: persecuted, but not abandoned; struck down, but not destroyed.

ekegusii: na ogochandwa kwane, na ogochandeka kwane, okwo nanyorete ase Antiokia na Ikonio, na Listra. Nogochandwa kore naki naremereretie! Na korwa ase ayio onsi Omonene agantooria.
english: persecutions, sufferings-- what kinds of things happened to me in Antioch, Iconium and Lystra, the persecutions I endured. Yet the Lord rescued me from all of them.

ekegusii: Tiga oboremereria obwo bobe nemeremo emeikeranu, erinde monyare koba abaikeranu, na abagima, motaremeiri na ing’ana rinde rionsi.
english: Perseverance must finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything.

ekegusii: na oboremereria nigo bokorenta oboremu bw’omoyo, na oboremu bw’omoyo nigo bokorenta ogosemeria.
english: perseverance, character; and character, hope.

ekegusii: Persia, Cush and Put will be with them, all with shields and helmets,
english: Abarwani b’Ayemi, na aba Etiopia, na aba Libia, mbabe amo nabarabwo; bonsi mbabe babogoretie chinguba na ebigogwa b’ebioma.

ekegusii: Petero na baria barenge amo nere, konya babwatirwe ne chitoro, korende nigo batagesetie, bakarora obonene bwaye, na abanto baria babere bateneine amo nere.
english: Peter and his companions were very sleepy, but when they became fully awake, they saw his glory and the two men standing with him.

ekegusii: Korende Petero na abatomwa bande bakairaneria, “Netogwenerete koigwera Nyasae kobua mwanyabanto.
english: Peter and the other apostles replied: "We must obey God rather than men!

ekegusii: Peter answered him, "We have left everything to follow you! What then will there be for us?"
english: Erio Petero akamoiraneria, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire, inki rende toranyore?”

ekegusii: Korende Petero akamotebia, “Chifeta chiao chisire amo naye, ekiagera okagete ng’a nonyore ekeegwa kia Nyasae ase chibesa!
english: Peter answered: "May your money perish with you, because you thought you could buy the gift of God with money!

ekegusii: Petero akamoboria, “Ntebia, igo mwaoonetie omogondo ase rigori erio?” Akairaneria, “Ee, ase rigori erio.”
english: Peter asked her, "Tell me, is this the price you and Ananias got for the land?" "Yes," she said, "that is the price."

ekegusii: Petero akamoboria, “Omonene, nintwe ogotebia omoreng’anio oyo, gose nase abanto bonsi?”
english: Peter asked, "Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everyone?"

ekegusii: Petero akamotebia, “Omonene, nase ki ntanyare kogotunyana bono? Nindue obogima bwane ase engencho yao.”
english: Peter asked, "Lord, why can't I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you."

ekegusii: Korende Petero agachaka kobatebereria amang’ana onsi buna abete,
english: Peter began and explained everything to them precisely as it had happened:

ekegusii: Petero akamotebia, “Neba inabagochwe bonsi na kogotiga, korende tai inche.”
english: Peter declared, "Even if all fall away, I will not."

ekegusii: Na Petero akamotunyana korwa nyuma ore egeka, goika ime ase egoora y’omokuani omonene, agaikaransa amo nabasomba gwota omorero.
english: Peter followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. There he sat with the guards and warmed himself at the fire.

ekegusii: Agasoka, akamotunyana, gose tamanyete ng’a ayakoretwe nomomalaika nay’ekeene, korende agakaga ng’a nokorora arorire.
english: Peter followed him out of the prison, but he had no idea that what the angel was doing was really happening; he thought he was seeing a vision.

ekegusii: Na ekero Petero achia gotura egesieri kia geita, omoiseke omosomba, okorokwa Roda, agacha koigwa.
english: Peter knocked at the outer entrance, and a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer the door.

ekegusii: Peter looked straight at him, as did John. Then Peter said, "Look at us!"
english: Petero akamobeta amaiso, amo na Yohana, akabora, “Torigererie intwe!”

ekegusii: Ere akabakania nokoboko, ng’a bakire, tibakwana, akabatebereria buna Omonene amosokia korwa ase echela. Akabora, “Genda, motebie Yakobo na abaminto amang’ana aya.” Agasoka, akagenda ensemo ende.
english: Peter motioned with his hand for them to be quiet and described how the Lord had brought him out of prison. "Tell James and the brothers about this," he said, and then he left for another place.

ekegusii: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, "Rabbi, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered!"
english: Petero akainyora amang’ana aria, akamotebia, “Rabii, rora, omoko oria kwaragereretie bwomire.”

ekegusii: Petero akamotebia, “Neba inabagochwe bonsi na bagotige ase engencho yao, inche tinkogochwa na kogotiga nonya ng’ake.”
english: Peter replied, "Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will."

ekegusii: Petero akabora, “Omonto oyo, timanyeti eri ogokwana.” Erio kegima kagokwana, etuoni ekabuga.
english: Peter replied, "Man, I don't know what you're talking about!" Just as he was speaking, the rooster crowed.

ekegusii: Petero akabairaneria, “Onchoka, mobatiswe kera oyomo ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo, monyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biaino, na inwe inamoegwe ekeegwa ki’Omoika Omochenu.
english: Peter replied, "Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins. And you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Petero akamoboria, “Naki abete mogancherana goteema Omoika bw’Omonene? Rora, amagoro abo abatindeka omosacha oo nao are agwo gesieri, na barabwo nabakobogorie aye gochia isiko.”
english: Peter said to her, "How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look! The feet of the men who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out also."

ekegusii: Peter said to him, "We have left all we had to follow you!"
english: Petero akabora, “Rora, intwe twatigire chinka chiaito, twagotunyanire aye.”

ekegusii: Peter said to him, "We have left everything to follow you!"
english: Petero agachaka komotebia, “Rora, intwe twatigire bionsi, twagotunyanire.”

ekegusii: Peter said to Jesus, "Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will put up three shelters-- one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."
english: Petero agatebia Yeso, “Omworokia, mbuya intwe koba aiga; onye ngwancha, ninkore aiga ebigutu bitato, ekemo ekiao, ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija.”

ekegusii: Petero agatebia Yesu, “Omonene, mbuya intwe koba aiga, tiga tokore ebigutu bitato: ekemo ekiao, ekemo ekia Musa, na ekemo eki’Elija.”
english: Peter said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters-- one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah."

ekegusii: Korende Petero akamotebia, “Totebererie omoreng’anio oyio.”
english: Peter said, "Explain the parable to us."

ekegusii: Petero akabasokia bonsi isiko, agatung’ama, agasaba. Akeonchora gochia ase egetondo, agateba, “Tabitha, imoka!” Na ere akaramokia amaiso aye; ekero arora Petero, akaboka, agaikaransa.
english: Peter sent them all out of the room; then he got down on his knees and prayed. Turning toward the dead woman, he said, "Tabitha, get up." She opened her eyes, and seeing Peter she sat up.

ekegusii: Petero akamenya Yopa amatuko atai make ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo ore korokwa Simion, omoroisia bw’amao.
english: Peter stayed in Joppa for some time with a tanner named Simon.

ekegusii: Petero akamoira ensemo, agachaka komokania, akabora, “Omonene, ayio tabaisa gokonyora! Takoba asore buna ayio.”
english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. "Never, Lord!" he said. "This shall never happen to you!"

ekegusii: Petero akeonchora, akarora omworokigwa oria Yeso anchete okobatunyana; nere oria bweegegete egekuba kiaye ekero gi’okoria endagera ya mogoroba na gokwana, “Omonene, ning’o orakorue?”
english: Peter turned and saw that the disciple whom Jesus loved was following them. (This was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper and had said, "Lord, who is going to betray you?")

ekegusii: Petero agaika ase abanto baria, agateba, “Ninche ere oyo mokorigia. Igo mwacha ase engencho ki?”
english: Peter went down and said to the men, "I'm the one you're looking for. Why have you come?"

ekegusii: Peter went with them, and when he arrived he was taken upstairs to the room. All the widows stood around him, crying and showing him the robes and other clothing that Dorcas had made while she was still with them.
english: Petero akaimoka, akagenda amo nabarabwo. Ekero aikire aroro, bakamoira akanyomba ka irongo. Ababoraka bonsi bagatenena ang’e nere bakorera, na komworokia chiganchwa ne chianga echi Dorika arenge koroisia ekero arenge amo nabarabwo.

ekegusii: Inche Petero, omotomwa o Yeso Kristo, nkobarikera nde inwe abachore, abamwatananekire gochia komenya buna abamenyi ase Ponto, na Galatia, na Kapadokia, na Asia, na Bitinia.
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, To God's elect, strangers in the world, scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia,

ekegusii: Korende Petero akaimoka, akagenda bwango ase oboina, agatung’ama, akarigereria ime, akarora ebitambaa biria bireo bioka, akairana bwoye, okumetie ase aya akorekire.]
english: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. Bending over, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.

ekegusii: Omoruoti nigo abegete Petahia, mosinto o Mesesabeli bw’ororeria rwa Sera, mosinto o Yuda, gotenenera abanto ase amang’ana onsi.
english: Pethahiah son of Meshezabel, one of the descendants of Zerah son of Judah, was the king's agent in all affairs relating to the people.

ekegusii: Farao akaimoka botuko, ere amo nabasomba baye bonsi, na Abamisiri bonsi. Ebirero ebinene bikaba ase ense ya Misiri, ekiagera nyomba ende tiyatigarete monto atakwete.
english: Pharaoh and all his officials and all the Egyptians got up during the night, and there was loud wailing in Egypt, for there was not a house without someone dead.

ekegusii: Pharaoh asked him, "How old are you?"
english: Farao akaboria Yakobo, “Inee! Emiaka yao nerenga?”

ekegusii: Farao akababoria, “Emeremo yaino nereri?” Bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abarisia be chitugo, buna nechisokoro chiaito chiarenge.”
english: Pharaoh asked the brothers, "What is your occupation?" "Your servants are shepherds," they replied to Pharaoh, "just as our fathers were."

ekegusii: Farao akaroka Yusufu Safenati‐Panea; akamonyuomeria omokungu, nere Asenati, omoiseke o Potifera, omokuani bw’Oni. Yusufu akagenda aaria na aaria korigereria ense yonsi ya Misiri.
english: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-Paneah and gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph went throughout the land of Egypt.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bande banyosetigwe edivai eria: Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, na abasomba baye, na abanene b’oboruoti bwaye, amo nabanto baye bonsi,
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his attendants, his officials and all his people,

ekegusii: Farao Neko akabeka Eliakimu, omwana omomura o Yosia, akamobeka akaba omoruoti ase ribaga ria ise, na akaonchora erieta riaye, akamoroka Yehoyakimu. Akarusia Yehoahasi agwo, akamoira Misiri, nere agakwera aroro.
english: Pharaoh Neco made Eliakim son of Josiah king in place of his father Josiah and changed Eliakim's name to Jehoiakim. But he took Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt, and there he died.

ekegusii: Farao Neko akamobwata, akamosiba agwo Ribula ase ense ya Hamati, erinde tabaisa kogamba agwo Yerusalemu, naende akabekera abanto b’ense eria ebango ye chitalanta rigana erimo chie chifeta na etalanta eyemo y’etahabu.
english: Pharaoh Neco put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath so that he might not reign in Jerusalem, and he imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

ekegusii: Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni ase obwango, akabatebia, “Nakorire ebibe ase Omonene. Nyasae oino, na asemore.
english: Pharaoh quickly summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "I have sinned against the LORD your God and against you.

ekegusii: Farao agatebia Yusufu, “Nigo narota okorota, gose onde tari oranyare gontebia engencho y’okorota kwane. Inche naigure amang’ana ao ng’a gokwaigure chindoto, nabo okomanya engencho ye chindoto echio.”
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I had a dream, and no one can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it."

ekegusii: Farao agatebia Yusufu, “Batebie abamino iga: Berekia ching’iti chiaino chigurube, moimoke mogende ase ense yaino ya Kanani,
english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, 'Do this: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan,

ekegusii: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Your father and your brothers have come to you,
english: Erio Farao agakwana na Yusufu, akamotebia, “Narorire ng’a iso na abamino bagocheire.

ekegusii: Farao agatebia Musa, “Karue ase obosio bwane! Bwerende, tobaisa gocha kondora naende, naki rituko riria orache korora obosio bwane naende, nigo orakwe.”
english: Pharaoh said to Moses, "Get out of my sight! Make sure you do not appear before me again! The day you see my face you will die."

ekegusii: Pharaoh said, "Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do."
english: Farao akairaneria, “Tiira ochie gotindeka iso, buna akorierete omwando.”

ekegusii: Farao akabora, “Nimbae ribaga mogende moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekeng’wanso ase erooro, korende timogenda aare, naende monsabere inche.”
english: Pharaoh said, "I will let you go to offer sacrifices to the LORD your God in the desert, but you must not go very far. Now pray for me."

ekegusii: Farao akabairaneria, “Inwe naboro mono. Nakio gekogera mogoteba ng’a: Toe ribaga togende toruere Omonene ekeng’wanso.
english: Pharaoh said, "Lazy, that's what you are-- lazy! That is why you keep saying, 'Let us go and sacrifice to the LORD.'

ekegusii: Korende Farao akabatebia, “Haha! Omonene abe amo nainwe onye nkobaa ribaga mogende amo nabana baino. Korende momanye ng’a amabe nabatang’aine ase mokogenda.
english: Pharaoh said, "The LORD be with you-- if I let you go, along with your women and children! Clearly you are bent on evil.

ekegusii: Farao akairaneria, “Omonene nere ng’o inyigwe amang’ana aye, na koa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende? Inche timomanyeti Omonene, gose tinkoa Abaisraeli ribaga bagende.”
english: Pharaoh said, "Who is the LORD, that I should obey him and let Israel go? I do not know the LORD and I will not let Israel go."

ekegusii: Farao agatoma abanto barigie egiakoregete, na barabwo bakamorentera amang’ana ng’a ase Abaisraeli tugo yabo ende tekweti. Nonya nabo enkoro ya Farao ekagenderera koba enkong’u, taa abanto ribaga bagende.
english: Pharaoh sent men to investigate and found that not even one of the animals of the Israelites had died. Yet his heart was unyielding and he would not let the people go.

ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni, akabatebia, “Mosabe Omonene arusie ebioto korwa ase ense na korwa ase abanto baane, na inche ning’ee abanto baye ribaga bagende koruera Omonene ekeng’wanso.”
english: Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Pray to the LORD to take the frogs away from me and my people, and I will let your people go to offer sacrifices to the LORD."

ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria abanto abanyasemi na abaragori, na abwo abaringoria ba Misiri bagakora boigo ase oborogi bwabo.
english: Pharaoh then summoned wise men and sorcerers, and the Egyptian magicians also did the same things by their secret arts:

ekegusii: Ase igo Farao akabea abateneneri abwo babere, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati.
english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officials, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,

ekegusii: Ekero aye Farao gwatobeete intwe abasomba bao, na gotosiekera, inche na omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati, ase echela eyere ase enyomba y’omotang’ani bw’abarendi,
english: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he imprisoned me and the chief baker in the house of the captain of the guard.

ekegusii: Hadadi akanyora ogwancherwa okonene ase obosio bwa Farao, na Farao akamonyuomeria mokoyoye, omoiseke omwabo Tapenesi mokaye, oyio orenge eting’ana.
english: Pharaoh was so pleased with Hadad that he gave him a sister of his own wife, Queen Tahpenes, in marriage.

ekegusii: Pharaoh will think, 'The Israelites are wandering around the land in confusion, hemmed in by the desert.'
english: Farao narengererie ng’a Abaisraeli batantanire enchera bakogenda, na erooro yabatangire tibagenda.

ekegusii: Farao na abarwani baye b’esegi abange tibakonyara gokonya omoruoti oyio ase esegi, ekero chiburi chiraagachwe, amo ne chindwaki chi’okoboera ase ogosiria abanto abange.
english: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great horde will be of no help to him in war, when ramps are built and siege works erected to destroy many lives.

ekegusii: Abarwani esegi ba Farao konya barure Misiri, na ekero Abakalidayo, abwo baboerete Yerusalemu, baigwete amang’ana igoro y’abarwani esegi ba Misiri, bagatiga Yerusalemu, bakagenda.
english: Pharaoh's army had marched out of Egypt, and when the Babylonians who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report about them, they withdrew from Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Orutire chigari chia Farao amo nomoganda oye ase enyancha ime; abarwani baye abachore obarimeirie ase Enyancha Embariri.
english: Pharaoh's chariots and his army he has hurled into the sea. The best of Pharaoh's officers are drowned in the Red Sea.

ekegusii: Na egekombe kia Farao nigo nakebwate ase okoboko kwane; nkabogoria amasabibu aria, nkayamitera ase egekombe kia Farao, nkaa Farao egekombe eke koboko kwaye.”
english: Pharaoh's cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes, squeezed them into Pharaoh's cup and put the cup in his hand."

ekegusii: Omoiseke o Farao agatebia omokungu oria, “Moire omwana oyo, omongonkerie, na inche ninkoe eng’eria yao.” Erio omokungu oria akaira omwana, akamorera.
english: Pharaoh's daughter said to her, "Take this baby and nurse him for me, and I will pay you." So the woman took the baby and nursed him.

ekegusii: Farao agatebigwa nabasomba baye, “Ngoika ririri omonto oyo aratotege? Batige abanto aba bagende bakorere Omonene, Nyasae obo. Toramanya nonya mbono ng’a ense ya Misiri yasarekire?”
english: Pharaoh's officials said to him, "How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the people go, so that they may worship the LORD their God. Do you not yet realize that Egypt is ruined?"

ekegusii: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;
english: Filipo na Baritholomayo; Tomas na Matayo, omorusia ebango; Yakobo bw’Alufayo na Tadayo;

ekegusii: Filipo akamoiraneria, “Emegati ye chidinari amagana abere tekobaisana, kera oyomo anyore moke igo.”
english: Philip answered him, "Eight months' wages would not buy enough bread for each one to have a bite!"

ekegusii: Filipo akanyora Natanaeli, akamotebia, “Twanyorire ere oyo amang’ana aye arigetwe na Musa ase amachiko, naende nababani, Yeso omwana o Yusufu, omonto o Nazareti.”
english: Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote-- Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph."

ekegusii: Philip said to him, "You may be baptized if you believe with all your heart." "I do," he answered; "I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God." [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version.]
english: Filipo akamotebia, “Koregene nenkoro yao yonsi, nenyarekane.” Akairaneria, “Negenire ng’a Yeso Kristo nere Omwana o Nyasae.”]

ekegusii: Filipo akamotebia, “Omonene, tworokie Tata, toisaneke.”
english: Philip said, "Lord, show us the Father and that will be enough for us."

ekegusii: Philip went down to a city in Samaria and proclaimed the Christ there.
english: Filipo agatirimboka, agasoa omochie o Samaria, akabaranderia Kristo.

ekegusii: Philip went to tell Andrew; Andrew and Philip in turn told Jesus.
english: Filipo akagenda, agatebia Anderea; erio Anderea na Filipo bagatebia Yeso.

ekegusii: Korende Filipo akarorekana ase Asoto, na ekero arenge goeta, akarandia enchili ase emechie yonsi, goika agaika Kaisaria.
english: Philip, however, appeared at Azotus and traveled about, preaching the gospel in all the towns until he reached Caesarea.

ekegusii: Nere Filipo nigo arenge omonto o Bethisaida, omochie bw’Anderea na Petero.
english: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.

ekegusii: Furugia na Pamfulia, Misiri ne chinsemo chia Libia ya Kurene, amo nabageni korwa Rumi,
english: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya near Cyrene; visitors from Rome

ekegusii: Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."
english: Pilato akairaneria, “Aya narikire, narikire.”

ekegusii: Pilato akarangeria amo abakuani abanene, na abagambi, na abanto,
english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers and the people,

ekegusii: Pilato akarika ekemanyererio, agakebeka igoro ase omosalaba. Igo kiarigetwe, “YESO OMONAZARETI, OMORUOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”
english: Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

ekegusii: Erio Pilato akabatebia, “Moire inwe, momogambie ase ogochika kwaino.” Abayahudi bakamotebia, “Intwe titori ne ribaga goita omonto.”
english: Pilate said, "Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law." "But we have no right to execute anyone," the Jews objected.

ekegusii: Erio Pilato agasoa ekegambero naende, akarangeria Yeso, akamoboria, “Inee! Naye omoruoti bw’Abayahudi?”
english: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, "Are you the king of the Jews?"

ekegusii: Pilato agakumia, ekiagera aikire gokwa, akarangeria omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, akamoboria gose nkare akwete.
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him if Jesus had already died.

ekegusii: Imbeke ase enkoro yao imbe buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio, ee, buna ebonyi ere nekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao. Obwanchani nigo bore ne chinguru buna amakweri, ne ribero nigo rire ritindi buna embeera. Ogwoka kw’obwanchani nigo konga ebibemberi bi’omorero, ee, nekebemberi gekorwa ase Omonene.
english: Place me like a seal over your heart, like a seal on your arm; for love is as strong as death, its jealousy unyielding as the grave. It burns like blazing fire, like a mighty flame.

ekegusii: Place the ark of the Testimony in it and shield the ark with the curtain.
english: Obeke Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori imeo, na oyekenge netoto.

ekegusii: place the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar and put water in it.
english: Obeke egetuba egati y’Eema y’Omosangererekano na egesasimero, obeke na amache imeo.

ekegusii: Oterekerere Oboikaranso bw’Amabera igoro y’Esanduku eria. Erio obeke imeo chibao echi chirikire oborori, echi ndakoe.
english: Place the cover on top of the ark and put in the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.

ekegusii: Erio obeke egesasimero gi’etahabu ase ubani erasamberwe bosio bw’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, na osunge egetambaa kere ase egesoero ki’Obomenyo.
english: Place the gold altar of incense in front of the ark of the Testimony and put the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.

ekegusii: Obeke emesa isiko y’etoto ensemo ya sugusu, na ekebekerero gie chitaya ensemo ya irianyi, ase Obomenyo ime.
english: Place the table outside the curtain on the north side of the tabernacle and put the lampstand opposite it on the south side.

ekegusii: Erio obeke chinyimbo echio ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano bosio bw’Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, agwo ase inche ndaumerane nainwe.
english: Place them in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony, where I meet with you.

ekegusii: Amarwaire agoita nigo atang’aine bosio bwaye, na amaakwa nigo akobwatia chimbaratero chiaye.
english: Plague went before him; pestilence followed his steps.

ekegusii: Ase ogosemania gotari, emeroberio nigo egosareka, korende ase abaesmia abange abaya bare nigo egokinigwa.
english: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.

ekegusii: Abwo basimekire ase enyomba y’Omonene, nigo baragenderere koreereta ase chigoora chia Nyasae oito.
english: planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.

ekegusii: Amang’ana akogokia nigo anga obooke bokorwa ase richoe, nigo are amansu ase omoyo naende nigo akogwenia omobere.
english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul and healing to the bones.

ekegusii: Koranche oire ebiegwa ebi nakorenteire, ekiagera Nyasae onkoreire obuya obonge, na inche nimbwate ebing’isaine.” Naboigo ere akaebereria Esau na ere agancha, akabiira.
english: Please accept the present that was brought to you, for God has been gracious to me and I have all I need." And because Jacob insisted, Esau accepted it.

ekegusii: Koranche, torua aase aa goika nkorentere okoruegwa kwane kw’endagera.” Omomalaika oria akamoiraneria, “Nimbeere aa, nkoganye goika oirane.”
english: Please do not go away until I come back and bring my offering and set it before you." And the LORD said, "I will wait until you return."

ekegusii: Nasabire, onyabere okomocha kwane, inche omosomba oo omokungu. Ekeene, Omonene nakore enyomba yao egenderere kobao, ekiagera aye nigo okorwana esegi yaye; na amabe takonyorekana asore ase obogima bwao bwonsi.
english: Please forgive your servant's offense, for the LORD will certainly make a lasting dynasty for my master, because he fights the LORD's battles. Let no wrongdoing be found in you as long as you live.

ekegusii: Koranche otoe ribaga toete ase egati y’ense yao. Titokogobera gochia ase emegondo y’endagera, gose ey’emesabibu, gose titokonywa amache korwa ase chinsoko chiaino. Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, titokogobera gochia ensemo ya borio, gose eya bomosi, goika tobe twaetanirie ense yao.”
english: Please let us pass through your country. We will not go through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will travel along the king's highway and not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory."

ekegusii: Amaguta ao akweakwa nigo are ne rimisu rigiya; erieta riao nigo ringa buna amaguta aumoirwe, ase ayio abaiseke abekungi nigo bagwanchete.
english: Pleasing is the fragrance of your perfumes; your name is like perfume poured out. No wonder the maidens love you!

ekegusii: Abaremi bakang’ororia emegongo yaito, bagakora emeng’ororia yabo emetambe.”
english: Plowmen have plowed my back and made their furrows long.

ekegusii: Plunder the silver! Plunder the gold! The supply is endless, the wealth from all its treasures!
english: Sakora chifeta! Sakora ne chitahabu! Obotenenku na obonge bwe chinibo bireo tibikoera.

ekegusii: Akarambora okoboko kwaye ase aborokigwa baye, akabora, “Rora baba na bamura baminto!
english: Pointing to his disciples, he said, "Here are my mother and my brothers.

ekegusii: Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,
english: Porata na Adalia, na Aridata;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwaye mbabe bakomokorera; mbabe bagokwana igoro y’Omonene ase ebiaare bigochi‐gocha.
english: Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord.

ekegusii: Umora endamwamu yao igoro ase abanto b’ebisaku batakomanyeti, na igoro ase amagambi ayio atari gokorangeria oyakonye.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;

ekegusii: Itera endamwamu yao ase ebisaku bitakomanyeti na ase abanto batari korangeria erieta riao bakonywe. Barabwo basiririe abanto ba Yakobo, ee, babamerire kegima na kobasiria, basaririe obomenyo bwabo bwabeire bosa.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the peoples who do not call on your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him completely and destroyed his homeland.

ekegusii: Obaumorere ekeririanda kiao, na endamwamu yao yoke igoro yabo.
english: Pour out your wrath on them; let your fierce anger overtake them.

ekegusii: Nyasae atogigwe, ekiagera tangeti koigwa ogosaba kwane, gose tarusetie korwa asende obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.
english: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld his love from me!

ekegusii: Tiga erieta riaye ri’obonene ritogigwe goika kare na kare; obonene bwaye tiga boichore ase ense yonsi. Amina, Amina!
english: Praise be to his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen.

ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, abakwe! Ase amabera aye amange atoiboire eria kabere, erinde tonyore ogosemeria kore moyo goetera ase okobokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo korwa ase abakure,
english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

ekegusii: Nyasae, Tata bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, Tata bw’amabera, Nyasae bw’okoremia gwonsi, atogigwe.
english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, atogigwe, ere oyotosesenetie ase Kristo nogosesenigwa gwonsi kw’omoika aase aaria igoro,
english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in the heavenly realms with every spiritual blessing in Christ.

ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe kare na kare! Amina. Amina.
english: Praise be to the LORD forever! Amen and Amen.

ekegusii: Omonene tiga atogigwe korwa Sayoni, Omonene oria omenyete Yerusalemu. Motogie Omonene!
english: Praise be to the LORD from Zion, to him who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, tiga atogigwe, nere bweka ogokora amakumia.
english: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oria ogokigwe asore na gokobeka ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, obe omoruoti ase obosio bwaye, ere Omonene, Nyasae oo! Ekiagera ere anchete Abaisraeli botambe, na akabakong’ia bakaba ne chinguru kare na kare, ogokorire aye koba omoruoti igoro asebare, erinde onyare konacha ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge.”
english: Praise be to the LORD your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on his throne as king to rule for the LORD your God. Because of the love of your God for Israel and his desire to uphold them forever, he has made you king over them, to maintain justice and righteousness."

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oria ogokigwe asore na okobekire ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli. Ekiagera Omonene anchete Abaisraeli botambe, agakobeka okaba omoruoti, erinde onyare konacha ekeene na oboronge.”
english: Praise be to the LORD your God, who has delighted in you and placed you on the throne of Israel. Because of the LORD's eternal love for Israel, he has made you king, to maintain justice and righteousness."

ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe! Ere oigure okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo.
english: Praise be to the LORD, for he has heard my cry for mercy.

ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe! Nigo anyorogetie obwanchani bwaye bw’ogokumia; akandenda ase omochie omokong’u.
english: Praise be to the LORD, for he showed his wonderful love to me when I was in a besieged city.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe, buna yarenge korwa kare nabo erabe goika kare na kare. Amina. Amina.
english: Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe korwa kare goika kare na kare; na abanto bonsi pi batebe, “Amina.” Togia Omonene!
english: Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atogigwe, korwa kare na kare, na gochia kare na kare! Erio abanto bonsi bagateba, “Amina!” Na bakamotogia Omonene.
english: Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Then all the people said "Amen" and "Praise the LORD."

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, atogigwe, oria obegete ring’ana eri ime ase enkoro y’omoruoti, oyobwanchire gokora enyomba y’Omonene ere Yerusalemu ebe ensiani mono.
english: Praise be to the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put it into the king's heart to bring honor to the house of the LORD in Jerusalem in this way

ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, rituko ase rituko nigo agotobogoreria chigurube chiaito. Nyasae nere ogotooreka gwaito.
english: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens. Selah

ekegusii: Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera tatoruete totaboranwe namaino ’abanto abwo.
english: Praise be to the LORD, who has not let us be torn by their teeth.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene otogigwe. Inyorokererie emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Praise be to you, O LORD; teach me your decrees.

ekegusii: “Inwe abamore ab’ororeria rw’Abaisraeli, motogie Omonene Nyasae ase egati y’omosangererekano omonene.”
english: Praise God in the great congregation; praise the LORD in the assembly of Israel.

ekegusii: Motogie ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okonene; motogie koreng’ana nobonene bwaye bore ne chinguru chinyinge goetania!
english: Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.

ekegusii: Motogie ase okobugia chinchigiri na gotenga; motogie ase okobugia amakano na ebiroria!
english: praise him with tambourine and dancing, praise him with the strings and flute,

ekegusii: Motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are inse; motogie ase ogoakania chisani chikwoga amariogi are igoro!
english: praise him with the clash of cymbals, praise him with resounding cymbals.

ekegusii: Motogie ase okobugia ebitureri; motogie ase okobugia amakano onsi!
english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet, praise him with the harp and lyre,

ekegusii: Inwe abamalaika baye mwensi, motogie, nainwe emeganda yaye yonsi, motogie!
english: Praise him, all his angels, praise him, all his heavenly hosts.

ekegusii: Praise him, sun and moon, praise him, all you shining stars.
english: Aye erioba, na aye omotienyi, motogie, nainwe ching’enang’eni chionsi chikobara, motogie.

ekegusii: Inwe igoro ya igoro chionsi, motogie Nainwe amache are igoro ya igoro, motogie!
english: Praise him, you highest heavens and you waters above the skies.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, motogie Nyasae oito, tiga eriogi ri’okomotogia riigweke.
english: Praise our God, O peoples, let the sound of his praise be heard;

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene korwa ase ense, nainwe ebitongwa bie chinyancha ne chindiba chionsi!
english: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,

ekegusii: Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase okobugia amakano ’ebirigisa, motogie ase okobugia amakano are ne chinga ikomi!
english: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to him on the ten-stringed lyre.

ekegusii: Togia Omonene, inwe emeganda yaye yonsi, na inwe abasomba baye, aba mogokora ogwancha kwaye!
english: Praise the LORD, all his heavenly hosts, you his servants who do his will.

ekegusii: Togia Omonene, inwe ebitongwa biaye bionsi, motogie aande onsi ase akogamba. Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!
english: Praise the LORD, all his works everywhere in his dominion. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, motogie Omonene! Inwe abanto bonsi, mobake!
english: Praise the LORD, all you nations; extol him, all you peoples.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, ekiagera ere nigo are omuya, terera erieta riaye, ekiagera nigo rire eriansu.
english: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.

ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene, tobaisa kweba obuya bwaye bwonsi agokoreire.
english: Praise the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits--

ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene! Omonene, Nyasae one, aye nigo ore omonene mono; nigo bweboetie ogosikwa na obonene.
english: Praise the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.

ekegusii: Inwe abamalaika b’Omonene, motogie; inwe abamore ne chinguru chinene na mogokora aya agochika ekero mwaigure eriogi rie ring’ana riaye.
english: Praise the LORD, you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, who obey his word.

ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Nasesenirie omonto oyio omoirogete Omonene, na ogokirie mono koigwera amachiko aye.
english: Praise the LORD. Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who finds great delight in his commands.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Moakere Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera ere nomuya, na obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Praise the LORD. Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Nigo ere buya komoterera Nyasae oito ase okomotogia, ayio naro amaya mono na atogwenerete.
english: Praise the LORD. How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise him!

ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Ning’ake ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene nenkoro yane yonsi, agwo ase omosangererekano bw’abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge.
english: Praise the LORD. I will extol the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Motogie Nyasae agwo ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu, motogie agwo igoro eyio yatongetwe ase okobua kwaye!
english: Praise the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Motogie Omonene korwa agwo igoro! Momotogie agwo igoro mono!
english: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD from the heavens, praise him in the heights above.

ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Aye omoyo one, togia Omonene!
english: Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Togia erieta ri’Omonene! Inwe abasomba b’Omonene, motogie!
english: Praise the LORD. Praise the name of the LORD; praise him, you servants of the LORD,

ekegusii: Togia Omonene! Inwe abasomba b’Omonene, motogie, ee, togia erieta riaye!
english: Praise the LORD. Praise, O servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene! Terera Omonene ogotera okoyia, motogie ase omosangererekano bw’abanto abegenwa.
english: Praise the LORD. Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

ekegusii: bakomotogia Nyasae na kogwenera abanto bonsi. Omonene akabamentera kera rituko ase okorenta baria barenge gotoorigwa.
english: praising God and enjoying the favor of all the people. And the Lord added to their number daily those who were being saved.

ekegusii: Monsabere nainche, ng’egwe amang’ana ase ogokwana noboremu, erinde ndandie obobisi bw’enchili.
english: Pray also for me, that whenever I open my mouth, words may be given me so that I will fearlessly make known the mystery of the gospel,

ekegusii: Saba motari gotiga!
english: pray continually;

ekegusii: Sabera Yerusalemu, erinde obe nomorembe! Abanto abwo bagwanchete basesenigwe.
english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May those who love you be secure.

ekegusii: Tosabere, naki ntore nobomaene ng’a chinkoro chiaito tichigotogambia, ntorigetie koba norogendo oruya ase amang’ana onsi.
english: Pray for us. We are sure that we have a clear conscience and desire to live honorably in every way.

ekegusii: erinde nsiborwe korwa ase baria bategeneti ase Boyahudi, naende emeremo imbwate aaria Yerusalemu yancheirwe nabachenu.
english: Pray that I may be rescued from the unbelievers in Judea and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints there,

ekegusii: Pray that I may proclaim it clearly, as I should.
english: Mosabe ng’a mboorokie buna ngwenerete koboorokia.

ekegusii: Otosabere ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, atworokie enchera togwenerete kobwatia, na eki togwenerete gokora.”
english: Pray that the LORD your God will tell us where we should go and what we should do."

ekegusii: Pray that this will not take place in winter,
english: Saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero ki’obokendu,

ekegusii: Korende saba ng’a ogotama kwaino tikoba ekero ki’obokendu, gose ase rituko ri’Esabato,
english: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.

ekegusii: Nsabere ase Omonene. Chinkoba echi amo nembura y’amagena biatonyarire. Nimbae ribaga mogende, timogwenereti mobeere aa goetania.”
english: Pray to the LORD, for we have had enough thunder and hail. I will let you go; you don't have to stay any longer."

ekegusii: Randia Ring’ana ria Nyasae, kora omokia ase engaki ekogwenerete, na ase eyetakogwenereti, kurera na togonyera, na gosorora ase oboremereria bwonsi, na ase okworokereria.
english: Preach the Word; be prepared in season and out of season; correct, rebuke and encourage-- with great patience and careful instruction.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto abachenu b’Omonene bagokwa, amakweri ayio nigo are ay’engencho enene asare.
english: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

ekegusii: Beka abanto ang’e, baite abamura b’omoruoti oyio; abana abwo nigo baraitwe ase engencho y’okomocha gwa chisokoro chiabo, tibabaisa koimokerera igoro baire ense na koyeichoria nemechie.”
english: Prepare a place to slaughter his sons for the sins of their forefathers; they are not to rise to inherit the land and cover the earth with their cities.

ekegusii: Okoruegwa okwo gokarangwe namaguta ase orogio, gosamunyorwe, erio kobe okoruegwa kw’endagera kore ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
english: Prepare it with oil on a griddle; bring it well-mixed and present the grain offering broken in pieces as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Prepare me the kind of tasty food I like and bring it to me to eat, so that I may give you my blessing before I die."
english: Erio ondoiserie endagera engiya, eria nyanchete, oyendetere indie, erinde ngosesenie konde moyo, ntarakwa.”

ekegusii: Prepare one lamb in the morning and the other at twilight,
english: Eyemo y’echio oyerue mambia, na eyende mogoroba.

ekegusii: Beka ebisaku ang’e biche korwania Babeli. Rangeria abaruoti b’Abamedi amo nabagavuna na abakonyi babo, na kera ense ere ase obogambi bwaye.
english: Prepare the nations for battle against her-- the kings of the Medes, their governors and all their officials, and all the countries they rule.

ekegusii: Emingichi eria ya kabere oyerue mogoroba amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna kwaruete eria ya mambia. Eke nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.”
english: Prepare the second lamb at twilight, along with the same kind of grain offering and drink offering that you prepare in the morning. This is an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.
