ekegusii: Igo morarue ebinto ebi amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko botambe.
english: Prepare these in addition to the regular morning burnt offering.

ekegusii: Morue ekeng’wanso ekio amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko, na okoruegwa kw’endagera. Ching’iti echio chionsi chi’ebing’wanso chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chiruegwe amo nokoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochikire amo.
english: Prepare these together with their drink offerings, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its grain offering. Be sure the animals are without defect.

ekegusii: Inwe ebeke ang’e, kera eamate ase ekeombe kiaye, koreng’ana nomoreberio o Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na oyo o Sulemani, omomura oye.
english: Prepare yourselves by families in your divisions, according to the directions written by David king of Israel and by his son Solomon.

ekegusii: Morue chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, amo ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo. Echi nchibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
english: Present a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old as an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero moraroisie omogati korwa ase obosie bw’ogotongora kw’endagera, namoyorente ase Omonene obe okoruegwa kw’ogotongora buna mokomoruera endagera korwa ase ekeooreri kiaino.
english: Present a cake from the first of your ground meal and present it as an offering from the threshing floor.

ekegusii: Morue eeri eyemo, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echi nachibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, kebe ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.
english: Present an offering made by fire as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, a burnt offering of one bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Morue chieri ikomi na isato, ne chimingichi ibore, ne chimanwa chimingichi ikomi na inye, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari ne kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekengw’anso kegosambwa nomorero, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
english: Present an offering made by fire as an aroma pleasing to the LORD, a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams and fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Morue eeri ensae eyemo, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo. Echio nchibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
english: Present as an aroma pleasing to the LORD a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Morue ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, chieri chinsae ibere, na emingichi eyemo, ne chimanwa chimingichi isano na ibere echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chibe chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: Present to the LORD an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of two young bulls, one ram and seven male lambs a year old, all without defect.

ekegusii: Amo nokoruegwa okwo morente ching’ondi isano na ibere echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, na eeri ensae, ne chimingichi ibere, chionsi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa okwo gochikire amo. Okwo nokoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.
english: Present with this bread seven male lambs, each a year old and without defect, one young bull and two rams. They will be a burnt offering to the LORD, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings-- an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Morue ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, chinyama amo namanyinga, igoro ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, Nyasae oino. Amanyinga ’ebing’wanso biaino binde, moyaumore igoro ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, Nyasae oino, korende chinyama chirochio morie.
english: Present your burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD your God, both the meat and the blood. The blood of your sacrifices must be poured beside the altar of the LORD your God, but you may eat the meat.

ekegusii: Ing’a obogima oboyia ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bwa botambe, erinde imbwatie oborori bwao gwakwanete.
english: Preserve my life according to your love, and I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

ekegusii: Oboenenu nigo bogotang’anera ogosirigwa, na omoika bw’obomwenu nigo ogotang’anera okogwa.
english: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.

ekegusii: Oboenenu nigo bokorenta okoamererania, korende baria bakoigwera ogosemigwa nigo bakoba nobong’aini.
english: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is found in those who take advice.

ekegusii: Abagambi baito babwatirwe na gosungwa, na abagaaka baito tibasikiri.
english: Princes have been hung up by their hands; elders are shown no respect.

ekegusii: Inwe raria okobua kwa Nyasae, oyio obonene bwaye bore igoro y’Abaisraeli, na okobua kwaye nigo kore igoro onsi.
english: Proclaim the power of God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose power is in the skies.

ekegusii: Raria amang’ana aya ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku: Ebeke ang’e ase esegi! Seegeta abarwani chituoni! Tiga abarwani bonsi bachiche ang’e bachake esegi.
english: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare for war! Rouse the warriors! Let all the fighting men draw near and attack.

ekegusii: Raria amang’ana ayio ase chinyomba chinkong’u chi’Asidodi, na echi’ense ya Misiri, motebie abanto bare aroro: “Inchuo, mosangererekane amo igoro ase ebitunwa bia Samaria, morore eburu‐buru ere aroro, na buna abanto bachandire.”
english: Proclaim to the fortresses of Ashdod and to the fortresses of Egypt: "Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria; see the great unrest within her and the oppression among her people."

ekegusii: proclaiming aloud your praise and telling of all your wonderful deeds.
english: imba ngotera neriogi rinene gokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono na koraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo akworokia ng’a Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge, ere nere egetare kiane, na obokorekanu tibori ime yaye.
english: proclaiming, "The LORD is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in him."

ekegusii: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance.
english: Gaki, ama okwama kogwenerete okoonchoka;

ekegusii: Gaki, ama okwama kogwenerete okoonchoka, gose timochaka kobora emioyo yaino ime: Ntore na sokoro yaito, nere Ibrahimu. Naki nabatebirie ng’a Nyasae nare nokobua ase amagena aya gokorera Ibrahimu abana.
english: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, 'We have Abraham as our father.' For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.

ekegusii: Omoiseke oria agateba buna ng’ina konya amotebereirie, “Ing’a omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi igaa ase esani.”
english: Prompted by her mother, she said, "Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist."

ekegusii: Proud beasts do not set foot on it, and no lion prowls there.
english: Eng’iti y’orosana eng’enenu tiyana koyetacha, gose endo tiyana goetera aroro.

ekegusii: Abanto abaenenu babekire oboreba bobisi ase ngoetera, bantegeire ebichanga bimbwate, babekire emeeto ase oboeto bwane bwonsi.
english: Proud men have hidden a snare for me; they have spread out the cords of their net and have set traps for me along my path. Selah

ekegusii: Naende beka ang’e chiyombo bariinie Paulo, momoire buya ase Feliki, gavuna.”
english: Provide mounts for Paul so that he may be taken safely to Governor Felix."

ekegusii: Ee, koramoake ekeranya nigo oratoorie obogima bwaye korwa aase abakure.
english: Punish him with the rod and save his soul from death.

ekegusii: Naende mochene kera eanga, na kera egento keroisirie korwa ase amasankwa, gose korwa ase amanya e chimbori, na ebinto bionsi bi’emete.”
english: Purify every garment as well as everything made of leather, goat hair or wood."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, babwatie nendamwamu yao, obasirie, basire korwa inse y’erioba!”
english: Pursue them in anger and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.

ekegusii: Otube chinkoro chiabo nomosunte; okoragereria kwao kobe igoro yabo.
english: Put a veil over their hearts, and may your curse be on them!

ekegusii: Ebi bionsi obibeke ase amaboko a Haroni amo nay’abamura baye, obisungusie bibe okoruegwa ase Omonene.
english: Put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.

ekegusii: Tuguta chinkwana chi’obokorekanu korwa ase omonwa oo, na amang’ana ’obong’ainereria korwa ase ebikoba biao.
english: Put away perversity from your mouth; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.

ekegusii: Put into it the pieces of meat, all the choice pieces-- the leg and the shoulder. Fill it with the best of these bones;
english: Obeke ebitari bie chinyama imeo, bionsi ebire ebiya, ekenama ne rireko, oyeichorie amauga, ochore ayare amaya.

ekegusii: Obeke egechungi eke korwa inse y’orosingo geike gochia gati‐gati y’egesasimero.
english: Put it under the ledge of the altar so that it is halfway up the altar.

ekegusii: Aye goika obekere abanto aba orobebe roetanane egetunwa eke, obatebie: Mwerende, timotiira ase egetunwa igoro, gose timokuna chinsinyo chiaye. Onde bwensi oragekune nigo araitwe akwe.
english: Put limits for the people around the mountain and tell them, 'Be careful that you do not go up the mountain or touch the foot of it. Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death.

ekegusii: Oumore amaguta ase okoruegwa okwo, obeke na ubani; okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera.
english: Put oil and incense on it; it is a grain offering.

ekegusii: Inwe abakuani, eboyie chigunia, morere, nainwe abakoreri b’egesasimero, bokia amagombo! Inwe abakoreri ba Nyasae one, eboyie chigunia, morere ase Hekalu ime ase obotuko bwonsi, ekiagera okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa biatangirwe, tibirentwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae oino.
english: Put on sackcloth, O priests, and mourn; wail, you who minister before the altar. Come, spend the night in sackcloth, you who minister before my God; for the grain offerings and drink offerings are withheld from the house of your God.

ekegusii: Eboyie ebirwanero bionsi bia Nyasae, erinde monyare gotenena korwania obong’ainereria bwa Saitani.
english: Put on the full armor of God so that you can take your stand against the devil's schemes.

ekegusii: “Kae ense ya Moabu chimbaba, eirurukere etame; emechie yaye yonsi nesirigwe, ebe amaturi atamenyiri na monto.
english: Put salt on Moab, for she will be laid waste; her towns will become desolate, with no one to live in them.

ekegusii: Obeke egesasimero ekio bosio bw’etoto eria ekengete aase aria esanduku egachire, eria ere ne chibao chirikire oborori amo n’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera igoro yaye. Aase agwo ndabe nkoumerana naye.
english: Put the altar in front of the curtain that is before the ark of the Testimony-- before the atonement cover that is over the Testimony-- where I will meet with you.

ekegusii: Erio obeke Oboikaranso bw’Amabera igoro y’Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire oborori ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono.
english: Put the atonement cover on the ark of the Testimony in the Most Holy Place.

ekegusii: Ase emesa eyio obeke emegati erabe ekoruegwa asende, imbe nkoyerora botambe.”
english: Put the bread of the Presence on this table to be before me at all times.

ekegusii: Omobekere na ekegogwa omotwe oye, na ase ekegogwa eke osiberanie ekemanyererio keria egechenu gekoorokia ng’a bwatananirwe.
english: Put the turban on his head and attach the sacred diadem to the turban.

ekegusii: Oyebeke ase egetonga, oyendetere ebe egetonga ime ekero okondetera ekeng’wanso ki’eeri na egie chimingichi chiria ibere.
english: Put them in a basket and present them in it-- along with the bull and the two rams.

ekegusii: Ekero omosunte ochire, obeke ebinto biao ireko, ekero abanto bakorigereretie. Otube obosio bwao torora ense, ekiagera nagokorire aye obe ekemanyererio ase egesaku ki’Abaisraeli.”
english: Put them on your shoulder as they are watching and carry them out at dusk. Cover your face so that you cannot see the land, for I have made you a sign to the house of Israel."

ekegusii: Gaki moite ebiimo biaino ebire ase ense: obotomani, eubi, okorengereria okobe, okogania okobe, na obwegimeria, engencho yaye ogosasima emegwekano.
english: Put to death, therefore, whatever belongs to your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires and greed, which is idolatry.

ekegusii: Ekero more nomobaso yuegene, erinde monyare koba abana b’omobaso.” Ekero Yeso akwanete ayio akagenda akebisa korwa asebare.
english: Put your trust in the light while you have it, so that you may become sons of light." When he had finished speaking, Jesus left and hid himself from them.

ekegusii: Abadani bakeonchora, bagachaka kogenda, bagatang’ania abana, ne chitugo, amo ne chinibo chiabo.
english: Putting their little children, their livestock and their possessions in front of them, they turned away and left.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio eyio, Vasti eting’ana, moka omoruoti, nere agakorera abakungu omoyega agwo ase enyomba y’omoruoti Ahaswero.
english: Queen Vashti also gave a banquet for the women in the royal palace of King Xerxes.

ekegusii: Naende barabwo bakarimia chinguru chi’omorero, bagetooria korwa ase obwoge bw’omoro, bakabekwa chinguru nyuma y’oboreu bwabo, bakaba abakong’u ase esegi, bagaseria emeganda y’abarwani y’ababisa.
english: quenched the fury of the flames, and escaped the edge of the sword; whose weakness was turned to strength; and who became powerful in battle and routed foreign armies.

ekegusii: questioned him, "Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?"
english: Bakaboria Yohana, “Naki rende okobatisa, onye aye tori Kristo, gose Elija, gose omobani oria?”

ekegusii: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
english: na Rabiti, na Kisioni, na Ebesi,

ekegusii: Raeli agatebia ise, “Tata, onyabere, tobaisa kombea, naki tinkonyara koimoka ase obosio bwao, ekiagera nimbwate engencho yaito intwe abakungu.” Nabo akariga‐rigia, tabinyora.
english: Rachel said to her father, "Don't be angry, my lord, that I cannot stand up in your presence; I'm having my period." So he searched but could not find the household gods.

ekegusii: Bilia, omosomba o Raeli, akaba morito naende, akaiborera Yakobo omwana omoisia o kabere.
english: Rachel's servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.

ekegusii: Ebiombe bitato bi’abarwani bikarua ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti; ekeombe ekemo gekaonchoka gochia Ofura, ase ense ya Sauli,
english: Raiding parties went out from the Philistine camp in three detachments. One turned toward Ophrah in the vicinity of Shual,

ekegusii: Tenenia ebendera igoro ase egetunwa getari na mete; aka eriogi rinene ase abarwani esegi, basime namaboko basoe ase ebiita bi’abanto abasike.
english: Raise a banner on a bare hilltop, shout to them; beckon to them to enter the gates of the nobles.

ekegusii: Imokia ekemanyererio kiorokie enchera egochia Sayoni; tama motooreke, timobaisa gotebana, ekiagera nkorenta nde obobe na ogosaria okonene korwa sugusu.”
english: Raise the signal to go to Zion! Flee for safety without delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, even terrible destruction."

ekegusii: Inwe abanto aba, kora eburu‐buru, nonya naboigo goika mosenyentwe! Ee, inwe mwensi abamore ase chinse chi’aare, igwa ayio! Eboyie mokong’e, goika mosenyentwe! Ee, eboyie goika mosenyentwe!
english: Raise the war cry, you nations, and be shattered! Listen, all you distant lands. Prepare for battle, and be shattered! Prepare for battle, and be shattered!

ekegusii: Aye imokia enyimbo yao, na orambore okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde yaatananeke, Abaisraeli banyare goeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku.
english: Raise your staff and stretch out your hand over the sea to divide the water so that the Israelites can go through the sea on dry ground.

ekegusii: ram skins dyed red and hides of sea cows; acacia wood;
english: amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, na amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, ne chibao chi’emekonge;

ekegusii: Ram the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,
english: na Aramu akaibora Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akaibora Nashoni, na Nashoni akaibora Salimoni,

ekegusii: Ramu akaibora Aminadabu, na Aminadabu akaibora Nahasoni, oyo orenge omotang’ani bw’abanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda.
english: Ram was the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab the father of Nahshon, the leader of the people of Judah.

ekegusii: Ramoth and Anem, together with their pasturelands;
english: na Ramoti, na Anemu, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.

ekegusii: Mobe abaya asare, momoe singo ebinto biisaine ase oboremerwa bwaye bonde bwonsi.
english: Rather be openhanded and freely lend him whatever he needs.

ekegusii: korende abe omoroisia abageni, omwanchi amaya, oyobwerendete ase onsi, omoronge, omochenu, na oyomanyete kwerita ase onsi.
english: Rather he must be hospitable, one who loves what is good, who is self-controlled, upright, holy and disciplined.

ekegusii: korende, buna erikire, “Baria batana gotebigwa amang’ana igoro yaye, nabarore, na baria batana koyaigwa, nabamanye.”
english: Rather, as it is written: "Those who were not told about him will see, and those who have not heard will understand."

ekegusii: korende ase kera ring’ana twenyore ogotogigwa okuya buna abasomba ba Nyasae, ase okoganya okonge, ase emechando, ase obokong’u, ase ogochandwa,
english: Rather, as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way: in great endurance; in troubles, hardships and distresses;

ekegusii: Korende mweboyie Omonene Yeso Kristo, timoa omobere ribaga goikerania okogania kwaye kw’ebibe.
english: Rather, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not think about how to gratify the desires of the sinful nature.

ekegusii: Naende momoruserie ebigara korwa ase emesaima, momotigere abichore, timobaisa komotanga.”
english: Rather, pull out some stalks for her from the bundles and leave them for her to pick up, and don't rebuke her."

ekegusii: Twangire amang’ana ’obosooku ayabisegete, gose titori gotaara ase obong’ainereria, gose gokorera ring’ana ria Nyasae noborimo. Korende ase okoorokia ayare ay’ekeene tweorokirie ase abanto bonsi ase okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime, ng’a ntore nekeene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: Rather, we have renounced secret and shameful ways; we do not use deception, nor do we distort the word of God. On the contrary, by setting forth the truth plainly we commend ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

ekegusii: korende mong’iroke inche Omonene, Nyasae oino; inche nimbarusie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baino.”
english: Rather, worship the LORD your God; it is he who will deliver you from the hand of all your enemies."

ekegusii: Rambora okoboko kwao korwa agwo igoro, ondusie na ontoorie korwa ase amache aya amange, na korwa ase amaboko ’abanto be chinse chingeni,
english: Reach down your hand from on high; deliver me and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hands of foreigners

ekegusii: Daudi agasoyia okoboko kwaye ase esaro, akarusia rigena, akariruta nenduruche, agaaka Omofilisti oria obosio bwaye. Rigena riria rikarimera obosio bwaye ime, na ere akagwa inse maumama, agakwa.
english: Reaching into his bag and taking out a stone, he slung it and struck the Philistine on the forehead. The stone sank into his forehead, and he fell facedown on the ground.

ekegusii: Reaya, mosinto o Sobali, akaibora Yahati, na Yahati akaibora Ahumai na Lahadi. Korwa ase abwo nao Abasora barwete.
english: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.

ekegusii: Reaiah, Rezin, Nekoda,
english: Reaya, na Resini, na Nekoda;

ekegusii: Rebeka nere akaimokia amaiso aye, akarora Isaka; erio agaika bwango korwa ase engamia igoro,
english: Rebekah also looked up and saw Isaac. She got down from her camel

ekegusii: Rebekah said to her son Jacob, "Look, I overheard your father say to your brother Esau,
english: Rebeka agatebia Yakobo, omwana oye, “Naigure iso ogotebia momura omino Esau:

ekegusii: Twasaririe na komokana Omonene, twairanire nyuma, twatigire komobwatia Nyasae oito; nigo togokwana amang’ana ay’ogokorera abande bobe, na ay’ogotaigwera; nigo togokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria akorwa ase chinkoro chiaito.
english: rebellion and treachery against the LORD, turning our backs on our God, fomenting oppression and revolt, uttering lies our hearts have conceived.

ekegusii: Togonyera eng’iti eria y’orosana emenyete ase ebitonto ime, na amaicho e chieri amo ne chimori chiabo, nabwo abanto. Togonyera abanto goika bekeyie na gokoruera chifeta chiabo. Osiarere abanto banchete esegi.
english: Rebuke the beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations. Humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora amariga ao nigo nkoba namaiga gokorora, erinde ing’ichorwe nomogoko.
english: Recalling your tears, I long to see you, so that I may be filled with joy.

ekegusii: Koranyore chibesa echi Abaisraeli bararue chibe embooria, ochikorere ase emeremo y’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase igo Abaisraeli babe bakoinyorwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende chibesa echio chibe embooria ase obogima bwabo.”
english: Receive the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will be a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD, making atonement for your lives."

ekegusii: Rero iga mweitia mogakora amang’ana are amaronge ase amaiso aane, mokararia obosibore, kera omonto ase omogisangio oye. Boigo mogakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania ase obosio bwane, agwo ase enyomba eyio ekorokwa ase erieta riane.
english: Recently you repented and did what is right in my sight: Each of you proclaimed freedom to his countrymen. You even made a covenant before me in the house that bears my Name.

ekegusii: Omonto nare otari korengereria aya agokwana, na amang’ana aye nigo anga buna omoro ogokeba, korende oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rokorenta amang’ana akogwenia.
english: Reckless words pierce like a sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

ekegusii: Omonene, aye nomanyete okoong’anya kwane, nigo osangereretie amariga aane okayabeka ase egetono kiao. Inee! Ayio onsi tarikiri ase ebuku yao?
english: Record my lament; list my tears on your scroll--are they not in your record?

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, booria Abaisraeli korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.
english: Redeem Israel, O God, from all their troubles!

ekegusii: Mboorie korwa ase ogokorerwa bobe nabanto, erio nario ndanyare korenda amachiko ao.
english: Redeem me from the oppression of men, that I may obey your precepts.

ekegusii: Korende emori entangi y’etigere goika oyeboorie ase okorua eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso. Onye tibwancheti koyebooria, goika oyebune ebigoti. Abana bao abaisia abatangi goika obaboorie. Onde tari orabe ogocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, namaboko amasa.
english: Redeem the firstborn donkey with a lamb, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem all your firstborn sons. "No one is to appear before me empty-handed.

ekegusii: Korende kera emori entangi y’etigere goika oyeboorie ase okorua emanwa y’eng’ondi ebe ekeng’wanso. Onye tibwancheti koyebooria goika oyebune ebigoti. Kera omwana omoisia omotangi o mwanyabanto goika omoboorie.
english: Redeem with a lamb every firstborn donkey, but if you do not redeem it, break its neck. Redeem every firstborn among your sons.

ekegusii: Rengereria mono ayio ngokwana, ekiagera Omonene nakoe okomanya ase amang’ana onsi.
english: Reflect on what I am saying, for the Lord will give you insight into all this.

ekegusii: Bwetange korwa ase endamwamu, tiga ekeririanda kegima. Togechigwa; okogechigwa nigo koragere okore ebibe.
english: Refrain from anger and turn from wrath; do not fret-- it leads only to evil.

ekegusii: Goika omobare ng’a nomochenu, ekiagera nere okorua okoruegwa kw’endagera asende inche Nyasae oo; nabe omochenu asore, ekiagera inche Omonene nomochenu inde, ninche nkobachena.
english: Regard them as holy, because they offer up the food of your God. Consider them holy, because I the LORD am holy-- I who make you holy.

ekegusii: Eye nenchili igoro y’Omwana oye Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito. Ere akaiborwa buna mwanyabanto ase ororeria rwa Daudi,
english: regarding his Son, who as to his human nature was a descendant of David,

ekegusii: Rehoboamu akabatebia, “Genda moirane aa asende naende nyuma y’amatuko atato.” Ase ayio bakagenda.
english: Rehoboam answered, "Come back to me in three days." So the people went away.

ekegusii: Rehoboamu akabatebia, “Genda inwe, na nyuma y’amatuko atato moirane gocha aa asende.” Ase ayio abanto bakagenda.
english: Rehoboam answered, "Go away for three days and then come back to me." So the people went away.

ekegusii: Rehoboamu agachora Abiya, omwana omomura o Maaka, akaba omotang’ani ase abamwabo, ekiagera nigo aganetie komobeka abe omoruoti.
english: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maacah to be the chief prince among his brothers, in order to make him king.

ekegusii: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem and built up towns for defense in Judah:
english: Rehoboamu akamenya Yerusalemu, na akaagacha emechie y’ogwekengera agwo Yuda.

ekegusii: Rehoboamu agancha Maaka, mosubati bw’Abisalomu goetania abakungu baye bonsi abanyuome, na abwo ba sere‐sere. (Nigo abwate abakungu abanyuome ikomi na batano na batato, na abakungu ba sere‐sere emerongo etano nomo; nabwate abana abamura emerongo ebere na batano na batato, na abana abaiseke emerongo etano nomo.)
english: Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than any of his other wives and concubines. In all, he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.

ekegusii: Rehoboam married Mahalath, who was the daughter of David's son Jerimoth and of Abihail, the daughter of Jesse's son Eliab.
english: Rehoboamu akanyuoma Mahalati, omoiseke o Yerimoti, mosinto o Daudi; ngina Mahalati nere Abihaili, omosubati bw’Eliabu, mosinto o Yese.

ekegusii: Rehoboamu akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi, na Abiya, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Rehoboam rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And Abijah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Bono Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, akagambera Abayuda. Ekero achagete kogamba konya okoorire emiaka emerongo ene nomo, akaba okogamba ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere, agwo Yerusalemu, omochie oria Omonene achorete korwa ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, erinde abeke erieta riaye aroro. Ng’ina Rehoboamu nigo arenge korokwa Naama, omosubati bw’Abaamoni.
english: Rehoboam son of Solomon was king in Judah. He was forty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city the LORD had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel in which to put his Name. His mother's name was Naamah; she was an Ammonite.

ekegusii: Rehoboamu akagenda Sekemu, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi konya bachiire aroro komobeka abe omoruoti.
english: Rehoboam went to Shechem, for all the Israelites had gone there to make him king.

ekegusii: Boigo Rehumu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, bakarikera Aritasasita rirube bagosoera Yerusalemu.
english: Rehum the commanding officer and Shimshai the secretary wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows:

ekegusii: Erio Rehemu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, na abande babwataine nabarabwo: abagambi ebina, na abagavuna, na abanene b’oboruoti, na Abaayemi, na Abaereki, na Abababeli, na Abasusa korwa ase ense y’Abaelamu,
english: Rehum the commanding officer and Shimshai the secretary, together with the rest of their associates-- the judges and officials over the men from Tripolis, Persia, Erech and Babylon, the Elamites of Susa,

ekegusii: Rehumu, na Hasabuna, na Maaseya;
english: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,

ekegusii: Goka na gochenga, ekiagera eng’eria yaino nenene igoro. Naki naboigo bachandete ababani abarengeo ritang’ani konya motarabao.
english: Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Edomu, inwe abamomenyete ase ense ya Usi, goka na gochenga! Nonya nasemore egekombe nkebaikere, monywe motinde goika motigare getirianda.
english: Rejoice and be glad, O Daughter of Edom, you who live in the land of Uz. But to you also the cup will be passed; you will be drunk and stripped naked.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni goka mono! Ee, inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, aka eriogi ri’omochengo! Rora, omoruoti oino nkobachera are; ere nomonyene oboronge na omobui. Nigo are omokanyeku oriinete etigere, ee, oriinete emori y’etigere, akamori g’etigere.
english: Rejoice greatly, O Daughter of Zion! Shout, Daughter of Jerusalem! See, your king comes to you, righteous and having salvation, gentle and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

ekegusii: Goka ase Omonene amatuko onsi; naende natebire: Goka!
english: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!

ekegusii: Inwe abanyene oboronge, mogokere Omonene na komochengera; inwe mwensi abamore ne chinkoro chindonge, aka eriogi nomogoko.
english: Rejoice in the LORD and be glad, you righteous; sing, all you who are upright in heart!

ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamore abaronge, goka ase Omonene, moake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.
english: Rejoice in the LORD, you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.

ekegusii: Goka igoro yaye, inwe aba igoro, inwe abachenu, na abatomwa, na ababani, naki Nyasae namogambetie ere, ekiagera ere abagambetie inwe!”
english: Rejoice over her, O heaven! Rejoice, saints and apostles and prophets! God has judged her for the way she treated you.'"

ekegusii: Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.
english: Goka amo nabwo bakogoka; rera amo nabwo bakorera.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanto b’ebisaku, goka amo nabanto b’Omonene; ekiagera orusirie egesiomba ki’amanyinga ’abasomba baye; orusirie egesiomba igoro ase ababisa baye, okorire okobwatania ase ense yaye na ase abanto baye.”
english: Rejoice, O nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants; he will take vengeance on his enemies and make atonement for his land and people.

ekegusii: Nigo nagokerete ense yaye emenyire nabanto, na nkaba nsasokerete mwanyabanto.
english: rejoicing in his whole world and delighting in mankind.

ekegusii: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,
english: na Rekemu, na Iripeli, na Tarala,

ekegusii: Nabasoroire, irana, timobaisa gokora ing’ana rinde riibe. Bono irana naende, ekiagera ring’ana riane neri’oboronge.
english: Relent, do not be unjust; reconsider, for my integrity is at stake.

ekegusii: Omonene, irana asetore! Ngoika ririri orabe kogotebana? Otororere intwe, abasomba bao, amabera!
english: Relent, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on your servants.

ekegusii: Okomokorera Nyasae okore ogochenu, gotari na komocha ase obosio bwa Nyasae Tata noko: Gochia korora chintakana na ababoraka ase obokong’u bwabo, na kwerenda ere omonyene, na igo taba na kemoa gi’ense.
english: Religion that God our Father accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.

ekegusii: Menya ime yane, na inche ime yaino. Buna orosagia rotanyare kwama rwoka oronyene, rotabeti ime ase omosabibu, naboigo nainwe motamenyeti ime yane.
english: Remain in me, and I will remain in you. No branch can bear fruit by itself; it must remain in the vine. Neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in me.

ekegusii: Engori eroisirie korwa ase efeta nebutorwe, na egetaabo keroisirie korwa ase etahabu ngiatwe, na enyongo yatwe agwo ase ensoko y’amache, na ekebara‐bara nkebunwe agwo ase egesima ki’amache.
english: Remember him-- before the silver cord is severed, or the golden bowl is broken; before the pitcher is shattered at the spring, or the wheel broken at the well,

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna obogima bwane bore obweng’e, nigo gwatongete mwanyabanto bonsi bakwe igo.
english: Remember how fleeting is my life. For what futility you have created all men!

ekegusii: Rora, ase ogoaka obomera naatananeire ebisaku biaino ense y’abanto aba batigarete amo ney’abwo konya nasiririe, ebe omwando oino, ense yonsi korwa orooche rwa Yorodan goika Enyancha Enene ya bosongo.
english: Remember how I have allotted as an inheritance for your tribes all the land of the nations that remain-- the nations I conquered-- between the Jordan and the Great Sea in the west.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora buna ababisa bagendererete kogochecheria, na abatakoirogeti nigo bagendererete korama erieta riao.
english: Remember how the enemy has mocked you, O LORD, how foolish people have reviled your name.

ekegusii: Moinyore buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, abeire okobaraa ase orogendo rwaino rwonsi ase erooro, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene yaetire, ase okobakora mobe abaitongo na kobateema ase okomanya ebirengerio biaino, arore gose moganetie korenda amachiko aye, gose yaya.
english: Remember how the LORD your God led you all the way in the desert these forty years, to humble you and to test you in order to know what was in your heart, whether or not you would keep his commands.

ekegusii: Moinyore Yeso Kristo, oyobogete korwa ase abakure, oyo bw’ororeria rwa Daudi, koreng’ana nenchili eye nkorandia inche.
english: Remember Jesus Christ, raised from the dead, descended from David. This is my gospel,

ekegusii: Remember Lot's wife!
english: Moinyore moka Loti.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ong’inyore ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio. Tobaisa gotinyia ogokora kwane okuya nakorire ase enyomba yao na ase emeremo ere aroro ey’okogokorera.
english: Remember me for this, O my God, and do not blot out what I have so faithfully done for the house of my God and its services.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, ong’inyore ong’e amaya koreng’ana buna amaya nakoreire abanto aba.
english: Remember me with favor, O my God, for all I have done for these people.

ekegusii: Omonene, ong’inyore ekero okororera abanto bao amabera, onchichere, ontoorie!
english: Remember me, O LORD, when you show favor to your people, come to my aid when you save them,

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tobaisa koinyora ebibe na ogosaria bi’obosae bwane; ong’inyore ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na ase engencho y’obuya bwao.
english: Remember not the sins of my youth and my rebellious ways; according to your love remember me, for you are good, O LORD.

ekegusii: Inyora ng’a engaki eria timwarenge na Kristo, nigo mwatananekanete korwa ase obobiare bw’Abaisraeli, abageni b’okobwatana kw’eira, motarenge na gosemeria konde, na motarenge na Nyasae ase ense.
english: remember that at that time you were separate from Christ, excluded from citizenship in Israel and foreigners to the covenants of the promise, without hope and without God in the world.

ekegusii: Inyora ng’a naye kwambombete buna esike. Inee! Nigo okong’irania imbe orotu naende?
english: Remember that you molded me like clay. Will you now turn me to dust again?

ekegusii: Inyora ng’a aye omonyene nigo kwarenge omosomba ase ense ya Misiri, na Omonene, Nyasae oo, agakorusia korwa aroro nokoboko kore ne chinguru koramboire. Ase ayio Omonene, Nyasae oo, nigo agochigete orende rituko ri’Esabato.
english: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and that the LORD your God brought you out of there with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God has commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.

ekegusii: Korende moinyore ing’a nainwe mwarenge abasomba ase ense ya Misiri, korende Omonene, Nyasae oino, akababooria korwa aroro; ase ayio nabachikire mobwatie amang’ana ayio.
english: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you from there. That is why I command you to do this.

ekegusii: Moinyore ng’a nainwe mwarenge abasomba ase ense ya Misiri, na Omonene, Nyasae oino, akababooria korwa aroro. Ase engencho eyio nabachikire amang’ana aya rituko ria rero.
english: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you. That is why I give you this command today.

ekegusii: Moinyore ng’a nainwe nigo mwarenge abasomba aaria Misiri, ase ayio morende na kobwata emeroberio eyio yonsi echikire.
english: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and follow carefully these decrees.

ekegusii: Inyora ng’a inwe nigo mwarenge abasomba ase ense ya Misiri; ase ayio nabachikire mobwatie amang’ana ayio.
english: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt. That is why I command you to do this.

ekegusii: erinde bamanye ayakoregete ase rituko riria mwatenenete ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, agwo Horebu, ekero Omonene akwanete nainche, agantebia: Sangereria abanto bonsi amo, na inche mbatebie amang’ana, erinde beorokererie konyiroka ase amatuko onsi barabe bare moyo ase ense, nabarabwo baborokererie abana babo boigo.
english: Remember the day you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, when he said to me, "Assemble the people before me to hear my words so that they may learn to revere me as long as they live in the land and may teach them to their children."

ekegusii: “Inyora amatuko a kare, rengereria igoro y’emiaka y’ebiaare biaetire. Boria iso, nere nakworokererie amang’ana ayio, boria abagaaka baino, nabarabwo mbakoyatebie.
english: Remember the days of old; consider the generations long past. Ask your father and he will tell you, your elders, and they will explain to you.

ekegusii: Inyora amang’ana abete kare; inche ninche Nyasae, onde tari; ninche Nyasae, onde tari onga buna inche.
english: Remember the former things, those of long ago; I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is none like me.

ekegusii: Gaki, inyora nkorwa ase ki ogwete. Onchoka, okore ogokora kwao kwe ritang’ani! Otakoreti bo, ninchiche asore, ndusie ekebekerero kiao gie chitaya korwa aase aye, otaonchogeti.
english: Remember the height from which you have fallen! Repent and do the things you did at first. If you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.

ekegusii: Inyora omoganda bw’abanto bao, abwo kwenyorerete ase chingaki chia kare. Aye nigo kwababooretie babe egesaku kere omwando oo. Inyora egetunwa gia Sayoni, agwo ase kwabeire komenyete.
english: Remember the people you purchased of old, the tribe of your inheritance, whom you redeemed-- Mount Zion, where you dwelt.

ekegusii: Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Israeli, omosomba bw’Omonene, inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abachore b’Omonene, inyora ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia na amakumia aye amo nebina anachete.
english: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Ibrahimu, omosomba bw’Omonene, ee, inwe abanto ba Yakobo, abachore b’Omonene, inyora emeremo y’ogokumia, eria akorire, inyora ebikone biaye, na ebina biaye bi’ekeene arure.
english: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

ekegusii: Inyora ring’ana riria nabatebetie: Omosomba tari omonene kobua omonene oye. Onye banchandete inche, nababachande nainwe; onye babwatete ring’ana riane nabwate neriaino.
english: Remember the words I spoke to you: 'No servant is greater than his master.' If they persecuted me, they will persecute you also. If they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours also.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae one, inyora abanto abwo, ekiagera bakorire obokuani bwabeire obotachenegeti na basaririe okobwatana kw’obokuani okwo kwabeire ogotachenegeti, na Abalawi boigo babeire abatachenegeti.
english: Remember them, O my God, because they defiled the priestly office and the covenant of the priesthood and of the Levites.

ekegusii: “Moinyore, timobaisa kweba buna mwagerete Omonene, Nyasae oino, akaba nendamwamu agwo ase erooro. Korwa ase rituko riria mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri, goika ekero mwaigete aase aiga, mwabeire motari koigwera Omonene.
english: Remember this and never forget how you provoked the LORD your God to anger in the desert. From the day you left Egypt until you arrived here, you have been rebellious against the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende inyora aya, oyogosimeka ebike nigo akogesa ebike; oyogosimeka ebinge nigo akogesa ebinge.
english: Remember this: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

ekegusii: tiga ere amanye ng’a oyokoirania omonyene ebibe korwa ase enchera y’ogosira, ere natoorie omoyo oye korwa ase amakweri na atube obonge bw’ebibe.
english: remember this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save him from death and cover over a multitude of sins.

ekegusii: Korende moinyore amatuko e ritang’ani, nyuma komwabarerigwe omobaso igo mwaremereretie okoamererania okonene kw’ogochandwa.
english: Remember those earlier days after you had received the light, when you stood your ground in a great contest in the face of suffering.

ekegusii: Inyora abwo basibire ase echela, buna nainwe mosibire amo nabarabwo, naende barabwo mbakoreretwe bobe, ekiagera naboigo nainwe more nomobere.
english: Remember those in prison as if you were their fellow prisoners, and those who are mistreated as if you yourselves were suffering.

ekegusii: Inyora gotogia emeremo yaye, eyio abanto babeire bagotera na koyetogia.
english: Remember to extol his work, which men have praised in song.

ekegusii: “Aye Nyasae one, inyora amang’ana a Tobia na Sanibalati, boigo aya Noadia, omobani oria omokungu, amo nay’ababani bande, abaganetie konyoboyia.”
english: Remember Tobiah and Sanballat, O my God, because of what they have done; remember also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets who have been trying to intimidate me.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria rero inyora buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, akobaa egesusuro ase okobarongeyia. (Tindi gokwana ase abana baino, baria bataramanya gose batararora amang’ana ayio.) Inyora obonene bwaye na okoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru koramboire,
english: Remember today that your children were not the ones who saw and experienced the discipline of the LORD your God: his majesty, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm;

ekegusii: “Moinyore aya Abaameleki babakorerete ekero mwarenge ase orogendo korwa Misiri.
english: Remember what the Amalekites did to you along the way when you came out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Ayio onsi inche nabachigete ng’a babatebie, goika moyakore. Inyora aya Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorerete Miriamu ekero mwarenge ase orogendo rwaino korwa Misiri.
english: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam along the way after you came out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Inyora Omotongi oo ekero ore omosae, ekero amatuko amabe ataracha, na emiaka eyio emebe etaraika ang’e ekero oratebe, “Tindi nomogoko koba moyo ase engaki buna eye!”
english: Remember your Creator in the days of your youth, before the days of trouble come and the years approach when you will say, "I find no pleasure in them"--

ekegusii: Inyora abwo baare kobatang’ana, ababatebetie ring’ana ria Nyasae. Naende morengererie mono omoerio bw’obogima bwabo, mobe abegi b’okwegena kwabo.
english: Remember your leaders, who spoke the word of God to you. Consider the outcome of their way of life and imitate their faith.

ekegusii: Inyora abasomba bao Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Israeli, na buna kwabarierete eira ase ogwetiania, okabatebia: Nigo ndamente oroiboro rwaino robe oronge buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro. Nimbae ense eye yonsi nabarierete eira ng’a nimbae ebe omwando obo kare na kare.”
english: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Israel, to whom you swore by your own self: 'I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and I will give your descendants all this land I promised them, and it will be their inheritance forever.'"

ekegusii: Inyora abasomba bao, Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo; tobaisa kobarera abanto aba ogotaigwera kwabo gose obonyaka bwabo, gose ebibe biabo.
english: Remember your servants Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. Overlook the stubbornness of this people, their wickedness and their sin.

ekegusii: Inyora ring’ana riao gwakwanete asende inche omosomba oo, ekiagera ase rirorio kwang’eire ogosemeria.
english: Remember your word to your servant, for you have given me hope.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’inyore inche omosomba oo buna ingokorerwa echeche; nigo ndemereretie emerumi y’abanto abange.
english: Remember, Lord, how your servant has been mocked, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the nations,

ekegusii: “Manya ng’a obogima bwane nigo bore buna embeo bosa; amaiso aane takorora amaya naende.
english: Remember, O God, that my life is but a breath; my eyes will never see happiness again.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora aya atonyorire, origererie orore ogochaywa gwaito.
english: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us; look, and see our disgrace.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyora amabe aya abanto b’Edomu bakorete ase rituko riria Yerusalemu obwatetwe; buna batebete, “Yotagore kegima! Yotagore amo noboroso bwaye!”
english: Remember, O LORD, what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. "Tear it down," they cried, "tear it down to its foundations!"

ekegusii: Omonene, inyora amabera ao na obwanchani bwao botari koera, ekiagera nao biarenge korwa kare.
english: Remember, O LORD, your great mercy and love, for they are from of old.

ekegusii: Gaki, inyora buna kwayanyorete, naende buna kwayaigwete; bwata ayio na koonchoka. Onye tokorenda ninchiche asore buna omoibi agocha, na aye tokomanya nonya ng’ake ensa ngocha asore.
english: Remember, therefore, what you have received and heard; obey it, and repent. But if you do not wake up, I will come like a thief, and you will not know at what time I will come to you.

ekegusii: na Remeti, na Eni‐Ganimu, na Eni‐Hada, na Beti‐Pasesi.
english: Remeth, En Gannim, En Haddah and Beth Pazzez.

ekegusii: Oinyorie abanto bekeyie ase abagambi, na ase abare nokobua, naende babe abaigweri, bebeke ang’e gokora kera ogokora okuya.
english: Remind the people to be subject to rulers and authorities, to be obedient, to be ready to do whatever is good,

ekegusii: Orusie Haroni chianga chiaye chi’obokuani, ochibekere Eleazari, momura oye. Haroni ere nakwe, na asangererekane amo nabanto baye, ekero more aaria.”
english: Remove Aaron's garments and put them on his son Eleazar, for Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will die there."

ekegusii: Onduserie ogochecherigwa na ogochaywa kwabo, ekiagera inche nigo ndendete oborori bwao.
english: Remove from me scorn and contempt, for I keep your statutes.

ekegusii: Rusia amabiria korwa ase efeta, na omoturi nanyore efeta akoroiseria egekorero ekiya.
english: Remove the dross from the silver, and out comes material for the silversmith;

ekegusii: Rusia abakori amabe korwa ase obosio bw’omoruoti, erio ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nigo keragenderere gokong’igwa noboronge.
english: remove the wicked from the king's presence, and his throne will be established through righteousness.

ekegusii: Rusia egesusuro kiao asende; naerire ase ogoakwa gw’okoboko kwao.
english: Remove your scourge from me; I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

ekegusii: Tandora chinkoro chiaino ase ogweitia, gose tari ogotandora chianga chiaino.” Irana gochia ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, ekiagera ere nomuya na omonyamabera; ere tari omwango ase okoba nendamwamu; obwanchani bwaye nobwa botambe, nigo akoonchoka otiga kobarentera amabe.
english: Rend your heart and not your garments. Return to the LORD your God, for he is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love, and he relents from sending calamity.

ekegusii: Bae egesusuro koreng’ana nogokora kwabo na ebibe biabo, obaakane koreng’ana nemeremo y’amaboko abo, obae eki bagwenerete konyora.
english: Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back upon them what they deserve.

ekegusii: Ase ayio onchoka korwa ase obobe bwao obo, osabe Omonene, erinde, keranyarekane, bwaberwe ebirengererio bi’enkoro yao.
english: Repent of this wickedness and pray to the Lord. Perhaps he will forgive you for having such a thought in your heart.

ekegusii: Onchoka rende! Otaonchogeti, ninchiche asore bwango, nkore esegi igoro asebare nomoyio o birende bw’omonwa one.
english: Repent therefore! Otherwise, I will soon come to you and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

ekegusii: Ase ayio onchoka, moirane, erinde ebibe biaino bitinyigwe, erio chingaki chi’ogotimokigwa chinyare gocha korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene,
english: Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord,

ekegusii: Refa nigo arenge omomura bw’Efraimu, na Resefu omomura oye, na Tela omomura oye, na Tahani omomura oye,
english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

ekegusii: Oyo obwatetie abwo koagacha, n’Refaya, mosinto o Huri, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rore rwa Yerusalemu.
english: Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section.

ekegusii: Nkonye na onsibore goetera ase oboronge bwao; ntegerere, ontoorie!
english: Rescue me and deliver me in your righteousness; turn your ear to me and save me.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane; nagotameire ombise.
english: Rescue me from my enemies, O LORD, for I hide myself in you.

ekegusii: Ntoorie, tindimera ase etintira ime! Ntoorie korwa ase ababisa baane, na korwa ase amache ’endiba entambe.
english: Rescue me from the mire, do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.

ekegusii: Ntoorie, ondusie ase emenwa ye chindo chiria; nkonya korwa ase chingunchara chie ching’era!
english: Rescue me from the mouth of the lions; save me from the horns of the wild oxen.

ekegusii: Tooria abatari na nguru, na aba tabwati kende, basibore korwa ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.”
english: Rescue the weak and needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.

ekegusii: Rescue those being led away to death; hold back those staggering toward slaughter.
english: Tooria abwo bakoirwa gochia gokwa; irania abwo bakoirwa gochia goitwa.

ekegusii: Ekeene, ogwechanda nigo kogoita omoriri, na emoko nigo egoita oyo otari omong’aini.
english: Resentment kills a fool, and envy slays the simple.

ekegusii: Mwange ere, na motenene bokong’u ase okwegena, momanye ng’a ogochandwa okwo okwo gwaikeranigwe ase abamino abare ase ense engima.
english: Resist him, standing firm in the faith, because you know that your brothers throughout the world are undergoing the same kind of sufferings.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toiranerie amaya aito, buna okoirania chindooche ase Ense ya Irianyi.
english: Restore our fortunes, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.

ekegusii: Ong’iranerie omogoko okorwa ase ogotooreka kwao, okong’ie omoika one obe omoigweri.
english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Omotooria oito, otoiranere, rusia ekeririanda kiao korwa asetore.
english: Restore us again, O God our Savior, and put away your displeasure toward us.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, toiranie gocha asore, erinde toiranigwe, onchora amatuko aito oyakore abe amayia, abe buna aria a kare!
english: Restore us to yourself, O LORD, that we may return; renew our days as of old

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, otoonchore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.
english: Restore us, O God Almighty; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, otokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.
english: Restore us, O God; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, tokore tobe abayia, otoraberie obosio bwao, erio nario toratooreke.
english: Restore us, O LORD God Almighty; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.

ekegusii: Omonto ogotanga omokungu buna oyio, okwo nigo konga ogotangwa kw’omwaga gose okobwata amaguta nokoboko gw’okorio.
english: restraining her is like restraining the wind or grasping oil with the hand.

ekegusii: “Ekero bogochia koira omoiranerie egetambaa akwambara erinde ebisie, nario aragosesenie, na igo gwakorire ayare boronge ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo.
english: Return his cloak to him by sunset so that he may sleep in it. Then he will thank you, and it will be regarded as a righteous act in the sight of the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Abana baane, irana mogende seino, ekiagera inche nagotire mono, tinkonyuomwa naende. Nonya nare korengereria ng’a ninde nogosemeria, na onye nare konyora omosacha rero, nyibore abana abamura.
english: Return home, my daughters; I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was still hope for me-- even if I had a husband tonight and then gave birth to sons--

ekegusii: “Irania omoyio ase ekeraaro kiaye! Agwo ase ense mwatongeretwe, ense y’obobiare bwaino, nao ndabanachere ekina.
english: Return the sword to its scabbard. In the place where you were created, in the land of your ancestry, I will judge you.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, moiranere oria mwasaretie asare mokamotiga.
english: Return to him you have so greatly revolted against, O Israelites.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae bw’Emeganda, yoiranere naende, rigereria korwa agwo igoro orore; bwechandere omosabibu oyio.
english: Return to us, O God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Watch over this vine,

ekegusii: Inwe abasibwa more nogosemeria, irana ase eburi yaino. Ase rituko ria rero nigo nkobarareria inwe ng’a nimbae amaya ara kabere.
english: Return to your fortress, O prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, irana ase Omonene Nyasae oino, ekiagera ebibe biaino nabio biabagochire na kobaiyeria.
english: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God. Your sins have been your downfall!

ekegusii: Agacha eria gatato, akabatebia, “Nonya mbono moraire, na gotimoka? Aisanire. Engaki yaikire. Rora, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto obekirwe ase amaboko ’abanyene ebibe.
english: Returning the third time, he said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

ekegusii: Reuben akabairaneria, “Tinabakanetie ng’a timomochera omosae oyo? Korende inwe mokaanga, timwanyigwera. Ase igo bono amanyinga aye aganigwe aakanwe.”
english: Reuben replied, "Didn't I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you wouldn't listen! Now we must give an accounting for his blood."

ekegusii: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah;
english: Reuben na Simeoni, Lawi na Yuda;

ekegusii: Ong’inyorie, tokwane komo, aye na inche; okwane amang’ana ao, erinde onyore oboronge bwao.
english: Review the past for me, let us argue the matter together; state the case for your innocence.

ekegusii: Rezin, Nekoda, Gazzam,
english: Resini, na Nekoda, na Gasamu;

ekegusii: Resoni nigo abete omobisa bw’Abaisraeli ase amatuko onsi aya Sulemani arenge kogamba, agakora ogosaria okonene buna Hadadi akorete; akagechia Abaisraeli, akaba okogambera Abasiiria.
english: Rezon was Israel's adversary as long as Solomon lived, adding to the trouble caused by Hadad. So Rezon ruled in Aram and was hostile toward Israel.

ekegusii: Omonda na omotaka nigo bamenyete ase obogima obomo; Omonene nere omotongi o bonsi.
english: Rich and poor have this in common: The LORD is the Maker of them all.

ekegusii: Motugute ogosaria kwaino gwonsi, okwo mwakorire asende, mwenyorere chinkoro chinyia na omoika omoyia. Inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki moganetie gokwa?
english: Rid yourselves of all the offenses you have committed, and get a new heart and a new spirit. Why will you die, O house of Israel?

ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo ore omonyene oboronge, na ebina biao nigo bire ebia boronge.
english: Righteous are you, O LORD, and your laws are right.

ekegusii: Oboronge na ekeene nabio bire oboroso bw’okogamba kwao, obwanchani bwa kare na kare, na obwegenwa, nigo bitang’aine bosio bwao.
english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; love and faithfulness go before you.

ekegusii: Oboronge nigo bogokinia egesaku, korende ebibe nigo bire obosooku ase abanto bande bonsi.
english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

ekegusii: Oboronge mbotang’ane bosio bwaye, naende bobwatie ase aetete.
english: Righteousness goes before him and prepares the way for his steps.

ekegusii: Oboronge nigo bokorenda oyore norogendo ororonge, korende ebibe nigo bikomosiria omokori amabe.
english: Righteousness guards the man of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

ekegusii: Righteousness will be his belt and faithfulness the sash around his waist.
english: Oboronge nabwo borabe orokini rw’ekenema kiaye, na obwegenwa bobe orokini rw’okweboeria.

ekegusii: Imokerera igoro, ochiche otokonye! Ototoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.
english: Rise up and help us; redeem us because of your unfailing love.

ekegusii: Nyasae, imoka bwerwanerere aye omonyene; inyora buna abatakoirogeti bakogokorera echeche kera rituko.
english: Rise up, O God, and defend your cause; remember how fools mock you all day long.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, imoka, ogambie ense ekina, ekiagera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabao.
english: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.

ekegusii: Aye omonachi ebina bw’ense, imoka oe abanto abaenenu eng’eria koreng’ana buna ogokora kwabo kore!
english: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.

ekegusii: Omonene, imoka! Orwanie ababisa baane obabue! Ntoorie korwa ase abakori amabe ase okobarwania nomoro oo;
english: Rise up, O LORD, confront them, bring them down; rescue me from the wicked by your sword.

ekegusii: Imoka, ekiagera emeremo eye naye echigete, na intwe nigo tore amo naye; kabe omoremu oyekore.”
english: Rise up; this matter is in your hands. We will support you, so take courage and do it."

ekegusii: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!"
english: Imoka, togende; rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.”

ekegusii: Rise, let us go! Here comes my betrayer!"
english: Imoka, togende, rora, ere oyokondua oikire ang’e.”

ekegusii: Erio Risipa, mosubati o Aya, akaira chianga chie chigunia agachiaara ase egetare keria, akabeerao korwa omochakano bwe rigesa goika embura ekorwa igoro egachaka gotwera emebere y’abwo basungetwe, gose tatigete chinyoni chigwe ase emebere eyio mobaso, gose ching’iti chi’orosana chichicheo botuko.
english: Rizpah daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it out for herself on a rock. From the beginning of the harvest till the rain poured down from the heavens on the bodies, she did not let the birds of the air touch them by day or the wild animals by night.

ekegusii: Baasamirie emenwa yabo gocha asende, yabeire buna chindo chikoronya na koruma.
english: Roaring lions tearing their prey open their mouths wide against me.

ekegusii: Moiyeke chinyama chi’ekeng’wanso ekio, mochiriere aase aria Omonene, Nyasae oino, arachore. Rituko ria kabere mambia moirane gochia ase chiema chiaino.
english: Roast it and eat it at the place the LORD your God will choose. Then in the morning return to your tents.

ekegusii: mwabeire nemeri na mwaagachirwe asare, mwakong’igwe ase okwegena buna mworokereretigwe, momenteke ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
english: rooted and built up in him, strengthened in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

ekegusii: obosareku na emechando nigo bire ase chinchera chiabo.
english: ruin and misery mark their ways,

ekegusii: Abagambi nigo bagonchanda engencho ende etaiyo, korende enkoro yane nigo eirogete amang’ana ao.
english: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at your word.

ekegusii: Minyoka bwango omorotote na omoborie gose mbuya are, na omosacha oye na omwana gose mbuya bare.” Omokungu oria akairaneria Gehasi, “Ee, mbuya bare.”
english: Run to meet her and ask her, 'Are you all right? Is your husband all right? Is your child all right?'" "Everything is all right," she said.

ekegusii: Birori bi’oborimo nigo bakonyimokera, bakomboria ase amang’ana ntamanyeti.
english: Ruthless witnesses come forward; they question me on things I know nothing about.

ekegusii: Kera rituko orue eeri ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa. Ase okorua ekeng’wanso ase okobwatanigwa nigo orabe kogochena egesasimero. Erio ogeake amaguta na kogiatanana ase emeremo emechenu.
english: Sacrifice a bull each day as a sin offering to make atonement. Purify the altar by making atonement for it, and anoint it to consecrate it.

ekegusii: Ebing’wanso na ebiruegwa tobiganeti, korende amato aane kwayatinoire. Ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebi’ebibe tobiganeti.
english: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but my ears you have pierced; burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not require.

ekegusii: Morusie eng’ondi, gose embori, gose eng’ombe, korwa ase amaicho aino, mogende aase Omonene arachore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye, erio morue eng’iti eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’Epasaka ase Omonene Nyasae oino.
english: Sacrifice as the Passover to the LORD your God an animal from your flock or herd at the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for his Name.

ekegusii: morue na ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, mobiriereo na mogoke ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: Sacrifice fellowship offerings there, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Aye omoruere Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, naende ikerania ase Oyore Igoro Mono chiira kwamorierete.
english: Sacrifice thank offerings to God, fulfill your vows to the Most High,

ekegusii: Emanwa eria ende oyerue mogoroba; oyerue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa, buna gwakorete mambia, kobe ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kebe ne rimisu rigiya ase Omonene.
english: Sacrifice the other lamb at twilight with the same grain offering and its drink offering as in the morning-- a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Yebusi bakamotebia, “Aye tokonyara gocha aiga nonya ng’ake.” Korende nonya naboigo, Daudi akabua eburi ya Sayoni, oyio noro Omochie o Daudi.
english: said to David, "You will not get in here." Nevertheless, David captured the fortress of Zion, the City of David.

ekegusii: Ere agatebia ng’ina, “Ekero omonto aibete chisekeli chie chifeta amagana ikomi na rimo naigure ng’a, nkwaragereretie omoibi bwe chifeta chiria. Rora aiga, ninche nchibwate. Ninche nachiirete.” Ngi’na akamotebia, “Omwana one, Nyasae agosesenie.”
english: said to his mother, "The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from you and about which I heard you utter a curse-- I have that silver with me; I took it." Then his mother said, "The LORD bless you, my son!"

ekegusii: Salu, na Amoki, na Hilikia, na Yedaya. Abwo barenge abatang’ani b’abakuani na ab’abamwabo, ase amatuko a Yesua.
english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah and Jedaiah. These were the leaders of the priests and their associates in the days of Jeshua.

ekegusii: na Salima, ise abanto ba Bethlehemu, na Harefu, ise abanto ba Beti‐Gaderi.
english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

ekegusii: Salmon the father of Boaz, Boaz the father of Obed,
english: Salimoni akaibora Boazi, na Boazi akaibora Obedi;

ekegusii: na Salimoni akaibora Boazi ase Rahabu, na Boazi akaibora Obedi ase Rutu, na Obedi akaibora Yese,
english: Salmon the father of Boaz, whose mother was Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed, whose mother was Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,

ekegusii: ng’a natotoorigwe korwa ase ababisa baito, na korwa ase amaboko abo bonsi abatogechete,
english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us--

ekegusii: Ogotooreka nigo kore aare korwa ase abakori amabe, ekiagera barabwo tibari korigia emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.

ekegusii: Gose gotooreka tikori ase onde bwensi, ekiagera erieta rinde tiriri inse ase erioba intwe mwanyabanto twaetwe eriranyare gototooria.”
english: Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved."

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Samaria nasirigwe arueo buna riuro rigosira korwa ase amache igoro.
english: Samaria and its king will float away like a twig on the surface of the waters.

ekegusii: “Samaria tiyakorete ebibe, nonya nekeng’ese kereng’aine ebiao; aye gwakorire ebibe ebinge bi’okogechia kobua emechie eyio. Ase engencho eyio kwagerire basubati bamino barorekanire bare abanyaboronge, ekero ebibe biao bikoreng’anigwa nebiabo.
english: Samaria did not commit half the sins you did. You have done more detestable things than they, and have made your sisters seem righteous by all these things you have done.

ekegusii: Samson answered her, "If anyone ties me with seven fresh thongs that have not been dried, I'll become as weak as any other man."
english: Samison akamoiraneria, “Kabaransibe ne chingori chi’emenyiki isano na ibere chinyia chitaroma, erio nainche nimbe omworo, na imbe buna monto onde bwensi.”

ekegusii: Samison akaba omogambi bw’Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere, ekero Abafilisti baare kogambera ense eria.
english: Samson led Israel for twenty years in the days of the Philistines.

ekegusii: Samison agatebia omosae oria omobwatete okoboko kwaye, “Ntige ntaba‐tabe, nkune chisiiro chisiirete enyomba, inyesiirere ase chirochio.”
english: Samson said to the servant who held his hand, "Put me where I can feel the pillars that support the temple, so that I may lean against them."

ekegusii: Samison agatebia Abafilisti, “Onye mogokora amang’ana anga buna aya, natianire ng’a tingotimoka goika inyeruserie egesiomba igoro yaino.”
english: Samson said to them, "Since you've acted like this, I won't stop until I get my revenge on you."

ekegusii: Korende Samison agateba, “Engaki eye tinkoba nokomocha igoro y’Abafilisti, ekero ndabakorere amabe.”
english: Samson said to them, "This time I have a right to get even with the Philistines; I will really harm them."

ekegusii: Erio agateba, “Tiga nkwe amo n’Abafilisti aba.” Naende agekumba ne chinguru chiaye chionsi, na enyomba eria ekagwera abatang’ani b’Abafilisti amo nabanto bande bonsi abarengeo. Abanto baria Samison aitete ekero akwete omonyene nigo barenge abange kobua baria bonsi abaitete ekero arenge moyo.
english: Samson said, "Let me die with the Philistines!" Then he pushed with all his might, and down came the temple on the rulers and all the people in it. Thus he killed many more when he died than while he lived.

ekegusii: Samson went down to Timnah and saw there a young Philistine woman.
english: Samison agatirimboka gochia Timuna, na aroro agwo akarora omoiseke oyomo bw’Abafilisti.

ekegusii: Erio Samison agatirimboka amo na ise na ng’ina gochia Timuna. Ekero baigete ase emegondo y’emesabibu agwo Timuna, endo ensae ekamochera ekoruma.
english: Samson went down to Timnah together with his father and mother. As they approached the vineyards of Timnah, suddenly a young lion came roaring toward him.

ekegusii: Samweli akaba omogambi ebina bw’Abaisraeli ase amatuko onsi arenge moyo.
english: Samuel continued as judge over Israel all the days of his life.

ekegusii: Samweli agakora ayio Omonene amochigete, akagenda Bethlehemu. Abagaaka b’omochie oria bagacha komorotota bakoiguswa bakamoboria, “Inee! Ngwachire namang’ana ’omorembe?”
english: Samuel did what the LORD said. When he arrived at Bethlehem, the elders of the town trembled when they met him. They asked, "Do you come in peace?"

ekegusii: Erio Samweli agatebia abanto buna oboruoti bogwenerete kogambwa, na akarika emeroberio eyio ase ebuku akayebeka ase obosio bw’Omonene. Nyuma y’ayio Samweli akaa abanto ribaga, kera oyomo agende inka bwoye.
english: Samuel explained to the people the regulations of the kingship. He wrote them down on a scroll and deposited it before the LORD. Then Samuel dismissed the people, each to his own home.

ekegusii: Samweli akarara goika mambia; erio akaboka, akaigora ebisieri bi’enyomba y’Omonene. Ere akoboa gotebia Eli okorora koria aroche.
english: Samuel lay down until morning and then opened the doors of the house of the LORD. He was afraid to tell Eli the vision,

ekegusii: Samweli akabairaneria, “Ee, nachire nomorembe. Nigo nachire imoruere Omonene ekeng’wanso. Echene inwe abanyene, moche amo nainche ase ekeng’wanso ekio.” Erio agachena Yese amo nabamura baye na akabarangeria bache ase ekeng’wanso ekio.
english: Samuel replied, "Yes, in peace; I have come to sacrifice to the LORD. Consecrate yourselves and come to the sacrifice with me." Then he consecrated Jesse and his sons and invited them to the sacrifice.

ekegusii: Samweli agatebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Rora, nabeire nkoigwa amang’ana aino; nakorire aya mwamboria, nabekire omoruoti orabagambere.
english: Samuel said to all Israel, "I have listened to everything you said to me and have set a king over you.

ekegusii: Samweli agatebia abanto bonsi, “Aiga moroche ere oyio Omonene achorire. Monto onde tari aa ase egati y’abanto aba bonsi omoreng’aine.” Erio abanto bonsi bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Omoruoti oyo achie kare!”
english: Samuel said to all the people, "Do you see the man the LORD has chosen? There is no one like him among all the people." Then the people shouted, "Long live the king!"

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akamotebia, “Rituko ria rero Omonene otandoire oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli, naborobwo bwarure asore, oboeire omonto omoao ore omuya gokobua.
english: Samuel said to him, "The LORD has torn the kingdom of Israel from you today and has given it to one of your neighbors-- to one better than you.

ekegusii: Samweli agatebia Saulo, “Ninche oria Omonene atomete kogoaka amaguta okaba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Ase ayio, tegerera bono oigwe amang’ana ’Omonene.
english: Samuel said to Saul, "I am the one the LORD sent to anoint you king over his people Israel; so listen now to the message from the LORD.

ekegusii: Samweli akaboria Saulo, “Nase ki gwanchandire okondeta korwa ase omotimoko one.” Saulo akairaneria, “Inche nigo nchandegete mono; Abafilisti nkondwania bare esegi, na Nyasae onyangire, tari kong’iraneria, goetera ase ababani, gose ase chindoto. Ase ayio nigo nakorangeirie, erinde ontebie eki ndakore.”
english: Samuel said to Saul, "Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?" "I am in great distress," Saul said. "The Philistines are fighting against me, and God has turned away from me. He no longer answers me, either by prophets or by dreams. So I have called on you to tell me what to do."

ekegusii: Samweli agatebia omorugi bwe chindagera, “Renta egetari keria nakoa, nkagotebia ng’a okegache ensemo ao.”
english: Samuel said to the cook, "Bring the piece of meat I gave you, the one I told you to lay aside."

ekegusii: Samweli akabatebia, “Rituko ria rero Omonene nigo are kirori asemore, boigo omoakwa amaguta oye nigo are kirori ng’a inwe timonyoreti gento kende gionsi ase okoboko kwane.” Barabwo bakairaneria, “Ee, Omonene nere kirori.”
english: Samuel said to them, "The LORD is witness against you, and also his anointed is witness this day, that you have not found anything in my hand." "He is witness," they said.

ekegusii: Samweli akamotebia, “Nonya kwaroche aye omonyene ng’a toisaini gento, Inee, aye tori omotang’ani ase ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli? Omonene igo akoagete amaguta obe omoruoti ase Abaisraeli.
english: Samuel said, "Although you were once small in your own eyes, did you not become the head of the tribes of Israel? The LORD anointed you king over Israel.

ekegusii: Samweli akairaneria, “Nase ki okomboria inche, onye Omonene okwangire na obeire omobisa oo?
english: Samuel said, "Why do you consult me, now that the LORD has turned away from you and become your enemy?

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akarangeria Abaisraeli basangererekane amo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Misipa,
english: Samuel summoned the people of Israel to the LORD at Mizpah

ekegusii: Ase igo Samweli agatebia abanto baria baganetie omoruoti amang’ana onsi Omonene amotebetie.
english: Samuel told all the words of the LORD to the people who were asking him for a king.

ekegusii: Erio Sanibalati na Gesemu bagatoma abanto gocha kondangeria, bagoteba, “Inchuo toumerane aiga ase oyomo bw’emechie ere ase ense omweya ya Ono.” Korende nigo barengereretie gochia gonkorera amabe.
english: Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: "Come, let us meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono." But they were scheming to harm me;

ekegusii: Obachene ase ekeene; ring’ana riao nario ekeene.
english: Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo nao are amagena e rigori rinene akorokwa safiro, amo namagena e chitahabu.
english: sapphires come from its rocks, and its dust contains nuggets of gold.

ekegusii: Sara akaba morito, akaiborera Ibrahimu omwana omoisia ase obogotu bwaye, ase engaki eria Nyasae amotebetie.
english: Sarah became pregnant and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised him.

ekegusii: Sara nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere (127); eye nero emiaka y’obogima bwa Sara.
english: Sarah lived to be a hundred and twenty-seven years old.

ekegusii: Sara akabora, “Nyasae onkoreire amaseko, na onde bwensi orayaigwe nansegisie.”
english: Sarah said, "God has brought me laughter, and everyone who hears about this will laugh with me."

ekegusii: Sara agakana, agateba, “Inche tinsegeti,” naki nigo oboete. Omonene akamotebia, “Taibo; korende aye ngwaseka.”
english: Sarah was afraid, so she lied and said, "I did not laugh." But he said, "Yes, you did laugh."

ekegusii: Saitani akagania gochanda Abaisraeli, agasukia enkoro ya Daudi ase okobara Abaisraeli.
english: Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to take a census of Israel.

ekegusii: Kobogokia mambia, otoisanekie nobwanchani bwao botari koera, erinde tochenge na kogoka amatuko aito onsi.
english: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

ekegusii: Saulo nere akagenda nka bwoye aria Gibea. Abanto bande abanene, abwo Nyasae konya akwanire ne chinkoro chiabo, bakamotunyana.
english: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah, accompanied by valiant men whose hearts God had touched.

ekegusii: Saulo na abanto baye bakagenda korigia Daudi, korende Daudi agatebigwa amang’ana ayio. Ase ayio akagenda ase egetare kiarenge ase erooro ya Maoni, akabeerao. Ekero Saulo aigwete ng’a Daudi ogendire agwo akamobwatia gochiao.
english: Saul and his men began the search, and when David was told about it, he went down to the rock and stayed in the Desert of Maon. When Saul heard this, he went into the Desert of Maon in pursuit of David.

ekegusii: Saulo, na Yonathani momura oye, amo nabanto barenge amo nabarabwo bakabeera agwo Geba o Benjamin, korende Abafilisti bagatoora agwo Mikimasi.
english: Saul and his son Jonathan and the men with them were staying in Gibeah in Benjamin, while the Philistines camped at Micmash.

ekegusii: Saulo amo n’Abaisraeli bagasangererekana, bagatoora ase ense omweremo ekorokwa Ela; nabarabwo bakarobera korwana n’Abafilisti.
english: Saul and the Israelites assembled and camped in the Valley of Elah and drew up their battle line to meet the Philistines.

ekegusii: Saulo akairaneria akabora, “Inche nomonto bw’egesaku kia Benjamin egesaku egeke mono ase Abaisraeli, na eamate yane nero nenke mono ase chiamate chionsi chi’egesaku ekio. Nase ki rende gwakwanire asende ring’ana ringa buna erio?”
english: Saul answered, "But am I not a Benjamite, from the smallest tribe of Israel, and is not my clan the least of all the clans of the tribe of Benjamin? Why do you say such a thing to me?"

ekegusii: Saulo akamoiraneria, “Abanto mbarenta ching’ondi ne chiombe korwa ase Abaameleki; nigo batiga echio chingiya mono chire moyo, erinde bachirue chibe ekeng’wanso ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, korende echinde chionsi nigo twachisiria kegima.”
english: Saul answered, "The soldiers brought them from the Amalekites; they spared the best of the sheep and cattle to sacrifice to the LORD your God, but we totally destroyed the rest."

ekegusii: Erio Saulo akamochiera Samweli agwo ase egeita, akamotebia, “Koranche ontebie ase omorori amenyete.”
english: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, "Would you please tell me where the seer's house is?"

ekegusii: Ase ayio Saulo akoboa Daudi mono kobua, naende akaba omobisa oye kogenderera ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
english: Saul became still more afraid of him, and he remained his enemy the rest of his days.

ekegusii: agachora abanto chilifu isato. Ase abwo abanto chilifu ibere bakaba amo nere agwo Mikimasi na ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Beteli, na abanto elifu eyemo bakaba amo na Yonathani aaria Gibea, ase orogongo rwa Benjamin. Abatigarete akabaa ribaga bakagenda kera omonto nka bwoye.
english: Saul chose three thousand men from Israel; two thousand were with him at Micmash and in the hill country of Bethel, and a thousand were with Jonathan at Gibeah in Benjamin. The rest of the men he sent back to their homes.

ekegusii: Naboigo Saulo akwete, ekiagera atarenge omwegenwa. Tarenge omwegenwa ase Omonene na tarendete amang’ana Omonene amochigete; naende akagenda korigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakure, ase okoraagwa nero,
english: Saul died because he was unfaithful to the LORD; he did not keep the word of the LORD and even consulted a medium for guidance,

ekegusii: Saulo akaimoka korwa inse, korende ekero achia koramokia amaiso aye tarora gento. Bakamobwata okoboko, bakamoira Damesiki.
english: Saul got up from the ground, but when he opened his eyes he could see nothing. So they led him by the hand into Damascus.

ekegusii: Saulo akaigwera amang’ana a Yonathani, agatiana agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, Daudi tagoitwa.”
english: Saul listened to Jonathan and took this oath: "As surely as the LORD lives, David will not be put to death."

ekegusii: Saulo agatoora ase ekegoro kia Hakila kororia Yesimoni ang’e nenchera, korende Daudi akagenderera kobeera agwo ase erooro, na ekero aigwete ng’a Saulo omobwatirie gocha ase erooro,
english: Saul made his camp beside the road on the hill of Hakilah facing Jeshimon, but David stayed in the desert. When he saw that Saul had followed him there,

ekegusii: Erio Saulo akamanya eriogi ria Daudi, akamoboria, “Naye Daudi, omwana one, eriogi eri neriao?” Daudi akamoiraneria, “Ee omoruoti, omonene one, neriane.”
english: Saul recognized David's voice and said, "Is that your voice, David my son?" David replied, "Yes it is, my lord the king."

ekegusii: Saulo akamoiraneria, “Nigo atotebetie boronge ng’a chitigere chianyorekanire.” Korende amang’ana aya Samweli akwanete igoro y’oboruoti tamoyatebetie.
english: Saul replied, "He assured us that the donkeys had been found." But he did not tell his uncle what Samuel had said about the kingship.

ekegusii: Saulo agateba, “Inche nakorire ebibe, korende bono insike ase amaiso ’abagaaka b’abanto baane, na ase Abaisraeli; irana amo nainche, erio ngende gosasima Omonene, Nyasae oo.”
english: Saul replied, "I have sinned. But please honor me before the elders of my people and before Israel; come back with me, so that I may worship the LORD your God."
