ekegusii: na Saulo akabachika batebie Daudi ng’a, “Omoruoti taganeti omoe enibo ende yonsi ase okomonyuomera omoiseke oye, otatiga aganetie omorentere amasankwa a isiko ay’ebiimo bi’obosacha bi’Abafilisti rigana erimo bakwete, na igo omoruserie egesiomba ase ababisa baye.” Ase enchera eyio Saulo nigo arengereretie ng’a Daudi agwe ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.
english: Saul replied, "Say to David, 'The king wants no other price for the bride than a hundred Philistine foreskins, to take revenge on his enemies.'" Saul's plan was to have David fall by the hands of the Philistines.

ekegusii: Saulo akabairaneria, “Tiga Omonene abasesenie, ekiagera mwandoreire amabera.
english: Saul replied, "The LORD bless you for your concern for me.

ekegusii: Saulo agakania Daudi, akamotebia, “Tokonyara korwania Omofilisti oyio. Aye nomoke; ere nigo enaretie korwana esegi korwa obosae bwaye.”
english: Saul replied, "You are not able to go out against this Philistine and fight him; you are only a boy, and he has been a fighting man from his youth."

ekegusii: Saulo takwanete gento kende ase rituko riria, ekiagera nigo arengereretie ng’a ring’ana gete riamonyorire Daudi; ande tagachenegeti.
english: Saul said nothing that day, for he thought, "Something must have happened to David to make him ceremonially unclean-- surely he is unclean."

ekegusii: Saulo agatebia Abiya, “Renta Esanduku ya Nyasae aiga.” (Ase engaki eria Esanduku eria nigo yarenge ase Abaisraeli.)
english: Saul said to Ahijah, "Bring the ark of God." (At that time it was with the Israelites.)

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia Daudi, “Rora, ninkoe Merabu, omoiseke one omotangi, abe mokao, onye kogonkorera buna omonto omoremu, erinde orwane esegi y’Omonene.” Saulo igo arengereretie ng’a Daudi nigo agochia goitwa n’Abafilisti, ng’a ere omonyene tabaisa komoita.
english: Saul said to David, "Here is my older daughter Merab. I will give her to you in marriage; only serve me bravely and fight the battles of the LORD." For Saul said to himself, "I will not raise a hand against him. Let the Philistines do that!"

ekegusii: Saulo akamoboria, “Nase ki aye na mosinto o Yese mwabeire mamincha yane? Aye nkwamoa endagera, na omoyio o birende naende okaboria Nyasae ase engencho yaye? Ere obeire mamincha yane na okomboera buna ere rero iga.”
english: Saul said to him, "Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, giving him bread and a sword and inquiring of God for him, so that he has rebelled against me and lies in wait for me, as he does today?"

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia omonto oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero, “Simora omoyio oo, ombete nkwe, erinde abanto aba batarogeti tibabaisa kong’ita na gonchecheria.” Korende omonto oria akaanga, ekiagera nigo abete nobwoba obonene. Ase ayio Saulo akabwata omoyio oye omonyene akegweria igoro yaye.
english: Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and abuse me." But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia omonto oria omobogoreretie ebirwanero, “Somora omoyio, ombete nkwe, erinde abanto aba batarogeti tibabaisa kong’ita na gonchecheria.” Korende omonto oria akaanga, ekiagera abete nobwoba obonene. Erio Saulo agasomora omoyio oye omonyene, akegweria ase omoyio oyio bweka omonyene.
english: Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and run me through, or these uncircumcised fellows will come and run me through and abuse me." But his armor-bearer was terrified and would not do it; so Saul took his own sword and fell on it.

ekegusii: Saulo akaboria omosomba oye, “Onye tokogenda ase omonto oyio, inki tobwate tokomoirera? Endagera twabwate ase ebibekerero biaito yaerire, na keegwa kende titobwati tokoirera omonto oyio o Nyasae. Ninki tobwate?”
english: Saul said to his servant, "If we go, what can we give the man? The food in our sacks is gone. We have no gift to take to the man of God. What do we have?"

ekegusii: Erio Saulo akaboria Mikali, “Nase ki kwang’aina ase enchera buna eye, na ogatiga omobisa one agatama agetooria?” Mikali akamoiraneria, “Ere nigo antebetie: Ntiga ngende, timbaisa kogoita.”
english: Saul said to Michal, "Why did you deceive me like this and send my enemy away so that he escaped?" Michal told him, "He said to me, 'Let me get away. Why should I kill you?'"

ekegusii: Saulo agakwana nabasomba baye, akabora, “Igwa inwe Ababenjamin! Inee! Mosinto o Yese nae kera oyomo oino emegondo y’endagera amo ney’emesabibu? Nakore inwe mwensi mobe abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu na ab’amagana?
english: Saul said to them, "Listen, men of Benjamin! Will the son of Jesse give all of you fields and vineyards? Will he make all of you commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds?

ekegusii: Saulo agateba, “Aka obomera ase egati yane na Yonathani, omwana one.” Obomera bokagwera Yonathani.
english: Saul said, "Cast the lot between me and Jonathan my son." And Jonathan was taken.

ekegusii: Saulo agatebia abanto, “Inchuo, tochiere Abafilisti ase obotuko obo, tobasakore goika mambia kobogokiamoka; titotiga monto onde nonya noyomo abe moyo.” Bakamoiraneria, “Kora aya orarore are buya.” Korende omokuani akabatebia, “Ritang’ani, toike Nyasae ang’e aiga, tomoborie.”
english: Saul said, "Let us go down after the Philistines by night and plunder them till dawn, and let us not leave one of them alive." "Do whatever seems best to you," they replied. But the priest said, "Let us inquire of God here."

ekegusii: Saulo akabora, “Aye mosinto bw’Ahitubu, tegerera, oigwe.” Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa, Omonene one.”
english: Saul said, "Listen now, son of Ahitub." "Yes, my lord," he answered.

ekegusii: Saul said, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if you do not die, Jonathan."
english: Saulo agateba, “Nyasae ang’e egesusuro ekenene. Ekeene, aye Yonathani goika okwe.”

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo Saulo agatoma abanto ase enyomba ya Daudi komoboera, erinde bamoite mambia kagosoka. Korende Mikali, moga Daudi, akamokurera, akamotebia, “Otetooreti ase obotuko obo, mambia goika oche oitwe.”
english: Saul sent men to David's house to watch it and to kill him in the morning. But Michal, David's wife, warned him, "If you don't run for your life tonight, tomorrow you'll be killed."

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatiana ase engencho y’omokungu oria, agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, aye tokonyora egesusuro ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio.”
english: Saul swore to her by the LORD, "As surely as the LORD lives, you will not be punished for this."

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia Abaisraeli bonsi, “Inwe beera ensemo eyemo, na inche amo na Yonathani, omwana one, tobeere ensemo ende.” Abanto bakamoiraneria, “Kora aya orarore are buya.”
english: Saul then said to all the Israelites, "You stand over there; I and Jonathan my son will stand over here." "Do what seems best to you," the men replied.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia abasomba baye, “Indigererie omokungu okoboria amang’ana korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakure, nimochiere, ndigie ogosemigwa korwa asare.” Abasomba baye bakamoiraneria, “Naama! Agwo Eni‐Dori omokungu buna oyio nareo.”
english: Saul then said to his attendants, "Find me a woman who is a medium, so I may go and inquire of her." "There is one in Endor," they said.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Saulo agatebia abatang’ani bonsi b’abanto, “Suka gocha ang’e aa, morore na komanya ng’a mbibe ki biakorirwe aiga rero.
english: Saul therefore said, "Come here, all you who are leaders of the army, and let us find out what sin has been committed today.

ekegusii: Saulo agakwana na Yonathani, omomura oye, na abasomba baye bonsi ng’a naganetie goita Daudi, korende Yonathani nigo anchete Daudi mono.
english: Saul told his son Jonathan and all the attendants to kill David. But Jonathan was very fond of David

ekegusii: Saulo agateema kobeta Daudi ritimo amobwateranie enyasi, korende Daudi akebacha, ne ritimo riria rikabeta enyasi. Daudi agatama, agatooreka ase obotuko obwo.
english: Saul tried to pin him to the wall with his spear, but David eluded him as Saul drove the spear into the wall. That night David made good his escape.

ekegusii: Saul was [thirty] years old when he became king, and he reigned over Israel [forty-]two years.
english: Saulo konya ogambire omwaka oyomo, na omwaka o kabere ekero agendererete kogambera Abaisraeli,

ekegusii: Saulo akairoka Daudi mono, ekiagera Omonene nigo arenge amo na Daudi, korende konya otigire Saulo.
english: Saul was afraid of David, because the LORD was with David but had left Saul.

ekegusii: Saulo akagenda ensemo eyemo y’egetunwa, na Daudi na abanto baye bakagenda ensemo ende. Daudi nigo abete okoayerera gotama Saulo, na Saulo na abanto baye konya bachakire konaaria Daudi na abanto baye, ase okobabwata.
english: Saul was going along one side of the mountain, and David and his men were on the other side, hurrying to get away from Saul. As Saul and his forces were closing in on David and his men to capture them,

ekegusii: Saulo nigo arenge otoorete ase orobebe rwa Gibea inse y’omote okorokwa omokomomanga agwo Migironi, na abanto abarenge amo nere nigo barenge koreng’ana amagana atano na rimo (600).
english: Saul was staying on the outskirts of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree in Migron. With him were about six hundred men,

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo aigwete aya abanyorire, agatoma abanto bande, nabarabwo boigo bagachaka kobaboka ase okobana. Na ekero Saulo atomete abanto eria gatato nabwo bagachaka kobana.
english: Saul was told about it, and he sent more men, and they prophesied too. Saul sent men a third time, and they also prophesied.

ekegusii: Saulo agatebigwa ng’a Daudi osoire Keila. Erio agateba, “Nyasae obekire Daudi ase okoboko kwane, igo bwebwatire ere bweka, ekiagera osoire ase omochie obwate ebiita na ebisiekero.”
english: Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, and he said, "God has handed him over to me, for David has imprisoned himself by entering a town with gates and bars."

ekegusii: Ayio akagechia Saulo, goika akaba nendamwamu enene, agateba, “Abakungu aba batebire ng’a Daudi oitire chilifu emerongo na emerongo, korende asende, batebire ng’a ne chilifu rioka. Ninki rende giatigaire batamoeti goika bono otatiga oboruoti?”
english: Saul was very angry; this refrain galled him. "They have credited David with tens of thousands," he thought, "but me with only thousands. What more can he get but the kingdom?"

ekegusii: Saulo akagenda ase omochie bw’Abaameleki, akababoera agwo ase rigoko.
english: Saul went to the city of Amalek and set an ambush in the ravine.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo akaba nendamwamu enene ase Yonathani, akamotebia, “Aye omwana bw’omokungu omosaria, nimanyete ng’a kwabwatanire na mosinto o Yese, ase okwerentera obosooku, na obosooku bw’obogetirianda bwa nyoko.
english: Saul's anger flared up at Jonathan and he said to him, "You son of a perverse and rebellious woman! Don't I know that you have sided with the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of the mother who bore you?

ekegusii: Abasomba baye bakamotebia, “Rigereria bono, Omoika omobe okorwa ase Nyasae nkogochanda ore.
english: Saul's attendants said to him, "See, an evil spirit from God is tormenting you.

ekegusii: Kisi, ise Saulo, na Neri, ise Abineri, nigo barenge basinto b’Abieli.
english: Saul's father Kish and Abner's father Ner were sons of Abiel.

ekegusii: Abarendi ba Saulo abarendete agwo Gibea ase orogongo rwa Benjamin bakarora Abafilisti baburukanire na goserebekana, bakominyoka gochia aaria na aaria.
english: Saul's lookouts at Gibeah in Benjamin saw the army melting away in all directions.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Saulo nabwo aba: Yonathani, na Isivi, na Malikisua; na amarieta ’abaiseke baye babere naro aya: omoiseke omotangi Merabu, na oria omoke Mikali.
english: Saul's sons were Jonathan, Ishvi and Malki-Shua. The name of his older daughter was Merab, and that of the younger was Michal.

ekegusii: Ise moke akamotebia, “Koranche ontebie aya Samweli abatebetie.”
english: Saul's uncle said, "Tell me what Samuel said to you."

ekegusii: Ntoorie korwa ase ogosaria kwane, tontiga nsekererwe noyio ore omoriri.
english: Save me from all my transgressions; do not make me the scorn of fools.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, Nyasae bw’ogotooreka kwane, ontoorie, ting’itera amanyinga ’abanto, na oromeme rwane rotere mono oboronge bwao.
english: Save me from bloodguilt, O God, the God who saves me, and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.

ekegusii: Inche noyoo, ntoorie! Nigo nabeire nkona‐koinyora amachiko ao.
english: Save me, for I am yours; I have sought out your precepts.

ekegusii: Koranche ontoorie bono korwa ase okoboko kw’oyominto Esau, ekiagera nairokire ng’a nabaise kong’ita, aite na abakungu na abana.
english: Save me, I pray, from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid he will come and attack me, and also the mothers with their children.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ntoorie korwa ase abanto bagokwana oborimo, bare ne chimeme chi’obong’ainereria.
english: Save me, O LORD, from lying lips and from deceitful tongues.

ekegusii: Igo nonyare gotooria abanto abwo gwanchete; otoe obobui goetera ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio, oigwe ogosaba gwaito.
english: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

ekegusii: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.
english: Intoorie nokoboko kwao gw’okorio na oigwe aya nkogosaba.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, totoorie; tosangererie amo, otorusie korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku, erio tonyare gotogia erieta riao richenu, na gochengera obonene bwao.
english: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tooria abanto bao abare omwando oo, obe omorisia obo, obabogorie goika kare na kare.
english: Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.

ekegusii: Bakarora abande b’aborokigwa baye bakoragera namaboko are neriko, engencho yaye ataisabiri.
english: saw some of his disciples eating food with hands that were "unclean," that is, unwashed.

ekegusii: Tebia abanto bonsi b’ebisaku, “Omonene nere okogamba. Ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa. Omonene nanachere abanto ekina atari gwanchereria.”
english: Say among the nations, "The LORD reigns." The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity.

ekegusii: Motebie Nyasae: Naki ogokora kwao kore ogw’okwoboyia! Obobui bwao nigo bore obonene mono, goika ababisa bao bekeyie asore.
english: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies cringe before you.

ekegusii: omotebie: Erende, kabe nobotoereru toiroka. Tokwa omoyo ase engencho y’endamwamu enene ya Resini oyio ore amo n’Abasiiria, na eya mosinto o Remalia, abwo bare buna ebigenga bibere bikoimokia erioki.
english: Say to him, 'Be careful, keep calm and don't be afraid. Do not lose heart because of these two smoldering stubs of firewood-- because of the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram and of the son of Remaliah.

ekegusii: Omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene atebire: Aye nigo gwaita Naboti, naende kwairire omogondo oria obeire oyoo. Naende omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene atebire: Aase agwo chisese chiamenerete amanyinga a Naboti, nao chiramenere nayao.”
english: Say to him, 'This is what the LORD says: Have you not murdered a man and seized his property?' Then say to him, 'This is what the LORD says: In the place where dogs licked up Naboth's blood, dogs will lick up your blood-- yes, yours!'"

ekegusii: momotebie amang’ana aya aane: Omorembe obe asore, na ase enyomba yao, na ase binde bionsi obwate.
english: Say to him: 'Long life to you! Good health to you and your household! And good health to all that is yours!

ekegusii: “Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora, ninkore Aase aane Aachenu abe aatachenegeti, aase ayio are obonene bwe chinguru chiaino, na omogoko bw’amaiso aino, na okogania kw’emioyo yaino. Abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, abwo mwatigete nyuma, mbaitwe nemioro.
english: Say to the house of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to desecrate my sanctuary-- the stronghold in which you take pride, the delight of your eyes, the object of your affection. The sons and daughters you left behind will fall by the sword.

ekegusii: Kwana n’Abaisraeli, obatebie ng’a amaguta aya akweakwa abe amachenu asende egati yaino ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: Say to the Israelites, 'This is to be my sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.

ekegusii: Say to the Israelites: 'If anyone curses his God, he will be held responsible;
english: Erio otebie Abaisraeli: Monto onde bwensi oraragererie Nyasae oye nabogorie ebibe biaye na anyore egesusuro.

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Tebia omoruoti na ng’ina bekeyie babe abaitongo ekiagera chigutwa chiabo chingiya chiarusigwe ase emetwe yabo.”
english: Say to the king and to the queen mother, "Come down from your thrones, for your glorious crowns will fall from your heads."

ekegusii: na aande onsi arasoe motebie omonyene enyomba: Omworokia otebire: Ng’ai ere enyomba y’abageni ndiere Epasaka amo naborokigwa baane?
english: Say to the owner of the house he enters, 'The Teacher asks: Where is my guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?'

ekegusii: Otebie abanto bamenyete ase ense eye ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba igoro y’abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu ase ense y’Abaisraeli: Barabwo mbarie endagera yabo bare nomoichano na mbanywe amache abo bare nobwoba, ekiagera ense yabo nesakorwe na ebinto bionsi bireo, etigwe ere bosa ase engencho y’obobe obwo abanto bareo bakorire.
english: Say to the people of the land: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says about those living in Jerusalem and in the land of Israel: They will eat their food in anxiety and drink their water in despair, for their land will be stripped of everything in it because of the violence of all who live there.

ekegusii: “Otebie abanto b’egesaku ki’Abaisraeli, abwo bare abasaria, ng’a aya naro inche Omonene Nyasae ngoteba: Inwe Abaisraeli, tiga ogokora kwaino gw’okogechia goisanere agwo.
english: Say to the rebellious house of Israel, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Enough of your detestable practices, O house of Israel!

ekegusii: Otebie rinani ria Negebu iga: Igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene. Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora, nintongie omorero ime yao, noro nosambe osirie emete emebese, na emiomo yonsi. Omorero oyio ekebemberi tokorimigwa, na amasio ’abanto bonsi korwa irianyi goika sugusu nasambwe noro.
english: Say to the southern forest: 'Hear the word of the LORD. This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to set fire to you, and it will consume all your trees, both green and dry. The blazing flame will not be quenched, and every face from south to north will be scorched by it.

ekegusii: “Aye Misiri, ning’o obuete ase obosiani? Tirimboka ogende inse orare amo nabatarogeti?
english: Say to them, 'Are you more favored than others? Go down and be laid among the uncircumcised.'

ekegusii: Batebie ng’a inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, tindi kogokera ogokwa kw’omokori amabe, korende nigo nganetie omokori amabe aonchoke, atige enchera yaye embe abe moyo. Ase ayio onchoka, onchoka, motige chinchera chiaino chimbe! Inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki moganetie mokwe?
english: Say to them, 'As surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that they turn from their ways and live. Turn! Turn from your evil ways! Why will you die, O house of Israel?'

ekegusii: obatebie iga: Inwe abaruoti b’Abayuda na inwe Abayuda mwensi, na inwe mwensi aba Yerusalemu, aba mogosoera ebiita ebi, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: Say to them, 'Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah and all people of Judah and everyone living in Jerusalem who come through these gates.

ekegusii: Obatebie baigwe ring’ana ri’Omonene Nyasae, otebe: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe nigo mwagogete, mogateba: Ahaa! Ahaa! Ekero Aase aane Aachenu akoretwe akaba aatachenegeti, na ekero ense y’Abaisraeli yatigarete bosa, na ekero Abayuda bairetwe ase obosomba.
english: Say to them, 'Hear the word of the Sovereign LORD. This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you said "Aha!" over my sanctuary when it was desecrated and over the land of Israel when it was laid waste and over the people of Judah when they went into exile,

ekegusii: Obatebie ng’a aye nigo ore ekemanyererio asebare, na buna aye gwakorire nabarabwo nabo barakore, mbang’anyigwe bairwe ase obosomba.
english: Say to them, 'I am a sign to you.' "As I have done, so it will be done to them. They will go into exile as captives.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo antebetie ng’a ntebie abanto iga: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Onye mwangire konyigwera, na timobwateti amachiko aane nabaete,
english: Say to them, 'This is what the LORD says: If you do not listen to me and follow my law, which I have set before you,

ekegusii: Obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekeongo ekenene kiabwate chimbaba chinene, na amarionya e chimbaba chiaye namatambe, na omobere oye nigo otubire namarionya arenge nebieni ao ao, kegacha Lebanoni, gekabutora enkoro y’omocharake.
english: Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: A great eagle with powerful wings, long feathers and full plumage of varied colors came to Lebanon. Taking hold of the top of a cedar,

ekegusii: Ase ayio batebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ninsirie enkwana eyio, tibayekwana naende ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Korende batebie: Amatuko ayio abeire ang’e, na amaroro onsi ay’obobani goika aikeranigwe.
english: Say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to put an end to this proverb, and they will no longer quote it in Israel.' Say to them, 'The days are near when every vision will be fulfilled.

ekegusii: Obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora, ninyimokie enyimbo y’enyomba ya Yusufu (eyio ere ase okoboko gwa Efraimu) amo nebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, ebio biabwatanire nero; erio inyebwateranie amo nenyimbo y’Abayuda, erinde chibe enyimbo eyemo ere ase okoboko kwane.
english: say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to take the stick of Joseph-- which is in Ephraim's hand-- and of the Israelite tribes associated with him, and join it to Judah's stick, making them a single stick of wood, and they will become one in my hand.'

ekegusii: “Obatebie: Eke nakio ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero moramoruere Omonene: Kera rituko botambe morue chimanwa chimingichi ibere, echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo.
english: Say to them: 'This is the offering made by fire that you are to present to the LORD: two lambs a year old without defect, as a regular burnt offering each day.

ekegusii: Tebia abanto abwo babwate chinkoro chinyoba: “Mobe abaremu, timwoboa! Naama! Nyasae oino nache korusia egesiomba. Rora, Nyasae nache kobaruseria egesiomba. Ere nache kobatooria.”
english: say to those with fearful hearts, "Be strong, do not fear; your God will come, he will come with vengeance; with divine retribution he will come to save you."

ekegusii: Otebie Turo oyio ore ase egesoero ki’enyancha, naende ogokora oboonchoreria nabanto abange bamenyete ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba:” “Aye Turo, nigo ogokwana ng’a nigo ore omoseera omoikeranu.
english: Say to Tyre, situated at the gateway to the sea, merchant of peoples on many coasts, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'You say, O Tyre, "I am perfect in beauty."

ekegusii: Tebia obong’aini, “Aye naye mosubati ominto”, na obomanyi oboroke omosani oo momanyaine,
english: Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," and call understanding your kinsman;

ekegusii: Ase ayio, obatebie ng’a mosubati ominto ore, erinde ebe buya asende, na ase engencho yao imbe moyo.”
english: Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake and my life will be spared because of you."

ekegusii: Kwana: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Abanto mbakwe, na emebere yabo esiarerwe aande onsi, ebe buna esike ase emegondo, na buna emesaima yatigetwe nabagesi, onde takoyesangereria.”
english: Say, "This is what the LORD declares: "'The dead bodies of men will lie like refuse on the open field, like cut grain behind the reaper, with no one to gather them.'"

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Genda ase agachie karia mokoorokera, erio kegima namorore etigere esibire, na emori yaye amo nero; mochisibore mochindetere.
english: saying to them, "Go to the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt by her. Untie them and bring them to me.

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Genda ase agachie karia mokoorokera, erio kamogosoa aroro, namorore emori y’etigere esibire, etana koriinwa na monto; moyendetere.
english: saying to them, "Go to the village ahead of you, and just as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

ekegusii: saying, "I will surely bless you and give you many descendants."
english: agateba, “Ekeene, ogosesenia ningosesenie, na okomenta ninkomentekie.”

ekegusii: agateba, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Ibrahimu, atogigwe! Ere tatigeti koorokia omonene one obuya na obwegenwa. Omonene ondaaire enchera, naikire enka y’abamwabo omonene one.”
english: saying, "Praise be to the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not abandoned his kindness and faithfulness to my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the journey to the house of my master's relatives."

ekegusii: akabatebia “Irana chinka chiaino amo nobotenenku obo obonge mwanyorire, chitugo chinyinge amo ne chifeta ne chitahabu ne chitaai, na ebioma, amo ne chianga chinyinge. Ase ayio mwatananere abamino ebisakorwa ebio mwasakorete ababisa baino.”
english: saying, "Return to your homes with your great wealth-- with large herds of livestock, with silver, gold, bronze and iron, and a great quantity of clothing-- and divide with your brothers the plunder from your enemies."

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteba, “Ndiriri omoyega bw’Omotienyi Omoyia oraere, erinde toonie chimbusuro chiaito? Naende ndiriri Esabato eraere, erinde toonie engano? Erio toyerenge nekemunu egeke, na tokinie rigori ri’esekeli, naende tobe tokong’ainereria nebirengero bi’obourereria.
english: saying, "When will the New Moon be over that we may sell grain, and the Sabbath be ended that we may market wheat?"-- skimping the measure, boosting the price and cheating with dishonest scales,

ekegusii: bagokwana: Omonto oyo nigo achagete oboagacho, korende tabokoora.
english: saying, 'This fellow began to build and was not able to finish.'

ekegusii: bakobora, “Amina! Ogotogigwa na obonene, na obong’aini, na ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono, na ogosikwa, na okobua, ne chinguru, nebia Nyasae oito goika kare na kare. Amina.”
english: saying: "Amen! Praise and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God for ever and ever. Amen!"

ekegusii: bamotebie “Oko nokoiraneria kwa Yefta: Abaisraeli tibairete ense y’Abamoabu, gose ey’Abaamoni,
english: saying: "This is what Jephthah says: Israel did not take the land of Moab or the land of the Ammonites.

ekegusii: bagoteba, “Aye Omonene Nyasae Omobui, oyoreo na oyokwarengeo, twagoakeire ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera kwabogoirie okobua kwao okonene, na gwachakire kogamba.
english: saying: "We give thanks to you, Lord God Almighty, the One who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and have begun to reign.

ekegusii: Ase obwango obwo naruete ase abarendi abwo, nkanyora omwanchi bw’omoyo one. Nkamotarera tinamotiga agende; nigo namorentete mwa baba, nkamosoyia gochia ase eero y’oyio onyiborete.
english: Scarcely had I passed them when I found the one my heart loves. I held him and would not let him go till I had brought him to my mother's house, to the room of the one who conceived me.

ekegusii: Amabe ayio nakoreirwe asionoire enkoro yane, bono nerusirie moyo. Nigo nasemeretie ng’a ndorerwe amabeebe, korende tinayaroreretwe; nigo nasemeretie inyore abaremia, korende tinabanyora.
english: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.

ekegusii: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.
english: Aye Nyasae, ndiga‐rigie omanye enkoro yane. Nteeme omanye ebirengererio biane.

ekegusii: Goika obeke omonyo ase okoruegwa kwao gwonsi kw’endagera. Ase okoruegwa okwo tibweba kobeka omonyo bw’okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania. Omonyo tomocha kobekwa ase kera okoruegwa kwao.
english: Season all your grain offerings with salt. Do not leave the salt of the covenant of your God out of your grain offerings; add salt to all your offerings.

ekegusii: Omomura oyomo, erieta riaye Eutiko, oikaransete ase ekebao, akabwatwa ne chitoro chindito ekero Paulo agendererete gokwana; akabugwa ne chitoro chinyinge akagwa korwa rirongo ria gatato, akabogorigwa konya okure.
english: Seated in a window was a young man named Eutychus, who was sinking into a deep sleep as Paul talked on and on. When he was sound asleep, he fell to the ground from the third story and was picked up dead.

ekegusii: Rora, nigo agosiarera okomesa kwamoetanana, naende otuba enkori y’enyancha.
english: See how he scatters his lightning about him, bathing the depths of the sea.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, rora buna nyanchete amachiko ao! Ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nobwanchani bwao botari koera.
english: See how I love your precepts; preserve my life, O LORD, according to your love.

ekegusii: Rora ababisa baane bonsi buna bare abange; na buna bangechete nobotindi obonge.
english: See how my enemies have increased and how fiercely they hate me!

ekegusii: Rora aase abakori amabe bagure inse, baiyerigwe tibakonyara koboka naende.
english: See how the evildoers lie fallen-- thrown down, not able to rise!

ekegusii: Omochie oyio orenge omwegenwa obeire buna omokungu omotayayi. Agwo kare nigo orenge konacha ebina bia boronge, na oboronge nigo bwarenge ime yaye, korende bono abanto baye babeire abaiti.
english: See how the faithful city has become a harlot! She once was full of justice; righteousness used to dwell in her-- but now murderers!

ekegusii: Bono kwarorire ng’a barabwo bachire gotosiria na gotoseria korwa ase ense eye yao gwatoeire ebe omwando oito.
english: See how they are repaying us by coming to drive us out of the possession you gave us as an inheritance.

ekegusii: Rora, abanto aba bebisete na komboera bang’ite, abanto abatindi basangererekanire amo bankore bobe; Omonene, ayio tari ase engencho y’ogosaria gose ebibe nakorire.
english: See how they lie in wait for me! Fierce men conspire against me for no offense or sin of mine, O LORD.

ekegusii: Rora, ababisa bao buna bagokora riroroche; abwo bakogechete baimokereirie emetwe igoro ase oboenenu.
english: See how your enemies are astir, how your foes rear their heads.

ekegusii: Origererie timbwatia enchera y’obosiru, na ondaae ase enchera ya kare na kare.
english: See if there is any offensive way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

ekegusii: Naama! Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, narusie korwa ase Yerusalemu, na korwa ase Abayuda, kera egento basemeretie na ebi begenete; narusieo endagera yonsi, na amache onsi.
english: See now, the Lord, the LORD Almighty, is about to take from Jerusalem and Judah both supply and support: all supplies of food and all supplies of water,

ekegusii: Morigererie ng’a onde taba omotomani, gose oyotamosigeti Nyasae, buna Esau, oyoonetie omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi ase endagera eyemo.
english: See that no one is sexually immoral, or is godless like Esau, who for a single meal sold his inheritance rights as the oldest son.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, tiga aikaranse ime yaino. Onye amang’ana aria mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani aikaransete ime yaino, erio nainwe namomenye ime ase Omwana, na ime ase Ise.
english: See that what you have heard from the beginning remains in you. If it does, you also will remain in the Son and in the Father.

ekegusii: “Kera ring’ana nabachikire moribwate na korikora. Timomenta amang’ana aino ase ayio nabachikire, gose timorusia egento korwao.
english: See that you do all I command you; do not add to it or take away from it.

ekegusii: Origererie buya obikore buna nakworogetie ase egetunwa.”
english: See that you make them according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

ekegusii: Morigererie mono ng’a onde taremerwa obuya bwa Nyasae, “omori bw’obororo” tocha gokumbaria na kobachanda, na abanto abange batambokerigwe ogotacheneka ase oyio.
english: See to it that no one misses the grace of God and that no bitter root grows up to cause trouble and defile many.

ekegusii: Rigereria monto onde tabaisa kobakora abasakore ase chisemi chiaye chinene, na obong’ainereria bwa bosa koreng’ana ne chingencho chia mwanyabanto, na koreng’ana namorokererio aye ritang’ani ay’ense eye, gose tari buna aya Kristo.
english: See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition and the basic principles of this world rather than on Christ.

ekegusii: Rigereria, timomwanga ere oyogokwana. Naki onye baria tibetooretie baria bamwangete ere oyobakurerete ase ense, kobua mono intwe titogwetooria onye tokomwanga ere oyogotokurera korwa igoro.
english: See to it that you do not refuse him who speaks. If they did not escape when they refused him who warned them on earth, how much less will we, if we turn away from him who warns us from heaven?

ekegusii: Rigereria baminto, taba onde omo oino oyore nenkoro embe y’ogotegena, abaise kweatanana korwa ase Nyasae ore moyo.
english: See to it, brothers, that none of you has a sinful, unbelieving heart that turns away from the living God.

ekegusii: See to it, then, that the light within you is not darkness.
english: Gaki renda, oborabu obwo bore ime yao tibocha koba omosunte.

ekegusii: Rigereria, buna chinuguta chire chinene echi nabarikeire nokoboko kwane omonyene.
english: See what large letters I use as I write to you with my own hand!

ekegusii: Morigererie buna ense eria ere, naende morore gose abanto bareo mbare ne chinguru, gose naboro bare, gose nabake, gose nabange.
english: See what the land is like and whether the people who live there are strong or weak, few or many.

ekegusii: Oise kobarigereria, orore buna bakona‐gokwana‐kwana! Ebikoba biabo nigo bire buna emioro emioge, bateba, “Ning’o oranyare gotoigwa?”
english: See what they spew from their mouths-- they spew out swords from their lips, and they say, "Who can hear us?"

ekegusii: Rora buna ogoichanigwa okwo kore ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae kwabarenteire omokia, na ogwekengera, na okobea, okoiroka na amaiga amange, ogwetigana na egesiomba! Ase kera enchera mweorokererie koba motari na komocha ase ring’ana erio.
english: See what this godly sorrow has produced in you: what earnestness, what eagerness to clear yourselves, what indignation, what alarm, what longing, what concern, what readiness to see justice done. At every point you have proved yourselves to be innocent in this matter.

ekegusii: See! The winter is past; the rains are over and gone.
english: ekiagera bono engaki y’obokendu yaerire, boigo engaki y’embura yaerire.

ekegusii: Rora, omoruoti naoroke oragambe ase oboronge, na abagambi b’obogambi mbagambe bakore ay’ekeene.
english: See, a king will reign in righteousness and rulers will rule with justice.

ekegusii: Rora, omosunte notube ense, na omosunte ekerima notube abanto b’ebisaku, korende aye, Omonene nakomorekere, na obonene bwaye mbororekane igoro yao.
english: See, darkness covers the earth and thick darkness is over the peoples, but the LORD rises upon you and his glory appears over you.

ekegusii: Rora omorero okarwa igoro ogasamba abatang’ani baria babere b’abarwani emerongo etano, amo nabarwani babo bonsi, korende koranche, tiga obogima bwane bobe obw’engencho enene asore.”
english: See, fire has fallen from heaven and consumed the first two captains and all their men. But now have respect for my life!"

ekegusii: Naama! Inche nachakire korenta amabe igoro ase omochie oyio okorokwa ase erieta riane. Inee! Nigo mokorengereria ng’a nigo moratigwe timoegwa egesusuro? Goika monyore egesusuro, ekiagera nindete esegi erwanie abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
english: See, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that bears my Name, and will you indeed go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, for I am calling down a sword upon all who live on the earth, declares the LORD Almighty.'

ekegusii: Naama! Ninkore ring’ana riyia; ring’ana erio riachakire kooroka; Inee! Timorirochi? Nindoisie enchera ase erooro, nintubokie chindooche ase ense enyomo,
english: See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the desert and streams in the wasteland.

ekegusii: Korende bono nimbarangerie barue aase aria mwabaoonetie gochia, erinde mbairanerie inwe ogokora kwaino kobe igoro yaino.
english: 'See, I am going to rouse them out of the places to which you sold them, and I will return on your own heads what you have done.

ekegusii: “Naama! Rituko ria rero nabekire ase amasio aino ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa.
english: See, I am setting before you today a blessing and a curse--

ekegusii: Rora, ninteneine aiga ase ensoko y’amache, na abaiseke b’omochie oyo ngocha bare kobuucha amache.
english: See, I am standing beside this spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.

ekegusii: Rora ninteneine aiga ase ensoko y’amache. Tiga ebe iga: Omoiseke onde omo orache kobuucha amache, na inche imosabe oyio: Koranche ong’e amache make korwa ase enyongo yao inywe.
english: See, I am standing beside this spring; if a maiden comes out to draw water and I say to her, "Please let me drink a little water from your jar,"

ekegusii: Rora, nigo imang’erete amarieta aino ase ebisanyi bi’amaboko aane; ne chindwaki chigoetanaine nigo chire ase obosio bwane botambe.
english: See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are ever before me.

ekegusii: Rigereria, inche Omonene nabaeire ense eyio. Genda moyeire; eyio inche Omonene nariete eira na gotiana ng’a ninyee Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, chisokoro chiaino, amo nabanto b’ororeria rwabo.”
english: See, I have given you this land. Go in and take possession of the land that the LORD swore he would give to your fathers-- to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob-- and to their descendants after them."

ekegusii: Rora, nigo namobegete abe kirori one ase abanto, naende abe omoraai na omochiki igoro ase abanto.
english: See, I have made him a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander of the peoples.

ekegusii: Rora nabachenire, ko tari buna efeta egochenwa; nabateemire ase okobaetia ase omorero bw’emechando.
english: See, I have refined you, though not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.

ekegusii: “Naama! Inche naborokereirie amachiko na emeroberio, buna Omonene, Nyasae one, anchigete, erinde inwe moyaigwere ase ense eria mokogenda koira ebe eyaino.
english: See, I have taught you decrees and laws as the LORD my God commanded me, so that you may follow them in the land you are entering to take possession of it.

ekegusii: See, I have told you ahead of time.
english: Rora, nabatebirie aya ritang’ani.

ekegusii: “Rora, rituko ria rero nabekire ase amasio aino obogima na ayare amaya, amakweri na ayare amabe.
english: See, I set before you today life and prosperity, death and destruction.

ekegusii: Rora, nimbarente korwa ase ense ya sugusu, mbasangererie korwa chinsinyo chi’ense. Amo nabarabwo mbachiche emeuko na ebirema, abakungu bare barito na abakobina baibore, nabairane aase aiga bare omoganda omonene.
english: See, I will bring them from the land of the north and gather them from the ends of the earth. Among them will be the blind and the lame, expectant mothers and women in labor; a great throng will return.

ekegusii: Rora, inche Omonene ninseegete Abamedi abwo batabare chifeta ne chitahabu koba nengencho enene.
english: See, I will stir up against them the Medes, who do not care for silver and have no delight in gold.

ekegusii: Aye tata, rigereria orore omokoba bw’eanga yao, ore koboko kwane; nigo nayobutora, korende nkagotiga kore moyo, erio nario oramanye ng’a obobe gose ogosaria tibiri asende; inche tindakora ebibe asore, nonya gokorigia kong’ita.
english: See, my father, look at this piece of your robe in my hand! I cut off the corner of your robe but did not kill you. Now understand and recognize that I am not guilty of wrongdoing or rebellion. I have not wronged you, but you are hunting me down to take my life.

ekegusii: Naama! Omosomba one naseseneke ase ogokora kwaye, nakinigwe na koimokererigwa igoro, nabe omonene mono.
english: See, my servant will act wisely; he will be raised and lifted up and highly exalted.

ekegusii: Rora, Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori bw’okobwatana, eyio y’Omonene bw’ense engima, nkwambokigwa ere gochia rooche ng’umbu, bosio bwaino.
english: See, the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth will go into the Jordan ahead of you.

ekegusii: Rora, rituko ri’Omonene ngocha rire; nigo rire ritindi ri’ekeririanda na endamwamu egwoka, ndisarie ense ebe bosa na gosiria kegima abanyabibe bamenyeteo.
english: See, the day of the LORD is coming--a cruel day, with wrath and fierce anger-- to make the land desolate and destroy the sinners within it.

ekegusii: Rora, amang’ana natebete agwo kare aikeranire, na bono nigo nkobarareria amang’ana amayia, nkobayamanyia atarakorekana.”
english: See, the former things have taken place, and new things I declare; before they spring into being I announce them to you."

ekegusii: Rora, Omonene nabwate oyomo ore nokobua ne chinguru; oyio nigo anga buna embura y’amagena, na buna omwaga omotindi ogosaria, na buna omoubera ore nembura enyinge oraiyerie ebinto bionsi inse ne chinguru.
english: See, the Lord has one who is powerful and strong. Like a hailstorm and a destructive wind, like a driving rain and a flooding downpour, he will throw it forcefully to the ground.

ekegusii: Rora, Omonene ngosoka are korwa aase aye, ae abanto bamenyete ase ense egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo. Okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ase ense nkobe maiso marore, na ense tekogenderera kobisa abanto abwo baitetwe.
english: See, the LORD is coming out of his dwelling to punish the people of the earth for their sins. The earth will disclose the blood shed upon her; she will conceal her slain no longer.

ekegusii: “Rora, Omonene nachiche nomorero, ne chigari chiaye chi’esegi chire buna ekembugu‐mbugu. Nigo ararente endamwamu yaye ere nobotindi na ogotogonyera kwaye kore ne chimeme chi’omorero.
english: See, the LORD is coming with fire, and his chariots are like a whirlwind; he will bring down his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.

ekegusii: Naama! Omonene nasarie ense, ayetige ere bosa; nayeonchorane ayeumamie, na abanto bamenyeteo abasiarere gochia aaria na aaria.
english: See, the LORD is going to lay waste the earth and devastate it; he will ruin its face and scatter its inhabitants--

ekegusii: Rigereria, Omonene, Nyasae oino, obaeire ense eria. Genda moyeire ebe eyaino, buna Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, abatebirie. Timoiroka, gose timokwa emioyo.”
english: See, the LORD your God has given you the land. Go up and take possession of it as the LORD, the God of your fathers, told you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged."

ekegusii: Rora, Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, nabutore chinsagia ne chinguru chi’okwoboyia; emete ere emetambe mono negechwe egwe inse, na eyechongororogete gochia igoro nekumbwe gochia inse.
english: See, the Lord, the LORD Almighty, will lop off the boughs with great power. The lofty trees will be felled, the tall ones will be brought low.

ekegusii: Rora, erieta ri’Omonene ngocha rire korwa aare. Nigo agocha ore nendamwamu egwoka, ne rikundesi rinene ri’erioki; amang’ana ’ebikoba biaye nigo aichire nekeririanda, na oromeme rwaye nigo rore buna omorero ogosiria.
english: See, the Name of the LORD comes from afar, with burning anger and dense clouds of smoke; his lips are full of wrath, and his tongue is a consuming fire.

ekegusii: Rora, Omonene Nyasae ngocha are ore nokobua, okoboko kwaye nkobe gokogamba. Naama! Nigo agocha obwate eng’eria yaye, na ebiasakoire nigo bire ase obosio bwaye.
english: See, the Sovereign LORD comes with power, and his arm rules for him. See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.

ekegusii: Rigereria, ase obosio bwa Yoshua nabekire rigena erimo; nareo amaiso atano na abere arigereretie rigena erio. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo ngoteba iga: Nimang’ere ase rigena erio ririko ririgwenerete, na nindusie ebibe bi’ense eye ase rituko erimo.
english: See, the stone I have set in front of Joshua! There are seven eyes on that one stone, and I will engrave an inscription on it,' says the LORD Almighty, 'and I will remove the sin of this land in a single day.

ekegusii: Rora omwaga bw’Omonene! Endamwamu yaye yachire buna omwaga bw’ekerambauti, noguse igoro ase emetwe y’abanyabibe.
english: See, the storm of the LORD will burst out in wrath, a driving wind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.

ekegusii: Rora, omwaga omotindi okorwa ase Omonene, oichire nendamwamu yaye enga buna ekerambauti osokire; nigo egocha igoro ase emetwe y’abanyabibe.
english: See, the storm of the LORD will burst out in wrath, a whirlwind swirling down on the heads of the wicked.

ekegusii: Naama! Chinyasae echio chionsi mbosa. Emeremo eyio y’abanto nigo ere bosa kegima, ee, emegwekano eyio abanto babombete nigo enga embeo bosa.”
english: See, they are all false! Their deeds amount to nothing; their images are but wind and confusion.

ekegusii: Rora, abanto mbache korwa chinse chi’aare, abande barue sugusu, na abande bosongo, na abande barue ense ya Sinimu.”
english: See, they will come from afar-- some from the north, some from the west, some from the region of Aswan."

ekegusii: Naama! Rituko ria rero nakoeire okobua igoro y’ebisaku, na igoro y’amaruoti, obe kogosimora na gotagora, kogosaria na koonchorana, gokoagacha na gosimeka.”
english: See, today I appoint you over nations and kingdoms to uproot and tear down, to destroy and overthrow, to build and to plant."

ekegusii: Akarora omoko oyomo ase enchera ensemo, akayochiera, tarora gento asoro otatiga amato oka. Akayotebia, “Korwa bono tokwama amatunda nonya ndinde.” Erio kegima omoko oyio okoma.
english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. Then he said to it, "May you never bear fruit again!" Immediately the tree withered.

ekegusii: Akarora korwa are omoko ore namato, akagenda arore gose amako nareo. Agachia goika aroro tarora gento otatiga amato, ekiagera tikiarenge ekero ki’amako.
english: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to find out if it had any fruit. When he reached it, he found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.

ekegusii: agatang’ana korora aya, agakwana igoro y’okoboka kwaye Kristo, ng’a tagotigwa agwo aase abakure, nonya nomobere oye tokorora ogosareka.
english: Seeing what was ahead, he spoke of the resurrection of the Christ, that he was not abandoned to the grave, nor did his body see decay.

ekegusii: Rigia ayare amaya, na tari ayare amabe, erio nario morabe moyo. Komorakore bo, Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabe amo nainwe, buna inwe mwatebire.
english: Seek good, not evil, that you may live. Then the LORD God Almighty will be with you, just as you say he is.

ekegusii: Morigie Omonene, nario morabe moyo; motakoreti bo, Omonene nigo arachere ororeria rwa Yusufu arosirie buna omorero ogosiria, na onde tari orayorimie atoorie Beteli.
english: Seek the LORD and live, or he will sweep through the house of Joseph like a fire; it will devour, and Bethel will have no one to quench it.

ekegusii: Morigie Omonene ekero akonyorekana, morangerie erinde abakonye ekero are ang’e!
english: Seek the LORD while he may be found; call on him while he is near.

ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamore abaitongo ase ense eye, inwe abamobwatete amachiko aye, morigie Omonene; rigia oboronge, rigia ay’obokanyeku. Ande nabo morabaise gokengerwa ase rituko riria ri’endamwamu y’Omonene.
english: Seek the LORD, all you humble of the land, you who do what he commands. Seek righteousness, seek humility; perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD's anger.

ekegusii: Ekero ararore ng’a omosae oyo taiyo, nigo arakwe, na intwe, abasomba bao, nigo toragere agende ase oboina ne chimbuche chiaye, ore nomoichano.
english: sees that the boy isn't there, he will die. Your servants will bring the gray head of our father down to the grave in sorrow.

ekegusii: Segubu akaibora Yairi, oyio obwate emechie emerongo ebere, na etato, ase ense ya Gileadi.
english: Segub was the father of Jair, who controlled twenty-three towns in Gilead.

ekegusii: Amagoro ao tanara kona‐kogenda ase enyomba y’omosani oo, nigo arabaise korosa naye, erinde akogeche.
english: Seldom set foot in your neighbor's house-- too much of you, and he will hate you.

ekegusii: mochore emechie erabe obotamero asemore, erinde omonto onde bwensi, onye oitire omonto onde mosiabano, natamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio.
english: select some towns to be your cities of refuge, to which a person who has killed someone accidentally may flee.

ekegusii: Nong’oonerie endagera indie na amache inywe, nainche ninkoe chibesa. Aye ing’a ribaga ng’ete namagoro ase ense yao.
english: Sell us food to eat and water to drink for their price in silver. Only let us pass through on foot--

ekegusii: Oonia ebio more nabio, morue ebiegwa; mwekorere ebimoya bitari kogota amo nenibo etari gokea igoro, aase omoibi atagoika, gose ebigwankwa gosaria.
english: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide purses for yourselves that will not wear out, a treasure in heaven that will not be exhausted, where no thief comes near and no moth destroys.

ekegusii: bakaoonia chinibo chiabo na ebinto ebibarenge nabio, na kobigabera abanto bonsi koreng’ana buna kera oyomo aremeire.
english: Selling their possessions and goods, they gave to anyone as he had need.

ekegusii: Goika morusie korwa ase ebitwori abasacha na abakungu abwo babeire abatachenegeti babeere isiko, erinde tibabaisa gokora ebitwori biabo bibe bitachenegeti, agwo ase inche imenyete ase egati y’abanto baane.”
english: Send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them."

ekegusii: Mesia chinkoba chiao oserebanie ababisa, ruta chinsara chiao obasirie kegima!
english: Send forth lightning and scatter [the enemies]; shoot your arrows and rout them.

ekegusii: Ntomere oborabu bwao, na ekeene kiao, binyare kondaa, na kong’ikia ase egetunwa kiao egechenu kere obomenyo bwao.
english: Send forth your light and your truth, let them guide me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.

ekegusii: Korwa ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli motome abanto elifu eyemo, bagende korwana esegi.”
english: Send into battle a thousand men from each of the tribes of Israel."

ekegusii: Tomera omogambi bw’ense ebango ye chimanwa chie ching’ondi korwa ase omochie o Sela, goetera ase erooro, gochia ase egetunwa ki’omochie o Sayoni.
english: Send lambs as tribute to the ruler of the land, from Sela, across the desert, to the mount of the Daughter of Zion.

ekegusii: Toma oyomo oino agende korenta oyio omino, na inwe abande motigare echela. Nabo morateemwe gose namaene mogoteba. Onye taibo, amaene buna Farao are moyo, inwe nechirooti more.”
english: Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are telling the truth. If you are not, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!"

ekegusii: Kae abanto aba ribaga, erinde bagende emechie na ebichie, aria na aaria, begorere endagera.”
english: Send the people away so they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat."

ekegusii: Ase igo, toma abanto Yopa, orangerie Simion, oyokorokwa Petero; ere nomogeni are nyomba mwa Simion, omoroisia bw’amao, nigo amenyete ang’e nengegu y’enyancha.
english: Send to Joppa for Simon who is called Peter. He is a guest in the home of Simon the tanner, who lives by the sea.'

ekegusii: Na abasomba ba Senakeribu bakamenta korama Omonene Nyasae na Hezekia, omosomba oye.
english: Sennacherib's officers spoke further against the LORD God and against his servant Hezekiah.

ekegusii: bagatoma abanto barusie Yeremia korwa ase egoora y’abarendi. Abanto abwo bakamobeka ase oborendi bwa Gedalia mosinto bw’Ahikamu, omochokoro o Safani, amoire nka. Bono Yeremia akaba omenyete amo nabanto bande.
english: sent and had Jeremiah taken out of the courtyard of the guard. They turned him over to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, to take him back to his home. So he remained among his own people.

ekegusii: Ere agatoma abanto ase Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, agwo Petori ore ang’e norooche rw’Eufarati, ase ense yabo. Barabwo bakamotebia amang’ana a Balaki, “Rigereria, abanto bachire korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nabarabwo nabange, batubete orogongo rwonsi, batoorire ang’e naintwe, barigereretie ense yane.
english: sent messengers to summon Balaam son of Beor, who was at Pethor, near the River, in his native land. Balak said: "A people has come out of Egypt; they cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.

ekegusii: Seraiah son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, supervisor in the house of God,
english: Seraya, mosinto o Hilikia, o Mesulamu, o Zadoki, o Merayoti, o Ahitubu, omoteneneri bw’enyomba ya Nyasae,

ekegusii: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
english: Seraya, na Asaria, na Yeremia;

ekegusii: Serug, Nahor, Terah
english: na Serugi, na Nahori, na Tera,

ekegusii: Mokorere Omonene more nobwoba na okoiguswa.
english: Serve the LORD with fear and rejoice with trembling.

ekegusii: ase omoyo omuya mogokorera Omonene, gose tari mwanyabanto.
english: Serve wholeheartedly, as if you were serving the Lord, not men,

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, beka omorendi ase omonwa one, abe okorenda ebikoba biane.
english: Set a guard over my mouth, O LORD; keep watch over the door of my lips.

ekegusii: “Mwatananere Omonene, Nyasae oino, chintangi chionsi chie chieri, na echie chimingichi, na echie chigoree. Timobaisa gokorera chieri echio chintangi emeremo ende yonsi, gose timobaisa konacha amarionya e chimingichi echio.
english: Set apart for the LORD your God every firstborn male of your herds and flocks. Do not put the firstborn of your oxen to work, and do not shear the firstborn of your sheep.

ekegusii: naende agatobeka ekemanyererio kiaye, agatoa Omoika oye ase chinkoro chiaito okaba intenenera.
english: set his seal of ownership on us, and put his Spirit in our hearts as a deposit, guaranteeing what is to come.

ekegusii: Osibore omoyo one korwa ase obosibwa, erinde imbe ngotogia erieta riao. Abanyene oboronge mbang’etanane, ekiagera gwankoreire amaya.
english: Set me free from my prison, that I may praise your name. Then the righteous will gather about me because of your goodness to me.

ekegusii: Rigori ri’omonto omosacha bw’emiaka emerongo ebere goika emerongo etano nomo, nigo rirabe chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo etano, ase ekerengo gi’esekeli egokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
english: set the value of a male between the ages of twenty and sixty at fifty shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel;

ekegusii: Oroberie emegati eyio ase chindwaro ibere, etano nomo ase kera orwaro, igoro ase emesa eoomire netahabu echenire, agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
english: Set them in two rows, six in each row, on the table of pure gold before the LORD.

ekegusii: Otenenie orosenge rw’egetambaa roetanane eraaro, na osunge egetambaa ase egesoero ki’eraaro.
english: Set up the courtyard around it and put the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard.

ekegusii: Rengereria ayare igoro, gose tari ayare ase ense.
english: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

ekegusii: Seti nere akaibora omwana omomura, akamoroka Enosu. Erio agwo abanto bagachaka korangeria erieta ri’Omonene ase okomosasima.
english: Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atano na abere nindete embura ase ense etwe amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, na kende gionsi nakorete kere moyo ase ense ningesirie.”
english: Seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living creature I have made."

ekegusii: Amatuko atano na abere akaera korwa riria Omonene aagete orooche rwa Naili.
english: Seven days passed after the LORD struck the Nile.

ekegusii: Abakorete ayio nabamura batano na babere ba Sikewa, Omoyahudi orenge omokuani omonene.
english: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, were doing this.

ekegusii: Ekeriinero kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na bibere nkiarengeo kiare koriinerwa gochiao; egesona kiaye nigo kiarenge ime y’oboagacho obwo. Emegwekano y’emekendo nigo yachabeire ase chisiiro chiaye chiarenge ase chinsemo ibere.
english: Seven steps led up to it, with its portico opposite them; it had palm tree decorations on the faces of the projecting walls on each side.

ekegusii: Ara gatano na kabere ase rituko nigo nkogotogia, ase engencho y’emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.

ekegusii: Anyororokerie amanyinga aria ara gatano na kabere igoro ase omonto oyio ogochia gochenwa ase oborwaire bwa ukoma, atebe ng’a omonto oria ochenekire, na atige enyoni eria ere moyo eiruruke, egende orosana.
english: Seven times he shall sprinkle the one to be cleansed of the infectious disease and pronounce him clean. Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields.

ekegusii: Rora, ngochi‐gocha ere emiaka etano na ebere y’omoigoto ase ense yonsi ya Misiri,
english: Seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atai make, Feliki agaika na Durusila mokaye, oyorenge Omoyahudi. Akarangeria Paulo, akamoigwa ogokwana amang’ana igoro y’okomwegena Kristo Yeso.
english: Several days later Felix came with his wife Drusilla, who was a Jewess. He sent for Paul and listened to him as he spoke about faith in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
english: na Saalabini, na Ayaloni, na Itila,

ekegusii: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim)--fourteen towns and their villages.
english: na Saaraimu, na Aditaimu, na Gedera, na Gederotaimu, emechie ikomi na ene, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Sabetai na Yosabadi, abwo babere nabwo barenge abateneneri b’Abalawi abwo barenge gokora emeremo isiko ase enyomba ya Nyasae;
english: Shabbethai and Jozabad, two of the heads of the Levites, who had charge of the outside work of the house of God;

ekegusii: Erio Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bakairaneria omoruoti oria, bakamotebia, “Aye Nebukadinesaro, titoganeti gokoiraneria igoro y’amang’ana aya.
english: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego replied to the king, "O Nebuchadnezzar, we do not need to defend ourselves before you in this matter.

ekegusii: Aye Yerusalemu, esamunse korwa ase orotu, tenena na oikaranse aase ao. Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, esibore amakorogoto mwasiberetwe ase amagoti aino.
english: Shake off your dust; rise up, sit enthroned, O Jerusalem. Free yourself from the chains on your neck, O captive Daughter of Zion.

ekegusii: Ninyare gwanchera ebirengero bi’obourereria, gose amagena ’obong’ainereria ay’okorengera abeere ase chisaro ime?
english: Shall I acquit a man with dishonest scales, with a bag of false weights?

ekegusii: Inee, tingokora ase Yerusalemu, na ase emegwekano yaye egosasimwa, buna nakorete ase Samaria na ase emegwekano yaye?”
english: shall I not deal with Jerusalem and her images as I dealt with Samaria and her idols?'"

ekegusii: Inee! Ntosarie naende amachiko ao na tonyuomerane nabanto aba bagokora okogechia oko? Inee! Igo aye tokoba nendamwamu asetore na otosirie kegima, erinde abatigari tibanyorekana, gose monto onde atooreke?
english: Shall we again break your commands and intermarry with the peoples who commit such detestable practices? Would you not be angry enough with us to destroy us, leaving us no remnant or survivor?

ekegusii: Oyo omobwatetie koagacha, n’Salumu, mosinto o Halohesi, omogambi bw’ekeng’ese ki’orogongo rwa Yerusalemu. Abaiseke baye bakamokonya.
english: Shallum son of Hallohesh, ruler of a half-district of Jerusalem, repaired the next section with the help of his daughters.

ekegusii: Salumu, mosinto o Yabesi, agachaka kogamba ase omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na kianda, bw’okogamba gwa Usia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akagamba omotienyi oyomo agwo Samaria.
english: Shallum son of Jabesh became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah king of Judah, and he reigned in Samaria one month.

ekegusii: Salumu, mosinto o Yabesi, agakora omoroberio bw’okomoita, akamoitera ase amasio ’abanto, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah. He attacked him in front of the people, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Salumu, mosinto o Kore bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora, amo nabanto bande b’eamate yaye, nabwo Abakora, nigo barenge abateneneri b’okorenda ase ebiita bi’Eema y’Omosangererekano, buna chisokoro chiabo chiarenge korenda ase egesoero ki’egetwori ki’Omonene.
english: Shallum son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his fellow gatekeepers from his family (the Korahites) were responsible for guarding the thresholds of the Tent just as their fathers had been responsible for guarding the entrance to the dwelling of the LORD.

ekegusii: Shallum the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah the father of Azariah,
english: Salumu akaibora Hilikia, na Hilikia akaibora Asaria;

ekegusii: Shallum the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah the father of Elishama.
english: Salumu akaibora Yekamia, na Yekamia akaibora Elisama.

ekegusii: Shallum was Shaul's son, Mibsam his son and Mishma his son.
english: Sauli akaibora Salumu, na Salumu akaibora Mibusamu, na Mibusamu akaibora Misima.

ekegusii: Shallum, Amariah and Joseph.
english: Salumu na Amaria, na Yusufu;

ekegusii: Salimaneseri, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akarwania Hosea, na Hosea akerua asare, akaba okomoa ebango.
english: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up to attack Hoshea, who had been Shalmaneser's vassal and had paid him tribute.

ekegusii: Sama na Elika korwa Harodi;
english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

ekegusii: Samoti korwa Harodi na Helesi korwa Peleti;
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

ekegusii: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,
english: Samiserai na Seharia, na Atalia,

ekegusii: Mobe ang’e gokonya abachenu ase okoremerwa kwabo, mobe abanyamokia ase okoroisia abageni.
english: Share with God's people who are in need. Practice hospitality.

ekegusii: Ense omweya ya Saroni nebe oborisia bw’amaicho e ching’ondi, na Ebate y’Akori ebe aase chiombe chikorara. Aase agwo naegwe abanto baane abwo babeire bakondigia.
english: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for my people who seek me.

ekegusii: otierigwe, erinde oite ogoita okonene, osenigwe, erinde omese buna okomesa gw’enkoba. Inee! Inatoyogokere? Enyimbo y’omwana one nigo yachayete kera omote.
english: sharpened for the slaughter, polished to flash like lightning! "'Shall we rejoice in the scepter of my son [Judah]? The sword despises every such stick.

ekegusii: Mokigite chitukia chi’emetwe yaino ase okoreera abana baino mwanchete. Tiga emetwe yaino etigare bosa buna omotwe bw’ensoti, ekiagera abana baino mbairwe ase obosomba.
english: Shave your heads in mourning for the children in whom you delight; make yourselves as bald as the vulture, for they will go from you into exile.

ekegusii: Na amasankwa aria e chimanwa chie chimbori akamoboyia ase amaboko aye ne rigoti.
english: She also covered his hands and the smooth part of his neck with the goatskins.

ekegusii: Boigo omokungu oria akaibora Saafu, ise Madimana, na Sheva, ise abanto ba Makibena na aba Gibea. Omoiseke o Kalebu nigo arenge korokwa Asika.
english: She also gave birth to Shaaph the father of Madmannah and to Sheva the father of Macbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Acsah.

ekegusii: She answered him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milcah bore to Nahor."
english: Ere akamoiraneria, “Inche nomoiseke o Betueli, oyo Milka aiborerete Nahori.”

ekegusii: ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora, “Nyasae onduseirie ogochaywa kwane.”
english: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son and said, "God has taken away my disgrace."

ekegusii: na Batisua akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Eri.
english: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, who was named Er.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaiborera Rehoboamu abana abamura: Yeusi, na Semaria, na Sahamu.
english: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah and Zaham.

ekegusii: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.
english: Nere akamoiborera Simurani, na Yokisani, na Medani, na Midiani, na Isibaki, na Sua.

ekegusii: Abigaeli akaimoka, agatung’ama inse, akabora, “Rora, inche omosomba oye omokungu nigo inde ang’e gosibia amagoro ’abasomba b’omonene one.”
english: She bowed down with her face to the ground and said, "Here is your maidservant, ready to serve you and wash the feet of my master's servants."

ekegusii: Ase obogima bwaye bwonsi omokungu oyio nigo agokorera omosacha oye amaya, gose tari korenta amabe asare.
english: She brings him good, not harm, all the days of her life.

ekegusii: Endo eria eaberi egakinia emanwa yaye eyemo, ero ekaba endo ere ne chinguru, ekeorokereria gotwara, ekaba ekoria abanto.
english: She brought up one of her cubs, and he became a strong lion. He learned to tear the prey and he devoured men.

ekegusii: akarangeria abanto ba nyomba mwaye, akabatebia, “Rigereria, omosacha one otorenteire omonto oyo Omoibirania ase egati yaito atokorere echeche; nigo acha asende ng’a arare nainche, na inche nakuura neriogi rinene,
english: she called her household servants. "Look," she said to them, "this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us! He came in here to sleep with me, but I screamed.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akarangeria omosacha oye, akamotebia, “Toma omosomba oyomo gochia aaria amo netigere, ng’ayerere gochia ase omonto oria o Nyasae; naende ng’irane bwango.”
english: She called her husband and said, "Please send me one of the servants and a donkey so I can go to the man of God quickly and return."

ekegusii: Agacha agatung’ama ase amagoro Elisha, akaumama, erio akaimokia omwana oye, agasoka isiko.
english: She came in, fell at his feet and bowed to the ground. Then she took her son and went out.

ekegusii: Ere agatunyana Yeso korwa nyuma, agakuna omokoba bw’eanga yaye; erio kegima amanyinga aye agakama.
english: She came up behind him and touched the edge of his cloak, and immediately her bleeding stopped.

ekegusii: Erio agetweka ebitonga biria, akairana omochie, akorokia ng’ina biara eyio achorete. Naende akamoa endagera eria yatigarete ekero ariete akaigota.
english: She carried it back to town, and her mother-in-law saw how much she had gathered. Ruth also brought out and gave her what she had left over after she had eaten enough.

ekegusii: omokungu oria akamobwata eanga yaye eyare kwambara, akamotebia, “Rara nainche.” Korende Yusufu agatigera omokungu oria eanga yaye eyare kwambara, agatama gochia isiko.
english: She caught him by his cloak and said, "Come to bed with me!" But he left his cloak in her hand and ran out of the house.

ekegusii: Naende akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Onani.
english: She conceived again and gave birth to a son and named him Onan.

ekegusii: Naende Lea akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora, “Omonene ororire ng’a tinyanchiri, ong’eire noyo nere omoisia boigo,” akamoroka Simeoni.
english: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Because the LORD heard that I am not loved, he gave me this one too." So she named him Simeon.

ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akabora, “Engaki eye nintogie Omonene.” Ase ayio akamoroka Yuda. Erio agatenena koibora.
english: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "This time I will praise the LORD." So she named him Judah. Then she stopped having children.

ekegusii: Nigo akorigia omogondo oyogora, na korwa ase ebitoki bi’emeremo y’amaboko aye nigo agosimeka emesabibu.
english: She considers a field and buys it; out of her earnings she plants a vineyard.

ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akamotebia, “Agwo kare abanto nigo banarete goteba: Genda Abeli, omochie oyio, erinde onyore ogosemigwa; ayio naro arenge gokoora amang’ana abo.
english: She continued, "Long ago they used to say, 'Get your answer at Abel,' and that settled it.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akana‐kogenderera korera asare ase amatuko aria atano na abere omoyega ogendererete. Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere Samison akamotebia engencho y’omobayeno oria, ekiagera omokungu oria amobetereretie bokong’u. Erio omokungu oria agatebia abanto baria ba sobo engencho yaye.
english: She cried the whole seven days of the feast. So on the seventh day he finally told her, because she continued to press him. She in turn explained the riddle to her people.

ekegusii: Ohola tatigete obonyaka bwaye, boria anarete gokora korwa ekero arenge Misiri, ekiagera ase oboiseke bwaye abasacha nigo barenge gokora obonyaka nere, bagasiria obwekungi bwaye, bakaumora okogania kwabo okobe igoro asare.
english: She did not give up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when during her youth men slept with her, caressed her virgin bosom and poured out their lust upon her.

ekegusii: Okorire eki anyarete, goaka omobere one ase ogotindekwa kwane.
english: She did what she could. She poured perfume on my body beforehand to prepare for my burial.

ekegusii: Sara agakwera ase Kiriati‐Ariba, agwo nao Heburoni, ase ense ya Kanani. Ibrahimu akaba okomoreera Sara na kweumia ase engencho yaye.
english: She died at Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went to mourn for Sarah and to weep over her.

ekegusii: Ekero atungaime inse ase amagoro a Daudi agateba, “Omonene one, okomocha okwo tiga kobarwe igoro yane; koranche ontige inche omosomba oo omokungu nkwane, naye otegerere amang’ana aane.
english: She fell at his feet and said: "My lord, let the blame be on me alone. Please let your servant speak to you; hear what your servant has to say.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaibora omwana omoisia, oyio nere oragambere abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nenyimbo y’ekioma. Korende omwana oye agataborigwa gochia igoro ase Nyasae na ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who will rule all the nations with an iron scepter. And her child was snatched up to God and to his throne.

ekegusii: Akaba morito naende, akaibora omwana omoisia, akamoroka Sela. Yuda nere nao arenge aria Kisibo ekero amoiborete.
english: She gave birth to still another son and named him Shelah. It was at Kezib that she gave birth to him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio agakora obonyaka nabasacha bonsi b’Abaasuri, abarenge nebieni ebiya, na ase enchera eyio agesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasima emegwekano y’abwo barenge nokogania okobe asare.
english: She gave herself as a prostitute to all the elite of the Assyrians and defiled herself with all the idols of everyone she lusted after.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Hagari akaroka Omonene oyo okwanete nere Eli‐Roi, engencho yaye “Aye naye Nyasae bw’okorora”; naki akeboria, “Inee! Amaene, narorire Nyasae, na ere ontiga inde moyo nyuma konamororire?”
english: She gave this name to the LORD who spoke to her: "You are the God who sees me," for she said, "I have now seen the One who sees me."

ekegusii: Nigo akoboka kobore botuko, oroiseria abanto b’enyomba yaye endagera, na oa abasomba baye abaiseke eyebatungetie.
english: She gets up while it is still dark; she provides food for her family and portions for her servant girls.

ekegusii: Ere tari gotaara enchera ekogenda ase obogima; orogendo rwaye nigo rokona‐koonchaonchoka, ere tamanyeti ayio.
english: She gives no thought to the way of life; her paths are crooked, but she knows it not.

ekegusii: Ere narenge nomosubati omwabo ore korokwa Mariamu. Mariamu nigo aikaransete ase amagoro a Yeso, okoigwa amang’ana aye.
english: She had a sister called Mary, who sat at the Lord's feet listening to what he said.

ekegusii: Ere nigo achandegete mono ase amaboko ’abarwaria abange. Ere konya osiareire ebinto bionsi arenge nabio, tagwenigwa nonya ng’ake, korende obogima bwaye bokamentekana koba obobe kobua.
english: She had suffered a great deal under the care of many doctors and had spent all she had, yet instead of getting better she grew worse.

ekegusii: “Omokungu oria tamanyete ng’a ninche narenge komoa endagera, na edivai, na amaguta, naende ninche narenge komoa chifeta ne chitahabu chinyinge, echio abanto beroiseretie enyasae Baali.
english: She has not acknowledged that I was the one who gave her the grain, the new wine and oil, who lavished on her the silver and gold-- which they used for Baal.

ekegusii: Bwanyenyire ching’iti chiaye; bwochoganirie edivai yaye, bwariganirie emesa yaye.
english: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

ekegusii: Bwatomire abasomba baye abaiseke gochia aase aimokererete igoro mono a omochie korangeria abanto, bogoteba:
english: She has sent out her maids, and she calls from the highest point of the city.

ekegusii: Ere nigo anarete goikaransa inse y’omote orenge korokwa Omokendo o Debora, egati ya Rama na Beteli, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na Abaisraeli nigo banarete gocha asare abagayane.
english: She held court under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites came to her to have their disputes decided.

ekegusii: Nigo bore omote bw’obogima ase abwo babobwatererete; na kera omonto ogendererete kobobwata bokong’u nasesenirie.
english: She is a tree of life to those who embrace her; those who lay hold of her will be blessed.

ekegusii: Nigo akweboyia chinguru na amasikani, na igo nabe nomogoko ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha.
english: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

ekegusii: Nigo anga chimeeri chi’abaonchoreria; nigo akorenta endagera korwa ase ense y’aare.
english: She is like the merchant ships, bringing her food from afar.

ekegusii: Nigo bore nengencho enene kobua amagena akomeka‐meka e rigori rinene, gose tokoboreng’ania na kende gionsi oganetie.
english: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

ekegusii: Ogotigwa bosa, na okong’anywa, na ogosarigwa, biabeireo; chinkoro chiarianyekire, na amaru nigo agoaka‐akana. Chibachwa nigo chigwatigwa, na amasio a bonsi aonchokire arabire se ase omoondoko.
english: She is pillaged, plundered, stripped! Hearts melt, knees give way, bodies tremble, every face grows pale.

ekegusii: Akagacha eanga eria goika omosacha oye agacha inka,
english: She kept his cloak beside her until his master came home.

ekegusii: Akana‐gokora ayio amatuko amange. Korende Paulo agakoona, akeonchora, agatebia ekerecha keria, “Nagochikire ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo: Karue ase oyo!” Gekamorua ensa eria eria.
english: She kept this up for many days. Finally Paul became so troubled that he turned around and said to the spirit, "In the name of Jesus Christ I command you to come out of her!" At that moment the spirit left her.

ekegusii: Esagero eaberi nigo egotiga amagena aye ase amaroba ime anyora riberera korwao.
english: She lays her eggs on the ground and lets them warm in the sand,

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akarua asare akagenda, agasoa nyomba mwaye amo nabamura baye, agasieka egesieri. Abamura baye bakamorentera ebibekerero, ne ere akaba okoumora amaguta.
english: She left him and afterward shut the door behind her and her sons. They brought the jars to her and she kept pouring.

ekegusii: Atalia akarora omoruoti oteneine ang’e nesiiro buna engencho yarenge. Abatang’ani na abanto abarenge kobugia ebirombeta bateneine mbarabare y’omoruoti, na abanto bonsi b’ense eria nigo barenge nomochengo, bakobugia ebirombeta. Atalia agatandora chianga chiaye, akarera, “Oko nokoregwa! Nokoregwa!”
english: She looked and there was the king, standing by the pillar, as the custom was. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her robes and called out, "Treason! Treason!"

ekegusii: Na aroro akarora omoruoti oteneine ang’e nesiiro yaye agwo ase egesoero, na abatang’ani na abanto barenge kobugia ebirombeta mbateneine mbarabare ase omoruoti, na abanto bonsi b’ense eria nigo barenge nomochengo bakobugia ebirombeta. Abateria ababwate ebinto biabo bikobugigwa, bakaba batang’anete amatera ’ogotogia. Erio Atalia agatandora chianga chiaye, akarera, “Oko nokoregwa! Nokoregwa!”
english: She looked, and there was the king, standing by his pillar at the entrance. The officers and the trumpeters were beside the king, and all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets, and singers with musical instruments were leading the praises. Then Athaliah tore her robes and shouted, "Treason! Treason!"

ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akweroiseria ebirarero; chianga chiaye nigo chiroisirie korwa ase egatani engiya ne chiusi chimbariri.
english: She makes coverings for her bed; she is clothed in fine linen and purple.

ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akoroisia chianga chi’egatani engiya, ochioonia; naende nigo akoroisia chinkini, ochiooneria abaonchoreria bande.
english: She makes linen garments and sells them, and supplies the merchants with sashes.

ekegusii: Tabaisa koria gento kende gionsi gekorwa ase omosabibu, gose tabaisa konywa edivai na ebinyugwa ebigotindia, gose taria endagera ende yonsi ere etachenegeti. Aya onsi namochika, goika ayarende.”
english: She must not eat anything that comes from the grapevine, nor drink any wine or other fermented drink nor eat anything unclean. She must do everything I have commanded her."

ekegusii: Akaroka omwana oria Yusufu, akabora, “Omonene karanche amentere omwana onde omoisia.”
english: She named him Joseph, and said, "May the LORD add to me another son."

ekegusii: Akaroka omwana oria I‐Kabodi, ogoteba, “Obonene bwarure ase Abaisraeli.” Nigo akwanete igo, ekiagera Esanduku eria ya Nyasae konya yairirwe, boigo ekiagera ise biara konya okure, na omosacha oye konya oitirwe.
english: She named the boy Ichabod, saying, "The glory has departed from Israel"-- because of the capture of the ark of God and the deaths of her father-in-law and her husband.

ekegusii: Tori koigwera eriogi rinde rionsi, tori gwancha korongeigwa; tori komosemeria Omonene, gose komoika Nyasae oye ang’e.
english: She obeys no one, she accepts no correction. She does not trust in the LORD, she does not draw near to her God.

ekegusii: agakemumora, akanyora omwana omoke ore imeo. Omwana oria akarera, na omoiseke o Farao akamororera amabeebe, agakwana, “Oyoiga noyomo bw’abana b’Abaibirania.”
