english: She opened it and saw the baby. He was crying, and she felt sorry for him. "This is one of the Hebrew babies," she said.

ekegusii: Nigo akorambora okoboko kwaye okonya abataka, ee, nabaremeire nigo akobaramborera amaboko aye.
english: She opens her arms to the poor and extends her hands to the needy.

ekegusii: Asika akairaneria, “Nekeegwa ntagete, ekiagera ngwansogetie okang’ira ase ense enyomo ya Negebu. Ase ayio, ong’e chinsoko chi’amache.” Kalebu akamoa chinsoko chia rogoro amo nechia maate.
english: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

ekegusii: Asika akairaneria, “Nekeegwa nganetie, ekiagera ngwansogetie okang’ira ase ense enyomo ya Negebu. Ase ayio, ing’a chinsoko chi’amache.” Kalebu akamoa chinsoko chia rogoro amo nechia maate.
english: She replied, "Do me a special favor. Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me also springs of water." Then Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

ekegusii: Akabekera etigere egeikaransero, agatebia omosomba oye, “Tema etigere egende bwango, tobaisa koyeira ng’ora goika nagotebirie.”
english: She saddled the donkey and said to her servant, "Lead on; don't slow down for me unless I tell you."

ekegusii: Omokungu oria agatebia Elija, “Aye omonto o Nyasae, mbobe ki obwate asende? Igo gwacha asende, erinde ebibe biane biinyorwe na okarenta ogokwa ase omwana one?”
english: She said to Elijah, "What do you have against me, man of God? Did you come to remind me of my sin and kill my son?"

ekegusii: Omokungu oria agatebia omosacha oye, “Narorire ng’a omonto oyo ogoeta aa botambe nomonto omochenu o Nyasae.
english: She said to her husband, "I know that this man who often comes our way is a holy man of God.

ekegusii: Omoiseke oria agatebia moka omonene oye, “Onye ndiria omonene one arenge koba amo nomobani oria okare agwo Samaria, omobani oria nanga namogwenia oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma.”
english: She said to her mistress, "If only my master would see the prophet who is in Samaria! He would cure him of his leprosy."

ekegusii: Igo arengereretie ase omoyo oye ime, “Inse gokuna eanga yaye, ningwene.”
english: She said to herself, "If I only touch his cloak, I will be healed."

ekegusii: Batiseba akamotebia, “Omonene one, nkwandierete inche, omosomba oo, eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, ogateba: Sulemani, omwana oo omomura, nere oragambe nyuma yane, nere oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oboruoti.
english: She said to him, "My lord, you yourself swore to me your servant by the LORD your God: 'Solomon your son shall be king after me, and he will sit on my throne.'

ekegusii: Eting’ana eria egatebia omoruoti, “Chinkuma nabeire nkoigwa ekero narenge ase ense yane igoro y’emeremo yao, na obong’aini bwao, nechi’ekeene bori.
english: She said to the king, "The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.

ekegusii: Eting’ana eria egatebia omoruoti, “Chinkuma nabeire nkoigwa ekero narenge ase ense yane igoro y’emeremo yao, na obong’aini bwao, nechi’ekeene kegima.
english: She said to the king, "The report I heard in my own country about your achievements and your wisdom is true.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akabatebia, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteba ng’a mogende ase omonto oria obatomete gocha asende, momotebie:
english: She said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Mogende ase omonto oria obatomete gocha asende, momotebie:
english: She said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Tell the man who sent you to me,

ekegusii: Hana akabora, “Tiga inche, omosomba oo, inyore ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao.” Erio omokungu oria akarua aase agwo, akagenda koragera, gose taba oichanete naende.
english: She said, "May your servant find favor in your eyes." Then she went her way and ate something, and her face was no longer downcast.

ekegusii: Agateba, “Obonene bwarure ase Abaisraeli,” ekiagera Esanduku eria ya Nyasae konya yairirwe.
english: She said, "The glory has departed from Israel, for the ark of God has been captured."

ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria agateba, “Aye omoruoti, koranche oinyore Omonene, Nyasae oo, erinde omorusia egesiomba ki’amanyinga tamenta gosaria na goita omwana one.” Akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, nonya nagatukia akamo k’omwana oo tigakogwa inse.”
english: She said, "Then let the king invoke the LORD his God to prevent the avenger of blood from adding to the destruction, so that my son will not be destroyed." "As surely as the LORD lives," he said, "not one hair of your son's head will fall to the ground."

ekegusii: Nigo aboria ribaga ri’ogochora ebigara ebitigari korwa nyuma y’abagesi, na korwa mambia goika bono nigo agendererete gochora ebigara, taratimoka rinde otatiga bono ase engaki ensinini akendererete ase ekegutu keria.”
english: She said, 'Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves behind the harvesters.' She went into the field and has worked steadily from morning till now, except for a short rest in the shelter."

ekegusii: Nigo akorora ng’a emeremo yaye nigo ekorenta ebitoki, na etaya yaye teri korima nyomba mwaye botuko.
english: She sees that her trading is profitable, and her lamp does not go out at night.

ekegusii: Omokungu oyio nigo akorigia amarionya e ching’ondi ne chiusi chi’egatani, okora emeremo namaboko aye ore nomoyo omuya.
english: She selects wool and flax and works with eager hands.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo akarangeria Baraki, mosinto bw’Abinoamu, korwa ase omochie o Kedesi bw’ense ya Nafutali, akamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agochikire: Genda ochore abanto chilifu ikomi korwa ase egesaku kia Nafutali na egia Sabuloni, obaire gochia ase egetunwa gia Tabori.
english: She sent for Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him, "The LORD, the God of Israel, commands you: 'Go, take with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun and lead the way to Mount Tabor.

ekegusii: Nigo akweboyia chinguru buna orokini, okora emeremo emekong’u namaboko aye.
english: She sets about her work vigorously; her arms are strong for her tasks.

ekegusii: rirorio bamorente ase egesieri ki’enyomba ya ise, na abanto b’omochie bw’omoiseke oria bamoake amagena akwe, ekiagera orentire obosooku ase egati y’Abaisraeli ase ogokora obonyaka ekero atarasoka. Goika morusie obobe borue asemore.
english: she shall be brought to the door of her father's house and there the men of her town shall stone her to death. She has done a disgraceful thing in Israel by being promiscuous while still in her father's house. You must purge the evil from among you.

ekegusii: Nigo agoikaransera ekerogo ase egesieri ki’enyomba yaye, agwo aase aimokererete igoro ase omochie,
english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,

ekegusii: Amorokererio akorua ase omonwa oye nigo are ay’obong’aini, na obwororo nigo bore ase oromeme rwaye.
english: She speaks with wisdom, and faithful instruction is on her tongue.

ekegusii: Akaba nokogania okobe ase abamura b’Abaasuri, abwo barenge abagambi, na abachiki, na abarwani esegi beboeranetie ebirwanero, na abariini be chibarasi. Bonsi nigo barenge abamura abaya b’ogosanerwa.
english: She too lusted after the Assyrians-- governors and commanders, warriors in full dress, mounted horsemen, all handsome young men.

ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akaboania omomura oria na komonyunyunta, akomorigereria namaiso, atari nobosooku, akomotebia,
english: She took hold of him and kissed him and with a brazen face she said:

ekegusii: akarusia chianga chiaye chi’ogokobania, akeboyia chianga na gwetuba obosio bwaye, agaikaransa geita ki’Enaimu, ang’e nenchera ekogenda Timuna; naki nigo aroche ng’a Sela obeire omonto omonene, na tamoeiri amotware.
english: she took off her widow's clothes, covered herself with a veil to disguise herself, and then sat down at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah. For she saw that, though Shelah had now grown up, she had not been given to him as his wife.

ekegusii: Nigo ere entindi mono ase ebichuchu biaye, yabikorera biaba buna mbitari ebiaye; teri gwechandera oroiboro rwaye,
english: She treats her young harshly, as if they were not hers; she cares not that her labor was in vain,

ekegusii: Ere nigo arenge morito, akarera nobororo bw’okobina, ekiagera achandegete ase okoibora.
english: She was pregnant and cried out in pain as she was about to give birth.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kw’omoruoti Ahaswero, omotienyi o ikomi okorokwa Tebeti, Esteri akarentwa ase omoruoti, agwo ase enyomba yaye y’oboruoti.
english: She was taken to King Xerxes in the royal residence in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

ekegusii: Nigo akoroberia buya amang’ana ’enyomba yaye, gose tari koria endagera atari gokorera emeremo.
english: She watches over the affairs of her household and does not eat the bread of idleness.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akagenda, agatebia omonto oria o Nyasae amang’ana ayio. Nere agatebia omokungu oria. “Genda, oonie amaguta ayio, oakane esira yao, na echiratigare nchigoisane aye na abana bao.”
english: She went and told the man of God, and he said, "Go, sell the oil and pay your debts. You and your sons can live on what is left."

ekegusii: Oyo akagenda agatebia baria barenge amo nere korwa kare, baare kweumia na korera.
english: She went and told those who had been with him and who were mourning and weeping.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akagenda, agakora buna Elija amotebetie, na omokungu oria, na Elija, na abanto bonsi b’enyomba y’omokungu oria bakaba bakonyora endagera eisaine ase amatuko amange.
english: She went away and did as Elijah had told her. So there was food every day for Elijah and for the woman and her family.

ekegusii: Akagenda mwaye, akanyora omwana oria bwareirie borere, na ekerecha keria kiamorure.
english: She went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon gone.

ekegusii: She went out and said to her mother, "What shall I ask for?" "The head of John the Baptist," she answered.
english: Omoiseke oria agasoka, akaboria ng’ina, “Inki ndasabe?” Ng’ina akamoiraneria, “Omotwe o Yohana Omobatisi.”

ekegusii: Akamoira akamwareria ase oborere bw’omonto oria o Nyasae, agasieka egesieri akamotiga aroro, agasoka isiko.
english: She went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, then shut the door and went out.

ekegusii: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, sends you her greetings, and so does my son Mark.
english: Ekanisa ya Babeli eyachorirwe amo nainwe yabakwanirie. Nonya Mariko, omwana one, obakwanirie.

ekegusii: Nabe okobwatia abanchi baye, korende takobaikeera; nabarigie, korende takobanyora. Erio natebe: Bono nkoirana inde, ngende ase omosacha one bwe ritang’ani, ekiagera engaki eria narenge asare nigo narenge buya kobua bono.
english: She will chase after her lovers but not catch them; she will look for them but not find them. Then she will say, 'I will go back to my husband as at first, for then I was better off than now.'

ekegusii: Ere naibore omwana omoisia, nomoroke erieta riaye Yeso, ekiagera nere oratoorie abanto baye korwa ase ebibe biabo.”
english: She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins."

ekegusii: Babeli tokomenywa nonya ng’ake nebiaare binde bionsi, nonya n’Omoarabu tagotenenia eema yaye agwo, gose abarisia tibakorenta ching’ondi ne chimbori chitimokereo.
english: She will never be inhabited or lived in through all generations; no Arab will pitch his tent there, no shepherd will rest his flocks there.

ekegusii: Mbobeke ase omotwe oo ekiore gechabeire, naende bokoe egutwa y’obonene.
english: She will set a garland of grace on your head and present you with a crown of splendor."

ekegusii: Erio abanto ba Seba, na aba Dedani, na abaonchoreria ba Tarisisi, amo nabatang’ani babo bonsi banga chindo chinsae mbakoborie: Nigo gwachire gwosa na gosakora? Inee! Nigo gwasangereirie emeganda yao gocha koira ebisakorwa, buna chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitugo, na ebinto, erinde oire ebisakorwa ebinge?
english: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish and all her villages will say to you, "Have you come to plunder? Have you gathered your hordes to loot, to carry off silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods and to seize much plunder?"'

ekegusii: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel Beth Maacah and through the entire region of the Berites, who gathered together and followed him.
english: Seba agaeta egati ye chingongo chi’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, agaika omochie o Abeli Beti‐Maaka, na Ababeri bonsi bagasangererekana amo, bakamotunyana.

ekegusii: Sebania na Yehosafati, Netaneli na Amasai, Zakaria na Benaya, na Eliezeri, abakuani, babe bakobugia ebirombeta bosio bw’Esanduku eria ya Nyasae. Obedi‐Edomu na Yehia mbarabwo babe abarendi b’egeita ase Esanduku eria.
english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer the priests were to blow trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-Edom and Jehiah were also to be doorkeepers for the ark.

ekegusii: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
english: Sekania, na Rehumu, na Meremoti;

ekegusii: Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,
english: na Selemia, Nathani na Adaya,

ekegusii: Selomiti na abamwabo nabwo batenenerete chikungo chionsi chi’ebiegwa Daudi omoruoti aatananerete Omonene, amo nebio abateneneri be chiamate, na abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi chilifu na ab’amagana, na abachiki b’abarwani esegi baatananete bikaba ebichenu.
english: Shelomith and his relatives were in charge of all the treasuries for the things dedicated by King David, by the heads of families who were the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and by the other army commanders.

ekegusii: Selumieli, mosinto o Surisadai, nere orenge omoraai bw’abanto b’egesaku gia Simeoni.
english: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,

ekegusii: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
english: Ororeria rwa Shemu narwo oro: Arifakisadi, na Sela,

ekegusii: Shema was the father of Raham, and Raham the father of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai.
english: Sema akaibora Rahamu, ise Yorikeamu. Rekemu akaibora Samai.

ekegusii: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
english: Semaya, na Yoyaribu, na Yedaya;

ekegusii: korwa ase egesaku gia Simeoni, Semueli, mosinto bw’Amihudi;
english: Shemuel son of Ammihud, from the tribe of Simeon;

ekegusii: Bono Sefatia, mosinto o Matani, na Gedalia, mosinto o Pasuri, na Yukali, mosinto o Selemia, na Pasuri, mosinto o Malikia, mbaigwete ekero Yeremia akwanete nabanto bonsi akabatebia,
english: Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, Jehucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malkijah heard what Jeremiah was telling all the people when he said,

ekegusii: Sefatia na Hatili, Pokereti‐Hasebaimu na Ami.
english: Shephatiah, Hattil, Pokereth-Hazzebaim and Ami

ekegusii: Sefatia na Hatili, na Pokereti-Hasebamiu, na Amoni.
english: Shephatiah, Hattil, Pokereth-Hazzebaim and Amon

ekegusii: Risia abanto bao nenyimbo yao abanto abwo bare riicho ri’omwando oo, rimenyete ao rioka ase rinani ime agwo Karimeli. Oritige rikorisia agwo Basani na Gileadi, buna yarenge ase amatuko a kare.
english: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your inheritance, which lives by itself in a forest, in fertile pasturelands. Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead as in days long ago.

ekegusii: Abarisia mbachiche aroro namaicho abo, batenenie chiema chiabo chinsemo chiaye chionsi; kera omorisia nenyorere aroro aase aye akorisia ching’ondi chiaye.
english: Shepherds with their flocks will come against her; they will pitch their tents around her, each tending his own portion."

ekegusii: Sesani akaa Yara, omosomba oye, omoiseke oye akaba mokaye; ere akaibora omomura orenge korokwa Atai.
english: Sheshan gave his daughter in marriage to his servant Jarha, and she bore him Attai.

ekegusii: Sesani tabwate abana abamura, korende igo abwate abana abaiseke boka. Ere Sesani nabwate omosomba oye omomura Omomisiri orenge korokwa Yara.
english: Sheshan had no sons-- only daughters. He had an Egyptian servant named Jarha.

ekegusii: Sheva nomoriki orenge, na Zadoki na Abiatari nabakuani barenge.
english: Sheva was secretary; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;

ekegusii: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son and Asaiah his son.
english: na Simea omomura oye, na Hagia omomura oye, na Asaia omomura oye.

ekegusii: Simei agatebia omoruoti, “Egento gwatebire nekiya; buna aye omonene one omoruoti gwatebire, naboigo inche, omosomba oo, ndakore.” Ase ayio, Simei akamenya ase Yerusalemu amatuko amange.
english: Shimei answered the king, "What you say is good. Your servant will do as my lord the king has said." And Shimei stayed in Jerusalem for a long time.

ekegusii: Simei nigo abwate abana abamura ikomi na batano nomo, na abaiseke batano nomo; korende abamura bamwabo tibabwate abana abange, gose chiamate chiabo chionsi tichiamentekanete buna echia Yuda.
english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children; so their entire clan did not become as numerous as the people of Judah.

ekegusii: Simei, mosinto bwa Ela, agatenenera orogongo rwa Benjamin;
english: Shimei son of Ela-- in Benjamin;

ekegusii: Na Simei, mosinto o Gera, Omobenjamin korwa Bahurimu, akaayerera amo n’Abayuda gochia korotota omoruoti Daudi.
english: Shimei son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, hurried down with the men of Judah to meet King David.

ekegusii: Simei Omoramati agatenenera emegondo y’emesabibu, na Sabidi Omosifumi agatenenera edivai ase yare kogachwa.
english: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards. Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats.

ekegusii: Chimeeri chia Kitimu nchiche komorwania, nere noboe atame airane, naonchore ekeririanda kiaye mamincha y’okobwatana ogochenu. “Ekero arabe oiranire nabe ogotegerera na koigwera abwo batigire okobwatana okwo ogochenu.
english: Ships of the western coastlands will oppose him, and he will lose heart. Then he will turn back and vent his fury against the holy covenant. He will return and show favor to those who forsake the holy covenant.

ekegusii: Abanto mbachiche ne chimeeri korwa ase engegu ya Kitimu, nabarabwo mbachande Abaasuri na Abaeberi, korende barabwo abanyene mbasirigwe boigo.”
english: Ships will come from the shores of Kittim; they will subdue Asshur and Eber, but they too will come to ruin."

ekegusii: Sitirai Omosaroni agatenenera amaicho arenge korisia agwo Saroni, na Safati, mosinto bw’Adilai, agatenenera amaicho arenge korisia ase amakura.
english: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon. Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys.

ekegusii: Engaki ende, nyuma Hanania omobani karusirie rikorogoto riria ase rigoti ria Yeremia omobani na koribuna, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamotebia,
english: Shortly after the prophet Hananiah had broken the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah:

ekegusii: Nigo okagete ng’a Nyasae nigo aragoakane buna oranche, ekiagera gwakanire ande onsi? Aye goika ochore, gose tari inche; ase ayio, kwana aya omanyete.
english: Should God then reward you on your terms, when you refuse to repent? You must decide, not I; so tell me what you know.

ekegusii: Inee! Amaya naakanwe namabe? Abanto bakunyire engoro, erinde basirie obogima bwane. Omonene, ing’inyore buna natenenete ase obosio bwao kobasabera na gokwana amang’ana amaya ase engencho yabo, erinde aye oonchoke na otige endamwamu yao korwa asebare.
english: Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember that I stood before you and spoke in their behalf to turn your wrath away from them.

ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nigo agochia gotebigwa ng’a inche ninganetie gokwana? Onde nare oganetie ere amosirie?
english: Should he be told that I want to speak? Would any man ask to be swallowed up?

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akaboria: “Inee! Tinkobaa egesusuro ase amang’ana aya? Tinkweruseria egesiomba ase egesaku buna eke?
english: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?

ekegusii: Naende Omonene okwanire iga: “Inee! Tinkobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora okwo? Tinkweruseria egesiomba igoro ase egesaku kegokora amang’ana buna ayio?
english: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?

ekegusii: Inee! Tinkobaa egesusuro ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio? Tinkweruseria egesiomba ase egesaku kenga buna eke?” Nabo Omonene akwanire.
english: Should I not punish them for this?" declares the LORD. "Should I not avenge myself on such a nation as this?"

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, Inee, amang’ana aya nagwenerete gokwanwa: Omoika bw’Omonene nigo ore omwango kogechigwa? Oko nakwo ogokora kwaye? Inee! Amang’ana aane tari korenta amaya ase omonto ore nenkoro endonge?
english: Should it be said, O house of Jacob: "Is the Spirit of the LORD angry? Does he do such things?" "Do not my words do good to him whose ways are upright?

ekegusii: Aye buna omoirogete Nyasae, tori noboremu? Naende buna chinchera chiao chire chindonge, tori nogosemeria?
english: Should not your piety be your confidence and your blameless ways your hope?

ekegusii: Korende onye enyama eria embariri ekoonchoka ebe endabu, erio omonto oyio agende ase omokuani,
english: Should the raw flesh change and turn white, he must go to the priest.

ekegusii: Tomoe, gose titomoa?” Ere konya omanyire obong’ainereria bwabo, akabatebia: “Nase ki mogonteema? Yendetere ebesa inyerore!”
english: Should we pay or shouldn't we?" But Jesus knew their hypocrisy. "Why are you trying to trap me?" he asked. "Bring me a denarius and let me look at it."

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe timokonyiroka inche Omonene? Timokoiguswa ase obosio bwane? Nigo nabegete omokenye okaba orobebe rw’enyancha, egetango kia botambe enyancha etanyare gotamboka. Nonya nemerindo ekorotwoma, tekonyara korotagora. Nonya ekoimokerera igoro, tekonyara goeta orobebe roria.
english: Should you not fear me?" declares the LORD. "Should you not tremble in my presence? I made the sand a boundary for the sea, an everlasting barrier it cannot cross. The waves may roll, but they cannot prevail; they may roar, but they cannot cross it.

ekegusii: Inee! Aye nigo okwerigeria ebinto ebinene. Tobaisa kobirigia, ekiagera rora, inche nkorenta nde emechando igoro ase mwanyabanto bonsi, korende nintoorie obogima bwao toitwa ase esegi aase ande onsi oragende.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: Should you then seek great things for yourself? Seek them not. For I will bring disaster on all people, declares the LORD, but wherever you go I will let you escape with your life.'"

ekegusii: Inee! Chinsoko chiao nchigwenerete gwesiarera gochia aare, ne chindooche chiao chi’amache ase chinchera?
english: Should your springs overflow in the streets, your streams of water in the public squares?

ekegusii: Inee! Aye tikwagwenerete kwabera omosomba oria onde, buna nainche nakwaberete?
english: Shouldn't you have had mercy on your fellow servant just as I had on you?'

ekegusii: Imoka, aka eriogi ri’esegi ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi. Babeli bwerure omonyene; chiburi chiaye chiagure, chindwaki chiatagoirwe na koiyerigwa inse. Ekio negesiomba Omonene akorusia. Ase ayio, rusia egesiomba ase omochie oyio. Buna koreng’ana Babeli okorete moyokore boigo.
english: Shout against her on every side! She surrenders, her towers fall, her walls are torn down. Since this is the vengeance of the LORD, take vengeance on her; do to her as she has done to others.

ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete Sayoni, aka eriogi, motere nomogoko, ekiagera ere oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli nigo are omonene ase egati yaino.”
english: Shout aloud and sing for joy, people of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel among you."

ekegusii: Aye ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omogoko ase Omonene, tera ogotera kw’omogoko na motogie ase amariogi amanene.
english: Shout for joy to the LORD, all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;

ekegusii: Inwe igoro chionsi, tera nomogoko; naye ense, aka eriogo ri’omochengo; inwe ebitunwa, tera mono, ekiagera Omonene oremirie abanto baye, ororeire abachandegete baye amabera.
english: Shout for joy, O heavens; rejoice, O earth; burst into song, O mountains! For the LORD comforts his people and will have compassion on his afflicted ones.

ekegusii: bagaaka eriogi, bagateba, “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, tokonye! Omonto oyo nere oria okworokereria abanto ase kera ensemo mamincha y’egesaku giaito, na amachiko, na aase aiga. Kobua ase aya orentire Abagiriki ase Hekalu ime ogindirie aase aiga aachenu riko.”
english: shouting, "Men of Israel, help us! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against our people and our law and this place. And besides, he has brought Greeks into the temple area and defiled this holy place."

ekegusii: Tegerera moigwe amatera ’omogoko igoro y’obobui, ayio akorwa ase obomenyo bw’abanyene oboronge, agoteba, “Okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nigo kogokora amang’ana ’ogokumia.
english: Shouts of joy and victory resound in the tents of the righteous: "The LORD's right hand has done mighty things!

ekegusii: Timobaisa komororera amabera, korende morusie korwa ase Abaisraeli okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’omonto otarenge na komocha, erinde nebe buya asemore.
english: Show him no pity. You must purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, so that it may go well with you.

ekegusii: Show me the coin used for paying the tax." They brought him a denarius,
english: Inyorokia ebesa y’ebango.” Bakamorentera ebesa.

ekegusii: Omonene, imanyie chinchera chiao; inyorokererie oboeto bwao.
english: Show me your ways, O LORD, teach me your paths;

ekegusii: Timobaisa komororera amabera. Egesusuro nigo kerabe obogima ase obogima, eriso ase eriso na erino ase erino, okoboko ase okoboko na okogoro ase okogoro.
english: Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

ekegusii: Mosike abanto bonsi. Mwanche abamino. Moiroke Nyasae. Mosike omoruoti.
english: Show proper respect to everyone: Love the brotherhood of believers, fear God, honor the king.

ekegusii: Aye Omotooria bw’abagotamera okoboko kwao kwa borio korwa ase ababisa babo, oorokia obwanchani bwao bw’ogokumia.
english: Show the wonder of your great love, you who save by your right hand those who take refuge in you from their foes.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, otoorokerie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na otoe ogotooreka kwao.
english: Show us your unfailing love, O LORD, and grant us your salvation.

ekegusii: Sebueli, omomura o Gerisomu, mosinto o Musa, nere orenge omoteneneri omonene bwe chikungo chiria.
english: Shubael, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.

ekegusii: Sibekai korwa Husa, na Ilai korwa Ahohi;
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo bakobekwa ase riroba bareng’anetie, bagunda, na amakonde abatuba.
english: Side by side they lie in the dust, and worms cover them both.

ekegusii: Agaita Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamoni, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, na Ogi, omoruoti o Basani; boigo agasiria amaruoti onsi a Kanani.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan and all the kings of Canaan--

ekegusii: Oyomo obo nere Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori. Ere nigo amenyete Hesiboni, akagamba korwa Aroeri ore ensinyo ye rigoko ri’Arinoni, na korwa gati‐gati ye rigoko riria goika orooche rwa Yaboki, orore ribebe ri’Abaamoni. Ense eyio nekeng’ese kia Gileadi.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge-- from the middle of the gorge-- to the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites. This included half of Gilead.

ekegusii: Korende Sihoni tabegenete Abaisraeli, na tabaete ribaga baete ase ense yaye. Agasangereria abarwani baye, na barabwo bagatoora agwo Yahasi, bakarwania Abaisraeli.
english: Sihon, however, did not trust Israel to pass through his territory. He mustered all his men and encamped at Jahaz and fought with Israel.

ekegusii: Simeoni akamonyora, akamoagata ase amaboko aye, agatogia Nyasae, akabora,
english: Simeon took him in his arms and praised God, saying:

ekegusii: Boigo ase omokerubi o kabere, orobaba oromo rw’obotambe bw’amaboko atano rwaramboire rogaika enyasi ende y’enyomba, na orobaba ronde rw’obotambe buna obwo rogakunana norobaba rw’omokerubi bwe ritang’ani.
english: Similarly one wing of the second cherub was five cubits long and touched the other temple wall, and its other wing, also five cubits long, touched the wing of the first cherub.

ekegusii: Naboigo nabamura, obasorore babe aberendete ase onsi.
english: Similarly, encourage the young men to be self-controlled.

ekegusii: Similarly, if anyone competes as an athlete, he does not receive the victor's crown unless he competes according to the rules.
english: Omoamereria bwe chigosori takoegwa egutwa y’obobui ataamereraneti koreng’ana namachiko.

ekegusii: Simon (whom he named Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew,
english: Simion nere arogete Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo na Yohana, Filipo na Baritholomayo,

ekegusii: Simion na abarenge amo nere bakamotunyana,
english: Simon and his companions went to look for him,

ekegusii: Simion akamoiraneria, “Omonene, nabo twakorire emeremo obotuko obogima, titonyoreti gento, korende ase ring’ana riao natoikie ebionga.”
english: Simon answered, "Master, we've worked hard all night and haven't caught anything. But because you say so, I will let down the nets."

ekegusii: Simion otworokirie buna Nyasae ritang’ani acheire abanto b’Ebisaku, erinde achore abanto korwa asebare babogorie erieta riaye.
english: Simon has described to us how God at first showed his concern by taking from the Gentiles a people for himself.

ekegusii: Simon himself believed and was baptized. And he followed Philip everywhere, astonished by the great signs and miracles he saw.
english: Nonya n’Simion omonyene akeegena, na nyuma kabatisirwe akagenderera koba amo na Filipo. Ekero aroche ebikone na ogokora okonene gwe chinguru biakoretwe, agakumia.

ekegusii: Simion Petero na omworokigwa onde bagatunyana Yeso. Omworokigwa oria onde nigo amanyekanete nomokuani omonene, agasoa amo na Yeso ase egoora y’omokuani omonene,
english: Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Because this disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priest's courtyard,

ekegusii: Simion Petero akamoiraneria, “Omonene! Togende ase ng’o? Aye nore namang’ana ’obogima bwa kare na kare.
english: Simon Peter answered him, "Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.

ekegusii: Simon Peter answered, "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God."
english: Simion Petero akamoiraneria, “Aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasae ore moyo.”

ekegusii: Simion Petero akamoboria, “Omonene, ng’ai okogenda?” Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aase ngochia tokonyara gontunyana bono, korende nontunyane nyuma.”
english: Simon Peter asked him, "Lord, where are you going?" Jesus replied, "Where I am going, you cannot follow now, but you will follow later."

ekegusii: Erio Simion Petero akariina obwato ime, akang’usa ekeonga gochia engegu geichire chinswe chinene, rigana erimo, na emerongo etano, na isato; nonya chiarenge chinyinge buna iga, ekeonga tigiatandogete.
english: Simon Peter climbed aboard and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many the net was not torn.

ekegusii: Nabo Simion Petero akamosima, akamoboria, “Moborie ning’o atora?”
english: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, "Ask him which one he means."

ekegusii: Inche Simion Petero, omosomba na omotomwa o Yeso Kristo, nkobarikera nde inwe abamwanyorire okwegena okomo naintwe, okore kwe rigori rinene, goetera ase oboronge bwa Nyasae na Omotooria oito Yeso Kristo.
english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:

ekegusii: Simion Petero, na Tomas oyokorokwa Barongo, na Natanaeli o Kana ya Galili, na abamura ba Zebedi, na babere bande b’aborokigwa baye barenge amo.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas (called Didymus), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.

ekegusii: Simion akairaneria, “Igo ndabore ng’a, noria bwaberetwe ebinge.” Yeso akamotebia, “Kwanachire boronge.”
english: Simon replied, "I suppose the one who had the bigger debt canceled." "You have judged correctly," Jesus said.

ekegusii: Simon the Zealot and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
english: Simion, oyomo bw’Abazelote, na Yudas Iskariota, nere oyo omoruete.

ekegusii: Ng’ina biara Simion oraire, orwarete esosera. Erio kegima bakamotebia amang’ana igoro yaye.
english: Simon's mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they told Jesus about her.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aino abe: Ee, gose: Yaya; naki ayakomenteka ase aya, nigo akorwa ase oria omobe.
english: Simply let your 'Yes' be 'Yes,' and your 'No,' 'No'; anything beyond this comes from the evil one.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’omoruoti nigo rire nokobua. Ning’o oranyare komotebia, “Aye ngento ki eke ogokora?”
english: Since a king's word is supreme, who can say to him, "What are you doing?"

ekegusii: Naki omotang’ani bw’ekanisa nemogwenerete abe omonto otari ne chingencho chimbe, ekiagera ere nomoteneneri bw’ebire ebia Nyasae. Ere taba omonto okwegwenera ere omonyene, gose omwango bw’okobea, gose oyonarete edivai, gose omonto bwanchete goaka abanto, gose gwancha okonyora kw’oborianania,
english: Since an overseer is entrusted with God's work, he must be blameless-- not overbearing, not quick-tempered, not given to drunkenness, not violent, not pursuing dishonest gain.

ekegusii: Korwa amatuko a kare onde tana koigwa nogoto kwaye, gose korora neriso riaye, Nyasae onga buna aye ogokorera abwo bagosemeretie amaya.
english: Since ancient times no one has heard, no ear has perceived, no eye has seen any God besides you, who acts on behalf of those who wait for him.

ekegusii: Ekiagera Abaedomu barinete Abaisraeli ribaga goeta ase ense yabo, Abaisraeli bakarua asebare, bagaeta ensemo eng’ao.
english: Since Edom refused to let them go through their territory, Israel turned away from them.

ekegusii: Naboigo, ekiagera ebinto ebi bionsi nabisire, nebagwenerete inwe mobe abanto b’orogendo orochenu na abe chingencho chi’obonyasae.
english: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to live holy and godly lives

ekegusii: Ere nigo aigwete eriogi ri’egetureri, korende taigwera ogokurerwa okwo, ase ayio okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye nakobarwe igoro yaye. Korende karaigwere ogokurerwa okwo, natoorie obogima bwaye.
english: Since he heard the sound of the trumpet but did not take warning, his blood will be on his own head. If he had taken warning, he would have saved himself.

ekegusii: Ekero asinyetwe goakana, omonene oye agachika aoonigwe, ere na mokaye, na abana baye, na ebiabwate bionsi, na esira eria eakanwe.
english: Since he was not able to pay, the master ordered that he and his wife and his children and all that he had be sold to repay the debt.

ekegusii: Inche goika mbarwe ng’a nomokori amabe inde. Nase ki rende ngwechanda nemeremo ere bosa?
english: Since I am already found guilty, why should I struggle in vain?

ekegusii: Nigo yarenge engencho y’omoruoti arigie ogosemigwa korwa ase abanto abang’aini bamanyete amachiko, naende bamanyete kogamba ebina. Ase ayio akarangeria abanto abasemia, baria bamanyete ebimanyererio bie chingaki.
english: Since it was customary for the king to consult experts in matters of law and justice, he spoke with the wise men who understood the times

ekegusii: Rora, amanyinga aye tairetwe agwo Aase Aachenu; nigo yabagwenerete mokeriere agwo aase achenire.”
english: Since its blood was not taken into the Holy Place, you should have eaten the goat in the sanctuary area, as I commanded."

ekegusii: Ekiagera Yudas arenge kobogoria esanduku ye chibesa, baria bande bagakaga ng’a Yeso nigo are komotebia, “Gora ebitorigetie ase Rituko Rinene”, gose ng’a abae abataka egento.
english: Since Judas had charge of the money, some thought Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the Feast, or to give something to the poor.

ekegusii: ekiagera abange bagwetogia ase engencho yabo abanyene, na inche boigo ninyetogie).
english: Since many are boasting in the way the world does, I too will boast.

ekegusii: Ekiagera abanto abange ase omosangererekano konya tibarechena, Abalawi bakanyenya chimanwa chie ching’ondi chi’Epasaka ase bonsi abatachenegete ase okobaatanana na kobachena ase Omonene.
english: Since many in the crowd had not consecrated themselves, the Levites had to kill the Passover lambs for all those who were not ceremonially clean and could not consecrate [their lambs] to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’emechando y’abanto baane enkoro yane yachandekire. Nigo nkorera na kweumia, ekiagera naichoirwe nomoondoko.
english: Since my people are crushed, I am crushed; I mourn, and horror grips me.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, kwabeire gokonyorokereria korwa obwana bwane, goika rero iga ningenderere konakoraria ogokora kwao kw’ogokumia.
english: Since my youth, O God, you have taught me, and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.

ekegusii: Since no man knows the future, who can tell him what is to come?
english: Omonto tamanyeti ayagochia koba, na ning’o oranyare komotebia buna amang’ana arabe?

ekegusii: Since that time he waits for his enemies to be made his footstool,
english: Erio oganyete goika ababisa baye babekwe inse y’amagoro aye.

ekegusii: Na bono ekiagera Abaameleki na Abakanani bamenyete ime ase amakura, inwe ankio moonchoke, mochake koirana gochia ase enchera ekogenda ase omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri.”
english: Since the Amalekites and Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera abana babwataine ase amanyinga ne chinyama, Yeso naboigo abwataine nayio ayio, erio ase enchera y’amakweri asirie ere oyore nokobua igoro y’amakweri, engencho yaye Saitani,
english: Since the children have flesh and blood, he too shared in their humanity so that by his death he might destroy him who holds the power of death-- that is, the devil--

ekegusii: Korwa rituko riria nang’anyetie abanto baane Abaisraeli korwa Misiri, tinachorete omochie onde bwonsi ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli agwo ase nare koagacha enyomba, erinde erieta riane ribe aroro, korende nachorete Daudi agambere abanto baane Abaisraeli.”
english: 'Since the day I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built for my Name to be there, but I have chosen David to rule my people Israel.'

ekegusii: Korwa rituko riria nang’anyetie abanto baane korwa ase ense ya Misiri, tinachorete omochie onde bwonsi, ase egati y’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, agwo ase nare koagacha enyomba, erinde erieta riane ribe aroro, naende tinachorete omonto nonya noyomo koba omonene igoro ase abanto baane Abaisraeli,
english: 'Since the day I brought my people out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city in any tribe of Israel to have a temple built for my Name to be there, nor have I chosen anyone to be the leader over my people Israel.

ekegusii: Ekiagera ekiambokero eke tikiarenge ekiya ase abanto komenya aroro ekero ki’obokendu, abange babo bakarigia mono korua aroro, erinde keranyarekane, baike Foiniki na kobeera aroro ekero ki’obokendu. Na kerokio nekiambokero gia Kirete, kerigereretie gati ya irianyi ya bosongo na sugusu ya bosongo.
english: Since the harbor was unsuitable to winter in, the majority decided that we should sail on, hoping to reach Phoenix and winter there. This was a harbor in Crete, facing both southwest and northwest.

ekegusii: Korwa engaki eyio mobani onde tana gotoka ase Abaisraeli onga buna Musa, oria Omonene arenge gokwana nere obosio ase obosio.
english: Since then, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,

ekegusii: Naki Nyasae noyomo, oranyare koa baria barogete oboronge ase okwegena, na abwo batarogeti ase enchera y’okwegena.
english: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.

ekegusii: Ekiagera batanyarete komoika ang’e ase engencho y’omoganda, bakabochora ekerama aase aaria arenge. Kobakoorire kogetagora, bagaikia oborere boria oria orenge rigata araire.
english: Since they could not get him to Jesus because of the crowd, they made an opening in the roof above Jesus and, after digging through it, lowered the mat the paralyzed man was lying on.

ekegusii: Naki kobarabe tibamanyeti oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae, naende bakorigia goikerania oboronge bwabo abanyene, igo tibebegeti inse ase oboronge bwa Nyasae.
english: Since they did not know the righteousness that comes from God and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to God's righteousness.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagechete chisemi tibancheti komoiroka Omonene.
english: Since they hated knowledge and did not choose to fear the LORD,

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bambekeire oboreba bobisi engencho ende etaiyo, na bakunyire eirima ng’a basirie obogima bwane.
english: Since they hid their net for me without cause and without cause dug a pit for me,

ekegusii: Abanto abwo tibari kobara ng’a ogokora kw’Omonene, gose emeremo y’amaboko aye, negento; ase ayio nabaiyerie inse, takobaimokia naende.
english: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD and what his hands have done, he will tear them down and never build them up again.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakoorokia ng’a aya amachiko are korigia arikirwe ime ase chinkoro chiabo. Okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime nigo gokobabera kirori, na ebirengererio biabo nigo bikobasoera gose kobaegera.
english: since they show that the requirements of the law are written on their hearts, their consciences also bearing witness, and their thoughts now accusing, now even defending them.)

ekegusii: Na ekero baikaransire aroro amatuko amange, Festo agatebia omoruoti amang’ana igoro ya Paulo, agateba, “Nare aa omonto oyomo omosibwa, otigetwe na Feliki.
english: Since they were spending many days there, Festus discussed Paul's case with the king. He said: "There is a man here whom Felix left as a prisoner.

ekegusii: Tibancheti koigwera ring’ana riane ri’okobasemia nonya nerimo; nigo bachayete ogokurera kwane gwonsi.
english: since they would not accept my advice and spurned my rebuke,

ekegusii: Naboigo kobua mono, gatwaeirwe oboronge ase amanyinga aye, ere natotoorie korwa ase endamwamu ya Nyasae.
english: Since we have now been justified by his blood, how much more shall we be saved from God's wrath through him!

ekegusii: Abanchani baane, ekiagera tore ne chiira echio, twesibie intwe abanyene ogotacheneka kw’omobere na omoika, erio toikeranie obochenu ase okomoiroka Nyasae.
english: Since we have these promises, dear friends, let us purify ourselves from everything that contaminates body and spirit, perfecting holiness out of reverence for God.

ekegusii: Onye intwe twabeire moyo ase Omoika, togenderere boigo ase Omoika.
english: Since we live by the Spirit, let us keep in step with the Spirit.

ekegusii: Bono ayaranyare komanywa igoro ya Nyasae aorokigwe asebare, ekiagera Nyasae nabaorokeretie.
english: since what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.

ekegusii: ekiagera morigetie ekiorokererio gia Kristo ng’a ere nigo agokwana ime yaino. Ere tari omoreu asemore, korende nare ne chinguru ime asemore.
english: since you are demanding proof that Christ is speaking through me. He is not weak in dealing with you, but is powerful among you.

ekegusii: Na inwe nabo more nokorwanerera koria koria mwaroche asende, na koigwa ng’a ninde nakwo goika bono.
english: since you are going through the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.

ekegusii: Aye naye egetare kiane na eburi yane; ase engencho y’erieta riao ondaae na kondenda.
english: Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo more ab’engencho enene ase amaiso aane, mwabeire mosikire, nainche nigo mbanchete; ase ayio nindue abanto b’ebisaku basirigwe ribaga riaino, erinde obogima bwaino botoorigwe.
english: Since you are precious and honored in my sight, and because I love you, I will give men in exchange for you, and people in exchange for your life.

ekegusii: Onye mokomoroka Tata, ere oyoragambie kera omonto koreng’ana nogokora kwaye atari nogwanchereria, mogenderere nokoiroka ase ekero kiaino gi’okomenya aiga buna abaeti.
english: Since you call on a Father who judges each man's work impartially, live your lives as strangers here in reverent fear.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye timori konyara gokora nonya ne ring’ana erire rike buna eri, nase ki mogwechandera amang’ana ande?
english: Since you cannot do this very little thing, why do you worry about the rest?

ekegusii: Gaki, onye mwakure amo na Kristo, mwatigire amorokererio aye ritang’ani ay’ense, nase ki rende mogendererete buna nab’ense more? Nase ki naende mokoigwera amachiko buna ayio:
english: Since you died with Christ to the basic principles of this world, why, as though you still belonged to it, do you submit to its rules:

ekegusii: Ekiagera obwatete ring’ana riane ri’oboremereria, inche ninkorende korwa ase engaki y’ogoteemwa eyere ang’e gochera ense yonsi goteema abwo bamenyete ase ense.
english: Since you have kept my command to endure patiently, I will also keep you from the hour of trial that is going to come upon the whole world to test those who live on the earth.

ekegusii: Inwe timoraika ase morabe nobotoereru na ase ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino.
english: since you have not yet reached the resting place and the inheritance the LORD your God is giving you.

ekegusii: since you ignored all my advice and would not accept my rebuke,
english: Mwachayire ogosemia kwane gwonsi, gose onde tari oigwerete ogokurera kwane.

ekegusii: mokomanya ng’a namonyore omwando buna eng’eria korwa ase Omonene, ekiagera mogokorera Omonene Kristo.
english: since you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as a reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.

ekegusii: “Ekiagera inwe mosemeretie emeremo yaino, na obotenenku bwaino, inamwoswe moirwe ase obosomba, na enyasae eria Kemosi neirwe ase obosomba, amo nabakuani baye na abanene b’obogambi bwaye.
english: Since you trust in your deeds and riches, you too will be taken captive, and Chemosh will go into exile, together with his priests and officials.

ekegusii: Nabo gatwamanyire komoiroka Omonene, twateemire kong’usa abanto; korende twamanyekanire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na inche nasemeirie ng’a twamanyekanire ase okomanya gwe chinkoro chiaino ime boigo.
english: Since, then, we know what it is to fear the Lord, we try to persuade men. What we are is plain to God, and I hope it is also plain to your conscience.

ekegusii: Gaki, onye mwabokire amo na Kristo, rigia ayare igoro aase Kristo aikaransete ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae.
english: Since, then, you have been raised with Christ, set your hearts on things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

ekegusii: Inwe igoro chionsi, tera nomogoko, ekiagera Omonene oikeranirie ayio; naye ense yonsi, aka eriogi ri’omochengo! Inwe ebitunwa, na amanani, na kera omote ore aroro, tera nechinguru chinyinge, ekiagera Omonene obooririe abanto ba Yakobo, neorokie ase egati y’Abaisraeli ore nobonene.
english: Sing for joy, O heavens, for the LORD has done this; shout aloud, O earth beneath. Burst into song, you mountains, you forests and all your trees, for the LORD has redeemed Jacob, he displays his glory in Israel.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto abaronge, mochengere Omonene! Inwe abamore ne chinkoro chindonge goika motogie Omonene!
english: Sing joyfully to the LORD, you righteous; it is fitting for the upright to praise him.

ekegusii: Tera amatera ay’ogotogia Nyasae, tera amatera ay’ogotogia! Tera amatera ay’ogotogia omoruoti oito, tera amatera ay’ogotogia!
english: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.

ekegusii: Tera amatera ase ogotogia Omonene oyomenyete Sayoni! Tebia ebisaku bionsi ogokora kwaye okonene!
english: Sing praises to the LORD, enthroned in Zion; proclaim among the nations what he has done.

ekegusii: terera obonene bw’erieta riaye, moe obonene ase okomotogia!
english: Sing the glory of his name; make his praise glorious!

ekegusii: Inwe amaruoti are ase ense, tera motogie Nyasae; tera amatera ay’okomotogia Omonene!
english: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth, sing praise to the Lord, Selah

ekegusii: Moterere Nyasae, tera amatera agotogia erieta riaye. Moroiserie enchera ere agoetera ase chirooro. Erieta riaye n’Omonene, kabe nomochengo ase obosio bwaye!
english: Sing to God, sing praise to his name, extol him who rides on the clouds--his name is the LORD-- and rejoice before him.

ekegusii: Moterere ogotera okoyia, na kobugia ase eriogi rireng’aine buya na komochengera!
english: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully, and shout for joy.

ekegusii: Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia; raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia.
english: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

ekegusii: Terera Omonene, moterere amatera ay’okomotogia, raria ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia!
english: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogotera okoyia; motogie korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense! Inwe abaeti ase enyancha amo nebinto bionsi bire imeo, inwe abamomenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, motogie Omonene!
english: Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise from the ends of the earth, you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who live in them.

ekegusii: Moterere Omonene ogotera okoyia, aye ense yonsi, moterere Omonene!
english: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.

ekegusii: Moterere Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono; bugeria Nyasae oito amakano namariogi amaya!
english: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music to our God on the harp.

ekegusii: Moterere Omonene, momotogie! Ere otooririe obogima bw’abaremerwa na kobarusia ase amaboko ’abakori amabe.
english: Sing to the LORD! Give praise to the LORD! He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of the wicked.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, moterere Omonene! Raria ogotooreka kwaye rituko ase rituko!
english: Sing to the LORD, all the earth; proclaim his salvation day after day.

ekegusii: “Tera amatera ay’okomotogia Omonene, ekiagera okorire ayare amaya mono. Amang’ana ayio tiga amanyekane ase ense yonsi.
english: Sing to the LORD, for he has done glorious things; let this be known to all the world.

ekegusii: Moterere Omonene, motogie erieta riaye, mobe mokoraria ogotooreka kwaye rituko ase rituko.
english: Sing to the LORD, praise his name; proclaim his salvation day after day.

ekegusii: Inwe abachenu baye, tera amatera ay’okobaka Omonene, iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riaye richenu.
english: Sing to the LORD, you saints of his; praise his holy name.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, tera neriogi rinene! Inwe Abaisraeli, aka eriogi! Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, goka na gochenga ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi!
english: Sing, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!

ekegusii: Erio agasangereria chigari chiaye amagana kianda, amo nabarwani baye bonsi, korwa ase Haroseti, omochie bw’Ebisaku, gochia ase orooche rwa Kisoni.
english: Sisera gathered together his nine hundred iron chariots and all the men with him, from Harosheth Haggoyim to the Kishon River.

ekegusii: Sisera akaminyoka, agatamera eema ya Yaeli, moka Heberi Omokeni, ekiagera ase engaki eria Yabini, omoruoti o Hasori, na eamate ya Heberi Omokeni nigo barenge abasani.
english: Sisera, however, fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there were friendly relations between Jabin king of Hazor and the clan of Heber the Kenite.

ekegusii: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, "If anyone wants to be first, he must be the very last, and the servant of all."
english: Agaikaransa inse, akarangeria baria ikomi na babere, akabatebia, “Omonto origetie koba oyo bwe ritang’ani nabe oyo bw’omoerio kobua bonsi, omosomba o bonsi.”

ekegusii: Chinsagia isano nemo chibe chigosoka korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.
english: Six branches are to extend from the sides of the lampstand-- three on one side and three on the other.

ekegusii: Nigo kiare ne chinsagia isano nemo, chiasogete korwa ase ritina, isato korwa ase ensemo eyemo, na isato korwa ase ensemo ende.
english: Six branches extended from the sides of the lampstand-- three on one side and three on the other.

ekegusii: Nabo amatuko atano na rimo ritang’ani ri’Epasaka Yeso agaika Bethania, agwo aase Lazaro arenge, oria okwete, akabokigwa na Yeso.
english: Six days before the Passover, Jesus arrived at Bethany, where Lazarus lived, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.

ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo mobe mokoyesangereria. Ase rituko ria gatano na kabere n’Esabato, endagera eyio tegotoka ase rituko erio.”
english: Six days you are to gather it, but on the seventh day, the Sabbath, there will not be any."

ekegusii: Amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao yonsi,
english: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

ekegusii: Ase amatuko atano na rimo okore emeremo yao yonsi.
english: Six days you shall labor and do all your work,

ekegusii: Mbareo abakungu chiting’ana chi’omoruoti emerongo etano nomo, na abakungu ba sere‐sere emerongo etano na etato, boigo mbareo abaiseke abekungi abange batari kobareka.
english: Sixty queens there may be, and eighty concubines, and virgins beyond number;

ekegusii: slanderers, God-haters, insolent, arrogant and boastful; they invent ways of doing evil; they disobey their parents;
english: abaitania, abamogechete Nyasae, abachayi, abaenenu, abetogia, abaroisia amabe, abatari koigwera abaibori babo,

ekegusii: Erio oyenyenye na oitorore amanyinga aye ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: Slaughter it and take the blood and sprinkle it against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Erio oyenyenyere ase obosio bw’Omonene ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Slaughter it in the LORD's presence at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio oyenyenye, orusie amanyinga make, na ase amanyinga ayio ogindie mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kwa Haroni amo na mesia y’amato ’abamura baye; ogindie boigo ebiara ebinene bi’amaboko abo a borio, na ebiara ebinene bi’amagoro abo a borio. Oitorore amanyinga amatigari ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: Slaughter it, take some of its blood and put it on the lobes of the right ears of Aaron and his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then sprinkle blood against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Moite mosirie kegima abagaaka, na abamura, na abaiseke, na abana, amo nabakungu, korende timobaisa gokuna omonto obekeire ekemanyererio keria. Mochakere Aase aane Aachenu.” Ase ayio bagachaka goita abagaaka bateneine bosio bw’enyomba eria.
english: Slaughter old men, young men and maidens, women and children, but do not touch anyone who has the mark. Begin at my sanctuary." So they began with the elders who were in front of the temple.

ekegusii: Monyenye ching’ondi chi’Epasaka, naende mwechene abanyene na moroisie ching’ondi echio ase engencho y’abanto bamino, erinde mokore koreng’ana ne ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase Musa.”
english: Slaughter the Passover lambs, consecrate yourselves and prepare [the lambs] for your fellow countrymen, doing what the LORD commanded through Moses."

ekegusii: Abasomba nabwo bagotogambera, na onde tari ogototooria korwa ase amaboko abo.
english: Slaves rule over us, and there is none to free us from their hands.

ekegusii: Nainwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase ense eye ase amang’ana onsi, tari obosomba bw’okwegwenia ase amaiso a mwanyabanto, gose kogwenera abanto, korende ase enkoro endonge, mokomoiroka Omonene.
english: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything; and do it, not only when their eye is on you and to win their favor, but with sincerity of heart and reverence for the Lord.

ekegusii: Inwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase ense eye buna mokoigwera Kristo, ase obwoba na okoiguswa, na ase oboitongo bw’enkoro,
english: Slaves, obey your earthly masters with respect and fear, and with sincerity of heart, just as you would obey Christ.

ekegusii: Inwe abasomba, moigwere abanene baino ase okoiroka gwonsi, tari abwo boka abare abaya gose abororo, korende na abwo bare abatindi boigo.
english: Slaves, submit yourselves to your masters with all respect, not only to those who are good and considerate, but also to those who are harsh.

ekegusii: Erioki nigo rigosoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, buna enyongo ekobera egosokia omooki bw’amache.
english: Smoke pours from his nostrils as from a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

ekegusii: Erioki rigasoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, na omorero ogosamba korwa ase omonwa oye: ee, omorero bw’amakara ogasoka korwa asare.
english: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

ekegusii: Erioki rigasoka korwa ase chimioro chiaye, na omorero ogosamba ogasoka korwa ase omonwa oye; ee, omorero bw’amakara ogasoka korwa asare.
english: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

ekegusii: Korende motoorie abande ase okobataboria korwa ase omorero. Abande mobarorere amabera mobe nokoiroka, mogeche nonya neanga eria ebekire riko ri’okogania okobe kw’omobere.
english: snatch others from the fire and save them; to others show mercy, mixed with fear-- hating even the clothing stained by corrupted flesh.

ekegusii: Ase igo Haroni na abamura baye bagakora onsi aya Omonene achigete goetera ase Musa.
english: So Aaron and his sons did everything the LORD commanded through Moses.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Haroni agasuka gochia ang’e ase egesasimero, akanyenya emori eria ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye omonyene,
english: So Aaron came to the altar and slaughtered the calf as a sin offering for himself.

ekegusii: Haroni akaimokia orogio rwa ubani buna Musa amotebetie, akaminyoka gochia ase egati y’omoganda oria. Amaakwa konya achakire ase egati y’abanto, korende Haroni akabeka ubani ase orogio roria, agakora okobwatanigwa asebare.
english: So Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly. The plague had already started among the people, but Aaron offered the incense and made atonement for them.

ekegusii: Haroni akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’amache onsi a Misiri, na ebioto bigatiira, bigatuba ense eyio yonsi.
english: So Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land.

ekegusii: Abimeleki amo nabanto bonsi barenge komo bakaimoka botuko, bakebisa, bakaboera Sekemu, bare ebiombe bine.
english: So Abimelech and all his troops set out by night and took up concealed positions near Shechem in four companies.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Abimeleki agatianera abanto bonsi, akabatebia, “Monto onde bwensi aise gokuna omonto oyo ore aa, gose mokaye, goika aitwe.”
english: So Abimelech gave orders to all the people: "Anyone who molests this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."

ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarangeria Isaka, akamoboria, “Amaene, oyo mokao? Naki gwakora ogateba ng’a oyo mosubati omino?” Isaka akamoiraneria, “Nigo narengereretie ng’a, aande nimbaise goitwa ase engencho yaye.”
english: So Abimelech summoned Isaac and said, "She is really your wife! Why did you say, 'She is my sister'?" Isaac answered him, "Because I thought I might lose my life on account of her."

ekegusii: Ase igo abanto koreng’ana chilifu isato bagatiira kogendao, korende barabwo bagaserigwa nabanto ba Ai.
english: So about three thousand men went up; but they were routed by the men of Ai,

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu akaimokia ching’ondi ne chiombe, akaa Abimeleki, na barabwo babere bagakora okobwatana.
english: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelech, and the two men made a treaty.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akaroka aase aria Yahwe‐Yire; buna abanto bagokwana goika rero iga, “Ase egetunwa ki’Omonene nao ekonyorekana.”
english: So Abraham called that place The LORD Will Provide. And to this day it is said, "On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided."

ekegusii: Ase igo Ibrahimu akaayerera, agasoa eema ime ase Sara, akamotebia, “Renta bwango obosie, ebirengo bitato, obokonye, okore emegati.”
english: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah. "Quick," he said, "get three seahs of fine flour and knead it and bake some bread."

ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akaimoka, akagenda buna Omonene amotebetie, na Loti akagenda amo nere. Aburamu nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo etano na ebere, na etano (75), ekero arenge kong’anya korwa Harani.
english: So Abram left, as the LORD had told him; and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he set out from Haran.

ekegusii: Erio Aburamu akang’anyia eema yaye, agacha akamenya akanani k’emete enga buna emetontera agwo Mamure, ang’e na Heburoni. Akaagachera Omonene egesasimero aroro.
english: So Abram moved his tents and went to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar to the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio Aburamu agatebia Loti, “Tai buya twomane inche naye, abarisia baane na abao, ekiagera intwe nabanto abamo tore.
english: So Abram said to Lot, "Let's not have any quarreling between you and me, or between your herdsmen and mine, for we are brothers.

ekegusii: Aburamu akarua Misiri, akagenda Negebu, ere amo na mokaye na ebi bionsi abwate, na Loti akagenda amo nere.
english: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, with his wife and everything he had, and Lot went with him.

ekegusii: Ase igo abasomba b’Abisalomu bagakora Amunoni buna Abisalomu abachigete. Nyuma y’ayio abamura bonsi b’omoruoti bakaimoka, bakariina, kera omonto eyombo yaye, bagatama.
english: So Absalom's men did to Amnon what Absalom had ordered. Then all the king's sons got up, mounted their mules and fled.

ekegusii: Erio Akisi akarangeria Daudi, akamotebia, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, nigo ndoche buya ng’a ogende amo nainche ase esegi. Korwa ekero gwachete asende goika rituko ria rero tinana korora okomocha asore, korende nonya naboigo, abanene aba tibagwancheti.
english: So Achish called David and said to him, "As surely as the LORD lives, you have been reliable, and I would be pleased to have you serve with me in the army. From the day you came to me until now, I have found no fault in you, but the rulers don't approve of you.

ekegusii: Adoni‐Sedeki, omuruoti o Yerusalemu, agatoma abanto gochia ase Hohamu, omoruoti o Heburoni, na Piramu, omoruoti o Yarimuti, na Yafia, omoruoti o Lakisi, na Debiri, omoruoti bw’Egiloni, akabatebia,
english: So Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem appealed to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish and Debir king of Eglon.

ekegusii: Ase igo, nyuma Aburamu kamenyire ense ya Kanani emiaka ikomi, Sarai akaimokia Hagari, omosomba oye Omomisiri, akamomoa Aburamu, omosacha oye, ng’a abe mokaye o sere‐sere.
english: So after Abram had been living in Canaan ten years, Sarai his wife took her Egyptian maidservant Hagar and gave her to her husband to be his wife.

ekegusii: Naboigo kondaikeranie ring’ana eri na kobaa ebiegwa ebi biasangererigwe, ekero nabibekire ekemanyererio, ning’etere seino konde orogendo rwane gochia Hispania.
english: So after I have completed this task and have made sure that they have received this fruit, I will go to Spain and visit you on the way.

ekegusii: Erio kobakoorire okweng’ata na ogosaba bakababekera amaboko, bakabatiga bagende.
english: So after they had fasted and prayed, they placed their hands on them and sent them off.

ekegusii: Pilato akamoboria naende, akabora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Rora amang’ana aya amange bagosoeire.”
english: So again Pilate asked him, "Aren't you going to answer? See how many things they are accusing you of."

ekegusii: Ase igo Ahabu agatoma abanto bagasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi na ababani bonsi ba Baali amo, agwo ase egetunwa gia Karimeli.
english: So Ahab sent word throughout all Israel and assembled the prophets on Mount Carmel.

ekegusii: Erio Ahabu akaroberia abasomba baria abamura b’abagambi be chingongo, amagana abere, na emerongo etato, na babere (232); naende nyuma y’ayio akaroberia Abaisraeli bonsi, na barabwo nigo barenge chilifu isano na ibere (7,000).
english: So Ahab summoned the young officers of the provincial commanders, 232 men. Then he assembled the rest of the Israelites, 7,000 in all.

ekegusii: Ahabu akagenda inka bwoye nenkoro y’obororo, naende akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Naboti, Omoyesireeli oria, akanire ng’a takomoa omwando oye aetwe ne chisokoro chiaye. Ahabu akarara borere bwaye, akaonchora obosio bwaye gochia ase enyasi, akaba taria gento.
english: So Ahab went home, sullen and angry because Naboth the Jezreelite had said, "I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers." He lay on his bed sulking and refused to eat.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Ahabu akaimoka, akaria na akanywa, korende Elija agatiira gochia ase egetunwa gia Karimeli igoro, agatung’ama inse akaumama, akabeka obosio bwaye gati‐gati y’amaru aye.
english: So Ahab went off to eat and drink, but Elijah climbed to the top of Carmel, bent down to the ground and put his face between his knees.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli bonsi bakarenta Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene. Bagaaka amariogi ’omochengo, bakabugia chingoma na eoirombeta, ne chisani chigoakanigwa chikwoga, naende bakabugia mono namakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa.
english: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouts, with the sounding of rams' horns and trumpets, and of cymbals, and the playing of lyres and harps.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakaigwa amang’ana agokwanwa ng’a Saulo oitire omotang’ani bw’abarwani b’Abafilisti, naende ng’a Abaisraeli babeire okogechia ase Abafilisti. Abanto bakarangerigwa babwatane na Saulo bagende Giligali.
english: So all Israel heard the news: "Saul has attacked the Philistine outpost, and now Israel has become a stench to the Philistines." And the people were summoned to join Saul at Gilgal.

ekegusii: Korende kera oyomo bw’Abaisraeli, oyo oganetie gotieria obokombe bwaye, gose ekoyo, gose egesire, gose omoyio oye, goika agende ase Abafilisti.
english: So all Israel went down to the Philistines to have their plowshares, mattocks, axes and sickles sharpened.

ekegusii: Erio abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagasangererekana amo, bakagenda ase Samweli agwo Rama,
english: So all the elders of Israel gathered together and came to Samuel at Ramah.

ekegusii: Ase igo, kera oyomo ase abanto baria akagecha chinsagia chiaye; erio bagatunyana Abimeleki, bakabeka emete eria ang’e ase obotamero boria obokong’u, na kobotongia omorero, bakabosiria amo nabanto bonsi b’omorobiri oria. Abwo bonsi, abanto koreng’ana elifu eyemo, abasacha na abakungu, bagakwa.
english: So all the men cut branches and followed Abimelech. They piled them against the stronghold and set it on fire over the people inside. So all the people in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women, also died.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiga Daudi, bakabwatia Seba, mosinto o Bikiri; korende Abayuda bakabwatia omoruoti obo korwa Yorodan goika Yerusalemu.
english: So all the men of Israel deserted David to follow Sheba son of Bicri. But the men of Judah stayed by their king all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bagasangererekana, bakabwatana amo buna omonto oyomo, bakarwania omochie oria.
english: So all the men of Israel got together and united as one man against the city.

ekegusii: Abanene b’oboruoti amo nabanto bonsi abakorete okobwatana ng’a kera omonto asibore omosomba oye, omosacha gose omokungu, bakaigwa amang’ana ayio na bakabasibora.
english: So all the officials and people who entered into this covenant agreed that they would free their male and female slaves and no longer hold them in bondage. They agreed, and set them free.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakaamboka Yorodan, omoruoti nere akaamboka; erio omoruoti akanyunyunta Barisilai na komosesenia, ere akairana gochia inka bwoye.
english: So all the people crossed the Jordan, and then the king crossed over. The king kissed Barzillai and gave him his blessing, and Barzillai returned to his home.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakarusia ebigera bie chitahabu biare ase amato abo, bakamobiirera Haroni.
english: So all the people took off their earrings and brought them to Aaron.

ekegusii: Ase igo abanto bonsi bakagenda Giligali, na aroro agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene bakabeka Saulo akaba omoruoti. Boigo bakarua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Saulo amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakaba nomogoko omonene mono.
english: So all the people went to Gilgal and confirmed Saul as king in the presence of the LORD. There they sacrificed fellowship offerings before the LORD, and Saul and all the Israelites held a great celebration.

ekegusii: Erio abaroisia baria abang’aini, abarenge gokora emeremo ende yonsi ase Obomenyo boria Obochenu, nyuma kobatigire emeremo eye baare gokora bagacha ase Musa,
english: So all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work

ekegusii: (Ne chinsoko chiria chionsi abasomba ba Ibrahimu ise Isaka baremete, Abafilisti konya bachitichire namaroba.)
english: So all the wells that his father's servants had dug in the time of his father Abraham, the Philistines stopped up, filling them with earth.

ekegusii: Naboigo emeremo y’Obomenyo bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano egaikeranigwa n’Abaisraeli; bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: So all the work on the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: So also, the one with the two talents gained two more.
english: Naboigo noria oetwe chitalanta ibere akanyora ebitoki, chitalanta chinde ibere.

ekegusii: Nabo naintwe, ekero twarenge abana, nigo twarenge abasomba inse y’amorokererio aye ritang’ani ay’ense.
english: So also, when we were children, we were in slavery under the basic principles of the world.

ekegusii: Amasia akaa abarwani esegi barwete Efraimu ribaga bairane ase chinka chiabo, na barabwo bakaba nendamwamu enene ase Abayuda, bakairana bare nekeririanda ekenene.
english: So Amaziah dismissed the troops who had come to him from Ephraim and sent them home. They were furious with Judah and left for home in a great rage.

ekegusii: Agwo Amunoni akarara, agekora buna nomorwaire are. Ekero omoruoti achete korora Amunoni, nere akamotebia, “Koranche otebie Tamari ominto ache andoiserie emegati ebere aa ase ndoche, indie korwa ase okoboko kwaye.”
english: So Amnon lay down and pretended to be ill. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to him, "I would like my sister Tamar to come and make some special bread in my sight, so I may eat from her hand."

ekegusii: So arise, let us attack at night and destroy her fortresses!"
english: Imoka togende toyorwanie botuko, totagore chinyomba chiaye chi’oboruoti.”

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria omoruoti Yoramu akarua Samaria, akaroberia Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: So at that time King Joram set out from Samaria and mobilized all Israel.

ekegusii: Igo aya onsi ay’okomokorera Omonene nigo akoretwe ase rituko riria; nigo barendete Epasaka bakarua okoruegwa kw’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, buna Yosia omoruoti achigete.
english: So at that time the entire service of the LORD was carried out for the celebration of the Passover and the offering of burnt offerings on the altar of the LORD, as King Josiah had ordered.

ekegusii: “Ase engaki eria tokaira ense y’abaruoti baria babere b’Abaamori, ense yarenge moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodan, gochakera orooche rw’Arinoni goikera egetunwa kia Herimoni.
english: So at that time we took from these two kings of the Amorites the territory east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge as far as Mount Hermon.

ekegusii: Musa agatoma abanto korwa ase erooro ya Parani, buna Omonene amochigete. Abanto abwo bonsi nigo barenge abatang’ani ase Abaisraeli.
english: So at the LORD's command Moses sent them out from the Desert of Paran. All of them were leaders of the Israelites.

ekegusii: Ense y’Abakalidayo nesakorwe, nabwo bonsi bakoyesakora nabaisaneke nebisakorwa ebio.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: So Babylonia will be plundered; all who plunder her will have their fill," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Batiseba akagenda ase omoruoti, agasoa akanyomba k’omoruoti. (Bono omoruoti konya obeire omogotu mono, na Abisagi, Omosunemu, nere orenge omokoreri oye.)
english: So Bathsheba went to see the aged king in his room, where Abishag the Shunammite was attending him.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio morende na gokora aya Omonene, Nyasae oino, abachikire. Timoyatiga na koonchoka gochia aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee.
english: So be careful to do what the LORD your God has commanded you; do not turn aside to the right or to the left.

ekegusii: Ase ayio renda, moinyore ng’a ase emiaka etato, obotuko na omobaso, tinatigete gokurera kera omonto ase amariga.
english: So be on your guard! Remember that for three years I never stopped warning each of you night and day with tears.

ekegusii: Korende inwe mwerende! Rora, nakoorire koborokia onsi ritang’ani.
english: So be on your guard; I have told you everything ahead of time.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, mwerende, momwanche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: So be very careful to love the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Benaya akagenda ase Eema y’Omonene, agatebia Yoabu, “Omoruoti ogochikire osoke isiko.” Korende Yoabu agakana, “Yaya, aa nao ngokwera.” Benaya akagenda ase omoruoti, akamotebia amang’ana Yoabu atebete.
english: So Benaiah entered the tent of the LORD and said to Joab, "The king says, 'Come out!'" But he answered, "No, I will die here." Benaiah reported to the king, "This is how Joab answered me."

ekegusii: Erio Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akagenda, agaaka Yoabu, akamoita. Nere Yoabu agatindekwa ase enka yaye agwo ase erooro.
english: So Benaiah son of Jehoiada went up and struck down Joab and killed him, and he was buried on his own land in the desert.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire: Rora, amatuko ngocha are, aase aria atarokwe Tofeti, gose Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, korende ndirokwe Rikura ri’Okonyenyera. Abanto mbatindekwe agwo Tofeti, ekiagera aase ande tari.
english: So beware, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when people will no longer call it Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter, for they will bury the dead in Topheth until there is no more room.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire,” “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, aase aria atarokwe Tofeti, gose Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, korende nigo rirarokwe Rikura ri’Okonyenyera.
english: So beware, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when people will no longer call this place Topheth or the Valley of Ben Hinnom, but the Valley of Slaughter.

ekegusii: “Besaleli na Oholiabu amo nabaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene konya aeire obong’aini, abare nogwancha kw’ogokora emeremo ende yonsi egwenerete ase okoagacha Obomenyo Obochenu, goika bakore kera emeremo buna Omonene konya achikire.”
english: So Bezalel, Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the LORD has given skill and ability to know how to carry out all the work of constructing the sanctuary are to do the work just as the LORD has commanded."

ekegusii: Erio Boazi agakwana na Rutu, akamotebia, “Mwana one, ntegerera! Tobaisa kogenda gochora ebigara ebitigari ase omogondo omoao; obeere aa oka, obe gokobwatia abaiseke aba.
english: So Boaz said to Ruth, "My daughter, listen to me. Don't go and glean in another field and don't go away from here. Stay here with my servant girls.

ekegusii: Ase igo Boazi akaira Rutu, na ere akaba mokaye. Erio bakamenyana, na Omonene aganchera Rutu koba morito, na ere akaibora omwana omoisia.
english: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife. Then he went to her, and the LORD enabled her to conceive, and she gave birth to a son.

ekegusii: Naboigo abaiseke abwo babere ba Loti bakorete, bakaba barito korwa ase ise.
english: So both of Lot's daughters became pregnant by their father.

ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo babere bakeorokia ase Abafilisti abwo barenge ase eburi, na barabwo bagateba, “Rigereria, Abaibirania abwo bagosoka korwa ase chingoro ase bebisete.”
english: So both of them showed themselves to the Philistine outpost. "Look!" said the Philistines. "The Hebrews are crawling out of the holes they were hiding in."

ekegusii: Erio Kaini akarua ase obosio bw’Omonene, akagenda, akamenya ase ense ya Nodi, moocha ya Edeni.
english: So Cain went out from the LORD's presence and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

ekegusii: Naboigo na Kristo, ere teimokereretie igoro ere omonyene koba Omokuani Omonene, korende nigo abegetwe nere oyomotebetie, “Aye naye Omwana one, rero nakoiboire.”
english: So Christ also did not take upon himself the glory of becoming a high priest. But God said to him, "You are my Son; today I have become your Father."

ekegusii: naboigo Kristo nere, gakoorire koruegwa abe ekeng’wanso ara rimo ase okorusia ebibe bi’abanto abange, narorekane eria kabere, tari ase okobogoria ebibe, korende ase okonyorera abamoganyete ogotooreka.
english: so Christ was sacrificed once to take away the sins of many people; and he will appear a second time, not to bear sin, but to bring salvation to those who are waiting for him.

ekegusii: Bono Danieli oyio agasesenigwa akanyora okobua ase engaki y’okogamba kwa Dario na ey’ogwa Koresi Omoayemi.
english: So Daniel prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

ekegusii: Erio Danieli akarentwa ase obosio bw’omoruoti, na omoruoti akamoboria: “Inee! Naye Danieli oria, oyomo bw’abanto baria boosetwe korwa ase ense y’Abayuda, oria omoruoti tata arentete korwa ase ense eria?
english: So Daniel was brought before the king, and the king said to him, "Are you Daniel, one of the exiles my father the king brought from Judah?

ekegusii: Ase igo ase obotuko obwo Daudi na Abisai bakagenda agwo ase abanto b’egetwori keria, bakanyora Saulo oraire aase chigari chiabekire chikengete. Saulo nigo asimisetie ritimo riaye ang’e nomotwe oye, na Abineri na abarwani bande b’esegi nigo baraire, bamoetanaine.
english: So David and Abishai went to the army by night, and there was Saul, lying asleep inside the camp with his spear stuck in the ground near his head. Abner and the soldiers were lying around him.
