ekegusii: Erio Daudi na abanto bonsi barenge komo bakaimoka, bakaamboka Yorodan. Bogachia gokia, bonsi konya bambokire; onde tatigarete otambogete.
english: So David and all the people with him set out and crossed the Jordan. By daybreak, no one was left who had not crossed the Jordan.

ekegusii: Daudi na abanto baye bakaba bagendererete enchera yabo, na Simei nere okona‐goeta ensemo y’egetunwa, okoragereria; akamoruta amagena, na komosiarera ebuse.
english: So David and his men continued along the road while Shimei was going along the hillside opposite him, cursing as he went and throwing stones at him and showering him with dirt.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi amo nabanto baye bakaimoka mambia chuni, bagachaka orogendo rwabo, bakairana ase ense y’Abafilisti, korende Abafilisti bakagenda gochia Yesireeli.
english: So David and his men got up early in the morning to go back to the land of the Philistines, and the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi na abanto baye bakagenda Keila, bakarwania Abafilisti, bakababua. Bagaita Abafilisti abange mono, bagoosa chiombe chiabo. Igo Daudi agatooria abanto bamenyete agwo Keila.
english: So David and his men went to Keilah, fought the Philistines and carried off their livestock. He inflicted heavy losses on the Philistines and saved the people of Keilah.

ekegusii: Daudi akagenda goika Baali‐Perasimu, akababua agwo. Erio akabora, “Nyasae okoroorire ababisa baane goetera ase okoboko kwane, buna chiooro chi’amache are nemerindo chigokoroora.” Ase ayio bakaroka aase aria Baali‐Perasimu.
english: So David and his men went up to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, God has broken out against my enemies by my hand." So that place was called Baal Perazim.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi na abanto baria barenge komo bagaaka amariogi abo, bakarera mono goika chinguru chikabaerera.
english: So David and his men wept aloud until they had no strength left to weep.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi na abanto baye abarenge koreng’ana amagana atano na rimo, bakaimoka, bakarua agwo Keila, bakana‐koong’anya gochia aande onsi ase baare konyara kogenda.
english: So David and his men, about six hundred in number, left Keilah and kept moving from place to place. When Saul was told that David had escaped from Keilah, he did not go there.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu bakagenda kwoyia Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, korwa ase enyomba y’Obedi‐Edomu, bagachenga nomogoko omonene mono.
english: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of units of a thousand went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-Edom, with rejoicing.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akaimoka amo nabanto baye amagana atano na rimo, akagenda ase Akisi, mosinto o Maoki, omoruoti o Gati.
english: So David and the six hundred men with him left and went over to Achish son of Maoch king of Gath.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Sihori ya Misiri goika egesoero kia Hamati, erinde barente Esanduku eria ya Nyasae korwa Kiriati‐Yearimu.
english: So David assembled all the Israelites, from the Shihor River in Egypt to Lebo Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath Jearim.

ekegusii: Daudi agakora buna Nyasae amochigete, na barabwo bagaita abarwani b’Abafilisti korwa Gibeoni goikera Geseri.
english: So David did as God commanded him, and they struck down the Philistine army, all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.

ekegusii: Daudi agakora buna Omonene amotebetie, agaita Abafilisti korwa Geba goika Geseri.
english: So David did as the LORD commanded him, and he struck down the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to Gezer.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agachika abanto baye, barabwo bagaita Rekabu na Baana, bakababutora amaboko na amagoro, bakabasunga ang’e ne ritibo agwo Heburoni. Korende omotwe o Isi‐Boseti bakayoira, bakayotindeka ase embeera y’Abineri agwo Heburoni.
english: So David gave an order to his men, and they killed them. They cut off their hands and feet and hung the bodies by the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-Bosheth and buried it in Abner's tomb at Hebron.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi agatiana buna igo. Erio Saulo akagenda bwoye, na Daudi na abanto baye bakagenda komenya ase amakuruma ’egetare.
english: So David gave his oath to Saul. Then Saul returned home, but David and his men went up to the stronghold.

ekegusii: Daudi agachika abamenyi abarenge ase ense y’Abaisraeli basangererigwe amo, akababeka kobaacha amagena na koyaroisia ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: So David gave orders to assemble the aliens living in Israel, and from among them he appointed stonecutters to prepare dressed stone for building the house of God.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akebisa mogondo na ekero ki’Omotienyi Omoyia omoruoti agaikaransa koragera.
english: So David hid in the field, and when the New Moon festival came, the king sat down to eat.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aboretie Nyasae naende, Nyasae akamoiraneria, “Tobarwania esegi korwa aa, korende oetanane ogende obatubokere korwa nyuma ase emete ekorokwa balisamu ere.
english: so David inquired of God again, and God answered him, "Do not go straight up, but circle around them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.

ekegusii: Na Daudi akaboria Nyasae “Inee! Ndagenda korwania Abafilisti? Nobabeke ase amaboko aane gose?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, genda, nimbabeke ase amaboko ao.”
english: so David inquired of God: "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me?" The LORD answered him, "Go, I will hand them over to you."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaboria Omonene, “Inee! Ndagenda korwania Abafilisti? Nobabeke ase amaboko aane gose?” Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee genda, nimbabeke ase amaboko ao.”
english: so David inquired of the LORD, "Shall I go and attack the Philistines? Will you hand them over to me?" The LORD answered him, "Go, for I will surely hand the Philistines over to you."

ekegusii: Naende Daudi akaboria Omonene, nere akamokania, akamotebia, “Tobaumokera korwa aa, korende ogende obanaarie korwa nyuma, erio obatubokere korwa ase emete ereo ekorokwa balisamu.
english: so David inquired of the LORD, and he answered, "Do not go straight up, but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agasangereria abanto bonsi, akagenda Raba, akayorwania, akayobua na koyoira.
english: So David mustered the entire army and went to Rabbah, and attacked and captured it.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akaa Orinani etahabu y’oborito bwe chisekeli amagana atano na rimo agoakanera ekeooreri keria.
english: So David paid Araunah six hundred shekels of gold for the site.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agatebia Yoabu na abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi, “Genda mobare Abaisraeli korwa Beeri‐Seba goika Dani, erio mondetere amang’ana imanye omobaro obo.”
english: So David said to Joab and the commanders of the troops, "Go and count the Israelites from Beersheba to Dan. Then report back to me so that I may know how many there are."

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Yonathani, “Ankio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, nigo embetereretie ng’a ng’ikaranse koragera amo nomoruoti, korende ing’a ribaga ngende kwebisa agwo ase omogondo goika ankio ende mogoroba.
english: So David said, "Look, tomorrow is the New Moon festival, and I am supposed to dine with the king; but let me go and hide in the field until the evening of the day after tomorrow.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatoma amang’ana ase Yoabu akamotebia, “Toma Uria oyio Omohiti ache asende,” na Yoabu akamotoma ase Daudi.
english: So David sent this word to Joab: "Send me Uriah the Hittite." And Joab sent him to David.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Daudi akaimokia ritimo na ekerandi keria ki’amache korwa ensemo y’omotwe o Saulo. Erio Daudi na Abisai bakagenda. Monto onde taroche aya kagokorekana, gose koyamanya, na onde tatabobogete. Bonsi nigo baraire chitoro chindito, ekiagera Omonene abarenterete chitoro echio chindito.
english: So David took the spear and water jug near Saul's head, and they left. No one saw or knew about it, nor did anyone wake up. They were all sleeping, because the LORD had put them into a deep sleep.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akabua Omofilisti oria, akamoita ne rigena ri’enduruche atari nomoro koboko kwaye.
english: So David triumphed over the Philistine with a sling and a stone; without a sword in his hand he struck down the Philistine and killed him.

ekegusii: Daudi agacha Baali‐Perasimu, akababua agwo. Erio akabora, “Omonene okoroorire ababisa baane buna chiooro chi’amache are nemerindo.” Ase igo aase aria akarokwa Baali‐Perasimu.
english: So David went to Baal Perazim, and there he defeated them. He said, "As waters break out, the LORD has broken out against my enemies before me." So that place was called Baal Perazim.

ekegusii: Ase ogochika kw’Omonene koria Gadi amotebetie Daudi, Daudi agatiira.
english: So David went up in obedience to the word that Gad had spoken in the name of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi agatiira gochiao amo nabakungu baye babere, Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli, na Abigaeli, oyotigetwe omoboraka, orenge moka Nabali o Karimeli.
english: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the widow of Nabal of Carmel.

ekegusii: Ase igo Daudi akaigwera amang’ana aya Omonene achigete goetera ase Gadi.
english: So David went up, as the LORD had commanded through Gad.

ekegusii: Chinkuma chia Daudi chigasarera ase chinse chionsi; na Omonene akarentera abanto b’ebisaku bionsi obwoba, bakamoiroka.
english: So David's fame spread throughout every land, and the LORD made all the nations fear him.

ekegusii: Husai, omosani o Daudi, agasoa omochie o Yerusalemu ekero Abisalomu nere asoeteo.
english: So David's friend Hushai arrived at Jerusalem as Absalom was entering the city.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Delila agatebia Samison, “Koranche, ontebie obobisi bwe chinguru chiao, naende ontebie buna omonto aranyare kogosiba akobue.”
english: So Delilah said to Samson, "Tell me the secret of your great strength and how you can be tied up and subdued."

ekegusii: Erio Delila akaimokia chingori chinyia, akamosibera. Naende akamorangeria, “Samison! Abafilisti aba bachire gokobwata!” Abanto nigo bebisete baganyete ase enyomba ende. Korende Samison akabutora chingori chiria korwa ase amaboko aye buna eusi enyororo.
english: So Delilah took new ropes and tied him with them. Then, with men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the ropes off his arms as if they were threads.

ekegusii: Gaki, torora obosooku kobera Omonene oito kirori, gose tondorera inche, omosibwa oye, obosooku, korende nonya naye oremererie emechando ase engencho y’enchili, ase okobua kwa Nyasae,
english: So do not be ashamed to testify about our Lord, or ashamed of me his prisoner. But join with me in suffering for the gospel, by the power of God,

ekegusii: Ase ayio timoiroka, inche nigo inde amo nainwe, timoichana, inche ninche Nyasae oino; nimbabeke chinguru, mbakonye, nimbasiire nokoboko gw’okorio kw’oboronge bwane.
english: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, timobaisa koigwera ababani baino, gose abaringoria, gose abarogi bande bonsi, abwo bakobatebia ng’a timogochia komokorera omoruoti o Babeli.
english: So do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums or your sorcerers who tell you, 'You will not serve the king of Babylon.'

ekegusii: Ase ayio, timotuguta oboremu bwaino, ekiagera mbore neng’eria enene.
english: So do not throw away your confidence; it will be richly rewarded.

ekegusii: So do not worry, saying, 'What shall we eat?' or 'What shall we drink?' or 'What shall we wear?'
english: Gaki, timona gwechanda mogoteba: Ninki torarie? Gose: Ninki toranywe? Gose: Ninki torabeke?

ekegusii: Gaki kora ring’ana eri toragotebie. Mbare aiga asetore abanto bane abariete eira gete.
english: so do what we tell you. There are four men with us who have made a vow.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, timoiroka; inwe imobuete rigori rie chinchiro chinyinge.
english: So don't be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

ekegusii: Ase ayio kera omonto akaimokia orogio rwaye, akarobeka omorero, na igoro yaye ubani, bagacha bagatenena ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Musa na Haroni bagatenenenao boigo.
english: So each man took his censer, put fire and incense in it, and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Ebedi‐Meleki akagenda amo nabanto baria ase enyomba ase ekenunchi, inse ye rigachero, akarusia korwa aroro amachanchabe ne chianga chingotu, agachisiba chingori, agachitirimbokia gochia ase engoro inse ase Yeremia.
english: So Ebed-Melech took the men with him and went to a room under the treasury in the palace. He took some old rags and worn-out clothes from there and let them down with ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.

ekegusii: Nabo Eleazari omokuani akaimokia chindogio chiria chi’etaai, echio abanto baria omorero osambete konya barentire ase obosio bw’Omonene. Echio chikaroisigwa, chikaba ekemumeko ki’egesasimero.
english: So Eleazar the priest collected the bronze censers brought by those who had been burned up, and he had them hammered out to overlay the altar,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, agatebia Samweli, “Genda orare, na karakorangerie naende, okwane iga: Omonene kwana, inche omosomba oo ninyigwete.” Erio Samweli akagenda, akarara naende aase aye.
english: So Eli told Samuel, "Go and lie down, and if he calls you, say, 'Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening.'" So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

ekegusii: Elihu oyio, mosinto o Barakeli Omobusi, agateba: “Inche nigo inde omoke ase emiaka, korende inwe nabakoro more; ayio naro agerete nkaba nobwoba, ngakira‐kiri, na tinakwana ay’ebirengererio biane asemore.
english: So Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite said: "I am young in years, and you are old; that is why I was fearful, not daring to tell you what I know.

ekegusii: Ase ayio akarua agwo, akagenda akanyora Elisha, mosinto o Safati, okoremia chiombe; ebisangio bie chiombe ikomi na bibere nigo biarenge bosio bwaye. Ere omonyene nigo arenge negesangio gia ikomi na kabere. Elija agaeta agwo, akarutera Elisha egetambaa kiaye ambarete
english: So Elijah went from there and found Elisha son of Shaphat. He was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen, and he himself was driving the twelfth pair. Elijah went up to him and threw his cloak around him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Elija akagenda kweorokia ase Ahabu. Engaki eria enchara nigo yarenge endoro se agwo Samaria.
english: So Elijah went to present himself to Ahab. Now the famine was severe in Samaria,

ekegusii: Ase igo Elifasi Omotemani, na Bilidadi Omosua, na Sofari Omonama, bakagenda bagakora buna Omonene abachigete, na Omonene aganchera ogosaba kw’Ayubu.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite did what the LORD told them; and the LORD accepted Job's prayer.

ekegusii: Erio agatiga Elija, akairana, akanyenya chiombe chiaye ibere, akaiyeka chinyama ase omorero bw’amakorogoto aria, akaa abanto chinyama chiria, nabarabwo bakaria. Erio akaimoka akabwatia Elija, akaba okomokorera.
english: So Elisha left him and went back. He took his yoke of oxen and slaughtered them. He burned the plowing equipment to cook the meat and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he set out to follow Elijah and became his attendant.

ekegusii: Oboremo bw’Efuroni obwo bware agwo Makipela moocha ya Mamure, oboremo amo ne rikuruma riria riare imeo na emete yonsi yarengeo, ensemo eria yonsi Ibrahimu akayeegwa.
english: So Ephron's field in Machpelah near Mamre-- both the field and the cave in it, and all the trees within the borders of the field-- was deeded

ekegusii: Ase igo Esau, oyokorokwa naende Edomu, akaba okomenya ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Seiri.
english: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.

ekegusii: Nabo, nonya nabarikerete, tindigeti ase engencho yaye ere oyokorete bobe, gose tari ase engencho yaye ere oyokoreretwe bobe, korende ogwetigana kwaino asetore konyare koorokigwa asemore ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did the wrong or of the injured party, but rather that before God you could see for yourselves how devoted to us you are.

ekegusii: Erio Ezara akaimoka, akaboria abakuani abarenge abatang’ani, na Abalawi, na Abaisraeli bonsi, koria eira na gotiana ng’a mbakore buna batebetigwe. Ase ayio bakaria eira, bagatiana.
english: So Ezra rose up and put the leading priests and Levites and all Israel under oath to do what had been suggested. And they took the oath.

ekegusii: Na omorero ogaika korwa ase Omonene, okabasamba, barabwo bakayia, bagakwera agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: So fire came out from the presence of the LORD and consumed them, and they died before the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, korwa bono intwe titomanyeti monto onde koreng’ana buna mwanyabanto bamomanyete; nonya intwe twamomanyete Kristo ritang’ani buna mwanyabanto bamomanyete, korende bono titokomomanya buna igo.
english: So from now on we regard no one from a worldly point of view. Though we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.

ekegusii: Nabo korwa rituko riria bakarengereria buna baranyare komoita.
english: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.

ekegusii: Gaali agatang’ana abanto ba Sekemu, nabarabwo bakagenda bakarwania Abimeleki.
english: So Gaal led out the citizens of Shechem and fought Abimelech.

ekegusii: Erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi, akamomanyia amang’ana ayio, akamotebia, “Nigo origetie enchara eche ase ense yao emiaka etato? Gose nigo origetie otame korwa ase ababisa bao emetienyi etato? Gose nigo origetie oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita abanto bosoe ense yao amatuko atato? Bono rengereria mono na ong’e amairanerio imoirere oyio ontomete.”
english: So Gad went to David and said to him, "Shall there come upon you three years of famine in your land? Or three months of fleeing from your enemies while they pursue you? Or three days of plague in your land? Now then, think it over and decide how I should answer the one who sent me."

ekegusii: Erio Gadi akagenda ase Daudi akamotebia, “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Chora erimo eri oranche.
english: So Gad went to David and said to him, "This is what the LORD says: 'Take your choice:

ekegusii: Ase igo Gehasi akabwatia Naamani. Na ekero Naamani aroche omonto okominyoka korwa nyuma yaye, agaika korwa ase egari igoro, akagenda akaumerana nere, akamoboria, “Mang’ana ki aba?”
english: So Gehazi hurried after Naaman. When Naaman saw him running toward him, he got down from the chariot to meet him. "Is everything all right?" he asked.

ekegusii: Imoka, oike, ogende amo nabarabwo, toba ne chitang’u‐tang’u ekiagera ninche nabatoma.”
english: So get up and go downstairs. Do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them."

ekegusii: Erio Gidioni akaagachera Omonene egesasimero aroro agwo, agakeroka “Omonene nere Omorembe.” Egesasimero ekio nigo geteneine agwo Ofura, omochie bw’eamate y’Abieseri, nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: So Gideon built an altar to the LORD there and called it The LORD is Peace. To this day it stands in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

ekegusii: Nabo Gidioni akarusia asebare endagera eye babwate amo nebitureri, agatebia Abaisraeli bonsi, otatiga abwo amagana atato, bairane nka. Egetwori ki’Abamidiani nigo kiarenge maate yabo ase ense omweya.
english: So Gideon sent the rest of the Israelites to their tents but kept the three hundred, who took over the provisions and trumpets of the others. Now the camp of Midian lay below him in the valley.

ekegusii: Gidioni akaimoka amo nabasomba baye ikomi, agakora buna Omonene amotebetie. Bono ekiagera arenge nobwoba ase abanto b’eamate yaye, na ab’omochie obo, gokora aya ekero kia mobaso, akayakora botuko.
english: So Gideon took ten of his servants and did as the LORD told him. But because he was afraid of his family and the men of the town, he did it at night rather than in the daytime.

ekegusii: Ase igo Gidioni agatirimbokia abanto baria gochia rooche, na Omonene akamotebia, “Onde bwensi orabe ogosiara amache noromeme gochia monwa oye, buna esese egosiara, omobeke ensemo eyemo; na onde bwensi oratung’ame inse namaru konywa amache, omobeke ensemo eng’ao.”
english: So Gideon took the men down to the water. There the LORD told him, "Separate those who lap the water with their tongues like a dog from those who kneel down to drink."

ekegusii: Gaki, chika oboina borendwe buya goika rituko ria gatato, aborokigwa baye tibabaisa gocha komoiba, batebie abanto ng’a obokire korwa ase abakure; okong’aina kw’omoerio nakobue koria kwe ritang’ani.”
english: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, oite abana babo nenchara, orue abwo abanyene babugwe nababisa babo na baitwe nemioro; tiga abakungu babo bakwerwe nabana babo amo nabasacha babo, batigwe babe ababoraka. Abanto babo abasacha baitwe namarwaire, na abamura babo baitwe nemioro ase esegi.
english: So give their children over to famine; hand them over to the power of the sword. Let their wives be made childless and widows; let their men be put to death, their young men slain by the sword in battle.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ing’a inche, omosomba oo, okomanya kw’obong’aini gw’okogambera abanto bao, erio nario ndamanye gwatanana amaya na amabe. Naki ning’o oranyare kogambera abanto aba bao abange?”
english: So give your servant a discerning heart to govern your people and to distinguish between right and wrong. For who is able to govern this great people of yours?"

ekegusii: Nabo Nyasae agatonga mwanyabanto ase omogwekano oye omonyene; ase omogwekano o Nyasae ere akamotonga. Agatonga omosacha na omokungu.
english: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him; male and female he created them.

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agatonga ebitongwa ebinene bire ase amache ime, amo nebitongwa binde bionsi bire moyo, ebio bigoetanana ase obonge imeo; agatonga kera egesaku nengencho yaye. Agatonga ne chinyoni chibwate chimbaba, kera egesaku nengencho yaye. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.
english: So God created the great creatures of the sea and every living and moving thing with which the water teems, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.

ekegusii: So God has taken away your father's livestock and has given them to me.
english: Naboigo Nyasae akarusia etugo ya iso, akang’a inche.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akabaraa goetanana ase erooro gochia Enyancha Embariri. Na Abaisraeli bakarua ase ense ya Misiri bare nebirwanero bi’esegi.
english: So God led the people around by the desert road toward the Red Sea. The Israelites went up out of Egypt armed for battle.

ekegusii: So God looked on the Israelites and was concerned about them.
english: akarorera Abaisraeli amabeebe na kobechandera.

ekegusii: Igo Nyasae agakora eaanga eria, agaatanana amache ayare inse y’eaanga korwa ase amache ayare igoro y’eaanga; akaba boigo.
english: So God made the expanse and separated the water under the expanse from the water above it. And it was so.

ekegusii: Nyasae akamotebia, “Ekiagera kwaboririe ring’ana eri, na tibweborereti aye omonyene oegwe obogima obotambe, gose obonda obonge, gose ogosirigwa kw’obogima bw’ababisa bao, korende kwaboririe ng’a oegwe okomanya kw’obong’aini ase okomanyereria ayare amaronge,
english: So God said to him, "Since you have asked for this and not for long life or wealth for yourself, nor have asked for the death of your enemies but for discernment in administering justice,

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agatebia Nuhu, “Narorire ng’a ninkoore okobao kwa mwanyabanto bonsi, ekiagera baichoirie ense obotindi na oboregani, nimbasirie amo nense.
english: So God said to Noah, "I am going to put an end to all people, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. I am surely going to destroy both them and the earth.

ekegusii: Nyasae agatebia Nuhu, “Eke nakio ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana okwo nakorire egati yane na ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo ase ense.”
english: So God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant I have established between me and all life on the earth."

ekegusii: Nyasae agakorera abaiboria baria amaya, na abanto bakagenderera komenteka koba abange.
english: So God was kind to the midwives and the people increased and became even more numerous.

ekegusii: Erio Hagari akaiborera Aburamu omwana omoisia; nere akaroka omwana oria oye, Isumaeli.
english: So Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.

ekegusii: Ase igo Hamani akaimokia eanga eria akayebekera Moredekai, na akamoriinia ebarasi igoro, akamoetanania ase ekerario ki’omochie, akaba okoraria bosio bwaye, “Omonto oyio omoruoti anchete gosika igo arakorerwe buna iga.”
english: So Haman got the robe and the horse. He robed Mordecai, and led him on horseback through the city streets, proclaiming before him, "This is what is done for the man the king delights to honor!"

ekegusii: Ase igo Hamori na Sekemu, omomura oye, bakagenda ase egeita ki’omochie obo, bagakwana nabanto babo, bakabatebia,
english: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city to speak to their fellow townsmen.

ekegusii: Ase igo Hanuni akabwata abasomba abwo ba Daudi, akagingira chinderu chiabo ensemo eyemo, na akanacha chianga chiabo agachiikia ebinema, akabaseria bagende.
english: So Hanun seized David's men, shaved off half of each man's beard, cut off their garments in the middle at the buttocks, and sent them away.

ekegusii: Ase igo Hanuni akabwata abasomba ba Daudi akabagingira chinderu chiabo, na akabutora chianga chiabo chikaba ebimini, agachiikeria ebinema, erio akabaseria bakagenda.
english: So Hanun seized David's men, shaved them, cut off their garments in the middle at the buttocks, and sent them away.

ekegusii: Hataki akagenda ase Moredekai agwo ase eraaro y’omochie, bosio bw’egeita ki’enyomba y’omoruoti.
english: So Hathach went out to Mordecai in the open square of the city in front of the king's gate.

ekegusii: Omorendi oria akaigwera amang’ana aria abo, akabateema ase engaki y’amatuko ikomi.
english: So he agreed to this and tested them for ten days.

ekegusii: Hamani akairaneria omoruoti, “Oria omoruoti anchete gosika
english: So he answered the king, "For the man the king delights to honor,

ekegusii: Erio akaboria Yehosafati, “Nogende amo nainche, torwanie Ramoti o Gileadi?” Yehosafati akamoiraneria, “Ee, ningende amo naye, na abanto baane amo nabanto bao, ne chibarasi chiane amo ne chibarasi chiao.”
english: So he asked Jehoshaphat, "Will you go with me to fight against Ramoth Gilead?" Jehoshaphat replied to the king of Israel, "I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses."

ekegusii: Naende akaboria Yese, “Inee! Abamura bao bonsi nabwo aba?” Yese akamoiraneria, “Omoke omwabo nagatigarete korisia ching’ondi.” Erio Samweli agatebia Yese, “Toma omonto achie komorenta, titogoikaransa koragera ere ataracha aiga.”
english: So he asked Jesse, "Are these all the sons you have?" "There is still the youngest," Jesse answered, "but he is tending the sheep." Samuel said, "Send for him; we will not sit down until he arrives."

ekegusii: Ase igo akaboria abateneneri abwo ba Farao, abarenge amo nere ase egesibo ase enyomba y’omonene oye, akabora, “Naki moichanete iga rero?”
english: So he asked Pharaoh's officials who were in custody with him in his master's house, "Why are your faces so sad today?"

ekegusii: Agakoreka koba omonene kobua abamalaika, buna erieta eri anyorete ri’omwando rire rinene kobua ayabo.
english: So he became as much superior to the angels as the name he has inherited is superior to theirs.

ekegusii: Agatenena ang’e nere, agatogonyera esosera eria; ekamotiga. Bwango ere akaimoka akabakorera.
english: So he bent over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and began to wait on them.

ekegusii: So he built the temple and completed it, roofing it with beams and cedar planks.
english: Naboigo Sulemani akaagacha Hekalu, akayekoora. Akaroisia risang’ina ri’enyomba ne chibao chi’emecharake.

ekegusii: Akamorangeria, akamotebia: Ninki eke naigure asore? Orokia amang’ana ay’oborendi bwao, ekiagera tokonyara kogenderera koba omorendi.
english: So he called him in and asked him, 'What is this I hear about you? Give an account of your management, because you cannot be manager any longer.'

ekegusii: Akarangeria oyomo bw’abasomba, akamoboria amang’ana ayio, engencho yaye inki.
english: So he called one of the servants and asked him what was going on.

ekegusii: Akarangeria abanto ikomi korwa ase abasomba baye, akabaa ebirengo ikomi bie chiropia, akabatebia: Biire mobionchorerie goika ekero nkoirana.
english: So he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. 'Put this money to work,' he said, 'until I come back.'

ekegusii: Akarera, akabora: Tata Ibrahimu, indorera amabera, toma Lazaro atobeke ekiara kiaye mesia ase amache, akendie oromeme rwane, ekiagera nachandekire ase omorero oyo.
english: So he called to him, 'Father Abraham, have pity on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue, because I am in agony in this fire.'

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia akarangeria Yohanani, mosinto o Karea amo nabachiki bonsi b’abarwani esegi, abwo barenge amo nere, na abanto bonsi korwa omoke goika omonene,
english: So he called together Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him and all the people from the least to the greatest.

ekegusii: Agaika bwango, akamoroisia nomogoko.
english: So he came down at once and welcomed him gladly.

ekegusii: Igo agaika omochie o Samaria, okorokwa Sikari, ang’e nomogondo oria Yakobo aete Yusufu omwana oye;
english: So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.

ekegusii: Adonia agakwana, “Nagosabire, genda oborie omoruoti Sulemani ang’e Abisagi, Omosunemu oria, abe mokaane. Nimanyete ng’a takogokania.”
english: So he continued, "Please ask King Solomon-- he will not refuse you-- to give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife."

ekegusii: Ase ayio Elija akagenda, agakora buna ring’ana ri’Omonene riamochigete; akagenda akamenya agwo ase akarooche ga Keriti, moocha ya Yorodan.
english: So he did what the LORD had told him. He went to the Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan, and stayed there.

ekegusii: Ase igo Ahasia agakwa buna Omonene akwanete goetera ase Elija. Ahasia tabwate omwana omomura; ase igo Yoramu akaba omoruoti ase ribaga riaye, ase omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Yehoramu mosinto o Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: So he died, according to the word of the LORD that Elijah had spoken. Because Ahaziah had no son, Joram succeeded him as king in the second year of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.

ekegusii: Ase ayio agakoora amatuko abo, akayasiria, na emiaka yabo ekaera ase okoondokia.
english: So he ended their days in futility and their years in terror.

ekegusii: Agatama amo nenibo yaye yonsi eye abwate, akaamboka orooche roria Eufarati, akagenda gochia ebitunwa bia Gileadi.
english: So he fled with all he had, and crossing the River, he headed for the hill country of Gilead.

ekegusii: Ere akabaa egento baboretie baegwe, korende akabatomera oborwaire bw’okobareyia.
english: So he gave them what they asked for, but sent a wasting disease upon them.

ekegusii: Elija akaboka, akaria, akanywa, na ase chinguru chi’endagera eyio akayegendera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, agaika Horebu, egetunwa kia Nyasae.
english: So he got up and ate and drank. Strengthened by that food, he traveled forty days and forty nights until he reached Horeb, the mountain of God.

ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda ase ise. Agachia koba okare are, ise akamorora, akamororera amabera, akaminyoka, akamoboania rigoti, akamonyunyunta mono.
english: So he got up and went to his father. "But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him.

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa ase endagera, akabeka chianga chiaye ensemo, akabogoria egetambaa, akeboyia.
english: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

ekegusii: Akaimoka, akaira omwana amo na ng’ina, akagenda ase ense ya Israeli.
english: So he got up, took the child and his mother and went to the land of Israel.

ekegusii: So he got up, took the child and his mother during the night and left for Egypt,
english: Ere akaimoka botuko, akaira omwana oria na ng’ina, akagenda Misiri,

ekegusii: Farao akabeka egari yaye y’esegi ang’e, akaira abarwani baye amo nere.
english: So he had his chariot made ready and took his army with him.

ekegusii: Esanduku eria ekabogorigwa goetanana omochie ara rimo. Erio bonsi bakairana ase batoorete, bakabeerao obotuko boria.
english: So he had the ark of the LORD carried around the city, circling it once. Then the people returned to camp and spent the night there.

ekegusii: Akabaseria korwa ase ekegambero.
english: So he had them ejected from the court.

ekegusii: Erio kegima omoruoti agatoma omorwani oyomo, agachika ng’a omotwe o Yohana orentwe. Omorwani oria akagenda akamonacha omotwe aria echela ime,
english: So he immediately sent an executioner with orders to bring John's head. The man went, beheaded John in the prison,

ekegusii: Ase igo agatiga bionsi ebiarenge nabio ase amaboko a Yusufu; gose taba ogwechandera gento kende gionsi otatiga endagera yoka eria arenge koria. Yusufu nigo arenge omonto omerete buya, naende omonyakieni.
english: So he left in Joseph's care everything he had; with Joseph in charge, he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Now Joseph was well-built and handsome,

ekegusii: Akabatiga naende, akagenda, agasaba eria gatato agakwana amang’ana aria amatang’ani.
english: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.

ekegusii: Daudi agatiga ise na ng’ina bare agwo ase omoruoti o Moabu; barabwo bakagenderera komenya agwo ase engaki yonsi Daudi abete bwebisete ase rikuruma.
english: So he left them with the king of Moab, and they stayed with him as long as David was in the stronghold.

ekegusii: Agakora omocharichi bwe chingori, agasokia bonsi korwa ase Hekalu, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe; agaitera chibesa chiabo abaare koonchora chibesa, akaonchorana chimesa chiabo.
english: So he made a whip out of cords, and drove all from the temple area, both sheep and cattle; he scattered the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Hosea akagenda, akanyuoma Gomeri, omoiseke o Dibulaimu, na omokungu oyio akaba morito, akamoiborera omwana omoisa.
english: So he married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.

ekegusii: Naboigo akarenga chinsemo chionsi inye chi’aase aria. Orwaki nigo rwaetanaineo; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obwe chimoti amagana atano, na obogare bwaye boigo. Orwaki orwo nigo rwatananete aase aachenu korwa aase ataatananetwe abe aachenu.
english: So he measured the area on all four sides. It had a wall around it, five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide, to separate the holy from the common.

ekegusii: Agachika babatiswe ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo. Erio bakamoboria amente komenya amo nabarabwo amatuko atai make.
english: So he ordered that they be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked Peter to stay with them for a few days.

ekegusii: Nabo akaooma enyomba yonsi kegima netahabu; boigo akaooma egesasimero gi’Aase Aachenu netahabu.
english: So he overlaid the whole interior with gold. He also overlaid with gold the altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary.

ekegusii: Bakagenda, bagaeta ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na ense ya Salisa, korende tibachinyora. Naende bagaeta ase ense ya Saalimu, korende chitigere echio tichiarengeo. Nyuma y’ayio bagaeta ase orogongo rwa Benjamin, nonya naroro tibachinyora.
english: So he passed through the hill country of Ephraim and through the area around Shalisha, but they did not find them. They went on into the district of Shaalim, but the donkeys were not there. Then he passed through the territory of Benjamin, but they did not find them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akaumora ekeririanda kiaye ase abanto, akabaumorera endamwamu yaye egwoka, na esegi entindi. Abanto bakaba bagosambwa nomorero ase chinsemo chionsi, ko tibamanyete kende, ee, omorero oria okabasamba, korende tibarengereretie ayio ime ase chinkoro chiabo.
english: So he poured out on them his burning anger, the violence of war. It enveloped them in flames, yet they did not understand; it consumed them, but they did not take it to heart.

ekegusii: Ase igo omoruoti akabaroiseria omoyega omonene, na ekero bakoorire koria na konywa, akabaa ribaga, na barabwo bakagenda ase omonene obo. Abasiiria baria tibairanete naende nebiombe biabo korwania Abaisraeli.
english: So he prepared a great feast for them, and after they had finished eating and drinking, he sent them away, and they returned to their master. So the bands from Aram stopped raiding Israel's territory.

ekegusii: Ase igo akaonchora okoba gwe chingencho chiaye ase amasio abo, agekora buna ebarimo na kona‐koara ebisieri biabo; na agatiga amate akana‐konyororoka korwa monwa, agaitekera chinderu chiaye.
english: So he pretended to be insane in their presence; and while he was in their hands he acted like a madman, making marks on the doors of the gate and letting saliva run down his beard.

ekegusii: Abana baiboretwe korwa nyuma yabo konya batararokigwa kobare orogendo ase erooro, abwo nabwo Yoshua arogetie.
english: So he raised up their sons in their place, and these were the ones Joshua circumcised. They were still uncircumcised because they had not been circumcised on the way.

ekegusii: Agatang’ana bwango, akariina igoro ase omoko anyare komorora, ekiagera ngoetera arenge ase enchera eria.
english: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore-fig tree to see him, since Jesus was coming that way.

ekegusii: Nabo ase esinagogi agakwana n’Abayahudi na abanto abamoirogete Nyasae, na kera rituko ase echiiro nabaria abaare gocha aroro.
english: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the God-fearing Greeks, as well as in the marketplace day by day with those who happened to be there.

ekegusii: Ase igo Ahabu agatebia abanto baria Beni‐Hadadi atomete, “Motebie omonene one omoruoti ng’a ayio onsi aganetie ase engaki entang’ani ninyakore, korende aya a nyuma tinkoyakora.” Abanto baria Beni‐Hadadi atomete bakairana, bakamoirera amang’ana ayio.
english: So he replied to Ben-Hadad's messengers, "Tell my lord the king, 'Your servant will do all you demanded the first time, but this demand I cannot meet.'" They left and took the answer back to Ben-Hadad.

ekegusii: Akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Genda motebie Yohana ayamwarora na ayamwaigwa: Abarenge emeuko nkorora bare, abarenge amagata ngotaara bare, abarenge noborwaire bwa ukoma basibekire, abarenge emetino nkoigwa bare, abare ebitondo nkobokigwa bare, na abataka nkoranderigwa bare amang’ana amaya.
english: So he replied to the messengers, "Go back and report to John what you have seen and heard: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, those who have leprosy are cured, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.

ekegusii: Korende ere akairaneria ng’ina chibesa chiria. Ngi’na akaimokia chifeta amagana abere, agachiirera omoturi bwe chifeta, na ere akaroisia omogwekano obaachire na oomire ne chifeta. Omogwekano oyio okabekwa ase enyomba ya Mika.
english: So he returned the silver to his mother, and she took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a silversmith, who made them into the image and the idol. And they were put in Micah's house.

ekegusii: Akairana Yesireeli gochia korwarigwa chingoma chiria anyorete agwo Rama, ekero arwanete na Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria. Ahasia, mosinto o Yehoramu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akagenda korora Yoramu, mosinto bw’Ahabu, agwo Yesireeli, ekiagera nigo arenge omorwaire.
english: so he returned to Jezreel to recover from the wounds they had inflicted on him at Ramoth in his battle with Hazael king of Aram. Then Ahaziah son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to Jezreel to see Joram son of Ahab because he had been wounded.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akarengereria ng’a abasirie, korende Musa, omochore oye, agatenena ase obosio bwaye buna omobwatania, ase ogotanga endamwamu yaye teita abanto.
english: So he said he would destroy them-- had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him to keep his wrath from destroying them.

ekegusii: Ise akamotebia, “Genda bono orore gose abamino mbuya bare amo namaicho, na ondetere amang’ana.” Ase igo akamotoma korwa ase omweya o Heburoni, akagenda agaika Sekemu.
english: So he said to him, "Go and see if all is well with your brothers and with the flocks, and bring word back to me." Then he sent him off from the Valley of Hebron. When Joseph arrived at Shechem,

ekegusii: Omobani oria omogotu agatebia abamura baye, “Imbekere etigere egeikaransero.” Erio bakabekera etigere egeikaransero, na omobani oria akariina etigere eria,
english: So he said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me." And when they had saddled the donkey for him, he mounted it

ekegusii: Erio akairaneria, agantebia, “Eri nario ring’ana ri’Omonene riachierete Serubabeli, rikamotebia: Ayio tagokoreka ase chinguru, gose ase okobua kw’omonto, korende nase Omoika one. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
english: So he said to me, "This is the word of the LORD to Zerubbabel: 'Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit,' says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Agatebia omoroiseria bw’omogondo bw’emesabibu: Rora, emiaka eye etato nachire korigia amatunda ase omoko oyo, na tindanyora gento. Yonache! Nase ki ogosaria riroba?
english: So he said to the man who took care of the vineyard, 'For three years now I've been coming to look for fruit on this fig tree and haven't found any. Cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?'

ekegusii: Ase igo akabatebia, “Ekero ndachiche naende inde nobobui, nintagore omorobiri oyo.”
english: So he said to the men of Peniel, "When I return in triumph, I will tear down this tower."

ekegusii: Erio akabatebia, “Nase ki mogokora amang’ana buna ayio? Abanto bonsi bantebirie amabe aino mogokora.
english: So he said to them, "Why do you do such things? I hear from all the people about these wicked deeds of yours.

ekegusii: Ase igo Saulo agateba, “Ndetere aa ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na eki’omorembe.” Erio akarua ekeng’wanso keria ki’ogosambwa.
english: So he said, "Bring me the burnt offering and the fellowship offerings." And Saul offered up the burnt offering.

ekegusii: Erio akamboria, “Inee, kwamanyire ekiagera nacha aa asore? Bono nkoirana inde ngende korwania omogambi bw’Abaayemi, na ekero ndabe namobuire, erio agwo omogambi bw’Abagiriki nachiche.
english: So he said, "Do you know why I have come to you? Soon I will return to fight against the prince of Persia, and when I go, the prince of Greece will come;

ekegusii: So he said, "I am Abraham's servant.
english: Erio agateba, “Inche nomosomba o Ibrahimu.

ekegusii: Erio agantebia, “Aba nabwo abaakwa amaguta babere, abagotenena ase okomokorera Omonene bw’ense engima.”
english: So he said, "These are the two who are anointed to serve the Lord of all the earth."

ekegusii: Erio Yese agatoma omonto korenta omwana oria omoke, Omwana oria nigo arenge omobariri, obwate amaiso amaya, naende orenge omonyakieni. Omonene agatebia Samweli. “Omomura oria nere oyio, moake amaguta.”
english: So he sent and had him brought in. He was ruddy, with a fine appearance and handsome features. Then the LORD said, "Rise and anoint him; he is the one."

ekegusii: Ase ayio Saulo akamorusia korwa asare, akamobeka akaba omotang’ani bw’abarwani baye b’esegi elifu eyemo, na Daudi akaba ogotang’ana abanto aande onsi ase baare kogenda na koirana.
english: So he sent David away from him and gave him command over a thousand men, and David led the troops in their campaigns.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Saulo agatoma abanto boyie Daudi. Korende ekero abanto aba baigeteo, bakarora ekeombe ki’ababani bakobaboka ase okobana, na Samweli oteneineo buna omotang’ani obo. Omoika o Nyasae ogaika igoro asebare, nabarabwo boigo bagachaka kobana.
english: so he sent men to capture him. But when they saw a group of prophets prophesying, with Samuel standing there as their leader, the Spirit of God came upon Saul's men and they also prophesied.

ekegusii: Erio agatoma abamura ikomi ase Nabali, akabatebia, “Genda ase Nabali agwo Karimeli, momoirere ogokwania kwane,
english: So he sent ten young men and said to them, "Go up to Nabal at Carmel and greet him in my name.

ekegusii: Agatoma babere b’aborokigwa baye akabatebia, “Genda ase omochie na moumerane nomosacha obogoretie enyongo ere namache; momotunyane,
english: So he sent two of his disciples, telling them, "Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.

ekegusii: Akaborokia ase baranyare gosoera omochie oria. Barabwo bagaita abanto bande bonsi b’omochie nemioro, korende bagatiga omonto oria amo neamate yaye bare moyo.
english: So he showed them, and they put the city to the sword but spared the man and his whole family.

ekegusii: Akaimoka, akagenda. Na rora, ekero are inchera, akarora omonto bw’Etiopia, omogomba, oyobegetwe igoro y’enibo yonsi ya Kandake, eting’ana ya Etiopia. Ere nigo agendete Yerusalemu gosasima.
english: So he started out, and on his way he met an Ethiopian eunuch, an important official in charge of all the treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians. This man had gone to Jerusalem to worship,

ekegusii: Agwo Musa agatenena geita ki’egetwori, akabora, “Onde bwensi oyore ensemo y’Omonene ache aa asende.” Abalawi bonsi bagasangererekana asare.
english: So he stood at the entrance to the camp and said, "Whoever is for the LORD, come to me." And all the Levites rallied to him.

ekegusii: Agakanya chinkoro chiabo ase okobaa obokong’u, bakaiyerigwa inse, na monto onde tarengeo okobakonya.
english: So he subjected them to bitter labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

ekegusii: Ase ayio akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro yabo, agatiana ng’a abatige bakwere agwo ase erooro,
english: So he swore to them with uplifted hand that he would make them fall in the desert,

ekegusii: Ase igo omoerio akamotebia obobisi bwaye bwonsi, akabora, “Onde tana gokigita etukia y’omotwe one, ekiagera inche nigo naatananetwe ase Nyasae buna Omwerwa oye korwa ase enda ya baba. Inse gokigitwa etukia y’omotwe one, chinguru chiane nigo chirarue asende, naende imbe omworo, na imbe buna monto onde bwensi.”
english: So he told her everything. "No razor has ever been used on my head," he said, "because I have been a Nazirite set apart to God since birth. If my head were shaved, my strength would leave me, and I would become as weak as any other man."

ekegusii: Ase ayio agaetera enchera eng’ao, tairanera ase enchera eria acherete agwo Beteli.
english: So he took another road and did not return by the way he had come to Bethel.

ekegusii: So he took him into his house and fed his donkeys. After they had washed their feet, they had something to eat and drink.
english: Erio akabasoyia nyomba mwaye, akaa chitigere endagera. Na ekero besibirie amagoro abo, bakaria na konywa.

ekegusii: Erio akamoimokia, akamoira ase omotang’ani oria omonene, akamotebia, “Paulo, oria omosibwa nandangeria, omboria nkorentere omomura oyo, ekiagera nare ne ring’ana akogotebia.”
english: So he took him to the commander. The centurion said, "Paul, the prisoner, sent for me and asked me to bring this young man to you because he has something to tell you."

ekegusii: Akamoira goika ase omogondo o Sofimu agwo ase egechuria gia Pisiga. Agwo Balaki akaagacha ebisasimero bitano na bibere, akarua eeri eyemo na emingichi eyemo igoro ase kera egesasimero.
english: So he took him to the field of Zophim on the top of Pisgah, and there he built seven altars and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.

ekegusii: Ere akaimoka nabanto baye, akabaatanana ase ebiombe bitato, barabwo bakebisa na koboa ase egetii. Ekero aroche abanto bagosoka korwa ase omochie, agasoka korwa aase ebisete, akabaumokera na kobaita.
english: So he took his men, divided them into three companies and set an ambush in the fields. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he rose to attack them.

ekegusii: Agasoa ase chisinagogi chiabo ase ense yonsi ya Galili, okorandia na goseria ebirecha.
english: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.

ekegusii: So he went and got them and brought them to his mother, and she prepared some tasty food, just the way his father liked it.
english: Erio agwo akagenda, agachirentera ng’ina, na ere akaroisia endagera engiya, eria ise anchete.

ekegusii: Akagenda akabwatana nomonto oyomo bw’abanyene ense eria; ere akamoira ebitii biaye korageria chimbeche.
english: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him to his fields to feed pigs.

ekegusii: Baalamu akairana gochia ase Balaki, akamonyora oteneine mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, amo nabanene bonsi b’Abamoabu.
english: So he went back to him and found him standing beside his offering, with all the princes of Moab.

ekegusii: Ase igo akairana gochia ase Yuda, akamotebia, “Timonyoreti; naboigo nonya nabanto b’aase aria nigo bankania ng’a mokungu omotayayi tana kobao.”
english: So he went back to Judah and said, "I didn't find her. Besides, the men who lived there said, 'There hasn't been any shrine prostitute here.'"

ekegusii: Ase ayio agatirimboka, agasoa ase orooche rwa Yorodan ara gatano na kabere, buna omonto oria o Nyasae amotebetie. Omobere oye okairanerana okaba buna oyo bw’omwana omoke, ere agacheneka.
english: So he went down and dipped himself in the Jordan seven times, as the man of God had told him, and his flesh was restored and became clean like that of a young boy.

ekegusii: Akagenda akabwata ebibwe amagana atato, akabisiberania bibere bibere ase ebimincha biabo, erio agasiberania ebieri bi’omorero ase egati y’ebimincha biria bibere.
english: So he went out and caught three hundred foxes and tied them tail to tail in pairs. He then fastened a torch to every pair of tails,

ekegusii: Akamoika ang’e, akamoimokia ase okomobwata okoboko. Erio esosera ekamotiga na ere akabakorera.
english: So he went to her, took her hand and helped her up. The fever left her and she began to wait on them.

ekegusii: Baalamu akairana gochia ase Balaki, akamonyora oteneine mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, na abanene b’Abamoabu bateneine agwo amo nere. Balaki akamoboria, “Mang’ana ki Omonene akwanire?”
english: So he went to him and found him standing beside his offering, with the princes of Moab. Balak asked him, "What did the LORD say?"

ekegusii: Erio akamoika ang’e, akamonyunyunta. Isaka agatiokerera rimisu rie chianga chiaye, akamosesenia, akabora, “Naama! Rimisu ri’omwana one nigo rigotioka buna rimisu ri’omogondo omuya, osesenirie n’Omonene!
english: So he went to him and kissed him. When Isaac caught the smell of his clothes, he blessed him and said, "Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the LORD has blessed.

ekegusii: akagenda o Isumaeli, akanyuoma Mahalati, omoiseke o Isumaeli mosinto o Ibrahimu, mosubati omwabo Nebayoti, abe omokungu oye amo nabakungu baria bande abwate ritang’ani.
english: so he went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Ishmael son of Abraham, in addition to the wives he already had.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, akaimoka, akagenda Sarefata. Ekero aigete ang’e negeita ki’omochie, akarora omokungu omoboraka narengeo ogochora chinko. Elija akamorangeria, akamotebia, “Koranche ndetere amache make negetoono, inywe.”
english: So he went to Zarephath. When he came to the town gate, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and asked, "Would you bring me a little water in a jar so I may have a drink?"

ekegusii: Na ere oyoikaransete igoro ase riire riria agasoyia omoyio oye ase ense, na ense ekageswa.
english: So he who was seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

ekegusii: Erio nario abana baye barabe abachenu, tibasareka ase egati y’abanto baye, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
english: so he will not defile his offspring among his people. I am the LORD, who makes him holy. '"

ekegusii: ang’e rikuruma riaye, erio rire agwo Makipela, ase ensinyo y’oboremo bwaye. Ase rigori riikeranu tiga ang’ere ase amasio aino, togoranereo, ribe aase aane ndabe ngotindeka abakure.”
english: so he will sell me the cave of Machpelah, which belongs to him and is at the end of his field. Ask him to sell it to me for the full price as a burial site among you."

ekegusii: Beka chinko chinyinge, na omorero ogenderere gwoka mono, erinde oiyeke chinyama chiyie kegima, na omosori oyie oere, na amauga ayie arigise.
english: So heap on the wood and kindle the fire. Cook the meat well, mixing in the spices; and let the bones be charred.

ekegusii: Naboigo Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, Omokenisi, akaegwa Heburoni, okaba omwando oye. Nonya ndero iga ororeria rwaye narwo royobwate, ekiagera ere aigwerete Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: So Hebron has belonged to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite ever since, because he followed the LORD, the God of Israel, wholeheartedly.

ekegusii: Nabo oria Herodia akaba nokogecha asare, akarigia komoita, korende tanyara,
english: So Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she was not able to,

ekegusii: Hezekia akamoa chifeta chionsi chianyorekanete ime ase enyomba y’Omonene, na ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’omoruoti.
english: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the temple of the LORD and in the treasuries of the royal palace.

ekegusii: Erio Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, agatoma amang’ana gochia ase omoruoti bw’Abaasuri agwo Lakisi, akamotebia, “Nakorire okomocha; ntige, irana ogende; egento kende gionsi oramborie ningekore.” Na omoruoti bw’Abaasuri akagania korwa ase Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, chitalanta chie chifeta amagana atato, ne chitalanta chie chitahabu emerongo etato.
english: So Hezekiah king of Judah sent this message to the king of Assyria at Lachish: "I have done wrong. Withdraw from me, and I will pay whatever you demand of me." The king of Assyria exacted from Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

ekegusii: Erio agatoma amang’ana ase Sulemani, agateba, “Naigure amang’ana gwatomire asende; igo inde ang’e gokora onsi aya oganetie ase amang’ana ’emete emecharake na emetarakwa.
english: So Hiram sent word to Solomon: "I have received the message you sent me and will do all you want in providing the cedar and pine logs.

ekegusii: Omosomba agasokia Tamari, oria agasieka egesieri. Tamari nigo abegete eganchwa entambe, ekiagera chiganchwa buna echio nachio abaiseke abekungi b’omoruoti barenge kobeka.
english: So his servant put her out and bolted the door after her. She was wearing a richly ornamented robe, for this was the kind of garment the virgin daughters of the king wore.

ekegusii: Ase igo abasomba baye bakamotebia, “Tiga aye omonene oito omoruoti origerigwe omoiseke omwekungi; ere abe ogokorenda na kogokorera. Boigo abe ogokorarisia, akobekere riberera.”
english: So his servants said to him, "Let us look for a young virgin to attend the king and take care of him. She can lie beside him so that our lord the king may keep warm."

ekegusii: Ase ayio nainche nimbachorere amaakwa abo na kobarentera obwoba, ekiagera ekero nabarangeretie, onde taitabete, na ekero nakwanete, onde tategererete; nigo bakorete ayarenge amabe ase obosio bwane, nigo bachorete gokora aya atangogeti.”
english: so I also will choose harsh treatment for them and will bring upon them what they dread. For when I called, no one answered, when I spoke, no one listened. They did evil in my sight and chose what displeases me."

ekegusii: Ase ayio ningosirie kegima, aye Baasa amo nabanto b’enyomba yao ebe buna enyomba ya Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati.
english: So I am about to consume Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nkagora orokini buna Omonene anchigete, nkeboeria kenema kiane.
english: So I bought a belt, as the LORD directed, and put it around my waist.

ekegusii: Ase igo nkamogora chisekeli chie chifeta ikomi na isano, na esairi ebitonga ikomi na bitano.
english: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and about a homer and a lethek of barley.

ekegusii: Korwa ase Hanameli, momura o tata moke, nkagora omogondo orenge agwo Anatoti. Nkamorengera chibesa chisekeli chie chifeta ikomi, na isano na ibere.
english: so I bought the field at Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel and weighed out for him seventeen shekels of silver.

ekegusii: Ayio naro agera nacha gokorotota, nigo nakorigirie nomokia ng’a nkorore, na bono nakonyorire.
english: So I came out to meet you; I looked for you and have found you!

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkarua ogochika ng’a abanto abang’aini bonsi ba Babeli barentwe ase obosio bwane, erinde bantebie engencho ye chindoto chiria.
english: So I commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be brought before me to interpret the dream for me.

ekegusii: Ngatogia omogoko, na nkarora ng’a mwanyabanto tabwati gento kende kere ekiya aiga inse y’erioba, otatiga arie na anywe, na kwegokia nayio. Ayio naro aranyare kobeera asare ekero agendererete gokora emeremo emekong’u ase obogima obo are moyo, obo Nyasae amoeire aiga inse y’erioba.
english: So I commend the enjoyment of life, because nothing is better for a man under the sun than to eat and drink and be glad. Then joy will accompany him in his work all the days of the life God has given him under the sun.

ekegusii: Erio naende nkabatebia, “Amang’ana aya mogokora tari amaya. Inee! Tebagwenereti momoiroke Nyasae oito ase orogendo rwaino, erio nario abanto b’ebisaku, ababisa baito, batabe nengencho y’ogotochaya?
english: So I continued, "What you are doing is not right. Shouldn't you walk in the fear of our God to avoid the reproach of our Gentile enemies?

ekegusii: Ase igo, nanchire ababoraka batari nemiaka emenge banyuomwe, baibore abana, barende chinka chiabo, na tibaa moengereria onde ribaga ri’ogokwana bobe igoro asetore.
english: So I counsel younger widows to marry, to have children, to manage their homes and to give the enemy no opportunity for slander.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ngatiana ase endamwamu yane ng’a tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane.
english: So I declared on oath in my anger, "They shall never enter my rest."

ekegusii: buna natianire ase endamwamu yane: Tibagosoa ase ogotimoka kwane nonya ng’ake.”
english: So I declared on oath in my anger, 'They shall never enter my rest.'"

ekegusii: Inche ngakora buna nachigetwe; mobaso gati ngasokia ebinto biane isiko, nkaba buna nkong’anya inde, na riachia koba mogoroba, nkabochora enyasi namaboko aane. Ekero omosunte ochire, nkabeka ebinto biane ireko, nkagenda ekero abanto barigereretie.
english: So I did as I was commanded. During the day I brought out my things packed for exile. Then in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. I took my belongings out at dusk, carrying them on my shoulders while they watched.

ekegusii: Narorire ogochika oko, ng’a kondigetie gokora ekere ekiya, ekere ekebe nigo kenyesungetie.
english: So I find this law at work: When I want to do good, evil is right there with me.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabatiga babwatie obomwenu bwe chinkoro chiabo, erinde bakore buna koreng’ana konya barobeirie abanyene.
english: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.

ekegusii: Nkabaa ense ase motakorete emeremo, na emechie motaagachete. Nigo momenyete ase emechie eyio na koria okwama kw’emesabibu na okw’emezeituni motasimegete.
english: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities you did not build; and you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant.'

ekegusii: Erio nkaimoka, nkagenda aaria ase ense omweya, na obonene bw’Omonene bogatenena aroro buna boria konya narorire ang’e norooche rwa Kebari; ekero naboroche, ngatung’ama inse, nkaumama.
english: So I got up and went out to the plain. And the glory of the LORD was standing there, like the glory I had seen by the Kebar River, and I fell facedown.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkagecha obogima, ekiagera emeremo egokorwa inse y’erioba, nigo ekorenta obororo asende. Ayio onsi mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
english: So I hated life, because the work that is done under the sun was grievous to me. All of it is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

ekegusii: naboigo nainche ngendererete koba nobobe omotienyi ase omotienyi, na obotuko ase obotuko nigo inde ase emechando.
english: so I have been allotted months of futility, and nights of misery have been assigned to me.

ekegusii: Nigo naikire mbatoorie korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri, mbatiirie korwa ase ense eria, mbaire ase ense engiya engare, eyere entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, emenyire n’Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.
english: So I have come down to rescue them from the hand of the Egyptians and to bring them up out of that land into a good and spacious land, a land flowing with milk and honey-- the home of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

ekegusii: “Erio nkaroisia Esanduku ye chibao chi’omokonge, na nkabaacha chibao chi’amagena ibere chiagwekaine chiria chie ritang’ani; nkabogoria chibao chiria ibere ase okoboko kwane, ngatiira gochia ase egetunwa igoro.
english: So I made the ark out of acacia wood and chiseled out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I went up on the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.

ekegusii: Korende nkarengereria ase omoyo one, ng’a tingocha seino naende ase okobaichania.
english: So I made up my mind that I would not make another painful visit to you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ngaasamia omonwa one, na ere akang’a ebuku eria inyerie.
english: So I opened my mouth, and he gave me the scroll to eat.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkaba nkorisia riicho rie ching’ondi chiria chiarenge gochia konyenywa, ee, ching’ondi chiria chiachandegete. Nkaimokia chinyimbo ibere, eyemo nkayeroka “Ogwancherwa” na eyende “Obomo”. Erio nkaba nkorisia ching’ondi chiria.
english: So I pastured the flock marked for slaughter, particularly the oppressed of the flock. Then I took two staffs and called one Favor and the other Union, and I pastured the flock.

ekegusii: Nkaumora endamwamu yane asebare, ekiagera baiterete amanyinga ’abanto ase ense eye, na ekiagera bakorete ense ekaba eyetachenegeti ase ogosasima emegwekano.
english: So I poured out my wrath on them because they had shed blood in the land and because they had defiled it with their idols.

ekegusii: Erio nkabana buna Omonene anchigete. Omoika bw’obomoyo ogasoa ime yabo, barabwo bakaba moyo, bagatenena namagoro abo; nigo barenge omoganda omonene mono.
english: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and breath entered them; they came to life and stood up on their feet-- a vast army.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabana buna Omonene anchigete: na ekero nagendererete kobana, nkaigwa eriogi rinene riarenge negetitiro; amauga ayio agacha amo, riuga rikabwatana neriuga riamwabo.
english: So I prophesied as I was commanded. And as I was prophesying, there was a noise, a rattling sound, and the bones came together, bone to bone.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio nkabachena korwa ase kera egento kiarenge ekegeni, nkaroberia emeremo y’abakuani, na ey’Abalawi ekorwe boronge, erinde kera omonto amanye omoremo oye.
english: So I purified the priests and the Levites of everything foreign, and assigned them duties, each to his own task.

ekegusii: Erio nkomana nabanene nkababoria, “Nase ki enyomba ya Nyasae yatigirwe etarendiri?” Nkabasangereria na nkabeka kera omonto aase aye akore emeremo.
english: So I rebuked the officials and asked them, "Why is the house of God neglected?" Then I called them together and stationed them at their posts.

ekegusii: Nkarengereria igoro y’amang’ana aya onsi, ngateema komanya buna abanyene oboronge na abare nobong’aini bare ase okoboko kwa Nyasae, amo nogokora kwabo, gokorabe okw’obwanchani gose okw’okogecha. Monto onde tamanyeti amang’ana are bosio.
english: So I reflected on all this and concluded that the righteous and the wise and what they do are in God's hands, but no man knows whether love or hate awaits him.

ekegusii: Erio nkabairaneria, nkabatebia ng’a ring’ana ri’Omonene ndiacha asende, rigantebia:
english: So I said to them, "The word of the LORD came to me:

ekegusii: Erio ngateba, “Obong’aini nigo bore obuya mbobuete chinguru, nonya obong’aini bw’omonto oria omotaka bwachayetwe, na amang’ana aye tarenge koigwerwa.”
english: So I said, "Wisdom is better than strength." But the poor man's wisdom is despised, and his words are no longer heeded.

ekegusii: Nigo ngoteba, “Aye Nyasae one, takondusia aiga ekero inde ase egati‐gati y’obogima bwane. “Omonene, aye nigo oreo kare na kare, ase ebiaare bionsi.
english: So I said: "Do not take me away, O my God, in the midst of my days; your years go on through all generations.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkarora ng’a gento kende tikeri kere ekiya, otatiga omonto agokere emeremo yaye; ekio nakio egetari kiaye. Ning’o orachie komoirania ache korora na komanya ayakoregete nyuma yaye?
english: So I saw that there is nothing better for a man than to enjoy his work, because that is his lot. For who can bring him to see what will happen after him?

ekegusii: Ngateba, “Chinguru chiane chiaerire, na ogosemeria kwane ase Omonene boigo.”
english: So I say, "My splendor is gone and all that I had hoped from the LORD."

ekegusii: Gaki nigo nkobatebia, mogenderere ase Omoika na timogoikerania okogania gwe chingencho chiaino chi’ebibe.
english: So I say, live by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the sinful nature.

ekegusii: Erio bwango ngatoma abanto asore, na aye gwakorire buya gwachire. Na bono twensi nao tore aiga ase obosio bwa Nyasae, tonyare koigwa aya onsi Omonene agochikire gokwana.”
english: So I sent for you immediately, and it was good of you to come. Now we are all here in the presence of God to listen to everything the Lord has commanded you to tell us."

ekegusii: Erio ngatoma abanto asebare, nkabatebia, “Nigo ngokora emeremo ere emenene mono; tinkonyara gotirimboka gocha agwo. Nase ki ndatige emeremo etenene, ntirimboke gocha asemore?”
english: so I sent messengers to them with this reply: "I am carrying on a great project and cannot go down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and go down to you?"

ekegusii: Mambia rituko ria kabere ngakwana nabanto, na mogoroba yaye omokungu one agakwa. Rituko riare koribwatia ngakora buna konya nachikirwe.
english: So I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. The next morning I did as I had been commanded.

ekegusii: “Rora, naramboire okoboko kwane kogoaka, nakeeirie endagera yao, naende nakorure nakobekire ase abakungu b’Abafilisti, abwo bakogechete naende barorire obosooku ase ogokora kwao kw’obonyaka, erinde bagokore buna banchete.
english: So I stretched out my hand against you and reduced your territory; I gave you over to the greed of your enemies, the daughters of the Philistines, who were shocked by your lewd conduct.

ekegusii: Inche boigo nateemire koba nenkoro etari kongambia ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase obosio bw’abanto.
english: So I strive always to keep my conscience clear before God and man.

ekegusii: Erio ngatoma abanto korangeria Eliezeri na Arieli, Semaya na Elinatani, Yaribu na Elinatani, Nathani na Zakaria, na Mesualmu, abwo barenge abaraai b’abanto; boigo nkarangeria Yoyaribu na Elinatani, abarenge abanto abanyasemi.
english: So I summoned Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah and Meshullam, who were leaders, and Joiarib and Elnathan, who were men of learning,

ekegusii: Bono ngokwana nde ring’ana eri, na koba kirori ase Omonene, korwa bono timogenda buna abanto b’Ebisaku bakogenda ase ebirengorerio biabo bitari nengencho.
english: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord, that you must no longer live as the Gentiles do, in the futility of their thinking.

ekegusii: Nabo narorire ng’a ningwenerete ntebie abaminto aba bantang’ane gocha asemore, na koroisia bwango ekeegwa kiaino keria mwarierete eira y’okorua korwa kare, erinde kenyare koba ang’e, buna ekeegwa, gose tari buna egento gekorugwa ase obong’iti.
english: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you in advance and finish the arrangements for the generous gift you had promised. Then it will be ready as a generous gift, not as one grudgingly given.

ekegusii: Inche: nkabatebia: Onde bwensi obwate etahabu ayerusie. Barabwo bagachirusia, bagaching’a, na inche ngachiruta ase omorero ime, na emori eye ekabao.”
english: So I told them, 'Whoever has any gold jewelry, take it off.' Then they gave me the gold, and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf!"

ekegusii: Nkabatebia amang’ana ayio Omonene akwanete, korende mokaanga koigwera, mogasaria amang’ana Omonene abachigete, mokagenda nobomwenu ase ense eria y’ebitunwa.
english: So I told you, but you would not listen. You rebelled against the LORD's command and in your arrogance you marched up into the hill country.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkaimokia egekombe keria korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene, nkaa ebisaku bionsi ase antomete gochia, nkabinyoisia edivai eria y’endamwamu yaye.
english: So I took the cup from the LORD's hand and made all the nations to whom he sent me drink it:

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkabeka abanto baria bachoretwe korwa ase kera egesaku kiaino, abanto abang’aini, abamanyekanete buya, abaranyare gokora emeremo buya, babe abaraai baino: abande ase chilifu, na abande ase amagana, na abande ase emerongo etano, na abande ase ikomi. Naboigo nkababeka bakaba abateneneri b’ebisaku biaino bionsi.”
english: So I took the leading men of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them to have authority over you-- as commanders of thousands, of hundreds, of fifties and of tens and as tribal officials.

ekegusii: Nkabwata chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena ase amaboko aane, ngachiakera inse, ngachiatera agwo ase amasio aino.
english: So I took the two tablets and threw them out of my hands, breaking them to pieces before your eyes.

ekegusii: “Nkairana, ngatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa imbogoretie ase amaboko aane abere chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena chiarikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Egetunwa keria nigo kiarenge gwoka omorero.
english: So I turned and went down from the mountain while it was ablaze with fire. And the two tablets of the covenant were in my hands.

ekegusii: Erio ngachaka korengereria imanye, na gotuka, na korigia obong’aini, na komanya buna ebinto bionsi bire; naende nkagania komanya obobe bw’oboriri, na oboriri obore obobarimo.
english: So I turned my mind to understand, to investigate and to search out wisdom and the scheme of things and to understand the stupidity of wickedness and the madness of folly.

ekegusii: Erio nkamorigereria Omonene Nyasae, nkamorigia nogosaba, na okoboria kw’oboitongo, na ase okweng’ata, nkeboyia chigunia na kweaka ribu.
english: So I turned to the Lord God and pleaded with him in prayer and petition, in fasting, and in sackcloth and ashes.

ekegusii: So I was afraid and went out and hid your talent in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.'
english: erio nkoboa, nkagenda nkabisa etalanta yao inse. Nero eye.

ekegusii: Ngatigara inche bweka ndigereretie okorora koria, ne chinguru chikang’erera, ekieni kiane gekaonchoka gekarachoka, ne chinguru chionsi chikarua asende.
english: So I was left alone, gazing at this great vision; I had no strength left, my face turned deathly pale and I was helpless.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkorera ase engencho y’emesabibu ya Sibuma, buna aba Yaeseri bakoyereera. Inwe aba Hesiboni na ab’Eleale, nigo nkobaiyereria amariga amange, ekiagera ekero mogotora amatunda na kogesa endagera, eriogi ri’esegi riabachera.
english: So I weep, as Jazer weeps, for the vines of Sibmah. O Heshbon, O Elealeh, I drench you with tears! The shouts of joy over your ripened fruit and over your harvests have been stilled.

ekegusii: Nkagenda nkarobisa aase agwo buna Omonene anchigete.
english: So I went and hid it at Perath, as the LORD told me.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nkagenda ngaika ase enyomba eyio y’omokori chinyongo. Ere nigo arenge gokora emeremo ase emesa yaye y’okoroisia chinyongo.
english: So I went down to the potter's house, and I saw him working at the wheel.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ngasoa ime, nkarigereria enyasi chinsemo chionsi, nkarora kera egesaku gie ching’iti chi’okogechia, na emegwekano yonsi Abaisraeli bagosasima, biamang’eire ase chinyasi.
english: So I went in and looked, and I saw portrayed all over the walls all kinds of crawling things and detestable animals and all the idols of the house of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase ayio inche nkaira Yasania, omwana o Yeremia, mosinto o Habasinia, amo nabamura bamwabo, na abana baye bonsi, na abanto bonsi b’eamate y’Abarekabu.
english: So I went to get Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers and all his sons-- the whole family of the Recabites.

ekegusii: Nkagenda goika Eufarati, ngakunya aase narobisete, nkarorusia, nkanyora rwasarekire kegima na rororwo tirwagwenerete kende gionsi.
english: So I went to Perath and dug up the belt and took it from the place where I had hidden it, but now it was ruined and completely useless.

ekegusii: Nkagenda ase omomalaika oria nkamotebia, “Ing’a ebuku eyio enke.” Agantebia, “Yebogorie, oyerie; ero nekobekere obororo ase enda yao, korende ase omonwa oo nebe enyansu buna obooke.”
english: So I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, "Take it and eat it. It will turn your stomach sour, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatoma amo nainche abarwani esegi, na abariini chibarasi, akang’a rirube nkairera abagambi abarenge bosongo y’orooche roria, nkabaria.
english: So I went to the governors of Trans-Euphrates and gave them the king's letters. The king had also sent army officers and cavalry with me.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo nkagenda ase rikura, nkarata orwaki, erio nkairanera aase naeterete, ase Egeita kie Rikura, erio nkairana gochia aase narenge.
english: so I went up the valley by night, examining the wall. Finally, I turned back and reentered through the Valley Gate.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, tinkomocha kobainyoria amang’ana ayio botambe, nonya moyamanyete na mwabekirwe chinguru ase ekeene ekio mwanyorire.
english: So I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are firmly established in the truth you now have.

ekegusii: Rigereria, nimorute borere arware, na abwo batomanire amo nere banyore emechando emenene, bataonchogeti korwa ase ogokora kwaye.
english: So I will cast her on a bed of suffering, and I will make those who commit adultery with her suffer intensely, unless they repent of her ways.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nkaba buna endo asebare, nkababoera ase chinchera chiabo buna engo ekoboera.
english: So I will come upon them like a lion, like a leopard I will lurk by the path.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ngatiga abanene b’Aase Achenu bakaba abatachenegeti, nkarua abanto ba Yakobo bakaba okoragererigwa, ee, nkarua Abaisraeli ase ogochaywa.”
english: So I will disgrace the dignitaries of your temple, and I will consign Jacob to destruction and Israel to scorn.

ekegusii: Ninkong’ie okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania koria nakorete naye; erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: So I will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Ningende ase abanto abanene, nkwane nabarabwo, ekiagera barabwo mbamanyete enchera y’Omonene na ogochika kwa Nyasae obo.” Korende nabarabwo bonsi boigo konya babunire rikorogoto na kobutora ebisibo basiberetwe,
english: So I will go to the leaders and speak to them; surely they know the way of the LORD, the requirements of their God." But with one accord they too had broken off the yoke and torn off the bonds.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ninachere Abamisiri ekina; erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: So I will inflict punishment on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: So I will not look on them with pity or spare them, but I will bring down on their own heads what they have done."
english: Inche tinkoombia ng’a timbarochi, gose tinkobarorera amabera, goika mbaakane ogokora kwabo kobairanere.”

ekegusii: Ase ayio naumoire ekeririanda kiane igoro asebare; nabasiririe nomorero bw’endamwamu yane. Ogokora kwabo nkobairanere. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: So I will pour out my wrath on them and consume them with my fiery anger, bringing down on their own heads all they have done, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ninsirie obosooku na obonyaka bwao kwarentanete korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde tobaisa korigereria Abamisiri, gose koinyora ense eria naende.
english: So I will put a stop to the lewdness and prostitution you began in Egypt. You will not look on these things with longing or remember Egypt anymore.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio ning’umore endamwamu yane eerere ase okoiyeria orwaki roria na gosiria baria baroagete echooka eria. Erio nimbatebie: Orwaki roria tiroiyo, nonya mbaria baroagete echooka tibaiyo.
english: So I will spend my wrath against the wall and against those who covered it with whitewash. I will say to you, "The wall is gone and so are those who whitewashed it,

ekegusii: Inche nindambore okoboko kwane, ng’ake Abamisiri namaakwa ’ogokumia ndakore ase egati yabo. Erio nyuma babae ribaga mogende.
english: So I will stretch out my hand and strike the Egyptians with all the wonders that I will perform among them. After that, he will let you go.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nimbaserie morue ase ense eye, mogende ase ense inwe motamanyeti, gose chisokoro chiaino chitamanyete. Ase ense eyio namokorere chinyasae ching’ao omobaso na obotuko, gose tinkobarorera amabera.”
english: So I will throw you out of this land into a land neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.'

ekegusii: Ase omogoko omonge ninyebeke, naende ninyerue ase engencho y’emioyo yaino. Onye nkomenta kobancha mono, Inee, ningwenerete koremerwa obwanchani?
english: So I will very gladly spend for you everything I have and expend myself as well. If I love you more, will you love me less?

ekegusii: Gaki onye Nyasae obaeire barabwo ekeegwa keria keria atoete intwe, ekero twamwegenete Omonene Yeso Kristo, inche ninche ng’o, ndanyare koamereria Nyasae?”
english: So if God gave them the same gift as he gave us, who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to think that I could oppose God?"
