english: so that you, your children and their children after them may fear the LORD your God as long as you live by keeping all his decrees and commands that I give you, and so that you may enjoy long life.

ekegusii: Mogenderere buya, erinde monyore ogosika korwa ase abwo bare isiko, na timoba abamosemeretie gento korwa ase onde.
english: so that your daily life may win the respect of outsiders and so that you will not be dependent on anybody.

ekegusii: Erio nario inwe amo na abana baino moramenye amatuko amange ase ense eria Omonene arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabayee ebe eyabo. Nigo moragenderere komenyao ase engaki koreng’ana buna igoro egendererete koba igoro y’ense.
english: so that your days and the days of your children may be many in the land that the LORD swore to give your forefathers, as many as the days that the heavens are above the earth.

ekegusii: erinde okwegena kwaino tikoba ase obong’aini bwa mwanyabanto korende ase chinguru chia Nyasae.
english: so that your faith might not rest on men's wisdom, but on God's power.

ekegusii: so that your giving may be in secret. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
english: ebiegwa biao binyare koba bobisi; na Iso oo oyokorora bobisi nagoakane.”

ekegusii: erinde erieta riao ritogigwe kare na kare. Erio abanto bariatore botambe, bagoteba: Omonene bw’Emeganda, nere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli. Ase enchera eyio enyomba y’omosomba oo, inche Daudi, ekong’igwe ase obosio bwao.
english: so that your name will be great forever. Then men will say, 'The LORD Almighty is God over Israel!' And the house of your servant David will be established before you.

ekegusii: Rituko ria rero nakoyamanyirie, ee, nakoyamanyirie, erinde omosemerie Omonene.
english: So that your trust may be in the LORD, I teach you today, even you.

ekegusii: erio okorigereria nabarigererie, ko tibakorora, na okoigwa nabaigwe, ko tibakomanya; tibacha koonchoka, baaberwe ebibe biabo.”
english: so that, "'they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven!'"

ekegusii: erinde gatwanyorire oboronge ase amabera aye, tonyare koba abanyamwando b’obogima bwa kare na kare, obo tosemeretie.
english: so that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life.

ekegusii: erinde, buna ebibe biagambete ase amakweri, naboigo ase enchera y’oboronge amabera agambe goika obogima bwa kare na kare goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito.
english: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

ekegusii: Abanene baria bande, na abagambi baria abanene bakabwatana amo, bakagenda ase omoruoti, bakamotebia, “Aye omoruoti Dario, ochie kare!
english: So the administrators and the satraps went as a group to the king and said: "O King Darius, live forever!

ekegusii: omosangererekano ogatoma abanto abaremu mono chilifu ikomi na ibere, bakabachika, “Genda moite abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi nemioro, moite nabakungu na abana abasinini.
english: So the assembly sent twelve thousand fighting men with instructions to go to Jabesh Gilead and put to the sword those living there, including the women and children.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’omoganda bakamosokia isiko y’egetwori, bakamoaka amagena goika agakwa, buna Omonene achigete Musa.
english: So the assembly took him outside the camp and stoned him to death, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Ababenjamin bakairana ase engaki eria, na Abaisraeli bakaa abaiseke baria korwa Yabesi o Gileadi, bataitetwe babe abakungu babo; korende abwo tibabaisanete abasacha b’Ababenjamin.
english: So the Benjamites returned at that time and were given the women of Jabesh Gilead who had been spared. But there were not enough for all of them.

ekegusii: Omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa agatebia Yusufu okorota kwaye, akabora, “Ase okorota kwane nigo naroche omosabibu ore ase obosio bwane,
english: So the chief cupbearer told Joseph his dream. He said to him, "In my dream I saw a vine in front of me,

ekegusii: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
english: Abakuani abanene bagakora ekina baite Lazaro boigo,

ekegusii: Nabo chikanisa chikabekwa chinguru ase okwegena; omobaro obo okamentekana kera rituko.
english: So the churches were strengthened in the faith and grew daily in numbers.

ekegusii: Naki riire ri’Omonene nigo riare kobeera ase Obomenyo ekero kia mobaso, na ekero kia botuko omorero oba ase riire ime; na agwo Abaisraeli bonsi baba bakorirora aande onsi ase barenge ase orogendo rwabo.
english: So the cloud of the LORD was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel during all their travels.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omorugi oria bwe chindagera akaimokia ekenama keria ekiya, agakebeka bosio bwa Saulo. Samweli agatebia Saulo, “Rora egetari eke kiagachetwe, kiabekirwe ase obosio bwao; okerie, ekiagera naye gwakegacheretwe ng’a oche gokeria ase engaki eyio ekero abageni barangerigwe.” Ase igo Saulo akaragera na Samweli ase rituko erio.
english: So the cook took up the leg with what was on it and set it in front of Saul. Samuel said, "Here is what has been kept for you. Eat, because it was set aside for you for this occasion, from the time I said, 'I have invited guests.'" And Saul dined with Samuel that day.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto ba Dani bagachora korwa ase chiamate chiabo abarwani batano, korwa ase omochie o Sora, na obw’Esitaoli, bakabatoma bagende koroota ense, na koyerata. Ekero abanto baria chirooti baigete ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu bakagenda ase enyomba ya Mika, bakarara aroro.
english: So the Danites sent five warriors from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land and explore it. These men represented all their clans. They told them, "Go, explore the land." The men entered the hill country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah, where they spent the night.

ekegusii: Erio Abadani bakagenderera orogendo rwabo, na ekero Mika aroche ng’a abanto baria nigo barenge ne chinguru komobua, akeonchora akairana nka bwoye.
english: So the Danites went their way, and Micah, seeing that they were too strong for him, turned around and went back home.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ogochika gokaruegwa ng’a abanto abwo bonsi baitwe, na Danieli amo na baria bamwabo barigigwe baitwe boigo.
english: So the decree was issued to put the wise men to death, and men were sent to look for Daniel and his friends to put them to death.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni bakaegwa emechie eye: Heburoni, omochie bw’obotamero, na Libuna, amo namarisio aetanaineo, Yatiri na Esitemoa amo namarisio aetanaineo,
english: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), and Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,

ekegusii: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.
english: Aborokigwa bagakora buna bachigetwe na Yeso, bakaarigania Epasaka.

ekegusii: Na abanto b’omochie, na abagaaka, na abanene b’omochie oyio, bagakora buna Yesebeli abatebetie. Buna koreng’ana arikire ase amarube aria atomete asebare,
english: So the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth's city did as Jezebel directed in the letters she had written to them.

ekegusii: Abagaaka b’Abayahudi bakagenderera koagacha na konyora ogosesenigwa goetera ase obobani bwa Hagai na Zakaria bw’ororeria rwa Ido. Igo abanto bagakoora emeremo y’oboagacho obwo buna bachigetwe na Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, na buna Koresi, na Dario, na Aritasasita, abaruoti b’Abaayemi bachigete.
english: So the elders of the Jews continued to build and prosper under the preaching of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah, a descendant of Iddo. They finished building the temple according to the command of the God of Israel and the decrees of Cyrus, Darius and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia.

ekegusii: Abanto abairanete korwa ase obosomba bagakora buna batebetigwe. Ezara omokuani agachora abanto abarenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, oyomo oyomo korwa ase kera eamate, na bonsi bakarikwa amarieta abo. Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o ikomi, barabwo bagachaka gotuka amang’ana aria,
english: So the exiles did as was proposed. Ezra the priest selected men who were family heads, one from each family division, and all of them designated by name. On the first day of the tenth month they sat down to investigate the cases,

ekegusii: Nabo oboremo boria, ne rikuruma riria riare imeo, Ibrahimu akabinyora korwa ase Abahiti bibe aase aye agotindeka abakure.
english: So the field and the cave in it were deeded to Abraham by the Hittites as a burial site.

ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batano bakarua aroro, bakagenda goika omochie o Laisi. Na agwo bakarora buna abanto bamenyete bare nobogima botari nobwoba, buna abanto ba Sidoni. Nigo barenge abanto abatoereru na ab’omorembe, bataremeiri gento korwa ase riroba. Nigo bamenyete are korwa ase Abasidoni, naende tibarenge gosanga nabanto bande.
english: So the five men left and came to Laish, where they saw that the people were living in safety, like the Sidonians, unsuspecting and secure. And since their land lacked nothing, they were prosperous. Also, they lived a long way from the Sidonians and had no relationship with anyone else.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli agaseegeta omoika o Puli, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri (nere Tiligati‐Pileseri), na Puli oyio akaira abanto b’ororeria rwa Reuben, na ab’orwa Gadi, na ekeng’ese ki ’egesaku kia Manase goika Hala na Habori, na Hara, na goika ase orooche rwa Goseni; nao bare goika rero iga.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria (that is, Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria), who took the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile. He took them to Halah, Habor, Hara and the river of Gozan, where they are to this day.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omorendi oria akabatiga tibaria endagera eria, na tibanywa edivai eria, bachikeretwe, akaba okobaa chindagera chikwama korwa ase riroba.
english: So the guard took away their choice food and the wine they were to drink and gave them vegetables instead.

ekegusii: Nabo Abaisraeli baete Abalawi emechie eyio amo namarisio arengeo, ase ogoaka obomera, buna Omonene konya achikire goetera ase Musa.
english: So the Israelites allotted to the Levites these towns and their pasturelands, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora buna Yoshua abachigete. Bakaimokia amagena ikomi na abere korwa Yorodan, erimo ase kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli, buna Omonene konya atebereirie Yoshua, bakayaira ase baare gochia gotoora, bakayabeka inse.
english: So the Israelites did as Joshua commanded them. They took twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan, according to the number of the tribes of the Israelites, as the LORD had told Joshua; and they carried them over with them to their camp, where they put them down.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora onsi buna Omonene konya achikire Musa. Bagatoora inse ye chibendera chiabo, naende kobakogenda orogendo, bakagenda kera oyomo amo neamate yaye, na enyomba yaye.
english: So the Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses; that is the way they encamped under their standards, and that is the way they set out, each with his clan and family.

ekegusii: Naboigo Abaisraeli baatananete ense ase ogoaka obomera, buna Omonene achigete Musa.
english: So the Israelites divided the land, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

ekegusii: So the Israelites gave the Levites these towns and their pasturelands.
english: Naboigo Abaisraeli baete Abalawi emechie amo namarisio aetanaineo.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarusia korwa asebare chinyasae chiria Baali na Asitaroti, bakamokorera Omonene bweka.
english: So the Israelites put away their Baals and Ashtoreths, and served the LORD only.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatoma Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, omokuani, gochia ase abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben na ekia Dani amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, ase ense ya Gileadi.
english: So the Israelites sent Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, to the land of Gilead-- to Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli bakamanora, bakagenda, na ase rituko ria gatato bagaika emechie yabo: Gibeoni, na Kefira, na Beroti, na Kiriati‐Yearimu.
english: So the Israelites set out and on the third day came to their cities: Gibeon, Kephirah, Beeroth and Kiriath Jearim.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakarusia ebinto biria bechaberete, na tibabibeka korwa ekero batigete egetunwa kia Horebu kobagendererete ase orogendo rwabo.
english: So the Israelites stripped off their ornaments at Mount Horeb.

ekegusii: Chinyama chie chimanwa chiria nigo chiarietwe n’Abaisraeli baria bairanete korwa ase obosomba, boigo na kera omonto bweatananete korwa ase ogosaria kw’abanto b’ebisaku b’ense eria na kobwatana n’Abaisraeli ase ogosasima Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: So the Israelites who had returned from the exile ate it, together with all who had separated themselves from the unclean practices of their Gentile neighbors in order to seek the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abayahudi bagancha kwenaria gokora buna bachagete, na buna Moredekai abarikerete bakore.
english: So the Jews agreed to continue the celebration they had begun, doing what Mordecai had written to them.

ekegusii: Ase igo, omoruoti na Hamani bakagenda koria endagera amo n’Esteri eting’ana.
english: So the king and Haman went to dine with Queen Esther,

ekegusii: Ase ayio omoruoti akamboria, “Nase ki okororekana kore nomoichano iga, naye tori omorwaire? Ekio tikeri egento ekeao otatiga obororo bore ase enkoro yao.” Ekero akwanete igo, nkaba nobwoba obonene mono,
english: so the king asked me, "Why does your face look so sad when you are not ill? This can be nothing but sadness of heart." I was very much afraid,

ekegusii: Omoruoti agachika ayio akorwe; ogochika okwo gokararigwa agwo Susa, na abamura baria ikomi ba Hamani bagatongwa ase chimbambo igoro.
english: So the king commanded that this be done. An edict was issued in Susa, and they hanged the ten sons of Haman.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omoruoti taigwerete amang’ana ’abanto. Ayio nigo akorekanete na Nyasae, erinde Omonene anyare goikerania ring’ana riria akwanete ase Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, goetera ase Ahiya, omobani oria korwa Silo.
english: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from God, to fulfill the word the LORD had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omoruoti taigwerete amang’ana ’abanto. Ayio nigo akorekanete n’Omonene, erinde ere anyare goikerania ring’ana riaye riria akwanete ase Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, goetera ase Ahiya, omobani oria korwa Silo.
english: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events was from the LORD, to fulfill the word the LORD had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agakwa, akairwa Samaria, agatindekwa aroro.
english: So the king died and was brought to Samaria, and they buried him there.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti akarua ogochika ng’a Danieli arentwe. Danieli akarentwa, akarutwa ase engoro ye chindo. Omoruoti agatebia Danieli, “Nyasae oo, oria ogokorera botambe nagotoorie.”
english: So the king gave the order, and they brought Daniel and threw him into the lions' den. The king said to Daniel, "May your God, whom you serve continually, rescue you!"

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agasoka, agaikaransa ase egeita ki’omochie. Abanto bonsi bagatebigwa ng’a omoruoti nao are ase egeita; na igo bakagenda asare. Abaisraeli bonsi konya batamire, kera omonto gochia inka bwoye.
english: So the king got up and took his seat in the gateway. When the men were told, "The king is sitting in the gateway," they all came before him. Meanwhile, the Israelites had fled to their homes.

ekegusii: naboigo omoruoti bw’Abaasuri araire abasomba korwa Misiri, naire na Abaetiopia abooswa. Nigo baraire abanto abake na abanene bare getirianda na batabegeti bikoroto, gose batatubeti chinyonga chiabo, na igo ense y’Abamisiri erenterwe obosooku.
english: so the king of Assyria will lead away stripped and barefoot the Egyptian captives and Cushite exiles, young and old, with buttocks bared-- to Egypt's shame.

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli na Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, bakagenda korwania Ramoti o Gileadi.
english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat king of Judah went up to Ramoth Gilead.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agasangerereria ababani ang’e amagana ane amo, akababoria, “Nkogenda nde korwania Ramoti o Gileadi, gose yaya?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria “Genda, ekiagera Omonene nabeke omochie oyio ase okoboko kwao aye omoruoti.”
english: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets-- about four hundred men-- and asked them, "Shall I go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" "Go," they answered, "for the Lord will give it into the king's hand."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agasangereria ababani, abanto amagana ane, amo, akababoria, “Nkogenda tore korwania Ramoti o Gileadi, gose yaya?” Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Genda, ekiagera Nyasae nabeke omochie oyio ase okoboko kwao, aye omoruoti.”
english: So the king of Israel brought together the prophets-- four hundred men-- and asked them, "Shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" "Go," they answered, "for God will give it into the king's hand."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akarangeria omosomba oye oyomo, akamochika, “Genda bwango orente Mikaya, mosinto o Imula!”
english: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akarangeria omosomba oyomo, akamochika, “Genda bwango orente Mikaya, mosinto o Imula.”
english: So the king of Israel called one of his officials and said, "Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once."

ekegusii: Na omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agatoma abanto gochia aase aria omonto oria o Nyasae amotebetie ase okomokurera. Na omoruoti agetooria, tari engaki eyemo gose ibere, korende chinyinge.
english: So the king of Israel checked on the place indicated by the man of God. Time and again Elisha warned the king, so that he was on his guard in such places.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akagenda amo nomoruoti bw’Abayuda, na omoruoti bw’Abaedomu. Na ekero bagendire orogendo rw’ogosiongorokana ase amatuko atano na abere, amache akabora abarwani esegi amo ne ching’iti chiarenge kobatunyana.
english: So the king of Israel set out with the king of Judah and the king of Edom. After a roundabout march of seven days, the army had no more water for themselves or for the animals with them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio agatoma abanto ase Rahabu komotebia, “Abanto abwo basoire mwao, nigo bachire koroota ense engima. Ase igo, basokie gocha asetore.”
english: So the king of Jericho sent this message to Rahab: "Bring out the men who came to you and entered your house, because they have come to spy out the whole land."

ekegusii: Ase igo omoruoti agatebia Yoabu, omotang’ani bw’emeganda yaye y’abarwani, “Bono etanana ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba, mobare abanto, erinde imanye omobaro obo.”
english: So the king said to Joab and the army commanders with him, "Go throughout the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and enroll the fighting men, so that I may know how many there are."

ekegusii: Na omoruoti agatebia Simei, “Togoitwa.” Naende agatiana ase ayio.
english: So the king said to Shimei, "You shall not die." And the king promised him on oath.

ekegusii: Naende omoruoti agatoma omotang’ani onde bw’abarwani esegi emerongo etano amo nabarwani baye emerongo etano; nere agatiira, na gaikire aroro agatung’ama inse akaumama ase obosio bw’Elija, akamosorora, akamotebia, “Aye omonto o Nyasae, nagosabire, tiga obogima bwane na obw’abasomba bao aba emerongo etano bobe obw’engencho enene asore.
english: So the king sent a third captain with his fifty men. This third captain went up and fell on his knees before Elijah. "Man of God," he begged, "please have respect for my life and the lives of these fifty men, your servants!

ekegusii: Naende omonto o kabere omoriini ebarasi agatomwa agaika asebare, agateba, “Omoruoti nigo akoboria gose amang’ana omorembe mobwate.” Yehu akamoiraneria, “Ninki ogokorera omorembe? Irana nyuma yane, ontunyane!”
english: So the king sent out a second horseman. When he came to them he said, "This is what the king says: 'Do you come in peace?'" Jehu replied, "What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akagenderera gotama, na abanto bonsi bakamotunyana korwa nyuma; bakaratenena ake ase enyomba yarenge ensinyo.
english: So the king set out, with all the people following him, and they halted at a place some distance away.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agachika ng’a abaringoria na abaragori, na abarogi, amo n’Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, barentwe, erinde bamotebie chindoto chiaye. Ase ayio abanto abwo bonsi bagacha ase obosio bwaye.
english: So the king summoned the magicians, enchanters, sorcerers and astrologers to tell him what he had dreamed. When they came in and stood before the king,

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti akarusia ebonyi yarenge ase ekiara kiaye gi’okoboko, yabwate ekemanyererio kiaye, akayea omobisa oria bw’Abayahudi, Hamani, mosinto o Hamedata, Omoagagi,
english: So the king took his signet ring from his finger and gave it to Haman son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews.

ekegusii: Ase igo omonyamwando oria agatebia Boazi, “Aye bogore”, na akamosomorera egekoroto kiaye.
english: So the kinsman-redeemer said to Boaz, "Buy it yourself." And he removed his sandal.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio emanwa y’eng’ondi, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na amaguta, mbibe bikoruegwa kera emambia, rituko ase rituko, bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa keragenderere koruegwa botambe.
english: So the lamb and the grain offering and the oil shall be provided morning by morning for a regular burnt offering.

ekegusii: Bono ense eria ekaba nobotoereru ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene. Erio Otinieli, mosinto o Kenasi, agakwa.
english: So the land had peace for forty years, until Othniel son of Kenaz died.

ekegusii: Naboigo amachiko abeire omotebereria oito agotoira goika ase Kristo, erinde tonyore oboronge ase okwegena.
english: So the law was put in charge to lead us to Christ that we might be justified by faith.

ekegusii: Omolawi oria agancha komenya amo nomonto oria, na ere akamokora buna oyomo bw’abana baye abamura.
english: So the Levite agreed to live with him, and the young man was to him like one of his sons.

ekegusii: Omolawi oria, omosacha bw’omokungu oria oitetwe moeneno, akairaneria, agateba, “Nigo nachete Gibea, omochie, bw’Ababenjamin, inche na omokungu one o sere‐sere, erinde torare aroro agwo ase obotuko.
english: So the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, said, "I and my concubine came to Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abalawi bagachora Hemani, mosinto o Yoeli, na ase abanto bamwabo Asafu, mosinto o Berekia, na ase ororeria rwa Merari abanto bamwabo Etani, mosinto o Kusaya.
english: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berekiah; and from their brothers the Merarites, Ethan son of Kushaiah;

ekegusii: Abalawi bagatenena babwate ebinto bi’okobugigwa bia Daudi, na abakuani babwate ebirombeta.
english: So the Levites stood ready with David's instruments, and the priests with their trumpets.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akarenta abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi b’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri igoro yabo; barabwo bakabwata Manase nekegobanio, bakamosiba ne chingataare chi’etaai, bakamoira Babeli.
english: So the LORD brought against them the army commanders of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh prisoner, put a hook in his nose, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon.

ekegusii: Omonene agatorusia ase ense ya Misiri nokoboko kwaye kore nechinguru koramboire, na ase okoondokia okonene na ebikone na amakumia.
english: So the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, with great terror and with miraculous signs and wonders.

ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene akaa Abaisraeli ense eyio yonsi arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nabayee; barabwo kobayeeirwe bakamenya aroro.
english: So the LORD gave Israel all the land he had sworn to give their forefathers, and they took possession of it and settled there.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae akamoseria korwa ase omogondo o Edeni, akamobeka areme riroba agwo ase arwete.
english: So the LORD God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akabekera omonto oria chitoro chindito mono. Ekero araire akamorusia orobaru rwaye oromo, na akairanerania chinyama aase aria.
english: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep; and while he was sleeping, he took one of the man's ribs and closed up the place with flesh.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae agatebia eng’iti eria, “Ekiagera gwakorire aya, aye kwaragererigwe kobua ching’iti chionsi chigotugwa, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana; aye nenda oragendere, na orotu orarie ase obogima bwao bwonsi.
english: So the LORD God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, "Cursed are you above all the livestock and all the wild animals! You will crawl on your belly and you will eat dust all the days of your life.

ekegusii: Agwo Omonene agatiga Musa, tamoita. Erio omokungu oyio agateba, “Omonyuomi bw’amanyinga ase engencho y’okwaroka.”
english: So the LORD let him alone. (At that time she said "bridegroom of blood," referring to circumcision.)

ekegusii: “Ase ayio Omonene, Nyasae oito, akabeka Ogi, omoruoti o Basani, amo nabanto baye bonsi, ase amaboko aito. Togaita bonsi pi, nonya noyomo tatigara ore moyo.
english: So the LORD our God also gave into our hands Og king of Bashan and all his army. We struck them down, leaving no survivors.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, agateba, “Naya boigo takoba bo.”
english: So the LORD relented. "This will not happen either," the Sovereign LORD said.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Omonene akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, agateba, “Ayio bono takoba bo.”
english: So the LORD relented. "This will not happen," the LORD said.

ekegusii: Esegi eria ekagendererera korwanwa goika ng’umbu ya Beti‐Aveni. Igo Omonene agatooria Abaisraeli ase rituko riria.
english: So the LORD rescued Israel that day, and the battle moved on beyond Beth Aven.

ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ndetera emori ritororo y’emiaka etato, na embori esubeni y’emiaka etato, na emingichi y’emiaka etato, ne riruma ne riige rie riruma.”
english: So the LORD said to him, "Bring me a heifer, a goat and a ram, each three years old, along with a dove and a young pigeon."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Ira Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, omonto oyio omoika one ore ime yaye, erio omobekere amaboko.
english: So the LORD said to Moses, "Take Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay your hand on him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene agatebia Sulemani, “Ekiagera gwakorire ayio, na tikwabwatete okobwatana kw’ogotianania, gose amachiko aane aya nagochigete, goika ntandorane na ndusie oboruoti korwa asore, imboe omosomba oo.
english: So the LORD said to Solomon, "Since this is your attitude and you have not kept my covenant and my decrees, which I commanded you, I will most certainly tear the kingdom away from you and give it to one of your subordinates.

ekegusii: Na Omonene akabora, “Nindusie Abayuda korwa ase obosio bwane, buna narusetie Abaisraeli; nintugute Yerusalemu, omochie oyio nachorete, na enyomba eria natebete ng’a nimbeke erieta riane aroro.”
english: So the LORD said, "I will remove Judah also from my presence as I removed Israel, and I will reject Jerusalem, the city I chose, and this temple, about which I said, 'There shall my Name be.'"

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agateba, “Mwanyabanto abwo natongete nimbarusie ase ense, gose tari mwanyabanto boka, korende ne ching’iti, na echi kwagura, ne chinyoni. Neitirie ekiagera natongete barabwo na chirochio.”
english: So the LORD said, "I will wipe mankind, whom I have created, from the face of the earth-- men and animals, and creatures that move along the ground, and birds of the air-- for I am grieved that I have made them."

ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akorete agatooria Hezekia na abanto ba Yerusalemu korwa ase okoboko gwa Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, na korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo bonsi. Erio akabaa obotoereru ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: So the LORD saved Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib king of Assyria and from the hand of all others. He took care of them on every side.

ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene akabaserebania korwa agwo, besiarere ase ense yonsi, bayemenye. Bagatiga koagacha omochie oria.
english: So the LORD scattered them from there over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akarentera Abaisraeli oborwaire obobe, na borobwo bogaita abanto korwa mambia goika engaki yaragetwe; abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bagakwa korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba.
english: So the LORD sent a plague on Israel from that morning until the end of the time designated, and seventy thousand of the people from Dan to Beersheba died.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akarentera Abaisraeli oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita; Abaisraeli chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) bagakwa.
english: So the LORD sent a plague on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell dead.

ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene akabatiga bakabugwa na Yabini, omoruoti o Kanani, oyorenge kogambera omochie o Hasori. Omotang’ani bw’emeganda yaye y’esegi nigo are korokwa Sisera. Ere nigo amenyete Haroseti, omochie bw’Ebisaku.
english: So the LORD sold them into the hands of Jabin, a king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor. The commander of his army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth Haggoyim.

ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria amang’ana amaya na ay’okoremia ase omomalaika ori a okwanete nainche.
english: So the LORD spoke kind and comforting words to the angel who talked with me.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agasukia omoika o Serubabeli mosinto o Sealitieli, oyorenge omogavuna bw’Abayuda, na oyo o Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, na oyo bw’abatigari bonsi b’abanto. Bonsi amo bagacha bagakora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae obo.
english: So the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the whole remnant of the people. They came and began to work on the house of the LORD Almighty, their God,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli na akabaseria korwa ase obosio bwaye; onde tatigarete otatiga egesaku ki’Abayuda gioka.
english: So the LORD was very angry with Israel and removed them from his presence. Only the tribe of Judah was left,

ekegusii: Omonene nigo abete amo na Yoshua, ne chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi.
english: So the LORD was with Joshua, and his fame spread throughout the land.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ase rituko erimo rioka Omonene nanache omotwe bw’Abaisraeli na ekemincha, boigo nanache orosagia rw’omokendo na esaka.
english: So the LORD will cut off from Israel both head and tail, both palm branch and reed in a single day;

ekegusii: Omonene nemanyekanie ase Abamisiri; na Abamisiri mbabe bakomomanya Omonene ase amatuko ayio. Mbabe bakomosasima na komoruera ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, naende mbabe bakoriera Omonene chiira na gochiikerania.
english: So the LORD will make himself known to the Egyptians, and in that day they will acknowledge the LORD. They will worship with sacrifices and grain offerings; they will make vows to the LORD and keep them.

ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu enene ase Abaisraeli, na ekero ase ekero akaba okobabeka ase okoboko kwa Hasaeli, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, na ase okwa Beni‐Hadadi, mosinto o Hasaeli.
english: So the LORD's anger burned against Israel, and for a long time he kept them under the power of Hazael king of Aram and Ben-Hadad his son.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio akaroka kera eng’iti egotugwa, na kera enyoni ekoiruruka, na kera eng’iti y’orosana erieta riaye. Korende tarorekana mokonyi onde, barakonyane nere.
english: So the man gave names to all the livestock, the birds of the air and all the beasts of the field. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.

ekegusii: Akabarigereria, osemeretie ng’a naegwe egento korwa asebare.
english: So the man gave them his attention, expecting to get something from them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto oria o Nyasae akairana amo nomobani oria omogotu, akaria endagera na konywa amache ase enyomba yaye.
english: So the man of God returned with him and ate and drank in his house.

ekegusii: Akagenda bwoye, agachaka koraria ase Dekapoli amang’ana aya Yeso amokoreire. Abanto bonsi bagakumia.
english: So the man went away and began to tell in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And all the people were amazed.

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agasoa nyomba, na Labani agasiborera chingamia chigurube chiabo, agachia obonyansi, na chirochio chikaria. Naende akarentera omonto oria amache, akarentera na abwo barenge komo, bagesibia amagoro.
english: So the man went to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and fodder were brought for the camels, and water for him and his men to wash their feet.

ekegusii: Bono abanto abwo bakagenda, bagaetanana ense eria engima, bakarika ase okworokia buna bayiatete ense ase chinsemo isano na ibere kobwatekana nemechie yonsi. Erio bakairana ase Yoshua ase egetwori agwo Silo
english: So the men left and went through the land. They wrote its description on a scroll, town by town, in seven parts, and returned to Joshua in the camp at Shiloh.

ekegusii: Abanto baria Musa atomete gochia koroota ense eria barentete amang’ana amabe igoro y’ense eria, bakagera omoganda bwonsi okemurungania ase Omonene.
english: So the men Moses had sent to explore the land, who returned and made the whole community grumble against him by spreading a bad report about it--

ekegusii: Abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu bagacha, bakaira Esanduku eria y’Omonene, bakayebeka ase enyomba y’Abinadabu, ase ekegoro igoro; bagachora na gwatanana Eleazari, omwana oye omomura, abe okorenda Esanduku eria.
english: So the men of Kiriath Jearim came and took up the ark of the LORD. They took it to Abinadab's house on the hill and consecrated Eleazar his son to guard the ark of the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto baria batometwe nomoruoti bakababwatia gochia Yorodan goika ebiambokero biaye. Kobachiire, egeita kegasiekwa.
english: So the men set out in pursuit of the spies on the road that leads to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as the pursuers had gone out, the gate was shut.

ekegusii: Ase igo abanto abwo bakaimokia ebiegwa, bakaimokia ne chibesa ara kabere; amo na Benjamin bakagenda, bagatirimboka gochia Misiri, bagachia bagatenena ase obosio bwa Yusufu.
english: So the men took the gifts and double the amount of silver, and Benjamin also. They hurried down to Egypt and presented themselves to Joseph.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanene baria ba Moabu bakaimoka bakagenda ase Balaki bakamotebia, “Baalamu nigo aanga, tacheti amo naintwe.”
english: So the Moabite princes returned to Balak and said, "Balaam refused to come with us."

ekegusii: Erio abanto banyare koraria erieta ri’Omonene ase Sayoni, na ogotogigwa kwaye agwo Yerusalemu,
english: So the name of the LORD will be declared in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere abanto bakaimoka mambia chuni, bakarua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, bakarenta na ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe. Abanto bagaikaransa, bakaria na konywa, erio bakaimoka gotenga.
english: So the next day the people rose early and sacrificed burnt offerings and presented fellowship offerings. Afterward they sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.

ekegusii: Nigo aganetie ng’a abanto b’ebiaare bigochi‐gocha bayamanye, ee, nonya nabana b’ebiaare konya bataraiborwa, naende abwo bayatebie abana babo.
english: so the next generation would know them, even the children yet to be born, and they in turn would tell their children.

ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bande bakamotebia, “Twarorire Omonene.” Korende ere akabatebia, “Ntarochi amaboko aye na ebimanyererio bi’emesumari, na kobeka ekiara kiane aase emesumari yamobetete, na kobeka okoboko kwane rikere riaye ime, tinkwegena nonya ng’ake.”
english: So the other disciples told him, "We have seen the Lord!" But he said to them, "Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe it."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ere oria otenenerete enyomba y’omoruoti, na oria otenenerete omochie, amo nabagaaka na abateneneri b’abana b’Ahabu, bagatoma amang’ana ase Yehu, bakabora, “Intwe nabasomba bao, nabo torakore onsi aya ogotochika. Titobeka onde bwensi koba omoruoti; aye kora kende gionsi oranche.”
english: So the palace administrator, the city governor, the elders and the guardians sent this message to Jehu: "We are your servants and we will do anything you say. We will not appoint anyone as king; you do whatever you think best."

ekegusii: Agwo abanto bakemurunganeria Musa, bakamoboria, “Ninki tokonywa?”
english: So the people grumbled against Moses, saying, "What are we to drink?"

ekegusii: Naboigo abanto bakaba bagotimoka ase rituko ria gatano na kabere.
english: So the people rested on the seventh day.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagesiarera ase ense yonsi ya Misiri na kwerigeria obonyansi ribaga rie chimboba.
english: So the people scattered all over Egypt to gather stubble to use for straw.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bagatomwa Silo, bakarenta Esanduku eria y’Omonene bw’Emeganda, oyio omenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’abakerubi; na Hofini na Finehasi, abamura babere ba Eli, bagacha amo n’Esanduku eria.
english: So the people sent men to Shiloh, and they brought back the ark of the covenant of the LORD Almighty, who is enthroned between the cherubim. And Eli's two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were there with the ark of the covenant of God.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakaimokia amabomba abo ay’obosie ritang’ani atarabekwa memera, bakaboa ebituba biabo, ebi baare gokonyera obosie, ase ebitambaa biabo baare kwambara, bakabibogoria ase amareko abo.
english: So the people took their dough before the yeast was added, and carried it on their shoulders in kneading troughs wrapped in clothing.

ekegusii: Abanto bakarenta chinsagia echio, erio kera omonto akaagacha ekegutu igoro ase ekerama ki’enyomba yaye, gose ase ekeooreri kiaye, na ase chiraaro chi’enyomba ya Nyasae, na ase eraaro bosio bw’Egeita ki’Amache, na ase ey’Egeita ki’Efraimu.
english: So the people went out and brought back branches and built themselves booths on their own roofs, in their courtyards, in the courts of the house of God and in the square by the Water Gate and the one by the Gate of Ephraim.

ekegusii: Nabo Abafarisai baria na aborokia b’amariko bakamoboria, “Nase ki aborokigwa bao batari kobwata chingencho chi’abagaaka, korende bakoragera namaboko are neriko?”
english: So the Pharisees and teachers of the law asked Jesus, "Why don't your disciples live according to the tradition of the elders instead of eating their food with 'unclean' hands?"

ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mwarorire ng’a timokonyara gokora gento; ense yagendire komotunyana.”
english: So the Pharisees said to one another, "See, this is getting us nowhere. Look how the whole world has gone after him!"

ekegusii: Ase igo Abafilisti bakarwana bokong’u, na Abaisraeli bakabugwa, bagatama kera oyomo gochia ase enka yaye. Okobugwa okwo nigo kwarenge okonene mono. Abarwani b’Abaisraeli chilifu emerongo etato bagaitwa bagakwa.
english: So the Philistines fought, and the Israelites were defeated and every man fled to his tent. The slaughter was very great; Israel lost thirty thousand foot soldiers.

ekegusii: Naboigo Abafilisti bakabugwa, tibanyora ribaga naende gosoa ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge mamincha y’Abafilisti ase amatuko onsi Samweli arenge moyo.
english: So the Philistines were subdued and did not invade Israelite territory again. Throughout Samuel's lifetime, the hand of the LORD was against the Philistines.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abaremerwa mbabe nogosemeria, korende abakori amabe nigo barakirigwe‐kiri.”
english: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omokuani akaa Daudi emegati eria emechenu, ekiagera mogati onde torengeo otatiga eria konya yarusigwe korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, erinde eyere iberera ebekweo ase rituko erio.
english: So the priest gave him the consecrated bread, since there was no bread there except the bread of the Presence that had been removed from before the LORD and replaced by hot bread on the day it was taken away.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abakuani na Abalawi bagechena abanyene, erinde bachie korenta Esanduku eria y’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: So the priests and Levites consecrated themselves in order to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Chingongo chi’omogambi nigo chirabebekane norw’Abalawi na orw’omochie, naende chibe ase egati y’orw’Abayuda na orw’Ababenjamin.
english: So the property of the Levites and the property of the city will lie in the center of the area that belongs to the prince. The area belonging to the prince will lie between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.

ekegusii: Onye omonto Omolawi takobooria enyomba aoonetie ere ime ase omochie ore omwando oye, enyomba eyio neiranigwe ase Omwaka bw’Omochengo, ekiagera chinyomba chire ime ase emechie y’Abalawi nigo chire omwando obo ase egati y’Abaisraeli.
english: So the property of the Levites is redeemable-- that is, a house sold in any town they hold-- and is to be returned in the Jubilee, because the houses in the towns of the Levites are their property among the Israelites.

ekegusii: Omobani oria akaimokia omobere oria bw’omonto o Nyasae, akayobeka ase etigere igoro, erio akayoirania gochia ase omochie oye omonyene, akamoreera na akamotindeka.
english: So the prophet picked up the body of the man of God, laid it on the donkey, and brought it back to his own city to mourn for him and bury him.

ekegusii: So the prophet said to him, "Come home with me and eat."
english: Omobani oria omogotu agatebia omonto oria o Nyasae, “Inchuo togende nka bwone, torie endagera.”

ekegusii: Erio omobani oria akamotebia, “Ekiagera kwangire koigwera eriogi ri’Omonene, rora, ase obwango obo okorua aa asende, endo negoite.” Erio kegima, ekero omonto oria aruete asare, akaumerana nendo ekamoita.
english: So the prophet said, "Because you have not obeyed the LORD, as soon as you leave me a lion will kill you." And after the man went away, a lion found him and killed him.

ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese kiegesaku kia Manase bagatiga Abaisraeli bande agwo Silo ase ense ya Kanani, bakairana ase ense ya Gileadi, ense eria banyorete ase okomenya, buna Omonene konya achikire goetera ase Musa.
english: So the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh left the Israelites at Shiloh in Canaan to return to Gilead, their own land, which they had acquired in accordance with the command of the LORD through Moses.

ekegusii: Erio abagambi baria abanene, na abagambi be chingongo, na abagavuna, na abasemia, na abagachi be chikungo, na abagambi ebina, na abamanyi b’amachiko, na abanene bande bonsi b’ense eria, bagacha gwatanana na gosesenia omogwekano oria omoruoti Nebukadinesaro konya atenenirie. Ekero bateneine bosio bw’omogwekano oria,
english: So the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates and all the other provincial officials assembled for the dedication of the image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up, and they stood before it.

ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akabeka okoboko kwaye inse y’ekebono kia Ibrahimu, omonene oye, akerama ase ring’ana erio.
english: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.

ekegusii: Abasomba baria bagasoka, bagaika ase chinchera, bagasangereria bonsi aba banyorete, ababe na abaya; igo enyomba y’enyangi egaichorwa nabageni.
english: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered all the people they could find, both good and bad, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.

ekegusii: Nabo baria basubati bamwabo bagatoma amang’ana asare, bakabora, “Omonene, ere oyobwanchete orwarire.”
english: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, "Lord, the one you love is sick."

ekegusii: Erio abarwani bakanacha chingori chi’obwato, bakabotiga bogwe amache ime.
english: So the soldiers cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it fall away.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abarwani esegi bagatiga abanto baria boosete amo nebisakorwa ase amasio ’abanene baria na ase omosangererekano bwonsi.
english: So the soldiers gave up the prisoners and plunder in the presence of the officials and all the assembly.

ekegusii: Bakabogoria chibesa chiria, bagakora buna batebetigwe, na omogano oyo okumire ase Abayahudi goika rero iga.
english: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.

ekegusii: Erio abarwani baria bakaimokia Paulo buna bachigetwe, bakamoira gochia Antipatiri ase obotuko boria.
english: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul with them during the night and brought him as far as Antipatris.

ekegusii: naki Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere omonene bw’Esabato.”
english: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath."

ekegusii: So the sons of Israel did this. Joseph gave them carts, as Pharaoh had commanded, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.
english: Erio basinto ba Israeli bagakora buna batebetigwe, na Yusufu akabaa chigari buna Farao achigete, amo nendagera bagochia koria inchera.

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ogokwana na kworokereria ayare boronge, gose tori koyiera monto, korende ase ekeene nigo okworokereria enchera ya Nyasae.
english: So the spies questioned him: "Teacher, we know that you speak and teach what is right, and that you do not show partiality but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.

ekegusii: Erio erioba rigatenena rigakira‐kiri, na omotienyi boigo, goika abanto bakeruseria egesiomba ase ababisa babo. Aya nigo arikire ase “Ebuku y’oyore omoronge.” Erioba rigatenena rigakira‐kiri aaria igoro gati‐gati kegima, ang’e rituko rigima, na tiriaayerera kogwa.
english: So the sun stood still, and the moon stopped, till the nation avenged itself on its enemies, as it is written in the Book of Jashar. The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, omwaka o kabere nyuma kobarure Misiri, Obomenyo boria bogatenenigwa.
english: So the tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month in the second year.

ekegusii: Erio abanto baria Batato bakabinya‐binyia egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amache korwa ase ensoko eria yarenge ase egeita kia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa otatiga ayaumorete akaba okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,
english: So the Three broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out before the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batato bakabinya‐binyia egati y’Abafilisti aase batoorete, bakabuucha amache korwa ase ensoko eria yarenge ase egeita kia Bethlehemu, bakayairera Daudi. Korende Daudi tayanywa, otatiga ayaiterete koba ekeng’wanso gi’ekenyugwa ase Omonene,
english: So the three mighty men broke through the Philistine lines, drew water from the well near the gate of Bethlehem and carried it back to David. But he refused to drink it; instead, he poured it out before the LORD.

ekegusii: Baria ikomi na babere bakarangeria omoganda bw’aborokigwa, bagateba, “Tetogwenereti intwe gotiga ring’ana ria Nyasae na gokora emeremo ye chimesa.
english: So the Twelve gathered all the disciples together and said, "It would not be right for us to neglect the ministry of the word of God in order to wait on tables.

ekegusii: Abanto baria babere bagaikaransa aroro, bakaria na konywa amo. Erio ise omosubati oria agatebia omonto oria, “Koranche, orare aiga naende ase obotuko bwa rero, oigwe buya.”
english: So the two of them sat down to eat and drink together. Afterward the girl's father said, "Please stay tonight and enjoy yourself."

ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo babere bakagenderera orogendo rwabo, bagaika Bethlehemu. Ekero baigete aroro, abanto bonsi b’omochie bakaeegaeega ase engencho yabo, na abakungu bakaborania, bagoteba, “Inee! Oyo Naomi?”
english: So the two women went on until they came to Bethlehem. When they arrived in Bethlehem, the whole town was stirred because of them, and the women exclaimed, "Can this be Naomi?"

ekegusii: Orwaki roria rokaira amatuko emerongo etano, na abere, rokaera ase rituko ria emerongo ebere na gatano ri’omotienyi bw’Elulu.
english: So the wall was completed on the twenty-fifth of Elul, in fifty-two days.

ekegusii: Omonene oria akabeka abasibwa bonsi abwo barenge echela ime ase amaboko a Yusufu; na onsi ayare gokoreka ase echela, ere akaba okoyakora.
english: So the warden put Joseph in charge of all those held in the prison, and he was made responsible for all that was done there.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebinge konya benyoreire, ne chinibo chionsi babeire bagachete mbabibogorie bamboke nabirobio ase Orooche rw’Emesobeti.
english: So the wealth they have acquired and stored up they carry away over the Ravine of the Poplars.

ekegusii: Bakaimoka korwa ase oboina bwango, bare nokoiroka na omogoko omonene, bakaminyoka, bakairera aborokigwa baye amang’ana.
english: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ria Nyasae rikaranda, na omobaro bw’aborokigwa okamentekana mono ase Yerusalemu, na abakuani abange bakaigwera okwegena.
english: So the word of God spread. The number of disciples in Jerusalem increased rapidly, and a large number of priests became obedient to the faith.

ekegusii: Ase ayio eira eria Omonene arierete Yehu ng’a abana baye goika ekiaare gia kane mbabe bagoikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti kw’Abaisraeli egaikeranigwa.
english: So the word of the LORD spoken to Jehu was fulfilled: "Your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."

ekegusii: Ase ayio omobani oria omosae akagenda Ramoti o Gileadi.
english: So the young man, the prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.

ekegusii: Erio abamura baria chirooti bakagenda, bagasokia Rahabu, na ise, na ng’ina, na abana bamwabo, na abanto ba nyomba mwaye, amo neamate yaye yonsi, bakabaa ribaga bamenye ang’e negetwori ki’Abaisraeli.
english: So the young men who had done the spying went in and brought out Rahab, her father and mother and brothers and all who belonged to her. They brought out her entire family and put them in a place outside the camp of Israel.

ekegusii: So then he told them plainly, "Lazarus is dead,
english: Erio agwo Yeso akabatebia maiso marore, “Lazaro okure.

ekegusii: Gaki ase amang’ana ay’okoria ebinto bikoruegwa ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, twamanyire ng’a “omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa tai gento ase ense”, ekiagera twamanyire ng’a “Nyasae onde tari aande, otatiga oyomo bweka.”
english: So then, about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world and that there is no God but one.

ekegusii: Ase ayio tiga aya akogochanda arue ase enkoro yao, na aya akorenta obororo ase omobere oo arue boigo, ekiagera obosae na obuya bw’obogima nigo bore bosa.
english: So then, banish anxiety from your heart and cast off the troubles of your body, for youth and vigor are meaningless.

ekegusii: Ase igo baminto, tenena bokong’u, na mobwate chingencho echio twaborokereretie, onye nase amang’ana ’emenwa yaito, gose nase rirube riaito.
english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abanchani, ekiagera motengerete ebio, kora omokia, erio moche kororekana asare more nomorembe, motari na kemoa gose na komocha.
english: So then, dear friends, since you are looking forward to this, make every effort to be found spotless, blameless and at peace with him.

ekegusii: Gaki amakweri nigo agokora emeremo ime yaito, korende obogima ime yaino.
english: So then, death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.

ekegusii: Gaki, bono timoiroka! Nimbaragerie inwe amo nabana baino.” Naboigo akaba okobaremia, agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana amaya.
english: So then, don't be afraid. I will provide for you and your children." And he reassured them and spoke kindly to them.

ekegusii: Ase igo, kera omonto ore ase egati yaito nache gwekwanera ere omonyene ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God.

ekegusii: So then, he who marries the virgin does right, but he who does not marry her does even better.
english: Gaki oyorasokie omoiseke oye omwekungi nakore buya; na oyotamosogeti okorire buya kobua.

ekegusii: Naboigo ekero omosacha oye are moyo, aise koba nomosacha onde nigo akorokwa omotomani; korende omosacha oye karakwe, rirorio osiboirwe korwa ase amachiko ayio. Naisa konyuomwa nomosacha onde, takorokwa omotomani.
english: So then, if she marries another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress. But if her husband dies, she is released from that law and is not an adulteress, even though she marries another man.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna mwamonyorire Kristo Yeso Omonene, naboigo mogenderere asare,
english: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to live in him,

ekegusii: Ase ayio titorara chitoro buna abande bagokora, korende torende na kwerita.
english: So then, let us not be like others, who are asleep, but let us be alert and self-controlled.

ekegusii: Omonto natobare iga, ng’a nabasomba ba Kristo tore, na abarendi b’obobisi bwa Nyasae.
english: So then, men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and as those entrusted with the secret things of God.

ekegusii: Gaki baminto, komogosangererekana amo ase okoria, moganyane.
english: So then, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for each other.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto tetogia ase mwanyabanto. Naki bionsi nebiaino;
english: So then, no more boasting about men! All things are yours,

ekegusii: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous and good.
english: Naboigo amachiko namachenu, na ogochika nogochenu, na okwa boronge, na okuya.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ring’ana ri’Omonene asebare nigo rirabe iga: “Ogochika igoro ase ogochika, ee, ogochika igoro ase ogochika; ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana, ee, ring’ana igoro ase ring’ana; aiga make, na aaria make,” erinde kobagotaara babe bakogwa kenyuma‐nyuma, babutokane, babe bagotegwa na kobwatwa.
english: So then, the word of the LORD to them will become: Do and do, do and do, rule on rule, rule on rule; a little here, a little there-- so that they will go and fall backward, be injured and snared and captured.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abwo bagochandwa koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae, tiga bakore amaya na babeke emioyo yabo asare ere oyore Omotongi omwegenwa.
english: So then, those who suffer according to God's will should commit themselves to their faithful Creator and continue to do good.

ekegusii: Naende ngoteba iga: Ogosemeria nkore asore ase amatuko agochi‐gocha, na abana bao nabairane gocha ase ense yabo.
english: So there is hope for your future," declares the LORD. "Your children will return to their own land.

ekegusii: Ase igo omogoko omonene okaba ase omochie oria.
english: So there was great joy in that city.

ekegusii: Chibao chionsi nigo chiabete isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chie chifeta ikomi, na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.
english: So there were eight frames and sixteen silver bases-- two under each frame.

ekegusii: Chimesa echio chionsi ase ebing’wanso biarenge konyenyerwa nigo chiarenge isano na isato, inye nigo chiarenge ase rikere erimo ri’oboagacho, na inye ase rikere rinde.
english: So there were four tables on one side of the gateway and four on the other-- eight tables in all-- on which the sacrifices were slaughtered.

ekegusii: Chibao chionsi nigo chirabe isano na isato, ne chinterekerero chiabo chie chifeta ikomi na isano nemo, ibere ibere inse ya kera ebao.
english: So there will be eight frames and sixteen silver bases-- two under each frame.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abamura baria batato bagasibwa bare ne chisirwari chiabo, ne chiganchwa chiabo, na emiambaro yabo, ne chianga chinde, bakarutwa ase eriko riria ri’omorero ekebemberi.
english: So these men, wearing their robes, trousers, turbans and other clothes, were bound and thrown into the blazing furnace.

ekegusii: Bono ekiagera Ayubu arenge omonyaboronge ase amaiso aye ere omonyene, abanto baria batato bagatiga komoiraneria.
english: So these three men stopped answering Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakairaneria Yeso, “Titomanyeti.” Na Yeso akabatebia “Nonya ninche tinkobatebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.”
english: So they answered Jesus, "We don't know." Jesus said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things."

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Titomanyeti.” Ere akabatebia, “Nonya ninche tinkobatebia inwe nase okobua ki ngokorera aya.
english: So they answered Jesus, "We don't know." Then he said, "Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.

ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Titomanyeti aase yarwete.”
english: So they answered, "We don't know where it was from."

ekegusii: Ase igo tibakoba babere naende, korende omobere oyomo. Naboigo, ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, mwanyabanto tabiatanana.”
english: So they are no longer two, but one. Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate."

ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakamoboria, “Totebie gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atonyorire. Meremo ki ogokora aye? Ng’ai kwarure? Ense yao nereri? Ngesaku ki ore?”
english: So they asked him, "Tell us, who is responsible for making all this trouble for us? What do you do? Where do you come from? What is your country? From what people are you?"

ekegusii: So they asked him, "What miraculous sign then will you give that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?
english: Bakamotebia, “Mbikone ki ogokora, erinde torore tokwegene? Meremo ki ogokora?

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Oria ogotebia: Etweke egesero kiao ogende, nere ng’o?”
english: So they asked him, "Who is this fellow who told you to pick it up and walk?"

ekegusii: Bakamorenta asare. Ekero kiarora Yeso, bwango ekerecha keria gekaigusia omomura oria, na ere akagwa inse akegaragaria, agasokia risombogoku.
english: So they brought him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.

ekegusii: Erio bakarenta ebikorero biria bie chitahabu na ebie chifeta, ebio biasakoretwe korwa ase Hekalu, enyomba eria ya Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu; omoruoti, na abanene baria, na abakungu baye, na abakungu baye ba sere‐sere, bakabinywera.
english: So they brought in the gold goblets that had been taken from the temple of God in Jerusalem, and the king and his nobles, his wives and his concubines drank from them.

ekegusii: Aya agakoreka. Bakarusia abaruoti baria batano korwa ase rikuruma: omoruoti o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni, na oyo o Yerimuti, na oyo o Lakisi, na oyo bw’Egiloni, bakabarenta ase Yoshua.
english: So they brought the five kings out of the cave-- the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon.

ekegusii: Erio bakarentera Yusufu chitugo chiabo, na Yusufu akabaa endagera. Bakarentera Yusufu chibarasi chiabo, ne ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere. Igo akaba okobarenda na kobaa endagera ase omwaka oyio oyomo, na barabwo bakamoa chitugo chiabo.
english: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their sheep and goats, their cattle and donkeys. And he brought them through that year with food in exchange for all their livestock.

ekegusii: Bakarangeria Rebeka, bakamoboria, “Inee! Inabwanche ogende nomonto oyo?” Akairaneria, “Ee, nanchire, ngende nere.”
english: So they called Rebekah and asked her, "Will you go with this man?" "I will go," she said.

ekegusii: Bagatoma abanto basangererie amo abanene bonsi b’Abafilisti, bakababoria, “Naki togokora n’Esanduku eye ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli?” Barabwo bakairaneria, “Esanduku eria ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tiga eirwe Gati.” Ase igo bakaira Esanduku eria ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli aroro.
english: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and asked them, "What shall we do with the ark of the god of Israel?" They answered, "Have the ark of the god of Israel moved to Gath." So they moved the ark of the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bagatoma abanto basangererie amo abanene bonsi b’Abafilisti, bakabora, “Rusia aiga Esanduku eye ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, moyeiranie gochia aase aye, tebaisa gotoita intwe amo nabana baito.” Obwoba bw’amakweri konya bwasoire ase omochie bwonsi, ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene nigo kwarenge okorito mono aroro.
english: So they called together all the rulers of the Philistines and said, "Send the ark of the god of Israel away; let it go back to its own place, or it will kill us and our people." For death had filled the city with panic; God's hand was very heavy upon it.

ekegusii: So they came and carried them, still in their tunics, outside the camp, as Moses ordered.
english: Barabwo bagacha, bakabogoria emebere eria eboyirie chiganchwa chiabo, bakayeira isiko y’egetwori, buna Musa abatebetie.

ekegusii: bakagenda ase Musa, na Eleazari omokuani, na ase abaraai b’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, bakabatebia,
english: So they came to Moses and Eleazar the priest and to the leaders of the community, and said,

ekegusii: Bagakora ekina, bakagora oboremo bw’omokori chinyongo, bobe aase bagotindeka abageni.
english: So they decided to use the money to buy the potter's field as a burial place for foreigners.

ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bagakora bo. Bakaimokia chiombe ibere chigokamwa, bagachisibera egari, bagasiekera chimori nka.
english: So they did this. They took two such cows and hitched them to the cart and penned up their calves.

ekegusii: Erio bagaatanana ense eria ase egati yabo, bayetaare. Ahabu akagenda ensemo eyemo ere bweka, na Obadia ensemo ende ere bweka.
english: So they divided the land they were to cover, Ahab going in one direction and Obadiah in another.

ekegusii: Bakagenda nabanto abwo ase ense ya Misiri, gochia ase omochie o Tapanesi, ekiagera tibamoigwerete Omonene.
english: So they entered Egypt in disobedience to the LORD and went as far as Tahpanhes.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakeonchora, bagatama korwa ase Abaisraeli gochia ensemo y’erooro, korende bakanarigwa nabarwani baria abange, na baria barwete ase omochie, bagaitwa.
english: So they fled before the Israelites in the direction of the desert, but they could not escape the battle. And the men of Israel who came out of the towns cut them down there.

ekegusii: Nabo bakabisangereria, bagaichoria ebitonga ikomi na bibere ase ebisamunye bi’emegati etano y’engano, ebiatigaretigwe na baria bariete.
english: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaa Yakobo ebinyasae ebigeni bionsi ebio babwate, na ebigera babegete ase amato abo, na Yakobo akabitindeka inse y’omote onga buna omotontera, oyorenge ang’e na Sekemu.
english: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods they had and the rings in their ears, and Jacob buried them under the oak at Shechem.

ekegusii: Bakamonyoisia naende edivai ase obotuko obwo. Omoiseke oria omoke akaimoka, akarara nere, ise tamanya ekero arara, gose ekero aboka.
english: So they got their father to drink wine that night also, and the younger daughter went and lay with him. Again he was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.

ekegusii: Erio bagatama ense etarakiamoka, bagatiga chiema chiabo, ne chibarasi chiabo, ne chitigere chiabo; bagatiga negetwori, bagatama ase ogotooria obogima bwabo.
english: So they got up and fled in the dusk and abandoned their tents and their horses and donkeys. They left the camp as it was and ran for their lives.

ekegusii: Ase igo Hamani agatongwa ase orobambo roria asimiseretie Moredekai. Erio endamwamu y’omoruoti egakenda.
english: So they hanged Haman on the gallows he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king's fury subsided.

ekegusii: Bakagenda nomoayerero, bakanyora Mariamu na Yusufu, na omwana oria ekeng’werere bwareirie ase orotuba.
english: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and the baby, who was lying in the manger.

ekegusii: Erio naende bakaboria Omonene, “Inee! Omonto oyio nachete aa?” Omonene akairaneria, “Rigereria oyio bwebisete ase ebinto bikogachwa.”
english: So they inquired further of the LORD, "Has the man come here yet?" And the LORD said, "Yes, he has hidden himself among the baggage."

ekegusii: Bagachika Ababenjamin, bakabatebia, “Genda mwebise moboe ase emegondo y’emesabibu,
english: So they instructed the Benjamites, saying, "Go and hide in the vineyards

ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo bageatanana bakarua ase chiema chia Kora, na Datani, na Abiiramu. Datani na Abiiramu bagasoka isiko, amo nabakungu babo na abana babo, abanene na abake, bagatenena ase ebisoero bie chiema chiabo.
english: So they moved away from the tents of Korah, Dathan and Abiram. Dathan and Abiram had come out and were standing with their wives, children and little ones at the entrances to their tents.

ekegusii: Bakabachika basoke korwa ase ekegambero, bagakora ekina barabwo ase barabwo,
english: So they ordered them to withdraw from the Sanhedrin and then conferred together.

ekegusii: Bagaeta Misia, bagatirimbokera Teroa.
english: So they passed by Mysia and went down to Troas.

ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo bagateneneria Abisalomu eema kerama igoro, na ere akarara nabakungu ba sere‐sere ba ise maiso marore ase Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and he lay with his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

ekegusii: Bagaatora babere, Yusufu ore korokwa Barsaba, naende erieta rinde Yusto, na Matia.
english: So they proposed two men: Joseph called Barsabbas (also known as Justus) and Matthias.

ekegusii: Naende kobarentire amaato abo gochia engegu, bagatiga bionsi, bakamotunyana.
english: So they pulled their boats up on shore, left everything and followed him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakabeka abateneneri abatindi igoro asebare babachande nemeremo emekong’u mono. Agwo Abaisraeli bakaagachera Farao emechie y’okogacha chinibo, nero Pitoni na Ramesesi.
english: So they put slave masters over them to oppress them with forced labor, and they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bakomania Musa, bagoteba, “Toe amache tonywe!” Musa akabatebia, “Nase ki mokonyomania? Nase ki mogoteema Omonene?”
english: So they quarreled with Moses and said, "Give us water to drink." Moses replied, "Why do you quarrel with me? Why do you put the LORD to the test?"

ekegusii: Bagaikaransa ase chindwaro, echinde rigana erimo na echinde emerongo etano.
english: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.

ekegusii: Na buna Musa abachigete bakagacha endagera eria yatigarete goika rituko ria kabere; ero tiyagunda etioke, gose tiyasogwa namakonde.
english: So they saved it until morning, as Moses commanded, and it did not stink or get maggots in it.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakabwata omokungu oria, bakamoetia gochia ase enyomba y’omoruoti na bakamoira aroro ase Egeita gie Chibarasi, bakamoitera aroro agakwa.
english: So they seized her as she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate on the palace grounds, and there they put her to death.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakabwata omokungu oria, bakamoetia ase egeita chibarasi chiarenge gosoera gochia ase enyomba y’omoruoti, bakamoitera aroro.
english: So they seized her as she reached the place where the horses enter the palace grounds, and there she was put to death.

ekegusii: Ase igo bagachora abanto babere bakariina chigari chiare kong’uswa ne chibarasi, na omoruoti akabatoma gochia koroota abarwani esegi b’Abasiiria.”
english: So they selected two chariots with their horses, and the king sent them after the Aramean army. He commanded the drivers, "Go and find out what has happened."

ekegusii: Abanto bakarangeria Yeroboamu; ere amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakagenda, bagakwana na Rehoboamu, bakamotebia,
english: So they sent for Jeroboam, and he and all Israel went to Rehoboam and said to him:

ekegusii: Erio bakaira Esanduku eria ya Nyasae goika omochie bw’Ekironi. Korende ekero yaigete aroro, abanto b’Ekironi bagaaka amariogi, bakabora, “Barentire Esanduku eria ya Nyasae aiga seito, erinde batoite intwe twensi.”
english: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron. As the ark of God was entering Ekron, the people of Ekron cried out, "They have brought the ark of the god of Israel around to us to kill us and our people."

ekegusii: Erio bakaa Rebeka ribaga amo nomoreri oye bagende nomosomba o Ibrahimu na abanto baye.
english: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham's servant and his men.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bagatoma abanto ase Yusufu komotebia ng’a, “Iso nigo atebete iga ritang’ani atarakwa.
english: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, "Your father left these instructions before he died:

ekegusii: Ase igo bagaatanana Kedesi o Galili, ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Nafutali, na Sekemu ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na Kiriati‐Ariba (nao Heburoni), ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Yuda.
english: So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee in the hill country of Naphtali, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim, and Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah.

ekegusii: Bakagenda, bagaetanana ase emechie, bakorandia enchili, na kogwenia abanto chinsemo chionsi.
english: So they set out and went from village to village, preaching the gospel and healing people everywhere.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaimoka bagatang’anera Saulo, bakagenda Sifu, korende Daudi amo nabanto baye nao barenge ase erooro ya Maoni, agwo ase Ekerubo Ekiomo, irianyi ya Yesimona.
english: So they set out and went to Ziph ahead of Saul. Now David and his men were in the Desert of Maon, in the Arabah south of Jeshimon.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka korwa ase egetunwa keria ki’Omonene, bakagenda orogendo rw’amatuko atato. Esanduku y’okobwatana kw’Omonene yare ne chibao chirikire okobwatana ekabatang’ana ekabanyorera aase bagochia gotoora,
english: So they set out from the mountain of the LORD and traveled for three days. The ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them during those three days to find them a place to rest.

ekegusii: Korende Paulo na Barnaba bakabakong’ontera orotu rw’amagoro abo, bakagenda Ikonio.
english: So they shook the dust from their feet in protest against them and went to Iconium.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bagaaka eriogi rinene, bagekebia emeyio ne chinsara chi’amatimo, buna engencho yabo yarenge, goika amanyinga agacharara korwa ase emebere yabo.
english: So they shouted louder and slashed themselves with swords and spears, as was their custom, until their blood flowed.

ekegusii: bagasima abagisangio babo, abarenge ase obwato bwa kabere, bache kobakonya. Bagacha, bagaichoria amaato onsi abere, goika agachaka korimera.
english: So they signaled their partners in the other boat to come and help them, and they came and filled both boats so full that they began to sink.

ekegusii: Bakanyenya chieri chiria, na abakuani bakaimokia amanyinga e chieri echio, bakayaumora ase egesasimero; naende bakanyenya chimingichi chiria, na amanyinga e chimingichi echio naro bakayaumora ase egesasimero. Nyuma y’ayio bakanyenya chimanwa chiria chie ching’ondi na amanyinga e chimanwa echio naro akaumorwa ase egesasimero.
english: So they slaughtered the bulls, and the priests took the blood and sprinkled it on the altar; next they slaughtered the rams and sprinkled their blood on the altar; then they slaughtered the lambs and sprinkled their blood on the altar.

ekegusii: Bagaseega abanto na abagaaka na aborokia b’amariko, bagachiera Stefano bakamobwata, bakamoira bosio bw’ekegambero.
english: So they stirred up the people and the elders and the teachers of the law. They seized Stephen and brought him before the Sanhedrin.

ekegusii: Erio bakaimoka, bakaroberia abanto ikomi na babere abatenenerete egesaku kia Benjamin na Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, na abanto ikomi na babere abatenenerete Daudi.
english: So they stood up and were counted off-- twelve men for Benjamin and Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, and twelve for David.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagaita Ogi, bagaita nabana baye abamura, na abanto baye, goika tibatigaria nonya nomonto oyomo ore moyo. Erio bakaira ense yaye ekaba eyabo.
english: So they struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army, leaving them no survivors. And they took possession of his land.

ekegusii: Bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita. Naki rende oria omonyene omogondo bw’emesabibu arabakore?
english: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. "What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?

ekegusii: naboigo na barabwo bono bataigwereti, erinde ase amabera aya mwanyorire inwe, nabarabwo boigo banyore amabera.
english: so they too have now become disobedient in order that they too may now receive mercy as a result of God's mercy to you.

ekegusii: Nabo bakarusia rigena riria. Yeso akaimokia amaiso aye igoro, akabora, “Tata, nakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera okonyigwa.
english: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, "Father, I thank you that you have heard me.

ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoita, bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu.
english: So they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.

ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamotuguta isiko korwa ase omogondo bw’emesabibu, bakamoita.
english: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.

ekegusii: Abasomba baye bakamobeka ase egari yaye ende, bakamoira Yerusalemu. Agakwera aroro, na agatindekwa ase chimbeera chie chisokoro chiaye. Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bonsi bakaba bakomoreera.
english: So they took him out of his chariot, put him in the other chariot he had and brought him to Jerusalem, where he died. He was buried in the tombs of his fathers, and all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for him.

ekegusii: Abagambi abwo bakaira Yeremia, bakamotirimbokeria chingori gochia ase engoro ya Malikia, omomura bw’omoruoti. Engoro eyio nigo yarenge ase egoora y’abarendi tiyarenge namache, korende netintira yoka yarengeo; na Yeremia akarateera imeo.
english: So they took Jeremiah and put him into the cistern of Malkijah, the king's son, which was in the courtyard of the guard. They lowered Jeremiah by ropes into the cistern; it had no water in it, only mud, and Jeremiah sank down into the mud.

ekegusii: Erio bakabuucha ribu korwa riko, bakagenda ase obosio bwa Farao. Musa akarisiara gochia igoro, na rirorio rikarenta amagumba na amaote amabe ase mwanyabanto ne chitugo.
english: So they took soot from a furnace and stood before Pharaoh. Moses tossed it into the air, and festering boils broke out on men and animals.

ekegusii: Bakaimokia eeri eria baetwe, bakayeroisia, bagasaba Baali ase okorangeria erieta riaye, korwa mambia goika mobaso gati bagaaka eriogi, bagoteba, “Aye Baali, toigwe, toiranerie!” Korende nonya neriogi rioka tiriarengeo, onde tabairaneretie. Bagachara‐charoka goetanana egesasimero keria baagachete.
english: So they took the bull given them and prepared it. Then they called on the name of Baal from morning till noon. "O Baal, answer us!" they shouted. But there was no response; no one answered. And they danced around the altar they had made.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase enyomba eria omosae oria Omolawi amenyete ase enka ya Mika, bakamoboria amang’ana aye buna agendererete.
english: So they turned in there and went to the house of the young Levite at Micah's place and greeted him.

ekegusii: Bakagenda, bakarangeria abarendi b’egeita ki’omochie, bakabatebia, “Iga twagenda ase egetwori ki’Abasiiria, twanyora ng’a monto onde tario nonya noyomo, gose titoigweti riogi ria monto; twanyora chibarasi chisibire, ne chitigere boigo, ne chiema chiteneine buna bachitigete.”
english: So they went and called out to the city gatekeepers and told them, "We went into the Aramean camp and not a man was there-- not a sound of anyone-- only tethered horses and donkeys, and the tents left just as they were."

ekegusii: Bakagenda ase obwato, aase abobisi, atari nabanto.
english: So they went away by themselves in a boat to a solitary place.

ekegusii: Erio bagasoa korua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde. Yehu konya obekire abanto emerongo etano na etato isiko, abatebetie, “Omonto onde bwensi asemore oratige omonto atooreke ase abwo nkobeka ase amaboko aino, oyio goika akwe ribaga riaye.”
english: So they went in to make sacrifices and burnt offerings. Now Jehu had posted eighty men outside with this warning: "If one of you lets any of the men I am placing in your hands escape, it will be your life for his life."

ekegusii: Bakagenderera orogendo rwabo, na ekero baikire ang’e na Gibea, omochie bw’Ababenjamin, konya bwairiire kegima.
english: So they went on, and the sun set as they neared Gibeah in Benjamin.

ekegusii: Abanto baria bakagenda ase omoruoti, bakamoboria igoro ye richiko riria: “Aye omoruoti, Inee! Tikwabeka ekemanyererio kiao ase richiko riria, ogateba ng’a ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato monto onde bwensi orasasime enyasae ende eng’ao, gose omonto onde, otatiga aye bweka aye omoruoti, oyio arutwe ase engoro ye chindo?” Omoruoti akairaneria, “Ee, richiko erio nigo riteneine bokong’u ritaonchorwe, koreng’ana buna amachiko ’Abamedi na Abaayemi atari koonchorwa.”
english: So they went to the king and spoke to him about his royal decree: "Did you not publish a decree that during the next thirty days anyone who prays to any god or man except to you, O king, would be thrown into the lions' den?" The king answered, "The decree stands-- in accordance with the laws of the Medes and Persians, which cannot be repealed."

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakagenda bakaroota ense eria, bagachakera korwa ase erooro ya Sini bagaika Rehobu ase enchera ekogenda Hamati.
english: So they went up and explored the land from the Desert of Zin as far as Rehob, toward Lebo Hamath.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakarua Misiri, bagaika ense ya Kanani ase Yakobo ise.
english: So they went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.

ekegusii: Ase igo bakamoika ang’e omoteneneri oria bw’enka ya Yusufu, bakaba bagokwana nere gesieri ki’enyomba,
english: So they went up to Joseph's steward and spoke to him at the entrance to the house.

ekegusii: Agasoka naende chinsa isano nemo, ne chinsa kianda, agakora boigo.
english: So they went. "He went out again about the sixth hour and the ninth hour and did the same thing.
