ekegusii: Ase ayio chiaserebekanire gochia aande onsi, ekiagera chitabwati omorisia, chiabeire endagera ye ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana, ee chiaserebekanire.
english: So they were scattered because there was no shepherd, and when they were scattered they became food for all the wild animals.

ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chinde chi’egesaku kia Manase bakaegwa chingongo chiabo. Aba nabwo barenge b’ororeria rw’Abieseri na Heleki, na Asirieli, na Sekemu, na Heferei, na Shemida. Aba nabwo abamura b’ororeria rwa Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, naende barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo.
english: So this allotment was for the rest of the people of Manasseh-- the clans of Abiezer, Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Hepher and Shemida. These are the other male descendants of Manasseh son of Joseph by their clans.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: “Rora inche nkobeka nde rigena ri’oboroso ase Sayoni, rigena rikong’u riateemirwe, rigena ri’ekoona ri’engencho enene rire oboroso obokong’u; na onde bwensi orariegene, takorua aroro.
english: So this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "See, I lay a stone in Zion, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone for a sure foundation; the one who trusts will never be dismayed.

ekegusii: Bono Sesibasari nere ochagete kobeka oboroso bw’enyomba ya Nyasae ere aiga Yerusalemu, na korwa engaki eyio goika rero iga, enyomba eye nigo egendererete koagachwa, teraera.
english: So this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the house of God in Jerusalem. From that day to the present it has been under construction but is not yet finished."

ekegusii: Na oria omoreu nigo agosirigwa ase engencho y’obong’aini bwao, nere oyominto Kristo akwete ase engencho yaye.
english: So this weak brother, for whom Christ died, is destroyed by your knowledge.

ekegusii: Naboigo abwo bare nokwegena mbasesenirie amo na Ibrahimu oyorenge omwegeni.
english: So those who have faith are blessed along with Abraham, the man of faith.

ekegusii: Eye nero emechie abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni omokuani baetwe: Heburoni, omochie oyio abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Libuna,
english: So to the descendants of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron (a city of refuge for one accused of murder), Libnah,

ekegusii: Na Omolawi boigo agachia goika aase aria, akamorora; nere agaeta ensemo.
english: So too, a Levite, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

ekegusii: Nabo ekero kia bono mbare abatigari abachorirwe ase obuya bwa Nyasae.
english: So too, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.

ekegusii: Ase ayio korwa ase Abaisraeli chilifu chinyinge bagachora abanto elifu eyemo korwa ase kera egesaku. Abarwani bonsi bachoretwe kogenda korwana esegi nigo baare chilifu ikomi na ibere.
english: So twelve thousand men armed for battle, a thousand from each tribe, were supplied from the clans of Israel.

ekegusii: Uria omokuani akaagacha egesasimero koreng’ana nomogwekano oria Ahasi omoruoti amotomerete korwa Damesiki, agakeroisia ritang’ani Ahasi ataraika aroro korwa Damesiki.
english: So Uriah the priest built an altar in accordance with all the plans that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus and finished it before King Ahaz returned.

ekegusii: erinde rinyare goikeranigwa eriatebetwe nomobani, “Nimaanore omonwa one ase emereng’anio, inyatore ayabisegete korwa ogotongwa gw’ense.”
english: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: "I will open my mouth in parables, I will utter things hidden since the creation of the world."

ekegusii: So watch yourselves. "If your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents, forgive him.
english: Erende; oyomino karakore ebibe, mokanie; karaonchoke, mwabere.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, intwe twarorire buya ase omosangererekano oito gochora abanto na kobatoma asemore amo nabanchwa baito Barnaba na Paulo,
english: So we all agreed to choose some men and send them to you with our dear friends Barnabas and Paul--

ekegusii: Ekero twaigete Yerusalemu, tokabeera aroro ase obotoereru amatuko atato.
english: So we arrived in Jerusalem, where we rested three days.

ekegusii: Ase ayio tokagenderera gokora emeremo emekong’u. Korwa mambia chuni, goika obotuko, ekero ching’enang’eni chiaorokire, ekeng’ese ki’abanto nigo bagendererete kobogoria amatimo abo.
english: So we continued the work with half the men holding spears, from the first light of dawn till the stars came out.

ekegusii: Ase ayio tokaiyeka omwana one tokamoria. Ne rituko ria kabere nkamotebia ng’a arente omwana oye tomorie, korende ere konya obisire omwana oye.”
english: So we cooked my son and ate him. The next day I said to her, 'Give up your son so we may eat him,' but she had hidden him."

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ayio tokeng’ata na koboria Nyasae oito, nere akaigwa okoboria gwaito kw’ogosorora.
english: So we fasted and petitioned our God about this, and he answered our prayer.

ekegusii: Titorigereria ebinto ebikororekana, korende ebitakororekana; naki ebikororekana nebi’ekero egeke gioka, korende ebitakororekana nebia kare na kare.
english: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

ekegusii: Ase ayio twarentire ebinto bie chitahabu bi’ogwechabera: ebitange bi’amaboko, na ebigera, ne chibonyi, na ebigera bi’amato, ne chisonoi. Ebinto ebio twasakorete kera oyomo oito, na bono twabirentire, twabirure ase Omonene, ase ogokora okobwatanigwa asetore ase obosio bwaye.”
english: So we have brought as an offering to the LORD the gold articles each of us acquired-- armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings and necklaces-- to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, onye tore aa, gose onye titori aa, nigo okogania gwaito kore ng’a tomogwenere ere.
english: So we make it our goal to please him, whether we are at home in the body or away from it.

ekegusii: Ase igo tokagenderera koagacha orwaki roria goika rokabwatanigwa, rogaikera ekeng’ese ki’obotambe bwaye gochia igoro, ekigaera abanto nigo babwate chinkoro chire morero ase ogokora emeremo eyio.
english: So we rebuilt the wall till all of it reached half its height, for the people worked with all their heart.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ntonyare goteba noboremu, “Omonene nere omokonyi one, tinkwoboa. Mwanyabanto, inki arankorere?”
english: So we say with confidence, "The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?"

ekegusii: Na igo twarorire ng’a tibanyarete gosoa ase engencho y’ogotegena kwabo.
english: So we see that they were not able to enter, because of their unbelief.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio tokabeera ase rikura riarochie omochie o Beti‐Peori.”
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

ekegusii: Togasorora Tito aikeranie emeremo y’obuya obo buna ayechagete ase egati yaino.
english: So we urged Titus, since he had earlier made a beginning, to bring also to completion this act of grace on your part.

ekegusii: “Erio tokaimoka, tokarua ase abaminto, abanto b’ororeria rw’Esau, abwo bamenyete Seiri, togatiga enchera y’Ekerubo Ekiomo, na Elati, na Esioni‐Geberi. Erio tokaonchoka, tokagenda gochia ase erooro ya Moabu.”
english: So we went on past our brothers the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir. We turned from the Arabah road, which comes up from Elath and Ezion Geber, and traveled along the desert road of Moab.

ekegusii: Inki rende ekio? Nindigetie nsabe ase omoika, naende nindigetie nsabe ase obong’aini. Nindigetie ntere ase omoika, naende nindigetie ntere ase obong’aini.
english: So what shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind; I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.

ekegusii: Okwegena okwo ore nakwo, obe nakorokwo ase egati yao na Nyasae. Nasesenirie omonto oria otenachereti ekina ase ring’ana riria anchete.
english: So whatever you believe about these things keep between yourself and God. Blessed is the man who does not condemn himself by what he approves.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Ahiya aigwete eriogi ri’amagoro aye agotitiria, na ekero omokungu oria arenge gocha ase egesieri, Ahiya akamotebia, “Inchuo soa nyomba, aye moka Yeroboamu! Nase ki ogwekora koba buna omokungu omoao? Nachikirwe kogotebia amang’ana amakong’u.
english: So when Ahijah heard the sound of her footsteps at the door, he said, "Come in, wife of Jeroboam. Why this pretense? I have been sent to you with bad news.

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Nyasae asaretie emechie eyio y’ense eraire, akaba okoinyora Ibrahimu, akarusia Loti ase ogosarigwa koria, ekero asambete emechie eyio ase Loti amenyete.
english: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, he remembered Abraham, and he brought Lot out of the catastrophe that overthrew the cities where Lot had lived.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ekero narangeretigwe ngacha, tinaanga. Nkoboria nde: Ing’ana ki mwandangereretie?”
english: So when I was sent for, I came without raising any objection. May I ask why you sent for me?"

ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo arenge koirana korwa mogondo mogoroba, Lea akagenda komorotota, akamotebia, “Rero goika orare mwane, nakogorire namasooni ng’ombe ay’omwana one.” Ase obotuko obwo akarara nere.
english: So when Jacob came in from the fields that evening, Leah went out to meet him. "You must sleep with me," she said. "I have hired you with my son's mandrakes." So he slept with her that night.

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Yusufu achia goika ase abamwabo, barabwo bakamorusia eanga eria engiya entambe abegete,
english: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe-- the richly ornamented robe he was wearing--

ekegusii: Erio ekero Petero achete ase Yerusalemu, baria abare ensemo y’okwaroka bakaamererania nere,
english: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him

ekegusii: Erio kobasangererekanire, Pilato akababoria, “Norori morigetie mbasiborere, Baraba gose Yeso, oyo okorokwa Kristo?”
english: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, "Which one do you want me to release to you: Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?"

ekegusii: Erio Abamidiani bagaeta aroro, baare gokora oboonchoreria; abamwabo bakarusia Yusufu korwa ase engoro eria, na komooneria Abaisumaeli ase chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo ebere; barabwo bakamoira goika Misiri.
english: So when the Midianite merchants came by, his brothers pulled Joseph up out of the cistern and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto baimogete korwa ase chiema chiabo erinde bamboke Yorodan, abakuani bakabatang’ana, babogoretie Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana.
english: So when the people broke camp to cross the Jordan, the priests carrying the ark of the covenant went ahead of them.

ekegusii: Nabo ekero Abasamaria baria bachia komochiera, bakamosorora aikaranse amo nabarabwo; akabeera aroro amatuko abere.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.

ekegusii: Korende ekero engaki yaigete, Saulo arenge koa Daudi Merabu, omoiseke oye, akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, akaa Adirili Omomehola omoiseke oria akaba mokaye.
english: So when the time came for Merab, Saul's daughter, to be given to David, she was given in marriage to Adriel of Meholah.

ekegusii: Na ekero bakoorire endagera eria bagorete korwa Misiri, ise akabatebia, “Irana naende motogorere endagera nke toche koria.”
english: So when they had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, "Go back and buy us a little more food."

ekegusii: Erio ekero basangererekanete amo, bakamoboria, “Omonene, ekero eke nakio okoiraneria Abaisraeli oboruoti bwabo?”
english: So when they met together, they asked him, "Lord, are you at this time going to restore the kingdom to Israel?"

ekegusii: Bono ekero abe ritang’ani bacha, bagakaga ng’a barabwo nabaegwe kobua abande, bakanyora nabarabwo kera oyomo edinari eyemo.
english: So when those came who were hired first, they expected to receive more. But each one of them also received a denarius.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero totanyarete koremereria kobua, togancha gotigara Atene intwe tweka.
english: So when we could stand it no longer, we thought it best to be left by ourselves in Athens.

ekegusii: Aye omonto oyokogambia baria bogokora ayio, naye omonyene naro ayio ogokora, Inee, nokagete ng’a aye notame korwa ase ekina kia Nyasae?
english: So when you, a mere man, pass judgment on them and yet do the same things, do you think you will escape God's judgment?

ekegusii: Gaki komokoria, gose mokonywa gose mogokora ing’ana rinde rionsi, kora onsi ase obonene bwa Nyasae.
english: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all for the glory of God.

ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu anaaretie omochie, akabeka Uria aase amanyete ng’a naumerane nabarwani abatindi.
english: So while Joab had the city under siege, he put Uriah at a place where he knew the strongest defenders were.

ekegusii: Bono naki rende otaratogonyera Yeremia oyio okorwa Anatoti ogendererete kobabanera inwe?
english: So why have you not reprimanded Jeremiah from Anathoth, who poses as a prophet among you?

ekegusii: Bono ebisaku ebinge mbimokumie, na abaruoti nigo baramumekerie emenwa yabo ase engencho yaye, ekiagera mbarore amang’ana batana gotebigwa, na aya batana koigwa mbayamanye.
english: so will he sprinkle many nations, and kings will shut their mouths because of him. For what they were not told, they will see, and what they have not heard, they will understand.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio naro arabinyore ebisaku bire ase ense; ense nebe buna ekero emezeituni ekonyegerigwa ase okoarora amatunda, na buna ogochorwa kw’amazeituni amatigari.
english: So will it be on the earth and among the nations, as when an olive tree is beaten, or as when gleanings are left after the grape harvest.

ekegusii: Naboigo nokobokigwa kw’abakure. Osimekwa ase ogosareka, obokigwa ase ogotasareka.
english: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead. The body that is sown is perishable, it is raised imperishable;

ekegusii: Nabo nainwe bono nigo more nomoichano; korende nimbarore naende, ne chinkoro chiaino nachigoke, na omogoko oino onde tari orabaure.
english: So with you: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nainwe, kabe ang’e; naki nase ensa motakagereti nero Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arache.
english: So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.

ekegusii: So you also, when you have done everything you were told to do, should say, 'We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.'"
english: Naboigo nainwe, komorakore onsi aya mwachikirwe, teba: Intwe nabasomba bataisaneti; twakorire aya atogwenerete gokora.”

ekegusii: Ase igo, aye tori omosomba naende, korende Nyasae ogokorire koba omwana oye; na onye kwabeire omwana, naboigo kwabeire omonyamwando.
english: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, God has made you also an heir.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye genda aroro ase rituko ri’okweng’ata osomere abanto amang’ana onsi ay’Omonene korwa ase ebuku eye kwarika ekero narenge koyakwana. Obasomere aase baranyare koigwa buya, obasomere n’Abayuda bonsi abwo barache korwa ase emechie yabo.
english: So you go to the house of the LORD on a day of fasting and read to the people from the scroll the words of the LORD that you wrote as I dictated. Read them to all the people of Judah who come in from their towns.

ekegusii: Ase ayio okababeka ase amaboko ’ababisa babo, na barabwo bakabachanda. Ekero barenge ase emechando yabo, bakarera asore; aye okabaigwa agwo igoro; na ase engencho y’amabera ao amange, okabaa abatooria abwo bakabatooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo.
english: So you handed them over to their enemies, who oppressed them. But when they were oppressed they cried out to you. From heaven you heard them, and in your great compassion you gave them deliverers, who rescued them from the hand of their enemies.

ekegusii: Bono aye kwaganirie obonyaka bw’oboiseke bwao, buna ekero Abamisiri barenge kobwata‐bwata chimbeere chiao chiarenge echi’oboiseke bwao.
english: So you longed for the lewdness of your youth, when in Egypt your bosom was caressed and your young breasts fondled.

ekegusii: Gaki, amang’ana onsi bakobatebia, moyanare na koyabwata; korende buna barabwo bagokora, timokora.
english: So you must obey them and do everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.

ekegusii: Igo mwetebire inwe abanyene, ng’a inwe nabana babo more, baria baitete ababani.
english: So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.

ekegusii: So you testify that you approve of what your forefathers did; they killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
english: Naboigo inwe mwabeire abarori na gwanchera ogokora gwe chisokoro chiaino, ekiagera nabwo babaitete, na inwe mokoagacha chimbeera chiabo.

ekegusii: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me.
english: Nainwe boigo, goka, ee, goka amo nainche.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye ogachaberwa ne chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chianga chiao nigo chiarenge echi’egatani engiya, na echi’ariri, na echiroisirie chire nebieni ao ao. Boigo okaria endagera yaroiseretigwe nobosie obonuke, na okaria obooke, na amaguta. Erio okaba omonyakieni mono, ogasesenigwa, ogaikera ekerengo ki’oboruoti.
english: So you were adorned with gold and silver; your clothes were of fine linen and costly fabric and embroidered cloth. Your food was fine flour, honey and olive oil. You became very beautiful and rose to be a queen.

ekegusii: Goika morusie korwa asemore okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’omonto otari na komocha; mokore boronge ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: So you will purge from yourselves the guilt of shedding innocent blood, since you have done what is right in the eyes of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio chinderia chiaino inachimanye ng’a Omonene nabamenyetie inwe Abaisraeli ase ebigutu ekero nabang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: so your descendants will know that I had the Israelites live in booths when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.'"

ekegusii: Ase igo Zadoki na Abiatari bakabogoria Esanduku ya Nyasae; bakayeirania Yerusalemu, nabarabwo bakabeera aroro.
english: So Zadok and Abiathar took the ark of God back to Jerusalem and stayed there.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Zadoki omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Abakereti, na Abapeleti bagatirimboka, bakariinia Sulemani ase eyombo y’omoruoti, erio bakamoira Gihoni.
english: So Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites went down and put Solomon on King David's mule and escorted him to Gihon.

ekegusii: Abaiseke be Selefehadi bagakora buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: So Zelophehad's daughters did as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Simuri agasiria kegima enyomba yonsi ya Baasa, koreng’ana buna ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete mamincha ya Baasa goetera ase Yehu omobani.
english: So Zimri destroyed the whole family of Baasha, in accordance with the word of the LORD spoken against Baasha through the prophet Jehu--

ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna Omoika Omochenu ogokwana, “Rero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye,
english: So, as the Holy Spirit says: "Today, if you hear his voice,

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakaa Abalawi emechie gete amo namarisio arengeo korwa ase emiando yabo, koreng’ana buna Omonene achigete.
english: So, as the LORD had commanded, the Israelites gave the Levites the following towns and pasturelands out of their own inheritance:

ekegusii: Ase ayio Abayahudi bagachaka gochanda Yeso, bakarigia komoita, ekiagera akora aya ase rituko ri’Esabato.
english: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jews persecuted him.

ekegusii: Nabo, ekiagera ore igatwa, otari morero gose omokendu, ningotwe buna amate korwa ase omonwa one.
english: So, because you are lukewarm-- neither hot nor cold-- I am about to spit you out of my mouth.

ekegusii: Ase ayio oyogwekaga ng’a nateneine erende tagwa.
english: So, if you think you are standing firm, be careful that you don't fall!

ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, nainwe mwakwereire amachiko ase enchera y’omobere o Kristo, erinde monyare koba ab’omoao, abaye ere oyobogetigwe korwa ase abakure, erinde tomwamere Nyasae okwama.
english: So, my brothers, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, that you might belong to another, to him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit to God.

ekegusii: narenge nomogondo, akayoonia, akarenta chibesa, agachibeka ase amagoro ’abatomwa.
english: sold a field he owned and brought the money and put it at the apostles' feet.

ekegusii: Omoruoti Sulemani agasangereria amo chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa; nigo abwate chigari elifu eyemo, na amagana ane (1,400) ne chibarasi chikoriinwa chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000). Echinde ase echio nigo chiabegetwe ase emechie ye chigari, ne chinde chikabekwa Yerusalemu ang’e ase omoruoti amenyete.
english: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Sulemani agasangereria amo chigari ne chibarasi chikoriinwa; nigo abwate chigari elifu eyemo, na amagana ane, ne chibarasi chikoriinwa chilifu ikomi na ibere. Echinde ase echio nigo chiabegetwe ase emechie ye chigari, na echinde chikabekwa Yerusalemu, ang’e nase omoruoti amenyete.
english: Solomon accumulated chariots and horses; he had fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Sulemani nachorete abanto abanene ikomi na babere abarenge gosangereria endagera na koyerentera omoruoti amo nab’enyomba yaye. Kera oyomo ase aba ikomi na babere nigo arenge korenta endagera eisaine koriegwa ase omotienyi oyomo ase omwaka.
english: Solomon also had twelve district governors over all Israel, who supplied provisions for the king and the royal household. Each one had to provide supplies for one month in the year.

ekegusii: Boigo Sulemani akaroisia ebinto binde biare kobekwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae: egesasimero gi’etahabu, ne chimesa ase emegati eyare koruegwa ase Nyasae yare kobekwa,
english: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in God's temple: the golden altar; the tables on which was the bread of the Presence;

ekegusii: Boigo Sulemani akaroisia ebinto binde bionsi biare kobekwa ase enyomba y’Omonene; egesasimero gi’etahabu, na emesa y’etahabu ase emegati yare koruegwa ase Nyasae yare kobekwa.
english: Solomon also made all the furnishings that were in the LORD's temple: the golden altar; the golden table on which was the bread of the Presence;

ekegusii: Sulemani akamoiraneria amaborio aye onsi; nonya ne ring’ana erimo tiriabisekanete ase Sulemani; nigo amanyete onsi na komoyorokia.
english: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for him to explain to her.

ekegusii: Sulemani akamoiraneria amaborio aye onsi; nonya ne ring’ana erimo tiriabisekanete ase omoruoti, igo amanyete onsi na komoyorokia.
english: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too hard for the king to explain to her.

ekegusii: Sulemani akairaneria Nyasae, “Aye nkwaorogetie obwanchani obonene botari koera ase Daudi tata, na inche kwambekire nabeire omoruoti ribaga riaye.
english: Solomon answered God, "You have shown great kindness to David my father and have made me king in his place.

ekegusii: Sulemani agateba, “Aye kworokirie obwanchani obonene botari koera ase omosomba oo Daudi tata, ekiagera igo ataarete ase obosio bwao ase obwegenwa, na oboronge, na ekeene gi’enkoro yaye. Naye kwagendereire komworokia obwanchani obonene botari koera, kwamoeire omwana omomura aikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti, buna ere rero iga.
english: Solomon answered, "You have shown great kindness to your servant, my father David, because he was faithful to you and righteous and upright in heart. You have continued this great kindness to him and have given him a son to sit on his throne this very day.

ekegusii: Sulemani akang’anyia mokaye, mosubati o Farao, korwa ase Omochie o Daudi gochia ase enyomba eria amoagacherete, ekiagera nigo atebete, “Omokungu oyo takomenya ase enyomba ya Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, ekiagera aase agwo ase Esanduku y’Omonene yarentirwe naachenu.”
english: Solomon brought Pharaoh's daughter up from the City of David to the palace he had built for her, for he said, "My wife must not live in the palace of David king of Israel, because the places the ark of the LORD has entered are holy."

ekegusii: Sulemani agaatanana na gochena obogati‐gati bw’eraaro eria yarenge bosio bw’enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo nao aruerete ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, ekiagera egesasimero gi’etaai keria Sulemani aroisetie tikiarenge konyara goisana ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ebitinya.
english: Solomon consecrated the middle part of the courtyard in front of the temple of the LORD, and there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the fellowship offerings, because the bronze altar he had made could not hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat portions.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaooma Hekalu ime netahabu engiya. Chingataare chiaoomire netahabu chikabekwa ase egesieri bosio bw’akanyomba ka ime.
english: Solomon covered the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaroberia koagachera erieta ri’Omonene Hekalu, naende eagachere enyomba yaye y’oboruoti.
english: Solomon gave orders to build a temple for the Name of the LORD and a royal palace for himself.

ekegusii: Sulemani nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu agwo Baali‐Hamoni, akayotigera abarendi, na kera omorendi nigo arenge korenta chibesa chie chifeta elifu eyemo goakanera amatunda.
english: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal Hamon; he let out his vineyard to tenants. Each was to bring for its fruit a thousand shekels of silver.

ekegusii: Sulemani nabwate ameri e chibarasi chilifu emerongo ene chiarenge kong’usa chigari, ne chibarasi chiare koriinwa, chilifu ikomi na ibere.
english: Solomon had four thousand stalls for chariot horses, and twelve thousand horses.

ekegusii: Sulemani nigo abwate ameeri chilifu inye (4,000) aye chibarasi, ne chigari, ne chibarasi chiare koriinwa chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000). Echinde ase echio nigo chiabegetwe ase emechie ye chigari, na echinde ase omoruoti amenyete agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horses, which he kept in the chariot cities and also with him in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Boigo Sulemani nabwate abanto chilifu emerongo etano na ebere (70,000) abarenge kobogoria chigurube, na abanto chilifu emerongo etano na etato (80,000) abarenge kobaacha amagena agwo ase ebitunwa.
english: Solomon had seventy thousand carriers and eighty thousand stonecutters in the hills,

ekegusii: Sulemani agatiga korenga ebinto ebi bionsi, ekiagera biarenge ebinge mono. Oborito bw’etaai eria tibwamanyekanete buna bwang’ana.
english: Solomon left all these things unweighed, because there were so many; the weight of the bronze was not determined.

ekegusii: Sulemani agakora oboamate na Farao, omoruoti o Misiri. Akanyuoma omoiseke o Farao, akamorenta ase Omochie o Daudi akamenya aroro goika ekero akoorete koagacha enyomba yaye omonyene amo nenyomba y’Omonene ne chindwaki chiaetanaine Yerusalemu.
english: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt and married his daughter. He brought her to the City of David until he finished building his palace and the temple of the LORD, and the wall around Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Sulemani akarua ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase Omonene, chiombe chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, ne chingondi chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ebere. Naboigo omoruoti amo nabanto bonsi bagaatanana enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Solomon offered a sacrifice of fellowship offerings to the LORD: twenty-two thousand cattle and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep and goats. So the king and all the Israelites dedicated the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: akaagacha naende emechie eria Huramu amoete, erio akabeka Abaisraeli aroro bayemenye.
english: Solomon rebuilt the villages that Hiram had given him, and settled Israelites in them.

ekegusii: Engaki Sulemani agambete agwo Yerusalemu igoro ase Abaisraeli nemiaka emerongo ene.
english: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

ekegusii: Sulemani akagamba agwo Yerusalemu igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi ase emiaka emerongo ene.
english: Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.

ekegusii: Sulemani agateba, “Karanyorekane ore omonto bw’ekeene, nonya nagatukia akamo k’omotwe oye tigakogwa inse; korende obobe koboranyorekane asare, goika akwe.”
english: Solomon replied, "If he shows himself to be a worthy man, not a hair of his head will fall to the ground; but if evil is found in him, he will die."

ekegusii: Na Sulemani agatoma amang’ana ase Hiramu, akabora,
english: Solomon sent back this message to Hiram:

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agatoma amang’ana ase Huramu, omoruoti o Turo, akamotebia, “Buna kwarenge gokorera Daudi tata, kware komotomera emete y’emecharake na ere akeagachera enyomba amenyete ime, inkorera nainche boigo.
english: Solomon sent this message to Hiram king of Tyre: "Send me cedar logs as you did for my father David when you sent him cedar to build a palace to live in.

ekegusii: Sulemani nigo anchete Omonene, akabwatia emeroberio Daudi achigete, korende nigo aruete ebing’wanso na gosamba ubani agwo aase aimokererete igoro.
english: Solomon showed his love for the LORD by walking according to the statutes of his father David, except that he offered sacrifices and burned incense on the high places.

ekegusii: Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, akanyora chinguru ase oboruoti bwaye, na Omonene, Nyasae oye, nigo arenge amo nere, na akamokora akaba omonene mono.
english: Solomon son of David established himself firmly over his kingdom, for the LORD his God was with him and made him exceedingly great.

ekegusii: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, Abijah the father of Asa,
english: na Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya, na Abiya akaibora Asa,

ekegusii: Solomon then went to Hamath Zobah and captured it.
english: Erio Sulemani akagenda koira orogongo rwa Hamati na Soba,

ekegusii: Sulemani akabara na korika abasacha abamenyi bonsi barenge ase ense y’Abaisraeli buna Daudi ise akorete, akanyora ng’a nigo barenge abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na isato, na amagana atano na rimo (153,600).
english: Solomon took a census of all the aliens who were in Israel, after the census his father David had taken; and they were found to be 153,600.

ekegusii: Sulemani akarigia goita Yeroboamu, korende Yeroboamu akaimoka, agatama gochia Misiri, ase Sisaki, omoruoti o Misiri, akamenya agwo Misiri goika ekero Sulemani akwete.
english: Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam fled to Egypt, to Shishak the king, and stayed there until Solomon's death.

ekegusii: Agwo Sulemani agatiira gochia ase egesasimero keria kiarenge agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, na igoro yaye akaruera Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa elifu eyemo.
english: Solomon went up to the bronze altar before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.

ekegusii: Endagera Sulemani arenge korenterwa ase rituko erimo nigo yarenge: obosie obonuke, ebitonga amagana atato, na obosie bonde, ebitonga amagana atano na rimo,
english: Solomon's daily provisions were thirty cors of fine flour and sixty cors of meal,

ekegusii: Chibarasi chikarentwa ase Sulemani korwa Misiri na korwa ase chinse chionsi.
english: Solomon's horses were imported from Egypt and from all other countries.

ekegusii: Sulemani nigo arenge korenterwa chibarasi korwa Misiri na Kue; na abaonchoreria baye igo barenge gochirenta korwa agwo ase ogoakana rigori gete.
english: Solomon's horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue--the royal merchants purchased them from Kue.

ekegusii: Sulemani nigo arenge korenterwa chibarasi korwa Misiri na korwa Kue; na abaonchoreria baye nigo barenge gochirenta korwa agwo ase ogochiakanera rigori gete.
english: Solomon's horses were imported from Egypt and from Kue--the royal merchants purchased them from Kue.

ekegusii: Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
english: Ororeria rwa Sulemani narwo oro: Sulemani akaibora Rehoboamu, na Rehoboamu akaibora Abiya; Abiya akaibora Asa, na Asa akaibora Yehosafati;

ekegusii: Solomon's Song of Songs.
english: Ogotera okuya gwa Sulemani.

ekegusii: Obong’aini bwa Sulemani nigo bwabuete obw’abanto bonsi ba Moocha na obw’Abamisiri bonsi.
english: Solomon's wisdom was greater than the wisdom of all the men of the East, and greater than all the wisdom of Egypt.

ekegusii: Abande bakaririeka, ekiagera babwatetie enchera y’ogosareka, na bakaba bagochandeka ase engencho y’ebibe biabo.
english: Some became fools through their rebellious ways and suffered affliction because of their iniquities.

ekegusii: Abwo ritina riabo riarenge ase ense y’Abaameleki, bagatirimboka korwa ase Efraimu, abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin bagakobwatia. Abatang’ani b’abarwani bagatirimboka korwa Makiri, na abarenge abariki ase esegi korwa Sabuloni.
english: Some came from Ephraim, whose roots were in Amalek; Benjamin was with the people who followed you. From Makir captains came down, from Zebulun those who bear a commander's staff.

ekegusii: Abande bakabora, “Nere”; abande bakabora, “Yaya, nigo agwekaine nere.” Ere omonyene akabora, “Ninche ere.”
english: Some claimed that he was. Others said, "No, he only looks like him." But he himself insisted, "I am the man."

ekegusii: Some distance from them a large herd of pigs was feeding.
english: Riicho rie chimbeche chinyinge ndiarenge egeka, rikorisia.

ekegusii: Abande bagachandeka ase ogochecherigwa na goakwa chinkini, naende bagasibwa nebinyuri na kobekwa chichela ime.
english: Some faced jeers and flogging, while still others were chained and put in prison.

ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, chikamera, chikoma ase okomocha amache.
english: Some fell on rock, and when it came up, the plants withered because they had no moisture.

ekegusii: na echinde chikagwa ase egetare, aase amaroba arenge amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.
english: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.

ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa aase egetare kere, aase amaroba are amake; chikamera bwango, ekiagera amaroba arenge amake.
english: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.

ekegusii: Abagadi bande bakagenda kobwatia Daudi agwo ase eburi yarenge ase erooro. Abanto aba nigo barenge chituoni, bamanyete korwana chisegi, naende nigo bamanyete korwanera chinguba na amatimo. Amasio abo nigo arenge buna aye chindo, naende nigo barenge kominyoka buna chingabi igoro y’ebitunwa.
english: Some Gadites defected to David at his stronghold in the desert. They were brave warriors, ready for battle and able to handle the shield and spear. Their faces were the faces of lions, and they were as swift as gazelles in the mountains.

ekegusii: Some have in fact already turned away to follow Satan.
english: Naki abande bairanire nyuma, na gotunyana Saitani.

ekegusii: Abande bamochete ayio, batantanire na koonchokera ogokwana kwa bosa.
english: Some have wandered away from these and turned to meaningless talk.

ekegusii: Abande babekwe babe abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na abande b’emerongo etano. Abande babe bakorema emegondo yaye na kogesa endagera yaye, abande babe bakoroisia ebirwanero bi’esegi na ebikorero bie chigari chiaye.
english: Some he will assign to be commanders of thousands and commanders of fifties, and others to plow his ground and reap his harvest, and still others to make weapons of war and equipment for his chariots.

ekegusii: Abaibirania bande bakaamboka Yorodan, bakagenda ase ense ya Gadi na Gileadi. Korende Saulo ere nao atigarete agwo Giligali, na abanto bonsi abamotunyanete baare koiguswa ase obwoba.
english: Some Hebrews even crossed the Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul remained at Gilgal, and all the troops with him were quaking with fear.

ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagaaka eriogi bagoteba iga, na abande iga. Ekero atanyarete komanya oboronge bw’amang’ana aria ase engencho y’egeturi keria, agachika arentwe ime ase enyomba y’abarwani.
english: Some in the crowd shouted one thing and some another, and since the commander could not get at the truth because of the uproar, he ordered that Paul be taken into the barracks.

ekegusii: Abande b’Abayahudi, abaseria b’ebirecha, abarenge abaetanani, bagateema gwatora erieta ri’Omonene Yeso igoro y’ababwatire nebirecha ebibe, bagoteba, “Twabitianirie ase Yeso oria okorandigwa na Paulo.”
english: Some Jews who went around driving out evil spirits tried to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who were demon-possessed. They would say, "In the name of Jesus, whom Paul preaches, I command you to come out."

ekegusii: Some men brought to him a paralytic, lying on a mat. When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, "Take heart, son; your sins are forgiven."
english: Na rigereria, bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata, oraire borere; na Yeso, ekero achia korora okwegena kwabo, agatebia oria rigata, “Remia enkoro, omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

ekegusii: Abanto bande bagacha bagatebia Yehosafati “Omoganda omonene mono bw’abanto korwa Edomu, ng’umbu y’enyancha ngocha ore gokorwania esegi; rora nao bare agwo Hasasoni‐Tamari (noro Eni‐Gedi).
english: Some men came and told Jehoshaphat, "A vast army is coming against you from Edom, from the other side of the Sea. It is already in Hazazon Tamar" (that is, En Gedi).

ekegusii: Na rigereria, abanto mbabogoretie noborere omonto orenge rigata, bakarigia komoira nyomba ime na komobeka ase obosio bwaye.
english: Some men came carrying a paralytic on a mat and tried to take him into the house to lay him before Jesus.

ekegusii: Abanto gete batirimbogete korwa Boyahudi bakorokereria abaminto ng’a, “Motarogeti koreng’ana buna Musa atochigete, timokonyara gotooreka.”
english: Some men came down from Judea to Antioch and were teaching the brothers: "Unless you are circumcised, according to the custom taught by Moses, you cannot be saved."

ekegusii: Abanto bagacha; bakamorentera omonto orenge rigata obogoirie nabanto bane.
english: Some men came, bringing to him a paralytic, carried by four of them.

ekegusii: Nabo abande b’aborokigwa baye bagatebania, “Ing’ana ki eri agoteba: Nkere ekero egeke, inwe motandore; naende nkere ekero egeke morandore; na: Nkogenda nde ase Tata?”
english: Some of his disciples said to one another, "What does he mean by saying, 'In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me,' and 'Because I am going to the Father'?"

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bande barenge gokwana amang’ana igoro ye Hekalu, buna echabeire namagena amaya na ebiegwa, agateba.
english: Some of his disciples were remarking about how the temple was adorned with beautiful stones and with gifts dedicated to God. But Jesus said,

ekegusii: Abande b’aborokigwa ba Kaisaria bakagenda amo naintwe, bagatoira mwa Mnasoni, omonto o Kuporo, omworokigwa o kare, tokarara bwoye.
english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea accompanied us and brought us to the home of Mnason, where we were to stay. He was a man from Cyprus and one of the early disciples.

ekegusii: Ebiombe binde bi’Abalawi ebiamenyete ase ense y’Abayuda bikaba bikobarwa amo nabanto ba Benjamin.
english: Some of the divisions of the Levites of Judah settled in Benjamin.

ekegusii: Abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli bagacha asende, bagaikaransa ase obosio bwane.
english: Some of the elders of Israel came to me and sat down in front of me.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, abagaaka bande b’ense eria bagatenena, bagakwana nabanto basangererekanete agwo, bakabatebia,
english: Some of the elders of the land stepped forward and said to the entire assembly of people,

ekegusii: Abateneneri bande be chiamate chiabo mbaruete ebiegwa ase ogokorera emeremo. Omogavuna akabeka ase ekungo ebisamunye bie chitahabu bikorokwa chidariki, elifu eyemo (1,000), ne chisani emerongo etano (50), ne chianga chi’abakuani, amagana atano, na emerongo etato (530).
english: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the work. The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 drachmas of gold, 50 bowls and 530 garments for priests.

ekegusii: Abatang’ani bande be chinyomba chinde bakarua ase ekungo eyio y’ogokorerwa emeremo, ebisamunye bie chitahabu, chidariki chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000), na ebie chifeta bikorokwa chimina, chilifu ibere, na amagana abere (2,200).
english: Some of the heads of the families gave to the treasury for the work 20,000 drachmas of gold and 2,200 minas of silver.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o gatano na kabere bw’okogamba kw’Aritasasita omoruoti, abande b’Abaisraeli, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abateri, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, bakagenda Yerusalemu.
english: Some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers and temple servants, also came up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes.

ekegusii: Abande bakang’useka, bakabwatana na Paulo na Sila, naboigo Abagiriki abange abasigete Nyasae amo nabakungu abasike batai bake.
english: Some of the Jews were persuaded and joined Paul and Silas, as did a large number of God-fearing Greeks and not a few prominent women.

ekegusii: Na abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati bakaegwa emechie korwa ase orogongo rw’egesaku gi’Efraimu.
english: Some of the Kohathite clans were given as their territory towns from the tribe of Ephraim.

ekegusii: Abanto bande b’egesaku kia Manase bagatama, bakagenda ase Daudi ekero arenge kogenda amo n’Abafilisti korwania Saulo. Korende Abafilisti tibaete Daudi ribaga abakonye, ekiagera ekero abagambi babo bagambete amo, bagateba, “Aise kogenda amo naintwe, ande nigo arabwatane amo na Saulo, omonene oye, igo batobutore emetwe.”
english: Some of the men of Manasseh defected to David when he went with the Philistines to fight against Saul. (He and his men did not help the Philistines because, after consultation, their rulers sent him away. They said, "It will cost us our heads if he deserts to his master Saul.")

ekegusii: Naende make ay’amaguta ayio are roe rwaye agindie igoro ase amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha agindire: Mesia y’ogoto kwa borio kw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa, na ekiara ekenene gi’okoboko kwaye kwa borio, na ekiara ekenene gi’okogoro kwaye kwa borio.
english: Some of the oil in his palm he is to put on the same places he put the blood of the guilt offering-- on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

ekegusii: Korende abande ase Abafarisai bakababoria, “Naki mogokora eritari borongo gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
english: Some of the Pharisees asked, "Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?"

ekegusii: Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge ase omosangererekano bakamotebia, “Omworokia, togonyera aborokigwa bao!”
english: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to Jesus, "Teacher, rebuke your disciples!"

ekegusii: Erio abande b’Abafarisai bakabora, “Omonto oyo tarwete ase Nyasae, ekiagera tabwateti Esabato.” Abande bakabora, “Naki omonto omonyene ebibe aranyare gokora ebikone buna ebi?” Ogwatananekana gokaba ase egati yabo.
english: Some of the Pharisees said, "This man is not from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath." But others asked, "How can a sinner do such miraculous signs?" So they were divided.

ekegusii: Ebinto binde biasakoretwe ekero gi’esegi bigaatananwa bikaba ebiegwa ase ogokorerwa emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Some of the plunder taken in battle they dedicated for the repair of the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio abande ase Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bakobora ng’a okobokigwa tikori,
english: Some of the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus with a question.

ekegusii: Abande ase aborokia b’amariko bakairaneria, “Omworokia, gwakwanire buya.”
english: Some of the teachers of the law responded, "Well said, teacher!"

ekegusii: Abande b’abwo bare abang’aini nabanyorwe nemechando eyio, erinde ogocheneka kobe ase egati yabo, basibeke goika engaki y’omoerio oyo oraike ase engaki eria echikire.
english: Some of the wise will stumble, so that they may be refined, purified and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.

ekegusii: Boigo abande bamwabo b’eamate ya Kohati bagatenenera emeremo y’okoroisia emegati yarenge koruegwa ase Omonene kera Esabato.
english: Some of their Kohathite brothers were in charge of preparing for every Sabbath the bread set out on the table.

ekegusii: Abalawi bande nabwo batenenerete ebikorero bi’emeremo, ekiagera nigo baganeirie kobibara ekero biarenge korentwa ime, na ekero biarenge koirwa isiko ase emeremo.
english: Some of them were in charge of the articles used in the temple service; they counted them when they were brought in and when they were taken out.

ekegusii: Bakamotega Yeso, barore gose nagwenie omonto oria ase rituko ri’Esabato, banyare komosoera.
english: Some of them were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal him on the Sabbath.

ekegusii: Korende mbarengeo ase egati yabo abanto ba Kuporo na Kurene, barabwo ekero bachia goika Antiokia bagakwana n’Abagiriki, bakabaranderia amang’ana amaya igoro y’Omonene Yeso.
english: Some of them, however, men from Cyprus and Cyrene, went to Antioch and began to speak to Greeks also, telling them the good news about the Lord Jesus.

ekegusii: Mbarengeo abanto bagechetigwe ase emioyo yabo, bakabora, “Nase ki ogosiria amaguta engencho buna eye?
english: Some of those present were saying indignantly to one another, "Why this waste of perfume?

ekegusii: Abande asemore baenenire ekiagera bakagire ng’a tindi gocha asemore.
english: Some of you have become arrogant, as if I were not coming to you.

ekegusii: Abwo nabwo bare enchera ensemo; aase ring’ana rikobusurwa, na barabwo kobaikire koriigwa, bwango Saitani ocha orusia ring’ana riria riabusuirwe ase emioyo yabo ime.
english: Some people are like seed along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.

ekegusii: Abanto bande bateneine aroro, bakababoria, “Inki ekio mogokora, mogosibora emori y’etigere?”
english: some people standing there asked, "What are you doing, untying that colt?"

ekegusii: Abanto bagaeta aase aria, bakarora omobere otugutire ase enchera, na endo eteneine mbarabare ase omobere oria. Barabwo bakagenda bagateba amang’ana ayio ase abanto b’omochie, agwo ase omobani oria omogotu amenyete.
english: Some people who passed by saw the body thrown down there, with the lion standing beside the body, and they went and reported it in the city where the old prophet lived.

ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoboria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto gotiga mokaye?” Bakamoteema.
english: Some Pharisees came and tested him by asking, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?"

ekegusii: Abafarisai bakamochiera, bakamoteema ase okomoboria, “Inee! Mboronge omonto atige mokaye ase ring’ana rinde rionsi?”
english: Some Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, "Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any and every reason?"

ekegusii: Abande ase Abafarisai abarenge amo nere bakaigwa aya, bakamoboria, “Inee! Naintwe nigo tore emeuko?”
english: Some Pharisees who were with him heard him say this and asked, "What? Are we blind too?"

ekegusii: Abafilisti bande bakarenta ebiegwa ase Yehosafati, amo ne chifeta chikaba ebango. Abaarabu boigo bakamorentera chimingichi chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana atano na abere (7,700), ne chigoree chilifu isano na ibere, na amagana atano na abere (7,700).
english: Some Philistines brought Jehoshaphat gifts and silver as tribute, and the Arabs brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred goats.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakoumora chitahabu korwa emebuko yabo na korenga chifeta nekerengero, erio baakanera omoturi bw’etahabu, nere oyeroisia yaba enyasae, na abanto abwo batung’ama bosio bw’enyasae eyio bayesasima.
english: Some pour out gold from their bags and weigh out silver on the scales; they hire a goldsmith to make it into a god, and they bow down and worship it.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bamenyete ase omosunte na ase ekiriri ki’amakweri, nigo basibire ase emechando, basibeire chingataare,
english: Some sat in darkness and the deepest gloom, prisoners suffering in iron chains,

ekegusii: Erio abarisia b’aroro bagacha bakabaseria, korende Musa agatenena agakonya abaiseke baria na kobanyoiseria riicho riabo.
english: Some shepherds came along and drove them away, but Moses got up and came to their rescue and watered their flock.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya Yeso akagenda ng’umbu y’enyancha ya Galili, nero enyancha ya Tiberia.
english: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),

ekegusii: Naki ase amatuko aetire Theuda naimoka, agetogia ng’a ere nomonto omonene; abanto koreng’ana amagana ane bakabwatana nere, korende ere agaitwa, na abatunyani baye bonsi bagaserebekana, bagasira.
english: Some time ago Theudas appeared, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men rallied to him. He was killed, all his followers were dispersed, and it all came to nothing.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amang’ana ayio kaerire Ibrahimu agatebigwa ng’a, “Milka oiboreire momura omino Nahori abana.
english: Some time later Abraham was told, "Milcah is also a mother; she has borne sons to your brother Nahor:

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, Nyasae akabekera Ibrahimu ogoteemwa. Akamorangeria, “Ibrahimu!” Na Ibrahimu akamoitabera. “Nao inde aa.”
english: Some time later God tested Abraham. He said to him, "Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoashi akagania koroisia enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Some time later Joash decided to restore the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekaba engaki nyuma y’ayio Yusufu agatebigwa ng’a, “Iso nomorwaire.” Erio akaimokia abana baye babere abamura, Manase na Efraimu, bakagenda komorora.
english: Some time later Joseph was told, "Your father is ill." So he took his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim along with him.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko amake Paulo agatebia Barnaba, “Toirane, tochie korora abaminto ase kera omochie twarandirie ring’ana ri’Omonene, gose mbuya bare.”
english: Some time later Paul said to Barnabas, "Let us go back and visit the brothers in all the towns where we preached the word of the Lord and see how they are doing."

ekegusii: Nyuma yaye akaibora omwana omoiseke, akamoroka Dina.
english: Some time later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’engaki enke akarooche karia kagakama, ekiagera embura tiyarenge gotwa ase ense.
english: Some time later the brook dried up because there had been no rain in the land.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio omwana omomura bw’omokungu oria omoboraka, omwarigania bw’Elija, akarwara. Oborwaire bw’omwana oria bokaba obonene goika bokamoita,
english: Some time later the son of the woman who owned the house became ill. He grew worse and worse, and finally stopped breathing.

ekegusii: Naboti Omoyesireeli nabwate omogondo bw’emesabibu agwo Yesireeli, ang’e nenyomba y’Ahabu, omoruoti bw’Abasamaria.
english: Some time later there was an incident involving a vineyard belonging to Naboth the Jezreelite. The vineyard was in Jezreel, close to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, Beni‐Hadadi, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, akaroberia abarwani baye b’esegi, akagenda akanaaria omochie o Samaria.
english: Some time later, Ben-Hadad king of Aram mobilized his entire army and marched up and laid siege to Samaria.

ekegusii: Naende nyuma y’ayio Samison akaba ogwancha omokungu ore korokwa Delila, omenyete ase ense omweya ya Soreki.
english: Some time later, he fell in love with a woman in the Valley of Sorek whose name was Delilah.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya ndiarenge Rituko Rinene ri’Abayahudi; Yeso agatiira kogenda Yerusalemu.
english: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for a feast of the Jews.

ekegusii: Ekaba nyuma y’amang’ana ayio, omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa bia Farao na omoteneneri oye bw’abaroisia emegati bakamochera omonene obo, omoruoti o Misiri.
english: Some time later, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their master, the king of Egypt.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’engaki enke akairana gochia komwoyia, akagobera enchera ensemo gochia korora ribego ri’endo eria, akanyora omwereri bwe chinchoke chibwate obooke ime ye ribego riria.
english: Some time later, when he went back to marry her, he turned aside to look at the lion's carcass. In it was a swarm of bees and some honey,

ekegusii: Engaki egaika, ekero Abaamoni bachagete korwania Abaisraeli.
english: Some time later, when the Ammonites made war on Israel,

ekegusii: Abanto bande nigo basemeretie chigari chi’esegi, na abande chibarasi chi’esegi, korende intwe nigo tosemeretie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oito.
english: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babete bakonagoetanana ase erooro enyomo, tibanyorete mochie onde ase baare komenya.
english: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no way to a city where they could settle.

ekegusii: Abande ase barabwo bakarigia komobwata; korende monto onde taramborete okoboko kwaye erinde amobwate.
english: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.

ekegusii: Some were convinced by what he said, but others would not believe.
english: Abande bagancha ayakwanete, abande tibayaancha.

ekegusii: Abande bagateba, “Intwe amo nabana baito, abamura na abaiseke, nigo tore abange, ntoganetie tonyore endagera torie, erinde togenderere koba moyo.”
english: Some were saying, "We and our sons and daughters are numerous; in order for us to eat and stay alive, we must get grain."

ekegusii: Mbarengeo abakungu barigereretie korwa are. Ase abwo nigo barenge Mariamu Magidalena na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo omoke na Yose, na Salome.
english: Some women were watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joses, and Salome.

ekegusii: Abanto bande abachorochombu, abanto ababe, bagasangererekana ase Yeroboamu, bakaba abaengereria abakong’u ase Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, ekero Rehoboamu arenge omoyia ataranara emeremo yaye, na tarenge konyara kobabua.
english: Some worthless scoundrels gathered around him and opposed Rehoboam son of Solomon when he was young and indecisive and not strong enough to resist them.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’emiaka emeke akagenda ase Ahabu agwo Samaria. Nere akanyenyera Yehosafati, amo nabanto barenge amo nere, ching’ondi chinyinge ne chiombe; erio akamoebereria agende amo nere korwania Ramoti o Gileadi.
english: Some years later he went down to visit Ahab in Samaria. Ahab slaughtered many sheep and cattle for him and the people with him and urged him to attack Ramoth Gilead.

ekegusii: Abande bagasekereria, bagoteba, “Nigo batindire nedivai enyia.”
english: Some, however, made fun of them and said, "They have had too much wine."

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo akamoboria, “Omonene, barabwo abaratoorigwe nabake?” Akabatebia,
english: Someone asked him, "Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?" He said to them,

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo ase omoganda akamotebia, “Omworokia, tebia momura ominto anyatanere omwando oito.”
english: Someone in the crowd said to him, "Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me."

ekegusii: Korende onye oboene obonge bwa Nyasae bwamentekire ase obonene bwaye ase engencho y’oborimo bwane, nase ki inche nonya mbono nkona‐kogambigwa buna omonyene ebibe?
english: Someone might argue, "If my falsehood enhances God's truthfulness and so increases his glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?"

ekegusii: Tiga ere arusie enyimbo yaye korwa asende; okogosa kwaye tikobaisa kong’ondokia.
english: someone to remove God's rod from me, so that his terror would frighten me no more.

ekegusii: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you."
english: Akairerwa amang’ana agatebigwa, “Nyoko na bamura bamino mbateneine isiko, baganetie kororana naye.”

ekegusii: Someone told him, "Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to you."
english: Omonto oyomo akamotebia, “Rora, nyoko na bamura bamino mbateneine isiko, barigetie gokwana naye.”

ekegusii: Chingaki chinde riire riria nigo riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria korwa mogoroba goika mambia rioka. Ekero kende gionsi riire riarenge koimokerera igoro, abanto nigo barenge gochaka orogendo rwabo. Onye riarenge kobeera agwo omobaso na obotuko goika ekero riarenge koimokerera igoro naende, abanto nigo barenge gochaka orogendo ekero ekio.
english: Sometimes the cloud stayed only from evening till morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they set out. Whether by day or by night, whenever the cloud lifted, they set out.

ekegusii: Ase chingaki chinde riire riria nigo riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko amake oka. Buna Omonene achigete, abanto nigo baare kobeera ase egetwori, naende ekero Omonene arenge kobachika, bachaka kogenda ase orogendo rwabo.
english: Sometimes the cloud was over the tabernacle only a few days; at the LORD's command they would encamp, and then at his command they would set out.

ekegusii: Engaki ende mokarorerigwa ase okoramwa na ogochandwa maiso marore, na engaki ende mokabwatana nabwo bakoreretwe ayio.
english: Sometimes you were publicly exposed to insult and persecution; at other times you stood side by side with those who were so treated.

ekegusii: Sama korwa Harari na Ahiamu, mosinto o Sharari, korwa Harari;
english: son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam son of Sharar the Hararite,

ekegusii: Rora, abana nigo bare omwando okorwa ase Omonene, ekiagera oroiboro rokorwa ase enda nigo rore ekeegwa.
english: Sons are a heritage from the LORD, children a reward from him.

ekegusii: Shemu, oyorenge sokororia bw’abana bonsi b’Eberi, naende orenge omomura omonene omwabo Yafeti, akaiborerwa abana.
english: Sons were also born to Shem, whose older brother was Japheth; Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura Daudi aiboreretwe agwo Heburoni: Aminoni nere orenge omwana oye omotangi, omwana bw’Ahinoamu korwa Yesireeli.
english: Sons were born to David in Hebron: His firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;

ekegusii: Saharaimu akaibora abana abamura ase ense ya Moabu ekero konya aseririe Husimu na Baara, abakungu baye.
english: Sons were born to Shaharaim in Moab after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara.

ekegusii: Nyuma ase aya akagenda omochie okorokwa Naini; aborokigwa baye bakagenda amo nere, na abanto abange.
english: Soon afterward, Jesus went to a town called Nain, and his disciples and a large crowd went along with him.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagachiera omoruoti, bakamoboria, “Nase ki Abayuda baminto bakoibete aye na eamate yao, na abanto bao bonsi, na kobaambokia Yorodan?”
english: Soon all the men of Israel were coming to the king and saying to him, "Why did our brothers, the men of Judah, steal the king away and bring him and his household across the Jordan, together with all his men?"

ekegusii: Omochie bwonsi ogaichorwa neburu‐buru, bakabwata Gayo na Aristarko, abanto ba Makedonia, baare gotaara amo na Paulo, bakabakurura na bakaminyoka amo gochia aase chigosori chigokorerwa.
english: Soon the whole city was in an uproar. The people seized Gaius and Aristarchus, Paul's traveling companions from Macedonia, and rushed as one man into the theater.

ekegusii: Omoichano nigo ore omuya kobua amaseko, ekiagera omoichano okororekana ase obosio nigo ogokora enkoro yaba nomogoko.
english: Sorrow is better than laughter, because a sad face is good for the heart.

ekegusii: twaichanigwe, korende amatuko onsi nigo tore nomogoko; tore abataka, korende twabatenenkirie abange, titori na gento, nonya nabo ntore nebinto bionsi.
english: sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; poor, yet making many rich; having nothing, and yet possessing everything.

ekegusii: Mobugie egetureri ase rituko ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ekero oorokire omogima, ase ogosika rituko riaito ri’omoyega richikire.
english: Sound the ram's horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our Feast;

ekegusii: Ebusurere oboronge, mogese ayare ay’obwanchani, eremere chimbuna chiaino, ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okomorigia Omonene, erinde ache abatwerie oboronge buna embura egotwa.
english: Sow for yourselves righteousness, reap the fruit of unfailing love, and break up your unplowed ground; for it is time to seek the LORD, until he comes and showers righteousness on you.

ekegusii: Busura embusuro yao mambia, nonya mogoroba totiga koyebusura, ekiagera tomanyeti eye erame, neye gose neria, gose nchionsi amo chirame buya.
english: Sow your seed in the morning, and at evening let not your hands be idle, for you do not know which will succeed, whether this or that, or whether both will do equally well.

ekegusii: Kwana bo, na kora boigo, buna abanto barache kogambigwa ase amachiko ’obosibore.
english: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom,

ekegusii: Kwana amang’ana ’obwororo ase Yerusalemu, moyorarerie ng’a emechando yaye yaerire, na ebibe biaye biabeirwe, naende ng’a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere korwa ase okoboko kw’Omonene ase ebibe biaye bionsi.
english: Speak tenderly to Jerusalem, and proclaim to her that her hard service has been completed, that her sin has been paid for, that she has received from the LORD's hand double for all her sins.

ekegusii: Kwana nere, omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, rora, inche nigo inde mamincha yao; aye ore enchoka enene eraire gati‐gati ye chindooche chiao, kogoteba: Orooche oro rwa Naili norwane, ninche omonyene narotongete.
english: Speak to him and say: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, you great monster lying among your streams. You say, "The Nile is mine; I made it for myself."

ekegusii: Motebereranie ase chizaburi, na amatera, ne chingero chi’omoika; motere na kobugia amariogi ase Omonene ase chinkoro chiaino,
english: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your heart to the Lord,

ekegusii: Maanora omonwa oo, ogambe ebina bi’ekeene, orwanerere oboronge bw’abataka na obaremeire.
english: Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy."

ekegusii: Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na oboseera nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu.
english: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and glory are in his sanctuary.

ekegusii: Ogosikwa na obonene nigo bire ase obosio bwaye, chinguru na omogoko nigo bire ase obomenyo bwaye.
english: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and joy in his dwelling place.

ekegusii: Igoro ase emetwe y’ebitongwa biria, egento nkiarengeo kenga buna eaanga igoro yaroiseirie ebirore bikomekameka na komesa, na kerokio nigo kiaarire igoro ase emetwe yabo.
english: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was what looked like an expanse, sparkling like ice, and awesome.

ekegusii: Ogochika koria kw’omoruoti kwaroisetigwe agwo ase eburi ya Susa, gokabetereria abanto baria abaango baminyoke gochia ase chingongo chionsi. Erio omoruoti na Hamani bagaikaransa konywa, korende omochie o Susa okaba nogokumia na ogoichana.
english: Spurred on by the king's command, the couriers went out, and the edict was issued in the citadel of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Susa was bewildered.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete Aroeri, tenena ase enchera ensemo, motengere! Moborie abasacha abwo bagotama, na abakungu abagwetooria: Mang’ana ki ayio akorekire?
english: Stand by the road and watch, you who live in Aroer. Ask the man fleeing and the woman escaping, ask them, 'What has happened?'

ekegusii: Tenena gaki, mweboyie ebinema biaino nekeene, na kobeka oboronge buna engobo y’ekioma ase ebikuba biaino,
english: Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist, with the breastplate of righteousness in place,

ekegusii: Erio Yesua na Bani, Kadimeli na Sebania, Buni na Serebia, Bani na Kenani, bagatenena igoro y’obotindiaro bwachikeire Abalawi, bagasaba neriogi rinene ase Omonene, Nyasae obo.
english: Standing on the stairs were the Levites-- Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani and Kenani-- who called with loud voices to the LORD their God.

ekegusii: Standing up, Paul motioned with his hand and said: "Men of Israel and you Gentiles who worship God, listen to me!
english: Paulo agatenena, akarambora okoboko, agakwana, “Inwe abasacha b’Abaisraeli, na inwe abamoirogete Nyasae, ntegerera.

ekegusii: Ogochaka eriomana nigo konga buna amache aigoreirwe, ase ayio tiga amang’ana ’eriomana atarabucha.
english: Starting a quarrel is like breaching a dam; so drop the matter before a dispute breaks out.

ekegusii: Moetanane omoruoti chinsemo chionsi, kera oyomo abwate ebirwanero biaye koboko, na omonto onde bwensi oraike ang’e ase abarendi goika aitwe akwe. Mobe amo nomoruoti aase ande onsi akogenda na koirana.”
english: Station yourselves around the king, each man with his weapon in his hand. Anyone who approaches your ranks must be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes."

ekegusii: Karue ase omonto omoriri, ekiagera tokonyora obong’aini korwa ase aya agokwana.
english: Stay away from a foolish man, for you will not find knowledge on his lips.

ekegusii: Bono beera aa ase obotuko obo goika mambia, torore gose omonyamwando oria onde ore ang’e kombua nanche gokorenda. Karakore igo mbuya. Onye tagwancha, rirorio ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, inche ninkorende. Bono rara aiga goika mambia.”
english: Stay here for the night, and in the morning if he wants to redeem, good; let him redeem. But if he is not willing, as surely as the LORD lives I will do it. Lie here until morning."

ekegusii: Mobeere ase enyomba eyio, morie na konywa ebi bakobaa, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete aegwe eng’eria yaye. Timoetanana enyomba ase enyomba.
english: Stay in that house, eating and drinking whatever they give you, for the worker deserves his wages. Do not move around from house to house.

ekegusii: Obe buna omomenyi ase ense eye, na inche nimbe amo naye, ningosesenie; naki ninkoe aye na ororeria rwao chinse echi chionsi, na ning’ikeranie eira yane eyio natianete ase Ibrahimu iso.
english: Stay in this land for a while, and I will be with you and will bless you. For to you and your descendants I will give all these lands and will confirm the oath I swore to your father Abraham.

ekegusii: Aye otenene isiko y’enyomba yaye, nere akorentere egento abeka koba intenenera.
english: Stay outside and let the man to whom you are making the loan bring the pledge out to you.

ekegusii: Omenye aroro ase engaki enke, goika ekeririanda kia momura omino gekende.
english: Stay with him for a while until your brother's fury subsides.

ekegusii: Menya aiga amo nainche, tibwoboa. Saulo nigo akorigia obogima bwane, na obwao boigo. Aye koramenye asende, tokonyorwa na bobe bonde.”
english: Stay with me; don't be afraid; the man who is seeking your life is seeking mine also. You will be safe with me."

ekegusii: Stern discipline awaits him who leaves the path; he who hates correction will die.
english: Egesusuro ekenene nkemonyore oyotigire enchera y’oboronge, na oyo ogechete ogokurerwa goika akwe.

ekegusii: Erio korwa ase egesasimero omomalaika onde agasoka, oyore nokobua igoro ase omorero, agakwana neriogi rinene, agatebia oyio orenge nomoyio okogesa, “Butora nomoyio oo okogesera, na gosangereria ebisago bi’amasabibu ’emesabibu y’ense, ekiagera amasabibu aye atobire.”
english: Still another angel, who had charge of the fire, came from the altar and called in a loud voice to him who had the sharp sickle, "Take your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of grapes from the earth's vine, because its grapes are ripe."

ekegusii: Naende oyonde nere akabora, “Omonene, ningotunyane, korende ritang’ani ing’a ribaga mbaakere ng’a batigare buya abanto b’enyomba yane.”
english: Still another said, "I will follow you, Lord; but first let me go back and say good-by to my family."

ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikama echinde rigana, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, na echinde emerongo etato.
english: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it produced a crop-- a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.

ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikamera, chikama rigana.” Ekero are kobatebia aya, agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.”
english: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up and yielded a crop, a hundred times more than was sown." When he said this, he called out, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

ekegusii: Na echinde chikagwa ase amaroba amaya, chikama endagera, chikamera na gokina, na kwama; echinde emerongo etato, na echinde emerongo etano nomo, naende echinde rigana.”
english: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up, grew and produced a crop, multiplying thirty, sixty, or even a hundred times."

ekegusii: Na abande bagateba, “Twasabire chibesa singo igoro y’amaremo aito, na emegondo yaito y’emesabibu, ase ogoakana ebango ase omoruoti.
english: Still others were saying, "We have had to borrow money to pay the king's tax on our fields and vineyards.

ekegusii: Naende abande nabwo baria babusuirwe ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoigwa ring’ana,
english: Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;

ekegusii: Abanto abange ase omoganda bakamwegena, bakabora, “Inee! Kristo ekero arachiche nakore ebikone ebinge mono kobua ebi iga oyo akorire?”
english: Still, many in the crowd put their faith in him. They said, "When the Christ comes, will he do more miraculous signs than this man?"

ekegusii: Momoake amagena goika akwe ekiagera aganetie kobasiria ng’a motige Omonene, Nyasae oino, oria obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense y’obosomba.
english: Stone him to death, because he tried to turn you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

ekegusii: Rigena neririto na omokenye nomorito, korende okogechigwa kw’omonto omoriri nigo kore okorito kobua ebinto ebio bibere.
english: Stone is heavy and sand a burden, but provocation by a fool is heavier than both.

ekegusii: Tiga korenta asende ebing’wanso bi’obong’ainereria; ogosambwa kwa ubani kwabeire okogechia asende, naboigo nemeyega y’Emetienyi Emeyia, ne Chisabato, na emesangererekano mokorangeria. Tinkonyara koremereria emesangererekano buna eyio yasarigwe nebibe.
english: Stop bringing meaningless offerings! Your incense is detestable to me. New Moons, Sabbaths and convocations-- I cannot bear your evil assemblies.

ekegusii: Korwa bono tonywa amache oka, korende onywe edivai nke, ase engencho y’enda yao na amarwaire agokonyora ekero ase ekero.
english: Stop drinking only water, and use a little wine because of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.

ekegusii: Timogamba ekina ase engencho y’ekieni, korende nacha ekina ase oboronge.”
english: Stop judging by mere appearances, and make a right judgment."

ekegusii: Omwana one, onye tokoigwera amorokererio nigo orasire korwa ase amang’ana akorenta chisemi.
english: Stop listening to instruction, my son, and you will stray from the words of knowledge.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, batige mwanyabanto, abwo okoeyana kwabo gwe chimioro kore embeo bosa. Omonto, ninki aisaine?
english: Stop trusting in man, who has but a breath in his nostrils. Of what account is he?

ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu bang’umokeire kong’ita, na abanto abatindi nigo baganetie obogima bwane; abwo tibakoirogeti aye Nyasae.
english: Strangers are attacking me; ruthless men seek my life-- men without regard for God. Selah

ekegusii: Amaiso aane nigo agoitera amariga amange buna amache a rooche, ase engencho y’ogosirigwa kw’omochie bw’abanto baane.
english: Streams of tears flow from my eyes because my people are destroyed.

ekegusii: Nigo nkorera, naitekia amariga amange mono, ekiagera abanto tibarendeti amachiko ao.
english: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for your law is not obeyed.

ekegusii: Rigoti riaye nigo ribwate chinguru, na okoondokia nigo kore bosio bwaye.
english: Strength resides in his neck; dismay goes before him.

ekegusii: Ong’e amasabibu amomo indie imbe nobogima oboyia, ong’e na amapera imbe ne chinguru, ekiagera amaiga ’obwanchani anyarire.
english: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.

ekegusii: Strengthen the feeble hands, steady the knees that give way;
english: Amaboko are amoro yabeke chinguru; kong’ia amaru arosire.

ekegusii: bakabeka emioyo y’aborokigwa chinguru na kobaremia bagenderere ase okwegena, bakabatebia ng’a “Netogwenerete gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae ase enchera y’emechando emenge.”
english: strengthening the disciples and encouraging them to remain true to the faith. "We must go through many hardships to enter the kingdom of God," they said.

ekegusii: orambore okoboko kwao ase okogwenia, na ebikone na amakumia bikoreke ase erieta ri’Omosomba oo omochenu, Yeso.”
english: Stretch out your hand to heal and perform miraculous signs and wonders through the name of your holy servant Jesus."

ekegusii: Omonene, obaondokie! Tiga bamanye ng’a barabwo mwanyabanto bare rioka.
english: Strike them with terror, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah

ekegusii: Mosikane inwe ase inwe ase okomoiroka Kristo.
english: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’Omonene mwebeke inse ya kera ekegochikwa na mwanyabanto, onye nomoruoti oyore omonene,
english: Submit yourselves for the Lord's sake to every authority instituted among men: whether to the king, as the supreme authority,

ekegusii: Gaki, mwebeke inse ase Nyasae; korende mwange Saitani, na ere nabatame.
english: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

ekegusii: Obong’aini obo tari boria bogocha korwa igoro, korende nobw’ense, na obwe chingencho chia mwanyabanto, na echi’ebirecha,
english: Such "wisdom" does not come down from heaven but is earthly, unspiritual, of the devil.

ekegusii: Naki nigo etogwenerete intwe tobe n’Omokuani Omonene buna oyo, oyore omochenu, otari na komocha, otari na kemoa, bwatananetwe korwa ase abanyene ebibe, oimokereretigwe igoro ya igoro.
english: Such a high priest meets our need-- one who is holy, blameless, pure, set apart from sinners, exalted above the heavens.

ekegusii: Na ogosemeria okwo tore nakwo ase obosio bwa Nyasae ase Kristo;
english: Such confidence as this is ours through Christ before God.

ekegusii: Naboigo nabanto bonsi abebire Nyasae bakoba, ogosemeria kw’omonto otamoirogeti Nyasae nagosire.
english: Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so perishes the hope of the godless.

ekegusii: Naboigo omoerio bwe chinchera chiabo ore, baria baganetie konyora chinibo ase ribero. Chinibo chiria nigo chigosiria obogima bw’abwo bagochinyora.
english: Such is the end of all who go after ill-gotten gain; it takes away the lives of those who get it.

ekegusii: “Eke nakio egetari ki’omokori amabe gekorwa ase Nyasae, naende oyio noro omwando oye Nyasae amochikerete.”
english: Such is the fate God allots the wicked, the heritage appointed for them by God."

ekegusii: Naboigo ekegori ki’abakomorigia kere; abwo bakorigia barore obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.
english: Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face, O God of Jacob. Selah

ekegusii: Okomanya okwo nigo kore okw’ogokumia asende; nigo kore okonene mono, tinkonyara gokomanya.
english: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

ekegusii: Emeganda emenene ekamosangererekanera, goika ere akariina obwato ime, agaikaransa aroro, na omoganda bwonsi ogatenena ase engegu.
english: Such large crowds gathered around him that he got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people stood on the shore.

ekegusii: Tiga abanto banga buna abwo bamanye, ng’a buna tokorika ase amarube aito ekero totari aroro, naboigo togokora gatoreo.
english: Such people should realize that what we are in our letters when we are absent, we will be in our actions when we are present.

ekegusii: Nabo abanto banga buna abwo twabachikire na kobasorora ase Omonene Yeso Kristo, ng’a bakore emeremo ase obotoereru, na koria endagera yabo abanyene.
english: Such people we command and urge in the Lord Jesus Christ to settle down and earn the bread they eat.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo akororekana ng’a nay’obong’aini ase ogosasima na okweororobia na goaka omobere, korende taisaneti gento kende ase ogotanga okogania gwe chingencho chi’obobe.
english: Such regulations indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-imposed worship, their false humility and their harsh treatment of the body, but they lack any value in restraining sensual indulgence.

ekegusii: ase obong’ainereria bw’abanto abanyaborimo, abwo chinkoro chiabo chiasambirwe, chitari koigwa kende.
english: Such teachings come through hypocritical liars, whose consciences have been seared as with a hot iron.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akorete; nere akaba nerieta rinene buna abanto Baria Batato chituoni.
english: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty men.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akorete. Nigo anyorete erieta rinene ase egati ya baria Batato.
english: Such were the exploits of Benaiah son of Jehoiada; he too was as famous as the three mighty men.

ekegusii: Amasio abo nabo arenge igo. Chimbaba chiabo nigo chiaramboire gochia igoro; chimbaba ibere chia kera ekemo chigakunana nechi’ekende, na ibere chinde chia kera ekemo chigatuba emebere yabo.
english: Such were their faces. Their wings were spread out upward; each had two wings, one touching the wing of another creature on either side, and two wings covering its body.

ekegusii: Bwango igo mbarengeo amo nomomalaika oria omoganda o igoro, bagotogia Nyasae, bakobora,
english: Suddenly a great company of the heavenly host appeared with the angel, praising God and saying,

ekegusii: Mobosokano okogusa kogacha korwa igoro, okogusa buna ogw’ekerambauti gekogusa ne chinguru, kogaichora enyomba yonsi aase baikaransete.
english: Suddenly a sound like the blowing of a violent wind came from heaven and filled the whole house where they were sitting.

ekegusii: Na rora, omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera, na amasase akamoreka akanyomba ime. Omomalaika oria agaaka Petero rikere riaye, akamotura, agateba, “Imoka bwango!” Ebinyuri bigasansoka korwa ase amaboko aye.
