english: Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. "Quick, get up!" he said, and the chains fell off Peter's wrists.

ekegusii: Na rora, Yeso akaumerana nabarabwo, akabakwania, “Masoge!” Na barabwo bagacha, bakamobwata amagoro, bakamosasima.
english: Suddenly Jesus met them. "Greetings," he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.

ekegusii: Mobosokano ebiara bi’okoboko kw’omonto bikaoroka, bikarika ase rioomo ri’enyasi y’enyomba y’omoruoti kororia ase ekebekerero gi’etaya, na omoruoti akarora okoboko koria gokorika.
english: Suddenly the fingers of a human hand appeared and wrote on the plaster of the wall, near the lampstand in the royal palace. The king watched the hand as it wrote.

ekegusii: Erio mobosokano omotengecho omonene okaba aroro, goika amaroso ’echela agatengechigwa; bwango ebisieri bionsi bikaigoka, na ebisibo bia bonsi bigasansoka.
english: Suddenly there was such a violent earthquake that the foundations of the prison were shaken. At once all the prison doors flew open, and everybody's chains came loose.

ekegusii: Erio bwango kobarigereirie aria na aaria, tibarora monto onde, otatiga Yeso bweka amo nabarabwo.
english: Suddenly, when they looked around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akagenda bwoye ore nomoichano na obororo bw’endamwamu, agaika Samaria.
english: Sullen and angry, the king of Israel went to his palace in Samaria.

ekegusii: Summon your power, O God; show us your strength, O God, as you have done before.
english: Aye Nyasae, oorokia okobua kwao; ee Nyasae, ayio gwatokoreire, genderera koyabeka chinguru.

ekegusii: summoned all Israel-- their elders, leaders, judges and officials-- and said to them: "I am old and well advanced in years.
english: akarangeria Abaisraeli bonsi: abagaaka, na abatang’ani, na abagambi, amo nabaraai babo, akabatebia, “Inche nabeire omogaaka omogotu mono.

ekegusii: Ekero emegwe yao yarenge korunda na komesa, ne ritimo riao riarenge komekameka, na erioba na omotienyi bigatenena aase abo.
english: Sun and moon stood still in the heavens at the glint of your flying arrows, at the lightning of your flashing spear.

ekegusii: Omoe ching’ondi kore nomoyo omorabu, omoe nendagera, na edivai, koreng’ana buna Omonene, Nyasae oo, agosesenirie.
english: Supply him liberally from your flock, your threshing floor and your winepress. Give to him as the LORD your God has blessed you.

ekegusii: Onye oyomino, omosacha gose omokungu, ore bosa, na oremeire endagera ya kera rituko,
english: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and daily food.

ekegusii: Naki karasoe ase omosangererekano oino omonto obegete ebonyi y’etahabu ase ekiara kiaye, na bweboetie chianga chingiya, naende omonto onde asoe, oyore omotaka na bweboetie chianga chire ne riko,
english: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes, and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in.

ekegusii: Naki enibo eyio yonsi Nyasae arusirie korwa ase tata nigo etotungetie intwe na abana baito. Ase igo ayio onsi Nyasae agotebirie, yakore.”
english: Surely all the wealth that God took away from our father belongs to us and our children. So do whatever God has told you."

ekegusii: Nimanyete ng’a Nyasae nere omokonyi one, Omonene nere orendete obogima bwane.
english: Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.

ekegusii: Rora, Nyasae nere ogotooreka kwane; nimosemerie, tinkwoboa. Omonene Nyasae nere chinguru chiane, ere nimoterere; ere obeire ogotooreka kwane.”
english: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. The LORD, the LORD, is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation."

ekegusii: Nyasae nakoiyerie inse kare na kare, nakobwate na kogotaboria korwa nyomba mwao, nagosimore korwa ase ense y’abare moyo.
english: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin: He will snatch you up and tear you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah

ekegusii: Omonene nasenyente emetwe y’ababisa baye, nasenyente ebiore bire netukia bi’abwo bakogenderera ne chinchera chiabo chi’ebibe.
english: Surely God will crush the heads of his enemies, the hairy crowns of those who go on in their sins.

ekegusii: Ekeene, obuya na obwanchani botari koera nabintunyane amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwane; nainche nimenye ase enyomba y’Omonene goika kare na kare.
english: Surely goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.

ekegusii: Ere nigo amanyete abanto batagwenereti. Ekero akorora amabe agokorwa, Inee, takorengereria igoro y’ayio?
english: Surely he recognizes deceitful men; and when he sees evil, does he not take note?

ekegusii: Inee! Tatebete ayio ase engencho yaito yoka? Ee, nigo arikire ase engencho yaito; ekiagera oyokorema nagwenerete korema ase ogosemeria, na ere oyokoora nigo akoora ase ogosemeria konyora ensemo yaye y’endagera.
english: Surely he says this for us, doesn't he? Yes, this was written for us, because when the plowman plows and the thresher threshes, they ought to do so in the hope of sharing in the harvest.

ekegusii: Ekeene, ere obogoirie omoichano oyo otogwenerete intwe, na bwetwekire obororo bwaito; intwe nigo twamobarete ng’a oakirwe na Nyasae, naende ng’a ere omoeire egesusuro na obororo.
english: Surely he took up our infirmities and carried our sorrows, yet we considered him stricken by God, smitten by him, and afflicted.

ekegusii: Omonyaboronge takonyegerigwa nonya ng’ake, nabe okoinyorwa kare na kare.
english: Surely he will never be shaken; a righteous man will be remembered forever.

ekegusii: Ere nagotoorie korwa ase omoeto bw’omotegi, na korwa ase amarwaire amabe agoita.
english: Surely he will save you from the fowler's snare and from the deadly pestilence.

ekegusii: Ekeene, ogotooreka kwaye nigo kore ang’e ase abanto bairogete Omonene; obonene mbobe bomenyete ase ense yaito.
english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.

ekegusii: Rora, inche nigo naiboretwe inde ne chingencho chi’ebibe; nigo narenge omonyabibe korwa ekero baba abogoretie oborito.
english: Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.

ekegusii: Ekeene, nigo nare koyabogoria igoro ase amareko aane; nanga nigo nayesiberania abe buna egutwa asende.
english: Surely I would wear it on my shoulder, I would put it on like a crown.

ekegusii: Surely in vain have I kept my heart pure; in vain have I washed my hands in innocence.
english: Ekeene, mbosa nabeire ndendete enkoro yane ebe echenegete, mbosa nabeire ngoisaba amaboko aane ng’a timba nokomocha.

ekegusii: Amaene, nigo anchete abanto b’ebisaku bionsi; abachenu baye bonsi nigo bare ase oborendi bw’okoboko kwaye. Barabwo nigo baikaraansete inse ase amagoro ’Omonene, borokererigwe amang’ana aye.
english: Surely it is you who love the people; all the holy ones are in your hand. At your feet they all bow down, and from you receive instruction,

ekegusii: Naama! Nigo narenge nobororo obonge, na obororo obwo bokandetera omorembe. Ase obwanchani bwao gwatooririe omoyo one korwa ase engoro y’obosareku; gwatugutire ebibe biane bionsi gochia nyuma yao.
english: Surely it was for my benefit that I suffered such anguish. In your love you kept me from the pit of destruction; you have put all my sins behind your back.

ekegusii: Ee, oyio noro omogoko ere abwate ase obogima bwaye, naende abande mbache babe ase ribaga riaye.
english: Surely its life withers away, and from the soil other plants grow.

ekegusii: Ekeene, abachecheria bang’etananire, na amaiso aane nigo agendererete korora okogechia kwabo.
english: Surely mockers surround me; my eyes must dwell on their hostility.

ekegusii: bateba: Amaene, ababisa baito basirigwe kegima, na ebinto biabo biatigarete biasambirwe nomorero.
english: 'Surely our foes are destroyed, and fire devours their wealth.'

ekegusii: Ekeene, obomenyo bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nabo bore igo, na aase ay’abataganeti komomanya Nyasae nabo are igo.”
english: Surely such is the dwelling of an evil man; such is the place of one who knows not God."

ekegusii: Amaene nigo ere bosa koba nogosemeria ase ebigoro na ase chigosori chimbe chire aroro. Omonene, Nyasae oito, nere ore ogotooreka kw’Abaisraeli.
english: Surely the [idolatrous] commotion on the hills and mountains is a deception; surely in the LORD our God is the salvation of Israel.

ekegusii: Naama! Okoboko kw’Omonene tikori okweng’e, erinde ere asinywe gotooria, gose amato aye tatineti atanyare koigwa.
english: Surely the arm of the LORD is not too short to save, nor his ear too dull to hear.

ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha mbanganye inche Omonene; chimeeri chia Tarisisi nchibe chintang’ani korenta abanto bao bakorwa chinse chi’aare; mbarentane chifeta ne chitahabu chie chinse echio. Ebinto ebio nigo birarentwe ase ogotogia erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oo, ere ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, ekiagera okoeire obonene.”
english: Surely the islands look to me; in the lead are the ships of Tarshish, bringing your sons from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor.

ekegusii: Naama! Ebisaku nigo binga buna entonyi y’amache egotonya korwa ase enyongo. Nigo bireng’anirie norotu orosinini rore ase esani ekorengera; rora, nigo akoimokia ebisinka buna orotu orosinini.
english: Surely the nations are like a drop in a bucket; they are regarded as dust on the scales; he weighs the islands as though they were fine dust.

ekegusii: Ekeene, abanyene oboronge mbaake ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta riao, abare ne chinkoro chindonge mbamenye ase obosio bwao.
english: Surely the righteous will praise your name and the upright will live before you.

ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene Nyasae tagokora ring’ana rinde rionsi ritang’ani ataramaanora obobisi bwaye ase abasomba baye ababani.
english: Surely the Sovereign LORD does nothing without revealing his plan to his servants the prophets.

ekegusii: Bono aye nigo okobara amatambokero aane, gose tori korigereria ebibe biane.
english: Surely then you will count my steps but not keep track of my sin.

ekegusii: Rirorio nobe gokwegokia ase Omonguru oria, onyare korigereria Nyasae.
english: Surely then you will find delight in the Almighty and will lift up your face to God.

ekegusii: Ekeene amang’ana aya agacha igoro y’Abayuda ase ogochika kw’Omonene, erinde abarusie barue ase obosio bwaye ase engencho y’ebibe bia Manase na aya onsi akorete,
english: Surely these things happened to Judah according to the LORD's command, in order to remove them from his presence because of the sins of Manasseh and all he had done,

ekegusii: Rora, abanto abwo nigo banga amasakwe, omorero nigo okoyasamba ayia aera, tari konyara gwetooria korwa ase chinguru chi’omorero. Amasakwe ayio takoyia abe omorero bw’amakara, omonto araikaranseo aywote.
english: Surely they are like stubble; the fire will burn them up. They cannot even save themselves from the power of the flame. Here are no coals to warm anyone; here is no fire to sit by.

ekegusii: Obobe nigo bogosamba buna omorero; noro nigo ogosamba amageri na amagwa, nigo ogosamba rinani rinoru, riaerera ase erioki richongororogete gochia igoro.
english: Surely wickedness burns like a fire; it consumes briers and thorns, it sets the forest thickets ablaze, so that it rolls upward in a column of smoke.

ekegusii: Rora, aye nigo oganetie ekeene ase enkoro ime; ase ayio inyorokererie obong’aini bwao ase enkoro yane ime.
english: Surely you desire truth in the inner parts; you teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

ekegusii: Ee, kwamokorire koba ogoseseneka gwa kare na kare, kwamogokeire, ekiagera ore amo nere botambe.
english: Surely you have granted him eternal blessings and made him glad with the joy of your presence.

ekegusii: Negenire ng’a mwaigure amang’ana ’oborendi bw’obuya bwa Nyasae, obo naetwe ase engencho yaino.
english: Surely you have heard about the administration of God's grace that was given to me for you,

ekegusii: Aye kwaigure aya abaruoti b’Abaasuri bakoreire chinse chionsi, bachisaririe kegima. Inee! Aye bono notooreke?
english: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?

ekegusii: Rora, aye kwaigure aya abaruoti b’Abaasuri bakoreire chinse chionsi, bachisaririe kegima. Inee! Aye bono notooreke?
english: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the countries, destroying them completely. And will you be delivered?

ekegusii: Inwe mwamoigwete na kworokererigwa nere, buna ekeene kere ime ase Yeso.
english: Surely you heard of him and were taught in him in accordance with the truth that is in Jesus.

ekegusii: Ee, aye nomanyete, ekiagera nigo kwaiboretwe kare, na emiaka yao nemenge.
english: Surely you know, for you were already born! You have lived so many years!

ekegusii: Ekeene, aye Omonene nigo okobabeka aase are aaterere, aye nigo okobaturunkania kwabasiria kegima.
english: Surely you place them on slippery ground; you cast them down to ruin.

ekegusii: Naki baminto, moinyorete emeremo yaito na obokong’u bwaito, ng’a ekero twabaranderetie enchili ya Nyasae, tware gokora emeremo obotuko na omobaso, erinde titocha komoraarereria onde oino.
english: Surely you remember, brothers, our toil and hardship; we worked night and day in order not to be a burden to anyone while we preached the gospel of God to you.

ekegusii: Naama! Aye norangerie abanto b’ebisaku otamanyeti, na abanto b’ebisaku batakomanyeti mbaminyoke gocha asore, ase engencho y’Omonene, Nyasae oo, oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, ekiagera okoeire obonene.”
english: Surely you will summon nations you know not, and nations that do not know you will hasten to you, because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has endowed you with splendor."

ekegusii: Ekeene, endamwamu ya mwanyabanto nenyare kogera aye otogigwe; eyeratigare noyieboyie buna orokini.
english: Surely your wrath against men brings you praise, and the survivors of your wrath are restrained.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase rituko riria abamura b’omochie oyio nabaitwe bagwe ase chinchera chiaye, na abarwani esegi baye bonsi mbaitwe. Nabo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda natebire.
english: Surely, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day," declares the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Ekeene, Nyasae okoorire chinguru chiane, na osiririe abanto bonsi b’enka yane.
english: Surely, O God, you have worn me out; you have devastated my entire household.

ekegusii: Ekerogo keria ki’obonene nigo giaetananire nebirogo emerongo ebere na bine bi’obonene, na ase ebirogo biria mbarengeo abagaaka emerongo ebere na bane baikaransete, babekeire chianga chindabu. Ase emetwe yabo mbarenge ne chigutwa chie chitahabu.
english: Surrounding the throne were twenty-four other thrones, and seated on them were twenty-four elders. They were dressed in white and had crowns of gold on their heads.

ekegusii: Ing’a chinguru buna kwarire eira, erinde imbe moyo, tobaisa gontiga indore obosooku ase ogosemeria kwane.
english: Sustain me according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.

ekegusii: Aase aande onsi amache ayio aragende, kera egetongwa kere moyo kemenye ime yaye nkegenderere koba moyo, ne chinswe chinyinge mono nchibeo. Ee, ekero amache aria araike ase enyancha eria, amache ’enyancha eria nanse abe amaya, na kera egento nkenyore obogima.
english: Swarms of living creatures will live wherever the river flows. There will be large numbers of fish, because this water flows there and makes the salt water fresh; so where the river flows everything will live.

ekegusii: Swarms of locusts will take over all your trees and the crops of your land.
english: Chingige nchirie emete yaino morasimeke, na okwama kwaino kwe riroba.

ekegusii: Soyia emeyio chinkuro mogondo, mogese, ekiagera rigesa riaikire. Soa ime motindache, ekiagera ekemitero ki’edivai kiaichoire. Chinyongo chiaichoire na goiteka, ekiagera obobe bwabo bwabeire obonene.”
english: Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, trample the grapes, for the winepress is full and the vats overflow-- so great is their wickedness!'

ekegusii: Omoro nogwere emechie yabo nobotindi, nosarie emekorogoto y’ebiita biabo na gosaria kende gionsi ase engencho y’emeroberio yabo abanyene.
english: Swords will flash in their cities, will destroy the bars of their gates and put an end to their plans.

ekegusii: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son and Shaul his son.
english: na Tahati omomura oye, na Urieli omomura oye, na Usia omomura oye, na Sauli omomura oye.

ekegusii: Erio moimokie chinsagia chia hisopo, mochitobeke ase amanyinga are egetaabo ime, mogindie omoriibo bw’emetobwa ya gesieri igoro amo nemetobwa eria ebere. Onde tabaisa gosoka korwa nyomba mwaye goika mambia.
english: Take a bunch of hyssop, dip it into the blood in the basin and put some of the blood on the top and on both sides of the doorframe. Not one of you shall go out the door of his house until morning.

ekegusii: Boigo oirere omochiki obo bw’abarwani elifu eyemo amabomba aya ikomi ay’amabeere abwatanire. Orore gose bamura bamino mbuya bare, naende ondetere ekemanyererio gete korwa asebare, erinde imanye buna bagendererete.
english: Take along these ten cheeses to the commander of their unit. See how your brothers are and bring back some assurance from them.

ekegusii: Induserie amang’ana ’ogochaywa inyirogete, ekiagera aya gwachikire nigo are amaya.
english: Take away the disgrace I dread, for your laws are good.

ekegusii: Mochigache goika rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi oyio. Agwo omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bachinyenye mogoroba.
english: Take care of them until the fourteenth day of the month, when all the people of the community of Israel must slaughter them at twilight.

ekegusii: Gaki, erende, tabaisa kobaikera amang’ana aria akwanetwe nababani:
english: Take care that what the prophets have said does not happen to you:

ekegusii: Mobogorie chibesa ara kabere ase amaboko aino, moirane chibesa chiria chiairanetigwe, echio chiabegetwe igoro y’endagera ase chigunia chiaino ime. Aande nigo chiebetwe chikabekwao.
english: Take double the amount of silver with you, for you must return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.

ekegusii: Inwe aba motamanyeti gento, kabe nokomanya! Inwe abariri, ndiriri morabe abang’aini?
english: Take heed, you senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?

ekegusii: Ing’use nkobwatie, tominyoke kogenda. Omoruoti ondetire ase chiero chiaye. Ntokogokere na kogochengera, ntotogie obwanchani bwao kobua edivai. Ekeene, nigo bagwanchete bori.
english: Take me away with you-- let us hurry! Let the king bring me into his chambers. We rejoice and delight in you; we will praise your love more than wine. How right they are to adore you!

ekegusii: Bono bogoria ensio osere obosie! Rusia egietubo otubete obosio bwao, ringa eganchwa yao eike ase amariagati, erio oete ase amache ime.
english: Take millstones and grind flour; take off your veil. Lift up your skirts, bare your legs, and wade through the streams.

ekegusii: Bogoria rikorogoto riane, mwegere asende, ekiagera inche nomwororo na omoitongo ase enkoro, na inwe namonyore ogotimoka ase emioyo yaino,
english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

ekegusii: Gose esaro ase orogendo, gose chianga ibere, gose ebikoroto, nonya nenyimbo, ekiagera omokori emeremo nagwenerete endagera yaye.
english: take no bag for the journey, or extra tunic, or sandals or a staff; for the worker is worth his keep.

ekegusii: Moire ense yabo ebe eyaino momenyeo, ekiagera nabayeire.
english: Take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.

ekegusii: Oimokie amanyinga make, erinde ogindie nekiara kiao emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero. Na amanyinga amatigari oyaumore inse ase egesasimero.
english: Take some of the bull's blood and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.

ekegusii: kera oyomo oino, arusie ogotongora gw’okwama kw’endagera aragese korwa ase omogondo bw’ense eria. Erio ayebeke ase egetonga ime, ayeire goika aase aria Omonene, Nyasae oino, arachore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye.
english: take some of the firstfruits of all that you produce from the soil of the land the LORD your God is giving you and put them in a basket. Then go to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name

ekegusii: Oire amo naye emegati ikomi, na amaandasi, na obooke egetono ekemo, ogende asare; ere nagotebie egento kegochia gokororekana ase omwana.”
english: Take ten loaves of bread with you, some cakes and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will happen to the boy."

ekegusii: Erio oimokie amaguta akweakwa, omonyororokerie ase omotwe oye, omoyaake.
english: Take the anointing oil and anoint him by pouring it on his head.

ekegusii: Moimokie Esanduku eye y’Omonene ase egari igoro, na emegwekano eria y’etahabu, moyebeke ase esanduku eng’ao ebeere ensemo y’Esanduku eria y’Omonene. Emegwekano eyio moyeirere Omonene ebe okoruegwa ase engencho y’okomocha okwo. Nyuma y’ayio motige Esanduku egende aase aye.
english: Take the ark of the LORD and put it on the cart, and in a chest beside it put the gold objects you are sending back to him as a guilt offering. Send it on its way,

ekegusii: Ira eanga y’omonto oyo bwerure koba intenenera ase omonto omoao, ira ebi abwate, ekiagera bwerure ase engencho y’omonto otamanyekaneti.
english: Take the garment of one who puts up security for a stranger; hold it in pledge if he does it for a wayward woman.

ekegusii: Take the garments and dress Aaron with the tunic, the robe of the ephod, the ephod itself and the breastpiece. Fasten the ephod on him by its skillfully woven waistband.
english: Oimokie chianga chiria, obekere Haroni: Eganchwa erobekanirie egoika inse, na eganchwa eria ende, na egesibao ki’obokuani na egesembe keria; omoboerie norokini rw’egesibao.

ekegusii: Naende bogoria ekegogwa gi’ekioma ki’ogotooreka, na omoro bw’Omoika, noro ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

ekegusii: Inche ninche Omonene. Ase ayio Abalawi babe abaane. Obanyatananere ribaga ri’abatangi bonsi b’Abaisraeli. Naboigo ne ribaga rie ching’iti chintangi chi’Abaisraeli onyatananere ching’iti chi’Abalawi.”
english: Take the Levites for me in place of all the firstborn of the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites. I am the LORD."

ekegusii: erio nario morarente agwo ase ebiita biaino omonto oria, omosacha gose omokungu, oyio okorire ogokora okwo okobe, erio momoake amagena goika akwe.
english: take the man or woman who has done this evil deed to your city gate and stone that person to death.

ekegusii: Ebitari ebio obirusie korwa ase eng’ondi enchore ere ase riicho riao; otumbe chinko chinyinge inse y’enyongo, oute omorero obiyeke buya, oiyekeranie amauga amo.
english: take the pick of the flock. Pile wood beneath it for the bones; bring it to a boil and cook the bones in it.

ekegusii: Ekero kwaeirwe chifeta ne chitahabu oroisie egutwa korwa ase ebinto ebio, oyebeke ase omotwe o Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki.
english: Take the silver and gold and make a crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.

ekegusii: Ira abanto aba okore buna engencho y’ogwesibia ere amo nabarabwo, obaakanere chibesa, erinde bakigite chitukia chiabo. Igo abanto bonsi banyare komanya ng’a amang’ana aria batebetigwe igoro yao tari ay’ekeene, korende aye omonyene nigo okogenderera buya na kobwata amachiko.
english: Take these men, join in their purification rites and pay their expenses, so that they can have their heads shaved. Then everybody will know there is no truth in these reports about you, but that you yourself are living in obedience to the law.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo baatananwe korwa ase ekeng’ese ekio baegwe Eleazari omokuani, babe ekeegwa ase Omonene, naboigo ne ching’iti chiria.
english: Take this tribute from their half share and give it to Eleazar the priest as the LORD's part.

ekegusii: Take up shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.
english: Bogoria enguba na eng’aya, imoka onkonye!

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu, tiga amang’ana aya abe ogokurerwa asemore; motaigwereti, inche nigo ndarue asemore mbatige, erio mbasirie, na ense yaino ebe buna erooro etamenyiri nabanto.”
english: Take warning, O Jerusalem, or I will turn away from you and make your land desolate so no one can live in it."

ekegusii: Oirane amo naye ching’iti chichenegete chirabe ekeng’wanso, isano na ibere isano na ibere, chinsacha ne chinkungu; na ase kera eng’iti etachenegeti, ibere ibere, ensacha na enkungu.
english: Take with you seven of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate, and two of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate,

ekegusii: Irana ase Omonene, momotebie amang’ana aya: “Toruserie obobe bwaito bwonsi obwo twakorire, bwanchere ayare amaya, naintwe torue asore ogotogia kw’ebikoba biaito konga buna okoruegwa kw’ebing’wanso bie chieri.
english: Take words with you and return to the LORD. Say to him: "Forgive all our sins and receive us graciously, that we may offer the fruit of our lips.

ekegusii: Moire na oyomino, mogende komo, mogende ase omonto oria naende.
english: Take your brother also and go back to the man at once.

ekegusii: Take your flocks and herds, as you have said, and go. And also bless me."
english: Ira ching’ondi chiaino ne chiombe chiaino buna mwaboririe, morue aa; monsabere, na inche nsesenigwe.”

ekegusii: Bwata ekere ekiao, ogende; nindigetie koa oyo o nyuma koreng’ana naye.
english: Take your pay and go. I want to give the man who was hired last the same as I gave you.

ekegusii: goika amatuko emerongo ene agaikerana. Ase amatuko ang’ana buna ayio naro egetondo kiare goakwa amariogo. Abamisiri bakamoreera Israeli amatuko emerongo etano na ebere.
english: taking a full forty days, for that was the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

ekegusii: Akamobwata okoboko gw’okorio, akamoimokia igoro. Erio kegima amagoro aye ne chinengo chi’amagoro aye bikanyora chinguru.
english: Taking him by the right hand, he helped him up, and instantly the man's feet and ankles became strong.

ekegusii: Erio Labani akaira abamwabo, bakamobwatia orogendo rw’amatuko atano na abere, akamoikeera ase ebitunwa bia Gileadi.
english: Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.

ekegusii: Erio bakabogoria omobere o Yeso, bakayoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani, bakayoaka amaguta aria amanukato, buna yarenge engencho y’Abayahudi ase ogotindeka.
english: Taking Jesus' body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.

ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, agasamunyora emegati eria, akaa aborokigwa baye babiterekere abanto, ne chinswe chiria ibere, akabagabera bonsi.
english: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to his disciples to set before the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.

ekegusii: Akabogoria emegati eria etano ne chinswe chiria ibere, akarigereria igoro, akabisesenia, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa babiterekere abanto.
english: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke them. Then he gave them to the disciples to set before the people.

ekegusii: Bakanyora okwama gw’ense eria, bagakorenta asetore, naende bagatorentera amang’ana aya baroche agwo ase ense eria, bagakwana: Ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oito, agochia gotoa nengiya mono.”
english: Taking with them some of the fruit of the land, they brought it down to us and reported, "It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us."

ekegusii: Ekero are gokwana na Kornelio, agasoa ime, akanyora abanto abange basangererekaneteo.
english: Talking with him, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.

ekegusii: Tamari ageaka ribu ase omotwe oye, agatandora eganchwa eria entambe abegete, akabeka amaboko motwe, akagenda okona‐korera ase eriogi rinene.
english: Tamar put ashes on her head and tore the ornamented robe she was wearing. She put her hand on her head and went away, weeping aloud as she went.

ekegusii: Tamari, moka momura o Yuda, akaiborera Yuda Peresi na Zera. Yuda nigo abwate abana abamura batano.
english: Tamar, Judah's daughter-in-law, bore him Perez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in all.

ekegusii: Moteeme Omonene, morore ng’a nomuya. Nasesenirie omonto oria omotameire.
english: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

ekegusii: Abarusia ebango bagacha erinde babatiswe, bakamoboria, “Omworokia, inki rende naintwe torakore?”
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized. "Teacher," they asked, "what should we do?"

ekegusii: Inyorokererie imanye kogamba buya na imbe ne chisemi, ekiagera nigo inyegenete amachiko ao.
english: Teach me knowledge and good judgment, for I believe in your commands.

ekegusii: Inyorokererie imanye gokora ogwancha kwao, ekiagera naye ore Nyasae one! Tiga Omoika oo omuya ondaae ase enchera ere endonge.
english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God; may your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

ekegusii: Bono inyorokererie aya ntamanyeti, na onye nakorire ebibe, tingwancha kobikora naende.
english: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do so again.'

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao, nigo nganetie kobwatia ekeene kiao; renda enkoro yane, erinde inyiroke erieta riao.
english: Teach me your way, O LORD, and I will walk in your truth; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera yao; indaae ong’eterie aase aateremu, ntooreke korwa ase ababisa baane.
english: Teach me your way, O LORD; lead me in a straight path because of my oppressors.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inyorokererie enchera y’emeroberio yao echikire; na inche ninyerende goika omoerio.
english: Teach me, O LORD, to follow your decrees; then I will keep them to the end.

ekegusii: Abasomba baigwere abanene babo ase amang’ana onsi, babagwenere, na tibaba abakobairaneria bobe,
english: Teach slaves to be subject to their masters in everything, to try to please them, not to talk back to them,

ekegusii: Abagaaka mbagwenerete babe aberiti, abare nogosika, aberendete ase onsi, babe abagima ase okwegena, na ase obwanchani, na ase oboremereria.
english: Teach the older men to be temperate, worthy of respect, self-controlled, and sound in faith, in love and in endurance.

ekegusii: Goika oborokererie amachiko na emeroberio, na obatebererie buna ebagwenerete babe na gokora.
english: Teach them the decrees and laws, and show them the way to live and the duties they are to perform.

ekegusii: Moyorokererie abana baino, mobe mokona‐koyairanerera ekero moikaransete ase chinyomba chiaino, na ekero more ase orogendo, na ekero mogochia korara, na ekero mokoboka.
english: Teach them to your children, talking about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.

ekegusii: Tworokererie, tomanye obweng’e bw’obogima bwaito, erinde chinkoro chiaito chibe nobong’aini.
english: Teach us to number our days aright, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

ekegusii: Ayio nakworokererie ayare ay’oboronge na ay’ekeene, erinde okwane ay’oboronge na ekeene ase abwo bagotomete.
english: teaching you true and reliable words, so that you can give sound answers to him who sent you?

ekegusii: TEKELI, engencho yaye: kwarengirwe ase ekerengero na kwanyorekanire noremeire;
english: Tekel: You have been weighed on the scales and found wanting.

ekegusii: Otebie abaroisia abang’aini, abwo naeire obong’aini ne chisemi, baroiserie Haroni chianga, erinde aatananwe abe ogonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
english: Tell all the skilled men to whom I have given wisdom in such matters that they are to make garments for Aaron, for his consecration, so he may serve me as priest.

ekegusii: Motebie Arikipo arigererie mono obosomba boria aetwe korwa ase Omonene, erinde aboikeranie.
english: Tell Archippus: "See to it that you complete the work you have received in the Lord."

ekegusii: Okwane nere, omotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Naama! Oyomo nachiche okorokwa Omoseboka, ere naseboke korwa aase aye, aagache Hekalu y’Omonene
english: Tell him this is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Here is the man whose name is the Branch, and he will branch out from his place and build the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Goika mobairanerie: Intwe nigo twarenge abasomba ba Farao ase ense ya Misiri, na Omonene agatorusiao nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.
english: tell him: "We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

ekegusii: Timobaisa koraria amang’ana ayio ase Gati, gose timobaisa korera nonya ng’ake. Mwegara‐garie ase orotu igoro, mweitie agwo Beti‐Le‐Afura.
english: Tell it not in Gath; weep not at all. In Beth Ophrah roll in the dust.

ekegusii: Yatebie abana baino, na abana baino bayatebie abana babo, na abana babo bayatebie ekegori kende.
english: Tell it to your children, and let your children tell it to their children, and their children to the next generation.

ekegusii: Tell me, you who want to be under the law, are you not aware of what the law says?
english: Ntebia, inwe abamorigetie koba inse y’amachiko, Inee, timori koigwera amachiko?

ekegusii: Aye omwanchi bw’omoyo one, ntebie ng’ai okorisia riicho riao. Ng’ai okoriira riakenderera mobaso gati? Nase ki ndabe nkona‐gotayaya ase egati y’amaicho ’abagisangio bao?
english: Tell me, you whom I love, where you graze your flock and where you rest your sheep at midday. Why should I be like a veiled woman beside the flocks of your friends?

ekegusii: Motebie tata obonene bwonsi mbwate aiga Misiri, na binde bionsi mwarorire. Mokore bwango, momorente gocha aa.”
english: Tell my father about all the honor accorded me in Egypt and about everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly."

ekegusii: Tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite,
english: Amang’ana aya naro oratebie Semaya, omonto o Nehelamu:

ekegusii: Korende ase omoruoti bw’Abayuda, oria obatoma erinde amanye korwa asende inche Omonene, aya naro moramotebie: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba igoro y’amang’ana aya kwaigwete:
english: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:

ekegusii: Korende ase omoruoti bw’Abayuda, oria obatoma, erinde amanye korwa asende inche Omonene, aya naro moramotebie: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli agoteba: Ekero kwaigwa amang’ana aria,
english: Tell the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the LORD, 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning the words you heard:

ekegusii: Bono genda okwane nabanto aba, ng’a kera oyomo ase abasacha na ase abakungu asabe korwa ase omogisangio oye ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu.”
english: Tell the people that men and women alike are to ask their neighbors for articles of silver and gold."

ekegusii: Aye chika abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana ng’a ekero baraike engegu y’orocche rwa Yorodan goika bateneneo.”
english: Tell the priests who carry the ark of the covenant: 'When you reach the edge of the Jordan's waters, go and stand in the river.'"

ekegusii: Tebia abanyene oboronge ng’a amang’ana nabe amaya asebare, barabwo mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo.
english: Tell the righteous it will be well with them, for they will enjoy the fruit of their deeds.

ekegusii: Genda orarerie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, obatebie: Rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi oyo kera omonto ore na mwaye achore emanwa, erio kera enyomba ebe nemanwa eyemo.
english: Tell the whole community of Israel that on the tenth day of this month each man is to take a lamb for his family, one for each household.

ekegusii: Mobatebie: Engencho yaye neye: Ekero Esanduku y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene yambogetigwe Yorodan, amache nigo nanachegete bosio bw’Esanduku eria. Ase ayio amagena aya nabe ekeinyorio ase Abaisraeli botambe.”
english: tell them that the flow of the Jordan was cut off before the ark of the covenant of the LORD. When it crossed the Jordan, the waters of the Jordan were cut off. These stones are to be a memorial to the people of Israel forever."

ekegusii: obatebie: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Aragererigwe omonto otari koigwera amang’ana ’okobwatana oko
english: Tell them that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Cursed is the man who does not obey the terms of this covenant--

ekegusii: mobatebie ng’a Abaisraeli nigo baambokerete Yorodan ase ense enkamoku.
english: tell them, 'Israel crossed the Jordan on dry ground.'

ekegusii: Kwana nabanto aba batari koigwera, obatebie omoreng’anio. Otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba:” “Tereka enyongo riko, ee, oyetereke, oumore amache ime yaye.
english: Tell this rebellious house a parable and say to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'Put on the cooking pot; put it on and pour water into it.

ekegusii: Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?"
english: Gaki totebie naki oroche aye? Mboronge komoa Kaisari ebango, gose taibo.”

ekegusii: tell us what the future holds, so we may know that you are gods. Do something, whether good or bad, so that we will be dismayed and filled with fear.
english: Totebie aya agochi‐gocha, erinde tomanye ng’a inwe ne chinyasae; kora amang’ana amaya, gose amabe erinde tokorora ayio tokumie.

ekegusii: bakabora, “Motebie abanto: Aborokigwa baye bachete botuko, bakamoiba ekero twararire.
english: telling them, "You are to say, 'His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.'

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko ikomi, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia.
english: Ten days later the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah.

ekegusii: ten head of stall-fed cattle, twenty of pasture-fed cattle and a hundred sheep and goats, as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks and choice fowl.
english: ne chiombe ikomi chinoru chiare gotugerwa nyomba, ne chiombe chiare korisia getii, emerongo ebere, na ching’ondi rigana erimo, ne chinsune, ne chingabi, na amang’o, ne chinyoni chinoru.

ekegusii: Ten times now you have reproached me; shamelessly you attack me.
english: Mwabeire mogonchecheria ara ikomi. Inee! Timori korora obosooku gonkorera bobe iga?

ekegusii: Tera nigo akoorete emiaka amagana abere, na etano (205); erio agakwera aaria Harani.
english: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Haran.

ekegusii: Tera akaira Aburamu omwana oye, na Loti omochokoro oye, omwana o Harani, amo na Sarai, moka momura oye Aburamu; bakagenda komo gochia Uru y’Abakalidayo, bakagenda goika ense ya Kanani. Korende ekero baigete omochie o Harani, bakamenya aroro.
english: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, the wife of his son Abram, and together they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to Canaan. But when they came to Haran, they settled there.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baratenenere aare, ekiagera bare nokoiroka ase ogoakwa kwaye, na goteba, “Obobe, obobe nobwao, omochie oria omonene, Babeli, omochie ore ne chinguru, naki ase ensa eyemo yoka okogambigwa kwao gwachire!”
english: Terrified at her torment, they will stand far off and cry: "'Woe! Woe, O great city, O Babylon, city of power! In one hour your doom has come!'

ekegusii: Amariogi ay’okwoboyia nigo agosoa ase amato aye; na ekero are nobotoereru, oyo ogosiria nigo akomochera.
english: Terrifying sounds fill his ears; when all seems well, marauders attack him.

ekegusii: Omoondoko na obwoba bikababwata; ase engencho y’okobua gw’okoboko kwao bagatenena, bagakira‐kiri buna amagena, goika abanto bao baetire, ee, Omonene, goika abanto bao kwabooretie baetire.
english: terror and dread will fall upon them. By the power of your arm they will be as still as a stone-- until your people pass by, O LORD, until the people you bought pass by.

ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete Moabu, omoondoko, na eirima, na omoeto, nigo bibaganyete. Omonene otebire ayio.
english: Terror and pit and snare await you, O people of Moab," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase ense, obwoba, na eirima, na omoeto, nigo bibaganyete.
english: Terror and pit and snare await you, O people of the earth.

ekegusii: Abanto mbabe nobwoba obonene; inababe nomoichano na obororo. Ee, mbabe nobororo buna obw’omokungu okobina agonkie, mbarigereranie bare nogokumia na omoichano na amaiso abo amwame ti.
english: Terror will seize them, pain and anguish will grip them; they will writhe like a woman in labor. They will look aghast at each other, their faces aflame.

ekegusii: Obwoba obonene bonga buna eooro nigo bokomochera; erio ekembugu‐mbugu kiamochera botuko kiamoira.
english: Terrors overtake him like a flood; a tempest snatches him away in the night.

ekegusii: Okogoswa gwanchicheire; ogosikwa kwane gwasirigwe buna omwaga ogosiria, na obotenenku bwane bwasirire pi buna amare agosira.
english: Terrors overwhelm me; my dignity is driven away as by the wind, my safety vanishes like a cloud.

ekegusii: Nabe okogoswa na kwoboyigwa korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, nkomoseria atame namagoro.
english: Terrors startle him on every side and dog his every step.

ekegusii: korende teema kera egento, bwata ekere ekiya,
english: Test everything. Hold on to the good.

ekegusii: Omonene, inteeme na ondenge; orenge enkoro yane na ebirengererio biane.
english: Test me, O LORD, and try me, examine my heart and my mind;

ekegusii: Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’ekeegwa kiaye, totanyare kogiatora buna egwenerete!
english: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!

ekegusii: Namoakeire Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase Yeso Kristo Omonene oito! Naki inche omonyene ase okomanya kwane nigo ngokorera amachiko a Nyasae, korende ase engencho y’obobe bwane nigo ngokorera amachiko ’ebibe.
english: Thanks be to God-- through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, I myself in my mind am a slave to God's law, but in the sinful nature a slave to the law of sin.

ekegusii: that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. He who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father, who sent him.
english: erinde bonsi basike Omwana buna basigete Tata. Oyotasigeti Omwana tasigeti Tata oyo omotomete.

ekegusii: bonsi babe abamo, buna aye Tata ore ime asende, na inche ime yao, erinde na aba babe abamo ime yaito; ense enyare kwengena ng’a naye gwantomete.
english: that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.

ekegusii: erinde ase erieta ria Yeso kera riru riringwe, ri’abwo bare igoro, na ase ense, na inse y’ense,
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

ekegusii: koreng’ana nenchili y’obonene bwa Nyasae, oyore Ogosesenigwa okonene, eye inche negenirwe koyeraria.
english: that conforms to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which he entrusted to me.

ekegusii: Rituko eri nario Daudi achigete ritang’ani ng’a ogotera gw’okomoiraneria Omonene ng’a mbuya mono goterwe n’Asafu na abanto bamwabo ase enchera eyio.
english: That day David first committed to Asaph and his associates this psalm of thanks to the LORD:

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Daudi akarua agwo, agatama korwa ase Saulo, akagenda ase Akisi, omoruoti o Gati,
english: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.

ekegusii: Na ase rituko riria akababeka babe bagwatia chinko na korenta amache ase omoganda na ase egesasimero ki’Omonene, aase aria Omonene achorete asasimerwe. Naboigo bagendererete gokora goika rero iga.
english: That day he made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers for the community and for the altar of the LORD at the place the LORD would choose. And that is what they are to this day.

ekegusii: Erio Herode na Pilato bakabwatana obwanchi ase rituko riria; naki ritang’ani nigo barenge nobobisa barabwo ase barabwo.
english: That day Herod and Pilate became friends-- before this they had been enemies.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria riria abasomba ba Isaka bagacha, bakamorentera amang’ana igoro y’entuboka eria banyorete, bakamotebia, “Twanyorire amache.”
english: That day Isaac's servants came and told him about the well they had dug. They said, "We've found water!"

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Yoshua akaumokera na kobwata omochie o Makeda, agaita na gosiria nemioro abanto bonsi pi abarenge imeo, amo nomoruoti obo. Onde tatooregete nonya noyomo. Agakora omoruoti o Makeda buna akorete omoruoti o Yeriko.
english: That day Joshua took Makkedah. He put the city and its king to the sword and totally destroyed everyone in it. He left no survivors. And he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.

ekegusii: Tiga rituko riria ribe omosunte; Nyasae ore igoro tabaisa koriechandera, gose omobaso tobaisa koribarera.
english: That day-- may it turn to darkness; may God above not care about it; may no light shine upon it.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Abaisraeli bakabua Abamoabu, na ense eria ekaba nomorembe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na etato.
english: That day Moab was made subject to Israel, and the land had peace for eighty years.

ekegusii: Rituko riria Omonene akaimokereria Yoshua igoro, ase amasio ’abanto bonsi. Barabwo bakaba basigete Yoshua ase obogima bwaye bwonsi, buna basigete Musa.
english: That day the LORD exalted Joshua in the sight of all Israel; and they revered him all the days of his life, just as they had revered Moses.

ekegusii: Naboigo ase rituko riria Omonene atooretie Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko ’Abamisiri; na Abaisraeli bakarora Abamisiri bakwete bacheng’enenete ase engegu y’enyancha.
english: That day the LORD saved Israel from the hands of the Egyptians, and Israel saw the Egyptians lying dead on the shore.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria, rigachia koba mogoroba, akabatebia, “Twamboke gochia ng’umbu.”
english: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, "Let us go over to the other side."

ekegusii: Rituko riria nigo rire eri’endamwamu, ne rituko ri’emechando na obororo, ne rituko ri’ogosirigwa na ogotigara bosa, ne rituko ri’omosunte na omorumbe, ne rituko ri’amare na omosunte ekerima.
english: That day will be a day of wrath, a day of distress and anguish, a day of trouble and ruin, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and blackness,

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Abaisraeli bagaita Abafilisti gochakera korwa Mikimasi goikera Ayaloni. Abaisraeli bakarosa mono ase okogoya, bare nenchara.
english: That day, after the Israelites had struck down the Philistines from Micmash to Aijalon, they were exhausted.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo oino amanye buna akogambera omobere oye omonyene ase obochenu na ogosika,
english: that each of you should learn to control his own body in a way that is holy and honorable,

ekegusii: ng’a abakungu b’Abaisraeli nigo barenge kogenda kobokia amagombo ase okoinyora omoiseke o Yefta, oria Omogileadi, ase engaki y’amatuko ane ase kera omwaka.
english: that each year the young women of Israel go out for four days to commemorate the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite.

ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, erioba korikogwa, bakamorentera bonsi abarenge abarwaire, na ababwatetwe nebirecha.
english: That evening after sunset the people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed.

ekegusii: Ekero baikaranseteo, omogaaka oyomo agacha, orenge korwa mogondo. Ere nigo arenge omonto bw’ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, na bono nigo arenge omomenyi bw’omochie o Gibea. (Abanto b’aase aria nigo barenge Ababenjamin).
english: That evening an old man from the hill country of Ephraim, who was living in Gibeah (the men of the place were Benjamites), came in from his work in the fields.

ekegusii: Mogoroba chinkware chigacha, chigaichora ase batoorete, na inkio mambia aase onsi aetanaine aase aria akanyorwa atoorire riime.
english: That evening quail came and covered the camp, and in the morning there was a layer of dew around the camp.

ekegusii: Omonto kararie na konywa, naende egokie ase ebio echandeire, ekio nekeegwa kia Nyasae.
english: That everyone may eat and drink, and find satisfaction in all his toil-- this is the gift of God.

ekegusii: erinde monto onde bwensi oyomwegenire tasira, korende abe nobogima bwa kare na kare.”
english: that everyone who believes in him may have eternal life.

ekegusii: na egesicha giasusanire kere obwari bw’obonene bwaye, ekio kere ase egetunwa igoro agwo ase rikura ritobu nkebe buna ogotongorwa kw’amako agotang’anera rigesa, ayio omonto akorora oyatwa, na ekero ayabekire koboko oyaria.
english: That fading flower, his glorious beauty, set on the head of a fertile valley, will be like a fig ripe before harvest-- as soon as someone sees it and takes it in his hand, he swallows it.

ekegusii: ekiagera Nyasae nigo arenge ime ya Kristo, akabwatania ense amo nere omonyene, tababarera ogosaria kwabo; ere obekire asetore ring’ana ri’okobwatanigwa.
english: that God was reconciling the world to himself in Christ, not counting men's sins against them. And he has committed to us the message of reconciliation.

ekegusii: Nigo nganetie Nyasae anche ang’ake ansegenye, arambore okoboko kwaye ang’ite nkwe!
english: that God would be willing to crush me, to let loose his hand and cut me off!

ekegusii: eye yaikire gocha asemore. Nabo yaikire ense yonsi, na kwama, na gokina, buna yakinire ase egati yaino inwe abanyene korwa rituko riria mwaigwete na komanya obuya bwa Nyasae ase ekeene.
english: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and understood God's grace in all its truth.

ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene agoteba, oyo oorogetie aya korwa kare.
english: that have been known for ages.

ekegusii: obo ere akabomenta asetore ase chisemi na obong’aini bwonsi.
english: that he lavished on us with all wisdom and understanding.

ekegusii: Erio Herode agatiana ase okomoriera eira ng’a namoe kende gionsi araborie.
english: that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.

ekegusii: eyio eragere omonto agenderere koba moyo botambe, tabaisa kogenda ase embeera.
english: that he should live on forever and not see decay.

ekegusii: naende agatindekwa, erio akaboka rituko ria gatato, buna amariko agoteba;
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

ekegusii: Oroiboro rwaye ndogenderere kobao botambe, na ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene nkegenderere kobao, buna erioba rirabe rireo ase obosio bwane.
english: that his line will continue forever and his throne endure before me like the sun;

ekegusii: erinde intenene ase abanto ba Sayoni, mbatebie ase ebiita biabo amang’ana onsi agerire nkogotogia; ningokere ogotooreka kwao.
english: that I may declare your praises in the gates of the Daughter of Zion and there rejoice in your salvation.

ekegusii: Erio inyare korora amaya abanto bao abachore baranyore, na inche inyare kogokera omogoko bw’abanto bao, naende inyare gwetogia amo nabanto bare omwando oo.
english: that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of your nation and join your inheritance in giving praise.

ekegusii: Nimbe ngotaara ase obosio bw’Omonene, inde ase ense y’abanto bare moyo.
english: that I may walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

ekegusii: that I will accept nothing belonging to you, not even a thread or the thong of a sandal, so that you will never be able to say, 'I made Abram rich.'
english: ng’a tinkoira nonya ng’ake eusi, gose enuga y’egekoroto kiao, gose kende gionsi kiao, obaise gocha goteba: Ninche natenenkirie Aburamu.

ekegusii: nigo ndaike gochia inse, indore onye bakorire amabe amange buna ekerero eke kiang’ikeire kegoteba; onye taibo, nimanye ayio.”
english: that I will go down and see if what they have done is as bad as the outcry that has reached me. If not, I will know."

ekegusii: Ekiagera koraorokie nomonwa oo, ng’a Yeso nere Omonene, na kwegena ime ase enkoro yao ng’a Nyasae namobogetie korwa ase abakure, notoorigwe.
english: That if you confess with your mouth, "Jesus is Lord," and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo kwabeire kogokora emeremo nabarabwo, naboigo bare, abwo kwabeire kogokora oboonchoreria nabarabwo korwa obwana bwao. Kera oyomo nabwatie enchera yaye, onde tari oragotoorie.”
english: That is all they can do for you-- these you have labored with and trafficked with since childhood. Each of them goes on in his error; there is not one that can save you.

ekegusii: Naboigo riire riagendererete botambe gotuba Obomenyo boria Obochenu; ase obotuko rirorekana rire buna omorero.
english: That is how it continued to be; the cloud covered it, and at night it looked like fire.

ekegusii: Oyio tari oro omoroberio oito, korende omonto oyomo bw’ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, oimokire koba mamincha y’omoruoti Daudi. Mosokie, nainche indue aa ase omochie oyo!” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Rigereria, noruterwe omotwe oye ase orwaki igoro.”
english: That is not the case. A man named Sheba son of Bicri, from the hill country of Ephraim, has lifted up his hand against the king, against David. Hand over this one man, and I'll withdraw from the city." The woman said to Joab, "His head will be thrown to you from the wall."

ekegusii: Agwo nao ebisaku bigotiira gochia, ebio bire ebisaku bi’Omonene. Abaisraeli abwo nigo bachigetwe ng’a babe bakoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase erieta ri’Omonene.
english: That is where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, to praise the name of the LORD according to the statute given to Israel.

ekegusii: Ase ensemo yane nigo nganetie mono korandia enchili nonya nasemore abamomenyete Rumi.
english: That is why I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are at Rome.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nanyorire emechando eye. Korende tinkorora obosooku, naki nimomanyete ere oyonyegenete, naende ninde nobomaene ng’a goika Rituko riria ere nanyare korenda keria angacherete.
english: That is why I am suffering as I am. Yet I am not ashamed, because I know whom I have believed, and am convinced that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him for that day.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nabeire nobwoba koba ase obosio bwaye, na ekero nkoyarengereria nigo nkomwoboa.
english: That is why I am terrified before him; when I think of all this, I fear him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo neroche ng’a tinyisaini gocha asore; korende kwana ring’ana rioka, na omosomba one nagwene.
english: That is why I did not even consider myself worthy to come to you. But say the word, and my servant will be healed.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nkagechigwa nekegori keria, ngateba: Botambe abanto aba nigo basirete ase chinkoro chiabo, ne chinchera chiane tibachimanyeti,
english: That is why I was angry with that generation, and I said, 'Their hearts are always going astray, and they have not known my ways.'

ekegusii: Ase ayio oboremo obo nigo bokorokwa Oboremo bw’Amanyinga goika rero.
english: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.

ekegusii: Ase ayio okarokwa Babeli, ekiagera Omonene atantanetie omonwa bw’abanto b’ense yonsi, na korwa agwo Omonene akabaserebania bagende ense yonsi, bayemenye.
english: That is why it was called Babel--because there the LORD confused the language of the whole world. From there the LORD scattered them over the face of the whole earth.

ekegusii: Nakio gekogera abange asemore bare abareu na abarwaire, na abanto batai bake bakure.
english: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abayahudi, abamenyete ase emechie emeke etagiteire, nigo barenge korenda rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi bw’Adari koba rituko ri’omogoko na eri’omoyega, Rituko Rinene, bagatomerana ebiegwa bi’endagera engiya baroisetie.
english: That is why rural Jews-- those living in villages-- observe the fourteenth of the month of Adar as a day of joy and feasting, a day for giving presents to each other.

ekegusii: Ase ayio emeeto yagoetananire, na obwoba bwa mobosokano nkogochanda bore.
english: That is why snares are all around you, why sudden peril terrifies you,

ekegusii: Aya naro akogera “Ebuku ye chisegi chi’Omonene” yakwana igoro ya “Omochie bw’Abahebu ase orogongo rwa Sufa, na amakura aase orooche rw’Arinoni rogoeta,
english: That is why the Book of the Wars of the LORD says:"...Waheb in Suphah and the ravines, the Arnon

ekegusii: Nakio kiagerire Abaisraeli babuirwe nababisa babo. Batamire, ekiagera barabwo abanyene baragererigwe ase ogosirigwa. Inche tinkoba amo nainwe goika mwarusirie korwa asemore ebinto ebi bionsi biragereirie ase ogosarigwa.
english: That is why the Israelites cannot stand against their enemies; they turn their backs and run because they have been made liable to destruction. I will not be with you anymore unless you destroy whatever among you is devoted to destruction.

ekegusii: Naki ase engencho eyio Abayahudi bakambwatera ime ase Hekalu, bagateema kong’ita.
english: That is why the Jews seized me in the temple courts and tried to kill me.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio Abalawi tibaetwe omwando bw’orogongo amo nabanto bamwabo. Omonene nere omwando obo, buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, abatebetie.)
english: That is why the Levites have no share or inheritance among their brothers; the LORD is their inheritance, as the LORD your God told them.)

ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera abateri be chingero bakobora: “Inchuo ase Hesiboni, tiga omochie oyo oagachwe, tiga omochie o Sihoni oagachwe na kogitwa.
english: That is why the poets say: "Come to Heshbon and let it be rebuilt; let Sihon's city be restored.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ensoko eria ekarokwa Beeri‐Lahai‐Roi; ero nigo ere egati ya Kadeshi na Beredi.
english: That is why the well was called Beer Lahai Roi; it is still there, between Kadesh and Bered.

ekegusii: Ayio naro akogera abakuani ba Dagoni na abanto bonsi baria bagosoa ase hekalu ya Dagoni agwo Asidodi batari gotacha omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: That is why to this day neither the priests of Dagon nor any others who enter Dagon's temple at Ashdod step on the threshold.

ekegusii: Ase engencho ya Kristo nagweneirwe namareu, na ogochaywa, na obokong’u, na okorosigwa, na emechando yonsi; ekero inde omoreu, erio nario inde ne chinguru.
english: That is why, for Christ's sake, I delight in weaknesses, in insults, in hardships, in persecutions, in difficulties. For when I am weak, then I am strong.

ekegusii: ebinto ebio bionsi bi’eeri eyio abisokie isiko y’ebitwori, abiire gochia aase achenire, ase ribu rigotugutwa, abisambere ase omorero bwe chinko agwo igoro ase ribu.
english: that is, all the rest of the bull-- he must take outside the camp to a place ceremonially clean, where the ashes are thrown, and burn it in a wood fire on the ash heap.

ekegusii: erinde toremanie inche nainwe, kera omonto ase okwegena kw’oyonde, okwaino na okwane.
english: that is, that you and I may be mutually encouraged by each other's faith.

ekegusii: Ase okomaanorerwa natebetigwe obobisi boria buna nabarikera rero iga ase amang’ana amake.
english: that is, the mystery made known to me by revelation, as I have already written briefly.

ekegusii: na ime ase Basani oboruoti bwonsi bwa Ogi, oyo orenge kogambera Asitaroti na Edirei. (Ogi nere oyo otigarete korwa ase Abarefai.) Abwo Musa konya abuire na kobaseria.
english: that is, the whole kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and had survived as one of the last of the Rephaites. Moses had defeated them and taken over their land.

ekegusii: erinde ense yonsi ekiamoke, ebwatwe ase chinsinyo chiaye, na abakori amabe banyegerigwe barueo?
english: that it might take the earth by the edges and shake the wicked out of it?

ekegusii: That kind of persuasion does not come from the one who calls you.
english: Okoebereria okwo tikwarwete asare ere oyobarangeretie inwe.

ekegusii: Naki omonto oria takaga ng’a nanyore egento korwa ase Omonene;
english: That man should not think he will receive anything from the Lord;

ekegusii: Eamate y’omonto oyio emanyekane ase Abaisraeli, buna eamate y’omonto oyio osomoretwe egekoroto korwa ase okogoro kwaye.
english: That man's line shall be known in Israel as The Family of the Unsandaled.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, omoyo one nogenderere kogotogia, togokira. Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, ninkoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera kare na kare.
english: that my heart may sing to you and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give you thanks forever.

ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi bw’abanto bagaaka eriogi rinene, bakaba bakorera ase obotuko boria.
english: That night all the people of the community raised their voices and wept aloud.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria Nyasae akaorokera Sulemani, akamotebia, “Mboria aya oganetie nkoe!”
english: That night God appeared to Solomon and said to him, "Ask for whatever you want me to give you."

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agacha ase Baalamu ase obotuko boria, akamotebia, “Onye abanto aba bachire gokorangeria, imoka ogende amo nabarabwo, korende egento ndagochike nakio gioka orakore.”
english: That night God came to Balaam and said, "Since these men have come to summon you, go with them, but do only what I tell you."

ekegusii: Na ase obotuko boria Nyasae agakora bo; mambia yaye risankwa nigo riarenge eriomo, korende riroba inse rionsi rikaba rinyiu ase obotooru.
english: That night God did so. Only the fleece was dry; all the ground was covered with dew.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo Yakobo akaimoka, akaira abakungu baye babere, na abasomba baye babere abakungu, na abana baye ikomi nomo, akaamboka orooche rwa Yaboki.
english: That night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two maidservants and his eleven sons and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.

ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima otube obotuko boria, tibobaisa kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’omwaka, gose kobarwa amo namatuko ande ay’emetienyi.
english: That night-- may thick darkness seize it; may it not be included among the days of the year nor be entered in any of the months.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria omomalaika bw’Omonene akagenda ase egetwori ki’Abaasuri, agaita abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato na isano (185,000). Ekero abanto babogete mambia, bakarora emebere y’abanto bakwete aande onsi.
english: That night the angel of the LORD went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning-- there were all the dead bodies!

ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria omoruoti tararete chitoro; agachika arenterwe ebuku erikire amang’ana ’ebiro arenge gokoreka agwenerete koinyorwa, na amang’ana ayio agasomwa asare.
english: That night the king could not sleep; so he ordered the book of the chronicles, the record of his reign, to be brought in and read to him.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo obwo Omonene akamoorokera, akamotebia, “Inche ninche Nyasae o Ibrahimu iso, tibwoboa, ekiagera nigo inde amo naye, ningosesenie aye amo nororeria rwao, ase engencho y’omosomba one Ibrahimu.”
english: That night the LORD appeared to him and said, "I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bless you and will increase the number of your descendants for the sake of my servant Abraham."

ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko obwo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Nathani, rikamotebia,
english: That night the word of God came to Nathan, saying:

ekegusii: Korende ase obotuko obwo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Nathani, rikamotebia,
english: That night the word of the LORD came to Nathan, saying:

ekegusii: Bakanyoisia ise edivai ase obotuko boria; omoiseke oria omotangi agachia, akarara nere, ise tamanya ekero arara, gose ekero aboka.
english: That night they got their father to drink wine, and the older daughter went in and lay with him. He was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.

ekegusii: Aase aria akarokwa Rikura ri’Esikoli ase engencho y’orosagia roria Abaisraeli babutorete korwa aroro.
english: That place was called the Valley of Eshcol because of the cluster of grapes the Israelites cut off there.

ekegusii: Korende omobani oyio, gose omonyondoto oyio, naitwe akwe, ekiagera oyio nigo akoborokereria ng’a mobe aba motari koigwera Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyio obarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na kobatooria korwa ase ense y’obosomba. Omonto oyio nigo arabasirie motige enchera eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, abachigete kobwatia. Goika morusie obobe bwonsi korwa asemore.
english: That prophet or dreamer must be put to death, because he preached rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt and redeemed you from the land of slavery; he has tried to turn you from the way the LORD your God commanded you to follow. You must purge the evil from among you.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’egesaku kia Benjamin agatama korwa ase esegi, akaminyoka gochia Silo, agaikao rituko erio erio, ore ne chianga chiatandoire, na obegete ebuse ase omotwe oye.
english: That same day a Benjamite ran from the battle line and went to Shiloh, his clothes torn and dust on his head.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Labani akarusia chigoree chimarera ne chinkororo, ne chimbori chiaberi, echiare chinkanga ne chinkororo, na kera eyare nebimoa ebirabu ase omobere oye, na kera eng’ondi eyare emwamu. Echio chionsi agachiaa abana baye abamura bachirende.
english: That same day he removed all the male goats that were streaked or spotted, and all the speckled or spotted female goats (all that had white on them) and all the dark-colored lambs, and he placed them in the care of his sons.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Yeso akarua nyomba agaikaransa ase enyancha mbarabare.
english: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the lake.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria omoruoti Ahaswero akaa Esteri eting’ana enyomba ya Hamani, omobisa oria bw’Abayahudi. Moredekai akanyora ribaga gosoa ase omoruoti, ekiagera Esteri konya otebirie omoruoti igoro y’obomwabo bare nere.
english: That same day King Xerxes gave Queen Esther the estate of Haman, the enemy of the Jews. And Mordecai came into the presence of the king, for Esther had told how he was related to her.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio erio Farao agachika abwo abachandi amo nabateneneri, akabatebia,
english: That same day Pharaoh gave this order to the slave drivers and foremen in charge of the people:

ekegusii: Omonto oria o Nyasae akarua ekemanyererio ase rituko riria, agateba, “Eke nakio ekemanyererio Omonene akwanire: Rora, egesasimero eke nagetandoke, ne ribu riria rire igoro yaye riiteke.”
english: That same day the man of God gave a sign: "This is the sign the LORD has declared: The altar will be split apart and the ashes on it will be poured out."

ekegusii: Rituko riria Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bakobora ng’a okobokigwa tikori, bakamoboria,
english: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko boria Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Imokia eeri ya iso, na eeri eyemo ende ere nemiaka etano na ebere, naende otagore egesasimero gia iso, keria aagacherete Baali, na okeiyerie inse; naende onache emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, ere ensemo y’egesasimero keria.
english: That same night the LORD said to him, "Take the second bull from your father's herd, the one seven years old. Tear down your father's altar to Baal and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo barie chinyama chiria chisambire nomorero, amo nemegati etabekiri memera, ne chinyeni chindoro.
english: That same night they are to eat the meat roasted over the fire, along with bitter herbs, and bread made without yeast.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteba, “Ase amang’ana ’emenwa yaito ntore ne chinguru, aya togokwana nigo agotokonya. Ning’o ore omonene gotobua?”
english: that says, "We will triumph with our tongues; we own our lips--who is our master?"

ekegusii: buna Kristo agwenerete achandwe, naende ase okoba omotang’ani ase okobokigwa kw’abakure, nararie amang’ana ’omobaso ase abanto baye, na ase abanto b’Ebisaku.”
english: that the Christ would suffer and, as the first to rise from the dead, would proclaim light to his own people and to the Gentiles."

ekegusii: ekiagera ebitongwa ebinyene nabisiborwe korwa ase obosibwa bwabo bw’ogosareka, bisoe ime ase ogosiborwa kw’obonene bw’abana ba Nyasae.
english: that the creation itself will be liberated from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.

ekegusii: ng’a omokori amabe nigo akorendwa ekero emechando yachire, naende atoorigwe ase rituko ri’endamwamu?
english: that the evil man is spared from the day of calamity, that he is delivered from the day of wrath?

ekegusii: omochengo bw’abakori amabe noyo bw’engaki enke, na omogoko bw’abatamoirogeti Nyasae nomweng’e?
english: that the mirth of the wicked is brief, the joy of the godless lasts but a moment.

ekegusii: erinde mwanyabanto abatigaire barigie Omonene amo nabanto b’Ebisaku bionsi, aba narangeirie ase erieta riane.
english: that the remnant of men may seek the Lord, and all the Gentiles who bear my name, says the Lord, who does these things'

ekegusii: Ayio nigo akoregete, erinde Abaisraeli baigwere emeroberio yaye echikire, naende barende amachiko aye. Motogie Omonene!
english: that they might keep his precepts and observe his laws. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: ee, arikwe nekaramu eroisirie korwa ase risasi, ekioma egekong’u, amang’erwe ase egetare abeo kare na kare.
english: that they were inscribed with an iron tool on lead, or engraved in rock forever!

ekegusii: Abakori amabe nabaisa koreereta buna obonyansi, na abakori ebibe bonsi babe bagosicha buya, korende omoerio obo nogosirigwa goika kare na kare.
english: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo obwo Belisasari, omoruoti bw’Abakalidayo, agaitwa agakwa,
english: That very night Belshazzar, king of the Babylonians, was slain,

ekegusii: Ase amatuko aria bagakora omogwekano bw’emori, bakarenta ekeng’wanso ase omogwekano oria basasimete, bakagokera emeremo y’amaboko abo.
english: That was the time they made an idol in the form of a calf. They brought sacrifices to it and held a celebration in honor of what their hands had made.

ekegusii: That was why his parents said, "He is of age; ask him."
english: Nero engencho yagerete abaibori baye bakabora, “Ere nomonto omogima, moborie.”

ekegusii: Eri riarengeo korwa omochakano, eri twaigwete, eri twaroche namaiso aito, eri twarigereretie, nonya namaboko aito akaribwata, eri nario Ring’ana ri’obogima togokwana.
english: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked at and our hands have touched-- this we proclaim concerning the Word of life.

ekegusii: ng’a abanto bande ababe batarochi inchera barure ase egati yaino, bang’usire abanto b’omochie obo, na kobasiria, bagoteba: Inchuo togende gosasima chinyasae ching’ao konya motana gosasima rinde.
english: that wicked men have arisen among you and have led the people of their town astray, saying, "Let us go and worship other gods" (gods you have not known),

ekegusii: that will not heed the tune of the charmer, however skillful the enchanter may be.
english: erinde tiriigwa amariogi abanyamosira, gose ay’abaebia b’obong’aini.

ekegusii: Egutwa y’oboenenu y’abanto b’Efraimu batindire netiringwe namagoro;
english: That wreath, the pride of Ephraim's drunkards, will be trampled underfoot.

ekegusii: Nigo okomorigereria kera emambia, naende nigo okomorenga kera engaki.
english: that you examine him every morning and test him every moment?

ekegusii: Aye kwebire Omonene, Omotongi oo, oyio bwarete igoro, na akabeka oboroso bw’ense. Omobaso boira aye nigo ogendererete kwoboa ekeririanda ki’omochandi oo buna nigo are ang’e kogoseria. Korende ng’ai ekeririanda ki’omochandi kere?
english: that you forget the LORD your Maker, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth, that you live in constant terror every day because of the wrath of the oppressor, who is bent on destruction? For where is the wrath of the oppressor?

ekegusii: Nigo mweng’ainete ekero mwantomete ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, mogantebia: Genda otosabere ase Omonene, Nyasae oo, na amang’ana ande onsi Omonene, Nyasae oito, aragotebie, aye gokoyatotebia goika toyakore.
english: that you made a fatal mistake when you sent me to the LORD your God and said, 'Pray to the LORD our God for us; tell us everything he says and we will do it.'

ekegusii: nario monyare koba abana ba Iso oino ore igoro, ekiagera ere nigo akobabareria omobaso oye ababe na abaya, abatweria embura abakori oboronge, na abatari gokora oboronge.
english: that you may be sons of your Father in heaven. He causes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the righteous and the unrighteous.

ekegusii: that you may maintain discretion and your lips may preserve knowledge.
english: Erio nario oramanye korenda ebirengererio biao, na ebikoba biao birende chisemi.

ekegusii: that you may plunge your feet in the blood of your foes, while the tongues of your dogs have their share."
english: erinde motache amanyinga abo namagoro aino, ne chisese chiaino chinyore ebitari biabo bi’ababisa baino.”

ekegusii: naye nonyare gotebia abana bao na abachokoro bao amang’ana aya nakorire ase egati y’Abamisiri, na ebikone ebi naorokirie ase egati yabo. Erio momanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: that you may tell your children and grandchildren how I dealt harshly with the Egyptians and how I performed my signs among them, and that you may know that I am the LORD."

ekegusii: that you must search out my faults and probe after my sin--
english: goika okona‐gotuka okomocha kwane na korigia ebibe biane?

ekegusii: bono togotokorera bobe bonde, buna intwe totagokunete, gose totagokorerete bobe, otatiga amaya oka; tokagotiga okagenda bwoo nomorembe. Naye bono nomosesenigwa bw’Omonene.”
english: that you will do us no harm, just as we did not molest you but always treated you well and sent you away in peace. And now you are blessed by the LORD."

ekegusii: Mondiere eira ng’a inamotoorie obogima bwa tata, na baba, na bamura baminto, na basubati baminto, na abanto babo bonsi! Mototoorie korwa ase amakweri!”
english: that you will spare the lives of my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, and all who belong to them, and that you will save us from death."

ekegusii: Tiga enchera yao emanyekane ase ense, na okobua kwao kw’ogotooria komanyekane ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
english: that your ways may be known on earth, your salvation among all nations.

ekegusii: Chikiro chilifu isano chie chifeta chiria nigo chiakoretwe ase okoroisia chinterekerero chi’Obomenyo Obochenu ne chi’etoto eria; chikiro chilifu isano ase chinterekerero rigana erimo, chikiro emerongo etano ase kera enterekerero.
english: The 100 talents of silver were used to cast the bases for the sanctuary and for the curtain-- 100 bases from the 100 talents, one talent for each base.

ekegusii: Omoigoto oria tokoinyorwa ase ense eye, ase engencho y’enchara eye erache gocha korwa nyuma yaye, ekiagera nigo erabe endito mono.
english: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, because the famine that follows it will be so severe.

ekegusii: Orue okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa egetuba ekemo, amo nemingichi eria entang’ani. Ekenyugwa eke egetindi keraumorwe agwo Aase Aachenu, ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: The accompanying drink offering is to be a quarter of a hin of fermented drink with each lamb. Pour out the drink offering to the LORD at the sanctuary.

ekegusii: Omonto ore omogisangio bw’omoibi nigo agechete obogima bwaye obonyene; nigo akoigwa ogotianerwa gw’okoragereria, korende okira takoorokia gento.
english: The accomplice of a thief is his own enemy; he is put under oath and dare not testify.

ekegusii: Amang’ana igoro y’abamura ba Yoashi na amang’ana akwanetwe igoro yaye, na buna aroisetie enyomba ya Nyasae, nigo arikire ase Ogotebereria kw’Ebuku y’Abaruoti. Amasia, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: The account of his sons, the many prophecies about him, and the record of the restoration of the temple of God are written in the annotations on the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Omonto oria oitete oyonde moeneno goika agenderere kobeera ase omochie oria bw’obotamero goika omokuani bw’engaki eyio akwe. Korende omokuani oria omonene gakure, omonto oria nairane gochia ase ense yaye, na ase omwando oye.
english: The accused must stay in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest; only after the death of the high priest may he return to his own property.

ekegusii: Ogokora gwe chingencho chi’ebibe nigo kore maiso marore na korokwo nobotomani, eubi, obonyaka,
english: The acts of the sinful nature are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity and debauchery;

ekegusii: Ekero akoibora nigo arabarine nonya nomogoye okorwa ase enda yaye, na abana akoibora. Ere omonyene nayorie bobisi, ekiagera oborirwe ebinto akoria. Emechando eyio nero ababisa baino barabarentere ekero barasiongorokane emechie yaino yonsi.
english: the afterbirth from her womb and the children she bears. For she intends to eat them secretly during the siege and in the distress that your enemy will inflict on you in your cities.

ekegusii: Ebibao biasiekeire ebitange nigo biarenge ase chinyasi chi’ebinyomba biria bi’oborendi, na ase emetobwa yabo, ne chinsemo chionsi chi’oboagacho obwo, ne chisiiro nigo chiachabeire nemegwekano y’emekendo.
english: The alcoves and the projecting walls inside the gateway were surmounted by narrow parapet openings all around, as was the portico; the openings all around faced inward. The faces of the projecting walls were decorated with palm trees.

ekegusii: Ebinyomba bi’oborendi mbiarengeo, kera akamo nigo karenge nobotambe bw’emoti eyemo, na obo gare bw’emoti eyemo boigo. Ribaga eriarenge gati‐gati y’ebinyomba ebio nigo riarenge ri’obotambe bw’amaboko atano, na ekerengo ki’egesona ki’oboagacho bw’egeita nigo kiarenge eki’emoti eyemo.
english: The alcoves for the guards were one rod long and one rod wide, and the projecting walls between the alcoves were five cubits thick. And the threshold of the gate next to the portico facing the temple was one rod deep.

ekegusii: Mokorere abamenyi bamenyete ase egati yaino buna mogokorera ababiare, mobanche buna mweanchete inwe abanyene, ekiagera nainwe nabo mwarenge abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: The alien living with you must be treated as one of your native-born. Love him as yourself, for you were aliens in Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
