english: Omoganda ogotiira gochiao, na barabwo bagachaka gosaba Pilato abakorere buna anarete kobakorera.

ekegusii: Omoganda okabwatana ase okobogerera, na abagambi bakabatandorera chianga chiabo na gochirusia, bagachika ng’a baakwe ne chinyimbo.
english: The crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas, and the magistrates ordered them to be stripped and beaten.

ekegusii: Bagategerera Paulo goika ring’ana riria rigakwanwa. Erio bagaaka eriogi riabo, bagateba, “Morusieo oyo ase ense, ekiagera tagwenereti abe moyo.”
english: The crowd listened to Paul until he said this. Then they raised their voices and shouted, "Rid the earth of him! He's not fit to live!"

ekegusii: Omoganda oria okabatogonyera ng’a banyare gokira, korende bakamenta kwoga eriogi, bakabora, “Omonene, tororere amabera, aye Omwana o Daudi.”
english: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

ekegusii: Erio omoganda okamoiraneria, “Nigo tokoigwa ase amachiko ng’a Kristo nigo arabeo goika kare na kare, na aye naki okobora ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto aimokererigwe igoro? Oyo Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere ng’o?”
english: The crowd spoke up, "We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever, so how can you say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up'? Who is this 'Son of Man'?"

ekegusii: ekiagera omoganda bw’abanto omotunyanete, ogoaka egeturi, ogateba, “Morusieo oyo!”
english: The crowd that followed kept shouting, "Away with him!"

ekegusii: Nabo abanto abateneine ang’e bakaigwa, bakabora ng’a kwabeire okogukura; abande bakabora, “Nomomalaika ogokwana nere.”
english: The crowd that was there and heard it said it had thundered; others said an angel had spoken to him.

ekegusii: The crowds answered, "This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee."
english: Emeganda ekairaneria, “Oyio nere Yeso, omobani o Nazareti o Galili.”

ekegusii: Emeganda eria yatang’aine, na eyare komotunyana, bagaaka eriogi, bagateba, “Hosana ase Omwana o Daudi! Nasesenirie oyio ogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene! Hosana, aye ore igoro!”
english: The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted, "Hosanna to the Son of David!" "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Hosanna in the highest!"

ekegusii: Chigutwa chiarenge ase emetwe yaito chiagure inse. Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera twakorire ebibe!
english: The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!

ekegusii: Egutwa eyio negenderere kobeera ime ase Hekalu y’Omonene koba ekeinyorio kia Helidai, na Tobia, na Yedaya, na Heni, mosinto o Sefania.
english: The crown will be given to Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah and Hen son of Zephaniah as a memorial in the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana efeta egoteemerwa ase enyongo ekonyititora, na etahabu ase omorero ekebemberi, naboigo omonto agoteemwa na komanyekana ase ogosikwa kwaye.
english: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but man is tested by the praise he receives.

ekegusii: Efeta nigo egoteemerwa ase enyongo ekoyenyititora, na etahabu yateemerwa ase omorero ekebemberi, korende Omonene nere okorenga chinkoro.
english: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the heart.

ekegusii: korende monyore okoragererigwa komoraange koigwera amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae oino, gose komoraonchoke korwa ase enchera eye nkobachika rituko ria rero. Timobaisa gosasima chinyasae chinde ching’ao, echio motamanyete agwo ritang’ani.
english: the curse if you disobey the commands of the LORD your God and turn from the way that I command you today by following other gods, which you have not known.

ekegusii: Egetambaa ki’egesoero bakaroisia korwa ase chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani chisisire. Obotambe bw’egetambaa keria nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano koreng’ana nobogare bwaye buna ebitambaa binde bi’eraaro.
english: The curtain for the entrance to the courtyard was of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen-- the work of an embroiderer. It was twenty cubits long and, like the curtains of the courtyard, five cubits high,

ekegusii: Egetambaa gi’okonacha Hekalu kegatondoka korwa igoro goika inse, gekaba bibere.
english: The curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.

ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi’eraaro eetanaine Obomenyo boria na egesasimero, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori chionsi chireo amo nebikorero bigokorerwao. Barabwo bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.
english: the curtains of the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, the curtain for the entrance, the ropes and all the equipment used in its service. The Gershonites are to do all that needs to be done with these things.

ekegusii: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard;
english: ebitambaa ebirakenge eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiaye, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro,

ekegusii: na ebitambaa bi’eraaro, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’eraaro, ne chingori, na ebirochi, na ebikorero bionsi bi’obokoreri ase Obomenyo ime, ase Eema y’Omosangererekano,
english: the curtains of the courtyard with its posts and bases, and the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard; the ropes and tent pegs for the courtyard; all the furnishings for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting;

ekegusii: Naende babe bakorenda ebitambaa bigosungwa ase ogokenga eraaro, na ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro eetanaine Obomenyo Obochenu, na egesasimero, ne chingori chiabo. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.
english: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard surrounding the tabernacle and altar, and the ropes-- and everything related to their use.

ekegusii: Abadani bakamoiraneria “Tobaisa gokwana nonya ne ring’ana erimo naintwe. Abanto aba mbabaise koba nendamwamu na kogoita, aye amo nabanto bao bonsi mosire, mokwe.”
english: The Danites answered, "Don't argue with us, or some hot-tempered men will attack you, and you and your family will lose your lives."

ekegusii: Abanto ba Misiri nabanyore obosooku, nababekwe ase amaboko ’abanto bakorwa sugusu.”
english: The Daughter of Egypt will be put to shame, handed over to the people of the north."

ekegusii: Abanto ba Turo, abare abanda mono, nigo barakorentere ebiegwa, barigie ogwancherwa kwao.
english: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift, men of wealth will seek your favor.

ekegusii: Omoiseke oria Sayoni otigirwe buna egesa gi’okorendera kere ase omogondo bw’emesabibu giatigirwe bosa; nigo anga buna ekegutu kere ase omogondo bw’amasosa, na buna omochie oboeire.
english: The Daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a city under siege.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio abaiseke ba Selofehadi, mosinto o Heferi o Gileadi, o Makiri, o Manase bagacha. Aba nigo barwete ase chiamate chia Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, na amarieta abo naro aya: Mala, na Noa, na Hogila, na Milka, na Tirisa.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, belonged to the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph. The names of the daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah and Tirzah. They approached

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere Gedalia gaitirwe, na monto onde konya taramanya amang’ana ayio,
english: The day after Gedaliah's assassination, before anyone knew about it,

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria kabere nyuma kobariire Epasaka, bakaria okwama gw’ense eria: emegati etabekiri memera, na engano ekarangire, ase rituko erio erio.
english: The day after the Passover, that very day, they ate some of the produce of the land: unleavened bread and roasted grain.

ekegusii: Ankio ende otirimboke bwango gochia aase aria kwebisete rituko riria kwaganeirie. Obeere aroro, moino y’etui y’amagena aria.
english: The day after tomorrow, toward evening, go to the place where you hid when this trouble began, and wait by the stone Ezel.

ekegusii: Ayio akoreke ase rituko erimo ase chingongo chionsi chi’omoruoti Ahaswero, ne rituko erio nigo rirabe eria ikomi na gatato ri’omotienyi o ikomi na kabere okorokwa Adari.
english: The day appointed for the Jews to do this in all the provinces of King Xerxes was the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar.

ekegusii: Rituko ndiche ekero chindwaki chiao chiraagachwe. Ase rituko erio chimbebe chiao nchigareeigwe.
english: The day for building your walls will come, the day for extending your boundaries.

ekegusii: na buna akorete ebikone ebinge ase ense ya Misiri, na amakumia agwo ase orogongo rwa Soani.
english: the day he displayed his miraculous signs in Egypt, his wonders in the region of Zoan.

ekegusii: Omobaso noyoo, na obotuko nobwao, naye gwatongete omotienyi na erioba.
english: The day is yours, and yours also the night; you established the sun and moon.

ekegusii: Ekiagera ekero kende gionsi orasoke korwa aroro, bwamboke akarooche ga Kidironi, omanye ng’a gioka okwe; okomocha kw’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ao nigo korabe okwao.”
english: The day you leave and cross the Kidron Valley, you can be sure you will die; your blood will be on your own head."

ekegusii: ekiagera amatuko ngocha are ekero ndairanerie abanto baane Abaisraeli na Abayuda amaya abo; mbarente ase ense eyio naete chisokoro chiabo, na barabwo nabayeire ebe eyabo.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: The days are coming,' declares the LORD, 'when I will bring my people Israel and Judah back from captivity and restore them to the land I gave their forefathers to possess,' says the LORD."

ekegusii: Amatuko ’egesusuro aikire, ee, amatuko ay’ogoakanera ogokora kw’abanto aikire. Abaisraeli mbamanye ayio. Omobani obeire omoriri, na omonto ore nomoika obeire ebarimo, ekiagera obobe bwaino bwabeire obonge, na okogecha kwaino kwabeire okonene.
english: The days of punishment are coming, the days of reckoning are at hand. Let Israel know this. Because your sins are so many and your hostility so great, the prophet is considered a fool, the inspired man a maniac.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo amanyete amatuko ’abamoirogete, na omwando obo nogenderere kobao kare na kare.
english: The days of the blameless are known to the LORD, and their inheritance will endure forever.

ekegusii: Naki amatuko nagochere, ababisa bao barakoagachere orwaki bagoetanane, bagotange ase chinsemo chionsi,
english: The days will come upon you when your enemies will build an embankment against you and encircle you and hem you in on every side.

ekegusii: Oria okwete agasoka, oboyirie egetambaa amagoro na amaboko; obosio bwaye boboyirie egetambaa. Yeso akabatebia, “Mosansore, momotige agende.”
english: The dead man came out, his hands and feet wrapped with strips of linen, and a cloth around his face. Jesus said to them, "Take off the grave clothes and let him go."

ekegusii: The dead man sat up and began to talk, and Jesus gave him back to his mother.
english: Omonto oria egetondo akaboka, agaikaransa, agachaka gokwana. Yeso akamomoa ng’ina.

ekegusii: Ase ogokwa koria akwete nigo akwerete ebibe ara rimo rioka, korende obogima boria are nabwo nigo are nabwo ase Nyasae.
english: The death he died, he died to sin once for all; but the life he lives, he lives to God.

ekegusii: Chindiba nigo chigokana chiateba: Tibori asende aa, na enyancha nigo egoteba: Tibori aiga asende.
english: The deep says, 'It is not in me'; the sea says, 'It is not with me.'

ekegusii: The deep waters have covered them; they sank to the depths like a stone.
english: Amache abatubire, barimeire chindiba ime buna rigena rikorutwa.”

ekegusii: the deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope and the mountain sheep.
english: ne chinsune, ne chingabi, ne ebisia, ne chimbori chi’orosana, ne chiburo, ne chitobe, ne ching’ondi chi’orosana.

ekegusii: Egekengero ki’Abayuda nigo kiarusetigweo kegima. Ase engaki eyio mokarigia ebirwanero biarenge kogachwa ase Enyomba ye Rinani.
english: the defenses of Judah are stripped away. And you looked in that day to the weapons in the Palace of the Forest;

ekegusii: Ebirecha biria bikamosorora, bikabora, “Onye kogotorusia aa, rirorio toe ribaga tosoe ase riicho rie chimbeche.”
english: The demons begged Jesus, "If you drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs."

ekegusii: Ebirecha bionsi bikamosorora, bikabora, “Toire ase chimbeche, tonyare gosoa chirochio.”
english: The demons begged Jesus, "Send us among the pigs; allow us to go into them."

ekegusii: Ase egesaku gi’Aseri nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaimuna, abarwete ase Imuna, na Abaisibi, abarwete ase Isibi, na Ababeria, abarwete ase Beria.
english: The descendants of Asher by their clans were: through Imnah, the Imnite clan; through Ishvi, the Ishvite clan; through Beriah, the Beriite clan;

ekegusii: Abamura ba Bela nabwo Aridi na Naamani. Korwa ase Aridi nao Abaaridi barwete, na korwa ase Naamani nao Abanaamani barwete.
english: The descendants of Bela through Ard and Naaman were: through Ard, the Ardite clan; through Naaman, the Naamite clan.

ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Benjamin nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Ababela, abarwete ase Bela, na Abaasibeli, abarwete ase Asibeli, na Abaahiramu, abarwete ase Ahiramu,
english: The descendants of Benjamin by their clans were: through Bela, the Belaite clan; through Ashbel, the Ashbelite clan; through Ahiram, the Ahiramite clan;

ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chia Delaya, na Tobia, na Nekoda; bonsi namagana atano na rimo, na emerongo ene, na babere (642).
english: the descendants of Delaiah, Tobiah and Nekoda 642

ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chia Delaya, na Tobia, na Nekoda, bonsi namagana atano na rimo, na emerongo etano na babere (652).
english: The descendants of Delaiah, Tobiah and Nekoda 652

ekegusii: Ase abana b’Eliezeri Rehabia nere orenge omoteneneri obo. Eliezeri tabwate abana abamura bande; korende abana abamura ba Rehabia nigo barenge abange mono.
english: The descendants of Eliezer: Rehabiah was the first. Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very numerous.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elikana nabwo Amasi na Ahimoti.
english: The descendants of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth,

ekegusii: The descendants of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
english: Oro narwo ororeria rw’Efraimu: Sutela omomura oye, na Beredi omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye, na Eleada omomura oye, na Tahati omomura oye,

ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Gadi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abazefoni, abarwete ase Zefoni, na Abahagi, abarwete ase Hagi, na
english: The descendants of Gad by their clans were: through Zephon, the Zephonite clan; through Haggi, the Haggite clan; through Shuni, the Shunite clan;

ekegusii: Ase abana ba Gerisomu Sebueli nere orenge omoteneneri obo.
english: The descendants of Gershom: Shubael was the first.

ekegusii: Abagerisoni bakanyora emechie ikomi na etato korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru, na egi’Aseri, na ekia Nafutali, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase agwo Basani, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
english: The descendants of Gershon were allotted thirteen towns from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.

ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisomu bakaegwa emechie ikomi na etato agwo Basani korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku bia Isakaru, na Aseri, na Nafutali, na Manase agwo Basani.
english: The descendants of Gershon, clan by clan, were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher and Naphtali, and from the part of the tribe of Manasseh that is in Bashan.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hanania nabwo Pelatia na Yesaia, naende abamura ba Refaya, na ab’Arinani, na ab’Obadia, na aba Sekania.
english: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah, and the sons of Rephaiah, of Arnan, of Obadiah and of Shecaniah.

ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Isakaru nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abatola, abarwete ase Tola, na Abapua, abarwete ase Pua,
english: The descendants of Issachar by their clans were: through Tola, the Tolaite clan; through Puah, the Puite clan;

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abaiboire korwa ase Yakobo nigo barenge emerongo etano na ebere. Yusufu ere konya nao amenyete Misiri korwa kare.
english: The descendants of Jacob numbered seventy in all; Joseph was already in Egypt.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yekonia, oyo bwosetwe, nabwo aba: Sealitieli,
english: The descendants of Jehoiachin the captive: Shealtiel his son,

ekegusii: The descendants of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
english: Ororeria rwa Yoeli narwo oro: Yoeli akaibora Semaya, na Semaya akaibora Gogi, na Gogi akaibora Simei.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yonadabu, mosinto o Rekabu, babeire baigwerete na korenda ogochika baetwe na sokoro yabo, korende abanto aba bangire konyigwera inche.
english: The descendants of Jonadab son of Recab have carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not obeyed me.'

ekegusii: Ebisaku bia Yusufu nebi’abamura baye babere, Manase na Efraimu:
english: The descendants of Joseph by their clans through Manasseh and Ephraim were:

ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Yuda nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abasela, abarwete ase Sela, na Abaperesi, abarwete ase Peresi, na Abazera, abarwete ase Zera.
english: The descendants of Judah by their clans were: through Shelah, the Shelanite clan; through Perez, the Perezite clan; through Zerah, the Zerahite clan.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Peresi na Hezironi, Karimi na Huri, na Sobali.
english: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur and Shobal.

ekegusii: The descendants of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
english: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Kohati: Aminadabu omomura oye, na Kora omomura oye, na Asiri omomura oye,

ekegusii: Abamura b’ororeria rwa Ladani, nabwo Abagerisoni, nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chia Ladani Omogerisoni. Ase abwo nigo barenge Abayehieli.
english: The descendants of Ladan, who were Gershonites through Ladan and who were heads of families belonging to Ladan the Gershonite, were Jehieli,

ekegusii: Abanto ba Makiri, mosinto o Manase, bakagenda bakaumokera ense ya Gileadi, bagaseria Abaamori bamenyeteo, erio bakaira ense eria.
english: The descendants of Makir son of Manasseh went to Gilead, captured it and drove out the Amorites who were there.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Manase nabwo aba: Asirieli, oria omokungu oye o sere‐sere, orenge Omoaramai amoiborerete. Boigo omokungu oria akaibora Makiri, ise Gileadi.
english: The descendants of Manasseh: Asriel was his descendant through his Aramean concubine. She gave birth to Makir the father of Gilead.

ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Manase nao eamate ya Makiri yarwete. Makiri nere orenge ise Gileadi, na korwa asare nao Abagileadi barwete.
english: The descendants of Manasseh: through Makir, the Makirite clan (Makir was the father of Gilead); through Gilead, the Gileadite clan.

ekegusii: Abamerari bakanyora emechie ikomi na ebere ase chiamate chiabo korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku kia Reuben, na ekia Gadi, na egia Sabuloni.
english: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abamerari bakaegwa emechie ikomi na ebere korwa ase ebisaku bia Reuben, na Gadi, na Sabuloni.
english: The descendants of Merari, clan by clan, were allotted twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad and Zebulun.

ekegusii: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
english: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Merari: Mali omomura oye, na Libini omomura oye, na Simei omomura oye, na Usa omomura oye,

ekegusii: The descendants of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son and Shimei his son.
english: Misima akaibora Hamueli, na Hamueli akaibora Sakuri, na Sakuri akaibora Simei.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’oyomo bw’Abakeni, ise biara Musa, bakagenda amo n’Abayuda korwa ase Omochie bw’Emekendo gochia erooro, irianyi y’Aradi, ase ense ya Yuda, na bakamenya ase egati y’abanto b’aroro.
english: The descendants of Moses' father-in-law, the Kenite, went up from the City of Palms with the men of Judah to live among the people of the Desert of Judah in the Negev near Arad.

ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Nafutali nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abayaseli, abarwete ase Yaseli, na Abaguni, abarwete ase Guni,
english: The descendants of Naphtali by their clans were: through Jahzeel, the Jahzeelite clan; through Guni, the Gunite clan;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Parosi: chilifu ibere, ne rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (2,172);
english: the descendants of Parosh 2,172

ekegusii: Chiamate chia Peresi nigo chiarenge: Abahezironi, abarwete ase Hezironi, na Abahamuli, abarwete ase Hamuli.
english: The descendants of Perez were: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Hamul, the Hamulite clan.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ororeria rwa Peresi abamenyete Yerusalemu, nigo barenge amagana ane, na emerongo etano nomo, na batano na batato (468). Bonsi nigo barenge chituoni chi’okorwana esegi.
english: The descendants of Perez who lived in Jerusalem totaled 468 able men.

ekegusii: Reuben nere orenge omomura omotangi o Israeli. Ase egesaku kiaye nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abahanoki, abarwete ase Hanoki, na Abapalu, abarwete ase Palu,
english: The descendants of Reuben, the firstborn son of Israel, were: through Hanoch, the Hanochite clan; through Pallu, the Palluite clan;

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Salima nabwo abanto ba Bethlehemu, na Abanetofa, na abanto b’Ataroti‐Beti‐Yoabu, na ekeng’ese ki’Abamanahati, nabwo Abasori,
english: The descendants of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half the Manahathites, the Zorites,

ekegusii: Omwana o Sekania nere Semaya, na abana baye abamura nabwo aba: Hatusi na Igali, Baria na Nearia, na Safati; bonsi mbatano nomo.
english: The descendants of Shecaniah: Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah and Shaphat-- six in all.

ekegusii: Sobali, ise abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu, nabwate abana abamura bande: Haroe na ekeng’ese ki’abanto ba Menuhoti.
english: The descendants of Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim were: Haroeh, half the Manahathites,

ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Simeoni nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abanemweli, abarwete ase Nemweli, na Abayamini, abarwete ase Yamini, na Abayakini, abarwete ase Yakini,
english: The descendants of Simeon by their clans were: through Nemuel, the Nemuelite clan; through Jamin, the Jaminite clan; through Jakin, the Jakinite clan;

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simeoni nabwo aba: Nemweli na Yamini, Yaribu na Zera, na Sauli.
english: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah and Shaul;

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin bakaba bakomenya gochakera Geba na kogenderera goikera Mikimasi, na Aiya, na Beteli na ase ebichie biaye;
english: The descendants of the Benjamites from Geba lived in Micmash, Aija, Bethel and its settlements,

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani: Chiamate chia Sotai, na Hasofereti, na Peruda;
english: The descendants of the servants of Solomon: the descendants of Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda,

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani nabwo aba: Chiamate chia Sotai, na Sofereti, na Perida;
english: The descendants of the servants of Solomon: the descendants of Sotai, Sophereth, Perida,

ekegusii: Ase egesaku gia Sabuloni nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaseredi, abarwete ase Seredi, na Abaeloni, abarwete ase Eloni, na Abayaleeli, abarwete ase Yaleeli.
english: The descendants of Zebulun by their clans were: through Sered, the Seredite clan; through Elon, the Elonite clan; through Jahleel, the Jahleelite clan.

ekegusii: Erooro na ense enyomo nchibe nomogoko; ee, erooro nechenge na gosicha buna ebisicha ebiya.
english: The desert and the parched land will be glad; the wilderness will rejoice and blossom. Like the crocus,

ekegusii: Chinsoti na ebirongo mbimenye aroro; ense eyio nebe eye chinyakweumia na ebigonkoru. Omonene narambore igoro yaye ekerengero gi’okoyetantania na ekebiro gi’okoyerentera obosiru.
english: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it; the great owl and the raven will nest there. God will stretch out over Edom the measuring line of chaos and the plumb line of desolation.

ekegusii: the desert owl, the osprey, the cormorant,
english: etekere, na ekeongo kende, na omoneke,

ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete ase erooro mbatung’ame ase obosio bwaye bamosike, na ababisa baye bamene orotu.
english: The desert tribes will bow before him and his enemies will lick the dust.

ekegusii: Okogania kw’abanyene oboronge nigo gokorenta amaya, korende okw’abakori amabe nigo gokobarentera egesusuro.
english: The desire of the righteous ends only in good, but the hope of the wicked only in wrath.

ekegusii: Ense eyio yatigetwe ere bosa neremwe naende, gose abaeti tibakoyerora egendererete koba bosa.
english: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through it.

ekegusii: Oyio ogosaria na gosiria nachiche ase kera omochie, mochie onde togotooreka. Rikura amo nense omweya nabisarigwe, buna Omonene atebire.
english: The destroyer will come against every town, and not a town will escape. The valley will be ruined and the plateau destroyed, because the LORD has spoken.

ekegusii: Saitani akamoira goika Yerusalemu, akamotenenia igoro ase egechuria gie Hekalu egetambe mono, akamotebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, etugute gochia inse korwa aa,
english: The devil led him to Jerusalem and had him stand on the highest point of the temple. "If you are the Son of God," he said, "throw yourself down from here.

ekegusii: Saitani akamoira aase aimokererete igoro, akamworokia amaruoti onsi ay’ense ase egeka ekemo,
english: The devil led him up to a high place and showed him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.

ekegusii: The devil said to him, "If you are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread."
english: Saitani akamotebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, tebia rigena eri ribe omogati.”

ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto ore nokomanya nigo ekorigia chisemi, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekwerageria oboriri.
english: The discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.

ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bakamoboria, “Nase ki rende aborokia b’amariko bagoteba ng’a negwenerete Elija ache ritang’ani?”
english: The disciples asked him, "Why then do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?"

ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye bagacha, bakamoboria, “Nase ki kware gokwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio?”
english: The disciples came to him and asked, "Why do you speak to the people in parables?"

ekegusii: Korende tibamanya nonya nering’ana erimo ase aya. Ring’ana eri rikabiseka asebare, na tibamanya ayatebetwe.
english: The disciples did not understand any of this. Its meaning was hidden from them, and they did not know what he was talking about.

ekegusii: The disciples did so, and everybody sat down.
english: Bagakora boigo, bakabaikaransia bonsi.

ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakeeba koirana emegati; nonya nase obwato tibarenge na gento, otatiga omogati oyomo bwoka.
english: The disciples had forgotten to bring bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.

ekegusii: The disciples left, went into the city and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.
english: Aborokigwa bagasoka, bakagenda omochie, bakarora buna abatebetie, bakaroisia Epasaka.

ekegusii: Aborokigwa bakamotebia, “Amang’ana igoro y’omonto na mokaye karabe engencho eye, tegwenereti konyuoma.”
english: The disciples said to him, "If this is the situation between a husband and wife, it is better not to marry."

ekegusii: Bagateba, “Omonene, rora ntore nemeyio ya birende ebere aa.” Akabatebia, “Nabo aisanire.”
english: The disciples said, "See, Lord, here are two swords." "That is enough," he replied.

ekegusii: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.
english: Aborokigwa bakagenda, bagakora buna Yeso abachigete.

ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakamotebia, “Omonene, totoorie, ngosira tore!”
english: The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Lord, save us! We're going to drown!"

ekegusii: Bakamochiera, bakamotura, bakabora, “Omonene, Omonene, ngosira tore.” Akaboka, agatogonyera omwaga na emerindo y’amache, na birobio bigakira, gokaba ogotoerera.
english: The disciples went and woke him, saying, "Master, Master, we're going to drown!" He got up and rebuked the wind and the raging waters; the storm subsided, and all was calm.

ekegusii: Aborokigwa bagaichana ase amang’ana aya. Yeso akairaneria naende, akabatebia, “Abana, nabe aakong’u ase abasemeretie enibo gosoa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae!
english: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus said again, "Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!

ekegusii: The disciples were even more amazed, and said to each other, "Who then can be saved?"
english: Barabwo bagaichana mono, bakaborania, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

ekegusii: Na aborokigwa baria, kera oyomo koreng’ana buna okonyara kwaye, bakang’ea gotoma ogokonywa ase abamwabo abamenyete Boyahudi.
english: The disciples, each according to his ability, decided to provide help for the brothers living in Judea.

ekegusii: Ekero eriomana rinene riachia kooroka, omotang’ani oria omonene akoboa ng’a Paulo nabaise kobutoranwa nabarabwo, agachika abarwani baike na komotaboria korwa ase amaboko abo, na komorenta ase enyomba enene y’abarwani.
english: The dispute became so violent that the commander was afraid Paul would be torn to pieces by them. He ordered the troops to go down and take him away from them by force and bring him into the barracks.

ekegusii: Obotambe korwa ase oboagacho bw’egeita gia isiko gochia ase obw’egeita kia ime nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano.
english: The distance from the entrance of the gateway to the far end of its portico was fifty cubits.

ekegusii: Abateneneri baria abanene nigo barenge korenta chindagera ase omoruoti Sulemani na ase abanto bonsi abarenge koragera bwoye. Kera oyomo obo nigo are korenta endagera eisaine koriegwa ase omotienyi oyomo ase omwaka, endagera tiyarenge kobora.
english: The district officers, each in his month, supplied provisions for King Solomon and all who came to the king's table. They saw to it that nothing was lacking.

ekegusii: Naende abanto b’egetwori gia Efuraimu, abatoorete inse y’ebendera yabo, bakaimoka kogenda, ekeombe ase ekeombe, na Elisama, mosinto bw’Amihudi, nere orenge omoraai bw’omoganda oria.
english: The divisions of the camp of Ephraim went next, under their standard. Elishama son of Ammihud was in command.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egetwori kia Yuda, abatoorete inse y’ebendera yabo, bakaba abatang’ani b’okoimoka gochaka orogendo, ekeombe ase ekeombe, na Nahasoni, mosinto bw’Aminadabu, nere orenge omoraai bw’omoganda oria.
english: The divisions of the camp of Judah went first, under their standard. Nahshon son of Amminadab was in command.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio abanto b’egetwori kia Reuben, abatoorete inse y’ebendera yabo, bakaimoka kogenda ekeombe ase ekeombe, na Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri, nere orenge omoraai bw’omoganda oria.
english: The divisions of the camp of Reuben went next, under their standard. Elizur son of Shedeur was in command.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarendi b’ebiita: Korwa ase ororeria rwa Kora, Meselemia, omwana omomura o Kora bw’ororeria rw’Asafu.
english: The divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.

ekegusii: Rora ebiombe bi’abakuani na Abalawi baria barakore emeremo yonsi y’enyomba ya Nyasae nao bare aa; kera omonto ore nogwancha, naende omanyete emeremo ende yonsi, nabe naye ase emeremo yonsi. Boigo abaraai bonsi amo nabanto bonsi nababe bagokora aya onsi orabachike.”
english: The divisions of the priests and Levites are ready for all the work on the temple of God, and every willing man skilled in any craft will help you in all the work. The officials and all the people will obey your every command."

ekegusii: Naende etigere ekaboria Baalamu, “Inee! Inche tindi etigere yao, kwabeire gokondiina ase amatuko ’obogima bwao bwonsi goika rituko eri ria rero? Inee! Inche nana‐gokora egento buna eke asore?” Baalamu akairaneria, “Yaya.”
english: The donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your own donkey, which you have always ridden, to this day? Have I been in the habit of doing this to you?" "No," he said.

ekegusii: Korende etigire ero yandora, nero yeonchora gochia enchera ensemo chintunda isato. Ekeene, onye etigere eye eteonchora gochia ensemo korwa asende, nanga nigo nagoita okwe, ntige etigere ere moyo.”
english: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If she had not turned away, I would certainly have killed you by now, but I would have spared her."

ekegusii: Malikia, mosinto o Rekabu, omogambi bw’orogongo rwa Beti-Hakeremu, akaagacha naende Egeita ki’Eubi, agakebekera ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto.
english: The Dung Gate was repaired by Malkijah son of Recab, ruler of the district of Beth Hakkerem. He rebuilt it and put its doors and bolts and bars in place.

ekegusii: Emeremo yabo nebe ogokonya abwo b’ororeria rwa Haroni ase obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene, na gotenenera chiraaro na ebinyomba ebike; boigo ogosibia ebinto bichenire, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’obokoreri bw’enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: The duty of the Levites was to help Aaron's descendants in the service of the temple of the LORD: to be in charge of the courtyards, the side rooms, the purification of all sacred things and the performance of other duties at the house of God.

ekegusii: the earrings and bracelets and veils,
english: na ebigera bi’amato, ne chitaai chi’amaboko, na ebiechabero bia metwe,

ekegusii: Ense nigo ekweumia na kogenderera gosira; oboiko bwonsi bwagoyire, ngochia gosira bore, na abare abanene b’ense baereirwe chinguru.
english: The earth dries up and withers, the world languishes and withers, the exalted of the earth languish.

ekegusii: Ense yabwerekire, ee, yabwerekire kegima, yatandoirwe ebing’ese; ense yatengechigwe ne chinguru chintindi.
english: The earth is broken up, the earth is split asunder, the earth is thoroughly shaken.

ekegusii: Ense yasarigwe nabanto bamenyeteo; barabwo basaririe amachiko, bangire koigwera emeroberio echikire, naende basaririe okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwa kare na kare.
english: The earth is defiled by its people; they have disobeyed the laws, violated the statutes and broken the everlasting covenant.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe nigo boichire ase ense, nyorokererie imanye emeroberio yao echikire.
english: The earth is filled with your love, O LORD; teach me your decrees.

ekegusii: Riroba rikabwereka rikabamera amo na Kora, ekero omorero osambete na gosiria abanto amagana abere, na emerongo etano. Ayio akaba ekiorokererio ki’ogokurera.
english: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, whose followers died when the fire devoured the 250 men. And they served as a warning sign.

ekegusii: riroba rikabwereka rikamera Datani, na rikamumekeria abanto b’ekeombe ki’Abiiramu.
english: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it buried the company of Abiram.

ekegusii: Ense yatindire buna oyotindire amarwa; nigo ekorunda‐rundigwa buna oborunda‐rundia bw’omote. Ogosaria kwaye kwayeritoereire, negwe, tekonyara koboka naende.
english: The earth reels like a drunkard, it sways like a hut in the wind; so heavy upon it is the guilt of its rebellion that it falls-- never to rise again.

ekegusii: ense nigo yatengechete, embura egatwa korwa igoro, na aye Nyasae nao kwarenge. Nonya negetunwa gia Sinai nigo giatengechete, ekero aye Nyasae kwarengeo; aye ore Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Ense nigo ekoonchorwa yarorekana buna amaroba abeire inse y’ebonyi ere nekemanyererio, na ebinto bionsi nigo bikororekana buna chianga chire nebieni ao ao.
english: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its features stand out like those of a garment.

ekegusii: Erio ense ekanyegerigwa na koondoka, na amaroso ’ebitunwa agatengechigwa. Ee, ense ekaiguswa, ekiagera Omonene arenge nendamwamu.
english: The earth trembled and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shook; they trembled because he was angry.

ekegusii: Ense nesarigwe kegima ebe bosa, ekiagera n’Omonene otebire ring’ana erio.
english: The earth will be completely laid waste and totally plundered. The LORD has spoken this word.

ekegusii: Korende ense netigwe ebe bosa ase engencho y’abanto bamenyeteo; okwo korabe okwama kw’ogokora kwabo okobe.
english: The earth will become desolate because of its inhabitants, as the result of their deeds.

ekegusii: Ase riroba igoro nao endagera ekwama ime y’ense inse aroro aonchoranwa aba buna omorero ogosamba oonchorana.
english: The earth, from which food comes, is transformed below as by fire;

ekegusii: Obogare bw’ensemo ya bosio, erochie moocha, nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano.
english: The east end, toward the sunrise, was also fifty cubits wide.

ekegusii: Omwaga okorwa moocha nigo okomoirurukia; omorusia aase aye, omosiria kegima.
english: The east wind carries him off, and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.

ekegusii: Orobebe rwa moocha nigo rwabwatetie Enyancha y’Omonyo goika ensemo yaye ya sugusu ase orooche rwa Yorodan ronuchete. Orobebe rwa sugusu nigo rwachakerete aroro,
english: The eastern boundary is the Salt Sea as far as the mouth of the Jordan. The northern boundary started from the bay of the sea at the mouth of the Jordan,

ekegusii: Abaedomu konya barwanirie Abayuda bababuire na boosire abanto.
english: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away prisoners,

ekegusii: Abamisiri bakababwatia korwa nyuma amo ne chibarasi chionsi, ne chigari chia Farao, na abariini chibarasi chiaye, na abarwani baye bonsi, bakabanyora batoorire enyancha mbarabare, ang’e na Pi‐Hahiroti kororia Baali‐Sefoni.
english: The Egyptians-- all Pharaoh's horses and chariots, horsemen and troops-- pursued the Israelites and overtook them as they camped by the sea near Pi Hahiroth, opposite Baal Zephon.

ekegusii: Na Abamisiri bagasoa na kobabwatia gochia gati y’enyancha amo ne chibarasi chionsi chia Farao, ne chigari chiaye, na abariini chibarasi.
english: The Egyptians pursued them, and all Pharaoh's horses and chariots and horsemen followed them into the sea.

ekegusii: Abamisiri bagasorora abanto abwo, bakabaayereria barue ase ense yabo; naki nigo batebete ng’a, “Aande nigo torabaise gokwa intwe twensi.”
english: The Egyptians urged the people to hurry and leave the country. "For otherwise," they said, "we will all die!"

ekegusii: Na Abamisiri nabamanye ng’a ninche Omonene, ekero nkwenyorera ogotogigwa ase okomobua Farao amo ne chigari chiaye na abariini chibarasi chiaye.”
english: The Egyptians will know that I am the LORD when I gain glory through Pharaoh, his chariots and his horsemen."

ekegusii: Nindusie omoika bw’Abamisiri orue asebare, ninsarie emeroberio yabo; barabwo mbabe bakogenda korigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emegwekano egosasimwa, na korwa ase abaragori, na korwa ase abwo bakorangeria emeika y’abakure, na korwa ase abarogi.
english: The Egyptians will lose heart, and I will bring their plans to nothing; they will consult the idols and the spirits of the dead, the mediums and the spiritists.

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na gatato bokagwera Hanani; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Obwa gatano na gatato bokagwera Yesaia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na gatato, Sibekai bw’ororeria rwa Husa Omozera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na gatato. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The eighth, for the eighth month, was Sibbecai the Hushathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Inche omogaaka ngokorikera nde aye Gayo, omwanchani, oyonyanchete ase ekeene.
english: The elder, To my dear friend Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

ekegusii: Inche omogaaka ngokorikera nde aye omokungu omochore amo nabana bao, inwe abwo nyanchete ase ekeene. Tari inche bweka mbanchete, korende nabaria bonsi abamanyete ekeene.
english: The elder, To the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in the truth-- and not I only, but also all who know the truth--

ekegusii: the elders and prominent men are the head, the prophets who teach lies are the tail.
english: Omogaaka bw’amasikani nere omotwe, na omobani okworokereria oborimo nere ekemincha.

ekegusii: Erio abagaaka na abanto bonsi bakamotebia, “Tobaisa koigwa amang’ana ayio gose koyancha.”
english: The elders and the people all answered, "Don't listen to him or agree to his demands."

ekegusii: The elders are gone from the city gate; the young men have stopped their music.
english: Abagaaka tibari goikaransa geita ki’omochie, na abamura batigire kobugia amakano abo.

ekegusii: Abagaaka ba Gileadi bakamoiraneria, “Ntokore buna gwatebire. Omonene nabe kirori ase egati yaito.”
english: The elders of Gilead replied, "The LORD is our witness; we will certainly do as you say."

ekegusii: Abagaaka baria ba Gileadi bakamoiraneria, “Ayio naro agerire twakoiraneire bono: Ntorigetie aye ogende amo naintwe, otokonye korwania Abaamoni, na obe omotang’ani oito, na oyo bw’abanto bonsi ba Gileadi.”
english: The elders of Gilead said to him, "Nevertheless, we are turning to you now; come with us to fight the Ammonites, and you will be our head over all who live in Gilead."

ekegusii: Ekero keria abagaaka ba Gileadi bakagenda korangeria Yefta korwa ase ense ya Tobu,
english: the elders of Gilead went to get Jephthah from the land of Tob.

ekegusii: Na abagaaka b’enyomba yaye bagacha bamoimokie korwa agwo inse, korende ere tancha, nonya nokoragera, taria amo nabarabwo.
english: The elders of his household stood beside him to get him up from the ground, but he refused, and he would not eat any food with them.

ekegusii: erio abagaaka b’omochie bw’omoiti oria batome abanto bamorusie korwa ase omochie oria atameire, bamobeke ase okoboko kw’oria okorusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo, nere aite omoiti oria.
english: the elders of his town shall send for him, bring him back from the city, and hand him over to the avenger of blood to die.

ekegusii: Abagaaka ba Yabesi bakamotebia, “Toe ribaga ri’amatuko atano na abere, erinde totome abanto ase chingongo chionsi chi’Abaisraeli. Onde atatogeti oratotoorie, rirorio twerue asore.”
english: The elders of Jabesh said to him, "Give us seven days so we can send messengers throughout Israel; if no one comes to rescue us, we will surrender to you."

ekegusii: Abagaaka ba Moabu na ab’Abamidiani bakabogoria eng’eria y’okoringoreria ase amaboko abo, bakayeirera Baalamu, bakamotebia amang’ana onsi a Balaki.
english: The elders of Moab and Midian left, taking with them the fee for divination. When they came to Balaam, they told him what Balak had said.

ekegusii: Agwo ase obosio bwane abagaaka b’omoganda oria goika babeke amaboko abo igoro ase omotwe bw’eeri eyio, na ero enyenyerwe agwo ase obosio bwane.
english: The elders of the community are to lay their hands on the bull's head before the LORD, and the bull shall be slaughtered before the LORD.

ekegusii: Abagaaka b’omochie o Sayoni nigo baikaransete inse bakirete‐kiri, besiarerete ebuse ase emetwe yabo na kweboyia chigunia, abaiseke abekungi ba Yerusalemu nigo baturegete emetwe yabo gochia inse.
english: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence; they have sprinkled dust on their heads and put on sackcloth. The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground.

ekegusii: Abagaaka abakogamba buya babarerwe ng’a mbagwenerete amasikani ara kabere, kobua mono abwo bagokora emeremo y’okorandia na kworokereria.
english: The elders who direct the affairs of the church well are worthy of double honor, especially those whose work is preaching and teaching.

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na rimo bokagwera Asareli; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: obwa ikomi na rimo bokagwera Eliasibu, na obwa ikomi na kabere Yakimu;
english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi na rimo, Benaya korwa Piratoni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The eleventh, for the eleventh month, was Benaiah the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: The end has come! The end has come! It has roused itself against you. It has come!
english: Omoerio ngocha ore, ee, omoerio ngocha ore okonyore! Naama! Ngocha ore!

ekegusii: “Bono omoerio ogocheire, na inche nkorenta nde endamwamu yane ebe igoro asore, na ninkonachere ekina koreng’ana nogokora kwao; ninkoe egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwao gwonsi gw’okogechia.
english: The end is now upon you and I will unleash my anger against you. I will judge you according to your conduct and repay you for all your detestable practices.

ekegusii: Omoerio bw’egento nigo ore omuya kobua omochakano oye; na omonto omoremereria nigo are omuya koba omonto omoenenu.
english: The end of a matter is better than its beginning, and patience is better than pride.

ekegusii: Bono omoerio bw’amang’ana onsi oikire ang’e. Ase ayio, mobe nobong’aini na kwerita ase ogosaba.
english: The end of all things is near. Therefore be clear minded and self-controlled so that you can pray.

ekegusii: Omobisa oyio oramboire amaboko aye gochia gosakora ebinto bionsi bie rigori rinene bire ase omochie ime; ee, omochie oyio ororire abanto b’ebisaku bagosoa Aase aye Aachenu, agwo aye Omonene gwakanete ng’a tibasoa ase omosangererekano oo.
english: The enemy laid hands on all her treasures; she saw pagan nations enter her sanctuary-- those you had forbidden to enter your assembly.

ekegusii: Omobisa one obeire okorigia omoyo one; obeire ogontiringera inse ase amaroba, ong’ikaransirie ase omosunte, nabeire buna omonto okwete kare.
english: The enemy pursues me, he crushes me to the ground; he makes me dwell in darkness like those long dead.

ekegusii: Nigo narimerete ase amache ime, na endiba ekang’etanana, enderema ya nyancha ekaranderera omotwe one.
english: The engulfing waters threatened me, the deep surrounded me; seaweed was wrapped around my head.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagacha ase rinani, na aroro agwo bakarora obooke bore inse.
english: The entire army entered the woods, and there was honey on the ground.

ekegusii: Omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abayuda, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na omosangererekano bw’Abaisraeli abachete korwa ase ense yabo, na abageni abachete korwa ase ense y’Abaisraeli, na abamenyi bamenyete ase ense y’Abayuda, bakaba nomogoko omonene.
english: The entire assembly of Judah rejoiced, along with the priests and Levites and all who had assembled from Israel, including the aliens who had come from Israel and those who lived in Judah.

ekegusii: Abarwani bonsi, abarenge amo nere, bagatiira, bagaika ang’e nomochie, bagatoora sugusu ya Ai; rikura ndiarenge egati yabo na Ai.
english: The entire force that was with him marched up and approached the city and arrived in front of it. They set up camp north of Ai, with the valley between them and the city.

ekegusii: Naki amachiko onsi aikeranigwe ase ring’ana erimo, na rirorio nario eri, “Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete.”
english: The entire law is summed up in a single command: "Love your neighbor as yourself."

ekegusii: “Orogongo roria rwonsi orochenu nigo rorabe orw’ekerengo gie chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000), chinsemo chionsi nigo chirabe chireng’aine. Oro narwo orogongo orochenu amo norw’omochie oyio.
english: The entire portion will be a square, 25,000 cubits on each side. As a special gift you will set aside the sacred portion, along with the property of the city.

ekegusii: Boigo eyemo ya ikomi y’amaicho e chiombe, gose ching’ondi, gose chimbori, engencho yaye kera eng’iti ya ikomi ye ching’iti chigoeta inse ase enyimbo y’omorisia, nebe enchenu ase Omonene.
english: The entire tithe of the herd and flock-- every tenth animal that passes under the shepherd's rod-- will be holy to the LORD.

ekegusii: Egesoero kegosoera ebinyomba bia inse nigo kiarenge ensemo ya sugusu ye Hekalu na goetera ase ebiriinero abanto nigo barenge koriina gochia ase rirongo ria kabere, na korwa aroro bariina gochia ase rirongo ria gatato.
english: The entrance to the lowest floor was on the south side of the temple; a stairway led up to the middle level and from there to the third.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha ase obosio bwa Musa, na obwa Eleazari omokuani, na ase amasio ’abatang’ani, na ase omoganda bwonsi, bagatenena agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bagateba,
english: the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the leaders and the whole assembly, and said,

ekegusii: Obogare bw’egesieri nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ikomi, na obwe chinyasi nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano kera ensemo. Boigo akarenga Aase Aachenu; obotambe bwaye bokaba obw’amaboko emerongo ene, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere.
english: The entrance was ten cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were five cubits wide. He also measured the outer sanctuary; it was forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.

ekegusii: Ekerengero gia efa (gose egetonga) na ekia bati (gose ensiongo) bibe ekerengo ekemo. Kera ekemo getware ensemo eyemo ya ikomi y’ekerengero gekorokwa homeri. Ekerengero kiaino ekenene mokorengera kebe ekie homeri.
english: The ephah and the bath are to be the same size, the bath containing a tenth of a homer and the ephah a tenth of a homer; the homer is to be the standard measure for both.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Efraimu mbabe buna chituoni chi’esegi, bagoke ase chinkoro chiabo buna abanyure edivai. Abana babo mbarore ayio, bagoke, mbagokere Omonene ase chinkoro chiabo ime.
english: The Ephraimites will become like mighty men, and their hearts will be glad as with wine. Their children will see it and be joyful; their hearts will rejoice in the LORD.

ekegusii: Nyasae o kare na kare nere ore obotamero bwaino; Inse aa nao amaboko aye a kare na kare are kogamba. Naserie ababisa baino korwa asemore, abatebie inwe: Basirie!
english: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He will drive out your enemy before you, saying, 'Destroy him!'

ekegusii: Omogomba oria akaboria Filipo, “Koranche ontebie igoro ya ng’o omobani oyo agokwana, igoro yaye omonyene gose igoro y’omonto onde?”
english: The eunuch asked Philip, "Tell me, please, who is the prophet talking about, himself or someone else?"

ekegusii: Amang’ana e ririko ayarenge gosoma naro aya: “Akairwa buna eng’ondi egochia konyenywa, na buna emanwa etari kwana ase omonachi bw’amarionya, naboigo tamaanorete omonwa oye.
english: The eunuch was reading this passage of Scripture: "He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so he did not open his mouth.

ekegusii: The evening meal was being served, and the devil had already prompted Judas Iscariot, son of Simon, to betray Jesus.
english: Ekero ki’endagera ya mogoroba, Saitani gaikire kobeka Yudas omwana o Simion Iskariota enkoro y’okomorua,

ekegusii: Aya onsi Asa akorete, korwa omochakano goika omoerio, nigo arikire ase Ebuku y’Abaruoti b’Abayuda na ab’Abaisraeli.
english: The events of Asa's reign, from beginning to end, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

ekegusii: Ebibe bi’omokori amabe nigo bikomobwata omonyene; nasibwe ne chingori chire ebibe biaye.
english: The evil deeds of a wicked man ensnare him; the cords of his sin hold him fast.

ekegusii: Ekerecha keria ki’eubi gekamogaragaria, gekarera ase eriogi rinene, gekamorwa.
english: The evil spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.

ekegusii: The expert in the law replied, "The one who had mercy on him." Jesus told him, "Go and do likewise."
english: Akabora, “Noria omororerete amabera.” Yeso akamotebia, “Genda naye okore boigo.”

ekegusii: The eye cannot say to the hand, "I don't need you!" And the head cannot say to the feet, "I don't need you!"
english: Eriso tirikonyara gotebia okoboko, “Tinkoganeti”, gose omotwe tokonyara gotebia amagoro, “Timbaganeti.”

ekegusii: Eriso ri’omotomani nigo rikoganya kobwairire, ere oteba: Onde tari ondoche, erio otuba obosio bwaye bwekona.
english: The eye of the adulterer watches for dusk; he thinks, 'No eye will see me,' and he keeps his face concealed.

ekegusii: Omonto ondoche bono takondora naende nonya ng’ake, bono aye nondoche, korende bwango nimbe tindio.
english: The eye that now sees me will see me no longer; you will look for me, but I will be no more.

ekegusii: Eriso riarenge komorora, tirikomorora naende, gose aase aye tiaakomorigereria naende.
english: The eye that saw him will not see him again; his place will look on him no more.

ekegusii: Amaiso ’ebitongwa bionsi nigo akorigereretie nogosemeria, naye nigo okobia chindagera chiabo ase chingaki chigwenerete.
english: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food at the proper time.

ekegusii: Okorigereria kw’obomwenu bwa mwanyabanto nkoiranigwe inse, na oboenenu bwabo mbokeeigwe, na ase rituko erio Omonene bweka naimokererigwe igoro.
english: The eyes of the arrogant man will be humbled and the pride of men brought low; the LORD alone will be exalted in that day.

ekegusii: Amaiso ’Omonene nigo aroche ande onsi, nigo arigereretie ababe amo nabaya.
english: The eyes of the LORD are everywhere, keeping watch on the wicked and the good.

ekegusii: Amaiso ’Omonene nigo arigereretie abanyene oboronge, na amato aye nigo akoigwa ebirero biabo.
english: The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their cry;

ekegusii: Amaiso ’Omonene nigo arigereretie na korenda oyore nokomanya, korende nigo akoonchorana na gosaria amang’ana ’abatari abegenwa.
english: The eyes of the LORD keep watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

ekegusii: obosio bw’omonto bokarigereria omokendo ensemo eyemo, na obw’endo bokarigereria omokendo ensemo ende. Emegwekano eyio nigo yaroisirie ase enyomba yonsi.
english: the face of a man toward the palm tree on one side and the face of a lion toward the palm tree on the other. They were carved all around the whole temple.

ekegusii: Obosio bw’Omonene nigo bore mamincha y’abwo bagokora amabe, nabasirie korwa ase ense, tibainyorwa.
english: the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.

ekegusii: ekiagera kwabeire nabasacha batano, na ere oyore nere bono tari omosacha oo, ase ayio gwakwanire ekeene.”
english: The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true."

ekegusii: Naende ng’a nigo amobogetie korwa ase abakure, erinde tanyara koirana naende ase ogosareka, okwanire iga, Nimbae ogosesenigwa ogochenu na ogw’ekeene, koria narierete Daudi eira.
english: The fact that God raised him from the dead, never to decay, is stated in these words: "'I will give you the holy and sure blessings promised to David.'

ekegusii: ase engencho y’ogosemeria okwo mwagacheirwe igoro. Igoro y’ogosemeria oko konya mwaigure ase ring’ana ri’ekeene ase enchili
english: the faith and love that spring from the hope that is stored up for you in heaven and that you have already heard about in the word of truth, the gospel

ekegusii: Omonto ogure korwa ase okwegena kwaye, nabo araisaneke nokwama gwe chinchera chiaye, na omonto omuya nigo agoisaneka ase omoyo oye.
english: The faithless will be fully repaid for their ways, and the good man rewarded for his.

ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ororeria rwa Lawi, barabwo tibabaretwe amo nabanto abwo bande,
english: The families of the tribe of Levi, however, were not counted along with the others.

ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’Abalawi abarenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo okarikwa ase Ebuku y’Amang’ana ’Ebiro goikera ase amatuko a Yohanani, mosinto bw’Eliasibu.
english: The family heads among the descendants of Levi up to the time of Johanan son of Eliashib were recorded in the book of the annals.

ekegusii: Abateneneri be chinyomba chie chiamate chi’egesaku kia Gileadi, mosinto o Makiri, o Manase, o Yusufu, bakagenda gokwana na Musa amo nabaraai bande be chiamate amo nabaraai bande be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli.
english: The family heads of the clan of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh, who were from the clans of the descendants of Joseph, came and spoke before Moses and the leaders, the heads of the Israelite families.

ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi okarikwa ase amatuko ’Eliasibu, na Yoyada, na Yohanani, na Yadua, Boigo oyo bw’abakuani okarikwa ekero Dario arenge omogambi bw’Abaayemi.
english: The family heads of the Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan and Jaddua, as well as those of the priests, were recorded in the reign of Darius the Persian.

ekegusii: Omobusuri nering’ana akobusura.
english: The farmer sows the word.

ekegusii: Ebitinya bi’eng’iti egokwa yoka enyene, na ebi’eng’iti egoitwa neyende, ebio nabikorerwe emeremo emeao, korende tibikoriegwa nonya ng’ake.
english: The fat of an animal found dead or torn by wild animals may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it.

ekegusii: Tata omwanchire Omwana, omoeire bionsi ase amaboko aye.
english: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.

ekegusii: Ise bw’omonto ore omonyene oboronge nigo akoba nomogoko omonene. Ere oyoiboire omwana omomura omong’aini nagokigwe nere.
english: The father of a righteous man has great joy; he who has a wise son delights in him.

ekegusii: “Abande nigo bagotaboria chintakana korwa ase chimbeere chi’abang’ina, na baira abana ebing’werere b’abataka babe intenenera.
english: The fatherless child is snatched from the breast; the infant of the poor is seized for a debt.

ekegusii: Ching’iti chionsi chire ase ense chiboboe na kobairoka inwe: chinyoni chia igoro, ne ching’iti chikwagura igoro ase ense, ne chinswe chionsi chi’enyancha; echio chionsi chiabekirwe ase amaboko aino.
english: The fear and dread of you will fall upon all the beasts of the earth and all the birds of the air, upon every creature that moves along the ground, and upon all the fish of the sea; they are given into your hands.

ekegusii: Nyasae akoboyia amaruoti onsi ay’ense, ekero abanto b’aroro baigwete ng’a Omonene narwanetie ababisa b’Abaisraeli.
english: The fear of God came upon all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard how the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokomenta amatuko amange ase obogima, korende emiaka y’omokori amabe nigo erakeeigwe.
english: The fear of the LORD adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

ekegusii: Omonene akaboyia amaruoti onsi e chinse chiaetanaine Abayuda, na onde tacha korwania Yehosafati.
english: The fear of the LORD fell on all the kingdoms of the lands surrounding Judah, so that they did not make war with Jehoshaphat.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nakwo ensoko y’obogima eragere omonto eatanane korwa ase amareba ’amakweri.
english: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nering’ana richenegete, okwo koragenderere kare na kare; okogamba kw’Omonene nogw’ekeene, na okw’oboronge.
english: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever. The ordinances of the LORD are sure and altogether righteous.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, noro omochakano bwe chisemi. Abariri nigo bagochaya obong’aini na amorokererio.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, oyio noro omochakano bw’obong’aini, bonsi abagokora ayio nigo bare nokomanya okuya. Ogotogigwa kwaye nogwa kare na kare.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow his precepts have good understanding. To him belongs eternal praise.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nigo gokorenta obogima, na omonto ore nokoiroka okwo nigo agoisaneka, gose amabe takomonyora.
english: The fear of the LORD leads to life: Then one rests content, untouched by trouble.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene, nakwo amorokererio akorenta obong’aini, na oboitongo nigo bogotang’anera ogosikwa.
english: The fear of the LORD teaches a man wisdom, and humility comes before honor.

ekegusii: ase oboremo boria Ibrahimu agorete korwa ase Abahiti. Agwo nao Ibrahimu atindegetwe ase Sara mokaye nere atindegetwe.
english: the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried with his wife Sarah.

ekegusii: Oboremo obwo amo ne rikuruma riria nigo biagoretwe korwa ase Abahiti.”
english: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites."

ekegusii: Rabi‐Sake akabatebia ng’a batebie Hezekia iga: “Aya naro omoruoti omonene, oria bw’Abaasuri, agokwana: Nigoro yang’o obegete ogosemeria kwao?
english: The field commander said to them, "Tell Hezekiah, "'This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?

ekegusii: Rabi‐Sake akabatebia ng’a batebie Hezekia. “Aya naro omoruoti omonene, oria bw’Abaasuri, agokwana: Nigoro ya gento ki obegete ogosemeria kwao?
english: The field commander said to them, "Tell Hezekiah: "'This is what the great king, the king of Assyria, says: On what are you basing this confidence of yours?

ekegusii: omogondo nense; embusuro eyio engiya nabana b’oboruoti; na amabanchore nabwo abana b’oria omobe.
english: The field is the world, and the good seed stands for the sons of the kingdom. The weeds are the sons of the evil one,

ekegusii: Emegondo yatigaire bosa; riroba nigo rikorera ekiagera endagera yasirigwe, edivai enyia tekobao na amaguta ’emezeituni akeeire kegima.
english: The fields are ruined, the ground is dried up; the grain is destroyed, the new wine is dried up, the oil fails.

ekegusii: Emegondo ere Hesiboni yasusanire amo nemesabibu ere Sibuma. Abanene b’ebisaku babutoire chinsagia chi’emesabibu, echio chiarandete chigaika Yaeseri, na chikagenderera goika ase erooro. Emerande yaye nigo yarandete, ekaamboka enyancha.
english: The fields of Heshbon wither, the vines of Sibmah also. The rulers of the nations have trampled down the choicest vines, which once reached Jazer and spread toward the desert. Their shoots spread out and went as far as the sea.

ekegusii: Endamwamu entindi y’Omonene tekonyara koirana ebatige goika abe oikeranirie ekina kiaye na gokora buna okogania kwaye kore. Amang’ana ayio nigo morache koyamanya buya ase amatuko agochi‐gocha.
english: The fierce anger of the LORD will not turn back until he fully accomplishes the purposes of his heart. In days to come you will understand this.

ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatano bokagwera Biliga, na obwa ikomi na gatano na rimo Imeri;
english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano bokagwera Yeremoti; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the fifteenth to Jerimoth, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano agaitera egetaabo kiaye igoro ase ekerogo ki’obonene ki’eng’iti eria, na oboruoti bwaye bokabekwa omosunte. Abanto bagatakuna chimeme chiabo ase engencho y’obororo,
english: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was plunged into darkness. Men gnawed their tongues in agony

ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano akabugia egetureri kiaye. Erio nkarora eng’enang’eni konya yagure korwa igoro gocha ase ense. Eng’enang’eni eria ekaegwa ekeigorero gi’ekeronga ki’eora y’abakure.
english: The fifth angel sounded his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The star was given the key to the shaft of the Abyss.

ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri.
english: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher, clan by clan.

ekegusii: na obwa gatano saridoniki, na obwa gatano na rimo sardio, na obwa gatano na kabere kurusolito, na obwa gatano na gatato berulo, na obwa kianda topasio, na obwa ikomi kurusoparaso, na obwa ikomi na rimo hiakinto, na obwa ikomi na kabere ametisito.
english: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

ekegusii: obwa gatano bokagwera Malikia, na obwa gatano na rimo Miyamini;
english: the fifth to Malkijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

ekegusii: Obwa gatano bokagwera Netania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Oyo o gatano, Samuti bw’ororeria rwa Isihari akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital; and the sixth, Ithream, by his wife Eglah.
english: oyo o gatano Sefatia, oiboretwe n’Abitali, na oyo o gatano na rimo Iteramu, oiboretwe n’Egila moga Daudi.

ekegusii: Omwaka oyo bw’emerongo etano nobe oyio bw’Omochengo asemore. Ase omwaka oyio timobusura kende, gose kogesa echiemeretie korwa ase chimbusuro chiagwete inse, gose timosangereria amasabibu korwa emesabibu etacheretwe.
english: The fiftieth year shall be a jubilee for you; do not sow and do not reap what grows of itself or harvest the untended vines.

ekegusii: Emeko yachakire kwama amako, na emesabibu yachakire gosicha, nigo egotioka rimisu rigiya. Aye omosani one omuya, imoka togende!
english: The fig tree forms its early fruit; the blossoming vines spread their fragrance. Arise, come, my darling; my beautiful one, come with me."

ekegusii: Esegi ekaba entindi mono igoro ya Saulo; abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria mono; ere akabwatwa nomoondoko omonene ase engencho ya barabwo.
english: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him critically.

ekegusii: Esegi ekaba entindi mono ase Saulo, na abaruti emegwe bakamoromereria, bakamorasa, bakamoaka chingoma.
english: The fighting grew fierce around Saul, and when the archers overtook him, they wounded him.

ekegusii: the fine robes and the capes and cloaks, the purses
english: ne chiganchwa chi’emeyega, ne chigoti chi’okwambara, na ebiambaro bi’amareko, na emebuko ya koboko,

ekegusii: The fire must be kept burning on the altar continuously; it must not go out.
english: Omorero oyio orendwe ogenderere gwoka botambe, tobaisa korima.

ekegusii: Omorero ore ase egesasimero orendwe ogenderere gwoka, torima. Kera emambia omokuani amente chinko ase omorero oyio, naende achoke buya ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa igoro ase chinko echio na asambe ebitinya bi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.
english: The fire on the altar must be kept burning; it must not go out. Every morning the priest is to add firewood and arrange the burnt offering on the fire and burn the fat of the fellowship offerings on it.

ekegusii: Omomalaika bwe ritang’ani akabugia egetureri kiaye. Erio embura y’amagena amo nomorero, bisang’anaine namanyinga, bigatwa ase ense. Ensemo ya gatato y’ense egasambwa egasira, na ensemo ya gatato y’emete boigo, na obonyansi bwonsi obobese bogasambwa, bogasira.
english: The first angel sounded his trumpet, and there came hail and fire mixed with blood, and it was hurled down upon the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees were burned up, and all the green grass was burned up.

ekegusii: Omomalaika bwe ritang’ani akagenda agaitera egetaabo kiaye igoro ase ense, na amagumba amabe akaria abanto abwo barenge nekemanyererio ki’eng’iti, na baare gosasima omogwekano oye.
english: The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the land, and ugly and painful sores broke out on the people who had the mark of the beast and worshiped his image.

ekegusii: Omochakano bw’obogambi bwaye nigo bware Babeli, na Ereku, na Akadi, [na Kaline]; eyio yonsi nigo yare ase ense ya Shinari.
english: The first centers of his kingdom were Babylon, Erech, Akkad and Calneh, in Shinar.

ekegusii: Egari ye ritang’ani nigo yarenge kong’uswa ne chibarasi chimbariri, na eya kabere ne chibarasi chimwamu,
english: The first chariot had red horses, the second black,

ekegusii: The first daughter he named Jemimah, the second Keziah and the third Keren-Happuch.
english: Akaroka omoiseke omotang’ani Yemima, na oyo o kabere Kesia, na oyo o gatato Kereni‐Hapuki.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani timogokora emeremo ende yonsi ya kera rituko, korende nigo morabe nomosangererekano bwatananire ase ogosasima.
english: The first day is a sacred assembly; do no regular work.

ekegusii: Eng’iti ye ritang’ani ere moyo nigo yagwekaine endo, na eya kabere nigo yagwekaine emori, na eya gatato nigo yabwate obosio buna obw’omonto, na eya kane nigo yagwekaine ensoti ekoiruruka.
english: The first living creature was like a lion, the second was like an ox, the third had a face like a man, the fourth was like a flying eagle.

ekegusii: Obomera bokagwera chiamate chi’Abakohati buna iga: Abalawi abarenge b’ororeria rwa Haroni, omokuani, bakanyora emechie ikomi na etato korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, na egia Simeoni, na ekia Benjamin, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
english: The first lot came out for the Kohathites, clan by clan. The Levites who were descendants of Aaron the priest were allotted thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon and Benjamin.

ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yehoyaribu, na obwa kabere Yedaya;
english: The first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

ekegusii: Obomera obotang’ani bokagwera Yusufu ase eamate y’Asafu. Obwa kabere bokagwera Gedalia; ere amo nabamwabo na abana baye abamura nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons and relatives, 12 the second to Gedaliah, he and his relatives and sons, 12

ekegusii: Omonto bwe ritang’ani akarwa inse, agatongwa korwa ase amaroba; omonto o kabere akarwa igoro.
english: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.

ekegusii: “Kera omwana omotangi bakorua asende nabe oyoo, na kera eng’iti entangi boigo, korende nonya naboigo bwanche embooria ase omwana omotangi o mwanyabanto, na ase chintangi chie ching’iti chiria chitachenegeti.
english: The first offspring of every womb, both man and animal, that is offered to the LORD is yours. But you must redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.

ekegusii: Omwana omoisia omotangi omokungu oria araibore, arokwe erieta ri’oyomwabo ise oria okwete. Erio nario erieta riaye ritabaise gosira korwa ase Abaisraeli.
english: The first son she bears shall carry on the name of the dead brother so that his name will not be blotted out from Israel.

ekegusii: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, "We have found the Messiah" (that is, the Christ).
english: Oyo akanyora ritang’ani Simion momura omwabo omonyene, akamotebia, “Twanyorire Masihi” (okoonchorwa kwaye Kristo).

ekegusii: Oyo bwe ritang’ani agasoka, ere nigo arenge omobariri, omobere bwonsi nigo orenge namarionya; bakamoroka Esau.
english: The first to come out was red, and his whole body was like a hairy garment; so they named him Esau.

ekegusii: Omonto gekwaneire ritang’ani nigo akororekana ng’a nekeene agokwana, korende omonto omoao gachire, nigo akoorokia amang’ana ayio buna are.
english: The first to present his case seems right, till another comes forward and questions him.

ekegusii: Obobe bwe ritang’ani bwaetire; rora, amabe ande abere nache nyuma y’ayio.
english: The first woe is past; two other woes are yet to come.

ekegusii: Basinto ba Hasena bakaagacha Egeita gie Chinswe, bagakebekera emetobwa na ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto.
english: The Fish Gate was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah. They laid its beams and put its doors and bolts and bars in place.

ekegusii: Ne chinswe chiare ase orooche chigakwa, na orooche rokagunda na gotioka, na Abamisiri bagasinywa konywa amache aria. Amanyinga akaba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.
english: The fish in the Nile died, and the river smelled so bad that the Egyptians could not drink its water. Blood was everywhere in Egypt.

ekegusii: Ne chinswe chire ase orooche ime inachikwe, chigunde, na orooche narotioke bobe, na Abamisiri nabasinywe konywa amache aria.”
english: The fish in the Nile will die, and the river will stink; the Egyptians will not be able to drink its water.'"

ekegusii: Erio chinswe chire nyancha, ne chinyoni chia igoro, ne ching’iti chire ase ense, na chionsi echikwagura ase riroba, nchitengechigwe ase obosio bwane, amo nabanto bare ase ense. Ebitunwa mbitegoke bigwe inse amo nebitare, na kera oboagacho mbogwe inse.
english: The fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the beasts of the field, every creature that moves along the ground, and all the people on the face of the earth will tremble at my presence. The mountains will be overturned, the cliffs will crumble and every wall will fall to the ground.

ekegusii: Abanto bakoruba ne chindobio ase orooche rwa Naili mbarere na kobokia amagombo, na abwo bakoruta ebionga aroro mbaumate.
english: The fishermen will groan and lament, all who cast hooks into the Nile; those who throw nets on the water will pine away.

ekegusii: Abanto baria batano, abarootete ense eria ritang’ani, bagasoa enyomba eria, bakaimokia omogwekano oria obaachire, na egesibao keria ki’obokuani, na ebinyasae biria, na omogwekano oria onyititoire na kobombwa, na omokuani oria agatenena ase egeita amo nabanto baria amagana atano na rimo babogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi.
english: The five men who had spied out the land went inside and took the carved image, the ephod, the other household gods and the cast idol while the priest and the six hundred armed men stood at the entrance to the gate.

ekegusii: Ekero abagambi baria b’Abafilisti baroche ayio bakairana gochia Ekironi ase rituko riria.
english: The five rulers of the Philistines saw all this and then returned that same day to Ekron.

ekegusii: Abanto batigarete ase ense eria nabwo aba: Abagambi batano b’Abafilisti, na Abakanani bonsi, na Abasidoni, na Abahivi, baria bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Lebanoni, korwa egetunwa kia Baali‐Herimoni goika enchera ekogenda Hamati.
english: the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites living in the Lebanon mountains from Mount Baal Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

ekegusii: Korende chinyama ne riiyo akabisamba nomorero isiko y’egetwori.
english: the flesh and the hide he burned up outside the camp.

ekegusii: naende eooro nigo yarenge gocha gotokorobanania, amache nigo arenge gocha goeta igoro yaito;
english: the flood would have engulfed us, the torrent would have swept over us,

ekegusii: Emenia y’omobere oye nigo ekinyaine amo; nigo yesibete bokong’u ase omobere oye, tekonyarwa kobwatokanigwa.
english: The folds of his flesh are tightly joined; they are firm and immovable.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bachete korwa Teli‐Mela, na Teli‐Harisa, na Kerubu, na Adani, na Imeri, korende tibanyarete koorokia ase okomanyereria chiamate chiabo, nonya ne chinderia chiabo, gose ekeene ng’a n’Abaisraeli bare:
english: The following came up from the towns of Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Addon and Immer, but they could not show that their families were descended from Israel:

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo bachete korwa Teli-Mela, na Teli-Harisa, na Kerubu, na Adoni, na Imeri, korende tibanyarete koorokia ase okomanyereria chiamate chiabo, nonya ne chinderia chiabo gose ekeene ng’a n’Abaisraeli bare:
english: The following came up from the towns of Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Addon and Immer, but they could not show that their families were descended from Israel:

ekegusii: Rituko rigotunya erio bagasoa Kaisaria. Na Kornelio nigo arenge obaganyete, konya osangereirie eamate yaye amo nabanchi baye.
english: The following day he arrived in Caesarea. Cornelius was expecting them and had called together his relatives and close friends.

ekegusii: Obotuko boria Omonene agatenena ang’e nere, akamotebia, “Remia enkoro, ekiagera buna kwamberete kirori Yerusalemu, nekogwenerete kombera boigo Rumi.”
english: The following night the Lord stood near Paul and said, "Take courage! As you have testified about me in Jerusalem, so you must also testify in Rome."

ekegusii: na endagera yarenge korentwa ase emesa yaye, na buna abakonyi baye bamenyete, na buna abasomba baye baare komokorera, ne chianga chiabo babegete, na buna ababogoria babogoretie ebikombe, naende akarora buna omoruoti arenge gosamba ebing’wanso biaye ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakumia na koumata.
english: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, his cupbearers, and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the LORD, she was overwhelmed.

ekegusii: na endagera yarenge korentwa ase emesa yaye, na akarora buna abakonyi baye bamenyete aroro, na buna abasomba baye baare komokorera, ne chianga babegete, na ababogoria ebikombe baye, ne chianga babegete, na ebing’wanso biaye bi’ogosambwa aruete ase enyomba y’Omonene, agakumia na koumaata.
english: the food on his table, the seating of his officials, the attending servants in their robes, the cupbearers in their robes and the burnt offerings he made at the temple of the LORD, she was overwhelmed.

ekegusii: Omoriri nigo agwetumata, na bweria omobere oye orea.
english: The fool folds his hands and ruins himself.

ekegusii: Baria abariri bagatebia baria abang’aini: Twatanere amaguta aino, ekiagera chitaya chiaito chiarimire.
english: The foolish ones said to the wise, 'Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.'

ekegusii: Na ekero baria abariri baimogetie chitaya chiabo, tibachiimokia namaguta;
english: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.

ekegusii: Omoteneneri oyio akamoiraneria, “Oyo nomosubati bw’Abamoabu, oria ochicha na Naomi korwa ase ense yabo.
english: The foreman replied, "She is the Moabitess who came back from Moab with Naomi.

ekegusii: Aba bakoraria Kristo ase esugu gose tari ase omoyo omorabu, bakorengereria komenta obororo bwane ase ogosibwa kwane.
english: The former preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can stir up trouble for me while I am in chains.

ekegusii: Naki chinguru chi’ogochika koria kwe ritang’ani nigo chiasiretigwe ase engencho y’oboreu bwaye na ogotaisanera kwaye.
english: The former regulation is set aside because it was weak and useless

ekegusii: The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Kinnereth,
english: Emechie yabo yagiteire chindwaki nero: Sidimu, na Seri, na Hamati, na Rakati, na Kinereti,

ekegusii: The fortified city stands desolate, an abandoned settlement, forsaken like the desert; there the calves graze, there they lie down; they strip its branches bare.
