english: Omochie ogiteire chindwaki ong’anyirwe, otamirwe na gotigwa bosa, obeire buna erooro; agwo nao chimori chikorisia na korara, chiaba chikoria amato e chinsagia chireo.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Chiburi chi’Efraimu nchisarigwe kegima, na oboruoti bwa Damesiki mbosirigwe; na abatigari b’Abasiiria mbaurwe obonene bwabo buna Abaisraeli bauretwe.
english: The fortified city will disappear from Ephraim, and royal power from Damascus; the remnant of Aram will be like the glory of the Israelites," declares the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Chinyomba chi’oboruoti nchitigwe chire bosa, omochie oichire nabanto nong’anywe, eburi na emerobiri y’obotengerero mbibe amakuruma kare na kare; agwo nao chitigere chi’orosana chiregokerie, na omochie oyio obe oborisia bw’amaicho e ching’iti.
english: The fortress will be abandoned, the noisy city deserted; citadel and watchtower will become a wasteland forever, the delight of donkeys, a pasture for flocks,

ekegusii: Oboroso bwe Hekalu bokabekwa ase omotienyi o Sivu, ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba gwa Sulemani.
english: The foundation of the temple of the LORD was laid in the fourth year, in the month of Ziv.

ekegusii: Sulemani akabeka oboroso bw’enyomba ya Nyasae, na obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, koreng’ana nekerengo egekoro.
english: The foundation Solomon laid for building the temple of God was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide (using the cubit of the old standard).

ekegusii: Amaroso ’orwaki rw’omochie nigo achabeire namagena e rigori rinene a kera egesaku. Oboroso bwe ritang’ani nigo bwarenge yasipi, na obwa kabere safiro, na obwa gatato kalkedoni, na obwa kane sumaridi,
english: The foundations of the city walls were decorated with every kind of precious stone. The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

ekegusii: Amagena ’oboroso nigo arenge aye rigori rinene, amagena amanene na amarito, ayande ay’obotambe bw’amaboko ikomi, na ayande ay’amaboko atano na atato.
english: The foundations were laid with large stones of good quality, some measuring ten cubits and some eight.

ekegusii: Salumu mosinto o Koli-Hose, omogambi bw’orogongo rwa Misipa, akaagacha naende Egeita gi’Ensoko, agakeagachera ekerama na gokebekera ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto. Boigo akaagacha orwaki rwe Ritibo ria Siloa, eriarenge ang’e nomogondo bw’omoruoti, goikera ase ebiriinero biare gotirimbokerwa korwa ase Omochie o Daudi.
english: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Col-Hozeh, ruler of the district of Mizpah. He rebuilt it, roofing it over and putting its doors and bolts and bars in place. He also repaired the wall of the Pool of Siloam, by the King's Garden, as far as the steps going down from the City of David.

ekegusii: Ching’iti echio chinene inye, abwo nabaruoti bane baraoroke ase ense.
english: 'The four great beasts are four kingdoms that will rise from the earth.

ekegusii: Orogunchara roria rwabunegete na aase aye chingunchara inye chikamera aroro, engencho yaye nere eye: Amaruoti ane naoroke korwa ase egesaku ekio, korende takoba nokobua buna koria kwa roria rwe ritang’ani.
english: The four horns that replaced the one that was broken off represent four kingdoms that will emerge from his nation but will not have the same power.

ekegusii: na emegwekano y’amakomomanga amagana ane eyabegetwe igoro y’ebichanga ebio, chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure kiarenge igoro ye chisiiro, erinde ensemo y’ebisure biria yatambeete etubwe.
english: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network, decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);

ekegusii: Akaroisia nemegwekano y’amakomomanga amagana ane, ekabekwa ase ebichanga ebio, chindwaro ibere ase kera egesure kiarenge igoro ye chisiiro, erinde ebisure biria biatambeete gochia isiko bitubwe.
english: the four hundred pomegranates for the two sets of network (two rows of pomegranates for each network, decorating the bowl-shaped capitals on top of the pillars);

ekegusii: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food; then they went away.
english: Erio ababisa bagasakora chinibo chionsi chia Sodomu na Gomora, na endagera yabo yonsi bakaira chinsobo.

ekegusii: The four living creatures said, "Amen," and the elders fell down and worshiped.
english: Ne ching’iti chiria inye chire moyo chikabora, “Amina!” Na abagaaka baria bagatung’ama, bagasasima.

ekegusii: Amagoro aye ane nigo abegetwe inse ye chinsingo chiaye, ne rinyongo riaye nigo ribwateranirie nekebekerero. Obotambe bwa kera okogoro nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese.
english: The four wheels were under the panels, and the axles of the wheels were attached to the stand. The diameter of each wheel was a cubit and a half.

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na kane bokagwera Matitia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the fourteenth to Mattithiah, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Omomalaika o kane agaitera egetaabo kiaye igoro ase erioba, akaegwa ribaga gosamba abanto nomorero.
english: The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun, and the sun was given power to scorch people with fire.

ekegusii: Omomalaika o kane akabugia egetureri kiaye. Erio ensemo ya gatato y’erioba egaakwa, na ensemo ya gatato y’omotienyi, na ensemo ya gatato ye ching’enang’eni boigo. Igo ensemo yabo ya gatato ekabekwa omosunte, erinde ensemo ya gatato y’omobaso tobara, nonya nobotuko boigo.
english: The fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun was struck, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them turned dark. A third of the day was without light, and also a third of the night.

ekegusii: Obomera bwa kane bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru.
english: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, clan by clan.

ekegusii: the fourth Nethanel, the fifth Raddai,
english: na Netaneli oyo o kane, na Radai oyo o gatano,

ekegusii: Obwa kane bokagwera Isiri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
english: Oyo o kane Adonia o Hagiti, na oyo o gatano Sefatia bw’Abitali;

ekegusii: Oyo o kane, Asaeli, omomura omwabo Yoabu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o kane, na Sebadia, omomura oye, akagetenenera nyuma yaye. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The fourth, for the fourth month, was Asahel the brother of Joab; his son Zebadiah was his successor. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Ebioto ebio inabikogenderere omobere oo, na ey’abanto bao, na ey’abasomba bao.”
english: The frogs will go up on you and your people and all your officials.'"

ekegusii: Ebioto nabirue asore na ase chinyomba chiao, ase abasomba bao na ase abanto bao; binde tibigotigara otatiga ase orooche rwa Naili oka.”
english: The frogs will leave you and your houses, your officials and your people; they will remain only in the Nile."

ekegusii: Ayaratoke korwa ase oboronge nomorembe, na okwama kw’oboronge nobotoereru na ogosemeria kwa botambe.
english: The fruit of righteousness will be peace; the effect of righteousness will be quietness and confidence forever.

ekegusii: Okwama kw’omonyaboronge nigo kore omote bw’obogima, na omonto omong’aini nigo akong’usa emioyo y’abanto obakonya.
english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.

ekegusii: The fruit of your womb will be blessed, and the crops of your land and the young of your livestock-- the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.
english: “Ndosesenigwe oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, amo nokwama kwaino kwe riroba, na okobiara gwe chitugo chiaino nachio chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori.

ekegusii: “Ndoragererigwe oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino amo nokwama kwaino kwe riroba, na okobiara gwe chiombe chiaino, na ogwe ching’ondi ne chimbori chiaino.
english: The fruit of your womb will be cursed, and the crops of your land, and the calves of your herds and the lambs of your flocks.

ekegusii: Abagadi na Abareuben bakairaneria, bagateba, “Buna Omonene atochikire intwe abasomba bao, nabo torakore.
english: The Gadites and Reubenites answered, "Your servants will do what the LORD has said.

ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi na ab’ekia Reuben bakamotebia Musa, “Omonene oito, intwe abasomba bao inatokore buna gwachikire.
english: The Gadites and Reubenites said to Moses, "We your servants will do as our lord commands.

ekegusii: The Gadites built up Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
english: Abagadi bakaagacha emechie ya Diboni, na Ataroti, na Aroeri,

ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi bakamenya agwo Gileadi na Basani, na ase emechie y’aroro na ase oborisia bwonsi bwa Saroni goikera chinsinyo chiaye.
english: The Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its outlying villages, and on all the pasturelands of Sharon as far as they extended.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Gadi bakamenya sugusu y’abanto b’orwa Reuben agwo ase ense ya Basani, bagaikera omochie o Saleka.
english: The Gadites lived next to them in Bashan, as far as Salecah:

ekegusii: The gaiety of the tambourines is stilled, the noise of the revelers has stopped, the joyful harp is silent.
english: Omogoko bw’eriogi rie chinchigiri oerire, na eriogi ri’abwo bagochenga riaerire, na omogoko bw’eriogi ri’amakano oerire.

ekegusii: Aase agwo nigo achabeire nobwari obonge: ebitambaa ebirabu na ebiare buru, bionsi biaroisirie korwa ase egatani. Ebitambaa ebio nigo biasungeire ne chingori chindabu ne chimonyinga, chiaroisirie korwa ase egatani engiya. Chingori echio nigo chiasoirie ase chibonyi chie chifeta chiarenge ase chisiiro chi’amagena amarabu akomeka‐meka e rigori rinene. Ebiikaransero biaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu ne chifeta nigo biabekire inse aase atichire namagena akomeka‐meka e rigori rinene, amarabu na amabariri, na ayare buna obonyansi na amamwamu.
english: The garden had hangings of white and blue linen, fastened with cords of white linen and purple material to silver rings on marble pillars. There were couches of gold and silver on a mosaic pavement of porphyry, marble, mother-of-pearl and other costly stones.

ekegusii: Abarendi b’ebiita nabwo abe chiamate chia Salumu, na Ateri, na Talimoni, na Akubu, na Hatita, na Sobai; bonsi nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na kianda (139).
english: The gatekeepers of the temple: the descendants of Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita and Shobai 139

ekegusii: Erio abarendi b’egeita bakararia amang’ana ayio nonya ngoikera ase enyomba y’omoruoti.
english: The gatekeepers shouted the news, and it was reported within the palace.

ekegusii: Abarendi baria b’ebiita bakabeera aria korenda chinsemo chia moocha, na bosongo, na sugusu, na irianyi.
english: The gatekeepers were on the four sides: east, west, north and south.

ekegusii: Abarendi b’ebiita nabwo aba: Akubu na Talimoni amo nabamwabo, abarenge korenda ase ebiita, bonsi nabanto rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na ebere, na babere (172).
english: The gatekeepers: Akkub, Talmon and their associates, who kept watch at the gates-- 172 men.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abarendi b’ebiita bamenyete Yerusalemu: Salumu na Akubu, Talimoni na Ahimani, na abanto bande bamwabo. Salumu nere orenge omoteneneri obo.
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman and their brothers, Shallum their chief

ekegusii: Abarendi b’ebiita, nabwo abe chiamate chia Salumu, na Ateri, na Talimoni, na Akubu, na Hatita, na Sobai: rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na batano na batato (138).
english: The gatekeepers: the descendants of Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita and Shobai 138

ekegusii: Ebiita bitato nigo birabe ensemo ya sugusu. Ebiita ebio nigo birarokwe iga: Egeita kia Reuben, na ekia Yuda, na ekia Lawi. Ebiita bionsi nigo birarokwe kobwatekana namarieta ’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli.
english: the gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. The three gates on the north side will be the gate of Reuben, the gate of Judah and the gate of Levi.

ekegusii: Ebiita bi’omochie oyio mbirere na kobokia amagombo; nigo oraikaranse inse obe otigarete bosa.
english: The gates of Zion will lament and mourn; destitute, she will sit on the ground.

ekegusii: Ebibao nigo biarenge ase oboagacho obwo ase chinsemo chionsi, na ase egesona kiaye, nabirobio nigo biareng’aine nebinde. Obotambe bw’oboagacho boria nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obogare bwaye obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano.
english: The gateway and its portico had narrow openings all around, like the openings of the others. It was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.

ekegusii: the gecko, the monitor lizard, the wall lizard, the skink and the chameleon.
english: ekiigo egeke, na eng’oina, na esagara, enke na enene, amo nenyambu.

ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisoni nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya bosongo nyuma y’Obomenyo Obochenu.
english: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle.

ekegusii: Korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Abagerisomu bakaegwa Golani agwo Basani, na Asitaroti, amo namarisio aetanaine emechie eyio.
english: The Gershonites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they received Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands;

ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’ororeria rwa Gerisoni, eamate ase eamate, na enyomba ase enyomba.
english: The Gershonites were counted by their clans and families.

ekegusii: Abagibeoni bakamoiraneria, “Titorigeti chifeta gose chitahabu korwa ase Saulo, gose korwa ase eamate yaye; intwe titorigeti goita omonto onde bwensi ase Abaisraeli.” Daudi akababoria, “Ninki rende nkobakorera?”
english: The Gibeonites answered him, "We have no right to demand silver or gold from Saul or his family, nor do we have the right to put anyone in Israel to death." "What do you want me to do for you?" David asked.

ekegusii: Erio Abagibeoni bagatoma abanto ase Yoshua agwo Giligali ase atoorete komotebia, “Tototiga intwe abasomba bao! Ayerera, otiire gocha aa, otokonye na gototooria, ekiagera abaruoti bonsi b’Abaamori, abwo bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, basangererekanire gotorwania.”
english: The Gibeonites then sent word to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal: "Do not abandon your servants. Come up to us quickly and save us! Help us, because all the Amorite kings from the hill country have joined forces against us."

ekegusii: Abanto ba Gileadi bakabwata ebiambokero bia Yorodan, bagatanga abanto b’Efraimu. Na ekero Omoefraimu onde bwensi oyorenge gotama are gosaba ribaga kwamboka, abanto ba Gileadi nigo baare komoboria, “Aye n’Omoefraimu ore?” Onye omonto oria orenge gokana oteba, “Yaya”,
english: The Gileadites captured the fords of the Jordan leading to Ephraim, and whenever a survivor of Ephraim said, "Let me cross over," the men of Gilead asked him, "Are you an Ephraimite?" If he replied, "No,"

ekegusii: Omoiseke oria akagokia Hegai mono, akanyora ogwancherwa nere. Ase obwango obwo Hegai akamoa amaguta akweaka erinde arorekane ore omonyakieni, na akamoa endagera yamogwenerete. Boigo akaa Esteri abaiseke batano na babere abachoretwe asare korwa ase enyomba y’omoruoti bakaba bakomokorera. Hegai akaira Esteri amo nabakoreri baria baye bamenye aase aagiya mono ase enyomba eria y’abakungu.
english: The girl pleased him and won his favor. Immediately he provided her with her beauty treatments and special food. He assigned to her seven maids selected from the king's palace and moved her and her maids into the best place in the harem.

ekegusii: Erio omoiseke oria akaminyoka, agaika inka sobo, agatebia abanto ba nyomba mwa ng’ina amang’ana ayio.
english: The girl ran and told her mother's household about these things.

ekegusii: Na omoiseke oria nigo arenge omonyakieni, naende nomwekungi, otaraba na mosacha onde. Agatirimboka gochia ase ensoko, agaichoria enyongo yaye amache, agatiira.
english: The girl was very beautiful, a virgin; no man had ever lain with her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar and came up again.

ekegusii: Omoiseke oria nigo arenge omonyakieni mono: ere akaba omokoreri bw’omoruoti, korende omoruoti tamenyanete nere.
english: The girl was very beautiful; she took care of the king and waited on him, but the king had no intimate relations with her.

ekegusii: The girl's father will say to the elders, "I gave my daughter in marriage to this man, but he dislikes her.
english: Ise omoiseke oria akwane nabagaaka baria, abatebie: Naa omonto oyo omoiseke one abe mokaye, na bono ere omwangire.

ekegusii: Na obonene bw’abanto b’ebisaku na ogosika kwabo nigo birarentwe imeo.
english: The glory and honor of the nations will be brought into it.

ekegusii: Obonene bw’Omonene bogasoa Hekalu goetera ase egeita kia moocha.
english: The glory of the LORD entered the temple through the gate facing east.

ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaimokerera igoro korwa ase omochie oria, bokagenda bogatenena igoro ase egetunwa kere moocha y’omochie.
english: The glory of the LORD went up from within the city and stopped above the mountain east of it.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba ng’a obonene bw’enyomba eye ya bono nabobe obonene goetania obw’eria ya kare. Aase aiga nindete omorembe obe okogambao. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.”
english: 'The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house,' says the LORD Almighty. 'And in this place I will grant peace,' declares the LORD Almighty."

ekegusii: Chinguru nachio chire obonene bw’abamura, korende chimbuche nigo chire obwari bw’abanto abagotu.
english: The glory of young men is their strength, gray hair the splendor of the old.

ekegusii: Bono ekerenga ki’ogochika oko nakio eke, ng’a babe nobwanehani bokorwa ase chinkoro chindabu, ne chinkoro chitari kobagambia, na okwegena gotari nobong’ainereria.
english: The goal of this command is love, which comes from a pure heart and a good conscience and a sincere faith.

ekegusii: Erio egoree eria egakora amang’ana amanene mono. Ekero yabete ne chinguru chinyinge, orogunchara rwaye oronene rokabuneka, na ase ribaga riaye chingunchara inye chi’ogokumia chikamerao chiarochie gochia ase chinsemo inye chia igoro.
english: The goat became very great, but at the height of his power his large horn was broken off, and in its place four prominent horns grew up toward the four winds of heaven.

ekegusii: Naboigo embori eria ebogorie ebibe biabo bionsi, egende nabio gochia ase erooro ase abanto batamanyeti.
english: The goat will carry on itself all their sins to a solitary place; and the man shall release it in the desert.

ekegusii: Erio bakarenta chigoree chiria chi’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase omoruoti na ase omosangererekano, na barabwo bakabeka amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe ye chigoree echio.
english: The goats for the sin offering were brought before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.

ekegusii: Nyasae, Ise Omonene Yeso, oyorabakwe goika kare na kare, omanyire ng’a tindi gokwana oborimo.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus, who is to be praised forever, knows that I am not lying.

ekegusii: Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, oeire Omosomba oye Yeso obonene, ere inwe mokamorua na komwanga ase obosio bwa Pilato, ekero agambete ekina kiaye ng’a amosibore.
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his servant Jesus. You handed him over to be killed, and you disowned him before Pilate, though he had decided to let him go.

ekegusii: Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli okwanire, ere oyore egetare ki’Abaisraeli ontebirie: Oyo okogambera abanto ase oboronge, oyo okogambera ase okoiroka Nyasae,
english: The God of Israel spoke, the Rock of Israel said to me: 'When one rules over men in righteousness, when he rules in the fear of God,

ekegusii: Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito obogetie Yeso, ere inwe mwaitete, mokamosunga ase omote.
english: The God of our fathers raised Jesus from the dead-- whom you had killed by hanging him on a tree.

ekegusii: The God of peace be with you all. Amen.
english: Nyasae bw’omorembe abe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.

ekegusii: Nyasae bw’omorembe namionogorere Saitani inse y’amagoro aino bwango. Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.
english: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

ekegusii: Nyasae bw’abanto aba Abaisraeli agachora chisokoro chiaito, na ekero barabwo bamenyete buna abamenyi ase ense ya Misiri, akabaimokereria igoro. Ase okobua kwaye akabarusia aroro,
english: The God of the people of Israel chose our fathers; he made the people prosper during their stay in Egypt, with mighty power he led them out of that country,

ekegusii: Ase ayio enyasae y’ense eye yaukoirie ebirengererio bi’abwo bategeneti, erinde omobaso bw’enchili y’obonene bwa Kristo, oyore ekieni kia Nyasae, tobaikera.
english: The god of this age has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so that they cannot see the light of the gospel of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.

ekegusii: Abanto bamoirogete Nyasae basirire korwa ase ense, na oyore nenkoro endonge tari ase egati y’abanto. Bonsi nigo bakoboera abanto baitere amanyinga abo. Kera omonto nigo akobwata, oyomwabo noboreba.
english: The godly have been swept from the land; not one upright man remains. All men lie in wait to shed blood; each hunts his brother with a net.

ekegusii: Chinyasae echio chiariete ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso biabo, na konywa okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa bi’edivai, ng’ai chire? Tiga chichiche erio chibakonye na kobarenda.”
english: the gods who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up to help you! Let them give you shelter!

ekegusii: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
english: na egesasimero gi’etahabu, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ekorua rimisu rigiya, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Eema,

ekegusii: Naboigo ebe emegwekano ye rikomomanga bwateranie ne chindege chie chitahabu bietanane omoringero o inse bw’eganchwa.
english: The gold bells and the pomegranates are to alternate around the hem of the robe.

ekegusii: emegwekano y’ebisicha, ne chitaya, ne chigami biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitahabu chioka;
english: the gold floral work and lamps and tongs (they were solid gold);

ekegusii: Oborito bw’emesumari ye chitahabu nigo bwarenge chisekeli emerongo etano chie chitahabu. Ebinyomba bia irongo boigo bikaoomwa netahabu.
english: The gold nails weighed fifty shekels. He also overlaid the upper parts with gold.

ekegusii: Omonto omuya, ase emonga yaye engiya nigo akorua amaya, na omonto omobe, ase emonga yaye embe nigo akorua amabe.
english: The good man brings good things out of the good stored up in him, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in him.

ekegusii: Omonto omuya ase emonga engiya y’enkoro yaye nigo akorua ayare amaya; na omonto omobe ase emonga yaye embe nigo akorua ayare amabe, ekiagera ebiichire ase enkoro, nabio omonwa ogokwana.
english: The good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For out of the overflow of his heart his mouth speaks.

ekegusii: eye Nyasae atang’anete koria eira ase emenwa y’ababani baye ase amariko amachenu.
english: the gospel he promised beforehand through his prophets in the Holy Scriptures

ekegusii: Omogambi akabakania ng’a tibabaisa koria endagera yarenge enchenu mono, goika engaki omokuani arenge gochia koboria Nyasae goetera ase Urimu na Tumimu.
english: The governor ordered them not to eat any of the most sacred food until there was a priest ministering with the Urim and Thummim.

ekegusii: Ekero arisomire, akaboria, “Omonto oyo noyo bw’ense ki?” Ekero aigwete ng’a nomonto o Kilikia, agateba,
english: The governor read the letter and asked what province he was from. Learning that he was from Cilicia,

ekegusii: Omogambi akabakania akabatebia ng’a tibabaisa koria endagera yarenge enchenu mono, goika engaki omokuani arenge gochia koboria Nyasae goetera ase Urimu na Tumimu.
english: The governor, therefore, ordered them not to eat any of the most sacred food until there should be a priest ministering with the Urim and Thummim.

ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe mwensi.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.

ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version.]

ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nainwe.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

ekegusii: Abaminto, obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nemioyo yaino. Amina.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

ekegusii: na obuya bw’Omonene oito bwamentekanire mono amo nokwegena na obwanchani ebire ime ase Kristo Yeso.
english: The grace of our Lord was poured out on me abundantly, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yeso bobe amo nainwe mwensi. Amina.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with God's people. Amen.

ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yeso bobe amo nainwe.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo bobe amo nemioyo yaino.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

ekegusii: Obuya bw’Omonene Yesu Kristo bobe amo nemioyo yaino.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

ekegusii: Amo nemingichi eria arue okoruegwa kw’endagera egetonga ekemo, na amo ne chimanwa chiria chie ching’ondi arue okoruegwa kw’endagera ekerengo aranyare korua; boigo amo na kera egetonga gi’okoruegwa kw’endagera arue ebituba bine bi’amaguta.
english: The grain offering given with the ram is to be an ephah, and the grain offering with the lambs is to be as much as he pleases, along with a hin of oil for each ephah.

ekegusii: Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo, ekero Omonene abiuteire omoika oye; naboigo na mwanyabanto banga buna obonyansi.
english: The grass withers and the flowers fall, because the breath of the LORD blows on them. Surely the people are grass.

ekegusii: Ee, obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo, korende ring’ana ria Nyasae oito nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.”
english: The grass withers and the flowers fall, but the word of our God stands forever."

ekegusii: Amarisia e chirooro nigo agotonya boigo, na ebigoro nigo bieboetie omogoko.
english: The grasslands of the desert overflow; the hills are clothed with gladness.

ekegusii: “Aase abakure abeire nomoegaego gocha gokorotota ekero okogenda aroro; emerengari y’abakure yaturirwe ase engencho yao, ee, abwo bonsi barenge abatang’ani b’ense. Abwo bonsi barenge abaruoti b’ebisaku batenenigwe barue ase ebirogo biabo.
english: The grave below is all astir to meet you at your coming; it rouses the spirits of the departed to greet you-- all those who were leaders in the world; it makes them rise from their thrones-- all those who were kings over the nations.

ekegusii: aase abakure, na enda engomba, ne riroba rirang’ete amache, na omorero. Ebio tibiana goteba, “Twaisanekire.”
english: the grave, the barren womb, land, which is never satisfied with water, and fire, which never says, 'Enough!'

ekegusii: Abanto bamerire chimbuche amo nabakoorire emiaka emenge nao bare aa amo naintwe, barabwo mbabuete iso ase emiaka.
english: The gray-haired and the aged are on our side, men even older than your father.

ekegusii: Omochie oria omonene ogaatananekana ase chinsemo isato, na emechie y’abanto b’ebisaku ekagwa. Nyasae akainyora Babeli, omochie oria omonene, ayoe onywe ase egekombe ki’edivai y’endamwamu yaye entindi.
english: The great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations collapsed. God remembered Babylon the Great and gave her the cup filled with the wine of the fury of his wrath.

ekegusii: Orwaki rw’eraaro enene igo rwaagachetwe namagena abaachire, abekire chindwaro isato gochia igoro, ne chibao chi’emecharake orwaro oromo. Naboigo norwaki rw’eraaro ya ime y’enyomba y’Omonene amo nenyomba yarenge bosio bw’aroro.
english: The great courtyard was surrounded by a wall of three courses of dressed stone and one course of trimmed cedar beams, as was the inner courtyard of the temple of the LORD with its portico.

ekegusii: Na enchoka eria enene egatugutwa gocha inse. Eria neng’iti ya kare ekorokwa Omogenki na Saitani, omong’ainereria bw’ense yonsi. Ere agatugutwa gocha ase ense, na abamalaika baye bagatugutwa amo nere.
english: The great dragon was hurled down-- that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray. He was hurled to the earth, and his angels with him.

ekegusii: Nere oyore omonene mono kobua asemore, nigo arabe omokoreri oino,
english: The greatest among you will be your servant.

ekegusii: Abanto bachandegete ase omochie nigo bakweumia, abanto baakire chingoma nigo bakorera, nonya naboigo Nyasae tari gotegerera ogosaba kwabo.
english: The groans of the dying rise from the city, and the souls of the wounded cry out for help. But God charges no one with wrongdoing.

ekegusii: Ekiagera embura teri gotwa ase ense, ne riroba riomire pa, abaremi barorire obosooku na gotuba emetwe yabo.
english: The ground is cracked because there is no rain in the land; the farmers are dismayed and cover their heads.

ekegusii: Ase okomoiroka ere abarendi bakaiguswa, bakaba buna abanto bakure.
english: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.

ekegusii: Na abarendi baria bagatenena korwa ensemo ya irianyi y’enyomba goika ensemo ya sugusu, bagaetanana omorouti ang’e negesasimero na enyomba yonsi; kera oyomo obo obwate ebirwanero koboko kwaye.
english: The guards, each with his weapon in his hand, stationed themselves around the king-- near the altar and the temple, from the south side to the north side of the temple.

ekegusii: “Obobe bw’Abaefraimu nigo bosibire amo, na ebibe biabo nigo birikire bigachire.
english: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up, his sins are kept on record.

ekegusii: Aase agwo eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ekonyenyerwa nao eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha eranyenyerwe. Amanyinga aye asiarerwe ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: The guilt offering is to be slaughtered in the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered, and its blood is to be sprinkled against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Ekeng’ese egiatungetie Abaisraeli, ekio Musa arusetie korwa ase abarwani baria b’esegi,
english: The half belonging to the Israelites, which Moses set apart from that of the fighting men--

ekegusii: Ekeng’ese egiatungetie abarwani b’esegi nigo kiarenge: Ching’ondi amo ne chimbori chilifu amagana atato na emerongo etato na isano na ibere, na amagana atano (337,500).
english: The half share of those who fought in the battle was: 337,500 sheep,

ekegusii: Aroro agwo okoboko kw’Omonene gokambeka chinguru, ere agantebia, “Imoka, ogende ase ense omweya, na aroro aaria inche ninkwane naye.”
english: The hand of the LORD was upon me there, and he said to me, "Get up and go out to the plain, and there I will speak to you."

ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene kogacha igoro yane, na Omonene akang’ira goetera ase Omoika oye, akambeka ase egati ye rikura riaichire amauga.
english: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and he brought me out by the Spirit of the LORD and set me in the middle of a valley; it was full of bones.

ekegusii: erio nario okoboko kw’Omonene koraake chitugo chiao aase chikorisia, ne chibarasi chiao, ne chitigere, ne chingamia, ne chiombe, ne ching’ondi; chirochio chinyore oborwaire obobe mono borachiite.
english: the hand of the LORD will bring a terrible plague on your livestock in the field-- on your horses and donkeys and camels and on your cattle and sheep and goats.

ekegusii: Okoboko kw’Omonene nkobeere igoro y’egetunwa eke, korende Abamoabu mbatiringerwe inse aase abo buna obonyansi obwomo bogotiringeranigwa ase engoro y’esike.
english: The hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain; but Moab will be trampled under him as straw is trampled down in the manure.

ekegusii: Abanto baria birori nabwo barabe abatang’ani komoaka amagena ase okomoita, na nyuma yabo abanto bande bamanye komoaka amagena. Naboigo morarusie obobe bwonsi korwa asemore.
english: The hands of the witnesses must be the first in putting him to death, and then the hands of all the people. You must purge the evil from among you.

ekegusii: Omoremi oyobwechandeire emeremo, ere nemogwenerete abe oyo bwe ritang’ani konyora ensemo y’okwama.
english: The hardworking farmer should be the first to receive a share of the crops.

ekegusii: Samaria noro omochie omonene bw’Abaefraimu, na mosinto o Remalia nere omogambi o Samaria. “Onye timori nokwegena timokogenderera kobao.”
english: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is only Remaliah's son. If you do not stand firm in your faith, you will not stand at all.'"

ekegusii: Omotwe bw’omogwekano oria nigo oroisetigwe korwa ase etahabu engiya mono; egekuba kiaye na amaboko aye nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chifeta, na enda yaye na amariagati aye nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitaai.
english: The head of the statue was made of pure gold, its chest and arms of silver, its belly and thighs of bronze,

ekegusii: the headdresses and ankle chains and sashes, the perfume bottles and charms,
english: na ebinyuri bi’amagoro, ne chinkini chi’okweboeria, ne chichuba chire namaguta agotioka, na ebite bi’ogwekong’era,

ekegusii: “Enkoro nigo ere eng’ainereria mono goetania ebinto bionsi, na nigo ere ensareku kegima. Ning’o orayemanye buna ere?
english: The heart is deceitful above all things and beyond cure. Who can understand it?

ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekonyora chisemi, na ogoto kwaye nigo kogochirigia.
english: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge; the ears of the wise seek it out.

ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonyene oboronge nigo ekorengereria aya ekoiraneria, korende emenwa y’abakori amabe nigo ekoumora ayare amabe.
english: The heart of the righteous weighs its answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes evil.

ekegusii: Enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomoraa gochia borio, korende ey’omoriri nigo ekomoraa gochia bomosi.
english: The heart of the wise inclines to the right, but the heart of the fool to the left.

ekegusii: Chinkoro chi’abanto abang’aini nigo chikoba ase enyomba y’ebirero, korende chinkoro chi’abariri nigo chire ase enyomba y’okwegokia.
english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning, but the heart of fools is in the house of pleasure.

ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chikorera ase Omonene. Ee, aye orwaki rw’omochie o Sayoni, tiga amariga ao aiteke buna orooche, omobaso na obotuko! Tobaisa korosa, gose gotimokia amaiso ao.
english: The hearts of the people cry out to the Lord. O wall of the Daughter of Zion, let your tears flow like a river day and night; give yourself no relief, your eyes no rest.

ekegusii: Igoro neyao, na ense neyao, ense na ebinto bionsi bireo naye kwabitongete.
english: The heavens are yours, and yours also the earth; you founded the world and all that is in it.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, igoro nchitogie emeremo yao y’ogokumia, naende obwegenwa bwao boigo ase omosangererekano bw’abachenu bao.
english: The heavens praise your wonders, O LORD, your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.

ekegusii: Igoro chionsi nigo chikoraria oboronge bwaye, na abanto bonsi barora obonene bwaye.
english: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.

ekegusii: Igoro neorokie ebibe biaye maiso marore, na ense nemoimokere komorwania.
english: The heavens will expose his guilt; the earth will rise up against him.

ekegusii: Obotambe bwa kera omokerubi nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ikomi.
english: The height of each cherub was ten cubits.

ekegusii: Narusie korwao abanto bare chituoni na abarwani bande b’esegi, na abagambi ebina, na ababani, na abaringoria, na abagaaka,
english: the hero and warrior, the judge and prophet, the soothsayer and elder,

ekegusii: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the coneys.
english: Ebitunwa ebitambe nabio bire obomenyo bwe chimbori chi’orosana, emienya y’ebitare nero obotamero bw’ebisengi.

ekegusii: Aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo Aveni, ase Abaisraeli bakoreire ebibe, nasirigwe. Amagwa na amageri mbimere ase ebisasimero biabo; erio abanto abwo batebie ebitunwa: “Totube”, na ebigoro: “Togwere”.
english: The high places of wickedness will be destroyed-- it is the sin of Israel. Thorns and thistles will grow up and cover their altars. Then they will say to the mountains, "Cover us!" and to the hills, "Fall on us!"

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa tatagoretwe. Abanto konya tibaraonchokera Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo.
english: The high places, however, were not removed, and the people still had not set their hearts on the God of their fathers.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa tatagoretwe. Abanto bakagenderera korua ebing’wanso na gosambera ubani aroro.
english: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

ekegusii: Aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agatiga kobao; abanto bakagenderera korua ebing’wanso na gosamba ubani igoro y’aase aria.
english: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa tatagorete, na abanto bakagenderera korua ebing’wanso na gosamba ubani igoro y’aase aria.
english: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agatigwa kobao; abanto bakagenderera korua ebing’wanso na gosambera ubani igoro y’aase agwo. Yotamu akaagacha Egeita kia Rogoro ki’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: The high places, however, were not removed; the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there. Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Naki emebere ye ching’iti chiria amanyinga abo are korentwa ime Aase Aachenu nomokuani omonene ase engencho y’ebibe, nigo yare gosamberwa isiko y’omochie.
english: The high priest carries the blood of animals into the Most Holy Place as a sin offering, but the bodies are burned outside the camp.

ekegusii: Omokuani omonene agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Ninki tokorigeria abarori bande?
english: The high priest tore his clothes. "Why do we need any more witnesses?" he asked.

ekegusii: Igoro chionsi nechi’Omonene, korende ense ero oyeire mwanyabanto.
english: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth he has given to man.

ekegusii: Ogweatanana korwa ase amabe, eyio nero enchera enene y’abanyene oboronge; na omonto orendete enchera yaye, nigo arendete obogima bwaye.
english: The highway of the upright avoids evil; he who guards his way guards his life.

ekegusii: Chinchera chinene chiasarekire, omoeti tari ogoeta aroro. Okobwatana kw’ogotianania gwasarigwe; emechie yachayirwe, na abanto tibasikiri.
english: The highways are deserted, no travelers are on the roads. The treaty is broken, its witnesses are despised, no one is respected.

ekegusii: Ense eria ekabwaterania ense y’ebitunwa, na ense omweya, na Ekerubo Ekiomo, na ebitirimboko bi’ebitunwa, amo nerooro, na Negebu, na ense y’Abahiti, na ey’Abaamori, na ey’Abakanani, na ey’Abaperisi, na ey’Abahivi, na ey’Abayebusi. Abaruoti abwo babuetwe nabwo aba:
english: the hill country, the western foothills, the Arabah, the mountain slopes, the desert and the Negev-- the lands of the Hittites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites):

ekegusii: Endagera ekoria nigo ekwama ase ebitunwa igoro, agwo ase ching’iti chi’orosana chikogosoreria.
english: The hills bring him their produce, and all the wild animals play nearby.

ekegusii: Omonto orikire, tari ere omorisia, gose ching’ondi tichiri echiaye; gakorora esese y’orosana egocha, nigo agotiga ching’ondi, otama, na esese y’orosana yachisakora, na gochiserebania.
english: The hired hand is not the shepherd who owns the sheep. So when he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf attacks the flock and scatters it.

ekegusii: The Hittites replied to Abraham,
english: Abahiti bakairaneria Ibrahimu, bakamotebia,

ekegusii: Naki Omoika Omochenu noro otobereire kirori. Naki ritang’ani nigo agoteba iga:
english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this. First he says:

ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu nigo okworokereria ring’ana eri, ng’a enchera y’ogosoa Aase Aachenu konya teraorokigwa ekero Eema ye ritang’ani ereo eteneine.
english: The Holy Spirit was showing by this that the way into the Most Holy Place had not yet been disclosed as long as the first tabernacle was still standing.

ekegusii: Chibarasi chiaye nchitiringe chinchera chiao chionsi nebitaago biabo, omoruoti oyio naite abanto bao nemioro, naende atagore amatenenerio ao amanene anga chisiiro agwe inse.
english: The hoofs of his horses will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and your strong pillars will fall to the ground.

ekegusii: esagero, na omoyaye, na enyakoboko, na ebisaku biamwabo;
english: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

ekegusii: esagero na omoyaye, na enyakoboke, na enyautuutu, na ebisaku biamwabo;
english: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,

ekegusii: Chibarasi nigo chikobekwa ang’e kogenda korwana esegi, korende obobui nigo bokorua ase Omonene.
english: The horse is made ready for the day of battle, but victory rests with the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto oria akariina ebarasi, akagenda koumerana nere, akamotebia, “Omoruoti nigo akoboria gose namang’ana ’omorembe obwate.” Yehu akamoiraneria, “Ninki ogokorera omorembe? Irana nyuma yane ontunyane!” Omorendi oria akaira amang’ana, agateba “Omonto oria otomwa naika asebare, korende tari koirana gocha.”
english: The horseman rode off to meet Jehu and said, "This is what the king says: 'Do you come in peace?'" "What do you have to do with peace?" Jehu replied. "Fall in behind me." The lookout reported, "The messenger has reached them, but he isn't coming back."

ekegusii: Ase okorora kwane naroche chibarasi amo nabwo bachiriinete koba buna iga: Abariini nigo baare ne chingobo chi’ebioma ase ebikuba biabo chire nekieni ki’omorero, na ekemunsi, na ekemonuri. Chibarasi nigo chiarenge nemetwe enga buna eye chindo, na korwa ase emenwa yabo bikarua omorero, na erioki, na ekebiriti.
english: The horses and riders I saw in my vision looked like this: Their breastplates were fiery red, dark blue, and yellow as sulfur. The heads of the horses resembled the heads of lions, and out of their mouths came fire, smoke and sulfur.

ekegusii: Enyomba omonto oyio araagache nigo erabe buna ey’oronyambobe, na buna ekegutu omorendi akoagacha.
english: The house he builds is like a moth's cocoon, like a hut made by a watchman.

ekegusii: Abanto b’enyomba ya Israeli na eya Yuda tibari abegenwa asende nonya ng’ake. Inche Omonene nakwanire.”
english: The house of Israel and the house of Judah have been utterly unfaithful to me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto b’enyomba ya Yakobo mbabe omorero, na ab’enyomba ya Yusufu mbabe buna ekebemberi ki’omorero, na ab’enyomba ya Esau mbabe buna amasakwe amomo. Abanto ba Yakobo na aba Yusufu mbasambe abanto ba Esau babasirie. Onde tari oratigare ase enyomba yaye, ekiagera n’Omonene okwanire ayio.
english: The house of Jacob will be a fire and the house of Joseph a flame; the house of Esau will be stubble, and they will set it on fire and consume it. There will be no survivors from the house of Esau." The LORD has spoken.

ekegusii: Enyomba y’omonyene oboronge nigo ere enene, korende ebitoki bi’abakori amabe nigo biichire nemechando.
english: The house of the righteous contains great treasure, but the income of the wicked brings them trouble.

ekegusii: Enyomba y’omokori amabe nesirigwe, korende ekegutu ki’omonyene oboronge nkegenderere gosesenigwa.
english: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

ekegusii: Chinyomba chia Yerusalemu, na echi’abaruoti b’Abayuda, chinyomba chionsi echio igoro ase ebirama biabo abanto basambire ubani ase ogosasima erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni chionsi chia igoro, naende okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa biaumoirwe ase chinyasae ching’ao, chinyomba echi nachikorwe chibe echitachenegeti buna Tofeti.”
english: The houses in Jerusalem and those of the kings of Judah will be defiled like this place, Topheth-- all the houses where they burned incense on the roofs to all the starry hosts and poured out drink offerings to other gods.'"

ekegusii: Abanto bare nenchara nabwo bakoria endagera eye omonto oria akogesa, abwo nigo bakoyerusia nonya egiteire namagwa; abasaneri nigo bagosanera obotenenku bwaye.
english: The hungry consume his harvest, taking it even from among thorns, and the thirsty pant after his wealth.

ekegusii: Omosacha ae omokungu oye ekemogwenerete; naboigo nomokungu ae omosacha oye ekemogwenerete.
english: The husband should fulfill his marital duty to his wife, and likewise the wife to her husband.

ekegusii: Omosacha oria takoba nokomocha, korende onye mokaye okorire ogosaria okwo, goika aegwe egesusuro.”
english: The husband will be innocent of any wrongdoing, but the woman will bear the consequences of her sin.'"

ekegusii: “Amang’ana ayio akarorekana asende ng’a namaya, na inche ngachora abanto ikomi na babere, oyomo korwa ase kera egesaku.
english: The idea seemed good to me; so I selected twelve of you, one man from each tribe.

ekegusii: Emegwekano egosasimwa nabanto b’ebisaku nigo eroisirie korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu; nigo ere emeremo y’amaboko a mwanyabanto.
english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

ekegusii: Ebinyasae bire ase chinyomba nigo bigokwana amang’ana are bosa, na amaroro ’abaringoria nay’oborimo. Abaroti chindoto nigo bagokwana chindoto chi’obong’ainereria, na baremia abande ase okoremia kwa bosa. Ase engencho eyio abanto nigo bagotayaya buna riicho rie ching’ondi, bachandegete, ekiagera tibabwati omorisia.
english: The idols speak deceit, diviners see visions that lie; they tell dreams that are false, they give comfort in vain. Therefore the people wander like sheep oppressed for lack of a shepherd.

ekegusii: Emegwekano yabo bagosasima moyesambe nomorero. Timogania koira chifeta gose chitahabu chire ase emegwekano eyio. Moise gochigania nigo chirabe chikobatega. Ayio onsi nigo arabe okogechia ase Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: The images of their gods you are to burn in the fire. Do not covet the silver and gold on them, and do not take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it, for it is detestable to the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Mbuya ase ense ere nomoruoti okogamba buya na korigereria ng’a abanto nkorema bare emegondo yabo.
english: The increase from the land is taken by all; the king himself profits from the fields.

ekegusii: Omwana okogonka nabe okogosoria ase engoro ye rirubi, boigo omwana omotache nabe ogosoyia okoboko kwaye ase engoro ye ring’ere.
english: The infant will play near the hole of the cobra, and the young child put his hand into the viper's nest.

ekegusii: Na abwo bamenyete ase ense nabachenge igoro asebare na kogoka, na barabwo nabatomerane ebiegwa, ekiagera ababani baria babere bachandete abwo bamenyete ase ense.
english: The inhabitants of the earth will gloat over them and will celebrate by sending each other gifts, because these two prophets had tormented those who live on the earth.

ekegusii: Emechie eyio emenyire nesarigwe kegima, na ense etigwe ere bosa. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: The inhabited towns will be laid waste and the land will be desolate. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Omwando bw’egesaku gia Simeoni nigo orenge ensemo y’oyio bw’egesaku kia Yuda, ekiagera ensemo y’egesaku kia Yuda nigo yarenge enene mono asebare. Ayio naro agerete egesaku gia Simeoni gekaegwa omwando obo korwa ase omwando bw’egesaku kia Yuda.
english: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the share of Judah, because Judah's portion was more than they needed. So the Simeonites received their inheritance within the territory of Judah.

ekegusii: Agwo ase ensemo ya irianyi oboagacho mbwarengeo bware negeita kegosoerwa goika ase eraaro ya ime. Akarenga obotambe korwa ase oboagacho bonde goika ase obonde, bokaba obw’amaboko rigana erimo.
english: The inner court also had a gate facing south, and he measured from this gate to the outer gate on the south side; it was a hundred cubits.

ekegusii: Obotambe bw’akanyomba karia ka ime nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo ebere; naboigo obogare bwaye na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro, naende nigo kaoomire netahabu echenire. Bosio bw’akanyomba karia egesasimero gekaroisigwa, kegatubwa ne chibao chi’emecharake.
english: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty wide and twenty high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold, and he also overlaid the altar of cedar.

ekegusii: Chibao chi’emecharake chiatubete enyomba ime nigo chiarenge nemegwekano y’ebirandi, na ey’ebisicha, yabaachetwe ase chibao echio. Yonsi nigo yatubetwe nemecharake, na igena rinde tiriarorekanete.
english: The inside of the temple was cedar, carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; no stone was to be seen.

ekegusii: Obwegenwa bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokobaraa, korende obokorekanu bw’abatari abegenwa nigo bokobasiria.
english: The integrity of the upright guides them, but the unfaithful are destroyed by their duplicity.

ekegusii: Omoruoti oria o sugusu orachere oria o irianyi, nakore buna aranche; gose monto onde tari oramobue. Oyio natenene ase ense eria ere engiya mono, na ogosirigwa ngoche goetera ase okoboko kwaye.
english: The invader will do as he pleases; no one will be able to stand against him. He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land and will have the power to destroy it.

ekegusii: Abanyene ense eria bagatokorera obuya boetete engencho, ekiagera bagatoutera omorero, bagatoroisia intwe twensi, ekiagera embura yatwete na obokendu mbwarenge.
english: The islanders showed us unusual kindness. They built a fire and welcomed us all because it was raining and cold.

ekegusii: Ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha chiarorire ayio chiamwoboire, chinsinyo chi’ense nigo chigotengechigwa; chiasukire gocha ang’e.
english: The islands have seen it and fear; the ends of the earth tremble. They approach and come forward;

ekegusii: Abachandi abwo babekire na Farao bakaba bagoaka abateneneri b’Abaisraeli, abwo babegetwe gotenenera emeremo, bakabatebia, “Naki motaikeranetie omobaro oino bw’amatabori igoro na rero, oyio konya mogokora botambe?”
english: The Israelite foremen appointed by Pharaoh's slave drivers were beaten and were asked, "Why didn't you meet your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as before?"

ekegusii: Abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakarora ng’a basoire ase obokongu ekiagera batebetigwe ng’a. “Goika moikeranie kera rituko omobaro oria oria bw’amatabori.”
english: The Israelite foremen realized they were in trouble when they were told, "You are not to reduce the number of bricks required of you for each day."

ekegusii: Abisalomu amo n’Abaisraeli bagatoora ase ense ya Gileadi.
english: The Israelites and Absalom camped in the land of Gilead.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli babeire abaenenu buna ritororo rienenu ritari kogambereka. Inee! Omonene nanyare kobarisia buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi chikorisigwa ase egetii ekegare?
english: The Israelites are stubborn, like a stubborn heifer. How then can the LORD pasture them like lambs in a meadow?

ekegusii: Nabo Abaisraeli goika babwate na korenda rituko ri’Esabato ebiaare ase ebiaare, ekiagera oko nokobwatana koragenderere botambe.
english: The Israelites are to observe the Sabbath, celebrating it for the generations to come as a lasting covenant.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bande nabatenenie chiema chiabo, kera egesaku ase egetwori kiaye, na kera omonto abeere inse y’ebendera yaye, ase ekeombe kiaye.
english: The Israelites are to set up their tents by divisions, each man in his own camp under his own standard.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenderera koria mana engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika bagaika aase abanto bamenyete; bakayeria goika bagaika orobebe rw’ense ya Kanani.
english: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a land that was settled; they ate manna until they reached the border of Canaan.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaira abakungu b’Abamidiani amo nabana babo. Boigo bagasakora chiombe ne ching’ondi, na ebinto bionsi bi’Abamidiani.
english: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and children and took all the Midianite herds, flocks and goods as plunder.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagasakora ebinto bionsi bi’emechie eyio, ne chitugo chionsi bakaira chikaba echiabo. Korende bagaita abanto bonsi nemioro, bakabasiria kegima, tibatigaria nonya noyomo ore moyo.
english: The Israelites carried off for themselves all the plunder and livestock of these cities, but all the people they put to the sword until they completely destroyed them, not sparing anyone that breathed.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora onsi buna Omonene abachigete goetera ase Musa.
english: The Israelites did all this just as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bakorire buna Musa abatebetie; konya basabire korwa ase Abamisiri ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitahabu amo ne chianga.
english: The Israelites did as Moses instructed and asked the Egyptians for articles of silver and gold and for clothing.

ekegusii: The Israelites did as they were told; some gathered much, some little.
english: Abaisraeli bagakora bo, bagasangereria abande enyinge, na abande enke.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakeba Omonene, Nyasae obo, na bagasasima chinyasae chiria Baali na Asera.
english: The Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD; they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenda, bagakora onsi aya Omonene achigete Musa na Haroni.
english: The Israelites did just what the LORD commanded Moses and Aaron.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora buna Omonene atebetie Musa. Bakarusia korwa ase ebitwori abanto abwo.
english: The Israelites did this; they sent them outside the camp. They did just as the LORD had instructed Moses.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatama korwa ase Abayuda, na Nyasae akababeka ase amaboko ’Abayuda.
english: The Israelites fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hands.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamoreera ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato agwo ase emieya ya Moabu, na nyuma y’ayio amatuko okomoreera na kobokia amagombo ase engencho yaye akaera.
english: The Israelites grieved for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the time of weeping and mourning was over.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bakorire emeremo yonsi boronge kegima buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: The Israelites had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya bataarire ase erooro ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika abanto bonsi abaare konyara korwana esegi konya bakure, ekiagera bangete koigwera Omonene. Ase igo Omonene agatiana ng’a takobaa ribaga ri’ogosoa ense eria konya ariereire chisokoro chiabo eira ase ogotiana ng’a natoe ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke.
english: The Israelites had moved about in the desert forty years until all the men who were of military age when they left Egypt had died, since they had not obeyed the LORD. For the LORD had sworn to them that they would not see the land that he had solemnly promised their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamanora korwa Ramesesi, bagaika Sukoti. Nigo barenge abasacha abaare kwegendera koreng’ana chilifu amagana atano na rimo (600,000), abakungu na abana tibabaretwe.
english: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Succoth. There were about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides women and children.

ekegusii: The Israelites left Rameses and camped at Succoth.
english: Abaisraeli bakarua Ramesesi, bakagenda Sukoti, bagatoora aroro.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakamenya ase egati y’Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.
english: The Israelites lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites.

ekegusii: The Israelites moved on and camped at Oboth.
english: Abaisraeli bakaimoka kogenda orogendo rwabo, bagaika Oboti, bagatoora aroro.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe bionsi biria Yeroboamu akorete; tibeatananete korwa ase birobio.
english: The Israelites persisted in all the sins of Jeroboam and did not turn away from them

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakamotebia, “Intwe nigo toraete ase enchera enene yoka, na gatoranywe amache ao, intwe gose chitugo chiaito, rirorio natoakane amache ayio. Toe ribaga toete rioka namagoro, titokogania gento kende goetania ekio.”
english: The Israelites replied: "We will go along the main road, and if we or our livestock drink any of your water, we will pay for it. We only want to pass through on foot-- nothing else."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Abaisraeli bagatebia Gidioni, “Gwatotooririe korwa ase amaboko ’Abamidiani; ase ayio kabe omogambi oito; na nyuma yao omwana oo na omochokoro oo nabatogambere.”
english: The Israelites said to Gideon, "Rule over us-- you, your son and your grandson-- because you have saved us out of the hand of Midian."

ekegusii: The Israelites said to Moses, "We will die! We are lost, we are all lost!
english: Abaisraeli bagatebia Musa, “Rora, intwe twaikeire omoerio oito, twakure, twasirire intwe twensi.

ekegusii: bakabatebia, “Nanga mbuya onye twakwerete ase amaboko ’Omonene aaria ase ense ya Misiri. Agwo twaikaransete ase chinyongo chie chinyama, tware koria endagera enyinge, twaigota. Korende bono mwatorentire aa ase erooro ase ogotoita intwe twensi nenchara.”
english: The Israelites said to them, "If only we had died by the LORD's hand in Egypt! There we sat around pots of meat and ate all the food we wanted, but you have brought us out into this desert to starve this entire assembly to death."

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagakora bobisi ebinto ebibe ase Omonene, Nyasae obo. Bakeagachera aase aimokererete igoro ase bagosasimera, agwo aase abo onsi bamenyete, ase emerobiri y’okorenda yaagachire amo nemechie egiteire chindwaki.
english: The Israelites secretly did things against the LORD their God that were not right. From watchtower to fortified city they built themselves high places in all their towns.

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, rituko ria ikomi na gatano, rituko riarenge kobwatia eri’Epasaka, Abaisraeli bakang’anya korwa ase ense ya Misiri. Bakaimoka korwa Ramesesi, bare noboremu. Bakarua ase amasio ’Abamisiri,
english: The Israelites set out from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month, the day after the Passover. They marched out boldly in full view of all the Egyptians,

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabwata abanto bamwabo chilifu amagana abere (200,000): abakungu, na abana, abamura na abaiseke, bakabaira ase obosomba. Boigo bagasakora ebinto ebinge korwa ase abanto baria, bakabiira Samaria.
english: The Israelites took captive from their kinsmen two hundred thousand wives, sons and daughters. They also took a great deal of plunder, which they carried back to Samaria.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatiira gochia Beteli, bakaba bakorera ase obosio bw’Omonene goika mogoroba, bakamoboria, “Natonyare naende kogenda korwana n’Ababenjamin abanto baminto?” Omonene akairaneria, “Genda, mobarwanie!”
english: The Israelites went up and wept before the LORD until evening, and they inquired of the LORD. They said, "Shall we go up again to battle against the Benjamites, our brothers?" The LORD answered, "Go up against them."

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka, bakagenda Beteli koboria ogosemia korwa ase Nyasae, bakaboria, “Mbarabi asetore barabe abe ritang’ani gochia korwania Ababenjamin?” Omonene akairaneria, “Abayuda nababe abe ritang’ani”.
english: The Israelites went up to Bethel and inquired of God. They said, "Who of us shall go first to fight against the Benjamites?" The LORD replied, "Judah shall go first."

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaba bagokorera Egiloni, omoruoti o Moabu, ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi, na etano na etato.
english: The Israelites were subject to Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli abarenge aroro bakarenda Epasaka ase engaki eria, naende bakagenderera korenda Rituko Rinene ri’Emegati etabekiri memera, ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: The Israelites who were present celebrated the Passover at that time and observed the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli abarenge Yerusalemu bakarenda Amatuko Amanene ay’Emegati etabekiri memera. Bagakora igo ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, bare nomogoko omonene. Abalawi na Abakuani bakaba bagotogia Omonene rituko ase rituko, bakaba bagotera na kobugia amakano ne chinguru chiabo chionsi ase ogotogia Omonene.
english: The Israelites who were present in Jerusalem celebrated the Feast of Unleavened Bread for seven days with great rejoicing, while the Levites and priests sang to the LORD every day, accompanied by the LORD's instruments of praise.

ekegusii: omoiri oria goika atiane ase Omonene ng’a takuneti enibo aetwe sagare. Omonyene etugo eria goika anche ng’a ayio atianwa namaene, na tagoakanwa.
english: the issue between them will be settled by the taking of an oath before the LORD that the neighbor did not lay hands on the other person's property. The owner is to accept this, and no restitution is required.

ekegusii: Akabaira mwaye, akabarageria, akagoka mono amo na bonsi b’enyomba yaye, ekiagera konya bamwegenire Nyasae.
english: The jailer brought them into his house and set a meal before them; he was filled with joy because he had come to believe in God-- he and his whole family.

ekegusii: Akarigia chitaya chirentwe, akarindoka gochia ime, okoiguswa ase obwoba, akagwa inse ase amagoro a Paulo na Sila;
english: The jailer called for lights, rushed in and fell trembling before Paul and Silas.

ekegusii: Omorendi oria bw’echela akairera Paulo amang’ana ayio, agateba, “Abagambi batomire amang’ana ng’a mosiborwe; gaki bono, soka isiko, mogende nomorembe!”
english: The jailer told Paul, "The magistrates have ordered that you and Silas be released. Now you can leave. Go in peace."

ekegusii: Omorendi bw’echela akaboka na akarora ebisieri bi’echela biaigokire, akang’usa omoyio o birende, akarigia gweita, ekiagera akagete ng’a abasibwa mbatamire.
english: The jailer woke up, and when he saw the prison doors open, he drew his sword and was about to kill himself because he thought the prisoners had escaped.

ekegusii: Yehoyada, mosinto o Pasea, na Mesulamu, mosinto o Besodeya, bakaagacha Egeita Egekoro, bagakebekera emetobwa, na ebisieri, na ebisiekero, na emekorogoto.
english: The Jeshanah Gate was repaired by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah. They laid its beams and put its doors and bolts and bars in place.

ekegusii: Na Epasaka, rituko rinene ri’Abayahudi, nigo yarenge ang’e.
english: The Jewish Passover Feast was near.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Titori gokwana boronge ng’a aye nigo ore Omosamaria, naende nigo obwatire nekerecha?”
english: The Jews answered him, "Aren't we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?"

ekegusii: Bono Abayahudi bagasangererekana amo ase emechie yabo yonsi, na ase chingongo chionsi chi’obogambi bw’omoruoti Ahaswero, erinde baite abanto baria barigetie kobasiria. Monto onde tarenge onyarete kobatanga, ekiagera obwoba ase engencho y’abwo konya bwasoire ase abanto bonsi.
english: The Jews assembled in their cities in all the provinces of King Xerxes to attack those seeking their destruction. No one could stand against them, because the people of all the other nationalities were afraid of them.

ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakamoetanana, bakamoboria, “Ngoika ririri oratoichanie emioyo yaito? Onye naye Kristo, totebia maiso marore.”
english: The Jews gathered around him, saying, "How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly."

ekegusii: Abayahudi abarenge Susa bagasangerereka amo naende, ase rituko ria ikomi na kane, omotienyi bw’Adari, bagaita abanto amagana atato aroro, korende tibakunete ebinto biabo kobisakora.
english: The Jews in Susa came together on the fourteenth day of the month of Adar, and they put to death in Susa three hundred men, but they did not lay their hands on the plunder.

ekegusii: Abayahudi abarenge Susa, barabwo nigo basangererekanete ase rituko ria ikomi na gatato, na eria ikomi na kane, na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano bagatimoka bakarikora rikaba eri’omoyega na omogoko.
english: The Jews in Susa, however, had assembled on the thirteenth and fourteenth, and then on the fifteenth they rested and made it a day of feasting and joy.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakamoiraneria, “Intwe ntore nogochika, naende ase ogochika okwo nagwenerete akwe, ekiagera agwekora koba Omwana o Nyasae.”
english: The Jews insisted, "We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God."

ekegusii: The Jews joined in the accusation, asserting that these things were true.
english: Abayahudi nabarabwo bakamosoera, bakabora ng’a amang’ana ayio naboigo are.

ekegusii: Abande ase omosangererekano bagatebereria Aleksanderi, oyo Abayahudi bakamosukia ase amaiso ’abanto. Aleksanderi akaimokia okoboko kwaye, akarigia gwekengera.
english: The Jews pushed Alexander to the front, and some of the crowd shouted instructions to him. He motioned for silence in order to make a defense before the people.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakabora, “Hekalu eye yaagachetwe ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene na etano nomo, na aye oyetenenie ase amatuko atato?”
english: The Jews replied, "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?"

ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Oyo ng’ai aragende goika intwe titomonyora? Nigo aragende ase Abagiriki abwo abaatananekire na kworokereria Abagiriki abwo?
english: The Jews said to one another, "Where does this man intend to go that we cannot find him? Will he go where our people live scattered among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi tibeegena amang’ana aye, ng’a nigo arenge omouko, naende anyarete korora, goika bakarangeria abaibori baye oria onyorete okorora,
english: The Jews still did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they sent for the man's parents.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abayahudi bakabua ababisa babo bonsi, bakabaita na kobasiria nemioro; bagakora buna banchete ase abwo babagechete.
english: The Jews struck down all their enemies with the sword, killing and destroying them, and they did what they pleased to those who hated them.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bagachika ase barabwo abanyene, na ase chinderia chiabo, na ase abande bonsi babwatanete nabarabwo ng’a babe bakorenda amatuko ayio abere kera omwaka, naende bayabwate koreng’ana buna bachikire, ne chingaki chichikire.
english: the Jews took it upon themselves to establish the custom that they and their descendants and all who join them should without fail observe these two days every year, in the way prescribed and at the time appointed.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bagakumia ase aya, bakabora, “Naki amanyete chisemi, na ere tasometigwe?”
english: The Jews were amazed and asked, "How did this man get such learning without having studied?"

ekegusii: The Jordan formed the boundary on the eastern side. These were the boundaries that marked out the inheritance of the clans of Benjamin on all sides.
english: Yorodan narwo orobebe rwa moocha. Echio nachio chimbebe chiaetanaine orogongo orwo chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamin chianyorete rokaba omwando obo.

ekegusii: Abagambi goika baunenkie mono bamanye gose kirori oria nigo agosoera oyomwabo ase oborimo.
english: The judges must make a thorough investigation, and if the witness proves to be a liar, giving false testimony against his brother,

ekegusii: Na aase aimokerete igoro agosasimerwa arenge moocha ya Yerusalemu, irianyi y’Egetunwa ki’Obosareku, aria Sulemani, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, aagacherete Asitaroti, okogechia kw’Abasidoni, na Kemosi, okogechia kw’Abamoabu, na Milikomu, okogechia kw’Abaamoni, omoruoti agaakora akaba aatachenegeti.
english: The king also desecrated the high places that were east of Jerusalem on the south of the Hill of Corruption-- the ones Solomon king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the vile goddess of the Sidonians, for Chemosh the vile god of Moab, and for Molech the detestable god of the people of Ammon.

ekegusii: Boigo omoruoti agatebia Simei, “Nomanyete aye omonyene ase enkoro yao ime obobe bwonsi boria gwakorete ase Daudi tata. Omonene nakoiranerie obobe bwao.
english: The king also said to Shimei, "You know in your heart all the wrong you did to my father David. Now the LORD will repay you for your wrongdoing.

ekegusii: Naende omoruoti agatebia Zadoki omokuani, “Aye nomorori. Irana ase omochie nomorembe. Oirane n’Ahimasi, omwana oo, na Yonathani, omwana o Abiatari, abana abwo babere baino.
english: The king also said to Zadok the priest, "Aren't you a seer? Go back to the city in peace, with your son Ahimaaz and Jonathan son of Abiathar. You and Abiathar take your two sons with you.

ekegusii: Senakeribu akarika rirube ri’ogochecheria Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agakwana amang’ana amabe igoro asare, agateba, “Buna koreng’ana chinyasae chi’ebisaku bie chinse chiasinyirwe gotooria abanto babo korwa ase okoboko kwane, naboigo na Nyasae bwa Hezekia takonyara gotooria abanto baye korwa ase okoboko kwane.”
english: The king also wrote letters insulting the LORD, the God of Israel, and saying this against him: "Just as the gods of the peoples of the other lands did not rescue their people from my hand, so the god of Hezekiah will not rescue his people from my hand."

ekegusii: Korende ase abanto aba, omoruoti gose abasomba baye, abwo baigwete amang’ana aria agosomwa, onde tabete nobwoba, gose tibatandorete chianga chiabo.
english: The king and all his attendants who heard all these words showed no fear, nor did they tear their clothes.

ekegusii: Omoruoti na abanto baye bonsi konya barosire ekero baigete aase gete. Ase igo bakaba bagotimokera aroro.
english: The king and all the people with him arrived at their destination exhausted. And there he refreshed himself.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi omoruoti na abanto baye bakagenda Yerusalemu, erinde barwanie Abayebusi, abanyene ense eria. Barabwo bagatebia Daudi. “Aye tokonyara gocha aiga nonya ng’ake; emeuko na ebirema nabwo baranyare kogoseria kegima.” Abayebusi nigo barengereretie ng’a Daudi takonyara gosoa aroro.
english: The king and his men marched to Jerusalem to attack the Jebusites, who lived there. The Jebusites said to David, "You will not get in here; even the blind and the lame can ward you off." They thought, "David cannot get in here."

ekegusii: Ogosemia okwo kwa Memukani gokagokia omoruoti amo nabanene bonsi, na omoruoti agakora buna Memukani atebete.
english: The king and his nobles were pleased with this advice, so the king did as Memucan proposed.

ekegusii: Omoruoti na abagambi b’oboruoti bwaye, na omosangererekano bwonsi orenge Yerusalemu, konya bagambire amo korenda Rituko Rinene ri’Epasaka ase omotienyi o kabere.
english: The king and his officials and the whole assembly in Jerusalem decided to celebrate the Passover in the second month.

ekegusii: Omoruoti na Yehoyada bakaa abatenenerete emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene chibesa chiria, na abwo bakarika abaagacheri amagena na abasenia be chibao baroiserie enyomba y’Omonene ase yatagogete; boigo bakarika abakori emeremo b’ebioma na ab’etaai baroisie enyomba eyio.
english: The king and Jehoiada gave it to the men who carried out the work required for the temple of the LORD. They hired masons and carpenters to restore the LORD's temple, and also workers in iron and bronze to repair the temple.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akairaneria abanto baria amang’ana ase obotindi, akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria.
english: The king answered the people harshly. Rejecting the advice given him by the elders,

ekegusii: Omoruoti akabairaneria amang’ana amatindi akaanga ogosemia kw’abagaaka baria.
english: The king answered them harshly. Rejecting the advice of the elders,

ekegusii: Omoruoti akabairaneria, “Aya mwarora ng’a namaya naro ngokora.” Ase ayio omoruoti agatenena geita ensemo ekero abarwani baare gosoka gochia isiko ase ebiombe bi’amagana ne chilifu.
english: The king answered, "I will do whatever seems best to you." So the king stood beside the gate while all the men marched out in units of hundreds and of thousands.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaboria Danieli, oria orogetwe Beli‐Tesasari, “Inee! Aye nonyare gontebia chindoto echio narotete na engencho yaye?”
english: The king asked Daniel (also called Belteshazzar), "Are you able to tell me what I saw in my dream and interpret it?"

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoboria, “Emechando yao nereri?” Akamoiraneria, “Inche nomoboraka; omosacha one nigo akwete.
english: The king asked her, "What is troubling you?" She said, "I am indeed a widow; my husband is dead.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaboria Omoetiopia oria, “Inee! Omosae oria Abisalomu mbuya are?” Omoetiopia oria akamoiraneria, “Nigo nare kogania ng’a aya amonyora omosae oria, abanyore nababisa bao bonsi; boigo anyore nabaria bagokoimokera kogokorera bobe.”
english: The king asked the Cushite, "Is the young man Absalom safe?" The Cushite replied, "May the enemies of my lord the king and all who rise up to harm you be like that young man."

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti aboretie omokungu oria, nere akamotebia amang’ana onsi. Ase ayio omoruoti agachora omoteneneri oyomo anyare gokonya omokungu oria, akamotebia, “Irania ebinto bionsi biria biarenge bi’omokungu oyo, amo nokwama gwonsi korwa ase oboremo boria, gochakera rituko riria aruete ase oboremo boria goika bono.”
english: The king asked the woman about it, and she told him. Then he assigned an official to her case and said to him, "Give back everything that belonged to her, including all the income from her land from the day she left the country until now."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akababoria, “Naki omonto oyio arenge, oyio ochicha oumerana nainwe, na obatebia amang’ana ayio?”
english: The king asked them, "What kind of man was it who came to meet you and told you this?"

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaboria Siba, “Naki gwakora kwarenta ebinto ebi?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Chitigere nechi ’abanto b’omoruoti bagochia koriina, na emegati na amatunda nebi’abamura abwo bagochia koria, na edivai baegwe banywe kobarosire ase erooro.”
english: The king asked Ziba, "Why have you brought these?" Ziba answered, "The donkeys are for the king's household to ride on, the bread and fruit are for the men to eat, and the wine is to refresh those who become exhausted in the desert."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Omosae oria Abisalomu mbuya are?” Ahimasi akamoiraneria, “Ekero Yoabu antoma, inche, omosomba oo, nigo naigwa egetitiro ekenene, korende tinamanya engencho yaye.”
english: The king asked, "Is the young man Absalom safe?" Ahimaaz answered, "I saw great confusion just as Joab was about to send the king's servant and me, your servant, but I don't know what it was."

ekegusii: Naende omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Monto onde natigarete ase enka ya Saulo inyare komokorera obuya bwa Nyasae?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Ee, nareo omonto oyomo, mosinto o Yonathani, ore ekerema.”
english: The king asked, "Is there no one still left of the house of Saul to whom I can show God's kindness?" Ziba answered the king, "There is still a son of Jonathan; he is crippled in both feet."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Yoabu takari amo naye ase aya onsi?” Omokungu oria akairaneria, akabora, “Ekeene, buna aye, omonene one omoruoti, ore moyo, monto onde tari oranyare gokana gose kwanga gokoiraneria amaborio ao na gotama gochia aande, ensemo ya borio gose eya bomosi. Ekeene, Yoabu, omosomba oo, nere omboretie inche, omosomba oo, ng’a nkwane amang’ana aya onsi.
english: The king asked, "Isn't the hand of Joab with you in all this?" The woman answered, "As surely as you live, my lord the king, no one can turn to the right or to the left from anything my lord the king says. Yes, it was your servant Joab who instructed me to do this and who put all these words into the mouth of your servant.

ekegusii: Erio akabora, “Nkeinyorio ki keria narorire aaria ng’umbu?” Abanto b’omochie bakamoiraneria, “Eyio nembeera y’omonto o Nyasae oria orwete ense y’Abayuda na akabana igoro y’amang’ana aya gwakorire ase ogosaria egesasimero agwo Beteli.”
english: The king asked, "What is that tombstone I see?" The men of the city said, "It marks the tomb of the man of God who came from Judah and pronounced against the altar of Bethel the very things you have done to it."

ekegusii: Omoruoti agachika ng’a kera rituko babe bakoegwa endagera buna eria ere omonyene are koria, naende babe bakonywa edivai buna eria ere omonyene are konywa. Nigo barenge gochia kworokererigwa ase engaki y’emiaka etato; nyuma y’ayio barentwe ase obosio bw’omoruoti, babe bakomokorera.
english: The king assigned them a daily amount of food and wine from the king's table. They were to be trained for three years, and after that they were to enter the king's service.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agaaka eriogi rinene, agachika ng’a abaragori na Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, na abamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni, barentwe, Agatebia abang’aini baria ba Babeli, “Omonto onde bwensi orasome amariko aya, naende antebie engencho yaye, ere nabekerwe eanga emonyinga, naende abekerwe chisonoi chie chitahabu igoti riaye, ere oyio nabekwe abe omogambi o gatato ase oboruoti obo.”
english: The king called out for the enchanters, astrologers and diviners to be brought and said to these wise men of Babylon, "Whoever reads this writing and tells me what it means will be clothed in purple and have a gold chain placed around his neck, and he will be made the third highest ruler in the kingdom."

ekegusii: Omoruoti agachika Yoabu, na Abisai, na Itai, akabatebia, “Ase engencho yane timokorera omosae oyio Abisalomu bobe.” Na abanto bonsi mbaigwete ekero omoruoti akoa abatang’ani abwo ogochika okwo igoro y’Abisalomu.
english: The king commanded Joab, Abishai and Ittai, "Be gentle with the young man Absalom for my sake." And all the troops heard the king giving orders concerning Absalom to each of the commanders.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akarua korwa ase chitugo chiaye ching’iti chiare koruegwa ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, ebia mambia na ebia mogoroba, na ebie Chisabato, na ebi’Emetienyi Emeyia, na ebi’Amatuko Amanene ande achikire ase amachiko ’Omonene.
english: The king contributed from his own possessions for the morning and evening burnt offerings and for the burnt offerings on the Sabbaths, New Moons and appointed feasts as written in the Law of the LORD.
