ekegusii: Omoruoti agetuba obosio bwaye, akarera ase eriogi rinene, “Obee! Abisalomu, omwana one! Obee! Abisalomu, omwana one, omwana one!”
english: The king covered his face and cried aloud, "O my son Absalom! O Absalom, my son, my son!"

ekegusii: Erio Yosia omoruoti agachika abanto bonsi, akabatebia, “Mobe ne Rituko Rinene ri’Epasaka ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, buna arikire ase Ebuku eye y’Okobwatana kw’Ogotianania.”
english: The king gave this order to all the people: "Celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, as it is written in this Book of the Covenant."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaimoka ore nendamwamu, akarua ase omoyega, akagenda isiko ase egeticha kiare ase enyomba yaye. Hamani agatenena gosorora Esteri eting’ana ng’a amotige abe moyo, ekiagera aroche ng’a omoruoti nigo arengereretie komosiria.
english: The king got up in a rage, left his wine and went out into the palace garden. But Haman, realizing that the king had already decided his fate, stayed behind to beg Queen Esther for his life.

ekegusii: Na omoruoti akaimoka botuko, agatebia abasomba baye, “Tiga mbatebie egento Abasiiria barobeirie mamincha yaito. Bamanyire ng’a intwe igo tore nenchara; ase ayio basokire korwa ase egetwori bagendire kwebisa orosana batoboere, barengereretie ng’a ekero togosoka korwa ase omochie batobwate tore moyo, naende basoe omochie bayobwate.”
english: The king got up in the night and said to his officers, "I will tell you what the Arameans have done to us. They know we are starving; so they have left the camp to hide in the countryside, thinking, 'They will surely come out, and then we will take them alive and get into the city.'"

ekegusii: Omoruoti nabwate chimeeri chiaye chia Tarisisi chiarenge goeta chinyancha amo ne chimeeri chia Hiramu. Ara rimo ase emiaka etato chimeeri chia Tarisisi nigo chiarenge gocha chiarenta chitahabu ne chifeta, na amaino e chinchogu, ne chingoge amo ne chinyoni chi’ebieni ebiya.
english: The king had a fleet of trading ships at sea along with the ships of Hiram. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.

ekegusii: Chimeeri chi’omoruoti nigo chiarenge kogenda Tarisisi chibogoretie abasomba ba Huramu. Ara rimo ase emiaka etato chimeeri chia Tarisisi nigo chiarenge gocha korenta chitahabu, ne chifeta, na amaino e chinchogu, naende chikaba chikorenta chingoge ne chinyoni chikorokwa tausi.
english: The king had a fleet of trading ships manned by Hiram's men. Once every three years it returned, carrying gold, silver and ivory, and apes and baboons.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebio omoruoti akabibomba korwa ase etaai enyititoire, ime ase esike ebombire agwo egati ya Sukoti na Saretani ase Riranya ria Yorodan.
english: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebio omoruoti akabiroisia korwa ase chitaai chinyititoire na kobombwa ime ase esike ebombire agwo ase egati ya Sukoti na Sereda, ase riranya ria Yorodan.
english: The king had them cast in clay molds in the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan.

ekegusii: Omoruoti otomire amo nere Zadoki omokuani, na Nathani omobani, na Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na Abakereti, na Abapeleti, nabarabwo bariinirie Sulemani ase eyombo y’omoruoti.
english: The king has sent with him Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, the Kerethites and the Pelethites, and they have put him on the king's mule,

ekegusii: Oboseera bwao mbogere omoruoti agosanere, ekiagera ere nomonene oo, goika bwekumbe ase obosio bwaye.
english: The king is enthralled by your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.

ekegusii: Naki omoruoti namanyete engencho y’amang’ana aya, naende ninyare gokwana nere ntari nokoiroka, ekiagera namanyire mono ng’a ring’ana tiriri nonya nerimo ase ayio otamanyeti, ekiagera erio tiriakoregete bobisi.
english: The king is familiar with these things, and I can speak freely to him. I am convinced that none of this has escaped his notice, because it was not done in a corner.

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti ore nokobua, nigo bwanchete ekeene, aye gwakorire oboronge botenene bokong’u, nigo okonacha ebina bi’ekeene na oboronge ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo.
english: The King is mighty, he loves justice-- you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akarenta chifeta ne chitahabu chinyinge agwo Yerusalemu, chikabucha buna amagena; ne chibao chi’emecharake chiarenge chinyinge buna echi’emeko yarenge ase ense omweya.
english: The king made silver and gold as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akarenta chifeta chinyinge agwo Yerusalemu, chikabucha buna amagena, ne chibao chi’emecharake chiarenge chinyinge buna echi’emeko yarenge ase ense omweya.
english: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akarenta chifeta chinyinge agwo Yerusalemu, chikabucha buna amagena, ne chibao chi’emecharake nigo chiarenge chinyinge buna echi’emeko yarenge ase ense omweya.
english: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as plentiful as sycamore-fig trees in the foothills.

ekegusii: Korende omoruoti bw’Abaamoni taigwerete gose gosika amang’ana aya Yefta amotomerete.
english: The king of Ammon, however, paid no attention to the message Jephthah sent him.

ekegusii: the king of Aphek one the king of Lasharon one
english: na oyo bw’Afeki, na oyo o Lasaroni,

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaasuri akarenta abanto korwa Babeli, na Kuta, na Awa, na Hamati, na Sefariwaimu, akababeka ase emechie ya Samaria bayemenye ribaga ri’Abaisraeli. Ase igo abanto abwo bakaira ense ya Samaria, bakamenya ase emechie y’aroro.
english: The king of Assyria brought people from Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath and Sepharvaim and settled them in the towns of Samaria to replace the Israelites. They took over Samaria and lived in its towns.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaasuri akamwanchera, akagenda Damesiki, akayobua agoosa abanto b’aroro, akabaira gochia Kiri, agaita Resini.
english: The king of Assyria complied by attacking Damascus and capturing it. He deported its inhabitants to Kir and put Rezin to death.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaasuri agoosa Abaisraeli, akabaira Asuri, akabeka abande ase omochie o Hala, na abande ang’e na Habori, orooche rwa Gosani, na abande ase emechie y’Abamedi.
english: The king of Assyria deported Israel to Assyria and settled them in Halah, in Gozan on the Habor River and in towns of the Medes.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaasuri akagenda ase ense eria, akaboera Samaria ase engaki y’emiaka etato.
english: The king of Assyria invaded the entire land, marched against Samaria and laid siege to it for three years.

ekegusii: Korwa Lakisi omoruoti bw’Abaasuri agatoma abachiki abanene batato. Taritani, na Rabi‐Sarisi, na Rabi‐Sake, amo nabarwani abange b’esegi, gochia ase Hezekia agwo Yerusalemu. Bakagenda bagaika Yerusalemu, na ekero baigete bagatenena ang’e nomotaro bw’amache e ritibo ria rogoro, rire ase enchera ekogenda egetii ki’omosibia bw’ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga.
english: The king of Assyria sent his supreme commander, his chief officer and his field commander with a large army, from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. They came up to Jerusalem and stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Washerman's Field.

ekegusii: Boigo agoosa abanto bonsi barenge ne chinguru, chilifu isano na ibere, akabaira Babeli. Akaira nabaroisia ebinto, na abaturi ebioma, elifu eyemo. Abanto aba bonsi nigo baare ne chinguru naende baisanerete korwana esegi.
english: The king of Babylon also deported to Babylon the entire force of seven thousand fighting men, strong and fit for war, and a thousand craftsmen and artisans.

ekegusii: “Omoruoti o Babeli oigure amang’ana igoro yabo, amaboko aye aborirwe chinguru, omoichano omosoire, na obororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore.”
english: The king of Babylon has heard reports about them, and his hands hang limp. Anguish has gripped him, pain like that of a woman in labor.

ekegusii: the king of Debir one the king of Geder one
english: na oyo o Debiri, na oyo o Gederi,

ekegusii: na oyo o Dori, ase orogongo rwa Dori, na oyo o Goimu ase Giligali,
english: the king of Dor (in Naphoth Dor) one the king of Goyim in Gilgal one

ekegusii: the king of Eglon one the king of Gezer one
english: na oyo bw’Egiloni, na oyo o Geseri,

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Misiri agacha Yerusalemu akarusia Yehoahasi ase oboruoti, erio akabekera abanto b’ense eria ebango ye chitalanta rigana erimo chie chifeta, na etalanta eyemo y’etahabu.
english: The king of Egypt dethroned him in Jerusalem and imposed on Judah a levy of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Misiri taruete ase ense yaye naende, ekiagera omoruoti o Babeli konya oirire ense yonsi yarenge y’omoruoti o Misiri, gochakera akarooche ka Misiri goikera orooche rwa Eufarati.
english: The king of Egypt did not march out from his own country again, because the king of Babylon had taken all his territory, from the Wadi of Egypt to the Euphrates River.

ekegusii: Neko, omoruoti oyio o Misiri, akabeka Eliakimu, momura omwabo omoruoti oria arusetie, akaba omoruoti igoro ase Abayuda, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, na akaonchora erieta riaye, akamoroka Yehoyakimu. Neko akaira Yehoahasi, omomura omwabo Eliakimu, Misiri.
english: The king of Egypt made Eliakim, a brother of Jehoahaz, king over Judah and Jerusalem and changed Eliakim's name to Jehoiakim. But Neco took Eliakim's brother Jehoahaz and carried him off to Egypt.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Misiri agachika Sifura na Pua, abaiboria b’Abaibirania, akabatebia,
english: The king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives, whose names were Shiphrah and Puah,

ekegusii: the king of Hormah one the king of Arad one
english: na oyo o Horima, na oyo bw’Aradi,

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akagenda agaita chibarasi agasaria chigari, agaita n’Abasiiria ase ogoita okonene.
english: The king of Israel advanced and overpowered the horses and chariots and inflicted heavy losses on the Arameans.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akairaneria Yehosafati, “Omonto oyomo natigarete toranyare koboria Omonene goetera asare, nere Mikaya, mosinto o Imula, korende inche nigo imogechete, ekiagera ere tari kobana amang’ana amaya igoro yane, korende namabe oka.” Yehosafati akamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, tobaisa gokwana igo.”
english: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one man through whom we can inquire of the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah." "The king should not say that," Jehoshaphat replied.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akairaneria Yehosafati, “Omonto oyomo natigarete, toraborie Omonene goetera asare, nere Mikaya, mosinto o Imula, korende nigo imogechete, ekiagera ere tari kobana amang’ana amaya igoro yane, korende botambe namabe oka.” Yehosafati akamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, tobaisa gokwana igo.”
english: The king of Israel answered Jehoshaphat, "There is still one man through whom we can inquire of the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good about me, but always bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah." "The king should not say that," Jehoshaphat replied.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akairaneria, “Buna gwatebire aye omonene one, aye omoruoti, inche noyoo inde, na ebinto bionsi imbwate nebiao.”
english: The king of Israel answered, "Just as you say, my lord the king. I and all I have are yours."

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akairaneria, akabora, “Momotebie ng’a oyo okweboyia ebirwanero biaye tabaisa gwetogia buna oyo okobirusia.”
english: The king of Israel answered, "Tell him: 'One who puts on his armor should not boast like one who takes it off.'"

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agatebia abasomba baye, “Inwe momanyete ng’a Ramoti o Gileadi noyoito. Inee! Naki rende twakirire‐kiri, totarayoirania korwa ase amaboko ’omoruoti bw’Abasiiria?”
english: The king of Israel had said to his officials, "Don't you know that Ramoth Gilead belongs to us and yet we are doing nothing to retake it from the king of Aram?"

ekegusii: Na omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agatebia Yehosafati, “Tinagotebia ng’a ere takobana amang’ana amaya igoro asende, korende namabe oka?”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Didn't I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?"

ekegusii: Na omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agatebia Yehosafati, “Tinagotebia ng’a ere takobana amang’ana amaya igoro yane, korende namabe oka?”
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "Didn't I tell you that he never prophesies anything good about me, but only bad?"

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agatebia Yehosafati, “Inche nigo ngwekona ase ogwetuba timanyekana, erio ngende ase esegi, korende aye obeke chianga chiao chi’oboruoti.” Na omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agekona ase ogwetuba tamanyekana, akagenda ase esegi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.

ekegusii: Na omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agatebia Yehosafati, “Inche nigo ngwekona ase ogwetuba timanyekana, erio ngende ase esegi, korende aye obeke chianga chiao chi’oboruoti.” Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agekona ase ogwetuba tamanyekana; erio bakagenda ase esegi.
english: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, "I will enter the battle in disguise, but you wear your royal robes." So the king of Israel disguised himself and went into battle.

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akarangeria abagaaka bonsi b’ense yaye, akabatebia, “Rora bono buna omonto oyo akorigia korenta emechando, igo atoma abanto, akagania imoe abakungu baane, na abana baane, ne chifeta, ne chitahabu, nainche timorineti.”
english: The king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land and said to them, "See how this man is looking for trouble! When he sent for my wives and my children, my silver and my gold, I did not refuse him."

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agateba, “Bwata Mikaya momoiranie ase Amoni omonene bw’omochie na ase Yoashi, omwana bw’omoruoti,
english: The king of Israel then ordered, "Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king's son

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli agateba, “Bwata Mikaya momoiranie ase Amoni, omonene bw’omochie, na ase Yoashi, omomura bw’omoruoti,
english: The king of Israel then ordered, "Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon the ruler of the city and to Joash the king's son,

ekegusii: the king of Jarmuth one the king of Lachish one
english: na oyo o Yarimuti, na oyo o Lakisi,

ekegusii: Omoruoto o Yeriko, na oyo bwa Ai, ang’e na Beteli,
english: the king of Jericho one the king of Ai (near Bethel) one

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Yeriko agatebigwa ng’a Abaisraeli bande basoire aroro obotuko boria koroota ense eria.
english: The king of Jericho was told, "Look! Some of the Israelites have come here tonight to spy out the land."

ekegusii: the king of Jerusalem one the king of Hebron one
english: na oyo o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni,

ekegusii: the king of Kedesh one the king of Jokneam in Carmel one
english: na oyo o Kedesi, na oyo o Yokinamu, ang’e na Karimeli,

ekegusii: the king of Libnah one the king of Adullam one
english: na oyo o Libuna, na oyo bw’Adulamu,

ekegusii: the king of Madon one the king of Hazor one
english: na oyo o Madoni, na oyo o Hasori,

ekegusii: the king of Makkedah one the king of Bethel one
english: na oyo o Makeda, na oyo o Beteli,

ekegusii: the king of Shimron Meron one the king of Acshaph one
english: na oyo o Simuroni‐Meroni, na oyo bw’Akisafu,

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Sodomu agatebia Aburamu, “Ing’a abanto baane, korende enibo ero oire aye.”
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the people and keep the goods for yourself."

ekegusii: the king of Taanach one the king of Megiddo one
english: na oyo o Taanaki, na oyo o Megido

ekegusii: the king of Tappuah one the king of Hepher one
english: na oyo o Tapua, na oyo o Heferi,

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abaamoni akairaneria abanto abwo batometwe na Yefta, “Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri mbairete ense yane korwa orooche rw’Arinoni goika orwa Yaboki, na goika Yorodan. Ase ayio bono yeiranie nomorembe.”
english: The king of the Ammonites answered Jephthah's messengers, "When Israel came up out of Egypt, they took away my land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, all the way to the Jordan. Now give it back peaceably."

ekegusii: Omoruoti oria o sugusu nairane gochia ase ense yaye, aire ebinto ebinge asakoire, na enkoro yaye neroberie mamincha y’okobwatana koria ogochenu, na ekero arabe oikeranirie ayio, nairane gochia ase ense yaye omonyene.
english: The king of the North will return to his own country with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant. He will take action against it and then return to his own country.

ekegusii: na oyo o Tirisa. Abaruoti abwo bonsi nigo barenge emerongo etato nomo.
english: the king of Tirzah one thirty-one kings in all.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agachika Hilikia, omokuani omonene, na abakuani, abakonyi baye, na abarendi b’egesieri, barusie korwa ase Hekalu y’Omonene ebikorero bionsi biaroisetwe ase ogosasimera Baali na Asera, na erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni chionsi chia igoro. Nyuma y’ayio akabisambera isiko ya Yerusalemu, agwo ase egetii gia Kidironi, akaira ribu riabo Beteli.
english: The king ordered Hilkiah the high priest, the priests next in rank and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal and Asherah and all the starry hosts. He burned them outside Jerusalem in the fields of the Kidron Valley and took the ashes to Bethel.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akabeka Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, akaba omochiki bw’abarwani esegi ribaga ria Yoabu, na Zadoki omokuani akabekwa ribaga ri’Abiatari.
english: The king put Benaiah son of Jehoiada over the army in Joab's position and replaced Abiathar with Zadok the priest.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akabairaneria, akabatebia, “Amang’ana aane tari koonchoka, na motantebeti chindoto chiane amo nengencho yaye, nigo morabutoranwe ekiimo ase ekiimo, ne chinyomba chiaino nchitagorwe chibe amatombe.
english: The king replied to the astrologers, "This is what I have firmly decided: If you do not tell me what my dream was and interpret it, I will have you cut into pieces and your houses turned into piles of rubble.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoiraneria, “Onde bwensi aise kogotebia amang’ana are mamincha yao, omorente asende, nere takogokuna naende.”
english: The king replied, "If anyone says anything to you, bring him to me, and he will not bother you again."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoiraneria, “Onye Omonene takogokonya, naki inche ndagokonye? Nkorwa ase ekeooreri, gose nkorwa ase egeteera gi’okomitera edivai?”
english: The king replied, "If the LORD does not help you, where can I get help for you? From the threshing floor? From the winepress?"

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti, na gavuna, na Bereniki, na baria baikaransete amo nabarabwo bagatenena,
english: The king rose, and with him the governor and Bernice and those sitting with them.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia Barisilai, “Inchuo ogende amo nainche, nimbe ngokorageria aaria Yerusalemu.”
english: The king said to Barzillai, "Cross over with me and stay with me in Jerusalem, and I will provide for you."

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia Danieli, “Ekeene, Nyasae oino nere Nyasae ore igoro ye chinyasae chionsi, na Omonene bw’abaruoti, naende nere okomaanora obobisi. Namanyire aya, ekiagera aye kwamaanoire obobisi obo.”
english: The king said to Daniel, "Surely your God is the God of gods and the Lord of kings and a revealer of mysteries, for you were able to reveal this mystery."

ekegusii: Omoruoti oria akamotebia, “Tibwoboa! Ninki kwarora?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Narorire enyasae egotiira korwa riroba inse.”
english: The king said to her, "Don't be afraid. What do you see?" The woman said, "I see a spirit coming up out of the ground."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamotebia, “Genda nomorembe.” Ase igo Abisalomu akaimoka, akagenda Heburoni.
english: The king said to him, "Go in peace." So he went to Hebron.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamotebia, “Ng’ara karenga nkogotebia bwetianie ng’a ontebie ekeene gioka ase erieta ri’Omonene.”
english: The king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the LORD?"

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoboria, “Ng’ara karenga nkogotiania ng’a ontebie ekeene gioka ase erieta ri’Omonene?”
english: The king said to him, "How many times must I make you swear to tell me nothing but the truth in the name of the LORD?"

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoiraneria, “Naki okona‐komenta gokwana amang’ana ayio ao? Inche natebire ng’a aye na Siba mwatanane amaremo a Saulo.”
english: The king said to him, "Why say more? I order you and Ziba to divide the fields."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaboria Itai Omogiti, “Nase ki naye okogenda amo naintwe? Irana obeere nomoruoti oyio omoyia; aye nomomenyi ore, naende nigo gwaserigwa korwa seino.
english: The king said to Ittai the Gittite, "Why should you come along with us? Go back and stay with King Absalom. You are a foreigner, an exile from your homeland.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio omoruoti agatebia Yoabu, “Naama! Nakoeire ribaga eri. Genda orente omosae oria Abisalomu.”
english: The king said to Joab, "Very well, I will do it. Go, bring back the young man Absalom."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti akamboria, “Ngento ki oganetie okorerwe?” Inche nkagenderera gosaba Nyasae o igoro.
english: The king said to me, "What is it you want?" Then I prayed to the God of heaven,

ekegusii: na omoruoti agatebia Esteri eting’ana, “Agwo ase eburi ya Susa, Abayahudi baitire abanto amagana atano, babasiririe, amo nabamura ikomi ba Hamani. Onye ere igo, Inee, ngento ki bakorire ase chinsemo chinde ase chingongo chi’oboruoti bwane? Bono ninki naende oganetie? Nokeegwe. Ntebia ngento ki naende otarakorerwa. Nakerokio nokorerwe.”
english: The king said to Queen Esther, "The Jews have killed and destroyed five hundred men and the ten sons of Haman in the citadel of Susa. What have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? Now what is your petition? It will be given you. What is your request? It will also be granted."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia omonto oria o Nyasae, “Inchuo togende nyomba mwane, otimokere aroro, onyore chinguru naende, nainche ninkoe ekeegwa.”
english: The king said to the man of God, "Come home with me and have something to eat, and I will give you a gift."

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia omokungu oria “Genda bwoo, ninkoroiserie amang’ana ayio.”
english: The king said to the woman, "Go home, and I will issue an order in your behalf."

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia Abineri, “Genda oborie omanye gose omosae oyo noyo ng’o?”
english: The king said, "Find out whose son this young man is."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoiraneria, “Kimuhamu nagende amo nainche, nimokorere kende gionsi aye oraganie. Na ande onsi oramborie ningokorere aye.”
english: The king said, "Kimham shall cross over with me, and I will do for him whatever pleases you. And anything you desire from me I will do for you."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamotebia, “Tigera, otenene agwo ensemo,” na Ahimasi agatigera, agatenena ensemo.
english: The king said, "Stand aside and wait here." So he stepped aside and stood there.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agateba, “Oyomo nigo agoteba: Omwana oyo ore moyo, nere oyone, na omwana oria okwete, nere oyoo; na oyonde igo agokana: Yaya, omwana oo, nere okwete, na omwana one, nere ore moyo.”
english: The king said, "This one says, 'My son is alive and your son is dead,' while that one says, 'No! Your son is dead and mine is alive.'"

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaboria, “Ning’o oyio ore ase egoora?” Ekaba ng’a Hamani nere orenge gosoa ase egoora isiko y’enyomba y’omoruoti, akwane nomoruoti, erinde achie gotonga Moredekai ase orobambo roria amosimiseretie.
english: The king said, "Who is in the court?" Now Haman had just entered the outer court of the palace to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows he had erected for him.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaba okweumia igoro y’Abineri, okobora, “Inee! Nabo Abineri agwenerete gokwa buna omonto omoriri?
english: The king sang this lament for Abner: "Should Abner have died as the lawless die?

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatoma abanto bakamosibora, ee, oyorenge omogambi bw’abanto akamosibora.
english: The king sent and released him, the ruler of peoples set him free.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatoma Yehudi agende korenta ebuku eria. Yehudi akayerenta korwa ase eero y’Elisama omoriki, erio akayesomera omoruoti amo nabanene bonsi b’oboruoti bwaye, abwo bamoetanaine.
english: The king sent Jehudi to get the scroll, and Jehudi brought it from the room of Elishama the secretary and read it to the king and all the officials standing beside him.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatoma amairanerio aya: “Ase Rehemu, omosemia omonene, na Simusai omoriki, na ase abanto baria bande babwataine nabarabwo bamenyete Samaria, boigo nase baria barenge ase orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, nabakwanirie.
english: The king sent this reply: To Rehum the commanding officer, Shimshai the secretary and the rest of their associates living in Samaria and elsewhere in Trans-Euphrates: Greetings.

ekegusii: Ase igo omoruoti akagenda, na abanto bonsi b’omochie oye bakamotunyana. Omoruoti agatiga abakungu baye ba sere‐sere ikomi bakorenda enyomba yaye.
english: The king set out, with his entire household following him; but he left ten concubines to take care of the palace.

ekegusii: “Aye omoruoti, bono manya ng’a Abayahudi aba barua asore, bagacha asetore aiga Yerusalemu, bachakire koagacha omochie oria oichire nogosaria na obobe. Nigo bare ang’e gokoora chindwaki chiaye na koroisia amaroso aye.
english: The king should know that the Jews who came up to us from you have gone to Jerusalem and are rebuilding that rebellious and wicked city. They are restoring the walls and repairing the foundations.

ekegusii: “Nigo togokomanyia aye omoruoti ng’a intwe ntwagenda ase orogongo orwo rw’Abayuda, ase enyomba ya Nyasae oyore omonene. Nigo egendererete koagacherwa amagena amanene mono, ne chibao chibekire ase chinyasi. Ekeene, emeremo eye nigo egokorwa ase okwerwa okonene, na nigo esesenirie ase amaboko abo.
english: The king should know that we went to the district of Judah, to the temple of the great God. The people are building it with large stones and placing the timbers in the walls. The work is being carried on with diligence and is making rapid progress under their direction.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatiga Mefiboseti, mosinto o Yonathani o Saulo, ase engencho y’eira Daudi na Yonathani barierereranete ase Omonene,
english: The king spared Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, because of the oath before the LORD between David and Jonathan son of Saul.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatenena aase aye, agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania ase obosio bw’Omonene ng’a nabwatie Omonene, na abwate amachiko aye, na oborori bwaye, na emeroberio yaye echikire, nayakore nenkoro yaye yonsi na omoyo oye bwonsi, nakore amang’ana onsi aganeirie nokobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania, ayarikire ase ebuku eye.
english: The king stood by his pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the LORD-- to follow the LORD and keep his commands, regulations and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, and to obey the words of the covenant written in this book.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatenena ang’e nesiiro, agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania ase obosio bw’Omonene, ng’a mbabwatie Omonene na kobwata amachiko aye, na oborori bwaye, na emeroberio yaye echikire, bayakore ne chinkoro chiabo chionsi na emioyo yabo yonsi, mbakore amang’ana onsi aganeirie nokobwatana oko kw’ogotianania, ayarikire ase ebuku eye. Erio abanto bonsi bakaria eira ng’a mbabwate okobwatana koria kw’ogotianania.
english: The king stood by the pillar and renewed the covenant in the presence of the LORD-- to follow the LORD and keep his commands, regulations and decrees with all his heart and all his soul, thus confirming the words of the covenant written in this book. Then all the people pledged themselves to the covenant.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti akaimoka, agatandora chianga chiaye, akarara inse ase amaroba, na abasomba baye abateneineo bagatandora chianga chiabo.
english: The king stood up, tore his clothes and lay down on the ground; and all his servants stood by with their clothes torn.

ekegusii: akamorangeria, akamotebia, “Inche nigo nagotebetie ng’a orie eira y’ogotiana ase Omonene ng’a tobaisa korua Yerusalemu. Naende nkagokurera mono ngateba: Rituko orasoke korwa aroro agwo, na ogende aande onsi, goika okwe. Inee! Tigwanchete ng’a nonyigwere na okore bo?
english: the king summoned Shimei and said to him, "Did I not make you swear by the LORD and warn you, 'On the day you leave to go anywhere else, you can be sure you will die'? At that time you said to me, 'What you say is good. I will obey.'

ekegusii: Daudi akarangeria Abagibeoni. (Barabwo tibarenge Abaisraeli; nigo barenge ekeombe giatigarete korwa ase Abaamori, na Abaisraeli konya babariereire eira ng’a babatige babe moyo, korende Saulo akarigia kobaita ase omokia oye, ase engencho y’Abaisraeli na Abayuda.)
english: The king summoned the Gibeonites and spoke to them. (Now the Gibeonites were not a part of Israel but were survivors of the Amorites; the Israelites had sworn to [spare] them, but Saul in his zeal for Israel and Judah had tried to annihilate them.)

ekegusii: Omoruoti agakwana nabarabwo, na ase abwo bonsi onde tanyorekanete omogogetie buna Danieli, na Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria. Ase ayio abwo bane bakaba bakomokorera omoruoti.
english: The king talked with them, and he found none equal to Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah; so they entered the king's service.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamoboria, “Ng’ai omochokoro bw’omonene oo akare?” Siba akamoiraneria, “Yerusalemu akare. Nigo ateba ng’a rero Abaisraeli bamoiraneirie oboruoti bwa sokoro yaye.”
english: The king then asked, "Where is your master's grandson?" Ziba said to him, "He is staying in Jerusalem, because he thinks, 'Today the house of Israel will give me back my grandfather's kingdom.'"

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia Doegi, “Aye imoka oite abakuani abwo,” na Doegi, Omoedomu, akaimoka, akabaita. Ase rituko erio agaita abanto emerongo etano na etato, na batano, abwo babegete ebisibao bi’egatani.
english: The king then ordered Doeg, "You turn and strike down the priests." So Doeg the Edomite turned and struck them down. That day he killed eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.

ekegusii: Na omoruoti akaria eira y’ogotiana, agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oria otooretie obogima bwane korwa ase emechando yonsi,
english: The king then took an oath: "As surely as the LORD lives, who has delivered me out of every trouble,

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti akarusia ebonyi eria arusetie ase Hamani, akayea Moredekai, na Esteri akabeka Moredekai atenenere enyomba eria yarenge eya Hamani.
english: The king took off his signet ring, which he had reclaimed from Haman, and presented it to Mordecai. And Esther appointed him over Haman's estate.

ekegusii: Korwa ase chibao chi’alugumu omoruoti akaroisia ebiriinero bi’enyomba y’Omonene, na ebi’enyomba y’omoruoti, naende akaroisia amakano, na amakano ’ebirigisa akobugigwa nabateri. Ebinto buna ebio tibiana‐kororekana naende nonya ng’ake ase ense y’Abayuda.
english: The king used the algumwood to make steps for the temple of the LORD and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. Nothing like them had ever been seen in Judah.)

ekegusii: Korwa ase chibao chi’alumugu omoruoti akaroisia ebinto bi’enyomba y’Omonene, na ebi’enyomba y’omoruoti, naende akaroisia amakano na ebinto binde bikobugigwa nabateri. Chibao chi’emete buna eyio tichiana kororekana naende nonya ng’ake ase ense eye.
english: The king used the almugwood to make supports for the temple of the LORD and for the royal palace, and to make harps and lyres for the musicians. So much almugwood has never been imported or seen since that day.)

ekegusii: Omoruoti agaichana, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye na abageni baye ase omoyega, agachika ayoegwe.
english: The king was distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he ordered that her request be granted

ekegusii: Omoruoti oria akaba nendamwamu, agatoma emeganda y’abarwani, agasiria abaiti baria, na omochie obo akayosamba nomorero.
english: The king was enraged. He sent his army and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaba nomoichano mono, korende ase engencho ye chiira chiaye, na ase engencho y’abwo baikaransete ase omoyega, tarigetie kwanga.
english: The king was greatly distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he did not want to refuse her.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaba nomogoko omonene mono, agachika ng’a Danieli arusigwe ase engoro eria. Ase ayio Danieli akarusigwa aroro na tanyorekanete oarire aande onsi ase omobere oye, ekiagera nigo amosemeretie Nyasae oye.
english: The king was overjoyed and gave orders to lift Daniel out of the den. And when Daniel was lifted from the den, no wound was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agachandeka mono, akariina gochia akanyomba karenge ase egeita igoro, akarera nobororo, akaba ogotaara‐taara na goteba, “Abisalomu, omwana one! Obee! Omwana one! Abisalomu, ntare gokwa ribaga riao! Abisalomu, omwana one!”
english: The king was shaken. He went up to the room over the gateway and wept. As he went, he said: "O my son Absalom! My son, my son Absalom! If only I had died instead of you-- O Absalom, my son, my son!"

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti nigo arenge gokwana na Gehasi, omosomba bw’omonto oria o Nyasae, akamoboria amotebie amang’ana amanene Elisha konya akorire.
english: The king was talking to Gehazi, the servant of the man of God, and had said, "Tell me about all the great things Elisha has done."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akagenda Gibeoni gochia korua ekeng’wanso aroro, ekiagera nao arenge aase aimokererete igoro mono; akarua aroro ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa elifu eyemo.
english: The king went to Gibeon to offer sacrifices, for that was the most important high place, and Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

ekegusii: Omoruoti nabe okweumia, na abagambi mbatubwe nomoichano; amaboko ’abanto b’ense eye nabe akoiguswa ase obwoba. Nimbakorere koreng’ana nogokora kwabo; nimbagambie koreng’ana buna barenge kogamba. Erio nario baramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: The king will mourn, the prince will be clothed with despair, and the hands of the people of the land will tremble. I will deal with them according to their conduct, and by their own standards I will judge them. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

ekegusii: Omoruoti oyio takwementera chibarasi chinyinge, gose tabaisa gotoma abanto bairane Misiri ase ogochia korigia chibarasi chinyinge, ekiagera Omonene obatebirie ng’a timokonyara koirana gochia ase enchera eria naende.
english: The king, moreover, must not acquire great numbers of horses for himself or make the people return to Egypt to get more of them, for the LORD has told you, "You are not to go back that way again."

ekegusii: ande nabo arabe nendamwamu, akoborie: Naki mwakorete mokagenda ang’e nomochie? Inee! Timwamanyete ng’a abanto nigo bakoruta emegwe korwa ase orwaki?
english: the king's anger may flare up, and he may ask you, 'Why did you get so close to the city to fight? Didn't you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?

ekegusii: Bono ekiagera ogochika kw’omoruoti kwarenge ogotindi, na ase ayio omorero bw’eriko riria konya omentirwe obeire omonene mono, chimeme chi’omorero oria chigasamba na goita abanto baria barutete Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, ase omorero oria.
english: The king's command was so urgent and the furnace so hot that the flames of the fire killed the soldiers who took up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego,

ekegusii: Amarube ayio agatebereria ng’a omoruoti orure ribaga ase Abayahudi ba kera omochie bache amo, erinde beegerere abanyene. Baegwe ribaga boigo goita abarwani bande bonsi ba kera egesaku bare gocha kobarwania, baite nabana babo na abakungu babo; boigo basakore chinibo chiabo.
english: The king's edict granted the Jews in every city the right to assemble and protect themselves; to destroy, kill and annihilate any armed force of any nationality or province that might attack them and their women and children; and to plunder the property of their enemies.

ekegusii: Enkoro y’omoruoti nigo enga buna orooche rore ase okoboko kw’Omonene; na Omonene nigo akomoraa gochia aande onsi buna aganetie.
english: The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD; he directs it like a watercourse wherever he pleases.

ekegusii: The kings of Tarshish and of distant shores will bring tribute to him; the kings of Sheba and Seba will present him gifts.
english: Abaruoti ba Tarisisi na ab’ebisinka mbabe bakomorentera ebiegwa; naboigo nabaruoti ba Sheba na Seba mbamorentere ebango.

ekegusii: Abaruoti b’ense, na abanto bonsi bamenyeteo, tibegenete ng’a omochandi, gose omobisa onde bwensi, nkonyara arenge gosoa ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu.
english: The kings of the earth did not believe, nor did any of the world's people, that enemies and foes could enter the gates of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abaruoti b’ense bebekire ang’e, na abagambi nigo bakogamba amo ase okwanga Omonene na Omoakwa Amaguta oye.
english: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the LORD and against his Anointed One.

ekegusii: Abaruoti b’ense bebekire ang’e, na abagambi nigo bakogamba amo ase okwanga Omonene na Kristo oye.
english: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against his Anointed One.'

ekegusii: Abasomba b’omoruoti bakamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, intwe abasomba bao nigo twebegete ang’e gokora rinde rionsi oratotebie.”
english: The king's officials answered him, "Your servants are ready to do whatever our lord the king chooses."

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’omoruoti rikaba ne chinguru igoro ya Yoabu na abatang’ani b’abarwani. Ase igo Yoabu na abatang’ani bande bakarua ase omoruoti, bakagenda kobara Abaisraeli.
english: The king's word, however, overruled Joab and the army commanders; so they left the presence of the king to enroll the fighting men of Israel.

ekegusii: Korende ring’ana ri’omoruoti rikaba ne chinguru igoro ya Yoabu. Erio Yoabu akaimoka akagenda ase Abaisraeli bonsi, erio akairana gocha Yerusalemu.
english: The king's word, however, overruled Joab; so Joab left and went throughout Israel and then came back to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya irianyi y’Obomenyo boria.
english: The Kohathite clans were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.

ekegusii: Abana ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.
english: The Kohathite clans: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto nigo gokomobetereria gokora emeremo, ekiagera nigo aganetie gweisanekia ere omonyene.
english: The laborer's appetite works for him; his hunger drives him on.

ekegusii: ching’ondi nigo chikonachwa amarionya akoroisigwa chianga, ne chimbori chiaoonigwa ase okogora omogondo.
english: the lambs will provide you with clothing, and the goats with the price of a field.

ekegusii: na Samweli nigo arenge oraire ime ase Obomenyo Obochenu aase Esanduku ya Nyasae yarenge. Ritang’ani chitaya chia Nyasae chitararima,
english: The lamp of God had not yet gone out, and Samuel was lying down in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was.

ekegusii: Omoika ore ase omonto, noro etaya y’Omonene; nigo ekomoreka na komanya amang’ana onsi are ime y’enkoro y’omonto.
english: The lamp of the LORD searches the spirit of a man; it searches out his inmost being.

ekegusii: Haroni arende chitaya echio chire ase ekebekerero gi’etahabu echenire, erinde chigenderere gwoka botambe ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
english: The lamps on the pure gold lampstand before the LORD must be tended continually.

ekegusii: the lampstand that is for light with its accessories, lamps and oil for the light;
english: ekebekerero gie chitaya na ebikorero biaye, ne chitaya chiaye amo namaguta e chitaya,

ekegusii: Ebibekerero bie chitaya bitano biare kobekwa ensemo y’okorio, na bitano ensemo y’okobee, bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono; na emegwekano y’ebisicha, ne chitaya, amo nebinachi biakorire korwa ase chitahabu.
english: the lampstands of pure gold (five on the right and five on the left, in front of the inner sanctuary); the gold floral work and lamps and tongs;

ekegusii: na ebibekerero bie chitaya amo ne chitaya chiabo chiaroisetigwe korwa ase chitahabu chichenire chiarenge gwoka bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono, buna amang’ana achigetwe;
english: the lampstands of pure gold with their lamps, to burn in front of the inner sanctuary as prescribed;

ekegusii: Ense eyio ere mbarabare y’enyancha nebe amarisio aase abarisia barabe namakuruma abo na ameri ’amaicho abo.
english: The land by the sea, where the Kerethites dwell, will be a place for shepherds and sheep pens.

ekegusii: Igo ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase Yeremia rigaikeranigwa, na ense eria nigo yatimogete. Ekero ense eria yatigarete ere amatongo, nigo yarendete Esabato, goika emiaka emerongo etano na ebere ekaera.
english: The land enjoyed its sabbath rests; all the time of its desolation it rested, until the seventy years were completed in fulfillment of the word of the LORD spoken by Jeremiah.

ekegusii: Na ense eye naete Ibrahimu na Isaka, ninkoyee aye na ororeria rwao rorache korwa nyuma yao.”
english: The land I gave to Abraham and Isaac I also give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you."

ekegusii: Ense eye nigo eichire nabatomani, nigo ekweumia ase engencho y’okoragererigwa, na amarisia ’erooro omire. Orogendo rw’abanto nigo rore orobe, ne chinguru chiabo nigo chire ase ogokora aya atari amaronge.
english: The land is full of adulterers; because of the curse the land lies parched and the pastures in the desert are withered. The [prophets] follow an evil course and use their power unjustly.

ekegusii: Ense nigo ekweumia, yaereirwe chinguru; rinani ria Lebanoni riasookire na gosusana; rikura ria Saroni riabeire buna Ekerubo Ekiomo, na emete ya Basani na Karimeli yaarorokire amato.
english: The land mourns and wastes away, Lebanon is ashamed and withers; Sharon is like the Arabah, and Bashan and Carmel drop their leaves.

ekegusii: ase ense y’Abakeni, na Abakenisi, na Abakadimoni,
english: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,

ekegusii: Na ense ekamera bionsi ebigokina: ebimeri bikorua chimbusuro chiabo chinyene, na emete ekwama amatunda are ne chimbusuro chire imeo, kera oyomo ase egesaku kiaye ekenyene. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.
english: The land produced vegetation: plants bearing seed according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed in it according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.

ekegusii: nemechie y’ense eyio Omonene atigete omoganda bw’Abaisraeli okayebua, na ense eye nigo ere engiya ase oborisia bwe chitugo, na intwe abasomba bao nigo tobwate amaicho amange e chitugo.”
english: the land the LORD subdued before the people of Israel-- are suitable for livestock, and your servants have livestock.

ekegusii: Erio ense etengeche na koiguswa ase obororo, ekiagera omoroberio bw’Omonene bw’ogosaria Babeli noikeranigwe, na ere nasirie ense eyio ebe bosa temenywa na monto.
english: The land trembles and writhes, for the LORD's purposes against Babylon stand-- to lay waste the land of Babylon so that no one will live there.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ense eye mbeumie, kera eamate ase ensemo yaye; eamate y’enyomba ya Daudi ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo; eamate y’enyomba ya Nathani ensemo yaye, na abakungu babo ensemo yabo;
english: The land will mourn, each clan by itself, with their wives by themselves: the clan of the house of David and their wives, the clan of the house of Nathan and their wives,

ekegusii: Ense eria mogochia gosoa moyeire teri buna ense ya Misiri agwo ase mwarwa. Aroro nigo mwarenge kobusura chimbusuro chiaino, naende mwakora emeremo y’ogosiarera amache, buna mogosiarera amache ase egeticha gie chinyeni.
english: The land you are entering to take over is not like the land of Egypt, from which you have come, where you planted your seed and irrigated it by foot as in a vegetable garden.

ekegusii: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.
english: Omobisa bw’omoerio orasirigwe namakweri.

ekegusii: abwo ase obwanchani, bamanyete ng’a nabekirwe ase okorwanerera enchili.
english: The latter do so in love, knowing that I am put here for the defense of the gospel.

ekegusii: Amachiko ao gwakwanete nigo are amaya asende, kobua chitahabu ne chifeta chilifu chinyinge.
english: The law from your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.

ekegusii: Amachiko nigo are ao ase okwegena, ekiagera nigo arikire, “Omonto oyorakore ayio nabe moyo ase aro.”
english: The law is not based on faith; on the contrary, "The man who does these things will live by them."

ekegusii: Naki ayare ime y’amachiko nekiriri gioka ki’amang’ana agochi‐gocha, gose tari ekieni ekenyene. Ase ayio, ebing’wanso biria biria biare koruegwa kera omwaka botambe tibiarenge konyara kobaikerania abwo baare kobirua.
english: The law is only a shadow of the good things that are coming-- not the realities themselves. For this reason it can never, by the same sacrifices repeated endlessly year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.

ekegusii: Amachiko a Nyasae oye nigo abeerete ase enkoro y’omonto oyio; ase agoeta tari gotererigwa.
english: The law of his God is in his heart; his feet do not slip.

ekegusii: Amachiko ’Omonene namaikeranu, nigo agokora omoyo oba omoyia. Oborori bw’Omonene nobw’ekeene, nigo akong’ainiyia oyotamanyeti amange.
english: The law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul. The statutes of the LORD are trustworthy, making wise the simple.

ekegusii: Musa agatoa amachiko, ayio are omwando bw’omosangererekano bw’abanto ba Yakobo.
english: the law that Moses gave us, the possession of the assembly of Jacob.

ekegusii: Amachiko agasoa, erinde ogosaria kobe okonene mono. Korende aase ebibe biamentegete, amabera akamenteka akaba amange kobua,
english: The law was added so that the trespass might increase. But where sin increased, grace increased all the more,

ekegusii: Omonto omworo tari koiyeka nonya neki arusirie ase orotwari, korende omokia nigo ore enibo ere nengencho enene ase omonto.
english: The lazy man does not roast his game, but the diligent man prizes his possessions.

ekegusii: The leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
english: Eliasafu, mosinto o Laeli, nere orabe omotang’ani bwe chiamate chi’Abagerisoni.

ekegusii: Elisafani, mosinto bwa Usieli, nere orabe omotang’ani bw’egesaku ki’Abakohati.
english: The leader of the families of the Kohathite clans was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabe bagotoora ensemo ya sugusu y’Obomenyo boria. Surieli, mosinto bw’Abihaili, nere orabe omotang’ani bw’abanto b’egesaku kia Merari.
english: The leader of the families of the Merarite clans was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.

ekegusii: Abatang’ani babo bakarenta amagena e rigori rinene buna oiniki na ayande arabekwe ase egesibao na egesembe ki’obokuani,
english: The leaders brought onyx stones and other gems to be mounted on the ephod and breastpiece.

ekegusii: Abatang’ani b’abanto bonsi b’ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli bagacha ase omosangererekano oria bw’abanto ba Nyasae. Abwo barenge gotaara namagoro babogoretie emioro, nigo barenge chilifu amagana ane.
english: The leaders of all the people of the tribes of Israel took their places in the assembly of the people of God, four hundred thousand soldiers armed with swords.

ekegusii: Erio abanene b’Abaisraeli, amo nomoruoti, bagekeyia bakaba abaitongo, bagateba, “Omonene nere omonyene oboronge.”
english: The leaders of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, "The LORD is just."

ekegusii: Barabwo amo nabanene b’oboruoti bw’Abayuda, na aba Yerusalemu, na abateneneri b’enyomba y’omoruoti, na abakuani, na abanto bonsi b’ense eye, baria baetete ase egati y’ebing’ese bi’emori eria,
english: The leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the court officials, the priests and all the people of the land who walked between the pieces of the calf,

ekegusii: Abanto ba Gileadi na abatang’ani babo bagakwana barabwo ase barabwo, “Ning’o oranche gochaka korwania Abaamoni? Ere oyio nabe omogambi bw’abanto bonsi ba Gileadi.”
english: The leaders of the people of Gilead said to each other, "Whoever will launch the attack against the Ammonites will be the head of all those living in Gilead."

ekegusii: Abatang’ani b’abanto nabwo aba: Parosi, na Pahati-Moabu, na Elamu, na Satu, na Bani;
english: The leaders of the people: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

ekegusii: The lean, ugly cows ate up the seven fat cows that came up first.
english: Agwo chiombe chiria chimbe chindeu chikaria chiombe chiria isano na ibere chie ritang’ani, chiare chingiya chinoru,

ekegusii: Oyore omoke nabuche abe chilifu, na oyo otari na nguru nabe egesaku kere nokobua. Inche ninche Omonene; ekero engaki yane eraike ning’ayererie ayio.”
english: The least of you will become a thousand, the smallest a mighty nation. I am the LORD; in its time I will do this swiftly."

ekegusii: Emiaka y’obogima bwaito nemerongo etano na ebere; onye tore ne chinguru, eba emerongo etano na etato; na obogima obo nigo boichire nobokong’u na emechando, nigo bogoeta bwango, na intwe tweiruruka twasira.
english: The length of our days is seventy years-- or eighty, if we have the strength; yet their span is but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

ekegusii: Ere akabagambera Abayuda agwo Heburoni ase engaki y’emiaka etano na ebere, na emetienyi etano nomo.
english: The length of time David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

ekegusii: Akairana rirube ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli riarikire iga, “Ekero rirube eri rikogoikera, omanye ng’a natomire Naamani, omosomba one, erinde omogwenie ase oborwaire bwaye bwa ukoma.”
english: The letter that he took to the king of Israel read: "With this letter I am sending my servant Naaman to you so that you may cure him of his leprosy."

ekegusii: “Rirube mwatoma gocha asetore riasomirwe buya asende, nariigure.
english: The letter you sent us has been read and translated in my presence.

ekegusii: Abagerisoni, chiamate chinde chi’Abalawi, bakaegwa korwa ase ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase Golani o Basani, omochie abaiti ba mosiabano baare gotamera, na Besitera, emechie ebere, amo namarisio arengeo.
english: The Levite clans of the Gershonites were given: from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan (a city of refuge for one accused of murder) and Be Eshtarah, together with their pasturelands-- two towns;

ekegusii: Abalawi na Abayuda bonsi bagakora onsi koreng’ana buna Yehoyada omokuani abachigete. Kera oyomo akarenta abanto baye, baria barenge gokora emeremo ase rituko ri’Esabato, na baria barenge korua ase emeremo ase rituko riria, ekiagera Yehoyada omokuani tabaete ribaga bagende.
english: The Levites and all the men of Judah did just as Jehoiada the priest ordered. Each one took his men-- those who were going on duty on the Sabbath and those who were going off duty-- for Jehoiada the priest had not released any of the divisions.

ekegusii: Abalawi mbaetanane omoruoti, kera oyomo abe obwate ebirwanero biaye koboko kwaye; na monto onde bwensi orasoe ase enyomba eria goika aitwe akwe. Mobe amo nomoruoti aase ande onsi akogenda na koirana.”
english: The Levites are to station themselves around the king, each man with his weapons in his hand. Anyone who enters the temple must be put to death. Stay close to the king wherever he goes."

ekegusii: Abalawi bagaeta ase egati y’abanto, bakabakiria, bagoteba, “Kabe nobotoereru, ekiagera rituko eri nerichenu, timobaisa koba nomoichano.”
english: The Levites calmed all the people, saying, "Be still, for this is a sacred day. Do not grieve."

ekegusii: Abalawi bagakora buna Musa abatebetie, na abanto chilifu isato bagaitwa ase rituko erio.
english: The Levites did as Moses commanded, and that day about three thousand of the people died.

ekegusii: Abalawi bagatiga amarisio abo, ne chinka chiabo, bakagenda ase ense y’Abayuda na Yerusalemu, ekiagera Yeroboamu amo nabamura baye nigo babaseretie korwa ase obokoreri bwabo bw’obokuani bw’Omonene.
english: The Levites even abandoned their pasturelands and property, and came to Judah and Jerusalem because Jeroboam and his sons had rejected them as priests of the LORD.

ekegusii: Abalawi bonsi abamenyete ase omochie oyio omochenu nigo barenge amagana abere, na emerongo etano na etato, na bane (284).
english: The Levites in the holy city totaled 284.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bagatenena, kera oyomo aase aye, na Yesua na Bani, Serebia na Yamini, Akubu na Sabetai, Hodia na Maaseya, Kelita na Asaria, Yosabadi na Hanani, na Pelaya, amo n’Abalawi bande bakorokereria abanto amachiko.
english: The Levites-- Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan and Pelaiah-- instructed the people in the Law while the people were standing there.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Abalawi tibaganeirie kobogoria Eema gose ebinto binde bionsi bi’obokoreri bw’Eema eria.”
english: the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle or any of the articles used in its service."

ekegusii: Abalawi bagechena korwa ase ebibe na bagasibia chianga chiabo, na Haroni akabaatanana bakaba buna ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende agakora okobwatanigwa asebare, na kobachena.
english: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Then Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD and made atonement for them to purify them.

ekegusii: The Levites shall recite to all the people of Israel in a loud voice:
english: Na Abalawi bakwane amang’ana aya neriogi rinene, erinde Abaisraeli bonsi bayaigwe:

ekegusii: Abalawi abarenge nemiaka emerongo etato na goetania bakabarwa, na omobaro obo okaba chilifu emerongo etato na isano na isato (38,000).
english: The Levites thirty years old or more were counted, and the total number of men was thirty-eight thousand.

ekegusii: Abalawi bakarusia Esanduku eria y’Omonene, amo nesanduku eria ende yabekire amo, eyarenge nemegwekano eria y’etahabu, bagachibeka igoro ase rigena riria rinene. Erio ase rituko riria abanto ba Beti‐Semesi bakaruera Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde.
english: The Levites took down the ark of the LORD, together with the chest containing the gold objects, and placed them on the large rock. On that day the people of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and made sacrifices to the LORD.

ekegusii: Abalawi nabwo aba: Yesua na Binui, na Kadimieli, na Serebia, na Yuda, na Matania, oyio amo nabanto b’eamate yaye nabwo batenenerete emeremo y’amatera ay’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono.
english: The Levites were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and also Mattaniah, who, together with his associates, was in charge of the songs of thanksgiving.

ekegusii: Korende Abalawi nigo baratenenie chiema chiabo chietanane Obomenyo obwo bore noborori, na komenyao, erinde endamwamu yane etangwe tebaisa kogwera omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli. Abalawi barende Obomenyo obwo bore noborori.”
english: The Levites, however, are to set up their tents around the tabernacle of the Testimony so that wrath will not fall on the Israelite community. The Levites are to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the Testimony."

ekegusii: Abalawi barabwo tibakoegwa egetari gi’ense amo nainwe, ekiagera egetari kiabo nokomokorera Omonene ase emeremo y’obokuani. Egesaku kia Gadi, na ekia Reuben na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase barabwo konya baeirwe omwando obo moocha ya Yorodan, omwando oria Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaatananerete.”
english: The Levites, however, do not get a portion among you, because the priestly service of the LORD is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan. Moses the servant of the LORD gave it to them."

ekegusii: Abalawi barabwo tibabaretwe amo n’Abaisraeli bande, ekiagera nabo Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: The Levites, however, were not counted along with the other Israelites, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: The Levites: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,
english: Abalawi nabwo aba: Yesua, mosinto bw’Asania, na Binui bw’eamate ya Henadadi, na Kadimeli;

ekegusii: The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua (through Kadmiel through the line of Hodaviah) 74
english: Abalawi nabwo aba: Abe chiamate chia Yesua o Kadimeli, ab’ororeria rwa Hodawia: emerongo etano na ebere, na bane (74).

ekegusii: The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua and Kadmiel (through the line of Hodaviah) 74
english: Abalawi nabwo aba: Abe chiamate chia Yesua na Kadimeli, ab’ororeria rwa Hodawia: emerongo etano na ebere, na bane (74).

ekegusii: Obogima obwo bokaorokigwa, na intwe tokaborora na kobobera kirori; na intwe igo tokabarareria inwe obogima obwo bwa kare na kare, obwo bwarenge ase Tata na koorokigwa asetore.
english: The life appeared; we have seen it and testify to it, and we proclaim to you the eternal life, which was with the Father and has appeared to us.

ekegusii: Oborabu bore ase obomenyo bwaye nigo borabe omosunte, na etaya yaye ere asare nerimigwe.
english: The light in his tent becomes dark; the lamp beside him goes out.

ekegusii: nonya noborabu bw’etaya tibokomoreka ime asore naende nonya ng’ake; nonya neriogi ri’omonyuomi na eri ’omoriakari takoigugwa ime asore naende nonya ng’ake. Abaonchoreria bao nigo barenge abanene b’ense, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bang’ainetwe ase oborogi bwao.
english: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voice of bridegroom and bride will never be heard in you again. Your merchants were the world's great men. By your magic spell all the nations were led astray.

ekegusii: Oborabu bw’Abaisraeli mboonchoke bobe omorero, na oyore Omochenu obo nabe ekebemberi ki’omorero. Omorero oyio nosambe na gosiria amagwa na amageri ase rituko erimo.
english: The Light of Israel will become a fire, their Holy One a flame; in a single day it will burn and consume his thorns and his briers.

ekegusii: Oborabu bw’abanyene oboronge nigo bokomoreka nomogoko, korende etaya y’abakori amabe nerime.
english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

ekegusii: Noro omobaso obarire ase omosunte, erio omosunte toyorimia.
english: The light shines in the darkness, but the darkness has not understood it.

ekegusii: Korende abana ba Kora barabwo tibaitetwe.)
english: The line of Korah, however, did not die out.

ekegusii: Endo koyarumire, monto ki otari kwoboa? Omonene Nyasae gakwanire, ning’o otari koraria obobani obwo?
english: The lion has roared-- who will not fear? The Sovereign LORD has spoken-- who can but prophesy?

ekegusii: Endo nigo yatandoranete eke yaitete kegaisana chimanwa chiaye; naende egaita ekaa chindo chiaye chiaberi. Nigo yaichoretie amakuruma aye nebi yaitete, ne chingoro chiaye nebi yasakorete.
english: The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled the prey for his mate, filling his lairs with the kill and his dens with the prey.

ekegusii: Endo engotu nekwe ase okoborwa chinyama ekoria. Ne chimanwa chi’endo eaberi nigo chigoserebekana.”
english: The lion perishes for lack of prey, and the cubs of the lioness are scattered.

ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nachinyare koremerwa na koba nenchara, korende abwo bakomorigia Omonene tibakoremerwa kende gionsi kere ekiya.
english: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.

ekegusii: Nonya bakoruma buna endo ere entindi, bakirigwe, na amaino e chindo chinsae nigo akobunwa.
english: The lions may roar and growl, yet the teeth of the great lions are broken.

ekegusii: Chindo chinsae nigo chikoronya ekero chigotwara, chiarigia endagera yabo korwa ase Nyasae.
english: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

ekegusii: Chinkwana chinchenu nchigwenerete koba ase ebikoba bi’omoruoti, na omonwa oye tomocha ekero akonacha ebina.
english: The lips of a king speak as an oracle, and his mouth should not betray justice.

ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bimanyete gokwana amang’ana agwanchwa, korende omonwa bw’omokori amabe nigo ogokwana ayatagwenereti.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting, but the mouth of the wicked only what is perverse.

ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’omonyene oboronge nigo bikorenta amaya ase abanto abange, korende abariri nigo bagokwa, ekiagera baborirwe okomanya.
english: The lips of the righteous nourish many, but fools die for lack of judgment.

ekegusii: Ebikoba bi’abang’aini nigo bikoraria chisemi, korende chinkoro chi’abariri tichiri gokora bo.
english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so the hearts of fools.

ekegusii: the little owl, the cormorant, the great owl,
english: enyakweumia, na endubi, na ebarara;

ekegusii: the little owl, the great owl, the white owl,
english: enyakweumia enke na enene, na etibibi;

ekegusii: Naki enibo yao nigo yarenge enke ritang’ani ekero ntaracha aa, korende bono yamentekanire mono. Omonene ogosesenirie aande onsi nabeire nkogenda. Korende bono indi ndabe nkoroisia amang’ana a bwone inche omonyene?”
english: The little you had before I came has increased greatly, and the LORD has blessed you wherever I have been. But now, when may I do something for my own household?"

ekegusii: Omonto ore moyo nere orakoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono, buna inche ngokoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase rituko ria rero; ise abana nere agokora obwegenwa bwao bwamanyekana ase abana baye.
english: The living, the living-- they praise you, as I am doing today; fathers tell their children about your faithfulness.

ekegusii: Ase ebieni biabo chingige chiria nigo chiagwekaine chibarasi chibekire ang’e ase esegi. Ase emetwe yabo nigo chiarenge nebinto bikororekana buna chigutwa chie chitahabu, na amasio abo nigo agwekaine amasio a mwanyabanto.
english: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore something like crowns of gold, and their faces resembled human faces.

ekegusii: Okororekana kw’amaiso abo kwababereire kirori; nigo bakoraria ebibe biabo buna Abasodomu bakorete, tibari kobibisa. Obobe nobwabo! Barabwo abanyene berenteire obobe obwo.
english: The look on their faces testifies against them; they parade their sin like Sodom; they do not hide it. Woe to them! They have brought disaster upon themselves.

ekegusii: Naende omorendi oria akaira amang’ana, agateba, “Naika asebare, korende tari koirana gocha. Okogendia egari kwabo nigo konga buna okwa Yehu, mosinto o Nimusi, ekiagera ere nigo akominyokia egari buna ebarimo.”
english: The lookout reported, "He has reached them, but he isn't coming back either. The driving is like that of Jehu son of Nimshi-- he drives like a madman."

ekegusii: Ekerengero ki’oborito ki’obong’ainereria nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende egi’ekeene nigo gekomogokia.
english: The LORD abhors dishonest scales, but accurate weights are his delight.

ekegusii: Omonene akarentera omoruoti oborwaire bwa ukoma bokaba bomoriete goika rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye. Ase igo omoruoti akamenya enyomba ere bweka ao. Yotamu, omwana oye omomura, akaba omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’obogambi, akagambera abanto b’ense eria.
english: The LORD afflicted the king with leprosy until the day he died, and he lived in a separate house. Jotham the king's son had charge of the palace and governed the people of the land.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Nintome ebuku eyio ase enyomba y’omoibi, na ase enyomba y’oyo ogotiana ogotiana kw’oborimo ase erieta riane; ebuku eyio nebeere ase chinyomba chi’abanto abwo echisirie kegima, chibao chiabo amo namagena abo.”
english: The LORD Almighty declares, 'I will send it out, and it will enter the house of the thief and the house of him who swears falsely by my name. It will remain in his house and destroy it, both its timbers and its stones.'"

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda ochikire rituko erimo arasirie abwo bonsi bare abaenenu na abamwenu, na bonsi abakweimokereria igoro mbairanigwe inse.
english: The LORD Almighty has a day in store for all the proud and lofty, for all that is exalted (and they will be humbled),

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda otianire ase inche inyigwete ogoteba, “Ekeene, chinyomba chinyinge, chinene ne chingiya, goika chitigare bosa chitamenyiri nabanto.
english: The LORD Almighty has declared in my hearing: "Surely the great houses will become desolate, the fine mansions left without occupants.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nere onyorokirie amang’ana ayio na gontebia, “Ekeene, timokwaberwa ebibe ebio nonya ng’ake.” Omonene bw’Emeganda otebire ayio.
english: The LORD Almighty has revealed this in my hearing: "Till your dying day this sin will not be atoned for," says the Lord, the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda bwetianirie ogoteba: Ekeene, ninkorentere abanto abange mono buna chingige, bachiche gokorwania, na barabwo nabakobue na baake eriogi ri’obobui.”
english: The LORD Almighty has sworn by himself: I will surely fill you with men, as with a swarm of locusts, and they will shout in triumph over you.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda otianire, ogoteba, “Ekeene, buna narobeirie, nabo arabe, na buna nachikire, goika aikerane.
english: The LORD Almighty has sworn, "Surely, as I have planned, so it will be, and as I have purposed, so it will stand.

ekegusii: Korende inwe tiga inche Omonene bw’Emeganda imbe nchenegete asemore; ninche bweka morairoke na konyoboa.
english: The LORD Almighty is the one you are to regard as holy, he is the one you are to fear, he is the one you are to dread,

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo are amo naintwe, Nyasae o Yakobo nere obotamero bwaito.
english: The LORD Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nere oroberetie ayio ase okoiyeria inse oboenenu bw’obonene na gochaya abanene bonsi b’ense.
english: The LORD Almighty planned it, to bring low the pride of all glory and to humble all who are renowned on the earth.

ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene bw’Emeganda nabasesenie, atebe: “Imosesenirie inwe Abamisiri, abamore abanto baane, nainwe Abaasuri, abamore emeremo y’amaboko aane, nainwe Abaisraeli, abamore omwando one.”
english: The LORD Almighty will bless them, saying, "Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria my handiwork, and Israel my inheritance."

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda naake abanto bao ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw’ense, na egeturi ekenene, na ekerambauti, na embura omoubera, na amasaria ’omorero ogosamba.
english: the LORD Almighty will come with thunder and earthquake and great noise, with windstorm and tempest and flames of a devouring fire.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ninyimokererie omocharichi one igoro, ng’wanie barabwo, buna nang’wanetie Abamidiani agwo ase egetare ki’Orebu. Ninyimokererie enyimbo yaane igoro y’enyancha, buna nakorete igoro y’Abamisiri.
english: The LORD Almighty will lash them with a whip, as when he struck down Midian at the rock of Oreb; and he will raise his staff over the waters, as he did in Egypt.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteba iga, “Rora, nkorenta nde egesusuro igoro ase Amoni, enyasae ya Tebesi, na ase Farao na Misiri, na ase chinyasae chi’ense eyio, na ase abaruoti b’aroro, na ase Farao omonyene, na ase abanto bonsi baria bamosemeretie.
english: The LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "I am about to bring punishment on Amon god of Thebes, on Pharaoh, on Egypt and her gods and her kings, and on those who rely on Pharaoh.

ekegusii: “Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nabasimegete, korende bono nachikire amabe abachere, ekiagera inwe Abaisraeli na Abayuda mwangechirie namabe aino ay’ogosamba ubani ase Baali nkaba nendamwamu.”
english: The LORD Almighty, who planted you, has decreed disaster for you, because the house of Israel and the house of Judah have done evil and provoked me to anger by burning incense to Baal.

ekegusii: Omonene bweka omonyene nere obaraaete, na enyasae engeni tiyarenge amo nere.”
english: The LORD alone led him; no foreign god was with him.

ekegusii: Omonene akabeka omochie oyio amo nomoruoti oye ase amakobo ’Abaisraeli. Bagaita nemioro abanto bonsi pi b’omochie oyio; onde tatooregete nonya noyomo. Naende agakora omoruoti bw’aroro buna akorete omoruoti o Yeriko.
english: The LORD also gave that city and its king into Israel's hand. The city and everyone in it Joshua put to the sword. He left no survivors there. And he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
english: The LORD also said to Moses,

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agatebia Musa,
english: The LORD also said to Moses,

ekegusii: Omonene akarua ogochika, na omoganda omonene bw’abakungu bakararia amang’ana ayio:
english: The Lord announced the word, and great was the company of those who proclaimed it:

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akamoiraneria, “Inwe abang’ainereria, Inee, kera oyomo oino tari gosibora eng’ombe yaye gose etigere yaye korwa bweri ase rituko ri’Esabato, ogenda nero koyenyoisia?
english: The Lord answered him, "You hypocrites! Doesn't each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it out to give it water?

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Inee! Nigo oroche ng’a okoboko kwane nokweng’e? Bono norore gose amang’ana aane naikeranigwe asore, gose yaya.”
english: The LORD answered Moses, "Is the LORD's arm too short? You will now see whether or not what I say will come true for you."

ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, akamotebia, “Oire amo naye abagaaka bande b’Abaisraeli, amo nenyimbo yao, eria kwaagete orooche, motang’ane abanto mogende.
english: The LORD answered Moses, "Walk on ahead of the people. Take with you some of the elders of Israel and take in your hand the staff with which you struck the Nile, and go.

ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Inche nimbe amo naye, naye noite Abamidiani buna nigo bare omonto oyomo.”
english: The LORD answered, "I will be with you, and you will strike down all the Midianites together."

ekegusii: Omonene akabairaneria, “Abayuda mbabe abatang’ani kogenda; rora, nabekire ense eria ase amaboko abo.”
english: The LORD answered, "Judah is to go; I have given the land into their hands."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Samweli, “Igwera amang’ana abo, obachorere omoruoti.” Erio Samweli agatebia Abaisraeli bairane, kera omonto ase omochie oye.
english: The LORD answered, "Listen to them and give them a king." Then Samuel said to the men of Israel, "Everyone go back to his town."

ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Ning’o rende ore omosomba omwegenwa, naende ore omong’aini, omonene oye arabeke igoro ase enyomba yaye yonsi, ae abanto endagera ekerengo kiabo ase ekero kegwenerete?
english: The Lord answered, "Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their food allowance at the proper time?

ekegusii: Omonene akaorokera Ibrahimu ase emete enga buna emetontera agwo Mamure, ekero ere aikaransete gesieri ki’eema yaye, engaki y’omobaso omororo.
english: The LORD appeared to Abraham near the great trees of Mamre while he was sitting at the entrance to his tent in the heat of the day.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akamoorokera Aburamu, akamotebia, “Ning’ee ororeria rwao ense eye ebe omwando obo.” Ase igo Aburamu akaagachera Omonene egesasimero agwo, Omonene oyo omoorokerete.
english: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, "To your offspring I will give this land." So he built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.

ekegusii: Omonene akamoorokera eria kabere buna amoorokerete agwo Gibeoni ritang’ani.
english: the LORD appeared to him a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaorokera Sulemani ase obotuko, akamotebia, “Naigure ogosaba kwao, nechoreire aase aiga abe enyomba y’okoruerwa kw’ebing’wanso.
english: the LORD appeared to him at night and said: "I have heard your prayer and have chosen this place for myself as a temple for sacrifices.

ekegusii: Na Omonene akaorokera Isaka, akamotebia, “Totirimboka gochia Misiri, korende omenye ase ense eye ndagotebie.
english: The LORD appeared to Isaac and said, "Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land where I tell you to live.

ekegusii: inche Omonene nkabaorokera korwa aare. Nabeire mbanchete nobwanchani bwa kare na kare. Ase ayio obuya bwane bwa botambe bwabang’usire.
english: The LORD appeared to us in the past, saying: "I have loved you with an everlasting love; I have drawn you with loving-kindness.

ekegusii: Omonene agasukia Abafilisti na Abaarabu, abwo bare ang’e n’Abaetiopia, bakarwania Yehoramu esegi.
english: The LORD aroused against Jehoram the hostility of the Philistines and of the Arabs who lived near the Cushites.

ekegusii: Omonene abe amo nomoyo oo. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.
english: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.

ekegusii: Omonene akaba nendamwamu ase Sulemani, ekiagera enkoro yaye yaonchogete korwa asare ere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oria omoorokerete ara kabere,
english: The LORD became angry with Solomon because his heart had turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.

ekegusii: Omonene agasesenia amatuko a nyuma ay’Ayubu kobua aye ritang’ani. Boigo Ayubu akanyora ching’ondi chilifu ikomi na inye, ne chingamia chilifu isano nemo, ne chiombe chilifu ibere, ne chitigere chiaberi elifu eyemo.
english: The LORD blessed the latter part of Job's life more than the first. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen and a thousand donkeys.

ekegusii: Omonene naagache Yerusalemu naende, nasangererie amo Abaisraeli abwo baserebanetigwe.
english: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the exiles of Israel.

ekegusii: Omonene akarangeria Samweli eria gatato. Ere akaimoka, akagenda ase Eli, akamotebia, “Nao inde aa. Aye nigo kwandangeria.” Erio Eli akamanya ng’a n’Omonene okorangeria omwana oria.
english: The LORD called Samuel a third time, and Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, "Here I am; you called me." Then Eli realized that the LORD was calling the boy.

ekegusii: Omonene akarangeria Musa, agakwana nere korwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, akamotebia,
english: The LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting. He said,

ekegusii: Agwo kare inche Omonene nigo nabarogete” “Omozeituni omobese obwate amazeituni amaya”, korende bono narentire okogukura okonene na koyotongia omorero, ne chinsagia chiaye chiyie chisareke.
english: The LORD called you a thriving olive tree with fruit beautiful in form. But with the roar of a mighty storm he will set it on fire, and its branches will be broken.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agacha, agatenena aria, akarangeria buna chingaki chinde, “Samweli! Samweli!” Samweli agaitaba, “Kwana. Inche, omosomba oo, ninyigwete.”
english: The LORD came and stood there, calling as at the other times, "Samuel! Samuel!" Then Samuel said, "Speak, for your servant is listening."

ekegusii: Erio agatochika ng’a toigwere amachiko aya onsi, na koiroka Omonene, Nyasae oito, erio nario erabe buya asetore botambe. Toise gokora bo ere natorende, buna atorendete goika rero iga, naintwe natogenderere koba moyo.
english: The LORD commanded us to obey all these decrees and to fear the LORD our God, so that we might always prosper and be kept alive, as is the case today.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omosani bw’abanto bamoirogete, nigo akobamanyia okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.
english: The LORD confides in those who fear him; he makes his covenant known to them.

ekegusii: Omonene akagenderera kweorokia agwo Silo, akeorokia ase Samweli goetera ase ring’ana riaye. Na ekero Samweli arenge gokwana, Abaisraeli bonsi nigo barenge gotegerera.
english: The LORD continued to appear at Shiloh, and there he revealed himself to Samuel through his word.

ekegusii: Omonene akabua Ababenjamin ase obosio bw’Abaisraeli; nabarabwo bagaita Ababenjamin chilifu emerongo ebere na isano, ne rigana erimo, ase rituko riria. Abanto abwo bonsi baitetwe nigo bamanyete korwanera emioro.
english: The LORD defeated Benjamin before Israel, and on that day the Israelites struck down 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.

ekegusii: korende nigo agokirie nabanto abwo bamoirogete, abwo basemeretie obwanchani bwaye bogendererete botambe.
english: the LORD delights in those who fear him, who put their hope in his unfailing love.

ekegusii: Omonene agaika ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Sinai, akarangeria Musa agende asare, na Musa agatiira gochiao.
english: The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the top of the mountain. So Moses went up

ekegusii: Omonene onachire ase ebirengererio biaye gosaria chindwaki chi’omochie o Sayoni, oramboire engori y’okorengera. Tagotanga okoboko kwaye tayosaria; otigire chiburi ne chindwaki chikweumia, chionsi amo nigo chiumatete.
english: The LORD determined to tear down the wall around the Daughter of Zion. He stretched out a measuring line and did not withhold his hand from destroying. He made ramparts and walls lament; together they wasted away.

ekegusii: Kera omonto ore omoenenu nigo are okogechia ase Omonene; omonto oyio goika aegwe egesusuro.
english: The LORD detests all the proud of heart. Be sure of this: They will not go unpunished.

ekegusii: Ebirengo bi’oborito bire ara kabere nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, na ekerengero gi’okoreng’anania ki’oborimo nigo kere ekebe.
english: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales do not please him.

ekegusii: Ebikoba bigokwana oborimo nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare abegenwa ase ogokora kwabo nigo bakomogokia.
english: The LORD detests lying lips, but he delights in men who are truthful.

ekegusii: Abanto abakorekanu ase chinkoro chiabo nigo bare okogechia ase Omonene, korende abare norogendo ororonge nigo bakomogokia.
english: The LORD detests men of perverse heart but he delights in those whose ways are blameless.

ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ki’abakori amabe nigo kere okogechia ase Omonene, korende ogosaba kw’abare ne chinkoro chindonge nigo gokomogokia.
english: The LORD detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but the prayer of the upright pleases him.

ekegusii: Ebirengererio ebibe nigo bire okogechia ase Omonene, korende amang’ana amaya nigo akomogokia.
english: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but those of the pure are pleasing to him.

ekegusii: Enchera y’omokori amabe nigo ere okogechia ase Omonene, korende nigo anchete oyo okobwatia oboronge.
english: The LORD detests the way of the wicked but he loves those who pursue righteousness.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye Omonene nigo kwarenge nobomaene bw’ogotorentera amaakwa ayio, ekiagera aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo ore omonyene oboronge ase ogokora kwao gwonsi, korende intwe titwaigwerete eriogi riao.
english: The LORD did not hesitate to bring the disaster upon us, for the LORD our God is righteous in everything he does; yet we have not obeyed him.
