ekegusii: “Omonene tang’usetwe nainwe, gose tabachorete ekiagera mwarenge abange kobua abanto bande (inwe nigo mwarenge abake mono kobua abanto bonsi),
english: The LORD did not set his affection on you and choose you because you were more numerous than other peoples, for you were the fewest of all peoples.

ekegusii: Omonene tari gotiga omonyene oboronge abe nenchara; korende nigo akwanga okogania kw’abakori amabe.
english: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.

ekegusii: Kende gionsi Omonene agwancha gokora nigo akogekora; gokerabe ase ense, gose igoro, gose ase enyancha, gose ase chindiba.
english: The LORD does whatever pleases him, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.

ekegusii: Omonene nachake kogambia abagaaka na abagambi b’abanto baye, atebe, “Ninwe mwarire omogondo one bw’emesabibu, na ebisakorwa bi’abataka nigo bire ase chinyomba chiaino.
english: The LORD enters into judgment against the elders and leaders of his people: "It is you who have ruined my vineyard; the plunder from the poor is in your houses.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene agakora oboruoti bwaye bokaba ne chinguru ase okoboko kwaye, na Abayuda bonsi bakamorentera ebiegwa, ere akaba nobonda obonge na amasikani amanene.
english: The LORD established the kingdom under his control; and all Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, so that he had great wealth and honor.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorenga abare abaronge na abakori amabe, korende omoyo oye nogechete abakori amabe na abagokorera abande obotindi.
english: The LORD examines the righteous, but the wicked and those who love violence his soul hates.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoonchorana emeroberio y’abanto b’ebisaku, na gosaria okogamba kwa mwanyabanto kwaba bosa.
english: The LORD foils the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.

ekegusii: Omonene akang’a chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena Nyasae arigete nekiara kiaye. Nigo chiarikire amang’ana onsi Omonene konya akwanire nainwe agwo ase egetunwa korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, ekero mwasangererekanete aroro.
english: The LORD gave me two stone tablets inscribed by the finger of God. On them were all the commandments the LORD proclaimed to you on the mountain out of the fire, on the day of the assembly.

ekegusii: Omonene akaa Sulemani obong’aini buna amorierete eira. Omorembe okaba ase egati ya Hiramu na Sulemani, na aba babere bagakora okobwatana gw’okoigwana.
english: The LORD gave Solomon wisdom, just as he had promised him. There were peaceful relations between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.

ekegusii: Omonene akabaa obotoereru ase chinsemo chionsi, buna arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ase ogotiana. Onde tarenge ase ababisa babo obabuete, ekiagera Omonene abegete ababisa babo bonsi ase amaboko abo.
english: The LORD gave them rest on every side, just as he had sworn to their forefathers. Not one of their enemies withstood them; the LORD handed all their enemies over to them.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akamwatanana Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, akamotebia, “Otenene bokong’u, obe noboremu, ekiagera naye orabaire Abaisraeli ase ense eria nabarierete eira ng’a nimbayee. Inche nimbe amo naye.”
english: The LORD gave this command to Joshua son of Nun: "Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the Israelites into the land I promised them on oath, and I myself will be with you."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoramokia emeuko amaiso na kogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse. Omonene nigo anchete abanyaboronge.
english: the LORD gives sight to the blind, the LORD lifts up those who are bowed down, the LORD loves the righteous.

ekegusii: Omonene nae abanto baye chinguru, naende abasesenie ase okobaa omorembe.
english: The LORD gives strength to his people; the LORD blesses his people with peace.

ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae bw’Emeganda. Omonene nario erieta riaye.
english: the LORD God Almighty, the LORD is his name of renown!

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akabomba na koroisia omonto korwa ase orotu rw’amaroba, akamoutera omoika bw’obogima ase chimioro chiaye, na igo omonto akaba ore nobomoyo.
english: the LORD God formed the man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae akaroiseria Adamu na mokaye chingobo chi’amasankwa, akababoyia.
english: The LORD God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and clothed them.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae agateba, “Tai buya omonto oyo abe bweka, nimokorere omokonyi barakonyane nere.”
english: The LORD God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him."

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae akaira omonto oria, akamobeka ase omogondo o Edeni, ayoroisie na koyorenda.
english: The LORD God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.

ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene agatiga abanto b’ebisaku biria bamenyeo, tabaseria bwango, gose tababegete ase amaboko a Yoshua.
english: The LORD had allowed those nations to remain; he did not drive them out at once by giving them into the hands of Joshua.

ekegusii: Naboigo Omonene akorerete abanto b’ororeria rw’Esau, baria bamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa ya Seiri. Agaita Abahori, na Abaesau bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo, nao bamenyete goika rero iga.
english: The LORD had done the same for the descendants of Esau, who lived in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them. They drove them out and have lived in their place to this day.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo aganetie kwororoberia Abayuda ase engencho y’Ahasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, ekiagera ere arenterete Abayuda obosooku na tarenge omwegenwa ase Omonene.
english: The LORD had humbled Judah because of Ahaz king of Israel, for he had promoted wickedness in Judah and had been most unfaithful to the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonene konya oeire abanto abwo ogwancherwa ase Abamisiri, na barabwo bakabaa kende gionsi eki baganetie. Ase enchera eye bagasakora Abamisiri.
english: The LORD had made the Egyptians favorably disposed toward the people, and they gave them what they asked for; so they plundered the Egyptians.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Aburamu, akamotebia, “Karue ase ense eye yao, na ase eamate yao, na ase omochie o iso, ogende goika ense ndakworokie.
english: The LORD had said to Abram, "Leave your country, your people and your father's household and go to the land I will show you.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa. “Farao takobaigwa inwe. Ase ayio ning’orokie amakumia ande ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: The LORD had said to Moses, "Pharaoh will refuse to listen to you-- so that my wonders may be multiplied in Egypt."

ekegusii: ekiagera Omonene nigo atebetie Musa,
english: The LORD had said to Moses:

ekegusii: Omonene nigo aroche emechando y’Abaisraeli ng’a nemenene mono, ngochia koera bare bonsi, omosomba na oyo tari omosomba, naende monto onde tarenge ogokonya Abaisraeli.
english: The LORD had seen how bitterly everyone in Israel, whether slave or free, was suffering; there was no one to help them.

ekegusii: Na Omonene akabeka Lakisi ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli, erio bakayobwata rituko ria kabere, bagaita nemioro abanto bonsi b’omochie, buna bakorete agwo Libuna.
english: The LORD handed Lachish over to Israel, and Joshua took it on the second day. The city and everyone in it he put to the sword, just as he had done to Libnah.

ekegusii: Omonene agakong’ia enkoro ya Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, na ere akabwatia Abaisraeli korwa nyuma, ekero barabwo bang’anyete bare nobomwenu.
english: The LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, so that he pursued the Israelites, who were marching out boldly.

ekegusii: Omonene nabwate amang’ana akwomania Abayuda, nae abanto ba Yakobo egesusuro koreng’ana ne chinchera chiabo, nabaakane koreng’ana nogokora kwabo.
english: The LORD has a charge to bring against Judah; he will punish Jacob according to his ways and repay him according to his deeds.

ekegusii: Omonene okobekire aye Sefania obe omokuani ribaga ria Yehoyada. Bono aye obe omoteneneri ase enyomba y’Omonene obe igoro ya kera omonto okobaboka kobana ng’a omobwate na komosoyia ase rikorogoto na komobekera engataare y’ekioma ase rigoti riaye.
english: 'The LORD has appointed you priest in place of Jehoiada to be in charge of the house of the LORD; you should put any madman who acts like a prophet into the stocks and neck-irons.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae osesenirie omonene one mono, na ere obeire omotenenku. Omoeire amaicho e ching’ondi, na aye chiombe, chifeta ne chitahabu, na abasomba, abamura na abaiseke, chingamia ne chitigere.
english: The LORD has blessed my master abundantly, and he has become wealthy. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, and camels and donkeys.

ekegusii: Omonene obunire enyimbo y’abakori amabe, enyimbo eyio y’abagambi,
english: The LORD has broken the rod of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

ekegusii: Omonene obaitereire inwe omoika bw’okorara chitoro chindito; oukoirie amaiso ’ababani, abwo bare amaiso aino, na otubire emetwe y’abarori, abwo bare emetwe yaino.
english: The LORD has brought over you a deep sleep: He has sealed your eyes (the prophets); he has covered your heads (the seers).

ekegusii: Omonene obeire okong’a egesusuro ekenene gi’okondongeyia, korende tantigeti inkwe.
english: The LORD has chastened me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo ang’ete eng’eria y’obuya, ekiagera inde omoronge, nigo ansesenetie, ekiagera inde namaboko atari na komocha.
english: The LORD has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

ekegusii: Ee, Omonene otokoreire amang’ana amanene; ase ayio ntore nomogoko.
english: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito.
english: the LORD has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes.

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nigo riarure ase Omonene, na rirorio nogokumia ase amaiso aito?”
english: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes'?"

ekegusii: Omonene okorire aya achigete ng’a ayakore, oikeranirie ring’ana riaye aroberetie agwo kare, otagoire atari namabera, otigire ababisa bao bagochenga igoro yao, ere okinirie chingunchara chi’ababisa bao.
english: The LORD has done what he planned; he has fulfilled his word, which he decreed long ago. He has overthrown you without pity, he has let the enemy gloat over you, he has exalted the horn of your foes.

ekegusii: Omonene ogokoreire ayio akwanete goetera asende; okourire oboruoti korwa ase amaboko ao, oboeire omonto omoao, nere Daudi.
english: The LORD has done what he predicted through me. The LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hands and given it to one of your neighbors-- to David.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo abegete ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene aaria igoro, na oboruoti bwaye nigo bokogambera onsi.
english: The LORD has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene achikire igoro yao: “Ororeria tirogotoka roratorwe ase erieta riao. Ninsirie korwa ase enyomba ye chinyasae chiao emegwekano yao ogosasima, eyio ebaachire na eyio ebombire. Ninkoroiserie oboina bwao, ekiagera aye nigo ore omokayayu.”
english: The LORD has given a command concerning you, [Nineveh]: "You will have no descendants to bear your name. I will destroy the carved images and cast idols that are in the temple of your gods. I will prepare your grave, for you are vile."

ekegusii: Omonene oumoire okogechigwa kwaye, ee, oumoire endamwamu yaye entindi; na ase Sayoni otongirie omorero, osambire amaroso aye.
english: The LORD has given full vent to his wrath; he has poured out his fierce anger. He kindled a fire in Zion that consumed her foundations.

ekegusii: Omonene oigure okoboria kwane gw’okonyora amabera, ere bwancheire ogosaba kwane.
english: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.

ekegusii: Omonene okorire ogotooreka kwaye komanyekane, oorokirie oboronge bwaye ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku;
english: The LORD has made his salvation known and revealed his righteousness to the nations.

ekegusii: Naama! Omonene oraririe amang’ana ase ense yonsi, ogoteba: “Tebia abanto ba Sayoni ng’a ogotooreka kwaino kwabereire ang’e; Omonene ngocha are obwate eng’eria yaye, na okonyora kwaye nigo gotang’aine bosio bwaye.”
english: The LORD has made proclamation to the ends of the earth: "Say to the Daughter of Zion, 'See, your Savior comes! See, his reward is with him, and his recompense accompanies him.'"

ekegusii: Naki Omonene nigo akorete orooche rwa Yorodan rokaba orobebe egati yaito nainwe, inwe Abareuben na Abagadi. Ase ayio timori negetari kende gionsi ase Omonene. Na igo abana b’ororeria rwaino mbabaise kogera ab’orwaito tibamoiroka Omonene.
english: The LORD has made the Jordan a boundary between us and you-- you Reubenites and Gadites! You have no share in the LORD.' So your descendants might cause ours to stop fearing the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonene oigoire ase agachete ebirwanero biaye, na ase endamwamu yaye obisokirie, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nabwate emeremo agokora ase ense y’Abakalidayo.
english: The LORD has opened his arsenal and brought out the weapons of his wrath, for the Sovereign LORD Almighty has work to do in the land of the Babylonians.

ekegusii: Omonene obekire omoika bw’obotantanu ase egati y’abanto b’aroro, nabarabwo bakorire ense ya Misiri yatindire ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi, nigo ekogaragara, buna omonto otindire okwegaragaria ase amaroki aye.
english: The LORD has poured into them a spirit of dizziness; they make Egypt stagger in all that she does, as a drunkard staggers around in his vomit.

ekegusii: Omonene bwangire egesasimero kiaye, otigire Aase aye Aachenu asarigwe; otigire chindwaki chiaye ase amaboko ’ababisa. Abanto bakuurire ime ase enyomba y’Omonene, buna nase rituko ri’omosangererekano bw’ogosasima.
english: The Lord has rejected his altar and abandoned his sanctuary. He has handed over to the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwairete oboruoti korwa ase Saulo, na bono Omonene nkoruseria are abanto b’enyomba ya Saulo abwo gwaitete egesiomba. Bono Omonene obekire oboruoti ase okoboko kw’Aibsalomu, omwana oo. Rigereria, obobe bwao bwakoiraneire, aye omoiteri amanyinga.”
english: The LORD has repaid you for all the blood you shed in the household of Saul, in whose place you have reigned. The LORD has handed the kingdom over to your son Absalom. You have come to ruin because you are a man of blood!"

ekegusii: Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera aroche ng’a nomochenu inde.
english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in his sight.

ekegusii: Omonene ong’akanire, ekiagera ngokora ayare boronge, na ekiagera aroche ng’a amaboko aane achenekire.
english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

ekegusii: Omonene otomire ring’ana kogambia ororeria rwa Yakobo, narirorio ndibaikere Abaisraeli.
english: The Lord has sent a message against Jacob; it will fall on Israel.

ekegusii: Omonene oramboire okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha, onyegeirie amaruoti; orure ogochika igoro ya Kanani ng’a chiburi chiaye chitagorwe.
english: The LORD has stretched out his hand over the sea and made its kingdoms tremble. He has given an order concerning Phoenicia that her fortresses be destroyed.

ekegusii: Omonene otianire, takoonchora ebirengererio biaye: “Aye nigo ore omokuani goika kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.”
english: The LORD has sworn and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

ekegusii: Omonene orire eira na gotiana oramborete okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na ase okoboko kwaye gw’okobua, ogoteba: “Tinkorua endagera yao ng’ee ababisa bao bayerie, na abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao tibakonywa edivai yao gwakoreire emeremo emekong’u.
english: The LORD has sworn by his right hand and by his mighty arm: "Never again will I give your grain as food for your enemies, and never again will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled;

ekegusii: Omonene otianire ase Oyore Obonene bw’abanto ba Yakobo, ogoteba, “Ekeene, tinkweba ogokora kwabo nonya ng’ake.
english: The LORD has sworn by the Pride of Jacob: "I will never forget anything they have done.

ekegusii: Omonene orusirie asemore ekina eke konya mwanacheirwe, oseririe ababisa baino. Omonene, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, nigo are ase egati yaino, timokoiroka bobe bonde.
english: The LORD has taken away your punishment, he has turned back your enemy. The LORD, the King of Israel, is with you; never again will you fear any harm.

ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kw’Elija, na obomoyo bw’omwana oria bokamoiranera, ere agacha moyo.
english: The LORD heard Elijah's cry, and the boy's life returned to him, and he lived.

ekegusii: “Omonene nigo aigwete amang’ana aino ekero keria mware gokwana nainche, erio agantebia: Naigure amang’ana abanto abwo bakwanire naye. Ayio onsi bagotebirie, mbuya bakwanire.
english: The LORD heard you when you spoke to me and the LORD said to me, "I have heard what this people said to you. Everything they said was good.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoigwa abanto baria baremeire; ere tari gochaya abanto baye abwo bare ase obosibwa.
english: The LORD hears the needy and does not despise his captive people.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobakonya na kobatooria; nigo akobarusia korwa ase abakori amabe, obatooria, ekiagera bakomotamera.
english: The LORD helps them and delivers them; he delivers them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.

ekegusii: Omonene akaa Sulemani erieta rinene ase egati y’Abaisraeli bonsi, naende akamoa oboruoti bore nobonene obwo ataete omoruoti onde bwensi omotang’anerete agwo ase Abaisraeli.
english: The LORD highly exalted Solomon in the sight of all Israel and bestowed on him royal splendor such as no king over Israel ever had before.

ekegusii: Omonene nere oragotang’ane, nabe amo naye, takogotiga obugwe, gose takogotuguta, Tobaisa koiroka gose kwoboa.”
english: The LORD himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged."

ekegusii: Okobea kw’Omonene kwabasiareire, takobechandera naende; abakuani tibasigetwe, na abagaaka tibaroreretwe amabera.
english: The LORD himself has scattered them; he no longer watches over them. The priests are shown no honor, the elders no favor.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are Nyasae bwe risemi, ere nigo akweruseria egesiomba na koba nendamwamu enene. Omonene nigo akweruseria egesiomba ase abwo bakoamererania nere; nigo akobagachera ababisa baye ekeririanda.
english: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD takes vengeance and is filled with wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his foes and maintains his wrath against his enemies.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are obotamero ase abwo bagokorerwa bobe, nere obotamero ase chingaki chi’emechando.
english: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

ekegusii: Omonene nomorwani bwe chisegi, Omonene nario erieta riaye.
english: The LORD is a warrior; the LORD is his name.

ekegusii: Omonene obeire nendamwamu enene ase ebisaku bionsi, na obeire nekeririanda ase emeganda yabo yonsi y’esegi; obanacheire ekina gi’okobasiria, obarure baitwe.
english: The LORD is angry with all nations; his wrath is upon all their armies. He will totally destroy them, he will give them over to slaughter.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo ateneine ase ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio; ere nasenyente abaruoti ase rituko ri’endamwamu yaye.
english: The Lord is at your right hand; he will crush kings on the day of his wrath.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang’e nabwo chinkoro chiabo chiabunekire, nigo akobatooria abwo berusirie moyo.
english: The LORD is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene amabera na obuya, tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo are nobwanchani botari koera.
english: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonene igoro ase ebisaku bionsi, na obonene bwaye nigo boetanaine igoro chionsi.
english: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, his glory above the heavens.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo aimokererete igoro, ekiagera nigo amenyete igoro mono; naichorie Sayoni nekeene na oboronge.
english: The LORD is exalted, for he dwells on high; he will fill Zion with justice and righteousness.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are aare korwa ase abakori amabe, korende nigo akoigwa ogosaba kw’abanyene oboronge.
english: The LORD is far from the wicked but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

ekegusii: Omonene nere Nyasae, ere otoeire omobaso. Bogoria chinsagia chi’emete, mochake rituko rinene, mogende gochia ase egesasimero kere nemegwekano ye chingunchara!
english: The LORD is God, and he has made his light shine upon us. With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession up to the horns of the altar.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya ase abanto bonsi, naende nigo are namabera ase ebitongwa biaye bionsi.
english: The LORD is good to all; he has compassion on all he has made.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omuya ase onde bwensi omoganyete, ee, nomuya ase oyo okomorigia.
english: The LORD is good to those whose hope is in him, to the one who seeks him;

ekegusii: Omonene nomuya; ere neburi enkong’u ase engaki y’emechando, nigo abamanyete abwo bakomotamera.
english: The LORD is good, a refuge in times of trouble. He cares for those who trust in him,

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobwanchani obonge, na amabera amange; tari omwango ase okoba nendamwamu, nigo aichire nobwanchani bogendererete botambe.
english: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are nobuya na oboronge; Nyasae oito nigo are omonyene amabera.
english: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ase Hekalu yaye enchenu, ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene naaria igoro kere. Amaiso aye nigo amongerete, nigo arigereretie ase okorenga mwanyabanto.
english: The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD is on his heavenly throne. He observes the sons of men; his eyes examine them.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omoruoti o kare na kare; abanto b’Ebisaku batamomanyeti basirigwe ase ense yaye.
english: The LORD is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.

ekegusii: Omonene bwemanyekanirie ase okonacha ebina bia boronge; abakori amabe babwatirwe ase ogokora kwabo abanyene.
english: The LORD is known by his justice; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion. Selah

ekegusii: Omonene obeire buna omobisa, osiririe Abaisraeli; osiririe chinyomba chiaye chionsi chi’oboruoti, otagoire chiburi chiaye chinkong’u; naende omenteire abanto ba Yuda okorera na okweumia.
english: The Lord is like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds. He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah.

ekegusii: Omonene nere egetare kiane na eburi yane enkong’u, nere Omotooria one, na Nyasae one, Nyasae one nere egetare kiane ndatamere; nere enguba egonkengera, na Omotooria one bwe chinguru, oyo ogonkengera bokong’u.
english: The LORD is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge. He is my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

ekegusii: Omonene nere chinguru chiane na enguba yane; nere nsemeretie ase enkoro yane, ere nankonyete. Ase ayio ninde nomosasoko ase enkoro yane; nimbe nkomoterera na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono.
english: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and I am helped. My heart leaps for joy and I will give thanks to him in song.

ekegusii: Omonene nere chinguru chiane na ogotera kwane, obeire ogotooreka kwane.
english: The LORD is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.

ekegusii: “Omonene nere chinguru chiane, nimoterere ere, ere nogotooreka kwane. Ere Nyasae one, nimotogie; ere Nyasae o tata, ninterere obonene bwaye.
english: The LORD is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise him, my father's God, and I will exalt him.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ang’e ase abanto abwo bakomorangeria; abwo bonsi bakomorangeria ase ekeene.
english: The LORD is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

ekegusii: Omonene tagotebana goikerania, eira yaye, buna abande bakagete ng’a otebanire, korende nigo aremereretie ase engencho yaino, tancheti monto onde bwensi asire, korende bonsi baikere okoonchoka.
english: The Lord is not slow in keeping his promise, as some understand slowness. He is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are omonyene oboronge ase chinchera chiaye chionsi, na omuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
english: The LORD is righteous in all his ways and loving toward all he has made.

ekegusii: Omonene tari omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, korende nigo are nokobua okonene; tari gotiga koa abamochi egesusuro. Enchera y’Omonene nigo ere ase omwaga na ekembugu‐mbugu; na amare nigo are orotu rw’amagoro aye.
english: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power; the LORD will not leave the guilty unpunished. His way is in the whirlwind and the storm, and clouds are the dust of his feet.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene tindi omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, nigo inde omonyene amabera, naende nigo inde nobwanchani botari koera. Nigo nkwabera amamocho na ogosaria, korende tingotiga koa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato, na egia kane, ase engencho y’amabe ’abaibori babo.
english: 'The LORD is slow to anger, abounding in love and forgiving sin and rebellion. Yet he does not leave the guilty unpunished; he punishes the children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation.'

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are chinguru ase abanto baye, na obotamero bw’ogotooreka ase omoakwa amaguta oye.
english: The LORD is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are ase ensemo yane; ningoke ase engencho y’okobugwa kw’abwo bangechete.
english: The LORD is with me; he is my helper. I will look in triumph on my enemies.

ekegusii: Omonene kare ase ensemo yane, tinkonyara kwoboa. Mwanyabanto ninki baranyare gonkorera?
english: The LORD is with me; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

ekegusii: Omonene nigo amanyete ebirengererio bia mwanyabanto, ng’a nigo bire bosa.
english: The LORD knows the thoughts of man; he knows that they are futile.

ekegusii: Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kw’Abaisraeli, akabaa obobui igoro y’Abakanani. Abaisraeli bakabasiria kegima, bagasaria nemechie yabo. Ase igo aase aria akarokwa Horima (Ogosarigwa).
english: The LORD listened to Israel's plea and gave the Canaanites over to them. They completely destroyed them and their towns; so the place was named Hormah.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo are moyo! Ere oyore egetare kiane atogigwe! Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane aimokererigwe igoro.
english: The LORD lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be God my Savior!

ekegusii: Omonene nigo arigereretie mwanyabanto korwa igoro, arore gose monto onde nareo ore omong’aini, oyokomorigia Nyasae.
english: The LORD looks down from heaven on the sons of men to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

ekegusii: Ere nigo anchete ayare boronge na ekeene, na ense nigo eichire nobwanchani bw’Omonene botari koera.
english: The LORD loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of his unfailing love.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo anchete ebiita bia Sayoni kobua aande onsi ase abanto ba Yakobo bamenyete.
english: the LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

ekegusii: Omonene agasesenia abanto abwo bakabucha mono, naende bakaba ne chinguru chinyinge kobua abachandi babo.
english: The LORD made his people very fruitful; he made them too numerous for their foes,

ekegusii: Omonene abaraberie obosio bwaye, abaabere;
english: the LORD make his face shine upon you and be gracious to you;

ekegusii: Omonene akamoorokera Baalamu, akamotebia amang’ana arenge gochia gokwana, naende akamotoma airane ase Balaki namang’ana ayio ayio.
english: The LORD met with Balaam and put a message in his mouth and said, "Go back to Balak and give him this message."

ekegusii: korende Omonene, Nyasae oito, akamobeka ase amaboko aito, ere amo nabamura baye, na abanto baye bonsi, na intwe tokababua.
english: the LORD our God delivered him over to us and we struck him down, together with his sons and his whole army.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo obwate amabera, naende nigo ogotwabera, nonya twasaririe asore.
english: The Lord our God is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against him;

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oito, nakorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo naintwe agwo Horebu.
english: The LORD our God made a covenant with us at Horeb.

ekegusii: Ekero twarenge ase egetunwa kia Horebu, Omonene, Nyasae oito, agakwana naintwe, agatotebia, “Mwabeire mokobeera aiga ase egetunwa eke engaki entambe eisaine.
english: The LORD our God said to us at Horeb, "You have stayed long enough at this mountain.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akorenda abanto abakanyeku; ekero nabete nemechando, nigo antooretie.
english: The LORD protects the simplehearted; when I was in great need, he saved me.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akaa Abaisraeli omotooria, obatooretie korwa ase amaboko ’Abasiiria. Nyuma y’ayio Abaisraeli bakagenderera komenya ase chinka chiabo buna agwo ritang’ani.
english: The LORD provided a deliverer for Israel, and they escaped from the power of Aram. So the Israelites lived in their own homes as they had before.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Baalamu ring’ana agochia gokwana. Naende akamotoma airane ase Balaki namang’ana ayio ayio.
english: The LORD put a message in Balaam's mouth and said, "Go back to Balak and give him this message."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobooria emioyo y’abasomba baye, gose onde tari ase abwo bakomotamera orache kogambigwa.
english: The LORD redeems his servants; no one will be condemned who takes refuge in him.

ekegusii: Omonene nagambe goika kare na kare; aye Sayoni, Nyasae oo nagambere ebiaare bionsi.
english: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo are omoruoti o kare na kare, obekire ang’e ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, erinde anache ekina.
english: The LORD reigns forever; he has established his throne for judgment.

ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba, nigo eboetie obonene. Omonene nigo asiberanetie chinguru. Ase ayio ense nigo eteneine bokong’u tekonyegerigwa.
english: The LORD reigns, he is robed in majesty; the LORD is robed in majesty and is armed with strength. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

ekegusii: Omonene nere omoruoti. Aye ense, goka! Na inwe ebisinka ebinge, chenga!
english: The LORD reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.

ekegusii: Omonene nere okogamba! Ase ayio, abanto b’ebisaku nigo bakoiguswa. Omonene nigo amenyete nobonene bwaye igoro y’abakerubi, na ense nigo egotengechigwa.
english: The LORD reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.

ekegusii: Omonene obeire ogotoinyora, natosesenie; nasesenie Abaisraeli, nasesenie nab’ororeria rwa Haroni.
english: The LORD remembers us and will bless us: He will bless the house of Israel, he will bless the house of Aaron,

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Onye rende ise arenge komotwera amate ase obosio bwaye, Inee, tagwenerete anyore obosooku ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere? Tiga aatananwe korwa ase egetwori abekwe aase aao ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, na nyuma y’ayio airanigwe ase egetwori.”
english: The LORD replied to Moses, "If her father had spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Confine her outside the camp for seven days; after that she can be brought back."

ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Musa, “Omonto oria onkoreire ebibe, nere ndatinyie erieta riaye korwa ase ebuku yane.
english: The LORD replied to Moses, "Whoever has sinned against me I will blot out of my book.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Tirimboka gochia inse, orente Haroni, motiire nere gocha aa. Korende abakuani na abanto tibabaisa gotamboka orobebe gocha aa asende, mbaise kobaa egesusuro.”
english: The LORD replied, "Go down and bring Aaron up with you. But the priests and the people must not force their way through to come up to the LORD, or he will break out against them."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agateba, “Nabaabeire koreng’ana buna gwansabire.
english: The LORD replied, "I have forgiven them, as you asked.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Inche omonyene nigo ndagende amo naye, ninkoe obotoereru.”
english: The LORD replied, "My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest."

ekegusii: Omonene akabairaneria, “Inee! Tinabatooretie korwa ase Abamisiri, na Abaamori, na Abafilisti?
english: The LORD replied, "When the Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, the Philistines,

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoakana kera omonto buna oboronge bwaye bore, na obwegenwa boigo. Ase rituko ria rero Omonene nigo akobegete ase okoboko kwane, korende nkaanga korambora okoboko kwane igoro ase omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.
english: The LORD rewards every man for his righteousness and faithfulness. The LORD delivered you into my hands today, but I would not lay a hand on the LORD's anointed.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana goetera ase abasomba baye ababani, agateba,
english: The LORD said through his servants the prophets:

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Haroni, “Genda gochia ase erooro orotote Musa.” Erio akagenda, akaumerana nere ase egetunwa kia Nyasae, akamonyunyunta.
english: The LORD said to Aaron, "Go into the desert to meet Moses." So he met Moses at the mountain of God and kissed him.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agatebia Haroni, “Aye tokonyora omwando bw’orogongo ase egati y’Abaisraeli bande. Tokoegwa ensemo ende yonsi ase egati yabo. Inche ninche ensemo yao, naende omwando oo, ase egati y’Abaisraeli.
english: The LORD said to Aaron, "You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any share among them; I am your share and your inheritance among the Israelites.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Haroni, “Aye na abamura bao amo nabanto b’eamate yaino nigo morabarerwe okomocha konde gwonsi korabe kogokorerwa ase obokoreri ime y’Aase Aachenu, naende aye na abamura bao inamobarerwe okomocha konde gwonsi korabe kogokorwa ase obokuani bwaino.
english: The LORD said to Aaron, "You, your sons and your father's family are to bear the responsibility for offenses against the sanctuary, and you and your sons alone are to bear the responsibility for offenses against the priesthood.

ekegusii: Nyuma Loti na Aburamu kobaatananekire, Omonene agatebia Aburamu, “Imokia amaiso ao, origererie korwa agwo aase ore, origererie ensemo ya sugusu, na irianyi, na moocha, na bosongo;
english: The LORD said to Abram after Lot had parted from him, "Lift up your eyes from where you are and look north and south, east and west.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Gadi, omorori o Daudi, akamotebia,
english: The LORD said to Gad, David's seer,

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Ase abanto aba amagana atato basiara amache gochia monwa nimbatoorie inwe na kobeka Abamidiani ase amaboko ao, korende tiga abanto bande bonsi bairane, kera oyomo ase enka yaye.”
english: The LORD said to Gideon, "With the three hundred men that lapped I will save you and give the Midianites into your hands. Let all the other men go, each to his own place."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Gidioni, “Abanto abwo bagokobwatia nigo bare abange goetania ntanyare kobeka Abamidiani ase amaboko abo. Aande Abaisraeli nigo barachie gwetogia mamincha yane, na goteba: Amaboko aito intwe abanyene naro atotooretie.
english: The LORD said to Gideon, "You have too many men for me to deliver Midian into their hands. In order that Israel may not boast against me that her own strength has saved her,

ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ebisaku bibere mbire enda yao ime, abanto babere orache koibora, na barabwo mbaatananekane korwa okoiborwa kwabo; oyomo nabe ne chinguru kobua oria onde, oria omonene nakorere oria omoke.”
english: The LORD said to her, "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger."

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Irana, ogende enchera yao goika ase erooro ya Damesiki; na ekero oraike aroro, oake Hasaeli amaguta, omobeke abe omoruoti igoro y’Abasiiria.
english: The LORD said to him, "Go back the way you came, and go to the Desert of Damascus. When you get there, anoint Hazael king over Aram.

ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ning’o oete mwanyabanto omonwa? Ning’o omokorete abe rimama, gose omotino, gose abe okorora, gose omouko? Inee! Tari inche Omonene?
english: The LORD said to him, "Who gave man his mouth? Who makes him deaf or mute? Who gives him sight or makes him blind? Is it not I, the LORD?

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Naigure ogosaba kwao na okoboria kwao kw’oboitongo. Naatananire na gochena enyomba eye kwaagachire, nabekire erieta riane ribe aroro kare na kare. Amaiso aane na enkoro yane mbibe aroro ase chingaki chionsi.
english: The LORD said to him: "I have heard the prayer and plea you have made before me; I have consecrated this temple, which you have built, by putting my Name there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Yehu, “Ekiagera gwakorire buya ase ogokora ayare amaronge ase amaiso aane, naende gwakoreire enyomba y’Ahabu koreng’ana nebirengererio bi’enkoro yane, abana bao goika ekiaare gia kane mbabe bagoikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti ki’Abaisraeli.”
english: The LORD said to Jehu, "Because you have done well in accomplishing what is right in my eyes and have done to the house of Ahab all I had in mind to do, your descendants will sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation."

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akagenderera gokwana, agatebia Ayubu,
english: The LORD said to Job:

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Yoshua, “Toiroka abanto aba, ekiagera ankio, engaki buna eye, nimbarue bonsi bakwe ase amaboko ’Abaisraeli. Nainwe monache chibarasi chiabo chinteng’e na mosambe chigari chiabo nomorero.”
english: The LORD said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them, because by this time tomorrow I will hand all of them over to Israel, slain. You are to hamstring their horses and burn their chariots."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Yoshua, “Tobairoka, nabekire abanto aba ase okoboko kwao, onde tari oranyare gokobua.”
english: The LORD said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid of them; I have given them into your hand. Not one of them will be able to withstand you."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Yoshua, “Imoka, otenene! Nase ki okorara maumama igo?
english: The LORD said to Joshua, "Stand up! What are you doing down on your face?

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia:
english: the LORD said to me,

ekegusii: Korende Omonene agantebia: Tobaisa komoiroka, ekiagera ere amo nabanto baye bonsi nababekire ase amaboko ao, boigo nakoeire ense yaye. Nomokore buna gwakorete Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, oria orenge kogamba agwo Hesiboni.
english: The LORD said to me, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have handed him over to you with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia: “Abaisraeli batarenge abegenwa babeire abaronge kobua Abayuda baria bare abang’ainereria.
english: The LORD said to me, "Faithless Israel is more righteous than unfaithful Judah.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Obobe nabotuboke korwa sugusu, erinde bobachere abanto bonsi bare ase ense eye.
english: The LORD said to me, "From the north disaster will be poured out on all who live in the land.

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Genda omwanche naende omokungu oyio nonya ogokora obotomani nomwanchi oye, omwanche buna Omonene anchete Abaisraeli, nonya baonchokeire chinyasae ching’ao, naende banchire amasabibu amomo.”
english: The LORD said to me, "Go, show your love to your wife again, though she is loved by another and is an adulteress. Love her as the LORD loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love the sacred raisin cakes."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Genda ase emechie y’Abayuda na ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu, orarie amang’ana aya onsi, otebie abanto bategerere amang’ana ’okobwatana okwo na koyakora.
english: The LORD said to me, "Proclaim all these words in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem: 'Listen to the terms of this covenant and follow them.

ekegusii: “Omonene agantebia: Rora, nachakire kobeka Sihoni amo nense yaye ase amaboko aino. Ase ayio, chaka koira ense yaye ebe eyaino.
english: The LORD said to me, "See, I have begun to deliver Sihon and his country over to you. Now begin to conquer and possess his land."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, rengereria mono, origererie namaiso ao, na oigwe namato ao amang’ana onsi ngochia kogotebia igoro y’emeroberio echikire ase enyomba y’Omonene, na amachiko onsi igoro y’enyomba eye. Origererie mono buna abanto baranyare gosoa ase enyomba y’Omonene na buna baranyare gosoka.
english: The LORD said to me, "Son of man, look carefully, listen closely and give attention to everything I tell you concerning all the regulations regarding the temple of the LORD. Give attention to the entrance of the temple and all the exits of the sanctuary.

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, abanto aba nabwo bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora ebibe na korua ogosemia kw’ogokora amabe ase omochie oyo.
english: The LORD said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who are plotting evil and giving wicked advice in this city.

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Imokia ebao enene ekorikwa, orike amariko aya mwanyabanto baranyare gosoma buya, orike: Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.”
english: The LORD said to me, "Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary pen: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Egeita eke nigo keragenderere gosiekwa, tigekoigorwa rinde, na monto onde tagosoera aroro, ekiagera aiga nao Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, asoerete ime. Ase ayio goika kegenderere gosiekwa.
english: The LORD said to me, "This gate is to remain shut. It must not be opened; no one may enter through it. It is to remain shut because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Kwarorire boronge, ekiagera inche nigo ntengerete, indore ng’a ring’ana riane riaikeranire ase ekeene.”
english: The LORD said to me, "You have seen correctly, for I am watching to see that my word is fulfilled."

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, Inee, nonachere Ohola na Oholiba ekina? Onye nabo, obatebie ogokora kwabo gw’okogechia.
english: The LORD said to me: "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then confront them with their detestable practices,

ekegusii: Omonene agantebia: Amang’ana ayio bakwanire nay’ekeene.
english: The LORD said to me: "What they say is good.

english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron in Egypt,

english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron,

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa na Haroni, “Omoroberio bw’Epasaka noro oyo: Omonto omomenyi tabaisa koyeria,
english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, "These are the regulations for the Passover: "No foreigner is to eat of it.

english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron:

english: The LORD said to Moses in the Desert of Sinai,

english: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

english: The LORD said to Moses,

english: The LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia.
english: The LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Baacha chibao chi’amagena ibere chire buna chiria chie ritang’ani, na inche nindike ase chibao echio amang’ana aria arenge ase chiria chie ritang’ani, echio gwatete.
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones, and I will write on them the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa asende egetunwa igoro, obeere aiga, na inche nkoe chibao chi’amagena chire namachiko onsi aya narikireo, ayio ogochia kworokereria abanto.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Come up to me on the mountain and stay here, and I will give you the tablets of stone, with the law and commands I have written for their instruction."

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia, “Bara abanto abasacha abatangi, abakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, obarike.
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Count all the firstborn Israelite males who are a month old or more and make a list of their names.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene agatebia Musa, “Tobaisa komoiroka, ekiagera namobekire ase okoboko kwao, ere amo nabanto baye bonsi, na ense yaye. Aye goika omokore buna gwakorete Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, oria omenyete agwo Hesiboni.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Do not be afraid of him, for I have handed him over to you, with his whole army and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Ngoika ririri abanto aba barabe bagonchaya? Na ngoika ririri barabe batari konyegena, nonya nakorire ebikone ebinge ase egati yabo?
english: The LORD said to Moses, "How long will these people treat me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in me, in spite of all the miraculous signs I have performed among them?

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Ninchiche asore inde ase riire ririto ime, erio abanto aba baigwe kongokwana naye, na barabwo bakwegene botambe.” Erio Musa agatebia Omonene amang’ana abanto bairaneretie.
english: The LORD said to Moses, "I am going to come to you in a dense cloud, so that the people will hear me speaking with you and will always put their trust in you." Then Moses told the LORD what the people had said.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Roisia omogwekano bw’eng’iti korwa ase etaai, erio oyebeke igoro ase omote, erinde kera omonto oromirwe neng’iti kararigererie eng’iti eria nabe moyo.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Make a snake and put it up on a pole; anyone who is bitten can look at it and live."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Naama! Amatuko ao abereire ang’e ogochia gokwa. Rangeria Yoshua, erinde mochiche agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, erio imobeke ase emeremo agwenerete akore.” Musa na Yoshua bakagenda agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano,
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Now the day of your death is near. Call Joshua and present yourselves at the Tent of Meeting, where I will commission him." So Moses and Joshua came and presented themselves at the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Irania enyimbo ya Haroni ebeere agwo bosio bw’Esanduku ere noborori, erinde egachwe ebe ekemanyererio ki’ogokurera abanto batari koigwera. Nabo okirie okwemurungania kwabo asende, timbaisa koigwa amang’ana buna ayio, mbaise kobaita bakwe.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Put back Aaron's staff in front of the Testimony, to be kept as a sign to the rebellious. This will put an end to their grumbling against me, so that they will not die."

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia, “Kwana nabakuani, abamura ba Haroni, obatebie ng’a omokuani tabaisa gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogokuna egetondo ki’omonto okure ase egati y’abanto baye.
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them: 'A priest must not make himself ceremonially unclean for any of his people who die,

ekegusii: Erio agatebia Musa, “Renta abatang’ani bonsi b’Abaisraeli, obasunge agwo ase obosio bwane erioba ribasambe, erinde endamwamu yane enene etige Abaisraeli.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Take all the leaders of these people, kill them and expose them in broad daylight before the LORD, so that the LORD's fierce anger may turn away from Israel."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa amotebie Haroni, “Imokia enyimbo yao, orambore okoboko kwao igoro ase amache onsi ay’Abamisiri, ase chindooche chiabo na ase ebirooche, ase amatibo onsi ne chinsoko. Amache ayio onsi aonchoke abe amanyinga. Naboigo amanyinga abe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, nonya nase chintuba na ase chinyongo chionsi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, 'Take your staff and stretch out your hand over the waters of Egypt-- over the streams and canals, over the ponds and all the reservoirs'-- and they will turn to blood. Blood will be everywhere in Egypt, even in the wooden buckets and stone jars."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Bono ekero orairane Misiri, origererie buya ng’a nokore ase obosio bwa Farao amakumia onsi aya nakoeire okobua gw’okoyakora. Korende ninkong’ie enkoro yaye, na ere tagotiga abanto bagende.
english: The LORD said to Moses, "When you return to Egypt, see that you perform before Pharaoh all the wonders I have given you the power to do. But I will harden his heart so that he will not let the people go.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
english: The LORD said to Moses:

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa,
english: The LORD said to Moses:

ekegusii: Omonene akamoiraneria, “Sangereria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etano na ebere, abwo basikire, bamanyekanete bare abatang’ani b’abanto, obarente agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, batenene aroro amo naye.
english: The LORD said to Moses: "Bring me seventy of Israel's elders who are known to you as leaders and officials among the people. Have them come to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

ekegusii: akamotebia, “Tebia Haroni, momura omino, ng’a tabaisa gosoa ime y’Aase Aachenu Mono, moino y’etoto, bosio bw’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera obore ekemumeko gi’Esanduku eria, engaki ende yonsi, ekiagera agwo nao ngochia kooroka ime ye riire igoro y’Oboikaranso obwo bw’Amabera. Aise gokora bo, goika akwe.
english: The LORD said to Moses: "Tell your brother Aaron not to come whenever he chooses into the Most Holy Place behind the curtain in front of the atonement cover on the ark, or else he will die, because I appear in the cloud over the atonement cover.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Samweli, “Ngoika ririri oragenderere koba nomoichano ase engencho ya Saulo. Inche namwangire, takogenderera koba omoruoti, bw’Abaisraeli. Ichoria orogunchara rwao amaguta, ngotome ogende o Yese, omonto o Bethlehemu, ekiagera nechoreire oyomo bw’abamura baye abe omoruoti.”
english: The LORD said to Samuel, "How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and be on your way; I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem. I have chosen one of his sons to be king."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Saitani, “Aye Saitani, inche Omonene ningotogonyere! Ee, inche Omonene nachorire Yerusalemu, ningotogonyere! Inee! Omonto oyo tari ekegenga giataboretigwe korwa ase omorero ime?”
english: The LORD said to Satan, "The LORD rebuke you, Satan! The LORD, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebuke you! Is not this man a burning stick snatched from the fire?"

ekegusii: Agwo Omonene agatebia Saitani, “Rora, ebinto bionsi Ayubu abwate bono nigo bire inse y’okobua kwao, korende ere omonyene tobaisa komokuna.” Erio Saitani akarua agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, akagenda.
english: The LORD said to Satan, "Very well, then, everything he has is in your hands, but on the man himself do not lay a finger." Then Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agatebia Saitani, “Rora, Ayubu nigo are inse y’okobua kwao, korende omotige abe moyo.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, "Very well, then, he is in your hands; but you must spare his life."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaboria Saitani, “Naye ng’ai okorwa?” Saitani akamoiraneria, “Nigo nkorwa ase etaaro yane, nkona‐goetanana ase ense yonsi, naende nabo nkonagotiira na gotirimboka aroro.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, "Where have you come from?" Satan answered the LORD, "From roaming through the earth and going back and forth in it."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani, “Genda ase egati‐gati y’amagoro aria anga chinyange, are inse y’omokerubi, bwanchare namaboko ao omorero bw’amakara ore ase egati y’abakerubi baria, oyosiarere igoro y’omochie.” Erio akagenda imorigereretie.
english: The LORD said to the man clothed in linen, "Go in among the wheels beneath the cherubim. Fill your hands with burning coals from among the cherubim and scatter them over the city." And as I watched, he went in.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Soka ogende, otenene ase egetunwa igoro agwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene!” Erio Omonene agaeta agwo, na omwaga ore ne chinguru ogatandora ebitunwa na gwata amagena ’ebitare agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, korende Omonene tarenge ime ase omwaga oria. Na ekero omwaga oerire, omotengecho bw’ense ogacha, korende Omonene tarenge ase omotengecho oria.
english: The LORD said, "Go out and stand on the mountain in the presence of the LORD, for the LORD is about to pass by." Then a great and powerful wind tore the mountains apart and shattered the rocks before the LORD, but the LORD was not in the wind. After the wind there was an earthquake, but the LORD was not in the earthquake.

ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Amaene narorire emechando y’abanto baane abwo bakare Misiri; naigure buna bakorera ase engencho y’abwo bakobachanda, na inche namanyire kegima obororo bwabo.
english: The LORD said, "I have indeed seen the misery of my people in Egypt. I have heard them crying out because of their slave drivers, and I am concerned about their suffering.

ekegusii: Omonene agateba, “Rora, abanto aba negesaku ekemo, na bagokwana omonwa oyomo bonsi, naya naro bachakire gokora, na nyuma y’ayio tibagosinywa gento kende gionsi bararengererie gokora.
english: The LORD said, "If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Inse konyora abanyene oboronge emerongo etano ase omochie oria o Sodomu, rirorio nigo ndatige aase aria ase engencho y’abwo, tinkoyosaria.”
english: The LORD said, "If I find fifty righteous people in the city of Sodom, I will spare the whole place for their sake."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agateba, “Naboigo Abaisraeli bararie endagera etachenegeti ekero barabe bare ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku biria ase ndabaserie gochia.”
english: The LORD said, "In this way the people of Israel will eat defiled food among the nations where I will drive them."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoiraneria: “Aya nigo akorekanire, ekiagera batigire ogochika kwane nabaete, bangire konyigwera na kobwatia chinchera chiane.
english: The LORD said, "It is because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them; they have not obeyed me or followed my law.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire: “Ekeene, ninkobeke chinguru, ngosesenie. Ase engaki y’emechando nimbetererie ababisa bao batung’ame ase obosio bwao.
english: The LORD said, "Surely I will deliver you for a good purpose; surely I will make your enemies plead with you in times of disaster and times of distress.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Yerute inse!” Na ekero Musa ayeruta inse, ekaonchoka ekaba eng’iti, na Musa agatama korwa asere.
english: The LORD said, "Throw it on the ground." Moses threw it on the ground and it became a snake, and he ran from it.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamotebia, “Inki eke gwakorire? Eriogi ri’amanyinga ’oyomino riarure ase riroba, riang’ikeire.
english: The LORD said, "What have you done? Listen! Your brother's blood cries out to me from the ground.

ekegusii: Omonene akarora ng’a obobe bwa mwanyabanto nobonge ase ense, na kera okoroberia na okorengereria gwe chinkoro chiabo nokobe botambe.
english: The LORD saw how great man's wickedness on the earth had become, and that every inclination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil all the time.

ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene aroche amang’ana ayio, akabaanga, akaba nendamwamu ase abana baye, abamura na abaiseke.
english: The LORD saw this and rejected them because he was angered by his sons and daughters.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene agateba, “Ning’iranie abanto abwo korwa Basani, mbarente korwa ase chindiba chi’enyancha,
english: The Lord says, "I will bring them from Bashan; I will bring them from the depths of the sea,

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba, “Abakungu ba Sayoni nigo bare aberori, nigo bagotaara basongorete amagoti, na bagoaka‐akania amaiso are nokogania okobe; nigo bagotira‐tiria kobakogenda na kwogia chinchigiri chire amagoro abo.
english: The LORD says, "The women of Zion are haughty, walking along with outstretched necks, flirting with their eyes, tripping along with mincing steps, with ornaments jingling on their ankles.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Abanto aba nigo bakong’ika ang’e ase ogokwana nemenwa yabo na gonsika nebikoba biabo, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare korwa asende, na okonyiroka kwabo nigo kore amachiko mwanyabanto borokereretie.
english: The Lord says: "These people come near to me with their mouth and honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me. Their worship of me is made up only of rules taught by men.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agokora omonto oba omotaka, gose omonda, ere nigo agokeyia omonto, gose omoimokereria igoro.
english: The LORD sends poverty and wealth; he humbles and he exalts.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatoma ebiombe bi’Abakalidayo, na Abasiiria, na Abamoabu, na Abaamoni, gochia korwania Yehoyakimu na gosaria ense y’Abayuda, buna akwanete goetera ase abasomba baye ababani.
english: The LORD sent Babylonian, Aramean, Moabite and Ammonite raiders against him. He sent them to destroy Judah, in accordance with the word of the LORD proclaimed by his servants the prophets.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatoma Nathani ase Daudi. Nathani akagenda asare, akamotebia, “Abanto babere mbamenyete ase omochie gete, oyomo obo igo arenge omonda, na oria onde nomotaka.
english: The LORD sent Nathan to David. When he came to him, he said, "There were two men in a certain town, one rich and the other poor.

ekegusii: Omonene agachora engaki, akabora, “Ankio inche Omonene ninchiche nkore ayio ase ense eye.”
english: The LORD set a time and said, "Tomorrow the LORD will do this in the land."

ekegusii: Omonene nigo aikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene kogambera chioora; Omonene nere omoruoti ase ekerogo kiaye kare na kare.
english: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.

ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene aigwete rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera, agateba ase omoyo oye ime, “Tinkoragereria ense naende nonya ng’ake ase engencho ya mwanyabanto, naki ebirengererio bie chinkoro chia mwanyabanto nebibe korwa obwana bwabo; nonya nebitongwa bionsi bire moyo tingocha kobisiria naende buna nakorete.
english: The LORD smelled the pleasing aroma and said in his heart: "Never again will I curse the ground because of man, even though every inclination of his heart is evil from childhood. And never again will I destroy all living creatures, as I have done.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Manase na abanto bonsi, korende bakaanga koigwera.
english: The LORD spoke to Manasseh and his people, but they paid no attention.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana eria kabere, agantebia,
english: The LORD spoke to me again:

ekegusii: Omonene akabeka igoro asende okoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru, agakwana nainche, agankurera ng’a timbaisa kobwatia chinchera chi’abanto aba, agateba,
english: The LORD spoke to me with his strong hand upon me, warning me not to follow the way of this people. He said:

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ogokwa kw’abamura baria babere ba Haroni baitetwe n’Omonene, ekero bamorenterete omorero bw’engencho eng’ao, oyio batachigetwe, Omonene agakwana na Musa,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron who died when they approached the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka o kabere, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, nyuma Abaisraeli kobarure ense ya Misiri, Omonene agakwana na Musa agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, akamotebia,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Desert of Sinai in the first month of the second year after they came out of Egypt. He said,

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani ri’omotienyi o kabere bw’omwaka o kabere nyuma Abaisraeli kobarure ase ense ya Misiri, Omonene agakwana na Musa ime y’Eema y’Omosangererekano, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, akamotebia,
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Desert of Sinai on the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites came out of Egypt. He said:

ekegusii: Agwo ase egetunwa Omonene nigo akwanete nainwe obosio ase obosio korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero.
english: The LORD spoke to you face to face out of the fire on the mountain.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akabua Abaetiopia ase obosio bwa Asa, na ase obosio bw’Abayuda; na Abaetiopia bagatama.
english: The LORD struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah. The Cushites fled,

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akoimokereria abanto abaitongo igoro, korende abakori amabe nigo akobaiyeria inse.
english: The LORD sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, tokonyara gotiga eira eyio kwarierete Daudi ase ogotiana, ogateba: “Oyomo bw’oroiboro rwao nimobeke aikaranse ase ekerogo kiao ki’obogambi.
english: The LORD swore an oath to David, a sure oath that he will not revoke: "One of your own descendants I will place on your throne--

ekegusii: Omonene obeire ang’e korenta ekina, otenenire konachera ebisaku ekina.
english: The LORD takes his place in court; he rises to judge the people.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agotagora enyomba y’omonto omoenenu, korende arenda chimbebe chi’omoboraka.
english: The LORD tears down the proud man's house but he keeps the widow's boundaries intact.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Omonene, Nyasae obo, nabatoorie, ekiagera nigo bare abanto be riicho riaye. Barabwo nigo bare buna amagena e rigori rinene abekire ase egutwa, akomeka‐meka na komoreka ase ense yaye.
english: The LORD their God will save them on that day as the flock of his people. They will sparkle in his land like jewels in a crown.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Nuhu, “Soa ase obwato ime amo nabanto bao, ekiagera nakororire ng’a aye bweka ase ekegori eke nigo ore omonto omoronge ase obosio bwane.
english: The LORD then said to Noah, "Go into the ark, you and your whole family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.

ekegusii: Omonene akabatantania na kobaondokia ase amasio ’Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bakabaita ogoita okonene agwo Gibeoni, akababwatia gochia egetirimboko kia Beti‐Horoni, naende akababwatia na kobaita goika omochie bw’Aseka na oyo o Makeda.
english: The LORD threw them into confusion before Israel, who defeated them in a great victory at Gibeon. Israel pursued them along the road going up to Beth Horon and cut them down all the way to Azekah and Makkedah.

ekegusii: “Omonene agaaka enkoba korwa igoro, na eriogi ri’Oyore Igoro Mono rikaigugwa.
english: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

ekegusii: Omonene agaaka enkoba korwa igoro; na eriogi ri’Oyore Igoro Mono rikaigugwa; amagena ’embura na omorero bw’amakara bigacha.
english: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

ekegusii: Eriogi ri’Omonene ndiigugwe bosio bw’omoganda oye bw’esegi, ekiagera omoganda oye bw’esegi nigo ore omonene mono; echio chigoikerania amang’ana aye, nigo chire ne chinguru. Rituko ri’Omonene nigo rire rinene na eri’okoirokia. Ning’o oranyare koriremereria?
english: The LORD thunders at the head of his army; his forces are beyond number, and mighty are those who obey his command. The day of the LORD is great; it is dreadful. Who can endure it?

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Imoka ogende enchera eria ekorokwa Enchera Endonge, origie ime ase enyomba ya Yudas omonto okorokwa Saulo o Tariso; rora, nao are agosaba.
english: The Lord told him, "Go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for a man from Tarsus named Saul, for he is praying.

ekegusii: Omonene abaonchorere obosio bwaye, abae omorembe.
english: the LORD turn his face toward you and give you peace."'

ekegusii: Omonene akeonchora, akarigereria Petero. Petero akainyora ring’ana ri’Omonene, buna amotebetie, “Rero, ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga nonkane ara gatato.”
english: The Lord turned and looked straight at Peter. Then Peter remembered the word the Lord had spoken to him: "Before the rooster crows today, you will disown me three times."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akeonchora gochia asare, akamotebia, “Genda ne chinguru echio chiao, otoorie Abaisraeli korwa ase amaboko ’Abamidiani. Inche ninche nkogotoma.”
english: The LORD turned to him and said, "Go in the strength you have and save Israel out of Midian's hand. Am I not sending you?"

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akobwata bonsi abakogwa, nigo akogororokia abwo bakumbirwe gochia inse.
english: The LORD upholds all those who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

ekegusii: Goetera ase omobani Omonene akang’anyia Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na goetera ase omobani abanto abwo bakaba barendire.
english: The LORD used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt, by a prophet he cared for him.

ekegusii: Omonene konya obeire ogokurera Abaisraeli na Abayuda goetera ase kera omobani, na ase kera omorori, ogoteba, “Onchoka, motige chinchera chiaino chi’obobe, na mobwate amachiko aane, na emeroberio yane echikire, koreng’ana namachiko onsi ayio nachigete chisokoro chiaino, ayio nabatomerete inwe goetera ase abasomba baane ababani.”
english: The LORD warned Israel and Judah through all his prophets and seers: "Turn from your evil ways. Observe my commands and decrees, in accordance with the entire Law that I commanded your fathers to obey and that I delivered to you through my servants the prophets."

ekegusii: Kobua ayio Omonene nigo ambeete ase engencho yaino, agatiana ng’a inche tinkonyara kwamboka orooche rwa Yorodan, na kogenda ase ense eria engiya Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, ebe omwando oino.
english: The LORD was angry with me because of you, and he solemnly swore that I would not cross the Jordan and enter the good land the LORD your God is giving you as your inheritance.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene ageitia, ekiagera atongete mwanyabanto ase ense, agaichana ase omoyo oye.
english: The LORD was grieved that he had made man on the earth, and his heart was filled with pain.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo asinyetwe koira abanto aba ase ense eria konya arire eira akobaa; ase ayio obaiteire ase erooro.
english: 'The LORD was not able to bring these people into the land he promised them on oath; so he slaughtered them in the desert.'

ekegusii: Omonene akagokigwa namang’ana ayio Sulemani aboretie.
english: The Lord was pleased that Solomon had asked for this.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akaba ore amo na Yusufu, akamokorera obuya, akamoa ogwancherwa ase omonene bw’echela.
english: the LORD was with him; he showed him kindness and granted him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.

ekegusii: Omonene akaba amo na Yehosafati, ekiagera abwatetie chinchera chie ritang’ani chia Daudi, sokoro yaye. Ere tasasimete Baali,
english: The LORD was with Jehoshaphat because in his early years he walked in the ways his father David had followed. He did not consult the Baals

ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge amo na Yusufu, na ere akanyora ogosesenigwa. Yusufu akamenya ase enka y’omonene oye, oria Omomisiri.
english: The LORD was with Joseph and he prospered, and he lived in the house of his Egyptian master.

ekegusii: Samweli akamenta gokina; Omonene akaba nere, erinde tatiga ring’ana riaye nonya nerimo ritaikeranetigwe.
english: The LORD was with Samuel as he grew up, and he let none of his words fall to the ground.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo arenge amo n’Abayuda, na barabwo bakaira ense y’ebitunwa, korende tibanyarete goseria abanto bamenyete ase ense omweya, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo babwate chigari chi’ebioma.
english: The LORD was with the men of Judah. They took possession of the hill country, but they were unable to drive the people from the plains, because they had iron chariots.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo arendete bonsi abamwanchete; korende nasirie abakori amabe bonsi.
english: The LORD watches over all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo akorenda abanto abageni, nigo akoa chintakana na ababoraka ogosemeria, korende chinchera chi’abakori amabe nigo agochisiria.
english: The LORD watches over the alien and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.

ekegusii: Omonene nere omorendi oo, nere ekiriri kiao ase ensemo y’okoboko kwao kwa borio.
english: The LORD watches over you-- the LORD is your shade at your right hand;

ekegusii: Naende Daudi agateba, “Omonene oria ontooretie korwa ase chinchara chi’endo na echi’edubu, nigo arantoorie korwa ase amaboko ’Omofilisti oria.” Saulo akamotebia, “Gaki genda, na Omonene abe amo naye.”
english: The LORD who delivered me from the paw of the lion and the paw of the bear will deliver me from the hand of this Philistine." Saul said to David, "Go, and the LORD be with you."

ekegusii: The LORD will afflict you with madness, blindness and confusion of mind.
english: Nabakore mobe chibarimo, na emeuko, na omwochogano bw’ebirengererio.

ekegusii: Omonene nabarentere inwe amagumba buna aria arenterete Abamisiri, nabarentere namasisa, na okweagia, amarwaire ayio atanyare kogwenigwa.
english: The LORD will afflict you with the boils of Egypt and with tumors, festering sores and the itch, from which you cannot be cured.

ekegusii: Omonene nabaake moriegwe namagumba amabe ase amaru aino na ase amagoro aino, ee amagumba ayio natuboke korwa chimbaratero chiaino goika emetwe yaino igoro, nainwe timokogwena.
english: The LORD will afflict your knees and legs with painful boils that cannot be cured, spreading from the soles of your feet to the top of your head.

ekegusii: Omonene nabarentere amarwaire ao ao, na emechando eyio etarikiri ase ebuku eye y’amachiko, goika inwe mosirigwe kegima.
english: The LORD will also bring on you every kind of sickness and disaster not recorded in this Book of the Law, until you are destroyed.

ekegusii: Omonene nabaondokie. Nakore chinyasae chionsi chire ase ense eyio chibe bosa. Abanto be chinse chi’ebisaku mbamosasime, kera oyomo aase aye.
english: The LORD will be awesome to them when he destroys all the gods of the land. The nations on every shore will worship him, every one in its own land.

ekegusii: Omonene nabe omoruoti bw’ense engima. Ase engaki eyio Omonene nere orabe ere bweka, na erieta riaye ribe rirorio rioka.
english: The LORD will be king over the whole earth. On that day there will be one LORD, and his name the only name.

ekegusii: Omonene narente egesaku ekeao geche kobarwania korwa aare, korwa ensinyo y’ense, ekere ekiango gekoiruruka buna ekeongo, ekio motamanyete omonwa obo.
english: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the ends of the earth, like an eagle swooping down, a nation whose language you will not understand,

ekegusii: “Omonene narente amatuko amabe igoro asore, na ase abanto bao, na ase abanto b’ororeria rwa iso, amatuko buna ayio atana koba bo rinde korwa ekero Abaefraimu beatananete korwa ase Abayuda; narente omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.”
english: The LORD will bring on you and on your people and on the house of your father a time unlike any since Ephraim broke away from Judah-- he will bring the king of Assyria."

ekegusii: Nyasae oo nigo agoteba iga: “Inche Omonene nakorangeirie aye ore buna omokungu bwangetwe, oichanete ase omoyo oye, ee, nakorangeirie aye ore buna omokungu oseretigwe ekero arenge omoriakari.
english: The LORD will call you back as if you were a wife deserted and distressed in spirit-- a wife who married young, only to be rejected," says your God.

ekegusii: Omonene naake eriogi riaye ri’obonene na abanto bariigwe, na ogoaka kw’endamwamu gokorwa ase okoboko kwaye kororekane. Nigo araake goetera ase omorero ogosamba na gosiria, na omwaga bwe chinguru, na embura y’omoubera, na amagena ’embura.
english: The LORD will cause men to hear his majestic voice and will make them see his arm coming down with raging anger and consuming fire, with cloudburst, thunderstorm and hail.

ekegusii: “Omonene nae ababisa baino ribaga bababue. Namoetere enchera eyemo ekero mokogenda kobarwania, korende motame korwa asebare, moetere chinchera isano na ibere. Amagambi onsi are ase ense nakumie na kwoboa ase amang’ana arabanyore inwe.
english: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies. You will come at them from one direction but flee from them in seven, and you will become a thing of horror to all the kingdoms on earth.

ekegusii: Omonene nababeke ase amaboko aino, nainwe mobakore koreng’ana namang’ana onsi nabachikire.
english: The LORD will deliver them to you, and you must do to them all that I have commanded you.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nasiririe Babeli; nakiririe amariogi amanene arengeo. Emerindo egocha aroro nigo ekoeera buna amache amange, eriogi riabo rinene nigo riraigugwe.
english: The LORD will destroy Babylon; he will silence her noisy din. Waves [of enemies] will rage like great waters; the roar of their voices will resound.

ekegusii: “Omonene nabaire inwe amo nomoruoti oyio oino morechorere, ababeke inse y’egesaku kende ekeao, eke inwe motamanyete, gose chisokoro chiaino. Aroro agwo inamokorere chinyasae ching’ao chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena.
english: The LORD will drive you and the king you set over you to a nation unknown to you or your fathers. There you will worship other gods, gods of wood and stone.

ekegusii: Omonene nasarie kegima omosomo bw’enyancha ya Misiri; nasungusie okoboko kwaye arente omwaga oguse igoro ase Orooche rwa Eufarati, erio arwatanane robe ebiambokero bitano na bibere, erinde abanto bambokere aroro buna ase ense enyomo.
english: The LORD will dry up the gulf of the Egyptian sea; with a scorching wind he will sweep his hand over the Euphrates River. He will break it up into seven streams so that men can cross over in sandals.

ekegusii: “Kamorarende na kobwata amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae oino, na gotaara ase chinchera chiaye, nabaimokererie igoro mobe abanto abachenu asare, buna abariereire eira na gotiana.
english: The LORD will establish you as his holy people, as he promised you on oath, if you keep the commands of the LORD your God and walk in his ways.

ekegusii: Korwa Sayoni Omonene narambore enyimbo yao y’obogambi ere nokobua, atebe, “Gamba ase egati y’ababisa bao.”
english: The LORD will extend your mighty scepter from Zion; you will rule in the midst of your enemies.

ekegusii: Omonene nabarwanere inwe, na inwe mokire‐kiri rioka.”
english: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene nonyare goikerania aya kwandierete eira, ekiagera obwanchani bwao nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare. Tobaisa kweba emeremo y’amaboko ao.
english: The LORD will fulfill [his purpose] for me; your love, O LORD, endures forever-- do not abandon the works of your hands.

ekegusii: “Omonene natige ababisa baino, baria bagocha kobarwania, babugwe ase amasio aino. Barabwo mbabachere baetere ase enchera eyemo ekero bagocha kobarwania, korende mbatame korwa asemore baetere chinchera isano na ibere.
english: The LORD will grant that the enemies who rise up against you will be defeated before you. They will come at you from one direction but flee from you in seven.

ekegusii: Omonene nabae obotenenku, nabuchie oroiboro rwe chinda chiaino, nabuchie ne chitugo chiaino, naende nabae okwama okonge kwe riroba agwo ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabayee inwe.
english: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity-- in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your ground-- in the land he swore to your forefathers to give you.

ekegusii: Igo Omonene nakoraae kogenderera botambe, nagoisanekie nebinto ebiya, nakong’ie amauga ’omobere oo, naye obe buna omogondo ogoitororerwa amache, na buna ensoko y’amache etari gokama.
english: The LORD will guide you always; he will satisfy your needs in a sun-scorched land and will strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.

ekegusii: Boigo Omonene nache abeke Abaisraeli amo naye ase amaboko ’Abafilisti. Ankio aye amo nabamura bao moche kobeera amo nainche, na Omonene nache abeke abarwani b’esegi b’Abaisraeli ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.”
english: The LORD will hand over both Israel and you to the Philistines, and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me. The LORD will also hand over the army of Israel to the Philistines."

ekegusii: Omonene narorere ororeria rwa Yakobo amabera, nachore Abaisraeli abwo naende, abarente bamenye ase ense yabo. Abanto abaao mbabwatane nab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, bamenye amo nabarabwo.
english: The LORD will have compassion on Jacob; once again he will choose Israel and will settle them in their own land. Aliens will join them and unite with the house of Jacob.

ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene narue ayare amaya, na orogongo rwaito rorue okwama kwaye.
english: The LORD will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.

ekegusii: Omonene naire Abayuda babe omwando oye ore ase ense eye enchenu, nachore Yerusalemu obe omochie oye naende.
english: The LORD will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land and will again choose Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Omonene nanachere abanto baye ekina kia boronge, na arorere abasomba baye amabera, ekero ararore ng’a chinguru chiabo chiaerire, naende onde tatigareti, omosomba gose omobiare.
english: The LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants when he sees their strength is gone and no one is left, slave or free.

ekegusii: Omonene narusie amarwaire onsi korwa asemore; nonya nobomo bw’amarwaire aria amabe arenge Misiri, aria ase mwamenyete, tagocha igoro asemore kobachanda, korende nigo arayarente ase abanto baria bonsi babagechete.
english: The LORD will keep you free from every disease. He will not inflict on you the horrible diseases you knew in Egypt, but he will inflict them on all who hate you.

ekegusii: Omonene nakorende korwa ase amabe onsi, narende omoyo oo.
english: The LORD will keep you from all harm-- he will watch over your life;

ekegusii: Omonene oorokirie okoboko kwaye ogochenu ase amaiso ebisaku bionsi, ne chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense nchirore ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito.
english: The LORD will lay bare his holy arm in the sight of all the nations, and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.

ekegusii: Komoraigwere amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae oino, ayio nkobaa rituko ria rero, na mobe abegenwa ase okoyakora, nabakore mobe ab’omotwe, gose tari ab’ekemincha. Nabakore mogenderere gokina, gose timokogenderera gokeeigwa gochia inse.
english: The LORD will make you the head, not the tail. If you pay attention to the commands of the LORD your God that I give you this day and carefully follow them, you will always be at the top, never at the bottom.

ekegusii: Omonene naoroke buna etuoni y’esegi, na buna omorwani esegi abokie omokia oye; nigo agoaka eriogi ri’esegi na kwoga mono, nigo akweorokia ng’a nare nokobua igore y’ababisa baye.
