english: The priest is to take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one to be cleansed, on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

ekegusii: Omokuani aimokie amanyinga make ay’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’ebibe, agindie emetobwa y’egesieri gie Hekalu, ne chikoona inye chi’egesasimero, na emetobwa y’egesoero kegochia ase eraaro ya ime.
english: The priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the upper ledge of the altar and on the gateposts of the inner court.

ekegusii: Omokuani aimokie emanwa y’eng’ondi eria y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, amo namaguta aria egetuba ekemo, abinduere inche Omonene bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa.
english: The priest is to take the lamb for the guilt offering, together with the log of oil, and wave them before the LORD as a wave offering.

ekegusii: Erio omokuani asungusie omogati bw’ogotongora amo ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi echio ibere ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ebinto ebio biatananwe bibe ebichenu ase Omonene, bibe endagera y’omokuani.
english: The priest is to wave the two lambs before the LORD as a wave offering, together with the bread of the firstfruits. They are a sacred offering to the LORD for the priest.

ekegusii: Omokuani o Zeu, oyo hekalu yaye yarenge isiko y’omochie, akarenta chieri na ebisembe bi’ebisicha goika ase ebiita; ere amo nabanto bakarigia korua ekeng’wanso.
english: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought bulls and wreaths to the city gates because he and the crowd wanted to offer sacrifices to them.

ekegusii: Omokuani oria akamotebia, “Omoyio o Goliato, Omofilisti oria gwaitete agwo ase ense omweremo ya Ela, nore aa, oboire egetambaa na kogachwa magega y’egesibao ki’obokuani. Onye koyoganetie yoire, ekiagera onde omoao tori aa.” Daudi agateba, “Onde tori onga buna oyio, yong’e”.
english: The priest replied, "The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here; it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod. If you want it, take it; there is no sword here but that one." David said, "There is none like it; give it to me."

ekegusii: Omokuani arente enyoni eyio ase egesasimero, na amine omotwe oye, ayobutore. Erio ayosambe ase egesasimero. Anyititorere amanyinga ase egesasimero ensemo,
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, wring off the head and burn it on the altar; its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar.

ekegusii: Omokuani asambere ebitinya ase egesasimero, korende ritaana ribe eria Haroni na abamura baye.
english: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast belongs to Aaron and his sons.

ekegusii: Omokuani asambe ebigara bike bie biria bisenyentire, amo namaguta; abisambe amo na ubani yonsi bibe ekemanyererio ng’a okoruegwa okwo nokwane inche Omonene. Okwo nokoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero asende.
english: The priest shall burn the memorial portion of the crushed grain and the oil, together with all the incense, as an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Omokuani abisambere ase egesasimero, bibe ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene. Ekio nekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar as an offering made to the LORD by fire. It is a guilt offering.

ekegusii: Omokuani abisambere ase egesasimero bibe endagera ekoruegwa egosambwa nomorero, ere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera. Ebitinya bionsi nebiane.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma. All the fat is the LORD's.

ekegusii: Omokuani otenenerete asambe ebinto ebio bionsi ase egesasimero bibe endagera ekoruegwa ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar as food, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: erio omokuani asoke korwa ase enyomba eyio, na ayesieke ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: the priest shall go out the doorway of the house and close it up for seven days.

ekegusii: omokuani achike abanto barente chinyoni ibere chichenegete chire moyo, na oroko rw’omocharake, na eusi embariri, na orosagia rwa hisopo, ase engencho y’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa.
english: the priest shall order that two live clean birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop be brought for the one to be cleansed.

ekegusii: “Erio omokuani arusie egetonga keria korwa ase okoboko kwao akebeke bosio bw’egesasimero ki’Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: The priest shall take the basket from your hands and set it down in front of the altar of the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Naende arue riruma ria kabere ribe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, koreng’ana buna achikire. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria ase engencho y’ebibe ebi akorire, na omonto oria naaberwe.
english: The priest shall then offer the other as a burnt offering in the prescribed way and make atonement for him for the sin he has committed, and he will be forgiven.

ekegusii: Omokuani abeke eganchwa yaye y’egatani, amo ne chisirwari chi’ogwetuba, erio abuuche ribu korwa ase omorero oria osamberete ekeng’wanso ase egesasimero, aribeke ase egesasimero ensemo.
english: The priest shall then put on his linen clothes, with linen undergarments next to his body, and shall remove the ashes of the burnt offering that the fire has consumed on the altar and place them beside the altar.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio omokuani oria agindie amanyinga make ase emegwekano ye chingunchara ere ase chikoona chi’egesasimero ase ubani egosamberwa, kere ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, ase obosio bwane, na amanyinga ’eeri eria agotigara ayaumore inse agwo ase egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kere ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: The priest shall then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting. The rest of the bull's blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Naende omokuani aimokie amaguta aria ataaere oroe rw’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee,
english: The priest shall then take some of the log of oil, pour it in the palm of his own left hand,

ekegusii: Omokuani arente ebinto ebio amo ne ritaana na ekenama bi’emingichi, abisungusie bibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosungusigwa ase Omonene. Ebinto ebio nigo biatananetwe ase omokuani. Erio nario Omwerwa oria arabe ne ribaga konywa edivai.”
english: The priest shall then wave them before the LORD as a wave offering; they are holy and belong to the priest, together with the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.

ekegusii: Omokuani oakirwe amaguta na gwatananwa abe omokuani ribaga ria ise, nere orakore okobwatanigwa okwo. Ere nigo arabeke chianga chiria chinchenu chi’egatani,
english: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest is to make atonement. He is to put on the sacred linen garments

ekegusii: Omokuani okorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosamwa ase engencho y’omonto onde, aire risankwa ri’ekeng’wanso keria ribe eriaye.
english: The priest who offers a burnt offering for anyone may keep its hide for himself.

ekegusii: Omokuani oyio okorua ekeng’wanso ekio nakeriere aase achenire, agwo ase eraaro y’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: The priest who offers it shall eat it; it is to be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Omokuani otenenerete arente omonto oria ogochia gochenwa amo nokoruegwa okwo ase obosio bwane inche Omonene, agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: The priest who pronounces him clean shall present both the one to be cleansed and his offerings before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: omokuani akore rigori ri’oboremo boria koreng’ana nemiaka etigarete goika Omwaka bw’Omochengo. Ase rituko riria kegima omonto oria aakane rigori riria ribekire, ne chibesa echi chibe chiatananirwe ase Omonene.
english: the priest will determine its value up to the Year of Jubilee, and the man must pay its value on that day as something holy to the LORD.

ekegusii: Abakuani bagancha ng’a tibagochia korusia chibesa chinde korwa ase abanto, naende ng’a tibagochia koroisia enyomba ase yatagokire.
english: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money from the people and that they would not repair the temple themselves.

ekegusii: Abakuani na Abalawi bagacha korwa ase ense y’Abaisraeli ase bamenyete, bakabwatana na Rehoboamu.
english: The priests and Levites from all their districts throughout Israel sided with him.

ekegusii: Abakuani na Abalawi konya bechenire; bono bonsi nigo barenge abachenegete. Ase ayio bakanyenya chimanwa chiria chie ching’ondi chi’Epasaka ase engencho y’abwo bonsi bairanete korwa ase obosomba, na ase abakuani bamwabo, na ase barabwo abanyene.
english: The priests and Levites had purified themselves and were all ceremonially clean. The Levites slaughtered the Passover lamb for all the exiles, for their brothers the priests and for themselves.

ekegusii: Ekero barenge gokwana nabanto, abakuani abanene, na omonene bw’abarendi be Hekalu, na Abasadukai bakabaorokera,
english: The priests and the captain of the temple guard and the Sadducees came up to Peter and John while they were speaking to the people.

ekegusii: Erio abakuani na Abalawi bagatenena, bagasesenia abanto, na amariogi abo akaigugwa, na ogosaba kwabo kogaika ase obomenyo obochenu bw’Omonene aaria igoro.
english: The priests and the Levites stood to bless the people, and God heard them, for their prayer reached heaven, his holy dwelling place.

ekegusii: Abakuani tibarenge konyara gosoa ase enyomba y’Omonene, ekiagera obonene bw’Omonene bwaichorete ase enyomba eria y’Omonene.
english: The priests could not enter the temple of the LORD because the glory of the LORD filled it.

ekegusii: Abakuani tibaboretie: Ng’ai Omonene are? Baria barenge kworokereria amachiko aane, tibamanyete inche; abagambi bagasaria asende; ababani bakaba bakobana ase erieta ri’enyasae ekorokwa Baali; barabwo bagatunyana na gokorera ebinto bitarenge kobakonya.”
english: The priests did not ask, 'Where is the LORD?' Those who deal with the law did not know me; the leaders rebelled against me. The prophets prophesied by Baal, following worthless idols.

ekegusii: Abakuani tibabaisa gokora ebinto ebi ebichenu Abaisraeli bagwatanana na kobirua ase Omonene bibe ebitachenegeti,
english: The priests must not desecrate the sacred offerings the Israelites present to the LORD

ekegusii: The priests must not eat anything, bird or animal, found dead or torn by wild animals.
english: Abakuani tibabaisa koria enyama ende yonsi y’enyoni gose ey’eng’iti ekwete yoka enyene, gose eitire ne ching’iti chinde.

ekegusii: Erio abakuani bakarenta Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene, bakayesoyia aase aye ase akanyomba ka ime, agwo Aase Aachenu Mono, bakayebeka inse ye chimbaba chi’abakerubi.
english: The priests then brought the ark of the LORD's covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.

ekegusii: Bono abakuani baria bakarenta Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Ogotianania kw’Omonene, bakayesoyia aase aye, ase akanyomba ka ime agwo Aase Aachenu Mono, bakayebeka inse ye chimbaba chi’abakerubi.
english: The priests then brought the ark of the LORD's covenant to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the Most Holy Place, and put it beneath the wings of the cherubim.

ekegusii: Abakuani baga chinyenya, na amanyinga e chigoree echio bakayaumora ase egesasimero akaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase okobwatania Abaisraeli bonsi na Nyasae. Omoruoti nigo achigete ng’a ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na eki’ebibe biruegwe ase engencho y’Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: The priests then slaughtered the goats and presented their blood on the altar for a sin offering to atone for all Israel, because the king had ordered the burnt offering and the sin offering for all Israel.

ekegusii: Abakuani bonsi abarenge aroro ekero keria konya bechenire abanyene, nonya barenge b’ekeombe kende gionsi. Bono ekero abakuani bonsi basogete korwa ase Aase Aachenu,
english: The priests then withdrew from the Holy Place. All the priests who were there had consecrated themselves, regardless of their divisions.

ekegusii: Abakuaani bagatenena ase emeremo yabo y’obokuani, na Abalawi barengeo babwate ebinto bi’okobugigwa ase ogoterera Omonene, ebinto biria Daudi omoruoti konya aroisirie ase okoiraneria Omonene ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bogendererete kare na kare. Daudi nigo ababegete babe bagotera ogotera kw’ogotogia. Abakuani bakaba bakobugia ebirombeta, ekero Abaisraeli bonsi bateneine.
english: The priests took their positions, as did the Levites with the LORD's musical instruments, which King David had made for praising the LORD and which were used when he gave thanks, saying, "His love endures forever." Opposite the Levites, the priests blew their trumpets, and all the Israelites were standing.

ekegusii: Abakuani bagasoa ase chinsemo chia ime kegima chi’enyomba y’Omonene, bakayechena. Bagasokia korwa imeo ebinto bionsi biakorete Hekalu y’Omonene ekaba eyetachenegeti goikera ase eraaro, na korwa aroro Abalawi bakabibogoria bakabiira goika ase rikura ria Kidironi.
english: The priests went into the sanctuary of the LORD to purify it. They brought out to the courtyard of the LORD's temple everything unclean that they found in the temple of the LORD. The Levites took it and carried it out to the Kidron Valley.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli baare kwamboka ase ense yakamokire, abakuani abwo babogoretie Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene bagatenena gati‐gati ya Yorodan, ase ense yakamokire, goika abanto bonsi bakaera ase okwamboka Yorodan.
english: The priests who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD stood firm on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan, while all Israel passed by until the whole nation had completed the crossing on dry ground.

ekegusii: Korende abakuani nigo barenge abake mono, na tibanyarete korusia amasankwa korwa ase ching’iti chiria chionsi chianyenyetwe chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa. Ase ayio Abalawi bamwabo bakabakonya goika emeremo eria ekaera, na goika abakuani bande bakaba bachenekire. Abalawi bakaba ne chinkoro chindonge kobua abakuani ase ogwechena abanyene.
english: The priests, however, were too few to skin all the burnt offerings; so their kinsmen the Levites helped them until the task was finished and until other priests had been consecrated, for the Levites had been more conscientious in consecrating themselves than the priests had been.

ekegusii: Erio abakuani, na Abalawi, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abateri, na abanto bande, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, amo n’Abaisraeli bande bakaba bakomenya ase emechie yabo. Ekero omotienyi o gatano na kabere oigete, Abaisraeli bonsi konya bamenyire ase emechie yabo.
english: The priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers and the temple servants, along with certain of the people and the rest of the Israelites, settled in their own towns. When the seventh month came and the Israelites had settled in their towns,

ekegusii: Abakuani, na Abalawi, na abanto bande, bakaba bakomenya ase emechie yabo. Abateri, na abarendi b’ebiita, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, nabarabwo bakaba bakomenya ase emechie yabo, na Abaisraeli bonsi ase emechie yabo.
english: The priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers and the temple servants settled in their own towns, along with some of the other people, and the rest of the Israelites settled in their towns.

ekegusii: Abakuani na ababani, na abanto bonsi bakaigwa Yeremia ogokwana amang’ana ayio ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: The priests, the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speak these words in the house of the LORD.

ekegusii: Na abakuani Abalawi bagende agwo ase rigoko, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, abachorire bamokorere na gosesenia ase erieta riaye. Ase ring’ana riabo kera eriomana na ogokorerana bobe ase obotindi nabinachwe.
english: The priests, the sons of Levi, shall step forward, for the LORD your God has chosen them to minister and to pronounce blessings in the name of the LORD and to decide all cases of dispute and assault.

ekegusii: “Abakuani Abalawi na egesaku gionsi ki’Abalawi tibakonyora egetari gose omwando amo n’Abaisraeli bande. Nigo barabe bakoria ebing’wanso bigosambwa nomorero ase Omonene na okoruegwa konde gokorentwa asare.
english: The priests, who are Levites-- indeed the whole tribe of Levi-- are to have no allotment or inheritance with Israel. They shall live on the offerings made to the LORD by fire, for that is their inheritance.

ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge abamwabo, abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, elifu eyemo, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (1,760). Bonsi nigo barenge abamanyi ase ogokora emeremo ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: The priests, who were heads of families, numbered 1,760. They were able men, responsible for ministering in the house of God.

ekegusii: The priests: the descendants of Jedaiah (through the family of Jeshua) 973
english: Omobaro bw’abakuani noro oyo: Abwo b’ororeria rwa Yedaya be chiamate chia Yesua: amagana kianda, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batato (973);

ekegusii: The priests: the descendants of Jedaiah (through the family of Jeshua) 973
english: Omobaro bw’abakuani noro oyo: Ab’ororeria rwa Yedaya, bw’eamate ya Yesua: amagana kianda, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batato (973);

ekegusii: Omogambi bweka nere oraikaranseo ariere endagera ase obosio bw’Omonene. Nigo arasoere goetera gesona ki’oboagacho bore geita, naende asokere enchera eyio eyio.”
english: The prince himself is the only one who may sit inside the gateway to eat in the presence of the LORD. He is to enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way."

ekegusii: Omogambi asoe ime amo nabanto, na ekero bagosoka, nere asoke amo nabarabwo.
english: The prince is to be among them, going in when they go in and going out when they go out.

ekegusii: Omogambi asoe goetera ase egesona ki’oboagacho bore geita, atenene ase omotobwa bw’egesieri kere aroro. Omogambi oria abe ogosasimera agwo ase egesoero ekero abakuani bagendererete korua ebing’wanso biaye bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe. Erio omogambi asoke isiko, korende egeita keria tigesiekwa goika mogoroba.
english: The prince is to enter from the outside through the portico of the gateway and stand by the gatepost. The priests are to sacrifice his burnt offering and his fellowship offerings. He is to worship at the threshold of the gateway and then go out, but the gate will not be shut until evening.

ekegusii: Omogambi takoura abanto emiando yabo ayee abana baye, korende nigo arae abana baye emiando korwa ase omwando oye omonyene. Igo monto onde tari ase abanto baane oraurwe enibo yaye.”
english: The prince must not take any of the inheritance of the people, driving them off their property. He is to give his sons their inheritance out of his own property, so that none of my people will be separated from his property.'"

ekegusii: Abanene b’Abaisakaru nigo babwatetie Debora, na buna Abaisakaru bakorete, naboigo na Baraki, bagatirimboka gochia ase ense omweya, bakabwatia chimbaratero chiabo. Korende ase chindooche chi’abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, okogamba na okoroberia okonene nigo biarengeo.
english: The princes of Issachar were with Deborah; yes, Issachar was with Barak, rushing after him into the valley. In the districts of Reuben there was much searching of heart.

ekegusii: Naki eira eye nigo ere asemore na ase abana baino, na ase abanto bonsi abare aare, na bonsi abarangerigwe n’Omonene Nyasae oito.”
english: The promise is for you and your children and for all who are far off-- for all whom the Lord our God will call."

ekegusii: Chiira chiria chiarieretwe Ibrahimu na omoiborwa oye. Takwanetwe, “Ase oroiboro” buna nase abange; korende eira iga erengete ase oyomo, “Ase omoiborwa oo”, nere Kristo.
english: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say "and to seeds," meaning many people, but "and to your seed," meaning one person, who is Christ.

ekegusii: Elisha agateba, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, oria inche ngokorera, tinkoira ekeegwa nonya nekemo.” Naamani akamosorora anche abiire, korende Elisha akaanga.
english: The prophet answered, "As surely as the LORD lives, whom I serve, I will not accept a thing." And even though Naaman urged him, he refused.

ekegusii: Akamoboria, “Ngento ki barora nyomba mwao?” Hezekia akairaneria, “Nigo barora ebinto bionsi bire nyomba mwane; tikeri nonya negento ekemo ase amagachero aane ntaborokia.”
english: The prophet asked, "What did they see in your palace?" "They saw everything in my palace," Hezekiah said. "There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them."

ekegusii: Isaya akamoboria, “Ngento ki barora ase enyomba yao?” Hezekia akairaneria, “Nigo barora ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba yane, tikeri nonya negento ekemo ase amagachero aane ntaborokia.”
english: The prophet asked, "What did they see in your palace?" "They saw everything in my palace," Hezekiah said. "There is nothing among my treasures that I did not show them."

ekegusii: Elisha omobani akarangeria oyomo bwa’borokigwa b’ababani, akamotebia, “Esibe ekenema kiao norokini, obogorie echuba ere namaguta, ogende Ramoti o Gileadi.
english: The prophet Elisha summoned a man from the company of the prophets and said to him, "Tuck your cloak into your belt, take this flask of oil with you and go to Ramoth Gilead.

ekegusii: Naende omobani oria akanyora omonto onde, akamotebia, “Nagosabire, ing’ake ong’ite?” Omonto oria akamoaka bokong’u, akamoniarora omobere.
english: The prophet found another man and said, "Strike me, please." So the man struck him and wounded him.

ekegusii: The prophet said to his sons, "Saddle the donkey for me," and they did so.
english: Erio agatebia abamura baye, “Imbekere etigere egeikaransero.” Nabarabwo bagakora bo.

ekegusii: Abaefraimu nigo barenge abarendi ba Nyasae, korende bono babeire emeeto y’obotegi ase chinchera chiabo chionsi; obobisa bwabo nigo bore ime ase enyomba ya Nyasae obo.
english: The prophet, along with my God, is the watchman over Ephraim, yet snares await him on all his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.

ekegusii: Ababani nigo barabe buna embeo ekogusa, tibabwati ring’ana ria Nyasae. Ase ayio barabwo mbakorerwe amang’ana ayio.”
english: The prophets are but wind and the word is not in them; so let what they say be done to them."

ekegusii: Ababani nigo bakobana oborimo, na abakuani nigo bagwancherana namang’ana abo. Abanto baane nigo banchete amang’ana ayio, korende ninki morakore ekero omoerio orache?”
english: The prophets prophesy lies, the priests rule by their own authority, and my people love it this way. But what will you do in the end?

ekegusii: Ogosemeria kw’abanyene oboronge nigo koraikeranigwe ase omogoko, korende okw’abakori amabe nigo korasire.
english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hopes of the wicked come to nothing.

ekegusii: Omonto ore omoenenu na omwerori, na ogokora kwaye kore okw’obomwenu, nigo akorokwa “Omonyacheche”.
english: The proud and arrogant man-- "Mocker" is his name; he behaves with overweening pride.

ekegusii: Eye nero emereng’anio ya Sulemani mosinto o Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:

ekegusii: Eye nemereng’anio ya Sulemani. Omwana omomura omong’aini nigo akogokia ise, korende oyore omoriri nigo akorentera ng’ina omoichano.
english: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.

ekegusii: Omonto omong’aini nigo akororera emechando aare bwebisa, korende oyotamanyeti amange nigo akogenderera gochia bosio oumerana nero, erio ochandeka.
english: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and suffer for it.

ekegusii: The punishment inflicted on him by the majority is sufficient for him.
english: Egesusuro eke omonto onga buna oyio aetwe nabange, nakio kiamoisanete.

ekegusii: Aya nigo abanyorete, ekiagera ebibe biakorire ase omochie bw’abanto baane nigo biarenge ebinene kobua ebi’abanto ba Sodomu, omochie oyio nigo oonchoranetwe ase etagika eyemo, na okoboko kw’onde tikwayokunete.
english: The punishment of my people is greater than that of Sodom, which was overthrown in a moment without a hand turned to help her.

ekegusii: Naende akaroisia chisani ne chigami, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero, ne chimbata chi’ebisieri bi’akanyomba ka ime, Aase Aachenu Mono, na echi’ebisieri bie Hekalu enyene. Ebinto ebio bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase chitahabu chichenire.
english: the pure gold basins, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold sockets for the doors of the innermost room, the Most Holy Place, and also for the doors of the main hall of the temple.

ekegusii: the pure gold lampstand with its row of lamps and all its accessories, and the oil for the light;
english: na ekebekerero gie chitaya gi’etahabu echenire, ne chitaya chiare kobekwa aroro amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na amaguta e chitaya,

ekegusii: naboigo nebinachi, ne chisani, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, ne chindogio chi’okorenta omorero; ebisieri bie Hekalu, ebio bi’Aase Aachenu Mono na ebi’Aase Aachenu biaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu.
english: the pure gold wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and censers; and the gold doors of the temple: the inner doors to the Most Holy Place and the doors of the main hall.

ekegusii: Emeroberio ere ase enkoro y’omonto nigo enga buna amache are ase endiba, korende omonto ore nokomanya nigo akoyabucha korwa aroro.
english: The purposes of a man's heart are deep waters, but a man of understanding draws them out.

ekegusii: Eting’ana ya Irianyi netenene ase rituko ri’ekina amo nabanto b’ekegori eke; ere nabanachere ekina, ekiagera nigo arwete ase chinsinyo chi’ense anyare koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani; na rora, oyobuete Sulemani naiga are.
english: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them; for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon's wisdom, and now one greater than Solomon is here.

ekegusii: Eting’ana ya Irianyi netenene ase ekina amo nabanto b’ekegori eke; ere nabanachere ekina, ekiagera arwete ase chinsinyo chi’ense anyare koigwa obong’aini bwa Sulemani, na rora, oyobuete Sulemani naiga are.
english: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomon's wisdom, and now one greater than Solomon is here.

ekegusii: Eting’ana, ng’ina omoruoti, akaigwa amang’ana aya omoruoti na abanene baria barenge gokwana, erio agasoa ase enyomba eria y’omoyega agateba, “Aye omoruoti ochie kare! Tobaisa gochandeka ase ebirengererio biao, gose obosio bwao boonchoke borachoke.
english: The queen, hearing the voices of the king and his nobles, came into the banquet hall. "O king, live forever!" she said. "Don't be alarmed! Don't look so pale!

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya gotegerera amang’ana omonto omong’aini agokwana ase obotoereru kobua gotegerera amang’ana ’omogambi ogoaka eriogi ase egati y’abanto abariri.
english: The quiet words of the wise are more to be heeded than the shouts of a ruler of fools.

ekegusii: Chinsara nigo chikorutwa chiaba chikwoga goeta igoro yaye, na amatimo akomesa, ne chisimisi boigo.
english: The quiver rattles against his side, along with the flashing spear and lance.

ekegusii: Timoria egesusu, ekiagera nigo gekoria eng’ang’ura, korende tikebwati ebitaago biatananegete; ase ayio tigechenegeti.
english: The rabbit, though it chews the cud, does not have a split hoof; it is unclean for you.

ekegusii: Abanto baria basang’anaine n’Abaisraeli nigo barenge nobotoonu obonene bw’okogania chinyama, na Abaisraeli boigo bakarera bagateba, “Naki totanyora chinyama torie?
english: The rabble with them began to crave other food, and again the Israelites started wailing and said, "If only we had meat to eat!

ekegusii: ee, amache aichoreranete nigo arenge gocha gotomera kegima.
english: the raging waters would have swept us away.

ekegusii: The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell with a great crash."
english: embura egatwa amo nomwaga, na eooro egacha, bigatwoma enyomba eria, ekagwa; okogwa kwaye gokaba okonene.”

ekegusii: embura egatwa amo nomwaga, na eooro egacha, egatwoma enyomba eria, korende tiyagwa, ekiagera oboroso bwaye bwaagachetwe igoro ase egetare.
english: The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because it had its foundation on the rock.

ekegusii: Rigori ri’okobooria omoyo oye nigo rire rinene mono, na mbooria ende teri eraisanere rigori erio,
english: the ransom for a life is costly, no payment is ever enough--

ekegusii: Abatooretigwe n’Omonene mbairane, bache Sayoni bagotera; omogoko o kare na kare nobe igoro ase emetwe yabo; mbabe nomogoko na omochengo. Obororo na omoichano mbiere kegima.
english: The ransomed of the LORD will return. They will enter Zion with singing; everlasting joy will crown their heads. Gladness and joy will overtake them, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.

ekegusii: Ebigonkoru biria bikaba bikomorentera omogati na enyama, mambia na mogoroba; na Elija akaba okonywa amache korwa ase akarooche karia.
english: The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning and bread and meat in the evening, and he drank from the brook.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eye nkagotiga Kirete, erinde oroisie ayaremeteo. Ochore abagaaka ase kera omochie, buna nagochigete.
english: The reason I left you in Crete was that you might straighten out what was left unfinished and appoint elders in every town, as I directed you.

ekegusii: Eke nakio kiagerete nkabarikera, erinde mbateeme na komanya gose mwabeire abaigweri ase amang’ana onsi.
english: The reason I wrote you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Tata nanyanchete, ekiagera narure obogima bwane, erinde inyare koboirania naende.
english: The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life-- only to take it up again.

ekegusii: Na bono Farao, okorota kwao nigo gwachete eria kabere, aya nigo akoorokia ng’a Nyasae ochikire amang’ana aya, na Nyasae nayaikeranie iga bwango.
english: The reason the dream was given to Pharaoh in two forms is that the matter has been firmly decided by God, and God will do it soon.

ekegusii: Abasaria nigo bagendererete komenta obobe bwabo, korende bonsi nimbae egesusuro.
english: The rebels are deep in slaughter. I will discipline all of them.

ekegusii: the red kite, any kind of black kite,
english: amakoru na ebisaku biamwabo;

ekegusii: the red kite, the black kite, any kind of falcon,
english: amakoru na ebisaku biamwabo;

ekegusii: Ensemo eria bamenyete nigo yachakerete Mesa gochia Sefari, ase ebitunwa bia moocha.
english: The region where they lived stretched from Mesha toward Sephar, in the eastern hill country.

ekegusii: Abanto bamwabo be chiamate chionsi chia Isakaru nigo barenge abakong’u ase esegi. Bonsi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na etato na isano na ibere (87,000), buna barigetwe ase chinderia chiabo.
english: The relatives who were fighting men belonging to all the clans of Issachar, as listed in their genealogy, were 87,000 in all.

ekegusii: Abatigari b’Abaisraeli tibagokora ayare amabe, gose tibagokwana oborimo; chinkwana chi’obong’ainereria tichikorua ase emenwa yabo. Mbabe bakoragera na korara, na onde tari araboboyie.”
english: The remnant of Israel will do no wrong; they will speak no lies, nor will deceit be found in their mouths. They will eat and lie down and no one will make them afraid."

ekegusii: Ee, abatigari abwo ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, babe buna endo ere ase egati ye ching’iti chire ase rinani, na buna endo ensae ere ase egati ye riicho rie ching’ondi, eyio ekero yasoire ase riicho nigo egotachera inse na gotandorana eyaitire, na onde tari oranyare koyetooria.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which mauls and mangles as it goes, and no one can rescue.

ekegusii: Erio abatigari ba Yakobo mbabe ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebinge, buna riime rigotonya korwa ase Omonene, na buna embura engiya egotwera obonyansi, embura eria tegotebana koganya monto gete, gose mwanyabanto onde bwensi.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.

ekegusii: Ababwatetie Meremoti koagacha nabakuani abamenyete ase ense omweya.
english: The repairs next to him were made by the priests from the surrounding region.

ekegusii: Bakamotomera amang’ana arikire iga: “Ase Dario omoruoti, omorembe bwonsi obe asore!
english: The report they sent him read as follows: To King Darius: Cordial greetings.

ekegusii: Nkaa ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase ensemo eyatigarete ase ense ya Gileadi, amo na Basani yonsi, eyio yarenge obogambi bwa Ogi. Orwo narwo orogongo rwonsi rw’Arigobu.” (Basani yonsi nigo yarenge korokwa ense ya Refaimu.
english: The rest of Gilead and also all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh. (The whole region of Argob in Bashan used to be known as a land of the Rephaites.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Kohati abatigarete bakaegwa emechie ikomi ase ogoakerwa obomera, bakayeegwa korwa ase eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase.
english: The rest of Kohath's descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of half the tribe of Manasseh.

ekegusii: Na Abakohati abatigarete bakanyora emechie ikomi korwa ase chiamate chi’egesaku ki’Efraimu na ekia Dani, na ekeng’ese kia Manase, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
english: The rest of Kohath's descendants were allotted ten towns from the clans of the tribes of Ephraim, Dan and half of Manasseh.

ekegusii: Na mwanyabanto abatigarete bataitetwe ase amaakwa ayio tibaonchogete korwa ase emeremo eria bakorete namaboko abo, na tibatiga gosasima ebirecha na emegwekano yakorire korwa ase chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na amagena, na emete, eyio etanyare korora, gose koigwa, gose kogenda.
english: The rest of mankind that were not killed by these plagues still did not repent of the work of their hands; they did not stop worshiping demons, and idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone and wood-- idols that cannot see or hear or walk.

ekegusii: Ekeratigare korwa ase okoruegwa kw’endagera okwo nakobe okwa Haroni na abamura baye. Ekio negechenu mono, ekiagera kiarusigwe korwa ase okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende.
english: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Ekeratigare korwa ase okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera nakebe ekia Haroni na abamura baye. Ekio negechenu mono, ekiagera kiarusigwe korwa ase okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero asende.
english: The rest of the grain offering belongs to Aaron and his sons; it is a most holy part of the offerings made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Abande b’Abaisraeli, na ab’abakuani, na ab’Abalawi, bakaba bamenyete ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda, kera oyomo ase omwando oye.
english: The rest of the Israelites, with the priests and Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, each on his ancestral property.

ekegusii: Abanto be chiamate chinde chi’Abakohati, abarenge Abalawi, bakaegwa emechie korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, buna obomera bwabagwerete.
english: The rest of the Kohathite clans of the Levites were allotted towns from the tribe of Ephraim:

ekegusii: Naende maguta ayagotigara ase oroe rwaye ayaumore igoro ase omotwe bw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa. Ase enchera eyio omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oria agwo ase obosio bwane.
english: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed and make atonement for him before the LORD.

ekegusii: Amaguta agotigara ase oroe rwaye ayaumore ase omotwe bw’omonto oria ogochia gochenwa. Ase enchera eyio akore okobwatanigwa asare, agwo ase obosio bwane.
english: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest shall put on the head of the one to be cleansed, to make atonement for him before the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto bande ekero baraigwe ayio bairoke, tibakora okomocha konga buna okwo ase egati yaino.
english: The rest of the people will hear of this and be afraid, and never again will such an evil thing be done among you.

ekegusii: Abatigari b’Abasiiria bagatama gochia ase omochie o Afeki. Chindwaki chi’omochie oria chikagwera abanto abwo batigarete, chilifu emerongo ebere na isano na ibere (27,000). Beni‐Hadadi boigo agatama, agasoa ase akanyomba ka ime ase omochie.
english: The rest of them escaped to the city of Aphek, where the wall collapsed on twenty-seven thousand of them. And Ben-Hadad fled to the city and hid in an inner room.

ekegusii: Na baria batigarete bagaitwa nomoyio o birende bw’oyoikaransete igoro ase ebarasi eria, omoyio o birende, oria okorua ase omonwa oye. Ne chinyoni chionsi chikaigota ase chinyama chiabo.
english: The rest of them were killed with the sword that came out of the mouth of the rider on the horse, and all the birds gorged themselves on their flesh.

ekegusii: Korende baria abande bakabora, “Tiga torore gose Elija ngocha are komotooria.”
english: The rest said, "Now leave him alone. Let's see if Elijah comes to save him."

ekegusii: na abatigarete bakabwata abasomba baye, bakabakora bobe bakabaita.
english: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them and killed them.

ekegusii: Abaratigare bagende, abande ase chibao, na abande ase ebinto binde bi’emeeri. Naboigo abanto bonsi bagaika ase ense enyomo buya.
english: The rest were to get there on planks or on pieces of the ship. In this way everyone reached land in safety.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, na ab’ekia Gadi, nigo babwate amaicho amange mono. Ekero baroche ense ya Yaeseri na eya Gileadi ng’a nigo chire chingiya ase oborisia,
english: The Reubenites and Gadites, who had very large herds and flocks, saw that the lands of Jazer and Gilead were suitable for livestock.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Reuben, na aba Gadi, na ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, nigo babwate abanto chituoni barenge kobogoria chinguba na emioro, naende nigo bamanyete korasa nemegwe abanto abang’aini ase esegi. Abwo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na inye, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etano nomo (44,760), nigo barenge bebegete ang’e korwana esegi.
english: The Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh had 44,760 men ready for military service-- able-bodied men who could handle shield and sword, who could use a bow, and who were trained for battle.

ekegusii: Oko nokomaanoka kwa Yeso Kristo oko Nyasae amoete, erinde orokie abasomba baye amang’ana agwenerete gocha gokoreka bwango. Ase ogotoma omomalaika oye akorokia omosomba oye Yohana,
english: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show his servants what must soon take place. He made it known by sending his angel to his servant John,

ekegusii: Oyore omonda takorua goetania ekeng’ese gi’esekeli, gose oyore omotaka takorua inse y’ekio, ekero morarue ekeegwa ekio ase Omonene. Kerokio kebe embooria ase obogima bwaino.
english: The rich are not to give more than a half shekel and the poor are not to give less when you make the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives.

ekegusii: Oria omonda nigo abwate ching’ondi ne chiombe chinyinge mono.
english: The rich man had a very large number of sheep and cattle,

ekegusii: Omonto omonda nigo akogambera omotaka; na omonto ogosaba aegwe singo nigo akoba omosomba bw’oria omoa singo.
english: The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo agwechandera oboronge bw’abataka, korende omokori amabe tamanyeti kende.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor, but the wicked have no such concern.

ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bakorera ng’a bakonywe, Omonene nigo akobaigwa na kobatooria korwa ase emechando yabo yonsi.
english: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears them; he delivers them from all their troubles.

ekegusii: Omonto otari omoronge nigo are okogechia ase oyo ore omoronge, na oyore nenkoro endonge nigo are okogechia ase omokori amabe.
english: The righteous detest the dishonest; the wicked detest the upright.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo abwate endagera ekomoisanekia, korende enda y’omokori amabe nigo ekogenderera kogania.
english: The righteous eat to their hearts' content, but the stomach of the wicked goes hungry.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo agechete oborimo, korende omokori amabe nigo agokora ay’okogechia na ay’obosooku.
english: The righteous hate what is false, but the wicked bring shame and disgrace.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akorusigwa ase emechando, erio omokori amabe osoa ase emechando ribaga riaye.
english: The righteous man is rescued from trouble, and it comes on the wicked instead.

ekegusii: Omonto omonyene oboronge obwatetie chinchera chindonge, abana baye mbasesenigwe korwa nyuma yaye.
english: The righteous man leads a blameless life; blessed are his children after him.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nigo akorigereria enyomba y’omokori amabe; ere nigo akoiyeria abakori amabe inse basire.
english: The Righteous One takes note of the house of the wicked and brings the wicked to ruin.

ekegusii: Omonto omonyene oboronge nigo agosira, na monto onde tari okorengereria igoro y’ayio; abegenwa b’Omonene nigo bakorusigwao, na monto onde takomanya engencho yaye. Omonyene oboronge nigo akorusigwa korwa ase obobe,
english: The righteous perish, and no one ponders it in his heart; devout men are taken away, and no one understands that the righteous are taken away to be spared from evil.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge nagoke ekero egesiomba kegoakanwa, natiringe amanyinga ’abanto abanyabibe.
english: The righteous will be glad when they are avenged, when they bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge naseboke buna omokendo, nakine buna omocharake o Lebanoni.
english: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;

ekegusii: Abanyene oboronge mbaire ense ebe eyabo, erio bagenderere komenyao botambe.
english: the righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

ekegusii: Omonyene oboronge takonyegerigwa, korende omokori amabe takogenderera komenya ase ense.
english: The righteous will never be uprooted, but the wicked will not remain in the land.

ekegusii: The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at him, saying,
english: Abanyene oboronge mbarore ayio boboe, bamosekerere batebe,

ekegusii: Oboronge bw’omonto omoikeranu nigo borarongeyie chinchera chiaye, korende omokori amabe, obobe bwaye mbomoiyerie.
english: The righteousness of the blameless makes a straight way for them, but the wicked are brought down by their own wickedness.

ekegusii: Oboronge bw’abanto bare ne chinkoro chindonge mbobatoorie, korende abasaria nigo barabwatwe nokogania kwabo okobe.
english: The righteousness of the upright delivers them, but the unfaithful are trapped by evil desires.

ekegusii: The rings are to be close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.
english: ang’e norosingo; na emiaro esoigwe imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.

ekegusii: Chibonyi chiria chibekire ase egesembe chibwateranigwe ne chibonyi chi’egesibao neusi eburu; erio egesembe keria kebeere orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka.
english: The rings of the breastpiece are to be tied to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband, so that the breastpiece will not swing out from the ephod.

ekegusii: The rings were put close to the rim to hold the poles used in carrying the table.
english: Chibonyi chiria chikabekwa ang’e norosingo, na emiaro eria egasoigwa imeo, erinde emesa enyare kobogorerigwa.

ekegusii: naende ng’a ebiambokero biabwatirwe, amaagacho ogwekengera asambirwe nomorero, na abarwani esegi baondokire.
english: the river crossings seized, the marshes set on fire, and the soldiers terrified."

ekegusii: Ebiita bire ase chindooche biaigoirwe, enka y’omoruoti yaichoirwe nomoondoko.
english: The river gates are thrown open and the palace collapses.

ekegusii: Orooche rwa Kisoni rokabaira, orwo norooche rwa kare rwa Kisoni. Omoyo one, genderera ne chinguru!
english: The river Kishon swept them away, the age-old river, the river Kishon. March on, my soul; be strong!

ekegusii: Chinchera chikogenda Sayoni nigo chiichanete, ekiagera onde tari ogocha ase Amatuko Amanene achikire; ebiita biaye bionsi nigo bitigarete bosa, na abakuani baye bonsi nigo baichanete. Abaiseke baye abekungi nigo baumatete, na omochie omonyene nigo ore nobororo obonge.
english: The roads to Zion mourn, for no one comes to her appointed feasts. All her gateways are desolate, her priests groan, her maidens grieve, and she is in bitter anguish.

ekegusii: Ase ayio eriomana rie chisegi ndibe ase egati y’abanto baino, ne chiburi chiaino chisarigwe, buna omoruoti Salimani asaretie Beti‐Aribeli ase rituko riria ri’esegi, abang’ina amo nabana babo banachanetwe bakaba ebing’ese.
english: the roar of battle will rise against your people, so that all your fortresses will be devastated-- as Shalman devastated Beth Arbel on the day of battle, when mothers were dashed to the ground with their children.

ekegusii: Ekeranya na ogotogonyera ase okorongeyia nigo bikorenta obong’aini, korende omwana ogotigwa okora buna anchete, nigo akorentera ng’ina obosooku.
english: The rod of correction imparts wisdom, but a child left to himself disgraces his mother.

ekegusii: Ebinyomba ebio biaagachetwe ase rirongo ria gatato tibiabwate chisiiro buna chigoora. Ase ayio ebinyomba bia igoro nigo biarenge ebieng’e gochia ime kobua ebia inse na ebia gati.
english: The rooms on the third floor had no pillars, as the courts had; so they were smaller in floor space than those on the lower and middle floors.

ekegusii: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.
english: Renda omote oyo gwasimegete nokoboko kwao gw’okorio, orosagia orwo gwechoreire na korobeka chinguru.

ekegusii: Abanene bonsi b’oboruoti, na abagambi bonsi be chingongo, na abagambi baria abanene, na abasemia, na abagavuna, bancheranire ng’a aye omoruoti obeke richiko na okaane bokong’u ng’a monto onde bwensi tabaisa gosaba enyasae ende yonsi, gose omonto onde, otatiga aye bweka aye omoruoti, ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato. Aise gokora ayio, rirorio arutwe ase engoro ye chindo.
english: The royal administrators, prefects, satraps, advisers and governors have all agreed that the king should issue an edict and enforce the decree that anyone who prays to any god or man during the next thirty days, except to you, O king, shall be thrown into the lions' den.

ekegusii: Omosike oria akamotebia, “Omonene, tirimboka ritang’ani omwana one atarakwa.”
english: The royal official said, "Sir, come down before my child dies."

ekegusii: Omochie oyio obwate eburu‐buru otagoirwe; kera enyomba ereo yasiekirwe, monto onde tari ogosoa aroro.
english: The ruined city lies desolate; the entrance to every house is barred.

ekegusii: Abanto abatang’ani b’Abafilisti bakagenda ase omokungu oria, bakamotebia, “Gachie omoebererie Samison agotebie obobisi bwe chinguru chiaye, naende buna toranyare komobua; erio tonyare komosiba na komobeka inse asetore. Kera oyomo asetore nakoe chisekeli chie chifeta elifu eyemo ne rigana erimo.”
english: The rulers of the Philistines went to her and said, "See if you can lure him into showing you the secret of his great strength and how we can overpower him so we may tie him up and subdue him. Each one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver."

ekegusii: The ruthless will vanish, the mockers will disappear, and all who have an eye for evil will be cut down--
english: Abakoirokia abande mbasirigwe, na abachecheria tibakobao; abwo bonsi bakorigia gokora amabe mbaitwe tibabao.

ekegusii: Ekeng’wanso ki’omokori amabe nigo kere okogechia, Inee, tari bobe mono goetania ekero agokerua nebirengererio ebibe?
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is detestable-- how much more so when brought with evil intent!

ekegusii: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.
english: Ebing’wanso biancheire na Nyasae nemioyo emekanyeku; enkoro yabunekire na gwekeyia, aye Nyasae, tokoyechaya.

ekegusii: Ogotooreka kw’abanyaboronge nigo gokorwa ase Omonene, ere nere obotamero bwabo ase chingaki chi’emechando.
english: The salvation of the righteous comes from the LORD; he is their stronghold in time of trouble.

ekegusii: Nabo omokungu oria bw’Abasamaria akamoboria, “Naki yaba aye Omoyahudi ogonsaba amache, na inche nomokungu bw’Abasamaria?” (Abayahudi tibari gosanga n’Abasamaria).
english: The Samaritan woman said to him, "You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?" (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)

ekegusii: Ogochika nokomo ase omobiare bw’Abaisraeli na omomenyi oyomenyete ase egati yaino.”
english: The same law applies to the native-born and to the alien living among you."

ekegusii: Ogochika nokomo, na omoroberio noyomo, asemore na ase omomenyi omenyete amo nainwe.”
english: The same laws and regulations will apply both to you and to the alien living among you.'"

ekegusii: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.
english: Naboigo noyo o kabere akamotwara, na oyo o gatato, goika bonsi batano na babere bakaera.

ekegusii: na orokini rwe chiusi chi’egatani engiya chisisire, amo ne chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: The sash was of finely twisted linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn-- the work of an embroiderer-- as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: The sayings of Agur son of Jakeh-- an oracle: This man declared to Ithiel, to Ithiel and to Ucal:
english: Aya naro amang’ana ’Aguri, mosinto o Yake o Masa. Omonto oyio agatebia Itieli na Ukali:

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Lemweli omoruoti orokereretigwe na ng’ina:
english: The sayings of King Lemuel-- an oracle his mother taught him:

ekegusii: Enyimbo y’obogambi bw’abakori amabe tekogenderera kogambera omwando bw’abanto abaronge; abwo babaise korambora amaboko abo ase ogokora amabe.
english: The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land allotted to the righteous, for then the righteous might use their hands to do evil.

ekegusii: Enyimbo y’obogambi tekorua o Yuda, gose omobeki amachiko ase ororereria rwaye, goika achiche oyo orabogorie obogambi, oyo abanto b’ebisaku bionsi baraigwere.
english: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs and the obedience of the nations is his.

ekegusii: Ebirengererio bi’oboriri nebibe, na omonyacheche nigo are okogechia ase abanto.
english: The schemes of folly are sin, and men detest a mocker.

ekegusii: Ebirwanero bi’omong’ainereria nigo bire ebi’obobe; ere nigo agokora emeroberio y’obosooku gosiria abachandegete ase okobatebera oborimo, nonya nekero barabwo bagokwana ay’oboronge bwabo.
english: The scoundrel's methods are wicked, he makes up evil schemes to destroy the poor with lies, even when the plea of the needy is just.

ekegusii: Semaya, mosinto o Netaneli Omolawi, akarika amarieta abo agwo ekero omoruoti na abanene abarenge komokonya, na Zadoki omokuani, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’abakuani, na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Chiamate chigachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera, eyemo korwa ase ororeria rw’Eleazari, na eyende korwa ase orwa Itamari.
english: The scribe Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, recorded their names in the presence of the king and of the officials: Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites-- one family being taken from Eleazar and then one from Ithamar.

ekegusii: Korende ayio amariko aroche korwa kare, ng’a Nyasae nae abanto b’Ebisaku oboronge ase okwegena. Ase ayio akaranderia Ibrahimu enchili kare, akabora, “Asore aye abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabasesenigwe.”
english: The Scripture foresaw that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, and announced the gospel in advance to Abraham: "All nations will be blessed through you."

ekegusii: Akaegwa ebuku y’omobani Isaya. Nabo akaigora ebuku eyio, akanyora aase arikire,
english: The scroll of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. Unrolling it, he found the place where it is written:

ekegusii: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;
english: na egetuba ekenene ekemo amo nemegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere ekabekwa inse y’egetuba keria,

ekegusii: the Sea and the twelve bulls under it;
english: na egetuba ekenene ekemo amo nemegwekano ye chiombe,

ekegusii: Enyancha ekarusia abakure abarenge ime yaye. Amakweri na aase abakure bikarusia abakure abarenge ime aroro. Barabwo bakagambigwa koreng’ana buna ogokora kwabo kwarenge.
english: The sea gave up the dead that were in it, and death and Hades gave up the dead that were in them, and each person was judged according to what he had done.

ekegusii: Enyancha neyaye, ekiagera nere oyetongete, okoboko kwaye nakwo kwabombete ense enyomo.
english: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.

ekegusii: The sea looked and fled, the Jordan turned back;
english: Enyancha ekarora ayio egatama, na orooche rwa Yorodan rokanacheka, rokairana nyuma.

ekegusii: Egetuba keria giaterekereretwe igoro y’emegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere. Chiombe isato chikarigereria gochia sugusu, na isato gochia bosongo, na isato gochia irianyi, na isato gochia moocha; chinsemo chiabo chia nyuma chikarigereria gochia gati‐gati inse y’egetuba keria.
english: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.

ekegusii: Egetuba keria nigo kiabekereire igoro ase emegwekano ye chiombe ikomi na ibere; isato chikarigereria sugusu, na isato bosongo, na isato irianyi, na isato moocha. Egetuba keria nigo kiabegetwe igoro ase chirochio; chinsemo chiabo chia nyuma chikarigereria gochia gati‐gati, inse y’egetuba keria.
english: The Sea stood on twelve bulls, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south and three facing east. The Sea rested on top of them, and their hindquarters were toward the center.

ekegusii: Erio abanto baria bakamoboria, “Ngento ki tokogokorera, erinde enyancha etotoerere?” Ekembugu‐mbugu keria nigo kiagendererete kona‐koburukania enyancha mono goetania.
english: The sea was getting rougher and rougher. So they asked him, "What should we do to you to make the sea calm down for us?"

ekegusii: Enyancha yaumokire igoro ase Babeli, emerindo y’enyancha yayetubire.
english: The sea will rise over Babylon; its roaring waves will cover her.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, amache aimokereire igoro, amache nkoeera are neriogi, ee, aimokereirie emerindo yaye igoro.
english: The seas have lifted up, O LORD, the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.

ekegusii: Omomalaika o kabere agaitera egetaabo kiaye ase enyancha ime, na enyancha ekaonchoka ekaba amanyinga buna ay’omonto okure, na ebitongwa bionsi bire moyo ase enyancha ime bigakwa.
english: The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea, and it turned into blood like that of a dead man, and every living thing in the sea died.

ekegusii: Omomalaika o kabere akabugia egetureri kiaye. Erio egento keng’ana ekegoro ekenene kegwoka omorero gekarutwa ase enyancha.
english: The second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a huge mountain, all ablaze, was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned into blood,

ekegusii: Omokerubi oria onde boigo nigo arenge bw’ekerengo ekio ekio. Abakerubi bonsi babere nigo barenge bareng’aine kegima ase ekerengo na bagwekaine ase ekieni.
english: The second cherub also measured ten cubits, for the two cherubim were identical in size and shape.

ekegusii: Ekeombe kende ki’abateri baria barenge gotera amatera ay’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, bakagenda gochia ensemo y’okobee igoro ase orwaki roria, na inche amo nekeng’ese ki’abanto tokababwatia, tokagenda goetera ase Omorobiri bw’Eriko, gochia ase Orwaki Orogare.
english: The second choir proceeded in the opposite direction. I followed them on top of the wall, together with half the people-- past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall,

ekegusii: The second is this: 'Love your neighbor as yourself.' There is no commandment greater than these."
english: Na ogwa kabere nakwo oko: Mwanche omogisangio oo buna bweanchete. Amachiko ande tari amanene kobua aya.”

ekegusii: Obomera bwa kabere bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simeoni. Omwando obo nigo orenge gati‐gati y’omwando bw’egesaku kia Yuda.
english: The second lot came out for the tribe of Simeon, clan by clan. Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah.

ekegusii: Na oyo o kabere akamotwara, agakwa; nonya nere tatiga abana; nonya noyo o gatato boigo.
english: The second one married the widow, but he also died, leaving no child. It was the same with the third.

ekegusii: Na omwana o kabere akamoroka Efraimu, agateba, “Nyasae ong’eire oroiboro ase ense y’emechando yane.”
english: The second son he named Ephraim and said, "It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering."

ekegusii: Obobe bwa kabere bwaetire, rora, obobe bwa gatato ngocha bore bwango.
english: The second woe has passed; the third woe is coming soon.

ekegusii: “Amang’ana a bobisi nigo are ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, korende ayio amaanoirwe nigo are asetore na ase abana baito kogenderera botambe, naintwe goika tokore amang’ana onsi arikire ase amachiko aya.
english: The secret things belong to the LORD our God, but the things revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may follow all the words of this law.

ekegusii: Na echio chiagwete ase amagwa, aba nabwo bakoriigwa, na barabwo kobakogenderera bamigwa nokorengereria kw’enibo, na omogoko bw’ense eye, tibakwama ase ogoikerania.
english: The seed that fell among thorns stands for those who hear, but as they go on their way they are choked by life's worries, riches and pleasures, and they do not mature.

ekegusii: Chimbusuro chiomeire ase riroba ime; ebiage biatigaire bosa na ebigancha biasarekire, ekiagera endagera yaborire.
english: The seeds are shriveled beneath the clods. The storehouses are in ruins, the granaries have been broken down, for the grain has dried up.

ekegusii: Abarori mbasookigwe, na abaringoria boigo. Abwo bonsi mbatube emenwa yabo, ekiagera Nyasae takobairaneria gento kende.
english: The seers will be ashamed and the diviners disgraced. They will all cover their faces because there is no answer from God."

ekegusii: Omoonia tari gocha koiranerigwa egento ekio aoonetie nonya ogendererete koba moyo. Aya abanetwe igoro y’omoganda bwonsi tagotigwa taikeranigwa. Onde tari ase abwo bagokora ebibe oranyare gotooria obogima bwaye.
english: The seller will not recover the land he has sold as long as both of them live, for the vision concerning the whole crowd will not be reversed. Because of their sins, not one of them will preserve his life.

ekegusii: Omonto omoriri takonyara kobimanya, na oyo otari nobong’aini takonyara komanya amang’ana buna ayio.
english: The senseless man does not know, fools do not understand,

ekegusii: Omosomba oria akamoiraneria naende, “Rora, nimbwate aa akang’ese gi’esekeli y’efeta. Eye ning’ee omonto oria o Nyasae, erinde atotebie enchera tokogenda.”
english: The servant answered him again. "Look," he said, "I have a quarter of a shekel of silver. I will give it to the man of God so that he will tell us what way to take."

ekegusii: Omosomba oria akamoiraneria, “Aande, omokungu oria atancheraneti gocha amo nainche goika ase ense eye; Inee, nigo ndaire omwana oo goika ase ense eria kwarwete?”
english: The servant asked him, "What if the woman is unwilling to come back with me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the country you came from?"

ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akaminyoka bwango gochia komorotota, akamosaba, “Koranche, ong’e amache inywe.”
english: The servant hurried to meet her and said, "Please give me a little water from your jar."

ekegusii: Omonene bw’omosomba oria agasogwa namabera, akamosibora, akamwabera ase esira yaye.
english: The servant's master took pity on him, canceled the debt and let him go.

ekegusii: Ekero konya okwebeka ang’e gwakorirwe, abakuani bagatenena aase abo, na Abalawi ase ebiombe biabo, koreng’ana buna omoruoti achigete.
english: The service was arranged and the priests stood in their places with the Levites in their divisions as the king had ordered.

ekegusii: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years; it is one and the same dream.
english: Chiombe chiria chingiya isano na ibere, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere, na ebigara biria ebiya bitano na bibere, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere; chindoto echio nechimo.

ekegusii: Ne chiombe chiria isano na ibere chimbe chindeu, chiachitunyanete chiria chinoru, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere, na ebigara biria bitano na bibere bitaamete, biasusanirie nomwaga ore korwa moocha, eyio nemiaka etano na ebere y’enchara.
english: The seven lean, ugly cows that came up afterward are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind: They are seven years of famine.

ekegusii: Abakuani baria batano na babere ababwate ebitureri bi’omochengo bitano na bibere, bakabibugia kobakogenda, bare bosio bw’Esanduku y’Omonene. Abanto ababwate ebirwanero bi’esegi bakabatang’ana, na abarwani bande bakabwatia Esanduku eria y’Omonene korwa nyuma. Ebitureri biria bikabugigwa kogenderera.
english: The seven priests carrying the seven trumpets went forward, marching before the ark of the LORD and blowing the trumpets. The armed men went ahead of them and the rear guard followed the ark of the LORD, while the trumpets kept sounding.

ekegusii: Emiaka eria etano na ebere y’omoigoto ekaera ase ense ya Misiri,
english: The seven years of abundance in Egypt came to an end,

ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatano na kabere bokagwera Hesiri, na obwa ikomi na gatano na gatato Hapisesi;
english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na kabere bokagwera Yosibekasa; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano na kabere agaitera egetaabo kiaye igoro ase embeo bosa, na eriogi rinene rikarua ase Hekalu korwa ase ekerogo keria ki’obonene, rigoteba, “Aikire gokoreka!”
english: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air, and out of the temple came a loud voice from the throne, saying, "It is done!"

ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano na kabere akabugia egetureri kiaye. Erio amariogi amanene akaigugwa igoro, agoteba, “Oboruoti bw’ense bwabeire oboruoti bw’Omonene oito, na obwa Kristo oye, ere nagambe goika kare na kare.”
english: The seventh angel sounded his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, which said: "The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ, and he will reign for ever and ever."

ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano na kabere bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku kia Dani.
english: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of Dan, clan by clan.

ekegusii: Engaki ya gatano na kabere, abakuani kobagendererete kobugia ebitureri, Yoshua agatebia abanto, “Aka eriogi ri’esegi, ekiagera Omonene obaeire omochie oyo!
english: The seventh time around, when the priests sounded the trumpet blast, Joshua commanded the people, "Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!

ekegusii: Na ase entunda ya gatano na kabere omosomba oria agateba, “Narorire riire rike buna egesanyi gi’okoboko kw’omonto rikoimoka korwa ase enyancha.” Erio Elija akamotebia, “Genda otebie Ahabu abeke egari yaye ang’e, atirimboke, embura tebaisa komotanga.”
english: The seventh time the servant reported, "A cloud as small as a man's hand is rising from the sea." So Elijah said, "Go and tell Ahab, 'Hitch up your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.'"

ekegusii: obwa gatano na kabere bokagwera Hakosi, na obwa gatano na gatato Abiya;
english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

ekegusii: Obwa gatano na kabere bokagwera Yesarela; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the seventh to Jesarelah, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na kabere, Helesi, Omopeloni bw’ororeria rw’Efraimu, akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na kabere. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The seventh, for the seventh month, was Helez the Pelonite, an Ephraimite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Baria emerongo etano na ebere bakairana nomogoko, bagateba, “Omonene, nonya nebirecha biatoigwereire ase erieta riao.”
english: The seventy-two returned with joy and said, "Lord, even the demons submit to us in your name."

ekegusii: na egoree eria yabwate amanya, oyio nomoruoti bw’Abagiriki, na orogunchara roria oronene rwarenge gati‐gati y’amaiso aye, oyio nomoruoti obo bwe ritang’ani.
english: The shaggy goat is the king of Greece, and the large horn between his eyes is the first king.

ekegusii: “Ase chibesa, esekeli eyemo nigo ebwate chigera emerongo ebere; emina eyemo nigo ebwate chisekeli emerongo etano nomo (emerongo ebere, na emerongo ebere na isano, na ikomi na isano).
english: The shekel is to consist of twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels equal one mina.

ekegusii: “Abarisia babeire abariri, tibari korigia oboraai korwa ase Omonene. Ase ayio, tibari kogenderera konyora amaya, riicho riabo rionsi riasiareirwe.
english: The shepherds are senseless and do not inquire of the LORD; so they do not prosper and all their flock is scattered.

ekegusii: Abarisia bakairana, bagotogia Nyasae na komobaka ase amang’ana onsi baigwete, na ayabaroche, buna batebetigwe.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things they had heard and seen, which were just as they had been told.

ekegusii: Abarisia tibakonyora ase baratamere; abanene be riicho tibagotooreka.
english: The shepherds will have nowhere to flee, the leaders of the flock no place to escape.

ekegusii: Chinguba chi’ababisa babo bare chituoni nigo chiabeire chimbariri, abarwani babo b’esegi nigo babegete chianga chimbariri. Chigari chiabo nigo chikomesa buna omorero, ekero chiroberete gocha korwana. Amatimo abo achomeire chintanga chi’emetarakwa nigo agotimitigwa mono.
english: The shields of his soldiers are red; the warriors are clad in scarlet. The metal on the chariots flashes on the day they are made ready; the spears of pine are brandished.

ekegusii: Ekero emeeri yatwometwe na tiyare konyara goeta ase omwaga, tokayetiga etoire ase ekoirwa gochia.
english: The ship was caught by the storm and could not head into the wind; so we gave way to it and were driven along.

ekegusii: Eriogi ri’okorera kw’abagendia chimeeri chiao, nditengechie ense eyio egoetanaine.
english: The shorelands will quake when your seamen cry out.

ekegusii: Supimu na Hupimu nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Iri, naende Abahusi nab’ororeria rw’Aheri.
english: The Shuppites and Huppites were the descendants of Ir, and the Hushites the descendants of Aher.

ekegusii: Ebinyomba biria biaetanaine Hekalu nigo biaagachetwe iga: Ebia inse nigo biarenge ebinyerere, korende ebia gati‐gati na ebia igoro bikagareigwa kobwatia ebitambokero biria. Ase rikere rie Hekalu ebiriinero mbiarengeo ebiare koriinerwa gochia ase rirongo ria gatato goetera ase eria kabere.
english: The side rooms all around the temple were wider at each successive level. The structure surrounding the temple was built in ascending stages, so that the rooms widened as one went upward. A stairway went up from the lowest floor to the top floor through the middle floor.

ekegusii: Ebinyomba ebio biaetanaine Hekalu nigo biarenge namarongo atato, kera rirongo nigo riabwate ebinyomba emerongo etato. Ebitambokero nigo biachomeranirie ase enyasi ye Hekalu, erinde emeriibo y’ebinyomba biria egatoorera aroro, tiyasoete ase enyasi eria ime.
english: The side rooms were on three levels, one above another, thirty on each level. There were ledges all around the wall of the temple to serve as supports for the side rooms, so that the supports were not inserted into the wall of the temple.

ekegusii: Boigo Abasidoni, na Abaameleki, na Abaamoni, abwo bonsi mbabachandete; mokarera asende, na inche nkabatooria korwa ase amaboko abo.
english: the Sidonians, the Amalekites and the Maonites oppressed you and you cried to me for help, did I not save you from their hands?

ekegusii: Aya arorekanete igo arenge ay’okwoboyia, goika Musa agateba, “Nabwatirwe nomoondoko na okoiguswa.”
english: The sight was so terrifying that Moses said, "I am trembling with fear."

ekegusii: Komorarore aya onsi, nigo morasareke ase ebirengererio biaino, mobe buna chiosi.
english: The sights you see will drive you mad.

ekegusii: the signet rings and nose rings,
english: ne chibonyi chire nebimanyererio, na ebigera bie chimioro,

ekegusii: na ebikone biaye, na ogokora kwaye okwo akorete agwo Misiri ase Farao omoruoti, na ase abanto b’ense yaye.
english: the signs he performed and the things he did in the heart of Egypt, both to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his whole country;

ekegusii: Chifeta nechiane, ne chitahabu nechiane. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda atebire.
english: 'The silver is mine and the gold is mine,' declares the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Efeta eyaruetwe nomoganda bw’abwo barigetwe nigo yarenge chikiro chilifu isano, na emerongo etato, na isano (5,035), ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu.
english: The silver obtained from those of the community who were counted in the census was 100 talents and 1,775 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel--

ekegusii: Abatamanyeti amange, oboriri nigo bokoba omwando obo, korende abare nokomanya nigo bakoegwa chisemi chiaba egutwa yabo.
english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

ekegusii: Naki okorengereria koria kw’engencho y’ebibe nobobisa igoro ase Nyasae, ekiagera tikori gwancha koigwera amachiko a Nyasae, gose tikori koyaigwera nonya ng’ake.
english: the sinful mind is hostile to God. It does not submit to God's law, nor can it do so.

ekegusii: Chiamate ch’abateri chigasangererigwa korwa ase chinsemo chionsi chia Yerusalemu, na korwa ase emechie y’Abanetofa.
english: The singers also were brought together from the region around Jerusalem-- from the villages of the Netophathites,

ekegusii: Omoruoti nigo aruete ogochika igoro ase abanto b’eamate eyio, buna barenge gokora emeremo y’amatera agwo ase Hekalu, buna yaganeirie rituko ase rituko.
english: The singers were under the king's orders, which regulated their daily activity.

ekegusii: Abateri nabwo abanto b’ororeria rw’Asafu: rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na batano na batato (128).
english: The singers: the descendants of Asaph 128

ekegusii: Abateri, nabwo abanto b’ororeria rw’Asafu: rigana erimo, na emerongo ene, na batano na batato (148).
english: The singers: the descendants of Asaph 148

ekegusii: Abanyabibe bare Sayoni basoirwe nobwoba; omoondoko obabwatire abwo batamoirogeti Nyasae. “Monto ki oito oranyare koremereria amenye nomorero ogosiria? Ning’o ore asetore oranyare komenya ime ase omorero oyio ogendererete gwoka kare na kare?”
english: The sinners in Zion are terrified; trembling grips the godless: "Who of us can dwell with the consuming fire? Who of us can dwell with everlasting burning?"

ekegusii: Ebibe bi’abanto bande nigo bire maiso marore, biatang’anire gochia ase ekina, korende ebi’abande nigo bikobatunyana korwa nyuma.
english: The sins of some men are obvious, reaching the place of judgment ahead of them; the sins of others trail behind them.

ekegusii: Na omoiseke omwabo Tapenesi akaiborera Hadadi Genubati, omwana omomura. Tapenesi agatacha omwana oyio agwo ase enyomba ya Farao, na Genubati akabeera ase enyomba ya Farao amo nabana abamura ba Farao.
english: The sister of Tahpenes bore him a son named Genubath, whom Tahpenes brought up in the royal palace. There Genubath lived with Pharaoh's own children.

ekegusii: Abanto baria amagana atano na rimo, Abadani, babogoretie ebirwanero bi’esegi, bebegete ang’e, bagatenena ase egeita.
english: The six hundred Danites, armed for battle, stood at the entrance to the gate.

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatano na rimo bokagwera Hanania; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano na rimo agaitera egetaabo kiaye igoro ase orooche roria oronene rokorokwa Eufarati, na amache aye agakama. Erio enchera ekaroiserigwa abaruoti bakorwa moocha bagoetera.
english: The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up to prepare the way for the kings from the East.

ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatano na rimo akabugia egetureri kiaye. Erio nkaigwa eriogi rie chingunchara chiria inye chi’egesasimero gi’etahabu kere ase obosio bwa Nyasae,
english: The sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice coming from the horns of the golden altar that is before God.

ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatano na rimo bokagwera chiamate ch’egesaku kia Nafutali.
english: The sixth lot came out for Naphtali, clan by clan:

ekegusii: the sixth Ozem and the seventh David.
english: Osemu oyo o gatano na rimo, na Daudi oyo o gatano na kabere.

ekegusii: Obwa gatano na rimo bokagwera Bukia; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Oyo o gatano na rimo, Ira, mosinto o Ikesi Omotekoa akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o gatano na rimo. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The sixth, for the sixth month, was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Igoro nekong’e pa, ebe buna etaai, embura tetwa, riroba ri’ense riome rikong’e pa, ribe buna ekioma.
english: The sky over your head will be bronze, the ground beneath you iron.

ekegusii: Igoro ekarusigwa buna ebuku ye risankwa ekoringwa, na kera egetunwa na egesinka gekang’anyigwa korwa aase aye.
english: The sky receded like a scroll, rolling up, and every mountain and island was removed from its place.

ekegusii: Abachandi baria bakagenderera kobabetereria, bagoteba, “Goika mokore kera rituko omobaro bw’amatabori buna konya mogokora ekero mware korenterwa chimboba.”
english: The slave drivers kept pressing them, saying, "Complete the work required of you for each day, just as when you had straw."

ekegusii: Chitoro chi’omokori emeremo nigo chire chingiya mono, neba ng’a nigo abwate egento egeke akoria, gose ebinge; korende obotenenku bw’omonto omonda tibokomotiga arare chitoro.
english: The sleep of a laborer is sweet, whether he eats little or much, but the abundance of a rich man permits him no sleep.

ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, orosa gokobogoria gocha ase omonwa oye.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akobeka okoboko kwaye ase esani y’endagera, gose tagokoimokia gocha ase omonwa oye.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not even bring it back to his mouth!

ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo are omosaneri, korende takonyora kende, korende oyore nomokia nigo agoisanekigwa.
english: The sluggard craves and gets nothing, but the desires of the diligent are fully satisfied.

ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo akwerora ng’a nomong’aini are abuete abanto batano na babere barakwane amang’ana are nengencho.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer discreetly.

ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agoteba, “Endo nere isiko, ee, endo nere ase chinchera chi’omochie.”
english: The sluggard says, "There is a lion in the road, a fierce lion roaming the streets!"

ekegusii: Omonto omworo nigo agoteba, “Endo nere isiko! Nigo ndabaise gochia goiterwa ase chinchera.”
english: The sluggard says, "There is a lion outside!" or, "I will be murdered in the streets!"

ekegusii: Okogania kw’omonto omworo nigo gokomoita okwa, ekiagera nigo akwanga gokora emeremo namaboko aye.
english: The sluggard's craving will be the death of him, because his hands refuse to work.

ekegusii: Abanto batasikiri na abasikire nigo bareng’anetie aroro; omosomba nigo are omosibore korwa ase oyorenge omonene oye.”
english: The small and the great are there, and the slave is freed from his master.

ekegusii: Na erioki ria ubani rigachongororoka gochia igoro amo nogosaba kw’abachenu korwa ase okoboko kw’omomalaika oria ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: The smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, went up before God from the angel's hand.

ekegusii: Chibarasi chi’ababisa baito nigo chikwana korwa Dani, na ase amariogi ay’okwoga gwe chibarasi chiaberi, ense yonsi nigo ekonyegera. Nigo bagocha gosaria ense yaito na ebinto bireo; basarie omochie, basirie nabanto bamenyeteo.
english: The snorting of the enemy's horses is heard from Dan; at the neighing of their stallions the whole land trembles. They have come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who live there."

ekegusii: Amaroba e rigoko nabe amansu asare; abanto bonsi mbamotunyane korwa nyuma, na omobaro bw’abamotang’anerete tori kobareka.
english: The soil in the valley is sweet to him; all men follow after him, and a countless throng goes before him.

ekegusii: The soldiers also came up and mocked him. They offered him wine vinegar
english: Abarwani boigo bakamosekereria, bakamochiera, bakamoa chinkama,

ekegusii: Abarwani bakamoira ime ase enyomba y’ekegambero (nero Praitorio), bagasangererekana amo ekeombe ekegima.
english: The soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called together the whole company of soldiers.

ekegusii: Omoroberio bw’abarwani nigo orenge ng’a baite abasibwa, omonto terema abaise gotama.
english: The soldiers planned to kill the prisoners to prevent any of them from swimming away and escaping.

ekegusii: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.
english: Erio abarwani bakagenda, bakabuna amagoro abo, oyo bwe ritang’ani, na oyo o kabere, abwo babambetwe amo na Yeso.

ekegusii: Korende abanto mbarenta korwa ase ebisakorwa ching’ondi ne chiombe, echio chingiya mono chiaatananetwe ase ogosirigwa; mbachirenta, erinde bachirue chibe ekeng’wanso agwo Giligali ase Omonene, Nyasae oo.”
english: The soldiers took sheep and cattle from the plunder, the best of what was devoted to God, in order to sacrifice them to the LORD your God at Gilgal."

ekegusii: Abarwani bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera ase omotwe, bakamobekera na eanga embariri,
