english: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe

ekegusii: Ere nigo agotobareria obonene bwa Nyasae, na buna Nyasae are, nere naboigo are, naende nigo akobogoria ebinto bionsi ne ring’ana riaye ri’okobua. Gaikire gokora ogosibigwa kw’ebibe, agaikaransa ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’Obonene igoro.
english: The Son is the radiance of God's glory and the exact representation of his being, sustaining all things by his powerful word. After he had provided purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty in heaven.

ekegusii: The son of Aaron who offers the blood and the fat of the fellowship offering shall have the right thigh as his share.
english: Omokuani, omomura o Haroni, oyio orabe okorua amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio ki’omorembe amo nebitinya, nere oraire ekenama keria kia borio kebe egetari kiaye.

ekegusii: bw’Abisua, o Finehasi, bw’Eleazari, o Haroni, omokuani omonene.
english: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest--

ekegusii: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
english: bw’Amaria, bw’Asaria, o Merayoti,

ekegusii: the son of Amminadab, the son of Ram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
english: o Aminadabu, o Admin, o Aramu, o Hezironi, o Peresu, o Yuda,

ekegusii: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
english: bw’Amusi, o Bani, o Semeri,

ekegusii: Omwana omomura bw’Ana nere Dishoni. Abana ba Dishoni nabwo aba: Hamurani na Esibani, Itirani na Kerani.
english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.

ekegusii: The son of Appaim: Ishi, who was the father of Sheshan. Sheshan was the father of Ahlai.
english: Apaimu akaibora Ishi, na Ishi akaibora Sesani, na Sesani akaibora Alai.

ekegusii: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
english: o Kainani, o Arifaksadi, o Shemu, o Nuhu, o Lameki,

ekegusii: Karimi nigo abwate omomura oyomo orenge korokwa Akari oyo ochandete Abaisraeli ase amang’ana ’ebinto biatananetwe na koragererigwa.
english: The son of Carmi: Achar, who brought trouble on Israel by violating the ban on taking devoted things.

ekegusii: The son of Dan: Hushim.
english: Omwana omomura o Dani nere Husimu.

ekegusii: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
english: bw’Elikana, o Yerohamu, bw’Elieli, o Toa,

ekegusii: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
english: bw’Elikana, o Yoeli, bw’Asaria, o Zefania,

ekegusii: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
english: o Enosu, o Seti, o Adamu, o Nyasae.

ekegusii: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
english: bw’Etani, o Sima, o Simei,

ekegusii: Asaria nigo arenge omwana omomura bw’Etani.
english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

ekegusii: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
english: bw’Etini, o Zera, bw’Adaya,

ekegusii: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
english: o Hasabia, bw’Amasia, o Hilikia,

ekegusii: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel;
english: o Isari, o Kohati, o Lawi, o Israeli.

ekegusii: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
english: o Yakobo, o Isaka, o Ibrahimu, o Tera, o Nahori,

ekegusii: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershon, the son of Levi;
english: o Yahati, o Gerisomu, o Lawi.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yediaeli nabwo aba: Bilihani amo nabana baye abamura: Yeusi, na Benjamin, na Ehudi, na Kenaana, na Setani, na Tarisisi, na Ahisahari,
english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish and Ahishahar.

ekegusii: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
english: o Yese, o Obedi, o Boazi, o Salimoni, o Nashoni,

ekegusii: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
english: o Yohana, o Resa, o Serubabeli, o Salatieli, o Neri,

ekegusii: The son of Jonathan: Merib-Baal, who was the father of Micah.
english: Omwana omomura o Yonathani nere Meribu‐Baali; ere akaibora Mika.

ekegusii: The son of Jonathan: Merib-Baal, who was the father of Micah.
english: Yonathani akaibora Meribu‐Baali, na Meribu‐Baali akaibora Mika.

ekegusii: the son of Joshua, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
english: o Yoshua, o Eliezeri, o Yorimu, o Mathati, o Lawi,

ekegusii: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,
english: o Maathi, o Matathia, o Semei, o Yoseki, o Yuda,

ekegusii: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
english: o Mali, o Musi, o Merari, o Lawi.

ekegusii: Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nigo achete okoria na konywa, na barabwo bagoteba: Rora, ere nomonto omoribobe na oyogotinda edivai, omosani bw’abarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe! Na obong’aini bwa Nyasae bwamanyekanire koba oboronge ase abana baye bonsi.”
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, 'Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and "sinners." 'But wisdom is proved right by her actions."

ekegusii: Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto ochire, okoria na konywa, na inwe mogoteba: Rora, nomonto omoribobe, ogotinda edivai, omosani bw’ababangi ebango na abanyene ebibe!
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, 'Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and "sinners."'

ekegusii: ng’a nemogwenerete Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto abekwe ase amaboko ’abanto abanyene ebibe, na kobambwa, na ase rituko ria gatato naboke.”
english: 'The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, be crucified and on the third day be raised again.'"

ekegusii: Ekiagera Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nkogenda are buna yachigetwe; korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria okomorua!”
english: The Son of Man will go as it has been decreed, but woe to that man who betrays him."

ekegusii: Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nkogenda are buna arikeretwe, korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria, Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arurwe nere! Nanga mbuya kobua asare omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.”
english: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born."

ekegusii: Naki Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nkogenda are buna arikeretwe korende obobe nobwaye omonto oria orure Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto. Nanga mbuya asare omonto oria, nonya ataiboretwe.”
english: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born."

ekegusii: Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto natome abamalaika baye, na barabwo nabasangererie na kobarusia korwa ase oboruoti bwaye abakogera abande bagochwe, na abagokora ebibe bonsi,
english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will weed out of his kingdom everything that causes sin and all who do evil.

ekegusii: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
english: o Matathia, o Amos, o Nahum, o Esili, o Nagai,

ekegusii: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melki, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
english: o Mathati, o Lawi, o Meliki, o Yana, o Yusufu,

ekegusii: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
english: o Melea, o Mainani, o Mattatha, o Nathani, o Daudi,

ekegusii: the son of Melki, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,
english: o Meliki, o Adi, o Kosamu, o Elimadamu, o Eri,

ekegusii: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Kenan,
english: o Metusela, o Enoku, o Yaredi, o Malaleeli, o Kainani,

ekegusii: o Mikaeli, o Baseya, o Malikia,
english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malkijah,

ekegusii: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
english: o Serugi, o Ragau, o Pelegi, o Eberi, o Sala,

ekegusii: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
english: o Salumu, o Zadoki, bw’Ahitubu,

ekegusii: The son of Shammai was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
english: Samai akaibora Maoni, na Maoni akaibora Beti‐Suri.

ekegusii: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,
english: o Simeoni, o Yuda, o Yusufu, o Yonam, o Eliakimu,

ekegusii: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
english: o Tahati, bw’Asiri, bw’Ebiasafu, o Kora,

ekegusii: Omonto oria ng’ina arenge Omoisraeli akarama erieta ri’Omonene na koriragereria. Abanto bakamobwata, bakamorenta ase Musa. Ng’ina omonto oyio nigo arenge korokwa Selomiti, omosubati o Debiri bw’egesaku kia Dani.
english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name with a curse; so they brought him to Moses. (His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri the Danite.)

ekegusii: Ulamu nabwate omwana omomura orenge korokwa Bedani. Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gileadi, mosinto o Makiri o Manase.
english: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Makir, the son of Manasseh.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Usi nabwo aba: Isiraya amo nabana baye abamura: Mikaeli, na Obadia, na Yoeli, na Isia, bonsi mbatano; na abwo nigo barenge abateneneri.
english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel and Isshiah. All five of them were chiefs.

ekegusii: The son of Uzziel: Micah; from the sons of Micah: Shamir.
english: Mika bw’ororeria rwa Usieli, na Samiri bw’ororeria rwa Mika;

ekegusii: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
english: o Seraya, o Usi, o Buki,

ekegusii: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
english: o Sufu, bw’Elikana, o Mahati, bw’Amasai,

ekegusii: Omokuani, omomura o Haroni, oyo oakire amaguta na gwatananwa ase okomobwatia, nere orarue okoruegwa okwo asende. Okwo nogochika koragenderere botambe. Okoruegwa okwo nagosambwe gwonsi asende inche Omonene.
english: The son who is to succeed him as anointed priest shall prepare it. It is the LORD's regular share and is to be burned completely.

ekegusii: Omomura o Haroni, oyorabogorie emeremo y’obokuani ase ribaga riaye, goika eboyie chianga echi engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, ekero agochia gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano na gokora emeremo ime y’Aase Aachenu.
english: The son who succeeds him as priest and comes to the Tent of Meeting to minister in the Holy Place is to wear them seven days.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hezironi nabwo aba: Yerameeli na Ramu, na Kelubai.
english: The sons born to Hezron were: Jerahmeel, Ram and Caleb.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ketura, omokungu o sere‐sere o Ibrahimu, nabwo aba: Simurani na Yokisani, Medani na Midiani, Isibaki na Sua. Abana abamura ba Yokisani nabwo Seba na Dedani.
english: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham's concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

ekegusii: na abamura ba Haroni omokuani baute omorero ase egesasimero, bachoke chinko ase omorero oyio.
english: The sons of Aaron the priest are to put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ibrahimu nabwo Isaka na Isumaeli.
english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Amuramu nabwo Haroni na Musa. Haroni agaatananwa koba oyochenegete mono kogenderera botambe. Ere amo nabamura baye babe bagosamba ubani ase obosio bw’Omonene na komokorera, naende babe bagosesenia ase erieta riaye botambe.
english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses. Aaron was set apart, he and his descendants forever, to consecrate the most holy things, to offer sacrifices before the LORD, to minister before him and to pronounce blessings in his name forever.

ekegusii: Na abana b’Aramu nabwo aba: Usi, na Huli, na Geteri, na Masi.
english: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshech.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo Sera.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura b’Aseri nabwo aba: Imuna, na Isiva, na Isivi, na Beria, na omoiseke omwabo nere Sera. Na abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi na Malikieli.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bekeri nabwo aba: Semira, na Yoashi, na Eliezeri, na Elioenai, na Omuri, na Yerimoti, na Abiya, na Anatoti, na Alemeti. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abana abamura ba Bekeri.
english: The sons of Beker: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Beker.

ekegusii: The sons of Bela were: Addar, Gera, Abihud,
english: Abamura ba Bela nabwo aba: Adari na Gera, na Abihudi,

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bela nabwo aba: Esiboni, na Usi, na Usieli, na Yerimoti, na Iri. Aba bonsi batano nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, abanto abakong’u ase esegi. Abwo barikire ase omoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na emerongo etato, na bane (22,034).
english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth and Iri, heads of families-- five in all. Their genealogical record listed 22,034 fighting men.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Benjamin nabwo aba: Bela, na Bekeri, na Asibeli, na Gera, na Naamani, na Eki, na Roshi, na Mupimu, na Hupimu, na Aridi.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim and Ard.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Beria nabwo Heberi, na Malikieli, oria orenge ise Birisaiti.
english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, nabwo aba: Iru na Ela, na Naamu; na omwana omomura bw’Ela nere Kenasi.
english: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kalebu omwabo Yerameeli nabwo aba: Mesha, omwana omomura oye omotangi, oyorenge ise Sifu, oyorenge ise Maresa, na Maresa orenge ise Heburoni.
english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel: Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and his son Mareshah, who was the father of Hebron.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kusi nabwo aba: Seba na Havila, Sabuta na Raama, na Sabiteka. Na abana abamura ba Raama nabwo Seba na Dedani.
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

ekegusii: Na abana ba Kusi nabwo aba: Seba, na Havila, na Sabuta, na Raama, na Sabiteka. Na abana ba Raama nabwo aba: Seba na Dedani.
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

ekegusii: The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
english: Na basinto ba Disani nabwo Usi na Arani.

ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Disoni: Hemudani, na Esibani, na Itirani, na Kerani.
english: The sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elionai nabwo aba: Hodawia na Eliasibu, Pelaya na Akubu, Yohanani na Delaya, na Anani; bonsi mbatano na babere.
english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah and Anani-- seven in all.

ekegusii: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz.
english: Na basinto b’Elifasi nabwo aba: Temani na Omari, na Sefo, na Gatamu, na Kenasi.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elifasi nabwo aba: Temani na Omari, Sefo na Gatamu, Kenasi ase Timuna, na Amaleki.
english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz; by Timna: Amalek.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Elipali nabwo Eberi na Misamu, naende Semedi, oria oagachete emechie ya Omo na Lodi amo nebichie biabo.
english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, Shemed (who built Ono and Lod with its surrounding villages),

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Esau nabwo aba: Elifasi na Reueli, Yeusi na Yalamu, na Kora.
english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam and Korah.

ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Reueli, mosinto bw’Esau: Omogambi Nahati, na omogambi Zera, na omogambi Sama, na omogambi Miza. Aba nabwo barenge abagambi korwa ase ororeria rwa Reueli ase ense y’Edomu. Aba nabwo abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.
english: The sons of Esau's son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the chiefs descended from Reuel in Edom; they were grandsons of Esau's wife Basemath.

ekegusii: Na abana aba nabwo abamura ba Oholibama, moga Esau mosubati o Ana, mosinto o Sibeoni: Ere akaiborera Esau Yeusi, na Yalamu, na Kora.
english: The sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam and Korah.

ekegusii: The sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the chiefs descended from Esau's wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
english: Naba nabwo abamura b’Oholibama, moga Esau: Omogambi Yeusi, na omogambi Yalamu, na omogambi Kora. Aba nabwo abagambi baiboretwe na Oholibama, mosubati o Ana moga Esau.

ekegusii: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.
english: Naba nabwo basinto b’Eseri: Bilihani, na Sawani, na Akani.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Eseri nabwo aba: Bilihani na Sawani, na Akani. Abana abamura ba Disani nabwo Usi na Arani.
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Ezara nabwo aba: Yeteri na Meredi, Eferi na Yaloni. Aba nabwo abana ba Bitia, mosubati o Farao, oria Meredi anyuomete: Omoiseke oye nigo are korokwa Miriamu, na abamura nabwo Samai na Isiba, ise abanto b’Esitemoa.
english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. One of Mered's wives gave birth to Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gadi nabwo aba: Sifioni, na Hagi, na Suni, na Esiboni, na Eri, na Arodi, na Areli.
english: The sons of Gad: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi and Areli.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Libini na Simei, ne chiamate chiabo.
english: The sons of Gershon, by clans, were Libni and Shimei.

ekegusii: Abamura ba Nyasae bakarora abaiseke ba mwanyabanto ng’a nigo baare nebieni ebiya, bakenyuomeria ase ogwechorera onde bwensi baganetie.
english: the sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they married any of them they chose.

ekegusii: Na abana ba Gomeri nabwo aba: Asikenasi, na Rifati, na Togama.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Gomeri nabwo aba: Asikenasi na Rifati, na Togarima.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.

ekegusii: Na abana ba Hamu nabwo aba: Kusi, na Misiri, na Putu, na Kanani.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put and Canaan.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hamu nabwo aba: Kusi na Misiri, Putu na Kanani.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put and Canaan.

ekegusii: basinto ba Hasemu korwa Gisoni na Yonathani, mosinto o Sagee, korwa Harari;
english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite,

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Yeria nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Amaria, oyo o kabere, na Yahasieli, oyo o gatato, na Yekameamu, oyo o kane.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Yeria omotangi, na Amaria oyo o kabere, na Yahasieli, oyo o gatato, na Yekameamu oyo o kane;
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third and Jekameam the fourth.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Heburoni nabwo aba: Kora na Tapua, Rekemu na Sema.
english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem and Shema.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hela nabwo aba: Sereti na Isihari, na Etinani.
english: The sons of Helah: Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan,

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Eseki, momura omwabo, nabwo aba: Ulamu, omwana oye omotangi, na Yeusi, oyo o kabere, na Elifeleti, oyo o gatato.
english: The sons of his brother Eshek: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second son and Eliphelet the third.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Helemu, omomura omwabo, nabwo aba: Sofa, na Imuna, na Selesi, na Amali.
english: The sons of his brother Helem: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh and Amal.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Hodia, mosubati omwabo Nahamu, nigo barenge babere, oyomo nigo arenge ise Keila Omogarimi, na oyo o kabere n’Esitemoa bw’Abamaaka.
english: The sons of Hodiah's wife, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Isakaru nabwo aba: Tola, na Pua, na Yasubu, na Simuroni, bonsi mbane.
english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron-- four in all.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Isakaru nabwo aba: Tola, na Pua, na Yobu, na Simuroni.
english: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Isari nabwo aba: Kora, na Nefegi, na Sikiri.
english: The sons of Izhar were Korah, Nepheg and Zicri.

ekegusii: Ase abana ba Isari, Selomiti nere orenge omoteneneri obo.
english: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith was the first.

ekegusii: The sons of Jacob came upon the dead bodies and looted the city where their sister had been defiled.
english: Erio abamura bande ba Yakobo bagachiera abwo baitetwe na bagasakora omochie, ekiagera konya basaririe omoiseke omwabo;

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Raeli, moka Yakobo, nabwo Yusufu na Benjamin.
english: The sons of Jacob's wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yada, momura omwabo Sama, nabwo Yeteri na Yonathani. Yeteri agakwa atabwati abana.
english: The sons of Jada, Shammai's brother: Jether and Jonathan. Jether died without children.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yahadai nabwo aba: Regemu na Yotamu, Gesani na Peleti, Efa na Saafu.
english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah and Shaaph.

ekegusii: Abana ba Yafeti nabwo aba: Gomeri, na Magogu, na Madai, na Yavani, na Tubali, na Mesheki, na Tirasi.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech and Tiras.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yafeti nabwo aba: Gomeri na Magogu, Madai na Yavani, Tubali na Meseki, na Tirasi.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech and Tiras.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yafileti nabwo aba: Pasaki, na Bimuhali, na Asiwati. Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Yafileti.
english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal and Ashvath. These were Japhlet's sons.

ekegusii: Na abana ba Yavani nabwo aba: Elisha, na Tarisisi, na Kitimu, na Rodani.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittim and the Rodanim.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yavani nabwo aba: Elisha na Tarisisi, na Kitimu, na Rodanimu.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittim and the Rodanim.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yehaleleli nabwo aba: Sifu na Zifa, Tiria na Asareli.
english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.

ekegusii: Abamura babere b’Abayehieli, Setamu na Yoeli momura omwabo, abwo bakaba bagotenenera chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: the sons of Jehieli, Zetham and his brother Joel. They were in charge of the treasuries of the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yerameeli, omomura omotangi o Hezironi, nabwo aba: Ramu, omomura oye omotangi, Buna na Oreni, Osemu na Ahiya.
english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron: Ram his firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem and Ahijah.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yeteri nabwo aba: Yefune, na Pisipa, na Ara.
english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispah and Ara.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yonathani nabwo Peleti na Sasa. Aba nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yerameeli.
english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the descendants of Jerahmeel.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yosia nabwo aba: Yohanani, omwana oye omotangi na Yehoyakimu, oyo o kabere, na Zedekia, oyo o gatato, na Salumu, oyo o kane.
english: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second son, Zedekiah the third, Shallum the fourth.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Eri na Onani, na Sela. Aba batato nabwo Batisua, omosubati orwete Kanani, aiborerete Yuda. Eri, omwana omomura omotangi o Yuda, nigo arenge omobe ase obosio bw’Omonene, na Omonene akamoita.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan and Shelah. These three were born to him by a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua. Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the LORD's sight; so the LORD put him to death.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yuda nabwo aba: Eri, na Onani, na Sela, na Peresu, na Zera; korende Eri na Onani bagakwera ase ense ya Kanani. Na abana ba Peresu nabwo Hezironi na Hamuli.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez and Zerah (but Er and Onan had died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kenasi nabwo Otinieli na Seraya; na abamura b’Otinieli nabwo Hatati na Meonotai.
english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu, na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli. Kohati nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etato (133).
english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel. Kohath lived 133 years.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba bane: Amuramu na Isari, Heburoni na Usieli.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel-- four in all.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, Heburoni na Usieli.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Kohati nabwo aba: Amuramu na Isari, na Heburoni, na Usieli.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Kora nabwo aba: Asiri, na Elikana, na Abiasafu. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Kora.
english: The sons of Korah were Assir, Elkanah and Abiasaph. These were the Korahite clans.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ladani nabwo aba batato: Yehieli, omoteneneri obo, na Setamu, na Yoeli.
english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the first, Zetham and Joel-- three in all.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lea nabwo aba: Reuben, omwana omotangi o Yakobo, na Simeoni, na Lawi, na Yuda, na Isakaru, na Sabuloni.
english: The sons of Leah: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Silpa, omoiseke omosomba o Lea, nabwo Gadi na Aseri. Aba nabwo abana abamura Yakobo aiboreretwe agwo Padan‐Aramu.
english: The sons of Leah's maidservant Zilpah: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisoni na Kohati, na Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lawi nabwo aba: Gerisomu na Kohati, na Merari.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

ekegusii: Na basinto ba Lotani nabwo Hori na Hemamu, na mosubati omwabo Lotani nigo arenge korokwa Timuna.
english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan's sister.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Lotani nabwo Hori na Homamu; omosubati omwabo Lotani nigo arenge korokwa Timuna.
english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan's sister.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo.
english: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of Levi according to their records.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Merari ase Yaasia, omwana oye omomura, nabwo aba: Beno na Sohamu, Sakuri na Ibiri.
english: The sons of Merari: from Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur and Ibri.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Omwana omomura o Yaasia nere Beno.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi; na abana abamura ba Mali nabwo Eleazari na Kisi.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Merari nabwo Mali na Musi. Echi nechiamate chi’abanto ba Lawi, chiatoire ase abaise:
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers:

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Mika nabwo aba: Pitoni na Meleki, Tarea na Ahasi.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea and Ahaz.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Mika nabwo aba: Pitoni na Meleki, na Tarea, na Ahasi.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea and Ahaz.

ekegusii: Basinto ba Midiani nabwo aba: Efa, na Eferi, na Hanoki, na Abida, na Elidaa. Abwo bonsi nabwo barenge abana ba Ketura.
english: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Midiani nabwo aba: Efa na Eferi, Hanoki na Abida, na Elidaa. Aba bonsi nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Ketura.
english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musa, omonto o Nyasae, bakabareranigwa amo negesaku kia Lawi.
english: The sons of Moses the man of God were counted as part of the tribe of Levi.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musa nabwo Gerisomu na Eliezeri.
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Musi nabwo aba batato: Mali, na Ederi, na Yeremoti.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth-- three in all.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nadabu nabwo Seledi na Apaimu; Seledi agakwa atabwati abana.
english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim. Seled died without children.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Nafutali nabwo aba: Yaseeli, na Guni, na Yaseri, na Silemu.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nafutali nabwo aba: Yaseeli, na Guni, na Yeseri, na Salumu. Nabwo abanto b’ororeria rwa Bilia.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem--the descendants of Bilhah.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Nearia nabwo aba: Elionai na Hezekia, na Asirikamu; bonsi mbatato.
english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah and Azrikam-- three in all.

ekegusii: Abana ba Nuhu abarwete ase obwato nabwo aba: Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. Hamu nere ise Kanani.
english: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham and Japheth. (Ham was the father of Canaan.)

ekegusii: The sons of Noah: Shem, Ham and Japheth.
english: Lameki akaibora Nuhu, na Nuhu akaibora Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti.

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Onamu nabwo Samai na Yada. Abana abamura ba Samai nabwo Nadabu na Abisuri.
english: The sons of Onam: Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Pedaya nabwo Serubabeli na Simei. Abana abamura ba Serubabeli nabwo Mesulamu na Hanania, na Selomiti nere orenge omoiseke omwabo.
english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah. Shelomith was their sister.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Peresi nabwo Hezironi na Hamuli.
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Raeli nabwo Yusufu na Benjamin.
english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Bilia, omoiseke omosomba o Raeli, nabwo Dani na Nafutali.
english: The sons of Rachel's maidservant Bilhah: Dan and Naphtali.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ramu, omomura omotangi o Yerameeli, nabwo aba: Maasi na Yamini, na Ekeri.
english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel: Maaz, Jamin and Eker.

ekegusii: Reuben nigo arenge omwana omomura omotangi o Israeli. (Korende ekiagera nararete na moga ise, omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi okaegwa abana abamura ba Yusufu, mosinto o Israeli. Korende Yusufu tarikiri ase omoroberio bw’okonyora omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.
english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (he was the firstborn, but when he defiled his father's marriage bed, his rights as firstborn were given to the sons of Joseph son of Israel; so he could not be listed in the genealogical record in accordance with his birthright,

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Reuben, omwana omotangi o Israeli, nabwo aba: Hanoki na Palu, Hezironi na Karimi.
english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Reuben nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi.
english: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Reueli nabwo aba: Nahati na Zera, Sama na Miza.
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto ba Reueli: Nahati, na Zera, na Sama, na Miza. Aba nabwo barenge abachokoro abamura ba Basemati, moga Esau.
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were grandsons of Esau's wife Basemath.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Samweli nabwo Yoeli, omwana oye omotangi, na Abiya, oyo o kabere.
english: The sons of Samuel: Joel the firstborn and Abijah the second son.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Seiri nabwo aba: Lotani na Sobali, Sibeoni na Ana, Dishoni na Eseri, na Disani.
english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer and Dishan.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sela, mosinto o Yuda, nabwo aba: Eri, ise abanto ba Leka, na Laada, ise abanto ba Maresa, na abe chiamate chi’abaroisia ebitambaa bi’egatani agwo Beti‐Asibea;
english: The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth Ashbea,

ekegusii: Abana ba Shemu nabwo aba: Elamu, na Asuri, na Arifaksadi, na Ludi, na Aramu.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Shemu nabwo aba: Elamu na Asuri, Arifakisadi na Ludi, Aramu na Usi, Huli na Geteri, na Mesheki.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshech.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Semaya nabwo aba: Otini na Refaeli, na Obedi, na Elisabadi; boigo Elihu na Semakia, abamura bamwabo Semaya, nigo barenge abamura abakong’u mono ase emeremo yabo.
english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed and Elzabad; his relatives Elihu and Semakiah were also able men.

ekegusii: Abana ba Shemida nabwo aba: Ahiani, na Sekemu, na Liki, na Aniamu.
english: The sons of Shemida were: Ahian, Shechem, Likhi and Aniam.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simei nabwo aba batato: Selomoti na Hasieli na Harani. Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chia Ladani.
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel and Haran-- three in all. These were the heads of the families of Ladan.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Shimoni nabwo aba: Amunoni na Rina, Beni‐Hanani na Tiloni. Abana abamura ba Ishi nabwo Soheti na Beni‐Soheti.
english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-Zoheth.

ekegusii: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
english: Naba nabwo basinto ba Sobali: Alivani, na Manahati, na Sefo, na Onamu.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sobali nabwo aba: Aliani na Manahati, Ebali na Sefo, na Onamu. Na abana abamura ba Sibeoni nabwo Aya na Ana.
english: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Someri, omomura omwabo, nabwo aba: Roga, na Yehuba, na Aramu.
english: The sons of Shomer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah and Aram.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Simeoni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Sauli, omwana bw’omokungu Omokanani. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Simeoni.
english: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman. These were the clans of Simeon.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Simeoni nabwo aba: Yemueli, na Yamini, na Ohadi, na Yakini, na Sohari, na Sauli, omwana bw’omokungu Omokanani.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Tola nabwo aba: Usi na Refaya, na Yerieli, na Yamai, na Ibusamu, na Semueli. Aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate chia Tola, abanto chituoni ase okorwana esegi ase ebigori biabo. Ase amatuko ’okogamba gwa Daudi nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana atano na rimo (22,600).
english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam and Samuel-- heads of their families. During the reign of David, the descendants of Tola listed as fighting men in their genealogy numbered 22,600.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Ulamu nigo barenge abanto chituoni ase esegi, bamanyete koruta emegwe. Nigo babwate abana abamura na abachokoro abamura abange, bonsi nigo barenge rigana erimo, na emerongo etano. Aba bonsi nigo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Benjamin.
english: The sons of Ulam were brave warriors who could handle the bow. They had many sons and grandsons-- 150 in all. All these were the descendants of Benjamin.

ekegusii: Abana ba Ula nabwo aba: Ara, na Hanieli, na Risia.
english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel and Rizia.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo aba: Mishaeli na Elisafani, na Sitiri.
english: The sons of Uzziel were Mishael, Elzaphan and Sithri.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Usieli nabwo Mika, omoteneneri obo, na Isia, oyo o kabere.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the first and Isshiah the second.

ekegusii: Abana b’abwo bagokorerete bobe, mbache asore bagotung’amere na koumama. Abwo bonsi bagochayete mbatung’ame ase amagoro ao; mbakoroke Omochie bw’Omonene, Sayoni bw’Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.”
english: The sons of your oppressors will come bowing before you; all who despise you will bow down at your feet and will call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Sabuloni nabwo aba: Seredi na Eloni, na Yaleeli.
english: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon and Jahleel.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Zera nabwo aba: Simuri na Etani, Hemani na Kalikuli, na Dara, bonsi mbatano.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol and Darda--five in all.

ekegusii: Naba nabwo basinto ba Sibeoni: Aya na Ana. Ana oyo nere onyorete chinsoko chi’amache are morero, ase erooro, ekero arenge korisia chitigere chia Sibeoni ise.
english: The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the desert while he was grazing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Sofa nabwo aba: Sua, na Hareneferi, na Suali, na Beri, na Imura,
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

ekegusii: Abwo bakominyokera chinyasae ching’ao, nigo bakwementera emechando. Tinkoumora okoruegwa kw’amanyinga okwo bakorua, gose tingwatora amarieta abo nebikoba biane.
english: The sorrows of those will increase who run after other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood or take up their names on my lips.

ekegusii: Omonto ogokora ebibe nere orakwe. Omwana tagochandwa ase engencho y’ebibe bia ise, gose ise tagochandwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’omwana oye. Omonyaboronge nanyore eng’eria y’oboronge bwaye, na omonyabibe nanyore eng’eria y’obobe bwaye.
english: The soul who sins is the one who will die. The son will not share the guilt of the father, nor will the father share the guilt of the son. The righteousness of the righteous man will be credited to him, and the wickedness of the wicked will be charged against him.

ekegusii: Eriogi ri’ogoakania chimbaba chi’abakerubi baria rikaigugwa ase eraaro ya isiko, buna eriogi ria Nyasae Omobui ekero agokwana.
english: The sound of the wings of the cherubim could be heard as far away as the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

ekegusii: Nkaigwa na eriogi rie chimbaba chi’ebitongwa biria bire moyo chigokunana, na eriogi ri’amagoro aria arenge mbarabare yabo riarenge buna eri’ogoaka gw’enkoba.
english: the sound of the wings of the living creatures brushing against each other and the sound of the wheels beside them, a loud rumbling sound.

ekegusii: Eriogi ri’okorera riaigwekanire korwa Sayoni, rikobora: “Twasirigwe kegima! Twanyorire obosooku obonene. Goika torue ase ense yaito, ekiagera ababisa batagoire chinyomba chiaito.”
english: The sound of wailing is heard from Zion: 'How ruined we are! How great is our shame! We must leave our land because our houses are in ruins.'"

ekegusii: Korende aase agwo eriogi ri’omogoko na eri’omochengo nariigugwe naende, eriogi ri’omonyuomi na eri’omoriakari, na amariogi ’abateri abwo bagotera ekero bakorenta okoruegwa gw’okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase enyomba y’Omonene. Mbabe bagotera iga:” “Iraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, ekiagera Omonene nomuya, obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete botambe. Inche Omonene ning’iranerie ense obuya bwaye bwe ritang’ani.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those who bring thank offerings to the house of the LORD, saying, "Give thanks to the LORD Almighty, for the LORD is good; his love endures forever." For I will restore the fortunes of the land as they were before,' says the LORD.

ekegusii: Orobebe rwa irianyi nigo rwachakerete ensinyo ya Kiriati‐Yearimu, rokagenderera gochia ensemo ya bosongo, rogaika ase chinsoko chia Nefitoa.
english: The southern side began at the outskirts of Kiriath Jearim on the west, and the boundary came out at the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

ekegusii: Emechie yabo eyarenge ensinyo kegima ya irianyi ang’e norobebe rw’Edomu, nigo yarenge: Kabuseli, na Ederi, na Yaguri,
english: The southernmost towns of the tribe of Judah in the Negev toward the boundary of Edom were: Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae, oyio ogosangereria Abaisraeli abaseretigwe, agoteba: “Ninsangererie abanto bande abaao amo kobua abwo konya basangererigwe.”
english: The Sovereign LORD declares-- he who gathers the exiles of Israel: "I will gather still others to them besides those already gathered."

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae ong’eire oromeme buna orw’abeorokereretie, erio nario ndamanye gokwana ring’ana rikorenta oboremu ase oyo orosire. Emambia ase emambia nigo agontura, otabobora amato aane, nigo agontabobora inyigwe buna oyo okworokererigwa.
english: The Sovereign LORD has given me an instructed tongue, to know the word that sustains the weary. He wakens me morning by morning, wakens my ear to listen like one being taught.

ekegusii: Ee, Omonene Nyasae otinoire amato aane; nainche tinyangeti koigwera, gose tinaonchogete gochia nyuma.
english: The Sovereign LORD has opened my ears, and I have not been rebellious; I have not drawn back.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nigo agoteba iga: “Inche Omonene netianirie ngoteba: Nigo ngechirie noboenenu bw’abanto ba Yakobo, na nigo ngechete chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u. Ase ayio nintige omochie osirigwe amo nebinto bionsi bireo.”
english: The Sovereign LORD has sworn by himself-- the LORD God Almighty declares: "I abhor the pride of Jacob and detest his fortresses; I will deliver up the city and everything in it."

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae otianire ase obochenu bwaye, ogoteba: “Rora, amatuko ngocha are, ababisa baino barabang’use nebigobanio babarusie aiga, na abatigari baino bang’uswe ne chindobio.
english: The Sovereign LORD has sworn by his holiness: "The time will surely come when you will be taken away with hooks, the last of you with fishhooks.

ekegusii: Nyasae oyore Omonene, nere chinguru chiane; nigo agokora amagoro aane abe amaango buna ay’ensune, nigo agontaaria ase ebitunwa biane igoro. Ase omoteria. Ogotera kogoterwa ase okobugigwa kw’amakano aane.
english: The Sovereign LORD is my strength; he makes my feet like the feet of a deer, he enables me to go on the heights. For the director of music. On my stringed instruments.

ekegusii: Abanto baria chirooti bakarora omonto oyomo ogosoka korwa ase omochie oria, bakamotebia, “Tworokie ng’ai toranyare gosoera omochie oyo, naintwe ntogokorere amaya.”
english: the spies saw a man coming out of the city and they said to him, "Show us how to get into the city and we will see that you are treated well."

ekegusii: Omoika na omoriakari nigo bagoteba, “Inchuo!” Na ere oyokoyaigwa, tiga atebe, “Inchuo!” Na ere oyore nerang’o, tiga ache, na oyobwanchete, tiga abogorie amache ’obogima bosa.
english: The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" And let him who hears say, "Come!" Whoever is thirsty, let him come; and whoever wishes, let him take the free gift of the water of life.

ekegusii: Omoika okwanire ase amang’ana akoigweka boronge, ng’a ase ekero ki’omoerio abanto bande mbeatanane korwa ase okwegena ase okoigwera emeika y’obong’ainereria na amorokererio ’ebirecha,
english: The Spirit clearly says that in later times some will abandon the faith and follow deceiving spirits and things taught by demons.

ekegusii: Omoika noro okobeka obogima, omobere togwenereti gento; amang’ana nabatebirie nomoika, naende nobogima.
english: The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life.

ekegusii: Omoika omonyene obeire kirori amo nemeika yaito, ng’a intwe nabana ba Nyasae.
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are God's children.

ekegusii: Ase okorora naetwe, Omoika o Nyasae okanyimokereria igoro, okang’ira ase ense y’Abakalidayo, ase abanto abwo boosetwe barenge. Nyuma y’ayio okorora koria naroche gokarua asende.
english: The Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the exiles in Babylonia in the vision given by the Spirit of God. Then the vision I had seen went up from me,

ekegusii: Omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro y’Asaria, mosinto bw’Odedi.
english: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded.

ekegusii: Omoika o Nyasae noro ontongete, na omoika bw’obomoyo bw’Omonguru noro okong’a obogima.”
english: The Spirit of God has made me; the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro ya Samison, okamobeka chinguru goika agatandora endo eria buna nemanwa y’embori yarenge, nonya tarenge nekerwanero kende gionsi maboko aye. Korende tatebetie abaibori eki akorete.
english: The Spirit of the LORD came upon him in power so that he tore the lion apart with his bare hands as he might have torn a young goat. But he told neither his father nor his mother what he had done.

ekegusii: Omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro asare, na ere akaba omogambi bw’Abaisraeli. Akagenda korwana esegi, na Omonene akabeka Kusani‐Risataimu, omoruoti o Mesopotamia, ase amaboko aye. Otinieli akamobua kegima.
english: The Spirit of the LORD came upon him, so that he became Israel's judge and went to war. The LORD gave Cushan-Rishathaim king of Aram into the hands of Othniel, who overpowered him.

ekegusii: Erio Omoika bw’Omonene noche igoro yao ne chinguru; naye nobane amo nabarabwo, na oonchorwe obe kore ne chingencho ching’ao.
english: The Spirit of the LORD will come upon you in power, and you will prophesy with them; and you will be changed into a different person.

ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene nobeere igoro asare; omoika bw’obong’aini na okomanya, omoika bw’ogosemia na okobua; omoika bwe chisemi na okomoiroka Omonene.
english: The Spirit of the LORD will rest on him-- the Spirit of wisdom and of understanding, the Spirit of counsel and of power, the Spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the LORD--

ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene Nyasae nigo ore igoro yane; ekiagera Omonene ong’akire amaguta, erinde ndanderie abataka amang’ana amaya; ontomire kogwenia abasionoirwe chinkoro chiabo, na ndarie obosibore ase abasibwa, naende inyigorere abanto basibire basoke.
english: The Spirit of the Sovereign LORD is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners,

ekegusii: Omoika bw’ekeene. Ense etanyare komwancha, ekiagera temorochi, nonya nkomomanya. Korende inwe mwamomanyire, ekiagera namenyete amo nainwe, naende nabe ime yaino.
english: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot accept him, because it neither sees him nor knows him. But you know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

ekegusii: Erio gekarera, gekamogaragaria mono gekamorwa. Omwana oria akaba buna oyokure, goika abange bakabora, “Okure.”
english: The spirit shrieked, convulsed him violently and came out. The boy looked so much like a corpse that many said, "He's dead."

ekegusii: Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, okang’ira aase aao, na inche nkagenda inde nobororo bogwoka ase omoika one, korende okoboko kw’Omonene gokambeka chinguru.
english: The Spirit then lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit, with the strong hand of the LORD upon me.

ekegusii: Omoika Omochenu ogantebia ngende amo nabarabwo, timbaisa koba ne chitang’u‐tang’u. Na abaminto aba batano nomo bakagenda amo nainche, togasoa ase enyomba y’omonto oria;
english: The Spirit told me to have no hesitation about going with them. These six brothers also went with me, and we entered the man's house.

ekegusii: Erio Omoika ogatebia Filipo, “Genda ang’e negari eyio, ogende nero.”
english: The Spirit told Philip, "Go to that chariot and stay near it."

ekegusii: Mbire birori bitato: Omoika, na amache, na amanyinga, na ebi bitato nigo bikorua oborori obomo.
english: the Spirit, the water and the blood; and the three are in agreement.

ekegusii: Emeika y’ababani nigo ekoigwera ababani.
english: The spirits of prophets are subject to the control of prophets.

ekegusii: Korende oria orenge bw’omoika, tari oro orenge bwe ritang’ani, korende noria bw’omobere o mwanyabanto orenge bwe ritang’ani; nyuma y’ayio oria bw’omoika.
english: The spiritual did not come first, but the natural, and after that the spiritual.

ekegusii: Omonto ore n’Omoika nigo akomanya onsi, korende ere takomanyigwa na monto onde.
english: The spiritual man makes judgments about all things, but he himself is not subject to any man's judgment:

ekegusii: Buna koreng’ana oborwaire bokoria omobere bw’omonto bwayokoora, naboigo obonene bwe rinani ri’Abaisraeli amo nemegondo yabo ekwama birasirigwe kegima. Omonene nigo arasirie omoyo amo nomobere.
english: The splendor of his forests and fertile fields it will completely destroy, as when a sick man wastes away.

ekegusii: Enyimbo y’omonto oria inche ndachore neseboke. Ase enchera eyio ninkore Abaisraeli batige kwemurungania mamincha yane, naende ningere batige kwemurungania mamincha yaino.”
english: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid myself of this constant grumbling against you by the Israelites."

ekegusii: the stands with their basins;
english: Boigo akaroisia ebibekerero bi’ebituba amo nebituba biaterekereireo,

ekegusii: Ching’enang’eni chire igoro, na ebiombe biamwabo, tichikorua oborabu bwabo; erioba naribe omosunte ekero rigosoka mambia, na omotienyi tokobara.
english: The stars of heaven and their constellations will not show their light. The rising sun will be darkened and the moon will not give its light.

ekegusii: ne ching’enang’eni nachigwe korwa igoro, ne chinguru chire igoro nachitengechigwe.
english: the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.'

ekegusii: Gwachikire oborori bwao ase oboronge, na ase obwegenwa bwonsi.
english: The statutes you have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.

ekegusii: Bono endagera eria egaterekerwa abanto baria barie, korende ekero barenge koyeria, bakarera neriogi, “Aye omonto o Nyasae, obee! Endagera eye yatorenteire amakweri!” Barabwo tibanyara koyeria.
english: The stew was poured out for the men, but as they began to eat it, they cried out, "O man of God, there is death in the pot!" And they could not eat it.

ekegusii: Omonto oria akaira abanto baria nyomba mwa Yusufu, akabaa amache bagesibia amagoro abo, akaa ne chitigere chiabo endagera.
english: The steward took the men into Joseph's house, gave them water to wash their feet and provided fodder for their donkeys.

ekegusii: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
english: Obororo bw’amakweri nebibe, ne chinguru chi’ebibe namachiko.

ekegusii: The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone;
english: Rigena riria abaagachi bangete riabeire rigena rinene ri’ekoona.

ekegusii: The stones of the wall will cry out, and the beams of the woodwork will echo it.
english: Amagena ’enyasi naake eriogi na emiamba ye rirongo neyairanerie.

ekegusii: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.
english: riagonga, na omoneke, na ebisaku biamwabo; enteema bobe na egetabora mato.”

ekegusii: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe and the bat.
english: na amaagonga na ebisaku biamwabo, na enteema bobe, na egetabora mato.

ekegusii: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jehoiachin his son, and Zedekiah.
english: Ororeria rwa Yehoyakimu narwo oro: Yehoyakimu akaibora Yekonia, na Yekonia akaibora Zedekia.

ekegusii: The sun and moon will be darkened, and the stars no longer shine.
english: Erioba na omotienyi mbibekwe omosunte, ne ching’enang’eni tichikobara.

ekegusii: Obonene bw’erioba nigo bore ao, na obonene bw’omotienyi nigo bore ao, na obonene bwe ching’enang’eni nigo bore ao, naende ogwatananekana nkore ase egati ye ching’enang’eni chinyene ase obonene.
english: The sun has one kind of splendor, the moon another and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.

ekegusii: Erioba nigo rigosoka naende riarimera, erio riaayerera gochia aase rigosoka korwa.
english: The sun rises and the sun sets, and hurries back to where it rises.

ekegusii: Ekero erioba rigochia kooroka chiairana, chiagenda korara ase amakuruma abo.
english: The sun rises, and they steal away; they return and lie down in their dens.

ekegusii: Erioba rikaorokera Yakobo kagoeta Penueli, akaba ogosegora, ekiagera ateng’eretigwe enengo y’ebachwa.
english: The sun rose above him as he passed Peniel, and he was limping because of his hip.

ekegusii: Akabeka erioba rigambe mobaso, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: the sun to govern the day, His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi nobe amanyiga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene, erire rinene, na eri’okoondokia, ritaracha.
english: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erioba narionchoke ribe omosunte, na omotienyi nobe amanyinga, ekero rituko riria ri’Omonene ritaracha, rituko erire rinene, na erire maiso marore.
english: The sun will be turned to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the great and glorious day of the Lord.

ekegusii: “Erioba tirigokobareria omobaso ase engaki y’omobaso, gose omotienyi togokoa oborabu ase obotuko, korende Omonene nere orabe omobaso oo o kare na kare; na Nyasae oo nabe obonene bwao bokomeka‐meka.
english: The sun will no more be your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon shine on you, for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

ekegusii: the sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
english: Erioba tirikogoaka omobaso, gose omotienyi obotuko.

ekegusii: Abanto chituoni b’Abakedari, abamanyete koruta chinsara, nigo baratigare abake mono. Inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, natebire amang’ana ayio.”
english: The survivors of the bowmen, the warriors of Kedar, will be few." The LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio abanto bamanyete kominyoka chimbero, mbasinywe gotama, na abwo bare ne chinguru, mbaborwe chinguru, na abarwani esegi bare chituoni, tibagotooria obogima bwabo.
english: The swift will not escape, the strong will not muster their strength, and the warrior will not save his life.

ekegusii: Omoro bw’Omonene oichoirwe namanyinga, otubirwe nebitinya, ee, oichoirwe namanyinga e chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na aye chimbori, na otubirwe nebitinya bie chinyigo chie chimingichi. Omonene ngokora are ekeng’wanso agwo Bosira, na ogoitwa okonene nkobe ase ense y’Abaedomu.
english: The sword of the LORD is bathed in blood, it is covered with fat-- the blood of lambs and goats, fat from the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah and a great slaughter in Edom.

ekegusii: The sword that reaches him has no effect, nor does the spear or the dart or the javelin.
english: Nerutwa omoro oyegwere, tori koyekorera kende, nonya ne ritimo, gose ensara, gose esimisi.

ekegusii: Korende ase engaki eria Eema y’Omonene, eria Musa atenenetie agwo ase erooro, na egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nigo kiarenge agwo aase aimokererete igoro aaria Gibeoni.
english: The tabernacle of the LORD, which Moses had made in the desert, and the altar of burnt offering were at that time on the high place at Gibeon.

ekegusii: nabio ebi: Obomenyo na eema yaye, na egietubo kiaye, ebigobanio ne chibao chiaye, na emeriibo, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo;
english: the tabernacle with its tent and its covering, clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

ekegusii: na emesa amo nebinto bireo, na ekebekerero gie chitaya amo nebikorero biaye, na egesasimero ase ubani egosamberwa,
english: the table and all its articles, the lampstand and its accessories, the altar of incense,

ekegusii: emesa na ebinto birabeo, ekebekerero gie chitaya gi’etahabu echenire na ebikorero biaye na egesasimero ase ubani erasamberwe,
english: the table and its articles, the pure gold lampstand and all its accessories, the altar of incense,

ekegusii: na emesa amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na Emegati eyare koruegwa ase Nyasae,
english: the table with all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

ekegusii: emesa na emiaro yaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi, na emegati eria eraruegwe ase Nyasae;
english: the table with its poles and all its articles and the bread of the Presence;

ekegusii: Chibao echio nigo chiaroisetigwe na Nyasae omonyene, na amariko aya nigo arikire na Nyasae, amang’eire ase chibao chiria.
english: The tablets were the work of God; the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

ekegusii: Omonene, ababisa bao nigo bagonchecheria, ee, nigo bagochecheria amabarato ’omoakwa amaguta oo.
english: the taunts with which your enemies have mocked, O LORD, with which they have mocked every step of your anointed one.

ekegusii: Akarigia konyora amang’ana arenge kogokia, akarika amang’ana ’ekeene ase oboronge.
english: The Teacher searched to find just the right words, and what he wrote was upright and true.

ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariko na abakuani abanene bakarigia komobwata ensa eyio eyio, ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omoreng’anio oria nabwo agoteba, korende bakairoka abanto.
english: The teachers of the law and the chief priests looked for a way to arrest him immediately, because they knew he had spoken this parable against them. But they were afraid of the people.

ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai bakarenta omokungu obwatetwe ase obotomani. Kabamobekire gati‐gati,
english: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before the group

ekegusii: Amorokererio ’omonto omong’aini nigo are ensoko y’obogima, ekiagera nigo agokonya omonto tabwatwa noboreba bw’amakweri.
english: The teaching of the wise is a fountain of life, turning a man from the snares of death.

ekegusii: Ekembugu‐mbugu nigo kegosoka korwa ase chiero chiaye agwo irianyi, na omwaga ore nobokendu orua sugusu oseria amare.
english: The tempest comes out from its chamber, the cold from the driving winds.

ekegusii: Abakori emeremo bonsi be Hekalu, amo nabanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani nigo barenge amagana atato, na emerongo kianda; na babere (392).
english: The temple servants and the descendants of the servants of Solomon 392

ekegusii: Abakori emeremo be Hekalu na abanto b’ororeria rw’abasomba ba Sulemani nigo barenge amagana atato, na emerongo kianda, na babere (392).
english: The temple servants and the descendants of the servants of Solomon 392

ekegusii: Korende abakori emeremo be Hekalu bakamenya agwo Ofeli. Siha na Gisipa nabwo barenge abateneneri b’abwo.
english: The temple servants lived on the hill of Ophel, and Ziha and Gishpa were in charge of them.

ekegusii: Abakori emeremo be Hekalu nabwo aba: Abanto be chiamate chia Siha, na Hasufa, na Tabaoti;
english: The temple servants: the descendants of Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth,

ekegusii: Abakori emeremo be Hekalu nabwo aba: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Siha, na Hasufa, na Tabaoti;
english: The temple servants: the descendants of Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth,

ekegusii: Enyomba eria omoruoti Sulemani aagacherete Omonene nigo yarenge iga: Obotambe bwaye nobw’ekerengo ki’amaboko emerongo etano nomo, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo ebere, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.
english: The temple that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty wide and thirty high.

ekegusii: Enyomba eria ekaagachwa ekaera ase rituko ria gatato ri’omotienyi okorokwa Adari, ase omwaka o gatano na rimo bw’okogamba kwa Dario, omoruoti.
english: The temple was completed on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.

ekegusii: The tempter came to him and said, "If you are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread."
english: Omoteemi agacha, akamotebia, “Onye kore Omwana o Nyasae, tebia amagena aya abe omogati.”

ekegusii: Chingunchara chiria ikomi, abwo nabaruoti ikomi baraoroke, na nyuma yabo omoruoti onde naoroke. Ere nigo arabe nogwatananekana korwa ase abwo bamotang’anerete, nabue abaruoti batato.
english: The ten horns are ten kings who will come from this kingdom. After them another king will arise, different from the earlier ones; he will subdue three kings.

ekegusii: abamura ikomi b’omobisa oria bw’Abayahudi, Hamani, mosinto o Hamedata. Korende tibakunete ebinto biabo kobisakora.
english: the ten sons of Haman son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews. But they did not lay their hands on the plunder.

ekegusii: Naende akaroisia ebibekerero bi’ebituba amo nebituba ikomi biaterekereireo,
english: the ten stands with their ten basins;

ekegusii: Ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo kie rirondia keringwe, getube Obomenyo ase kera rikere riaye.
english: The tent curtains will be a cubit longer on both sides; what is left will hang over the sides of the tabernacle so as to cover it.

ekegusii: Barabwo baroisie Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduku ebe ne chibao chirikire oborori, na Oboikaranso bw’Amabera, na ebinto bionsi bi’Eema eyio,
english: the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony with the atonement cover on it, and all the other furnishings of the tent--

ekegusii: the tent pegs for the tabernacle and for the courtyard, and their ropes;
english: na ebirochi bi’Obomenyo na ebi’eraaro amo ne chingori chiabo,

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi bokagwera Simei; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Oyo o ikomi, Maharai korwa Netofa bw’ororeria rwa Zera akaba omoteneneri bw’ekeombe ki’omotienyi o ikomi. Ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The tenth, for the tenth month, was Maharai the Netophathite, a Zerahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: abanto bamenyete ase chiema chi’Edomu na Abaisumaeli; Abamoabu na Abahagari;
english: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

ekegusii: Chinka chi’abauri nigo chigendererete koba nomorembe, na abwo bagechete Nyasae nigo barendire buya, na enyasae yabo nigo ere ase amaboko abo.”
english: The tents of marauders are undisturbed, and those who provoke God are secure-- those who carry their god in their hands.

ekegusii: nachigete chisokoro chiaino, ekero nachirusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense eria yarenge buna eriko rigosamba. Nigo nabatebetie ng’a kobaranyigwere na bakore onsi aya nabachigete, erio nario baare gocha koba abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.
english: the terms I commanded your forefathers when I brought them out of Egypt, out of the iron-smelting furnace.' I said, 'Obey me and do everything I command you, and you will be my people, and I will be your God.

ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwachakerete Mahanaimu, na nigo rwabwateranetie Basani engima oboruoti bwonsi bw’Ogi, omoruoti o Basani, amo nemechie yonsi emerongo etano nomo ya Yairi agwo Basani.
english: The territory extending from Mahanaim and including all of Bashan, the entire realm of Og king of Bashan-- all the settlements of Jair in Bashan, sixty towns,

ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie omochie bw’Aroeri, ang’e ne rigoko ri’Arinoni, amo nomochie ore gati‐gati ye rigoko, na ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu, yaetanaine Medeba,
english: The territory from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge, and from the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau past Medeba

ekegusii: Orogongo rwabo nigo rwabwateranetie Yaeseri na emechie yonsi ya Gileadi, na ekeng’se gi’ense y’Abaamori goika Aroeri, oyore moocha ya Raba,
english: The territory of Jazer, all the towns of Gilead and half the Ammonite country as far as Aroer, near Rabbah;

ekegusii: Orogongo rwa Manase rogachakera Aseri, rogaika Mikemetati, moocha ya Sekemu. Erio rokagenda gochia irianyi ase abanto b’Eni‐Tapua.
english: The territory of Manasseh extended from Asher to Micmethath east of Shechem. The boundary ran southward from there to include the people living at En Tappuah.

ekegusii: Omwando obo okabwaterania Sora, na Esitaoli, na Iri‐Semesi,
english: The territory of their inheritance included: Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir Shemesh,

ekegusii: Okogosa kwao na oboenenu bw’enkoro yao biakong’ainire. Aye omenyete ime ase emienya y’ebitare, aye obwaterererete egetunwa egetambe, korende nonya koagachete egeswa kiao aaria igoro mono buna ekeongo, inche ninkorusie aroro ngotabokanie gocha inse. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: The terror you inspire and the pride of your heart have deceived you, you who live in the clefts of the rocks, who occupy the heights of the hill. Though you build your nest as high as the eagle's, from there I will bring you down," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Omoibi tagocha, otatiga aibe, na konyenya, na gosaria; inche nigo nachete erio babe nobogima, naende babe naborobwo obonge.
english: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.

ekegusii: Ekenama gekoruegwa, ne ritaana riria rigosungusigwa, birentwe amo nebitinya bikoruegwa ebing’wanso bigosambwa nomorero, bisungusigwe bibe ebing’wanso bi’ogosungusigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene. Ebio nabibe egetari kiao amo neki’abamura bao kogenderera botambe, buna Omonene achigete.”
english: The thigh that was presented and the breast that was waved must be brought with the fat portions of the offerings made by fire, to be waved before the LORD as a wave offering. This will be the regular share for you and your children, as the LORD has commanded."

ekegusii: na ebigara biria ebireu bikaria biria ebinoru bitano na bibere. Inche ngatebia abaringoria, korende onde tari onyarete gontebia engencho y’okorota kwane.”
english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads. I told this to the magicians, but none could explain it to me."

ekegusii: Agwo ebigara ebio ebireu bitano na bibere bikaria biria binde ebinene ebinoru. Farao akaboka, akanyora ng’a nigo are korota.
english: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy, full heads. Then Pharaoh woke up; it had been a dream.

ekegusii: Ekeene ebimanyererio bi’omotomwa bw’ekeene nigo biaorogetigwe egati yaino ase oboremereria bwonsi ase ebikone, na amakumia, na ogokora gwe chinguru.
english: The things that mark an apostle-- signs, wonders and miracles-- were done among you with great perseverance.

ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatato agaitera egetaabo kiaye ase chindooche ime, na ase chinsoko chi’amache, na chirochio chikaonchoka chikaba amanyinga.
english: The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

ekegusii: Omomalaika o gatato akabugia egetureri kiaye. Erio eng’enang’eni enene ekagwa korwa igoro, yare gwoka buna ekieri; ekagwa igoro ase ensemo ya gatato ye chindooche, na igoro ye chinsoko chi’amache.
english: The third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star, blazing like a torch, fell from the sky on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water--

ekegusii: Omoteneneri bw’ekeombe kia gatato, ase omotienyi o gatato, nere Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada omokuani. Benaya nigo arenge omotang’ani omonene, na ekeombe kiaye nigo kiarenge nabanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000).
english: The third army commander, for the third month, was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest. He was chief and there were 24,000 men in his division.

ekegusii: Erio rituko ria gatato nyuma inche konaiboire, omokungu oyo nere akaibora; nintwe tweka babere twarengeo, monto onde omoao tarenge ase enyomba eria.
english: The third day after my child was born, this woman also had a baby. We were alone; there was no one in the house but the two of us.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ekiaare kia gatato ase ororeria rwabo, bancherwe basoe ase omosangererekano bw’Omonene.
english: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD.

ekegusii: Obomera bwa gatato bokagwera chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Orogongo rwabete omwando obo rogaikera Saridi.
english: The third lot came up for Zebulun, clan by clan: The boundary of their inheritance went as far as Sarid.

ekegusii: Akamoboria eria gatato, “Simion mosinto o Yohana, nonyanchete inche?” Petero agaichana ekiagera amoboretie eria gatato, “Nonyanchete?” Akamoiraneria, “Omonene, aye nomanyete onsi, nomanyete ng’a ningwanchete.” Yeso akamotebia, “Risia ching’ondi chiane.
english: The third time he said to him, "Simon son of John, do you love me?" Peter was hurt because Jesus asked him the third time, "Do you love me?" He said, "Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you." Jesus said, "Feed my sheep.

ekegusii: obwa gatato bokagwera Harimu, na obwa kane Seorimu;
english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

ekegusii: Obwa gatato bokagwera Sakuri; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: na eya gatato ne chibarasi chindabu, na eya kane ne chibarasi chire matonto, chionsi nigo chiarenge ne chinguru mono.
english: the third white, and the fourth dappled-- all of them powerful.

ekegusii: oyo o gatato Abisalomu, oiboretwe na Maaka, mosubati o Talimai, omoruoti o Gesuri; oyo o kane Adonia, oiboretwe na Hagiti;
english: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

ekegusii: obwa ikomi na gatato bokagwera Hupa, na obwa ikomi na kane Yesebeabu;
english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

ekegusii: Obwa ikomi na gatato bokagwera Subaeli; ere amo nabana baye abamura na abamwabo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: the thirteenth to Shubael, his sons and relatives, 12

ekegusii: Naboigo abanto bonsi b’ebiombe biria bitato bakabugia ebitureri biabo na bagaata ebiguuru biabo; babwate ebieri bi’omorero ase amaboko abo a bomosi, na ase amaboko a borio babwate ebitureri biabo bi’okobugia, bagaaka eriogi rinene, bakabora, “Omoro ase Omonene na ase Gidioni!”
english: The three companies blew the trumpets and smashed the jars. Grasping the torches in their left hands and holding in their right hands the trumpets they were to blow, they shouted, "A sword for the LORD and for Gideon!"

ekegusii: Abamura batato b’omokungu Seruya, Yoabu na Abisai, na Asaeli, nao barenge. Asaeli nigo arenge omominyoki mono buna egesia.
english: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai and Asahel. Now Asahel was as fleet-footed as a wild gazelle.

ekegusii: The threshing floors will be filled with grain; the vats will overflow with new wine and oil.
english: Ebiooreri bikoorerwa mbiichorwe ne chindagera; na ebimitero mbiichore nedivai na amaguta goika biiteke.

ekegusii: Ekerogo keria ki’oboruoti nigo kiabwate ekeriinero kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na ekemo, na egeteni ki’amagoro kiaroisirie korwa ase etahabu; bionsi nigo biabwatanirie nekerogo keria. Kera ensemo y’ekerogo mbiarengeo ebisiirero ase arenge gotoorera amaboko, na emegwekano ye chindo ebere yatenenirieo, oyomo ase kera ensemo.
english: The throne had six steps, and a footstool of gold was attached to it. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.

ekegusii: Ekerogo keria ki’oboruoti nigo kiabwate ekeriinero kiarenge nebitambokero bitano na ekemo; ensemo ya nyuma ekerogo keria nigo kiamurumuntire igoro. Kera ensemo y’ekerogo mbiarengeo ebisiirero ase arenge gotoorera amaboko, na emegwekano ye chindo ebere yatenenirieo, oyomo ase kera ensemo.
english: The throne had six steps, and its back had a rounded top. On both sides of the seat were armrests, with a lion standing beside each of them.

ekegusii: “Engaki eria ngocha ere, rituko riria riaikire ang’e; omogori tabaisa kogoka, gose omoonia tabaisa korera, ekiagera endamwamu yane nigo egochia kobanyora abanto abwo bonsi.
english: The time has come, the day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice nor the seller grieve, for wrath is upon the whole crowd.

ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko ngocha are, ekero ndasirie chinguru chiao ne chinguru chi’abanto b’ororeria rwa sokororia yao, erio tanyorekana omonto omogotu ase eamate yao.
english: The time is coming when I will cut short your strength and the strength of your father's house, so that there will not be an old man in your family line

ekegusii: Engaki Yehu agambete igoro ase Abaisraeli agwo Samaria nemiaka emerongo ebere, na etano na etato.
english: The time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty-eight years.

ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko ngocha are, ekero ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba yao, na ebinto bionsi chisokoro chiao chiagachete goika rero iga nabiimokigwe biirwe Babeli; nonya negento ekemo tikegotigara. Aya naro Omonene agoteba.
english: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your fathers have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.

ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko ngocha are, ekero ebinto bionsi bire ase enyomba yao, na ebinto bionsi chisokoro chiao chiagachete goika rero iga nabiimokigwe biirwe Babeli. Nonya negento ekemo tikegotigara. Aya naro Omonene atebire.
english: The time will surely come when everything in your palace, and all that your fathers have stored up until this day, will be carried off to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.

ekegusii: Chimbeera chikamaanoka chigaasama, na emebere emenge y’abanto abachenu konya bakure ekabokigwa.
english: The tombs broke open and the bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.

ekegusii: Oromeme narwo omorero, na ense y’obobe. Ase ebiimo biaito bionsi oromeme narwo rokobeka omobere bwonsi ebimoa, na gotongia omorero egesingo ki’obogima bwaito, na orwo oronyene nigo rwatongetwe nomorero o kare na kare.
english: The tongue also is a fire, a world of evil among the parts of the body. It corrupts the whole person, sets the whole course of his life on fire, and is itself set on fire by hell.

ekegusii: Amakweri na obogima nigo bire ase chinguru chi’oromeme, na abwo banchete korokorera emeremo mbanyore okwama kwaye.
english: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonyene oboronge nigo ronga buna efeta echorire korende ebirengererio bi’omokori amabe tibigwenereti kende.
english: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is of little value.

ekegusii: Oromeme rw’omonto omong’aini nigo rogokwana aye chisemi chingiya, korende emenwa y’abariri nigo ekoumora ay’oboriri.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of the fool gushes folly.

ekegusii: Oromeme rw’obokanyeku nigo rore omote bw’obogima, korende orw’obokorekanu nigo rogotandora enkoro.
english: The tongue that brings healing is a tree of life, but a deceitful tongue crushes the spirit.

ekegusii: Topasio, rigena rie rigori rinene rikorwa Etiopia, tirikoboreng’anigwa, gose tibokoreng’anigwa netahabu echenire.
english: The topaz of Cush cannot compare with it; it cannot be bought with pure gold.

ekegusii: Etahabu yonsi eyakoreretwe ase emeremo y’okoroisia Obomenyo Obochenu, eyaatananetwe ebe ekerugwa, nigo yarenge chikiro elifu eyemo, na amagana ane, na emerongo etano nomo, na isano (1,465) ase ekerengo gi’esekeli y’Obomenyo Obochenu.
english: The total amount of the gold from the wave offering used for all the work on the sanctuary was 29 talents and 730 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.

ekegusii: Ebi abanto bande baruete nigo biarenge: ebisamunye bie chitahabu chidariki chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000), na ebisamunye bie chifeta, chimina chilifu ibere (2,000), ne chianga chi’abakuani, emerongo etano nomo, na isano na ibere (67).
english: The total given by the rest of the people was 20,000 drachmas of gold, 2,000 minas of silver and 67 garments for priests.

ekegusii: Ching’iti chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa nigo chiarenge chieri ikomi na ibere, ne chimingichi ikomi na ibere, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiakoorire omwaka oyomo ikomi na ibere, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera gwachikire amo, ne chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe.
english: The total number of animals for the burnt offering came to twelve young bulls, twelve rams and twelve male lambs a year old, together with their grain offering. Twelve male goats were used for the sin offering.

ekegusii: Ching’iti chionsi chiaruetwe chikaba ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe nigo chiabete: Chieri emerongo ebere na inye, ne chimingichi emerongo etano nomo, ne chigoree emerongo etano nomo, ne chimanwa chimingichi chiakoorire omwaka oyomo emerongo etano nomo. Ebio nabio ebiegwa biaruetwe ekero egesasimero giatananetwe na goakwa amaguta.
english: The total number of animals for the sacrifice of the fellowship offering came to twenty-four oxen, sixty rams, sixty male goats and sixty male lambs a year old. These were the offerings for the dedication of the altar after it was anointed.

ekegusii: Omobaro bw’abateneneri be chiamate chiabo nigo barenge chilifu ibere, na amagana atano na rimo (2,600), abanto chituoni ase esegi.
english: The total number of family leaders over the fighting men was 2,600.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abasacha abatangi aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batato (22,273).
english: The total number of firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.

ekegusii: Abanto abasacha b’Abalawi, aba konya bakoorire omotienyi oyomo na goetania, abwo Musa na Haroni barigete, eamate ase eamate, buna Omonene abachigete, nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000).
english: The total number of Levites counted at the LORD's command by Moses and Aaron according to their clans, including every male a month old or more, was 22,000.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’Abaisraeli abarigetwe nigo barenge chilifu amagana atano na rimo na eyemo, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etato (601,730).
english: The total number of the men of Israel was 601,730.
