english: Their descendants will be known among the nations and their offspring among the peoples. All who see them will acknowledge that they are a people the LORD has blessed."

ekegusii: Omoerio obo nogosareka, enyasae yabo nenda, obonene bwabo nigo bore ase obosooku bwabo, bakorengereria amang’ana ’ense.
english: Their destiny is destruction, their god is their stomach, and their glory is in their shame. Their mind is on earthly things.

ekegusii: Ababisa babo bakabakorera bobe, bakababua bakababeka inse y’obogambi bwabo.
english: Their enemies oppressed them and subjected them to their power.

ekegusii: Oyo noro orenge omoroberio obo, eamate ase eamate. Korwa ase Abayuda nigo barenge abateneneri aba b’abarwani esegi chilifu: Adina, omochiki amo nabarwani baye chituoni chilifu amagana atato (300,000).
english: Their enrollment by families was as follows: From Judah, commanders of units of 1,000: Adnah the commander, with 300,000 fighting men;

ekegusii: Emebere y’abakerubi baria, na emegongo yabo, na amaboko abo, ne chimbaba chiabo, amo namagoro aria abakerubi baria bane babwate, nigo biaichire namaiso ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: Their entire bodies, including their backs, their hands and their wings, were completely full of eyes, as were their four wheels.

ekegusii: Amasio abo nigo agwekaine kegima buna aria naroche agwo ang’e norooche rwa Kebari. Kera oyomo akagenderera gochia bosio atari koonchoka.
english: Their faces had the same appearance as those I had seen by the Kebar River. Each one went straight ahead.

ekegusii: Okororekana kw’amasio a kera ekemo ki’ebitongwa ebio bine nigo kwarenge iga: Amasio abo a bosio nigo arenge buna aya mwanyabanto, na aya a borio nigo arenge buna aye chindo, na aya a bomosi nigo arenge buna aye chiombe; boigo kera ekemo nigo kiabwate obosio buna obw’ensoti.
english: Their faces looked like this: Each of the four had the face of a man, and on the right side each had the face of a lion, and on the left the face of an ox; each also had the face of an eagle.

ekegusii: Ise abamura baria akababoria “Nchera ki agenda?” Na abamura baye bakamworokia enchera omonto oria o Nyasae orwete ense ya Yuda agendete.
english: Their father asked them, "Which way did he go?" And his sons showed him which road the man of God from Judah had taken.

ekegusii: Efraimu ise akaba okobareera ase amatuko amange, na abamura bamwabo bagacha komoremia.
english: Their father Ephraim mourned for them many days, and his relatives came to comfort him.

ekegusii: Ise akabaa ebiegwa ebinene, chifeta ne chitahabu, ne chinibo chie rigori rinene, amo nemechie y’Abayuda yagiteire chindwaki; korende akaa Yehoramu oboruoti, ekiagera nere orenge omomura omotangi.
english: Their father had given them many gifts of silver and gold and articles of value, as well as fortified cities in Judah, but he had given the kingdom to Jehoram because he was his firstborn son.

ekegusii: Yakobo ise akabatebia, “Mwang’urire abana baane, Yusufu taiyo, na Simeoni taiyo, na bono morigetie koira Benjamin nere. Amang’ana aya onsi anyorire inche.”
english: Their father Jacob said to them, "You have deprived me of my children. Joseph is no more and Simeon is no more, and now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is against me!"

ekegusii: Amagoro abo nigo are amaango ase ogokora amabe; nigo bakoayerera goitera amanyinga ’abanto batari na komocha. Ebirengererio biabo nebi’ebibe. Ogosaria na ogosiria nigo bire ase chinchera chiabo.
english: Their feet rush into sin; they are swift to shed innocent blood. Their thoughts are evil thoughts; ruin and destruction mark their ways.

ekegusii: Their fellow Levites were assigned to all the other duties of the tabernacle, the house of God.
english: Abalawi bamwabo bagachorwa gokora emeremo yonsi y’Eema nero enyomba ya Nyasae.

ekegusii: Ahiya oyomo bw’Abalawi nere otenenerete chikungo chi’enyomba ya Nyasae, naende nere orendete ebiatananetwe bikaba ebichenu.
english: Their fellow Levites were in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries for the dedicated things.

ekegusii: Abwo barikire ase omoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chiabo, nigo barenge abanto abakong’u ase esegi, abanto chilifu emerongo ebere, na amagana abere (20,200).
english: Their genealogical record listed the heads of families and 20,200 fighting men.

ekegusii: Chimbeera chiabo nigo chikare inse aatambe, na emeganda yabo nigo eetanaine chimbeera chiabo ase chinsemo chionsi. Bonsi baitirwe nemioro bakure; abanto abwo kare barentete obwoba ase ense y’abare moyo.
english: Their graves are in the depths of the pit and her army lies around her grave. All who had spread terror in the land of the living are slain, fallen by the sword.

ekegusii: Chitukia chiabo nigo chiarenge buna chitukia chi’abakungu, na amaino abo buna amaino e chindo.
english: Their hair was like women's hair, and their teeth were like lions' teeth.

ekegusii: Nigo bare abang’ainereria ase chinkoro chiabo; ase ayio goika baegwe egesusuro gi’okomocha kwabo. Omonene natagore ebisasimero biabo, atagore ne chisiiro chiabo bagosasima.
english: Their heart is deceitful, and now they must bear their guilt. The LORD will demolish their altars and destroy their sacred stones.

ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chinorete buna ebitinya, korende inche nigo inde nomogoko ase amachiko ao.
english: Their hearts are callous and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.

ekegusii: Chinkoro chiabo nigo chiare gwoka nokogania okobe buna eriko rigwoka omorero. Ase obotuko bwonsi, okogania okwo nigo gokorara, na mambia kobwakire kwaba kogwoka buna omorero ekebemberi.
english: Their hearts are like an oven; they approach him with intrigue. Their passion smolders all night; in the morning it blazes like a flaming fire.

ekegusii: Tibamobwatetie bokong’u ne chinkoro chiabo, gose tibarenge abegenwa ase okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania.
english: their hearts were not loyal to him, they were not faithful to his covenant.

ekegusii: Chinka chiabo nigo chire buya, bwoba tiboiyo, gose Nyasae tari kobaa egesusuro.
english: Their homes are safe and free from fear; the rod of God is not upon them.

ekegusii: “Chibarasi chiabo nigo chikominyoka bwango kobua chingo, nigo chire chintindi kobua chisese chi’orosana chigotwara mogoroba; abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bagochararacharara. Ee, abariini babo be chibarasi nigo bakorwa aare, nigo bakoiruruka buna ekeongo kegochia kobwata eke gekoria.
english: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves at dusk. Their cavalry gallops headlong; their horsemen come from afar. They fly like a vulture swooping to devour;

ekegusii: Abanto abaao mbaire chinyomba chiabo, amo nabakungu babo na emegondo yabo. Ee, nindambore okoboko kwane, ing’ee abanto b’ense eye egesusuro.
english: Their houses will be turned over to others, together with their fields and their wives, when I stretch out my hand against those who live in the land," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Abana babo ebing’werere mbasenyentwe ase amasio ’abaibori babo, chinyomba chiabo nchisakorwe, na abakungu babo mbakorerwe ay’obosooku.
english: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses will be looted and their wives ravished.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo achigete Musa ng’a obomera boakwe ekero agwatanana ense ase ebisaku biria kianda, amo na keria kende ekeng’ese.
english: Their inheritances were assigned by lot to the nine-and-a-half tribes, as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo eichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, nigo bagotung’ama inse basasima emeremo y’amaboko abo, eyio bakorire nebiara biabo abanyene.
english: Their land is full of idols; they bow down to the work of their hands, to what their fingers have made.

ekegusii: Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chifeta ne chitahabu, ne chinibo chiabo tichiri nomoerio. Ense yabo nigo eichire ne chibarasi, ne chigari chiabo tichikoera.
english: Their land is full of silver and gold; there is no end to their treasures. Their land is full of horses; there is no end to their chariots.

ekegusii: Ebioro bigacha bigaichora ase ense yabo nonya nase ebinyomba bi’okorara bi’abagambi babo.
english: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.

ekegusii: Basaririe ense yabo na koyekora ey’ogoichanerwa, na ey’ogosekererigwa kare na kare. Kera omonto ogoeta aroro nigo agokumia na gosingisia omotwe oye.
english: Their land will be laid waste, an object of lasting scorn; all who pass by will be appalled and will shake their heads.

ekegusii: Chingongo chiabo bamenyete nachio Beteli na ebichie biaye, na ensemo ya moocha Naarani, na ensemo ya bosongo Geseri na ebichie biaye, na Sekemu na ebichie biaye, na Aya na ebichie biaye.
english: Their lands and settlements included Bethel and its surrounding villages, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its villages to the west, and Shechem and its villages all the way to Ayyah and its villages.

ekegusii: Omonene obo nigo arabe omonto obo abanyene, na omogambi obo nigo ararue ase egati yabo. Nimosukie gocha ang’e asende, nere nang’ike ang’e, ekiagera monto ki orabe noboremu kong’ika ang’e bweka ntamong’useti.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: Their leader will be one of their own; their ruler will arise from among them. I will bring him near and he will come close to me, for who is he who will devote himself to be close to me?' declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Amagoro abo nigo arongeete, na ebisanyi bi’amagoro abo nigo biagwekaine ebi’emori. Ebitongwa ebio nigo biarenge komeka‐meka buna etaai ekomeka‐meka.
english: Their legs were straight; their feet were like those of a calf and gleamed like burnished bronze.

ekegusii: Obwanchani bwabo, na okogecha, ne ribero, bionsi ebio nigo biasirete amo nabarabwo. Tibabwati nonya ng’ake egetari kende ase ayio agokorwa aiga inse y’erioba.
english: Their love, their hate and their jealousy have long since vanished; never again will they have a part in anything that happens under the sun.

ekegusii: Obotambe bwaye nigo boetanetie obw’ense, na obogare bwaye mboetanetie obw’enyancha.
english: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.

ekegusii: Korende chinyama chiabo amo ne ritaana rigosungusigwa, na ekenama kia borio, echio nachio echiao.
english: Their meat is to be yours, just as the breast of the wave offering and the right thigh are yours.

ekegusii: Ng’ina nigo arenge omotayayi, ee, oyo obaiborete nigo arenge gokora obonyaka. Nigo atebete: Nimbe ngotunyana abanchi baane, abwo bakong’a endagera nkoria, na amache, na amarionya e ching’ondi, na egatani, na amaguta, na edivai.
english: Their mother has been unfaithful and has conceived them in disgrace. She said, 'I will go after my lovers, who give me my food and my water, my wool and my linen, my oil and my drink.'

ekegusii: Emenwa yabo nigo egokwana amang’ana amabe are mamincha ya igoro; ne chimeme chiabo chiasokia ayakogenda ase ense engima.
english: Their mouths lay claim to heaven, and their tongues take possession of the earth.

ekegusii: Eriogi ri’okorera kwabo riaichoire ase ense ya Moabu; ekerero ekio giaikire Egilaimu na Beeri‐Elimu.
english: Their outcry echoes along the border of Moab; their wailing reaches as far as Eglaim, their lamentation as far as Beer Elim.

ekegusii: Abanto be chinse echio nigo barenge abareu batari na nguru, bakaondoka na gosookigwa, bakaba buna ebimeri bire mogondo, na buna obonyansi oborere, buna obonyansi bomerete kerama igoro bogosusana botarakina.
english: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.

ekegusii: Abanto be chinse echio nigo barenge abareu batari na nguru, bakaondoka na gosookigwa, bakaba buna ebimeri bire mogondo, na buna obonyansi oborere bomerete kerama igoro bogosusana botarakina.
english: Their people, drained of power, are dismayed and put to shame. They are like plants in the field, like tender green shoots, like grass sprouting on the roof, scorched before it grows up.

ekegusii: Ekiagera babwate enibo enyinge tibare konyara komenya amo; na ense eria tiyare kobaisana bamenye babere bonsi ne chitugo chiabo.
english: Their possessions were too great for them to remain together; the land where they were staying could not support them both because of their livestock.

ekegusii: Abakuani babo nigo baitetwe nemioro, na ababoraka babo tibanyarete kobareera.
english: their priests were put to the sword, and their widows could not weep.

ekegusii: Abagambi baye nigo barenge komeka‐meka kobua amagena ’embura, nigo barenge abarabu se kobua amabeere, emebere yabo nigo yarenge emebariri kobua amagena amabariri, na okororekana kwabo nigo kwarenge buna safiro, rigena rie rigori rinene.
english: Their princes were brighter than snow and whiter than milk, their bodies more ruddy than rubies, their appearance like sapphires.

ekegusii: Their proposal seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.
english: Amang’ana abo akagwenera Hamori na omomura oye Sekemu.

ekegusii: Chigochi chie chinsara chiabo nigo chinga buna chimbeera chiasie, bonsi nigo bare abanto chituoni.
english: Their quivers are like an open grave; all of them are mighty warriors.

ekegusii: Na abamwabo ase chiamate chiabo buna barigetwe ase omoroberio bwe chinderia chi’ebiare biabo nabwo aba: Yeieli, nere orenge omoteneneri obo, na Zakaria,
english: Their relatives by clans, listed according to their genealogical records: Jeiel the chief, Zechariah,

ekegusii: Their relatives, by families, were: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia and Eber-- seven in all.
english: Na abamwabo be chiamate chiabo nabwo aba: Mikaeli na Mesulamu, Seba na Yorai, Yakani na Sia, na Eberi, bonsi mbatano na babere.

ekegusii: Amagoro ayio ane nigo arenge ne chibonyi chingare chi’okoondokia, chiaichire namaiso ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.

ekegusii: Ooruma kwabo nigo konga buna okw’endo, nigo bakoruma buna chindo chinsae na koronya; nigo bakobwata na koira ebisakore na abooswa, na onde tari oranyare gotooria.
english: Their roar is like that of the lion, they roar like young lions; they growl as they seize their prey and carry it off with no one to rescue.

ekegusii: Ekero abagambi babo baraturunkanigwe ase egetare, abanto mbanche amang’ana aane ng’a namaya.
english: their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs, and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.

ekegusii: Abaiseke bamwabo nabwo barenge Seruya na Abigaeli. Abana abamura b’omokungu Seruya nabwo aba: Abisai na Yoabu, na Asaeli, bonsi mbatato.
english: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah's three sons were Abishai, Joab and Asahel.

ekegusii: Emebere y’abanto baraitwe nigo eratugutwe isiko, na ogotioka kw’obogundo bw’ebitondo ebio nigo koratioke aande onsi; amanyinga ’emebere eyio natirimboke korwa ase ebitunwa igoro.
english: Their slain will be thrown out, their dead bodies will send up a stench; the mountains will be soaked with their blood.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abana babo bakagenda bakaira ense eyio. Aye okabua Abakanani, abanto b’ense eye, okababeka ase amaboko ’abanto bao, okabaa nabaruoti babo na abanto b’ense eye, erinde babakorere buna banchete.
english: Their sons went in and took possession of the land. You subdued before them the Canaanites, who lived in the land; you handed the Canaanites over to them, along with their kings and the peoples of the land, to deal with them as they pleased.

ekegusii: Orobebe rwabo rwa irianyi nigo rwachakerete ase ensinyo y’Enyancha y’Omonyo ensemo ya irianyi,
english: Their southern boundary started from the bay at the southern end of the Salt Sea,

ekegusii: Oyore egetare kiabo natame ore nomoondoko omonge; na abakogamba amo nere mbatame ase okogoswa ekero bararore ebendera y’esegi.” Omonene, oyio omorero oye ore ase Sayoni, na ekebemberi kiaye ki’omorero kere Yerusalemu, otebire amang’ana ayio.
english: Their stronghold will fall because of terror; at sight of the battle standard their commanders will panic," declares the LORD, whose fire is in Zion, whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Na emechie yabo emeke nigo yarenge Etamu na Aini, Rimoni na Tokeni, na Asani; yonsi netano.
english: Their surrounding villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token and Ashan-- five towns--

ekegusii: Amang’ana abo nigo akoria buna rikwege ri’esiria. Ase abwo mbareo Himenayo na Fileto.
english: Their teaching will spread like gangrene. Among them are Hymenaeus and Philetus,

ekegusii: Mosakore chiema chiabo na amaicho abo, na ebietubo bie chiema chiabo, na ebinto biabo bionsi; boigo moire chingamia chiabo. Morere igoro yabo, motebe: Obwoba nigo bore ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: Their tents and their flocks will be taken; their shelters will be carried off with all their goods and camels. Men will shout to them, 'Terror on every side!'

ekegusii: Ensemo yabo nigo yabwateranetie Helikati, na Hali, na Beteni, na Akisafu,
english: Their territory included: Helkath, Hali, Beten, Acshaph,

ekegusii: Ensemo yabo nigo yabwateranetie Yesireeli, na Kesuloti, na Sunemu,
english: Their territory included: Jezreel, Kesulloth, Shunem,

ekegusii: Nigo bakorengereria ng’a nigo chirabeo kare na kare, na obomenyo bwabo ebiaare ase ebiaare; nigo bagwatora emegondo yabo ase amarieta abo.
english: Their tombs will remain their houses forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they had named lands after themselves.

ekegusii: Chimeme chiabo nigo chinga buna chinsara chigoita, ekiagera nigo chigokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria. Kera omonto nigo agokwana amang’ana ’omorembe ase omogisangio oye ase ebikoba igoro, korende ime ase enkoro yaye nigo akoroberia komotegera oboreba.
english: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks with deceit. With his mouth each speaks cordially to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets a trap for him.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbakabwate abana babo babere, Ahimasi, omwana o Zadoki, na Yonathani, omwana bw’Abiatari. Mobe mokobatoma bandetere kera ring’ana moraigwe.”
english: Their two sons, Ahimaaz son of Zadok and Jonathan son of Abiathar, are there with them. Send them to me with anything you hear."

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo babwate obosongo bonga buna obw’eng’iti, nigo banga buna rirubi rigoticha amato aye,
english: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like that of a cobra that has stopped its ears,

ekegusii: Emesabibu yabo nigo ekorwa ase emesabibu ya Sodomu, na korwa ase emegondo ya Gomora; na amasabibu abo nigo are nobosongo, ebisago biabo nigo bire ebiroro.
english: Their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are filled with poison, and their clusters with bitterness.

ekegusii: Amaroro abo nay’obong’ainereria, na oboringoria bwabo nobw’oborimo. Barabwo nigo bagoteba iga: Omonene otebire bo. Korende Omonene tabatometi. Nonya naboigo, nigo basemeretie ng’a Omonene naikeranie amang’ana abo babanire.
english: Their visions are false and their divinations a lie. They say, "The LORD declares," when the LORD has not sent them; yet they expect their words to be fulfilled.

ekegusii: Eriogi riabo riagendire, riesiareire ase ense engima, na amang’ana abo aikire chinsinyo chi’ense. Nyasae okorire igoro koba obomenyo bw’erioba.
english: Their voice goes out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens he has pitched a tent for the sun,

ekegusii: Chinibo chiabo nchisakorwe, ne chinyomba chiabo nchisarigwe chitigwe bosa. Nabaisa koagacha chinyomba, tibagochimenya, nabaisa gosimeka emesabibu, tibakonywa edivai ekorwao.”
english: Their wealth will be plundered, their houses demolished. They will build houses but not live in them; they will plant vineyards but not drink the wine.

ekegusii: Edivai yabo nigo enga buna obosongo bwe ching’iti, na obotindi bwabo buna obosongo obatindi bw’amarubi.”
english: Their wine is the venom of serpents, the deadly poison of cobras.

ekegusii: Chimanwa chiabo nigo chikoba ne chinguru chiakinera ase orosana. Nigo chikogenda kegima, tichiri koirana.
english: Their young thrive and grow strong in the wilds; they leave and do not return.

ekegusii: Naki abagaaka baito ba kare nababo, na korwa asebare Kristo nao aiboretwe buna mwanyabanto; ere nigo are Nyasae igoro ase ebinto bionsi, oyorabakwe goika kare na kare. Amina.
english: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them is traced the human ancestry of Christ, who is God over all, forever praised! Amen.

ekegusii: Erio nabachake gotebia ebitunwa: Togwere, na ebigoro: Totube.
english: Then "'they will say to the mountains, "Fall on us!" and to the hills, "Cover us!"'

ekegusii: Korende riire rigacha rikababisia; eriogi rikarwa ase riire riria, rigateba, “Oyo n’Omwana one, omwanchwa, moigwere ere!”
english: Then a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and a voice came from the cloud: "This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!"

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo, erieta riaye Yairo, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, agacha, akagwa ase amagoro a Yeso, akamosorora asoe nyomba mwaye,
english: Then a man named Jairus, a ruler of the synagogue, came and fell at Jesus' feet, pleading with him to come to his house

ekegusii: Erio omonto ochenegete aimokie orosagia rwa hisopo, arotobeke ase amache ayio ime, erio anyororokerie eema na ebinto bionsi bireo, amo nabanto barenge imeo. Naende anyororokerie omonto oria okunete riuga, gose okunete omonto oitetwe, gose oyokwete bweka, gose oboina.
english: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water and sprinkle the tent and all the furnishings and the people who were there. He must also sprinkle anyone who has touched a human bone or a grave or someone who has been killed or someone who has died a natural death.

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oyomo bwe chinguru akaimokia rigena rire buna orogena oronene rogosia, akariruta ase enyancha ime, akabora, “Buna iga, ase chinguru na ekerundo, Babeli, omochie oria omonene, norutwe inse, gose tokonyara kororekana nonya ng’ake.
english: Then a mighty angel picked up a boulder the size of a large millstone and threw it into the sea, and said: "With such violence the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to be found again.

ekegusii: “Erio omoruoti ore ne chinguru chinene naoroke, abe okogamba nokobua okonene na akore buna anchete ere omonyene.
english: Then a mighty king will appear, who will rule with great power and do as he pleases.

ekegusii: Omoruoti omoyia, oyotamomanyete Yusufu, akaira obogambi bw’ense ya Misiri.
english: Then a new king, who did not know about Joseph, came to power in Egypt.

ekegusii: Omworokia bw’amariko oyomo akamochiera, akamotebia, “Omworokia, ningotunyane aande onsi ase okogenda.”
english: Then a teacher of the law came to him and said, "Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go."

ekegusii: Eriogi rikarua ase ekerogo ki’obonene rigateba, “Motogie Nyasae oito, inwe abasomba baye bonsi, inwe abamomoirogete, abake na abanene!”
english: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: "Praise our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, both small and great!"

ekegusii: Eriogi rikamochera, rikamotebia: “Petero, imoka onyenye orie!”
english: Then a voice told him, "Get up, Peter. Kill and eat."

ekegusii: Haroni gakoorire korua ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na eki’ogosambwa, na eki’omorembe, akaimokia amaboko aye igoro ase abanto, akabasesenia, naende agaika gocha inse.
english: Then Aaron lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them. And having sacrificed the sin offering, the burnt offering and the fellowship offering, he stepped down.

ekegusii: Ekero amaakwa atigete goita abanto, Haroni akairana ase Musa agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, for the plague had stopped.

ekegusii: Erio abamura ba Haroni babisambere ase egesasimero, igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa kebekire ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero. Ekio nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero kere ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
english: Then Aaron's sons are to burn it on the altar on top of the burnt offering that is on the burning wood, as an offering made by fire, an aroma pleasing to the LORD.

ekegusii: Naende abakuani, abamura ba Haroni, babeke ebitari biria, amo nomotwe na ebitinya, igoro ase chinko chiria chire ase omorero bw’egesasimero.
english: Then Aaron's sons the priests shall arrange the pieces, including the head and the fat, on the burning wood that is on the altar.

ekegusii: Erio Abidoni, mosinto o Hileli, Omopiratoni, agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Piratoni, ase ense y’Efraimu, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaameleki.
english: Then Abdon son of Hillel died, and was buried at Pirathon in Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.

ekegusii: Then Abimelech brought sheep and cattle and male and female slaves and gave them to Abraham, and he returned Sarah his wife to him.
english: Erio Abimeleki akaimokia ching’ondi ne chiombe, amo nabasomba, abamura na abaiseke, akaa Ibrahimu, akamoiraneria na Sara mokaye.

ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki akarangeria Ibrahimu, akamoboria, “Inki eke gwatokoreire iga? Inki nakomocheire goika kwarentire igoro yane na igoro y’oboruoti bwane ebibe ebinene buna ebi? Gwankoreire amang’ana atagwenerete gokorwa.”
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham in and said, "What have you done to us? How have I wronged you that you have brought such great guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should not be done."

ekegusii: Erio Abimeleki agatebia Isaka, “Karue asetore, ekiagera aye kwabeire ne chinguru chinyinge gotobua.”
english: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, "Move away from us; you have become too powerful for us."

ekegusii: Abimeleki akamoboria, “Inki eke gwatokoreire iga? Aande monto onde oito arenge gochia arare na mokao, na aye anga nigo gwatobeka ase okomocha.”
english: Then Abimelech said, "What is this you have done to us? One of the men might well have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us."

ekegusii: Erio Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, agatebia omoruoti, “Naki esese eria ekwete egokoragereria iga, aye omoruoti, omonene one? Tiga ngende mbutore omotwe oye.”
english: Then Abishai son of Zeruiah said to the king, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Let me go over and cut off his head."

ekegusii: Abisai, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya, akabora, “Inee! Simei tagoitwa akwe, ekiagera amoragereretie omoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene?”
english: Then Abishai son of Zeruiah said, "Shouldn't Shimei be put to death for this? He cursed the LORD's anointed."

ekegusii: Abineri agatebia Daudi, “Nkogenda inde nsangererie Abaisraeli bonsi ase ensemo yao, aye omoruoti, omonene one, erio bakore okobwatana amo naye, erinde onyore eki kwaganetie, obagambere bonsi pi.” Ase igo Daudi akaa Abineri ribaga, na Abineri akagenda nomorembe.
english: Then Abner said to David, "Let me go at once and assemble all Israel for my lord the king, so that they may make a compact with you, and that you may rule over all that your heart desires." So David sent Abner away, and he went in peace.

ekegusii: Abineri akamotebia, “Gobera gochia ensemo ende, eya borio gose eya bomosi, obwatie omomura oyomo bw’abwo, oire ebirwanero biaye.” Korende Asaeli tancha koonchoka amotige.
english: Then Abner said to him, "Turn aside to the right or to the left; take on one of the young men and strip him of his weapons." But Asahel would not stop chasing him.

ekegusii: Abineri agatebia Yoabu, “Tiga abamura baimoke bagosorie ase amasio aito.” Yoabu agateba, “Tiga baimoke.”
english: Then Abner said to Joab, "Let's have some of the young men get up and fight hand to hand in front of us." "All right, let them do it," Joab said.

ekegusii: Abineri agatoma abanto ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, akabora, “Ense eye neya ng’o? Kora okobwatana nainche, erio ngokonye na nkorentere Abaisraeli bonsi babwatane naye.”
english: Then Abner sent messengers on his behalf to say to David, "Whose land is it? Make an agreement with me, and I will help you bring all Israel over to you."

ekegusii: Ibrahimu agasuka gochia ase Omonene, akamoboboria, “Inee! Amaene, nigo orasirie abanyene oboronge amo nabakori amabe?
english: Then Abraham approached him and said: "Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked?

ekegusii: Nigo akwete ase obogotu obuya, ore omogaaka, oisanekire nemiaka emenge; agasangerekana amo nabanto baye.
english: Then Abraham breathed his last and died at a good old age, an old man and full of years; and he was gathered to his people.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akamororera Abimeleki bobe ase engencho y’ensoko eria abasomba b’Abimeleki bamourete.
english: Then Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well of water that Abimelech's servants had seized.

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu agasaba Nyasae; na Nyasae akagwenia Abimeleki amo na mokaye, na abasomba baye abakungu, na barabwo bakaibora abana.
english: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, his wife and his slave girls so they could have children again,

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu akairana gochia ase abamura baria barenge komo; bonsi bakaimoka, bakagenda amo gochia Beeri‐Seba; na Ibrahimu akaba okomenya agwo Beeri‐Seba.
english: Then Abraham returned to his servants, and they set off together for Beersheba. And Abraham stayed in Beersheba.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akaimoka, agatung’ama inse ase amasio ’Abahiti, abanto b’ense eria.
english: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akaimoka korwa ase egetondo kiaye, agatebia Abahiti,
english: Then Abraham rose from beside his dead wife and spoke to the Hittites. He said,

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akairaneria, “Rigereria, ningendererete gokwana n’Omonene, nonya inche inde orotu rw’amaroba, na eribu bosa.
english: Then Abraham spoke up again: "Now that I have been so bold as to speak to the Lord, though I am nothing but dust and ashes,

ekegusii: Na Aburamu akabwatia orogendo akagenderera bosio gochia ensemo ya Negebu.
english: Then Abram set out and continued toward the Negev.

ekegusii: Erio Abisalomu akamoboria, “Onye togocha, koranche ong’e Amunoni ominto agende naintwe.” Omoruoti akamoboria, “Nase ki ere aragende nainwe?”
english: Then Absalom said, "If not, please let my brother Amnon come with us." The king asked him, "Why should he go with you?"

ekegusii: Erio Abisalomu akarangeria Yoabu, erinde amotome ase omoruoti, korende Yoabu akaanga gocha asare. Naende akamorangeria eria kabere, korende boigo akaanga, tacha.
english: Then Absalom sent for Joab in order to send him to the king, but Joab refused to come to him. So he sent a second time, but he refused to come.

ekegusii: Korende Abisalomu agatoma abanto bobisi ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli babitebie, “Ekero moraigwe eriogi ri’egetureri, erio moake eriogi motebe: Bono Abisalomu obeire omoruoti o Heburoni!”
english: Then Absalom sent secret messengers throughout the tribes of Israel to say, "As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpets, then say, 'Absalom is king in Hebron.'"

ekegusii: Abisalomu omotebia, “Rora, amang’ana ao namaya, naende amaronge, korende monto onde tari aa omoruoti abegete orakoigwere.”
english: Then Absalom would say to him, "Look, your claims are valid and proper, but there is no representative of the king to hear you."

ekegusii: Erio Adoni‐Bezeki agateba, “Abaruoti emerongo etano na ebere, abwo ebiara biabo ebinene bi’amaboko na ebi’amagoro biabutoretwe, barenge gochora amatori korwa nyaro y’emesa yane. Na bono Nyasae onkoreire inche buna inche nabakorerete barabwo.” Akarentwa Yerusalemu, agakwera aroro.
english: Then Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them." They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.

ekegusii: Aye echabere nobonene na obwari, eboyie ogosikwa na okobua.
english: Then adorn yourself with glory and splendor, and clothe yourself in honor and majesty.

ekegusii: Erio nyuma y’emiaka etato ngatiira kogenda Yerusalemu gokwania Kefa, nkamenya amo nere amatuko ikomi na atano.
english: Then after three years, I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Peter and stayed with him fifteen days.

ekegusii: Then Agrippa said to Festus, "I would like to hear this man myself." He replied, "Tomorrow you will hear him."
english: Agripa agatebia Festo, “Nainche omonyene nindigetie koigwa omonto oyio.” Akabora, “Noche omoigwe ankio.”

ekegusii: Agripa agatebia Paulo, “Ase amang’ana amake norigetie gonkora imbe Omokristo.”
english: Then Agrippa said to Paul, "Do you think that in such a short time you can persuade me to be a Christian?"

ekegusii: Then Agrippa said to Paul, "You have permission to speak for yourself." So Paul motioned with his hand and began his defense:
english: Agripa agatebia Paulo, “Nore ne ribaga gokwana amang’ana ao.” Erio Paulo akarambora okoboko kwaye, agekengera,

ekegusii: Ahimasi agaaka eriogi, agatebia omoruoti, “Nomorembe!” Naende agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase obosio bw’omoruoti, akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae oo, atogigwe, oyo obarusirieo abanto aba konya baimokirie amaboko abo igoro yao, aye omoruoti, omonene one.”
english: Then Ahimaaz called out to the king, "All is well!" He bowed down before the king with his face to the ground and said, "Praise be to the LORD your God! He has delivered up the men who lifted their hands against my lord the king."

ekegusii: Na Abaisraeli bonsi baigwe ayio akorekanire na bairoke, erinde obobe buna obwo tibokorwa ase egati yaino naende.
english: Then all Israel will hear and be afraid, and no one among you will do such an evil thing again.

ekegusii: “Erio inwe mwensi mogacha asende, mogantebia: Totome abanto bagende koroota ense eria, erinde batorentere amang’ana buna ense eria ere, barore enchera togochia goetera, naende emechie eria togochia koira, buna ere.”
english: Then all of you came to me and said, "Let us send men ahead to spy out the land for us and bring back a report about the route we are to take and the towns we will come to."

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene nasomoire omoyio one korwa ase ekeraaro kiaye, tinkoyoirania ime naende.
english: Then all people will know that I the LORD have drawn my sword from its scabbard; it will not return again.'

ekegusii: Erio abachiki bonsi b’abarwani esegi, amo na Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, na Yesania, mosinto o Hosaya, na abanto bonsi, korwa omoke goika omonene, bagacha,
english: Then all the army officers, including Johanan son of Kareah and Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least to the greatest approached

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi ba Sekemu, na abwo ba Beti‐Milo, bagasangererekana amo agwo Sekemu ase omote oria onga buna omotontera ang’e nekeinyorio giatenenirieo, na agwo bakabeka Abimeleki akaba omoruoti.
english: Then all the citizens of Shechem and Beth Millo gathered beside the great tree at the pillar in Shechem to crown Abimelech king.

ekegusii: Abagaaka bonsi b’omochie oria ore ang’e kobua naase aria omonto oria aiteretwe baisabere amaboko abo igoro ase ritororo riria riabunetwe ebigoti agwo ase rigoko.
english: Then all the elders of the town nearest the body shall wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken in the valley,

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Dani goika Beeri‐Seba, amo nab’ense ya Gileadi bakarua chinka chiabo, bagasangererekana amo, bakabwatana, bakaba buna omonto oyomo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Misipa.
english: Then all the Israelites from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead came out as one man and assembled before the LORD in Mizpah.

ekegusii: Erio abanto abang’aini bonsi b’omoruoti bagasoa ime, korende tibanyarete gosoma amariko aria, gose gotebia omoruoti engencho yaye.
english: Then all the king's wise men came in, but they could not read the writing or tell the king what it meant.

ekegusii: Erio agwo abanto bonsi b’omochie oye bamoake amagena goika akwe. Ase enchera eyio morusie obobe borue ase egati yaino. Abaisraeli bonsi kobaraigwe ayio, mbairoke.
english: Then all the men of his town shall stone him to death. You must purge the evil from among you. All Israel will hear of it and be afraid.

ekegusii: Erio abasacha bonsi abamanyete ng’a abakungu babo konya basambire ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao, amo nabakungu bonsi bateneine agwo, na omosangererekano omonene, na abanto bonsi abamenyete ase orogongo rwa Patirosi ase ense ya Misiri, bakairaneria Yeremia, bakamotebia,
english: Then all the men who knew that their wives were burning incense to other gods, along with all the women who were present-- a large assembly-- and all the people living in Lower and Upper Egypt, said to Jeremiah,

ekegusii: Ekero omochie o Yerusalemu obwatetwe, abanene baria bonsi b’oboruoti bwa Babeli bagasoa ime, bagaikaransa ase Egeita kia Gati‐gati. Abanene abwo nabwo aba: Nerigali‐Sareseri, na Namigari‐Nebo, na Sari‐Sekemu omoteneneri bw’abasomba b’omoruoti, na Nerigali‐Sareseri, omoringoria omonene amo nabanene bande bonsi b’omoruoti o Babeli.
english: Then all the officials of the king of Babylon came and took seats in the Middle Gate: Nergal-Sharezer of Samgar, Nebo-Sarsekim a chief officer, Nergal-Sharezer a high official and all the other officials of the king of Babylon.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakarua agwo, kera omonto akagenda nka bwoye, na Daudi akagenda bwoye gosesenia abanto b’enyomba yaye.
english: Then all the people left, each for his own home, and David returned home to bless his family.

ekegusii: Erio Abayuda bonsi bakabeka Asaria akaba omoruoti ribaga ri’Amasia ise. Asaria nigo arenge nemiaka ikomi na etano nomo ekero keria.
english: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

ekegusii: Ekero Usia arenge nemiaka ikomi na etano nomo, Abayuda bonsi bakamobeka akaba omoruoti ribaga ri’Amasia ise.
english: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.

ekegusii: Naboigo abanto bonsi b’ense y’Abageraseni bakamoboria arue asebare, ekiagera basoetwe nokoiroka okonene. Erio akariina obwato, akairana.
english: Then all the people of the region of the Gerasenes asked Jesus to leave them, because they were overcome with fear. So he got into the boat and left.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi bakagenda ase chinka chiabo, bakaba bakoria na konywa, bagaatanera chindagera chiabo baria batabwate, bakaba nomogoko, ekiagera konya bamanyire buya engencho y’amang’ana ayio bateberetigwe.
english: Then all the people went away to eat and drink, to send portions of food and to celebrate with great joy, because they now understood the words that had been made known to them.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi b’ense mbabarore mogwatorwa ase erieta riaye, erio babairoke.
english: Then all the peoples on earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD, and they will fear you.

ekegusii: Erio abagambi bonsi bare ase ense ere enyancha mbarabare mbarue ase ebirogo biabo bi’obonene, barusie emiambaro yabo, naende barusie chianga chiabo chire nebieni ao ao. Barabwo mbabe bakoiguswa, nigo baraikaranse inse ase amaroba, babe bakona‐koiguswa na goichana igoro yao.
english: Then all the princes of the coast will step down from their thrones and lay aside their robes and take off their embroidered garments. Clothed with terror, they will sit on the ground, trembling every moment, appalled at you.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bonsi abamenyete Misiri mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. “Abamisiri nigo barenge buna emoti Abaisraeli begenete.
english: Then all who live in Egypt will know that I am the LORD. "'You have been a staff of reed for the house of Israel.

ekegusii: Naende Amasia agatebia Amosi, “Aye omorori, tama ogende ase ense y’Abayuda; aroro agwo nonyore endagera okoria, na obe gokobanera aroro.
english: Then Amaziah said to Amos, "Get out, you seer! Go back to the land of Judah. Earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.

ekegusii: Erio Amasia agatoma abanto ase Yehoasi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, oyorenge omwana o Yehoahasi, mosinto o Yehu, agateba, “Inchuo torigereranie obosio ase obosio!”
english: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, with the challenge: "Come, meet me face to face."

ekegusii: Erio Amasia, omokuani o Beteli, agatoma amang’ana ase Yeroboamu, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, komotebia, “Amosi oseegetire Abaisraeli bonsi babe mamincha yao; na ense eye tekonyara koremereria amang’ana aye onsi.
english: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent a message to Jeroboam king of Israel: "Amos is raising a conspiracy against you in the very heart of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Amunoni akagecha Tamari okogecha okonene, na okogecha okwo amogecha gokaba okonene kobua obwanchani boria amwanchete ritang’ani. Amunoni akamotebia, “Imoka, orue aa!”
english: Then Amnon hated her with intense hatred. In fact, he hated her more than he had loved her. Amnon said to her, "Get up and get out!"

ekegusii: Amunoni agatebia Tamari, “Ndetere emegati eyio aa, inyerie korwa ase okoboko kwao.” Tamari akaimokia emegati eyio aroisetie, akayeirera Amunoni, momura omwabo, ase akanyomba ime.
english: Then Amnon said to Tamar, "Bring the food here into my bedroom so I may eat from your hand." And Tamar took the bread she had prepared and brought it to her brother Amnon in his bedroom.

ekegusii: Zakaria akaorokerwa nomomalaika bw’Omonene, oteneine ensemo ya borio y’egesasimero ki’ogosambera ubani.
english: Then an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing at the right side of the altar of incense.

ekegusii: Omoisraeli oyomo agacha akarentana omokungu oyomo bw’Abamidiani ase eamate yaye, ase obosio bwa Musa amo nomoganda bwonsi kobateneine agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bakorera.
english: Then an Israelite man brought to his family a Midianite woman right before the eyes of Moses and the whole assembly of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Ere nasirie abarwani esegi abange baria baramochere; boigo nasirie omogambi oria arakore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere.
english: Then an overwhelming army will be swept away before him; both it and a prince of the covenant will be destroyed.

ekegusii: Anania akagenda, agasoa nyomba ime. Akamobekera amaboko aye, akabora, “Oyominto Saulo, Omonene Yeso, ere oyokoorokerete ase enchera kware gochera, ontomire, erinde onyare korora naende, na oichorwe n’Omoika Omochenu.”
english: Then Ananias went to the house and entered it. Placing his hands on Saul, he said, "Brother Saul, the Lord-- Jesus, who appeared to you on the road as you were coming here-- has sent me so that you may see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit."

ekegusii: Nabo Anasi akamoira osibire ase Kayafa, omokuani omonene.
english: Then Annas sent him, still bound, to Caiaphas the high priest.

ekegusii: Naende oake amaguta ase egesasimero ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe, amo nebikorero biaye bionsi. Naboigo ogiatanane, kebe egechenu mono.
english: Then anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils; consecrate the altar, and it will be most holy.

ekegusii: Na omomalaika onde agasoka korwa ase Hekalu akarera neriogi rinene, agatebia oyoikaransete igoro ase riire riria, “Soyia omoyio oo mogondo, ogese, ekiagera engaki y’okogesa yaikire, ne rigesa riomire mono.”
english: Then another angel came out of the temple and called in a loud voice to him who was sitting on the cloud, "Take your sickle and reap, because the time to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."

ekegusii: Ebarasi ende ekaoroka, yarenge embariri burure, na ere oyoyeriinete naetwe ribaga korusia omorembe korwa ase ense, erinde abanto baitane barabwo ase barabwo, akaegwa omoyio o birende omonene.
english: Then another horse came out, a fiery red one. Its rider was given power to take peace from the earth and to make men slay each other. To him was given a large sword.

ekegusii: goika omoruoti onde akabekwa Misiri, oyotamomanyete Yusufu.
english: Then another king, who knew nothing about Joseph, became ruler of Egypt.

ekegusii: Egekone kende gekarorekana igoro: Enchoka enene embariri eyarenge nemetwe etano na ebere ne chingunchara ikomi, na igoro ase emetwe yaye nigo yarenge ne chigutwa isano na ibere.
english: Then another sign appeared in heaven: an enormous red dragon with seven heads and ten horns and seven crowns on his heads.

ekegusii: Asa akarera ase Omonene, Nyasae oye, agateba, “Aye Omonene, onde tari onga buna aye ase ogokonya abatari ne chinguru na abare ne chinguru. Ase ayio, aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, otokonye, ekiagera naye tosemeretie, na ase erieta riao twachire korwana nomoganda oyo omonene. Aye Omonene, aye naye Nyasae oito, omonto onde tari orakobue.”
english: Then Asa called to the LORD his God and said, "LORD, there is no one like you to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, O LORD our God, for we rely on you, and in your name we have come against this vast army. O LORD, you are our God; do not let man prevail against you."

ekegusii: Asa akarara, ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase omochie o Daudi, sokororia yaye, na Yehosafati, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Then Asa rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the city of his father David. And Jehoshaphat his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Erio Belisasari akarua ogochika ng’a Danieli abekerwe eanga emonyinga, ne chisonoi chie chitahabu igoti riaye, na ararigwe ng’a ere nomogambi o gatato ase obogambi obo.
english: Then at Belshazzar's command, Daniel was clothed in purple, a gold chain was placed around his neck, and he was proclaimed the third highest ruler in the kingdom.

ekegusii: Ase igo Musa agachika Abaisraeli koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene, agateba, “Abanto b’egesaku kia Yusufu nigo bagokwana amang’ana ay’ekeene.
english: Then at the LORD's command Moses gave this order to the Israelites: "What the tribe of the descendants of Joseph is saying is right.

ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akaimoka, akairana bwoye, na Balaki nere akabwatia enchera, akagenda bwoye.
english: Then Balaam got up and returned home and Balak went his own way.

ekegusii: Baalamu agatebia Balaki, “Beera aa, otenene mbarabare ase ekeng’wanso kiao ki’ogosambwa; inche ngende korora gose ande Omonene nang’orokerie. Kende gionsi arantebie, ekio nakio ndagotebie.” Baalamu agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro aarabu.
english: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Stay here beside your offering while I go aside. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet with me. Whatever he reveals to me I will tell you." Then he went off to a barren height.

ekegusii: Erio Baalamu akarigereria Abaameleki, agakwana obobani obo: “Abaameleki nabwo barange abe ritang’ani ase ebisaku, korende ase omoerio nabasirigwe kegima.”
english: Then Balaam saw Amalek and uttered his oracle: "Amalek was first among the nations, but he will come to ruin at last."

ekegusii: Baalamu agakwana obobani bwaye, agateba: “Balaki, omoruoti o Moabu, ondetire korwa Siiria, korwa ase ebitunwa bia Moocha, otebire: Inchuo, ondagererie abanto ba Yakobo, inchuo ogambie Abaisraeli.
english: Then Balaam uttered his oracle: "Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the eastern mountains. 'Come,' he said, 'curse Jacob for me; come, denounce Israel.'

ekegusii: Then Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath Huzoth.
english: Erio Baalamu akagenda amo na Balaki, bagaika Kiriati‐Husoti.

ekegusii: Balaki agatebia Baalamu, “Bono inchuo nkoire aase ande aao. Aande gose Nyasae nanche obandagererie korwa aroro.”
english: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Come, let me take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God to let you curse them for me from there."

ekegusii: Naende Balaki agatebia Baalamu, “Bono tobaisa kobaragereria, gose tobaisa kobasesenia nonya ng’ake.”
english: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!"

ekegusii: Balaki akamotebia, “Inchuo, togende amo naye goika aase ande aao. Korwa aroro nonyare korora abare ang’e. Tokorora bonsi. Korwa aase agwo nobandagererie.”
english: Then Balak said to him, "Come with me to another place where you can see them; you will see only a part but not all of them. And from there, curse them for me."

ekegusii: Naende Balaki agatoma abanene bande, abange kobua baria be ritang’ani, naende ababwate amasikani amanene kobua abwo.
english: Then Balak sent other princes, more numerous and more distinguished than the first.

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio Balaki akaba nendamwamu enene ase Baalamu, agaaka chinkobi, akamotebia, “Nigo nakorangeretie ng’a oragererie ababisa baane, na rora, bono aye kwabasesenirie chintunda echi isato.
english: Then Balak's anger burned against Balaam. He struck his hands together and said to him, "I summoned you to curse my enemies, but you have blessed them these three times.

ekegusii: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
english: Barnaba akarua agwo, akagenda Tariso korigia Saulo,

ekegusii: Erio Batiseba agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase okoorokia amasikani ase omoruoti, agakwana, “Tiga aye omonene one, omoruoti Daudi, ochie kare!”
english: Then Bathsheba bowed low with her face to the ground and, kneeling before the king, said, "May my lord King David live forever!"

ekegusii: Beni‐Hadadi agatoma amang’ana asare naende agateba, “Chinyasae ching’e egesusuro ekenene, na goetania, onye orotu rwa Samaria ndogoisana chinsanyi chi’abanto bonsi bagontunyana.”
english: Then Ben-Hadad sent another message to Ahab: "May the gods deal with me, be it ever so severely, if enough dust remains in Samaria to give each of my men a handful."

ekegusii: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
english: Erio Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:

ekegusii: Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
english: Bilidadi Omosua akairaneria, akabora:

ekegusii: Na ekero chinsoti chiachia kogwa ase amabego aria, Aburamu agachiseria.
english: Then birds of prey came down on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.

ekegusii: Erio Boazi agatebia abagaaka baria na abanto bonsi abarengeo, “Inwe mbirori more rero ng’a nagorire korwa ase amaboko a Naomi bionsi ebiarenge ebi’Elimeleki, na ebia Kilioni amo nebia Mahaloni.
english: Then Boaz announced to the elders and all the people, "Today you are witnesses that I have bought from Naomi all the property of Elimelech, Kilion and Mahlon.

ekegusii: Erio Boazi akamotebia, “Korende onye gokogora oboremo korwa ase Naomi, rirorio oire Rutu, Omomoabu oria, moka oria okwete, abe mokao, naye omotenenerie oria okwete egesaku kerarie omwando oye.”
english: Then Boaz said, "On the day you buy the land from Naomi and from Ruth the Moabitess, you acquire the dead man's widow, in order to maintain the name of the dead with his property."

ekegusii: “Erio orente Haroni amo nabamura baye ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, obasibie namache.
english: Then bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and wash them with water.

ekegusii: Naende ong’agachere inche Omonene, Nyasae oo, egesasimero, ase ogochoka amagena buya igoro ase eburi eye enkong’u. Erio orente eeri eria ya kabere, oyerue ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, oyesambere chinko chi’omote oria bw’Asera ogochia konacha.”
english: Then build a proper kind of altar to the LORD your God on the top of this height. Using the wood of the Asherah pole that you cut down, offer the second bull as a burnt offering."

ekegusii: Osambere chinyama echi chionsi chi’emingichi ase egesasimero igoro. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene, ekeng’wanso ki’omorero kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene.
english: Then burn the entire ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Korende enyama amo nemegati biratigare mobisambe nomorero.
english: Then burn up the rest of the meat and the bread.

ekegusii: Korende Kalebu agakiria abanto tibabaisa koamereria Musa, agateba, “Tiga togende bwango, erinde toire ense eria, ekiagera intwe ntonyare kobua ense eria.”
english: Then Caleb silenced the people before Moses and said, "We should go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly do it."

ekegusii: Rituko ri’Emegati etabekiri memera rigaika, eri’emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka egwenerete konyenywa.
english: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed.

ekegusii: Ndiarenge Rituko Rinene ri’okoinyora okoigorwa na ogosaberwa gwe Hekalu aria Yerusalemu.
english: Then came the Feast of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,

ekegusii: Morende Amatuko Amanene e Chichuma ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, Morente ebiegwa bi’ogwancha ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, mobirue buna koreng’ana abasesenirie.
english: Then celebrate the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God by giving a freewill offering in proportion to the blessings the LORD your God has given you.

ekegusii: Onye nabo, anga yamogwenerete achandwe ekero ase ekero korwa omochakano, ekero oboroso bw’ense bwabegetwe. Korende bono, ase amatuko ’omoerio bw’ense akaoroka ara rimo rioka ase okorusia ebibe ase okong’wanswa kwaye ere omonyene.
english: Then Christ would have had to suffer many times since the creation of the world. But now he has appeared once for all at the end of the ages to do away with sin by the sacrifice of himself.

ekegusii: Toimoke totiire kogenda Beteli, erinde ing’agachere Nyasae egesasimero aroro, Nyasae oyonyigwete ekero keria narenge nobokong’u, akaba amo nainche ase orogendo rwane rwonsi.”
english: Then come, let us go up to Bethel, where I will build an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and who has been with me wherever I have gone."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio origererie amasio aito na ay’abamura abwo bakoria endagera ekorwa ase omoruoti, na korarore buna tokororekana, otokorere buna oranche.”
english: Then compare our appearance with that of the young men who eat the royal food, and treat your servants in accordance with what you see."

ekegusii: Erio Danieli, oyo orenge korokwa Beli‐Tesasari, agaichanigwa ase ekero egeke ase engencho y’amang’ana aria, na ebirengererio biaye bikamoichania. Omoruoti akamotebia, “Beli‐Tesasari, chindoto echi na engencho yaye, tibigoichania.” Beli‐Tesasari akairaneria, akamotebia, “Omonene one, naki yare koba buya onye chindoto echi nchiaba igoro y’abwo bakogechete, na engencho yaye ebe igoro y’ababisa bao.
english: Then Daniel (also called Belteshazzar) was greatly perplexed for a time, and his thoughts terrified him. So the king said, "Belteshazzar, do not let the dream or its meaning alarm you." Belteshazzar answered, "My lord, if only the dream applied to your enemies and its meaning to your adversaries!

ekegusii: Erio agwo Danieli akairaneria omoruoti, akamotebia, “Gacha ebiegwa biao, na kae omonto omoao ebio oganetie kong’a. Korende nonya naboigo, inche ningosomere aye omoruoti amariko aya, naende ngotebie engencho yaye.
english: Then Daniel answered the king, "You may keep your gifts for yourself and give your rewards to someone else. Nevertheless, I will read the writing for the king and tell him what it means.

ekegusii: Then Daniel returned to his house and explained the matter to his friends Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.
english: Erio Danieli akairana gochia inka, agatebia Hanania, na Mishaeli, na Asaria, abamwabo, amang’ana aria,

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio Danieli akagenda ase Arioki, oria omoruoti achorete ng’a aite abanto abang’aini ba Babeli, akamotebia, “Tobaisa goita abang’aini ba Babeli; ng’ire ase obosio bw’omoruoti, imotebie engencho ye chindoto chiria.”
english: Then Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to execute the wise men of Babylon, and said to him, "Do not execute the wise men of Babylon. Take me to the king, and I will interpret his dream for him."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agancha ebinto biria omokungu oria amoirerete, akamotebia, “Irana gochia bwoo nomorembe. Rora, naigure amang’ana ao, nanchire okoboria kwao.”
english: Then David accepted from her hand what she had brought him and said, "Go home in peace. I have heard your words and granted your request."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabwata chianga chiaye, agachitandora, na abanto bonsi abarenge amo nere bagakora bo.
english: Then David and all the men with him took hold of their clothes and tore them.

ekegusii: Daudi agacha ase Orinani, na ekero Orinani amoroche akarua agwo ase ekeooreri, agacha agatung’ama, akaumama ase obosio bwa Daudi.
english: Then David approached, and when Araunah looked and saw him, he left the threshing floor and bowed down before David with his face to the ground.

ekegusii: Then David called one of his men and said, "Go, strike him down!" So he struck him down, and he died.
english: Erio Daudi akarangeria omomura oyomo, akamotebia, “Inchuo omoite!” Omomura oria agaaka Omoameleki oria, akamoita,

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akairana gochia ase abanto baria amagana abere konya barosire batigarete agwo ase akarooche ka Besori. Ekero aigete ang’e, barabwo bagacha komorotota, ere na abanto baria barenge komo. Daudi akabachiera, akabakwania.
english: Then David came to the two hundred men who had been too exhausted to follow him and who were left behind at the Besor Ravine. They came out to meet David and the people with him. As David and his men approached, he greeted them.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaba okoremia Batiseba mokaye; akaba nere, na ere akaibora omwana omoisia, na Daudi akamoroka Sulemani. Na Omonene akaba bwanchete omwana oria,
english: Then David comforted his wife Bathsheba, and he went to her and lay with her. She gave birth to a son, and they named him Solomon. The LORD loved him;

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akaamboka gochia eng’umbu ende, agatenena aare ase ekegoro keria, bokaba oboare botari boke ase egati yabo.
english: Then David crossed over to the other side and stood on top of the hill some distance away; there was a wide space between them.

ekegusii: Daudi agatama korwa Nayoti agwo Rama, akagenda ase Yonathani, akamoboria, “Ninki nakorire? Okomocha kwane, na ebibe biane mbiribi ase obosio bwa iso? Nase ki arigetie kong’ita?”
english: Then David fled from Naioth at Ramah and went to Jonathan and asked, "What have I done? What is my crime? How have I wronged your father, that he is trying to take my life?"

ekegusii: Then David gave his son Solomon the plans for the portico of the temple, its buildings, its storerooms, its upper parts, its inner rooms and the place of atonement.
english: Erio Daudi akaa Sulemani, omwana oye, omogwekano bw’enyomba eria enke erabe bosio bwe Hekalu, na oyo bw’ebinyomba bie Hekalu, ne chikungo chie Hekalu, na obw’ebinyomba bia irongo, na ebinyomba bia ime, na obw’akanyomba k’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera.

ekegusii: Daudi akaimoka korwa inse agesibia, ageaka amaguta, akaonchoreria chianga chiaye; agasoa ase enyomba y’Omonene agasasima. Erio akairana bwoye, akaboria endagera, akaegwa akaria.
english: Then David got up from the ground. After he had washed, put on lotions and changed his clothes, he went into the house of the LORD and worshiped. Then he went to his own house, and at his request they served him food, and he ate.

ekegusii: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon.
english: Daudi agachika abaraai bonsi b’Abaisraeli ng’a babe bagokonya Sulemani, omwana oye, akabatebia,

ekegusii: Daudi akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, erio agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi.
english: Then David rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David.

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Abiatari omokuani, mosinto bw’Ahimeleki, “Ndetere egesibao ki’obokuani.” Abiatari akarentera Daudi egesibao keria.
english: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, "Bring me the ephod." Abiathar brought it to him,

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia Abiatari, “Rituko riria Doegi Omoedomu arenge aaria, inche nabo namanyete ng’a goika atebie Saulo; ase ayio ninche nagerete abanto b’eamate yao bonsi bagaitwa.
english: Then David said to Abiathar: "That day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, I knew he would be sure to tell Saul. I am responsible for the death of your father's whole family.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia Akisi, “Onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, koranche ong’e aase nkomenya ase omochie ore isiko korwa ase omochie oo. Tari buya asende, omosomba oo, ngenderere komenya ase omochie omonene bw’oboruoti amo naye?”
english: Then David said to Achish, "If I have found favor in your eyes, let a place be assigned to me in one of the country towns, that I may live there. Why should your servant live in the royal city with you?"

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia abasomba baye bonsi, abwo barenge nere agwo Yerusalemu, “Imoka totame, onye torigetie gwetooria korwa ase Abisalomu. Ayerera bwango, Abisalomu tabaisa gocha gotoumokera na gotorentera amabe, gose aite abanto b’omochie nomoro.”
english: Then David said to all his officials who were with him in Jerusalem, "Come! We must flee, or none of us will escape from Absalom. We must leave immediately, or he will move quickly to overtake us and bring ruin upon us and put the city to the sword."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia Nyasae, “Nakorire ebibe ebinene ase aya nakorire. Korende bono nagosabire, onyabere inche, omosomba oo, ogosaria kwane, naki nigo nakorire egento ki’oboriri obonene.”
english: Then David said to God, "I have sinned greatly by doing this. Now, I beg you, take away the guilt of your servant. I have done a very foolish thing."

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Uria, “Beera aiga rero naende, ankio nkoe ribaga ogende.” Ase igo Uria akabeera Yerusalemu ase rituko riria, ne rituko ria kabere boigo.
english: Then David said to him, "Stay here one more day, and tomorrow I will send you back." So Uriah remained in Jerusalem that day and the next.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agachika Yoabu amo nabanto bonsi barenge amo nere batandore chianga chiabo na beboyie chigunia, erinde bareere Abineri. Omoruoti Daudi nere omonyene agatunyana oborere kobobogoirie.
english: Then David said to Joab and all the people with him, "Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth and walk in mourning in front of Abner." King David himself walked behind the bier.

ekegusii: Daudi agatebia Nathani, “Nakoreire Omonene ebibe.” Nathani akamoiraneria, “Omonene okwabeire ebibe biao; togokwa.
english: Then David said to Nathan, "I have sinned against the LORD." Nathan replied, "The LORD has taken away your sin. You are not going to die.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatebia omosangererekano bwonsi, “Togia Omonene, Nyasae oino!” Na omosangererekano bwonsi ogatogia Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, na agwo abanto baria bagatureka emetwe yabo, bagasasima Omonene naende bakaorokia amasikani ase omoruoti.
english: Then David said to the whole assembly, "Praise the LORD your God." So they all praised the LORD, the God of their fathers; they bowed low and fell prostrate before the LORD and the king.

ekegusii: Daudi akaboria omomura oria, “Naki gwakorete okamanya ng’a Saulo na Yonathani, momura oye, bakure?”
english: Then David said to the young man who brought him the report, "How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?"

ekegusii: Naende agatebia Uria, “Genda bwoo, bwesibie amagoro otimoke.” Uria akarua nyomba mw’omoruoti, na Daudi akamotunyaneria ekeegwa.
english: Then David said to Uriah, "Go down to your house and wash your feet." So Uriah left the palace, and a gift from the king was sent after him.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akabora, “Onde takobogoria Esanduku eria ya Nyasae otatiga Abalawi boka, ekiagera Omonene nigo achorete Abalawi babe bakobogoria Esanduku y’Omonene, naende bamokorere kogenderera.”
english: Then David said, "No one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, because the LORD chose them to carry the ark of the LORD and to minister before him forever."

ekegusii: Daudi agateba, “Aiga nao enyomba y’Omonene Nyasae erabe ase Abaisraeli bakoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.”
english: Then David said, "The house of the LORD God is to be here, and also the altar of burnt offering for Israel."

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatoma abanto bamwoyie. Ere agacha ase Daudi, na Daudi akarara nere. Batiseba gakoorire gwechena korwa ase ogotechena kwaye, akaimoka, akairana mwaye.
english: Then David sent messengers to get her. She came to him, and he slept with her. (She had purified herself from her uncleanness.) Then she went back home.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi agatoma abanto ase Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, akabora, “Ing’iranerie Mikali mokane, oyio narierete boko, na ngaakana rigori ri’amasankwa a isiko ay’ebiimo bi’obosacha ay’Abafilisti rigana erimo, erinde imonyuome.”
english: Then David sent messengers to Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, demanding, "Give me my wife Michal, whom I betrothed to myself for the price of a hundred Philistine foreskins."

ekegusii: Daudi akaimoka, akagenda aase aria Saulo atoorete. Akarora aase aria Saulo araire amo n’Abineri, mosinto o Neri; omochiki bw’abarwani baye. Saulo nigo araire aase chigari chiabekire chikengete, na abarwani bamoetanaine.
english: Then David set out and went to the place where Saul had camped. He saw where Saul and Abner son of Ner, the commander of the army, had lain down. Saul was lying inside the camp, with the army encamped around him.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi akarangeria abakuani Zadoki na Abiatari, naende Abalawi: Urieli na Asaia, Yoeli na Semaya, Elieli na Aminadabu,
english: Then David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel and Amminadab the Levites.

ekegusii: Daudi akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Omonene aitete Usa, na igo akaroka aase aria Peresi‐Usa; naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: Then David was angry because the LORD's wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.

ekegusii: Daudi akagechigwa mono, ekiagera Omonene aitete Usa. Aase aria akarokwa Peresi‐Usa, naboigo akorokwa nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: Then David was angry because the LORD's wrath had broken out against Uzzah, and to this day that place is called Perez Uzzah.

ekegusii: Daudi nere akaimoka agasoka korwa ase rikuruma riria, akabwatia Saulo, akarangeria neriogi, agateba, “Aye omoruoti, omonene one!” Ekero Saulo eonchorete korigereria, Daudi agatung’ama inse, akaumama, akorokia amasikani.
english: Then David went out of the cave and called out to Saul, "My lord the king!" When Saul looked behind him, David bowed down and prostrated himself with his face to the ground.

ekegusii: Amakweri agatugutwa amo na aase abakure ase enyancha y’omorero. Enyancha eye y’omorero nero amakweri a kabere.
english: Then death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.

ekegusii: Erio Debora agatebia Baraki, “Imoka, ogende! Rituko ria rero nario Omonene abekire Sisera ase amaboko ao. Omonene ogotang’aneire gochia korwana esegi.” Baraki agatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gia Tabori amo nabanto chilifu ikomi baare komotunyana.
english: Then Deborah said to Barak, "Go! This is the day the LORD has given Sisera into your hands. Has not the LORD gone ahead of you?" So Barak went down Mount Tabor, followed by ten thousand men.

ekegusii: Delila agatebia Samison, “Rora, gwankoreire echeche, naende gwantebirie oborimo. Koranche ontebie buna oranyare gosibwa.”
english: Then Delilah said to Samson, "You have made a fool of me; you lied to me. Come now, tell me how you can be tied."

ekegusii: Ase ayio omwana one, bono nigo ore inse y’okobua kw’omonto oyio, na onye korigetie gwetooria korwa asare okore iga: Kabe omoitongo, ogende asare omosorore, erinde agosibore korwa ase eira eyio.
english: then do this, my son, to free yourself, since you have fallen into your neighbor's hands: Go and humble yourself; press your plea with your neighbor!

ekegusii: Komoranyore ng’a noborimo, erio mokorere kirori oria amang’ana aria aria ere arengereretie gokorera oyomwabo. Naboigo morusie obobe borue asemore.
english: then do to him as he intended to do to his brother. You must purge the evil from among you.

ekegusii: Erio obekere Haroni chianga chiria chinchenu, omoake amaguta na komwatanana, anyare gonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani,
english: Then dress Aaron in the sacred garments, anoint him and consecrate him so he may serve me as priest.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo akabwata omotwe bw’oyo riare koamererania, na komobeta omoyio ase rikere; bonsi bakagwa inse bagakwa. Ase ayio, aase aria a Gibeoni akarokwa Helikati‐Hasurimu.
english: Then each man grabbed his opponent by the head and thrust his dagger into his opponent's side, and they fell down together. So that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaegwa eanga entambe endabu, bagatebigwa batimoke engaki ende enke goika omobaro bw’abasomba abamo, na abamwabo, oikeranigwe, abwo barache goitwa boigo buna barabwo abanyene baitetwe.
english: Then each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to wait a little longer, until the number of their fellow servants and brothers who were to be killed as they had been was completed.

ekegusii: Then Ehud went out to the porch; he shut the doors of the upper room behind him and locked them.
english: Erio Ehudi agasoka, agasieka ebisieri bi’akanyomba karia, akabibunga.

ekegusii: Eleazari atobeke ekiara kiaye ase amanyinga ’eng’ombe eria, ayanyororokerie ara gatano na kabere bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Then Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Na Eleazari omokuani agatebia abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase okorwana esegi, “Oyo noro omoroberio Omonene achigete Musa:
english: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, "This is the requirement of the law that the LORD gave Moses:

ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, oria orenge omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa, mosinto bw’Asafu, omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bagacha ase Hezekia ne chianga chiabo chitandogete, bakamotebia amang’ana onsi omochiki oria omonene akwanete.
english: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.

ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia, oria orenge omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw’Asafu, omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bagacha ase Hezekia bare ne chianga chitandogete, bakamotebia amang’ana ayio Rabi‐Sake akwanete.
english: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went to Hezekiah, with their clothes torn, and told him what the field commander had said.

ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, mosinto o Hilikia na Sebuna, na Yoa, bagatebia Rabi‐Sake oria, “Koranche kwana naintwe, abasomba bao, ase omonwa bw’Ekearamaik, ekiagera ntoyomanyete; tobaisa gokwana naintwe ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda ekero abanto bare ase orwaki igoro bategererete.”
english: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, and Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don't speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall."

ekegusii: Erio Eliakimu, na Sebuna, na Yoa, bagatebia Rabi‐Sake, “Koranche okwane naintwe, abasomba bao, ase omonwa bw’Ekearamaiki, ekiagera ntoyomanyete; tobaisa gokwana naintwe ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda ekero abanto bare ase orwaki igoro bategererete.”
english: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to the field commander, "Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it. Don't speak to us in Hebrew in the hearing of the people on the wall."

ekegusii: Then Elihu said:
english: Erio Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:

ekegusii: Then Elihu said:
english: Elihu akagenderera gokwana, akabora:

ekegusii: Erio Elija agatebia abanto, “Bwata ababani aba ba Baali, timotiga nonya noyomo atame.” Na abanto bakababwata, na Elija akabatirimbokia gochia ase akarooche ga Kisoni, akabaitera aroro agwo.
english: Then Elijah commanded them, "Seize the prophets of Baal. Don't let anyone get away!" They seized them, and Elijah had them brought down to the Kishon Valley and slaughtered there.

ekegusii: Erio Elija agatebia abanto bonsi, “Inchuo ang’e asende.” Na abanto bonsi bagacha ang’e asare. Ere akaroisia egesasimero ki’Omonene, keria konya giatagoirwe kiaiyerigwe inse.
english: Then Elijah said to all the people, "Come here to me." They came to him, and he repaired the altar of the LORD, which was in ruins.

ekegusii: Naende Elija agatebia Elisha, “Aye beera aiga, ekiagera Omonene ontomire ngende Yeriko.” Korende Elisha akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, naende buna aye ore moyo, tinkogotiga.” Ase ayio bakagenda Yeriko.
english: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here, Elisha; the LORD has sent me to Jericho." And he replied, "As surely as the LORD lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So they went to Jericho.

ekegusii: Erio Elija agatebia Elisha, “Aye beera aiga, ekiagera Omonene ontomire ngende Yorodan.” Elisha akamoiraneria, “Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, naende buna aye ore moyo, tinkogotiga.” Ase ayio, aba babere bakagenda orogendo rwabo.
english: Then Elijah said to him, "Stay here; the LORD has sent me to the Jordan." And he replied, "As surely as the LORD lives and as you live, I will not leave you." So the two of them walked on.

ekegusii: Erio Elija agatebia abanto, “Inche ninche bweka natigaire omobani bw’Omonene, korende ababani ba Baali namagana ane, na emerongo etano.
english: Then Elijah said to them, "I am the only one of the LORD's prophets left, but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.

ekegusii: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
english: Bono Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:

ekegusii: Then Eliphaz the Temanite replied:
english: Erio Elifasi Omotemani akairaneria, akabora:

ekegusii: Elisha agatebia Gehasi, “Morangerie!” Na ekero arangeretie omokungu oria, nere agatenena gesieri.
english: Then Elisha said, "Call her." So he called her, and she stood in the doorway.

ekegusii: Erio Elikana akairana gochia Rama nka bwoye, korende omwana oria Samweli agatigara ogokorera Omonene inse y’oboteneneri bwa Eli omokuani.
english: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy ministered before the LORD under Eli the priest.

ekegusii: Erio agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Ayaloni, ase orogongo rwa Sabuloni.
english: Then Elon died, and was buried in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.

ekegusii: Ekero Esau achia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora abakungu na abana, akamoboria, “Aba naba ng’o more komo?” Yakobo akamoiraneria, “Aba nabana Nyasae ang’eire inche, omosomba oo, ase obuya bwaye.”
english: Then Esau looked up and saw the women and children. "Who are these with you?" he asked. Jacob answered, "They are the children God has graciously given your servant."

ekegusii: Then Esau said, "Let us be on our way; I'll accompany you."
english: Erio Esau akamotebia, “Eta, togende seito, na inche ningotang’ane.”

ekegusii: Naende Esteri akabatoma ase Moredekai bamoiranerie,
english: Then Esther sent this reply to Mordecai:

ekegusii: Erio Esteri akarangeria Hataki, oyo omoruoti achorete koba omokoreri bw’Esteri, akamotoma agende ase Moredekai amoborerie engencho y’amang’ana ayio, naende ninki kiagerire achandegete igo.
english: Then Esther summoned Hathach, one of the king's eunuchs assigned to attend her, and ordered him to find out what was troubling Mordecai and why.

ekegusii: Igo nonya noyore omoremu buna endo, nigo arairianyeke kegima, ekiagera Abaisraeli bonsi mbamanyete ng’a iso nigo are etuoni y’esegi, na abanto baye nabatindi ase esegi.
english: Then even the bravest soldier, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will melt with fear, for all Israel knows that your father is a fighter and that those with him are brave.

ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa bonsi bakamotiga, bagatama.
english: Then everyone deserted him and fled.

ekegusii: Nebe ng’a omonto onde bwensi ase eamate yao oratigare ore moyo nagende gotung’ama ase obosio bw’omokuani oyio, amosabe amoe ebesa gose omogati, ogoteba: Nagosabire ombeke nainche nkonye ase emeremo gete y’obokuani, erinde inyore omogati nkoria.”
english: Then everyone left in your family line will come and bow down before him for a piece of silver and a crust of bread and plead, "Appoint me to some priestly office so I can have food to eat."'"

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abaigusetwe ase engencho y’amang’ana aria Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli akwanete igoro y’ogotegenwa kw’abanto baria bairanete korwa ase obosomba, bagasangererekana asende agwo ase naikaransete ing’ichanete goika engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba.
english: Then everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered around me because of this unfaithfulness of the exiles. And I sat there appalled until the evening sacrifice.

ekegusii: rirorio moonchorerie ebinto ebio ase chibesa, erinde mochiire aase agwo Omonene oino achorire.
english: then exchange your tithe for silver, and take the silver with you and go to the place the LORD your God will choose.

ekegusii: Agwo Ezara omokuani agatenena, akabatebia, “Inwe timobeti abegenwa, mwanyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao; ase igo mwagerire amamocho ’Abaisraeli amentekanire.
english: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, "You have been unfaithful; you have married foreign women, adding to Israel's guilt.

ekegusii: Ezara akarua agwo ase enyomba ya Nyasae, akagenda ase akanyomba ka Yehohanani, mosinto bw’Eliasibu, akabeera aroro; taria kende gose konywa, korende nigo abete okorera, ekiagera abanto baria barenge ase obosomba tibabete abegenwa.
english: Then Ezra withdrew from before the house of God and went to the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. While he was there, he ate no food and drank no water, because he continued to mourn over the unfaithfulness of the exiles.

ekegusii: Korende Feliki, ekiagera amanyete boronge amang’ana ’Enchera eria, agatiga ekina kerare, akabora, “Lisia, omochiki omonene bw’abarwani karatirimboke, rirorio ninyigwe amang’ana aino.”
english: Then Felix, who was well acquainted with the Way, adjourned the proceedings. "When Lysias the commander comes," he said, "I will decide your case."

ekegusii: Erio akarenterwa na endagera, korende agateba, “Tinkoria goika ndateba amang’ana aane.” Labani akairaneria, “Gaki, yakwane!”
english: Then food was set before him, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told you what I have to say." "Then tell us," [Laban] said.

ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore ogosaba kwabo na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, obae oboronge bwabo.
english: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa aase agwo igoro, ase obomenyo bwao bore, ogosaba kwabo na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, obae oboronge bwabo na bwabere abanto bao abakorire ebibe asore.
english: then from heaven, your dwelling place, hear their prayer and their pleas, and uphold their cause. And forgive your people, who have sinned against you.

ekegusii: Eng’iti eria egasiara amache korwa ase omonwa oye, anga buna orooche, korwa nyuma y’omokungu oria, emoire norooche roria.
english: Then from his mouth the serpent spewed water like a river, to overtake the woman and sweep her away with the torrent.

ekegusii: Naende korwa ase egetonga keria kiarenge agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene akarusia omogati oyomo otabekiri memera, ne rindasi erimo, na omogati oyomo omoo, erio akabibeka igoro ase ebitinya ebio na ekenama ekio kia borio.
