english: Then from the basket of bread made without yeast, which was before the LORD, he took a cake of bread, and one made with oil, and a wafer; he put these on the fat portions and on the right thigh.

ekegusii: Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi agateba, “Abimeleki nere ng’o? Naintwe, abanto ba Sekemu, mbanto ki tore? Nase ki togokorera Abimeleki? Ere mosinto o Yerubi‐Baali! Na Sebuli, nere omoteneneri bw’abanto baye! Nase ki rende togokorera Abimeleki? Taibo, tobe abegenwa ase abanto abarwete Hamori, sokoro y’abanto ba Sekemu!
english: Then Gaal son of Ebed said, "Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should be subject to him? Isn't he Jerub-Baal's son, and isn't Zebul his deputy? Serve the men of Hamor, Shechem's father! Why should we serve Abimelech?

ekegusii: Erio Gidioni akagenda ase abanto ba Sukoti, akabatebia, “Rora aiga Seba na Salimuna, baria inwe mwanyomaneretie mogoteba iga: Torabua Seba na Salimuna. Naki rende torakore toe abarwani bao, abwo bagoyire, emegati!”
english: Then Gideon came and said to the men of Succoth, "Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, about whom you taunted me by saying, 'Do you already have the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna in your possession? Why should we give bread to your exhausted men?'"

ekegusii: Gidioni akairaneria, “Ekero Omonene arabeke Seba na Salimuna ase amaboko aane, ning’arie chinyama chi’emebere yaino namagwa ’orosana na amageri.”
english: Then Gideon replied, "Just for that, when the LORD has given Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, I will tear your flesh with desert thorns and briers."

ekegusii: Gidioni agakwana na Nyasae, akamotebia, “Nyasae, totiga endamwamu yao yoke asende, korende ing’a ribaga nkwane naye rimo naende. Tiga nteeme rimo naende ne risankwa eri. Na bono ekero eke kora iga ng’a risankwa ribe eriomo, korende obotooru bobe ase riroba inse rionsi.”
english: Then Gideon said to God, "Do not be angry with me. Let me make just one more request. Allow me one more test with the fleece. This time make the fleece dry and the ground covered with dew."

ekegusii: Erio osoe nyomba mwao amo nabana bao, osieke egesieri, oumore amaguta ase ebibekerero ebio. Kera ekemo kogiaichoire okebeke ensemo.”
english: Then go inside and shut the door behind you and your sons. Pour oil into all the jars, and as each is filled, put it to one side."

ekegusii: Na genda bwango, motebie aborokigwa baye ng’a obokire korwa ase abakure; na rora, obatang’aneire kogenda Galili; agwo nao moramorore. Rora, inche nabatebirie ayio.”
english: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: 'He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.' Now I have told you."

ekegusii: Erio ogende ase omoruoti, omotebie amang’ana ndagotebie,” na Yoabu akamotebia aya agochia gokwana.
english: Then go to the king and speak these words to him." And Joab put the words in her mouth.

ekegusii: Nyasae agasesenia Nuhu amo nabamura baye, akabatebia, “Moibore, momeneteke, moichore ase ense.
english: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, saying to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the earth.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae agachera Labani Omoaramu ase chindoto botuko, akamotebia, “Bwerende, tobaisa kwomania Yakobo, korende okwane nere ase obwororo.”
english: Then God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream at night and said to him, "Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad."

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akaramokia Hagari amaiso, na ere akarora ensoko y’amache, akagenda, akabuucha, agaichoria ekerandi amache, akaa omwana akanywa.
english: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.

ekegusii: Nyasae akabochora engoro yarenge agwo Lei, na amache agasoka korwa agwo. Samison akanywa amache ayio, na akaigwa obeire buna omonto omoyia, akanyora chinguru. Eke nakio gekogera ensoko eria ya Lei ekarokwa Eni‐Hakore; nabo ekorokwa nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: Then God opened up the hollow place in Lehi, and water came out of it. When Samson drank, his strength returned and he revived. So the spring was called En Hakkore, and it is still there in Lehi.

ekegusii: Korende Nyasae akaba okoinyora Raeli, akaigwa ogosaba kwaye, akaigora enda yaye;
english: Then God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and opened her womb.

ekegusii: Nyasae agatebia Ibrahimu, “Aye goika obwate okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, aye na ororeria rwao rorache korwa nyuma yao, ekiaare ase ekiaare.
english: Then God said to Abraham, "As for you, you must keep my covenant, you and your descendants after you for the generations to come.

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akamotebia ase okorota, “Inche namanyire ng’a ase enkoro etari na komocha gwakorire aya, na inche nkagotanga tigwankorera ebibe. Ase ayio, tinakoa ribaga omokune.
english: Then God said to him in the dream, "Yes, I know you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against me. That is why I did not let you touch her.

ekegusii: Nyasae agatebia Yakobo, “Imoka, otiire ogende Beteli, omenye aroro, oagachere Nyasae egesasimero agwo, Nyasae, oyo okoorokerete ekero kware gotama korwa ase Esau omino.”
english: Then God said to Jacob, "Go up to Bethel and settle there, and build an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you were fleeing from your brother Esau."

ekegusii: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him:
english: Erio Nyasae agatebia Nuhu amo nabamura baye,

ekegusii: Then God said to Noah,
english: Erio Nyasae agatebia Nuhu,

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateba, “Rora, nabaeire kera ekemeri gekwama chimbusuro ase ense engima, na kera omote okwama amatunda are ne chimbusuro chire imeo; nabio birabe endagera yaino.
english: Then God said, "I give you every seed-bearing plant on the face of the whole earth and every tree that has fruit with seed in it. They will be yours for food.

ekegusii: Naende Nyasae agateba, “Tiga ense emere ebinto bigokina, buna ebimeri bikorua chimbusuro, na emete ekwama amatunda are ne chimbusuro chire imeo, kera oyomo ase egesaku kiaye ekenyene”; akaba boigo.
english: Then God said, "Let the land produce vegetation: seed-bearing plants and trees on the land that bear fruit with seed in it, according to their various kinds." And it was so.

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae agateba, “Tiga tokore omonto ase omogwekano oito, otogwekaine, agambere chinswe chia nyancha, ne chinyoni chikoiruruka igoro, ne ching’iti chigotugwa, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana, na ense yonsi, ne ching’iti chionsi chikwagura igoro ase ense.”
english: Then God said, "Let us make man in our image, in our likeness, and let them rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, over all the earth, and over all the creatures that move along the ground."

ekegusii: Nyasae akamotebia, “Moire Isaka, omwana oyo oo omomoima, oyobwanchete, ogende nere goika ense ya Moria. Agwo omorue abe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase egetunwa ekemo ki’ebio ndakworokie.”
english: Then God said, "Take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go to the region of Moriah. Sacrifice him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains I will tell you about."

ekegusii: Nyasae akamokania, akamotebia, “Taibo, Sara mokao nakoiborere omwana omomura, na aye nomoroke Isaka. Inche ning’ikeranie nere okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, kobe okobwatana gwa kare na kare ase ororeria rwaye rorache korwa nyuma yaye.
english: Then God said, "Yes, but your wife Sarah will bear you a son, and you will call him Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.

ekegusii: Erio Nyasae akaimoka gochia igoro korwa asare, agwo ase arenge gokwana nere.
english: Then God went up from him at the place where he had talked with him.

ekegusii: Erio Hekalu ya Nyasae ere igoro ekaigorwa, na Esanduku y’okobwatana kwaye ekarorekana ase Hekalu yaye ime. Aroro bikaba okomesa, na okogukura, ne chinkoba, na omotengecho bw’ense, na embura y’amagena enyinge mono egatwa.
english: Then God's temple in heaven was opened, and within his temple was seen the ark of his covenant. And there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder, an earthquake and a great hailstorm.

ekegusii: Naende Hagai akaboria, “Onye omonto obeire oyotachenegeti ase ogokuna egetondo karakune ekemo ase ebinto ebio, Inee, ekio nakebe egetachenegeti?” Abakuani bakairaneria, bagateba, “Ee, nkebe egetachenegeti.”
english: Then Haggai said, "If a person defiled by contact with a dead body touches one of these things, does it become defiled?" "Yes," the priests replied, "it becomes defiled."

ekegusii: “Erio Hagai akairaneria, agateba,” “Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Naboigo nabanto aba, na egesaku eke, bare ase obosio bwane, na kera omoremo bagokora namaboko abo nabo ore, na kende gionsi eke bakorua aroro nigo kere egetachenegeti.
english: Then Haggai said, "'So it is with this people and this nation in my sight,' declares the LORD. 'Whatever they do and whatever they offer there is defiled.

ekegusii: Erio Hagai, omotomwa bw’Omonene, agakwana nabanto amang’ana ’Omonene, akabatebia, “Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Inche nigo inde amo nainwe.”
english: Then Haggai, the LORD's messenger, gave this message of the LORD to the people: "I am with you," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio Hamani agatebia omoruoti Ahaswero, “Mbare aa abanto b’egesaku gete besiarerete, bamenyete ase egati y’abanto be chingongo chionsi chi’oboruoti bwao. Amachiko ’abanto abwo nigo are nogwatananeka korwa ase amachiko ’abanto bande. Barabwo tibari korenda amachiko ao, aye omoruoti. Ase ayio, aye omoruoti, okoremereria koba nabanto aba tigokorenta bitoki binde ebiya asore.
english: Then Haman said to King Xerxes, "There is a certain people dispersed and scattered among the peoples in all the provinces of your kingdom whose customs are different from those of all other people and who do not obey the king's laws; it is not in the king's best interest to tolerate them.

ekegusii: Hana agasaba, agakwana, “Enkoro yane yachengeire Omonene; ase Omonene orogunchara rwane rwaimokereire igoro. Omonwa one nigo ogosekereria ababisa baane; nagokire ase ogotooreka kw’Omonene.
english: Then Hannah prayed and said: "My heart rejoices in the LORD; in the LORD my horn is lifted high. My mouth boasts over my enemies, for I delight in your deliverance.

ekegusii: Haribona, oyomo bw’abasomba abaare gokorera omoruoti, akabora, “Rora orobambo rore rw’obotambe bw’amaboko emerongo etano, roria Hamani asimiseretie Moredekai, oyo ogotooretie aye omoruoti, nao rore ang’e nenyomba ya Hamani.” Agwo omoruoti agachika, “Gachie motonge Hamani ase orobambo roria igoro.”
english: Then Harbona, one of the eunuchs attending the king, said, "A gallows seventy-five feet high stands by Haman's house. He had it made for Mordecai, who spoke up to help the king." The king said, "Hang him on it!"

ekegusii: Erio ase rituko ria ikomi ri’omotienyi o gatano na kabere, Rituko ri’Okobwatanigwa, egetureri kebugigwe ase ense yaino yonsi.
english: Then have the trumpet sounded everywhere on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the Day of Atonement sound the trumpet throughout your land.

ekegusii: Hasaeli akarua ase Elisha, akairana ase omonene oye. Nere akamoboria, “Naki Elisha agotebia?” Hasaeli akamoiraneria, “Nigo antebia ng’a ekeene aye nogwene.”
english: Then Hazael left Elisha and returned to his master. When Ben-Hadad asked, "What did Elisha say to you?" Hazael replied, "He told me that you would certainly recover."

ekegusii: Naende akamotebia, “Nimbwate egento ngokwana naye.” Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Kwana.”
english: Then he added, "I have something to say to you." "You may say it," she replied.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inwe abasacha b’Abaisraeli, erende buna morakorere abanto aba.
english: Then he addressed them: "Men of Israel, consider carefully what you intend to do to these men.

ekegusii: Naende nigo agoteba, “Ebibe biabo, na ogosaria kwabo tinkobiinyora naende nonya ng’ake.”
english: Then he adds: "Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more."

ekegusii: Erio arue bwoo, ere amo nabana baye, airane gochia ase eamate yaye na amenye ase omwando bwe chisokoro chiaye.
english: Then he and his children are to be released, and he will go back to his own clan and to the property of his forefathers.

ekegusii: Ere na abanto baria barenge komo bakaria na bakanywa, erio bakarara aroro. Mambia kobwachia gokia akabatebia, “Ing’a ribaga ng’irane ase omonene one.”
english: Then he and the men who were with him ate and drank and spent the night there. When they got up the next morning, he said, "Send me on my way to my master."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio akaorokera Yakobo, erio abatomwa bonsi.
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

ekegusii: Naende akaboria omokungu oria, “Emechando yao nereri?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Omokungu nare aa tore komo agantebia: Rituko ria rero tiga torie omwana oo, na ankio torie oyone.
english: Then he asked her, "What's the matter?" She answered, "This woman said to me, 'Give up your son so we may eat him today, and tomorrow we'll eat my son.'

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Ning’o asemore ore netigere gose eng’ombe yagure ase engoro, otari koyerusia erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
english: Then he asked them, "If one of you has a son or an ox that falls into a well on the Sabbath day, will you not immediately pull him out?"

ekegusii: Erio Gidioni akaboria Seba na Salimuna, “Inee! Abanto baria mwaitete agwo Tabori, nkieni ki barenge?” Bakamoiraneria, “Kera oyomo obo nigo akogwekaine. Nigo barorekanete buna bare abana b’omoruoti.”
english: Then he asked Zebah and Zalmunna, "What kind of men did you kill at Tabor?" "Men like you," they answered, "each one with the bearing of a prince."

ekegusii: akamoboria, “Nomoiseke o ng’o ore? Naende ontebie gose ribaga ndire mwa iso toranyare korara botuko.”
english: Then he asked, "Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father's house for us to spend the night?"

ekegusii: Agasangereria Abayuda na Ababenjamin bonsi, na abanto bonsi korwa ase Abaefraimu na Abamanase, na Abasimeoni, abarenge abamenyi ase egati yabo. Abanto abange korwa ase Abaisraeli konya batamire gochia asare, ekero baroche ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oye, nigo arenge amo nere.
english: Then he assembled all Judah and Benjamin and the people from Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon who had settled among them, for large numbers had come over to him from Israel when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.

ekegusii: Erio agachaka kweragereria na gotiana, okobora, “Inche timomanyeti omonto oyio.” Erio kegima etuoni ekabuga.
english: Then he began to call down curses on himself and he swore to them, "I don't know the man!" Immediately a rooster crowed.

ekegusii: Erio agasesenia Yusufu, akabora, “Nyasae o sokoro yane Ibrahimu na o Isaka tata, oyio baare gotaara ase obosio bwaye; Nyasae oyo nere ondisirie ase obogima bwane bwonsi goika rero,
english: Then he blessed Joseph and said, "May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,

ekegusii: Erio Isaka agakwa, agasangerereka amo nabanto baye, ore omogotu kegima, omonto bw’emiaka emenge, na abamura baye, Esau na Yakobo, bakamotindeka.
english: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

ekegusii: Naende Musa akarenta abamura ba Haroni, akababekera chiganchwa, akababoeria chinkini na akababekera ebigogwa ebike ase emetwe yabo, buna Omonene amochigete.
english: Then he brought Aaron's sons forward, put tunics on them, tied sashes around them and put headbands on them, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Ekero arentire egesaku kia Benjamin ang’e, obomera bokagwera eamate ya Matiri, na ase eamate ya Matiri obomera bokagwera Saulo, omomura o Kisi, korende abanto bagachia komorigia tibamonyora.
english: Then he brought forward the tribe of Benjamin, clan by clan, and Matri's clan was chosen. Finally Saul son of Kish was chosen. But when they looked for him, he was not to be found.

ekegusii: Omonto oria akang’ira ase eraaro ya ime goetera ase oboagacho bware geita ase ensemo ya irianyi, akaborenga, naborobwo nigo bwareng’aine nayande.
english: Then he brought me into the inner court through the south gate, and he measured the south gate; it had the same measurements as the others.

ekegusii: Omonto oria akang’ira goika ase eraaro ya isiko yatichire inse namagena ase chinsemo chionsi, na aroro agwo nkarora ebinyomba emerongo etato biaagachire igoro y’amagena ayio.
english: Then he brought me into the outer court. There I saw some rooms and a pavement that had been constructed all around the court; there were thirty rooms along the pavement.

ekegusii: Erio akandeta ase egesieri ki’eraaro, na ekero narigereretie nkarora ekebao ase enyasi.
english: Then he brought me to the entrance to the court. I looked, and I saw a hole in the wall.

ekegusii: Erio akang’ira ase egesoero ki’egeita gia sugusu ase enyomba y’Omonene, na aroro nkarora abakungu baikaranseteo bakoreera enyasae ekorokwa Tamusi.
english: Then he brought me to the entrance to the north gate of the house of the LORD, and I saw women sitting there, mourning for Tammuz.

ekegusii: Naende akang’ira ase eraaro ya ime goetera ase oboagacho bware geita ensemo ya moocha, akaborenga, naborobwo nigo bwareng’aine nayande.
english: Then he brought me to the inner court on the east side, and he measured the gateway; it had the same measurements as the others.

ekegusii: Erio akang’ira ase oboagacho bware geita ase ensemo ya sugusu, akaborenga; naborobwo nigo bwareng’aine nayande.
english: Then he brought me to the north gate and measured it. It had the same measurements as the others,

ekegusii: Akabeka Esanduku eria ime y’Obomenyo, agasunga etoto eria y’egetambaa ase ogokenga Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, buna Omonene konya amochikire.
english: Then he brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the shielding curtain and shielded the ark of the Testimony, as the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Akarangeria Sulemani, omwana oye, akamochika aagache enyomba ase Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Then he called for his son Solomon and charged him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Akarangeria omoganda na aborokigwa baye, akabatebia, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye, antunyane.
english: Then he called the crowd to him along with his disciples and said: "If anyone would come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria agaaka eriogi, agantebia, “Naama! Chibarasi echio chiagendete ase ense ya sugusu chiatoereirie omoika one ase ense eria.”
english: Then he called to me, "Look, those going toward the north country have given my Spirit rest in the land of the north."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio akarangeria babere b’abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akabatebia, “Beka ang’e abarwani amagana abere, na abarwani abariini chibarasi emerongo etano na ebere, na abare namatimo amagana abere ase okogenda Kaisaria chinsa isato chia botuko.
english: Then he called two of his centurions and ordered them, "Get ready a detachment of two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen and two hundred spearmen to go to Caesarea at nine tonight.

ekegusii: Akariina ime ase obwato asebare; omwaga ogakira. Bagaichana mono,
english: Then he climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. They were completely amazed,

ekegusii: Omonto oyio natere ase amasio ’abanto, atebe: Nigo nakorete ebibe, nkaonchorana aya arenge amaronge, gose tinanyorete egesusuro buna nagwenerete.
english: Then he comes to men and says, 'I sinned, and perverted what was right, but I did not get what I deserved.

ekegusii: Erio agantebia, “Aye Danieli, tibwoboa, ekiagera korwa rituko rie ritang’ani kwaruete enkoro yao ase okomanya, naende ogekeyia ase obosio bwa Nyasae oo, amang’ana ao nigo aigwetwe, na bono inche nachire ase engencho y’amang’ana aria ao.
english: Then he continued, "Do not be afraid, Daniel. Since the first day that you set your mind to gain understanding and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard, and I have come in response to them.

ekegusii: Erio akarera ase Omonene, akabora, “Omonene, Nyasae one, Inee, aye nigo kwarentire amaakwa igoro ase omokungu oyo omoboraka, imenyete mwaye, ase ogoita omwana oye?
english: Then he cried out to the LORD, "O LORD my God, have you brought tragedy also upon this widow I am staying with, by causing her son to die?"

ekegusii: Agasoa Hekalu ime, agachaka gosokia baria barenge koonia aroro,
english: Then he entered the temple area and began driving out those who were selling.

ekegusii: Akabeka amaru inse, akarera ase eriogi rinene, “Omonene, tobabarera ebibe ebi!” Ochia gokoora gokwana aya, agakwa. Na Saulo nigo aroche buya ase ogoitwa kwaye.
english: Then he fell on his knees and cried out, "Lord, do not hold this sin against them." When he had said this, he fell asleep.

ekegusii: Naende akagaba endagera ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, ase abasacha na abakungu; kera oyomo akaegwa omogati oyomo, na enyama inke, ne ribomba ri’amasasabibu amomo.
english: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each Israelite man and woman.

ekegusii: Erio akagaba endagera ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, abasacha na abakungu; kera oyomo akaegwa omogati oyomo, na akanyama gake, na amasabibu amomo. Erio kera omonto akarua agwo, akagenda bwoye.
english: Then he gave a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins to each person in the whole crowd of Israelites, both men and women. And all the people went to their homes.

ekegusii: Akamoa okwaroka buna ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana. Erio Ibrahimu akaibora Isaka, akamosara rituko ria gatano na gatato. Isaka akaibora Yakobo, na Yakobo akaibora baria ikomi na babere, abagaaka baito ba kare.
english: Then he gave Abraham the covenant of circumcision. And Abraham became the father of Isaac and circumcised him eight days after his birth. Later Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

ekegusii: Yehoyada omokuani akaa abatang’ani baria amatimo, ne ching’aya, ne chinguba echio chiarenge echia Daudi, chiabegetwe ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: Then he gave the commanders of units of a hundred the spears and the large and small shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of God.

ekegusii: Omokuani akaa abatang’ani baria amatimo ne chinguba chiria chiarenge echi’omoruoti Daudi; ebinto ebio biarenge ime ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Then he gave the commanders the spears and shields that had belonged to King David and that were in the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio Israeli akabachika, akabora, “Inche nkoirwa inde gosangererekana amo nabanto baane. Montindeke ase chisokoro chiane chiatindegetwe ase rikuruma ri’oboremo bware bw’Efuroni Omohiti,
english: Then he gave them these instructions: "I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

ekegusii: Yehu akariina egari yaye, akagenda Yesireeli, ekiagera Yoramu nao arenge orwarete, na Ahasia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda konya ochiireo komorora.
english: Then he got into his chariot and rode to Jezreel, because Joram was resting there and Ahaziah king of Judah had gone down to see him.

ekegusii: Ekero achia koriina obwato, aborokigwa baye bakamotunyana.
english: Then he got into the boat and his disciples followed him.

ekegusii: akariina borere igoro, akerambora igoro ase omwana oria, akabeka omonwa oye igoro ase omonwa bw’omwana, na amaiso aye igoro ase amaiso ’omwana, na amaboko aye igoro ase amaboko ’omwana; na buna eramborete igoro ase omwana, omobere bw’omwana ogachaka koba ne riberera.
english: Then he got on the bed and lay upon the boy, mouth to mouth, eyes to eyes, hands to hands. As he stretched himself out upon him, the boy's body grew warm.

ekegusii: Naende akarota okorota konde, na okwo agatebia abamwabo, akabora, “Moigwe! Inche nigo narotete okorota konde. Nkarora erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni ikomi nemo chigotung’ama inse ase obosio bwane.”
english: Then he had another dream, and he told it to his brothers. "Listen," he said, "I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me."

ekegusii: Agachika abanto bonsi abarenge agwo Yerusalemu na aba ase orogongo rwa Benjamin babwatane nokobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania, na abanto ba Yerusalemu bagakora koreng’ana nokobwatana koria kwa Nyasae ore Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo.
english: Then he had everyone in Jerusalem and Benjamin pledge themselves to it; the people of Jerusalem did this in accordance with the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

ekegusii: Erio omokuani atige enyoni eria ere moyo eiruruke, egende orosana isiko y’omochie. Ase enchera eyio akore okobwatanigwa ase enyomba eria, na ero ebe yachenekire.”
english: Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields outside the town. In this way he will make atonement for the house, and it will be clean."

ekegusii: omosacha oye amoire ase omokuani. Boigo arue obosie bw’esairi ebimunu bibere, ase engencho y’omokungu oria. Taumora amaguta igoro y’okoruegwa okwo, gose ubani, ekiagera nokoruegwa ase engencho ye risemi riaye. Okwo nokoruegwa koragere okomocha koinyorwe.
english: then he is to take his wife to the priest. He must also take an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour on her behalf. He must not pour oil on it or put incense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, a reminder offering to draw attention to guilt.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio arusie chianga chiaye, abeke chianga ching’ao, naende aimokie ribu, arisokie isiko y’egetwori, ariire gochia aase achenire.
english: Then he is to take off these clothes and put on others, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a place that is ceremonially clean.

ekegusii: Naende aimokie oroko orwo rw’omocharake, na orosagia rwa hisopo, na eusi eria embariri amo nenyoni eria ere moyo, abitobeke bionsi ime ase amanyinga ’enyoni eria yanyenyetwe, na amache aria amaya a rooche; erio anyororokerie enyomba eria ara gatano na kabere.
english: Then he is to take the cedar wood, the hyssop, the scarlet yarn and the live bird, dip them into the blood of the dead bird and the fresh water, and sprinkle the house seven times.

ekegusii: Naende arente chigoree chiria ibere ase obosio bwane inche Omonene agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Then he is to take the two goats and present them before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Erio amang’ana akararigwa ase Nineva bwonsi kobwatekana nogochika kw’omoruoti amo nabannene b’oboruoti bwaye, agateba: “Monto onde tabaisa koria kende; nonya neng’iti ende yonsi, gose eng’ombe, tichibaisa korisigwa, gose konyoisigwa.
english: Then he issued a proclamation in Nineveh: "By the decree of the king and his nobles: Do not let any man or beast, herd or flock, taste anything; do not let them eat or drink.

ekegusii: Naende akabeka amaboko aye igoro ase omotwe o Yoshua, akamwatanana, akamobeka ase ribaga riaye, buna Omonene konya amochikire goetera ase Musa.
english: Then he laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD instructed through Moses.

ekegusii: Ere akabeka omobere oria ase embeera yaye omonyene, na barabwo bakamoreera, na kera oyomo agateba, “Obee! Momura ominto!”
english: Then he laid the body in his own tomb, and they mourned over him and said, "Oh, my brother!"

ekegusii: Ase obotuko obwo Elija akarara inse ase omote oria omoretemu, na aroro omomalaika agacha akamokuna akamotebia, “Boka orie!”
english: Then he lay down under the tree and fell asleep. All at once an angel touched him and said, "Get up and eat."

ekegusii: Erio Efraimu akaba na mokaye, na ere akanyora oborito, akaibora omwana omomura. Efraimu akaroka omwana oria Beria, ekiagera amang’ana amabe achete ase enka yaye.
english: Then he lay with his wife again, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. He named him Beriah, because there had been misfortune in his family.

ekegusii: Omonto oria akang’ira gochia ase ensemo ya irianyi, na aroro nkarora oboagacho bware geita. Akarenga chisiiro chiaye na egesoero kiaye, na ebirengo ebio nigo biarenge buna ebi’ebinde.
english: Then he led me to the south side and I saw a gate facing south. He measured its jambs and its portico, and they had the same measurements as the others.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatiga emeganda, akagenda nyomba. Aborokigwa baye bakamochiera, bakobora, “Totebererie omoreng’anio bw’amabanchore a mogondo.”
english: Then he left the crowd and went into the house. His disciples came to him and said, "Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field."

ekegusii: Akabatiga, akariina obwato naende, akamboka ng’umbu.
english: Then he left them, got back into the boat and crossed to the other side.

ekegusii: Akarigereria abwo baikaransete bamoetanaine, akabora, “Rora baba na bamura baminto!
english: Then he looked at those seated in a circle around him and said, "Here are my mother and my brothers!

ekegusii: nario aroche obong’aini naende akaboraria; akaboikerania na koboenekia ase abanto.
english: then he looked at wisdom and appraised it; he confirmed it and tested it.

ekegusii: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
english: Akabaacha emiaro y’emekonge, akayeooma netahabu.

ekegusii: Erio agakora emegwekano y’abakerubi babere ey’etahabu esunyuntire, akayebeka ase chinsinyo ibere chi’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera,
english: Then he made two cherubim out of hammered gold at the ends of the cover.

ekegusii: Naende Rehoboamu akanyuoma Maaka, omoiseke bw’Abisalomu, nere akamoiborera Abiya, na Atai, na Sisa, na Selomiti.
english: Then he married Maacah daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza and Shelomith.

ekegusii: Naende omonto oria akarenga eraaro ya ime; obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obogare bwaye boigo; egesasimero nigo kiarenge bosio bwe Hekalu.
english: Then he measured the court: It was square-- a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide. And the altar was in front of the temple.

ekegusii: Naende akarenga obotambe korwa ase oboagacho bw’egeita gia inse gochia ase obw’egeita ki’eraaro ya ime, naborobwo bokaba obw’amaboko rigana erimo. Ekerengo gi’ensemo ya moocha na eya sugusu nigo biareng’aine.
english: Then he measured the distance from the inside of the lower gateway to the outside of the inner court; it was a hundred cubits on the east side as well as on the north.

ekegusii: Naende akarenga obotambe korwa ase akanyomba akamo goika ase akande karenge ensemo ende y’egesoero. Obotambe obwo bokaba obw’amaboko emerongo ebere na atano. Ebisieri bi’ebinyomba ebio nigo biachikaine.
english: Then he measured the gateway from the top of the rear wall of one alcove to the top of the opposite one; the distance was twenty-five cubits from one parapet opening to the opposite one.

ekegusii: Naende akagenda ase oboagacho bware geita ki’eraaro ya isiko kiarochie sugusu, na akarenga obotambe na obogare bwaye.
english: Then he measured the length and width of the gate facing north, leading into the outer court.

ekegusii: Akarenga obotambe bw’enyomba yaagachire magega amo nebisona biaye biarochie ase chinsemo ibere, bokaba nekerengo ki’amaboko rigana erimo. Boigo akarenga Aase Aachenu Mono, ne chinyomba chinde chiare ime y’eraaro.
english: Then he measured the length of the building facing the courtyard at the rear of the temple, including its galleries on each side; it was a hundred cubits. The outer sanctuary, the inner sanctuary and the portico facing the court,

ekegusii: Boigo akarenga ensemo y’egesona ime, nero ekaba ey’ekerengo ki’emoti eyemo.
english: Then he measured the portico of the gateway;

ekegusii: Naboigo omonto oria akarenga Hekalu eria; obotambe bwaye bokaba obw’amaboko rigana erimo, na obotambe bw’egoora na oboagacho bwarenge ao amo ne chindwaki chiaye bokaba amaboko rigana erimo.
english: Then he measured the temple; it was a hundred cubits long, and the temple courtyard and the building with its walls were also a hundred cubits long.

ekegusii: Naende akarenga enyasi ye Hekalu; obonetu bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko atano na rimo, na obogare bw’ebinyomba biaetanaine Hekalu nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko ane.
english: Then he measured the wall of the temple; it was six cubits thick, and each side room around the temple was four cubits wide.

ekegusii: Naende akarenga obogare bw’egeita kia ime, naborobwo bokaba obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko ikomi, na obotambe bw’egesoero bokaba obw’amaboko ikomi na atato.
english: Then he measured the width of the entrance to the gateway; it was ten cubits and its length was thirteen cubits.

ekegusii: Erio akaigora chinkoro chiabo, banyare komanya amariko.
english: Then he opened their minds so they could understand the Scriptures.

ekegusii: Erio akabeka ebite biria ase chintuba chi’amache ase amaicho are gocha konywera. Na ekiagera ching’iti chiria chiare koa chinkungu amarieme, ekero chigocha konywa amache,
english: Then he placed the peeled branches in all the watering troughs, so that they would be directly in front of the flocks when they came to drink. When the flocks were in heat and came to drink,

ekegusii: Akamobekera ekegogwa ase omotwe oye, na bosio ase ekegogwa ekio agasiberania ekemanyererio egechenu gi’etahabu kiarenge kworokia ng’a bwatananirwe. Ase igo Musa agakora buna Omonene amochigete.
english: Then he placed the turban on Aaron's head and set the gold plate, the sacred diadem, on the front of it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Ere agasaba, agateba, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’omonene one Ibrahimu, nagosabire, onsesenie ase amang’ana aane a rero, okorere omonene one Ibrahimu obuya.
english: Then he prayed, "O LORD, God of my master Abraham, give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

ekegusii: Erio ageatanana korwa ase Yakobo oboare bw’orogendo rw’amatuko atato; na Yakobo agatigerwa okorisia riicho ria Labani eriatigarete.
english: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob continued to tend the rest of Laban's flocks.

ekegusii: Akabeka amaboko aye igoro asare, na ere akaramboka erio kegima, akamotogia Nyasae.
english: Then he put his hands on her, and immediately she straightened up and praised God.

ekegusii: Then he put out Zedekiah's eyes and bound him with bronze shackles to take him to Babylon.
english: Nyuma y’ayio agakonora Zedekia amaiso, erio akamosiba ne chingataare, akamoira Babeli.

ekegusii: Naende agakonora amaiso a Zedekia, akamosiba nebinyuri, akamoira Babeli, akamobeka ase echela, akamotiga aroro goika rituko ri’ogokwa kwaye.
english: Then he put out Zedekiah's eyes, bound him with bronze shackles and took him to Babylon, where he put him in prison till the day of his death.

ekegusii: Then he put up the curtain at the entrance to the tabernacle.
english: Agasunga egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Obomenyo.

ekegusii: Erio Ibrahimu akaminyoka getii ase riicho riaye, akarenta emori engiya enoru, enterere, akayea omosomba oye, akamotebia, “Yeroisie bwango, oyerente.”
english: Then he ran to the herd and selected a choice, tender calf and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.

ekegusii: Then he reached out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.
english: Erio Ibrahimu akarambora okoboko kwaye, akabogoria omoyio anyenye omwana oye.

ekegusii: Erio nakwane nabarabwo ase endamwamu yaye, abagose ase ekeririanda kiaye, ogoteba,
english: Then he rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,

ekegusii: Omonene akaanga abanto b’ororeria rwa Yusufu, gose tachorete abanto b’egesaku gi’Efraimu,
english: Then he rejected the tents of Joseph, he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;

ekegusii: Erio akabasiborera Baraba, na nyuma gaakire Yeso emecharichi, akabamotigera anyare kobambwa.
english: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akainyora chindoto chiria arenge kobarotera, akabatebia, “Inwe nechirooti more, nigo mwachire koroota ense eye, na korora ase ere bosa etari na getango.”
english: Then he remembered his dreams about them and said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see where our land is unprotected."

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi ise, na Rehoboamu, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga ria ise.
english: Then he rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi ise, na Rehoboamu, omwana oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Then he rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of David his father. And Rehoboam his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Akaroisia naende egesasimero ki’Omonene gekaba ekeyia, erio akaruera aroro ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, na ebi’ogoaka ng’a mbuya mono; agachika Abayuda bakorere Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Then he restored the altar of the LORD and sacrificed fellowship offerings and thank offerings on it, and told Judah to serve the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. "Could you men not keep watch with me for one hour?" he asked Peter.
english: Agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabanyora bararire, agatebia Petero, “Inee! Iga timokonyara korenda amo nainche nonya nensa eyemo?

ekegusii: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. "Simon," he said to Peter, "are you asleep? Could you not keep watch for one hour?
english: Agacha, akabanyora bararire, agatebia Petero, “Simion, nkwararire? Tokonyara korenda nonya nensa eyemo?

ekegusii: Erio agachiera aborokigwa baria, akabatebia, “Nonya mbono moraire na gotimoka? Rora ensa yaikire, na Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto obekirwe ase amaboko ’abanyene ebibe.
english: Then he returned to the disciples and said to them, "Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour is near, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

ekegusii: Akamumekeria ebuku eria akayea omokori emeremo bw’esinagogi, agaikaransa. Abanto bonsi abarenge ase esinagogi bakamobeta amaiso.
english: Then he rolled up the scroll, gave it back to the attendant and sat down. The eyes of everyone in the synagogue were fastened on him,

ekegusii: Then he said to her, "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace."
english: Akamotebia, “Omoiseke one, okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie; genda nomorembe.”

ekegusii: Then he said to him, "Rise and go; your faith has made you well."
english: Akamotebia, “Tenena, ogende; okwegena kwao gwakogwenirie.”

ekegusii: Erio nyuma ase aya agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Togende Boyahudi naende.”
english: Then he said to his disciples, "Let us go back to Judea."

ekegusii: Erio agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Rigesa nerinene, korende abakori emeremo nabake;
english: Then he said to his disciples, "The harvest is plentiful but the workers are few.

ekegusii: Agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Amatuko nache morarigie korora rituko erimo ri’amatuko ’Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto, korende timokorirora.
english: Then he said to his disciples, "The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abisalomu agatebia abasomba baye, “Rora omogondo o Yoabu nigo osinyaine noyone, noro bwamire esairi, genda motongie omorero esairi eria eyie.” Bakagenda, bakayetongia omorero ekayia.
english: Then he said to his servants, "Look, Joab's field is next to mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire." So Absalom's servants set the field on fire.

ekegusii: agatebia Yeroboamu, “Eimokerie aye omonyene ebing’ese ebi ikomi, ekiagera aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atebire: Rora inche igo inde ang’e gotandorana oboruoti mborusie korwa ase okoboko gwa Sulemani, nkoe ebisaku ikomi.
english: Then he said to Jeroboam, "Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'See, I am going to tear the kingdom out of Solomon's hand and give you ten tribes.

ekegusii: Erio agakwana na Kora na abanto bonsi b’ekeombe kiaye, akabatebia, “Ankio mambia Omonene nache aorokie ng’a ning’o ore oyoye, naende ning’o ore omochenu na ning’o arae ribaga amoike ang’e. Nache arente omonto oyo achorire aike ang’e nere.
english: Then he said to Korah and all his followers: "In the morning the LORD will show who belongs to him and who is holy, and he will have that person come near him. The man he chooses he will cause to come near him.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, bana orangerie omoika, bana oyotebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye omoika, inchuo korwa ase chimbeo inye chi’ense, erio outere aba iga baitetwe omoika bw’obomoyo, erinde babe moyo naende.”
english: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, son of man, and say to it, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe into these slain, that they may live.'"

ekegusii: Naende agantebia, “Banera amauga aya, oyatebie: Inwe amauga amomo, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene!
english: Then he said to me, "Prophesy to these bones and say to them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!

ekegusii: Naende agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, karie ebuku eye ngokoa eichore ase enda yao.” Erio nkayeria, egansa ase omonwa one buna obooke.
english: Then he said to me, "Son of man, eat this scroll I am giving you and fill your stomach with it." So I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey in my mouth.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, imokia amaiso ao igoro, origererie gochia sugusu.” Ase ayio nkarigereria gochia sugusu, nkarora omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa, oria obogetie risemi ria Nyasae oteneine ensemo ya sugusu y’egesoero ki’egeita kegochia ase egesasimero.
english: Then he said to me, "Son of man, look toward the north." So I looked, and in the entrance north of the gate of the altar I saw this idol of jealousy.

ekegusii: Naende omonto oria agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Eye nero emeroberio echikire erakorwe ase egesasimero ase rituko erio kerabe kiaagachirwe, erinde ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa biruerwe aroro, na amanyinga nabe akonyororokerigwa igoro yaye.
english: Then he said to me, "Son of man, this is what the Sovereign LORD says: These will be the regulations for sacrificing burnt offerings and sprinkling blood upon the altar when it is built:

ekegusii: Omonto oria agantebia, “Ebinyomba ebio bire ensemo ya sugusu, na ebia irianyi, kororia aase atigire ataagachiri, ebio nebichenu. Abakuani abwo bagotenena ase obosio bw’Omonene nao barabe bakoriera ebing’wanso bire ebichenu mono; agwo nao barabeke ebing’wanso bire ebichenu mono: okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, na ebi’okomocha, ekiagera aase agwo naachenu.
english: Then he said to me, "The north and south rooms facing the temple courtyard are the priests' rooms, where the priests who approach the LORD will eat the most holy offerings. There they will put the most holy offerings-- the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings-- for the place is holy.

ekegusii: Agwo Omonene agantebia, “Aye mwanyabanto, amauga aya naro egesaku gionsi ki’Abaisraeli. Rora, barabwo nigo bagoteba: Amauga aito omire pa, na ogosemeria gwaito gwasirire; intwe bono twasirigwe kegima.
english: Then he said to me: "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. They say, 'Our bones are dried up and our hope is gone; we are cut off.'

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Tiira gocha aa asende, aye amo na Haroni, na Nadabu, na Abihu, na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli emerongo etano na ebere. Mobeere aare ake, motung’ame inse monsasime.
english: Then he said to Moses, "Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel. You are to worship at a distance,

ekegusii: Erio agatebia Abakeni, “Eongore, morue ase Abaameleki timbaisa kobasiria amo nabarabwo. Inwe nigo mwabete abaya ase Abaisraeli, ekero baare korua Misiri.” Ase ayio Abakeni bakeongora, bakarua ase Abaameleki.
english: Then he said to the Kenites, "Go away, leave the Amalekites so that I do not destroy you along with them; for you showed kindness to all the Israelites when they came up out of Egypt." So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites.

ekegusii: Erio Boazi agatebia omonyamwando oria, “Naomi, oria oirana korwa ense y’Abamoabu, nkoonia are oboremo boria bwarenge omwando bw’Elimeleki ominto.
english: Then he said to the kinsman-redeemer, "Naomi, who has come back from Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our brother Elimelech.

ekegusii: Then he said to the man, "Stretch out your hand." So he stretched it out and it was completely restored, just as sound as the other.
english: Erio agatebia omonto oria, “Rambora okoboko kwao.” Agakorambora; gokagwena, gokaba okogima buna okonde.

ekegusii: Musa akabatebia, “Mwebeke ang’e goika rituko ria gatato: timobaisa goika abakungu baino ang’e.”
english: Then he said to the people, "Prepare yourselves for the third day. Abstain from sexual relations."

ekegusii: Yeso akayotebia, “Korwa bono monto taria amatunda ao nonya ndinde.” Aborokigwa baye bakaigwa aya.
english: Then he said to the tree, "May no one ever eat fruit from you again." And his disciples heard him say it.

ekegusii: Agatebia bonsi, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye kera rituko antunyane.
english: Then he said to them all: "If anyone would come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow me.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akabatebia, “Mokore enyomba yane ebe eyetachenegeti; moichorie chiraaro chiaye nebitondo bi’abanto. Nyuma y’ayio mosoe ase omochie” Ase ayio bagasoa ase omochie, bagaita abanto.
english: Then he said to them, "Defile the temple and fill the courts with the slain. Go!" So they went out and began killing throughout the city.

ekegusii: Then he said to them, "My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me."
english: Erio akabatebia, “Omoyo one nore nobororo obonge, nonya ngoika ogokwa; ikaransa aa, morende amo nainche.”

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Ning’o asemore ore nomosani oramochiere botuko gati amotebie: Mosani, ing’a singo emegati etato,
english: Then he said to them, "Suppose one of you has a friend, and he goes to him at midnight and says, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Esabato nigo yakoretwe ase engencho ya mwanyabanto, tari mwanyabanto ase engencho y’Esabato;
english: Then he said to them, "The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

ekegusii: Ere akabatebia, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, otebire iga: Kera oyomo oino abogorie omoyio oye o birende, agende aaria na aaria ase egetwori korwa geita ekemo goika ekende. Kera oyomo aite onde bwensi aranyore, nonya noyomwabo, gose omosani, gose omogisangio.”
english: Then he said to them, "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'Each man strap a sword to his side. Go back and forth through the camp from one end to the other, each killing his brother and friend and neighbor.'"

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Rigereria, erende korwa ase okogania okobe, ekiagera obogima bw’omonto tibori ase obonge bw’enibo yaye abwate.”
english: Then he said to them, "Watch out! Be on your guard against all kinds of greed; a man's life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions."

ekegusii: akabatebia, “Onde bwensi oramwanche omwana oyo ase erieta riane, onyanchire inche; na oyoranyanche inche, omwanchire ere oyontomete. Ekiagera ere oyore omoke ase egati yaino, oyio nere omonene.”
english: Then he said to them, "Whoever welcomes this little child in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me. For he who is least among you all-- he is the greatest."

ekegusii: Erio akabatebia, “Egesaku nakeimoke korwana negesaku kende, na oboruoti naborwane noboruoti bonde;
english: Then he said to them: "Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

ekegusii: Erio agatebia Tomas, “Renta aiga ekiara kiao. Orore amaboko aane. Renta okoboko kwao, okobeke ase rikere riane; toba oyotegeneti, korende oyo bwegenete.”
english: Then he said to Thomas, "Put your finger here; see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it into my side. Stop doubting and believe."

ekegusii: Naende Saulo akabatebia, “Genda mwesiarerere gochia ase abanto, mobatebie ng’a kera omonto obwate eng’ombe gose eng’ondi ayerente ayenyenyere aiga, ariere chinyama echio aiga, tabaisa gokora ebibe ase Omonene ase okoria chinyama chire namanyinga ime yaye.” Ase ayio ase obotuko obwo kera omonto akarenta eng’ombe yaye agwo akayenyenyerao.
english: Then he said, "Go out among the men and tell them, 'Each of you bring me your cattle and sheep, and slaughter them here and eat them. Do not sin against the LORD by eating meat with blood still in it.'" So everyone brought his ox that night and slaughtered it there.

ekegusii: Then he said, "Here I am, I have come to do your will." He sets aside the first to establish the second.
english: Erio akabora, “Rora, nachire gokora ogwancha kwao.” Igo akarusia ebie ritang’ani, erinde abeke egia kabere.

ekegusii: Naende akamotebia, “Inche ninche Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiao, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na o Isaka, na o Yakobo.” Erio Musa agatuba obosio bwaye, ekiagera nigo airogete korigereria Nyasae.
english: Then he said, "I am the God of your father, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob." At this, Moses hid his face, because he was afraid to look at God.

ekegusii: Erio agatebia Yeso, “Yeso, ong’inyore ekero ogocha ase oboruoti bwao!”
english: Then he said, "Jesus, remember me when you come into your kingdom."

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akamoboria naende, “Omonene, tobaisa kombea, bono ndimo rioka ngokoboria, barachia konyorekana rende ikomi boka?” Akairaneria, “Tingosaria omochie, inse konyora agwo ikomi boka.”
english: Then he said, "May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak just once more. What if only ten can be found there?" He answered, "For the sake of ten, I will not destroy it."

ekegusii: Ibrahimu akabora, “Omonene, koranche, tobaisa kombea ningendererete gokwana naye. Aande barabaisa konyorekana rende emerongo etato?” Omonene akairaneria, “Tingosaria omochie inse konyora bare emerongo etato aroro.”
english: Then he said, "May the Lord not be angry, but let me speak. What if only thirty can be found there?" He answered, "I will not do it if I find thirty there."

ekegusii: Naende Isaka akamotebia, “Yendetere aiga ang’e, omwana one, indie enyama y’obotwari bwao, erio ngosesenie.” Ase igo akamoyeirera na ere akaria, akamoa na edivai, akanywa.
english: Then he said, "My son, bring me some of your game to eat, so that I may give you my blessing." Jacob brought it to him and he ate; and he brought some wine and he drank.

ekegusii: Erio Elisha agatebia omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, “Imokia emegwe!” Nere akayeimokia. Naende akamotebia, “Rasa inse ase riroba!” Nere akarasa inse ase riroba ara gatato, agatiga.
english: Then he said, "Take the arrows," and the king took them. Elisha told him, "Strike the ground." He struck it three times and stopped.

ekegusii: agateba, “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli atogigwe, ere oyo oikeranirie nokoboko kwaye aya arierete Daudi tata eira nomonwa oye, agateba:
english: Then he said: "Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who with his hands has fulfilled what he promised with his mouth to my father David. For he said,

ekegusii: agateba, “Atogigwe Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ere oyoikeranirie nokoboko kwaye aya arierete Daudi tata eira nomonwa oye, ogoteba:
english: Then he said: "Praise be to the LORD, the God of Israel, who with his own hand has fulfilled what he promised with his own mouth to my father David. For he said,

ekegusii: Naende akarigereria Abakeni, agakwana obobani obo: “Obomenyo bwabo nabogenderere kobao, buna egeswa keagachire ase engako y’egetare.
english: Then he saw the Kenites and uttered his oracle: "Your dwelling place is secure, your nest is set in a rock;

ekegusii: Agatoma naende asebare omosomba onde, na oyio bakamoaka chingoma ase omotwe, bakamosokia bakamokora bobe.
english: Then he sent another servant to them; they struck this man on the head and treated him shamefully.

ekegusii: Erio agatigana nabamwabo bagende sobo, akabatebia, “Timobaisa kwomana inchera!”
english: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they were leaving he said to them, "Don't quarrel on the way!"

ekegusii: Ase igo omoruoti agatoma gochia aroro chibarasi, ne chigari, na omoganda omonene bw’abarwani esegi, na barabwo bagaika aroro botuko, bakanaaria omochie.
english: Then he sent horses and chariots and a strong force there. They went by night and surrounded the city.

ekegusii: Naende agatoma abasomba bande, abange kobua baria be ritang’ani; bakabakora boigo.
english: Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.

ekegusii: Erio agatoma riruma arore gose amache akamokire korwa ase ense,
english: Then he sent out a dove to see if the water had receded from the surface of the ground.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatomera Elija omotang’ani bw’abarwani esegi emerongo etano, amo nabarwani baye emerongo etano. Omotang’ani oria akanyora Elija oikaransete ase egechuria ki’egetunwa, akamotebia, “Aye omonto o Nyasae, omoruoti otebire ng’a otirimboke ogende asare.”
english: Then he sent to Elijah a captain with his company of fifty men. The captain went up to Elijah, who was sitting on the top of a hill, and said to him, "Man of God, the king says, 'Come down!'"

ekegusii: Yehu agatoma amang’ana ase Abaisraeli bonsi, na abakoreri ba Baali bonsi bagacha, goika nonya nomonto oyomo tatigara otachete. Bagasoa enyomba ya Baali, na enyomba eria egaichora nabanto churi.
english: Then he sent word throughout Israel, and all the ministers of Baal came; not one stayed away. They crowded into the temple of Baal until it was full from one end to the other.

ekegusii: Agatoma abamura b’Abaisraeli barue ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, banyenyere Omonene chieri chi’ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.
english: Then he sent young Israelite men, and they offered burnt offerings and sacrificed young bulls as fellowship offerings to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio agaterekera abanto, na barabwo bakaria, naende bagatigaria eyende, buna Omonene atebete.
english: Then he set it before them, and they ate and had some left over, according to the word of the LORD.

ekegusii: Then he shall sacrifice the doves or the young pigeons, which the person can afford,
english: Erio omonto oria arue riruma gose riige rie riruma, koreng’ana buna aranyare koyanyora.

ekegusii: aumore amache amachenu ase egetaabo ki’amaroba, naende aimokie amaroba korwa inse agwo ase Obomenyo Obochenu, ayabeke ime ase amache aria.
english: Then he shall take some holy water in a clay jar and put some dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.

ekegusii: Erio aire eeri eyio isiko y’egetwori, ayesambere aroro, buna asambete eeri eria ye ritang’ani. Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoganda bwonsi.
english: Then he shall take the bull outside the camp and burn it as he burned the first bull. This is the sin offering for the community.

ekegusii: Erio Yonathani akarangeria omomura oria, akamotebia, “Minyoka bwango, tobaisa gotebana.” Na omwana oria agasangereria emegwe eria, erio akairana gocha ase omonene oye.
english: Then he shouted, "Hurry! Go quickly! Don't stop!" The boy picked up the arrow and returned to his master.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akanyorokia Yoshua, omokuani omonene, oteneine ase obosio bw’omomalaika bw’Omonene, na Saitani oteneine ase ensemo ya borio ya Yoshua okomosoera.
english: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right side to accuse him.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio akanyenya eng’iti y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na abamura baye bakamorentera amanyinga ’ekeng’wanso ekio, nere akayasiarera ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: Then he slaughtered the burnt offering. His sons handed him the blood, and he sprinkled it against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Akaara eema igoro y’Obomenyo boria, na kobeka egietubo kiaye buna Omonene konya amochikire.
english: Then he spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the covering over the tent, as the LORD commanded him.

ekegusii: Erio akaramamera omwana oria ara gatato, naende akarera ase Omonene,” “Aye Omonene Nyasae one, tiga obomoyo bw’omwana oyo bomoiranere naende.”
english: Then he stretched himself out on the boy three times and cried to the LORD, "O LORD my God, let this boy's life return to him!"

ekegusii: Omonene agaita abana abatangi bonsi ase ense eria, ne ching’iti chintangi, ogotongora gwe chinguru chiabo chionsi.
english: Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their manhood.

ekegusii: Erio akaboania Benjamin rigoti, akarera; Benjamin nere akarera kamoboanetie rigoti riaye.
english: Then he threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin embraced him, weeping.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Ase engencho ye ring’ana eri, genda bwoo, ekerecha kiarure ase enyaroka yao.”
english: Then he told her, "For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter."

ekegusii: Naende agantebia, “Tobisa amang’ana ’obobani bw’ebuku eye gose koyabeka ekemanyererio, ekiagera engaki ng’ang’e ere
english: Then he told me, "Do not seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, because the time is near.

ekegusii: Akabatebia amang’ana amange ase emereng’anio, okobora, “Omobusuri akamanora kogenda kobusura.
english: Then he told them many things in parables, saying: "A farmer went out to sow his seed.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, Bono taa, “moirere omonene bw’omoyega.” Bakamoirera.
english: Then he told them, "Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet." They did so,

ekegusii: Agakwana omoreng’anio oyo, “Omonto oyomo narenge nomoko osimekire ase omogondo oye bw’emesabibu; akagenda korigia amatunda ase omoko oria, korende tanyora gento.
english: Then he told this parable: "A man had a fig tree, planted in his vineyard, and he went to look for fruit on it, but did not find any.

ekegusii: Ere akaimokia omoiborwa bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere, na akamotebia arie eira y’ogwetiania, (Abanto b’ense eria baare nokobua akabaira
english: Then he took a member of the royal family and made a treaty with him, putting him under oath. He also carried away the leading men of the land,

ekegusii: Erio akaira igoro ase orwaki omwana omomura oye omotangi, oria orenge gocha kogamba ase ribaga riaye, akamorua akaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa. Agwo Abaisraeli bakagechigwa bagatiga korwana, bakairana gochia ase ense yabo.
english: Then he took his firstborn son, who was to succeed him as king, and offered him as a sacrifice on the city wall. The fury against Israel was great; they withdrew and returned to their own land.

ekegusii: Erio akaimokia enyimbo yaye ase okoboko kwaye, agachora amagena atano amaterere korwa ase akarooche, akayabeka ase esaro yaye y’oborisia, na enduruche akabogoria koboko kwaye. Na bono agasuka gochia ang’e n’Omofilisti oria.
english: Then he took his staff in his hand, chose five smooth stones from the stream, put them in the pouch of his shepherd's bag and, with his sling in his hand, approached the Philistine.

ekegusii: Akayoikia, akayoboyia egetambaa ki’egatani, akayobeka ase oboina bwabaachetwe ase egetare, aase monto onde atana kobekwa.
english: Then he took it down, wrapped it in linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut in the rock, one in which no one had yet been laid.

ekegusii: Erio akaimokia ebuku y’okobwatana kw’ogotianania agasomera abanto baigwe. Barabwo bakabora, “Natoyakore onsi aya Omonene akwanire, na tomoigwere.”
english: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read it to the people. They responded, "We will do everything the LORD has said; we will obey."

ekegusii: Agwo agaaka amache negetambaa keria gi’okwambara kiarwete ase Elija, akabora, “Ng’ai Omonene, Nyasae bw’Elija, are?” Na ekero aakire amache, amache agaatananekana gochia ensemo na ensemo. Elisha agaeta aase aakamoku, akaamboka ng’umbu.
english: Then he took the cloak that had fallen from him and struck the water with it. "Where now is the LORD, the God of Elijah?" he asked. When he struck the water, it divided to the right and to the left, and he crossed over.

ekegusii: Then he took the cup, gave thanks and offered it to them, and they all drank from it.
english: Akabogoria egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa. Bagakenywera bonsi.

ekegusii: Then he took the cup, gave thanks and offered it to them, saying, "Drink from it, all of you.
english: Akabogoria na egekombe, na ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabaa, akabora, “Kanywe aya inwe mwensi,

ekegusii: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, and when he had given thanks, he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and they in turn to the people.
english: Akabogoria emegati eria etano na ebere, ne chinswe chiria. Ekero airaneirie ng’a mbuya mono, akabisamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, na barabwo bakayea emeganda eria.

ekegusii: Erio agwo agakuna amaiso abo, akabatebia, “Koreng’ana nokwegena kwaino abe asemore.”
english: Then he touched their eyes and said, "According to your faith will it be done to you";

ekegusii: Akeonchorera aborokigwa baye, akabatebia bobisi, “Nasesenirie amaiso aya arorire aya mwarorire inwe!
english: Then he turned to his disciples and said privately, "Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.

ekegusii: Naende akaonchoka gochia ensemo ya bosongo, akayerenga ekaba chimoti amagana atano.
english: Then he turned to the west side and measured; it was five hundred cubits by the measuring rod.

ekegusii: Akeonchorera omokungu oria, agatebia Simion, “Kwarorire omokungu oyo? Inasoa mwao, tikwang’a amache ay’ogwesibia amagoro, korende oyo osibirie amagoro aane namariga aye, na koyatinyia netukia y’omotwe oye.
english: Then he turned toward the woman and said to Simon, "Do you see this woman? I came into your house. You did not give me any water for my feet, but she wet my feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.

ekegusii: Baalamu akagenderera gokwana obobani bwaye: “Obee! Ning’o oranyare koba moyo ekero Nyasae arakore aya?
english: Then he uttered his oracle: "Ah, who can live when God does this?

ekegusii: Baalamu agachaka gokwana obobani bwaye, agateba, “Inchuo aye Balaki, omwana o Sipori, ontegerere oigwe aya ngokwana!
english: Then he uttered his oracle: "Arise, Balak, and listen; hear me, son of Zippor.

ekegusii: Then he uttered his oracle: "The oracle of Balaam son of Beor, the oracle of one whose eye sees clearly,
english: Erio Baalamu agakwana obobani obo: “Amang’ana aya inche Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, ngokwana, amang’ana aya nayane, inche omonto oramokigwe amaiso.

ekegusii: Then he warned his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Christ.
english: Erio agachika aborokigwa baye bokong’u tibatebia onde ng’a nere Kristo.

ekegusii: Then he went down and talked with the woman, and he liked her.
english: Samison akagenda agakwana nomoiseke oria, nere akamogokia mono.

ekegusii: Agatirimboka goika Kapernaumu, omochie o Galili. Akaba nkoborokereria are rituko ri’Esabato.
english: Then he went down to Capernaum, a town in Galilee, and on the Sabbath began to teach the people.

ekegusii: Agatirimboka amo nabarabwo, agaika Nazareti, akaba nkobaigwera are. Ng’ina akagacha amang’ana aya onsi ase enkoro yaye ime.
english: Then he went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But his mother treasured all these things in her heart.

ekegusii: Agasoa nyomba, agatenena ase obosio bw’omonene oye Elisha, nere akamoboria, “Gehasi, ng’ai gese kwarenge?” Ere akairaneria, “Inche omosomba oo tinagendete aande.”
english: Then he went in and stood before his master Elisha. "Where have you been, Gehazi?" Elisha asked. "Your servant didn't go anywhere," Gehazi answered.

ekegusii: Naende akagenda ase akanyomba kaime. Erio akarenga emetobwa y’egesieri, na obogare bwabo bokaba obw’amaboko abere. Akarenga na egesieri, gekaba ekerengo ki’amaboko atano na rimo, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano na abere.
english: Then he went into the inner sanctuary and measured the jambs of the entrance; each was two cubits wide. The entrance was six cubits wide, and the projecting walls on each side of it were seven cubits wide.

ekegusii: Ere akagenda, akanyora omobere otugutire ase enchera, na etigere na endo chiteneine mbarabare ase omobere oria. Endo tiyariete omobere oria, gose tiyaitete etigere eria, gose koyetandora.
english: Then he went out and found the body thrown down on the road, with the donkey and the lion standing beside it. The lion had neither eaten the body nor mauled the donkey.

ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoka gesieri, omoiseke onde akamorora, agatebia abarengeo, “Omonto oyo nigo arenge amo na Yeso, Omonazareti.”
english: Then he went out to the gateway, where another girl saw him and said to the people there, "This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth."

ekegusii: Erio akagenda ase ensoko y’amache, agaitera omonyo oria aroro, agateba, “Aya naro Omonene atebire: Nagwenirie amache aya; korwa bono na kogenderera amakweri gose okwama amarandi amaroro tibikorwa ase amache aya.”
english: Then he went out to the spring and threw the salt into it, saying, "This is what the LORD says: 'I have healed this water. Never again will it cause death or make the land unproductive.'"

ekegusii: Naende akagenda ase egeita kiarochie moocha, akariinera ekeriinero kiaye. Erio akarenga obogare bw’egesona inse agwo ase oboagacho bw’egeita, bokaba emoti eyemo.
english: Then he went to the gate facing east. He climbed its steps and measured the threshold of the gate; it was one rod deep.

ekegusii: Then he went up and touched the coffin, and those carrying it stood still. He said, "Young man, I say to you, get up!"
english: Akagenda ang’e, agakuna ekige; ababogoria ekige bagatenena. Erio agakwana, “Omomura, nagotebirie, imoka!”

ekegusii: Paulo akariina igoro naende, agasamunyora omogati akaria, agakwana nabarabwo goika bogakia mambia. Erio akaimoka, akagenda.
english: Then he went upstairs again and broke bread and ate. After talking until daylight, he left.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio naonchokere korwania ebisinka ne chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, nabue ebisinka ebinge ne chinse boigo. Korende omochiki oyomo bw’abarwani esegi namobue asirie ogochaya kwaye, ee, namoiranerie ogochaya okwo.
english: Then he will turn his attention to the coastlands and will take many of them, but a commander will put an end to his insolence and will turn his insolence back upon him.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agachaka gokora emeremo nomokia omonene, akaroisia orwaki ase konya rwatagokire, na akaagacha emerobiri igoro yaye. Boigo akaagacha orwaki ronde isiko y’orwo, na agakong’ia Milo, egekengero keria kiarenge ase Omochie o Daudi. Naende akaroisia ebirwanero ebinge, akagoncha ne chinguba chinyinge.
english: Then he worked hard repairing all the broken sections of the wall and building towers on it. He built another wall outside that one and reinforced the supporting terraces of the City of David. He also made large numbers of weapons and shields.

ekegusii: aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro, okore ogokora kwao, onachere abasomba bao ekina kia boronge. Tiga oria ore omomochi abogorie egesusuro gi’okomocha kwaye, na oria ore omoronge aegwe oboronge bwaye.
english: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, condemning the guilty and bringing down on his own head what he has done. Declare the innocent not guilty, and so establish his innocence.

ekegusii: aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro, okore buna oranche gokora, onachere abasomba bao ekina. Tiga oria ore omomochi abogorie egesusuro gi’okomocha kwaye, na oria ore omoronge aegwe oboronge bwaye.
english: then hear from heaven and act. Judge between your servants, repaying the guilty by bringing down on his own head what he has done. Declare the innocent not guilty and so establish his innocence.

ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abanto bao Abaisraeli, naende obarente gocha ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiabo.
english: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to their fathers.

ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abanto bao Abaisraeli, naende obarente gocha ase ense eye kwaete chisokoro chiabo.
english: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your people Israel and bring them back to the land you gave to them and their fathers.

ekegusii: rirorio aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abasomba bao Abaisraeli, okoborokereria enchera engiya bagwenerete kobwatia. Naende otwerie ense yao embura, ense eria kwaeire abanto bao ekaba omwando obo.
english: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.

ekegusii: rirorio aye oigwe korwa agwo igoro. Bwabere ebibe bi’abasomba bao Abaisraeli, oborokererie enchera engiya bagwenerete kobwatia. Naende orente embura igoro ase ense yao, eye kwaeire abanto bao yabeire omwando obo.
english: then hear from heaven and forgive the sin of your servants, your people Israel. Teach them the right way to live, and send rain on the land you gave your people for an inheritance.

ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ogosaba kwabo, na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, na obae oboronge bwabo.
english: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

ekegusii: rirorio oigwe korwa agwo igoro ogosaba kwabo na okoboria kwabo kw’oboitongo, na obae oboronge bwabo.
english: then hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and uphold their cause.

ekegusii: oigwe korwa igoro agwo aase obomenyo bwao bore. Okorere omogeni oria amang’ana onsi akoboria, erinde abanto bonsi b’ense bamanye erieta riao, naende bakoiroke buna abanto bao Abaisraeli bakomanyete na bakoirogete, naende bamanye ng’a enyomba eye naagachire nigo ekorokwa ase erieta riao.
english: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.

ekegusii: oigwe korwa igoro agwo aase obomenyo bwao bore. Okorere omogeni oria amang’ana onsi arakoborie, erinde abanto bonsi b’ense barimanye erieta riao, naende bakoiroke, buna abanto bao Abaisraeli bakomanyete na gokoiroka, naende bamanye ng’a enyomba eye naagachire nigo ekorokwa ase erieta riao.
english: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place, and do whatever the foreigner asks of you, so that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and fear you, as do your own people Israel, and may know that this house I have built bears your Name.

ekegusii: obaigwe korwa agwo igoro ase obomenyo bwao bore. Bwabere, okore ogokora kwao, okorere kera oyomo koreng’ana nogokora kwaye, (ekiagera naye bweka omanyete chinkoro chia mwanyabanto bonsi,)
english: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive and act; deal with each man according to all he does, since you know his heart (for you alone know the hearts of all men),

ekegusii: rirorio obaigwe korwa agwo aase obomenyo bwao bore. Bwabere, okore ogokora kwao, okorere kera oyomo koreng’ana nogokora kwaye gwonsi, ekiagera naye bweka omanyete chinkoro chia mwanyabanto.
english: then hear from heaven, your dwelling place. Forgive, and deal with each man according to all he does, since you know his heart (for you alone know the hearts of men),

ekegusii: rirorio inwe abatigari b’Abayuda, igwa ring’ana Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Onye mwanachire ekina ng’a mogende Misiri komenya aroro,
english: then hear the word of the LORD, O remnant of Judah. This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'If you are determined to go to Egypt and you do go to settle there,

ekegusii: Erio igoro na ense, na ebinto bionsi bireo, mbitere nomochengo, ekero abasaria bararue sugusu gocha gosaria Babeli. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout for joy over Babylon, for out of the north destroyers will attack her," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ayio onsi, omosacha oria bwe ritang’ani omoseretie, tabaisa komoirania gocha bwoye abe mokaye naende, ekiagera omokungu oria obeire oyotachenegeti; okwo nigo kore okogechia ase obosio bw’Omonene, nainwe timobaisa korenta okomocha kobe ase ense eyio Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa ebe omwando oino.
english: then her first husband, who divorced her, is not allowed to marry her again after she has been defiled. That would be detestable in the eyes of the LORD. Do not bring sin upon the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.

ekegusii: Herode na abarwani baye bakamochaya, bakamosekereria, bakamobekera chianga chingiya mono, akamoirania ase Pilato.
english: Then Herod and his soldiers ridiculed and mocked him. Dressing him in an elegant robe, they sent him back to Pilate.

ekegusii: Erio Herode akarangeria abanto baria abang’aini bobisi, akarigia asebare ekeene nkero ki eng’enang’eni eria yarorekanete.
english: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and found out from them the exact time the star had appeared.

ekegusii: Hezekia agekeyia, ageitia ase engencho y’oboenenu bw’enkoro yaye, na abanto ba Yerusalemu nabarabwo bagekeyia. Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene tiyacha igoro asebare ase amatuko a Hezekia.
english: Then Hezekiah repented of the pride of his heart, as did the people of Jerusalem; therefore the LORD's wrath did not come upon them during the days of Hezekiah.

ekegusii: Erio Hezekia agatebia abanto “Bono mwatananirwe ase Omonene na gochenwa. Inchuo ang’e, renta ebing’wanso bi’okonyenywa, na ebi’omorembe ase enyomba y’Omonene.” Omosangererekano okarenta ebing’wanso biria, na baria barenge ne chinkoro chi’ogwancha, bakarenta ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa.
english: Then Hezekiah said, "You have now dedicated yourselves to the LORD. Come and bring sacrifices and thank offerings to the temple of the LORD." So the assembly brought sacrifices and thank offerings, and all whose hearts were willing brought burnt offerings.

ekegusii: Nyuma yaye oyomwabo agasoka ore neusi embariri koboko kwaye. Nere akarokwa Zera.
english: Then his brother, who had the scarlet thread on his wrist, came out and he was given the name Zerah.

ekegusii: Abamura bamwabo amo nabanto bonsi b’eamate yaye bagatirimboka kwoyia omobere oye. Bakamoira, bakamotindeka ase egati ya Sora na Esitaoli, ase embeera ya Manoa ise. Samison konya ogambeire Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ebere.
english: Then his brothers and his father's whole family went down to get him. They brought him back and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of Manoah his father. He had led Israel twenty years.

ekegusii: Then his disciples said to each other, "Could someone have brought him food?"
english: Aborokigwa baye bakaborania, “Inee! Nomonto omorentera endagera?”

ekegusii: Isaka ise akamotebia, “Omwana one, inchuo aiga ang’e asende, onyunyunte.”
english: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come here, my son, and kiss me."

ekegusii: Omobere oye oiranigwe obe buna oyo bw’obosae bwaye, naende aonchorwe abe buna ekero arenge ne chinguru.
english: then his flesh is renewed like a child's; it is restored as in the days of his youth.

ekegusii: erio omonene oye amorente ase obosio bwa Nyasae, amoikie ase egesieri gose ase emetobwa ya gesieri na amotuue ogoto kwaye nesindake. Erio omonto oria abe omosomba oye ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
english: then his master must take him before the judges. He shall take him to the door or the doorpost and pierce his ear with an awl. Then he will be his servant for life.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bakainyora amatuko aria a kare, bakainyora na Musa, bagateba, “Ng’ai are oria bwambogetie abanto ase enyancha, amo nabarisia be riicho riaye? Ng’ai are oria obegete Omoika oye Omochenu ase egati yabo?
english: Then his people recalled the days of old, the days of Moses and his people-- where is he who brought them through the sea, with the shepherd of his flock? Where is he who set his Holy Spirit among them,

ekegusii: Omoiseke omwabo omwana oria akaboria omoiseke o Farao, “Inee! Norigetie ngende nkorangererie omokungu oyomo bw’Abaibirania ache gokomogonkeria?”
english: Then his sister asked Pharaoh's daughter, "Shall I go and get one of the Hebrew women to nurse the baby for you?"

ekegusii: Ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere bw’okogamba kwa Yotamu, mosinto bwa Usia, Hosea, mosinto bwa Ela, agakora omoroberio bw’ogoita Peka, mosinto o Remalia; akamoita, naende akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Then Hoshea son of Elah conspired against Pekah son of Remaliah. He attacked and assassinated him, and then succeeded him as king in the twentieth year of Jotham son of Uzziah.

ekegusii: Naki yaba iga, intwe toigwete kera oyomo ase omonwa oye aiboretwe noro?
english: Then how is it that each of us hears them in his own native language?

ekegusii: Ekero Husai Omoariki, omosani o Daudi, aigete ase Abisalomu, akamotebia, “Omoruoti, ochie kare! Omoruoti, ochie kare!”
english: Then Hushai the Arkite, David's friend, went to Absalom and said to him, "Long live the king! Long live the king!"

ekegusii: Erio ngakoorokeria ebibe biane, gose tinakobisete okomocha kwane, ngateba, “Nimoorokerie Omonene ogosaria kwane,” erio okanyabera ebibe biane bionsi.
english: Then I acknowledged my sin to you and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the LORD"-- and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

ekegusii: Naende nkerua nenkoro yane komanya obong’aini, na obobarimo, na oboriri, korende nigo nanyorete ng’a ayio onsi akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
english: Then I applied myself to the understanding of wisdom, and also of madness and folly, but I learned that this, too, is a chasing after the wind.

ekegusii: Naende nkaboria omomalaika oria, “Emezeituni eye ebere, oyomo ore ensemo y’okorio na oyonde ensemo y’okobee y’ekebekerero keria gie chitaya, neya ki?”
english: Then I asked the angel, "What are these two olive trees on the right and the left of the lampstand?"

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio nkabuna enyimbo eria ya kabere yarenge korokwa “Obomo,” na igo ngasaria okoigwana kwarenge ase egati y’Abayuda na Abaisraeli.
english: Then I broke my second staff called Union, breaking the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

ekegusii: Erio nkarangeria erieta ri’Omonene, ngasaba, “Aye Omonene, tooria omoyo one.”
english: Then I called on the name of the LORD: "O LORD, save me!"

ekegusii: nainche nkeonchora, ngatirimboka korwa ase egetunwa, nkabeka chibao chiria ime ase Esanduku eria konya naroisirie buna Omonene anchigete; nao chire goika rero iga.
english: Then I came back down the mountain and put the tablets in the ark I had made, as the LORD commanded me, and they are there now.

ekegusii: Ngachika Abalawi bechene, erio bachiche korenda ebiita na korenda rituko ri’Esabato ribe richenu. Aye Nyasae one, ing’inyore boigo ase engencho y’amang’ana aya, na ondorere amabera, ekiagera aye nigo ore nobwanchani botari koera.
