english: Then I commanded the Levites to purify themselves and go and guard the gates in order to keep the Sabbath day holy. Remember me for this also, O my God, and show mercy to me according to your great love.

ekegusii: Erio nkamotebia, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, nagosoroire, tiga tobaisa gokora ayio. Naki abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baranyare koba moyo ekero bare abake iga?”
english: Then I cried out, "Sovereign LORD, I beg you, stop! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!"

ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa omochenu oyomo ogokwana, na omochenu onde akaboria oria orenge gokwana, “Nengaki eng’ana naki okorora okwo igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gwa kera rituko gokworokia? Nengaki eng’ana naki ogosaria kw’ogosiria korabe, na okoruegwa kw’Obomenyo Obochenu na okw’omoganda oria biratiringerwe inse korabe?”
english: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to him, "How long will it take for the vision to be fulfilled-- the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, and the surrender of the sanctuary and of the host that will be trampled underfoot?"

ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa eriogi rinene rikorwa ase Hekalu, rigotebia abamalaika baria batano na babere, “Genda moitere ebitaabo biria bitano na bibere bi’endamwamu ya Nyasae igoro ase ense.”
english: Then I heard a loud voice from the temple saying to the seven angels, "Go, pour out the seven bowls of God's wrath on the earth."

ekegusii: Nkaigwa eriogi rinene igoro rigoteba, “Bono ogotooreka kwa Nyasae oito gwachire amo ne chinguru na oboruoti bwaye, na okobua gwa Kristo oye, ekiagera omosoeri bw’abaminto orutirwe inse, ere oyorenge kobasoera ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito omobaso na obotuko.
english: Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say: "Now have come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ. For the accuser of our brothers, who accuses them before our God day and night, has been hurled down.

ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa eriogi rikorwa igoro rigoteba, “Rika aya: Mbasesenirie abagokwa korwa bono, bamwegenete Omonene. Ee, nabo, Omoika ogoteba, tiga batimoke korwa ase emeremo yabo, ekiagera okwama kw’ogokora kwabo nigo gokobatunyana.”
english: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, "Write: Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on." "Yes," says the Spirit, "they will rest from their labor, for their deeds will follow them."

ekegusii: Then I heard a voice telling me, 'Get up, Peter. Kill and eat.'
english: Nkaigwa eriogi rigonte bia: Petero, imoka, onyenye orie!

ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa eriogi rinde korwa igoro, rigoteba, “Inwe abanto baane, karue asare, erinde timobwatana nere ase ebibe biaye, na konyora amaakwa amo nere.
english: Then I heard another voice from heaven say: "Come out of her, my people, so that you will not share in her sins, so that you will not receive any of her plagues;

ekegusii: Naende nkaigwa kera egetongwa ekere igoro, na ekere ase ense, na inse y’ense, na igoro y’enyancha na imeo, kegoteba, “Asare ere oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene, na ase Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ogotogigwa, na ogosikwa, na obonene, na okobua goika kare na kare!”
english: Then I heard every creature in heaven and on earth and under the earth and on the sea, and all that is in them, singing: "To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be praise and honor and glory and power, for ever and ever!"

ekegusii: Nkaigwa Omonene ogoaka eriogi rinene, ogoteba, “Tebia abwo bachikirwe gosaria omochie bache, kera oyomo ache ore nekerwanero kiaye ase okoboko kwaye.”
english: Then I heard him call out in a loud voice, "Bring the guards of the city here, each with a weapon in his hand."

ekegusii: Then I heard him speaking, and as I listened to him, I fell into a deep sleep, my face to the ground.
english: Erio nkaigwa eriogi ri’amang’ana aye; ekero nariigwete, nkaba ne chitoro chinene, nkagwa inse nkaumama.

ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa omomalaika, oyore nokobua igoro y’amache, ogoteba, “Aye nomonyene oboronge ase okogamba kwao, aye Omochenu, oyoreo na oyokwarengeo.
english: Then I heard the angel in charge of the waters say: "You are just in these judgments, you who are and who were, the Holy One, because you have so judged;

ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa omobaro obo abwo babekirwe ekemanyererio. Nigo barenge abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ene na inye (144,000) korwa ase kera egesaku kia basinto ba Israeli.
english: Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: 144,000 from all the tribes of Israel.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio nkaigwa Omonene okoboria, “Ning’o ngotoma, na ning’o oranyare koba omotomwa oito?” Nkairaneria ngateba, “Nao inde aa, ntome.”
english: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, "Whom shall I send? And who will go for us?" And I said, "Here am I. Send me!"

ekegusii: Erio nkaigwa buna neriogi ri’omoganda omonene, na buna eri’amache amange, na buna eri’enkoba ye chinguru rigoteba, “Haleluya! Omonene Nyasae oito Omobui nkogamba are.
english: Then I heard what sounded like a great multitude, like the roar of rushing waters and like loud peals of thunder, shouting: "Hallelujah! For our Lord God Almighty reigns.

ekegusii: Nkaigwa buna neriogi rikorwa gati‐gati ye ching’iti chiria inye chire moyo, rikobora, “Engano ekemunu ekemo ase edinari eyemo, na esairi ebimunu bitato ase edinari eyemo; amaguta na edivai tobisaria.”
english: Then I heard what sounded like a voice among the four living creatures, saying, "A quart of wheat for a day's wages, and three quarts of barley for a day's wages, and do not damage the oil and the wine!"

ekegusii: Erio nkarigereria, nkaigwa egeturi ki’abamalaika abange abarenge baetanaine ekerogo keria ki’obonene ne ching’iti chiria chire moyo, na abagaaka baria; na omobaro obo nigo orenge chilifu ikomi ara chilifu ikomi, ne chilifu ara chilifu.
english: Then I looked and heard the voice of many angels, numbering thousands upon thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand. They encircled the throne and the living creatures and the elders.

ekegusii: Naende nkarigereria, nkarora omonto obwate engori y’okorengera ase okoboko kwaye.
english: Then I looked up-- and there before me was a man with a measuring line in his hand!

ekegusii: Naende nkarigereria, nkarora chingunchara inye.
english: Then I looked up-- and there before me were four horns!

ekegusii: Erio nkaimokia amaiso aane, nkarora abakungu babere bakooroka. Embeo egasoa ase chimbaba chiabo chiarenge buna echie riagonga. Abakungu abwo bakaimokia egetonga keria, bakairuruka nakerokio gochia gati‐gati y’ense na igoro.
english: Then I looked up-- and there before me were two women, with the wind in their wings! They had wings like those of a stork, and they lifted up the basket between heaven and earth.

ekegusii: Ekero narigereretie, nkarora okoboko koramboire gocha asende, na ase okoboko okwo ebuku yaringire iyarengeo.
english: Then I looked, and I saw a hand stretched out to me. In it was a scroll,

ekegusii: Erio nkarigereria, nkarora Emanwa y’Eng’ondi oteneine ase egetunwa gia Sayoni, na amo nere abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo ene na inye (144,000) abaare nerieta riaye amo neria Ise riarikire ase amasio abo igoro.
english: Then I looked, and there before me was the Lamb, standing on Mount Zion, and with him 144,000 who had his name and his Father's name written on their foreheads.

ekegusii: Naende ngaeta gochia ase Egeita gi’Ensoko na ase Ritibo ri’Omoruoti, korende aase akabora ase eng’iti eria nariinete egoetera.
english: Then I moved on toward the Fountain Gate and the King's Pool, but there was not enough room for my mount to get through;

ekegusii: Then I myself will admit to you that your own right hand can save you.
english: Igo inche ninyancherane naye, ng’a okoboko kwao gw’okorio ngokoe okobua.

ekegusii: Naama! Aya narorire are amaya na agwenerete nokoria na konywa na koba nomogoko ase ebinto ebio bionsi omonto echandeire aiga inse y’erioba, ase engaki y’amatuko amake Nyasae amoeire; ekio nakio egetari kiaye.
english: Then I realized that it is good and proper for a man to eat and drink, and to find satisfaction in his toilsome labor under the sun during the few days of life God has given him-- for this is his lot.

ekegusii: Nkainyora ring’ana riria ri’Omonene, buna atebete: Yohana nigo arenge kobatisa ase amache, korende inwe inamobatiswe ase Omoika Omochenu.
english: Then I remembered what the Lord had said: 'John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.'

ekegusii: Erio nkeboria: Inee! Abanto aba abanyaka nigo bagochia gokora obonyaka nomokungu oyo okorire obonyaka ase engaki entambe?
english: Then I said about the one worn out by adultery, 'Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is.'

ekegusii: Erio ngatebia abanene baria basikire, na abatang’ani, na abanto bande, “Emeremo nigo ere emenene, naende egareete, na intwe nigo twesiarerete ase orwaki rwonsi, na kera omonto nigo are aare korwa ase oyonde.
english: Then I said to the nobles, the officials and the rest of the people, "The work is extensive and spread out, and we are widely separated from each other along the wall.

ekegusii: Erio ngakwana nabakuani na abanto bonsi, nkabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene atebire: Timobaisa koigwera amang’ana ’abanto baino, abwo bakobabanera, bagoteba: Rora, ebikorero bi’enyomba y’Omonene nabiiranigwe korwa Babeli bwango iga. Obwo noborimo bakobabanera.
english: Then I said to the priests and all these people, "This is what the LORD says: Do not listen to the prophets who say, 'Very soon now the articles from the LORD's house will be brought back from Babylon.' They are prophesying lies to you.

ekegusii: Korende bono nkabatebia, “Mwarorire emechando yatonyorire aa: Yerusalemu otagoirwe, na ebiita biaye biasambirwe. Inchuo toagache naende orwaki rwa Yerusalemu, erinde titobaisa kogenderera koba nobosooku bw’ogochaywa.”
english: Then I said to them, "You see the trouble we are in: Jerusalem lies in ruins, and its gates have been burned with fire. Come, let us rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, and we will no longer be in disgrace."

ekegusii: Erio nkababoria: Aase agwo aimokererete igoro ase mogochia naaki? Ase ayio, aase buna agwo nigo akorokwa Aase Aimokererete Igoro Agosasimerwa, nabo akorokwa goika rero iga.
english: Then I said to them: What is this high place you go to?'" (It is called Bamah to this day.)

ekegusii: “Erio nkabatebia: Timoiroka gose goichanigwa ase abanto baria.
english: Then I said to you, "Do not be terrified; do not be afraid of them.

ekegusii: Nkabatebia: Bono mwaikire ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaamori, eyio Omonene, Nyasae oito, agochia gotoa.
english: Then I said to you, "You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God is giving us.

ekegusii: Erio ngateba, “Ayee, Omonene Nyasae! Abanto aba nigo bagokwana igoro yane baboria: Inee! Omonto oyo tari gokwana ase emebayeno?”
english: Then I said, "Ah, Sovereign LORD! They are saying of me, 'Isn't he just telling parables?'"

ekegusii: Erio ngateba, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, kwabang’ainire abanto aba ba Yerusalemu, ekiagera kwabatebetie ng’a mbabe nomorembe, korende bono omoro obeire ang’e kobaita.”
english: Then I said, "Ah, Sovereign LORD, how completely you have deceived this people and Jerusalem by saying, 'You will have peace,' when the sword is at our throats."

ekegusii: Erio nkaboria, “Aye Omonene, ngoika ririri amang’ana ayio arabe igo?” Nere akairaneria, agantebia, “Ngoika ekero emechie erabe yasarigwe etamenyiri nabanto, ne chinyomba chiatigirwe bosa, na ense ebe yasarigwe kegima na yabeire amatongo.
english: Then I said, "For how long, O Lord?" And he answered: "Until the cities lie ruined and without inhabitant, until the houses are left deserted and the fields ruined and ravaged,

ekegusii: Erio ngateba, “Rigereria, nachire; ase ebuku nigo erikire aya ngwenrete gokora.
english: Then I said, "Here I am, I have come-- it is written about me in the scroll.

ekegusii: Inche ngateba: “Inwe abatang’ani b’abanto ba Yakobo, inwe abagambi b’Abaisraeli, igwa! Inee! Tebagwenereti inwe momanye ayare ay’oboronge?
english: Then I said, "Listen, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the house of Israel. Should you not know justice,

ekegusii: Erio nkamoiraneria, nkamotebia, “Yaya, Omonene Nyasae, Naama, inche tinana gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka; korwa obwana bwane goika bono iga, tinana koria enyama y’eng’iti ekwete enyene, gose eyeitire ne ching’iti chinde; enyama ende yonsi y’okogechia tiyana gosoa ase omonwa one.”
english: Then I said, "Not so, Sovereign LORD! I have never defiled myself. From my youth until now I have never eaten anything found dead or torn by wild animals. No unclean meat has ever entered my mouth."

ekegusii: Erio inche ngateba, “Bono mobekere egetambaa ekerabu motwe.” Ase igo bakamobekera egetambaa ekerabu motwe na bakamobekera ne chianga chiria chingiya, ekero omomalaika oria bw’Omonene ateneineo.
english: Then I said, "Put a clean turban on his head." So they put a clean turban on his head and clothed him, while the angel of the LORD stood by.

ekegusii: Erio ngakwana: Nachire gokora ogwancha kwao, Nyasae, buna erikire igoro yane ase ebuku.”
english: Then I said, 'Here I am-- it is written about me in the scroll-- I have come to do your will, O God.'"

ekegusii: ngateba, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae ore igoro, Nyasae Omonene bw’okoirokia, aye bwanchete na korenda okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania na kobaa obuya abwo bagwanchete na babwatete amachiko ao.
english: Then I said: "O LORD, God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of love with those who love him and obey his commands,

ekegusii: Erio nkarora ekerogo ki’obonene, ekenene, ekerabu, amo noyogeikaranserete. Korwa ase obosio bwaye ense na igoro bigatama, na aase abo tarorekana ase bakobeera.
english: Then I saw a great white throne and him who was seated on it. Earth and sky fled from his presence, and there was no place for them.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, oteneine gati y’ekerogo ki’obonene ne ching’iti chiria inye chire moyo, na gati‐gati y’abagaaka; nere ororekanete buna oyonyenyetwe. Nigo arenge ne chingunchara isano na ibere na amaiso atano na abere, ayare emeika etano na ebere ya Nyasae, yatomirwe ase ense yonsi.
english: Then I saw a Lamb, looking as if it had been slain, standing in the center of the throne, encircled by the four living creatures and the elders. He had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora igoro aayia na ense enyia, naki igoro ye ritang’ani na ense ye ritang’ani biaetire, nonya nenyancha teri naende.
english: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and there was no longer any sea.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora ng’a omonto takonyara komanya emeremo ende yonsi ya Nyasae egokorekana aiga inse y’erioba. Omonto naisa gwechanda mono ase okorigia koyemanya, takonyara koyemanya. Nonya omonto omong’aini ogoteba ng’a namanyete, takonyara koyemanya.
english: then I saw all that God has done. No one can comprehend what goes on under the sun. Despite all his efforts to search it out, man cannot discover its meaning. Even if a wise man claims he knows, he cannot really comprehend it.

ekegusii: Naende nkarora omomalaika onde ogotiira korwa aase erioba rigosoka korwa ore nekemanyererio kia Nyasae ore moyo; akabaakera egeturi ase eriogi rinene abamalaika baria bane baetwe ribaga gosaria ense na enyancha,
english: Then I saw another angel coming up from the east, having the seal of the living God. He called out in a loud voice to the four angels who had been given power to harm the land and the sea:

ekegusii: Erio nkarora omomalaika onde okoiruruka igoro gati. Oyo nigo arenge nenchili ya kare na kare okorareria abwo bamenyete ase ense, ase kera egesaku, na eamate, na omonwa, na abanto.
english: Then I saw another angel flying in midair, and he had the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who live on the earth-- to every nation, tribe, language and people.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora eng’iti ende egotiira korwa inse. Ero nigo yarenge ne chingunchara ibere chinga buna echi’emanwa y’eng’ondi, egakwana buna enchoka.
english: Then I saw another beast, coming out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb, but he spoke like a dragon.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora omomalaika onde bwe chinguru ogoika korwa igoro oboirie riire. Nigo arenge nomokubinyongo bw’embura oetanaine omotwe oye, na obosio bwaye nigo bwarenge buna erioba, na amagoro aye buna chisiiro chi’omorero.
english: Then I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven. He was robed in a cloud, with a rainbow above his head; his face was like the sun, and his legs were like fiery pillars.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora ase okoboko gw’okorio kw’oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene ebuku erikire ime na isiko, yabekirwe ebimanyererio bitano na bibere.
english: Then I saw in the right hand of him who sat on the throne a scroll with writing on both sides and sealed with seven seals.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora eng’iti eria, na abaruoti b’ense amo nemeganda yabo y’esegi basangererekanete amo bamorwanie ere oyoriinete ebarasi eria na omoganda oye.
english: Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to make war against the rider on the horse and his army.

ekegusii: Nkarora emeika y’eubi etato enga buna ebioto ekorua ase omonwa bw’enchoka, na ase omonwa bw’eng’iti, na ase omonwa bw’omobani oria bw’oborimo.
english: Then I saw three evil spirits that looked like frogs; they came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

ekegusii: Erio ngachora abakuani ikomi na babere, abarenge abatang’ani: Serebia na Hasabia, amo nabakuani bande bamwabo ikomi.
english: Then I set apart twelve of the leading priests, together with Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their brothers,

ekegusii: Ngatereka bosio bw’abanto b’eamate ya Rekabu ebitoono biaichire edivai, nkabaa nebikombe, nkabatebia, “Kanywe edivai eyio.”
english: Then I set bowls full of wine and some cups before the men of the Recabite family and said to them, "Drink some wine."

ekegusii: Erio nkeboria, “Ande, amang’ana akomonyora omoriri naro aranyore nainche, nase ki rende inche nabeire nobong’aini obonge?” Ase ayio ngetebia ng’a aya boigo mbosa.
english: Then I thought in my heart, "The fate of the fool will overtake me also. What then do I gain by being wise?" I said in my heart, "This too is meaningless."

ekegusii: Erio ngateba, “Obo nobororo bwane, eye nengaki okoboko gw’okorio kw’Oyore Igoro Mono gwantomeire.”
english: Then I thought, "To this I will appeal: the years of the right hand of the Most High."

ekegusii: Nkamotebia, “Ogenderere komenya nainche amatuko amange kore omweriti ase engencho yane. Tobaisa gokora obonyaka, gose koba oyo bw’omosacha onde omoao, na inche ningenderere kwerita ase engencho yao.”
english: Then I told her, "You are to live with me many days; you must not be a prostitute or be intimate with any man, and I will live with you."

ekegusii: Erio nkaimokia enyimbo eria yane yarenge korokwa “Ogwancherwa”, nkayebuna, na igo ngasaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania okwo konya nakorire nabanto bonsi.
english: Then I took my staff called Favor and broke it, revoking the covenant I had made with all the nations.

ekegusii: Nkaonchora ebirengererio biane korigereria obong’aini na obobarimo, na oboriri. Omonto oyio okobekwa oboruoti ribaga ri’oyio orengeo, ninki arakore? Tagokora kende otatiga keria oyio omotang’ani akorete.
english: Then I turned my thoughts to consider wisdom, and also madness and folly. What more can the king's successor do than what has already been done?

ekegusii: Inche nigo narenge amo nere buna oyomanyete emeremo eyio buya. Kera rituko nigo arenge kogokigwa nainche, na inche nkaba inde nomogoko ase obosio bwaye botambe.
english: Then I was the craftsman at his side. I was filled with delight day after day, rejoicing always in his presence,

ekegusii: Erio agantebia, “Nekogwenerete obane naende igoro ase abanto, na ebisaku, na emenwa, na abaruoti abange.”
english: Then I was told, "You must prophesy again about many peoples, nations, languages and kings."

ekegusii: Erio nkaba nomokungu one orenge omobani, na ere akaba morito, akaibora omwana omoisia, na Omonene agantebia, “Moroke Maheri‐Salali Hasi‐Basi.
english: Then I went to the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. And the LORD said to me, "Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

ekegusii: Erio inyore ring’ana ndairanerie abwo bagonchecheria, ekiagera nigo inyegenete ring’ana riao.
english: then I will answer the one who taunts me, for I trust in your word.

ekegusii: Ningotugute gochia ase embeera ime, ogende ase abanto ba kare bachiete. Ninkobeke omenye ime ye riroba, aase agwo asaretigwe kare, obeere amo nabanto abwo bagendete ase chimbeera ime. Aye tokomenywa naende, korende inche ninkore amang’ana amanene ase ense y’abare moyo.
english: then I will bring you down with those who go down to the pit, to the people of long ago. I will make you dwell in the earth below, as in ancient ruins, with those who go down to the pit, and you will not return or take your place in the land of the living.

ekegusii: rirorio ninsirie Abaisraeli korwa ase ense eria nabaeire, na enyomba eye naatananire na koyechena ase engencho y’erieta riane ninyetige, tinkoyerigereria namaiso aane. Abaisraeli nababe omorabaaro ne ring’ana rigokwanwa nabanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
english: then I will cut off Israel from the land I have given them and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. Israel will then become a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.

ekegusii: rirorio nainche nimbakorere amang’ana aya: Nimbarentere omoondoko mobosokano, na oborwaire bw’okoria emebere, na obw’ogosaria amaiso, na obw’ogokoora obogima. Namobusure chindagera, korende timokonyora gento, ekiagera ababisa baino nabwo barachirie.
english: then I will do this to you: I will bring upon you sudden terror, wasting diseases and fever that will destroy your sight and drain away your life. You will plant seed in vain, because your enemies will eat it.

ekegusii: Inche nimenye ase egati y’Abaisraeli, imbe Nyasae obo.
english: Then I will dwell among the Israelites and be their God.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio nigo nare konyara goikerania eira y’ogotiana narierete chisokoro chiabo ng’a nimbae ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, buna akoregete goika rituko ria rero.” Inche Yeremia nkairaneria, nkabora, “Ee, Omonene, tiga abe bo.”
english: Then I will fulfill the oath I swore to your forefathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey'-- the land you possess today." I answered, "Amen, LORD."

ekegusii: Nimbae inwe abarisia abaya, abarangokie ase enkoro yane, abarabaragerie bare nobong’ani na okomanya.
english: Then I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will lead you with knowledge and understanding.

ekegusii: “Ning’irane ngende ase obomenyo bwane, goika babe bamanyire okomocha kwabo, erinde bache kondigia. Ee, ekero bare nemechando mbaayerere gocha kondigia.”
english: Then I will go back to my place until they admit their guilt. And they will seek my face; in their misery they will earnestly seek me."

ekegusii: Ninkobeke ase amaboko ’abanchi bao; barabwo mbatagore ebinyomba biria kweagacherete bi’emegwekano ogosasima amo naase ao aimokererete igoro. Naende mbakorusie chianga chiao, na baire ebinto biao ebiya bi’ogwechabera, bagotige kore getirianda otabegeti eanga.
english: Then I will hand you over to your lovers, and they will tear down your mounds and destroy your lofty shrines. They will strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry and leave you naked and bare.

ekegusii: Erio nintige amache areo akenonoke, ne chindooche chiminyoke buna amaguta. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: Then I will let her waters settle and make her streams flow like oil, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Komoraonchoke, erio inche nimbatige mogenderere komenya aase aiga ase ense naete chisokoro chiaino agwo kare ng’a ebe eyabo kogenderera botambe.
english: then I will let you live in this place, in the land I gave your forefathers for ever and ever.

ekegusii: rirorio inche ninsarie enyomba eye ebe buna Silo, na ebisaku bionsi bi’ense bibe bikoragereria ase erieta ri’omochie oyo.”
english: then I will make this house like Shiloh and this city an object of cursing among all the nations of the earth.'"

ekegusii: then I will reject the descendants of Jacob and David my servant and will not choose one of his sons to rule over the descendants of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. For I will restore their fortunes and have compassion on them.'"
english: nanga nangete nororeria rwa Yakobo, na orwa Daudi omosomba one, na tinchora omonto bw’ororeria rwaye agambere oroiboro rwa Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo. Nimbairanerie amaya abo na kobarorera amabera.”

ekegusii: Erio ndusie okoboko kwane, na aye ondore amagega aane, korende obosio bwane tokonyara koborora.”
english: Then I will remove my hand and you will see my back; but my face must not be seen."

ekegusii: Erio nintome omosomba one arigie emegwe eria. Kondatebie omosomba oria: Rigereia, emegwe nigo ere magega ao, gocha ensemo yane, genda oyerente, rirorio aye Daudi ochiche, obe nomorembe. Ekeene, buna Omonene are moyo, togokorerwa bobe bonde.
english: Then I will send a boy and say, 'Go, find the arrows.' If I say to him, 'Look, the arrows are on this side of you; bring them here,' then come, because, as surely as the LORD lives, you are safe; there is no danger.

ekegusii: rirorio ere nabatwerie embura ase ense yaino ase engaki egwenerete, embura ye ritang’ani na ey’okwamia endagera nainwe monyore endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni.
english: then I will send rain on your land in its season, both autumn and spring rains, so that you may gather in your grain, new wine and oil.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo ning’ake obota bore ase okoboko kwao gw’okobee bogwe inse, ne chinsara chire ase okoboko kwao gw’okorio chigwe inse boigo.
english: Then I will strike your bow from your left hand and make your arrows drop from your right hand.

ekegusii: Erio inyorokererie abasaria chinchera chiao, na abanyene ebibe mbairane asore.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will turn back to you.

ekegusii: Erio nainche nimbatebie maiso marore abanto baria: Timbamanyeti inwe nonya ng’ake; karue asende, inwe abakori amabe!
english: Then I will tell them plainly, 'I never knew you. Away from me, you evildoers!'

ekegusii: rirorio nimbarusie korwa ase ense eye nabaeire; na enyomba eye naatananire na koyechena ase engencho y’erieta riane ninyetugute erue ase amaiso aane, naende ebe ring’ana rigokwanwa bobe nabanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
english: then I will uproot Israel from my land, which I have given them, and will reject this temple I have consecrated for my Name. I will make it a byword and an object of ridicule among all peoples.

ekegusii: Rirorio tingosookigwa ekero ndabe ndigereretie amachiko ao onsi.
english: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all your commands.

ekegusii: Erio inyare gokwana ntari nobwoba ase engencho yaye, nimanyete ng’a tindi nokomocha.”
english: Then I would speak up without fear of him, but as it now stands with me, I cannot.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo are kogera ndemigwe; nigo narenge kogoka ntari koigwa obororo bw’okoromwa oko okonene. Ekiagera tinkaneti amang’ana a Nyasae ore Omochenu.
english: Then I would still have this consolation-- my joy in unrelenting pain-- that I had not denied the words of the Holy One.

ekegusii: Erio inche Danieli nkarigereria nkarora abanto babere bateneine ase engegu y’orooche, oyomo ase engegu eyemo, na oyonde ase engegu ende.
english: Then I, Daniel, looked, and there before me stood two others, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.

ekegusii: Then Ibzan died, and was buried in Bethlehem.
english: Erio Ibasani agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Bethlehemu.

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oraigwe eriogi ri’egetureri ekio, korende taigwera ogokurerwa okwo, omoro koramonyore omoite, okomocha kw’ogoiteka kw’amanyinga aye, nakobarwe igoro yaye.
english: then if anyone hears the trumpet but does not take warning and the sword comes and takes his life, his blood will be on his own head.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakorenda Rituko Rinene ri’Ebigutu, koreng’ana buna riachigetwe, na kera rituko bakaba bakorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase omobaro ochikire o kera rituko.
english: Then in accordance with what is written, they celebrated the Feast of Tabernacles with the required number of burnt offerings prescribed for each day.

ekegusii: erio nario naende ndabae egususuro ara gatano na kabere ase engencho y’ebibe biaino.
english: then in my anger I will be hostile toward you, and I myself will punish you for your sins seven times over.

ekegusii: Asa agakwa ase omwaka bw’emerongo ene nomo bw’okogamba kwaye, akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete.
english: Then in the forty-first year of his reign Asa died and rested with his fathers.

ekegusii: Kobwakiire mambia, na Nabali gatindokire, Abigaeli akamotebia amang’ana ayio. Erio enkoro yaye ekarianyeka, ekoma pa, ekaba buna rigena.
english: Then in the morning, when Nabal was sober, his wife told him all these things, and his heart failed him and he became like a stone.

ekegusii: Abwo baratooreke korwa ase emioro na koirwa ase obosomba ase egati y’ebisaku mbabe bakong’inyora, ekiagera nasenyentete chinkoro chiabo chi’obokayayu, echio chiantigete, na nkaukoria amaiso abo, ayio atengerete ase okogania emegwekano yabo bagosasima. Mbachandeke na kwegecha boka abanyene, ase engencho y’ebibe bakorire, na ase engencho y’okogechia kwabo gwonsi.
english: Then in the nations where they have been carried captive, those who escape will remember me-- how I have been grieved by their adulterous hearts, which have turned away from me, and by their eyes, which have lusted after their idols. They will loathe themselves for the evil they have done and for all their detestable practices.

ekegusii: Erio Isaka agatebia Yakobo, “Inchuo aiga ang’e asende, ngotabatabe, erinde imanye gose naye omwana one Esau, gose tari aye.”
english: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Come near so I can touch you, my son, to know whether you really are my son Esau or not."

ekegusii: Naboigo Isaka agatebia Yakobo agende, na ere akagenda Padan‐Aramu ase Labani, mosinto o Betueli Omoaramu, Labani nere momura omwabo Rebeka, ng’ina Yakobo na Esau.
english: Then Isaac sent Jacob on his way, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.

ekegusii: Erio Isaya agatebia Hezekia, “Bono igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Eganda:
english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the LORD Almighty:

ekegusii: Erio Isaya agatebia Hezekia, “Igwa buna Omonene atebire:
english: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, "Hear the word of the LORD:

ekegusii: Erio Isaya agateba, “Inwe ab’ororeria rwa Daudi, igwa bono! Inee! Namang’ana amasinini mono asemore korosia abanto, na bono mwamorosirie na Nyasae one boigo?
english: Then Isaiah said, "Hear now, you house of David! Is it not enough to try the patience of men? Will you try the patience of my God also?

ekegusii: Isaya agateba, “Renta ribomba ri’amako.” Na ekero riarentetwe rikabekwa igoro ase rigumba, na Hezekia akagwena.
english: Then Isaiah said, "Prepare a poultice of figs." They did so and applied it to the boil, and he recovered.

ekegusii: Erio Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, agatoma amang’ana ase Hezekia, akomotebia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Aye gwansabire igoro ya Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
english: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Because you have prayed to me concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria,

ekegusii: Erio Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, agatoma amang’ana ase Hezekia, agateba, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Naigure amang’ana gwansabire igoro ya Senakeribu, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
english: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah: "This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria.

ekegusii: Erio Isaya omobani agacha ase Hezekia omoruoti, akamoboria, “Ngento ki abanto aba bakwana? Ng’ai barwa bagacha asore?” Hezekia akamoiraneria, “Barabwo nigo barure ense y’aare, ense ya Babeli.”
english: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, "What did those men say, and where did they come from?" "From a distant land," Hezekiah replied. "They came from Babylon."

ekegusii: Erio omobani Isaya agacha ase Hezekia, omoruoti akamoboria, “Ngento ki abanto aba bakwana? Ng’ai barwa bagacha asore?” Hezekia akamoiraneria, “Barabwo nigo barwa Babeli, ense y’aare, bagacha asende.”
english: Then Isaiah the prophet went to King Hezekiah and asked, "What did those men say, and where did they come from?" "From a distant land," Hezekiah replied. "They came to me from Babylon."

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagacha Misiri; Yakobo akaba omomenyi ase ense ya Hamu.
english: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob lived as an alien in the land of Ham.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakariera Omonene eira, bakabora, “Aye korabeke abanto aba ase amaboko aito, intwe natosirie emechie yabo kegima.”
english: Then Israel made this vow to the LORD: "If you will deliver these people into our hands, we will totally destroy their cities."

ekegusii: Erio Israeli agatebia Yusufu, “Rora ng’ang’e inde gokwa. Nyasae nigo arabe amo nainwe, nabairanie gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiaino.
english: Then Israel said to Joseph, "I am about to die, but God will be with you and take you back to the land of your fathers.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagatera ogotera oko: “Chinsoko, sokia amache acharare gocha, naintwe togoke na gotera ase amache ayio.
english: Then Israel sang this song: "Spring up, O well! Sing about it,

ekegusii: Korwa agwo bagatoma abanto gochia ase omoruoti bw’Edomu bamoborie ribaga baetere ense yaye. Korende omoruoti bw’Edomu tanchete gotegerera amang’ana ayio. Naende bagatoma abanto ase omoruoti o Moabu, nere boigo tabaete ribaga. Ase ayio Abaisraeli bagatigara agwo Kadeshi.
english: Then Israel sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, 'Give us permission to go through your country,' but the king of Edom would not listen. They sent also to the king of Moab, and he refused. So Israel stayed at Kadesh.

ekegusii: Then Israel set an ambush around Gibeah.
english: Abaisraeli bakabeka abarwani bakaboa goetanana omochie o Gibea.

ekegusii: Korwa agwo rokagenderera gochia moocha, rogaika Gati‐Heferi na Eta‐Kasini, rokagenda gochia Rimoni, rokaonchoka gochia Nea.
english: Then it continued eastward to Gath Hepher and Eth Kazin; it came out at Rimmon and turned toward Neah.

ekegusii: rogaetanana bosongo ya Baala gochia egetunwa gia Seiri, naende sugusu y’egetunwa kia Yearimu (nakio Kesaloni), na maate gochia Beti‐Semesi na rokabwatia Timuna.
english: Then it curved westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Kesalon), continued down to Beth Shemesh and crossed to Timnah.

ekegusii: Then it goes and takes seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that man is worse than the first."
english: Erio kiagenda, kiarentana ebirecha bitano na bibere binde ebire ebibe gokebua kerokio ekenyene. Birobio bigosoa na komenya aroro; okoba kw’omoerio kw’omonto oyio kwaba okobe kobua okwe ritang’ani.”

ekegusii: Erio kiagenda, kiarentana ebirecha binde bitano na bibere, ebire ebibe kobua kerokio ekenyene. Nabirobio biasoa na komenya aroro; okoba kw’omoerio kw’omonto oyio kwaba okobe kobua okwe ritang’ani. Naboigo erache koba ase ekegori eke ekebe.”
english: Then it goes and takes with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that man is worse than the first. That is how it will be with this wicked generation."

ekegusii: Erio rokagenderera gochia rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, irianyi y’egetunwa kia Yebusi, nao Yerusalemu. Nyuma y’ayio rogatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ekio kerochie Rikura ria Hinomu, ensemo ya bosongo, sugusu y’ense omweremo ya Refaimu.
english: Then it ran up the Valley of Ben Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem). From there it climbed to the top of the hill west of the Hinnom Valley at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.

ekegusii: Erio kiabora: Ning’irane ase enyomba yane aase narwete. Gakegocha kiayenyora nenchwa, yaabusirwe, yaroisigwe.
english: Then it says, 'I will return to the house I left.' When it arrives, it finds the house unoccupied, swept clean and put in order.

ekegusii: Korwa Yanoa rogatirimboka gochia Ataroti na Naara, erio rogatwomera Yeriko, na korwa aroro rogaika Yorodan.
english: Then it went down from Janoah to Ataroth and Naarah, touched Jericho and came out at the Jordan.

ekegusii: Naende akababoria, “Mbuya are?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee, mbuya are; na rigereria, Raeli, omoiseke oye oyio ogocha ne ching’ondi!”
english: Then Jacob asked them, "Is he well?" "Yes, he is," they said, "and here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep."

ekegusii: Yakobo agasesenia Farao naende, akarua ase obosio bwaye.
english: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from his presence.

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akarangeria abamura baye, akabatebia, “Sangererekana asende aa, mbatebie amang’ana arabanyore ase amatuko agochi‐gocha.”
english: Then Jacob called for his sons and said: "Gather around so I can tell you what will happen to you in days to come.

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akabwatia orogendo rwaye, agaika ense y’abanto ba moocha.
english: Then Jacob continued on his journey and came to the land of the eastern peoples.

ekegusii: Then Jacob gave Esau some bread and some lentil stew. He ate and drank, and then got up and left. So Esau despised his birthright.
english: Erio Yakobo akaa Esau omogati na omosori bwe ching’ende, na ere akaria na konywa; erio akaimoka akagenda. Naboigo Esau achayete omwando oye bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi.

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akanyunyunta Raeli, akarera na koiyeria amariga.
english: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and began to weep aloud.

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaimoka korwa Beeri‐Seba, akagenda. Basinto ba Israeli bakabogoria Yakobo ise, amo nabana babo abake, na abakungu babo ase chigari chiria Farao abatomerete chibabogorie.
english: Then Jacob left Beersheba, and Israel's sons took their father Jacob and their children and their wives in the carts that Pharaoh had sent to transport him.

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaria eira, okobora, “Nyasae karabe amo nainche, andende ase orogendo rwane na kong’a endagera nkoria, ne chianga nkobeka,
english: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me and will watch over me on this journey I am taking and will give me food to eat and clothes to wear

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agasaba, akabora, “Aye Nyasae o sokoro yane Ibrahimu, Nyasae o Isaka tata, aye Omonene, gwantebetie ng’a: Oirane gochia seino, na eamate yao, na inche ningokorere amaya.
english: Then Jacob prayed, "O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, O LORD, who said to me, 'Go back to your country and your relatives, and I will make you prosper,'

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo akaimoka, akariinia abana baye na abakungu baye ase chingamia igoro;
english: Then Jacob put his children and his wives on camels,

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agatebia Labani, “Bono naikeranirie engaki yane, ing’a mokane, torare komo.”
english: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife. My time is completed, and I want to lie with her."

ekegusii: Erio Yakobo agatebia Simeoni na Lawi, “Inwe mwambekire ase emechando, mwankorire ntioke bobe egati y’abanto b’ebisaku bi’ense eye, Abakanani na Abaperisi. Inche na abanto baane nabake tore; barabwo baise gosangererekana na kong’umokera nigo barang’ite na gonsiria amo nabanto baane.”
english: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have brought trouble on me by making me a stench to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people living in this land. We are few in number, and if they join forces against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed."

ekegusii: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and mourned for his son many days.
english: Erio Yakobo agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chigunia kenema kiaye, akaba okomoreera omwana oye engaki entambe.

ekegusii: Then Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our fathers died.
english: Yakobo agatirimboka, agaika Misiri; ere agakwera aroro, ere omonyene ne chisokoro chiaito.

ekegusii: Yakobo na Yohana, abana ba Zebedi, bakamochiera, bakamotebia, “Omworokia, ntorigetie otokorere rinde rionsi toragosabe.”
english: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to him. "Teacher," they said, "we want you to do for us whatever we ask."

ekegusii: Erio Yehoahasi agasaba Omonene, na Omonene akamoigwa, ekiagera aroche ogochandwa kw’Abaisraeli, buna omoruoti bw’Abasiiria abachandete.
english: Then Jehoahaz sought the LORD's favor, and the LORD listened to him, for he saw how severely the king of Aram was oppressing Israel.

ekegusii: Erio Yehoasi, mosinto o Yehoahasi, akaira naende korwa ase Beni‐Hadadi, mosinto o Hasaeli, emechie eyio ere konya airire korwa ase Yehoahasi ise ekero gi’esegi. Yehoasi akabua Beni‐Hadadi ara gatato, akairania emechie y’Abaisraeli.
english: Then Jehoash son of Jehoahaz recaptured from Ben-Hadad son of Hazael the towns he had taken in battle from his father Jehoahaz. Three times Jehoash defeated him, and so he recovered the Israelite towns.

ekegusii: Yehoyada akabeka abarendi ase enyomba y’Omonene, bagatenenerwa nabakuani Abalawi, baria Daudi konya achorire batenenere enyomba y’Omonene. Barabwo babe bakorua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Omonene, koreng’ana buna arikire ase amachiko a Musa. Naende babe bakorua ebing’wanso biria ase omogoko na amatera, buna aroberetigwe na Daudi.
english: Then Jehoiada placed the oversight of the temple of the LORD in the hands of the priests, who were Levites, to whom David had made assignments in the temple, to present the burnt offerings of the LORD as written in the Law of Moses, with rejoicing and singing, as David had ordered.

ekegusii: Yehosafati akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase chiatindegetwe ase Omochie o Daudi, sokororia yaye; na Yehoramu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the city of David his father. And Jehoram his son succeeded him.

ekegusii: Yehosafati akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, agatindekwa ase Omochie o Daudi, ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe, na Yehoramu, omwana oye omomura, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Then Jehoshaphat rested with his fathers and was buried with them in the City of David. And Jehoram his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Yehosafati agatenena ase egati y’omosangererekano oria bw’Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu agwo ase eraaro enyia y’enyomba y’Omonene,
english: Then Jehoshaphat stood up in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem at the temple of the LORD in the front of the new courtyard

ekegusii: Yehu agasoa enyomba ya Baali amo na Yehonadabu, mosinto o Rekabu, agatebia abakoreri ba Baali “Rigia na morore ng’a omosomba bw’Omonene tari ase egati yaino nonya noyomo, korende nabakoreri ba Baali boka.”
english: Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Recab went into the temple of Baal. Jehu said to the ministers of Baal, "Look around and see that no servants of the LORD are here with you-- only ministers of Baal."

ekegusii: Yehu agasangereria abanto bonsi, akabatebia, “Ahabu nigo akorerete Baali ake igo, korende inche Yehu nigo ndayekorere mono goetania.
english: Then Jehu brought all the people together and said to them, "Ahab served Baal a little; Jehu will serve him much.

ekegusii: Erio Yehu akaruta omogwe ne chinguru chiaye chionsi, akarasa Yoramu gati y’amareko, na omogwe oria okarimera ime ase enkoro yaye, nere akagwa ime ase egari yaye.
english: Then Jehu drew his bow and shot Joram between the shoulders. The arrow pierced his heart and he slumped down in his chariot.

ekegusii: Yehu akagenda Yesireeli, na ekero Yesebeli aigwete amang’ana ayio agasata amaiso aye na gochabera omotwe oye, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao.
english: Then Jehu went to Jezreel. When Jezebel heard about it, she painted her eyes, arranged her hair and looked out of a window.

ekegusii: Naende akabarikera rirube eria kabere, akabatebia, “Onye more ase ensemo yane, naende onye more ang’e konyigwera, butora emetwe y’abana b’omonene oino, na ankio, engaki buna eye mochiche asende aiga Yesireeli.” Abana b’omoruoti emerongo etano na ebere, nao bamenyete amo nabanto abanene b’omochie, baria batenenerete.
english: Then Jehu wrote them a second letter, saying, "If you are on my side and will obey me, take the heads of your master's sons and come to me in Jezreel by this time tomorrow." Now the royal princes, seventy of them, were with the leading men of the city, who were rearing them.

ekegusii: Erio Yefta agatoma abanto ase omoruoti bw’Abaamoni komoboria, “Ndiomana ki obwate asende? Nase ki gwachire korwania ense yane?”
english: Then Jephthah sent messengers to the Ammonite king with the question: "What do you have against us that you have attacked our country?"

ekegusii: Yefta akaamboka gochia ng’umbu, akagenda korwania Abaamoni, na Omonene akababeka ase amaboko aye.
english: Then Jephthah went over to fight the Ammonites, and the LORD gave them into his hands.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia agakwana nabanene bonsi b’oboruoti, na abanto bonsi, akabatebia, “Omonene nere ontoma kobana mamincha y’enyomba eye na omochie oyo amang’ana ayio onsi mwaigwa.
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the officials and all the people: "The LORD sent me to prophesy against this house and this city all the things you have heard.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia akairaneria, agatebia abanto bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, abwo bonsi bakwanete amang’ana ayio, akabora,
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, both men and women, who were answering him,

ekegusii: Naende Yeremia agakwana nabanto bonsi amo nabakungu bonsi, akabatebia, “Inwe Abayuda bonsi aba more ase ense ya Misiri, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including the women, "Hear the word of the LORD, all you people of Judah in Egypt.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia akaboria Zedekia omoruoti, “Mang’ana ki amabe nakorire asore, gose ase abasomba bao, gose ase abanto aba goika kwambekire ase echela?
english: Then Jeremiah said to King Zedekiah, "What crime have I committed against you or your officials or this people, that you have put me in prison?

ekegusii: Korende Yeremia agakwana nabanto b’eamate y’Abarekabu, agateba, “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Mwaigwereire amang’ana aria Yonadabu, sokoro yaino, abachigete, na mwarendire emeroberio yaye yonsi, na gokora amang’ana onsi abachigete.
english: Then Jeremiah said to the family of the Recabites, "This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'You have obeyed the command of your forefather Jonadab and have followed all his instructions and have done everything he ordered.'

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia agatebia Zedekia, “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Aye korerue ase amaboko ay’abakogamba inse y’omoruoti o Babeli, notigwe obe moyo, na omochie oyo togosambwa nomorero; aye amo nabanto b’eamate yao namotigwe mobe moyo.
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, "This is what the LORD God Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'If you surrender to the officers of the king of Babylon, your life will be spared and this city will not be burned down; you and your family will live.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia omobani agatebia Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda amang’ana ayio onsi agwo Yerusalemu,
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet told all this to Zedekiah king of Judah, in Jerusalem,

ekegusii: Yeremia agatebia Baruku iga: “Inche natangirwe tingenda ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Then Jeremiah told Baruch, "I am restricted; I cannot go to the LORD's temple.

ekegusii: Erio Yeroboamu akaagacha omochie Sekemu ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu, akamenya aroro, naende akarua agwo, akagenda akaagacha Penueli.
english: Then Jeroboam fortified Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. From there he went out and built up Peniel.

ekegusii: Then Jeroboam's wife got up and left and went to Tirzah. As soon as she stepped over the threshold of the house, the boy died.
english: Erio moka Yeroboamu akaimoka, akagenda Tirisa, na ekero agotamboka omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba omwana oria agakwa.

ekegusii: Erio Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, amo nabakuani bamwabo, na Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na abanto bamwabo, bakaimoka koagacha egesasimero kia Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, bamoruere ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase kerokio, buna arikire ase amachiko a Musa, omonto o Nyasae.
english: Then Jeshua son of Jozadak and his fellow priests and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his associates began to build the altar of the God of Israel to sacrifice burnt offerings on it, in accordance with what is written in the Law of Moses the man of God.

ekegusii: Erio Yese akarangeria Aminadabu, akamoetia ase obosio bwa Samweli. Samweli agateba, “Nonya noyo, Omonene tamochoreti.”
english: Then Jesse called Abinadab and had him pass in front of Samuel. But Samuel said, "The LORD has not chosen this one either."

ekegusii: Yeso akamoiraneria, “Inee! Obogima bwao noborue ase engencho yane? Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie: Etuoni tekobuga goika gwankanire ara gatato.
english: Then Jesus answered, "Will you really lay down your life for me? I tell you the truth, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times!

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akamoiraneria, “Aye omong’ina, okwegena kwao nokonene! Tiga abe buna oganetie.” Na ekero ekio enyaroka yaye ekagwenigwa.
english: Then Jesus answered, "Woman, you have great faith! Your request is granted." And her daughter was healed from that very hour.

ekegusii: Yeso akamoboria, “Erieta riao naki okorokwa?” Akairaneria, “Erieta riane n’Elegioni, ekiagera nabange tore.”
english: Then Jesus asked him, "What is your name?" "My name is Legion," he replied, "for we are many."

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Inee! Ekero nabatomete motari nebimoya, ne chisaro, na ebikoroto, imwaremeretwe na gento?” Bakamoiraneria, “Yaya”.
english: Then Jesus asked them, "When I sent you without purse, bag or sandals, did you lack anything?" "Nothing," they answered.

ekegusii: Akababoria, “Mboronge ase rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya, gose gokora amabe, gotooria obogima, gose koboita?” Bagakira.
english: Then Jesus asked them, "Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?" But they remained silent.

ekegusii: Naende akabora, “Oboruoti bwa Nyasae nigo boreng’anirie naki? Ninki nkoboreng’ania?
english: Then Jesus asked, "What is the kingdom of God like? What shall I compare it to?

ekegusii: Erio agachaka gotogonyera emechie eria, aase ebikone biaye ebinge bie chinguru biakorekire, ekiagera etaonchogete:
english: Then Jesus began to denounce the cities in which most of his miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio Yeso akarua Galili, akagenda ase Yohana ase orooche rwa Yorodan abatiswe nere.
english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.

ekegusii: Yeso agacha, akabatebia, “Naeirwe okobua gwonsi igoro na ense.
english: Then Jesus came to them and said, "All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.

ekegusii: Yeso agaaka eriogi akabora, “Oyonyegenire inche, tanyegeneti inche, korende ere oyontomete.
english: Then Jesus cried out, "When a man believes in me, he does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Inche nomogati bw’obogima; ere oyogocha asende takoigwa enchara nonya ng’ake, na ere oyoranyegene takorang’a nonya ng’ake.
english: Then Jesus declared, "I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will never go hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.

ekegusii: Then Jesus declared, "I who speak to you am he."
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Inche, oyo ngokwana naye, nere.”

ekegusii: Akabachika babaikaransie bonsi, ebiombe, ebiombe, ase obonyansi obobese.
english: Then Jesus directed them to have all the people sit down in groups on the green grass.

ekegusii: Then Jesus' disciples said, "Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.
english: Aborokigwa baye bakabora, “Rora, bono ngokwana ore maiso marore, gose tori gokwana omoreng’anio onde bwonsi.

ekegusii: Na omoganda ogasangerereka naende; barabwo abanyene tibanyara nonya nokoria.
english: Then Jesus entered a house, and again a crowd gathered, so that he and his disciples were not even able to eat.

ekegusii: Akarua naende ensemo ya Turo, agaeta gati‐gati ya Sidoni, akagenda goika enyancha ya Galili, egati y’ensemo ya Dekapoli.
english: Then Jesus left the vicinity of Tyre and went through Sidon, down to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.

ekegusii: Then Jesus' mother and brothers arrived. Standing outside, they sent someone in to call him.
english: Ng’ina na bamura bamwabo Yeso bagacha, bagatenena isiko, bagatoma omonto komorangeria.

ekegusii: Akamotebia, “Totebia monto onde ing’ana, korende genda, bweorokie ase omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso ase ogosibeka kwao buna Musa achigete, kebe kirori ase abanto.”
english: Then Jesus ordered him, "Don't tell anyone, but go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them."

ekegusii: Then Jesus replied, "Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!"
english: Yeso akabairaneria, “Inee! Tinabachorete inwe ikomi na babere, na oyomo oino nekerecha?”

ekegusii: Agatebia omokungu oria, “Kwabeirwe ebibe biao.”
english: Then Jesus said to her, "Your sins are forgiven."

ekegusii: Then Jesus said to him, "Get up! Pick up your mat and walk."
english: Yeso akamotebia, “Tenena, etweke egesero kiao, ogende.”

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Rigereria, totebia monto onde ing’ana; korende genda, bweorokie ase omokuani, orue ekeng’wanso egiachigetwe na Musa, erinde kebe kirori ase abanto.”
english: Then Jesus said to him, "See that you don't tell anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the gift Moses commanded, as a testimony to them."

ekegusii: Yeso agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Nekeene nabatebirie: Nabe aakong’u ase omonto omonda gosoa ase oboruoti bwa igoro.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "I tell you the truth, it is hard for a rich man to enter the kingdom of heaven.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Oyorigetie gontunyana, tiga ekaane ere omonyene, etweke omosalaba oye, antunyane.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, "If anyone would come after me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow me.

ekegusii: Agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Ase aya nabatebirie, timochandeka igoro y’obogima bwaino, eki morarie; gose ase emebere yaino, eki morabeke.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples: "Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat; or about your body, what you will wear.

ekegusii: Then Jesus said to his host, "When you give a luncheon or dinner, do not invite your friends, your brothers or relatives, or your rich neighbors; if you do, they may invite you back and so you will be repaid.
english: Agatebia oria omorangeretie, “Kogokora endagera ya mambia gose eya mogoroba, torangeria abasani bao, gose abamino, gose eamate yao, gose abagisangio bao abanda; babaise gokorangeria banyare gokoakana.

ekegusii: Yeso agatebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, “Genda bwoo, nabe asore koreng’ana nokwegena kwao.” Omosomba oria akagwenigwa ase ekero keria.
english: Then Jesus said to the centurion, "Go! It will be done just as you believed it would." And his servant was healed at that very hour.

ekegusii: Yeso agatebia abakuani abanene, na abanene b’abarendi, na abagaaka, baria bamocherete, “Iga mwachire nemeyio ya birende ne chinungu buna mogochiera omouri.
english: Then Jesus said to the chief priests, the officers of the temple guard, and the elders, who had come for him, "Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come with swords and clubs?

ekegusii: Naende Yeso agatebia emeganda na aborokigwa baye,
english: Then Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabatebia, “Timoiroka! Genda motebie abaminto bagende Galili, nao barandore.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, "Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me."

ekegusii: Then Jesus said to them, "Don't you understand this parable? How then will you understand any parable?
english: Akabatebia, “Timomanyeti omoreng’anio oyo? Gaki emereng’anio yonsi naki morayemanye?

ekegusii: Then Jesus said to them, "Give to Caesar what is Caesar's and to God what is God's." And they were amazed at him.
english: Yeso akabatebia, “Ebire bia Kaisari, moe Kaisari, na ebia Nyasae, moe Nyasae.” Bakamokumia mono.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Naki abanto bagoteba ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?
english: Then Jesus said to them, "How is it that they say the Christ is the Son of David?

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Nkobaboria nde ring’ana erimo: Mboronge rituko ri’Esabato gokora amaya gose amabe, gotooria obogima gose kobosiria?”
english: Then Jesus said to them, "I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?"

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere Omonene bw’Esabato.”
english: Then Jesus said to them, "The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Tinagotebia ng’a koregene norore obonene bwa Nyasae?”
english: Then Jesus said, "Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?"

ekegusii: Akabora, “Oyore namato akoigwera tiga aigwe.”
english: Then Jesus said, "He who has ears to hear, let him hear."

ekegusii: Yeso akamotebia, “Iga kwegena ekiagera kwandora; mbasesenirie abatarochi ko begenire.”
english: Then Jesus told him, "Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed."

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia omoreng’anio ng’a nebagwenerete komosaba Nyasae botambe, tibakwa emioyo,
english: Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to show them that they should always pray and not give up.

ekegusii: Then Jesus told them this parable:
english: Erio akabatebia omoreng’anio oyo:

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabatebia, “Ase obotuko bwa rero inwe mwensi inamogochwe na gontiga ase engencho yane; naki narikire: Ning’ake omorisia, ne ching’ondi chie riicho inachiserebekane.
english: Then Jesus told them, "This very night you will all fall away on account of me, for it is written: "'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Omobaso nigo ore amo nainwe egeka egeke bosio. Genda ekero more nomobaso oria, omosunte tocha kobabua; ere oyokogenda ase omosunte ime tamanyeti aase akogenda.
english: Then Jesus told them, "You are going to have the light just a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, before darkness overtakes you. The man who walks in the dark does not know where he is going.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akairwa n’Omoika ase erooro gochia goteemwa na Saitani.
english: Then Jesus was led by the Spirit into the desert to be tempted by the devil.

ekegusii: Akagenda naende ng’umbu ya Yorodan goika aase aria Yohana arenge kobatisera ritang’ani, akabeera aroro.
english: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing in the early days. Here he stayed

ekegusii: Ekero arenge kogenda Yerusalemu, agaeta ase emechie na ebichie okworokereria.
english: Then Jesus went through the towns and villages, teaching as he made his way to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.
english: Yeso agatiira gochia egetuawa, agaikaransa aroro amo naborokigwa baye.

ekegusii: Naende Yeso akagenda nabarabwo goika aase akorokwa Gethisemane, agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa ekero nkogenda aria gosaba.”
english: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to them, "Sit here while I go over there and pray."

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agaaka eriogi riaye ase Hekalu ime, okworokereria, okobora, “Inche momanyete, na aase narure mwaamanyire, naende tinyerenteti inche omonyene, korende ere oyontomete noyo bw’ekeene, oyio motamanyeti inwe.
english: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, "Yes, you know me, and you know where I am from. I am not here on my own, but he who sent me is true. You do not know him,

ekegusii: Erio Yetero akarentera Nyasae ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde bi’okonyenywa. Haroni amo nabagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha bakaragera amo na ise biara Musa, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: Then Jethro, Moses' father-in-law, brought a burnt offering and other sacrifices to God, and Aaron came with all the elders of Israel to eat bread with Moses' father-in-law in the presence of God.

ekegusii: Agwo Yoabu na abanto barenge amo nere bagasuka gochia korwana n’Abasiiria, na barabwo bagatama korwa asare.
english: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.

ekegusii: Agwo Yoabu na abanto barenge amo nere bagasuka bagaika ang’e n’Abasiiria ase okorwana esegi, na Abasiiria baria bagatama korwa asare.
english: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and they fled before him.

ekegusii: Na bono Yoabu akaimoka, akagenda bw’Abisalomu, akamoboria, “Nase ki abasomba bao basambire esairi yane iga?”
english: Then Joab did go to Absalom's house and he said to him, "Why have your servants set my field on fire?"

ekegusii: Yoabu akairana korwa ase okobwatia Abineri; na ekero asangereretie abanto bonsi amo, bakanyora ng’a abasomba ba Daudi ikomi na kianda tibaiyo; boigo Asaeli taiyo.
english: Then Joab returned from pursuing Abner and assembled all his men. Besides Asahel, nineteen of David's men were found missing.

ekegusii: Erio Yoabu agatebia Omoetiopia oyomo, “Genda otebie omoruoti aya kwarora.” Na Omoetiopia oria agekumba inse ase obosio bwa Yoabu, akaminyoka kogenda.
english: Then Joab said to a Cushite, "Go, tell the king what you have seen." The Cushite bowed down before Joab and ran off.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoabu akabugia egetureri ase ogotanga esegi, na abanto bakairana bagatiga kobwatia Abaisraeli.
english: Then Joab sounded the trumpet, and the troops stopped pursuing Israel, for Joab halted them.

ekegusii: Erio Yoabu agacha nyomba ase omoruoti, akamotebia, “Rero aye gwakorire abasomba bao bonsi barorire obosooku, abanto aba konya batooririe obogima bwao, na obw’abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, na obw’abakungu bao, na abakungu bao ba sere‐sere.
english: Then Joab went into the house to the king and said, "Today you have humiliated all your men, who have just saved your life and the lives of your sons and daughters and the lives of your wives and concubines.

ekegusii: Yoabu akaimoka, akagenda Gesuri, akarenta Abisalomu,
english: Then Joab went to Geshur and brought Absalom back to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneria Omonene, agateba:
english: Then Job answered the LORD:

ekegusii: Erio Ayubu akairaneria Omonene, akabora:
english: Then Job replied to the LORD:

ekegusii: Then Job replied:
english: Erio Ayubu akairaneria, agateba:

ekegusii: Then Job replied:
english: Erio Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:

ekegusii: Then Job replied:
english: Bono Ayubu akairaneria, akabora:

ekegusii: Then Job replied:
english: Ayubu akairaneria, akabora,

ekegusii: Ayubu akaba ogoikaransa ase ribu, akaimokia orogio, akana‐kwearera amaote aye.
english: Then Job took a piece of broken pottery and scraped himself with it as he sat among the ashes.

ekegusii: Erio Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, amo nabatang’ani b’abarwani esegi, abarenge amo nere, bakairana korwa Gibeoni abanto abatigari, abarwani esegi, na abakungu, na abana, na abasomba, abwo Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, arusetie Misipa, ekero aitete Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu.
english: Then Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him led away all the survivors from Mizpah whom he had recovered from Ishmael son of Nethaniah after he had assassinated Gedaliah son of Ahikam: the soldiers, women, children and court officials he had brought from Gibeon.

ekegusii: Erio Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, agakwana na Gedalia bobisi agwo Misipa, akamotebia, “Ing’a ribaga ngende ing’ite Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, na omonto onde tari oramanye amang’ana ayio. Nase ki ere aragoite, erinde Abayahudi bonsi bachire asore baserebekane, na abatigari b’Abayuda basire?”
english: Then Johanan son of Kareah said privately to Gedaliah in Mizpah, "Let me go and kill Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and no one will know it. Why should he take your life and cause all the Jews who are gathered around you to be scattered and the remnant of Judah to perish?"

ekegusii: Naende Yohana akaorokia, “Narorire Omoika ogoika korwa igoro buna riruma, okobeera igoro asare.
english: Then John gave this testimony: "I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio aborokigwa ba Yohana bakamochiera, bakamoboria, “Nase ki intwe na Abafarisai tokweng’ata ekero ase ekero, ko aborokigwa bao tibari kweng’ata
english: Then John's disciples came and asked him, "How is it that we and the Pharisees fast, but your disciples do not fast?"

ekegusii: Yonathani akaa omosae oria ebirwanero biaye akamotebia, “Genda, obiire ase omochie.”
english: Then Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and said, "Go, carry them back to town."

ekegusii: na Yonathani akamotebia Daudi. “Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, abe kirori ase aya. Ase chinsa buna echi, ankio gose ankio ende, nindigie komanya ebirengererio bia tata buna bire igoro yao, na kondabimanye, ningotomere amang’ana, erinde obimanye.
english: Then Jonathan said to David: "By the LORD, the God of Israel, I will surely sound out my father by this time the day after tomorrow! If he is favorably disposed toward you, will I not send you word and let you know?

ekegusii: Erio Yonathani agatebia Daudi, “Ankio ne Rituko Rinene ri’Omotienyi Omoyia, na ekiagera togochi‐gocha koba ase omoyega, ekerogo kiao nigo keratigare bosa.
english: Then Jonathan said to David: "Tomorrow is the New Moon festival. You will be missed, because your seat will be empty.

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu akarenta Yakobo ise, akamoira ase obosio bwa Farao; na Yakobo agasesenia Farao.
english: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob in and presented him before Pharaoh. After Jacob blessed Pharaoh,

ekegusii: Agwo Yusufu agasinywa gotanga okweigwa kwaye, ase obosio bw’abanto bonsi abateneine ang’e nere, agaaka eriogi, akabora, “Barusie aa bonsi ase obosio bwane!” Ase igo monto onde tarengeo ase obosio bwa Yusufu ekero emanyekanetie ase abamwabo,
english: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, "Have everyone leave my presence!" So there was no one with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.

ekegusii: Then Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So the physicians embalmed him,
english: Agachika abarwaria abaare komokorera, ng’a baake Israeli ise amariogo, tabaisa kogunda; naboigo abarwaria bamokorerete,

ekegusii: Yusufu akarusia abana korwa ase amagoro a ise, agatung’ama inse.
english: Then Joseph removed them from Israel's knees and bowed down with his face to the ground.

ekegusii: Yusufu agatebia abamwabo na abanto b’enka ya ise, “Nkogenda inde ase Farao imotebie: Abaminto na abanto b’enka ya tata, aba barenge ase ense ya Kanani, bachire asende.
english: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's household, "I will go up and speak to Pharaoh and will say to him, 'My brothers and my father's household, who were living in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agatebia bamura bamwabo, “Inchuo asende ang’e!” Barabwo bakamoika ang’e. Naende akabatebia, “Ninche Yusufu omino, oyo mwaoonetie gocha aa Misiri.
english: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "Come close to me." When they had done so, he said, "I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt!

ekegusii: Yusufu agatebia abamwabo, “Ng’ang’e inde gokwa, korende amaene Nyasae nabanyorere enchera y’okobarusia ase ense eye, abatiirie mogende ase ense eria abarierete eira na gotiana, ng’a nae Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo.”
english: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "I am about to die. But God will surely come to your aid and take you up out of this land to the land he promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob."

ekegusii: Erio Yusufu agatebia Farao, “Chindoto chiao, aye Farao, nigo chire echimo. Nyasae okworokirie, aye Farao, aya agochia gokora iga bwango.
english: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.

ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua Lakisi, bakagenda Egiloni, bakayoetanana na koyoumokera.
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Lachish to Eglon; they took up positions against it and attacked it.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akaimoka amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi korwa Libuna, bakagenda Lakisi, bakayoetanana na koyoumokera.
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Libnah to Lachish; he took up positions against it and attacked it.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoshua amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua Makeda, bakagenda korwania Libuna.
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him moved on from Makkedah to Libnah and attacked it.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana Debiri, akaumokera omochie oyio.
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him turned around and attacked Debir.

ekegusii: Korwa Egiloni Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiira, bagaika Heburoni bayorwanie.
english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron and attacked it.

ekegusii: Yoshua agasangereria ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli agwo Sekemu. Akarangeria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani, na abagambi, amo nabaraai babo, nabarabwo bagacha ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders, leaders, judges and officials of Israel, and they presented themselves before God.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agasesenia Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune, akamoa omochie o Heburoni okaba omwando oye.
english: Then Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh and gave him Hebron as his inheritance.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akabasesenia, akabaa ribaga, na barabwo bakagenda chinka chiabo.
english: Then Joshua blessed them and sent them away, and they went to their homes.

ekegusii: Yoshua akaagachera Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, egesasimero ase egetunwa ki’Ebali.
english: Then Joshua built on Mount Ebal an altar to the LORD, the God of Israel,

ekegusii: Yoshua agakora omorembe na kobwatana nabarabwo, akabaa ribaga babe moyo na komenyao. Abatang’ani b’omoganda bw’Abaisraeli bagancherana nokobwatana okwo ase ogotiana.
english: Then Joshua made a treaty of peace with them to let them live, and the leaders of the assembly ratified it by oath.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana Giligali ase batoorete.
english: Then Joshua returned with all Israel to the camp at Gilgal.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua agatebia Akani, “Omwana one, mosike Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyaorokie erinde ere atogigwe. Ontebie aya gwakorire, toyabisa!”
english: Then Joshua said to Achan, "My son, give glory to the LORD, the God of Israel, and give him the praise. Tell me what you have done; do not hide it from me."

ekegusii: Yoshua akabatebia, “Inwe mwebereire birori ng’a mwachorire Omonene.” Bakairaneria, “Ee, twebereire birori intwe abanyene.”
english: Then Joshua said, "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD." "Yes, we are witnesses," they replied.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akaa abanto ribaga bakagenda kera oyomo ase omwando oye.
english: Then Joshua sent the people away, each to his own inheritance.

ekegusii: Naboigo Yoshua akabatoma, na barabwo bakagenda, bakaboa egati ya Beteli na Ai, bosongo ya Ai. Korende Yoshua agatigara, akabeera amo nabanto obotuko obwo.
english: Then Joshua sent them off, and they went to the place of ambush and lay in wait between Bethel and Ai, to the west of Ai-- but Joshua spent that night with the people.

ekegusii: Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni agatoma abanto babere korwa Sitimu bobisi, bachie koroota, akabatebia, “Genda, moroote ense eria, na mono omochie o Yeriko.” Bakagenda aroro, bagasoa enyomba y’omokungu omotayayi ore korokwa Rahabu, bakarara aroro.
english: Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim. "Go, look over the land," he said, "especially Jericho." So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Yoshua agaita abaruoti baria, akabatonga ase emete etano; agwo bagasung’unana goika mogoroba.
english: Then Joshua struck and killed the kings and hung them on five trees, and they were left hanging on the trees until evening.

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akarangeria abanto baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwatong’ainete na goteba ng’a nigo mokamenyete ense y’aare, na inwe nabanto momenyete ang’e aa ase egati yaito?
english: Then Joshua summoned the Gibeonites and said, "Why did you deceive us by saying, 'We live a long way from you,' while actually you live near us?

ekegusii: Erio Yoshua akarangeria abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase,
english: Then Joshua summoned the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh

ekegusii: Yoshua amo nabagaaka b’Abaisraeli bagatandora chianga chiabo, bakagwa maumama bosio bw’Esanduku y’Omonene, bakarara agwo goika mogoroba, bagesiarera ebuse emetwe yabo
english: Then Joshua tore his clothes and fell facedown to the ground before the ark of the LORD, remaining there till evening. The elders of Israel did the same, and sprinkled dust on their heads.

ekegusii: Yoshua na Abaisraeli bonsi bakaira Akani, mosinto o Zera, amo ne chifeta chiria, na egetambaa keria gi’okwambara, na ebao eria y’etahabu, goika ebate ekorokwa Akori. Bakaira na abana baye, abamura na abaiseke, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, ne ching’ondi chiaye, na eema amo nebinto binde bionsi ebi abwate.
english: Then Joshua, together with all Israel, took Achan son of Zerah, the silver, the robe, the gold wedge, his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys and sheep, his tent and all that he had, to the Valley of Achor.

ekegusii: Ekero Yosia aonchogete, akarora chimbeera chiarenge ase ekegoro igoro, agatoma abanto bakarenta amauga korwa ase chimbeera chiria ime, erio akayasambera ase egesasimero, na ekio gekaba egetachenegeti, koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene riararetigwe nomonto o Nyasae, oria obanete igoro ase ebinto ebio.
english: Then Josiah looked around, and when he saw the tombs that were there on the hillside, he had the bones removed from them and burned on the altar to defile it, in accordance with the word of the LORD proclaimed by the man of God who foretold these things.

ekegusii: Then Jotham fled, escaping to Beer, and he lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelech.
english: Erio Yotamu akaminyoka, agatama gochia Beeri, akamenya agwo, ekiagera airogete Abimeleki momura omwabo.

ekegusii: Yuda agatebia Israeli ise, “Mong’e omosae oyo agende amo nainche, erio toimoke togende aroro, erinde egere tobe moyo, titokwa, intwe, naye, amo nabana baito abake.
english: Then Judah said to Israel his father, "Send the boy along with me and we will go at once, so that we and you and our children may live and not die.

ekegusii: Then Judah said to Onan, "Lie with your brother's wife and fulfill your duty to her as a brother-in-law to produce offspring for your brother."
english: Erio Yuda agatebia Onani, “Motware moka momura omino, erinde omotenenerie egesaku.”

ekegusii: Yuda akabora, “Tiga atware ebinto ebio namoete bibe intenenera, titobaisa gocha kororekana nobosooku. Rora, namotomerete emanwa egoree, na aye tikwamonyorete.”
english: Then Judah said, "Let her keep what she has, or we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you didn't find her."

ekegusii: Erio Yuda akamoika ang’e, akamotebia, “Koranche, omonene one, ong’e inche, omosomba oo, ribaga ngotebie ring’ana erimo. Tobaisa kombea inche, omosomba oo, naki aye nigo ore buna Farao.
english: Then Judah went up to him and said: "Please, my lord, let your servant speak a word to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, though you are equal to Pharaoh himself.

ekegusii: Yudas (tari oria o Iskariota) akamoboria, “Omonene, naki yaba ng’a norigetie kweorokia asetore, gose tari ase ense?”
english: Then Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said, "But, Lord, why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?"

ekegusii: Yudas Iskariota, ere noyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, akagenda ase abakuani abanene, anyare komorua asebare.
english: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.

ekegusii: Yudas, nere oyokomorua, akamoboria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche? Akamoiraneria: Naboigo. Aye gwatebire.”
english: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, "Surely not I, Rabbi?" Jesus answered, "Yes, it is you."

ekegusii: Ahasi omoruoti akagenda Damesiki koumerana na Tigilati‐Pileseri, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, na ekero aroche egesasimero kiarenge aroro, agatoma omogwekano bw’egesasimero keria ase Uria omokuani, akaorokia boronge kegima buna kiaroisetigwe.
english: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria. He saw an altar in Damascus and sent to Uriah the priest a sketch of the altar, with detailed plans for its construction.

ekegusii: Erio Asa omoruoti akaira Abayuda bonsi, na barabwo bakagenda bakabogoria amagena onsi a Rama, ne chibao, ebinto biria Baasa arenge koagachera, na ase ebio Asa akaagachera Geba na Misipa.
english: Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah, and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using. With them he built up Geba and Mizpah.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Asa akarua okoraria ase Abayuda bonsi, nonya nomonnto oyomo tatigetwe otakonye koira amagena a Rama, amo ne chibao chiarengeo, ebinto ebio bionsi Baasa arenge kogitera omochie oria; na ase ebinto ebio omoruoti Asa akagitera Geba ase orogongo rwa Benjamin amo na Misipa.
english: Then King Asa issued an order to all Judah-- no one was exempt-- and they carried away from Ramah the stones and timber Baasha had been using there. With them King Asa built up Geba in Benjamin, and also Mizpah.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Dario omoruoti akarika amang’ana, akayatoma ase abanto bonsi, na ebisaku, na abanto b’emenwa ao ao, bamenyete ase ense yonsi, akabatebia: “Omorembe omentekane asemore:
english: Then King Darius wrote to all the peoples, nations and men of every language throughout the land: "May you prosper greatly!

ekegusii: Daudi omoruoti agakwana nomosangererekano bwonsi, agateba, “Sulemani, omwana one, oyo Nyasae achorire, nomoke, taramanya amange, na emeremo eye nigo ere emenene. Enyomba eye y’obonene tekoba ase mwanyabanto, korende nase Omonene Nyasae.
english: Then King David said to the whole assembly: "My son Solomon, the one whom God has chosen, is young and inexperienced. The task is great, because this palatial structure is not for man but for the LORD God.
