ekegusii: Omoruoti Daudi akairaneria, “Rangeria Batiseba achiche asende.” Ase ayio Batiseba agacha ase obosio bw’omoruoti, agatenenao.
english: Then King David said, "Call in Bathsheba." So she came into the king's presence and stood before him.

ekegusii: Erio Daudi omoruoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabora, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, inche ninki ing’isaine, na eamate yane ninki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?
english: Then King David went in and sat before the LORD, and he said: "Who am I, O LORD God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

ekegusii: Erio Daudi omoruoti agasoa akabeera ase obosio bw’Omonene, akabora, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, inche inki ng’isaine, na eamate yane inki eisaine, ng’a aye gwankoreire amang’ana amaya iga?
english: Then King David went in and sat before the LORD, and he said: "Who am I, O Sovereign LORD, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

ekegusii: Erio Nebukadinesaro omoruoti agatung’ama inse akaumama, akaorokia amasikani ase Danieli, agachika ng’a ekeng’wanso na ubani biruegwe ase Danieli.
english: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell prostrate before Daniel and paid him honor and ordered that an offering and incense be presented to him.

ekegusii: Erio Nebukadinesaro omoruoti agakumia na goichana, agatenena ase obwango, akaboria abasemia baye, “Inee! Titwarutete abanto batato boka ase omorero basibire?” Bakamoiraneria, “Ee, aye omoruoti, ayio namaene.”
english: Then King Nebuchadnezzar leaped to his feet in amazement and asked his advisers, "Weren't there three men that we tied up and threw into the fire?" They replied, "Certainly, O king."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Rehoboamu akaboria ogosemia korwa ase abagaaka baria barenge gosemia Sulemani ise, ekero arenge moyo, akababoria, “Ngosemia ki mokong’a, erinde imbairanerie abanto aba?”
english: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "How would you advise me to answer these people?" he asked.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Rehoboamu akaboria ogosemigwa korwa ase abagaaka baria barenge gosemia Sulemani ise, ekero arenge moyo, akababoria, “Ngosemia ki morang’e erinde ing’iranerie abanto aba?”
english: Then King Rehoboam consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon during his lifetime. "How would you advise me to answer these people?" he asked.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Sulemani agatoma abanto nabarabwo bakamorusia agwo ase egesasimero, bakamorenta. Ere agacha agatung’ama, akaumama ase okoorokia amasikani ase omoruoti Sulemani, na Sulemani akamotebia, “Genda nka bwoo.”
english: Then King Solomon sent men, and they brought him down from the altar. And Adonijah came and bowed down to King Solomon, and Solomon said, "Go to your home."

ekegusii: Sulemani agasangereria amo abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani bonsi b’ebisaku biabo, na baria qarenge abaraai be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bache ase obosio bwaye agwo Yerusalemu, erinde bagende Sayoni, Omochie o Daudi, kwoyia Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene.
english: Then King Solomon summoned into his presence at Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the LORD's covenant from Zion, the City of David.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti Sulemani agatiana ase Omonene, agateba, “Nyasae ang’e egesusuro ekenene onye ring’ana eri riaye aboririe tirigochia kogera asirie obogima bwaye.
english: Then King Solomon swore by the LORD: "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if Adonijah does not pay with his life for this request!

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Zedekia omoruoti agatoma abanto barente Yeremia asare, na aroro ase enyomba yaye akamoboria bobisi, “Inee! Ing’ana rinde ndire rikorwa ase Omonene?” Yeremia akamoiraneria, akamotebia, “Ee, ndireo.” Erio akamotebia, “Aye nobekwe ase okoboko kw’omoruoti o Babeli.”
english: Then King Zedekiah sent for him and had him brought to the palace, where he asked him privately, "Is there any word from the LORD?" "Yes," Jeremiah replied, "you will be handed over to the king of Babylon."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Zedekia omoruoti agatoma abanto ase Yeremia omobani bakamorenta asare agwo ase egesoero kia gatato ki’Enyomba y’Omonene. Erio omoruoti agakwana na Yeremia, akamotebia, “Ngokoboria inde ring’ana; tobaisa kombisa gento kende gionsi.”
english: Then King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah the prophet and had him brought to the third entrance to the temple of the LORD. "I am going to ask you something," the king said to Jeremiah. "Do not hide anything from me."

ekegusii: Komoranyigwere igo, rirorio abaruoti abarache goikaransa ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi nabasoere ase ebiita bi’omochie oyo. Abaruoti abwo amo nabanene b’oboruoti obwo, na abanto ba Yuda, na aba Yerusalemu, nababe bakoriina ne chibarasi, na abanto nabagenderere komenya ase omochie oyo botambe.
english: then kings who sit on David's throne will come through the gates of this city with their officials. They and their officials will come riding in chariots and on horses, accompanied by the men of Judah and those living in Jerusalem, and this city will be inhabited forever.

ekegusii: rirorio momanye ng’a Nyasae orentire amabe aya asende, na ontegire noboreba bwaye.
english: then know that God has wronged me and drawn his net around me.

ekegusii: manya inwe mwensi na Abaisraeli bonsi ng’a erieta ria Yeso Kristo o Nazareti, ere inwe mwabambete, na Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakure, erieta erio riagwenirie omonto oyo kegima, oteneine bosio bwaino.
english: then know this, you and all the people of Israel: It is by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead, that this man stands before you healed.

ekegusii: Erio Labani akamotebia, “Amaene, aye namanyinga ’omobere one.” Ere akamenya bwoye ase engaki y’omotienyi oyomo.
english: Then Laban said to him, "You are my own flesh and blood." After Jacob had stayed with him for a whole month,

ekegusii: Labani akaboria Yakobo, “Inki eke gwakorire iga, okweiberia na koira abana baane abasubati buna abasakorwa korwa ase esegi?
english: Then Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done? You've deceived me, and you've carried off my daughters like captives in war.

ekegusii: Oyogitere orwaki rw’okoyoboera ase chinsemo chionsi, na oyoetananie neburi boigo, naende oyobekere ebitwori bi’abarwani esegi, na otenenie ebikorero bi’ogotagorera ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: Then lay siege to it: Erect siege works against it, build a ramp up to it, set up camps against it and put battering rams around it.

ekegusii: Erio Lea akabora, “Nyasae ong’eire ekeegwa ekiya; bono omosacha one nansike, ekiagera namoiboreire abana abaisia batano nomo.” Ase igo akamoroka Sabuloni.
english: Then Leah said, "God has presented me with a precious gift. This time my husband will treat me with honor, because I have borne him six sons." So she named him Zebulun.

ekegusii: Lea akabora, “Nyasae ong’eire eng’eria yane, ekiagera naete omosacha one omosomba one omoiseke.” Ase igo akaroka omwana oria Isakaru.
english: Then Leah said, "God has rewarded me for giving my maidservant to my husband." So she named him Issachar.

ekegusii: Lea akabora, “Inche ninde nomogoko omonene, naki abakungu nabandoke Oyore nomogoko.” Ase igo akamoroka Aseri.
english: Then Leah said, "How happy I am! The women will call me happy." So she named him Asher.

ekegusii: Then Leah said, "What good fortune!" So she named him Gad.
english: Lea akabora, “Ninde negesio.” Akamoroka Gadi.

ekegusii: rirorio tiga amagwa amereo ribaga ri’engano, na amabanchore ribaga ri’esairi.” Amang’ana ’Ayubu aereire aa.
english: then let briers come up instead of wheat and weeds instead of barley." The words of Job are ended.

ekegusii: rirorio tiga amareko aane ongoke agwe inse, ne chinengo chi’amaboko aane chinsomoke.
english: then let my arm fall from the shoulder, let it be broken off at the joint.

ekegusii: rirorio tiga omobisa one ambwatie na kombwata, erio antiringere inse asirie obogima bwane, ansarerie amasikani.
english: then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let him trample my life to the ground and make me sleep in the dust. Selah

ekegusii: Omoiseke oria orakogokie aye omoruoti, otige abe eting’ana ribaga ria Vasti.” Ogosemia okwo gokagwenera omoruoti, ere agakora buna asemetigwe.
english: Then let the girl who pleases the king be queen instead of Vashti." This advice appealed to the king, and he followed it.

ekegusii: Omotang’ani oyomo omonene, ore gokorera omoruoti, aegwe eanga eyio na ebarasi eyio. Erio abekere omonto oyio omoruoti anchete gosika eanga eyio, na amoriinie ase ebarasi eyio, amoetananie ase ekerario ki’omochie, okoraria bosio bwaye amang’ana ayio: Omonto oyio omoruoti anchete gosika nigo arakorerwe buna iga.”
english: Then let the robe and horse be entrusted to one of the king's most noble princes. Let them robe the man the king delights to honor, and lead him on the horse through the city streets, proclaiming before him, 'This is what is done for the man the king delights to honor!'"

ekegusii: Erio abare Boyahudi tiga batame gochia ase ebitunwa, na abare ime ase omochie basoke isiko, na abare isiko tibasoa aroro,
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country not enter the city.

ekegusii: erio abare Boyahudi batame gochia ase ebitunwa.
english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

ekegusii: Nere Lawi akamokorera omoyega omonene nyomba mwaye, naende mbarengeo omoganda bw’abarusia ebango na abanto bande baikaransete amo nabarabwo ase endagera.
english: Then Levi held a great banquet for Jesus at his house, and a large crowd of tax collectors and others were eating with them.

ekegusii: Erio abana abake bakarentwa asare, erinde ababekere amaboko aye na kobasabera. Aborokigwa baye bagatanga abanto,
english: Then little children were brought to Jesus for him to place his hands on them and pray for them. But the disciples rebuked those who brought them.

ekegusii: Erio abaiseke abekungi mbatenge na bagoke, abanto abake na abagotu nababe nomogoko. Ning’onchore ebirero biabo bibe omogoko. Nimbaremie, mbae omosasoko ribaga ri’omoichano.
english: Then maidens will dance and be glad, young men and old as well. I will turn their mourning into gladness; I will give them comfort and joy instead of sorrow.

ekegusii: Oture ebigobanio emerongo etano bi’etaai ase ebioro biria, obwatanerie amarondia ayio abere abe eema eyemo engima.
english: Then make fifty bronze clasps and put them in the loops to fasten the tent together as a unit.

ekegusii: Oture ebigobanio bie chitahabu emerongo etano, obwateranie amarondia ayio abere amo, ebe eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.
english: Then make fifty gold clasps and use them to fasten the curtains together so that the tabernacle is a unit.

ekegusii: ikerania omogoko one ase okoba nokorengereria okwo okwo na obwanchani obomo; mobe nomoyo oyomo, na okorengereria okomo.
english: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being one in spirit and purpose.

ekegusii: Then make poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
english: Obaache emiaro ebere y’emekonge, oyeoome netahabu.

ekegusii: Mwanyabanto nigo bakogenda ase emeremo yabo, bayekora goika mogoroba.
english: Then man goes out to his work, to his labor until evening.

ekegusii: Manoa akabora, “Totebie buna okorokwa, erinde torue amasikani asore, ekero amang’ana ao araikerane!”
english: Then Manoah inquired of the angel of the LORD, "What is your name, so that we may honor you when your word comes true?"

ekegusii: Erio Manoa agasaba Omonene, agateba, “Omonene, nagosabire, tiga omonto oria o Nyasae gwatoma atochere naende, erinde atworokererie aya togwenerete gokora ase omwana oria omomura oraiborwe.”
english: Then Manoah prayed to the LORD: "O Lord, I beg you, let the man of God you sent to us come again to teach us how to bring up the boy who is to be born."

ekegusii: Erio Manoa akaimokia emanwa y’embori amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera, akabibeka ase egetare, akabirua ase Omonene, oyokorete ogokumia ekero Manoa na mokaye barigereretie.
english: Then Manoah took a young goat, together with the grain offering, and sacrificed it on a rock to the LORD. And the LORD did an amazing thing while Manoah and his wife watched:

ekegusii: Erio Mariamu akabogoria ekerengo ki’eratili eyemo y’amanukato e rigori rinene, agaaka Yeso amagoro, akayatinyia netukia yaye; enyomba egaichora rimisu ri’amaguta aria.
english: Then Mary took about a pint of pure nard, an expensive perfume; she poured it on Jesus' feet and wiped his feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.

ekegusii: rirorio tiga omokungu one abe ogosera omonto omoao obosie, naende abasacha bande babe bakoba nere.
english: then may my wife grind another man's grain, and may other men sleep with her.

ekegusii: rirorio inche nsimeke endagera, na omonto omoao ayeire, na kende gionsi kiane keramere gesimorwe.”
english: then may others eat what I have sown, and may my crops be uprooted.

ekegusii: Erio Melkizedeki, omoruoti o Salemu, akarenta omogati na edivai; ere nigo arenge omokuani o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono.
english: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High,

ekegusii: Erio Memukani agatebia omoruoti na abanene bonsi, “Vasti eting’ana tari ng’a nomoruoti bweka amocheire, korende omocheire abanene bonsi, na abanto bonsi bare ase chingongo chionsi echio aye omoruoti Ahaswero okogambera.
english: Then Memucan replied in the presence of the king and the nobles, "Queen Vashti has done wrong, not only against the king but also against all the nobles and the peoples of all the provinces of King Xerxes.

ekegusii: Erio abanto batebe, “Ekeene, abanyaboronge nigo bakonyora eng’eria yabo; ekeene, Nyasae nareo okonacha ebina ase ense.”
english: Then men will say, "Surely the righteous still are rewarded; surely there is a God who judges the earth."

ekegusii: Erio Menahemu, mosinto o Gadi, akarua Tirisa, akagenda Samaria, agaita Salumu, mosinto o Yabesi, agwo Samaria, naende akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Then Menahem son of Gadi went from Tirzah up to Samaria. He attacked Shallum son of Jabesh in Samaria, assassinated him and succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Mika agaatanana omosae oria, nere akaba omokuani oye, akamenya ase enyomba ya Mika.
english: Then Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest and lived in his house.

ekegusii: Mika akamotebia, “Menya aa amo nainche, obe asende tata, na obe omokuani one, na inche nkoe chisekeli chie chifeta ikomi kera omwaka, naende nkoe chianga amo nendagera.”
english: Then Micah said to him, "Live with me and be my father and priest, and I'll give you ten shekels of silver a year, your clothes and your food."

ekegusii: Mikaya akairaneria, “Narora Abaisraeli bonsi besiarerete igoro y’ebitunwa buna ching’ondi chitabwati omorisia, na Omonene agantebia: Aba tibabwati omoraai obo, tiga kera oyomo airane, agende nka bwoye ore nomorembe.”
english: Then Micaiah answered, "I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the LORD said, 'These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.'"

ekegusii: Mikaya akairaneria, “Naroche Abaisraeli bonsi besiarerete igoro y’ebigoro buna ching’ondi chitabwati omorisia, na Omonene agantebia: Abanto aba tibabwati omoraai obo, tiga kera oyomo airane agende nka ore nomorembe!”
english: Then Micaiah answered, "I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd, and the LORD said, 'These people have no master. Let each one go home in peace.'"

ekegusii: Mikali akaimokia omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa orenge nyomba ime, akaywareria borere, akabeka amanya e chimbori asisire ase omotwe bw’omogwekano oria, erio akayobisia egetambaa.
english: Then Michal took an idol and laid it on the bed, covering it with a garment and putting some goats' hair at the head.

ekegusii: Na Miriamu omobani, omoiseke omwabo Haroni, akaimokia ekebangarara kiaye, na abakungu bonsi bakamobwatia bakobugia ebibangarara biabo na gotenga.
english: Then Miriam the prophetess, Aaron's sister, took a tambourine in her hand, and all the women followed her, with tambourines and dancing.

ekegusii: Na abanto ba Moabu nabarore obosooku ase enyasae eria Kemosi, buna Abaisraeli baroche obosooku ase enyasae ya Beteli oyio basemeretie.
english: Then Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed when they trusted in Bethel.

ekegusii: Musa na Haroni bagatung’ama inse bakaumama ase amasio ’omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli osangererekanete.
english: Then Moses and Aaron fell facedown in front of the whole Israelite assembly gathered there.

ekegusii: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the Tent of Meeting,
english: Musa na Haroni bagacha bosio bw’Eema eria.

ekegusii: Ase igo Musa na Haroni bakarentwa naende ase Farao. Ere akabatebia, “Genda, mokorere Omonene, Nyasae oino. Korende ning’o nang’o moganetie mogende komo?”
english: Then Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh. "Go, worship the LORD your God," he said. "But just who will be going?"

ekegusii: Erio Musa na abagaaka b’Abaisraeli bakairana ase egetwori.
english: Then Moses and the elders of Israel returned to the camp.

ekegusii: Erio Musa na Abaisraeli bakamoterera Omonene ogotera oko, bagoteba: “Nimoterere Omonene, ekiagera ere obuire ase okobua okonene; chibarasi amo nabachiriinete obarimeirie ase enyancha ime.”
english: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: "I will sing to the LORD, for he is highly exalted. The horse and its rider he has hurled into the sea.

ekegusii: Musa na abakuani Abalawi bagakwana n’Abaisraeli bonsi, bakabatebia, “Inwe Abaisraeli, tegerera, moigwe! Rituko ria rero inwe mwabeire abanto b’Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: Then Moses and the priests, who are Levites, said to all Israel, "Be silent, O Israel, and listen! You have now become the people of the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Musa akagechigwa mono, agatebia Omonene, “Tobaisa gwanchera ebing’wanso biabo. Inche tindaira nonya netigere yabo eyemo, gose tindakorera nonya noyomo obo bobe.”
english: Then Moses became very angry and said to the LORD, "Do not accept their offering. I have not taken so much as a donkey from them, nor have I wronged any of them."

ekegusii: Musa akarenta Haroni na abamura baye, akabasibia namache.
english: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward and washed them with water.

ekegusii: Erio Musa agasokia isiko chinyimbo chiria chionsi korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, agachirenta ase Abaisraeli bonsi. Abwo bagachirigereria, na kera omonto akabogoria enyimbo yaye.
english: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the LORD's presence to all the Israelites. They looked at them, and each man took his own staff.

ekegusii: Musa akarua emieya ya Moabu, agatiira gochia ase egetunwa kia Nebo igoro ase egechuria gia Pisiga, kororia Yeriko. Omonene akamworokia ense eria yonsi, ense ya Gileadi goika orogongo rwa Dani,
english: Then Moses climbed Mount Nebo from the plains of Moab to the top of Pisgah, across from Jericho. There the LORD showed him the whole land-- from Gilead to Dan,

ekegusii: Musa akabachika akabatebia, “Ase omoerio o kera omwaka o gatano na kabere, ase engaki echikire y’omwaka bw’obosibore, ase Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu,
english: Then Moses commanded them: "At the end of every seven years, in the year for canceling debts, during the Feast of Tabernacles,

ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, akabora, “Ninki ngokorera abanto aba? Barabwo nigo bare ang’e kong’aka amagena.”
english: Then Moses cried out to the LORD, "What am I to do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me."

ekegusii: Musa akarera ase Omonene, na Omonene akamworokia omote. Omote oyio Musa akayoruta amache ime, na amache aria akaba amaansu. Agwo Omonene akabekera abanto amachiko akobaraa, na agwo akaba okobateema.
english: Then Moses cried out to the LORD, and the LORD showed him a piece of wood. He threw it into the water, and the water became sweet. There the LORD made a decree and a law for them, and there he tested them.

ekegusii: Musa agasoa riire ime, agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, akabeera aroro ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko.
english: Then Moses entered the cloud as he went on up the mountain. And he stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akarareria abanto bonsi b’egetwori, akabachika, “Onde tabaisa korenta ebiegwa binde goetania ebi konya biasangererigwe ase Obomenyo Obochenu, abe omosacha gose omokungu.” Ase igo abanto bagatiga korenta ebiegwa binde.
english: Then Moses gave an order and they sent this word throughout the camp: "No man or woman is to make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary." And so the people were restrained from bringing more,

ekegusii: Igoro y’amang’ana ’abanto abwo, Musa agachika Eleazari omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na abaraai be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli,
english: Then Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun and to the family heads of the Israelite tribes.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Musa akaa abanto b’egesaku kia Gadi, na ab’ekia Reuben, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase, mosinto o Yusufu, orogongo rwa Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, na orw’Ogi, omoruoti o Basani. Amo nechio akabaa emechie y’ense eria amo ne chinse chiaetanaineo.
english: Then Moses gave to the Gadites, the Reubenites and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan-- the whole land with its cities and the territory around them.

ekegusii: Musa agatang’ana Abaisraeli kogenda orogendo korwa ase Enyancha Embariri gochia erooro ya Suri. Ase engaki y’amatuko atato bagataara ase erooro, tibanyora amache.
english: Then Moses led Israel from the Red Sea and they went into the Desert of Shur. For three days they traveled in the desert without finding water.

ekegusii: Erio Musa agatang’ana abanto korwa ase egetwori bachie koumerana na Nyasae. Barabwo bagatenena ase egetunwa mbarabare.
english: Then Moses led the people out of the camp to meet with God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.

ekegusii: Erio Musa akarua o Farao, agasaba Omonene.
english: Then Moses left Pharaoh and prayed to the LORD,

ekegusii: Musa akarua o Farao, na ase omochie, akaimokia amaboko aye, agasaba Omonene. Erio chinkoba chiria na embura y’amagena bigatangwa, na embura tiyagenderera gotwa ase ense.
english: Then Moses left Pharaoh and went out of the city. He spread out his hands toward the LORD; the thunder and hail stopped, and the rain no longer poured down on the land.

ekegusii: Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye, agaaka egetare keria nenyimbo yaye ara kabere. Amache agasoka amange mono, na omoganda oria okanywane chitugo chiabo chikanywa boigo.
english: Then Moses raised his arm and struck the rock twice with his staff. Water gushed out, and the community and their livestock drank.

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Haroni amo n’Eleazari na Itamari, abamura ba Haroni, “Timobaisa gotiga chitukia chiaino chitachanoiri, gose timobaisa gotandora chianga chiaino ase okobaichanera. Moise gokora igo, goika mokwe, na endamwamu entindi y’Omonene echiche igoro y’omoganda bwonsi. Korende Abaisraeli bamino bonsi barabwo mbabe bakorera ase engencho y’ogosamba ogotindi Omonene arentire.
english: Then Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not let your hair become unkempt, and do not tear your clothes, or you will die and the LORD will be angry with the whole community. But your relatives, all the house of Israel, may mourn for those the LORD has destroyed by fire.

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Haroni, “Imokia orogio rwao rw’ogosambera ubani rusia omorero ase egesasimero oyobeke igoro yaye, erio obeke ubani igoro ase omorero oyio, oroimokie ogende bwango ase omoganda bw’abanto, erinde okore okobwatanigwa asebare, ekiagera Omonene obeire nendamwamu: amaakwa achakire goita abanto.”
english: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Take your censer and put incense in it, along with fire from the altar, and hurry to the assembly to make atonement for them. Wrath has come out from the LORD; the plague has started."

ekegusii: Musa akamoiraneria, “Onye aye omonyene tokogenda amo naintwe, rirorio totige, tobeere aa.
english: Then Moses said to him, "If your Presence does not go with us, do not send us up from here.

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Abaisraeli, “Rora, Omonene ochorire Besaleli, oyore mosinto o Uri, mochokoro o Huri bw’egesaku kia Yuda.
english: Then Moses said to the Israelites, "See, the LORD has chosen Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah,

ekegusii: Erio Musa agatebia abanto, “Mobe mokoinyora rituko eri mwang’anyete korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense eyio mwarenge abasomba, ekiagera Omonene abang’anyetie korwa agwo nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru. Omogati obekire ememera toriegwa.
english: Then Moses said to the people, "Commemorate this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery, because the LORD brought you out of it with a mighty hand. Eat nothing containing yeast.

ekegusii: Musa akabairaneria, agateba, “Onye mogochia gokora bo, rirorio bogoria ebirwanero biaino bi’esegi ase obosio bw’Omonene, erio mogende korwana esegi.
english: Then Moses said to them, "If you will do this-- if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,

ekegusii: Musa akabatebia, “Monto onde tatigaria endagera ende goika mambia.”
english: Then Moses said to them, "No one is to keep any of it until morning."

ekegusii: Musa akamosaba, “Koranche, onyorokie obonene bwao!”
english: Then Moses said, "Now show me your glory."

ekegusii: Musa agatebia abanto, “Ase aya namomanye ng’a Omonene ontomire gokora aya onsi, naende ng’a tari inche omonyene nebegete gokora buna inyanchete.
english: Then Moses said, "This is how you will know that the LORD has sent me to do all these things and that it was not my idea:

ekegusii: Erio Musa agateba, “Eke nakio Omonene abachigete mokore, erio obonene bw’Omonene mbobaorokere.”
english: Then Moses said, "This is what the LORD has commanded you to do, so that the glory of the LORD may appear to you."

ekegusii: Musa akabatebia. “Rero inwe mweatananire ase ogokorera Omonene, ekiagera timwarengereretie abana baino gose abamino; ase igo Omonene obasesenirie rero.”
english: Then Moses said, "You have been set apart to the LORD today, for you were against your own sons and brothers, and he has blessed you this day."

ekegusii: Erio Musa agakooba ise biara, akamotiga okogenda ase ense yaye.
english: Then Moses sent his father-in-law on his way, and Jethro returned to his own country.

ekegusii: Then Moses set aside three cities east of the Jordan,
english: Erio Musa agachora emechie etato agwo moocha ya Yorodan.

ekegusii: Then Moses set out with Joshua his aide, and Moses went up on the mountain of God.
english: Musa akaimoka amo nomosomba oye Yoshua, agatiira gochia egetunwa kia Nyasae.

ekegusii: Then Moses set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and altar and put up the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard. And so Moses finished the work.
english: Agatenenia orosenge rw’eraaro roetanane Obomenyo na egesasimero, na agasunga ebitambaa bi’egesoero ki’eraaro. Naboigo Musa agakoora emeremo eyio yonsi.

ekegusii: Emingichi eyio ekanyenywa, na Musa agasiara amanyinga ’emingichi eyio ase egesasimero chinsemo chionsi.
english: Then Moses slaughtered the ram and sprinkled the blood against the altar on all sides.

ekegusii: Nabo Musa agatebia Abaisraeli, na barabwo bagasokia isiko y’egetwori omonto oria oragereretie, bakamoaka amagena, bakamoita. Naboigo Abaisraeli bagakora buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: Then Moses spoke to the Israelites, and they took the blasphemer outside the camp and stoned him. The Israelites did as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Erio Musa akarambora okoboko kwaye igoro y’enyancha; na Omonene agasukia enyancha gochia nyuma ne chinguru chi’omwaga okorwa moocha okagusa obotuko obogima. Naboigo agakora enyancha koba ense enkamoku. Amache agaatananeka,
english: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove the sea back with a strong east wind and turned it into dry land. The waters were divided,

ekegusii: Musa akarangeria abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Genda mochore chimanwa echirabaisane abanto ba kera enyomba, mochinyenye chibe chimanwa chi’epasaka.
english: Then Moses summoned all the elders of Israel and said to them, "Go at once and select the animals for your families and slaughter the Passover lamb.

ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Besaleli amo na Oholiabu na abaroisia bande bonsi, aba Omonene aeire obong’aini, abare nogwancha, bache, bachake emeremo eria.
english: Then Moses summoned Bezalel and Oholiab and every skilled person to whom the LORD had given ability and who was willing to come and do the work.

ekegusii: Then Moses summoned Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab. But they said, "We will not come!
english: Erio Musa akarangeria Datani na Abiiramu, basinto b’Eliabu. Barabwo bakairaneria, “Intwe titogocha.

ekegusii: Erio Musa akarangeria Yoshua, agakwana nere agwo ase Abaisraeli bonsi baigwete, akamotebia, “Otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu, ekiagera naye oratang’ane abanto aba gochia ase ense eria Omonene arierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nabayee. Naye orabaatananere ense eria ebe omwando obo.
english: Then Moses summoned Joshua and said to him in the presence of all Israel, "Be strong and courageous, for you must go with this people into the land that the LORD swore to their forefathers to give them, and you must divide it among them as their inheritance.

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Haroni amang’ana onsi Omonene amotebetie, na igoro y’ebikone bionsi amochigete akore.
english: Then Moses told Aaron everything the LORD had sent him to say, and also about all the miraculous signs he had commanded him to perform.

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Haroni, “Batebie omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli basuke gocha ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera oigure okwemurungania kwabo.”
english: Then Moses told Aaron, "Say to the entire Israelite community, 'Come before the LORD, for he has heard your grumbling.'"

ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amaguta akweakwa amo namanyinga arenge igoro ase egesasimero, akanyororokeria Haroni amo ne chianga chiaye, akanyororokeria na abamura ba Haroni amo ne chianga chiabo. Naboigo agaatanana Haroni na abamura baye amo ne chianga chiabo ase emeremo emechenu.
english: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood from the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments and on his sons and their garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments and his sons and their garments.

ekegusii: Musa akaimokia amaguta akweakwa, agaaka Obomenyo Obochenu, na kera egento kiarenge imeo, akabiatanana bikaba ebichenu.
english: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it, and so consecrated them.

ekegusii: Naende Musa akabirusia korwa ase amaboko abo, akabisambera ase egesasimero amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, bibe ekeng’wanso gi’okobaatanana. Eke nekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, kere ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera.
english: Then Moses took them from their hands and burned them on the altar on top of the burnt offering as an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Musa akairana gochia ase Yetero, ise biara, akamotebia, “Koranche, ong’e ribaga ng’irane Misiri korora abaminto gose moyo bare.” Yetero akamotebia, “Ee, ogende nomorembe.”
english: Then Moses went back to Jethro his father-in-law and said to him, "Let me go back to my own people in Egypt to see if any of them are still alive." Jethro said, "Go, and I wish you well."

ekegusii: Musa akagenderera gokwana amang’ana aya ase Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: Then Moses went out and spoke these words to all Israel:

ekegusii: Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro koumerana na Nyasae. Omonene akamorangeria agwo ase egetunwa, akamotebia, “Amang’ana aya naro oratebie abanto b’egesaku kia Yakobo, baria Abaisraeli:
english: Then Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him from the mountain and said, "This is what you are to say to the house of Jacob and what you are to tell the people of Israel:

ekegusii: Obeke emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori rinene ase egesembe keria. Ase omong’ororia bwe ritang’ani obeke saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;
english: Then mount four rows of precious stones on it. In the first row there shall be a ruby, a topaz and a beryl;

ekegusii: Boigo okobwatana kwane nakorete na Daudi, omosomba one, ngotenene. Omonto takobora ase ororeria rwaye oraikaranse ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti. Boigo nokobwatana kwane nabakuani b’ororeria rwa Lawi ngotenene.
english: then my covenant with David my servant-- and my covenant with the Levites who are priests ministering before me-- can be broken and David will no longer have a descendant to reign on his throne.

ekegusii: Ekero ndarangerie Omonene, ababisa baane mbairanigwe gochia nyuma. Nimanyete kegima ng’a Nyasae nigo are ase ensemo yane.
english: Then my enemies will turn back when I call for help. By this I will know that God is for me.

ekegusii: Erio oria ore omobisa one arore ayio, na obosooku mbomotube oria omboretie, “Ng’ai Omonene, Nyasae oo, are?” Nimorigererie ngoke; ere natiringerwe inse buna esike ere inchera.
english: Then my enemy will see it and will be covered with shame, she who said to me, "Where is the LORD your God?" My eyes will see her downfall; even now she will be trampled underfoot like mire in the streets.

ekegusii: Ninyimokererigwa igoro ase ababisa baane bang’etanaine. Ase eema yaye ime nindue ebing’wanso inde nomochengo; ninterere Omonene na komotogia.
english: Then my head will be exalted above the enemies who surround me; at his tabernacle will I sacrifice with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the LORD.

ekegusii: Omoyo one nogoke ase Omonene na gochenga ase engencho y’ogotooreka kwaye.
english: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and delight in his salvation.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio ning’isanekie endamwamu yane asore, ne risemi riane ndirue asore, erio nario ndabe nobotoereru, gose tinkogechigwa naende.
english: Then my wrath against you will subside and my jealous anger will turn away from you; I will be calm and no longer angry.

ekegusii: Akairana ase omonto oria o Nyasae, ere amo nabanto bonsi barenge komo, agatenena ase obosio bwaye, akamotebia, “Bono namanyire ng’a Nyasae onde tari ase ense yonsi, otatiga oyo bw’Abaisraeli. Ase ayio bono, koranche oire ekeegwa korwa asende inche omosomba oo.”
english: Then Naaman and all his attendants went back to the man of God. He stood before him and said, "Now I know that there is no God in all the world except in Israel. Please accept now a gift from your servant."

ekegusii: Naomi agatebia baka bamura baye ng’a bairane, na kera oyomo agende komenya mwa ng’ina. Naende akabora, “Omonene abakorere amaya, buna inwe mwakorerete baria bakwete, mogankorera nainche.
english: Then Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, "Go back, each of you, to your mother's home. May the LORD show kindness to you, as you have shown to your dead and to me.

ekegusii: Then Naomi said, "Wait, my daughter, until you find out what happens. For the man will not rest until the matter is settled today."
english: Naomi akamotebia, “Bono omwana one, remereria oganye goika orore aya arabe asore. Boazi tagokira rero goika arore ng’a oroisirie amang’ana ao.”

ekegusii: Then Naomi took the child, laid him in her lap and cared for him.
english: Naomi akaimokia omwana oria, akamoagata, akaba okomorera.

ekegusii: Nathani akagenda ase Batiseba, akamotebia, “Inee! Aye toraigwa ng’a Adonia, omwana o Hagiti, obeire omoruoti, na Daudi, omonene oito, taramanya amang’ana ayio?
english: Then Nathan asked Bathsheba, Solomon's mother, "Have you not heard that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, has become king without our lord David's knowing it?

ekegusii: Agwo Nathani agatebia Daudi, “Naye omonto oria. Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteba iga: Inche nakoagete amaguta okaba omoruoti igoro y’Abaisraeli, nkagotooria korwa ase okoboko gwa Saulo.
english: Then Nathan said to David, "You are the man! This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: 'I anointed you king over Israel, and I delivered you from the hand of Saul.

ekegusii: Natanaeli akamoiraneria, “Omworokia, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae, naye Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.”
english: Then Nathanael declared, "Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the King of Israel."

ekegusii: Erio Nebukadinesaro agaaka eriogi, agateba, “Atogigwe Nyasae o Sadaraka, na o Meshaka, na bw’Abedi‐Nego, oyio otomire omomalaika oye gotooria abasomba baye abwo bamosemeretie na bangete koigwera ogochika kwane inche omoruoti, bakarua emebere yabo esire kobua gokorera na gosasima enyasae ende yonsi, otatiga Nyasae obo bweka.
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar said, "Praise be to the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, who has sent his angel and rescued his servants! They trusted in him and defied the king's command and were willing to give up their lives rather than serve or worship any god except their own God.

ekegusii: Erio Nebukadinesaro agaichorwa nekeririanda, na obosio bwaye bokaonchoka igoro ya Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego. Agachika ng’a omorero bw’eriko riria omentwe obe omonene ara gatano na kabere kobua oyo o botambe.
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar was furious with Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, and his attitude toward them changed. He ordered the furnace heated seven times hotter than usual

ekegusii: Ekero abanto baigwete amang’ana ayio agosomwa, bagasambeka chinkoro chiabo, bakarera. Nehemia oyorenge omogambi obo, na Ezara, omokuani na omworokia bw’amachiko, na Abalawi abwo borokereretie abanto bonsi, bagatebia abanto, “Rituko eri ria rero nerichenu ase Omonene, Nyasae oino; ase ayio timobaisa korera, gose kobokia amagombo.”
english: Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and scribe, and the Levites who were instructing the people said to them all, "This day is sacred to the LORD your God. Do not mourn or weep." For all the people had been weeping as they listened to the words of the Law.

ekegusii: amabe ande onsi tagokonyora, na amaakwa ande onsi tagocha ase enka yao.
english: then no harm will befall you, no disaster will come near your tent.

ekegusii: Erio Nuhu akaagachera Omonene egesasimero, akarusia eyemo ase kera eng’iti, na ase kera enyoni echenegete, agachirua chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa igoro ase egesasimero keria.
english: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD and, taking some of all the clean animals and clean birds, he sacrificed burnt offerings on it.

ekegusii: Bono Omuri akaimoka korwa Gibetoni amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi, bakagenda koboera Tirisa.
english: Then Omri and all the Israelites with him withdrew from Gibbethon and laid siege to Tirzah.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatano na gatato, arente amaruma abere, gose amage ’amaruma abere, ase omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Then on the eighth day he must bring two doves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase rituko ria ikomi na gatato, ri’omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, abariki b’omoruoti bakarangerigwa, barike amang’ana ’ogochika koria omoruoti aruete. Amarube akarikwa gochia ase abagambi abanene b’oboruoti, na ase abagavuna, na ase abanene b’abanto be chingongo chionsi ase oboruoti bwaye, ase kera orogongo ase okorikwa kw’engencho y’amariko abo, na ase kera egesaku ase omonwa obo. Amang’ana ayio nigo arigetwe akabekwa erieta ri’omoruoti Ahaswero amo nekemanyererio ki’ebonyi eria yaye.
english: Then on the thirteenth day of the first month the royal secretaries were summoned. They wrote out in the script of each province and in the language of each people all Haman's orders to the king's satraps, the governors of the various provinces and the nobles of the various peoples. These were written in the name of King Xerxes himself and sealed with his own ring.

ekegusii: Erio naende nkarara maumama ase obosio bw’Omonene buna agwo ritang’ani, ase engaki y’amatuko emeronge ene, omobaso na obotuko. Tinabete nkoria kende gose konywa, ase engencho y’ebibe bionsi inwe konya mwakorire, ase ogokora amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene, mokamogechia goika akaba nendamwamu.
english: Then once again I fell prostrate before the LORD for forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water, because of all the sin you had committed, doing what was evil in the LORD's sight and so provoking him to anger.

ekegusii: Omokerubi oria oyomo akarambora okoboko kwaye ase egati‐gati y’abakerubi bande, na agaanchara omorero bw’amakara orenge ase egati‐gati y’abakerubi baria bande, akayobeka ase amaboko ’omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani, na omonto oria akayobogoria, agasoka noro isiko.
english: Then one of the cherubim reached out his hand to the fire that was among them. He took up some of it and put it into the hands of the man in linen, who took it and went out.

ekegusii: Erio oyomo bw’abagaaka baria akaonchoka, akamboria, “Abanto aba babekeirwe chianga chindabu barabwo mbarabi, naende ng’ai barure?”
english: Then one of the elders asked me, "These in white robes-- who are they, and where did they come from?"

ekegusii: Then one of the elders said to me, "Do not weep! See, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has triumphed. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals."
english: Na oyomo bw’abagaaka baria agantebia, “Torera, rora Endo bw’egesaku kia Yuda, Ritina ria Daudi, obuire, nere oranyare koigora ebuku eria na gosansora ebimanyererio biaye bitano na bibere.”

ekegusii: Na eyemo ye ching’iti chiria inye chire moyo ekaa abamalaika baria batano na babere ebitaabo bitano na bibere bie chitahabu biichire endamwamu ya Nyasae ore moyo goika kare na kare.
english: Then one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, who lives for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Erio omoserafi oyomo akairuruka gocha asende, obogoretie ase okoboko kwaye rikara rire nomorero, erio arusetie ne rigami korwa ase egesasimero.
english: Then one of the seraphs flew to me with a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with tongs from the altar.

ekegusii: Korende omonto oyomo akamotebia, “Iso nigo abegete ogochika ogokong’u, agatiania abanto, akabatebia: Aragererigwe omonto onde bwensi orarie endagera ende yonsi ase rituko ria rero.” Na abanto abwo bakaborwa chinguru, bakagoyana ase enchara.
english: Then one of the soldiers told him, "Your father bound the army under a strict oath, saying, 'Cursed be any man who eats food today!' That is why the men are faint."

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo bw’abanene b’esinagogi agacha, erieta riaye Yairo. Agachia komorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye,
english: Then one of the synagogue rulers, named Jairus, came there. Seeing Jesus, he fell at his feet

ekegusii: Na ekero ekio oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, nere, oyokorokwa Yudas Iskariota, agachiera abakuani abanene,
english: Then one of the Twelve-- the one called Judas Iscariot-- went to the chief priests

ekegusii: Then one of them said, "Won't you please come with your servants?" "I will," Elisha replied.
english: Oyomo obo akamotebia, “Koranche, ogende amo naintwe abasomba bao.” Elisha akamoiraneria, “Ee, ningende amo nainwe.”

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo asebare, Kayafa, oyorenge omokuani omonene ase omwaka oria, akabatebia, “Inwe timomanyeti kende gionsi.
english: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, "You know nothing at all!

ekegusii: Na oyomo ase baria bateneine ang’e akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.
english: Then one of those standing near drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

ekegusii: Erio oria ogwekaine mwanyabanto agakuna ebikoba biane, na inche nkamaanora omonwa one ngakwana. Ngatebia oria oteneine ase obosio bwane, “Aye Omonene one, okorora oko kwandeteire omoichano, ne chinguru chiarure asende.
english: Then one who looked like a man touched my lips, and I opened my mouth and began to speak. I said to the one standing before me, "I am overcome with anguish because of the vision, my lord, and I am helpless.

ekegusii: Tiga abamura baito ase oboke bwabo babe buna ebimeri biakinire bire ne chinguru, na abaiseke baito babe buna ebisigisa bie chikoona bibaachire buya bikogwenera chinyomba chi’oboruoti.
english: Then our sons in their youth will be like well-nurtured plants, and our daughters will be like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

ekegusii: Rora, omokungu agacha akaumerana nomomura oria. Omokungu oria nigo abegete chianga chi’obotayayi orenge omong’ainereria ase enkoro yaye.
english: Then out came a woman to meet him, dressed like a prostitute and with crafty intent.

ekegusii: Omoondoko ogasoa ase abanto bonsi b’egetwori agwo ase egetii. Abanto b’eburi amo nabwo barenge abasakori, bonsi bagatengechigwa nomoondoko; goika nonya nense egatengechigwa. Omoondoko oria omonene nigo orwete ase Omonene.
english: Then panic struck the whole army-- those in the camp and field, and those in the outposts and raiding parties-- and the ground shook. It was a panic sent by God.

ekegusii: Paulo na Barnaba bagakwana noboremu, bagateba, “Igo yagwenerete ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae rikwanwe asemore ritang’ani. Korende ekiagera mwarisukeirie are mwenacheire inwe abanyene ng’a timogwenereti obogima bwa kare na kare, tweonchoreire abanto b’Ebisaku.
english: Then Paul and Barnabas answered them boldly: "We had to speak the word of God to you first. Since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we now turn to the Gentiles.

ekegusii: Erio Paulo akairaneria, “Inki eke mogokora, mokorera na kong’ita omoyo? Nigo inde ang’e, tari ase ogosibwa gwoka, korende nonya nogoitwa ase Yerusalemu ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene Yeso.”
english: Then Paul answered, "Why are you weeping and breaking my heart? I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die in Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus."

ekegusii: Paulo akarangeria oyomo bw’abatang’ani b’abarwani rigana, akamotebia, “Ira omomura oyo ase omotang’ani omonene, ekiagera nabwate ring’ana akomotebia.”
english: Then Paul called one of the centurions and said, "Take this young man to the commander; he has something to tell him."

ekegusii: Akaimoka korwa agwo, agasoa enyomba y’omonto ore korokwa Tito Yusto, omosasimi Nyasae. Mwaye nigo yasinyaine nesinagogi.
english: Then Paul left the synagogue and went next door to the house of Titius Justus, a worshiper of God.

ekegusii: Paulo agekengera iga, “Inche timocheti ring’ana igoro ase amachiko ’Abayahudi, gose ase Hekalu, nonya nase Kaisari.”
english: Then Paul made his defense: "I have done nothing wrong against the law of the Jews or against the temple or against Caesar."

ekegusii: Erio Paulo akamotebia, “Nyasae nagoake aye, enyasi eakire echooka! Aye gwaikaransire konachera inche ekina boronge koreng’ana buna ogochika, naende kogoteba mamincha y’amachiko ng’a ng’akwe?”
english: Then Paul said to him, "God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit there to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck!"

ekegusii: Paulo agatebia omotang’ani oria bw’abarwani rigana, na abarwani, “Aba bataikaranseti ase emeeri ime timokonyara gotooreka.”
english: Then Paul said to the centurion and the soldiers, "Unless these men stay with the ship, you cannot be saved."

ekegusii: Korende ekero Paulo achia komanya ng’a ensemo eyemo n’Abasadukai, na ensemo ya kabere n’Abafarisai, agaaka eriogi ase ekegambero keria, agateba, “Abaminto, inche n’Omofarisai, omwana bw’Abafarisai; inche nigo nkogambigwa ase engencho y’ogosemeria na ase okobokigwa kw’abakure.”
english: Then Paul, knowing that some of them were Sadducees and the others Pharisees, called out in the Sanhedrin, "My brothers, I am a Pharisee, the son of a Pharisee. I stand on trial because of my hope in the resurrection of the dead."

ekegusii: Erio Petero na Yohana bakababekera amaboko abo, na barabwo bakanyora Omoika Omochenu.
english: Then Peter and John placed their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Erio Petero agachaka gokwana, akabora, “Ase ekeene naikire komanya ng’a Nyasae tari nogwanchereria,
english: Then Peter began to speak: "I now realize how true it is that God does not show favoritism

ekegusii: Ekero Petero achia komanya, agateba, “Bono namanyire bori ng’a Omonene nere otoma omomalaika oye ochia kondusia ase okoboko kwa Herode, na korwa ase ogosemeria gwonsi kw’abanto b’Abayahudi.”
english: Then Peter came to himself and said, "Now I know without a doubt that the Lord sent his angel and rescued me from Herod's clutches and from everything the Jewish people were anticipating."

ekegusii: Erio Petero agacha, akamoboria, “Omonene, ng’ara karenga oyominto arankorere ebibe, na inche mwabere? Goika chintunda isano na ibere gose?”
english: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, "Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother when he sins against me? Up to seven times?"

ekegusii: Erio Petero akabatebia basoe nyomba, babe abageni baye. Rituko ria kabere akaimoka akagenda amo nabarabwo, na abande bamwabo korwa Yopa bakagenda amo nere.
english: Then Peter invited the men into the house to be his guests. The next day Peter started out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa went along.

ekegusii: Erio Petero akainyora ring’ana riria Yeso atebete, “Ritang’ani etuoni etarabuga, nonkane ara gatato.” Agasoka isiko, akarera nobororo.
english: Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken: "Before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times." And he went outside and wept bitterly.

ekegusii: Erio Petero akamoboria, “Anania, nase ki Saitani aichoire enkoro yao, okong’aina Omoika Omochenu na kobisa ensemo ye rigori ri’omogondo?
english: Then Peter said, "Ananias, how is it that Satan has so filled your heart that you have lied to the Holy Spirit and have kept for yourself some of the money you received for the land?

ekegusii: Korende Petero akamotebia, “Efeta timbwati, nonya netahabu, korende eki mbwate nakio ngokoa: Ase erieta ria Yeso Kristo o Nazareti, tenena ogende!”
english: Then Peter said, "Silver or gold I do not have, but what I have I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, walk."

ekegusii: Korende Petero agatenena amo na baria ikomi nomo, agaaka eriogi riaye, akabatebia, “Inwe abasacha ba Boyahudi, na inwe mwensi abamomenyete Yerusalemu, tiga ring’ana eri rimanyekane asemore, tegerera amang’ana aane.
english: Then Peter stood up with the Eleven, raised his voice and addressed the crowd: "Fellow Jews and all of you who live in Jerusalem, let me explain this to you; listen carefully to what I say.

ekegusii: Erio Petero agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, akabatebia, “Abanene b’abanto, na abagaaka,
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them: "Rulers and elders of the people!

ekegusii: Erio Farao agachika abanto bakoobe Aburamu amo na mokaye na kende gionsi abwate.
english: Then Pharaoh gave orders about Abram to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and everything he had.

ekegusii: Erio Farao agachika abanto baye bonsi, akabatebia, “Kera omwana omoisia okoiborwa ase Abaibirania, momotugute ase orooche rwa Naili, korende kera omwana omoiseke momotige abe moyo.”
english: Then Pharaoh gave this order to all his people: "Every boy that is born you must throw into the Nile, but let every girl live."

ekegusii: Naende Farao agatebia Yusufu, “Ninche Farao. Otancheti aye, onde takoba ase ense yonsi ya Misiri oraimoke gokora gento.”
english: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I am Pharaoh, but without your word no one will lift hand or foot in all Egypt."

ekegusii: Erio Farao agatebia Yusufu, “Ase okorota kwane nigo naroche ng’a nteneine ase engegu y’orooche.
english: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "In my dream I was standing on the bank of the Nile,

ekegusii: Erio Farao agatebia Yusufu, “Ekiagera Nyasae okomanyirie amang’ana ayio onsi, onde tari aa omanyete, naende ore na omong’aini buna aye.
english: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one so discerning and wise as you.

ekegusii: Naende Farao akabora, “Abanto aba babeire abange kobua abanyene ense eye. Naende morigetie kobarusia ase emeremo yabo.”
english: Then Pharaoh said, "Look, the people of the land are now numerous, and you are stopping them from working."

ekegusii: Erio Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni, akabatebia, “Genda moruere Nyasae oino ekeng’wanso, korende naiga ase ense yaito.”
english: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron and said, "Go, sacrifice to your God here in the land."

ekegusii: Farao akarangeria Musa na Haroni, akabatebia, “Ase engaki eye inche nakorire ebibe; Omonene nere omonyene oboronge, inche na abanto baane nabamochi tore.
english: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and Aaron. "This time I have sinned," he said to them. "The LORD is in the right, and I and my people are in the wrong.

ekegusii: Farao akarangeria Musa, akamotebia, “Genda mokorere Omonene. Moire abana baino, korende chitugo chiaino chirochio mochitige aiga.”
english: Then Pharaoh summoned Moses and said, "Go, worship the LORD. Even your women and children may go with you; only leave your flocks and herds behind."

ekegusii: Erio Farao akarusia ebonyi yaye ere nekemanyererio korwa ase ekiara kiaye, akamoyebekera Yusufu kiara kiaye, akamobekera na eanga engiya y’egatani, akamobekera ne chisonoi chi’etahabu igoti riaye.
english: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring from his finger and put it on Joseph's finger. He dressed him in robes of fine linen and put a gold chain around his neck.

ekegusii: Erio omoiseke o Farao agatirimboka gochia rooche gwesibia, na abasomba baye abaiseke bakaba bakonagotaara ase engegu. Ekero aroche ekebaari keria ase amauncho, agatoma omoiseke oyomo akerente;
english: Then Pharaoh's daughter went down to the Nile to bathe, and her attendants were walking along the river bank. She saw the basket among the reeds and sent her slave girl to get it.

ekegusii: Filipo agachaka gokwana; agachakera korwa ase ririko eri, akamoranderia amang’ana amaya igoro ya Yeso.
english: Then Philip began with that very passage of Scripture and told him the good news about Jesus.

ekegusii: Filipo akaminyoka gochia asare, akamoigwa ogosoma ebuku y’omobani Isaya, akamoboria, “Inee! Kwamanyire buya aya ogosoma?”
english: Then Philip ran up to the chariot and heard the man reading Isaiah the prophet. "Do you understand what you are reading?" Philip asked.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari, omokuani, na abatang’ani baria, bagatiga Abareuben na Abagadi agwo Gileadi, bakairana gochia ase ense ya Kanani, ase Abaisraeli, bakabairera amang’ana onsi.
english: Then Phinehas son of Eleazar, the priest, and the leaders returned to Canaan from their meeting with the Reubenites and Gadites in Gilead and reported to the Israelites.

ekegusii: Pilato agatebia abakuani abanene na emeganda, “Inche tindochi bobe bonde ase omonto oyo.”
english: Then Pilate announced to the chief priests and the crowd, "I find no basis for a charge against this man."

ekegusii: Erio Pilato akamotebia, “Toigweti amang’ana aya amange bakona‐goteba igoro yao?”
english: Then Pilate asked him, "Don't you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?"

ekegusii: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.
english: Erio Pilato akaira Yeso, akamoaka emecharichi.

ekegusii: Puli, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri agacha korwania ense eria, na Menahemu akaa Puli chibesa chie chifeta, chitalanta elifu eyemo, erinde amokonye na akore oboruoti bwaye bobe ne chinguru.
english: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave him a thousand talents of silver to gain his support and strengthen his own hold on the kingdom.

ekegusii: Then put in the ark the Testimony, which I will give you.
english: Ime y’Esanduku eria obeke chibao echi chirikire oborori, echi ndakoe.”

ekegusii: Obeke na egekombe kiane keria kiaroisetigwe korwa ase chifeta, okebeke ime ase egunia y’omomura oria omoke kegima, amo ne chibesa chiria achete nachio kogora endagera.” Ere agakora buna Yusufu amotebetie.
english: Then put my cup, the silver one, in the mouth of the youngest one's sack, along with the silver for his grain." And he did as Joseph said.

ekegusii: Eting’ana Esteri akairaneria, akabora, “Aye omoruoti, onye nanyorire ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, naende amang’ana aya karakogokie, ntige ngenderere koba moyo, na abanto baane boigo; oko nakwo okogania kwane.
english: Then Queen Esther answered, "If I have found favor with you, O king, and if it pleases your majesty, grant me my life-- this is my petition. And spare my people-- this is my request.

ekegusii: Erio Raeli na Lea bakamoiraneria, “Inee! Ntwatigaretie egetari gose omwando ase omochie o tata?
english: Then Rachel and Leah replied, "Do we still have any share in the inheritance of our father's estate?

ekegusii: Erio Raeli akabora, “Nyasae ong’eire oboronge bwane, amaene, oigure ekerero kiane, ong’eire omwana omoisia.” Ase ayio akamoroka Dani.
english: Then Rachel said, "God has vindicated me; he has listened to my plea and given me a son." Because of this she named him Dan.

ekegusii: Raeli akabora, “Ase okoamererania okonene nabeire nkoamererania na mosubati ominto, nabuire.” Ase igo akamoroka Nafutali.
english: Then Rachel said, "I have had a great struggle with my sister, and I have won." So she named him Naphtali.

ekegusii: Then Rebekah and her maids got ready and mounted their camels and went back with the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.
english: Erio Rebeka akaimoka amo nabaiseke baye abasomba, bakariina chingamia, bagatunyana omonto oria. Naboigo omosomba oria akaira Rebeka, akagenda nere sobo.

ekegusii: Erio Rebeka agakwana na Isaka, akamotebia, “Nigo ngechirie mono ase obogima bwane ase engencho y’abaiseke b’Abahiti. Onye Yakobo ogochia konyuoma oyomo bw’abaiseke b’Abahiti, koreng’ana buna aba bamenyete ase ensemo eye, rirorio obogima bwane, inki borangwenere?”
english: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, "I'm disgusted with living because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a wife from among the women of this land, from Hittite women like these, my life will not be worth living."

ekegusii: Erio Rebeka akabogoria eanga eria engiya mono ya Esau, omwana oye omotangi; eye nigo yagachire nyomba mwaye, akayebekera Yakobo, omwana oye omoke.
english: Then Rebekah took the best clothes of Esau her older son, which she had in the house, and put them on her younger son Jacob.

ekegusii: Erio Reuben agatebia ise “Oite abana baane babere abamura onye tinkomoirania gocha asore. Mobeke ase amaboko aane na inche nimoiranie.”
english: Then Reuben said to his father, "You may put both of my sons to death if I do not bring him back to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him back."

ekegusii: Erio abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, na ekia Gadi, amo nekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase bakairaneria abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakabatebia,
english: Then Reuben, Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh replied to the heads of the clans of Israel:

ekegusii: Resini, omoruoti bw’Abasiiria, na Peka, mosinto o Remalia, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, bakagenda korwania Yerusalemu, bakanaaria Ahasi, korende tibabua omochie.
english: Then Rezin king of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem and besieged Ahaz, but they could not overpower him.

ekegusii: Naende Rutu, Omomoabu oria, akamotebia, “Amo nayio ere nigo antebia ng’a mbeere amo nabasomba baye goika bakoore rigesa riaye rionsi.”
english: Then Ruth the Moabitess said, "He even said to me, 'Stay with my workers until they finish harvesting all my grain.'"

ekegusii: Then sacrifice one male goat for a sin offering and two lambs, each a year old, for a fellowship offering.
english: Naboigo morue egoree eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, ne chimanwa ibere chie ching’ondi, chiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe.

ekegusii: Erio Samison akarangeria Omonene, akabora, “Omonene Nyasae, nagosabire, ong’inyore, ong’e chinguru ase engaki eye yoka. Aye Nyasae, erio inyeruserie egesiomba ase amaiso aane abere igoro y’Abafilisti!”
english: Then Samson prayed to the LORD, "O Sovereign LORD, remember me. O God, please strengthen me just once more, and let me with one blow get revenge on the Philistines for my two eyes."

ekegusii: Agwo Samison akaboania chisiiro chiria ibere chia gati‐gati, chiasiirete enyomba, agachibwata bokong’u, esiiro eyemo nokoboko okomo, na eyende nokoboko konde.
english: Then Samson reached toward the two central pillars on which the temple stood. Bracing himself against them, his right hand on the one and his left hand on the other,

ekegusii: Erio Samison agakwana, “Ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere naitire abanto elifu eyemo, ase riuga ri’orosea rw’etigere nababekire chitui.”
english: Then Samson said, "With a donkey's jawbone I have made donkeys of them. With a donkey's jawbone I have killed a thousand men."

ekegusii: Moga Samison akagenda asare, akarera akamotebia, “Aye nigo ongechete, tonyancheti, ogatebia abanto baminto omobayeno, korende tontebeti inche engencho y’omobayeno oria.” Samison akamotebia, “Rora, tindatebia tata, gose baba, engencho y’omobayeno oria, naki ndakore ngotebie aye?”
english: Then Samson's wife threw herself on him, sobbing, "You hate me! You don't really love me. You've given my people a riddle, but you haven't told me the answer." "I haven't even explained it to my father or mother," he replied, "so why should I explain it to you?"

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaira Saulo amo nomosomba oye, akabasoyia ase enyomba y’abageni, akabaikaransia aase ay’amasikani, ase egati y’abageni bande emerongo etato.
english: Then Samuel brought Saul and his servant into the hall and seated them at the head of those who were invited-- about thirty in number.

ekegusii: Ase igo Samweli agasaba Omonene, nere agatoma enkoba na embura ase rituko riria. Abanto bonsi bakoboa Omonene, bakoboa na Samweli.
english: Then Samuel called upon the LORD, and that same day the LORD sent thunder and rain. So all the people stood in awe of the LORD and of Samuel.

ekegusii: Then Samuel left for Ramah, but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul.
english: Erio Samweli akagenda Rama, na Saulo akagenda bwoye agwo Gibea o Saulo.

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimoka, akarua Giligali, akagenda Gibea ase orogongo rwa Benjamin. Na Saulo akabara abanto abatigarete amo nere, na barabwo nigo barenge koreng’ana amagana atano na rimo.
english: Then Samuel left Gilgal and went up to Gibeah in Benjamin, and Saul counted the men who were with him. They numbered about six hundred.

ekegusii: Samweli agatebia abanto, “Inchuo togende Giligali, erinde toirore oboruoti obo tobokore bobe oboyia.”
english: Then Samuel said to the people, "Come, let us go to Gilgal and there reaffirm the kingship."

ekegusii: Samweli agatebia abanto, “Omonene, oria ochorete Musa na Haroni, naende akarenta chisokoro chiaino korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nere kirori.
english: Then Samuel said to the people, "It is the LORD who appointed Moses and Aaron and brought your forefathers up out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Samweli agateba, “Sangereria Abaisraeli bonsi agwo Misipa, erinde imbasabere aroro ase Omonene.”
english: Then Samuel said, "Assemble all Israel at Mizpah and I will intercede with the LORD for you."

ekegusii: Samweli akabora, “Ndetera Agagi, omoruoti bw’Abaameleki, aiga.” Agagi agacha asare, ore nomogoko agakwana, “Ekeene, obororo bw’amakweri bwaerire.”
english: Then Samuel said, "Bring me Agag king of the Amalekites." Agag came to him confidently, thinking, "Surely the bitterness of death is past."

ekegusii: Erio Samueli akaimokia echuba y’amaguta, akaumorera Saulo ase omotwe, akamonyunyunta, akamotebia, “Omonene ogoakire amaguta obe omotang’ani bw’Abaisraeli, abanto baye. Aye nogambere abanto b’Omonene na kobatooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa babo babaetanaine. Eke nakio kerabe ekemanyererio asore ng’a Omonene ogoakire amaguta ng’a obe omotang’ani igoro ase abanto bare omwando oye:
english: Then Samuel took a flask of oil and poured it on Saul's head and kissed him, saying, "Has not the LORD anointed you leader over his inheritance?

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimokia rigena, akaritenenia gati ya Misipa na Seni, akariroka Ebeni‐Eseri, akabora, “Omonene otokonyire twaikire aiga.”
english: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Shen. He named it Ebenezer, saying, "Thus far has the LORD helped us."

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akaimokia emanwa y’eng’ondi ekogonka, akayerua ase Omonene ekaba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ekegima, agasabera Abaisraeli ase Omonene, na Omonene akaigwa ogosaba kwaye.
english: Then Samuel took a suckling lamb and offered it up as a whole burnt offering to the LORD. He cried out to the LORD on Israel's behalf, and the LORD answered him.

ekegusii: Sarai agatebia Aburamu, “Obobe obo bwanyorete, tiga naye bokonyore! Inakoa omoiseke one omosomba koboko kwao; ere, ekero arora ng’a obeire morito, onchayire. Tiga Omonene atogambane inche naye!”
english: Then Sarai said to Abram, "You are responsible for the wrong I am suffering. I put my servant in your arms, and now that she knows she is pregnant, she despises me. May the LORD judge between you and me."

ekegusii: Saitani agasoa Yudas okorokwa Iskariota. Yudas nigo arenge oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere.
english: Then Satan entered Judas, called Iscariot, one of the Twelve.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo na abanto bonsi abarenge amo nere bagasangererekana amo, bagasoa ase esegi eria. Kobaikire agwo bakarora ng’a Abafilisti baitanire, kera oyomo noyonde nomoro, na eburu‐buru eria ekaba enene inono.
english: Then Saul and all his men assembled and went to the battle. They found the Philistines in total confusion, striking each other with their swords.

ekegusii: Saulo akarwania Abaameleki akababua, gochakera Havila goikera Suri, moocha ya Misiri.
english: Then Saul attacked the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, to the east of Egypt.

ekegusii: Ase igo Saulo agatiga kobwatia Daudi, akairana, akagenda korwania Abafilisti. Ase ayio aase agwo akarokwa “Egetare ki’Ogwatananeka.”
english: Then Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to meet the Philistines. That is why they call this place Sela Hammahlekoth.

ekegusii: Agwo Saulo akaagachera Omonene egesasimero; ekio nakio egesasimero egetang’ani aagacherete Omonene.
english: Then Saul built an altar to the LORD; it was the first time he had done this.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo akaimokia ebirwanero biaye bi’esegi, akabibekera Daudi, akamobekera na ekegogwa gi’etaai omotwe oye, na egoti eroisirie korwa ase ebioma.
english: Then Saul dressed David in his own tunic. He put a coat of armor on him and a bronze helmet on his head.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agachika abasomba baye, akabora, “Kwana na Daudi bobisi, momotebie ng’a inche omoruoti nigo ngokirie nere, na abasomba baane bonsi nigo bamwanchete. Ase ayio bono momotebie ng’a inche imbe ise biara.”
english: Then Saul ordered his attendants: "Speak to David privately and say, 'Look, the king is pleased with you, and his attendants all like you; now become his son-in-law.'"

ekegusii: Ase igo Saulo akabora, “Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nase ki kwangire koiraneria omosomba oo rituko ria rero? Onye okomocha okwo nokwane, gose nokwa Yonathani, omwana one, iraneria ase enchera y’obomera bwa Urimu, konye kore okw’Abaisraeli iraneria na Tumimu.” Igo obomera bokagwera Saulo na Yonathani, na abanto bagatooreka.
english: Then Saul prayed to the LORD, the God of Israel, "Give me the right answer." And Jonathan and Saul were taken by lot, and the men were cleared.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia Daudi, “Aye Daudi, omwana one, nosesenigwe. Aye nokore ebinto ebinge mono na kobua.” Daudi akabwatia enchera yaye, na Saulo akairana nka bwoye.
english: Then Saul said to David, "May you be blessed, my son David; you will do great things and surely triumph." So David went on his way, and Saul returned home.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia Yonathani, “Ntebie amang’ana gwakorire.” Yonathani agateba, “Nigo nachobia mesia y’enyimbo yarenge koboko kwane ase eriana rire nobooke, nkariria; ase ayio, nao inde aa, bono goika nkwe.”
english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, "Tell me what you have done." So Jonathan told him, "I merely tasted a little honey with the end of my staff. And now must I die?"

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia Samweli, “Nakorire ebibe, ekiagera nasaririe ogochika kw’Omonene na amang’ana ao gwantebetie. Nigo nairogete abanto, nkaba nkoigwera okogania kwabo.
english: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned. I violated the LORD's command and your instructions. I was afraid of the people and so I gave in to them.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatebia abanto abwo barenge nere, “Bara abanto morore gose ning’o otari aa asetore.” Na ekero bababarete bakarora ng’a Yonathani na omomura oyorenge komobogoreria ebirwanero tibaiyo.
english: Then Saul said to the men who were with him, "Muster the forces and see who has left us." When they did, it was Jonathan and his armor-bearer who were not there.

ekegusii: Erio Saulo akamotebia “Nakorire ebibe! Aye Daudi, omwana one, irana. Tinkogokorera amabe naende, ekiagera rituko ria rero obogima bwane nigo bwaba bw’engencho enene asore. Nakorire ayare oboriri, na igo nakorire okomocha okonene.”
english: Then Saul said, "I have sinned. Come back, David my son. Because you considered my life precious today, I will not try to harm you again. Surely I have acted like a fool and have erred greatly."

ekegusii: Ase ayio Saulo agatoma abanto gotebia Yese, “Ntomere Daudi, omwana oo omomura, oyio okorisia ching’ondi.”
english: Then Saul sent messengers to Jesse and said, "Send me your son David, who is with the sheep."

ekegusii: Saulo akabatoma naende ase Daudi, akabatebia, “Momobogorie noborere, momorente asende, erinde imoite.”
english: Then Saul sent the men back to see David and told them, "Bring him up to me in his bed so that I may kill him."

ekegusii: Erio Saulo agatoma amang’ana ase Yese, akamotebia, “Tiga Daudi abeere aiga abe ogonkorera, ekiagera namwanchire mono.”
english: Then Saul sent word to Jesse, saying, "Allow David to remain in my service, for I am pleased with him."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Saulo agatiga kobwatia Abafilisti; bakairana gochia nka sobo.
english: Then Saul stopped pursuing the Philistines, and they withdrew to their own land.

ekegusii: Korende Saulo, oyokorokwa naende Paulo, agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu, akamotogoreria amaiso, akabora,
english: Then Saul, who was also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, looked straight at Elymas and said,

ekegusii: Omotebie ng’a: Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abiabirania, ontomire ngotebie ng’a oe abanto baye ribaga bagende komokorera ase erooro. Naye goika bono toraigwa.
english: Then say to him, 'The LORD, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to say to you: Let my people go, so that they may worship me in the desert. But until now you have not listened.

ekegusii: Erio omotebie Farao: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Abaisraeli nomwana one omotangi.
english: Then say to Pharaoh, 'This is what the LORD says: Israel is my firstborn son,

ekegusii: Naende otebie Abaisraeli ng’a bachore egoree ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emori amo nemanwa y’eng’ondi echiakoorire omwaka oyomo, chionsi chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa,
english: Then say to the Israelites: 'Take a male goat for a sin offering, a calf and a lamb-- both a year old and without defect-- for a burnt offering,

ekegusii: Erio okwane amang’ana aya ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo, omotebie: Narusirie korwa ase enyomba yane ebinto biatananetwe bibe ebichenu, nabieire Abalawi, na abamenyi, ne chintakana, na ababoraka. Nakorire buna gwanchigete. Tinsareti gose tinyebeti ogochika konde kwao.
english: Then say to the LORD your God: "I have removed from my house the sacred portion and have given it to the Levite, the alien, the fatherless and the widow, according to all you commanded. I have not turned aside from your commands nor have I forgotten any of them.

ekegusii: Erio obairanerie, obatebie ng’a Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Chisokoro chiaino nigo chiantigete, chikarigia chinyasae ching’ao, chigachikorera na gochisasima, chigantiga na chikaanga korenda amachiko aane.
english: then say to them, 'It is because your fathers forsook me,' declares the LORD, 'and followed other gods and served and worshiped them. They forsook me and did not keep my law.

ekegusii: Erio obatebie: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Naama! Inche Omonene nindangerie Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, omosomba one, ere nabeke ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene igoro ase amagena aya natubire aiga, nabe okwara na kogetuba omogeke oye bw’obonene.
english: Then say to them, 'This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will send for my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones I have buried here; he will spread his royal canopy above them.

ekegusii: Erio otebe: Aye Omonene gwatebire ng’a nosirie aase aiga kegima, gento kende tikemenyao, mwanyabanto gose ching’iti, na ense eye nesirigwe ebe erooro kogenderera botambe.
english: Then say, 'O LORD, you have said you will destroy this place, so that neither man nor animal will live in it; it will be desolate forever.'

ekegusii: Erio otebe iga: Naboigo Babeli erarimere, gochia inse, teimoka naende nonya ng’ake, ase engencho y’obobe nkorenta ase ense eyio, goika obwo bobagoyie.” Amang’ana a Yeremia aereire aiga.
english: Then say, 'So will Babylon sink to rise no more because of the disaster I will bring upon her. And her people will fall.'" The words of Jeremiah end here.

ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoira, bakagenda nere nyomba ime ase omokuani omonene. Na Petero akamotunyana korwa nyuma ore egeka.
english: Then seizing him, they led him away and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed at a distance.

ekegusii: Toma abanto abwo bachete Yerusalemu korora Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, erinde baire ebinto ebio ase omoruoti bw’Abaedomu, na oyo bw’Abamoabu, na oyo bw’Abaamoni, na oyo o Turo, na oyo o Sidoni.
english: Then send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre and Sidon through the envoys who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.

ekegusii: mwatanane emechie etato ase ense eyio Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa.
english: then set aside for yourselves three cities centrally located in the land the LORD your God is giving you to possess.

ekegusii: Erio otige enyongo eyio ere bosa igoro ase omorero bw’amakara, eyie esambwe, erinde etaai y’enyongo eyio eyie ebariire burure; riko rire imeo rigokomoke, na oboboosu bw’enyongo eyio boyie bonyititoke boere.
english: Then set the empty pot on the coals till it becomes hot and its copper glows so its impurities may be melted and its deposit burned away.

ekegusii: Naende Safani agatebia omoruoti, “Hilikia omokuani nang’a ebuku.” Erio Safani agasomera omoruoti ebuku eria.
english: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.

ekegusii: Erio Safani omoriki agatebia omoruoti, “Hilikia omokuani ong’eire ebuku eye.” Erio akayesoma agwo ase obosio bw’omoruoti.
english: Then Shaphan the secretary informed the king, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read from it in the presence of the king.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio omoriki oria akagenda ase omoruoti, akamotebia, “Abasomba bao mbarusia chibesa chionsi chianyorekana ase enyomba, bakaa abakori emeremo abwo bare abateneneri b’emeremo egokorwa ase enyomba y’Omonene.”
english: Then Shaphan the secretary went to the king and reported to him: "Your officials have paid out the money that was in the temple of the LORD and have entrusted it to the workers and supervisors at the temple."

ekegusii: Safani akaira ebuku eria ase omoruoti, naende akamotebia, “Emeremo yonsi kwaete abasomba bao nkoyekora bare.
english: Then Shaphan took the book to the king and reported to him: "Your officials are doing everything that has been committed to them.

ekegusii: Erio akarangeria, “Samison! Abafilisti aba bachire gokobwata!” Samison akaboka korwa ase chitoro chiaye, akarengereria ng’a “Bono ninyesibore buna botambe, ngende,” ekiagera tamanyete ng’a Omonene omotigire.
english: Then she called, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" He awoke from his sleep and thought, "I'll go out as before and shake myself free." But he did not know that the LORD had left him.

ekegusii: Erio eting’ana eria ekaa omoruoti ebiegwa ebio arentete: Chitahabu ang’e chikiro chilifu isano (5,000), na ebinsari ebinge mono, na amagena e rigori rinene. Ebinsari binde tibiarentetwe ekero kende gionsi bireng’aine na biria eting’ana ya Seba yarenterete omoruoti Sulemani.
english: Then she gave the king 120 talents of gold, large quantities of spices, and precious stones. There had never been such spices as those the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

ekegusii: Erio akabeka ase amaboko ’omwana oye Yakobo endagera eria engiya aroisetie, amo nomogati.
english: Then she handed to her son Jacob the tasty food and the bread she had made.

ekegusii: Esteri agakwana na Hataki, akamotebia airane ase Moredekai, amotebie,
english: Then she instructed him to say to Mordecai,

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoboria, “Naki oranyare goteba ng’a nonyanchete, ekero enkoro yao etari amo nainche? Gwankoreire echeche chintunda isato na torantebia obobisi bwe chinguru chiao.”
english: Then she said to him, "How can you say, 'I love you,' when you won't confide in me? This is the third time you have made a fool of me and haven't told me the secret of your great strength."

ekegusii: Erio akamoiraneria, “Nimbwate omosomba one omoiseke, Bilia. Motware, erinde inyore abana korwa asare, barokwe abana baane, na goetera asare na inche inyore oroiboro.”
english: Then she said, "Here is Bilhah, my maidservant. Sleep with her so that she can bear children for me and that through her I too can build a family."

ekegusii: Erio akarenta endagera eyio ase Saulo na abasomba baye, nabarabwo bakayeria. Nyuma y’ayio bakaimoka, bakagenda ase obotuko obwo.
english: Then she set it before Saul and his men, and they ate. That same night they got up and left.

ekegusii: Abigaeli agatebia abasomba baye, “Tang’ana mogende, nainche nkobabwatia inde.” Korende tatebetie Nabali, omosacha oye.
english: Then she told her servants, "Go on ahead; I'll follow you." But she did not tell her husband Nabal.

ekegusii: akamotebia amang’ana ayio ayio, agateba, “Omoibirania oyo omosomba kwarenta aa nabo asoa asende gonkorera echeche.
english: Then she told him this story: "That Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me.

ekegusii: Naende akaimokia esani ere nemegati eria, akayeterekera Amunoni, korende ere akaanga koria. Amunoni agateba, “Tiga abanto bonsi barue aa asende.” Ase igo kera omonto agasoka isiko.
english: Then she took the pan and served him the bread, but he refused to eat. "Send everyone out of here," Amnon said. So everyone left him.

ekegusii: Erio akagenda, agaikaransa are ake, ase oboare bw’okoruta omogwe, ekiagera nigo atebete, “Tinkorora omwana one kagokwa.” Ekero aikaransete amorigereretie, agaaka eriogi riaye, akarera.
