english: Then she went off and sat down nearby, about a bowshot away, for she thought, "I cannot watch the boy die." And as she sat there nearby, she began to sob.

ekegusii: Erio Sekania, mosinto o Yehieli, oyo bw’eamate ya Elamu, agakwana na Ezara, akamotebia, “Intwe titori abegenwa ase Nyasae oito, ekiagera twanyuomire abakungu b’ebisaku ebiao bi’abanto b’ense eye. Nonya nabo, ogosemeria ngotigarete koba ase Abaisraeli.
english: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, said to Ezra, "We have been unfaithful to our God by marrying foreign women from the peoples around us. But in spite of this, there is still hope for Israel.

ekegusii: Sekemu agatebia ise Dina na bamura bamwabo, “Nyanchere aya naboria asemore, kende gionsi moramborie nindue.
english: Then Shechem said to Dinah's father and brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and I will give you whatever you ask.

ekegusii: Then Shechem's father Hamor went out to talk with Jacob.
english: Hamori, ise Sekemu, akaimoka akagenda o Yakobo gokwana nere.

ekegusii: Aase agwo nao ching’ondi chirabe chikorisia abe buna oborisia bwabo, na amatuuri atigirwe nabanda nairwe nabarisia bakonakong’anya‐ng’anya.
english: Then sheep will graze as in their own pasture; lambs will feed among the ruins of the rich.

ekegusii: Oyo nenyaroka ya Ibrahimu; ekiagera Saitani omosibire emiaka eye ikomi na etano na etato, temogwenereti asiborwe korwa ase egesibo eke ase rituko ri’Esabato?”
english: Then should not this woman, a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be set free on the Sabbath day from what bound her?"

ekegusii: Simeoni akabasesenia, agatebia Mariamu ng’ina, “Rora, Omwana oyo obekirwe ase okogwa na ogotenena ase abange b’Abaisraeli, abe ekiorokererio kerabe kegokwanwa mamincha,
english: Then Simeon blessed them and said to Mary, his mother: "This child is destined to cause the falling and rising of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be spoken against,

ekegusii: Simion akairaneria, “Insabera inwe ase Omonene, ng’a amang’ana aya mwakwanire tabaisa gocha konyora nonya nerimo riabo.”
english: Then Simon answered, "Pray to the Lord for me so that nothing you have said may happen to me."

ekegusii: Nabo Simion Petero narenge nomoyio o birende, akayong’usa, agaaka omosomba bw’omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto kwaye gw’okorio. Na omosomba oria erieta riaye nigo are korokwa Maliko.
english: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priest's servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servant's name was Malchus.)

ekegusii: Then Simon Peter, who was behind him, arrived and went into the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying there,
english: Erio Simion Petero agacha, akamotunyana, agasoa oboina ime, akarora ebitambaa bireo,

ekegusii: Abanto amagana atano na rimo b’egesaku kia Dani, babogoretie ebirwanero, bakaimoka korwa Sora na Esitaoli, bagatiira,
english: Then six hundred men from the clan of the Danites, armed for battle, set out from Zorah and Eshtaol.

ekegusii: Sulemani akaboka, akamanya ng’a omaanoreirwe ayio goetera ase chindoto. Erio akagenda Yerusalemu, agatenena bosio bw’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene, akaruera Omonene ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa na eki’omorembe. Nyuma y’ayio agakorera abasomba baye bonsi omoyega.
english: Then Solomon awoke-- and he realized it had been a dream. He returned to Jerusalem, stood before the ark of the Lord's covenant and sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings. Then he gave a feast for all his court.

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agachaka koagacha enyomba y’Omonene agwo Yerusalemu, igoro ase egetunwa kia Moria, agwo ase Omonene aorokerete Daudi ise, Daudi nigo achorete aase agwo ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani Omoyebusi kiarenge.
english: Then Solomon began to build the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to his father David. It was on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite, the place provided by David.

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akabora, “Omonene obekire erioba igoro, korende otebire ng’a narigetie komenya ase omosunte ekerima.
english: Then Solomon said, "The LORD has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akabora: “Omonene otebire ng’a narigetie komenya ase omosunte ekerima.
english: Then Solomon said, "The LORD has said that he would dwell in a dark cloud;

ekegusii: Then Solomon spoke to all Israel-- to the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, to the judges and to all the leaders in Israel, the heads of families--
english: Sulemani agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi, abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi chilifu, na ab’amagana, na abagambi ebina, na abaraai bonsi b’Abaisraeli, nabwo abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli.

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agatenena bosio bw’egesasimero ki’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye.
english: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani agatenena bosio bw’egesasimero ki’Omonene ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, akarambora amaboko aye gochia igoro,
english: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven

ekegusii: Sulemani agasangereria abagaaka b’Abaisraeli, na abatang’ani bonsi b’ebisaku biabo, na abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, agwo Yerusalemu, erinde bagende korenta Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, korwa ase Omochie o Daudi, noro Sayoni.
english: Then Solomon summoned to Jerusalem the elders of Israel, all the heads of the tribes and the chiefs of the Israelite families, to bring up the ark of the LORD's covenant from Zion, the City of David.

ekegusii: Sulemani agatebigwa ng’a Adonia omoirokire na obwatire emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero, ogoteba: “Ritang’ani tiga omoruoti Sulemani andiere eira y’ogotiana ng’a takong’ita inche, omosomba oye, nomoro.”
english: Then Solomon was told, "Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon and is clinging to the horns of the altar. He says, 'Let King Solomon swear to me today that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.'"

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Sulemani akagenda agwo Esioni‐Geberi na Eloti ase engegu y’enyancha, ase ense ya Edomu.
english: Then Solomon went to Ezion Geber and Elath on the coast of Edom.

ekegusii: Erio Sulemani akairana korwa agwo aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa agwo Gibeoni, korwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, akagenda Yerusalemu na akaba okogambera Abaisraeli.
english: Then Solomon went to Jerusalem from the high place at Gibeon, from before the Tent of Meeting. And he reigned over Israel.

ekegusii: Abande bagachaka komotwera amate, na komotuba obosio, na komoaka chinkundi, na komotebia, “Bana!” Abarendi nabarabwo bakamoaka chindoe.
english: Then some began to spit at him; they blindfolded him, struck him with their fists, and said, "Prophesy!" And the guards took him and beat him.

ekegusii: Korende amaato ande agacha korwa Tiberia ang’e naase aria bariete emegati ekero Omonene ayesesenetie.
english: Then some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi korwa Antiokia na Ikonio bagacha, na ekero bagenkire abanto bagaaka Paulo amagena, bakamokurura gochia isiko y’omochie, bagakaga ng’a okure,
english: Then some Jews came from Antioch and Iconium and won the crowd over. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, thinking he was dead.

ekegusii: Abalawi baria barenge Abakohati na Abakora bagatenena gotogia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ase eriogi rinene mono.
english: Then some Levites from the Kohathites and Korahites stood up and praised the LORD, the God of Israel, with very loud voice.

ekegusii: Naende abande abarenge amo naintwe bakagenda ase oboina, bakarora buna abakungu batebete, korende ere tibamorora.”
english: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had said, but him they did not see."

ekegusii: Korende abande ase Abafarisai, abwo begenete, bagatenena, bagateba, “Negwenerete kobarokia na kobachika babwate amachiko a Musa.”
english: Then some of the believers who belonged to the party of the Pharisees stood up and said, "The Gentiles must be circumcised and required to obey the law of Moses."

ekegusii: Abanto bande abanene b’Abaefraimu: Asaria, mosinto o Yohanani, na Berekia mosinto o Mesilemoti, na Yehisikia, mosinto o Salumu, na Amasa, mosinto o Hadilai, bagatenena gokania abarwani baria barenge koirana korwa ase esegi,
english: Then some of the leaders in Ephraim-- Azariah son of Jehohanan, Berekiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai-- confronted those who were arriving from the war.

ekegusii: Erio abande ase aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai bakamotebia, “Omworokia, ntorigetie torore egekone buna ekemanyererio korwa asore.”
english: Then some of the Pharisees and teachers of the law said to him, "Teacher, we want to see a miraculous sign from you."

ekegusii: Ekero ekio Abafarisai na aborokia b’amariko bakarwa Yerusalemu, bagachiera Yeso, bakamoboria,
english: Then some Pharisees and teachers of the law came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,

ekegusii: Abarwani nabarabwo bakamoboria, “Naintwe inki torakore?” Akabairaneria, “Timourereria monto onde ase chinguru gose ase obosoeri bw’oborimo; naende moisaneke neng’eria yaino.”
english: Then some soldiers asked him, "And what should we do?" He replied, "Don't extort money and don't accuse people falsely-- be content with your pay."

ekegusii: Then some stood up and gave this false testimony against him:
english: Na abande bagatenena bakamotebera oborimo, bakabora,

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo agacha, akabatebia, “Rora, abanto baria mwabegete echela ime nigo bateneine ase Hekalu ime kworokereria abanto.”
english: Then someone came and said, "Look! The men you put in jail are standing in the temple courts teaching the people."

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo atebetigwe ng’a abanto bakorire ebibe ase Omonene ase okoria chinyama chire namanyinga ime yabo, akabora. “Mwakorire ogosaria. Bono torunkania rigena rinene gocha aiga asende.”
english: Then someone said to Saul, "Look, the men are sinning against the LORD by eating meat that has blood in it." "You have broken faith," he said. "Roll a large stone over here at once."

ekegusii: Then summon me and I will answer, or let me speak, and you reply.
english: “Erio aye ondangerie, na inche ng’itabe, gose ing’a ribaga nkwane, naye ong’iranerie.

ekegusii: Orusie ebitinya biria bitubete chinyama chi’enda; naboigo nebi’eriini, ne chinyigo chionsi ibere, amo nebitinya bichitubete; obisambere ase egesasimero igoro.
english: Then take all the fat around the inner parts, the covering of the liver, and both kidneys with the fat on them, and burn them on the altar.

ekegusii: rirorio oimokie esindake omotue ogoto, na esindake eria esoe ase omotobwa bw’egesieri kiao, nere nabe omosomba oo ase obogima bwaye bwonsi. Naboigo orakore nase omosomba oo omokungu.
english: then take an awl and push it through his ear lobe into the door, and he will become your servant for life. Do the same for your maidservant.

ekegusii: Oimokie esani y’ekioma, oyetenenie buna orwaki ase egati yao na omochie oyio; oyorigererie, oyoboere na ogenderere koyoboera. Ayio nabe ekemanyererio ase Abaisraeli.
english: Then take an iron pan, place it as an iron wall between you and the city and turn your face toward it. It will be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This will be a sign to the house of Israel.

ekegusii: Then take it to your father to eat, so that he may give you his blessing before he dies."
english: Erio oirere iso arie, erinde anyare kogosesenia ritang’ani atarakwa.”

ekegusii: Oimokie echuba ere namaguta akweakwa, oyaumorere omotwe oye igoro, okwane: Aya naro Omonene atebire: Nagoakire amaguta, obe omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli. Erio oigore egesieri, osoke otame; tobaisa gotebana.”
english: Then take the flask and pour the oil on his head and declare, 'This is what the LORD says: I anoint you king over Israel.' Then open the door and run; don't delay!"

ekegusii: Erio obirusie ase amaboko abo, obisambere ase egesasimero igoro y’ekeng’wanso keria kere ne rimisu rigiya rikogwenera Omonene. Eke nekeng’wanso ki’omorero.
english: Then take them from their hands and burn them on the altar along with the burnt offering for a pleasing aroma to the LORD, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: erio obairanerie, obatebie: Nigo nasorora omoruoti ng’a tabaisa kong’irania naende gochia ase enyomba ya Yonathani, mbaise gochia gokwerao.”
english: then tell them, 'I was pleading with the king not to send me back to Jonathan's house to die there.'"

ekegusii: Inamobairanerie: Eke nekeng’wanso ki’Epasaka y’Omonene, ekiagera naetete chinyomba chi’Abaisraeli aaria Misiri ekero aitete Abamisiri, korende agatiga chinyomba chiaito.” Erio abanto bagatung’ama inse, bagasasima Nyasae.
english: then tell them, 'It is the Passover sacrifice to the LORD, who passed over the houses of the Israelites in Egypt and spared our homes when he struck down the Egyptians.'" Then the people bowed down and worshiped.

ekegusii: Erio obatebie: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Nintindie abanto bonsi bamenyete ase ense eye, amo nabaruoti bare ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi, na abakuani, na ababani, na abanto bonsi ba Yerusalemu.
english: then tell them, 'This is what the LORD says: I am going to fill with drunkenness all who live in this land, including the kings who sit on David's throne, the priests, the prophets and all those living in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase igo bamura bamwabo Yusufu ikomi bagatirimboka gochia Misiri kogora endagera.
english: Then ten of Joseph's brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

ekegusii: Erio abanto chilifu ikomi, abachoretwe korwa ase Abaisraeli bonsi, bakagenda korwania omochie o Gibea, na esegi eria ekaba entindi. Ababenjamin tibamanyete ng’a ogosirigwa kwabo konya gwaikire ang’e.
english: Then ten thousand of Israel's finest men made a frontal attack on Gibeah. The fighting was so heavy that the Benjamites did not realize how near disaster was.

ekegusii: then the Almighty will be your gold, the choicest silver for you.
english: erinde Omonguru bweka abe etahabu yao, na efeta yao ere nengencho enene.

ekegusii: Erio Abaameleki na Abakanani abamenyete ase ense y’ebitunwa, bagatirimboka bakarwania Abaisraeli abwo, bakababua na kobaseria, bakababwatia goikera Horima.
english: Then the Amalekites and Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down and attacked them and beat them down all the way to Hormah.

ekegusii: Inabogoretigwe n’Omoika, na omomalaika oria akang’ira goika ase erooro. Aroro nkarora omokungu oikaransete igoro ase eng’iti embariri mono, eichire amarieta ay’okorama arikire asere, eyare nemetwe etano na ebere, ne chingunchara ikomi.
english: Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a desert. There I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns.

ekegusii: Na omomalaika oria naroche oteneine ase enyancha na ase ense enyomo akaimokereria okoboko kwaye gw’okorio igoro,
english: Then the angel I had seen standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand to heaven.

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene, oyio otang’aine omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, akairana nyuma yabo. Ne riire riria riateneine buna esiiro bosio bwabo rikairana nyuma yabo,
english: Then the angel of God, who had been traveling in front of Israel's army, withdrew and went behind them. The pillar of cloud also moved from in front and stood behind them,

ekegusii: Erio naende omomalaika bw’Omonene akagenda bosio, agatenena aase aagote mono, ase ribaga ritarenge ri’okogobera gochia ensemo ya borio, gose eya bomosi.
english: Then the angel of the LORD moved on ahead and stood in a narrow place where there was no room to turn, either to the right or to the left.

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene agachika Gadi atebie Daudi ng’a agende atenenie egesasimero ase Omonene agwo ase ekeooreri ki’Orinani, Omoyebusi.
english: Then the angel of the LORD ordered Gad to tell David to go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria bw’Omonene akaboria, “Aye Omonene bw’Emeganda, ngoika ririri orabe otari kororera Yerusalemu, na emechie y’Abayuda amabera, eyio kwabeire kogechirie mono nero ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere (70)?”
english: Then the angel of the LORD said, "LORD Almighty, how long will you withhold mercy from Jerusalem and from the towns of Judah, which you have been angry with these seventy years?"

ekegusii: Naende omomalaika oria bw’Omonene akagenda ase enchera yarenge engote gati y’emegondo y’emesabibu, ne chimbago nchiarenge ase chinsemo chionsi ibere.
english: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow path between two vineyards, with walls on both sides.

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene akamotebia, “Irana gochia ase moibori omino, na bwekeyie asare.”
english: Then the angel of the LORD told her, "Go back to your mistress and submit to her."

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika bw’Omonene akagenda ase egetwori ki’Abaasuri agaita abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato na isano (185,000). Ekero abanto babogete mambia, bakarora emebere y’abanto bakwete ere aande onsi.
english: Then the angel of the LORD went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand men in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up the next morning-- there were all the dead bodies!

ekegusii: Omomalaika akamotebia, “Eboyie, obeke ebikoroto biao.” Agakora bo. Naende akamotebia, “Beka eganchwa yao, ontunyane!”
english: Then the angel said to him, "Put on your clothes and sandals." And Peter did so. "Wrap your cloak around you and follow me," the angel told him.

ekegusii: Erio agantebia, “Amache aria kwaroche, aase omotayayi oria aikaransete, ayio nabanto, na emeganda y’abanto, na ebisaku, na emenwa.
english: Then the angel said to me, "The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations and languages.

ekegusii: Omomalaika oria agantebia, “Rika aya: Mbasesenirie abarangerigwe ase omoyega bw’enyangi y’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi.” Naende agantebia, “Amang’ana aya namang’ana ay’ekeene a Nyasae.”
english: Then the angel said to me, "Write: 'Blessed are those who are invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb!'" And he added, "These are the true words of God."

ekegusii: Na omomalaika oria agantebia, “Naki ogokumia? Ningotebie obobisi bw’omokungu oyio, na obw’eng’iti eyio emobogoretie ere nemetwe etano na ebere, ne chingunchara ikomi.
english: Then the angel said to me: "Why are you astonished? I will explain to you the mystery of the woman and of the beast she rides, which has the seven heads and ten horns.

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria akanyorokia orooche rw’amache ’obogima rokomeka‐meka buna ekerore gekomeka‐meka, rokorua ase ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae na eki’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi,
english: Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life, as clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of God and of the Lamb

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika akabogoria egetaabo, akageichoria omorero korwa ase egesasimero akayoruta igoro ase ense, na agwo bikaba ogoaka gw’enkoba, na okogukura, na okomesa, na omotengecho bw’ense.
english: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it on the earth; and there came peals of thunder, rumblings, flashes of lightning and an earthquake.

ekegusii: Omomalaika oria okwanete nainche ritang’ani agacha naende, agantura buna omonto oraire agoturwa korwa ase chitoro.
english: Then the angel who talked with me returned and wakened me, as a man is wakened from his sleep.

ekegusii: Omomalaika oria orenge gokwana nainche agacha naende, agantebia, “Imokia amaiso ao, orore ngento ki keria kegocha.”
english: Then the angel who was speaking to me came forward and said to me, "Look up and see what this is that is appearing."

ekegusii: Then the angel who was speaking to me left, and another angel came to meet him
english: Erio nkarora omomalaika oria konya okwanire nainche ogocha, na omomalaika onde agacha koumerana nere,

ekegusii: Ase ayio omomalaika oria agantebia, “Raria, otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Nigo inde ne risemi rinene ase engencho ya Yerusalemu na Sayoni.
english: Then the angel who was speaking to me said, "Proclaim this word: This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'I am very jealous for Jerusalem and Zion,

ekegusii: Omokuani oyio oakire amaguta, aire amanyinga make ay’eeri eyio ase Eema y’Omosangererekano ime.
english: Then the anointed priest is to take some of the bull's blood into the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Omokuani oyoakire amaguta aimokie amanyinga make ay’eeri eria, ayarente ime ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull's blood and carry it into the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Erio akagwenera abatomwa na abagaaka amo nab’ekanisa yonsi gochora abanto korwa ase egati yabo na kobatoma Antiokia amo na Paulo na Barnaba. Bagatoma Yuda ore korokwa Barsaba, na Sila, abatang’ani b’abamwabo,
english: Then the apostles and elders, with the whole church, decided to choose some of their own men and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas. They chose Judas (called Barsabbas) and Silas, two men who were leaders among the brothers.

ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe bagatorasa intwe, abasomba bao, korwa orwaki igoro; abande b’abasomba bao bakure, na Uria Omohiti, omosomba oo, nere okure.”
english: Then the archers shot arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king's men died. Moreover, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead."

ekegusii: Abakalidayo baria bagatebia omoruoti ase omonwa bw’Ekearamaik, “Aye omoruoti ochie kare! Totebie intwe abasomba bao chindoto echio, na intwe ntonyare kogotebia engencho yaye.”
english: Then the astrologers answered the king in Aramaic, "O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will interpret it."

ekegusii: Abanene ba Babeli bagacha, bagakora obonyaka nere, na ase okogania koria okobe bakamosoyia ase ogotacheneka, na nyuma gasoigwe ase ogotacheneka, akabatiga, akabagecha.
english: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her. After she had been defiled by them, she turned away from them in disgust.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Abakalidayo nabairane gocha naende ase omochie oyo, bayobwate na koyosamba nomorero.
english: Then the Babylonians will return and attack this city; they will capture it and burn it down.'

ekegusii: Ase igo abanto ba Benjamin bakarora ng’a babuirwe. Abaisraeli bakairana gochia nyuma korwa ase Ababenjamin, ekiagera begenete Abaisraeli baria baboerete omochie o Gibea.
english: Then the Benjamites saw that they were beaten. Now the men of Israel had given way before Benjamin, because they relied on the ambush they had set near Gibeah.

ekegusii: Erio orobebe rogatirimboka gochia akarooche ga Kana. Emechie yarenge irianyi y’akarooche aka neya Efraimu, nonya yarenge ase orogongo rwa Manase. Orobebe rwa Manase rokagenderera goika sugusu y’akarooche, rogatwomera Enyancha Enene.
english: Then the boundary continued south to the Kanah Ravine. There were towns belonging to Ephraim lying among the towns of Manasseh, but the boundary of Manasseh was the northern side of the ravine and ended at the sea.

ekegusii: Erio rotirimboke robwatie orooche rwa Yorodan rotwomere Enyancha y’Omonyo. Eye nero erabe ense yaino, ne chimbebe chiaye chietanaineo.”
english: Then the boundary will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. "'This will be your land, with its boundaries on every side.'"

ekegusii: Emebere yabo ekwete nebe endagera ye chinyoni chia igoro ne ching’iti chi’orosana. Omonto tagochiseria ekero chikoria emebere eyio.
english: Then the carcasses of this people will become food for the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

ekegusii: Amakerubi abwo bakaimoka gochia igoro. Ebitongwa ebio nabio biria naroche ang’e norooche rwa Kebari.
english: Then the cherubim rose upward. These were the living creatures I had seen by the Kebar River.

ekegusii: Erio abakerubi bakarambora chimbaba chiabo, na amagoro arenge mbarabare yabo; na obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli bokaba igoro yabo.
english: Then the cherubim, with the wheels beside them, spread their wings, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

ekegusii: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, "Today I am reminded of my shortcomings.
english: Erio omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa agatebia Farao, “Bono nainyoire okomocha kwane.

ekegusii: Erio abakuani abanene na abagaaka b’abanto bagasangererekana ase egoora y’omokuani omonene oyore korokwa Kayafa;
english: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,

ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bagasangererekana ase ekegambero, bakabora, “Ninki togokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo nigo agokora ebikone ebinge.
english: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the Sanhedrin. "What are we accomplishing?" they asked. "Here is this man performing many miraculous signs.

ekegusii: Erio ekanisa ekanyora omorembe ase chinsemo chionsi chia Boyahudi, na Galili, na Samaria. Ekagenderera koagachwa ase okoiroka kw’Omonene, na ase okoremia kw’Omoika Omochenu ekamentekana.
english: Then the church throughout Judea, Galilee and Samaria enjoyed a time of peace. It was strengthened; and encouraged by the Holy Spirit, it grew in numbers, living in the fear of the Lord.

ekegusii: Erio chindwaki chi’omochie chikabochorwa, na abanto bonsi b’esegi bagatama botuko, bagaetera egeita kiarenge gatigati ye chindwaki ibere, ang’e nomogondo bw’omoruoti, nonya Abakalidayo banaaretie omochie chinsemo chionsi. Bakagenda gochia ase Ekerubo Ekiomo.
english: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled at night through the gate between the two walls near the king's garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,

ekegusii: Erio chindwaki chi’omochie chikabochorwa, na abanto bonsi b’esegi bagatama botuko, bagaetera ase egeita kiarenge gati‐gati ye chindwaki ibere, ang’e nomogondo bw’omoruoti, nonya Abakalidayo banaaretie omochie ase chinsemo chionsi. Bagatama gochia ase Ekerubo Ekiomo.
english: Then the city wall was broken through, and the whole army fled. They left the city at night through the gate between the two walls near the king's garden, though the Babylonians were surrounding the city. They fled toward the Arabah,

ekegusii: Erio riire rigatuba Eema y’Omosangererekano, na obonene bw’Omonene bogaichora ime ase Obomenyo.
english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the tabernacle.

ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria, omonene akairaneria, “Inche nigo nagorete obobiare obo ase chibesa chinyinge.” Paulo agateba, “Inche n’Omorumi omobiare.”
english: Then the commander said, "I had to pay a big price for my citizenship." "But I was born a citizen," Paul replied.

ekegusii: Erio Rabi‐Sake agatenena, agaaka eriogi rinene ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda, agateba, “Igwa ring’ana ri’omoruoti omonene, ore omoruoti bw’Abaasuri.
english: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew, "Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

ekegusii: Erio omochiki oria omonene agatenena, agaaka eriogi rinene ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda, agateba, “Igwa ring’ana ri’omoruoti omonene, ore omoruoti bw’Abaasuri!
english: Then the commander stood and called out in Hebrew: "Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria!

ekegusii: Nkarigereria, nkarora ekemumeko kiaroiseirie risasi gekomumoka, na omokungu oikaransete ase egetonga keria ime.
english: Then the cover of lead was raised, and there in the basket sat a woman!

ekegusii: Chiombe chiria chikagenda chikona‐kwana, chikabwatia enchera endonge ekogenda Beti‐Semesi, tichiagobera aande, ensemo y’okorio gose ey’okobee, na abagambi b’Abafilisti bakaba bagochitunyana korwa nyuma, goika ase orobebe rwa Beti‐Semesi.
english: Then the cows went straight up toward Beth Shemesh, keeping on the road and lowing all the way; they did not turn to the right or to the left. The rulers of the Philistines followed them as far as the border of Beth Shemesh.

ekegusii: Omoetiopia nere agacha, agatebia omoruoti, “Nakorenteire amang’ana amaya, aye omonene one. Rero Omonene okoruseirie egesiomba ase baria bakoimokera gokorwania.”
english: Then the Cushite arrived and said, "My lord the king, hear the good news! The LORD has delivered you today from all who rose up against you."

ekegusii: Abarwani b’esegi amo nomotang’ani obo, na abarendi baria b’Abayahudi bakabwata Yeso, bakamosiba.
english: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him

ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamotiga, na rora, abamalaika bagacha, bakamokorera.
english: Then the devil left him, and angels came and attended him.

ekegusii: Erio Saitani akamoira goika omochie omochenu, akamobeka igoro ase egechuria gie Hekalu egetambe mono.
english: Then the devil took him to the holy city and had him stand on the highest point of the temple.

ekegusii: Omworokigwa oria Yeso anchete agatebia Petero, “Nere Omonene.” Erio Simion Petero, agachia koigwa ng’a n’Omonene, akeboyia eanga yaye (ekiagera arenge getirianda), akeruta enyancha ime.
english: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, "It is the Lord!" As soon as Simon Peter heard him say, "It is the Lord," he wrapped his outer garment around him (for he had taken it off) and jumped into the water.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio aborokigwa baye bagacha, bakamoboria, “Inee! Kwamanyire ng’a Abafarisai, ekero baigwete ring’ana riria, mbagechetigwe?”
english: Then the disciples came to him and asked, "Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?"

ekegusii: Then the disciples came to Jesus in private and asked, "Why couldn't we drive it out?"
english: Erio aborokigwa bagachiera Yeso bobisi, bakabora, “Ninki kiagera intwe totanyara korusia ekerecha keria?”

ekegusii: Erio aborokigwa baye bakamanya ng’a Yohana Omobatisi nere are kobatebia.
english: Then the disciples understood that he was talking to them about John the Baptist.

ekegusii: Then the disciples went back to their homes,
english: Erio aborokigwa baria bakagenda chinsobo.

ekegusii: Na barabwo bakaimoka, bakarandia chinsemo chionsi. Omonene akaba ogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo, na goikerania ring’ana ase ebimanyererio bie chinguru ebiatunyanete. Amina.
english: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.

ekegusii: Ase igo, enchoka eria ekaba nendamwamu ase omokungu oria, ekagenda gokora esegi ase oroiboro rwaye oro rwatigarete, ase abwo babwatete amachiko a Nyasae, na bare noborori bwa Yeso.
english: Then the dragon was enraged at the woman and went off to make war against the rest of her offspring-- those who obey God's commandments and hold to the testimony of Jesus.

ekegusii: Abagaaka baria na abanto bande bonsi abarenge ase etureti agwo ase egeita ki’omochie bakairaneria, “Ee, mbirori tore. Tiga Omonene asesenie omokungu oyio orache ase enka yao abe buna Raeli na Lea, abwo baiborerete Israeli abana abange bakaba egesaku. Aye osesenigwe ase egati y’Abaefarati na omanyekane ase Bethlehemu.
english: Then the elders and all those at the gate said, "We are witnesses. May the LORD make the woman who is coming into your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel. May you have standing in Ephrathah and be famous in Bethlehem.

ekegusii: “Erio abagaaka baria b’omochie barangerie omonto oria, bakwane nere, na karagenderere gokana ng’a tatageti gotwara omokungu oria,
english: Then the elders of his town shall summon him and talk to him. If he persists in saying, "I do not want to marry her,"

ekegusii: Erio abagaaka b’omochie oranyorekane ore ang’e kobua nase omonto oyio akwerete, bachore ritororo ritarakorigwa emeremo, gose ritarasiberwa rikorogoto ase ogokurura ebinto.
english: Then the elders of the town nearest the body shall take a heifer that has never been worked and has never worn a yoke

ekegusii: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.
english: Aborokigwa baria ikomi nomo bakagenda Galili, bagaika egetunwa keria Yeso abachigete.

ekegusii: Erio agwo omoerio ochiche, ekero arae Nyasae Tata oboruoti, nyuma gasaririe kera obogambi na kera okobua ne chinguru.
english: Then the end will come, when he hands over the kingdom to God the Father after he has destroyed all dominion, authority and power.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bairanete korwa ase obosomba bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli; bakarua chieri ikomi na ibere ase engencho y’Abaisraeli bonsi, naende bakarua chimingichi emerongo kianda na isano nemo (96), ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi emerongo etano na ebere, na isano na ibere (77). Naende bakarua chigoree ikomi na ibere chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ebibe. Ching’iti echio chionsi nigo chiaruetwe chikaba ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase Omonene.
english: Then the exiles who had returned from captivity sacrificed burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven male lambs and, as a sin offering, twelve male goats. All this was a burnt offering to the LORD.

ekegusii: Na amaiso abo bonsi babere akaramokigwa, bakamanya ng’a ngetirianda bare; bagatabora amato ’omoko, bakayabwatania, bakeboyia.
english: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they realized they were naked; so they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings for themselves.

ekegusii: Erio amaiso ’abanto abwo bakorora tagoukora, na amato ’abanto abwo bakoigwa naigwe.
english: Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

ekegusii: Erio abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abayuda na Ababenjamin amo nabakuani na Abalawi, kera omonto oyo Nyasae akunire omoika oye ng’a atiire, erinde aagache naende enyomba y’Omonene aaria Yerusalemu, bakebeka ang’e.
english: Then the family heads of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests and Levites-- everyone whose heart God had moved-- prepared to go up and build the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Erio ise akamanya ng’a nensa eria eria atebetigwe na Yeso, “Omwana oo nabe moyo!” Akeegena ere, na enyomba yaye yonsi.
english: Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, "Your son will live." So he and all his household believed.

ekegusii: Erio omorero bw’Omonene okagwa korwa igoro, ogasamba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, ne chinko chiria, na amagena, na amaroba, ogakamia amache aria arenge ase omotaro.
english: Then the fire of the LORD fell and burned up the sacrifice, the wood, the stones and the soil, and also licked up the water in the trench.

ekegusii: Erio abaruoti abwo batano b’Abaamori: oyo o Yerusalemu, na oyo o Heburoni, na oyo o Yarimuti, na oyo o Lakisi, na oyo bw’Egiloni, bagasangererekana amo, bagatiira amo nabarwani babo bonsi, bagaetanana Gibeoni na koyoumokera.
english: Then the five kings of the Amorites-- the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish and Eglon-- joined forces. They moved up with all their troops and took up positions against Gibeon and attacked it.

ekegusii: Erio abanto baria batano bagendete koroota ense yaetanaine Laisi, bakaboria abanto barenge komo, “Inee! Momanyete ng’a ase enyomba eyemo ase echio nkereo egesibao ki’obokuani? Naende ebinyasae bi’ogosasimwa mbireo, amo nomogwekano obaachire, na oyo onyititoire na kobombwa. Ase ayio rengereria aya mogochia gokora.”
english: Then the five men who had spied out the land of Laish said to their brothers, "Do you know that one of these houses has an ephod, other household gods, a carved image and a cast idol? Now you know what to do."

ekegusii: “Onye naboigo, ise na ng’ina omoiseke oria bamoire ase abagaaka b’omochie oria, ase bakogambera agwo ase egeita, babarentere ebimanyererio bi’obwekungi bw’omoiseke oria.
english: then the girl's father and mother shall bring proof that she was a virgin to the town elders at the gate.

ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokarua ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba y’Omonene, bokagenda bogatenena igoro y’abakerubi baria.
english: Then the glory of the LORD departed from over the threshold of the temple and stopped above the cherubim.

ekegusii: Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaimokerera igoro, bokarua ase omokerubi oria, bokagenda ase omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba eria; enyomba eria egaichorwa ne riire, na eraaro egaichorwa nobomeka‐meku bw’obonene bw’Omonene.
english: Then the glory of the LORD rose from above the cherubim and moved to the threshold of the temple. The cloud filled the temple, and the court was full of the radiance of the glory of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio abarwani ba gavuna bakaira Yeso ime ase enyomba y’ekegambero, bakamosangererekera omoganda omogima bw’abarwani.
english: Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.

ekegusii: omoraria agaaka eriogi rinene, akabora, “Inwe abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, na ab’emenwa yonsi, mwachikirwe
english: Then the herald loudly proclaimed, "This is what you are commanded to do, O peoples, nations and men of every language:

ekegusii: Omokuani omonene akaimoka, na bonsi abarenge amo nere; abwo nabwo barenge b’Abasadukai. Bagaichorwa ne ribero,
english: Then the high priest and all his associates, who were members of the party of the Sadducees, were filled with jealousy.

ekegusii: Omokuani omonene akaboria Stefano, “Inee! Amang’ana ayio naboigo are?”
english: Then the high priest asked him, "Are these charges true?"

ekegusii: Erio omokuani omonene agatenena akamoboria, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”
english: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, "Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?"

ekegusii: Omokuani omonene agatenena gati‐gati, akaboria Yeso, okobora, “Tokoiraneria ing’ana? Inki aba bakogosoera?”
english: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, "Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?"

ekegusii: Erio omokuani omonene agatandora chianga chiaye, akabora, “Oramire Nyasae; abarori naba ki tokorigia? Mwaigure emerumi yaye akorama.
english: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, "He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.

ekegusii: Abanto abange b’ebisaku bionsi abwo bakorwania Arieli, ee, bonsi abakorwania omochie oyio, na gotagora chiburi chiaye, na koyorentera emechando, nigo barasirigwe, beebwe buna okorota gokwebwa, ee, buna okorora kwa botuko gokwebwa.
english: Then the hordes of all the nations that fight against Ariel, that attack her and her fortress and besiege her, will be as it is with a dream, with a vision in the night--

ekegusii: Erio ebioma biria, na amaroba, ne chitaai, ne chifeta, ne chitahabu, bionsi ebio bigasamunyoranwa, bikaba buna omoiriro ore ase ekeooreri ekero ki’eguru‐gura. Omwaga okairurukia ebinto biria gochia aare nonya nokoba kwabo tikwarorekana aande. Korende rigena riria riagete omogwekano oria rigakina, rikaba egetunwa ekenene kegaichora ase ense engima.
english: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver and the gold were broken to pieces at the same time and became like chaff on a threshing floor in the summer. The wind swept them away without leaving a trace. But the rock that struck the statue became a huge mountain and filled the whole earth.

ekegusii: Erio abateneneri b’Abaisraeli bakagenda ase Farao, bagateba, “Inki ogotokorera iga intwe abasomba bao?
english: Then the Israelite foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh: "Why have you treated your servants this way?

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaboria, “Mbarabi ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli batachicha ase omosangererekano, ase obosio bw’Omonene?” Barabwo konya barire eira na gotiana ng’a omonto onde bwensi otacheti ase Omonene agwo Misipa goika aitwe.
english: Then the Israelites asked, "Who from all the tribes of Israel has failed to assemble before the LORD?" For they had taken a solemn oath that anyone who failed to assemble before the LORD at Mizpah should certainly be put to death.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakarera ase Omonene, bagoteba, “Twakorire ebibe asore, ekiagera twagotigire aye Nyasae oito, na gokorera chinyasae chiria Baali.”
english: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, "We have sinned against you, forsaking our God and serving the Baals."

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe ase obosio bw’Omonene, bagachaka gokorera chinyasae chiare korokwa Baali.
english: Then the Israelites did evil in the eyes of the LORD and served the Baals.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaisraeli bakagenda korwana n’Ababenjamin rituko ria kabere.
english: Then the Israelites drew near to Benjamin the second day.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaimoka korwa ase erooro ya Sinai, bakagenda bakaba bakona‐gotoora egetwori ase egetwori, ne riire riria rigaika agwo ase erooro ya Parani, rikabeera aroro.
english: Then the Israelites set out from the Desert of Sinai and traveled from place to place until the cloud came to rest in the Desert of Paran.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenderera norogendo rwabo gochia ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, bagatoora aroro, moocha ya Yorodan, kororia Yeriko.
english: Then the Israelites traveled to the plains of Moab and camped along the Jordan across from Jericho.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bagatiira gochia Beteli, bakaba bakorera. Bagaikaransa aroro agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakeng’ata rituko riria goika mogoroba, na bakaruera Omonene ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe.
english: Then the Israelites, all the people, went up to Bethel, and there they sat weeping before the LORD. They fasted that day until evening and presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakabora, “Naki omonto oyo aranyare gotoa omobere oye toyorie?”
english: Then the Jews began to argue sharply among themselves, "How can this man give us his flesh to eat?"

ekegusii: Nabo Abayahudi bakamoboria, “Ngekone ki ogotworokia, ng’a nore noboronge bw’ogokora aya?”
english: Then the Jews demanded of him, "What miraculous sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?"

ekegusii: Erio bakaira Yeso korwa ase Kayafa goika enyomba enene y’ekegambero. Bokaba bogokiamoka, na barabwo abanyene tibasoa ime ase ekegambero, tibabaisa gocha kobekwa ogotacheneka korende bararia Epasaka.
english: Then the Jews led Jesus from Caiaphas to the palace of the Roman governor. By now it was early morning, and to avoid ceremonial uncleanness the Jews did not enter the palace; they wanted to be able to eat the Passover.

ekegusii: Then the Jews said, "See how he loved him!"
english: Erio Abayahudi bakabora, “Rora buna amwanchete.”

ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi abamenyete ang’e nababisa baito, bakaba bagocha gotokurera nonya ngoika ara ikomi, ng’a ababisa abwo nigo barachiche korwa ase chinsemo chionsi batorwanie.
english: Then the Jews who lived near them came and told us ten times over, "Wherever you turn, they will attack us."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti na abanto bonsi amo nere bakarua ekeng’wanso ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Then the king and all Israel with him offered sacrifices before the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti amo nabanto bonsi bakarua ebing’wanso ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akairaneria, akabatebia, “Ekeene, namanyire ng’a nigo moganetie koegwa chingaki, ekiagera mwamanyire ng’a amang’ana aane tari koonchoka.
english: Then the king answered, "I am certain that you are trying to gain time, because you realize that this is what I have firmly decided:

ekegusii: na omoruoti akamoboria, “Eting’ana Esteri, ninki origetie? Intebia eki oganetie; aye nokeegwe, nakeba nonya nekeng’ese ki’oboruoti bwane.”
english: Then the king asked, "What is it, Queen Esther? What is your request? Even up to half the kingdom, it will be given you."

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatoma abanto barangerie abagaaka bonsi b’Abayuda na aba Yerusalemu, bagasangererekana asare.
english: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatoma amang’ana, agasangereria amo abagaaka b’Abayuda na aba Yerusalemu,
english: Then the king called together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akamotebia, “Kora buna atebire, gachie omoake, omoite na komotindeka. Ase enchera eye onduserie inche na enyomba ya tata egesiomba ase engencho y’amanyinga atari na komocha aria Yoabu aiterete.
english: Then the king commanded Benaiah, "Do as he says. Strike him down and bury him, and so clear me and my father's house of the guilt of the innocent blood that Joab shed.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agachika Ebedi‐Meleki, Omoetiopia oria, akamotebia, “Ira abanto emerongo etato korwa aiga, ogende amo nabarabwo, na morusie Yeremia omobani korwa ase engoro ime, atarakwa.”
english: Then the king commanded Ebed-Melech the Cushite, "Take thirty men from here with you and lift Jeremiah the prophet out of the cistern before he dies."

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaimokia enyimbo eria y’etahabu, akayiorotera Esteri. Esteri akaimoka, agatenena ase obosio bw’omoruoti,
english: Then the king extended the gold scepter to Esther and she arose and stood before him.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akairaneria, agateba, “Omwana oyo ore moyo, kae omokungu oyo bwe ritang’ani, timobaisa konachana omwana oyo; omokungu oyo nere ng’ina.”
english: Then the king gave his ruling: "Give the living baby to the first woman. Do not kill him; she is his mother."

ekegusii: Omoruoti agachika Benaya, mosinto o Yehoyada, na ere akagenda agaaka Simei, akamoita. Ase ayio oboruoti bokabekwa chinguru ase okoboko gwa Sulemani.
english: Then the king gave the order to Benaiah son of Jehoiada, and he went out and struck Shimei down and killed him. The kingdom was now firmly established in Solomon's hands.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaroisia ekerogo ki’oboruoti, akagechabera amaino e chinchogu na agakeooma netahabu echenire.
english: Then the king made a great throne inlaid with ivory and overlaid with fine gold.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akaroisia ekerogo ekenene ki’oboruoti, akagechabera amaino e chinchogu, na agakeooma netahabu echenire.
english: Then the king made a great throne inlaid with ivory and overlaid with pure gold.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti bw’Abaasuari agachika, agateba, “Toma gochia aase aria oyomo bw’abakuani baria kwarusetie aroro, amenye aroro, orokererie abanto amachiko a Nyasae oria.”
english: Then the king of Assyria gave this order: "Have one of the priests you took captive from Samaria go back to live there and teach the people what the god of the land requires."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti oyio bw’Abaasuri agatoma Rabi‐Sake korwa Lakisi amo nabarwani esegi abange agende ase Hezekia agwo Yerusalemu. Rabi‐Sake agatenena ase omotaro bwe ritibo ria rogoro ase enchera ekogenda ase egetii ki’omosibia bw’ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga.
english: Then the king of Assyria sent his field commander with a large army from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem. When the commander stopped at the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Washerman's Field,

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Misiri akarangeria abaiboria baria, akababoria, “Nase ki mwakorire iga? Mwatigire abana abaisia bare moyo.”
english: Then the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them, "Why have you done this? Why have you let the boys live?"

ekegusii: Agwo omoruoti o Sodomu, na oyo o Gomora, na oyo bw’Adima, na oyo o Seboimu, na oyo o Bela, noro Soari, bakagenda, bakabwatana ase okorwana esegi ase ense omweya ya Sidimu,
english: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and drew up their battle lines in the Valley of Siddim

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti o Sugusu nache aagache chiburi, abue omochie ogiteire chindwaki. Abarwani esegi b’omoruoti o irianyi mbabugwe, nonya nabarwani baye abachore tibakonyara kobua, ekiagera mbaborwe chinguru.
english: Then the king of the North will come and build up siege ramps and will capture a fortified city. The forces of the South will be powerless to resist; even their best troops will not have the strength to stand.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio omoruoti o sugusu nache korwania omoruoti o irianyi, korende goika airane gochia ase ense yaye omonyene.
english: Then the king of the North will invade the realm of the king of the South but will retreat to his own country.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agachika Asipenasi, omoteneneri bw’abasomba b’enyomba yaye, arente abamura korwa ase egati y’Abaisraeli, abare ab’enyomba y’omoruoti, na abande abarenge ab’amasikani.
english: Then the king ordered Ashpenaz, chief of his court officials, to bring in some of the Israelites from the royal family and the nobility--

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia abarendi abwo bamoetanaine, “Imoka, moite abakuani abwo b’Omonene, ekiagera nigo babwataine na Daudi. Boigo barabwo mbamanyete ng’a otamire na tibantebetie.” Korende abasomba b’omoruoti bakaanga korambora amaboko abo ase ogoita abakuani b’Omonene.
english: Then the king ordered the guards at his side: "Turn and kill the priests of the LORD, because they too have sided with David. They knew he was fleeing, yet they did not tell me." But the king's officials were not willing to raise a hand to strike the priests of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti akaa Danieli amasikani amanene, na ebiegwa ebinene ebinge, naende akamobeka akaba omogambi igoro ase orogongo rwonsi rwa Babeli na omoteneneri omonene igoro y’abang’aini bonsi ba Babeli.
english: Then the king placed Daniel in a high position and lavished many gifts on him. He made him ruler over the entire province of Babylon and placed him in charge of all its wise men.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akabeka Sadaraka, na Meshaka, na Abedi‐Nego, bakaba abanene ase orogongo rwa Babeli.
english: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the province of Babylon.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti are koirana gaikire Yorodan, akanyora Abayuda bachire Giligali komorotota na komwambokia Yorodan.
english: Then the king returned and went as far as the Jordan. Now the men of Judah had come to Gilgal to go out and meet the king and bring him across the Jordan.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti akairana, akagenda nyomba mwaye, akeng’ata ase obotuko boria bwonsi. Tancha chigosori na kogokerwa konde gwonsi bikorwe, ne chitoro chikamobora.
english: Then the king returned to his palace and spent the night without eating and without any entertainment being brought to him. And he could not sleep.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia Amasa, “Rangeria Abayuda bache asende ekero amatuko atato ataraera; naye obe aiga ase engaki eyio.”
english: Then the king said to Amasa, "Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days, and be here yourself."

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia abasomba baye, “Timomanyeti ng’a rero omonto omonene, omogambi bw’Abaisraeli, okure?
english: Then the king said to his men, "Do you not realize that a prince and a great man has fallen in Israel this day?

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia omonto oria o Nyasae, “Sorora Omonene na onsabere inyore ogwancherwa, erinde okoboko kwane kogwene.” Na omonto oria o Nyasae agasorora Omonene, na okoboko kw’omoruoti gokaba buna kwarenge ritang’ani.
english: Then the king said to the man of God, "Intercede with the LORD your God and pray for me that my hand may be restored." So the man of God interceded with the LORD, and the king's hand was restored and became as it was before.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia omokungu oria, “Tobaisa kombisa gento kende gionsi ndakoborie.” Omokungu oria akamotebia, “Aye omonene one omoruoti, mboria.”
english: Then the king said to the woman, "Do not keep from me the answer to what I am going to ask you." "Let my lord the king speak," the woman said.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia Zadoki, “Bogoria Esanduku ya Nyasae, oyeiranie ase omochie ime. Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase Omonene, ere nang’iranie, ayenyorokie naende amo n’Obomenyo bwaye omonyene.
english: Then the king said to Zadok, "Take the ark of God back into the city. If I find favor in the LORD's eyes, he will bring me back and let me see it and his dwelling place again.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatebia Siba, “Rigereria, kera egento ekiarenge ekia Mefiboseti nebiao.” Siba akamotebia, “Nebekire inse asore. Koranche inyore ogwancherwa asore, aye omoruoti, omonene one.”
english: Then the king said to Ziba, "All that belonged to Mephibosheth is now yours." "I humbly bow," Ziba said. "May I find favor in your eyes, my lord the king."

ekegusii: Ase igo akaboria aegwe omoro. Na ekero arenteirwe omoro,
english: Then the king said, "Bring me a sword." So they brought a sword for the king.

ekegusii: Naende Omoruoti akarangeria Simei, akamotebia, “Eagachere enyomba ime ya Yerusalemu omenyeo, tobaisa korua aroro ogende aande onsi nonya ng’ake.
english: Then the king sent for Shimei and said to him, "Build yourself a house in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti agatoma abanto korangeria Ahimeleki omokuani, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, amo nabanto bonsi b’eamate yaye, na abakuani bonsi abarenge agwo Nobu. Abwo bonsi bakagenda ase omoruoti.
english: Then the king sent for the priest Ahimelech son of Ahitub and his father's whole family, who were the priests at Nob, and they all came to the king.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti akarangeria Siba, omosomba o Saulo, akamotebia, “Ebinto bionsi ebiarenge bia Saulo, na bionsi ebia nyomba mwaye, nabieire omochokoro bw’omonene oo.
english: Then the king summoned Ziba, Saul's servant, and said to him, "I have given your master's grandson everything that belonged to Saul and his family.

ekegusii: Ekero eting’ana mokaye yaikaransete agwo, omoruoti akamboria, “Nengaki eng’ana naki oganetie kogenda, naende indi orairane?” Ekero naroche ng’a omoruoti bwanchire kong’a ribaga, nkamotebia engaki eisaine.
english: Then the king, with the queen sitting beside him, asked me, "How long will your journey take, and when will you get back?" It pleased the king to send me; so I set a time.

ekegusii: Erio abaruoti b’ense, na abanene, na abatang’ani b’esegi, na abanda, na abanto bare ne chinguru, na kera omosomba, na oyotari omosomba, bakebisa ase amabwago na ase emetaro y’ebigoro,
english: Then the kings of the earth, the princes, the generals, the rich, the mighty, and every slave and every free man hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains.

ekegusii: Erio abasomba abarenge gokorera omoruoti bakamotebia, “Tiga abaiseke abekungi abanyabieni barigigwe barentwe asore, aye omoruoti.
english: Then the king's personal attendants proposed, "Let a search be made for beautiful young virgins for the king.

ekegusii: Erio Abakohati bakaimoka kogenda babogoretie ebinto ebichenu. Ekero konya bataraika ase egetwori bakanyora ng’a baria abande batenenirie Obomenyo boria Obochenu.
english: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the holy things. The tabernacle was to be set up before they arrived.

ekegusii: Ekero mokare ase ense y’ababisa baino, na ense yaino negendererete koba amatongo, ero negokere engaki y’ogotimoka okwo inwe mwayetangete.
english: Then the land will enjoy its sabbath years all the time that it lies desolate and you are in the country of your enemies; then the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.

ekegusii: Ense eria iyame okwama kwaye, na inwe monyore endagera mokoria na koigota, naende momenye ase obotoereru.
english: Then the land will yield its fruit, and you will eat your fill and live there in safety.

ekegusii: Ense yamire okwama kwaye okonge, Nyasae, aye ore Nyasae oito, otosesenie!
english: Then the land will yield its harvest, and God, our God, will bless us.

ekegusii: Erio abateneneri be chiamate chiabo bakarua ebiegwa bi’ogwancha; abaraai b’ebisaku na abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi chilifu na ab’amagana, na abateneneri b’emeremo y’omoruoti boigo bakarua.
english: Then the leaders of families, the officers of the tribes of Israel, the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and the officials in charge of the king's work gave willingly.

ekegusii: abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli, abwo barenge abateneneri igoro ase baria babaretwe,
english: Then the leaders of Israel, the heads of families who were the tribal leaders in charge of those who were counted, made offerings.

ekegusii: Erio abagambi b’egesaku ki’Abayuda mbetebie ase chinkoro chiabo ime: “Abanto bamenyete Yerusalemu nigo babwate chinguru goetera ase Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae obo.
english: Then the leaders of Judah will say in their hearts, 'The people of Jerusalem are strong, because the LORD Almighty is their God.'

ekegusii: Omonene akairaneria Ayubu korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime, akamotebia:
english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the storm. He said:

ekegusii: Omonene akaoroka agwo ore ime ase riire rire buna esiiro, narirorio rigatenena agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema eria.
english: Then the LORD appeared at the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the cloud stood over the entrance to the Tent.

ekegusii: Omonene akamboria, “Yeremia, ninki ekio oroche?” Nkamoiraneria, “Namako amaya, ee namaya mono, na ayande amabe, ee, namabe mono atanyare koriegwa.”
english: Then the LORD asked me, "What do you see, Jeremiah?" "Figs," I answered. "The good ones are very good, but the poor ones are so bad they cannot be eaten."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaboka buna nigo araire chitoro, na akaba buna omonto etuoni onyure edivai ogoaka eriogi;
english: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, as a man wakes from the stupor of wine.

ekegusii: Omonene akarangeria Samweli! Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa!”
english: Then the LORD called Samuel. Samuel answered, "Here I am."

ekegusii: Omonene agaika korwa igoro ore ime ase riire riria riare buna esiiro, agatenena agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema eria, akarangeria Haroni na Miriamu. Barabwo bagasuka gochia bosio,
english: Then the LORD came down in a pillar of cloud; he stood at the entrance to the Tent and summoned Aaron and Miriam. When both of them stepped forward,

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agaika korwa igoro ore riire ime, agakwana na Musa, na akaa abagaaka baria emerongo etano na ebere korwa ase omoika oria oria orenge ime ase Musa. Ekero omoika oria obete igoro asebare barabwo bakabana, korende tibagenderera gokora igo naende nonya ndinde.
english: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke with him, and he took of the Spirit that was on him and put the Spirit on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did not do so again.

ekegusii: Omonene agaika ore riire ime, agatenena amo nere, akararia erieta riaye OMONENE.
english: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and stood there with him and proclaimed his name, the LORD.

ekegusii: Na orobaru roria Omonene Nyasae arusetie ase omonto oria akarotonga rokaba omokungu, akamoirera omonto oria.
english: Then the LORD God made a woman from the rib he had taken out of the man, and he brought her to the man.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akameria omobono ogakina, na Yona agakenderera inse yaye, agatimoka korwa ase okorosa kwaye. Ase ayio akagokigwa mono nomobono oria.
english: Then the LORD God provided a vine and made it grow up over Jonah to give shade for his head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was very happy about the vine.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene Nyasae akaboria omokungu oria, “Ninki eke gwakorire?” Omokungu oria akamoiraneria, “Neng’iti yang’ainete, nkaria.”
english: Then the LORD God said to the woman, "What is this you have done?" The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaramokia Baalamu amaiso, na ere akarora omomalaika bw’Omonene oteneine ase enchera gati, obwate omoyio o birende ase okoboko kwaye. Baalamu agekumba, agatung’ama inse, akaumama.
english: Then the LORD opened Balaam's eyes, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with his sword drawn. So he bowed low and fell facedown.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agakunora omonwa bw’etigere eria goika egakwana, ekaboria Baalamu, “Ngento ki nagokoreire goika kwang’akire chintunda echi isato?”
english: Then the LORD opened the donkey's mouth, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you to make you beat me these three times?"

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaruta korwa igoro amagena ’omorero akonyititoka na omorero igoro ya Sodomu na Gomora,
english: Then the LORD rained down burning sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah-- from the LORD out of the heavens.

ekegusii: Omonene akarentera Sulemani omobisa, na omobisa oyio nere Hadadi, omonto bw’enyomba y’oboruoti bwa Edomu.
english: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.

ekegusii: Omonene akaa Abaisraeli abagambi baare kobatooria korwa ase abaurereria baria.
english: Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them out of the hands of these raiders.

ekegusii: Omonene akarambora okoboko kwaye, agakuna omonwa one, agantebia, “Rora, nabekire amang’ana aane ime ase omonwa oo.
english: Then the LORD reached out his hand and touched my mouth and said to me, "Now, I have put my words in your mouth.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaonchoka, tabakorera amabe aria konya arengereirie gokorera abanto baye.
english: Then the LORD relented and did not bring on his people the disaster he had threatened.

ekegusii: Omonene akang’iraneria, agantebia, “Rika okorora okwo ase ebao namariko amaya, erinde oyo okoyasoma ayasome buya.
english: Then the LORD replied: "Write down the revelation and make it plain on tablets so that a herald may run with it.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Haroni, akamotebia,
english: Then the LORD said to Aaron,

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Haroni, “Rora, nakoeire okoruegwa konde gwonsi gokoruegwa asende, obe gokorenda. Ebinto bionsi ebichenu Abaisraeli bakorua, ebio nakobieire bibe egetari kiao amo neki’ororeria rwao kogenderera botambe.
english: Then the LORD said to Aaron, "I myself have put you in charge of the offerings presented to me; all the holy offerings the Israelites give me I give to you and your sons as your portion and regular share.

ekegusii: Omonene akaboria Ibrahimu, “Ninki Sara agosekera, ogoteba: Inche amaene ninyibore omwana buna nagotire iga?
english: Then the LORD said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh and say, 'Will I really have a child, now that I am old?'

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaboria Kaini, “Ng’ai Abeli omino are?” Kaini akamoiraneria, “Timanyeti inche. Inee! Ninche nkomorenda oyominto?”
english: Then the LORD said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" "I don't know," he replied. "Am I my brother's keeper?"

ekegusii: Na Omonene akamoboria, “Kaini, nase ki okoba nendamwamu na obosio bwao bwairurire?
english: Then the LORD said to Cain, "Why are you angry? Why is your face downcast?

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Aburamu, “Manya amaene ng’a ororeria rwao inabache koba abamenyi ase ense etari eyabo, na barabwo inababe abasomba b’abanto b’agwo, na abwo inababachande mono ase engaki y’emiaka amagana ane.
english: Then the LORD said to him, "Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own, and they will be enslaved and mistreated four hundred years.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Bono inwe Abafarisai iga mogosibia egekombe na esani korwa isiko, korende ime yaino nigo moichire obouri na obobe.
english: Then the Lord said to him, "Now then, you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akamotebia, “Rambora okoboko kwao, oyebwate ekemincha.” Musa akarambora okoboko, akayebwata, na ase okoboko kwaye ekaonchoka, ekaba enyimbo naende.
english: Then the LORD said to him, "Reach out your hand and take it by the tail." So Moses reached out and took hold of the snake and it turned back into a staff in his hand.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Eye nero ense eria narierete Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira ng’a ning’ee ororeria rwabo ebe eyabo. Inche nigo nakoeire ribaga oyerore namaiso ao, korende tokonyara kwamboka gochia aroro.”
english: Then the LORD said to him, "This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob when I said, 'I will give it to your descendants.' I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not cross over into it."

ekegusii: Omonene akamoboria, “Inki ekio obwate koboko kwao?” Musa akairaneria, “Nenyimbo.”
english: Then the LORD said to him, "What is that in your hand?" "A staff," he replied.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Hosea, “Moroke Yesireeli, ekiagera engaki netigarete enke, ndarue egesusuro ase ororeria rwa Yehu, ndusie egesiomba ki’amanyinga aria abanto bamenyete Yesireeli baiterete. Ninsirie kegima oboruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Then the LORD said to Hosea, "Call him Jezreel, because I will soon punish the house of Jehu for the massacre at Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Isaya, “Genda amo na Seari‐Yasuba, momura oo, morotote Ahasi agwo ase omotaro bw’amache e ritibo ria rogoro ase enchera ekogenda egetii ki’omosibia ebitambaa bikoroisigwa chianga,
english: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, "Go out, you and your son Shear-Jashub, to meet Ahaz at the end of the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Washerman's Field.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agakwana na Yakobo, akamotebia, “Irana gochia ase ense ye chisokoro chiao, ase eamate yao, na inche nimbe amo naye.”
english: Then the LORD said to Jacob, "Go back to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Yoshua,
english: Then the LORD said to Joshua,

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Yoshua, “Toondoka, gose toiroka, imoka oire abarwani b’esegi amo naye, ogende orwanie omochie o Ai, Rora, nabekire omoruoti o Ai, na abanto baye, amo nomochie na ense yaye, ase amaboko ao.
english: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Take the whole army with you, and go up and attack Ai. For I have delivered into your hands the king of Ai, his people, his city and his land.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Yoshua, “Raga ne ritimo riao rire koboko kwao gochia Ai, ekiagera ninkoe omochie oyo ase amaboko ao.” Yoshua akaraga omochie ne ritimo abwate koboko kwaye.
english: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "Hold out toward Ai the javelin that is in your hand, for into your hand I will deliver the city." So Joshua held out his javelin toward Ai.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Yoshua, “Rora, nabekire Yeriko amo nomoruoti oye, na abamura chituoni baye b’esegi, ase okoboko kwao.
english: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "See, I have delivered Jericho into your hands, along with its king and its fighting men.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Yoshua, “Rituko ria rero narusirie korwa asemore ogochaywa mwarenteretwe n’Abamisiri.” Ase ayio aase aaria akarokwa Giligali, naboigo akorokwa goika rero iga.
english: Then the LORD said to Joshua, "Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you." So the place has been called Gilgal to this day.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Yoshua, akamotebia,
english: Then the LORD said to Joshua:

ekegusii: “Erio Omonene agakwana nainche, agantebia:
english: Then the LORD said to me,

ekegusii: “Omonene agantebia: Timobaisa gochegia abanto ba Moabu, gose korwana nabarabwo, ekiagera tinkobaa ensemo ende yonsi y’ense yabo ebe eyaino. Naeire abanto b’ororeria rwa Loti omochie o Ari obe oyobo.” (
english: Then the LORD said to me, "Do not harass the Moabites or provoke them to war, for I will not give you any part of their land. I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession."

ekegusii: Omonene agankania, agantebia, “Tobaisa gonsaba ase engencho y’abanto aba ng’a mbasesenie.
english: Then the LORD said to me, "Do not pray for the well-being of this people.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agantebia, “Bono imokia ebikorero bi’omorisia oyio otagwenereti kende.
english: Then the LORD said to me, "Take again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agantebia, “Ababani abwo nigo bakobana oborimo ase erieta riane. Inche tinabatomete, gose tinabachigete, gose tinakwanete nabarabwo. Barabwo nigo bakobabanera amaroro ’oborimo, na oboringoria bwa bosa, na obong’ainereria bw’ebirengererio biabo abanyene.
english: Then the LORD said to me, "The prophets are prophesying lies in my name. I have not sent them or appointed them or spoken to them. They are prophesying to you false visions, divinations, idolatries and the delusions of their own minds.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agantebia, “Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu bareganire.
english: Then the LORD said to me, "There is a conspiracy among the people of Judah and those who live in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agakwana nainche, agantebia, “Nonya Musa na Samweli barenge gotenena ase obosio bwane gonsorora, tinarenge koonchoka indorere abanto aba amabera. Baserie barue ase obosio bwane, bagende kegima.
english: Then the LORD said to me: "Even if Moses and Samuel were to stand before me, my heart would not go out to this people. Send them away from my presence! Let them go!

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa na Haroni, “Genda mobuuche ribu riichire roe korwa riko, na Musa arisiare gochia igoro, ase obosio bwa Farao.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, "Take handfuls of soot from a furnace and have Moses toss it into the air in the presence of Pharaoh.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agakwana na Musa akamotebia,
english: Then the LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
english: Then the LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
english: Then the LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa,
english: Then the LORD said to Moses,

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni ekero Farao agochia kogenda rooche, otenene ase obosio bwaye, omotebie: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende bankorere.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning and confront Pharaoh as he goes to the water and say to him, 'This is what the LORD says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Oche oimoke mambia chuni, otenene ase obosio bwa Farao, omotebie: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaibirania, agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Get up early in the morning, confront Pharaoh and say to him, 'This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me,

ekegusii: Korende Omonene agatebia Musa, “Tirimboka gochia inse, ekiagera abanto abwo bao kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri besaririe ase ogokora amabe,
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go down, because your people, whom you brought up out of Egypt, have become corrupt.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Genda otebie Farao: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende gonkorera.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, 'This is what the LORD says: Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Genda otebie Farao: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaibirania, agoteba: Bae abanto baane ribaga bagende, erinde bankorere.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh and say to him, 'This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: "Let my people go, so that they may worship me."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Genda ase Farao. Nakong’irie enkoro yaye na echi’abasomba baye, erinde inyare koorokia ebikone ebi biane ase egati yabo;
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the hearts of his officials so that I may perform these miraculous signs of mine among them

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia, “Tiira gochia igoro ase egetunwa eke ki’Abarimu, na origererie ense naeire Abaisraeli.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go up this mountain in the Abarim range and see the land I have given the Israelites.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Ngoika ririri morabe mokwanga ogotebereria kwane na amachiko aane?
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "How long will you refuse to keep my commands and my instructions?

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rora, nimbatwerie omogati korwa igoro. Kera rituko abanto bagende isiko, basangererie eyekobaisana ase rituko erimo. Naboigo mbateeme gose mbaganetie kobwatia amachiko aane, gose yaya.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "I will rain down bread from heaven for you. The people are to go out each day and gather enough for that day. In this way I will test them and see whether they will follow my instructions.

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia, “Imoka korwa aa ogende, aye amo nabanto aba kwang’anyetie korwa Misiri, obaire ase ense eria narierete Ibrahimu na Isaka na Yakobo eira, ngateba: Ning’ee ororeria rwaino ense eye.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Leave this place, you and the people you brought up out of Egypt, and go up to the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, saying, 'I will give it to your descendants.'

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Bono norore aya ndakorere Farao. Naki ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nimobetererie abae abanto baane ribaga bagende, ee, ase okoboko kwane gwe chinguru nabetererigwe abaserie korwa ase ense yaye.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Now you will see what I will do to Pharaoh: Because of my mighty hand he will let them go; because of my mighty hand he will drive them out of his country."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Farao okong’irie enkoro yaye, bwangire koa abanto aba ribaga bagende.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Pharaoh's heart is unyielding; he refuses to let the people go.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rora nagokorire obe buna Nyasae ase Farao, na Haroni akwane nere buna omobani oo.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "See, I have made you like God to Pharaoh, and your brother Aaron will be your prophet.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao igoro y’enyancha, erinde amache airanerane igoro y’Abamisiri, ne chigari chiabo amo nabariini chibarasi.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand over the sea so that the waters may flow back over the Egyptians and their chariots and horsemen."

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Imokia okoboko kwao gochia igoro, erinde omosunte ekerima onyare koba ase ense ya Misiri, omosunte oranyare gotaba‐tabwa.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward the sky so that darkness will spread over Egypt-- darkness that can be felt."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rambora okoboko kwao gochia igoro, erio embura y’amagena etwe ase ense ya Misiri, etwere mwanyabanto ne chitugo, na ebimeri bionsi bi’emegondo ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Stretch out your hand toward the sky so that hail will fall all over Egypt-- on men and animals and on everything growing in the fields of Egypt."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Oimokie ebinto bigotioka buya: Oborembo bwa nafiti, na amaguta ’amakorogonte na oborembo bwa kalibani, na ebinto binde ebiansu, na ubani engiya; kera egento kebe gi’ekerengo ekemo.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Take fragrant spices-- gum resin, onycha and galbanum-- and pure frankincense, all in equal amounts,

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Motebie Haroni abwate enyimbo yaye, ayeimokie igoro ye chindooche, na ebirooche, na amatibo, erinde agere ebioto bigende igoro ase ense yonsi ya Misiri.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, 'Stretch out your hand with your staff over the streams and canals and ponds, and make frogs come up on the land of Egypt.'"

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Motebie Haroni aimokie enyimbo yaye aake orotu rwe riroba, na rororwo naroonchoke robe chinsona ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Tell Aaron, 'Stretch out your staff and strike the dust of the ground,' and throughout the land of Egypt the dust will become gnats."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Amang’ana aya naro oratebie Abaisraeli: Inwe abanyene mwarorire ng’a nigo nakwanire nainwe korwa igoro.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Tell the Israelites this: 'You have seen for yourselves that I have spoken to you from heaven:

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatebia Musa, “Omonto oyio goika aitwe akwe: asokigwe isiko y’egetwori, erio omoganda bwonsi omoake amagena.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "The man must die. The whole assembly must stone him outside the camp."

ekegusii: Omonene akaboria Musa, “Inki okorera asende? Batebie Abaisraeli bagenderere bosio.
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Why are you crying out to me? Tell the Israelites to move on.

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Rika amang’ana aya, ekiagera ase amang’ana ayio nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania naye amo n’Abaisraeli.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa, “Yarike amang’ana aya ase ebuku, abe amang’ana ’okoinyorwa, otebie Yoshua ng’a ninkore Abaameleki bebwe kegima, tibabaisa koinyorwa inse y’erioba.”
english: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Write this on a scroll as something to be remembered and make sure that Joshua hears it, because I will completely blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven."

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana na Musa, akamotebia,
english: Then the LORD said to Moses:

ekegusii: Na Omonene agatebia Musa,
english: Then the LORD said to Moses:

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Musa,
english: Then the LORD said to Moses:

ekegusii: Agwo Omonene akaboria Saitani, “N’Ayubu, omosomba one, kwarorire buna are? Monto onde tari ase ense onga buna ere; nigo are omwegenwa na obwate enkoro endonge; ere nigo anyirogete inche Nyasae, naende nigo etangete korwa ase ogokora amabe. Nonya kwang’ebereretie komochanda ngencho ende etaiyo, ere nigo agendererete koba omwegenwa.”
english: Then the LORD said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil. And he still maintains his integrity, though you incited me against him to ruin him without any reason."

ekegusii: Agwo Omonene akaboria Saitani, “N’Ayubu, omosomba one, kwarorire buna are? Monto onde tari ase ense onga buna ere; nigo are omwegenwa, na obwate enkoro endonge; ere nigo anyirogete inche Nyasae, naende nigo etangete korwa ase ogokora amabe.”
english: Then the LORD said to Satan, "Have you considered my servant Job? There is no one on earth like him; he is blameless and upright, a man who fears God and shuns evil."

ekegusii: Omonene agatebia Hosea, “Moroke Lo‐Ami, ekiagera inwe timori abana baane, na inche tinkoba Nyasae oino.”
english: Then the LORD said, "Call him Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I am not your God.
