ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Amaene, inche ning’irane asore omwaka ogocha engaki enga buna eye, na ninyore ng’a Sara mokao onyorire omwana omoisia.” Sara nigo ategererete gesieri ki’eema yarenge magega Omonene.
english: Then the LORD said, "I will surely return to you about this time next year, and Sarah your wife will have a son." Now Sarah was listening at the entrance to the tent, which was behind him.

ekegusii: Omonene akamotebia, “Onye tibakwegena amang’ana ao, gose tibagwancha ase egekone kie ritang’ani, rirorio mbanche ase egia kabere.
english: Then the LORD said, "If they do not believe you or pay attention to the first miraculous sign, they may believe the second.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agateba, “Buna koreng’ana Isaya, omosomba one, abeire okona‐gotaara goetanana aaria na aaria ase emiaka etato yaetire, ore getirianda na atabegeti bikoroto, obeire ekemanyererio na omogwekano bw’amang’ana arabe ase Abamisiri na ase Abaetiopia,
english: Then the LORD said, "Just as my servant Isaiah has gone stripped and barefoot for three years, as a sign and portent against Egypt and Cush,

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agateba, “Omoika one tokonyara komenya ime ase mwanyabanto kare na kare, ekiagera ere nomobere ogokwa. Ase ayio emiaka yaye nigo erabe rigana erimo na emerongo ebere yoka.”
english: Then the LORD said, "My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days will be a hundred and twenty years."

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamotebia, “Soyia okoboko kwao eanga ime ase egekuba kiao.” Musa agakora boigo; na ekero akorusetie akanyora ng’a kwabeire okorabu se ase oborwaire bwa ukoma.
english: Then the LORD said, "Put your hand inside your cloak." So Moses put his hand into his cloak, and when he took it out, it was leprous, like snow.

ekegusii: Omonene agateba, “Inee! Imobise Ibrahimu ring’ana ngochia gokora,
english: Then the LORD said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?

ekegusii: Naende Omonene agateba, “Ekiagera ekerero gia Sodomu na Gomora nekenene, na ebibe biabo biamentekire mono,
english: Then the LORD said, "The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is so great and their sin so grievous

ekegusii: Naende Omonene akamotebia, “Rora, aase aiga are ang’e nainche, aye oranyare gotenena egetare igoro.
english: Then the LORD said, "There is a place near me where you may stand on a rock.

ekegusii: Omonene akabora, “Rora, bono ngokora inde nainwe okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Ase amasio ’abanto bao bonsi ninkore ebikone ebio bitana gokoreka ase ense yonsi, gose ase egesaku kende gionsi. Na abanto bonsi abagoetanaine inabarore ogokora kw’Omonene, naki ayio ndagokorere namang’ana ay’okoondokia.
english: Then the LORD said: "I am making a covenant with you. Before all your people I will do wonders never before done in any nation in all the world. The people you live among will see how awesome is the work that I, the LORD, will do for you.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene akagusia omwaga omonene mono igoro ase enyancha, na ekembugu‐mbugu gie chinguru kegacha ase enyancha, na emeeri ekaba ang’e kobuneka.
english: Then the LORD sent a great wind on the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship threatened to break up.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatoma Yeruba‐Baali, na Baraki, na Yefita, na inche Samweli, akabatooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baino babaetanaine, nainwe mokaba mokomenya ase obotoereru.
english: Then the LORD sent Jerub-Baal, Barak, Jephthah and Samuel, and he delivered you from the hands of your enemies on every side, so that you lived securely.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agatoma ching’iti chingenda inse chire nobosongo chigacha ase egati y’Abaisraeli, chikabaroma, na abanto abange bagakwa.
english: Then the LORD sent venomous snakes among them; they bit the people and many Israelites died.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akanyorokia abaturi b’ebioma bane.
english: Then the LORD showed me four craftsmen.

ekegusii: Erio korwa ase ekembugu‐mbugu ime Omonene akairaneria Ayubu, akamotebia:
english: Then the LORD spoke to Job out of the storm:

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agachika omomalaika oria, na ere akairania omoyio oye ime ase ekegocho.
english: Then the LORD spoke to the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene agakwana nainwe korwa ase omorero oria ime, mokaigwa amang’ana aye, korende timwaroche ekieni kiaye. Nigo mwaigwete eriogi rioka.
english: Then the LORD spoke to you out of the fire. You heard the sound of words but saw no form; there was only a voice.

ekegusii: “Erio Omonene agantebia: Imoka otirimboke bwango korwa aiga ase egetunwa, ekiagera abanto abwo kwang’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri bakorire ebibe. Baonchokire bwango, batigire enchera eria nabachigete kobwatia. Beroiseirie omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa onyititoire na kobombwa.
english: Then the LORD told me, "Go down from here at once, because your people whom you brought out of Egypt have become corrupt. They have turned away quickly from what I commanded them and have made a cast idol for themselves."

ekegusii: Omonene naoroke igoro y’abanto baye, ne chinsara chiaye chisoke buna okomesa gw’enkoba. Omonene Nyasae nabugie egetureri, achiche nekembugu‐mbugu gekorwa sugusu.
english: Then the LORD will appear over them; his arrow will flash like lightning. The Sovereign LORD will sound the trumpet; he will march in the storms of the south,

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaba ne risemi ase engencho y’ense yaye, akarorera abanto baye amabeebe.
english: Then the LORD will be jealous for his land and take pity on his people.

ekegusii: Igoro y’Egetunwa gia Sayoni gionsi, na igoro y’abanto bonsi basangererekaneteo, Omonene natonge riire na erioki bibeo mobaso, na omorero okomesa obeo botuko; na igoro y’obonene obwo bwonsi egietubo gi’okorenda nkebekweo.
english: Then the LORD will create over all of Mount Zion and over those who assemble there a cloud of smoke by day and a glow of flaming fire by night; over all the glory will be a canopy.

ekegusii: erio Omonene naserie ebisaku ebi bionsi bire ase amasio aino, na inwe namonyare koira ense y’ebisaku bire ebinene, naende bire ne chinguru kobabua inwe.
english: then the LORD will drive out all these nations before you, and you will dispossess nations larger and stronger than you.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene nasoke arwanie ebisaku ebio, buna arwanete kare ase rituko ri’esegi.
english: Then the LORD will go out and fight against those nations, as he fights in the day of battle.

ekegusii: “Omonene nabasiarere gochia ase egati y’ebisaku ebinge, korwa ensinyo eyemo y’ense goika eyende. Agwo namokorere chinyasae ching’ao chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena, echio inwe motamanyete, nonya ne chisokoro chiaino.
english: Then the LORD will scatter you among all nations, from one end of the earth to the other. There you will worship other gods-- gods of wood and stone, which neither you nor your fathers have known.

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabasesenie mono ase emeremo yaino yonsi mogokora namaboko aino, nasesenie oboiboro rwaino romentekane, namente ne chiombe chiaino na okwama kwaino kwe riroba. Na buna Omonene agogete ase ogosesenia chisokoro chiaino, naboigo aragoke ase okobasesenia inwe,
english: Then the LORD your God will make you most prosperous in all the work of your hands and in the fruit of your womb, the young of your livestock and the crops of your land. The LORD will again delight in you and make you prosperous, just as he delighted in your fathers,

ekegusii: rirorio Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarorere amabera na kobasesenia, naende abairanie korwa ase ebisaku bionsi ebio ase abasiarerete gochia.
english: then the LORD your God will restore your fortunes and have compassion on you and gather you again from all the nations where he scattered you.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaba nendamwamu egwoka igoro ya Musa, akamotebia, “Inee! Haroni omino, oria Omolawi, takaiyo? Nimanyete ng’a ere nere omonto omanyete gokwana buya. Naama! Ngocha are gokorotota; ere ekero arakorore nabe nomogoko omonene.
english: Then the LORD's anger burned against Moses and he said, "What about your brother, Aaron the Levite? I know he can speak well. He is already on his way to meet you, and his heart will be glad when he sees you.

ekegusii: Moise komotiga rirorio endamwamu yaye nigo erabe enene asemore, erinde asieke igoro, embura tetwa, na ense etige kwama, nainwe mokwe mosire ara rimo rioka timobao ase ense eria engiya Omonene agochia kobaa.
english: Then the LORD's anger will burn against you, and he will shut the heavens so that it will not rain and the ground will yield no produce, and you will soon perish from the good land the LORD is giving you.

ekegusii: Erio abakungu baria abasomba bagasuka gochia ang’e, kera oyomo nabana baye, bagatung’ama inse.
english: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down.

ekegusii: Omonto oria na mokaye bakaigwa eriogi ri’Omonene Nyasae kagotaara ase omogondo engaki ya mogoroba ense koyakendire, na barabwo bakebisa mogondo gati y’emete, ng’a Omonene Nyasae tabarora.
english: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the LORD God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and they hid from the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria agatung’ama inse, agasasima Omonene,
english: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the LORD,

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akang’ira gochia ase egeita gia isiko kiarenge ensemo ya moocha ye Hekalu; egeita ekio nigo giasiekire.
english: Then the man brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary, the one facing east, and it was shut.

ekegusii: Naende akang’ira, akang’eteria ase egeita gia sugusu, bosio bwe Hekalu; nkarigereria nkarora obonene bw’Omonene bwaichoire ase enyomba y’Omonene. Agwo ngatung’ama inse nkaumama.
english: Then the man brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked and saw the glory of the LORD filling the temple of the LORD, and I fell facedown.

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akang’eteria ase egesoero kiarenge ang’e negeita, agansoyia ase ebinyomba ebichenu bi’abakuani biarenge sugusu, nkarora aase aria korwa nyuma, ensemo ya bosongo.
english: Then the man brought me through the entrance at the side of the gate to the sacred rooms facing north, which belonged to the priests, and showed me a place at the western end.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio akang’ira goika ase egeita kiarochie moocha.
english: Then the man brought me to the gate facing east,

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akang’ira ase Hekalu, akarenga emetobwa; obogare bwabo bokaba obw’amaboko atano na rimo kera ensemo, koreng’ana nobogare bwe Hekalu.
english: Then the man brought me to the outer sanctuary and measured the jambs; the width of the jambs was six cubits on each side.

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani, na bweboeranetie ekaramu akorikera, akairana akarenta amang’ana, agateba, “Nakorire buna gwanchigete.”
english: Then the man in linen with the writing kit at his side brought back word, saying, "I have done as you commanded."

ekegusii: Omonto oria akang’ira ase eraaro ya isiko erochie sugusu, na akang’ira ase enyomba rirondo yanachanire ebinyomba yarenge gati y’aase atigire ataagachire na oboagacho bwa sugusu.
english: Then the man led me northward into the outer court and brought me to the rooms opposite the temple courtyard and opposite the outer wall on the north side.

ekegusii: Erio akamotebia, “Ntige ngende, ekiagera bwakiire.” Korende Yakobo akamotebia, “Tingokoa ribaga ogende, otaransesenia.”
english: Then the man said, "Let me go, for it is daybreak." But Jacob replied, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."

ekegusii: Akabora, “Omonene, negenire”; akamosasima.
english: Then the man said, "Lord, I believe," and he worshiped him.

ekegusii: Erio akamotebia, “Bono tokorokwa naende Yakobo, nigo orarokwe Israeli, ekiagera mwakinanire na Nyasae na abanto, na aye kwabuire.”
english: Then the man said, "Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with men and have overcome."

ekegusii: Ase ayio omonto oria oteneine ase egati y’emehadasi eria akang’iraneria, agantebia, “Chibarasi echio nachio Omonene atomire chietanane ase ense yonsi.”
english: Then the man standing among the myrtle trees explained, "They are the ones the LORD has sent to go throughout the earth."

ekegusii: Na omonto oria obwatire nekerecha ekebe akabarindokera, akabanyara, akababua, goika bagatama korwa ase enyomba eria getirianda, bare ne chingoma baakirwe.
english: Then the man who had the evil spirit jumped on them and overpowered them all. He gave them such a beating that they ran out of the house naked and bleeding.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Benjamin bagasangerererkana amo ase okoegera Abineri, bakagenda ase ekegoro igoro, bagatenenao.
english: Then the men of Benjamin rallied behind Abner. They formed themselves into a group and took their stand on top of a hill.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli na Abayuda bagaaka eriogi bakabwatia Abafilisti goikera Gati na ebiita bi’Ekironi. Abafilisti abaitetwe bakarara ase enchera korwa Saaraimu goikera Gati na Ekironi.
english: Then the men of Israel and Judah surged forward with a shout and pursued the Philistines to the entrance of Gath and to the gates of Ekron. Their dead were strewn along the Shaaraim road to Gath and Ekron.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakairaneria Abayuda, bakabora, “Omoruoti noyoito ara ikomi kobua buna are oyoino. Ase ayio, oyio Daudi noyoito bori. Nase ki mogotochaya? Inee! Titwarenge abe ritang’ani gokwana igoro y’okoirania omoruoti oito.” Korende amang’ana ’Abayuda nigo arenge amakong’u kobua ay’Abaisraeli.
english: Then the men of Israel answered the men of Judah, "We have ten shares in the king; and besides, we have a greater claim on David than you have. So why do you treat us with contempt? Were we not the first to speak of bringing back our king?" But the men of Judah responded even more harshly than the men of Israel.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakaonchoka, bakairana, na Ababenjamin bagasogwa nomoondoko, ekiagera nigo baroche ng’a ogosirigwa kwabo kwabacheire ang’e.
english: Then the men of Israel turned on them, and the men of Benjamin were terrified, because they realized that disaster had come upon them.

ekegusii: Abayuda bagacha Heburoni, bagaaka Daudi amaguta akaba omoruoti igoro y’abanto b’egesaku kiabo. Ekero Daudi atebetigwe ng’a abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi nabwo batindegete Saulo,
english: Then the men of Judah came to Hebron and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. When David was told that it was the men of Jabesh Gilead who had buried Saul,

ekegusii: Abayuda bagatebia Abasimeoni bamwabo, “Inchuo motiire amo naintwe gochia ase orogongo orore omwando oito, torwanie Abakanani. Erio nyuma intwe natogende amo nainwe ase orogongo orore orwaino.” Ase ayio Abasimeoni bakagenda amo nabarabwo.
english: Then the men of Judah said to the Simeonites their brothers, "Come up with us into the territory allotted to us, to fight against the Canaanites. We in turn will go with you into yours." So the Simeonites went with them.

ekegusii: Abayuda bakagenda amo n’Abasimeoni bamwabo, bakarwania Abakanani aria Sefati na kobabua. Bakaragereria omochie oria, bakayosaria kegima; nyuma y’ayio bakayoroka Horima.
english: Then the men of Judah went with the Simeonites their brothers and attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and they totally destroyed the city. Therefore it was called Hormah.

ekegusii: Naende abanto baria bagatubokera omoruoti bare amo, bakamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, manya ng’a amachiko ’Abamedi na Abaayemi naya, ng’a ogochika konde gwonsi omoruoti abekire na kogokong’ia tigokoonchorwa nonya ng’ake.”
english: Then the men went as a group to the king and said to him, "Remember, O king, that according to the law of the Medes and Persians no decree or edict that the king issues can be changed."

ekegusii: Nabo baria batometwe bagachia koirana nyomba mwaye, bakanyora omosomba oria otimokire.
english: Then the men who had been sent returned to the house and found the servant well.

ekegusii: Erio ng’ina abana ba Zebedi akamochiera amo nabana baye, akamotung’amera na komosaba ring’ana.
english: Then the mother of Zebedee's sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.

ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ebisaku ebio biatigarete bibaetanaine mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene naagachire aase agwo aasaretigwe, naende nasimekire chimbusuro ase emegondo yatigarete ere bosa. Ninche Omonene nakwanire, goika nkore ayio.”
english: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I the LORD have rebuilt what was destroyed and have replanted what was desolate. I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.'

ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ebisaku bakarua ase chinsemo chiabo, bakeroberia ase okoyerwania, bakayebekera ekeonga, ero ekagwa ase eirima yabo ime.
english: Then the nations came against him, those from regions round about. They spread their net for him, and he was trapped in their pit.

ekegusii: Ekero Obomenyo bwane Obochenu boragenderere kobeera amo n’Abaisraeli kogenderera botambe, erio abanto b’ebisaku mbamanye ng’a inche Omonene nigo ngochena Abaisraeli.”
english: Then the nations will know that I the LORD make Israel holy, when my sanctuary is among them forever.'"

ekegusii: “Naende abateneneri baria bagenderere gokwana nabanto, babatebie: Onye omonto ore aiga ore omwoba, ore nenkoro eondogete, oyio tiga airane agende nka bwoye, tabaisa kogera chinkoro chi ’abamwabo chiondoke buna aondogete ere omonyene.
english: Then the officers shall add, "Is any man afraid or fainthearted? Let him go home so that his brothers will not become disheartened too."

ekegusii: Erio abanene b’abarwani, abatang’ani b’abarwani chilifu, na ab’amagana, bagacha ase Musa,
english: Then the officers who were over the units of the army-- the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds-- went to Moses

ekegusii: Erio abanene baria b’oboruoti, na abanto bonsi bagakwana, bagatebia abakuani na ababani, “Omonto oyo tabwati okomocha gokogera anacherwe ekina ki’ogokwa, ekiagera okwanire naintwe ase erieta ri’Omonene oito.”
english: Then the officials and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, "This man should not be sentenced to death! He has spoken to us in the name of the LORD our God."

ekegusii: Erio abanene baria b’oboruoti bakamotebia, “Aye amo na Yeremia, genda mwebise. Timobaisa komanyia monto onde ase more.”
english: Then the officials said to Baruch, "You and Jeremiah, go and hide. Don't let anyone know where you are."

ekegusii: Erio abanene b’oboruoti bagatebia omoruoti, “Tiga omonto oyo aitwe. Nigo agoita emioyo y’abarwani esegi batigarete ase omochie oyo, amo ney’abanto bonsi ase okobatebia amang’ana buna ayio. Omonto oyo taganereti abanto amang’ana amaya, korende nigo abaganeretie amabe basire.”
english: Then the officials said to the king, "This man should be put to death. He is discouraging the soldiers who are left in this city, as well as all the people, by the things he is saying to them. This man is not seeking the good of these people but their ruin."

ekegusii: Oyokorua ebing’wanso buna ebio ase Omonene, goika arue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke ebimunu bibere bwochoganirie namaguta egetuba ekemo,
english: then the one who brings his offering shall present to the LORD a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakairaneria, “Taibo. Titorigeti gotiga Omonene na gokorera chinyasae ching’ao.
english: Then the people answered, "Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods!

ekegusii: Erio nyuma yaye bagasaba baegwe omoruoti. Nyasae akabaa Saulo, mosinto o Kishi, omonto bw’ororeria rwa Benjamin, ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
english: Then the people asked for a king, and he gave them Saul son of Kish, of the tribe of Benjamin, who ruled forty years.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bakamboria, “Nonyare gototebia engencho y’amang’ana aya, na eyagera gwakora iga?”
english: Then the people asked me, "Won't you tell us what these things have to do with us?"

ekegusii: Bagachaka gosorora Yeso arue ase chimbebe chiabo.
english: Then the people began to plead with Jesus to leave their region.

ekegusii: Bono Abaisraeli: abakuani, na Abalawi, na abanto bande abwo bairanete korwa ase obosomba, bagakora omoyega omonene bw’omogoko ase ogwatanana enyomba eria ya Nyasae na koyechena.
english: Then the people of Israel-- the priests, the Levites and the rest of the exiles-- celebrated the dedication of the house of God with joy.

ekegusii: Bono Abaisraeli bagaatananeka chinsemo ibere, ekeng’ese ki’abanto bagatunyana Tibuni, mosinto o Ginati, baganetie komobeka abe omoruoti, na ekeng’ese kende bagatunyana Omuri.
english: Then the people of Israel were split into two factions; half supported Tibni son of Ginath for king, and the other half supported Omri.

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba ng’a ase enchera eyio Abaisraeli tibakorua asende bachie gosira, gose gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka nonya ng’ake ase engencho y’ogosaria kwabo gwonsi, korende mbabe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.”
english: Then the people of Israel will no longer stray from me, nor will they defile themselves anymore with all their sins. They will be my people, and I will be their God, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ense eria bagaita abanto bonsi baria bakorete omoroberio bw’ogoita Amoni omoruoti, na bakabeka Yosia, omwana oye omomura, akaba omoruoti ase ribaga riaye.
english: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.

ekegusii: Korende abanto b’ense eria bagaita abanto bonsi baria bakorete omoroberio bw’ogoita Amoni omoruoti; nyuma y’ayio bakabeka Yosia, omwana oye omomura, akaba omoruoti ase ribaga riaye.
english: Then the people of the land killed all who had plotted against King Amon, and they made Josiah his son king in his place.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Samaria bakagenda bagasakora egetwori ki’Abasiiria. Ase ayio obosie obonuke bw’engano ebitita bibere bokaoonigwa ase esekeli eyemo, na obw’esairi ebitita bine ase esekeli eyemo, buna Omonene atebete.
english: Then the people went out and plundered the camp of the Arameans. So a seah of flour sold for a shekel, and two seahs of barley sold for a shekel, as the LORD had said.

ekegusii: Erio abanto b’ense eria bagaita Abayuda emioyo, bakaboboyia ng’a tibagenderera koagacha.
english: Then the peoples around them set out to discourage the people of Judah and make them afraid to go on building.

ekegusii: Erio kegima Abafarisai baria bagasoka, bakagamba amo n’Abaherodiani buna barakore baite Yeso.
english: Then the Pharisees went out and began to plot with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.

ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai bakagenda, bagakora ekina buna bagochia komotega ase amang’ana aye.
english: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.

ekegusii: Omofilisti oria akagenderera gokwana, agateba, “Nachayire emeganda y’abarwani b’Abaisraeli ase rituko ria rero. Ing’a omonto, torwane nere.”
english: Then the Philistine said, "This day I defy the ranks of Israel! Give me a man and let us fight each other."

ekegusii: Abafilisti bakamobwata, bakamokonora amaiso, naende bakamoira gochia Gasa, bakamosiba ne chingataare chie chitaai. Bakamobeka gosia obosie agwo ase enyomba y’obosibwa.
english: Then the Philistines seized him, gouged out his eyes and took him down to Gaza. Binding him with bronze shackles, they set him to grinding in the prison.

ekegusii: Omokuani aimokie amanyinga make, atobeke ekiara kiaye agindie emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero ki’ogosambera ebing’wanso; amanyinga aya agotigara ayaumore agwo inse, ase egesasimero ekio.
english: Then the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

ekegusii: Erio omokuani achike abanto banyenyere enyoni eyemo igoro ase egetega ki’amaroba kere namache amaya a rooche.
english: Then the priest shall order that one of the birds be killed over fresh water in a clay pot.

ekegusii: Erio omokuani abeke omokungu oyio inse y’okoragererigwa, amotebie: Onye omonto omoao tararete naye, na igo tigwakorete obotomani ase ogotaba omwegenwa ase omosacha oo, rirorio amache aya amaroro akorenta okoragererigwa takonyara kogokorera bobe bonde.
english: Then the priest shall put the woman under oath and say to her, "If no other man has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become impure while married to your husband, may this bitter water that brings a curse not harm you.

ekegusii: Omokuani atobeke ekiara kiaye ime ase amanyinga ayagindie ase emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, korende amanyinga onsi agotigara ayaumore agwo inse ase egesasimero ekio.
english: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

ekegusii: Omokuani aimokie amanyinga make ay’emanwa eyio, atobeke ekiara kiaye agindie emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero ki’ogosambera ebing’wanso, korende amanyinga ayagotigara ayaumore agwo inse, ase egesasimero ekio.
english: Then the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akagokia omokuani oria mono; ere akaimoka akabogoria egesibao keria ki’obokuani, na ebinyasae biria, na omogwekano oria obaachire, akagenda amo nabanto baria.
english: Then the priest was glad. He took the ephod, the other household gods and the carved image and went along with the people.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abakuani na Abalawi bakaimokia chifeta ne chitahabu echio barengerete amo nebikorero, erinde baire ebinto ebio Yerusalemu, ase enyomba ya Nyasae oito.
english: Then the priests and Levites received the silver and gold and sacred articles that had been weighed out to be taken to the house of our God in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abakuani na ababani bagatebia abanene baria b’oboruoti amo nabanto bonsi, “Omonto oyo nigo agwenerete anacherwe ekina ki’ogokwa, ekiagera nigo abana mamincha y’omochie oyo, buna mweigwera namato aino.”
english: Then the priests and the prophets said to the officials and all the people, "This man should be sentenced to death because he has prophesied against this city. You have heard it with your own ears!"

ekegusii: Erio Hanania, omobani oria, akarusia rikorogoto riria korwa ase rigoti ria Yeremia omobani, akaribuna.
english: Then the prophet Hananiah took the yoke off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah and broke it,

ekegusii: Isaya omobani akarera ase Omonene, na Omonene akairania omorengari bw’ekerengo gie chinsa ki’Ahasi ebitambokero ikomi, ebio konya biatambeire gochia bosio.
english: Then the prophet Isaiah called upon the LORD, and the LORD made the shadow go back the ten steps it had gone down on the stairway of Ahaz.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia omobani akairaneria Hanania omobani, agwo ase amasio ’abakuani na ase abanto bonsi bateneine ime ase enyomba y’Omonene,
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah replied to the prophet Hananiah before the priests and all the people who were standing in the house of the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio Yeremia omobani agatebia Hanania omobani, “Aye Hanania, tegerera oigwe, Omonene tagotometi aye, korende kwaeire abanto ribaga begene oborimo.
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, "Listen, Hananiah! The LORD has not sent you, yet you have persuaded this nation to trust in lies.

ekegusii: Erio bwango akarusia egetambaa ase amaiso aye, na omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akamanya ng’a ere noyomo bw’ababani.
english: Then the prophet quickly removed the headband from his eyes, and the king of Israel recognized him as one of the prophets.

ekegusii: Erio Semaya omobani akagenda ase Rehoboamu, na ase abanene b’Abayuda abwo basangererekanete agwo Yerusalemu ase okwoboa Sisaki, akabatebia, “Aya naro Omonene atebire: Inwe mwantigire inche, ase ayio nainche nabatigire inwe, nababekire ase okoboko gwa Sisaki.”
english: Then the prophet Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and to the leaders of Judah who had assembled in Jerusalem for fear of Shishak, and he said to them, "This is what the LORD says, 'You have abandoned me; therefore, I now abandon you to Shishak.'"

ekegusii: Omobani oria akagenda, akaganya omoruoti agwo ase enchera, agetuba negetambaa ase amaiso aye.
english: Then the prophet went and stood by the road waiting for the king. He disguised himself with his headband down over his eyes.

ekegusii: Erio abanyene oboronge nabagirigente buna erioba ase oboruoti bwa Ise obo. Oyore namato akoigwera, tiga aigwe.
english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him hear.

ekegusii: Erio abasomba bande b’omoruoti abarenge kobeera agwo ase egeita bakaboria Moredekai, “Inee! Nase ki kwangire koigwera ogochika kw’omoruoti?”
english: Then the royal officials at the king's gate asked Mordecai, "Why do you disobey the king's command?"

ekegusii: Erio abatang’ani b’Abafilisti bakarentera omokungu oria chingori chi’emenyiki isano na ibere chinyia chitaroma, agasibera Samison nachirochio.
english: Then the rulers of the Philistines brought her seven fresh thongs that had not been dried, and she tied him with them.

ekegusii: Na Abasadukai bakamochiera, baria bakobora ng’a okobokigwa tikori, bakamoboria,
english: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.

ekegusii: Abanto baria bagatebania, “Tiga toake obomera tomanye gose ning’o ogerire amabe aya atocheire.” Erio bagaaka obomera, na obomera obwo bokagwera Yona.
english: Then the sailors said to each other, "Come, let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity." They cast lots and the lot fell on Jonah.

ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akarusia ebinto bi’ogwechabera bie chitahabu, na ebie chifeta, amo ne chianga, akaa Rebeka. Naende akaa momura omwabo amo na ng’ina ebiegwa bie rigori rinene.
english: Then the servant brought out gold and silver jewelry and articles of clothing and gave them to Rebekah; he also gave costly gifts to her brother and to her mother.

ekegusii: Then the servant told Isaac all he had done.
english: Na omosomba oria agatebia Isaka amang’ana onsi, buna akorete.

ekegusii: Erio omosomba oria akarusia chingamia ikomi chi’omonene oye, akaimokia na ebiegwa ebinge ebiya; akaimoka, akagenda gochia Mesopotamia, agaika omochie oria Nahori amenyete.
english: Then the servant took ten of his master's camels and left, taking with him all kinds of good things from his master. He set out for Aram Naharaim and made his way to the town of Nahor.

ekegusii: Abamalaika baria batano na babere abarenge nebitureri bitano na bibere bakebeka ang’e kobibugia.
english: Then the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.

ekegusii: Abachandi abwo na abateneneri bagasoka bagatebia abanto, “Farao otebire iga: Tinkobaa inwe chimboba naende.
english: Then the slave drivers and the foremen went out and said to the people, "This is what Pharaoh says: 'I will not give you any more straw.

ekegusii: Oboruoti, na okobua gw’okogamba, na obonene bw’amaruoti are inse y’erioba, mbiegwe abanto abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono. Oboruoti bwaye mbobe obwa kare na kare, na bonsi abaare kogamba mbamokorere na komoigwera.
english: Then the sovereignty, power and greatness of the kingdoms under the whole heaven will be handed over to the saints, the people of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will worship and obey him.'

ekegusii: Erio Omoika ogasoa ime yane, ogantenenia, na Omonene agakwana nainche, agantebia, “Genda bwesiekere nyomba mwao.
english: Then the Spirit came into me and raised me to my feet. He spoke to me and said: "Go, shut yourself inside your house.

ekegusii: Erio omoika ogacha igoro ase Amasai, omonene bw’abanto baria Emerongo Etato, nere agateba, “Aye Daudi, intwe nigo tore abanto bao; na nigo tokobwatana amo naye, aye omwana o Yese. Omorembe obe asore, na omorembe obe ase abakogokonya, ekiagera Nyasae oo, nere okogokonya.” Erio Daudi akabanchera, akababeka bakaba abatang’ani b’emeganda yaye y’esegi.
english: Then the Spirit came upon Amasai, chief of the Thirty, and he said: "We are yours, O David! We are with you, O son of Jesse! Success, success to you, and success to those who help you, for your God will help you." So David received them and made them leaders of his raiding bands.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo Omoika okany’imokereria igoro, okang’ira ase eraaro ya ime, na nkarora obonene bw’Omonene bwaichoire ase Hekalu eria yonsi.
english: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner court, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.

ekegusii: Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, okang’ira ase egeita ki’enyomba y’Omonene kiarochie moocha. Na rora, agwo ase egesieri ki’egeita mbarengeo abasacha emerongo ebere, na batano, na ase egati yabo nkarora Yasania, mosinto bw’Asuri, na Peletia, mosinto o Benaya, abwo barenge abagambi b’abanto.
english: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the LORD that faces east. There at the entrance to the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, leaders of the people.

ekegusii: Erio Omoika okanyimokereria igoro, nkaigwa korwa nyuma yane eriogi buna eri’ogoaka gw’enkoba, rigoteba: “Obonene bw’Omonene botogigwe korwa agwo ase bore!”
english: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a loud rumbling sound-- May the glory of the LORD be praised in his dwelling place!--

ekegusii: Omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro ase Zakaria, mosinto o Yehoyada omokuani. Ere agatenena ase egati y’abanto, akabatebia, “Aya naro Nyasae agokwana: Nase ki mogosaria amachiko ’Omonene? Timokonyara gosesenigwa. Ekiagera inwe mwamotigire Omonene, nere obatigire inwe.”
english: Then the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest. He stood before the people and said, "This is what God says: 'Why do you disobey the LORD's commands? You will not prosper. Because you have forsaken the LORD, he has forsaken you.'"

ekegusii: Gidioni agasogwa ne chinguru chi’Omoika bw’Omonene. Ere akabugia egetureri gi’esegi, na Abaabieseri bakarangerigwa bakamobwatia.
english: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon, and he blew a trumpet, summoning the Abiezrites to follow him.

ekegusii: Na omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro ya Samison, okamobeka chinguru, na ere agatirimboka gochia Asikeloni, agaita abasacha b’omochie emerongo etato, agasakora ebinto biabo, akaira ne chianga chiabo chi’omoyega, akaa abanto baria batebete engencho y’omobayeno oria. Nyuma y’ayio akairana gochia ase ise ore nekeririanda ekenene.
english: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon him in power. He went down to Ashkelon, struck down thirty of their men, stripped them of their belongings and gave their clothes to those who had explained the riddle. Burning with anger, he went up to his father's house.

ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro ase Yahasieli, mosinto o Zakaria o Benaya, o Yeieli, o Matania, Omolawi bw’ororeria rw’Asafu, ekero ateneine gati‐gati y’omosangererekano.
english: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite and descendant of Asaph, as he stood in the assembly.

ekegusii: Erio omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro ya Yefta, na ere agaeta ase egati y’ense ya Gileadi na eya Manase, akagenderera goeta Misipa ase Gileadi, na korwa aroro akagenda, agaika ense y’Abaamoni.
english: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah. He crossed Gilead and Manasseh, passed through Mizpah of Gilead, and from there he advanced against the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Omoika bw’Omonene ogacha igoro asende, ogantebia, “Batebie ng’a aya naro Omonene agoteba: Inwe Abaisraeli, naboigo mogokwana; inche nigo imanyete ayare ase chinkoro chiaino ime.
english: Then the Spirit of the LORD came upon me, and he told me to say: "This is what the LORD says: That is what you are saying, O house of Israel, but I know what is going through your mind.

ekegusii: Na omosomba oria agachaka koriga‐rigia, agachakera ase omomura omonene, agachia gokoorera ase omoke, na egekombe gekanyorekana ase egunia ya Benjamin.
english: Then the steward proceeded to search, beginning with the oldest and ending with the youngest. And the cup was found in Benjamin's sack.

ekegusii: Erio omonto onde bwensi oratigare ore moyo korwa ase abanto b’ebisaku abwo bachete korwania abanto ba Yerusalemu nabe ogotiira omwaka ase omwaka gochia gosasima Omoruoti, nere Omonene bw’Emeganda, naende narende Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.
english: Then the survivors from all the nations that have attacked Jerusalem will go up year after year to worship the King, the LORD Almighty, and to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.

ekegusii: rirorio emioro eyio moirogete, amo nenchara, nabibatunyane, bibaikeere agwo ase ense ya Misiri, bibaitere aroro.
english: then the sword you fear will overtake you there, and the famine you dread will follow you into Egypt, and there you will die.

ekegusii: Ekero Obomenyo bwatagoretwe Abagerisoni na Abamerari, abarenge kobobogoria, bagachaka orogendo.
english: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and Merarites, who carried it, set out.

ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakogenda orogendo, Eema y’Omosangererekano nebe ekobogorigwa n’Abalawi, na barabwo babe gati‐gati y’ebiombe binde. Ase omoroberio oyo abanto mbabe bagotoora, naboigo barabe kobakogenda orogendo. Kera omonto abe ensemo yaye inse y’ebendera yaye.
english: Then the Tent of Meeting and the camp of the Levites will set out in the middle of the camps. They will set out in the same order as they encamp, each in his own place under his standard.

ekegusii: Erio emete ye rinani netere nomogoko ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ere ngocha are konachera ense ekina.
english: Then the trees of the forest will sing, they will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.

ekegusii: Erio abanto baria babere bakairana, bagatirimboka korwa ase ebitunwa, bakaamboka orooche, bakagenda ase Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni. Agwo bakamotebia amang’ana onsi aya abanyorete,
english: Then the two men started back. They went down out of the hills, forded the river and came to Joshua son of Nun and told him everything that had happened to them.

ekegusii: Na barabwo bakabatebia aya akoreka inchera, buna emanyekania asebare ase ogosamunyora omogati.
english: Then the two told what had happened on the way, and how Jesus was recognized by them when he broke the bread.

ekegusii: Erio eriogi riria naigwete korwa igoro riare gokwana nainche naende, rigateba, “Genda, obogorie ebuku eria eigoire ere ase okoboko kw’omomalaika oria oteneine ase enyancha na ase ense enyomo.”
english: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me once more: "Go, take the scroll that lies open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land."

ekegusii: Naende omorendi akarora omonto onde okominyoka gocha ore bweka. Erio akarangeria omorendi bw’egesieri, akamotebia, “Omonto onde oyio gocha ore bweka!” Omoruoti agateba, “Nere boigo namang’ana amaya abwate.”
english: Then the watchman saw another man running, and he called down to the gatekeeper, "Look, another man running alone!" The king said, "He must be bringing good news, too."

ekegusii: Bakaimoka bonsi, bakaira Yeso ase Pilato.
english: Then the whole assembly rose and led him off to Pilate.

ekegusii: Erio omosangererekano bwonsi bw’abanto bagatoma amang’ana gochia ase abanto ba Benjamin baria barenge ase egetare kia Rimoni, bakabarareria omorembe.
english: Then the whole assembly sent an offer of peace to the Benjamites at the rock of Rimmon.

ekegusii: Erio omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli okaruao agwo ase obosio bwa Musa.
english: Then the whole Israelite community withdrew from Moses' presence,

ekegusii: Na rora, abanto bonsi b’omochie oria bakagenda koumerana na Yeso; bagachia komorora, bakamosorora arue ensemo yabo.
english: Then the whole town went out to meet Jesus. And when they saw him, they pleaded with him to leave their region.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akamoboria, “Ning’o oganetie nkorangererie arorekane?” Saulo akamoiraneria, “Indangererie Samweli.”
english: Then the woman asked, "Whom shall I bring up for you?" "Bring up Samuel," he said.

ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria aganye ase engaki y’amatuko emerongo etato na atato, goika amanyinga akame, na ere omonyene nabe oyochenegete. Tabaisa gokuna gento kende goinsi gechenegete, gose gosoa Aase Aachenu, goika amatuko aye ay’ogochenwa aere.
english: Then the woman must wait thirty-three days to be purified from her bleeding. She must not touch anything sacred or go to the sanctuary until the days of her purification are over.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria agatebia Elija, “Bono namanyire ng’a aye nomonto o Nyasae, naende ng’a ring’ana ri’Omonene rire ase omonwa oo neri’ekeene.”
english: Then the woman said to Elijah, "Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the LORD from your mouth is the truth."

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akabora, “Aye omoruoti, omonene one, ing’a inche, omosomba oo, ribaga nkwane ring’ana erimo asore.” Akamotebia, “Aye kwana.”
english: Then the woman said, "Let your servant speak a word to my lord the king." "Speak," he replied.

ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akaebereria abanto bonsi ase chisemi, na barabwo bakabutora Seba, mosinto o Bikiri, omotwe, bakayoruta gochia isiko ase Yoabu. Erio Yoabu akabugia egetureri, na abanto bonsi bagaserebekana; kera omonto akagenda bwoye. Na Yoabu akairana Yerusalemu ase omoruoti.
english: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise advice, and they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bicri and threw it to Joab. So he sounded the trumpet, and his men dispersed from the city, each returning to his home. And Joab went back to the king in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akagenda agatebia omosacha oye, “Omonto o Nyasae nachicha asende: nigo arenge kororekana buna omomalaika o Nyasae, nigo arenge bw’okoondokia mono. Tinamoboretie ase are korwa, nere tantebetie erieta riaye.
english: Then the woman went to her husband and told him, "A man of God came to me. He looked like an angel of God, very awesome. I didn't ask him where he came from, and he didn't tell me his name.

ekegusii: Na omokungu oria agasogwa nomoondoko na okoiguswa, akamanya eriamonyorire, agacha akamogwera, akamoorokeria ekeene gionsi.
english: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell at his feet and, trembling with fear, told him the whole truth.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria ekero achia korora ng’a tabisekaneti, agacha okoiguswa, akamogwera, na ase amasio ’abanto bonsi akamworokia engencho yagera omokuna, naende buna agwenetigwe ara rimo.
english: Then the woman, seeing that she could not go unnoticed, came trembling and fell at his feet. In the presence of all the people, she told why she had touched him and how she had been instantly healed.

ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Emeganda rigacha asende, rigantebia,
english: Then the word of the LORD Almighty came to me:

ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha goetera ase Hagai omobani, rikaboria:
english: Then the word of the LORD came through the prophet Haggai:

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija, Omotisibi, rikamotebia,
english: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite:

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija, Omotisibi, rigateba,
english: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite:

ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija, rikamotebia,
english: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah:

ekegusii: Naende ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Elija rikamotebia,
english: Then the word of the LORD came to him:

english: Then the word of the LORD came to him: "This man will not be your heir, but a son coming from your own body will be your heir."

english: Abamura bakaimoka, bakamotuba egetambaa, bakamobogoria gochia isiko, bakamotindeka.

english: Then their eyes were opened and they recognized him, and he disappeared from their sight.

ekegusii: Israeli ise akabatebia, “Onye naboigo are, bono mokore iga: Mobeke ebinto ebiya bi’ense eye yaito ase chigunia chiaino, moirere omonto oyio buna ebiegwa. Momoirere amaguta okogwenia make, na obooke boke, na ubani, na manemane, na amajozi, na amalozi.
english: Then their father Israel said to them, "If it must be, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your bags and take them down to the man as a gift-- a little balm and a little honey, some spices and myrrh, some pistachio nuts and almonds.

ekegusii: Ekero bakeetigwe na kworoba ase engencho y’ogokorerwa bobe na gochandwa,
english: Then their numbers decreased, and they were humbled by oppression, calamity and sorrow;

ekegusii: Korwa igoro y’eaanga eria yarenge igoro y’emetwe y’ebitongwa ebio okwoga gokaruao, na birobio bigatenena na kwororobia chimbaba chiabo gochia inse.
english: Then there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood with lowered wings.

ekegusii: Igo bikaba okomesa, na okogukura, ne chinkoba, na omotengecho omonene bw’ense. Na korwa ekero mwanyabanto bachagete koba ase ense motengecho onde tona koba omonene buna oyio.
english: Then there came flashes of lightning, rumblings, peals of thunder and a severe earthquake. No earthquake like it has ever occurred since man has been on earth, so tremendous was the quake.

ekegusii: Erio nario oragokigwe nebing’wanso bi’oboronge na ebi’ogosambwa; erio chieri nchiruegwe igoro ase egesasimero kiao.
english: Then there will be righteous sacrifices, whole burnt offerings to delight you; then bulls will be offered on your altar.

ekegusii: Onye nakorete ayio nigo nare koegwa egesusuro nabagambi ebina, ekiagera ayio nokomokana Nyasae ore igoro.”
english: then these also would be sins to be judged, for I would have been unfaithful to God on high.

ekegusii: Erio Abalawi aba bakaimoka: Mahati, mosinto bw’Amasai, na Yoeli, mosinto bw’Asaria, be chiamate chi’Abakohati; na korwa ase chiamate chia Merari: Kisi, mosinto bw’Abidi, na Asaria, mosinto o Yehaleleli; na korwa ase chiamate chia Gerisoni: Yoah, mosinto o Sima, na Edeni, mosinto o Yoa.
english: Then these Levites set to work: from the Kohathites, Mahath son of Amasai and Joel son of Azariah; from the Merarites, Kish son of Abdi and Azariah son of Jehallelel; from the Gershonites, Joah son of Zimmah and Eden son of Joah;

ekegusii: Bono abanto baria bagatubokera Danieli amo, bakamonyora ogosaba okorangeria Nyasae oye amokonye.
english: Then these men went as a group and found Daniel praying and asking God for help.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bagacha koebereria Daudi arie endagera, korende Daudi agatiana, ogoteba, “Nyasae ang’e egesusuru bono na kogenderera onye nkoria endagera erioba ritaragwa.”
english: Then they all came and urged David to eat something while it was still day; but David took an oath, saying, "May God deal with me, be it ever so severely, if I taste bread or anything else before the sun sets!"

ekegusii: Erio bonsi bakabwata Sostene, omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, bakamoaka ase obosio bw’ekegambero. Korende Galio tarora ng’a amang’ana ayio gose ngento.
english: Then they all turned on Sosthenes the synagogue ruler and beat him in front of the court. But Gallio showed no concern whatever.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria Yoshua, “Onsi ayagwatochikire natoyakore, na aase aande onsi oratotome natogende.
english: Then they answered Joshua, "Whatever you have commanded us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.

ekegusii: Naende batube egetambaa ekio ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche, na igoro ase risankwa erio baare egetambaa kere buru kegima. Erio basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria Esanduku eria.
english: Then they are to cover this with hides of sea cows, spread a cloth of solid blue over that and put the poles in place.

ekegusii: Igoro ase egesasimero ekio babeke ebikorero bionsi ebio bigokorerwa ase ogosasima: chindogio chi’okorenta omorero, ne chigami, na ebichiko, ne chisani, naende baare risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche igoro ase ebio bionsi, babitube. Erio basoyie emiaro y’okobogoreria egesasimero keria.
english: Then they are to place on it all the utensils used for ministering at the altar, including the firepans, meat forks, shovels and sprinkling bowls. Over it they are to spread a covering of hides of sea cows and put its poles in place.

ekegusii: Then they are to take other stones to replace these and take new clay and plaster the house.
english: Amagena ande arentwe, abekwe ribaga ri’aria atagorwa na gotugutwa, ne chinyasi, chioomwe nesike enyia.

ekegusii: Barabwo goika baimokie amanyinga aria, bayagindie emetobwa ebere ya gesieri na omoribo o igoro bw’emetobwa, ase kera enyomba barayeriere emanwa eria.
english: Then they are to take some of the blood and put it on the sides and tops of the doorframes of the houses where they eat the lambs.

ekegusii: Nababeke ekebekerero ekio amo nebikorero biaye ase omobuko bwe risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche, na kobibeka ase ekebogorerio.
english: Then they are to wrap it and all its accessories in a covering of hides of sea cows and put it on a carrying frame.

ekegusii: Erio bakaboria Baruku, “Totebie, naki gwakorete okarika amang’ana aya onsi? Inee! Nigo kwayarigete ekero Yeremia are koyakwana?”
english: Then they asked Baruch, "Tell us, how did you come to write all this? Did Jeremiah dictate it?"

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Naki agokorerete? Naki akoramogetie amaiso?”
english: Then they asked him, "What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?"

ekegusii: Nabo bakamoboria, “Ninki togokora tonyare gokora emeremo ya Nyasae?”
english: Then they asked him, "What must we do to do the works God requires?"

ekegusii: Erio bakamoboria, “Ng’ai Iso are?” Yeso akairaneria, “Timokomanya inche, nonya n’Tata timokomomanya, onye momanyete inche, anga mwamomanyire na Tata one.”
english: Then they asked him, "Where is your father?" "You do not know me or my Father," Jesus replied. "If you knew me, you would know my Father also."

ekegusii: Naende bakaboria, “Gesaku kende nkereo ki’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli getachicha ase Omonene agwo Misipa?” Bakanyora ng’a onde tari nonya noyomo korwa Yabesi o Gileadi ochete ase omosangererekano oria agwo ase egetwori.
english: Then they asked, "Which one of the tribes of Israel failed to assemble before the LORD at Mizpah?" They discovered that no one from Jabesh Gilead had come to the camp for the assembly.

ekegusii: Erio bakegena ring’ana ri’Omonene, agwo bagatera ase okomotogia.
english: Then they believed his promises and sang his praise.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio akarenterwa omonto obwatire nekerecha; ere nomouko orenge, naende nigo arenge rimama. Akamogwenia, goika oria orenge omouko ne rimama agakwana na korora.
english: Then they brought him a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute, and Jesus healed him, so that he could both talk and see.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakarentera Musa Obomenyo boria, na eema amo nebinto bionsi ebirabeo: ebigobanio, ne chibao, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo,
english: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, frames, crossbars, posts and bases;

ekegusii: Erio bagasamba omochie nomorero, amo nebinto bionsi, otatiga ebie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu, na ebi’ebioma. Ebinto ebio bikabekwa ase ekungo y’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Then they burned the whole city and everything in it, but they put the silver and gold and the articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the LORD's house.

ekegusii: Abaasuri bagaaka eriogi rinene ase omonwa bw’Ekeyuda ase abanto ba Yerusalemu abarenge igoro ase orwaki ase okobagosa na koboboyia, erinde baire omochie oria.
english: Then they called out in Hebrew to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, to terrify them and make them afraid in order to capture the city.

ekegusii: Bakabarangeria, bakabatianera tibabaisa gokwana gose kworokereria ase erieta ria Yeso.
english: Then they called them in again and commanded them not to speak or teach at all in the name of Jesus.

ekegusii: Erio abanto bagaika Elimu; agwo chinsoko nchiarengeo ikomi na ibere, na emekendo emerongo etano na ebere. Bagatoora agwo ang’e namache.
english: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees, and they camped there near the water.

ekegusii: Bagaika Yeriko. Goika agachia koba okobwatia enchera korwa Yeriko amo naborokigwa baye na omoganda omonene, omwana o Timayo, Baritimayo, oria orenge omouko, nigo arenge oikaransete enchera ensemo, ogosaba ebiegwa.
english: Then they came to Jericho. As Jesus and his disciples, together with a large crowd, were leaving the city, a blind man, Bartimaeus (that is, the Son of Timaeus), was sitting by the roadside begging.

ekegusii: Abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, na ab’ekia Gadi bagacha ase Musa bakabora, “Toe ribaga toagache ameri amakong’u aiga ase chitugo chiaito chikobeera, naende toagache emechie egiteire chindwaki ase abana baito baramenye.
english: Then they came up to him and said, "We would like to build pens here for our livestock and cities for our women and children.

ekegusii: erinde borokererie abakungu abasubati banche abasacha babo, na abana babo.
english: Then they can train the younger women to love their husbands and children,

ekegusii: bakayesoyia ase hekalu ya Dagoni, bakayebeka ensemo ya Dagoni, enyasae yabo.
english: Then they carried the ark into Dagon's temple and set it beside Dagon.

ekegusii: Bakabakorera obomera, na obomera bokagwera Matia; ere agachorwa koba amo nabatomwa ikomi nomo.
english: Then they cast lots, and the lot fell to Matthias; so he was added to the eleven apostles.

ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yabo, nere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
english: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.

ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
english: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.

ekegusii: Erio bakarera ase Omonene ase engencho y’emechando yabo, ere akabatooria korwa ase obokong’u bwabo.
english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto baria bakarera ase Omonene, bagateba, “Aye Omonene, twagosoroire, tototiga tosire ase engencho y’obogima bw’omonto oyo. Tobaisa gotobarera okomocha kw’ogokwa kw’omonto otari na komocha, ekiagera aye Omonene gwakorire buna bwanchete.”
english: Then they cried to the LORD, "O LORD, please do not let us die for taking this man's life. Do not hold us accountable for killing an innocent man, for you, O LORD, have done as you pleased."

ekegusii: Abanto bagachaya ense eria yarenge engiya, ekiagera tibegenete eira y’Omonene.
english: Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe his promise.

ekegusii: Naende bakarema, bakanyora entuboka ende, nero bakayiomanera. Ase igo akayeroka Sitina.
english: Then they dug another well, but they quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.

ekegusii: Chibesa chiria chikaegwa abateneneri b’emeremo yare gokorerwa ase enyomba y’Omonene; na barabwo bagachia abanto barenge koroisia enyomba y’Omonene na koyeagacha naende.
english: Then they entrusted it to the men appointed to supervise the work on the LORD's temple. These men paid the workers who repaired and restored the temple.

ekegusii: bakaba bakorenta ase obwegenwa ensemo yabo ya ikomi, amo nebinto biatananetwe ase Omonene. Konania Omolawi nere orenge omoteneneri bw’ebinto ebio, na Simei, omomura omwabo, nere orenge omokonyi oye.
english: Then they faithfully brought in the contributions, tithes and dedicated gifts. Conaniah, a Levite, was in charge of these things, and his brother Shimei was next in rank.

ekegusii: Bakayesiberania bosio bw’ekegogwa ne chiusi chiburu, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: Then they fastened a blue cord to it to attach it to the turban, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Bakayabeka ase ebitwanga bi’amareko ase egesibao ki’obokuani, abe ase okoinyora abamura ba Israeli. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Na emeika eria egasangereria abaruoti amo gochia aase akorokwa ase Ekeibirania Arimagedon.
english: Then they gathered the kings together to the place that in Hebrew is called Armageddon.

ekegusii: Abanto bakarua chibesa, bakaa abaagacheri b’amagena, na abasenia be chibao, naende bakarua chindagera, na ebinyugwa, na amaguta ’amazeituni, ase Abasidoni na Abaturo, erinde barente emecharake korwa Lebanoni goetera ase enyancha goika Yopa, koreng’ana buna Koresi, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi abaete ribaga.
english: Then they gave money to the masons and carpenters, and gave food and drink and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre, so that they would bring cedar logs by sea from Lebanon to Joppa, as authorized by Cyrus king of Persia.

ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia eanga ya Yusufu, na bakanyenya embori, bakaimokia eanga eria, bakayetobeka ase amanyinga;
english: Then they got Joseph's robe, slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood.

ekegusii: Ase igo bakarusia na gotuguta chinyasae chingeni echiarenge ase egati yabo, bagakorera Omonene. Na bono Omonene tare konyara koremereria naende korora emechando y’Abaisraeli.
english: Then they got rid of the foreign gods among them and served the LORD. And he could bear Israel's misery no longer.

ekegusii: Ababani baria babere bakaigwa eriogi rinene korwa igoro rikobatebia, “Tiira gocha aa!” Bagatiira gochia igoro ase amare ime, na ababisa babo babarigereretie.
english: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here." And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies looked on.

ekegusii: Erio bakamorama, bakabora, “Naye ore omworokigwa oye, korerende intwe nigo tore aborokigwa ba Musa.
english: Then they hurled insults at him and said, "You are this fellow's disciple! We are disciples of Moses!

ekegusii: Bakarigia komobwata, korende bakairoka omoganda, ekiagera bamanyete ng’a omoreng’anio oria nabwo ogoteba; bakamotiga, bakagenda.
english: Then they looked for a way to arrest him because they knew he had spoken the parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd; so they left him and went away.

ekegusii: Bagatura ebigobanio bie chitahabu emerongo etano, na ase ebio bakabwatania amarondia ayio amo, akaba eema eyemo y’Obomenyo.
english: Then they made fifty gold clasps and used them to fasten the two sets of curtains together so that the tabernacle was a unit.

ekegusii: Bagakora ebioro emerongo etano, bakabibeka ase ensinyo ye rirondia rinene rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase rirondia rinene ria kabere ase rigochakera.
english: Then they made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in one set and also along the edge of the end curtain in the other set.

ekegusii: Bagakora rirondia ri’amasankwa e chimingichi aakire etaago, ase ogotuba eema, ne rirondia rinde ri’amasankwa amaterere e ching’iti chia rooche, erirabekwe igoro ye rirondia rie ritang’ani.
english: Then they made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red, and over that a covering of hides of sea cows.

ekegusii: Na barabwo kobanyorire eira y’okobatenenera korwa ase Yasoni na abamwabo, bakabatiga bagende.
english: Then they made Jason and the others post bond and let them go.

ekegusii: Bagakora ebioro bie chiusi chiburu, bakabibeka ase ensinyo y’egetambaa kere ensinyo y’ensemo ya kera rirondia.
english: Then they made loops of blue material along the edge of the end curtain in one set, and the same was done with the end curtain in the other set.

ekegusii: Bakorokia ise ase ogokwana kw’ebimanyererio bi’amaboko, komoboria buna arigetie arokwe.
english: Then they made signs to his father, to find out what he would like to name the child.

ekegusii: Naende bagakora chibonyi chinde chie chitahabu, bagachibeka ase ebitwanga biria bibere bi’amareko bi’egesibao bire bosio, ang’e nomobarero, igoro y’orokini rw’egesibao.
english: Then they made two more gold rings and attached them to the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod, close to the seam just above the waistband of the ephod.

ekegusii: Bagakebekera emeng’ororia ene y’amagena e rigori. Ase omong’ororia bwe ritang’ani bakabeka saridio, na topasio, na sumaridi;
english: Then they mounted four rows of precious stones on it. In the first row there was a ruby, a topaz and a beryl;

ekegusii: Erio kobare orogendo rwabo korwa Beteli, ekero batigairie orogendo oroke baike Efarati, Raeli agachaka kobina ase okoibora, akaba nobokong’u bw’okoibora.
english: Then they moved on from Bethel. While they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth and had great difficulty.

ekegusii: Then they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.
english: Bakamoa edivai yochoganirie na manemane anywe, ko tancha konywa.

ekegusii: Then they overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.
english: Akayeoma netahabu echenire, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etahabu.

ekegusii: Bagasaba, bakabora, “Aye omonene, oyomanyete chinkoro chi’abanto bonsi, tworokie ning’o gwachorire ase abaiga babere
english: Then they prayed, "Lord, you know everyone's heart. Show us which of these two you have chosen

ekegusii: Then they remembered his words.
english: Bakainyora amang’ana aye.

ekegusii: Erio bakairana gochia Yerusalemu korwa ase egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, kiarenge ang’e na Yerusalemu, oboare bw’orogendo rwe rituko ri’Esabato.
english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the hill called the Mount of Olives, a Sabbath day's walk from the city.

ekegusii: Erio bagatebania, “Aya tari aro amaronge togokora. Rituko ria rero neri’amang’ana amaya. Onye togokira na koganya goika bokie, ekeene, egesusuro ngetonyore. Ase ayio, inchuo togende, totebie abanto b’enyomba y’omoruoti amang’ana aya.”
english: Then they said to each other, "We're not doing right. This is a day of good news and we are keeping it to ourselves. If we wait until daylight, punishment will overtake us. Let's go at once and report this to the royal palace."

ekegusii: Abanto baria bakamotebia, “Koranche, oborie Nyasae, erinde tomanye orogendo oro rwaito twachakire gose noruya rorabe!”
english: Then they said to him, "Please inquire of God to learn whether our journey will be successful."

ekegusii: Erio bagatebia Yeremia, “Tiga Omonene abe kirori bw’ekeene na oyo bw’obwegenwa igoro asetore onye titogochia gokora koreng’ana onsi aya Omonene, Nyasae oo aratotebie goetera asore.
english: Then they said to Jeremiah, "May the LORD be a true and faithful witness against us if we do not act in accordance with everything the LORD your God sends you to tell us.

ekegusii: Erio bakairaneria, bakamotebia, “Aye omoruoti, Danieli, oria oyomo bw’Abayuda baria boosetwe, ere tari gokoigwera, gose koigwera richiko riria kwabegete ekemanyererio kiao, korende nigo agokora ogosaba kwaye botambe ara gatato kera rituko.”
english: Then they said to the king, "Daniel, who is one of the exiles from Judah, pays no attention to you, O king, or to the decree you put in writing. He still prays three times a day."

ekegusii: Erio bagateba, “Inchuo tweagachere omochie na omorobiri, na obotambe bwaye boike erioba igoro, twekorere erieta rinene, titobaisa gocha goserebanigwa ase ense yonsi.”
english: Then they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens, so that we may make a name for ourselves and not be scattered over the face of the whole earth."

ekegusii: Bakamotebia, “Tiga torangerie omoiseke, tomoborie, toigwe buna agoteba.”
english: Then they said, "Let's call the girl and ask her about it."

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamotebia, “Nyasae bw’Abaibirania natoorokera. Koranche, otoe ribaga togende orogendo rw’amatuko atato gochia ase erooro, erinde toruere Omonene, Nyasae oito, ebing’wanso, tabaisa gocha gotoita namarwaire gose nemioro.”
english: Then they said, "The God of the Hebrews has met with us. Now let us take a three-day journey into the desert to offer sacrifices to the LORD our God, or he may strike us with plagues or with the sword."

ekegusii: Bakabora, “Mborori ki torigetie goetania obo? Naki intwe abanyene twaigure amang’ana korwa ase omonwa oye.”
english: Then they said, "Why do we need any more testimony? We have heard it from his own lips."

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagaikaransa inse agwo amo nere ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere, omobaso na obotuko; agwo onde tabete ogokwana ing’ana rinde rionsi ase Ayubu, ekiagera baroche ng’a emechando yaye nigo yarenge emenene mono.
english: Then they sat on the ground with him for seven days and seven nights. No one said a word to him, because they saw how great his suffering was.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakarigia ase ense yonsi y’Abaisraeli, banyore omoiseke omwekungi omonyakieni. Bakanyora Abisagi Omosunemu, bakamorenta ase omoruoti.
english: Then they searched throughout Israel for a beautiful girl and found Abishag, a Shunammite, and brought her to the king.

ekegusii: Goika bakagenka abanto batebe, “Ntwaigwa omonto oyo ogokwana amang’ana ’oborami igoro ya Musa na Nyasae.”
english: Then they secretly persuaded some men to say, "We have heard Stephen speak words of blasphemy against Moses and against God."

ekegusii: Ase igo bagatoma abanto ase baria bemenyete Kiriati‐Yearimu babatebie ng’a, “Abafilisti bairanirie Esanduku eria y’Omonene. Tirimboka gocha moyioyie.”
english: Then they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath Jearim, saying, "The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD. Come down and take it up to your place."

ekegusii: Erio bagatoma amang’ana ase Yesebeli, bagateba, “Naboti oakirwe amagena okure.”
english: Then they sent word to Jezebel: "Naboth has been stoned and is dead."

ekegusii: Naende bakarua agwo Oboti, bakagenda bagaika Iye‐Abarimu, agwo ase erooro ere moocha ya Moabu, bagatoora aroro.
english: Then they set out from Oboth and camped in Iye Abarim, in the desert that faces Moab toward the sunrise.

ekegusii: Ekero baimogete kogenda orogendo rwabo, okoondokia gokarua ase Nyasae, gokabwata abanto b’emechie eria yabaetanaine; ase igo tibanyara kobwatia basinto ba Yakobo.
english: Then they set out, and the terror of God fell upon the towns all around them so that no one pursued them.

ekegusii: Then they spit in his face and struck him with their fists. Others slapped him
english: Erio agwo bakamotwera amate obosio, bakamoaka chinkundi; abande bakamoaka chindoe,

ekegusii: Bagakwana ring’ana ri’Omonene asare na ase abanto bonsi abarenge mwaye.
english: Then they spoke the word of the Lord to him and to all the others in his house.

ekegusii: Erio bakabaukoria abanto baria barenge gesieri isiko, abake na abanene, erinde bagasinywa konyora egesieri.
english: Then they struck the men who were at the door of the house, young and old, with blindness so that they could not find the door.

ekegusii: Erio baeta bwango buna omwaga, bagenderera gochia bosio; abanto abwo bare abamochi, ne chinguru chiabo nachio enyasae yabo.”
english: Then they sweep past like the wind and go on-- guilty men, whose own strength is their god."

ekegusii: Bakamobwata, bakamoira goika Areopago, bakamoboria, “Inee! Nonyare gototebia engencho y’okworokereria okwo okoyia ogokwana?
english: Then they took him and brought him to a meeting of the Areopagus, where they said to him, "May we know what this new teaching is that you are presenting?

ekegusii: Erio bakaimokia Yona, bakamoruta ase enyancha ime; ero ekaba nobotoereru.
english: Then they took Jonah and threw him overboard, and the raging sea grew calm.

ekegusii: Erio bakabogoria amauga abo, bakayatindeka inse y’omote onga buna ekerachuoki agwo Yabesi, bakeng’ata ase engaki y’amatuko atano na abere.
english: Then they took their bones and buried them under a tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.

ekegusii: Bagakora emeremo yabo, kera oyomo aase aye, koreng’ana namachiko a Musa, omonto o Nyasae. Abakuani bakanyororokeria amanyinga aria banyorete korwa ase amaboko ’Abalawi.
english: Then they took up their regular positions as prescribed in the Law of Moses the man of God. The priests sprinkled the blood handed to them by the Levites.

ekegusii: Ekero Abadani bairete ebinyasae biria Mika aroisetie, amo nomokuani oye, bakagenda koumokera abanto ba Laisi, abanto baria bamenyete ase obotoereru batare na bwoba bonde, bakabaita nemioro, na omochie obo bakayosamba nomorero.
english: Then they took what Micah had made, and his priest, and went on to Laish, against a peaceful and unsuspecting people. They attacked them with the sword and burned down their city.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakairana, bagaetera ase enchera yarenge kogenda Basani. Ogi, omoruoti o Basani, agacha amo nabarwani baye korwania Abaisraeli agwo Edirei.
english: Then they turned and went up along the road toward Bashan, and Og king of Bashan and his whole army marched out to meet them in battle at Edrei.

ekegusii: Erio bakairana goika Enimisifati, noro Kadeshi, bagasaria ense yonsi y’Abaamaleki, na eya Abaamori abwo bamenyete Hasasoni‐Tamari.
english: Then they turned back and went to En Mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who were living in Hazazon Tamar.

ekegusii: Erio bakamanya ng’a tare kobatebia okwerenda nememera y’emegati, korende nokworokereria kw’Abafarisai na Abasadukai.
english: Then they understood that he was not telling them to guard against the yeast used in bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

ekegusii: Bakairana, bakaroisia amanukato na amaguta e rimisu rigiya. Ne rituko ri’Esabato bagatimoka buna yachigetwe.
english: Then they went home and prepared spices and perfumes. But they rested on the Sabbath in obedience to the commandment.

ekegusii: Bakagenda ase Hezekia omoruoti, bakamotebia, “Twachenire enyomba yonsi y’Omonene, na egesasimero gi’okoruera ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, amo nebikorero biaye bionsi, na emesa y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae amo nebikorero biaye bionsi bi’emesa eyio.
english: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and reported: "We have purified the entire temple of the LORD, the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the table for setting out the consecrated bread, with all its articles.

ekegusii: Erio bakagenda ase Yoshua ase egetwori kia Giligali bakamotebia ere amo n’Abaisraeli, “Intwe nigo twarure ense y’aare. Ntorigetie mokore okobwatana naintwe.”
english: Then they went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal and said to him and the men of Israel, "We have come from a distant country; make a treaty with us."

ekegusii: Bakagenda Turo, omochie ore ne chindwaki, na ase emechie yonsi y’Abahivi, na ey’Abakanani. Nyuma y’ayio bakagenda Beeri‐Seba ase ense y’Abayuda, ensemo ya sugusu.
english: Then they went toward the fortress of Tyre and all the towns of the Hivites and Canaanites. Finally, they went on to Beersheba in the Negev of Judah.

ekegusii: Bagancha komosoyia obwato ime, erio kegima obwato bogaika ase barenge kogenda.
english: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.

ekegusii: Erio mbarere ase Omonene, korende ere takobaigwa. Ase engaki eyio ere nababise obosio bwaye, ekiagera babeire bagokora ayare amabe.”
english: Then they will cry out to the LORD, but he will not answer them. At that time he will hide his face from them because of the evil they have done.

ekegusii: Erio nario barabwatie emeroberio yane echikire, babwatie na amachiko aane na koyaigwera. Barabwo mbabe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.
english: Then they will follow my decrees and be careful to keep my laws. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

ekegusii: Then they will have towns to live in and pasturelands for their cattle, flocks and all their other livestock.
english: Emechie eyio ebe eyabo baramenye, na ebitii bi’oborisia bakorisia chiombe chiabo ne ching’iti chiabo chinde chionsi.

ekegusii: Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene Nyasae obo, ekiagera ninche nabaruete bakairwa ase obosomba bamenye ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku; naende ninche ndabasangererie na kobairania ase ense yabo. Tingotiga nonya nomonto oyomo obo agenderere kobeera ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku ebio.
english: Then they will know that I am the LORD their God, for though I sent them into exile among the nations, I will gather them to their own land, not leaving any behind.

ekegusii: Ekero ndabe nasaririe kegima ense eyio yabo ebe bosa, ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bionsi bi’okogechia bakorire, erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the detestable things they have done.'

ekegusii: Erio ekero ndabe natongirie omorero agwo Misiri, na abakonyi baye bonsi basirigwe, barabwo mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are crushed.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbamanye ng’a inche Omonene, Nyasae obo, nigo inde amo nabarabwo, naende ng’a Abaisraeli barabwo nabanto baane. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them and that they, the house of Israel, are my people, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: naende baonchoke barigererie ense inse, korende nigo bararore obororo, na omosunte, na ogoichanigwa okonene, erio basoigwe ase omosunte ekerima.
english: Then they will look toward the earth and see only distress and darkness and fearful gloom, and they will be thrust into utter darkness.

ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo mbatebe, “Titobwati omoruoti, ekiagera titomoirogeti Omonene. Inee! Toraba nomoruoti, ngento ki aratokorere?”
english: Then they will say, "We have no king because we did not revere the LORD. But even if we had a king, what could he do for us?"

ekegusii: Erio barabwo mbakoreere, babokie amagombo batebe: “Aye omochie omenyire nabanto be chinyancha, naki gwasarigwe! Aye omochie omanyekanete mono, aye kwarenge ne chinguru ase enyancha, nigo gwaichanetie bonsi abamenyete ime yao na kobaondokia.
english: Then they will take up a lament concerning you and say to you: "'How you are destroyed, O city of renown, peopled by men of the sea! You were a power on the seas, you and your citizens; you put your terror on all who lived there.

ekegusii: Na barabwo bakamosasima, bakairana Yerusalemu nomogoko omonene;
english: Then they worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

ekegusii: Erio nario barabe bagosemeria Nyasae, na tibabaisa kweba emeremo yaye, korende babe bakobwata amachiko aye.
english: Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget his deeds but would keep his commands.

ekegusii: Omochie oyio nobe okongokia ase ogontogia na okombaka ase amasio ’ebisaku bionsi bire ase ense, ebio biraigwe chinkuma chi’amang’ana nakoreire abanto b’omochie oyio. Abanto b’ebisaku mbairoke na koiguswa ase obwoba, ekiagera nakoreire omochie oyio amaya, naende nayosesenirie.”
english: Then this city will bring me renown, joy, praise and honor before all nations on earth that hear of all the good things I do for it; and they will be in awe and will tremble at the abundant prosperity and peace I provide for it.'

ekegusii: Nabo Tomas, ore korokwa Barongo, agatebia aborokigwa bamwabo, “Togende naintwe, tokwe amo nere.”
english: Then Thomas (called Didymus) said to the rest of the disciples, "Let us also go, that we may die with him."

ekegusii: Naende nabwo bakwete ase Kristo basirire.
english: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ are lost.

ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bamoirogete Omonene bakaba bagokwana barabwo ase barabwo; Omonene agategerera, akaigwa amang’ana abo, na ebuku y’ekeinyorio ekarikwa ase obosio bwaye ase okoinyora abwo bamoirogete na barengereretie igoro y’erieta riaye.
english: Then those who feared the LORD talked with each other, and the LORD listened and heard. A scroll of remembrance was written in his presence concerning those who feared the LORD and honored his name.

ekegusii: Nabwo abarenge ase obwato ime bakamosasima, bagateba, “Ekeene, aye n’Omwana o Nyasae.”
english: Then those who were in the boat worshiped him, saying, "Truly you are the Son of God."

ekegusii: Abayuda chilifu isato bagatirimboka gochia ase rikuruma riria ri’egetare gi’Etamu, bakaboria Samison, “Aye tomanyeti ng’a Abafilisti nabwo bagotogambera? Ase ayio, ngento ki eke gwatokoreire?” Ere akabairaneria, “Eke bakorete asende, nakio nainche nabakoreire barabwo.”
english: Then three thousand men from Judah went down to the cave in the rock of Etam and said to Samson, "Don't you realize that the Philistines are rulers over us? What have you done to us?" He answered, "I merely did to them what they did to me."

ekegusii: Then thundered the horses' hoofs-- galloping, galloping go his mighty steeds.
english: Erio chibarasi chiare gotitiria nebitaago biabo, chituoni chiachiriinete chiare gocharara‐charara.

ekegusii: Aase agwo Omonene, Nyasae oino, arachore abe obomenyo bw’erieta riaye, nao morarente ebinto bionsi nabachikire: ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde, na ensemo yaino ya ikomi, na okoruegwa konde morarente, na ebiegwa mwarierete Omonene eira komoruera.
english: Then to the place the LORD your God will choose as a dwelling for his Name-- there you are to bring everything I command you: your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, and all the choice possessions you have vowed to the LORD.

ekegusii: Nkarora abakori amabe batindekirwe batimogete, na abwo baare gokora ayare boronge barure ase Obomenyo bw’Oyore Omochenu, bakebwa ase omochie. Ayio boigo mbosa.
english: Then too, I saw the wicked buried-- those who used to come and go from the holy place and receive praise in the city where they did this. This too is meaningless.

ekegusii: Abanto babere abatagwenereti bagacha, bagaikaransa kororia asare, bakamosoera ase amasio ’abanto, bagateba, “Naboti oragerere Nyasae na omoruoti.” Ase igo abanto bakamosokia isiko y’omochie, bakamoaka amagena goika agakwa.
english: Then two scoundrels came and sat opposite him and brought charges against Naboth before the people, saying, "Naboth has cursed both God and the king." So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death.

ekegusii: Then use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony,
english: Oake Eema y’Omosangererekano, na Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori,

ekegusii: Erio tokarera ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaito, atokonye, nere agatoigwa, akarora emechando yaito, na emeremo emekong’u twarenge gokora, na ogokorerwa bobe gwaito.
english: Then we cried out to the LORD, the God of our fathers, and the LORD heard our voice and saw our misery, toil and oppression.

ekegusii: “Erio tokaonchoka, tokagenda gochia ase erooro goetera ase enchera egochia ase Enyancha Embariri, buna Omonene konya antebirie. Ase amatuko amange, tokaba tokonakoong’anya ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Seiri.”
