english: Then we turned back and set out toward the desert along the route to the Red Sea, as the LORD had directed me. For a long time we made our way around the hill country of Seir.

ekegusii: Erio toorokere Daudi aande onsi aranyorekane, tomogwere buna riime rikogwa igoro ase riroba, gose titotiga onde bwensi abe moyo, ere gose monto onde bwensi bare komo.
english: Then we will attack him wherever he may be found, and we will fall on him as dew settles on the ground. Neither he nor any of his men will be left alive.

ekegusii: Ntorigetie koba buna ebisaku binde; ntoganetie omoruoti ogotogambera na gototang’ana, ekero togochia korwana chisegi chiaito.”
english: Then we will be like all the other nations, with a king to lead us and to go out before us and fight our battles."

ekegusii: Erio natobae abaiseke baito, na intwe toire abaino, tomenye amo, tobe abanto abamo.
english: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We'll settle among you and become one people with you.

ekegusii: erinde titoba naende abana ebing’werere, bagotugutwa aaria na aaria, na koirwa ase kera embeo y’okworokereria, ase obong’ainereria bw’abanto, ekero bakobang’aina kobwatia chinchera chi’okobasiria.
english: Then we will no longer be infants, tossed back and forth by the waves, and blown here and there by every wind of teaching and by the cunning and craftiness of men in their deceitful scheming.

ekegusii: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name.
english: Erio titokoonchoka togotige; torende togenderere koba moyo, na intwe ntobe togotogia erieta riao.

ekegusii: Erio intwe, abanto bao, aba tore abe riicho ri’oborisia bwao, natokoiranerie ng’a mbuya mono kogenderera botambe, na ebiaare ase ebiaare natobe tokogotogia.
english: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will recount your praise.

ekegusii: Nase ki rende mwachiete isiko? Korora omobani? Ee, nabatebirie, oyore omonene kobua omobani.
english: Then what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio rigaikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia,
english: Then what was said through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:

ekegusii: Erio rigaikeranigwa eriatebetwe nomobani Yeremia, ogoteba, “Bakaimokia chibesa chiria chie chifeta emerongo etato, rigori riaye oria obegetwe rigori nabanto bande b’Abaisraeli,
english: Then what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: "They took the thirty silver coins, the price set on him by the people of Israel,

ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ’ogochika okwo kw’omoruoti arararigwe ase oboruoti obo obonene, abakungu bonsi, abanene na abake, mbabe bagosika abasacha babo.”
english: Then when the king's edict is proclaimed throughout all his vast realm, all the women will respect their husbands, from the least to the greatest."

ekegusii: na ense eria ebe yabuirwe ase Omonene. Nyuma y’ayio nario moranyare koirana aiga motari na komocha, na igo monyore ense eye ebe eyaino, monyare komenya ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free from your obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will be your possession before the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria amo nomokungu oye o sere‐sere, na omosomba oye, baimogete kogenda, ise omosubati oria akamotebia, “Rora bono omobaso oerire, na bwaisire koiira, nagosoroire, beera aiga ase obotuko bwa rero naende, oigwe buya. Ankio oimoke mambia chuni, ochake orogendo, ogende seino.”
english: Then when the man, with his concubine and his servant, got up to leave, his father-in-law, the girl's father, said, "Now look, it's almost evening. Spend the night here; the day is nearly over. Stay and enjoy yourself. Early tomorrow morning you can get up and be on your way home."

ekegusii: Abanto bao bonsi mbabe abanyene oboronge, mbaire ense ebe eyabo kare na kare; barabwo nigo barabe ekemeri kiane nasimegete, emeremo y’amaboko aane, erio inche ntogigwe.
english: Then will all your people be righteous and they will possess the land forever. They are the shoot I have planted, the work of my hands, for the display of my splendor.

ekegusii: Igo nimbe ngotera ase ogotogia erieta riao botambe, naende rituko ase rituko imbe ngoikeranie chiira chiane.
english: Then will I ever sing praise to your name and fulfill my vows day after day.

ekegusii: Erio ngende ase egesasimero kiao, aye Nyasae, Nyasae, aye oyore omogoko one omonene, nimbugie obokano na gotera ogotera gw’okogotogia, aye Nyasae ore Nyasae one.
english: Then will I go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the harp, O God, my God.

ekegusii: Then will the eyes of the blind be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
english: Erio amaiso ’emeuko aramokigwe, na amato ’emetino atinorwe.

ekegusii: Ebisegora mbichara‐charoke buna chinsune, ne chimeme chi’amamama nchitere nomogoko. Chindooche nchisoke ase erooro, na ebirooche ase ekerubo ekiomo.
english: Then will the lame leap like a deer, and the mute tongue shout for joy. Water will gush forth in the wilderness and streams in the desert.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio momokoobe gocha aiga nka asende, nere aikaranse ase ekerogo kiane ki’oboruoti, ekiagera nere orabe omoruoti ase ribaga riane; nere nachorire agambere Abaisraeli na Abayuda.”
english: Then you are to go up with him, and he is to come and sit on my throne and reign in my place. I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah."

ekegusii: Erio omoiranerie, omotebie: Ney’omosomba oo Yakobo, nekeegwa akorenteire aye omonene one Esau; ere omonyene ngotobwatia are korwa nyuma,”
english: then you are to say, 'They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift sent to my lord Esau, and he is coming behind us.'"

ekegusii: Erio mosabe ase erieta ri’enyasae yaino na inche nsabe ase erieta ri’Omonene one; na Nyasae oria oriaranerie ase okorenta omorero, oyio nere Nyasae.” Abanto bonsi bakairaneria, “Ayio naro amang’ana amaya gwakwanire.”
english: Then you call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the LORD. The god who answers by fire-- he is God." Then all the people said, "What you say is good."

ekegusii: Nkwamentete obotayayi bwao, okagenda nonya ngochia ase ense y’Abakalidayo, abwo bare abaonchoreria, na barabwo boigo tibagoisanegetie.”
english: Then you increased your promiscuity to include Babylonia, a land of merchants, but even with this you were not satisfied.

ekegusii: rirorio goika momanye ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, tagoseria abanto aba korwa asemore, korende barabwo nigo barabe bakobatega, naende babe buna ebiranya bikobang’wania amakere aino, na buna amagwa akobeta amaiso aino. Goika mosirigwe kegima korwa ase ense eye engiya Omonene, Nyasae oino, abaeire
english: then you may be sure that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become snares and traps for you, whips on your backs and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land, which the LORD your God has given you.

ekegusii: Mouna‐unie mono amang’ana ayio, erio momanye buya gose nabo are. Onye okogechia buna okwo gwakorekanire ase egati yaino,
english: then you must inquire, probe and investigate it thoroughly. And if it is true and it has been proved that this detestable thing has been done among you,

ekegusii: timori komotiga naende amokorere ise gose ng’ina ring’ana rinde.
english: then you no longer let him do anything for his father or mother.

ekegusii: “Erio mokang’iraneria mogantebia: Twakorire ebibe ase Omonene, korende bono nkogenda tore korwana esegi buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, atochigete. Kera omonto asemore akabogoria ebirwanero biaye bi’esegi, akarengereria ng’a namang’ana amagusu kogenda koira ense eria y’ebitunwa.
english: Then you replied, "We have sinned against the LORD. We will go up and fight, as the LORD our God commanded us." So every one of you put on his weapons, thinking it easy to go up into the hill country.

ekegusii: Oiranerie amang’ana aya okwane ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oo: Sokororia yane nigo arenge Omoaramu, orenge okona‐koong’anyang’anya. Agatirimboka gochia Misiri, akaba omomenyi aroro amo nabanto baye. Ekero agendete ase ense eria nigo abwate abanto abake, na aroro agwo bakabucha, bakaba egesaku ekenene, kiarenge nechinguru, naende kiarenge nabanto abange.
english: Then you shall declare before the LORD your God: "My father was a wandering Aramean, and he went down into Egypt with a few people and lived there and became a great nation, powerful and numerous.

ekegusii: Erio namondangerie mochiche asende mosabe, nainche nimbaigwe.
english: Then you will call upon me and come and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

ekegusii: Erio norangerie, na Omonene nakoiranerie, norere, nere natebe iga: Nao inde aa.” “Koratige kobekera abande amakorogoto, na kobaraga nekiara, na kobakwana bobe;
english: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry for help, and he will say: Here am I. "If you do away with the yoke of oppression, with the pointing finger and malicious talk,

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio moimokie emegwekano yaino mogosasima, eyio ebachire na koomwa ne chifeta, na eyende ebombire na koomwa netahabu, moyetugute buna ebinto bitachenegeti, moyetebie: “Karue aa asetore!”
english: Then you will defile your idols overlaid with silver and your images covered with gold; you will throw them away like a menstrual cloth and say to them, "Away with you!"

ekegusii: rirorio nonyore omogoko asende inche Omonene, nainche ningoetie ase ebitunwa bi’ense igoro, nkoe omwando o Yakobo, sokoro yao, oyorie.” Omonene nere okwanire amang’ana ayio korwa ase omonwa oye.
english: then you will find your joy in the LORD, and I will cause you to ride on the heights of the land and to feast on the inheritance of your father Jacob." The mouth of the LORD has spoken.

ekegusii: Erio notaare ase enchera yao kore noborendi obuya, gose tokogochwa okogoro kwao.
english: Then you will go on your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble;

ekegusii: Korarende na kobwata emeroberio yonsi eyio Omonene achigete Musa ase engencho y’Abaisraeli nigo orasesenigwe. Obe omokong’u na omoremu! Toiroka, tobaisa gokwa omoyo!
english: Then you will have success if you are careful to observe the decrees and laws that the LORD gave Moses for Israel. Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or discouraged.

ekegusii: Erio namomanye ng’a inche nigo inde ase egati y’Abaisraeli, naende ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, naende Nyasae onde omoao tari. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende.”
english: Then you will know that I am in Israel, that I am the LORD your God, and that there is no other; never again will my people be shamed.

ekegusii: Ekero ndabarente ase ense y’Abaisraeli eyio nariete eira na gotiana ng’a ninyee chisokoro chiaino, erio momanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: Then you will know that I am the LORD, when I bring you into the land of Israel, the land I had sworn with uplifted hand to give to your fathers.

ekegusii: Erio nario oramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Inche naigure amang’ana ao ay’okorama gwakwanire mamincha y’ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, kogoteba: Biasarigwe biabeire bosa, biabekirwe ase amaboko aito tobirie.
english: Then you will know that I the LORD have heard all the contemptible things you have said against the mountains of Israel. You said, "They have been laid waste and have been given over to us to devour."

ekegusii: “Erio namomanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, imenyete Sayoni, egetunwa kiane egechenu. Yerusalemu nobe omochie omochenu, na abanto b’ebisaku ebigeni tibagosoa aroro nonya ng’ake.
english: 'Then you will know that I, the LORD your God, dwell in Zion, my holy hill. Jerusalem will be holy; never again will foreigners invade her.

ekegusii: naende namomanye ekeene, na kerokio nakebasibore.”
english: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."

ekegusii: Timoyeika ang’e; mobeere nyuma ase oboare bw’ekiromita eyemo. Erio namomanye ase mogoeta, naki timwana goeta enchera eyio rinde.”
english: Then you will know which way to go, since you have never been this way before. But keep a distance of about a thousand yards between you and the ark; do not go near it."

ekegusii: amaene, rirorio norigererie otari na komocha, naende norendwe buya tokoba nobwoba.
english: then you will lift up your face without shame; you will stand firm and without fear.

ekegusii: Ekero orarore ayio nobe nomogoko, ogirigente; enkoro yao netwoma‐twome na kogareea, ekiagera obotenenku obore ase enyancha mbogochere, na obw’abanto b’ebisaku mborentwe asore.”
english: Then you will look and be radiant, your heart will throb and swell with joy; the wealth on the seas will be brought to you, to you the riches of the nations will come.

ekegusii: Ase igo moinyore na kobwata amachiko aane onsi, nainwe namobe abachenu asende inche Nyasae oino.
english: Then you will remember to obey all my commands and will be consecrated to your God.

ekegusii: Erio moinyore chinchera chiaino chimbe, na ogokora kwaino gotarenge okuya, mwegeche inwe abanyene ase engencho y’obobe bwaino, na ogokora kwaino gw’okogechia.
english: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds, and you will loathe yourselves for your sins and detestable practices.

ekegusii: Erio aye oinyore ogokora kwao obe nobosooku, ekero oraire basubati bamino abanene na abake. Ninkobae babe abaiseke bao, korende tari ase engencho y’okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania koria nakorete naye.
english: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, both those who are older than you and those who are younger. I will give them to you as daughters, but not on the basis of my covenant with you.

ekegusii: Erio nokwane ase enkoro yao, bweborie: Ning’o onyiborerete abana aba? Nigo nasiretie abana baane, ngatigwa inde bosa buna omogomba, nigo noosetwe nkana‐gotayaya. Inee! Ning’o ondererete abana aba? Naama! Nigo natigetwe inde bosa, abana aba ng’ai barenge?”
english: Then you will say in your heart, 'Who bore me these? I was bereaved and barren; I was exiled and rejected. Who brought these up? I was left all alone, but these-- where have they come from?'"

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio ndakore ring’ana erio, inwe imotiringe abakori amabe namagoro aino, na barabwo mbabe buna ribu.” Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
english: Then you will trample down the wicked; they will be ashes under the soles of your feet on the day when I do these things," says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Oise gokora bo, rirorio nomanye komoiroka Omonene, naende nigo oranyare komomanya Nyasae.
english: then you will understand the fear of the LORD and find the knowledge of God.

ekegusii: Koranyigwere, rirorio nomanye ayare boronge na ekeene, na ayagwenerete: ee, nomanye chinchera chionsi chire chingiya,
english: Then you will understand what is right and just and fair-- every good path.

ekegusii: Igo nario oranyore ogwancherwa na okomanya okuya ase obosio bwa Nyasae, na ase mwanyabanto.
english: Then you will win favor and a good name in the sight of God and man.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto baane, ekero ekio ndaigore chimbeera mbarusieo, erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: Then you, my people, will know that I am the LORD, when I open your graves and bring you up from them.

ekegusii: then your barns will be filled to overflowing, and your vats will brim over with new wine.
english: Erio ebiage biao mbiichore nendagera enyinge na ebimitero biao biichore nedivai engiya.

ekegusii: timobaisa koenena na kweba Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyobarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ense y’obosomba.
english: then your heart will become proud and you will forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the land of slavery.

ekegusii: “Korakore igo, omobaso oo nobare buna ensakia ya mambia, na okogwenigwa kwao nkogoikere bwango; oboronge bwao mbogotang’ane, na obonene bw’Omonene nabogotunyane korwa nyuma, bobe bokorendete.
english: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will quickly appear; then your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard.

ekegusii: Erio Sebuli akamotebia, “Ng’ai are amang’ana ao ay’ogwetogia ekero gwatebete: Abimeleki nere ng’o? Nase ki tokomokorera? Aba tibari abanto abagwachayete? Soka bono obarwanie.”
english: Then Zebul said to him, "Where is your big talk now, you who said, 'Who is Abimelech that we should be subject to him?' Aren't these the men you ridiculed? Go out and fight them!"

ekegusii: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, "Do not let anyone know about this conversation, or you may die.
english: Erio Zedekia agatebia Yeremia omobani, “Tobaisa gotebia monto onde amang’ana aya twakwanire naye. Oise gotebia onde ayio, goika okwe.

ekegusii: Erio Zedekia, mosinto o Kenaana, agaika ang’e ase Mikaya, akamoaka oroe ase orosea, akamoboria, “Naki omoika bw’Omonene okora orua asende, erinde okwana naye?”
english: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. "Which way did the spirit from the LORD go when he went from me to speak to you?" he asked.

ekegusii: Erio Zedekia, mosinto o Kenaana, agaika ang’e ase Mikaya, akamoaka oroe ase orosea, akamoboria, “Nase nchera ki omoika oria bw’Omonene orua asende, erinde ogakwana naye?”
english: Then Zedekiah son of Kenaanah went up and slapped Micaiah in the face. "Which way did the spirit from the LORD go when he went from me to speak to you?" he asked.

ekegusii: Erio Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yesua, mosinto o Yosadaki, bagachaka koagacha naende enyomba ya Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu, na ababani ba Nyasae mbarengeo amo nabarabwo ase okobakonya.
english: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak set to work to rebuild the house of God in Jerusalem. And the prophets of God were with them, helping them.

ekegusii: Erio Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yoshua omokuani omonene, mosinto o Yehosadaki, amo nabatigari bonsi b’abanto bakaigwera eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae obo, na amang’ana ’omobani Hagai, oyio Omonene, Nyasae obo, atomete; abanto bakaba bakomoiroka Omonene.
english: Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the whole remnant of the people obeyed the voice of the LORD their God and the message of the prophet Haggai, because the LORD their God had sent him. And the people feared the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio Siba akairaneria omoruoti, “Inche omosomba oo ninkore ayio onsi gwachikire.” Ase igo Mefiboseti akaba okoragera ase emesa ya Daudi, akaba buna oyomo bw’abana b’omoruoti.
english: Then Ziba said to the king, "Your servant will do whatever my lord the king commands his servant to do." So Mephibosheth ate at David's table like one of the king's sons.

ekegusii: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:
english: Erio Sofari Omonaama agakwana, akabora:

ekegusii: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:
english: Erio Sofari Omonaama akairaneria, akabora:

ekegusii: Then, after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.
english: Na okogania koria okobe gokwabogoirie oborito kwaibora ebibe, na ebibe biria kobiakinire, biarenta amakweri.

ekegusii: “Intwe togakora buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, atochigete; tokarua Horebu, tokagenda, togaeta ase egati y’erooro enene ekwoboyia mono, eria mwaroche ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Abaamori; erio togaika Kadeshi‐Barinea.
english: Then, as the LORD our God commanded us, we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites through all that vast and dreadful desert that you have seen, and so we reached Kadesh Barnea.

ekegusii: Na ekero engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba yaigete, nkaimoka korwa aase aria naikaransete inyekeetie, imbegete chianga na omwambaro one otandogete, erio ngatung’ama inse nkaumama, nkarambora amaboko aane gochia ase Omonene, Nyasae one,
english: Then, at the evening sacrifice, I rose from my self-abasement, with my tunic and cloak torn, and fell on my knees with my hands spread out to the LORD my God

ekegusii: Bono Tatenai, omogavuna bw’orogongo rore bosongo y’orooche roria, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abarenge kogamba komo, bagakora ase okwerwa amang’ana ayio onsi Dario omoruoti konya achikire.
english: Then, because of the decree King Darius had sent, Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and their associates carried it out with diligence.

ekegusii: Akabatebia, “Inchuo inwe mweka, togende aase abanto batari, motimoke ake.” Naki abanto abange mbarengeo, bagocha na bakogenda; nonya neribaga tiriarenge ri’okoria.
english: Then, because so many people were coming and going that they did not even have a chance to eat, he said to them, "Come with me by yourselves to a quiet place and get some rest."

ekegusii: Nabo omokungu oria agatiga enyongo yaye, akagenda omochie, agatebia abanto,
english: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,

ekegusii: Erio bakairana, kera oyomo bw’Abayuda na obw’abanto ba Yerusalemu, na Yehosafati akabatang’ana. Bakairana Yerusalemu bare nomochengo, ekiagera Omonene abaete obobui igoro ase ababisa babo.
english: Then, led by Jehoshaphat, all the men of Judah and Jerusalem returned joyfully to Jerusalem, for the LORD had given them cause to rejoice over their enemies.

ekegusii: Naende ase entunda ya gatano, Sanibalati agatoma omosomba oye asende obwate rirube ritamumekeirie
english: Then, the fifth time, Sanballat sent his aide to me with the same message, and in his hand was an unsealed letter

ekegusii: Inche kondaike nimbatome ne rirube aba morachore, baire ebiegwa biaino goika Yerusalemu.
english: Then, when I arrive, I will give letters of introduction to the men you approve and send them with your gift to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ekero ndabe nakwabeire aya onsi gwakorire, aye noyainyore erinde oumate okirekiri, tomumora omonwa oo, ase engencho y’obosooku bwao. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: Then, when I make atonement for you for all you have done, you will remember and be ashamed and never again open your mouth because of your humiliation, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: erio nosiborwe korwa ase eira eyio nakoboririe otiane. Ekero oraike ase eamate yane, onye tibagokoa omoiseke oyio, aye rirorio nobe gwasiboirwe korwa ase ogotiana kwao.
english: Then, when you go to my clan, you will be released from my oath even if they refuse to give her to you-- you will be released from my oath.'

ekegusii: There a centurion's servant, whom his master valued highly, was sick and about to die.
english: Omosomba oyomo bw’omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana konya onyarekire ang’e nogokwa; ere nomonto anchete mono.

ekegusii: Akarora Omonene oteneine ase obosio bwaye, okobora, “Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae o Ibrahimu, na Nyasae o Isaka. Ense eye oraire ninkoyee aye amo noroiboro rwao;
english: There above it stood the LORD, and he said: "I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying.

ekegusii: Agwo nao Ibrahimu atindegetwe ase Sara mokaye ensemo; agwo nao Isaka na Rebeka mokaye batindegetwe, na agwo inche omonyene natindegete Lea.
english: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried, and there I buried Leah.

ekegusii: Agwo ning’umerane n’Abaisraeli, na aase agwo ning’akore abe aachenu nobonene bwane.
english: there also I will meet with the Israelites, and the place will be consecrated by my glory.

ekegusii: Agwo omonto omonyaboronge nigo are konyara koamererania nere, rirorio nigo nare gotigwa kegima noyokongambia.
english: There an upright man could present his case before him, and I would be delivered forever from my judge.

ekegusii: Naende mbire igoro ebitongwa bitongire, na mbire ase ense ebitongwa bitongire, korende obonene bw’ebia igoro nigo bore ao, na obonene bw’ebia nse nigo bore ao.
english: There are also heavenly bodies and there are earthly bodies; but the splendor of the heavenly bodies is one kind, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is another.

ekegusii: Bono mbireo ebiegwa ao ao, korende Omoika noro oria oyomo.
english: There are different kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

ekegusii: Naboigo nkore ogokora ao ao, korende Omonene nere oria oyomo.
english: There are different kinds of service, but the same Lord.

ekegusii: Naende nkore ogokora kw’emeremo ase chinchera ao ao, korende Nyasae nere oria oria ogokora emeremo yonsi ase bonsi.
english: There are different kinds of working, but the same God works all of them in all men.

ekegusii: Mbire ebinto bitano na ekemo Omonene agechete, ee, mbire bitano na bibere bire okogecha asare, nabio ebi:
english: There are six things the LORD hates, seven that are detestable to him:

ekegusii: Amagena ayio nigo arabe ikomi na abere, abe namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli. Amarieta ayio amang’erwe buna omonto akomang’a ekemanyererio. Kera rigena ribe nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.
english: There are to be twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

ekegusii: Korende ebitongwa ebio ebisinini bibwate chimbaba na amagoro ane inamorie ebio bigotaroka nebirenge.
english: There are, however, some winged creatures that walk on all fours that you may eat: those that have jointed legs for hopping on the ground.

ekegusii: Agwo Ribula omoruoti o Babeli agaita abana abamura ba Zedekia; agaita nabanene bonsi b’Abayuda.
english: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes and also killed all the nobles of Judah.

ekegusii: Agwo Ribula omoruoti oria agaita abana abamura ba Zedekia ase amaiso aye, agaita nabanene bonsi b’oboruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: There at Riblah the king of Babylon slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; he also killed all the officials of Judah.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Babeli akabaitera aroro agwo Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati, bagakwerao. Igo Abayuda bakarusigwa ase ense yabo bakairwa ase obosomba.
english: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.

ekegusii: Omoruoti o Babeli akabaita bagakwera agwo Ribula, ase ense ya Hamati. Ase igo Abayuda bakarusigwa ase ense yabo, bakairwa ase obosomba.
english: There at Riblah, in the land of Hamath, the king had them executed. So Judah went into captivity, away from her land.

ekegusii: Agwo nao morarente ebing’wanso biaino bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde, na ensemo yaino ya ikomi, na okoruegwa mokorenta, na ebi mwarierete Omonene eira komoruera, na okoruegwa kwaino kw’ogwancha, ne chintangi chiaino chie chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori.
english: there bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and special gifts, what you have vowed to give and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks.

ekegusii: Akaoroka omonto, otometwe korwa ase Nyasae, erieta riaye Yohana.
english: There came a man who was sent from God; his name was John.

ekegusii: Ituko rinde tiriana koba buna erio nonya ng’ake, ritang’ani ri’ayio, gose nyuma y’ayio, ekero Omonene aigwerete mwanyabanto. Nyasae nigo arwanererete Abaisraeli.
english: There has never been a day like it before or since, a day when the LORD listened to a man. Surely the LORD was fighting for Israel!

ekegusii: Aroro agwo Zadoki omokuani na Nathani omobani bamoake amaguta ase okomwatanana abe omoruoti okogambera Abaisraeli. Erio mobugie ebitureri bi’omochengo, motebe: Sulemani omoruoti ochie kare!
english: There have Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him king over Israel. Blow the trumpet and shout, 'Long live King Solomon!'

ekegusii: Aroro agwo nabunete chinsara chi’amata chikomesa, boigo naende akabutorana chinguba, na emioro na ebirwanero binde bi’esegi.
english: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shields and the swords, the weapons of war. Selah

ekegusii: Aroro agwo nigo arentete abanto bare nenchara; barabwo bakaagacha omochie aroro bakamenyao.
english: there he brought the hungry to live, and they founded a city where they could settle.

ekegusii: Agwo akaagacha egesasimero, akaroka aase aria Eli‐Beteli, ekiagera agwo nao Nyasae aorokerete Yakobo, ekero ere arenge gotama korwa ase oyomwabo.
english: There he built an altar, and he called the place El Bethel, because it was there that God revealed himself to him when he was fleeing from his brother.

ekegusii: Akanyora omonto oyomo aroro ore korokwa Ainea. Omonto oyio konya obeire ekeoru borere ase engaki y’emiaka etano na etato, are rigata.
english: There he found a man named Aeneas, a paralytic who had been bedridden for eight years.

ekegusii: Ere arue ekeng’wanso kiaye ase Omonene: emanwa emingichi yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na emanwa esigiti yakoorire omwaka oyomo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na emingichi eyemo ebe ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe; chionsi chibe chitari na bimocho ase emebere yabo.
english: There he is to present his offerings to the LORD: a year-old male lamb without defect for a burnt offering, a year-old ewe lamb without defect for a sin offering, a ram without defect for a fellowship offering,

ekegusii: Akanyora Omoyahudi oyomo, erieta riaye Akwila, omobiare o Ponto. Ere nigo achete korwa ase ense ya Italia ase amatuko a bwango amo na Priskila mokaye, ekiagera Klaudio konya ochikire Abayahudi bonsi barue Rumi. Paulo agaika asebare,
english: There he met a Jew named Aquila, a native of Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to see them,

ekegusii: Agwo akarora ensoko yare aase aarabu, na amaicho atato e ching’ondi araire ensoko ensemo, ekiagera ase ensoko eyio nao amaicho are konywera amache. Na ndiarengeo rigena rinene igoro y’omonwa bw’ensoko.
english: There he saw a well in the field, with three flocks of sheep lying near it because the flocks were watered from that well. The stone over the mouth of the well was large.

ekegusii: There he set up an altar and called it El Elohe Israel.
english: Akaagacha agwo egesasimero, agakeroka Eli‐Elohe‐Israeli.

ekegusii: Akaonchoka ekieni kiaye asebare, obosio bwaye bokagirigenta buna erioba, ne chianga chiaye chikaraba buna omobaso.
english: There he was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.

ekegusii: Aroro agasoa rikuruma ime, akararao ase obotuko boria. Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asare, rikamoboria, “Elija, ninki ogokora ime aa?”
english: There he went into a cave and spent the night. And the word of the LORD came to him: "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

ekegusii: na aroro agwo nabekire Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’Omonene, koria akorete n’Abaisraeli.”
english: There I have placed the ark, in which is the covenant of the LORD that he made with the people of Israel."

ekegusii: Ekero ararue agwo nimoiranerie emegondo yaye y’emesabibu, naende ninkore Ebate y’Akori ebe egesieri ki’ogosemeria. Aroro agwo natere buna ekero keria arenge omoke, ekero aruete ase ense ya Misiri.
english: There I will give her back her vineyards, and will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope. There she will sing as in the days of her youth, as in the day she came up out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Na rora, ase obosio bwaye narengeo omonto oyomo orenge noborwaire bw’okobimbia omobere.
english: There in front of him was a man suffering from dropsy.

ekegusii: Natagore emegwekano y’amagena egosasimwa agwo Heliopolis ase ense ya Misiri. Nasambe nomorero chinyomba chie chinyasae chia Misiri.”
english: There in the temple of the sun in Egypt he will demolish the sacred pillars and will burn down the temples of the gods of Egypt.'"

ekegusii: Ababani bareo bakorire emeroberio emebe, nigo banga buna chindo chikoruma chigotandorana ebi chiaitire. Barabwo basiririe emioyo y’abanto, na bairire chinibo chiabo, na ebinto bi’amagori amanene; bagerire abakungu abange batigaire bare ababoraka ase omochie ime.
english: There is a conspiracy of her princes within her like a roaring lion tearing its prey; they devour people, take treasures and precious things and make many widows within her.

ekegusii: Oyo oranyange na otancheti amang’ana aane, nare noyo oramogambie. Ring’ana riria nakwanete, nario riranyare komogambia ase rituko ri’omoerio.
english: There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words; that very word which I spoke will condemn him at the last day.

ekegusii: Omonto oyomo nare aiga ase oboruoti bwao, omoika bwe chinyasae chinchenu ore ime yaye. Ase engaki eria iso arenge kogamba, omonto oyio akarorekana ore noborabu, na okomanya, na obong’aini bore buna obwe chinyasae, ime yaye. Omoruoti Nebukadinesaro iso akamobeka akaba omonene bw’abaringoria, na abarogi, na Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, na abamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni, ee, nabo omoruoti iso akorete,
english: There is a man in your kingdom who has the spirit of the holy gods in him. In the time of your father he was found to have insight and intelligence and wisdom like that of the gods. King Nebuchadnezzar your father-- your father the king, I say-- appointed him chief of the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners.

ekegusii: Orooche ndoreo chindooche chiaye chikogokia omochie o Nyasae, omochie ore obomenyo obochenu bw’Oyore Igoro Mono.
english: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.

ekegusii: Kera egento nkere nekero kiaye, na aiga inse y’erioba kera ekegokorekana nkere nengaki yaye.
english: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under heaven:

ekegusii: Enchera nere ekororekana ase omonto ng’a nendonge, korende omoerio bw’enchera eyio namakweri.
english: There is a way that seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

ekegusii: Aiga inse y’erioba narorire obobe, na obobe obo nigo bokorentwa nabagambi:
english: There is an evil I have seen under the sun, the sort of error that arises from a ruler:

ekegusii: Nare oyonde oyokombera kirori; na inche namanyire ng’a oborori bwaye agonteba nobw’ekeene.
english: There is another who testifies in my favor, and I know that his testimony about me is valid.

ekegusii: Nabo ere aakong’u asetore, tari ng’a nemeremo yaito yoka erachaywe, korende nonya ne hekalu y’Aritemi, enyasae enkungu ere enene, nigo erabarwe ng’a teri gento. Naende enyasae eria, egosasimwa nabanto b’Asia yonsi na ab’ense yonsi nigo eraurwe obonene bwaye.”
english: There is danger not only that our trade will lose its good name, but also that the temple of the great goddess Artemis will be discredited, and the goddess herself, who is worshiped throughout the province of Asia and the world, will be robbed of her divine majesty."

ekegusii: Obong’ainereria nigo bore ase chinkoro chi’abwo bakoroberia amabe, korende abwo bakoroberia ay’omorembe nigo bakogera omogoko oba.
english: There is deceit in the hearts of those who plot evil, but joy for those who promote peace.

ekegusii: Aiga tari Omoyahudi gose Omogiriki, tari omosomba gose omosibore, tari omosacha gose omokungu, ekiagera inwe mwensi nigo more oyomo ime ase Kristo Yeso.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Aase aamwamu tari, gose omosunte ekerima, ase omokori amabe aranyare kwebisa.
english: There is no dark place, no deep shadow, where evildoers can hide.

ekegusii: Obwanchani tibori nobwoba, korende obwanchani oboikeranu nigo bogoseria obwoba gochia isiko. Naki obwoba mbore negesusuro, na oyore nobwoba taikeraniri ase obwanchani.
english: There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear, because fear has to do with punishment. The one who fears is not made perfect in love.

ekegusii: Ase amang’ana ay’ogokorera abachenu, tindi nengencho y’okobarikera.
english: There is no need for me to write to you about this service to the saints.

ekegusii: Monto onde tari orabarwanerere. Eriogo ri’amaote aino tiriri, okogwenigwa tikori asemore.
english: There is no one to plead your cause, no remedy for your sore, no healing for you.

ekegusii: onde tari okomanya, onde tari okorigia Nyasae.
english: there is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aetire takoinyorwa, gose ayagochi‐gocha takoinyorwa nabwo bakorwa nyuma.
english: There is no remembrance of men of old, and even those who are yet to come will not be remembered by those who follow.

ekegusii: Oborogi tibogokora gento ase abanto ba Yakobo, gose oboriori ase Abaisraeli. Nakwanwe igoro y’abanto ba Yakobo, nabwo Abaisraeli: Rora aya Nyasae akorire!
english: There is no sorcery against Jacob, no divination against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and of Israel, 'See what God has done!'

ekegusii: There is no speech or language where their voice is not heard.
english: Chinkwana chinde tichiri aroro, gose omonwa onde ogokwanwa tori, na eriogi riabo tiriri koigugwa.

ekegusii: Obong’aini tibori, gose okomanya, gose ogosemia, biranyare koamererania n’Omonene.
english: There is no wisdom, no insight, no plan that can succeed against the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekeene, omonto tari aiga ase ense ore omoronge ogokora amaya otari gokora ebibe.
english: There is not a righteous man on earth who does what is right and never sins.

ekegusii: Korende ing’ana rinde tiriri rimumekeirie, ritache koorokigwa, gose eribisekanete ritache komanyekana.
english: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, or hidden that will not be made known.

ekegusii: Ense ya Misiri tegosesenigwa ase ogokora konde gwonsi, kobe ogokora kw’omotwe gose ogw’ekemincha, okw’orosagia rw’omokendo gose orw’egetonto.
english: There is nothing Egypt can do-- head or tail, palm branch or reed.

ekegusii: Omobere noyomo, na Omoika noyomo, buna mwarangeretigwe ase ogosemeria okomo gw’okorangerigwa kwaino.
english: There is one body and one Spirit-- just as you were called to one hope when you were called--

ekegusii: Nigo bagotiana na gokwana oborimo; nigo bagoita na koiba, naende bakora obotomani. Nigo bagosaria amachiko onsi, na ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga nigo gokobwatigwa nokonde.
english: There is only cursing, lying and murder, stealing and adultery; they break all bounds, and bloodshed follows bloodshed.

ekegusii: Omorua amachiko na omogambia noyomo bweka, nere oranyare gotooria na gosiria. Korende aye naye ng’o okogambia omogisangio oo?
english: There is only one Lawgiver and Judge, the one who is able to save and destroy. But you-- who are you to judge your neighbor?

ekegusii: Nare amang’ana a bosa kegima agokorekana aiga ase ense; mbareo abanto abanyaboronge bakonyorwa negesusuro ki’ogokora kw’abanyabibe, na boigo abanyabibe banyora obuya bw’ogokora kw’abanyaboronge. Ase ayio ngateba, “Ayio boigo mbosa.”
english: There is something else meaningless that occurs on earth: righteous men who get what the wicked deserve, and wicked men who get what the righteous deserve. This too, I say, is meaningless.

ekegusii: Ekeene, eng’eria nekare bosio, na ogosemeria kwao tikogosira bosa.
english: There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Benjamin, abare abasinini mono ase egati yabo, nao bare babatang’aine, na abanene b’Abayuda nao bare amo nomoganda obo, na abanene b’Abasabuloni na ab’Abanafutali.
english: There is the little tribe of Benjamin, leading them, there the great throng of Judah's princes, and there the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.

ekegusii: Enyancha nero enene naende engare; nigo eichire nebitongwa bire moyo bitari kobareka, ebike na ebinene.
english: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number-- living things both large and small.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, obuya bonde mbore ime asore, aye gwasaretie emete y’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, ekarua ense eye, naende kwerure korigia Nyasae nenkoro yao.”
english: There is, however, some good in you, for you have rid the land of the Asherah poles and have set your heart on seeking God."

ekegusii: There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and lay with her;
english: Aroro Yuda akarora Batisua, omoiseke bw’Omokanani gete, akamonyuoma. Bakaba bakorara amo,

ekegusii: Aye nokwere ase egetunwa ekio ase ogotiira gochia, osangererekane amo nabanto bao, buna Haroni momura omino akwerete ase egetunwa kia Hori, agasangererekana amo nabanto baye,
english: There on the mountain that you have climbed you will die and be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor and was gathered to his people.

ekegusii: Bagatoora ang’e na Yorodan, na egetwori kiabo kegachakera Beti‐Yesimoti, kegaikeera Abeli‐Sitimu, ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu.
english: There on the plains of Moab they camped along the Jordan from Beth Jeshimoth to Abel Shittim.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo nigo twasungete amakano aito ase emete enga buna emesobeti.
english: There on the poplars we hung our harps,

ekegusii: Ase igo, ogotimoka gw’esabato gwatigaire ase abanto ba Nyasae.
english: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God;

ekegusii: Ere akaba nokogania okobe ase abatomani baria baare nokogania kw’omobere buna chitigere chire, naende bagasokia oroiboro buna chibarasi chigosokia orwabo.
english: There she lusted after her lovers, whose genitals were like those of donkeys and whose emission was like that of horses.

ekegusii: Bakamorentera omonto ore omotino, naende nigo are gotutura kagokwana; bagasorora Yeso abeke okoboko kwaye igoro asare.
english: There some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk, and they begged him to place his hand on the man.

ekegusii: Agwo omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera ase omogwekano bwe risase ri’omorero riare gwoka korwa ase egetutu gati. Musa akarigereria, akarora ng’a nonya kiare gwoka, tikiare koyia keere.
english: There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in flames of fire from within a bush. Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabugwa nabarwani ba Daudi. Ogoitwa okwo gokaba okonene, na ase rituko riria abanto chilifu emerongo ebere bagaitwa.
english: There the army of Israel was defeated by David's men, and the casualties that day were great-- twenty thousand men.

ekegusii: Chinyoni nigo chikoagacha ebiswa biabo ase emete eyio, amaagonga nigo akoagacha ebiswa biabo aroro ase emetarakwa.
english: There the birds make their nests; the stork has its home in the pine trees.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya sugusu orobebe rokaonchokera Hanatoni, rogaikera ense omweremo ya Ifuta‐Eli.
english: There the boundary went around on the north to Hannathon and ended at the Valley of Iphtah El.

ekegusii: There the centurion found an Alexandrian ship sailing for Italy and put us on board.
english: Aria omotang’ani oria akanyora emeeri y’Aleksanderia eyarenge ang’e kogenda gochia Italia, agatoriinia.

ekegusii: Aroro Abadani bageteneneria omogwekano oria bw’ogosasimwa. Yonathani, mosinto o Gerisomu o Musa, nere orenge omokuani ase Abadani, na abana baye abamura bakaba abakuani babo goika engaki y’ogwoswa kwabo.
english: There the Danites set up for themselves the idols, and Jonathan son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of Dan until the time of the captivity of the land.

ekegusii: There the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down and, like grasshoppers, consume you. Multiply like grasshoppers, multiply like locusts!
english: Aroro agwo omorero nogosambe, na omoro nogoite okorie buna chingeeti chikoria. Aye menteka obuche buna chingeeti, na buna chingige.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo Omonene natoorokere ore nobonene, nabe asetore buna chindooche na ebirooche, ase amaato agosukigwa nemegango ataete, gose chimeeri chinene chitaete.
english: There the LORD will be our Mighty One. It will be like a place of broad rivers and streams. No galley with oars will ride them, no mighty ship will sail them.

ekegusii: There the ships go to and fro, and the leviathan, which you formed to frolic there.
english: Chimeeri nao chigoeta, na Leviatani, eng’iti eria enene y’okwoboyia gwatongete, ekonagoswenenao.

ekegusii: There the thrones for judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
english: Agwo nao ebirogo bi’okonacherwa ekina bire, ebirogo bi’obonene bi’enyomba ya Daudi.

ekegusii: Aroro agwo abakori amabe tibari gochanda abande, boigo abarosire kobaikire aroro, nigo bagotimoka.
english: There the wicked cease from turmoil, and there the weary are at rest.

ekegusii: aase amakonde abo atagokwa, na omorero otakorimeka].
english: There the worms that eat them never die, and the fire that burns them is never put out. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version. See verse 48.]

ekegusii: Erio agwo abanto abwo mbasogwe nomoondoko omonene mono, ekiagera Nyasae nigo are amo nabanto abaronge.
english: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is present in the company of the righteous.

ekegusii: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.
english: bakamoa edivai esang’anirie nendorwe, anywe. Agachia koyeigwa, tancha konywa.

ekegusii: Bakagobera gochia Gibea, barare aroro ase obotuko boria. Kobasoire aroro, bagaikaransa eraaro isiko, ase omochie oria, korende onde tarenge bwanchete kobasoyia nyomba mwaye ase obotuko obwo.
english: There they stopped to spend the night. They went and sat in the city square, but no one took them into his home for the night.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagosogwa nomoondoko omonene mono, omoondoko buna oyio tona‐komanyekana nonya ndinde, Nyasae nasiarere amauga ’emebere y’ababisa abwo bakonaaretie. Nyasae nabasookie, ekiagera obaangire.
english: There they were, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to dread. God scattered the bones of those who attacked you; you put them to shame, for God despised them.

ekegusii: “Nigo bakorera igoro ya Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, na komoroka Omosiru oyosiririe chingaki chiaye.
english: There they will exclaim, 'Pharaoh king of Egypt is only a loud noise; he has missed his opportunity.'

ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Benjamin narengeo omonto oyomo ore korokwa Kisi, mosinto bw’Abieli, o Serori, o Bekorati bw’Afia, omonto bw’egesaku kia Benjamin. Kisi nigo arenge omonto omonda.
english: There was a Benjamite, a man of standing, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.

ekegusii: Narenge omonto ore korokwa Elikana korwa ase egesaku gi’Efraimu, omenyete Ramataimu‐Sofimu, ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu. Ere nigo arenge mosinto o Yerohamu bw’Elihu, o Tohu, o Sufu, Omoefraimu.
english: There was a certain man from Ramathaim, a Zuphite from the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Elkanah son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite.

ekegusii: Kororia ase oboagacho obwo bwa geita gia sugusu, oboagacho bonde mbwarengeo bw’egeita kiare gosoerwa gochia ase eraaro ya ime. Obwo nabwo bwareng’aine noboagacho bw’egeita kiarochie moocha. Akarenga obotambe korwa ase oboagacho bonde goika ase obonde, bokaba obw’amaboko rigana erimo.
english: There was a gate to the inner court facing the north gate, just as there was on the east. He measured from one gate to the opposite one; it was a hundred cubits.

ekegusii: Enchara enene yarenge agwo Samaria ekero keria bayonaaretie. Omotwe bw’etigere okaba okoonigwa ase rigori rie chisekeli chie chifeta emerongo etano na etato, na amabi ’amaruma aisanete agatita akamo ase chisekeli chie chifeta isano.
english: There was a great famine in the city; the siege lasted so long that a donkey's head sold for eighty shekels of silver, and a quarter of a cab of seed pods for five shekels.

ekegusii: Bikaba ebituri ebinge; aborokia b’amariko b’ensemo y’Abafarisai bagatenena, bakamobuna, bagoteba, “Titorochi bobe bonde ase omonto oyo. Aande onye nomoika gose omomalaika okwanire nere?”
english: There was a great uproar, and some of the teachers of the law who were Pharisees stood up and argued vigorously. "We find nothing wrong with this man," they said. "What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?"

ekegusii: Nare omonto otabwate omwana gose omwabo; ere nigo agendererete gwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u, na amaiso aye tari goisaneka ne chinibo; omonto oyio tana kweboria, “Ning’o ngochandekera gokorera na kwerina omogoko bwonsi?” Aya naro mbosa, na ogwechanda gotari nomogoko.
english: There was a man all alone; he had neither son nor brother. There was no end to his toil, yet his eyes were not content with his wealth. "For whom am I toiling," he asked, "and why am I depriving myself of enjoyment?" This too is meaningless-- a miserable business!

ekegusii: Ekero okong’orerwa kw’abanto b’Ebisaku na Abayahudi amo nabanene babo gwakoretwe igoro y’abatomwa ase okobakorera amabe na kobaaka amagena,
english: There was a plot afoot among the Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, to mistreat them and stone them.

ekegusii: Na rora, norengeo omotengecho omonene, ekiagera omomalaika bw’Omonene aigete korwa igoro, agachia agatigeria rigena riria, akariikaransera.
english: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.

ekegusii: Egesasimero kiaroisirie korwa ase chibao nkiarengeo; obotambe bwaye gochia igoro nobw’amaboko atato, na obotambe bwaye amaboko abere. Nigo kiarenge ne chikoona ne chinterekerero, ne chinyasi, chionsi nigo chiaroisirie korwa ase chibao. Omonto oria agantebia: “Eye nemesa ere ase obosio bw’Omonene.”
english: There was a wooden altar three cubits high and two cubits square; its corners, its base and its sides were of wood. The man said to me, "This is the table that is before the LORD."

ekegusii: Igoro asare nkiarengeo ekemanyererio kerikire ase omonwa bw’Ekegiriki, na Ekerumi, na Ekeibirania “OYO NERE OMORUOTI BW’ABAYAHUDI.”
english: There was a written notice above him, which read: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

ekegusii: Narengeo omokungu omobani, Anna, omoiseke o Fanueli, bw’egesaku ki’Asheri. Ere nomong’ina bw’amatuko amange, obete nomosacha oye emiaka etano na ebere nyuma y’okoera kw’oboiseke bwaye.
english: There was also a prophetess, Anna, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher. She was very old; she had lived with her husband seven years after her marriage,

ekegusii: Ang’e naase aria yarengeo emegondo y’omonene bw’egesinka keria, erieta riaye Pubilio. Omonto oyo agatoroisia ase omoyo bw’obosani, tokaba abageni baye ase ekero ki’amatuko atato.
english: There was an estate nearby that belonged to Publius, the chief official of the island. He welcomed us to his home and for three days entertained us hospitably.

ekegusii: Orwaki ndwarenge mbarabare y’ebinyomba biria rwarochie gochia ase eraaro ya isiko. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano.
english: There was an outer wall parallel to the rooms and the outer court; it extended in front of the rooms for fifty cubits.

ekegusii: Esegi nigo yagendererete botambe ase egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu.
english: There was continual warfare between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.

ekegusii: Bono omogoko omonene okaba agwo Yerusalemu. Korwa ase chingaki chia Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, amang’ana buna ayio tana koba rinde ase Yerusalemu.
english: There was great joy in Jerusalem, for since the days of Solomon son of David king of Israel there had been nothing like this in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo arenge koraa tibare kobareka. Nonya naboigo abwo barachiche nyuma y’abwo tibakomogokera. Ekeene, aya naro mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
english: There was no end to all the people who were before them. But those who came later were not pleased with the successor. This too is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

ekegusii: Bono ase ense yonsi endagera tiyarengeo; na enchara nigo yarenge endito mono, konya yanyarire abanto ba Misiri na aba Kanani.
english: There was no food, however, in the whole region because the famine was severe; both Egypt and Canaan wasted away because of the famine.

ekegusii: There was no more war until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's reign.
english: Chisegi chinde tichiabete goika omwaka bw’emerongo etato, na etano, bw okogamba gwa Asa.

ekegusii: Onde tachete kobatooria, ekiagera Laisi orenge aare korwa Sidoni, naende abanto ba Laisi tibarenge gosanga nabanto bande. Omochie oria nigo orenge ase rikura riare ang’e na Beti‐Rehobu. Abanto ba Dani bakaagacha omochie o Laisi naende, bakamenyao.
english: There was no one to rescue them because they lived a long way from Sidon and had no relationship with anyone else. The city was in a valley near Beth Rehob. The Danites rebuilt the city and settled there.

ekegusii: Yoshua agasomera omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, amo nabakungu na abana, na abamenyi, abamenyete ase egati yabo, amang’ana onsi Musa achigete, tatigete nonya nerimo.
english: There was not a word of all that Moses had commanded that Joshua did not read to the whole assembly of Israel, including the women and children, and the aliens who lived among them.

ekegusii: Egento kende ekeao tikiarenge ime ase Esanduku eria, otatiga chibao chiria ibere chi’amagena, chiria Musa abegete imeo, agwo Horebu ase Omonene akorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Abaisraeli ekero barwete ase ense ya Misiri.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Egento kende ekeao tikiarenge ime ase Esanduku eria, otatiga chibao chiria ibere Musa abegete imeo agwo Horebu, aroro ase Omonene akorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania n’Abaisraeli, ekero barwete ase ense ya Misiri.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb, where the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites after they came out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Norenge omochie omoke omenyire nabanto abake; omoruoti orenge omonene mono agacha koyorwania esegi; akayonaaria, akaagacha chiburi chinene chi’ogwekengera ase okoyorwania.
english: There was once a small city with only a few people in it. And a powerful king came against it, surrounded it and built huge siegeworks against it.

ekegusii: Omoruoti tarenge agwo Edomu, korende nomokonyi oyomo orenge kogamba ase ribaga ri’omoruoti.
english: There was then no king in Edom; a deputy ruled.

ekegusii: Esegi nigo yagendererete koba egati y’Asa na Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, ase amatuko abo onsi.
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.

ekegusii: Esegi nigo yagendererete koba egati y’Asa na Baasa, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, ase obogima bwabo bwonsi.
english: There was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel throughout their reigns.

ekegusii: Esegi nigo yagendererete koba egati ya Rehoboamu na Yeroboamu ase obogima bwonsi bwa Rehoboamu.
english: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam throughout [Abijah's] lifetime.

ekegusii: Agwo tokanyora abaminto, bagatosorora tomenye amo nabarabwo amatuko atano, na abere; erio togaika Rumi.
english: There we found some brothers who invited us to spend a week with them. And so we came to Rome.

ekegusii: Na bonsi nigo barenge abasacha koreng’ana ikomi na babere.
english: There were about twelve men in all.

ekegusii: There were also five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berekiah, Hasadiah and Jushab-Hesed.
english: Abamura bande batano ba Serubabeli nabwo aba: Hasuba na Oheli, Berekia na Hasadia, na Yusabi‐Hesedi.

ekegusii: Naende nchiarengeo chimesa inye ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa chiaroisirie korwa ase amagena abaachire. Igoro yabo nao ebinto biarenge gokorerwa emeremo ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde, biarenge kogachwa. Obotambe bwa kera emesa nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese, na obogare bw’okoboko okomo na ekeng’ese boigo, na obotambe gochia igoro nigo bwarenge obw’okoboko okomo.
english: There were also four tables of dressed stone for the burnt offerings, each a cubit and a half long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit high. On them were placed the utensils for slaughtering the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices.

ekegusii: Daudi nabwate abamura bande, nabwo aba: Ibuhari na Elisama, na Elifeleti;
english: There were also Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,

ekegusii: Ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa nigo biarenge ebinge, na amo nebio ebitinya bi’ebing’wanso bi’omorembe, na okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa gochikire koruegwa amo na birobio. Na igo obokoreri ase enyomba y’Omonene bokaba bokoroberigwa buya.
english: There were burnt offerings in abundance, together with the fat of the fellowship offerings and the drink offerings that accompanied the burnt offerings. So the service of the temple of the LORD was reestablished.

ekegusii: Ebisieri biarenge gosoerwa ase ebinyomba biria; ekemo nigo kiarochie ase ensemo ya sugusu, na ekende ensemo ya irianyi. Obogare boria bwatigarete bosa botaagachiri nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: There were entrances to the side rooms from the open area, one on the north and another on the south; and the base adjoining the open area was five cubits wide all around.

ekegusii: Mbarenge aroro ase ense eria abasacha abanyaka bakarigania ase obosooku. Abanto abwo bagakora okogechia konde gwonsi okwo abanto b’ebisaku biria Omonene aseretie korwa ase Abaisraeli barenge gokora.
english: There were even male shrine prostitutes in the land; the people engaged in all the detestable practices of the nations the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Nchiarengeo chitaya chinyinge ase enyomba ya irongo aase twasangererekanete.
english: There were many lamps in the upstairs room where we were meeting.

ekegusii: Ase chinsemo chiaye narengeo amakomomanga emerongo kianda, na atano na rimo. Amakomomanga onsi arenge igoro ase egesure ekemo ase chinsemo chiaye chionsi nigo arenge rigana erimo.
english: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; the total number of pomegranates above the surrounding network was a hundred.

ekegusii: Na monto onde tarenge ase egati yabo oyorenge nokoremerwa, ekiagera abanto bonsi abarenge nemegondo ne chinyomba nigo babioonetie, bakarenta chibesa chi’ebinto biria biaoonetigwe,
english: There were no needy persons among them. For from time to time those who owned lands or houses sold them, brought the money from the sales

ekegusii: Abarendi batano nomo nigo barenge kobeera ensemo ya moocha kera rituko, na ensemo ya sugusu mbane kera rituko, na ensemo ya irianyi mbane kera rituko; na ase ebigachero babere babere.
english: There were six Levites a day on the east, four a day on the north, four a day on the south and two at a time at the storehouse.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya moocha mbiarengeo ebiita bitato, na ensemo ya sugusu ebiita bitato, na ensemo ya irianyi ebiita bitato, na ensemo ya bosongo ebiita bitato.
english: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south and three on the west.

ekegusii: Na amagena ayio nigo arenge ikomi na abere, akaba namarieta ’abamura ba Israeli, amang’ekire buna ekemanyererio gekomang’wa. Kera rigena rikaba nerieta ri’egesaku ekemo ki’ebisaku biabo ikomi na bibere.
english: There were twelve stones, one for each of the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

ekegusii: Abataka tibakoera korwa ase ense; na ase engencho eyio nabachikire ng’a mobe nemioyo emerabu ase ogokonya abamino bare abataka, na abaremeire bare ase ense yaino.
english: There will always be poor people in the land. Therefore I command you to be openhanded toward your brothers and toward the poor and needy in your land.

ekegusii: Rituko ngocha rire ekero abarendi bararangerie korwa ase ense y’ebigoro y’Efraimu, batebe: Imoka togende Sayoni ase Omonene Nyasae oito.”
english: There will be a day when watchmen cry out on the hills of Ephraim, 'Come, let us go up to Zion, to the LORD our God.'"

ekegusii: Enchera enene neroiserigwe abatigari b’abanto baye abatoorigwe korwa Asuri. Enchera eyio nebe buna eria Abaisraeli baeterete kobakorua Misiri.
english: There will be a highway for the remnant of his people that is left from Assyria, as there was for Israel when they came up from Egypt.

ekegusii: emetengecho emenene y’ense nebe chinsemo ne chinsemo, na enchara, na emechando emenene; nabe namang’ana ’ogoichania, na ebimanyererio ebinene bikorwa igoro.
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines and pestilences in various places, and fearful events and great signs from heaven.

ekegusii: Erio ebirero ebinene inabibe ase ense yonsi ya Misiri, binde bitana koba bo, gose tibigocha koba bo naende nonya ng’ake.
english: There will be loud wailing throughout Egypt-- worse than there has ever been or ever will be again.

ekegusii: Obotuko tibokobao nonya ng’ake, tibaganeiri oborabu bw’etaya gose omobaso bw’erioba, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae nababarerie omobaso, na barabwo nabagambe goika kare na kare.
english: There will be no more night. They will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, for the Lord God will give them light. And they will reign for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Emechando na obororo inabibe igoro ase kera oyomo bw’abana ba mwanyabanto oyogokora amabe, ritang’ani ase Omoyahudi, na ase Omogiriki boigo;
english: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil: first for the Jew, then for the Gentile;

ekegusii: Ebirero mbibe ase emegondo yonsi y’emesabibu. Ayio onsi nigo arabe, ekiagera inche Omonene ning’ete ase egati yaino mbaite.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: There will be wailing in all the vineyards, for I will pass through your midst," says the LORD.

ekegusii: Agwo ase ense eria namoinyore chinchera chiaino, na ogokora kwaino gwonsi, ase okwo mwabeire mogwesoyia ase ogotacheneka; inwe mwegeche abanyene ase engencho y’amabe onsi mwakorire.
english: There you will remember your conduct and all the actions by which you have defiled yourselves, and you will loathe yourselves for all the evil you have done.

ekegusii: Agwo ase morasiarerwe gochia, namobe mogosasima chinyasae chiroisirie korwa ase emete na amagena, emeremo y’amaboko a mwanyabanto, echio chitari korora, gose koigwa, gose koragera, gose konyonka.
english: There you will worship man-made gods of wood and stone, which cannot see or hear or eat or smell.

ekegusii: Agwo ninchiche ng’umerane naye. Korwa igoro y’Oboikaranso bw’Amabera, gati‐gati y’abakerubi aba babere bare igoro y’Esanduku ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, nimbe ngokwana naye igoro y’amachiko aya ngochia koa Abaisraeli goetera asore.”
english: There, above the cover between the two cherubim that are over the ark of the Testimony, I will meet with you and give you all my commands for the Israelites.

ekegusii: Erio agwo ase orooche rw’Ahawa, nkarareria abanto, nkabatebia ng’a tweng’ate, naende twekeyie tobe abaitongo ase obosio bwa Nyasae oito na korigia korwa asare oborendi obuya ase orogendo rwaito, intwe na abana baito, na ebinto biaito bionsi.
english: There, by the Ahava Canal, I proclaimed a fast, so that we might humble ourselves before our God and ask him for a safe journey for us and our children, with all our possessions.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli kobarigereretie, Yoshua akarika ase amagena amachiko aria aria Musa konya arikire.
english: There, in the presence of the Israelites, Joshua copied on stones the law of Moses, which he had written.

ekegusii: Agwo nao morabiriere ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, nainwe namobe nomogoko amo nabanto be chinka chiaino, ase ebitoki bionsi moranyore ase emeremo yaino, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, obasesenirie.
english: There, in the presence of the LORD your God, you and your families shall eat and shall rejoice in everything you have put your hand to, because the LORD your God has blessed you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio okoragererigwa nkogendererete gosiria ense; abanto bamenyeteo nigo bachandegete ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo kw’ebibe, basambirwe, na abanto abake boka batigaireo.
english: Therefore a curse consumes the earth; its people must bear their guilt. Therefore earth's inhabitants are burned up, and very few are left.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio endo nerue rinani ebaite; esese y’orosana nerue erooro ebasirie; engo nebaboere ase emechie yabo. Kera omonto ogosoka korwa aroro natandoranwe, ekiagera ogosaria kwabo nokonge, na okogwa kwabo kw’ogontiga nokonene.
english: Therefore a lion from the forest will attack them, a wolf from the desert will ravage them, a leopard will lie in wait near their towns to tear to pieces any who venture out, for their rebellion is great and their backslidings many.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: “Ekeene, buna inde moyo ekiagera inwe mwakorire Obomenyo, bwane Obochenu bwabeire obotachenegeti ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino kw’obokayayu, na okogechia kwaino gwonsi, nimbaserie kegima; eriso riane tirikobarigereria namabeebe, gose inche tinkobarorera amabera.
english: Therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your vile images and detestable practices, I myself will withdraw my favor; I will not look on you with pity or spare you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Omonene Nyasae nigo agoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ningotige amanyinga ao aiteke, na ogoiteka okwo kw’amanyinga ao ngokobwatie: aye togecheti ogoiteka kw’amanyinga, ase ayio, ogoiteka kw’amanyinga ao ngokobwatie.
english: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will give you over to bloodshed and it will pursue you. Since you did not hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche Omonene Nyasae nigo ngoteba iga: Ekeene, buna inche inde moyo, ningokorere koreng’ana nendamwamu yao, ne ribero riao, erio kwaorogetie, ekiagera ogechete Abaisraeli. Ekero ndakonachere ekina, nimanyekane ase egati yabo.
english: therefore as surely as I live, declares the Sovereign LORD, I will treat you in accordance with the anger and jealousy you showed in your hatred of them and I will make myself known among them when I judge you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ase engencho yaino Sayoni noremwe buna omogondo, na Yerusalemu nobe amaturi, na egetunwa gie Hekalu kebe egetunwa kere ne rinani.
english: Therefore because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of rubble, the temple hill a mound overgrown with thickets.

ekegusii: Orokerania ebibe biaino inwe ase inwe, na gosaberana, monyore okogwenigwa. Ogosaba kw’omonyene oboronge nigo kore nengencho enene mono gokorasabwe nomokia.
english: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man is powerful and effective.

ekegusii: Mwerende gaki inwe buna mokoigwa, ekiagera ere oyobwate naegwe, korende oyotabwati, naurwe nonya nkeria arengereretie abwate.”
english: Therefore consider carefully how you listen. Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken from him."

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio emechando nemochere mobosokano; nigo arasirigwe mobosokano atanyare gotoorigwa.
english: Therefore disaster will overtake him in an instant; he will suddenly be destroyed-- without remedy.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, timoba abariri, korende mobe abanto bakomanya buna ogwancha kw’Omonene kore.
english: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord's will is.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, timosanga nabarabwo.
english: Therefore do not be partners with them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, monto onde tabagambia inwe ase engencho y’ebimokoria gose ebimokonywa, gose ase engencho ye Rituko Rinene, gose okooroka kw’omotienyi, gose Esabato.
english: Therefore do not let anyone judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a religious festival, a New Moon celebration or a Sabbath day.

ekegusii: Bono timotiga ebibe bigambe ime ase emebere yaino eyekonyorekana namakweri, na timobaisa koigwera okogania kwabo okobe.
english: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its evil desires.

ekegusii: “Gaki, timwechandera ay’ankio, ekiagera ankio nariechande rinyene. Kera rituko ndiisaine nogwechanda kwaye.
english: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Each day has enough trouble of its own.

ekegusii: Gaki aboria oborimo, mokwane ekeene kera omonto nomogisangio oye, naki nigo tore ebiimo ebimo intwe ase intwe.
english: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one body.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, remania inwe ase inwe ase amang’ana aya.
english: Therefore encourage each other with these words.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, remania inwe ase inwe, na koagachana, kera omonto noyomwabo, buna mogokora.
english: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

ekegusii: Gaki genda mokore ebisaku bionsi koba aborokigwa, mokobabatisa ase erieta ria Tata, neri’Omwana, neri’Omoika Omochenu,
english: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

ekegusii: Naende obekire rituko gete, neri nario ria Rero. Aya nigo akwanete goetera ase Daudi nyuma y’engaki entambe, buna konya aikire gokwana, “Rero, komoraigwe eriogi riaye, timokong’ia chinkoro chiaino.”
english: Therefore God again set a certain day, calling it Today, when a long time later he spoke through David, as was said before: "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts."

ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akamoimokereria igoro mono, akamoa erieta riria ribuete amarieta onsi,
english: Therefore God exalted him to the highest place and gave him the name that is above every name,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Nyasae akabatiga ase okogania okobe gwe chinkoro chiabo, batunyane obonyaka goika bagasarerania ogosika ase emebere yabo barabwo ase barabwo,
english: Therefore God gave them over in the sinful desires of their hearts to sexual impurity for the degrading of their bodies with one another.

ekegusii: Ase igo, oyo arigetie kororera amabera, nigo akomororera amabera, na oyo arigetie gokora abe omokong’u ase enkoro yaye, nigo akomokora abe omokong’u.
english: Therefore God has mercy on whom he wants to have mercy, and he hardens whom he wants to harden.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nare nokobua gw’okobatooria kegima abwo bagocha ase Nyasae goetera asare, ekiagera nigo are moyo botambe ase okobasabera.
english: Therefore he is able to save completely those who come to God through him, because he always lives to intercede for them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo bakorua ebing’wanso ase ekeonga kiabo na kogesambera ubani, ekiagera ebinto ebio nabio bikobanyorera ebinoru na endagera enyinge.
english: Therefore he sacrifices to his net and burns incense to his dragnet, for by his net he lives in luxury and enjoys the choicest food.

ekegusii: Therefore he sent the hand that wrote the inscription.
english: Ayio naro agerete Nyasae agatoma okoboko koria gokarika amariko aya.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abachecheria aba mokogambera abanto ba Yerusalemu, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: Therefore hear the word of the LORD, you scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye ochandegete, aye gwatindire, ko tari ase ogotinda kw’edivai, igwa amang’ana aya:
english: Therefore hear this, you afflicted one, made drunk, but not with wine.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abanto b’ebisaku, na inwe omoganda bwonsi, tegerera moigwe amang’ana agochia kobanyora abwo bangire.
english: Therefore hear, O nations; observe, O witnesses, what will happen to them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inche nigo inde mamincha yao, na mamincha ye chindooche chiao. Ninsarie ense ya Misiri kegima ebe bosa korwa Migidoli goika Siwene ase orobebe rw’Etiopia.
english: therefore I am against you and against your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt a ruin and a desolate waste from Migdol to Aswan, as far as the border of Cush.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nakorire omokia mono komotoma, erinde ekero moramorore naende, monyare kogoka, na inche nkeeanerigwe omoichano one.
english: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may be glad and I may have less anxiety.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ninsangererie abanchi bao abwo kwegokeretie, na bonsi abwo gwanchete, na abwo kwagechete; nimbasangererie korwa ase chinsemo chionsi bagoetanane, ngwasiorie, erinde barore obogetirianda bwao.
english: therefore I am going to gather all your lovers, with whom you found pleasure, those you loved as well as those you hated. I will gather them against you from all around and will strip you in front of them, and they will see all your nakedness.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nimbarue mbabeke ase amaboko ’abanto ba moocha, mobe ababo. Barabwo mbabeke chiema chiabo ase egati yaino, naende mbaagache obomenyo bwabo aroro; mbarie okwama kwaino na banywe amabeere aino.
english: therefore I am going to give you to the people of the East as a possession. They will set up their camps and pitch their tents among you; they will eat your fruit and drink your milk.

ekegusii: Ase ayio natomire ababani asemore, na abanto abang’aini, na aborokia b’amariko; abande babo inamobaite na kobabamba, na abande babo inamobang’wanie emecharichi ase chisinagogi chiaino, na kobachanda omochie ase omochie.
english: Therefore I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nabaakire goetera ase ababani baane, nabaitire namang’ana akorwa ase omonwa one; ebina biane nkobanachera nigo bikooroka buna omobaso.
english: Therefore I cut you in pieces with my prophets, I killed you with the words of my mouth; my judgments flashed like lightning upon you.

ekegusii: “Bono narure ogochika ng’a omonto onde bwensi bw’egesaku kende gionsi, gose bw’omonwa onde bwensi, orakwane mamincha ya Nyasae o Sadaraka, na o Meshaka, na bw’Abedi‐Nego, oyio nabutoranwe ekiimo ase ekiimo, na enyomba yaye netagorwe ebe rituuri, ekiagera enyasae ende teri eranyare gotooria ase enchera buna eye.”
english: Therefore I decree that the people of any nation or language who say anything against the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego be cut into pieces and their houses be turned into piles of rubble, for no other god can save in this way."

ekegusii: Ase ayio nechayire inche omonyene, naende neakire orotu ne ribu ase ogweitia na koonchoka.”
english: Therefore I despise myself and repent in dust and ashes."

ekegusii: Nonya ninche nkominyoka nde chimbero ntari gotiting’ara; naboigo inkorwanera chinkundi, tari buna oyokorwana nembeo.
english: Therefore I do not run like a man running aimlessly; I do not fight like a man beating the air.

ekegusii: Ase ayio naremereirie onsi ase engencho y’abachore, erinde nabarabwo banyore ogotooreka kore ase Kristo Yeso amo nobonene bwa kare na kare.
english: Therefore I endure everything for the sake of the elect, that they too may obtain the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with eternal glory.

ekegusii: Bono ninde nengencho y’okweenenia ime ya Kristo Yeso ase emeremo yane ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: Therefore I glory in Christ Jesus in my service to God.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio nkabarusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri, nkabarenta ase erooro.
english: Therefore I led them out of Egypt and brought them into the desert.

ekegusii: Ase ayio inche ngateba, “Tobaisa kondigereria, ntige ndere nobororo ing’iyerie amariga; tobaisa gwechanda kondemia ase engencho y’ogosarigwa kw’omochie bw’abanto baane.”
english: Therefore I said, "Turn away from me; let me weep bitterly. Do not try to console me over the destruction of my people."

ekegusii: Ase ayio natebirie Abaisraeli ng’a monto onde bwensi obo, gose omomenyi omenyete ase egati yabo, tabaisa koria amanyinga ande onsi.
english: Therefore I say to the Israelites, "None of you may eat blood, nor may an alien living among you eat blood."

ekegusii: Ase igo nkabeka abanto maate, magega y’orwaki, aase aasie; nkababeka eamate ase eamate, bare nebirwanero biabo: emioro, na amatimo, na amata.
english: Therefore I stationed some of the people behind the lowest points of the wall at the exposed places, posting them by families, with their swords, spears and bows.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nindigetie kobamanyia, ng’a monto onde tari oyogokwana ase Omoika o Nyasae ogoteba ng’a, “Yeso oragererigwe!” Gose onde takonyara goteba, “Yeso n’Omonene”, otatiga ase Omoika Omochenu.
english: Therefore I tell you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, "Jesus be cursed," and no one can say, "Jesus is Lord," except by the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nabatebirie, ebinto bionsi morasabe, egene ng’a mwabinyorire, na‐birobio nabibe ebiaino.
english: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

ekegusii: Ase ayio inabarareretie amang’ana ayio kare konya ataraba, ekero konya ataraikerana nkabayatebia; nigo nakorete bo, erinde timobaisa gocha goteba: Emegwekano yaito togosasima, eyebaachire, gose eyebombire, nero yarenta ayio.”
english: Therefore I told you these things long ago; before they happened I announced them to you so that you could not say, 'My idols did them; my wooden image and metal god ordained them.'

ekegusii: Therefore I urge you to imitate me.
english: Gaki nabasoroire, mobe abegi baane.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, nindeere ense ya Moabu, nindeere abanto bonsi ba Moabu, boigo nindeere abanto ba Kiri‐Heresi.
english: Therefore I wail over Moab, for all Moab I cry out, I moan for the men of Kir Hareseth.

ekegusii: “Ase engencho eyio nintiche enchera yaye namagwa, ning’agache orwaki roramotange ase agoetera.
english: Therefore I will block her path with thornbushes; I will wall her in so that she cannot find her way.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nimbakorere amabe inde nendamwamu. Tinkoombia ng’a timbarochi, gose tinkobarorera amabera. Nabaisa korera baake eriogi rinene asende, tinkobaigwa.”
english: Therefore I will deal with them in anger; I will not look on them with pity or spare them. Although they shout in my ears, I will not listen to them."

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ninyasiore ense ya Moabu, agwo ase egetirimboko ase emechie ere, eyio ere obonene bw’ense eria, nero Beti‐Yesimoti, na Baali‐Meoni, na Kiriataimu.
english: therefore I will expose the flank of Moab, beginning at its frontier towns-- Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon and Kiriathaim-- the glory of that land.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ningosangererie ase chisokoro chiao chiachiete; aye nobekwe ase embeera yao kore nomorembe, na amaiso ao takorora obobe boria bwonsi ndarente igoro y’aase aiga.” Barabwo bakairera omoruoti amang’ana ayio.
english: Therefore I will gather you to your fathers, and you will be buried in peace. Your eyes will not see all the disaster I am going to bring on this place.'" So they took her answer back to the king.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nimwatananere abange babe egetari kiaye; ere naatanerwe ebisakorwa amo nabare ne chinguru, ekiagera aruete obogima bwaye agakwa, akabarwa buna noyomo bw’abasaria. Nigo abogoretie ebibe bi’abanto abange, agasabera abasaria.
