english: Therefore I will give him a portion among the great, and he will divide the spoils with the strong, because he poured out his life unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors. For he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ning’ee abanto abaao abakungu babo, na emegondo yabo ninyee abanto barababue. Abanto aba bonsi, korwa omoke goika omonene, nigo bare neribero ri’okonyora ebitoki bi’obong’ainereria. Abakuani na ababani boigo nigo bagokora amang’ana ’oborimo.
english: Therefore I will give their wives to other men and their fields to new owners. From the least to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; prophets and priests alike, all practice deceit.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ri’ekeririanda kiane inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nintengechie igoro chionsi na inyegerie ense erue aase aye goetera ase endamwamu yane egwoka.
english: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble; and the earth will shake from its place at the wrath of the LORD Almighty, in the day of his burning anger.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ase ayio ningotogie ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, ninterere erieta riao ase okoritogia.
english: Therefore I will praise you among the nations, O LORD; I will sing praises to your name.

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene, ase ayio ningotogie ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, ninterere erieta riao ase okoritogia.
english: Therefore I will praise you, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to your name.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio inche nimbaire ase obosomba ase ense ere ng’umbu ya Damesiki.” Nabo Omonene atebire. Nyasae bw’Emeganda, nario erieta riaye.
english: Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus," says the LORD, whose name is God Almighty.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, rora, nindambore okoboko kwane igoro asemore mbae egesusuro, nimbarue mwoswe nebisaku binde. Nimbaite mbasirie korwa ase abanto, ee, mbasirie kegima, morue ase chinse echio. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: therefore I will stretch out my hand against you and give you as plunder to the nations. I will cut you off from the nations and exterminate you from the countries. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Ase ayio namobakorere ababisa baino, abwo Omonene aratome gocha kobarwania; inamobe nenchara, na erang’o y’amache, namobe gesobono, naende namoremerwe ebinto bionsi. Nabeke rikorogoto ri’ekioma igoro ase ebigoti biaino goika abasirie kegima.
english: therefore in hunger and thirst, in nakedness and dire poverty, you will serve the enemies the LORD sends against you. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, ase rituko erimo rioka amaakwa aye nache, naboigo namakweri, na omoichano, na enchara. Ere nasambwe kegima nomorero, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae, oyokomogambia, nare ne chinguru.”
english: Therefore in one day her plagues will overtake her: death, mourning and famine. She will be consumed by fire, for mighty is the Lord God who judges her.

ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe abamore moocha, motogie Omonene; abamore ase ebisinka na ase chinse chire ang’e nenyancha, togia erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Therefore in the east give glory to the LORD; exalt the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio abaibori mbarie abana babo, na abana mbarie abaibori babo, agwo ase egati yaino. Nimbanachere ekina, na abatigari baino nimbasiarere gochia ase chinsemo chionsi chi’ense.”
english: Therefore in your midst fathers will eat their children, and children will eat their fathers. I will inflict punishment on you and will scatter all your survivors to the winds.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene natige abanto baye goika engaki eike, ekero oyio okobina araibore; erio nario abanto bamwabo abatigari barairane gocha ase Abaisraeli.
english: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until the time when she who is in labor gives birth and the rest of his brothers return to join the Israelites.

ekegusii: Naboigo ase abanto abarenge gotaara amo naintwe ase ekero gionsi eki Omonene Yeso arenge gosoa na gosoka ase egati yaito,
english: Therefore it is necessary to choose one of the men who have been with us the whole time the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

ekegusii: Yeso tataarete naende maiso marore ase egati y’Abayahudi, korende akarua aria akagenda aase ang’e nerooro, goika omochie okorokwa Efraimu; akamenya aroro amo naborokigwa baye.
english: Therefore Jesus no longer moved about publicly among the Jews. Instead he withdrew to a region near the desert, to a village called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso akabatebia naende, “Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie: Ninche inde egesieri gie ching’ondi.
english: Therefore Jesus said again, "I tell you the truth, I am the gate for the sheep.

ekegusii: Yeso akabatebia, “Ekero kiane tikeraika, korende ekero kiaino botambe nkereo.
english: Therefore Jesus told them, "The right time for me has not yet come; for you any time is right.

ekegusii: Ase ayio timogamba ing’ana rinde rionsi engaki etaraika, ekero Omonene ataracha; nere orabaorokerie ayabisegete ase omosunte, na koorokia amang’ana are ase chinkoro ime. Erio nario kera omonto aranyore ogotogigwa kwaye korwa ase Nyasae.
english: Therefore judge nothing before the appointed time; wait till the Lord comes. He will bring to light what is hidden in darkness and will expose the motives of men's hearts. At that time each will receive his praise from God.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Yoashi omoruoti akarangeria Yehoyada omokuani na abakuani bande, agakwana nabarabwo agateba, “Ninki kiagera motari koroisia enyomba aase yatagokire? Bono timobaisa korusia chibesa chinde chionsi korwa ase abanto, korende morente chibesa chiria mobwate, erinde eroiserigwe ase yatagokire.”
english: Therefore King Joash summoned Jehoiada the priest and the other priests and asked them, "Why aren't you repairing the damage done to the temple? Take no more money from your treasurers, but hand it over for repairing the temple."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, kera omonto oyokoirogete tiga agosabe ase engaki y’emechando. Ekero amache amange agotirimboka gocha bwango, tabaisa komoikera.
english: Therefore let everyone who is godly pray to you while you may be found; surely when the mighty waters rise, they will not reach him.

ekegusii: Gaki tobe nomoyega, tari ase ememera ya kare, gose ase ememera y’ogosaria na ey’obobe, korende ase omogati otabekiri memera, nabwo oborabu bw’omoyo na ekeene.
english: Therefore let us keep the Festival, not with the old yeast, the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with bread without yeast, the bread of sincerity and truth.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, totige okworokereria kwe ritang’ani gwa Kristo, togenderere toikere oboikeranu. Titobeka naende oboroso bw’okoonchoka korwa ase ogokora gotari nobogima, na obw’okomwegena Nyasae,
english: Therefore let us leave the elementary teachings about Christ and go on to maturity, not laying again the foundation of repentance from acts that lead to death, and of faith in God,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, titoba nkona‐kogambania tore, korende anga mbuya kobua togambe ng’a onde tabekera oyomwabo egento gekomogocha gose gekomotanga.
english: Therefore let us stop passing judgment on one another. Instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in your brother's way.

ekegusii: Nabo abange ase Abayahudi abachete amo na Mariamu na korora aya Yeso akorete, bakamwegena.
english: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, put their faith in him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio enkoro yane nigo ere nomosasoko, oromeme rwane narogoke; na kobua, omobere one noro notimoke ase ogosemeria,
english: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will live in hope,

ekegusii: Ase igo enkoro yane nigo ere nomosasoko amo nomoyo one; nonya nomobere one nigo omenyete ase oborendi obuya.
english: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto baane nigo bagwoswa na koirwa ase obosomba ase ogotaba nobong’aini; abanene babo abasike nigo bagokwa nenchara, na omoganda obo ore neburu‐buru orang’ire mono ase okoborwa amache.
english: Therefore my people will go into exile for lack of understanding; their men of rank will die of hunger and their masses will be parched with thirst.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto baane mbamanye erieta riane; ee, ase ayio, ase rituko riria mbamanye ng’a ninche Omonene ngokwana, inche nao inde aa.”
english: Therefore my people will know my name; therefore in that day they will know that it is I who foretold it. Yes, it is I."

ekegusii: Ase ayio obotuko mbobachere timorora amaroro, na omosunte nobachere timomanya igoro y’amang’ana agochi‐gocha. Erioba ndirimere tiribarera ababani, ne rituko ndionchoke ribe omosunte igoro asebare.
english: Therefore night will come over you, without visions, and darkness, without divination. The sun will set for the prophets, and the day will go dark for them.

ekegusii: Naki ase ogokora kw’amachiko onde tari ase mwanyabanto oranyare konyora oboronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae, ekiagera amachiko naro akorenta okomanya ebibe.
english: Therefore no one will be declared righteous in his sight by observing the law; rather, through the law we become conscious of sin.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo arakoreke, erinde mote onde bwensi ore ase amache tobaisa kweenenia ase obotambe bwaye, gose gwetambeyia gochia igoro ase amare; gose emete ende yonsi ekonyora amache tekina gochia igoro yeenenie, ekiagera yonsi yachikeirwe ogokwa esoe inse ye riroba ase mwanyabanto bakure basoete.
english: Therefore no other trees by the waters are ever to tower proudly on high, lifting their tops above the thick foliage. No other trees so well-watered are ever to reach such a height; they are all destined for death, for the earth below, among mortal men, with those who go down to the pit.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, rora, ningenderere gokora amang’ana ay’ogokumia ase abanto aba, ee, amang’ana ayio nigo arabe ay’ogokumigwa na goichanwa; obong’aini bw’abanto babo bare abang’aini mbosire, na okomanya kw’abamanyete mono nkobiswe.”
english: Therefore once more I will astound these people with wonder upon wonder; the wisdom of the wise will perish, the intelligence of the intelligent will vanish."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, obwerori nigo boetanaine amagoti abo, na obotindi nabwo beboyetie buna eanga.
english: Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye mwanyabanto, bana ayare mamincha, yabo; ee babanere.”
english: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, bana ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe abanto baane, rora, ninyigore chimbeera chiaino, mbarusieo, erinde mbairanie gochia inka, ase ense y’Abaisraeli.
english: Therefore prophesy and say to them: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: O my people, I am going to open your graves and bring you up from them; I will bring you back to the land of Israel.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, bana otebe ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe ebitunwa, ababisa baino babasaririe babatigire bosa, babamerire ase chinsemo chionsi, erinde monyare koba enibo y’ebisaku biatigarete, naende abanto babeire bakobakwana bobe na kobachaya.
english: Therefore prophesy and say, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because they ravaged and hounded you from every side so that you became the possession of the rest of the nations and the object of people's malicious talk and slander,

ekegusii: “Aye bana igoro y’ense y’Abaisraeli, otebie ebitunwa, na ebigoro, na amaranya, na amakura, ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora, nakwanire inde ne risemi na ekeririanda, ekiagera mwachandekire ase ogochaywa nabanto b’ebisaku.
english: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and say to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys: 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I speak in my jealous wrath because you have suffered the scorn of the nations.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, bogoria ebirwanero bionsi bia Nyasae, erinde monyare koamererania ase rituko ri’obobe, na komwaikeranirie onsi, motenene.
english: Therefore put on the full armor of God, so that when the day of evil comes, you may be able to stand your ground, and after you have done everything, to stand.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye igoro, chenga, na inwe abamomenyete imeo. Korende obobe nobwaino, ense na enyancha, ekiagera omosoeri oria oikire asemore ore nendamwamu enyinge, ekiagera amanyete ng’a engaki yaye nenke!”
english: Therefore rejoice, you heavens and you who dwell in them! But woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has gone down to you! He is filled with fury, because he knows that his time is short."

ekegusii: Erio obatebie ng’a egesaku eke nakio getamoigwereti Omonene, Nyasae obo, naende tigiancheti Omonene akerongeyie. Ekeene giasirire korwa ase emenwa yabo.”
english: Therefore say to them, 'This is the nation that has not obeyed the LORD its God or responded to correction. Truth has perished; it has vanished from their lips.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, batebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Inwe nigo mokoria enyama ere namanyinga, naende nigo mokorigereria emegwekano yaino mogosasima, boigo inwe nigo mogoitera amanyinga ’abanto. Inee! Naki moranyare koira ense eye ebe eyaino?
english: Therefore say to them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Since you eat meat with the blood still in it and look to your idols and shed blood, should you then possess the land?

ekegusii: Nabo moorokie ase obosio bwe chikanisa obwanchani bwaino, na ogwetogia gwaito ase engencho yaino asebare.
english: Therefore show these men the proof of your love and the reason for our pride in you, so that the churches can see it.

ekegusii: “Ase igo, kwana nabarabwo, obatebie ng’a aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Omonto onde bwensi bw’Abaisraeli orae emegwekano yaye agosasima ribaga ase enkoro yaye, na emegwekano eyio ebe ekegocha gekomoraa gochia gokora ebibe, naende abe ogocha ase omobani, oyio ninche Omonene omonyene ndamoiranerie buna agwenerete ase engencho y’emegwekano yaye emenge agosasima.
english: Therefore speak to them and tell them, 'This is what the Sovereign LORD says: When any Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face and then goes to a prophet, I the LORD will answer him myself in keeping with his great idolatry.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanto bare ne chinguru mbagotogie, emechie y’ebisaku ebitindi nekoiroke.
english: Therefore strong peoples will honor you; cities of ruthless nations will revere you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, motebie ng’a, ngokora inde nere okobwatana kwane kw’omorembe.
english: Therefore tell him I am making my covenant of peace with him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio tebia abanto: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Ing’iranere inche Omonene bw’Emeganda, nainche nimbairanere. Nabo Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba.
english: Therefore tell the people: This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'Return to me,' declares the LORD Almighty, 'and I will return to you,' says the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Ase ayio goika otebie ababani abwo bagoaka orwaki orwo echooka eyio ng’a orwaki orwo narogwe. Embura y’omoubera netwe amo namagena amanene, na ekembugu‐mbugu biroiyerie inse.
english: therefore tell those who cover it with whitewash that it is going to fall. Rain will come in torrents, and I will send hailstones hurtling down, and violent winds will burst forth.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ense nereere na kweumia, igoro nchionchoke chimwame ti, ekiagera ninche nakwanire, naganirie gokora ayio; tinkonyara gweitia gose koonchora ebirengererio biane.”
english: Therefore the earth will mourn and the heavens above grow dark, because I have spoken and will not relent, I have decided and will not turn back."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aase abakure atoonire na gwasamia omonwa oye goetania ekerengo, na abare nobonene ase omochie oyio, na emeganda ere aroro, na ebiombe bire neburu‐buru, na bonsi abagochenga ime yaye, mbatirimboke gochia aase agwo.
english: Therefore the grave enlarges its appetite and opens its mouth without limit; into it will descend their nobles and masses with all their brawlers and revelers.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akarangeria Yehoyada, omokuani oria omonene, akamoboria, “Nase ki otaratebia Abalawi barente korwa ase Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu ebango yachigetwe na Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, eyio omosangererekano ogwenerete korenta ase Eema y’Oborori?”
english: Therefore the king summoned Jehoiada the chief priest and said to him, "Why haven't you required the Levites to bring in from Judah and Jerusalem the tax imposed by Moses the servant of the LORD and by the assembly of Israel for the Tent of the Testimony?"

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio amachiko tari ne chinguru, na oboronge tibori gokorwa. Abakori amabe nigo baetanaine abanyaboronge, na ebina nigo bikonachwa bobe.
english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Ekiagera mwabeire mokwanga konyigwera,
english: Therefore the LORD Almighty says this: "Because you have not listened to my words,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene omonyene nabae ekemanyererio eke: Naama! Omoiseke omwekungi nabe morito, erio aibore omwana omoisia, namoroke erieta riaye Imanueli.
english: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: The virgin will be with child and will give birth to a son, and will call him Immanuel.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene, Nyasae oye, akabeka Ahasi ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abasiiria. Barabwo bakamobua, bagoosa abanto abange, bakabaira Damesiki. Boigo Omonene akamobeka ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli. Omoruoti oyio akamobua, agaita abanto abange.
english: Therefore the LORD his God handed him over to the king of Aram. The Arameans defeated him and took many of his people as prisoners and brought them to Damascus. He was also given into the hands of the king of Israel, who inflicted heavy casualties on him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, rora inche Omonene nkorenta inde igoro y’abanto abwo amache ’orooche are amange, naende are ne chinguru, ayio naro omoruoti bw’Abaasuri amo nobonene bwaye bwonsi. Amache ayio naichore aete chingegu igoro, aiteke gochia aande onsi.
english: therefore the Lord is about to bring against them the mighty floodwaters of the River--the king of Assyria with all his pomp. It will overflow all its channels, run over all its banks

ekegusii: Omonene akaanga chinderia chionsi chi’Abaisraeli, akabaa egesusuro, akababeka ase amaboko ’abasakori goika akabaseria korwa ase obosio bwaye kegima.
english: Therefore the LORD rejected all the people of Israel; he afflicted them and gave them into the hands of plunderers, until he thrust them from his presence.

ekegusii: Erio Omonene akaba nendamwamu ase abanto baye, na akagechigwa nabanto bare omwando oye.
english: Therefore the LORD was angry with his people and abhorred his inheritance.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akaba nendamwamu entindi ase Abaisraeli, agateba, “Abanto aba basaririe okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania, okwo nachigete chisokoro chiabo chikobwate. Na bono ekiagera tibanyigwereti,
english: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel and said, "Because this nation has violated the covenant that I laid down for their forefathers and has not listened to me,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene nae abakungu ba Sayoni oborwaire bw’ogosunyora chitukia chiabo, naende abaasiorie chianga abatige bare getirianda.”
english: Therefore the Lord will bring sores on the heads of the women of Zion; the LORD will make their scalps bald."

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene tari nomogoko ase abasae babo, na tari namabera ase chintakana na ababoraka babo, ekiagera kera omonto nomosaria ase Nyasae, na omokori amabe, na kera oyomo nigo agokwana ay’oboriri. Ase engencho y’ayio onsi Omonene taratiga endamwamu yaye; nigo agendererete korambora okoboko kwaye kobaa egesusuro.
english: Therefore the Lord will take no pleasure in the young men, nor will he pity the fatherless and widows, for everyone is ungodly and wicked, every mouth speaks vileness. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, ore Omobui ase egati y’Abaisraeli, otebire iga: “Naama! Ning’itere endamwamu yane ase ababisa baane, naende inche omonyene ninyeruserie egesiomba asebare.
english: Therefore the Lord, the LORD Almighty, the Mighty One of Israel, declares: "Ah, I will get relief from my foes and avenge myself on my enemies.

ekegusii: Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene ekaba enene ase ense eye, ere akarenta okoragereria gwonsi okwo korikire ase ebuku eye.
english: Therefore the LORD's anger burned against this land, so that he brought on it all the curses written in this book.

ekegusii: Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene yokire ase abanto baye, na ere oramboire okoboko kwaye asebare obaakire. Ebitunwa biatengechigwe, na emebere y’abanto bakwete nebe buna eubi ase chinchera. Nonya ayio onsi agochia koba igo, endamwamu yaye tekoera; okoboko kwaye nigo koragenderere korua egesururo.
english: Therefore the LORD's anger burns against his people; his hand is raised and he strikes them down. The mountains shake, and the dead bodies are like refuse in the streets. Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away, his hand is still upraised.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Abamoabu mbarere; kera omonto tiga areere ense ya Moabu. Eng’ererie moichane, ekiagera mwaborirwe amabomba ’amasabibu amomo akwama Kiri‐Hareseti.
english: Therefore the Moabites wail, they wail together for Moab. Lament and grieve for the men of Kir Hareseth.

ekegusii: Erio Abafarisai nabarabwo bakamoboria naende buna anyorete okorora. Akabatebia, “Nigo abegete etintira igoro ase amaiso aane, ngesibia, na bono nkorora nde.”
english: Therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. "He put mud on my eyes," the man replied, "and I washed, and now I see."

ekegusii: Aase aaria akarokwa Kibiroti‐Hatawa, ekiagera aroro agwo nao abanto baria barenge abatoonu b’okogania chinyama batindegetwe.
english: Therefore the place was named Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had craved other food.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, omonto ore omong’aini nakire‐kiri ase engaki buna eyio, ekiagera eyio nengaki embe.
english: Therefore the prudent man keeps quiet in such times, for the times are evil.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio embura rigengo yatangirwe tegotwa, naboigo nembura y’okwamia endagera. Korende nonya naboigo, amasio aino nigo anga buna ay’abakungu abatayayi, timorochi obosooku.
english: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and no spring rains have fallen. Yet you have the brazen look of a prostitute; you refuse to blush with shame.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abakori amabe tibagocha gwekengera ase rituko ri’ekina, gose abanyabibe ase omosangererekano bw’abanyene oboronge.
english: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto babo nigo bakoonchoka bababwatia, nigo bakwong’otera amache abo are amange.
english: Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.

ekegusii: Ase ayio abanto abwo nabasire buna ritaturi ria mambia, gose buna riime rigosira bwango, na buna omoiriro okoirurukigwa nomwaga korwa ase ekeooreri, gose buna erioki rigoetera ase ekebao riasira.
english: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, like the early dew that disappears, like chaff swirling from a threshing floor, like smoke escaping through a window.

ekegusii: erinde amanyinga ’ababani bonsi, ayaitegete korwa omochakano bw’ense naganigwe ase ekegori eke,
english: Therefore this generation will be held responsible for the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the beginning of the world,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Nimbanyititore ase okobachena na kobateema. Ngento ki rende ndanyare gokorera abanto baane?
english: Therefore this is what the LORD Almighty says: "See, I will refine and test them, for what else can I do because of the sin of my people?

ekegusii: Ee, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Nimbae egesusuro; abamura babo nabaitwe ase esegi, na abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, nabakwe nenchara.
english: therefore this is what the LORD Almighty says: 'I will punish them. Their young men will die by the sword, their sons and daughters by famine.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Naama! Nindetere omoruoti o Babeli, amo nense yaye, egesusuro, buna nakorete ase omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Therefore this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "I will punish the king of Babylon and his land as I punished the king of Assyria.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, agoteba: “Ekiagera bakwanire ring’ana eri: Naama, inche ninkore amang’ana aane are ime ase omonwa oo abe buna omorero; abanto aba nababe buna chinko, na omorero oria nobasambe.”
english: Therefore this is what the LORD God Almighty says: "Because the people have spoken these words, I will make my words in your mouth a fire and these people the wood it consumes.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro ya Yehoyakimu mosinto o Yosia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda: “Abanto tibakomoreera na gokwana: Obee! Momura ominto! Gose: Obee! Mosubati ominto! Onde tari oramoreere na gokwana: Obee! Omonene! Obee! Naki arenge omonene!
english: Therefore this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: "They will not mourn for him: 'Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!' They will not mourn for him: 'Alas, my master! Alas, his splendor!'

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Naama! Nimbeke ebigocha ase amasio ’abanto aba, erio bibagoche bagwe. Abaise na abana babo abamura nabagwe amo: naboigo abagisangio babo na abasani babo amo.”
english: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "I will put obstacles before this people. Fathers and sons alike will stumble over them; neighbors and friends will perish."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Aye korairane, ninkoe ribaga ong’iranere, naye notenene ase obosio bwane. Aye korakwane amang’ana amaronge, na tari amang’ana atari nengencho, rirorio nobe ribaga ri’omonwa one. Abanto abwo mbakoiranere aye, korende aye tokobairanera barabwo.
english: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "If you repent, I will restore you that you may serve me; if you utter worthy, not worthless, words, you will be my spokesman. Let this people turn to you, but you must not turn to them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Boria abanto b’ebisaku gose bana koigwa amang’ana anga buna ayio. Abaisraeli, abwo banga buna omoiseke omwekungi, bakorire amang’ana are amabe mono.
english: Therefore this is what the LORD says: "Inquire among the nations: Who has ever heard anything like this? A most horrible thing has been done by Virgin Israel.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio inche Omonene nkobarentera inde ogosiria, na barabwo tibakonyara gwetooria, na ekero bararere asende, tinkobaigwa.
english: Therefore this is what the LORD says: 'I will bring on them a disaster they cannot escape. Although they cry out to me, I will not listen to them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio aya naro Omonene atebire: Aye togoika korwa ase oborere obwo kwariina korende ekeene, goika okwe.” Bono Elija akagenda,
english: Therefore this is what the LORD says: 'You will not leave the bed you are lying on. You will certainly die!'" So Elijah went.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba igoro y’abarisia, abwo babekire korenda abanto baane: “Inwe mwaserebanirie riicho riane, mwariseririe gochia aare, gose timwariechanderete. Naama! Nimbae inwe egesusuro ase engencho y’ogokora kwaino okobe.
english: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says to the shepherds who tend my people: "Because you have scattered my flock and driven them away and have not bestowed care on them, I will bestow punishment on you for the evil you have done," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, ngoteba; Rora, nindete igoro ya Yerusalemu na igoro y’Abayuda obobe obonene, na kera omonto noboigwe, na amato aye abere nabe akoeera.
english: Therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that the ears of everyone who hears of it will tingle.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, oyore Omonene, atebire: “Ebirero mbibe ase chiraaro chionsi chi’omochie, na ase chinchera chiaye chionsi abanto barere bakobuga: Obee! Obee! Mbarangerie abaremi bache korera, na abamanyete kobokia amagombo bache kweng’ereria.
english: Therefore this is what the Lord, the LORD God Almighty, says: "There will be wailing in all the streets and cries of anguish in every public square. The farmers will be summoned to weep and the mourners to wail.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene, oria obooretie Ibrahimu, okwanire amang’ana aya igoro y’ororeria rwa Yakobo, “Abanto ba Yakobo tibakogenderera koba nobosooku; amasio abo takoirura nonya ng’ake naende.
english: Therefore this is what the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, says to the house of Jacob: "No longer will Jacob be ashamed; no longer will their faces grow pale.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Ababisa mbanaarie ense eye, baiyerie chindwaki chiaino inse, echio mwekengerete, ne chinyomba chiaino chinkong’u chisakorwe.”
english: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "An enemy will overrun the land; he will pull down your strongholds and plunder your fortresses."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Naama! Abasomba baane mbabe bakonyora endagera bakoria, korende inwe mobe nenchara. Rora, abasomba baane mbanyore ekenyugwa bakonywa, korende inwe mobe nerang’o. Naama! Abasomba baane mbagoke, korende inwe mosooke.
english: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "My servants will eat, but you will go hungry; my servants will drink, but you will go thirsty; my servants will rejoice, but you will be put to shame.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ekiagera inwe mwensi mwabeire buna amabiria, rora nimbasangererie, mbarente ase egati‐gati ya Yerusalemu,
english: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: 'Because you have all become dross, I will gather you into Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Nindambore okoboko kwane mbae Abafilisti egesusuro, ning’ite Abakereti, mbasirie kegima, naende nsirie kegima abwo baratigare ase chinse chia ng’umbu mbarabare y’enyancha.
english: therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am about to stretch out my hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Kerethites and destroy those remaining along the coast.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Nigo inde mamincha ya Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, nimbune amaboko aye onsi, koria kore nechinguru amo na koria kwabunegete; ning’iyerie omoro korwa ase okoboko kwaye.
english: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break both his arms, the good arm as well as the broken one, and make the sword fall from his hand.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Aye Turo, rora, inche nabeire mamincha yao, nindete abanto b’ebisaku ebinge mono bakorwanie, buna emerindo y’enyancha ekoimokerera igoro.
english: therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against you, O Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, like the sea casting up its waves.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Rora, nimbeke ense ya Misiri ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli; ere naire obotenenku bwa Misiri, nayesakore na koira ebinto bire aroro. Ebinto ebio mbibe eng’eria y’abarwani baye b’esegi.
english: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am going to give Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will carry off its wealth. He will loot and plunder the land as pay for his army.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Naimokirie okoboko kwane igoro na goteba: Ekeene, abanto abwo b’ebisaku babaetanaine mbachaywe barabwo boka abanyene.
english: Therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I swear with uplifted hand that the nations around you will also suffer scorn.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Nindambore okoboko kwane mamincha y’Abaedomu; ning’ite nsirie kera omonto, na kera eng’iti. Ninsarie ense eyio ebe bosa. Abanto mbaitwe nemioro korwa Temani goika Dedani.
english: therefore this is what the Sovereign LORD says: I will stretch out my hand against Edom and kill its men and their animals. I will lay it waste, and from Teman to Dedan they will fall by the sword.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Abaisraeli tibari koria omoki bw’enengo y’ebachwa goika rero iga, ekiagera omonto oria namoteng’eretie Yakobo omoki bw’enengo y’ebachwa yaye.
english: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob's hip was touched near the tendon.

ekegusii: Bono Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Ase ayio monganye goika rituko riria riike ekero ndaimoke koira abooswa baane, ekiagera nanachire amang’ana aane ng’a nsangererie abanto b’ebisaku, na ab’amaruoti mbabeke amo, mbaumorere ekeririanda kiane na endamwamu yane yonsi entindi; ense yonsi esambwe nomorero bwe risemi riane.
english: Therefore wait for me," declares the LORD, "for the day I will stand up to testify. I have decided to assemble the nations, to gather the kingdoms and to pour out my wrath on them-- all my fierce anger. The whole world will be consumed by the fire of my jealous anger.

ekegusii: Gaki amatuko onsi nigo tore nomoyo bw’oboremu, naende twamanyire ng’a ekero tore aa ase omobere nigo tomenyete aare korwa ase Omonene,
english: Therefore we are always confident and know that as long as we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord.

ekegusii: Ase ayio twatomire Yuda na Sila, abaranyare kobatebia amang’ana ayio ayio ase emenwa yabo.
english: Therefore we are sending Judas and Silas to confirm by word of mouth what we are writing.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, titogokwa emioyo; korende nonya omonto oito o isiko ogosarigwa, omonto oito o ime akorwe omoyia rituko ase rituko.
english: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though outwardly we are wasting away, yet inwardly we are being renewed day by day.

ekegusii: Ase ayio titokwoboa, ense neisa gotengechigwa na ebitunwa birutwe ase chindiba chi’enyancha,
english: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,

ekegusii: Naboigo ebi Nyasae abwatanirie, mwanyabanto tabiatanana.”
english: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate."

ekegusii: inche ninkoe obong’aini ne chisemi. Boigo ninkoe obotenenku ne chinibo, na ogosikwa oko omoruoti onde atana koegwa, gose oyorache korwa nyuma yao takoegwa.”
english: therefore wisdom and knowledge will be given you. And I will also give you wealth, riches and honor, such as no king who was before you ever had and none after you will have."

ekegusii: Na bono timoremeiri keegwa kende gionsi, komoganyete okoorokigwa kw’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: Therefore you do not lack any spiritual gift as you eagerly wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe mobe abe ritang’ani koirwa ase obosomba, na emegoko y’emeyega yaino neere.
english: Therefore you will be among the first to go into exile; your feasting and lounging will end.

ekegusii: Ase ayio aye karue ebiegwa bi’ogotigana ase abanto bamenyete Mosereti‐Gati. Chinyomba chire agwo Akisibu nchibe buna chindooche chikong’aina abaruoti b’Abaisraeli.
english: Therefore you will give parting gifts to Moresheth Gath. The town of Aczib will prove deceptive to the kings of Israel.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio onde tari orarambore engori y’okorengera egetari ase omosangererekano bw’Omonene.
english: Therefore you will have no one in the assembly of the LORD to divide the land by lot.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bono tokogenderera koria abanto, gose goita abana b’egesaku kiao. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: therefore you will no longer devour men or make your nation childless, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio timokogenderera korora amaroro ay’obong’ainereria, gose kwenaria oboringoria. Nindusie abanto baane korwa ase amaboko aino. Erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.”
english: therefore you will no longer see false visions or practice divination. I will save my people from your hands. And then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

ekegusii: “Ayio naro agerete bare bosio bw’ekerogo ki’obonene kia Nyasae, na barabwo nigo bakomokorera omobaso na obotuko ase Hekalu yaye; ere oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene igo aramenye amo nabarabwo na kobarenda.
english: Therefore, "they are before the throne of God and serve him day and night in his temple; and he who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ninde noboremu obonge ase Kristo kogochika eri ogwenerete okore.
english: Therefore, although in Christ I could be bold and order you to do what you ought to do,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, na intwe abanyene nigo togwetogia ase engencho yaino ase chikanisa chia Nyasae, ase engencho y’oboremereria bwaino, na okwegena more nakwo ase ogochandwa kwaino gwonsi, na emechando eye moremereretie.
english: Therefore, among God's churches we boast about your perseverance and faith in all the persecutions and trials you are enduring.

ekegusii: Therefore, as God's chosen people, holy and dearly loved, clothe yourselves with compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness and patience.
english: Gaki, ekiagera more abachore ba Nyasae, abachenu na abanchwa, mweboyie amabeebe, obuya, obokanyeku, obwororo, oboremereria.

ekegusii: Ase igo buna erikire, “Ere oyogwetogia, tiga etogie ase Omonene.”
english: Therefore, as it is written: "Let him who boasts boast in the Lord."

ekegusii: Ase ayio ekero abanto b’ebisaku bionsi na ab’emenwa yonsi baigwete eriogi ri’ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amariogi a kera egento ki’amatera, bonsi bakaba bagatung’ama na gosasima omogwekano bw’etahabu, oria omoruoti konya atenenetie.
english: Therefore, as soon as they heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp and all kinds of music, all the peoples, nations and men of every language fell down and worshiped the image of gold that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nigo agoteba iga: “Ekeene, buna inde moyo, ense ya Moabu nebe buna Sodomu, na ense y’Abaamoni nebe buna Gomora, ense ere namasa ne chingoro chire nomonyo, aase agwo nabe agendererete gosareka botambe. Abatigari b’abanto baane mbasakore abanto abwo, na abatooregete b’egesaku kiane mbaboose babakore babe abasomba babo.”
english: Therefore, as surely as I live," declares the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, "surely Moab will become like Sodom, the Ammonites like Gomorrah-- a place of weeds and salt pits, a wasteland forever. The remnant of my people will plunder them; the survivors of my nation will inherit their land."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna koreng’ana chimeme chi’omorero chigosamba amasakwe, na buna obonyansi obwomo bokoyia bwasira, naboigo na omori bw’abanto abwo oragunde, na ebisicha biabo birurukigwe buna orotu, ekiagera bangire amachiko ’Omonene bw’Emeganda, na bachayire ring’ana ri’Omonene bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Therefore, as tongues of fire lick up straw and as dry grass sinks down in the flames, so their roots will decay and their flowers blow away like dust; for they have rejected the law of the LORD Almighty and spurned the word of the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: Nabo gatorabe ne ribaga tokorere abanto bonsi amaya, korende kobua mono abwo bare ab’okwegena.
english: Therefore, as we have opportunity, let us do good to all people, especially to those who belong to the family of believers.

ekegusii: Ankio norore, engaki buna eye, nindete embura y’amagena endito mono, eyio omogwekano oye etana gotwa rinde ase Misiri korwa riria ense eye yachagete goika bono.
english: Therefore, at this time tomorrow I will send the worst hailstorm that has ever fallen on Egypt, from the day it was founded till now.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, riime rikorwa igoro riatangirwe na ense tekwama endagera.
english: Therefore, because of you the heavens have withheld their dew and the earth its crops.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, baminto, ase obokong’u bwaito, na emechando yaito, tokaremigwa ase okwegena kwaino.
english: Therefore, brothers, in all our distress and persecution we were encouraged about you because of your faith.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, baminto, ntore noboremu bw’ogosoa Aase Aachenu goetera ase amanyinga a Yeso,
english: Therefore, brothers, since we have confidence to enter the Most Holy Place by the blood of Jesus,

ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, intwe titori abana b’omokungu omosomba, korende nabana b’omokungu omonyuome, oyotarenge omosomba.
english: Therefore, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman, but of the free woman.

ekegusii: Naboigo baminto, igo tore abasira, korende tari ase chingencho chiaito chi’ebibe, ase ogotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe,
english: Therefore, brothers, we have an obligation-- but it is not to the sinful nature, to live according to it.

ekegusii: Gaki, abanchani, komwatang’anire komanya aya, erende timobaisa gotantanigwa nogosira kw’abwo bagosaria amachiko, na igo mobaise kogwa korwa ase ogwetenenera kwaino.
english: Therefore, dear friends, since you already know this, be on your guard so that you may not be carried away by the error of lawless men and fall from your secure position.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, timobaisa gosokia abaiseke baino ase abamura babo, gose timobaisa kobarigeria omorembe gose ogosesenigwa. Mobe abakong’u na morie amaya ay’ense eye na moyetigere abana baino ebe omwando obo kogenderera botambe.
english: Therefore, do not give your daughters in marriage to their sons or take their daughters for your sons. Do not seek a treaty of friendship with them at any time, that you may be strong and eat the good things of the land and leave it to your children as an everlasting inheritance.'

ekegusii: Ase ayio, beka aare ogotacheneka gwonsi, na obonge bw’amabe, na ase obwororo mwanche ring’ana erio riasimekirwe ime yaino, eriranyare gotooria emioyo yaino.
english: Therefore, get rid of all moral filth and the evil that is so prevalent and humbly accept the word planted in you, which can save you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ere oyobwangire aya, tangeti mwanyabanto, korende Nyasae, oyokobaa inwe Omoika oye Omochenu.
english: Therefore, he who rejects this instruction does not reject man but God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Gaki, oyorarie emuma ase egesasimero nigo ararie ase ekio, na ase ebinto bionsi ebire igoro yaye.
english: Therefore, he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto bonsi narusetie Yerusalemu nkabaira Babeli ase obosomba, tegerera moigwe ring’ana ri’Omonene!
english: Therefore, hear the word of the LORD, all you exiles whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, tegerera moigwe omoroberio inche Omonene nakorire igoro y’abanto ba Babeli, na okogania kwane mbwate igoro y’ense y’Abakalidayo. Ekeene, nonya nabana babo mbakururwe buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi chigokururwa chiairwa. Ee, ekeene, ense yabo nebaichanere.
english: Therefore, hear what the LORD has planned against Babylon, what he has purposed against the land of the Babylonians: The young of the flock will be dragged away; he will completely destroy their pasture because of them.

ekegusii: Ase ayio tegerera moigwe omoroberio inche Omonene nakorire igoro y’Abaedomu, na okogania kwane mbwate igoro ase abanto ba Temani: Ekeene, nonya nabana babo mbakururwe buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi chigokururwa chiairwa. Ekeene, ense yabo nebaichanere.
english: Therefore, hear what the LORD has planned against Edom, what he has purposed against those who live in Teman: The young of the flock will be dragged away; he will completely destroy their pasture because of them.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio abamura b’omochie oyio, nabaitwe, bakwere agwo ase chinchera, na abarwani baye bonsi b’esegi nabasirigwe kegima. Nabo inche Omonene natebire.
english: Therefore, her young men will fall in the streets; all her soldiers will be silenced in that day," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abaminto abachenu, ababwatani b’okorangerigwa gokorwa igoro, morengererie mono Yeso omotomwa na Omokuani Omonene bw’okoorokia gwaito.
english: Therefore, holy brothers, who share in the heavenly calling, fix your thoughts on Jesus, the apostle and high priest whom we confess.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nabaorokeirie bonsi ase rituko ria rero, ng’a inche tindi na komocha ase amanyinga a monto onde bwensi,
english: Therefore, I declare to you today that I am innocent of the blood of all men.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ebibe biaino nimbaake timogwena rinde, mbasirie kegima.
english: Therefore, I have begun to destroy you, to ruin you because of your sins.

ekegusii: Ase ayio natianire ase eamate ya Eli ng’a okobwatanigwa tigokoba nonya ng’ake ase ebibe biabo ase enchera y’ebing’wanso gose okoruegwa konde gwonsi.”
english: Therefore, I swore to the house of Eli, 'The guilt of Eli's house will never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.'"

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nagotebirie, obwanchani bwaye bworokirie ng’a ebibe biaye ebinge biabeirwe; ere oyokwaberwa ebike nigo anchete ake.”
english: Therefore, I tell you, her many sins have been forgiven-- for she loved much. But he who has been forgiven little loves little."

ekegusii: Gaki baminto, nabasoroire mono ase amabera a Nyasae, morue emebere yaino ebe ekeng’wanso kere moyo, egechenu, ekeranyare gwanchwa na Nyasae, nakio ogosasima kwaino gw’ekeene.
english: Therefore, I urge you, brothers, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God-- this is your spiritual act of worship.

ekegusii: Therefore, I will punish him and then release him."
english: Erio konamoakire, nimosibore.”

ekegusii: rirorio inche nimbaserie morue ase obosio bwane, inwe amo nomochie oyio nabaete inwe ne chisokoro chiaino.
english: Therefore, I will surely forget you and cast you out of my presence along with the city I gave to you and your fathers.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, omonto karabe ime ya Kristo nigo are egetongwa ekeyia; ebia kare biaetire, rora bionsi biabeire ebiyia.
english: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; the old has gone, the new has come!

ekegusii: Ase ayio, endagera keragere oyominto agwe, rirorio tinkoria enyama nonya ng’ake, timbaisa kogera oyominto agwe.
english: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother to fall into sin, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause him to fall.

ekegusii: Gaki komorabe mogosoerana ase amang’ana buna ayio, naki rende mokoyarenta ase abwo batabariri buna ngento ase ekanisa?
english: Therefore, if you have disputes about such matters, appoint as judges even men of little account in the church!

ekegusii: Nabo omobere oo bwonsi korabe noborabu, ensemo ende teba omosunte, omobere oo noichore noborabu kegima, buna etaya ase amasase aye egwoka oborabu.”
english: Therefore, if your whole body is full of light, and no part of it dark, it will be completely lighted, as when the light of a lamp shines on you."

ekegusii: Na bono nabatebirie, eatanane korwa ase abanto aba, batige, ekiagera onye ring’ana eri, gose emeremo eye, neya mwanyabanto, nesarigwe,
english: Therefore, in the present case I advise you: Leave these men alone! Let them go! For if their purpose or activity is of human origin, it will fail.

ekegusii: Ase ayio negwenerete kera oyomo aigwere, tari ase engencho y ’endamwamu ya Nyasae yoka, korende aigwere boigo, erinde enkoro yaye temogambia.
english: Therefore, it is necessary to submit to the authorities, not only because of possible punishment but also because of conscience.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna ase engencho y’omonto oyomo ebibe bigasoa ase ense, na ase engencho y’ebibe amakweri, naboigo amakweri agaikera abanto bonsi, ekiagera bonsi bakorire ebibe.
english: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, and in this way death came to all men, because all sinned--

ekegusii: Ase ayio mwanyabanto nigo bamoirogete; ere tari gosika oyokwerengereria ng’a nomong’aini are.”
english: Therefore, men revere him, for does he not have regard for all the wise in heart?"

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abaminto, kora omokia kobua gokora okorangerigwa kwaino na ogochorwa kwaino kobe goteneine bokong’u, naki komorakore ayio, timokogwa nonya ng’ake.
english: Therefore, my brothers, be all the more eager to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never fall,

ekegusii: Ase ayio baminto, rigia mono okobana, gose timokana ogokwana kw’emenwa.
english: Therefore, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

ekegusii: Gaki baminto, inwe abanyanchete, abwo amaiga andiereire, omogoko one na egutwa yane, tenena bokong’u ase Omonene, abanchi baane.
english: Therefore, my brothers, you whom I love and long for, my joy and crown, that is how you should stand firm in the Lord, dear friends!

ekegusii: Gaki baminto, abanchwa, mobe ne chinguru, motari gotengechingwa, momente mono gokora emeremo y’Omonene ase amatuko onsi, momanye ng’a emeremo yaino ase Omonene teri bosa.
english: Therefore, my dear brothers, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, abanchwa baane, buna moigwerete botambe, tari ekero indeo rioka, korende kobua mono ekero ntaiyo, korera ogotooreka kwaino abanyene ase okwoboa na okoiguswa,
english: Therefore, my dear friends, as you have always obeyed-- not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence-- continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling,

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio, abanchwa baane, tama, timobaisa gosasima emegwekano.
english: Therefore, my dear friends, flee from idolatry.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio nkarenta ekeririanda kiane na endamwamu yane ase emechie y’Abayuda ne chinchera chia Yerusalemu, na bikaba amaturi bitamenyiri, buna bire goika rero iga.
english: Therefore, my fierce anger was poured out; it raged against the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem and made them the desolate ruins they are today.

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aye omoruoti, ancha ogosemia oko kwane. Tokora ebibe, na chaka gokora oboronge; tiga obobe bwao, na ororere abagokorerwa bobe amabera. Ande nabo oranyare komenterwa ogosesenigwa ase amatuko ao.”
english: Therefore, O king, be pleased to accept my advice: Renounce your sins by doing what is right, and your wickedness by being kind to the oppressed. It may be that then your prosperity will continue."

ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene Nyasae! Aya naro Omonene Nyasae akobatebia inwe ebitunwa, na ebigoro, ne chindooche, na amakura, na amaturi, na emechie eng’anyire na gosakorwa, naende echayire nebisaku bire ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Sovereign LORD: This is what the Sovereign LORD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, to the desolate ruins and the deserted towns that have been plundered and ridiculed by the rest of the nations around you--

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abarisia, igwa ring’ana ri’Omonene:
english: therefore, O shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:

ekegusii: Ase ayio, eboyie bokong’u ebinema bi’ebirengererio biaino, mobe aberiti, mobe nogosemeria ogoikeranu ase obuya boria morarenterwe ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.
english: Therefore, prepare your minds for action; be self-controlled; set your hope fully on the grace to be given you when Jesus Christ is revealed.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inyora buna mwarenge kare. Inwe abanto b’Ebisaku ase chingencho chi’omobere mware korokwa abanto batarogeti na baria bakwaroka ase okwaroka kw’omobere kogokorwa namaboko.
english: Therefore, remember that formerly you who are Gentiles by birth and called "uncircumcised" by those who call themselves "the circumcision" (that done in the body by the hands of men)--

ekegusii: Therefore, rid yourselves of all malice and all deceit, hypocrisy, envy, and slander of every kind.
english: Gaki, beka are obobe bwonsi, na obong’ainereria bwonsi, na oborianania, na emoko, na oboitania bwonsi.

ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera Kristo achandetwe ase omobere, nainwe boigo eboyie ebirwanero bi’ebirengererio ebio ebio, ekiagera ere oyochandetwe ase omobere bweatananire korwa ase ebibe.
english: Therefore, since Christ suffered in his body, arm yourselves also with the same attitude, because he who has suffered in his body is done with sin.

ekegusii: Naboigo nainche narorire buya, konaikire kwenyorera amang’ana onsi boronge korwa ritang’ani, gokorikera aye Theofilo bw’amasikani,
english: Therefore, since I myself have carefully investigated everything from the beginning, it seemed good also to me to write an orderly account for you, most excellent Theophilus,

ekegusii: Gaki, onye eira eria y’ogosoa ase ogotimoka kwaye ereo, tiga toiroke ng’a onde omo oino tabaisa konyorekana ng’a omochire gokonyora.
english: Therefore, since the promise of entering his rest still stands, let us be careful that none of you be found to have fallen short of it.

ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera amang’ana aya takonyara gokanwa, mogwenerete gokira, timokora ring’ana ria bwango.
english: Therefore, since these facts are undeniable, you ought to be quiet and not do anything rash.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera tore nobosomba obo koreng’ana namabera aya twanyorire, titokwa emioyo.
english: Therefore, since through God's mercy we have this ministry, we do not lose heart.

ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera twanyorire oboruoti obotanyare gotengechigwa, tiga toiranerie ng’a mbuya mono na komokorera Nyasae ase okomogokia amo namasikani na okoiroka.
english: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekiagera intwe tore nabarori abange buna igo, batoetanaine buna riire, totugute are kera egurube, na ebibe biria bitobwatete. Tominyoke noboremereria ase okoamererania koria kobekire bosio bwaito,
english: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off everything that hinders and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with perseverance the race marked out for us.

ekegusii: Gaki, ekiagera tore n’Omokuani Omonene mono, oyosoete igoro, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae, tobwate mono okoorokia gwaito.
english: Therefore, since we have a great high priest who has gone through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold firmly to the faith we profess.

ekegusii: Ase igo ekero twaeirwe oboronge ase okwegena, ntore nomorembe na Nyasae goetera ase Omonene oito Yeso Kristo.
english: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,

ekegusii: Therefore, since we have such a hope, we are very bold.
english: Gaki, ekiagera tore nogosemeria kore buna oko, iga tore noboremu obonge gatogokwana.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, mobeke chinguru amaboko ayio ororobire, na amaru ayagataire.
english: Therefore, strengthen your feeble arms and weak knees.

ekegusii: Bono morende na koigwera amachiko, na emeroberio echikire, mokore ayio onsi nabachikire ase rituko ria rero.”
english: Therefore, take care to follow the commands, decrees and laws I give you today.

ekegusii: Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene egacha igoro ase Abayuda, na ase abanto ba Yerusalemu. Omonene akabakora bakaba ebiorokererio bi’ogokurera, na aya abakorerete abeire ay’ogoichania na ay’okoondokia abanto. Aya moyaroche namaiso aino.
english: Therefore, the anger of the LORD has fallen on Judah and Jerusalem; he has made them an object of dread and horror and scorn, as you can see with your own eyes.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba: Rora, nkoroberia inde amabe igoro yaino inwe ab’egesaku eke, na timokonyara korusia amagoti aino korwa ase amabe ayio, gose timokonyara gotaara moeneno, ekiagera nigo erabe engaki embe.
english: Therefore, the LORD says: "I am planning disaster against this people, from which you cannot save yourselves. You will no longer walk proudly, for it will be a time of calamity.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, natome oborwaire bw’okoreeyia abanto abanoru, na obonene bw’omoruoti oyio botongigwe boyie buna omorero.
english: Therefore, the Lord, the LORD Almighty, will send a wasting disease upon his sturdy warriors; under his pomp a fire will be kindled like a blazing flame.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio eira eye nigo yanyoretwe ase okwegena, ebe ase enchera y’amabera, erinde enyare koba eng’ikeranu ase oroiboro rwaye rwonsi, tari ase baria b’amachiko boka korende nase baria bare nokwegena buna okwa Ibrahimu. Ere nere tata oito intwe twensi,
english: Therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may be by grace and may be guaranteed to all Abraham's offspring-- not only to those who are of the law but also to those who are of the faith of Abraham. He is the father of us all.

ekegusii: Na bono kogambigwa tikori ase abwo bare ime ase Kristo Yeso.
english: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus,

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli otebire iga: “Inwe mwachayire ring’ana eri, mwanchire amang’ana ’obobe na obong’ainereria, naro mosemeretie.
english: Therefore, this is what the Holy One of Israel says: "Because you have rejected this message, relied on oppression and depended on deceit,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba igoro y’ababani abwo: “Naama! Nimbae ekemeri ekeroro barie, nimbae namache are nobosongo banywe. Korwa ase ababani ba Yerusalemu, ogotamoiroka Nyasae gwesiareire ase ense yonsi.”
english: Therefore, this is what the LORD Almighty says concerning the prophets: "I will make them eat bitter food and drink poisoned water, because from the prophets of Jerusalem ungodliness has spread throughout the land."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Rora, nae abanto aba ebimeri ebiroro barie, na amache are nobosongo banywe.
english: Therefore, this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "See, I will make this people eat bitter food and drink poisoned water.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Omonto takobora korwa ase ororeria rwa Yonadabu, mosinto o Rekabu, oratenene ase obosio bwane kare na kare.”
english: Therefore, this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'Jonadab son of Recab will never fail to have a man to serve me.'"

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro ya Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda: Omonto takonyorekana ase ororeria rwaye oragambe ase ekerogo ki’obonene gia Daudi. Omobere o Yehoyakimu okwete notugutwe isiko obe aroro ase omobaso omororo na ase obokendu bwa botuko.
english: Therefore, this is what the LORD says about Jehoiakim king of Judah: He will have no one to sit on the throne of David; his body will be thrown out and exposed to the heat by day and the frost by night.

ekegusii: Ase ayio inche Omonene nigo ngoteba igoro ase ababani abwo bakobana goetera ase erieta riane batatomiri nainche: Barabwo nigo bagokwana ng’a esegi na enchara tibikonyara korentwa ase ense eye. Ababani abwo nabaitwe nemioro, na enchara, goika basirigwe kegima.
english: Therefore, this is what the LORD says about the prophets who are prophesying in my name: I did not send them, yet they are saying, 'No sword or famine will touch this land.' Those same prophets will perish by sword and famine.

ekegusii: Ase ayio aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Naama! Nimbarwanerere inwe, mbaruserie egesiomba. Ninkamie enyancha ya Babeli, nkamie ne chinsoko chiaye chionsi.
english: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: "See, I will defend your cause and avenge you; I will dry up her sea and make her springs dry.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro inche Omonene ngoteba: Rora nkobeka nde omochie oyo ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, ee, ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, goika ayoire.
english: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: I am about to hand this city over to the Babylonians and to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who will capture it.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio Omonene otebire ng’a nagoite orue ase ense. Nokwe ase omwaka oyo, ekiagera gwakwanire amang’ana agerire abanto basaririe ase Omonene.”
english: Therefore, this is what the LORD says: 'I am about to remove you from the face of the earth. This very year you are going to die, because you have preached rebellion against the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene, oyore Omonene bw’Emeganda, agoteba: “Inwe abanto baane momenyete Sayoni, timoiroka Abaasuri nonya bakobaaka nenyimbo na koyeimokereria igoro, buna Abamisiri bakorete.
english: Therefore, this is what the Lord, the LORD Almighty, says: "O my people who live in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrians, who beat you with a rod and lift up a club against you, as Egypt did.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio ninkore enyomba eye ekorokwa ase erieta riane, eye inwe mwegenete, buna nakorete Silo, na ense eye naete chisokoro chiaino amo nainwe ebe boigo.
english: Therefore, what I did to Shiloh I will now do to the house that bears my Name, the temple you trust in, the place I gave to you and your fathers.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, Kristo kagosoa ase ense nigo agoteba, “Ebing’wanso na ebiruegwa tikwabiganetie, korende omobere kwandoiseirie.
english: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, he said: "Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but a body you prepared for me;

ekegusii: Gaki kera oyokoria omogati oyo gose konywera egekombe eke ki’Omonene buna etagwenereti nabe nokomocha igoro y’omobere bw’Omonene na amanyinga aye.
english: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.

ekegusii: Gaki, onde bwensi oyo orekeyie omonyene koba buna omwana oyo, oyio nere ore omonene kobua abande ase oboruoti bwa igoro.
english: Therefore, whoever humbles himself like this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, inwe abaruoti, mobe abang’aini, inwe abagambi b’ense, igwera ogokurerwa oko:
english: Therefore, you kings, be wise; be warned, you rulers of the earth.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nonyare korora ense eria ere bosio bwao, korende tokonyara kogenda aroro na gosoa ase ense eria ngochia koa Abaisraeli.”
english: Therefore, you will see the land only from a distance; you will not enter the land I am giving to the people of Israel."

ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebio bionsi naye bisemeretie, erio oe kera ekemo endagera yaye ase engaki egwenerete.
english: These all look to you to give them their food at the proper time.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya boigo nay’abang’aini. Tari buya gwanchereria abanto ekero ebina bikonachwa.
english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judging is not good:

ekegusii: These also were Levite clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, the Korahite clan. (Kohath was the forefather of Amram;
english: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Lawi: Eamate y’Abalibini, na ey’Abaheburoni, na ey’Abamali na ey’Abamusi, na ey’Abakora. Kohati nere orenge ise Amuramu.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nekiriri ki’amang’ana agochi‐gocha, korende omoikerania omonyene n’Kristo.
english: These are a shadow of the things that were to come; the reality, however, is found in Christ.

ekegusii: koreng’ana buna mwanyabanto bakoyanyora ase amachiko na amorokererio abo? (Amang’ana ayio onsi nigo agosareka ekero agokorerwa.)
english: These are all destined to perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.

ekegusii: Ebing’wanso ebio bimentwe ase ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ki’Omotienyi Omoyia, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera gochikire, na ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko na okoruegwa kw’endagera na ogw’ekenyugwa gokorentwa amo nebio, koreng’ana nomoroberio ochikire. Ebinto ebio bire ne rimisu rigiya, okoruegwa kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene.
english: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their grain offerings and drink offerings as specified. They are offerings made to the LORD by fire-- a pleasing aroma.

ekegusii: Eye nero emereng’anio ya Sulemani, eyio abanto ba Hezekia omoruoti bw’Abayuda, basangereretie.
english: These are more proverbs of Solomon, copied by the men of Hezekiah king of Judah:

ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bare abasaria, abana abanyaborimo, abana batari koigwera amachiko ’Omonene.
english: These are rebellious people, deceitful children, children unwilling to listen to the LORD's instruction.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’ebinto ebiakoreretwe ase okoroisia Obomenyo, engencho yaye Obomenyo bw’Oborori. Omobaro oyo Musa achigete ogakorwa n’Abalawi inse y’oboraai bwa Itamari, mosinto o Haroni, omokuani.
english: These are the amounts of the materials used for the tabernacle, the tabernacle of the Testimony, which were recorded at Moses' command by the Levites under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

ekegusii: These are the animals you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,
english: Echi nachio ching’iti morabe mokoria: chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori,

ekegusii: Echio nachio chiamate chi’abana ba Nuhu, gotunyana ororeria rwabo ase ebisaku biabo; na korwa asebare ebisaku bigesiarera ase ense yonsi nyuma y’etoigo eria.
english: These are the clans of Noah's sons, according to their lines of descent, within their nations. From these the nations spread out over the earth after the flood.

ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya naro Omonene akwanete ase omosangererekano oino bwonsi agwo ase egetunwa, ekero akwanete korwa ase egati‐gati y’omorero, ne riire, na omosunte ekerima. Akayakwana neriogi rinene, na tamentete gento kende gionsi. Akayarika ase chibao ibere chi’amagena, erio agaching’a.
english: These are the commandments the LORD proclaimed in a loud voice to your whole assembly there on the mountain from out of the fire, the cloud and the deep darkness; and he added nothing more. Then he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to me.

ekegusii: Ayio naro amachiko na emeroberio Omonene achigete Abaisraeli goetera ase Musa, agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, ang’e na Yorodan, Kororia Yeriko.
english: These are the commands and regulations the LORD gave through Moses to the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

ekegusii: Aya naro amachiko Omonene achigete Abaisraeli goetera ase Musa agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai.
english: These are the commands the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai for the Israelites.

ekegusii: “Aya naro amachiko, na emeroberio echikire, Omonene, Nyasae oino, anchigete imborokererie, erinde moyaigwere na koyakora ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
english: These are the commands, decrees and laws the LORD your God directed me to teach you to observe in the land that you are crossing the Jordan to possess,

ekegusii: “Aya naro amachiko na emeroberio echikire moraigwere na gokora ase ense eyio Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, agochia kobaa ebe eyaino. Ase amatuko onsi morabe momenyete ase ense mobe mokoyaigwera.
english: These are the decrees and laws you must be careful to follow in the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess-- as long as you live in the land.

ekegusii: Eyio nero emeroberio echikire amo namachiko Omonene aruete goetera ase omonwa o Musa, agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai, ebe ase egati yaye na Abaisraeli.
english: These are the decrees, the laws and the regulations that the LORD established on Mount Sinai between himself and the Israelites through Moses.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo abateneneri be chiamate echio chiaruete Babeli, chigatiira amo nainche, ekero Aritasasita arenge kogamba, na oyo nomoroberio bwe chinderia chiabo:
english: These are the family heads and those registered with them who came up with me from Babylon during the reign of King Artaxerxes:

ekegusii: Ne chianga baramoroiserie nachio echi: Egesembe ki’obokuani, na egesibao ki’obokuani, na eganchwa, na eganchwa ende erobekanirie egoika inse, na ekegogwa, na orokini. Bakorere Haroni amo nabamura baye chianga chinchenu, erio babe bagonkorera ase emeremo y’obokuani.
english: These are the garments they are to make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash. They are to make these sacred garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so they may serve me as priests.

ekegusii: Abafilisti bakarua emegwekano eria y’amagumba, eroisirie korwa ase etahabu, ekaba okoruegwa gw’okomocha ase Omonene, omogwekano oyomo korwa ase kera oyomo bw’emechie eyio: Asidodi, na Gasa, na Askeloni, na Gati, na Ekironi.
english: These are the gold tumors the Philistines sent as a guilt offering to the LORD-- one each for Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo Abaisraeli barigetwe korwa ase kera eamate, ekeombe ase ekeombe. Omobaro obo nigo ore chilifu amagana atano na rimo na isato, na amagana atano, na emerongo etano (603,550).
english: These are the Israelites, counted according to their families. All those in the camps, by their divisions, number 603,550.

ekegusii: Yohsua na Abaisraeli bakabua na goita abaruoti bonsi abamenyete bosongo ya Yorodan, gochakera Baali‐Gadi ase ebate ya Lebanoni goikera egetunwa kia Halaki, kegotiirerwa gochia Seiri. Yoshua agaatananera kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli ense eria ekaba eyabo.
english: These are the kings of the land that Joshua and the Israelites conquered on the west side of the Jordan, from Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which rises toward Seir (their lands Joshua gave as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel according to their tribal divisions--

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabua abaruoti na bakaira ense yarenge ng’umbu, moocha ya Yorodan, korwa rigoko ri’Arinoni goika egetunwa kia Herimoni, amo n’Ekerubo Ekiomo, ensemo ya moocha. Abaruoti abwo nabwo aba:
english: These are the kings of the land whom the Israelites had defeated and whose territory they took over east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Gorge to Mount Hermon, including all the eastern side of the Arabah:

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana ’omoerio a Daudi, mosinto o Yese, omonto oyo oimokereretigwe igoro, omoakwa amaguta o Nyasae o Yakobo, omoteri bw’amatera agwansa ase Abaisraeli:
english: These are the last words of David: "The oracle of David son of Jesse, the oracle of the man exalted by the Most High, the man anointed by the God of Jacob, Israel's singer of songs:

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto Daudi abegete bakaba abateneneri b’amatera ase enyomba y’Omonene, ekero Esanduku eria yarenge nokobwatana kw’Omonene konya yabekirwe aroro.
english: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark came to rest there.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo Omonene achigete baatanane ense ya Kanani ebe emiando y’Abaisraeli.
english: These are the men the LORD commanded to assign the inheritance to the Israelites in the land of Canaan.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nabwo bakorenta ogwatananeka, bare abanto b’ense eye yoka, korende Omoika tibabwati.
english: These are the men who divide you, who follow mere natural instincts and do not have the Spirit.

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abarwani chituoni Daudi abwate: Yosebe‐Basebeti korwa Takemoni. Ere nigo arenge omonene bw’Abwo Batato, chituoni chi’abarwani. Ere agaita abanto amagana atano na atato ase engaki eyemo, ase okona‐kong’wana‐ng’wania ne ritimo riaye.
english: These are the names of David's mighty men: Josheb-Basshebeth, a Tahkemonite, was chief of the Three; he raised his spear against eight hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta a basinto b’Esau: Elifasi, omomura o Ada moga Esau, na Reueli, omomura o Basemati moga Esau.
english: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau's wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau's wife Basemath.

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana abwo baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu; Samua na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani;
english: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana baiboretwe asare agwo Yerusalemu: Samua na Sobabu, Nathani na Sulemani,
english: These are the names of the children born to him there: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abanto baria Musa atomete gochia koroota ense eria. Musa akaroka Hosea, mosinto o Nuni, Yoshua.
english: These are the names of the men Moses sent to explore the land. (Moses gave Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua.)

ekegusii: Amarieta ’abanto abwo naro aya: Korwa ase egesaku kia Reuben, Elisuri, mosinto o Sedeuri.
english: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: from Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana abamura ba Gerisomu: Libini na Simei.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei.

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abana ba Isumaeli, ase omoroberio bw’okoiborwa kwabo: Nebayoti, nere omwana oye omotangi, na Kedari, na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu,
english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, listed in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta Abaisraeli abwo bagendete Misiri: Yakobo na abana baye, nabwo aba: Reuben, nere omotangi o Yakobo.
english: These are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob.

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abamura ba Israeli abasoete Misiri amo na Yakobo ise, kera oyomo amo nabanto b’omochie oye:
english: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob, each with his family:

ekegusii: Na amarieta abo baria ikomi na babere naro aya: Oyo bwe ritang’ani, Simion, oyokorokwa Petero, na Anderea momura omwabo; Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi na Yohana momura omwabo;
english: These are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon (who is called Peter) and his brother Andrew; James son of Zebedee, and his brother John;

ekegusii: Omonene nigo atigete abanto b’ebisaku binde bamenye ase ense eria, erinde ateeme Abaisraeli baria konya bataramanya esegi ende yonsi ase ense ya Kanani.
english: These are the nations the LORD left to test all those Israelites who had not experienced any of the wars in Canaan

ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’emeganda y’abarwani esegi, baria bachete ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, buna Omonene achigete, erinde bamoe oboruoti boria bwarusetigwe ase Saulo.
english: These are the numbers of the men armed for battle who came to David at Hebron to turn Saul's kingdom over to him, as the LORD had said:

ekegusii: Na ebiegwa orasangererie korwa asebare nabio ebi: chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai;
english: These are the offerings you are to receive from them: gold, silver and bronze;

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo Musa na Eleazari omokuani barigete ekero babarete Abaisraeli agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, ase Yorodan kororia Yeriko.
english: These are the ones counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they counted the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto b’orogongo rwa Yuda, baria Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, airete ase obosomba, bairanete gocha Yerusalemu na ase ense y’Abayuda, (kera oyomo akagenda komenya ase omochie oye
english: These are the people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had taken captive (they returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own town,

ekegusii: Ase emechie emeke ase ense y’Abayuda, kera omonto bw’Abaisraeli bande bonsi, na abakuani, na Abalawi, na abakori emeremo be Hekalu, na abana b’abasomba ba Sulemani, akamenya ase omwando oye. Aba nabwo abanene be chingongo chi’ense y’Abayuda abamenyete Yerusalemu,
english: These are the provincial leaders who settled in Jerusalem (now some Israelites, priests, Levites, temple servants and descendants of Solomon's servants lived in the towns of Judah, each on his own property in the various towns,

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika igoro ase ebinto bire na ukoma, kobirabe chianga chiroisirie korwa ase amarionya gose egatani, gose gokerabe egetambaa keroisirie ase chingencho ao ao, gose gento kende gionsi keroisirie korwa ase risankwa. Ase ogochika okwo egento ekio inagiatorwe ng’a giachenekire, gose tigechenegeti.
english: These are the regulations concerning contamination by mildew in woolen or linen clothing, woven or knitted material, or any leather article, for pronouncing them clean or unclean.

ekegusii: Aya naro amachiko ase omonto okorua amache anga buna chimengere, na oyogosokia embusuro yaye y’oroiboro, na koba oyotachenegeti ase engencho eyio,
english: These are the regulations for a man with a discharge, for anyone made unclean by an emission of semen,

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika igoro y’oborwaire bwa ukoma, ne richoncho,
english: These are the regulations for any infectious skin disease, for an itch,

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika ase omonto obwate oborwaire bwa ukoma, oria otanyare korua ebing’wanso bi’ogochenwa bia botambe bichikire.
english: These are the regulations for anyone who has an infectious skin disease and who cannot afford the regular offerings for his cleansing.

ekegusii: Eye nero emeroberio echikire, Omonene amoete Musa, yarenge koba ase egati y’omosacha na omokungu oye, na egati ya ise na omwana oye omoiseke otarasoka, ekero are ase omochie o ise.
english: These are the regulations the LORD gave Moses concerning relationships between a man and his wife, and between a father and his young daughter still living in his house.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Hamu, buna barenge ase chiamate chiabo, na emenwa yabo, ne chinse chiabo, na ebisaku biabo.
english: These are the sons of Ham by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Shemu, buna barenge ase chiamate chiabo, na emenwa yabo, ne chinse chiabo, na ebisaku biabo.
english: These are the sons of Shem by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.

ekegusii: These are the stipulations, decrees and laws Moses gave them when they came out of Egypt
english: Nyuma Abaisraeli kobarure Misiri, Musa akaa Abaisraeli oborori, na emeroberio echikire, na amachiko aya.

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana ’okobwatana kw’ogotianania Omonene achigete Musa akore n’Abaisraeli agwo ase ense ya Moabu. Okobwatana okwo nigo kwamentetwe ase koria Omonene konya akorire amo nabarabwo aria Horebu.
english: These are the terms of the covenant the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in Moab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Horeb.

ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Eleazari, omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi’ebisaku bi’Abaisraeli, baatananete ase ogoaka obomera aria Silo, ase okoboria Omonene, ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano. Nabo bagakoora emeremo y’ogwatanana ense eria.
