english: These are the territories that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the tribal clans of Israel assigned by lot at Shiloh in the presence of the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. And so they finished dividing the land.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro morakore: Kera omonto akwane ekeene noyomwabo; monache ebina bia boronge na ebi’omorembe agwo ase ebiita biaino.
english: These are the things you are to do: Speak the truth to each other, and render true and sound judgment in your courts;

ekegusii: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);
english: Baria ikomi na babere achorete nabwo aba: Simion nere arogete erieta rinde Petero,

ekegusii: Abwo nabwo emete eria ebere y’emezeituni na ebibekerero biria bie chitaya bibere biteneine ase obosio bw’Omonene bw’ense.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.

ekegusii: “Oko nakwo okorora naroche ekero naraire borere bwane: Nkarora omote omonene orenge omotambe mono oteneine ase egati‐gati y’ense.
english: These are the visions I saw while lying in my bed: I looked, and there before me stood a tree in the middle of the land. Its height was enormous.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Musa akwanete n’Abaisraeli bonsi ekero barenge ase erooro, moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodan. Nigo barenge ase Ekerubo Ekiomo kororia Sufu, gati gati y’omochie o Parani ase ensemo eyemo, na emechie ya Tofeli na Labani, na Haseroti, na Disahabu ase ensemo ende. (
english: These are the words Moses spoke to all Israel in the desert east of the Jordan-- that is, in the Arabah-- opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth and Dizahab.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Omonene akwanete igoro y’Abaisraeli na Abayuda:
english: These are the words the LORD spoke concerning Israel and Judah:

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abanto abwo: Beni‐Huri agatenenera ense y’ebigoro y’Efraimu;
english: These are their names: Ben-Hur-- in the hill country of Ephraim;

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto bachoretwe: Korwa ase egesaku kia Yuda, Kalebu, mosinto o Yefune;
english: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh, from the tribe of Judah;

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta abo: Korwa ase egesaku kia Reuben, Samua, mosinto o Sakuri;
english: These are their names: from the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;

ekegusii: Aba nabwo batesoetie ase ogotacheneka nabakungu, ekiagera barabwo nabekungi, naende bagotunyana Emanwa y’Eng’ondi kera aase ase akogenda. Aba nababooretigwe korwa ase mwanyabanto buna ogotongorwa ase Nyasae na ase Emanwa y’Eng’ondi,
english: These are those who did not defile themselves with women, for they kept themselves pure. They follow the Lamb wherever he goes. They were purchased from among men and offered as firstfruits to God and the Lamb.

ekegusii: Ayio naro akobekera omonto ogotacheneka korende okoria namaboko ataisabiri tikori kobekera omonto ogotacheneka.”
english: These are what make a man 'unclean'; but eating with unwashed hands does not make him 'unclean.'"

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nkobachika rituko ria rero timobaisa koyeba nonya ng’ake.
english: These commandments that I give you today are to be upon your hearts.

ekegusii: Amatuko ayio abe akoinyorwa na kobwatwa ebiaare ase ebiaare, ase kera eamate na ase kera orogongo, na kera omochie. Amatuko ayio a Purimu tabaisa gotigwa korendwa ase egati y’Abayahudi, gose ekeinyorio ki’amatuko ayio tikemocha koba ase chinderia chiabo.
english: These days should be remembered and observed in every generation by every family, and in every province and in every city. And these days of Purim should never cease to be celebrated by the Jews, nor should the memory of them die out among their descendants.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebiombe ebio bi’abarendi b’ebiita amo nabatang’ani babo nigo babegetwe gokora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene buna Abalawi bamwabo barenge gokora.
english: These divisions of the gatekeepers, through their chief men, had duties for ministering in the temple of the LORD, just as their relatives had.

ekegusii: These double calamities have come upon you-- who can comfort you?--ruin and destruction, famine and sword-- who can console you?
english: Amang’ana aya abere akonyorire: Ogosirigwa na ogotigwa bosa, ogoitwa nenchara na emioro. Ning’o orakororere amabeebe? Gose ning’o orakoremie?

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bane nigo barenge ab’ororeria rw’amamonto korwa Gati. Barabwo nigo baitetwe na Daudi na abanto baye.
english: These four were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.

ekegusii: Abagadi aba nigo barenge abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi, na oyo otarenge ne chinguru nigo are konyara kobua abanto rigana erimo, na oyorenge ne chinguru nigo are konyara kobua abanto elifu eyemo.
english: These Gadites were army commanders; the least was a match for a hundred, and the greatest for a thousand.

ekegusii: Igo okwegena kwaino, gakoratenene ase ogoteemwa, kore kwe rigori rinene kobua etahabu egosira (nonya egoteemwa ase omorero) naende konyorekane kogwenerete ogotogigwa, na obonene, na ogosikwa ase okoorokigwa kwa Yeso Kristo.
english: These have come so that your faith-- of greater worth than gold, which perishes even though refined by fire-- may be proved genuine and may result in praise, glory and honor when Jesus Christ is revealed.

ekegusii: abwo bonsi nimbarente ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, mbakore babe nomogoko ime ase enyomba yane y’ogosaba. Ekero barabe bakorua ebing’wanso biabo bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde, igoro ase egesasimero kiane, nimbianchere, ekiagera enyomba yane nerokwe enyomba y’ogosaba ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.”
english: these I will bring to my holy mountain and give them joy in my house of prayer. Their burnt offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on my altar; for my house will be called a house of prayer for all nations."

ekegusii: Abanto aba nebitare bikogocha ase emeyega yaino y’obwanchani, kobagokora emeyega amo nainwe batari nokoiroka, bakwerisia barabwo abanyene. Abanto aba namare atari nembura akoirwa nembeo, na emete yaarorokire amato etari namatunda, yakure ara kabere, na gosimorwa kegima.
english: These men are blemishes at your love feasts, eating with you without the slightest qualm-- shepherds who feed only themselves. They are clouds without rain, blown along by the wind; autumn trees, without fruit and uprooted-- twice dead.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bare abemurungania na abereri, kobagotunyana okogania kwabo okobe, na emenwa yabo ekwana amang’ana ’oboenenu amanene mono, bagotogia abanto ase engencho y’okwenyorera.
english: These men are grumblers and faultfinders; they follow their own evil desires; they boast about themselves and flatter others for their own advantage.

ekegusii: Taibo buna mokagete; abanto aba tibatindeti, ekiagera bono nechinsa isato chioka chia mobaso,
english: These men are not drunk, as you suppose. It's only nine in the morning!

ekegusii: Abanto aba nechinsoko chitari namache na amare akoirwa nomwaga, bagacheirwe obomwamu bw’omosunte.
english: These men are springs without water and mists driven by a storm. Blackest darkness is reserved for them.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bare nokobua gosieka igoro, erinde embura tetwa amatuko ’obobani bwabo, naende mbare nokobua gw’okoonchora amache abe amanyinga, na goaka ense ase kera ogoakwa, koreng’ana buna baganetie.
english: These men have power to shut up the sky so that it will not rain during the time they are prophesying; and they have power to turn the waters into blood and to strike the earth with every kind of plague as often as they want.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoboera goitera amanyinga abo abanyene, baumokera obogima bwabo abanyene.
english: These men lie in wait for their own blood; they waylay only themselves!

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene akabaaka noborwaire bogoita, na barabwo bagakwera agwo ase obosio bwaye.
english: these men responsible for spreading the bad report about the land were struck down and died of a plague before the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo baonchoire obotuko bwabeire omobaso; nigo bagoteba ng’a omobaso nigo ore ang’e, korende omosunte noreo.
english: These men turn night into day; in the face of darkness they say, 'Light is near.'

ekegusii: Abanto aba bagatang’ana, bagatoganyera Teroa.
english: These men went on ahead and waited for us at Troas.

ekegusii: bakabora: Abwo ba nyuma nigo bakora emeremo y’ensa eyemo yoka, na aye kwabatoreng’aneria naintwe abatwaremereretie emechando ne riberera ri’omobaso bwonsi.
english: 'These men who were hired last worked only one hour,' they said, 'and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the work and the heat of the day.'

ekegusii: Amatuko aya Amanene nigo amentirwe ase Chisabato chiane chia botambe, naende amentirwe ase ebiegwa biaino, na ase ebing’wanso bie chiira mwariete, na ebi’ogwancha, mokomoruera Omonene.
english: These offerings are in addition to those for the LORD's Sabbaths and in addition to your gifts and whatever you have vowed and all the freewill offerings you give to the LORD.)

ekegusii: Emiaro eria nigo yarenge emetambe, ne chinsinyo chiabo chikarorekana korwa Aase Aachenu ase oyo oteneine bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono, korende tiyarenge kororekana korwa isiko; nero nao ere agwo goika rero iga.
english: These poles were so long that their ends could be seen from the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.

ekegusii: Emiaro eria nigo yarenge emetambe, goika chinsinyo chiabo chikarorekana korwa Aase Aachenu bosio bw’Aase Aachenu Mono, korende tiyarenge kororekana korwa isiko; ero nao ere goika rero.
english: These poles were so long that their ends, extending from the ark, could be seen from in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from outside the Holy Place; and they are still there today.

ekegusii: Nabarabwo bakagenda bagatebia abande amang’ana aria, korende abwo tibabegena.
english: These returned and reported it to the rest; but they did not believe them either.

ekegusii: Abwo bakariga‐rigia korwa ase emeroberio ye chinderia gose mbanyore chisokoro chiabo, korende tichianyoretwe chirikire aroro. Ase ayio bakaangwa tibaba abakuani, ekiagera nigo babaretwe koba abatachenegeti.
english: These searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.

ekegusii: Abwo bakariga-rigia korwa ase emeroberio ye chinderia gose mbanyore chisokoro chiabo, korende tichianyoretwe chirikire aroro. Ase ayio bakaangwa tibaba abakuani, ekiagera nigo babaretwe koba abatachenegeti.
english: These searched for their family records, but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean.

ekegusii: Emechie eyio etano nomo ebe ey’obotamero ase Abaisraeli, na ase abageni bagoeta, na ase abanto bare abamenyi ase egati yabo, erinde monto onde bwensi oraite omonto mosiabano atancheti atamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio.
english: These six towns will be a place of refuge for Israelites, aliens and any other people living among them, so that anyone who has killed another accidentally can flee there.

ekegusii: Emechie eyio morachore ebe ey’obotamero nigo erabe etano nomo.
english: These six towns you give will be your cities of refuge.

ekegusii: Abamura aba batano nomo nabwo Daudi aiboreretwe agwo Heburoni, aroro agwo ase agambete ase engaki y’emiaka etano, na ebere, na emetienyi etano nomo. Daudi akaba okogamba agwo Yerusalemu emiaka emerongo etato, na etato.
english: These six were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years,

ekegusii: ebitinya ebio bionsi bakabibeka igoro ase amataana, na Haroni akabisambera ase egesasimero,
english: these they laid on the breasts, and then Aaron burned the fat on the altar.

ekegusii: Naki aya nigo akoregete erinde ririko riikerane, eriatebete, “Riuga riaye tirikobunwa.”
english: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: "Not one of his bones will be broken,"

ekegusii: Aya agakoreka asebare buna ekiorokererio, akarikwa ase ogotokurera intwe abatogocherwa nomoerio bw’ense.
english: These things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come.

ekegusii: Nigo nkoumora ayare ase omoyo one ime, ekero nkoinyora amang’ana aetire, buna narenge kogenda amo nomoganda bw’abanto gochia ase enyomba ya Nyasae, nkaba ngotera nomogoko neriogi rinene na koiraneria ng’a mbuya mono amo nabwo barenge koinyora na korenda Rituko Rinene.
english: These things I remember as I pour out my soul: how I used to go with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God, with shouts of joy and thanksgiving among the festive throng.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo agokwanwa buna omoreng’anio. Abakungu aba nabwo amabwatano abere. Okomo nigo gokorwa egetunwa Sinai, gokoibora abana ase obosomba; nere Hagari.
english: These things may be taken figuratively, for the women represent two covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai and bears children who are to be slaves: This is Hagar.

ekegusii: Kwabeire gokona‐gokora ayio, nainche nkirete‐kiri, nigo okagete ng’a inche nigo inde buna aye. Korende bono nkogotogonyera nde na kobeka ayio ase obosio bwao.
english: These things you have done and I kept silent; you thought I was altogether like you. But I will rebuke you and accuse you to your face.

ekegusii: Emechie eyio amo nebichie biabo nigo yaatananetwe ase kera eamate y’egesaku kia Gadi ebe omwando obo.
english: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Gadites, clan by clan.

ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri.
english: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Asher, clan by clan.

ekegusii: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, clan by clan.
english: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Dani.

ekegusii: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, clan by clan.
english: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate ch’egesaku gia Isakaru.

ekegusii: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali, clan by clan.
english: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nero omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali.

ekegusii: Emechie eyio, amo nebichie biabo, nigo biarenge omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni.
english: These towns and their villages were the inheritance of Zebulun, clan by clan.

ekegusii: Aba ikomi na babere Yeso akabatoma, akabachika, “Timogenda enchera ende yonsi y’abanto b’Ebisaku, nonya nomochie bw’Abasamaria timosoa onde bwonsi,
english: These twelve Jesus sent out with the following instructions: "Do not go among the Gentiles or enter any town of the Samaritans.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebio bibere na ekeng’ese, barabwo konya banyorire omwando obo moocha ya Yorodan, kororia Yeriko.”
english: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan of Jericho, toward the sunrise."

ekegusii: Abanto aba bonsi babereirwe kirori goetera ase okwegena kwabo, korende tibanyora ayabarieretwe eira,
english: These were all commended for their faith, yet none of them received what had been promised.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo barenge ab’ororeria rw’amamonto korwa Gati. Abwo nigo Daudi na abanto baye babaitete.
english: These were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.

ekegusii: akabakania tibaira gento ase orogendo rwabo, otatiga cnyimbo yoka. Tibaira nonya nomogati, nonya nesaro, nonya nechibesa ase ebimoya biabo.
english: These were his instructions: "Take nothing for the journey except a staff-- no bread, no bag, no money in your belts.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abagambi korwa ase ororeria rw’Esau. Basinto b’Elifasi, omomura omotangi bw’Esau, nabwo aba: Omogambi Temani, na omogambi Omari, na omogambi Sefo, na omogambi Kenasi,
english: These were the chiefs among Esau's descendants: The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abagambi barwete ase ororeria rwa Esau, gotunyana chiamate chiabo, na aase bamenyete nigo are namarieta abo: Omogambi Timuna, na omogambi Aliva, na omogambi Yeteti,
english: These were the chiefs descended from Esau, by name, according to their clans and regions: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto abanene chituoni ba Daudi, baria bamosiirete bokong’u ase oboruoti bwaye, amo n’Abaisraeli bonsi bakamobeka akaba omoruoti, koreng’ana ne ring’ana ri’Omonene igoro y’Abaisraeli.
english: These were the chiefs of David's mighty men-- they, together with all Israel, gave his kingship strong support to extend it over the whole land, as the LORD had promised--

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro ba Silpa, oyio Labani aete Lea, omwana oye omosubati. Abwo Silpa aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na batano nomo.
english: These were the children born to Jacob by Zilpah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Leah-- sixteen in all.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Aseri. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na isato, na amagana ane (53,400).
english: These were the clans of Asher; those numbered were 53,400.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamin. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano, na amagana atano na rimo (45,600).
english: These were the clans of Benjamin; those numbered were 45,600.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Efraimu. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etato na ibere, na amagana atano (32,500). Aba nabwo barenge abana ba Yusufu ne chiamate chiabo.
english: These were the clans of Ephraim; those numbered were 32,500. These were the descendants of Joseph by their clans.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Gadi. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifi emerongo ene, na amagana atano (40,500).
english: These were the clans of Gad; those numbered were 40,500.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Isakaru. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo na inye, na amagana atato (64,300).
english: These were the clans of Issachar; those numbered were 64,300.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na ebere na isano nemo, na amagana atano (76,500).
english: These were the clans of Judah; those numbered were 76,500.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiarenge chiamate chi’egesaku kia Manase. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano na ibere, na amagana atano na abere (52,700).
english: These were the clans of Manasseh; those numbered were 52,700.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Nafutali. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isano, na amagana ane (45,400).
english: These were the clans of Naphtali; those numbered were 45,400.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku kia Reuben. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ene na isato, na amagana atano na abere, na emerongo etato (43,730).
english: These were the clans of Reuben; those numbered were 43,730.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Simeoni. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere, na amagana abere (22,200).
english: These were the clans of Simeon; there were 22,200 men.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chiamate chi’egesaku gia Sabuloni. Ababaretwe nigo barenge chilifu emerongo etano nomo, na amagana atano (60,500).
english: These were the clans of Zebulun; those numbered were 60,500.

ekegusii: These were the descendants of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
english: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Haroni: Eleazari omomura oye, na Finehasi omomura oye, na Abisua omomura oye,

ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Kalebu. Abana abamura ba Huri, omwana omomura omotangi bw’Efarata, nabwo aba; Sobali, ise abanto ba Kiriati‐Yearimu,
english: These were the descendants of Caleb. The sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Dani nigo chiarenge chiamate chi’Abasuhamu, abarwete ase Suhamu. Aba nabwo abanto b’egesaku kia Dani ase chiamate chiabo.
english: These were the descendants of Dan by their clans: through Shuham, the Shuhamite clan. These were the clans of Dan:

ekegusii: Abana abamura b’Ehudi nigo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo, echio chiamenyete Geba. Barabwo bagooswa, bakairwa ase ense ya Manahati.
english: These were the descendants of Ehud, who were heads of families of those living in Geba and were deported to Manahath:

ekegusii: Ase egesaku gi’Efraimu nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abasutela, abarwete ase Sutela, na Ababekeri, abarwete ase Bekeri, na Abatahani, abarwete ase Tahani.
english: These were the descendants of Ephraim by their clans: through Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; through Beker, the Bekerite clan; through Tahan, the Tahanite clan.

ekegusii: Ase ororeria rwa Gileadi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abaieseri, abarwete ase Ieseri, na Abaheleki, abarwete ase Heleki,
english: These were the descendants of Gilead: through Iezer, the Iezerite clan; through Helek, the Helekite clan;

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Lawi ase chiamate chiabo amo nabateneneri be chiamate chiria, buna barigetwe kera oyomo ase erieta riaye. Abwo nigo barenge nemiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, na nigo baisanerete gokora emeremo y’obokoreri bw’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: These were the descendants of Levi by their families-- the heads of families as they were registered under their names and counted individually, that is, the workers twenty years old or more who served in the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Sutela nigo arenge ise Erani, na korwa asare nao Abaerani barwete.
english: These were the descendants of Shuthelah: through Eran, the Eranite clan.

ekegusii: Ebi nabio biarenge ebiombe bi’abarendi b’ebiita korwa ase abanto b’ororeria rwa Kora na orwa Merari.
english: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers who were descendants of Korah and Merari.

ekegusii: Ebi nabio ebiombe bi’abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni. Abana abamura ba Haroni nabwo aba: Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Itamari.
english: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron: The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chiabo: Eferi na Ishi, Elieli na Asirieli, Yeremia na Hodawia, na Yadieli. Abwo nabanto chituoni bachiete nkuma ase okorwana esegi.
english: These were the heads of their families: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah and Jahdiel. They were brave warriors, famous men, and heads of their families.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge emetwe ye chiamate chiabo. Abana abamura ba Reuben, omomura omotangi o Israeli, nabwo aba: Hanoki, na Palu, na Hezironi, na Karimi. Aba nabwo chiamate chia Reuben.
english: These were the heads of their families: The sons of Reuben the firstborn son of Israel were Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi. These were the clans of Reuben.

ekegusii: Na abagambi barwete ase Abahori nabwo aba: Omogambi Lotani, na omogambi Sobali, na omogambi Sibeoni, na omogambi Ana,
english: These were the Horite chiefs: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

ekegusii: Na abaruoti abagamberete ense y’Edomu ritang’ani moruoti onde bwensi ataragambera Abaisraeli nabwo aba:
english: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned:

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abaruoti bagamberete ense y’Abaedomu, ekero omoruoti onde bwensi konya ataragambera Abaisraeli: Bela, mosinto o Beori, oyio omochie oye orenge korokwa Dinihaba.
english: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned: Bela son of Beor, whose city was named Dinhabah.

ekegusii: Ase egesaku kia Lawi nigo chiarenge chiamate echi: Abagerisoni, abarwete ase Gerisoni, na Abakohati, abarwete ase Kohati, na Abamerari, abarwete ase Merari.
english: These were the Levites who were counted by their clans: through Gershon, the Gershonite clan; through Kohath, the Kohathite clan; through Merari, the Merarite clan.

ekegusii: Ebitongwa ebio nabio biria naroche bire inse ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli ang’e norooche rwa Kebari, na nkamanya ng’a abwo nabakerubi barenge.
english: These were the living creatures I had seen beneath the God of Israel by the Kebar River, and I realized that they were cherubim.

ekegusii: Echi nachio chinsemo abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni b’eamate ya Kohati bamenyete ase chingongo chiabo. Obomera bwe ritang’ani bokabagwera;
english: These were the locations of their settlements allotted as their territory (they were assigned to the descendants of Aaron who were from the Kohathite clan, because the first lot was for them):

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo barenge abateneneri ase ebisaku ebio biabo, naende abatang’ani be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bachoretwe korwa ase omoganda bwonsi.
english: These were the men appointed from the community, the leaders of their ancestral tribes. They were the heads of the clans of Israel.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo barigetwe na Musa, na Haroni, na abatang’ani b’Abaisraeli ikomi na babere, abatenenerete kera oyomo egesaku kiaye.
english: These were the men counted by Moses and Aaron and the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.

ekegusii: Daudi nigo amenyete Sikilagi, ekero arenge kwebisa korwa ase Saulo, mosinto o Kisi. Abanto chituoni abarenge komokonya ase esegi bagacha asare.
english: These were the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was banished from the presence of Saul son of Kish (they were among the warriors who helped him in battle;

ekegusii: Abanto aba bakaba bagokora emeremo y’omoruoti amo na baria bande abegete ase emechie yagiteire chindwaki ase ense yonsi y’Abayuda.
english: These were the men who served the king, besides those he stationed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.

ekegusii: These were the names of the Gershonite clans: Libni and Shimei.
english: Abamura ba Gerisoni nabwo Libini na Simei.

ekegusii: Aya naro amarieta ’abamura ba Lawi, buna batunyaine ase okoiborwa kwabo: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari. Lawi nigo akoorete emiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etato, na etano na ebere (137).
english: These were the names of the sons of Levi according to their records: Gershon, Kohath and Merari. Levi lived 137 years.

ekegusii: Lawi nigo abwate abamura batato: Gerisoni, na Kohati, na Merari.
english: These were the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

ekegusii: Omobaro bwonsi bw’ebinto biaruetwe nabatang’ani b’Abaisraeli ase ogwatananwa kw’egesasimero ase rituko riria kiaagetwe amaguta nigo biabete iga: Chisani ikomi na ibere chiaroisirie korwa ase chifeta, na ebitaabo ikomi na bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chifeta, na ebitaabo ikomi na bibere biaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu.
english: These were the offerings of the Israelite leaders for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver plates, twelve silver sprinkling bowls and twelve gold dishes.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’abakuani na Abalawi abairanete korwa ase obosomba amo na Serubabeli, mosinto o Sealitieli, na Yesua. Abakuani nabwo aba: Seraya, na Yeremia na Ezara;
english: These were the priests and Levites who returned with Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and with Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro abamura Bilia aiborerete Yakobo, abanto batano na babere.
english: These were the sons born to Jacob by Bilhah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Rachel-- seven in all.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana abamura Lea aiborerete Yakobo agwo Padan‐Aramu. Na omoiseke oyomo aiborete, nere Dina. Abana baye bonsi amo nabachokoro, abamura na abaiseke, nigo barenge emerongo etato na batato.
english: These were the sons Leah bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, besides his daughter Dinah. These sons and daughters of his were thirty-three in all.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge basinto b’Abihaili, mosinto o Huri o Yaroa, o Gileadi, o Mikaeli, o Yesisai, o Yado, o Busi.
english: These were the sons of Abihail son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.

ekegusii: These were the sons of David born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon the son of Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second, Daniel the son of Abigail of Carmel;
english: Aba nabwo abamura ba Daudi, abwo baiboretwe asare agwo Heburoni: Amunoni, omomura oye omotangi, oiboretwe n’Ahinoamu orwete Yesireeli, na oyo o kabere Danieli, oiboretwe n’Abigaeli orwete Karimeli;

ekegusii: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.
english: Aba nabwo basinto b’Esau, nere Edomu; naba nabwo abagambi babo.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abana abamura b’Etamu: Yesireeli na Isima, na Idibasi, na omoiseke omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Haseleliponi.
english: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. Their sister was named Hazzelelponi.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana ba Isumaeli, na aya naro amarieta abo ase emechie yabo na ebitwori biabo, na barabwo nigo barenge abagambi ikomi na babere, ase ebisaku biabo.
english: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these are the names of the twelve tribal rulers according to their settlements and camps.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abana abamura ba Israeli: Reuben, na Simeoni, Lawi na Yuda, Isakaru na Sabuloni,
english: These were the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abamura na abachokoro Raeli aiborerete Yakobo, abanto ikomi na bane.
english: These were the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob-- fourteen in all.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo basinto ba Seiri Omohori, ababiare b’ense eria: Lotani, na Sobali, na Sibeoni, na Ana,
english: These were the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the region: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

ekegusii: Aba batato nabwo barenge abana ba Nuhu, na korwa ase abwo mwanyabanto bakaranda ase ense engima.
english: These were the three sons of Noah, and from them came the people who were scattered over the earth.

ekegusii: Aya naro amache a Meriba aase Abaisraeli baamereranetie n’Omonene, na ere akeorokia ng’a nomochenu are ase egati yabo.”
english: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD and where he showed himself holy among them.

ekegusii: These were their descendants: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
english: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rwabo. Omwana omomura omotangi o Isumaeli nere Nebayoti; na abande nabwo aba: Kedari na Adibeeli, na Mibusamu;

ekegusii: Abanto aba abanyabibe bangire koigwera amang’ana aane; babwatirie ebirengererio bie chinkoro chiabo chi’oboenenu, batunyanire chinyasae ching’ao, naende nachio bagokorera na gochisasima. Ase ayio nababe buna orokini orwo rore bosa, rotagwenereti kende gionsi.
english: These wicked people, who refuse to listen to my words, who follow the stubbornness of their hearts and go after other gods to serve and worship them, will be like this belt-- completely useless!

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika igoro y’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na egi’okorongeyia okomocha, na eki’ogosungusigwa, na eki’omorembe.
english: These, then, are the regulations for the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering and the fellowship offering,

ekegusii: These, then, are the things you should teach. Encourage and rebuke with all authority. Do not let anyone despise you.
english: Kwana amang’ana aya, kurera, na gotogonyera nokobua gwonsi. Monto onde bwensi tagochaya.

ekegusii: Abanto bagatiga enyomba y’Omonene, na Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, bagakorera emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, na emegwekano ende y’ogosasimwa. Ase ayio endamwamu y’Omonene egacha igoro ase Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu ase engencho y’okomocha kwabo.
english: They abandoned the temple of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and worshiped Asherah poles and idols. Because of their guilt, God's anger came upon Judah and Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakoyeooma ne chifeta ne chitahabu, bayeakerania bokong’u nenyundo na emesumari, erinde tenyegerigwa.
english: They adorn it with silver and gold; they fasten it with hammer and nails so it will not totter.

ekegusii: Nigo bakobagora aase aagare banchichera ne chinguru, erio bang’umokera goetera ase omogwa oyio babagoire.
english: They advance as through a gaping breach; amid the ruins they come rolling in.

ekegusii: Naende bakagenda korwania Abakanani abamenyete ase omochie o Heburoni, oyio orenge korokwa Kiriati‐Ariba agwo ritang’ani. Bakabua Sesai, na Ahimani, na Talimai.
english: They advanced against the Canaanites living in Hebron (formerly called Kiriath Arba) and defeated Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.

ekegusii: Bakabora bonsi, “Aye naye Omwana o Nyasae.” Akabatebia, “Inwe mwatebire ng’a ninche ere.”
english: They all asked, "Are you then the Son of God?" He replied, "You are right in saying I am."

ekegusii: They all ate and were satisfied,
english: Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota.

ekegusii: Bakaria bonsi, bakaigota. Bagasangereria ebisamunye bi’emegati ebiatigarete, ebitonga ikomi na bibere biichire.
english: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria, bakaigota. Na ebisamunye biria biatigarete bigasangererigwa, bigaichora ebitonga ikomi na bibere.
english: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

ekegusii: Bakaria bonsi, bakaigota; bagasangereria ebisamunye bi’emegati ebiatigarete, ebitonga bitano na bibere biichire.
english: They all ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.

ekegusii: Bonsi bakaria endagera eria eria y’omoika.
english: They all ate the same spiritual food

ekegusii: Ase igo Abayahudi abwo bonsi bakairana korwa ase chinsemo chionsi echio ase konya baserigwe gochia, bagacha ase ense yabo, ase Gedalia agwo Misipa. Aroro agwo bagasangereria na kogacha edivai na amatunda ay’ekero ki’omorakeera.
english: they all came back to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah at Mizpah, from all the countries where they had been scattered. And they harvested an abundance of wine and summer fruit.

ekegusii: “Abanto abwo bonsi nigo bagocha gokora ay’obotindi. Nigo bakorigereria gochia bosio bare nomokia buna omwaga okorwa moocha; nigo bagosangereria abasibwa abange buna omokenye.
english: they all come bent on violence. Their hordes advance like a desert wind and gather prisoners like sand.

ekegusii: ekiagera aba bonsi nigo babeka korwa ase obonge bw’enibo yabo; korende oyo ase obotaka bwaye obekire bionsi ebiarenge nabio, nonya nenibo y’obogima bwaye bwonsi.”
english: They all gave out of their wealth; but she, out of her poverty, put in everything-- all she had to live on."

ekegusii: Abaiga bonsi nigo bagendererete nogosaba ase omoyo oyomo, amo nabakungu bande, na Mariamu ng’ina Yeso, na bamura bamwabo Yeso.
english: They all joined together constantly in prayer, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo, kobagosoka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.”
english: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao berusirie moyo kobagosoka korwa ase chiburi chiabo, nigo bakoiguswa.
english: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

ekegusii: Bakabwatana amo bakabekana omokia, erinde bagende bonsi amo ase okorwania Yerusalemu na koburukania abakori emeremo.
english: They all plotted together to come and fight against Jerusalem and stir up trouble against it.

ekegusii: Na bonsi bakaiyeria amariga, bakaboania Paulo rigoti riaye, bakamonyunyunta.
english: They all wept as they embraced him and kissed him.

ekegusii: Barabwo babeire ang’e gonsiria aiga ase ense, nonya naboigo, tintigeti amachiko ao.
english: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbasoe ase enyomba yane enchenu, bache ang’e nemesa yane bankorere, naende bagenderere korenda amang’ana aane nachikire.
english: They alone are to enter my sanctuary; they alone are to come near my table to minister before me and perform my service.

ekegusii: Naende bakaboria iga, “Abaagachi b’oboagacho obo, naki bakorokwa?”
english: They also asked, "What are the names of the men constructing this building?"

ekegusii: Bagatagora na gosaria chiema chi’abanto baria babwate chitugo, bakaira ching’ondi ne chimbori chinyinge ne chingamia. Erio bakairana, bakagenda Yerusalemu.
english: They also attacked the camps of the herdsmen and carried off droves of sheep and goats and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Naende bagatoma abakori emeremo be Hekalu amagana abere, na emerongo ebere (220), ekeombe kere buna Daudi na abakonyi baye bachorete gokonya Abalawi ase emeremo yabo. Abwo bonsi nigo batoretwe ase amarieta abo.
english: They also brought 220 of the temple servants-- a body that David and the officials had established to assist the Levites. All were registered by name.

ekegusii: naende ebinto bie rimisu rigiya amo namaguta e chitaya, na amaguta akweakwa, na ubani ere ne rimisu rigiya.
english: They also brought spices and olive oil for the light and for the anointing oil and for the fragrant incense.

ekegusii: Kera omonto nigo arenge korenta esairi na obonyansi aase biaganeirie ase chibarasi chiare kong’usa chigari amo ne chibarasi chinde.
english: They also brought to the proper place their quotas of barley and straw for the chariot horses and the other horses.

ekegusii: Bakabwata abagambi babere b’Abamidiani, Orebu na Seebu. Bagaitera Orebu ase Egetare ki’Orebu, na Seebu bakamoitera ase ekemitero ki’edivai gia Seebu, na bakagenderera kobwatia Abamidiani. Omotwe bw’Orebu na oyo o Seebu bakayeirera Gidioni aase arenge, moocha ya Yorodan.
english: They also captured two of the Midianite leaders, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb at the winepress of Zeeb. They pursued the Midianites and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon, who was by the Jordan.

ekegusii: Naboigo bagoosa Loti, omwana omomura omwabo Aburamu, oyomenyete agwo Sodomu, bakamoira amo nenibo yaye.
english: They also carried off Abram's nephew Lot and his possessions, since he was living in Sodom.

ekegusii: Abateneneri abwo be chiamate chiabo, abatang’ani amo nabamwabo abake, bagaaka obomera buna abamwabo, abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni, ekero Daudi omoruoti, na Zadoki, na Ahimeleki, na abatang’ani be chiamate chi’abakuani na echi’Abalawi barigereretie. Oyorenge omonene ase eamate ogaakerwa obomera koreng’ana buna oyorenge omoke.
english: They also cast lots, just as their brothers the descendants of Aaron did, in the presence of King David and of Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites. The families of the oldest brother were treated the same as those of the youngest.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakarenta amang’ana arigetwe nomoruoti, bakayaa abagambi abanene ase oboruoti, na abagavuna b’orogongo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, barabwo bonsi bakaba bagokonya abanto, bagakonya nenyomba ya Nyasae.
english: They also delivered the king's orders to the royal satraps and to the governors of Trans-Euphrates, who then gave assistance to the people and to the house of God.

ekegusii: Tibakorerete abanto b’eamate ya Yerubi‐Baali (nere Gidioni) amaya, ase okoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono ase amaya onsi akorerete Abaisraeli.
english: They also failed to show kindness to the family of Jerub-Baal (that is, Gideon) for all the good things he had done for them.

ekegusii: Bagachia abasenia be chibao, na abaagachi bagore amagena abaachire, amo nemete y’okoroiseria emeriibo, na emiamba, ase okoagacha amaagacho aria abaruoti b’Abayuda batigete agatagoka.
english: They also gave money to the carpenters and builders to purchase dressed stone, and timber for joists and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had allowed to fall into ruin.

ekegusii: They also killed Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,
english: Bagaita Parisanidata, na Dalifoni, na Asipata;

ekegusii: Bakaira abasacha, na abakungu, na abana, na abaiseke b’omoruoti, na kera omonto Nebusaradani, omochiki bw’abarendi, atigete ase oborendi bwa Gedalia mosinto bw’Ahikamu, omochokoro o Safani; bakaira na Yeremia omobani, na Baruku, mosinto o Neria.
english: They also led away all the men, women and children and the king's daughters whom Nebuzaradan commander of the imperial guard had left with Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, and Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch son of Neriah.

ekegusii: They also made around it a rim a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
english: Erio agakora orosingo rore nobogare bong’ana egesanyi gi’okoboko, na akaroetanania omong’ororia bw’etahabu.

ekegusii: They also made crossbars of acacia wood: five for the frames on one side of the tabernacle,
english: Bakabaacha emeriibo etano y’emekonge, eriibe chibao chie rikere erimo ri’Obomenyo,

ekegusii: Bagakora ebioro emerongo etano, bakabibeka ase egetambaa kegochakera rirondia rie ritang’ani, na emerongo etano ase egetambaa kegokoorera rirondia ria kabere. Ebioro bia kera rirondia bigachikana.
english: They also made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the end curtain of the other set, with the loops opposite each other.

ekegusii: Naende akaroisia amaguta amachenu akweakwa, na ubani echenire are ne rimisu rigiya, akayaroisia buna omoroisia, oyomanyete buya, aranyare koyaroisia.
english: They also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense-- the work of a perfumer.

ekegusii: Naende bakamotebia, “Nigo twachire tobe abamenyi b’ense eye, ekiagera intwe, abasomba bao, titori naase tokorisia amaicho aito, ekiagera enchara nenene mono ase ense ya Kanani. Ase igo koranche otoe intwe, abasomba bao, ribaga tomenye ase ensemo ya Goseni.”
english: They also said to him, "We have come to live here awhile, because the famine is severe in Canaan and your servants' flocks have no pasture. So now, please let your servants settle in Goshen."

ekegusii: Barabwo bakeagachera aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, ne chisiiro, na emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, igoro ase ebigoro bionsi na inse ya kera omote omobese.
english: They also set up for themselves high places, sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.

ekegusii: Bagasieka ebisieri bi’enyomba yaagachire bosio bwe Hekalu yabwateranirie nero, na bakarimia chitaya, na tibasambete ubani gose tibaruete ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ime y’Aase Aachenu, ase Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: They also shut the doors of the portico and put out the lamps. They did not burn incense or present any burnt offerings at the sanctuary to the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Boigo bakaira chindogio, na ebichiko, na ebinachi, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, na ebikorero bionsi bie chitaai biarenge gokorerwa emeremo ase hekalu.
english: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.

ekegusii: Boigo bakaira chindogio, na ebichiko, na ebinachi, ne chisani, na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, na ebikorero bionsi bie chitaai biarenge gokorerwa emeremo ase Hekalu.
english: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, sprinkling bowls, dishes and all the bronze articles used in the temple service.

ekegusii: Bakaira chitugo chiabo ne chinibo chiabo echi baniberete ase ense ya Kanani. Nabo bagaika Misiri, Yakobo na oroiboro rwaye rwonsi amo nere,
english: They also took with them their livestock and the possessions they had acquired in Canaan, and Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt.

ekegusii: Ase igo barabwo amo nabamura be chinderia chiabo bakagenderera korenda ebiita bi’enyomba y’Omonene, nero Eema eria.
english: They and their descendants were in charge of guarding the gates of the house of the LORD-- the house called the Tent.

ekegusii: Bakagechia Omonene ase engencho y’aase abo aimokererete igoro bagosasimera, na ekiagera basasimete emegwekano, Omonene akaba ne risemi.
english: They angered him with their high places; they aroused his jealousy with their idols.

ekegusii: Bakabatebia buna Yeso abachigete; na abwo bakabatiga bagende.
english: They answered as Jesus had told them to, and the people let them go.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamotebia, “Kirakiri! Tokwana nonya ne ring’ana erimo! Inchuo amo naintwe, obe asetore buna tata, obe omokuani oito! Inee! Inki kere buya kobua asore, koba omokuani ase enyomba y’omonto oyomo, gose ase egesaku ekegima ki’Abaisraeli?”
english: They answered him, "Be quiet! Don't say a word. Come with us, and be our father and priest. Isn't it better that you serve a tribe and clan in Israel as priest rather than just one man's household?"

ekegusii: They answered him, "We are Abraham's descendants and have never been slaves of anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?"
english: Bakamoiraneria, “Igo tore oroiboro rwa Ibrahimu, na titoraba abasomba b’omonto kero kende gionsi, naki rende ogoteba: Namokorwe abasibore?”

ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria Yoshua, “Omonene, nigo twakorire aya, ekiagera twatebetigwe na koenekerigwa ng’a Omonene. Nyasae oo, nachigete Musa, omosomba oye, abae ense eye engima na gosiria bonsi abamenyete aa. Ase ayio tokaondoka, tokaba nobwoba obonene ng’a motoite; ayio akagera togakora aya.
english: They answered Joshua, "Your servants were clearly told how the LORD your God had commanded his servant Moses to give you the whole land and to wipe out all its inhabitants from before you. So we feared for our lives because of you, and that is why we did this.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakairaneria omoruoti, “Omonto oria akarigia gotosiria kegima ng’a titomenya ase Abaisraeli.
english: They answered the king, "As for the man who destroyed us and plotted against us so that we have been decimated and have no place anywhere in Israel,

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Omomisiri oyomo otokonya korwa ase abarisia baria; amo nayio otobuuchera amache na gotonyoiseria riicho riaito.”
english: They answered, "An Egyptian rescued us from the shepherds. He even drew water for us and watered the flock."

ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Imoka, togende korwania abanto baria, ekiagera ntwarora ense eria, ng’a nengiya mono. Inaki mogoikaransa aa bosa? Timobaisa gotebana kogenda aroro na koira ense eria.
english: They answered, "Come on, let's attack them! We have seen that the land is very good. Aren't you going to do something? Don't hesitate to go there and take it over.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakabairaneria, “Onye mokoirania Esanduku eyio ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, timobaisa koyeirania bosa etari nebiegwa; goika momoruere okoruegwa ase engencho y’okomocha. Erio namogwene, naende monyare komanya ng’a nase ki Omonene agendererete kobaa egesusuro.”
english: They answered, "If you return the ark of the god of Israel, do not send it away empty, but by all means send a guilt offering to him. Then you will be healed, and you will know why his hand has not been lifted from you."

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Amaene, twarorire maiso marore ng’a Omonene nigo are amo naye. Na nigo torengereretie ng’a totiananie na tokore okobwatana naye ng’a,
english: They answered, "We saw clearly that the LORD was with you; so we said, 'There ought to be a sworn agreement between us'-- between us and you. Let us make a treaty with you

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Twanchire gokobia.” Erio bakaara egetambaa inse, na ase egetambaa ekio kera oyomo akabeka ebigera biaye bi’amato ebisakorete.
english: They answered, "We'll be glad to give them." So they spread out a garment, and each man threw a ring from his plunder onto it.

ekegusii: Erio bakamoiraneria, “Intwe abasomba bao nigo twarure ense y’aare, twaigure erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oo, buna riakumire. Twaigure amang’ana onsi ayakorete aria Misiri,
english: They answered: "Your servants have come from a very distant country because of the fame of the LORD your God. For we have heard reports of him: all that he did in Egypt,

ekegusii: Barabwo nabanto bakoondokia na kwoboyia; oboronge bwabo na okobua kwabo nigo bikorwa ase barabwo abanyene.
english: They are a feared and dreaded people; they are a law to themselves and promote their own honor.

ekegusii: “Abaisraeli nabanto batancheti gosemigwa, na tibari nobong’aini bonde bwonsi.
english: They are a nation without sense, there is no discernment in them.

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi nigo bare abatomani. Nigo banga buna eriko ri’okogekera emegati riutire omorero, na omoroisia bw’emegati nigo agotiga koigereria omorero goika abe okonyire ribomba ri’obosie na ememera ebe yaribotirie.
english: They are all adulterers, burning like an oven whose fire the baker need not stir from the kneading of the dough till it rises.

ekegusii: Bonsi nigo bare abasaria na abanyabigoti bikong’u; nigo bagotaaria obogenki; nigo bare buna etaai na ekioma, bonsi nigo bagokora ay’ogosaria.
english: They are all hardened rebels, going about to slander. They are bronze and iron; they all act corruptly.

ekegusii: Barabwo bonsi tibamanyeti gento, nabariri bare. Naki ogosemigwa korwa ase emegwekano eyio nemete bosa.
english: They are all senseless and foolish; they are taught by worthless wooden idols.

ekegusii: Emetwe eyio boigo nabaruoti batano na babere. Batano b’abwo baikire kogwa, na oyomo nao are, na oyonde taracha. Nere karache nigo arabeo ekero egeke gioka.
english: They are also seven kings. Five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; but when he does come, he must remain for a little while.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo akogenderera kona‐korua ebiegwa na korua singo, abana baye nigo barasesenigwe.
english: They are always generous and lend freely; their children will be blessed.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagocha babwate amata na amatimo. Nigo bare abatindi batari namabera. Eriogi ri’ebititiro biabo nigo rikoeera buna enyancha ekoeera. Nigo bariinete chibarasi, baroberete buna abanto bagochia korwana esegi, bachire kobarwania inwe abanto ba Sayoni.”
english: They are armed with bow and spear; they are cruel and show no mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, O Daughter of Zion."

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babwate amata na amatimo, nigo bare abatindi, abatari namabera. Amariogi abo nigo akoeera buna okoeera kw’enyancha. Nigo bariinete chibarasi, berobeirie buna omonto bwebekire ang’e ase esegi, erinde babarwanie inwe, abanto ba Babeli.”
english: They are armed with bows and spears; they are cruel and without mercy. They sound like the roaring sea as they ride on their horses; they come like men in battle formation to attack you, O Daughter of Babylon.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baragochwe bagwe inse korende intwe nigo toragororoke totenene boronge.
english: They are brought to their knees and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bararokwe chifeta chiangirwe ekiagera inche Omonene nabangire.”
english: They are called rejected silver, because the LORD has rejected them."

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio mbono atongirwe, tarengeo kare, timwana koyaigwa rinde, otatiga rituko ria rero; igo nario motabaise goteba ng’a nkorwa kare mwayamanyete.
english: They are created now, and not long ago; you have not heard of them before today. So you cannot say, 'Yes, I knew of them.'

ekegusii: Obong’aini bwabo bwabekirwe omosunte, barusananigwe korwa ase obogima bwa Nyasae ekiagera ase ogotamanya koria kore ime asebare ase engencho y’obokong’u bwe chinkoro chiabo.
english: They are darkened in their understanding and separated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them due to the hardening of their hearts.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagoichana, ekiagera tibanyorete eki basemeretie; ekero bachete aase agwo, bakanyora ng’a nigo bang’ainetwe.
english: They are distressed, because they had been confident; they arrive there, only to be disappointed.

ekegusii: Chisese echio nigo chire chindia bobe, tichiri koigota. Na abarisia boigo tibari nobong’aini; bonsi baonchokeire chinchera chiabo, kera oyomo nigo akwerigeria ebitoki korwa ase kera emeremo.
english: They are dogs with mighty appetites; they never have enough. They are shepherds who lack understanding; they all turn to their own way, each seeks his own gain.

ekegusii: Emebere yabo nigo enyiete nembura egotwa ase ebitunwa, erio bamigererania ase chingako chi’ebitare koigama aroro.
english: They are drenched by mountain rains and hug the rocks for lack of shelter.

ekegusii: Tibabwati emechando buna abanto bande babwate; tibari konyora amaakwa buna abande.
english: They are free from the burdens common to man; they are not plagued by human ills.

ekegusii: Omogwekano oyio nigo oruete ase Abaisraeli. Nigo oroisetigwe nomoroisia bw’ebinto, oyio tari oro Nyasae. Omogwekano oria bw’emori ore Samaria nosenyentwe obe ebisamunye.
english: They are from Israel! This calf-- a craftsman has made it; it is not God. It will be broken in pieces, that calf of Samaria.

ekegusii: Abwo nab’ense bare. Ase ayio, ayabagokwana nay’ense, na ense igo ekobaigwa.
english: They are from the world and therefore speak from the viewpoint of the world, and the world listens to them.

ekegusii: Onye bore obonene gochia igoro, inki oranyare gokora? Onye bore obotambe inse gochia aase abakure, inki oranyare komanya?
english: They are higher than the heavens-- what can you do? They are deeper than the depths of the grave--what can you know?

ekegusii: Nigo erinde ribwatanirie nerinde; naro nigo asoaine, takonyara gwatananwa.
english: They are joined fast to one another; they cling together and cannot be parted.

ekegusii: Nigo bakoirwa bare nomogoko na omochengo, erio basoigwa ase enyomba y’omoruoti.
english: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo banga buna endo eganetie orotwari; buna endo ensae eboete ase egesarara.
english: They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a great lion crouching in cover.

ekegusii: Nigo bagwekaine nabana baikaransete ase echiiro, bakorangerania, bakobora,” “Twababugeirie ebiroria, na inwe timotengeti; tweumirie, na inwe timorereti.
english: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to each other: "'We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not cry.'

ekegusii: Ayio onsi nigo are amaya kobua etahabu, ee, kobua etahabu echenire na amansu kobua obooke, ee, kobua richoe ri’obooke.
english: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

ekegusii: nigo bire ebiyia ase kera emambia, ee, obwegenwa bwao nigo bore obonene.
english: They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.

ekegusii: Ayio tari amang’ana a bosa asemore, naro obogima bwaino; na ase okoigwera amang’ana aya namogenderere komenya engaki entambe ase ense eyio mogochia koira ng’umbu ya Yorodan.”
english: They are not just idle words for you-- they are your life. By them you will live long in the land you are crossing the Jordan to possess."

ekegusii: Barabwo tibari ab’ense, buna inche ntari oyo bw’ense.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.

ekegusii: Tibagocha ang’e ase ebinto biane ebichenu, gose ase ebio bire ebichenu mono. Goika berorere obosooku bw’ogokora kwabo gw’okogechia okwo babeire bagokora.
english: They are not to come near to serve me as priests or come near any of my holy things or my most holy offerings; they must bear the shame of their detestable practices.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakure, tibakoba moyo naende, babeire amarengari, tibakoboka; ase ayio kwabaeire egesusuro na kobasiria, kwabasiririe, tibakoinyorwa nonya ng’ake.
english: They are now dead, they live no more; those departed spirits do not rise. You punished them and brought them to ruin; you wiped out all memory of them.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebi nigo biare ase okoria na okonywa, na ogosibigwa ao ao, amachiko ase omobere ayabekire goika engaki y’okoroisigwa okoyia eike.
english: They are only a matter of food and drink and various ceremonial washings-- external regulations applying until the time of the new order.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakobabanera oborimo ase erieta riane, ekiagera inche timbatometi. Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: They are prophesying lies to you in my name. I have not sent them," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: abariri, abatari abegenwa, abatari nobwanchani, abatari namabera.
english: they are senseless, faithless, heartless, ruthless.

ekegusii: Naki eyio nemeika y’ebirecha egokora ebikone, na gosoka gochia ase abaruoti b’ense yonsi kobasangereria ase esegi ase rituko rinene ria Nyasae Omobui.
english: They are spirits of demons performing miraculous signs, and they go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.

ekegusii: Amachiko ayio nigo ateneine bokong’u kare na kare, aikeranigwe ase ekeene na oboronge.
english: They are steadfast for ever and ever, done in faithfulness and uprightness.

ekegusii: Barabwo baruegwe kegima korwa ase Abaisraeli babe abaane, ekiagera nabachorire ribaga ri’abana abatangi b’Abaisraeli.
english: They are the Israelites who are to be given wholly to me. I have taken them as my own in place of the firstborn, the first male offspring from every Israelite woman.

ekegusii: Naki ase egati yabo mbareo abagwesoyia ase chinyomba chi’abanto gosakora abakungu aboro, abare ne chigurube chi’ebibe, na koraagwa nokogania okobe gwe chingencho ao ao.
english: They are the kind who worm their way into homes and gain control over weak-willed women, who are loaded down with sins and are swayed by all kinds of evil desires,

ekegusii: Barabwo nabagokorere, naende bakore emeremo yonsi ase Eema eria, korende tibabaisa goika ang’e ase ebikorero ebichenu bi’Aase Aachenu, gose tibaika ang’e ase egesasimero. Baise gokora igo, aye amo nabarabwo igo morakwe.
english: They are to be responsible to you and are to perform all the duties of the Tent, but they must not go near the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar, or both they and you will die.

ekegusii: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, its covering and the outer covering of hides of sea cows, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
english: Barabwo mbabogorie ebitambaa bi’Obomenyo Obochenu amo nebitubo bi’Eema eria, ne risankwa ri’eng’iti ya rooche rikobituba, na egetambaa ki’egesoero ki’Eema eria,

ekegusii: nigo ararirende ase omotienyi o kabere, rituko ria ikomi na kane, chinsa chia mogoroba. Narie emanwa y’eng’ondi y’Epasaka amo nemegati etabekiri memera, ne chinyeni chindoro.
english: They are to celebrate it on the fourteenth day of the second month at twilight. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

ekegusii: Barabwo barie ebinto ebi biarurwe ase ogokora okobwatanigwa ekero baatananetwe ase emeremo emechenu. Monto onde omoao takoba ne ribaga ri’okobiria, ekiagera ebinto ebi nebichenu.
english: They are to eat these offerings by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration. But no one else may eat them, because they are sacred.

ekegusii: Nigo barabwatane naye na gokora emeremo yabo yonsi y’obokoreri ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Omonto onde omoao otachikiri tabaisa goika ang’e akore emeremo amo nainwe.
english: They are to join you and be responsible for the care of the Tent of Meeting-- all the work at the Tent-- and no one else may come near where you are.

ekegusii: Abalawi abwo mbakorere Haroni emeremo, boigo bakorere omoganda bwonsi agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, ekero bagokora emeremo ase Obomenyo Obochenu.
english: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole community at the Tent of Meeting by doing the work of the tabernacle.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbatenenere ebinto bionsi bire ase Eema y’Omosangererekano. Ase ogokora emeremo yonsi ase Obomenyo Obochenu nigo barabe bagokorera Abaisraeli bonsi.
english: They are to take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, fulfilling the obligations of the Israelites by doing the work of the tabernacle.

ekegusii: “Barabwo mborokererie abanto baane bamanye gwatanana ebinto bire ebichenu na ebitaatananiri koba ebichenu, naende baborokererie bamanye gwatanana ebinto bichenegete na ebitachenegeti.
english: They are to teach my people the difference between the holy and the common and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbabeke ase emetwe yabo ebitambaa biroisirie korwa ase egatani, naende babeke chisirwari chi’egatani; tibakweboeria kende gionsi keragere bagiramore.
english: They are to wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They must not wear anything that makes them perspire.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibabete abegenwa ase Omonene. Nigo baiborete abana batari abaye. Ase ayio, emeyega y’Omotienyi Omoyia nebasirie amo nemeganda yabo.
english: They are unfaithful to the LORD; they give birth to illegitimate children. Now their New Moon festivals will devour them and their fields.

ekegusii: Nigo barenge buna chibarasi chiaragerigwe buya chire nokogania, kera omonto akaba okogania omokungu bw’omogisangio oye.”
english: They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for another man's wife.

ekegusii: Naende barabwo nemerindo y’enyancha etagotangeka, ekoorokia obosooku bwaye enyene buna riuro, ne ching’enang’eni chigoetanana na gosira, na bagacheire obomwamu bw’omosunte goika kare na kare.
english: They are wild waves of the sea, foaming up their shame; wandering stars, for whom blackest darkness has been reserved forever.

ekegusii: Saulo, na bamura bamino, na Abaisraeli bonsi nao bakare ase ense omweremo ya Ela korwana n’Abafilisti.”
english: They are with Saul and all the men of Israel in the Valley of Elah, fighting against the Philistines."

ekegusii: Eyio mbosa kegima, emeremo eyio nesekererwe. Ekero eraegwe egesusuro, nesirigwe kegima.
english: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.

ekegusii: Eyio nigo ere bosa, nesekererwe, ekero eraegwe egesusuro, nesirigwe.
english: They are worthless, the objects of mockery; when their judgment comes, they will perish.

ekegusii: Kobachorire rituko nere, abanto abange mono bagacha asare aase amenyete. Akabatebereria korwa mambia goika mogoroba, na koorokia amang’ana igoro y’oboruoti bwa Nyasae, agateema kobatebereria amang’ana igoro ya Yeso korwa ase amang’ana ’amachiko a Musa na korwa ase ababani.
english: They arranged to meet Paul on a certain day, and came in even larger numbers to the place where he was staying. From morning till evening he explained and declared to them the kingdom of God and tried to convince them about Jesus from the Law of Moses and from the Prophets.

ekegusii: bakabwata abatomwa, bakababeka ase echela ime.
english: They arrested the apostles and put them in the public jail.

ekegusii: Bagaika Yerusalemu naende. Ekero are gotaara Hekalu ime, abakuani abanene, na aborokia b’amariko, na abagaaka bakamochiera,
english: They arrived again in Jerusalem, and while Jesus was walking in the temple courts, the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders came to him.

ekegusii: Bagaika Efeso, akabatiga agwo; ere omonyene agasoa esinagogi, agakwana n’Abayahudi.
english: They arrived at Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He himself went into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.

ekegusii: They asked each other, "Were not our hearts burning within us while he talked with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?"
english: Bakaborania, “Inee! Emioyo yaito tiyarenge gwoka ekero aba ngokwana are naintwe inchera na gotworokereria amariko?”

ekegusii: They asked each other, "Who did this?" When they carefully investigated, they were told, "Gideon son of Joash did it."
english: Barabwo bakaborania, “Ning’o okorete amang’ana aya?” Ekero baare koboria na kouna‐unia, bakanyora ng’a Gidioni, mosinto o Yoashi, nere okorete ayio.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoboria, “Omokungu, inki okorera?” Akabairaneria, “Nekiagera barusirie Omonene one, na timanyeti aase bamobeka.”
english: They asked her, "Woman, why are you crying?" "They have taken my Lord away," she said, "and I don't know where they have put him."

ekegusii: Bakamoboria, “Naki rende? Naye Elija?” Akabora, “Inche tindi ere.” “Aye naye omobani oria?” Akairaneria, “Yaya.”
english: They asked him, "Then who are you? Are you Elijah?" He said, "I am not." "Are you the Prophet?" He answered, "No."

ekegusii: Ekero baboretie eki bakoria, ere agatoma chinkware, boigo akabaigotia nendagera korwa igoro.
english: They asked, and he brought them quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

ekegusii: Bagasangererekana agwo Yerusalemu ase omotienyi o gatato bw’omwaka o ikomi na gatano bw’okogamba gwa Asa.
english: They assembled at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's reign.

ekegusii: Nabarabwo bakaria na konywa ase obosio bw’Omonene ase rituko riria, bakaba nomogoko omonene. Bono eria kabere bakabeka Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, akaba omoruoti obo; bakamoaka amaguta akaba omogambi ase ogokorera Omonene, na Zadoki agaakwa amaguta akaba omokuani.
english: They ate and drank with great joy in the presence of the LORD that day. Then they acknowledged Solomon son of David as king a second time, anointing him before the LORD to be ruler and Zadok to be priest.

ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakaria chinyama bakaigota, ekiagera Nyasae nigo abaete eke basanerete.
english: They ate till they had more than enough, for he had given them what they craved.

ekegusii: chikaria chigakoora ebimeri bi’ense eria, boigo chikaria okwama kwe riroba riabo.
english: they ate up every green thing in their land, ate up the produce of their soil.

ekegusii: Bakagenda ase ense y’Abayuda, bagasoa aroro, bagasakora chinibo chionsi chi’enyomba y’omoruoti, bakaira na abana baye abamura, na abakungu baye, tibatigete nonya nomwana omomura oyomo otatiga Yehoahasi, oria orenge omoke ase abana baye.
english: They attacked Judah, invaded it and carried off all the goods found in the king's palace, together with his sons and wives. Not a son was left to him except Ahaziah, the youngest.

ekegusii: Nigo bakoumokera amo omoyo bw’oyore omonyaboronge, banachera oyotari nokomocha ekina ki’ogokwa.
english: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.

ekegusii: Ekero barenge abaiseke bagakora obonyaka agwo Misiri. Aroro agwo bakaba bakobwatwa‐bwatwa chimbeere chiabo, bagasiria obwekungi bwabo.
english: They became prostitutes in Egypt, engaging in prostitution from their youth. In that land their breasts were fondled and their virgin bosoms caressed.

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o gatato bagachaka korenta ebiegwa ebio, na abakuani bakagenderera kobichoka goika ase omotienyi o gatano na kabere.
english: They began doing this in the third month and finished in the seventh month.

ekegusii: Ase rituko rie ritang’ani, omotienyi bwe ritang’ani, bagachaka gochena Hekalu, na ase rituko ria gatano na gatato ri’omotienyi oyio bagaikera enyomba yaagachire bosio bw’enyomba y’Omonene na yabwateranirie nero. Naende bagasoa bakaba bagochena enyomba y’Omonene ase engaki y’amatuko atano na atato, na ase rituko ria ikomi na gatano, na rimo, ri’omotienyi oyio bwe ritang’ani bagakoora emeremo eria.
english: They began the consecration on the first day of the first month, and by the eighth day of the month they reached the portico of the LORD. For eight more days they consecrated the temple of the LORD itself, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.

ekegusii: Na barabwo bagachaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, gose ning’o asebare orakore ring’ana eri.
english: They began to question among themselves which of them it might be who would do this.

ekegusii: Nigo yarorekanete buna nabanto bakogecha emete, bakaimokia ebisire kogecha rinani rinoru.
english: They behaved like men wielding axes to cut through a thicket of trees.

ekegusii: Bakamotuba amaiso, bakamoboria, “Bana! Ning’o ogoaka?”
english: They blindfolded him and demanded, "Prophesy! Who hit you?"

ekegusii: They bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate, the governor.
english: Bakamosiba, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato, oyorenge gavuna.

ekegusii: Ime ase ebitutu nigo bakwogererana, inse y’amasa akorura nao bagosangererekana amo.
english: They brayed among the bushes and huddled in the undergrowth.

ekegusii: Basaririe enchera yane ngoetera; abwo batabwate gokonyeka konde abanyene, nigo bagokonya abande ase ogonsiria.
english: They break up my road; they succeed in destroying me-- without anyone's helping them.

ekegusii: bakarentera Omonene okoruegwa kwabo. Bakarua chigari isano nemo chitubire, ne chiombe ikomi na ibere, egari eyemo ase abatang’ani babere na kera eng’ombe eyemo ase omoraai oyomo. Bakarenta ebio agwo bosio bw’Obomenyo Obochenu.
english: They brought as their gifts before the LORD six covered carts and twelve oxen-- an ox from each leader and a cart from every two. These they presented before the tabernacle.

ekegusii: Bakayerenta ase Yeso; bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ase emori eria, bakariinia Yeso igoro asero.
english: They brought it to Jesus, threw their cloaks on the colt and put Jesus on it.

ekegusii: Bakamoira aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore).
english: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha (which means The Place of the Skull).

ekegusii: Bakaira chieri isano na ibere, ne chimingichi isano na ibere, ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi isano na ibere, ne chigoree isano na ibere, chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’oboruoti, na Hekalu, na Abayuda. Agachika abakuani ab’ororeria rwa Haroni bachirue ase egesasimero ki’Omonene.
english: They brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven male lambs and seven male goats as a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary and for Judah. The king commanded the priests, the descendants of Aaron, to offer these on the altar of the LORD.

ekegusii: Kobarentire Esanduku eria ya Nyasae, bakayebeka ime ase eema eria Daudi ayeteneneretie, bakarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe, ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: They brought the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and they presented burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before God.

ekegusii: Abanto baria baare korenta Esanduku eria y’Omonene, bakayebeka aase aye eema ime, eema eria Daudi ayeteneneretie. Erio Daudi akarua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebi’omorembe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: They brought the ark of the LORD and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and David sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings before the LORD.

ekegusii: They brought the coin, and he asked them, "Whose portrait is this? And whose inscription?" "Caesar's," they replied.
english: Bakayerenta. Ere akababoria, “Ekieni eke na amariko aya nebiang’o?” Bakamoiraneria, “Nebia Kaisari.”

ekegusii: Bakamorentera etigere amo nemori yaye, bakaara chianga chiabo igoro ya chirochio, na Yeso akayeriina.
english: They brought the donkey and the colt, placed their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.

ekegusii: Bakaira omotwe oyio o Isi‐Boseti ase Daudi agwo Heburoni, bakamotebia, “Rora, oyo nomotwe o Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, omobisa oo, oyo orenge korigia obogima bwao. Rero Omonene okoruseirie aye, omonene oito, egesiomba igoro ya Saulo na igoro y’ororeria rwaye.”
english: They brought the head of Ish-Bosheth to David at Hebron and said to the king, "Here is the head of Ish-Bosheth son of Saul, your enemy, who tried to take your life. This day the LORD has avenged my lord the king against Saul and his offspring."

ekegusii: ne chisiiro chiateneneirie Baali bagachisokia korwa aroro, bagachisamba.
english: They brought the sacred stone out of the temple of Baal and burned it.

ekegusii: Bakabaira ase abagambi, bagateba, “Abanto aba basaririe omochie oito, na barabwo n’Abayahudi.
english: They brought them before the magistrates and said, "These men are Jews, and are throwing our city into an uproar

ekegusii: Bakamoira oria orenge omouko ritang’ani ase Abafarisai.
english: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.

ekegusii: bakoyia Uria korwa aroro, bakamorenta ase Yehoyakimu omoruoti, na ere akamoita nomoro, agatuguta omobere oye aase abanto bande bonsi barenge gotindekwa.
english: They brought Uriah out of Egypt and took him to King Jehoiakim, who had him struck down with a sword and his body thrown into the burial place of the common people.)

ekegusii: Nigo asibetwe chingatare chigasionora amagoro aye, naende akabekerwa eteyo y’ekioma ase rigoti riaye,
english: They bruised his feet with shackles, his neck was put in irons,

ekegusii: Bakaagachera Baali aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, agwo ase Rikura ria mosinto o Hinomu, na aroro bakarua abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, ase enyasae Moleki. Amang’ana ayio inche ntabachigete, gose atarenge ase ebirengererio biane, ng’a bakore okogechia okwo, na ayio akagera Abayuda bonsi bagakora ebibe.”
english: They built high places for Baal in the Valley of Ben Hinnom to sacrifice their sons and daughters to Molech, though I never commanded, nor did it enter my mind, that they should do such a detestable thing and so make Judah sin.

ekegusii: Erio akaagacha egesasimero gie chibao chi’emekonge ase ebing’wanso birasamberwe. Obotambe bwaye nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atano, na obogare bwaye amaboko atano; nabo chinsemo chiaye inye chikaba chireng’aine, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro nigo bwarenge obw’ekerengo ki’amaboko atato.
english: They built the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood, three cubits high; it was square, five cubits long and five cubits wide.

ekegusii: Erio bagatindeka Abineri agwo Heburoni. Omoruoti akarera neriogi rinene agwo ase oboina bw’Abineri; na abanto bonsi bakarera.
english: They buried Abner in Hebron, and the king wept aloud at Abner's tomb. All the people wept also.

ekegusii: Erio agatindekwa ase oboina eroiseretie ere omonyene, agwo ase Omochie o Daudi. Bakamwareria ase ekerarero giaichoretigwe ebinsari na amarembo ao ao, ebinto bigotioka buya, biaroisetigwe nabaroisia abang’aini. Abanto bagauta omorero omonene ase okworokia amasikani ase engencho ya Asa.
english: They buried him in the tomb that he had cut out for himself in the City of David. They laid him on a bier covered with spices and various blended perfumes, and they made a huge fire in his honor.

ekegusii: Na Abaisraeli bonsi bakamotindeka na komoreera, koreng’ana buna ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase omobani Ahiya, omosomba oye.
english: They buried him, and all Israel mourned for him, as the LORD had said through his servant the prophet Ahijah.

ekegusii: Erio bagatindeka amauga a Saulo na aya Yonathani, omwana oye, ase ense ya Benjamin, aaria Zela, ase embeera ya Kisi ise. Barabwo bagakora onsi aya omoruoti achigete. Nyuma y’ayio Nyasae akaigwa aya basaberete ense eria.
english: They buried the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the tomb of Saul's father Kish, at Zela in Benjamin, and did everything the king commanded. After that, God answered prayer in behalf of the land.

ekegusii: Bagasamba emechie ase Abamidiani bamenyete, bagasamba nebitwori biabo bionsi bie chiema.
english: They burned all the towns where the Midianites had settled, as well as all their camps.

ekegusii: Nigo basambete nomorero Obomenyo bwao Obochenu, bakaiyeria inse Obomenyo Obochenu bw’erieta riao, na bakabokora bokaba obotachenegeti.
english: They burned your sanctuary to the ground; they defiled the dwelling place of your Name.

ekegusii: Ekero barangeretie omoruoti, Eliakimu mosinto o Hilikia oyorenge omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, na Sebuna omoriki, na Yoa mosinto bw’Asafu, oyorenge omoriki bw’amang’ana are gokoreka, bakagenda isiko asebare.
english: They called for the king; and Eliakim son of Hilkiah the palace administrator, Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph the recorder went out to them.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakarera neriogi rinene, bagateba, “Aye Omogambi omonene, omochenu na omonyene ekeene, goika ririri oratebane kogambia abwo bamenyete ase ense, na gotorusereria egesiomba ki’amanyinga aito?”
english: They called out in a loud voice, "How long, Sovereign Lord, holy and true, until you judge the inhabitants of the earth and avenge our blood?"

ekegusii: Bakarangeria neriogi bakaboria gose Simion, oyokorokwa Petero, nao are ime.
english: They called out, asking if Simon who was known as Peter was staying there.

ekegusii: bakarangeria Loti, bakamoboria, “Abanto abwo bacha mwao bono botuko, ng’ai bare? Basokie isiko aa, tobakorere obosooku.”
english: They called to Lot, "Where are the men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us so that we can have sex with them."

ekegusii: bagotebia ebigoro na ebitare, “Togwere, otobise korwa ase obosio bwaye ere oyoikaransete ase ekerogo ki’obonene, gose titorora endamwamu y’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi,
english: They called to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!

ekegusii: Barabwo bakabwatana, bakaba mamincha ya Musa na Haroni, bakabatebia, “Bono ayio aisanire. Abanto bonsi b’omoganda oyo nigo bare abachenu; Omonene nigo are amo na kera oyomo. Nase ki rende inwe mweimokereirie igoro na mogwekora abanene igoro y’omosangererekano bw’Omonene?”
english: They came as a group to oppose Moses and Aaron and said to them, "You have gone too far! The whole community is holy, every one of them, and the LORD is with them. Why then do you set yourselves above the LORD's assembly?"

ekegusii: Bakairana gochia ase Musa na Haroni, na ase omoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli agwo Kadeshi ase erooro ya Parani, bakabatebia amang’ana onsi, na bakaborokia okwama gw’ense eria.
english: They came back to Moses and Aaron and the whole Israelite community at Kadesh in the Desert of Paran. There they reported to them and to the whole assembly and showed them the fruit of the land.

ekegusii: Korende ekero bachete ase ense eye na koyeira ebe eyabo, tibakoigwerete gose tibabwatetie amachiko ao. Ebinto bionsi kwabachigete bakore, tibabikorete nonya nekemo. Ase engencho eyio kwarentire amabe aya onsi igoro asebare.
english: They came in and took possession of it, but they did not obey you or follow your law; they did not do what you commanded them to do. So you brought all this disaster upon them.

ekegusii: Kabarure ase chimbeera, nyuma y’okoboka kwa Yeso bagasoa ase omochie omochenu bakaorokera abange.
english: They came out of the tombs, and after Jesus' resurrection they went into the holy city and appeared to many people.

ekegusii: Bakaimoka korwa omochie, bakamochiera.
english: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagacha nabarwani babo bonsi, omoganda bw’abanto abange buna omokenye bw’engegu y’enyancha. Nigo barenge ne chibarasi ne chigari chinyinge mono.
english: They came out with all their troops and a large number of horses and chariots-- a huge army, as numerous as the sand on the seashore.

ekegusii: Bagachia goika aase akorokwa Gologotha (engencho yaye: Aase Ekeore),
english: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means The Place of the Skull).

ekegusii: Bagacha bakabasaba okwaberwa. Erio kobabasokirie isiko bakababoria barue ase omochie oria.
