english: They must not leave any of it till morning or break any of its bones. When they celebrate the Passover, they must follow all the regulations.

ekegusii: Ere takonyuoma omokungu omoboraka, gose oyotiganire nomosacha oye, korende nanyare konyuoma omoiseke omwekungi bw’ororeria rw’Abaisraeli, gose nabo aranyare konyuoma omokungu omoboraka bw’omokuani.
english: They must not marry widows or divorced women; they may marry only virgins of Israelite descent or widows of priests.

ekegusii: Orogongo orwo tirobaisa koonigwa gose koonchorerigwa; orogongo orwo rore oruya goetania echinde chionsi tiroegwa onde, ekiagera nigo rore orochenu ase Omonene.
english: They must not sell or exchange any of it. This is the best of the land and must not pass into other hands, because it is holy to the LORD.

ekegusii: They named it Dan after their forefather Dan, who was born to Israel-- though the city used to be called Laish.
english: Bakaroka omochie oyio Dani, erieta ria Dani sokoro yabo, mosinto o Israeli.

ekegusii: Nigo banchete korua ebing’wanso asende, erinde barie chinyama chi’ebing’wanso ebio, korende inche Omonene timbagokereti. Bono ning’inyore okomocha kwabo mbae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo; barabwo bairane gochia Misiri.
english: They offer sacrifices given to me and they eat the meat, but the LORD is not pleased with them. Now he will remember their wickedness and punish their sins: They will return to Egypt.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo nigo bare koigwa rioka ng’a, “Ere oyotochandete ritang’ani, bono nkorandia are okwegena koria aare gosaria agwo ritang’ani.”
english: They only heard the report: "The man who formerly persecuted us is now preaching the faith he once tried to destroy."

ekegusii: Na barabwo bakamobua ase chinguru chi’amanyinga ’Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, na ase amang’ana ’oborori bwabo; tibancha obogima bwabo nonya ngoika ogokwa.
english: They overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.

ekegusii: Erio bakaooma chibao echio netahabu, bagakora chibonyi chie chitahabu ase emiaro erasoigwe, naende bakaooma emeriibo eria netahabu.
english: They overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars. They also overlaid the crossbars with gold.

ekegusii: Agakeooma netahabu echenire, igoro yaye, ne chinsemo chiaye, amo ne chingunchara chiaye, akayeetanania omong’ororia bw’etahabu.
english: They overlaid the top and all the sides and the horns with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia goetania ensemo ye ritang’ani na ensemo ya kabere ase abarendi barendete, bagaika egeita ki’ebioma kegosoerwa omochie ime. Eke gekabaigokera, na barabwo bagaeta ase enchera eyemo. Erio kegima omomalaika oria agatiga Petero.
english: They passed the first and second guards and came to the iron gate leading to the city. It opened for them by itself, and they went through it. When they had walked the length of one street, suddenly the angel left him.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaorokia ebimanyererio ase egati y’abanto, bagakora ebikone agwo ase ense ya Hamu.
english: They performed his miraculous signs among them, his wonders in the land of Ham.

ekegusii: Abakuani na Abalawi bagakora emeremo ya Nyasae obo, na ey’ogochena. Abateri na abarendi b’ebiita bakaba bagokora emeremo yabo buna Daudi na Sulemani, omomura oye, bachigete.
english: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as did also the singers and gatekeepers, according to the commands of David and his son Solomon.

ekegusii: Bakabeka Esanduku y’Omonene ase egari, bakabeka na esanduku eria yabekire emegwekano eria ye chimbeba na ey’amagumba eroisirie korwa ase etahabu.
english: They placed the ark of the LORD on the cart and along with it the chest containing the gold rats and the models of the tumors.

ekegusii: Nigo bagokora emeroberio emebe, bagoteba, “Bono twakorire omoroberio oito omoikeranu.” Ekeene, ebirengererio bia ime bi’omonto, na enkoro yaye, nigo bisinyete.
english: They plot injustice and say, "We have devised a perfect plan!" Surely the mind and heart of man are cunning.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakarindoka na koumokera ebisakorwa, bakaira ching’ondi ne chiombe, ne chimori, bagachinyenya na gochiria chire namanyinga ime yabo.
english: They pounced on the plunder and, taking sheep, cattle and calves, they butchered them on the ground and ate them, together with the blood.

ekegusii: Abakori amabe bonsi nigo bagwetogia, nigo bagokwana‐kwana amang’ana amabe.
english: They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.

ekegusii: Nyuma kobarandirie amang’ana amaya ase omochie oria, na kobakorire abange koba aborokigwa, bakairana goika Listra, na Ikonio, na Antiokia,
english: They preached the good news in that city and won a large number of disciples. Then they returned to Lystra, Iconium and Antioch,

ekegusii: They prepared their gifts for Joseph's arrival at noon, because they had heard that they were to eat there.
english: Barabwo bakabeka ebiegwa biabo ang’e, baganye Yusufu kagocha mobaso, ekiagera konya baigure ng’a nao bagocha koragerera endagera ya mobaso.

ekegusii: Bakababeka bosio bw’abatomwa, na barabwo bakabasabera na kobabekera amaboko.
english: They presented these men to the apostles, who prayed and laid their hands on them.

ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo akoibera omokungu omogomba; gose tari gokorera omoboraka amaya.
english: They prey on the barren and childless woman, and to the widow show no kindness.

ekegusii: bakararia okweng’ata, na bakabeka Naboti ase amasio ’abanto ase okomoa amasikani.
english: They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth in a prominent place among the people.

ekegusii: Bagatenenia birori b’oborimo abaare goteba, “Omonto oyo tatigeti gokwana bobe igoro y’aase aa aachenu na igoro y’amachiko.
english: They produced false witnesses, who testified, "This fellow never stops speaking against this holy place and against the law.

ekegusii: Bakobariera eira y’obosibore, korende barabwo abanyene nigo bare abasomba b’ogosareka. Naki omonto kabuirwe nomonto onde nigo akoba omosomba bw’omonto oria.
english: They promise them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of depravity-- for a man is a slave to whatever has mastered him.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakobang’aina na bagere moirwe ase ense y’aare; inche nimbaserie morue aiga mochie gosira.
english: They prophesy lies to you that will only serve to remove you far from your lands; I will banish you and you will perish.

ekegusii: Ase igo ogokora okwo kwabo gokagechia Omonene goika akaba nendamwamu, na oborwaire bogoita bogatuboka ase egati yabo.
english: they provoked the LORD to anger by their wicked deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

ekegusii: Bakamoboyia eanga emonyinga, bagatwang’a egutwa y’amagwa, bakamobekera motwe,
english: They put a purple robe on him, then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on him.

ekegusii: Ekero narenge nenchara, abanto bakang’a amache ’endorwe ribaga ri’endagera, na ekero narenge nerang’o, bakang’a chinkama nkanywa.
english: They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst.

ekegusii: They put Hamor and his son Shechem to the sword and took Dinah from Shechem's house and left.
english: Bagaita Hamori amo nomomura oye nemeyio ya birende, bakarusia Dina omwabo mwa Sekemu, bakagenda nere.

ekegusii: Abanto bakamobeka echela, na bakaganya amang’ana korwa ase Omonene ng’a ninki omonto oyio agochia gokorerwa.
english: They put him in custody until the will of the LORD should be made clear to them.

ekegusii: Erio bakabeka ebirwanero biaye ase enyomba y’Asitaroti, enyasae yabo enkungu, na omobere oye bakayotonga ase orwaki rwa Beti‐Sani.
english: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

ekegusii: Bakabeka ebirwanero biaye ime ase hekalu ye chinyasae chiabo, erio bagasiberania omotwe oye ase hekalu ya Dagoni.
english: They put his armor in the temple of their gods and hung up his head in the temple of Dagon.

ekegusii: Abanto baria bakaamerererania na Musa, bagakwana, “Nanga nigo yabete buya kobua onye naintwe ntwakwete ekero abaminto baitetwe agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: They quarreled with Moses and said, "If only we had died when our brothers fell dead before the LORD!

ekegusii: Erio abanto mbaake amariogi batere nomogoko, mbaake amariogi korwa ase enyancha, batogie obonene bw’Omonene.
english: They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they acclaim the LORD's majesty.

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakaminyoka bakamorusia aroro, na ekero atenenete ase egati y’abanto bamoroche ng’a naetanetie abanto bande bonsi ase obotambe bw’omotwe korwa amareko gochia igoro.
english: They ran and brought him out, and as he stood among the people he was a head taller than any of the others.

ekegusii: bakaminyoka, bagaetanana ense eria yonsi, bagachaka kobogoria abarwaire bare ase amarere abo, bakagenda kera aase baigwete ng’a nao are.
english: They ran throughout that whole region and carried the sick on mats to wherever they heard he was.

ekegusii: Abalawi abwo bagasoma buya mono amachiko a Nyasae korwa ase Ebuku eria. Naende bakaorokia engencho y’amang’ana ayio, erinde abanto bayaigwe na koyamanya.
english: They read from the Book of the Law of God, making it clear and giving the meaning so that the people could understand what was being read.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaegwa korwa ase Musa ebiegwa ebi bionsi Abaisraeli konya barentire ase okoroisia Obomenyo boria Obochenu. Na Abaisraeli bakagenderera korenta ebiegwa biabo kera emambia.
english: They received from Moses all the offerings the Israelites had brought to carry out the work of constructing the sanctuary. And the people continued to bring freewill offerings morning after morning.

ekegusii: Bakamomanya ng’a nere oria orenge goikaransa na gosaba ebiegwa aria ase Egesieri Ekiya gie Hekalu. Erio bagaichorwa nogokumia na ogoichana ase amang’ana aria akoregete asare.
english: they recognized him as the same man who used to sit begging at the temple gate called Beautiful, and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

ekegusii: Bakaba bakoong’anya na gotabataba buna abanto batindire, na obong’aini bwabo bwonsi bokabaerera.
english: They reeled and staggered like drunken men; they were at their wits' end.

ekegusii: Bakaanga koigwera, gose tibarengereretie na koinyora amakumia gwakorete ase egati yabo; bagakong’ia ebigoti, bagachora omoraai abatang’ane koirana gochia Misiri ase obosomba. Korende aye naye Nyasae bw’okwabera, nigo ore omuya, naende omonyene amabera, tori omwango bw’okoba nendamwamu, aye nigo ore nobwanchani obonge botari koera, gose tikwabatigete.
english: They refused to listen and failed to remember the miracles you performed among them. They became stiff-necked and in their rebellion appointed a leader in order to return to their slavery. But you are a forgiving God, gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in love. Therefore you did not desert them,

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagachaya emeroberio yaye echikire na okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, koria akorete ne chisokoro chiabo, na ogokurerwa aruete asebare. Bagakora emegwekano y’ogosasimwa etagwenerete kende, bakayebwatia, bakabwatia chingencho chi’abanto b’ebisaku babaetanaine, abwo Omonene abakanetie ng’a tibakora buna barabwo.
english: They rejected his decrees and the covenant he had made with their fathers and the warnings he had given them. They followed worthless idols and themselves became worthless. They imitated the nations around them although the LORD had ordered them, "Do not do as they do," and they did the things the LORD had forbidden them to do.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagochengera erieta riao omobaso boira; na goetera ase oboronge bwao nigo bakoimokererigwa igoro.
english: They rejoice in your name all day long; they exult in your righteousness.

ekegusii: Nigo bainyorete ng’a Nyasae nere egetare kiabo; naende ng’a Nyasae Oyore Igoro Mono, nere Omobooria obo.
english: They remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.

ekegusii: Bakaimoka bakarusia ebisasimero biarenge agwo Yerusalemu, na ebisasimero bionsi bi’ogosambera ubani bakabirusia aroro, bakabituguta ase Rikura ria Kidironi.
english: They removed the altars in Jerusalem and cleared away the incense altars and threw them into the Kidron Valley.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya, nerusirie moyo.
english: They repay me evil for good and leave my soul forlorn.

ekegusii: Nigo bakong’akana amabe ase amaya aane na kongecha ase obwanchani bwane.
english: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my friendship.

ekegusii: Ase igo abasomba ba Saulo bagatebia Daudi amang’ana ayio bobisi. Nere akabairaneria, “Inee! Inwe nigo moroche ng’a nering’ana rike omoruoti abe tata biara. Inche igo inde omonto omotaka mono, naende tindi na bonene bonde.”
english: They repeated these words to David. But David said, "Do you think it is a small matter to become the king's son-in-law? I'm only a poor man and little known."

ekegusii: Abanto bakairaneria, bakamotebia, “Amang’ana aria aria arakorerwe oyo oraite omonto oria.”
english: They repeated to him what they had been saying and told him, "This is what will be done for the man who kills him."

ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Inee! Naye boigo n’Galili kwarwa? Rigia, orore ng’a mobani takorwa Galili.” [Bakagenda kera omonto bwoye.
english: They replied, "Are you from Galilee, too? Look into it, and you will find that a prophet does not come out of Galilee."

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Mwegene Omonene Yeso, na aye notooreke amo nab’enyomba yao.”
english: They replied, "Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved-- you and your household."

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Igo abegete eganchwa eroisirie korwa ase amarionya, na bweboeretie orokini rwe riiyo kenema kiaye.” Omoruoti akabatebia, “Ekeene, oyio n’Elija Omotisibi.”
english: They replied, "He was a man with a garment of hair and with a leather belt around his waist." The king said, "That was Elijah the Tishbite."

ekegusii: Abagaaka bakamoiraneria, “Onye koganetie gokorera abanto aba bono, oigwe okoboria kwabo na okwane amang’ana amaya asebare, erio barabwo nababe bakogokorera botambe.”
english: They replied, "If today you will be a servant to these people and serve them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants."

ekegusii: Abagaaka baria bakamoiraneria, “Korabe omwororo ase abanto aba na kobagwenera, naende okwane amang’ana amaya asebare, barabwo nababe bakogokorera botambe.”
english: They replied, "If you will be kind to these people and please them and give them a favorable answer, they will always be your servants."

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Otwanchere intwe toikaranse, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okorio, na oyonde ensemo y’okoboko kwao gw’okobee, ase obonene bwao.”
english: They replied, "Let one of us sit at your right and the other at your left in your glory."

ekegusii: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets."
english: Bakamoiraneria, “Abande nig’o bagoteba: Yohana Omobatisi; na abande: Elija; na abande: Yeremia gose oyomo bw’ababani.”

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Yohana Omobatisi; na abande: Elija; na abande: Oyomo ase ababani.”
english: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets."

ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Yohana Omobatisi; abande Elija, na abande ng’a oyomo ase ababani abakoro obokire.”
english: They replied, "Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that one of the prophets of long ago has come back to life."

ekegusii: Bakabora, “Omonene nayeganetie.”
english: They replied, "The Lord needs it."

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamoiraneria, “Omonto oria nigo atounetie mono amanye amang’ana aito na ay’eamate yaito, agatoboria: Iso moyo are? Mokare nonde omino? Na intwe tokamoiraneria buna atoboretie. Inee! Ntwamanyete aya agochia gokwana ng’a: Gachie morente oyomino?”
english: They replied, "The man questioned us closely about ourselves and our family. 'Is your father still living?' he asked us. 'Do you have another brother?' We simply answered his questions. How were we to know he would say, 'Bring your brother down here'?"

ekegusii: Baria bakamotebia, “Intwe titwana konyora amarube ande agokwana amang’ana igoro yao korwa Boyahudi, gose onde ominto tari nonya noyomo oikire aiga na gototebia amang’ana, gose okwanire ring’ana riibe igoro yao.
english: They replied, "We have not received any letters from Judea concerning you, and none of the brothers who have come from there has reported or said anything bad about you.

ekegusii: They replied, "Your servant our father is still alive and well." And they bowed low to pay him honor.
english: Bakamoiraneria, “Ee, omosomba oo tata mbuya are. Nabo moyo are.” Barabwo bagatureka emetwe yabo inse.

ekegusii: bakagamba bagende komong’ainereria nobong’aini. Bakamanora, bagasangereria ebinto bi’orogendo, bakaberekia chitigere chiabo chigunia chingotu, na ebirandi ebigotu bi’edivai, bikorire korwa ase amasankwa, bibekire ebiraka.
english: they resorted to a ruse: They went as a delegation whose donkeys were loaded with worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.

ekegusii: Kera omogoroba nigo bakoirana, baetanana omochie, bakoga buna chisese.
english: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

ekegusii: ababete ang’e korua obogima bwabo ase engencho yane. Nabaakeire ng’a mbuya mono, gose tari inche bweka, korende nonya ne chikanisa chionsi chi’abanto b’Ebisaku.
english: They risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.

ekegusii: Bagasamba chinyama chie chimanwa chi’Epasaka ase omorero buna achikire, korende echi’ebing’wanso binde ebichenu bagachiyekera chinyongo, na ebitega, ne chisuguria; erio bwango bagachiirera abanto bonsi.
english: They roasted the Passover animals over the fire as prescribed, and boiled the holy offerings in pots, caldrons and pans and served them quickly to all the people.

ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokiamoka, Samweli akarangeria Saulo oyorenge ase ekerama igoro, akabora, “Imoka ngokoobe, ogende ase orogendo rwao.” Saulo akaimoka, na barabwo babere bakagenda bare amo.
english: They rose about daybreak and Samuel called to Saul on the roof, "Get ready, and I will send you on your way." When Saul got ready, he and Samuel went outside together.

ekegusii: Amache akagenderera komenteka goichora igoro ase ense goika ebitunwa bionsi ebitambe, ebiare ande onsi inse y’erioba, bigatubwa.
english: They rose greatly on the earth, and all the high mountains under the entire heavens were covered.

ekegusii: Nigo chikorindokera omochie, na kominyoka ase chindwaki igoro; nigo chikoriina ase chinyomba chisoa ime na chietera ase chitirisa buna abaibi.
english: They rush upon the city; they run along the wall. They climb into the houses; like thieves they enter through the windows.

ekegusii: Nigo bakoruera ebing’wanso ase ebitunwa igoro, na basambera ubani ase ebigoro, inse y’emete enga buna emetontera, na inse y’emesobeti, na inse y’ebirachuoki, ekiagera agwo nao ebiriri ebiya bire. “Ase ayio, abaiseke baino nigo bagokora obonyaka, na baka bamura baino nigo bagokora obotomani.
english: They sacrifice on the mountaintops and burn offerings on the hills, under oak, poplar and terebinth, where the shade is pleasant. Therefore your daughters turn to prostitution and your daughters-in-law to adultery.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagasamba abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, bakaba ebing’wanso, naende bagakora oboriori na oborogi, bakerua abanyene gokora ebibe ase obosio bw’Omonene, bakamogechia goika akaba nendamwamu.
english: They sacrificed their sons and daughters in the fire. They practiced divination and sorcery and sold themselves to do evil in the eyes of the LORD, provoking him to anger.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo baruete abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, bakaba ebing’wanso ase ebirecha.
english: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

ekegusii: Bakarua ebing’wanso ase ebirecha bitari Nyasae: bagasasima chinyasae batamanyete agwo ritang’ani, chinyasae chinyia chiasoete nyuma, echio chisokoro chiaino chitairogete.
english: They sacrificed to demons, which are not God-- gods they had not known, gods that recently appeared, gods your fathers did not fear.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagateba ase emioyo yabo, “Goika tobasirie kegima.” Nigo basambete aase onsi abanto ba Nyasae bagosangererekana.
english: They said in their hearts, "We will crush them completely!" They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagatebania, “Inchuo, tokore amatabori na toyasambe nomorero.” Igo bakanyora amatabori ribaga ri’amagena, na esike gete ase okoyabwaterania.
english: They said to each other, "Come, let's make bricks and bake them thoroughly." They used brick instead of stone, and tar for mortar.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo batebetie Nyasae: Karue asetore! Naende bakabora: Inee! Ngento ki Omonguru oyio aratokorere?
english: They said to God, 'Leave us alone! What can the Almighty do to us?'

ekegusii: Bakamotebia, “Tari nonya noyomo ase eamate yao okorokwa erieta erio.”
english: They said to her, "There is no one among your relatives who has that name."

ekegusii: Bakamotebia, “Aborokigwa ba Yohana nigo bakweng’ata ebiro ebinge na gosaba, na aborokigwa b’Abafarisai nabo bagokora, korende abao nigo bakoria na konywa.”
english: They said to him, "John's disciples often fast and pray, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours go on eating and drinking."

ekegusii: They said to him, "Sit down, please, and read it to us." So Baruch read it to them.
english: bakamotebia, “Ikaransa, otosomere ebuku eyio.” Na Baruku agakora bo.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakamotebia, “Intwe nigo twachire kogosiba, erio tokobeke ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.” Samison akabatebia, “Tiana asende ng’a inwe abanyene timokong’ita.”
english: They said to him, "We've come to tie you up and hand you over to the Philistines." Samson said, "Swear to me that you won't kill me yourselves."

ekegusii: bakamotebia, “Rora bono aye kwagotire, na abamura bao tibari kobwatia chinchera chiao. Ase ayio tochorere omoruoti oranyare gotogambera buna ebisaku binde bionsi bibwate abaruoti.”
english: They said to him, "You are old, and your sons do not walk in your ways; now appoint a king to lead us, such as all the other nations have."

ekegusii: bakabora, “Ntwaenegetie ng’a Omonene otoeire ense eria yonsi, na bono abanto bonsi b’ense eria baondokire ase engencho yaito.”
english: They said to Joshua, "The LORD has surely given the whole land into our hands; all the people are melting in fear because of us."

ekegusii: Bagakwana, bagatebia Nebukadinesaro omoruoti, “Aye omoruoti, ochie kare!
english: They said to King Nebuchadnezzar, "O king, live forever!

ekegusii: Bakang’iraneria, bagantebia, “Abatigari baria batooretigwe korwa ase obosomba bare ase orogongo rwabo, nigo bare ase emechando emenene na ogochaywa okonene Orwaki rwa Yerusalemu rwatagoirwe, na ebiita biaye biasambirwe.”
english: They said to me, "Those who survived the exile and are back in the province are in great trouble and disgrace. The wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire."

ekegusii: Naki nigo bantebia: Tokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa Misiri.
english: They said to me, 'Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don't know what has happened to him.'

ekegusii: Bagatebia Musa, “Inee! Chimbeera tichiarenge Misiri? Nase ayio ogatorenta toche gokwera aa ase erooro? Igo gwatokorera bobe ekero gwatorusia korwa Misiri!
english: They said to Moses, "Was it because there were no graves in Egypt that you brought us to the desert to die? What have you done to us by bringing us out of Egypt?

ekegusii: Erio bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, “Amaene, ntwamocherete oyominto. Nigo twaroche ogochandeka kw’omoyo oye, na ekero atosororete titwamoigwete. Ase ayio nakio kiagerire obokong’u obo bwatonyorire.”
english: They said to one another, "Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw how distressed he was when he pleaded with us for his life, but we would not listen; that's why this distress has come upon us."

ekegusii: bagatebia Samweli, “Tobaisa gotiga kogenderera gotosabera ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, ng’a atotoorie korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti.”
english: They said to Samuel, "Do not stop crying out to the LORD our God for us, that he may rescue us from the hand of the Philistines."

ekegusii: bagatebia Abaamoni, “Ankio inatwerue asemore, motokorere ande onsi morarore arabe buya asemore.”
english: They said to the Ammonites, "Tomorrow we will surrender to you, and you can do to us whatever seems good to you."

ekegusii: bagatebia omokungu oria, “Bono twegenire, tari ase engencho y’amang’ana ao, korende ekiagera tweigwereire intwe abanyene, naende twamanyire ekeene ng’a oyo n’Omotooria bw’ense.”
english: They said to the woman, "We no longer believe just because of what you said; now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man really is the Savior of the world."

ekegusii: Bakairaneria, “Titokonyara gokora ring’ana eri, komoa omonto otarogeti, omoiseke ominto, ekiagera ayio nigo arabe obosooku asetore.
english: They said to them, "We can't do such a thing; we can't give our sister to a man who is not circumcised. That would be a disgrace to us.

ekegusii: Naki igo babatebetie, “Ase engaki y’omoerio nababeo abanto abasekereria, abagotunyana okogania kwabo okobe kw’ogotaba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae.”
english: They said to you, "In the last times there will be scoffers who will follow their own ungodly desires."

ekegusii: nigo baare komoboria atebe “Shibolet”. Onye orenge goteba “Sibolet”, ekiagera tarenge konyara gwatora ring’ana riria boronge, nigo barenge komobwata, bamoitera agwo ase ebiambokero bia Yorodan. Ase engaki eria Abaefraimu chilifu emerongo ene bagaitwa.
english: they said, "All right, say 'Shibboleth.'" If he said, "Sibboleth," because he could not pronounce the word correctly, they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. Forty-two thousand Ephraimites were killed at that time.

ekegusii: Abanto bagakwana, bagatebania, “Inchuo tokore omoroberio bw’ogoita Yeremia. Ntobwate abakuani, na barabwo tibagotiga gotworokereria, gose abanto abang’aini tibagotiga gotosemia, gose ababani tibagotiga gotorareria amang’ana. Inchuo tomosoere titobaisa koigwera amang’ana aye nonya nerimo.”
english: They said, "Come, let's make plans against Jeremiah; for the teaching of the law by the priest will not be lost, nor will counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophets. So come, let's attack him with our tongues and pay no attention to anything he says."

ekegusii: Bakabora, “Oyo tari Yeso, omwana o Yusufu? Ntomanyete ise na ng’ina. Naki rende akobora: Naikire korwa igoro?”
english: They said, "Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, 'I came down from heaven'?"

ekegusii: Bagateba, “Musa nigo aruete ribaga korika rirube ri’ogotigana, na komotiga.”
english: They said, "Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce and send her away."

ekegusii: Abwo babeire bakobatebia,” “Kera oyomo oino aonchoke atige chinchera chiaye chi’ebibe na ogokora kwaye okobe, erio nario moramenye ase ense eye Omonene aete chisokoro chiaino kare, nainwe obayeeire ebe eyaino kogenderera botambe.
english: They said, "Turn now, each of you, from your evil ways and your evil practices, and you can stay in the land the LORD gave to you and your fathers for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakabora, “Omonene nigo agochigete aye omonene oito ng’a bwatanane ense ase Abaisraeli ebe omwando obo, ase ogoaka omobera. Naende Omonene akagochika ng’a omwando o Selofehadi ominto oegwe abaiseke baye.
english: They said, "When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, he ordered you to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda goika Ofiri, bakarenta korwa aroro chitahabu, chikiro chilifu ikomi na inye, na amagana atano (14,500), bakairera omoruoti Sulemani.
english: They sailed to Ophir and brought back 420 talents of gold, which they delivered to King Solomon.

ekegusii: Bagaika engegu y’ense y’Abageraseni, erigereretie Galili.
english: They sailed to the region of the Gerasenes, which is across the lake from Galilee.

ekegusii: Ekero baroche omochie oria, nigo bakumetie, bakaondoka, bagatama.
english: they saw [her] and were astounded; they fled in terror.

ekegusii: na barabwo baba bakorora risankwa ri’obosio bwaye rikomeka‐meka. Erio Musa abeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye goika airana naende gokwana n’Omonene.
english: they saw that his face was radiant. Then Moses would put the veil back over his face until he went in to speak with the LORD.

ekegusii: mbaaroche ogokora kw’Omonene, ee, ogokora kwaye kw’ogokumia ime ase chindiba.
english: They saw the works of the LORD, his wonderful deeds in the deep.

ekegusii: Chimeme buna echi’omorero chikabaorokera, chikabaatananekera, naende chikabaikaransera kera oyomo obo.
english: They saw what seemed to be tongues of fire that separated and came to rest on each of them.

ekegusii: Nigo bagotebia abarori b’amaroro: “Timobaisa korora amang’ana,” na batebia ababani: “Timobaisa gotobanera amang’ana amaronge; totebie amang’ana amororo aya agotwansera, motobanere ay’obong’ainereria.
english: They say to the seers, "See no more visions!" and to the prophets, "Give us no more visions of what is right! Tell us pleasant things, prophesy illusions.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakoboria abang’ina: “Ng’ai endagera ere, na edivai?” Nigo bakona‐kogireka na korara ase chinchera chi’omochie buna abaakirwe chingoma, batweka mo ase amaboko ’abang’ina.
english: They say to their mothers, "Where is bread and wine?" as they faint like wounded men in the streets of the city, as their lives ebb away in their mothers' arms.

ekegusii: Inwe mwensi abamogoteba ng’a, omote noro iso, ne rigena nario nyoko, nigo morasookigwe. Ayio nigo arakoreke, ekiagera mwantigire na kong’a amagega; timong’onchorereti amasio aino. Korende ekero more nemechando mwabora: Inchuo ototoorie.
english: They say to wood, 'You are my father,' and to stone, 'You gave me birth.' They have turned their backs to me and not their faces; yet when they are in trouble, they say, 'Come and save us!'

ekegusii: bateba, “Nyasae omotigire, inchuo tomotunye, erinde tomobwate, onde tari oranyare komotooria.”
english: They say, "God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for no one will rescue him."

ekegusii: Erio bateba, “Naki Nyasae arakore amanye? Inee! Ere Oyore Igoro Mono nabwate obong’aini?”
english: They say, "How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?"

ekegusii: erio bateba, “Omonene tari korora amang’ana ayio, Nyasae o Yakobo tari komanya ayio.”
english: They say, "The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed."

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bagoteba ng’a engaki teraika ang’e tokoagacha chinyomba; omochie oyo nenyanyeni ekoiyeka, na intwe nechinyama.
english: They say, 'Will it not soon be time to build houses? This city is a cooking pot, and we are the meat.'

ekegusii: Nigo bagochecheria abande na gokwana ase okobakora bobe. Nigo bakweimokereria igoro na kobatianera.
english: They scoff, and speak with malice; in their arrogance they threaten oppression.

ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bakoba nokogenderera okuya amo nabarabwo, na ororeria rwabo boigo.
english: They see their children established around them, their offspring before their eyes.

ekegusii: Bakababwata, bakababeka echela ime goika mambia, ekiagera konya riabeire mogoroba.
english: They seized Peter and John, and because it was evening, they put them in jail until the next day.

ekegusii: Bagasakora chitugo chiabo: Chingamia chilifu emerongo etano (50,000), ne ching’ondi chilifu amagana abere na emerongo etano (250,000) ne chitigere chilifu ibere (2,000). Naende bagoosa abanto chilifu rigana erimo (100,000),
english: They seized the livestock of the Hagrites-- fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep and two thousand donkeys. They also took one hundred thousand people captive,

ekegusii: bakaira ching’ondi, ne chiombe, ne chitigere, na bionsi ebiarenge ase omochie ime, na bionsi ebiarenge ase emegondo boigo.
english: They seized their flocks and herds and donkeys and everything else of theirs in the city and out in the fields.

ekegusii: Abana babo nigo bagotomwa isiko banga buna amaicho, nigo bakoba bagotenga na gocharacharara.
english: They send forth their children as a flock; their little ones dance about.

ekegusii: Bagatoma aborokigwa babo asare, amo n’Abaherodiani, bakabora, “Omworokia, twamanyire ng’a nigo ore omonto bw’ekeene, na enchera ya Nyasae nigo okoyiorokereria ase ekeene, gose tori koyiera monto; ekiagera torengerereti obonene bw’abanto.
english: They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians. "Teacher," they said, "we know you are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You aren't swayed by men, because you pay no attention to who they are.

ekegusii: Abwo baare gokorera ayare omogwekano bw’amang’ana are igoro, na ekiriri ki’ayio. Naki ekero Musa arenge koroisia Eema eria, Nyasae akamotebia, “Rigereria, okore ebinto bionsi ase omogwekano bw’oria kworogetigwe ase egetunwa.”
english: They serve at a sanctuary that is a copy and shadow of what is in heaven. This is why Moses was warned when he was about to build the tabernacle: "See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain."

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakogamba ebina bi’abanto botambe. Ebina ebikong’u baba bakobirentera Musa, korende ebire ebike baba bakobigamba abanyene.
english: They served as judges for the people at all times. The difficult cases they brought to Moses, but the simple ones they decided themselves.

ekegusii: Bakamobekera endagera bweka ao, na abamwabo boka ao, na Abamisiri baria konya bakoragera komo boka ao, ekiagera Abamisiri nigo bagechete Abaibirania, tibari koria amo nabarabwo.
english: They served him by himself, the brothers by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because Egyptians could not eat with Hebrews, for that is detestable to Egyptians.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo barengeo ase amatuko a Yoyakimu, mosinto o Yesua o Yosadaki, na ase amatuko a Nehemia omogavuna, na ay’Ezara, oyorenge omokuani na omworokia bw’amariko.
english: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and of Ezra the priest and scribe.

ekegusii: Bagaatanana chinyama chie ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase abanto ba kera eamate, erinde barabwo banyare gochirua ase Omonene, buna arikire ase Ebuku ya Musa. Naboigo bakorete ne chiombe chiria.
english: They set aside the burnt offerings to give them to the subdivisions of the families of the people to offer to the LORD, as is written in the Book of Moses. They did the same with the cattle.

ekegusii: They set fire to God's temple and broke down the wall of Jerusalem; they burned all the palaces and destroyed everything of value there.
english: Agasamba enyomba ya Nyasae na agatagora chindwaki chia Yerusalemu, agasamba ne chinyomba chionsi chi’oboruoti na agasaria ebikorero bionsi bie rigori rinene biarengeo.

ekegusii: Mobaso gati, ekero Beni‐Hadadi amo nabaruoti baria emerongo etato na babere barenge komokonya banyure na gotinda agwo ase chiema, Abaisraeli bagachaka esegi.
english: They set out at noon while Ben-Hadad and the 32 kings allied with him were in their tents getting drunk.

ekegusii: Bakarua Midiani, bakagenda bagaika Parani, naende bakagenda amo nabanto bande korwa Parani, bagaika Misiri. Aroro bakagenda ase Farao, omoruoti o Misiri. Ere akamoa enyomba, naende akamochikera endagera arenge koba okonyora botambe; boigo akamoa oboremo.
english: They set out from Midian and went to Paran. Then taking men from Paran with them, they went to Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, who gave Hadad a house and land and provided him with food.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio bakaimoka korwa Seredi, bakagenda bagatoora sugusu y’orooche rw’Arinoni, ase erooro eria eigete orobebe rw’Abaamori. Arinoni nigo rware orobebe gati y’Abamoabu na Abaamori.
english: They set out from there and camped alongside the Arnon, which is in the desert extending into Amorite territory. The Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

ekegusii: Omonene agachika Musa, na Abaisraeli bagachaka orogendo rwabo ase ekero egetang’ani.
english: They set out, this first time, at the LORD's command through Moses.

ekegusii: Korwa ase enyomba y’Abinadabu, agwo ekegoro igoro, bakarusia Esanduku eria, bakayebeka igoro ase egari enyia. Usa na Ahiyo, basinto b’Abinadabu, bakaba bakoraa Esanduku eyio ya Nyasae.
english: They set the ark of God on a new cart and brought it from the house of Abinadab, which was on the hill. Uzzah and Ahio, sons of Abinadab, were guiding the new cart

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakwarigania endagera bayebeka ase emesa, babeka abarendi bakorenda, naende baria na konywa. Bono inwe abagambi, imoka, moake chinguba chiaino ebitinya.
english: They set the tables, they spread the rugs, they eat, they drink! Get up, you officers, oil the shields!

ekegusii: “Abaisraeli bebekeire abaruoti, batamboreti, bebekeire abagambi abwo ntamanyeti, na korwa ase chifeta ne chitahabu chiabo beroiseirie emegwekano bagosasima; ayio nigo arabarentere ogosirigwa.
english: They set up kings without my consent; they choose princes without my approval. With their silver and gold they make idols for themselves to their own destruction.

ekegusii: Bageteneneria chisiiro chi’ogosasima na emete y’Asera igoro ase kera ekegoro egetambe, na inse ya kera omote omobese.
english: They set up sacred stones and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every spreading tree.

ekegusii: Bakarenta emegwekano y’ogosasimwa ere okogechia ase enyomba eyio ekorokwa ase erieta riane, na igo bakayekora ekaba eyetachenegeti.
english: They set up their abominable idols in the house that bears my Name and defiled it.

ekegusii: Naende bamonachere aakane, chibesa, chisekeli chie chifeta rigana erimo, amoe ise omoiseke oria, ekiagera osaririe erieta ri’omoiseke omwekungi bw’Abaisraeli. Erio oria agenderere koba mokaye, na omosacha oye tabaisa komotiga nonya ng’ake ase obogima bwaye bwonsi.
english: They shall fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the girl's father, because this man has given an Israelite virgin a bad name. She shall continue to be his wife; he must not divorce her as long as he lives.

ekegusii: Ase ayio tibakonyora omwando amo nabanto bamwabo, ekiagera Omonene omonyene nere omwando obo, buna abarierete eira.
english: They shall have no inheritance among their brothers; the LORD is their inheritance, as he promised them.

ekegusii: Agwo bakwane amang’ana aya ase abagaaka baria: Omwana oyo oito nigo are omoenenu, na omosaria, tari gotoigwera, nigo are omoria bobe na gotinda ase okonywa.
english: They shall say to the elders, "This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey us. He is a profligate and a drunkard."

ekegusii: Barabwo babe bagoisaba amaboko, basibie na amagoro, tibabaisa gokwa. Ayio nigo arabe ogochika koragenderere asare na ase ororeria rwaye ebiaare ase ebiaare.”
english: they shall wash their hands and feet so that they will not die. This is to be a lasting ordinance for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come."

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagotieria chimeme chiabo buna emioro, amang’ana bagokwana nigo are nobororo, anga buna chinsara.
english: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their words like deadly arrows.

ekegusii: Bagaitera amanyinga ’abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, abatari na komocha, abwo baruete bakaba ebing’wanso ase emegwekano bagasasima ase ense ya Kanani; na ense eria ekaba eyetachenegeti ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ayio.
english: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was desecrated by their blood.

ekegusii: Korwa ase baboete nigo bakorasa omonto otari na komocha, bamorasa chinsara mobosokano batari nobwoba.
english: They shoot from ambush at the innocent man; they shoot at him suddenly, without fear.

ekegusii: Tiga basangererie endagera eye yonsi y’emiaka eye emiya egocha, bayebeke erendwe ase emechie, ase okobua gwa Farao.
english: They should collect all the food of these good years that are coming and store up the grain under the authority of Pharaoh, to be kept in the cities for food.

ekegusii: Erio bagaaka eriogi naende, bakabora, “Tari oyo, korende Baraba!” Baraba ere nigo arenge omouri.
english: They shouted back, "No, not him! Give us Barabbas!" Now Barabbas had taken part in a rebellion.

ekegusii: Abanto bagaaka eriogi, bagateba, “Eri neriogi ri’enyasae, tari eri’omonto!”
english: They shouted, "This is the voice of a god, not of a man."

ekegusii: Nigo bagotera bakobugia chinchigiri na amakano, naende bagokera amariogi ’ebiroria.
english: They sing to the music of tambourine and harp; they make merry to the sound of the flute.

ekegusii: Ee, nigo agoeta bwango buna obwato obonyerere bw’ebirigisa, buna ensoti egotaboria ebiekoria biaye.
english: They skim past like boats of papyrus, like eagles swooping down on their prey.

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi o kabere, bakanyenya ching’ondi chi’Epasaka. Abakuani na Abalawi bakaba nobosooku; ase igo bagechena na korenta ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: They slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the second month. The priests and the Levites were ashamed and consecrated themselves and brought burnt offerings to the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Nigo bagoita ababoraka na abamenyi, ne chintakana nigo bagochiita;
english: They slay the widow and the alien; they murder the fatherless.

ekegusii: Nigo baimogetie chinyundo na ebisire, bakabuna ebinto bionsi bie Hekalu biabachetwe korwa ase emete.
english: They smashed all the carved paneling with their axes and hatchets.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakobusura emegondo, naende basimeka emesabibu, bakanyora okwama okonene mono.
english: They sowed fields and planted vineyards that yielded a fruitful harvest;

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagokwana bobe igoro yao; nigo bare abaenenu bagokora ebibe asore.
english: They speak of you with evil intent; your adversaries misuse your name.

ekegusii: Nigo bakogenderera kwegokia nobotenenku bwabo; bakwa bagenda aase abakure bare nomorembe.
english: They spend their years in prosperity and go down to the grave in peace.

ekegusii: Erio bakamotwera amate, bakaimokia egetonto keria, bakamoaka ase omotwe.
english: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.

ekegusii: Bagakwana igoro ya Nyasae o Yerusalemu, buna bakwanete igoro ye chinyasae chi’abanto b’ebisaku b’ense eye, chiria chiaroisetigwe namaboko a mwanyabanto.
english: They spoke about the God of Jerusalem as they did about the gods of the other peoples of the world-- the work of men's hands.

ekegusii: Bakemurunganeria Nyasae na Musa, bakabora, “Nase ki mwatorusetie korwa ense ya Misiri, mogatorenta aa tokwere ase erooro eye? Aiga endagera na amache tibiiyo, intwe twagechigwe nendagera eye embe.”
english: they spoke against God and against Moses, and said, "Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the desert? There is no bread! There is no water! And we detest this miserable food!"

ekegusii: Bagakwana amang’ana arenge mamincha ya Nyasae, bagateba, “Inee! Nyasae nanyare gototerekera endagera eisaine aa ase erooro?
english: They spoke against God, saying, "Can God spread a table in the desert?

ekegusii: Ababisa bantegeire oboreba ase ngoeta, bamionogoreire inse. Bakunyire eirima ase enchera yane, korende mbarabwo abanyene bagure imeo.
english: They spread a net for my feet-- I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path-- but they have fallen into it themselves. Selah

ekegusii: Bagatenena kera oyomo aase aye, na Ebuku eria y’Amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae obo, ekaba egosomwa asebare ase egeka gie chinsa isato, naende bakaba bakoorokia ebibe biabo na komosasima Omonene, Nyasae obo, ase egeka kende gie chinsa isato, ase rituko erio.
english: They stood where they were and read from the Book of the Law of the LORD their God for a quarter of the day, and spent another quarter in confession and in worshiping the LORD their God.

ekegusii: Chinyasae echio nigo chiekumbete gochia inse amo, tichikonyara gotooria chigurube chiria, echio chinyene nigo chigwoswa chiairwa ase obosomba.
english: They stoop and bow down together; unable to rescue the burden, they themselves go off into captivity.

ekegusii: Bagakora oboruoti bw’Abayuda bokaba obokong’u, na ase engaki y’emiaka etato bakabeka Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani, chinguru, ekiagera babwatetie chinchera chia Daudi na Sulemani ase emiaka eria etato.
english: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah and supported Rehoboam son of Solomon three years, walking in the ways of David and Solomon during this time.

ekegusii: Ekero barabwo bamokorerete obosooku obwo, bakaira abana baye, abamura na abaiseke, ere akaba okorabaarwa nabakungu bande ekero anacheretwe ekina.
english: They stripped her naked, took away her sons and daughters and killed her with the sword. She became a byword among women, and punishment was inflicted on her.

ekegusii: Bakamorusia chianga chiaye, bakamobekera eanga embariri.
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,

ekegusii: Bakamonuura ebinto biaye, bakanacha omotwe oye bakayoira, bakaira nebirwanero biaye, erio bagatoma abanto bararie amang’ana aya amaya ase ense yonsi y’Abafilisti, ase emegwekano yabo y’ogosasimwa na ase abanto.
english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines to proclaim the news among their idols and their people.

ekegusii: Ekiagera Abayuda basaririe asende, ababisa babo mbabaetanane buna abarendi b’omogondo bakoyoetanana. Omonene okwanire.
english: They surround her like men guarding a field, because she has rebelled against me,'" declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Nigo bang’etananete ase chinsemo chionsi, korende ase erieta ri’Omonene nkabasiria.
english: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakagenderera goita abanto ba Benjamin, bakababwatia na kobatiringera inse goikera aase gete moocha ya Gibea.
english: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them and easily overran them in the vicinity of Gibeah on the east.

ekegusii: Nigo bang’umokerete buna chinchoke, korende bakarima buna omorero bw’amagwa; ase erieta ri’Omonene nkabasiria.
english: They swarmed around me like bees, but they died out as quickly as burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaimokia ebuku y’ogochika kw’Omonene, bakagenda ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda, bakorokereria abanto.
english: They taught throughout Judah, taking with them the Book of the Law of the LORD; they went around to all the towns of Judah and taught the people.

ekegusii: Nimbaakane obobe bwabo na emeremo y’amaboko abo. Ebisaku ebinge na abaruoti abanene nabakore abanto ba Babeli babe abasomba babo.”
english: They themselves will be enslaved by many nations and great kings; I will repay them according to their deeds and the work of their hands."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, barabwo nigo bakorora ng’a nay’ogokumia, ekiagera inwe motari koayerera amo nabarabwo gochia ase obonyaka botari nekerengo, na nigo bakobarama.
english: They think it strange that you do not plunge with them into the same flood of dissipation, and they heap abuse on you.

ekegusii: Ababani abwo barengereirie ng’a abanto baane nigo barebe erieta riane ase engencho ye chindoto chiabo babe bagotebania buna chisokoro chiabo chiebete erieta riane, chikaonchokera Baali.
english: They think the dreams they tell one another will make my people forget my name, just as their fathers forgot my name through Baal worship.

ekegusii: Nigo bagotwoma abaremeire korwa inchera, bagera abataka bonsi b’ense eyio bachia kwebisa amo.
english: They thrust the needy from the path and force all the poor of the land into hiding.

ekegusii: Naki igo bakoboa chigurube chindito, bachitweka abanto ase amareko abo, korende barabwo abanyene tibari gwancha gochitigeria nekiara kiabo.
english: They tie up heavy loads and put them on men's shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.

ekegusii: Bagachibwaterania chibonyi chi’egesembe amo nechi’egesibao ki’obokuani neusi eburu; erio egesembe gekabeera orokini igoro, tigecha gosuka. Bionsi bigakoreka buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: They tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with blue cord, connecting it to the waistband so that the breastpiece would not swing out from the ephod-- as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: bagatebia Haroni: Tokorere chinyasae echiranyare gototang’ana. Titomanyeti eriamonyorire Musa, oyotorusetie ase ense ya Misiri.
english: They told Aaron, 'Make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who led us out of Egypt-- we don't know what has happened to him!'

ekegusii: They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is passing by."
english: Bakamoiraneria, “Yeso o Nazareti ogoeta.”

ekegusii: Agwo bakamanyia ise amang’ana ng’a Yusufu moyo are, naende nere omogambi ase ense yonsi ya Misiri. Yakobo agachia koyaigwa, akagoyaana ase omoyo oye, tanyara kwegena amang’ana abo.
english: They told him, "Joseph is still alive! In fact, he is ruler of all Egypt." Jacob was stunned; he did not believe them.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakamotebia, “Aya naro Hezekia agoteba: Rituko ria rero neri’obororo na egesusuro, na ogochaywa. Abana babeire ang’e baiborwe, korende chinguru chi’okobasukia basoke chiaborire.
english: They told him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the point of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakamotebia, “Aya naro Hezekia agoteba: Rituko ria rero neri’obororo, na egesusuro, na ogochaywa, buna ekero abana babeire ang’e baiborwe, korende chinguru chi’okobasukia basoke chiaborire.
english: They told him, "This is what Hezekiah says: This day is a day of distress and rebuke and disgrace, as when children come to the point of birth and there is no strength to deliver them.

ekegusii: Agatebia abanto baria batometwe, “Motebie abanto ba Yabesi o Gileadi: Ankio mobaso gati namonyore obosibore.” Abatomwa baria bakairana, bagatebia abanto ba Yabesi amang’ana ayio, na barabwo bakaba nomogoko omonene,
english: They told the messengers who had come, "Say to the men of Jabesh Gilead, 'By the time the sun is hot tomorrow, you will be delivered.'" When the messengers went and reported this to the men of Jabesh, they were elated.

ekegusii: Abanto bakaimokia omobere bw’Abisalomu, bakayoruta ase engoro entambe, agwo ase rinani, bakayotuba amagena akaba etui enene, na Abaisraeli bonsi bagatama kera omonto gochia bwoye.
english: They took Absalom, threw him into a big pit in the forest and piled up a large heap of rocks over him. Meanwhile, all the Israelites fled to their homes.

ekegusii: Bakaira ebinto bionsi basakorete, bagoosa abanto, bakaira ne chitugo chionsi.
english: They took all the plunder and spoils, including the people and animals,

ekegusii: bakagenda amo nabarwani esegi babo bonsi komorwania. Bakamochiera, bakamonyora ase ritibo rinene agwo Gibeoni.
english: they took all their men and went to fight Ishmael son of Nethaniah. They caught up with him near the great pool in Gibeon.

ekegusii: Bakaria emuma ase erieta ri’Omonene, ase ogokwana neriogi rinene ase ogochenga, na ase okobugia ebirombeta na ebitureri.
english: They took an oath to the LORD with loud acclamation, with shouting and with trumpets and horns.

ekegusii: Abanto bakaimokia omobere bw’Asaeli, bakayoira bakayotindeka ase embeera ya ise agwo Bethlehemu. Erio Yoabu na abanto baye bakaba bare ase orogendo ase obotuko obogima, na ekero baikire Heburoni bokabakiera aroro.
english: They took Asahel and buried him in his father's tomb at Bethlehem. Then Joab and his men marched all night and arrived at Hebron by daybreak.

ekegusii: Bakaira Yeso ase omokuani omonene; bakamosangererekera bonsi, abakuani abanene na abagaaka, na aborokia b’amariko.
english: They took Jesus to the high priest, and all the chief priests, elders and teachers of the law came together.

ekegusii: bakabogoria chinsagia chi’emekendo, bagasoka isiko kogenda komorotota, bagaaka eriogi, bagateba, “Hosana! Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene, Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.”
english: They took palm branches and went out to meet him, shouting, "Hosanna!" "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!" "Blessed is the King of Israel!"

ekegusii: bakaira ense yaye ekaba eyabo, naende bakaira ense ya Ogi, omoruoti o Basani. (Abaruoti abwo babere nigo bamenyete moocha ya Yorodan.)
english: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan.

ekegusii: Bakaruta ekerengo, bakanyora ebirengo bi’amaboko emerongo ebere. Bakagenderera ake, bakaruta ekerengo naende, bakanyora ebirengo bi’amaboko ikomi na bitano.
english: They took soundings and found that the water was a hundred and twenty feet deep. A short time later they took soundings again and found it was ninety feet deep.

ekegusii: Bakayobwata na bagaita nemioro omoruoti oye na kera omonto bw’omochie oyio amo nabwo b’emechie ende yarenge ang’e Yoshua agasiria omochie oyio kegima, buna akorete omochie bw’Egiloni; tatigete nonya noyomo abe moyo.
english: They took the city and put it to the sword, together with its king, its villages and everyone in it. They left no survivors. Just as at Eglon, they totally destroyed it and everyone in it.

ekegusii: Akayobwata amo nomoruoti oye na emechie yonsi yarenge ang’e. Bagaita nemioro abanto abarenge imeo, tibatigaretie nonya noyomo abe moyo. Agakora omochie o Debiri na omoruoti bw’aroro buna akorete omochie o Heburoni, na omochie o Libuna, na abaruoti b’emechie eyio.
english: They took the city, its king and its villages, and put them to the sword. Everyone in it they totally destroyed. They left no survivors. They did to Debir and its king as they had done to Libnah and its king and to Hebron.

ekegusii: They took the ornamented robe back to their father and said, "We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son's robe."
english: bakagenda nero eanga eria entambe bakayeirera ise, bakamotebia, “Yemanye eanga eye gose ney’omwana oo gose tari ero.”

ekegusii: Bakarusia ebinto biria korwa ase eema, bakabiira ase Yoshua na Abaisraeli, bakabibeka ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: They took the things from the tent, brought them to Joshua and all the Israelites and spread them out before the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto bakarenta ebinto ebio bionsi Musa abachigete, bakabibeka bosio bw’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na omoganda bwonsi ogaika ang’e, ogatenena agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: They took the things Moses commanded to the front of the Tent of Meeting, and the entire assembly came near and stood before the LORD.

ekegusii: Bakanyuomeria abamura babo abaiseke b’abanto baria b’ebisaku, na bagasokia abaiseke babo ase abanto abwo naende bagakorera chinyasae chiabo.
english: They took their daughters in marriage and gave their own daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotiringera emetwe y’abataka ase orotu rw’ense, naende nigo bagokorekania amang’ana ’omonto omoitongo. Omomura na ise nigo bagokora obonyaka nomoiseke oyomo, na igo bakora erieta riane riaba eritachenegeti.
english: They trample on the heads of the poor as upon the dust of the ground and deny justice to the oppressed. Father and son use the same girl and so profane my holy name.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakarua ase egetunwa keria kia Hori, bakagenda orogendo rwabo, bagaetera enchera ekogenda gochia omosomo bw’Enyancha Embariri, erio bachie goetanana ense y’Edomu. Abanto tibaba abaremereria ase ogoeta enchera eria.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor along the route to the Red Sea, to go around Edom. But the people grew impatient on the way;

ekegusii: Ekero bakoorire goeta gati‐gati y’egesinka gionsi goika Pafo, bakanyora aroro omonto oyomo Omoyahudi omorogi, omobani bw’oborimo, ore korokwa Bar Yeso.
english: They traveled through the whole island until they came to Paphos. There they met a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus,

ekegusii: Bakanduta ase engoro ime inde moyo, na konduta amagena.
english: They tried to end my life in a pit and threw stones at me;

ekegusii: They turned their backs to me and not their faces; though I taught them again and again, they would not listen or respond to discipline.
english: Barabwo baonchokire bang’eire amagega abo gose tari amasio abo. Nonya nabeire nkoborokereria kogenderera botambe, bangire gotegerera amorokererio aane.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagatosaba na gotosorora mono tobae ribaga babwatane naintwe ase ogokorera abachenu.
english: they urgently pleaded with us for the privilege of sharing in this service to the saints.

ekegusii: They urgently requested Festus, as a favor to them, to have Paul transferred to Jerusalem, for they were preparing an ambush to kill him along the way.
english: na bakamosaba abanchere, arue ogochika ng’a Paulo arentwe Yerusalemu, konya barobeirie komoboera na komoitera nchera.

ekegusii: Ase chitaai chiria akaroisia chinterekerero chi’egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, na egesasimero gi’etaai amo negechungi kiaye, na ebikorero biaye bionsi,
english: They used it to make the bases for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar with its bronze grating and all its utensils,

ekegusii: Ase chifeta chikiro emerongo etato na isano chiatigarete chiakoreretwe ase okoroisia ebigobanio bie chisiiro na ase okooma ebisure biabo, na koroisia chinuga chiabo.
english: They used the 1,775 shekels to make the hooks for the posts, to overlay the tops of the posts, and to make their bands.

ekegusii: Bakaba bakorwana esegi n’Abahagari abarwete ase Yeturi na Nafisi, na Nodabu.
english: They waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish and Nodab.

ekegusii: Nigo barenge koba banganyete buna embura ekoganywa; bakaba bagwasamia emenwa yabo buna embura y’okwamia endagera egwasamerwa.
english: They waited for me as for showers and drank in my words as the spring rain.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaganya egeka giaisanete koganya. Nonya naboigo, omoruoti taigora egesieri ki’enyomba. Ase ayio bakaimokia ekeigorero, bakaigora egesieri, na Ani! Omonene obo nigo araire inse okwete.
english: They waited to the point of embarrassment, but when he did not open the doors of the room, they took a key and unlocked them. There they saw their lord fallen to the floor, dead.

ekegusii: Nigo bakoong’anya korigia endagera, batayenyoreti nigo bakogeesa bokia.
english: They wander about for food and howl if not satisfied.

ekegusii: Bakaba bagoetanana korwa ase egesaku ekemo gochia ase ekende, na korwa ase oboruoti obomo gochia ase obonde.
english: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

ekegusii: Naende nigo banchete koba aborokia b’amachiko, korende tibamanyeti ayabagokwana, gose amang’ana aria bakomigereria ne chinguru.
english: They want to be teachers of the law, but they do not know what they are talking about or what they so confidently affirm.

ekegusii: Abanto bagasiberia egari eria agwo ase ritibo ria Samaria, ne chisese chikamena amanyinga aye, na abakungu abatayayi bagesiberia ase ritibo riria, buna Omonene konya akwanire.
english: They washed the chariot at a pool in Samaria (where the prostitutes bathed), and the dogs licked up his blood, as the word of the LORD had declared.

ekegusii: Ekero baare gosoa Eema y’Omosangererekano, gose goika ang’e ase egesasimero, baba bagwesibia, buna Omonene konya achikire Musa.
english: They washed whenever they entered the Tent of Meeting or approached the altar, as the LORD commanded Moses.

ekegusii: Bagaika ng’umbu y’enyancha, goika ense y’Abageraseni.
english: They went across the lake to the region of the Gerasenes.

ekegusii: Bakagenda, bakarora emori y’etigere esibire geita isiko ase enchera enene; bakayesibora.
english: They went and found a colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. As they untied it,

ekegusii: Ekero bairanete, bagatebia Yehu amang’ana ayio, nere akabairaneria, agateba, “Eri ne ring’ana ri’Omonene riria akwanete goetera ase omosomba oye Elija Omotisibi: Agwo ase oboremo bore Yesireeli chisese nachirie omobere o Yesebeli.
english: They went back and told Jehu, who said, "This is the word of the LORD that he spoke through his servant Elijah the Tishbite: On the plot of ground at Jezreel dogs will devour Jezebel's flesh.

ekegusii: Ase ayio barabwo bonsi bakamerwa bare moyo, bakagenda gochia aase abakure, boigo nebinto biabo, erio riroba rikairanerana, rikabatindeka, na barabwo bagasirigwa bakarua ase omosangererekano oria.
english: They went down alive into the grave, with everything they owned; the earth closed over them, and they perished and were gone from the community.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagekora buna nengano bagochia kwoyia. Ekero baigete nyomba ime, bakabeta Isi‐Boseti omoyio enda. Erio Rekabu na Baana omwabo bagatama.
english: They went into the inner part of the house as if to get some wheat, and they stabbed him in the stomach. Then Recab and his brother Baanah slipped away.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barenge gokorera chinyasae ching’ao na gochisasima, chinyasae barabwo batamanyete agwo ritang’ani, echio Omonene atabaete.
english: They went off and worshiped other gods and bowed down to them, gods they did not know, gods he had not given them.

ekegusii: Bagasoka, bakarandia ng’a abanto baonchoke.
english: They went out and preached that people should repent.

ekegusii: Abwo basokire korwa asetore, korende tibarenge abaito. Naki onye nabaito baare, anga mbabete amo naintwe. Korende barureo, erinde emanyekane ng’a tari bonsi barenge abaito.
english: They went out from us, but they did not really belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us; but their going showed that none of them belonged to us.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase ense yonsi y’Abayuda, bagasangereria Abalawi korwa ase emechie yonsi y’Abayuda amo nabateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, bakagenda Yerusalemu.
english: They went throughout Judah and gathered the Levites and the heads of Israelite families from all the towns. When they came to Jerusalem,

ekegusii: Naende bagaika aase akorokwa Gethisemane: agatebia aborokigwa baye, “Ikaransa aa, ekero ngosaba.”
english: They went to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, "Sit here while I pray."

ekegusii: Bakabwatia enchera goika Kapernaumu, na erio kegima ase rituko ri’Esabato Yeso agasoa ase esinagogi akorokereria.
english: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath came, Jesus went into the synagogue and began to teach.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase Eleazari, omokuani, na Yoshua, mosinto o Nuni, na ase abatang’ani abanene, bakabora, “Omonene nachigete Musa ng’a intwe toegwe orogongo ororabe omwando oito ase egati y’abaminto.” Ase ayio bakaegwa omwando ase egati y’abamwabo ise, buna Omonene achigete.
english: They went to Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the leaders and said, "The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers." So Joshua gave them an inheritance along with the brothers of their father, according to the LORD's command.

ekegusii: Erio bakagenda Gileadi na ase ense ya Tatimu‐Hodisi. Naende bakagenda Dani, na korwa Dani bagaetanana bagaika Sidoni.
english: They went to Gilead and the region of Tahtim Hodshi, and on to Dan Jaan and around toward Sidon.

ekegusii: Bakairera Hilikia, omokuani omonene, chibesa echi konya chiarentirwe ase enyomba ya Nyasae, na chiria Abalawi na abarendi b’ebisieri basangereretie korwa ase Abamanase na Abaefraimu, na korwa ase abanto abatigari b’Abaisraeli, na korwa ase Abayuda na Ababenjamin bonsi, na korwa ase abanto ba Yerusalemu.
english: They went to Hilkiah the high priest and gave him the money that had been brought into the temple of God, which the Levites who were the doorkeepers had collected from the people of Manasseh, Ephraim and the entire remnant of Israel and from all the people of Judah and Benjamin and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakagenda ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka, bakabora, “Ntwatiananetie bokong’u ng’a titoria gento goika twaitire Paulo.
english: They went to the chief priests and elders and said, "We have taken a solemn oath not to eat anything until we have killed Paul.

ekegusii: Na ase rituko ria gatato bakagenda korwania Ababenjamin, bakeroberia ase okorwana agwo Gibea, buna chingaki chiria chie ritang’ani.
english: They went up against the Benjamites on the third day and took up positions against Gibeah as they had done before.

ekegusii: Bagatiira, bakagenda ritang’ani ase ensemo ya irianyi y’ense eria, na bagaika Heburoni, agwo ase Ahimani, na Sesai, na Talimai, abanto b’ororeria rw’Anaki, bamenyete. (Heburoni konya oagachirwe emiaka etano na ebere ritang’ani omochie o Soani o Misiri otaraagachwa.)
english: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, lived. (Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

ekegusii: Ase ayio bakagenda ase omochie. Ekero barenge gosoa aroro bakarora Samweli ogocha koumerana nabarabwo, ekero arenge gotiira gochia aase agwo bakoruera ebing’wanso.
english: They went up to the town, and as they were entering it, there was Samuel, coming toward them on his way up to the high place.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo barenge abanene naende abatambe buna Abaanaki; boigo nigo barenge abange. Korende Omonene akabasiria, na Abaamoni bakaba bakomenya ase ense eria ribaga riabo.
english: They were a people strong and numerous, and as tall as the Anakites. The LORD destroyed them from before the Ammonites, who drove them out and settled in their place.

ekegusii: Barabwo babere bagakora obogima bwa Isaka na Rebeka koba nobororo obonge.
english: They were a source of grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

ekegusii: bonsi bakabatiswa ase Musa ime ase riire na ime ase enyancha.
english: They were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea.

ekegusii: They were all encouraged and ate some food themselves.
english: Erio bonsi bakagonkomoka, na barabwo bakaria endagera.

ekegusii: Omoondoko okabwata bonsi, bagatogia, Nyasae, bakabora, “Omobani omonene oorokire ase egati yaito!” Na “Nyasae ocheire abanto baye!”
english: They were all filled with awe and praised God. "A great prophet has appeared among us," they said. "God has come to help his people."

ekegusii: Abanto baria bonsi nigo baganetie gotwoboyia, bakorengereria ng’a nigo bagochia gotoita emioyo, toborwe chinguru chi’ogokora emeremo eyio, erinde etenene. Korende ngasaba, “Aye Nyasae, ing’a chinguru na oboremu.”
english: They were all trying to frighten us, thinking, "Their hands will get too weak for the work, and it will not be completed." [But I prayed,] "Now strengthen my hands."

ekegusii: Abateneneri abanene b’omoruoti Sulemani nigo barenge abanto amagana abere na emerongo etano; abwo nigo barenge kogambera abakori emeremo.
english: They were also King Solomon's chief officials-- two hundred and fifty officials supervising the men.

ekegusii: Abateneneri abanene igoro y’emeremo ya Sulemani nigo barenge abanto amagana atano, na emerongo etano; abwo nigo batenenerete abanto barenge gokora emeremo eria.
english: They were also the chief officials in charge of Solomon's projects-- 550 officials supervising the men who did the work.

ekegusii: Barabwo babe bagotenenera kera rituko, mambia na mogoroba, bakoiraneria Omonene ng’a mbuya mono na komotogia.
english: They were also to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD. They were to do the same in the evening

ekegusii: Bagakumia mono ase okworokereria kwaye, ekiagera ring’ana riaye riarenge nokobua.
english: They were amazed at his teaching, because his message had authority.

ekegusii: Abanene b’oboruoti boria bakagechigwa mono ase Yeremia; bakamoaka mono, bakamosiekera ase enyomba ya Yonathani omoriki, eyio konya yakorirwe ebe echela,
english: They were angry with Jeremiah and had him beaten and imprisoned in the house of Jonathan the secretary, which they had made into a prison.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo babwate amata, na nigo bamanyete koruta emegwe na amagena e chinduruche nokoboko gw’okorio amo nogw’okobee. Aba nigo barenge Ababenjamin, abanto bamwabo Saulo. Abanto aba nabwo aba:
english: they were armed with bows and were able to shoot arrows or to sling stones right-handed or left-handed; they were kinsmen of Saul from the tribe of Benjamin):

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagoserigwa korwa ase egati y’abanto, baakerwa amariogi korwa nyuma na kwogererwa buna abaibi.
english: They were banished from their fellow men, shouted at as if they were thieves.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bataboretigwe engaki yabo konya etaraika; na oboroso bwabo bokairwa buna omogoko okoira.
english: They were carried off before their time, their foundations washed away by a flood.

ekegusii: Bakagoka bakabwatana nere komoa chiropia.
english: They were delighted and agreed to give him money.

ekegusii: They were delighted to hear this and promised to give him money. So he watched for an opportunity to hand him over.
english: Na barabwo bagachia koyaigwa bakagoka, bakamoriera eira komoa chibesa. Akarigia enchera akomoruera ekero aranyore ribaga rigiya.

ekegusii: Ase igo bagenda komenya ase amakuruma are ase amagoko, na ase chingoro inse y’ense, na ase ebitare.
english: They were forced to live in the dry stream beds, among the rocks and in holes in the ground.

ekegusii: abanto b’ebisakubiria Omonene akanetie Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Timobaisa konyuomerana nabarabwo, ekiagera ekeene, nigo baraonchore chinkoro chiaino, erinde mogwe na koonchokera chinyasae chiabo.” Sulemani akabwatana nabarabwo, akabancha.
english: They were from nations about which the LORD had told the Israelites, "You must not intermarry with them, because they will surely turn your hearts after their gods." Nevertheless, Solomon held fast to them in love.

ekegusii: ase igo bakaegwa Heburoni amo namarisio aetanaineo, agwo ase ense ya Yuda.
english: They were given Hebron in Judah with its surrounding pasturelands.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akagwenera Abaisraeli, nabarabwo bagatogia Nyasae, na tibaba bakoroberia korwania Abareuben na Abagadi, gose gosaria ense eria bamenyete.
english: They were glad to hear the report and praised God. And they talked no more about going to war against them to devastate the country where the Reubenites and the Gadites lived.

ekegusii: Erio bakaba nomogoko, ekiagera banyorete obotoereru, na Omonene akabaikia ase ekiambokero keria baganetie.
english: They were glad when it grew calm, and he guided them to their desired haven.

ekegusii: bagechirie, ekiagera abatomwa barenge kworokereria abanto na koraria okobokigwa korwa ase abakure gokonyorekana ase Yeso.
english: They were greatly disturbed because the apostles were teaching the people and proclaiming in Jesus the resurrection of the dead.

ekegusii: Nigo barenge abamwenu, na bakaba bagokora ay’okogechia ase obosio bwane, Ase ayio, ekero naroche amang’ana ayio, nigo nabarusetieo.
english: They were haughty and did detestable things before me. Therefore I did away with them as you have seen.

ekegusii: Ekiagera bamwegenete Nyasae bakarera ase okonyora ogokonywa, na Nyasae akaigwa ogosaba kwabo, na barabwo bakabua Abahagari na abanto bonsi barenge amo nabarabwo.
english: They were helped in fighting them, and God handed the Hagrites and all their allies over to them, because they cried out to him during the battle. He answered their prayers, because they trusted in him.

ekegusii: Nigo babete nenchara na erang’o goika bakerusia moyo.
english: They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives ebbed away.

ekegusii: Naende babe bagotenenera emeremo y’emegati ekoruegwa ase Nyasae, na ey’obosie obonuke bw’okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ey’emegati ere emeoo etabekiri memera, na ey’ekarangeire orogio, na ey’obosie bwochoganirie amaguta, na ey’ebirengo binde bionsi.
english: They were in charge of the bread set out on the table, the flour for the grain offerings, the unleavened wafers, the baking and the mixing, and all measurements of quantity and size.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo atigete abanto aba ase ense eria, erinde ateeme Abaisraeli, arore gose mbatagete koigwera amachiko aria achigete chisokoro chiabo goetera ase Musa.
english: They were left to test the Israelites to see whether they would obey the LORD's commands, which he had given their forefathers through Moses.

ekegusii: Kobarigereretie mono gochia igoro, ekero are kogenda, rora, abasacha babere, babekeire chianga chindabu, bagatenena ang’e nabarabwo,
english: They were looking intently up into the sky as he was going, when suddenly two men dressed in white stood beside them.

ekegusii: Tichiaegwa ribaga ri’okobaita bakwe, korende eri’okobachanda ase engaki y’emetienyi etano. Okoroma kwabo nigo kwarenge buna okoroma gw’ekeuge gekoroma omonto.
english: They were not given power to kill them, but only to torture them for five months. And the agony they suffered was like that of the sting of a scorpion when it strikes a man.

ekegusii: Bakaba inchera, bagotiira kogenda Yerusalemu. Yeso nigo arenge obatang’aine, na barabwo bagaichana, na abamotunyanete bakairoka. Akaira naende baria ikomi na babere, agachaka kobatebia ebirage bi’amang’ana agochia komonyora,
english: They were on their way up to Jerusalem, with Jesus leading the way, and the disciples were astonished, while those who followed were afraid. Again he took the Twelve aside and told them what was going to happen to him.

ekegusii: Abanto bakabisangereria, bakabibeka chitui chinyinge, na ense yonsi egatioka bobe.
english: They were piled into heaps, and the land reeked of them.

ekegusii: Ee, amaene, abagweneire gokora bo, naende nabasira babo bare, ekiagera onye abanto b’Ebisaku babwatanire nabarabwo ase ogosesenigwa kwabo kw’omoika, igo nebagwenerete bakorere abachenu baria ase ebinto birabakonye ase obogima obo.
english: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in the Jews' spiritual blessings, they owe it to the Jews to share with them their material blessings.

ekegusii: Nigo baenenerete obwari bw’ebinto ebio, na korwa ase ebio bakaroisia emegwekano yabo y’okogechia na ey’obosooku. Ase ayio ninkore ebinto ebio bibe buna eubi asebare.
english: They were proud of their beautiful jewelry and used it to make their detestable idols and vile images. Therefore I will turn these into an unclean thing for them.

ekegusii: Barabwo nabwo barabe bakorenda ebinto ebi: Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana, na emesa, na ekebekerero gie chitaya, na ebisasimero, na ebikorero bionsi bi’Obomenyo boria, biria abakuani bagokorera emeremo, amo negetambaa gekengete Aase Aachenu Mono. Bakore emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie gokorwa ase ebinto ebio.
english: They were responsible for the care of the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used in ministering, the curtain, and everything related to their use.

ekegusii: Bagachaka goichana, bakamoboria oyomo oyomo “Inee! Ninche?”
english: They were saddened, and one by one they said to him, "Surely not I?"

ekegusii: Abanto kobagosambwa nomorero oria omotindi bakaragereria erieta ria Nyasae, oyore nokobua igoro y’amaakwa ayio, gose tibaonchoka na gotogia obonene bwaye.
english: They were seared by the intense heat and they cursed the name of God, who had control over these plagues, but they refused to repent and glorify him.

ekegusii: They were startled and frightened, thinking they saw a ghost.
english: Bakegosa, bagasogwa nomoondoko, bagakaga ng’a nerirengari barorire.

ekegusii: Bagaakwa amagena, bagateemwa, bakanachwa ne chinseke, bagaitwa nemeyio ya birende. Naende bagaetanana beboetie chingobo chie ching’ondi na echie chimbori, bakaba abaremerwa, bagachandwa na gokorwa bobe,
english: They were stoned; they were sawed in two; they were put to death by the sword. They went about in sheepskins and goatskins, destitute, persecuted and mistreated--

ekegusii: Na barabwo ngokwana baare barabwo ase barabwo igoro ase aya onsi akorekire.
english: They were talking with each other about everything that had happened.

ekegusii: Bagasogwa nomoondoko omonene, bagatebania, “Ning’o oyo rende, goika nonya nomwaga na enyancha bikomoigwera?”
english: They were terrified and asked each other, "Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!"

ekegusii: Aba nabwo baria batebetie omoruoti o Misiri ng’a barusie Abaisraeli korwa Misiri. Musa na Haroni nabwo baria baria.
english: They were the ones who spoke to Pharaoh king of Egypt about bringing the Israelites out of Egypt. It was the same Moses and Aaron.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo barenge abaroisia chinyongo na ababiare ba Netaimu na Gedera; aba nigo bamenyete amo nomoruoti, bakaba bakomokorera emeremo.
english: They were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah; they stayed there and worked for the king.

ekegusii: Chirochio chigatebigwa tichisaria obonyansi bw’ense, gose kemeri kende, gose mote onde bwonsi, otatiga chisarie abanto baria batari nekemanyererio kia Nyasae ase amasio abo igoro.
english: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

ekegusii: Na ekemitero keria kegatiringwa isiko y’omochie, na amanyinga agaiteka korwa ase ekemitero, na amanyinga aria akagenda ase oboare bwe chimaeli amagana abere, agaichora goika ebiokio bie chibarasi.
english: They were trampled in the winepress outside the city, and blood flowed out of the press, rising as high as the horses' bridles for a distance of 1,600 stadia.

ekegusii: Tibanyara komobwata ase ring’ana riaye ase obosio bw’abanto; bagakumia ase okoiraneria kwaye, bagakira.
english: They were unable to trap him in what he had said there in public. And astonished by his answer, they became silent.

ekegusii: Bagateba ring’ana eri ase okomoteema, banyore enchera bakomosoera. Korende Yeso agekumba, akarika nekiara kiaye inse.
english: They were using this question as a trap, in order to have a basis for accusing him. But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger.

ekegusii: Bagaichana mono, bagachaka kera oyomo komoboria, “Inee! Omonene, ninche?”
english: They were very sad and began to say to him one after the other, "Surely not I, Lord?"

ekegusii: Naki ekero gete omomalaika ngoika arenge asoa ase ritibo riria, oturubania amache. Nabo ere oyorenge gosoa ritang’ani nyuma ase amache gaturubanigwe, nigo arenge kogwena oborwaire bonde bwonsi obwamonyorete.]
english: They were waiting for the water to move, because every now and then an angel of the Lord went down into the pool and stirred up the water.
