The first sick person to go into the pool after the water was stirred up was healed from whatever disease he had. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version.]

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwane, mbagende gochia inse kegima y’ense.
english: They who seek my life will be destroyed; they will go down to the depths of the earth.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bagotiana ase ebibe bi’Abasamaria, bagoteba: Aye Dani, ekeene, buna enyasae yao ere moyo, naende bateba: Ekeene, buna enchera egochia Beeri‐Seba egendererete kobao, abanto abwo goika bagwe, tibaboka rinde.”
english: They who swear by the shame of Samaria, or say, 'As surely as your god lives, O Dan,' or, 'As surely as the god of Beersheba lives'-- they will fall, never to rise again."

ekegusii: Chinsagia echio chionsi nchitigerwe chinyoni chi’ebitunwa ne ching’iti chi’ense. Chinyoni chintindi nchimenyeo ase engaki y’omobaso, ne ching’iti chionsi chi’ense ase engaki y’obokendu.
english: They will all be left to the mountain birds of prey and to the wild animals; the birds will feed on them all summer, the wild animals all winter.

ekegusii: Echio chionsi nchiche chimenye ase amagoko, na ase chingako chi’ebitare, na ase ebitutu bi’amagwa, na ase ebitii bionsi.
english: They will all come and settle in the steep ravines and in the crevices in the rocks, on all the thornbushes and at all the water holes.

ekegusii: They will all respond, they will say to you, "You also have become weak, as we are; you have become like us."
english: Abwo bonsi mbakwane, bagotebie: Bono naye kwaurirwe chinguru buna intwe, gwatogwekanire.

ekegusii: Boigo mbakorusie chianga, na baire ebinto biao ebiya bwechaberete.
english: They will also strip you of your clothes and take your fine jewelry.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbaborie bamanye enchera ekogenda Sayoni, babe bakoonchora amasio abo gochia aroro, batebania: Inchuo tobwatane n’Omonene, tokore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nere, okwo koragenderere botambe gotanyare kwebwa.
english: They will ask the way to Zion and turn their faces toward it. They will come and bind themselves to the LORD in an everlasting covenant that will not be forgotten.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe buna egetinti gechabeire ase omotwe oo, na buna chisonoi chingiya chire ase rigoti riao.
english: They will be a garland to grace your head and a chain to adorn your neck.

ekegusii: Okwo nigo korabe ekemanyererio na ogokumia igoro asemore, na ase chinderia chiaino kogenderera botambe.
english: They will be a sign and a wonder to you and your descendants forever.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbarokwe “Abanto abachenu”, na “Ababoorigwe n’Omonene”, na aye omonyene norokwe “Omochie origigwe”, na “Omochie otatigwe.”
english: They will be called the Holy People, the Redeemed of the LORD; and you will be called Sought After, the City No Longer Deserted.

ekegusii: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law."
english: Mbaatananeke, ise na omwana omomura, na omwana omomura na ise, ng’ina na omwana omoiseke, na omwana omoiseke na ng’ina; ng’ina biara, na moka momura oye, moka momura oye na ng’ina biara.”

ekegusii: Nabaisa kobwatana buna amagwa akweringania, na gotinda nekenyugwa kegotindia, goika bayie baere buna obonyansi obwomo.
english: They will be entangled among thorns and drunk from their wine; they will be consumed like dry stubble.

ekegusii: Nasiarerwe inse y’erioba, na omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni chionsi, ebinto ebio abanto aba banchete gokorera, bakabirigia mono na kobitunyana, naende bakabisasima. Amauga ayio tagosangererigwa amo, gose gotindekwa, korende nabe buna obwoyo bore ase riroba.
english: They will be exposed to the sun and the moon and all the stars of the heavens, which they have loved and served and which they have followed and consulted and worshiped. They will not be gathered up or buried, but will be like refuse lying on the ground.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bararuegwe baitwe nemioro, babe endagera ye chisese chi’orosana.
english: They will be given over to the sword and become food for jackals.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbasangererigwe amo buna abasibwa, babekwe ase engoro eyemo; mbasiekerwe buna abasibwa, na ekero amatuko amange aerire mbaegwe egesusuro.
english: They will be herded together like prisoners bound in a dungeon; they will be shut up in prison and be punished after many days.

ekegusii: Igo ebio mbibe obogima ase omoyo oo, na ogwechabera okuya ase rigoti riao.
english: they will be life for you, an ornament to grace your neck.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae obo.
english: They will be my people, and I will be their God.

ekegusii: Bakonyorwa nobobe buna eng’eria y’ogokora okobe. Barabwo nigo bagokaga ng’a ogotinda na okwegokia ekero kia mobaso nobwansu. Babeire ebimoa bi’obosooku na amamocho, bakwegokia ase obong’ainereria bwabo kobagokora emeyega amo nainwe.
english: They will be paid back with harm for the harm they have done. Their idea of pleasure is to carouse in broad daylight. They are blots and blemishes, reveling in their pleasures while they feast with you.

ekegusii: Emechie eyio nebe obotamero bwaino, erinde omonto oria okorigia korusia egesiomba ki’oyomwabo oria oitwa, omoiti oria aratamere gochiao, abeereo goika rituko arache korentwa kogambigwa ase obosio bw’omosangererekano bwonsi.
english: They will be places of refuge from the avenger, so that a person accused of murder may not die before he stands trial before the assembly.

ekegusii: Barabwo nabanyore egesusuro ki’ogosareka, naende nabaatananwe korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene kare na kare, na korwa ase obonene bw’okobua kwaye,
english: They will be punished with everlasting destruction and shut out from the presence of the Lord and from the majesty of his power

ekegusii: Ebinto ebio nabiirwe goika Babeli bigenderere kobeerao, goika ekero rituko riria ndabianchere birusigweo birentwe aase aiga.”
english: 'They will be taken to Babylon and there they will remain until the day I come for them,' declares the LORD. 'Then I will bring them back and restore them to this place.'"

ekegusii: Abwo mbabogorie egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo, egesusuro ki’omobani na eki’omonto oria ochete koboria amang’ana korwa asare, nigo kerabe ekemo.
english: They will bear their guilt-- the prophet will be as guilty as the one who consults him.

ekegusii: “Abwo mbagochere amo nomoganda omonene, bagoake amagena na gokobutorana nemioro.
english: They will bring a mob against you, who will stone you and hack you to pieces with their swords.

ekegusii: Mbagotugute gochia ase embeera ime, aye nokwe ogokwa buna okw’abwo baitetwe nemioro bakarutwa agwo ase enyancha ime.
english: They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die a violent death in the heart of the seas.

ekegusii: Abanto mbaagache chinyomba na gochimenya, mbasimeke emesabibu ase emegondo yabo, babe bakoria okwama kw’emegondo eyio.
english: They will build houses and dwell in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

ekegusii: Mbasambe chinyomba chiao, naende bakonachere ekina ase amasio ’abakungu abange. Ningotange tokora obonyaka, na tokogenderera korua chibesa ase obonyaka naende.
english: They will burn down your houses and inflict punishment on you in the sight of many women. I will put a stop to your prostitution, and you will no longer pay your lovers.

ekegusii: Mbararie chinkuma chi’obuya bwao obonge, babe bagotera namariogi amanene gotogia oboronge bwao.
english: They will celebrate your abundant goodness and joyfully sing of your righteousness.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba ng’a mbageche rinani ri’ense eria nonya rire rinoru mono ritaetwe nonde, ekiagera abwo nigo bare abange mono kobua chingige, tibakonyara kobareka.
english: They will chop down her forest," declares the LORD, "dense though it be. They are more numerous than locusts, they cannot be counted.

ekegusii: Mbagochere babwate ebirwanero, ne chigari ao ao, na omoganda omonene bw’abanto babwate chinguba, ne ching’aya, babegete ebigogwa bi’ebioma, bakoumokere korwa chinsemo chionsi. Inche nimbachike bakonachere ekina kobwatekana namachiko abo.
english: They will come against you with weapons, chariots and wagons and with a throng of people; they will take up positions against you on every side with large and small shields and with helmets. I will turn you over to them for punishment, and they will punish you according to their standards.

ekegusii: Nabachiche bagotera neriogi rinene igoro y’egetunwa gia Sayoni; nabaayerere gochia ase obuya bw’Omonene, gochia ase endagera, na edivai, na amaguta ’amazeituni, na ase chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na echie chimbori, ne chimori chie chiombe. Obogima bwabo nabobe buna omogondo ogoitororerwa amache; barabwo tibakogoya nonya ng’ake.
english: They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion; they will rejoice in the bounty of the LORD-- the grain, the new wine and the oil, the young of the flocks and herds. They will be like a well-watered garden, and they will sorrow no more.

ekegusii: Mbairuruke buna chinyoni korwa Misiri, bache bakoiguswa, na buna amaruma korwa ase ense y’Asuri. Nimbabeke bamenye ase chinka chiabo.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt, like doves from Assyria. I will settle them in their homes," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero barairane mbache bakorera, korende inche nimbatang’ane mbairanie gocha bagosaba. Nimbatang’ane gochia ase chindooche chi’amache, mbaeterie ase enchera engiya ase batagochwe. Inche nigo inde ise bw’Abaisraeli, na Efraimu nomwana one omotangi.
english: They will come with weeping; they will pray as I bring them back. I will lead them beside streams of water on a level path where they will not stumble, because I am Israel's father, and Ephraim is my firstborn son.

ekegusii: Ne chingige echio inachitube ense eye yonsi, erio monto tanyara korora riroba, na chirochio inachisirie endagera eria etasaretigwe nembura y’amagena, amo na kera omote ore ase ense yao.
english: They will cover the face of the ground so that it cannot be seen. They will devour what little you have left after the hail, including every tree that is growing in your fields.

ekegusii: na bakoiyerie inse, na abana bao ime asore. Tibagotiga ime asore rigena erimo igoro ase erinde, ekiagera otamanyeti engaki y’ogocherwa kwao.”
english: They will dash you to the ground, you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of God's coming to you."

ekegusii: Barabwo mbakogeche mono, bakoure ebinto biao bionsi, ebio gwechanderete okabinyora. Nigo baragotige kore getirianda, otari na gento ogwetuba. Erio obosooku bw’obonyaka bwao bororekane. Obosooku bwao na obonyaka gwakorire
english: They will deal with you in hatred and take away everything you have worked for. They will leave you naked and bare, and the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your lewdness and promiscuity

ekegusii: Abwo mbasarie chindwaki chia Turo, batagore nemerobiri y’ogotengerera. Inche nincheche riroba riaye rionsi, erinde aase agwo atigare are egetare gioka.
english: They will destroy the walls of Tyre and pull down her towers; I will scrape away her rubble and make her a bare rock.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbarie chimori chie chiombe chiaino, na okwama kwe riroba riaino, goika mosirigwe kegima. Tibakobatigareria endagera yaino, gose edivai, gose amaguta, gose chimori chie chiombe chiaino, gose chimanwa chie ching’ondi na echie chimbori chiaino; nabagere mosire kegima.
english: They will devour the young of your livestock and the crops of your land until you are destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine or oil, nor any calves of your herds or lambs of your flocks until you are ruined.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbarie okwama gwe chindagera chiaino, na abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, ne ching’ondi ne chiombe chiaino, na amasabibu na amako aino. Emechie yaino egiteire chindwaki, eyio mosemeretie, barabwo nabayetagore nemioro.”
english: They will devour your harvests and food, devour your sons and daughters; they will devour your flocks and herds, devour your vines and fig trees. With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust.

ekegusii: Naende ayio nababakorere, ekiagera tibamomanyeti Tata, nonya ninche.
english: They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.

ekegusii: Ase ayio mbarie okwama kw’ogokora kwabo, baisaneke nemeroberio yabo abanyene
english: they will eat the fruit of their ways and be filled with the fruit of their schemes.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe bakoria okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, na ebi’okomocha, na kera egento keraatananwe na gokungwa asende korwa ase egati y’Abaisraeli nkebe eki’abakuani.
english: They will eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings; and everything in Israel devoted to the LORD will belong to them.

ekegusii: “Abanto ba Misiri mbaitwe barare amo nabwo baitetwe nemioro. Emioro y’okobasiria yarurwe. Ase ayio rusia ense eyio aroro amo nemeganda yaye yonsi.
english: They will fall among those killed by the sword. The sword is drawn; let her be dragged off with all her hordes.

ekegusii: Barabwo nabagwe ase chinsonga chi’emioro, nabooswe bairwe ase ebisaku bionsi, na Yerusalemu notachwe nabanto b’Ebisaku, goika ebiro biabo biikeranigwe.
english: They will fall by the sword and will be taken as prisoners to all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled on by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo mbaitwe ase ense y’Abakalidayo, babe bakwete ase chinchera chi’emechie yabo.
english: They will fall down slain in Babylon, fatally wounded in her streets.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbakorwanie, korende tibagokobua, ekiagera inche nigo inde amo naye ngokonye. Nabo inche Omonene ngoteba.”
english: They will fight against you but will not overcome you, for I am with you and will rescue you," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Chinyomba chiaino amo nechi’abasomba bao, na echi’Abamisiri bonsi inachiichorwe ne chingige. Omogwekano bw’echio chisokoro chiao gose chisokororia chitaroche nonya ng’ake korwa ekero bachagete komenya ase ense eye goika rero iga.” Erio Musa akaonchoka, akarua o Farao.
english: They will fill your houses and those of all your officials and all the Egyptians-- something neither your fathers nor your forefathers have ever seen from the day they settled in this land till now.'" Then Moses turned and left Pharaoh.

ekegusii: Erio basoe ase emienya y’ebitare, na ase obotandoku bw’aroro, mbatame korwa ase okoirokia kw’Omonene, na korwa ase obonene bwaye bore obonene mono, ekero araimoke kwoboyia ense.
english: They will flee to caverns in the rocks and to the overhanging crags from dread of the LORD and the splendor of his majesty, when he rises to shake the earth.

ekegusii: “Abanto abwo mbabwatie Omonene; ere narume buna endo, ee, narume, na abanto baye mbache korwa bosongo bakoiguswa.
english: They will follow the LORD; he will roar like a lion. When he roars, his children will come trembling from the west.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli baramenye ase ense eyio bare nobotoereru, na monto onde takoboboyia, erio mbabwatwe nobosooku ase engencho y’ogosaria gwonsi bakorete.
english: They will forget their shame and all the unfaithfulness they showed toward me when they lived in safety in their land with no one to make them afraid.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbagokwanie, bakoe emegati ebere, noyianche, oyebogorie korwa ase amaboko abo.
english: They will greet you and offer you two loaves of bread, which you will accept from them.

ekegusii: erinde bikorende korwa ase omokungu omonyaka ogokwana amang’ana ay’okoebereria.
english: they will keep you from the adulteress, from the wayward wife with her seductive words.

ekegusii: Barabwo inabamoite, ne rituko ria gatato naboke.” Bagaichana mono.
english: They will kill him, and on the third day he will be raised to life." And the disciples were filled with grief.

ekegusii: Barabwo nabamanye ng’a inche ninche Nyasae obo; ninche nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde imbe imenyete ase egati yabo. Inche ninche Nyasae obo.”
english: They will know that I am the LORD their God, who brought them out of Egypt so that I might dwell among them. I am the LORD their God.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo barabamige mono ase emechie yaino yonsi, babarwanie goika chindwaki chiaino chintambe, echio morabe mosemeretie, chigwe inse agwo ase ense yaino yonsi; ee, mbabamige ase emechie yaino yonsi ase ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, abaeire.
english: They will lay siege to all the cities throughout your land until the high fortified walls in which you trust fall down. They will besiege all the cities throughout the land the LORD your God is giving you.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbamene orotu rwe riroba buna ching’iti chingenda inse. Mbarue ase chinyomba chiabo chinkong’u bakoiguswa bekurure inse buna amakonde; mbakoonchokere aye Omonene, Nyasae oito, bare nobwoba obonene, ee, mbakoiroke aye.
english: They will lick dust like a snake, like creatures that crawl on the ground. They will come trembling out of their dens; they will turn in fear to the LORD our God and will be afraid of you.

ekegusii: Barabwo nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde togochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.
english: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

ekegusii: naende, “Nabakoimokie ase amaboko abo, erinde tobaisa kogochwa okogoro kwao ne rigena.”
english: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.'"

ekegusii: Mbamenye ase ense eyio chisokoro chiabo chiamenyete, eyio naete Yakobo, omosomba one. Barabwo mbamenyeo, boigo na abana babo, na abachokoro, na abachokororia, goika kare na kare; na Daudi, omosomba one, nere orabe omogambi obo goika kare na kare.
english: They will live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob, the land where your fathers lived. They and their children and their children's children will live there forever, and David my servant will be their prince forever.

ekegusii: Mbamenye nobotoereru ase ense eyio; baagache chinyomba, naende basimeke emesabibu ase emegondo. Barabwo mbamenye nobotoereru, ekero ndanachere abanto bonsi babaetanaine ekina, abwo babachayete. Erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.”
english: They will live there in safety and will build houses and plant vineyards; they will live in safety when I inflict punishment on all their neighbors who maligned them. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.'"

ekegusii: Abwo nabakore esegi barwanie Emanwa y’Eng’ondi, na Emanwa y’Eng’ondi nababue, ekiagera ere n’Omonene bw’abanene, na Omoruoti bw’abaruoti; na abwo barangerigwe, na abachore, na abegenwa nababue amo nere.”
english: They will make war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will overcome them because he is Lord of lords and King of kings-- and with him will be his called, chosen and faithful followers."

ekegusii: Aase onsi ase egetunwa kiane egechenu, ayare amabe, gose ayagosiria tagokorekana aroro; ekiagera ense neichorwe nabanto bamomanyete Omonene, buna amache aichire ase enyancha.
english: They will neither harm nor destroy on all my holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.

ekegusii: Tibakoba nenchara, gose erang’o, eguru‐gura na omobaso tibikobasamba, ekiagera Omonene oria obaroreire amabera nabaraae, nabatang’ane gochia ase chinsoko chi’amache.
english: They will neither hunger nor thirst, nor will the desert heat or the sun beat upon them. He who has compassion on them will guide them and lead them beside springs of water.

ekegusii: Tibagotwarwa buna ching’iti naende nabanto b’ebisaku, gose ching’iti chi’orosana tichikobaria. Mbabe bamenyete bare noborendi obuya, gose onde tari oraboboyie.
english: They will no longer be plundered by the nations, nor will wild animals devour them. They will live in safety, and no one will make them afraid.

ekegusii: Tibakogenderera gwesoyia ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasima emegwekano yabo, gose ase ogokora kwabo gw’okogechia, gose ase ogosaria kwabo konde gwonsi. Nimbatoorie korwa ase obomenyo bwabo bwonsi agwo aase bakorerete ebibe, nimbachene. Erio mbabe abanto baane, na inche nimbe Nyasae obo.
english: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols and vile images or with any of their offenses, for I will save them from all their sinful backsliding, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

ekegusii: Tibagosemeria ebisasimero ebire emeremo y’amaboko abo, gose tibakorigereria emete eteneneirie Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, gose ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani, ebi baroisirie nebiara biabo.
english: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands, and they will have no regard for the Asherah poles and the incense altars their fingers have made.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio Abaisraeli tibakogenda orosana gotenya chinko, gose gotema emete ase amanani. Ebirwanero ebio mbibe chinko chiabo bagoutera omorero. Barabwo mbasakore ebinto bi’abwo babasakorete, na baure abwo babaurete chinibo chiabo. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: They will not need to gather wood from the fields or cut it from the forests, because they will use the weapons for fuel. And they will plunder those who plundered them and loot those who looted them, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Tibakorua okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gi’edivai ase Omonene, ere takogokera ebing’wanso bararue asare. Okoruegwa okwo kw’endagera bararue asare nigo korabe buna endagera y’ebirero; na omonto onde bwensi orayerie nigo arabe oyo otachenegeti, ekiagera endagera eyio erabe egoisanekia oyore nenchara rioka, tekorentwa ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: They will not pour out wine offerings to the LORD, nor will their sacrifices please him. Such sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat them will be unclean. This food will be for themselves; it will not come into the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibakogenderera komenya ase ense y’Omonene; Abaefraimu mbairane gochia ase ense ya Misiri, na agwo Asuri babe bakoria endagera etachenegeti.
english: They will not remain in the LORD's land; Ephraim will return to Egypt and eat unclean food in Assyria.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibakoba bagokora emeremo ya bosa, gose tibakoibora abana barakwe mobosokano, ekiagera bare oroiboro rw’abasesenirie n’Omonene, na abana babo boigo.
english: They will not toil in vain or bear children doomed to misfortune; for they will be a people blessed by the LORD, they and their descendants with them.

ekegusii: Ekero baraete ase egati y’enyancha y’emechando, inche Omonene ning’ake emerindo yaye, ne chindiba chionsi chi’orooche rwa Naili nchikame; na igo oboenenu bw’Abaasuri mbotiringerwe inse, na enyimbo y’obogambi ya Misiri nesirigwe.
english: They will pass through the sea of trouble; the surging sea will be subdued and all the depths of the Nile will dry up. Assyria's pride will be brought down and Egypt's scepter will pass away.

ekegusii: Ebio inabisire, korende aye nigo oragenderere kobao, birobio inabigote buna eanga,
english: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment.

ekegusii: Echio chionsi nchisirigwe, korende aye nigo oreo kare na kare, echio chionsi nchigote buna eanga, ekiagera aye nigo ogochionchoreria buna eanga ekoonchorerigwa, ee, nigo chirasirigwe kegima.
english: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them and they will be discarded.

ekegusii: nababwata ching’iti, gose nabanywa egento kegoita, ko tigekobaita nonya ng’ake; nababeke amaboko abo igoro ase abarwaire, na barabwo nabagwene.”
english: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well."

ekegusii: Abanto abwo mbakoure obotenenku bwao bwonsi, na mbaire ebinto biao bi’oboonchoreria; mbatagore chindwaki chiao ne chinyomba chiao chingiya. Nigo baraimokie amagena, ne chibao, na amaroba, babirute ase chinyancha ime.
english: They will plunder your wealth and loot your merchandise; they will break down your walls and demolish your fine houses and throw your stones, timber and rubble into the sea.

ekegusii: Oboronge bwaye mbobe bokorarigwa ase abanto bataraiborwa, ng’a ere oikeranirie onsi.
english: They will proclaim his righteousness to a people yet unborn-- for he has done it.

ekegusii: Erio batobwatie, naintwe tobang’use gochia aare korwa ase omochie. Barabwo barengererie iga: Bono batamire korwa asetore, buna bakorete engaki eria ye ritang’ani.
english: They will pursue us until we have lured them away from the city, for they will say, 'They are running away from us as they did before.' So when we flee from them,

ekegusii: They will put on sackcloth and be clothed with terror. Their faces will be covered with shame and their heads will be shaved.
english: Mbeboyie chigunia, batubwe nomoondoko. Amasio abo nabe nobosooku, na emetwe yabo esunyoke etukia ebe amasio.

ekegusii: Nababaserie korwa ase chisinagogi; nabo engaki neche ekero onde bwensi arabaite akage ng’a okoreire Nyasae emeremo.
english: They will put you out of the synagogue; in fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God.

ekegusii: Abwo mbakoreere aye namariogi amanene, bare nobororo obonge, mbasiarere ebuse ase emetwe yabo, begara‐garie ase ribu igoro.
english: They will raise their voice and cry bitterly over you; they will sprinkle dust on their heads and roll in ashes.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbaagache naende amaturi a kare, mbatenenie amaagacho a kare asaretigwe; mbaroisie naende emechie eria yatagoretwe, aase agwo atigetwe asaregete nebiaare ebinge.
english: They will rebuild the ancient ruins and restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities that have been devastated for generations.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbasirie ense y’Abaasuri nemioro, na ense ya Nimurodi bayesirie nemeyio ya birende. Boigo mbatotoorie korwa ase Abaasuri ekero barasoe ase ense yaito goetera ase chimbebe chiaito.
english: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, the land of Nimrod with drawn sword. He will deliver us from the Assyrian when he invades our land and marches into our borders.

ekegusii: “Kera omonto nakwane igoro yane na goteba: Oboronge ne chinguru nigo bire ase Omonene bweka; bonsi abamogechete mbache asare basookigwe.
english: They will say of me, 'In the LORD alone are righteousness and strength.'" All who have raged against him will come to him and be put to shame.

ekegusii: Abanto mbatebe:” “Ense eye yasaretigwe egatigwa ere bosa, bono yabeire buna omogondo o Edeni, na emechie eyio yatagoretwe egatigwa ere amaturi, bono yamenyirwe na kogiterwa chindwaki.
english: They will say, "This land that was laid waste has become like the garden of Eden; the cities that were lying in ruins, desolate and destroyed, are now fortified and inhabited."

ekegusii: bagoteba, “Ng’ai bore oboikeranu bw’eira eria y’ogocha kwaye? Naki korwa agwo chisokoro chiaito chiararete ebinto bionsi nabo bigendererete engencho eyio eyio, buna biarenge korwa omochakano bw’ogotongwa.”
english: They will say, "Where is this 'coming' he promised? Ever since our fathers died, everything goes on as it has since the beginning of creation."

ekegusii: Na barabwo nabamorore obosio bwaye, na erieta riaye naribe ase amasio abo igoro.
english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

ekegusii: Mbakigite chitukia chiabo ase engencho yao, na beboyie chigunia; nigo barabe bagokoreera nobororo bwe chinkoro chiabo, babokie amagombo bare nobororo.
english: They will shave their heads because of you and will put on sackcloth. They will weep over you with anguish of soul and with bitter mourning.

ekegusii: ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ngocha are, ee, ngocha are konachera ense ekina. Nigo aranachere ense ekina ase oboronge, na anachere abanto ekina ase obwegenwa.
english: they will sing before the LORD, for he comes, he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in his truth.

ekegusii: Babusuire engano, korende mbagese amagwa. Babeire bakwerosia ase emeremo, korende tibanyoreti ebitoki. Mwanyorire obosooku ase ogotanyora rigesa, ekiagera Omonene abeire nendamwamu enene asemore.”
english: They will sow wheat but reap thorns; they will wear themselves out but gain nothing. So bear the shame of your harvest because of the LORD's fierce anger."

ekegusii: Nimbe nkorengereria mono igoro y’obonene bwao bw’ogosikwa okonene, na igoro y’emeremo yao y’ogokumia.
english: They will speak of the glorious splendor of your majesty, and I will meditate on your wonderful works.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbarambore amaboko abo buna omonto akorambora amaboko aye ase ogoaka entimbu, korende Omonene nasirie oboenenu bwabo amo nobong’ainereria bw’emeremo y’amaboko abo.
english: They will spread out their hands in it, as a swimmer spreads out his hands to swim. God will bring down their pride despite the cleverness of their hands.

ekegusii: Abwo mbakine buna obonyansi, bakine buna emesobeti ere ase chindooche mbarabare.
english: They will spring up like grass in a meadow, like poplar trees by flowing streams.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bakogenderera goseboka nonya bagotire, nigo baragenderere kobesea.
english: They will still bear fruit in old age, they will stay fresh and green,

ekegusii: Namogochane buna abanto bagotama korwa ase esegi, nonya monto onde tari kobabwatia. Timokonyara koba ne chinguru chi’okorwania ababisa baino.
english: They will stumble over one another as though fleeing from the sword, even though no one is pursuing them. So you will not be able to stand before your enemies.

ekegusii: Agatiga emeganda yaino ekagochwa na kogwa, erio bagakwana na gotebania Omonto ase omonto: Imoka, toirane ase abanto baito, ase ense yaito twaiboreretwe, totame korwa ase omoro bw’abagotochanda.
english: They will stumble repeatedly; they will fall over each other. They will say, 'Get up, let us go back to our own people and our native lands, away from the sword of the oppressor.'

ekegusii: Barabwo mbarangerie abanto b’ebisaku bachiche ase egetunwa kiabo, aroro agwo nabarue ebing’wanso ebironge, ekiagera nigo bakonyora obotenenku bwabo korwa ase chinyancha chinibo chibisekanete ime y’omokenye.”
english: They will summon peoples to the mountain and there offer sacrifices of righteousness; they will feast on the abundance of the seas, on the treasures hidden in the sand."

ekegusii: Abayuda na Abaefraimu mbaumokere Abafilisti korwa ensemo ya bosongo, naende mbasakore abanto ba moocha. Erio barwanie Abaedomu na Abamoabu; Abaamoni mbabe bakoaigwera.
english: They will swoop down on the slopes of Philistia to the west; together they will plunder the people to the east. They will lay hands on Edom and Moab, and the Ammonites will be subject to them.

ekegusii: Mbabe bakoraria obonene bw’oboruoti bwao, naende babe bagokwana igoro y’okobua kwao,
english: They will tell of the glory of your kingdom and speak of your might,

ekegusii: Abanto mbabe bakoraria ogokora kwao okonene gw’okoirokia, nainche nimbe nkoraria obonene bwao.
english: They will tell of the power of your awesome works, and I will proclaim your great deeds.

ekegusii: Bagasiara ebuse igoro ase emetwe yabo, bakorera, na gokuura, na kweumia, bagoteba, “Obobe, obobe nobwaye, omochie oria omonene! Ase chinibo chiaye bonsi ababwate chimeeri ase enyancha betenenkirie. Ase ensa eyemo yoka obeire bosa.
english: They will throw dust on their heads, and with weeping and mourning cry out: "'Woe! Woe, O great city, where all who had ships on the sea became rich through her wealth! In one hour she has been brought to ruin!

ekegusii: Mbatugute chifeta chiabo ase chinchera; chitahabu chiabo nchibarwe chibe buna egento ki’eubi. Chifeta ne chitahabu chiabo tichikonyara kobatooria ase rituko ri’endamwamu y’Omonene. Ebinto ebio tibigoisanekia okogania kwabo, gose tibikobaigotia, ekiagera nigo biabete ebigocha bikagera bagakora ebibe.
english: They will throw their silver into the streets, and their gold will be an unclean thing. Their silver and gold will not be able to save them in the day of the LORD's wrath. They will not satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs with it, for it has made them stumble into sin.

ekegusii: nababatugute ase eriko ri’omorero. Aroro agwo abanto inababe nekerero na okoriania amaino.
english: They will throw them into the fiery furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

ekegusii: Korende aya onsi nababakorere ase engencho y’erieta riane, ekiagera tibamomanyeti oyontomete.
english: They will treat you this way because of my name, for they do not know the One who sent me.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbeatanane korwa ase okoigwa ayare ay’ekeene, na koonchokera emegano ao ao.
english: They will turn their ears away from the truth and turn aside to myths.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, nimbakore babe abasomba baye, erio nario baranyare komanya ogwatananekana kore egati ase ogonkorera inche na ogokorera abaruoti be chinse.”
english: They will, however, become subject to him, so that they may learn the difference between serving me and serving the kings of other lands."

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bateemete Nyasae ase chinkoro chiabo ime, bakagania baegwe endagera basanerete.
english: They willfully put God to the test by demanding the food they craved.

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagonsasima ogosasima kwa bosa, bakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiko a mwanyabanto oka.
english: They worship me in vain; their teachings are but rules taught by men.'

ekegusii: Abwo nigo bagonsasima ogosasima kwa bosa kobakworokereria amorokererio ayare amachiko a mwanyabanto oka.”
english: They worship me in vain; their teachings are but rules taught by men.'"

ekegusii: bagakorera emegwekano y’ogosasimwa eyio Omonene abakanetie ng’a tibayekorera.
english: They worshiped idols, though the LORD had said, "You shall not do this."

ekegusii: Boigo bakamoiroka Omonene, bagachora korwa ase egati yabo abanto be chingencho ao ao bakaba abakuani b’aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa, baria baruete ebing’wanso ase engencho yabo ase chinyomba chi’aase aria.
english: They worshiped the LORD, but they also appointed all sorts of their own people to officiate for them as priests in the shrines at the high places.

ekegusii: Bakamoiroka Omonene, korende boigo bagakorera chinyasae chiabo abanyene, bagakora buna abanto b’ebisaku biria, ase bang’anyetigwe korwa, barenge gokora.
english: They worshiped the LORD, but they also served their own gods in accordance with the customs of the nations from which they had been brought.

ekegusii: Nigo bakorerete emegwekano yabo baare gosasima, na eyio ekaba amareba asebare.
english: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

ekegusii: Barabwo tibabaisa koba buna chisokoro chiabo, chiria chitaigwerete, naende chiasaretie; tichiarenge ne chinkoro chindonge, gose tichiarenge chinyegenwa ase Nyasae ase emioyo yabo.
english: They would not be like their forefathers-- a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose hearts were not loyal to God, whose spirits were not faithful to him.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo bakaanga tibaigwera, bagakora buna chingencho chiabo chintang’ani chiarenge.
english: They would not listen, however, but persisted in their former practices.

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba bakobeera isiko bagaetanana enyomba ya Nyasae, ekiagera emeremo y’oborendi nigo yabegetwe igoro asebare, naende nabwo barenge koigora enyomba eria kera emambia.
english: They would spend the night stationed around the house of God, because they had to guard it; and they had charge of the key for opening it each morning.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakabwatana na Baali, enyasae ya Peori, bakaria ebing’wanso biarenge koruegwa ase chinyasae chitari moyo.
english: They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;

ekegusii: Amare amarito nigo amotubete, takonyara korora, naende nigo agotaara ase obokumbe bwa igoro.
english: Thick clouds veil him, so he does not see us as he goes about in the vaulted heavens.'

ekegusii: Rora, aye kworokereirie abanto abange, na amaboko atabwate chinguru kwayakong’irie.
english: Think how you have instructed many, how you have strengthened feeble hands.

ekegusii: Barabwo bagakaga ng’a nigo are ase omoganda obo, bakagenda orogendo rw’omobaso oyomo, bakamorigia ase eamate yabo na ase abairi.
english: Thinking he was in their company, they traveled on for a day. Then they began looking for him among their relatives and friends.

ekegusii: thirty female camels with their young, forty cows and ten bulls, and twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.
english: ne chingamia chiare gokamwa emerongo etato, amo ne chimori chiabo, ne chiombe chiaberi emerongo ene, ne chintang’ana ikomi, ne chitigere chiaberi emerongo ebere, ne chitigere chinsacha ikomi.

ekegusii: Korwa engaki twarwete Kadeshi‐Barinea goika ekero twambogete akarooche ga Seredi nigo yarenge emiaka emerongo etato, na etano na etato. Abanto bonsi b’ekegori keria, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagakwa bakaera, buna Omonene konya atianire.
english: Thirty-eight years passed from the time we left Kadesh Barnea until we crossed the Zered Valley. By then, that entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.

ekegusii: Aya nigo akoregete Bethania ng’umbu ya Yorodan, aase Yohana arenge kobatisera.
english: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

ekegusii: Aya akamanyekana ase Yopa, ase omochie omogima, na abanto abange bakamwegena Omonene.
english: This became known all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.

ekegusii: Kera rituko ri’Esabato botambe emegati eroberigwe ase emesa igoro, agwo ase obosio bwane. Okwo nokoruegwa korwa ase Abaisraeli, nakobe okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa botambe.
english: This bread is to be set out before the LORD regularly, Sabbath after Sabbath, on behalf of the Israelites, as a lasting covenant.

ekegusii: Rigereria emegatiyaito! Nigo yarenge morero korwa riko, ekero twachagete orogendo rwaito, na rora bono buna yaboosire, naende yagundire.
english: This bread of ours was warm when we packed it at home on the day we left to come to you. But now see how dry and moldy it is.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akarenta ogwatananekana okonene, na Paulo na Barnaba bakaamererania nabanto aba. Erio Paulo, na Barnaba, na abande korwa ase egati yabo bagachikwa batiire kogenda Yerusalemu ase abatomwa na abagaaka ase engencho y’okoamererania okwo.
english: This brought Paul and Barnabas into sharp dispute and debate with them. So Paul and Barnabas were appointed, along with some other believers, to go up to Jerusalem to see the apostles and elders about this question.

ekegusii: Aiga nao abachenu barabe nokoremereria, abwo babwatete amachiko a Nyasae na koba abegenwa ase Yeso.
english: This calls for patient endurance on the part of the saints who obey God's commandments and remain faithful to Jesus.

ekegusii: Aiga nao obong’aini boganeirie. Ere oyore ne chisemi tiga abare chinamba chi’eng’iti eyio, naki echi nechinamba chia mwanyabanto, ne chinamba chiaye namagana atano na rimo na emerongo etano nomo na isano nemo (666).
english: This calls for wisdom. If anyone has insight, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is man's number. His number is 666.

ekegusii: Omochie oyo tori gochia koba buna enyanyeni asemore, na inwe timori koba chinyama ime yaye; inche nimbanachere ekina agwo ase ribebe ri’Abaisraeli.
english: This city will not be a pot for you, nor will you be the meat in it; I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel.

ekegusii: This command was also evil in the sight of God; so he punished Israel.
english: Amang’ana ayio akoregete akagechia Nyasae; ere akaa Abaisraeli amaakwa.

ekegusii: Abarwani esegi b’Abaisraeli abwo bairetwe ase obosomba mbairane bamenye ase ense ya Kanani gochia ase omochie o Sarefata. Abanto ba Yerusalemu bairetwe ase obosomba, abwo bamenyete Sefaradi, mbaire emechie ya Negebu ebe eyabo.
english: This company of Israelite exiles who are in Canaan will possess [the land] as far as Zarephath; the exiles from Jerusalem who are in Sepharad will possess the towns of the Negev.

ekegusii: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.
english: Oyo noro omoerio bw’ogosaba gwa Daudi, mosinto o Yese.

ekegusii: Rituko ria rero narangeirie igoro na ense chibe birori asemore ng’a inche nabekire ase amasio aino obogima na amakweri, ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa. Ase ayio, chora obogima, erinde inwe amo ne chinderia chiaino monyare kogenderera koba moyo.
english: This day I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you that I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live

ekegusii: Rituko ria rero Omonene nakobeke ase okoboko kwane. Ninkoiyerie inse, na kobutora omotwe oo; ning’ee chinyoni ne ching’iti chi’orosana emebere ekwete y’abarwani b’Abafilisti; erio abanto b’ense yonsi mbamanye ng’a Abaisraeli nigo bare na Nyasae.
english: This day the LORD will hand you over to me, and I'll strike you down and cut off your head. Today I will give the carcasses of the Philistine army to the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and the whole world will know that there is a God in Israel.

ekegusii: Rituko erio ababisa mbabeere agwo Nobu, barambore amaboko abo na koyasungusia igoro y’egetunwa ki’abanto ba Sayoni, ekio kere egetunwa kia Yerusalemu.
english: This day they will halt at Nob; they will shake their fist at the mount of the Daughter of Zion, at the hill of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Rigereria orore, rituko ria rero, agwo ase rikuruma ime, Omonene nigo akobeka ase okoboko kwane, na abanto bande nigo bambetereria ng’a ngoite, korende inche nagotiga kore moyo. Nigo nateba ng’a tinkorambora okoboko kwane kogokore aye omonene one bobe, ekiagera aye nomoakwa amaguta bw’Omonene.
english: This day you have seen with your own eyes how the LORD delivered you into my hands in the cave. Some urged me to kill you, but I spared you; I said, 'I will not lift my hand against my master, because he is the LORD's anointed.'

ekegusii: Omoruoti bw’Abasiiria akaba oichanete ase ebirengererio biaye; akarangeria abasomba baye, akababoria, “Inee! Timokonyara gontebia monto ki ase egati yaito ore ensemo y’omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli?”
english: This enraged the king of Aram. He summoned his officers and demanded of them, "Will you not tell me which of us is on the side of the king of Israel?"

ekegusii: Ezara oyio akarua Babeli. Ere nigo arenge omworokia bw’amariko; nigo orokereretigwe na omanyete mono amachiko a Musa, ayio Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aruete; na ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene, Nyasae oye, kwarenge amo nere, omoruoti akamoa gento kende gionsi aboretie.
english: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a teacher well versed in the Law of Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given. The king had granted him everything he asked, for the hand of the LORD his God was on him.

ekegusii: Na endagera eye egachwe eche koegwa abanto emiaka eye etano na ebere y’enchara, erache gocha ase ense ya Misiri, abanto tibabaisa gocha gosira ase enchara eyio.”
english: This food should be held in reserve for the country, to be used during the seven years of famine that will come upon Egypt, so that the country may not be ruined by the famine."

ekegusii: Agatunyana Paulo na intwe, ogoaka eriogi ogoteba, “Abanto aba nabasomba ba Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono, bakoranderia inwe enchera y’ogotooreka.”
english: This girl followed Paul and the rest of us, shouting, "These men are servants of the Most High God, who are telling you the way to be saved."

ekegusii: Aya nigo akoregete, ekiagera Abaisraeli tibaigwerete eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae obo, korende bagasaria okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwaye, amang’ana onsi aya Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, achigete, tibayaigwerete gose tibanchete koyakora.
english: This happened because they had not obeyed the LORD their God, but had violated his covenant-- all that Moses the servant of the LORD commanded. They neither listened to the commands nor carried them out.

ekegusii: Aya nigo akoregete ase rituko ria ikomi na gatato, omotienyi bw’Adari, na ase rituko ria ikomi na kane ri’omotienyi oyio bagatimoka, bakarikora rikaba eri’omoyega na omogoko.
english: This happened on the thirteenth day of the month of Adar, and on the fourteenth they rested and made it a day of feasting and joy.

ekegusii: Erio riikeranigwe ring’ana riria akwanete, “Aba kwang’ete tinsireti nonya noyomo obo.”
english: This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: "I have not lost one of those you gave me."

ekegusii: Erio ring’ana ria Yeso riikeranigwe, eri akwanete ase okoorokia imakweri ki aranyare gokwa.
english: This happened so that the words Jesus had spoken indicating the kind of death he was going to die would be fulfilled.

ekegusii: Eri rigakoreka ara gatato, na egento keria gekabogorigwa gochia igoro naende.
english: This happened three times, and immediately the sheet was taken back to heaven.

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rigakoreka ara gatato, naende ebinto biria bionsi bikang’uswa gochia igoro.
english: This happened three times, and then it was all pulled up to heaven again.

ekegusii: This has been my practice: I obey your precepts.
english: Oko nakwo ogosesenigwa kwane, ng’a nabeire indendete amachiko ao.

ekegusii: This heap is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this heap to your side to harm you and that you will not go past this heap and pillar to my side to harm me.
english: Etui eye ebe kirori, na esiiro eye ebe kirori boigo, ng’a tingotamboka etui eye inchiche bwoo, gose aye togoetania etui eye na esiiro eye ochiche bwone, tokorerane amabe.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro arikire ase rirube riria omoruoti Aritasasita aete Ezara, omokuani na omworokia bw’amariko, oyo bworokereretigwe na omanyete mono amachiko ’Omonene na emeroberio yaye echikire ase Abaisraeli:
english: This is a copy of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest and teacher, a man learned in matters concerning the commands and decrees of the LORD for Israel:

ekegusii: Ase igo Tatenai, omogavuna bw’orogongo orwo rwa bosongo y’orooche rw’Eufarati, na Setari‐Bosenai, na abagavuna bande baare kogamba amo nabarabwo ase orogongo orwo bagatoma rirube ase Dario omoruoti.
english: This is a copy of the letter that Tattenai, governor of Trans-Euphrates, and Shethar-Bozenai and their associates, the officials of Trans-Euphrates, sent to King Darius.

ekegusii: Oyio nigo ore omoroberio ochikire ase Abaisraeli, na aya Nyasae o Yakobo achikire.
english: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika kwa botambe asebare. Omonto oria okonyororokeria amache aria ay’ogochena asibie chianga chiaye, na omonto onde omoao karakune amache aria, nere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: This is a lasting ordinance for them. "The man who sprinkles the water of cleansing must also wash his clothes, and anyone who touches the water of cleansing will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Obo nobobisi obonene; korende ngokwana nde amang’ana a Kristo na ekanisa.
english: This is a profound mystery-- but I am talking about Christ and the church.

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene, rigwenerete gwancherwa kegima.
english: This is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri neri’ekeene. Igoro y’amang’ana ayio nindigetie oyakwane ne chinguru, erinde abwo bamwegenete Nyasae banyare kwerua ase ogokora okuya. Amang’ana aya namaya, naende nanyare gokonya abanto.
english: This is a trustworthy saying. And I want you to stress these things, so that those who have trusted in God may be careful to devote themselves to doing what is good. These things are excellent and profitable for everyone.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio naende nakio mokoruera ebango, ekiagera abare nokobua nigo bare abakoreri ba Nyasae, ase ogokora emeremo eyio eyio.
english: This is also why you pay taxes, for the authorities are God's servants, who give their full time to governing.

ekegusii: Ebi nigo birabe bitungetie Haroni amo nabamura baye kogenderera botambe korwa ase Abaisraeli, bibe ekeegwa ki’Omonene korwa asebare, ekeng’wanso kiabo ki’omorembe.
english: This is always to be the regular share from the Israelites for Aaron and his sons. It is the contribution the Israelites are to make to the LORD from their fellowship offerings.

ekegusii: Eke negento egeke ase Omonene; boigo nabeke Abamoabu ase amaboko aino.
english: This is an easy thing in the eyes of the LORD; he will also hand Moab over to you.

ekegusii: Eyio nekiorokererio ase engaki eye ya bono, ekero ebiegwa na ebing’wanso bikorugwa, ebitanyare komoikerania oyokobirua erinde enkoro yaye temogambia.
english: This is an illustration for the present time, indicating that the gifts and sacrifices being offered were not able to clear the conscience of the worshiper.

ekegusii: ekiagera timwabete abegenwa asende ase egati y’Abaisraeli agwo ase amache a Meriba‐Kadeshi, ase erooro ya Sini. Timwansigete na kworokia Abaisraeli ng’a inche nigo inde omochenu.
english: This is because both of you broke faith with me in the presence of the Israelites at the waters of Meribah Kadesh in the Desert of Zin and because you did not uphold my holiness among the Israelites.

ekegusii: na kobua mono baria bakobwatia okogania okobe kw’omobere na gochaya okobua. Barabwo nigo bare abeanchi, bare noboremu, na tibari koiguswa ase okorama abwo b’obonene.
english: This is especially true of those who follow the corrupt desire of the sinful nature and despise authority. Bold and arrogant, these men are not afraid to slander celestial beings;

ekegusii: Eri nerigiya, naende ndiancheire ase obosio bwa Nyasae, Omotooria oito,
english: This is good, and pleases God our Savior,

ekegusii: Naki oyio nere otebetwe nomobani Isaya, ekero atebete, “Eriogi ri’oyogoaka egeturi ase erooro: Roisia enchera y’Omonene, rongeyia oboeto bwaye.”
english: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: "A voice of one calling in the desert, 'Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.'"

ekegusii: Ase eri obwanchani bwa Nyasae bwarorekanire asetore: Nyasae otomire Omwana oye omomoima ase ense, erinde tonyore obogima asare.
english: This is how God showed his love among us: He sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio buna morakore: Kera omonto oete omogisangio oye egento singo, amotigere esira eyio. Tabaisa koboria oyomwabo bw’egesaku kiaye amoakane esira eyio, ekiagera obosibore bw’Omonene bw okwabera chisira bwararigwe.
english: This is how it is to be done: Every creditor shall cancel the loan he has made to his fellow Israelite. He shall not require payment from his fellow Israelite or brother, because the LORD's time for canceling debts has been proclaimed.

ekegusii: Naboigo arache koba ase omoerio bw’ense. Abamalaika nabaoroke bache gwatanana baria ababe korwa ase abanyene oboronge,
english: This is how it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous

ekegusii: Ase omotienyi o ikomi, omwaka o kianda bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, amo nabarwani baye bonsi b’esegi, bagacha bakaboera Yerusalemu.
english: This is how Jerusalem was taken: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched against Jerusalem with his whole army and laid siege to it.

ekegusii: Okoiborwa kwa Yeso Kristo nigo kwarenge iga: Ekero Mariamu ng’ina ariereire boko na Yusufu, bataraikana ang’e, akarorekana ore morito ase Omoika Omochenu.
english: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about: His mother Mary was pledged to be married to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be with child through the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: Ekebekerero gie chitaya na enterekerero yaye, amo nemegwekano yaye y’ebisicha nigo biaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu chiturire. Nabo Musa aroisetie ekebekerero ekio buna Omonene konya amochikire.
english: This is how the lampstand was made: It was made of hammered gold-- from its base to its blossoms. The lampstand was made exactly like the pattern the LORD had shown Moses.

ekegusii: Ebibekerero biria nigo biakoretwe iga: Chinsingo nchiarenge ase chinsemo chiabo ase egati ye chinsingo chie chikoona.
english: This is how the stands were made: They had side panels attached to uprights.

ekegusii: Ase ring’ana eri twamanyire ng’a twabanchire abana ba Nyasae ekero twamwanchire Nyasae, na kobwata amachiko aye.
english: This is how we know that we love the children of God: by loving God and carrying out his commands.

ekegusii: Ase eri twamanyire obwanchani: Kristo nigo aruete obogima bwaye ase engencho yaito. Naboigo naintwe ntogwenerete korua obogima bwaito ase engencho y’abaminto.
english: This is how we know what love is: Jesus Christ laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for our brothers.

ekegusii: Ase eri abana ba Nyasae nigo bare maiso marore, na abana ba Saitani boigo: Onde bwensi otari gokora boronge tarueti ase Nyasae, nonya noyo otancheti oyomwabo.
english: This is how we know who the children of God are and who the children of the devil are: Anyone who does not do what is right is not a child of God; nor is anyone who does not love his brother.

ekegusii: Obwato obwo nigo orabokore iga: Obotambe bwaye nigo borabe obw’ebirengo bi’amaboko amagana atato, na obogare bwaye amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bwaye gochia igoro amaboko emerongo etato.
english: This is how you are to build it: The ark is to be 450 feet long, 75 feet wide and 45 feet high.

ekegusii: Enchera morayerie nero eye: Mweboyie chinkini chiaino, mokong’e, mobeke ebikoroto ase amagoro aino, mobwate chinyimbo maboko aino, moyerie nomoayerero. Naki eyio n’Epasaka y’Omonene.
english: This is how you are to eat it: with your cloak tucked into your belt, your sandals on your feet and your staff in your hand. Eat it in haste; it is the LORD's Passover.

ekegusii: Ayio naro morakore ase emechie ere aare korwa asemore, eyio etari y’abanto bare ang’e naiga.
english: This is how you are to treat all the cities that are at a distance from you and do not belong to the nations nearby.

ekegusii: Ase eri nario moramanye Omoika o Nyasae: Kera omoika oyokoorokia Yeso Kristo, ng’a ochire ase omobere, oyio noyo o Nyasae,
english: This is how you can recognize the Spirit of God: Every spirit that acknowledges that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is from God,

ekegusii: Naende akabora, “Iga namomanye ng’a Nyasae ore moyo nigo are ase egati yaino, takomocha kobaseria korwa asemore Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abahivi, na Abaperisi, na Abagirigasi, na Abaamori, na Abayebusi.
english: This is how you will know that the living God is among you and that he will certainly drive out before you the Canaanites, Hittites, Hivites, Perizzites, Girgashites, Amorites and Jebusites.

ekegusii: Naki okomwancha Nyasae nario okobwata amachiko aye, na amachiko aye tari amarito.
english: This is love for God: to obey his commands. And his commands are not burdensome,

ekegusii: Obo nabwo obwanchani, tari ng’a nintwe twamwanchete Nyasae, korende nere otwanchete intwe, agatoma Omwana oye koba ekeng’wanso gi’okobwatania ase ebibe biaito.
english: This is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son as an atoning sacrifice for our sins.

ekegusii: naki aya naro amanyinga aane ay’okobwatana okoyia, aitekire ase engencho y’abange ase okwaberwa kw’ebibe.
english: This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

ekegusii: This is my command: Love each other.
english: “Aya nabachikire naro aya: mwanchane.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo okobwatana kwane, orabwate egati yane naye, na ororeria rwao rorache korwa nyuma yao: Kera omosacha ore asemore arokigwe.
english: This is my covenant with you and your descendants after you, the covenant you are to keep: Every male among you shall be circumcised.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo okoiraneria kwane ase baria bakomboria.
english: This is my defense to those who sit in judgment on me.

ekegusii: Bono Abaisraeli tibakonyara gokora buna barenge gokora agwo ritang’ani, tibakonyenyera ching’iti chi’ebing’wanso biabo orosana isiko; goika bachindetere inche Omonene, bachiire ase omokuani agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, bachinyenyereo chibe ebing’wanso bi’omorembe asende.
english: This is so the Israelites will bring to the LORD the sacrifices they are now making in the open fields. They must bring them to the priest, that is, to the LORD, at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and sacrifice them as fellowship offerings.

ekegusii: This is the account of Abraham's son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,
english: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Isaka, mosinto o Ibrahimu. Ibrahimu nere oiborete Isaka.

ekegusii: This is the account of Abraham's son Ishmael, whom Sarah's maidservant, Hagar the Egyptian, bore to Abraham.
english: Oro narwo ororeria rwa Isumaeli, omwana o Ibrahimu, oyo Hagari, omosomba o Sara, amoiborerete.

ekegusii: This is the account of Esau (that is, Edom).
english: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rwa Esau, nere Edomu.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rwa Esau sokoro bw’Abaedomu, ase ense y’ebitunwa bia Seiri.
english: This is the account of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omogano bw’ororeria rwa Yakobo. Yusufu, ekero konya abeire nemiaka ikomi, na etano na ebere, nigo arenge korisia amaicho amo na bamura bamwabo. Omosae oyio akaba ore amo nabamura bamwabo, abana ba Bilia na Silpa, abakungu ba ise. Yusufu akaba okorentera ise amang’ana igoro y’ogokora kwabo okobe.
english: This is the account of Jacob. Joseph, a young man of seventeen, was tending the flocks with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives, and he brought their father a bad report about them.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rwa Nuhu. Ere nigo arenge omonto omoronge na omoikeranu ase ekiaare kiaye; ere akaba ogotaara amo na Nyasae.
english: This is the account of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time, and he walked with God.

ekegusii: Oro narwo ororeria rw’abana ba Nuhu, nabwo Shemu, na Hamu, na Yafeti. Asebare mbaiboretwe abana abamura nyuma y’etoigo eria.
english: This is the account of Shem, Ham and Japheth, Noah's sons, who themselves had sons after the flood.

ekegusii: This is the account of Shem. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
english: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rwa Shemu. Ekero Shemu abeire nemiaka rigana erimo (100), akaibora Arifaksadi; ekaba emiaka ebere nyuma y’etoigo eria.

ekegusii: This is the account of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
english: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rwa Tera. Tera akaibora Aburamu, na Nahori, na Harani. Harani akaibora Loti.

ekegusii: Aba nabwo abanto b’ororeria rwa Haroni, na orwa Musa, ase engaki eria Omonene akwanete na Musa, agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai.
english: This is the account of the family of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD talked with Moses on Mount Sinai.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omogano buna igoro na ense biatongetwe.
english: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created. When the LORD God made the earth and the heavens--

ekegusii: “Amang’ana aya naro batotebia: Intwe nigo tore abasomba ba Nyasae o igoro na ense, na nigo tokoagacha naende enyomba eria omoruoti omonene bw’Abaisraeli aagachete na akayekoora ase emiaka emenge yaetire.
english: This is the answer they gave us: "We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago, one that a great king of Israel built and finished.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosesenia Musa, omonto o Nyasae, asesenetie Abaisraeli ekero konya atarakwa.
english: This is the blessing that Moses the man of God pronounced on the Israelites before his death.

ekegusii: Oyio nomogati oigete korwa igoro, tari buna chisokoro chiaino chiariete mana, bagakwa; oyorarie omogati oyio nabe moyo goika kare na kare.”
english: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Your forefathers ate manna and died, but he who feeds on this bread will live forever."

ekegusii: Eke nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera Esabato gekoruegwa amo nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, na okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa gochikire amo.
english: This is the burnt offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omochie oria orenge nomogoko, omenyete nobotoereru, orenge gwetogia, oteba: “Inche ninche inde bweka, na onde tari onga buna inche.” Naki omochie oyio osarigwe otigaire bosa, obeire aase ching’iti chi’orosana chigotimokera! Kera omonto oraete ang’e noro nigo arabugie omororia ase ogokumia na gosamunsa amaboko aye.
english: This is the carefree city that lived in safety. She said to herself, "I am, and there is none besides me." What a ruin she has become, a lair for wild beasts! All who pass by her scoff and shake their fists.

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogosemeria tore nakwo asare, ng’a gatoramosabe gento kende gionsi koreng’ana nogwancha kwaye, nigo aratoigwe.
english: This is the confidence we have in approaching God: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us.

ekegusii: Naende Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Oko nakwo okobwatana ndakore n’Abaisraeli nyuma y’amatuko aria: Nimbeke amachiko aane ase ebirengererio biabo, ninyarike ase chinkoro chiabo ime; inche nimbe Nyasae obo, na barabwo mbabe abanto baane.
english: This is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after that time, declares the Lord. I will put my laws in their minds and write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

ekegusii: Rituko eri nario Omonene akorire, tiga tobe nomogoko, tochenge ase rirorio.
english: This is the day the LORD has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

ekegusii: Oyo nomworokigwa oria oroche aya, na koyarika, naende twamanyire ng’a oborori bwaye nobw’ekeene.
english: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.

ekegusii: Obo nabwo obobe ase aya onsi agokorekana aiga inse y’erioba, ng’a egento nekemo gekobanyora bonsi; chinkoro chia mwanyabanto nigo chiichire obobe na obobarimo ekero bare moyo, na nyuma y’ayio nigo bakogenda ase abakure.
english: This is the evil in everything that happens under the sun: The same destiny overtakes all. The hearts of men, moreover, are full of evil and there is madness in their hearts while they live, and afterward they join the dead.

ekegusii: Obwo nabwo obosiru bw’abanto abwo besemeretie abanyene, omoerio obo abwo begenete amang’ana abo.
english: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings. Selah

ekegusii: Oko nakwo ogochika okonene, naende nakwo kwe ritang’ani.
english: This is the first and greatest commandment.

ekegusii: Eke nakio egeita ki’Omonene, abanyene oboronge nabwo barasoere aroro.
english: This is the gate of the LORD through which the righteous may enter.

ekegusii: Eyio nero emiando Musa aatananete agwo ase ebirubo ebiomo bia Moabu, moocha ya Yorodan, kororia Yeriko.
english: This is the inheritance Moses had given when he was in the plains of Moab across the Jordan east of Jericho.

ekegusii: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Judah, clan by clan:
english: Oyo noro omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Yuda.

ekegusii: Aya naro amachiko a Nyasae Musa aruete ase Abaisraeli.
english: This is the law Moses set before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’abanto chituoni ba Daudi: Ritang’ani Yasobeamu korwa Hakimoni. Ere nigo arenge omonene bwa baria Batato. Ere akarwania abanto amagana atato ne ritimo riaye akabaita ase engaki eyemo.
english: this is the list of David's mighty men: Jashobeam, a Hacmonite, was chief of the officers; he raised his spear against three hundred men, whom he killed in one encounter.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’Abaisraeli na abateneneri be chiamate chiabo na obw’abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi chilifu na ab’amagana, na obw’abateneneri b’emeremo ende yonsi ase oboruoti. Kera omotienyi ase omwaka ekeombe ki’abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na inye (24,000), nigo kiarenge gokora emeremo inse y’oboraai bw’omotang’ani bw’omotienyi oyio.
english: This is the list of the Israelites-- heads of families, commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds, and their officers, who served the king in all that concerned the army divisions that were on duty month by month throughout the year. Each division consisted of 24,000 men.

ekegusii: oyio nere oramenye aase are igoro. Ebitare ebikong’u mbibe ebikengero biaye; naegwe endagera yaye, na amache aye tagosira.
english: this is the man who will dwell on the heights, whose refuge will be the mountain fortress. His bread will be supplied, and water will not fail him.

ekegusii: buna koreng’ana kwaroche rigena rigotegoka rinyene korwa ase egetunwa, ritategoiri namaboko a mwanyabanto, ne rigena riria rigaaka na gosamunyora ekioma, na etaai, na amaroba, na efeta, na etahabu. Nyasae ore omonene okomanyirie aye omoruoti amang’ana agochi‐gocha. Chindoto chiao nechi’ekeene, na engencho yaye nagotebirie ney’ekeene.”
english: This is the meaning of the vision of the rock cut out of a mountain, but not by human hands-- a rock that broke the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver and the gold to pieces. "The great God has shown the king what will take place in the future. The dream is true and the interpretation is trustworthy."

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana Yeremia omobani achigete Seraya mosinto o Neria, omochokoro o Maaseya, ekero agendete Babeli amo na Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia. Seraya nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’aase agotimokerwa.
english: This is the message Jeremiah gave to the staff officer Seraiah son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went to Babylon with Zedekiah king of Judah in the fourth year of his reign.

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nario Omonene atebetie Yeremia igoro y’ogocha kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, ase okobua ense ya Misiri:
english: This is the message the LORD spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about the coming of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to attack Egypt:

ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana twaigwete korwa asare, na tokobarareria inwe, ng’a Nyasae nomobaso, gose mosunte onde bwonsi tori ime asare.
english: This is the message we have heard from him and declare to you: God is light; in him there is no darkness at all.

ekegusii: Naki aya naro amang’ana mwaigwete korwa ritang’ani, ng’a twanchane intwe ase intwe.
english: This is the message you heard from the beginning: We should love one another.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’abanto Nebukadinesaro airete ase obosomba: ase omwaka o gatano na kabere akaira Abayahudi chilifu isato, na emerongo ebere, na batato (3,023).
english: This is the number of the people Nebuchadnezzar carried into exile: in the seventh year, 3,023 Jews;

ekegusii: Naki oyio nere amang’ana aya arikire igoro yaye: “Rigereria, natomire omotomwa one ase obosio bwao, oyo oratang’ane koroisia enchera yao!
english: This is the one about whom it is written: "'I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.'

ekegusii: ekiagera oyio nere amang’ana aya arikire igoro yaye,” “Rigereria, inche natomire omotomwa one ase obosio bwao, oyo oratang’ane koroisia enchera yao.
english: This is the one about whom it is written: "'I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way before you.'

ekegusii: Oyo nere naare goteba igoro yaye: Ngocha are omonto nyuma yane oyore omonene kombua, ekiagera nao arenge ritang’ani asende.
english: This is the one I meant when I said, 'A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.'

ekegusii: Yeso Kristo, nere oyo ochete ase amache na amanyinga, tari ase amache oka, korende ase amache na amanyinga.
english: This is the one who came by water and blood-- Jesus Christ. He did not come by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

ekegusii: Amaakwa aya naro Omonene ararue ase abanto abwo bonsi barache korwania abanto ba Yerusalemu: Chinyama chi’emebere yabo nchigunde ekero bagendererete gotenena namagoro abo, na amaiso abo nagunde ekero are ase chinyongo chiabo ime, ne chimeme chiabo inachigunde ase emenwa yabo ime.
english: This is the plague with which the LORD will strike all the nations that fought against Jerusalem: Their flesh will rot while they are still standing on their feet, their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths.

ekegusii: Aya naro achikirwe igoro y’ense yonsi, na oko nakwo okoboko koramboire igoro ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi.
english: This is the plan determined for the whole world; this is the hand stretched out over all nations.

ekegusii: “Ekio negetari kemotungetie Haroni na abamura baye korwa ase ebing’wanso bigosambwa nomorero asende; nigo kiabete ekiabo korwa rituko riria baatananetwe bakaba abakuani bagonkorera inche Omonene.
english: This is the portion of the offerings made to the LORD by fire that were allotted to Aaron and his sons on the day they were presented to serve the LORD as priests.

ekegusii: eira eyio eyio ebisaku biaito ikomi na bibere biasemeretie koyeikera, kobiragenderere komosasima Nyasae obotuko na omobaso. Aye omoruoti! Ase engencho y’ogosemeria okwo nasoeirwe n’Abayahudi.
english: This is the promise our twelve tribes are hoping to see fulfilled as they earnestly serve God day and night. O king, it is because of this hope that the Jews are accusing me.

ekegusii: Ekio nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gia kera rituko, ekio Musa aruete ritang’ani agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai gekaba rimisu rigiya, ekeng’wanso kegosambwa nomorero ase Omonene.
english: This is the regular burnt offering instituted at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, an offering made to the LORD by fire.

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi oraite oyonde mosiabano, atamogechete agwo ritang’ani, nanyare gotamera oyomo bw’emechie eyio, na gotooria obogima bwaye.
english: This is the rule concerning the man who kills another and flees there to save his life-- one who kills his neighbor unintentionally, without malice aforethought.

ekegusii: Itamari, omomura o Haroni omokuani, nere oratenenere emeremo abanto be chiamate chi’Abagerisoni barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.”
english: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting. Their duties are to be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest.

ekegusii: Eye nero emeremo y’abanto be chiamate chia Merari barabe bagokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, inse y’oboteneneri bwa Itamari, omomura o Haroni omokuani.”
english: This is the service of the Merarite clans as they work at the Tent of Meeting under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron, the priest."

ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakorua eng’ombe, gose eng’ondi, gose embori, koba ekeng’wanso, bae abakuani rireko, ne chinsea ibere, na enda; ebio nabio ebitari abanto barae abakuani.
english: This is the share due the priests from the people who sacrifice a bull or a sheep: the shoulder, the jowls and the inner parts.

ekegusii: Yeremia omobani agatoma rirube korwa Yerusalemu gochia ase abagaaka b’abanto barenge ase obosomba na ase abakuani, na ababani, na abanto bonsi aba Nebukadinesaro oosete korwa Yerusalemu, akabaira Babeli ase obosomba.
english: This is the text of the letter that the prophet Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the surviving elders among the exiles and to the priests, the prophets and all the other people Nebuchadnezzar had carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon.

ekegusii: Na eke nakio ekina ng’a omobaso ochire ase ense, korende abanto bagancha omosunte kobua omobaso, ekiagera ogokora kwabo kwarenge okobe.
english: This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but men loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio nigo akonachera abanto ekina; naende nigo akobaa chindagera ase obonge.
english: This is the way he governs the nations and provides food in abundance.

ekegusii: Naboigo akaroisia ebibekerero bionsi ikomi. Bionsi nigo biaroisetigwe korwa ase etaai enyititoire na kobombwa; nigo biareng’aine na nigo biagwekaine.
english: This is the way he made the ten stands. They were all cast in the same molds and were identical in size and shape.

ekegusii: Eri ne ring’ana rikong’u ri’Omonene igoro y’Abaisraeli: Aya naro Omonene agoteba, oyio oramborete igoro chionsi na akabeka oboroso bw’ense, oyio otongete omoika ime ase omonto:
english: This is the word of the LORD concerning Israel. The LORD, who stretches out the heavens, who lays the foundation of the earth, and who forms the spirit of man within him, declares:

ekegusii: Ase omochakano bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia omobani igoro y’ense y’Elamu, rikamotebia,
english: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, early in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah:

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia omobani igoro y’ebisaku.
english: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations:

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia igoro y’Abafilisti ekero Farao atarabua Gasa, rikamotebia,
english: This is the word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines before Pharaoh attacked Gaza:

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri ri’Omonene rikamochera Yeremia. Omonene akamotebia igoro y’eguru‐gura:
english: This is the word of the LORD to Jeremiah concerning the drought:

ekegusii: Ekero Yehoyakimu, mosinto o Yosia, arenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda, ring’ana rigacha ase Yeremia korwa ase Omonene, rikamotebia,
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD during the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah:

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia ase omwaka o ikomi bw’okogamba gwa Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda. Omwaka oyio nigo orenge omwaka o ikomi na gatano na gatato bw’okogamba kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli.
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

ekegusii: Ring’ana rigacha ase Yeremia korwa ase Omonene, rikamotebia
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

ekegusii: Ring’ana rikarua ase Omonene rigacha asende inche Yeremia,
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

ekegusii: Ring’ana rikarwa ase Omonene rigacha asende inche Yeremia, rigantebia,
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, rikamotebia,
english: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

ekegusii: Erio nario ring’ana Omonene akwanire: Aye Senakeribu, Sayoni omochie ore buna omoiseke omwekungi nigo ogochayete na kogosekerera; omochie o Yerusalemu nigo ogosingiseria omotwe magega yao.
english: This is the word that the LORD has spoken against him: "'The Virgin Daughter of Zion despises you and mocks you. The Daughter of Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.

ekegusii: Ring’ana erio nario Omonene akwanete igoro y’ense ya Moabu agwo kare.
english: This is the word the LORD has already spoken concerning Moab.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, eri nario ring’ana Omonene akwanire: Aye Senakeribu, Sayoni, omochie ore buna omoiseke omwekungi, nigo agochayete na kogosekerera; omochie o Yerusalemu nigo okogosingiseria omotwe magega yao.
english: this is the word the LORD has spoken against him: "The Virgin Daughter of Zion despises and mocks you. The Daughter of Jerusalem tosses her head as you flee.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene akwanete goetera ase Yeremia omobani igoro y’omochie o Babeli na ense engima y’Abakalidayo:
english: This is the word the LORD spoke through Jeremiah the prophet concerning Babylon and the land of the Babylonians:

ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio bw’ororeria rw’Adamu. Ekero keria Nyasae atongete omonto, akamokora ase omogwekano oye omonyene.
english: This is the written account of Adam's line. When God created man, he made him in the likeness of God.

ekegusii: Emeremo yabo ase Eema eria ebe ey’okobogoria ebinto ebi: Chibao chi’Obomenyo Obochenu, na emeriibo, ne chisiiro amo ne chinterekerero chiabo,
english: This is their duty as they perform service at the Tent of Meeting: to carry the frames of the tabernacle, its crossbars, posts and bases,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Tata abakwe ekero mwamire mono; na inwe namobe aborokigwa baane.
english: This is to my Father's glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogwenerete koborania, kera omonto nomogisangio oye, na kera oyomo noyomwabo: Mang’ana ki Omonene airaneria? Gose: Narari akwanire?
english: This is what each of you keeps on saying to his friend or relative: 'What is the LORD's answer?' or 'What has the LORD spoken?'

ekegusii: Omonene Nyasae, oyotongete igoro chionsi na gochirambora, oyo bwarete ense na bionsi ebikorwao, oyo oete abanto bareo obogima, na kobaa omoika abwo bagotaara aroro, nigo agoteba iga:
english: This is what God the LORD says-- he who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and all that comes out of it, who gives breath to its people, and life to those who walk on it:

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro akoregete ase amatuko ’Ahaswero, Ahaswero oyio akaba okogambera chingongo rigana erimo, na emerongo ebere, na isano na ibere (127), gochakera India goikera Etiopia.
english: This is what happened during the time of Xerxes, the Xerxes who ruled over 127 provinces stretching from India to Cush:

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkamorora oteneine igoro y’orwaki rwaagachetwe ase okorengwa nekebiro, na ase okoboko kwaye nabwate ekebiro.
english: This is what he showed me: The Lord was standing by a wall that had been built true to plumb, with a plumb line in his hand.

ekegusii: Ayio naro Hezekia akorete ase ense yonsi y’Abayuda; agakora ayare amaya na amaronge, na ay’obwegenwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oye.
english: This is what Hezekiah did throughout Judah, doing what was good and right and faithful before the LORD his God.

ekegusii: Ekero mwaruete ase ense ya Misiri nigo nabarierete eira ng’a botambe nigo ndabe amo nainwe; ase ayio Omoika one nigo ogendererete komenya ase egati yaino; timoiroka.
english: 'This is what I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt. And my Spirit remains among you. Do not fear.'

ekegusii: Naende Omonene otebire: “Naboigo ndakore aase aiga amo nabanto bamenyeteo, omochie oyo obe buna Tofeti.
english: This is what I will do to this place and to those who live here, declares the LORD. I will make this city like Topheth.

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri nario Isaya, mosinto bw’Amosi, aroche igoro y’Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu:
english: This is what Isaiah son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem:
