ekegusii: Aya naro amang’ana Yeremia akwanete na Baruku, mosinto o Neria, na Baruku akayarika buna Yeremia ayakwanete, ase omwaka o kane bw’okogamba kwa Yehoyakimu oyorenge mosinto o Yosia na omoruoti bw’Abayuda:
english: This is what Jeremiah the prophet told Baruch son of Neriah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, after Baruch had written on a scroll the words Jeremiah was then dictating:

ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’ekeng’ese ki’egesaku kia Manase ensemo y’ense eyio, ebe omwando obo.
english: This is what Moses had given to the half-tribe of Manasseh, that is, to half the family of the descendants of Manasseh, clan by clan:

ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’egesaku kia Gadi ensemo y’ense eria ebe omwando obo.
english: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Gad, clan by clan:

ekegusii: Musa konya oeire kera eamate y’egesaku kia Reuben ensemo y’ense ebe omwando obo.
english: This is what Moses had given to the tribe of Reuben, clan by clan:

ekegusii: Naki ase okwo abagaaka abakoro mbaberetwe kirori.
english: This is what the ancients were commended for.

ekegusii: Aya naro omoruoti agokwana: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abang’aine, ekiagera ere takonyara kobatooria korwa ase okoboko kwane.
english: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you from my hand.

ekegusii: Aya naro omoruoti agokwana: Timobaisa gwancha Hezekia abang’aine, ekiagera ere takonyara kobatooria.
english: This is what the king says: Do not let Hezekiah deceive you. He cannot deliver you!

ekegusii: Aya naro inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ngoteba: “Chindwaki chinetu chia Babeli nachiyerigwe inse, na ebiita biaye ebitambe gochia igoro mbisambwe nomorero. “Emeremo abanto bagokora nebe bosa; ebisaku nigo bikwerosia bosa ase emeremo erasambwe nomorero.”
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Babylon's thick wall will be leveled and her high gates set on fire; the peoples exhaust themselves for nothing, the nations' labor is only fuel for the flames."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Rengereria amang’ana aya! Rangeria abakungu abamanyete kobokia amagombo bachiche! Toma abanto barangerie abakungu abegerete ayio bachiche!”
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Consider now! Call for the wailing women to come; send for the most skillful of them.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Gecha emete, agacha eburi, moboere Yerusalemu. Omochie oyio goika oegwe egesusuro, ekiagera nomochie omobe, ogendererete gochanda abanto bareo.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Cut down the trees and build siege ramps against Jerusalem. This city must be punished; it is filled with oppression.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Timobaisa koigwera amang’ana ’ababani abwo bakonakobabanera na kobaichoria nogosemeria kw’obong’ainereria. Barabwo nigo bagokwana amaroro aye chindoto chie chinkoro chiabo, gose tari ayakorwa ase omonwa one inche Omonene.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Do not listen to what the prophets are prophesying to you; they fill you with false hopes. They speak visions from their own minds, not from the mouth of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Rengereria buna amang’ana aino abeire.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Give careful thought to your ways.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Inche nigo inde ne risemi rinene mono ase engencho ya Sayoni; ee, risemi erio riagerire nabeire nendamwamu enene ase engencho yaye.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "I am very jealous for Zion; I am burning with jealousy for her."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Rora, nintoorie abanto baane, mbarente korwa ase chinse chia moocha na bosongo.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "I will save my people from the countries of the east and the west.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Ase amatuko ayio abanto ikomi ba kera egesaku bagokwana emenwa ao ao mbache babwate omokoba bw’omwambaro bw’Omoyahudi, batebe: Intwe ntorigetie kogenda amo nainwe, ekiagera twaigure ng’a Nyasae nigo are amo nainwe.”
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "In those days ten men from all languages and nations will take firm hold of one Jew by the hem of his robe and say, 'Let us go with you, because we have heard that God is with you.'" An Oracle

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Onye amang’ana ayio are ay’ogokumia ase abatigari b’egesaku eke, Inee, nabe ay’ogokumia asende boigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda?
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "It may seem marvelous to the remnant of this people at that time, but will it seem marvelous to me?" declares the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Buna koreng’ana naroberetie kobarentera amabe, ekero chisokoro chiaino chiakorete ebibe chikagera nkaba nendamwamu, gose tinaonchorete omoroberio oyio,
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Just as I had determined to bring disaster upon you and showed no pity when your fathers angered me," says the LORD Almighty,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Chora abatigari b’Abaisraeli, buna amasabibu amatigari agochorwa. Kabe gokorambora okoboko kwao naende, buna omosangereria amasabibu akoyarusia ase chinsagia.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Let them glean the remnant of Israel as thoroughly as a vine; pass your hand over the branches again, like one gathering grapes."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Rora, obobe naboche ase egesaku ekemo, bogende ase ekende, na ekembugu‐mbugu nageche korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Look! Disaster is spreading from nation to nation; a mighty storm is rising from the ends of the earth."

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Engaki ngocha ere, ekero abanto abange bararue ase emechie emenge, bache aa.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Abagaaka na abang’ina nabanyorekane ase chinchera chia Yerusalemu naende, kera oyomo nabe nenyimbo yaye agwesiirera, ekiagera babeire abagotu mono.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "Once again men and women of ripe old age will sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each with cane in hand because of his age.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Rora, nimbune amata ’Abaelamu, ayio are chinguru chi’okobua kwabo.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "See, I will break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Chingaki chi’okweng’ata ase omotienyi o kane, na oyo o gatano, na oyo o gatano na kabere, na oyo o ikomi, nachibe ase Abayuda chingaki chi’omogoko na omochengo, na Amatuko Amanene ay’okwegokia. Ase ayio mwanche ekeene na omorembe.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months will become joyful and glad occasions and happy festivals for Judah. Therefore love truth and peace."

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda nigo bachandire. Abanto abwo babairete ase obosomba nigo bababwatete bokong’u, bangire kobaa ribaga bagende sobo.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "The people of Israel are oppressed, and the people of Judah as well. All their captors hold them fast, refusing to let them go.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: “Abanto aba nigo bagokwana ng’a engaki teraika ekero enyomba y’Omonene egwenerete koagachwa naende.”
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "These people say, 'The time has not yet come for the LORD's house to be built.'"

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Mobe abaremu! Inwe bono mwabeire mokoigwa amang’ana ayio ababani barenge gokwana, ekero oboroso bw’enyomba y’Omonene bw’Emeganda bware kobekwa, ng’a Hekalu neagachwe naende.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: "You who now hear these words spoken by the prophets who were there when the foundation was laid for the house of the LORD Almighty, let your hands be strong so that the temple may be built.

ekegusii: Omonene bw’Emeganda nigo agoteba iga: Ngochia inde korua egesusuro ase Abaameleki, ekiagera barabwo batangete Abaisraeli, ekero barenge ase orogendo rwabo korwa Misiri.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty says: 'I will punish the Amalekites for what they did to Israel when they waylaid them as they came up from Egypt.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba igoro y’Ahabu, mosinto o Kolaya, na igoro ya Zedekia, mosinto o Maaseya, abwo bakobabanera oborimo ase erieta riane: Naama! Nimbabeke ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, ere nabaitere agwo ase amasio aino.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says about Ahab son of Kolaiah and Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying lies to you in my name: "I will hand them over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will put them to death before your very eyes.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, atebire ase abanto bonsi narusetie Yerusalemu nkaira Babeli ase obosomba:
english: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says to all those I carried into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon:

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Abanto ba Babeli babeire buna ekeooreri gi’okoorera kiaroisigwe ase ogotachwa. Engaki netigarete enke, erio rigesa riaye riike.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "The Daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time it is trampled; the time to harvest her will soon come."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: “Ekero ndairanerie abanto bairetwe obosomba amaya abo, nabakwane naende amang’ana aya ase ense y’Abayuda na ase emechie ereo: “Omonene agosesenie aye obomenyo bw’abanyaboronge, aye ekegoro egechenu.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "When I bring them back from captivity, the people in the land of Judah and in its towns will once again use these words: 'The LORD bless you, O righteous dwelling, O sacred mountain.'

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: “Koreng’ana buna narentete endamwamu yane enene igoro ase abanto ba Yerusalemu, naboigo ndayerente igoro asemore, ekero moragende Misiri. Inwe nigo morabe mogokwanwa ekero abanto barabe bakoragereria, na ekero abanto bakobarora nigo barakumie na goichana, naende mobe mogochecherigwa. Timokoirana gocha korora aase aiga naende.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: 'As my anger and wrath have been poured out on those who lived in Jerusalem, so will my wrath be poured out on you when you go to Egypt. You will be an object of cursing and horror, of condemnation and reproach; you will never see this place again.'

ekegusii: Nimbeke ase amagoti ’abanto b’ebisaku bionsi rikorogoto ri’ekioma, erinde babe abasomba ba Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, nabarabwo mbamokorere, ekiagera inche Omonene namoeire ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana boigo.”
english: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: I will put an iron yoke on the necks of all these nations to make them serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they will serve him. I will even give him control over the wild animals.'"

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Onchora chinchera chiaino, na ogokora kwaino, na inche nimbatige mogenderere komenya aase aiga.
english: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Reform your ways and your actions, and I will let you live in this place.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Imokia okobwatana oko gw’okogorana kw’omogondo, okwo komumekeirie na okwo gotamumekeiri, obeke amakaratasi ayio abeere ase ekeguru gekorire korwa ase amaroba, erinde agenderere kobao ase engaki entambe.
english: 'This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: Take these documents, both the sealed and unsealed copies of the deed of purchase, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Inwe amo nabakungu baino mwakorire na goikerania namaboko aino ayio mwakwanete nemenwa yaino, mogateba: Goika tokore buna twariete eira gokora; tosambe ubani ase Eting’ana ya Igoro, naende toumore okoruegwa kw’ebinyugwa asere. Bono inwe kora bo, moikeranie chiira chiaino!
english: This is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: You and your wives have shown by your actions what you promised when you said, 'We will certainly carry out the vows we made to burn incense and pour out drink offerings to the Queen of Heaven.' "Go ahead then, do what you promised! Keep your vows!

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Omonene achikire igoro y’abaiseke ba Selefehadi: Tiga banyuomwe nabanto baria banchete, korende goika babe abanto be chiamate chi’egesaku kiabo.
english: This is what the LORD commands for Zelophehad's daughters: They may marry anyone they please as long as they marry within the tribal clan of their father.

ekegusii: Ring’ana erio nario Omonene achigete: Sangereria endagera eyio, kera oyomo buna agwenerete, ebimunu bibere ase kera omonto. Kera omonto asangererie buna abwate abanto bang’ana ase eema yaye.”
english: This is what the LORD has commanded: 'Each one is to gather as much as he needs. Take an omer for each person you have in your tent.'"

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae one, agoteba: “Risia riicho rie ching’ondi echio chiachikeirwe konyenywa.
english: This is what the LORD my God says: "Pasture the flock marked for slaughter.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene antebirie: “Genda ogore orokini rw’egatani orobeke kenema kiao, korende tobaisa korotobeka ase amache.”
english: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and buy a linen belt and put it around your waist, but do not let it touch water."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene antebetie: “Genda otenene ase Egeita ki’Abanto, agwo ase abaruoti b’Abayuda bagosoera na gosokera, naende ase ebiita binde bionsi bia Yerusalemu,
english: This is what the LORD said to me: "Go and stand at the gate of the people, through which the kings of Judah go in and out; stand also at all the other gates of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene antebetie: “Eroiserie chingori ne rikorogoto, obibeke ase rigoti riao.
english: This is what the LORD said to me: "Make a yoke out of straps and crossbars and put it on your neck.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’abanto aba: “Barabwo nigo banchete okona‐koombogana, tibari gotanga amagoro abo. Ase engencho eyio inche Omonene tinkobanchera, korende goika ing’inyore ebibe biabo, nimbae egesusuro ase ebibe ebio.”
english: This is what the LORD says about this people: "They greatly love to wander; they do not restrain their feet. So the LORD does not accept them; he will now remember their wickedness and punish them for their sins."

ekegusii: Omonene oroisetie enchera ase enyancha ime, ee, oboeto ase amache amange are ne chinguru,
english: This is what the LORD says-- he who made a way through the sea, a path through the mighty waters,

ekegusii: Omonene, oria ogotongete ase enda ya nyoko, naende okogokonya, nigo agoteba iga: Aye Yakobo, omosomba one, aye Yerusalemu, omochore one, toiroka.
english: This is what the LORD says-- he who made you, who formed you in the womb, and who will help you: Do not be afraid, O Jacob, my servant, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omobooria bw’Abaisraeli, Omochenu obo, oria ochayetwe kegima na kogechwa na mwanyabanto; oria ore omosomba bw’abagambi, atebire: “Abaruoti mbarore ayio, bagororoke batenene, na abagambi batung’ame, ase engencho y’Omonene oyore omwegenwa, oyio ore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, oyio ogochorire.”
english: This is what the LORD says-- the Redeemer and Holy One of Israel-- to him who was despised and abhorred by the nation, to the servant of rulers: "Kings will see you and rise up, princes will see and bow down, because of the LORD, who is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene antebetie; “Buna koreng’ana endo ensae ekoronya ase eng’iti yaitire, na teri kogoswa namariogi ’omoganda bw’abarisia, gose teri kwoboa egeturi kiabo, naboigo inche Omonene bw’Emeganda ndache korwana ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase ekegoro kiaye.
english: This is what the LORD says to me: "As a lion growls, a great lion over his prey-- and though a whole band of shepherds is called together against him, he is not frightened by their shouts or disturbed by their clamor-- so the LORD Almighty will come down to do battle on Mount Zion and on its heights.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro Omonene antebetie, “Genda mobeke omorendi atengere, nere oyio nabararerie abatebie amang’ana ararore.
english: This is what the Lord says to me: "Go, post a lookout and have him report what he sees.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene antebetie: “Nintegerere korwa aiga ase obomenyo bwane inde nobotoereru, imoreke buna amasase ’erioba akomoreka. Nigo ndabe buna riire rigotonya riime ase engaki y’omobaso omororo bwe rigesa.”
english: This is what the LORD says to me: "I will remain quiet and will look on from my dwelling place, like shimmering heat in the sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest."

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene ontebirie iga: “Ekero omwaka oyomo otaraera omwaka onga buna oyo bw’omorikwa, obonene bwonsi bwa Kedari mbosirigwe boere.
english: This is what the Lord says to me: "Within one year, as a servant bound by contract would count it, all the pomp of Kedar will come to an end.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agotebia Abaisraeli: “Ndigie inche, erio nario morabe moyo.
english: This is what the LORD says to the house of Israel: "Seek me and live;

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agotebia Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu: “Chaka korema embuna timobaisa kobusura ase amagwa ime.
english: This is what the LORD says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: "Break up your unplowed ground and do not sow among thorns.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Omobooria oino oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: “Ase engencho yaino nintome abarwani esegi gochia Babeli baserie abanto b’aroro, erinde batame; ee, Abakalidayo abwo baserigwe gochia ase chimeeri chiabo echio bagokerete.
english: This is what the LORD says-- your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I will send to Babylon and bring down as fugitives all the Babylonians, in the ships in which they took pride.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Omobooria oo, Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: “Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oo, ninche ngokworokereria okore aya agokorentera amaya, ninche nkogotang’ana ase enchera ogwenerete kobwatia.
english: This is what the LORD says-- your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the LORD your God, who teaches you what is best for you, who directs you in the way you should go.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba, “Ere oyogotoa erioba riabara mobaso, na gochika omoroberio bw’omotienyi obara botuko amo ne ching’enang’eni, ere oyio ogoserokia enyancha erinde yaeera, oyio erieta riaye n’Omonene bw’Emeganda.
english: This is what the LORD says, he who appoints the sun to shine by day, who decrees the moon and stars to shine by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar-- the LORD Almighty is his name:

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Eriogi riaigurwe Rama, okorera na okweumia nobororo. Raeli nkobareera are abana baye; tancheti aremigwe ase engencho y’abana baye, ekiagera tibaiyo.”
english: This is what the LORD says: "A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because her children are no more."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Nabaisa koba abange bare ne chinguru, goika basirigwe tibabao naende. Nonya nabeire nkobachanda inwe, bono tinkogenderera kobachanda naende nonya ng’ake.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Although they have allies and are numerous, they will be cut off and pass away. Although I have afflicted you, [O Judah,] I will afflict you no more.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Buna koreng’ana omorisia agotaboria korwa ase omonwa bw’endo amauga ’amagoro abere, gose egetabo ki’ogoto, naboigo n’Abaisraeli barataborigwe, abwo bamenyete Samaria baikaransete ase ebirogo ebiororo na ase emeito etubire nebitambaa bi’ariri.”
english: This is what the LORD says: "As a shepherd saves from the lion's mouth only two leg bones or a piece of an ear, so will the Israelites be saved, those who sit in Samaria on the edge of their beds and in Damascus on their couches."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’abagisangio baane ababe, abwo bagosaria omwando oria naeire Abaisraeli: “Nimbarusie barue ase ense yabo, naende nindusie Abayuda barue ase egati yabo.
english: This is what the LORD says: "As for all my wicked neighbors who seize the inheritance I gave my people Israel, I will uproot them from their lands and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba igoro y’ababani abwo bakoraa abanto baane gochia ase obosiru, abwo bagoteba ng’a omorembe noreo, ekero baeirwe egento barire, korende bakora esegi ase abwo batabaeti egento bakobeka monwa.
english: This is what the LORD says: "As for the prophets who lead my people astray, if one feeds them, they proclaim 'peace'; if he does not, they prepare to wage war against him.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Buna koreng’ana edivai ekonyorekana korwa ase egesago ki’omosabibu, na abanto bateba: Timogesaria, ekiagera ogosesenigwa nkore ime yaye, naboigo ndakore ase engencho y’abasomba baane, tingoita na gosiria abanto abwo bonsi.
english: This is what the LORD says: "As when juice is still found in a cluster of grapes and men say, 'Don't destroy it, there is yet some good in it,' so will I do in behalf of my servants; I will not destroy them all.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Oragererigwe omonto oyo osemeretie mwanyabanto na kwegena chinguru chia mwanyabanto, oyio okoonchoka ase enkoro yaye ontiga inche Omonene.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Cursed is the one who trusts in man, who depends on flesh for his strength and whose heart turns away from the LORD.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Timobaisa kweorokereria chingencho chi’abanto b’ebisaku, gose ebimanyererio bikorwa igoro tibibaisa kobaondokia, ebio nigo bikoondokia abanto b’ebisaku.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by signs in the sky, though the nations are terrified by them.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’Abaamoni ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo boorete abakungu ba Gileadi barenge barito, ekero barenge kogareyia orogongo rwabo.
english: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Ammon, even for four, I will not turn back [my wrath]. Because he ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead in order to extend his borders,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Damesiki ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora, ekiagera barabwo baoorire Abagileadi nebioorero bi’ebioma.
english: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Damascus, even for four, I will not turn back [my wrath]. Because she threshed Gilead with sledges having iron teeth,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Edomu ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo babwatetie abamwabo bare nemioro, tibabete namabera nonya ng’ake; nigo bagendererete koba nendamwamu na ekeririanda botambe.
english: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Edom, even for four, I will not turn back [my wrath]. Because he pursued his brother with a sword, stifling all compassion, because his anger raged continually and his fury flamed unchecked,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Gasa ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bairete abanto egesaku ekegima gochia ase ense ya Edomu, bakabakora abasomba.
english: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Gaza, even for four, I will not turn back [my wrath]. Because she took captive whole communities and sold them to Edom,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’Abaisraeli ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo baoonetie omonyene oboronge ase rigori ri’efeta, na omotaka bakamoonia ase rigori ri’ebikoroto bibere.
english: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Israel, even for four, I will not turn back [my wrath]. They sell the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’Abayuda ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bachayete amachiko ’Omonene, gose tibabwatete emeroberio yaye echikire, korende amang’ana ’obong’ainereria bwabo, ayio chisokoro chiabo chiarenge kobwatia abasiririe.
english: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Judah, even for four, I will not turn back [my wrath]. Because they have rejected the law of the LORD and have not kept his decrees, because they have been led astray by false gods, the gods their ancestors followed,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Moabu ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo basambete amauga ’omoruoti o Edomu akaba ribu.
english: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Moab, even for four, I will not turn back [my wrath]. Because he burned, as if to lime, the bones of Edom's king,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire: “Ase engencho y’ogosaria kw’abanto ba Turo ara gatato, ee, ara kane, tingotanga egesusuro tikebanyora. Barabwo nigo bairete abanto egesaku ekegima ase ense ya Edomu, tibainyorete okobwatana kw’ogotianania kw’obomwabo.
english: This is what the LORD says: "For three sins of Tyre, even for four, I will not turn back [my wrath]. Because she sold whole communities of captives to Edom, disregarding a treaty of brotherhood,

ekegusii: Omonene agakwana nainche agantebia, “Genda ogore enyongo korwa ase omokori chinyongo. Ogende nabagaaka b’abanto, na abagaaka b’abakuani,
english: This is what the LORD says: "Go and buy a clay jar from a potter. Take along some of the elders of the people and of the priests

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Tirimboka gochia ase enyomba y’omoruoti bw’Abayuda, okwane amang’ana aya:
english: This is what the LORD says: "Go down to the palace of the king of Judah and proclaim this message there:

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Igoro nero ekerogo kiane ki’obonene, na ense negeteni kiane ki’amagoro; inyomba ki moranyare kong’agachera? Gose ng’ai aase are ndanyare gotimokera?
english: This is what the LORD says: "Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. Where is the house you will build for me? Where will my resting place be?

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Ning’irane gocha ase Sayoni, imenye ase egati‐gati ya Yerusalemu, na Yerusalemu norokwe Omochie bw’Obwegenwa, na egetunwa ki’Omonene bw’Emeganda nakerokwe Egetunwa Egechenu.
english: This is what the LORD says: "I will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem. Then Jerusalem will be called the City of Truth, and the mountain of the LORD Almighty will be called the Holy Mountain."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Onye abanto baria batagwenerete konywa egekombe ki’egesusuro bakenywerete, Inee, inwe nigo moratigwe timonyora egesusuro? Goika monyore egesusuro; ase ayio goika mokenywere.
english: This is what the LORD says: "If those who do not deserve to drink the cup must drink it, why should you go unpunished? You will not go unpunished, but must drink it.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Ase engaki yancheire, nakoiraneretie ogosaba kwao, ase rituko ri’ogotooreka, nagokonyete, nabeire nkorendete, na goetera asore nakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabanto, erinde oiranerie ense amaya aye na gwatanana emiando yasaretigwe.
english: This is what the LORD says: "In the time of my favor I will answer you, and in the day of salvation I will help you; I will keep you and will make you to be a covenant for the people, to restore the land and to reassign its desolate inheritances,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Omonto omong’aini tabaisa gwetogeria obong’aini bwaye, gose oyore omonene obonene bwaye, gose oyore omonda obonda bwaye.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Let not the wise man boast of his wisdom or the strong man boast of his strength or the rich man boast of his riches,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Egesaku gete nkeiruruke bwango buna ekeongo, kerambore chimbaba chiaye igoro y’Abamoabu.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Look! An eagle is swooping down, spreading its wings over Moab.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Rora, abanto ngocha bare korwa ense ya sugusu. Egesaku ekenene kere ne chinguru gekorwa aare ase chinsinyo chi’ense.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Look, an army is coming from the land of the north; a great nation is being stirred up from the ends of the earth.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Renda ayare ay’oboronge oyakore, ekiagera ogotooreka kwane nigo kore ang’e gocha, na bwango oboronge bwane mbooroke.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Maintain justice and do what is right, for my salvation is close at hand and my righteousness will soon be revealed.

ekegusii: Naende aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Igoro chionsi chiise korengwa na komanyekana, na amaroso ’ense aise gotukwa na komanyekana buna ere, erio inche nintugute ororeria rw’Abaisraeli ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio onsi bakorire.”
english: This is what the LORD says: "Only if the heavens above can be measured and the foundations of the earth below be searched out will I reject all the descendants of Israel because of all they have done," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Rika igoro y’omonto oyio ng’a tari nabana, obeire omonto otasesenetigwe ase obogima bwaye. Ororeria rwaye tirogotoka roraikaranse ase ekerogo ki’oboruoti gia Daudi agambere Abayuda.”
english: This is what the LORD says: "Record this man as if childless, a man who will not prosper in his lifetime, for none of his offspring will prosper, none will sit on the throne of David or rule anymore in Judah."

ekegusii: Naende aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Tiga korera mono iga, takoiyeria amariga, ekiagera emeremo yao nenyorerwe eng’eria yaye, abwo nabairane korwa ase ense y’ababisa babo, Inche Omonene nakwanire.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Restrain your voice from weeping and your eyes from tears, for your work will be rewarded," declares the LORD. "They will return from the land of the enemy.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Naama! Amache naimokerere igoro korwa sugusu, naichore aminyoke buna emegoko emenene, naichore na gotuba ense na bionsi ebire aroro; namere emechie na bonsi abamenyeteo. Erio abanto mbarere, na abamenyi bonsi b’ense eyio mbarere na kweng’ereria.
english: This is what the LORD says: "See how the waters are rising in the north; they will become an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and everything in it, the towns and those who live in them. The people will cry out; all who dwell in the land will wail

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Rora, inche ninseegete omoika bw’ogosiria Babeli na abanto bamenyete aroro bare mamincha yane.
english: This is what the LORD says: "See, I will stir up the spirit of a destroyer against Babylon and the people of Leb Kamai.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Tera neriogi ri’omogoko ase engencho y’abanto ba Yakobo, moake amariogi ase engencho yaye oyore omonene bw’ebisaku. Raria na goaka ng’a mbuya mono, erio motebe: Omonene obooririe abanto baye, abatigari b’Abaisraeli.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Sing with joy for Jacob; shout for the foremost of the nations. Make your praises heard, and say, 'O LORD, save your people, the remnant of Israel.'

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Tenena ase chinchera, morigererie, moborie momanye chinchera chia kare, ase enchera engiya ere; moyebwatie, nario moranyore obotoereru ase obogima bwaino. “Korende abanto bakaanga, bagateba: Intwe titorigeti koyebwatia.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Stand at the crossroads and look; ask for the ancient paths, ask where the good way is, and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But you said, 'We will not walk in it.'

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Abanto abwo batooregete korwa ase ogoitwa nemioro, mbanyorete amabera agwo ase erooro. Ekero Abaisraeli baganetie banyore obotoereru,
english: This is what the LORD says: "The people who survive the sword will find favor in the desert; I will come to give rest to Israel."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba; “Abamisiri ne chinibo chiabo bechanderete, na Abaetiopia na oboonchoreria bwabo, na abanto ba Seba bare abatambe, bonsi mbache asore, babe abao amo ne chinibo chiabo. Barabwo mbagotunyane basibire chingataare, batung’ame asore, bagosabe, batebe: Ekeene, Nyasae nigo are ime yao, onde tari, Nyasae onde tari otatiga ere bweka.”
english: This is what the LORD says: "The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, and those tall Sabeans-- they will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you, coming over to you in chains. They will bow down before you and plead with you, saying, 'Surely God is with you, and there is no other; there is no other god.'"

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Ense yonsi nesarigwe etigare bosa, korende tinkoyesiria kegima.
english: This is what the LORD says: "The whole land will be ruined, though I will not destroy it completely.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: “Mbobe ki chisokoro chiaino chiaroche asende, erinde chigantiga, chikagenda gosasima emegwekano ere bosa?
english: This is what the LORD says: "What fault did your fathers find in me, that they strayed so far from me? They followed worthless idols and became worthless themselves.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene atebire: Ekero emiaka emerongo etano na ebere echikire mokobeera agwo Babeli eraere, erio nimbachere, ning’ikeranie eira yane asemore, mbairanie aase aiga.
english: This is what the LORD says: "When seventy years are completed for Babylon, I will come to you and fulfill my gracious promise to bring you back to this place.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene akoboria: “Ng’ai rirube ri’ogotigana rire, riria naete nyoko ng’a totigane? Gose monto ki nabwate esira yaye nkabaoonia inwe asare? Taibo! Ebibe nabio biagerete mokaoonigwa, na ogosaria kwaino nakwo kwagerete nyoko agaserigwa.
english: This is what the LORD says: "Where is your mother's certificate of divorce with which I sent her away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Because of your sins you were sold; because of your transgressions your mother was sent away.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Onye moganetie gotooria obogima bwaino, mwerende, timobaisa kobogoria egurube ende yonsi ase rituko ri’Esabato, gose koyesoyia ase ebiita bia Yerusalemu ase rituko erio.
english: This is what the LORD says: Be careful not to carry a load on the Sabbath day or bring it through the gates of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene otebire iga: Ase ring’ana eri ndakore, nario oramanye ng’a ninche Omonene. Rigereria, ning’ake amache ’orooche rwa Naili nenyimbo eye mbwate koboko kwane, na amache aya naonchoke abe amanyinga.
english: This is what the LORD says: By this you will know that I am the LORD: With the staff that is in my hand I will strike the water of the Nile, and it will be changed into blood.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene atebire: Inwe timogenda korwania abanto bamino Abaisraeli. Irana kera omonto nka bwoye, ekiagera aya akorekire nigo akoretwe nainche.” Ase ayio abanto bakaigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana gochia chinka chiabo, buna abatebetie.
english: 'This is what the LORD says: Do not go up to fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.'" So they obeyed the word of the LORD and went home again, as the LORD had ordered.

ekegusii: aya naro Omonene atebire: Inwe timogenda korwania abanto bamino. Irana kera omonto nka bwoye, ekiagera aya akorekire nigo akorirwe nainche.” Ase ayio abanto bakaigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakairana, tibagenda korwania Yeroboamu.
english: 'This is what the LORD says: Do not go up to fight against your brothers. Go home, every one of you, for this is my doing.'" So they obeyed the words of the LORD and turned back from marching against Jeroboam.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Kora ayare ay’ekeene na oboronge, naende motoorie omonto ourererigwe korwa ase okoboko kw’omochandi oye. Timobaisa gokorera abamenyi ne chintakana bobe, gose ababoraka, gose koba abatindi asebare, na aase aiga timobaisa goitera amanyinga ’omonto otari na komocha.
english: This is what the LORD says: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of his oppressor the one who has been robbed. Do no wrong or violence to the alien, the fatherless or the widow, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Rora, nindete igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto b’aiga okoragererigwa gwonsi korikire ase ebuku eye yasomwa ase omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: 'This is what the LORD says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people-- all the curses written in the book that has been read in the presence of the king of Judah.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Rora inche Omonene nindete igoro y’aase aiga, na igoro y’abanto b’aiga, amabe aya onsi arikire ase ebuku eye omoruoti bw’Abayuda asomire.
english: 'This is what the LORD says: I am going to bring disaster on this place and its people, according to everything written in the book the king of Judah has read.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Nimbeke Farao Hofura, omoruoti o Misiri, ase amaboko ’ababisa baye, abwo bakorigia gosiria obogima bwaye, buna nabegete Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, ase okoboko kwa Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, oria orenge omobisa oye, na origetie komoita.”
english: This is what the LORD says: 'I am going to hand Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt over to his enemies who seek his life, just as I handed Zedekiah king of Judah over to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the enemy who was seeking his life.'"

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aya naro Omonene atebire: Naama! Ning’ee Semaya Omonehelamu egesusuro, ere amo nororeria rwaye. Omonto takonyorekana ore moyo ase abanto baye, oyio orarore amang’ana amaya aya ndakorere abanto baane, ekiagera ere ogerire abanto basaririe ase Omonene!” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: this is what the LORD says: I will surely punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his descendants. He will have no one left among this people, nor will he see the good things I will do for my people, declares the LORD, because he has preached rebellion against me.'"

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba: Inche nakorete okobwatana igoro y’omobaso na obotuko, na emeroberio echikeire igoro na ense. Onye ntakong’etie okobwatana okwo,
english: This is what the LORD says: 'If I have not established my covenant with day and night and the fixed laws of heaven and earth,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, antebirie: “Bogoria egekombe eke ki’edivai y’endamwamu korwa ase okoboko kwane, erio oe ebisaku bionsi ase ndagotome gochia, biyenywe.
english: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, said to me: "Take from my hand this cup filled with the wine of my wrath and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.

ekegusii: ng’a aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Naama! Ebirwanero ebio mobwate ase amaboko aino korwaneria omoruoti o Babeli na Abakalidayo, abwo babanaaririe isiko ye chindwaki, inche omonyene nimbionchore na mbisangererie amo gati‐gati y’omochie oyio.
english: 'This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: I am about to turn against you the weapons of war that are in your hands, which you are using to fight the king of Babylon and the Babylonians who are outside the wall besieging you. And I will gather them inside this city.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, agoteba: “Inchuo ogende ase Sebuna, oyio ore omogachi na omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’obogambi, omotebie:
english: This is what the Lord, the LORD Almighty, says: "Go, say to this steward, to Shebna, who is in charge of the palace:

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae akobatebia inwe amauga: Rora, nimbeke omoika bw’obomoyo ime yaino, na inwe mobe moyo naende.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says to these bones: I will make breath enter you, and you will come to life.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Rora, nindambore okoboko kwane gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku, nintenenie ekemanyererio kiane bakerore; erio abanto abwo mbarente abana bao abamura, bababegete bikuba, na abana bao abaiseke bababegete mareko.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "See, I will beckon to the Gentiles, I will lift up my banner to the peoples; they will bring your sons in their arms and carry your daughters on their shoulders.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Omochie bw’Abaisraeli otomete abarwani esegi elifu eyemo, bono nigo otigarete ne rigana erimo, na oyotomete rigana erimo, bono nigo otigarete na ikomi.”
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "The city that marches out a thousand strong for Israel will have only a hundred left; the town that marches out a hundred strong will have only ten left."

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: “Echi nachio chirabe chimbebe chi’ense egochia gwatananerwa ebisaku ikomi na bibere bi’Abaisraeli ebe emiando yabo. Ororeria rwa Yusufu rororwo roegwe ebitari bibere.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: "These are the boundaries by which you are to divide the land for an inheritance among the twelve tribes of Israel, with two portions for Joseph.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Obosooku bwao bwaorokigwe isiko, na obogetirianda bwao tibotubiri ekero ogokora obonyaka nabanchi bao. Naende nigo gwasasimete emegwekano yao y’okogechia na okarua abana bao bakaba ekeng’wanso ase emegwekano eyio.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Because you poured out your wealth and exposed your nakedness in your promiscuity with your lovers, and because of all your detestable idols, and because you gave them your children's blood,

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Naama! Inche nigo inde mamincha y’abarisia abwo. Ninganie ching’ondi chiane korwa ase amaboko abo; nimbaange, tibakogenderera koba abarisia be ching’ondi chiane; abarisia abwo tibakogenderera kwerageria boka abanyene. Nintoorie ching’ondi chiane korwa ase emenwa yabo tichiba endagera yabo.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: I am against the shepherds and will hold them accountable for my flock. I will remove them from tending the flock so that the shepherds can no longer feed themselves. I will rescue my flock from their mouths, and it will no longer be food for them.

ekegusii: “Ee, aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba. Ekeene, nakwanire inde ne ribero rigwoka igoro y’ebisaku bitigarete, na igoro y’Abaedomu bonsi, abwo bairire ense yane koba eyabo, bare ne chinkoro chigogete na ebirengererio bi’oboenenu, erinde baserie abanyene ense, na koyesakora.
english: this is what the Sovereign LORD says: In my burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, for with glee and with malice in their hearts they made my land their own possession so that they might plunder its pastureland.'

ekegusii: “Ase ayio, aya naro inche Omonene Nyasae ngoteba: Omonto onde bwensi bw’egesaku ekegeni otarogeti ase enkoro, na ase omobere, ore ase egati y’Abaisraeli, tabaisa gosoa ase enyomba yane enchenu.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: No foreigner uncircumcised in heart and flesh is to enter my sanctuary, not even the foreigners who live among the Israelites.

ekegusii: Rusia egetambaa kia motwe amo negutwa. Amang’ana takogenderera koba buna are bono. Ayio konya akeeigwe naimokererigwe igoro, na ayio konya aimokererigwe igoro nakeeigwe. Nabo Omonene Nyasae agoteba.
english: this is what the Sovereign LORD says: Take off the turban, remove the crown. It will not be as it was: The lowly will be exalted and the exalted will be brought low.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ababisa baino babasekereire, bagoteba: Ahaa! Aase aimokererete igoro a kare ase baare gosasimera abeire aaito.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: The enemy said of you, "Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession."'

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ense yonsi negoke ekero ndagosarie obe bosa.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: While the whole earth rejoices, I will make you desolate.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Obobe nobw’ababani abwo abariri bakobwatia emeika yabo abanyene, na tibabwati korora konde gwonsi bagokwana.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD says: Woe to the foolish prophets who follow their own spirit and have seen nothing!

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkarora egetonga kere namatunda amatobu.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD showed me: a basket of ripe fruit.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkamorora ogotonga chingige ekero obonyansi bwachagete goseboka; okwo nogoseboka gwa kabere ekero obonyansi bw’omoruoti konya bwagekirwe.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts after the king's share had been harvested and just as the second crop was coming up.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene anyorogetie ase amaroro: Nkarora Omonene Nyasae ogocha korua egesusuro goetera ase omorero; omorero oyio ogasamba chindiba chinene, naende ogachaka gosamba nense ekoremwa.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD showed me: The Sovereign LORD was calling for judgment by fire; it dried up the great deep and devoured the land.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene Nyasae, Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli agoteba: “Komorang’iranere mobe abatoereru imotooreke; ase oboremereria na ogosemeria monyore chinguru.” Korende inwe mwangire gokora bo.
english: This is what the Sovereign LORD, the Holy One of Israel, says: "In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength, but you would have none of it.

ekegusii: Naama! Naboigo abakori amabe bare; botambe nigo bare buya na bagendererete komenta obotenenku bwabo.
english: This is what the wicked are like-- always carefree, they increase in wealth.

ekegusii: Okwo nakwo korabe ogoakanwa kwabo ase engencho y’oboenenu bwabo, ekiagera bachecheretie na gwetogia igoro y’abanto b’Omonene bw’Emeganda.
english: This is what they will get in return for their pride, for insulting and mocking the people of the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Naro nigo tokoyakwana, tari ase amang’ana tworokererigwe ne chisemi chia mwanyabanto, korende aya tworokererigwe n’Omoika; igo togokwana amang’ana ’Omoika ase abare n’Omoika.
english: This is what we speak, not in words taught us by human wisdom but in words taught by the Spirit, expressing spiritual truths in spiritual words.

ekegusii: Aya naro torabakorere: Tobatige babe moyo ase engencho y’ogotiana okwo twatianete. Nyasae tabaisa gotoa egesusuro.”
english: This is what we will do to them: We will let them live, so that wrath will not fall on us for breaking the oath we swore to them."

ekegusii: “Korende ase rituko erio Gogi arache korwania ense y’Abaisraeli, endamwamu yane entindi inayoke buna omorero. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: This is what will happen in that day: When Gog attacks the land of Israel, my hot anger will be aroused, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Aya naro morabakorere: Motagore ebisasimero biabo, mobutore chisiiro chiabo bagosasima, monachane emete y’Asera, enyasae yabo enkungu, na mosambe nomorero emegwekano yabo bagosasima,
english: This is what you are to do to them: Break down their altars, smash their sacred stones, cut down their Asherah poles and burn their idols in the fire.

ekegusii: Motebie Yusufu iga: Nagosabire obaabere abamino amamocho abo na ebibe biabo bagokorerete. Nimanyete ng’a mbagokorerete bobe. Ase igo bono twagosabire, otwabere ebibe biaito, naki intwe nabasomba ba Nyasae o iso.” Yusufu akarera ekero abamwabo bamoboretie amang’ana ayio.
english: 'This is what you are to say to Joseph: I ask you to forgive your brothers the sins and the wrongs they committed in treating you so badly.' Now please forgive the sins of the servants of the God of your father." When their message came to him, Joseph wept.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro oraborie ababani abwo: Ninki Omonene akoiraneirie? Gose: Narari akwanire?
english: This is what you keep saying to a prophet: 'What is the LORD's answer to you?' or 'What has the LORD spoken?'

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya naro chisokoro chiaino chiakorete ekero nabatomete korwa Kadeshi‐Barinea gochia koroota ense eyio.
english: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to look over the land.

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene agoteba, oyio ore Omonene, Nyasae oo, okorwanerera abanto baye: “Naama, narusirie korwa ase amaboko ao egekombe ekio okonywera na gotinda, egekombe ki’endamwamu yane togokenywera naende.
english: This is what your Sovereign LORD says, your God, who defends his people: "See, I have taken out of your hand the cup that made you stagger; from that cup, the goblet of my wrath, you will never drink again.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ase okwegena kwaye “akabarerwa ng’a nare noboronge.”
english: This is why "it was credited to him as righteousness."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, okobwatana koria kwe ritang’ani tigwachagete gotare namanyinga,
english: This is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio yamogwenerete arue ekeng’wanso ase engencho y’ebibe biaye ere omonyene, buna are korua ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abanto.
english: This is why he has to offer sacrifices for his own sins, as well as for the sins of the people.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nabachikire mwatanane emechie etato.
english: This is why I command you to set aside for yourselves three cities.

ekegusii: Eke nakio kiagerete ngatangwa ebiro ebinge tinacha asemore.
english: This is why I have often been hindered from coming to you.

ekegusii: Eke nakio gekogera ngokwana nabarabwo ase emereng’anio, ekiagera okorora nabarore, korende tibakorora, na okoigwa nabaigwe, korende tibakoigwa, nonya nokomanya, tibakomanya.
english: This is why I speak to them in parables: "Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio narikire aya ekero ntari agwo, erinde nkoba agwo tinkorera obotindi ase ekerengo gi’okobua koria naetwe n’Omonene ase okobaagacha, gose tari ase okobatagora.
english: This is why I write these things when I am absent, that when I come I may not have to be harsh in my use of authority-- the authority the Lord gave me for building you up, not for tearing you down.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nigo agoteba. “Ekero agendete igoro, akaira abasakore, akaa mwanyabanto ebiegwa.”
english: This is why it says: "When he ascended on high, he led captives in his train and gave gifts to men."

ekegusii: Bono abatata baito baitirwe nemioro bakure; abana baito, abamura na abaiseke, na abakungu baito bairirwe obosomba ase engencho y’ayio.
english: This is why our fathers have fallen by the sword and why our sons and daughters and our wives are in captivity.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Eke nakio kerabe egetari kiaino ndabae, ekiagera mwanyebire na mwasemeirie amang’ana ’oborimo.
english: This is your lot, the portion I have decreed for you," declares the LORD, "because you have forgotten me and trusted in false gods.

ekegusii: Bakaira ense gochakera Aroeri ase orobebe rwe rigoko ri’Arinoni goikera egetunwa keria Sioni (nakio Herimoni).
english: This land extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon Gorge to Mount Siyon (that is, Hermon),

ekegusii: Ensemo eyio nebe ey’omogambi agwo ase ense y’Abaisraeli. Abagambi baane tibabaisa kogenderera gochanda abanto baane, korende batige kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli kemenye ase orogongo rwaye.
english: This land will be his possession in Israel. And my princes will no longer oppress my people but will allow the house of Israel to possess the land according to their tribes.

ekegusii: This law also applies if the bull gores a son or daughter.
english: Onye eng’ombe egoita omomura gose omoiseke ne chingunchara chiaye, ogochika nakwo okwo okomo.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bakabora, “Inee! Nigo areite, ekiagera akobora: Aase nkogenda inche, timokonyara gochao?”
english: This made the Jews ask, "Will he kill himself? Is that why he says, 'Where I go, you cannot come'?"

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’amang’ana ayio, omoruoti akaba nendamwamu na ekeririanda ekenene, agachika ng’a abang’aini bonsi ba Babeli basirigwe.
english: This made the king so angry and furious that he ordered the execution of all the wise men of Babylon.

ekegusii: ekiagera omoika omuya mono, na okomanya, na obong’aini bw’okomanya engencho ye chindoto, na koorokia engencho y’emebayeno, na korongeyia obokong’u, biarenge ime ase omonto oria Danieli, oria omoruoti arogete Beli‐Tesasari. Bono tiga Danieli arangerigwe, nere oratebe engencho y’amariko aya.”
english: This man Daniel, whom the king called Belteshazzar, was found to have a keen mind and knowledge and understanding, and also the ability to interpret dreams, explain riddles and solve difficult problems. Call for Daniel, and he will tell you what the writing means."

ekegusii: Obomenyo bwaye nigo bwarenge aria ase chimbeera. Monto onde tarenge ore konyara komosiba nonya nase ebinyuri,
english: This man lived in the tombs, and no one could bind him any more, not even with a chain.

ekegusii: Yeso oyio nigo aruetwe ase amang’ana aroberetigwe na Nyasae, oyo oyamanyete korwa kare, na inwe mokamobamba na komoita ase amaboko ’abanto batari namachiko.
english: This man was handed over to you by God's set purpose and foreknowledge; and you, with the help of wicked men, put him to death by nailing him to the cross.

ekegusii: Omonto oyo nigo abwatwa n’Abayahudi, na barabwo bakaba ang’e komoita. Erio ngacha nomoganda bw’abarwani, nkamotooria, konya nanyorire amang’ana ng’a n’Omorumi are.
english: This man was seized by the Jews and they were about to kill him, but I came with my troops and rescued him, for I had learned that he is a Roman citizen.

ekegusii: Korende Melkizedeki, nonya tarenge bw’ororeria rwabo, akaira ensemo ya ikomi korwa ase Ibrahimu, na akamosesenia ere oyorenge ne chiira.
english: This man, however, did not trace his descent from Levi, yet he collected a tenth from Abraham and blessed him who had the promises.

ekegusii: Mariamu nere oyo oagete Omonene amaguta na komotinyia amagoro aye netukia yaye. Bono Lazaro momura omwabo nigo arenge omorwaire.
english: This Mary, whose brother Lazarus now lay sick, was the same one who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair.

ekegusii: Naki Melkizedeki oyio nigo arenge omoruoti o Salemu, omokuani o Nyasae Ore Igoro Mono. Ekero Ibrahimu are koirana korwa ase ogoita abaruoti, Melkizedeki akaumerana nere, akamosesenia.
english: This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the defeat of the kings and blessed him,

ekegusii: Obobisi boria nobo, ng’a abanto b’Ebisaku babeire abanyamwando amo naintwe, ebiimo bi’omobere oyomo, na ababwatani amo naintwe ase cira ere ase Kristo Yeso ase enchera y’enchili.
english: This mystery is that through the gospel the Gentiles are heirs together with Israel, members together of one body, and sharers together in the promise in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Chinkuma chiaye chigasarera ase ense yonsi ya Boyahudi, na ense yonsi yaetanaine.
english: This news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and the surrounding country.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya abe ekemanyererio ase okoboko kwao, na ase obosio bwao abe ekeinyorio kegokoinyoria, erinde ogenderere gokwana amachiko Omonene, ekiagera Omonene nakong’anyetie korwa Misiri nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru.
english: This observance will be for you like a sign on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that the law of the LORD is to be on your lips. For the LORD brought you out of Egypt with his mighty hand.

ekegusii: Naama! Egento gioka narigirie nanyorire neke: Nyasae nigo atongete mwanyabanto bare abaikeranu, korende barabwo batukire chinchera chinyinge chi’okobaisanekia.
english: This only have I found: God made mankind upright, but men have gone in search of many schemes."

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria Ahasi omoruoti akwete, amang’ana aya naro araretigwe:
english: This oracle came in the year King Ahaz died:

ekegusii: Epasaka eyio enene nigo yarendetwe ase omwaka o ikomi, na gatano na gatato, bw’okogamba kwa Yosia.
english: This Passover was celebrated in the eighteenth year of Josiah's reign.

ekegusii: This plan seemed good to Absalom and to all the elders of Israel.
english: Ogosemia okwo gokagwenera Abisalomu na abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli.

ekegusii: Omonto omotaka nigo akorera, na Omonene omoigwa, omotooria korwa ase emechando yaye yonsi.
english: This poor man called, and the LORD heard him; he saved him out of all his troubles.

ekegusii: Ring’ana eri rikagwenera omosangererekano bwonsi. Bagachora Stefano, omonto oichire nokwegena na Omoika Omochenu, na Filipo, na Prokoro, na Nikanora, na Timoni, na Parmena, na Nikolao bw’Antiokia, omonto oonchogete.
english: This proposal pleased the whole group. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit; also Philip, Procorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas from Antioch, a convert to Judaism.

ekegusii: engencho yaye oboronge bokorwa ase Nyasae obo bogocha ase enchera y’okomwegena Yeso Kristo ase bonsi abegenete. Naki gwatananekana tikori,
english: This righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no difference,

ekegusii: Naki emeremo y’ogokora oko teri goisanera abachenu okoremerwa kwabo gwoka, korende yamentekire mono egere Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono ara aange.
english: This service that you perform is not only supplying the needs of God's people but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanks to God.

ekegusii: Ebibe ebi bi’abamura ba Eli nigo biarenge ebinene mono ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera ase enchera eyio abanto nigo beorokereretie gochaya ebing’wanso bi’Omonene.
english: This sin of the young men was very great in the LORD's sight, for they were treating the LORD's offering with contempt.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, okomocha oko kw’ebibe nkobe asemore buna obotandoku bore ase orwaki orotambe rwekumbire, rore ang’e kogwa, na okogwa kwaye nigo korache bwango mobosokano.
english: this sin will become for you like a high wall, cracked and bulging, that collapses suddenly, in an instant.

ekegusii: Erio abanto baria bakairoka mono, bakamoboria, “Mang’ana ki aya gwakorire?” Abanto baria nigo bamanyete ng’a Yona nigo arenge gotama korwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, ekiagera konya obatebirie amang’ana ayio.
english: This terrified them and they asked, "What have you done?" (They knew he was running away from the LORD, because he had already told them so.)

ekegusii: Oborori obo nobw’ekeene. Ase ayio, obatogonyere bokong’u, erinde babe abagima ase okwegena
english: This testimony is true. Therefore, rebuke them sharply, so that they will be sound in the faith

ekegusii: Ase eri natomanye ng’a nigo tore ab’ekeene, na ase obosio bwaye natoremie chinkoro chiaito.
english: This then is how we know that we belong to the truth, and how we set our hearts at rest in his presence

ekegusii: Bagakora bo, bagatoma ebiegwa ase abagaaka ase amaboko a Barnaba na Saulo.
english: This they did, sending their gift to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ensemo eyio eyemo ya isato nimbaetie ase omorero ime, mbasibie buna efeta egosibigwa, na mbateeme buna etahabu egoteemwa. Barabwo mbarangerie erieta riane ng’a batoorigwe, na inche nimbaigwe. Inche nintebe: Abanto abwo nabaane. Barabwo mbairanerie: Omonene nere Nyasae oito.”
english: This third I will bring into the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on my name and I will answer them; I will say, 'They are my people,' and they will say, 'The LORD is our God.'"

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio Ababenjamin bagasoka korwa Gibea, bakarwana n’Abaisraeli, bagaita abanto chilifu ikomi na isano, abamanyete korwanera emioro.
english: This time, when the Benjamites came out from Gibeah to oppose them, they cut down another eighteen thousand Israelites, all of them armed with swords.

ekegusii: Ase obosio bwaye igoro nigo arenge nerieta ri’obobisi riarikire iga: “Babeli, omochie oria omonene, ng’ina abatayayi na oyo bw’okogechia gw’ense.”
english: This title was written on her forehead: MYSTERY BABYLON THE GREAT THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

ekegusii: Obo boigo nobobe bw’obororo; onye okorua ase ense ogenda buna achete, mbitoki ki abwate ase ogwechanda gokora emeremo emekong’u y’okominyokia aya are buna embeo bosa?
english: This too is a grievous evil: As a man comes, so he departs, and what does he gain, since he toils for the wind?

ekegusii: Aya onsi agakoreka, erinde anyare goikeranigwa ayatebetwe nomobani, ogoteba,
english: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:

ekegusii: Rero ninchake kogosa abanto bonsi bare inse y’erioba, erinde babairoke na koboboa ekero bakoigwa chinkuma chiaino, na batengechigwe nomoondoko.”
english: This very day I will begin to put the terror and fear of you on all the nations under heaven. They will hear reports of you and will tremble and be in anguish because of you."

ekegusii: Rituko ria rero ritaraera, abakungu b’abanene bonsi b’Abaayemi na ab’Abamedia mbabe bakoigwa aya eting’ana yakorire, na igo bagochia koyatebia abanene bonsi ase obogambi, na ogochayana okonene nigo kogochia koba amo nokoengererania okonene.
english: This very day the Persian and Median women of the nobility who have heard about the queen's conduct will respond to all the king's nobles in the same way. There will be no end of disrespect and discord.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nigo abete ekero Omonene konya abuire Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori, oyomenyete Hesiboni, amo na Ogi, omoruoti o Basani, oyomenyete Asitaroti ang’e na Edirei.
english: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, and at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’ogokora okwo Finehasi akabarwa ng’a nomonyene oboronge aare, ebiaare ase ebiaare kogenderera botambe.
english: This was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.

ekegusii: Eye nero yarenge engencho yane: Riberera ri’omobaso boira rikaba rigonsamba, na obokendu boganchanda botuko, ne chitoro chikaera korwa ase amaiso aane.
english: This was my situation: The heat consumed me in the daytime and the cold at night, and sleep fled from my eyes.

ekegusii: Eke nekero kia gatato Yeso arorekanete ase aborokigwa baye nyuma y’okobokigwa korwa ase abakure.
english: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.

ekegusii: Orogongo oro narwo rwaetwe egesaku kia Manase, omwana omomura omotangi o Yusufu ase ogoakerwa obomera, Makiri, ise Gileadi, nigo arenge omwana omomura omotangi o Manase. Ororeria rwaye rokaegwa Gileadi na Basani, ekiagera Makiri nigo arenge omonto etuoni y’esegi.
english: This was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh as Joseph's firstborn, that is, for Makir, Manasseh's firstborn. Makir was the ancestor of the Gileadites, who had received Gilead and Bashan because the Makirites were great soldiers.

ekegusii: Amagoro ayio onsi nigo areng’aine. Ebieni biabo nigo biarenge buna berulo, rigena rikomeka‐meka. Kera okogoro nigo kwaroisirie kogasoanigwa nokonde.
english: This was the appearance and structure of the wheels: They sparkled like chrysolite, and all four looked alike. Each appeared to be made like a wheel intersecting a wheel.

ekegusii: Benaya nere orenge omonto etuoni, omanyekanete ase baria Emerongo Etato, naende orenge nomochiki obo. Amisabadi, omomura oye, nere orenge komokonya ase ekeombe ekio.
english: This was the Benaiah who was a mighty man among the Thirty and was over the Thirty. His son Ammizabad was in charge of his division.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bw’ebinto ebio: Chisani chiroisirie korwa ase chitahabu, emerongo etato (30), ne chisani chiroisirie korwa ase chifeta, elifu eyemo (1,000), na ebitaabo bi’ogosambera ubani, emerongo ebere na kianda (29);
english: This was the inventory: gold dishes 30 silver dishes 1,000 silver pans 29

ekegusii: Oyo noro orenge omoroberio bw’Abaisraeli ekero barenge kogenda orogendo rwabo, ekeombe ase ekeombe, ekero kende gionsi baare koimoka korwa ase egetwori.
english: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.

ekegusii: Eke nakio egekone gia kabere Yeso akorete korwa ekero arwete Boyahudi kogenda Galili.
english: This was the second miraculous sign that Jesus performed, having come from Judea to Galilee.

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio nigo abete ebibe ase enyomba ya Yeroboamu, na akagera ekanachwa na egasirigwa kegima korwa ase ense.
english: This was the sin of the house of Jeroboam that led to its downfall and to its destruction from the face of the earth.

ekegusii: Oro narwo orogongo rwe chiamate chi’egesaku gi’Efraimu: Orobebe rwabo rwa moocha rogachakera Ataroti‐Adari, rokagenderera goika Beti‐Horoni ya rogoro,
english: This was the territory of Ephraim, clan by clan: The boundary of their inheritance went from Ataroth Addar in the east to Upper Beth Horon

ekegusii: Oyio noro omobaro bwe chiamate chi’Abakohati abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, abwo Musa na Haroni babarete, buna Omonene achigete Musa.
english: This was the total of all those in the Kohathite clans who served in the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the LORD's command through Moses.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bwe chiamate chi’Abagerisoni, abarigetwe, abwo baare konyara gokora emeremo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, abwo Musa na Haroni babarete, buna Omonene achigete.
english: This was the total of those in the Gershonite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the LORD's command.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omobaro bwe chiamate chi’Abamerari, abwo Musa na Haroni babarete, buna Omonene achigete Musa.
english: This was the total of those in the Merarite clans. Moses and Aaron counted them according to the LORD's command through Moses.

ekegusii: Oyo noro omoroberio obo bw’obokoreri bwabo bw’enyomba y’Omonene buna Haroni, sokoro yabo, abarobereretie koreng’ana buna Omonene Nyasae amochigete.
english: This was their appointed order of ministering when they entered the temple of the LORD, according to the regulations prescribed for them by their forefather Aaron, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

ekegusii: erinde riikeranigwe ring’ana riria omobani Isaya atebete, “Omonene, ning’o bwegenire amang’ana aito? Naende ning’o okoboko kw’Omonene kwamaanoreirwe?”
english: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: "Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?"

ekegusii: Eri nigo riabete, erinde rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya,
english: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:

ekegusii: rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya, ogoteba, “Ere akaimokia oboreu bwaito, na akabogoria amarwaire aito.”
english: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah: "He took up our infirmities and carried our diseases."

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya akagenderera ase engaki y’emiaka ebere, goika bonsi abamenyete Asia, Abayahudi na Abagiriki, bakaigwa ring’ana ri’Omonene.
english: This went on for two years, so that all the Jews and Greeks who lived in the province of Asia heard the word of the Lord.

ekegusii: Nabo agendererete gokora omwaka ase omwaka. Ekero barenge kogenda gosasima ase enyomba y’Omonene, Penina akaba ogoichania Hana, na Hana nigo arenge kona‐korera goika takoria gento.
english: This went on year after year. Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the LORD, her rival provoked her till she wept and would not eat.

ekegusii: Ense eye yonsi nesareke ebe amaturi na ebisaku ebi nabimokorere omoruoti o Babeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo etano na ebere.
english: This whole country will become a desolate wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

ekegusii: Na eke nekemanyererio asemore: Namonyore omwana ekeng’werere obekeire chianga chi’obwana, bwareirie ase orotuba.”
english: This will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger."

ekegusii: Orogongo orwo nigo rorabe orw’abakuani abwo bachenekire, abwo b’ororeria rwa Zadoki. Abwo nigo babete abegenwa asende, tibantigete buna Abalawi bande bakorete ekero Abaisraeli basaretie bagantiga.
english: This will be for the consecrated priests, the Zadokites, who were faithful in serving me and did not go astray as the Levites did when the Israelites went astray.

ekegusii: Ekero eke nekia gatato ngocha asemore. Ase emenwa y’abarori babere gose batato kera ring’ana nariikeranigwe.
english: This will be my third visit to you. "Every matter must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses."

ekegusii: Ekio nakio kerabe egesusuro ase Abamisiri na ase abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, abwo baraange gotiira gochia korenda Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu.
english: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that do not go up to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles.

ekegusii: Abakuani mbanyore orogongo rwabo korwa ase orwo orochenu. Orogongo rwabo nigo rorabe nobotambe bwe chimoti chilifu emerongo ebere na isano (25,000) korwa moocha goika bosongo, na korwa sugusu goika irianyi robe chimoti chilifu ikomi (10,000). Aase aachenu ay’Omonene nigo arabe gati‐gati y’oboremo obwo.
english: This will be the sacred portion for the priests. It will be 25,000 cubits long on the north side, 10,000 cubits wide on the west side, 10,000 cubits wide on the east side and 25,000 cubits long on the south side. In the center of it will be the sanctuary of the LORD.

ekegusii: This will bring health to your body and nourishment to your bones.
english: Korakore igo, ayio nagwenie omobere oo abeke emeseto y’amauga ao chinguru.

ekegusii: Ayio naro aragokie Omonene kobua komoruera eng’ombe koba ekeng’wanso, gose komoruera eeri ere ne chingunchara na ebitaago.
english: This will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with its horns and hoofs.

ekegusii: This will result in your being witnesses to them.
english: Eke nekero kiaino koba kirori.

ekegusii: Nabo arache koba ase rituko riria, koreng’ana nenchili eye nkorandia, Nyasae kagochi‐gocha nanachere obobisi bwa mwanyabanto ekina, goetera ase Kristo Yeso.
english: This will take place on the day when God will judge men's secrets through Jesus Christ, as my gospel declares.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia igoro y’Abayahudi bonsi bamenyete ase ense ya Misiri, agwo ase emechie ya Migidoli, na Tapanesi, na Memifisi, na ase orogongo rwa Patirosi, rigateba:
english: This word came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews living in Lower Egypt-- in Migdol, Tahpanhes and Memphis-- and in Upper Egypt:

ekegusii: Oyio noro omochakano bw’ebikone Yeso akorete, agwo Kana ya Galili, akaorokia obonene bwaye; aborokigwa baye bakamwegena.
english: This, the first of his miraculous signs, Jesus performed at Cana in Galilee. He thus revealed his glory, and his disciples put their faith in him.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nabwo ororeria rwa Peresi: Peresi akaibora Hezironi;
english: This, then, is the family line of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron,

ekegusii: Tomas akamoboria, “Omonene, titomanyeti aase ogochia, naki toramanye enchera?”
english: Thomas said to him, "Lord, we don't know where you are going, so how can we know the way?"

ekegusii: Tomas akamoiraneria, “Omonene one, na Nyasae one!”
english: Thomas said to him, "My Lord and my God!"

ekegusii: thorns had come up everywhere, the ground was covered with weeds, and the stone wall was in ruins.
english: Nkarora omogondo oyio omerire amagwa, na amasa ayotubire, na amagena aagacheire chindwaki chiaye konya atagokire.

ekegusii: Amagwa namere ase chinyomba chi’oboruoti, amasa na amageri mbimere ase chiburi chi’aroro. Nabe obomenyo bwe chisese chi’orosana ne chisagero.
english: Thorns will overrun her citadels, nettles and brambles her strongholds. She will become a haunt for jackals, a home for owls.

ekegusii: Baria b’enchera ensemo, nabwo baikire koriigwa; erio Saitani ochicha, na korusia ring’ana riria ase chinkoro chiabo, erinde tibacha kwegena batooreke.
english: Those along the path are the ones who hear, and then the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.

ekegusii: Those controlled by the sinful nature cannot please God.
english: Abagotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe tibakonyara kogwenera Nyasae.

ekegusii: Abanto korwa ase ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli, baria baruete chinkoro chiabo komorigia Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, bagatunyana Abalawi gochia Yerusalemu, bakarua ebing’wanso ase Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo.
english: Those from every tribe of Israel who set their hearts on seeking the LORD, the God of Israel, followed the Levites to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the LORD, the God of their fathers.

ekegusii: Abanto b’ororeria rwa Yuda, na orwa Benjamin, na orw’Efraimu, na orwa Manase, abwo bamenyete Yerusalemu nabwo aba:
english: Those from Judah, from Benjamin, and from Ephraim and Manasseh who lived in Jerusalem were:

ekegusii: Obasangereirie obarentire korwa ase chinse ao ao, korwa moocha na bosongo, na korwa sugusu na irianyi.
english: those he gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.

ekegusii: Bono Abaibirania abwo babwataine n’Abafilisti korwa agwo kare na komenya amo nabarabwo ase egetwori kiabo, bakairana bakabwatana n’Abaisraeli abwo barenge gotang’anwa na Saulo na Yonathani.
english: Those Hebrews who had previously been with the Philistines and had gone up with them to their camp went over to the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.

ekegusii: Mbare negesio abwo bagokwa ase ogoitwa nemioro kobua abwo enchara egoita, ekiagera barabwo nigo bakogenderera korea na korea, ase okoborwa gw’okwama kw’emegondo.
english: Those killed by the sword are better off than those who die of famine; racked with hunger, they waste away for lack of food from the field.

ekegusii: Abamenyete ase chinsinyo chi’ense nigo bagokumia ebimanyererio biao. Abare ase erioba rigosoka korwa goikera ase rikogwa gochia, nigo okogera batera nomogoko.
english: Those living far away fear your wonders; where morning dawns and evening fades you call forth songs of joy.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli konya berusananirie korwa ase abamenyi bonsi, na bagatenena koorokia ebibe biabo, amo nogokora okobe gwe chisokoro chiabo.
english: Those of Israelite descent had separated themselves from all foreigners. They stood in their places and confessed their sins and the wickedness of their fathers.

ekegusii: Baria bare abake asemore baratigare bare moyo agwo ase ense y’ababisa baino nabasirere aroro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo, naboigo nase engencho y’ebibe bie chisokoro chiabo nabasire buna chisokoro chiabo chiasirete.
english: Those of you who are left will waste away in the lands of their enemies because of their sins; also because of their fathers' sins they will waste away.

ekegusii: Abande b’abasomba ba Farao, abwo bairogete ring’ana ri’Omonene, bakaayerera korenta abasomba babo ne chitugo chiabo inka.
english: Those officials of Pharaoh who feared the word of the LORD hurried to bring their slaves and their livestock inside.

ekegusii: Na baria bare ase egetare nabwo baria bakoigwa ring’ana, baribwata nomogoko, korende barabwo tibari nemeri, begena ase ekero egeke, na ekero ki’ogoteemwa beatanana.
english: Those on the rock are the ones who receive the word with joy when they hear it, but they have no root. They believe for a while, but in the time of testing they fall away.

ekegusii: Baria bande mbare nomokia asemore, korende tari ase enchera ere engiya; mbarigetie kobasie kera isiko, erinde monyare gokora omokia kobakorera.
english: Those people are zealous to win you over, but for no good. What they want is to alienate you [from us], so that you may be zealous for them.

ekegusii: Bonsi abaare konyara korua chifeta ne chitaai bakabirenta bibe ebiegwa ase Omonene, na bonsi abarenge nemekonge eyere emiya ase emeremo ende yonsi, bakayerenta.
english: Those presenting an offering of silver or bronze brought it as an offering to the LORD, and everyone who had acacia wood for any part of the work brought it.

ekegusii: Abwo nabwo barenge ababani baria b’Abaisraeli babanete igoro ya Yerusalemu, na baroche amaroro ay’omorembe, nonya omorembe torengeo. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: those prophets of Israel who prophesied to Jerusalem and saw visions of peace for her when there was no peace, declares the Sovereign LORD."'

ekegusii: Abarisia bagatama, bakararia amang’ana aya ase omochie na ebichie. Abanto bagasoka barore amang’ana aorokire.
english: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.

ekegusii: Na abarisia bagatama, bakagenda omochie bakararia amang’ana onsi ayakoregete ase baria babwatire nebirecha.
english: Those tending the pigs ran off, went into the town and reported all this, including what had happened to the demon-possessed men.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo Omonene asesenirie mbaire ense ebe eyabo, korende abwo aragereirie mbasirigwe kegima.
english: those the LORD blesses will inherit the land, but those he curses will be cut off.

ekegusii: Abamura aba ba Haroni nabwo baagetwe amaguta na gwatananwa ase emeremo y’obokuani.
english: Those were the names of Aaron's sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.

ekegusii: Na barabwo abanchete ring’ana riaye bakabatiswa, ne rituko riria bakamentekana abanto koreng’ana chilifu isato.
english: Those who accepted his message were baptized, and about three thousand were added to their number that day.

ekegusii: “Abanto bamenyete aare mbachiche gokonya koagacha Hekalu y’Omonene. Erio nario moramanye ng’a Omonene bw’Emeganda nere ontomete asemore. Amang’ana ayio nigo araikerane koraigwe eriogi ri’Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: Those who are far away will come and help to build the temple of the LORD, and you will know that the LORD Almighty has sent me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the LORD your God."

ekegusii: Rora, abanto abwo bagweatanana korwa asore nabasire; aye nigo orasirie abwo batari abegenwa asore.
english: Those who are far from you will perish; you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.

ekegusii: Erio nebe ng’a kera omonto otigarete ase Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, narokwe omochenu, kera oyomo oyorikire ase egati y’abwo bare moyo ase Yerusalemu.
