english: Those who are left in Zion, who remain in Jerusalem, will be called holy, all who are recorded among the living in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abwo bamenyete ang’e naye, na abwo bare aare, mbagochecherie aye otari nerieta rigiya, oichire neburuburu.
english: Those who are near and those who are far away will mock you, O infamous city, full of turmoil.

ekegusii: Abanto mbare bakwerora ng’a nabaikeranu bare, korende tibachenegeti korwa ase obobe bwabo.
english: those who are pure in their own eyes and yet are not cleansed of their filth;

ekegusii: Erio abwo basirire ase omoika mbaegwe okomanya, na abwo bakwemurungania mbanche amorokererio.”
english: Those who are wayward in spirit will gain understanding; those who complain will accept instruction."

ekegusii: Abwo bare abang’aini mbabe bakomeka‐meka buna amasase a igoro, na abwo baonchorete abange bakanyora oboronge mbameka‐meke buna ching’enang’eni goika kare na kare.
english: Those who are wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Abwo bare aba Kristo Yeso babambire chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe amo nokogania okobe na okorengereria kwabo.
english: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the sinful nature with its passions and desires.

ekegusii: Ninsirie baria bakoriina kerama igoro gosasima erioba, na omotienyi, ne ching’enang’eni boigo ninsirie abanto baria bagonsasima inche Omonene na batiana asende, naende batiana nase enyasae eria Milikomu.
english: those who bow down on the roofs to worship the starry host, those who bow down and swear by the LORD and who also swear by Molech,

ekegusii: Abamoitete nabwo aba: Sabadi, omomura o Simeati, omokungu bw’Abaamoni, na Yehosabadi, omomura o Simiriti, omokungu bw’Abamoabu.
english: Those who conspired against him were Zabad, son of Shimeath an Ammonite woman, and Jehozabad, son of Shimrith a Moabite woman.

ekegusii: Abwo bakominyokera amabe bambereire ang’e; abwo nigo bare aare korwa ase amachiko ao.
english: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from your law.

ekegusii: Abanto baria batakwete bakariegwa namagumba, bakarera, na ekerero kiabo kegaika igoro.
english: Those who did not die were afflicted with tumors, and the outcry of the city went up to heaven.

ekegusii: Abanto baria bakoria endagera amo nere mbamosirie, na abarwani baye b’esegi mbaserebekane, na abange mbaitwe bakwe.
english: Those who eat from the king's provisions will try to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall in battle.

ekegusii: Abaratooreke korwa ase emioro mbarue ase ense ya Misiri, bairane ase ense y’Abayuda, abanto abasinini mono ase omobaro. Abatigari bonsi b’Abayuda abagendete komenya ase ense ya Misiri nabamanye gose ring’ana neriang’o riragenderere koba eri’ekeene, eriane gose eriabo.
english: Those who escape the sword and return to the land of Judah from Egypt will be very few. Then the whole remnant of Judah who came to live in Egypt will know whose word will stand-- mine or theirs.

ekegusii: Abanto batigire amachiko nigo bagotogia abakori amabe, korende abarendete amachiko nigo bakoamererania nabwo.
english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law resist them.

ekegusii: Abanto baria bamonyorete bakamoira ase Musa na Haroni, na ase omoganda bwonsi.
english: Those who found him gathering wood brought him to Moses and Aaron and the whole assembly,

ekegusii: Abwo bakoraa abanto aba mbabasirie, na abwo bakoraagwa nabanto abwo mbasirigwe.
english: Those who guide this people mislead them, and those who are guided are led astray.

ekegusii: Baria babwatete Yeso bakamoira ase Kayafa omokuani omonene, aase aborokia b’amariko na abagaaka basangererekanete.
english: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas, the high priest, where the teachers of the law and the elders had assembled.

ekegusii: Na baria baserebanetigwe bakagenda chinsemo ne chinsemo, bakarandia ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: Those who had been scattered preached the word wherever they went.

ekegusii: Na baria bayaroche bakabatebia buna oria obwatire nebirecha agwenetigwe.
english: Those who had seen it told the people how the demon-possessed man had been cured.

ekegusii: Na baria abayaroche bakaorokia amang’ana amonyorire oria obwatire nebirecha, na amang’ana e chimbeche.
english: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the demon-possessed man-- and told about the pigs as well.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bangechete bosa engencho ende etaiyo; nigo bare abange kobua etukia ere ase omotwe one. Ababisa baane nigo bagokwana oborimo igoro yane, baganetie gosiria obogima bwane, nigo bare ne chinguru chinyinge. Nigo naakanete ebi ntaibete.
english: Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.

ekegusii: Abwo bangechete inche Omonene, nigo baare gocha gotung’ama asende bare nobwoba, na amatuko abo nagenderere kobao kare na kare.
english: Those who hate the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

ekegusii: Na baria bare nabanene abegeni tibabachaya ekiagera nabamwabo bare, korende babakorere buya kobua, ekiagera abwo bakoreirwe emeremo emiya nigo bare abegeni na abanchwa. Bworokererie amang’ana aya, na gokurera.
english: Those who have believing masters are not to show less respect for them because they are brothers. Instead, they are to serve them even better, because those who benefit from their service are believers, and dear to them. These are the things you are to teach and urge on them.

ekegusii: Naki abwo bagokora emeremo yabo y’obokonyi buya benyoreire amasikani na oboremu obonge ase okwegena kore ime ase Kristo Yeso.
english: Those who have served well gain an excellent standing and great assurance in their faith in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Those who heard this asked, "Who then can be saved?"
english: Na abwo abayaigwete bakabora, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi bamanyete erieta riao, nigo bagosemeretie, ekiagera aye Omonene togotiga abwo bagokorigia.
english: Those who know your name will trust in you, for you, LORD, have never forsaken those who seek you.

ekegusii: Nabwo batang’aine bakamokania, bakamotebia akire, korende ere akamenta mono goaka eriogi, “Omwana o Daudi, indorera amabera!”
english: Those who led the way rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, "Son of David, have mercy on me!"

ekegusii: Nabanto abwo bakona‐konywa edivai ase chingaki chintambe, na abwo bakona‐korigia konywa edivai yochoganirie neyende.
english: Those who linger over wine, who go to sample bowls of mixed wine.

ekegusii: Baria bagotunyana chingencho chiabo chi’ebibe nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’ebibe, korende baria bagotunyana chingencho chi’Omoika nigo barengereretie chingencho chi’Omoika.
english: Those who live according to the sinful nature have their minds set on what that nature desires; but those who live in accordance with the Spirit have their minds set on what the Spirit desires.

ekegusii: Abanto bamenyete Maroti nigo baganyete mono ng’a baremigwe; amaakwa arure ase Omonene, aikire ase egeita kia Yerusalemu.
english: Those who live in Maroth writhe in pain, waiting for relief, because disaster has come from the LORD, even to the gate of Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Emete eyio egasoa amo noro gochia aase abakure ase abwo baitetwe nemioro basoete, ee, emete eyio nigo yaikaransete ase ekiriri kiaye ase egati y’ebisaku ase okoyokonya.
english: Those who lived in its shade, its allies among the nations, had also gone down to the grave with it, joining those killed by the sword.

ekegusii: Abwo bamorigereretie nigo bakomeka‐meka bare nomogoko, gose amasio abo takororekana are nobosooku.
english: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.

ekegusii: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.
english: Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nabo barabe buna ero ere; naboigo na baria bayiegenete.

ekegusii: Abakoroisia emegwekano eyio nigo banga buna ero, ee, naboigo abwo bonsi bayiegenete.
english: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

ekegusii: those who mourn, as if they did not; those who are happy, as if they were not; those who buy something, as if it were not theirs to keep;
english: na baria bakorera babe buna tibari korera; na baria bagogete babe buna tibagogeti: na baria bakogora babe buna tibari na gento;

ekegusii: Na bonsi ababwatete amachiko aye nigo bamenyete ime asare na ere ime asebare. Na igo twamanyire ng’a ere nigo amenyete ime asetore, twayamanyire korwa ase Omoika oria atoeire.
english: Those who obey his commands live in him, and he in them. And this is how we know that he lives in us: We know it by the Spirit he gave us.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo barenge koria endagera engiya mono bakwereire ase chinchera; na abwo barenge kweboyia chianga chimonyinga, nigo baraire ase chitui chie ribu.
english: Those who once ate delicacies are destitute in the streets. Those nurtured in purple now lie on ash heaps.

ekegusii: oyorabatebererie ase obwororo abwo bakoamererania nere. Aande Nyasae nabaonchore, erinde bamanye ekeene gionsi,
english: Those who oppose him he must gently instruct, in the hope that God will grant them repentance leading them to a knowledge of the truth,

ekegusii: Abare mamincha y’Omonene nabasenyentwe, Omonene nabaake nenkoba korwa igoro. Ere nanachere ense yonsi ekina. Omonene nae omoruoti oye okobua na aimokererie igoro orogunchara rw’omoakwa amaguta oye.”
english: those who oppose the LORD will be shattered. He will thunder against them from heaven; the LORD will judge the ends of the earth. "He will give strength to his king and exalt the horn of his anointed."

ekegusii: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads
english: Na barabwo abaare goeta, bakamorama, bagosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo, bakobora,

ekegusii: Na abanto abaare goeta bakamorama, bagosinga‐singisia emetwe yabo, bagoteba, “A! Aye oyogotagora Hekalu na koyeagacha ase amatuko atato,
english: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads and saying, "So! You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days,

ekegusii: Abachandi baito bigo batobwatete amogoti, nigo tokorosa mono, titori konyora ogotimoka.
english: Those who pursue us are at our heels; we are weary and find no rest.

ekegusii: Abwo bagoakana amabe ase amaya nigo babeire ababisa baane, ekiagera ngokora ayare amaya.
english: Those who repay my good with evil slander me when I pursue what is good.

ekegusii: Ababegete ebimanyererio biabo ase okobwatana koria nabwo aba: Nehemia omogavuna, mosinto o Hakalia, na Zedekia.
english: Those who sealed it were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah. Zedekiah,

ekegusii: “Abanto abwo barakorore mbakorigererie baasamie emenwa yabo bakumie, mbabe bakorengereria igoro yao, batebe: Inee! Omonto oyo nere oria otengechetie ense, oria onyegeretie amaruoti?
english: Those who see you stare at you, they ponder your fate: "Is this the man who shook the earth and made kingdoms tremble,

ekegusii: Abanto abwo baganetie gosiria obogima bwane bantegeire oboreba; na abwo baganetie gonkora bobe nigo bagokwana amang’ana ’ogosirigwa kwane, bakorengereria amang’ana ’obong’ainereria omobaso boira.
english: Those who seek my life set their traps, those who would harm me talk of my ruin; all day long they plot deception.

ekegusii: Abwo bagokora ebibe, obatogonyere ase amasio ’abanto bonsi, erinde abande bairoke.
english: Those who sin are to be rebuked publicly, so that the others may take warning.

ekegusii: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of the drunkards.
english: Inche ngokwanwa bobe nabwo bagoikaransa ang’e negeita kogamba, abakonywa na gotinda bakoroisia amatera ay’ogonchecheria.

ekegusii: Abwo bakobusura bare namariga mbagese bare nomochengo.
english: Those who sow in tears will reap with songs of joy.

ekegusii: Tinkwoboa abanto abwo basemeretie obotenenku bwabo; barabwo nigo bare bakoenenera obonda bwabo bore obonge.
english: those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?

ekegusii: Abanto abwo basemeretie Abamisiri na betogeretie Abaetiopia mbabe baichanete na gosooka.
english: Those who trusted in Cush and boasted in Egypt will be afraid and put to shame.

ekegusii: Ninsirie abairanire nyuma batigire kombwatia inche Omonene, na baria batari kondigia inche Omonene, gose komboria amang’ana.”
english: those who turn back from following the LORD and neither seek the LORD nor inquire of him.

ekegusii: na baria bagokorera ense eye babe buna tibari koyekorera, ekiagera ense buna ere bono ngoeta ere.
english: those who use the things of the world, as if not engrossed in them. For this world in its present form is passing away.

ekegusii: osoa ase omorembe. Abwo bagotaara ase oboronge nigo bakoba batimogete ase chimbeera chiabo.
english: Those who walk uprightly enter into peace; they find rest as they lie in death.

ekegusii: Bonsi abwo barigetie kororekana buya ase emebere yabo, abwo nabwo bakobabetereria ng’a mwarokigwe, erinde tibachandwa ase engencho y’omosalaba o Kristo.
english: Those who want to make a good impression outwardly are trying to compel you to be circumcised. The only reason they do this is to avoid being persecuted for the cross of Christ.

ekegusii: Abanto abatang’aine na baria baare komotunyana bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Hosana! Nasesenirie oyogocha ase erieta ri’Omonene!
english: Those who went ahead and those who followed shouted, "Hosanna!" "Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"

ekegusii: Erio baria barenge ang’e komoboria bakaimoka, bakamotiga bwango, na oria omotang’ani omonene akoboa ekero aigwa ng’a n’Omorumi are, na konya omosibire.
english: Those who were about to question him withdrew immediately. The commander himself was alarmed when he realized that he had put Paul, a Roman citizen, in chains.

ekegusii: Abanto ababwate endagera eisaine kare bono berure gokora emeremo, erinde banyore endagera, nabwo barenge nenchara, baigotire bono. Omokungu orenge omogomba oiboire abana batano na babere, korende oria konya obwate abange otigaire ore bosa.
english: Those who were full hire themselves out for food, but those who were hungry hunger no more. She who was barren has borne seven children, but she who has had many sons pines away.

ekegusii: Abande nigo barenge abateri abanene, boigo nabwo barenge abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abalawi. Barabwo nigo bamenyete ase ebinyomba bie Hekalu; tibarenge gokora emeremo ende emeao, ekiagera omobaso na obotuko nigo barenge ase emeremo baetwe gokora.
english: Those who were musicians, heads of Levite families, stayed in the rooms of the temple and were exempt from other duties because they were responsible for the work day and night.

ekegusii: “Nigo narenge korigigwa buna enyoni nabwo barenge ababisa baane engencho ende etaiyo.
english: Those who were my enemies without cause hunted me like a bird.

ekegusii: Nabo baria batometwe bakagenda, bakayenyora buna abatebetie.
english: Those who were sent ahead went and found it just as he had told them.

ekegusii: Baria bateneine ang’e nere bakabora, “Inee! Naye okorama omokuani omonene o Nyasae?”
english: Those who were standing near Paul said, "You dare to insult God's high priest?"

ekegusii: Omonene nasirie abanto abwo bagosiria abande namang’ana abo, abwo bakobeka omoeto ase oyo okogamba ebina agwo ase egeita, bakwana oborimo na koonchorana oboronge bw’omonto ore omoronge.
english: those who with a word make a man out to be guilty, who ensnare the defender in court and with false testimony deprive the innocent of justice.

ekegusii: Those who work with combed flax will despair, the weavers of fine linen will lose hope.
english: Abwo bakoroisia chiusi chi’egatani, na abakoroisia ebitambaa bi’ebamba, mberusie moyo.

ekegusii: Inche nigo nkobaa egesusuro bonsi abanyanchete, na kobagambera; gaki kabe nomokia na koonchoka.
english: Those whom I love I rebuke and discipline. So be earnest, and repent.

ekegusii: Abanto mbare bagwekaga ng’a nabaya bare na korigereria namaiso aichire nobomwenu.
english: those whose eyes are ever so haughty, whose glances are so disdainful;

ekegusii: Abanto mbare babwate amaino anga emioro, ne chintakunero chi’amaino abo nigo chinga emeyio; barabwo nigo bakoria na gosiria abataka bare ase ense; nigo bakoura abaremeire bare ase abanto.
english: those whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are set with knives to devour the poor from the earth, the needy from among mankind.

ekegusii: Neba omoganda omonene bw’esegi ong’etananire, enkoro yane tekoba nobwoba; gose abanto nabachicha kondwania esegi, inche nigo ndagenderere koba noboremu.
english: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then will I be confident.

ekegusii: Omokori amabe naisa gwanchererigwa, takweorokereria oboronge; ekero are ase ense egokora oboronge nigo arakore ay’obokorekanu, takorora obonene bw’Omonene.
english: Though grace is shown to the wicked, they do not learn righteousness; even in a land of uprightness they go on doing evil and regard not the majesty of the LORD.

ekegusii: Though hail flattens the forest and the city is leveled completely,
english: Ekero embura y’amagena erabe egotwa neiyerie emete ye rinani, na omochie oino noiranigwe inse mono.

ekegusii: Nonya omobekire ase omoichano, namororere amabera naende, ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye obonene bwa botambe.
english: Though he brings grief, he will show compassion, so great is his unfailing love.

ekegusii: nonya obwatererete obobe obwo bokong’u, takobotiga, korende nabogache ase omonwa oye ime,
english: though he cannot bear to let it go and keeps it in his mouth,

ekegusii: Nabe ogotama korwa ase ekerwanero gi’ekioma, abetwe nensara y’etaai.
english: Though he flees from an iron weapon, a bronze-tipped arrow pierces him.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio naisa gosangereria chifeta chinyinge, naende atumbe chianga chibe chindwenyi buna esike;
english: Though he heaps up silver like dust and clothes like piles of clay,

ekegusii: Omonene naisa kong’ita, ningenderere komosemeria, nonya nabo goika ndete amang’ana aane ase obosio bwaye.
english: Though he slay me, yet will I hope in him; I will surely defend my ways to his face.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio naisa kogochwa, takogwa inse, ekiagera Omonene namobwatete okoboko kwaye.
english: though he stumble, he will not fall, for the LORD upholds him with his hand.

ekegusii: Ere naisa koba nobonene boigete igoro, na omotwe oye oike ase amare,
english: Though his pride reaches to the heavens and his head touches the clouds,

ekegusii: Ekero agokwana amang’ana are amansu, tobaisa komwegena, ekiagera nabwate ay’okogechia atano na abere, ase enkoro yaye ime.
english: Though his speech is charming, do not believe him, for seven abominations fill his heart.

ekegusii: Naki nonya inde nobosibore korwa ase abanto bonsi, nekorire omosomba o bonsi, erinde ndete abanto abange kobua.
english: Though I am free and belong to no man, I make myself a slave to everyone, to win as many as possible.

ekegusii: Inche nabeire buna ekerandi ki’edivai gekorire korwa ase risankwa kere ase erioki, nonya naboigo, tindeba emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget your decrees.

ekegusii: Nigo inde oyo otasikiri, naende inchayire, korende nonya naboigo tinkweba amachiko ao.
english: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget your precepts.

ekegusii: Ase chingaki chionsi tinaborarete obogima bwane, na tinyebeti amachiko ao.
english: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget your law.

ekegusii: Nonya ninche ase ensemo yane ninyare gosemeria ebia omobere. Onye omonto onde okorora ng’a nare nengencho y’ogosemeria ebia omobere, inche nkobua,
english: though I myself have reasons for such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has reasons to put confidence in the flesh, I have more:

ekegusii: Nonya nabasiarerete gochia ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, mbabe bakong’inyora ase chinse chiria chi’aare. Barabwo mbabe moyo amo nabana babo, naende bairane inka.
english: Though I scatter them among the peoples, yet in distant lands they will remember me. They and their children will survive, and they will return.

ekegusii: Nimba ngoeta ase egati y’emechando, aye nigo ondendete ngenderere koba moyo; aye nigo okorambora okoboko kwao igoro y’ababisa baane bare nendamwamu, na okoboko kwao gw’okorio gwantooria.
english: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life; you stretch out your hand against the anger of my foes, with your right hand you save me.

ekegusii: Nonya inche nare koba tindi nokomocha, tinarenge komoiraneria; nigo narenge gosaba amabera korwa ase omonsoeri.
english: Though I were innocent, I could not answer him; I could only plead with my Judge for mercy.

ekegusii: mambia nigo bogokina bwasicha, mogoroba bwanachwa bwoma.
english: though in the morning it springs up new, by evening it is dry and withered.

ekegusii: ero nenke mono kobua chimbusuro chionsi, korende koyakinire eba enene kobua chinyeni chionsi, eba omote, goika chinyoni chia igoro chichia koroisia ebiswa ase chinsagia chiaye.”
english: Though it is the smallest of all your seeds, yet when it grows, it is the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and perch in its branches."

ekegusii: Omwana oria taroche erioba, gose tamanyete gento kende, korende nonya naboigo nigo akonyora omotimoko kobua omonto oria,
english: Though it never saw the sun or knew anything, it has more rest than does that man--

ekegusii: gose emerindo y’enyancha neba ekoruma na koimokerera igoro, na ebitunwa bibe bigotengechigwa ase ogoturubanigwa okwo.
english: though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging. Selah

ekegusii: Onye tata na baba baraba bagontiga, Omonene nang’ire imbe oyoye.
english: Though my father and mother forsake me, the LORD will receive me.

ekegusii: Nonya yare koba ng’a ase rituko erio okoyesimeka noyegitere orobago, na mambia yaye esiche, okwama kwaye nigo korasirigwe ekero rituko ri’emechando rirache, rire nobororo botari gokwaneka.
english: though on the day you set them out, you make them grow, and on the morning when you plant them, you bring them to bud, yet the harvest will be as nothing in the day of disease and incurable pain.

ekegusii: Omonto aise korwania oyomo ore bweka, namobue, korende onye bare babere, takobabua. Engori esisire nemegoye etato teri kobutoka bwango.
english: Though one may be overpowered, two can defend themselves. A cord of three strands is not quickly broken.

ekegusii: Omonene karaamereranie nomonto amang’ana elifu eyemo, omonto takonyara komoiraneria nonya nerimo.
english: Though one wished to dispute with him, he could not answer him one time out of a thousand.

ekegusii: Abagambi nabaikaransa amo koroberia bankore bobe, korende inche, omosomba oo, nigo nkona‐koiranerera emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Though rulers sit together and slander me, your servant will meditate on your decrees.

ekegusii: Abanto abamwenu nigo bakongamba na gokwana oborimo igoro yane, korende inche nigo ndendete amachiko ao nenkoro yane yonsi.
english: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep your precepts with all my heart.

ekegusii: Emeko tegosicha, na emesabibu tekwama; emezeituni nigo erabe bosa tiyama, na emegondo tekwama chindagera. Amaicho e ching’ondi nasirigwe korwa ase ameri, na amaicho e chiombe takobao.
english: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though there are no sheep in the pen and no cattle in the stalls,

ekegusii: Nonya Omonene ore igoro aare, nigo aroche abanto abaitongo, korende abare abaenenu nigo akobamanya kobare aare.
english: Though the LORD is on high, he looks upon the lowly, but the proud he knows from afar.

ekegusii: Nonya nebitunwa nabiisa kong’anya, na ebigoro bitengeche, obwanchani bwane bogendererete botambe tibokorua asore, na okobwatana kwane kw’omorembe tigokonyegerigwa.” Nabo Omonene, oyogokororera amabera, agoteba.
english: Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed, yet my unfailing love for you will not be shaken nor my covenant of peace be removed," says the LORD, who has compassion on you.

ekegusii: Chingori chi’abakori amabe chiang’etananire, korende tinkweba amachiko ao.
english: Though the wicked bind me with ropes, I will not forget your law.

ekegusii: Nabaisa koirwa ase obosomba nababisa babo, aroro agwo ninchike emioro ebaite. Nimbaonchorere amaiso aane mbakorere ayare amabe na tari ayare amaya.”
english: Though they are driven into exile by their enemies, there I will command the sword to slay them. I will fix my eyes upon them for evil and not for good."

ekegusii: Babugirie ebitureri na kobeka ebinto bionsi ang’e, korende nonya noyomo tari oragende ase esegi eyio, ekiagera endamwamu yane nigo ere igoro y’omoganda bwonsi.
english: Though they blow the trumpet and get everything ready, no one will go into battle, for my wrath is upon the whole crowd.

ekegusii: Nabaisa korema basoe inse agwo aase abakure, okoboko kwane nigo korabarusieo; nabaisa koriina baike igoro nimbatabokanie gochia inse aa.
english: Though they dig down to the depths of the grave, from there my hand will take them. Though they climb up to the heavens, from there I will bring them down.

ekegusii: Though they found no proper ground for a death sentence, they asked Pilate to have him executed.
english: Nonya tibanyorete engencho y’okomoita, bagasaba Pilato aitwe.

ekegusii: Nonya abagambi baino bare ase omochie o Soani, na abatomirwe baikire ase omochie o Hanesi,
english: Though they have officials in Zoan and their envoys have arrived in Hanes,

ekegusii: Nabaisa kwebisa ase egechuria ki’egetunwa gia Karimeli, nimbarigie mbarusieo; nabaisa gosoa ase enkori y’enyancha inse bebise ng’a timbarora, aroro agwo ninchike eng’iti engenda inse ebarome.
english: Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, there I will hunt them down and seize them. Though they hide from me at the bottom of the sea, there I will command the serpent to bite them.

ekegusii: Kobarabe bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora bobe, gose korengereria chinchera chi’okorenta emechando, tibakobua,
english: Though they plot evil against you and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed;

ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore abasibwa; nonya naboigo, aye Nyasae oito toratotiga ase obosibwa bwaito. Aye gwatoorokeirie obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na kwagerire twanyorire ogwancherwa ase abaruoti b’Abaayemi. Barabwo batoeire ribaga koagacha naende enyomba yao, eria yatagoretwe, aye Nyasae oito, na twaeirwe eburi egotokengera aiga ase ense y’Abayuda na ase Yerusalemu.
english: Though we are slaves, our God has not deserted us in our bondage. He has shown us kindness in the sight of the kings of Persia: He has granted us new life to rebuild the house of our God and repair its ruins, and he has given us a wall of protection in Judah and Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Nonya omonto oyio ekero are moyo, ogweteba ng’a nigo asesenirie, ee, nonya ogotogigwa ekero ekoreire amaya,
english: Though while he lived he counted himself blessed-- and men praise you when you prosper--

ekegusii: Nonya momanyete amang’ana aya onsi ninganetie kobainyoria buna Omonene atooretie abanto korwa ase ense ya Misiri, na nyuma y’ayio agasiria abwo batamwegenete.
english: Though you already know all this, I want to remind you that the Lord delivered his people out of Egypt, but later destroyed those who did not believe.

ekegusii: Na inwe timomomanyeti, korende inche nimomanyete. Kondatebe ng’a timomanyeti nimbe omonyaborimo buna inwe, korende nimomanyete, naende ring’ana riaye nindibwatete.
english: Though you do not know him, I know him. If I said I did not, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and keep his word.

ekegusii: Omonto omoriri nomobekerania ase ekonu ime, omoswageranie amo nobori, oboriri bwaye tibogosira.
english: Though you grind a fool in a mortar, grinding him like grain with a pestle, you will not remove his folly from him.

ekegusii: Ekero gwatotigete, nigo twaroche emechando emenge, korende nonyare gotokora abayia naende; torusie, ototiirie korwa ase chiirima chire ase ense.
english: Though you have made me see troubles, many and bitter, you will restore my life again; from the depths of the earth you will again bring me up.

ekegusii: Ere oyo mwamwanchire, nonya timomorochi, mwamwegenire, nonya timoramorora, na igo moragoke ase omogoko otari gotebeka oichire nobonene,
english: Though you have not seen him, you love him; and even though you do not see him now, you believe in him and are filled with an inexpressible and glorious joy,

ekegusii: Nonya nabo nomanyete ng’a inche tindi nokomocha, na onde tari orantoorie korwa ase okoboko kwao?
english: though you know that I am not guilty and that no one can rescue me from your hand?

ekegusii: Aye kwarengire enkoro yane, nonya nase obotuko nigo ogonteema, kwauna‐unirie na tonyoreti gento, amabe are ase enkoro yane tinkoyakwana.
english: Though you probe my heart and examine me at night, though you test me, you will find nothing; I have resolved that my mouth will not sin.

ekegusii: Nigo morabarigie abwo bakobasoera, ko timokobanyora; abwo barenge kobarwania nigo barabe bosa kegima.
english: Though you search for your enemies, you will not find them. Those who wage war against you will be as nothing at all.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: “Noisa koagacha egeswa kiao aaria igoro buna ekeongo, ee, nokebeke ase egati‐gati ye ching’enang’eni, inche ninkoiyerie korwa aroro.”
english: Though you soar like the eagle and make your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Omonto obwate okobua nigo akoira ense yaba eyaye, na oyio oeirwe ogosikwa nere okoyemenya.
english: though you were a powerful man, owning land-- an honored man, living on it.

ekegusii: Nonya Abaisraeli bare abange buna omokenye ore nyancha, abatigari boka nabwo barairane. Ogosirigwa gwachikirwe ogokong’u nigo korache buna eooro kore noboronge.
english: Though your people, O Israel, be like the sand by the sea, only a remnant will return. Destruction has been decreed, overwhelming and righteous.

ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang’ani robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo kebe ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo robe nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chibe boigo.
english: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms are to be on one branch, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

ekegusii: Orosagia rwe ritang’ani rokaba nemegwekano etato y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi, kera ekemo ne rimumu na egesicha, na orosagia rwa kabere boigo rokaba nemegwekano y’ebisicha binga buna ebi’omolozi; ne chinsagia chionsi isano nemo chikaba boigo.
english: Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms were on one branch, three on the next branch and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand.

ekegusii: Bono Festo gasoire ase obogambi bwaye, nyuma y’amatuko atato agatiira gochia Yerusalemu korwa Kaisaria.
english: Three days after arriving in the province, Festus went up from Caesarea to Jerusalem,

ekegusii: Amatuko atato nyuma kobakorire okobwatana nabanto abwo, Abaisraeli bakaigwa ng’a barabwo ng’ang’e bamenyete.
english: Three days after they made the treaty with the Gibeonites, the Israelites heard that they were neighbors, living near them.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atato, akarangeria abanene b’Abayahudi amo. Ekero basangererekanire akabatebia, “Baminto, nonya tinkoreti ring’ana riibe ase abanto baito, gose ring’ana riatananegete korwa ase chingencho chie chisokoro chiaito, korwa Yerusalemu nkabekwa ase amaboko ’Abarumi buna omosibwa.
english: Three days later he called together the leaders of the Jews. When they had assembled, Paul said to them: "My brothers, although I have done nothing against our people or against the customs of our ancestors, I was arrested in Jerusalem and handed over to the Romans.

ekegusii: Yeroboamu amo nabanto bonsi bagacha ase Rehoboamu rituko ria gatato, buna omoruoti abatebetie ng’a bakore.
english: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back to me in three days."

ekegusii: Yeroboamu amo nabanto bonsi bagacha ase Rehoboamu omoruoti rituko ria gatato buna abatebetie bakore.
english: Three days later Jeroboam and all the people returned to Rehoboam, as the king had said, "Come back to me in three days."

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria gatato ekero abwo barogete barenge koromwa mono, abamura babere ba Yakobo, Simeoni na Lawi, bamura ba ng’ina omo na Dina, bakaimoka nemeyio ya birende, bagasoa ase omochie ime mobosokano, bagaita abasacha bonsi abarengeo.
english: Three days later, while all of them were still in pain, two of Jacob's sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, took their swords and attacked the unsuspecting city, killing every male.

ekegusii: Abanto baria basiarete amache ase okoyasiara gochia monwa nebiara bi’amaboko abo, nigo barenge amagana atato. Na abatigarete igo batung’amete namaru inse, bakanywa.
english: Three hundred men lapped with their hands to their mouths. All the rest got down on their knees to drink.

ekegusii: Rituko erimo abanto batato ba baria abanene emerongo etato bagatirimboka gochia ase egetare, bakagenda ase Daudi agwo ase rikuruma ri’Adulamu, ekero abarwani esegi b’Abafilisti batoorete ase ense omweya y’Abarefai.
english: Three of the thirty chiefs came down to David to the rock at the cave of Adullam, while a band of Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.

ekegusii: Abisalomu nigo aiboreretwe abamura batato, na omoiseke oyomo ore korokwa Tamari. Ere nigo arenge omoiseke omonyakieni.
english: Three sons and a daughter were born to Absalom. The daughter's name was Tamar, and she became a beautiful woman.

ekegusii: Abana abamura ba Benjamin nabwo aba: Bela, na Bekeri, na Yediaeli, bonsi mbatato.
english: Three sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker and Jediael.

ekegusii: Nkorua inde chitahabu, chitalanta chilifu isato, korwa ase Ofiri, ne chifeta chichenire chitalanta amagana atano na abere ase okooma chinyasi chi’enyomba,
english: three thousand talents of gold (gold of Ophir) and seven thousand talents of refined silver, for the overlaying of the walls of the buildings,

ekegusii: “Ara gatato kera omwaka abanto bao bonsi abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Three times a year all your men are to appear before the Sovereign LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: “Ara gatano kera omwaka abanto baino abasacha babe bagocha ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, aase agwo arachore; bagende aroro ase Amatuko Amanene ay’Emegati etabekiri memera, na ase Amatuko Amanene aye Chichuma, na ase Amatuko Amanene ay’Ebigutu. Tibagenda ase obosio bw’Omonene bare namaboko amasa.
english: Three times a year all your men must appear before the LORD your God at the place he will choose: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of Tabernacles. No man should appear before the LORD empty-handed:

ekegusii: Ara gatato ase omwaka Sulemani nigo arenge korua ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso bi’omorembe ase egesasimero keria aagacherete Omonene. Boigo aba ogosamba ubani ase Omonene. Ase igo agakoora emeremo y’okoagacha enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Three times a year Solomon sacrificed burnt offerings and fellowship offerings on the altar he had built for the LORD, burning incense before the LORD along with them, and so fulfilled the temple obligations.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’egento eke ngasaba Omonene ara gatato kendue.
english: Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.

ekegusii: Ara gatato ngaakwa chinyimbo, erimo ngaakwa amagena. Ara gatato ngasarekerwa nemeeri, obotuko obomo na omobaso oyomo ngaikaransa igoro y’endiba;
english: Three times I was beaten with rods, once I was stoned, three times I was shipwrecked, I spent a night and a day in the open sea,

ekegusii: Noganetie enchara echiche ase emiaka etato; gose nigo oganetie oserigwe nababisa bao ase engaki y’emetienyi etato, babe bakobabuna‐buna na kobaita nemioro; gose mochandwe nomoro bw’Omonene ase amatuko atato, ekero oborwaire obobe bw’ogoita abanto borache igoro ase ense eye yaino, na omomalaika bw’Omonene ogosaria ense y’Abaisraeli? Bono ntebia aya ngochia koiraneria oria ontoma.”
english: three years of famine, three months of being swept away before your enemies, with their swords overtaking you, or three days of the sword of the LORD-- days of plague in the land, with the angel of the LORD ravaging every part of Israel.' Now then, decide how I should answer the one who sent me."

ekegusii: Korende ebiooreri bi’okoorera na ebimitero bi’edivai tibigoisanekia abanto, na edivai enyia tekonyorekana asebare.
english: Threshing floors and winepresses will not feed the people; the new wine will fail them.

ekegusii: Amang’ana aya nigo achigetwe na Nyasae ng’a okogwa kw’Ahasia kobe ase okogenda kwaye korora Yoramu. Ekero Ahasia aigete aroro, nigo agendete amo na Yoramu koumerana na Yehu, mosinto o Nimusi, oria Omonene aagete amaguta, erinde asirie enyomba y’Ahabu.
english: Through Ahaziah's visit to Joram, God brought about Ahaziah's downfall. When Ahaziah arrived, he went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to destroy the house of Ahab.

ekegusii: na Abaarodi, abarwete ase Arodi, na Abaareli, abarwete ase Areli.
english: through Arodi, the Arodite clan; through Areli, the Arelite clan.

ekegusii: Abaasirieli, abarwete ase Asirieli, na Abasekemu, abarwete ase Sekemu,
english: through Asriel, the Asrielite clan; through Shechem, the Shechemite clan;

ekegusii: Twanyorire ogosikwa na ogotasikwa; togokwanwa bobe na togokwanwa buya. Twakorirwe buna abanto abang’ainereria, korende nabanto b’ekeene tore,
english: through glory and dishonor, bad report and good report; genuine, yet regarded as impostors;

ekegusii: na Abahezironi, abarwete ase Hezironi, na Abakarimi, abarwete ase Karimi.
english: through Hezron, the Hezronite clan; through Carmi, the Carmite clan.

ekegusii: Bionsi bigakoreka ase oyio; gose onye tari ere, anga tigiakoregete kende gionsi egiakoregete.
english: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.

ekegusii: Asare ere ntwanyorete obuya na obotomwa, erio ase engencho y’erieta riaye tworokererie abanto b’ebisaku bionsi, erinde banyare koba nokoigwera gw’okwengena
english: Through him and for his name's sake, we received grace and apostleship to call people from among all the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith.

ekegusii: na asere kera oyomwegenire nigo akobarerwa oboronge ase amang’ana aria atakonyarekana kobarerwa oboronge ase amachiko a Musa.
english: Through him everyone who believes is justified from everything you could not be justified from by the law of Moses.

ekegusii: Goetera asare ere mwamwegenire Nyasae, oyomobogetie korwa ase abakure na akamoa obonene, erinde okwegena kwaino na ogosemeria kwaino kobe ase Nyasae.
english: Through him you believe in God, who raised him from the dead and glorified him, and so your faith and hope are in God.

ekegusii: na Abayasubu, abarwete ase Yasubu, na Abashimuroni, abarwete ase Shimuroni.
english: through Jashub, the Jashubite clan; through Shimron, the Shimronite clan.

ekegusii: Gaki, goetera asare togenderere koa Nyasae ekeng’wanso gi’okomotogia, engencho yaye okwama kw’emenwa yaito eyekoorokia erieta riaye.
english: Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise-- the fruit of lips that confess his name.

ekegusii: na Abayeseri, abarwete ase Yeseri, na Abasilemu, abarwete ase Silemu.
english: through Jezer, the Jezerite clan; through Shillem, the Shillemite clan.

ekegusii: Ase chisemi chire, chiero chi’enyomba eyio nigo chigoichorigwa nebinto ao ao bi’engencho enene, na ebi’okogokia.
english: through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

ekegusii: Ase amabera, na obwegenwa, embooria yaakanirwe ase engencho y’ebibe, na ase okomoiroka Omonene omonto nigo akweatanana korwa ase amabe.
english: Through love and faithfulness sin is atoned for; through the fear of the LORD a man avoids evil.

ekegusii: Abasuni, abarwete ase Suni, na Abaosini, abarwete ase Osini, na Abaeri, abarwete ase Eri,
english: through Ozni, the Oznite clan; through Eri, the Erite clan;

ekegusii: Oboremereria nigo bokwororobia omogambi, na oromeme rw’obwororo nigo rokobuna riuga.
english: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.

ekegusii: na Abasemida, abarwete ase Semida, na Abaheferi, abarwete ase Heferi.
english: through Shemida, the Shemidaite clan; through Hepher, the Hepherite clan.

ekegusii: na Abasefufamu, abarwete ase Sefufamu, na Abahufamu, abarwete ase Hufamu.
english: through Shupham, the Shuphamite clan; through Hupham, the Huphamite clan.

ekegusii: Goetera ase ogosesenia kw’abanyene oboronge omochie nigo okoimokererigwa igoro, korende goetera ase chinkwana chi’abakori amabe nigo okoiyerigwa.
english: Through the blessing of the upright a city is exalted, but by the mouth of the wicked it is destroyed.

ekegusii: Naende enka yao ebe buna eya Peresi, oria Tamari aiborerete Yuda, goetera ase oroiboro roria Omonene arakoe korwa ase omokungu oyio.”
english: Through the offspring the LORD gives you by this young woman, may your family be like that of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah."

ekegusii: Amasikani ’omoruoti nigo are amanene, ekiagera aye kwamokonyire; kwamoeire obonene obonge na ogosika okonene.
english: Through the victories you gave, his glory is great; you have bestowed on him splendor and majesty.

ekegusii: Ase ebinto ebio otoeire chiira chinene mono, echie rigori rinene, erinde ase echio monyare koba ababwatani be chingencho chia Nyasae, na gotama ogosaria gw’okogania okobe kore ase ense eye.
english: Through these he has given us his very great and precious promises, so that through them you may participate in the divine nature and escape the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.

ekegusii: Ase omoika oyo agachiera emeika eria yarenge ase obosibwa, akayeranderia.
english: through whom also he went and preached to the spirits in prison

ekegusii: Goetera asare twaigoreirwe enchera ase okwegena goikera ase obuya obo toteneine ime yaye, naende nigo tokogoka ase ogosemeria kw’obonene bwa Nyasae.
english: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand. And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.

ekegusii: Ase chinguru chiao nigo toraiyerie inse ababisa baito; goetera ase erieta riao nigo toratiringere inse abwo bagocha gotorwania esegi.
english: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.

ekegusii: Ase ayio namotige omwando oyo nabaete, na inche mbatige mokorere ababisa baino ase ense inwe motamanyeti, ekiagera endamwamu yane nigo ere buna omorero outire, nosambe kogenderera botambe.”
english: Through your own fault you will lose the inheritance I gave you. I will enslave you to your enemies in a land you do not know, for you have kindled my anger, and it will burn forever."

ekegusii: Ekero gwakorete oboonchoreria obonge, ogaichorwa nobobe; ase igo ogakora ebibe. Ase ayio nkagoseria buna egento getachenegeti, okarua ase egetunwa kia Nyasae, ee, aye omokerubi ogatuba oboagare obonene, nagosiririe korwa ase amagena aria are nomorero.
english: Through your widespread trade you were filled with violence, and you sinned. So I drove you in disgrace from the mount of God, and I expelled you, O guardian cherub, from among the fiery stones.

ekegusii: na Abazera, abarwete ase Zera, na Abasauli, abarwete ase Sauli.
english: through Zerah, the Zerahite clan; through Shaul, the Shaulite clan.

ekegusii: Ase ense yonsi ya Misiri embura eria y’amagena egaita mwanyabanto bonsi abarenge isiko, amo ne chitugo chionsi. Na embura eria y’amagena egaita na gosaria ebimeri bionsi bi’emegondo, ekabuna na emete yonsi y’orosana.
english: Throughout Egypt hail struck everything in the fields-- both men and animals; it beat down everything growing in the fields and stripped every tree.

ekegusii: “Ase ense eyio yonsi moranyore ebe eyaino, ekero amaremo araoonigwe, namotige ribaga ri’okoyabooria naende.
english: Throughout the country that you hold as a possession, you must provide for the redemption of the land.

ekegusii: Ase ebiaare biaino bionsi morentere Omonene okoruegwa korwa ase obosie bw’ogotongora kwaino.
english: Throughout the generations to come you are to give this offering to the LORD from the first of your ground meal.

ekegusii: Ere nigo arabe omochenu ase Omonene ase amatuko aye onsi eatananete.
english: Throughout the period of his separation he is consecrated to the LORD.

ekegusii: Tagenda aike ang’e negetondo ase amatuko ayio onsi eatananete koba Omwerwa bw’Omonene.
english: Throughout the period of his separation to the LORD he must not go near a dead body.

ekegusii: Bakaba bakoamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakabora, “Omoruoti nigo atotooretie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito, na korwa ase amaboko ’Abafilisti, na bono otamire Abisalomu, otigire ense eye.
english: Throughout the tribes of Israel, the people were all arguing with each other, saying, "The king delivered us from the hand of our enemies; he is the one who rescued us from the hand of the Philistines. But now he has fled the country because of Absalom;

ekegusii: Inchuo obwatane amo naintwe; tobe nekegancha ekemo.”
english: throw in your lot with us, and we will share a common purse"--

ekegusii: Aye Samaria, omogwekano oria bw’emori ore ase egati yao yabeire okogechia asende. Endamwamu yane nigo egwoka igoro y’abanto abwo. Ngoika ririri baragenderere koba iga bataracheneka?
english: Throw out your calf-idol, O Samaria! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of purity?

ekegusii: Ere agatuguta eanga yaye, agacharoka, agachiera Yeso.
english: Throwing his cloak aside, he jumped to his feet and came to Jesus.

ekegusii: na kobaseria ababisa baino bonsi korwa asemore, buna Omonene atebete.
english: thrusting out all your enemies before you, as the LORD said.

ekegusii: Naboigo ekaba ng’a Nyasae oakanire egesiomba ase engencho y’ebibe biria Abimeleki akorerete ise ase ogoita abana baye, abamura bamwabo omonyene, emerongo etano na ebere.
english: Thus God repaid the wickedness that Abimelech had done to his father by murdering his seventy brothers.

ekegusii: Omonene akabarenta ase ense yaye enchenu, ase egetunwa keria enyorerete nokoboko kwaye gw’okorio.
english: Thus he brought them to the border of his holy land, to the hill country his right hand had taken.

ekegusii: agasamba emechie eyio, amo nense eyio yonsi eraire, na agasiria bonsi abamenyete imeo, na ebinto bionsi biare gokina ase ense eria.
english: Thus he overthrew those cities and the entire plain, including all those living in the cities-- and also the vegetation in the land.

ekegusii: Rora, naboigo omonto oria omoirogete Omonene arasesenigwe.
english: Thus is the man blessed who fears the LORD.

ekegusii: Nabo Abamidiani babuetwe n’Abaisraeli, na tibanyara koimoka gokora kende. Na bono ense eria ekaba nobotoereru ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, goika Gidioni agakwa.
english: Thus Midian was subdued before the Israelites and did not raise its head again. During Gideon's lifetime, the land enjoyed peace forty years.

ekegusii: Naboigo igoro na ense bigaikeranigwa amo nemeganda yonsi y’ebitongwa.
english: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.

ekegusii: Erio ogwatananekana kogasoa ase omoganda ase engencho yaye.
english: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.

ekegusii: Naki ring’ana riria: Oyomo obusura, na oyonde okogesa, nigo rire ekeene.
english: Thus the saying 'One sows and another reaps' is true.

ekegusii: Bono emeremo yare gokorwa ase enyomba ya Nyasae agwo Yerusalemu egasiekwa kegima na ekaba egendererete gosiekwa goika omwaka o kabere bw’okogamba kwa Dario, omoruoti bw’Abaayemi.
english: Thus the work on the house of God in Jerusalem came to a standstill until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

ekegusii: Na ebigori bionsi korwa Ibrahimu goika Daudi nigo biarenge ebigori ikomi na bine: na korwa Daudi goika ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa gochia Babeli nebigori ikomi na bine: na korwa ogosakorwa na okong’anyigwa gochia Babeli goika Kristo nebigori ikomi na bine.
english: Thus there were fourteen generations in all from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Christ.

ekegusii: Thus they bring judgment on themselves, because they have broken their first pledge.
english: Barabwo nabagambigwe, ekiagera batigire eira yabo ye ritang’ani.

ekegusii: Naboigo na abanto ba Beteli barabakore ase engencho y’obobe bwaino obonene. Kobogokiamoka omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli naitwe akwe.”
english: Thus will it happen to you, O Bethel, because your wickedness is great. When that day dawns, the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.

ekegusii: Igo mogosaria ring’ana ria Nyasae ase chingencho chiaino chia kare. Naende amange mwakorire mware koenana omogwekano bw’ayio.”
english: Thus you nullify the word of God by your tradition that you have handed down. And you do many things like that."

ekegusii: Ase ayio, obwatie enchera y’abanto abaya, na otaare ase oboeto bw’abanyaboronge.
english: Thus you will walk in the ways of good men and keep to the paths of the righteous.

ekegusii: Naboigo, nase okwama kwabo morabamanyere.
english: Thus, by their fruit you will recognize them.

ekegusii: Moyasiberanie ase amaboko aino, na moyabeke ase amasio aino igoro, abe amariko akobainyoria.
english: Tie them as symbols on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.

ekegusii: Erio Tiligati‐Pileseri, omoruoti bw’Abaasuri, akagenda akamorwania na komochanda ribaga ri’okomokonya.
english: Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria came to him, but he gave him trouble instead of help.

ekegusii: Ee, akamotunyana goika ensara ekamobeta egaika riini ime. Nigo abete buna enyoni ekoayerera gochia ase ebisugunia na tamanyete ng’a ayio nobogima bwaye agosiria.
english: till an arrow pierces his liver, like a bird darting into a snare, little knowing it will cost him his life.

ekegusii: goika ekero nasoete ime ase obomenyo obochenu bwa Nyasae, erio nario namanyete omoerio bw’abanyabibe buna ore.
english: till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their final destiny.

ekegusii: goika inyore aase, agwo arabe obomenyo bw’Oyore Chinguru chia Yakobo.”
english: till I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio ntoitererwe Omoika korwa igoro, na aase arenge erooro abe omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge, na omogondo okwama chindagera chinyinge noonchorwe obe rinani.
english: till the Spirit is poured upon us from on high, and the desert becomes a fertile field, and the fertile field seems like a forest.

ekegusii: goika ayabanete agaikerana. Ase ayio ring’ana ri’Omonene rikaenekia ng’a Yusufu nomoronge.
english: till what he foretold came to pass, till the word of the LORD proved him true.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Tarisisi, menteka, moichore ase ense yaino, mobe buna amache ’orooche rwa Naili; kende tikeri kerabatange.
english: Till your land as along the Nile, O Daughter of Tarshish, for you no longer have a harbor.

ekegusii: Aye Timotheo, renda aya abekirwe asore. Bweatanane korwa ase amang’ana atari ne chingencho chi’obonyasae, na korwa ase okoamererania ase aya akorokwa chisemi, korende nay’oborimo.
english: Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to your care. Turn away from godless chatter and the opposing ideas of what is falsely called knowledge,

ekegusii: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends his greetings to you, as do Lucius, Jason and Sosipater, my relatives.
english: Timotheo, omokori emeremo amo nainche, obakwanirie; naboigo Lukio, na Yasoni, na Sosipita, abaamate baane, babakwanirie.

ekegusii: Timotheo, omwana one, ogochika oko nakoeire, koreng’ana namang’ana ’obobani ayakwanetwe igoro yao, erinde ase ayio orwane esegi ere engiya.
english: Timothy, my son, I give you this instruction in keeping with the prophecies once made about you, so that by following them you may fight the good fight,

ekegusii: Egesaku kere ekenene keegwe orogongo oronene robe omwando obo, na egesaku kere egeke keegwe orogongo oroke robe omwando obo. Kera egesaku nakeegwe omwando oye koreng’ana nomobaro obo.
english: To a larger group give a larger inheritance, and to a smaller group a smaller one; each is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those listed.

ekegusii: na egeturi ki’egetureri, na eriogi ri’amang’ana. Abwo bayaigwete bagasorora tibatebigwa ing’ana rinde naende.
english: to a trumpet blast or to such a voice speaking words that those who heard it begged that no further word be spoken to them,

ekegusii: ase omoiseke omwekungi oriereire boko nomosacha, erieta riaye Yusufu, bw’eamate ya Daudi, na erieta ri’omoiseke oria Mariamu.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man named Joseph, a descendant of David. The virgin's name was Mary.

ekegusii: Omoruoti agatebia Abiatari omokuani, “Genda Anatoti ase oboremu bwao: aye igo ogwenerete okwe, korende inche tinkogoita ase engaki eye, ekiagera aye nkwabogoretie Esanduku y’Omonene Nyasae bosio bwa Daudi tata, naende ngwachandegete amo na tata ase emechando yaye yonsi.”
english: To Abiathar the priest the king said, "Go back to your fields in Anathoth. You deserve to die, but I will not put you to death now, because you carried the ark of the Sovereign LORD before my father David and shared all my father's hardships."

ekegusii: buna atebetie chisokoro chiaito, Ibrahimu na oroiboro rwaye, goika kare na kare.”
english: to Abraham and his descendants forever, even as he said to our fathers."

ekegusii: Igo ayeetwe ase amasio ’Abahiti, abwo bonsi baare gosoera egeita kiaye.
english: to Abraham as his property in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of the city.

ekegusii: Agatebia Adamu, “Ekiagera kwaigwerete mokao na okaria amatunda ’omote oria nagokanetie ng’a toria, riroba riaragererigwe ase engencho yao. Ase ogwechanda norie okwama kwaye amatuko onsi ay’obogima bwao.
english: To Adam he said, "Because you listened to your wife and ate from the tree about which I commanded you, 'You must not eat of it,' "Cursed is the ground because of you; through painful toil you will eat of it all the days of your life.

ekegusii: Nabarikeire inwe mwensi abamomenyete Rumi, abanchwa ba Nyasae, abamwarangeretigwe koba abachenu. Obuya bobe asemore na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito, na ase Omonene Yeso Kristo.
english: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Narorire ng’a gento kende tikeri kere noboikeranu, korende amachiko ao namaikeranu.
english: To all perfection I see a limit; but your commands are boundless.

ekegusii: Oyonde aegwa okwegena ase Omoika oria oria, na oyonde aegwa ekeegwa gi’okogwenia ase Omoika oria oria.
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,

ekegusii: Oyonde aegwa gokora emeremo y’ebikone bie chinguru, na oyonde obobani, na oyonde okomanya kw’ogwatanana emeika, na oyonde ogokwana kw’emenwa ao ao, na oyonde okoonchora emenwa.
english: to another miraculous powers, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in different kinds of tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.

ekegusii: Nkobarikera tore boigo Apia, mosubati ominto, na Arikipo, omorwani ore amo naintwe, na abanto b’ekanisa ere ase enyomba yao.
english: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier and to the church that meets in your home:

ekegusii: to ask him, "Are you the one who was to come, or should we expect someone else?"
english: “Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”

ekegusii: erinde imbe omosomba o Kristo Yeso ase ogokorera abanto b’Ebisaku, ase emeremo y’obokuani ase okorandia enchili ya Nyasae, erinde ekeng’wanso kiabo giancherwe, gechenwe n’Omoika Omochenu.
english: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles with the priestly duty of proclaiming the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: erio amororere amabera, atebe: Tooria omonto oyo tabaisa gotirimboka gochia ase oboina, ekiagera inche namonyoreire embooria.
english: to be gracious to him and say, 'Spare him from going down to the pit; I have found a ransom for him'--

ekegusii: mokorwe abayia ase emeika na ebirengererio biaino,
english: to be made new in the attitude of your minds;

ekegusii: ng’a ase ekero ki’ogoikeranigwa kw’engaki nabekeranie ebinto bionsi bibe nobomo ase Kristo, ebinto bire igoro, na ebire ase ense, asere oyio.
english: to be put into effect when the times will have reached their fulfillment-- to bring all things in heaven and on earth together under one head, even Christ.

ekegusii: Naende babe aberendete ase onsi, abachenu, abagokora emeremo ase chinka chiabo, abaya, abaigwerete abasacha babo abanyene, erinde ring’ana ria Nyasae tiriramwa.
english: to be self-controlled and pure, to be busy at home, to be kind, and to be subject to their husbands, so that no one will malign the word of God.

ekegusii: to bind their kings with fetters, their nobles with shackles of iron,
english: Boigo banyare gosiba abaruoti babo nebinyuri, na abanene babo ne chingataare chi’ekioma,

ekegusii: akabachika barente Vasti eting’ana achiche ase obosio bwaye obegete egutwa y’oboruoti. Vasti nigo arenge omokungu omonyakieni mono; ase igo omoruoti akagania amoorokie ase abanto bonsi na ase abanene barenge agwo, erinde bamorore.
english: to bring before him Queen Vashti, wearing her royal crown, in order to display her beauty to the people and nobles, for she was lovely to look at.

ekegusii: erinde babanachere ekina kerikire. Obo nabwo obonene bw’abegenwa bonsi b’Omonene. Motogie Omonene!
english: to carry out the sentence written against them. This is the glory of all his saints. Praise the LORD.

ekegusii: erinde ase rituko ria rero, Omonene anyare kobakora mobe abanto baye b’ekeene, ere nabe Nyasae oino, buna abatebetie na buna arierete chisokoro chiaino Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo, eira ase ogotiana.
english: to confirm you this day as his people, that he may be your God as he promised you and as he swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.

ekegusii: Omonto ogotiringera inse abasibwa bonsi bare ase ense,
english: To crush underfoot all prisoners in the land,

ekegusii: abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.
english: to cut and set stones, to work in wood and to engage in all kinds of artistic craftsmanship.

ekegusii: Ere abe okobaacha amagena e rigori rinene na koyabeka ase ebikonde, na kobaacha emete, na gokora emeremo ende yonsi y’oboroisia.
english: to cut and set stones, to work in wood, and to engage in all kinds of craftsmanship.

ekegusii: Omonene natoorie emioyo yabo korwa ase amakweri, tibakwa ekero gi’enchara.
english: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

ekegusii: gose koonchorana oboronge bw’omonto ase obosio bw’Oyore Igoro Mono,
english: to deny a man his rights before the Most High,

ekegusii: gose gokorekania ekina ki’omonto onde bwensi. Inee! Ayio Omonene nkoyaanchera are?
english: to deprive a man of justice-- would not the Lord see such things?

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo bakoonchorana ebina bi’abaremeire na koura abataka b’abanto baane oboronge bwabo, erinde ababoraka babe ebisakorwa biabo, ne chintakana chiaurererigwa.
english: to deprive the poor of their rights and withhold justice from the oppressed of my people, making widows their prey and robbing the fatherless.

ekegusii: Ogochika okwo nigo gokworokia onye ebinto tibichenegeti gose mbichenegete. Okwo nogochika gwa ukoma.
english: to determine when something is clean or unclean. These are the regulations for infectious skin diseases and mildew.

ekegusii: to Dibon, Nebo and Beth Diblathaim,
english: na Diboni, na Nebo, na Beti‐Dibulataimu,

ekegusii: Ogokora oboronge na ekeene, ayio naro Omonene agwancha kobua ebing’wanso.
english: To do what is right and just is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

ekegusii: Agaseria korwa bosio bwaino ebisaku biarenge ebinene, naende biarenge ne chinguru kobabua; akabarenta ase ense yabo, nainwe mokayeira ekaba omwando oino, naboigo ere nonya ngoika rero iga.
english: to drive out before you nations greater and stronger than you and to bring you into their land to give it to you for your inheritance, as it is today.

ekegusii: Akaa kera oyomo eanga agochia koonchoreria, korende Benjamin ere akamoa chisekeli chie chifeta amagana atato amo ne chianga isano, echi agochia koonchoreria.
english: To each of them he gave new clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.

ekegusii: Ogokonywa kwa Misiri nigo kore bosa; ase ayio narokire ense eyio “Rahabu etari gokora gento.”
english: to Egypt, whose help is utterly useless. Therefore I call her Rahab the Do-Nothing.

ekegusii: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech.
english: Enoku akaibora Iradi, Iradi akaibora Metusaeli, Metusaeli akaibora Lameki.

ekegusii: Nigo boboete Abakalidayo, ekiagera Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, konya oitire Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu, oyio omoruoti o Babeli konya abekire koba omogambi ase ense eria.
english: to escape the Babylonians. They were afraid of them because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed as governor over the land.

ekegusii: Amarube ayio akababetereria ng’a amatuko a Purimu arendwe ase engaki eria echikire, buna Moredekai Omoyahudi oria, na Esteri eting’ana, bachigete Abayahudi. Boigo arendwe buna barabwo abanyene bachigete na bagachikera abanto be chinderia chiabo ase amang’ana ’okweng’ata na okorua.
english: to establish these days of Purim at their designated times, as Mordecai the Jew and Queen Esther had decreed for them, and as they had established for themselves and their descendants in regard to their times of fasting and lamentation.

ekegusii: Okomoiroka Omonene nokogecha obobe; nigo ngechete oboenenu, na obwerori, na orogendo orobe, boigo namang’ana ’obong’ainereria.
english: To fear the LORD is to hate evil; I hate pride and arrogance, evil behavior and perverse speech.

ekegusii: rinyare goikerana eriatebetwe nomobani Isaya,
english: to fulfill what was said through the prophet Isaiah:

ekegusii: Korende ekero omosangererekano okorangerigwa gochicha amo, ebirombeta goika bibugigwe, go tari ase eriogi ri’ogotabobora.
english: To gather the assembly, blow the trumpets, but not with the same signal.

ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Libini na eya Simei, abwo nabwo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Gerisoni.
english: To Gershon belonged the clans of the Libnites and Shimeites; these were the Gershonite clans.

ekegusii: omanyie abanto baye ogotooreka ase okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo.
english: to give his people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,

ekegusii: omonto oranyare gotang’ana abanto kobagosoka na kobakoirana, erinde omoganda bw’abanto b’Omonene tobaisa koba buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia.”
english: to go out and come in before them, one who will lead them out and bring them in, so the LORD's people will not be like sheep without a shepherd."

ekegusii: egambere omobaso na obotuko, na gwatanana oborabu korwa ase omosunte. Nyasae akarora ayio ng’a namaya.
english: to govern the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good.

ekegusii: Oyo oiboire omwana omoriri nigo akoba nomoichano, na ise omwana oyio tari koba nomogoko.
english: To have a fool for a son brings grief; there is no joy for the father of a fool.

ekegusii: akabatebia ng’a barende rituko ria ikomi na kane, na eria ikomi na gatano, ase omotienyi bw’Adari, omwaka ase omwaka, abe Amatuko Amanene.
english: to have them celebrate annually the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar

ekegusii: erinde aigwe okweumia kw’abasibwa, na gosibora abwo konya banacheirwe ekina ki’ogokwa.
english: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death."

ekegusii: na Hesiboni, na emechie yonsi ase ense eimokererete igoro ere enteremu; Diboni, na Bamoti‐Baali, na Beti‐Baali‐Meoni;
english: to Heshbon and all its towns on the plateau, including Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,

ekegusii: asare ere obonene ase ekanisa na ase Kristo Yeso goika ebigori bionsi kare na kare. Amina.
english: to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, for ever and ever! Amen.

ekegusii: Okobua nokwaye goika kare na kare. Amina
english: To him be the power for ever and ever. Amen.

ekegusii: “Chinguru na obong’aini nigo bikorwa asare. Abwo bakong’aineka na abakong’ainereria nigo bare ase okoboko kwaye.
english: To him belong strength and victory; both deceived and deceiver are his.

ekegusii: Nere bweka okorete amakumia amanene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: to him who alone does great wonders, His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Ere nigo aatananete Enyancha Embariri, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: to him who divided the Red Sea asunder His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Bono asare ere oyoranyare kobarenda inwe timotererigwa, na kobatenenia ase obonene bwaye, motari na komocha, ase omogoko omonene,
english: To him who is able to keep you from falling and to present you before his glorious presence without fault and with great joy--

ekegusii: Ere nigo araaete abanto baye goetera ase erooro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: to him who led his people through the desert, His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Ere oyorabue na gokora ogokora kwane goika omoerio, oyio nimoe okobua igoro y’abanto b’ebisaku,
english: To him who overcomes and does my will to the end, I will give authority over the nations--

ekegusii: Ere oyorabue, nimoe ribaga aikaranse amo nainche ase ekerogo kiane ki’obonene, buna nainche nabuete, ngaikaransa amo na Tata one ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene.
english: To him who overcomes, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne, just as I overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

ekegusii: Moterere ere oria oriinete igoro, igoro eria yarengeo korwa chingaki chia kare. Rora, nigo agoaka eriogi riaye rire ne chinguru riaigugwa.
english: to him who rides the ancient skies above, who thunders with mighty voice.

ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abana abatangi ba Misiri, ne ching’iti chintangi boigo, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akomenta ogosaria ase ebibe biaye, naende nigo agotoakera chinkobi ase ogotochaya na gokwana amang’ana amange are mamincha ya Nyasae.”
english: To his sin he adds rebellion; scornfully he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God."

ekegusii: erinde barusie egesiomba ase egesaku, na bae abanto egesusuro.
english: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,

ekegusii: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
english: erinde abe ogotebereria abanene b’oboruoti boria buna anchete, na kworokereria abagaaka baye b’oboruoti chisemi.

ekegusii: na Yeso oyore omobwatania bw’okobwatana okoyia, na amanyinga akonyororokerigwa ayagokwana buya kobua aria ay’Abeli.
english: to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the sprinkled blood that speaks a better word than the blood of Abel.

ekegusii: erinde agambie abanto bonsi ekina na aenekie abwo bonsi batare ne chingencho chi’obonyasae ase engencho y’emeremo yabo yonsi etare ne chingencho chi’obonyasae, eye baare gokora ase ogotaba ne chingencho chi’obonyasae, na ase engencho y’amang’ana amakong’u abwo abanyene ebibe, abatare ne chingencho chi’obonyasae, baare gokwana igoro yaye.”
english: to judge everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of all the ungodly acts they have done in the ungodly way, and of all the harsh words ungodly sinners have spoken against him."

ekegusii: ekero ararusie okogamba korwa ase abatamoirogeti na abatange tibaba amareba ase abanto?
english: to keep a godless man from ruling, from laying snares for the people.

ekegusii: Erinde timbaisa gocha koenena goetania ekerengo, ekiagera ase obonge bw’okomaanorerwa okwo, nkaegwa riigwa rimbetete ase omobere, omotomwa o Saitani, ang’ake, timbaisa gocha koenena goetania ekerengo.
english: To keep me from becoming conceited because of these surpassingly great revelations, there was given me a thorn in my flesh, a messenger of Satan, to torment me.

ekegusii: ng’a obwate ogochika oko, obe otari na kemoa, gose na komocha, goika Omonene oito Yeso Kristo aorokigwe.
english: to keep this command without spot or blame until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

ekegusii: na Kerioti, na Bosira, na emechie yonsi y’ense ya Moabu ere aare na ang’e.
english: to Kerioth and Bozrah-- to all the towns of Moab, far and near.

ekegusii: to Kiriathaim, Beth Gamul and Beth Meon,
english: na Kiriataimu, na Beti‐Gamuli, na Beti‐Meoni,

ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate y’Amuramu, na eya Isari, na eya Heburoni, na eya Usieli; abwo nabwo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Kohati.
english: To Kohath belonged the clans of the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites and Uzzielites; these were the Kohathite clans.

ekegusii: na komwancha nenkoro yonsi, na okomanya gwonsi, ne chinguru chionsi, na gwancha omogisangio oo buna bweanchete, nkogwenerete kobua omosango bw’ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa na ebing’wanso binde.”
english: To love him with all your heart, with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices."

ekegusii: abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai.
english: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,

ekegusii: abe oyomanyete koroberia na koroisia ebinto bie chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai,
english: to make artistic designs for work in gold, silver and bronze,

ekegusii: erio anyare koyechena ase okoyesibia ase amache na ase ring’ana,
english: to make her holy, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,

ekegusii: Mwanyabanto nigo agokora emeroberio ase enkoro yaye, korende aya oromeme rokoiraneria nigo akorwa ase Omonene.
english: To man belong the plans of the heart, but from the LORD comes the reply of the tongue.

ekegusii: Abanto b’eamate ya Mali, na eya Musi abwo nabwo barenge abanto b’ororeria rwa Merari.
english: To Merari belonged the clans of the Mahlites and the Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.

ekegusii: Ase obosooku bwane nigo ngokwana ng’a nigo twarenge abareu ase ogokora amang’ana aya. Korende onye omonto ore noboremu bw’ogwetogia ase rinde rionsi (nakwanire ase oboriri), na inche ninde noboremu boigo bw’ogwetogia.
english: To my shame I admit that we were too weak for that! What anyone else dares to boast about-- I am speaking as a fool-- I also dare to boast about.

ekegusii: Akaa oyomo chitalanta isano, na oyonde ibere, na oyonde eyemo, kera omonto koreng’ana nokonyara kwaye. Erio akagenda.
english: To one he gave five talents of money, to another two talents, and to another one talent, each according to his ability. Then he went on his journey.

ekegusii: Naki omonto oyomo ase Omoika aegwa ogokwana kw’obong’aini, na oyonde ring’ana ri’okomanya ase Omoika oria oyomo.
english: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by means of the same Spirit,

ekegusii: Oramokie amaiso ’emeuko, osibore abasibwa korwa ase echela, na abwo bamenyete ase omosunte korwa ase obosibwa bwabo.
english: to open eyes that are blind, to free captives from prison and to release from the dungeon those who sit in darkness.

ekegusii: Nigo oraramokie amaiso abo baonchoke korwa ase omosunte, bache ase omobaso, batige okobua gwa Saitani na baonchokere Nyasae, banyore okwaberwa kw’ebibe biabo, na omwando ase egati yabo abachenirwe ase okonyegena.
english: to open their eyes and turn them from darkness to light, and from the power of Satan to God, so that they may receive forgiveness of sins and a place among those who are sanctified by faith in me.'

ekegusii: Bono Nyasae, Tata oito, abakwe kare na kare. Amina.
english: To our God and Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

ekegusii: Agakora bo ase ogoikerania abachenu ase emeremo y’obosomba, goika omobere o Kristo oagachwe.
english: to prepare God's people for works of service, so that the body of Christ may be built up

ekegusii: Kera emambia na omogoroba botambe babe bakorua ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase egesasimero gi’ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, koreng’ana buna arigetwe ase amachiko aria Omonene aete Abaisraeli.
english: to present burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering regularly, morning and evening, in accordance with everything written in the Law of the LORD, which he had given Israel.

ekegusii: Nigo agotanga omonto tagenda ase oboina, naende orenda obogima bwaye tibosirigwa nomoro.
english: to preserve his soul from the pit, his life from perishing by the sword.

ekegusii: Ontomire ndarie omwaka bw’Omonene bwancheire, ne rituko ria Nyasae oito ri’okorusia egesiomba, rituko araremie bonsi abaichanete.
english: to proclaim the year of the LORD's favor and the day of vengeance of our God, to comfort all who mourn,

ekegusii: “na korandia omwaka bw’Omonene bwancheretwe.”
english: to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor."

ekegusii: Kera emambia nigo ere buya koraria obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe, na kera obotuko koraria obwegenwa bwao,
english: to proclaim your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night,

ekegusii: “Obotomani, na edivai, na ekenyugwa kegotindia, nigo bikoura abanto okomanya kwabo.
english: to prostitution, to old wine and new, which take away the understanding

ekegusii: ase okondoiseria chibao chinyinge, ekiagera enyomba ngochia koagacha nigo erabe enene mono, naende ey’ogokumia.
english: to provide me with plenty of lumber, because the temple I build must be large and magnificent.

ekegusii: Omokuani arente chinyoni ibere amo noroko rw’omocharake, na eusi embariri, na orosagia rwa hisopo, ase ogochenwa kw’enyomba eria.
english: To purify the house he is to take two birds and some cedar wood, scarlet yarn and hyssop.

ekegusii: Ekero okobachena nigo orakore iga: Onyororokie amache ’ogwesibia igoro yabo, na barabwo bakigite emebere yabo yonsi na basibie chianga chiabo. Erio babe bachenekire.
english: To purify them, do this: Sprinkle the water of cleansing on them; then have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.

ekegusii: Abanto abasacha abatangi b’Abaisraeli nabange bare, mbaetanetie Abalawi ase amagana abere, na emerongo etano na ebere, na batato (273). Ase ayio oboorie kera oyomo obo ne chibesa chie chisekeli isano, koreng’ana ne chisekeli chigokorerwa ase Obomenyo Obochenu. (Esekeli eyemo nechigera emerongo ebere).
english: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who exceed the number of the Levites,

ekegusii: erinde ababoorie baria barenge inse y’amachiko, erinde tonyare gokorwa koba abana baye.
english: to redeem those under law, that we might receive the full rights of sons.

ekegusii: ng’a natoe ribaga ri’okomosasima totari nobwoba, gatoratoorigwe korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito,
english: to rescue us from the hand of our enemies, and to enable us to serve him without fear

ekegusii: agancha koorokia Omwana oye ime asende erinde, imorandie ase egati y’abanto b’Ebisaku. Erio tinarigia gosemania na mwanyabanto onde bwensi;
english: to reveal his Son in me so that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I did not consult any man,

ekegusii: Ere agatebia Sara, “Rora naeire momura omino chisekeli chie chifeta elifu eyemo, chibe entorobi yao ase amaiso ’abanto bonsi abare amo naye, erio omanyekane ng’a nomonto omoronge ore.”
english: To Sarah he said, "I am giving your brother a thousand shekels of silver. This is to cover the offense against you before all who are with you; you are completely vindicated."

ekegusii: Embura eyio nigo ekoigotia ense ere bosa etamenyiri, yagera yamera obonyansi.
english: to satisfy a desolate wasteland and make it sprout with grass?

ekegusii: Otebie abasibwa: Soka korwa ase obosibwa, na otebie abare ase omosunte: Eorokie! Barabwo mbabe bakoragerigwa ekero bare ase orogendo, mbanyore oborisia bwabo ase ebigoro na ase ebitunwa biarenge bosa.
english: to say to the captives, 'Come out,' and to those in darkness, 'Be free!' "They will feed beside the roads and find pasture on every barren hill.

ekegusii: Amagena aya abe ekeinyorio asemore. Ekero abana baino barache kobaboria: Ninki engencho y’amagena aya?
english: to serve as a sign among you. In the future, when your children ask you, 'What do these stones mean?'

ekegusii: abarere abamenyete ase omosunte na ase ekiriri ki’amakweri, na koraa amagoro aito ase enchera y’omorembe.”
english: to shine on those living in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace."

ekegusii: erinde abakorere amabera chisokoro chiaito, na koinyora okobwatana kwaye ogochenu.
english: to show mercy to our fathers and to remember his holy covenant,

ekegusii: Tari buya gokora ogwanchereria ase abanto, korende ase engencho y’agasamunye k’omogati omonto nigo agwekora koba omosaria.
english: To show partiality is not good-- yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

ekegusii: Obatebie tibakwana bobe igoro ya monto onde bwensi, tibaba abanyariomana, korende babe abaremereria, bakoorokia obwororo ase abanto bonsi.
english: to slander no one, to be peaceable and considerate, and to show true humility toward all men.

ekegusii: Akabatebia omoreng’anio oyo ase abanto baare gwekaga ng’a nabanyene oboronge, bagochaya abande bonsi,
english: To some who were confident of their own righteousness and looked down on everybody else, Jesus told this parable:

ekegusii: Nigo natigete amanyinga ayio aiteretwe agenderere kobeera igoro ase egetare atatubiri, erio nario aragere imbe nendamwamu na ndusie egesiomba.
english: To stir up wrath and take revenge I put her blood on the bare rock, so that it would not be covered.

ekegusii: Nabasoroire baigwere abanto buna aba, na kera omonto oyogokora emeremo amo nabarabwo ase ogwechanda.
english: to submit to such as these and to everyone who joins in the work, and labors at it.

ekegusii: abogorie ensemo y’ogokora oko na obotomwa obo Yudas atigete, akagenda aase aye.”
english: to take over this apostolic ministry, which Judas left to go where he belongs."
