ekegusii: Nigo ngokania abanto bagwetogia: Timobaisa gwetogia, naende nintebie abakori amabe: Timobaisa komera chingunchara chi’obomwenu.
english: To the arrogant I say, 'Boast no more,' and to the wicked, 'Do not lift up your horns.

ekegusii: Naboigo agatoma amang’ana ase Abakanani ba moocha na bosongo, ase Abaamori na Abahiti, na Abaperisi, na Abayebusi ase ense y’ebitunwa, amo n’Abahivi abamenyete ang’e na Herimoni, egetunwa gi’ense ya Misipa.
english: to the Canaanites in the east and west; to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites and Jebusites in the hill country; and to the Hivites below Hermon in the region of Mizpah.

ekegusii: nkobarikera tore inwe ab’ekanisa ya Nyasae ere ase Korinto, inwe abamwachenirwe ase Kristo Yeso, abamwarangerigwe koba abachenu amo na bonsi abakorangeria erieta ri’Omonene oito Yeso Kristo kera aase, nere Omonene obo na oyoito.
english: To the church of God in Corinth, to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy, together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ-- their Lord and ours:

ekegusii: na omosangererekano bw’omoyega, na omosangererekano bw’abaiborwa be ritang’ani, abwo amarieta abo arikire igoro, na Nyasae oyore omogambi bw’abanto bonsi, na emeika y’abanto abanyene oboronge abaikeranigwe,
english: to the church of the firstborn, whose names are written in heaven. You have come to God, the judge of all men, to the spirits of righteous men made perfect,

ekegusii: Nigo akoigweka buya ase omonto oyio okoyamanya, naende namaronge ase abwo banyorire chisemi.
english: To the discerning all of them are right; they are faultless to those who have knowledge.

ekegusii: Ensemo ya moocha bakamenya goikera egesoero ki’erooro egoikera orooche rw’Eufarati, ekiagera amaicho abo nigo abuchete mono ase ense ya Gileadi.
english: To the east they occupied the land up to the edge of the desert that extends to the Euphrates River, because their livestock had increased in Gilead.

ekegusii: Nasoroire abagaaka abare ase egati yaino, inche buna omogaaka omogisangio obo, na kirori bw’ogochandwa gwa Kristo, na omobwatani bw’obonene boria borache koorokigwa:
english: To the elders among you, I appeal as a fellow elder, a witness of Christ's sufferings and one who also will share in the glory to be revealed:

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ore omwegenwa ase abwo bare abegenwa, nigo okweorokia ng’a nomoikeranu ore ase abwo bare abaikeranu.
english: To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

ekegusii: nkobarikera tore inwe abachenu na abegeni baminto ba Kristo abamomenyete Kolosai: Obuya bobe asemore na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata oito.
english: To the holy and faithful brothers in Christ at Colosse: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.

ekegusii: Ase Abaisraeli obonene bokarorekana buna omorero ogosiria, ase egetunwa igoro.
english: To the Israelites the glory of the LORD looked like a consuming fire on top of the mountain.

ekegusii: Ase Abayahudi nkaba buna Omoyahudi, erinde mbarente Abayahudi; ase baria bare inse y’amachiko nkaba buna oyore inse y’amachiko (nonya inche omonyene tindi inse y’amachiko) erinde mbarente baria bare inse y’amachiko.
english: To the Jews I became like a Jew, to win the Jews. To those under the law I became like one under the law (though I myself am not under the law), so as to win those under the law.

ekegusii: Nabo Yeso agatebia Abayahudi baria bamwegenete, “Komoramenye ase ring’ana riane, nigo more aborokigwa baane b’ekeene,
english: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, "If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.

ekegusii: ense emwamu ti buna omosunte ekerima; naende ey’ekiriri ki’amakweri na obotantanu, agwo oborabu bwaye bore obomwamu ti buna obw’obotuko gati.”
english: to the land of deepest night, of deep shadow and disorder, where even the light is like darkness."

ekegusii: Moiranere amachiko na oborori! Abanto batari gokwana koreng’ana namang’ana ayio, ekeene, omobaso o mambia torababarera.
english: To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.

ekegusii: Nigo nkorera ase Omonene ng’a ankonye, nere nigo akong’iraneria korwa ase egetunwa kiaye egechenu.
english: To the LORD I cry aloud, and he answers me from his holy hill. Selah

ekegusii: Rigereria, igoro ney’Omonene, Nyasae oino, na igoro ya igoro mono neyaye boigo, na ense na ebinto bionsi bireo nebiaye.
english: To the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, the earth and everything in it.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo akoa omonto oyo okomogokia obong’aini, naende omoa okomanya, na omogoko, korende nigo akoa omonyabibe emeremo y’ogosangereria ebinto na kobigacha, korende omonto oria abie oria ogogetie Nyasae. Ayio boigo mbosa, na aya akominyokerwa konyorwa nigo are buna embeo bosa.
english: To the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge and happiness, but to the sinner he gives the task of gathering and storing up wealth to hand it over to the one who pleases God. This too is meaningless, a chasing after the wind.

ekegusii: Korende baria baikire konyuomana nabachikire, gose tari inche, korende Omonene, ng’a omokungu tatiga omosacha oye,
english: To the married I give this command (not I, but the Lord): A wife must not separate from her husband.

ekegusii: ase okobugia obokano bore ne chinga ikomi, na amakano ande are namariogi amaya.
english: to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.

ekegusii: ase abwo bagosira ogotioka kw’amakweri gokorenta amakweri; ase abwo bagotoorigwa ogotioka kw’obogima gokorenta obogima. Ning’o oraisane ase amang’ana aya?
english: To the one we are the smell of death; to the other, the fragrance of life. And who is equal to such a task?

ekegusii: Aye nigo okoa abaruoti obobui, naye gwatooretie Daudi, omosomba oo, korwa ase omoro bw’obobe.
english: to the One who gives victory to kings, who delivers his servant David from the deadly sword.

ekegusii: Ere nigo atoinyorete ekero twarenge aboro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: to the One who remembered us in our low estate His love endures forever.

ekegusii: ere oyore Nyasae bweka, Omotooria oito goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omonene oito, asare ere ogotogigwa, na obonene, na obonguru, na okobua, korwa kare na kare, na bono, na goika kare na kare. Amina.
english: to the only God our Savior be glory, majesty, power and authority, through Jesus Christ our Lord, before all ages, now and forevermore! Amen.

ekegusii: ase Nyasae, omonyene obong’aini bweka, ogotogigwa kare na kae ase Yeso Kristo! Amina.
english: to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.

ekegusii: erinde obonene bw’obuya bwaye botogigwe, obo atoeire buna ekeegwa ase Omwanchwa oye.
english: to the praise of his glorious grace, which he has freely given us in the One he loves.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu, nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.
english: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the crooked you show yourself shrewd.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omochenu ase abwo bare abachenu; nigo okwanga abwo bare abakorekanu.
english: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the crooked you show yourself shrewd.

ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi nebichenu ase abwo bare abachenu, korende tikeri ekere egechenu ase abwo batachenegeti na abategeneti, ekiagera ebirengererio biabo na okomanya gwe chinkoro chiabo ime biabeire ebitachenegeti.
english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are corrupted and do not believe, nothing is pure. In fact, both their minds and consciences are corrupted.

ekegusii: Abwo bande nkobatebia inche, gose tari Omonene, ng’a onye onde ominto ore nomokungu otegeneti na omokungu oyio bwanchire komenya nere, tamotiga.
english: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If any brother has a wife who is not a believer and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.

ekegusii: Nigo narimerete ngaika inse kegima y’ebitunwa, ase ense eria emekorogoto yaye yansiekerete goika kare na kare. Nonya naboigo, aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo kwandusetie ase embeera inde moyo.
english: To the roots of the mountains I sank down; the earth beneath barred me in forever. But you brought my life up from the pit, O LORD my God.

ekegusii: Ase abare abareu nkaba omoreu, erinde mbarente abareu. Igo nkaba chingencho chionsi ase abanto bonsi, erinde inyare kobatooria abanto ase chinchera chionsi.
english: To the weak I became weak, to win the weak. I have become all things to all men so that by all possible means I might save some.

ekegusii: Akaonchokera omokungu, akamotebia, “Ninkomentere emechando emenge ekero okoba morito, na ekero okoibora abana nonyore obororo; nonya nabo okogania kwao nigo korabe ase omosacha oo, na ere nakogambere.”
english: To the woman he said, "I will greatly increase your pains in childbearing; with pain you will give birth to children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you."

ekegusii: Nyasae agancha koorokia asebare obobisi boria bore obonene na obw’obonda ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku. Obobisi boria nabwo obo, ng’a Kristo nigo are ime yaino, ayio naro ogosemeria kw’obonene.
english: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

ekegusii: amarieta abo nainyorwe ime ase enyomba yane, na ime ye chindwaki chiane. Ayio nabe ogosesenigwa kobua abana abamura na abaiseke. Nimbae erieta ria kare na kare ritasirigwe.
english: to them I will give within my temple and its walls a memorial and a name better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name that will not be cut off.

ekegusii: Nyasae akaa abamura baria bane chisemi na obomanyi bw’okomanya amariko ao ao, na obong’aini bwonsi; naende akaa Danieli obong’aini bw’okomanya engencho y’amaroro ne chindoto.
english: To these four young men God gave knowledge and understanding of all kinds of literature and learning. And Daniel could understand visions and dreams of all kinds.

ekegusii: Ase igo Abaedomu bagasaria bakaanga kogamberwa n’Abayuda; naboigo ere goika rero iga. Ase engaki eria abanto b’omochie o Libuna boigo bagasaria, bakaanga kogamberwa na Yehoramu, ekiagera ere atigete Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaye.
english: To this day Edom has been in rebellion against Judah. Libnah revolted at the same time, because Jehoram had forsaken the LORD, the God of his fathers.

ekegusii: Igo Abaedomu bagasaria, bakaanga kogamberwa n’Abayuda na babeire baatananegete goika rero iga. Naende ase engaki eyio eyio abanto b’omochie o Libuna nabarabwo bagasaria, bagatiga obogambi bw’Abayuda.
english: To this day Edom has been in rebellion against Judah. Libnah revolted at the same time.

ekegusii: Goika rituko ria rero monto onde tari bwekeeirie ase okoba omoitongo, gose koiroka na kobwata amachiko aane, na emeroberio nabegete ase amasio aino, na ase amasio e chisokoro chiaino.
english: To this day they have not humbled themselves or shown reverence, nor have they followed my law and the decrees I set before you and your fathers.

ekegusii: Goika rituko ria rero nigo bagokora buna banarete gokora ritang’ani. Tibamoirogete Omonene, na tibari kobwatia emeroberio echikire, gose amachiko onsi aria Omonene achigete abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo, oria arogete Israeli.
english: To this day they persist in their former practices. They neither worship the LORD nor adhere to the decrees and ordinances, the laws and commands that the LORD gave the descendants of Jacob, whom he named Israel.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio inche nigo ngokora emeremo na ngokora omokia ase chinguru chiaye chinene, echigokora emeremo ime asende.
english: To this end I labor, struggling with all his energy, which so powerfully works in me.

ekegusii: Stefano akairaneria, “Abaminto na abatata, ntegerere. Nyasae bw’obonene naorokerete sokoro yaito Ibrahimu, ekero arenge ase Mesopotamia, ritang’ani ataramenya Harani,
english: To this he replied: "Brothers and fathers, listen to me! The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran.

ekegusii: Yohana akairaneria, “Omonto takonyara konyora ring’ana rinde rionsi otatiga aegwe korwa igoro.
english: To this John replied, "A man can receive only what is given him from heaven.

ekegusii: Bakamoiraneria, “Aye nigo kwaiboretwe ase ebibe ebinene, na intwe ngotworokereria ore?” Bakamosokia isiko.
english: To this they replied, "You were steeped in sin at birth; how dare you lecture us!" And they threw him out.

ekegusii: Nonya ngoika egeka eke kia bono ntore nenchara na erang’o, naende nigo tore gesobono; iga togoakwa chinkundi titori nobomenyo,
english: To this very hour we go hungry and thirsty, we are in rags, we are brutally treated, we are homeless.

ekegusii: Ase ayio naro mwarangereretigwe, ekiagera Kristo nere nigo achandetwe ase engencho yaino, obatigeire ekiorokererio, erinde mobwatie chimbaratero chiaye.
english: To this you were called, because Christ suffered for you, leaving you an example, that you should follow in his steps.

ekegusii: to those in Aroer, Siphmoth, Eshtemoa
english: na Aroeri, na Sifamoti, na Esitemoa,

ekegusii: to those in Hormah, Bor Ashan, Athach
english: abwo ba Horima, na Bori‐Asani, na Ataki,

ekegusii: Ase baria batari namachiko nkaba buna oyo otari namachiko (tari buna tindi namachiko ase obosio bwa Nyasae, korende nigo inde inse y’amachiko a Kristo) erinde mbarente baria batari namachiko.
english: To those not having the law I became like one not having the law (though I am not free from God's law but am under Christ's law), so as to win those not having the law.

ekegusii: nabae obogima bwa kare na kare baria bakorigia obonene, na ogosika, na ogotasareka, na gokora amaya ase oboremereria.
english: To those who by persistence in doing good seek glory, honor and immortality, he will give eternal life.

ekegusii: Abwo baganyete amakweri, korende tibari koyanyora; nigo bakoyarigia kobua korigia chinibo chibisire.
english: to those who long for death that does not come, who search for it more than for hidden treasure,

ekegusii: bateba, “Tiga Omonene ache bwango, aayererie emeremo yaye, erinde toyerore. Tiga aya Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli aroberetie asuke gocha ang’e aikerane, erio nario toranyare koyamanya.”
english: to those who say, "Let God hurry, let him hasten his work so we may see it. Let it approach, let the plan of the Holy One of Israel come, so we may know it."

ekegusii: Naende akabatebia baria barenge koonia amaruma, “Rusia ebinto ebi aa timokora enyomba ya Tata one koba enyomba y’okoonchoreria.”
english: To those who sold doves he said, "Get these out of here! How dare you turn my Father's house into a market!"

ekegusii: ngokorikera nde aye Timotheo, omwana one bori ase okwegena: Obuya na amabera, na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.
english: To Timothy my true son in the faith: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

ekegusii: ngokorikera nde aye Timotheo, omwana one omwanchwa: Obuya na amabera, na omorembe, bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omonene oito.
english: To Timothy, my dear son: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

ekegusii: Ngokorikera nde aye Tito, omwana one bori ase okwegena tosangete naye: Obuya na omorembe bikorwa ase Nyasae Tata, na ase Kristo Yeso, Omotooria oito.
english: To Titus, my true son in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior.

ekegusii: erinde amoiranie korwa ase oboina, ng’a oyio anyare komorekerwa noborabu bw’obogima.”
english: to turn back his soul from the pit, that the light of life may shine on him.

ekegusii: to turn man from wrongdoing and keep him from pride,
english: ng’a anyare koonchora omonto atige ogokora kwaye okobe, na atange oboenenu bw’omonto.

ekegusii: echio chikogera embura yatwa aase monto atamenyeti, ase erooro monto ataiyo?
english: to water a land where no man lives, a desert with no one in it,

ekegusii: Emechie eyio nero omoiti aranyare gotamera, oria oraite omonto onde mosiabano, gose atamogechete agwo ritang’ani. Omonto oria karatamere oyomo bw’emechie eyio nigo aratigwe abe moyo.
english: to which anyone who had killed a person could flee if he had unintentionally killed his neighbor without malice aforethought. He could flee into one of these cities and save his life.

ekegusii: Inee! Momalaika ki otebetigwe nere kero kende gionsi, “Ikaransa ensemo y’okoboko kwane gw’okorio, goika mbabeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao”?
english: To which of the angels did God ever say, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet"?

ekegusii: Obonene nobwaye kare na kare. Amina.
english: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

ekegusii: “Ning’o ngotebia aigwe gonkomokurera? Naama! Amato abo tarogeti, tibakonyara gotegerera. Amang’ana ’Omonene abeire echeche asebare, tibari kogokigwa naro.
english: To whom can I speak and give warning? Who will listen to me? Their ears are closed so they cannot hear. The word of the LORD is offensive to them; they find no pleasure in it.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo atebetie abanto abwo: “Aiga naase agotimokerwa, tiga abwo barosire batimokere aiga, erinde banyore chinguru naende.” Korende abanto abwo tibaigwerete.
english: to whom he said, "This is the resting place, let the weary rest"; and, "This is the place of repose"-- but they would not listen.

ekegusii: To whom, then, will you compare God? What image will you compare him to?
english: Nyasae, ning’o moramoreng’anie, gose mogwekano ki moramoreng’anie?

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, inche nigo nkorera asore, ekiagera eguru‐gura enga buna omorero yomirie amarisio ’erooro, na eyio enga buna chimeme chi’omorero yasambire emete yonsi y’orosana.
english: To you, O LORD, I call, for fire has devoured the open pastures and flames have burned up all the trees of the field.

ekegusii: Erio nkarera asore, aye Omonene, ngakoboria ase oboitongo:
english: To you, O LORD, I called; to the Lord I cried for mercy:

ekegusii: Tobia Omoamoni, oyorenge ang’e nere, agateba, “Nabaagacha orwaki orwo naki, ekebwe geise koriina igoro nigo keraroiyerie rogwe inse.”
english: Tobiah the Ammonite, who was at his side, said, "What they are building-- if even a fox climbed up on it, he would break down their wall of stones!"

ekegusii: Rero ere otirimbokire, onyenyire chiombe, ne chimori chinoru, ne ching’ondi, ase obonge, naende orangeirie abana abamura bonsi b’omoruoti, na abachiki b’abarwani esegi, na Abiatari omokuani; na rora, igo bakoria na konywa ase obosio bwaye bagoteba: Adonia omoruoti ochie kare!
english: Today he has gone down and sacrificed great numbers of cattle, fattened calves, and sheep. He has invited all the king's sons, the commanders of the army and Abiathar the priest. Right now they are eating and drinking with him and saying, 'Long live King Adonijah!'

ekegusii: Naama! Ase rituko ria rero nagokong’irie obe buna omochie ogiteire chindwaki, na buna esiiro y’ekioma, naende buna chindwaki chi’etaai. Nigo orabe kogotenena bokong’u, tokobugwa nense eye yonsi, gose nabaruoti b’Abayuda, gose abanene b’oboruoti boria, gose abakuani b’aroro, gose abanto bonsi b’ense eye.
english: Today I have made you a fortified city, an iron pillar and a bronze wall to stand against the whole land-- against the kings of Judah, its officials, its priests and the people of the land.

ekegusii: naki rero ase omochie o Daudi oiboirwe Omotooria ase engencho yaino, nere Kristo Omonene.
english: Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is Christ the Lord.

ekegusii: Rora, rero gwanseririe korwa ase riroba eri, nimbiseke korwa ase obosio bwao, timborora naende. Nimbe omoomboganu na omoetanani ase ense, na onde bwensi orang’umere nigo arang’ite.”
english: Today you are driving me from the land, and I will be hidden from your presence; I will be a restless wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me."

ekegusii: Rituko ria rero ase omotienyi bw’Abibu noro mokong’anya korwa aa.
english: Today, in the month of Abib, you are leaving.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbabe buna chituoni chi’esegi, batiringere ababisa babo inse buna eubi ere ase chinchera. Mbarwane, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde amo nabarabwo, basookie abariini be chibarasi.”
english: Together they will be like mighty men trampling the muddy streets in battle. Because the LORD is with them, they will fight and overthrow the horsemen.

ekegusii: Kera eyemo oyerue amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera, ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta amitire korwa ase amazeituni egetuba ekemo.
english: together with a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives.

ekegusii: Boigo oire chifeta ne chitahabu chionsi, echio oranyore korwa ase ense yonsi ya Babeli, oire nokoruegwa kw’ogwancha okwo abanto na abakuani bararue ase enyomba ya Nyasae obo ere Yerusalemu.
english: together with all the silver and gold you may obtain from the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests for the temple of their God in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ekio morue obosie ebimunu bine bwochoganirie namaguta, bibe okoruegwa kw’endagera kogosambwa nomorero ase Omonene, kore ne rimisu rigiya rikomogwenera. Amo nokwo morue edivai egetuba ekemo ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa.
english: together with its grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil-- an offering made to the LORD by fire, a pleasing aroma-- and its drink offering of a quarter of a hin of wine.

ekegusii: Bakarika amang’ana onsi igoro y’okogamba kwaye, na okobua kwaye, na amang’ana onsi amonyorete ere amo n’Abaisraeli, na amaruoti ande onsi ay’ense.
english: together with the details of his reign and power, and the circumstances that surrounded him and Israel and the kingdoms of all the other lands.

ekegusii: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and a basket of bread made without yeast-- cakes made of fine flour mixed with oil, and wafers spread with oil.
english: Boigo arente egetonga kere nemegati etabekiri memera, na arue amaandasi aroisirie nobosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta, na emegati emeoo eakire amaguta, amo nokoruegwa kw’endagera na okw’ebinyugwa gochikire amo.

ekegusii: na abana baino, na abakungu baino, na abamenyi bamenyete amo nainwe ase ebitwori biaino, na abanto bonsi abwo bakobaateria chinko amo nabwo bakobarentera amache.
english: together with your children and your wives, and the aliens living in your camps who chop your wood and carry your water.

ekegusii: Ankio mogende mobarwanie; mobarore bagotiira ase egetiiro gia Sisi; namobanyore agwo ase ensinyo ye rikura, moocha y’erooro ya Yerueli.
english: Tomorrow march down against them. They will be climbing up by the Pass of Ziz, and you will find them at the end of the gorge in the Desert of Jeruel.

ekegusii: Gaki emenwa eyio nekemanyererio, tari ase abegenete, korende ase abategeneti. Korende obobani nekemanyererio, tari ase abategeneti, korende ase abegenete.
english: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers but for unbelievers; prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.

ekegusii: Nabeire imenyete ase engaki entambe ase egati y’abanto bagechete omorembe.
english: Too long have I lived among those who hate peace.

ekegusii: Aase ogosambera ebing’wanso bi’okogechia nigo aroisetigwe kare; ee aase agwo nigo aroiseretigwe omoruoti. Aase agwo nigo are aatambe na aagare, aichorigwe chinko na omorero. Omoika bw’omonwa bw’Omonene, onga buna omorero bw’amagena akoyia, noro orayouterere.
english: Topheth has long been prepared; it has been made ready for the king. Its fire pit has been made deep and wide, with an abundance of fire and wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of burning sulfur, sets it ablaze.

ekegusii: Omosunte ekerima nigo ogacheire chinibo chiaye; omorero otautiri nonde nomosirie, na ebitigarete ase obomenyo bwaye mbisambwe biere.
english: total darkness lies in wait for his treasures. A fire unfanned will consume him and devour what is left in his tent.

ekegusii: Orokereria omwana abwatie enchera egwenerete, na ekero abeire omogotu takoyetiga.
english: Train a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not turn from it.

ekegusii: treacherous, rash, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God--
english: abarua abande, abatancheti gokanigwa, abamwenu, abanchete kwegokia kobua komwancha Nyasae,

ekegusii: Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye, ee, ense nigo eteneine bokong’u, tekonyegerigwa.
english: Tremble before him, all the earth! The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

ekegusii: Aye ense, tengechigwa ase obosio bw’Omonene, ee, ase obosio bwa Nyasae o Yakobo.
english: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

ekegusii: Ase ayio inwe abakungu motechandereti kende, iguswa, mwechabore chianga chiaino mobe getirianda, erio mweboyie chigunia.
english: Tremble, you complacent women; shudder, you daughters who feel secure! Strip off your clothes, put sackcloth around your waists.

ekegusii: Bakarua agwo, bagatama korwa ase oboina, ekiagera basoetwe nokoiguswa na ogokumia. Tibatebetie monto ing’ana, ekiagera bairogete.
english: Trembling and bewildered, the women went out and fled from the tomb. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid.

ekegusii: Bagasogwa nobwoba, bakaiguswa, bagaichana na koba nobororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore.
english: Trembling seized them there, pain like that of a woman in labor.

ekegusii: Emechando na omoichano bianyorire, korende nigo ngokerete amachiko ao.
english: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands are my delight.

ekegusii: Amorokererio amaronge nigo arenge ase omonwa oye, na obobe tibwanyorekanete ase ebikoba biaye. Nigo abete ogotaara nainche ase omorembe na oboronge, na akaonchora abanto abange korwa ase ebibe.
english: True instruction was in his mouth and nothing false was found on his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many from sin.

ekegusii: Truly you are a God who hides himself, O God and Savior of Israel.
english: Aye Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, aye Omotooria, ekeene, aye naye Nyasae ore bobisi.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto, mwegene Omonene ase chingaki chionsi, morentere emechando yaino; Nyasae nere obotamero bwaito.
english: Trust in him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge. Selah

ekegusii: Mosemerie Omonene okore ayare amaya, erio nario oramenye ase ense, obe korendire buya.
english: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.

ekegusii: Mosemerie Omonene botambe, ekiagera Omonene Nyasae nere egetare gia kare na kare.
english: Trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD, the LORD, is the Rock eternal.

ekegusii: Osemerie Omonene nenkoro yao yonsi; tobaisa gosemeria okomanya kwao.
english: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding;

ekegusii: Ekeene kiaborire, na oyo ogotiga obobe nere ogwoswa oirwa. Omonene ororire ng’a ekeene tikeri gokorwa, na amang’ana ayio amogechirie mono.
english: Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever shuns evil becomes a prey. The LORD looked and was displeased that there was no justice.

ekegusii: Ebikoba bigokwana ekeene mbigenderere kobao botambe, korende oromeme rogokwana oborimo nigo rokobao ase engaki enke yoka.
english: Truthful lips endure forever, but a lying tongue lasts only a moment.

ekegusii: Bakarigia nkero ki, naende nkero kenga buna kere ki, Omoika o Kristo, oyorenge ime yabo, oorogetie, ekero otang’anete koba kirori igoro y’ogochandwa gwa Kristo, na obonene obwo borache koba nyuma y’ayio.
english: trying to find out the time and circumstances to which the Spirit of Christ in them was pointing when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow.

ekegusii: Aye nkwaberete buna amache; korende togoetania abande, ekiagera nkwararete na moga iso, ase igo okarenta obosooku.
english: Turbulent as the waters, you will no longer excel, for you went up onto your father's bed, onto my couch and defiled it.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto momenyete Dedani, onchoka motame, mwebise aase aakong’u, ekiagera ning’ee ororeria rw’Esau emechando ase rituko erio ndamoe egesusuro.
english: Turn and flee, hide in deep caves, you who live in Dedan, for I will bring disaster on Esau at the time I punish him.

ekegusii: Ase ayio irana ogende nomorembe, erinde tobaisa gokora gento ase okogechia abanene b’Abafilisti.”
english: Turn back and go in peace; do nothing to displease the Philistine rulers."

ekegusii: Otige amabe, okore amaya; origie omorembe na koyobwata mono.
english: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

ekegusii: Tiga gokora amabe, kora ayare amaya, igo nario orachie kare.
english: Turn from evil and do good; then you will dwell in the land forever.

ekegusii: Oonchore amaiso aane tarigereria amang’ana atagwenereti; ing’a obogima oboyia mbwatie chinchera chiao.
english: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to your word.

ekegusii: Oonchore enkoro yane yanche oborori bwao, na toyetiga ebe nokogania kwe ribero.
english: Turn my heart toward your statutes and not toward selfish gain.

ekegusii: Aye omonene, ing’iranere ondorere amabera, ekiagera nigo inde inche bweka, naende nchandegete.
english: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.

ekegusii: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
english: Ndigererie, ondorere amabera buna egwenerete abwo banchete erieta riao.

ekegusii: Ing’iranerie na ondorere amabera, ong’e inche omosomba oo chinguru chiao, intoorie inche omwana bw’omosomba oo omokungu.
english: Turn to me and have mercy on me; grant your strength to your servant and save the son of your maidservant.

ekegusii: Turn your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me.
english: Tegerera oigwe amang’ana aane, obe omwango gontooria. Kabe egetare kiane ngotamera, na eburi yane enkong’u, na ontoorie!

ekegusii: Onchora amaiso ao otige kondigereria, ekiagera ambuire; etukia yao nigo enga buna riicho rie chimbori, chigotirimboka ase ebitirimboko bia Gileadi.
english: Turn your eyes from me; they overwhelm me. Your hair is like a flock of goats descending from Gilead.

ekegusii: “Bwasiorie eanga korwa ase okoboko kwao, origererie Yerusalemu oyio oboeire, erio obane mamincha y’oro.
english: Turn your face toward the siege of Jerusalem and with bared arm prophesy against her.

ekegusii: Inchuo otaare aase agwo agendererete gosareka; ababisa nigo basaretie bionsi ebiarenge ime ase obomenyo boria obochenu.
english: Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ing’iranere omboorie! Ontoorie ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao botari koera.
english: Turn, O LORD, and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.

ekegusii: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, "What do you want?" They said, "Rabbi" (which means Teacher), "where are you staying?"
english: Yeso akeonchora, akabarora bakomotunyana, akababoria, “Ninki mokorigia?” Bakamotebia, “Rabii” (okoonchorwa kwaye Omworokia), “nga’i omenyete?”

ekegusii: Naende agatebia Yeteri, omwana oye omomura omotangi, “Imoka, obaite!” Korende omwana oyio tang’usa omoyio oye o birende, ekiagera nigo arenge omosae omoke.
english: Turning to Jether, his oldest son, he said, "Kill them!" But Jether did not draw his sword, because he was only a boy and was afraid.

ekegusii: erinde oigwe obong’aini, naende orue enkoro yao ebe nokomanya.
english: turning your ear to wisdom and applying your heart to understanding,

ekegusii: Na emegwekano ye chindo ikomi na ebere yatenenirie aroro, oyomo ase kera ensemo ya kera egetambokero. Omogwekano bw’ekerogo buna ekio tona koroisigwa ase obogambi bonde bwonsi.
english: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.

ekegusii: Na emegwekano ye chindo ikomi na ibere yatenenirie aroro, oyomo ase kera ensemo ya kera ekeriinero. Omogwekano bw’ekerogo ekio tona koroisigwa ase obogambi bonde bwonsi.
english: Twelve lions stood on the six steps, one at either end of each step. Nothing like it had ever been made for any other kingdom.

ekegusii: Ekero emetienyi ikomi na ebere yachia koera, akariina kerama igoro ki’enyomba y’oboruoti agwo Babeli, agataara aroro,
english: Twelve months later, as the king was walking on the roof of the royal palace of Babylon,

ekegusii: Bonsi abaitetwe ase rituko erio nigo barenge chilifu ikomi na ibere. Abwo nabwo barenge abanto bonsi ba Ai.
english: Twelve thousand men and women fell that day-- all the people of Ai.

ekegusii: Nigo ere buya koba babere kobua oyomo, ekiagera mbanyore eng’eria engiya ase emeremo yabo bagokora.
english: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their work:

ekegusii: Rora, abanto babere emeuko baikaransete ase enchera ensemo, na ekero bachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ogoeta, bagaaka eriogi, bakabora, “Tororere amabera, aye omwana o Daudi!”
english: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, "Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!"

ekegusii: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
english: Agachora chimbori chiaberi amagana abere, ne chigoree emerongo ebere, ne ching’ondi chiaberi amagana abere, ne chimingichi emerongo ebere,

ekegusii: Abanto amagana abere korwa Yerusalemu bakagenda amo n’Abisalomu. Abwo bachigetwe koba abageni, bakagenda batari na komocha, ekiagera tibamanyete amang’ana agochia gokorwa.
english: Two hundred men from Jerusalem had accompanied Absalom. They had been invited as guests and went quite innocently, knowing nothing about the matter.

ekegusii: Engaki eyio abanto babere nababe mogondo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.
english: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.

ekegusii: Abanto babere nababe mogondo, oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe.]”
english: Two men will be working in a field: one will be taken away, the other will be left behind. [* Verse originally omitted in Good News version. See Matthew 24:40.]

ekegusii: Naende rora, abanto babere bagakwana nere, nabwo Musa na Elija.
english: Two men, Moses and Elijah,

ekegusii: Ase kera egesaku gie chinyoni, ne ching’iti chionsi, na echikwagura igoro ase ense, ochirente ibere ibere amo naye, erinde chibe moyo.
english: Two of every kind of bird, of every kind of animal and of every kind of creature that moves along the ground will come to you to be kept alive.

ekegusii: Ababani bakwane babere gose batato, na abande barenge amang’ana aya bakwana.
english: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.

ekegusii: Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with him to be executed.
english: Abande babere abasaria bakairwa, baitwe amo nere.

ekegusii: Erio abauri babere bakabambwa amo nere, oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio, na oyomo ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okobee.
english: Two robbers were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.

ekegusii: Eberi akaibora abana babere abamura. Oria omotangi nigo aare korokwa Pelegi, ekiagera ase amatuko aye nario ense yaatananegete, na oyomwabo nigo aare korokwa Yokitani.
english: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.

ekegusii: Eberi akaibora abana babere abamura. Oria omotangi nigo arenge korokwa Pelegi, ekiagera ase amatuko aye abanto b’ense baatananegete, na omomura omwabo nigo arenge korokwa Yokitani.
english: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.

ekegusii: Abakungu babere nababe bagosera ase orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyonde natigwe. [
english: Two women will be grinding grain together; one will be taken and the other left."

ekegusii: Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.
english: Abakungu babere nababe bagosera orogena oromo; oyomo nairwe, na oyomo natigwe.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’emiaka ebere koyaerire, Abisalomu akaba nabanto baare konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya, aaria Baali‐Hasori, ang’e norogongo rwa Efraimu, agachika abamura bonsi b’omoruoti bagende aroro.
english: Two years later, when Absalom's sheepshearers were at Baal Hazor near the border of Ephraim, he invited all the king's sons to come there.

ekegusii: Tukiko oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa, omosomba amo nainche ase Omonene, nabamanyie amang’ana aane onsi.
english: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a dear brother, a faithful minister and fellow servant in the Lord.

ekegusii: Erinde monyare komanya buna inche inde, naende ninki ngokora, Tukiko, oyominto omwanchwa, omosomba omwegenwa ase Omonene, nabatebie amang’ana onsi.
english: Tychicus, the dear brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything, so that you also may know how I am and what I am doing.

ekegusii: Turo bweagacheire chiburi chinkong’u, naende osangereirie chindwenyi chie chifeta chinyinge buna orotu, ne chitahabu chinyinge buna eubi ere ase chinchera.
english: Tyre has built herself a stronghold; she has heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.

ekegusii: Ummah, Aphek and Rehob. There were twenty-two towns and their villages.
english: na Uma, na Afeki, na Rehobu, emechie emerongo ebere, na ebere, amo nebichie biabo.

ekegusii: Agatoma abanto gochia ase Abimeleki bobisi bamotebie, “Gaali, mosinto bw’Ebedi, amo nabamura bamwabo bachire Sekemu, goseegeta abanto b’omochie babe mamincha yao.
english: Under cover he sent messengers to Abimelech, saying, "Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.

ekegusii: Abanto bagatagora ebisasimero bie chinyasae chiria Baali agwo ase obosio bwaye; na Yosia agatagora na koiyeria inse ebisasimero bi’ogosambera ubani ase erioba, ebiatenenirie igoro y’ebio bia Baali. Akanachana emete y’Asera; boigo agasaria emegwekano yabaachire na kobombwa, akabisia bikaba orotu, akarosiara igoro ase chimbeera chi’abanto baria barenge korua ebing’wanso ase emegwekano eyio.
english: Under his direction the altars of the Baals were torn down; he cut to pieces the incense altars that were above them, and smashed the Asherah poles, the idols and the images. These he broke to pieces and scattered over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.

ekegusii: Inse y’eaanga eria kera egetongwa nigo kiaramborete chimbaba chiaye ibere chigakunana nechi’ekende, na kera ekemo kegatuba omobere oye ne chimbaba chinde ibere.
english: Under the expanse their wings were stretched out one toward the other, and each had two wings covering its body.

ekegusii: Nigo ekorara ase ekiriri ki’omote okorokwa lotusi, yebisa na gokenderera ime ase ebitonto bire ase etente.
english: Under the lotus plants he lies, hidden among the reeds in the marsh.

ekegusii: Inse y’obochiki bwabo nigo barenge abanto chilifu amagana atato na isano na ibere, na amagana atano (307,500). Barabwo nigo barenge korwana esegi ne chinguru na oboremu, gokonya omoruoti ase okorwania ababisa baye.
english: Under their command was an army of 307,500 men trained for war, a powerful force to support the king against his enemies.

ekegusii: Inse ye chimbaba chiabo, ase chinsemo chiabo inye, nigo biabwate amaboko buna aya mwanyabanto. Amasio abo ne chimbaba chiabo nigo biarenge iga:
english: Under their wings on their four sides they had the hands of a man. All four of them had faces and wings,

ekegusii: Indi abareretwe ayio? Nekero konya arokire gose nekero konya atararoka? Tari ekero konya arokire, korende nekero konya atararoka.
english: Under what circumstances was it credited? Was it after he was circumcised, or before? It was not after, but before!

ekegusii: Ase ayio mobe nobomaene ng’a Omonene, Nyasae oino, tari gochia kobaa ense eria engiya ekiagera more abanyene oboronge. Taibo! Inwe nigo more abanto abanyabigoti bikong’u.
english: Understand, then, that it is not because of your righteousness that the LORD your God is giving you this good land to possess, for you are a stiff-necked people.

ekegusii: Gaki manya iga, ng’a baria bare nokwegena, abwo nabwo bare abana ba Ibrahimu.
english: Understand, then, that those who believe are children of Abraham.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore ensoko y’obogima ase omong’aini, korende oboriri nigo bore egesusuro ase oboriri.
english: Understanding is a fountain of life to those who have it, but folly brings punishment to fools.

ekegusii: Inyora ng’a nere emenwa ere ne chingencho chinyinge ase ense, gose onde tari nonya noyomo, otari nengencho yaye.
english: Undoubtedly there are all sorts of languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.

ekegusii: Siara ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwao, erio origererie kera omonto ore omoenenu, omokeyie.
english: Unleash the fury of your wrath, look at every proud man and bring him low,

ekegusii: otatiga ase engencho ye ring’ana erimo natebete neriogi rinene, ekero natenenete egati yabo. Ngateba: Ase engencho y’okobokigwa kw’abakure nakio nkogamberigwa ase obosio bwaino iga rero.”
english: unless it was this one thing I shouted as I stood in their presence: 'It is concerning the resurrection of the dead that I am on trial before you today.'"

ekegusii: Onye Omonene bw’Emeganda atatotigerete abatigari bake, nanga nigo twabete buna Sodomu na Gomora.
english: Unless the LORD Almighty had left us some survivors, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah.

ekegusii: Onye Omonene atankonyete, omoyo one nigo orenge gocha kobeera ase obokiriru bw’amakweri bwango.
english: Unless the LORD had given me help, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.

ekegusii: Gose ngwatotangire kegima? Nigo ogendererete kogechigwa mono naintwe?
english: unless you have utterly rejected us and are angry with us beyond measure.

ekegusii: Eke nakio togokoboria okore: Ekero torasoe ase ense eye, osibe engori eye embariri ase ekebao eke gwatoikeria. Osangererie gocha nyomba mwao iso, na nyoko, na bamura bamino, amo nabanto bonsi b’enyomba ya iso.
english: unless, when we enter the land, you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down, and unless you have brought your father and mother, your brothers and all your family into your house.

ekegusii: Naki intwe titori buna abange abagokora okoonchorana okobe ase ring’ana ria Nyasae; korende buna abanto bagokwana ase oborabu bw’omoyo, buna abanto batomirwe na Nyasae. Ase obosio bwa Nyasae, nigo togokwana, tore ime ase Kristo.
english: Unlike so many, we do not peddle the word of God for profit. On the contrary, in Christ we speak before God with sincerity, like men sent from God.

ekegusii: Ere tagwenerete korua ebing’wanso kera rituko, buna abakuani bande abanene, ritang’ani ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene, naende ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abanto, ekiagera ayio nigo ayakorete ara rimo rioka ekero eruete ere omonyene.
english: Unlike the other high priests, he does not need to offer sacrifices day after day, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. He sacrificed for their sins once for all when he offered himself.

ekegusii: Ero nigo ekoyeba, tekomanya ng’a naatwe namagoro, naende ng’a gose eng’iti y’orosana neyatache.
english: unmindful that a foot may crush them, that some wild animal may trample them.

ekegusii: goika inchiche imbarusie agwo mbaire ase ense egwekaine buna ense eyio yaino, ense ere ne chindagera, na edivai, ense ere nemegati na emegondo y’emesabibu.
english: until I come and take you to a land like your own-- a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

ekegusii: goika inchiche imbarusie agwo mbaire ase ense egwekaine ense eye yaino, ense ere ne chindagera na edivai, ense ere nemegati, na emegondo y’emesabibu, ense ere nemete emezeituni na obooke, agwo ase moragenderere koba moyo timokwa. Timobaisa gotegerera Hezekia ekero akobang’aina ogoteba: Omonene natotoorie.
english: until I come and take you to a land like your own, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of olive trees and honey. Choose life and not death! "Do not listen to Hezekiah, for he is misleading you when he says, 'The LORD will deliver us.'

ekegusii: Goika nchiche, kora omokia ase ogosomera abanto amariko, na gokurera, na kworokereria.
english: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to preaching and to teaching.

ekegusii: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet."'
english: goika mbeke ababisa bao babe inse y’amagoro ao.

ekegusii: Goika rero timorasaba gento ase erieta riane; saba, namonyore, erinde omogoko oino obe omoikeranu.
english: Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.

ekegusii: goika omonto oria omokoro bw’amatuko amange agacha, na abachenu b’Oyore Igoro Mono bakaegwa oboronge bwabo, na engaki egaika ekero abachenu bairete oboruoti boria.
english: until the Ancient of Days came and pronounced judgment in favor of the saints of the Most High, and the time came when they possessed the kingdom.

ekegusii: Ekero rigochia kogoroba na emerengari egochia gosira, ningende ase egetunwa ase manemane ekoruerwa na ase ekegoro ki’ogosambera ubani.
english: Until the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of incense.

ekegusii: Ekero rigochia kogoroba na emerengari egochia gosira, aye omwanchi one, onchoka gocha asende, ominyoke buna engabi, gose buna ensune ensae igoro ase egetunwa kere chinchwara.
english: Until the day breaks and the shadows flee, turn, my lover, and be like a gazelle or like a young stag on the rugged hills.

ekegusii: goika rituko riria abogoretigwe gochia igoro. Ritang’ani ri’ayio agachika goetera ase Omoika Omochenu abatomwa baria achorete.
english: until the day he was taken up to heaven, after giving instructions through the Holy Spirit to the apostles he had chosen.

ekegusii: Korwa ase engaki eyio Samweli tagendete korora Saulo naende nonya ng’ake, korende akagenderera koba nomoichano ase engencho yaye. Na Omonene agaichana, ekiagera konya abekire Saulo koba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.
english: Until the day Samuel died, he did not go to see Saul again, though Samuel mourned for him. And the LORD was grieved that he had made Saul king over Israel.

ekegusii: Mokonye abanto bamino goika banyore ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabae ng’umbu ya Yorodan na abae obotoereru buna abaete inwe. Erio namoirane, kera omonto ase orogongo rwaye namoeire.
english: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers as he has to you, and they too have taken over the land that the LORD your God is giving them, across the Jordan. After that, each of you may go back to the possession I have given you."

ekegusii: Mobakonye goika Omonene abae barabwo obotoereru, buna abaete inwe, nabarabwo mbaire ense eyio Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabae. Erio momanye koirana ase ense yaino, eye Musa, omosomba bw’Omonene, abaete aiga moocha ya Yorodan.”
english: until the LORD gives them rest, as he has done for you, and until they too have taken possession of the land that the LORD your God is giving them. After that, you may go back and occupy your own land, which Moses the servant of the LORD gave you east of the Jordan toward the sunrise."

ekegusii: Inche Omonene ning’anyie abanto abwo korwa ase ense eyio bagende aare, na aase agwo aratigwe are bosa, nabe aange mono ase ense eyio.
english: until the LORD has sent everyone far away and the land is utterly forsaken.

ekegusii: goika ekero Omonene ararigererie korwa igoro na arore ayio onsi.
english: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.

ekegusii: Ase igo Omonene akarusia Abaisraeli korwa ase obosio bwaye, buna akwanete goetera ase ababani, abasomba baye. Nabo Abaisraeli bakarusigwa korwa ase ense yabo abanyene, bakairwa Asuri, nao bare goika rero iga.
english: until the LORD removed them from his presence, as he had warned through all his servants the prophets. So the people of Israel were taken from their homeland into exile in Assyria, and they are still there.

ekegusii: Nabo goika intwe twensi tonyare goikera obomo bw’okwegena, na komanya mono Omwana o Nyasae, na koba omonto omoikeranu, goika ekerengo ki’ogokina kw’ogoichorwa gwa Kristo;
english: until we all reach unity in the faith and in the knowledge of the Son of God and become mature, attaining to the whole measure of the fullness of Christ.

ekegusii: Momoe goikera chifeta chitalanta rigana erimo (100), na engano ebitonga elifu eyemo (1,000), na edivai chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na amaguta ’amazeituni chilita chilifu isato, na amagana atano na rimo (3,600), na momoe omonyo otari na kerengo.
english: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.

ekegusii: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.
english: Nsiire bokong’u, indende buya, inyare gosika botambe emeroberio yao echikire.

ekegusii: Ere ekero anyorire ogochika oko akabaruta ase akanyomba ka ime, agasoyia amagoro abo ase amakorogoto.
english: Upon receiving such orders, he put them in the inner cell and fastened their feet in the stocks.

ekegusii: Abanto abaronge bakumirie amang’ana aya, ee, omonto otari na komocha oimokire gokorera bobe oria otamoirogeti Nyasae.
english: Upright men are appalled at this; the innocent are aroused against the ungodly.

ekegusii: Uria akamoiraneria, “Esanduku y’Omonene, na Abaisraeli amo n’Abayuda nigo bamenyete ase ebigutu isiko. Yoabu, omonene one, na abasomba baye nigo bagatoorete isiko ase egetii. Inee! Inche ngende nyomba mwane koria na konywa, na korara na mokane? Ekeene, buna aye ore moyo, na omoika oo ore moyo, inche tingokora ring’ana buna erio.”
english: Uriah said to David, "The ark and Israel and Judah are staying in tents, and my master Joab and my lord's men are camped in the open fields. How could I go to my house to eat and drink and lie with my wife? As surely as you live, I will not do such a thing!"

ekegusii: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad son of Ahlai,
english: Uria Omohiti na Sabadi, mosinto bw’Alai,

ekegusii: Mokorere ekerengo kia boronge; motware amagena ay’okorenga a boronge, na ebimunu bi’okorenga bia boronge, na ebituba bi’okorenga bia boronge. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabarusetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
english: Use honest scales and honest weights, an honest ephah and an honest hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt.

ekegusii: Chibesa echio mogore chiombe, gose ching’ondi, gose edivai, gose ebinyugwa ebiroro, kende gionsi moganetie. Mobiriere agwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino, erinde mogoke amo nabanto be chinka chiaino.
english: Use the silver to buy whatever you like: cattle, sheep, wine or other fermented drink, or anything you wish. Then you and your household shall eat there in the presence of the LORD your God and rejoice.

ekegusii: Utai, omwana bw’Amihudi, mosinto bw’Omuri o Imuri, o Bani korwa ase ororeria rwa Peresi, mosinto o Yuda,
english: Uthai son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, a descendant of Perez son of Judah.

ekegusii: Utterly amazed, they asked: "Are not all these men who are speaking Galileans?
english: Bagakumia bonsi na goichana, bagatebania, “Inee! Aba bonsi bagokwana, tibari Abagalili?

ekegusii: Abana abwo nabwo aba: Usi, omwana oye omotangi, na Busi omwabo, na Kemueli, ise Aramu,
english: Uz the firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel (the father of Aram),

ekegusii: Usa, na Pasea, na Besai;
english: Uzza, Paseah, Besai,

ekegusii: Uzzi the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah the father of Meraioth,
english: Usi akaibora Seraya, na Seraya akaibora Merayoti;

ekegusii: Usia korwa Asitera; Sama na Yeieli, basinto ba Hotamu korwa Aroeri;
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

ekegusii: Usia akaagacha emerobiri ase Yerusalemu agwo ase Egeita gi’Ekoona, na ase Egeita kie Rikura, na ase Chinsanganio, erio akayegitera chiburi.
english: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the Corner Gate, at the Valley Gate and at the angle of the wall, and he fortified them.

ekegusii: Naende Usia nabwate omoganda bw’abarwani esegi bamanyete korwana. Barabwo bakagenda korwana esegi, ekeombe ase ekeombe, koreng’ana buna babaretwe na korikwa na Yeieli omoriki, na Maaseya omoteneneri, inse y’obochiki bwa Hanania, omochiki bw’abarwani b’omoruoti.
english: Uzziah had a well-trained army, ready to go out by divisions according to their numbers as mustered by Jeiel the secretary and Maaseiah the officer under the direction of Hananiah, one of the royal officials.

ekegusii: Usia akagonchera abarwani baye chinguba, akabaturera na amatimo, akabaroiseria na ebigogwa, ne chingobo chi’ebioma, na amata, na amagena barenge koruta ne chinduruche.
english: Uzziah provided shields, spears, helmets, coats of armor, bows and slingstones for the entire army.

ekegusii: Usia akarara ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, na agatindekwa ase chisokoro chiaye chiatindegetwe agwo ase oboremo bw’ogotindeka abaruoti, ekiagera nigo akwanetwe, “Oyo nigo arenge noborwaire bwa ukoma.” Yotamu, omomura oye, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Uzziah rested with his fathers and was buried near them in a field for burial that belonged to the kings, for people said, "He had leprosy." And Jotham his son succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Uzziah the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, Ahaz the father of Hezekiah,
english: na Usia akaibora Yotamu na Yotamu akaibora Ahasi, na Ahasi akaibora Hezekia,

ekegusii: Usia nigo arenge nemiaka ikomi na etano nomo, ekero achagete kogamba; akagamba emiaka emerongo etano, na ebere, agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Yekolia korwa Yerusalemu.
english: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem fifty-two years. His mother's name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Usia akaba nendamwamu enene agwo aase ateneine negetaabo ase okoboko kwaye gochia gosamba ubani, na ekero abete nendamwamu ase abakuani, oborwaire bwa ukoma bokamobwata ase obosio bwaye agwo bosio bw’abakuani, ime ase enyomba y’Omonene, ase egesasimero ki’ogosambera ubani.
english: Uzziah, who had a censer in his hand ready to burn incense, became angry. While he was raging at the priests in their presence before the incense altar in the LORD's temple, leprosy broke out on his forehead.

ekegusii: Oyobwatetie abwo koagacha, nere Usieli, mosinto o Harahaya, oyomo bw’abaturi be chifeta. Oyo omobwatetie koagacha nere Hanania, oyomo bw’abaroisia amaguta akweakwa, agotioka buya. Abwo bakaagacha Yerusalemu goikera aase are korokwa Orwaki Oronetu.
english: Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, repaired the next section; and Hananiah, one of the perfume-makers, made repairs next to that. They restored Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.

ekegusii: Abare ne chinkoro chimwenu baurirwe ebinto konya basakoire, bono bararire chitoro chindito. Abarwani esegi bonsi basinyirwe korwana namaboko abo.
english: Valiant men lie plundered, they sleep their last sleep; not one of the warriors can lift his hands.

ekegusii: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
english: Wania na Maremoti, Eliasibu

ekegusii: Erio kobwachia gokia mambia, abakuani abanene bagakora ekina amo nabagaaka na aborokia b’amariko, na ekegambero ekegima. Bagasiba Yeso, bakamoira, bakamomoa Pilato.
english: Very early in the morning, the chief priests, with the elders, the teachers of the law and the whole Sanhedrin, reached a decision. They bound Jesus, led him away and handed him over to Pilate.

ekegusii: Mambia, botarakiamoka, akaimoka, agasoka, akagenda aase atari nabanto, agasabera aroro.
english: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.

ekegusii: Goika mambia chuni, rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma, bakagenda ase oboina, erioba korikooroka.
english: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they were on their way to the tomb

ekegusii: Naki naakong’u omonto gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omonyene oboronge, korende nanyarekane omonto koremereria gokwa ribaga ri’omonto omuya.
english: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though for a good man someone might possibly dare to die.

ekegusii: Engaki enke yatigaire, endamwamu yane asemore eere, erio eonchoke gosiria Abaasuri.
english: Very soon my anger against you will end and my wrath will be directed to their destruction."

ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene nakwane nabanto aba goetera ase abanto b’ebisaku ebiao, abwo bagokwana omonwa omogeni.
english: Very well then, with foreign lips and strange tongues God will speak to this people,

ekegusii: Abagaaka amo nabanto abang’aini ba Gebali nigo bamenyete ime yao; abwo nabwo barenge goticha aase ao aatandogete. Chimeeri chionsi chi’enyancha nigo chiarenge gocha asore, na abanto barenge imeo bakaba bakoonchorerania ebinto naye.
english: Veteran craftsmen of Gebal were on board as shipwrights to caulk your seams. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came alongside to trade for your wares.

ekegusii: Emechie y’Abaisraeli nigo yaraire, kende tikiarenge gokorekao goika aye Debora okaimoka, ee, goika okaimoka, okaba ng’ina ase Abaisraeli.
english: Village life in Israel ceased, ceased until I, Deborah, arose, arose a mother in Israel.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, Nyasae one, nacha ekina kiane koreng’ana noboronge bwao, tobaisa gotiga ababisa baane bagoke igoro yane.
english: Vindicate me in your righteousness, O LORD my God; do not let them gloat over me.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ing’a oboronge bwane, ndwanerere nkonye korwa ase abanto batakoirogeti, ntoorie korwa ase abanto abang’ainereria, abatari abanyakeene.
english: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; rescue me from deceitful and wicked men.

ekegusii: Okorega okwo gwakinire, kwabeire enyimbo igoro y’abwo bagokora amabe. Omonto obo tagotigara nonya noyomo; obotenenku bwabo mbosirigwe amo na kende gionsi babwate, na obonene bwabo bwonsi mboere.
english: Violence has grown into a rod to punish wickedness; none of the people will be left, none of that crowd-- no wealth, nothing of value.

ekegusii: chiira chiria nakwanete nomonwa one, echio nariete ekero narenge ase emechando.
english: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.

ekegusii: Inwe rera nobororo, ekiagera rituko ri’Omonene riabereire ang’e; nigo rirachiche buna ogosiria gokorwa ase Omonene Omobui.
english: Wail, for the day of the LORD is near; it will come like destruction from the Almighty.

ekegusii: Aye egeita, eumie! Aye omochie, rera! Inwe Abafilisti mwensi, ichana ase obwoba! Erioki nkorwa rire sugusu, na ase egati yabo onde tari oranyorwe.
english: Wail, O gate! Howl, O city! Melt away, all you Philistines! A cloud of smoke comes from the north, and there is not a straggler in its ranks.

ekegusii: Wail, O pine tree, for the cedar has fallen; the stately trees are ruined! Wail, oaks of Bashan; the dense forest has been cut down!
english: Aye omotarakwa, rera, ekiagera omocharake oiyerigwe inse. Emete ere nobonene yasirigwe. Inwe emete enga emetontera ere Basani, rera, ekiagera rinani rinoru riaiyerigwe inse.

ekegusii: Wail, you ships of Tarshish; your fortress is destroyed!
english: Inwe abe chimeeri chia Tarisisi rera, ekiagera chiburi chiaino chiatagoirwe.

ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete ase ensemo eye ekorokwa Ekonu, rera, ekiagera abaonchoreria bonsi basirigwe, na abasangereria bonsi be chibesa basirigwe.
english: Wail, you who live in the market district; all your merchants will be wiped out, all who trade with silver will be ruined.

ekegusii: Ganya Omonene na obwatie enchera yaye, nere nakoimokererie igoro akoe ense ebe eyao; erio norigererie orore buna abanyabibe bagosirigwa.
english: Wait for the LORD and keep his way. He will exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

ekegusii: Remereria oganye Omonene, kabe omoremu, tokwa omoyo; ee, remereria oganye Omonene!
english: Wait for the LORD; be strong and take heart and wait for the LORD.

ekegusii: bakomotega, banyore ring’ana korwa ase omonwa oye, erinde banyare komosoera.
english: waiting to catch him in something he might say.

ekegusii: Obe omorendi, oyabeke chinguru ayatigarete, ayare ang’e gokwa. Naki tindochi ng’a ogokora kwao ngoikeranete ase obosio bwa Nyasae one.
english: Wake up! Strengthen what remains and is about to die, for I have not found your deeds complete in the sight of my God.

ekegusii: Imoka, Debora, imoka! Imoka, otere ogotera! Naye Baraki, mosinto bw’Abinoamu, tenena, oire abanto abwo gwosire.
english: 'Wake up, wake up, Deborah! Wake up, wake up, break out in song! Arise, O Barak! Take captive your captives, O son of Abinoam.'

ekegusii: Inwe abamwatindire nebinyugwa ebiroro, boka morere! Inwe mwensi aba mokonywa edivai, bokia amagombo, ase engencho y’edivai enyia, ekiagera yarusigwe korwa ase emenwa yaino.
english: Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you drinkers of wine; wail because of the new wine, for it has been snatched from your lips.

ekegusii: Taara moetanane Sayoni, mobare emerobiri yaye.
english: Walk about Zion, go around her, count her towers,

ekegusii: Mobwatie chinchera chionsi Omonene, Nyasae oino, abachikire, erio nario morabe moyo, naende nario erabe buya asemore, na inwe momenye amatuko amange ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.”
english: Walk in all the way that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live and prosper and prolong your days in the land that you will possess.

ekegusii: Wanting to release Jesus, Pilate appealed to them again.
english: Nabo eria kabere Pilato agakwana nabarabwo, akarigia gosibora Yeso.

ekegusii: Wanting to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
english: Pilato agancha gokora ayaragwenere omoganda, akabasiborera Baraba, na ekero aakire Yeso chinkini, akamorua abambwe.

ekegusii: Omonto orarente okweatanana, ekero kwamokanirie erie ritang’ani, naende eria kabere, omwange.
english: Warn a divisive person once, and then warn him a second time. After that, have nothing to do with him.

ekegusii: warning them not to tell who he was.
english: Akabachika tibamoorokia.

ekegusii: Was a man already circumcised when he was called? He should not become uncircumcised. Was a man uncircumcised when he was called? He should not be circumcised.
english: Monto onde bwensi orangerigwe na Nyasae ekero aikire kwaroka, tekora buna tarogeti, na monto onde bwensi orangerigwe otarogeti, taroka.

ekegusii: igo abogoretigwe goika Paradiso ya Nyasae, akaigwa amang’ana atagwatoreka, ayatagwenerete mwanyabanto ayakwane.
english: was caught up to paradise. He heard inexpressible things, things that man is not permitted to tell.

ekegusii: Ase Baria Batato ere nigo abwate ogosikwa okuya goetania abande, akaba omoraai obo, korende tareng’anetie na Baria Batato be ritang’ani.
english: Was he not held in greater honor than the Three? He became their commander, even though he was not included among them.

ekegusii: Inee! Nebibe nakorire ase okweirania inse, erio mokinigwe, ekiagera nabarandeirie enchili ya Nyasae ntari neng’eria?
english: Was it a sin for me to lower myself in order to elevate you by preaching the gospel of God to you free of charge?

ekegusii: Inee! Sulemani, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, takorete ebibe ase engencho y’abakungu banga buna abwo? Ase abaruoti bonsi b’ebisaku, omoruoti onde tarenge buna ere, ekiagera Nyasae nigo amwanchete, na akamobeka akaba omoruoti igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi. Nonya naboigo, abakungu baria b’ebisaku ebio bakagera agakora ebibe.
english: Was it not because of marriages like these that Solomon king of Israel sinned? Among the many nations there was no king like him. He was loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel, but even he was led into sin by foreign women.

ekegusii: Inee! Tari aye gwakametie amache ’enyancha, amache e chindiba chintambe chi’enyancha, erio okaroisia enchera aroro, erinde ababooretigwe bakaambokerao?
english: Was it not you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, who made a road in the depths of the sea so that the redeemed might cross over?

ekegusii: Onde tanyorekanete oiranete komotogia Nyasae, otatiga omogeni oyo?”
english: Was no one found to return and give praise to God except this foreigner?"

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe timwabasekererete Abaisraeli? Abwo banyorekanete bare ase ekeombe ki’abaibi? Gose nase ki mwarenge gosinga‐singisia emetwe yaino ekero mware gokwana igoro yabo?
english: Was not Israel the object of your ridicule? Was she caught among thieves, that you shake your head in scorn whenever you speak of her?

ekegusii: Inee! Sokoro yaito Ibrahimu taetwe oboronge ase ogokora, ekero aruete Isaka, omwana oye, igoro ase egesasimero?
english: Was not our ancestor Abraham considered righteous for what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar?

ekegusii: Inee! Ebibe biria twakorete ase ogosasima Peori tibiatoisanete? Korwa ase ebibe biria titwana gochenwa nonya ngoika rero iga, na egesusuro gekanyora omoganda bwonsi bw’Omonene.
english: Was not the sin of Peor enough for us? Up to this very day we have not cleansed ourselves from that sin, even though a plague fell on the community of the LORD!

ekegusii: Inee! Eye nengaki entang’ani nabeire nkomoboreria korwa ase Nyasae? Taibo aye omoruoti tobaisa kombarera inche, omosomba oo, gose eamate ya tata bobe bonde, ekiagera timanyeti gento kende gionsi ase ayio, kebe ekenene gose egeke.”
english: Was that day the first time I inquired of God for him? Of course not! Let not the king accuse your servant or any of his father's family, for your servant knows nothing at all about this whole affair."

ekegusii: Ning’o ase ababani chisokoro chiaino chitachandete? Na barabwo mbaitete baria babanete amang’ana igoro y’ogocha kw’oria Omonyene Oboronge. Inwe bono mwabeire abamorua na abamoiti.
english: Was there ever a prophet your fathers did not persecute? They even killed those who predicted the coming of the Righteous One. And now you have betrayed and murdered him--

ekegusii: Esibie na mwechene; rusia ogokora kwaino okobe korwa ase amaiso aane; tiga gokora ayare amabe.
english: wash and make yourselves clean. Take your evil deeds out of my sight! Stop doing wrong,

ekegusii: Ase ayio esibie, bweake amaguta agotioka buya, obeke chianga chiao chingiya. Erio otirimboke gochia ase ekeooreri, korende tobaisa kweorokia ase omonto oria goika ekero akoorire koragera na konywa.
english: Wash and perfume yourself, and put on your best clothes. Then go down to the threshing floor, but don't let him know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.

ekegusii: Onsibie kegima korwa ase obobe bwane, na onchene korwa ase ebibe biane.
english: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

ekegusii: Renda, saba, timobaisa gosoa ase ogoteemwa; omoika nore nogwancha, korende omobere tori ne chinguru.”
english: Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the body is weak."

ekegusii: Mwerende korwa ase chisese, mwerende na korwa ase abwo bagokora amabe, mwerende nabwo bakwenachanacha!
english: Watch out for those dogs, those men who do evil, those mutilators of the flesh.

ekegusii: Erigererie inwe abanyene timosiria aya twabarenteire, korende monyore eng’eria eng’ikeranu.
english: Watch out that you do not lose what you have worked for, but that you may be rewarded fully.

ekegusii: Origererie orore ase bakogesa obabwatie korwa nyuma! Nakanirie abanto baane tibakogochanda. Gokorang’a, ogende ase chinsiongo echio baichoirie amache, otaae onywe!”
english: Watch the field where the men are harvesting, and follow along after the girls. I have told the men not to touch you. And whenever you are thirsty, go and get a drink from the water jars the men have filled."

ekegusii: Bwerende aye omonyene na okworokereria kwao, ogenderere ase ayio, ekiagera korakore igo mbwetoorie aye omonyene amo nabwo bakogotegerera.
english: Watch your life and doctrine closely. Persevere in them, because if you do, you will save both yourself and your hearers.

ekegusii: Amache amange naiteke korwa ase chinyongo chiabo na oroiboro rwabo nigo rorabe oronge mono. Omoruoti obo nabe omonene goetania Agagi, na oboruoti bwaye inabotogigwe mono.
english: Water will flow from their buckets; their seed will have abundant water. "Their king will be greater than Agag; their kingdom will be exalted.

ekegusii: Onye togwancha oborori bwa mwanyabanto, oborori bwa Nyasae nobonene kobua, na oborori bwa Nyasae nobo, ng’a oikire kobera Omwana oye kirori.
english: We accept man's testimony, but God's testimony is greater because it is the testimony of God, which he has given about his Son.

ekegusii: Tokagwa inse twensi, nkaigwa eriogi rigontebia ase omonwa bw’Ekeibirania: Saulo, Saulo, nase ki gwanchandire? Naakong’u asore goaka ensonga y’esimisi chintacho.
english: We all fell to the ground, and I heard a voice saying to me in Aramaic, 'Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.'

ekegusii: Intwe twensi nigo tokwamuma buna chidubu, na tweumia buna amaruma; nigo toganetie ay’oboronge, korende tibori aande; nigo toganetie ogotooreka, korende nigo kore aare naintwe.
english: We all growl like bears; we moan mournfully like doves. We look for justice, but find none; for deliverance, but it is far away.

ekegusii: Naki intwe twensi nigo tokomocha ase chinchera chinyinge. Onye omonto takomocha ase ogokwana, oyio nomonto omoikeranu, oranyare kogambera omobere oye bwonsi boigo.
english: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to keep his whole body in check.

ekegusii: Intwe twensi konya twasirire buna ching’ondi chinsiru; kera omonto nigo abwatetie enchera yaye omonyene, na Omonene omotwekire obobe bwaito intwe twensi.
english: We all, like sheep, have gone astray, each of us has turned to his own way; and the LORD has laid on him the iniquity of us all.

ekegusii: Naende ntwababoria amarieta abo, erinde tokorikere amarieta ’abatang’ani abwo babo.
english: We also asked them their names, so that we could write down the names of their leaders for your information.

ekegusii: na omanyete ng’a amachiko tabekiri ase omonto omoronge. Korende nigo abekire ase abasaria amachiko, na abatari koigwera, ase abatari aba Nyasae, na abanyabibe, ase abatari abachenu, baria bare ab’ense eye, ase abaiti abaise gose abang’ina, na abaiti bande,
english: We also know that law is made not for the righteous but for lawbreakers and rebels, the ungodly and sinful, the unholy and irreligious; for those who kill their fathers or mothers, for murderers,

ekegusii: Botambe nigo tokobogoria ogoitwa kwa Yeso ase emebere yaito, erinde obogima bwa Yeso naborobwo boorokigwe ase emebere yaito.
english: We always carry around in our body the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

ekegusii: Botambe nigo togoakera Nyasae ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho yaino mwensi, na kobaatora ase ogosaba gwaito.
english: We always thank God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers.

ekegusii: Botambe nigo togoakera Nyasae, Ise Omonene oito Yeso Kristo, ng’a mbuya mono, ekero tokobasabera inwe,
english: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,

ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore ase ense y’obogeni, naende nigo tore abaeti ase obosio bwao, buna chisokoro chiaito chionsi chiarenge; amatuko aito ay’okomenya ase ense nigo anga buna omorengari, na ogosemeria konde tikoiyo.
english: We are aliens and strangers in your sight, as were all our forefathers. Our days on earth are like a shadow, without hope.

ekegusii: Intwe twensi nabana b’omonto oyomo. Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abanto abaronge, titori chirooti.”
english: We are all the sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies."

ekegusii: Amaene, emioyo yaito yaiyerigwe inse ase orotu, emebere yaito yabwateranigwe inse ase riroba.
english: We are brought down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.

ekegusii: Ntore nomoyo bw’oboremu, na twarorire buya kobua korua ase omobere na komenya amo n’Omonene.
english: We are confident, I say, and would prefer to be away from the body and at home with the Lord.

ekegusii: Intwe nigo togosirigwa nendamwamu yao, twaondokigwa nekeririanda kiao.
english: We are consumed by your anger and terrified by your indignation.

ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore abariri ase engencho ya Kristo, korende inwe nigo more abang’aini ase Kristo. Intwe nigo tore abareu, korende inwe nigo more ne chinguru. Inwe nigo mosikire, korende intwe tochayire.
english: We are fools for Christ, but you are so wise in Christ! We are weak, but you are strong! You are honored, we are dishonored!

ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore aba Nyasae. Ere oyomanyete Nyasae nigo agotoigwa, na ere oyotari o Nyasae tagotoigwa. Ase eri twamanyire gwatanana Omoika bw’ekeene, na omoika bw’ogosira.
english: We are from God, and whoever knows God listens to us; but whoever is not from God does not listen to us. This is how we recognize the Spirit of truth and the spirit of falsehood.

ekegusii: Titorochi ebimanyererio biaito, na ababani tibari, na onde tari ase egati yaito omanyete ngoika ririri aya arabe.
english: We are given no miraculous signs; no prophets are left, and none of us knows how long this will be.

ekegusii: Naki twagokire ekero intwe tore abareu, na inwe more ne chinguru. Eri twasabire neri, ng’a moikeranigwe.
english: We are glad whenever we are weak but you are strong; and our prayer is for your perfection.

ekegusii: Korwa ase chinsemo chionsi nigo tokomigwa, korende titori komigeka; iga togoichanigwa, korende titogokwa emioyo,
english: We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;

ekegusii: Naki titori gwekinia intwe abanyene goetania ekerengo giaito buna ntotari kobaikera inwe. Naki intwe nabatang’ani tore b’okobarentera inwe enchili ya Kristo.
english: We are not going too far in our boasting, as would be the case if we had not come to you, for we did get as far as you with the gospel of Christ.

ekegusii: Titogokora buna Musa oyotubete obosio bwaye, erinde Abaisraeli tibanyara korigereria mono omoerio bw’obonene boria bwarenge goeta.
english: We are not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face to keep the Israelites from gazing at it while the radiance was fading away.

ekegusii: Titogwetogia intwe abanyene ase obosio bwaino naende, korende twabaeire ribaga ri’ogwetogia ase engencho yaito erinde monyare koba nokoiraneria ase abagwetogia ase amang’ana a isiko oka, gose tari ase amang’ana ’enkoro ime.
english: We are not trying to commend ourselves to you again, but are giving you an opportunity to take pride in us, so that you can answer those who take pride in what is seen rather than in what is in the heart.

ekegusii: Titosiegeti chinkoro chiaito asemore, korende inwe nigo mosiegete echiaino asetore.
english: We are not withholding our affection from you, but you are withholding yours from us.

ekegusii: Intwe bono nao tore ase amaboko ao, otokorere aya oroche are amaya na amaronge.”
english: We are now in your hands. Do to us whatever seems good and right to you."

ekegusii: Intwe twabeire okogechia ase abanto bamenyete ang’e naintwe, abanto batoetanaine nigo bagotochecheria na gotosekerera.
english: We are objects of reproach to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.

ekegusii: Intwe ekeene mboronge; ekiagera twaeirwe eng’eria ya boronge y’ogokora gwaito, korende oyo takoreti gento kende kebe.”
english: We are punished justly, for we are getting what our deeds deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong."

ekegusii: Intwe nigo tore abanto b’omorembe na abegenwa ase Abaisraeli. Inee! Aye nigo origetie gosiria omochie oyo ore ng’ina ase egati y’Abaisraeli? Nase ki oganetie gosaria omwando bw’Omonene?”
english: We are the peaceful and faithful in Israel. You are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel. Why do you want to swallow up the LORD's inheritance?"

ekegusii: Nabo tore abatomire na Kristo; Nyasae nigo akobasorora inwe goetera ase emenwa yaito. Twabasoroire ase engencho ya Kristo: Mobwatanigwe na Nyasae.
english: We are therefore Christ's ambassadors, as though God were making his appeal through us. We implore you on Christ's behalf: Be reconciled to God.

ekegusii: Intwe na Omoika Omochenu, oyio Nyasae aeire bonsi abamoigwerete, nigo tore birori ase amang’ana aya.”
english: We are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him."

ekegusii: Twabeire buna abanto aye otana kogambera rinde, na buna abanto batari korokwa ase erieta riao.
english: We are yours from of old; but you have not ruled over them, they have not been called by your name.

ekegusii: Na intwe twegenire na komanya ng’a aye naye Omochenu o Nyasae.”
english: We believe and know that you are the Holy One of God."

ekegusii: Naki onye twegenire ng’a Yeso nakwete, naende akaboka, naboigo nabwo bararire ase Yeso, Nyasae nabarente amo nere.
english: We believe that Jesus died and rose again and so we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in him.

ekegusii: Togasoa ase emeeri y’Aderamiti eyarenge ang’e kogenda goika emechie ye chingegu chi’Asia, tokaimoka. Aristarko, Omomakedonia o Tesaloniki, nigo arenge amo naintwe.
english: We boarded a ship from Adramyttium about to sail for ports along the coast of the province of Asia, and we put out to sea. Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was with us.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, intwe titokonyara korua abaiseke baito banyuomwe nabarabwo.” Abaisraeli konya barire eira na gotiana ng’a, “Omonto oria orarue omoiseke oye anyuomwe n’Ababenjamin aragererigwe.”
english: We can't give them our daughters as wives, since we Israelites have taken this oath: 'Cursed be anyone who gives a wife to a Benjamite.'

ekegusii: Togasaria emechie eyio yonsi, togaita abanto bonsi, abasacha na abakungu, na abana, buna twakorete ase emechie ya Sihoni, omoruoti o Hesiboni.
english: We completely destroyed them, as we had done with Sihon king of Heshbon, destroying every city-- men, women and children.

ekegusii: Na intwe ase obosio bwa Nyasae Tata oito titori gotiga koinyora emeremo yaino ase okwegena, na ogwechanda kwaino ase obwanchani, na oboremereria bwaino ase okomosemeria Omonene Yeso Kristo.
english: We continually remember before our God and Father your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love, and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Gotwachia gokoora orogendo rwaito korwa Turo, togaika Potolemai, togakwania abaminto, togaikaransa nabarabwo rituko erimo.
english: We continued our voyage from Tyre and landed at Ptolemais, where we greeted the brothers and stayed with them for a day.

ekegusii: Intwe nigo tokoiyeria ebirengererio na kera egetango kieimokereretie igoro kegotanga Nyasae tamanywa, na gosiba kera ekerengererio kenyare koigwera Kristo;
