english: When all Israel heard the verdict the king had given, they held the king in awe, because they saw that he had wisdom from God to administer justice.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baroche ng’a omoruoti nigo angete kobaigwera, bakamoiraneria, bagateba, “Ngetari ki intwe tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese. Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye! Inwe abanto ba Daudi, erende inwe abanyene!” Ase igo Abaisraeli bonsi bakarua aroro agwo, bakagenda ase chinka chiabo.
english: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse's son? To your tents, O Israel! Look after your own house, O David!" So all the Israelites went home.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baroche ng’a omoruoti nigo aangete kobaigwera, bakamoiraneria, bakamotebia, “Ngetari ki intwe tobwate ase Daudi? Titori nomwando na mosinto o Yese. Inwe Abaisraeli, genda kera omonto bwoye! Inwe abanto ba Daudi, erende inwe abanyene!” Ase igo Abaisraeli bakarua aroro agwo, bakagenda ase chinka chiabo.
english: When all Israel saw that the king refused to listen to them, they answered the king: "What share do we have in David, what part in Jesse's son? To your tents, O Israel! Look after your own house, O David!" So the Israelites went home.

ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baito bonsi baigwete ayio, na abanto b’ebisaku bionsi biatoetanaine bayaroche, bakaba nobwoba obonene, bagechaya na gwesookera abanyene, ekiagera nigo bamanyete ng’a emeremo eyio nigo yakoretwe na goikeranigwa ase ogokonywa kwa Nyasae oito.
english: When all our enemies heard about this, all the surrounding nations were afraid and lost their self-confidence, because they realized that this work had been done with the help of our God.

ekegusii: Ekero abatang’ani bonsi b’abarwani esegi, amo nabanto babo, baigwete ng’a omoruoti o Babeli ochorire Gedalia agambere ense eria, bakagenda asare agwo Misipa. Abagendeteo nabwo aba: Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, na Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, na Seraya, mosinto o Tanahumeti korwa Netofa, na Yasania, omomura bw’omonto o Maaka, amo nabanto baye.
english: When all the army officers and their men heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah as governor, they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah-- Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, and their men.

ekegusii: Abachiki bonsi b’abarwani esegi b’Abayuda, amo nabanto babo, abwo batigarete ase chinsemo chinde ase ense eyio, bakaigwa ng’a omoruoti o Babeli obekire Gedalia, mosinto bw’Ahikamu, koba omogambi ase ense eria, agambere abanto abarenge abataka mono, abasacha na abakungu, amo nabana, abwo batairetwe Babeli ase obosomba.
english: When all the army officers and their men who were still in the open country heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam as governor over the land and had put him in charge of the men, women and children who were the poorest in the land and who had not been carried into exile to Babylon,

ekegusii: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the Levites took up the ark,
english: Abagaaka bonsi bagacha, na Abalawi bakaimokia Esanduku eria,

ekegusii: Ekero abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bachete, abakuani bakaimokia Esanduku y’Omonene,
english: When all the elders of Israel had arrived, the priests took up the ark,

ekegusii: Nabo abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha ase omoruoti agwo Heburoni; na aroro Daudi agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene, na barabwo bagaaka Daudi amaguta akaba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli, koreng’ana ne ring’ana riria Omonene akwanete goetera ase Samweli.
english: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, he made a compact with them at Hebron before the LORD, and they anointed David king over Israel, as the LORD had promised through Samuel.

ekegusii: Ase igo abagaaka bonsi b’Abaisraeli bagacha ase Daudi omoruoti agwo Heburoni; ere agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene agwo Heburoni.
english: When all the elders of Israel had come to King David at Hebron, the king made a compact with them at Hebron before the LORD, and they anointed David king over Israel.

ekegusii: Agwo nao amaicho onsi arenge gosangererekana, na abarisia nigo baare korusia rigena riria korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko banyoisia ching’ondi, naende bariirania ase omonwa bw’ensoko.
english: When all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone away from the well's mouth and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.

ekegusii: Korende ekero abanto bonsi ba Yabeshi o Gileadi baigwete aya onsi Abafilisti bakorerete Saulo,
english: When all the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard of everything the Philistines had done to Saul,

ekegusii: Na ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baigwete ng’a Yeroboamu oiranire, bagatoma abanto bamorangerie ache ase omosangererekano, bakamobeka akaba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli. Omonto onde tari otunyanete abanto b’enyomba ya Daudi, otatiga abanto b’egesaku kia Yuda boka.
english: When all the Israelites heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent and called him to the assembly and made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to the house of David.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge ase ense eria omweremo baroche ng’a abarwani ’esegi babo batamire, na ng’a Saulo na abamura baye bakure, bagatiga emechie yabo bagatama. Erio Abafilisti bagacha, bakamenya ase emechie eyio.
english: When all the Israelites in the valley saw that the army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bonsi baroche omorero orwete igoro, na baroche obonene bw’Omonene igoro ye Hekalu, bagatung’ama bakaumama gochia inse, bagasasima Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, bagateba, “Omonene nomuya, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye bwa botambe nigo bogendererete kare na kare.”
english: When all the Israelites saw the fire coming down and the glory of the LORD above the temple, they knelt on the pavement with their faces to the ground, and they worshiped and gave thanks to the LORD, saying, "He is good; his love endures forever."

ekegusii: Boigo Abaisraeli bande, abwo konya bebisire ase ebitunwa bi’ense y’Efraimu, ekero baigwete ng’a Abafilisti batamire, nabarabwo bakababwatia nomokia gochia kobarwania
english: When all the Israelites who had hidden in the hill country of Ephraim heard that the Philistines were on the run, they joined the battle in hot pursuit.

ekegusii: Ekero ebibekerero bionsi biaichorete, agatebia omwana oyomo, “Ndetere ekebekerero kende.” Omwana oye akamotebia, “Ekebekerero kende tikeiyo.” Erio amaguta agatiga gocha.
english: When all the jars were full, she said to her son, "Bring me another one." But he replied, "There is not a jar left." Then the oil stopped flowing.

ekegusii: Abayahudi bonsi abarenge ase ense y’Abamoabu, na abwo bamenyete ase egati y’Abaamoni, na ase ense y’Abaedomu, na ase chinse chinde, bakaigwa ng’a omoruoti o Babeli natigaretie Abayahudi bande ase ense yabo, naende ng’a konya obekire Gedalia mosinto bw’Ahikamu, mochokoro o Safani, obeire omogambi igoro ase abanto abwo.
english: When all the Jews in Moab, Ammon, Edom and all the other countries heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant in Judah and had appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, as governor over them,

ekegusii: Ekero abarwani bonsi abwo barenge inse ya Hadadeseri baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagakora omorembe nabarabwo na kwebeka inse yabo. Ase ayio Abasiiria bakoboa gokonya Abaamoni naende.
english: When all the kings who were vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with the Israelites and became subject to them. So the Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites anymore.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi, abwo Isumaeli airete, baroche Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, amo nabatang’ani b’abarwani esegi, bakaba nomogoko omonene.
english: When all the people Ishmael had with him saw Johanan son of Kareah and the army officers who were with him, they were glad.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi bakamorora ogotaara na komotogia Nyasae.
english: When all the people saw him walking and praising God,

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi baroche ayio, bagatung’ama inse bakaumama, bagateba, “Omonene nere Nyasae! Omonene nere Nyasae!”
english: When all the people saw this, they fell prostrate and cried, "The LORD-- he is God! The LORD-- he is God!"

ekegusii: Egachia koba abanto bonsi kobabatisirwe, na Yeso boigo kabatisirwe, na ekero agosaba, igoro akamaanoka.
english: When all the people were being baptized, Jesus was baptized too. And as he was praying, heaven was opened

ekegusii: Naende emeganda yonsi, abasangererekanete korora aya, kobachia korora ayakoreka, bakairana chinka chiabo, bakweaka ebikuba.
english: When all the people who had gathered to witness this sight saw what took place, they beat their breasts and went away.

ekegusii: Naboigo emeremo eye yonsi omoruoti Sulemani akorete ase enyomba y’Omonene ekaera. Na Sulemani agasoyia aroro ebinto ebi Daudi ise aatananete koba ebichenu: chifeta, ne chitahabu, na ebikorero; akabigacha ase chikungo chi’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: When all the work King Solomon had done for the temple of the LORD was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated-- the silver and gold and the furnishings-- and he placed them in the treasuries of the LORD's temple.

ekegusii: Emeremo yonsi Sulemani akorete ase enyomba y’Omonene ekaera. Erio Sulemani akarenta ime ase enyomba eria ebinto Daudi ise aatananete: Chifeta ne chitahabu, na ebikorero bionsi, akabigacha ime ase ebigachero bi’enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: When all the work Solomon had done for the temple of the LORD was finished, he brought in the things his father David had dedicated-- the silver and gold and all the furnishings-- and he placed them in the treasuries of God's temple.

ekegusii: “Ekero ogosesenigwa na okoragererigwa, ayio naborokereirie arabe akobanyora ekero mogendererete komenya ase egati y’ebisaku bionsi ebio ase Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabaserie gochia, monyare koinyora amang’ana aane.
english: When all these blessings and curses I have set before you come upon you and you take them to heart wherever the LORD your God disperses you among the nations,

ekegusii: Ekero Amatuko ayio onsi Amanene aerete, Abaisraeli bonsi abarenge aroro bakagenda ase emechie y’Abayuda bakanachana amatenenerio agosasimwa na bagatagora emete y’Asera, enyasae eria enkungu, naende bagasaria aase aimokererete igoro agosasimerwa. Boigo bagasaria kegima ebisasimero biarenge agwo ase orogongo rwonsi rw’Abayuda, na orw’Ababenjamin, na orw’Abaefraimu, na orw’Abamanase. Erio Abaisraeli bonsi bakairana gochia ase emechie yabo, kera omonto akagenda bwoye.
english: When all this had ended, the Israelites who were there went out to the towns of Judah, smashed the sacred stones and cut down the Asherah poles. They destroyed the high places and the altars throughout Judah and Benjamin and in Ephraim and Manasseh. After they had destroyed all of them, the Israelites returned to their own towns and to their own property.

ekegusii: Abanto bonsi abwo konya bamomanyete agwo ritang’ani, ekero bamoroche okobana amo nababani baria, bagakwana barabwo ase barabwo, “Mang’ana ki aya amonyorire omwana o Kisi? Inee! Saulo nere nabeire oyomo bw’ababani?”
english: When all those who had formerly known him saw him prophesying with the prophets, they asked each other, "What is this that has happened to the son of Kish? Is Saul also among the prophets?"

ekegusii: Ekero Amasia airanete korwa ase ogoita Abaedomu, akarentana chinyasae chi’Abaedomu, agachisasima na gochiruera ebing’wanso.
english: When Amaziah returned from slaughtering the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the people of Seir. He set them up as his own gods, bowed down to them and burned sacrifices to them.

ekegusii: Ekero Anania achia koigwa amang’ana aya, agaaka inse, agakwa. Omoondoko omonene okanyora abanto bonsi abaigwete aya.
english: When Ananias heard this, he fell down and died. And great fear seized all who heard what had happened.

ekegusii: Ekero enkoro yane ere nogwechanda okonge, okoremia kwao okonge nigo gokogokia omoyo one.
english: When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought joy to my soul.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto onde bwensi akorua ekeng’wanso ki’omorembe asende, ase engencho y’eira ariete, gose eki’ogwancha kwaye, korwa ase chiombe gose ching’ondi, goika ebe eng’iti eng’ikeranu, etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, eyio nero erancherwe.
english: When anyone brings from the herd or flock a fellowship offering to the LORD to fulfill a special vow or as a freewill offering, it must be without defect or blemish to be acceptable.

ekegusii: Ninki kiabete ase amatuko aria? Ekero omonto arenge kogenda ase etui y’emesaima ng’a anyore emesaima emerongo ebere, onyora ikomi yoka, na ekero arenge kogenda ase amasabibu akomiterwa ng’a anyore ebibekerero emerongo etano biichire edivai, onyora emerongo ebere bioka.
english: When anyone came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When anyone went to a wine vat to draw fifty measures, there were only twenty.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto akoigwa ring’ana ri’oboruoti, na ere takorimanya, nigo agocha oria omobe, otaboria riria riasimekirwe ase enkoro yaye, oyo nere obusuirwe ase enchera ensemo.
english: When anyone hears the message about the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in his heart. This is the seed sown along the path.

ekegusii: Ekero arigia kwamboka enyancha gochia Akaya, abaminto bakamoremia, bakarikera aborokigwa b’aroro rirube bamoroisie. Ere gaikire aroro agakonya mono baria abegenete goetera ase obuya bwa Nyasae,
english: When Apollos wanted to go to Achaia, the brothers encouraged him and wrote to the disciples there to welcome him. On arriving, he was a great help to those who by grace had believed.

ekegusii: Arauna agachia korigereria akarora omoruoti na abasomba baye bagotiira gocha asare. Erio agasoka, agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase obosio bw’omoruoti.
english: When Araunah looked and saw the king and his men coming toward him, he went out and bowed down before the king with his face to the ground.

ekegusii: Ekero Arioki, omochiki bw’abarendi b’omoruoti, agendete ng’a aite abanto abang’aini ba Babeli, Danieli agakwana nere ore nobong’aini na obomanyi bw’amasikani,
english: When Arioch, the commander of the king's guard, had gone out to put to death the wise men of Babylon, Daniel spoke to him with wisdom and tact.

ekegusii: When Arphaxad had lived 35 years, he became the father of Shelah.
english: Ekero Arifaksadi abeire nemiaka emerongo etato, na etano (35) akaibora Sela.

ekegusii: Ekero Asa aigwete amang’ana ’obobani bw’Odedi, akaba noboenenu, akarusia emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, okogechia koria, korwa ase ense yonsi y’Abayuda na Ababenjamin, na korwa ase emechie yonsi eria konya airire agwo ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu; naende akaroisia egesasimero ki’Omonene agwo ang’e nenyomba yaagachetwe bosio bw’enyomba y’Omonene.
english: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah son of Oded the prophet, he took courage. He removed the detestable idols from the whole land of Judah and Benjamin and from the towns he had captured in the hills of Ephraim. He repaired the altar of the LORD that was in front of the portico of the LORD's temple.

ekegusii: Ekero Atalia aigwete amariogi ’abarendi na ay’abanto bonsi, agasoa enyomba y’Omonene ase abanto basangererekanete.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise made by the guards and the people, she went to the people at the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero Atalia aigwete eriogi ri’abanto barenge gocharoka‐charoka na gotogia omoruoti, agasoa enyomba y’Omonene ase abanto basangererekanete.
english: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and cheering the king, she went to them at the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero Atalia, ng’ina Ahasia, aroche ng’a omwana oye okure, akaimoka, agaita ab’enyomba yonsi y’omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family of the house of Judah.

ekegusii: Bono ekero Atalia, ng’ina Ahasia, aroche ng’a omwana oye okure, akaimoka, agaita eamate yonsi y’omoruoti.
english: When Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she proceeded to destroy the whole royal family.

ekegusii: Asaria, omokuani omonene, na abakuani baria bakarigereria omoruoti, bakarora ng’a onyorire oborwaire bwa ukoma ase obosio bwaye. Bakamobwata, bakamosokia gochia isiko bwango, nere omonyene akaayerera agasoka isiko, ekiagera Omonene amoagete.
english: When Azariah the chief priest and all the other priests looked at him, they saw that he had leprosy on his forehead, so they hurried him out. Indeed, he himself was eager to leave, because the LORD had afflicted him.

ekegusii: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
english: Ekero Asuba akwete, Kalebu akanyuoma Efarata; ere akamoiborera Huri.

ekegusii: Ekero Baali‐Hanani akwete, Hadadi akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye. Omochie oye nigo orenge korokwa Pai, na mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Mehetabeli, mosubati o Matiredi o Mesahabu.
english: When Baal-Hanan died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife's name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.

ekegusii: Baali‐Hanani, mosinto o Akibori, nere agakwa, na Hadari akaba ogokamba ase ribaga riaye, na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Pau, na mokaye nigo arenge korokwa Mehetabeli, mosubati o Matiredi, mosubati o Mesahabu.
english: When Baal-Hanan son of Acbor died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife's name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.

ekegusii: Ekero Baasa aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatiga kogita omochie o Rama, na emeremo yaye aroro egatenena.
english: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and abandoned his work.

ekegusii: Na ekero Baasa aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatiga kogitera omochie o Rama, akagenda komenya agwo Tirisa.
english: When Baasha heard this, he stopped building Ramah and withdrew to Tirzah.

ekegusii: Agachia koimokia amaiso, aye, akarora Abaisraeli batoorete egesaku ase egesaku. Erio omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro asare.
english: When Balaam looked out and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe, the Spirit of God came upon him

ekegusii: Ekero Balaki aigwete ng’a Baalamu inchera are gocha, akagenda komorototera agwo Ari, omochie orenge ang’e norooche rw’Arinoni, ase orobebe rwa Moabu.
english: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the Moabite town on the Arnon border, at the edge of his territory.

ekegusii: Erio Balaki, omoruoti o Moabu, mosinto o Sipori, akaimoka kobarwania inwe Abaisraeli. Akarangeria Baalamu, mosinto o Beori, achiche kobaragereria,
english: When Balak son of Zippor, the king of Moab, prepared to fight against Israel, he sent for Balaam son of Beor to put a curse on you.

ekegusii: Barnaba na Saulo, ekero bakoorire obotomwa bwabo, bakairana korwa Yerusalemu, bakarentana Yohana ore korokwa Mariko.
english: When Barnabas and Saul had finished their mission, they returned from Jerusalem, taking with them John, also called Mark.

ekegusii: Ase ayio Batiseba akagenda ase omoruoti Sulemani akwane nere ase engencho y’Adonia. Omoruoti agatenena korotota ng’ina, agatung’ama, akamworokia amasikani; erio agaikaransa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’oboruoti, agachika ng’ina arenterwe ekerogo, na ng’ina agaikaransa ase ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kw’omoruoti.
english: When Bathsheba went to King Solomon to speak to him for Adonijah, the king stood up to meet her, bowed down to her and sat down on his throne. He had a throne brought for the king's mother, and she sat down at his right hand.

ekegusii: Bela agakwa, na Yobabu mosinto o Zera, oyo orwete Bosira, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ekero Bela akwete, Yobabu, mosinto o Zera, korwa Bosira, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Boazi kariire na konywa akaigwa buya, akagenda ang’e netui y’esairi, akarara aroro. Erio Rutu agachoba ng’ora‐ng’ora, agatubora ekiebisio korwa ase amagoro a Boazi, akarara aroro.
english: When Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went over to lie down at the far end of the grain pile. Ruth approached quietly, uncovered his feet and lay down.

ekegusii: Ekero ebirombeta bionsi bibere birabugigwe, abanto bonsi nabache na gosangererekana agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: When both are sounded, the whole community is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Omokori amabe nigo agotugutwa riarua ase engencho y’ogokora kwaye okobe, korende omonyene oboronge nigo agokwa ore nogosemeria.
english: When calamity comes, the wicked are brought down, but even in death the righteous have a refuge.

ekegusii: ee, ekero obwoba borabachere buna ekembugu‐mbugu, na emechando buna ekerambauti, boigo ekero obokong’u na omoichano birabachere.
english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster sweeps over you like a whirlwind, when distress and trouble overwhelm you.

ekegusii: Korende Kristo oikire gocha, oyore Omokuani Omonene bw’amang’ana amaya agochi‐gocha. Agaeta ase eema ere enene na eng’ikeranu kobua, etakoretwe namaboko, engencho yaye etari egetongwa gi’ense eye.
english: When Christ came as high priest of the good things that are already here, he went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not man-made, that is to say, not a part of this creation.

ekegusii: Ekero Kristo, oyore obogima bwaito, ararorekane, erio nario nainwe morarorekane amo nere ase obonene.
english: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with him in glory.

ekegusii: Barabwo nigo banga buna chindooche chiamerire amache ’obokendu abwataine, na amagena ’embura are imeo.
english: when darkened by thawing ice and swollen with melting snow,

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi na abanto baye bachete ase omochie oyio, bakanyora ng’a osambirwe, na abakungu babo amo nabamura na abaiseke babo bairirwe ase obosomba.
english: When David and his men came to Ziklag, they found it destroyed by fire and their wives and sons and daughters taken captive.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigete ekegoro igoro, ase Nyasae are gosasimerwa, Husai Omoariki agacha komorotota; eganchwa yaye nigo yatandoire, na ebuse ere ase omotwe oye.
english: When David arrived at the summit, where people used to worship God, Hushai the Arkite was there to meet him, his robe torn and dust on his head.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigete Sikilagi, agatoma ebiegwa ase abagaaka b’Abayuda abwo barenge abasani baye, akabora, “Ebiegwa ebi nebisakorwa korwa ase ababisa b’Omonene.”
english: When David arrived in Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, who were his friends, saying, "Here is a present for you from the plunder of the LORD's enemies."

ekegusii: Ekaba Daudi gaikire Mahanaimu, akanyorana na Sobi, mosinto o Nahasi, korwa Raba, ase ense y’Abaamoni, na Makiri, mosinto bw’Amieli, korwa Lo‐Debari, na Barisilai Omogileadi korwa Rogelimu.
english: When David came to Mahanaim, Shobi son of Nahash from Rabbah of the Ammonites, and Makir son of Ammiel from Lo Debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya, Saulo akamoboria, “Eri neriogi riao aye Daudi, omwana one!” Erio Saulo akarera,
english: When David finished saying this, Saul asked, "Is that your voice, David my son?" And he wept aloud.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atamire na gwetooria, akagenda ase Samweli agwo Rama, akamotebia amang’ana onsi Saulo konya amokoreire. Erio Samweli na Daudi bakagenda Nayoti, bakamenyao.
english: When David had fled and made his escape, he went to Samuel at Ramah and told him all that Saul had done to him. Then he and Samuel went to Naioth and stayed there.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi agendire ake goetania egetunwa igoro, akaumerana na Siba, omosomba o Mefiboseti, ore ne chitigere ibere chibogoretie emegati amagana abere, na amabomba ’amasabibu amomo rigana erimo, na amabomba ’amako rigana erimo, amo nekerandi ekemo keroisirie korwa ase risankwa, kere nedivai.
english: When David had gone a short distance beyond the summit, there was Ziba, the steward of Mephibosheth, waiting to meet him. He had a string of donkeys saddled and loaded with two hundred loaves of bread, a hundred cakes of raisins, a hundred cakes of figs and a skin of wine.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigwete ng’a Nabali okure, akabora, “Omonene atogigwe, ekiagera onduseirie egesiomba ase Nabali ase amabe onsi aya ere ankoreire; naende ontangire inche, omosomba oye, tinakora ebibe. Omonene oakanire obobe obwo, na kobobeka igoro ase Nabali omonyene.” Erio Daudi agatoma abanto bakwane n’Abigaeli, erinde amonyuome abe mokaye.
english: When David heard that Nabal was dead, he said, "Praise be to the LORD, who has upheld my cause against Nabal for treating me with contempt. He has kept his servant from doing wrong and has brought Nabal's wrongdoing down on his own head." Then David sent word to Abigail, asking her to become his wife.

ekegusii: Daudi agachia komanya ng’a Saulo okorire omoroberio bw’ogocha komosiria, agatebia Abiatari omokuani, “Renta egesibao ekio ki’obokuani aiga.”
english: When David learned that Saul was plotting against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod."

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi airanete inka bwoye gosesenia abanto baye, Mikali, mosubati o Saulo, agasoka korotota Daudi, akabora, “Mbonene ki omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akwenyorera rero ekero aorokirie obogetirianda bwaye ase abaiseke b’abasomba baye buna omonto omoriri.”
english: When David returned home to bless his household, Michal daughter of Saul came out to meet him and said, "How the king of Israel has distinguished himself today, disrobing in the sight of the slave girls of his servants as any vulgar fellow would!"

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aigete inka bwoye agwo Yerusalemu, akaira abakungu baye ikomi ba sere‐sere, abwo atigete bakorenda enyomba, akababeka aase baranyare korendwa, akaba okobarageria, korende tachiete koba nabarabwo. Barabwo bakaba basiekeire aase agwo ase amatuko onsi barenge moyo, bakaba bakomenya buna ababoraka.
english: When David returned to his palace in Jerusalem, he took the ten concubines he had left to take care of the palace and put them in a house under guard. He provided for them, but did not lie with them. They were kept in confinement till the day of their death, living as widows.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi aroche omomalaika oria orenge goita abanto, agatebia Omonene, “Rora, ninche inde omonyabibe, ninche nakorire obobe obo, korende ching’ondi echi chiane, inki chiakorete? Okoboko kwao tiga kobe igoro yane, na igoro y’enyomba ya tata.”
english: When David saw the angel who was striking down the people, he said to the LORD, "I am the one who has sinned and done wrong. These are but sheep. What have they done? Let your hand fall upon me and my family."

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi konya agotire mono akabeka Sulemani, omomura oye, akaba omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli.
english: When David was old and full of years, he made his son Solomon king over Israel.

ekegusii: Abasomba abwo bakarora obosooku obonene mono, na ekero Daudi atebetigwe buna bakoretwe, agatoma abanto bachie kobarotota babatebie, “Omoruoti otebire ng’a mobeere agwo Yeriko goika chinderu chiaino chimere, erio monyare koirana nka.”
english: When David was told about this, he sent messengers to meet the men, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi amo, akaamboka orooche rwa Yorodan, erio akagenda asebare, akaira abarwani baye b’esegi gochia kobarwania. Ekero Daudi aroberetie abarwani baye b’esegi korwania Abasiiria, barabwo bakamorwania.
english: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan; he advanced against them and formed his battle lines opposite them. David formed his lines to meet the Arameans in battle, and they fought against him.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe amang’ana ayio agasangereria Abaisraeli bonsi, akaamboka Yorodani, akagenda Helamu. Aroro Abasiiria bakeroberia korwania Daudi esegi.
english: When David was told of this, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan and went to Helam. The Arameans formed their battle lines to meet David and fought against him.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi atebetigwe ayio Risipa, mosubati o Aya, omokungu o sere‐sere o Saulo akorete,
english: When David was told what Aiah's daughter Rizpah, Saul's concubine, had done,

ekegusii: Abanto bagatebia Daudi, “Abafilisti nkorwania bakare omochie o Keila, na basakoire chindagera chinyia korwa ase ebiooreri.”
english: When David was told, "Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and are looting the threshing floors,"

ekegusii: Abanto bagatebia Daudi ng’a Uria tagendete bwoye. Daudi akamoboria, “Inee! Tikwarwete ase orogendo? Nase ki otagendete bwoo?”
english: When David was told, "Uriah did not go home," he asked him, "Haven't you just come from a distance? Why didn't you go home?"

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi agendete Sikilagi, abanto aba b’egesaku kia Manase bagacha asare: Adina na Yosabadi, Yediaeli na Mikaeli, Yosabadi na Elihu, na Siletai. Aba nabwo barenge abateneneri b’abanto chilifu ba Manase.
english: When David went to Ziklag, these were the men of Manasseh who defected to him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu and Zillethai, leaders of units of a thousand in Manasseh.

ekegusii: Ekero abamura abwo Daudi atomete baigete ase Nabali, bakamotebia amang’ana onsi a Daudi. Erio bakaganya.
english: When David's men arrived, they gave Nabal this message in David's name. Then they waited.

ekegusii: Kobwachia gokia, tibamanya ense eria, otatiga baroche omosomo ore nengegu, bagatebania gosoyia emeeri aroro, keranyarekane.
english: When daylight came, they did not recognize the land, but they saw a bay with a sandy beach, where they decided to run the ship aground if they could.

ekegusii: Omoiti nigo akoboa mambia chuni ng’a aite abataka na abachandegete, na ase obotuko bwekora omoibi.
english: When daylight is gone, the murderer rises up and kills the poor and needy; in the night he steals forth like a thief.

ekegusii: Ekero Delila aroche ng’a Samison omotebirie obobisi bwaye bwonsi, agatoma abanto barangerie abatang’ani b’Abafilisti, babatebie, “Inchuo naende rimo, ekiagera ere ontebirie obobisi bwaye bwonsi.” Erio abatang’ani b’Abafilisti bagacha ase omokungu oria, bakarentana chibesa chiria.
english: When Delilah saw that he had told her everything, she sent word to the rulers of the Philistines, "Come back once more; he has told me everything." So the rulers of the Philistines returned with the silver in their hands.

ekegusii: When did we see you a stranger and invite you in, or needing clothes and clothe you?
english: Indi twakoroche kore omogeni, togakoroisia, gose getirianda, togakoboyia?

ekegusii: Naende indi twakoroche kore omorwaire, gose gosibire echela, togacha gokorora?
english: When did we see you sick or in prison and go to visit you?'

ekegusii: When Eber had lived 34 years, he became the father of Peleg.
english: Ekero Eberi abeire nemiaka emerongo etato, na ene (34), akaibora Pelegi.

ekegusii: Eliabu, omomura omonene omwabo Daudi, akaigwa buna agokwana nabanto. Akaba nendamwamu enene ase Daudi, agateba, “Ninki kiagera gwachicha aa? Ning’o gwatigera riicho riria rike rie ching’ondi chikare nka aaria ase erooro? Nimanyete oboenenu bwao na obobe bore ase enkoro yao. Nigo gwacha aa korora esegi rioka.”
english: When Eliab, David's oldest brother, heard him speaking with the men, he burned with anger at him and asked, "Why have you come down here? And with whom did you leave those few sheep in the desert? I know how conceited you are and how wicked your heart is; you came down only to watch the battle."

ekegusii: Na ekero Elija aigwete eriogi riria, agatuba obosio bwaye negetambaa kiaye gi’okwambara, agasoka isiko, agatenena ase egesoero kie rikuruma riria; na agwo eriogi rigacha asare, rigakwana, rikamoboria, “Elija, ninki ogokora aiga?”
english: When Elijah heard it, he pulled his cloak over his face and went out and stood at the mouth of the cave. Then a voice said to him, "What are you doing here, Elijah?"

ekegusii: Ekero Elisha asoete nyomba, akarora omwana bwareirie igoro ase oborere bwaye okwete.
english: When Elisha reached the house, there was the boy lying dead on his couch.

ekegusii: Korende Elisha, omonto oria o Nyasae, akaigwa ng’a omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli otandoire chianga chiaye, agatoma omonto ase omoruoti amotebie, “Ninki kiagera aye gwatandora chianga chiao? Tiga omonto oyio achiche asende, erio nario aramanye ng’a omobani nare ase Abaisraeli.”
english: When Elisha the man of God heard that the king of Israel had torn his robes, he sent him this message: "Why have you torn your robes? Have the man come to me and he will know that there is a prophet in Israel."

ekegusii: Ekaba Elisabeti agachia koigwa ogokwania kwa Mariamu, omwana omoke agatuma ase enda yaye ime; Elisabeti agaichorwa n’Omoika Omochenu,
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he became the father of Methuselah.
english: Ekero Enoku abeire nemiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano (65), akaibora Metusela.

ekegusii: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he became the father of Kenan.
english: Ekero Enosu abeire nemiaka emerongo kianda (90), akaibora Kainani.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaefraimu barenge gokwana, abanto nigo barenge koiguswa; nigo beimokereretie igoro ase egati y’Abaisraeli; korende bakarenta okomocha ase ogosasima enyasae Baali, na ase ayio bagakwa.
english: When Ephraim spoke, men trembled; he was exalted in Israel. But he became guilty of Baal worship and died.

ekegusii: Ekero Esau achia koigwa amang’ana a ise, akarera ekerero ekenene mono ki’obororo, akamotebia, “Nsesenie nainche boigo, tata!”
english: When Esau heard his father's words, he burst out with a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, "Bless me-- me too, my father!"

ekegusii: Ekero Esau abeire nemiaka emerongo ene akanyuoma Yuditi, omoiseke o Beeri, Omohiti, na Basemati, omoiseke o Eloni, nere n’Omohiti.
english: When Esau was forty years old, he married Judith daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and also Basemath daughter of Elon the Hittite.

ekegusii: Ekero abaiseke abasomba b’Esteri na abakoreri b’enyomba yaye bamotebetie amang’ana igoro ya Moredekai, eke agendererete gokora, Esteri agaichana akaba nobororo obonge; agatomera Moredekai chianga ng’a arusie chigunia abeke chianga chiria, korende ere agachiaanga.
english: When Esther's maids and eunuchs came and told her about Mordecai, she was in great distress. She sent clothes for him to put on instead of his sackcloth, but he would not accept them.

ekegusii: When Esther's words were reported to Mordecai,
english: Ekero Moredekai atebetigwe amang’ana ’Esteri,

ekegusii: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,
english: Rigachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bagatirimboka gochia nyancha,

ekegusii: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
english: Riachia koba mogoroba agacha amo na baria ikomi na babere.

ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, agaikaransa ase endagera, amo naborokigwa baria ikomi na babere.
english: When evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the Twelve.

ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, bakamoirera abanto abange ababwatire nebirecha, na ere akarusia ebirecha ase ring’ana, na bonsi abarenge abarwaire akabagwenia;
english: When evening came, many who were demon-possessed were brought to him, and he drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the sick.

ekegusii: Riachia koba mogoroba, obwato bokaba enyancha gati, na ere bweka ase ense enyomo.
english: When evening came, the boat was in the middle of the lake, and he was alone on land.

ekegusii: Koriaba mogoroba akarua ase omochie.
english: When evening came, they went out of the city.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero bwaisire koira, ekero Esabato etarachaka, nigo naruete ogochika ng’a ebiita bia Yerusalemu bisiekwe, na bigenderere gosiekwa goika ekero Esabato eraere. Nkabeka abasomba baane bande korenda ase ebiita barore ng’a gurube ende terentwa ime ase omochie, ase rituko ri’Esabato.
english: When evening shadows fell on the gates of Jerusalem before the Sabbath, I ordered the doors to be shut and not opened until the Sabbath was over. I stationed some of my own men at the gates so that no load could be brought in on the Sabbath day.

ekegusii: Ebinto ebi kobiaroisigwe igo, abakuani baare gosoa ase Eema ye ritang’ani ase amatuko onsi na goikerania obokoreri bwabo,
english: When everything had been arranged like this, the priests entered regularly into the outer room to carry on their ministry.

ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakong’umokera ng’a bamere, ababisa baane abwo bangechete nigo baragochwe na kogwa.
english: When evil men advance against me to devour my flesh, when my enemies and my foes attack me, they will stumble and fall.

ekegusii: Ekero Gaali aroche abanto, agatebia Sebuli, “Rigereria, abanto bagotirimboka korwa ebitunwa igoro.” Korende Sebuli agateba, “Ebio nebiriria bi’ebitunwa kwarorire bikororekana buna abanto.”
english: When Gaal saw them, he said to Zebul, "Look, people are coming down from the tops of the mountains!" Zebul replied, "You mistake the shadows of the mountains for men."

ekegusii: Ekero baigete agwo ase ekegoro, Gehasi akabirusia korwa ase amaboko abo, akabibeka nyomba ime. Erio agatiga abanto baria bakagenda.
english: When Gehazi came to the hill, he took the things from the servants and put them away in the house. He sent the men away and they left.

ekegusii: Gidioni agachia koigwa okorota okwo, naende buna engencho y’okorota okwo yarenge, agatung’ama inse, agasasima. Erio akairana gochia ase Abaisraeli, akabatebia, “Imoka mogende! Omonene obekire ebitwori bi’abarwani b’Abamidiani ase amaboko aino.”
english: When Gideon heard the dream and its interpretation, he worshiped God. He returned to the camp of Israel and called out, "Get up! The LORD has given the Midianite camp into your hands."

ekegusii: Bono Gidioni akamanya ng’a oria nomomalaika bw’Omonene orenge, akabora, “Ani! Aye Omonene Nyasae! Narorire omomalaika oo obosio ase obosio.”
english: When Gideon realized that it was the angel of the LORD, he exclaimed, "Ah, Sovereign LORD! I have seen the angel of the LORD face to face!"

ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae aroche ayio, akaba nekeririanda, agatiga Abaisraeli kegima.
english: When God heard them, he was very angry; he rejected Israel completely.

ekegusii: Naki ekero Nyasae arierete Ibrahimu eira agatiana; na ekiagera atarenge nonde omonene komobua asare ere aranyare gotiana, agetiania ere omonyene,
english: When God made his promise to Abraham, since there was no one greater for him to swear by, he swore by himself,

ekegusii: Nyasae ekero abogetie Omosomba oye, akamotoma asemore ritang’ani, erinde abasesenie ase ogwatanana kera oyomo oino korwa ase obobe bwaye.”
english: When God raised up his servant, he sent him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways."

ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae aroche aya bakorete, buna baonchogete bagatiga ogokora kwabo kw’ebibe, ere akaonchora ebirengererio biaye, tabakorera aria konya atebire ng’a abakorere.
english: When God saw what they did and how they turned from their evil ways, he had compassion and did not bring upon them the destruction he had threatened.

ekegusii: Hadadi nere agakwa, na Samula, oyo orwete Masereka, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ekero Hadadi akwete, Samula, oyo orwete Masereka, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ase igo Hamani agasoa ime, na omoruoti akamoboria, “Ninki agwenerete akorerwe omonto oria inche omoruoti nanchire gosika?” Hamani akarengereria ase omoyo oye ime, “Ning’o omoruoti anchete gosika kobua inche?”
english: When Haman entered, the king asked him, "What should be done for the man the king delights to honor?" Now Haman thought to himself, "Who is there that the king would rather honor than me?"

ekegusii: Hamani akaba nendamwamu enene mono ekero aroche ng’a Moredekai tarenge gotung’ama ase okomosasima.
english: When Haman saw that Mordecai would not kneel down or pay him honor, he was enraged.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bamoroche, bakarangeria abagisangio emerongo etato koba amo nere.
english: When he appeared, he was given thirty companions.

ekegusii: Ere, ekero achia goika na korora buna obuya bwa Nyasae bwakorire, akagoka, agasorora bonsi babe abegenwa ase Omonene ase okogania gwe chinkoro.
english: When he arrived and saw the evidence of the grace of God, he was glad and encouraged them all to remain true to the Lord with all their hearts.

ekegusii: Agachia goika nyomba, tancha monto onde asoe amo nere otatiga Petero, na Yohana, na Yakobo, na ise na ng’ina b’omwana oria.
english: When he arrived at the house of Jairus, he did not let anyone go in with him except Peter, John and James, and the child's father and mother.

ekegusii: Ekero achia goika ng’umbu y’ense y’Abageraseni, abanto babere ababwatire nebirecha bakaumerana nere, na barabwo nigo baare korwa ase chimbeera, nigo barenge abatindi mono, goika monto onde tarenge konyara goeta enchera eria.
english: When he arrived at the other side in the region of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men coming from the tombs met him. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.

ekegusii: Nabo ekero achia goika Galili, Abagalili bakamoroisia, ekiagera baroche amang’ana onsi ayakorete Yerusalemu ekero kie rituko rinene; naki nabarabwo boigo mbagendete ase rituko rinene.
english: When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Feast, for they also had been there.

ekegusii: Ekero aigete aroro, akabugia egetureri gi’esegi ase ense y’ebitunwa y’Efraimu. Erio Abaisraeli bagatirimboka korwa ase ebitunwa bakamobwatia, nere akaba omotang’ani obo.
english: When he arrived there, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites went down with him from the hills, with him leading them.

ekegusii: Ekero aigete aroro akanyora abatang’ani b’abarwani esegi baikaransete kogamba, agateba, “Omonene, nimbwate amang’ana narentire asore.” Yehu akamoboria, “Nase ng’o ase egati ya intwe twensi obwate amang’ana?” Omobani oria akairaneria, “Nasore aye omochiki.”
english: When he arrived, he found the army officers sitting together. "I have a message for you, commander," he said. "For which of us?" asked Jehu. "For you, commander," he replied.

ekegusii: Ekero achete ase omoruoti, omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Mikaya, nkogenda tore korwania Ramoti o Gileadi, gose totige?” Nere akamoiraneria, “Genda, obue! Omonene nabeke Ramoti o Gileadi ase okoboko kwao aye omoruoti.”
english: When he arrived, the king asked him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" "Attack and be victorious," he answered, "for the LORD will give it into the king's hand."

ekegusii: Ekero achete ase omoruoti, omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Mikaya, nkogenda tore korwania Ramoti o Gileadi, gose totige?” Ere akamoiraneria, “Genda, obue! Abanto baria nababekwe ase amaboko aino.”
english: When he arrived, the king asked him, "Micaiah, shall we go to war against Ramoth Gilead, or shall I refrain?" "Attack and be victorious," he answered, "for they will be given into your hand."

ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria aigeteo, Eli nigo arenge oikaransete ase ekerogo kiaye agwo enchera ensemo otengerete, ekiagera nigo arenge nobwoba ase engencho y’Esanduku eria ya Nyasae. Na ekero omonto oria arentete amang’ana ayio akorekire, abanto bonsi b’omochie bakarera mono.
english: When he arrived, there was Eli sitting on his chair by the side of the road, watching, because his heart feared for the ark of God. When the man entered the town and told what had happened, the whole town sent up a cry.

ekegusii: Agacha naende, akabanyora bararire; ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito.
english: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.

ekegusii: Naende akagenda akabanyora bararire, ekiagera amaiso abo abeire amarito, gose tibamanya eri bakomoiraneria.
english: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy. They did not know what to say to him.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa igoro, emeganda emenge ekamotunyana.
english: When he came down from the mountainside, large crowds followed him.

ekegusii: Ekero Mefiboseti achete korwa Yerusalemu gochia korotota omoruoti, omoruoti akamoboria, “Mefiboseti, naki otagendete amo nainche?”
english: When he came from Jerusalem to meet the king, the king asked him, "Why didn't you go with me, Mephibosheth?"

ekegusii: Ekero aigete ang’e nengoro eria ase Danieli arutetwe, akarangeria neriogi ri’omoichano, akaboria Danieli, “Aye Danieli, omosomba o Nyasae ore moyo, Inee, Nyasae oo, oria ogokorera botambe, ogotooririe korwa ase chindo?”
english: When he came near the den, he called to Daniel in an anguished voice, "Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you serve continually, been able to rescue you from the lions?"

ekegusii: Agachia goika egetirimboko ki’egetunwa ki’Emezeituni, omoganda bwonsi bw’aborokigwa baye bagachaka kogoka na komobaka Nyasae ase eriogi rinene ase ebikone bie chinguru bionsi barorire,
english: When he came near the place where the road goes down the Mount of Olives, the whole crowd of disciples began joyfully to praise God in loud voices for all the miracles they had seen:

ekegusii: Goika ekero achia gosoka, tanyara gokwana nabarabwo; bakamanya ng’a nigo arora okorora aria Hekalu ime. Ere nigo arenge kobateberia nokoboko, akagenderera koba rimama.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They realized he had seen a vision in the temple, for he kept making signs to them but remained unable to speak.

ekegusii: Ekero achia goika Yerusalemu agateema kobwatana naborokigwa; na barabwo bonsi bakamoiroka, ekiagera tibanchete ng’a ere nomworokigwa arenge.
english: When he came to Jerusalem, he tried to join the disciples, but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he really was a disciple.

ekegusii: When he caught up with them, he repeated these words to them.
english: Ekero abaikerete agakwana nabarabwo amang’ana aria aria.

ekegusii: Naende ekero arache ere, naenekerie ense ase amang’ana ’ebibe, naende oboronge, naende ekina;
english: When he comes, he will convict the world of guilt in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment:

ekegusii: Ere akanywa edivai; erio agatinda, akarara ore getirianda ase eema yaye ime.
english: When he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and lay uncovered inside his tent.

ekegusii: Ekero abegete igoro ekabao, na ekero abegete chinsoko chigosokia amache korwa ase chindiba ne chinguru,
english: when he established the clouds above and fixed securely the fountains of the deep,

ekegusii: Ekero Nyasae arengete chinguru chi’omwaga, na akarenga obonge bw’amache,
english: When he established the force of the wind and measured out the waters,

ekegusii: Ekero akwanire amang’ana aya agatuguta riuga riria ri’orosea. Aase aria akarokwa Ramati Lei.
english: When he finished speaking, he threw away the jawbone; and the place was called Ramath Lehi.

ekegusii: Ere agachia korora eruru eyemo ye rigori rinene, akaimoka akagenda, akaoonia ebiabwate bionsi, akayegora.
english: When he found one of great value, he went away and sold everything he had and bought it.

ekegusii: na ekero abekerete chinyancha chimbebe, amache tabaisa goetania ogochika kwaye; na ekero abegete amaroso ’ense nao narenge.
english: when he gave the sea its boundary so the waters would not overstep his command, and when he marked out the foundations of the earth.

ekegusii: When he had called together all the people's chief priests and teachers of the law, he asked them where the Christ was to be born.
english: Erio kabasangereirie abakuani abanene na aborokia b’amariko, akababoria, “Ng’ai Kristo agocha koiborerwa?”

ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria konya akoorire korenga aase e Hekalu a ime, agansokia isiko goetera ase egeita kiarenge ensemo ya moocha, erio akarenga aase onsi aetanaine Hekalu.
english: When he had finished measuring what was inside the temple area, he led me out by the east gate and measured the area all around:

ekegusii: Yeso gakwanire amang’ana aya, akaimoka amo naborokigwa baye kogenda ng’umbu y’akarooche Kedron, aase omogondo orenge. Ere na aborokigwa baye bagasoa aroro.
english: When he had finished praying, Jesus left with his disciples and crossed the Kidron Valley. On the other side there was an olive grove, and he and his disciples went into it.

ekegusii: Nyasae ekero akoorire gokwana na Ibrahimu, akairana korwa asare, akagenda.
english: When he had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.

ekegusii: Goika agachia gokoora ogokwana kwaye, agatebia Simion, “Sukia obwato goika endiba, moikie ebionga biaino ase okoruba.”
english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, "Put out into deep water, and let down the nets for a catch."

ekegusii: Nabo agachia gokoora kobasibia amagoro abo na kobogoria chianga chiaye, agaikaransa naende, akabatebia, “Mwamanyire eki nabakorera?
english: When he had finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and returned to his place. "Do you understand what I have done for you?" he asked them.

ekegusii: Akagenderera bosio ake, akarora Yakobo, omwana o Zebedi, na Yohana momura omwabo; barabwo nigo barenge obwato ime bakoroisia ebionga biabo.
english: When he had gone a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, preparing their nets.

ekegusii: Yeso agachia gosoa nyomba, baria barenge emeuko bakamochiera. Yeso akababoria, “Inee! Mwegenire ng’a inche ninyare gokora ring’ana eri?” Bakamotebia, “Ee, Omonene.”
english: When he had gone indoors, the blind men came to him, and he asked them, "Do you believe that I am able to do this?" "Yes, Lord," they replied.

ekegusii: Akabatang’ana gochia isiko goika Bethania; akaimokia amaboko aye, akabasesenia.
english: When he had led them out to the vicinity of Bethany, he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

ekegusii: Akababekera amaboko aye, akaimoka korwa aroro, akagenda.
english: When he had placed his hands on them, he went on from there.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia konyora chinkama, agateba, “Yaikeranire!” Agatureka omotwe, agatweka mo.
english: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, "It is finished." With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

ekegusii: When he had said this, he knelt down with all of them and prayed.
english: Gakoorire gokwana aya agatung’ama inse, agasaba amo nabarabwo bonsi.

ekegusii: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and feet.
english: Ekero akoorire gokwana aya akaborokia amaboko aye na amagoro aye.]

ekegusii: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, "Lazarus, come out!"
english: Ekero akwanire igo, agaaka eriogi rinene, “Lazaro, soka isiko!”

ekegusii: Gakorusia isiko ching’ondi echire echiaye, nigo agochitang’ana, ne ching’ondi nigo chikomotunyana, ekiagera nchimanyete eriogi riaye.
english: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.

ekegusii: Gaki ebinto bionsi kobiabekirwe inse asare, erio agwo Omwana omonyene nere nabekwe inse ase Nyasae, oyo obegete ebinto bionsi inse asare, erinde Nyasae abe nokobua ase bionsi.
english: When he has done this, then the Son himself will be made subject to him who put everything under him, so that God may be all in all.

ekegusii: Nebe ng’a ekero aisire koigota, Nyasae namotomere ekeririanda gi’okogechigwa kwaye; egesusuro ekio nigo keramochere ekero agendererete koragera.
english: When he has filled his belly, God will vent his burning anger against him and rain down his blows upon him.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio ekero akoorire koroisia riroba, Inee, tari kobusura obotu bw’ebinsari bikorokwa dili na komini; naende obusura engano ase chindwaro, na esairi aase aye, na engano ende ase chingito?
english: When he has leveled the surface, does he not sow caraway and scatter cummin? Does he not plant wheat in its place, barley in its plot, and spelt in its field?

ekegusii: na ekero aigwa ng’a nakuurire neriogi rinene, ontigera eanga yaye koboko kwane, otama gochia isiko.”
english: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."

ekegusii: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!"
english: Agachia koigwa ng’a nere Yeso Omonazareti, agachaka goaka eriogi, na goteba, “Yeso, omwana o Daudi, indorera amabera!”

ekegusii: When he heard the crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
english: Agachia koigwa omoganda ogoeta, akaboria, “Inki ekio?”

ekegusii: Korende ekero achia koigwa aya akaba nomoichano, ekiagera arenge omonda mono.
english: When he heard this, he became very sad, because he was a man of great wealth.

ekegusii: Yeso agachia koyaigwa, akabora, “Oborwaire obwo tari obw’amakweri, korende ase okoorokia obonene bwa Nyasae, erinde Omwana o Nyasae abakwe ase obwo.”
english: When he heard this, Jesus said, "This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for God's glory so that God's Son may be glorified through it."

ekegusii: Ekero abete ogotebana, abanto abwo bakamobwata okoboko, bakabwata na mokaye na abaiseke baye, ekiagera Omonene amororerete amabera, akamosokia isiko y’omochie.
english: When he hesitated, the men grasped his hand and the hands of his wife and of his two daughters and led them safely out of the city, for the LORD was merciful to them.

ekegusii: Erio akababoria amang’ana ensa achagete koba buya. Bakamotebia, “Nigoro, chinsa isano na ibere esosera yamotigete.”
english: When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, "The fever left him yesterday at the seventh hour."

ekegusii: Nigo nkomorigeria ensemo y’okobee, korende tindi komorora; naonchoka gochia ase ensemo y’okorio, korende tindi komorora.
english: When he is at work in the north, I do not see him; when he turns to the south, I catch no glimpse of him.

ekegusii: agwo ekero ebibe biria akorete birabe biamanyekanire asare, arente egoree etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso kiaye.
english: When he is made aware of the sin he committed, he must bring as his offering a male goat without defect.

ekegusii: agwo ekero ebibe bi’omonto oria birabe biamanyekanire asare arente embori eaberi etari na kemocho ase omobere oye, ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe biaye.
english: When he is made aware of the sin he committed, he must bring as his offering for the sin he committed a female goat without defect.

ekegusii: Ekero agambigwe ekina, tiga abarerwe okomocha, nonya nogosaba kwaye kobarwe ng’a nebibe.
english: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayers condemn him.

ekegusii: Gaikire Kaisaria, agatiira gochia gokwania abanto b’ekanisa. Erio agatirimboka gochia Antiokia.
english: When he landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the church and then went down to Antioch.

ekegusii: When he learned from the centurion that it was so, he gave the body to Joseph.
english: Goika agachia konyora ekeene ng’a okure, akaa Yusufu omobere.

ekegusii: Agachia komanya ng’a nigo are inse ase obogambi bwa Herode, akamotoma gochia ase Herode. Na Herode omonyene nigo arenge Yerusalemu ase amatuko aria.
english: When he learned that Jesus was under Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem at that time.

ekegusii: Ekero ararire, origererie omanye aase aria. Erio ogende aroro, otubore ekiebisio kiaye korwa ase amagoro aye maate, orareo nere nagotebie aya ogwenerete gokora.”
english: When he lies down, note the place where he is lying. Then go and uncover his feet and lie down. He will tell you what to do."

ekegusii: Omogaaka oria akarora omogendi oria ase eraaro eria, akamoboria, “Ng’ai okorwa? Naende ng’ai okogenda?”
english: When he looked and saw the traveler in the city square, the old man asked, "Where are you going? Where did you come from?"

ekegusii: Na ere oyondoche inche nigo aroche ere oyontomete.
english: When he looks at me, he sees the one who sent me.

ekegusii: ekero abegete ogochika ase embura, na akaroisia enchera y’okomesa gw’enkoba,
english: when he made a decree for the rain and a path for the thunderstorm,

ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria atorete Esanduku eria ya Nyasae, Eli akagwa gochia magega korwa ase ekerogo, agwo ase egeita ensemo, akabuneka ebigoti agakwa, ekiagera konya ogotire mono, naende nigo arenge omorito. Ere konya ogambeire Abaisraeli ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
english: When he mentioned the ark of God, Eli fell backward off his chair by the side of the gate. His neck was broken and he died, for he was an old man and heavy. He had led Israel forty years.

ekegusii: Ekero achia gotoikeera aaria Asosi, tokamosoyia ase emeeri, togaika Metilene.
english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and went on to Mitylene.

ekegusii: When he noticed how the guests picked the places of honor at the table, he told them this parable:
english: Agatebia baria barangeretigwe omoreng’anio, gachia korora buna bachorire ebirogo bie ritang’ani, akabatebia,

ekegusii: Na igo ekaigora ekeronga ki’eora eria, na erioki rigasoka korwa ase ekeronga keria buna erioki ri’eriko rinene, na erioba na omoika bikabekwa omosunte nerioki riria riarwete ase ekeronga keria.
english: When he opened the Abyss, smoke rose from it like the smoke from a gigantic furnace. The sun and sky were darkened by the smoke from the Abyss.

ekegusii: Ekero achia gosansora ekemanyererio kia gatano, nkarora inse y’egesasimero emeika y’abwo baitetwe ekiagera barenge koraria ring’ana ria Nyasae, na koba abegenwa ase oborori bwabo.
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been slain because of the word of God and the testimony they had maintained.

ekegusii: Ekero Emanwa y’Eng’ondi achia gosansora ekemanyererio kia gatano na kabere, obotoereru bokaba igoro ase engaki koreng’ana nekeng’ese gi’ensa.
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

ekegusii: “Rora! Ere nigo akong’ika ang’e oeta, tinkomorora; nigo akong’etania, tinkomomanyereria.
english: When he passes me, I cannot see him; when he goes by, I cannot perceive him.

ekegusii: Agaika aase gete, akarara agwo botuko, ekiagera erioba konya riagure. Akabogoria rigena erimo ri’aase aria, akarara, agatoorera omotwe oye ase rigena riria.
english: When he reached a certain place, he stopped for the night because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones there, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.

ekegusii: Na ekero aigete inka bwoye, akaimokia omoyio, akabwata omokungu oye o sere‐sere, akamonachana ekiimo ase ekiimo goika ebing’ese ikomi na bibere. Erio agatoma abanto, nabarabwo bakabiira chinsemo chionsi ase ense y’Abaisraeli.
english: When he reached home, he took a knife and cut up his concubine, limb by limb, into twelve parts and sent them into all the areas of Israel.

ekegusii: Omomura oria akairania chisekeli chiria chie chifeta amagana ikomi na rimo ase ng’ina. Ng’ina agateba, “Naatananire chifeta echi ase Omonene ase engencho y’omwana one. Chifeta echio nachibe echi’okoroisia omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa orabe obaachire na oomire ne chifeta. Ase ayio, omwana one, ningochiiranerie.”
english: When he returned the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, she said, "I solemnly consecrate my silver to the LORD for my son to make a carved image and a cast idol. I will give it back to you."

ekegusii: When he returned, he said to his father and mother, "I have seen a Philistine woman in Timnah; now get her for me as my wife."
english: Erio akairana nka, akamotebia ise na ng’ina, “Narora omoiseke oyomo Omofilisti agwo Timuna bono monyorere oria, imonyuome abe mokane.”

ekegusii: Ekero ekoimoka gotenena, abanto chituoni nigo bakwoboa mono; ekero ekorindoka gocha nigo bagotang’ang’a.
english: When he rises up, the mighty are terrified; they retreat before his thrashing.

ekegusii: Agachia koimoka korwa ase ogosaba agachiera aborokigwa baye, akabanyora bararire ase ogoichana.
english: When he rose from prayer and went back to the disciples, he found them asleep, exhausted from sorrow.

ekegusii: When he said this, a dispute broke out between the Pharisees and the Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.
english: Erio gakwanire aya, ogwatananekana gokaba egati y’Abafarisai na Abasadukai, na omosangererekano ogaatananekana.

ekegusii: Naende ekero are gokwana aya, abanto bonsi abare koamererania nere bagasookigwa. Abanto bonsi bakagoka ase engencho y’amang’ana onsi amanene akorire.
english: When he said this, all his opponents were humiliated, but the people were delighted with all the wonderful things he was doing.

ekegusii: Ekero Ahabu aroche Elija, akamoboria, “Inee! Naye oyo gwachandire Abaisraeli?”
english: When he saw Elijah, he said to him, "Is that you, you troubler of Israel?"

ekegusii: Ekero Yefta aroche omoiseke oria, agatandora chianga chiaye, akarera, “Obee! Omoiseke one! Kwagerire enkoro yane yairianyekire. Naende kwandeteire emechando emenene. Inche narierete Omonene eira, ngatiana, na tinkonyara gotiga eira eria nariete.”
english: When he saw her, he tore his clothes and cried, "Oh! My daughter! You have made me miserable and wretched, because I have made a vow to the LORD that I cannot break."

ekegusii: Agachia korora Yeso korwa are, akaminyoka chimbero, akamosasima;
english: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.

ekegusii: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, "Look, the Lamb of God!"
english: Akarigereria Yesu ogotaara, akabora, “Rora, Emanwa y’Eng’ondi ya Nyasae!”

ekegusii: Agachia korora Yeso, agaaka egeturi, akagwa ase obosio bwaye, agakwana neriogi rinene, okobora, “Inaki inde naye, Yeso, Omwana o Nyasae ore Igoro Mono? Nagosabire, tonchanda.”
english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell at his feet, shouting at the top of his voice, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don't torture me!"

ekegusii: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he asked them for money.
english: Agachia korora Petero na Yohana kobagosoa Hekalu ime, agasaba bamoe ebiegwa.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti aroche Esteri eting’ana oteneine ase egoora, Esteri akanyora ogwancherwa asare. Omoruoti akamworotera enyimbo yaye y’oboruoti eroisirie korwa ase etahabu, arenge nero koboko. Erio Esteri akagenda gochia ang’e, agakuna mesia y’enyimbo eria,
english: When he saw Queen Esther standing in the court, he was pleased with her and held out to her the gold scepter that was in his hand. So Esther approached and touched the tip of the scepter.

ekegusii: Ekero aroche ng’a aya agweneire Abayahudi, akagenderera, akabwata Petero nere. Amatuko ayio naro amatuko emegati etabekiri memera.
english: When he saw that this pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This happened during the Feast of Unleavened Bread.

ekegusii: Agachia korora emeganda y’abanto, akabarorera amabeebe, ekiagera konya bachandekire, baserebekanire buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia.
english: When he saw the crowds, he had compassion on them, because they were harassed and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.

ekegusii: Agachia kobarora, akabatebia, “Genda mweorokie ase abakuani.” Kobakogenda bagasibeka.
english: When he saw them, he said, "Go, show yourselves to the priests." And as they went, they were cleansed.

ekegusii: Musa agakumia ase okorora koria, na ekero achia goika ang’e gokorora, eriogi ri’Omonene rikamochera, rigateba:
english: When he saw this, he was amazed at the sight. As he went over to look more closely, he heard the Lord's voice:

ekegusii: Omonto oyio kararore abariini chibarasi bagocha babere babere, na abariini chitigere, na abe chingamia, tiga ategerere mono, ee, ategerere buya kegima.”
english: When he sees chariots with teams of horses, riders on donkeys or riders on camels, let him be alert, fully alert."

ekegusii: Akarora ng’a aase agotimokera naagiya, na ense eria nero ekomogwenera. Ase igo agekumba abogorie egurube, akerua kogenderera nemeremo emekong’u.
english: When he sees how good is his resting place and how pleasant is his land, he will bend his shoulder to the burden and submit to forced labor.

ekegusii: Ee, amaene ere naagete egetare na amache agacharara korwao, ne chindooche chi’amache amange chikarwao, korende, Inee, nanyare boigo koa intwe abanto baye endagera? Nanyare gotoa na enyama torie?”
english: When he struck the rock, water gushed out, and streams flowed abundantly. But can he also give us food? Can he supply meat for his people?"

ekegusii: Ekero aikaransire ase ekerogo ki’obonene ase oboruoti bwaye, ’arente ebuku y’amachiko korwa ase abakuani Abalawi, naende arike amang’ana ayio ayio ase ebuku ende.
english: When he takes the throne of his kingdom, he is to write for himself on a scroll a copy of this law, taken from that of the priests, who are Levites.

ekegusii: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimea, David's brother, killed him.
english: Ere akarama Abaisraeli, na Yonathani, omomura o Simea omwabo Daudi, akamoita.

ekegusii: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimeah, David's brother, killed him.
english: Ere akarama Abaisraeli, na Yonathani, momura o Simea omwabo Daudi, akamoita.

ekegusii: Ase eriogi riaye amache are igoro chionsi akoeera neriogi, nigo akorenta ritaturi korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Nere okorenta chinkoba chire nembura, na omwaga ogusa korwa ase ebigancha biaye.
english: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

ekegusii: Ekero agokwana neriogi riaye, amache are igoro nigo akoruma. Nigo agokora ritaturi riaimokerera igoro korwa ase chinsinyo chi’ense. Nigo akomesia na korenta embura, naende orenta omwaga ogusa korwa ase ebigachero biaye.
english: When he thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; he makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth. He sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

ekegusii: ekero omonto akorire ebibe buna ebio na obeire nokomocha, nairanie egento keria airete ase obourereria, gose ase okorega, gose egento aetwe korenda, gose egento giasirete agakenyora,
english: when he thus sins and becomes guilty, he must return what he has stolen or taken by extortion, or what was entrusted to him, or the lost property he found,

ekegusii: Korende ekero atebetie ise na bamura bamwabo amang’ana ayio, ise akamotogonyera, akamoboria, “Nkorota ki okwo okorota? Inee! Inche na nyoko, na bamura bamino, amaene, nigo torache togotung’amere togosasime aye?”
english: When he told his father as well as his brothers, his father rebuked him and said, "What is this dream you had? Will your mother and I and your brothers actually come and bow down to the ground before you?"

ekegusii: Ekero ataboranete Abaisraeli korwa ase enyomba ya Daudi, barabwo bakabeka Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati akaba omoruoti obo. Yeroboamu akang’usa Abaisraeli bagatiga gotunyana Omonene, akagera bagakora ebibe ebinene mono.
english: When he tore Israel away from the house of David, they made Jeroboam son of Nebat their king. Jeroboam enticed Israel away from following the LORD and caused them to commit a great sin.

ekegusii: When he turned around and saw me, he called out to me, and I said, 'What can I do?'
english: Agachia korigereria nyuma, akandora, akandangeria, na inche ngaitaba: Nao inde aa.

ekegusii: Korende ochia gosoerwa nabakuaani abanene na abagaaka, tairaneria ing’ana rinde.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.

ekegusii: Ekero arenge bweka, abanto baria bamoetanaine amo nabaria ikomi na babere bakamoboria amang’ana ’emereng’anio eria.
english: When he was alone, the Twelve and the others around him asked him about the parables.

ekegusii: When he was at the table with them, he took bread, gave thanks, broke it and began to give it to them.
english: Ekero aikaransire amo nabarabwo koragera, akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akabaa.

ekegusii: Erio oyio gasokire, Yeso akabora, “Bono Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto obakirwe, na Nyasae obakirwe ime yaye.
english: When he was gone, Jesus said, "Now is the Son of Man glorified and God is glorified in him.

ekegusii: When he was placed outside, Pharaoh's daughter took him and brought him up as her own son.
english: Ekero achia gotugutwa, omoiseke o Farao akamoira, ’akamotuga na komorera buna omwana oye.

ekegusii: Goika agachia koba nemiaka ikomi na ebere, bagatiira kogenda aroro, buna yarenge engencho ye Rituko Rinene.
english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to the Feast, according to the custom.

ekegusii: Ekero rituko ri’okobariera omwando riraike, omonto oria takoba ne ribaga gwanchereria omomura oye bw’omokungu oria anchete, na komoa omwando bw’okoiborwa kw’obotangi ribaga ri’okomoa oria ore omotangi bori aiboreretwe nomokungu atancheti.
english: when he wills his property to his sons, he must not give the rights of the firstborn to the son of the wife he loves in preference to his actual firstborn, the son of the wife he does not love.

ekegusii: Erio kangire amang’ana aito togakira togateba, “Ogwancha kw’Omonene tiga gokoreke.”
english: When he would not be dissuaded, we gave up and said, "The Lord's will be done."

ekegusii: Omosacha oye akaimoka mambia, akaigora ebisieri, na ekero are gosoka agenderere orogendo rwaye, akanyora omokungu oye o sere‐sere oraire obwatete omoriibo o inse bw’egesieri ki’enyomba.
english: When her master got up in the morning and opened the door of the house and stepped out to continue on his way, there lay his concubine, fallen in the doorway of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

ekegusii: Ekero Herode achia korora ng’a ochayirwe nabanto baria abang’ani, akaba nekeririanda ekenene mono, agatoma abanto goita abana abaisia bonsi abarenge Bethlehemu ne chinsemo chiaye chionsi, abakoorire emiaka ebere na abatarakoora emiaka ebere, koreng’ana nekero keria atebetigwe nabanto baria abang’aini.
english: When Herod realized that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was furious, and he gave orders to kill all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, in accordance with the time he had learned from the Magi.

ekegusii: Ekero Herode achia korora Yeso akagokigwa mono, ekiagera korwa kare nigo arigetie komorora, ekiagera aigwete chinkuma chiaye, naende nigo asemeretie korora egekone kegokorwa nere.
english: When Herod saw Jesus, he was greatly pleased, because for a long time he had been wanting to see him. From what he had heard about him, he hoped to see him perform some miracle.

ekegusii: Ekero Hezekia amo nabagambi barenge ase oboruoti bwaye bachete bakarora chitui chiria, bagatogia Omonene na Abaisraeli, abanto baye.
english: When Hezekiah and his officials came and saw the heaps, they praised the LORD and blessed his people Israel.

ekegusii: Ekero Hezekia aroche ng’a Senakeribu ochire oganetie korwania Yerusalemu,
english: When Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come and that he intended to make war on Jerusalem,

ekegusii: Inee! Hezekia tari kobasiria na kobatiga mokwe motari nendagera na ebinyugwa ekero akobatebia: Omonene, Nyasae oito, natotoorie korwa ase okoboko kw’omoruoti bw’Abaasuri?
english: When Hezekiah says, 'The LORD our God will save us from the hand of the king of Assyria,' he is misleading you, to let you die of hunger and thirst.

ekegusii: Ekero Hiramu aigwete amang’ana a Sulemani, akaba nomogoko omonene, akabora, “Omonene atogigwe rituko ria rero, oyo oeire Daudi omwana omomura omong’aini agambere abanto aba abange.”
english: When Hiram heard Solomon's message, he was greatly pleased and said, "Praise be to the LORD today, for he has given David a wise son to rule over this great nation."

ekegusii: Hiramu, omoruoti o Turo ekero aigwete ng’a Sulemani oakirwe amaguta na obeire omoruoti ribaga ria ise, agatoma abasomba baye asare, ekiagera Hiramu botambe igo anchete Daudi.
english: When Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king to succeed his father David, he sent his envoys to Solomon, because he had always been on friendly terms with David.

ekegusii: Na baria abamosoeri ekero batenenete, tibamosoera ase ing’ana riibe, buna nakagete,
english: When his accusers got up to speak, they did not charge him with any of the crimes I had expected.

ekegusii: Abamwabo ekero baroche ng’a ise nigo amwanchete ere kobua abamwabo bonsi, barabwo bakamogecha, tibare gokwana amang’ana amaya nere.
english: When his brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.

ekegusii: Abaamate baye bagachia koigwa amang’ana aya, bagasoka kogenda komobwata, ekiagera batebete, “Obakirwe neosi.”
english: When his family heard about this, they went to take charge of him, for they said, "He is out of his mind."

ekegusii: Ekero ise biara Musa aroche onsi aya Musa are gokorera abanto, akamoboria. “Inki eke ogokorera abanto? Naki oikaransete aye bweka, na abanto bagoetanaine korwa mambia goika mogoroba?”
english: When his father-in-law saw all that Moses was doing for the people, he said, "What is this you are doing for the people? Why do you alone sit as judge, while all these people stand around you from morning till evening?"

ekegusii: Engaki eria etaya yaye yarenge komorekera omotwe one, na ase oborabu bwaye nkaba ngotaara ase omosunte.
english: when his lamp shone upon my head and by his light I walked through darkness!

ekegusii: Ekero omonene o Yusufu achia koigwa aya mokaye amotebirie ng’a, “Aya naro omosomba oo ankorera”, akaba nekeririanda ekenene.
english: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, "This is how your slave treated me," he burned with anger.

ekegusii: Ere nigo aroche ng’a Omonene nigo arenge amo na Yusufu, ogerire ebinto bionsi biasesenigwe ase amaboko aye.
english: When his master saw that the LORD was with him and that the LORD gave him success in everything he did,

ekegusii: When his parents saw him, they were astonished. His mother said to him, "Son, why have you treated us like this? Your father and I have been anxiously searching for you."
english: Abaibori baye bagachia komorora bagaichana mono. Ng’ina akamotebia, “Omwana one, naki gwatokorire iga? Rora, iso na inche twarenge gokorigia nomoichano.”

ekegusii: Ekero Isaka akoorire amatuko atano na atato, Ibrahimu akamosara, buna Nyasae konya amochikire.
english: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God commanded him.

ekegusii: Naende amatuko aye ay’ogokora emeremo agachia koera, akagenda bwoye.
english: When his time of service was completed, he returned home.

ekegusii: Na ekero Husai achete ase Abisalomu, Abisalomu akamotebia, “Aya naro Ahitofeli atosemirie. Naro tokobwatia gose? Onye taibo, aye totebie aya togokora.”
english: When Hushai came to him, Absalom said, "Ahithophel has given this advice. Should we do what he says? If not, give us your opinion."

ekegusii: Husamu nere agakwa, na Hadadi, mosinto o Bedadi, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye; oyo nere obuete Abamidiani, ase ense ya Moabu na omochie oye nigo ore korokwa Aviti.
english: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.

ekegusii: Ekero Husamu akwete, Hadadi, mosinto o Bedadi, oria obuete Abamidiani ase ense ya Moabu, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye; na omochie oye noro Awiti.
english: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.

ekegusii: Ekero inde nobwoba, nigo ngosemeretie.
english: When I am afraid, I will trust in you.

ekegusii: Ekero inche amo nabanto bonsi tore komo torabugie ebitureri, nainwe mobugie ebitureri biaino ase chinsemo chionsi chi’egetwori, erio moake eriogi rinene, motebe: Ase Omonene na ase Gidioni!”
english: When I and all who are with me blow our trumpets, then from all around the camp blow yours and shout, 'For the LORD and for Gideon.'"

ekegusii: Ekero nabegete ebirengererio biane komanya obong’aini na korora emeremo emekong’u abanto bagokora aiga ase ense, batari korara chitoro omobaso gose obotuko.
english: When I applied my mind to know wisdom and to observe man's labor on earth-- his eyes not seeing sleep day or night--

ekegusii: Ekero nare goeta ase engegu eyio nkarora emete emenge ase chingegu chi’orooche orwo ase chinsemo chionsi.
english: When I arrived there, I saw a great number of trees on each side of the river.

ekegusii: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?" "Twelve," they replied.
english: Ekero nasamunyorete emegati eria etano nkaa baria chilifu isano, ebitonga mbirenga mwasangererete biichire ebisamunye?” Bakamotebia, “Ikomi na bibere.”

ekegusii: Nkabarenta ase ense eyio nabarierete eira ng’a nimbayee. Na aase aande onsi baroche aimokererete igoro, gose emete yabwate chinsagia chinyinge, nao barenge koruera ebing’wanso biabo na okoruegwa konde, ebio biarenge okogechia asende. Aroro agwo bakaruera ebing’wanso bire ne rimisu rigiya, na bakaumora okoruegwa kwabo kw’ebinyugwa.
english: When I brought them into the land I had sworn to give them and they saw any high hill or any leafy tree, there they offered their sacrifices, made offerings that provoked me to anger, presented their fragrant incense and poured out their drink offerings.

ekegusii: Nkarusia chisokoro chiaino korwa Misiri, mogaika ase Enyancha Embariri, Abamisiri bakababwatia goikao ne chigari ne chibarasi.
english: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt, you came to the sea, and the Egyptians pursued them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea.

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria nakorangeretie, nigo kwanyigwete, okaremia omoyo one, okambeka chinguru.
english: When I called, you answered me; you made me bold and stouthearted.

ekegusii: Inche, ekero nachete asemore, baminto, tinachete kobaranderia oborori bwa Nyasae ase enchera y’obuya bwe chinkwana, gose ase obong’aini.
english: When I came to you, brothers, I did not come with eloquence or superior wisdom as I proclaimed to you the testimony about God.

ekegusii: “Nase ki ntanyorete nonya nomonto oyomo ekero nachete? Nase ki nonya nomonto oyomo atanyitaberete ekero narangeretie? Inee! Okoboko kwane nigo kweng’eire gotanyare kobooria? Gose inche nigo naborirwe chinguru chi’ogotooria? Naama! Ekero ngotogonyera enyancha, amache nigo agosira; nigo ngokora chindooche chiaba erooro; chinswe chireo nigo chikoborwa amache, chiakwa chiagunda.
