english: When I came, why was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Was my arm too short to ransom you? Do I lack the strength to rescue you? By a mere rebuke I dry up the sea, I turn rivers into a desert; their fish rot for lack of water and die of thirst.

ekegusii: Ekero nkorigereria gochia igoro, na korora emeremo gwakorete namaboko ao, omotienyi ne ching’enang’eni, ebi kwabegete aase abo;
english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,

ekegusii: Ninkeyie chindagera chiaino chibe chinke; abakungu ikomi barugere eriko erimo, na barabwo babarengere endagera ensinini, na inwe namoyerie, korende timokoigota.
english: When I cut off your supply of bread, ten women will be able to bake your bread in one oven, and they will dole out the bread by weight. You will eat, but you will not be satisfied.

ekegusii: Korende ekero banyorete endagera eisaine, bakaria bakaigota, erio bakaenena na kweimokereria igoro; ase ayio bakanyeba.
english: When I fed them, they were satisfied; when they were satisfied, they became proud; then they forgot me.

ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana onsi arenge amaya asende, ngateba ng’a tinkobugwa.
english: When I felt secure, I said, "I will never be shaken."

ekegusii: naende nkabekera enyancha chimbebe chiaye, boigo nkayebekera emekorogoto na ebisieri,
english: when I fixed limits for it and set its doors and bars in place,

ekegusii: Ayio nigo arabe ekero ndabasangererie mbarusie korwa ase egati y’abanto, na korwa ase chinse chi’ababisa babo. Goetera asebare ninyeorokie ase amasio ’abanto b’ebisaku ng’a inche nomochenu inde.
english: When I have brought them back from the nations and have gathered them from the countries of their enemies, I will show myself holy through them in the sight of many nations.

ekegusii: Nimbaire ase ense eyio entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, eyio narierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a nimbayee. Aroro agwo mbanyore ebinto ebinge barie, baisaneke na konora, korende nigo baraonchokere chinyasae ching’ao na gochikorera, erio banchaye na gosaria okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania.
english: When I have brought them into the land flowing with milk and honey, the land I promised on oath to their forefathers, and when they eat their fill and thrive, they will turn to other gods and worship them, rejecting me and breaking my covenant.

ekegusii: When I heard their outcry and these charges, I was very angry.
english: Ekero naigwete amang’ana ’ebirero biabo nkaba nendamwamu enene;

ekegusii: Ekero naigwete amang’ana ayio, ngaikaransa inse, nkarera. Ase amatuko atai make nkaba nkobokia amagombo na kweng’ata amo nogosaba ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro,
english: When I heard these things, I sat down and wept. For some days I mourned and fasted and prayed before the God of heaven.

ekegusii: Ekero naigwete amang’ana ayio, nigo natandorete chianga chiane na eganchwa yane, ngasunyora etukia yane, ne chinderu chiane, erio ngaikaransa ngaichana.
english: When I heard this, I tore my tunic and cloak, pulled hair from my head and beard and sat down appalled.

ekegusii: Ekero konya ntaraorokia ebibe biane, omobere one okoma pa ase okwerera omobaso boira.
english: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

ekegusii: Ekero nararire nigo nkoboria: Indi bogocha gokia mboke? Obotuko bwatambeire mono. Agwo naba nkona‐kweonchaonchora bokia goika mambia.
english: When I lie down I think, 'How long before I get up?' The night drags on, and I toss till dawn.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora ng’a mwakorire ebibe ase Omonene, Nyasae oino: konya mweroiseirie omogwekano bw’emori onyititoire na kobombwa, na mwaonchokire bwango, mwatigire enchera eria Omonene abachigete mobwatie.
english: When I looked, I saw that you had sinned against the LORD your God; you had made for yourselves an idol cast in the shape of a calf. You had turned aside quickly from the way that the LORD had commanded you.

ekegusii: when I made the clouds its garment and wrapped it in thick darkness,
english: Ekero keria naroisetie amare abe chianga chiaye, na nkayeboyia omosunte ekerima,

ekegusii: Ekero ndasarie ense ya Misiri ebe bosa, na ebinto bionsi bireo bisirigwe, naende nsirie abanto bonsi bamenyeteo, erio mbamanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: When I make Egypt desolate and strip the land of everything in it, when I strike down all who live there, then they will know that I am the LORD.'

ekegusii: Inee! Ekero narengereretie gokora aya, inarenge ne chitang’u‐tang’u koroisia emeroberio yane? Gose nigo nayeroisetie buna omonto bw’ense ore ang’e goteba, “Ee, ee”, na, “Taibo, taibo”?
english: When I planned this, did I do it lightly? Or do I make my plans in a worldly manner so that in the same breath I say, "Yes, yes" and "No, no"?

ekegusii: Ekero ndaganie, nimbae egesusuro gi’okobarongeyia, erio abanto b’ebisaku ebiaao mbasangererekane amo, babachere amo babae egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biabo bibere.
english: When I please, I will punish them; nations will be gathered against them to put them in bonds for their double sin.

ekegusii: Ekero neboyetie chigunia ase okweumia bakaba bakondabaara.
english: when I put on sackcloth, people make sport of me.

ekegusii: Ekero naroche ng’a natererigwe, aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao bwa botambe nigo bwansiirete tinagwa.
english: When I said, "My foot is slipping," your love, O LORD, supported me.

ekegusii: ngateba: Aa nao oraikere, korende togoetania, naiga nao emerindo yao eimokererete igoro eratangerwe.
english: when I said, 'This far you may come and no farther; here is where your proud waves halt'?

ekegusii: Ngachia komorora nkagwa ase amagoro aye, nkaba buna oyokure. Erio akabeka okoboko kwaye gw’okorio igoro asende, agantebia, “Toiroka, inche noyo bwe ritang’ani, na oyo bw’omoerio,
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead. Then he placed his right hand on me and said: "Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.

ekegusii: Ase ebinto biria biasakoretwe nkarora egetambaa gi’okwambara kiarwete Babeli, ne chifeta chikiro ibere na ekeng’ese, na ebao y’etahabu eisaine ekeng’ese gi’ekiro. Nkaba nokogania kw’ebinto ebio, nkabiira. Mobinyore bibisire gati‐gati y’eema yane, ase amaroba ime, ne chifeta chiria chibekire inse kegima.”
english: When I saw in the plunder a beautiful robe from Babylonia, two hundred shekels of silver and a wedge of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them. They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath."

ekegusii: Korende ekero nachia korora ng’a ogokora kwabo tikware okwa boronge ase ekeene gi’enchili, ngatebia Kefa ase amasio ’abanto bonsi, “Onye aye, oyore Omoyahudi, gokobwatia chingencho chi’abanto b’Ebisaku, gose tari echi’Abayahudi, naki rende oranyare kobetereria abanto b’Ebisaku babwatie chingencho chi’Abayahudi?”
english: When I saw that they were not acting in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Peter in front of them all, "You are a Jew, yet you live like a Gentile and not like a Jew. How is it, then, that you force Gentiles to follow Jewish customs?

ekegusii: Na ekero naroche ng’a timwanchete gontooria tinaraarete obogima bwane, nkaamboka, nkagenda korwania Abaamoni, na Omonene akababeka ase amaboko aane. Nase ki mwachire gokora esegi nainche?”
english: When I saw that you wouldn't help, I took my life in my hands and crossed over to fight the Ammonites, and the LORD gave me the victory over them. Now why have you come up today to fight me?"

ekegusii: Kondatebe omokori amabe: Ekeene aye goika okwe, na aye koratige tomokurera, gose tokwana nomokori amabe oyio ase okomokurera, erinde atige chinchera chiaye chi’obobe atoorie obogima bwaye, rirorio omokori amabe oyio nakwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende amanyinga aye ninyaganie korwa ase okoboko kwao.
english: When I say to a wicked man, 'You will surely die,' and you do not warn him or speak out to dissuade him from his evil ways in order to save his life, that wicked man will die for his sin, and I will hold you accountable for his blood.

ekegusii: Kondatebie omonto omokori amabe: Aye omokori amabe, goika okwe, na aye okire tokwana omokurere ng’a aonchoke korwa ase enchera yaye embe, omokori amabe oria nakwe ore ase ebibe biaye, korende ninganie amanyinga aye korwa ase okoboko kwao.
english: When I say to the wicked, 'O wicked man, you will surely die,' and you do not speak out to dissuade him from his ways, that wicked man will die for his sin, and I will hold you accountable for his blood.

ekegusii: Nigo ngotieria omoro one okomesa, na okoboko kwane kwanacha ekina. Nindusie egesiomba igoro ase ababisa baane, ning’akane baria bonsi bangechete.
english: when I sharpen my flashing sword and my hand grasps it in judgment, I will take vengeance on my adversaries and repay those who hate me.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio nindase abanto bao chinsara chiane chi’enchara, chibaite na kobasiria kegima. Ekero ndakore ayio ninkeyie endagera yabo bakoria ebe enke na enchara egenderere komenteka.
english: When I shoot at you with my deadly and destructive arrows of famine, I will shoot to destroy you. I will bring more and more famine upon you and cut off your supply of food.

ekegusii: Ekero konya berusirie moyo nigo narenge kobasekera; obwasioku bw’obosio bwane tibabosieereretie.
english: When I smiled at them, they scarcely believed it; the light of my face was precious to them.

ekegusii: Ekero ekio ndagosirie nintube igoro, imbeke omosunte ase ching’enang’eni; nintube erioba ne riire, na omotienyi tokobara.
english: When I snuff you out, I will cover the heavens and darken their stars; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.

ekegusii: Ekero nkoinyora amang’ana aya, obwoba nigo bogonsoa, na omobere one oiguswa.
english: When I think about this, I am terrified; trembling seizes my body.

ekegusii: Ekero nkorengereria ng’a oborere bwane mbonyare kondemia, na ebirengererio biane mbinyare gonkeaneria obororo bwane,
english: When I think my bed will comfort me and my couch will ease my complaint,

ekegusii: Bono ekero nabete nkorengereria komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio, amang’ana ayio akaba amakong’u asende,
english: When I tried to understand all this, it was oppressive to me

ekegusii: Nigo narenge omwana, narenge na tata; nigo narenge omwororo nanchire na baba, ekiagera nigo narenge omomoima.
english: When I was a boy in my father's house, still tender, and an only child of my mother,

ekegusii: Ekero narenge omwana, nigo narenge gokwana buna omwana, nigo narenge korengereria buna omwana, naende nigo narenge komanya buna omwana; konabeire omonto omonene natigire amang’ana ’obwana.
english: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I put childish ways behind me.

ekegusii: Ase chingaki chi’emechando nigo nkorigia Omonene; ase obotuko nigo nkorambora okoboko kwane ase ogosaba ntari korosa, omoyo one nigo okwanga koremigwa.
english: When I was in distress, I sought the Lord; at night I stretched out untiring hands and my soul refused to be comforted.

ekegusii: Ekero nanyora amang’ana ng’a bamoboeire omonto oyo, ngachora komotoma asore erio kegima, ngachika abamosoeri bache bakwane amang’ana igoro yaye ase obosio bwao.”
english: When I was informed of a plot to be carried out against the man, I sent him to you at once. I also ordered his accusers to present to you their case against him.

ekegusii: Ekero nabete nkorera ase omoyo one na kweng’ata, ngachaywa na gokwanwa bobe.
english: When I weep and fast, I must endure scorn;

ekegusii: Ekero narenge Yerusalemu, abakuani abanene na abagaaka b’Abayahudi bagantebia amang’ana igoro yaye, bakarigia agambigwe.
english: When I went to Jerusalem, the chief priests and elders of the Jews brought charges against him and asked that he be condemned.

ekegusii: Ekero inche natiirete gochia ase egetunwa igoro koegwa chibao chiria chi’amagena chiarikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania koria Omonene akorete nainwe, nkagenderera kobeera ase egetunwa igoro ase amatuko emerongo ene, omobaso na obotuko, tinare koria kende, gose konywa.
english: When I went up on the mountain to receive the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the LORD had made with you, I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread and drank no water.

ekegusii: Ekero konya bamenyire aria engaki entambe, Abimeleki, omoruoti bw’Abafilisti, akarigereria korwa ase ekebao, akarora Isaka bakogosoria na Rebeka mokaye.
english: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked down from a window and saw Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.

ekegusii: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called for Esau his older son and said to him, "My son." "Here I am," he answered.
english: Ekero Isaka konya abeire omogotu, na amaiso aye konya abeire orotutu, atari korora buya, akarangeria Esau, omwana oye omotangi, akamotebia, “Omwana one!” Ere akamoitabera, “Nao inde aa”

ekegusii: When Ish-Bosheth son of Saul heard that Abner had died in Hebron, he lost courage, and all Israel became alarmed.
english: Ekero Isi‐Boseti, mosinto o Saulo, aigwete ng’a Abineri oitirwe agwo Heburoni, akerusia moyo, na Abaisraeli bonsi bagaichana na gokumia.

ekegusii: Agwo nyuma, ekero Abaisraeli babeire ne chinguru, bakabetereria Abakanani babakorere emeremo emekong’u, korende tibabaseretie korwa ense eria.
english: When Israel became strong, they pressed the Canaanites into forced labor but never drove them out completely.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barwete Misiri, ee, ekero abanto ba Yakobo barwete ase abanto barenge gokwana omonwa omoao,
english: When Israel came out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bakoorire goita abanto bonsi ba Ai abarenge agwo aase aarabu, na ase erooro, ase babaseretie gochia, bakairana Ai, bagaita nemioro bonsi abarenge aroro.
english: When Israel had finished killing all the men of Ai in the fields and in the desert where they had chased them, and when every one of them had been put to the sword, all the Israelites returned to Ai and killed those who were in it.

ekegusii: Israeli, ekero aroche abana ba Yusufu, akamoboria, “Aba mbarabi?”
english: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, "Who are these?"

ekegusii: When it arrives, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.
english: Gakegocha, kiayenyora yaabusirwe, yaroisigwe.

ekegusii: Ere tari kwoboa chingaki chi’obokendu, ekiagera abanto bonsi b’enyomba yaye nigo babwate chianga chie riberera chiroisirie korwa ase chiusi chimonyinga.
english: When it snows, she has no fear for her household; for all of them are clothed in scarlet.

ekegusii: Naende Epasaka y’Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang’e, na Yeso agatiira goika Yerusalemu.
english: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Naende Epasaka y’Abayahudi nigo yarenge ang’e; abange bagatiira korwa chinka chiabo kogenda Yerusalemu gotang’anera Epasaka, erinde besibie.
english: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, many went up from the country to Jerusalem for their ceremonial cleansing before the Passover.

ekegusii: Ekero bwachia gokia, abagambi bagatoma abanyanyimbo, bagoteba, “Tiga abanto abwo bagende!”
english: When it was daylight, the magistrates sent their officers to the jailer with the order: "Release those men."

ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana achikwa ng’a togende nemeeri goika Italia, bakabeka Paulo na abasibwa bande ase amaboko a Yulio, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana ase ekeombe ki’abarwani ki’omogambi Augusto.
english: When it was decided that we would sail for Italy, Paul and some other prisoners were handed over to a centurion named Julius, who belonged to the Imperial Regiment.

ekegusii: Ekero giaichoire, abanto bagakeng’usa gocha engegu; bagaikaransa, bagasangereria chiria chingiya ase amakuru, na chiria chimbe bagachituguta.
english: When it was full, the fishermen pulled it up on the shore. Then they sat down and collected the good fish in baskets, but threw the bad away.

ekegusii: Kegaika ekero gi’okoibora kwa Elisabeti, akaibora omwana omoisia.
english: When it was time for Elizabeth to have her baby, she gave birth to a son.

ekegusii: Ekero chinsagia chiomire, nigo chikobuneka, abakungu bacha bachiira bachiutera omorero. Abanto b’egesaku eke tibari nobong’aini, ase ayio oria obatongete takobarorera amabeebe, gose kobarorera amabera.
english: When its twigs are dry, they are broken off and women come and make fires with them. For this is a people without understanding; so their Maker has no compassion on them, and their Creator shows them no favor.

ekegusii: Yabini, omoruoti o Hasori, akaigwa amang’ana ayio. Erio agatoma amang’ana ase Yobabu, omoruoti o Madoni, na ase abaruoti ba Simuroni na ase Akisafu,
english: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of this, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Acshaph,

ekegusii: Yakobo akaboka korwa ase chitoro chiaye, akabora, “Amaene, Omonene nao are aase aa, na inche tinamanyete.”
english: When Jacob awoke from his sleep, he thought, "Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was not aware of it."

ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo akoorete gochika abamura baye amang’ana aya, akaimokia amagoro aye, akayabeka borere igoro; erio agakwa agasangererekana amo nabanto baye.
english: When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed, breathed his last and was gathered to his people.

ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo achia koigwa ng’a Sekemu osaririe Dina, omoiseke oye, abana baye ngetii barenge korisia, ase igo Yakobo agakira‐kiri goika bakairana inka.
english: When Jacob heard that his daughter Dinah had been defiled, his sons were in the fields with his livestock; so he kept quiet about it until they came home.

ekegusii: Korende Yakobo gachia koigwa ng’a endagera nekare Misiri, agatoma chisokoro chiaito aroro ase orogendo rwe ritang’ani.
english: When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers on their first visit.

ekegusii: Ekero Yakobo aigwete ng’a endagera nekare ase ense ya Misiri, akaboria abamura baye, “Inaki morigereranetie iga?”
english: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, "Why do you just keep looking at each other?"

ekegusii: Bono ekero Yakobo achia korora Raeli, omoiseke o Labani, ng’ina rome, okorenta riicho ria Labani, akaimoka, agatigeria rigena riria korwa ase omonwa bw’ensoko, akanyoisia ching’ondi chia Labani, ng’ina rome.
english: When Jacob saw Rachel daughter of Laban, his mother's brother, and Laban's sheep, he went over and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle's sheep.

ekegusii: Na ekero Yakobo abaroche akabora, “Oyo nomoganda o Nyasae!” Ase igo akaroka aase aria Mahanaimu.
english: When Jacob saw them, he said, "This is the camp of God!" So he named that place Mahanaim.

ekegusii: Yakobo nere agatebigwa ng’a, “Yusufu, omwana oo, ngocha are gokorora.” Erio Israeli agekomereria, akaboka, agaikaransa borere igoro.
english: When Jacob was told, "Your son Joseph has come to you," Israel rallied his strength and sat up on the bed.

ekegusii: When Jair died, he was buried in Kamon.
english: Yairi agakwa, agatindekwa agwo Kamoni.

ekegusii: When Jared had lived 162 years, he became the father of Enoch.
english: Ekero Yaredi abeire nemiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano nomo, na ebere (162), akaibora Enoku.

ekegusii: Ekero Yehoramu airete oboruoti bwa ise, na kanyorire chinguru ase borobwo, agaita abamura bamwabo bonsi nomoro, boigo agaita abanene bande b’Abaisraeli.
english: When Jehoram established himself firmly over his father's kingdom, he put all his brothers to the sword along with some of the princes of Israel.

ekegusii: Yehosafati, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akairana nka bwoye agwo Yerusalemu, orendire buya.
english: When Jehoshaphat king of Judah returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem,

ekegusii: Na ekero aigete Samaria, agaita abanto bonsi batigarete ase enyomba y’Ahabu agwo Samaria, goika akabasiria kegima, buna Omonene atebete goetera ase Elija.
english: When Jehu came to Samaria, he killed all who were left there of Ahab's family; he destroyed them, according to the word of the LORD spoken to Elijah.

ekegusii: Ekero Yehu asogete isiko, akagenda ase abasomba b’omonene oye, na barabwo bakamoboria, “Mang’ana ki? Nase ki omonto oria ebarimo achicha aa asore?” Yehu akabairaneria, “Inwe momanyete omonto oria ne chinkwana chiaye.”
english: When Jehu went out to his fellow officers, one of them asked him, "Is everything all right? Why did this madman come to you?" "You know the man and the sort of things he says," Jehu replied.

ekegusii: Yefta akairana gochia inka bwoye aaria Misipa, na agwo akarora omoiseke oye ogocha komorotota, okobugia ekebangarara na gotenga. Omoiseke oria, nere bweka Yefta abwate, tabwate mwana onde, omomura gose omoiseke.
english: When Jephthah returned to his home in Mizpah, who should come out to meet him but his daughter, dancing to the sound of tambourines! She was an only child. Except for her he had neither son nor daughter.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeremia akoorete gotebia abanto bonsi amang’ana ayio Omonene, Nyasae obo, amotomete kobatebia,
english: When Jeremiah finished telling the people all the words of the LORD their God-- everything the LORD had sent him to tell them--

ekegusii: Na ekero Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, aigwete amang’ana ayio, akairana korwa Misiri aaria ase atamete gochia kwebisa korwa ase omoruoti Sulemani.
english: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.

ekegusii: Na ekero Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, aigwete amang’ana ayio, akairana korwa Misiri aaria ase atamete gochia korwa ase omoruoti Sulemani. Abanto bakarangeria Yeroboamu, na ere amo nomosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli bakagenda, bagatebia Rehoboamu,
english: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard this (he was still in Egypt, where he had fled from King Solomon), he returned from Egypt.

ekegusii: When Jesus came into Peter's house, he saw Peter's mother-in-law lying in bed with a fever.
english: Ekero Yeso asoete nyomba mwa Petero, akarora ng’ina biara Petero oraire, orwarete esosera.

ekegusii: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, "Here is the man!"
english: Erio Yeso agasoka isiko, obekeire egutwa eria y’amagwa na eanga eria y’oboruoti embariri. Pilato akabatebia, “Rora omonto oyo!”

ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso acha ensemo ya Kaisaria Filipi, akaboria aborokigwa baye, “Inee! Abanto nigo bakobora ng’a Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto nere ng’o?”
english: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, "Who do people say the Son of Man is?"

ekegusii: Ekero achia gosoa Yerusalemu, omochie omogima ogaseega‐seega, abanto bakaboria, “Ning’o oyio?”
english: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, "Who is this?"

ekegusii: Yeso agachia gosoa enyomba y’omonto oria omonene, akarora abakobugia ebiroria, na abanto abasangererekaneteo bakorera.
english: When Jesus entered the ruler's house and saw the flute players and the noisy crowd,

ekegusii: Na abwo barenge amo nere bagachia korora ayakorigia koba, bakabora, “Omonene, inatorwane nomoyio o birende?”
english: When Jesus' followers saw what was going to happen, they said, "Lord, should we strike with our swords?"

ekegusii: Yeso agachia goika korwa obwato; agwo akaumerana nomonto okorwa ase chimbeera obwatire nekerecha ki’eubi.
english: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man with an evil spirit came from the tombs to meet him.

ekegusii: Yeso kambokire naende koirana ng’umbu nobwato boria, omoganda omonene okamosangererekanera; ere nigo arenge ensemo y’enyancha.
english: When Jesus had again crossed over by boat to the other side of the lake, a large crowd gathered around him while he was by the lake.

ekegusii: Akarangeria baria ikomi na babere akabaa chinguru na okobua igoro ase ebirecha bionsi na ase okogwenia amarwaire.
english: When Jesus had called the Twelve together, he gave them power and authority to drive out all demons and to cure diseases,

ekegusii: Naende agachia gosoa Kapernaumu, omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana akamochiera, akamosorora,
english: When Jesus had entered Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking for help.

ekegusii: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,
english: Ekero Yeso akoorire gokwana amang’ana aya onsi, agatebia aborokigwa baye,

ekegusii: Agachia gokoora amang’ana aye onsi ekero abanto bamoigwete, agasoa Kapernaumu.
english: When Jesus had finished saying all this in the hearing of the people, he entered Capernaum.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia gokoora amang’ana ayio, akarua Galili, agasoa ensemo ya Boyahudi ng’umbu ya Yorodan;
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went into the region of Judea to the other side of the Jordan.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire amang’ana aya, emeganda egakumia ase okworokereria kwaye,
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching,

ekegusii: When Jesus had finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him to eat with him; so he went in and reclined at the table.
english: Ekero arenge gokwana, Omofarisai oyomo akamorangeria aragere amo nere. Agasoa, agaikaransa koragera.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso akoorire emereng’anio eyio, akarua aroro, akagenda aase aande.
english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he moved on from there.

ekegusii: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he returned to Galilee.
english: Ekero Yeso achia koigwa ng’a Yohana osibirwe echela, akaimoka, akagenda Galili.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akamotebia, “Egento ekemo ngekoremete; oonie ebio ore nabio bionsi ogabere abataka, na aye nobe nenibo igoro. Erio ochiche ontunyane.”
english: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, "You still lack one thing. Sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me."

ekegusii: Yeso agachia koigwa aya, agakumia asare, akeonchorera omoganda orenge komotunyana, akabora, “Nabatebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.”
english: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed at him, and turning to the crowd following him, he said, "I tell you, I have not found such great faith even in Israel."

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso amoigwa agakumia, agatebia abamotunyanete, “Nekeene nabatebirie: Nonya nase Abaisraeli tindanyora okwegena okore buna oko.
english: When Jesus heard this, he was astonished and said to those following him, "I tell you the truth, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.

ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso achia koigwa aya, akarua agwo nobwato, akagenda ere bweka aase abanto batari. Korende ekero emeganda yachia koigwa aya, bakamotunyana namagoro korwa ase emechie.
english: When Jesus heard what had happened, he withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. Hearing of this, the crowds followed him on foot from the towns.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso aikire engegu, akarora omoganda omonene, akabarorera amabera, akagwenia abarwaire babo.
english: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them and healed their sick.

ekegusii: Yeso agachia goika korwa ase obwato, akarora omoganda omonene, akabarorera amabera, ekiagera barenge buna ching’ondi chitari nomorisia: agachaka koborokereria amang’ana amange.
english: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. So he began teaching them many things.

ekegusii: Agachia gosoka korwa aroro, aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai bagachaka komomiga namaborio amakong’u, na komochegia akwane igoro y’ebinto ebinge;
english: When Jesus left there, the Pharisees and the teachers of the law began to oppose him fiercely and to besiege him with questions,

ekegusii: Nabo Yeso agachia koimokia amaiso aye, akarora omoganda omonene ogocha asare, akaboria Filipo, “Ng’ai togochia kogora emegati, aba banyare koria?”
english: When Jesus looked up and saw a great crowd coming toward him, he said to Philip, "Where shall we buy bread for these people to eat?"

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia goika aase aria, akarigereria igoro, akamotebia, “Zakayo, ika bwango, ekiagera rero ningwenerete goikaransa nyomba mwao.”
english: When Jesus reached the spot, he looked up and said to him, "Zacchaeus, come down immediately. I must stay at your house today."

ekegusii: Yeso ekero abokire, mambia rituko rie ritang’ani ri’echuma akaorokera ritang’ani Mariamu Magidalena, ere oria arusetie ebirecha bitano na bibere.
english: When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had driven seven demons.

ekegusii: Gachia gokwana amang’ana aya, oyomo bw’abarendi baria oteneine ang’e, agaaka Yeso oroe, akabora, “Naboigo okoiraneria omokuani omonene?”
english: When Jesus said this, one of the officials nearby struck him in the face. "Is this the way you answer the high priest?" he demanded.

ekegusii: When Jesus said, "I am he," they drew back and fell to the ground.
english: Nabo ekero Yeso achia kobatebia, “Ninche ere,” bakairana nyuma, bagaaka inse.

ekegusii: Erio Yeso agachia komorora okorera, na Abayahudi baria bachete amo nere bakorera; agasogwa nobororo ase omoyo oye, agaichana.
english: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso achia komorora, akamorangeria, akamotebia, “Aye omokungu, gwasiboirwe korwa ase oboreu bwao.”
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her forward and said to her, "Woman, you are set free from your infirmity."

ekegusii: Yeso agachia komorora oraire, konya omanyire ng’a obeire engencho eye amatuko amange, akamoboria, “Norigetie koba omogima?”
english: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, "Do you want to get well?"

ekegusii: When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to his mother, "Dear woman, here is your son,"
english: Erio ekero Yeso achia korora ng’ina na omworokigwa oria anchete bateneine ang’e agatebia ng’ina, “Omong’ina, rora omwana oo!”

ekegusii: Yeso akarora Natanaeli ogocha asare, agakwana igoro yaye, “Rora oyo n’Omoisraeli ekeene, otari nobong’ainereria ime yaye!”
english: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, "Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is nothing false."

ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora ng’a omoganda ngosangererekana ore bwango, agakania ekerecha keria ki’eubi, akagetebia, “Aye ekerecha rimama na egetino, inche nagochikire, morwe, tomoiranera naende!”
english: When Jesus saw that a crowd was running to the scene, he rebuked the evil spirit. "You deaf and mute spirit," he said, "I command you, come out of him and never enter him again."

ekegusii: Yeso agachia korora ng’a nigo airaneria ase obong’aini, akamotebia, “Aye tori are korwa ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae.” Korwa erio monto onde tanyara komoboria ring’ana naende.
english: When Jesus saw that he had answered wisely, he said to him, "You are not far from the kingdom of God." And from then on no one dared ask him any more questions.

ekegusii: Bono ekero Yeso achia korora emeganda emenge yamoetananire, agachika ng’a baimoke korwa aroro bagende ng’umbu.
english: When Jesus saw the crowd around him, he gave orders to cross to the other side of the lake.

ekegusii: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralytic, "Son, your sins are forgiven."
english: Yeso agachia korora okwegena kwabo agatebia oria orenge rigata, “Omwana one, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

ekegusii: When Jesus saw their faith, he said, "Friend, your sins are forgiven."
english: Agachia korora okwegena kwabo, akamotebia, “Omonto oyo, ebibe biao biabeirwe.”

ekegusii: Korende Yeso agachia korora, akabea mono, akabatebia, “Batige abana abake bache asende, timobaisa kobatanga, ekiagera abare buna aba, oboruoti bwa Nyasae nobwabo
english: When Jesus saw this, he was indignant. He said to them, "Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

ekegusii: Yeso agakwana nabarabwo naende, akabora, “Inche nomobaso bw’ense; oyogontunyana takogenda ase omosunte, korende nabe nomobaso bw’obogima.”
english: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life."

ekegusii: Agachia goika engegu, akaumerana nomonto oyomo bw’omochie oria, obwatire nebirecha; na ase amatuko amange tarenge kweboyia chianga, tarenge komenya nyomba, otatiga ase chimbeera.
english: When Jesus stepped ashore, he was met by a demon-possessed man from the town. For a long time this man had not worn clothes or lived in a house, but had lived in the tombs.

ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu aigete amo nabarwani baye bonsi, ere agatebigwa ng’a Abineri, mosinto o Neri, nao arenge ase omoruoti, na omoruoti omoeire ribaga, ochiire ore nomorembe.
english: When Joab and all the soldiers with him arrived, he was told that Abner son of Ner had come to the king and that the king had sent him away and that he had gone in peace.

ekegusii: Yobabu nere agakwa, na Husamu bw’ense y’Abatemani akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ekero Yobabu akwete, Husamu, bw’ense y’Abatemani akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ayubu nabwate abasani batato: Elifasi korwa Temani, na Bilidadi korwa Sua, na Sofari korwa Naama. Ekero barabwo baigwete igoro y’emechando eria Ayubu anyorete, bagachikana ng’a kera oyomo arue bwoye, baumerane amo, bagende komwechandera na komoremia.
english: When Job's three friends, Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite, heard about all the troubles that had come upon him, they set out from their homes and met together by agreement to go and sympathize with him and comfort him.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Yohanani, mosinto o Karea, amo nabatang’ani b’abarwani esegi bonsi barenge amo nere, baigwete amang’ana ayio amabe, Isumaeli, mosinto o Netania, akorete,
english: When Johanan son of Kareah and all the army officers who were with him heard about all the crimes Ishmael son of Nethaniah had committed,

ekegusii: Ekero Yohana achia koigwa aaria ase echela ebitage bia Kristo, agatoma aborokigwa baye komoboria,
english: When John heard in prison what Christ was doing, he sent his disciples

ekegusii: Ekero Yoramu aroche Yehu, akamoboria, “Yehu, nomorembe okorenta?” Yehu akairaneria, “Naki omorembe orakore obe, ekero obonyaka na oborogi obonge bwa Yesebeli nyoko bogendererete koba iga?”
english: When Joram saw Jehu he asked, "Have you come in peace, Jehu?" "How can there be peace," Jehu replied, "as long as all the idolatry and witchcraft of your mother Jezebel abound?"

ekegusii: Barabwo bagachia gokoora goikerania onsi koreng’ana namachiko ’Omonene, bakairana Galili goika omochie obo Nazareti.
english: When Joseph and Mary had done everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to Galilee to their own town of Nazareth.

ekegusii: Na ekero Yusufu achete nyomba ime bakamoirera ebiegwa biria barentete, bagatung’ama inse ase obosio bwaye.
english: When Joseph came home, they presented to him the gifts they had brought into the house, and they bowed down before him to the ground.

ekegusii: Ekero Yusufu agendete mambia kobarigereria akabanyora nigo baichanete.
english: When Joseph came to them the next morning, he saw that they were dejected.

ekegusii: Ekero Yusufu aroche Benjamin ore amo nabarabwo agatebia omoteneneri bw’enka yaye, “Barente abanto abwo nyomba, na onyenye emori, oyeroisie, ekiagera abanto abwo nigo bagocha koragera amo nainche endagera ya mobaso.”
english: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, "Take these men to my house, slaughter an animal and prepare dinner; they are to eat with me at noon."

ekegusii: Yusufu agachia korora ng’a ise obekire okoboko kwaye gw’okorio igoro ase omotwe o Efraimu, ayio tayancha. Akabwata okoboko gwa ise akorusie korwa ase omotwe o Efraimu, erio akobeke ase oyo o Manase.
english: When Joseph saw his father placing his right hand on Ephraim's head he was displeased; so he took hold of his father's hand to move it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.

ekegusii: Na Yusufu agachia koboka korwa ase chitoro, agakora buna achigetwe nomomalaika bw’Omonene; akaira mokaye,
english: When Joseph woke up, he did what the angel of the Lord had commanded him and took Mary home as his wife.

ekegusii: Ekero abamwabo Yusufu baroche ng’a ise okure, bagatebania. “Aande Yusufu nigo aratorege, arusie egesiomba ase amabe aria twamokorerete.”
english: When Joseph's brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "What if Joseph holds a grudge against us and pays us back for all the wrongs we did to him?"

ekegusii: Erio, buna Yoshua abachigete, abakuani batano na babere bakagenda bosio bw’Esanduku y’Omonene bakobugia ebitureri biria bi’omochengo, na Esanduku y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene ebogoirie korwa nyuma.
english: When Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests carrying the seven trumpets before the LORD went forward, blowing their trumpets, and the ark of the LORD's covenant followed them.

ekegusii: Yoshua akaigwa eriogi ri’abanto bakwoga, agatebia Musa, “Naigure eriogi ase egetwori, eriogi buna eri’esegi.”
english: When Joshua heard the noise of the people shouting, he said to Moses, "There is the sound of war in the camp."

ekegusii: Bono Yoshua konya ogotire mono. Omonene akamotebia, “Aye bono kwagotire mono, korende ensemo enene y’ense netigarete etarairwa.
english: When Joshua was old and well advanced in years, the LORD said to him, "You are very old, and there are still very large areas of land to be taken over.

ekegusii: Ekero Yoshua atebetigwe ng’a abaruoti baria barorekanire bebisete agwo ase rikuruma riria,
english: When Joshua was told that the five kings had been found hiding in the cave at Makkedah,

ekegusii: Ekero Yotamu atebetigwe amang’ana ayio, akagenda, agatenena ase egetunwa kia Gerisimu igoro, agaaka eriogi rinene agateba, “Inwe abanto ba Sekemu, ntegerera, erinde Nyasae nere abategerere.
english: When Jotham was told about this, he climbed up on the top of Mount Gerizim and shouted to them, "Listen to me, citizens of Shechem, so that God may listen to you.

ekegusii: Erio Abayuda bakagenda korwana esegi, na Omonene akabeka Abakanani na Abaperisi ase amaboko abo; Abayuda bagaita abanto chilifu ikomi agwo Bezeki.
english: When Judah attacked, the LORD gave the Canaanites and Perizzites into their hands and they struck down ten thousand men at Bezek.

ekegusii: Ekero Yuda amoroche, agakaga ng’a nomokungu omotayayi, ekiagera nigo atubete obosio bwaye.
english: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

ekegusii: Ekero Yudas, oria omoruete achia korora ng’a onacheirwe ekina, ageitia, akairania chibesa chiria chie chifeta emerongo etato ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka,
english: When Judas, who had betrayed him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was seized with remorse and returned the thirty silver coins to the chief priests and the elders.

ekegusii: Ekero ekeene giakorirwe, ayio nigo akoba omogoko bw’abanyene oboronge, korende ase abakori amabe nomoichano.
english: When justice is done, it brings joy to the righteous but terror to evildoers.

ekegusii: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he became the father of Mahalalel.
english: Ekero Kainani abeire nemiaka emerongo etano na ebere, (70), akaibora Mahalaleeli.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti Daudi aigwete amang’ana ayio, akaba nekeririanda ekenene.
english: When King David heard all this, he was furious.

ekegusii: Bono omoruoti Daudi konya ogotire mono, okoorire emiaka emenge; nonya ore kobisigwa amarangeti amange, tarenge koigwa riberera.
english: When King David was old and well advanced in years, he could not keep warm even when they put covers over him.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti Herode achia koigwa aya agaichanigwa, na Yerusalemu yonsi amo nere.
english: When King Herod heard this he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.

ekegusii: Ekero Hezekia omoruoti aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chianga chie chigunia, erio agasoa ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti Hezekia aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chianga chie chigunia, erio agasoa ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes and put on sackcloth and went into the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero abasomba ba Hezekia omoruoti baigete ase Isaya,
english: When King Hezekiah's officials came to Isaiah,

ekegusii: Ekero Yehoyakimu omoruoti, amo nabarwani baye b’esegi, na abanene b’oboruoti, baigwete amang’ana a Uria, akarigia komoita, korende ekero Uria aigwete ayio akairoka agatama gochia ase Misiri.
english: When King Jehoiakim and all his officers and officials heard his words, the king sought to put him to death. But Uriah heard of it and fled in fear to Egypt.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti Yeroboamu aigwete ogokwana okwo kw’omonto oria o Nyasae, koria arentete maminncha y’egesasimero agwo Beteli, akarambora okoboko kwaye korwa ase egesasimero, agateba, “Bwata omonto oyo!” Okoboko koria kwaye aramborete gochia ase omonto oria gokooma pa, goika tanyarete naende gokoringa.
english: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, "Seize him!" But the hand he stretched out toward the man shriveled up, so that he could not pull it back.

ekegusii: Erio Kora agasangereria omoganda bwonsi, na barabwo bagatenena bosio bwa Musa na Haroni agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema eria. Erio obonene bw’Omonene bokaorokera omoganda bwonsi.
english: When Korah had gathered all his followers in opposition to them at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the glory of the LORD appeared to the entire assembly.

ekegusii: When Laban had gone to shear his sheep, Rachel stole her father's household gods.
english: Ekero Labani konya achiire konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya, Raeli akaiba ebinyasae biaye bi’ogosasimwa, ebiarenge nyomba mwaye.

ekegusii: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he had a son.
english: Ekero Lameki abeire nemiaka rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato, na ebere (182), akaibora omwana omomura,

ekegusii: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she took her maidservant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
english: Ekero Lea achia korora ng’a otenenire koibora, akaimokia Silpa, omosomba oye omoiseke, akamomoa Yakobo, abe mokaye.

ekegusii: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he became the father of Jared.
english: Ekero Mahalaleeli abeire nemiaka emerongo etano nomo, na etano (65), akaibora Yaredi.

ekegusii: Nabo Martha agachia koigwa ng’a Yeso ngocha are, akagenda komorotota, korende Mariamu nigo aikaransete nyomba ime.
english: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.

ekegusii: Mariamu agachia koigwa, akaimoka bwango, akamochiera.
english: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.

ekegusii: Erio Mariamu agachia goika aase aria Yeso arenge, akamorora, akagwa ase amagoro aye, akamotebia, “Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete.”
english: When Mary reached the place where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, "Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died."

ekegusii: Abanto nigo barabe nobwoba ase ebitiiro, na okogoswa kobe ase chinchera. Emelozi nesiche, na ebisase bibe bikwagura ng’ora ng’ora, na okogania gwonsi ngosire. Eyio nengaki mwanyabanto aragende ase obomenyo bwaye bwa kare na kare; abakona‐korera mbabe bakomochiera ekero ase ekero.
english: when men are afraid of heights and of dangers in the streets; when the almond tree blossoms and the grasshopper drags himself along and desire no longer is stirred. Then man goes to his eternal home and mourners go about the streets.

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo agokeyia abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo obatooria.
english: When men are brought low and you say, 'Lift them up!' then he will save the downcast.

ekegusii: Mwanyabanto bakagenderera komentekana ase ense, na abana abaiseke bakaiborwa asebare.
english: When men began to increase in number on the earth and daughters were born to them,

ekegusii: “Onye abanto babere babwate eriomana ase egati yabo, rirorio bagende ase ekegambero, erio abagambi bagambe ekina ekio, na oyio ore noboronge aegwe oboronge bwaye, na oria ore nokomocha abarerwe okomocha kwaye.
english: When men have a dispute, they are to take it to court and the judges will decide the case, acquitting the innocent and condemning the guilty.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto barabatebie, “Genda moborie abwo bakorigia ogosemigwa korwa ase emeika y’abanto bakure, naende moborie abaragori, abwo bakomonyererana na komumura,” inwe mobairanerie iga: “Inee! Tegwenereti abanto komorigia Nyasae obo? Naki erabe ng’a toborie emeika y’abakure ase engencho y’abanto bare moyo?”
english: When men tell you to consult mediums and spiritists, who whisper and mutter, should not a people inquire of their God? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?

ekegusii: Ekero Mefiboseti, mosinto o Yonathani o Saulo, achete ase Daudi, agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase okoorokia amasikani. Daudi akabora, “Mefiboseti.” Ere agaitaba, “Nao inde aa, inche omosomba oo!”
english: When Mephibosheth son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, came to David, he bowed down to pay him honor. David said, "Mephibosheth!" "Your servant," he replied.

ekegusii: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he became the father of Lamech.
english: Ekero Metusela abeire nemiaka rigana erimo, na emerongo etano na etato, na etano na ebere (187), akaibora Lameki.

ekegusii: Ekero Mikaya mosinto o Gema ria, omochokoro o Safani, aigwete amang’ana ayio onsi ay’Omonene arikire ase ebuku eria,
english: When Micaiah son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, heard all the words of the LORD from the scroll,

ekegusii: Nonya Abamoabu bagwechanda na kwerosia gotiira gochia aase aimokererete igoro bagosasima, gose babe bakogenda ase chihekalu chiabo gosaba, tibakonyara konyora ogokonywa konde gwonsi.
english: When Moab appears at her high place, she only wears herself out; when she goes to her shrine to pray, it is to no avail.

ekegusii: Ekero Moredekai atebetigwe amang’ana onsi akorirwe, agatandora chianga chiaye, akeboyia chigunia na kweaka ribu, akagenda ase egati y’omochie okorera neriogi rinene, ore nobororo obonge,
english: When Mordecai learned of all that had been done, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and ashes, and went out into the city, wailing loudly and bitterly.

ekegusii: Bogachia gokia mambia akarangeria aborokigwa baye, agachora korwa asebare ikomi na babere, na abwo arogete abatomwa.
english: When morning came, he called his disciples to him and chose twelve of them, whom he also designated apostles:

ekegusii: When morning came, there was Leah! So Jacob said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? I served you for Rachel, didn't I? Why have you deceived me?"
english: Bogachia gokia mambia, Yakobo akanyora ng’a Lea aetwe. Erio akaboria Labani, “Inki eke gwankorerete? Tinagokorerete, erinde ong’e Raeli? Naki gwakorete okang’aina?”

ekegusii: Musa gaikire ang’e negetwori akarora emori eria, na buna abanto baare gotenga, akaba nendamwamu enene; agaakera inse chibao chiria abwate maboko aye, chigaateka, chikaba ebisamunye ase egetunwa inse.
english: When Moses approached the camp and saw the calf and the dancing, his anger burned and he threw the tablets out of his hands, breaking them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.

ekegusii: Ekero Musa arenge gotirimboka korwa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, obwate ase okoboko kwaye chibao chirikire oborori, tamanya ng’a risankwa ri’obosio bwaye nigo riare komeka‐meka, ekiagera konya okwanire n’Omonene.
english: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands, he was not aware that his face was radiant because he had spoken with the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero Musa asoete ase Eema y’Omosangererekano gokwana n’Omonene, akaigwa eriogi rigokwana nere korwa ase Oboikaranso bw’Amabera, obwo bwarenge igoro ase Esanduku yarenge ne chibao chirikire oborori. Eriogi erio rikarua ase egati y’Abakerubi baria babere, rigakwana nere.
english: When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the atonement cover on the ark of the Testimony. And he spoke with him.

ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana amang’ana ayio ase Abaisraeli bonsi,
english: When Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel,

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria Musa konya akoorire gotenenia Obomenyo Obochenu naende kaboakire amaguta na kobwatanana amo nebinto biaye bionsi, naende gakoorire gwatanana egesasimero na ebikorero biaye,
english: When Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed it and consecrated it and all its furnishings. He also anointed and consecrated the altar and all its utensils.

ekegusii: Ekero Musa akoorire gokwana nabarabwo, akabeka egietubo ase obosio bwaye.
english: When Moses finished speaking to them, he put a veil over his face.

ekegusii: naki ekero kera richiko riaikire gokwanwa na Musa ase abanto bonsi, buna yachigetwe ase amachiko, akabogoria amanyinga e chimori na aye chimbori amo namache na amarionya amabariri, ne chinsagia chia hisopo, akanyororokeria ebuku enyene, na abanto bonsi,
english: When Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves, together with water, scarlet wool and branches of hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people.

ekegusii: When Moses' hands grew tired, they took a stone and put it under him and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held his hands up-- one on one side, one on the other-- so that his hands remained steady till sunset.
english: Ekero amaboko a Musa arosire, Haroni na Huri bakaimokia rigena, bakaritereka inse, na Musa akariikaransera. Erio bakaba bagosiira amaboko a Musa, oyomo okoboko okomo, na oyonde okonde. Naboigo bakamosiira goika erioba rikagwa.

ekegusii: When Moses heard this, he fell facedown.
english: Ekero Musa aigwete amang’ana ayio agatung’ama inse akaumama.

ekegusii: Ase engencho y’amang’ana aya Musa agatama gochia ase ense ya Midiani, akamenya aroro buna omomenyi. Akaiborera abana babere abamura aroro.
english: When Moses heard this, he fled to Midian, where he settled as a foreigner and had two sons.

ekegusii: When Moses heard this, he was satisfied.
english: Ekero Musa aigwete amang’ana ayio agaisaneka.

ekegusii: Musa agatuka mono komanyanaki embori y’ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe yabete, akamanya ng’a embori eria nigo yasambetwe. Ase ayio akaba nendamwamu enene ase Eleasari na Itamari, abamura ba Haroni, baria batigarete, akabatebia.
english: When Moses inquired about the goat of the sin offering and found that it had been burned up, he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's remaining sons, and asked,

ekegusii: Musa agatebia Abaisraeli amang’ana onsi Omonene akwanete, na abanto bakarera mono nobororo.
english: When Moses reported this to all the Israelites, they mourned bitterly.

ekegusii: Ekero Musa are kobatoma gochia koroota ense ya Kanani, akabatebia, “Genda motiire gochia Negebu, ensemo ya irianyi y’ense eria, naende motiire gochia igoro ase ense y’ebitunwa.
english: When Moses sent them to explore Canaan, he said, "Go up through the Negev and on into the hill country.

ekegusii: Musa agatenenia Obomenyo boria, akabeka chinterekerero aase abo, agatenenia ne chibao chiaye, agasoyia emeriibo, na gotenenia chisiiro.
english: When Moses set up the tabernacle, he put the bases in place, erected the frames, inserted the crossbars and set up the posts.

ekegusii: Musa akaimokereria enyimbo yaye gochia igoro, na Omonene akarenta chinkoba na embura y’amagena, na okomesa gw’enkoba kogaika ase ense. Naboigo Omonene agaitera embura y’amagena igoro ya Misiri.
english: When Moses stretched out his staff toward the sky, the LORD sent thunder and hail, and lightning flashed down to the ground. So the LORD rained hail on the land of Egypt;

ekegusii: Musa akagenda agatebia abanto amang’ana onsi aya Omonene akwanete, na amachiko aye onsi. Abanto bonsi bakamoiraneria ase eriogi erimo, bakabora, “Amang’ana ayio onsi Omonene akwanire inatoyakore.”
english: When Moses went and told the people all the LORD's words and laws, they responded with one voice, "Everything the LORD has said we will do."

ekegusii: Erio Musa agatiira gochia egetunwa igoro, ne riire rikagetuba.
english: When Moses went up on the mountain, the cloud covered it,

ekegusii: Erio ekero obonene bwane borabe bogoeta, ninkobeke ase omotaro bw’egetare keria, na ngotube nokoboko kwane, goika imbe naetire.
english: When my glory passes by, I will put you in a cleft in the rock and cover you with my hand until I have passed by.

ekegusii: Ekero narenge nobororo ase omoyo ime, na enkoro yane ekaba buna eyabetirwe,
english: When my heart was grieved and my spirit embittered,

ekegusii: nigo narenge gwesibia amagoro aane namabeere, emezeituni ekamera ase egetare, nkanyora chindooche chi’amaguta ’amazeituni.
english: when my path was drenched with cream and the rock poured out for me streams of olive oil.

ekegusii: Ekero nkoba buna oyo okogireka, aye nomanyete ase ngoetera. Agwo ase ngoeta ababisa bambekeire amareba.
english: When my spirit grows faint within me, it is you who know my way. In the path where I walk men have hidden a snare for me.

ekegusii: When Nahor had lived 29 years, he became the father of Terah.
english: Ekero Nahori abeire nemiaka emerongo ebere, na kianda (29), akaibora Tera.

ekegusii: Ekero Naomi aroche ng’a Rutu otenenire bokong’u ase ebirengererio biaye bi’okogenda amo nere, takwana gento kende.
english: When Naomi realized that Ruth was determined to go with her, she stopped urging her.

ekegusii: Ekero erioba ne ching’enang’eni bitarorekanete ase amatuko amange, na omwaga omonene mono ogatotuba, tokerusia moyo ase ogotooreka.
english: When neither sun nor stars appeared for many days and the storm continued raging, we finally gave up all hope of being saved.

ekegusii: Ekero Nuhu atindokire korwa ase okonywa kwaye kw’edivai, akamanya eke omwana oye omoke amokoreire,
english: When Noah awoke from his wine and found out what his youngest son had done to him,

ekegusii: Omonto gete akamorora, akagenda ase Yoabu akamotebia, “Narora Abisalomu osung’unaine agwo moino ase omote onga buna omotontera.”
english: When one of the men saw this, he told Joab, "I just saw Absalom hanging in an oak tree."

ekegusii: Ching’iti echio chiise kogwera egento kende gionsi ekero chiakure, egento ekio nakebe egetachenegeti, onye negento keroisirie korwa ase emete, gose gokerabe eanga, gose risankwa, gose esaro, gose egento kende gionsi kegokorerwa emeremo. Egento ekio kebekwe ime ase amache, naende kebe getachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio; erio nakebe giachenekire.
english: When one of them dies and falls on something, that article, whatever its use, will be unclean, whether it is made of wood, cloth, hide or sackcloth. Put it in water; it will be unclean till evening, and then it will be clean.

ekegusii: Ekero oyomo ase abwo baikaransete ase endagera amo nere achia koyaigwa akamotebia, “Nasesenirie oyoranyare koria omogati ase oboruoti bwa Nyasae!”
english: When one of those at the table with him heard this, he said to Jesus, "Blessed is the man who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God."

ekegusii: Ekero ababisa baito baigwete ng’a twamanyire emeroberio yabo, naende ng’a Nyasae oyesaririe, tokairana twensi ase okoagacha, na kera omonto agakora emeremo aetwe gokora.
english: When our enemies heard that we were aware of their plot and that God had frustrated it, we all returned to the wall, each to his own work.

ekegusii: Ekero chisokoro chiaito chiarenge Misiri, tichiarengereretie igoro y’emeremo yao y’ogokumia; tichiainyorete obwanchani bwao obonge bogendererete botambe, korende chigasaria asore aaria ase Enyancha Embariri.
english: When our fathers were in Egypt, they gave no thought to your miracles; they did not remember your many kindnesses, and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.

ekegusii: Nkarora chiombe isano na ibere, chinoru chingiya mono, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka;
english: when out of the river there came up seven cows, fat and sleek, and they grazed among the reeds.

ekegusii: akarora chiombe isano na ibere, chingiya mono chinoru, chikorwa rooche, chikorisia amasangaka.
english: when out of the river there came up seven cows, sleek and fat, and they grazed among the reeds.

ekegusii: Ekero Paulo achire, Abayahudi abarwete Yerusalemu bagatenena, bakamoetanana, bakarenta amasoero amange amarito igoro yaye, ayabatanyare koorokia oboene ng’a mboronge are.
english: When Paul appeared, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing many serious charges against him, which they could not prove.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Paulo arigia ng’a arendwe goika agamberigwe ase Omoruoti omonene, ngachika arendwe goika inyare komoira ase Kaisari.”
english: When Paul made his appeal to be held over for the Emperor's decision, I ordered him held until I could send him to Caesar."

ekegusii: Na ekero Paulo abekire amaboko aye igoro asebare, Omoika Omochenu okabaikera; bagachaka gokwana ase emenwa na kobana.
english: When Paul placed his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied.

ekegusii: Nabo agachia goika ase ebiriinero akabogorigwa nabarwani ase engencho y’obotindi bw’omoganda,
english: When Paul reached the steps, the violence of the mob was so great he had to be carried by the soldiers.

ekegusii: Ekero Teritulo achia korangerigwa, agachaka komosoera, agateba, “Aye, omosike Feliki, ase okogamba kwao twanyorire omorembe omonge, na ase okorigereria kwao gwakoreire egesaku giaito ebinto ebinge ebiya,
english: When Paul was called in, Tertullus presented his case before Felix: "We have enjoyed a long period of peace under you, and your foresight has brought about reforms in this nation.

ekegusii: When Peleg had lived 30 years, he became the father of Reu.
english: Ekero Pelegi abeire nemiaka emerongo etato, akaibora Reu.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Kefa achete Antiokia, nkaamererania nere obosio ase obosio, ekiagera konya oikire kogambigwa.
english: When Peter came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face, because he was clearly in the wrong.

ekegusii: Petero agachia komorora oyio, akaboria Yeso, “Omonene, noyo rende?”
english: When Peter saw him, he asked, "Lord, what about him?"

ekegusii: Ekero Petero arora aya akaboria abanto, “Inwe abasacha ba Israeli, inki mogokumeria aya gose nase ki mogotobeta amaiso, ng’a buna intwe ase chinguru chiaito abanyene, gose ase obuya bwaito, twamokora oyo ogenda?
english: When Peter saw this, he said to them: "Men of Israel, why does this surprise you? Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk?

ekegusii: When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, 'What is your occupation?'
english: Bono, Farao karabarangerie na kobaboria meremo ki monarete gokora,

ekegusii: Ekero Farao achia koigwa amang’ana ayio akarigia goita Musa, korende Musa agatama korwa o Farao gochia komenya Midiani, agaika ase ensoko yare, agaikaransa aroro.
english: When Pharaoh heard of this, he tried to kill Moses, but Moses fled from Pharaoh and went to live in Midian, where he sat down by a well.

ekegusii: Ekero Farao aete abanto ribaga bagende, Nyasae tabaraa baetere ense y’Abafilisti, nonya enchera eyio yarenge omobutokanio. Nyasae nigo arengereretie ng’a aande onye abanto aba bagochia koumera esegi mbabaisa koirana Misiri.
english: When Pharaoh let the people go, God did not lead them on the road through the Philistine country, though that was shorter. For God said, "If they face war, they might change their minds and return to Egypt."

ekegusii: When Pharaoh saw that the rain and hail and thunder had stopped, he sinned again: He and his officials hardened their hearts.
english: Ekero Farao aroche ng’a embura y’amagena ne chinkoba biatangirwe, akagenderera gokora ebibe, bagakong’ia chinkoro chiabo ere amo nabasomba baye.

ekegusii: Naki ekero Farao akong’etie enkoro yaye akaanga gotoa ribaga kogenda, Omonene agaita kera omwana omotangi ase ense ya Misiri amo ne ching’iti chintangi chionsi. Nakio gekogera nkoruera Omonene kera eng’iti entangi y’eeri, na emingichi, na egoree, na omwana one omoisia omotangi nigo nkomobooria.
english: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, the LORD killed every firstborn in Egypt, both man and animal. This is why I sacrifice to the LORD the first male offspring of every womb and redeem each of my firstborn sons.'

ekegusii: Ekero chibarasi chia Farao, amo ne chigari na abariini basoete nyancha ime, Omonene akairania amache igoro yabo, akabatuba; korende Abaisraeli bagaeta egati y’enyancha ase ense enkamoku.
english: When Pharaoh's horses, chariots and horsemen went into the sea, the LORD brought the waters of the sea back over them, but the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.

ekegusii: Finehasi, mosinto bw’Eleazari o Haroni omokuani, akaimoka korwa ase omoganda bw’Abaisraeli, akabogoria ritimo,
english: When Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, the priest, saw this, he left the assembly, took a spear in his hand

ekegusii: Ekero Finehasi, omokuani, na abatang’ani b’omoganda abwo baare abateneneri be chiamate chi’Abaisraeli, abaare amo nere, baigwete aya abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben, na ab’ekia Gadi, amo nab’ekia Manase bakwanete, barabwo bagaisaneka.
english: When Phinehas the priest and the leaders of the community-- the heads of the clans of the Israelites-- heard what Reuben, Gad and Manasseh had to say, they were pleased.

ekegusii: Erio ekero Pilato achia koigwa amang’ana aya, akarenta Yeso isiko, agaikaransa igoro ase ekerogo gi’ekina, aase akorokwa Atichire n’Amagena, naende ase Ekeibirania, Gabata.
english: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judge's seat at a place known as the Stone Pavement (which in Aramaic is Gabbatha).

ekegusii: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,
english: Erio Pilato agachia koigwa ring’ana erio, akaba nobwoba kobua.

ekegusii: Ekero Pilato achia korora ng’a gento tikenyarekaneti asare, ne riroroche rioka rikona‐kobucha, akaimokia amache, agaisaba amaboko aye ase obosio bw’omoganda, ogoteba, “Inche tindi na komocha ase amanyinga ’omonto oyo omonyene oboronge. Nigoro yaino abanyene.”
english: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that instead an uproar was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. "I am innocent of this man's blood," he said. "It is your responsibility!"

ekegusii: Bakaegwa endagera korwa ase emesa ya Yusufu, korende Benjamin ere akarenterwa enyinge kobua abwo bande, ebirengo bitano. Naboigo bakanywa, bakagoka amo nere.
english: When portions were served to them from Joseph's table, Benjamin's portion was five times as much as anyone else's. So they feasted and drank freely with him.

ekegusii: Ekero oboenenu bwachire, nobosooku nario bogocha, korende obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase abanto abaitongo.
english: When pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with humility comes wisdom.

ekegusii: Ekero Raeli aroche ng’a tari koiborera Yakobo abana, akarorera mosubati omwabo ribero, agatebia Yakobo, “Ing’a abana! Otabang’eti, rirorio nigo ndakwe!”
english: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing Jacob any children, she became jealous of her sister. So she said to Jacob, "Give me children, or I'll die!"

ekegusii: Korende ekero Rebeka atebigwa aya Esau, omwana oye omonene, agoteba, agatoma omonto korangeria Yakobo, omwana oye omoke, akamotebia, “Rora, momura omino Esau ogotianeire ng’a agoite.
english: When Rebekah was told what her older son Esau had said, she sent for her younger son Jacob and said to him, "Your brother Esau is consoling himself with the thought of killing you.

ekegusii: Ekero Rehoboamu achete Yerusalemu, agasangereria abanto b’enyomba ya Yuda, na ab’eya Benjamin, abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato (180,000), abamanyete korwana esegi, ng’a bagende korwania Abaisraeli bairanie oboruoti ase Rehoboamu.
english: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered the house of Judah and Benjamin-- a hundred and eighty thousand fighting men-- to make war against Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam.

ekegusii: Ekero Rehoboamu achete Yerusalemu, agasangereria abanto bonsi b’enyomba ya Yuda, na egesaku kia Benjamin, abanto chilifu rigana erimo na emerongo etano na etato, abamanyete korwana esegi, bagende korwania Abaisraeli na bairanie oboruoti ase Rehoboamu, mosinto o Sulemani.
english: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered the whole house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin-- a hundred and eighty thousand fighting men-- to make war against the house of Israel and to regain the kingdom for Rehoboam son of Solomon.

ekegusii: When Reu had lived 32 years, he became the father of Serug.
english: Ekero Reu abeire nemiaka emerongo etato, na ebere (32), akaibora Serugi,

ekegusii: Reuben ekero ayaigwete, akarigia komotooria korwa ase amaboko abo, akabatebia, “Titomoita akwe.”
english: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue him from their hands. "Let's not take his life," he said.

ekegusii: Reuben agachia koirana korigereria ase engoro, akanyora Yusufu taiyo ase engoro, ere agatandora chianga chiaye,
english: When Reuben returned to the cistern and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes.

ekegusii: Ekero Rutu aigete ase ng’ina biara, ere akamoboria, “Mang’ana ki, omwana one?” Rutu akamotebia amang’ana onsi Boazi amokorerete.
english: When Ruth came to her mother-in-law, Naomi asked, "How did it go, my daughter?" Then she told her everything Boaz had done for her

ekegusii: Samula nere agakwa, na Sauli, oyo orwete Rehoboti, omochie orenge orooche ensemo, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ekero Samula akwete, Sauli oyo orwete Rehoboti, orenge ang’e norooche rw’Eufarati, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ase igo Samweli akarenta ebisaku bionsi bi’Abaisraeli ang’e, na egesaku kia Benjamin kegachorwa ase ogoakerwa obomera.
english: When Samuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, the tribe of Benjamin was chosen.

ekegusii: Ekero Samweli aroche Saulo, Omonene akamotebia, “Omonto oyio nere nagotebia amang’ana aye. Oyo nere orabe okogambera abanto baane.”
english: When Samuel caught sight of Saul, the LORD said to him, "This is the man I spoke to you about; he will govern my people."

ekegusii: Ekero Samweli konya agotire akabeka abamura baye babe abagambi igoro y’Abaisraeli.
english: When Samuel grew old, he appointed his sons as judges for Israel.

ekegusii: Ekero Samweli aigwete amang’ana aya abanto bakwanire, akayaira ase Omonene.
english: When Samuel heard all that the people said, he repeated it before the LORD.

ekegusii: Erio Samweli akagenda ase Saulo, na Saulo akamokwania, akamotebia, “Omonene agosesenie. Naikeranirie aya Omonene anchigete.”
english: When Samuel reached him, Saul said, "The LORD bless you! I have carried out the LORD's instructions."

ekegusii: Ekero Sanibalati aigwete ng’a intwe Abayahudi konya twachakire koagacha orwaki rw’omochie naende, akaba nekeririanda ekenene, agachaka gotochecheria.
english: When Sanballat heard that we were rebuilding the wall, he became angry and was greatly incensed. He ridiculed the Jews,

ekegusii: Korende ekero Sanibalati korwa Beti-Horoni, na Tobia, omonene bw’orogongo rw’Abaamoni, baigwete ng’a omonto gete ochire gokorera Abaisraeli amaya, bakagechigwa bakaba nekeririanda ekenene mono.
english: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about this, they were very much disturbed that someone had come to promote the welfare of the Israelites.

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo aigwete amang’ana ayio, Omoika o Nyasae ogacha igoro asare, okamobeka chinguru; erio Saulo akaba nendamwamu enene.
english: When Saul heard their words, the Spirit of God came upon him in power, and he burned with anger.

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo abarete Abaisraeli agwo Bezeki, nigo barenge chilifu amagana atato (300,000), na Abayuda chilifu emerongo etato (30,000).
english: When Saul mustered them at Bezek, the men of Israel numbered three hundred thousand and the men of Judah thirty thousand.

ekegusii: Saulo akarora na akamanya ng’a Omonene nigo arenge amo na Daudi, naende ng’a Mikali, omoiseke oye, nigo amwanchete Daudi.
english: When Saul realized that the LORD was with David and that his daughter Michal loved David,

ekegusii: When Saul saw how successful he was, he was afraid of him.
english: Ekero Saulo aroche ng’a Daudi onyorire obobui, akamwoboa mono kobua.

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo aroche abarwani b’Abafilisti agasogwa nomoondoko, na enkoro yaye ekaiguswa mono.
english: When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid; terror filled his heart.

ekegusii: Erio abanto batometwe na Saulo kwoyia Daudi bachete, na Mikali akabatebia, “Orwarire.”
english: When Saul sent the men to capture David, Michal said, "He is ill."

ekegusii: When Saul was told that David had fled to Gath, he no longer searched for him.
english: Ekero Saulo atebetigwe ng’a Daudi konya otamire gochia Gati, tagendete komorigia.

ekegusii: When Saul's servants told him what David had said,
english: Abasomba abwo bagachia gotebia Saulo aya Daudi akwanete,

ekegusii: When Serug had lived 30 years, he became the father of Nahor.
english: Ekero Serugi abeire nemiaka emerongo etato (30) akaibora Nahori.

ekegusii: When Seth had lived 105 years, he became the father of Enosh.
english: Ekero Seti abeire nemiaka rigana erimo, na etano (105), akaibora Enosu.

ekegusii: Sauli nere agakwa, na Baali‐Hanani mosinto o Akibori akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Acbor succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Ekero Sauli akwete, Baali Hanani, mosinto bw’Akibori, akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Acbor succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Goika ochia kobatiswa, ere amo nab’enyomba yaye, agatosorora, ogoteba, “Onye mwandorire ng’a nomwegeni nde ase Omonene, soa nyomba mwane, moikaranse.” Agatobetereria.
english: When she and the members of her household were baptized, she invited us to her home. "If you consider me a believer in the Lord," she said, "come and stay at my house." And she persuaded us.

ekegusii: Korende akagenderera gokora obonyaka bwaye maiso marore, akaorokia nobogetirianda bwaye, goika inche nkagechigwa nere buna nagechetigwe na Ohola, mosubati omwabo.
english: When she carried on her prostitution openly and exposed her nakedness, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.

ekegusii: Erio agachia koigwa amang’ana igoro ya Yeso, agaeta ase omoganda korwa nyuma, agakuna eanga yaye,
english: When she heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his cloak,

ekegusii: Naomi kare agwo ase ense y’Abamoabu akaigwa ng’a Omonene ororeire abanto baye amabera, obaeire endagera naende; ase ayio akamanora korua ense eria amo na baka bamura baye.
english: When she heard in Moab that the LORD had come to the aid of his people by providing food for them, Naomi and her daughters-in-law prepared to return home from there.

ekegusii: Buna anyororokeria amaguta aya ase omobere one, onkoreire aya ase okombeka ang’e ase ogotindekwa kwane.
english: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

ekegusii: Na ekero aigete ase egetunwa ase omonto oria o Nyasae, akabwata amagoro aye. Gehasi agacha komorusia aroro. Korende omonto oria o Nyasae akamotebia, “Motige, ekiagera nigo are nobororo obonge; na Omonene obisire amang’ana ayio korwa asende, tantebetie gento.”
english: When she reached the man of God at the mountain, she took hold of his feet. Gehazi came over to push her away, but the man of God said, "Leave her alone! She is in bitter distress, but the LORD has hidden it from me and has not told me why."

ekegusii: Kamanyire eriogi ria Petero, akaba nomogoko, taigora egesieri, korende akaminyoka, agasoa nyomba, akabatebia ng’a Petero ngesieri ateneine.
english: When she recognized Peter's voice, she was so overjoyed she ran back without opening it and exclaimed, "Peter is at the door!"

ekegusii: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked closely at him. "You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus," she said.
english: akarora Petero ogwota omorero, akamorigereria, agateba, “Aye naye kwarenge amo noria Omonazareti, Yeso.”

ekegusii: Omokungu oria, ekero aroche ng’a Yusufu omotigeire eanga yaye koboko kwaye, na gotama gochia isiko,
english: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,

ekegusii: Ekero Sekemu, omwana o Hamori Omohivi, omonene bw’ense eria, amoroche, akamobwata, akarara nere, akamosareria obwekungi bwaye.
english: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the ruler of that area, saw her, he took her and violated her.

ekegusii: When Shelah had lived 30 years, he became the father of Eber.
english: Ekero Sela abeire nemiaka emerongo etato (30), akaibora Eberi.

ekegusii: Sisaki, omoruoti o Misiri, akagenda akarwania Yerusalemu, akaira chinibo chi’enyomba y’Omonene na echi’enyomba y’omoruoti; akaira kera egento. Boigo akaira chinguba chi’etahabu chiria Sulemani agonchete.
english: When Shishak king of Egypt attacked Jerusalem, he carried off the treasures of the temple of the LORD and the treasures of the royal palace. He took everything, including the gold shields Solomon had made.

ekegusii: Erio Sihoni amo nabanto baye bonsi bagacha gotorwania esegi, ekero twarenge ase omochie o Yahasi,
english: When Sihon and all his army came out to meet us in battle at Jahaz,

ekegusii: Korende ekero Sila na Timotheo bachia gotirimboka korwa Makedonia, Paulo agasukigwa mono ase okorandia ring’ana na koorokia ase Abayahudi nomokia ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.
english: When Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, Paul devoted himself exclusively to preaching, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

ekegusii: Korende Simion Petero, agachia korora aya, akagwa ase amaru a Yeso, akabora, “Omonene, karue asende, ekiagera inche nomonto omonyene ebibe!”
english: When Simon Peter saw this, he fell at Jesus' knees and said, "Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!"

ekegusii: Ekero Simion achia korora ng’a abanto nigo bakoegwa Omoika ase okobekerwa amaboko nabatomwa, akabarentera chibesa,
english: When Simon saw that the Spirit was given at the laying on of the apostles' hands, he offered them money

ekegusii: Ekero Sulemani akoorete ogosaba kwaye, omorero ogacha korwa igoro ogasamba ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso binde, na obonene bw’Omonene bogaichora ase Hekalu ime.
english: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple.

ekegusii: Bono ekero Sulemani akoorete ogosaba oko gwonsi na okoboria Omonene ase oboitongo, akaimoka korwa ase egesasimero ki’Omonene aase atung’amete namaru aye inse oramborete amaboko aye gochia igoro,
english: When Solomon had finished all these prayers and supplications to the LORD, he rose from before the altar of the LORD, where he had been kneeling with his hands spread out toward heaven.

ekegusii: Ekero Sulemani konya akoorire koagacha enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’oboruoti, na aande onsi ase anchete koagacha,
english: When Solomon had finished building the temple of the LORD and the royal palace, and had achieved all he had desired to do,

ekegusii: Sulemani agakoora koagacha enyomba y’Omonene, na enyomba y’omoruoti, na ebio bionsi Sulemani aroberetie gokora ase enyomba y’Omonene na ase enyomba yaye omonyene; akabiikerania na kobikoora buya.
english: When Solomon had finished the temple of the LORD and the royal palace, and had succeeded in carrying out all he had in mind to do in the temple of the LORD and in his own palace,

ekegusii: Ekero Sulemani atebetigwe ng’a Simei narua Yerusalemu, akagenda Gati, naende akairana,
english: When Solomon was told that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had returned,

ekegusii: When some of those standing near heard this, they said, "Listen, he's calling Elijah."
english: Na abande b’abwo bateneine ang’e koyaigwa bakabora, “Rora, nkorangeria are Elija.”

ekegusii: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, "He's calling Elijah."
english: Na abande b’abwo bateneine aroro, bakayaigwa, bakabora, “Omonto oyo n’Elija akorangeria.”

ekegusii: Abasomba abwo bakarora obosooku obonene mono, na ekero Daudi atebetigwe buna bakoretwe, agatoma abanto bachie kobarotota na kobatebia, “Omoruoti otebire ng’a mobeere agwo Yeriko goika chinderu chiaino chimere, erio monyare koirana nka.”
english: When someone came and told David about the men, he sent messengers to meet them, for they were greatly humiliated. The king said, "Stay at Jericho till your beards have grown, and then come back."

ekegusii: Omonto aise koba aiga, oyo oigwete amang’ana’okobwatana okwo kw’ogotianania naende eremie abe nobomaene ime ase enkoro yaye, erio akwane: Nabo erabe buya asende nonya nkogenderera koba omotaigweri, oyio nigo arabasirie mwensi, abamogotinda na abamore nerang’o.
english: When such a person hears the words of this oath, he invokes a blessing on himself and therefore thinks, "I will be safe, even though I persist in going my own way." This will bring disaster on the watered land as well as the dry.

ekegusii: bono omwaga bwe chinguru ocha korwa ase erooro, onyegeria chikoona inye chi’enyomba eria, erinde yagwera abana abwo abasae, bakure bonsi; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogotebia.”
english: when suddenly a mighty wind swept in from the desert and struck the four corners of the house. It collapsed on them and they are dead, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"

ekegusii: Ekero Tamari atebetigwe ng’a ise biara nkogenda akare Timuna konacha ching’ondi chiaye amarionya,
english: When Tamar was told, "Your father-in-law is on his way to Timnah to shear his sheep,"

ekegusii: Omonto karateemwe, tateba, “Nateemirwe na Nyasae,” ekiagera Nyasae tagoteemwa namabe, gose tagoteema omonto.
english: When tempted, no one should say, "God is tempting me." For God cannot be tempted by evil, nor does he tempt anyone;

ekegusii: Ekero ogosirigwa korabachere mbarigie omorembe, korende tibakoyonyora.
english: When terror comes, they will seek peace, but there will be none.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio namobe mokorera nobororo ase engencho y’omoruoti oino, oyio mwechorerete, korende Omonene takoba ogotegerera okorera kwaino.”
english: When that day comes, you will cry out for relief from the king you have chosen, and the LORD will not answer you in that day."
