ekegusii: Omwaka oria oyomo okaera. Naende omwaka o kabere bakamochiera, bakamotebia, “Titokonyara gokobisa, omonene oito, ng’a chibesa chiaito chiaerire, ne chitugo chiaito chiabeire echiao. Titotigareti gento kende togokoa, omonene oito, otatiga emebere yaito na amaremo aito.
english: When that year was over, they came to him the following year and said, "We cannot hide from our lord the fact that since our money is gone and our livestock belongs to you, there is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land.

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene ore Omobui asiarerete abaruoti b’aase agwo, amagena ’embura agatwa ase egetunwa gia Salimoni.
english: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like snow fallen on Zalmon.

ekegusii: Engaki eria Omonguru nigo arenge amo nainche, na abana baane nigo bang’etanaine;
english: when the Almighty was still with me and my children were around me,

ekegusii: Ase rituko riria egesasimero giatananetwe na goakwa amaguta, abatang’ani bakarenta okoruegwa kwabo bosio bw’egesasimero.
english: When the altar was anointed, the leaders brought their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.

ekegusii: Abaamoni bakamanya ng’a bekorire koba okogechia ase Daudi, erio Hanuni na Abaamoni bagatoma chifeta chitalanta elifu eyemo goakanera chigari na abariini chibarasi chiare korwa Mesopotamia na Aramu‐Maaka, na korwa Soba.
english: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench in David's nostrils, Hanun and the Ammonites sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and charioteers from Aram Naharaim, Aram Maacah and Zobah.

ekegusii: Abaamoni bakamanya ng’a bagechirie Daudi. Ase igo bagasaba Abasiiria ba Beti‐Rehobu na Soba babae abarwani babo chilifu emerongo ebere (20,000), na omoruoti o Maaka ache amo nabarwani baye elifu eyemo (1,000); naende bagasaba baegwe abarwani chilifu ikomi na ibere (12,000) korwa Tobu.
english: When the Ammonites realized that they had become a stench in David's nostrils, they hired twenty thousand Aramean foot soldiers from Beth Rehob and Zobah, as well as the king of Maacah with a thousand men, and also twelve thousand men from Tob.

ekegusii: Abaamoni bagachia korora ng’a Abasiiria batamire, na barabwo boigo bagatama korwa ase Abisai, bagasoa omochie ime. Erio Yoabu agatiga korwana n’Abaamoni, akairana Yerusalemu.
english: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans were fleeing, they fled before Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab returned from fighting the Ammonites and came to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abaamoni bagachia korora ng’a Abasiiria batamire, nabarabwo boigo bagatama korwa ase Abisai, momura omwabo Yoabu, bagasoa omochie ime. Erio Yoabu akagenda Yerusalemu.
english: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans were fleeing, they too fled before his brother Abishai and went inside the city. So Joab went back to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Abaamoni bakarangerigwa gocha korwana, bagatoora agwo Gileadi, korende Abaisraeli bagasangererigwa, bagatoora agwo Misipa.
english: When the Ammonites were called to arms and camped in Gilead, the Israelites assembled and camped at Mizpah.

ekegusii: Ekero chibesa chiria chiarengirwe, nigo chiare koruegwa ase amaboko ’abanto baria batenenerete emeremo y’enyomba y’Omonene. Nabarabwo nigo barenge goakana ching’eria ase abasenia be chibao na abaagachi barenge gokora emeremo ase enyomba y’Omonene,
english: When the amount had been determined, they gave the money to the men appointed to supervise the work on the temple. With it they paid those who worked on the temple of the LORD-- the carpenters and builders,

ekegusii: Omomalaika bw’Omonene akamoorokera agwo, akamotebia, “Omonene nigo are amo naye, aye omonto omoremu ase okorwana esegi!”
english: When the angel of the LORD appeared to Gideon, he said, "The LORD is with you, mighty warrior."

ekegusii: Korwa ekero keria omomalaika oria taoroka ase Manoa naende, gose ase omorugi oye, Erio Manoa akamanya ng’a oria nigo arenge omomalaika bw’Omonene.
english: When the angel of the LORD did not show himself again to Manoah and his wife, Manoah realized that it was the angel of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika bw’Omonene atebetie Abaisraeli bonsi amang’ana ayio, barabwo bagachaka korera.
english: When the angel of the LORD had spoken these things to all the Israelites, the people wept aloud,

ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika aramborete okoboko kwaye asirie Yerusalemu, Omonene akaonchora ebirengererio biaye ase amabe ayio, agatebia omomalaika oria orenge gosiria abanto, “Bono aisanire, ororobia okoboko kwao.” Omomalaika konya oikire ang’e nekeooreri ki’Arauna Omoyebusi.
english: When the angel stretched out his hand to destroy Jerusalem, the LORD was grieved because of the calamity and said to the angel who was afflicting the people, "Enough! Withdraw your hand." The angel of the LORD was then at the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

ekegusii: Ekero omomalaika, oria okwanete nere, aimoka korwa aroro, Kornelio akarangeria abasomba baye babere na omorwani oyomo osigete Nyasae korwa ase baria bare komokorera botambe,
english: When the angel who spoke to him had gone, Cornelius called two of his servants and a devout soldier who was one of his attendants.

ekegusii: Ekero abamalaika abwo bachia koimoka kogenda igoro, abarisia baria bagatebania, “Gaki togende goika Bethlehemu, torore ring’ana eri riakorekire, eri Omonene atomanyirie.”
english: When the angels had left them and gone into heaven, the shepherds said to one another, "Let's go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has told us about."

ekegusii: Na ekero abatomwa ba Yerusalemu bachia koigwa ng’a Abasamaria banchire ring’ana ria Nyasae, bakabatomera Petero na Yohana.
english: When the apostles in Jerusalem heard that Samaria had accepted the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them.

ekegusii: Abatomwa baria ekero bachia koirana bagatebia Yeso amang’ana onsi ayabakorire. Erio akabaira, akagenda amo nabarabwo bobisi gochia ase omochie okorokwa Bethisaida.
english: When the apostles returned, they reported to Jesus what they had done. Then he took them with him and they withdrew by themselves to a town called Bethsaida,

ekegusii: Na ekero Abasiiria ba Damesiki bachete gokonya Hadadeseri, omoruoti o Soba, Daudi akabarwania, agaita abanto chilifu emerongo ebere na ibere (22,000).
english: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.

ekegusii: Na ekero Abasiiria ba Damesiki bachete gokonya Hadadeseri, omoruoti o Soba, Daudi akabarwania, agaita abanto chilifu emerongo eberena ibere (22,000).
english: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of them.

ekegusii: Abasiiria bakagenda bagatiga Yoashi ore oakirwe chingoma chimbe. Korende abasomba baye bagakora omoroberio bw’okomoita, ekiagera aiterete amanyinga ’omwana o Yehoyada omokuani; bakagenda bakamoitera borere bwaye, agakwa; na abanto bakamotindeka ase Omochie o Daudi, korende tibamotindegete ase chimbeera chi’abaruoti.
english: When the Arameans withdrew, they left Joash severely wounded. His officials conspired against him for murdering the son of Jehoiada the priest, and they killed him in his bed. So he died and was buried in the City of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.

ekegusii: Esanduku eria y’Omonene ekabeera ase ense y’Abafilisti ase engaki y’emetienyi etano na ebere.
english: When the ark of the LORD had been in Philistine territory seven months,

ekegusii: Ekero Esanduku eria y’Okobwatana kw’Omonene yaigete ase egetwori, Abaisraeli bonsi bagaaka amariogi amanene goika ense ekoga.
english: When the ark of the LORD's covenant came into the camp, all Israel raised such a great shout that the ground shook.

ekegusii: Ekero omobogoria ebirwanero aroche ayio, nere akegweria ase omoyio oye, agakwa amo na Saulo.
english: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died with him.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto oria omobogoria ebirwanero aroche ng’a Saulo okure, nere akegweria ase omoyio oye omonyene, agakwa.
english: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell on his sword and died.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti oyio o irianyi arabe osiririe omoganda oria, enkoro yaye inayeimokererie igoro, korende naisa goita chilifu chinyinge, takonyara kobua.
english: When the army is carried off, the king of the South will be filled with pride and will slaughter many thousands, yet he will not remain triumphant.

ekegusii: Ekero abasomba baria batebetie Daudi amang’ana aria Saulo atebete, Daudi akagokigwa naro ng’a omoruoti abe ise biara. Ekero engaki eria konya etaraika,
english: When the attendants told David these things, he was pleased to become the king's son-in-law. So before the allotted time elapsed,

ekegusii: Na ekero omwana oria aigete aase omogwe oria ogwete, Yonathani agaaka eriogi, akamotebia, “Omogwe oyio ore bosio bwao, aaria moino.”
english: When the boy came to the place where Jonathan's arrow had fallen, Jonathan called out after him, "Isn't the arrow beyond you?"

ekegusii: When the brothers learned of this, they took him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.
english: Ekero abamwabo bachia konyora amang’ana aya, bakamoira goika Kaisaria, bakamotoma agende Tariso.

ekegusii: Ase ayio aba ng’ina rome bagakwana amang’ana ayio ase abanto ba Sekemu ase ogokonya Abimeleki, na bonsi bakang’uswa bakaba ase ensemo yaye, naende bagateba ng’a ere nere orenge oyomwabo.
english: When the brothers repeated all this to the citizens of Shechem, they were inclined to follow Abimelech, for they said, "He is our brother."

ekegusii: Ekero abaagachi bachagete kobeka oboroso bwe Hekalu y’Omonene, abakuani babegete chianga chi’obokuani bagacha nebirombeta, na Abalawi abarenge b’ororeria rw’Asafu babwate chisani chigoakanigwa kwoga, ase okomotogia Omonene, koreng’ana buna Daudi, omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli, achigete.
english: When the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, the priests in their vestments and with trumpets, and the Levites (the sons of Asaph) with cymbals, took their places to praise the LORD, as prescribed by David king of Israel.

ekegusii: Ekero chingamia chiakoorire konywa amache, omonto oria akamoruseria ekegera gi’etahabu, kiare noborito bwe chigiramu isano na isato, na ebitange bibere bie chitahabu ase amaboko aye, ebiare noborito bwe chigiramu rigana erimo, na emerongo etano,
english: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took out a gold nose ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets weighing ten shekels.

ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barabe bakomanora na koimoka korwa ase ebitwori, Haroni amo nabamura baye babe bagosoa ase Eema ime, basungore egetambaa keria gekengete Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire oborori, na gotuba Esanduku eria negetambaa ekio.
english: When the camp is to move, Aaron and his sons are to go in and take down the shielding curtain and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti oyomo Omokanani, oyorenge kogamba agwo Aradi, ensemo ya irianyi ase ense ya Kanani, aigwete ng’a Abaisraeli nigo bare ase enchera ekogenda Atarimu, akabaumokera, akabarwania, na agoosa abande babo.
english: When the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim, he attacked the Israelites and captured some of them.

ekegusii: Na Abakanani abamenyete ase ense eria, ekero bachia korora ebirero agwo Atadi ase ekeooreri, bakabora, “Ebirero ebi bi’Abamisiri nebinene mono.” Ase ayio, aase aria ng’umbu ya Yorodan akarokwa Abeli‐Misiri.
english: When the Canaanites who lived there saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, "The Egyptians are holding a solemn ceremony of mourning." That is why that place near the Jordan is called Abel Mizraim.

ekegusii: Abarwani baria be chibarasi bagachia goika Kaisaria, bakaa gavuna rirube riria, bakabeka na Paulo ase obosio bwaye.
english: When the cavalry arrived in Caesarea, they delivered the letter to the governor and handed Paul over to him.

ekegusii: Na ekero omotang’ani bw’abarwani rigana, na abwo barenge amo nere korenda Yeso, bachia korora omotengecho bw’ense na ebiakorekire, bakairoka mono, bakabora, “Ekeene, oyo nigo arenge Omwana o Nyasae!”
english: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified, and exclaimed, "Surely he was the Son of God!"

ekegusii: Omotang’ani oria ochia koigwa aya, akagenda akorokia omotang’ani oria omonene, akabora, “Naki origetie gokora? Ekiagera omonto oyo n’Omorumi are.”
english: When the centurion heard this, he went to the commander and reported it. "What are you going to do?" he asked. "This man is a Roman citizen."

ekegusii: Ekero abateneneri be chigari baroche Yehosafati, bagateba, “Ere ekeene nomoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.” Ase ayio bakaonchoka bakarwana nere, na Yehosafati akarera rimo.
english: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, "Surely this is the king of Israel." So they turned to attack him, but when Jehoshaphat cried out,

ekegusii: Ekero abateneneri be chigari baroche Yehosafati, bagateba, “Nere omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli.” Ase ayio bakaonchoka bakarwana nere, na Yehosafati akarera mono, na Omonene akamokonya. Nyasae akabang’usa bakarua asare,
english: When the chariot commanders saw Jehoshaphat, they thought, "This is the king of Israel." So they turned to attack him, but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the LORD helped him. God drew them away from him,

ekegusii: Ekero abakerubi baria barenge kogenda naboigo na amagoro aria naro arenge goeta mbarabare yabo, na ekero abakerubi baria barenge korambora chimbaba chiabo ase okoimoka gochia igoro, amagoro aria tarenge gwatananeka korwa asebare.
english: When the cherubim moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the cherubim spread their wings to rise from the ground, the wheels did not leave their side.

ekegusii: Ekero barenge gotenena, na amagoro aria naro atenena; ekero barenge koimoka gochia igoro, na amagoro aria aimoka amo nabarabwo, ekiagera omoika bw’ebitongwa biria nigo orenge ime yabo.
english: When the cherubim stood still, they also stood still; and when the cherubim rose, they rose with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in them.

ekegusii: Ekero omoteneneri bw’abaroisia emegati aroche ng’a okoonchora okwo nigo kwabete okuya, agatebia Yusufu, “Nainche boigo nigo narotete. Nkarora ng’a inyetwegete chinteru isato chire nemegati emerabu ase omotwe one.
english: When the chief baker saw that Joseph had given a favorable interpretation, he said to Joseph, "I too had a dream: On my head were three baskets of bread.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa emereng’anio yaye, abakuani abanene na Abafarisai bakamanya ng’a nabwo agoteba.
english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard Jesus' parables, they knew he was talking about them.

ekegusii: Na ekero basangererekanire amo nabagaaka, na kobaroisirie amang’ana, bakaa abarendi baria chibesa chinyinge,
english: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,

ekegusii: Ekero omwana oria akinire, omokungu oria akamoirania ase omoiseke o Farao koba omwana oye na ere akamoroka Musa, ogoteba, “Ndooche namorusetie.”
english: When the child grew older, she took him to Pharaoh's daughter and he became her son. She named him Moses, saying, "I drew him out of the water."

ekegusii: Ekero riire riria riaruete ase Eema eria, omobere o Miriamu konya obeire noborwaire bwa ukoma, okaraba se. Haroni akaonchoka komorigereria, akarora ng’a omobere oye obeire noborwaire bwa ukoma.
english: When the cloud lifted from above the Tent, there stood Miriam-- leprous, like snow. Aaron turned toward her and saw that she had leprosy;

ekegusii: Onye riire riria riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko amange, Abaisraeli nigo baigwerete Omonene, na barabwo tibarenge komanora kogenda.
english: When the cloud remained over the tabernacle a long time, the Israelites obeyed the LORD's order and did not set out.

ekegusii: Omochiki oria bw’abarendi akaira Yeremia ensemo, akamotebia, “Omonene, Nyasae oo, nararetie ng’a amang’ana aya amabe nayenyore ense eye.
english: When the commander of the guard found Jeremiah, he said to him, "The LORD your God decreed this disaster for this place.

ekegusii: Ekero omosangererekano bw’esinagogi oera, Abayahudi abange na abegeni b’ebisaku binde abaonchogete bakabwatana na Paulo na Barnaba, abakwanete nabarabwo, na kobaremia bagenderere ase obuya bwa Nyasae.
english: When the congregation was dismissed, many of the Jews and devout converts to Judaism followed Paul and Barnabas, who talked with them and urged them to continue in the grace of God.

ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa ebio biarenge kogenda, okoeera gwe chimbaba chiabo nigo kwarenge ase amato aane buna okw’amache amange, buna eriogi ri’Omonguru, ee, nigo kwarenge buna okwoga kw’emeganda y’esegi. Ekero biarenge gotenena, nigo biarenge kwororobia chimbaba chiabo gochia inse.
english: When the creatures moved, I heard the sound of their wings, like the roar of rushing waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army. When they stood still, they lowered their wings.

ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa biria biarenge kogenda, na amagoro aria nabo arenge kogenda; ekero biarenge gotenena, naro nabo arenge gotenena; ekero biarenge koimokerera igoro korwa inse ase riroba, naro nabo arenge koimokerera igoro mbarabare yabo, ekiagera omoika bw’ebitongwa biria bire moyo nigo orenge ime ase amagoro aria.
english: When the creatures moved, they also moved; when the creatures stood still, they also stood still; and when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels rose along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

ekegusii: Emeganda egachia korora aya, bakooboa, bakamotogia Nyasae, oyoete mwanyabanto okobua konga buna oko.
english: When the crowd saw this, they were filled with awe; and they praised God, who had given such authority to men.

ekegusii: Ekero emeganda yachia korora aya Paulo akora, bagaaka amariogi abo, bagakwana ase Ekelukania, “Chinyasae chiatoikeire ase emegwekano ya mwanyabanto!”
english: When the crowd saw what Paul had done, they shouted in the Lycaonian language, "The gods have come down to us in human form!"

ekegusii: Emeganda yonsi ase omoyo oyomo bagategerera amang’ana onsi Filipo are gokwana, ekero bamoigwete na korora ebikone ebiarenge gokora.
english: When the crowds heard Philip and saw the miraculous signs he did, they all paid close attention to what he said.

ekegusii: Ekero omoganda ochia koigwa aya, ogakumia ase okworokereria kwaye.
english: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.

ekegusii: Ekero omoiseke bwe Herodia asoa gotenga, akagokia Herode amo nabwo baikaransete nere ase omoyega. Omoruoti agatebia omoiseke oria, “Nsabe kende gionsi ekio origetie, na inche ninkoe.”
english: When the daughter of Herodias came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his dinner guests. The king said to the girl, "Ask me for anything you want, and I'll give it to you."

ekegusii: Ekero rituko ria Pentekosti riaigete, bonsi nigo barenge aase amo.
english: When the day of Pentecost came, they were all together in one place.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko okomoreera Israeli aerete, Yusufu agakwana nabanto b’enka ya Farao, akabora, “Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase amaiso aino, komoranche monteberie Farao
english: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh's court, "If I have found favor in your eyes, speak to Pharaoh for me. Tell him,

ekegusii: Ensemo eyemo ya isato y’etukia eyio oyesambere gati‐gati y’omochie, ekero amatuko ay’okoyoboera kaerire; na ensemo ende ya isato oyeake nomoyio oria goetanana ase omochie oria; na ensemo ende ya isato oyesiarere eirurukigwe nomwaga, na inche ninyebwatie nomoro one.
english: When the days of your siege come to an end, burn a third of the hair with fire inside the city. Take a third and strike it with the sword all around the city. And scatter a third to the wind. For I will pursue them with drawn sword.

ekegusii: Naki kobaraboke korwa ase abakure, tibakonyuoma, korende nigo barabe buna abamalaika bare igoro.
english: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.

ekegusii: Ebirecha biria bigasoka korwa ase omonto oria, bigasoa chimbeche. Riicho riria rigatirimboka bwango gochia ase egeturunkano goika chikagwa enyancha ime, chikarimera.
english: When the demons came out of the man, they went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.

ekegusii: Saitani agachia gokoora ogoteema kwaye gwonsi, akaimoka korwa asare, akamotiga ase egeka.
english: When the devil had finished all this tempting, he left him until an opportune time.

ekegusii: Mana eyio nigo yarenge kogwa amo ne riime ase ebitwori ekero kia botuko.
english: When the dew settled on the camp at night, the manna also came down.

ekegusii: Na ekero riime riakamokire, bakarora inse aria ase erooro ebinto binga buna amagoocho, bikarorekana buna obosie oborabu.
english: When the dew was gone, thin flakes like frost on the ground appeared on the desert floor.

ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bakagwa inse maumama, bakabwatwa nomoondoko omonene.
english: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown to the ground, terrified.

ekegusii: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, "Who then can be saved?"
english: Ekero aborokigwa bachia koigwa aya, bagakumia mono, bagateba, “Ning’o rende oranyare gotooreka?”

ekegusii: Aborokigwa baye Yakobo na Yohana bagachia korora, aya, bakabora, “Omonene, norigetie toborie omorero oike korwa igoro obasirie [buna Elija akorete]?”
english: When the disciples James and John saw this, they asked, "Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven to destroy them?"

ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa bachia komorora ogotaara ase enyancha igoro, bakaondoka, bakabora, “Eri nerirengari!” Bagaaka eriogi ase okoiroka.
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the lake, they were terrified. "It's a ghost," they said, and cried out in fear.

ekegusii: Ekero aborokigwa bachia korora ogokora oko, bagakumia, bakaboria, “Naki bono omoko oyo bwoma bwango iga?”
english: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. "How did the fig tree wither so quickly?" they asked.

ekegusii: Korende ekero aborokigwa baye bachia korora aya, bakagechigwa, bakabora, “Nobwa ki obosiru obo?
english: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant. "Why this waste?" they asked.

ekegusii: Etigere eria egachia korora omomalaika oria obwate omoyio o birende koboko kwaye, ekagobera gochia enchera ensemo, ekagenda ase omogondo. Baalamu agaaka etigere eria koyeirania ase enchera.
english: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with a drawn sword in his hand, she turned off the road into a field. Balaam beat her to get her back on the road.

ekegusii: Ekero etigere yaroche omomalaika oria, ekarara inse, na Baalamu oriinete omogongo igoro. Baalamu akaba nendamwamu enene mono, agaaka etigere eria nenyimbo yaye.
english: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she lay down under Balaam, and he was angry and beat her with his staff.

ekegusii: Etigere eria egachia korora omomalaika oria bw’Omonene, ekemigereria gochia orobago ang’e, ekabwaterania okogoro kwa Baalamu ase orobago, na Baalamu akayeaka naende.
english: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she pressed close to the wall, crushing Balaam's foot against it. So he beat her again.

ekegusii: Ebisieri birochie ase chinchera mbisiekwe, na amariogi ay’ogosia nakee; amariogi e chinyoni natabobore omonto korwa ase chitoro, na amariogi ’abaiseke bagotera nakee.
english: when the doors to the street are closed and the sound of grinding fades; when men rise up at the sound of birds, but all their songs grow faint;

ekegusii: Riruma riria rikairana chinsa chia mogoroba, na rora, ndiabwate rito ribese ri’omozeituni ase omonwa oye. Ase ayio Nuhu akamanya ng’a amache akamokire korwa ase ense.
english: When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth.

ekegusii: Na enchoka eria, ekero yachia korora ng’a yatugutirwe ase ense, egatunyana omokungu oria oiborete omwana omoisia.
english: When the dragon saw that he had been hurled to the earth, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

ekegusii: ekero riroba riabwatanire riomire pa, na amagakara abwatanire amo.
english: when the dust becomes hard and the clods of earth stick together?

ekegusii: Ekero ense egotengechigwa amo na bonsi abamenyeteo, ninche omonyene nigo nkobwata chisiiro chiaye bokong’u.
english: When the earth and all its people quake, it is I who hold its pillars firm. Selah

ekegusii: aande gose Abamisiri, ekero barakorore, nigo baratebe: Oyo mokaye; erio bang’ite inche, korende aye bagotige moyo.
english: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, 'This is his wife.' Then they will kill me but will let you live.

ekegusii: Bono ekero ababisa b’Abayuda, na ab’Ababenjamin baigwete ng’a abanto baria bairanire korwa ase obosomba naende ng’a nkoagachera bare Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, Hekalu,
english: When the enemies of Judah and Benjamin heard that the exiles were building a temple for the LORD, the God of Israel,

ekegusii: Ase igo, ekero enchara yasoete ase ense eria engima, Yusufu akaigora ebiage bionsi, akaooneria Abamisiri endagera, ekiagera enchara nigo yabete endito ase ense ya Misiri.
english: When the famine had spread over the whole country, Joseph opened the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe throughout Egypt.

ekegusii: Omochiki oria akairana, akanyora omoruoti bw’Abaasuri okorwana na Libuna, ekiagera aigwete ng’a omoruoti konya orure Lakisi.
english: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.

ekegusii: Rabi‐Sake akairana, ekiagera aigwete ng’a omoruoti bw’Abaasuri orure Lakisi, akamonyora okorwana na Libuna.
english: When the field commander heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish, he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah.

ekegusii: Korende ekero oboremo boria bogochia gotigwa ase engaki y’Omwaka bw’Omochengo, bobe obwatananirwe ase Omonene. Nigo borabe obw’omokuani.
english: When the field is released in the Jubilee, it will become holy, like a field devoted to the LORD; it will become the property of the priests.

ekegusii: When the foundations are being destroyed, what can the righteous do?"
english: Onye amaroso atagoirwe, ngento ki omonto omoronge aranyare gokora?”

ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’Ebisaku bachia koigwa ayio bakagoka, bagatogia ring’ana ri’Omonene, na abwo bachikeretwe konyora obogima bwa kare na kare bakeegena.
english: When the Gentiles heard this, they were glad and honored the word of the Lord; and all who were appointed for eternal life believed.

ekegusii: Ekero abaiseke baria bairanete ase Reueli ise, ere akababoria, “Nakimwakora rero mwairana bwango iga?”
english: When the girls returned to Reuel their father, he asked them, "Why have you returned so early today?"

ekegusii: Erio gavuna akorotera Paulo okoboko erinde akwane. Paulo akairaneria, “Amaene namanyire ng’a aye kwabeire omogambi ase egesaku eke ase ekero ki’emiaka emenge, igo ninyare gwekengera ase omoyo bw’omosasoko.
english: When the governor motioned for him to speak, Paul replied: "I know that for a number of years you have been a judge over this nation; so I gladly make my defense.

ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’amatunda yachia goika ang’e, agatoma abasomba baye ase abaremi, banyore amatunda aye.
english: When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.

ekegusii: Ekero obonyansi obokoro bwasirire, na oboyia nigo bokomera, na ebimeri bi’ebitunwa biasangererigwa,
english: When the hay is removed and new growth appears and the grass from the hills is gathered in,

ekegusii: Erio ensa egachia goika ang’e, agaikaransa amo nabatomwa.
english: When the hour came, Jesus and his apostles reclined at the table.

ekegusii: Abanyene ense eria, ekero barora eng’iti eria esung’unaine ase okoboko kwaye, bagatebania, “Takomocha omonto oyo koba omoiti, nonya otooregete korwa ase enyancha, oboronge tibokomotiga abe moyo.”
english: When the islanders saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said to each other, "This man must be a murderer; for though he escaped from the sea, Justice has not allowed him to live."

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli abwo barenge ensemo ende ase ense omweremo, na abwo narenge moocha ya Yorodan baigwete ng’a Abaisraeli konya batamire, na ng’a Saulo na abamura baye bakure, bagatiga emechie yabo bagatama. Erio Abafilisti bakagenda bakamenya ase emechie eyio.
english: When the Israelites along the valley and those across the Jordan saw that the Israelite army had fled and that Saul and his sons had died, they abandoned their towns and fled. And the Philistines came and occupied them.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli barerete ase Omonene ase engencho y’Abamidiani,
english: When the Israelites cried to the LORD because of Midian,

ekegusii: Abanto baria batoorete aria bakaigwa ng’a Simuri okorire omoroberio bw’ogoita omoruoti. Ase ayio, ekero Abaisraeli bonsi barenge ase egetwori ase rituko riria bakabeka Omuri, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, akaba omoruoti obo.
english: When the Israelites in the camp heard that Zimri had plotted against the king and murdered him, they proclaimed Omri, the commander of the army, king over Israel that very day there in the camp.

ekegusii: Erio Abaisraeli bakairana korwa ase baseretie Abafilisti bagasakora egetwori kiabo.
english: When the Israelites returned from chasing the Philistines, they plundered their camp.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli babiroche tibamanyete gose mbinto ki, bagachaka koborania barabwo ase barabwo, “Mbinto ki biria?” Musa akabatebia, “Oria nomogati oyo Omonene abaeire morie.
english: When the Israelites saw it, they said to each other, "What is it?" For they did not know what it was. Moses said to them, "It is the bread the LORD has given you to eat.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli baroche ng’a Abimeleki okure, bakairana nka, kera oyomo goika bwoye.
english: When the Israelites saw that Abimelech was dead, they went home.

ekegusii: When the Israelites saw the man, they all ran from him in great fear.
english: Ekero Abaisraeli baroche Goliato, bagatama bonsi, bakamwoboa mono.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bakaroberigwa na koariganerigwa chindagera, bakagenda korwania Abasiiria. Abaisraeli bagatoora korigererania n’Abasiiria, bakarorekana buna amaicho abere amake e chimbori, korende Abasiiria bagaichora aase aria.
english: When the Israelites were also mustered and given provisions, they marched out to meet them. The Israelites camped opposite them like two small flocks of goats, while the Arameans covered the countryside.

ekegusii: Korende Abayahudi ba Tesaloniki, ekero baigwete ng’a ring’ana ria Nyasae riarandigwe na Paulo ase Beroya, bakagenda aroro bakaburukania abanto na kobarubania.
english: When the Jews in Thessalonica learned that Paul was preaching the word of God at Berea, they went there too, agitating the crowds and stirring them up.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Abayahudi bachia korora emeganda, bagaichorwa ne ribero, bagakana amang’ana ayare gokwanwa na Paulo, bakamorama.
english: When the Jews saw the crowds, they were filled with jealousy and talked abusively against what Paul was saying.

ekegusii: Erio Abayahudi baria barenge amo nere nyomba ime bakomoremia, bagachia korora Mariamu buna aimoka bwango na gosoka, bakamotunyana, bakagete ng’a nigo akogenda embeera erinde arere aroro.
english: When the Jews who had been with Mary in the house, comforting her, noticed how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.

ekegusii: Engaki eyio abarendi b’enyomba mbaiguswe, na abasacha bare ne chinguru bekumbe, na abagosia batige gosia ekiagera bare abake ase omobaro, na abwo batengerete korwa ase ebibao, batubwe norotutu.
english: when the keepers of the house tremble, and the strong men stoop, when the grinders cease because they are few, and those looking through the windows grow dim;

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti achete korwa Damesiki agakerora, akageika ang’e, akarua ekeng’wanso igoro yaye.
english: When the king came back from Damascus and saw the altar, he approached it and presented offerings on it.

ekegusii: Omoruoti akagenda agaika Giligali na Kimuhamu akagenda amo nere. Abayuda bonsi, na abanto ekeng’ese ki’Abaisraeli nabarabwo bakagenda amo nere.
english: When the king crossed over to Gilgal, Kimham crossed with him. All the troops of Judah and half the troops of Israel had taken the king over.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti aigwete amang’ana ’omokungu oria, agatandora chianga chiaye. Ere nigo arenge gotaara ase orwaki igoro, na abanto barenge ang’e bakarora obegete chianga chie chigunia korwa ime ase omobere oye.
english: When the king heard the woman's words, he tore his robes. As he went along the wall, the people looked, and there, underneath, he had sackcloth on his body.

ekegusii: Na ekero omoruoti aigwete amang’ana ’Ebuku eria y’Amachiko agatandora chianga chiaye.
english: When the king heard the words of the Book of the Law, he tore his robes.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti aigwete amang’ana ’amachiko aria, agatandora chianga chiaye.
english: When the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his robes.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti aigwete amang’ana aria, agachandeka mono, akarigia enchera y’ogotooria Danieli. Goika ekero erioba korikogwa akaba ogendererete korigia enchera y’okomotooria.
english: When the king heard this, he was greatly distressed; he was determined to rescue Daniel and made every effort until sundown to save him.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti o Ai aroche amang’ana buna are, akaayerera amo nabanto baye baare omochie ime, bakebeka ang’e. Mambia chuni bagasoka korwania Abaisraeli agwo aase aragetwe, kororia Ekerubo Ekiomo. Korende omoruoti tamanyete ng’a abarwani mbaboete magega y’omochie.
english: When the king of Ai saw this, he and all the men of the city hurried out early in the morning to meet Israel in battle at a certain place overlooking the Arabah. But he did not know that an ambush had been set against him behind the city.

ekegusii: Ekero Farao, omoruoti o Misiri, atebetigwe ng’a Abaisraeli batamire, ere amo nabasomba baye bakaonchora ebirengererio biabo, bagateba, “Inki eke twakora? Tokaa Abaisraeli ribaga korua aa ase barenge gotokorera.”
english: When the king of Egypt was told that the people had fled, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about them and said, "What have we done? We have let the Israelites go and have lost their services!"

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli aroche abanto baria, akaboria Elisha, “Tata, ndaita abanto aba? Ndabaita?”
english: When the king of Israel saw them, he asked Elisha, "Shall I kill them, my father? Shall I kill them?"

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti bw’Abamoabu aroche ng’a esegi yamobuire, akaira abanto amagana atano na abere babogoretie emioro, akagania amigererie gochia ase omoruoti bw’Abaedomu, korende tanyarete.
english: When the king of Moab saw that the battle had gone against him, he took with him seven hundred swordsmen to break through to the king of Edom, but they failed.

ekegusii: Rora, abaruoti nigo basangererekanete, bagacha amo.
english: When the kings joined forces, when they advanced together,

ekegusii: Ekero ogochika koria okoyia kw’omoruoti kwararetigwe, na abaiseke basangereretigwe agwo ase eburi ya Susa, bakabekwa inse y’oborendi bwa Hegai, oyorenge omorendi bw’abakungu ase enyomba y’omoruoti; Esteri nigo arenge oyomo bw’abwo.
english: When the king's order and edict had been proclaimed, many girls were brought to the citadel of Susa and put under the care of Hegai. Esther also was taken to the king's palace and entrusted to Hegai, who had charge of the harem.

ekegusii: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, "Come!"
english: Ekero achia gosansora ekemanyererio gia kane, nkaigwa eriogi ri’eng’iti ya kane ere moyo ekobora, “Inchuo!”

ekegusii: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, "Come!"
english: Ekero Emanwa y’Eng’ondi achia gosansora ekemanyererio gia kabere, nkaigwa eng’iti ya kabere ere moyo ekobora, “Inchuo!”

ekegusii: Ekero achia gosansora ekemanyererio kia gatato, nkaigwa eng’iti ya gatato ere moyo ekobora, “Inchuo!” Nkarigereria, nkarora ebarasi emwamu, na ere oyoyeriinete narenge nekerengo gi’okorenga ase okoboko kwaye.
english: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, "Come!" I looked, and there before me was a black horse! Its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.

ekegusii: Ekero rirube riria riabaikerete, bakaimokia abana b’omoruoti emerongo etano na ebere, bakabaita nemioro. Erio bakabeka emetwe yabo ebitonga ime, bakayetoma gochia ase Yehu agwo Yesireeli.
english: When the letter arrived, these men took the princes and slaughtered all seventy of them. They put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu in Jezreel.

ekegusii: Ekero ebitongwa biria biarenge kogenda, naboigo na amagoro aria naro arenge kogenda amo nabirobio mbarabare, na ekero ebitongwa biria biarenge koimokerera igoro korwa ase riroba, naboigo na amagoro aria arenge koimokerera igoro.
english: When the living creatures moved, the wheels beside them moved; and when the living creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose.

ekegusii: Ekero omorendi oteneine ase omorobiri o Yesireeli atengerete, akarora ekeombe kia Yehu kegocha, agateba, “Narorire ekeombe ki’abanto.” Yoramu akamotebia, “Toma omonto ariine ebarasai, agende aumerane nabarabwo na kobaboria gose namang’ana ’omorembe babwate.”
english: When the lookout standing on the tower in Jezreel saw Jehu's troops approaching, he called out, "I see some troops coming." "Get a horseman," Joram ordered. "Send him to meet them and ask, 'Do you come in peace?'"

ekegusii: Agwo ekero Omonene achagete gokwana goetera ase Hosea, Omonene akamotebia iga: “Genda onyuome omokungu omotayayi, onyore abana b’obotayayi, ekiagera ense eye yantigire inche Omonene ase ogokora obotayayi obonene.”
english: When the LORD began to speak through Hosea, the LORD said to him, "Go, take to yourself an adulterous wife and children of unfaithfulness, because the land is guilty of the vilest adultery in departing from the LORD."

ekegusii: Omonene nabarierete chisokoro chiaino eira ng’a nabae ense y’Abakanani, na Abahiti, na Abaamori, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi. Eyio nense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke. Ekero arabaikie agwo goika mobe mokomoruera ekeng’wanso eke ase omotienyi oyio.
english: When the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Hivites and Jebusites-- the land he swore to your forefathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey-- you are to observe this ceremony in this month:

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene achigete omonto oria obegete eanga y’egatani agende korusia omorero korwa ase egati‐gati y’amagoro aria anga chinyange, korwa ase egati‐gati y’abakerubi, omonto oria agasoa agatenena ang’e nokomo kw’amagoro aria.
english: When the LORD commanded the man in linen, "Take fire from among the wheels, from among the cherubim," the man went in and stood beside a wheel.

ekegusii: Ekeene, Omonene tare konyara koremereria nogokora kwaino okobe, na okogechia okwo mwakorete. Ase ayio ense yaino yasarigwe yabeire bosa, naende yaragererigwe, temenyiri na onde; naboigo ere goika rero iga.
english: When the LORD could no longer endure your wicked actions and the detestable things you did, your land became an object of cursing and a desolate waste without inhabitants, as it is today.

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoorire gokwana na Musa agwo ase egetunwa gia Sinai, akamoa chibao ibere chi’amagena chirikire oborori nekiara kia Nyasae.
english: When the LORD finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two tablets of the Testimony, the tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God.

ekegusii: Na ki Omonene nache aete ense ya Misiri aite Abamisiri, korende ekero ararore amanyinga agindirie omoriibo bw’emetobwa ya gesieri igoro na emetobwa eria ebere, nigo araete egesieri ekio, gose tagotiga oria omosiria asoe chinyomba chiaino abaite.
english: When the LORD goes through the land to strike down the Egyptians, he will see the blood on the top and sides of the doorframe and will pass over that doorway, and he will not permit the destroyer to enter your houses and strike you down.

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene akoorete gokwana na Ibrahimu, akagenda; na Ibrahimu akairana bwoye.
english: When the LORD had finished speaking with Abraham, he left, and Abraham returned home.

ekegusii: Omonene one, ekero Omonene agakoreire amaya ayio onsi akorierete eira ng’a nagokorere, naende okobekire obe omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli,
english: When the LORD has done for my master every good thing he promised concerning him and has appointed him leader over Israel,

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene arabe okoorire gokora emeremo yaye yonsi ase Egetunwa gia Sayoni, na ase Yerusalemu, nae omoruoti bw’Abaasuri egesusuro ase engencho y’ogwetogia kwaye, na oboenenu bw’okweimokereria igoro.
english: When the Lord has finished all his work against Mount Zion and Jerusalem, he will say, "I will punish the king of Assyria for the willful pride of his heart and the haughty look in his eyes.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, ekero Omonene aigwete ayio, agaichorwa nekeririanda, akarwania abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo nomorero, ekiagera nigo abete nendamwamu enene mono ase Abaisraeli.
english: When the LORD heard them, he was very angry; his fire broke out against Jacob, and his wrath rose against Israel,

ekegusii: “Omonene akaigwa amang’ana aino, akaba nendamwamu, agatiana na goteba:
english: When the LORD heard what you said, he was angry and solemnly swore:

ekegusii: akarua Boyahudi, akagenda Galili naende.
english: When the Lord learned of this, he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.

ekegusii: Omonene agakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania nabarabwo, akabachika, “Timobaisa koiroka chinyasae ching’ao, gose gotung’ama gochisasima; timochikorera gose timochiruera ebing’wanso.
english: When the LORD made a covenant with the Israelites, he commanded them: "Do not worship any other gods or bow down to them, serve them or sacrifice to them.

ekegusii: Na ekero Omonene achia komorora akamororera amabera, akamotebia, “Torera!”
english: When the Lord saw her, his heart went out to her and he said, "Don't cry."

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene aroche ng’a Musa oikire ang’e arore, akamorangeria korwa ase egetutu ime, “Musa! Musa!” Musa agaitaba, “Nao inde aa.”
english: When the LORD saw that he had gone over to look, God called to him from within the bush, "Moses! Moses!" And Moses said, "Here I am."

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene aroche ng’a Lea tanchiri, akaigora enda yaye, korende Raeli akagombaa.
english: When the LORD saw that Leah was not loved, he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene aroche ng’a bekeeirie babeire abaitongo, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Semaya, rigoteba: “Bono barabwo bekeeirie babeire abaitongo; ase ayio tinkobasiria, korende nyuma y’engaki enke nimbaboorie, tingoitera endamwamu yane igoro ase Yerusalemu goetera ase okoboko gwa Sisaki.
english: When the LORD saw that they humbled themselves, this word of the LORD came to Shemaiah: "Since they have humbled themselves, I will not destroy them but will soon give them deliverance. My wrath will not be poured out on Jerusalem through Shishak.

ekegusii: Ase engaki eria Omonene aganetie koira Elija igoro ase enchera y’ekerambauti, Elija na Elisha nigo barenge ase orogendo rwabo korwa Giligali.
english: When the LORD was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind, Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal.

ekegusii: “Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabaire na kobaikia ase ense eria arierete chisokoro chiaino, Ibrahimu, na Isaka, na Yakobo eira, ng’a nabae inwe ense eria ebwate emechie emenene naende emiya, eyio inwe motaagachete.
english: When the LORD your God brings you into the land he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, to give you-- a land with large, flourishing cities you did not build,

ekegusii: “Omonene, Nyasae oino, nabaikie ase ense eria, mogochia koira ebe eyaino, na aserie ebisaku ebinge birue ase amasio aino, ebisaku bitano na bibere bire ebinene, naende bire ne chinguru kobabua. Ebisaku ebio nabio ebi: Abahiti, na Abagirigasi, na Abaamori, na Abakanani, na Abaperisi, na Abahivi, na Abayebusi.
english: When the LORD your God brings you into the land you are entering to possess and drives out before you many nations-- the Hittites, Girgashites, Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites, seven nations larger and stronger than you--

ekegusii: Omonene, Nyasae oino, kayobekire ase amaboko aino, moite nemioro abanto abasacha bonsi bareo.
english: When the LORD your God delivers it into your hand, put to the sword all the men in it.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nebe ekero Omonene, Nyasae oino, abaeire ense eria ebe omwando oino, naende ekero abaeire obotoereru korwa ase ababisa baino bonsi babaetanaine, goika mosirie Abaameleki bonsi, tibainyorwa nonya ng’ake inse y’erioba. Timobaisa kweba amang’ana ayio.
english: When the LORD your God gives you rest from all the enemies around you in the land he is giving you to possess as an inheritance, you shall blot out the memory of Amalek from under heaven. Do not forget!

ekegusii: Ekero Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabaikie ase ense eria mokogenda koira, mokwane ogosesenigwa korwa ase egetunwa kia Gerisimu na okoragererigwa korwa ase egetunwa ki’Ebali. (
english: When the LORD your God has brought you into the land you are entering to possess, you are to proclaim on Mount Gerizim the blessings, and on Mount Ebal the curses.

ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabe osiririe abanto b’ebisaku biria mogochia koegwa ense yabo, na ekero mwairire ense amo nemechie yabo, na komenya ase chinyomba chiabo,
english: When the LORD your God has destroyed the nations whose land he is giving you, and when you have driven them out and settled in their towns and houses,

ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabagareerie orogongo rwaino buna abarierete eira, nainwe mokwane: Natorie chinyama, ekiagera more abatoonu b’okogania chinyama, nabo morarie chinyama, morie chinyinge buna moraganie.
english: When the LORD your God has enlarged your territory as he promised you, and you crave meat and say, "I would like some meat," then you may eat as much of it as you want.

ekegusii: Erio abaringoria, na abaragori, na Abakalidayo bamanyete oborogi, na abamanyete igoro ye ching’enang’eni, bagacha asende. Inche nkabatebia chindoto chiria, korende tibanyarete gontebia engencho yaye.
english: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners came, I told them the dream, but they could not interpret it for me.

ekegusii: Elikana amo nabanto b’enka yaye bakagenda naende koruera Omonene ekeng’wanso gia kera omwaka na goikerania eira bariete.
english: When the man Elkanah went up with all his family to offer the annual sacrifice to the LORD and to fulfill his vow,

ekegusii: Ekero omobani oria omogotu akoorire koria na konywa, akabekera etigere egeikaransero ase omobani oria airanetie araikaranse.
english: When the man of God had finished eating and drinking, the prophet who had brought him back saddled his donkey for him.

ekegusii: When the man saw that he could not overpower him, he touched the socket of Jacob's hip so that his hip was wrenched as he wrestled with the man.
english: Nere omonto oria, ekero arora ng’a tari kobua Yakobo, akamokuna enengo y’ebachwa, akamoteng’eria, kobagendererete gokinana.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo baikire asare, bakamotebia, “Yohana Omobatisi ototomire asore, okobora: Aye naye oria ogocha, gose toganye omoao?”
english: When the men came to Jesus, they said, "John the Baptist sent us to you to ask, 'Are you the one who was to come, or should we expect someone else?'"

ekegusii: Erio abanto abwo bakaimoka korwa agwo, bakagenda, bakaba barigereretie gochia Sodomu, na Ibrahimu akagenda amo nabarabwo, akabakooba.
english: When the men got up to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them on their way.

ekegusii: Nyuma kobakoorire kobotiria bakabogoria chingori chi’ogokonya, bagachietanania emeeri. Bakairoka ng’a tibabaisa korateera ase omokenye okorokwa Siriti, bagasibora ebitambaa, bakairwa bosa.
english: When the men had hoisted it aboard, they passed ropes under the ship itself to hold it together. Fearing that they would run aground on the sandbars of Syrtis, they lowered the sea anchor and let the ship be driven along.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’Asidodi baroche amang’ana ayio, bagateba, “Esanduku eye ya Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tekonyara kobeera aiga amo naintwe, ekiagera okoboko kw’Omonene nokorito igoro asetore, na igoro ase Dagoni, enyasae yaito.”
english: When the men of Ashdod saw what was happening, they said, "The ark of the god of Israel must not stay here with us, because his hand is heavy upon us and upon Dagon our god."

ekegusii: Abaisraeli bagachia korora ng’a bamigirwe nobokong’u, bagatang’ang’a na kwebisa ase amabwago, na ase chinsana na ebitare ime, nonya nase chingoro na ase amakuruma.
english: When the men of Israel saw that their situation was critical and that their army was hard pressed, they hid in caves and thickets, among the rocks, and in pits and cisterns.

ekegusii: Ekero Abayuda bachete ase omorobiri bw’oborendi agwo ase erooro na bakarigereria, bakarora ebitondo birambereretie inse; onde tatooregete nonya noyomo.
english: When the men of Judah came to the place that overlooks the desert and looked toward the vast army, they saw only dead bodies lying on the ground; no one had escaped.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto b’aase aria bamoboretie amang’ana igoro ya mokaye, akabatebia, “Oyo mosubati ominto.” Naki nigo oboete goteba ng’a ere mokaye, akarengeria ng’a abanto b’aase aria mbabaise komoita ase engencho ya Rebeka, ekiagera ere arenge omonyakieni.
english: When the men of that place asked him about his wife, he said, "She is my sister," because he was afraid to say, "She is my wife." He thought, "The men of this place might kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is beautiful."

ekegusii: Abanto b’omochie oria bagasoka korwana na Yoabu, na abanto bande ase abasomba ba Daudi bagaitwa, na Uria Omohiti nere agaitwa.
english: When the men of the city came out and fought against Joab, some of the men in David's army fell; moreover, Uriah the Hittite died.

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Daudi are koirana, ekero aitire Omofilisti oria, na abarwani b’esegi bakoirana boigo, abakungu bagacha korwa ase emechie yonsi bakana‐gotera na gotenga bare nomogoko, bakobugia ebikonu ne chinchigiri.
english: When the men were returning home after David had killed the Philistine, the women came out from all the towns of Israel to meet King Saul with singing and dancing, with joyful songs and with tambourines and lutes.

ekegusii: Ekero omonto arentete amang’ana ng’a emetwe y’abana b’omoruoti yarentirwe, Yehu agateba, “Yebeke amo ase chitui ibere agwo ase egesoero ki’egeita, ebeereo goika mambia.”
english: When the messenger arrived, he told Jehu, "They have brought the heads of the princes." Then Jehu ordered, "Put them in two piles at the entrance of the city gate until morning."

ekegusii: Abatomwa baria bagaika Gibea ase Saulo amenyete, bagatebia abanto b’aroro amang’ana ayio, na abanto bonsi bakarera mono.
english: When the messengers came to Gibeah of Saul and reported these terms to the people, they all wept aloud.

ekegusii: Abatomwa baria, ekero bairanete ase Yakobo bakamotebia, “Ntwaika o momura omino Esau, ere ngocha are gokorotota ore nabanto amagana ane.”
english: When the messengers returned to Jacob, they said, "We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."

ekegusii: na abanto baria batometwe bakairana gochia ase omoruoti, nere akababoria, “Ninki kiagera mwairana?”
english: When the messengers returned to the king, he asked them, "Why have you come back?"

ekegusii: Ekero chibesa chionsi chiaerire ase ense ya Misiri na ase ense ya Kanani, Abamisiri bagachiera Yusufu, bakamosaba, “Toe endagera, titobaisa gokwera ase obosio bwao, ekiagera chibesa chiaito chiaerire.”
english: When the money of the people of Egypt and Canaan was gone, all Egypt came to Joseph and said, "Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? Our money is used up."

ekegusii: Ekero Oyore Igoro Mono aete abanto b’ebisaku emiando yabo, na ekero aatananete mwanyabanto. Akababekera chimbebe ase baramenye, kobwatekana nomobaro bw’Abaisraeli,
english: When the Most High gave the nations their inheritance, when he divided all mankind, he set up boundaries for the peoples according to the number of the sons of Israel.

ekegusii: Ekero Yoabu aigwete amang’ana ayio, agatama gochia ase Eema y’Omonene, akabwaterera emegwekano ye chingunchara chi’egesasimero. Ere igo abwatanete n’Adonia ase okomokonya, korende tabwatanete n’Abisalomu.
english: When the news reached Joab, who had conspired with Adonijah though not with Absalom, he fled to the tent of the LORD and took hold of the horns of the altar.

ekegusii: Ekero chinkuma chiaigwetwe ase enka ya Farao ng’a abamwabo Yusufu bachire, amang’ana ayio akagwenera Farao amo nabasomba baye bonsi.
english: When the news reached Pharaoh's palace that Joseph's brothers had come, Pharaoh and all his officials were pleased.

ekegusii: Ekero amang’ana ayio aigete ase omoruoti, ere akaimoka korwa ase ekerogo kiaye ki’obonene, akarusia engobo yaye y’obonene, akeboyia chigunia, agaikaransa ase ribu igoro.
english: When the news reached the king of Nineveh, he rose from his throne, took off his royal robes, covered himself with sackcloth and sat down in the dust.

ekegusii: Ekero okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso gwakoorirwe, omoruoti amo nabanto bonsi barenge amo nere bagekumba, bagasasima.
english: When the offerings were finished, the king and everyone present with him knelt down and worshiped.

ekegusii: When the officers have finished speaking to the army, they shall appoint commanders over it.
english: Na ekero abateneneri baria bakoorire gokwana nabarwani baria, bachore abatang’ani babe bakoraa abarwani b’esegi.

ekegusii: Ekero abanene b’oboruoti bw’Abayuda baigwete amang’ana ayio, bakarua ase enyomba y’omoruoti, bakagenda ase enyomba y’Omonene, erio bagaikaransa ase egesoero kiarenge korokwa Egeita Ekeyia, agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: When the officials of Judah heard about these things, they went up from the royal palace to the house of the LORD and took their places at the entrance of the New Gate of the LORD's house.

ekegusii: Ekero abasomba bande bachia korora aya akoreka, bagaichana mono, bakagenda, bagatebia omonene obo onsi ayakorekire.
english: When the other servants saw what had happened, they were greatly distressed and went and told their master everything that had happened.

ekegusii: Korende ekero abanene baye bachia korora ng’a ogosemeria kw’enibo yabo gwasirire, bakabwata Paulo na Sila, bakabakurura goika echiiro ase obosio bw’abanene b’omochie.
english: When the owners of the slave girl realized that their hope of making money was gone, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged them into the marketplace to face the authorities.

ekegusii: Abanto bakarera ase Musa ng’a bakonywe, nere agasaba Omonene, na omorero oria okarimigwa.
english: When the people cried out to Moses, he prayed to the LORD and the fire died down.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto baigwete amang’ana ayio amakong’u bagaichana gose onde taba obegete ebinto biaye bi’ogwechabera.
english: When the people heard these distressing words, they began to mourn and no one put on any ornaments.

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli baigwete amachiko ayio asometwe asebare bakerusanania korwa ase abanto bonsi abarenge ab’ebisaku ebiao.
english: When the people heard this law, they excluded from Israel all who were of foreign descent.

ekegusii: Ekero bachia koigwa aya, bagasambwa ase chinkoro chiabo, bakaboria Petero na abatomwa bande, “Abaminto, inki torakore?”
english: When the people heard this, they were cut to the heart and said to Peter and the other apostles, "Brothers, what shall we do?"

ekegusii: Rituko ria kabere mambia chuni, ekero abanto b’Asidodi babogete, bakanyora Dagoni egwete inse maumama bosio bw’Esanduku eria y’Omonene. Bakayegororokia, bakayetenenia aase aye.
english: When the people of Ashdod rose early the next day, there was Dagon, fallen on his face on the ground before the ark of the LORD! They took Dagon and put him back in his place.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bamenyete Yabesi o Gileadi baigwete aya Abafilisti bakorete ase Saulo,
english: When the people of Jabesh Gilead heard of what the Philistines had done to Saul,

ekegusii: Na ekero abanto baroche Samison, bagatogia enyasae yabo, bagateba, “Enyasae yaito yabekire omobisa oito ase amaboko aito, omobisa oria osaririe ense yaito na oitire abanto baito abange.”
english: When the people saw him, they praised their god, saying, "Our god has delivered our enemy into our hands, the one who laid waste our land and multiplied our slain."

ekegusii: Ekero abanto baroche ng’a Musa otebanire goika korwa ase egetunwa, bagasangererekana amo, bagachiera Haroni, bakamotebia, “Inchuo aa, tokorere enyasae eratotang’ane, ekiagera titomanyeti eki kiamonyorire Musa, oyo otong’anyetie korwa ase ense ya Misiri.”
english: When the people saw that Moses was so long in coming down from the mountain, they gathered around Aaron and said, "Come, make us gods who will go before us. As for this fellow Moses who brought us up out of Egypt, we don't know what has happened to him."

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi baroche okomesa, na koigwa enkoba na eriogi ri’egetureri na korora egetunwa gekoimoka erioki, bakaiguswa, bagatenenera aare.
english: When the people saw the thunder and lightning and heard the trumpet and saw the mountain in smoke, they trembled with fear. They stayed at a distance

ekegusii: ekero ekio abanto b’ebisaku bionsi mbasangererekane amo namaruoti ase ogosasima Omonene.
english: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero oyo bw’ogosareka oranyore ogotasareka, na oyo bw’ogokwa oranyore ogotakwa; erio naribe ring’ana riria ririkire, “Amakweri amerirwe ase okobua.”
english: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come true: "Death has been swallowed up in victory."

ekegusii: Omofarisai, oria omorangeretie, agachia koyarora akeboria ase omoyo oye ime, ogoteba, “Omonto oyo, onye nomobani orenge, anga namomanya oyo ng’a nere ng’o, gose mokungu ki oyo okomokuna, ng’a nomonyene ebibe.”
english: When the Pharisee who had invited him saw this, he said to himself, "If this man were a prophet, he would know who is touching him and what kind of woman she is-- that she is a sinner."

ekegusii: Ekero Abafarisai bachia korora aya, bakaboria aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki omworokia oino akoria amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”
english: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked his disciples, "Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and 'sinners'?"

ekegusii: Korende ekero Abafarisai bachia korora aya, bakamotebia, “Rigereria, aborokigwa bao buna bagokora eritari boronge gokorwa ase rituko ri’Esabato.”
english: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, "Look! Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath."

ekegusii: Ekero Abafilisti baboretie, “Ning’o okora aya?” Bagatebigwa ng’a Samison, oria onyuomete omoiseke bw’omonto o Timuna, nere okora ayio. Omonto oria o Timuna nigo aimogetie omokungu o Samison, akamoa omong’wansi oye, na ere akamonyuoma. Abafilisti bakagenda, bagasamba omokungu oria nomorero, bagasamba na ise; bonsi babere bagakwa.
english: When the Philistines asked, "Who did this?" they were told, "Samson, the Timnite's son-in-law, because his wife was given to his friend." So the Philistines went up and burned her and her father to death.

ekegusii: Ekero Abafilisti baigwete ng’a Daudi oakirwe amaguta obeire omoruoti igoro ase Abaisraeli bonsi, bagatiira gochia komorigia. Daudi akaigwa ayio, akagenda koumerana nabarabwo ase okorwana esegi.
english: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went out to meet them.

ekegusii: Ekero Abafilisti baigwete ng’a Daudi oakirwe amaguta koba omoruoti igoro y’Abaisraeli bonsi, bagatiira gochia komorigia. Daudi kaigure ayio, agatirimboka gochia ase eburi ime,
english: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over Israel, they went up in full force to search for him, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

ekegusii: When the Philistines heard that Israel had assembled at Mizpah, the rulers of the Philistines came up to attack them. And when the Israelites heard of it, they were afraid because of the Philistines.
english: Ekero Abafilisti baigwete ng’a Abaisraeli basangererekanire agwo Misipa, abanene b’Abafilisti bakagenda gochia kobarwania. Abaisraeli bagachia koigwa amang’ana ayio, bakabairoka,

ekegusii: Ekero chibarasi chiria chiarenge ne chinguru mono chiasogete chikagania kogenda goetanana ase ense yonsi. Omomalaika oria agachitebia, “Genda moetanane ase ense yonsi.” Nachirochio chigakora bo.
english: When the powerful horses went out, they were straining to go throughout the earth. And he said, "Go throughout the earth!" So they went throughout the earth.

ekegusii: Ekero Pasuri omokuani, mosinto o Imeri, oyorenge omoteneneri omonene bw’enyomba y’Omonene, aigwete Yeremia okobana amang’ana ayio,
english: When the priest Pashhur son of Immer, the chief officer in the temple of the LORD, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things,

ekegusii: Ekero omokuani ararore ng’a enyama eria embariri yasokire, rirorio atebe ng’a omonto oyio tachenegeti. Enyama eria embariri nigo ere eyetachenegeti. Obwo noborwaire bwa ukoma.
english: When the priest sees the raw flesh, he shall pronounce him unclean. The raw flesh is unclean; he has an infectious disease.

ekegusii: Abakuani na Abalawi bagechena abanyene, bagache na nabanto bonsi amo nebiita, na orwaki roria.
english: When the priests and Levites had purified themselves ceremonially, they purified the people, the gates and the wall.

ekegusii: Ekero abakuani barenge gosoka korwa ase Aase Aachenu, riire rigaichora enyomba y’Omonene,
english: When the priests withdrew from the Holy Place, the cloud filled the temple of the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero omogambi oria arasoe aetere egesona ki’oboagacho bore geita, naende airanere enchera eyio eyio.
english: When the prince enters, he is to go in through the portico of the gateway, and he is to come out the same way.

ekegusii: “Ekero omogambi ararente ase Omonene okorua kwaye kw’ogwancha, gakorabe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose eki’omorembe, aigorerwe egeita kerochie moocha. Nigo ararue ekeng’wanso kiaye ki’ogosambwa, na eki’omorembe, ase enchera buna eria agokora ase rituko ri’Esabato. Gasokire, egeita keria giasiekwa.
english: When the prince provides a freewill offering to the LORD-- whether a burnt offering or fellowship offerings-- the gate facing east is to be opened for him. He shall offer his burnt offering or his fellowship offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he shall go out, and after he has gone out, the gate will be shut.

ekegusii: Ekero gavuna achia korora ayakoreka, akeegena, agakumia ase okworokereria kw’Omonene.
english: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he believed, for he was amazed at the teaching about the Lord.

ekegusii: Na ekero omobani oria omoiranetie korwa inchera, aigwete amang’ana ayio, agateba, “Oyio nomonto oria o Nyasae bwangete koigwera ring’ana ri’Omonene; ase ayio, n’Omonene omorua ase endo, nero yamotandoire na komoita, koreng’ana buna Omonene amotebetie.”
english: When the prophet who had brought him back from his journey heard of it, he said, "It is the man of God who defied the word of the LORD. The LORD has given him over to the lion, which has mauled him and killed him, as the word of the LORD had warned him."

ekegusii: Ekero eting’ana ya Seba aigwete chinkuma chia Sulemani igoro y’ayio akorete ase engencho y’erieta ri’Omonene, agacha komoteema ase okomoboria amang’ana amakong’u.
english: When the queen of Sheba heard about the fame of Solomon and his relation to the name of the LORD, she came to test him with hard questions.

ekegusii: Ekero eting’ana ya Seba aigwete chinkuma chia Sulemani, agacha Yerusalemu komoteema ase okomoboria amang’ana amakong’u, agacha amo nabasomba baye abange ne chingamia chiabogoretie ebinsari, ne chitahabu chinyinge, na amagena e rigori rinene. Na ekero aigete ase Sulemani, akamotebia amang’ana onsi arenge ase ebirengererio biaye.
english: When the queen of Sheba heard of Solomon's fame, she came to Jerusalem to test him with hard questions. Arriving with a very great caravan-- with camels carrying spices, large quantities of gold, and precious stones-- she came to Solomon and talked with him about all she had on her mind.

ekegusii: Na ekero eting’ana eria ya Seba akoorire korora obong’aini bwonsi bwa Sulemani, na enyomba eria aagachete,
english: When the queen of Sheba saw all the wisdom of Solomon and the palace he had built,

ekegusii: Na ekero eting’ana ya Seba yaroche obong’aini bwonsi bwa Sulemani, na enyomba eria aagachete,
english: When the queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, as well as the palace he had built,

ekegusii: Nigo arache ng’ora ng’ora, asoe ase chinsemo chintobu chi’ense eria; nigo arakore amang’ana chisokoro ne chisokororia chiaye chitakorete, nasiarere ase egati y’abanto baye ebinto aureretie, na ebi asakorete, ne chinibo. Nakore emeroberio y’okorwania chiburi chinkong’u, korende ase engaki enke yoka.
english: When the richest provinces feel secure, he will invade them and will achieve what neither his fathers nor his forefathers did. He will distribute plunder, loot and wealth among his followers. He will plot the overthrow of fortresses-- but only for a time.

ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bagendererete koba buya, abanto b’omochie nigo bakogoka, na ekero abakori amabe bagosira nigo bagoaka amariogi ’omochengo.
english: When the righteous prosper, the city rejoices; when the wicked perish, there are shouts of joy.

ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge bakogamba, abanto nigo bakoba nomogoko, korende ekero abakori amabe bakogamba, abanto nigo bagochandeka na korera.
english: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.

ekegusii: Ekero abanyene oboronge babuire, obonene obonge nigo bokobao, korende ekero abakori amabe bakogamba, abanto nigo bakwebisa.
english: When the righteous triumph, there is great elation; but when the wicked rise to power, men go into hiding.

ekegusii: Rora, nonya orooche rore nemerindo, ero teri kwoboa; nonya orooche rwa Yorodan rokominyoka gocha ase omonwa oye, nigo ere noboremu.
english: When the river rages, he is not alarmed; he is secure, though the Jordan should surge against his mouth.

ekegusii: Na ekero gi’Esabato agachaka kworokereria ase esinagogi; abange abamoigwete bagakumia, bagatebania, “Oyo ng’ai anyorire aya? Mbong’aini ki obo aeirwe oyo? Ogokora gwe chinguru ki oko okonene kogokoreka ase amaboko aye?
english: When the Sabbath came, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were amazed. "Where did this man get these things?" they asked. "What's this wisdom that has been given him, that he even does miracles!

ekegusii: Goika Esabato koyaerire, Mariamu Magidalena, na Mariamu ng’ina Yakobo, na Salome, bakagora amaguta amanukato, banyare kogenda komoaka.
english: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go to anoint Jesus' body.

ekegusii: Mwanyabanto nigo bakwerua ase chinkoro chiabo gokora ayare amabe, ekiagera ebibe tibiri konacherwa ekina bwango.
english: When the sentence for a crime is not quickly carried out, the hearts of the people are filled with schemes to do wrong.

ekegusii: Omoiseke oria omosomba akamorora naende, agachaka gotebia abateneine ang’e, “Oyo noyomo obo.”
english: When the servant girl saw him there, she said again to those standing around, "This fellow is one of them."

ekegusii: Ekero omosomba bw’omonto oria o Nyasae abogete mambia chuni, agasoka isiko, akarora omoganda oria bw’abarwani esegi, amo ne chigari ne chibarasi, agateba, “Obee, omonene one! Ninki togokora?”
english: When the servant of the man of God got up and went out early the next morning, an army with horses and chariots had surrounded the city. "Oh, my lord, what shall we do?" the servant asked.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aria atano na abere achia koba ang’e goikeranigwa Abayahudi abarwete Asia bakamorora ase Hekalu ime, bagaseegeta abanto bonsi, bakamobwata,
english: When the seven days were nearly over, some Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul at the temple. They stirred up the whole crowd and seized him,

ekegusii: Ekero omotienyi o gatano na kabere oigete, na Abaisraeli bamenyete ase emechando yabo, bonsi bagasangererekana ase obomo agwo Yerusalemu.
english: When the seventh month came and the Israelites had settled in their towns, the people assembled as one man in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Erio abarwani kobabambire Yeso, bakabogoria chianga chiaye, bagachiatanana chinsemo inye, kera omorwani anyore ensemo yaye. Bakabogoria eganchwa nero. Korende eganchwa eyio tiyasonire; igo yabwatanirie korwa igoro goika inse.
english: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.

ekegusii: Ekero abarwani abatigarete bairanete gocha ase egetwori, abagaaka b’Abaisraeli bagateba, “Nase ki Omonene atotiga twabugwa n’Abafilisti ase rituko ria rero? Togende torente korwa Silo Esanduku eria ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’Omonene, erinde eche ebe egati yaito na gototooria korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baito.”
english: When the soldiers returned to camp, the elders of Israel asked, "Why did the LORD bring defeat upon us today before the Philistines? Let us bring the ark of the LORD's covenant from Shiloh, so that it may go with us and save us from the hand of our enemies."

ekegusii: Ekero omwaga ekembugu‐mbugu egoeta, omokori amabe nigo agosira, korende omonyene oboronge nigo are oboroso boteneine bokong’u kare na kare.
english: When the storm has swept by, the wicked are gone, but the righteous stand firm forever.

ekegusii: Ekero erioba riagure, abe ochenekire, na nyuma y’ayio amanye koria ebinto ebichenu, ekiagera ebinto ebio nabio endagera yaye.
english: When the sun goes down, he will be clean, and after that he may eat the sacred offerings, for they are his food.

ekegusii: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, a smoking firepot with a blazing torch appeared and passed between the pieces.
english: Ekero erioba riagure, na omosunte osoire, eriko rigosokia erioki amo nekieri kere nomorero ekebemberi, bigaeta gati ye chinyama chiria.

ekegusii: Ekero erioba riatiirire gocha igoro, Nyasae akarenta omwaga okagusa korwa moocha orenge nomobaso omororo se, na omobaso oria ogasamba Yona bobe ase omotwe goika akagireka. Erio akagania akwe, agateba, “Nigo ere buya asende gokwa kobua kogenderera koba moyo.”
english: When the sun rose, God provided a scorching east wind, and the sun blazed on Jonah's head so that he grew faint. He wanted to die, and said, "It would be better for me to die than to live."

ekegusii: Goika erioba rigachia kogwa bakarenta asare abanto bonsi abarenge nabarwaire bare namarwaire ao ao, na ere akabeka amaboko aye igoro ase kera oyomo, akabagwenia.
english: When the sun was setting, the people brought to Jesus all who had various kinds of sickness, and laying his hands on each one, he healed them.

ekegusii: Aborokia b’amariko na Abafarisai bagachia komorora okoria amo nabanyene ebibe na abarusia ebango, bagatebia aborokigwa baye, “Nase ki akoria na konywa amo nabarusia ebango na abanyene ebibe?”
english: When the teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw him eating with the "sinners" and tax collectors, they asked his disciples: "Why does he eat with tax collectors and 'sinners'?"

ekegusii: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.
english: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bagachaka kobea Yakobo na Yohana.

ekegusii: Ekero baria ikomi bachia koigwa aya, bakabea ase abamura baria babere ba ise omo.
english: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.

ekegusii: Na emiaka eria elifu eyemo keraere, Saitani nasiborwe korwa ase egesibo kiaye.
english: When the thousand years are over, Satan will be released from his prison

ekegusii: Ekero abanto ba Gidioni babugetie ebitureri biria amagana atato, Omonene akaondokia Abamidiani, kera oyomo akaonchokera goita oyomwabo nomoro ase egetwori keria ekegima, na abarwani bonsi bagatama gochia ensemo ya Serera goikera Beti‐Hasita, na goikera Abeli‐Mehola, ang’e na Tabati.
english: When the three hundred trumpets sounded, the LORD caused the men throughout the camp to turn on each other with their swords. The army fled to Beth Shittah toward Zererah as far as the border of Abel Meholah near Tabbath.

ekegusii: Ekero amatuko aye ay’okoibora achia goikerana, bakanyora ne chibarongo chiare enda yaye ime.
english: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

ekegusii: Ekero engaki yaye y’okoibora yachia goika, akarorekana ore ne chibarongo enda yaye ime.
english: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

ekegusii: When the time drew near for David to die, he gave a charge to Solomon his son.
english: Ekero engaki y’ogokwa gwa Daudi yaigete ang’e, agachika Sulemani, omwana oye, akamotebia,

ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’ogokwa gwa Israeli yabete ang’e, ere akarangeria Yusufu, omwana oye, akamotebia, “Onye nkonyora ogwancherwa ase obosio bwao, beka okoboko kwao inse y’ekebono kiane, na ondiere eira, ng’a nonkorere amabera na obwanchani. Tontindeka aa ase ense ya Misiri,
english: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called for his son Joseph and said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise that you will show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,

ekegusii: Na ekero amatuko ’ogwesibia kwabo achia goika, ayachikire ase amachiko a Musa, bakamoira Yerusalemu, bamobeke ase Omonene
english: When the time of their purification according to the Law of Moses had been completed, Joseph and Mary took him to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

ekegusii: Abakuani bakabugia ebitureri, na abanto kobabiigure bagaaka eriogi rinene ri’esegi, ne chindwaki chikagwa inse kegima. Erio abanto bakagenda bosio, bagatiira gochia omochie, bakayoira.
english: When the trumpets sounded, the people shouted, and at the sound of the trumpet, when the people gave a loud shout, the wall collapsed; so every man charged straight in, and they took the city.

ekegusii: Ekero engaki y’okogenda ase omoruoti yaigete ase Esteri, oyio orenge omoiseke bw’Abihaili, ise moke Moredekai, oyio omotugete buna omwana oye, taboretie gento kende akoirana otatiga ebi Hegai, omosomba bw’omoruoti, oria otenererete abaiseke baria, amosemetie. Bono Esteri nigo agwenerete abanto bonsi baare komorora.
english: When the turn came for Esther (the girl Mordecai had adopted, the daughter of his uncle Abihail) to go to the king, she asked for nothing other than what Hegai, the king's eunuch who was in charge of the harem, suggested. And Esther won the favor of everyone who saw her.

ekegusii: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
english: Aborokigwa baria babere bakamoigwa ogoteba aya, bagatunyana Yeso.

ekegusii: Eburu‐buru eria egachia koera, Paulo akarangeria aborokigwa, akabaremia, agatigana nabarabwo, akaimoka akagenda Makedonia.
english: When the uproar had ended, Paul sent for the disciples and, after encouraging them, said good-by and set out for Macedonia.

ekegusii: Ekero abasomba ba Hadadeseri baroche ng’a babuirwe n’Abaisraeli, bagakora omorembe na Daudi, bakebeka inse yaye. Ase ayio Abasiiria tibanchete gokonya Abaamoni naende.
english: When the vassals of Hadadezer saw that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became subject to him. So the Arameans were not willing to help the Ammonites anymore.

ekegusii: Ekero abaiseke abekungi basangererekanete engaki ya kabere, Moredekai akaba ogoikaransa ase egeita ki’omoruoti.
english: When the virgins were assembled a second time, Mordecai was sitting at the king's gate.

ekegusii: Ekero eriogi riakwanire, Yeso akarorekana ore bweka. Na barabwo bagakira, tibatebia monto ase amatuko aria ring’ana rinde rionsi ri’ayio baroche.
english: When the voice had spoken, they found that Jesus was alone. The disciples kept this to themselves, and told no one at that time what they had seen.

ekegusii: Ekero orwaki orwo rorabe rwagure inse, Inee, abanto tibakobaboria: Ng’ai echooka eria mwaroagete ere bono?
english: When the wall collapses, will people not ask you, "Where is the whitewash you covered it with?"

ekegusii: When the water in the skin was gone, she put the boy under one of the bushes.
english: Ekero amache aria arenge ebirandi ime aerire, akaareria omwana inse y’egetutu.

ekegusii: Amache nigo akobwatana oma pa buna rigena, ne chinyancha chioma pa chiaba buna egetare.
english: when the waters become hard as stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen?

ekegusii: When the wheat sprouted and formed heads, then the weeds also appeared.
english: Egachia komera ekama chinyeke, erio amabanchore naro akarorekana.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi konya bambokire Yorodan, Omonene agatebia Yoshua,
english: When the whole nation had finished crossing the Jordan, the LORD said to Joshua,

ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakogamba, abanto nigo bakwebisa, korende ekero basirigwe, abanyaboronge nigo bakomentekana.
english: When the wicked rise to power, people go into hiding; but when the wicked perish, the righteous thrive.

ekegusii: Ekero abakori amabe bakomentekana, ogosaria nigo gokomentekana, korende abanyene oboronge mbarore okogwa kw’abwo.
english: When the wicked thrive, so does sin, but the righteous will see their downfall.

ekegusii: Goika edivai egachia kobaremera, ng’ina Yeso akamotebia, “Tibari nedivai.”
english: When the wine was gone, Jesus' mother said to him, "They have no more wine."

ekegusii: Erio omokungu oria akamochera Saulo akarora ng’a osoirwe nomoondoko, akamotebia, “Rora inche omosomba oo omokungu nigonakoigwera na tinaegerete obogima bwane, nakora buna kwaganetie.
english: When the woman came to Saul and saw that he was greatly shaken, she said, "Look, your maidservant has obeyed you. I took my life in my hands and did what you told me to do.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria o Tekoa, ekero aigete ase omoruoti, agatung’ama inse, akaumama ase okomosika, akabora, “Aye omoruoti, koranche onkonye.”
