english: where he stayed until the death of Herod. And so was fulfilled what the Lord had said through the prophet: "Out of Egypt I called my son."

ekegusii: Na Baraki akarangeria abanto ba Nafutali na aba Saluboni bache Kedesi, na abanto chilifu ikomi bagatiira amo na Baraki, na Debora akagenda nere.
english: where he summoned Zebulun and Naphtali. Ten thousand men followed him, and Deborah also went with him.

ekegusii: Ing’ai omoruoti o Hamati are, gose omoruoti bw’Aripadi, na oyo bw’omochie o Sefariwaimu, na oyo o Hena, gose oyo o Iwa?”
english: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, or of Hena or Ivvah?"

ekegusii: Ng’ai omoruoti o Hamati are, gose omoruoti bw’Aripadi, na oyo bw’omochie o Sefarawaimu, na oyo o Hena, na oyo o Iwa?”
english: Where is the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, the king of the city of Sepharvaim, or of Hena or Ivvah?"

ekegusii: Ng’ai are omong’aini? Ng’ai are omworokia bw’amariko? Ng’ai are oyokoamererania namang’ana ’ense eye? Inee! Nyasae takorete obong’aini bw’ense eye koba oboriri?
english: Where is the wise man? Where is the scholar? Where is the philosopher of this age? Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world?

ekegusii: Bono ng’ai omoruoti oino are, erinde abatoorie ase emechie yaino yonsi? Ng’ai abagambi ebina baino bare, inwe abamwatebete: Toe omoruoti na abagambi batogambere?
english: Where is your king, that he may save you? Where are your rulers in all your towns, of whom you said, 'Give me a king and princes'?

ekegusii: na korwa agwo Asimoni rogenderere kobwatia orooche rw’orobebe rwa Misiri, roike Enyancha Enene.
english: where it will turn, join the Wadi of Egypt and end at the Sea.

ekegusii: Aase aria Yeso asoete buna omotang’ani oito, na ase engencho yaito, ekero abeire Omokuani Omonene o kare na kare, koreng’ana buna Melkizedeki.
english: where Jesus, who went before us, has entered on our behalf. He has become a high priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek.

ekegusii: Amaraaro e chindo, ng’ai are? Ng’ai chindo chinsae chikoriera? Ng’ai chindo chituoni, ne chiaberi, ne chimanwa chiabo, chiarenge gotaara chitarenge kwoboigwa nonde?
english: Where now is the lions' den, the place where they fed their young, where the lion and lioness went, and the cubs, with nothing to fear?

ekegusii: where she entered Zechariah's home and greeted Elizabeth.
english: agasoa nyomba mwa Zakaria, agakwania Elisabeti.

ekegusii: Abakuani abanene na abanene b’Abayahudi bakamomanyia amang’ana igoro ya Paulo. Bagasorora Festo,
english: where the chief priests and Jewish leaders appeared before him and presented the charges against Paul.

ekegusii: “Inwe Abayuda, ng’ai chinyasae chiaino chire, echio mweroiseretie? Tiga chiche, erinde chibatoorie ekero more nemechando, ekiagera buna emechie yaino ere emenge, nabo nachirochio chire chinyinge.
english: Where then are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them come if they can save you when you are in trouble! For you have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah.

ekegusii: where then is my hope? Who can see any hope for me?
english: Inee! Ng’ai rende ogosemeria kwane kore? Ning’o oranyare gokorora?

ekegusii: Ase chiombe chi’okorema chitari, ebiage nigo bikoba bosa, korende ase chinguru chie chiombe chire, endagera enyinge nigo ekonyorekana.
english: Where there are no oxen, the manger is empty, but from the strength of an ox comes an abundant harvest.

ekegusii: Ase okomaanorerwa kw’amang’ana gotari, abanto tibari gwetanga gokora amabe, korende nasesenirie oyo obwatete amachiko.
english: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but blessed is he who keeps the law.

ekegusii: where they continued to preach the good news.
english: Aroro bakagenderera korandia enchili.

ekegusii: bakariina obwato ime, bagachaka kwamboka enyancha kogenda Kapernaumu. Naende omosunte konya obeire, na Yeso konya taracha asebare.
english: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.

ekegusii: Aase aye orakwere, nainche nao ndakwere, na ntindekwe aroro. Tiga Omonene ang’e egesusuro bono na kogenderera onye gento kende kegochia konyatanana korwa asore, otatiga amakweri oka.”
english: Where you die I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD deal with me, be it ever so severely, if anything but death separates you and me."

ekegusii: Agwo chisokoro chiaino nchianteemete ase okondenga, naende nchiaroche ogokora kwane ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene.
english: where your fathers tested and tried me and for forty years saw what I did.

ekegusii: Aaria chisokoro chiaino nigo chianteemete, nonya chiaroche emeremo yane nigo chiandengete.
english: where your fathers tested and tried me, though they had seen what I did.

ekegusii: Ng’ai rende ogwetogia gwaito kore? Gwasiekeirwe isiko. Ase ogochika ki? Ase ogochika kw’ogokora? Yaya, korende ase ogochika gw’okwegena.
english: Where, then, is boasting? It is excluded. On what principle? On that of observing the law? No, but on that of faith.

ekegusii: Abanto abaratigare b’egesaku eke ekebe, baria bare moyo ase chinsemo chionsi ase nabaseretie gochia, mbaganie ogokwa kobua koba moyo. Inche Omonene bw’Emeganda nakwanire.
english: Wherever I banish them, all the survivors of this evil nation will prefer death to life, declares the LORD Almighty.'

ekegusii: Aase ande onsi nabeire nkona‐kogenda amo n’Abaisraeli, tinana koboria mogambi onde bw’Abaisraeli, oyo nabegete akaba omorisia bw’abanto baane ng’a nase ki atang’agachereti obomenyo bw’emecharake.
english: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their leaders whom I commanded to shepherd my people, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?"'

ekegusii: Aase aande onsi nabeire nkona‐kogenda amo n’Abaisraeli, tinana koboria mogambi onde bw’Abaisraeli, oyo nabegete akaba omorisia bw’abanto baane, nase ki otang’agachereti obomenyo bw’emecharake.
english: Wherever I have moved with all the Israelites, did I ever say to any of their rulers whom I commanded to shepherd my people Israel, "Why have you not built me a house of cedar?"'

ekegusii: Aande onsi ase omoika orenge kogenda, nao na ebitongwa biria biarenge kogenda; naboigo na amagoro aria arenge kogenda amo nabirobio, ekiagera omoika bw’ebitongwa biria nigo orenge ime y’amagoro aria.
english: Wherever the spirit would go, they would go, and the wheels would rise along with them, because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

ekegusii: Naki aase ribego rire, nao chinsoti chigosangererekana.
english: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.

ekegusii: Agwo aase ore koraigwe eriogi ri’egetureri, oche aa asetore; Nyasae oito natorwanere.”
english: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, join us there. Our God will fight for us!"

ekegusii: Aase aande onsi morabe momenyete, emechie yaino nesirigwe, na aase aino aimokererete igoro mogosasimera natagorwe na atigwe bosa, na emegwekano yaino mogosasima nebutoranwe tebao naende; boigo na amatenenerio aino aya mogosasimera erioba nabutorwe agwo inse, naboigo na ebisasimero biaino bi’ogosambera ubani, na emeremo yaino yonsi mwakorire esirigwe.
english: Wherever you live, the towns will be laid waste and the high places demolished, so that your altars will be laid waste and devastated, your idols smashed and ruined, your incense altars broken down, and what you have made wiped out.

ekegusii: Omobiare o inka na omogorwa chibesa, bonsi goika barokigwe. Ase igo ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana kwane inakebe ase emebere yaino goika kare na kare.
english: Whether born in your household or bought with your money, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh is to be an everlasting covenant.

ekegusii: Aya naro achikire ase amang’ana ayio: Amache ayio karagenderere korua, gose atigire korua, omonto oyio tachenegeti.
english: Whether it continues flowing from his body or is blocked, it will make him unclean. This is how his discharge will bring about uncleanness:

ekegusii: Amang’ana ayio karabe amaya gose amabe, intwe goika tomoigwere Omonene, Nyasae oito, oyio asare twagotomire; ekiagera toise komoigwera Omonene, Nyasae oito, amang’ana nabe amaya asetore.”
english: Whether it is favorable or unfavorable, we will obey the LORD our God, to whom we are sending you, so that it will go well with us, for we will obey the LORD our God."

ekegusii: Ase igo kobirabe ebirarero, gose egento omokungu oria aikaranserete, omonto karabikune nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: Whether it is the bed or anything she was sitting on, when anyone touches it, he will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: onye Paulo, gose Apolo, gose Kefa, gose ense, gose obogima, gose amakweri, gose biria bire bono, gose ebio birache koba; bionsi nebiaino;
english: whether Paul or Apollos or Cephas or the world or life or death or the present or the future-- all are yours,

ekegusii: Onye riire riarenge kobeera igoro ase Obomenyo boria amatuko abere, gose omotienyi oyomo, gose engaki entambe, Abaisraeli nigo barenge kobeera ase egetwori, tibarenge komanora kogenda, korende ekero riire riaimokereire igoro, barabwo nigo barenge gochaka orogendo.
english: Whether the cloud stayed over the tabernacle for two days or a month or a year, the Israelites would remain in camp and not set out; but when it lifted, they would set out.

ekegusii: Komorabe mwagobeire korwa ase enchera gochia ensemo y’okorio, gose ey’okobee, inwe namoigwe korwa nyuma yaino amang’ana aya: “Enchera neye, yebwatie.”
english: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, "This is the way; walk in it."

ekegusii: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.
english: Gaki onye ninche, onye mbaria, naboigo tokorandia, naboigo mwegenete.

ekegusii: Oyosesenirie, oyore nokobua ere bweka, Omoruoti bw’abaruoti, Omonene bw’abanene, orache gotwo rokia okoorokigwa okwo ase ekero kiaye.
english: which God will bring about in his own time-- God, the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

ekegusii: Ime aroro mbiarengeo egesasimero gi’etahabu ki’ogosambera ubani, na esanduku y’okobwatana yaoomire netahabu chinsemo chionsi. Ime ase esanduku eria mbiarengeo: Egetaabo gi’etahabu aase biabegetwe endagera yare korokwa mana, na enyimbo ya Haroni yasebogete, ne chibao chi’amagena aase amang’ana ’okobwatana kw’ogotianania arikire.
english: which had the golden altar of incense and the gold-covered ark of the covenant. This ark contained the gold jar of manna, Aaron's staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.

ekegusii: Ere nigo akorete emeremo eyio ase Kristo ekero amobogetie korwa ase abakure, akamoikaransia ensemo y’okoboko kwaye gw’okorio aaria igoro,
english: which he exerted in Christ when he raised him from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly realms,

ekegusii: Akarusia obooke boria, akaboimokia, akaba okoboria ekero are kogenda. Akagenda ase ise na ng’ina akabaa obooke, nabarabwo bakaria. Korende Samison tabatebetie ng’a nigo aborusetie ase ribego ri’endo.
english: which he scooped out with his hands and ate as he went along. When he rejoined his parents, he gave them some, and they too ate it. But he did not tell them that he had taken the honey from the lion's carcass.

ekegusii: Ebuku eria ekaramborwa ase obosio bwane; nero nigo yarikire bosio na nyuma. Amang’ana arikire aroro nigo arenge ay’amagombo, na okweumia, na okorera kw’obobe.
english: which he unrolled before me. On both sides of it were written words of lament and mourning and woe.

ekegusii: Amagena ayio ngachete goika ase engaki y’emechando, amatuko aria arabe ay’esegi na okorwana konde.
english: which I reserve for times of trouble, for days of war and battle?

ekegusii: abwo baagete abanto nendamwamu, na bakaba bakobaaka batari gotiga. Nigo bagamberete ebisaku nendamwamu, bakaba bakobichanda batari namabera.
english: which in anger struck down peoples with unceasing blows, and in fury subdued nations with relentless aggression.

ekegusii: Ndiriri rire eriango, gotebia oyore rigata: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteba: Imoka, bwetweke oborere bwao, ogende?
english: Which is easier: to say to the paralytic, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up, take your mat and walk'?

ekegusii: Which is easier: to say, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up and walk'?
english: Ndiriri rire eriango, goteba: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteba: Imoka ogende?

ekegusii: Which is easier: to say, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or to say, 'Get up and walk'?
english: Ndiriri rire eriango, goteba: Ebibe biao biabeirwe, gose goteba: Imoka, ogende?

ekegusii: eyere omobere oye, ogoikerania kwaye ere oyogoikerania ebinto bionsi ase bonsi.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills everything in every way.

ekegusii: Erioba nigo rigosoka buna omonyuomi ogosoka korwa mwaye, na riagoka buna omogosoria omokong’u okominyoka chimbero.
english: which is like a bridegroom coming forth from his pavilion, like a champion rejoicing to run his course.

ekegusii: Enchili ende eng’ao teri, korende abanto bande mbare bakobachanda na korigia koonchorana enchili ya Kristo.
english: which is really no gospel at all. Evidently some people are throwing you into confusion and are trying to pervert the gospel of Christ.

ekegusii: bakagera nkaba nendamwamu asebare goika nkabaira ase ense y’ababisa babo. Onye chinkoro chiabo echio chire chinkong’u chigwekeyia, na barabwo banche konyora egesusuro ki’ebibe biabo,
english: which made me hostile toward them so that I sent them into the land of their enemies-- then when their uncircumcised hearts are humbled and they pay for their sin,

ekegusii: ebio Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, atairete ekero keria airete korwa ase Yerusalemu Yekonia mosinto o Yehoyakimu, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, amo nabanene bonsi b’Abayuda na aba Yerusalemu, akabaira Babeli ase obosomba.
english: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take away when he carried Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim king of Judah into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem--

ekegusii: Ning’o otamanyeti amang’ana aya onsi ng’a okoboko kw’Omonene nakwo gwakorire aya?
english: Which of all these does not know that the hand of the LORD has done this?

ekegusii: Ning’o asemore oranyare gotegerera amang’ana aya, erio ayarengererie na koyaigwera ase chingaki chigochi‐gocha.
english: Which of you will listen to this or pay close attention in time to come?

ekegusii: rigoteba, “Aya orarore oyarike ase ebuku, oyatome ase chikanisa echi isano na ibere echire Efeso, na Sumurina, na Perigamo, na Tiatira, na Saridi, na Filadelfia, na Laodikia.”
english: which said: "Write on a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia and Laodicea."

ekegusii: eyio egotoma abatomwa goetera ase orooche rwa Naili bariinete amaato aroisirie korwa ase amauncho! Inwe abatomwa more abaango, genda ase abanto b’egesaku bare abatambe babwate emebere emeterere ekomeka‐meka, bairokire nabanto bare ang’e, na abare aare. Egesaku ekio nigo kere ne chinguru, naende gekona‐kobua, na ense yabo chindooche chinachete.
english: which sends envoys by sea in papyrus boats over the water. Go, swift messengers, to a people tall and smooth-skinned, to a people feared far and wide, an aggressive nation of strange speech, whose land is divided by rivers.

ekegusii: Naki abande babwatirie ayio, na basirire korwa ase okwegena. Obuya bobe amo nainwe mwensi.
english: which some have professed and in so doing have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you.

ekegusii: Ogochika okwo nakwo Omonene aete Musa ase egetunwa gia Sinai, agwo ase erooro ya Sinai, ase rituko riria achigete Abaisraeli bamoruere Omonene ebing’wanso biabo.
english: which the LORD gave Moses on Mount Sinai on the day he commanded the Israelites to bring their offerings to the LORD, in the Desert of Sinai.

ekegusii: Obobisi obo Nyasae tamanyetie mwanyabanto ase ebigori binde buna bono ase Omoika abaigoreire abatomwa baye abachenu na ababani.
english: which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God's holy apostles and prophets.

ekegusii: oko kwabekire ase amaiso ’abanto bonsi,
english: which you have prepared in the sight of all people,

ekegusii: Ekero omoganda omonene osangererekanete, na abanto ba kera omochie bakamochiera, agakwana ase omoreng’anio:
english: While a large crowd was gathering and people were coming to Jesus from town after town, he told this parable:

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Haroni arenge gokwana nomoganda bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli, barabwo bakeonchora bakarigereria gochia ase erooro, bakarora obonene bw’Omonene bokooroka korwa ase riire.
english: While Aaron was speaking to the whole Israelite community, they looked toward the desert, and there was the glory of the LORD appearing in the cloud.

ekegusii: Ekero Abisalomu arenge korua ebing’wanso, agatoma abanto korangeria Ahitofali, omosemia bw’omoruoti Daudi, korwa ase omochie o Gilo. Obobe bwabo bw’okoba mamincha ya Daudi bokabucha, bokaba ne chinguru, na abanto abwo bakabwatana n’Abisalomu bakamentekana, bakaba abange.
english: While Absalom was offering sacrifices, he also sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David's counselor, to come from Giloh, his hometown. And so the conspiracy gained strength, and Absalom's following kept on increasing.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bonsi bamotegererete agatebia aborokigwa baye,
english: While all the people were listening, Jesus said to his disciples,

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Apolo arenge Korinto, Paulo agaeta egati y’ense ya rogoro, agaika Efeso. Aroro akanyorana naborokigwa batai bake.
english: While Apollos was at Corinth, Paul took the road through the interior and arrived at Ephesus. There he found some disciples

ekegusii: Bono Orinani nigo arenge koora engano, na agwo akeonchora akarora omomalaika, na abana baye abamura bane abarenge amo nero bakebisa.
english: While Araunah was threshing wheat, he turned and saw the angel; his four sons who were with him hid themselves.

ekegusii: Ekero anyure edivai atindire, agachika ng’a ebikorero biria bie chitahabu na ebie chifeta ebio Nebukadinesaro ise asakorete korwa ase Hekalu agwo Yerusalemu, birentwe, erinde ere, na abanene b’oboruoti bwaye, na abakungu baye, na abakungu baye ba sere‐sere, banywere ebikorero ebio edivai.
english: While Belshazzar was drinking his wine, he gave orders to bring in the gold and silver goblets that Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken from the temple in Jerusalem, so that the king and his nobles, his wives and his concubines might drink from them.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi arenge agwo Horesi, ase erooro ya Sifu, akaigwa ng’a Saulo konya ochire agwo korigia gosiria obogima bwaye.
english: While David was at Horesh in the Desert of Ziph, he learned that Saul had come out to take his life.

ekegusii: Ekero Daudi arenge ase erooro akaigwa ng’a Nabali nkonacha arenge ching’ondi chiaye amarionya.
english: While David was in the desert, he heard that Nabal was shearing sheep.

ekegusii: Bono Daudi nigo aikaransete egati y’ebiita bibere bi’omochie, egia isiko na ekia ime. Omorendi akariina gochia kerama igoro y’ebiita, ang’e norwaki. Na ekero arigereretie akarora omonto oyomo okominyoka gocha ore bweka.
english: While David was sitting between the inner and outer gates, the watchman went up to the roof of the gateway by the wall. As he looked out, he saw a man running alone.

ekegusii: Kera omonto agatenena aase aye goetanana ase egetwori keria; erio abarwani b’esegi abarenge imeo bagachaka kominyoka gochia aaria na aaria, bagakuura na gotama.
english: While each man held his position around the camp, all the Midianites ran, crying out as they fled.

ekegusii: Korende abanto ababe na abang’ainereria mbamentekane kobua ase obobe, bakong’aina na kong’aineka.
english: while evil men and impostors will go from bad to worse, deceiving and being deceived.

ekegusii: Bono ekero Ezara agendererete gosaba na koorokia amamocho, okorera na oramaime inse bosio bw’enyomba ya Nyasae, omosangererekano omonene mono bw’Abaisraeli, abasacha na abakungu, na abana, bagacha asare. Abanto abwo bonsi nigo babete bakorera bare nobororo obonge.
english: While Ezra was praying and confessing, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, a large crowd of Israelites-- men, women and children-- gathered around him. They too wept bitterly.

ekegusii: Korende ekero Galio arenge gavuna bw’Akaya, Abayahudi bakarindokera Paulo ase obomo, bakamoira bosio bw’ekegambero,
english: While Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews made a united attack on Paul and brought him into court.

ekegusii: Naboigo Daudi na Abaisraeli bonsi bakarenta Esanduku y’Omonene, bakaba bagoaka amariogi ’omogoko na kobugia egetureri.
english: while he and the entire house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouts and the sound of trumpets.

ekegusii: na ere omonyene akagenda ase erooro orogendo rwe rituko erimo, agaikaransa inse y’omote okorokwa omoretemu, agesabera ng’a akwe, akabora,” “Bono Omonene, aya aisanire, ira obogima bwane, ekiagera inche tindi omuya kobua chisokoro chiane.”
english: while he himself went a day's journey into the desert. He came to a broom tree, sat down under it and prayed that he might die. "I have had enough, LORD," he said. "Take my life; I am no better than my ancestors."

ekegusii: Kabasesenirie ageatanana korwa asebare akabogorigwa gochia igoro.
english: While he was blessing them, he left them and was taken up into heaven.

ekegusii: Yeso ekero arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simion oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma, gaikaransete ase endagera, agacha omokungu orenge nechuba ye rigena rirabu ere namaguta agotioka buya, aye rigori rinene, agaata echuba eria, akamonyororokeria omotwe oye.
english: While he was in Bethany, reclining at the table in the home of a man known as Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke the jar and poured the perfume on his head.

ekegusii: Hadadi, ekero arenge ase ense ya Misiri, akaigwa ng’a Daudi orarire ase chisokoro chiaye chiararete, naende ng’a Yoabu, omochiki bw’emeganda y’esegi, nere okure, agatebia Farao, “Ing’a ribaga ngende ase ense yane.”
english: While he was in Egypt, Hadad heard that David rested with his fathers and that Joab the commander of the army was also dead. Then Hadad said to Pharaoh, "Let me go, that I may return to my own country."

ekegusii: Akamenya ase erooro ya Parani, na ng’ina akamonyuomeria omokungu korwa ase ense ya Misiri.
english: While he was living in the Desert of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from Egypt.

ekegusii: While he was saying this to me, I bowed with my face toward the ground and was speechless.
english: Ekero akoorete gokwana nainche amang’ana aya, ngetureka gochia inse, nkaba rimansu.

ekegusii: Ekero Yeso are gokwana aya, omonene oyomo agacha, akabeka amaru inse asare, okobora, “Omwana one omoiseke okure bono iga, korende inchuo aye, omobekere okoboko, na ere nabe moyo.”
english: While he was saying this, a ruler came and knelt before him and said, "My daughter has just died. But come and put your hand on her, and she will live."

ekegusii: Ekero agendererete gokwana nainche, chitoro chinene chikambwata gontung’aime inse ng’umaime, korende agankuna, agantenenia, na inche ngatenena boronge.
english: While he was speaking to me, I was in a deep sleep, with my face to the ground. Then he touched me and raised me to my feet.

ekegusii: Ekero agokwana amang’ana aya riire rigacha rikababisia, bakairoka kobachia gosoa ase riire.
english: While he was speaking, a cloud appeared and enveloped them, and they were afraid as they entered the cloud.

ekegusii: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.
english: Ekero arenge gotirimboka abasomba baye bagacha komorotota, bakamotebia, “Omwana oo moyo are.”

ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, rora, omoganda ogacha, na oria okorokwa Yudas, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, obatang’aine. Ere akamoika Yeso ang’e komonyunyunta.
english: While he was still speaking a crowd came up, and the man who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, was leading them. He approached Jesus to kiss him,

ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, rora, riire rirabu rikababisia, na eriogi rikarwa ase riire riria, rigateba, “Oyo n’Omwana one omwanchwa, ngokirie nere; moigwere ere.”
english: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, "This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased. Listen to him!"

ekegusii: Na ekero noyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agatebia Ayubu, “Abakalidayo nigo bachicha bare ebiombe bitato, baumokera chingamia, bachiira, naende baita abasomba bande nemioro; ninche bweka natigara inde moyo, natama gocha kogotebia.”
english: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, "The Chaldeans formed three raiding parties and swept down on your camels and carried them off. They put the servants to the sword, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"

ekegusii: Ekero oyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agateba, “Omorero o Nyasae nigo ogwa korwa igoro, osamba ching’ondi chiayia chiaera, naende boigo osamba abasomba bayia baera; ninche bweka natigara, natama gocha kogotebia.”
english: While he was still speaking, another messenger came and said, "The fire of God fell from the sky and burned up the sheep and the servants, and I am the only one who has escaped to tell you!"

ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, Yudas, oyomo bwa baria ikomi na babere, agacha, na omoganda omonene amo nere bare nemioro ne chinungu, bakorwa ase abakuani abanene na abagaaka b’abanto.
english: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the elders of the people.

ekegusii: Ekero agendererete gokwana omoruoti akamoboria, “Inee! Ntwagochorire obe omosemia bw’omoruoti? Kira‐kiri! Noganetie togoite okwe?” Omobani oria agakira, erio agateba, “Namanyire ng’a Nyasae onachire ekina agoite, ekiagera gwakorire egento eke na kwangire koigwera ogosemia kwane.”
english: While he was still speaking, the king said to him, "Have we appointed you an adviser to the king? Stop! Why be struck down?" So the prophet stopped but said, "I know that God has determined to destroy you, because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel."

ekegusii: Ekero noyio agendererete gokwana, omonto onde agacha, agatebia Ayubu, “Abana bao, abamura na abaiseke, nigo babwate omoyega bw’okoria na konywa edivai ase enyomba ya momura omwabo omonene;
english: While he was still speaking, yet another messenger came and said, "Your sons and daughters were feasting and drinking wine at the oldest brother's house,

ekegusii: “Emechando eye nigo yarure ase Omonene. Ninki rende nganyete inyore korwa ase Omonene?”
english: While he was still talking to them, the messenger came down to him. And [the king] said, "This disaster is from the LORD. Why should I wait for the LORD any longer?"

ekegusii: Ekero arenge ogendererete gokwana nabarabwo, Raeli agacha obwate ching’ondi chia ise, naki nere orenge gochirisia.
english: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep, for she was a shepherdess.

ekegusii: Erio chinyama chi’eng’ombe eria, chisamberwe ase obosio bwaye amo ne riiyo na amanyinga, na esike.
english: While he watches, the heifer is to be burned-- its hide, flesh, blood and offal.

ekegusii: Harani agatanga gokwa, agatiga Tera ise moyo are, ase ense eria aiboreretwe, ase Uru y’Abakalidayo.
english: While his father Terah was still alive, Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, in the land of his birth.

ekegusii: Ekero inde ase ense, inche nomobaso bw’ense.”
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world."

ekegusii: Erio agwo nkagenderera gokwana na gosaba, nkaorokia ebibe biane, na ebi’abanto baane Abaisraeli na korenta ogosorora kwane ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae one, ase engencho y’egetunwa egechenu kia Nyasae one.
english: While I was speaking and praying, confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel and making my request to the LORD my God for his holy hill--

ekegusii: Ekero nagendererete gosaba, Gabirieli, omonto oria konya narorire ase okorora koria kwe ritang’ani, aganchichera bwango okoiruruka. Nigo yarenge engaki y’okoruegwa gw’ekeng’wanso kia mogoroba.
english: while I was still in prayer, Gabriel, the man I had seen in the earlier vision, came to me in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice.

ekegusii: Aya nabeire nkona‐koyairanerera korigia komanya buna are, korende tindayamanya. Ase abanto elifu eyemo nkanyora omosacha oyomo, korende ase abwo bonsi tinanyorete omokungu nonya noyomo.
english: while I was still searching but not finding-- I found one [upright] man among a thousand, but not one [upright] woman among them all.

ekegusii: Ekero narenge amo nabarabwo ase ense, nigo nabarendete ase okobua kw’erieta riao baria kwang’ete. Igo nabaritete, gose tari nonya noyomo obo osirire, otatiga oria omwana bw’obosiru, erinde ririko rinyare goikeranigwa.
english: While I was with them, I protected them and kept them safe by that name you gave me. None has been lost except the one doomed to destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled.

ekegusii: Erio nkarora abakerubi baria bakorambora chimbaba chiabo na koimokerera igoro korwa ase riroba ekero bagendete, na amagoro aria naro akagenda amo nabarabwo. Bagatenena ase egesoero ki’egeita kia moocha kegochia ase enyomba y’Omonene, na obonene bwa Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli nigo bwarenge igoro yabo.
english: While I watched, the cherubim spread their wings and rose from the ground, and as they went, the wheels went with them. They stopped at the entrance to the east gate of the LORD's house, and the glory of the God of Israel was above them.

ekegusii: Ekero inche Danieli naroche okorora koria na nkarigia imanye engencho yaye, nkarora oyomo ogwekaine mwanyabanto oteneine ase obosio bwane.
english: While I, Daniel, was watching the vision and trying to understand it, there before me stood one who looked like a man.

ekegusii: Engaki eria Israeli amenyete ase ense eria, Reuben akagenda akarara na Bilia, omokungu o ise, oria o sere‐sere, na Israeli akaigwa amang’ana ayio. Abamura ba Yakobo nigo barenge ikomi na babere.
english: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father's concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard of it. Jacob had twelve sons:

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli batoorete agwo Sitimu, abanto bagachaka gokora obotomani nabakungu b’Abamoabu.
english: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with Moabite women,

ekegusii: Ekero Yehu arenge korua egesusuro igoro ase enyomba y’Ahabu, akanyora abanene b’Abayuda, na abana abamura b’abamura bamwabo Ahasia, baria barenge gokorera Ahasia, akabaita.
english: While Jehu was executing judgment on the house of Ahab, he found the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's relatives, who had been attending Ahaziah, and he killed them.

ekegusii: Agwo ritang’ani, ekero Yeremia agendererete komenya ase egoora eria y’abarendi, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asare, rikamotebia,
english: While Jeremiah had been confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD came to him:

ekegusii: Ekero Yeremia agendererete kobeera ase egoora y’enyomba y’abasibwa agwo ase enyomba y’oboruoti, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha asare eria kabere, rikamotebia,
english: While Jeremiah was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, the word of the LORD came to him a second time:

ekegusii: Ekaba ekero Yeso aikaransete nyomba mw’omonto oria, okoria endagera, abarusia ebango abange na abanyene ebibe bagaikaransa amo na Yeso na aborokigwa baye; naki barenge abange bamotunyanete.
english: While Jesus was having dinner at Levi's house, many tax collectors and "sinners" were eating with him and his disciples, for there were many who followed him.

ekegusii: While Jesus was having dinner at Matthew's house, many tax collectors and "sinners" came and ate with him and his disciples.
english: Ekero Yeso aikaransire nyomba koragera, rora, abarusia ebango abange amo nabanyene ebibe bagacha, bagaikaransa amo na Yeso na aborokigwa baye.

ekegusii: Na Yeso, ekero arenge Bethania ase enyomba ya Simion, oyorenge noborwaire bwa ukoma,
english: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of a man known as Simon the Leper,

ekegusii: Ekero arenge ase omochie oyomo, rora, narengeo omonto omosacha oichire noborwaire bwa ukoma. Ere agachia korora Yeso, akagwa maumama, akamosorora, okomotebia, “Omonene, onye ngwancha, nonyare gonsibia.”
english: While Jesus was in one of the towns, a man came along who was covered with leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell with his face to the ground and begged him, "Lord, if you are willing, you can make me clean."

ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana, abanto korwa ase enyomba y’omotang’ani bw’esinagogi bagacha, bakabora, “Enyaroka yao yakure. Inki okona‐koroseria Omworokia rende?”
english: While Jesus was still speaking, some men came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue ruler. "Your daughter is dead," they said. "Why bother the teacher any more?"

ekegusii: Erio kagokwana, omonto agacha korwa ase enyomba y’oria omotang’ani bw’esinagogi, akamotebia, “Enyaroka yao yakure, torosia omworokia naende.”
english: While Jesus was still speaking, someone came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue ruler. "Your daughter is dead," he said. "Don't bother the teacher any more."

ekegusii: Ekero arenge gokwana nabanto, rora, ng’ina na bamura bamwabo nigo bateneine isiko, barigetie gokwana nere.
english: While Jesus was still talking to the crowd, his mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to him.

ekegusii: Yeso akabora gakworokereria ime ase Hekalu, “Naki aborokia b’amariko bakobora ng’a Kristo nomwana o Daudi?
english: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, he asked, "How is it that the teachers of the law say that the Christ is the son of David?

ekegusii: Ekero Yesebeli aitete ababani b’Omonene, Obadia nigo airete ababani rigana erimo, akabaatanana ebiombe bibere, kera ekeombe nigo kiabwate abanto emerongo etano, akababisa ase rikuruma, akaba okobarageria na kobaa amache bakonywa.)
english: While Jezebel was killing off the LORD's prophets, Obadiah had taken a hundred prophets and hidden them in two caves, fifty in each, and had supplied them with food and water.)

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ’okogamba kwa Yosia, Farao Neko, omoruoti o Misiri, akagenda korwana nomoruoti bw’Abaasuri agwo ase orooche rw’Eufarati. Yosia omoruoti akagenda agwo korwana nere, na ekero Farao Neko amoroche, akamoitera agwo Megido.
english: While Josiah was king, Pharaoh Neco king of Egypt went up to the Euphrates River to help the king of Assyria. King Josiah marched out to meet him in battle, but Neco faced him and killed him at Megiddo.

ekegusii: Ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase Yeremia, ekero Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, amo nabarwani baye bonsi b’esegi, na amaruoti onsi ayarenge inse y’obogambi bwaye, na abanto bonsi barenge korwania Yerusalemu na emechie yaye, rikamotebia,
english: While Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army and all the kingdoms and peoples in the empire he ruled were fighting against Jerusalem and all its surrounding towns, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD:

ekegusii: abande barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yuda, na abande ab’orwa Benjamin. Ab’ororeria rwa Yuda nabwo aba: Ataya, mosinto o Usia, o Zakaria, bw’Amaria, o Sefatia, o Mahalaleli, bw’ororeria rwa Peresi;
english: while other people from both Judah and Benjamin lived in Jerusalem): From the descendants of Judah: Athaiah son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, a descendant of Perez;

ekegusii: naki ebiimo biaito bire nobuya tibiganeti ayio. Korende Nyasae obwatanirie omobere, na ekiimo keria keremeire ogosika okeire ogosika kobua,
english: while our presentable parts need no special treatment. But God has combined the members of the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,

ekegusii: Ekero Paulo abaganyete aria Atene, akarora buna omochie oria oichire nemegwekano y’ogosasimwa, akaigwa bobe ase omoika oye.
english: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was greatly distressed to see that the city was full of idols.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bagoteba, “Ntore nomorembe na obotoereru”, erio nario ogosareka gokobachera mobosokano buna obororo bw’okobina bokomochera oyore morito, na tibakonyara gwetooria.
english: While people are saying, "Peace and safety," destruction will come on them suddenly, as labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.

ekegusii: Na Petero nigo arenge egoora inse, na oyomo bw’abaiseke abasomba b’omokuani omonene agacha,
english: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.

ekegusii: Ekero Petero arenge gokwana aya Omoika Omochenu ogaikera bonsi abaigwete amang’ana aya.
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came on all who heard the message.

ekegusii: Na Petero, karengereretie okorora koria, Omoika okamotebia, “Rora, abanto batato bagokorigia.
english: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Spirit said to him, "Simon, three men are looking for you.

ekegusii: Ekero Petero arenge ne chitang’u‐tang’u ase omoyo oye ime ase okorora okwo aroche, engencho yaye inki, rora, abanto baria batometwe na Kornelio, kobaboririe enyomba ya Simion, bagatenena geita.
english: While Peter was wondering about the meaning of the vision, the men sent by Cornelius found out where Simon's house was and stopped at the gate.

ekegusii: Ekero Pilato aikaransire ase ekerogo gi’ekina, akarenterwa amang’ana na mokaye, ogoteba, “Oyio nomonto omonyene oboronge, tobaisa kwebwatia asare, ekiagera rero inachandetwe namange ase okorota ase engencho yaye.”
english: While Pilate was sitting on the judge's seat, his wife sent him this message: "Don't have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of him."

ekegusii: Ekero Samweli arenge korua ekeng’wanso keria ki’ogosambwa, Abafilisti bagacha korwania Abaisraeli, korende Omonene akabarentera okogukura okonene gwe chinkoba korwa igoro, akabatantania, na Abaisraeli bakabua Abafilisti.
english: While Samuel was sacrificing the burnt offering, the Philistines drew near to engage Israel in battle. But that day the LORD thundered with loud thunder against the Philistines and threw them into such a panic that they were routed before the Israelites.

ekegusii: Ekero Saulo agendererete gokwana nomokuani, eburu‐buru eyarenge ase egetwori ki’Abafilisti ekamentekana kobucha. Ase ayio Saulo akamotebia, “Tiga, tobaisa koboria Omonene.”
english: While Saul was talking to the priest, the tumult in the Philistine camp increased more and more. So Saul said to the priest, "Withdraw your hand."

ekegusii: Ekero omokungu oria agendererete gokwana nomoruoti, Nathani omobani agacha aroro agwo.
english: While she was still speaking with the king, Nathan the prophet arrived.

ekegusii: Ekero bigendererete gosicha, engaki y’okobitema etaraika, nigo birasusane bitige ebimeri binde.
english: While still growing and uncut, they wither more quickly than grass.

ekegusii: ekero abarwani esegi b’omoruoti o Babeli bagendererete korwania Yerusalemu na emechie ya Lakisi na Aseka, emechie y’Abayuda, konya yatigaire yagiteire chindwaki.
english: while the army of the king of Babylon was fighting against Jerusalem and the other cities of Judah that were still holding out-- Lachish and Azekah. These were the only fortified cities left in Judah.

ekegusii: Ekero are kobwata‐bwata Petero na Yohana, abanto bonsi ase ogokumia bakaminyoka na gosangererekana amo asebare ase egesona kiare korokwa Egesona gia Sulemani.
english: While the beggar held on to Peter and John, all the people were astonished and came running to them in the place called Solomon's Colonnade.

ekegusii: Ababenjamin bagateba, “Twababuire buna chingaki chiria chinde.” Korende Abaisraeli konya barobeirie ng’a babang’use korwa ase omochie oria, erinde bagende gochia ase chinchera chinene.
english: While the Benjamites were saying, "We are defeating them as before," the Israelites were saying, "Let's retreat and draw them away from the city to the roads."

ekegusii: Ekero Abaisraeli bagendererete koba ase erooro, omonto oyomo akanyorwa ogotenya chinko ase rituko ri’Esabato.
english: While the Israelites were in the desert, a man was found gathering wood on the Sabbath day.

ekegusii: Ekero omoruoti arenge aase aye agotimokera, amaguta aane akorokwa narada agatioka rimisu rigiya.
english: While the king was at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

ekegusii: Erio omonto agatenena mbarabare asende, na nkaigwa omonto onde ogokwana nainche korwa ime ye Hekalu eria,
english: While the man was standing beside me, I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple.

ekegusii: ekero ching’enang’eni chia mambia chiaterete amo, na abana bonsi ba Nyasae baagete eriogi ri’omogoko?
english: while the morning stars sang together and all the angels shouted for joy?

ekegusii: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
english: Abafarisai kobasangererekanire amo, Yeso akababoria,

ekegusii: Na Abafilisti konya baumokeire emechie y’ense omweya ya Yuda amo na Negebu, bakaira Beti‐Semesi, na Ayaloni, na Gederoti, na Soko, amo nebichie biaye, na Timuna amo nebichie biaye, na Gimoso amo nebichie biaye, bakamenya aroro.
english: while the Philistines had raided towns in the foothills and in the Negev of Judah. They captured and occupied Beth Shemesh, Aijalon and Gederoth, as well as Soco, Timnah and Gimzo, with their surrounding villages.

ekegusii: Obotambe bw’ebinyomba biarochie ase eraaro ya isiko nigo bwarenge obw’amaboko emerongo etano, na obotambe bw’ebio biarenge ang’e ne Hekalu amaboko rigana erimo.
english: While the row of rooms on the side next to the outer court was fifty cubits long, the row on the side nearest the sanctuary was a hundred cubits long.

ekegusii: Erio omoruoti akeonchora akarigereria abanto, agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli ekero oteneine,
english: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.

ekegusii: Na omoruoti akeonchora, agasesenia omosangererekano bwonsi bw’Abaisraeli ekero oteneine,
english: While the whole assembly of Israel was standing there, the king turned around and blessed them.

ekegusii: Kobakogenda, rora, abande b’abarendi baria bagasoa ase omochie, bagatebia abakuani abanene amang’ana onsi ayakoregete.
english: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.

ekegusii: Ekero abasomba baria barenge baganyete, Ehudi agatama. Ere konya oetire ase amagena arenge, aria abaachire are emegwekano, agatama gochia Seira.
english: While they waited, Ehud got away. He passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah.

ekegusii: Obochore ekebao ase enyasi ekero abanto abwo bakoroche, erio obogorie ebinto biao oetereo.
english: While they watch, dig through the wall and take your belongings out through it.

ekegusii: Ekero baigete ase rigena rinene agwo Gibeoni, Amasa agachia kobarotota. Yoabu nigo abegete chianga chiaye chi’esegi, na nigo eboeranetie omoyio o birende ase orokini. Ekero are gocha, omoyio oria okagwa inse.
english: While they were at the great rock in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was wearing his military tunic, and strapped over it at his waist was a belt with a dagger in its sheath. As he stepped forward, it dropped out of its sheath.

ekegusii: Ekero barenge korenta chibesa chiria konya chiarentirwe ase enyomba y’Omonene, Hilikia omokuani akanyora Ebuku y’Amachiko ’Omonene yarwetwe goetera ase Musa.
english: While they were bringing out the money that had been taken into the temple of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD that had been given through Moses.

ekegusii: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to his disciples, saying, "Take and eat; this is my body."
english: Kobakoragera, Yeso akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akaa aborokigwa, akabora, “Bogoria, morie; oyo noro omobere one.”

ekegusii: Barabwo bakaba nkoria bare, akabogoria omogati, akayosesenia, akayosamunyora, akabaa, akabora, “Bogoria! Oyo noro omobere one.”
english: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks and broke it, and gave it to his disciples, saying, "Take it; this is my body."

ekegusii: Ekero barenge kwegokia igo, abanto bande abanyaka b’omochie oria bagacha mobosokano, bagaetanana enyomba na goaka egesieri, bagatebia omogaaka oria, “Mosokie omonto oria ocha mwao, erinde torare nere tomosarie.”
english: While they were enjoying themselves, some of the wicked men of the city surrounded the house. Pounding on the door, they shouted to the old man who owned the house, "Bring out the man who came to your house so we can have sex with him."

ekegusii: Ekero bachia gosoka isiko, rora, abanto bakamorentera omonto orenge rimama, naende igo abwatire nekerecha.
english: While they were going out, a man who was demon-possessed and could not talk was brought to Jesus.

ekegusii: Na ekero chinkoro chiabo chiabete nomochengo, bagateba, “Torentere Samison atokorere chigosori!” Ase ayio bakarenta Samison korwa enyomba y’obosibwa, ere akabakorera chigosori. Bakamobeka agatenena gati‐gati ye chisiiro.
english: While they were in high spirits, they shouted, "Bring out Samson to entertain us." So they called Samson out of the prison, and he performed for them. When they stood him among the pillars,

ekegusii: Ekero abwo bagendererete goita abanto, ngatigara inche bweka. Erio ngatung’ama inse nkaumama, nkarera ase Omonene, nkamoboria, “Aye Omonene Nyasae, Inee, nigo ogochia gosiria Abaisraeli bonsi abwo batigaire ase okoumora endamwamu yao ase Yerusalemu?”
english: While they were killing and I was left alone, I fell facedown, crying out, "Ah, Sovereign LORD! Are you going to destroy the entire remnant of Israel in this outpouring of your wrath on Jerusalem?"

ekegusii: Abanto baria bagachia koigwa aya, Yeso akamenta kobatebia omoreng’anio, ekiagera konya oikire ang’e na Yerusalemu, na barabwo bagakaga ng’a oboruoti bwa Nyasae nigo borarorekane ekero ekio kegima.
english: While they were listening to this, he went on to tell them a parable, because he was near Jerusalem and the people thought that the kingdom of God was going to appear at once.

ekegusii: Ekaba kobare inchera kogenda sobo, Daudi agatebigwa ng’a, “Abisalomu oitire abamura bao bonsi, onde tatigareti nonya noyomo.”
english: While they were on their way, the report came to David: "Absalom has struck down all the king's sons; not one of them is left."

ekegusii: Na barabwo kobaikaransire ase endagera bakoria, Yeso akabora, “Nekeene, nabatebirie: Oyomo oino oyokoria amo nainche nandue.”
english: While they were reclining at the table eating, he said, "I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me-- one who is eating with me."

ekegusii: Na ekero barenge baikaransete ase emesa, ring’ana ri’Omonene rigacha ase omobani oria omogotu, oria omoiranetie;
english: While they were sitting at the table, the word of the LORD came to the old prophet who had brought him back.

ekegusii: Ekero baare gokwana iga, Yeso omonyene agatenena egati yabo, akabatebia, “Omorembe obe asemore!”
english: While they were still talking about this, Jesus himself stood among them and said to them, "Peace be with you."

ekegusii: Ekero bagendererete gokwana nere, abakoreri b’enyomba y’omoruoti bagacha kwoyia Hamani bakamoira bwango ase endagera eria Esteri aroisetie.
english: While they were still talking with him, the king's eunuchs arrived and hurried Haman away to the banquet Esther had prepared.

ekegusii: Bagaaka Stefano amagena ekero arenge gosaba, ogoteba, “Omonene Yeso, ira omoika one.”
english: While they were stoning him, Stephen prayed, "Lord Jesus, receive my spirit."

ekegusii: Ekero barenge aroro engaki yaye y’okoibora egaika.
english: While they were there, the time came for the baby to be born,

ekegusii: Ekero bateemire komoita, amang’ana agaikera omotang’ani bw’abarwani elifu ng’a omochie omogima o Yerusalemu osarekire.
english: While they were trying to kill him, news reached the commander of the Roman troops that the whole city of Jerusalem was in an uproar.

ekegusii: Ekero baichanete ase aya, rora, abanto babere bagatenena ang’e asebare, beboyetie chianga chikomeka‐meka.
english: While they were wondering about this, suddenly two men in clothes that gleamed like lightning stood beside them.

ekegusii: Abaiga, ekero barenge gosasima Omonene, na kweng’ata, Omoika Omochenu agateba, “Nchorere Barnaba na Saulo ase emeremo eria nabarangereretie bayekore.”
english: While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, "Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them."

ekegusii: gatoganyete ogoikeranigwa kw’ogosemeria gosesenirie, na okooroka kw’obonene bwa Nyasae omonene, na Omotooria oito Kristo Yeso,
english: while we wait for the blessed hope-- the glorious appearing of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

ekegusii: Bono nebe ekero aye ogendererete gokwana nomoruoti, nainche boigo ninsoe mbeke amang’ana ao chinguru ase okoenekia ng’a nekeene.”
english: While you are still there talking to the king, I will come in and confirm what you have said."

ekegusii: Ekero morabusure chindagera ase emegondo yaino ase omwaka o gatano na gatato mogenderere koria endagera eria enkoro, goika endagera y’omwaka o kianda egeswe.
english: While you plant during the eighth year, you will eat from the old crop and will continue to eat from it until the harvest of the ninth year comes in.

ekegusii: Naende inche Omonene nigo ngoteba iga: Bono mwakorire amang’ana aya onsi, timorigeti koigwera ekero ngendererete gokwana nainwe, na ekero nabarangeretie timwaitabete.
english: While you were doing all these things, declares the LORD, I spoke to you again and again, but you did not listen; I called you, but you did not answer.

ekegusii: Ekero kwarigereretie okarora rigena rigotegoka ritakuniri namaboko a mwanyabanto, rigaaka amagoro ’omogwekano oria arenge ay’ebioma na amaroba, rikayasamunyora akaba ebisamunye.
english: While you were watching, a rock was cut out, but not by human hands. It struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay and smashed them.

ekegusii: Na buna inche omosomba oo nabwate emeremo emenge narenge gokora aa na aaria, omonto oria akagenda.” Omoruoti bw’Abaisraeli akamotebia, “Naboigo okonachwa gw’ekina kiao kerabe; aye omonyene gwakenachire.”
english: While your servant was busy here and there, the man disappeared." "That is your sentence," the king of Israel said. "You have pronounced it yourself."

ekegusii: Naki inche, omosomba oo, ekero narenge imenyete Gesuri ya Siiria, nigo narierete Omonene eira ng’a karang’iranie Yerusalemu, erio nimbe nkomokorera agwo Heburoni.”
english: While your servant was living at Geshur in Aram, I made this vow: 'If the LORD takes me back to Jerusalem, I will worship the LORD in Hebron. '"

ekegusii: abwo bakoegwa riaaki baa oyore nokomocha oboronge, erio barina omonyene oboronge oboronge bwaye.
english: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice to the innocent.

ekegusii: Nere bweka otari konyorekana namakweri, nigo amenyete ase omobaso otanyare goikwa ang’e, na onde tari ase mwanyabanto omoroche gose oranyare komorora. Asare ere ogosika na okobua kare na kare. Amina.
english: who alone is immortal and who lives in unapproachable light, whom no one has seen or can see. To him be honor and might forever. Amen.

ekegusii: Ning’o ore asemore omoirogete Omonene na koigwera eriogi ri’omosomba oye? Oyio ogotaara ase omosunte otari korora omobaso, tiga egene erieta ri’Omonene na amosemerie Nyasae.
english: Who among you fears the LORD and obeys the word of his servant? Let him who walks in the dark, who has no light, trust in the name of the LORD and rely on his God.

ekegusii: Ning’o oete Nyasae okobua gw’okogambera ense? Ning’o obegete ense yonsi koba eyaye?
english: Who appointed him over the earth? Who put him in charge of the whole world?

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bakogoka mono na gochenga, ee, nabo bakogoka kobabeire ang’e kogenda ase chimbeera.
english: who are filled with gladness and rejoice when they reach the grave?

ekegusii: korende nigo nkogokora nainwe abamoteneine aiga rero amo naintwe ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oito, naende amo nabwo batateneini amo naintwe aiga rero.
english: who are standing here with us today in the presence of the LORD our God but also with those who are not here today.

ekegusii: Aye naye ng’o okogambia omosomba bw’omonto onde? Ase omonene oye omonyene nigo ateneine gose nigo akogwa. Ee, natenene, ekiagera Omonene nere ore nokobua gw’okomotenenia.
english: Who are you to judge someone else's servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.

ekegusii: inwe nigo mokoagacha Sayoni ase ogoitera amanyinga, na Yerusalemu ase ogokora okobe.
english: who build Zion with bloodshed, and Jerusalem with wickedness.

ekegusii: Ere ase obong’aini bwaye nigo atongete igoro, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: who by his understanding made the heavens, His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare korenta egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti? Onde taiyo, nonya noyomo.
english: Who can bring what is pure from the impure? No one!

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobara ororeria rwa Yakobo, abwo bare abange buna orotu rw’amaroba? Gose ning’o oranyare kobara nonya nensemo ya inye y’Abaisraeli? Tiga inkwe buna oyomo bw’abanyene oboronge, na omoerio bw’amatuko aane obe buna oyobo.”
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and may my end be like theirs!"

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare komanya amamocho aye? Omonene, nchene korwa ase amamocho aane abisekanete.
english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive my hidden faults.

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare goteba ogokora okonene kw’Omonene, gose koraria obonene bwaye bwonsi?
english: Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the LORD or fully declare his praise?

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare goteba, “Nasibekire ase enkoro yane; nachenekire korwa ase ebibe biane”?
english: Who can say, "I have kept my heart pure; I am clean and without sin"?

ekegusii: Ning’o okwanete ring’ana, na rirorio rigakoreka, onye Omonene tarichigete rikorwe?
english: Who can speak and have it happen if the Lord has not decreed it?

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koyiaboria risankwa riaye? Ning’o oranyare gosoyia okoboko kwaye gati‐gati y’amaino aye?
english: Who can strip off his outer coat? Who would approach him with a bridle?

ekegusii: Inee! Monto onde nanyare komanya buna amare agwesiarera, gose buna okogukura gw’enkoba gokorua ase obomenyo bwa Nyasae?
english: Who can understand how he spreads out the clouds, how he thunders from his pavilion?

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare gotenena ase ekeririanda kiaye tikemosiria? Gose ning’o oranyare koremereria obotindi bw’endamwamu yaye? Ekeririanda kiaye nigo kiaumoirwe buna omorero, na ebitare nigo bigotandoka ase obosio bwaye.
english: Who can withstand his indignation? Who can endure his fierce anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; the rocks are shattered before him.

ekegusii: Inche nigo ngokora ring’ana ri’omosomba one riaba ne chinguru na goikerania emeroberio y’abatomwa baane. Ninche ngoteba igoro ya Yerusalemu ng’a nomenywe, na igoro y’emechie y’Abayuda ng’a neagachwe naende; ninche ndatenenie amaagacho ayio agwete inse.
english: who carries out the words of his servants and fulfills the predictions of his messengers, who says of Jerusalem, 'It shall be inhabited,' of the towns of Judah, 'They shall be built,' and of their ruins, 'I will restore them,'

ekegusii: Ere nigo agotoremia ase emechando yaito yonsi, erinde naintwe tonyare koremia baria bare ase emechando ende yonsi, ase okoremia okwo twaremigwe intwe abanyene na Nyasae.
english: who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.

ekegusii: “Ning’o oremete omotaro ase chiooro chi’embura chigoeta, gose enchera ase chinkoba chikogukura goeta,
english: Who cuts a channel for the torrents of rain, and a path for the thunderstorm,

ekegusii: Ning’o oraasamie omonwa oye? Amaino aye nigo are ay’okwoboyia mono.
english: Who dares open the doors of his mouth, ringed about with his fearsome teeth?

ekegusii: Nigo bakogokera ase ogokora amabe, naende bagokera chingencho chionsi chi’obobe.
english: who delight in doing wrong and rejoice in the perverseness of evil,

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koorokeria omokori amabe chinchera chiaye? Ning’o oramoakane amabe ayio akorire?
english: Who denounces his conduct to his face? Who repays him for what he has done?

ekegusii: Ere nigo agochaya oyobwangirwe na Nyasae, korende osika abwo bamoirogete Omonene. Karire eira na gotiana tari koonchoka, nonya egochia komorentera obokong’u.
english: who despises a vile man but honors those who fear the LORD, who keeps his oath even when it hurts,

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bakoroberia amabe ase chinkoro chiabo ime, baba bakona‐korwana esegi botambe.
english: who devise evil plans in their hearts and stir up war every day.

ekegusii: Onde tana gotoka okorete ebikone buna ebi Omonene atomete Musa kobikora ase ense ya Misiri, na ase Farao amo nabasomba baye, na ense yaye yonsi.
english: who did all those miraculous signs and wonders the LORD sent him to do in Egypt-- to Pharaoh and to all his officials and to his whole land.

ekegusii: Emeika eyio ney’abwo bataigwerete agwo kare, ekero Nyasae aganyete ase oboremereria ase amatuko aria Nuhu are koroisia obwato. Ime ase abwo abanto abake, engencho yaye abanto batano na batato, batooregete goetera ase amache.
english: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built. In it only a few people, eight in all, were saved through water,

ekegusii: akarenta aroro chigari chi’esegi ne chibarasi, na abarwani esegi amo ne chituoni chiabo, erio akabaiyeria inse, tibatenena naende; nigo basiretigwe bakarima buna orotambe rw’etaya. Aya naro Omonene oyio agoteba:
english: who drew out the chariots and horses, the army and reinforcements together, and they lay there, never to rise again, extinguished, snuffed out like a wick:

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoria chinyama chi’emebere y’abanto baane. Nigo mogosaabora amasankwa abo, mwabuna amauga abo mwayakora ebing’ese. Naende mwanachana emebere yabo buna chinyama chikobekwa ase egetega chikonachanwa.
english: who eat my people's flesh, strip off their skin and break their bones in pieces; who chop them up like meat for the pan, like flesh for the pot?"

ekegusii: Ning’o okobeka obong’aini ase enkoro ime, gose okomanya ase omoyo ime?
english: Who endowed the heart with wisdom or gave understanding to the mind?

ekegusii: oyio onyorete ogwancherwa ase obosio bwa Nyasae, agasaba ng’a anyorere Nyasae o Yakobo obomenyo.
english: who enjoyed God's favor and asked that he might provide a dwelling place for the God of Jacob.

ekegusii: Inche nigo ngosaria ebimanyererio bi’ababani b’oborimo na gokora abaringoria baba chiosi. Nigo nkoirania nyuma obong’aini bw’abang’aini na gokora okomanya kwabo kwaba oboriri.
english: who foils the signs of false prophets and makes fools of diviners, who overthrows the learning of the wise and turns it into nonsense,

ekegusii: who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases,
english: Nere ogokwabera ebibe biao bionsi, na kogwenia amarwaire ao onsi.

ekegusii: Aye gwakong’irie ebitunwa ne chinguru chiao, ekiagera aye nigo bweboetie okobua.
english: who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,

ekegusii: ere oyobweruete omonyene koba embooria ase engencho ya bonsi. Igoro y’ayio oborori borentwe ekero engaki yaye eraike.
english: who gave himself as a ransom for all men-- the testimony given in its proper time.

ekegusii: oyobweruete ere omonyene ase engencho y’ebibe biaito, erinde atotoorie korwa ase ense eye embe ya bono, koreng’ana nogwancha kwa Nyasae Tata oito.
english: who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,

ekegusii: oyobweruete omonyene ase engencho yaito, erinde atoboorie korwa ase ogosaria gwonsi, na gwesiberia ere omonyene abanto babe abaye, bare nomokia ase ogokora okuya.
english: who gave himself for us to redeem us from all wickedness and to purify for himself a people that are his very own, eager to do what is good.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogenda ase Misiri korigia ogokonywa korwa ase Farao, korende timori korigia ogosemigwa korwa asende. Nigo mokorigia obotamero ase ekiriri kia Misiri.
english: who go down to Egypt without consulting me; who look for help to Pharaoh's protection, to Egypt's shade for refuge.

ekegusii: Ekero Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babel, achete Yerusalemu, agoosa Yekonia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, akamoira ase obosomba amo nabanto bande, na Moredekai nigo arenge oyomo bw’abwo.
english: who had been carried into exile from Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, among those taken captive with Jehoiachin king of Judah.

ekegusii: who had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those troubled by evil spirits were cured,
english: Na abwo bachandire nebirecha bi’eubi bakagwenigwa.

ekegusii: Ere tanchete amang’ana abo, nonya nogokora kwabo, nigo aganyete oboruoti bwa Nyasae.
english: who had not consented to their decision and action. He came from the Judean town of Arimathea and he was waiting for the kingdom of God.

ekegusii: Ning’o oruete abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo ase amaboko ’abasakori? Ning’o oruete Abaisraeli ase amaboko ’abauri? Inee! Tari Omonene oria twakorete ebibe asare? Tokaanga kobwatia chinchera chiaye, naende tokaanga koigwera amachiko aye.
english: Who handed Jacob over to become loot, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the LORD, against whom we have sinned? For they would not follow his ways; they did not obey his law.

ekegusii: Who has a claim against me that I must pay? Everything under heaven belongs to me.
english: Ning’o ong’eire egento ritang’ani ng’a nainche imogeakane? Gento kende gionsi kere inse y’erioba nekiane.”

ekegusii: Ning’o bwegenire amang’ana aya twararetie? Ning’o Omonene amaanoreire okoboko kwaye?
english: Who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the LORD been revealed?

ekegusii: Ning’o okorete na goikerania aya? Ning’o orangeretie ebiaare bi’abanto korwa omochakano? Ninche Omonene, ninche oyo bw’omochakano; ninche oyo bw’omoerio, ninche Ere.”
english: Who has done this and carried it through, calling forth the generations from the beginning? I, the LORD-- with the first of them and with the last-- I am he."

ekegusii: Ning’o ona‐koigwa amang’ana anga buna ayio? Ning’o ona‐korora amang’ana anga buna ayio? Inee! Ense nenyare koiborwa ase rituko erimo? Gose egesaku nkeiborwe ara rimo? Korende ekero omochie o Sayoni ochagete kobina okaibora abana baye erio kegima.”
english: Who has ever heard of such a thing? Who has ever seen such things? Can a country be born in a day or a nation be brought forth in a moment? Yet no sooner is Zion in labor than she gives birth to her children.

ekegusii: oyosoete igoro, na bono nao are ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae. Abamalaika, na okobua, ne chinguru nigo bibekire inse yaye.
english: who has gone into heaven and is at God's right hand-- with angels, authorities and powers in submission to him.

ekegusii: Ning’o oriinete gochia igoro na goika gocha aa inse? Ning’o osangereirie omwaga ase enkundi yaye? Ning’o obwatire amache na koyaboa ase eanga yaye? Ning’o okong’etie chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense? Naki oyio akorokwa, na omwana oye naki akorokwa? Ntebia onye koyamanyete!
english: Who has gone up to heaven and come down? Who has gathered up the wind in the hollow of his hands? Who has wrapped up the waters in his cloak? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and the name of his son? Tell me if you know!

ekegusii: Nase chinguru chia ng’o gwakwanire amang’ana buna aya? Na ngoetera ase omoika o ng’o kwayakwanire?
english: Who has helped you utter these words? And whose spirit spoke from your mouth?

ekegusii: oyio otigire omwanchi bw’oboke bwaye, naende bwebire okobwatana kw’ogotianania kwa Nyasae oye.
english: who has left the partner of her youth and ignored the covenant she made before God.

ekegusii: Ning’o orengire amache e chinyancha noroe rw’okoboko kwaye? Ning’o oramboire ebiara bi’amaboko aye korenga igoro? Ning’o obekire orotu rw’ense ase ekerengero, gose ning’o orengire ebitunwa na ebigoro nekerengero?
english: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, or with the breadth of his hand marked off the heavens? Who has held the dust of the earth in a basket, or weighed the mountains on the scales and the hills in a balance?

ekegusii: Ning’o ochikeire Nyasae enchera yaye? Gose ning’o oranyare komotebia: Aye gwakorire bobe?
english: Who has prescribed his ways for him, or said to him, 'You have done wrong'?

ekegusii: oyototooretie na agatorangeria ase okorangeria ogochenu, tari ase engencho y’ogokora gwaito korende koreng’ana nokorigia kwaye omonyene, na obuya bwaye. Obuya obo twaetwe ase Kristo Yeso korwa agwo kare
english: who has saved us and called us to a holy life-- not because of anything we have done but because of his own purpose and grace. This grace was given us in Christ Jesus before the beginning of time,

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare koba nobong’aini abare amare? Gose ning’o oranyare koberereka chinyongo chi’amache chia igoro,
english: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Who can tip over the water jars of the heavens

ekegusii: Ning’o okoraa Omoika bw’Omonene, gose ning’o okomosemia na komotebereria?
english: Who has understood the mind of the LORD, or instructed him as his counselor?

ekegusii: Ning’o oyio ore nobobe? Ning’o oyio oichanete? Ning’o oyio okorwana na kwerera? Ning’o oyio oakirwe chingoma chitagwenerete aakwe? Ning’o oyio obariiretie amaiso?
english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwachoretwe koreng’ana buna Nyasae Tata amanyete korwa kare, na mogachenwa n’Omoika, monyare koigwera Yeso Kristo, na konyororokerigwa namanyinga aye. Obuya na omorembe bimenteke asemore.
english: who have been chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through the sanctifying work of the Spirit, for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by his blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.

ekegusii: who have tasted the goodness of the word of God and the powers of the coming age,
english: na koigwa obuya bwe ring’ana ria Nyasae amo nogokora gwe chinguru gw’ekero kegochi‐gocha,

ekegusii: Abwo basirerigwe korwa ase ekeene, bagoteba ng’a okobokigwa gwaikire kobao, na igo bakoonchorana okwegena kw’abanto bande.
english: who have wandered away from the truth. They say that the resurrection has already taken place, and they destroy the faith of some.

ekegusii: Abwo bakarangeria Abaisraeli bagende ase emeyega y’ebing’wanso yarenge gokorerwa chinyasae chiabo, na barabwo bakabiria, naende bagasasima chinyasae chi’Abamoabu.
english: who invited them to the sacrifices to their gods. The people ate and bowed down before these gods.

ekegusii: Oyo noro ore intenenera ase omwando oito, goika okoboorigwa kw’abare aba Nyasae, ase ogotogigwa kw’obonene bwaye.
english: who is a deposit guaranteeing our inheritance until the redemption of those who are God's possession-- to the praise of his glory.

ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae onde nare onga buna aye? Aye nigo okwabera abatigari abare omwando oo ebibe biabo, na kweba obobe bwabo. Aye tori kogenderera koba nendamwamu yao goika kare na kare, ekiagera bwanchete koorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera.
english: Who is a God like you, who pardons sin and forgives the transgression of the remnant of his inheritance? You do not stay angry forever but delight to show mercy.

ekegusii: Ning’o ore omouko otatiga omosomba one? Ning’o ore omotino buna omonto one natomire? Ning’o ore omouko buna omwegenwa one, gose buna omosomba one inche Omonene?
english: Who is blind but my servant, and deaf like the messenger I send? Who is blind like the one committed to me, blind like the servant of the LORD?

ekegusii: Ning’o orabakorere amabe, komorabe nomokia ase ayare amaya?
english: Who is going to harm you if you are eager to do good?

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobanachera ekina? Kristo Yeso nere okwete, ee, na kobua ase aya obokigwe korwa ase abakure; ere nigo are ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Nyasae, naende nere ogotosabera.
english: Who is he that condemns? Christ Jesus, who died-- more than that, who was raised to life-- is at the right hand of God and is also interceding for us.

ekegusii: Inee! Omoruoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere n’Omonene bw’Emeganda; ere n’Omoruoti bw’Obonene.
english: Who is he, this King of glory? The LORD Almighty-- he is the King of glory. Selah

ekegusii: Oyorabue ense ning’o, otatiga ere oyobwegenire ng’a Yeso n’Omwana o Nyasae?
english: Who is it that overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

ekegusii: Aye ning’o gwasekereire na korama? Ning’o gwaakeire eriogi riao ase oboenenu na kweimokereirie igoro kore namaiso ’oboenenu? Aye kwabeire mamincha y’Omonene bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Who is it you have insulted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!

ekegusii: Aye ning’o gwasekereire na korama? Ning’o gwaakeire eriogi riao ase ’oboenenu na kweimokereria igoro namaiso ’oboenenu? Aye kwabeire mamincha y’Omonene bw’Abaisraeli.
english: Who is it you have insulted and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride? Against the Holy One of Israel!

ekegusii: Ning’o onga buna Omonene, Nyasae oito, oria omenyete aaria igoro mono,
english: Who is like the LORD our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,

ekegusii: Ning’o onga buna omonto omong’aini? Ning’o omanyete engencho y’amang’ana? Obong’aini nigo bogokora obosio bw’omonto bwagirigenta, nigo bokoonchora obokong’u bw’okororekana kwaye.
english: Who is like the wise man? Who knows the explanation of things? Wisdom brightens a man's face and changes its hard appearance.

ekegusii: Oria Omonguru ninki are goika tomokorere? Mbitoki ki toranyore ase okomosaba?
english: Who is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What would we gain by praying to him?'

ekegusii: Ning’o ore omonyaborimo otatiga ere oyogokana ng’a Yeso tari ere Kristo? Oyogokana Ise na Omwana, oyio nere omobisa o Kristo.
english: Who is the liar? It is the man who denies that Jesus is the Christ. Such a man is the antichrist-- he denies the Father and the Son.

ekegusii: Ning’o oyio okorwa Edomu, oyio okorwa Bosira obegete chianga chimbariri burure, oyio bweboyetie obonene, ogotaara ore ne chinguru chinyinge? “Oyio ninche, ngokwana ase oboronge inde nokobua kw’ogotooria.”
english: Who is this coming from Edom, from Bozrah, with his garments stained crimson? Who is this, robed in splendor, striding forward in the greatness of his strength? "It is I, speaking in righteousness, mighty to save."

ekegusii: Monto ki oria ogotiira gocha aa korwa ase erooro, oyio bweegegete omwanchi oye? Agwo inse y’omote bw’amapera inche nigo nagoturete oboke. Aroro agwo nyoko nigo arenge nobororo bw’okobina akoibore, ee, agwo nao nyoko akoiborerete ore nobororo.
english: Who is this coming up from the desert leaning on her lover? Under the apple tree I roused you; there your mother conceived you, there she who was in labor gave you birth.

ekegusii: Ning’o oria ogocha korwa ase erooro onga buna rikundesi ri’erioki? Nigo eagete amaguta a manemane na ubani, na ebinto bisiire bigotioka buya.
english: Who is this coming up from the desert like a column of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and incense made from all the spices of the merchant?

ekegusii: Inee! Omoruoti oyio bw’obonene nere ng’o? Ere n’Omonene ore ne chinguru na okobua, ere n’Omonene Omobui ase chisegi.
english: Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

ekegusii: Ning’o oyio okorigereria buna erioba rigotonga mambia? Ning’o oyio ore omuya buna omotienyi, na okomeka‐meka buna erioba? Ere nigo are oyo bw’okoirokia buna abarwani esegi babogoretie chibendera chiabo.
english: Who is this that appears like the dawn, fair as the moon, bright as the sun, majestic as the stars in procession?

ekegusii: Who is weak, and I do not feel weak? Who is led into sin, and I do not inwardly burn?
english: Ning’o ore omoreu, na inche timba omoreu? Ning’o ogerire ogwe, na inche tingechigwa?

ekegusii: Ning’o asemore ore omong’aini na omomanyi? Ere aorokie ogokora kwaye ase orogendo rwaye oruya, ase obwororo bokorwa ase obong’aini.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good life, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.

ekegusii: Oyore omong’aini, nere oramanye amang’ana aya; oyore nokomanya, nere orayarengererie. Chinchera chi’Omonene nigo chire chindonge, na abanyene oboronge nabwo baraetere aroro, korende abasaria nigo baragochwe bagwe ase chirochio.
english: Who is wise? He will realize these things. Who is discerning? He will understand them. The ways of the LORD are right; the righteous walk in them, but the rebellious stumble in them.

ekegusii: Ning’o oitete Abimeleki, mosinto o Yerubi‐Beseti? Tari omokungu orutete ensio korwa orwaki igoro, akamoita aaria Tebesi? Naki mwakorete mogaika orwaki ang’e igo? Omoruoti karakoberie igo, omotebie: Omosomba oo Uria Omohiti nere oitirwe boigo.”
english: Who killed Abimelech son of Jerub-Besheth? Didn't a woman throw an upper millstone on him from the wall, so that he died in Thebez? Why did you get so close to the wall?' If he asks you this, then say to him, 'Also, your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead.'"

ekegusii: Abanto ba Ai bagaita Abaisraeli emerongo etato, na batano nomo, bakabaseria korwa isiko y’egeita gochia Sebarimu, bakabaitera aroro ase ebitirimboko. Erio Abaisraeli bakoboa na kwerusia moyo.
english: who killed about thirty-six of them. They chased the Israelites from the city gate as far as the stone quarries and struck them down on the slopes. At this the hearts of the people melted and became like water.

ekegusii: abaitete Omonene Yeso na ababani, na intwe bagatoseria. Barabwo tibagwenera Nyasae, naende nigo bare mamincha ase abanto bonsi.
english: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and also drove us out. They displease God and are hostile to all men

ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete gose omoika o mwanyabanto nigoro ogochia, na oyo bwe ching’iti ogenda inse y’ense?
english: Who knows if the spirit of man rises upward and if the spirit of the animal goes down into the earth?"

ekegusii: Who knows the power of your anger? For your wrath is as great as the fear that is due you.
english: Ning’o omanyete okobua kw’endamwamu yao, na ogw’ekeririanda kiao, erinde akoiroke?

ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete, ande nabo Nyasae arabaise koonchora ebirengererio biaye, erinde atige endamwamu yaye entindi, intwe titosirigwa.”
english: Who knows? God may yet relent and with compassion turn from his fierce anger so that we will not perish."

ekegusii: Ning’o omanyete, ande gose Omonene naonchoke atige kobarentera amabe, korende abatigere ogosesenigwa, erinde moruere Omonene, Nyasae oino, okoruegwa kw’endagera, na ogw’ekenyugwa?
english: Who knows? He may turn and have pity and leave behind a blessing-- grain offerings and drink offerings for the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo nigo bagotiga chinchera chi’oboronge, babwatia chinchera chi’omosunte.
english: who leave the straight paths to walk in dark ways,

ekegusii: Ere akabaetia ase chindiba ime buna chibarasi chigoeta ase erooro, barabwo tibagochetwe aande.”
english: who led them through the depths? Like a horse in open country, they did not stumble;

ekegusii: Ekero akorua chibesa chiaye singo tari kogania ebitoki, omonto oyio tari koira riaaki kogera omonto otari nokomocha agambigwe. Omonto ogokora oboronge ase amang’ana ayio onsi namenye ase obotoereru kare na kare.
english: who lends his money without usury and does not accept a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.

ekegusii: Ere okorete emebaso eria emenene, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: who made the great lights-- His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Who marked off its dimensions? Surely you know! Who stretched a measuring line across it?
english: Ning’o obegete ebirengo biaye? Ntebie onye komanyete. Gose ning’o oramborete engori y’okoyerenga?

ekegusii: Ning’o oragwenere gotiira ase egetunwa ki’Omonene? Ning’o oragwenere gotenena aase aye aachenu?
english: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in his holy place?

ekegusii: Nereri ase egati ye chinyasae chionsi chie chinse yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane? Nainwe mokorengereria ng’a Omonene natoorie Yerusalemu korwa ase okoboko kwane?”
english: Who of all the gods of these countries has been able to save his land from me? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?"

ekegusii: Nereri ase egati ye chinyasae chionsi chie chinse echio yatooririe ense yaye korwa ase okoboko kwane? Nainwe nigo mokorengereria ng’a Omonene natoorie Yerusalemu korwa ase okoboko kwane?”
english: Who of all the gods of these countries has been able to save his land from me? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?"

ekegusii: Nereri ase chinyasae chionsi chi’ebisaku biria chisokoro chiane chiasiretie kegima yanyarete gokonya abanto baye korwa ase okoboko kwane?
english: Who of all the gods of these nations that my fathers destroyed has been able to save his people from me? How then can your god deliver you from my hand?

ekegusii: Naende ning’o ore asemore oranyare gwechanda komenta ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo ase obotambe bwaye?
english: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?

ekegusii: Ning’o ore asemore oranyare gwechanda komenta ekerengo gi’okoboko okomo ase obotambe bwaye?
english: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?

ekegusii: Ning’o otigarete ase egati yaino oyo oroche obonene bw’enyomba eria entang’ani? Moise koreng’ania eye neria ya kare, naki eye ekororekana ase amaiso aino? Inee! Teri kororekana asemore ng’a negento bosa?
english: 'Who of you is left who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Does it not seem to you like nothing?

ekegusii: Abwo nigo baiteretwe agwo Eni Dori; bakaba esike ase riroba.
english: who perished at Endor and became like refuse on the ground.

ekegusii: Ning’o oroberetie amang’ana aya onsi mamincha ya Turo? Omochie oyio orenge kobekera abaruoti chigutwa, na abaonchoreria baye nigo barenge abagambi, na abaoonia baye nigo basikire ase ense.
english: Who planned this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are renowned in the earth?
