ekegusii: Ogoitania abanto nigo goichire ase enkoro yaye, botambe nigo akoroberia korenta amabe; nigo agosimeka chimbusuro chi’amariomana.
english: who plots evil with deceit in his heart-- he always stirs up dissension.

ekegusii: Ning’o okoa ekegonkoru endagera yaye, ekero amage aye akorera ase Nyasae na goetanana onsi korigia endagera?”
english: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God and wander about for lack of food?

ekegusii: Nigo akobooria obogima bwao korwa ase embeera na gokobekera egutwa y’obwanchani bogendererete botambe amo namabera.
english: who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion,

ekegusii: who said, "Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God."
english: ekiagera batebete, “Inchuo toire amarisio a Nyasae abe ayaito.”

ekegusii: Ere nigo agoisanekia okogania kwao namaya, erinde otigara koba omosae buna ekeongo kegwekerora.
english: who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

ekegusii: Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa baane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha yane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.
english: who saves me from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from violent men you rescued me.

ekegusii: Nigo bagotebia abande:” “Tigera korwa asetore, mobeere aare, ekiagera intwe twatananirwe tobe abachenu kobua inwe.” “Abanto aba nigo bare erioki rire ase chimioro chiane inche Omonene, na nigo bare omorero ogendererete koyia omobaso boira.”
english: who say, 'Keep away; don't come near me, for I am too sacred for you!' Such people are smoke in my nostrils, a fire that keeps burning all day.

ekegusii: Nigo ngoteba igoro ya Koresi ng’a namobekire abe omorisia bw’abanto baane; ere naikeranie ogwancha kwane gwonsi, na atebe igoro ya Yerusalemu ng’a oagachwe naende, naende atebe igoro ye Hekalu ng’a oboroso bwaye bobekwe naende.”
english: who says of Cyrus, 'He is my shepherd and will accomplish all that I please; he will say of Jerusalem, "Let it be rebuilt," and of the temple, "Let its foundations be laid."'

ekegusii: Ninche ngoteba igoro ye chindiba chie chinyancha ng’a chiome pa, ninche ndakamie chindooche chiaye.
english: who says to the watery deep, 'Be dry, and I will dry up your streams,'

ekegusii: Ng’ai are oria okoboko kwaye kw’obonene kwarenge ase ensemo y’okoboko gw’okorio kwa Musa, oria bwatananete amache ’enyancha ase amasio ’abanto, erinde akenyorera erieta rigotogigwa kare na kare?
english: who sent his glorious arm of power to be at Moses' right hand, who divided the waters before them, to gain for himself everlasting renown,

ekegusii: Morwani ki okogenda ase esegi kero kende gionsi na kweakanera ere omonyene? Moremi ki otakoria amasabibu ’omogondo oye bw’emesabibu? Gose ning’o okorisia riicho, otakonywa amabeere aye?
english: Who serves as a soldier at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its grapes? Who tends a flock and does not drink of the milk?

ekegusii: oyio oonchoire enkoro yaye ase ogokorigia aye Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiabo, Omonene Nyasae, nonya tachenegeti kobwatekana nomoroberio bwe Hekalu.”
english: who sets his heart on seeking God-- the LORD, the God of his fathers-- even if he is not clean according to the rules of the sanctuary."

ekegusii: Ere nigo antooretie korwa ase ababisa baane, akanyimokereria igoro ase abare mamincha yane, naende agantooria korwa ase abanto abatindi.”
english: who sets me free from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from violent men you rescued me.

ekegusii: Ning’o oratwatanane korwa ase obwanchani bwa Kristo? Inee! Nogochandwa, gose nobororo, gose nokorosigwa, gose nenchara, gose ngesobono, gose nobobe, gose nomoro?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or hardship or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

ekegusii: Who shapes a god and casts an idol, which can profit him nothing?
english: Ning’o okwebaachera enyasae na kwebombera ogosasimwa bitari gokonya nonyang’ake?

ekegusii: Aye Omoruoti bw’ebisaku, ning’o otagwenereti gokoiroka. Aye nogwenerete oirokwe. Onde tari okogwekaine ase abang’aini bonsi b’ebisaku, gose ase amaruoti abo onsi.
english: Who should not revere you, O King of the nations? This is your due. Among all the wise men of the nations and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.

ekegusii: Nyasae tari gwanchereria abagambi, gose tari kobara abanda ng’a mbare nengencho enene kobua abataka, ekiagera abwo bonsi nigo bare emeremo y’amaboko aye.
english: who shows no partiality to princes and does not favor the rich over the poor, for they are all the work of his hands?

ekegusii: Nigo bakogenda ase chimbeera baikaransa aroro, na ase obotuko baba bakobeera aase are bobisi. Abanto abwo nigo bakoria chinyama chie chimbeche, na babwate omosori bw’ebinto bi’okogechia ase ebibekerero biabo.
english: who sit among the graves and spend their nights keeping secret vigil; who eat the flesh of pigs, and whose pots hold broth of unclean meat;

ekegusii: Ere oramborete ense, akayiaara ase amache, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: who spread out the earth upon the waters, His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotoereria enyancha ekoruma, na emerindo yaye, naboigo namaroroche a mwanyabanto.
english: who stilled the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

ekegusii: na origereretie gocha inse aa arore igoro na ense.
english: who stoops down to look on the heavens and the earth?

ekegusii: Ere nigo aitete abaruoti barenge ne chinguru, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: who struck down great kings, His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agotworokereria kobua ching’iti chi’ense, na otokora twaba nobong’aini kobua chinyoni.
english: who teaches more to us than to the beasts of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the air?'

ekegusii: oyorenge kirori ase ring’ana ria Nyasae na ase oborori bwa Yeso Kristo, ase ogoteba amang’ana onsi ayaroche.
english: who testifies to everything he saw-- that is, the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Ase omwaka oria barabwo bagachanda Abaisraeli na kobakorera bobe. Ase engaki y’emiaka ikomi, na etano na etato, bagachanda Abaisraeli bonsi abamenyete moocha y’orooche rwa Yorodan ase ense y’Abaamori ase Gileadi.
english: who that year shattered and crushed them. For eighteen years they oppressed all the Israelites on the east side of the Jordan in Gilead, the land of the Amorites.

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobana buna inche, buna nabanete korwa ekero keria nabegete abanto abwo ba kare? Tiga ararie amang’ana ayio na koyanyorokia. Oyio tiga atebie abanto amang’ana are bosio agochia gokoreka.
english: Who then is like me? Let him proclaim it. Let him declare and lay out before me what has happened since I established my ancient people, and what is yet to come-- yes, let him foretell what will come.

ekegusii: inwe abamorendire nokobua kwa Nyasae ase enchera y’okwegena, monyore ogotooreka kore ang’e koorokigwa ase ekero ki’omoerio.
english: who through faith are shielded by God's power until the coming of the salvation that is ready to be revealed in the last time.

ekegusii: Abwo ase okwegena bakabua amaruoti, bagakora oboronge, bakanyora ayabarieretwe chiira, bagasieka emenwa ye chindo.
english: who through faith conquered kingdoms, administered justice, and gained what was promised; who shut the mouths of lions,

ekegusii: Ning’o obanete amang’ana ayio agwo kare, erinde tonyare komanya ng’a amang’ana oyio atebete nay’ekeene? Onde tari nonya noyomo oyaorogetie na koyararia; onde tari oigwete komokoyakwana.
english: Who told of this from the beginning, so we could know, or beforehand, so we could say, 'He was right'? No one told of this, no one foretold it, no one heard any words from you.

ekegusii: who turned the rock into a pool, the hard rock into springs of water.
english: Oyio oonchorete egetare gekaba ritibo ri’amache, ne rigena rikong’u rikaba ensoko y’amache.

ekegusii: oyorigetie abanto bonsi batoorigwe, banyare komanya onsi ayare ay’ekeene.
english: who wants all men to be saved and to come to a knowledge of the truth.

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nigo arenge amo na gavuna Sergio Paulo, omonto bw’obong’aini. Ere akarangeria Barnaba na Saulo bache asare, akarigia koigwa ring’ana ria Nyasae.
english: who was an attendant of the proconsul, Sergius Paulus. The proconsul, an intelligent man, sent for Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.

ekegusii: (Eli konya okoorire emiaka emerongo kianda, na etano na etato; amaiso aye konya aukoire; ase ayio tarenge konyara korora.)
english: who was ninety-eight years old and whose eyes were set so that he could not see.

ekegusii: oyorenge kobatang’ana botambe na kobarigeria aase mware gochia gotoora. Ase obotuko nigo arenge kobaraa nomorero, na ase omobaso obaraa ne riire, koborokia aase mware goetera.”
english: who went ahead of you on your journey, in fire by night and in a cloud by day, to search out places for you to camp and to show you the way you should go.

ekegusii: abwo barenge koagacha orwaki. Abanto abwo barenge kobogoria chigurube, nigo barenge gokora emeremo nokoboko okomo, na okonde kobogoretie ekerwanero.
english: who were building the wall. Those who carried materials did their work with one hand and held a weapon in the other,

ekegusii: ekero barabwo barenge gotindeka abana babo abatangi, baria Omonene aitete, naende akanachera chinyasae chiabo ekina.
english: who were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck down among them; for the LORD had brought judgment on their gods.

ekegusii: Who were they who heard and rebelled? Were they not all those Moses led out of Egypt?
english: Naki mbarabi baria bamogechetie ekero baigwete? Tari baria bonsi barwete Misiri, baare koraagwa na Musa?

ekegusii: Who will bring any charge against those whom God has chosen? It is God who justifies.
english: Ning’o oranyare gosoera abachore ba Nyasae? Nyasae nere okobaa oboronge.

ekegusii: Ning’o orandaae ansoyie ase omochie ogiteire chindwaki? Ning’o orantang’ane gochia Edomu?
english: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

ekegusii: who will judge its quality as good or bad. Whatever value the priest then sets, that is what it will be.
english: na ere akore rigori ri’eng’iti eria koreng’ana buna ere engiya gose embe. Rigori omokuani arakore, nario erio rirabe.

ekegusii: Ning’o oranyare kobaigwera ase amang’ana buna ayio? Yaya, buna abanto abwo bagendete korwana esegi bakoegwa ebisakorwa, naboigo nabwo batigarete nyuma korenda ebinto baraegwe. Nigo baragaberwe bareng’anie.”
english: Who will listen to what you say? The share of the man who stayed with the supplies is to be the same as that of him who went down to the battle. All will share alike."

ekegusii: na barabwo nabamochecherie, na komo aka chinkini, na komotwera amate, na komoita; nyuma y’amatuko atato naboke.”
english: who will mock him and spit on him, flog him and kill him. Three days later he will rise."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ning’o otakoiroke? Ning’o otatogie erieta riao? Naki naye bweka ore omochenu. Abanto b’ebisaku bionsi nabachiche gosasima ase obosio bwao, ekiagera emeroberio yao y’oboronge yaikire koorokigwa.”
english: Who will not fear you, O Lord, and bring glory to your name? For you alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous acts have been revealed."

ekegusii: Ning’o oratenene andwanerie abakori amabe? Ning’o oratenene ankonye korwa ase abakori ebibe?
english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?

ekegusii: Nigo agosimera ebioge bi’amaiso aye, naende nigo agosimera amagoro, na okworokia ebimanyererio namaboko aye.
english: who winks with his eye, signals with his feet and motions with his fingers,

ekegusii: Ere omochakano nigo arenge oyomo na Nyasae, na tabarete ng’a okoba koreng’ana buna Nyasae negento gi’okobwaterera,
english: Who, being in very nature God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,

ekegusii: oyoranyare koonchora emebere yaito y’obosareku enyare kogwekana nomobere oye bw’obonene, koreng’ana nokobua kwaye ase okwo aranyare kobeka ebinto bionsi inse asare.
english: who, by the power that enables him to bring everything under his control, will transform our lowly bodies so that they will be like his glorious body.

ekegusii: Kera omonto omoirogete Omonene, oyio Omonene nigo akomworokereria enchera agwenerete gochora.
english: Who, then, is the man that fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the way chosen for him.

ekegusii: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
english: Oyoregene na kobatiswa, natooreke, ko oyotegeneti, nagambigwe.

ekegusii: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because he has not believed in the name of God's one and only Son.
english: Oyomwegenire takogambigwa oyotegeneti oikire kogambigwa, ekiagera atariegeneti erieta ri’Omwana omomoima o Nyasae.

ekegusii: Oyonyegenire inche, buna amariko agoteba, chindooche chi’amache are moyo nachirue ase enkoro yaye.”
english: Whoever believes in me, as the Scripture has said, streams of living water will flow from within him."

ekegusii: Oyoramwegene Omwana nare nobogima bwa kare na kare; oyotaigwereti Omwana takorora obogima, korende endamwamu ya Nyasae nigo emoikaranserete.”
english: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for God's wrath remains on him."

ekegusii: Ere oyogoteba ng’a nigo amenyete ime asare, nagwenerete kogenda ere omonyene buna Yeso arenge kogenda.
english: Whoever claims to live in him must walk as Jesus did.

ekegusii: Whoever digs a pit may fall into it; whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
english: Omonto ogokunya eirima, nere oragwe imeo, na oyo okobochora enyasi, eng’iti engenda inse nemorome.

ekegusii: Naki oyorakore ogwancha kwa Nyasae, oyio nere momura ominto, na mosubati ominto, na baba.”
english: Whoever does God's will is my brother and sister and mother."

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi otatung’ameti na koumama ase okoyosasima, erio agwo kegima oyio narutwe ase eriko ri’omorero ekebemberi.”
english: Whoever does not fall down and worship will immediately be thrown into a blazing furnace."

ekegusii: Oyotancheti, tamomanyeti Nyasae, ekiagera Nyasae nobwanchani.
english: Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amachiko a Nyasae oo, na ay’omoruoti, oyio anacherwe ekina kia boronge, kebe eki’ogokwa, gose eki’ogoserigwa, gose kourwa ebinto biaye, gose asibwe.”
english: Whoever does not obey the law of your God and the law of the king must surely be punished by death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orakerie ekero ekio nabarerwe obobe bwaye, ekiagera okorire egento giatananetwe asende kebe egetari egechenu. Omonto oyio naatananwe korwa ase abanto baye.
english: Whoever eats it will be held responsible because he has desecrated what is holy to the LORD; that person must be cut off from his people.

ekegusii: Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nare nobogima bwa kare na kare, na inche nimobokie ase rituko ri’omoerio,
english: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

ekegusii: Oyokoria omobere one na konywa amanyinga aane nigo akomenya ime yane, na inche ime yaye.
english: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in him.

ekegusii: Oyorarigie koegera obogima bwaye nabosirie, na oyorasirie obogima bwaye ase engencho yane nabonyore.
english: Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for my sake will find it.

ekegusii: Omonto okong’aina omonto onde namang’ana amansu, oyio nigo agwetegera oboreba ase amagoro aye.
english: Whoever flatters his neighbor is spreading a net for his feet.

ekegusii: Nebe ng’a oyogotama kaigure eriogi ri’okogosa nagwe ase eirima, na oyo orasoke korwa ase eirima eyio nabwatwe nomoeto, ekiagera chitirisa chia igoro chiaigoirwe, oboroso bw’ense bwanyegerigwe.
english: Whoever flees at the sound of terror will fall into a pit; whoever climbs out of the pit will be caught in a snare. The floodgates of the heavens are opened, the foundations of the earth shake.

ekegusii: Abanto bande bonsi babanyorete nigo babakorete bobe. Ababisa babo babeire bagoteba: Intwe titori nokomocha ase ogokora iga, ekiagera barabwo bakorire ebibe ase Omonene obo, oyore obomenyo bwabo bw’ekeene, Omonene oyio orenge ogosemeria gwe chisokoro chiabo.
english: Whoever found them devoured them; their enemies said, 'We are not guilty, for they sinned against the LORD, their true pasture, the LORD, the hope of their fathers.'

ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera Ring’ana nanyore amaya, na oyo okomosemeria Omonene nasesenirie.
english: Whoever gives heed to instruction prospers, and blessed is he who trusts in the LORD.

ekegusii: Oyore namachiko aane, na koyabwata, oyio nere onyanchete; ere oyonyanchete nanchwe na Tata one, na inche nimwanche na kweorokia asare.”
english: Whoever has my commands and obeys them, he is the one who loves me. He who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I too will love him and show myself to him."

ekegusii: Naki oyore na gento naegwe, nere namenteranigwe; korende oyotabwati gento naurwe nonya nekio abwate.
english: Whoever has will be given more, and he will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from him.

ekegusii: Naki oyobwate naegwe; korende oyotabwati naurwe nonya neyio abwate.”
english: Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what he has will be taken from him."

ekegusii: “Ekero abanto barenge konyigwa, nigo barenge kondoka oyosesenirie, ekero baare kondora, baba birori asende,
english: Whoever heard me spoke well of me, and those who saw me commended me,

ekegusii: Kerabe omonto okwerigeria ogosesenigwa ase ense, oyio nandigie inche Nyasae bw’ekeene imosesenie, na onde bwensi ase ense eye orabe ogotiana, nabe ogotiana asende inche Nyasae bw’ekeene; rirorio nebe ng’a emechando emetang’ani yebirwe na kobiswa korwa ase amaiso aane.
english: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth; he who takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth. For the past troubles will be forgotten and hidden from my eyes.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi oranyorwe, nabetwe ritimo, na onde bwensi orabwatwe, naitwe nomoro.
english: Whoever is captured will be thrust through; all who are caught will fall by the sword.

ekegusii: Omonto onde bwensi ore omong’aini, tiga aigwe amang’ana aya, tiga arengererie mono amanye obwanchani bw’Omonene bogendererete botambe.
english: Whoever is wise, let him heed these things and consider the great love of the LORD.

ekegusii: Whoever kills an animal must make restitution, but whoever kills a man must be put to death.
english: Omonto oraite etugo goika nayeakane, na omonto oraite omonto onde, nere goika aitwe akwe.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi bwanchete amorokererio akomorongeyia, oyio nigo anchete chisemi, korende oyo ogechete ogokurerwa tabwati ebirengererio.
english: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.

ekegusii: na ere oyobwanchete oyomwabo nigo amenyete ase omobaso, na ime asare gento tikeiyo keragere agochwe.
english: Whoever loves his brother lives in the light, and there is nothing in him to make him stumble.

ekegusii: Omonto bwanchete chibesa, tagoisaneka nachirochio; gose oyobwanchete obotenenku, tagoisaneka nebitoki biaye. Ayio boigo mbosa.
english: Whoever loves money never has money enough; whoever loves wealth is never satisfied with his income. This too is meaningless.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amanukato anga buna ayio ase okwegokeria rimisu riaye nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku ki’abanto b’Omonene.”
english: Whoever makes any like it to enjoy its fragrance must be cut off from his people."

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi aise koroisia amaguta buna ayio gose koyaaka omonto omoao, oyotari omokuani, nigo araatananwe korwa ase egesaku kiaye.”
english: Whoever makes perfume like it and whoever puts it on anyone other than a priest must be cut off from his people.'"

ekegusii: Omonto okoigwera amachiko takonyorwa namabe, na enkoro y’omonto omong’aini nigo ekomanya engaki na enchera y’okonacha boronge.
english: Whoever obeys his command will come to no harm, and the wise heart will know the proper time and procedure.

ekegusii: Inee! Aye nomonto bwanchete obogima? Oganetie obe moyo amatuko amange, na korora amaya?
english: Whoever of you loves life and desires to see many good days,

ekegusii: na onde bwensi oraimokie egekwete korwa ase ebio nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: Whoever picks up one of their carcasses must wash his clothes, and he will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Oyo ogwatia amagena nigo araakwe naro, na oyo ogwatia emete, ande nanyore obokong’u asero.
english: Whoever quarries stones may be injured by them; whoever splits logs may be endangered by them.

ekegusii: Whoever rebels against your word and does not obey your words, whatever you may command them, will be put to death. Only be strong and courageous!"
english: Monto onde bwensi oraange koigwera amachiko ao na taigwa amang’ana okomotebia, goika aitwe akwe. Aye otenene bokong’u, obe omoremu!”

ekegusii: Oyo ogotebia omonto omomochi, “Aye tori nokomocha”, oyio abanto mbamoragererie, na abanto b’ebisaku nigo baramogeche.
english: Whoever says to the guilty, "You are innocent"-- peoples will curse him and nations denounce him.

ekegusii: Omonto karankorere, antunyane; na aase inde inche, nomosomba one nao arabe; naende omonto karankorere, Tata namosike.
english: Whoever serves me must follow me; and where I am, my servant also will be. My Father will honor the one who serves me.

ekegusii: Whoever sits on anything that the man with a discharge sat on must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.
english: Na onde bwensi oraikaransere egento omonto oria omorwaire aikaranserete, goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.

ekegusii: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, him will I put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, him will I not endure.
english: Ninsirie omonto okona‐gokwana bobe omonto onde bobisi, tinkoremereria omonto omoenenu na omweanchi.

ekegusii: Omonto orabeere ase omochie oyo ime naitwe nemioro, na enchara, na oborwaire; korende oyorasoke korwa imeo na kwerua ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, abwo banaaretie omochie, oyio nere orabe moyo, na tabaisa goitwa ase esegi.
english: Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine or plague. But whoever goes out and surrenders to the Babylonians who are besieging you will live; he will escape with his life.

ekegusii: Na onde bwensi orakune egento omokungu oyio aikaranserete, nigo arasibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache; ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: Whoever touches anything she sits on must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Onde bwensi orakune ebirarero bi’omokungu oyio goika asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, ere nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: Whoever touches her bed must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Monto onde bwensi orakune omobere bw’omonto okwete, korende tesibia, igo agokora Obomenyo bw’Omonene bobe obotachenegeti. Omonto oyio aatananwe korwa ase Abaisraeli, ekiagera amache aria ay’okomochena taumoiri asare; ere agenderere koba oyotachenegeti.
english: Whoever touches the dead body of anyone and fails to purify himself defiles the LORD's tabernacle. That person must be cut off from Israel. Because the water of cleansing has not been sprinkled on him, he is unclean; his uncleanness remains on him.

ekegusii: Na onde bwensi orakune ebinto ebio nabe oyotachenegeti; ere asibie chianga chiaye, esibie nomobere namache, naende nabe oyotachenegeti goika omogoroba oyio.
english: Whoever touches them will be unclean; he must wash his clothes and bathe with water, and he will be unclean till evening.

ekegusii: Omonto takoyakuna otatiga abe obwate ebioma na orotanga rwe ritimo, barabwo nabasambwe nomorero aroro agwo.”
english: Whoever touches thorns uses a tool of iron or the shaft of a spear; they are burned up where they lie."

ekegusii: Oyorarigie koegera obogima bwaye nabosirie, korende oyorasirie obogima bwaye nabonyore.
english: Whoever tries to keep his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life will preserve it.

ekegusii: Omonto osemeretie chinibo chiaye nigo aragwe, korende abanyene oboronge mbareerete buna amato ’emete.
english: Whoever trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous will thrive like a green leaf.

ekegusii: Omonto okona‐korigereria komanya igoro y’embeo tagosimeka, na oyo okona‐korigereria amare buna are takogesa.
english: Whoever watches the wind will not plant; whoever looks at the clouds will not reap.

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe ning’o mogochecheria? Ning’o mwasameirie emenwa na mwasokirie chimeme? Inwe nigo more abanto b’ogosaria na oroiboro rw’abang’ainereria.
english: Whom are you mocking? At whom do you sneer and stick out your tongue? Are you not a brood of rebels, the offspring of liars?

ekegusii: Ning’o Omonene akoboria amosemie amang’ana buya? Ning’o omworokereretie oboeto bw’oboronge, na komworokia okomanya, gose komworokia enchera y’okomanya?
english: Whom did the LORD consult to enlighten him, and who taught him the right way? Who was it that taught him knowledge or showed him the path of understanding?

ekegusii: Inee! Ning’o naende imbwate aaria igoro, otatiga aye bweka? Ekero nkobwate, gento tikeri aiga ase ense nganetie.
english: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.

ekegusii: oyo atoitererete ase obonge goetera ase Yeso Kristo, Omotooria oito,
english: whom he poured out on us generously through Jesus Christ our Savior,

ekegusii: Omonene akaonchora chinkoro chi’Abamisiri, erinde bakagecha abanto baye, erio bagakorera abasomba b’Omonene amabe ay’obong’ainereria.
english: whose hearts he turned to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

ekegusii: Hiramu nigo arenge omwana bw’omokungu omoboraka bw’egesaku kia Nafutali, na ise nigo arenge omonto o Turo, omoturi bwe chitaai. Hiramu omonyene nigo arenge nobong’aini obonge amo ne chisemi, omanyete gotura ebinto binde bionsi bie chitaai. Ere agacha ase Sulemani, akamokorera emeremo yaye yonsi.
english: whose mother was a widow from the tribe of Naphtali and whose father was a man of Tyre and a craftsman in bronze. Huram was highly skilled and experienced in all kinds of bronze work. He came to King Solomon and did all the work assigned to him.

ekegusii: Ng’ina nigo arenge omokungu bw’egesaku kia Dani, na ise nigo arenge omonto o Turo. Ere nigo orokereretigwe akamanya buya gokora emeremo ase chitahabu, ne chifeta, ne chitaai, na ebioma, na amagena, ne chibao. Naende nigo amanyete koroisia ebitambaa bi’ebieni bimonyinga, na ebire buru, na ebibariri amo nebi’egatani engiya. Ere nigo amanyete emeremo ende yonsi y’okomang’a na gokora omogwekano onde bwonsi are gotebigwa ng’a ayokore. Tiga akore emeremo amo nabakori emeremo bao, na amo nabwo omonene one Daudi iso abegete.
english: whose mother was from Dan and whose father was from Tyre. He is trained to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, and with purple and blue and crimson yarn and fine linen. He is experienced in all kinds of engraving and can execute any design given to him. He will work with your craftsmen and with those of my lord, David your father.

ekegusii: whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.
english: abwo bagokwana oborimo nemenwa yabo, na amaboko abo a borio agokora ay’obong’ainereria.

ekegusii: Chinchera chiabo nigo chire chinkorekanu, nigo bagotaara ase chinchera chire borogochi.
english: whose paths are crooked and who are devious in their ways.

ekegusii: Nase ki tokobarwa koba buna ching’iti? Nase ki tokobarwa koba abanto batamanyeti gento kende?
english: Why are we regarded as cattle and considered stupid in your sight?

ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano? Nase ki otari nobotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ase ogotooreka gokorwa ase obosio bwaye.
english: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and

ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano omonene? Nase ki otari nobotoereru? Semeria Nyasae! Igo ninyare komotogia naende ere oyore ogotooreka kwane, na Nyasae one.
english: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

ekegusii: Aye omoyo one, nase ki kwabeire nomoichano omonene? Nase ki otari nobotoereru? Semeria Nyasae, ekiagera ninyare komotogia naende ere oyore ogotooreka kwane, na Nyasae one.
english: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

ekegusii: Nase ki aye okoba buna omonto otantanigwe, buna oyore nokobua, korende otanyare gotooria? Korende nonya naboigo, aye Omonene nigo ore ase egati yaito, naintwe nigo tokorokwa ase erieta riao; tobaisa gototiga.”
english: Why are you like a man taken by surprise, like a warrior powerless to save? You are among us, O LORD, and we bear your name; do not forsake us!

ekegusii: Nase ki chianga chiao chire chimbariri burure, buna echi’oyo ogotacha egeteera gi’okomita emesabibu?
english: Why are your garments red, like those of one treading the winepress?

ekegusii: Omwana one, nase ki okogokigwa nomokungu omonyaka? Nase ki okoboania omokungu bw’omonto omoao?
english: Why be captivated, my son, by an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another man's wife?

ekegusii: Nase ki nasogete korwa ase enda ya baba, korora emechando na obororo, na nkoba nobosooku ase amatuko amange?
english: Why did I ever come out of the womb to see trouble and sorrow and to end my days in shame?

ekegusii: Nase ki mwatorentire intwe omoganda bw’Omonene ase erooro eye, erinde tokwere aiga, intwe amo ne chitugo chiaito?
english: Why did you bring the LORD's community into this desert, that we and our livestock should die here?

ekegusii: Nase ki mwatorusetie Misiri na gotorenta aase aiga aabe mono? Aase aa atari kwama endagera, gose amako, gose amasabibu, gose amakomomanga. Nonya namache tokonywa tari aa.”
english: Why did you bring us up out of Egypt to this terrible place? It has no grain or figs, grapevines or pomegranates. And there is no water to drink!"

ekegusii: Nase ki gwachayire ring’ana riane inche Omonene, na gwakorire amabe ase obosio bwane? Gwaitire Uria Omohiti; okamorua, na Abaamoni bakamoita nomoro, naende kwairire mokaye koba mokao.
english: Why did you despise the word of the LORD by doing what is evil in his eyes? You struck down Uriah the Hittite with the sword and took his wife to be your own. You killed him with the sword of the Ammonites.

ekegusii: Nase ki rende otaigwerete aya Omonene agochigete? Nase ki kwarindokerete na koumokera ebisakorwa, ogakora ayare amabe ase obosio bw’Omonene?”
english: Why did you not obey the LORD? Why did you pounce on the plunder and do evil in the eyes of the LORD?"

ekegusii: Nase ki gwatamete okeiberia, tigwantebia? Inche anga nagokoobete nomochengo na amatera, na kobugia chikonu na amakano.
english: Why did you run off secretly and deceive me? Why didn't you tell me, so I could send you away with joy and singing to the music of tambourines and harps?

ekegusii: Why did you say, 'She is my sister,' so that I took her to be my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!"
english: Naki gwakorete ogateba ng’a oyo mosubati omino, na inche nkamoira akaba mokane? Bono mokao oyio moire, ogende nere.”

ekegusii: Nase ki moikaransete ase eero ye ching’ondi, mokoigwa abarisia bakobugia ebiroria bakorangeria ching’ondi? Ee, ase chindooche chi’abanto b’egesaku kia Reuben; okogamba na okoroberia okonene nigo biarengeo, nigo kwarenge okoamererania okonene.
english: Why did you stay among the campfires to hear the whistling for the flocks? In the districts of Reuben there was much searching of heart.

ekegusii: “Nase ki ndabeke enyama y’omobere one ase amaino aane? Ting’egereti obogima bwane.
english: Why do I put myself in jeopardy and take my life in my hands?

ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bagokora riroroche? Nase ki abanto bagokora emeroberio ere bosa?
english: Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?

ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku batakomanyeti baraborie, “Ng’ai Nyasae oyio obo are?”
english: Why do the nations say, "Where is their God?"

ekegusii: “Nase ki abakori amabe bakogenderera koba moyo na kwegotera bare ne chinguru na okobua?
english: Why do the wicked live on, growing old and increasing in power?

ekegusii: Naki gwatwebire kogenderera botambe? Naki gwatotigire ase engaki entambe iga?
english: Why do you always forget us? Why do you forsake us so long?

ekegusii: Inwe abaiseke baane ababiare motari abegenwa, nase ki mogwetogia ng’a amakura aino naichire chindagera? Inwe mwegenete obonda bwaino mogoteba ng’a onde tari oranyare kobarwania.
english: Why do you boast of your valleys, boast of your valleys so fruitful? O unfaithful daughter, you trust in your riches and say, 'Who will attack me?'

ekegusii: Nase ki okoamererania nere kogoteba ng’a ere takoiraneria amang’ana aya nonya nerimo?
english: Why do you complain to him that he answers none of man's words?

ekegusii: Nase ki mokorera ase engencho y’emechando yaino? Obororo bwaino tibokogwenigwa. Ogosaria kwaino nokonene, na ebibe biaino biamentekanire. Ayio naro agerire nabakoreire igo.
english: Why do you cry out over your wound, your pain that has no cure? Because of your great guilt and many sins I have done these things to you.

ekegusii: Nase ki inwe mogoita Abaisraeli emioyo, erinde tibabaisa kwamboka gochia ng’umbu ya Yorodan, na koira ense eria Omonene abaeire?
english: Why do you discourage the Israelites from going over into the land the LORD has given them?

ekegusii: Nase ki mokwerosia kobwatia chinchera ching’ao? Inwe mwasookigwe n’Abamisiri buna mwasoogetigwe n’Abaasuri.
english: Why do you go about so much, changing your ways? You will be disappointed by Egypt as you were by Assyria.

ekegusii: Nase ki mogokong’ia chinkoro chiaino buna Abamisiri na Farao bakong’etie echiabo. Inee! Ekero Omonene abaete amaakwa amakong’u tibaete Abaisraeli ribaga bakaruao?
english: Why do you harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh did? When he treated them harshly, did they not send the Israelites out so they could go on their way?

ekegusii: “Nase ki okobisa obosio bwao na kombara ng’a nomobisa oo inde?
english: Why do you hide your face and consider me your enemy?

ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwabisire obosio bwao korwa asetore? Nase ki aye kwebire emechando yaito na ogokorerwa bobe gwaito?
english: Why do you hide your face and forget our misery and oppression?

ekegusii: Nase ki aye kwaringire okoboko kwao gw’okorio? Korambore korwa ase egekuba kiao, obasirie kegima.
english: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take it from the folds of your garment and destroy them!

ekegusii: Naki gwantigire narorire amabe buna aya? Naki ondigereretie ing’etananire nemechando? Ogosirigwa na ogokorerwa bobe nigo bire ase obosio bwane; amariomana na ogotaigwana nigo bireo.
english: Why do you make me look at injustice? Why do you tolerate wrong? Destruction and violence are before me; there is strife, and conflict abounds.

ekegusii: Nase ki otakonyabera ogosaria kwane, erinde otige ebibe biane kegima? Bono inche nkogenda inde korara ime ye riroba; aye nigo orabe gokondigia, korende tokonyora aande.”
english: Why do you not pardon my offenses and forgive my sins? For I will soon lie down in the dust; you will search for me, but I will be no more."

ekegusii: Bono, ninki okorera neriogi rinene? Inee! Omoruoti tari ime yao? Abasemia bao mbasirigwe goika kwabeire nobororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore?
english: Why do you now cry aloud-- have you no king? Has your counselor perished, that pain seizes you like that of a woman in labor?

ekegusii: Nase ki kwabana ase erieta ri’Omonene gwateba ng’a enyomba eye ebe buna Silo, naende ng’a omochie oyo nosirigwe obe bosa, monto onde tamenya aroro? Abanto bonsi bakamoetanana agwo ase enyomba y’Omonene.
english: Why do you prophesy in the LORD's name that this house will be like Shiloh and this city will be desolate and deserted?" And all the people crowded around Jeremiah in the house of the LORD.

ekegusii: Nase ki nainwe mogonchanda buna Nyasae anchandire? Inee! Timoisanegeti ase ogonchanda omobere one?
english: Why do you pursue me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli, nase ki mogoteba ng’a Omonene tarochi chinchera chiaino, naende ng’a ere Nyasae obarinire oboronge bwaino?
english: Why do you say, O Jacob, and complain, O Israel, "My way is hidden from the LORD; my cause is disregarded by my God"?

ekegusii: Nase ki rende mwabeire mogochaya na koba ne ribero ase ebing’wanso biane, na okoruegwa kwane, nachigete birentwe ase Obomenyo bwane? Aye Eli kwaeire abamura bao ogosika kong’etania ase okobaa ribaga kwenoria ase eyere enoru mono kobua, ase kera ekeng’wanso abanto baane Abaisraeli bakonduera.
english: Why do you scorn my sacrifice and offering that I prescribed for my dwelling? Why do you honor your sons more than me by fattening yourselves on the choice parts of every offering made by my people Israel?'

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nase ki omonto omokori amabe akogochaya, na korengereria ng’a aye tokomoa egesusuro.
english: Why does the wicked man revile God? Why does he say to himself, "He won't call me to account"?

ekegusii: Aye egetunwa ki’ebichuria ebinge, nase ki okorigereria ne ribero ase egetunwa ekio Nyasae achorire koba obomenyo bwaye? Ee, Nyasae ochorire komenya aroro kogenderera botambe.
english: Why gaze in envy, O rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign, where the LORD himself will dwell forever?

ekegusii: Naki omochie oria omanyekanete mono, naende inche nagokerete, ong’anyirwe iga na otigirwe bosa?
english: Why has the city of renown not been abandoned, the town in which I delight?

ekegusii: Nase ki enkoro yao ere morero, na amaiso ao akomogora,
english: Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,

ekegusii: “Abanto abwo nigo bagoteba: Nase ki tokweng’ata, na aye Omonene tori korengereria amang’ana ayio? Nase ki togwekeyia, na aye tori korora ayio? Omonene nigo agoteba: Rora rituko eri mokweng’ata nigo mokwerigeria aya akobagokia inwe abanyene, naende mwachanda abakori emeremo baino bonsi.
english: 'Why have we fasted,' they say, 'and you have not seen it? Why have we humbled ourselves, and you have not noticed?' "Yet on the day of your fasting, you do as you please and exploit all your workers.

ekegusii: Nase ki rende aye gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye, erinde bonsi abagoeta ase enchera batabora amasabibu aye?
english: Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?

ekegusii: Nase ki omobaso oorokire ase omonto chinchera chiaye chibisire, oyio Nyasae agiteire chinsemo chionsi?
english: Why is life given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

ekegusii: Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.
english: Naki motamanyeti amang’ana aane aya ngokwana? Nekiagera motancheti koigwa ring’ana riane.

ekegusii: Nase ki obororo bwane bogendererete botari koera, na amaote aane atari kogwena? Inee! Aye nigo okoba asende buna akarooche ntasemereti, akwo amache aye agokama?”
english: Why is my pain unending and my wound grievous and incurable? Will you be to me like a deceptive brook, like a spring that fails?

ekegusii: Ninki kiagera Omonene agotoira ase ense eria tochie goitwa ase esegi? Abakungu baito, na abana baito, nigo bagochia gwoswa nababisa baito. Nigo yare koba buya toirane Misiri.”
english: Why is the LORD bringing us to this land only to let us fall by the sword? Our wives and children will be taken as plunder. Wouldn't it be better for us to go back to Egypt?"

ekegusii: Oborabu bwao bwabekirwe omosunte, goika tori korora, na amache amange agotubire.
english: why it is so dark you cannot see, and why a flood of water covers you.

ekegusii: Naki rende totagokora obobe, erinde obuya boche? Buna abande bagoteba ase ogotoitania. Okogambigwa kwabo nigo kore boronge.
english: Why not say-- as we are being slanderously reported as saying and as some claim that we say-- "Let us do evil that good may result"? Their condemnation is deserved.

ekegusii: Nase ki? Ekiagera tibarenge koborigia ase enchera y’okwegena, korende nase enchera y’ogokora, Bakagochwa igoro ase rigena riria rikogocha;
english: Why not? Because they pursued it not by faith but as if it were by works. They stumbled over the "stumbling stone."

ekegusii: Nase ki mokongechia nkoba nendamwamu ase engencho y’emeremo y’amaboko aino ase ogosamba ubani ase chinyasae ching’ao agwo ase ense ya Misiri momenyete? Inee! Nigo mogokora ayio ase ogwesiria kegima, erinde abanto b’ebisaku bionsi bi’ense babachecherie na koragereria ase erieta riaino?
english: Why provoke me to anger with what your hands have made, burning incense to other gods in Egypt, where you have come to live? You will destroy yourselves and make yourselves an object of cursing and reproach among all the nations on earth.

ekegusii: Nase ki okomboria? Boria baria baigwete aya nakwanete nabarabwo; barabwo mbamanyete aya nabatebetie.”
english: Why question me? Ask those who heard me. Surely they know what I said."

ekegusii: Nase ki rende mwanyabanto ore moyo akwemurunganeria? Nase ki akwemurungania ekero akonyora egesusuro ase engencho y’ebibe biaye.
english: Why should any living man complain when punished for his sins?

ekegusii: Nase ki motari gwancha nga Nyasae nkobabokia are abakure?
english: Why should any of you consider it incredible that God raises the dead?

ekegusii: Inche tinkoba nobwoba ase chingaki chi’emechando, ekero amabe ’abachandi baane arabe ang’etananire.
english: Why should I fear when evil days come, when wicked deceivers surround me--

ekegusii: Inee! Ninyare koimokia endagera yane, na ekenyugwa kiane, na enyama ye ching’iti chiane nanyenyeire abanto bakonachera ching’ondi amarionya, na kobia abanto ntamanyeti aase bakorua?”
english: Why should I take my bread and water, and the meat I have slaughtered for my shearers, and give it to men coming from who knows where?"

ekegusii: Nase ki erieta ria tata rigosirigwa korwa ase eamate yaye ekiagera tabwate abana abamura? Toe naintwe omwando ase egati y’abamura bamwabo tata.”
english: Why should our father's name disappear from his clan because he had no son? Give us property among our father's relatives."

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo origetie Abamisiri batebe: Igo abarusia aa, oganetie kobaita ase ebitunwa na kobasiria kegima? Ase igo onchoka korwa ase endamwamu yao enene, tokora amabe aya kwarengereirie gokorera abanto bao.
english: Why should the Egyptians say, 'It was with evil intent that he brought them out, to kill them in the mountains and to wipe them off the face of the earth'? Turn from your fierce anger; relent and do not bring disaster on your people.

ekegusii: Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bakoboria, “Ng’ai Nyasae oyio obo are?” Ase amasio aito tiga abanto b’ebisaku bamanye buna okorusia egesiomba ase engencho y’ogoiterwa kw’amanyinga ’abasomba bao.
english: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.

ekegusii: Nase ki torakwere ase obosio bwao, na amaremo aito asareke? Togore intwe, ogore na amaremo aito, na intwe tobe abasomba ba Farao, na amaremo aito abe ayaye. Toe chimbusuro tosimeke, titokwa, na amaremo aito abe bosa.”
english: Why should we perish before your eyes-- we and our land as well? Buy us and our land in exchange for food, and we with our land will be in bondage to Pharaoh. Give us seed so that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate."

ekegusii: Nase ki mogendererete gosaria? Nigo moganetie konyora egesusuro goetania? Omotwe bwonsi orwarire, na enkoro yanyarekire.
english: Why should you be beaten anymore? Why do you persist in rebellion? Your whole head is injured, your whole heart afflicted.

ekegusii: Nase ki mokorua chibesa chiaino kogora egento getari endagera? Nase ki mokwerosia gokora emeremo ase eke getari goisanekia? Ntegerere moigwe, nainwe morie eyere engiya, namogokere endagera enoru.
english: Why spend money on what is not bread, and your labor on what does not satisfy? Listen, listen to me, and eat what is good, and your soul will delight in the richest of fare.

ekegusii: Naki otarenda eira yao y’ogotiana ase Omonene amo naya nagochigete?”
english: Why then did you not keep your oath to the LORD and obey the command I gave you?"

ekegusii: Naki rende otabegete chibesa chiane ase aba bakorua ebitoki, ninche ngocha anga nachinyora amo nebitoki?
english: Why then didn't you put my money on deposit, so that when I came back, I could have collected it with interest?'

ekegusii: Nase ki inwe abanto ba Yerusalemu mogendererete gontiga iga? Mwancheranire nokong’ainererigwa, na mwangire kong’iranera.
english: Why then have these people turned away? Why does Jerusalem always turn away? They cling to deceit; they refuse to return.

ekegusii: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
english: Aye enyancha, ninki kwaroche, erinde ogatama? Aye Yorodani, ninki kiabete asore, erinde okanacheka okairana nyuma?

ekegusii: Why were there knees to receive me and breasts that I might be nursed?
english: Ninki kiagerete baba akaang’agata? Ninki kiagerete akangonkia amabeere aye?

ekegusii: Nase ki aye amo nabanto bao moganetie gokwa ase ogoitwa nemioro na enchara, na oborwaire? Ayio naro Omonene atebire arakoreke ase egesaku kende gionsi keraange gokorera omoruoti o Babeli.
english: Why will you and your people die by the sword, famine and plague with which the LORD has threatened any nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

ekegusii: Nase ki abanto baino bare ne chinguru batamire? Tibatenenete, ekiagera Omonene abaseretie.
english: Why will your warriors be laid low? They cannot stand, for the LORD will push them down.

ekegusii: Omonene, naki gwatotigire togosaria na gotiga chinchera chiao? Aye gwakorire chinkoro chiaito chiabeire chinkong’u chitari gokoiroka. Toiranere ase engencho y’abasomba bao, na ase engencho y’ebisaku bire omwando oo.
english: Why, O LORD, do you make us wander from your ways and harden our hearts so we do not revere you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes that are your inheritance.

ekegusii: Omonene, nase ki gwatugutire omoyo one? Nase ki kwabisire obosio bwao korwa asende?
english: Why, O LORD, do you reject me and hide your face from me?

ekegusii: Omonene, naki gwateneneire aare iga? Naki okwebisa, otari kororekana ase chingaki chi’emechando?
english: Why, O LORD, do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

ekegusii: Inwe timomanyeti ayarache abe ankio. Obogima bwaino ninki? Naki inwe neritaturi, rikororekana ase egeka egeke, naende riasira.
english: Why, you do not even know what will happen tomorrow. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes.

ekegusii: Nase ki? Ekiagera ntabancheti inwe? Nyasae namanyete ng’a nimbanchete.
english: Why? Because I do not love you? God knows I do!

ekegusii: Abakori amabe nigo bagosirigwa, tibakobao naende, korende enyomba y’omonyene oboronge netenene bokong’u.
english: Wicked men are overthrown and are no more, but the house of the righteous stands firm.

ekegusii: wild animals and all cattle, small creatures and flying birds,
english: nainwe ching’iti chi’orosana na echitugire chionsi, nainwe echikwagura amo ne chinyoni chionsi!

ekegusii: Chitigere chi’orosana nigo chigotenena ase ebigoro igoro, nigo chikoeyana bwango buna chisese chi’orosana. Amaiso abo agoyanire ekiagera ebimeri biasirire.”
english: Wild donkeys stand on the barren heights and pant like jackals; their eyesight fails for lack of pasture."

ekegusii: Inee! Abanto aba bonsi abakori amabe tibari nokomanya? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari korangeria Omonene abakonye.
english: Will evildoers never learn-- those who devour my people as men eat bread and who do not call on the LORD?

ekegusii: otatiga aegwe ara rigana ase ekero kia bono, chinyomba, na bamura bamwabo, na basubati bamwabo, na abang’ina, na abana, na emegondo, ase emechando, na ase ense egochigocha obogima bwa kare na kare.
english: will fail to receive a hundred times as much in this present age (homes, brothers, sisters, mothers, children and fields-- and with them, persecutions) and in the age to come, eternal life.

ekegusii: otanyore kobua ara aange bono, naende ase ense egochi‐gocha obogima bwa kare na kare.”
english: will fail to receive many times as much in this age and, in the age to come, eternal life."

ekegusii: Omonto oyio nagokigwe ase Omonguru? Nabe okorangeria Nyasae ase chingaki chionsi?”
english: Will he find delight in the Almighty? Will he call upon God at all times?

ekegusii: Inee! Nenyare gokoboria amang’ana amange ase oboitongo? Gose nenyare gokwana naye amang’ana amororo?
english: Will he keep begging you for mercy? Will he speak to you with gentle words?

ekegusii: Ero nekore okobwatana amo naye, ng’a ebe omosomba oo kogendera botambe?
english: Will he make an agreement with you for you to take him as your slave for life?

ekegusii: Ogosemeria okwo nigo koragende gochia aase abakure. Nintirimboke amo nakorokwo gochia gotimoka ase riroba ime.”
english: Will it go down to the gates of death? Will we descend together into the dust?"

ekegusii: Rituko riria ri’Omonene nigo rirabe eri’omosunte, tirikoba eri’oborabu, ee, neri’omosunte ekerima, na omobaso tokobara nonya ng’ake.
english: Will not the day of the LORD be darkness, not light-- pitch-dark, without a ray of brightness?

ekegusii: Inee, ogokora kw’Omoika tigokoba nobonene goetania boria?
english: will not the ministry of the Spirit be even more glorious?

ekegusii: Inee! Abanto baria kwairete ebinto biabo tibakogochera mobosokano, na bagochande, bakobwate bakoire ase obosomba.
english: Will not your debtors suddenly arise? Will they not wake up and make you tremble? Then you will become their victim.

ekegusii: Inee! Abanto ba Keila nigo barandue, bambeke ase amaboko aye? Saulo nachiche buna inche omosomba oo, naigure? Aye Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nagosoroire, koranche ontebie inche omosomba oo ekerabe.” Na Omonene akamoiraneria, “Ee, nachiche.”
english: Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me to him? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? O LORD, God of Israel, tell your servant." And the LORD said, "He will."

ekegusii: Inee! Abanto abwo bagokora amabe, tibamanyeti gento? Nigo bakoria abanto baane ase okobaurereria buna bakoria endagera yabo; tibari kondangeria inche Nyasae mbakonye.
english: Will the evildoers never learn-- those who devour my people as men eat bread and who do not call on God?

ekegusii: Inee! Omonene nagokigwe ne chimingichi chilifu, gose ne chindooche chi’amaguta chilifu ikomi? Inee! Nindue omwana one omotangi ase engencho y’ogosaria kwane, omwana oyio ore okwama kw’obogima bwane, abe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe ase engencho y’omoyo one?”
english: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousand rivers of oil? Shall I offer my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

ekegusii: Will they not instruct you and tell you? Will they not bring forth words from their understanding?
english: Inee! Amang’ana ’obong’aini chisokoro chiria chiakwanete, takonyara gokworokereria, erinde bwegere?

ekegusii: Inee! Abaoonia mbakorerane rigori igoro yaye, gose bayebutorane ase okoyeoonerania?
english: Will traders barter for him? Will they divide him up among the merchants?

ekegusii: Inee! Omonene nigo aratobee goika kare na kare, na endamwamu yaye nigo eragenderere kobao goika omoerio? Ee, inwe nabo mogoteba, naende nigo mogendererete gokora amabe onsi buna moranyare.”
english: will you always be angry? Will your wrath continue forever?' This is how you talk, but you do all the evil you can."

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo ogochia koba nendamwamu asetore kogenderera botambe? Inee! Endamwamu yao nigo egendererete koba ase ebiaare bionsi?
english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger through all generations?

ekegusii: “Inee! Nenchera enkoro ogochia kobwatia, eria abakori amabe babwatetie?
english: Will you keep to the old path that evil men have trod?

ekegusii: Inee! Nengaki eng’ana naki ogochia koba gokona‐kondigereria? Naki otagontiga, erinde inyore obosibore imere amate?
english: Will you never look away from me, or let me alone even for an instant?

ekegusii: Inee! Togotokora abayia naende, erinde intwe abanto bao tobe nomogoko asore?
english: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

ekegusii: Aye togotwara egento Kemosi, enyasae yao, yakoeire, kebe ekiao? Naboigo naintwe natoire ense y’abanto baria Omonene Nyasae aseretie korwa ase amasio aito.
english: Will you not take what your god Chemosh gives you? Likewise, whatever the LORD our God has given us, we will possess.

ekegusii: Inee! Noyesemerie ekiagera ere ne chinguru chinyinge? Nonyare gotiga emeremo yao, ng’a ero ekoyekorere?
english: Will you rely on him for his great strength? Will you leave your heavy work to him?

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo more nogwanchereria asare? Nigo moganetie korwanerera Nyasae?
english: Will you show him partiality? Will you argue the case for God?

ekegusii: Inee! Inwe nigo mokorwanerera Nyasae ase ogokwana aya atari a boronge? Naende mokomorwanerera ase obong’ainereria?
english: Will you speak wickedly on God's behalf? Will you speak deceitfully for him?

ekegusii: Ekero orabe ase amaboko abanto abwo, bakogoita, Inee, nogenderere gokwana ase amasio abo ng’a aye Nyasae ore? Aye nigo ore mwanyabanto, orabe ase amaboko ay’abwo bakogoita, tori Nyasae.
english: Will you then say, "I am a god," in the presence of those who kill you? You will be but a man, not a god, in the hands of those who slay you.

ekegusii: Inee! Nigo orasegenyie rito eriomo rikona‐koirwa nembeo? Gose aye nigo ogochia gotunya omoiriro korwa nyuma?
english: Will you torment a windblown leaf? Will you chase after dry chaff?

ekegusii: Ase amatuko ndarente egesusuro asore, Inee, nogenderere koba noboremu gose amaboko ao nabe ne chinguru? Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio, goika inyaikeranie.
english: Will your courage endure or your hands be strong in the day I deal with you? I the LORD have spoken, and I will do it.

ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana ao atari nengencho nagere abanto bakire‐kiri? Na ekero ogokwana amang’ana ay’ogochecheria, monto onde takogosookia?
english: Will your idle talk reduce men to silence? Will no one rebuke you when you mock?

ekegusii: Will your long-winded speeches never end? What ails you that you keep on arguing?
english: Inee! Amang’ana ayio anga buna omwaga okogusa aerire? Gose nkere egekogoseegeta oiranerie ayande?

ekegusii: Edivai nigo ekorenta echeche, ekenyugwa egetindi nigo gekorenta eriomana; na onde bwensi otari gokianga nigo akoborwa obong’aini.
english: Wine is a mocker and beer a brawler; whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bakonywa edivai na baba nomogoko; nigo bakweaka amaguta, bagirigenta amasio abo, naende baria endagera, erinde emebere yabo yanyora chinguru.
english: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil to make his face shine, and bread that sustains his heart.

ekegusii: Ebinyugwa bikabekwa ase ebikombe biaroisirie korwa ase chitahabu; kera egekombe nigo kiaroisetigwe k’obwaye getagwekaini ekende. Edivai ekonyugwa ase enyomba y’omoruoti ekarentwa ase obonge.
english: Wine was served in goblets of gold, each one different from the other, and the royal wine was abundant, in keeping with the king's liberality.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogoaka eriogi rinene ase chinchera, boigo nase chichiiro.
english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street, she raises her voice in the public squares;

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bweagacherete enyomba. Nigo bwebaacherete chisiiro isano na ibere.
english: Wisdom has built her house; she has hewn out its seven pillars.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogotokonya buna chibesa chigotokonya, korende obuya bw’omonyasemi mboria ng’a obong’aini nigo bokorenda obogima bw’oyio ong’ainiire.
english: Wisdom is a shelter as money is a shelter, but the advantage of knowledge is this: that wisdom preserves the life of its possessor.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obuya kobua ebirwanero bi’esegi; korende omonyabibe oyomo nigo agosaria amaya amange.
english: Wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one sinner destroys much good.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bokonyorekana ase omonwa bw’omonto omomanyi, korende oyo otari nokomanya nigo agwenerete aakwe enyimbo ase omogongo oye.
english: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obw’engencho enene. Ase ayio, enyorere obong’aini, na kende gionsi okorigia, rigia obe nokomanya.
english: Wisdom is supreme; therefore get wisdom. Though it cost all you have, get understanding.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore egento kere aare korwa ase omonto omoriri; ere tari komaanora omonwa oye agwo ase egeita.
english: Wisdom is too high for a fool; in the assembly at the gate he has nothing to say.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bogokora abare abang’aini koba ne chinguru chibuete echi’abagambi ikomi bare ase omochie oyomo.
english: Wisdom makes one wise man more powerful than ten rulers in a city.

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bomenyete ase enkoro y’omonto ore nokomanya, korende ase enkoro y’omoriri nigo bwemanyekanetie obonyene.
english: Wisdom reposes in the heart of the discerning and even among fools she lets herself be known.

ekegusii: Obong’aini mbokorusie korwa ase chinchera chi’obobe na korwa ase abanto bagokwana amang’ana ’obosiru.
english: Wisdom will save you from the ways of wicked men, from men whose words are perverse,

ekegusii: Obong’aini nigo bore obuya buna omwando, na nigo bogokonya abwo baroche erioba.
english: Wisdom, like an inheritance, is a good thing and benefits those who see the sun.

ekegusii: Abanto abang’aini nigo bakogacha chisemi, korende omonwa bw’omonto omoriri nigo okorenta ogosirigwa ang’e.
english: Wise men store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool invites ruin.

ekegusii: With a loud cry, Jesus breathed his last.
english: Yeso agaaka eriogi rinene, agatweka mo.

ekegusii: Akabarusia aroro nokoboko kwaye gwe chinguru koramboire, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.
english: with a mighty hand and outstretched arm; His love endures forever.

ekegusii: Akarera neriogi rie chinguru, ogoteba, “Babeli ogure! Babeli, omochie oria omonene, ogure! Obeire obomenyo bw’ebirecha, na obogacho bwa kera omoika bw’eubi, na obwa kera enyoni etachenegeti na ey’okogechia.
english: With a mighty voice he shouted: "Fallen! Fallen is Babylon the Great! She has become a home for demons and a haunt for every evil spirit, a haunt for every unclean and detestable bird.

ekegusii: Ekero chigoeta igoro ase ebitunwa, ebititiro biabo nigo binga buna ebie chigari, naende nigo binga buna ogotoreka kw’omorero ogosamba amasakwe; chirochio nigo chire buna abarwani esegi bare ne chinguru baroberigwe.
english: With a noise like that of chariots they leap over the mountaintops, like a crackling fire consuming stubble, like a mighty army drawn up for battle.

ekegusii: Bosio bw’ebinyomba ebio aase arenge goeterwa narengeo. Ebinyomba ebio nigo biareng’aine na biria biarenge ensemo ya sugusu. Obotambe bwabo na obogare nigo bwarenge buna obw’ebio. Aase abo onsi arenge goeterwa nigo areng’aine buna aase aria aande, na emeroberio ende yonsi amo nebisieri nigo biarenge buna emeroberio eria ende.
english: with a passageway in front of them. These were like the rooms on the north; they had the same length and width, with similar exits and dimensions. Similar to the doorways on the north

ekegusii: Inche ase ogokora aya narenge konyara, nabekire ebinto ang’e ase okoagachera enyomba ya Nyasae one: chitahabu ase ebinto bie chitahabu, ne chifeta ase ebinto bie chifeta, ne chitaai ase ebinto bie chitaai, na ebioma ase ebinto bi’ebioma, ne chibao ase ebinto bie chibao. Amo nebinto ebio narure amagena e rigori rinene, buna oiniki na ayande ay’ogosata, ayare nebieni ao ao, akomeka‐meka, amo namagena ande amange amarabu akomeka‐meka.
english: With all my resources I have provided for the temple of my God-- gold for the gold work, silver for the silver, bronze for the bronze, iron for the iron and wood for the wood, as well as onyx for the settings, turquoise, stones of various colors, and all kinds of fine stone and marble-- all of these in large quantities.

ekegusii: Obochore engoro gati gati, ase omotwe ogosoera, oyebeke ekenario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.
english: with an opening for the head in its center. There shall be a woven edge like a collar around this opening, so that it will not tear.

ekegusii: Ase eganchwa eria bakabochora engoro ase omotwe ogosoera, enga buna engoro y’esati. Engoro eria ekabekwa ekenaario buna egi’esati, techa gotandoka.
english: with an opening in the center of the robe like the opening of a collar, and a band around this opening, so that it would not tear.

ekegusii: amato aye arenge amaya, na amatunda aye namange, na ase omote oria endagera nao yarenge goisanekia abanto bonsi. Inse yaye ching’iti chi’orosana nao chiare konyora ekiriri chigokenderera, na ase chinsagia chiaye chinyoni chikaba chikomenyao.
english: with beautiful leaves and abundant fruit, providing food for all, giving shelter to the beasts of the field, and having nesting places in its branches for the birds of the air--

ekegusii: Nigo yasibeire chinkini ase ebinema biabo na emetwe yabo nigo yanareire ebitambaa ebiya mono. Abasacha baria bonsi nigo baare kororekana ng’a nabarwani abanene. Ekero aroche emegwekano eyio y’abanto ba Babeli, ababiare b’ense ya Kalidayo,
english: with belts around their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like Babylonian chariot officers, natives of Chaldea.

ekegusii: Abaruti emegwe bakomoimokera ase okomochanda bororo, bakomoruta emegwe na komorosia,
english: With bitterness archers attacked him; they shot at him with hostility.

ekegusii: Ase ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, na ebing’wanso bi’ebibe, tikwagogetigwe nabirobio.
english: with burnt offerings and sin offerings you were not pleased.

ekegusii: Nigo bagokora emeroberio y’obong’ainereria igoro y’abanto bao; abwo nigo bagosemania kobakorera bobe abanto bao abwo orendete.
english: With cunning they conspire against your people; they plot against those you cherish.

ekegusii: Akabaa amanooga e chiombe, na amabeere e chimbori, ne chinyama chinoru chie chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na echie chimingichi, amo ne ching’ondi ne chimbori chingiya chikorwa Basani. Mokaria engano yarenge engiya mono, na mokanywa edivai korwa ase amasabibu amonyinga.”
english: with curds and milk from herd and flock and with fattened lambs and goats, with choice rams of Bashan and the finest kernels of wheat. You drank the foaming blood of the grape.

ekegusii: Naende morue okoruegwa kw’endagera obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta: Amo na kera eeri ensae morue obosie ebimunu bitano na ekemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,
english: With each bull prepare a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

ekegusii: Ekenyugwa gekoruegwa amo na kera eeri nigo kerabe edivai ebituba bibere, na amo nemingichi eria edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, na amo na kera emanwa emingichi edivai egetuba ekemo. Eke nkebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gekoruegwa kera omotienyi ase emetienyi yonsi y’omwaka.
english: With each bull there is to be a drink offering of half a hin of wine; with the ram, a third of a hin; and with each lamb, a quarter of a hin. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year.

ekegusii: Morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta ’amazeituni. Amo na kera eeri morue obosie ebimunu bitano na ekemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,
english: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil;

ekegusii: Amo nekeng’wanso ekio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta ’amazeituni. Amo na kera eeri morue obosie ebimunu bitano na ekemo, na amo nemingichi eria obosie ebimunu bine,
english: With each bull there is to be a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with the ram, two-tenths;

ekegusii: na edivai egetuba ekemo kebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa, amo na kera emanwa y’eng’ondi; onye nekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa gose ekeng’wanso kende gionsi.
english: With each lamb for the burnt offering or the sacrifice, prepare a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.

ekegusii: Amo nechio morue okoruegwa kw’endagera, obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta. Amo na kera eyemo ye chieri chiria ikomi na isato morue obosie ebimunu bitano na ekemo, na amo na kera eyemo ye chimingichi chiria ibere obosie ebimunu bine,
english: With each of the thirteen bulls prepare a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil; with each of the two rams, two-tenths;

english: With eyes full of adultery, they never stop sinning; they seduce the unstable; they are experts in greed-- an accursed brood!

ekegusii: Abwo bagokora amabe ase okobwatana okwo ere nabang’use namang’ana ay’okweansia goika bagotige kegima, korende abanto baria bamomanyete Nyasae obo mbatenene bokong’u bakore ayabagwenerete bakore.
english: With flattery he will corrupt those who have violated the covenant, but the people who know their God will firmly resist him.

english: with four posts and four bronze bases. Their hooks and bands were silver, and their tops were overlaid with silver.

ekegusii: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.
english: Ekero tore amo na Nyasae, inatokore amang’ana amanene, nere orabue ababisa baito na kobatiringera inse.

english: With great power the apostles continued to testify to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and much grace was upon them all.

english: With her the kings of the earth committed adultery and the inhabitants of the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her adulteries."

ekegusii: Barabwo bagatiga aase aaria bamenyete, korende ekero barenge kogenda gochia ase ense y’Abayuda,
english: With her two daughters-in-law she left the place where she had been living and set out on the road that would take them back to the land of Judah.

ekegusii: Nigo ngokwana nere obosio ase obosio, gose tindi gokwana nere ase emerabaaro; ere ororire ekieni kiane. Nase ki inwe motabete nobwoba gokwana mamincha ya Musa, omosomba one?”
english: With him I speak face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?"

ekegusii: Omoruoti oria nigo are ne chinguru chia mwanyabanto, korende Omonene, Nyasae oito, nigo are amo naintwe ase ogotokonya na gotorwanisia.” Abanto bakaba abaremu ase engencho y’amang’ana a Hezekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda.
english: With him is only the arm of flesh, but with us is the LORD our God to help us and to fight our battles." And the people gained confidence from what Hezekiah the king of Judah said.

ekegusii: Amo na Finehasi bagatoma abatang’ani ikomi, oyomo bwa kera egesaku ki’Abaisraeli; kera oyomo nigo arenge omoteneneri bw’eamate ase egesaku kiaye.
english: With him they sent ten of the chief men, one for each of the tribes of Israel, each the head of a family division among the Israelite clans.

ekegusii: Amo nere nigo arenge Oholiabu, omwana o Ahisamaki bw’egesaku kia Dani, komokonya. Ere nigo arenge omong’aini bw’okomang’a na kobaacha, na bw’okoroisia ebitambaa bie chiusi chi’amarionya chire buru, ne chimonyinga, ne chimbariri, amo nechi’egatani engiya.
english: with him was Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan-- a craftsman and designer, and an embroiderer in blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine linen.)

ekegusii: Simei nigo arenge amo nabanto elifu eyemo b’egesaku kia Benjamin. Na Siba, omosomba o Saulo, na abamura baye ikomi na batano, na abasomba baye emerongo ebere, bakaayerera gochia ase Yorodan, bagaikao omoruoti ataraika.
english: With him were a thousand Benjamites, along with Ziba, the steward of Saul's household, and his fifteen sons and twenty servants. They rushed to the Jordan, where the king was.

ekegusii: Oyo otamoirogeti Nyasae nigo agosiria abanto bande namang’ana agokwana korwa ase omonwa oye, korende goetera ase obong’aini abanyene oboronge mbatoorigwe.
english: With his mouth the godless destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous escape.

ekegusii: Arente namaboko aye omonyene ekeng’wanso kiaye kegosambwa nomorero asende inche Omonene; arente ebitinya amo ne ritaana, ne ritaana erio risungusigwe ribe ekeng’wanso kegosungusigwa ase obosio bwane inche Omonene.
english: With his own hands he is to bring the offering made to the LORD by fire; he is to bring the fat, together with the breast, and wave the breast before the LORD as a wave offering.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwabetete emetwe y’abarwani esegi babo namatimo abo abanyene, ekero batocherete buna ekembugumbugu kegocha gotoserebania bare nomochengo gotosiria buna abataka bagosirigwa bobisi.
english: With his own spear you pierced his head when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though about to devour the wretched who were in hiding.

ekegusii: korende akabisa ensemo ye rigori riaye, na mokaye nere namanyete aya. Akarenta ensemo eyemo, akayebeka ase amagoro ’abatomwa.
english: With his wife's full knowledge he kept back part of the money for himself, but brought the rest and put it at the apostles' feet.

ekegusii: Bakayegobania nekegobanio, bakayebeka ase egesaisero, bakayeira ase omoruoti o Babeli. Aroro agwo bakayesiekera ase eburi enkong’u, ng’a eriogi riaye tiribaisa koigweka ase ebitunwa bi’Abaisraeli.
english: With hooks they pulled him into a cage and brought him to the king of Babylon. They put him in prison, so his roar was heard no longer on the mountains of Israel.

ekegusii: With it he touched my mouth and said, "See, this has touched your lips; your guilt is taken away and your sin atoned for."
english: Erio agakuna omonwa one ne rikara riria, agateba, “Rora, rikara eri ri’omorero riakunire ebikoba biao; ogosaria kwao kwarusigweo, na ebibe biao biaabeirwe.”

ekegusii: with it the reaper cannot fill his hands, nor the one who gathers fill his arms.
english: tibori goichora okoboko kw’omosangereria, gose kobogwa omosaima okoboko.

english: With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation.

ekegusii: buna abaruoti b’ense amo nabasemia babo bakaraire, abwo beagacherete amaagacho ’obosareku.
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built for themselves places now lying in ruins,

ekegusii: With long life will I satisfy him and show him my salvation."
english: Nimoisanekie nobogima obotambe na komworokia ogotooreka kwane.

ekegusii: Petero akabaorokeria ase amang’ana ande amange na kobakurera, ogoteba, “Etoorie korwa ase ekegori eke getari ekeronge.”
english: With many other words he warned them; and he pleaded with them, "Save yourselves from this corrupt generation."

ekegusii: Ase emereng’anio emenge ere buna eye nigo arenge gokwana ring’ana asebare, koreng’ana buna baare konyara koigwa,
english: With many similar parables Jesus spoke the word to them, as much as they could understand.

ekegusii: With me are riches and honor, enduring wealth and prosperity.
english: Ninche nkorua obonda na ogosikwa, amo nobotenenku na oboronge bitari koera.

ekegusii: Omokungu oria nabisete abanto baganyete ase akanyomba ka ime. Erio akamorangeria, “Samison! Abafilisti aba bachire gokobwata!” Korende Samison akabutora chingori chiria buna eusi enyororo ekorurwa nomorero. Ase ayio, obobisi bwe chinguru chiaye tibwamanyekanete.
english: With men hidden in the room, she called to him, "Samson, the Philistines are upon you!" But he snapped the thongs as easily as a piece of string snaps when it comes close to a flame. So the secret of his strength was not discovered.

ekegusii: Ninche ase okobua kwane ne chinguru chiane, natongete ense, na mwanyabanto, ne ching’iti chionsi chire ase ense. Ninche nkoyea omonto onde bwensi nanchire koa.
english: With my great power and outstretched arm I made the earth and its people and the animals that are on it, and I give it to anyone I please.

ekegusii: With my lips I recount all the laws that come from your mouth.
english: Nimbe nkona‐koraria aya onsi gwanchikire nomonwa oo.

ekegusii: Ning’iranerie Omonene ng’a mbuya mono kegima nomonwa one, nimbe nkona‐komotogia ase egati y’abanto abange.
english: With my mouth I will greatly extol the LORD; in the great throng I will praise him.

ekegusii: Abanto abagambire ase omoyo oyomo na bakorire okobwatana mamincha yao nabwo aba;
english: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against you--

english: Bagaaka eriogi bonsi amo, bakabora, “Morusie oyo, tosiborere Baraba!”

ekegusii: Omokungu oria akaebereria omomura oria namang’ana amansu ao ao, na ase amang’ana ’ebikoba ebiterere akamobua.
english: With persuasive words she led him astray; she seduced him with her smooth talk.

english: with Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, ministering before it.) They asked, "Shall we go up again to battle with Benjamin our brother, or not?" The LORD responded, "Go, for tomorrow I will give them into your hands."

ekegusii: Bakaba bagotera na goitabererania, bagotogia Omonene na komoiraneria ng’a mbuya mono, bagoteba, “Omonene nomuya, ekiagera obwanchani bwaye ase Abaisraeli nigo bogendererete goika kare na kare.” Abanto bonsi bagaaka amariogi amanene komotogia Omonene, ekiagera oboroso bw’enyomba y’Omonene konya bwabekirwe.
english: With praise and thanksgiving they sang to the LORD: "He is good; his love to Israel endures forever." And all the people gave a great shout of praise to the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

ekegusii: Inche anga nigo inde buna abanene batenengete ne chitahabu, baichoretie chinyomba chiabo ne chifeta.
english: with rulers who had gold, who filled their houses with silver.

ekegusii: Ekiagera abange babwatire nebirecha bi’eubi, na ebirecha ebi bikarwa asebare, bikarera ase egeturi ekenene; abanto abarenge amagata, na baria barenge ebirema bakagwenigwa.
english: With shrieks, evil spirits came out of many, and many paralytics and cripples were healed.

ekegusii: Na ekero omokungu oria arenge kona‐komoboraboria amang’ana ayio rituko ase rituko, Samison akarosa kegima, goika akerusia moyo.
english: With such nagging she prodded him day after day until he was tired to death.

ekegusii: Na rora, oyomo obo bw’abarenge amo na Yeso akarambora okoboko kwaye, akang’usa omoyio oye o birende, agaaka omosomba bw’omokuani omonene, akamobutora ogoto.
english: With that, one of Jesus' companions reached for his sword, drew it out and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.

ekegusii: Kobayerusirie korwa ase enyomba y’Abinadabu agwo ekegoro igoro, Ahiyo nere oyetang’aine.
english: with the ark of God on it, and Ahio was walking in front of it.

english: with the best gifts of the earth and its fullness and the favor of him who dwelt in the burning bush. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.

english: abae amatunda amaya ay’okwama kw’omobaso, abae okwama okonge kw’emetienyi.

english: With the coming of dawn, the angels urged Lot, saying, "Hurry! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away when the city is punished."

ekegusii: Ase amabomba aria barentanete korwa Misiri bakaroisia emegati etabekiri memera. Ememera tiyarengeo, ekiagera nigo baseretigwe korwa Misiri ase obwango, bataranyora ribaga koroisia endagera bagochia koria.
english: With the dough they had brought from Egypt, they baked cakes of unleavened bread. The dough was without yeast because they had been driven out of Egypt and did not have time to prepare food for themselves.

ekegusii: Amo nemanwa eria entang’ani orue ebimunu bibere bi’obosie obonuke bwochoganirie namaguta amaya, egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese, amitire korwa ase amazeituni. Naende goika orue edivai egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese ebe okoruegwa gw’ekenyugwa.
english: With the first lamb offer a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil from pressed olives, and a quarter of a hin of wine as a drink offering.

ekegusii: Ase okoboko gwa Silivano, oyominto omwegenwa buna ndoche, nabarikeire ase amang’ana amake, kobasorora na koorokia ng’a obo nabwo obuya bw’ekeene bwa Nyasae. Tenena bokong’u ase obwo.
english: With the help of Silas, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand fast in it.

ekegusii: With the help of Zadok a descendant of Eleazar and Ahimelech a descendant of Ithamar, David separated them into divisions for their appointed order of ministering.
english: Daudi agaatanana abwo b’ororeria rwa Haroni na akaroberia buna bakore emeremo. Zadoki bw’ororeria rw’Eleazari na Ahimeleki bw’ororeria rwa Itamari barabwo mbabete bakomokonya.

ekegusii: Ase okorua emingichi eria y’ekeng’wanso gi’okomocha, omokuani akore okobwatanigwa ase omonto oyio ase obosio bwane, ase engencho y’ebibe biria akorire, na omonto oyio naaberwe ase ebibe ebio akorire.
english: With the ram of the guilt offering the priest is to make atonement for him before the LORD for the sin he has committed, and his sin will be forgiven.

ekegusii: Na ase amagena aria akaagachera egesasimero ase erieta ri’Omonene; naende akarema omotaro goetanana egesasimero keria. Omotaro oria nigo orenge nobogare bware goisana kobusurwa ebiee bibere bie chimbusuro.
english: With the stones he built an altar in the name of the LORD, and he dug a trench around it large enough to hold two seahs of seed.

ekegusii: Erio omomalaika oria akarambora okoboko kwaye, na ase mesia y’enyimbo yaye agakuna chinyama chiria na emegati eria etabekiri memera.
