english: With the tip of the staff that was in his hand, the angel of the LORD touched the meat and the unleavened bread. Fire flared from the rock, consuming the meat and the bread. And the angel of the LORD disappeared.

ekegusii: Ase orwo twatogia Omonene Tata, na ase orwo twaragereria mwanyabanto abatongetwe ase omogwekano o Nyasae.
english: With the tongue we praise our Lord and Father, and with it we curse men, who have been made in God's likeness.

ekegusii: Na abana abamura ba Yusufu, abaiboreretwe agwo Misiri, mbabere barenge. Abanto bonsi ba Yakobo abasoete Misiri nigo barenge emerongo etano na ebere.
english: With the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob's family, which went to Egypt, were seventy in all.

ekegusii: Amaboko ’abakungu abare namayianda aiyekire abana babo abanyene; abwo nigo babete endagera yabo, ekero omochie bw’abanto baane orenge gosirigwa.
english: With their own hands compassionate women have cooked their own children, who became their food when my people were destroyed.

ekegusii: bakabaa baire rirube ririkire iga, “Ase abaminto b’Ebisaku abamore ase Antiokia, na Siiria, na Kilikia. Intwe abamino, abatomwa na abagaaka, twabakwanirie.
english: With them they sent the following letter: The apostles and elders, your brothers, To the Gentile believers in Antioch, Syria and Cilicia: Greetings.

ekegusii: Amo nabanene baria agatoma Abalawi aba: Semaya, na Netania, na Sebadia, na Asaeli, na Semiramoti, na Yehonathani, na Adonia, na Tobia, na Tobi‐Adonia. Naende amo n’Abalawi aba agatoma Elisama na Yehoramu abakuani.
english: With them were certain Levites-- Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah and Tob-Adonijah-- and the priests Elishama and Jehoram.

ekegusii: Amo nabwo barenge Hemani na Yedutuni, na abanto baria bachoretwe na korikwa amarieta abo ase okoiraneria Omonene ng’a mbuya mono ase engencho y’obwanchani bwaye obwo bogendererete kare na kare.
english: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, "for his love endures forever."

ekegusii: Akabachika akabatebia, “Genda mwebise, moboere omochie korwa nyuma, timobeera aare, korende mwebeke ang’e koyoumokera.
english: with these orders: "Listen carefully. You are to set an ambush behind the city. Don't go very far from it. All of you be on the alert.

ekegusii: Daudi akaebereria abanto baye ase okobatebia amang’ana ayio, na tabaa ribaga baumokere Saulo. Erio Saulo akaimoka korwa ase rikuruma erio, akagenderera orogendo rwaye.
english: With these words David rebuked his men and did not allow them to attack Saul. And Saul left the cave and went his way.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, nigo tokobasabera botambe, erio Nyasae oito ababare ng’a mwagweneire okorangeria kwaye. Ere aikeranie kera okogania kw’obuya, na kera emeremo y’okwegena, ase okobua kwaye,
english: With this in mind, we constantly pray for you, that our God may count you worthy of his calling, and that by his power he may fulfill every good purpose of yours and every act prompted by your faith.

ekegusii: “Obe omwegenwa, na ase chibesa echio ogore chieri, ne chimingichi, ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi, na okoruegwa kw’endagera, na okw’ebinyugwa bikoruegwa amo nebing’wanso ebio. Orue ebinto ebio ase egesasimero ki’enyomba ya Nyasae oo ere agwo Yerusalemu.
english: With this money be sure to buy bulls, rams and male lambs, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and sacrifice them on the altar of the temple of your God in Jerusalem.

ekegusii: ase abwo bakobwata okobwatana kwaye kw’ogotianania, naende bakoinyora amachiko aye na koyaigwera.
english: with those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his precepts.

english: with three administrators over them, one of whom was Daniel. The satraps were made accountable to them so that the king might not suffer loss.

ekegusii: Sisaki agacha ne chigari elifu eyemo, na amagana abere (1,200), na abariini chibarasi chilifu emerongo etano nomo (60,000). Abanto bachete amo nere korwa Misiri, na Libia, na Suki, na Etiopia, nigo barenge abange batarenge kobareka.
english: With twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen and the innumerable troops of Libyans, Sukkites and Cushites that came with him from Egypt,

ekegusii: Chisiiro chikobibwata chibe emerongo ebere chie chitaai, ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai. Ebigobanio bie chisiiro chiria ne chinuga chiabo chibe chie chifeta.
english: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

ekegusii: Chisiiro chiaye emerongo ebere echiare kobibwata nigo chiarenge ne chinterekerero chiabo emerongo ebere chie chitaai, korende ebigobanio ne chinuga chiabo nigo chiarenge chie chifeta.
english: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases, and with silver hooks and bands on the posts.

ekegusii: Okore chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwatanerigwe. Naboigo oranyare koroisia chibao chionsi chi’Obomenyo.
english: with two projections set parallel to each other. Make all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

ekegusii: Bagakora chintamang’o ibere ase kera ebao, ase chibao echio chirabwateranigwe. Naboigo baroisetie chibao echi chionsi chi’Obomenyo.
english: with two projections set parallel to each other. They made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way.

ekegusii: “Ngento ki ndarentere Omonene, na ntung’ame ase obosio bwa Nyasae ore igoro? Inee! Nigo ndache ase obosio bwaye, ndetane ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa, gose chimori chiakoorire omwaka oyomo?
english: With what shall I come before the LORD and bow down before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

ekegusii: Nigo tware koba tokogamba amo amang’ana amaya ay’ogosemania, naende nigo tware koba togosasima amo ase enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship as we walked with the throng at the house of God.

ekegusii: Bang’etananire bagokwana amang’ana ’obogechi, nigo bakondwania engencho ende etaiyo.
english: With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.

ekegusii: Goetera asore ninsamunyore chibarasi na abanto bachiriinete; ninsamunyore ne chigari na abagochigendia.
english: with you I shatter horse and rider, with you I shatter chariot and driver,

ekegusii: Goetera asore ninsamunyore abasacha na abakungu, ninsamunyore abanto abagotu na abake, ninsamunyore abamura na abaiseke;
english: with you I shatter man and woman, with you I shatter old man and youth, with you I shatter young man and maiden,

ekegusii: goetera asore ninsamunyore abarisia ne riicho riabo, ninsamunyore abaremi ne chiombe chiabo; boigo goetera asore ninsamunyore abagavuna na abachiki.”
english: with you I shatter shepherd and flock, with you I shatter farmer and oxen, with you I shatter governors and officials.

ekegusii: Aye omonyene nigo gwaseretie abanto b’ebisaku nokoboko kwao, korende chisokoro chiaito okabarenta okabasimeka aroro; nigo kwarentete emechando ase abanto b’ebisaku, korende chisokoro chiaito okabamentekania bakaranda.
english: With your hand you drove out the nations and planted our fathers; you crushed the peoples and made our fathers flourish.

ekegusii: Konde amo naye, nigo ndasirie omoganda bw’esegi, na ekero inde na Nyasae one nincharoke chindwaki igoro.”
english: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

ekegusii: Konde amo naye, nigo ndasirie omoganda bw’esegi; na ekero inde na Nyasae one nincharoke chindwaki igoro.
english: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatooretie abanto bao nokoboko kwao koramboire. Abanto abwo nigo barenge ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo na orwa Yusufu.
english: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph. Selah

ekegusii: With your own eyes you saw those great trials, those miraculous signs and great wonders.
english: Boigo mwaroche namaiso aino amaakwa aria amanene, na ebikone, na amakumia amanene;

ekegusii: Rusia okoboko kwao korwa asende, na okogosa kwao tikogenderera konyoboyia.
english: Withdraw your hand far from me, and stop frightening me with your terrors.

ekegusii: Ase orogongo rwa Isakaru na orw’Aseri Manase akaegwa Beti‐Sehani, na Ibileamu, amo nebichie biabo. Naende akaegwa abanto ba Dori, na Eni‐Dori, na Taanaki, na Megido, amo nebichie b’emechie eyio, na Nafati, ensemo ya gatato.
english: Within Issachar and Asher, Manasseh also had Beth Shan, Ibleam and the people of Dor, Endor, Taanach and Megiddo, together with their surrounding settlements (the third in the list is Naphoth).

ekegusii: Ase engaki eyio y’amatuko atato Abayuda bonsi na Ababenjamin bagasangererekana agwo Yerusalemu. Erio nigo riarenge rituko ri’emerongo ebere ri’omotienyi o kianda. Abanto abwo bonsi bagaikaransa ase eraaro isiko, bosio bw’enyomba ya Nyasae, bakaba bakoiguswa ase engencho ye ring’ana riria, naende ekiagera embura yarenge enyinge.
english: Within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin had gathered in Jerusalem. And on the twentieth day of the ninth month, all the people were sitting in the square before the house of God, greatly distressed by the occasion and because of the rain.

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atato Farao nakoimokie, agosunge ase omote igoro ne chinyoni nachirie chinyama chi’omobere oo.”
english: Within three days Pharaoh will lift off your head and hang you on a tree. And the birds will eat away your flesh."

ekegusii: Nyuma y’amatuko atato Farao nakorusie aiga, akoe ogosika, akoiranie ase emeremo yao, na aye nobe gokomoa egekombe koboko kwaye, buna kware komoa agwo ritang’ani, ekero kwarenge omoteneneri bw’ebinyugwa biaye.
english: Within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your position, and you will put Pharaoh's cup in his hand, just as you used to do when you were his cupbearer.

ekegusii: Ekero emiaka ebere etaraera ning’iranie gocha aase aiga ebikorero bionsi bi’enyomba y’Omonene, ebio Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, arusetie aiga, akabiira Babeli.
english: Within two years I will bring back to this place all the articles of the LORD's house that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon removed from here and took to Babylon.

ekegusii: Nyasae, ekero tore ase Hekalu yao ime, nigo tokorengereria igoro y’obwanchani bwao bogendererete botambe.
english: Within your temple, O God, we meditate on your unfailing love.

ekegusii: Timoiroka abwo bakobaengereria ase ing’ana rinde rionsi. Eke nekemanyererio ase ogosira kwabo, korende asemore inwe nekemanyererio ki’ogotooreka. Eke igo gekorwa ase Nyasae.
english: without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a sign to them that they will be destroyed, but that you will be saved-- and that by God.

ekegusii: Erio kegima akabarangeria; barabwo bagatiga Zebedi ise ime ase obwato amo nabanto b’eng’eria, bakamotunyana.
english: Without delay he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed him.

ekegusii: Ere tarenge na ise, gose na ng’ina, gose ne chisokoro chiaye; tarenge nomochakano bw’amatuko aye, gose nomoerio bw’obogima bwaye, korende ogwekanigwe n’Omwana o Nyasae. Igo agendererete koba omokuani o kare na kare.
english: Without father or mother, without genealogy, without beginning of days or end of life, like the Son of God he remains a priest forever.

ekegusii: Ere nigo agosenyenta abare nokobua atari kona‐kouna‐unia, erio abeke abande aase abo.
english: Without inquiry he shatters the mighty and sets up others in their place.

ekegusii: abatancheti abanto bande, abatarigeti kobwatana, abang’achi, abatari gwetanga ase rinde rionsi, abatindi, abagechete ayare amaya,
english: without love, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not lovers of the good,

ekegusii: Omonene oiyeirie inse obomenyo bwonsi bw’abanto ba Yakobo atari namabera, otagoire chiburi chi’ense y’Abayuda, ekero arenge nendamwamu; osiririe oboruoti, na ourire abanene baye amasikani.
english: Without pity the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob; in his wrath he has torn down the strongholds of the Daughter of Judah. He has brought her kingdom and its princes down to the ground in dishonor.

ekegusii: Erio omonto oria akamobeta amaiso, akaba okirete kiri, erinde amanye gose Omonene osesesenirie orogendo rwaye, gose taibo.
english: Without saying a word, the man watched her closely to learn whether or not the LORD had made his journey successful.

ekegusii: Rora, omwaga omonene okaimoka ase enyancha, goika obwato bogatubwa nemerindo; korende ere konya orarire.
english: Without warning, a furious storm came up on the lake, so that the waves swept over the boat. But Jesus was sleeping.

ekegusii: Tabete omworo ase okwegena, ekero aroche ng’a omobere oye obeire ang’e nogokwa, ekiagera konya okoorire emiaka koreng’ana rigana erimo, na enda ya Sara egombaete;
english: Without weakening in his faith, he faced the fact that his body was as good as dead-- since he was about a hundred years old-- and that Sarah's womb was also dead.

ekegusii: Ase chinko chitari, omorero nigo okorima, naboigo nase omogenki atari, eriomana nigo rigosira.
english: Without wood a fire goes out; without gossip a quarrel dies down.

ekegusii: Naboigo, inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino, erinde onye abande bare aroro, abategeneti ring’ana, bang’uswe ase orogendo rw’abakungu babo, batatebiri ring’ana,
english: Wives, in the same way be submissive to your husbands so that, if any of them do not believe the word, they may be won over without words by the behavior of their wives,

ekegusii: Inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino buna mokoigwera Omonene.
english: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.

ekegusii: Inwe abakungu, moigwere abasacha baino, buna egwenerete ase Omonene.
english: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

ekegusii: Woe to him who says to his father, 'What have you begotten?' or to his mother, 'What have you brought to birth?'
english: Obobe nobw’oyio okoboria ise: Inki aye okoibora? Gose koboria ng’ina: Inki eke obogoretie inda yao ogochia koibora?”

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omonto oria ogotebia egento kebaachire korwa ase omote: Boka! Na otebia rigena ritanyare gokwana: Imoka! Inee! Ebinto ebio mbinyare gokworokereria enchera? Rora, ebio nigo bioomire ne chitahabu ne chifeta, korende omoika tori ime yabo.
english: Woe to him who says to wood, 'Come to life!' Or to lifeless stone, 'Wake up!' Can it give guidance? It is covered with gold and silver; there is no breath in it.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaito, ekiagera twasunyuntirwe. Amaote aito tari kogwenigwa. Intwe nigo twarengereretie: Ekeene, eye nemechando, korende goika toremererie.
english: Woe to me because of my injury! My wound is incurable! Yet I said to myself, "This is my sickness, and I must endure it."

ekegusii: Obobe nobwane, ekiagera inde omomenyi agwo Meseki, nigo imenyete ase egati y’Abakedari.
english: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

ekegusii: Obobe nobwao aye ore egutwa y’oboenenu bw’abanto ba Efraimu batindire. Nigo ore buna egesicha giasusanire, obwari bw’obonene bwao bwasirire. Nigo ore ase egetunwa igoro, igoro ye rikura ritobu ri’abwo babuirwe nedivai.
english: Woe to that wreath, the pride of Ephraim's drunkards, to the fading flower, his glorious beauty, set on the head of a fertile valley-- to that city, the pride of those laid low by wine!

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omochie oyio oiteire amanyinga amange, oyio oichire noborimo na obouri, oyio otari gotiga gosakora na koira!
english: Woe to the city of blood, full of lies, full of plunder, never without victims!

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaye omochie oria osaririe na obeire oyo otachenegeti, oyio ochandire abanto baye!
english: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!

ekegusii: Obobe nobw’ense eyio ogoakanigwa gwe chimbaba gokoigweka, ense ere ng’umbu ye chindooche chi’Etiopia,
english: Woe to the land of whirring wings along the rivers of Cush,

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abakori amabe! Amang’ana nabe amabe asebare, ekiagera aya amaboko abo abeire agokora, naro barakorerwe abanyene.
english: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them! They will be paid back for what their hands have done.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo, ekiagera bagendererete ase enchera ya Kaini, na gwetuguta ase ogosaria kwa Baalamu ase engencho y’okonyora eng’eria, na barabwo basirire ase ogotaigwera gwa Kora.
english: Woe to them! They have taken the way of Cain; they have rushed for profit into Balaam's error; they have been destroyed in Korah's rebellion.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwabo, ekiagera batamire korwa asende. Mbasirigwe, ekiagera basaririe asende bantigire. Nanga nabatooria, korende babeire bagokwana oborimo igoro yane.
english: Woe to them, because they have strayed from me! Destruction to them, because they have rebelled against me! I long to redeem them but they speak lies against me.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bare chituoni ase okonywa edivai, naende bare abaremu ase ogwochogania amo ebinyugwa bigotindia,
english: Woe to those who are heroes at drinking wine and champions at mixing drinks,

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bagwekora abang’aini, naende bagwekora abamanyi.
english: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes and clever in their own sight.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakoroka ayare amabe amaya, na ayare amaya amabe, na babeka omosunte ase oborabu bore, na oborabu ase omosunte ore, na babeka obororo ribaga ri’obwansu, na obwansu ribaga ri’obororo.
english: Woe to those who call evil good and good evil, who put darkness for light and light for darkness, who put bitter for sweet and sweet for bitter.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakweng’usera obobe ne chingori chi’obong’ainereria, abwo bakweng’usera ebibe buna ne chingori chie chigari,
english: Woe to those who draw sin along with cords of deceit, and wickedness as with cart ropes,

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bagotirimboka gochia Misiri korigia ogokonywa, abwo basemeretie chibarasi ne chigari, ekiagera chire chinyinge, na abariini chibarasi, ekiagera bare ne chinguru, korende tibari korigia Oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli, gose korigia ogosesenigwa korwa ase Omonene oyio.
english: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in the multitude of their chariots and in the great strength of their horsemen, but do not look to the Holy One of Israel, or seek help from the LORD.

ekegusii: Obobe nobw’abanto abwo bagokora emeroberio yabo erio bayebisa aase aatambe ng’a Omonene tayerora. Abanto abwo nigo bagokora ogokora kwabo ase chinchera chi’omosunte, erio bateba, “Ning’o otoroche? Ning’o otomanyete?”
english: Woe to those who go to great depths to hide their plans from the LORD, who do their work in darkness and think, "Who sees us? Who will know?"

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakobeka amachiko atari aya boronge, na abariki abakona‐korika amang’ana ay’ogokorera abande bobe.
english: Woe to those who make unjust laws, to those who issue oppressive decrees,

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bagokora emeroberio y’ogokora amabe na bayebeka ang’e kobare ase amarere abo; mambia kobwakire baba bakoyaikerania, ekiagera nigo ere ase okobua kw’amaboko abo.
english: Woe to those who plan iniquity, to those who plot evil on their beds! At morning's light they carry it out because it is in their power to do it.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakoimoka mambia chuni, baminyoka gochia konywa ebinyugwa bigotindia, abwo bakogenderera kobeera agwo goika obotuko bokia, erinde edivai eyio yabasamba na kobaonchorana.
english: Woe to those who rise early in the morning to run after their drinks, who stay up late at night till they are inflamed with wine.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaito! Ning’o oratotoorie korwa ase amaboko e chinyasae echio chire nokobua gotoetania?
english: Woe to us! Who will deliver us from the hand of these mighty gods? They are the gods who struck the Egyptians with all kinds of plagues in the desert.

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino inwe, ekero abanto bakobatogia, ekiagera chisokoro chiabo nabo chiakorerete ababani b’oborimo engencho eyio eyio.
english: Woe to you when all men speak well of you, for that is how their fathers treated the false prophets.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bakwementera enyomba ase enyomba, naende bementera oboremo ase oboremo, goika bakoora aase onsi, erinde ng’a barabwo boka bamenye ase ense eyio engima.
english: Woe to you who add house to house and join field to field till no space is left and you live alone in the land.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwabo abwo bamenyete buya agwo Sayoni, na abwo batoererete ase ebitunwa bia Samaria, abwo bare abasike b’egesaku egetang’ani, eki Abaisraeli bagochiera.
english: Woe to you who are complacent in Zion, and to you who feel secure on Mount Samaria, you notable men of the foremost nation, to whom the people of Israel come!

ekegusii: “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamoigotete bono, ekiagera namoche koba nenchara. “Obobe nobwaino inwe abamogoseka bono, ekiagera namoche goichana na korera.
english: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will go hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino inwe abanto momenyete ase enyancha mbarabare inwe egesaku ki’Abakereti! Aye Kanani, ense y’Abafilisti, ring’ana ri’Omonene nigo rire mamincha yao. “Ningosirie goika monto onde tatigara omenyete ime yao.”
english: Woe to you who live by the sea, O Kerethite people; the word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, land of the Philistines. "I will destroy you, and none will be left."

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino inwe abamoganetie rituko ri’Omonene riike! Nase ki moganetie rituko riria ri’Omonene? Rituko erio nigo rirabe eri’omosunte, gose tirikoba eri’omobaso.
english: Woe to you who long for the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? That day will be darkness, not light.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwao aye Arieli, Arieli, omochie ase Daudi arenge gotoora. Omwaka ase omwaka imogenderere korenda Amatuko aino Amanene, na emeyega yaino.
english: Woe to you, Ariel, Ariel, the city where David settled! Add year to year and let your cycle of festivals go on.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino inwe aba mogosiria, ko inwe timwana gosirigwa! Obobe nobwaino inwe abaurereria, ko inwe timwana kourererigwa! Ekero morabe mwakoorire gosiria, nainwe mosirigwe, na ekero morabe mwakoorire kourereria, nainwe mourererigwe.
english: Woe to you, O destroyer, you who have not been destroyed! Woe to you, O traitor, you who have not been betrayed! When you stop destroying, you will be destroyed; when you stop betraying, you will be betrayed.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwao, aye ense, ekero omoruoti oo are omwana, na abagambi bao bakobeera ase emeyega y’okwegokia ase chingaki chia mambia.
english: Woe to you, O land whose king was a servant and whose princes feast in the morning.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe abanto ba Moabu! Abanto bagosasima Kemosi basirigwe. Abana baino abamura boosirwe, na abaiseke baino bairirwe obosomba.
english: Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh are destroyed; your sons are taken into exile and your daughters into captivity.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe Abamoabu! Mwasirigwe, inwe abamogesasima Kemosi! Nere otigire abana baino abamura bagotama, bakorigia aase bakwebisa, na abana baino abaiseke boosirwe, barabwo bairirwe ase Sihoni, omoruoti bw’Abaamori.
english: Woe to you, O Moab! You are destroyed, O people of Chemosh! He has given up his sons as fugitives and his daughters as captives to Sihon king of the Amorites.

ekegusii: Abakungu baito bare Sayoni bakoreirwe amabe, boigo nabaiseke abekungi abare ase emechi y’Abayuda.
english: Women have been ravished in Zion, and virgins in the towns of Judah.

ekegusii: Abakungu bakanyora naende abakwete babo ase okobokigwa. Abande bagaitwa bobe goika bagakwa, tibancha gosiborwa, erinde banyore okobokigwa okore okuya kobua.
english: Women received back their dead, raised to life again. Others were tortured and refused to be released, so that they might gain a better resurrection.

ekegusii: abakungu bakire ase chikanisa. Naki tibari ne ribaga ri’ogokwana, korende baigwere buna amachiko agoteba.
english: women should remain silent in the churches. They are not allowed to speak, but must be in submission, as the Law says.

ekegusii: Inee! Zadoki na Abiatari abakuani tibakari aroro? Gaki ing’ana rinde rionsi oraigwe ase enyomba y’omoruoti oribatebie.
english: Won't the priests Zadok and Abiathar be there with you? Tell them anything you hear in the king's palace.

ekegusii: Amaicho abo, na enibo yabo, na etugo yabo yonsi, Inee, tibikoba ebiaito? Tiga twancherane nabarabwo rioka, bamenye aa seito.”
english: Won't their livestock, their property and all their other animals become ours? So let us give our consent to them, and they will settle among us."

ekegusii: Saulo agatebigwa ng’a Daudi nigo amenyete Nayoti aria Rama.
english: Word came to Saul: "David is in Naioth at Ramah";

ekegusii: Amang’ana akorua ase omonto omong’aini nigo akogera bwanchwa, korende aya akorua ase ebikoba bi’omoriri nigo akomosiria.
english: Words from a wise man's mouth are gracious, but a fool is consumed by his own lips.

ekegusii: Mosasime Omonene mweboetie obochenu! Inwe abanto b’ense yonsi, mobe mokoiguswa ase obosio bwaye.
english: Worship the LORD in the splendor of his holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.

ekegusii: Mokorere Omonene more nomogoko, moche ase obosio bwaye na komoterera amatera ’omochengo!
english: Worship the LORD with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.

ekegusii: Momokorere Omonene Nyasae oino, na inche ninsesenie endagera yaino na amache aino, nindusie amarwaire asemore.
english: Worship the LORD your God, and his blessing will be on your food and water. I will take away sickness from among you,

ekegusii: Would he argue with useless words, with speeches that have no value?
english: Inee! Nemogwenerete koamererania ne chinkwana chitari nengencho, gose amang’ana atari korenta buya bonde?

ekegusii: Inee! Takomotebia: Ebeke ang’e, ondoiserie endagera goika indie inywe, na nyuma yaye, naye orie na konywa?
english: Would he not rather say, 'Prepare my supper, get yourself ready and wait on me while I eat and drink; after that you may eat and drink'?

ekegusii: Inee! Nyasae nkoamererania arenge nainche ase okobua kwaye kore okonene? Yaya, nigo arenge gontegerera.
english: Would he oppose me with great power? No, he would not press charges against me.

ekegusii: Would he thank the servant because he did what he was told to do?
english: Gose nkomotebia are omosomba oria ng’a mbuya mono, ekiagera akora eki achikwa?

ekegusii: Inee! Amang’ana nabe amaya asemore Omonene karabarenge abamanye buna more? Gose mokagete ng’a nigo moramong’aine buna abanto bakong’ainana?
english: Would it turn out well if he examined you? Could you deceive him as you might deceive men?

ekegusii: Inee, Nyasae tari komanya amang’ana ayio? Ere nigo amanyete obobisi bwonsi bore ime ase enkoro.
english: would not God have discovered it, since he knows the secrets of the heart?

ekegusii: Inee! Obonene bwaye tibokoboboyia, na okogosa kwaye kobaondokie?
english: Would not his splendor terrify you? Would not the dread of him fall on you?

ekegusii: Inee! Ntonyare konyenya ching’ondi gose chiombe chiisaine abanto aba baegwe barie baigote? Gose ne chinswe chionsi chia nyancha chirasangererigwe, erinde chibaisane?”
english: Would they have enough if flocks and herds were slaughtered for them? Would they have enough if all the fish in the sea were caught for them?"

ekegusii: Inee, nkoganya mware goika bakine? Gose ngwetanga mware timonyuomwa nabasacha bande? Taibo, abana baane. Omonene ong’onchokeire na kong’a emechando, nainche nabechandeire mono.”
english: would you wait until they grew up? Would you remain unmarried for them? No, my daughters. It is more bitter for me than for you, because the LORD's hand has gone out against me!"

ekegusii: Inee! Obotenenku bwao mbonyare kogotanga korwa ase emechando? Gose okobua kwao ne chinguru chiao mbinyare?
english: Would your wealth or even all your mighty efforts sustain you so you would not be in distress?

ekegusii: Ogoakwa gokorwa ase omosani nigo kore okw’obwegenwa, korende okonyunyunta kw’omobisa nigo kore okw’obong’ainereria.
english: Wounds from a friend can be trusted, but an enemy multiplies kisses.

ekegusii: Erio morike ase amagena ayio amang’ana onsi ay’ogochika oko. Ekero morabe mwambokire gochia ng’umbu na gosoa ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa, ense eria entenenku ere namabeere na amooke, buna Omonene, Nyasae bwe chisokoro chiaino, abarierete eira ng’a nabayee,
english: Write on them all the words of this law when you have crossed over to enter the land the LORD your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, promised you.

ekegusii: Moyarike ase emetobwa na ase emeriibo y’ebisieri bie chinyomba chiaino, na ase ebiita biaino.
english: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates,

ekegusii: Moyarike ase emetobwa na emeriibo y’ebisieri bie chinyomba chiaino, na ase ebiita biaino.
english: Write them on the doorframes of your houses and on your gates.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Sayoni, bina moigwe obororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore; korwa bono karue ase omochie, momenye ase chinsana. Mogende Babeli, na aroro motoorigwe. Aroro agwo Omonene nabatoorie korwa ase amaboko ’ababisa baino.
english: Writhe in agony, O Daughter of Zion, like a woman in labor, for now you must leave the city to camp in the open field. You will go to Babylon; there you will be rescued. There the LORD will redeem you out of the hand of your enemies.

ekegusii: Kera omwaka omonto oyio nigo arenge gotiira korwa ase omochie oye, ogenda gosasima na korua ebing’wanso ase Omonene bw’Emeganda agwo Silo. Aroro agwo Ofini na Finehasi, abamura babere ba Eli, nigo barenge abakuani b’Omonene.
english: Year after year this man went up from his town to worship and sacrifice to the LORD Almighty at Shiloh, where Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were priests of the LORD.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaba okorenta ebiegwa biaye: ebinto bie chifeta na ebie chitahabu, ne chianga, na ebirwanero, na ebinsari, amo ne chibarasi ne chiyombo. Naboigo ekaba omwaka ase omwaka.
english: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift-- articles of silver and gold, and robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.

ekegusii: Kera oyomo obo akaba okorenta ebiegwa biaye, ebinto bie chifeta, na ebie chitahabu, ne chianga, na ebirwanero, na ebinsari, ne chibarasi, ne chiyombo, ebinto ebinge mono, omwaka ase omwaka.
english: Year after year, everyone who came brought a gift-- articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons and spices, and horses and mules.

ekegusii: “Ee, inche ninche Nyasae; nigo ngendererete koba oyio oyio. Omonto tari oranyare gotooria omonto onde korwa ase okoboko kwane, nigo ngokora emeremo, na onde tari oranyare koyetanga.”
english: Yes, and from ancient days I am he. No one can deliver out of my hand. When I act, who can reverse it?"

ekegusii: Ee, naye bo, omosaiga bw’ekeene, nakoboririe okonye abakungu abwo bakorete emeremo y’enchili amo nainche, na Klementi nere, na baria bande bakorete emeremo amo nainche, abwo amarieta abo are ime ase ebuku y’obogima.
english: Yes, and I ask you, loyal yokefellow, help these women who have contended at my side in the cause of the gospel, along with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

ekegusii: Yes, Father, for this was your good pleasure.
english: Ee, Tata, oko nakwo kwarenge ogwancha kwao okuya.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, intwe nigo tokoganyete kogocha konacha ebina biao; okona‐koinyora erieta riao nakwo kore okogania kw’emioyo yaito.
english: Yes, LORD, walking in the way of your laws, we wait for you; your name and renown are the desire of our hearts.

ekegusii: ee, aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda agoteba: Rora, abwo nkobatomera nde esegi, na enchara, na oborwaire bogoita. Nimbakore babe buna amako are amabe mono atanyare koriegwa.
english: yes, this is what the LORD Almighty says: "I will send the sword, famine and plague against them and I will make them like poor figs that are so bad they cannot be eaten.

ekegusii: “Aya naro Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba igoro y’ebikorero biria biatigarete ase enyomba y’Omonene, na ase enyomba y’omoruoti bw’Abayuda na ase Yerusalemu:
english: yes, this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says about the things that are left in the house of the LORD and in the palace of the king of Judah and in Jerusalem:

ekegusii: Aya naro Omonene bw’Emeganda, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba: Timobaisa kong’ainwa nababani baino, na abaringoria baino, abwo bare ase egati yaino, gose timobaisa korengereria igoro ye chindoto chiaino mokorota.
english: Yes, this is what the LORD Almighty, the God of Israel, says: "Do not let the prophets and diviners among you deceive you. Do not listen to the dreams you encourage them to have.

ekegusii: Boigo inche nigo inde mamincha y’ababani abwo bagokwana amang’ana abo abanyene na goteba ng’a Omonene otebire bo.
english: Yes," declares the LORD, "I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and yet declare, 'The LORD declares.'

ekegusii: Omonene otebire iga: Ekeene, buna rituko ria igoro narora amanyinga a Naboti na ay’abana baye agoiterwa, ningoakanie egesiomba aiga ase oboremo obo. Ase ayio bono, moimokie momotugute ase omogondo oria buna Omonene atebete.”
english: 'Yesterday I saw the blood of Naboth and the blood of his sons, declares the LORD, and I will surely make you pay for it on this plot of ground, declares the LORD.' Now then, pick him up and throw him on that plot, in accordance with the word of the LORD."

ekegusii: Korende ensa neche, na bono nere, ekero abasasimi b’ekeene barasasime Tata ase omoika na ekeene, ekiagera Tata nigo akorigia abanto buna abwo bamosasime.
english: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks.

ekegusii: Korende abange nonya nabanene bakamwegena, korende ase engencho y’Abafarisai tibamoorogetie, tibacha korusigwa ase esinagogi,
english: Yet at the same time many even among the leaders believed in him. But because of the Pharisees they would not confess their faith for fear they would be put out of the synagogue;

ekegusii: nonya naboigo, ekero embura eratwe, nigo keraseboke na gosokia ebisebo buna ekemeri ekeyia.
english: yet at the scent of water it will bud and put forth shoots like a plant.

ekegusii: Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!
english: Ekiagera inche ngokwana ekeene, timori konyegena.

ekegusii: Korende ekiagera are na kemocho ase omobere oye, tagoika ang’e netoto enachete Obomenyo Obochenu, gose tagocha aike ang’e negesasimero. Aise goika ang’e, nigo aragere Obomenyo bwane Obochenu bobe botachenegeti. Inche ninche Omonene, ninche nkobachena.”
english: yet because of his defect, he must not go near the curtain or approach the altar, and so desecrate my sanctuary. I am the LORD, who makes them holy. '"

ekegusii: Korende abakori amabe tibakonyora amaya ayio, gose obogima bwabo tibokoba obotambe. Nigo banga buna omorengari ogoeta, ekiagera tibamoirogete Nyasae.
english: Yet because the wicked do not fear God, it will not go well with them, and their days will not lengthen like a shadow.

ekegusii: korende ekiagera omoboraka oyo andosirie, nimogambere boronge, tacha kondosia ase ogonchichera botambe.”
english: yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will see that she gets justice, so that she won't eventually wear me out with her coming!'"

ekegusii: Timomobara buna omobisa, korende momokurere buna oyomino.
english: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but warn him as a brother.

ekegusii: na Elija tatometwe ase oyomo obo, otatiga ase omokungu oyorenge omoboraka agwo Sarepata, ase ense ya Sidoni.
english: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to a widow in Zarephath in the region of Sidon.

ekegusii: Abamalaika, nonya bare abanene kobua ase chinguru na okobua, tibakorenta ekina gi’okorama barabwo ase obosio bw’Omonene.
english: yet even angels, although they are stronger and more powerful, do not bring slanderous accusations against such beings in the presence of the Lord.

ekegusii: Nonya nabo oborori bwabo tibwabwatana.
english: Yet even then their testimony did not agree.

ekegusii: korende asetore intwe Nyasae noyomo bweka, oyore Tata, na ebinto bionsi nigo bikorwa asare, na intwe nigo tore moyo asare. Naende nareo Omonene oyomo, nere Yeso Kristo, na ebinto bionsi nere obitongete, naboigo naintwe nere ototongete.
english: yet for us there is but one God, the Father, from whom all things came and for whom we live; and there is but one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom all things came and through whom we live.

ekegusii: Korende ase engencho yao nigo togoitwa omobaso boira, nigo tokobarwa buna ching’ondi chikonyenywa.
english: Yet for your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, Nyasae one, koranche oigwe ogosaba kwane inche omosomba oo, na okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo, na oigwe ekerero na ogosaba oko inche omosomba oo nkogosaba bono iga.
english: Yet give attention to your servant's prayer and his plea for mercy, O LORD my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence this day.

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene, Nyasae one, koranche oigwe ogosaba kwane, inche omosomba oo, na okoboria kwane kw’oboitongo; oigwe ekerero na ogosaba oko inche, omosomba oo, nkogosaba.
english: Yet give attention to your servant's prayer and his plea for mercy, O LORD my God. Hear the cry and the prayer that your servant is praying in your presence.

ekegusii: Naama! Nyasae onyorire amasoero asende, na ombarire ng’a nomobisa oye inde.
english: Yet God has found fault with me; he considers me his enemy.

ekegusii: Ekero Hamani amanyete ng’a Moredekai n’Omoyahudi orenge, akarora ng’a tari Moredekai bweka araite, korende aite na Abayahudi bonsi abarenge ase oboruoti bw’Ahaswero, ekiagera barenge ab’egesaku ekemo na Moredekai.
english: Yet having learned who Mordecai's people were, he scorned the idea of killing only Mordecai. Instead Haman looked for a way to destroy all Mordecai's people, the Jews, throughout the whole kingdom of Xerxes.

ekegusii: Korende taitete abana b’abaiti baria. Agakora koreng’ana namang’ana arikire ase Ebuku y’Amachiko a Musa ase Omonene achigete: “Abaibori tibagoitwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abana babo, gose abana tibagoitwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abaibori babo; korende kera omonto nigo arakwe ase ebibe biaye omonyene.”
english: Yet he did not put the sons of the assassins to death, in accordance with what is written in the Book of the Law of Moses where the LORD commanded: "Fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sins."

ekegusii: Korende taitete abana b’abasomba baria. Agakora koreng’ana namang’ana arikire ase ebuku y’amachiko a Musa agwo ase Omonene achigete, “Abaibori tibagoitwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abana babo, gose abana tibagoitwa ase engencho y’ebibe bi’abaibori babo, korende kera omonto nigo arakwe ase engencho y’ebibe biaye omonyene.”
english: Yet he did not put their sons to death, but acted in accordance with what is written in the Law, in the Book of Moses, where the LORD commanded: "Fathers shall not be put to death for their children, nor children put to death for their fathers; each is to die for his own sins."

ekegusii: gose tabete na tang’u‐tang’u chinde ase eira eria ya Nyasae ase ogotegena, korende nigo abegetwe chinguru ase okwegena kwaye, akamotogia Nyasae.
english: Yet he did not waver through unbelief regarding the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,

ekegusii: Korende nonya nabo, ere nigo achigete igoro, akaigora ebisieri bi’aroro;
english: Yet he gave a command to the skies above and opened the doors of the heavens;

ekegusii: korende ere omonyene tetigete atari na birori. Ere nigo are gokora amaya na kobaa embura korwa igoro, ne chingaki chie rigesa, agaisanekia chinkoro chiaino nendagera na omogoko.”
english: Yet he has not left himself without testimony: He has shown kindness by giving you rain from heaven and crops in their seasons; he provides you with plenty of food and fills your hearts with joy."

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Omonene akabatooria ase engencho y’erieta riaye, ng’a anyare komanyekania okobua kwaye okonene.
english: Yet he saved them for his name's sake, to make his mighty power known.

ekegusii: Ere nigo are omong’aini na nigo akorenta obobe gose tari koonchora amang’ana aye. Nae eamate y’abakori amabe egesusuro, boigo nae abakonyi b’abagokora amabe egesusuro.
english: Yet he too is wise and can bring disaster; he does not take back his words. He will rise up against the house of the wicked, against those who help evildoers.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo arenge namabera, akaba okwabera ebibe biabo tabasiria; ase chingaki chinyinge nigo arenge gotanga endamwamu yaye, gose tarenge gotiga ekeririanda kiaye gioke mono.
english: Yet he was merciful; he forgave their iniquities and did not destroy them. Time after time he restrained his anger and did not stir up his full wrath.

ekegusii: Ebikonyorekana korwa ase oboonchoreria bwaye, na ebitoki bi’ogokora kwaye kw’obonyaka mbiatananwe ase Omonene, tibigosangererigwa na kogachwa. Ebio banyorire ase oboonchoreria nigo biranyorere abanto abwo bamenyete ase obosio bw’Omonene endagera eisaine, ne chianga chingiya chikobekwa.
english: Yet her profit and her earnings will be set apart for the LORD; they will not be stored up or hoarded. Her profits will go to those who live before the LORD, for abundant food and fine clothes.

ekegusii: endagera eyio nigo erarore se ase enda yaye, ebe buna obosongo bw’eng’iti engenda inse ime yaye.
english: yet his food will turn sour in his stomach; it will become the venom of serpents within him.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, inche nigo ngendererete kobeera asore botambe, aye nigo obwatete okoboko kwane gw’okorio.
english: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.

ekegusii: ere tantigete ase omosunte nsire, nonya noria ekerima otubete obosio bwane.”
english: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness, by the thick darkness that covers my face.

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa; aye Nyasae, inchuo bwango onkonye! Aye naye Omokonyi one, na Omotooria one. Aye Omonene, totebana!
english: Yet I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.

ekegusii: Inche nigo inde omotaka na omoremerwa, korende Omonene nigo akonyechandera. Naye ore ogokonywa kwane, na ogotooreka kwane. Aye Nyasae one, totebana!
english: Yet I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

ekegusii: Naende nkobarikera nde ogochika okoyia, okore ogw’ekeene ime yaye, na ime yaino, ekiagera omosunte ngoeta ore, na omobaso bw’ekeene oikire kobara.
english: Yet I am writing you a new command; its truth is seen in him and you, because the darkness is passing and the true light is already shining.

ekegusii: Korende ase engencho y’obwanchani nanchire kobua kogosorora, buna inche Paulo inde omogaaka bono, naende inde omosibwa o Kristo Yeso.
english: yet I appeal to you on the basis of love. I then, as Paul-- an old man and now also a prisoner of Christ Jesus--

ekegusii: Korende ninde ne ring’ana eri igoro asore: Gwatigire obwanchani bwao bwe ritang’ani.
english: Yet I hold this against you: You have forsaken your first love.

ekegusii: “Nonya naboigo nkabarorera amabera, gose tinabasiretie kegima agwo ase erooro.
english: Yet I looked on them with pity and did not destroy them or put an end to them in the desert.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, nintigare nabanto chilifu isano na ibere b’Abaisraeli bonsi, baria batabegete amaru abo inse ase ogosasima Baali, gose koyenyunyunta.”
english: Yet I reserve seven thousand in Israel-- all whose knees have not bowed down to Baal and all whose mouths have not kissed him."

ekegusii: korende nabatebirie, nonya n’Sulemani ase obonene bwaye bwonsi tabegete chianga buna ekemo ki’ebi.
english: Yet I tell you that not even Solomon in all his splendor was dressed like one of these.

ekegusii: Inche Omonene nindete emechando asore Arieli, okorera na okweumia mbibe ime yao, na aye omochie nobe asende Arieli bori.
english: Yet I will besiege Ariel; she will mourn and lament, she will be to me like an altar hearth.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, tinkorusia oboruoti bwonsi korwa ase omwana oo, nimoe egesaku ekemo, ase engencho ya Daudi, omosomba one, naende ase engencho ya Yerusalemu, omochie oria nachorete.”
english: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom from him, but will give him one tribe for the sake of David my servant and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen."

ekegusii: Korende nimbabeke babe abarendi be Hekalu, babe bagokora emeremo ende yonsi eganeirie aroro.
english: Yet I will put them in charge of the duties of the temple and all the work that is to be done in it.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo ningokere Omonene, ninchengere Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwane.
english: yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will be joyful in God my Savior.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo ning’inyore okobwatana kw’ogotianania nakorete naye ase amatuko aria ay’obobe bwao, ninkore naye okobwatana kw’ogotianania koragenderere goika kare na kare.
english: Yet I will remember the covenant I made with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

ekegusii: Korende nindorere Abayuda amabera. Inche Omonene, Nyasae obo, nimbatoorie ne chinguru chiane, gose tari ase okorwana namata, gose nemioro, gose ne chibarasi chi’esegi, gose nabariini be chibarasi.”
english: Yet I will show love to the house of Judah; and I will save them-- not by bow, sword or battle, or by horses and horsemen, but by the LORD their God."

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo omoibi oria kanyorirwe, goika airanie ara gatano na kabere; nigo araakane ebinto bionsi abwate nyomba mwaye.
english: Yet if he is caught, he must pay sevenfold, though it costs him all the wealth of his house.

ekegusii: Korende onye mokogenderera gokora ebibe, rirorio nigo morasirigwe amo nomoruoti oino.”
english: Yet if you persist in doing evil, both you and your king will be swept away."

ekegusii: Korende Yerusalemu okorire ebibe kobua abanto b’ebisaku na bwangire koigwera amachiko aane, naende okorire ebibe kobua chinse echio chiyoetanaine, ekiagera bwangire koigwera aya nachigete, gose kobwatia emeroberio yane echikire.”
english: Yet in her wickedness she has rebelled against my laws and decrees more than the nations and countries around her. She has rejected my laws and has not followed my decrees.

ekegusii: Korende nonya nabo ase engaki eyio ekero bagendererete komenya ase ense eria y’ababisa babo, inche tinkobaanga gose kobatiga, na tinkobaseria. Tingotiga okobwatana kwane kw’ogotianania nakorete nabarabwo, ekiagera ninche Omonene, Nyasae obo.
english: Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them or abhor them so as to destroy them completely, breaking my covenant with them. I am the LORD their God.

ekegusii: Abaisraeli tibasambete emechie eyio yaagachetwe ase ebigoro igoro, otatiga Hazori bwoka, noro Yoshua asambete.
english: Yet Israel did not burn any of the cities built on their mounds-- except Hazor, which Joshua burned.

ekegusii: korende nigo agosangereria chindagera chiabo ekero chikonyorekana, achigacha goika ekero ki’eguru‐gura.
english: yet it stores its provisions in summer and gathers its food at harvest.

ekegusii: Korende mwakorete buya mokabwatana nainche ase emechando yane.
english: Yet it was good of you to share in my troubles.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo Nyasae konya oichoirie chinyomba chiabo nebinto ebiya. Ogosemia kw’abakori amabe tiga kobe aare nainche.
english: Yet it was he who filled their houses with good things, so I stand aloof from the counsel of the wicked.

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo anchete komokobora, akamokora akaba omorwaire; ekero arabe orure obogima bwaye bobe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, nario ararore oroiboro rwaye na abe moyo amatuko amange; ogwancha kwa Nyasae ngokoreke goetera ase amaboko aye.
english: Yet it was the LORD's will to crush him and cause him to suffer, and though the LORD makes his life a guilt offering, he will see his offspring and prolong his days, and the will of the LORD will prosper in his hand.

ekegusii: Korende Yehu tarendete na kobwata amachiko ’Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, nenkoro yaye yonsi. Tatigete gokora ebibe biria Yeroboamu akorete, akagera Abaisraeli bagakora ebibe.
english: Yet Jehu was not careful to keep the law of the LORD, the God of Israel, with all his heart. He did not turn away from the sins of Jeroboam, which he had caused Israel to commit.

ekegusii: Korende Yeroboamu, mosinto o Nebati, omosomba o Sulemani, mosinto o Daudi, akarega omonene oye omoruoti, akaanga komoigwera.
english: Yet Jeroboam son of Nebat, an official of Solomon son of David, rebelled against his master.

ekegusii: korende mwanyabanto nigo akoiborwa ase okonyora emechando, buna chinsase chi’omorero chigotaroka gochia igoro.”
english: Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward.

ekegusii: nonya tindakora bobe bonde namaboko aane, na ogosaba kwane kore ogoikeranu.
english: yet my hands have been free of violence and my prayer is pure.

ekegusii: Korende abanto baane banyebire, basambire ubani ase emegwekano bagosasima. Ase ayio bagochirwe na kogwa ase chinchera chiabo, ekiagera batigire goeta ase chinchera chia kare, baetire ase ebinchera gose tari ase enchera enene.
english: Yet my people have forgotten me; they burn incense to worthless idols, which made them stumble in their ways and in the ancient paths. They made them walk in bypaths and on roads not built up.

ekegusii: Korende Tito oyorenge amo nainche, nonya orenge Omogiriki, tabetereretigwe kwarokigwa.
english: Yet not even Titus, who was with me, was compelled to be circumcised, even though he was a Greek.

ekegusii: Bono nagokire, tari ekiagera mwaichanetigwe, korende ekiagera mwaichanetigwe goika mokaonchoka, ekiagera nigo mwaichanetigwe ase ogwancha kwa Nyasae, erinde timonyara gosira ase ogokora gwaito.
english: yet now I am happy, not because you were made sorry, but because your sorrow led you to repentance. For you became sorrowful as God intended and so were not harmed in any way by us.

ekegusii: Enkoro ya Farao nigo yarenge enkong’u, na buna Omonene atebete, taigwera Musa na Haroni.
english: Yet Pharaoh's heart became hard and he would not listen to them, just as the LORD had said.

ekegusii: Korende Saulo akagenderera komenteka koba ne chinguru, agatantania Abayahudi abamenyete Damesiki, ase okoorokia ekeene ng’a Yeso nere Kristo.
english: Yet Saul grew more and more powerful and baffled the Jews living in Damascus by proving that Jesus is the Christ.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo akagenderera gokora obonyaka bwaye maiso marore; akaba okoinyora amatuko ’oboiseke bwaye, ekero arenge gokora obonyaka ase ense ya Misiri.
english: Yet she became more and more promiscuous as she recalled the days of her youth, when she was a prostitute in Egypt.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, abanto b’omochie oyio nigo bairetwe ase obosomba. Abana baye nigo basenyenteretwe agwo ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi. Abanto baye abasike nigo baakeretwe obomera, na abanto baye abanene bagasibwa nebinyuri.
english: Yet she was taken captive and went into exile. Her infants were dashed to pieces at the head of every street. Lots were cast for her nobles, and all her great men were put in chains.

ekegusii: Ee, abanto abake mono mbatigareo, banga buna ekero omote bw’emezeituni okonyegerigwa, amazeituni abere, gose atato, atigare ase omote igoro, na ane, gose atano, atigare ase chinsagia. Nabo Omonene, Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, agoteba.”
english: Yet some gleanings will remain, as when an olive tree is beaten, leaving two or three olives on the topmost branches, four or five on the fruitful boughs," declares the LORD, the God of Israel.

ekegusii: Korende Abaisraeli nigo bagoteba: Enchera y’Omonene teri endonge. Inwe Abaisraeli, chinchera chiane nachio chitari chindonge? Inee! Chinchera chiaino tari chirochio chitari chindonge?
english: Yet the house of Israel says, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' Are my ways unjust, O house of Israel? Is it not your ways that are unjust?

ekegusii: Ase ayio Omonene nigo aganyete ng’a anyare kobakorera amaya; na ase ayio, neimokererie igoro mono goika abe okobarorera amabera, ekiagera Omonene nigo are Nyasae bw’oboronge. Mbasesenirie abanto bonsi abamoganyete.
english: Yet the LORD longs to be gracious to you; he rises to show you compassion. For the LORD is a God of justice. Blessed are all who wait for him!

ekegusii: Korende Omonene nigo ang’usegete ne chisokoro chiaino na gochiancha, na nyuma yabo akabachora inwe, ororeria rwabo, ase egati y’ebisaku binde. Naboigo more abaye goika rero iga.
english: Yet the LORD set his affection on your forefathers and loved them, and he chose you, their descendants, above all the nations, as it is today.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Manase tibanyarete goseria Abakanani b’emechie eyio. Ase igo Abakanani bakagenderera komenya ase ense eria.
english: Yet the Manassites were not able to occupy these towns, for the Canaanites were determined to live in that region.

ekegusii: Korende chinkuma chiaye chikamenteka gokuma. Emeganda emenge egasangererekana gocha komoigwa, na kogwenigwa amarwaire abo.
english: Yet the news about him spread all the more, so that crowds of people came to hear him and to be healed of their sicknesses.

ekegusii: Korende omobooria obo nigo are ne chinguru. Omonene bw’Emeganda nario erieta riaye. Ekeene, ere nabarwanerere, erinde arente obotoereru na omotimoko ase ense, korende narente omorero ase abanto bamenyete Babeli.
english: Yet their Redeemer is strong; the LORD Almighty is his name. He will vigorously defend their cause so that he may bring rest to their land, but unrest to those who live in Babylon.

ekegusii: Korende mbare abande ase egati yaino bategeneti.” Naki Yeso amanyete korwa omochakano mbarabi abategeneti, naende ning’o orache komorua.
english: Yet there are some of you who do not believe." For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray him.

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo mbatigare abanto bande bare moyo, amo nabana babo, abamura na abaiseke. Abwo mbasoke korwao bache asemore. Ekero barache, morigererie orogendo rwabo, na ogokora kwabo. Erio nario moraisaneke ng’a egesusuro ekio naruete igoro ya Yerusalemu, na aya onsi nayokorerete ase engencho y’ebibe biaye nay’oboronge.
english: Yet there will be some survivors-- sons and daughters who will be brought out of it. They will come to you, and when you see their conduct and their actions, you will be consoled regarding the disaster I have brought upon Jerusalem-- every disaster I have brought upon it.

ekegusii: Korende abanto aba nigo bakorama ase amang’ana onsi batamanyeti, na ase amang’ana bamanyete botambe koreng’ana buna ching’iti chitari nobong’aini chimanyete; ase aro besaria abanyene.
english: Yet these men speak abusively against whatever they do not understand; and what things they do understand by instinct, like unreasoning animals-- these are the very things that destroy them.

ekegusii: Abanto aba nigo bakorete amaya asetore, titwanyoretwe na bobe bonde. Ekero twarenge amo nabarabwo gotaara ase ebitii titwaiberetwe gento kende gionsi.
english: Yet these men were very good to us. They did not mistreat us, and the whole time we were out in the fields near them nothing was missing.

ekegusii: na barabwo tibanyora eki bagokora, ekiagera abanto bonsi bamotegererete.
english: Yet they could not find any way to do it, because all the people hung on his words.

ekegusii: Korende barabwo nigo baangete tibaigwerete gose gotegerera; nigo barenge abanyabigoti bikong’u ng’a tibabaisa koigwa na gwancha amorokererio.
english: Yet they did not listen or pay attention; they were stiff-necked and would not listen or respond to discipline.

ekegusii: Korende abanto abwo nigo basaretie ase Omonene, bagaichania Omoika oye Omochenu. Ase ayio Omonene akaonchoka, akaba omobisa obo, ere omonyene akabarwania.
english: Yet they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. So he turned and became their enemy and he himself fought against them.

ekegusii: “Abwo nigo bagotebia Nyasae: Karue aa asetore! Titoganeti komanya chinchera chiao.
english: Yet they say to God, 'Leave us alone! We have no desire to know your ways.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, tibaigwerete abagambi baria. Abaisraeli tibabete abegenwa ase Omonene, korende bakaba bagosasima chinyasae chinde ching’ao. Bwango bagatiga enchera eria chisokoro chiabo chiabwatetie, enchera y’okoigwera amachiko ’Omonene.
english: Yet they would not listen to their judges but prostituted themselves to other gods and worshiped them. Unlike their fathers, they quickly turned from the way in which their fathers had walked, the way of obedience to the LORD's commands.

ekegusii: Korende amang’ana aya nigo nkoyainyora ase omoyo one, ase ayio ninde nogosemeria.
english: Yet this I call to mind and therefore I have hope:

ekegusii: “Korende aya naro Omonene Nyasae agoteba: Ayio tagokorekana, gose tagoikeranigwa,
english: Yet this is what the Sovereign LORD says: "'It will not take place, it will not happen,

ekegusii: Korende bonsi abamwanchete, akabaa okobua babe abana ba Nyasae, nabwo bariegenire erieta riaye.
english: Yet to all who received him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God--

ekegusii: Ekero achia koigwa ng’a nomorwaire, agatebana amatuko abere aase aria arenge.
english: Yet when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days.

ekegusii: Korende ekero nasemeretie konyora amaya, amabe agacha, na ekero nabete nsemeretie konyora oborabu, omosunte ogacha.
english: Yet when I hoped for good, evil came; when I looked for light, then came darkness.

ekegusii: Naki onye nkorandia enchili, tindi neri ingwetogeria, ekiagera okobetererigwa kwabekirwe asende. Obobe nobwane ntarandeti enchili!
english: Yet when I preach the gospel, I cannot boast, for I am compelled to preach. Woe to me if I do not preach the gospel!

ekegusii: Nyuma y’ayio nkarengereria igoro y’emeremo eyio nakorete namaboko aane, na buna nayiechanderete. Naama! Ayio onsi nigo arenge bosa, na aya naminyokerete konyora nigo are buna embeo bosa, gose bitoki binde tibiri konyorekana inse y’erioba.
english: Yet when I surveyed all that my hands had done and what I had toiled to achieve, everything was meaningless, a chasing after the wind; nothing was gained under the sun.

ekegusii: korende koyasimekirwe, ekiina, eba enene kobua emete yonsi ye chinyeni, ekoba ne chinsagia chinene; goika chinyoni chia igoro chinyare gokenderera ase ekiriri kiaye.”
english: Yet when planted, it grows and becomes the largest of all garden plants, with such big branches that the birds of the air can perch in its shade."

ekegusii: Ekero ekoimokerera igoro, egwesamunsa eminyoke, nigo egosekerera ebarasi na oyo oyeriinete.
english: Yet when she spreads her feathers to run, she laughs at horse and rider.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto abwo barwarete nigo neboyetie eanga y’okweumia na goichana; ngechanda ase okweng’ata, ngasaba nturegete omotwe.
english: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. When my prayers returned to me unanswered,

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, aye nigo ore omochenu; aye obwate obonene, Abaisraeli nkogotogia bare.
english: Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One; you are the praise of Israel.

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nigo ore ang’e, na amachiko ao onsi nigo are ay’ekeene.
english: Yet you are near, O LORD, and all your commands are true.

ekegusii: Naende gokoboria ng’a mbuya ki oboronge bokogokorera kobua ogokora ebibe?
english: Yet you ask him, 'What profit is it to me, and what do I gain by not sinning?'

ekegusii: Omonene, naye kwandusetie ase enda ya baba; naye kwabete gokondenda buya ase amaboko a baba.
english: Yet you brought me out of the womb; you made me trust in you even at my mother's breast.

ekegusii: Korende nore namarieta amake agwo Saridi, abanto batagindeti chianga chiabo riko, na barabwo nabataare amo nainche bare ne chianga chindabu, ekiagera bagweneire aya.
english: Yet you have a few people in Sardis who have not soiled their clothes. They will walk with me, dressed in white, for they are worthy.

ekegusii: Korende nonya naboigo, Abakeni nabasirigwe, ekero Abaasuri barabaire babe abasibwa.”
english: yet you Kenites will be destroyed when Asshur takes you captive."

ekegusii: Korende aye Omonene nomanyete inche, nigo ondoche, na nigo ogoteema ebirengererio biane gose mbire asore. Barusieo abwo ababe buna ching’ondi chigochia konyenywa, obabeke ensemo baganye rituko bagochia konyenywa.
english: Yet you know me, O LORD; you see me and test my thoughts about you. Drag them off like sheep to be butchered! Set them apart for the day of slaughter!

ekegusii: ko mwangire gocha asende monyare koba nobogima.
english: yet you refuse to come to me to have life.

ekegusii: Ase engencho eyio aye nigo ogoteba: Inki Nyasae amanyete? Nanyare konacha ekina goetera ase omosunte ekerima?
english: Yet you say, 'What does God know? Does he judge through such darkness?

ekegusii: nonya nabo, iso obeire okong’ainereria, na koonchora eng’eria yane ara ikomi, korende Nyasae tamoete ribaga gonkorera bobe.
english: yet your father has cheated me by changing my wages ten times. However, God has not allowed him to harm me.

ekegusii: Musa akabaa okwaroka (tari ng’a nigo korwete ase Musa, korende ase chisokoro chiaino), na inwe nigo mogosara omonto ase rituko ri’Esabato.
english: Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a child on the Sabbath.

ekegusii: Naki ekero abana baria konya bataraiborwa na batarakora amaya gose amabe, ng’ina nigo atebetigwe, “Oyo omonene nakorere oyo omoke.” Igo omoroberio o Nyasae bw’ogochora goika ogenderere, tari ase engencho y’ogokora kw’abanto, korende ase okorangeria kwaye.
english: Yet, before the twins were born or had done anything good or bad-- in order that God's purpose in election might stand:

ekegusii: Korende inwe Abaisraeli nigo mogendererete goteba: Chinchera chi’Omonene tichiri echi’ekeene. Ninachere kera omonto ekina koreng’ana nogokora kwaye.”
english: Yet, O house of Israel, you say, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' But I will judge each of you according to his own ways."

ekegusii: Nonya naboigo, aye Omonene, naye Tata oito; intwe nigo tore esike, naye omokori chinyongo. Intwe twensi nigo tore emeremo y’amaboko ao.
english: Yet, O LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay, you are the potter; we are all the work of your hand.

ekegusii: Inwe abamotari abegenwa, timomanyeti ng’a obosani bw’ense nobobisa ase Nyasae? Gaki, oyorigetie koba omosani bw’ense bwekorire koba omobisa o Nyasae.
english: You adulterous people, don't you know that friendship with the world is hatred toward God? Anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God.

ekegusii: “Aye naye Omonene, aye bweka. Naye gwatongete igoro, na igoro ya igoro chionsi, na emeganda yabo yonsi, na ense amo nebinto bionsi bireo, ne chinyancha, na ebinto bionsi bire imeo. Naye obirendete bigendererete kobao; ebitongwa bionsi bia igoro nigo bikogosasima.
english: You alone are the LORD. You made the heavens, even the highest heavens, and all their starry host, the earth and all that is on it, the seas and all that is in them. You give life to everything, and the multitudes of heaven worship you.

ekegusii: Aye bweka nigo ore oyo bw’okoondokia mono. Ning’o oranyare gotenena ase obosio bwao, ekero kwabeire nendamwamu?
english: You alone are to be feared. Who can stand before you when you are angry?

ekegusii: “Boigo naende mwagerete Omonene akaba nendamwamu ekero mwarenge agwo Tabera, na Masa, na Kibiroti‐Hatawa.
english: You also made the LORD angry at Taberah, at Massah and at Kibroth Hattaavah.

ekegusii: Nainwe nabo, mobe ang’e, ekiagera ensa motakagereti, nero Omwana‐o‐mwanyabanto arache.”
english: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him."

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteba: Onde bwensi kararie emuma ase egesasimero tari gento; korende onde bwensi kararie emuma ase ekeng’wanso kere igoro ase egesasimero bwesibire nemuma yaye.
english: You also say, 'If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but if anyone swears by the gift on it, he is bound by his oath.'

ekegusii: Naende okaimokia ebinto biao ebiya bie chitahabu na ebie chifeta nakoete, erio okeroiseria emegwekano ogosasima enga abasacha, erio ogakora obonyaka nero.
english: You also took the fine jewelry I gave you, the jewelry made of my gold and silver, and you made for yourself male idols and engaged in prostitution with them.

ekegusii: Inwe abamore buna amagena are moyo moagachwe, mobe enyomba y’Omoika mobe abakuani abachenu, morue ebing’wanso bi’omoika ebirancherwe ase Nyasae goetera ase Yeso Kristo.
english: you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

ekegusii: Aye amo na Haroni mobare abanto abakoorire emiaka emerongo ebere na goetania, baria baranyare korwana esegi, mobaroberie ase esegi, ekeombe ase ekeombe.
english: You and Aaron are to number by their divisions all the men in Israel twenty years old or more who are able to serve in the army.

ekegusii: Aye notiire, obachiere buna ekembugu‐mbugu, obe buna riire otube ense, aye na emeganda yao yonsi, na abanto abange bare amo naye.
english: You and all your troops and the many nations with you will go up, advancing like a storm; you will be like a cloud covering the land.

ekegusii: Nigo okorosigwa, aye amo nabanto aba bonsi bare aa. Naki emeremo eye nemerito mono asore, tokonyara koyekora aye bweka.
english: You and these people who come to you will only wear yourselves out. The work is too heavy for you; you cannot handle it alone.

ekegusii: Emeremo ende yonsi aye amo nabanto bamino morarore ere buya, chibesa chiratigare mochiyekorere, korende mokore igo kobwatekana nogwancha kwa Nyasae oino.
english: You and your brother Jews may then do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, in accordance with the will of your God.

ekegusii: Inwe amo nabanto be chinka chiaino namoriere ebinto ebio aase aande onsi, ekiagera eyio neng’eria yaino moraakanwe ase emeremo mogokora agwo ase Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: You and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere, for it is your wages for your work at the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Aye, amo nabana bao na abasomba bao mobe mokomoremera emegondo. Norentere omochokoro bw’omonene oo okwama korwa mogondo, erinde anyore endagera, korende Mefiboseti omonyene, omochokoro bw’omonene oo, nigo arabe okoragera ase emesa yane botambe.” Siba nigo abwate abamura ikomi na batano na abasomba emerongo ebere.
english: You and your sons and your servants are to farm the land for him and bring in the crops, so that your master's grandson may be provided for. And Mephibosheth, grandson of your master, will always eat at my table." (Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.)

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore ogotooreka gwaito, ase ogokora kw’ogokumia ogotoigwa ase oboronge bwao; naye ore ogosemeria kw’abanto bamenyete ase ense, nonya ngoika chinsinyo chi’ense, na ase chinyancha chi’aare.
english: You answer us with awesome deeds of righteousness, O God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwanchete ayio, mokairaneria: Amang’ana ayio gwatotebirie namaya, natokore boigo.
english: You answered me, "What you propose to do is good."

ekegusii: Aye nigo onga buna ensoko y’amache are moyo ere mogondo, naende nigo onga buna chindooche chikorwa Lebanoni.
english: You are a garden fountain, a well of flowing water streaming down from Lebanon.

ekegusii: Moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, naye omogondo ogiteire, naye ensoko y’amache egiteire, na entuboka emumekire na ebekire ekemanyererio.
english: You are a garden locked up, my sister, my bride; you are a spring enclosed, a sealed fountain.

ekegusii: Yuda, aye nendo ensae. Omwana one, gokorwa gotwara, nigo oratiire, na korara, na gotimoka buna endo, buna endo eaberi—ning’o orabe noboremu kogotura?
english: You are a lion's cub, O Judah; you return from the prey, my son. Like a lion he crouches and lies down, like a lioness-- who dares to rouse him?

ekegusii: Aye omosubati nigo onga nyoko, oria bwangete omosacha oye, na abana baye; naende nigo onga basubati bamino, abwo bangete abasacha babo, na abana babo. Nyoko nigo arenge Omohiti na iso n’Omoamiori orenge.
english: You are a true daughter of your mother, who despised her husband and her children; and you are a true sister of your sisters, who despised their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.

ekegusii: Bono mwabeire ang’e kwamboka Yorodan, mogende koira ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa. Ekero morabe mwayeirire na koyemenya,
english: You are about to cross the Jordan to enter and take possession of the land the LORD your God is giving you. When you have taken it over and are living there,

ekegusii: Naki ime ase Kristo Yeso inwe mwensi mwabeire abana ba Nyasae ase enchera y’okwegena.
english: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus,

ekegusii: ekiagera inwe mwensi nabana b’oborabu, na abana b’omobaso. Intwe titori ab’obotuko, gose ab’omosunte.
english: You are all sons of the light and sons of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

ekegusii: Inwe mwaikire koba abachenu ase engencho ye ring’ana nabatebirie.
english: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.

ekegusii: Naende nigo tokobamanyia ng’a timobaisa kobeka ebango gose ogochoga ase onde bwensi bw’abakuani, gose Abalawi, gose abateri, gose abarendi b’ebiita, gose abakori emeremo be Hekalu, gose abakori emeremo bande b’enyomba ya Nyasae.
english: You are also to know that you have no authority to impose taxes, tribute or duty on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants or other workers at this house of God.

ekegusii: Boigo kera emambia orue ase Omonene okoruegwa kw’endagera ebimunu bine, na egetuba ekemo na ekeng’ese amaguta ochoganirie nobosie bw’okoruegwa koria kw’endagera. Oyo noro omoroberio ochikire orabe okogenderera botambe.
english: You are also to provide with it morning by morning a grain offering, consisting of a sixth of an ephah with a third of a hin of oil to moisten the flour. The presenting of this grain offering to the LORD is a lasting ordinance.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ekero nkoamererania naye, nigo okonyorekana kore omonyene oboronge. Nonya nabo, ngokwana inde naye igoro y’amang’ana ’oboronge. Nase ki chinchera chi’abakori amabe chikoba nogosesenigwa? Nase ki abanto abang’ainereria bagendererete koba buya?
english: You are always righteous, O LORD, when I bring a case before you. Yet I would speak with you about your justice: Why does the way of the wicked prosper? Why do all the faithless live at ease?

ekegusii: Nyasae nigo are oyo bw’okogosa korwa ase obomenyo bwaye obochenu; ere Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli; nigo akoa abanto baye okobua ne chinguru. Nyasae atogigwe!
english: You are awesome, O God, in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!

ekegusii: Aye omwanchi one, nigo ore omoseera buna omochie o Tirisa; nigo ore bw’okogokia buna Yerusalemu, na oyo bw’okoirokia buna abarwani esegi babogoretie ebendera.
english: You are beautiful, my darling, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, majestic as troops with banners.

ekegusii: Nigo okorenta amang’ana amageni ase amato aito; gaki ntorigetie komanya engencho y’amang’ana ayio.”
english: You are bringing some strange ideas to our ears, and we want to know what they mean."

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogokora emeremo ya iso oino.” Bakamotebia, “Intwe titoiboiri ase obonyaka; nigo tore na Tata oyomo, nere Nyasae.”
english: You are doing the things your own father does." "We are not illegitimate children," they protested. "The only Father we have is God himself."

ekegusii: Omonene, aye nigo ore omuya na oyo okwabera; nigo okoorokia obwanchani obonge ase abagokorangeria obakonye.
english: You are forgiving and good, O Lord, abounding in love to all who call to you.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae ore obotamero bwane, naki gwantigire? Ninki gekogera inche ngendererete kweumia, na ababisa baane bagendererete gonkorera bobe?
english: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?

ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omuya, naende nigo ogokora amaya, ase ayio inyorokererie emeroberio yao echikire.
english: You are good, and what you do is good; teach me your decrees.

ekegusii: Morigererie ayare ase amasio aino. Onye omonto ore nobomaene ase enkoro yaye ng’a ere nomonto o Kristo, tiga arengererie omonyene, ng’a buna ere are omonto o Kristo, naboigo naintwe tore abanto ba Kristo.
english: You are looking only on the surface of things. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should consider again that we belong to Christ just as much as he.

ekegusii: Inwe nabanto baminto ab’amanyinga aane ne chinyama chiane. Naki rende morigetie koba ab’omoerio ase okong’irania inche omoruoti inka?
english: You are my brothers, my own flesh and blood. So why should you be the last to bring back the king?'

ekegusii: Inwe nigo more abasani baane, komorakore aya nabachikire.
english: You are my friends if you do what I command.

ekegusii: Aye naye Nyasae one, nimbe nkogoakera ng’a mbuya mono; Nyasae one, nimbe nkona‐gokobaka.
english: You are my God, and I will give you thanks; you are my God, and I will exalt you.

ekegusii: Aye naye obwebiso bwane, nondendete korwa ase emechando, nimbe nomogoko na omochengo, ekiagera gwantooririe.
english: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah

ekegusii: Aye naye omoruoti one, na Nyasae one, ase ayio, chika ng’a abanto b’ororeria rwa Yakobo baegwe obobui.
english: You are my King and my God, who decrees victories for Jacob.

ekegusii: “Aye Omonene nigo ore etaya yane; Omonene one, nigo okoonchora omosunte one oba omobaso.
english: You are my lamp, O LORD; the LORD turns my darkness into light.

ekegusii: Omonene, aye negetare kiane; narire eira koigwera amang’ana ao.
english: You are my portion, O LORD; I have promised to obey your words.

ekegusii: Aye naye ore egekengero kiane, na enguba yane, nigo nsemeretie ring’ana riao.
english: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.

ekegusii: Aye tori Nyasae bwanchete ogokora okobe. Oyogokora ebibe takonyara komenya amo naye.
english: You are not a God who takes pleasure in evil; with you the wicked cannot dwell.

ekegusii: Tindi kogotoma ase abanto bagokwana omonwa omoao otamanyeti, korende ase Abaisraeli.
english: You are not being sent to a people of obscure speech and difficult language, but to the house of Israel--

ekegusii: “Ase ekero keria timobaisa gokora buna togokora bono aiga. Kera omonto nigo agokora buna aroche omonyene ng’a mboronge.
english: You are not to do as we do here today, everyone as he sees fit,

ekegusii: Egetongwa kende gionsi egeke kegwekururera enda, gose gekogendera amagoro ane, gose amange, ase ebio bigoetanana ase ense, nigo bire okogechia, timobaisa kobiria.
english: You are not to eat any creature that moves about on the ground, whether it moves on its belly or walks on all fours or on many feet; it is detestable.

ekegusii: Ase ayio mwaragererigwe. Inwe namobe abasomba botambe, mogwatia chinko na korenta amache ase enyomba ya Nyasae one.”
english: You are now under a curse: You will never cease to serve as woodcutters and water carriers for the house of my God."

ekegusii: Nigo mokorenda mono amatuko, na emetienyi, na ebiro, na emiaka.
english: You are observing special days and months and seasons and years!

ekegusii: Aye nigo okomeka‐meka oichire nobonene kogocha korwa ase ebitunwa bi’ababisa kwabuire.
english: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.

ekegusii: “Inche omoruoti, amo nabasemia baane batano na babere, twagotomire ogende komanya amang’ana ’ense y’Abayuda, na aya Yerusalemu, kobwatekana namachiko a Nyasae oo, ayio obwate ase okoboko kwao.
english: You are sent by the king and his seven advisers to inquire about Judah and Jerusalem with regard to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.

ekegusii: Na bono monyare gosoa ase okobwatana kw’ogotianania okwo Omonene, Nyasae oino, agokora amo nainwe rituko ria rero,
english: You are standing here in order to enter into a covenant with the LORD your God, a covenant the LORD is making with you this day and sealing with an oath,

ekegusii: ekiagera nonya mbono nigo more abanto b’engencho y’ebibe. Naki onye more ne ribero na eriomana ase egati yaino, Inee, timori abanto b’engencho y’ebibe, naende nigo mogendererete buna banto bande bonsi?
english: You are still worldly. For since there is jealousy and quarreling among you, are you not worldly? Are you not acting like mere men?

ekegusii: “Inwe nabana b’Omonene, Nyasae oino. Timwesaraga emebere yaino gose gwekigita chitukia chia bosio ase emetwe yaino ekero mokoreera abakure,
english: You are the children of the LORD your God. Do not cut yourselves or shave the front of your heads for the dead,

ekegusii: Aye nigo ore Nyasae ogokora amakumia; kwaorokirie okobua kwao ase egati ya mwanyabanto.
english: You are the God who performs miracles; you display your power among the peoples.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ore omoseera kobua abanto bonsi; ebikoba biao nigo bigokwana amang’ana ’obwanchani. Ase ayio Nyasae ogosesenirie goika kare na kare.
english: You are the most excellent of men and your lips have been anointed with grace, since God has blessed you forever.

ekegusii: “Inwe ninwe mwabeire mogendererete amo nainche ase ogoteemwa kwane,
english: You are those who have stood by me in my trials.

ekegusii: Mweatanane korwa ase ebinto birure ebing’wanso ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, na korwa ase amanyinga, na korwa ase enyama ende yonsi y’eng’iti eng’entire, na korwa ase obotomani. Kamoretange nayio, namokore buya. Motigare buya.”
english: You are to abstain from food sacrificed to idols, from blood, from the meat of strangled animals and from sexual immorality. You will do well to avoid these things. Farewell.

ekegusii: Moyiaterane ase ogoaka obomera, ebe emiando yaino na ey’abamenyi bare ase egati yaino baiborerete abana ase egati yaino. Abwo babe asemore buna ababiare b’Abaisraeli, baegwe emiando ase egati y’ebisaku biaino inwe Abaisraeli.
english: You are to allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the aliens who have settled among you and who have children. You are to consider them as native-born Israelites; along with you they are to be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel.
