ekegusii: Inwe mobe abachenu baane, ekiagera inche Omonene nigo inde omochenu, nabaatananire korwa ase ebisaku binde, erinde mobe abaane.
english: You are to be holy to me because I, the LORD, am holy, and I have set you apart from the nations to be my own.

ekegusii: Na orente ase obwato ime ching’iti, na chinde chionsi chire moyo echia kera egesaku, ibere ibere, chinsacha ne chinkungu, chibe moyo amo naye.
english: You are to bring into the ark two of all living creatures, male and female, to keep them alive with you.

ekegusii: Ekero kwarentire Abalawi ase obosio bwane, inche Omonene, Abaisraeli goika babeke amaboko abo igoro ase emetwe yabo.
english: You are to bring the Levites before the LORD, and the Israelites are to lay their hands on them.

ekegusii: Koragore omogondo korwa ase omonto onde oakane omonto oria koreng’ana nemiaka eyio etigarete aragese ekero Omwaka bw’Omochengo otaraika.
english: You are to buy from your countryman on the basis of the number of years since the Jubilee. And he is to sell to you on the basis of the number of years left for harvesting crops.

ekegusii: Naye oraite osirie abanto b’enyomba y’Ahabu, omonene oo, erinde inche nyeruserie egesiomba ase Yesebeli, ekiagera ere aiterete amanyinga ’abasomba baane ababani, na ay’abasomba baane bonsi, inche Omonene.
english: You are to destroy the house of Ahab your master, and I will avenge the blood of my servants the prophets and the blood of all the LORD's servants shed by Jezebel.

ekegusii: Mobaatere mobareng’anerie kera omonto ensemo yaye. Nigo netianetie koa chisokoro chiaino ense eye; ase ayio ense eyio nebe omwando oino.
english: You are to divide it equally among them. Because I swore with uplifted hand to give it to your forefathers, this land will become your inheritance.

ekegusii: Ense yatananwe ase chinsemo isano na ibere. Abayuda nigo baragenderere komenya ase orogongo rwabo agwo ensemo ya irianyi, na Abayusufu ase orwabo, ensemo ya sugusu.
english: You are to divide the land into seven parts. Judah is to remain in its territory on the south and the house of Joseph in its territory on the north.

ekegusii: Okore boigo ase rituko ria gatano na kabere ri’omotienyi, ase engencho y’omonto onde bwensi okorire ebibe atancheti, gose ayakorete ase oboriri bwaye. Ase enchera eyio mokore okobwatanigwa ase Hekalu.
english: You are to do the same on the seventh day of the month for anyone who sins unintentionally or through ignorance; so you are to make atonement for the temple.

ekegusii: Chinyama chie ching’iti buna echio mochiriere agwo ase emechie yaino. Abanto bonsi onye bare abatachenegeti, gose bachenegete, nabachirie. Nabo morachirie buna mokoria chinyama chie chingabi gose echie chinsune.
english: You are to eat it in your own towns. Both the ceremonially unclean and the clean may eat it, as if it were gazelle or deer.

ekegusii: Ase rituko erio oe abakuani Abalawi b’ororeria rwa Zadoki eeri ensae ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe. Abwo nabwo baeirwe ribaga ri’okong’ika ang’e ase ogonkorera. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: You are to give a young bull as a sin offering to the priests, who are Levites, of the family of Zadok, who come near to minister before me, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: omwatananere kera omwana omoisia omotangi; na kera eng’iti entangi y’eeri, na emingichi, na egoree; echio nigo chirabe echi’Omonene.
english: you are to give over to the LORD the first offspring of every womb. All the firstborn males of your livestock belong to the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekenama kia borio okee omokuani buna ekeegwa korwa ase ebing’wanso biaino bi’omorembe.
english: You are to give the right thigh of your fellowship offerings to the priest as a contribution.

ekegusii: Moe abakuani ogotongora kwaino kw’endagera, na edivai, na amaguta, na amarionya amatang’ani mokonacha korwa ase ching’ondi chiaino.
english: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain, new wine and oil, and the first wool from the shearing of your sheep,

ekegusii: Ase ebinto bire ebichenu mono, ebiratigare, bitari gosambwa nomorero, ebirabe ebiao, nabio ebi: Kera okoruegwa kw’endagera, na kera ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, na ekeng’wanso gi’okorongeyia okomocha. Ebinto bionsi barabwo barabe bakorua asende, nabibe ebichenu mono asore, na ase abamura bao.
english: You are to have the part of the most holy offerings that is kept from the fire. From all the gifts they bring me as most holy offerings, whether grain or sin or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.

ekegusii: Mobe ne richiko erimo rikogambera abanto bonsi, karabe omomenyi gose omobiare, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: You are to have the same law for the alien and the native-born. I am the LORD your God.'"

ekegusii: Erio ochirente ase obosio bw’Omonene, na abakuani bachinyororokerie omonyo na gochirua chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa ase Omonene.
english: You are to offer them before the LORD, and the priests are to sprinkle salt on them and sacrifice them as a burnt offering to the LORD.

ekegusii: Nigo morarue chibesa mogore endagera korwa asebare morie. Naboigo morue chibesa mogore amache korwa asebare monywe.”
english: You are to pay them in silver for the food you eat and the water you drink.'"

ekegusii: Bono ekero togotama, inwe morue ase moboete, moumokere omochie, ekiagera Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyobekire ase amaboko aino.
english: you are to rise up from ambush and take the city. The LORD your God will give it into your hand.

ekegusii: Goika otebie oyomino Haroni ayio onsi nagochikire, na ere akwane na Farao, amotebie ng’a ae Abaisraeli ribaga barue ase ense yaye.
english: You are to say everything I command you, and your brother Aaron is to tell Pharaoh to let the Israelites go out of his country.

ekegusii: You are to take every kind of food that is to be eaten and store it away as food for you and for them."
english: Oire endagera egochia koriegwa, oyegache. Eyio erabe endagera yaino na eya chirochio.”

ekegusii: Erio oimokie amanyinga make ay’ekeng’wanso ekio, oyagindie ase emegwekano eria ene ye chingunchara ere ase egesasimero, na ase chikoona inye chi’egesasimero, na igoro ase orosingo rw’egesasimero chinsemo chionsi. Ase enchera eyio nochene egesasimero na kogekorera okobwatanigwa.
english: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns of the altar and on the four corners of the upper ledge and all around the rim, and so purify the altar and make atonement for it.

ekegusii: Naende oire eeri eria oyerue ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ebibe, oyesambere aase achikire, isiko y’Aase Aachenu.
english: You are to take the bull for the sin offering and burn it in the designated part of the temple area outside the sanctuary.

ekegusii: Goika mokebwe risankwa ria isiko ri’ekiimo kiaino ki’obosacha, na ayio nabe ekemanyererio gi’okobwatana egati yane nainwe.
english: You are to undergo circumcision, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and you.

ekegusii: “Goika motware ebirengero bi’ekeene mokorengera oborito na obonge bw’ebinto bionsi.
english: You are to use accurate scales, an accurate ephah and an accurate bath.

ekegusii: You are under a curse-- the whole nation of you-- because you are robbing me.
english: Mwaragererigwe nokoragererigwa, ekiagera inwe egesaku eke gionsi mwanyibeire ebiane.

ekegusii: You are witnesses of these things.
english: Inwe mbirori b’amang’ana aya.

ekegusii: Inwe mbirori, na Nyasae boigo, buna okogenderera gwaito kwarenge ase egati yaino, inwe abamwegenire, buna tware nobochenu na oboronge, na titware na komocha.
english: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous and blameless we were among you who believed.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwambegete chinguru chi’okorwana esegi; okabeka ababisa baane inse y’amagoro aane.
english: You armed me with strength for battle; you made my adversaries bow at my feet.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoboria: “Nase ki atari kobianchera?” Nekiagera Omonene arenge kirori ase egati yao na omokungu bw’oboke bwao, oyio aye otari omwegenwa asare, nonya ore omokiare oo, na omokungu oo ase okobwatana kw’ogotianania.
english: You ask, "Why?" It is because the LORD is acting as the witness between you and the wife of your youth, because you have broken faith with her, though she is your partner, the wife of your marriage covenant.

ekegusii: Timwabete mokoria omogati, gose konywa edivai, gose ekenyugwa kende gionsi kegotindia, erio nario moranyare komanya ng’a ere nere Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: You ate no bread and drank no wine or other fermented drink. I did this so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Inwe mokaba abegi baito, na ab’Omonene, na nonya mwachandegete mono, mwanyorete ring’ana amo nomogoko okorwa ase Omoika Omochenu,
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord; in spite of severe suffering, you welcomed the message with the joy given by the Holy Spirit.

ekegusii: You believe that there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe that-- and shudder.
english: Aye mbwegenete ng’a Nyasae noyomo; gwakorire buya. Nonya nebirecha mbiegenete boigo na koiguswa.

ekegusii: Inwe naba iso oino Saitani, na ogwancha kwaino nogokora okogania gwa iso. Ere nigo arenge omoiti korwa omochakano, gose tatenenete ase ekeene, ekiagera ekeene tikeri ime yaye. Kagokwana oborimo, nigo agokwana ayare ayaye omonyene, ekiagera nomonyaborimo, na ise bw’oborimo.
english: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your father's desire. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.

ekegusii: Inwe abariri emeuko! Nkere ki kere ekenene kobua: netahabu, gose ne Hekalu egokora etahabu ebe enchenu?
english: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?

ekegusii: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
english: Inwe abaraai emeuko, mwakenonora egechuni, mwamera engamia!

ekegusii: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
english: Inwe emeuko! Nkere ki kere ekenene kobua: nesadaka, gose negesasimero kegokora esadaka ebe enchenu?

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogoteba, “Intwe twakorire okobwatana kw’ogotianania namakweri, na twabwatanire naase abakure; ekero emechando eyio emebe erache tegotoika ang’e, ekiagera twakorire oborimo bwabeire obotamero bwaito, na obong’ainereria bwabeire egekengero giaito.”
english: You boast, "We have entered into a covenant with death, with the grave we have made an agreement. When an overwhelming scourge sweeps by, it cannot touch us, for we have made a lie our refuge and falsehood our hiding place."

ekegusii: You boasted against me and spoke against me without restraint, and I heard it.
english: Ekeene, naigure amang’ana aino amange ay’ogwetogia mwakwanire mamincha yane.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okorenta omosunte bwaba botuko, erio ching’iti chionsi chi’orosana chiachaka gotaara.
english: You bring darkness, it becomes night, and all the beasts of the forest prowl.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okomenta oborori bwao igoro yane, na kwamentera ekeririanda igoro yane. Nigo okona‐kondetera ababisa bakondwania.
english: You bring new witnesses against me and increase your anger toward me; your forces come against me wave upon wave.

ekegusii: Kwang’eire aase aagare ngotaara, na amagoro aane tagotererigwa.
english: You broaden the path beneath me, so that my ankles do not turn.

ekegusii: Inwe oroiboro rwe ching’iti! Naki moranyare gokwana amaya ekero more ababe? Ekiagera ebiichire ase enkoro, nabio omonwa ogokwana.
english: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For out of the overflow of the heart the mouth speaks.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene nigo kwarentete omosabibu korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erio ogaseria abanto b’ebisaku korwa aase abo, okayosimeka aroro.
english: You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.

ekegusii: Nigo gwatotigete tokagwa ase egesibo aye nigo gwatotwegete egurube endito.
english: You brought us into prison and laid burdens on our backs.

ekegusii: Nigo kwang’anyetie abanto bao Abaisraeli korwa ase ense ya Misiri, ase enchera y’ebikone na amakumia, na okobua okonene, na okoboko koramboire kore ne chinguru, na ase okoondokia okonene,
english: You brought your people Israel out of Egypt with signs and wonders, by a mighty hand and an outstretched arm and with great terror.

ekegusii: okeagachera ebinyomba bi’emegwekano ogosasima, na ase kera enchera kwaagachire aase aimokererete igoro ogosasimera.
english: you built a mound for yourself and made a lofty shrine in every public square.

ekegusii: Mokaagacha etangi y’amache agwo ase egati ye chindwaki chiria ibere, erinde monyore amache akorwa ase ritibo rikoro, korende timwamorigeretie Oyio okorete ayio, gose timwamorengereretie Oyio okorete omoroberio oyio agwo kare.
english: You built a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the Old Pool, but you did not look to the One who made it, or have regard for the One who planned it long ago.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogosambeka nokogania okobe ase egati y’emete enga emetontera, na inse ya kera omote omobese. Nigo mogoiteera abana baino agwo ase amagoko, inse y’ebitare.
english: You burn with lust among the oaks and under every spreading tree; you sacrifice your children in the ravines and under the overhanging crags.

ekegusii: Ribaga ri’ayio kwairanire, naende kwarire endagera na kwanyure amache aase aiga. Aya Omonene agokanetie ng’a tokora igo. Ekiagera gwakorire igo, omobere oo gokwete tokonyara kobekwa ase chimbeera chie chisokoro chiao.”
english: You came back and ate bread and drank water in the place where he told you not to eat or drink. Therefore your body will not be buried in the tomb of your fathers.'"

ekegusii: Erio inwe mokairana, mokarera ase Omonene abakonye, korende Omonene taigwete okorera kwaino gose tabategererete.
english: You came back and wept before the LORD, but he paid no attention to your weeping and turned a deaf ear to you.

ekegusii: “Inwe nigo mwachete ang’e, mogatenena ase egetunwa keria mbarabare, ekero kiagendererete gwoka omorero oria ochongororogete gochia igoro obwate erioki rimwamuti, na amare, na omosunte omonene.
english: You came near and stood at the foot of the mountain while it blazed with fire to the very heavens, with black clouds and deep darkness.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwang’igete ang’e ase rituko riria narerete asore, ogantebia: Toondoka!
english: You came near when I called you, and you said, "Do not fear."

ekegusii: Nigoro gwacha aa. Nase ki ndagotige ontunyane na kona‐koong’anya amo nainche, nainche timanyeti nonya naase ngochia? Irana amo nabamino, na Omonene akoorokerie obwanchani bwaye botari koera na obwegenwa bwaye.”
english: You came only yesterday. And today shall I make you wander about with us, when I do not know where I am going? Go back, and take your countrymen. May kindness and faithfulness be with you."

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasogete ase ogotooria abanto bao, ee, okarentera omoakwa amaguta oo ogotooreka. Nigo gwasenyentete ekerama ki’enyomba y’omokori amabe, okayetagora korwa ase oboroso goika ase egechuria.
english: You came out to deliver your people, to save your anointed one. You crushed the leader of the land of wickedness, you stripped him from head to foot. Selah

ekegusii: Naki buna oranyare komanya, amatuko taraeta kobua ikomi na abere korwa ekero natiirete kogenda Yerusalemu gosasima.
english: You can easily verify that no more than twelve days ago I went up to Jerusalem to worship.

ekegusii: Inwe nabo moramenye egati yaito, aiga ase ense yaito ribaga ndireo asemore, moramenye na koonchoreria, mwenyorere enibo.”
english: You can settle among us; the land is open to you. Live in it, trade in it, and acquire property in it."

ekegusii: Monyare gotiga abasomba abwo ase abana baino barache nyuma yaino, babe omwando obo bakobakorera kogenderera botambe. Abwo mbanyare koba abasomba baino. Korende abanto bamino Abaisraeli, timobagambera nobotindi.
english: You can will them to your children as inherited property and can make them slaves for life, but you must not rule over your fellow Israelites ruthlessly.

ekegusii: Timokonyara konywera egekombe ki’Omonene na egekombe ki’ebirecha. Timokonyara kobwatana nemesa y’Omonene na emesa y’ebirecha.
english: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot have a part in both the Lord's table and the table of demons.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogwechandera ense, kwayerentera embura, nigo okoyea obotenenku obonge mono; chindooche chiao aye Nyasae nigo chiichire namache. Ase okoroisia riroba igo nigo okoa abanto endagera.
english: You care for the land and water it; you enrich it abundantly. The streams of God are filled with water to provide the people with grain, for so you have ordained it.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwayoraberetie aase na koaroisia, noro ogakina okaira emeri inse, okaranda ase ense eyio engima.
english: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okorotota abwo bagokora ay’oboronge bare nomogoko, abwo bagokoinyora bare ase chinchera chiao. Rora, aye nigo kwagechetigwe, ekero twakorete ebibe; twabeire tore ase ebibe biaito ase engakientambe. Inee! Ntonyare gotooreka?
english: You come to the help of those who gladly do right, who remember your ways. But when we continued to sin against them, you were angry. How then can we be saved?

ekegusii: Inwe nigo morabe barito bw’obonyansi obwomo, moibore amasakwe. Omoika oino bw’okoeyana noro omorero orabasambe moere.
english: You conceive chaff, you give birth to straw; your breath is a fire that consumes you.

ekegusii: Mokabara chinyomba chia Yerusalemu, na mogachitagora ase okoroisia orwaki robe orokong’u.
english: You counted the buildings in Jerusalem and tore down houses to strengthen the wall.

ekegusii: Nigo kwayetubete chindiba buna eanga egotuba, amache akabeera igoro ase ebitunwa.
english: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

ekegusii: Naye gwatongete sugusu na irianyi; egetunwa gia Tabori, na ekia Herimoni, nigo bigotogia erieta riao nomogoko.
english: You created the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.

ekegusii: Kwabekeire omwaka egutwa y’obuya bwao, amabarato ao nigo agotonya obonoru.
english: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwasenyentete enchoka eria Rahabu ekaba buna egetondo, nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru ogasiarera ababisa bao.
english: You crushed Rahab like one of the slain; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.

ekegusii: Aye kwairire bosa ebinto abamino baruete bibe ntenenera, naende kwabachaboire chianga, kwabatigire gesobono.
english: You demanded security from your brothers for no reason; you stripped men of their clothing, leaving them naked.

ekegusii: Mogatiga Egetare keria kiabaiborete, mokeba Nyasae oria obaete obogima.”
english: You deserted the Rock, who fathered you; you forgot the God who gave you birth.

ekegusii: Aye nigo orasirie abanyaborimo bonsi; aye Omonene nigo ogechete abaiteri amanyinga na abang’ainereria.
english: You destroy those who tell lies; bloodthirsty and deceitful men the LORD abhors.

ekegusii: Nigo kwababunete buna chimeeri chia Tarisisi nomwaga okogusa korwa moocha.
english: You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish shattered by an east wind.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwakorire ebibe ebio bobisi, korende inche nigo ndakoe egesusuro ekio maiso marore ase Abaisraeli bonsi baroche.”
english: You did it in secret, but I will do this thing in broad daylight before all Israel.'"

ekegusii: Tari inwe mwanchorire inche, korende ninche nabachorire inwe, nababekire mogende kwama, okwama kwaino goikaranse; erio rinde rionsi mogosaba Tata ase erieta riane, nigo arabae.
english: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you to go and bear fruit-- fruit that will last. Then the Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.

ekegusii: Tonyunyunteti, korende ere korwa ekero nasoete aa tatigete konyunyunta amagoro aane.
english: You did not give me a kiss, but this woman, from the time I entered, has not stopped kissing my feet.

ekegusii: Tong’ageti omotwe one amaguta, korende ere ong’akire amagoro aane amaguta agotioka buya.
english: You did not put oil on my head, but she has poured perfume on my feet.

ekegusii: Naki otantigerete ribaga inyunyunte abachokoro baane na abana baane abasubati, mbatebie ng’a bagende buya? Amaene, nigo gwankorerete egento ki’oboriri.
english: You didn't even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters good-by. You have done a foolish thing.

ekegusii: Igo mokorigarigia mono amariko, ekiagera mokagete ng’a nigo more nobogima bwa kare na kare ime y’aro; na ayio naro are kirori asende,
english: You diligently study the Scriptures because you think that by them you possess eternal life. These are the Scriptures that testify about me,

ekegusii: Ekero ngotaara gose kondaire nigo omanyete; aye nigo omanyete chinchera chiane chionsi.
english: You discern my going out and my lying down; you are familiar with all my ways.

ekegusii: Korende mokamwanga oria Omochenu, Omonyene Oboronge, na mokaboria moegwe omoiti.
english: You disowned the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you.

ekegusii: Ogaatanana amache ’enyancha ase amasio e chisokoro chiaito, erinde bagaeta ase egati y’enyancha buna ense enyomo; okarimeria abachandi babo ase chindiba, buna rigena rikorutwa ase amache amanene ime.
english: You divided the sea before them, so that they passed through it on dry ground, but you hurled their pursuers into the depths, like a stone into mighty waters.

ekegusii: Togokiri nekeng’wanso, ninsa gokerua; aye toganeti ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa.
english: You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.

ekegusii: Gose timorengerereti ng’a mbuya omonto oyomo akwe ase engencho y’abanto, erinde egesaku ekegima tigesira.”
english: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish."

ekegusii: Aye nigo okorenta embura ase chinchwara chi’emegondo y’ense; nigo okwarania aase aimokererete igoro, erio gwatoma embura yororobia riroba na gosesenia ebigokina ase emegondo.
english: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.

ekegusii: Nigo mokonywa edivai korwa ase ebitaabo ebinene, naende mweaka amaguta e rigori rinene, korende timoichanereti ogosirigwa kw’ororeria rwa Yusufu.
english: You drink wine by the bowlful and use the finest lotions, but you do not grieve over the ruin of Joseph.

ekegusii: Nigo mogoseria abakungu b’abanto baane korwa ase chinka chiabo echio bagokerete, mwaura abana babo obonene bokorwa asende tibabonyora nonya ng’ake.
english: You drive the women of my people from their pleasant homes. You take away my blessing from their children forever.

ekegusii: Nigo mokoria echire chinoru, naende mwabeka chianga chiroisirie korwa ase amarionya abo; ee, nigo mokonyenya echire chinoru, korende timori korisia riicho erio moriigotie.
english: You eat the curds, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the choice animals, but you do not take care of the flock.

ekegusii: “Naende ngwakorete obonyaka n’Abaasuri, ekiagera tigwaisanegete, ee, ngwakorete obotayayi nabarabwo, nonya naboigo tigwaisanegete.
english: You engaged in prostitution with the Assyrians too, because you were insatiable; and even after that, you still were not satisfied.

ekegusii: Nigo gwakorete obonyaka n’Abamisiri, abanto abwo mosinyaine bare nokogania okobe; okamenta obonyaka bwao, na okagera nkagechigwa nkaba nendamwamu.
english: You engaged in prostitution with the Egyptians, your lustful neighbors, and provoked me to anger with your increasing promiscuity.

ekegusii: Inwe abakori amabe nigo mogochaya omoroberio bw’omonto otari na nguru, korende Omonene nere obotamero bwaye.
english: You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor, but the LORD is their refuge.

ekegusii: Aye gwasoirie amagoro aane ase rikorogoto, nigo origereretie orogendo rwane rwonsi; aye kwabekire orobebe ase chimbaratero chiane chigotacha.
english: You fasten my feet in shackles; you keep close watch on all my paths by putting marks on the soles of my feet.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo moirogete ogoitwa nemioro, nindete emioro ebaite. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.
english: You fear the sword, and the sword is what I will bring against you, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Inwe Abagalatia abariri! Ning’o obarogete inwe ase amaiso aino Yeso Kristo oorogetigwe buna abambetwe?
english: You foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.

ekegusii: Korende aye, omonto otaisaini gento, norigetie komanya ng’a okwegena gotari nogokora nokogomba?
english: You foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is useless?

ekegusii: Inwe abariri, ere oyokorete egia isiko, tari ere okorete nekia ime nakerokio?
english: You foolish people! Did not the one who made the outside make the inside also?

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaberete abanto bao obobe bwabo, nigo gwatubete ebibe biabo bionsi.
english: You forgave the iniquity of your people and covered all their sins. Selah

ekegusii: Okamorora ng’a nigo arenge nenkoro y’obwegenwa ase obosio bwao, erio ogakora okobwatana kw’ogotianania amo nere ng’a noe ororeria rwaye ense y’Abakanani, ey’Abahiti na Abaamori, ey’Abaperisi, na Abayebusi, na Abagirigasi, na bono gwaikeranirie ring’ana gwakwanete, ekiagera aye nomonyene oboronge.”
english: You found his heart faithful to you, and you made a covenant with him to give to his descendants the land of the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Jebusites and Girgashites. You have kept your promise because you are righteous.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nigo kwarentete embura enyinge mono, na igo omwando oo oria konya orosire okayoiraneria chinguru.
english: You gave abundant showers, O God; you refreshed your weary inheritance.

ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire obogima na konyorokia obwanchani bwao botari koera; na oborendi bwao nigo borendete omoika one.
english: You gave me life and showed me kindness, and in your providence watched over my spirit.

ekegusii: You gave no water to the weary and you withheld food from the hungry,
english: Oyo konya orosire tomoeti amache anywe, na oyo orenge nenchara okamorina endagera.

ekegusii: okabaa ense eye kwarierete chisokoro chiabo eira kobayea, ense entenenku ere namabeere na amooke.
english: You gave them this land you had sworn to give their forefathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.

ekegusii: ayio gwachigete goetera ase abasomba bao ababani ogateba: Ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino nigo ere eyetachenegeti, ekiagera abanto b’aroro bayekorire yabeire enyaka ase okoyeichoria nogokora kwabo gw’okogechia korwa ensinyo eyemo goika eyende.
english: you gave through your servants the prophets when you said: 'The land you are entering to possess is a land polluted by the corruption of its peoples. By their detestable practices they have filled it with their impurity from one end to the other.

ekegusii: Aye kwarure ribaga toriegwe buna ching’ondi chikoriegwa, gwatosiareire gochia ase abanto b’ebisaku.
english: You gave us up to be devoured like sheep and have scattered us among the nations.

ekegusii: Aye okabaa Omoika oo omuya koborokereria; tikwabarinete mana baare koria, naende nigo kwabaete amache baare konywa ekero barenge nerang’o.
english: You gave your good Spirit to instruct them. You did not withhold your manna from their mouths, and you gave them water for their thirst.

ekegusii: Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, okoboko kwao gw’okorio kogansiira; na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.
english: You give me your shield of victory, and your right hand sustains me; you stoop down to make me great.

ekegusii: “Aye kwang’eire enguba yao ase ogontooria, na ogokonywa kwao gwankorire nabeire omonene.
english: You give me your shield of victory; you stoop down to make me great.

ekegusii: Inwe, ekiagera more nobong’aini, nigo mokoremereria nabariri ase omogoko.
english: You gladly put up with fools since you are so wise!

ekegusii: Genda inwe abanyene ase rituko rinene; tindi gotiira gochia ase Rituko Rinene, ekiagera ekero kiane tikeraika.”
english: You go to the Feast. I am not yet going up to this Feast, because for me the right time has not yet come."

ekegusii: naende kwamoa ogotimoka ase amatuko ’emechando, goika ekero abakori amabe bararemerwe chimbeera chiabo.
english: you grant him relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug for the wicked.

ekegusii: Mokemurungania ekero mwamenyete ase chiema chiaino, mogateba: Omonene nigo atogechete, nakio kiagerete agatorusia korwa ase ense ya Misiri, erinde atobeke ase amaboko ’Abaamori, nabarabwo batoite na gotosiria.”
english: You grumbled in your tents and said, "The LORD hates us; so he brought us out of Egypt to deliver us into the hands of the Amorites to destroy us.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okondaa na gonsemia, na nyuma y’ayio noche kong’ira onsoyie ase obonene.
english: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogechete amorokererio ay’okorongeyia, gwatugutire amang’ana aane gochia nyuma.
english: You hate my instruction and cast my words behind you.

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagechete oria okorwanerera ekeene agwo ase ekegambero kere geita, na bagechigwa noyo ogokwana ay’ekeene.
english: you hate the one who reproves in court and despise him who tells the truth.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwangire abanto bao, abwo bare ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, ekiagera barabwo baichoirwe ne chingencho chi’abanto ba moocha, na nigo bagokora oboringoria buna obw’Abafilisti; boigo babwatanire nabanto be chinse chingeni.
english: You have abandoned your people, the house of Jacob. They are full of superstitions from the East; they practice divination like the Philistines and clasp hands with pagans.

ekegusii: Rora, inwe mwensi mweroreire ayio; bono, nase ki rende mogokwana amang’ana a bosa?”
english: You have all seen this yourselves. Why then this meaningless talk?

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Yuda, chinyasae chiaino nigo chire chinyinge buna emechie yaino ere emenge, na buna chinchera chia Yerusalemu chire chinyinge, naboigo nebisasimero bi’obosooku bire, biria mwaroiseretie Baali, enyasae eria mogosambera ubani.
english: You have as many gods as you have towns, O Judah; and the altars you have set up to burn incense to that shameful god Baal are as many as the streets of Jerusalem.'

ekegusii: Aye kwabeire nokomocha, ekiagera gwaitire abanto abange, naende gwesoirie ase ogotacheneka ase ogosasima emegwekano kwaroisirie. Ase engencho eyio kwagerire amatuko ao asukire gocha ang’e; gwaikire omoerio bw’emiaka yao. Bono ningotige ochaywe nabanto b’ebisaku, na ochecherigwe ne chinse chionsi.
english: you have become guilty because of the blood you have shed and have become defiled by the idols you have made. You have brought your days to a close, and the end of your years has come. Therefore I will make you an object of scorn to the nations and a laughingstock to all the countries.

ekegusii: Aye kwabeire egekengero egekong’u ase abataka, ee, kwabeire egekengero ase abaremeire ekero bare nemechando; kwabeire obotamero ase engaki y’embura omoubera, na ekiriri ekero ki’omobaso omororo. Okogosa kw’abanto abatindi nigo konga embura omoubera egotwoma enyasi,
english: You have been a refuge for the poor, a refuge for the needy in his distress, a shelter from the storm and a shade from the heat. For the breath of the ruthless is like a storm driving against a wall

ekegusii: Ee, korwa nachagete kobamanya, mwabeire motari koigwera Omonene.
english: You have been rebellious against the LORD ever since I have known you.

ekegusii: na ekero mwasiboretwe korwa ase ebibe mogakorwa koba abasomba b’oboronge.
english: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.

ekegusii: Ere okorire omobere one obeire nemenia, na eyio yambereire kirori; oboreu bwane bwaorokeire ase obosio bwane kombera kirori.
english: You have bound me-- and it has become a witness; my gauntness rises up and testifies against me.

ekegusii: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.
english: Gwatagoire chindwaki chiaye chionsi gwatagoire amaagacho aye onsi are amakong’u abeire amatombe.

ekegusii: Naki iga mwarenta abanto aba bataibeti ebinto bie hekalu gose korama enyasae yaito enkungu.
english: You have brought these men here, though they have neither robbed temples nor blasphemed our goddess.

ekegusii: Aye gwasiekire ebirengererio biabo tibiba nokomanya, ase ayio tokobaimokereria igoro na kobaa okobua.
english: You have closed their minds to understanding; therefore you will not let them triumph.

ekegusii: You have condemned and murdered innocent men, who were not opposing you.
english: Mwagambirie omonyene oboronge na komoita, na ere tabaamerereti inwe.

ekegusii: You have covered yourself with a cloud so that no prayer can get through.
english: Aye omonyene gwetubire riire, ng’a ogosaba gwaito tikogoika ang’e.

ekegusii: Kwanachire amatuko aye ay’obosae abeire ameng’e, boigo kwamotubire nobosooku obonge mono.
english: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame. Selah

ekegusii: Rituko ria rero kwaorokirie ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae oo, naende ng’a nobwatie chinchera chiaye chionsi na kobwata emeroberio yaye echikire, na amachiko aye, na aya onsi achikire, naende ng’a nomoigwere.
english: You have declared this day that the LORD is your God and that you will walk in his ways, that you will keep his decrees, commands and laws, and that you will obey him.

ekegusii: Aye gwantooririe korwa ase okoamererania nabanto, kwambekire nabeire omogambi bw’abanto b’ebisaku; abanto ntamanyete, bono babeire abasomba baane.
english: You have delivered me from the attacks of the people; you have made me the head of nations; people I did not know are subject to me.

ekegusii: Gwachayire ebinto biane ebichenu, naende gwakorire Chisabato chiane chiabeire echitachenegeti.
english: You have despised my holy things and desecrated my Sabbaths.

ekegusii: Korende aye gwakorire ayare amabe goetania baria bonsi bagotang’anerete. Naende gwekoreire chinyasae ching’ao, na kweroiseirie emegwekano enyititoire na kobombwa, na igo kwangechirie goika nabeire nendamwamu kwangire na konyeba.
english: You have done more evil than all who lived before you. You have made for yourself other gods, idols made of metal; you have provoked me to anger and thrust me behind your back.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene gwasesenirie egesaku, na kerokio kiabuchire, kwarure omogoko, na oro obeire omonge; abanto abwo nigo bare nomochengo ase obosio bwao, buna abanto bakoba nomochengo ase engaki ye rigesa, na buna bakogoka ekero bagwatanana ebisakorwa.
english: You have enlarged the nation and increased their joy; they rejoice before you as people rejoice at the harvest, as men rejoice when dividing the plunder.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, gwakorire egesaku eke kementekane; ee, gwakementekanirie; ase ayio aye gwatogigwe, kwagareeirie ense y’egesaku eke.
english: You have enlarged the nation, O LORD; you have enlarged the nation. You have gained glory for yourself; you have extended all the borders of the land.

ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.
english: You have established your people Israel as your very own forever, and you, O LORD, have become their God.

ekegusii: You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; fine oils have been poured upon me.
english: Gwakinirie orogunchara rwane rwabeire buna orw’eng’era, kwang’umoreire amaguta amayia.

ekegusii: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.
english: Abwo bakomochanda aye kwabaeire chinguru chinyinge, na kwagerire ababisa baye bonsi bagoke.

ekegusii: You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.
english: Aye gwakorire amariga ’omoichano koba endagera yabo, kwabanyoisirie amariga amange mono.

ekegusii: Omosasoko oyo kwang’eire ase enkoro yane ime nigo are omuya kobua oyo abanto bande bakonyora, abwo bare nobonge bw’endagera na edivai.
english: You have filled my heart with greater joy than when their grain and new wine abound.

ekegusii: Inwe mwebire Nyasae ore ogotooreka kwaino, na timori koinyora Egetare kere obotamero bwaino. Ase ayio nigo mokoroisia emegondo emiya, mwasimeka emesabibu emiegarori.
english: You have forgotten God your Savior; you have not remembered the Rock, your fortress. Therefore, though you set out the finest plants and plant imported vines,

ekegusii: Gwaikeranirie amang’ana ao, ayio gwakwanete asetore, na ase abagambi baria barenge gotogambera, ase ogotorentera amaakwa amanene. Inse y’erioba ayio akorekanire ase Yerusalemu tana gokorekana aande.
english: You have fulfilled the words spoken against us and against our rulers by bringing upon us great disaster. Under the whole heaven nothing has ever been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.

ekegusii: Aye kwabwatirie chingencho chia mosubati omino. Ase engencho eyio ninkoe egekombe ki’egesusuro buna eki naruete asare.
english: You have gone the way of your sister; so I will put her cup into your hand.

ekegusii: Kwamoeire okogania gw’enkoro yaye; na totangeti aya aboretie korwa asore.
english: You have granted him the desire of his heart and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

ekegusii: “Inwe mwaigure amang’ana ayio, bono yarore onsi! Inee! Timokoyaorokia? Korwa bono na kogenderera nkobaorokeria inde amang’ana amayia, amang’ana konya abisekanete motana komanya.
english: You have heard these things; look at them all. Will you not admit them? "From now on I will tell you of new things, of hidden things unknown to you.

ekegusii: Nigo kwamentete abaonchoreria bao bakaba abange goetania ching’enang’eni chia igoro, bakaba buna ebisase bie chingige, bakaria ense bakairuruka, bakagenda.
english: You have increased the number of your merchants till they are more than the stars of the sky, but like locusts they strip the land and then fly away.

ekegusii: Ekero kwabuire Abaedomu kwaenenire ase enkoro yao. Isaneka nobonene obwo, naende beera inka bwoo. Nase ki ogotubora emechando ebaise kogera ogwe aye amo n’Abayuda?”
english: You have indeed defeated Edom and now you are arrogant. Glory in your victory, but stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?"

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti nigo kwarua ogochika ng’a kera omonto okoigwa eriogi ri’ebitureri, na ebiroria, na amakano ao ao, na amarandi, na amariogi a kera egento ki’amatera, goika atung’ame inse na gosasima omogwekano oria bw’etahabu,
english: You have issued a decree, O king, that everyone who hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes and all kinds of music must fall down and worship the image of gold,

ekegusii: Ase rituko ria rero kwaorokirie buna gwakorire amaya asende, ekiagera otang’ita ekero Omonene ambeka ase okoboko kwao.
english: You have just now told me of the good you did to me; the LORD delivered me into your hands, but you did not kill me.

ekegusii: Aye gwaikeranirie eira eria kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata. Aria gwakwanete nomonwa oo kwayaikeranirie nokoboko kwao rituko ria rero.
english: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it-- as it is today.

ekegusii: Aye gwaikeranirie eira eria kwarierete omosomba oo Daudi tata. Aria gwakwanete nomonwa oo, kwayaikeranirie nokoboko kwao rituko ria rero.
english: You have kept your promise to your servant David my father; with your mouth you have promised and with your hand you have fulfilled it-- as it is today.

ekegusii: Mwaitire abanto abange goetania, ase omochie oyo, mwaichoirie chinchera chiaye nebitondo.
english: You have killed many people in this city and filled its streets with the dead.

ekegusii: You have laid down precepts that are to be fully obeyed.
english: Aye gwatoeire amachiko ao, toyarende nomokia.

ekegusii: “Igo mogotiga richiko ria Nyasae, mwabwata chingencho chia mwanyabanto.”
english: You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to the traditions of men."

ekegusii: Yaya, nigo mwabogoretie Moleki, enyasae yaino, na eng’enang’eni y’enyasae Refani, emegwekano eyio mwakorete, erinde moyesasime. Ase ayio nimbang’anyie goika ng’umbu ya Babeli.
english: You have lifted up the shrine of Molech and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship. Therefore I will send you into exile' beyond Babylon.

ekegusii: Inwe mobogorie Sikuti, omogwekano oyio mogosasima buna omoruoti oino, na Kiyuni, enyasae yaino ye ching’enang’eni mweroiseretie.
english: You have lifted up the shrine of your king, the pedestal of your idols, the star of your god--which you made for yourselves.

ekegusii: Igo momenyete ase ense eye ase okwegokia, na timwetangeti ase okogania kwaino. Mwenoririe ase chinkoro chiaino goika rituko ri’okonyenya.
english: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. You have fattened yourselves in the day of slaughter.

ekegusii: Nigo bwanchete oboronge, na kogechete ogosaria; ase ayio, Nyasae, oyore Nyasae oo, ogoakire amaguta, korenteire omogoko kobua oyo bw’abande bamino.”
english: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy."

ekegusii: Aye nomanyie enchera ekogenda ase obogima; ase obosio bwao noreo omogoko omonge; ase ensemo yao y’okorio mboreo obwansu obuya goika kare na kare.
english: You have made known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

ekegusii: Kwanyorokereirie chinchera chi’obogima; nong’ichorie omogoko ase obosio bwao.
english: You have made known to me the paths of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence.'

ekegusii: Aye gwakorire abanto babe buna chinswe chi’enyancha, na buna ebitongwa bikwagura bitabwati omogambi obo.
english: You have made men like fish in the sea, like sea creatures that have no ruler.

ekegusii: Naama! Amatuko kwang’ete nameng’e mono. Engaki y’obogima bwane nigo ere buna teri gento ase obosio bwao. Amaene, kera omonto, nonya bwetenenerete bokong’u, nigo agoeta bwango buna omwaga.
english: You have made my days a mere handbreadth; the span of my years is as nothing before you. Each man's life is but a breath. Selah

ekegusii: Aye gwatagoire omochie, kwayokorire obeire etui y’amagena, omochie oyio konya ogiteire chindwaki obeire ritongo. Gwasaririe chinyomba chinene chi’omochie bw’abamenyi, omochie oyio tokoagachwa naende.
english: You have made the city a heap of rubble, the fortified town a ruin, the foreigners' stronghold a city no more; it will never be rebuilt.

ekegusii: okabakora bakaba ab’oboruoti na abakuani ase Nyasae oito, na barabwo nigo baragambe ase ense.”
english: You have made them to be a kingdom and priests to serve our God, and they will reign on the earth."

ekegusii: Gwatokorire koba omorabaaro ase egati y’abanto b’ebisaku, twabeire togosingiserigwa emetwe nabanto.
english: You have made us a byword among the nations; the peoples shake their heads at us.

ekegusii: Gwatokorire koba okogechia ase abanto baito; twabeire togochaywa na gosekererwa nabanto batoetanaine.
english: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, the scorn and derision of those around us.

ekegusii: Aye gwatokorire twabeire abakwomanerwa ase egati y’abanto bare ang’e naintwe, na ababisa baito nigo bagendererete gotochecheria.
english: You have made us a source of contention to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.

ekegusii: Aye gwatokorire twabeire eubi na abaangire, ase egati y’ebisaku bi’ense.
english: You have made us scum and refuse among the nations.

ekegusii: Nigo okobeka ekerarero kiao ase egetunwa keimokererete igoro mono, erio gwatiira gochiao korua ekeng’wanso.
english: You have made your bed on a high and lofty hill; there you went up to offer your sacrifices.

ekegusii: Nigo obwate abakori emeremo abange: ababaachi amagena, na abaagacheri amagena, na abasenia be chibao, na abanto bamanyete gokora emeremo ende yonsi
english: You have many workmen: stonecutters, masons and carpenters, as well as men skilled in every kind of work

ekegusii: Korwa amatuko a kare timwana koyaigwa, gose koyamanya, naki amato aino tatinoretwe moyaigwe. Nigo namanyete ng’a timwarenge koba abegenwa, ekiagera mwabeire abasaria korwa okoiborwa kwaino.
english: You have neither heard nor understood; from of old your ear has not been open. Well do I know how treacherous you are; you were called a rebel from birth.

ekegusii: Tori negetari gose nensemo ase ring’ana eri, ekiagera enkoro yao teri boronge ase obosio bwa Nyasae.
english: You have no part or share in this ministry, because your heart is not right before God.

ekegusii: Timwangorerete ebinto bigotioka buya ne chibesa chiaino. Timwang’isanegetie nebitinya bi’ebing’wanso biaino. Taibo! Korende nigo mwandosirie nebibe biaino; mwanchandire nogosaria kwaino.
english: You have not bought any fragrant calamus for me, or lavished on me the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened me with your sins and wearied me with your offenses.

ekegusii: Inwe timwandeterete ching’ondi chiaino chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosambwa, gose timwansigete ase okonduera ebing’wanso biaino. Inche timbaroseti ase okonduera okoruegwa kw’endagera, gose timbachandeti ase ogonsambera ubani.
english: You have not brought me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with grain offerings nor wearied you with demands for incense.

ekegusii: Naki timoraika ase egetunwa keranyare gokunwa, kegwoka omorero, gose omosunte, ne riire rimwamu, na ekembobe,
english: You have not come to a mountain that can be touched and that is burning with fire; to darkness, gloom and storm;

ekegusii: Barabwo tibatiirete gochia aase atagoire, gose tibagiterete Abaisraeli chindwaki, erinde bekengere ase esegi ye rituko ri’Omonene.
english: You have not gone up to the breaks in the wall to repair it for the house of Israel so that it will stand firm in the battle on the day of the LORD.

ekegusii: Tombegeti ase amaboko ’omobisa one; korende gwatenenirie amagoro aane aase are aagare.
english: You have not handed me over to the enemy but have set my feet in a spacious place.

ekegusii: Echio chire chindeu, timori gochibeka chinguru, na echire chindwaire, timori gochigwenia, na echibunegete, timori gochiboera ebitete, na echiaserebekanire, timori gochiirania asende, na echiasirire, timori gochirigia; mwabeire mogochigambera ase ogochibetereria more nobotindi.
english: You have not strengthened the weak or healed the sick or bound up the injured. You have not brought back the strays or searched for the lost. You have ruled them harshly and brutally.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwabeire mokobwatia amachiko ’Omuri, na ogokora gwonsi kw’enyomba y’Ahabu, naende mwabeire mokoigwera ogosemia kwabo. Ase ayio nimbasirie kegima, na abamenyete ime yao babe bagochaywa, na igo mobogorie okoramwa okwo abanto baane barametwe.”
english: You have observed the statutes of Omri and all the practices of Ahab's house, and you have followed their traditions. Therefore I will give you over to ruin and your people to derision; you will bear the scorn of the nations."

ekegusii: Naende okaremereria na kwebogoreria amange ase engencho y’erieta riane, na toroseti.
english: You have persevered and have endured hardships for my name, and have not grown weary.

ekegusii: Nigo mokobusura chimbusuro chinyinge, korende mwagesa chinke; nigo mokoragera, korende timori koigota; nkonywa more, korende timori goisaneka; nigo mokobeka chianga, korende timori koigwa riberera; oyo okonyora eng’eria, nigo akoyenyora erinde oyebeka ase omobuko obochogete.
english: You have planted much, but have harvested little. You eat, but never have enough. You drink, but never have your fill. You put on clothes, but are not warm. You earn wages, only to put them in a purse with holes in it."

ekegusii: Aye kwabasimekire, nabarabwo bairire emeri inse. Nigo bagokina, naende baama. Barabwo nigo bakomanyete ase emenwa yabo rioka, korende chinkoro chiabo nigo chire aare naye.
english: You have planted them, and they have taken root; they grow and bear fruit. You are always on their lips but far from their hearts.

ekegusii: Aye kwarenteire enyomba yao obosooku ase ogoita abanto abange, na igo gwakorire ebibe bi’ogosiria obogima bwao aye omonyene.
english: You have plotted the ruin of many peoples, shaming your own house and forfeiting your life.

ekegusii: Inwe mwankorire nabeire buna nigo inde oyotachenegeti ase egati y’abanto baane, ase okogania esairi eichire roe, na ebisamunye bi’omogati. Mwaitire abatagwenerete goitwa, na abagwenerete goitwa mwatigire koba moyo. Ayio nigo mwayakorire ase okong’ainereria abanto baane, abwo bagwancherana nay’oborimo.
english: You have profaned me among my people for a few handfuls of barley and scraps of bread. By lying to my people, who listen to lies, you have killed those who should not have died and have spared those who should not live.

ekegusii: Kwamourire obonene bwaye, gwaakeire inse ekerogo kiaye ki’obogambi.
english: You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.

ekegusii: Kwambekire inse kegima ase embeera ime; agwo aase are omosunte na aatambe gochia inse.
english: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

ekegusii: Aye gwatogonyeire abanto b’ebisaku na gosiria abakori amabe, gwasiririe amarieta abo, tibakoinyorwa kare na kare.
english: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.

ekegusii: Omonene nigo agoteba iga: Inwe abanyene mwanyangire, mwairanire nyuma, mwantigire. Ase engencho eyio naramboire okoboko kwane kobasiria kegima, ekiagera narosire ase okobarorera amabera.
english: You have rejected me," declares the LORD. "You keep on backsliding. So I will lay hands on you and destroy you; I can no longer show compassion.

ekegusii: Bono gwatigire okobwatana kwao kw’ogotianania gwakorete nomosomba oo, kwarutire egutwa yaye y’obogambi inse kwayemwamirie.
english: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.

ekegusii: Omosomba one nigo akorora ebinto ebinge, korende tari kobirengereria ng’a nebi’engencho enene; nigo atinogete amato aye, korende tari koigwa.”
english: You have seen many things, but have paid no attention; your ears are open, but you hear nothing."

ekegusii: Aye kwarorire buna ababisa baane baganetie korusia egesiomba, na buna bakorire emeroberio emebe asende.
english: You have seen the depth of their vengeance, all their plots against me.

ekegusii: Kwarorire obobe obo nakoreirwe, onache ekina kiane ase oboronge.
english: You have seen, O LORD, the wrong done to me. Uphold my cause!

ekegusii: Amabe aya twakorire nigo oyabegete ase obosio bwao, na ebibe biaito bia bobisi nigo bire maiso marore asore.
english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

ekegusii: Aye gwatengechirie ense na koyetandora; iraneria naende amatandoku ayio, ekiagera nigo egotengecha mono.
english: You have shaken the land and torn it open; mend its fractures, for it is quaking.

ekegusii: Gwakorire abanto bao babeire nemechando emekong’u; gwatonyoisirie edivai yatotindirie na gotoong’anyia.
english: You have shown your people desperate times; you have given us wine that makes us stagger.

ekegusii: Aye moiseke ominto, omoriakari one, kwang’usire enkoro yane na kwangokirie, okorigereria kw’amaiso ao kwang’usire enkoro yane, ee, esonoi eyemo yoka ye chisonoi chia igoti riao yang’usire.
english: You have stolen my heart, my sister, my bride; you have stolen my heart with one glance of your eyes, with one jewel of your necklace.

ekegusii: Kwabekire aare abagisangio baane twamanyaine, gwankorire nabeire okogechia asebare; nasiekereirwe, tinkonyara gosoka.
english: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;

ekegusii: Aye gwatananire omwanchwa one na omosani one bambeereire aare, na omosunte obeire omogisangio one.
english: You have taken my companions and loved ones from me; the darkness is my closest friend.

ekegusii: “Nigo kwabete noboremu ase ogokora kwao okobe, ogateba:” “Onde tandochi.” “Obong’aini bwao, ne chisemi chiao, nigo biagosiretie, ogateba ase enkoro yao ime:” “Inche ninche, onde tari otatiga inche bweka.”
english: You have trusted in your wickedness and have said, 'No one sees me.' Your wisdom and knowledge mislead you when you say to yourself, 'I am, and there is none besides me.'

ekegusii: Kwairanirie omoro oye bw’esegi, tori komoa chinguru chi’okorwana esegi.
english: You have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.

ekegusii: Inwe mwarosirie Omonene namang’ana aino. Nigo mokoboria: “Naki twamorosirie?” Nekiagera mogoteba ng’a kera omonto ogokora ebibe nigo are omuya ase obosio bw’Omonene, naende ng’a Omonene nigo akogokigwa noyio. Naende mwaboria; “Ng’ai Nyasae oyo okonacha ebina are?”
english: You have wearied the LORD with your words. "How have we wearied him?" you ask. By saying, "All who do evil are good in the eyes of the LORD, and he is pleased with them" or "Where is the God of justice?"

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogotegerera abanto abaitongo abagokogania; nigo okobaigwa na kobeka chinkoro chiabo chinguru.
english: You hear, O LORD, the desire of the afflicted; you encourage them, and you listen to their cry,

ekegusii: na aye okaigwa okorera kwane; toticha amato ao ase ogwechanda kwane ekero nkorera.
english: You heard my plea: "Do not close your ears to my cry for relief."

ekegusii: Aye nigo ong’etanaine ase chinsemo chionsi, na nigo obegete okoboko kwao igoro yane ondendete.
english: You hem me in-- behind and before; you have laid your hand upon me.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwandutete gochia ase chindiba, inse kegima y’enyancha, ne chiooro chi’enyancha chiang’etananire. Na emerindo yao yonsi ekaimokerera igoro egantuba.
english: You hurled me into the deep, into the very heart of the seas, and the currents swirled about me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.

ekegusii: Aye omong’ianereria, rusia ritang’ani omoribo ore ase eriso riao, nario orarore buya omanye korusia ekeogoto korwa ase eriso ri’oyomino.
english: You hypocrite, first take the plank out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother's eye.

ekegusii: Inwe abang’ainereria! Mbuya Isaya abanete igoro asemore, ekero atebete:
english: You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you:

ekegusii: Ekeene, inwe nabo mwarengereretie gonkorera amabe, korende Nyasae akayaonchora akaba amaya, na buna mwarorire rero iga, otooririe obogima bw’abanto abange.
english: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogambia ase okobwatia amang’ana a mwanyabanto; inche tindi kogambia omonto.
english: You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, nigo ogotanga amaiso aane takonyora chitoro. Nigo nchandegete mono, tinkonyara gokwana.
english: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.

ekegusii: Mogaita Omorua bw’obogima. Korende Nyasae akamobokia korwa ase abakure, na ase ayio intwe nigo tore abarori.
english: You killed the author of life, but God raised him from the dead. We are witnesses of this.

ekegusii: Tomanyeti Abineri, mosinto o Neri? Ere igo acha aa gokong’aina, naende amanye chinsemo ase okogenda na ebinto ebi ogokora.”
english: You know Abner son of Ner; he came to deceive you and observe your movements and find out everything you are doing."

ekegusii: Aye nomanyete amabe nakoreirwe, na buna nasookigwe na gochaywa; nigo omanyete ababisa baane bonsi.
english: You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed; all my enemies are before you.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, nomanyete oboriri bwane, naki amamocho aane tabisekaneti korwa asore.
english: You know my folly, O God; my guilt is not hidden from you.

ekegusii: Kwamanyire ng’a bonsi abare Asia bantigire, na ase abwo mbareo Figelo na Hermogene.
english: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.

ekegusii: Inche tinabisete ring’ana rinde rionsi eriranyare kobakonya, korende inaborogetie inwe maiso marore enyomba ase enyomba,
english: You know that I have not hesitated to preach anything that would be helpful to you but have taught you publicly and from house to house.

ekegusii: You know that I've worked for your father with all my strength,
english: Inwe momanyete ng’a nabeire ngokorera iso ne chinguru chiane chionsi;

ekegusii: Bono baminto, mwamanyire ng’a abanto ba nyomba mwa Stefana nigo barenge abe ritang’ani koonchoka agwo Akaya; na barabwo bebekire ase emeremo y’ogokorera abachenu.
english: You know that the household of Stephanas were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. I urge you, brothers,

ekegusii: Mwamanyire ng’a ekero mwarenge ab’Ebisaku nigo mware koirwa ase emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, eyio etarenge gokwana, buna mware gotang’anwa.
english: You know that when you were pagans, somehow or other you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.

ekegusii: You know the commandments: 'Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not give false testimony, honor your father and mother.'"
english: Kwamanyire amachiko; Totomana, Toita, Toiba, Toteba oborimo, sika iso na nyoko.”

ekegusii: You know the commandments: 'Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not give false testimony, do not defraud, honor your father and mother.'"
english: Kwamanyire amachiko: Toita, Totomana, Toiba, Toteba oborimo, Tong’aina, Sika iso na nyoko.”

ekegusii: Agatoma ring’ana eri ase Abaisraeli, akarandia amang’ana amaya ay’omorembe korwa ase Yeso Kristo, oyore Omonene o bonsi.
english: You know the message God sent to the people of Israel, telling the good news of peace through Jesus Christ, who is Lord of all.

ekegusii: Naase nkogenda inche, mwamanyire enchera.”
english: You know the way to the place where I am going."

ekegusii: Naki titwarenge namang’ana ay’okogwenera abanto, buna mwamanyire, gose ay’okobiserera obwegimeria. Nyasae nere kirori.
english: You know we never used flattery, nor did we put on a mask to cover up greed-- God is our witness.

ekegusii: Inwe momanyete, ng’a ring’ana eri riararetigwe ase Boyahudi yonsi, rigachakera Galili nyuma y’ebatiso eria Yohana arandetie,
english: You know what has happened throughout Judea, beginning in Galilee after the baptism that John preached--

ekegusii: Aye nigo omanyete ekero ing’ikaransete, na ekero inkoimoka. Nigo omanyete ebirengererio biane bionsi kore aare.
english: You know when I sit and when I rise; you perceive my thoughts from afar.

ekegusii: Naende Husai akamotebia, “Nomanyete iso na abanto baye, ng’a nabanto chituoni chi’esegi, bare abakong’u, naende nigo bare abatindi buna edubu yaurirwe chimanwa chiaye ase orosana. Iso nomonto omanyete korwana esegi, takorara botuko, ere nabanto baye.
english: You know your father and his men; they are fighters, and as fierce as a wild bear robbed of her cubs. Besides, your father is an experienced fighter; he will not spend the night with the troops.

ekegusii: Abaminto, inwe abanyene mwamanyire ng’a ogosoa gwaito ase egati yaino tikwabete okwa bosa.
english: You know, brothers, that our visit to you was not a failure.

ekegusii: Naboigo mworokereretigwe n’Epafara, omosomba omogisangio oito omwanchwa, oyore omosomba omwegenwa ase Kristo ase engencho yaino.
english: You learned it from Epaphras, our dear fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwaraaete abanto bao buna riicho rikoraagwa, ee, okabaraa goetera ase amaboko a Musa na Haroni.
english: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwarentete ababisa baito bagatotacha emetwe. Intwe nigo twaetete ime y’omorero na amache, korende nonya nabo, ogatorusiao, ogatobeka ase obuya obonge bore.
english: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino inwe aba mokorarera amarere achabeire amaino e chinchogu, naende mwaba mokwerambora ase ebirogo biaino bigwotota. Nigo mokoba mokoria chimanwa chie ching’ondi chichorire, ne chimori chinoru korwa ase ameeri.
english: You lie on beds inlaid with ivory and lounge on your couches. You dine on choice lambs and fattened calves.

ekegusii: Omonene otebire ng’a ase omenyete abanto nigo bagokora oborianania ase oborianania bonde. Na obong’ainereria ase obong’ainereria bonde, bangire konyigwera.
english: You live in the midst of deception; in their deceit they refuse to acknowledge me," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Aye ore noromeme rw’obong’ainereria, nigo bwanchete gokwana amang’ana agosaria.
english: You love every harmful word, O you deceitful tongue!

ekegusii: Aye nigo bwanchete amabe kobua amaya, nigo bwanchete gokwana oborimo kobua ekeene.
english: You love evil rather than good, falsehood rather than speaking the truth. Selah

ekegusii: Aye nigo bwanchete oboronge na kogechete ebibe. Ase ayio, Nyasae, oyore Nyasae oo ogoakire amaguta, okorenteire omogoko kobua oyo bw’abande bamino.
english: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy.

ekegusii: Nigo bwanchete abwo bakogechete na kogecha abwo bagwanchete. Naki rero kworokirie maiso marore ng’a abatang’ani na abasomba bao barabwo mbosa bare asore. Rero nario namanya ng’a onye Abisalomu moyo arenge, na intwe twensi tobe twakure, erio nanga nigo kwaigwa buya.
english: You love those who hate you and hate those who love you. You have made it clear today that the commanders and their men mean nothing to you. I see that you would be pleased if Absalom were alive today and all of us were dead.

ekegusii: Kwamokorire omoke kobua abamalaika ase ekero egeke, kwamobekeire egutwa y’obonene na amasikani. [Kwamobekire igoro ase emeremo y’amaboko ao.]
english: You made him a little lower than the angels; you crowned him with glory and honor

ekegusii: You made him a little lower than the heavenly beings and crowned him with glory and honor.
english: Kwamokorire koba inse ake asore aye omonyene, Nyasae; kwamoboirie obonene na amasikani.

ekegusii: Kwamobekire kogambera ebinto bionsi gwatongete; kwabekire ebitongwa bionsi inse y’amagoro aye:
english: You made him ruler over the works of your hands; you put everything under his feet:

ekegusii: Okaborokereria bakamanya Esabato yao Enchenu, naende okabaa emeroberio na amachiko goetera ase Musa, omosomba oo.”
english: You made known to them your holy Sabbath and gave them commands, decrees and laws through your servant Moses.

ekegusii: Ogaseria ababisa baane bagatama korwa asende, abangechete nkabasiria kegima.
english: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.

ekegusii: Ogakora ababisa baane bagatama korwa asende; abangechete nkabasiria kegima.
english: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.

ekegusii: Okabaa abana abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, na okabarenta ase ense eyio kwarierete chisokoro chiabo eira ng’a ebe eyabo.
english: You made their sons as numerous as the stars in the sky, and you brought them into the land that you told their fathers to enter and possess.

ekegusii: Gwatokorire gotama ababisa baito, na barabwo babeire bagosakora ebinto biaito.
english: You made us retreat before the enemy, and our adversaries have plundered us.

ekegusii: Aye gwekoreire abanto bao Abaisraeli babe abanto bao kare na kare, naye Omonene kwabeire Nyasae obo.
english: You made your people Israel your very own forever, and you, O LORD, have become their God.

ekegusii: Nabo oranyare kogora abana b’abamenyi baria bamenyete asemore, abana babo baria baiboreire ase ense yaino babe abaino.
english: You may also buy some of the temporary residents living among you and members of their clans born in your country, and they will become your property.

ekegusii: Komorasabe kende gionsi ase erieta riane, ekio ningekore.
english: You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.

ekegusii: Namoisa koboria: Ninki torarie ase omwaka o gatano na kabere, onye titogosimeka gose gosangereria okwama?
english: You may ask, "What will we eat in the seventh year if we do not plant or harvest our crops?"

ekegusii: Naki nekeene, aye gwatogirie buya, korende oria oyonde taagachiri.
english: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other man is not edified.

ekegusii: Manya ng’a omonto onga buna oyio bweatananire, naende nomokori ebibe, na ere omonyene bwegambirie.
english: You may be sure that such a man is warped and sinful; he is self-condemned.

ekegusii: Monyare kondetera ebinto ebio buna ogotongora kw’endagera, korende timobaisa kobisambera ase egesasimero. Moise gokora igo, tigokoba ne rimisu rigiya rikongwenera.
english: You may bring them to the LORD as an offering of the firstfruits, but they are not to be offered on the altar as a pleasing aroma.

ekegusii: Nonyare gosaba ebitoki korwa ase omonto omomenyi kwaete singo, korende tari korwa ase omonto omino Omoisraeli. Koraigwere amang’ana ayio, rirorio Omonene Nyasae oino, nagosesenie ase ense eria mogochia koira ebe eyaino.
english: You may charge a foreigner interest, but not a brother Israelite, so that the LORD your God may bless you in everything you put your hand to in the land you are entering to possess.

ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi ebwate ebitaago biatananegete kegima, naende ekoria eng’ang’ura, nero morarie.
english: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof completely divided and that chews the cud.

ekegusii: Kera eng’iti ebwate ebitaago biatananegete gati ase chinsemo ibere, naende chikoria eng’ang’ura, echio nachio morarie.
english: You may eat any animal that has a split hoof divided in two and that chews the cud.

ekegusii: You may eat any clean bird.
english: “Chinyoni chionsi chichenegete namochirie.

ekegusii: Omomenyi ere nakoiranerie egento kwamoete singo. Korende egento kende gionsi kwaete oyomino tomosaba akoiranerie.
english: You may require payment from a foreigner, but you must cancel any debt your brother owes you.

ekegusii: Mwerende, timobaisa gokwana ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Okobua gwaito ne chinguru chi’amaboko aito nachio chiatonyoreire obotenenku obo.
english: You may say to yourself, "My power and the strength of my hands have produced this wealth for me."

ekegusii: “Na komoreborie ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Naki torakore tomanye gose ring’ana riria rigokwanwa neri’Omonene?
english: You may say to yourselves, "How can we know when a message has not been spoken by the LORD?"

ekegusii: “Moise goteba ase chinkoro chiaino ime: Ebisaku ebi nigo bire ebinene gotobua, naki toranyare kobiseria birueo?
english: You may say to yourselves, "These nations are stronger than we are. How can we drive them out?"

ekegusii: “Aya naro narikire, ekiagera inwe mwatebire ng’a Omonene obaeire ababani agwo ase ense ya Babeli.
english: You may say, "The LORD has raised up prophets for us in Babylon,"

ekegusii: Oire amage oka, korende eng’ina ero oyetige eiruruke egende. Korakore igo nebe buya asore, naende nobe moyo ase engaki entambe.
english: You may take the young, but be sure to let the mother go, so that it may go well with you and you may have a long life.

ekegusii: Eeri gose emanwa y’eng’ondi ebwate ekiimo egetambe goetania ekende, gose ekieng’e mono, nabo oranyare koyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogwancha, korende ase okoyerua ebe ekeng’wanso ki’ogoikerania eira kwariete, tegwancherwa nainche.
english: You may, however, present as a freewill offering an ox or a sheep that is deformed or stunted, but it will not be accepted in fulfillment of a vow.

ekegusii: Motogie Omonene, inwe ebitunwa na ebigoro bionsi, nainwe emete ekwama amatunda, na emecharake yonsi,
english: you mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

ekegusii: Inwe ebitunwa, ninki kiagerete mogachara‐charara buna chimingichi, nainwe ebigoro boigo buna chimanwa chie ching’ondi?
english: you mountains, that you skipped like rams, you hills, like lambs?

ekegusii: Morende mono na gokora amang’ana ayio barabwo barabatebie korwa aase agwo Omonene arachore. Mokore koreng’ana buna barabasemie.
english: You must act according to the decisions they give you at the place the LORD will choose. Be careful to do everything they direct you to do.

ekegusii: Naende roberia abarwani b’esegi bang’ana buna abwo baitwa, ne chibarasi ne chigari ching’ana buna echio chiasirigwa, erio tobarwanie ase ense omweya; ekeene, goika tobe ne chinguru kobabua.” Omoruoti agancha amang’ana abo, naende agakora buna bamotebetie.
english: You must also raise an army like the one you lost-- horse for horse and chariot for chariot-- so we can fight Israel on the plains. Then surely we will be stronger than they." He agreed with them and acted accordingly.

ekegusii: Emeroberio yane yonsi echikire, na amachiko aane onsi, aria nabarikerete, moyarende botambe na koyakorera. Timobaisa koiroka chinyasae chinde ching’ao,
english: You must always be careful to keep the decrees and ordinances, the laws and commands he wrote for you. Do not worship other gods.

ekegusii: Inwe goika mobe abaikeranu ase obosio bw’Omonene, Nyasae oino.”
english: You must be blameless before the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Momoite akwe. Aye obe oyo bwe ritang’ani komoaka amagena; nyuma y’ayio abanto bonsi bamanye komoaka amagena.
english: You must certainly put him to death. Your hand must be the first in putting him to death, and then the hands of all the people.

ekegusii: moite abanto bonsi b’omochie oyio nemioro. Mosarie omochie oyio kegima amo nebinto bionsi bireo, ne chitugo mochiite boigo.
english: you must certainly put to the sword all who live in that town. Destroy it completely, both its people and its livestock.

ekegusii: Abanto abwo bonsi Omonene, Nyasae oino, arabeke ase amaboko aino, mobasirie, timobarorera amabera. Timobaisa gokorera chinyasae chiabo, ekiagera ase ogokora igo, chirochio nachinyare kobatega.”
english: You must destroy all the peoples the LORD your God gives over to you. Do not look on them with pity and do not serve their gods, for that will be a snare to you.

ekegusii: Inwe goika momanye gwatanana egento egechenu kere ekia Nyasae korwa ase ekio getaatananiri koba egechenu, na egento gechenegete korwa ase egetachenegeti.
english: You must distinguish between the holy and the common, between the unclean and the clean,

ekegusii: na igo momanye gwatanana ebichenegete korwa ase ebitachenegeti, ne ching’iti chire moyo chiancheire koriegwa korwa ase echitancheiri koriegwa.
english: You must distinguish between the unclean and the clean, between living creatures that may be eaten and those that may not be eaten.'"

ekegusii: Mokorere ebirengo bi’ekeene, naende ebiisaine bi’okomanya oborito na obonge; erio nario amatuko aino arabe amange ase ense eria Omonene, Nyasae oino, agochia kobaa.
english: You must have accurate and honest weights and measures, so that you may live long in the land the LORD your God is giving you.

ekegusii: Ase ayio ogochika oko goika okorende omwaka ase omwaka ase engaki eyio echikire.”
english: You must keep this ordinance at the appointed time year after year.

ekegusii: Timobaisa korenta ase enyomba y’Omonene, Nyasae oino, chibesa chikonyorekana korwa ase obonyaka bw’abakungu, gose obw’abasacha banga buna chisese, ase ogoikerania chiira. Chibesa chikonyorekana korwa ase chinchera echio nigo chire okogechia ase Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: You must not bring the earnings of a female prostitute or of a male prostitute into the house of the LORD your God to pay any vow, because the LORD your God detests them both.

ekegusii: Timobaisa gokora buna abanto ba Misiri bagokora, agwo ase mwamenyete, gose buna abanto ba Kanani bagokora, ense eyio nkobaira mochie komenya, gose timobaisa kobwatia chingencho chiabo.
english: You must not do as they do in Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. Do not follow their practices.

ekegusii: Timobaisa koria okwama okwo okoyia: Ebigara ebibese, gose ebikarangire, gose ebiaroisigwe emegati, ekero motararentera Nyasae oino okoruegwa kwaino kw’ogotongora. Ogochika okwo nigo koragenderere asemore ebiaare ase ebiaare, aande onsi ase moramenye.
english: You must not eat any bread, or roasted or new grain, until the very day you bring this offering to your God. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

ekegusii: Agwo ase momenyete ase emechie yaino timobaisa korierao ensemo ya ikomi y’endagera yaino, gose ey’edivai, gose ey’amaguta ’amazeituni, gose chintangi chiaino chie chiombe, ne ching’ondi, ne chimbori, gose ebi mwarierete Omonene eira komoruera, gose okoruegwa kwaino kw’ogwancha, gose okoruegwa konde gwonsi.
english: You must not eat in your own towns the tithe of your grain and new wine and oil, or the firstborn of your herds and flocks, or whatever you have vowed to give, or your freewill offerings or special gifts.

ekegusii: Timoyaria, korende nigo morayaitere ase riroba buna amache.
english: You must not eat the blood; pour it out on the ground like water.

ekegusii: You must not eat their meat or touch their carcasses; they are unclean for you.
english: Timoria chinyama chie ching’iti echio, gose timokuna emebere yabo ekwete, ekiagera echio tichichenegeti.”

ekegusii: Omobere oye totigwa ore ase omote igoro obotuko obogima, korende otindekwe ase rituko erio erio, ekiagera omonto oitirwe ase ogosungwa nigo aragereirie na Nyasae. Timobaisa gotiga ense yaino ebe nobobe, ense eyio Omonene, Nyasae oino, abaeire ebe omwando oino.
english: you must not leave his body on the tree overnight. Be sure to bury him that same day, because anyone who is hung on a tree is under God's curse. You must not desecrate the land the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance.

ekegusii: Ekero oramoe chibesa chia singo, tobaisa komosaba ebitoki korwa asare.
english: You must not lend him money at interest or sell him food at a profit.

ekegusii: timobaisa koigwa amang’ana ’omobani oyio gose ay’omonyandoto oyio. Omonene, Nyasae oino, nigo akobateema, erinde arore gose momwanchete ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi, na emioyo yaino yonsi.
english: you must not listen to the words of that prophet or dreamer. The LORD your God is testing you to find out whether you love him with all your heart and with all your soul.

ekegusii: Timochia kobwatia chingencho chi’abanto b’egesaku keria ngochia goseria kerue ase amasio aino; barabwo nigo bakorete amang’ana ayio onsi, na ase engencho y’ayio nkagechigwa nabarabwo.
english: You must not live according to the customs of the nations I am going to drive out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

ekegusii: Eng’iti ende yonsi chingetia chiaye chisaregete ase ogosunyuntwa, gose ase okomiorigwa, gose ase okobutorwa, gose ase okonatwa, timobaisa koyerua ebe ekeng’wanso asende. Timokora igo ase ense yaino.
english: You must not offer to the LORD an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, torn or cut. You must not do this in your own land,

ekegusii: “Timoruera ekeng’wanso ki’Epasaka ase emechie ende yaino, eyio Omonene Nyasae oino agochia kobaa.
english: You must not sacrifice the Passover in any town the LORD your God gives you

ekegusii: Timobaisa gosasima Omonene, Nyasae oino, buna barabwo barenge gosasima chinyasae chiabo. Barabwo nigo barenge gokora ase chinyasae chiabo kera egento kere okogechia, eke Nyasae agechete. Nigo bagosamba nomorero abana babo, abamura na abaiseke, babe ebing’wanso ase chinyasae chiabo.
english: You must not worship the LORD your God in their way, because in worshiping their gods, they do all kinds of detestable things the LORD hates. They even burn their sons and daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.

ekegusii: “Ekero mogosasima Omonene, Nyasae oino, timobaisa gokora buna abanto abwo bagokora.
english: You must not worship the LORD your God in their way.

ekegusii: Moigwere amachiko aane, na mokore aya nkobachika. Inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: You must obey my laws and be careful to follow my decrees. I am the LORD your God.

ekegusii: goika arue eeri, gose egoree, gose emingichi, chitari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, erio nario ekeng’wanso kerancherwe.
english: you must present a male without defect from the cattle, sheep or goats in order that it may be accepted on your behalf.

ekegusii: Korwa ase ebiegwa ebio bionsi moranyore korwa ase Abaisraeli, mwatananere Omonene biria bire ebiya mono.
english: You must present as the LORD's portion the best and holiest part of everything given to you.'

ekegusii: You must speak my words to them, whether they listen or fail to listen, for they are rebellious.
english: Amang’ana nkogotebia naro orabatebie kobarayategerere gose bayaange, ekiagera barabwo negesaku getari koigwera.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo morabeere agwo ase egesoero ki’Eema y’Omosangererekano, omobaso na obotuko, ase amatuko atano na abere, mobe mogokora aya Omonene achikire. Motakoreti ayio, inwe nigo morakwe.”
english: You must stay at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days and do what the LORD requires, so you will not die; for that is what I have been commanded."

ekegusii: Korende aye, kwana amang’ana ayagwenerete okworokereria kw’obogima.
english: You must teach what is in accord with sound doctrine.

ekegusii: “Inwe neching’ondi chiane, ee, nigo more ching’ondi chie riicho riane, inwe nigo more mwanyabanto, na inche nigo inde Nyasae oino. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are people, and I am your God, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Naki igo ebagwenerete mobe noboremereria, erinde komwaikire gokora ogwancha kwa Nyasae monyore aya mwarieretwe eira.
english: You need to persevere so that when you have done the will of God, you will receive what he has promised.

ekegusii: Aye tigwaisanegete ase okobwatia chinchera chiabo, gose aria gwakorete koreng’ana nokogechia kwabo, korende ase engaki enke yoka aye ogakora ayare amabe kobua ayabo, ase chinchera chiao chionsi.
english: You not only walked in their ways and copied their detestable practices, but in all your ways you soon became more depraved than they.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okomaanora okoboko kwao, kwarua amaya na goisanekia kera egetongwa kere moyo.
english: You open your hand and satisfy the desires of every living thing.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogendererete kobua omonto, na ere nigo agoeta osira, nigo okoonchora ekieni kiaye kwamosiria.
english: You overpower him once for all, and he is gone; you change his countenance and send him away.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene kwaorogetie ebikone na amakumia ase ense ya Misiri, naende ase amatuko aya nigo ogendererete kobiorokia ase Abaisraeli na ase mwanyabanto bonsi. Aye kwenyoreire erieta rinene goika rituko ria rero.
