english: You performed miraculous signs and wonders in Egypt and have continued them to this day, both in Israel and among all mankind, and have gained the renown that is still yours.

ekegusii: Kwambekeire endagera ase amasio ’ababisa baane; kwang’akire amaguta omotwe one ase okonyarigania, gwaichoirie egekombe kiane, ngoiteka kere.
english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

ekegusii: Obobe nobwaino, inwe abamogoteba ng’a rituko ri’obobe ng’are rire, na mwanchera ogokora okobe kw’obotindi kobeera ase egati yaino.
english: You put off the evil day and bring near a reign of terror.

ekegusii: Ekero okorongeyia omonto ase okomotogonyera ase engencho y’ebibe, nigo ogosiria obonene bwaye, koreng’ana buna ebigwankwa bikoria chianga. Amaene, mwanyabanto nigo anga buna omwaga.
english: You rebuke and discipline men for their sin; you consume their wealth like a moth-- each man is but a breath. Selah

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotogonyera abanto abaenenu, abwo baragereirie, abwo batigire kobwata amachiko ao.
english: You rebuke the arrogant, who are cursed and who stray from your commands.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okwanga abwo bagotantana korwa ase emeroberio yao echikire; ee, obong’ainereria bwabo nigo bore bosa.
english: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their deceitfulness is in vain.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mwegenete emioro yaino; nigo mogokora ay’okogechia, kera oyomo oino nigo agotomana nomokungu bw’omonto onde. Inee! Naki moranyare koira ense eye ebe eyaino?
english: You rely on your sword, you do detestable things, and each of you defiles his neighbor's wife. Should you then possess the land?'

ekegusii: Aye nigo okogambera enyancha ekoimokerera igoro; ekero emerindo yaye ekoimokerera igoro, aye nigo okoyotoereria.
english: You rule over the surging sea; when its waves mount up, you still them.

ekegusii: Nigo gwatebete ase enkoro yao ime: Inche nintiire gochia igoro aaria, ngende ng’etanie ching’enang’eni chia Nyasae, nimbeke ekerogo kiane ki’obonene aaria igoro. Ning’ikaranse ase egetunwa ki’omosangererekano aaria sugusu aare.
english: You said in your heart, "I will ascend to heaven; I will raise my throne above the stars of God; I will sit enthroned on the mount of assembly, on the utmost heights of the sacred mountain.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatebete, “Nakorire okobwatana nomochore one, narire eira y’ogotiana ase Daudi omosomba one.
english: You said, "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David my servant,

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwatebete ng’a nobe eting’ana kare na kare. Tikwarengereretie amang’ana ayio. Gose tikwainyorete buna omoerio bw’amang’ana ayio arabe.”
english: You said, 'I will continue forever-- the eternal queen!' But you did not consider these things or reflect on what might happen.

ekegusii: Nigo mogoteba ng’a moriine chibarasi chikominyoka mono, motame. Ee, goika motame. Inwe moganetie gotama ne chibarasi chinyango, korende ababisa baino abwo bakobabwatia nigo bare abaminyoki kobabua.
english: You said, 'No, we will flee on horses.' Therefore you will flee! You said, 'We will ride off on swift horses.' Therefore your pursuers will be swift!

ekegusii: Nigo gwakwanete ng’a obobe nobwao, ekiagera Omonene omentire omoichano ase obororo bwao, naende ng’a kwarosire ase ogochandeka kwao, gose tori nogotimoka.
english: You said, 'Woe to me! The LORD has added sorrow to my pain; I am worn out with groaning and find no rest.'"

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogosasima eki motamanyeti; intwe nigo togosasima eki tomanyete, ekiagera ogotooreka nigo gokorwa ase Abayahudi.
english: You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.

ekegusii: Erio ogaikaransa igoro ase egeikaransero ki’obonene, na emesa iyarenge bosio bwao, na igoro ase emesa eria okabekao ubani yane, na amaguta aane.
english: You sat on an elegant couch, with a table spread before it on which you had placed the incense and oil that belonged to me.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende abwo bare namaiso ’oboenenu nigo okobairania inse.
english: You save the humble but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogotooria abanto bare abaitongo, korende amaiso ao nigo arigereretie abare abaenenu ase okobairania inse.”
english: You save the humble, but your eyes are on the haughty to bring them low.

ekegusii: Mwaroche ebinto babwate bi’okogechia, emegwekano yabo baare gosasima, yaroisirie korwa ase emete, na amagena, ne chifeta, ne chitahabu, eyio yarenge ase egati yabo.
english: You saw among them their detestable images and idols of wood and stone, of silver and gold.

ekegusii: “Ekero Omonene akwanete nainwe korwa ase omorero ime agwo Horebu, timwaroche ekieni kiaye. Ase ayio moigwere na kwerenda,
english: You saw no form of any kind the day the LORD spoke to you at Horeb out of the fire. Therefore watch yourselves very carefully,

ekegusii: Erio mokanyora ng’a obotandoku bwe chindwaki chi’omochie o Daudi bwabeire obonge; inwe mogatanga amache tarua ase Ritibo ria Maate.
english: you saw that the City of David had many breaches in its defenses; you stored up water in the Lower Pool.

ekegusii: Moinyore amaakwa amanene aria mwaroche, na ebikone, na amakumia, na buna Omonene, Nyasae oino, abarusetieo nokoboko kwaye kore ne chinguru, koramboire. Naboigo arakore abanto bonsi baria moirogete.
english: You saw with your own eyes the great trials, the miraculous signs and wonders, the mighty hand and outstretched arm, with which the LORD your God brought you out. The LORD your God will do the same to all the peoples you now fear.

ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwaroche aya Omonene akorerete Baali‐Peori; abanto baria bonsi basasimete Baali‐Peori, akabasiria korwa ase egati yaino.
english: You saw with your own eyes what the LORD did at Baal Peor. The LORD your God destroyed from among you everyone who followed the Baal of Peor,

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoteba ng’a amang’ana ogokwana nay’ekeene, naende ng’a nigo ochenegete ase amaiso a Nyasae.
english: You say to God, 'My beliefs are flawless and I am pure in your sight.'

ekegusii: Na bono aye nigo ogokwana iga: Rora, inche naitire Abaedomu; ase igo kweimokereirie igoro ase enkoro yao ime na kweenenia. Korende aye, beera agwo nka bwoo! Nase ki okorangeria emechando, erinde ogwe, aye amo n’Abayuda?”
english: You say to yourself that you have defeated Edom, and now you are arrogant and proud. But stay at home! Why ask for trouble and cause your own downfall and that of Judah also?"

ekegusii: Nigo okorengereria ng’a ogokwana kw’amang’ana gwoka nakwo koganeirie ase okomanya koba nokobua korwana esegi? Ning’o osemeretie oragokonye goika kwangire konyigwera?
english: You say you have strategy and military strength-- but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?

ekegusii: Nigo okorengereria ng’a ogokwana kw’amang’ana gwoka nakwo koganeirie ase okomanya korwana esegi na koyebua? Ning’o osemeretie oragokonye goika kwangire konyingwera inche?
english: You say you have strategy and military strength-- but you speak only empty words. On whom are you depending, that you rebel against me?

ekegusii: You say, "I choose the appointed time; it is I who judge uprightly.
english: “Ekero engaki nachigete eraike, inche Nyasae ninache ekina kia boronge.

ekegusii: “Nigo mogendererete goteba: Intwe titori nokomocha, na ase ayio Omonene tari nendamwamu asetore. Ekiagera mwakanire ng’a timokoreti ebibe, nimbanachere ekina.
english: you say, 'I am innocent; he is not angry with me.' But I will pass judgment on you because you say, 'I have not sinned.'

ekegusii: Naki nigo ogoteba: Inche nomonda inde! Netenenkirie! Tindemeiri kende. Na aye tomanyeti ng’a nigo ore omonto bw’emechando, omonto ogwenerete kororerwa amabeebe, omotaka, na omouko, na ore getirianda.
english: You say, 'I am rich; I have acquired wealth and do not need a thing.' But you do not realize that you are wretched, pitiful, poor, blind and naked.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoboria: Ng’ai enyomba y’omochandi oria ere? Naende: Ng’ai obomenyo bw’abakori amabe bore?
english: You say, 'Where now is the great man's house, the tents where wicked men lived?'

ekegusii: Mwarorire ng’a mwanyabanto nigo akoegwa oboronge ase ogokora, gose tari ase okwegena gwoka.
english: You see that a person is justified by what he does and not by faith alone.

ekegusii: Kwarorire ng’a okwegena kwaye amo nogokora mbiakorete emeremo, na okwegena koria kogaikeranigwa ase ogokora.
english: You see that his faith and his actions were working together, and his faith was made complete by what he did.

ekegusii: Amaene ekero totarenge ne chinguru, ekero engaki yaigete, Kristo agakwa ase engencho y’abanyabibe.
english: You see, at just the right time, when we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.

ekegusii: Ogakora ebikone na amakumia mamincha ya Farao, mamincha y’abasomba baye bonsi na abanto bonsi b’ense yaye, ekiagera nkwamanyete buna abakorerete chisokoro chiaito bobe; boigo erieta riao rikamanyekana, rikaba rinene buna rire goika rero iga.
english: You sent miraculous signs and wonders against Pharaoh, against all his officials and all the people of his land, for you knew how arrogantly the Egyptians treated them. You made a name for yourself, which remains to this day.

ekegusii: Nigo kwabegete chimbebe aase amache atanyare goetania, erinde tabaisa gotuba ense yonsi naende.
english: You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.

ekegusii: Boigo ngwatigete koba nekeririanda, ngwatigete kegima kogechigwa nabarabwo.
english: You set aside all your wrath and turned from your fierce anger.

ekegusii: Bono naye orabe omoteneneri bw’enka yane, na abanto baane bonsi nabakoigwere buna orabe gokobachika. Ase ekerogo kiane ki’obogambi oka, nao ndabe omonene gokobua.”
english: You shall be in charge of my palace, and all my people are to submit to your orders. Only with respect to the throne will I be greater than you."

ekegusii: Naboigo oraatanane ebinto ebi, obikore ebichenu kegima, erio onde bwensi orabikune abe omochenu.
english: You shall consecrate them so they will be most holy, and whatever touches them will be holy.

ekegusii: timororera omokungu oria amabera; goika mobutore okoboko kwaye.
english: you shall cut off her hand. Show her no pity.

ekegusii: Timokora emeremo ende yonsi. Okwo nogochika koragenderere asemore, ebiaare ase ebiaare aande onsi ase moramenye.
english: You shall do no work at all. This is to be a lasting ordinance for the generations to come, wherever you live.

ekegusii: Okore omoruoti o Ai na omochie oye buna gwakorete Yeriko na omoruoti oye. Korende ase engaki eye monyare koira ebinto ne chitugo morasakore, bibe ebiaino. Obeke abanto baboere omochie, na koyoumokera korwa nyuma.”
english: You shall do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king, except that you may carry off their plunder and livestock for yourselves. Set an ambush behind the city."

ekegusii: Timoba nenyasae ende eng’ao ase egati yaino, timotung’amera na gosasima enyasae engeni.
english: You shall have no foreign god among you; you shall not bow down to an alien god.

ekegusii: Aye nigo oramenye ase ensemo ya Goseni, nigo oramenye ang’e nainche, aye amo nabana bao, na abachokoro bao.
english: You shall live in the region of Goshen and be near me-- you, your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and all you have.

ekegusii: Tobaisa gosasima gose gokorera emegwekano ekorire, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oo, Nyasae bwe risemi. Ase engencho y’amabe ’abaibori nigo nkoa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane, abwo bangechete.
english: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

ekegusii: Tobaisa gosasima gose gokorera emegwekano, ekiagera inche ninche Omonene, Nyasae oo, Nyasae bwe risemi. Ase engencho y’amabe ’abaibori nigo nkobaa abana egesusuro goika ekiaare kia gatato na egia kane, abwo bangechete.
english: You shall not bow down to them or worship them; for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the fathers to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

ekegusii: You shall speak to him and put words in his mouth; I will help both of you speak and will teach you what to do.
english: Aye nokwane nere, omotebie aya agochia gokwana. Inche nimbae inwe babere amang’ana mogochia gokwana, na koborokereria aya morakore.

ekegusii: mobasokie bonsi babere, mobaire isiko y’egeita ki’omochie, erio mobaake amagena bakwe. Omoiseke oria aitwe, ekiagera atakuurete akonywe, nonya orenge ase omochie ime, na omosacha oria, ekiagera atomana nomoiseke oriereirwe boko nomonto omoao. Goika morusie obobe borue asemore.
english: you shall take both of them to the gate of that town and stone them to death-- the girl because she was in a town and did not scream for help, and the man because he violated another man's wife. You must purge the evil from among you.

ekegusii: nigo moramoiranerie: Intwe abasomba bao nigo tore abatugi be chitugo korwa obwana bwaito goika rero; buna tore igo, nabo ne chisokoro chiaito chiarenge. Na igo namonyore ribaga komenya ase ensemo ya Goseni, ekiagera kera omorisia bwe chitugo nigo are okogechia ase Abamisiri.”
english: you should answer, 'Your servants have tended livestock from our boyhood on, just as our fathers did.' Then you will be allowed to settle in the region of Goshen, for all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians."

ekegusii: Inwe iroka ogoitwa nomoro, ekiagera oyore nekeririanda nigo akoegwa egesusuro ki’ogoitwa nemioro; erio monyare komanya ng’a okogambigwa nkoreo.”
english: you should fear the sword yourselves; for wrath will bring punishment by the sword, and then you will know that there is judgment."

ekegusii: Tokumia ekiagera nagotebia: Goika oiborwe naende.
english: You should not be surprised at my saying, 'You must be born again.'

ekegusii: Timobaisa kogoka ase rituko riria amabe arache ase abanto bamino. Gose timobaisa gochenga ase rituko ri’ogosirigwa kw’Abayuda, gose timobaisa gokwana noboenenu ase rituko ri’emechando yabo.
english: You should not look down on your brother in the day of his misfortune, nor rejoice over the people of Judah in the day of their destruction, nor boast so much in the day of their trouble.

ekegusii: Inwe timosoa ase egeita ki’abanto baane ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo; gose timogokera emechando yabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo, gose timorambora amaboko aino koira chinibo chiabo ase rituko ri’amaakwa abo.
english: You should not march through the gates of my people in the day of their disaster, nor look down on them in their calamity in the day of their disaster, nor seize their wealth in the day of their disaster.

ekegusii: Inwe timobaisa gotenena ase amatabekania e chinchera goita abanto ba Edomu kobagotama, gose timobeka abatooregete babo bache gosirigwa ase rituko riria ri’emechando yabo.”
english: You should not wait at the crossroads to cut down their fugitives, nor hand over their survivors in the day of their trouble.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okoorokia obwanchani bwao bwa botambe ase abanto chilifu chinyinge, korende nigo okorua egesusuro ase abana ase engencho y’okomocha kw’abaise. Aye Nyasae ore Omonene bwe chinguru, erieta riao nario Omonene bw’Emeganda.
english: You show love to thousands but bring the punishment for the fathers' sins into the laps of their children after them. O great and powerful God, whose name is the LORD Almighty,

ekegusii: Igo momanyekanete buya ng’a mwabeire rirube ria Kristo, erire emeremo y’ogokora gwaito, ririkire tari ase ewino, korende nase Omoika o Nyasae ore moyo; tari ase chibao chi’amagena, korende ase chibao chie chinkoro chia mwanyabanto.
english: You show that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.

ekegusii: Nering’ana rike aye kwaruete abana baane bakaba ebing’wanso bi’ogosambwa ase emegwekano eyio?
english: You slaughtered my children and sacrificed them to the idols.

ekegusii: Aye nigo onyimokereretie igoro kwambekire ase omwaga na kondiinia igoro yaye. Aye nigo okona‐konuchania gochia aaria na aaria, naba bosa ase omwaga omotindi.
english: You snatch me up and drive me before the wind; you toss me about in the storm.

ekegusii: Mwarusirie Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu korwa ase chingongo chiabo, mwabaoonirie ase Abagiriki.
english: You sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, that you might send them far from their homeland.

ekegusii: Aye kwaoonirie abanto bao ase rigori risinini mono; tikwababekerete rigori rinene.
english: You sold your people for a pittance, gaining nothing from their sale.

ekegusii: Aye nigo ogoikaransa na konakogamba abanto bamino bobe; nigo okona‐kong’acha oyomino morwete enda eyemo.
english: You speak continually against your brother and slander your own mother's son.

ekegusii: Naye gwakwanete n’Omoika Omochenu goetera ase omonwa o sokoro yaito Daudi, omosomba oo, “Nase ki abanto b’ebisaku bagokora riroroche, na abanto bagokora emeroberio ere bosa?
english: You spoke by the Holy Spirit through the mouth of your servant, our father David: "'Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

ekegusii: Ekiagera aye nigo ogendererete gotanga abanto baane, na tori kobaa ribaga bagende.
english: You still set yourself against my people and will not let them go.

ekegusii: Ekero kwaramborete okoboko kwao gw’okorio, ense ekabamera.”
english: You stretched out your right hand and the earth swallowed them.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogotera amatera ay’okwoga, na mweroiseria amakano ao ao, aya mokobugia, buna Daudi akorete.
english: You strum away on your harps like David and improvise on musical instruments.

ekegusii: You stumble day and night, and the prophets stumble with you. So I will destroy your mother--
english: Aye nogochwa mobaso na botuko, na omobani agochwe amo naye. Inche ninsirie nyoko.

ekegusii: Nigo ogokorobanania mwanyabanto buna eooro, baeta bwango buna chindoto. Barabwo nigo bare buna obonyansi bokomera mambia;
english: You sweep men away in the sleep of death; they are like the new grass of the morning--

ekegusii: Naki mwabarorerete amabera baria barenge ase ebisibo, mogancha nomogoko kourwa chinibo chiaino, ekiagera mwamanyete ng’a inwe abanyene more nenibo eyere engiya kobua, erabeo kare na kare.
english: You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, because you knew that you yourselves had better and lasting possessions.

ekegusii: Gaki, aye omwana one, obe ne chinguru ase obuya bore ime ase Kristo Yeso.
english: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

ekegusii: Aye bwerende korwa asare, ekiagera nigo aengereretie okworokereria gwaito.
english: You too should be on your guard against him, because he strongly opposed our message.

ekegusii: Naye boigo notinde bwerusie moyo. Aye boigo norigie aase okwebisa korwa ase ababisa bao.
english: You too will become drunk; you will go into hiding and seek refuge from the enemy.

ekegusii: Naboigo, nainwe remereria, kong’ia chinkoro chiaino, ekiagera ogocha kw’Omonene kwabeire ang’e.
english: You too, be patient and stand firm, because the Lord's coming is near.

ekegusii: Okaira chianga chiao, ogachabera aase aimokererete igoro akaba nebieni ao ao, na aroro agwo ogakorera obonyaka bwao. Amang’ana anga buna ayio tana gokorekana korwa kare, na tagokorekana nonya ng’ake.
english: You took some of your garments to make gaudy high places, where you carried on your prostitution. Such things should not happen, nor should they ever occur.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, buna koreng’ana mwatindacheire abataka inse na kobaura engano yabo ebe ebango, nebe ekero moraagache chinyomba chi’amagena abaachire, timogochimenya, na ekero morasimeke emesabibu ase emegondo emiya, timokonywa edivai yaye.
english: You trample on the poor and force him to give you grain. Therefore, though you have built stone mansions, you will not live in them; though you have planted lush vineyards, you will not drink their wine.

ekegusii: Nigo gwaetete ase enyancha ne chibarasi chiao, ogaetera ase emerindo yarenge koeera ne chinguru.
english: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning the great waters.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okoonchorana abanto bairana, baba amaroba naende, gwateba, “Inwe mwanyabanto, irana!”
english: You turn men back to dust, saying, "Return to dust, O sons of men."

ekegusii: Aye kwabeire omotindi asende; nigo okondwania nokoboko kwao kore ne chinguru.
english: You turn on me ruthlessly; with the might of your hand you attack me.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoonchorana amang’ana bobe. Inee! Omokori chinyongo nareng’anigwe nesike? Egento keroisirie ngetebie oyokeroisetie, “Tari aye kwandoisetie”; gose egento omonto abombete nkemotebie, “Tomanyeti kende”?
english: You turn things upside down, as if the potter were thought to be like the clay! Shall what is formed say to him who formed it, "He did not make me"? Can the pot say of the potter, "He knows nothing"?

ekegusii: Aye kwaonchoire omoichano one okaba omochengo; kwandusirie eanga y’emechando, kwambekeire ey’omogoko.
english: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

ekegusii: Obota bwao bwaorokigwe maiso marore amo nemegwe ye ring’ana riao kwarierete ebisaku eira. Nigo gwatandorete ense ne chindooche.
english: You uncovered your bow, you called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers;

ekegusii: “Ee, Omonene, nomanyete buya; ong’inyore, onkonye na konduseria egesiomba ase baria bagonchanda. Aye nomoremereria ore, tobaisa kondusiao. Nomanyete ng’a ase engencho y’erieta riao nachayirwe na gokorerwa bobe.
english: You understand, O LORD; remember me and care for me. Avenge me on my persecutors. You are long-suffering-- do not take me away; think of how I suffer reproach for your sake.

ekegusii: “Omonwa oo nigo ore omwango gokwana amang’ana ’obobe, na oromeme rwao nigo romanyete koroisia amang’ana ’obong’ainereria.
english: You use your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.

ekegusii: Ase ayio nainwe nabo mware gotaara kare, ekero mwamenyete ase aro.
english: You used to walk in these ways, in the life you once lived.

ekegusii: Nigo mokogania, korende timori na gento; moita na koba ne ribero, korende timokonyora gento. Nigo mogokora esegi na korwana, korende timori na gento, ekiagera timori gosaba.
english: You want something but don't get it. You kill and covet, but you cannot have what you want. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask God.

ekegusii: Aye kwamorenteire ogosesenigwa okuya; kwamobekeire egutwa y’etahabu echenire ase omotwe oye.
english: You welcomed him with rich blessings and placed a crown of pure gold on his head.

ekegusii: Nigo kwaimogetie amaguta, okairera omoruoti, okamoirera na amaguta ao amange agotioka buya. Nigo gwatomete abanto bao gochia ase chinse chi’aare, ee, nonya ngochia aase abakure.
english: You went to Molech with olive oil and increased your perfumes. You sent your ambassadors far away; you descended to the grave itself!

ekegusii: Aye nigo kwarenge omokerubi oagetwe amaguta, ogatuba oboagare obonene. Inche nigo nakobegete ase egetunwa egechenu kia Nyasae, agwo ase kwarenge kona‐gotaara ase egati y’amagena are nomorero.
english: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for so I ordained you. You were on the holy mount of God; you walked among the fiery stones.

ekegusii: Chingencho chiao nigo chiarenge ching’ikeranu, korwa rituko erio gwatongetwe goika ekero obobe bwanyorekanete ime yao.
english: You were blameless in your ways from the day you were created till wickedness was found in you.

ekegusii: ekiagera mwagoretwe ase rigori rinene. Ase ayio, motogie Nyasae ase emebere yaino.
english: you were bought at a price. Therefore honor God with your body.

ekegusii: Mokagorwa ase rigori, timoba abasomba b’abanto.
english: You were bought at a price; do not become slaves of men.

ekegusii: Nigo kwamenyete ime ya Edeni, omogondo o Nyasae. Nigo gwachaberetwe namagena ao ao e rigori rinene: Saridio, na topasio, na yasipi, na kurusolito, na berulo, na oiniki, na safiro, na sumaridi, na alimasi. Boigo nigo gwachaberetwe ne chitahabu. Ebinto biao bikobugigwa nigo biaroisetigwe ase rituko riria gwatongetwe.
english: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every precious stone adorned you: ruby, topaz and emerald, chrysolite, onyx and jasper, sapphire, turquoise and beryl. Your settings and mountings were made of gold; on the day you were created they were prepared.

ekegusii: Nigo mwarenge kominyoka buya; ning’o obatangete timoigwera ekeene?
english: You were running a good race. Who cut in on you and kept you from obeying the truth?

ekegusii: Omonene nigo aborogetie ayio, erinde momanye ng’a Omonene nere Nyasae; onde tari otatiga ere bweka.
english: You were shown these things so that you might know that the LORD is God; besides him there is no other.

ekegusii: Rusia chingencho chiaino chie ritang’ani chi’obomwanyabanto bwa kare, obwasarigwe ase okobwatia okogania kw’obong’ainereria;
english: You were taught, with regard to your former way of life, to put off your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;

ekegusii: Nigo kwerosetie norogendo rwao rw’enchera entambe. Nonya naboigo tigwatebete ng’a ogosemeria tikori. Nigo kwamentetwe chinguru chinyia; ase ayio tikwagoyete.
english: You were wearied by all your ways, but you would not say, 'It is hopeless.' You found renewal of your strength, and so you did not faint.

ekegusii: You who are far away, hear what I have done; you who are near, acknowledge my power!
english: Inwe abamomenyete aare, igwa aya nakorire; nainwe abamomenyete ang’e ancha na koorokia okobua kwane.

ekegusii: Inwe aba motamanyeti amange, egera obong’aini; na inwe abariri, egera okomanya.
english: You who are simple, gain prudence; you who are foolish, gain understanding.

ekegusii: Mwatananirwe korwa ase Kristo, inwe abamorigetie konyora oboronge korwa ase amachiko, mwagure korwa ase obuya.
english: You who are trying to be justified by law have been alienated from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.

ekegusii: Aye ogwetogeria amachiko, Inee, igo ogosareria Nyasae ogosika ase ogosaria kwao kw’amachiko?
english: You who brag about the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?

ekegusii: Aye Sayoni, omoraria bw’amang’ana amaya, tiira gochia ase ebitunwa ebitambe igoro. Aye Yerusalemu, omoraria bw’amang’ana amaya, aka eriogi riao ne chinguru; ee, aka eriogi mono, toiroka; tebia emechie y’Abayuda iga: “Rora Nyasae oino!”
english: You who bring good tidings to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who bring good tidings to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with a shout, lift it up, do not be afraid; say to the towns of Judah, "Here is your God!"

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokweroka ng’a nab’omochie omochenu more, naende ng’a nigo mosemeretie Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli, oyokorokwa Omonene bw’Emeganda.”
english: you who call yourselves citizens of the holy city and rely on the God of Israel-- the LORD Almighty is his name:

ekegusii: Aye oria omenyete ase emegondo, abagisangio baane nigo bategererete baigwe eriogi riao, tiga nainche indiigwe.
english: You who dwell in the gardens with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!

ekegusii: Inwe abamoirogete Omonene, mosemerie Omonene; ere nere Omokonyi oino na enguba yaino.
english: You who fear him, trust in the LORD-- he is their help and shield.

ekegusii: Inwe aba momoirogete Omonene, motogie! Inwe mwensi ab’ororeria rwa Yakobo, togia obonene bwaye! Inwe Abaisraeli bonsi, moiroke!
english: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor him! Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mogechete ayare amaya, mwancha ayare amabe. Nigo mogosaabora amasankwa ’emebere y’abanto baane, na mwongoria chinyama korwa ase amauga abo.
english: you who hate good and love evil; who tear the skin from my people and the flesh from their bones;

ekegusii: “Inwe abamwatoorekire korwa ase emioro, genda, timobaisa gotebana. Mong’inyore inche Omonene, ekero more ase ense y’aare, moyorengererie mono Yerusalemu.
english: You who have escaped the sword, leave and do not linger! Remember the LORD in a distant land, and think on Jerusalem."

ekegusii: Inwe abamwanyorete amachiko ayarentetwe nabamalaika, korende timwayabwata.”
english: you who have received the law that was put into effect through angels but have not obeyed it."

ekegusii: Aye omenyete aase amache amange are, ore omonda bwe chinibo chinyinge, korende omoerio oo oikire, naboigo na okogania kwao okonge.
english: You who live by many waters and are rich in treasures, your end has come, the time for you to be cut off.

ekegusii: Inwe abamomenyete Lakisi, sibera chibarasi chigari, ekiagera inwe abanto b’omochie oyio nigo mwarenge gokora ebibe, mokagera abanto ba Sayoni bagakora ebibe ebio. Ogosaria kw’Abaisraeli nigo kwanyorekanete ime yaino.
english: You who live in Lachish, harness the team to the chariot. You were the beginning of sin to the Daughter of Zion, for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

ekegusii: Inwe abanto ba Lebanoni, mwabeire more nobotoereru ase ebiswa biaino ime, ase egati y’emecharake. Ekeene, namweumie ekero moraigwe obororo, obororo buna obw’omokungu okobina aibore.
english: You who live in 'Lebanon, 'who are nestled in cedar buildings, how you will groan when pangs come upon you, pain like that of a woman in labor!

ekegusii: Inwe aba mogotenena ase enyomba y’Omonene, agwo ase chigoora chi’enyomba ya Nyasae oito, motogie!
english: you who minister in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokogokera egento kere bosa, mogoteba, “Inee! Titwenyorerete chingunchara goetera ase chinguru chiaito abanyene?”
english: you who rejoice in the conquest of Lo Debar and say, "Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?"

ekegusii: Aye ogoteba ng’a omonto tatomana, tori gotomana aye omonyene? Aye ogechete emegwekano y’ogosasimwa, aye tori koiba korwa ase chihekalu?
english: You who say that people should not commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

ekegusii: Inee! Nomanyete egekogera chianga chiao chigosamba ne riberera, ekero ense egotoererigwa nomwaga okogusa korwa irianyi?
english: You who swelter in your clothes when the land lies hushed under the south wind,

ekegusii: Inee! Aye nigo ogwetandora ase engencho y’endamwamu yao, ense nigo egochia gotigwa bosa ase engencho yao? Gose egetare ngetigerigwe korwa aase aye?
english: You who tear yourself to pieces in your anger, is the earth to be abandoned for your sake? Or must the rocks be moved from their place?

ekegusii: Inwe nigo mokoonchorana ayare amaronge aba ay’obororo, na mwatuguta oboronge inse ase riroba.
english: You who turn justice into bitterness and cast righteousness to the ground

ekegusii: Nonya more abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro, namosirigwe motigare more abake mono, ekiagera motaigwerete Omonene, Nyasae oino.
english: You who were as numerous as the stars in the sky will be left but few in number, because you did not obey the LORD your God.

ekegusii: Aye Gogi, nochiche korwania Abaisraeli, abanto baane. Noche buna riire otube ense eyio. Ase amatuko agochigocha ninkorente orwanie ense yaane, erinde abanto b’ebisaku bamanye inche, ekero ndeorokie ase amaiso abo ng’a inche inde omochenu ase egati yaino.
english: You will advance against my people Israel like a cloud that covers the land. In days to come, O Gog, I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I show myself holy through you before their eyes.

ekegusii: Aye notoiranere, otororere amabera naende; notiringere ebibe biaito inse y’amagoro ao, nobitugute bionsi ime ase chindiba chi’enyancha.
english: You will again have compassion on us; you will tread our sins underfoot and hurl all our iniquities into the depths of the sea.

ekegusii: Nainwe moigwere Omonene naende, na kobwata amachiko aye onsi aya nkobatebia rituko ria rero.
english: You will again obey the LORD and follow all his commands I am giving you today.

ekegusii: Nigo morarue asebare, mwetwegete amaboko ase emetwe, ekiagera Omonene bwangire abanto abwo mosemeretie, rirorio timokonyora ogosesenigwa amo nabarabwo.”
english: You will also leave that place with your hands on your head, for the LORD has rejected those you trust; you will not be helped by them.

ekegusii: Naki igo more nabataka amo nainwe amatuko onsi, korende timori nainche amatuko onsi.”
english: You will always have the poor among you, but you will not always have me."

ekegusii: Aye noimokerere igoro ororere Sayoni amabera; ekiagera eye nero engaki y’okoywancha; ee, engaki eria yachigetwe yaikire.
english: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.

ekegusii: Aye nobe egutwa enseera y’obonene ere ase okoboko kw’Omonene, na esombe y’omogambi ere ase okoboko kwa Nyasae oo.
english: You will be a crown of splendor in the LORD's hand, a royal diadem in the hand of your God.

ekegusii: “Ekero ndabe nendamwamu na obotindi na gokonachera ekina na gokoa egesusuro ki’ogokorongeyia, aye nobe kogochaywa na gosekererwa, na ekero abanto b’ebisaku biria bigoetanaine barakorore, nigo barorokererigwe na goichanigwa. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.
english: You will be a reproach and a taunt, a warning and an object of horror to the nations around you when I inflict punishment on you in anger and in wrath and with stinging rebuke. I the LORD have spoken.

ekegusii: Na inwe namoruegwe nabaibori baino, na bamura bamino, na eamate yaino, na abasani baino, na barabwo nababeke abande baino ase ogoitwa.
english: You will be betrayed even by parents, brothers, relatives and friends, and they will put some of you to death.

ekegusii: “Imosesenigwe ase emechie yaino na ase emegondo yaino.
english: You will be blessed in the city and blessed in the country.

ekegusii: Namosesenigwe kobua ebisaku binde bionsi. Ase egati yaino onde tari omosacha gose omokungu, orabe omogomba, gose etugo ende yaino tekogombaa.
english: You will be blessed more than any other people; none of your men or women will be childless, nor any of your livestock without young.

ekegusii: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
english: “Imosesenigwe ekero mogosoa inka, na ekero mokogenda isiko.

ekegusii: Barabwo mbabaremie, na ekero morarore chinchera chiabo, na ogokora kwabo, nigo moramanye ng’a aya nakorerete omochie oyio tinakorete engencho ende etaiyo. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: You will be consoled when you see their conduct and their actions, for you will know that I have done nothing in it without cause, declares the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: “Imoragererigwe ase emechie yaino, na ase emegondo yaino.
english: You will be cursed in the city and cursed in the country.

ekegusii: “Imoragererigwe ekero mogosoa inka, na ekero mokogenda isiko.
english: You will be cursed when you come in and cursed when you go out.

ekegusii: Noserigwe gochia aare korwa ase mwanyabanto, na obomenyo bwao nigo borabe amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana. Nobetererigwe orisie obonyansi buna eng’ombe, na nonyirirerwe ne riime rikorwa igoro, ase ebiro bitano na bibere, goika onyare komanya ng’a Oyore Igoro Mono nere okogambera oboruoti bwa mwanyabanto, naende nere okoa oboruoti obwo ase onde bwensi aranche.
english: You will be driven away from people and will live with the wild animals; you will eat grass like cattle and be drenched with the dew of heaven. Seven times will pass by for you until you acknowledge that the Most High is sovereign over the kingdoms of men and gives them to anyone he wishes.

ekegusii: aye noserigwe korwa ase mwanyabanto, omenye amo ne ching’iti chi’orosana, nobe gokorisia obonyansi buna eng’ombe. Okoore ebiro bitano na bibere goika ekero oramanye ng’a Oyore Igoro Mono nere okogambera oboruoti bwa mwanyabanto, na nere okoa oboruoti obwo ase onde bwensi aranche.”
english: You will be driven away from people and will live with the wild animals; you will eat grass like cattle. Seven times will pass by for you until you acknowledge that the Most High is sovereign over the kingdoms of men and gives them to anyone he wishes."

ekegusii: Nigo oratinde mono, naende obe nobororo obonge. Egekombe ekio gia Samaria, mosubati omino, negekombe ki’obwoba na ogosirigwa.
english: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, the cup of ruin and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.

ekegusii: Aye nigo gwaichoirwe nobosooku ribaga ri’ogosikwa. Aye kanywe, obe omonto otarogeti! Egekombe ki’egesusuro kere ase okoboko gw’okorio kw’Omonene nakegochere; na oboosoku mbotube obonene bwao.
english: You will be filled with shame instead of glory. Now it is your turn! Drink and be exposed! The cup from the LORD's right hand is coming around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

ekegusii: Inwe inamobe oboruoti bwane, abanto bagonkorera buna abakuani, egesaku kiane egechenu. Amang’ana aya naro oratebie Abaisraeli.”
english: you will be for me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.' These are the words you are to speak to the Israelites."

ekegusii: Inwe mobe chinko chigouterwa omorero; amanyinga aino naiterwe igoro ase ense. Timokoinyorwa nonya ng’ake. Ninche Omonene nakwanire ayio.”
english: You will be fuel for the fire, your blood will be shed in your land, you will be remembered no more; for I the LORD have spoken.'"

ekegusii: Naki nomobere kirori ase abanto bonsi igoro y’amang’ana ayakwarorire na koyaigwa.
english: You will be his witness to all men of what you have seen and heard.

ekegusii: You will be like an oak with fading leaves, like a garden without water.
english: Inwe namobe buna omotontera oyo amato aye omire, na buna omogondo oborirwe amache.

ekegusii: Nigo orabe buna omonto oraire ase egati‐gati y’enyancha, gose buna omonto ore ase omote omotambe igoro okoirwa esiororia.
english: You will be like one sleeping on the high seas, lying on top of the rigging.

ekegusii: Ekiagera mwatenenkigwe ase ebinto bionsi monyare koba nokorua gwonsi gokogera Nyasae aakerwe ng’a mbuya mono goetera ase emeremo yaito.
english: You will be made rich in every way so that you can be generous on every occasion, and through us your generosity will result in thanksgiving to God.

ekegusii: “Nebe kwariereire omoiseke boko, na omonto omoao amoire arare nere: noagache enyomba, korende tokoyemenya. Nosimeke emesabibu ase omogondo oo, korende tokoria amasabibu korwao.
english: You will be pledged to be married to a woman, but another will take her and ravish her. You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not even begin to enjoy its fruit.

ekegusii: Ekero abanto bakogokwana bobe nobiswe, na ekero amabe agoita arache, toyoboa.
english: You will be protected from the lash of the tongue, and need not fear when destruction comes.

ekegusii: Aye nomenye kore noboremu, ekiagera ogosemeria nkoreo; norendwe na gotimoka ase obotoereru.
english: You will be secure, because there is hope; you will look about you and take your rest in safety.

ekegusii: Aye noorokerie ororeria rwa Yakobo obwegenwa bwao, na orwa Ibrahimu obwanchani bwao botari koera, buna kwarierete chisokoro chiaito eira korwa ase amatuko a kare, ogatiana.
english: You will be true to Jacob, and show mercy to Abraham, as you pledged on oath to our fathers in days long ago.

ekegusii: Rora, nobe morito, noibore omwana omoisia, nomoroke erieta riaye Yeso.
english: You will be with child and give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus.

ekegusii: Bono goika obogorie egesusuro ki’ogokora kwao okobe, na okogechia kwao gwonsi.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: You will bear the consequences of your lewdness and your detestable practices, declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ase egati y’abanto b’ense eyio ase Omonene arabasiarere gochia, inwe mobe ab’ogoichanerwa, mobe omorabaaro na gokwanwa bobe nabanto abwo.
english: You will become a thing of horror and an object of scorn and ridicule to all the nations where the LORD will drive you.

ekegusii: Nobasoyie na kobabeka ase egetunwa kiao aye omonyene, aase aria kweroiseretie, aye Omonene, obomenyo obochenu kwaagachete namaboko ao.
english: You will bring them in and plant them on the mountain of your inheritance-- the place, O LORD, you made for your dwelling, the sanctuary, O Lord, your hands established.

ekegusii: You will call and I will answer you; you will long for the creature your hands have made.
english: Aye korandangerie, na inche ningoitabere, ekiagera noganie emeremo y’amaboko ao.

ekegusii: Erio noche korwa aase ao, agwo sugusu y’aare; nigo orache amo nabanto abange, bonsi bariinete chibarasi, bare omoganda omonene ore nabarwani esegi abange.
english: You will come from your place in the far north, you and many nations with you, all of them riding on horses, a great horde, a mighty army.

ekegusii: Nogende ase embeera kore nobogotu obuya, buna emesaima y’endagera ekorentwa ekero engaki yabo yaikire.”
english: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like sheaves gathered in season.

ekegusii: Aye noite abana babo, obasirie korwa ase ense, na ororeria rwabo orosirie kegima korwa ase mwanyabanto.
english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from mankind.

ekegusii: Aye nigo orakwe kore nomorembe, na buna abanto basambete ebinsari bigotioka buya ase ogotindekwa gwe chisokoro chiao, na abaruoti abwo bagotang’anerete, naboigo abanto barasambe ebinsari ase ogotindeka, na bakoreere aye, bagoteba; Obee, omonene! Nabo Omonene atebire.”
english: you will die peacefully. As people made a funeral fire in honor of your fathers, the former kings who preceded you, so they will make a fire in your honor and lament, "Alas, O master!" I myself make this promise, declares the LORD.'"

ekegusii: Aye nokwere ase amaboko ’abanto b’egesaku ekegeni, buna abanto batarogeti bagokwa. Ninche Omonene Nyasae nakwanire ayio.”
english: You will die the death of the uncircumcised at the hands of foreigners. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Nonywe amache korwa ase akarooche karia, inche nachikire ebigonkoru bikorentere endagera aroro.”
english: You will drink from the brook, and I have ordered the ravens to feed you there."

ekegusii: Nigo orabetererigwe onywe okoore ekenyugwa ekio gionsi, ee, goika omene ebisamunye biaye kogiatekire, naende oarie chimbeere chiao nabirobio. Ninche Omonene Nyasae nakwanire ayio.
english: You will drink it and drain it dry; you will dash it to pieces and tear your breasts. I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Aye nogonke amabeere ’abanto b’ebisaku, nogonke korwa ase ebikuba bi’abaruoti; aye nomanye ng’a inche Omonene, ninche Omotooria oo, ninche Omobooria oo, Omonguru o Yakobo.”
english: You will drink the milk of nations and be nursed at royal breasts. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

ekegusii: Nigo moraeterigwe ase chinyasi chibochogete, kera omokungu oyomo ase oyomo, morutwe ase Harimoni.” Nabo Omonene atebire.
english: You will each go straight out through breaks in the wall, and you will be cast out toward Harmon," declares the LORD.

ekegusii: Ekero morabe mokoragera, timokoigota; nigo moragenderere koba nenchara. Mosangererie na kwegachera ebinto, korende ebio mwegacheire nimbirue bisirigwe nemioro.
english: You will eat but not be satisfied; your stomach will still be empty. You will store up but save nothing, because what you save I will give to the sword.

ekegusii: Imorie chinyama chi’abarwani esegi bare ne chinguru, na monywe amanyinga ’abagambi b’ense, abwo banga buna chimingichi, ne chimanwa chie ching’ondi, ne chimbori, ne chieri, chionsi chire chinoru chia Basani.
english: You will eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of the princes of the earth as if they were rams and lambs, goats and bulls-- all of them fattened animals from Bashan.

ekegusii: Enchara nebe enene mono goika morie emebere y’abana baino, abamura na abaiseke.
english: You will eat the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters.

ekegusii: Aye nobe gokonyora okwama kw’emeremo y’amaboko ao; nosesenigwe, na amang’ana onsi nigo arabe buya asore.
english: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.

ekegusii: Inwe imoitwe nemioro. Nimbanachere ekina agwo ase ribebe ri’Abaisraeli. Erio momanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: You will fall by the sword, and I will execute judgment on you at the borders of Israel. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Inwe nigo morakwere ase egetii aarabu, ekiagera ninche Omonene Nyasae nakwanire ayio.
english: You will fall in the open field, for I have spoken, declares the Sovereign LORD.

ekegusii: Inwe imotame moetere ase rikura riria rire ase egati y’ebitunwa biane, ekiagera nigo riraikere Aseli, ee, nabo moratame buna mwatamete ekero omotengecho bw’ense obete ekero Uzia arenge omoruoti bw’Abayuda. Ase engaki eyio Omonene, Nyasae one, nachiche amo nabachenu bonsi.
english: You will flee by my mountain valley, for it will extend to Azel. You will flee as you fled from the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Then the LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with him.

ekegusii: “Inwe mosoke more nomogoko, motang’anwe more nomorembe. Ebitunwa na ebigoro mbitere ase amasio aino, na emete yonsi y’orosana neake chinkobi.
english: You will go out in joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees of the field will clap their hands.

ekegusii: Inamosimeke emezeituni ase orogongo rwaino rwonsi, korende timokweaka amaguta aye, ekiagera amazeituni nigo araaroroke atarama.
english: You will have olive trees throughout your country but you will not use the oil, because the olives will drop off.

ekegusii: Erio nonyore amabeere e chimbori agoisaine aye na abanto b’enka yao, boigo nase abasomba bao abaiseke.
english: You will have plenty of goats' milk to feed you and your family and to nourish your servant girls.

ekegusii: Monyore endagera enyinge mokoria moigote, erio motogie erieta ri’Omonene, Nyasae oino, oyio obakoreire amakumia. Abanto baane tibagochaywa naende.
english: You will have plenty to eat, until you are full, and you will praise the name of the LORD your God, who has worked wonders for you; never again will my people be shamed.

ekegusii: Nigo moraibore abana, abamura na abaiseke, korende tibakoba abaino, mbooswe bairwe ase obosomba.
english: You will have sons and daughters but you will not keep them, because they will go into captivity.

ekegusii: Ekiagera amasugunia ayio abe ekeinyorio asemore. Ekero mokoyarigereria monyare koinyora amachiko aane onsi na koyabwata. Naboigo moranyare gokonywa, erinde mobe abegenwa asende na gwetanga korwa ase okogania okobe gwe chinkoro chiaino na amaiso aino.
english: You will have these tassels to look at and so you will remember all the commands of the LORD, that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by going after the lusts of your own hearts and eyes.

ekegusii: Na inwe inamoigwe esegi, na ebirage, bi’esegi; rigereria timoichanigwa, ekiagera bori, aya onsi nabe; korende omoerio toracha.
english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.

ekegusii: Aye omente obonene bwane, na ondemie naende.
english: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.

ekegusii: Omonto ore nebirengererio ebironge asore, aye Omonene nigo okomoa omorembe omoikeranu, ekiagera agosemeretie.
english: You will keep in perfect peace him whose mind is steadfast, because he trusts in you.

ekegusii: Erio motige ebitambaa bibe ase emetwe yaino, na ebikoroto ase amagoro aino. Timobaisa kobokia amagombo gose korera, korende imoree ase engencho y’ebibe biaino, na mobe mokorererana.
english: You will keep your turbans on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn or weep but will waste away because of your sins and groan among yourselves.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, ekero ndabakorere amaya ase engencho y’erieta riane, tinkobakorera koreng’ana ne chinchera chiaino chimbe, gose koreng’ana nogokora kwaino kw’obosareku; erio nario moramanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene. Nabo Omonene Nyasae atebire.”
english: You will know that I am the LORD, when I deal with you for my name's sake and not according to your evil ways and your corrupt practices, O house of Israel, declares the Sovereign LORD.'"

ekegusii: Norore buna abana bao babeire abange, na ororeria rwao ndobuche robe oronge buna obonyansi bore ase ense.
english: You will know that your children will be many, and your descendants like the grass of the earth.

ekegusii: Erio nonyare korora ng’a obomenyo bwao mborendire buya, na ekero orabe gokorata ase ameri e chitugo chiao, nonyore ng’a ende tesireti korwao.
english: You will know that your tent is secure; you will take stock of your property and find nothing missing.

ekegusii: Ekero ogosiria na enchara birache, aye nobe gokobisekerera, gose tokwoboa ching’iti chintindi chire ase ense.
english: You will laugh at destruction and famine, and need not fear the beasts of the earth.

ekegusii: Namotige amarieta aino aragererigwe nabachore baane, nainche Omonene Nyasae nimbaite inwe, korende abasomba baane nimbaroke ase erieta eriaao.
english: You will leave your name to my chosen ones as a curse; the Sovereign LORD will put you to death, but to his servants he will give another name.

ekegusii: Ekero okorara, monto onde tagokwoboyia; abanto abange mbache asore bagosorore ng’a banyore ogwancherwa.
english: You will lie down, with no one to make you afraid, and many will court your favor.

ekegusii: Omoro oo bw’esegi nogere obe moyo, aye nomokorere oyomino; korende engaki neche orekong’ie, nobune rikorogoto erio akobekeire ase rigoti riao.”
english: You will live by the sword and you will serve your brother. But when you grow restless, you will throw his yoke from off your neck."

ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko namobe nobwoba, na obogima bwaino nabobe ase emechando; inwe timogosemeria okoba kw’obogima bwaino ng’a mbogenderere.
english: You will live in constant suspense, filled with dread both night and day, never sure of your life.

ekegusii: Inwe momenye ase ense eyio naete chisokoro chiaino; inwe mobe abanto baane, na inche imbe Nyasae oino.
english: You will live in the land I gave your forefathers; you will be my people, and I will be your God.

ekegusii: Namondigie, korende timokoonyara; na aase ndabe inche, timokonyara gochao.”
english: You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come."

ekegusii: Na ase ense moraganie koirana gochiao, timokonyara.”
english: You will never come back to the land you long to return to."

ekegusii: Timogochiria ase rituko erimo rioka, gose ase amatuko abere, gose atano, gose ikomi, gose emerongo ebere,
english: You will not eat it for just one day, or two days, or five, ten or twenty days,

ekegusii: Aye togotooreka korwa ase okoboko kwaye. Goika obwatwe na kobekwa ase okoboko kwaye, erinde mororane nomoruoti o Babeli, amaiso ase amaiso, na gokwana nere morigereranetie obosio ase obosio, aye goika oirwe Babeli.
english: You will not escape from his grasp but will surely be captured and handed over to him. You will see the king of Babylon with your own eyes, and he will speak with you face to face. And you will go to Babylon.

ekegusii: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
english: Tokwoboa okogoswa ekero kia botuko, gose omogwe okorutwa mobaso,

ekegusii: Inwe Abayuda na abanto ba Yerusalemu, timokorwana esegi eye; mobeere aase aino, motenene, mokire‐kiri na morore obobui bw’Omonene ase engencho yaino. Timoiroka, gose timokwa emioyo. Ankio mosoke mobachiere, na Omonene nabe amo nainwe.”
english: You will not have to fight this battle. Take up your positions; stand firm and see the deliverance the LORD will give you, O Judah and Jerusalem. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged. Go out to face them tomorrow, and the LORD will be with you.'"

ekegusii: Aye togotindekwa buna abaruoti bande, ekiagera gwasaririe ense yao, naende gwaitire abanto bao. Ororeria rw’abakori amabe tirogwatorwa nonya ng’ake.
english: you will not join them in burial, for you have destroyed your land and killed your people. The offspring of the wicked will never be mentioned again.

ekegusii: You will only observe with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.
english: Norigererie namaiso ao, orore buna abakori amabe bakoegwa egesusuro.

ekegusii: Nainwe mobue emechie yabo egiteire chindwaki na kera omochie omuya, naende namoteme kera omote omuya; boigo motiche na gosaria chinsoko chionsi chi’amache na mosarie kera oboremo obuya namagena.”
english: You will overthrow every fortified city and every major town. You will cut down every good tree, stop up all the springs, and ruin every good field with stones."

ekegusii: Namokwe mosirere ase ense y’ababisa baino, na ense yabo nebamere kegima.
english: You will perish among the nations; the land of your enemies will devour you.

ekegusii: Imosimeke chindagera, korende timogochigesa. Imomite amazeituni, korende timokweaka amaguta korwao; imomite amasabibu, korende timokonywa edivai ekorwao.
english: You will plant but not harvest; you will press olives but not use the oil on yourselves, you will crush grapes but not drink the wine.

ekegusii: Inamosimeke emesabibu ase emegondo na gokora emeremo aroro, korende timokonywa edivai, gose koria amasabibu korwao, ekiagera amakonde nigo arasoe arie yonsi.
english: You will plant vineyards and cultivate them but you will not drink the wine or gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.

ekegusii: You will pray to him, and he will hear you, and you will fulfill your vows.
english: Na ekero orabe gokomosaba, nakoigwe; naye nonyare goakana chiira chiao chi’ogotiana.

ekegusii: Namoserie ababisa baino, nababugwe ase amasio aino, baitwe nemioro.
english: You will pursue your enemies, and they will fall by the sword before you.

ekegusii: nobiringe buna egetambaa gi’okwambara, na birobio nabionchoke buna eanga. Korende aye naye oria oria ore buna kwarenge, na emiaka yao tekoba nomoerio.”
english: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed. But you remain the same, and your years will never end."

ekegusii: Aye nobabutore nenyimbo y’ekioma, obasegenyie babe buna enyongo yaatirwe.”
english: You will rule them with an iron scepter; you will dash them to pieces like pottery."

ekegusii: Bono notebe, “Chinsagia nigo chiabunegete, erinde nchomwe aroro.”
english: You will say then, "Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in."

ekegusii: You will say, "How I hated discipline! How my heart spurned correction!
english: notebe, “Naki nakorete nkagecha ogokurerwa, na enkoro yane egachaya okorongeigwa!

ekegusii: Aye nigo oratebe iga: Ngochiera inde ense ere nemechie etagiteiri chindwaki; ning’umokere abanto abwo begaarete bare nobotoereru; bonsi nigo bamenyeteo bategitereti chindwaki, tibabwati ebiita gose emekorogoto egosieka.
english: You will say, "I will invade a land of unwalled villages; I will attack a peaceful and unsuspecting people-- all of them living without walls and without gates and bars.

ekegusii: Namwerorere amang’ana ayio namaiso aino; erio motebe: “Omonene nigo are omonene nonya nisiko y’ense y’Abaisraeli.”
english: You will see it with your own eyes and say, 'Great is the LORD-- even beyond the borders of Israel!'

ekegusii: Timokorora abanto baria abatindi naende, abanto babwate ogokwana ogokong’u motari komanya, abwo bagokwana emenwa emeao ase okong’ung’ura motari komanya.
english: You will see those arrogant people no more, those people of an obscure speech, with their strange, incomprehensible tongue.

ekegusii: You will seek me and find me when you seek me with all your heart.
english: Namondigie monyoore, komorandigie ne chinkoro chiaino chionsi.

ekegusii: “Namosimeke chimbusuro chinyinge ase emegondo, korende mogese endagera ensinini, ekiagera chingige nachirie chindagera chiaino.
english: You will sow much seed in the field but you will harvest little, because locusts will devour it.

ekegusii: Namogenderere koria endagera enkoro ere enyinge ase ebiage, na ekiagera ere enyinge mono namoyerusie aroro, erinde monyore ribaga mobeke enyia.
english: You will still be eating last year's harvest when you will have to move it out to make room for the new.

ekegusii: Egesusuro ki’obonyaka bwaino nkebe igoro yaino, ee, imonyore egesusuro ki’ebibe biaino bi’ogosasima emegwekano. Erio momanye ng’a inche ninche Omonene Nyasae.”
english: You will suffer the penalty for your lewdness and bear the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign LORD."

ekegusii: Nigo orebe emechando yao, buna amache aetire, takoinyorwa naende.
english: You will surely forget your trouble, recalling it only as waters gone by.

ekegusii: erio mokwane amang’ana aya y’ogochecheria omoruoti o Babeli, motebe: “Naki omochandi oria akirigwe! Obotindi bw’ogochandwa gwaito bwaerire!
english: you will take up this taunt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has come to an end! How his fury has ended!

ekegusii: Notache chindo na amarubi, notiringe chindo chinsae ne chinchoka.
english: You will tread upon the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.

ekegusii: Ayio nigo aragere oroke endagera eria kwaria, naende amang’ana ao amaya asire bosa.
english: You will vomit up the little you have eaten and will have wasted your compliments.

ekegusii: Mobisiare, na omwaga obirurukie gochia aare, erio ekembugu‐mbugu kebisiarere. Inwe abanyene mogoke ase Omonene na komwetogeria oyore Omochenu bw’Abaisraeli.
english: You will winnow them, the wind will pick them up, and a gale will blow them away. But you will rejoice in the LORD and glory in the Holy One of Israel.

ekegusii: You women who are so complacent, rise up and listen to me; you daughters who feel secure, hear what I have to say!
english: Inwe abakungu mweisanegetie, imoka, montegerere! Inwe abaiseke motechandereti kende, tegerera, moigwe amang’ana ngokwana!

ekegusii: Onye naboigo, rirorio monyare goaka obomera igoro ye chintakana, monyare gokorera abasani baino amagori amake ase okobaoonia.
english: You would even cast lots for the fatherless and barter away your friend.

ekegusii: Inee! Sodomu, mosubati omino, tabete omobayeno kwarenge gokwana ase okomochaya, ekero kwarenge noboenenu.
english: You would not even mention your sister Sodom in the day of your pride,

ekegusii: nigo orantugute ime ase engoro, ne chianga chiane chigechigwe ase engencho yane.
english: you would plunge me into a slime pit so that even my clothes would detest me.

ekegusii: Aye omonyene nonyore oborwaire obobe bw’enda goika amara ao abe agosoka isiko ase engencho y’oborwaire obwo, rituko ase rituko.”
english: You yourself will be very ill with a lingering disease of the bowels, until the disease causes your bowels to come out.'"

ekegusii: Inwe abanyene nerirube riaito ririkire ase chinkoro chiaito, rimanyekanete na gosomwa nabanto bonsi.
english: You yourselves are our letter, written on our hearts, known and read by everybody.

ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwambereire kirori ng’a natebete: Inche tari Kristo, korende natomirwe imotang’anere.
english: You yourselves can testify that I said, 'I am not the Christ but am sent ahead of him.'

ekegusii: Inwe mweroreire aya onsi Omonene, Nyasae oino, akorire ase abanto aba bonsi b’ebisaku ebi ase engencho yaino. Omonene, Nyasae oino, nere obeire okobarwanera.
english: You yourselves have seen everything the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake; it was the LORD your God who fought for you.

ekegusii: Inwe mwarorire aya nakoreire Abamisiri, na buna nababogoretie inwe buna ensoti ekobogoria amage aye ase chimbaba chiaye, nabarentire aiga asende.
english: 'You yourselves have seen what I did to Egypt, and how I carried you on eagles' wings and brought you to myself.

ekegusii: “Inwe abanyene momanyete buna obogima bwaito bwarenge ekero twamenyete ase ense ya Misiri, naende buna twarweteo na goeta egati‐gati y’ebisaku ebio ase twaetete.
english: You yourselves know how we lived in Egypt and how we passed through the countries on the way here.

ekegusii: Inwe abanyene mwamanyire ng’a amaboko aya aane ankoreire okorigia kwane, na okw’abwo barenge amo nainche.
english: You yourselves know that these hands of mine have supplied my own needs and the needs of my companions.

ekegusii: Abana baane, inwe naba Nyasae more, naende mwabuire baria, ekiagera ere oyore ime asemore nomonene kobua ere oyore ime ase ense.
english: You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

ekegusii: Onye Omoika o Nyasae omenyete ime yaino, rirorio timori gotunyana chingencho chi’ebibe, korende chingencho chi’Omoika. Onde bwensi otari n’Omoika o Kristo, oyio tari omonto oye.
english: You, however, are controlled not by the sinful nature but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.

ekegusii: Korende inwe timworokereretigwe komomanya Kristo buna igo.
english: You, however, did not come to know Christ that way.

ekegusii: Korende aye kwabwatire okworokereria kwane, na orogendo rwane, na okorigia kwane ase obogima obo, na okwegena kwane, na oboremereria bwane, na obwanchani bwane, na okoganya kwane,
english: You, however, know all about my teaching, my way of life, my purpose, faith, patience, love, endurance,

ekegusii: Korende inwe nabatongi oborimo, inwe mwensi nabarwaria bare bosa, motari kogwenia.
english: You, however, smear me with lies; you are worthless physicians, all of you!

ekegusii: Korende aye nogende ase chisokoro chiao ase omorembe. Igo oratindekwe ase obogotu obuya.
english: You, however, will go to your fathers in peace and be buried at a good old age.

ekegusii: Ankio mambia moche mokore iga: Aye Kora amo na bonsi abagokobwatia, moimokie chindogio,
english: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do this: Take censers

ekegusii: Inwe abaminto, nigo mwarangeretigwe monyore obosibore; korende ogosiborwa kwaino tikoba ogw’okobwatia chingencho chiaino chi’ebibe, mbuya mokorerane inwe ase inwe ase obwanchani.
english: You, my brothers, were called to be free. But do not use your freedom to indulge the sinful nature; rather, serve one another in love.

ekegusii: “Aye omoruoti, omote oria naye omonyene. Aye gwakinire, kwabeire ne chinguru. Obonene bwao bwakinire, bwaikire igoro, na obogambi bwao bwaikire ase chinsinyo chionsi chi’ense.
english: you, O king, are that tree! You have become great and strong; your greatness has grown until it reaches the sky, and your dominion extends to distant parts of the earth.

ekegusii: Aye omoruoti nigo ore omonene goetania abaruoti bande. Nyasae ore igoro okoeire oboruoti, na okobua, ne chinguru, na obonene,
english: You, O king, are the king of kings. The God of heaven has given you dominion and power and might and glory;

ekegusii: Ee, naye ogontongeria etaya yane; Omonene, Nyasae one, nigo akomoreka omosunte ore asende oba oborabu.
english: You, O LORD, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.

ekegusii: Korende aye omonene nigo oragambe kare na kare, ekerogo kiao ki’obogambi nigo kerabeo ebiaare ase ebiaare.
english: You, O LORD, reign forever; your throne endures from generation to generation.

ekegusii: you, then, who teach others, do you not teach yourself? You who preach against stealing, do you steal?
english: Aye okworokereria abande, Inee, tokweorokereria aye omonyene? Aye okorandia ng’a omonto taiba, tori koiba aye omonyene?

ekegusii: Korende aye, nase ki okogambia oyomino? Gose aye, nase ki ogochaya oyomino? Naki intwe twensi natoche gotenena bosio bw’ekerogo gi’ekina kia Nyasae.
english: You, then, why do you judge your brother? Or why do you look down on your brother? For we will all stand before God's judgment seat.

ekegusii: Ase ayio, aye onde bwensi, tori naya ogotaamera, ekero okogambia oyonde ekina, ekiagera ase okomogambia oyonde ekina, naye okwegambia omonyene. Naki okomogambia, na aye nare ayio ogokora?
english: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on someone else, for at whatever point you judge the other, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.

ekegusii: Abwo bonsi, abake na abanene, aborokia na aborokigwa, bagaaka obomera ase ogwatanana emeremo yabo.
english: Young and old alike, teacher as well as student, cast lots for their duties.

ekegusii: nainwe abamura na abaiseke mwensi, nainwe abanto abagotu na abana.
english: young men and maidens, old men and children.

ekegusii: Abamura baito nabwo bakobogoria chingena chigoserwa, na abana abake nigo bakoritoerwa ase okobogoria chinko, bagwa.
english: Young men toil at the millstones; boys stagger under loads of wood.

ekegusii: Abamura abwo goika babe abatari na kemocho ase emebere yabo, naende babe abanyabieni, bare abang’aini abaranyare kweorokereria chisemi, barabe abaango b’okomanya, baraisanere gokorera omoruoti ase enyomba yaye. Asipenasi aborokererie bamanye amariko ’Abakalidayo, naende bamanye gokwana Egekalidayo.
english: young men without any physical defect, handsome, showing aptitude for every kind of learning, well informed, quick to understand, and qualified to serve in the king's palace. He was to teach them the language and literature of the Babylonians.

ekegusii: Naboigo nainwe abamore abake, mwebeke inse ase abagaaka. Na inwe mwensi eboyie oboitongo buna orokini, monyare gokorerana, ekiagera nigo erikire, “Nyasae nigo akwanga abare abaenenu, korende abare abaitongo nigo akobaa obuya.”
english: Young men, in the same way be submissive to those who are older. All of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because, "God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble."

ekegusii: Narorire okogechia kwaino, na obonyaka bwaino obobe, na obotomani bwaino. Narorire ng’a timwarenge abegenwa asende, nigo mwasasimete chinyasae ching’ao ase ebigoro bire ase ebitii. Aye Yerusalemu, obobe nobwao! Nengaki eng’ana naki oraire otarachenwa?
english: your adulteries and lustful neighings, your shameless prostitution! I have seen your detestable acts on the hills and in the fields. Woe to you, O Jerusalem! How long will you be unclean?"

ekegusii: Ebisasimero biaino mbisarigwe kegima, naboigo na ebisasimero biaino bi’ogosambera ubani. Abanto abwo baraitwe mbatugutwe bosio bw’emegwekano yaino mogosasima.
english: Your altars will be demolished and your incense altars will be smashed; and I will slay your people in front of your idols.

ekegusii: Okoboko kwao nigo kore nokobua, ee, nigo kore ne chinguru; okoboko kwao gw’okorio nigo koimokererete igoro.
english: Your arm is endued with power; your hand is strong, your right hand exalted.

ekegusii: Your attitude should be the same as that of Christ Jesus:
english: Naki mobe nebirengererio ebio ebio ime yaino buna ebio biarenge ime ya Kristo Yeso.

ekegusii: Your basket and your kneading trough will be blessed.
english: “Nesesenigwe endagera y’ebitonga biaino amo ney’ebituba biaino mogo konyera obosie.

ekegusii: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
english: “Neragererigwe endagera y’ebitonga biaino amo nebituba biaino mogokonyera obosie.

ekegusii: Ogwechabera kwaino tikoba ogwa isiko ase okomina chitukia, na kobeka ebigera bie chitahabu, gose chianga chinterere,
english: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment, such as braided hair and the wearing of gold jewelry and fine clothes.

ekegusii: Eki kwabwate ritang’ani kerorekane kere egeke, koreng’anigwa neki oramenterwe nyuma.
english: Your beginnings will seem humble, so prosperous will your future be.

ekegusii: Ogwetogia kwaino tikori okuya. Timomanyeti ng’a ememera emeke nigo ekobotia ribomba rigima?
english: Your boasting is not good. Don't you know that a little yeast works through the whole batch of dough?

ekegusii: Chimbeere chiao nigo chinga buna chimanwa ibere chire chisare chi’engabi.
english: Your breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.

ekegusii: 'Your brother has come,' he replied, 'and your father has killed the fattened calf because he has him back safe and sound.'
english: Ere akamoiraneria: Momura omino ochire, na iso omonyenyeire emori enoru, ekiagera amonyora ore omogima.

ekegusii: Nonya nabamino, abanto b’eamate ya iso, babeire abang’ainereria asore, nigo bagokuura korwa nyuma yao. Nabaisa gokwana amang’ana amaya asore, tobaisa kobegena.”
english: Your brothers, your own family-- even they have betrayed you; they have raised a loud cry against you. Do not trust them, though they speak well of you.

ekegusii: Emebere yaino ekw ete nebe endagera ye chinyoni chia igoro, na eye ching’iti chi’orosana, na onde tari orachiserie achioboyie.
english: Your carcasses will be food for all the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth, and there will be no one to frighten them away.

ekegusii: Chinsea chiao nechinseera, chichabeire nebinto bi’oboseera, ne rigoti riao nigo richabeire ne chisonoi.
english: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.

ekegusii: “Ase ebiaare bigochi‐gocha, ne chinderia chiaino, na abamenyi barache korwa ase chinse chi’aare, mbarore emechando y’ense eria, na amarwaire Omonene ayetomeire.
english: Your children who follow you in later generations and foreigners who come from distant lands will see the calamities that have fallen on the land and the diseases with which the LORD has afflicted it.

ekegusii: Abana baino nababe abarisia ase erooro eye ase engaki y’emiaka emerongo ene, nabarabwo nabachandeke, ekiagera inwe motabete abegenwa asende, mbabe bagochandeka goika omonto bw’omoerio bw’ekegori kiaino akwe, na omobere oye osirere ase erooro eye.
english: Your children will be shepherds here for forty years, suffering for your unfaithfulness, until the last of your bodies lies in the desert.

ekegusii: Amakura aino are amaya mono aichoirwe ne chigari, na abariini chibarasi mbateneine ase ebiita.
english: Your choicest valleys are full of chariots, and horsemen are posted at the city gates;

ekegusii: Ase emiaka eye yonsi emerongo ene, chianga chiano tichiabagoterete, gose amagoro aino tabimbete.
english: Your clothes did not wear out and your feet did not swell during these forty years.

ekegusii: Amachiko ao nigo agonkora naba omong’aini kobua ababisa baane, ekiagera ayio nigo are asende chingaki chionsi.
english: Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, for they are ever with me.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, amabera ao nigo are amanene; ong’e obogima oboyia koreng’ana nokogamba kwao.
english: Your compassion is great, O LORD; preserve my life according to your laws.

ekegusii: Ense yaino yasarigwe yatigaire ere bosa, emechie yaino yasambirwe nomorero; abanto b’egesaku ekeao barire okwama kw’emegondo yaino ase amaiso aino. Ense yasarigwe na koonchoranwa nabarabwo.
english: Your country is desolate, your cities burned with fire; your fields are being stripped by foreigners right before you, laid waste as when overthrown by strangers.

ekegusii: Erio okobwatana kw’ogotianania koria mwakorete namakweri ngosarigwe, na okobwatana kwaino mwakorete naase abakure tigokogenderera kobao; ekero emechando eyio emebe erache, goika motiringerwe inse
english: Your covenant with death will be annulled; your agreement with the grave will not stand. When the overwhelming scourge sweeps by, you will be beaten down by it.

ekegusii: Ekero imenyete ase enyomba yane y’obogeni, nabeire nkona‐gotererera emeroberio yao echikire.
english: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.

ekegusii: narororwo inarobe oronge buna orotu rw’ense, naye norande gochia ensemo ya bosongo, na moocha, na sugusu, na irianyi; na asore aye, na ase ororeria rwao, chiamate chionsi chi’ense inachisesenigwe.
english: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.

ekegusii: Oroiboro rwao nigo rware gocha koba oronge buna omokenye, na ororeria rwao robuche robe oronge buna chinche chi’omokenye. Amarieta abo tarenge gocha korusigwa, gose gosirigwa, korwa ase obosio bwane.”
english: Your descendants would have been like the sand, your children like its numberless grains; their name would never be cut off nor destroyed from before me."

ekegusii: Chimbebe chiao nigo chiigete enyancha gati; abaagachi bao nabwo bagokorete okaba omoseera omoikeranu.
english: Your domain was on the high seas; your builders brought your beauty to perfection.

ekegusii: rirorio abagaaka baino amo nabagambi, bagende korenga oboaare korwa aase agwo omonto oyio akwerete goika ase emechie eetanaine ere ang’e naase agwo.
english: your elders and judges shall go out and measure the distance from the body to the neighboring towns.

ekegusii: Abanto abakogechete mbarenterwe obosooku, na obomenyo bw’abakori amabe tibokogenderera kobao.”
english: Your enemies will be clothed in shame, and the tents of the wicked will be no more."

ekegusii: Etaya y’omobere oo neriso riao; ekero eriso riao rire rigiya, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire noborabu; korende ekero eriso riao rire riibe, omobere oo bwonsi nigo oichire nomosunte.
english: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body also is full of darkness.

ekegusii: Aye ore namaiso amachenu mono atari korigereria amabe na aya atari ay’oboronge, naki orakore oremererie korora abanto batari abegenwa, na okire‐kiri ekero abakori amabe bagosiria abare abanyaboronge kobabua?
english: Your eyes are too pure to look on evil; you cannot tolerate wrong. Why then do you tolerate the treacherous? Why are you silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?

ekegusii: Amaiso ao nigo andoche ekero narenge enche ase enda ya baba ime, amatuko aane onsi nigo arigetwe ase ebuku yao, na akaroberigwa ritang’ani rituko rinde ritaraika.
english: your eyes saw my unformed body. All the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.

ekegusii: Amaiso ao nigo ararore amang’ana amageni, na ebirengererio biao mbibe ebikorekanu.
english: Your eyes will see strange sights and your mind imagine confusing things.

ekegusii: Amaiso aino arore omoruoti ore ase obwari bwaye; narore ense ere engare mono.
english: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty and view a land that stretches afar.

ekegusii: Obwegenwa bwao nigo bogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi; aye gwakoreire ense aase aye, ero nigo eteneine bokong’u.
english: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures.

ekegusii: Rora, inwe nigo mokweng’ata ase okwomana na okoamererania. Nigo mogoakana chinkundi chi’ogokora amabe. Okweng’ata kwaino buna okwe rituko ria rero nigo kogotanga ogosaba kwaino tikoigugwa igoro.
english: Your fasting ends in quarreling and strife, and in striking each other with wicked fists. You cannot fast as you do today and expect your voice to be heard on high.

ekegusii: Ibrahimu sokoro yaino nigo agogete ng’a nanyare korora rituko riane; akarirora, akagoka.”
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad."

ekegusii: Ogosesenigwa gwa iso nkore ne chinguru ngoetanetie okw’ebitunwa bia kare, na obonene bw’ebigoro bia kare na kare. Ogosesenigwa okwo kobe egutwa y’omotwe o Yusufu, igoro y’egiototeri ki’oyore omogambi ase egati y’abamwabo.
english: Your father's blessings are greater than the blessings of the ancient mountains, than the bounty of the age-old hills. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.

ekegusii: Sokoro yao bwe ritang’ani nigo akorete ebibe, na abarenge abakwani b’amang’ana ao bagasaria asende,
english: Your first father sinned; your spokesmen rebelled against me.

ekegusii: Ababisa bao nigo bakwoga aase abanto bao basangererekanete, barabwo batenenirie chibendera chiabo koba ebimanyererio biabo.
english: Your foes roared in the place where you met with us; they set up their standards as signs.

ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaino nchiariete mana ase erooro, na barabwo bagakwa.
english: Your forefathers ate the manna in the desert, yet they died.

ekegusii: Chisokoro chiaino chiria chiatirimbogete gochia Misiri nigo chiarenge abanto emerongo etano na ebere, na bono Omonene, Nyasae oino, obamentekanirie, mwabeire abange buna ching’enang’eni chia igoro.
english: Your forefathers who went down into Egypt were seventy in all, and now the LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

ekegusii: Omobaso na obotuko ebiita biao mbibe biigoire botambe, tibigosiekwa, na abanto mbabe bagokorentera obotenenku bw’ebisaku, na abaruoti babo babe bakobatang’ana.
english: Your gates will always stand open, they will never be shut, day or night, so that men may bring you the wealth of the nations-- their kings led in triumphal procession.

ekegusii: Chitahabu ne chifeta chiaino chiasoirwe noboboosu, na oboboosu obwo bwabeire kirori igoro yaino, na borobwo naborie emebere yaino buna omorero okoria. Mwegacheire emonga amatuko aya ay’omoerio.
english: Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and eat your flesh like fire. You have hoarded wealth in the last days.

ekegusii: Abagambi bao nigo banga buna chingige, na abaraai bao nigo banga buna amasendo e chingige chigosoa ase chimbago ime ekero ki’obokendu; ekero omobaso obarire chiairuruka chiagenda, onde takomanya ase chiagenda.
english: Your guards are like locusts, your officials like swarms of locusts that settle in the walls on a cold day-- but when the sun appears they fly away, and no one knows where.

ekegusii: Ase enchera eyio amaboko aino naimokererigwe igoro y’abachandi baino, na inwe mosirie kegima ababisa baino bonsi.
english: Your hand will be lifted up in triumph over your enemies, and all your foes will be destroyed.

ekegusii: Aye Omoruoti, noikeere ababisa bao bonsi; nobwate nokoboko kwao gw’okorio abwo bakogechete.
english: Your hand will lay hold on all your enemies; your right hand will seize your foes.

ekegusii: Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding to learn your commands.
english: Amaboko ao naro ambombete akandoisia, ing’a obong’aini, erinde inyare kweorokereria amachiko ao.

ekegusii: Aye Abineri, amaboko ao tasibetwe, gose amagoro ao tare kobekwa chingataare. Nigo kwagwa buna omonto ogoitwa nabakayayu.” Naende abanto bonsi bakagenderera komoreera.
english: Your hands were not bound, your feet were not fettered. You fell as one falls before wicked men." And all the people wept over him again.

ekegusii: Omotwe oo nigo osongoire buna egetunwa gia Karimeli. Etukia y’omotwe oo ekona‐gosanyoka nigo ere ekieni kemonyinga; eyio yang’usire omoruoti.
english: Your head crowns you like Mount Carmel. Your hair is like royal tapestry; the king is held captive by its tresses.
