ekegusii: Enkoro yao nigo yeimokereretie igoro ase engencho y’obosiani bwao, aye ogasaria obong’aini bwao ase engencho y’obomeka‐meku bwao. Ase ayio ngakoiyeria inse, nkagotiga ase amaiso ’abaruoti bagosekerere.
english: Your heart became proud on account of your beauty, and you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor. So I threw you to the earth; I made a spectacle of you before kings.

ekegusii: Enyomba yao na oboruoti bwao nigo birakong’igwe bibe ne chinguru ase obosio bwane kare na kare, na ekerogo kiao ki’oboruoti nigo keratenene bokong’u kare na kare.”
english: Your house and your kingdom will endure forever before me; your throne will be established forever.'"

ekegusii: Oboruoti bwao boche, Ogwancha kwao gokoreke ense, Buna kogokoreka igoro.
english: your kingdom come, your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

ekegusii: Oboruoti bwao nobwa kare na kare, na okogambera kwao nigo kogendererete ase ebiaare bionsi. Omonene nigo are omwegenwa ase amang’ana aye onsi, na oichire nobuya ase ogokora kwaye gwonsi.
english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful to all his promises and loving toward all he has made.

ekegusii: Ebinto bionsi nigo bigendererete kobao goika rero buna aye kwabichigete, ekiagera bionsi nigo bikogokorera.
english: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.

ekegusii: Ebikoba biao nigo binga eusi embariri, omonwa oo nigo ore oyo bw’okogokia, chinsea chiao chitubire ime ase egietubo kiao; nigo chinga buna ebing’ese bie ritunda rikomomanga.
english: Your lips are like a scarlet ribbon; your mouth is lovely. Your temples behind your veil are like the halves of a pomegranate.

ekegusii: Aye omoriakari one, ebikoba biao nigo bikonyororokia obooke; obooke na amabeere nigo bire inse y’oromeme rwao. Rimisu rie chianga chiao nigo ringa eria Lebanoni.
english: Your lips drop sweetness as the honeycomb, my bride; milk and honey are under your tongue. The fragrance of your garments is like that of Lebanon.

ekegusii: Naki oyominto, nigo nabete nomogoko omonge na okoremigwa ase engencho y’obwanchani bwao, ekiagera chinkoro chi’abachenu chiatimogetigwe naye.
english: Your love has given me great joy and encouragement, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obwanchani bwao botari koera nigo bogoika aaria igoro, na obwegenwa bwao nigo boigete ase amare igoro.
english: Your love, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies.

ekegusii: Emereng’anio y’obong’aini bwaino nigo ere bosa buna ribu, ne chiburi chiaino nigo chigiteire esike.
english: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.

ekegusii: Abanto baino mbaitwe nemioro, na abarwani baino chituoni mbakwere ase esegi.
english: Your men will fall by the sword, your warriors in battle.

ekegusii: Your menservants and maidservants and the best of your cattle and donkeys he will take for his own use.
english: Boigo naire abasomba baino, abamura na abaiseke, na abasae baino abaya, babe bakomokorera, ne chitigere chiaino chibe chikomokorera boigo.

ekegusii: nyoko nabe nobosooku obonene, ee, omochie oyo okoiborete noichanigwe. Rora, ase egati ye chinse chi’ense oyio obe omoke mono kobua, nobe erooro enyomo ere bosa.
english: your mother will be greatly ashamed; she who gave you birth will be disgraced. She will be the least of the nations-- a wilderness, a dry land, a desert.

ekegusii: Obogetirianda bwao tibogotubwa, na obosooku bwao mbororekane. Nindusie egesiomba na tinkororera nonya noyomo amabera.”
english: Your nakedness will be exposed and your shame uncovered. I will take vengeance; I will spare no one."

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, erieta riao nigo rigendererete kobao goika kare na kare. Nobe gokoinyorwa nebiaare bionsi.
english: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, your renown, O LORD, through all generations.

ekegusii: Ekenyobu kiao nigo keborongosire buya buna egetaabo getari koererwa edivai yochoganirie. Enda yao nigo ere buna etui y’engano, eetananeirie ebisicha ebiya.
english: Your navel is a rounded goblet that never lacks blended wine. Your waist is a mound of wheat encircled by lilies.

ekegusii: Rigoti riao nigo ringa buna omorobiri oroiseirie amaino e chinchogu, amaiso ao nigo anga buna amatibo a Hesiboni, ang’e negeita kia Bati‐Rabimu. Emioro yao nigo enga buna omorobiri o Lebanoni orochie Damesiki.
english: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath Rabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon looking toward Damascus.

ekegusii: Rigoti riao nigo ringa buna omorobiri o Daudi, oyio oagachetwe koba rigachero ri’ebirwanero. Agwo nao ching’aya elifu eyemo chisungire, chionsi nigo chire echi’abarwani esegi bare chituoni.
english: Your neck is like the tower of David, built with elegance; on it hang a thousand shields, all of them shields of warriors.

ekegusii: Inche nigo ngechete emeyega y’Amatuko Amanene na ey’Emetienyi Emeyia; eyio yabeire egurube endito asende, narosire ase okona‐koyeremereria.
english: Your New Moon festivals and your appointed feasts my soul hates. They have become a burden to me; I am weary of bearing them.

ekegusii: Abanto barenge gosukia amaato ao nemegango, bagakoira aase amache amange are. Omwaga okorwa moocha okagusa ogakobunerao, agwo ase egati y’enyancha.
english: Your oarsmen take you out to the high seas. But the east wind will break you to pieces in the heart of the sea.

ekegusii: Okoruegwa okwo inwe morarue, nigo korabarwe asemore buna nokoruegwa kw’endagera korwa ase ebiooreri biaino, na okw’edivai na amaguta korwa ase ekemitero, okwo abande bakorua.
english: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.

ekegusii: “Mosubati omino omonene nere Samaria, oyio omenyete amo nabaiseke baye ensemo yao ya sugusu, na mosubati omino omoke nere Sodomu, oyio omenyete amo nabaiseke baye ensemo ya irianyi.
english: Your older sister was Samaria, who lived to the north of you with her daughters; and your younger sister, who lived to the south of you with her daughters, was Sodom.

ekegusii: Tari inche ngokonachera ekina, korende amang’ana aya ogokwana, ee, aya ogokwana nomonwa oo akobereire kirori.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, not mine; your own lips testify against you.

ekegusii: Chiombe chiaino nachinyenyerwe ase amaiso aino, korende timokoria chinyama chiabo. Namourwe chitigere chiaino ne chinguru ekero morigereretie, na tichikoiranigwa asemore naende. Ababisa baino mbaegwe ching’ondi chiaino, na onde tari orabakonye inwe.
english: Your ox will be slaughtered before your eyes, but you will eat none of it. Your donkey will be forcibly taken from you and will not be returned. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and no one will rescue them.

ekegusii: Nigo gwakorete enchera yao ase enyancha, oboeto bwao bokaba ime ase amache amange mono, korende nonya naboigo amabarato ao tarorekanete aroro.
english: Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.

ekegusii: Omoganda oo okanyora obomenyo aase agwo. Aye Nyasae, ase engencho y’obuya bwao, kwaeire abanto abataka aya baremeire.
english: Your people settled in it, and from your bounty, O God, you provided for the poor.

ekegusii: Abanto baraitwe mbagwe ase egati yaino, na inwe monyare komanya ng’a inche ninche Omonene.
english: Your people will fall slain among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto bao mbaagache naende amatombe aria a kare, noagache amaroso ’ebiaare ebinge; aye norokwe” “Omoroisia bw’aase atagogete”, na “Oyokoroisia chinchera chibe chinyia, erinde ense emenywe”.
english: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins and will raise up the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of Broken Walls, Restorer of Streets with Dwellings.

ekegusii: Buna omogondo ore namakomomanga aye nigo okwama amatunda amaya mono, na ebisicha bikorokwa hena mbireo, na ebimeri bikorokwa narada,
english: Your plants are an orchard of pomegranates with choice fruits, with henna and nard,

ekegusii: Abanto nigo bagocha babasakora buna chingeeti chigosakora, na buna chingige chikoumokera, nabarabwo nabo bakobaumokera.
english: Your plunder, O nations, is harvested as by young locusts; like a swarm of locusts men pounce on it.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, omoganda oo ogotaara ororekanire; ee, aye Nyasae one, na omoruoti one, omoganda oria oo ogosoa ase obomenyo bwao obochenu.
english: Your procession has come into view, O God, the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.

ekegusii: Ring’ana riao riateemirwe, nigo riteneine bokong’u, na inche omosomba oo nigo ndianchete.
english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

ekegusii: Inwe Abaisraeli, ababani baino nigo banga buna ebibwe bimenyete ase amaturi.
english: Your prophets, O Israel, are like jackals among ruins.

ekegusii: Chingori chi’omoenga bw’emeeri chianyega‐nyegire, tichikonyara gosiberania omoenga bokong’u aase aye, gose korambora ebitambaa. Erio ebinto ebinge mbisakorwe biatananwe, nonya nebisegora mbisakore ebinto.
english: Your rigging hangs loose: The mast is not held secure, the sail is not spread. Then an abundance of spoils will be divided and even the lame will carry off plunder.

ekegusii: Oboronge bwao nigo bore obwa kare na kare, na amachiko ao nigo are ay’ekeene.
english: Your righteousness is everlasting and your law is true.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oboronge bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u buna ebitunwa biao. Okogamba kwao nigo kore buna chindiba chintambe, aye nigo orendete mwanyabanto ne ching’iti boigo.
english: Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains, your justice like the great deep. O LORD, you preserve both man and beast.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, oboronge bwao boigete aaria igoro mono. Aye nigo gwakorete amang’ana amanene mono. Ee, Nyasae, ning’o ore buna aye?
english: Your righteousness reaches to the skies, O God, you who have done great things. Who, O God, is like you?

ekegusii: Abatang’ani bao nigo bare abasaria, naende babeire abagisangio b’abaibi. Kera oyomo obo nigo anchete riaaki, na nigo are omwango kwerigeria ebitoki. Tibari korwanerera chintakana, nigo bakwanga koigwa amang’ana ’ababoraka.
english: Your rulers are rebels, companions of thieves; they all love bribes and chase after gifts. They do not defend the cause of the fatherless; the widow's case does not come before them.

ekegusii: Your sacred cities have become a desert; even Zion is a desert, Jerusalem a desolation.
english: Emechie yao emechenu yasarigwe yabeire orosana, na Sayoni obeire erooro, na Yerusalemu obeire bosa.

ekegusii: Naki inche, omosomba oo, nigo nebegete nkaba intenenera ase omosae oyo ase tata, nkamotebia: Ntamoiraneti asore, nigo ndabe omomochi asore ase obogima bwane bwonsi.
english: Your servant guaranteed the boy's safety to my father. I said, 'If I do not bring him back to you, I will bear the blame before you, my father, all my life!'

ekegusii: rora omosomba oo onyorire ogwancherwa ase amaiso ao, kwamentire amabera ao asende ase ogotooria obogima bwane; korende inche tinkonyara gotama ng’ikeere ebitunwa; amabe abaise konyora, ang’ite.
english: Your servant has found favor in your eyes, and you have shown great kindness to me in sparing my life. But I can't flee to the mountains; this disaster will overtake me, and I'll die.

ekegusii: Your servant has killed both the lion and the bear; this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them, because he has defied the armies of the living God.
english: Inche, omosomba oo, nabeire ngoita chindo ne chidubu, naboigo buna nakorete ching’iti chiria ninkore n’Omofilisti oria otarogeti, oyochayire emeganda y’esegi ya Nyasae ore moyo.”

ekegusii: Inche omosomba oo nigo inde ase egati y’abanto bao, aba gwachorire, abanto abange batanyare kobareka ase engencho y’obonge bwabo.
english: Your servant is here among the people you have chosen, a great people, too numerous to count or number.

ekegusii: Omosomba oo Yoabu nigo akorire aya, erinde akoonchorerie goetera ase ring’ana eri, korende aye, omonene one, nigo ore ne chisemi buna echi’abamalaika ba Nyasae; nomanyete amang’ana onsi ayare ase ense.”
english: Your servant Joab did this to change the present situation. My lord has wisdom like that of an angel of God-- he knows everything that happens in the land."

ekegusii: Ninki rende aye omoruoti ogochia konduera eng’eria buna eyio. Tiga inche, omosomba oo, nyamboke Yorodan oka.
english: Your servant will cross over the Jordan with the king for a short distance, but why should the king reward me in this way?

ekegusii: Chimboba titori koegwa, korende nigo tokona‐kobetererigwa ng’a tokore amatabori. Na bono intwe, abasomba bao, nigo tokona‐goakwa; korende okomocha nokw’abanto bao.”
english: Your servants are given no straw, yet we are told, 'Make bricks!' Your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people."

ekegusii: Chifeta chiao ne chitahabu chiao nechiane; boigo abakungu bao abanyakieni, na abana bao nabaane.”
english: 'Your silver and gold are mine, and the best of your wives and children are mine.'"

ekegusii: Your silver has become dross, your choice wine is diluted with water.
english: Chifeta chiao chiabeire bosa buna amabiria, na edivai yao yochoganigwe namache.

ekegusii: Your sin prompts your mouth; you adopt the tongue of the crafty.
english: Ebibe biao biorokereirie omonwa oo amang’ana ogokwana, aye gwachorire gokwana amang’ana ’obong’ainereria.

ekegusii: Abana baino, abamura na abaiseke, inabairwe nabanto b’egesaku ekeao ekero morigereretie, erio mobe mochandegete, ne rituko ase rituko mobe namaiga ase abana baino, korende timokonyara gotanga tibairwa.
english: Your sons and daughters will be given to another nation, and you will wear out your eyes watching for them day after day, powerless to lift a hand.

ekegusii: “Abana bao nigo bakoayerera gocha, na abagosaretie nigo bagotama korwa asore.
english: Your sons hasten back, and those who laid you waste depart from you.

ekegusii: Abamura bao bagoyire, nigo baraire ase amatabekania e chinchera chionsi, buna chingabi chiabwatirwe nemeeto. Omonene Nyasae oo obeire nendamwamu asebare, obaeire egesusuro.
english: Your sons have fainted; they lie at the head of every street, like antelope caught in a net. They are filled with the wrath of the LORD and the rebuke of your God.

ekegusii: Abana bao abamura mbabe ribaga rie chisokoro chiao, naye nobabeke babe abagambi igoro ase ense yonsi.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

ekegusii: Aye nigo okinete buna omokendo, ne chimbeere chiao nigo chire buna ebisago bi’amasabibu.
english: Your stature is like that of the palm, and your breasts like clusters of fruit.

ekegusii: Oborori bwao nigo bore oboronge goika kare na kare; on g’e okomanya, erinde imbe moyo.
english: Your statutes are forever right; give me understanding that I may live.

ekegusii: Nigo ngokerete oborori bwao, ekiagera nabwo bogonsemia.
english: Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors.

ekegusii: Oborori bwao nabwo omwando one goika kare na kare, ee, nabwo enkoro yane egokerete mono.
english: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.

ekegusii: Oborori bwao nigo bore obw’ogokumia, ase ayio nigo mbobwatete nomoyo one bwonsi.
english: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, oborori bwao nigo boteneine bokong’u. Obochenu nabwo bore ogochaberwa kw’enyomba yao goika kare na kare.
english: Your statutes stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days, O LORD.

ekegusii: Emeremo yaino emekong’u morabe mogokora, nigo erabe bosa, ekiagera ense yaino tekwama endagera, na emete tekwama amatunda.
english: Your strength will be spent in vain, because your soil will not yield its crops, nor will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

ekegusii: Erioba riao tirikorimera nonya ng’ake, gose omotienyi oo togosira, ekiagera Omonene nere orabe omobaso oo o kare na kare, na amatuko ao ay’omoichano naere.
english: Your sun will never set again, and your moon will wane no more; the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will end.

ekegusii: Amaino ao nigo anga riicho rie ching’ondi chiaberi chianachirwe amarionya, chiarure gosibigwa chiarabire se, chionsi nigo chikobiara chisare, na manwa ende teri egokwa.
english: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep coming up from the washing. Each has its twin, not one of them is alone.

ekegusii: Amaino ao nigo anga ching’ondi chiaberi chianachirwe amarionya, chiarure gosibigwa chiarabire se, chionsi nigo chikobiara chisare, na manwa ende teri gokwa.
english: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep just shorn, coming up from the washing. Each has its twin; not one of them is alone.

ekegusii: Chinsea chiao nigo chitubire ime ase egietubo kiao, nigo chinga buna chimbaara chie ritunda rikomomanga.
english: Your temples behind your veil are like the halves of a pomegranate.

ekegusii: Orogongo rwaino nigo rorachakere erooro ya irianyi, roikere Lebanoni ensemo ya sugusu, naende rochakere orooche oronene rw’Eufarati, robwateranie ense yonsi y’Abahiti roikere Enyancha Enene ya bosongo.
english: Your territory will extend from the desert to Lebanon, and from the great river, the Euphrates-- all the Hittite country-- to the Great Sea on the west.

ekegusii: Okwama kwaino nakobe okonene, na mogenderere koora goika engaki y’ogotora amasabibu eike, na mogenderere gotora amasabibu goika engaki y’ogosimeka eike; na inwe namonyore endagera enyinge, naende momenye ase ense yaino ase obotoereru.
english: Your threshing will continue until grape harvest and the grape harvest will continue until planting, and you will eat all the food you want and live in safety in your land.

ekegusii: Ekerogo kiao ki’obonene nigo kiabekire aroro korwa kare, ekiagera aye nao kwarenge korwa kare.
english: Your throne was established long ago; you are from all eternity.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, ekerogo kiao ki’obonene nigo kegendererete kobao kare na kare. Enyimbo yao y’oboruoti nigo ere ey’oboronge.
english: Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.

ekegusii: Okogukura gw’enkoba nigo kwarenge ime ase ekerambauti, na ense egatengecha.
english: Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

ekegusii: Aye omong’ainereria, oromeme rwao nigo rokoroberia amang’ana ’ogosaria; nigo ronga buna omoyio otukia omwoge.
english: Your tongue plots destruction; it is like a sharpened razor, you who practice deceit.

ekegusii: Abanto bao mberue nogwancha kwabo, ekero orasangererie abarwani bao b’esegi. Abamura bao mbache asore beboetie oboseera obochenu, buna riime ria mambia.
english: Your troops will be willing on your day of battle. Arrayed in holy majesty, from the womb of the dawn you will receive the dew of your youth.

ekegusii: Chimbeere chiao nigo chinga buna chimanwa ibere buna chisare chi’engabi chikorisia agwo ase egati y’ebisicha ebiya.
english: Your two breasts are like two fawns, like twin fawns of a gazelle that browse among the lilies.

ekegusii: Abanto bayosambire nomorero na koyogecha. Osirie abanto abwo ase okobea kwao!
english: Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish.

ekegusii: Inwe Abatemani, abarwani baino b’esegi bare chituoni mbaondoke, na kera oyomo ore ase Egetunwa gia Esau naitwe asirigwe kegima.”
english: Your warriors, O Teman, will be terrified, and everyone in Esau's mountains will be cut down in the slaughter.

ekegusii: Aye Nyasae, chinchera chiao nigo chire chinchenu. Nenyasae ereri ere enene buna Nyasae oito?
english: Your ways, O God, are holy. What god is so great as our God?

ekegusii: “Obotenenku ne chinibo chiaino nimbirue bibe ebisakorwa, tibigoakanwa, ekiagera mwakorire ebibe ebinge ase ense yaino yonsi.
english: Your wealth and your treasures I will give as plunder, without charge, because of all your sins throughout your country.

ekegusii: Your wealth has rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
english: Chinibo chiaino chiagundire, ne chianga chiaino chiarirwe nebigwankwa.

ekegusii: Obotenenku bwao, na ebinto biao bionsi na oboonchoreria bwao, na abanto bao be chimeeri, na abagendia bao ba chirochio, na abwo barenge aase ao atandogete, na abarwani bao bonsi b’esegi abare ime yao, na omoganda oo bwonsi ore ime yao, bonsi nigo bararimere ime y’enyancha amo nebinto bionsi, ase rituko ri’ogosirigwa kwao.
english: Your wealth, merchandise and wares, your mariners, seamen and shipwrights, your merchants and all your soldiers, and everyone else on board will sink into the heart of the sea on the day of your shipwreck.

ekegusii: Amabe ao ogokora nigo akorenta emechando ase omonto onde onga buna aye, na oboronge bwao nabo boragere omonto onde anyore ayare amaya.”
english: Your wickedness affects only a man like yourself, and your righteousness only the sons of men.

ekegusii: “Obobe bwaino nabobarentere egesusuro; okogwa kwaino korwa ase okwegena nkogere motogonyerwe. Goika momanye na korora ng’a mwerenteire obobe na obororo ekero mwantigire inche Omonene, Nyasae oino, na timonyirogeti.” Nabo Omonene, Nyasae bw’Emeganda, atebire.
english: Your wickedness will punish you; your backsliding will rebuke you. Consider then and realize how evil and bitter it is for you when you forsake the LORD your God and have no awe of me," declares the Lord, the LORD Almighty.

ekegusii: Mokao nabe ase enyomba yao buna omosabibu okwama amasabibu; abana bao nigo barabe buna ebisebo bi’omozeituni, baikaranse baetanane emesa yao.
english: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your sons will be like olive shoots around your table.

ekegusii: Abakungu baino na abana baino nabatigare, amo namaicho aino, ase ense eye Musa abaete aiga moocha ya Yorodan. Inwe abanyene abamore chituoni chi’esegi goika mwamboke mobogoretie ebirwanero biaino, motang’ane abamino.
english: Your wives, your children and your livestock may stay in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan, but all your fighting men, fully armed, must cross over ahead of your brothers. You are to help your brothers

ekegusii: Ring’ana riao netaya ase amagoro aane na omobaso ase enchera ngoeta.
english: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light for my path.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, ring’ana riao nigo riteneine bokong’u aaria igoro goika kare na kare.
english: Your word, O LORD, is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.

ekegusii: Your words have supported those who stumbled; you have strengthened faltering knees.
english: Amang’ana ao abeire akoremia oyo konya osinyirwe kogenderera, na aye gwakong’irie amaru aye arenge koiguswa.

ekegusii: Endamwamu yao entindi yantubire kegima, amaakwa ao ansiririe.
english: Your wrath has swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.

ekegusii: Egesusuro kiao nigo kere ekerito igoro yane, kwambagoreire emerindo yao yonsi yantubire kegima.
english: Your wrath lies heavily upon me; you have overwhelmed me with all your waves. Selah

ekegusii: Na bono amamocho aino abatangire timonyora ebinto ebio, na ebibe biaino biatangire ebinto ebiya mwarenge gocha koegwa.
english: Your wrongdoings have kept these away; your sins have deprived you of good.

ekegusii: Aye Omonene, obonene nobwao amo nokobua, na obomeka‐meku, na obobui, na obonguru. Ebinto bionsi bire igoro na ebire ase ense nebiao. Aye Omonene, oboruoti nobwao, naye omonyene bweimokereretie igoro okaba omotwe o bionsi.
english: Yours, O LORD, is the greatness and the power and the glory and the majesty and the splendor, for everything in heaven and earth is yours. Yours, O LORD, is the kingdom; you are exalted as head over all.

ekegusii: Abanto baane nigo bagochandwa nabana, na abakungu nabwo bakobagambera. Inwe abanto baane, abaraai baino babatantanirie enchera, babasiririe ase enchera mogoeta.
english: Youths oppress my people, women rule over them. O my people, your guides lead you astray; they turn you from the path.

ekegusii: na Sabadi omomura oye, na Sutela omomura oye. Naende Efraimu nabwate abana babere, Eseri na Eleadi; baria abanto baiboretwe ase ense ya Gadi baitete, ekiagera bachete koiba chiombe chiabo.
english: Zabad his son and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the native-born men of Gath, when they went down to seize their livestock.

ekegusii: Zabad the father of Ephlal, Ephlal the father of Obed,
english: Sabadi akaibora Efilali, na Efilali akaibora Obedi;

ekegusii: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
english: Sakuri, na Serebia, na Sebania;

ekegusii: Zadok his son and Ahimaaz his son.
english: na Zadoki omomura oye, na Ahimasi omomura oye.

ekegusii: Zadoki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani, na Seraya nere orenge omoriki;
english: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was secretary;

ekegusii: Zadoki, mosinto bw’Ahitubu, na Ahimeleki, mosinto bw’Abiatari, nabwo barenge abakuani, na Sausa nere orenge omoriki.
english: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was secretary;

ekegusii: Aroro agwo Zadoki omokuani akabogoria orogunchara rw’amaguta korwa ase Eema y’Omosangererekano, agaaka Sulemani amaguta ayio ase okomwatanana. Erio bakabugia egetureri, na abanto bonsi bagateba, “Omoruoti Sulemani ochie kare!”
english: Zadok the priest took the horn of oil from the sacred tent and anointed Solomon. Then they sounded the trumpet and all the people shouted, "Long live King Solomon!"

ekegusii: Zadoki nao arenge na Abalawi bonsi. Barabwo babogoretie Esanduku ya Nyasae ere ne chibao chirikire okobwatana kw’ogotianania. Abiatari nere agachao. Ababogoretie Esanduku eria ba kayetoora inse goika abanto bonsi bakaba barure ase omochie.
english: Zadok was there, too, and all the Levites who were with him were carrying the ark of the covenant of God. They set down the ark of God, and Abiathar offered sacrifices until all the people had finished leaving the city.

ekegusii: Salimoni korwa Ahohi, na Maharai korwa Netofa;
english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

ekegusii: Sanoa, na Adulamu na ase ebichie biabo, na Lakisi na amaremo narengeo, na Aseka na ase ebichie biaye. Ase ayio bakaba bakomenya gochakera Beeri-Seba goikera ase Rikura ria Hinomu.
english: Zanoah, Adullam and their villages, in Lachish and its fields, and in Azekah and its settlements. So they were living all the way from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.

ekegusii: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam,
english: na Sanoa, na Eni‐Ganimu, na Tapua, na Enamu,

ekegusii: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,
english: Sebadia na Aradi, na Ederi,

ekegusii: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,
english: Sebadia na Mesulamu, Hisiki na Heberi,

ekegusii: Erio Seba na Salimuna bagatebia Gidioni, “Imoka aye omonyene, otoite, ekiagera buna omonto are, naboigo ne chinguru chiaye chire.” Ere akaimoka, agaita Seba na Salimuna; akarusia chisonoi chi’ogwechabera chiarenge ase amagoti e chingamia chiabo.
english: Zebah and Zalmunna said, "Come, do it yourself. 'As is the man, so is his strength.'" So Gideon stepped forward and killed them, and took the ornaments off their camels' necks.

ekegusii: Seba na Salimuna, abaruoti baria babere b’Abamidiani, bagatama, korende Gidioni akababwatia akababwata. Erio akagosa abarwani bonsi na kobaserebania.
english: Zebah and Zalmunna, the two kings of Midian, fled, but he pursued them and captured them, routing their entire army.

ekegusii: Zechariah asked the angel, "How can I be sure of this? I am an old man and my wife is well along in years."
english: Zakaria agatebia omomalaika, “Naki ndakore imanye ayio? Ekiagera inche nomogotu, na mokane nomong’ina.”

ekegusii: Zakaria, mosinto o Meselemia, nere orenge omorendi bw’egeita agwo ase egesoero ki Eema y’Omosangererekano.
english: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was the gatekeeper at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

ekegusii: Zakaria na Yasieli, Semiramoti na Yehieli, Uni na Eliabu, Maaseya na Benaya, aba babe bakobugia amakano koreng’ana buna amariogi a igoro ay’Alamoti.
english: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah and Benaiah were to play the lyres according to alamoth,

ekegusii: Na Zedekia, omoruoti bw’Abayuda, tagotooreka korwa ase amaboko ’Abakalidayo, korende ekeene, goika abekwe ase okoboko kw’omoruoti o Babeli, akwane nere obosio ase obosio, na kororana nere amaiso ase amaiso.
english: Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape out of the hands of the Babylonians but will certainly be handed over to the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him with his own eyes.

ekegusii: Nebukadinesaro, omoruoti o Babeli, akabeka Zedekia, mosinto o Yosia, koba omoruoti bw’Abayuda ribaga ria Konia, mosinto o Yehoyakimu.
english: Zedekiah son of Josiah was made king of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; he reigned in place of Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim.

ekegusii: Zedekia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere nomo, ekero achagete kogamba; akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years.

ekegusii: Zedekia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere nomo, ekero abete omoruoti, akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Hamutali, mosubati o Yeremia korwa Libuna.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother's name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

ekegusii: Zedekia nigo arenge nemiaka emerongo ebere nomo, ekero aetwe oboruoti, akagamba emiaka ikomi nomo agwo Yerusalemu. Ng’ina nigo arenge korokwa Hamutali, mosubati o Yeremia, omonto korwa Libuna.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he reigned in Jerusalem eleven years. His mother's name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah; she was from Libnah.

ekegusii: Zelah, Haeleph, the Jebusite city (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah and Kiriath-- fourteen towns and their villages. This was the inheritance of Benjamin for its clans.
english: na Zela, na Elefu, na Yebusi (noro Yerusalemu), na Gibea, na Kiriati‐Yearimu, emechie ikomi na ene, amo nebichie biabo. Oyo noro orenge omwando bwe chiamate chi’egesaku kia Benjamin.

ekegusii: Seleki korwa Amoni na Naharai korwa Beroti, omobogoria ebirwanero bia Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya;
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,

ekegusii: Seleki korwa Amoni na Naharai korwa Beroti, omobogoria ebirwanero bia Yoabu, omomura bw’omokungu Seruya;
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah,

ekegusii: Ase ayio Mala, na Tirisa, na Hogila, na Milka, na Noa, abaiseke ba Selofehadi, bakanyuomwa nabamura b’abaise moke.
english: Zelophehad's daughters-- Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah and Noah-- married their cousins on their father's side.

ekegusii: Naende yarengeo Senani, na Hadasa, na Migidali‐Gadi,
english: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdal Gad,

ekegusii: Zephaniah the priest, however, read the letter to Jeremiah the prophet.
english: Sefania omokuani agasoma rirube erio ekero Yeremia omobani ategererete.

ekegusii: Sera Omoetiopia amo nabarwani baye b’esegi emilioni eyemo (1,000,000) abarenge ne chigari amagana atato bagacha kobarwania esegi, bagaika Maresa.
english: Zerah the Cushite marched out against them with a vast army and three hundred chariots, and came as far as Mareshah.

ekegusii: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud, Abiud the father of Eliakim, Eliakim the father of Azor,
english: na Serubabeli akaibora Abihudi, na Abihudi akaibora Eliakimu, na Eliakimu akaibora Azoro,

ekegusii: Sikiri, omonto etuoni korwa Efraimu, agaita Maaseya, omomura bw’omoruoti, na Asirikamu, omoteneneri bw’enyomba y’omoruoti, na Elikana, oyo o kabere ase omoruoti.
english: Zicri, an Ephraimite warrior, killed Maaseiah the king's son, Azrikam the officer in charge of the palace, and Elkanah, second to the king.

ekegusii: Ziklag, Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susah,
english: na Sikilagi, na Beti‐Marikaboti, na Hasari‐Susa,

ekegusii: Ziklag, Madmannah, Sansannah,
english: na Sikilagi, na Madimana, na Sanisana,

ekegusii: Zila akaibora Tubali‐Kaini. Ere nigo arenge omoturi bw’ebinto bi’ebioma na ebie chitaai. Na omosubati omwabo nere Naama.
english: Zillah also had a son, Tubal-Cain, who forged all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. Tubal-Cain's sister was Naamah.

ekegusii: Simuri agasoa nyomba, akamoaka, akamoiyeria inse na komoita. Ayio igo akorete ase omwaka bw’emerongo ebere, na etano na ebere, bw’okogamba gw’Asa, omoruoti bw’Abayuda. Nyuma y’ayio Simuri akaba okogamba ase ribaga riaye.
english: Zimri came in, struck him down and killed him in the twenty-seventh year of Asa king of Judah. Then he succeeded him as king.

ekegusii: Korende omosomba oye Simuri, omochiki bw’ekeng’ese gie chigari chiaye, agakora omoroberio bw’okomoita. Ekero Ela arenge agwo Tirisa okonywa na gotinda ase enyomba y’Arisa, oria otenenerete enyomba y’oboruoti aroro,
english: Zimri, one of his officials, who had command of half his chariots, plotted against him. Elah was in Tirzah at the time, getting drunk in the home of Arza, the man in charge of the palace at Tirzah.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Sayoni nigo bakoigwa ayio bagoka, na ab’emechie ya Yuda bachenga, ekiagera aye Nyasae kwanachire ebina.
english: Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, O LORD.

ekegusii: Abanto ba Sayoni basamunsire amaboko abo, korende onde tari okobaremia. Omonene ochikire igoro y’abanto ba Yakobo ng’a abanto abwo babaetananire babe ababisa babo; Yerusalemu obeire okogechia asebare.
english: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The LORD has decreed for Jacob that his neighbors become his foes; Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.

ekegusii: Omochie o Sayoni nigo oraboorigwe goetera ase ekina kia boronge na abaonchokire ime yaye mbaboorigwe goetera ase oboronge.
english: Zion will be redeemed with justice, her penitent ones with righteousness.

ekegusii: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,
english: na Sifu, na Telemu, na Bealoti,

ekegusii: Omokungu oyio akamoiborera omwana omoisia, na Musa akamoroka Gerisomu, ogoteba, “Nabeire omomenyi ase ense engeni.”
english: Zipporah gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, saying, "I have become an alien in a foreign land."

ekegusii: na Sora, na Ayaloni, na Heburoni, emechie eyio egiteire chindwaki ere ase orogongo rwa Yuda na orwa Benjamin.
english: Zorah, Aijalon and Hebron. These were fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.

english: Abanto 52 people tested positive for Covid 19 abanto 52 people tested positive for Covid 19 yesterday with 1161 total cases so far. The Minister of Health Mutahi Kagwe said the case was confirmed in the Kibra area of Nairobi Kibra area.

ekegusii: Chinsemo chinde chia Baltimore ya bosongo nigo bono yarorokanire buna egetii kia esegi koreng’ana na omosaki Brian Todd so CNN. Emerero emeke nabo yarorekana rituko ria tichi kabere ekenyanchuge na abamenyi gokuruma enigo korwa ase chinyomba chia oboonchoreria emechie bogeka. Amaagacho ande abwatire omorero aaria Baltimore ase akorokwa Gilmor Homes, ase obomenyo boburukaine bosongo ya Baltimore.
english: The situation with crime in Baltimore has become quite serious, according to reports from CNN with Brian Todd. Yesterday, there was another shooting incident involving young people, and authorities are investigating what led to this latest act of violence. These incidents occurred near the Gilmor Homes in Baltimore, an area known for its high levels of poverty and crime.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Kera omonto nabwate ribaga ase obora bwechinsemo ao ao ime yense Omokonyi bwomonyakerogo bwekiombe gia kia Abasubati bakorigia amabaga yoborai (Kenya Women Candidates Association) Otebiri Ng’a kera omonto nabwate ribaga ase obora bwechinsemo ao ao ime yense. Nigo arenge koyakwana ime yomoroberio o’minto Bwakire na Evans Makori eng’era Ya Inanirituko ria rero.
english: Minto FM: They said today that women's groups are preparing to support their candidates fully this year. The association of women candidates (Kenya Women Candidates Association) has announced that they will support women's groups fully this year. It was reported that there is enough time for people Bwakire and Evans Makori to prepare for the upcoming election campaign.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Richiko na siasa chie Ebiama ime ya Kenya Siasa chie ebiama nigo chigendererete kobwata nse. Richiko ndireo erio rikwerera buna ebiama bibwenerete gokora egasi asengencho yo’gotiotereria oborai obuya na amagenderero. Omowakili Ken Nyaencha Ngosanga are amo naintwe igoro ye richiko rie ebiama na siasa chie ebiama ime ya Kenya
english: Minto FM: The situation with the politics of the Kenyan electricity company The politics of the electricity company are currently being discussed extensively. The country is facing a crisis where electricity bills are increasing rapidly, causing concern among citizens and various interests. Lawyer Ken Nyaencha Ngosanga has also been involved in the issue of the electricity company and the politics of the Kenyan electricity company.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Effects of Covid -19 on higher learning Korwa buna oborwaire bwa Covid – 19 bwasoete ense yaito, amasomo nigo atenenete rimo rioka. Korwa abaorokigwa be ebirasi ebike goika chi -college amo ne chi University. Korwa erio amange abeire gakoenekigwa. Orina Ogato, nomworokia ase amasomo a igoro,(Communication and media), nigo agotoerera emechando ereo ase amasomo a higher leaning.
english: Minto FM: Effects of Covid -19 on higher learning The impact of Covid – 19 has greatly affected education, and studies have been disrupted a lot. The impact has been felt in colleges and universities. This issue has caused many students to drop out. Ogato Orina, a student of communication and media, says the situation has worsened for those pursuing higher education.

ekegusii: Abagichora bangire epara Abamenyi be wadi ya Bogichora ekaunti ya Nyamira anene mono baria bagoetera epara ya Tente-Marindi-Kenyorora baemurunganiri igoro yemeremo yomonyakonda okogacha epara eyio bagoteba buna teri goeteka bagokwana negesa fm bakoraua na Elijah Bwoma nigo batebire buna epara eyio nigo esaregete nonya yaagachwa eiki yaeta nigo bono bamoboriri omogavana bwekaunti eyio John Nyagarama goesoyia gati erio koenekia buna nkoagachwa ere buna ebwenerete
english: Residents are protesting roads Nyamira County's Bogichora ward residents have united to protest the Tente-Marindi-Kenyorora road, claiming its poor state hinders development They met with Ngesa FM presenter Elijah Bwoma, demanding the road be repaired before the rains begin They also requested Governor John Nyagarama to intervene so the road can be fixed permanently

ekegusii: Igaa ni Irongo. Eee bono. Magokoro okanire. Nigo ateba inga ebisukari. Amatoke amo ne chinkara. Bionsi bibekwe irongo. Amang'ana are muhimu ase Abagusii korwa Youtube nao are irongo. Amang'ana amakoro. Sokoro nigo atebete inga ewebusaiti eye yaansire koba siloo. Agateba inga ebinto binde bibekwe kiage. Rakini magokoro akamwebereria na komotebia inga tiga ebisukari ebio bibekwe irongo. Onye gotagete kororora amangana amayia abete omwaka oria, aye genda irongo. Kenya egenderere.
english: Today is Sunday. Yes indeed. My heart is happy. I will eat sweet potatoes tomorrow. Bananas and meat. Let us respect elders. The youths who post on Youtube are also important to the Gusii people. Good news. Tomorrow I will look at the website and see what is new. They say things should be done well. Remember my friends and help me carry sweet potatoes which are important. Anyone who forgets good deeds from last year, they are foolish. Kenya is developing.

These affected areas include roads which have become dangerous for travel, and bridges have collapsed making movement difficult. Residents of Kinonga, West Mugirango, led by Anna Moraa, 95 years old, were left stranded after heavy rains destroyed their homes. The NTV crew in West Mugirango, in Nyamira County, reported this.

Also, Edwin Mokua, who is currently in form three at Sameta High School, was also number 1. Due to school closures, cases of child defilement in the Gusii region have risen significantly alongside the increase in teenage pregnancies due to children staying at home during the coronavirus pandemic. Dr. Janet Komenda, a child psychology expert, has urged Gusii elders to come together and address this issue so that girls can protect their lives.

Billy McKelvey, and the victim was transported to the hospital where their condition is unknown and they were treated by doctors who tried to save them. english: Kenya number one in safety The Kenyan government has launched a program to promote tourism recovery through safe travel initiatives known as the "Safer Tourism Seal" in collaboration with Rebuilding Travel. According to Tourism Minister Balala, the initiative will help market Kenya as a safe destination for travelers to conduct their businesses. This effort is intended to boost confidence among tourists visiting Kenya, especially within the tourism sector, to ensure significant economic growth amidst the Covid-19 pandemic.

english: The Nairobi Assembly has approved a report on the impeachment of the governor who was removed by Sonko. The speaker of the assembly and county Nairobi Beatrice Elachi said she had received the report of Beatrice Kananu Mwenda concerning the committee on governance of the assembly which was investigating allegations against the governor of the county who was accused of corruption. After a lengthy debate the assembly approved the report and thanked those involved in the investigation. The debate ended yesterday on February 17th following a motion by Peter Adhiambo Agoro to end the debate and allow the assembly of county Nairobi to approve the report so that the matter can be resolved by Sonko regarding the accusations.

The robber who is a big thief at the market was arrested while trying to sell stolen goods worth 3970 shillings in Kisii county headquarters. He colluded with the county commissioner Stephen Kihara, and they planned to steal maize from various places like Mwembe, Jogoo, Daraja Mbili, Nubia and Nyamataro. However, due to the efforts of the Mwembe community, the said Kihara was apprehended by the police and investigations revealed that they had been defrauding people of their money and also spreading coronavirus among 700 people who were found gathering during the enforcement of the curfew.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Tobwaterane Erinde Tokore Obokurumi Ebiombe bitari bie eserekari biaborigwe bibwaterane na biria bieserekari erio gokora obokurumi ime yense ya Kenya. Aya nkoreng’ana na Samuel Matonda oyio ore Omo’ Director bwo’ oboonchoreria na Amagenderero ase ekeombe keria kia Micro and Small Enterprises Authority. Ase emiaka yaetire, ebiombe binde bitari bie eserekari bianyorekanire n’ amamocho yo okobwaterana na abakurumi ase chinsemo chie eserekari na chiria chitari chie eserekari erinde n’ erio koenekia obokurumi. Matonda nigo akwana aye ime yo Omoroberio o’ Minto Bwakire na Evans Makori ime ya Minto FM.
english: Minto FM: Water sources and development initiatives for farmers and livestock keepers Farmers have been urged to utilize water resources effectively and sustainably for improved agricultural production in various parts of Kenya. This was revealed by Samuel Matonda, who is the Director of Cooperatives and Gender at the Micro and Small Enterprises Authority. For several years, farmers have been facing challenges accessing water for irrigation and livestock keeping due to limited water infrastructure and inadequate water management practices. Matonda stated that the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, together with Evans Makori from Minto FM, are working to address these issues.

english: The concerned parties regarding land issues in Kisii County People from various sub-counties within Kisii County have repeatedly complained about land disputes arising from boundary conflicts, leading to disagreements and potential violence. They possess titles deeds, but these people face significant challenges and may resort to conflict which could escalate and cause damage to property and injuries to individuals. These people need assistance so that this land dispute can be resolved peacefully and they can be helped to survey their ancestral lands and those who work on them, including farmers and business owners, as well as motorcycle taxi operators. It is therefore requested that the Kisii County government collaborate with peace committees to ensure that this land is properly investigated and its ownership clarified.

ekegusii: KUPPET yabakureire abanto igoro yo ogoseria abarimu kisii Ekeombe kia abarimu be chisukuru chie chisekondari KUPPET orosagi rwe ekaunti ya kisii kiabamochirie abanasiasa korwa gusii ase ogosoanana chisukuru na koraa okorobekana kwemurunganeria oboteneneri obobe bwe chisukuru echio kobwatekana no ogotakora buya ase amatemwa amanene yo omwaka oeta. Gokwanera abariki amangana ime yo omochi o kisii, omoriki omonene bwe ekeombe ekio ase ecounty eyio omari otungu nigo ateba na amamocho amanene abanto komochia abarimu abanene ase ogokora bobe kwa aborokigwa ase amatemwa amanene na kobasemia kobeka emeroberio yo okobwaterana na ababwatani bonsi be chisemi korora buna ebirengo bie chisemi birakine. Otungu nigo boigo ayeganirie eserekari koenekia buna abanto bari bagosagana chisukuru na goturubania chisemi inkoimokerigwa bare egetambokero.
english: KUPPET has urged parents to support teachers in Kisii The Kisii County branch of the Kenya Union of Post Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) has challenged politicians to prioritize education and address the challenges facing schools and prevent further disruption of the learning calendar due to frequent school closures this year. It is important for stakeholders to come together in Kisii, and this committee should ensure that the county government provides adequate funding to schools so that parents can support teachers and ensure students benefit from quality education and improve their performance in national examinations. The government should also investigate allegations that some people are interfering with schools and communities so that those affected can receive assistance and ensure that all children have access to education and that schools remain open.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Arama otebire amaonchorerio yerichiko ye busaa irarente emeremo, ebirengo biokorosia bigende igoro Omobunge bwe econstituency ya Nakuru Town West Hon.Samuel Arama nigo are nekerenga kiogochia gokorera amaonchorerio ensemo yerichiko ria “Alcohol drinks and control act of 2010 to legalise busaa” Nigo atebire buna richiko erio ribaise goeta emeremo neetoke, ebusaa korosigwa ne ebirengo bio obochenu bwa igoro ne ebango gotoka ase chinsemo ebusaa eraonigwe. Sangana Nancy Kemunto Ekiababa amo na Hon. Samuel Arama ime yomoroberio Bwebigeri erio bwemanyie amange.
english: Minto FM: The MP has requested an amendment to the law regarding traditional alcoholic beverages so that they can be legally produced, stating that brewers are suffering due to the current regulations. The Member of Parliament for Nakuru Town West Constituency Hon.Samuel Arama said he will bring a motion to amend the "Alcohol Drinks and Control Act of 2010" to legalize busaa. He added that this law is causing hardship for people because busaa production is prohibited and brewers are facing challenges and their businesses are being shut down due to illegal busaa brewing. Reportedly Nancy Kemunto Ekiababa and Hon. Samuel Arama were at a meeting in Bwebigeri where this issue was discussed extensively.

Gokwana ase ekanisa ye egecatholic ya St Christopher ime ya Athi River ecounty ya Machakos Ruto nigo rika riaye abagania abarai kobaa abakenya ribaga gosoma oroboti orwo rwa bbi rika rio ogoetanana kobabori abananchi koroitaba. Ruto nigo boigo abamochia abarai baikeranete omosangererekano o bbi abwo igoro ase egetii gia bukhungu ime ya kakamega ase okobarama abarai bande rika rio okorari omorembe na kobamochia abanyanyimbo ase kobaunereria abarai bande baganetie kwarigania omosangererekano obo ensemo ya mumias.
english: This discussion about the BBI bill has been going on for a long time The son of a preacher, William Ruto, said yesterday that he understands those who want to come together peacefully so that Kenya can have a good discussion, and he appreciates the discussions that are happening now, urging Kenyans to support the BBI and reject divisive politics. Yesterday at St Christopher Catholic Church in Athi River, Machakos County, Ruto asked those seeking office to prioritize the needs of Kenyans over the BBI process and to unite to serve the people. Ruto also thanked those who participated in the BBI discussions, saying that during his visit to Kakamega county, he encouraged people to embrace peace and understand the concerns of Mumias residents.

Ebura village is currently experiencing a crisis due to the death of a Rioma resident in Marani sub-county of Kisii county, causing singers and mourners to gather and console each other. In accordance with protocols, the singers are going to ensure that the mourners adhere to guidelines such as maintaining distance, washing hands frequently, and using sanitizers to prevent the spread of infection among the singers who are present and comforting each other while gathering at the funeral home. english: Sanitation boots Kisii Kisii County Kisii County has received equipment to be used for setting up sanitation booths in three subcounties of Kisii county The equipment was donated by Safaricom company, and it will be set up at Sare stage and along the Kisii-Migori, Getare and Kisii-Nyamira and Birongo Kisii-Keroka road. english: The former acting vice chancellor has appointed Professor Mbeche to the council. The nominations committee announced that Maureen Onyango was appointed to the council to represent the interests of Professor Isaac Mbeche's students as chancellor of the University of Nairobi and the interests of Professor Stephen Kiama who has been nominated to the board and will serve as chairman. Following the death of Education Cabinet Secretary Professor George Magoha, the appointment process to support Professor Kiama began and Professor Kiama was confirmed to the position and the nominations committee also approved this appointment which will be held on Friday. Regarding this matter, stakeholders from the university requested that Professor Kiama address Professor Mbeche regarding the issue of student representation as chancellor and stated that he should continue to cooperate with the existing board members.

english: Officials from the Manga constituency in Nyamira County have reported that they found themselves facing challenges regarding school items stolen from Nyaikuro and Ogango areas. Officials from the Manga constituency in Nyamira County have reported that they found themselves facing challenges regarding school items stolen from Nyaikuro and Ogango areas, specifically in Central Kitutu ward. According to area chief Evans Nyang’au, unknown individuals carried out the theft last week, and investigations are ongoing. english: This morning in Kenya, it has been reported that several people have been diagnosed with coronavirus disease variants 8 and 9. The Director General of Health, Dr. Patrick Amoth, said that this morning in Kenya, it has been reported that several people have been diagnosed with coronavirus disease variants 8 and 9. Speaking from Afya House, Amoth said that Kenya now has recorded 200 cases of people diagnosed with the disease over the past week. He urged Kenyans to adhere to health protocols issued by the government to prevent the spread of the disease. He also praised the efforts of Minister Mutahi Kagwe in educating Kenyans on how to protect themselves from the disease. 41 cases were reported today, with 20 in Mombasa County, 6 in Kwale, 3 in Garissa, 2 in Kajiado and 1 in Taita Taveta.

ekegusii: Marehemu omosike Joseph Obare Osuku: Principal, Nyabigena Boys High School, South Mugirango, Kisii County. Abaminto obokongu mbwabete. Mwanyagetinge minto mwensi nigo tore n' omoichano ase okobamanyia igoro y' ogosira kw' St Joseph, Nyabigena Boys High School Principal, Omosike Joseph Obare Osuku. Omosike Osuku nigo ararete obotuko bw' ogokiera 29/12/2015. Gati y' amagenderero amanene akorete, omosike Obare nigo amanyekanete buya ase okoba omwarimu omokung'u naende bw' omokia, oyio ogerete esukuru yaito ya Nyabigena Boys High School komanyekana ase ogokora buya ase amatemu ye ekerasi gia ikomi na kabere. Naintwe ase ekebute eke kia Mwanyagetinge nigo togotoma engora yaito gochia ase abamwabo Principal Obare, amo na abarimu amo na abaorokigwa bonsi ba St Joseph Nyabigena High School ase ogosirwa kw' Principal Obare. Tiga Omonene abaagate abaamate, abasani, abana amo na abarimu mwensi ase mwabeta.
english: The late Mr. Joseph Obare Osuku: Principal, Nyabigena Boys High School, South Mugirango, Kisii County. People have mourned greatly. A distinguished person who always loved his work and dedicated himself to serving at St Joseph, Nyabigena Boys High School Principal, Mr. Joseph Obare Osuku. Mr. Osuku was retired on December 29, 2015. Despite having great plans, Mr. Obare became known as a hardworking teacher who loved his profession, which led Nyabigena Boys High School to become well-known for its excellent performance in national exams. We, together with the community of Mwanyagetinge, extend our condolences to the family of Principal Obare, including teachers and all students of St Joseph Nyabigena High School as they mourn Principal Obare. We offer sincere sympathy to relatives, friends, children and teachers alike as they grieve.

english: Minto FM Kibagendi expressed his sadness over the ongoing struggles facing youth regarding access to funds and opportunities. The Director of Youth Affairs, Anthony Kibagendi expressed his sadness over the ongoing struggles facing youth regarding access to funds and opportunities. Kibagendi stated that the government is working to improve the lives of young people by providing them with access to Youth Fund resources and empowering them to start their own businesses so they can secure their future and obtain loans and grants, especially concerning the Youth Fund which aims to improve their livelihoods. ekegusii: Eserekari yaenanire chibesa chia abagotu ne chintakana Eserekari yaenanire chisiringi chibilion 4.3 chigochi gotumeka goakana abanto abagotu, chintakana amo na abanto bare no oborema berigete goetera ase omoroberi o inua jamii abwo bagoakanwa chibesa ne eserekari kera omotienyi kwegendereria. Omoriki obotambe ase ewizara ya social protection Nelson Marwa otebire buna egati ya abanto abwo chiribu 296,307 nigo bare abana chintakana amo na bari barwete chinka chitari kwenyara abwo bagochi goakanwa chisiringi ebilion 1.1. Boigo abanto abagotu bare gwetania emiaka 70 berigetie ase omoroberi oyio chiribu 764,644 nigo bagochi goakanwa chisiringi chibilion 3.3 ase boigo abanto bare no oborema chiribu 34,094 bagochia goakanwa chisiringi chimilion 136. Marwa otebire buna kera omonto gati ya abanto abwo nigo bagochi goakanwa chisiringi chiribu 4 chio omotienyi o 11 amo no omotienyi o 12 bwo omwaka oeta gochakera abwo ankio.
english: The researcher found that poverty is a major challenge. The researcher found that approximately 4.3 million people are facing challenges, and this affects families, making it difficult for them to access basic services and the researcher suggests strengthening social welfare programs. The head of social protection, Nelson Marwa, reported that around 296,307 families are experiencing difficulties and they lack resources to meet their needs, while 1.1 million people are struggling to afford essential items. He added that 764,644 elderly individuals over the age of 70 are receiving assistance, and 34,094 disabled people are getting support worth 136 million shillings. Marwa stated that more funds are needed to help these families, and that 4 out of 11 administrative units and 12 sub-counties have been identified as areas needing urgent attention this year.

"Intwe titori gochia gwanchera .XXX ase ense yaito ya Kenya" Nabo Dr. Bitange Ndemo amenta naende, ka agokwana ase omosangererekano o 20th anniversary celebrations of World Press Freedom Day, aaria Nairobi. Dr. Ndemo nigo arenge koiraneria riborio aborigwa kobwatekana no okoigorwa kwe enamba ye eintaneti enyia eyio ekorokwa .XXX. Enamba eyio ya .XXX nigo egecha koba buna .com, .net, .info, .US gose .org ase eintaneti. Nonya nabo igo, enamba eyio nigo egocha gotwara ebikori bioka. Ebikori biria abanyamorero bakoroka pornography. Nigo Dr. Ndemo ateba inga abaibori abange ba Kenya tibamanyeti kende igoro ye eintaneti rakini abana mbamanyete. Ase engencho abaibori abange batamanyeti igoro ye eintaneti, Dr. Ndemo nigo ateba inga, "such material would not be controlled." Goikera bono, Kenya amo na India nachio chinse chioka chiakanire enamba eyio ye ebikori ya .XXX.
english: These are his words: "This is a good thing for our country." Also Dr. Ndemo said. "This is not a good development. XXX has harmed the image of Kenya" Also Dr. Bitange Ndemo commented further, while attending the 20th anniversary celebrations of World Press Freedom Day, in Nairobi. Dr. Ndemo also stated that registration is important to prevent misuse of domain names which are being used .XXX. Those domain names of .XXX are similar to .com, .net, .info, .US and .org domains. However, those domain names are also used for bad things. These things include people who spread pornography. And Dr. Ndemo said that many Kenyans do not know how much internet abuse affects children. And regarding people who do not know about internet abuse, Dr. Ndemo said, "such material would not be controlled." Furthermore, Kenya and India have similar problems concerning those domain names and pornographic materials .XXX.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Omongina magokoro baba ominto nantebetie buna Abagusii ntwabwate amarieta gete twarenge gokwanera ase chingaki gete. Ase omorenganio, amarieta narengeo atato arenge gokwanerwa ekero omosubati abwate oborito. Nigo magokoro antebetie buna amarieta ayio nigo are: Kai tata! Ndoche egasi negendererete. Aaiga, abasubati batato baberekire. Gochia bogima: Aiga nekero omosubati ore morito agokwa ekero akoibora, nabo omwana oye arabe moyo, gose nere akwe. Omwana nere okomoita [ Nigo omosubati oyio achite bogima igoro botuko ]. Kobina: Erita eri nigo riarenge gokwanerwa ekero omokungu ori ore morito achakire koromwa, erinde aibore omwana [ Nyaboke nigo achagete kobinwa kendabu ]. Kobereka: Aiga, nekero omosubati abeire morito. Ase boigo, nigo omongina antebetie buna erieta eri ngokwanerwa riarenge ekero chibando mogondo chiabeire gosambwa, gose ritoke ekero rire mogondo riarosiri ritunda, nigo togoteba buna riaberekire [ Kemunto nigo abereka bwango ]. Bono aya naro amarieta aito atato ase rero, korwa ase magokoro baba ominto. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.
english: These are the things: The traditions of our ancestors are good for the Gusii people because they taught us how to live well and with respect. With respect, traditions help us live well and give us strength. These traditions also include: Hey father! I am very tired. My children, let them be shown. Respect life: Life is precious and should be valued, and a child who is born has a right to live, so protect them. A child deserves to be given life [Let this child live a long life]. Discipline: Know that discipline is important for a child to grow up properly, and teach them to respect others [Nyaboke was disciplined appropriately]. Education: Life, especially for a child, requires education so that they can understand things, and just as a seed needs water to grow, it is important to educate them [Kemunto received an education]. These days there are few traditions left, but we still have some from our ancestors. Thank you all and thank you for listening.

english: Minto FM: Charles Rasugu – A Good Story About Kenyan Corruption Corruption is now a matter of concern for the nation and a topic of discussion. Is there anyone who knows why Kenyans always have such a big problem with corruption in this country? A large scandal has emerged involving reports about this issue and others like it. Charles Rasugu, who is also a deputy director at the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission (EACC) headquarters in central Kenya, said that Kenyans need to stop being involved in these things and fighting corruption. He spoke with Minto Bwakire and Evans Makori, Inani News.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Omogaka oyomo nare na abang'ina baye babere. Abang'ina abwo nigo bare Mosera Ibu amo na Nyamisanchu. Bono omogaka oyo nigo anchete abangina aba bonsi ekianda gia ikomi. Abang'ina aba mbatagete komanya oyo bwanchire mono. Romantic Candlelight dinner aaria saiga mw' omogaka. Aye karatiga ebirengererio ebio obwate. There was romance too back in the day! Mosera Ibu amo na Nyamisancho barentire ebitoche ase omogaka obo. Omogaka oyo mokungu ki anchete mono? Emagoroba eyemo, bakamorugera endagera eng'ansu yo obokima bw' obori amo n' enyama y' nda bakamoirera omogaka oyo obo aaria saiga mwaye na komotema ng'a endagera ya mokung'u ki are gotaka kobega ritang'ani. Bono ng'aki are gokora gekogera bonsi nabang'ina baye, naende nigo abanchete bonsi? RICHIBU: Monto monene ndiogo! Oyo mbaka abe omogaka omong'aini na kobagoki bonsi. Nigo akorigia esani, abatebi bamobekere endagera gochia esani eye yaye. Tiga kera omokung'u amoatanere enusu enusu. Kagokora iga, onde tari orarorekane bwanchire kobua oyonde!
english: These are the stories: The elder was very strong and his people were good. Those people also loved Moses Ibu and Nyamisanchu. That elder always helped many people with problems. The people who didn't understand this thing were few. A romantic candlelight dinner would be nice for the elder. They prepared beautiful things for him. There was romance too back in the day! Moses Ibu and Nyamisancho brought gifts to the elder. What made that elder so special? In the evenings, they would tell stories about brave warriors and food, and they would praise that elder greatly, saying he was a great leader who could solve many problems. But why did he help so many people, and what made him so special? MESSAGE: A very big secret! He was a powerful elder who helped many people. He had wisdom, and when thieves stole something from him, they couldn't escape. Let us learn from leadership and share little by little. It is important, so don't let it disappear like smoke!

ekegusii: Minto FM: Omoroberio bw’obochenu; korusigwa amanyinga (Blood Transfusion) Ense ya kenya nebwatee omochando bwo okobora gwa amanyinga ase chinyagatari aywoo abwenerete gokonya abanto ao ao ,,korengana ne ekeombe gia obokonyi gia red crosss, nigo kera chingaki bakonyora okoboria korwa ase chinyagitari, abanto aoo bakoboria obokonyi bwa amanyinga korwa ase abanto ao ao erinde gokonya abarwaire. Nigo togokwana amo na Henry Sendero oywo ore omwobisa omonene ase ensemo eywoo etenenerete okorwa amanyinga ase orogongo rwa gusii.
english: Minto FM: Blood donation is important; receiving blood transfusions (Blood Transfusion) The Kenyan government has launched an initiative to collect blood from voluntary donors who wish to help people,, collaborating with the Kenya Red Cross branches, they have started educating people about donating blood voluntarily, so that people can donate blood to help those in need. It also involves Henry Sendero who is a great advocate for this effort and encourages blood donations throughout the Gusii region.

ekegusii: Omongina oyomo naitwa Nyamira ase ogokagerwa koba omorogi abaobisa ba abanyanyimbo ime ya nyamira bachakire obotuki igoro yo ogokwa kwo omongina oyomo bwe emiaka 60 oitwa emambi ya rero na abanto bamokagera koba omorogi ase ekenyoro gia kenyambi bundo ime ya bogichora. koenekia egekore ekio omo commissioner bwe ecounty ya nyamira amos mariba nigo ateba buna nyagosira agnes kwamboka nyagwachi nigo asaganwa na gotigerwa chingoma chie emioro na abakagerwa abwo na magega yaye omobere oye onyorekana obware bwe chimita 50 korwa ase enka yaye. mariba nigo ateba buna omosacha bwo omongina oyio peter nyagwachi nyamongo nigo abatebia abanyanyimbo buna abanto amanyete buya mono nigo baika ase enka yaye chinsa 9 chie emambi ya rero na komosokia mokaye isiko ase korende atamanyeti ase baamoira goika emambi ya rero chingaki omobere oye onyorekana. omobere o nyagosira nigo oirwa ase enkendu ye enyagitari enene ya nyamira.
english: The story goes that a person named Nyamira once had a problem; people from Nyamira district came together and decided to build a house for this person, which took about 60 years, known as the elders and those who helped build the house, and it was built beautifully in Bogichora village. It emerged that the then commissioner of Nyamira county, Amos Mariba, found Agnes Kwamboka Nyagwachi, and she was accused of stealing iron sheets and those who were involved with her and her accomplices, the house appeared to be 50 meters away from her farm. Mariba found out that the owner of the house, Peter Nyagwachi Nyamongo, had informed the residents that people should come and see, and they went to his farm around 9 am, and he showed them the boundary, but they did not understand what he was showing them. The woman, Agnes, was taken to court over the large piece of land in Nyamira.

ekegusii: Omobunge o Msambweni natindekwa Kwale Omobunge o msambweni suleiman Dori oyio okwa emambi ya rero natindekwa emagoroba ya rero ase enka yaye ekenyoro kia Gasi ime ya msambweini ecounty ya kwale. Chiribu chia abanto amo na abarai ao ao nigo bamorera nyagosira oyio akwera ase enyagitari ya agha khan ime yo omochi o mombasa magega yo okorwara oborwaire bwa cancer ase engaki entambe. Abarai ao ao bakorau no omorai bwo omobaro omonene ase ebunge Aden Duale, omorai bwo omobaro omoke ase ebunge John mbadi, omogavana o kwale salim mvurya amo no omosenator o kwale Isa Boi amo na gwetania ababunge 30 nigo baika aroro komorera. Nonya nabo Mbadi nigo enyora ase abe magega yo okwogererwa na abanto chingaki amobwaterania omokonyi bwo omorai bwe ense william ruto ne etender ya baandia yo obogori bwe chibunduki chia amajeshi ye chisiringi chibilion 39. Nyagosira nigo akwa kare ne emiaka 42 ase amotiga omoboraka amo na abana 2.
english: Omobunge of Msambweni was buried in Kwale The member of parliament for Msambweni Suleiman Dori who was a close friend of the late former president Moi was buried yesterday afternoon at his home in Gasi village of Msambweni in Kwale county. A large crowd including relatives and friends attended the funeral service which was full of grief and tears, with many recalling his good deeds and his fight against cancer and offering condolences. Relatives and friends included prominent leaders such as National Assembly Majority Leader Aden Duale, National Assembly Minority Leader John Mbadi, Kwale Governor Salim Mvurya and Kwale Senator Issa Boy together with 30 members of parliament who came to pay their respects. Mbadi said he was saddened by the loss and praised the people's unity and support for the family of the late President William Ruto and the provision of funds worth 39 million shillings for the construction of a modern hospital. The deceased was 42 years old and leaves behind a wife and two children.

Abange ba abasenator nigo baiyeria engana eyio igoro yo okoroisigwe gwe ekomiti eyio no omonogeri bwe ebunge eyio ken Lusaka eyio yarenge gochia korau no omosenator Cleophas malala amo no omokonyi oye susan kihika kwarigania oroboti rwabo igoro ye obotuki obwo ase amatuko 10 na rika riaye goetia ebunge engima etuke oroboti rwe ebunge ya kiambu igoro ye engana eyio magega ya abasenator 28 kogania ebunge engima na 16 kogania ekomiti koroisigwa. Abwo bosio okongusanana ogotindi nigo kwaenekigwa gati ya bari baete engana eyio okoboko ba kieleweke amo na bari bakwamereria engana eyio ba tanga tanga ase egeikaro ekio kia beene kiariganigwa rero gokwanera engana eyio.
english: The Senate committee has defended itself against accusations of influencing Governor Waititu's case. The Senate committee has invited interested parties to submit their views on the matter of the large amount of money in the aforementioned parliament of Kipchumba Murkomen and regarding the committee of eleven people accused of corruption, which was also raised in the county assembly of Kiambu concerning the governor of that county, Ferdinand Waititu, being accused. Senators have postponed the vote on the matter until the committee completes its work and the Speaker of Parliament, Ken Lusaka, adjourns the session and Senator Cleophas Malala and Ms. Susan Kihika disagree with the motion to postpone it for ten days, while the Senate committee awaits the report from the Kiambu County Assembly regarding the matter, where 28 senators voted in favor of the Senate motion and 16 voted in favor of the committee's postponement. This afternoon's meeting was well attended by members of both Kieleweke and Tanga Tanga factions, and the issue of unity was discussed further.

ekegusii: Ekero esukuru enene ya Gusii eraagachwe seito Gusii, nigo erarete obuya obonene seito. Nigo tobwate chisukuru chia puremari amo ne chisekenderi chinyinge lakini titobwati eyunivasiti nonya neyemo. Obunge o Nyaribari Masaba,Sam Ongeri natebete omwaka oyo oera inga tiga toagache esukuru enene aaria ase omogongo o Simbauti ase ensemo ya Borabu. Dr. John Akama, Vice Chachellor, Kisii University College Eyunivasiti ya Gusii (Kisii University College) nigo erarete amagenderero amange buna: - Amabaga ande amange nigo aratoke ya abana baito gosoma chisemi chinene. Bono iga abana abange tibari gosoma buna batagete nonya baetire amatemwa ase engencho ya amabaga gotatoka. - Ekero eyunivasiti eraagachwe, nigo erarente chigasi chinyinge ase Gusii yaito. Nigo esukuru eyio erarike abarimu amo na abakori emeremo be chinamuna chinyinge. Abaremi baito nabarabwo nigo baratware ase bakoonia chindagera. - Esukuru enene koagachwa negere chibara chinyinge chirosigwe amo no omorero kong’uswa. Ekero omochango oraanse, tiga tobwaterane toagache eyunivasiti yaito.
english: This great school of Gusii was established by the people of Gusii, and it has grown into a large school. It started as a primary school and then a secondary school, but we haven't reached university level yet. The Member of Parliament for Nyaribari Masaba, Sam Ongeri, helped greatly that year to build this big school for the children of Simbauti and the residents of Borabu. Dr. John Akama, Vice Chancellor, Kisii University College The Gusii University (Kisii University College) was established with the following objectives: - These courses were created so that many children can get a good education. This helps those children who didn't manage to study because they lacked resources to benefit from the available courses. - This university was established to provide higher education to the people of Gusii. That school attracts teachers and workers who contribute significantly. Many graduates are employed in various sectors. - The big school was built with a lot of effort and resources. This development plan aims to help develop this university.

ekegusii: Ababunge ba tanga tanga bakureirwe kobeka omorembe ase omosangererekano o BBI mombasa Ababunge baete okoboko ogocha amo kwo omorai bwe ense Uhuru kenyatta amo no omorai bwe ekiama kia ODM Raila Odinga babakureire abamwabo be ekeombe gia tanga tanga abwo bamoete okoboko omokonyi bwo omorai bwe ense William Ruto tibaenana amagani ande onsi chingaki bagochi gosanga nabwo goikerana omosangererekano bwo okobamanyia abananchi igoro yo oroboti rwa BBI orobereirie gochi gokorekana ime ya mombasa eikendi eye. Ababunge abwo bakorau no omoteneneri bwa ababunge bo omobaro omoke ase ebunge enene Junet mohammed amo no omokonyi bwo omorai bwo omobaro omoke ase ebunge ye esenate Cleophas malala batebire buna nonya kera omokenya kabwate obosibore bwo ogoikerana omosangererekano oyio abarai abwo tibabwenereti gocha na amachiko abo. Boigo omosenator o Nairobi Johnson sakaja amo no omobunge o kieni kanini kega batuguteire are amangana buna emesangererekano eyio ya bbi erengete siasa chio omwaka bwe 2022 na kobagania abarai gotiga komochecheria omorai bwe ense uhuru kenyatta.
english: Members of the Tangatanga faction have been accused of inciting chaos during the Building Bridges Initiative (BBI) Mombasa meeting. The MPs are said to have disrupted proceedings when President Uhuru Kenyatta and former Prime Minister Raila Odinga were addressing their supporters, leading to clashes with those from the Tangatanga side who also tried to disrupt the proceedings led by Deputy President William Ruto, causing a scene and almost disrupting the BBI popularization process, which was intended to educate citizens about the benefits of the BBI bill, culminating in chaotic scenes at the Mombasa event over the weekend. These MPs are allied with outspoken legislators from both houses, including National Assembly Minority Leader Junet Mohammed and Senate Deputy Majority Leader Cleophas Malala, who have accused them of deliberately trying to sabotage the BBI popularization efforts, alleging they will not succeed in their plans. Nairobi Senator Johnson Sakaja and Kieni MP Kanini Kega have stated that the BBI process should be postponed until after the 2022 elections and allow leaders to focus on other priorities under President Uhuru Kenyatta's leadership.

ekegusii: Aaria O' Bande, Omong'ina Naomi Agatwara Obororo Obonge Ase Omoyo Oye [ Ruth 1:1-5 ]: Omwana Omino, Reverend Douglas Otiso oyio Aya amwabo aya: Konyora emechando komenyete obande, amariga nigo agoichora, kwaborwa oyokogotinyia. Aaria ase ense y' bande, Naomi akanyora obokongu obonge mono. Ritang'ani, omogaka oye agasira na komotiga bweka n' abana. Buna okomiamia n' okoramokia, amakweri agaonchora obogima bw' Naomi, na komoura omwanchi oye. Bono gatigara kare omoboraka, amakweri naende agatarera omochi oye nyuma y' emiaka ikomi, abwo ase abana baye abamura babere, nabarabwo basirete, na komotiga ore bweka. Aaiga, omong'ina Naomi agatwara obororo obonge ase omoyo oye. Bono Tata otoriereire eiira. Amariga takoba aroro. Ebirero tibikoba aroro, ekero twaaikire nka ase Omonene Tata Nyasae. Omwana omino, Reverend Douglas Otiso oyio. Mbuya mono gochia ase Reverend Douglas Otiso ase okobeka ogotera oko kw' ogosesenigwa ase Youtube.
english: Aria O' Bande, Mother Naomi Agatwara Obororo Obonge Ase Omoyo Oye [Ruth 1:1-5]: The child of a man, Reverend Douglas Otiso oyio These are his words: Write down this story so that people remember, let them learn and be strengthened. Aria also tells the story of Bande, Naomi writes about her life. Remember, a husband dies and leaves behind his wife and children. Because of suffering and hardship, the troubles that affect Naomi's life, and she raises her daughter. This happened a long time ago, the troubles continued to come after five years, then her sons got wives, and they lived together, but they died, leaving only her. Therefore, Mother Naomi took the sorrowful journey with her life. Our Father provides everything. Traditions are not bad. Customs are not bad, but we should look up to our Great Father Nyasae. The child of a man, Reverend Douglas Otiso oyio. My mother tells me about Reverend Douglas Otiso about putting videos on Youtube.

ekegusii: Oboronge bwa Nyasae nigo bore maiso -marore naende tibari buna oboronge bwa mwanyabanto. oboronge bwa Nyasae nigo boorokirie ime ase enchiri yamache na omoika , obwo bwaikeranetigwe goetera ase okobatiswa kwa Yeso amo na Yohana na goetera ase amanyinga aye igoro ase omosaraba. Goika toirane ase okwegena kore ime ase oboronge bwa Nyasae chingaki chitaraera. Nomanyete ekiagera Yeso akabatiswa na Yohana omobatisi? Onye Yohana atabatisete Yeso, ebibe biaito nanga tibing'anyetigwe gochia asare. Yohana omobatisi nigo arenge omonto omonene omobatisi nigo arenge omonto omonene goetania bonsi, naende ebatiso eria abatisete Yeso nakwo kwarengeokogania ogoikeranu Nyasae atagete ase okong'anyia ebibe biaito korwa ase tore gochia ase Yeso. Yeso nigo abatisetwe ase okobogoria ebibe bionsi bi'ense igoro ase rireko riaye, naende agaitera amanyinga igoro ase omosaraba erinde aakane eng'eria yabo yonsi. Ebinto ebio bionsi biaonchoirie okomanya kwane ogotang'ani igoro ase omosaraba oka. bono Nyasae okworokereria oboronge bwaye buna bore erinde tomanye gochia ime na kwegena ime ase oboronge bwaye. Namoiraneirie omonene buya ase ogosesenia oko gwensi.
english: The shield of God is strong – it protects people from all shields of the wicked. The shield of God is perfected today, with strength and wisdom, and this which has been completed leads them to be baptized in Jesus and John and leads them to know His name during their worship. Let us strive to be cleansed today through the shield of God so that we may be acceptable. Do you remember when Jesus was baptized by John the baptizer? Why did John baptize Jesus, yet he himself was less important than Him? John the baptizer was a great prophet, a very great prophet who testified about everyone, and the baptism he gave to Jesus also showed the plan of God so that He might forgive sins and cleanse them through Jesus. Jesus was baptized to bear all sins of the world throughout his life, and He will lead them to know His name during their worship forever. All things have come to pass according to the knowledge of our Lord during their worship. Truly God has revealed His shield so that we may understand and be cleansed through His shield. I greatly desire your coming.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Obokoreri Bw’ Obochenu Ime Ya Kisii County – Ongwae Omogavana o’ Kisii County otebire buna eng’encho nereo abakoreri bo obochenu gotiga omogira na koirana emeremo. Nigo amentire goteba abakoreri abwo bo Obochenu nigo bare egati ya baria bagoakanwa eng’eria enene kobua abaobisa bande be ekaunti na nigo baire amaganio onsi y’ obokoreri bw obogwenia. Gokwana ime ya Minto FM n’ Omogaka Junior Lollypohp John, Omogavana oyio nigo atebire onye tibari gochia koirana emeremo riroria tamochigwa ekere barabutwe.
english: Minto FM: Addressing Concerns Regarding the Name of Kisii County – Ongwae The Governor of Kisii County has issued a directive regarding the concerns raised by traders and business people. He stated that he has heard the complaints of those traders from Obochenu and understands their difficulties in accessing funds and services within the county, and they have expressed numerous issues concerning the trading environment. Speaking on Minto FM with Host Junior Lollypohp John, the Governor said he will investigate the allegations of embezzlement of funds which have been circulating among the public.
