Tureti Y' Kebaki (September) 14, 2011 Aya amwabo aya: Nigo chiaigete chinsa chia maiso abakungu na magokoro akaara riiyo nse erinde tonya kogosoria. Keri keri, magokoro agateba buna nabwate embachero. Nigo omongina baba ominto atebete buna nabwate omwana oyomo. Ochire echiro na kogora amatoke abere. Bono korende gaikire nyomba, onyorire omwana oye ore n'abagisangio baye babere. Nigo abwate amatoke abere oka, ko natagete koa omwana oye ritoke erimo rigima. Naki magokoro agokora gose? Yaani manya. Magokoro nigo atorentera amatoke abere oka. Bono nako togokora? RICHIBU: Amatoke n'abere, abana mbatato. Nigo nkoa abagisangio b' omwana one ritoke erimo erimo. Manye kobatebia babutorere omwana one enusu kera oyomo. Enusu omente enusu nigo ekoba ritoke rigima. Igo nari omwana one arari ritoke rigima!
english: Good afternoon everyone: With Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Thursday (September) 14, 2011 These are the words: When someone steals a little bit of maize from leaders and their hearts become very angry, they protect themselves from being gossiped about. Truly, hearts get annoyed when they are given an insult. It is better for people to be quiet than to give a foolish child a name. Look closely and plant good bananas. Because if it ripens well, respect the child who has them and his relatives so that they can also have some. It is good to have good bananas, because if a child doesn't have enough, he will be weak. Why do hearts worry so much? Yes indeed. Hearts always want good bananas. But why don't they ripen? MESSAGE: Bananas and good things, few children. So let his relatives of the child who has enough share. Know that they will teach the child how to eat a whole banana. A half is not a full banana. That is why the child who has a full banana is happy!

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Aaria Nyamache, Bobasi ime ya Kisii County, obokongu mbwabete. Omosacha oyomo nigo aitete omwana na mokaye, nere gweeita ase eng'encho abaibori b' omokungu bakanete buna enywomo gati ya aba baere tekoba ase eng'encho bare ab' enyomba eyemo. Abrahama Moseti amo n' Alice Okemwa nigo baumeranete aaria Nairobi, bakamenya aamo n' konyora omwana oyomo. Bono ekero aba bagenda sobo omokungu erinde komanya abaibori ba mokaye, abaibori bakabatebia buna nigo ere chimuma ase aba babere konywomana ekiagera nigo bare ab' enyomba eyemo. Gotebigwa iga, Abraham Moseti akaigwa obororo kegima na gosamba enyomba yaye. Omwana ere nigo asirerete abwo abo. Korwa abwo, mokaye, omosubati Alice Okemwa nere agasirera aaria Kenyatta National Hospital, abwo ase aminyogetigwe gochia kobwenigwa. Omosacha oyo ere nigo akwerete nchera, gakominyokigwa gochia ase enyagitari kobwenigwa. Kobwatekana n' Ekegusii, Omometobo amo n' Omokiama tibari konywomerana, ekigera aba n' abana bare ab' enyomba eyemo. Igwa bono courtesy of NTV, Nyamache, Kisii County.
english: These are the details: Aaria Nyamache, Bobasi within Kisii County, a very sad incident. The old man and his wife, they say he took his child and went, truly speaking, he went with his children to bury them because the pain of those people was too much, they said he went to join them in death. Abraham Moseti and Alice Okemwa were married in Nairobi, they planned and decided to have a child. Truly this matter, the people went to seek help from their relatives, the relatives tried to stop him, but it was difficult to prevent those people from dying together. It is reported that Abraham Moseti fell ill and destroyed his house. The child is the one who survived all of this. After this, the wife, Alice Okemwa went to Kenyatta National Hospital, where she received treatment and recovered. The old man also got sick, and he was treated and recovered. According to Ekegusii tradition, grandfathers and grandmothers do not agree, which leads to the deaths of their grandchildren. This news courtesy of NTV, Nyamache, Kisii County.

ekegusii: KPR eyaigoretwe boronge ase omwaka o 2000 ase ense ya Slovakia ime ya yoropu, korende, etokoenana chintetere n’ebimeria korwa chinsemo chionsi ch’ense korwa omwaka o 1998. Ekerrengo giaito ekenene n’okobwatani abanyabiticha enseengima korwa ebitii bionsi egere torosie omogachi omonene bwe chimbego amo n’e bimeria (Ebenki y’echimbego n’ebimeria ya KPR) korwa ense yonsi. Bonoiga, etobwate ebisabo bitano nekemo (Slovakia, Czechia, Australia, India, Thailand, South Africa, Tanzania) na chikopeteti chietaneti 200 amo n’abasengererio korwa ense yonsi. Amatuko aya nabo tokonyara gosangereria na koenana chikabira goetania 10,000 korwa ense yonsi. Onye gokorigia kende gionsi, noo ore ase aronge! Nonye ntobwati kera ekemeri ase omosangererio oito ase bonoiga, etokonya komenta kere rituko, ng’ora ng’ora, embego ase embego, ekemeri ase ekemeri. Etoegenete buna buna bwanko iga ntonyare koenana kende kera egento! Ase koonia ebietaneti 10,000 n’ebimeriense engima - chipamu, chisikadi, ebirubo n’emete ya ngumgu, emenoru n’amache, emete ekori eyende, eyomwaka, eyarimoigo, obonyansi bw’ogochabera, n’eching’eni nebinde.
english: The KPR was established in the year 2000 in the country of Slovakia, Europe, therefore, it began its activities in the field of cooperation with various organizations from the year 1998. Currently, it focuses on uniting animal breeders from all regions to improve livestock production and quality (KPR Livestock and Cooperation Organization) throughout the country. Moreover, it collaborates with seven countries (Slovakia, Czechia, Australia, India, Thailand, South Africa, Tanzania) and has approximately 200 members from all regions. These funds will be used to support research and initiate a project costing 10,000 across the country. Anyone who understands this well, let them know! Anyone who wants to contribute their ideas regarding this matter, they can comment freely, step by step, organization by organization, idea by idea. It is important to work together so that we can achieve something substantial! With approximately 10,000 members in cooperative organizations – cattle, goats, sheep and local pigs, poultry and rabbits, improved breeds, annual, hybrid, veterinary services, and agricultural tools.

ekegusii: Ninde n'ekeene ng'a obomaene nigo bore bw'engencho kobua ebirengererio bi'abanto. Ebitabu biaito nigo bire bi'eritang'ani n'ebiekeene ase chingaki echi na bigokwana igoro yobobisi bore ime y'ebatiso y'Yeso eyio yakoretwe na Yohana omobatisi. Ekerisimasi tikiarenge aroro ase chikarne ibere chi'kanisa entang'ani korende Abakeristo b'ekanisa entang'ani amo n'aborokigwa ba Yeso, nigo bare koinyora rituko ri'abatiso y' Yeso yakoretwe na Yohana omobatisi aaria ase oroche rwa Jorodani ase omotienyi o Januari chitariki 6 ase kera omwaka, ninki kiagerete bakarikora rituko eri koba eriengencho mono ase okwegena kwabo? Ebitabu biaito nigo bikorwa obomaene ase riborio eri, n'obomaene nigo bore bw'engencho ase obokeristo bwaito mono. Ekerenga ekenene ki'ebitabu biaito nigo kere mono igoro y'ebatiso y'Yeso amo n'enchiri y'amache amo n'omoika (Yohana 3:5), eke tikeri ng'a negento kere ensemo yobokeristo bwaito, korende negento kere gi'ekerenga ekenene emia ase emia ase obokeresto bwaito. Ebitabu biaito nigo bikobeka abekeristo chinguru banyare koyiegena enchiri y'amache amo n'omoika. Enchiri y'egetabu eke tiga ebe ensemo yegento kiengencho ase okorigia ekeene kere ime y'ebuku.
english: Indeed, this story about baptism is important because it reminds us of the importance of repentance for all people. These scriptures also remind us of the significance of John the Baptist's ministry and the baptism of Jesus which was performed by John the baptizer. Christmas arrives quickly, and it is a time when the church gathers together, and Christians from the church gather and remember the baptism of Jesus performed by John the baptizer near the Jordan River and on January 6th each year, so why do they celebrate remembering this event and its meaning for their salvation? These scriptures are done in remembrance of this event, and this remembrance is important for our Christianity. The main point of these scriptures is the importance of the baptism of Jesus and the water and the Spirit (John 3:5), and it is not just a historical event, but an important point for our Christian faith, because it points to the main point of our Christian faith. These scriptures help Christians understand the importance of water and the Spirit. The message of the scripture is that there is hope for those who seek God and forgiveness for their sins through the book.

ekegusii: Ebicha korwa E Nation Patrick Mayoyo bwe e Nation nigo agoteba inga onye kore Omogusii, egento ekebe kerakobere ne ekero omonto onde aratebe inga aye no omorogi gose omokori ebinto ebibe buna oboibi. Ase ebitageka ebike, abanto bare na obororo nigo bagokogwera amo ne ebioma bia kera aina. Tibari kogotiga impaka gwakure. Abanto nigo bakare goitwa ase obonge aaria Bosongo, Gucha amo na Nyamira. Bono abanene be chikanisa amo na ebiombe biria bikorenda obogima bwa abanto nigo batagete bari bagoita abande batigigwe. Karibu abanto batano na omo nigo bagoitwa kera omotienyi ime ya Gusii. Abagusii bari bare echera aaria Bosongo tibatageti kogenda chinka ekiagera nigo baoboete inga imbache baitwe bakogenda chinka.Ekeombe keria getenenerete obogima bwa abanto Kenya (KNCHR) nigo kegoteba inga abanto nigo bagoitwa batarairwa ekoti erinde banyorwe na amagoso. Omotienyi okabere omwaka oyo, abanto batano imbaitwa na gosambwa aaria omochie o Kanunda ime ya Bomwanda ase e distrikti ya Bosongo. Bari baitetwe nigo bare korokwa Boyani Gichana, Yobensia Ongubo, Christoper Ongubo, Sandimu Mageto amo na Chietunde Agirio, omoiri obo, omosubati Nyaboe nabo ateba.
english: The news is in E Nation Patrick Mayoyo says in Nation that he has investigated how people from Omogusii live, saying this issue has been bothering him because of the suffering people undergo when they experience problems. They say the things they see, people and their families have been wronged and harmed greatly. It is said there is a lot of injustice happening. People are being called to areas of Bosongo, Gucha and Nyamira. This matter of people investigating and the courts making decisions about people's lives has caused people to feel like they are being oppressed. Welcome people and children who are being called to the land of Gusii. The people of Bosongo are not able to travel to seek help so they believe this is witchcraft. The Kenya National Commission on Human Rights says people are being mistreated and subjected to torture. During this year, five people were killed and buried in a place called Kanunda in Bomwanda within the district of Bosongo. Those involved are said to be Boyani Gichana, Yobensia Ongubo, Christoper Ongubo, Sandimu Mageto and Chietunde Agirio, their leader Nyaboe and others also participated.

ekegusii: Ebinyinyi bia corona ebigendererete komentekana Abanto bande 8 bakure gwetera ebinyinyi bia corona na igo goikia omobaro bwa abanto bakure gwetera ebinyinyi bia corona aiga kenya goika 181. Gokwanera abariki amangana ime ye ecounty ya kilifi omowaziri bwo obochenu mutahi kagwe nigo aichana buna omobaro bwa abanto bakure nigo ogendererete komentekana mono ase boigo araria ogokwa gwa Dr Doreen Adisa Lugaliki oyio okwera ase enyagitari ya aga khan ase konye akorwarigwa magega yo okwambokerigwa ebinyinyi ebio chingaki arenge ase emeremo yo okwenana obogwenia gochia ase abarwaire bande.. Dr Adisa nere obeire omonyagitari omotangani gokwa gwetera ebinyinyi ebio aiga kenya. Nakerakio ekeombe kia abanyagitari chidoctor KMPDU boigo kiamoreire omonyagitari omwabo na kogania chinyagitari chionsi chie eserekari amo na chiri chitari chie eserekari kwenekia buna abaobisa bo obochenu imbabwate ebinto bionsi biganeirie gotumeka gwetangera kwambokeriga ebinyinyi bia corona. Boigo kagwe nigo ateba abanto bande 473 banyorekanire ne ebinyinyi bia corona korwa ase abanto 6,979 barengetwe na igo goikia omobaro bwa abanto bambokerigwe ebinyinyi ebio aiga kenya koba 9448.
english: The number of coronavirus infections continues to rise. Eight people died yesterday from coronavirus, and today the total number of deaths from coronavirus in Kenya has reached 181. Health officials urge citizens to adhere to the guidelines issued by Health Minister Mutahi Kagwe, stating that the increase in deaths is worrying, and they express their condolences to the family of Dr. Doreen Adisa Lugaliki, who passed away at Aga Khan Hospital while undergoing treatment for complications related to contracting the virus, and also extend sympathy to those affected. Dr. Adisa was a dedicated doctor who worked tirelessly to combat the virus in Kenya. The Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union (KMPDU) has called on doctors to be careful and to ensure they have adequate protective equipment before treating coronavirus patients, emphasizing that the government should provide everything necessary to protect healthcare workers. Furthermore, Kagwe announced that 473 more people tested positive for coronavirus, bringing the total number of confirmed cases in Kenya to 6,979, with the cumulative number of people recovered from the virus reaching 2,088.

ekegusii: Abaorokigwa nigo bare ase omotimoko otakageire kobwatekana no ogoateka kwo oborwaire bwa Covid-19 ime y’ense. Ogosiekwa gwe chisukuru nigo kwabeire ekegosererio ekenene ase omoroberio bwe chisemi na amasomo ase ense yaito. Ko bono ababwatani be chisemi abu bare Eserekari, Abarimu, Abaibori amo na abaorokigwa egati ye ebiombe ebinge nigo babekire ebitambokero ne chinchera ao ao chio okwenekia abarokigwa nkosoma bare nonya bare ase chinka. Egati ye ebitambokero ebio n’amasomo korwa nka amo no ogosomo gotumeka emetandao ye ekerero (Home and online learning). Omwalimu Caroline Kwamboka korwa esukuru ya KERERI GIRLS amo na Dr. Andrew Rasugu Riechi korwa UON ngosanga bare obuya amo no oboremeru bore ase omoroberio oyo.
english: The situation is serious as the number of infections increases due to the spread of Covid-19 disease across the country. School closures have caused significant disruption to students' education and learning throughout the year. However, school stakeholders such as Principals, Teachers, Parents and students themselves have been equipped with resources and skills to ensure learners continue to learn effectively. These resources and lessons will also include home and online learning. Teacher Caroline Kwamboka from KERERI GIRLS school and Dr. Andrew Rasugu Riechi from UON agree that recovery and improvement are needed for this disruption.

ekegusii: EBIBILIA ENCHENU: This is the Bible in Ekegusii Language. Ase omosomi, Oko nokoochora kwe ritang'ani kw'iEbibilia Enchenu engima gochia ase omonwa bw'Ekegusii. Nyasae airanerigwe ng'a mbuya mono; amasikani na obonene nebiaye. Emeremo y'okoonchora oko nigo yakoretwe nabanto be chikanisa ao ao chire ime ya Gusii. Nyasae asesenie aba bonsi beruete ase emeremo eye na aba barure ogosemia ae amang'ana ao ao amo na bonsi abarabe bagosoma Amariko aya Amachenu. Amng'ana agiteire ase ebimanyererio ebi nigo akonyorekana ase amariko make a kare, korende tari ase amariko onsi. Rora Matayo 6:13, Mariko 9:44-46 ne chinsemo chinde. The Gusii language (also known as Kisii or Ekegusii) is a Bantu language spoken in the Kisii district in western Kenya, whose headquarters is Kisii town, (between the Kavirondo Gulf of Lake Victoria and the border with Tanzania). It is spoken by the Gusii people, numbering about 2.0 million (SIL/Ethnologue 1994). A few Gusii people are bilingual in Luo.
english: THE HOLY BIBLE: This is the Bible in the Ekegusii Language. Let us read, and understand the teachings contained within this Holy Bible which is written in Ekegusii. God should be praised for this good work; evenings and mornings He has blessed. The permission to translate this was given by elders who are from the land of Gusii. God has helped those who completed this work and those who have gathered together and many others who read these books of the New Testament. Those who desire should seek knowledge which will be revealed in these small books, continuing with other books. Read Matthew 6:13, Mark 9:44-46 and meditate deeply. ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Omochie o Keroka nigo chiabagorete ekero riororoche riabete gati ya abarusia ebango amo na abaonchoreria ase rituko ria igoro. Ekerenga, Keroka nigo egasaine korwanererwa na Kisii County amo na Nyamira County. Nigo oboonchoreria bwatenenete ase chinsa ekero bachagete korutana amagena na kominyokani ekairera abanyanyimbo gosoa ime erinde koreta omorembe. Eubi nigo eichire omochi omogima na nigo abaonchoreria bagosaba obokoreri obuya ekiagera Keroka nigo ere orobebe igoro. Nigo abarai be chinsemo chionsi barorokanete gokanya abanto barenge nekeririanda ekenene. Mhe Timothy Bosire, MP Kitutu Masaba amo nere Omosike Francis Aburi [Ichuni Ward] nao barenge ase omochie koboria abanto bonsi baire ngora na koboria obokoreri obuya n' omorembe. Keroka Town: Tiga toagache omochi oito n' omorembe These two Counties chionsi nechia Abagusii. Teri buya naende ntwe goitana. Tari bo gaki? Inee Keroka mbora ntwensi n' omorembe n' obwanchani tokorari? Tiga ntwe twensi, amo n' abarai baito torore obotutukanu obo, togayane na korenta omorembe ase abanto baito bonsi ba Keroka.
english: These are the things: The people of Keroka say that development has reached a level where it benefits everyone equally and includes those who investigate its progress. Currently, Keroka is situated between Kisii County and Nyamira County. The investigation shows that there is a need for improvement so that people can come together and solve problems and improve the lives of the poor who have been suffering for a long time. Today, there is excitement about the good things and the investigators are asking for cooperation so that Keroka can continue to develop. They say that all leaders should work together to help people and address the significant challenges. Mr. Timothy Bosire, MP Kitutu Masaba, and Hon. Francis Aburi [Ichuni Ward] are also among those who encourage people to unite and support development and peace. Keroka Town: It has greatly improved the lives of the people. These two counties entirely consist of Abagusii people. There is no place they don't meet. Why is this the case? Indeed, Keroka is a beautiful town with peace and good relationships. Is there anything we lack, and should leaders stop fighting and work towards improving the lives of all the people of Keroka?

Korengana na Alice mongare oyio ore ngina biara omosubati oyio oiborete ase enyagitari eyio, abanyagitari be enyagitari eyio ebabaonchoreria omwana oyio na goteba tibatebiri kende igoro yo ogokwa kwo omwana oyio orenge moyo chingaki aiboretwe goetera enchera yo okobarwa obotuko bwo ogokiera rero. Boigo Edwin mongare oyio ore ise omwana oyio nigo ayegania eserekari gwesoia gati koenekia buna inkonyora bare oboene. Nonya nabo omonyagitari omonene ase ecounty eyio Dr silas Ayunga nigo akanaa amangana ayio na goteba omwana oyio nigo abwate omochaando bwo okweyana ekero aiboretwe ase abanyagitari batemete gokonya obogima bwaye korende agakwa ekero abekire chimachine chio obogwenia ime ase korende ancherana buna ebanyoretwe kobamanyia abanto be eamate eyio igoro yo ogokwa kwo omwana oyio emambi ya rero.
english: The incident happened yesterday when a child was born in Nyamira. The unfortunate event occurred in the morning, and people were shocked by the large size of the newborn baby in Nyamira, causing great concern among those who saw it, especially the residents of West Mugirango in Nyamira County, who feared the child might die due to its unusual size and the challenges faced during delivery. Speaking to Alice Mongare, she said her sister gave birth to the baby, and the midwives attending to the baby expressed their surprise and fear, stating they had never witnessed such a situation before, hoping the baby would survive despite the difficulties encountered during childbirth. However, Edwin Mongare stated that he is the father of the child and believes there is something wrong because of the pain his wife experienced. Moreover, the prominent doctor in the county, Dr. Silas Ayunga, declined to comment on the matter, stating that the child survived through God's grace and the efforts of the midwives who worked tirelessly to save its life, adding that he could not disclose further details about what happened to avoid alarming the public regarding the condition of the newborn baby at the time of its birth.

ekegusii: Omosacha oyomo korwa Fort Worth obekirwe chingayo kobwatekana na amakweri y’omong’ina na abana baye babere ang’e chimaeli 42 miles Irianyi ya bosongo ya Dallas rituko ria omokubio(Sunday), koreng’ana na abanyanyimbo ba Alvarado Ricardo Martinez,bwe’miaka 53, nigo are kogendia rikorokoro riaye enchera ya komosi mamincha ye richiko aaria U.S. Highway 67 ange na County Road 810 na Baker Lane, ang’e chinsa isano na ibere ne chitageka emerongo ebere na isano neno chia botuko,ekero atuomete egari enke yabwate abanto banne ime koreng’ana na abanyanyimbo. Maranda Abshire, emiaka 22, Crus Dominguez, emiaka 2, and Christopher Dominguez, emiaka 5, nigo batebekanete gotweka mo’ agwo agwo.Omwana onde nigo airurugetigwe gochia nyagetari nechingoma chinyinge koreng’ana na abanyanyimbo, vhi’okogosa obogima. Omogendia naende omotindu oyo ase erieta nigo akorigigwa n’erichiko chintunde isato; eyemo yo’goita, eyende y’okorwana ase ogotinda . Ekerengo kia amaru (Alcohol content) nigo kiare .240, ara gatato goetania ekerengo keria giancheire, nonye ne chinsa isato magega yo omobasokano oyio buna abanyanyimbo bagoteba. Martinez boigo nigo asoereire ase okogendia erori gatindete aaria ekaonti ya Denton neya’ Tarrant counties. Amang’ana ande nigo akoenekia buna nigo omosaria oyio abwatire ase ekero egeke aaria Alvarado kaganyete goochorerigwa gochia ekaonti ya Johnson. Omoriki Orina Ontiri
english: A driver lost control near Fort Worth and crashed into a ditch with his vehicle and children inside, approximately 42 miles from Dallas on Sunday, while traveling with musicians from Alvarado. Ricardo Martinez, 53 years old, was driving his pickup truck when he veered off U.S. Highway 67 onto County Road 810 and Baker Lane, close to a bridge and a steep slope, and authorities believe alcohol played a role in the accident, which occurred while traveling with musicians. Maranda Abshire, 22 years old, Cruz Dominguez, 2 years old, and Christopher Dominguez, 5 years old, were also injured in the crash. The child was taken to the hospital with serious injuries while traveling with musicians, fearing for their lives. The driver reportedly had a high blood alcohol level; according to reports, he had been drinking before the incident, and the steep slope may have contributed to the accident because the musicians were present. Martinez is also accused of reckless driving in Denton and Tarrant counties. Investigators suspect this driver caused the accident and fled the scene near Alvarado, potentially leading to charges in Johnson County. Reported by Orina Ontiri

ekegusii: omwateko oyomo ororokanire aaria mandera chingaki abanyanyimbo banyorire ebiateki binde bibere rituko ria rero tichi kabere. Koreng’ana na omokonyi bwe’ County Commissioner aaria Mandera ya mocha, omosike Elvis Korir, nigo abanyanyimbo baabusa na konyore ebiateki bibere bitegire agwo korende nonya nabo, onde tanyoreti ngoma chinde gose bosaria bonde koigweka ang’e na orobebe. |omorengari orusirie koorokia egiateki gekoreta obosaria obonene buna egotebekana nigo kiarengete abanyanyimbo barenge gotara gotanga obosaria (Patrol).| Ebiateki ebio nigo bikageire gotongwa riroba ime ase obotuko bwa tichi rimo na abamenyi ba Bula hawa omochie omorabu aaria Somalia. Koreng’ana na omosike Korir, aasse aa nigo agotumeka na abanyanyimbo babo korenda orogongo na orobebe korende konya tibaraika chingakii egiateko ekio kiarubogete. Omonyanyimbo oria onyarete gosimora ebiateki ebio nigo agoteba buna ababegu abwo nigo bagosimeka ebiateki ebio erio kobarenga abanyanyimbo baito. “Ase egiateki ekemo goika ekende kebe gesimekire ang’e. Twanyorire buna egetang’ani nigo kegotumeka goita abanyanyimbo na abare aase agwo na ekero abande baminyokire gocha korora buna ninki kiabeire, egia kabere giateka na goita gose koa chingoma chime baria bagocha korora.” buna agoteba omonyanyimbo otaganetie kotebwa erieta. Abarai abange korwa ase eserekari nigo bare mandera,gati yabo omoriki bw’ oborende bwa ime omosike Victor Okioma,komenta oborendi.
english: The incident happened during a security operation in the Mandera region involving police officers and reservists on patrol duty. According to Mandera County Commissioner Moses Korir, the police officers were ambushed and attacked while conducting their duties, leading to a shootout that resulted in casualties on both sides. |He added that the attack was carried out by armed militants who aimed to disrupt security operations in the area.| The attackers reportedly crossed over from Somalia near the border town of Bula Hawa, where they launched the ambush. According to Police Officer Korir, he assured the public that they would pursue the militants and restore order to ensure the safety of residents and prevent further attacks. The police officer who sustained injuries during the attack has been admitted to hospital, while others have vowed to continue protecting citizens. “This attack is unfortunate and regrettable. We are committed to ensuring the safety of our people and will work tirelessly to bring those responsible to justice, so that such incidents do not happen again, and we will intensify patrols in the area,” said the injured police officer. Residents have called for increased security measures in the area, including deployment of more personnel led by Area Chief Victor Okioma, to address the insecurity situation.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Abwo kare kare, emiaka n' emiaka, narengeo omomura, egesora, osomete mono sana. Emagoroba eyemo akairerwa nchera, n' embura konye yature etari nke. Bono otigaire atari n' kiamboria. Omomura otamanyeti goteba buna "mbuya mono", nigo atigararete gatogoreti amaiso na kwebori amabori amange. Omonyene egari akamokoba mbaka ase are goikera. Bono gaika ase arenge gochia, omomura oyo agaika korwa egari ime na kogenda rioka kebweenenu. Korora iga, omonyene egari akagechigwa kerage na komorangeria na komotebia amoiranesi gochi aria ase amobogorereti gekogera omobuko oye nao ogwerete nse. Omomura oy' omosomu agasoa egari ime n' omonyene akarundi egari gochia ase barwete korwa. Ko baaika aria ase amonyorete, omonyene egari agatebia omomura oyo aike, erinde arigie gose narore omobuko oye. Buna aigete iga, omonyene egari agaokia egari na koyeminyokia gochia motwe chimbero chimbariri! Omomura oyo agatigara gatogoreti amaiso na kwebori amabori amange.
english: These are their words: Long ago, years and years, I remembered my mother, her beauty, she loved me very much. In the evening when it was getting dark, and the rain had stopped falling. Truly, truly, long ago we were together, the beautiful pot boiled over with sweetness. That mother valued the pot and cherished it. The pot broke. How can I be strong? Hurry up and bring firewood. But you refuse to listen to advice. The mother who knows well says “it’s just a little thing”, yet she looks at it sadly and polishes her belongings. The sweet child cried until she reached a certain point. Then she went back to cry again, that mother began to mend the pot inside and outside completely. Return now, the sweet child was comforted a little and started to remember things about her history and what she inherited from her ancestors. That wise mother smoothed the pot inside and the sweet child cleaned the pot thoroughly so they could use it. They sat down and remembered, the sweet child praised that mother greatly, hoping she would live long and protect her heritage. But if she cries again, the sweet child will smash the pot and scatter its pieces everywhere! That mother looked at it sadly and polished her belongings.

english: The elders have reduced – they are discussing matters. The elders are working on a report regarding the discussion of matters concerning the Kisii account, and they are gathering information about the scholarship funds allocated to students. They were created by Samwel Botai; these elders have appointed a committee led by Sylvanus Osoro to investigate the bursary which was established by the committee chairman Manson Oyongo, who is the head teacher, and to review the previous beneficiaries so that those who deserve it can be identified, and those who were wrongly included can be removed from the list because they did not meet the criteria. These elders also decided to visit Osoro to understand the situation of the elders' meeting, and the people there complained that they had not been informed properly. These elders also gathered together after being summoned due to the accident involving a boda-boda rider, and they went to see his motorcycle, and this issue was discussed extensively, and the meeting ended with a resolution to support the family of the deceased and provide them with assistance from the Gusii community fund. They requested the committee members to cooperate with them during the investigation and to ensure that this meeting is successful and that the agenda is achieved.

ekegusii: Korwa ase Standard Aya amwabo aya: South Mugirango MP, Mhe Manson Nyamweya South Mugirango MP, Mhe Manson Nyamweya orire eira kobeka abamenyi ba Kisii County aamo, erinde goikerania chisei 300,000 ase ogotwara e Referendum. Mhe Nyamweya nigo agendererete n' emeremo y' okorigia chisei echi, nonya abarai bande ba Coalition for Reforms and Democracy (Cord), tibari ase omoroberio oyo bw' e Referendum. Omogisangio oye ase CORD, Kitutu Chache South MP, Mhe Richard Onyonka ere okanire maiso marore na goteba buna omoroberio bw' Referendum n' ogosaria chingaki, amo n' chibesa chia Abakenya. Mhe Onyonka, amo na Bomachoge Chache MP, Mhe Simon Ogari mbachieti ase omosangererekano bw' Okoa Kenya, oyio orenge inse y' oborai bw' Mhe Nyamweya. "Abakenya boka nabwo babwenerete konacha ekina igoro y' Referendum. Onde tabweneretei gotogosa" Nabo Mhe Nyamweya atebete" The Coalition for Reforms and Democracy (Cord) nigo ebwate abarai abange korwa Kisii County buna Kisii County Governor James Ongwae, Deputy Governor Joash Maangi amo na Senators Chris Obure na Janet Ongera.
english: This is news from Standard Here are the details: South Mugirango MP, Hon Manson Nyamweya South Mugirango MP, Hon Manson Nyamweya has invited people from Kisii County to his home, intending to raise about 300,000 shillings to spend on the Referendum. Hon Nyamweya is said to be planning to contribute money himself, but supporters from the Coalition for Reforms and Democracy (Cord) say they will also participate in the fundraising for the Referendum. The leader of CORD, Kitutu Chache South MP, Hon Richard Onyonka has expressed concern and stated that the fundraising for the Referendum needs transparency, for the sake of Kenyan citizens. Hon Onyonka, along with Bomachoge Chache MP, Hon Simon Ogari have participated in discussions regarding Okoa Kenya, which supports the initiative of Hon Nyamweya. "Kenyan citizens should understand the importance of the Referendum. They shouldn't be forced to contribute," added Hon Nyamweya. The Coalition for Reforms and Democracy (Cord) has sent its supporters to work with Kisii County Governor James Ongwae, Deputy Governor Joash Maangi and Senators Chris Obure and Janet Ongera.

ekegusii: Minto FM: Omochumbe bwe econstituency ya South Mugirango omosike Silvanus Osoro ogikeirie mono obokurumi ase chi-county chia Gusii Kagokwana ime ya Minto FM ase omoroberio o Minto Bwakire amo nomoraria Wycliffe Nyabuto Riang’a, omosike Silvanus osoro nigo aenekirie buna ogotaigwana kwaye ne eserekari yecounty ya Kisii nkobwatekana no okobao kwo obokurumi okwo kwaireire amagenderero koirana magega naboigo abaraai koenyorera enibo enene mono ya abananchi. Omosike osoro nigo atebire buna tari gochia koirana magega ase esegi yo obokurumi goika chingaki abananchi barachie kobekwa bosio. Ase ensemo ya amagenderero omochumbe Osoro otebire buna abagirango nigo barachie komoinyora mono ase amagenderero ye chipara aoao echio aagachire, amaagacho ye chisukuru na kogorera chisukuru chi-bus naboigo koenekia okobao kwo oborendi obuya ase ensemo eyio.
english: Minto FM: The MP for South Mugirango constituency, Silvanus Osoro, has been speaking about the development in Gusii county. The morning show on Minto FM hosted by Minto Bwakire interviewed journalist Wycliffe Nyabuto Riang’a, and MP Silvanus Osoro spoke at length about the challenges facing the Kisii County government regarding the implementation of development projects which are causing disagreements among people and hindering progress for the residents. Abamachoge mbare ne chinyomba chikobwatia: Kobwatekana buna twatebigwe, Abagusii ntobwate amanyinga y' engoge. Nigo engoye yabiaretie enyaroka y' omogaka Oisera. english: Oral Sources On The Ground: Yes, these are the words: Oh! She has given birth to a child! And she gave birth to them, they were circumcised by the Basweta, so we know. It is this ceremony that revealed the crying, the child who was circumcised by Machoge Osweta Ngoge! There is no day people forgot. Anyone who investigates Gusii customs regarding circumcision, goes to Nyang'oge, and their knowledge comes from those who understand the pain. ekegusii: Abatuki babere be serikali barenge korigereria amangana aya nigo batamete na kwebisa. Ekiabete inga nigo banyorete amangana inga ingoitwa bare. Omowakili bwo omochie o Nyaruri, omosike Andrew Mandi nere otomeirwe amangana inga goika atige ekina eke goisa nabo arabaisa goitwa. Omosigari omotuki bwa amangana aya, Robert Natwoli nere otebigwe atige obotuki obo ataraitwa. Onde bwensi otagete koboria igoro ya Francis Nyaruri nigo akoonywa inga ingoitwa are. Obosoku sana ase ogotachera amachiko ye ense yaito inse. Naende, nigo ere bobe sana ase ogotarorera eamate na omochie o Francis Nyaruri amabera. Ase Omotienyo o Gatato omwaka oyo, ekeombe kia The Committee to Protect Journalists nigo kiarigete rirube gochia ase Omorai Bwe Ense, Mhe. Mwai Kibaki. Nigo giasororete Mhe. Kibaki arigererie amangana ya ogoitwa kwa abariki ba amangaseti. Naende imbaboretie arore inga obotuki bwo ogoitwa kwa Nyaruri kwabeire. Kende tikiana koba. Ase bono iga, ekeombe eke kia The Committee to Protect Journalists kiarikire rirube gochia ase Mhe. PM Raila Odinga. Nigo gekoboria PM Raila arigererie na korora inga bari bakorete amabe ase omosike Francis Nyaruri bagambigwe kobwatekana na amachiko aito Kenya. Nigo twensi togosaba omochie o Francis Nyaruri ororerwe amabera.
english: The people are saying that the government is delaying the investigation of these matters and they are being frustrated and angered. ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Abwo kare na kare ase ekenyoro kia Iruma, omoibi egiata narenge aroro. Omoibi oyo nigo achandete abanto n'oboibi bwe chindagera korwa mogondo na kiage. Abe ekenyoro kia Iruma bagasinywa eki barakorere simbiri oyo. Obotuko obomo, simbiri akamanora kogenda o Matacho koiba ritoke. Omoibi egiata. Nigo are kogatera amatoke abande na koyaiba. Ritoke n' esiro aaria Bonyakoni. Picture na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com files. Kwagachia, simbiri mbarenge n'omoisia oye oyio orenge gochia komokonya gotwa ritoke eri riang'ana swanya. Kibaika o Matacho, bakanyora omonyene omogondo nigo araire. Keri keri, simbiri agatebia omoisia oye abwate ritoke barinache, egere ndigwa nse riture Matacho. Simbiri agaaka ng'a, po! Akabuga ng'a ne ritoke anacha. Obe, obe! Kumbe n' omoisia oye anacha ebigoti. Akang'ea goichana, gakorera n'ebirero ebinge kagoteba buna aitire omwana oye. Abwo Matacho akaboka na kobugia esirimbi. Ekenyoro ekegima kia Iruma gekaminyokani kogenda o Matacho na goichana ne egekore eke. Korwa erio, oboibi bokaera pi, ase ekenyoro kia Iruma.
english: These are the news: Long ago and recently, there was a ceremony at the home of Iruma, people gathered together rejoicing greatly. That gathering involved people and their families who came from far and wide. Those at the home of Iruma were given a chance to work on this matter. The committee, they planned to go to Matacho to buy bananas. The family gathered. They decided to bring bananas and purchase them. Bananas and sweet potatoes are available at Bonyakoni. Picture by Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com files. However, the committee members and those who went to that place agreed to get bananas from a certain person. They went to Matacho, they wrote down the names of those who came first, and they were chosen. Quickly, quickly, the committee selected those who brought bananas, so that everyone could reach Matacho. The committee worked well, yes! This field and the bananas have been harvested. Oh, oh! It seems those who harvest also harvest the husks. He started digging, working with large hoes until he found the child. Then Matacho became tired and began singing a song. The ceremony at the home of Iruma ended going to Matacho and digging with the tools. In that time, the families rejoiced greatly, at the home of Iruma.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: "Nabo ogoteba ebinto gete ase omonwa oito, ebio otanyare goteba ase Ekenyamorero" Yaya, ayio tari mang'ana aito igaa ase Gusii.com. Ayio n' amangana atebetwe amo n' omosubati Inee Slaughter, Executive Director of the Indigenous Language Institute aaria Santa Fe, New Mexico, USA. Gati y' emenwa 300, eyio yakabeire ase USA amo na Canada, emenwa 100 yasirire. Omosubati Slaughter nigo akwana amang'ana aya gochia ase Boston.com, ekero arenge koborigwa igoro y' emeremo y' okorenda emenwa y' Abaindi b' America, eyio egendererete gosira. Nigo abatuki bagoteba buna gati y' emenwa 300 y' Abaindi ase USA amo na Canada, emenwa 100 yasirire pi. Ase enkwana eye, Boston.com nigo egoteba buna ebisaku ebinge nigo bigotumia apps, chikompiuta buna chi ipad amo n' tablets chinde, erinde gosemia ebisaku ebinge tibieba emenwa yabo aaiga Amerika. Komenta nayio, chiyunivasiti chinde buna California State University, San Bernardino, California, chiachakire gosomia emenwa eyio. Rora bono the full report korwa ase Boston.com igaa. Jared Nyaberi, Omosomba bwe Ekegusii nao agotoka ase Abagusii AT Gmail.com, Twitter.com/abagusii na Facebook.com/abagusii. Gusii.com, Duluth, Georgia, United States. Rigwata [ April ] 21, 2013.
english: These are the words: "They say that things are good when they are spoken about, those that are forgotten are like Ekenyamorero." Yes, this story is very small but important to the Gusii people. This was said between me and director Inee Slaughter, Executive Director of the Indigenous Language Institute in Santa Fe, New Mexico, USA. With 300 languages, those found in the USA and Canada, 100 have disappeared. Director Slaughter says this story comes from Boston.com, which recently published a story about the loss of Native American languages, which is worrying. They say that with 300 Native American languages in the USA and Canada, 100 have already gone. In that article, Boston.com says that many tools are used, computers including iPads and tablets, to help save these languages for their children in America. Commentators, including California State University, San Bernardino, California, are studying these languages. Read the full report on Boston.com now. Jared Nyaberi, Editor of Ekegusii also reports from Abagusii AT Gmail.com, Twitter.com/abagusii and Facebook.com/abagusii. Gusii.com, Duluth, Georgia, United States. Date [April] 21, 2013.

ekegusii: erombe ya amagima yatigaire eroro magega ye emashini ya kansa gokwa aaria ase enyagetari enene ya Kenyatta. Koreng’ana namariko yengazeti eyemo y’ ense ya kenya, chimashini echio ibere nigo chiarosa gokora emeremo gotiga abarwaire ase eroro. Bono nigo yatebekanire buna enyagetari ya Nairobi nabo barabakonye abarwaire abwo ase rigori rike ko nigo ekororekana buna oborwaire bwa kansa tibori koegwa ngencho neene koirera abarwaire korigia obogwenia boindi na ase chinse chia isiko. Abange nigo bagosiria amagima ase ogotaringorigwa na abande koegwa ogochika koganya ase chingaki chintambe eyio yaenekiigwe ekoirera amakweri amange koba ayio anga abwenerete gotangwa. Oborwaire bwa kansa nekansa borobwo obonyene ase Kenya yaito ekiagera onde taiyio nonya neserekari ogwechandera oboringoria obwo gose gokonya baria batari kwenyara. Enyagetari ya Kenyatta (KNH) nigo ekorengia buna abarwaire abayia chilibu emerongo ene nigo bagotoka kera omwaka gati yabo chilibu emerongo ebere na isano na ibere bagokwa ase okoborwa obogwenia. Ense engima ya kenya nigo ebwate ebitaseni bine bioka ase omochie omonene Nairobi bikogwenia kansa ko ebia abanyene naende bire rigori rinene.Abarwaire 1,000 nigo baganyete koegwa rituko korigia okogwenia okwo ekiagera KNH nero yoka egosaba chimia isano okororwa okomo chingaki MP Shah, Aga Khan na enyagetari ya Nairobi chigosaba chilibu ikomi echio omonto omotaka ataisanie.
english: The cost of medicine has increased due to the high demand for cancer machines in various large hospitals in Kenyatta. This comes amidst reports from the Kenyan National Newspaper, where the machine's first phase is said to be working to provide services to those suffering from the disease. However, it has been reported that Nairobi residents have also found patients with the disease who, due to their condition, say the fight against cancer will not end soon because of the need to help patients get individual attention and proper care. People are urging the government to address the issue of funds being misappropriated so that they can be used to purchase essential medicines which are currently unavailable and needed by many people. Cancer and breast cancer cases in Kenya are increasing daily, causing great concern among health officials regarding this problem and its impact on those unable to afford treatment. Kenyatta National Hospital (KNH) is reporting that over 1,000 patients are diagnosed annually, with approximately 1,000 more awaiting access to treatment. The Kenyan government has allocated four centers in major cities like Nairobi to combat cancer, but many people still face significant challenges accessing these facilities. 1,000 patients are estimated to seek treatment each year, and KNH alone requires substantial resources to improve healthcare, alongside other institutions such as MP Shah, Aga Khan, and Nairobi Hospital, which require considerable funding to meet the growing needs.

ekegusii: Emegano Ya Mwanyagetinge LXXXV: Abagaka Babere Banchaine Ekianda Gia Ikomi Aaria Motonto, Bonchari, Kisii County Aya amwabo aya: Petronillah Ogoti, Gusii.com Amaridadi y' amaiso. Tokare goika ase abanto baito abaya kogora ebiragwati aaria Motonto, Bonchari, Kisii County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 Abwo kare kare ase ekenyoro kia Motonto, abagaka babere mbarengeo. Bono abagaka aba nigo banchaine ekianda gia ikomi, naende nigo babwate obosani obonene kerage. Bono emaambia eyemo, omwana bw’ omogaka oyomo agasaria ebirangwati bio omosani oise. Omonyene ebirangwati ekero anyorete omwana oyo bw’ omogisangio oye, nigo amoitete na komotigera enda y’ obokima !! Omwana oyo akaigwa bobe, korende ise ere taigwa bobe. Bono amatuko make ekero aetire, omogaka ori oitete omwana ori ore gosari ebirangwati akabatarera. "Tanga n' omoro gwantoma" Ritang'ani, embori egaitwa n' endagera koroisigwa buya, erinde omogeni aragere. Korwa abwo, amarwa agaterekwa inse n' egetono. Bono riria amarwa aterekwa inse, ise agatebia omwana arentere omogisangi oise orokore, erinde banywere amaru. Gotebigwa iga, omwana oyo akaigwa bobe pi na gotebia ise buna "Tata nanga n’ omoro gwantoma, tomoitere. Nang’itete bobe"
english: The 85th Story of Mwanyagetinge: The Doctors Were Called to Investigate a Strange Incident in Motonto, Bonchari, Kisii County These are the details: Petronillah Ogoti, Gusii.com Beauty of the eyes. It happened that people went to investigate strange things in Motonto, Bonchari, Kisii County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 Long ago in the village of Motonto, the doctors were called. But these doctors were investigating a strange incident, and they found a very big problem. This story is true, a child whose father is a doctor was seeing strange things about this problem. Someone saw those strange things and told the child who was with the doctor, and he started being afraid!! That child was very scared, so he also became scared. But his friends said that the doctor was taking the child to see strange things and scaring him. "Give me my money" Reportedly, a business person who was being cheated was crying, fearing for their property. Because of this, debts were paid with force. But after the debts were paid with force, they began to threaten the child so that he would not tell anyone, lest the thieves be caught. It is said that the child was very scared and also threatened saying "Father give me my money back, please. I beg you."

ekegusii: Endege korwa ase abaonchoreria ba Lufthansa ekorokwa Germanwings budget airline yaatekeire embeo igoro aaria sugusu ya France rero tichi kabere na abarinete ime bonsi 148 nigo bakageire gokwa. Omorai omonene bwense ya France omosike Francois Hollande nigo atebire buna tegeneti gose onde naatorigwe korwa ase endege eyio. “Abayerinete nigo barenge 148 endege ime,” Hollande okomenta. “okororokana kwa omobosokano oyio, nigo ogotokora korengia ng’a onde tatigareti orabe moyo.” Ebitaseni bia oboraria bia France nigo biateba buna 142 nigo barenge abasombwa ko batano nomo nigo bare abakori emeremo and six crew on board. Hollande boigo nigo atebire buna ekororokana abanto korwa Germans nabwo barinete abange korwa Barcelona kogenda Duesseldorf. Nigo amentire goteba buna ase endege eyio yagwera tari goikereka bwango’ Omonogeri bw’ ekeombe gia France DGAC aviation authority nigo aenekia buna endege eyio nigo yaatekera omochie omonene o Barcelonnette ang’e chimaeli emerongo etano nomo na etano (65 Miles) 100 km irianyi ya omochie o French Riviera okorokwa o Nice. Abatuki korwa ense ya france bakoringoria emebasokano nigo bachiire Meolans-Revel, ekenyoro getamenyiri na banto bange ase ebitunwa bia French Alps. Abanyene endege nabarabwo baenekirie omwateko oyio. Endege eye yaateka ya A320 nigo yarenge emiaka emerongo ebere na ene na nigo yabeire ase abaonchoreria ba Lufthansa group korwa 1991, koreng’ana na amang’ana agachire ase chibuku chia eneti; airfleets.net
english: The plane was traveling from Barcelona to Düsseldorf when the Germanwings budget airline belonging to Lufthansa crashed in a remote area of ​​France, killing all 148 people on board. French President François Hollande said an investigation had been launched into the cause of the crash. "There were 148 passengers on the plane," Hollande said. "This is a tragedy, a terrible shock, and we must find out what happened." French authorities say 142 of those on board were passengers, including five children, and six crew members. Hollande also said the victims included Germans and Spaniards who were flying from Barcelona to Düsseldorf. He added that the cause of the crash was still unknown. A spokesman for the French civil aviation authority DGAC said the plane took off from Barcelona at around 10:55 am and crashed near the town of Barcelonnette, about 65 miles (100 km) inland from the French Riviera coast near Nice. Local residents reported hearing explosions and the wreckage of the plane was found near Meolans-Revel, a small village in the French Alps. The plane's black boxes have been recovered. The aircraft, an A320, was 24 years old and had been operated by the Lufthansa group since 1991, according to information available on the website airfleets.net.

english: uprooting of boundaries disputes Written by Hyline Major on February 25, 2022 People who trespass on boundaries should be careful so that boundary disputes do not arise. The incident happened in Keera location which is in Nyamaiya Nyamira South subcounty of Nyamira county, Senior Chief Oire has ordered investigations into the matter of Nyaisa land which involves people trespassing on boundaries. He also said that Oire instructed that the committee investigating boundary disputes should quickly finish its work so that people can farm peacefully and without conflicts. Oire further stated that they will help those whose boundaries have been interfered with to ensure they get their land back.

ekegusii: Ensemo y’oborendi ya ense ya Amerika yaenekirie ogoitwa kwa omorai bw’ ekeombe kia alshaabab omosike, Adan Garar. Korwa ensemo ya Pentagon nigo amang’ana atoikera buna endege y’ esegi etarigotwara omogendia nigo yamobutoria chokombora aaria Irianyi ya Somalia echuma yaeta eria tano. |ababegu aba baminyokirigwe na goserigwa ase chinkonko chinyinge ase ense ya Somalia| Garar nigo arenge omokagerwa ase omwaka chilibu ibere na ngwansa ikomi na isato (2013) ase echiro ya oboonchoreria ya Westgate obwo bwairereta abanto emerongo etano nomo na batano na babere gosiria amagima abo. Amerika nigo yegenete Garaar buna nigo arenge korigereria buna barakore obosagani na goita abanto be chinse chia bosongo. Nigo arenge omobwatani bw’ ekeombe ekio ase abwate ekerogo gio’koringoria buna inaki obogima bwabo bogosereirie kobwa mono n’ chinguru cha isiko koreng’ana na Pentagon. Aya onsi nigo akorekana ang’e chimaeli rigana n’emerongo etano gose (240 KM) bosongo ya Mogadishu ang’e n’omochie omonene Dinsoor. Washington yabeire gekobwatesia obomo bw’ cinse chia Afrika (AU force), obwo bwarusirie ebiombe ao ao bi’ obobegu korwa ase ense ya Somalia. Ensemo y’ oborendi ya Amerika nigo yateba buna ogokwa kwa Garar’ nokwengencho enene kobua buna kwaretige eriansa rinene ase ekeombe ekio kia ababegu ba alshaabab aaria Somalia. Ekero egeke magega ya Pentagon koyaenekia ayio, ogosagaana gwakorwa n’ekeombe ekio kia al-Shabab nigo kwairera ogokwa kwa abanto banne aaria sugusu-mocha ya Kenya. Ababegu aba batianire gochanda Kenya gotatimoka ase engencho y’okoba na obomo bwe chinse chia afrika ase oborendi bogendererete ase orogongo rwa Somalia.
english: The US military operation targeting a senior Al-Shabaab commander, Adan Garar, has been confirmed, according to sources. The Pentagon's operation reportedly involved an airstrike that successfully eliminated Garar in a remote area of southern Somalia. |Those who were radicalized and recruited alongside Garar within Al-Shabaab| Garar was allegedly identified as being involved in the 2013 attack on the Westgate shopping mall, which resulted in the deaths of at least sixty people. The United States accuses Garar of planning attacks and recruiting individuals for terrorist activities. He is also accused of being a key facilitator for the group, responsible for coordinating operations and providing support, according to information from the Pentagon. This incident occurred approximately 240 kilometers south of Mogadishu near the town of Dinsoor. Washington has provided assistance to the African Union forces (AU force) working to combat Al-Shabaab militants in Somalia. The US military operation aims to disrupt Garar's network and further weaken Al-Shabaab's presence in Somalia. Pentagon officials have indicated that ongoing operations against Al-Shabaab are intended to prevent future attacks against civilians in areas such as Sugusu-mocha in Kenya. Militants linked to the attack in Kenya reportedly originated from training camps supported by the African Union mission and the Somali government.

ekegusii: Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Monunguno O Barema (February) 22, 2011. Kobanga chinkomoro Nomanyete similes buna chikorokwa ase Ekegusii? Eee bono. Nigo chikorokwa chinkomoro. Rero tiga torakwana ingo igoro ye chinkomoro ibere na amo ne emebayeno ebere: CHINKOMORO: 1.Kora emerondo buna eye ekeguye. Yaani nigo andama bono? Engecho ende omonto obwate amagoro amanyerere mono. Aya nigo agotumeka ekero okorama oyonde gose abande bateba ekenyamerondo. 2.Omwororo buna riruma. Abaminto nonya korwa emuma ime riruma nigo rigotebekana rire riororo, riitongo, ndibwati mangana. Bono amangana aya nigo agotumeka ekero ogokwana igoro yo omonto omoitongo gose omwororo. EMEBAYENO: 1.Moeta mono onyora mara are iiga. Bakoro mbaroche aya onsi. Kona goeta kera ase nabo gokorenta chindwari chinyinge. Kera omonto nigo agokurerwa aya tiga obonyaka gose tagotwara abasani abange mogosanga kemobere ekiagera korakore obonyaka mara are iiga nakonyora endwari. 2.Tuga ntakana a ngombe, totuga ntakana a monto. Nabo orakonye omonto korwa emechando ime magega yaye nonya mbuya mono tagotebia, naende agokorere ogochaya na takoa esiko eria kwamokonyete ekero achandegete.
english: Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. February 22, 2011. The hyena's riddle Is there anyone who knows the proverbs of Ekegusii well? Yes indeed. It is a difficult riddle. Therefore, let us examine this riddle carefully so that those who know it can explain it clearly: HYENA: 1.It chases gazelles even when they have already fallen. What does this mean? It means that a greedy person always seeks more possessions even when he has enough. This is why people say that a person who is constantly looking for things will never be satisfied. 2.A coward runs away. People say that if a coward is wounded while running, he will stumble, fall, and become helpless. These sayings are used to describe a person who is afraid and unable to defend himself. LESSONS: 1.Don't speak ill of someone while they are still alive. Our ancestors said this. Don't try to destroy someone's reputation while they are still around. Because a person may recover from illness and then punish those who spoke badly about them while they were sick and vulnerable. 2.We don't quarrel over cattle, we don't quarrel over people. Our ancestors also said that people should not fight over material possessions because they are temporary, and instead focus on building good relationships and maintaining peace among themselves.

ekegusii: radio vuna gotarera abaonchoreria bechiro ya keroka Written by Hyline Major on February 24, 2022 Egetaseni kia Radio Vuna nigo kebegete ekambi ase echiro ya Keroka erio gosanga nabaonchoreria eyemo ase eyemo. Kobwaterana neserekali yekaonty ya Nyamira, abanto mbanyora amaegerio igoro yobuya bwokorwa ebango na boigo koenekia obochenu ase echiiro Amashabiki a radio vuna nabarabwo nigo benyorera ribaga riabene ase omosangererekano oyio
english: radio news reporter about the Keroka incident Written by Hyline Major on February 24, 2022 Concerning Radio Vuna news, it has been reported that an incident at Keroka occurred yesterday causing great concern among people. The Keroka incident reports have spread widely causing anxiety and fear among residents because of the ongoing issues. Speaking to our correspondent from Nyamira county, people said they have received information regarding what happened and are seeking clarification about the matter. Radio Vuna listeners have expressed their sadness and disappointment over this issue.

ekegusii: aya amwabo aya: Abagusii mbatebete buna ogochaya n' okobe, na gototebia buna "Ey' etari na kemincha, tiga etirerie ekeene" Bono igo naki? Nigo sokoro ominto agoteba iga: Riria omogaka Onduso aimokire gokwana iga, omogaka Kebiro nigo akoimoka korwa ensemo na goteba buna, "Kai! Naye ninki obwate ogototebia...... Motebie aikaranse" Amasikani n' egento ekiya. Eeeri eyio netaba n' ekemincha, nigo egotireria ekeene. Abagaka baimokire kogenda aase etureti kogayana. Picture na special correspondent, Gusii.com files. Bono omogaka Onduso ere tatakeiri gokwana, gose koigweka. Oikaransigwa na gokanigwa, taakwana. Ere nigo amanyire buna tabwati kende aratebie abamwabo aase etureti yaikaransire. Nigo okonyora buna ekero gie etureti, abanto bonsi nigo bagoikerana, mbaka bari bachaire. Ori ochaire ekero akoimoka gokwana, abanto bachaka kweonya buna nere ninki arakwane. Korende magega yaye, abanto bagochia goitona, baanyora buna eng'ana y' oria bachaete, nigo yare ey' eng'encho kegima [ etirerie ekeene ]. Nere buya ebirengererio bia kera oyomo biategererwa. Neba mbari bakageire koba abariri [ batabwati ekemincha ], nere buya baegwa chingaki, bakwana aya babwate. Ogochaya buna oko nakwo kwagerete Abagusii abakoro bagateba buna "Ey' etari na kemincha, tiga etirerie ekeene". Oyo noro omobayeno oito for this week. Korwa ase omogaka sokoro ominto, mbuya mono and thank you for listening.
english: These are their words: The Gusii people talk a lot and boast, and they say things like “A home without children is incomplete.” What does this mean? It means people say this: When someone visits God and finds favor, that person Kebiro also receives blessings and says, “Wow! But how can I express my gratitude… I am grateful!” Times and seasons pass. These days there are no children, so it seems incomplete. The visitors find themselves going around looking for news. Picture and special correspondent, Gusii.com files. This person Onduso did not receive favor, he was rejected. He was despised and hated, unfortunately. And now he understands that he should have listened to his relatives who were seeking news. It is regrettable that this matter has become widespread, so everyone knows about it, even those who are seated. When someone receives favor, people wonder what makes them special. Because of jealousy, people complain, they lament that the portion of food they eat is small, and they say it is not enough for life [it seems incomplete]. Now let us look at old stories that are worth remembering. Let our elders tell us about the reporters [who lack understanding], now let them speak the truth, so that those who listen understand. Boastful behavior has made the older Gusii people say “A home without children is incomplete.” That is the news for this week. Blessings to the visitor and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: abaonchoreria bechiro ya magombo ime yekaunti ya nyamira kwemurunganeria obokoreri obobe korwa ase eserekali yekaunti eyio Written by Hyline Major on February 24, 2022 Abaonchoreria ase echiro ya magombo ekaunti ya Nyamira nigo bemurunganeirie obokoreri obobe korwa ase eserekali yekaunti eyio nonya bakorwa ebango Nigo batebire buna mbabwati nonya nechinyomba chiakebara ,amache nonya bakorwa ebango, eserekali yekaunti eyio terabeka emeroberio yokoenekia buna ase bagokorera oboonchoreria bwabo nagiya are Bono nigo bamoboririe omogavana bwekaunti eyio Amos Nyaribo koenekia echiro eyio nebwate ebinto biengencho ase boigo baboririe babekerwe chitaya na amache erio banyare kogendereria emeremo yabo buya na korwa ebango buna ebwenerete
english: The chairperson of the health committee in Nyamira County has called for a meeting of healthcare workers from across the county. Written by Hyline Major on February 24, 2022 The chairperson of the health committee in Nyamira County has invited healthcare workers from across the county to discuss issues affecting their work and the county government's role. They have requested that those with grievances bring them forward, along with solutions, so that the county government can address the concerns of those working in healthcare and improve their services. Therefore, they have informed the governor of that county, Amos Nyaribo, about this issue and asked him to provide resources to help them resolve the problems facing them and enable them to continue serving the people effectively.

ekegusii: Enchiri yamache na omoika nero oboronge bwa Nyasae! Amang'ana are ime ase egetabu eke, naisanekie erng'ao ere ime ase enkoro yao. Abakristo abange b'amatuko aya, nigo bagendererete komenya, batamanyeti richibu ri'ekeene, ase ebibe biria bagokora kera rituko. Nomanyete oboronge bwa Nyasae, obwo boorokirie ime ase egetabu eke. Oboronge bwa Nyasae, bwabeire bokoba ne enchili yamache na omoika.s nonya nabo, koreng'ana n'enibo y'erigori, yabeire ekobiswa korwa ase amaiso y'ababwatani b'edini, ase chingaki chintambe. Ase engencho eyio, abanto abange bakaba bagosemeria na gwetogia ase oboronge bwabo abanyene, ribaga ri'okwegena oboronge bwa Nyasae. Ase igo, amorokererio y'obokristo atabwati engencho akaba okwegena koirete ribaga, ime ase chinkoro chi'abegeni orakage ng'a amorokererio aya, nabwate oboronge bwa Nyasae. Amorokererio y'ogoteba ng'a ebinto nigo bikororekana koreng'ana buna Nyasae achorete omonyene, ogocheneka omonto akona konyora ng'ora ng'ora, ayio naro amorokererio amanene y'obokristo naro arentete obotantanu, na ogoiserwa ime ase chinkoro chi'abegeni. Korende bono, Abakristo abange mbagwenerete komanya Nyasae buya, beorokererie igoro y'oboronge bwaye, na kogenderera ase okwegena koria bare nobomaene. "Omonene oito oy'okoba oboronge bwa Nyasae" Inakee, omoyo oo, okomanya okonene, na koyotang'ana gochia ase omorembe. Omoriki bw'egetabu eke, nigo atagete otware ogosesenia gw'okomanya, oboronge bwa Nyasae, kobe naye!
english: Behold, how beautiful and wonderful is the creation of God! The people who live in darkness, let them receive light, and may their hearts be enlightened. Christians from all tribes, let them strive to understand, so they may know the true path, and all their deeds may be righteous. Understand the creation of God, which has shone forth in darkness. The creation of God, it is perfect like beauty and wonder. And you, together with others, according to the covenant of righteousness, it is made manifest through the eyes of the followers of faith, and a lasting foundation. Through this teaching, people may repent and believe in their own creation, leading to understanding the creation of God. And now, the perfection of Christianity does not diminish this teaching, but rather leads to understanding the glory of God. The perfection of offering things is manifested when God creates everything, becoming strong and enduring forever, and even the great perfection of Christianity is not limited, and is established within the covenant of believers. Therefore, Christians should seek to know God again, appreciate the glory of His creation, and strive to understand so they may be saved. “How excellent is the perfection of God’s creation!” Indeed, life itself, to understand deeply, and to share goodness with each other. Usenet nigo yarenge e newsgroup, eyio in today's lingo, emineti social website. Korwa abwo, bagatoa Geocities. You were not hip onye tikwabwate e Geocities account. It did not take long. Abanto bakarosa na Geocities and moved on to Myspace. Erombe ya Myspace did not last long. Nigo kera omonto aagete Myspace etege gochia aaria ekero Facebook na Twitter chiaika ase erwenyi y' eintaneti. Hello? It is 2011. Bono abaminto karibuni to the future. Welcome to Google Plus. Abanyene Google barentire Google +, bagoteba buna this is the future. Nonya nabo igo, Google Plus nigo yaigora egesieri asiniini, naende ekamanya kogeakerani buna pa! Bono nigo bagoteba buna Google Plus nigo ere in Beta testing. Yaani nga nkona koyetieri bare. Nche I dont know. Egento kerokio manyete nkeri nga I have invitations to Google Plus. Onye gotage koyeunenkia, koranche toma agauko gochia ase akaimeili akwo kare below. Ase the subject line, ka moranche riika: Google Plus. Mwamogusii achabumbe. Enjoy.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Korwa ase Standard: Magwagwa, Nyamira County Abarai ba CORD, ase ewikendi eye mbaboretie omorai bwe ense, Mhe Uhuru Kenyatta, ategerere korwa ase chinsemo chionsi, ase ogoikerania obogambi obuya ase ense yaito. Bagokwana korwa aaria Magwagwa ime ya Nyamira County, abarai aba nigo batebete buna onye The President tari gotonga ogoto gochia se chinsemo chionsi, obogambi bwaye tibogokina buya. Gati ya abarai abwo nigo barenge ODM interim Secretary General, naende Budalangi MP Ababu Namwamba, ODM Executive Director Magerer Langat, MPs Ben Momanyi (Borabu), Charles Geni (North Mugirango), Simon Ogari (Bomachoge Chache), James Gesami (West Mugirango), Richard Onyonka (Kitutu Chache South) amo na Mathew Lembruken (Laikipia). Goika totige koombigwa, onye totagete amagenderero Nonya nabo igo, abarai aba tibatwareti enkwana ende yonsi igoro ye Constitutional Referendum. Ase ensemo yaye, Mhe Onyonka nigo atebete buna onye Abagusii titori gocha aamo, nabo torabe tokona koombigwa amo ne serikali enene ase amatuko onsi. " Goika totware egambo, amo na kogayana ase oboamo, erinde nario torakine na koreta amagendererro ime ya Gusii" Mhe Simeon Ogari nabo atebete. Abarai aba nigo bakwanete amang'ana aya ase omochango bw' ogokonya amaagacho ye chikanisa chiaito chionsi chia North Mugirango Constituency, ime ya Nyamira County.
english: These are the names: Event at Standard: Magwagwa, Nyamira County CORD members, during this weekend where they discussed matters concerning the president, Hon. Uhuru Kenyatta, have vowed to attend the event fully, and to support the agenda coming from the president. They gathered at Magwagwa within Nyamira County, these members saying that the President did not listen to their concerns fully, his agenda was not well received. Among these members were ODM interim Secretary General, and Budalangi MP Ababu Namwamba, ODM Executive Director Magerer Langat, MPs Ben Momanyi (Borabu), Charles Geni (North Mugirango), Simon Ogari (Bomachoge Chache), James Gesami (West Mugirango), Richard Onyonka (Kitutu Chache South) and Mathew Lembruken (Laikipia). Let them bring their supporters, so they can show their strength Despite this, these members have not yet decided on their position regarding the Constitutional Referendum. In their statement, Hon. Onyonka said that the Abagusii people are not united, and they will not agree on an agenda together with the national government and other communities. “Let them speak their minds, and also discuss their issues, so that unity can be achieved and development brought to the Gusii region” Hon. Simeon Ogari also added. These members met to plan this matter concerning the election of leaders in North Mugirango Constituency, within Nyamira County.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Abwo kare kare, Ogasusu na Mansamu mbamenyete mbarabare ne rinani ria Kiobegi. Bono aba babere nigo banchaine kerage na ituko rimo ndiare goeta batararorana. Aba nigo bare gosanga kera ekemo, nonya n' abana babo, nigo barenge gotiena aamo. Ogasusu n' Omasamu nigo barenge koenana ebisi Korende engaki eyemo, enchara egaateka aiga ase bamenyete. Bono aba nigo bare koenana ebisi yo kogenda korigia endagera. Nonya nabo igo, Omansamu korende narenge n' obote bwo okoria abana bo Ogasusu. Ekero rituko ri' Ogasusu arenge kogenda korigia endagera riaigete, Omansamu akagoka konyora ribaga ria bene, aite abana b' Ogasusu inde abarie. Rituko erio, Omansamu agaita omwana oyomo na agatama akagenda ense eng'ao. Ogasusu oiranire na kende kia mboto Ogasusu akairana magoroba kare n' omoroso omonene. Nonya nabo igo, tairanete bosa, narenge nakende baregocha kobeka mboto. Bono Ogasusu agaichana ekero abana baye bamotebeti eki Omansamu akorerete oyomwabo. Koigwa iga, Ogasusu akagechigwa na goitona ase egekorwa kia Omansamu orenge omosani oye bwe enkoro. Ogasusu agatiana ng'a takwabera Omansamu neba ki. Korwa erio Ogasusu na Mansamu mbanya kororana obosio ase obosio.
english: These are their stories: Long ago, Ogasusu and Mansamu knew each other well and had a good relationship with the people of Kiobegi. These people were known for their kindness and hospitality, always welcoming visitors. They also often found themselves in difficult situations, especially with their children, and they persevered through them all. Ogasusu and Omasamu often shared food together. Continuing this story, there was a certain time when they both knew about a matter that concerned them. These people often shared food with the intention of resolving issues. However, despite this, Omansamu continued to bother Ogasusu’s children. The household of Ogasusu often went to resolve issues, and Omansamu would secretly cause trouble for them, harming Ogasusu’s children. In that situation, Omansamu called out to a young child and sent him on a journey along a dangerous path. Ogasusu became angry because of this act. Ogasusu spent a long time thinking and worrying deeply. Despite this, they remained united, continuing to work towards peace. These two then decided to confront Omansamu about what he had done to his friend’s children. In the end, Ogasusu was defeated and succumbed to the influence of Omansamu, becoming like an ordinary person. Ogasusu realized that he could no longer trust Omansamu anymore. This time, Ogasusu and Mansamu began to quarrel over everything, over every little thing.

ekegusii: Kenya Power gochia gokoonya chikampani chirarosie chigari chigotumeka omorero Written by Zachary Mayieka on August 2, 2022 Ekampani yestima ya Kenya power nigo yararirie gochia korwa obokoonyi gochia ase chikampani chiria chiraerwe korosia chigari chigotumeka estima ime yense ya Kenya. Ekampani eyio nigo yarure okoboria buna chikampani echio chiresokie na korosia chigarie echio,mbaenekie chienekie buna nkobwati bare amachiko onsi yoborosia erio gotanga amabe aratoke kobwatekana nechigari echio. Goikera boniga ense ya kenya nigo ekoegokeria chigari chigotumeka estima chimii isato na merongo etano (350) egati yechigari chimillioni ibere nuguta ibere (2.2m) Kenya engima.
english: Kenya Power has announced a company loss due to increased fuel costs. Written by Zachary Mayieka on August 2, 2022 The estimated cost of Kenya Power is said to have increased due to the high cost of fuel, which has affected the entire country's electricity estimate. This company has stated that the company's losses and increased fuel costs are related, and they expect that customers will be able to pay their bills so that the company can continue operating. All Kenyan citizens are experiencing increased fuel costs, estimated at 350 shillings per liter, equivalent to two million two hundred thousand Kenyan shillings.

Eriakabere, abaminto twabasabire ribaga ase okoira engaki eye ase okobaakera buna mbuya mono ase ogotosegeta ase emiaka eye yonsi koru omwaka o 2009, goikera bono. Ewebusaiti teri koba kende, onye onde tari koyesoma. Mbuya mono ase okonyora chingaki chi' ogototarera na gotobeka omokia. Mwanyagetinge ominto, naende mbuya mono. Eriagatato, nigo tokobasabera abaminto mwensi ebisio ebiya koru ase Tata ase aya onsi mwakorire y' ogotosira. Nainwe tiga Tata Nyasae abasesenie ase enchera yaye ya bene, ase aya onsi mogokora. Tiga ogwancha kwo Omonene kororekane ase Mwanyagetinge ominto ase chingaki chionsi. Gaki aisuruu Eriakane, twasabire okwaberwa koru ase more, onye twakorete kende kebe ase omwaka oyo gochia ase more, gose ase ogotaikerania buya ase oboriki ase omwaka oyo o 2016. Onye oboremeru bwarorekanire, gaki aisuruu, ntwe twasabire okwaberu. Goetera ase Omonene oito, nigo tweegenete buna ntokore buya ase omwaka o 2017. Seasons Greetings From The Purple Heart City: Bethlehem, Georgia, 30620, USA. Mwanyagetinge.com files, 2016.

ekegusii: Description Verah Mosubati bw’Omwocha n’omoriki egesora. english: Description Verah Mosubati is a researcher and consultant in education. She obtained and completed a bachelor's degree (research) in technology (Education/Information Technology of the Faculty of Education) from the University of Nairobi. Currently she works as a senior educational technologist. She has published several articles on technology and information science. From time to time she publishes books which are few but relevant and useful. They have also been nicknamed "a treasure trove".

ekegusii: Aaria Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho: Chinyomba Chikoyia Na Koba Obonyinyo, Bono Abana Tibabwati Ase Bakorara Aya amwabo aya: Korwa ase Standard Media: Chinyomba isato ch' oboraro nigo chiayiete na koba obonyinyo aaria Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho. Omorero oyio orenge ekebemberia nigo obete ase rituko ria Tichi kabere botuko amo na igoro Tichi Gatato. Omwoorokia Omonene bw' esukuru eyio, Principal Zachary Nyariki nigo atebete buna esukuru eyio yasiekirwe, kobwatekana n' omobasokano oyio bw' omorero. Abaorokigwa baria konyora bataramanya igoro y' omorero oyo naende barenge koirana gocha ase esukuru eyio, nigo bairanete gochia ase chinka chiabo. "Nigo togokagera buna chinyomba echi nigo chiasambetwe, korende ntwe nigo totagete abanyanyimbo bakore obotuko bwabo, erinde gototebia ekeene" Nabo Principal Nyariki atebete. Esukuru eyio yachagetwe amo na Abakatholiki, nigo ebwate abaorokigwa goetania 1100. Gati ya abaorokigwa abwo, 250 bono mbabwati oboraro. Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho, Kisii County Chinyomba ibere nigo chiasambwa ase rituko ria Tichi Kabere morogoba ekero abana b' esukuru eyio basangererekanete ase ebaredi, gotebigwa amatangaso amo n' Principal. Enyomba y' gatato nigo yayiete igoro mogaso, ekero abanyanyimbo baria barendete enkore eyio, barwete aroro na kogenda korigia ganto babeke mboto. Enyomba yende y' Cardinal Otunga nigo yayiete omwaka oyo oera, korende obotuki tibwanya gochia aande. Kisii Central Division Criminal Investigation Officer, Paul Wambugu amo na Marani OCPD Benjamin Kimwale mbatarerete esukuru eyio na koria chiira buna obotuki boikeranete, mboche bokorwe.
english: Aaria Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho: The incident with stones and sticks, the students were disturbed and scattered. These are the details: Report from Standard Media: The incident of stones being thrown is said to have occurred at Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho. This morning, the school was closed indefinitely following a student strike on Tuesday afternoon. The Headteacher of that school, Principal Zachary Nyariki, stated that the school was closed due to the chaos caused by the strike. Students who spoke did not know the cause of the strike but said they found themselves running away from the school, fearing harm. “It is regrettable that this incident happened, because now students will not be able to continue with their studies, and it will delay their education” Also Principal Nyariki stated. The school which was founded by Catholics, can accommodate 1100 students. Out of those students, 250 are boarders. Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho, Kisii County This first incident happened during the Tichi Kabere holiday when the students were gathering in the field, and were addressed by the Principal. Yesterday afternoon, it was reported that the students who had attended that meeting, woke up angry and started causing trouble. Today’s meeting of Cardinal Otunga has been postponed until further notice, so that investigations can be carried out. Kisii Central Division Criminal Investigation Officer, Paul Wambugu and Marani OCPD Benjamin Kimwale visited the school and promised to investigate the matter thoroughly, and arrest those involved.

ekegusii: Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Egetamo (March) 11, 2011. Aya amwabo aya: Amandegere ande nao are aaria Tabaka. Timochiesera Abageka. Inee, nomanyete buna Abagusii intwabwate enyomba ya ababani gose e clan of prophets? Eee bono. Nigo egotebekana inga ababani bonsi pi ase Gusii engima nigo bare korwa ase enyomba ya a Abageka. Ase boigo, nigo sokoro antebetie inga Omobani (Prophet) Sakawa amo no omobani Ombati Omonyamorero nigo barwete ase enyomba ya Abageka eyio egotoka aaria Kitutu Chache. Manya bono. Omobani Sakawa ere nachiete nguma ase obobani bwaye ekero abanete igoro yo ogocha kwa Abasongo amo no okoagachwa kwo omochie o Getembe (Kisii Town). Korende onde taiyo oragotebie buna Sakawa asirete gose ase achiete. Nigo egotebekana buna emambia eyemo nyuma ya Sakawa gotwara omoyega bwo okoragera na konywa, agatoka taiyo. Korende abarugi baye nigo batebete inga kaa kagocha, nache na bwari buya, amare amatambe , amandegere name no obwate momura nayae korende otabwati momura narere, agasira tarorekana ase achiete. Tari igo rioka. Nigo egotebekana buna Sakawa nigo abanete inga amandegere nigo are gocha kwama aaria ase amaagacho ye enyomba ya National Bank Of Kenya, Kisii, eagachire rero. Kobwatekana no obobani bwa Sakawa, Getembe yaito yaikeranirie buna atebete. Obwonchoreria nigo bobwatete nse, naende nigo ekororekana buna amandegere nigo akuagwa ase obonge. Next In This Series: Abagambi Ba Abagusii Ekero Omosongo Aigete Nka Gusii
english: This is Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. March 11, 2011. Here are the words: Those who dwell near are those of Tabaka. They respect Abageka. Indeed, do people of Gusii know the history of the prophets in the clan of prophets? Very true. It is said that many prophets from the Gusii region were descended from the lineage of Abageka. In addition, it is reported that Prophet Sakawa and Prophet Ombati Omonyamorero originated from the lineage of Abageka which is located in Kitutu Chache. Very true. Prophet Sakawa once dreamed a dream about his followers and they went to consult with the Basongo and also to visit the town of Getembe (Kisii Town). Because of this, people say that Sakawa foresaw everything he did. It is said that the events that happened after Sakawa involved witchcraft and sorcery, which came to pass. Therefore, his enemies plotted against him, and some used poison, others used spears, those who dwelt nearby conspired against him, and his head was displayed where he had acted. That day passed. It is said that Sakawa dreamt that those who dwell near would be defeated at the location of the National Bank Of Kenya, Kisii, and so it happened. Concerning the dreams of Sakawa, Getembe truly understood that they were important. The interpretation is that those who dwell near will fall into trouble.
