ekegusii: Amang’ana amanene are ime y’egetabu eke igoro yokoiborwa ase amache amo n’ Omoika, oyo noro omochakano bwe egetabu eke, ase enchera ende, egetabu eke nigo kegotworokereria mono igoro yokoiborwa ase amache amo n’ omoika, na inaki omonto aranyare koiborwa ase amache amo n’omoika mono korengana ne ebuku. Amache nigo are omobwekano bwe ebatiso ya Yeso aria ase orooche rwa yorodani, ebuku nigo egototebia buna ebibe biaito bionsi nigo biabegetwe igoro ya Yeso ekero abatisetwe amo na yohana omobatisi. Yohana nigo arenge entenenera ya mwanyabanto bw’ ororeria rwa Aroni omokuani omonene. Aroni nigo are kobeka amoboko aye igoro y’omotwe bw’ Embori y’ekengwanso, na koyetambokeria ebibe bionsi bia aba Israeli bio ‘mwaka omogima, ase rituko riokobwatanigwa. Eke nigo kiarenge ekeriri kia amangana amaya arenge bosio. Ebatiso ya Yeso nigo yarenge buna ekiorokererio giekengwanso kiebibe igoro ya embori eria. Yeso nigo abatisetwe ase oroche rwa Yorodani, akobogoria ebibe bionsi biamwanyabanto ase omotwe oye ase okobekererwa amoboko amo na Yohana, akabambwa ase omosaraba erio aakanere ebibe bionsi. Korende abakeresito abange tibamanyeti ninki kiagerete Yeso akabatiswa amo na Yohana omobatisi ase oroche rwa Yorodani, ebatiso ya Yeso n’ekerenga ekenene ase egetabu eke, nensemo yenchiri etanyare goonchoka korende itagarete koba yekeene emiaka yonsi. Nigo tokoiborwa eriakabere ase okwegena enchiri y’omoika amo n’amache na ogokwa kwaye ase omosaraba.
english: The elders of the law were there at the place of purification where people gathered in Omoika, who knew this covenant like the law itself, and they increased and the law itself was fully explained about the place of purification where people gather in Omoika, and because of this reason they remembered the purification where people gather in Omoika and they agreed on a book. People also had a discussion about the baptism of Jesus Christ which happened in the river Jordan, and the book showed that all his deeds were done during the time of Jesus so that he could be baptized in it with John the baptizer. John did not have the authority of an angel like Aaron the high priest. Aaron had stretched out his hands at the place of the forehead during the glory of the tabernacle, and he sanctified all the possessions of the Israelites for a whole year, and the foundation was established. And he did not lack the power of the elders who had authority. The baptism of Jesus was like a full explanation of the glory of the tabernacle. Jesus was baptized in the river Jordan, forgiving all the sins of the people and his forehead and stretching out his hand with John, and he was bound by the spirit and he completed all things. Therefore, Christians today do not know what happened when Jesus was baptized with John the baptizer in the river Jordan, the baptism of Jesus is a great covenant like the law itself, and this teaching will continue to spread so that it remains forever. It is remembered greatly about being cleansed in Omoika and among the people and the spirit of forgiveness.

ekegusii: Abanto bande 960 batokire na corona Omobaro bwa abanto banyorekanire ne ebinyinyi bia corona ase ecounty ya kisii omentekanire goika abanto 25 magega yo omonto onde oyomo konyorekana ne ebinyinyi ebio gati ya abanto 960 bararigwa rero ne ewizara yo obochenu korwa ase abanto 8,261 barengetwe na igo goikia omobaro bwa abanto banyorekanire ne ebinyinyi ebio aiga kenya koba 17,603. korengana na amangana atomwa no omowaziri bwo obochenu mutahi kagwe egati ya abanto abwo abayia 960 banyorekanire ne ebinyinyi ebio ecounty ya Nairobi nigo etangaine na abanto 510, kobwatigwa na kajiado na abanto 102, kiambu na abanto 100, machakos nigo ebwate abanto 58 mombasa abanto 48, Busia abanto 21, Garissa abanto 17, Uasin Gishu abanto 15, kisumu abanto 14, Nakuru abanto 12, Narok na abanto 10, Turkana na abanto 9, keriho na abanto 7, ase chicounty chia muranga , makueni ,na Laikipia chibwate abanto 5 kera eyemo, Embu na abanto 3, chicounty chia Bungoma , kakameg, Nyeri na Taita Taveta gotwara abanto 2 kera eyemo ase boigo chicounty chia kisii, Tana river, na Trans Nzoia chibwate omonto oyomo. Nonya nabo abanto bande 2 bakure na igo goikia omobaro bwa abanto bakure gwetera ebinyinyi ebio aiga kenya koba 280, ase korende abanto bande 169 babwenire na goikia omobaro bwa abanto babwenire ebinyinyi ebio aiga kenya koba 7,743.
english: Abanto county recorded 960 infections with coronavirus. The total number of Abanto cases now stands at 17,603, with 25 deaths from the disease, while 960 people have recovered. A total of 8,261 people have been tested. The total number of Abanto cases in Kenya is 17,603. According to reports from the Ministry of Health through Minister Mutahi Kagwe, out of the 960 new cases, 510 were reported in Nairobi County, followed by Kajiado with 102, Kiambu with 100, Machakos with 58, Mombasa with 48, Busia with 21, Garissa with 17, Uasin Gishu with 15, Kisumu with 14, Nakuru with 12, Narok with 10, Turkana with 9, Kericho with 7, and Muranga, Makueni, and Laikipia counties each with 5 cases. Additionally, Embu had 3 cases, while Bungoma, Kakamega, Nyeri, and Taita Taveta each had 2 cases, and the counties of Kisii, Tana River, and Trans Nzoia each had only one case. Today, two people died from the disease, bringing the total number of deaths in Kenya to 280, while 169 people recovered, bringing the total number of recoveries in Kenya to 7,743.

ekegusii: Kenya nigo egochia koagacha orobago orotambe gotanga ababegu korwa ase ense ya somalia gosoa kenya. Omoriki bw’serekali oborendi bwa ime omosike Joseph Nkaissery nigo agoteba buna oyo ngati y’ emeroberio y’eserekari kobeka oborendi obonene ase ensemo ya ekaonti ya Mandera korwa ase obosagani bwa kera chingaki bwa Al-Shabaab naboigo na goteba buna nigo oboagachi obwo bogochia gochakwa korwa Mandera etaoni goika Wajir. “Mandera na Bulahawa nigo chire ang’e kegima goikera ekerengo otanyare goatanana korwa omochie onde bono tokonyara komanya kenya ng’ai na somalia ng’ai, nabo tokorigereria CCTV na chinchera chinyinge chia oborendi. Goika tonyore chingaki komanya ning’o ogocha na gosoka boigo ning’o orendete chinsa echio.” Nkaissery ogokwana na egetaseni ekemo aaria Kenya. Nkaissery nigo atebete buna orobago oro nigo bogochia korwa oborendi obonene ase engaki entambe bwachandire kenya ekiagera koreng’ana nere, ogosoa na gosoka korwa kenya nigo korabe goetera ase egesieri ekemo koirera komanya na gotanga ababegu ase ebirengo bia igoro. Ekeombe eke gia abaislamu abasaria nigo giakorire obosagani obonene ase chinsemo chia irianyi ya kenya amo n’ emechie emenene gati yabo omochie omonene o Nairobi, gesa orogongo rwa africa ya mocha gotoma abarendi gochia Somalia omwaka 2011 korwania ekeombe eke gesegetire na ekia Alkaida Boigo nigo Kenya egokagera ekeombe ekio goocherera abageni buna ensemo ya irianyi nonya archipelago emechia ya Mombasa na Lamu. Abanto 64 nigo baitwa omwaka oria ase ekaonti ya Mandera ase obosagani bobere bwakorwa na ekeombe kia Al-Shabaab, na batano bande gokwa nyuma yo’ bosagani bonde omwaka oyo buna ochaka ase ense eyio eyio. Okoagachwa kw’ enyasi oko nigo kogocha magega ya Kenya goteba buna nigo yare gati y’ chinkwana na Ethipoia kobeka ribaga ime ya Somalia riokomanya ase ekeombe ekio boigo kegosokera na koroberia obosagani bwabo.
english: Kenya is facing challenges due to ongoing attacks and instability along its border with Somalia affecting Kenyan citizens. The Interior Cabinet Secretary Fred Matiang'i stated that they are deploying more security forces to the Mandera county border area to address the increasing threat from Al-Shabaab militants and also stated that this deployment will cover the Mandera region extending to Wajir. "Mandera and Bulahawa are areas where criminals easily cross over making it difficult to distinguish between Kenyans and Somalis and we are installing CCTV cameras and enhancing border patrols. We need cooperation from the public to identify and report suspicious individuals." Matiang'i added while addressing a gathering in Kenya. Matiang'i further explained that the ongoing operations are aimed at protecting Kenya's territorial integrity and ensuring safety and security for its citizens and preventing attackers from entering the country through porous borders. The recent attacks carried out by al-Shabaab militants have caused significant damage to infrastructure in Kenya including the Westgate shopping mall attack in Nairobi which was linked to the African extremist group al-Shabaab who had previously sent fighters to Somalia in 2011 following an offensive against the coastal city of Kismayo and associated with the organization al-Qaeda. However Kenya has experienced increased attacks targeting foreigners especially in the coastal regions of Mombasa and Lamu. 64 people were killed last year in attacks in Mandera county perpetrated by al-Shabaab militants and five others were abducted during another attack that year escaping death in the same incident. The current situation requires Kenya to strengthen its defense capabilities and collaborate with Ethiopia to stabilize the border region of Somalia and combat terrorism and enhance their own security measures.

ekegusii: PETRONILLAH OGOTI, Gusii.com: December [ Egesunte, Egesunte Kia Masaba ] 16, 2015. Aya amwabo aya: Abwo kare kare, Kebaki amo n ' Okagonkoru mbamenyete aaria ase rinani erimo ria Magenche. Bono aba nigo barenge abasani abanene kegima na nigo banchaine ekianda gia ikomi. Kebaki amo n' Okagonkoru nigo barenge koagacha egesera ase oboamo na komenya aamo. Ase boigo, naende aba babere nigo barenge koumerana amo na gotiachora endagera ase oboamo ase chingaki chinyinge. Bono engaki eyemo, Okagonkoru okare kobora buna "Tiga totare rinani eri rionsi. Nabo toranyore ase agiya kobua aiga ase tomenyete ekiagera naigure gochia moino ye rinani eri endagera n' enyinge na nigo are agiya mono" Aba babere bagaancherana eng'ana eye na komanora gochia korigia enka enyia. Chinyoni echi chikairuruka na gotambururuka amo erinde barigie enka enyia. Kibakonya koiruruka bakaumera omote omotambe, omuuya ore ne ekiriri ekiiya. Kibanyora omote oyo, bagakung'ia erinde bamenye. Korende chinyoni echi chikaba tichiri koigwana buna gati y' Kebaki amo n' Okagonkoru, buna ning'o orenge gocha korosia egesera aaiga. Tibakoreti kende nonya, ase engencho y' esegi amo n' ekeminano Ekero baamererania ase egeka egetambe, eminano n' esegi egaateka. Ekero esegi eye yaateka, omonto akabora okoyetoria. Aba bakaba bakorwana ase engaki entambe, goikera ekairera chinyoni echi koirana gochia ase barwete, batarakora kende !! Korwa erio, aba babere bakamanya ase emioyo yabo ime buna okoigwana n' egento ekiya. Amachara bosa. Bono niingo ogocha koroisia egesera? Esegi teri gokonya onde bwensi. Bono Okagonkoru n' Okebaki bairanire gochia aaria sobo akoro, batarakora kende.
english: PETRONILLAH OGOTI, Gusii.com: December [ Greetings, Greetings to Masaba ] 16, 2015. These are the words: Long ago, Kebaki and Okagonkoru showed me a beautiful place near Magenche. These people always respect elders and they maintain good traditions. Kebaki and Okagonkoru always helped those who were suffering and comforted them. Because of this, others also respected them and praised their kindness. Those days passed, Okagonkoru once said “Let us protect our land together. Let us unite so that we can build a strong nation and develop our land well.” Others agreed with him and promised to work hard towards achieving this goal. This bird flies and hovers around, disturbing people greatly. It refuses to fly unless it sees a very tall tree, its wings and feathers shining. Ignoring that tree, they wonder how to understand it. Therefore, this bird keeps circling like the story of Kebaki and Okagonkoru, a story that continues to be told generation after generation. We continue today, with the strength of unity and cooperation. They remember the importance of working together, unity and cooperation. The strength of that cooperation, someone will start to appreciate it. Those who work on important matters, seek guidance from this bird to help them succeed, they try hard!! Work diligently, others know that their hearts are full of wisdom and understanding. Many thanks. Are these things still being remembered? There is no way to hide the truth. Why did Okagonkoru and Okebaki come together to show everyone the right path, they tried hard.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Koru ase The Nation Media. Ebinto ebinge biisaine chishilingi chimilioni chinyinge nigo biayiete na koba obonyinyo aaria ase Eronge SDA Boarding Primary school ime ya Borabu Constituency, Nyamira County. Omwoorokia omonene bw' esukuru eyio omosike Evans Osinde nigo ateba buna ase ebisio ebiya, onde bwensi tabwate chingoma chinde, kobwatekana n' omorero oyio. "Ntwe nigo togoakera Omonene Tata Nyasae buna mbuya mono ase eng'encho ekero omorero oyio obete, abaorokia amo na abaorokigwa konyora bachire ase ekanisa ime ase amasabo. Onde bwensi tarenge ase enyomba y' oboraro, eyio yayiete ase ekebemberi ekio" Nabo omosike Osinde atebete. "Ntwe nigo twaigwete enkoba y' eriogi rinene. Togochi korigereria, tokarora omorero amo n' erioki rinene koru ase enyomba eyio eyemo y' oboraro" Nabo omosike Osinde atebete okomenta naende. Nigo Principal Osinde atebete buna nabo batemete korimia omorero oyio bagotumia fire extinguishers chiabo, eyio ekagera omorero oyo tominchoria na kominyoka gochia ase chinyomba chinde. Ogokonywa ngotakeire Abanyanyimbo koru Manga amo na Esise Ward Rep Teresa Nyaanga nigo babwatesetie abana amo n' abarimu ase okorimia ekebemberi ekio. Gati y' ebinto biasambetwe n' omorero oyio n' ebitanda amo n' ebinto binde bia abana. Nigo Principal Osinde atebete buna omorero oyio nabo osambete ebinto biraire Ksh15 million. Omosike Osinde amo na Esise Ward Rep omosubati Nyaanga nigo baboretie eserikali amo n' abanto baito bonsi barwe ogokonya gochia ase abana abwo 160, erinde nario baragenderere amo n' amasomo abo. Enyomba y' oboraro nigo yayiete pi, korende enyomba y' amasabo abwo ase abana barenge ime gosaba Omonene Tata Nyasae egatigara kere buya. Below: Principal Evans Osinde okwoorokia Henry Nyarora o Daily Nation the extent of the fire.
english: These are the details: The incident occurred at The Nation Media. Items worth millions of shillings were destroyed by fire at Eronge SDA Boarding Primary School in Borabu Constituency, Nyamira County. The head teacher of that school, Mr. Evans Osinde, said that the cause of the fire is still unknown, and investigations are ongoing. “We thank God Almighty for saving the students from this unfortunate incident, the parents and teachers should pray for the church and its surroundings. Investigations are underway to determine the cause of the fire,” said Head Teacher Osinde. “We have received very sad news. We urge everyone to cooperate, restore the building and the large amount of property lost in the fire,” added Head Teacher Osinde while speaking further. The Principal Osinde also stated that they tried to put out the fire using fire extinguishers, but the fire spread quickly and caused significant damage to the building. Reporting by our correspondent Members of Parliament from Manga and Esise Ward Rep Teresa Nyaanga visited the children and teachers to comfort them over the incident. The extent of the damage to the building and the children's belongings is yet to be determined. Principal Osinde stated that the loss is estimated at Ksh15 million. Head Teacher Osinde and Esise Ward Rep Ms. Nyaanga appealed to the government and well-wishers to help the 160 students who are now displaced and their education disrupted. The dining hall was completely destroyed, leaving the students without a place to eat meals provided by God Almighty, which had been happening regularly. Below: Principal Evans Osinde showing Henry Nyarora of Daily Nation the extent of the fire.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Tokare gosamba chibando emorogoba eyemo, omogaka sokoro ominto agantebia buna Nare Komenya Ndore Bigori Chitana Nchiborwa Moenori Otari Mosunte. Greetings, the good news is that this announcement has been made by the leader himself, just now. Gusii.com at home found Nyang'iti, Bonchari, Kisii County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014. The doctor who works hard always helps people, bringing solutions. This doctor who has served for many years, has also been appointed to help people. The doctor has explained that he knows those years of service, and he will bring solutions and share information about everything, so that people know his information completely and accurately. “Moenori otari gesunte” as we said earlier, this is done to bring solutions, which will benefit people. Truly speaking, and according to the teachings of Mwamogusii, if someone brings good news, they should be praised and thanked very much. The solution is being implemented, and it involves various challenges. Regarding the solution brought forth, it concerns important issues regarding things, reaching Mwanyagetinge where people have gathered with Nare Komenya Ndore Bigori Chitana Nchiborwa Moenori Otari Mosunte. ekegusii: Abwo kare kare, narenge omongina oyomo omogoko ekerage. Monto nacha komokwania onye endagera konye yayire nigo arenge koyebisa. Omogeni karamoborie ng’a nkiekio giatioka, nigo arenge komoiraneria, ‘Gaki ntwe ntobwati kende pi! Enchara yatobatire ekerage, rimisu erio tari a ndagera, n’erimisu ria ebisabo bia egentunguu twaruta riko biyie.’ Rituko erimo omosani oye agacha komokwania. Korende mosani oria taganya eero, akagenda rioka goika chikoni. Abwo chikoni erongori nkona gotogota yare riko. Ebirengererio bigaichorera omosubati oria omogoko. Akeeboria; “Nki bono oyo nere acha korigia chikoni? Naende agosaria goikaransa! Akarongori aka gose orora” Ageekana na komonya g’ekumbete gochia nse “otarora kia morwaire” Omogeni oria akamotebia, “ “Erongori eyio teyieti obeke egekombe tonywe?” Omogeni oria nkomoigwa arenge kiagera namanyete ng’a omosubati oria n’omogoko omororo. Omosubati akamotebia; “Obe, okagete nche n’erongori nkorosia? Nche negento ngotema korora gose nkebe buna ndengereretie” Ekero omogeni oria anga gosuka korwa chikoni, omosubati omogoko akagenderera komenta obosie na gokonya nomogango bweching’eni. Konye megango eye babwate rero terarosigwa. Agakonya igo, mpaka erongori eria ekaba obokima. Oyio noro omochakano bwokoruga obokima. Nonya obogoko bwaretete obokima, ntwe bagusii ntoacheti bogoko. Nakio abagoko bagotererwa ng’a Eki’omogoko, n’omwana ogetoire… Yeso oyio. Omosani oo Axate
english: My father, my father, do not let the darkness overcome the light. Let me find strength to face tomorrow and let it be enough to show me the way. The woman remembered her beautiful dreams, and it was enough to encourage her, ‘Child, don't cry anymore! The sun has risen in the east, the dew is still on the leaves, and the dew of the sweet potatoes we harvested yesterday is still there.’ The path has thorns for those who seek strength. Therefore, thorns do not fear the soil, they grow and become strong. This path is very rough and difficult. The obstacles hinder the person who walks it. She said; “Why does this path lead me here? I wish I hadn't come! This path is full of trouble.” She walked and found a small stream saying "it flows like tears" The woman who understood, “ “Does this path really lead to happiness?” The woman who was confused felt pity for the person and the child who were suffering. The person replied; “Yes, if you persevere on this path, will you reach the end so that I can see?” As the woman continued walking along the path, the child followed closely behind, carrying their belongings with them. And they walked until they reached a place where they could rest. Then, they ate some food. They ate well, until the path became clear. That is how challenges build character. Because the body gets tired, people need rest. But others are strengthened by The hardships, and the child grows up... Jesus is good. The strength of Axate.

ekegusii: Ning’o orabe omoruoti bweching’iti chiorosana maega yeechui korwa oboruoti? Ekebusi ne’Esese nigo bire abasani. Nigo bibwate echeche nainde bikogoka gokora ebinto bionsi amo. Ekebusi amo ne’sese nigo bikorigereria korwa etirisa. Bikorigerei korwa etirisa, nario erio biaroche ekegwankwa. Ase omogano oyo omwana nigo akoerengia chianaga chinge, chinene na echi chimoisane. Omogano oyo nigo orwete ase “SEED story” korwa eyunibasiti ya Kwazulu-Natal. Chinyang’au nigo chire nerang’o aseigo chibare buna chigochia konywa amache. Omogano igora ya ogokonya ebirerwa bieching’iti chikoretwa ase enasari ye chitangana. Ebirerwa ebio nigo bikorerwa nomonto obene na abakonyi bande. Omonto oyo ore ase omogano oyo nigoare omontambe mono na ase igo keregento nigokere ekieng’e na egeke asare. Omonto oyo nigo agotatora obokong’u goetera ase okoreng’ania ebinto bionsi bimoreng’ane.
english: Is it possible to finish building a small house quickly so that we can start living in it? The bus and Esese have already arrived at the station. They have brought food and drinks for everyone. The bus and Esese will also help us build the foundation. They will build the foundation well, and then we will start constructing the walls. This story about a child is very interesting, beautiful, and full of meaning. This story is known as the "SEED story" from the University of KwaZulu-Natal. The sun shines brightly, warming the earth and making the plants grow. The story of a young girl who dreams of becoming a doctor is told in a small village. The dream is realized through hard work and dedication. That person, regarding this story, is a great storyteller and always manages to capture our attention and make us think deeply. That person has been chosen to share their stories with the world.

ekegusii: Omorai bw’ obochori korwa ODM omosike Junet Mohammed orangeirie ekeombe kia obochori n’ chimbebe (IEBC) koringoria obogori bw’ chikura bwaigwekanire aria Kajiado Central ase obochori oboke bogochia koera.Kobwaterana na abasike bande ba ekeombe ekio abajumbe, Junet nigo agoteba buna Jubilee Alliance Party nigo egokorera obong’ainereria bw’okoboko gose chibesa koiba chikura echio. omosike Junet obogoretie chibesa chikageire korwa ase omomenyi o Japan Gati ye ebitaseni bigotebekana buna Kajiado Town. JAP, nonya nabo yakanire amang’ana ayio na goteba buna echio ne chintacho chi’omoerio chia ebarasi. Ekerogo eke kiebunge nigo gekorwanererwa na Memusi Kanchori korwa ODM, Patrick Tutui o JAP na oyio bwetenenerete Kuntai Nkashuma. Bwango aya atarakoreka, abarobekani ba ODM bakoragwa na Homa Bay Woman Respresentative Gladys Wanga nigo baika esukuru y’ oboroso ya Eng’alibo ase chikura chigoakwa ase ekageire buna amarieta ya abaakii chikura aburukanirie. Nonya nabo,abaaki chikura bande nigo bairana nka magega yaamarieta abo kobora.Abande baterigetie buna abaaki chikura nabarabwo nigobaika ase obonge ko’ babetererigwa koirana chinsobo. Oboaki chikura nigo bokageire koera goika chinsa ikomi nemo chia mogoroba na obobari gochaka aaria Maasai Technical Training Institute Global Radio Network
english: The Member of Parliament for Suna East, Junet Mohammed, has accused the electoral commission (IEBC) of colluding with Kenya Kwanza coalition supporters in Kajiado Central to rig the election. Speaking to journalists, Junet alleged that the Jubilee Alliance Party was funding the rigging scheme to ensure victory for their candidate. MP Junet claimed the scheme involves using Japanese technology. However, this happened during the nominations in Kajiado Town. JAP, along with its allies, denied the allegations and maintained that the process was fair and transparent. The constituency returning officer was appointed by Memusi Kanchori from ODM, Patrick Tutui from JAP, and another official named Kuntai Nkashuma. These claims remain unsubstantiated, with ODM officials led by Homa Bay Women Representative Gladys Wanga dismissing them as baseless accusations aimed at discrediting the results. They also stated that voters should be allowed to choose their leaders freely. The officials further added that those making the allegations were likely unhappy with the outcome. The officials have vowed to challenge anyone who attempts to interfere with the election process. Their concerns stem from reports of irregularities at Maasai Technical Training Institute Global Radio Network

ekegusii: Waiguru gotenena bweka bokoonyi botaiyo korwa ase abanene. Written by Inka FM on 15 June 2020 Omorai bwekiama kia ODM Raila Odinga nigo atuguteire aare amang’ana buna nigo agendrerete emeremo bonkunyunkunyu erio komotooria omogavana o Kirinyaga Anne Waiguru. Gokwana emembia ya Rero, Raila nigo atebire buna eseneti eyio etigaretie richibu riomoerio nere buya yeegwe ribaga gokora emeremo yooka erio kobwatoka egetambokero ekeronge. Raila nigo atebire tabwenereti gotooria Waiguru ase asingereire buna tigaaegerere bweka ase okobeka ekeene nebunge konacha koreng’ana nekeene ekio. Nigo omorai oyio are koyakwana aya maega yokonyora ecertificate ekoorokia tabwati ndwari ya Corona maega yogwesokia korengwa abwo igoro ase chilaboratory chia Kemri ime ya Mbagathi.
english: Waiguru received strong support from her people regarding the case involving leaders. Written by Inka FM on 15 June 2020 The leader of the ODM party, Raila Odinga, has reportedly intervened on behalf of those involved and has defended Governor of Kirinyaga, Anne Waiguru, against accusations. According to sources from Rero, Raila stated that the senate should focus on more important matters instead of wasting time on the governor's case which is causing unnecessary disruption. Raila also stated that it is inappropriate to investigate Waiguru while she is working hard to address the challenges facing the country during this difficult time. It is reported that there are concerns about the accuracy of the certificate used to test for Coronavirus, especially considering the congestion at the Kemri laboratory in Mbagathi.

ekegusii: Description Dorothy Jebet nabwate obomanyi obuya botanetie emiaka 18. Ere okorire emeremo ase chinyomba chia abariki ao ao buna Nation Media, The Standard, Eria Yaereretwe Kenya Times, The Star na Kass FM ase ebitambokero ao ao. Nigo abwate obomanyi oboagare ase abariki banucha ense engima, obomo bwabo n’ekero gete akorerete enyomba y’abariki ekorokwa “US Congressional” chingaki chia Bill Clinton arenge koraa Amerika. Emeremo ya Dorothy nemegare, eyende nigo yasaneretwe na chinse chia maiko. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 Eyio ekomena oboke bwensi, na gokomba kera egento Buna abaibori baye basogete na korimera iga, omwana oyo akairaneria egesieri ki' enyomba na kogenda gotiena na abagisangio baye abooro. Keri keri, engi ekagenda egasoa mwabo, na koria endagera yonsi. Engi eye ekanyora oboke, naborobu ekabomena igo, goikera ekananterera oboke igoro !! Bono ekero omwana oyo akarosa gotiena na enchara ekamonyara, nario aminchogete gochia nyomba aragere. Nonya nabo igo, akanyora chisani chikombire, na ndagera teiyo. Agaichana, mono kegima, korende engi nabo yamotengerete. "Nigo ngokomera bogara" Bono engi egakare komotebia buna "Inche n' engi enene. Kogonkuna, ngokomera bogara" Koigwa iga, omwana oyo akaondoka na gotama kwagachia kerage, gotebia abaamate bache korora aya. Bono kera onde oyo are gotebi, nigo arenge kominchoka omotiga abwo bweka !! Omwana oyo akarosa nagoikaransa ase ekiriri gakona gwenchanda buna agocha gotebia ng'ina na ise ase arenge, goikera engi enene egasoa mwabo na koria endagera yonsi pi. Ageitia mono, ogotaigwera kwaye.
english: These are the stories: Long ago, there was a beautiful girl named Nyangoge, a very clever child. This child was also very strong. It happened like this, a story was told. A story was told, the elders said they couldn't manage to go to war, let her stay and finish her work. The beauty of her eyes: That wonderful girl used to wake up early to look around. Gusii.com at home is in Nyangoge, Borabu, Nyamira County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 That thing that makes the ground tremble, and remembering the past So the elders agreed and started planting seeds, this child would rejoice with her mother and go to visit her friends. Quickly quickly, the time came when the story was told, and everything was remembered. That time which shakes the ground, it brings joy to people, it makes the ground fertile!! But that time the child grew up and became a beautiful woman, but she still woke up early to look around. She loved her people, she shook hands, and nothing was missing. It was good, very strong, so that time she was respected. "I will respect everyone" But that time someone said that "This is a big time. Respect everyone" They said about the seeds, this child left and went to find a place to settle down, telling her relatives to remember this. But that person who settled there, was also able to wake up early !! This child grew up and found herself in a small house with a lot of wealth because of looking for things and because she was also strong, making that big time remembered and everything remembered completely. She did something, she didn't forget anyone.

ekegusii: abanto 21 gokwa ase omobasokano bwepara Tharaka Nithi Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 25, 2022 Omobaro bwabanto bakuure kobwatekana nomobasokano oikire 33 maega yegari ebus barinete ya Modern Coast kobwateranigwa nomobasokano bwepara. Koreng’ana naroboti, egari eyio yabogoretie abiria korwa Maua gochia Mombasa abwo igoro magoroba, eyanyorete omobasokano ase edaraja ya Tharaka Nithi. Egari eyuo nigo yabutogete chibreki egasiria oboroso na gotwoma eyende, egento kiairerete ekagwa ase edaraja eyuo chimita 40 gochia inse. Koreng’ana nabanyanyimbo baigete ensemo eyio, baria batigeretwe chingoma ebaminyogetigwe ase chinyagitari ya Chuka amo na Chogoria. Omocounty Commissioner o Tharaka Nithi Nobert Komora oenekirie buna abanto 10 ebare nechingoma chintindi ase chinyagitari.
english: Abanto 21 were involved in an accident involving a Modern Coast bus in Tharaka Nithi. Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 25, 2022 The driver of the Abanto bus lost control and collided with a matatu at around 33 meters from the Modern Coast bus station. According to witnesses, the vehicle was traveling from Maua towards Mombasa when it crashed near the Tharaka Nithi bridge. The vehicle reportedly failed brakes and had a high speed, causing it to fall off the bridge about 40 kilometers from the center. Witnesses said several people were injured in the incident, some seriously, at the Chuka and Chogoria junctions. The County Commissioner of Tharaka Nithi, Norbert Komora, confirmed that 10 people died in the accident.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Omong'ina magokoro baba ominto nantebetie buna abwo ase chingaki chia kare kare, amaiga y' omogaka narengeo. Bono amaiga y' omogaka ninki? Naende nabo oraborie. Magokoro nigo antebetie buna ase amatuko amakoro, nigo abagaka bare koriseria chiombe chiabo ase oboamo, naende nigo chiare korara ase ayamo. Nigo baba antebetie buna nigo abagaka aba bare korosia egesa gekorokwa gesarate, erinde babera na korara aroro. Bono abaminto manya buna gesarate n' ase abagaka bare komenya, ayio arenge aare na sobo, na nigo bare kong'anya ne chiombe chiabo. Ase boigo, nigo omong'ina antebetie buna abang'ina mbarenge kobera gesarate. Yaya. Abasae n' abagaka, nabwo boka barenge kobera aaiga gesarate. Bono ekero omong'ina arenge koigwa amaiga y' ogokwania omogaka oye, nigo omong'ina oyo are kwebwatesia, orosia endagera egotonontera, buna obokima amo n' ching'eni chiri omogaka oye ancheete. Tingocha kona kobeera nyombaa nche bweka: Omosubati nyakieni nkorengereria are, okweboria buna n' chinyeni ki gose, agocha koiyekera omogaka oye, erinde amoirere aaria gesarate. Ase Abagusii, amaiga y' omogaka narengeo. Korwa abwo, omanya gwetema igo, goika gesarate na kobairera endagera eyio eng'ansu. Bono omong'ina oyo gaikire abwo egesarate, nigo abagaka aba bande bare komanya buna omong'ina oyo nigo are n' amaiga y' omogaka oye, bamanya koa omogaka bw' omong'ina oyo ribaga, erinde ogenda bwoye! Kobwatekana n' omongina magokoro baba ominto, aya naro arenge gokwanerwa buna amaiga y' omogaka, n' Abagusii abakoro. Abaminto, obo nabwo obosemi bwaito bw' Ekegusii ase rero. Monywe mache maya, and thank you for listening.
english: These are the words: The story is about a person who greatly loved his family and friends, and he had a lot of wealth. But did he have enough wealth? I also want to share with you. The story is about a person who had many possessions, and people respected him because of his generosity, but he still wanted more. He greatly loved his family and people respected him because of his great achievements, and they were happy and satisfied. But some people didn't understand why he was so successful, they were jealous of him, and they tried to ruin his reputation. Because of this, the story is about how important it is to be successful. Yes. His children and relatives, they too wanted to achieve success. But what does this story mean when someone wants to acquire the wealth of another person, and that person refuses, causing conflict and problems, and ultimately leading to destruction? Consider this carefully and remember well: The advisor told the king, saying that it is important to listen to advice, and to respect others, and to help those in need, so that things will turn out well. And the Gusii people, they have a lot of wealth. Therefore, know this truth, it is good to work hard, to strive for success and to protect your property from thieves. But this story teaches us that if people try to take your success, then those people should understand that this success comes from the wealth of another person, they should also understand how that person feels, and then leave it alone! Connecting with the story of a person who greatly loved his family, these words also teach us about the wealth of our ancestors, and the ancient Gusii people. People, this is our heritage of Ekegusii forever. Thank you very much, and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Kera egento nao kere ase Facebook "Timogotiga kera egento kebe ase Facebook?" Omogaka Okioma ominto, riborio erio ne rigiya mono. Ee bono omogaka. Nao tore ase Facebook. Intobwate nonya na abasani ase Facebook. "Bono rende ewebu saiti eye ne eyaki? Intori korora kera egento mokorika ase Facebook?" Omogaka ekio ne ekeene pi pi pi. Abagusii nigo batebete buna, "Eya bande, morogoba egoosia". Ntwe ntomanyeti buna Facebook na amatuko arenga eragenderere koba. Titomanyeti eki kegocha koba gochia motwe. Nabo barayesieke tomanye gotigara bosa. Eroro igoro. "Inee, gete Facebook nigo ere free. Tari bo? Ninki gekogera motagete gotuguta chibesa ase chiwebu saiti chinde bosa, mokona korera buna ebesa yakongire? Abwo omogaka ekio ne ekeene. Onde tari goakanera besa ase Facebook. Nabo bakobichoka omotwe! Korende kende gionsi okorika ase Facebook, tikeri kiao. Nigo gekoba eki' Facebook. Nabo baratake gokora kende gionsi na amariko ao kwarikire aroro. Komenta nayio, baise kobichoka omotwe, nabo bagosieka eakounti yao bira riborio! Omanye gotigara otari na kiamboria. "Bono igo nainwe nigo motagete koba buna Facebook?" Aa! omogaka rero nabo okamineti. Abasomi ba Gusii.com nigo bare kera ase. Nigo bare ase Facebook, Twitter, Yahoogroups.... Kera ase. Naintwe nigo togosiomeria aroro ase Facebook, erinde kobatebia buna nao tore. Batoinyore. Erinde batorotote ekero banyorire ribaga. Omogaka Okioma, ekio nakio gekogera tokona gotumbaga aaiga ase ewebusaiti eye.
english: These are the things: They say people nowadays are on Facebook “Is it true people are on Facebook?” Old man Okioma asked, thinking deeply and shaking his head. Yes indeed, old man. Now I am on Facebook. People waste time and money on Facebook. “Why do you spend so much time there and what do you see? Why are people wasting their lives on Facebook?” The old man laughed repeatedly. The Gusii people often say, “Yes friend, life is difficult.” Don't be too involved with Facebook and those things that make you feel good. Don't let it control your mind. But some people have become addicted to it. It’s a bad thing. “Really, Facebook is free. Isn’t it? Why then do people spend a lot of money buying bundles for these websites only to find out they are being cheated? The old man laughed again. There is no need to suffer because of Facebook. But they are causing problems! So don’t waste your time aimlessly on Facebook, just know this. It is ruining Facebook. And they are taking our time and resources which could be used elsewhere. Comment on this, friends, stop causing problems, and they should delete their accounts completely! Be careful and wise. “Why is it that you people are spending so much time on Facebook?” Ah! the old man said and pondered. Readers of Gusii.com are also on it. They are on Facebook, Twitter, Yahoogroups…. They are on it. I myself didn’t want to be on Facebook, but I had to join because of others. I joined. And now I find myself spending a lot of time there. The old man Okioma, said this while speaking about how young people use websites.

ekegusii: Matiang’i komochia obomo bwa Kenya Kwanza; obaenekeirie abakenya omorembe Written by Zachary Mayieka on August 2, 2022 Omowaziri bwoborendi bwa ime Dr.Fred Matiang’I nigo amochirie obomo bwa Kenya Kwanza, maega yogoteba amasakara atoka gasiareranire ime yomochie ‘Mombasa ayio are kogosereria obogima bwabarai gete , nigo arwa ase abisi yomorai bwense omosike Uhuru Kenyatta. Gokwana chingaki chiegeikaro giokeneki omorembe bosio bwobochori obenene,Matiang’I nigo agikeria abarai abwo na kobaboria gotiga kong’aina abanainchi,ase ateba abakagerwa batano na batato (8) abwo bakageire koenekia egekore ekio nigo babekirwe biara. Nigo omowaziri oyuo abaenekeria omorembe oisaine abakenya, bosio bwobochori obonene, ase keria ateba eserekali nigo ere maiso, erio koenekia obochori bwekeene nobwasioku chitariki 9 chiomotienyi o gatano na gatato.
english: Matiang’i criticizes the plans of Kenya Kwanza; accuses Kenyans of being naive Written by Zachary Mayieka on August 2, 2022 The Minister for Internal Security Dr.Fred Matiang’I has criticized the plans of Kenya Kwanza, saying that some things are just empty promises made to deceive people, and he said those who support them are like fools following Uhuru Kenyatta. However, despite the large amount of money needed for this big project, Matiang’I told them and warned them not to mislead citizens, also saying that five and six (8) of them were arrested because they were found doing something wrong and were therefore released. He further accused the naive Kenyans, during this big project, also saying that the government is watching, seeing what this project will be like and whether it will succeed on September 9th next year.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: "Abana mbaragera?" Nabo tata akaboririe mama, gaiikire nka morogoba. Ntwe ebimwana nigo twakarageire ritang'ani, twabutiara. Go twabutiarire, twagenda isiko gotiena. Tata omanya koragera. Petronillah Ogoti nigo atebetigwe na ng'ina koro buna, "Tata N' omochobeeri. Agachobeera Akareta Baba". Bono igo ninki aase Ekegusii? Ase ogototebia igoro y' omoino oyo, ngina koro Petronillah natoete omogano. Kobwatekana na ng'ina koro, eye n' enywomo yatogetigwe ase omobayeno oyo oito. Enywomo eyio yabete, nigo yaagerete omwana oyomo akaba n' omogoko, na gotogia ise. Nigo ise omomura oyo arenge omogaka bwanchire ase enka amo n' ekenyoro kiaye. Bono omomura oyo gakiina na koba omonto omonene, akainyora obwanchani boria bwarenge ase enka yaye. Obwanchani boria bwachakerete gati y' ise na ng'ina, eyio yaagerete akaiborwa. Bono kaare n' omogoko, omomura oyo akainyora buna goetera ase ise konywoma ngina, akaiborwa. Kainyora iga, agatera omoino oyo ase enchera y' omobayeno. Tari igo rioka. Korora ebiinto ebiya ise amokorerete, omomura oyo akarora buna tiga amotogie, ase eng'encho nere ogerete abeire omomura egesora ase ekenyoro. Goetera ase omomura oyo, Abagusii bakabwatera abwo n' omobayeno oyo ogoteba buna"Tata N' omochobeeri. Agachobeera Akareta Baba". Oyo noro omoino oito for this week, naende Happy Father's Day ase abatata bonsi babeta. Monywe mache maya and thank you for listening. Happy Fathers Day 2012. Omwana omino, Fanuel Sedekia oyio.
english: These are their words: "Are the children enough?" And her father scolded her mother, reminding her like a foolish person. We children, we would argue constantly, we would fight. As we fought, we went outside together. Our father didn't know how to scold. Petronillah Ogoti was greeted by eight people, saying, “Father, you are a good man. The good man is Akareta Baba.” What does this mean in Ekegusii? It means she has experienced life, those eight people including Petronillah have agreed. To be associated with those eight people, and the wealth they possess is great. That wealth existed, and it helped the child who had problems and lacked respect, and it benefited them. And now this story continues to spread around about the past and the present. This story also involves a large amount of money, and it reminds people of the things they did in the past. Those things were shared among everyone, and those eight people helped. This time with problems and respect, this story reminds them to avoid being disrespectful to others, helping. It reminds them again, causing life to flourish through the help of others. Time passes quickly. Repeating the good deeds that our ancestors did, this story will continue until it reaches the ears of those who understand the importance of respecting elders. Because of this story, the Gusii people remember the relationship between fathers and children which says, “Father, you are a good man. The good man is Akareta Baba.” This is a good thing for life this week, and I wish Happy Father's Day to all fathers who exist. Have a nice day and thank you for listening. Happy Fathers Day 2012. This child, Fanuel Sedekia.

ekegusii: Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Amaumuntia (May) 3, 2011. Aya amwabo aya: Abangina Mosera Ibu amo na Nyamisanchu during happier times. Omongina Nyamisanchu nere otorentererete. Abwo kare kare, banto tibare gokwa. Bono rende inaki amakweri akorete agachera Mwanyagetinge? Abwo kare na kare, emiaka ne emiaka, omogaka oyomo nabwate abarugi babere. Mosera Ibu amo na na Nyamisanchu. Korende Nyamisanchu tanchete moibori omwabo. Nigo are komororera endamwamu enyinge sana mbaka akagania amakweri amoire. Goikera ekero eke, banto mbare gokwa. Rituko erimo, Nyamisanchu agaita moibori omwabo mbaka agatweka mo. Omogaka bwo omochi oyo akaba na amayianda ase ogosira kwo omorugi oye. Omogaka oyo akaba gakorenda oboina bwa nyagosira gekogera nigo abakoro bare kwegena buna monto tagokwa agende pi. Nigo begenete inga inkoboka are nyuma ya amatuko atano. Nyamisanchu tachia kogokigwa na okorendwa kwo oboina. Akaenga amarwa, na ekero amarwa aya ayiete, agatebia omogaka oye agende gotimoka gakonya kwegokia na amarwa ere arende oboina. Omogaka akagenda na gotiga Nyamisanchu arende oboina. Karendete, ribusi rikabusi amaroba. Nyamisanchu korora aya, akarigia enyimbo na gochwata embera igoro kagoteba, "monto okwa osira, motienyi okwa oboka, chitunda isato". Amaroba agakira tagenderera kobusia. korwa erio amakweri agacha buna amaroba aya are kobusia nyagosira otagete koboka Nyamisanchu akamochwata tachia koboka, amakweri agachera Mwanyagetinge korwa erio.
english: This is Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. May 3, 2011. These are the words: My father Mosera Ibu and Nyamisanchu during happier times. My mother Nyamisanchu was very generous. Long ago, people did not have much. Why does this wealth seem to favor the children of Mwanyagetinge? Long ago and long ago, years and years, the elder always helped his relatives. Mosera Ibu and Nyamisanchu. Because Nyamisanchu loved her family very much. She would save little by little until she managed to buy good clothes. It was said, people did not have much. In those days, Nyamisanchu would love her family so much that she would spoil them. The elder who had this habit also had friends who would help him with his farming. That elder was known for being kind and compassionate, and his neighbors would come together to help him when he needed it. They came together like ants after five days. Nyamisanchu continued to love her family and care for them. She saved money, and whenever these savings were enough, she would send the elder to buy things and bring them home. The elder went and bought Nyamisanchu what she wanted. As they returned, there was a lot of noise. Nyamisanchu sang songs and danced while carrying a pot, saying, “my wealth is increasing, my possessions are growing, my granary is full.” The pots made a lot of noise as they walked. This happened because the pots were full of things that Nyamisanchu had bought, and the children of Mwanyagetinge were happy about it.

ekegusii: IEBC gokora omosangererekano omonene igoro yobochori bwomwaka o 2022 KICC Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 11, 2022 Ekeombe kiobochoori nechimbebe IEBC nigo kerakore omosangererekano omonene igoro yokoerigania kwobochori obonene ase amaagacho a KICC ime yomochie o Nairobi. Omosangererekano oyio nigo ore nekerenga, ‘Ogosukia ense ya Kenya gochia ase ekerengo egeting’u kiobosibore’. Chinkwana nchibe igoro yokoerigania kwobochori na koenekia obochori obuya. Omorai bwense omosike Uhuru Kenyatta nigo akageire koigora omosangererekano oyuo bwamatuko ane, amo na abarwanereria bane bekerogo kioborai bwense. Abwo ng’amo na oria o ODM Raila Odinga, oria o UDA William Ruto, Roots Party George Wajackoya, amo na Agano Party David Wahiga. Boigo ebiombe biariganirie ng’amo na African Union, Commision of Chairperson Moussa Faki Mahamat amo nabanyakerogo korwa ebiombe binde biobochori. Omonachi ebina omonene Martha Koome, Attoney General Kihara Kariuki amo nomoteneneri o IEBC Wafula Chebukati nabaikerane.
english: IEBC prepares major election forum for the 2022 general election at KICC Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 11, 2022 The commission announced that IEBC will hold a major election forum for monitoring the general election at the KICC grounds in Nairobi. This forum's theme is, ‘Promoting peaceful elections in Kenya through inclusive dialogue’. The purpose of the forum is to monitor the election and educate voters. President Uhuru Kenyatta also attended the election forum yesterday, along with his running mate and other leaders. Among them were ODM leader Raila Odinga, UDA leader William Ruto, Roots Party candidate George Wajackoya, and Agano Party candidate David Wahiga. Several observers attended including representatives from the African Union, Commission of Chairperson Moussa Faki Mahamat and other election observation teams. Chief Justice Martha Koome, Attorney General Kihara Kariuki and IEBC chairman Wafula Chebukati were also present.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Abwo kare kare ase ekenyoro kia Makairo, omogaka gete narengeo orenge korokwa Nyandika. Bono omogaka Nyandika nigo arenge n' obwanchani naende nigo anchete korwa obokonyi gochi ase bari baremeire na kende. Amaridadi y' amaiso: Omobisa tanya koayererwa. Tokare nyomba gotiachora obokima bw' obori amo n' amabere amaroranu. Gusii.com at home ase enka y' omogaka Nyandika aaria Makairo, West Nugirango, Nyamira County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 Nonya nase ching'iti, tarenge korora buya ekero abanto bagochanda ebimoni, chisese, chimbori, ching'ondi tare korora buya. Rituko erimo, omogaka Nyandika akanyora emanwa y' eng'era yatigetwe yoka. Bono emanwa eye nigo yarenge n' enchara. Bono omogaka Nyandika okare koniantoka gochia bwoye Koyerora iga, omogaka Nyandika agaichorwa n' amabera na agatwara omong'uso bw' okorwa obokonyi. Keri keri, Nyandika akaniantoka kogenda bwoye na koirana ne ekerandi kere na amabere ache koa emanwa enywe. Ekero aairana, akayebekera monwa egere egonke. Bono omogaka oyo akagoka buna emanwa y' eng'era yare konywa amabere buya. Nonya nabo igo, omogoko oye torenge bwe egeka. Eng'ina kumbe nkoirana ekare. Bono engina korora aya, ekaigwa bobe na kogechigwa. Ekare korundokera omogaka Nyandika Kiyagechigwa, ekare korundokera Nyandika. Bono omogaka Nyandika koyerora, akaimoka gotama korende tanyara gotama bwango. Eng'era eye ekamobogani, ekamoimoki igoro, na komotinera inse buna "Mo" Nonya nabo igo, tachieti gokwa. Korwa erio, omogaka Nyandika agatwara obomanyi buna omobisa, tari koayererwa.
english: These are his words: Long ago, there was a doctor in Makairo, whose name was Nyandika, who treated people with herbs. This doctor Nyandika also had a habit of secretly treating patients and they would pay him with gifts. The beauty of eyes: A beautiful girl who is admired. She doesn't like seeing a healthy person with large breasts. Gusii.com at home and the doctor Nyandika's house in Makairo, West Nugirango, Nyamira County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 Every time she dreams, she refuses to return until people bring her charms, beads, clay pots, and money before she returns. It is said that the doctor Nyandika wrote down the medicine he was given completely. And this medicine was mixed with witchcraft. This doctor Nyandika used to refuse to accept payment. To admire her, Doctor Nyandika was approached with gifts and he carried messages while secretly treating patients. Quickly, Nyandika refused to go away and argued with the young man and his breasts were full of milk. Until he met her, he stayed awake all night. This doctor then went crazy because of the medicine he drank from the breasts. Every day now, the old man no longer sleeps. The head sometimes argues with itself. And the head refusing this, it falls and gets hurt. The story about Doctor Nyandika It is reported, the story about Nyandika. This doctor Nyandika admiring, he woke up feeling weak and very tired. That medicine which confused him, made him stay awake all night, and caused him trouble saying “No”. Every day now, he doesn’t know what to do. In those days, Doctor Nyandika carried knowledge that a girl, when admired, does not feel shy.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Minto Mwamogusii, mbuya mono ase Omonene Tata Nyasae, ase ogotoikia omwaka o 2012. Nigo nyegenete ng'a nakera oyomo nare n' obote bw' okwarigania omwaka omoyia buna omosubati okoarigania omwana okoiborwa. Naintwe aiga Gusii.com ntori gotigwa magega yaye. Naintwe nkoyochengera tore. "Ntakana ekebwata bobe egasira, ntakana ekebwata buya ekaba aroro". Tiga ntwe abana ba Mwanyagetinge twebwate buya in 2012, erinde tochabumbe. Happy new year 2012, ase abana baminto mwensi Bono nigo tokoganeria mwensi amaya na omorembe O' Yeso obe nainwe ne chiamate chiano chionsi, Gusii yaito, n' ense engima. N' omogoko omonene buna twabwaterana twensi ase okogokera buna egekoro giato kiare ase omwaka oyo oera. naende ntogenderere gosemanian ase omwaka oyo o 2012. Nigo tokobasaba togenderere kobwaterana nario omonwa oito oragenderere. Omwana gakonya gokina nigo akonya kong'ainia ake ake. Naintwe nkonya gokina tore. Nigo tososaba buna tiga togenderere gokina aamo. Abagusii baminto tiga tobwaterane twensi toegokere na koinyorerani buna twakabeire. Teri igo rioka. Tiga Ekegusii giato gechabumbe gaki nonya emenwa ende yachiire nguma. Aya takoba ,otaiyo buna omwana ominto. 2012 n'omwaka bw'obochori seito Kenya. Tiga tosabe omorembe oichore egati yaito twensi ekiagera abakoro mbatebete buna, "Ntakana ekebwata bobe egasira, ntakana ekebwata buya ekaba aroro". Tiga toebwate buya, tonya koba ororo. Aya na amaiga y' omwaka omuya 2012. Happy new year abana baminto Mwanyagetinge mwensi. Nyasae abe nainwe.
english: These are my words: Minto Mwamogusii, a child of mine who praised God, praised Him in the year 2012. It was a good day when I remembered and thought about the importance of raising a child well, like raising a young plant. I created Gusii.com so people could find information there. I continue to work on it diligently. “Don’t despise small beginnings, don’t despise humble origins.” This is what the children of Mwanyagetinge said in 2012, and it has remained true. Happy New Year 2012, to all the children of our clan. This is how we begin this year with peace and the love of Jesus Christ, whom we all know, Gusii people, and with all wisdom. And with great joy we will celebrate together and the year will end well. I also wish you blessings throughout the year 2012. We pray for blessings so we can continue to live and prosper. A strong child can become very successful. I hope this happens too. We ask that this blessing happen quickly. The Gusii people should always live together peacefully and help each other so we can progress. There is no time to waste. Let the Gusii language flourish and be known everywhere, and let it bring us honor. These words are true, they are important for every child. 2012 is a year of change for Kenya. We ask for peace to prevail during the elections so that people don’t fight, saying “Don’t despise small beginnings, don’t despise humble origins”. Let us embrace humility, and may we not be arrogant. These are the hopes for the year 2012. Happy New Year children of Mwanyagetinge clan. May God bless you.
