ekegusii: Buna twakabeire: Na PETRONILLAH OGOTI. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Engatiato [ January ] 15, 2014 Aya amwabo aya: Togaikaransete emogoroba eyemo konywa rikairo, omogaka sokoro ominto nantegerete omorabaro gete omorito. Nigo omogaka sokoro antebetie buna Esese Eaberi Neero Yarusetie Entwoni Bogere! Bono ninki engencho y' omorabaro oyo? Nche naboretie sokoro. Nere n' omokia tata gokora keri kebeterereti. Nabo ebeterereti buna esese eye goika egende ase atambe. Esese y' omogaka Bogonko korwa aaria Marani, Bogetutu. Kare kare, yaikire Bomariba, Bonchari! Nigo omogaka antebetie buna abwo ase amatuko a kare, chisese chintwoni nchiagatarire. Naende amatuko amange, chisese echi nigo chiarenge gotara orogendo orotambe. Nabo kwarenge konyora buna esese y' omogaka Bogonko, korwa aaria Marani, kare kare yaikire Bomariba! Nigo chisese chintwoni chiarenge kogenda aare, erinde korigia chisese chiaberi. Ande onsi ase esese eaberi ere, nigo kwarenge konyora chisese chintwani chigocha koyetarera, esese eye eaberi neba aare. Bono chiakorire esababu!! Bono chisese echi gichiakorire esababu yabo, naende nigo chikoirana gochi aaria ase chiarwa!! Yaani manya. Aaiga, eganga enene y' omorabaro oyo neri ng'a, omokia n' omuya. Onye omokia toiyo, rirorio tokonyora keri otagete, gose kebeterereti. Omokia noro oragere aye onyore keri kegochandete ase enkoro yao. Gosegeta abanto gokora omokia, nakio kiagerete Abagusii abakoro bagateba buna Esese Eaberi Neero Yarusetie Entwoni Bogere! Korwa ase omogaka sokoro ominto, oyo noro omobayeno oito for this week. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.
english: Good evening: With PETRONILLAH OGOTI. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Published [ January ] 15, 2014 These are the words: When someone builds a house and drinks beer, the owner does not quickly forget the builders and the plasterers. It is the owner who remembers that Esese Eaberi Neero Yarusetie Entwoni Bogere! What is the reason for remembering those builders? I also remember them quickly. And I see my father working hard until he gets tired. They get tired because the spirit of going to work is good. The spirit of the owner Bogonko works around Marani, Bogetutu. Very well, greet Bomariba, Bonchari! It is the owner who remembers that when they were young, their traditions were respected. These days the traditions are gone, and respect has disappeared from the road. But let us remember the spirit of the owner Bogonko, who works around Marani, very well greet Bomariba! Let the tradition disappear slowly, protecting the old tradition. If you see the old spirit, let us remember the new tradition so that the old spirit remains there. What did it cause?! What caused this tradition, and yet it spreads around where people live!! That is true. Listen, the big body of those builders is here now, my father and mother. Anyone who forgets them, their memory will not be lost, it will remain. My father always tells me to look carefully at his wealth. Let people work hard like my father, and let the Abagusii elders know that Esese Eaberi Neero Yarusetie Entwoni Bogere! Works with the owner, this is what I have for this week. Goodbye everyone and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: Raila koirera Arati na Ongwae gosabusana Written by Zachary Mayieka on August 2, 2022 Oyokorigia ekerogo kioborai bwense goetera obomo bwa Azimio La Umoja omosike Raila Odinga,nigo airete chikampeini chiobomo obwo ase orogongo rwa Gusii rituko ria tichi kabere. Gokwana ase egetii ekenene kia Gusii Raila ,nigo ababoria abagusii goesokia ase obonge chitariki kianda na komoakera chikura,erio koenekia buna nkoba are omorai ogatano bwense ya Kenya. Chingaki echio echio omosike Raila nigo aira ribaga erio kobwatani abakorigia ebirogo aoao ime yecounty ya Kisii,egati yabo oyokorigia ekerogo kiobogavana ime yecounty eyio omosike Simba Arati amo nomogavana bwecounty ya Kisii omosike James Ongwa ase Raila ateba buna nobosooku obonene ase abarai bakorwa obomo bwa Azimio ,gotwara okong’usanana egento kerairere kobugwa ase obochori obwo Babere abwo nigo babeire babwate oboererania obobe egento konya kiaireire obomo bwa Azimio korigia gotagoka ime yekaonty ya Kisii.
english: Raila campaigned with Arati and Ongwae extensively Written by Zachary Mayieka on August 2, 2022 Supporters gathered in large numbers to support the Azimio La Umoja coalition led by Raila Odinga, and they held rallies throughout the Gusii region for several days. Notably, Raila greatly appreciates the people of Gusii, and he has assured them that he will address their concerns and work towards development, adding that unity is key for the progress of Kenya. Recently, Raila held a meeting where he encouraged supporters from various parts of Kisii County, urging them to continue supporting the governors of those counties, namely Simba Arati and James Ongwae, assuring them that his victory would bring significant benefits to those working for the Azimio coalition, leading to widespread celebration and joy among the people. These people have vowed to remain united and work tirelessly to ensure the success of the Azimio coalition in the upcoming elections in Kisii County.

ekegusii: Ekemeri giepaini ya Khasi (Pinus kesiya) korwa Asia nigo gekwama bwago mono, naende nkeri gotoka raisi isiko ya sobo. Emete nigo egoika chimita 30–35 ase obotambe n’amatina agoika emita eyemo ase obonetu. Kera egesabo ekebwate amagwa amato akobeta atato, kera erimo rire chisentimita 15 goika 20 ase abotambe. Amatunda korwa aekemeri eke nigo are chisentimita 5 goika 9 ne chintetereechire chisentimita 1,5 goika 2,5 ase abotambe. Ekemeri giepaini ya Khasi nigo okwama ase Himalayaa: Ase rogoro-mocha ya Boindi (amatuko aya asengencho y’okogesaemete ase egetunwa kia Khasi ns egetunwa kia Naga ase ensemo ya Meghaliay na Manipur, China (ase omochie Yunnan), Burma (ase omochie o Myanmar), Thailandi ya rorogo, Laos, Vietnam (ase emechie ya Lai Chau, Lang Son, Cao Bang, Quang Ninh), na Filipino (omochie o Luzon). Chipaini korwa ufilipino nigo kero kende chikorokwa n’erieta Pinus insularis. Ime ya China nabo okonyora egesaku kende gekorokwa Pinus yunnanensis. Emete y’egesaku eke nigo egotoka ase ebitiro n’emete emaio emiao ekwama ase riroba ribe ri’erengi embariri nabisicha ere n’echumbi iga ya 4.5 na azse aimogete igoro goika chimita 800–2000 rakini mono korwa chimiti 1200 goika 1400. Ase agatigati abwate amache naende are aomo ase omwaka. Embura ere enyinge n’omoika oetaneti 70%. Ekemeri eke nabo gekonyara koremereria obokendu, korende ekegosira bwanko ekero chigotwara amato. Korende ekero chihosimekwa, bokendu obo mbotakeiri nonye. Amarieta ande y’ekemeri eke nigo are Pinus khasya, Pinus khasyanus ««« Previous article: Riembe ria Kalimantan, Kasturi (Mangifera casturi) Next article: Welwitschia mirabilis - ogosimeka kw’e obotobu bomenyete »»»
english: The Khasi pine (Pinus kesiya) is native to Asia and grows well in mountainous areas, and it is also grown as a commercial tree. It can reach heights of 30–35 meters with a trunk diameter of about one meter. The bark is reddish-brown, thick, and scaly, while the needles are 15 to 20 centimeters long. The cones of this pine are 5 to 9 centimeters long and 1.5 to 2.5 centimeters wide. The Khasi pine is found in the Himalayas: from the foothills of Bhoondi (these forests are often mixed with Khasi and Naga pines in the states of Meghalaya and Manipur, China (especially Yunnan province), Burma (now Myanmar), Thailand, Laos, Vietnam (particularly Lai Chau, Lang Son, Cao Bang, and Quang Ninh provinces), and the Philippines (Luzon island). In the Philippines, it is sometimes confused with Pinus insularis. In China, it is also sometimes confused with Pinus yunnanensis. This tree thrives on slopes and hillsides, growing well in well-drained soils at altitudes between 4.5 and 2000 meters, most commonly between 1200 and 1400 meters. It prefers cool climates and grows best in areas with abundant rainfall. The wood has a moisture content of around 70%. This pine is also known for its resilience, being able to grow on poor soils. It is also relatively fast-growing, making it a valuable timber species. Other names for this pine include Pinus khasya and Pinus khasyanus. ««« Previous article: Kalimantan's Mangga, Kasturi (Mangifera casturi) Next article: Welwitschia mirabilis - a unique plant from the Namib desert »»»

ekegusii: ebunge ya Kisii komochora omonegeri Written by Zachary Mayieka on September 22, 2022 Dr Philip Nyanumba nere omonogeri omoyia bwebunge yekaonti ya Kisii. Nyanumba nigo anyora ekerogo ekio magega yogoakerwa chikura 47 nakobwatigwa na changanya nechikura 21. Ekerogo ekio nigo kiamereire amate nabarwanereri ao ao goika ikomi na bane. Boigo nigo bamca bonsi batianigwa rero erio gochaka emeremo yabo bene. Abamca 45 nabwo bachoretwe nabande 26 mbari bare nominated. Abwo ritang’ani konyora abariki amang’ana korwa ase orogongo rwa Gusii bemurunganeirie ogosiekererwa isiko korwa ase ogosoa ase amaagacho yebunge ye ekaonti eyio, ase omoyega bwo okobatiani abamca na boigo komochora omosipika bwe ekaunty eyio. Abariki abwo nigo barwa okoboria gochia ase oboteneneri bwekaonti gosika abariki amang’ana, naboigo kobaa obosibore bwo ogoikerania emeremo yabo. Nigo baganiri ekeombe kia Media Council of Kenya gotara gocha ase orogongo rwa Gusii erio kwegerera oboene bwa abararia.
english: The Kisii County Assembly has elected its speaker. Written by Zachary Mayieka on September 22, 2022 Dr Philip Nyanumba was elected speaker of the Kisii County Assembly. Nyanumba won the election in the fourth round after receiving 47 votes and defeating his competitor with 21 votes. This election was peaceful and contestants accepted the results and congratulated their opponents. Most of those present were happy and thanked God for enabling them to reach this far. 45 members voted while 26 others were nominated. They agreed to write a letter to the Gusii elders requesting them to organize a meeting to discuss issues concerning the county and also to advise the members and leadership on how to run the county effectively. The elders will be expected to provide guidance on matters relating to the county government and also offer advice on how to resolve conflicts. They discussed the issue with the Media Council of Kenya regarding the coverage of Gusii issues and the need to protect the rights of journalists.

ekegusii: Buna Twakabeire Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Engoromoni (July) 18, 2011. Aya amwabo aya: Oyo obibwate, nabo akororekanera aare. Nigo akogora kende gionsi atagete. Nigo akoagacha enyomba engiya. Nabo obonda bwaye bokororekana kobwatekana ne ebinto abwate. Ase boigo, oyore n' oboiseru, nabo nere akororekanera aare. Chianga chiamogoteire. Tabwati endagera eisaine. Abana tibari koragera baigota. Abagusii ba kare nigo batebete buna Omokungu omotakanwa mororere bweri. Bono gaki gose ninki eke bamineti? Inaboretie magokoro. Eee omosacha nare ase omochio 'yo. Nabo omogaka Omambia agitete obweri bwaye buya. Baba ominto nigo atebete buna omokungu omotakanwa nabo okomomanya ekero gwachire bwoye. Korwa aare, nabo okorora buna mosacha tari ase omochie oyio. Nigo okonyora omochi otarabiri. Mosacha taiyo okorabia obonyansi gose kogita chimbago. Komenta nayio, obweri bwe chiombe chiaye tibogitiri ekiagera tabwati mogaka ogokora aya onsi. Tari igo rioka. Nonya na abaamate ababe nigo bagosukia chimbago chiaye ase engencho atabwati omosacha oye. Baba nigo agoteba buna eee abasacha bande mbaroo batari korabia bonyansi, kogita chimbago, gose gokora kende gionsi ase chinka chiabo, korende omobayeno oyo nigo orwete omobwekano bwe enka etabwati omosacha pi. Buna baba agoteba, oboremeru, gose obonda bwo omonto nigo bokororekana ekagera Abagusii ba kare bagateba buna Omokungu omotakanwa mororere bweri. Omongina baba nao akorera abwo ase emebayeno yaito for today. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.
english: Good afternoon, my name is Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. July 18, 2011. These are the words: That which is hidden, they say it benefits the owner. When he remembers everything he understands. When he lowers himself to the ground. They also say that a wound heals when it touches water. Therefore, you who are wise, and you who are foolish, they say it benefits the owner. It is a very important thing. Don't despise a small beginning. Children should not be allowed to roam around aimlessly. The Abagusii people used to say that Omokungu, a skilled person, could easily accomplish something difficult. But what is this now, what time is it? It causes heartache. Oh, the youth today are like that. And the elder Omambia has revealed his secrets. The father of people also said that a skilled person can understand things quickly. Work hard, and don't say that the youth don't understand anything. It is about revealing knowledge that was previously unknown. The youth today are capable of doing all sorts of things skillfully. Comment on this, the secret of a drink is not revealed to someone who doesn't respect elders. There is no day it will happen. Also, those old men who are friends often reveal his secret because they don't respect the youth. The father said that oh, the youth nowadays are lazy and don't want to work, skillfully, everything they do is incomplete, and that young man is ruining the reputation of the youth entirely. But the father said, patience, everything that belongs to a person eventually comes to light. The ancient Abagusii people used to say that a skilled person can easily accomplish something difficult. My friend, let him do that for today. Goodbye and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Nyachae ase Bomachoge Omoraria George Williams Atandi korwa Egesa FM nigo aboria iga bono morogoba: "Bono naki torakore erinde Omogusii achiche aamo, erinde nario torarente amagenderero ime ya Gusii?" Ritangani, ntwe ase okorengereria igoro ye riborio eri, baminto tiga toinyore buna Abagusii ntwagatwarire abagaka abanene, barenge korokwa Etureti, abwo bakaruure obosemia ase ogokinia ebinyoro. Goika Twebange: Abamura ebisore bare ase emeroberio kobacha chigware aaria Tabaka, South Mugirango, Kisii County Abagaka aba abanene nigo bagachorire omogaka oyomo omonene ase emiaka, gotenenera Etureti eye. Bateneneri be etureti tibakabeire babere, ase Ekegusii. Eriakabere, inyora buna ase matuko amange, Gusii nigo yagatwarire ebirogo bio obominista goetania ekemo. Ebirogo bio oboassistant minister nigo biakabeire ebinge. Buna korwa kare, amasikani ne egento ekiya. Goika totware amasikani, gochia ase abagaka baito be ekegori ekenene Korende ase okoiraneria riborio eri, Omogaka John Sindiga korwa aaria Masige East, Bobasi in Kisii County nigo ateba buya. Nigo ateba iga: "Abagusii toise korigereria ase chinsemo chinde, abagaka abanene nigo batachete amagoro inse, na korwa obosemia ase abanto babo. Ase Abagusii, omogaka Simeon Nyachae still moyo are. Omogaka Nyachae nabwate obosemia obonge, obwo boratokonye, ntwe kitoramoike aange, na komoboria atwere emeroberio yaito amate." Ntwe onye totagete gokiina, ritangani goika totware amasikani gochia ase abagaka baito be ekegori ekenene. Eriakabere, goika togende ase abagaka aba baito abanene, koboria obosemia. Eriagatato, kitwairwe obosemia na abagaka aba, goika naintwe tokore buna bateeba. Ayio naro amasikani ye Ekegusii.
english: These are the things: Nyachae from Bomachoge George Williams Atandi of Egesa FM once said this important thing: "Is this truth that Omogusii's children are lost, and their traditions are disappearing from the land of Gusii?" Indeed, he said that if someone wants to understand the history well, people should not forget that the Abagusii have suffered greatly, they went through war in Ethiopia, and they overcame many challenges in their journey. Today's News: The elders of the area are meeting to discuss the issue of land in Tabaka, South Mugirango, Kisii County The great leaders have chosen a good day for the event, remembering Ethiopia. They remember those days of Ethiopia, which were difficult, in Ekegusii. Recently, because of many problems, Gusii has gained much respect and importance. Many assistant ministers have emerged. As time goes on, evenings come quickly. Today we will talk about the problem of the leaders, especially the prominent ones Therefore, regarding this matter, Leader John Sindiga from Masige East, Bobasi in Kisii County spoke. He said: "The Abagusii need to unite and work together, the great leaders need to show the way, and overcome the challenges facing their people. For the Abagusii, leader Simeon Nyachae is still alive. Leader Nyachae did a lot of good things, things that benefited everyone, and he showed us how to live and helped develop this region greatly." Because no one understands everything, indeed today we will talk about the problem of the leaders, especially the prominent ones. Recently, today we will look at the great leaders, to overcome the challenges. It is believed that the challenges will be overcome with the help of the leaders, and today we hope they will succeed. This is the story of the evening news of Ekegusii.

ekegusii: Na KSAX.Com. Esagati-Esagati Ya Magonga (October) 15, 2010 Aya Amwabo aya: E picture ya Justus Kebabe na marehemu Bilha Omare Omoiti Justus Kebabe osoereirwe igoro yo ogoita omokungu amo na abana baye. Nigo asoerwa na three counts of murder ase 2nd degree na Ramsey County District Attorney's Office ase rituko ria rero. Justus Ogendi Kebabe nigo asoerwa baada yo okobwatwa na abanyanyimbo ba Minnesota State Patrol ase rituko ria Tichi Gatato botuko ogotama korwa Twin Cities. Nigo abwatwa ogotama ase ebara ya Interstate 35 na Elko-New Market Omwana o Kebabe oyio ore emiaka 4 nigo anyorekanete egari ime ore buya. Emebere ya Bilha Omare amo na abana baye Kinley na Ivyn nigo yatoka ase e apartment yabo na abatuki ba Ramsey County Sheriff's office. Emebere eyio nigo yatoka ekero momura omwabo Kebabe abaakera esimi bagende gochekia ekiagera Kebabe nigo amoakerete esimi "okorera na goteba inga ingweita are". Buna abatuki banyorire, Justus Kebabe nabo arenge determined goita abanto baye korwa kare. Ase omotienyi bwe Egesunte (December), 2008, Bilha Omare nigo atebetie abatuki inga "Ime ya Kenya, Kebabe nigo arenge kongita impaka nagireka". Kobwatekana ne e ripoti ya abatuki ba Ramsey County Sherrif's Office, Kebabe nigo achwatete omorugi oye ne e golf club ase omotwe impaka akagireka. Tari igo rioka. Nigo atebetie abatuki abwo inga nigo atumiete electrical wire komongeta. Ase ogoita abana baye, omorogi Justus Kebabe nigo aburukanetie cranberry juice amo ne chindetere chia Tylenol PM pills akabaa bakanywa. Tachiete gokorera abwo. Omorogi Kebabe nigo asugumerete omwana oye omoiseke ne e pillow ya motu rogoro, agasinywa koeyana na gokwa. Ase ogokwanwa gwe ekina kiaye ase ekoti ime, the Ramsey County Superior Court Judge nigo abekera Kebabe ebondi ya $ 3 millioni.
english: On KSAX.Com. News-News Of Magonga (October) 15, 2010 These are the news: A picture of Justus Kebabe and the late Bilha Omare The family of Justus Kebabe is grieving over the loss of his wife and children. He is charged with three counts of second-degree murder by the Ramsey County District Attorney's Office during this difficult time. Justus Ogendi Kebabe was charged after being arrested by officers from the Minnesota State Patrol during the evening hours near the Twin Cities. He was arrested near the intersection of Interstate 35 and Elko-New Market Kebabe's child who is 4 years old has been found safe and sound. The bodies of Bilha Omare and her children Kinley and Ivyn were discovered at their apartment by deputies from the Ramsey County Sheriff's office. Those bodies were discovered shortly after the Kebabe family had gone to check on Kebabe who reportedly said “work and be happy like a lion”. According to police reports, Justus Kebabe is also suspected of trying to harm others in the area. In December 2008, Bilha Omare told police that “the Kenyan man, Kebabe is always threatening me and leaving.” According to a report by Ramsey County Sheriff's Office detectives, Kebabe was found with a rope and a golf club near where he left. It wasn't clear yet. He told police that he used an electrical wire to hang himself. Regarding his children, the husband Justus Kebabe consumed cranberry juice along with a large amount of Tylenol PM pills which they drank together. He attempted to do so. The husband Kebabe suffocated his young son with a dirty pillow, covering his face and mouth. During questioning about what happened at the scene, the Ramsey County Superior Court Judge set bail for Kebabe at $3 million.

ekegusii: Na PETRONILLAH OGOTI. Mwanyagetinge.com Proverbs And Customs Editor. Monunguno O Barema (February) 9, 2011. Aya amwabo aya: Gotebererani buna twakabeire. Amasangi ninki? Amasangi n'egento ekebe Amasangi ne erieta rigwatoka no bwororo korende neribe. Amasangi namange korende nimbatebie aya omon'gina ogosoka isiko ye enywomo na bahati mbaya orire omogaka oye. Mosubati tare gotindeka omogaka oye onye tarakorerana ekiagera nigo amasangi aya are gochagoita abagaka bonsi baregocha gosanga kemobere. Amasangi nabo arenge goita abasacha abange!! Bono omogaka oye konyora ataratindekwa goika Ekegusii kiabetereretwe gekorwe. Obosi nigo bware kwengwa, enyama yanyenywa, nyagosira osaragwa ekebende na mokaye omena amanyinga aya na koyamera, obosi bwabekwa okobogoko gwo okorio kwa nyagosira, omokungu oyo omena naende omanya koegwa enyama embese na koyemera bogara egere tacha goita abasacha bande. Nabo omokungu arabutore omosacha oye omogongo Omokungu ogosoka isiko ye enywomo tare kobwaterana kobutora enyama bare no omogaka oye ekiagera ekero akobutora enyama, omogongo bwo omogaka oye nigo ore kobutokana na omoerio otweka mo. Nabo igo omokungu bwa amasangi tagokuna monyaroka oye ogonkiri ekiagera amokune gose komoereria kende giosi nigo omonyaroka oye agotitiboka omogoko no omoerio otweka mo. Amaraba y enguko nigo arenge koburukanigwa Ekero omonto abwatirwe na amasangi eriogo ndiarenge aroro. Rirongo nigo riare korigigwa, na aya na amaraba are korusigwa riiko ensemo na kwengwa, aburukanigwa na amaraba ase amatabekania ye chinchera ibere chikoumerana aamo, na amaraba yo omonganyi bwe enguko aba eriogo ria amasangi!! Timanyeti gose rero Omogusii nabwateti ekemira eke korende amasangi naroo naende abekire abange embera ime.
english: To PETRONILLAH OGOTI. Mwanyagetinge.com Proverbs And Customs Editor. Monunguno O Barema (February) 9, 2011. These are the words: Let us discuss what we have found. What about customs? Customs are a good thing. Customs and a beautiful pot do not spoil because of bad luck or a poor person who has a bad omen and misfortune. A person should not despise a poor person who does not cooperate so that these customs may benefit all people and they can live together peacefully. Customs also help those who are suffering!! That person who is greedy should not be allowed to speak badly about Ekegusii lest it be destroyed. It is said that when someone is circumcised, meat is eaten, the intestines are removed from the abdomen and given to young men and women to eat, and then the circumcision is completed with respect for the intestines, and this gift is given so that they do not steal meat and eat it secretly. Also, the elder scolds the youth. The elder who respects tradition should not refuse to give meat to the person and the poor person who comes to ask for it; the pride of the poor person is born from their poverty. Also, if the elder of the customs does not hide his secrets, he will reveal them to everyone and they will spread everywhere, and his secrets will be exposed and his poverty will be known. The signs of leadership should not be hidden. When a person is helped by customs, they become strong. The rope is tied, and these signs are added to it and hidden, revealed by the signs of witchcraft which cause trouble, and the signs of the diviner are like the strength of customs!! Let us all know therefore that an Omogusii should not forget the traditions that our ancestors left us and continue to practice them.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Kai tata! Onde taiyo omochi' oyo? Ase engaki y' egiateko n' enchara, Abagusii nabo twarenge gotiga chiika chiato, twagenda aare, gosuma endagera. Amatuko amake aerire, omogaka sokoro ominto nigo antebetie buna nonya Abagusii twarenge abakongu ase oboremi n' obotugi ase amatuko amakoro, egiateko ngocha kiarenge, goikera enchara yaba. Nigo omogaka antebetie buna oboremeru bw' embura eyio yarenge kwamia endagera, nigo bwarenge kogera abanto bakora ebinto batarenge gocha gokora. Nabo abange barenge kogenda aare, erinde gosuma endagera. Komenta nayio, nonya n' oboibi nkomentekana bwarenge, ekero ki' egiateko. Ogotayaya nkwarengeo, ase amatuko ayio amakoro Buna omogaka sokoro agoteba, nabo yabete igo, ekero gie enchara yabete enene, n' abanto bagatayaya gochia aare kegima korigia endagera. Bono ayaiga kaba, Omogusii omokoro akamanya goteba buna Enda N'Embe, Yarusetie Ekeongo Igoro, Kegaika Nse. Ayie! Ekeonge kiagaika nse rero Bono Ekeongo ninki sokoro? Nche naboretie omogaka. Nigo sokoro antebetie buna Ekeongo n' enyoni eri yanchete koiruruka aaria amare igoro, korwa maambia echuni, goikera bwaira. Ekero ki' omobaso omotindi n' enchara, nario rioka enyoni eye egoika gochia nse, erinde nero nario eranyore gento ebeke mboto! Ase ogoteba omobayeno oyo, Abagusii nigo babwekanetie mwanyabanto buna Ekeongo, ekiagera enchara nero ekogera omonto otayaya gochia chinse chiaare, erinde nere gose nanyore endagera, takwa. Bono korora iga, Abagusii abakoro bagateba buna Enda N'Embe, Yarusetie Ekeongo Igoro, Kegaika Nse. Korwa ase omogaka sokoro ominto, oyo noro omobayeno oito for this week. Motware chingaki chingiya, and thank you for listening.
english: These are the words: Hey my friend! Where did the sun hide today? Because we have finished harvesting, the Gusii people also have gathered in their farms, we have traveled far, completing the task. The seeds have sprouted, the leader thinks about the people and remembers that the Gusii people have strong warriors who fear war and peace because of the good seeds, finishing well, making the farm beautiful. And the leader remembers that the rain which fell was enough to water the farms, and they have told the people to work hard so they don’t lack anything. And others have gone far, protecting the completion of the task. Comment on this, because even evil comments will be heard, just like finishing well. It is very important, because of those good seeds. When the leader thinks, and he has seen it, just like the farm has grown big, and the people rejoice going far to finish the task quickly. But these days, the great Gusii person knows when Enda N'Embe, Yarusetie Ekeongo Igoro, Kegaika Nse will come. Oh! Ekeongo comes now then. But what does Ekeongo mean? I asked the leader. He remembered that Ekeongo and the bird flew high in the sky during the evening, carrying messages everywhere, making noise. Just like the youth and the farm, it seems the bird flies coming now, protecting everything from being stolen! Because of the good news, the Gusii people agreed among themselves that Ekeongo would make the farm prosper and the people rejoice greatly, protecting everything until it is completed, truly. But repeat again, the old Gusii people remember Enda N'Embe, Yarusetie Ekeongo Igoro, Kegaika Nse. Carrying the thought of the leader about the people, this is good news for this week. Take this message, and thank you for listening.

ekegusii: chinkwana chiabakoonyi b’abakorigia ekerogo kioborai bwense gokoreka CUEA Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 19, 2022 Chinkwana chieyemo ase eyemo egati ya abakonyi babakorigia ekerogo kioborai bwense, nigo giakoregete Jumanne ase Euniversity ya Catholic University of Eastern Africa ime yomochie o Nairobi. Omokonyi bwoyokorigia ekerogo kioborai bwense goetera ekiama kia Roots Party George Wajakoya,omosubati Justine Wangui,nigo aboririe abakenya koigora amaiso abo amo na amongo , erio gochaka gosimeka enyasore na koenyorera eng’eria engiya mono, korende eng’ana yagikeriwe mono nomokonyi oye David Mwaure bwekiama kia Agano, omosubati Ruth Musheru. Chingaki echio,omokonyi bwoyokorigia ekerogo kioborai bwense William Ruto,Rigathi Gachawa nigo amogikeria omokonyi oye Raila Odinga omosubati Martha Karua, ase okomotebi buna taisaini koba mokonyi bwomorai bwense ase abisi ende yonsi ekiagera nigo atamete korwa abisi yomora mwai kibaki na komotiga ase omosunte
english: The story of candidates vying for the presidency was reported extensively by various media outlets. Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 19, 2022 The story details how candidates vying for the presidency were covered extensively by various media outlets, and it was highlighted on Tuesday at the Catholic University of Eastern Africa located in Nairobi. Candidates vying for the presidency were drawn from the Roots Party led by George Wajakoya, deputy Justine Wangui, and they attracted Kenyans who focused their eyes and ears on them, causing a lot of discussion and analysis, and the candidate representing David Mwaure of the Agano party, deputy Ruth Musheru. In addition, candidates vying for the presidency William Ruto, Rigathi Gachagua faced off against candidates Raila Odinga and Martha Karua, and although they signed an agreement to ensure peace during the election and throughout the process, they failed to fulfill promises made previously by Kibaki and continued to engage in conflict.

ekegusii: Petronillah Ogoti, Gusii.com. Engatiato [January] 12, 2016. Aya amwabo aya: Amatimbo nabo agachiete agachaka gosaria chibao chi' ekerama ki' enyomba y' omogaka sokoro omogaka Ombongi. Korora iga, omogaka okare goteba buna Rero Ndero Itimbo Riegonkire. Bono ninki eng'encho y' omorabaro oyo? Ritang'ani, omogaka sokoro nigo antebetie buna ritimbo nigo rigokora kende gionsi n' omokia omonene. Nonya rire risiniini, nabo rikobochora omote omokung'u pa pa na kobeka engoro enene, naende entambe. Engoro eye etaraba, nigo rigokwerekerera, goikera riikie ekerengo ki' engoro eyio ritagete. Gotimoka tikoiyo, goikera engoro eye yaikeranire buna ritagete. Bono nabo ritimbo rirasarerigwe emeroberio yaye. Nabo embura erachake gotwa, ari ase riakunyire egekamago. Emeroberio yaye yamanya gosareka. Ase boigo, nabo omonyene enyomba eye arayeake erangi, na gosaria emeroberio y' ritimbo eri gose ariaake na koriita rikwe !! Mwanyagetinge ominto nigo arenge gokwanera omorabaro oyo ase ogweitia ekero ebinto ebibe biabeire. Simbiri nyamoibi oyio !! Nabo korabe ogweitia gose okonyorwa n' aya otakagerete. Buna nabo oragende mogondo, na gosimeka endagera yao buya. Chibando chimanye kobereka bibere bibere gose bitato bitato. Koru igabwo, oganye rigesa rigiya korende ekero rigesa riaikire, tata omoibi egiata agende mogondo kwao, aibe endagera yago yonsi pi !! Bono simbiri nyamoibi oyo ekero akoibeire koru aaaria ase gwasemereti, kwamanya gotigara bosa. Ase enchera ende, aye ritimbo tobwati ase ogosemeria gochi ekiagera emeroberio yao yasariigwe. Emeroberie eri yao emiya nabo egosareka. Nabo Matiebo agosaria kera egento Koru ase omogaka Ombong'i ominto, oyo noro omobayeno oito for this week. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.
english: Petronillah Ogoti, Gusii.com. Published [January] 12, 2016. These are the words: The elders and their children who gathered together were discussing a matter concerning the son of Omogaka Sokoro, Omogaka Ombongi. Return again, the son will tell you about Rero Ndero Itimbo Riegonkire. What is this gathering about? Listen, the son says that the story will spread throughout the land and reach many people. Yesterday morning, they brought a black goat and slaughtered it, and there was celebration. That goat which was sacrificed, it was very beautiful, resembling a young goat with a large horn. Remember well, resemble that goat so it doesn’t get lost. What if the story is forgotten over time? And when the rain came, it fell heavily, like a flood. Over time, she understood everything. But truly, the woman whose house burned down, and because of the story of the story, everyone has been angered and cursed !! You people should be enough with this gathering, those who know things should speak truthfully. This is a very important message !! And investigate thoroughly what is happening with those who haven’t understood. And let them prepare their belongings to leave. Let everyone show clearly all the small details. Hurry now, find a good path to follow, don’t wander aimlessly, let that foolish person return home quickly, taking all his possessions with him !! This is a very important message, so let it be known to anyone who wants to understand, knowing that it will be difficult. But encourage each other, let the story be completed so that her history is remembered. Her history is also important. And Matiebo was discussing something earlier. ekegusii: raria matiang’i buna nachie gotigara obowaziri buna abande barariigwe; abasomu ba Gusii babooririe Raila Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 11, 2022 Ekeombe kiabanto abasomu gose professionals baaboririe abarai korwa Gusii baria bakonya koba ebigocha ase omorai o Azimio Raila Odinga korwa komochoora Matiang’I buna omowaziri bwoborendi ase eserekali yaye, gotiga rimo rioka. Bakorau na Omowakili Danstan Omari amo noyokorigia ekerogo kia obojumbe West Mogirango Stephene Mogaka, nigo batebire mbamaete abasani ba Raila nabange bare ase orogongo rwa Gusii korende tiga batige Matiang’I aenekerigwe ekerogo ekio ribaga riokonyagokaania Raila. Nigo boigo bairete ribaga erio kogikeria aria aba ase egetii kia Gusii ase omosangererekano o Martha Karua aturubanetigwe. Baganirie Karua koroberia boyia esbari yaaye Kisii ase keria eyuo teri embwa yomogusii Stephene Mogaka nigo akoboria ekerogo kiobojumbe bwa West Mogirango ase abasabire abanto bensemo eyuo komobwatesia koreta amaonchorerio. ase keria orogongo orwo ase engaki bono, rwatigarire maega.
english: Rarely did Matiang'i realize that people would support him so much; Gusii people have chosen Raila Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 11, 2022 Prominent leaders and professionals have supported the development of the Gusii community because they fear the consequences of supporting Azimio Raila Odinga and Interior Minister Fred Matiang'i, which has caused a lot of division. They met with lawyer Danstan Omari and also spoke with West Mugirango MP Stephene Mogaka, and they agreed to help Raila's supporters because they believe that Matiang'i was unfairly targeted in that matter concerning Raila. They said that this issue should be addressed by those from the Gusii region and the election of Martha Karua should be celebrated. They praised Karua for visiting her home in Kisii and saying that there is no dog belonging to the Gusii people. Stephene Mogaka spoke about the constituency of West Mugirango and asked people to stop spreading false information. He said that this problem and its effects will be resolved soon.

ekegusii: Tiga gotokongeria ebinto "Imobwate Ekegusii-English Dictionary?" Nyamusi ominto. Abwo aroro nigo gwacha. Nigo omineti ritabu riria rineene ase abanto bakorigia amarieta? Intwe yaya. Titobwati e dictionary. Eyaki? Intwe nigo tokorika buna tweigwete. Goaka inse na kogororoka. Ekero totagete komanya erieta rinde rionsi rie Ekegusii riatosinyire, nigo togochwatera magokoro omongina Saringi esimi. Onye baba Saringi taiyo, nigo togoakera sokoro Nyankuru korwa bomame esimi. Abwo bakobora, nigo togoakera abagisangio baito esimi. Abagisangio bari twachiete iburu nabwo. Onye abagisangio bagotongaina na gototebia ukora, basi nigo togodiliti amarieta ayio. "Timokoroisia e dictionaty ye Ekegusii rende?" Mwana ominto. Nomanyete inga edigrii entangani nigo yatoirete emiaka 12? Yaani igo nigo otagete abanto baito baganye e dictionary ase emiaka 40? Intwe intomanyete oboremerwa bwaito. Intori bangaini moono buna aye okagerete. Yaya. Mangana a dictionary intoiyo. Eyio ne egasi ya abande. Intwe egasi yaito no okorika tu. Onye amagoso kare aroro, bahati mbaya. Intwe imotwe torigereretie. Inaki mogochekia spelling ero rende?" Baba Nyamusi. Naye tokabwati amangana? Nayio onsi nigo otagete komanya? Baminto. Rakini intwaboretie Bill Gates korwa Microsoft atobekere Spellcheck ye Ekegusii. Nomanyete inaki atebete? "Onye mokona korika chiwebu saiti ne ebimenu ebio biaino onde atari koigwa, you are on your own". Tari igo rioka. Bill nigo atebete inga, "No spellcheck for you". Oigwe bono Nyamusi ominto. Ekio nakio kegerete amagoso amange a spelling are ase ewebu saiti eye. Kanywe mache maya mwana ominto. Aya amwabo aya:

The father of Saringi was wise, so he didn't forget to teach his children the language. Those people, they don't teach their children the language. Those children have ruined everything because of it. Someone who doesn't support education, they don't value money. "Are we learning the Ekegusii dictionary now?" A child asked. Do you know that a degree from college takes about 12 years? Why hasn't someone taught people how to use the dictionary for 40 years? It's unbelievable how foolish we are. Because they gain nothing from it. Yes. Find me a dictionary quickly. This one is the wealth of the community. It seems this wealth won't last. Someone whose heart is bad, misfortune. This head is not right. Why are you questioning the spelling of this thing?" Father Nyamusi. But don't you understand? Maybe you don't understand? People. Imagine if someone like Bill Gates from Microsoft created a Spellcheck for Ekegusii. Do you know what he would say? "Someone who types websites and menus that aren't correct and makes mistakes, you are on your own." That's what it means. Bill said, "No spellcheck for you". That's why Nyamusi asked. ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Onde taiyo orenge kobibeka ase ense engima Omongina baba magokoro ominto nabwate eng'ana. Nigo ere eng'ana enke, ko n' endito. Nigo omongina baba agoteba buna gesaku kende nkeiyo ase ense eng'ima kiare kobibeka. Eee bono. Ebitinge. Ogotimigwa (okobekerwa) ebitinge nigo kiarenge egento gesaku kende gionsi ase ense engima getare gokora, otatiga Abagusii. Mwamogusii bweka, naende bene, nere okabekire gose gotimigwa ebitinge. Omosubati Omogusii nigo arenge gotimigwa egetinge ekero are gosoka gochia bwoye, na gokorerwa enyangi y' bitinge. Abana ba Mwanyagetinge babekire emeyabo. Kemunto, Kerubo, Moraa amo na Kwamboka nao bare ase omoyega bwe enyangi. On the far right, omongina bwe esiko ase ekenyoro, omosubati kwamboka otimigwe ebitinge. Picture na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com files. Ase boigo, nigo baba agoteba buna omoiseke orenge kobibekerwa nigo arenge omosubati bw'e esiko ase ekenyoro. Esiko eng'ana buna ki? Nigo yarenge esiko enene, mbaka omoiseke obibekeirwe nigo arenge gochora erieta ri' okwebaka! Amarieta y' ebitinge nigo are ane oka! Komenta nayio, nigo omongina baba agoteba buna abasubati ba Gusii nigo barenge kwebaka amarieta ane oka, ko batimigwe ebitinge. Kobwatekana na magokoro, amarieta ayio ane omoriakari o Gusii arenge kwebaka nigo are: Kemunto, Kerubo, Moraa amo na Kwamboka. Egetinge nigo kiare kobekwa magoro, ase egeting'iro korwa igoro, asiniiini. Erieta Egetinge ndibwate omoreng'anio, "Tinga". Eng'encho ende, omosubati nigo areng'e goting'wa kogoro (obwatanigwa). Bono oyo okobekerwa (ogotimigwa) egetinge orokwa Nyagetinge, erinde egesaku eke nakio Mwanyagetinge. Omongina baba nabo ateba buna bwatera abwo bono, ase okwegera ase twarwete. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening. Embarambamba iko juu sana. Mwanyagetinge amo n' omwana omino, Nyang'wara Mosioma eyio.
english: These are the words: When the sun rises beautifully, it reveals a mystery. The elders and fathers have hearts that understand little. It is a small thing, and not much. The elders and fathers remember well those days of old, revealing a mystery beautifully. Yes, truly. Traditions. Customs (preserved) traditions are beautiful and important to all people, especially the Gusii. My fellow Gusii people, let us cherish and protect these customs and traditions. The Gusii tradition is beautiful and strong, able to solve problems and be respected by generations. The children of Mwanyagetinge should respect their heritage. Kemunto, Kerubo, Moraa and Kwamboka also honor our traditions. On the far right, the elder shows respect during a ceremony, the tradition Kwamboka preserves traditions. Picture with Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com files. Therefore, the fathers remember that preserving something beautifully is a strong tradition. What kind of tradition is this? It is a great tradition, so that when something is preserved, it can bring about positive change! The wealth of traditions is very significant! Comment on this, the elders remember that the Gusii people can achieve great wealth, but they must preserve traditions. Connected to the heart, this wealth which is important to the Gusii can be achieved through: Kemunto, Kerubo, Moraa and Kwamboka. Traditions are beautifully preserved, and the initiation process is done carefully, meticulously. This Egetinge tradition teaches responsibility, “Responsibility.” Furthermore, the tradition is strengthened through unity (collaboration). This tradition (customs) of Egetinge originates from Nyagetinge, extending to the present day Mwanyagetinge. The elders also say that we should embrace this truth, and strive for progress. Thank you very much for listening. Embarambamba is very high up. Mwanyagetinge and his family, Nyang'wara Mosioma too.

ekegusii: obokoreri obobe nyamira,abamenyi kwemurungania Written by Hyline Major on February 21, 2022 Abamenyi ase ekaunti ya Nyamira nigo bagikerie obokoreri obobe ase ekaunti eyio Gokwana ime ya Bonyunyu eward ya Kiabonyoru nigo batebire buna abarai bachorete mbanya gokora kende gekororekana ase batebire buna nonya imbari barikire ase chiestate echio chire ime ya Borabu na North Mugirango mbanya gokonyeka nachio egekogera abamenyi borogongo orwo imbari koegwa ribaga ritang’ana ase abana babo korikwa Nigo boigo bemurunganeiri ogochandwa amor nechikampani chiestate yechae ase ensemo eyio ase batebire buna nigop abaa bachiete chisukuru bagasomka ase ensemo eyio korende mbanaya korigerererigwa nonya Nigo boigo batebire igoro yechimashine echio chiarentetwe ase estate eyio ase abange abwo bare gotora echae basiretie emeremo yabo engana eyio nigo boigo bagikeirie noyokorigia ekerogo kiobogavana Nyamira James Kemoni ase atebire buna nere buya chikampani echio chirusie ebiita ebio bibekire egatagati yechiestate echio erio korwa ribaga ase abamenyi goeta aroro buna yakabeire agwo ritang’ani
english: They have visited Nyamira county, those who know how to manage. Written by Hyline Major on February 21, 2022 Those who know the Nyamira county account are the ones who went to visit that county. The people of Bonyunyu ward of Kiabonyoru constituency went and found that the parents were working hard to cultivate so that they could work together and also ensure that the children get education in Borabu and North Mugirango constituencies so that they can benefit from what they learn from the knowledgeable people and their families are supported. So they managed to convene a meeting with the company's management and about that and they found out that some children dropped out of school and continued to engage in activities and they were encouraged to return to school. ekegusii: Emebayeno Ya Abagusii: Ng'ombe Na Mbori Chikane Korigia Magega Yaya, Korera Tarera Boreri Bobe, Bwoye Tagochongeria Mobere Osinye Bikoe !! Tokare kogenda ase enyangi ya Buyaki aaria Kegogi, Bosamaro, Omongina magokoro baba ominto nantebetie buna Ng'ombe Na Mbori Chikane Korigia Magega Yaya, Korera Tarera Boreri Bobe, Bwoye Tagochongeria Mobere Osinye Bikoe. Bono ninki eng'encho y' omorabaro oyo ase ntwe Abagusii? Aaiga, aya nigo arenge gokwanerwa ekero omoiseke arenge gosoka na kogenda bwoye. Ekero omoiseke arenge kogenda bwoye, nigo arenge gotebigwa aremereri komenya abwo ase enka yaye enyia, naende tabaisa konya kong'anyang'anya. Ase enchera ende, nigo ere buya amanye buna akomenya. Konara kong'anya korwa bwoye, tikiarenge gento kiya Amangana aya nigo aregotebigwa ekero ki'enyangi yaye, na ng'ina omoiborete. Onye ochire bwoye teri buya arigie magega, ekiagera chimbori amo ne chiombe chiaakanirwe. Bono tagwenereti kong'anya korwa bwoye. Okomenya okuya nigo gokogokia ng'ina biara na koorokia buna ng'ina omoibori mbuya amorerete. Na ngina biara nere nigo arenge gotebigwa buna takongeria moka momura obogima Ase boigo, ng'ina biara omoiseke nere ngotenbigwa arenge buna takong'eria omosubati oyo obogima erinde asinywe komenya ase enka eye enyia. Omosubati, ekero agochongerigwa, nigo agoichana, goikera oita ebikoe ekiagera nigo agosinywa buna ense eye achiete naki ere gose. Nka sobo Buyaki aaria Keumbu, Kisii County. Komenya n' omorembe n' egento ekiya. Chikorera nigo chiarenge koborigwa buna tichikongeria moka momura obogima. Obosemia obo bwarenge korwegwa gochia ase omoikeke na ng'ina biara ekero ki enyangi, nabio biagerete Abagusii abakoro bagateba buna Ng'ombe Na Mbori Chikane Korigia Magega Yaya, Korera Tarera Boreri Bobe, Bwoye Tagochongeria Mobere Osinye Bikoe. Oyo noro omobayeno oito ase ewiki eye. Mbuya mono and thank you for listening. Aya amwabo aya:
english: The History of the Gusii People: Cattle and Small Livestock are a Blessing, They Strengthen the Knees of Children, They Provide Food for the Poor, They Bring Joy to the Home!! It is said that in ancient times during the time of Buyaki, they migrated from Kegogi, Bosamaro, Omongina with heavy hearts, but cattle and small livestock remained a blessing, providing food for the poor, bringing joy to the home. Why does this tradition of wealth persist among the Gusii people? Perhaps, this is because it is considered important to have enough resources to avoid poverty and hardship. Having enough resources to avoid poverty and hardship is considered a sign of respect and honor, and prevents unnecessary wandering. But also, it is good to remember that having resources can bring about challenges. To prevent disputes over property, let us maintain peace. These matters are being discussed according to their traditions, and with great wisdom. Anyone who forgets them will not be able to stand on their feet, and their house will collapse like a termite mound. It is not right to cause disputes over property. True wealth lies in unity and cooperation so that everyone benefits. And those who lack resources are often seen as vulnerable and unable to sustain life. But sometimes, those who have little are respected more than those who possess abundant wealth. Wealth, when misused, can lead to arrogance and disrespect, causing problems and ultimately leading to its downfall. I come from Buyaki in Keumbu, Kisii County. Respect and humility are my guiding principles. The community should strive to ensure that no one suffers due to lack of basic necessities. This message is intended to reach those who understand and appreciate our traditions, and to remind the older generation of the Gusii people about the importance of cattle and small livestock as a blessing, providing food for the poor, bringing joy to the home. That is the end of this story today. Thank you for listening. These are the conclusions:

ekegusii: Abarisia Bobasi koemurunganeria okorusigwa abisi kwa Bichang’a Written by RadioVuna on June 15, 2020 Ensemo yabarisia bekanisa yege adventista korwa Bobasi bagikeirie enchera omo president bwensemo ya SOUTH Kenya ase chikanisa chiege adventista Dr Julius Bichanga bwango iga arusigwa abisi Gokwana nabariki amang’ana, abarai abwo nigo batebete ekerenga nkereo kiabobisi kiairera Bichanga goakwa isiko chingaki obochori bwe conference boberete ang’e(Bobasi) Bagokwana ime ya OGEMBO, abarisia abwo korwa chi kanisa ao ao ase e sub-county eyio nigo batebete abarai abange korwa ensemo eyio babeire bagotwara ebitari ase e conference nigo babeire bakorusigwa abisi ase obotutukanu(Koonera omobasi) Nigo baganirie oboteneneri bwekanisa eyio korigia chinchera chiokobagorora abarai baye anene abarandia rika riokobabuta Nigo boigo bagosereirie gochia koraa chikanisa korwa BObasi kwerusia ase e conference eyio ase banaganirie omorandia oyio amang’ana aye arigererigwe ase omroebrio Abarai abwo nigo baganirie baria bare abisi kwerita korwa siasa yoborai anene chingaki echi Kenya egendererete kominana na CORONA(Prayer)
english: The residents of Bobasi are mourning the death of Mr. Bichang'a Written by RadioVuna on June 15, 2020 The leaders have praised the Adventist church members of Bobasi for electing their leader, the President of South Kenya Adventist Church, Dr. Julius Bichanga, whose term has ended We thank God, those people have participated greatly in supporting the work of Pastor Bichanga throughout his leadership during the conference period (Bobasi) Those from OGEMBO division, the leaders of that church and also from that sub-county have participated greatly in supporting the work of that meeting so that they can take care of things at the conference level and be appointed accordingly (Looking at Bobasi) They discussed the challenges facing that church regarding the issue of restoring those who left and returning them Therefore, they agreed to continue working with the church in Bobasi to cooperate with the conference and discuss this matter further Those people also discussed how they will assist in the government's efforts to combat the disease affecting Kenya and related to CORONA (Prayer)

Ani Bwanchi Mbwa Maiso, Mioyo Etamanyaini" Egioto Ekemo Korwa Aaria Nyabitunwa Bine Aya amwabo aya: Abwo kare kare ebioto mbiarenge aroro aaria Nyabitunwa Bine. Ebioto ebi nigo biarenge goeta ase emete emenge yarenge. Kibigedererete goeta, ebioto ebi bibere bikagwa ime ye engoro yarenge etambe. Amaridadi ya amaiso: Gusii.com at home aaria Nyabitunwa Bine, South Mugirango, Kisii County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 Bono ebioto binde ekero biachiete korora ebi biamwabo bibere bigwete engoro ime bikabisekerera na kobitebia buna mbigosoka korwa engoro eyio ime bire moyo. Aaiga nario ebioto ebi bibere biekorete buna mbigweti aya yokobisekereria na gotema buna biare konyara erinde birwe engoro eye ime. Ebioto ebi biagwete engoro ime mbiakwete moyo, ekiagera nigo bierwete kerage, gosoka korwa engoro eye yarenge etambe mono. Egioto ekemo gekarosa na goaka inse na gokwa, abuo abuo. Egioto keri giatigarete engoro ime kegatema gocharoka gose ngesoke korwa engoro eye ime, korende gekaba kegosinywa. Erio erio, ebioto biri binde nigo biare goseka na goita egioto kiamwabo omoyo, bigoteba buna egioto ekio nagetiga gwechanda ekiagera ngokwera kere engoro eye ime. Bono ebioto ebi biamwabo, biagokire buna egioto eke tikiaigwete buna biagetakerete amabe !! Bono egioto eke kegatema igo, goikera kegasoka korwa engoro eye ime. Biri binde kibiachia korora aya bikamoboria buna gose nkoigwa arenge buna biare gokwana. Egioto eke gekabatebia buna ime y' engoro eyio ime, nigo amato atinete !! Ebioto ebio bikagoka buna taigwete buna biamotakerete amabe. Egioto eke korwa erio, gekamanya buna Bwanchi Mbwa Maiso, Mioyo Etamanyaini.
english: The Story of the Gusii People LXXXI: "Oh!! These White Dogs Are Crazy, Their Hearts Are Full of Pride" This story is about the events of the past concerning the people of Nyabitunwa Bine. These days are like this: Long ago, the people lived peacefully among the people of Nyabitunwa Bine. The people who were there used to live happily and peacefully. They would gather together, and the people would fall asleep in the shade of trees and wander around. Details of the eyes: Gusii.com at home among the people of Nyabitunwa Bine, South Mugirango, Kisii County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014 Some people say that those things happened because of the things they did, which caused them to fall asleep in the shade and wake up confused and unable to understand what was happening. Others say that those things happened because of their actions, which led to confusion and trouble, causing them to suffer greatly. The people who fell asleep in the shade had no life, and it seemed as though they were being punished, leading to suffering and wandering around. This story is full of sadness and pain, back and forth. This story is carefully crafted to reveal the truth and expose the secrets, so that it can be understood. Every now and then, the people remember the events of the past and try to understand this story, hoping to find peace in the shade. Some of the stories that have been told, are said to be untrue and fabricated, causing great anger!! Some of this story, if revealed, will lead to suffering and hardship. Some people believe that it is better to remain silent than to speak out, fearing that it will cause more harm. This story has been hidden for a long time, and its details are shocking!! The people who reveal it will face consequences and suffer greatly. This story is very important, knowing that White Dogs Are Crazy, Their Hearts Are Full of Pride.

ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Ase Mwanyagetinge abeta ase chintanda chionsi: Merry Christmas 2012! ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya: Onye gokagete inga Kenya nigo ebwate too many constituencies, we are getting more. Intoche toegwe 80 new constituencies kobwatekana ne Ekatiba enyia. Eee chikonstichwensi echio ne chinyinge rakini Ekatiba eye twaetia nabo egoteba inga we have to create more. Gati ye chikonstichwensi echio 80, Gusii neche enyore ibere, kobwatekana ne engana korwa ase e Standard. Kobwatekana na aya twaigure, only two constituencies in Gusii chigocha go benefit korwa ase okobutoranwa okwo. Kiabeire inga chikonstichwensi echio chigocha kobutoranwa nigo chire North Mugirango Borabu amo na Kitutu Chache. Yaani how did the Interim Independent Boundaries Commission (IIBRC) yaikerete enamba eyio ase Gusii? Obotaalamu ki batumiete? Intwe intomanyeti amange. who are we to know? Rakini nigo toroche inga nigo batumiete enamba ya abaaki chikura per constichwensi. Ase okobwatia chinamba chia registered voters korwa ase omwaka o 2007, North Mugirango/Borabu amo na Kitutu Chache nachio chibwate the most voters buna ekobwatia: Bono what does this mean as 2012? Oboke imboreo. Oboke no obonge especially ase abasubati baria batagete koboria chikura. Korwa North Mugirango Borabu, ribaga indiroo onye omongina Wilkista Onsando otagete koboria obojumbe. Omongina Onsando nigo amenyete ase ensemo ya Borabu. North Mugirango Borabu eise kobutorwa ebe North Mugirango na Borabu, there is a good chance inga omongina Wilkista nabo araborie chikura korwa Borabu. Kitutu Chache rende? Ase Kitutu Chache, there is a possibility inga Dr. Jane Onsongo korwa KACC nabo araborie obojumbe. Tari obobunge bwoka bore available. Egasi yo Oboseneta nero korwa Gusii is wide open. In addition ya abagaka abange baraborie ekerogo ekio, abasubati bande baratware interest nigo bare The Chairman of Nyansiongo Tea Factory, Mayor Claire Omanga amo na ODM Chief Executive Officer, omosubati Janet Ong'era. Ase igo? Abasubati ba Gusii imokerera igoro. This is the best chance indoche mobwate for 2012. Timotiga echiere inse.
english: These are the issues: The person who drew the boundaries in Kenya really created too many constituencies, we are getting more. It seems 80 new constituencies will be included in the current constitution. Indeed those constituencies and the changes to the constitution we made say that we have to create more. With those 80 constituencies, Gusii has very few, included in the report in the Standard. Included in what we saw, only two constituencies in Gusii will benefit from that review. These constituencies that will benefit include North Mugirango Borabu and Kitutu Chache. So how did the Interim Independent Boundaries Commission (IIBRC) allocate those numbers to Gusii? Perhaps they were compromised? We don't know. The reason is that they allocated numbers to people exceeding per constituency. Based on the number of registered voters from 2007, North Mugirango/Borabu and Kitutu Chache had the most voters thus deserving: So what does this mean for 2012? It is concerning. It is bad especially for our people who want to vote more. In North Mugirango Borabu, people are saying the MP Wilkista Onsando wants to retain his seat. MP Onsando is popular in Borabu. North Mugirango Borabu was divided into North Mugirango and Borabu, there is a good chance that MP Wilkista will also win in Borabu. What about Kitutu Chache? In Kitutu Chache, there is a possibility that Dr. Jane Onsongo from KACC will also win the seat. There are several candidates available. Also the Senate seat for Gusii is wide open. In addition to those candidates, people are showing interest including The Chairman of Nyansiongo Tea Factory, Mayor Claire Omanga and ODM Chief Executive Officer, businesswoman Janet Ong'era. What now? The people of Gusii are waiting eagerly. This is the best opportunity for us to get things done for 2012. Let us seize this moment.

Aaiga, ritangani, sokoro nigo antebetie buna omogano bw' omorabaro yo nore aroro. Nigo sokoro antebetie buna abwo kare kare, omogaka gete narengeo orenge korokwa Maeba. Bono omogaka oyo nigo amanyekanete koba omuya ase ekenyoro kiaye, naende nigo arenge omogaka bw' amasikani ase eng'encho arenge korwa obokonyi bonde bwensi gocha ase ekenyoro eke kiaye. Ase boigo, omogaka oyo nigo ekiage kiaye giachire kera engaki, naende endagera tiyarenge kobora ase enka yaye. Omogaka Maeba nigo achiete nguma Bono Maeba nigo anchete korageria na koa abaamate baye ebinyugwa. Abaamate baye ekero baigotire, nigo barenge komotera n' omoino bakomotogia, ase eng'encho onde taiyo orenge kobakonya na kobarageria buna Maeba. ekegusii: Description Enyangi y’Omogusii nigo yarenge n’engencho enene ase abamura na abaiseke amo ne’chiamate chiabo. Enywomo nero yarenge egetambokero ase omomura n’omoiseke korua ase amaboko abaibori babo na gochaka koagacha omochie obo. Engaki eyuo, enywomo tiyare koba onye enyangi teraba. Engaki ya kare ase Gusii, omosubati obegete ebitinge nigo are koegwa amasikani amanene kegima, ekiagera oyuo ’ng’ina ’monto (‘banto) okoagacha egesaku. Yare gotoka buna oirerwe kare nchera, nigo are gokobwa goika mwaye, koenekia buna oikire buya. Egetabu eke nigo kebwate obosemia obuya kegima ase engaki ya rero; obo obosemia obonene bw’okoagacha emechie, mono kobwatekana buna ense yaonchokire ekero abange batari korora buna enywomo n’egento ki’engencho enene buna egwenerete.
english: Description The language of the Gusii people is rich and has a large vocabulary used by both elders and children, including various names. The home is also rich in traditions passed down from parents and grandparents to their children and grandchildren, which are carefully preserved over time. In ancient times, the home was not like what it is today. In the past of the Gusii people, skilled craftsmen and builders built houses with their own hands and decorated them beautifully. These stories tell us about the history of the Gusii people; these stories of old are told during important ceremonies, which bring joy and unity ('people') together and create a sense of community. It happened that when someone died, they were mourned greatly, and songs were sung to comfort them, hoping they would return. This custom still exists today in relation to the stories of the past; this great tradition continues to be practiced, so that future generations can learn and understand the importance of maintaining our culture and heritage.

ekegusii: Uhuru tabwateraniri na gokong’a kwobogima ime yense; Col (rtd) Cyrus Oguna Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 6, 2022 Omonogeri bwe eserekali Cyrus Oguna otebire omorai bwense Uhuru Kenyatta tabwenereti gotamerwa ase ogokina kwa amagori yebinto ime yense ya Kenya Gokwana ne egetaseni ekemo kioboraria , Oguna nigo aenekia buna ogokina kwa amagori nomochando obwateraneti chinse chinyinge aseigo mochando oywo tori o’ Kenya gose Uhuru. Nigo Oguna amentire goteba buna Uhuru Kenyatta tabwati kobua konde gwensi ase chisegi chigendererete gati yense ya Russia na Ukraine eyu egerete anene mono ase ogokina kwobogima bwa abakenya. Boigo nairaneria amang’ana yoomokonyi bwomorai bwense omosike William Ruto ase atebete buna ogokwanania gati yomorai bwense omosike Uhuru na Raila odinga okwo komanyekanete buna handshake omwaka bwe chiribu ibere na ikomi na isano na isato (2018), nenchera eyemo esegetete ogokina kwamagori yebinto ime yense ya Kenya. Obaboririe abanasiasa batige gotumeka amang’ana buna aywo atabwati bokeene bonde bwensi ase okogania kwemanyekani . Boigo naenekia buna koru abarai abwo babere bakwanani, omorembe na amagenderero arorekanire.
english: Uhuru has been communicating with the government throughout the entire period; Col (rtd) Cyrus Oguna Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 6, 2022 The spokesperson, Cyrus Oguna, stated that President Uhuru Kenyatta should not be allowed to continue interfering with the affairs of the entire country of Kenya According to reports from various media outlets, Oguna explained that interference with the affairs and continuous communication secretly causes more harm than good to Kenya under Uhuru. He further stated that Uhuru Kenyatta does not want to take responsibility for his actions regarding the ongoing war between Russia and Ukraine which has caused great suffering to the people of Kenya. They are now discussing the differences between Deputy President William Ruto and the allegations that the relationship between President Uhuru and Raila Odinga which was established through a handshake in 2018, led to interference in the affairs of the entire country of Kenya. He urged politicians to stop making statements that they cannot fulfill and to focus on uniting the country. He also explained that it is important for leaders to work together, peacefully and with clear goals.

Nigo bakongakana Ksh. 1.7 millioni kera omotienyi. Igo bado tibaramenta chialawensi. Inwe timwancheti omonene bwa amachiko aino. english: These are their stories: Petronillah Ogoti, Mwanyagetinge.com Long ago, years and years ago, Mansamu and Ogasusu had a very big problem. Because of this, they searched for solutions to their problems, and finally they found some peace. With this peace, they found it with their mothers, and then they lived happily. When they asked their mothers, Mansamu and Ogasusu were told a strange story, a very strange story. It was surprising, Mansamu said, “What kind of story is this, and what does this story mean?” Below, Mansamu listened carefully to the story they were told. That day the weather was very good, and everything looked beautiful. After that, the pot began to boil. Ogasusu and Mansamu wanted something, like the contents of the pot. But Mansamu took a closer look at what was happening, so people wouldn't blame the pot. They gathered their friends and relatives together, to help them with their work. Ogasusu told Mansamu that she would finish the work. However, despite this, Ogasusu went ahead and did things her own way, and put the leftovers aside. When it was time to leave, they asked their mothers, and Ogasusu refused to tell them the secrets of the things they knew, saying they should stop bothering her with those matters! But they insisted on asking their friends and kept searching. When they met, they told each other different stories. But again Ogasusu just continued to be stubborn!! They went back to their homes, and remembered the strange story. Quickly, when the story ended, Mansamu grabbed his belongings and ran towards Ogasusu who was still being stubborn, rushing home so they could remember the story!! But Mansamu realized something, which Ogasusu noticed and refused to share. After that, Ogasusu and Mansamu became very close. This is a true story, a story from the heart, a story about kindness. Thank you very much and thank you for listening.

Kisii Municipal Council Deputy Mayor Patrick Aming'a Siro lost his seat rituko ria igoro. Kisii Resident Magistrate Njeri Thuku nigo arwete obogambi inga Siro taakeretwe kura buya na kobua korwa Nyaura Ward. Kisii Resident Magistrate Thuku nigo arwete obogambi obwo ase ekina kiabegetwe ase ekoti no omokansora omokoro, omosike Charles Ombuna. Kansora Ombuna nigo agoteba inga amagoso narenge aroro ase chikura chio omwaka o 2007, echio chiagerete omosike Patrick Siro akaba omobui. Resident Judge Njeri Thuku nigo atebete inga "chikura chia Nyaura Ward tichiarenge free and fair. Igo natebire inga chikura chiaakwe naende korwa Nyaura Ward". Komenta nayio, nigo Magistrate Njeri atebete inga goika The Interim Independent Electoral Commission (IIEC) ebe responsible ase ogoakia chikura chinyia. Nonya nabo igo, Siro amo na IIEC lawyer omosike Onchari Otiso nigo batebete inga imbache babeke e appeal. "Goika to appeal ase obogambi obo bwarurwe ekiagera tibori obwe ekeene". Nabo Siro atebetie abariki abwo isiko ye Ekoti. Nonya Siro otebete inga taetwe ribaga goteba his side of the story, Magistrate Thuku nigo atebete inga Siro did not file anything. No court briefs, did not call witnesses, naende inga ekeene nigo keratoke through probability eyio egocha koba possible through another election. Ombuna amo na abasaidi baye nigo bagoteba inga nigo baagete chikura ase Boronyi Ward. Nigo Ombuna atebete inga tiyare konyarekana baakere ekura ase Nyaura Ward ekiagera option eyio tiyarenge on the ballot paper. Ase application yaye gochia se Ekoti, Ombuna nigo atebete inga abaaki chiukura ba Nyaura Ward were denied a chance to vote ase engencho ye mix-up ya polling stations. Ombuna nigo agoteba inga amagoso nigo akoretwe na now defunct Electoral Commission of Kenya. Okorusigwa ekerogo gwa Siro as e deputy mayor nigo kore e big blow ase Kisii Mayor Sam Nyangeso ekiagera abwo babere nigo bare abasani abanene sana.
english: To Joshua Araka: Gusii.com, Kisii Town. Esagati (October) 23, 2010. These are the news: Kisii Town. Gusii.com photo file. Kisii Municipal Council Deputy Mayor Patrick Aming'a Siro lost his seat due to an election petition. Kisii Resident Magistrate Njeri Thuku ruled that the petition was valid because Siro was accused of bribery and influencing voters in Nyaura Ward. Kisii Resident Magistrate Thuku ruled that the case was strong enough because there were witnesses, including Charles Ombuna. Witness Ombuna testified that there were irregularities during the 2007 elections, which led to Patrick Siro being elected. Resident Judge Njeri Thuku stated that “the Nyaura Ward election was free and fair. She added that the election results for Nyaura Ward were accurate.” In addition, Magistrate Njeri stated that she would hold The Interim Independent Electoral Commission (IIEC) responsible for conducting future elections. However, Siro and IIEC lawyer Charles Otiso stated that they would appeal. "We will appeal so that this decision can be reviewed by a higher court." Siro also said he would consult with his lawyers. Siro stated that he was not given a chance to tell his side of the story, Magistrate Thuku stated that Siro did not submit anything. No court documents, did not call witnesses, and that the truth could only be determined through another election. Ombuna and his supporters claimed that they had won the election in Boronyi Ward. Ombuna stated that he wanted to show them how they voted in Nyaura Ward, but that option was not available on the ballot paper. In his application to the High Court, Ombuna stated that residents of Nyaura Ward were denied a chance to vote due to confusion at the polling stations. Ombuna testified that the irregularities occurred under the now-defunct Electoral Commission of Kenya. The removal of Siro as deputy mayor was a major setback for Kisii Mayor Sam Nyangeso, who said they had lost a very important ally.

english: The jackfruit family includes trees from the fig family (Moraceae, specifically the mulberry tree). It originates from Asia and especially the Pacific islands. Jackfruit trees grow well in tropical climates. The breadfruit tree is closely related to Artocarpus altilis. Artocarpus integer (Cempedak), Artocarpus heterophyllus (Jackfruit, Nangka), and also Artocarpus odoratissimus (Marang) all belong to the jackfruit family. This information comes from the Marang (Artocarpus odoratissimus) fruit. It grows mainly in the mountains of Borneo, Indonesia. Currently, it is also cultivated in various parts of Malaysia, Thailand, Tarap, Terap, and Khanun Sampalor. This tree is common in those areas. Furthermore, it originates from forests at altitudes between 1000 meters above sea level. The Marang tree can reach heights of up to 25 meters; its leaves range from 16 to 50 centimeters wide and 11 to 28 centimeters long. It bears fruit throughout the year, producing abundant fruits. The fruit of this tree is oval, measuring 16 centimeters wide and 13 centimeters long, with a rough skin that turns yellow when ripe and is easily damaged. The seeds inside are large and numerous. Breadfruit has been a staple food for Asian people for centuries. Its origin is unknown. Although the fruit is small, it is very nutritious, containing many vitamins (like Durian, another nutritious fruit with a strong smell). The unique aroma of the Marang fruit (Artocarpus odoratissimus) attracts attention. The scent is strongest when the fruit is ripe. Therefore, ripe fruit should be planted in open areas so the fragrance doesn't become overwhelming. Many birds and animals also enjoy eating it. The jackfruit tree requires significant space to grow. In tropical regions, it can reach an altitude of 7 degrees latitude. Both in the tropics and subtropics, this tree is often grown on hillsides, allowing its extensive roots to spread. ekegusii: Welwitscha (Welwitscha mirabilis) nigo kere ekemeri kiamete amatuko amatang’ani amwanyabanto, egekwama ase asinine ase ekengeka ki’enyancha ime ya Namibia na Angola ya maate. Welwitschia maene nigo ore omote korende tori kororekana boigo ekero okororekana ritang’ani. Ekemeri ekegima nigo kebwate ritina erimo rinene ribwate amato abere amanene akwama-aya akororekana buna ebisicha ebinene bieringete bikaba ebigare. Welwitschia ndire ekororekana buna egetunwa ki’eubi. Ekemeri eke nigo botambe kere ase engaki y’okomera (nonyen’enkaki y, obotobu) – eyio etari gokoreka mono ase ebimeri. Welwitschia n’ekemeri getari koibora gioka, igo ebimeri bibere (egesacha n’egekungu) mbiganeiri korosia entetere. Ebisicha nigo bire buna chichuba (buna biri bie chipaini gose chisikadi)bire gati gati y’amato. Chikoni chinsubati echikwerusekani ekero chiakinire korusia chinteretere chiabo chire chingusu, echio chigosiaru bwango n’embeo. Nigo chigotoka ase ekemeri egekoro gia Gnetophyta ebi bire oboiribwang’e ne chikonifa chikorokwa (Pinophyta). Gnetophyta ebwate ebisaku bitato ebing’ao ekero okorigereri okororekana kwabo: Gnetum lianas ebwate amato amororo, Ephedra – ebwate amagwa amona Welwitschia enyene. Welwitscha nigo yanyorete erieta riaye korwa ase omonyamete korwa Slovenia okorokwa Friedeich Welwitscha oomwaka o 1860. Welwitschia nkwama ere ase ebendera ya Namibia. Welwitscha nabo ekoigwana bwango n’ase are aomo mono.Tari buna nigo etegemeete embura mono naende nabo ekonyoraamache aisaine korwa ase amare agocha korwa nyancha. Aya n’amang’ana atakeire oinyore ekero okoyosimeka omote o Welwitschia. Esababu enene omote oyo o Welwitschia otari kwama buya n’ekero aobekeire amache amange egereogunda. Igo netakeire chintetere chiasimekea ase omochanga (wchinyeke chibe chimirimita 2–5 ase obogare) ekiagwera amarabaakogacha amache egeka gtari maya ase ogokinna kwaye. Netakeire Welwitschia eumoreru amache n’okorenda okonene gose ebekerwe omoika. Chintetere echikomera ase echuma eyemo. Nabo naende chirasimekwe chibekwe ase etirisa igoro chirigererie maate. Ekero ogosimeka Welwitscha, goika obe omoremereria mono ekiagera ekemeri eke nigo gekwama ng’ora mono nigo ere e dainosa ase ogokwana ekeene. Eise koegwa oborabu obonge moono amo n’amache amange, kemer eke ngekwama gekaokwe ogetige.
english: Welwitschia (Welwitschia mirabilis) is a unique plant found in the deserts of Namibia and Angola in Africa. Welwitschia itself is very strange because it only has two leaves throughout its life. The plant grows slowly and lives for a very long time, with some specimens living for over a thousand years, appearing like large, old piles. Welwitschia is a plant that survives through fog. The plant also has a strong stem (like a trunk, woody) - which does not branch like other plants. Welwitschia is a plant that grows from the ground, with its roots (deep and shallow) spreading widely to absorb moisture. The leaves are always green (even when they are old) and have many small ridges on them. This unusual plant can survive extreme heat and drought, and it stores water in its stem and roots. It belongs to the group of plants called Gnetophyta which are related to conifers (Pinophyta). Gnetophyta has three families with similar characteristics: Gnetum vines with shiny leaves, Ephedra - with branches resembling Welwitschia's stems. Welwitschia is named after the Austrian botanist Friedrich Welwitsch who discovered it in 1860. Welwitschia is also a symbol of Namibia. Welwitschia also tolerates harsh conditions and is able to live. It needs little rain but also endures strong winds from the ocean. These adaptations allow it to survive in the harsh environment of Welwitschia. A major reason this plant doesn't die is because it has deep roots that reach underground. Its roots spread wide (sometimes up to 2–5 meters wide) absorbing moisture from the soil. It takes Welwitschia a long time to grow and develop, but once established it becomes very strong. The root system is strong and helps support the plant. Also, it continues to grow slowly and remains stable for many years. To survive, Welwitschia relies heavily on fog, which provides moisture to the plant, even though it lives in a dry area. This plant is truly remarkable and shows how plants can adapt to survive in difficult environments.

Obwango obwo, ebimoni ebi bikang'ea korwanerera obooro obo, na goitana enyameni, kera ekemo kegoteba nakio kiaroche obooro obwo ritang'ani. Ebimoni ebi bikaba bikorwanerera endagera eye ase egeka getari geke, egaikera ase bikoigwana, kobagana obooro obo gati gati. Nonya nabo igo, bigasinywa kobagana gati gati. Ogakondo oyio ogwesigori gocha Abwo omote igoro Ogakondo natengerete ebimoni ebi buna biare gosumbuana igoro y' obooro obo. Ogakondo oyo agaakera obooro obo esabu, abobeke mboto bwensi. Bono Ogakondo agaika korwa omote igoro na gwesigoria gochia ase ebimoni ebi biare korwanerera endagera. Ogakondo agaika ase ebimoni ebi ogoteba buna "Abasani bane, naki ninyare kobakonya emechando eye mobwate?" Ekemoni ekemo kegaitaberia kegoba buna "Eee gaki kabe omogayani oito erinde otobagere obooro obo gatigati" Kai tata! Yaa Ogakondo otagotigera abwo? Okamoni nkoboria are, kagendererete goitera chindende. Bono koigwa iga, Ogakondo agasasoka na kobutora obooro obo, korende ensemo eyemo, akaunera eyende tibwabutoka gati gati! Aaiga nario Ogakondo atebete buna koboreng'ania, nere buya arome boria bonga bonene, erinde boreng'anane! Bono Ogakondo osasokire, na gochaka gotiachora obooro Ogakondo akaroma boria bonga bonene korende tibwareng'ana ekiagera aromete obonene mono! Bono bogakea mono. Nario erio naende Ogakondo atebete buna koreng'anania, nere buya arome boria bonde botigarete erinde kera ekemoni keire obooro borengaine. Korwa abwo, Ogakondo agatiachora obooro obonene kerage, goikera bokaamba koera. Kai! Ebimoni bikarora obooro bogasaine gokea kera engaki Ogakondo akoboroma ensemo eyemo, gose nereng'ane eyende. Kai! Ogakondo okwerekereire gotiachora obooro bwensi pi! Ogakondo agakwerekerera koroma ensemo yatigarete, obooro bokaera. Aaiga nario Ogakondo aimogete na gosaba ebimoni ebi okwabera, ogoteba buna "Gaki nyabere, nigo yabeire akong'u koreng'anania obooro obo erinde kera oyomo aire boreng'aine" Agacharoka agasoa omote igoro, ebimoni bigatigara biichanete.
english: These are their words: Long ago, spirits lived amongst people. These spirits were very clever, they started a war, causing great suffering. Quickly, these spirits began to destroy homes and property, leaving people destitute and helpless. These spirits also troubled dreams. The spirits who lived would seek out homes, entering through doorways and windows. Because of this, the spirits would fight over those homes, and gather in dreams, where everything seemed possible and the home appeared beautiful. The spirits would compete fiercely, each trying to surpass the others, vying for those homes constantly. However, they also had a purpose, being sent to compete constantly. This tradition is important. Long ago, the ancestors discovered that spirits often gathered around homes. This tradition helped protect homes from harm, keeping them safe from evil. These ancestors devised a way to prevent spirits from competing destructively. This tradition asks the spirits whether “Are you satisfied, or will you continue to cause trouble?” A spirit might respond, “Yes, we are happy if you allow us to share those homes peacefully.” Oh my father! Didn't the ancestor understand that? A dream is fleeting, so let us strive for peace. And now, the ancestor has returned and taken those homes, destroying everything, leaving nothing intact! He has also declared that he will continue to cause chaos, bringing about immense destruction, ensuring no one can rebuild. But the ancestor did not succeed, and instead caused more problems. The ancestor brought about immense destruction, leaving nothing untouched, completely ruining everything! But it was all in vain. Now, even today, the ancestor continues to cause chaos, bringing about immense hardship, preventing anyone from repairing what was broken. Through this, the ancestor has destroyed countless homes, causing widespread devastation. Oh! Spirits destroy homes, leading to the collapse of the entire community. Oh! The ancestor’s actions have caused immense problems indeed! The ancestor tried to rebuild what was destroyed, restoring the homes. He also promised to help the spirits find peace, saying, “Let me assist you, so that you may live together peacefully and restore what has been lost.” He then went back to his home, and the spirits gathered, rejoicing.
